verses.z: 亞當[生]塞特；塞特[生]以挪士；
verses.e: Adam , Seth , Enosh ,

verses.z: 古實生寧錄；他為世上英雄之首。
verses.e: Cush became the father of Nimrod . He began to be a mighty one in the earth .

verses.z: 麥西生路低人、亞拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.e: Mizraim became the father of Ludim , Anamim , Lehabim , Naphtuhim ,

verses.z: 帕斯魯細人、迦斯路希人、迦斐託人；從迦斐託出來的有非利士人。
verses.e: Pathrusim , Casluhim ( where the Philistines came from ) , and Caphtorim .

verses.z: 迦南生長子西頓，又生赫
verses.e: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn , Heth ,

verses.z: 和耶布斯人、亞摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.e: the Jebusite , the Amorite , the Girgashite ,

verses.z: 希未人、亞基人、西尼人、
verses.e: the Hivite , the Arkite , the Sinite ,

verses.z: 亞瓦底人、洗瑪利人，並哈馬人。
verses.e: the Arvadite , the Zemarite , and the Hamathite .

verses.z: 閃的兒子是以攔、亞述、亞法撒、路德、亞蘭、烏斯、戶勒、基帖、米設。
verses.e: The sons of Shem : Elam , Asshur , Arpachshad , Lud , Aram , Uz , Hul , Gether , and Meshech .

verses.z: 亞法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
verses.e: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah , and Shelah became the father of Eber .

verses.z: 希伯生了兩個兒子：一個名叫法勒，因為那時人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫約坍。
verses.e: To Eber were born two sons : the name of the one was Peleg , for in his days the earth was divided ; and his brother's name was Joktan .

verses.z: 以挪士[生]該南；該南[生]瑪勒列；瑪勒列[生]雅列；
verses.e: Kenan , Mahalalel , Jared ,

verses.z: 約坍生亞摩答、沙列、哈薩瑪非、耶拉、
verses.e: Joktan became the father of Almodad , Sheleph , Hazarmaveth , Jerah ,

verses.z: 哈多蘭、烏薩、德拉、
verses.e: Hadoram , Uzal , Diklah ,

verses.z: 以巴錄、亞比瑪利、示巴、
verses.e: Ebal , Abimael , Sheba ,

verses.z: 阿斐、哈腓拉、約巴。這都是約坍的兒子。
verses.e: Ophir , Havilah , and Jobab . All these were the sons of Joktan .

verses.z: 閃[生]亞法撒；亞法撒[生]沙拉；
verses.e: Shem , Arpachshad , Shelah ,

verses.z: 沙拉[生]希伯；希伯[生]法勒；法勒[生]拉吳；
verses.e: Eber , Peleg , Reu ,

verses.z: 拉吳[生]西鹿；西鹿[生]拿鶴；拿鶴[生]他拉；
verses.e: Serug , Nahor , Terah ,

verses.z: 他拉[生]亞伯蘭，亞伯蘭就是亞伯拉罕。
verses.e: Abram ( also called Abraham ) .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕的兒子是以撒、以實瑪利。
verses.e: The sons of Abraham : Isaac and Ishmael .

verses.z: 以實瑪利的兒子記在下面：以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，其次是基達、押德別、米比衫、
verses.e: These are their generations : the firstborn of Ishmael , Nebaioth ; then Kedar , Adbeel , Mibsam ,

verses.z: 雅列[生]以諾；以諾[生]瑪土撒拉；瑪土撒拉[生]拉麥；
verses.e: Enoch , Methuselah , Lamech ,

verses.z: 米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、哈達、提瑪、
verses.e: Mishma , Dumah , Massa , Hadad , Tema ,

verses.z: 伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。這都是以實瑪利的兒子。
verses.e: Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah . These are the sons of Ishmael .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的兒子，就是心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、書亞。約珊的兒子是示巴、底但。
verses.e: The sons of Keturah , Abraham's concubine : she bore Zimran , Jokshan , Medan , Midian , Ishbak , and Shuah . The sons of Jokshan : Sheba and Dedan .

verses.z: 米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大、以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
verses.e: The sons of Midian : Ephah , Epher , Hanoch , Abida , and Eldaah . All these were the sons of Keturah .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒的兒子是以掃和以色列。
verses.e: Abraham became the father of Isaac . The sons of Isaac : Esau and Israel .

verses.z: 以掃的兒子是以利法、流珥、耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。
verses.e: The sons of Esau : Eliphaz , Reuel , Jeush , Jalam , and Korah .

verses.z: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯、亭納、亞瑪力。
verses.e: The sons of Eliphaz : Teman , Omar , Zephi , Gatam , Kenaz , Timna , and Amalek .

verses.z: 流珥的兒子是拿哈、謝拉、沙瑪、米撒。
verses.e: The sons of Reuel : Nahath , Zerah , Shammah , and Mizzah .

verses.z: 西珥的兒子是羅坍、朔巴、祭便、亞拿、底順、以察、底珊。
verses.e: The sons of Seir : Lotan , Shobal , Zibeon , Anah , Dishon , Ezer , and Dishan .

verses.z: 羅坍的兒子是何利、荷幔；羅坍的妹子是亭納。
verses.e: The sons of Lotan : Hori and Homam ; and Timna was Lotan's sister .

verses.z: 拉麥[生]挪亞；挪亞[生]閃、含、雅弗。
verses.e: Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth .

verses.z: 朔巴的兒子是亞勒文、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示非、阿南。祭便的兒子是亞雅、亞拿。
verses.e: The sons of Shobal : Alian , Manahath , Ebal , Shephi , and Onam . The sons of Zibeon : Aiah and Anah .

verses.z: 亞拿的兒子是底順。底順的兒子是哈默蘭、伊是班、益蘭、基蘭。
verses.e: The son of Anah : Dishon . The sons of Dishon : Hamran , Eshban , Ithran , and Cheran .

verses.z: 以察的兒子是辟罕、撒番、亞干。底珊的兒子是烏斯、亞蘭。
verses.e: The sons of Ezer : Bilhan , Zaavan , and Jaakan . The sons of Dishan : Uz and Aran .

verses.z: 以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以東地作王的記在下面：有比珥的兒子比拉，他的[京]城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.e: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom , before any king reigned over the children of Israel : Bela the son of Beor ; and the name of his city was Dinhabah .

verses.z: 比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接續他作王。
verses.e: Bela died , and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place .

verses.z: 約巴死了，提幔地的人戶珊接續他作王。
verses.e: Jobab died , and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place .

verses.z: 戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接續他作王。這哈達就是在摩押地殺敗米甸人的，他的[京]城名叫亞未得。
verses.e: Husham died , and Hadad the son of Bedad , who struck Midian in the field of Moab , reigned in his place ; and the name of his city was Avith .

verses.z: 哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接續他作王。
verses.e: Hadad died , and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place .

verses.z: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接續他作王。
verses.e: Samlah died , and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place .

verses.z: 掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒‧哈南接續他作王。
verses.e: Shaul died , and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place .

verses.z: 雅弗的兒子是歌篾、瑪各、瑪代、雅完、土巴、米設、提拉。
verses.e: The sons of Japheth : Gomer , Magog , Madai , Javan , Tubal , Meshech , and Tiras .

verses.z: 巴勒‧哈南死了，哈達接續他作王。他的[京]城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希她別，是米‧薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
verses.e: Baal Hanan died , and Hadad reigned in his place ; and the name of his city was Pai . His wife's name was Mehetabel , the daughter of Matred , the daughter of Mezahab .

verses.z: 哈達死了，以東人的族長有亭納族長、亞勒瓦族長、耶帖族長、
verses.e: Then Hadad died . The chiefs of Edom were : chief Timna , chief Aliah , chief Jetheth ,

verses.z: 亞何利巴瑪族長、以拉族長、比嫩族長、
verses.e: chief Oholibamah , chief Elah , chief Pinon ,

verses.z: 基納斯族長、提幔族長、米比薩族長、
verses.e: chief Kenaz , chief Teman , chief Mibzar ,

verses.z: 瑪基疊族長、以蘭族長。這都是以東人的族長。
verses.e: chief Magdiel , and chief Iram . These are the chiefs of Edom .

verses.z: 歌篾的兒子是亞實基拿、低法、陀迦瑪。
verses.e: The sons of Gomer : Ashkenaz , Diphath , and Togarmah .

verses.z: 雅完的兒子是以利沙、他施、基提、多單。
verses.e: The sons of Javan : Elishah , Tarshish , Kittim , and Rodanim .

verses.z: 含的兒子是古實、麥西、弗、迦南。
verses.e: The sons of Ham : Cush , Mizraim , Put , and Canaan .

verses.z: 古實的兒子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉瑪、撒弗提迦。拉瑪的兒子是示巴、底但。
verses.e: The sons of Cush : Seba , Havilah , Sabta , Raama , Sabteca . The sons of Raamah : Sheba and Dedan .

verses.z: 非利士人與以色列人爭戰，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山有被殺仆倒的。
verses.e: Now the Philistines fought against Israel ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa .

verses.z: 又將掃羅的軍裝放在他們神的廟裏，將他的首級釘在大袞廟中。
verses.e: They put his armor in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the house of Dagon .

verses.z: 基列‧雅比人聽見非利士人向掃羅所行的一切事，
verses.e: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul ,

verses.z: 他們中間所有的勇士就起身前去，將掃羅和他兒子的屍身送到雅比，將他們的屍骨葬在雅比的橡樹下，就禁食七日。
verses.e: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons , and brought them to Jabesh , and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .

verses.z: 這樣，掃羅死了。因為他干犯耶和華，沒有遵守耶和華的命；又因他求問交鬼的婦人，
verses.e: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD , because of the LORD's word , which he didn't keep , and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit , to inquire ,

verses.z: 沒有求問耶和華，所以耶和華使他被殺，把國歸於耶西的兒子大衛。
verses.e: and didn't inquire of the LORD . Therefore he killed him , and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse .

verses.z: 非利士人緊追掃羅和他兒子們，就殺了掃羅的兒子約拿單、亞比拿達、麥基舒亞。
verses.e: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons ; and the Philistines killed Jonathan , Abinadab , and Malchishua , the sons of Saul .

verses.z: 勢派甚大，掃羅被弓箭手追上，射傷甚重，
verses.e: The battle went hard against Saul , and the archers overtook him ; and he was distressed by reason of the archers .

verses.z: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人說：「你拔出刀來，將我刺死，免得那些未受割禮的人來凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚懼怕，不肯刺他；
verses.e: Then Saul said to his armor bearer , " Draw your sword , and thrust me through with it , lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me . " But his armor bearer would not , for he was terrified . Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it .

verses.z: 掃羅就自己伏在刀上死了。拿兵器的人見掃羅已死，也伏在刀上死了。
verses.e: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead , he likewise fell on his sword and died .

verses.z: 這樣，掃羅和他三個兒子，並他的全家都一同死亡。
verses.e: So Saul died with his three sons ; and all his house died together .

verses.z: 住平原的以色列眾人見以色列軍兵逃跑，掃羅和他兒子都死了，也就棄城逃跑，非利士人便來住在其中。
verses.e: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , they abandoned their cities , and fled ; and the Philistines came and lived in them .

verses.z: 次日，非利士人來剝那被殺之人的衣服，看見掃羅和他兒子仆倒在基利波山，
verses.e: On the next day , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa .

verses.z: 就剝了他的軍裝，割下他的首級，打發人到非利士地的四境報信與他們的偶像和眾民，
verses.e: They stripped him and took his head and his armor , then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people .

verses.z: 以色列眾人聚集到希伯崙見大衛，說：「我們原是你的骨肉。
verses.e: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron , saying , " Behold , we are your bone and your flesh .

verses.z: 以下記錄跟隨大衛勇士的首領，就是奮勇幫助他得國、照着耶和華吩咐以色列人的話、與以色列人一同立他作王的。
verses.e: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had , who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom , together with all Israel , to make him king , according to the LORD's word concerning Israel .

verses.z: 大衛勇士的數目記在下面：哈革摩尼的兒子雅朔班，他是軍長的統領，一時舉槍殺了三百人。
verses.e: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had : Jashobeam , the son of a Hachmonite , the chief of the thirty ; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time .

verses.z: 其次是亞合人朵多的兒子以利亞撒，他是三個勇士裏的一個。
verses.e: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo , the Ahohite , who was one of the three mighty men .

verses.z: 他從前與大衛在巴斯‧達閔，非利士人聚集要打仗。那裏有一塊長滿大麥的田，眾民就在非利士人面前逃跑；
verses.e: He was with David at Pasdammim , and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle , where there was a plot of ground full of barley ; and the people fled from before the Philistines .

verses.z: 這勇士便站在那田間擊殺非利士人，救護了那田。耶和華使以色列人大獲全勝。
verses.e: They stood in the middle of the plot , defended it , and killed the Philistines ; and the LORD saved them by a great victory .

verses.z: 三十個勇士中的三個人下到磐石那裏，進了亞杜蘭洞見大衛；非利士的軍隊在利乏音谷安營。
verses.e: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David , into the cave of Adullam ; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim .

verses.z: 那時大衛在山寨，非利士人的防營在伯利恆。
verses.e: David was then in the stronghold , and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time .

verses.z: 大衛渴想，說：「甚願有人將伯利恆城門旁井裏的水打來給我喝！」
verses.e: David longed , and said , " Oh , that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem , which is by the gate ! "

verses.z: 這三個勇士就闖過非利士人的營盤，從伯利恆城門旁的井裏打水，拿來奉給大衛。他卻不肯喝，將水奠在耶和華面前，
verses.e: The three broke through the army of the Philistines , and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate , took it , and brought it to David ; but David would not drink any of it , but poured it out to the LORD ,

verses.z: 說：「我的上帝啊，這三個人冒死去打水，這水好像他們的血一般，我斷不敢喝！」如此，大衛不肯喝。這是三個勇士所做的事。
verses.e: and said , " My God forbid me , that I should do this ! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy ? " For they risked their lives to bring it . Therefore he would not drink it . The three mighty men did these things .

verses.z: 從前掃羅作王的時候，率領以色列人出入的是你；耶和華－你的上帝也曾應許你說：『你必牧養我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
verses.e: In times past , even when Saul was king , it was you who led out and brought in Israel . The LORD your God said to you , ' You shall be shepherd of my people Israel , and you shall be prince over my people Israel . ' "

verses.z: 約押的兄弟亞比篩是這三個勇士的首領；他舉槍殺了三百人，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
verses.e: Abishai , the brother of Joab , was chief of the three ; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them , and had a name among the three .

verses.z: 他在這三個勇士裏是最尊貴的，所以作他們的首領；只是不及前三個勇士。
verses.e: Of the three , he was more honorable than the two , and was made their captain ; however he wasn't included in the three .

verses.z: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅行過大能的事：他殺了摩押人亞利伊勒的兩個[兒子]，又在下雪的時候下坑裏去殺了一個獅子，
verses.e: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel , who had done mighty deeds , killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab . He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day .

verses.z: 又殺了一個埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手裏拿着槍，槍桿粗如織布的機軸；比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，從埃及人手裏奪過槍來，用那槍將他刺死。
verses.e: He killed an Egyptian , a man of great stature , five cubits high . In the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam ; and he went down to him with a staff , plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand , and killed him with his own spear .

verses.z: 這是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅所行的事，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
verses.e: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men .

verses.z: 他比那三十個勇士都尊貴，只是不及前三個勇士。大衛立他作護衛長。
verses.e: Behold , he was more honorable than the thirty , but he didn't attain to the three ; and David set him over his guard .

verses.z: 軍中的勇士有約押的兄弟亞撒黑，伯利恆人朵多的兒子伊勒哈難，
verses.e: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab , Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem ,

verses.z: 哈律人沙瑪，比倫人希利斯，
verses.e: Shammoth the Harorite , Helez the Pelonite ,

verses.z: 提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉，亞拿突人亞比以謝，
verses.e: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite , Abiezer the Anathothite ,

verses.z: 戶沙人西比該，亞合人以來，
verses.e: Sibbecai the Hushathite , Ilai the Ahohite ,

verses.z: 於是以色列的長老都來到希伯崙見大衛王。大衛在希伯崙耶和華面前與他們立約，他們就膏大衛作以色列的王，是照耶和華藉撒母耳所說的話。
verses.e: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron ; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD . They anointed David king over Israel , according to the LORD's word by Samuel .

verses.z: 尼陀法人瑪哈萊，尼陀法人巴拿的兒子希立，
verses.e: Maharai the Netophathite , Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite ,

verses.z: 便雅憫族基比亞人利拜的兒子以太，比拉頓人比拿雅，
verses.e: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin , Benaiah the Pirathonite ,

verses.z: 迦實溪人戶萊，亞拉巴人亞比，
verses.e: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash , Abiel the Arbathite ,

verses.z: 巴路米人押斯瑪弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，
verses.e: Azmaveth the Baharumite , Eliahba the Shaalbonite ,

verses.z: 基孫人哈深的眾子，哈拉人沙基的兒子約拿單，
verses.e: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite , Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite ,

verses.z: 哈拉人沙甲的兒子亞希暗，吾珥的兒子以利法勒，
verses.e: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite , Eliphal the son of Ur ,

verses.z: 米基拉人希弗，比倫人亞希雅，
verses.e: Hepher the Mecherathite , Ahijah the Pelonite ,

verses.z: 迦密人希斯羅，伊斯拜的兒子拿萊，
verses.e: Hezro the Carmelite , Naarai the son of Ezbai ,

verses.z: 拿單的兄弟約珥，哈基利的兒子彌伯哈，
verses.e: Joel the brother of Nathan , Mibhar the son of Hagri ,

verses.z: 亞捫人洗勒，比錄人拿哈萊（拿哈萊是給洗魯雅的兒子約押拿兵器的），
verses.e: Zelek the Ammonite , Naharai the Berothite ( the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah ) ,

verses.z: 大衛和以色列眾人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那時耶布斯人住在那裏。
verses.e: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem ( also called Jebus ) ; and the Jebusites , the inhabitants of the land , were there .

verses.z: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
verses.e: Ira the Ithrite , Gareb the Ithrite ,

verses.z: 赫人烏利亞，亞萊的兒子撒拔，
verses.e: Uriah the Hittite , Zabad the son of Ahlai ,

verses.z: 呂便人示撒的兒子亞第拿（他是呂便支派中的一個族長，率領三十人），
verses.e: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite ( a chief of the Reubenites ) , and thirty with him ,

verses.z: 瑪迦的兒子哈難，彌特尼人約沙法，
verses.e: Hanan the son of Maacah , Joshaphat the Mithnite ,

verses.z: 亞施他拉人烏西亞，亞羅珥人何坦的兒子沙瑪、耶利，
verses.e: Uzzia the Ashterathite , Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite ,

verses.z: 提洗人申利的兒子耶疊和他的兄弟約哈，
verses.e: Jediael the son of Shimri , and Joha his brother , the Tizite ,

verses.z: 瑪哈未人以利業，伊利拿安的兒子耶利拜、約沙未雅，摩押人伊特瑪、
verses.e: Eliel the Mahavite , and Jeribai , and Joshaviah , the sons of Elnaam , and Ithmah the Moabite ,

verses.z: 以利業、俄備得，並米瑣八人雅西業。
verses.e: Eliel , Obed , and Jaasiel the Mezobaite .

verses.z: 耶布斯人對大衛說：「你決不能進這地方。」然而大衛攻取錫安的保障，就是大衛的城。
verses.e: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David , " You will not come in here ! " Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion . The same is David's city .

verses.z: 大衛說：「誰先攻打耶布斯人，必作首領元帥。」洗魯雅的兒子約押先上去，就作了元帥。
verses.e: David had said , " Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain . " Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first , and was made chief .

verses.z: 大衛住在保障裏，所以那保障叫作大衛城。
verses.e: David lived in the stronghold ; therefore they called it David's city .

verses.z: 大衛又從米羅起，四圍建築城牆，其餘的是約押修理。
verses.e: He built the city all around , from Millo even around ; and Joab repaired the rest of the city .

verses.z: 大衛日見強盛，因為萬軍之耶和華與他同在。
verses.e: David grew greater and greater , for the LORD of Armies was with him .

verses.z: 大衛因怕基士的兒子掃羅，躲在洗革拉的時候，有勇士到他那裏幫助他打仗。
verses.e: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish . They were among the mighty men , his helpers in war .

verses.z: 第四彌施瑪拿，第五耶利米，
verses.e: Mishmannah the fourth , Jeremiah the fifth ,

verses.z: 第六亞太，第七以利業，
verses.e: Attai the sixth , Eliel the seventh ,

verses.z: 第八約哈難，第九以利薩巴，
verses.e: Johanan the eighth , Elzabad the ninth ,

verses.z: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。
verses.e: Jeremiah the tenth , and Machbannai the eleventh .

verses.z: 這都是迦得人中的軍長，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。
verses.e: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army . He who was least was equal to one hundred , and the greatest to one thousand .

verses.z: 正月，約旦河水漲過兩岸的時候，他們過河，使一切住平原的人東奔西逃。
verses.e: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month , when it had overflowed all its banks ; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys , both toward the east and toward the west .

verses.z: 又有便雅憫和猶大人到山寨大衛那裏。
verses.e: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David .

verses.z: 大衛出去迎接他們，對他們說：「你們若是和和平平地來幫助我，我心就與你們相契；你們若是將我這無罪的人賣在敵人手裏，願我們列祖的上帝察看責罰。」
verses.e: David went out to meet them , and answered them , " If you have come peaceably to me to help me , my heart will be united with you ; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries , since there is no wrong in my hands , may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it . "

verses.z: 那時[上帝]的靈感動那三十個勇士的首領亞瑪撒，[他就說]：大衛啊，我們是歸於你的！耶西的兒子啊，我們是幫助你的！願你平平安安，願幫助你的也都平安！因為你的上帝幫助你。大衛就收留他們，立他們作軍長。
verses.e: Then the Spirit came on Amasai , who was chief of the thirty , and he said , " We are yours , David , and on your side , you son of Jesse . Peace , peace be to you , and peace be to your helpers ; for your God helps you . " Then David received them and made them captains of the band .

verses.z: 大衛從前與非利士人同去，要與掃羅爭戰，有些瑪拿西人來投奔大衛，他們卻沒有幫助非利士人；因為非利士人的首領商議，打發他們回去，說：「恐怕大衛拿我們的首級，歸降他的主人掃羅。」
verses.e: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle , but they didn't help them , for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation , saying , " He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads . "

verses.z: 他們善於拉弓，能用左右兩手甩石射箭，都是便雅憫人掃羅的族弟兄。
verses.e: They were armed with bows , and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow . They were of Saul's relatives of the tribe of Benjamin .

verses.z: 大衛往洗革拉去的時候，有瑪拿西人的千夫長押拿、約撒拔、耶疊、米迦勒、約撒拔、以利戶、洗勒太都來投奔他。
verses.e: As he went to Ziklag , some from Manasseh joined him : Adnah , Jozabad , Jediael , Michael , Jozabad , Elihu , and Zillethai , captains of thousands who were of Manasseh .

verses.z: 這些人幫助大衛攻擊群賊；他們都是大能的勇士，且作軍長。
verses.e: They helped David against the band of raiders , for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army .

verses.z: 那時天天有人來幫助大衛，以致成了大軍，如上帝的軍一樣。
verses.e: For from day to day men came to David to help him , until there was a great army , like God's army .

verses.z: 預備打仗的兵來到希伯崙見大衛，要照着耶和華的話將掃羅的國位歸與大衛。他們的數目如下：
verses.e: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war , who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him , according to the LORD's word .

verses.z: 猶大支派，拿盾牌和槍預備打仗的有六千八百人。
verses.e: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred , armed for war .

verses.z: 西緬支派，能上陣大能的勇士有七千一百人。
verses.e: Of the children of Simeon , mighty men of valor for the war : seven thousand one hundred .

verses.z: 利未支派有四千六百人。
verses.e: Of the children of Levi : four thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 耶何耶大是亞倫[家]的首領，跟從他的有三千七百人。
verses.e: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron ; and with him were three thousand seven hundred ,

verses.z: 還有少年大能的勇士撒督，同着他的有族長二十二人。
verses.e: and Zadok , a young man mighty of valor , and of his father's house twenty-two captains .

verses.z: 便雅憫支派，掃羅的族弟兄也有三千人，他們向來大半歸順掃羅家。
verses.e: Of the children of Benjamin , Saul's relatives : three thousand , for until then , the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul's house .

verses.z: 為首的是亞希以謝，其次是約阿施，都是基比亞人示瑪的兒子。還有亞斯瑪威的兒子耶薛和毗力，又有比拉迦，並亞拿突人耶戶，
verses.e: The chief was Ahiezer , then Joash , the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite ; Jeziel and Pelet , the sons of Azmaveth ; Beracah ; Jehu the Anathothite ;

verses.z: 以法蓮支派大能的勇士，在本族著名的有二萬零八百人。
verses.e: Of the children of Ephraim : twenty thousand eight hundred , mighty men of valor , famous men in their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 瑪拿西半支派，冊上有名的共一萬八千人，都來立大衛作王。
verses.e: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh : eighteen thousand , who were mentioned by name , to come and make David king .

verses.z: 以薩迦支派，有二百族長都通達時務，知道以色列人所當行的；他們族弟兄都聽從他們的命令。
verses.e: Of the children of Issachar , men who had understanding of the times , to know what Israel ought to do , their heads were two hundred ; and all their brothers were at their command .

verses.z: 西布倫支派，能上陣用各樣兵器打仗、行伍整齊、不生二心的有五萬人。
verses.e: Of Zebulun , such as were able to go out in the army , who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war : fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart .

verses.z: 拿弗他利支派，有一千軍長；跟從他們、拿盾牌和槍的有三萬七千人。
verses.e: Of Naphtali : one thousand captains , and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand .

verses.z: 但支派，能擺陣的有二萬八千六百人。
verses.e: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array : twenty-eight thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 亞設支派，能上陣打仗的有四萬人。
verses.e: Of Asher , such as were able to go out in the army , who could set the battle in array : forty thousand .

verses.z: 約旦河東的呂便支派、迦得支派、瑪拿西半支派，拿着各樣兵器打仗的有十二萬人。
verses.e: On the other side of the Jordan , of the Reubenites , the Gadites , and of the half-tribe of Manasseh , with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle : one hundred twenty thousand .

verses.z: 以上都是能守行伍的戰士，他們都誠心來到希伯崙，要立大衛作以色列的王。以色列其餘的人也都一心要立大衛作王。
verses.e: All these were men of war who could order the battle array , and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel ; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king .

verses.z: 他們在那裏三日，與大衛一同吃喝，因為他們的族弟兄給他們預備了。
verses.e: They were there with David three days , eating and drinking ; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them .

verses.z: 基遍人以實買雅（他在三十人中是勇士，管理他們），且有耶利米、雅哈悉、約哈難，和基得拉人約撒拔、
verses.e: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite , a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty ; Jeremiah ; Jahaziel ; Johanan ; Jozabad the Gederathite ;

verses.z: 靠近他們的人以及以薩迦、西布倫、拿弗他利人將許多麵餅、無花果餅、乾葡萄、酒、油，用驢、駱駝、騾子、牛馱來，又帶了許多的牛和羊來，因為以色列人甚是歡樂。
verses.e: Moreover those who were near to them , as far as Issachar , Zebulun , and Naphtali , brought bread on donkeys , on camels , on mules , and on oxen : supplies of flour , cakes of figs , clusters of raisins , wine , oil , cattle , and sheep in abundance ; for there was joy in Israel .

verses.z: 伊利烏賽、耶利摩、比亞利雅、示瑪利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，
verses.e: Eluzai ; Jerimoth ; Bealiah ; Shemariah ; Shephatiah the Haruphite ;

verses.z: 可拉人以利加拿、耶西亞、亞薩列、約以謝、雅朔班，
verses.e: Elkanah , Isshiah , Azarel , Joezer , and Jashobeam , the Korahites ;

verses.z: 基多人耶羅罕的兒子猶拉和西巴第雅。
verses.e: and Joelah and Zebadiah , the sons of Jeroham of Gedor .

verses.z: 迦得支派中有人到曠野的山寨投奔大衛，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和槍的戰士。他們的面貌好像獅子，快跑如同山上的鹿。
verses.e: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness , mighty men of valor , men trained for war , who could handle shield and spear ; whose faces were like the faces of lions , and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains :

verses.z: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，
verses.e: Ezer the chief , Obadiah the second , Eliab the third ,

verses.z: 大衛與千夫長、百夫長，就是一切首領商議。
verses.e: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds , even with every leader .

verses.z: 耶和華向他發怒，因他伸手扶住[約]櫃擊殺他，他就死在上帝面前。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Uzza , and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark ; and he died there before God .

verses.z: 大衛因耶和華擊殺烏撒，心裏愁煩，就稱那地方為毗列斯‧烏撒，直到今日。
verses.e: David was displeased , because the LORD had broken out against Uzza . He called that place Perez Uzza , to this day .

verses.z: 那日，大衛懼怕上帝，說：「上帝的[約]櫃怎可運到我這裏來？」
verses.e: David was afraid of God that day , saying , " How can I bring God's ark home to me ? "

verses.z: 於是大衛不將[約]櫃運進大衛的城，卻運到迦特人俄別‧以東的家中。
verses.e: So David didn't move the ark with him into David's city , but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite's house .

verses.z: 上帝的[約]櫃在俄別‧以東家中三個月，耶和華賜福給俄別‧以東的家和他一切所有的。
verses.e: God's ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months ; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom's house and all that he had .

verses.z: 大衛對以色列全會眾說：「你們若以為美，見這事是出於耶和華－我們的上帝，我們就差遣人走遍以色列地，見我們未來的弟兄，又見住在有郊野之城的祭司利未人，使他們都到這裏來聚集。
verses.e: David said to all the assembly of Israel , " If it seems good to you , and if it is of the LORD our God , let's send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel , with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands , that they may gather themselves to us .

verses.z: 我們要把上帝的[約]櫃運到我們這裏來；因為在掃羅年間，我們沒有在[約]櫃前求問[上帝]。」
verses.e: Also , let's bring the ark of our God back to us again , for we didn't seek it in the days of Saul . "

verses.z: 全會眾都說可以如此行；這事在眾民眼中都看為好。
verses.e: All the assembly said that they would do so , for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .

verses.z: 於是，大衛將以色列人從埃及的西曷河直到哈馬口都招聚了來，要從基列‧耶琳將上帝的[約]櫃運來。
verses.e: So David assembled all Israel together , from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath , to bring God's ark from Kiriath Jearim .

verses.z: 大衛率領以色列眾人上到巴拉，就是屬猶大的基列‧耶琳，要從那裏將[約]櫃運來。這[約]櫃就是坐在二基路伯上耶和華上帝留名的[約]櫃。
verses.e: David went up with all Israel to Baalah , that is , to Kiriath Jearim , which belonged to Judah , to bring up from there God the LORD's ark that sits above the cherubim , that is called by the Name .

verses.z: 他們將上帝的[約]櫃從亞比拿達的家裏抬出來，放在新車上。烏撒和亞希約趕車。
verses.e: They carried God's ark on a new cart , and brought it out of Abinadab's house ; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart .

verses.z: 大衛和以色列眾人在上帝前用琴、瑟、鑼、鼓、號作樂，極力跳舞歌唱。
verses.e: David and all Israel played before God with all their might , even with songs , with harps , with stringed instruments , with tambourines , with cymbals , and with trumpets .

verses.z: 到了基頓的禾場；因為牛失前蹄，烏撒就伸手扶住[約]櫃。
verses.e: When they came to Chidon's threshing floor , Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark , for the oxen stumbled .

verses.z: 泰爾王希蘭將香柏木運到大衛那裏，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠給大衛建造宮殿。
verses.e: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees , masons , and carpenters , to build him a house .

verses.z: 大衛求問上帝，說：「我可以上去攻打非利士人嗎？你將他們交在我手裏嗎？」耶和華說：「你可以上去，我必將他們交在你手裏。」
verses.e: David inquired of God , saying , " Shall I go up against the Philistines ? Will you deliver them into my hand ? " The LORD said to him , " Go up ; for I will deliver them into your hand . "

verses.z: 非利士人來到巴力‧毗拉心，大衛在那裏殺敗他們。大衛說：「上帝藉我的手沖破敵人，如同水沖去一般」；因此稱那地方為巴力‧毗拉心。
verses.e: So they came up to Baal Perazim , and David defeated them there . David said , God has broken my enemies by my hand , like waters breaking out . Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim .

verses.z: 非利士人將神像撇在那裏，大衛吩咐人用火焚燒了。
verses.e: They left their gods there ; and David gave a command , and they were burned with fire .

verses.z: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。
verses.e: The Philistines made another raid in the valley .

verses.z: 大衛又求問上帝。上帝說：「不要一直地上去，要轉到他們後頭，從桑林對面攻打他們。
verses.e: David inquired again of God ; and God said to him , " You shall not go up after them . Turn away from them , and come on them opposite the mulberry trees .

verses.z: 你聽見桑樹梢上有腳步的聲音，就要出戰，因為上帝已經在你前頭去攻打非利士人的軍隊。」
verses.e: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees , then go out to battle ; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 大衛就遵着上帝所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的軍隊，從基遍直到基色。
verses.e: David did as God commanded him ; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer .

verses.z: 於是大衛的名傳揚到列國，耶和華使列國都懼怕他。
verses.e: The fame of David went out into all lands ; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations .

verses.z: 大衛就知道耶和華堅立他作以色列王，又為自己的民以色列，使他的國興旺。
verses.e: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel , for his kingdom was highly exalted , for his people Israel's sake .

verses.z: 大衛在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生兒女。
verses.e: David took more wives in Jerusalem , and David became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷所生的眾子是沙母亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門、
verses.e: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem : Shammua , Shobab , Nathan , Solomon ,

verses.z: 益轄、以利書亞、以法列、
verses.e: Ibhar , Elishua , Elpelet ,

verses.z: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亞、
verses.e: Nogah , Nepheg , Japhia ,

verses.z: 以利沙瑪、比利雅大、以利法列。
verses.e: Elishama , Beeliada , and Eliphelet .

verses.z: 非利士人聽見大衛受膏作以色列眾人的王，非利士眾人就上來尋索大衛。大衛聽見，就出去迎敵。
verses.e: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel , all the Philistines went up to seek David ; and David heard of it , and went out against them .

verses.z: 非利士人來了，布散在利乏音谷。
verses.e: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim .

verses.z: 大衛在大衛城為自己建造宮殿，又為上帝的[約]櫃預備地方，支搭帳幕。
verses.e: David made himself houses in David's city ; and he prepared a place for God's ark , and pitched a tent for it .

verses.z: 烏薛子孫中有族長亞米拿達和他的弟兄一百一十二人。
verses.e: of the sons of Uzziel , Amminadab the chief , and his brothers one hundred twelve .

verses.z: 大衛將祭司撒督和亞比亞他，並利未人烏列、亞帥雅、約珥、示瑪雅、以列、亞米拿達召來，
verses.e: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests , and for the Levites : for Uriel , Asaiah , Joel , Shemaiah , Eliel , and Amminadab ,

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們是利未人的族長，你們和你們的弟兄應當自潔，好將耶和華－以色列上帝的[約]櫃抬到我所預備的地方。
verses.e: and said to them , " You are the heads of the fathers ' households of the Levites . Sanctify yourselves , both you and your brothers , that you may bring the ark of the LORD , the God of Israel , up to the place that I have prepared for it .

verses.z: 因你們先前沒有[抬這約櫃]，按定例求問耶和華－我們的上帝，所以他刑罰我們。」
verses.e: For because you didn't carry it at first , the LORD our God broke out in anger against us , because we didn't seek him according to the ordinance . "

verses.z: 於是祭司利未人自潔，好將耶和華－以色列上帝的[約]櫃抬上來。
verses.e: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 利未子孫就用槓，肩抬上帝的[約]櫃，是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的。
verses.e: The children of the Levites bore God's ark on their shoulders with its poles , as Moses commanded according to the LORD's word .

verses.z: 大衛吩咐利未人的族長，派他們歌唱的弟兄用琴瑟和鈸作樂，歡歡喜喜地大聲歌頌。
verses.e: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music , stringed instruments , harps , and cymbals , sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy .

verses.z: 於是利未人派約珥的兒子希幔和他弟兄中比利家的兒子亞薩，並他們族弟兄米拉利子孫裏古沙雅的兒子以探。
verses.e: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel ; and of his brothers , Asaph the son of Berechiah ; and of the sons of Merari their brothers , Ethan the son of Kushaiah ;

verses.z: 其次還有他們的弟兄撒迦利雅、便雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、烏尼、以利押、比拿雅、瑪西雅、瑪他提雅、以利斐利戶、彌克尼雅，並守門的俄別‧以東和耶利。
verses.e: and with them their brothers of the second rank : Zechariah , Ben , Jaaziel , Shemiramoth , Jehiel , Unni , Eliab , Benaiah , Maaseiah , Mattithiah , Eliphelehu , Mikneiah , Obed-Edom , and Jeiel , the doorkeepers .

verses.z: 這樣，派歌唱的希幔、亞薩、以探敲銅鈸，大發響聲；
verses.e: So the singers , Heman , Asaph , and Ethan , were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud ;

verses.z: 那時大衛說：「除了利未人之外，無人可抬上帝的[約]櫃；因為耶和華揀選他們抬上帝的[約]櫃，且永遠事奉他。」
verses.e: Then David said , " No one ought to carry God's ark but the Levites . For the LORD has chosen them to carry God's ark , and to minister to him forever . "

verses.z: 派撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、烏尼、以利押、瑪西雅、比拿雅鼓瑟，調用女音；
verses.e: and Zechariah , Aziel , Shemiramoth , Jehiel , Unni , Eliab , Maaseiah , and Benaiah , with stringed instruments set to Alamoth ;

verses.z: 又派瑪他提雅、以利斐利戶、彌克尼雅、俄別‧以東、耶利、亞撒西雅領首彈琴，調用第八。
verses.e: and Mattithiah , Eliphelehu , Mikneiah , Obed-Edom , Jeiel , and Azaziah , with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre , to lead .

verses.z: 利未人的族長基拿尼雅是歌唱人的首領，又教訓人歌唱，因為他精通此事。
verses.e: Chenaniah , chief of the Levites , was over the singing . He taught the singers , because he was skillful .

verses.z: 比利家、以利加拿是[約]櫃前守門的。
verses.e: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark .

verses.z: 祭司示巴尼、約沙法、拿坦業、亞瑪賽、撒迦利雅、比拿亞、以利以謝在上帝的[約]櫃前吹號。俄別‧以東和耶希亞也是[約]櫃前守門的。
verses.e: Shebaniah , Joshaphat , Nethanel , Amasai , Zechariah , Benaiah , and Eliezer , the priests , blew the trumpets before God's ark ; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark .

verses.z: 於是，大衛和以色列的長老，並千夫長都去從俄別‧以東的家歡歡喜喜地將耶和華的約櫃抬上來。
verses.e: So David , the elders of Israel , and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD's covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy .

verses.z: 上帝賜恩與抬耶和華約櫃的利未人，他們就獻上七隻公牛，七隻公羊。
verses.e: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD's covenant , they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams .

verses.z: 大衛和抬[約]櫃的利未人，並歌唱人的首領基拿尼雅，以及歌唱的人，都穿着細麻布的外袍；大衛另外穿着細麻布的以弗得。
verses.e: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen , as were all the Levites who bore the ark , the singers , and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers ; and David had an ephod of linen on him .

verses.z: 這樣，以色列眾人歡呼吹角、吹號、敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，大發響聲，將耶和華的約櫃抬上來。
verses.e: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD's covenant up with shouting , with sound of the cornet , with trumpets , and with cymbals , sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps .

verses.z: 耶和華的約櫃進了大衛城的時候，掃羅的女兒米甲從窗戶裏觀看，見大衛王踴躍跳舞，心裏就輕視他。
verses.e: As the ark of the LORD's covenant came to David's city , Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window , and saw king David dancing and playing ; and she despised him in her heart .

verses.z: 大衛招聚以色列眾人到耶路撒冷，要將耶和華的[約]櫃抬到他所預備的地方。
verses.e: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem , to bring up the LORD's ark to its place , which he had prepared for it .

verses.z: 大衛又聚集亞倫的子孫和利未人。
verses.e: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites :

verses.z: 哥轄子孫中有族長烏列和他的弟兄一百二十人。
verses.e: of the sons of Kohath , Uriel the chief , and his brothers one hundred twenty ;

verses.z: 米拉利子孫中有族長亞帥雅和他的弟兄二百二十人。
verses.e: of the sons of Merari , Asaiah the chief , and his brothers two hundred twenty ;

verses.z: 革順子孫中有族長約珥和他的弟兄一百三十人。
verses.e: of the sons of Gershom , Joel the chief , and his brothers one hundred thirty ;

verses.z: 以利撒反子孫中有族長示瑪雅和他的弟兄二百人。
verses.e: of the sons of Elizaphan , Shemaiah the chief , and his brothers two hundred ;

verses.z: 希伯崙子孫中有族長以列和他的弟兄八十人。
verses.e: of the sons of Hebron , Eliel the chief , and his brothers eighty ;

verses.z: 眾人將上帝的[約]櫃請進去，安放在大衛所搭的帳幕裏，就在上帝面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
verses.e: They brought in God's ark , and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it ; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God .

verses.z: 要以他的聖名誇耀；尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜。
verses.e: Glory in his holy name . Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice .

verses.z: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力，時常尋求他的面。
verses.e: Seek the LORD and his strength . Seek his face forever more .

verses.z: 他僕人以色列的後裔，他所揀選雅各的子孫哪，你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事，並他口中的判語。
verses.e: Remember his marvelous works that he has done , his wonders , and the judgments of his mouth ,
you offspring of Israel his servant , you children of Jacob , his chosen ones .

verses.z: 他是耶和華－我們的上帝，全地都有他的判斷。
verses.e: He is the LORD our God . His judgments are in all the earth .

verses.z: 你們要記念他的約，直到永遠；他所吩咐的話，直到千代，
verses.e: Remember his covenant forever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations ,

verses.z: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的約，向以撒所起的誓。
verses.e: the covenant which he made with Abraham , his oath to Isaac .

verses.z: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例，向以色列定為永遠的約，
verses.e: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant ,

verses.z: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你，作你產業的分。
verses.e: saying , " I will give you the land of Canaan , The lot of your inheritance , "

verses.z: 當時你們人丁有限，數目稀少，並且在那地為寄居的；
verses.e: when you were but a few men in number , yes , very few , and foreigners in it .

verses.z: 大衛獻完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉耶和華的名給民祝福，
verses.e: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the LORD's name .

verses.z: 他們從這邦游到那邦，從這國行到那國。
verses.e: They went about from nation to nation , from one kingdom to another people .

verses.z: 耶和華不容甚麼人欺負他們，為他們的緣故責備君王，
verses.e: He allowed no man to do them wrong . Yes , he reproved kings for their sakes ,

verses.z: 說：不可難為我受膏的人，也不可惡待我的先知！
verses.e: " Don't touch my anointed ones ! Do my prophets no harm ! "

verses.z: 全地都要向耶和華歌唱！天天傳揚他的救恩，
verses.e: Sing to the LORD , all the earth ! Display his salvation from day to day .

verses.z: 在列邦中述說他的榮耀，在萬民中述說他的奇事。
verses.e: Declare his glory among the nations , and his marvelous works among all the peoples .

verses.z: 因耶和華為大，當受極大的讚美；他在萬神之上，當受敬畏。
verses.e: For great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised . He also is to be feared above all gods .

verses.z: 外邦的神都屬虛無，惟獨耶和華創造諸天。
verses.e: For all the gods of the peoples are idols , but the LORD made the heavens .

verses.z: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前，有能力和喜樂在他聖所。
verses.e: Honor and majesty are before him . Strength and gladness are in his place .

verses.z: 民中的萬族啊，你們要將榮耀能力歸給耶和華，都歸給耶和華！
verses.e: Ascribe to the LORD , you families of the peoples , ascribe to the LORD glory and strength !

verses.z: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他，拿供物來奉到他面前；當以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華。
verses.e: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name . Bring an offering , and come before him . Worship the LORD in holy array .

verses.z: 並且分給以色列人，無論男女，每人一個餅，一塊[肉]，一個葡萄餅。
verses.e: He gave to everyone of Israel , both man and woman , to everyone a loaf of bread , a portion of meat , and a cake of raisins .

verses.z: 全地要在他面前顫抖，世界也堅定不得動搖。
verses.e: Tremble before him , all the earth . The world also is established that it can't be moved .

verses.z: 願天歡喜，願地快樂；願人在列邦中說：耶和華作王了！
verses.e: Let the heavens be glad , and let the earth rejoice ! Let them say among the nations , " The LORD reigns ! "

verses.z: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃；願田和其中所有的都歡樂。
verses.e: Let the sea roar , and its fullness ! Let the field exult , and all that is in it !

verses.z: 那時，林中的樹木都要在耶和華面前歡呼，因為他來要審判全地。
verses.e: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD , for he comes to judge the earth .

verses.z: 應當稱謝耶和華；因他本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Oh give thanks to the LORD , for he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 要說：拯救我們的上帝啊，求你救我們，聚集我們，使我們脫離外邦，我們好稱讚你的聖名，以讚美你為誇勝。
verses.e: Say , " Save us , God of our salvation ! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations , to give thanks to your holy name , to triumph in your praise . "

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝，從亙古直到永遠，是應當稱頌的！眾民都說：「阿們！」並且讚美耶和華。
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD , the God of Israel , from everlasting even to everlasting . All the people said , " Amen , " and praised the LORD .

verses.z: 大衛派亞薩和他的弟兄在約櫃前常常事奉耶和華，一日盡一日的職分；
verses.e: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD's covenant , to minister before the ark continually , as every day's work required ;

verses.z: 又派俄別‧以東和他的弟兄六十八人，與耶杜頓的兒子俄別‧以東，並何薩作守門的；
verses.e: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives ; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers ;

verses.z: 且派祭司撒督和他弟兄眾祭司在基遍的邱壇、耶和華的帳幕前燔祭壇上，每日早晚，照着耶和華律法書上所吩咐以色列人的，常給耶和華獻燔祭。
verses.e: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests , before the LORD's tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon ,

verses.z: 大衛派幾個利未人在耶和華的[約]櫃前事奉，頌揚，稱謝，讚美耶和華－以色列的上帝：
verses.e: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD's ark , and to commemorate , to thank , and to praise the LORD , the God of Israel :
to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening , even according to all that is written in the LORD's law , which he commanded to Israel ;

verses.z: 與他們一同被派的有希幔、耶杜頓，和其餘被選名字錄在冊上的，稱謝耶和華，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen , who were mentioned by name , to give thanks to the LORD , because his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 希幔、耶杜頓同着他們吹號、敲鈸，大發響聲，並用別的樂器隨着歌頌上帝。耶杜頓的子孫作守門的。
verses.e: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud , and with instruments for the songs of God , and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate .

verses.z: 於是眾民各歸各家；大衛也回去為家眷祝福。
verses.e: All the people departed , each man to his house ; and David returned to bless his house .

verses.z: 為首的是亞薩，其次是撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、瑪他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄別‧以東、耶利，鼓瑟彈琴；惟有亞薩敲鈸，大發響聲；
verses.e: Asaph the chief , and second to him Zechariah , then Jeiel , Shemiramoth , Jehiel , Mattithiah , Eliab , Benaiah , Obed-Edom , and Jeiel , with stringed instruments and with harps ; and Asaph with cymbals , sounding aloud ;

verses.z: 祭司比拿雅和雅哈悉常在上帝的約櫃前吹號。
verses.e: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually , before the ark of the covenant of God .

verses.z: 那日，大衛初次藉亞薩和他的弟兄以詩歌稱頌耶和華，[說]：
verses.e: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers .

verses.z: 你們要稱謝耶和華，求告他的名，在萬民中傳揚他的作為！
verses.e: Oh give thanks to the LORD . Call on his name . Make what he has done known among the peoples .

verses.z: 要向他唱詩、歌頌，談論他一切奇妙的作為。
verses.e: Sing to him . Sing praises to him . Tell of all his marvelous works .

verses.z: 大衛住在自己宮中，對先知拿單說：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宮中，耶和華的約櫃反在幔子裏。」
verses.e: When David was living in his house , David said to Nathan the prophet , " Behold , I live in a cedar house , but the ark of the LORD's covenant is in a tent . "

verses.z: 並不像我命士師治理我民以色列的時候一樣。我必治服你的一切仇敵，並且我－耶和華應許你，必為你建立家室。
verses.e: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel . I will subdue all your enemies . Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house .

verses.z: 你壽數滿足歸你列祖的時候，我必使你的後裔接續你的位，我也必堅定他的國。
verses.e: It will happen , when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers , that I will set up your offspring after you , who will be of your sons ; and I will establish his kingdom .

verses.z: 他必為我建造殿宇；我必堅定他的國位直到永遠。
verses.e: He will build me a house , and I will establish his throne forever .

verses.z: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；並不使我的慈愛離開他，像離開在你以前的掃羅一樣。
verses.e: I will be his father , and he will be my son . I will not take my loving kindness away from him , as I took it from him who was before you ;

verses.z: 我卻要將他永遠堅立在我家裏和我國裏；他的國位也必堅定，直到永遠。』」
verses.e: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever . His throne will be established forever . " ' "

verses.z: 拿單就按這一切話，照這默示告訴大衛。
verses.e: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so Nathan spoke to David .

verses.z: 於是大衛王進去，坐在耶和華面前，說：「耶和華上帝啊，我是誰，我的家算甚麼，你竟使我到這地步呢？
verses.e: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD ; and he said , " Who am I , LORD God , and what is my house , that you have brought me this far ?

verses.z: 上帝啊，這在你眼中還看為小，又應許你僕人的家至於久遠。耶和華上帝啊，你看顧我好像看顧高貴的人。
verses.e: This was a small thing in your eyes , O God , but you have spoken of your servant's house for a great while to come , and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree , LORD God .

verses.z: 你加於僕人的尊榮，我還有何言可說呢？因為你知道你的僕人。
verses.e: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant ? For you know your servant .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你行了這大事，並且顯明出來，是因你僕人的緣故，也是照你的心意。
verses.e: LORD , for your servant's sake , and according to your own heart , you have done all this greatness , to make known all these great things .

verses.z: 拿單對大衛說：「你可以照你的心意而行，因為上帝與你同在。」
verses.e: Nathan said to David , " Do all that is in your heart ; for God is with you . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，照我們耳中聽見，沒有可比你的，除你以外再無上帝。
verses.e: LORD , there is no one like you , neither is there any God besides you , according to all that we have heard with our ears .

verses.z: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你上帝從埃及救贖他們作自己的子民，又在你贖出來的民面前行大而可畏的事，驅逐列邦人，顯出你的大名。
verses.e: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel , whom God went to redeem to himself for a people , to make you a name by great and awesome things , in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt ?

verses.z: 你使以色列人作你的子民，直到永遠；你－耶和華也作他們的上帝。
verses.e: For you made your people Israel your own people forever ; and you , LORD , became their God .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你所應許僕人和僕人家的話，求你堅定，直到永遠，照你所說的而行。
verses.e: Now , LORD , let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant , and concerning his house , be established forever , and do as you have spoken .

verses.z: 願你的名永遠堅立，被尊為大，說：『萬軍之耶和華是以色列的上帝，是治理以色列的上帝。』這樣，你僕人大衛的家必在你面前堅立。
verses.e: Let your name be established and magnified forever , saying , ' The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel , even a God to Israel . The house of David your servant is established before you . '

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，因你啟示僕人說，我必為你建立家室，所以僕人大膽在你面前祈禱。
verses.e: For you , my God , have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house . Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，惟有你是上帝，你也應許將這福氣賜給僕人。
verses.e: Now , LORD , you are God , and have promised this good thing to your servant .

verses.z: 現在你喜悅賜福與僕人的家，可以永存在你面前。耶和華啊，你已經賜福，還要賜福到永遠。」
verses.e: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant , that it may continue forever before you ; for you , LORD , have blessed , and it is blessed forever . "

verses.z: 當夜，上帝的話臨到拿單，說：
verses.e: That same night , the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,

verses.z: 「你去告訴我僕人大衛，說耶和華如此說：『你不可建造殿宇給我居住。
verses.e: " Go and tell David my servant , ' The LORD says , " You shall not build me a house to dwell in ;

verses.z: 自從我領以色列人出埃及，直到今日，我未曾住過殿宇，乃從這會幕到那會幕，從這帳幕[到那帳幕]。
verses.e: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day , but have gone from tent to tent , and from one tent to another .

verses.z: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列的一個士師，就是我吩咐牧養我民的說：你為何不給我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
verses.e: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel , did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel , whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people , saying , ' Why have you not built me a house of cedar ? ' " '

verses.z: 現在你要告訴我僕人大衛，說萬軍之耶和華如此說：『我從羊圈中將你召來，叫你不再跟從羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
verses.e: " Now therefore , you shall tell my servant David , ' The LORD of Armies says , " I took you from the sheep pen , from following the sheep , to be prince over my people Israel .

verses.z: 你無論往哪裏去，我常與你同在，剪除你的一切仇敵；我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一樣。
verses.e: I have been with you wherever you have gone , and have cut off all your enemies from before you . I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth .

verses.z: 我必為我民以色列選定一個地方，栽培他們，使他們住自己的地方，不再遷移；凶惡之子也不像從前擾害他們，
verses.e: I will appoint a place for my people Israel , and will plant them , that they may dwell in their own place , and be moved no more . The children of wickedness will not waste them any more , as at the first ,

verses.z: 此後，大衛攻打非利士人，把他們治服，從他們手下奪取了迦特和屬迦特的村莊；
verses.e: After this , David defeated the Philistines and subdued them , and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines .

verses.z: 就打發他兒子哈多蘭去見大衛王，問他的安，為他祝福，因為他殺敗了哈大利謝（原來陀烏與哈大利謝常常爭戰）。哈多蘭帶了金銀銅的各樣器皿來。
verses.e: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him ( for Hadadezer had wars with Tou ) ; and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze .

verses.z: 大衛王將這些器皿，並從各國奪來的金銀，就是從以東、摩押、亞捫、非利士、亞瑪力人所奪來的，都分別為聖獻給耶和華。
verses.e: King David also dedicated these to the LORD , with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations : from Edom , from Moab , from the children of Ammon , from the Philistines , and from Amalek .

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩在鹽谷擊殺了以東一萬八千人。
verses.e: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt .

verses.z: 大衛在以東地設立防營，以東人就都歸服他。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
verses.e: He put garrisons in Edom ; and all the Edomites became servants to David . The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went .

verses.z: 大衛作以色列眾人的王，又向眾民秉公行義。
verses.e: David reigned over all Israel ; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people .

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子約押作元帥；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
verses.e: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army ; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder ;

verses.z: 亞希突的兒子撒督和亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒作祭司[長]；沙威沙作書記；
verses.e: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests ; Shavsha was scribe ;

verses.z: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人。大衛的眾子都在王的左右作領袖。
verses.e: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites ; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king .

verses.z: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就歸服大衛，給他進貢。
verses.e: He defeated Moab ; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute .

verses.z: 瑣巴王哈大利謝往幼發拉底河去，要堅定自己的國權，大衛就攻打他，直到哈馬，
verses.e: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah , toward Hamath , as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates .

verses.z: 奪了他的戰車一千，馬兵七千，步兵二萬，將拉戰車的馬砍斷蹄筋，但留下一百輛車的馬。
verses.e: David took from him one thousand chariots , seven thousand horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen ; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses , but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots .

verses.z: 大馬士革的亞蘭人來幫助瑣巴王哈大利謝，大衛就殺了亞蘭人二萬二千。
verses.e: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah , David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians .

verses.z: 於是大衛在大馬士革的亞蘭地設立[防營]，亞蘭人就歸服他，給他進貢。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
verses.e: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus ; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute . The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went .

verses.z: 他奪了哈大利謝臣僕所拿的金盾牌帶到耶路撒冷。
verses.e: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 大衛又從屬哈大利謝的提巴和均二城中奪取了許多的銅。後來所羅門用此製造銅海、銅柱，和一切的銅器。
verses.e: From Tibhath and from Cun , cities of Hadadezer , David took very much bronze , with which Solomon made the bronze sea , the pillars , and the vessels of bronze .

verses.z: 哈馬王陀烏聽見大衛殺敗瑣巴王哈大利謝的全軍，
verses.e: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah ,

verses.z: 此後，亞捫人的王拿轄死了，他兒子接續他作王。
verses.e: After this , Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died , and his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對着亞蘭人擺陣；
verses.e: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose some of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .

verses.z: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對着亞捫人擺陣。
verses.e: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother ; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 約押對亞比篩說：「亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。
verses.e: He said , " If the Syrians are too strong for me , then you are to help me ; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you , then I will help you .

verses.z: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和上帝的城邑作大丈夫，願耶和華憑他的意旨而行。」
verses.e: Be courageous , and let's be strong for our people and for the cities of our God . May the LORD do that which seems good to him . "

verses.z: 於是約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。
verses.e: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle ; and they fled before him .

verses.z: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在約押的兄弟亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled , they likewise fled before Abishai his brother , and entered into the city . Then Joab came to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就打發使者將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來，哈大利謝的將軍朔法率領他們。
verses.e: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel , they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River , with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人過約旦河，來到亞蘭人那裏，迎着他們擺陣。大衛既擺陣攻擊亞蘭人，亞蘭人就與他打仗。
verses.e: David was told that , so he gathered all Israel together , passed over the Jordan , came to them , and set the battle in array against them . So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him .

verses.z: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑。大衛殺了亞蘭七千輛戰車[的人]，四萬步兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。
verses.e: The Syrians fled before Israel ; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen , and also killed Shophach the captain of the army .

verses.z: 屬哈大利謝[的諸王]見自己被以色列人打敗，就與大衛和好，歸服他。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
verses.e: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel , they made peace with David and served him . The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more .

verses.z: 大衛說：「我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」於是大衛差遣使者為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內見哈嫩，要安慰他，
verses.e: David said , " I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash , because his father showed kindness to me . " So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father . David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him .

verses.z: 但亞捫人的首領對哈嫩說：「大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親嗎？他的臣僕來見你不是為詳察窺探、傾覆這地嗎？」
verses.e: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun , " Do you think that David honors your father , in that he has sent comforters to you ? Haven't his servants come to you to search , to overthrow , and to spy out the land ? "

verses.z: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕[的鬍鬚]剃去[一半]，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。
verses.e: So Hanun took David's servants , shaved them , and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks , and sent them away .

verses.z: 有人將臣僕所遇的事告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，因為他們甚覺羞恥；告訴他們說：「可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。」
verses.e: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated . He sent to meet them ; for the men were greatly humiliated . The king said , " Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown , and then return . "

verses.z: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，哈嫩和亞捫人就打發人拿一千他連得銀子，從美索不達米亞、亞蘭、瑪迦、瑣巴雇戰車和馬兵，
verses.e: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David , Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia , out of Aram-maacah , and out of Zobah .

verses.z: 於是雇了三萬二千輛戰車和瑪迦王並他的軍兵；他們來安營在米底巴前。亞捫人也從他們的城裏出來，聚集交戰。
verses.e: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots , and the king of Maacah with his people , who came and encamped near Medeba . The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .

verses.z: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。
verses.e: When David heard of it , he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men .

verses.z: 亞捫人出來在城門前擺陣，所來的諸王另在郊野擺陣。
verses.e: The children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array at the gate of the city ; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field .

verses.z: 以色列的兒子是呂便、西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫、
verses.e: These are the sons of Israel : Reuben , Simeon , Levi , Judah , Issachar , Zebulun ,

verses.z: 蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順。拿順作猶大人的首領。
verses.e: Ram became the father of Amminadab , and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon , prince of the children of Judah ;

verses.z: 拿順生撒門；撒門生波阿斯；
verses.e: and Nahshon became the father of Salma , and Salma became the father of Boaz ,

verses.z: 波阿斯生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；
verses.e: and Boaz became the father of Obed , and Obed became the father of Jesse ;

verses.z: 耶西生長子以利押，次子亞比拿達，三子示米亞，
verses.e: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab , Abinadab the second , Shimea the third ,

verses.z: 四子拿坦業，五子拉代，
verses.e: Nethanel the fourth , Raddai the fifth ,

verses.z: 六子阿鮮，七子大衛。
verses.e: Ozem the sixth , and David the seventh ;

verses.z: 他們的姊妹是洗魯雅和亞比該。洗魯雅的兒子是亞比篩、約押、亞撒黑，共三人。
verses.e: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail . The sons of Zeruiah : Abishai , Joab , and Asahel , three .

verses.z: 亞比該生亞瑪撒；亞瑪撒的父親是以實瑪利人益帖。
verses.e: Abigail bore Amasa ; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite .

verses.z: 希斯崙的兒子迦勒娶阿蘇巴和耶略為妻，阿蘇巴的兒子是耶設、朔罷、押墩。
verses.e: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife , and by Jerioth ; and these were her sons : Jesher , Shobab , and Ardon .

verses.z: 阿蘇巴死了，迦勒又娶以法她，生了戶珥。
verses.e: Azubah died , and Caleb married Ephrath , who bore him Hur .

verses.z: 但、約瑟、便雅憫、拿弗他利、迦得、亞設。
verses.e: Dan , Joseph , Benjamin , Naphtali , Gad , and Asher .

verses.z: 戶珥生烏利；烏利生比撒列。
verses.e: Hur became the father of Uri , and Uri became the father of Bezalel .

verses.z: 希斯崙正六十歲娶了基列父親瑪吉的女兒，與她同房；瑪吉的女兒生了西割；
verses.e: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead , whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old ; and she bore him Segub .

verses.z: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三個城邑。
verses.e: Segub became the father of Jair , who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead .

verses.z: 後來基述人和亞蘭人奪了睚珥的城邑，並基納和其鄉村，共六十個。這都是基列父親瑪吉之子的。
verses.e: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them , with Kenath , and its villages , even sixty cities . All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead .

verses.z: 希斯崙在迦勒‧以法他死後，他的妻亞比雅給他生了亞施戶；亞施戶是提哥亞的父親。
verses.e: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah , Abijah , Hezron's wife , bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa .

verses.z: 希斯崙的長子耶拉篾生長子蘭，又生布拿、阿連、阿鮮、亞希雅。
verses.e: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn , Bunah , Oren , Ozem , and Ahijah .

verses.z: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亞她拉，是阿南的母親。
verses.e: Jerahmeel had another wife , whose name was Atarah . She was the mother of Onam .

verses.z: 耶拉篾長子蘭的兒子是瑪斯、雅憫、以結。
verses.e: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz , Jamin , and Eker .

verses.z: 阿南的兒子是沙買、雅大。沙買的兒子是拿答、亞比述。
verses.e: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada . The sons of Shammai : Nadab and Abishur .

verses.z: 亞比述的妻名叫亞比孩，亞比孩給他生了亞辦和摩利。
verses.e: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail ; and she bore him Ahban and Molid .

verses.z: 猶大的兒子是珥、俄南、示拉，這三人是迦南人書亞女兒所生的。猶大的長子珥在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華就使他死了。
verses.e: The sons of Judah : Er , Onan , and Shelah , which three were born to him of Shua's daughter the Canaanitess . Er , Judah's firstborn , was wicked in the LORD's sight ; and he killed him .

verses.z: 拿答的兒子是西列、亞遍；西列死了沒有兒子。
verses.e: The sons of Nadab : Seled and Appaim ; but Seled died without children .

verses.z: 亞遍的兒子是以示；以示的兒子是示珊；示珊的兒子是亞來。
verses.e: The son of Appaim : Ishi . The son of Ishi : Sheshan . The son of Sheshan : Ahlai .

verses.z: 沙買兄弟雅大的兒子是益帖、約拿單；益帖死了沒有兒子。
verses.e: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai : Jether and Jonathan ; and Jether died without children .

verses.z: 約拿單的兒子是比勒、撒薩。這都是耶拉篾的子孫。
verses.e: The sons of Jonathan : Peleth and Zaza . These were the sons of Jerahmeel .

verses.z: 示珊沒有兒子，只有女兒。示珊有一個僕人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。
verses.e: Now Sheshan had no sons , but only daughters . Sheshan had a servant , an Egyptian , whose name was Jarha .

verses.z: 示珊將女兒給了僕人耶哈為妻，給他生了亞太。
verses.e: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife ; and she bore him Attai .

verses.z: 亞太生拿單；拿單生撒拔；
verses.e: Attai became the father of Nathan , and Nathan became the father of Zabad ,

verses.z: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄備得；
verses.e: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal , and Ephlal became the father of Obed ,

verses.z: 俄備得生耶戶；耶戶生亞撒利雅；
verses.e: and Obed became the father of Jehu , and Jehu became the father of Azariah ,

verses.z: 亞撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亞薩；
verses.e: and Azariah became the father of Helez , and Helez became the father of Eleasah ,

verses.z: 猶大的兒婦她瑪給猶大生法勒斯和謝拉。猶大共有五個兒子。
verses.e: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah . All the sons of Judah were five .

verses.z: 以利亞薩生西斯買；西斯買生沙龍；
verses.e: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai , and Sismai became the father of Shallum ,

verses.z: 沙龍生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙瑪。
verses.e: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah , and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama .

verses.z: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的長子米沙，是西弗之祖瑪利沙的兒子，是希伯崙之祖。
verses.e: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn , who was the father of Ziph , and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron .

verses.z: 希伯崙的兒子是可拉、他普亞、利肯、示瑪。
verses.e: The sons of Hebron : Korah , Tappuah , Rekem , and Shema .

verses.z: 示瑪生拉含，是約干之祖。利肯生沙買。
verses.e: Shema became the father of Raham , the father of Jorkeam ; and Rekem became the father of Shammai .

verses.z: 沙買的兒子是瑪雲；瑪雲是伯‧夙之祖。
verses.e: The son of Shammai was Maon ; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur .

verses.z: 迦勒的妾以法生哈蘭、摩撒、迦謝；哈蘭生迦卸。（
verses.e: Ephah , Caleb's concubine , bore Haran , Moza , and Gazez ; and Haran became the father of Gazez .

verses.z: 雅代的兒子是利健、約坦、基珊、毗力、以法、沙亞弗。）
verses.e: The sons of Jahdai : Regem , Jothan , Geshan , Pelet , Ephah , and Shaaph .

verses.z: 迦勒的妾瑪迦生示別、特哈拿，
verses.e: Maacah , Caleb's concubine , bore Sheber and Tirhanah .

verses.z: 又生麥瑪拿之祖沙亞弗、抹比拿和基比亞之祖示法。迦勒的女兒是押撒。
verses.e: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah , Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea ; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah .

verses.z: 法勒斯的兒子是希斯崙、哈母勒。
verses.e: The sons of Perez : Hezron and Hamul .

verses.z: 迦勒的子孫就是以法她的長子、戶珥的兒子，記在下面：基列‧耶琳之祖朔巴，
verses.e: These were the sons of Caleb , the son of Hur , the firstborn of Ephrathah : Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim ,

verses.z: 伯利恆之祖薩瑪，伯迦得之祖哈勒。
verses.e: Salma the father of Bethlehem , and Hareph the father of Beth Gader .

verses.z: 基列‧耶琳之祖朔巴的子孫是哈羅以和一半米努‧哈人。
verses.e: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons : Haroeh , half of the Menuhoth .

verses.z: 基列‧耶琳的諸族是以帖人、布特人、舒瑪人、密來人，又從這些族中生出瑣拉人和以實陶人來。
verses.e: The families of Kiriath Jearim : the Ithrites , the Puthites , the Shumathites , and the Mishraites ; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites .

verses.z: 薩瑪的子孫是伯利恆人、尼陀法人、亞他綠‧伯‧約押人、一半瑪拿哈人、瑣利人，
verses.e: The sons of Salma : Bethlehem , the Netophathites , Atroth Beth Joab , and half of the Manahathites , the Zorites .

verses.z: 和住雅比斯眾文士家的特拉人、示米押人、蘇甲人。這都是基尼人利甲家之祖哈末所生的。
verses.e: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez : the Tirathites , the Shimeathites , and the Sucathites . These are the Kenites who came from Hammath , the father of the house of Rechab .

verses.z: 謝拉的兒子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各、大拉，共五人。
verses.e: The sons of Zerah : Zimri , Ethan , Heman , Calcol , and Dara — five of them in all .

verses.z: 迦米的兒子是亞干，這亞干在當滅的物上犯了罪，連累了以色列人。
verses.e: The son of Carmi : Achar , the troubler of Israel , who committed a trespass in the devoted thing .

verses.z: 以探的兒子是亞撒利雅。
verses.e: The son of Ethan : Azariah .

verses.z: 希斯崙所生的兒子是耶拉篾、蘭、基路拜。
verses.e: The sons also of Hezron , who were born to him : Jerahmeel , Ram , and Chelubai .

verses.z: 過了一年，到列王出戰的時候，約押率領軍兵毀壞亞捫人的地，圍攻拉巴；大衛仍住在耶路撒冷。約押攻打拉巴，將城傾覆。
verses.e: At the time of the return of the year , at the time when kings go out , Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon , and came and besieged Rabbah . But David stayed at Jerusalem . Joab struck Rabbah , and overthrew it .

verses.z: 大衛奪了亞捫人之王所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他連得，又嵌着寶石；人將這冠冕戴在大衛頭上。大衛從城裏奪了許多財物，
verses.e: David took the crown of their king from off his head , and found it to weigh a talent of gold , and there were precious stones in it . It was set on David's head , and he brought very much plunder out of the city .

verses.z: 將城裏的人拉出來，放在鋸下，或鐵耙下，或[鐵]斧下，大衛待亞捫各城的居民都是如此。其後大衛和眾軍都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: He brought out the people who were in it , and had them cut with saws , with iron picks , and with axes . David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon . Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 後來，以色列人在基色與非利士人打仗。戶沙人西比該殺了偉人的一個兒子細派，非利士人就被制伏了。
verses.e: After this , war arose at Gezer with the Philistines . Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai , of the sons of the giant ; and they were subdued .

verses.z: 又與非利士人打仗。睚珥的兒子伊勒哈難殺了迦特人歌利亞的兄弟拉哈米；這人的槍桿粗如織布的機軸。
verses.e: Again there was war with the Philistines ; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite , the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam .

verses.z: 又在迦特打仗。那裏有一個身量高大的人，手腳都是六指，共有二十四個指頭，他也是偉人的兒子。
verses.e: There was again war at Gath , where there was a man of great stature , who had twenty-four fingers and toes , six on each hand and six on each foot ; and he also was born to the giant .

verses.z: 這人向以色列人罵陣，大衛的哥哥示米亞的兒子約拿單就殺了他。
verses.e: When he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea , David's brother , killed him .

verses.z: 這三個人是迦特偉人的兒子，都死在大衛和他僕人的手下。
verses.e: These were born to the giant in Gath ; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants .

verses.z: 撒但起來攻擊以色列人，激動大衛數點他們。
verses.e: Satan stood up against Israel , and moved David to take a census of Israel .

verses.z: 「你去告訴大衛說，耶和華如此說：我有三樣災，隨你選擇一樣，我好降與你。」
verses.e: " Go and speak to David , saying , ' The LORD says , " I offer you three things . Choose one of them , that I may do it to you . " ' "

verses.z: 於是，迦得來見大衛，對他說：「耶和華如此說：『你可以隨意選擇：
verses.e: So Gad came to David and said to him , " The LORD says , ' Take your choice :

verses.z: 或三年的饑荒；或敗在你敵人面前，被敵人的刀追殺三個月；或在你國中有耶和華的刀，就是三日的瘟疫，耶和華的使者在以色列的四境施行毀滅。』現在你要想一想，我好回覆那差我來的。」
verses.e: either three years of famine ; or three months to be consumed before your foes , while the sword of your enemies overtakes you ; or else three days of the sword of the LORD , even pestilence in the land , and the LORD's angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel . Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me . ' "

verses.z: 大衛對迦得說：「我甚為難。我願落在耶和華的手裏，因為他有豐盛的憐憫；我不願落在人的手裏。」
verses.e: David said to Gad , " I am in distress . Let me fall , I pray , into the LORD's hand , for his mercies are very great . Don't let me fall into man's hand . "

verses.z: 於是，耶和華降瘟疫與以色列人，以色列人就死了七萬。
verses.e: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel , and seventy thousand men of Israel fell .

verses.z: 上帝差遣使者去滅耶路撒冷，剛要滅的時候，耶和華看見後悔，就不降這災了，吩咐滅城的天使說：「夠了，住手吧！」那時，耶和華的使者站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場那裏。
verses.e: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it . As he was about to destroy , the LORD saw , and he relented of the disaster , and said to the destroying angel , " It is enough . Now withdraw your hand . " the LORD's angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite .

verses.z: 大衛舉目，看見耶和華的使者站在天地間，手裏有拔出來的刀，伸在耶路撒冷以上。大衛和長老都身穿麻衣，面伏於地。
verses.e: David lifted up his eyes , and saw the LORD's angel standing between earth and the sky , having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem . Then David and the elders , clothed in sackcloth , fell on their faces .

verses.z: 大衛禱告上帝說：「吩咐數點百姓的不是我嗎？我犯了罪，行了惡，但這群羊做了甚麼呢？願耶和華－我上帝的手攻擊我和我的父家，不要攻擊你的民，降瘟疫與他們。」
verses.e: David said to God , " Isn't it I who commanded the people to be counted ? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly ; but these sheep , what have they done ? Please let your hand , O LORD my God , be against me and against my father's house ; but not against your people , that they should be plagued . "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者吩咐迦得去告訴大衛，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上為耶和華築一座壇；
verses.e: Then the LORD's angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite .

verses.z: 大衛就照着迦得奉耶和華名所說的話上去了。
verses.e: David went up at the saying of Gad , which he spoke in the LORD's name .

verses.z: 大衛就吩咐約押和民中的首領說：「你們去數點以色列人，從別是巴直到但，回來告訴我，我好知道他們的數目。」
verses.e: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people , " Go , count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan ; and bring me word , that I may know how many there are . "

verses.z: 那時阿珥楠正打麥子，回頭看見天使，就和他四個兒子都藏起來了。
verses.e: Ornan turned back and saw the angel ; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves . Now Ornan was threshing wheat .

verses.z: 大衛到了阿珥楠那裏，阿珥楠看見大衛，就從禾場上出去，臉伏於地，向他下拜。
verses.e: As David came to Ornan , Ornan looked and saw David , and went out of the threshing floor , and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground .

verses.z: 大衛對阿珥楠說：「你將這禾場與相連之地賣給我，我必給你足價，我好在其上為耶和華築一座壇，使民間的瘟疫止住。」
verses.e: Then David said to Ornan , " Sell me the place of this threshing floor , that I may build an altar to the LORD on it . You shall sell it to me for the full price , that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people . "

verses.z: 阿珥楠對大衛說：「你可以用這禾場，願我主我王照你所喜悅的去行。我也將牛給你作燔祭，把打糧的器具當柴燒，拿麥子作素祭。這些我都送給你。」
verses.e: Ornan said to David , " Take it for yourself , and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes . Behold , I give the oxen for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meal offering . I give it all . "

verses.z: 大衛王對阿珥楠說：「不然！我必要用足價向你買。我不用你的物獻給耶和華，也不用白得之物獻為燔祭。」
verses.e: King David said to Ornan , " No , but I will most certainly buy it for the full price . For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD , nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing . "

verses.z: 於是大衛為那塊地平了六百舍客勒金子給阿珥楠。
verses.e: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place .

verses.z: 大衛在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭，求告耶和華。耶和華就應允他，使火從天降在燔祭壇上。
verses.e: David built an altar to the LORD there , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings , and called on the LORD ; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
verses.e: Then the LORD commanded the angel , and he put his sword back into its sheath .

verses.z: 那時，大衛見耶和華在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上應允了他，就在那裏獻祭。
verses.e: At that time , when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite , then he sacrificed there .

verses.z: 摩西在曠野所造之耶和華的帳幕和燔祭壇都在基遍的高處；
verses.e: For the LORD's tabernacle , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of burnt offering , were at that time in the high place at Gibeon .

verses.z: 約押說：「願耶和華使他的百姓比現在加增百倍。我主我王啊，他們不都是你的僕人嗎？我主為何吩咐行這事，為何使以色列人陷在罪裏呢？」
verses.e: Joab said , " May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are . But , my lord the king , aren't they all my lord's servants ? Why does my lord require this thing ? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel ? "

verses.z: 只是大衛不敢前去求問上帝，因為懼怕耶和華使者的刀。
verses.e: But David couldn't go before it to inquire of God , for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD's angel .

verses.z: 但王的命令勝過約押。約押就出去，走遍以色列地，回到耶路撒冷，
verses.e: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab . Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel , then came to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 將百姓的總數奏告大衛：以色列人拿刀的有一百一十萬；猶大人拿刀的有四十七萬。
verses.e: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David . All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword ; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword .

verses.z: 惟有利未人和便雅憫人沒有數在其中，因為約押厭惡王的這命令。
verses.e: But he didn't count Levi and Benjamin among them , for the king's word was abominable to Joab .

verses.z: 上帝不喜悅這數點百姓的事，便降災給以色列人。
verses.e: God was displeased with this thing ; therefore he struck Israel .

verses.z: 大衛禱告上帝說：「我行這事大有罪了！現在求你除掉僕人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
verses.e: David said to God , " I have sinned greatly , in that I have done this thing . But now put away , I beg you , the iniquity of your servant , for I have done very foolishly . "

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐大衛的先見迦得說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Gad , David's seer , saying ,

verses.z: 大衛說：「這就是耶和華上帝的殿，為以色列人獻燔祭的壇。」
verses.e: Then David said , " This is the house of the LORD God , and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel . "

verses.z: 他必為我的名建造殿宇。他要作我的子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。』
verses.e: He shall build a house for my name ; and he will be my son , and I will be his father ; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever . '

verses.z: 我兒啊，現今願耶和華與你同在，使你亨通，照他指着你說的話，建造耶和華－你上帝的殿。
verses.e: Now , my son , may the LORD be with you and prosper you , and build the house of the LORD your God , as he has spoken concerning you .

verses.z: 但願耶和華賜你聰明智慧，好治理以色列國，遵行耶和華－你上帝的律法。
verses.e: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding , and put you in charge of Israel , so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你若謹守遵行耶和華藉摩西吩咐以色列的律例典章，就得亨通。你當剛強壯膽，不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。
verses.e: Then you will prosper , if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel . Be strong and courageous . Don't be afraid and don't be dismayed .

verses.z: 我在困難之中為耶和華的殿預備了金子十萬他連得，銀子一百萬他連得，銅和鐵多得無法可稱；我也預備了木頭、石頭，你還可以增添。
verses.e: Now , behold , in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD's house one hundred thousand talents of gold , one million talents of silver , and bronze and iron without weight ; for it is in abundance . I have also prepared timber and stone ; and you may add to them .

verses.z: 你有許多匠人，就是石匠、木匠，和一切能做各樣工的巧匠，
verses.e: There are also workmen with you in abundance — cutters and workers of stone and timber , and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work ;

verses.z: 並有無數的金銀銅鐵。你當起來辦事，願耶和華與你同在。」
verses.e: of the gold , the silver , the bronze , and the iron , there is no number . Arise and be doing , and may the LORD be with you . "

verses.z: 大衛又吩咐以色列的眾首領幫助他兒子所羅門，[說]：
verses.e: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son , saying ,

verses.z: 「耶和華－你們的上帝不是與你們同在嗎？不是叫你們四圍都平安嗎？因他已將這地的居民交在我手中，這地就在耶和華與他百姓面前制伏了。
verses.e: " Isn't the LORD your God with you ? Hasn't he given you rest on every side ? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand ; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people .

verses.z: 現在你們應當立定心意，尋求耶和華－你們的神；也當起來建造耶和華上帝的聖所，好將耶和華的約櫃和供奉上帝的聖器皿都搬進為耶和華名建造的殿裏。」
verses.e: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God . Arise therefore , and build the sanctuary of the LORD God , to bring the ark of the LORD's covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD's name . "

verses.z: 大衛吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，從其中派石匠鑿石頭，要建造上帝的殿。
verses.e: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel ; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God's house .

verses.z: 大衛預備許多鐵做門上的釘子和鉤子，又預備許多銅，多得無法可稱；
verses.e: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings , and bronze in abundance without weight ,

verses.z: 又預備無數的香柏木，因為西頓人和泰爾人給大衛運了許多香柏木來。
verses.e: and cedar trees without number , for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David .

verses.z: 大衛說：「我兒子所羅門還年幼嬌嫩，要為耶和華建造的殿宇必須高大輝煌，使名譽榮耀傳遍萬國；所以我要為殿預備材料。」於是，大衛在未死之先預備的材料甚多。
verses.e: David said , " Solomon my son is young and tender , and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent , of fame and of glory throughout all countries . I will therefore make preparation for it . " So David prepared abundantly before his death .

verses.z: 大衛召了他兒子所羅門來，囑咐他給耶和華－以色列的上帝建造殿宇，
verses.e: Then he called for Solomon his son , and commanded him to build a house for the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 對所羅門說：「我兒啊，我心裏本想為耶和華－我上帝的名建造殿宇，
verses.e: David said to Solomon his son , " As for me , it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God .

verses.z: 只是耶和華的話臨到我說：『你流了多人的血，打了多次大仗，你不可為我的名建造殿宇，因為你在我眼前使多人的血流在地上。
verses.e: But the LORD's word came to me , saying , ' You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars . You shall not build a house to my name , because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight .

verses.z: 你要生一個兒子，他必作太平的人；我必使他安靜，不被四圍的仇敵擾亂。他的名要叫所羅門。他在位的日子，我必使以色列人平安康泰。
verses.e: Behold , a son shall be born to you , who shall be a man of peace . I will give him rest from all his enemies all around ; for his name shall be Solomon , and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days .

verses.z: 大衛年紀老邁，日子滿足，就立他兒子所羅門作以色列的王。
verses.e: Now David was old and full of days ; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel .

verses.z: 示每的兒子是雅哈、細拿、耶烏施、比利亞共四人。
verses.e: The sons of Shimei : Jahath , Zina , Jeush , and Beriah . These four were the sons of Shimei .

verses.z: 雅哈是長子，細撒是次子。但耶烏施和比利亞的子孫不多，所以算為一族。
verses.e: Jahath was the chief , and Zizah the second ; but Jeush and Beriah didn't have many sons ; therefore they became a fathers ' house in one reckoning .

verses.z: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛共四人。
verses.e: The sons of Kohath : Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four .

verses.z: 暗蘭的兒子是亞倫、摩西。亞倫和他的子孫分出來，好分別至聖的物，在耶和華面前燒香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永遠。
verses.e: The sons of Amram : Aaron and Moses ; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things , he and his sons forever , to burn incense before the LORD , to minister to him , and to bless in his name forever .

verses.z: 至於神人摩西，他的子孫名字記在利未支派的冊上。
verses.e: But as for Moses the man of God , his sons were named among the tribe of Levi .

verses.z: 摩西的兒子是革舜和以利以謝。
verses.e: The sons of Moses : Gershom and Eliezer .

verses.z: 革舜的長子是細布業；
verses.e: The sons of Gershom : Shebuel the chief .

verses.z: 以利以謝的兒子是利哈比雅。以利以謝沒有別的兒子，但利哈比雅的子孫甚多。
verses.e: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief ; and Eliezer had no other sons , but the sons of Rehabiah were very many .

verses.z: 以斯哈的長子是示羅密。
verses.e: The son of Izhar : Shelomith the chief .

verses.z: 希伯倫的長子是耶利雅，次子是亞瑪利亞，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。
verses.e: The sons of Hebron : Jeriah the chief , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth .

verses.z: 大衛招聚以色列的眾首領和祭司利未人。
verses.e: He gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .

verses.z: 烏薛的長子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。
verses.e: The sons of Uzziel : Micah the chief , and Isshiah the second .

verses.z: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示。抹利的兒子是以利亞撒、基士。
verses.e: The sons of Merari : Mahli and Mushi . The sons of Mahli : Eleazar and Kish .

verses.z: 以利亞撒死了，沒有兒子，只有女兒，他們本族基士的兒子娶了她們為妻。
verses.e: Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters only ; and their relatives , the sons of Kish , took them as wives .

verses.z: 母示的兒子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。
verses.e: The sons of Mushi : Mahli , Eder , and Jeremoth , three .

verses.z: 以上利未子孫作族長的，照着男丁的數目，從二十歲以外，都辦耶和華殿的事務。
verses.e: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers ' houses , even the heads of the fathers ' houses of those who were counted individually , in the number of names by their polls , who did the work for the service of the LORD's house , from twenty years old and upward .

verses.z: 大衛說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝已經使他的百姓平安，他永遠住在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: For David said , " The LORD , the God of Israel , has given rest to his people ; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever .

verses.z: 利未人不必再抬帳幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。」
verses.e: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service . "

verses.z: 照着大衛臨終所吩咐的，利未人從二十歲以外的都被數點。
verses.e: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted , from twenty years old and upward .

verses.z: 他們的職任是服事亞倫的子孫，在耶和華的殿和院子，並屋中辦事，潔淨一切聖物，就是辦上帝殿的事務，
verses.e: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD's house — in the courts , in the rooms , and in the purifying of all holy things , even the work of the service of God's house ;

verses.z: 並管理陳設餅，素祭的細麵，或無酵薄餅，或用盤烤，或用油調和的物，又管理各樣的升斗尺度；
verses.e: for the show bread also , and for the fine flour for a meal offering , whether of unleavened wafers , or of that which is baked in the pan , or of that which is soaked , and for all measurements of quantity and size ;

verses.z: 利未人從三十歲以外的都被數點，他們男丁的數目共有三萬八千；
verses.e: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward ; and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty-eight thousand .

verses.z: 每日早晚，站立稱謝讚美耶和華，
verses.e: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise in the evening ;

verses.z: 又在安息日、月朔，並節期，按數照例，將燔祭常常獻給耶和華；
verses.e: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths , on the new moons , and on the set feasts , in number according to the ordinance concerning them , continually before the LORD ;

verses.z: 又看守會幕和聖所，並守[耶和華]吩咐他們弟兄亞倫子孫的，辦耶和華殿的事。
