verses.e: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting , the duty of the holy place , and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 其中有二萬四千人管理耶和華殿的事，有六千人作官長和士師，
verses.e: David said , " Of these , twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD's house , six thousand were officers and judges ,

verses.z: 有四千人作守門的，又有四千人用大衛所做的樂器頌讚耶和華。
verses.e: four thousand were doorkeepers , and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise . "

verses.z: 大衛將利未人革順、哥轄、米拉利的子孫分了班次。
verses.e: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi : Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

verses.z: 革順的子孫有拉但和示每。
verses.e: Of the Gershonites : Ladan and Shimei .

verses.z: 拉但的長子是耶歇，還有細坦和約珥，共三人。
verses.e: The sons of Ladan : Jehiel the chief , Zetham , and Joel , three .

verses.z: 示每的兒子是示羅密、哈薛、哈蘭三人。這是拉但族的族長。
verses.e: The sons of Shimei : Shelomoth , Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the heads of the fathers ' households of Ladan .

verses.z: 亞倫子孫的班次記在下面：亞倫的兒子是拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
verses.e: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron . The sons of Aaron : Nadab , Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .

verses.z: 第七是哈歌斯，第八是亞比雅，
verses.e: the seventh to Hakkoz , the eighth to Abijah ,

verses.z: 第九是耶書亞，第十是示迦尼，
verses.e: the ninth to Jeshua , the tenth to Shecaniah ,

verses.z: 第十一是以利亞實，第十二是雅金，
verses.e: the eleventh to Eliashib , the twelfth to Jakim ,

verses.z: 第十三是胡巴，第十四是耶是比押，
verses.e: the thirteenth to Huppah , the fourteenth to Jeshebeab ,

verses.z: 第十五是璧迦，第十六是音麥，
verses.e: the fifteenth to Bilgah , the sixteenth to Immer ,

verses.z: 第十七是希悉，第十八是哈闢悉，
verses.e: the seventeenth to Hezir , the eighteenth to Happizzez ,

verses.z: 第十九是毗他希雅，第二十是以西結，
verses.e: the nineteenth to Pethahiah , the twentieth to Jehezkel ,

verses.z: 第二十一是雅斤，第二十二是迦末，
verses.e: the twenty-first to Jachin , the twenty-second to Gamul ,

verses.z: 第二十三是第來雅，第二十四是瑪西亞。
verses.e: the twenty-third to Delaiah , and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah .

verses.z: 這就是他們的班次，要照耶和華－以色列的上帝藉他們祖宗亞倫所吩咐的條例進入耶和華的殿辦理事務。
verses.e: This was their ordering in their service , to come into the LORD's house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father , as the LORD , the God of Israel , had commanded him .

verses.z: 拿答、亞比戶死在他們父親之先，沒有留下兒子；故此，以利亞撒、以他瑪供祭司的職分。
verses.e: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father , and had no children ; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests .

verses.z: 利未其餘的子孫如下：暗蘭的子孫裏有書巴業；書巴業的子孫裏有耶希底亞。
verses.e: Of the rest of the sons of Levi : of the sons of Amram , Shubael ; of the sons of Shubael , Jehdeiah .

verses.z: 利哈比雅的子孫裏有長子伊示雅。
verses.e: Of Rehabiah : of the sons of Rehabiah , Isshiah the chief .

verses.z: 以斯哈的子孫裏有示羅摩；示羅摩的子孫裏有雅哈。
verses.e: Of the Izharites , Shelomoth ; of the sons of Shelomoth , Jahath .

verses.z: [希伯倫的]子孫裏有[長子]耶利雅，次子亞瑪利亞，三子雅哈悉，四子耶加面。
verses.e: The sons of Hebron : Jeriah , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth .

verses.z: 烏薛的子孫裏有米迦；米迦的子孫裏有沙密。
verses.e: The sons of Uzziel : Micah ; of the sons of Micah , Shamir .

verses.z: 米迦的兄弟是伊示雅；伊示雅的子孫裏有撒迦利雅。
verses.e: The brother of Micah : Isshiah ; of the sons of Isshiah , Zechariah .

verses.z: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示、[雅西雅]；雅西雅的兒子有比挪；
verses.e: The sons of Merari : Mahli and Mushi . The son of Jaaziah : Beno .

verses.z: 米拉利的子孫裏有雅西雅的兒子比挪、朔含、撒刻、伊比利。
verses.e: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah : Beno , Shoham , Zaccur , and Ibri .

verses.z: 抹利的兒子是以利亞撒；以利亞撒沒有兒子。
verses.e: Of Mahli : Eleazar , who had no sons .

verses.z: 基士的子孫裏有耶拉篾。
verses.e: Of Kish , the son of Kish : Jerahmeel .

verses.z: 以利亞撒的子孫撒督和以他瑪的子孫亞希米勒，同着大衛將他們的族弟兄分成班次。
verses.e: David , with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar , divided them according to their ordering in their service .

verses.z: 母示的兒子是末力、以得、耶利摩。按着宗族這都是利未的子孫。
verses.e: The sons of Mushi : Mahli , Eder , and Jerimoth . These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 他們在大衛王和撒督，並亞希米勒與祭司利未人的族長面前掣籤，正如他們弟兄亞倫的子孫一般。各族的長者與兄弟沒有分別。
verses.e: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king , Zadok , Ahimelech , and the heads of the fathers ' households of the priests and of the Levites , the fathers ' households of the chief even as those of his younger brother .

verses.z: 以利亞撒子孫中為首的比以他瑪子孫中為首的更多，分班如下：以利亞撒的子孫中有十六個族長，以他瑪的子孫中有八個族長；
verses.e: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar ; and they were divided like this : of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen , heads of fathers ' houses ; and of the sons of Ithamar , according to their fathers ' houses , eight .

verses.z: 都掣籤分立，彼此一樣。在聖所和上帝面前作首領的有以利亞撒的子孫，也有以他瑪的子孫。
verses.e: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots ; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God , both of the sons of Eleazar , and of the sons of Ithamar .

verses.z: 作書記的利未人拿坦業的兒子示瑪雅在王和首領，與祭司撒督、亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒，並祭司利未人的族長面前記錄他們的名字。在以利亞撒的子孫中取一族，在以他瑪的子孫中取一族。
verses.e: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe , who was of the Levites , wrote them in the presence of the king , the princes , Zadok the priest , Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , and the heads of the fathers ' households of the priests and of the Levites ; one fathers ' house being taken for Eleazar , and one taken for Ithamar .

verses.z: 掣籤的時候，第一掣出來的是耶何雅立，第二是耶大雅，
verses.e: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib , the second to Jedaiah ,

verses.z: 第三是哈琳，第四是梭琳，
verses.e: the third to Harim , the fourth to Seorim ,

verses.z: 第五是瑪基雅，第六是米雅民，
verses.e: the fifth to Malchijah , the sixth to Mijamin ,

verses.z: 大衛和眾首領分派亞薩、希幔，並耶杜頓的子孫彈琴、鼓瑟、敲鈸、唱歌。他們供職的人數記在下面：
verses.e: Moreover , David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph , of Heman , and of Jeduthun , who were to prophesy with harps , with stringed instruments , and with cymbals . The number of those who did the work according to their service was :

verses.z: 第三是撒刻；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the third to Zaccur , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第四是伊洗利；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the fourth to Izri , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第五是尼探雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the fifth to Nethaniah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第六是布基雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the sixth to Bukkiah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第七是耶薩利拉；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the seventh to Jesharelah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第八是耶篩亞；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the eighth to Jeshaiah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第九是瑪探雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the ninth to Mattaniah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十是示每；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the tenth to Shimei , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十一是亞薩烈；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the eleventh to Azarel , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十二是哈沙比雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: the twelfth to Hashabiah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 亞薩的兒子撒刻、約瑟、尼探雅、亞薩利拉都歸亞薩指教，遵王的旨意唱歌。
verses.e: of the sons of Asaph : Zaccur , Joseph , Nethaniah , and Asharelah . The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph , who prophesied at the order of the king .

verses.z: 第十三是書巴業；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the thirteenth , Shubael , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十四是瑪他提雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the fourteenth , Mattithiah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十五是耶利摩；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十六是哈拿尼雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the sixteenth to Hananiah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十七是約施比加沙；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十八是哈拿尼；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the eighteenth to Hanani , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第十九是瑪羅提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the nineteenth to Mallothi , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第二十是以利亞他；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the twentieth to Eliathah , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第二十一是何提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the twenty-first to Hothir , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第二十二是基大利提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the twenty-second to Giddalti , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 耶杜頓的兒子基大利、西利、耶篩亞、哈沙比雅、瑪他提雅、示每共六人，都歸他們父親耶杜頓指教，彈琴，唱歌，稱謝，頌讚耶和華。
verses.e: Of Jeduthun , the sons of Jeduthun : Gedaliah , Zeri , Jeshaiah , Shimei , Hashabiah , and Mattithiah , six , under the hands of their father Jeduthun , who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp .

verses.z: 第二十三是瑪哈秀；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth , his sons and his brothers , twelve ;

verses.z: 第二十四是羅幔提‧以謝；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
verses.e: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer , his sons and his brothers , twelve .

verses.z: 希幔的兒子布基雅、瑪探雅、烏薛、細布業、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亞他、基大利提、羅幔提‧以謝、約施比加沙、瑪羅提、何提、瑪哈秀；
verses.e: Of Heman , the sons of Heman : Bukkiah , Mattaniah , Uzziel , Shebuel , Jerimoth , Hananiah , Hanani , Eliathah , Giddalti , Romamti-Ezer , Joshbekashah , Mallothi , Hothir , and Mahazioth .

verses.z: 這都是希幔的兒子，吹角頌讚。希幔奉上帝之命作王的先見。上帝賜給希幔十四個兒子，三個女兒，
verses.e: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God , to lift up the horn . God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters .

verses.z: 都歸他們父親指教，在耶和華的殿唱歌、敲鈸、彈琴、鼓瑟，辦上帝殿的事務。亞薩、耶杜頓、希幔都是王所命定的。
verses.e: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD's house , with cymbals , stringed instruments , and harps , for the service of God's house : Asaph , Jeduthun , and Heman being under the order of the king .

verses.z: 他們和他們的弟兄學習頌讚耶和華；善於歌唱的共有二百八十八人。
verses.e: The number of them , with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD , even all who were skillful , was two hundred eighty-eight .

verses.z: 這些人無論大小，為師的、為徒的，都一同掣籤分了班次。
verses.e: They cast lots for their offices , all alike , the small as well as the great , the teacher as well as the student .

verses.z: 掣籤的時候，第一掣出來的是亞薩的兒子約瑟。第二是基大利；他和他弟兄並兒子共十二人。
verses.e: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph ; the second to Gedaliah , he and his brothers and sons were twelve ;

verses.z: 守門的班次記在下面：可拉族亞薩的子孫中，有可利的兒子米施利米雅。
verses.e: For the divisions of the doorkeepers : of the Korahites , Meshelemiah the son of Kore , of the sons of Asaph .

verses.z: 米拉利子孫何薩有幾個兒子：長子是申利，他原不是長子，是他父親立他作長子。
verses.e: Also Hosah , of the children of Merari , had sons : Shimri the chief ( for though he was not the firstborn , yet his father made him chief ) ,

verses.z: 次子是希勒家，三子是底巴利雅，四子是撒迦利亞。何薩的兒子並弟兄共十三人。
verses.e: Hilkiah the second , Tebaliah the third , and Zechariah the fourth . All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen .

verses.z: 這些人都是守門的班長，與他們的弟兄一同在耶和華殿裏按班供職。
verses.e: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers , even of the chief men , having offices like their brothers , to minister in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 他們無論大小，都按着宗族掣籤分守各門。
verses.e: They cast lots , the small as well as the great , according to their fathers ' houses , for every gate .

verses.z: 掣籤守東門的是示利米雅；他的兒子撒迦利亞是精明的謀士，掣籤守北門。
verses.e: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah . Then for Zechariah his son , a wise counselor , they cast lots ; and his lot came out northward .

verses.z: 俄別‧以東守南門，他的兒子守庫房。
verses.e: To Obed-Edom southward ; and to his sons the storehouse .

verses.z: 書聘與何薩守西門，在靠近沙利基門、通着往上去的街道上，班與班相對。
verses.e: To Shuppim and Hosah westward , by the gate of Shallecheth , at the causeway that goes up , watchman opposite watchman .

verses.z: 每日東門有六個利未人，北門有四個，南門有四個，庫房有兩個，又有兩個輪班替換。
verses.e: Eastward were six Levites , northward four a day , southward four a day , and for the storehouse two and two .

verses.z: 在西面街道上有四個，在遊廊上有兩個。
verses.e: For Parbar westward , four at the causeway , and two at Parbar .

verses.z: 以上是可拉子孫和米拉利子孫守門的班次。
verses.e: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers ; of the sons of the Korahites , and of the sons of Merari .

verses.z: 米施利米雅的長子是撒迦利亞，次子是耶疊，三子是西巴第雅，四子是耶提聶，
verses.e: Meshelemiah had sons : Zechariah the firstborn , Jediael the second , Zebadiah the third , Jathniel the fourth ,

verses.z: 利未子孫中有亞希雅掌管上帝殿的府庫和聖物的府庫。
verses.e: Of the Levites , Ahijah was over the treasures of God's house and over the treasures of the dedicated things .

verses.z: 革順族、拉但子孫裏，作族長的是革順族拉但的子孫耶希伊利。
verses.e: The sons of Ladan , the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan , the heads of the fathers ' households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite : Jehieli .

verses.z: 耶希伊利的兒子西坦和他兄弟約珥掌管耶和華殿裏的府庫。
verses.e: The sons of Jehieli : Zetham , and Joel his brother , over the treasures of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 暗蘭族、以斯哈族、希伯倫族、烏泄族[也有職分]。
verses.e: Of the Amramites , of the Izharites , of the Hebronites , of the Uzzielites :

verses.z: 摩西的孫子、革舜的兒子細布業掌管府庫。
verses.e: Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler over the treasuries .

verses.z: 還有他的弟兄以利以謝。以利以謝的兒子是利哈比雅；利哈比雅的兒子是耶篩亞；耶篩亞的兒子是約蘭；約蘭的兒子是細基利；細基利的兒子是示羅密。
verses.e: His brothers : of Eliezer , Rehabiah his son , and Jeshaiah his son , and Joram his son , and Zichri his son , and Shelomoth his son .

verses.z: 這示羅密和他的弟兄掌管府庫的聖物，就是大衛王和眾族長、千夫長、百夫長，並軍長所分別為聖的物。
verses.e: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things , which David the king , and the heads of the fathers ' households , the captains over thousands and hundreds , and the captains of the army , had dedicated .

verses.z: 他們將爭戰時所奪的財物分別為聖，以備修造耶和華的殿。
verses.e: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD's house .

verses.z: 先見撒母耳、基士的兒子掃羅、尼珥的兒子押尼珥、洗魯雅的兒子約押所分別為聖的物都歸示羅密和他的弟兄掌管。
verses.e: All that Samuel the seer , Saul the son of Kish , Abner the son of Ner , and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated , whoever had dedicated anything , it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers .

verses.z: 以斯哈族有基拿尼雅和他眾子作官長和士師，管理以色列的外事。
verses.e: Of the Izharites , Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel , for officers and judges .

verses.z: 五子是以攔，六子是約哈難，七子是以利約乃。
verses.e: Elam the fifth , Jehohanan the sixth , and Eliehoenai the seventh .

verses.z: 希伯倫族有哈沙比雅和他弟兄一千七百人，都是壯士，在約旦河西、以色列地辦理耶和華與王的事。
verses.e: Of the Hebronites , Hashabiah and his brothers , one thousand seven hundred men of valor , had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward , for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king .

verses.z: 希伯倫族中有耶利雅作族長。大衛作王第四十年，在基列的雅謝，從這族中尋得大能的勇士。
verses.e: Of the Hebronites , Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites , according to their generations by fathers ' households . They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David , and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead .

verses.z: 耶利雅的弟兄有二千七百人，都是壯士，且作族長；大衛王派他們在呂便支派、迦得支派、瑪拿西半支派中辦理上帝和王的事。
verses.e: His relatives , men of valor , were two thousand seven hundred , heads of fathers ' households , whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites , the Gadites , and the half-tribe of the Manassites , for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king .

verses.z: 俄別‧以東的長子是示瑪雅，次子是約薩拔，三子是約亞，四子是沙甲，五子是拿坦業，
verses.e: Obed-Edom had sons : Shemaiah the firstborn , Jehozabad the second , Joah the third , Sacar the fourth , Nethanel the fifth ,

verses.z: 六子是亞米利，七子是以薩迦，八子是毗烏利太，因為上帝賜福與俄別‧以東。
verses.e: Ammiel the sixth , Issachar the seventh , and Peullethai the eighth ; for God blessed him .

verses.z: 他的兒子示瑪雅有幾個兒子，都是大能的壯士，掌管父親的家。
verses.e: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son , who ruled over the house of their father ; for they were mighty men of valor .

verses.z: 示瑪雅的兒子是俄得尼、利法益、俄備得、以利薩巴。以利薩巴的弟兄是壯士，還有以利戶和西瑪迦。
verses.e: The sons of Shemaiah : Othni , Rephael , Obed , and Elzabad , whose relatives were valiant men , Elihu , and Semachiah .

verses.z: 這都是俄別‧以東的子孫，他們和他們的兒子並弟兄，都是善於辦事的壯士。俄別‧以東的子孫共六十二人。
verses.e: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers , able men in strength for the service : sixty-two of Obed-Edom .

verses.z: 米施利米雅的兒子和弟兄都是壯士，共十八人。
verses.e: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers , eighteen valiant men .

verses.z: 以色列人的族長、千夫長、百夫長，和官長都分定班次，每班是二萬四千人，週年按月輪流，替換出入服事王。
verses.e: Now the children of Israel after their number , the heads of fathers ' households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year — of every division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 七月第七班的班長是以法蓮族比倫人希利斯；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite , of the children of Ephraim . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 八月第八班的班長是謝拉族戶沙人西比該；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite , of the Zerahites . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 九月第九班的班長是便雅憫族亞拿突人亞比以謝；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite , of the Benjamites . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 十月第十班的班長是謝拉族尼陀法人瑪哈萊；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite , of the Zerahites . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 十一月第十一班的班長是以法蓮族比拉頓人比拿雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite , of the children of Ephraim . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 十二月第十二班的班長是俄陀聶族尼陀法人黑玳；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite , of Othniel . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 管理以色列眾支派的記在下面：管呂便人的是細基利的兒子以利以謝；管西緬人的是瑪迦的兒子示法提雅；
verses.e: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel : of the Reubenites , Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler ; of the Simeonites , Shephatiah the son of Maacah ;

verses.z: 管利未人的是基母利的兒子哈沙比雅；管亞倫子孫的是撒督；
verses.e: of Levi , Hashabiah the son of Kemuel ; of Aaron , Zadok ;

verses.z: 管猶大人的是大衛的一個哥哥以利戶；管以薩迦人的是米迦勒的兒子暗利；
verses.e: of Judah , Elihu , one of the brothers of David ; of Issachar , Omri the son of Michael ;

verses.z: 管西布倫人的是俄巴第雅的兒子伊施瑪雅；管拿弗他利人的是亞斯列的兒子耶利摩；
verses.e: of Zebulun , Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah ; of Naphtali , Jeremoth the son of Azriel ;

verses.z: 正月第一班的班長是撒巴第業的兒子雅朔班；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 管以法蓮人的是阿撒細雅的兒子何細亞；管瑪拿西半支派的是毗大雅的兒子約珥；
verses.e: of the children of Ephraim , Hoshea the son of Azaziah ; of the half-tribe of Manasseh , Joel the son of Pedaiah ;

verses.z: 管基列地瑪拿西那半支派的是撒迦利亞的兒子易多；管便雅憫人的是押尼珥的兒子雅西業；
verses.e: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead , Iddo the son of Zechariah ; of Benjamin , Jaasiel the son of Abner ;

verses.z: 管但人的是耶羅罕的兒子亞薩列。以上是以色列眾支派的首領。
verses.e: of Dan , Azarel the son of Jeroham . These were the captains of the tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人二十歲以內的，大衛沒有記其數目；因耶和華曾應許說，必加增以色列人如天上的星那樣多。
verses.e: But David didn't take the number of them from twenty years old and under , because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky .

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子約押動手數點，當時[耶和華]的烈怒臨到以色列人；因此，沒有點完，數目也沒有寫在大衛王記上。
verses.e: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census , but didn't finish ; and wrath came on Israel for this . The number wasn't put into the account in the chronicles of King David .

verses.z: 掌管王府庫的是亞疊的兒子押斯馬威。掌管田野城邑村莊保障之倉庫的是烏西雅的兒子約拿單。
verses.e: Over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel . Over the treasures in the fields , in the cities , in the villages , and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah ;

verses.z: 掌管耕田種地的是基綠的兒子以斯利。
verses.e: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub .

verses.z: 掌管葡萄園的是拉瑪人示每。掌管葡萄園酒窖的是實弗米人撒巴底。
verses.e: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite . Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite .

verses.z: 掌管高原橄欖樹和桑樹的是基第利人巴勒‧哈南。掌管油庫的是約阿施。
verses.e: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite . Over the cellars of oil was Joash .

verses.z: 掌管沙崙牧放牛群的是沙崙人施提賚。掌管山谷牧養牛群的是亞第賚的兒子沙法。
verses.e: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite . Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai .

verses.z: 他是法勒斯的子孫，統管正月[班]的一切軍長。
verses.e: He was of the children of Perez , the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month .

verses.z: 掌管駝[群]的是以實瑪利人阿比勒。掌管驢[群]的是米崙人耶希底亞。掌管羊群的是夏甲人雅悉。
verses.e: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite . Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite . Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite .

verses.z: 這都是給大衛王掌管產業的。
verses.e: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David's .

verses.z: 大衛的叔叔約拿單作謀士；這人有智慧，又作書記。哈摩尼的兒子耶歇作王眾子的師傅。
verses.e: Also Jonathan , David's uncle , was a counselor , a man of understanding , and a scribe . Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons .

verses.z: 亞希多弗也作王的謀士。亞基人戶篩作王的陪伴。
verses.e: Ahithophel was the king's counselor . Hushai the Archite was the king's friend .

verses.z: 亞希多弗之後，有比拿雅的兒子耶何耶大和亞比亞他接續他[作謀士]。約押作王的元帥。
verses.e: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah , and Abiathar . Joab was the captain of the king's army .

verses.z: 二月的班長是亞哈希人朵代，還有副官密基羅；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division , and Mikloth the ruler ; and in his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 三月第三班的班長是祭司耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah , the son of Jehoiada the chief priest . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 這比拿雅是那三十人中的勇士，管理那三十人；他班內又有他兒子暗米薩拔。
verses.e: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty . Of his division was Ammizabad his son .

verses.z: 四月第四班的班長是約押的兄弟亞撒黑。接續他的是他兒子西巴第雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab , and Zebadiah his son after him . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 五月第五班的班長是伊斯拉人珊合；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 六月第六班的班長是提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉；他班內有二萬四千人。
verses.e: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite . In his division were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 大衛招聚以色列各支派的首領和輪班服事王的軍長，與千夫長、百夫長，掌管王和王子產業牲畜的，並太監，以及大能的勇士，都到耶路撒冷來。
verses.e: David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , the captains of the companies who served the king by division , the captains of thousands , the captains of hundreds , and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons , with the officers and the mighty men , even all the mighty men of valor , to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 你當謹慎，因耶和華揀選你建造殿宇作為聖所。你當剛強去行。」
verses.e: Take heed now , for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary . Be strong , and do it . "

verses.z: 大衛將[殿的]遊廊、旁屋、府庫、樓房、內殿，和施恩所的樣式指示他兒子所羅門，
verses.e: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple , for its houses , for its treasuries , for its upper rooms , for its inner rooms , for the place of the mercy seat ;

verses.z: 又將被靈感動所得的樣式，就是耶和華上帝殿的院子、周圍的房屋、殿的府庫，和聖物府庫的一切樣式都指示他；
verses.e: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit , for the courts of the LORD's house , for all the surrounding rooms , for the treasuries of God's house , and for the treasuries of the dedicated things ;

verses.z: 又指示他祭司和利未人的班次與耶和華殿裏各樣的工作，並耶和華殿裏一切器皿的樣式，
verses.e: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites , for all the work of the service of the LORD's house , and for all the vessels of service in the LORD's house —

verses.z: 以及各樣應用金器的分兩和各樣應用銀器的分兩，
verses.e: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service , for all the vessels of silver by weight , for all vessels of every kind of service ;

verses.z: 金燈臺和金燈的分兩，銀燈臺和銀燈的分兩，輕重各都合宜；
verses.e: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold , and for its lamps , of gold , by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps ; and for the lamp stands of silver , by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps , according to the use of every lamp stand ;

verses.z: 陳設餅金桌子的分兩，銀桌子的分兩，
verses.e: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread , for every table ; and silver for the tables of silver ;

verses.z: 精金的肉叉子、盤子，和爵的分兩，各金碗與各銀碗的分兩，
verses.e: and the forks , the basins , and the cups , of pure gold ; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl ; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl ;

verses.z: 精金香壇的分兩，並用金子做基路伯；基路伯張開[翅膀]，遮掩耶和華的約櫃。
verses.e: and for the altar of incense , refined gold by weight ; and gold for the plans for the chariot , and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD's covenant .

verses.z: [大衛]說：「這一切工作的樣式都是耶和華用手劃出來使我明白的。」
verses.e: " All this " , David said , " I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD's hand , even all the works of this pattern . "

verses.z: 大衛王就站起來，說：「我的弟兄，我的百姓啊，你們當聽我言，我心裏本想建造殿宇，安放耶和華的約櫃，作為我上帝的腳凳；我已經預備建造的材料。
verses.e: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said , " Hear me , my brothers and my people ! As for me , it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD's covenant , and for the footstool of our God ; and I had prepared for the building .

verses.z: 大衛又對他兒子所羅門說：「你當剛強壯膽去行！不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。因為耶和華上帝就是我的上帝，與你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丟棄你，直到耶和華殿的工作都完畢了。
verses.e: David said to Solomon his son , " Be strong and courageous , and do it . Don't be afraid , nor be dismayed , for the LORD God , even my God , is with you . He will not fail you nor forsake you , until all the work for the service of the LORD's house is finished .

verses.z: 有祭司和利未人的各班，為要辦理上帝殿各樣的事，又有靈巧的人在各樣的工作上樂意幫助你；並有眾首領和眾民一心聽從你的命令。」
verses.e: Behold , there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God's house . Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work . Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command . "

verses.z: 只是上帝對我說：『你不可為我的名建造殿宇；因你是戰士，流了人的血。』
verses.e: But God said to me , ' You shall not build a house for my name , because you are a man of war and have shed blood . '

verses.z: 然而，耶和華－以色列的上帝在我父的全家揀選我作以色列的王，直到永遠。因他揀選猶大為首領；在猶大支派中揀選我父家，在我父的眾子裏喜悅我，立我作以色列眾人的王。
verses.e: However the LORD , the God of Israel , chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever . For he has chosen Judah to be prince ; and in the house of Judah , the house of my father ; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華賜我許多兒子，在我兒子中揀選所羅門坐耶和華的國位，治理以色列人。
verses.e: Of all my sons ( for the LORD has given me many sons ) , he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD's kingdom over Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：『你兒子所羅門必建造我的殿和院宇；因為我揀選他作我的子，我也必作他的父。
verses.e: He said to me , ' Solomon , your son , shall build my house and my courts ; for I have chosen him to be my son , and I will be his father .

verses.z: 他若恆久遵行我的誡命典章如今日一樣，我就必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。』
verses.e: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances , as it is today . '

verses.z: 現今在耶和華的會中，以色列眾人眼前所說的，我們的上帝也聽見了。你們應當尋求耶和華－你們上帝的一切誡命，謹守遵行，如此你們可以承受這美地，遺留給你們的子孫，永遠為業。
verses.e: Now therefore , in the sight of all Israel , the LORD's assembly , and in the audience of our God , observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God , that you may possess this good land , and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever .

verses.z: 「我兒所羅門哪，你當認識耶和華－你父的上帝，誠心樂意地事奉他；因為他鑒察眾人的心，知道一切心思意念。你若尋求他，他必使你尋見；你若離棄他，他必永遠丟棄你。
verses.e: You , Solomon my son , know the God of your father , and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind ; for the LORD searches all hearts , and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts . If you seek him , he will be found by you ; but if you forsake him , he will cast you off forever .

verses.z: 大衛王對會眾說：「我兒子所羅門是上帝特選的，還年幼嬌嫩；這工程甚大，因這殿不是為人，乃是為耶和華上帝建造的。
verses.e: David the king said to all the assembly , " Solomon my son , whom alone God has chosen , is yet young and tender , and the work is great ; for the palace is not for man , but for the LORD God .

verses.z: 所以，大衛在會眾面前稱頌耶和華說：「耶和華－我們的父，以色列的上帝是應當稱頌，直到永永遠遠的！
verses.e: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly ; and David said , " You are blessed , LORD , the God of Israel our father , forever and ever .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，尊大、能力、榮耀、強勝、威嚴都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；國度也是你的，並且你為至高，為萬有之首。
verses.e: Yours , LORD , is the greatness , the power , the glory , the victory , and the majesty ! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours . Yours is the kingdom , LORD , and you are exalted as head above all .

verses.z: 豐富尊榮都從你而來，你也治理萬物。在你手裏有大能大力，使人尊大強盛都出於你。
verses.e: Both riches and honor come from you , and you rule over all ! In your hand is power and might ! It is in your hand to make great , and to give strength to all !

verses.z: 我們的上帝啊，現在我們稱謝你，讚美你榮耀之名！
verses.e: Now therefore , our God , we thank you and praise your glorious name .

verses.z: 「我算甚麼，我的民算甚麼，竟能如此樂意奉獻？因為萬物都從你而來，我們把從你而得的獻給你。
verses.e: But who am I , and what is my people , that we should be able to offer so willingly as this ? For all things come from you , and we have given you of your own .

verses.z: 我們在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，與我們列祖一樣。我們在世的日子如影兒，不能長存。
verses.e: For we are strangers before you and foreigners , as all our fathers were . Our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is no remaining .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，我們預備這許多材料，要為你的聖名建造殿宇，都是從你而來，都是屬你的。
verses.e: LORD our God , all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand , and is all your own .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，我知道你察驗人心，喜悅正直；我以正直的心樂意獻上這一切物。現在我喜歡見你的民在這裏都樂意奉獻與你。
verses.e: I know also , my God , that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness . As for me , in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things . Now I have seen with joy your people , who are present here , offer willingly to you .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的上帝啊，求你使你的民常存這樣的心思意念，堅定他們的心歸向你，
verses.e: LORD , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Israel , our fathers , keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people , and prepare their heart for you ;

verses.z: 又求你賜我兒子所羅門誠實的心，遵守你的命令、法度、律例，成就這一切的事，用我所預備的建造殿宇。」
verses.e: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart , to keep your commandments , your testimonies , and your statutes , and to do all these things , and to build the palace , for which I have made provision . "

verses.z: 我為我上帝的殿已經盡力，預備金子做金器，銀子做銀器，銅做銅器，鐵做鐵器，木做木器，還有紅瑪瑙可鑲嵌的寶石，彩石和一切的寶石，並許多漢白玉。
verses.e: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold , the silver for the things of silver , the bronze for the things of bronze , iron for the things of iron , and wood for the things of wood , also onyx stones , stones to be set , stones for inlaid work of various colors , all kinds of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .

verses.z: 大衛對全會眾說：「你們應當稱頌耶和華－你們的上帝。」於是會眾稱頌耶和華－他們列祖的上帝，低頭拜耶和華與王。
verses.e: Then David said to all the assembly , " Now bless the LORD your God ! " All the assembly blessed the LORD , the God of their fathers , and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king .

verses.z: 次日，他們向耶和華獻[平安]祭和燔祭，就是獻公牛一千隻，公綿羊一千隻，羊羔一千隻，並同獻的奠祭；又為以色列眾人獻許多的祭。那日，他們在耶和華面前吃喝，大大歡樂。
verses.e: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day , even one thousand bulls , one thousand rams , and one thousand lambs , with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel ,

verses.z: 他們奉耶和華的命再膏大衛的兒子所羅門作王，又膏撒督作祭司。
verses.e: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness . They made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him before the LORD to be prince , and Zadok to be priest .

verses.z: 於是所羅門坐在耶和華所賜的位上，接續他父親大衛作王，萬事亨通；以色列眾人也都聽從他。
verses.e: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father , and prospered ; and all Israel obeyed him .

verses.z: 眾首領和勇士，並大衛王的眾子，都順服所羅門王。
verses.e: All the princes , the mighty men , and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king .

verses.z: 耶和華使所羅門在以色列眾人眼前甚為尊大，極其威嚴，勝過在他以前的以色列王。
verses.e: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel , and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel .

verses.z: 耶西的兒子大衛作以色列眾人的王，
verses.e: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel .

verses.z: 作王共四十年：在希伯崙作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
verses.e: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years ; he reigned seven years in Hebron , and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他年紀老邁，日子滿足，享受豐富、尊榮，就死了。他兒子所羅門接續他作王。
verses.e: He died at a good old age , full of days , riches , and honor ; and Solomon his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 大衛王始終的事都寫在先見撒母耳的書上和先知拿單並先見迦得的書上。
verses.e: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they are written in the history of Samuel the seer , and in the history of Nathan the prophet , and in the history of Gad the seer ,

verses.z: 且因我心中愛慕我上帝的殿，就在預備建造聖殿的材料之外，又將我自己積蓄的金銀獻上，建造我上帝的殿，
verses.e: In addition , because I have set my affection on the house of my God , since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver , I give it to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house :

verses.z: 他的國事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列並列國所經過的事都寫在這書上。
verses.e: with all his reign and his might , and the events that involved him , Israel , and all the kingdoms of the lands .

verses.z: 就是俄斐金三千他連得、精鍊的銀子七千他連得，以貼殿牆。
verses.e: even three thousand talents of gold , of the gold of Ophir , and seven thousand talents of refined silver , with which to overlay the walls of the houses ;

verses.z: 金子做金器，銀子做銀器，並藉匠人的手製造一切。今日有誰樂意將自己獻給耶和華呢？」
verses.e: of gold for the things of gold , and of silver for the things of silver , and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans . Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD ? "

verses.z: 於是，眾族長和以色列各支派的首領、千夫長、百夫長，並監管王工的官長，都樂意獻上。
verses.e: Then the princes of the fathers ' households , and the princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers over the king's work , offered willingly ;

verses.z: 他們為上帝殿的使用獻上金子五千他連得零一萬達利克，銀子一萬他連得，銅一萬八千他連得，鐵十萬他連得。
verses.e: and they gave for the service of God's house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics , of silver ten thousand talents , of bronze eighteen thousand talents , and of iron one hundred thousand talents .

verses.z: 凡有[寶]石的都交給革順人耶歇，送入耶和華殿的府庫。
verses.e: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD's house , under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .

verses.z: 因這些人誠心樂意獻給耶和華，百姓就歡喜，大衛王也大大歡喜。
verses.e: Then the people rejoiced , because they offered willingly , because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD ; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy .

verses.z: 大衛在希伯崙所生的兒子記在下面：長子暗嫩是耶斯列人亞希暖生的。次子但以利是迦密人亞比該生的。
verses.e: Now these were the sons of David , who were born to him in Hebron : the firstborn , Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess ; the second , Daniel , of Abigail the Carmelitess ;

verses.z: 所羅門的兒子是羅波安；羅波安的兒子是亞比雅；亞比雅的兒子是亞撒；亞撒的兒子是約沙法；
verses.e: Solomon's son was Rehoboam , Abijah his son , Asa his son , Jehoshaphat his son ,

verses.z: 約沙法的兒子是約蘭；約蘭的兒子是亞哈謝；亞哈謝的兒子是約阿施；
verses.e: Joram his son , Ahaziah his son , Joash his son ,

verses.z: 約阿施的兒子是亞瑪謝；亞瑪謝的兒子是亞撒利雅；亞撒利雅的兒子是約坦；
verses.e: Amaziah his son , Azariah his son , Jotham his son ,

verses.z: 約坦的兒子是亞哈斯；亞哈斯的兒子是希西家；希西家的兒子是瑪拿西；
verses.e: Ahaz his son , Hezekiah his son , Manasseh his son ,

verses.z: 瑪拿西的兒子是亞們；亞們的兒子是約西亞；
verses.e: Amon his son , and Josiah his son .

verses.z: 約西亞的長子是約哈難，次子是約雅敬，三子是西底家，四子是沙龍。
verses.e: The sons of Josiah : the firstborn Johanan , the second Jehoiakim , the third Zedekiah , and the fourth Shallum .

verses.z: 約雅敬的兒子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。
verses.e: The sons of Jehoiakim : Jeconiah his son , and Zedekiah his son .

verses.z: 耶哥尼雅被擄。他的兒子是撒拉鐵、
verses.e: The sons of Jeconiah , the captive : Shealtiel his son ,

verses.z: 瑪基蘭、毗大雅、示拿薩、耶加米、何沙瑪、尼大比雅。
verses.e: Malchiram , Pedaiah , Shenazzar , Jekamiah , Hoshama , and Nedabiah .

verses.z: 毗大雅的兒子是所羅巴伯、示每。所羅巴伯的兒子是米書蘭、哈拿尼雅，他們的妹子名叫示羅密。
verses.e: The sons of Pedaiah : Zerubbabel and Shimei . The sons of Zerubbabel : Meshullam and Hananiah ; and Shelomith was their sister ;

verses.z: 三子押沙龍是基述王達買的女兒瑪迦生的。四子亞多尼雅是哈及生的。
verses.e: the third , Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur ; the fourth , Adonijah the son of Haggith ;

verses.z: 米書蘭的兒子是哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙‧希悉，共五人。
verses.e: and Hashubah , Ohel , Berechiah , Hasadiah , and Jushab Hesed , five .

verses.z: 哈拿尼雅的兒子是毗拉提、耶篩亞。還有利法雅的眾子，亞珥難的眾子，俄巴底亞的眾子，示迦尼的眾子。
verses.e: The sons of Hananiah : Pelatiah and Jeshaiah ; the sons of Rephaiah , the sons of Arnan , the sons of Obadiah , the sons of Shecaniah .

verses.z: 示迦尼的兒子是示瑪雅；示瑪雅的兒子是哈突、以甲、巴利亞、尼利雅、沙法，共六人。
verses.e: The son of Shecaniah : Shemaiah . The sons of Shemaiah : Hattush , Igal , Bariah , Neariah , and Shaphat , six .

verses.z: 尼利雅的兒子是以利約乃、希西家、亞斯利干，共三人。
verses.e: The sons of Neariah : Elioenai , Hizkiah , and Azrikam , three .

verses.z: 以利約乃的兒子是何大雅、以利亞實、毗萊雅、阿谷、約哈難、第萊雅、阿拿尼，共七人。
verses.e: The sons of Elioenai : Hodaviah , Eliashib , Pelaiah , Akkub , Johanan , Delaiah , and Anani , seven .

verses.z: 五子示法提雅是亞比她生的。六子以特念是大衛的妻以格拉生的。
verses.e: the fifth , Shephatiah of Abital ; the sixth , Ithream by Eglah his wife :

verses.z: 這六人都是大衛在希伯崙生的。大衛在希伯崙作王七年零六個月，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
verses.e: six were born to him in Hebron ; and he reigned there seven years and six months . He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 大衛在耶路撒冷所生的兒子是示米亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門。這四人是亞米利的女兒拔‧書亞生的。
verses.e: and these were born to him in Jerusalem : Shimea , Shobab , Nathan , and Solomon , four , by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel ;

verses.z: 還有益轄、以利沙瑪、以利法列、
verses.e: and Ibhar , Elishama , Eliphelet ,

verses.z: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亞、
verses.e: Nogah , Nepheg , Japhia ,

verses.z: 以利沙瑪、以利雅大、以利法列，共九人。
verses.e: Elishama , Eliada , and Eliphelet , nine .

verses.z: 這都是大衛的兒子，還有他們的妹子她瑪，妃嬪的兒子不在其內。
verses.e: All these were the sons of David , in addition to the sons of the concubines ; and Tamar was their sister .

verses.z: 猶大的兒子是法勒斯、希斯崙、迦米、戶珥、朔巴。
verses.e: The sons of Judah : Perez , Hezron , Carmi , Hur , and Shobal .

verses.z: 雅比斯求告以色列的上帝說：「甚願你賜福與我，擴張我的境界，常與我同在，保佑我不遭患難，不受艱苦。」上帝就應允他所求的。
verses.e: Jabez called on the God of Israel , saying , " Oh that you would bless me indeed , and enlarge my border ! May your hand be with me , and may you keep me from evil , that I may not cause pain ! " God granted him that which he requested .

verses.z: 書哈的弟兄基綠生米黑，米黑是伊施屯之祖。
verses.e: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir , who was the father of Eshton .

verses.z: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亞，並珥拿轄之祖提欣拿，這都是利迦人。
verses.e: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha , Paseah , and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash . These are the men of Recah .

verses.z: 基納斯的兒子是俄陀聶、西萊雅。俄陀聶的兒子是哈塔。
verses.e: The sons of Kenaz : Othniel and Seraiah . The sons of Othniel : Hathath .

verses.z: 憫挪太生俄弗拉；西萊雅生革‧夏納欣人之祖約押。他們都是匠人。
verses.e: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah : and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim , for they were craftsmen .

verses.z: 耶孚尼的兒子是迦勒；迦勒的兒子是以路、以拉、拿安。以拉的兒子是基納斯。
verses.e: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh : Iru , Elah , and Naam . The son of Elah : Kenaz .

verses.z: 耶哈利勒的兒子是西弗、西法、提利、亞撒列。
verses.e: The sons of Jehallelel : Ziph , Ziphah , Tiria , and Asarel .

verses.z: 以斯拉的兒子是益帖、米列、以弗、雅倫。米列娶法老女兒比提雅為妻，生米利暗、沙買，和以實提摩之祖益巴。米列又娶猶大女子為妻，生基多之祖雅列，梭哥之祖希伯，和撒挪亞之祖耶古鐵。
verses.e: The sons of Ezrah : Jether , Mered , Epher , and Jalon ; and Mered's wife bore Miriam , Shammai , and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa .
His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor , Heber the father of Soco , and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah . These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh , whom Mered took .

verses.z: 荷第雅的妻是拿含的妹子，她所生的兒子是迦米人基伊拉和瑪迦人以實提摩之祖。
verses.e: The sons of the wife of Hodiah , the sister of Naham , were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite .

verses.z: 朔巴的兒子利亞雅生雅哈；雅哈生亞戶買和拉哈。這是瑣拉人的諸族。
verses.e: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath ; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad . These are the families of the Zorathites .

verses.z: 示門的兒子是暗嫩、林拿、便‧哈南、提倫。以示的兒子是梭黑與便‧梭黑。
verses.e: The sons of Shimon : Amnon , Rinnah , Ben Hanan , and Tilon . The sons of Ishi : Zoheth , and Ben Zoheth .

verses.z: 猶大的兒子是示拉；示拉的兒子是利迦之祖珥，瑪利沙之祖拉大，和屬亞實比族織細麻布的各家。
verses.e: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah : Er the father of Lecah , Laadah the father of Mareshah , and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen , of the house of Ashbea ;

verses.z: 還有約敬、哥西巴人、約阿施、薩拉，就是在摩押地掌權的，又有雅叔比利恆。這都是古時所記載的。
verses.e: and Jokim , and the men of Cozeba , and Joash , and Saraph , who had dominion in Moab , and Jashubilehem . These records are ancient .

verses.z: 這些人都是窯匠，是尼他應和基低拉的居民；與王同處，為王做工。
verses.e: These were the potters , and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah ; they lived there with the king for his work .

verses.z: 西緬的兒子是尼母利、雅憫、雅立、謝拉、掃羅。
verses.e: The sons of Simeon : Nemuel , Jamin , Jarib , Zerah , Shaul ;

verses.z: 掃羅的兒子是沙龍；沙龍的兒子是米比衫；米比衫的兒子是米施瑪；
verses.e: Shallum his son , Mibsam his son , and Mishma his son .

verses.z: 米施瑪的兒子是哈母利；哈母利的兒子是撒刻；撒刻的兒子是示每。
verses.e: The sons of Mishma : Hammuel his son , Zaccur his son , Shimei his son .

verses.z: 示每有十六個兒子，六個女兒，他弟兄的兒女不多，他們各家不如猶大族的人丁增多。
verses.e: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters ; but his brothers didn't have many children , and all their family didn't multiply like the children of Judah .

verses.z: 西緬人住在別是巴、摩拉大、哈薩‧書亞、
verses.e: They lived at Beersheba , Moladah , Hazarshual ,

verses.z: 辟拉、以森、陀臘、
verses.e: at Bilhah , at Ezem , at Tolad ,

verses.z: 以坦之祖的兒子是耶斯列、伊施瑪、伊得巴；他們的妹子名叫哈悉勒玻尼。
verses.e: These were the sons of the father of Etam : Jezreel , Ishma , and Idbash . The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi .

verses.z: 彼土利、何珥瑪、洗革拉、
verses.e: at Bethuel , at Hormah , at Ziklag ,

verses.z: 伯‧瑪嘉博、哈薩‧蘇撒、伯‧比利、沙拉音，這些城邑直到大衛作王的時候都是屬西緬人的。
verses.e: at Beth Marcaboth , Hazar Susim , at Beth Biri , and at Shaaraim . These were their cities until David's reign .

verses.z: 他們的五個城邑是以坦、亞因、臨門、陀健、亞珊；
verses.e: Their villages were Etam , Ain , Rimmon , Tochen , and Ashan , five cities ;

verses.z: 還有屬城的鄉村，直到巴力。這是他們的住處，他們都有家譜。
verses.e: and all their villages that were around the same cities , as far as Baal . These were their settlements , and they kept their genealogy .

verses.z: 還有米所巴、雅米勒、亞瑪謝的兒子約沙、
verses.e: Meshobab , Jamlech , Joshah the son of Amaziah ,

verses.z: 約珥、約示比的兒子耶戶；約示比是西萊雅的兒子；西萊雅是亞薛的兒子。
verses.e: Joel , Jehu the son of Joshibiah , the son of Seraiah , the son of Asiel ,

verses.z: 還有以利約乃、雅哥巴、約朔海、亞帥雅、亞底業、耶西篾、比拿雅、
verses.e: Elioenai , Jaakobah , Jeshohaiah , Asaiah , Adiel , Jesimiel , Benaiah ,

verses.z: 示非的兒子細撒。示非是亞龍的兒子；亞龍是耶大雅的兒子；耶大雅是申利的兒子；申利是示瑪雅的兒子。
verses.e: and Ziza the son of Shiphi , the son of Allon , the son of Jedaiah , the son of Shimri , the son of Shemaiah —

verses.z: 以上所記的人名都是作族長的，他們宗族的人數增多。
verses.e: these mentioned by name were princes in their families . Their fathers ' houses increased greatly .

verses.z: 他們往平原東邊基多口去，尋找牧放羊群的草場，
verses.e: They went to the entrance of Gedor , even to the east side of the valley , to seek pasture for their flocks .

verses.z: 基多之祖是毗努伊勒。戶沙之祖是以謝珥。這都是伯利恆之祖以法她的長子戶珥所生的。
verses.e: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah . These are the sons of Hur , the firstborn of Ephrathah , the father of Bethlehem .

verses.z: 尋得肥美的草場地，又寬闊又平靜。從前住那裏的是含族的人。
verses.e: They found rich , good pasture , and the land was wide , and quiet , and peaceful , for those who lived there before were descended from Ham .

verses.z: 以上錄名的人，在猶大王希西家年間，來攻擊含族人的帳棚和那裏所有的米烏尼人，將他們滅盡，就住在他們的地方，直到今日，因為那裏有草場可以牧放羊群。
verses.e: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there ; and they destroyed them utterly to this day , and lived in their place , because there was pasture there for their flocks .

verses.z: 這西緬人中，有五百人上西珥山，率領他們的是以示的兒子毗拉提、尼利雅、利法雅，和烏薛，
verses.e: Some of them , even of the sons of Simeon , five hundred men , went to Mount Seir , having for their captains Pelatiah , Neariah , Rephaiah , and Uzziel , the sons of Ishi .

verses.z: 殺了逃脫剩下的亞瑪力人，就住在那裏直到今日。
verses.e: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped , and have lived there to this day .

verses.z: 提哥亞之祖亞施戶有兩個妻子：一名希拉，一名拿拉。
verses.e: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives , Helah and Naarah .

verses.z: 拿拉給亞施戶生亞戶撒、希弗、提米尼、哈轄斯他利。這都是拿拉的兒子。
verses.e: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam , Hepher , Temeni , and Haahashtari . These were the sons of Naarah .

verses.z: 希拉的兒子是洗列、瑣轄、伊提南。
verses.e: The sons of Helah were Zereth , Izhar , and Ethnan .

verses.z: 哥斯生亞諾、瑣比巴，並哈崙兒子亞哈黑的諸族。
verses.e: Hakkoz became the father of Anub , Zobebah , and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum .

verses.z: 雅比斯比他眾弟兄更尊貴，他母親給他起名叫雅比斯，意思說：我生他甚是痛苦。
verses.e: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers . His mother named him Jabez , saying , " Because I bore him with sorrow . "

verses.z: 以色列的長子原是呂便；因他污穢了父親的床，他長子的名分就歸了約瑟。只是按家譜他不算長子。
verses.e: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel ( for he was the firstborn , but because he defiled his father's couch , his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel ; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright .

verses.z: 掃羅年間，他們與夏甲人爭戰，夏甲人倒在他們手下，他們就在基列東邊的全地，住在夏甲人的帳棚裏。
verses.e: In the days of Saul , they made war with the Hagrites , who fell by their hand ; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead .

verses.z: 迦得的子孫在呂便對面，住在巴珊地，延到撒迦。
verses.e: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah :

verses.z: 他們中間有作族長的約珥，有作副族長的沙番，還有雅乃和住在巴珊的沙法。
verses.e: Joel the chief , Shapham the second , Janai , and Shaphat in Bashan .

verses.z: 他們族弟兄是米迦勒、米書蘭、示巴、約賴、雅干、細亞、希伯，共七人。
verses.e: Their brothers of their fathers ' houses : Michael , Meshullam , Sheba , Jorai , Jacan , Zia , and Eber , seven .

verses.z: 這都是亞比孩的兒子。亞比孩是戶利的兒子；戶利是耶羅亞的兒子；耶羅亞是基列的兒子；基列是米迦勒的兒子；米迦勒是耶示篩的兒子；耶示篩是耶哈多的兒子；耶哈多是布斯的兒子。
verses.e: These were the sons of Abihail , the son of Huri , the son of Jaroah , the son of Gilead , the son of Michael , the son of Jeshishai , the son of Jahdo , the son of Buz ;

verses.z: 還有古尼的孫子、押比疊的兒子亞希。這都是作族長的。
verses.e: Ahi the son of Abdiel , the son of Guni , chief of their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 他們住在基列與巴珊和巴珊的鄉村，並沙崙的郊野，直到四圍的交界。
verses.e: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns , and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders .

verses.z: 這些人在猶大王約坦並在以色列王耶羅波安年間，都載入家譜。
verses.e: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel .

verses.z: 呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人，能拿盾牌和刀劍、拉弓射箭、出征善戰的勇士共有四萬四千七百六十名。
verses.e: The sons of Reuben , the Gadites , and the half-tribe of Manasseh , of valiant men , men able to bear buckler and sword , able to shoot with bow , and skillful in war , were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war .

verses.z: 他們與夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人、挪答人爭戰。
verses.e: They made war with the Hagrites , with Jetur , and Naphish , and Nodab .

verses.z: 猶大勝過一切弟兄，君王也是從他而出；長子的名分卻歸約瑟。
verses.e: For Judah prevailed above his brothers , and from him came the prince ; but the birthright was Joseph's ) —

verses.z: 他們得了[上帝的]幫助，夏甲人和跟隨夏甲的人都交在他們手中；因為他們在陣上呼求上帝，倚賴上帝，上帝就應允他們。
verses.e: They were helped against them , and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand , and all who were with them ; for they cried to God in the battle , and he answered them because they put their trust in him .

verses.z: 他們擄掠了夏甲人的牲畜，有駱駝五萬，羊二十五萬，驢二千；又有人十萬。
verses.e: They took away their livestock : of their camels fifty thousand , and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand , and of donkeys two thousand , and of men one hundred thousand .

verses.z: 敵人被殺仆倒的甚多，因為這爭戰是出乎上帝。他們就住在敵人的地上，直到被擄的時候。
verses.e: For many fell slain , because the war was of God . They lived in their place until the captivity .

verses.z: 瑪拿西半支派的人住在那地。從巴珊延到巴力‧黑們、示尼珥與黑門山。
verses.e: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land . They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon , Senir , and Mount Hermon .

verses.z: 他們的族長是以弗、以示、以列、亞斯列、耶利米、何達威雅、雅疊，都是大能的勇士，是有名的人，也是作族長的。
verses.e: These were the heads of their fathers ' houses : Epher , Ishi , Eliel , Azriel , Jeremiah , Hodaviah , and Jahdiel — mighty men of valor , famous men , heads of their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 他們得罪了他們列祖的上帝，隨從那地之民的神行邪淫；這民就是上帝在他們面前所除滅的。
verses.e: They trespassed against the God of their fathers , and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them .

verses.z: 故此，以色列的上帝激動亞述王普勒和亞述王提革拉‧毗列色的心，他們就把呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人擄到哈臘、哈博、哈拉與歌散河邊，直到今日還在那裏。
verses.e: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria , and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria , and he carried away the Reubenites , the Gadites , and the half-tribe of Manasseh , and brought them to Halah , Habor , Hara , and to the river of Gozan , to this day .

verses.z: 以色列長子呂便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米。
verses.e: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel : Hanoch , Pallu , Hezron , and Carmi .

verses.z: 約珥的兒子是示瑪雅；示瑪雅的兒子是歌革；歌革的兒子是示每；
verses.e: The sons of Joel : Shemaiah his son , Gog his son , Shimei his son ,

verses.z: 示每的兒子是米迦；米迦的兒子是利亞雅；利亞雅的兒子是巴力；
verses.e: Micah his son , Reaiah his son , Baal his son ,

verses.z: 巴力的兒子是備拉。這備拉作呂便支派的首領，被亞述王提革拉‧毗列色擄去。
verses.e: and Beerah his son , whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive . He was prince of the Reubenites .

verses.z: 他的弟兄照着宗族，按着家譜作族長的是耶利、撒迦利雅、比拉。
verses.e: His brothers by their families , when the genealogy of their generations was listed : the chief , Jeiel , and Zechariah ,

verses.z: 比拉是亞撒的兒子；亞撒是示瑪的兒子；示瑪是約珥的兒子；約珥所住的地方是從亞羅珥直到尼波和巴力‧免，
verses.e: and Bela the son of Azaz , the son of Shema , the son of Joel , who lived in Aroer , even to Nebo and Baal Meon ;

verses.z: 又向東延到幼發拉底河這邊的曠野，因為他們在基列地牲畜增多。
verses.e: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates , because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead .

verses.z: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
verses.e: The sons of Levi : Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

verses.z: 約哈難生亞撒利雅（這亞撒利雅在所羅門於耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的職分）；
verses.e: Johanan became the father of Azariah , who executed the priest's office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 亞撒利雅生亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅生亞希突；
verses.e: Azariah became the father of Amariah . Amariah became the father of Ahitub .

verses.z: 亞希突生撒督；撒督生沙龍；
verses.e: Ahitub became the father of Zadok . Zadok became the father of Shallum .

verses.z: 沙龍生希勒家；希勒家生亞撒利雅；
verses.e: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah . Hilkiah became the father of Azariah .

verses.z: 亞撒利雅生西萊雅；西萊雅生約薩答。
verses.e: Azariah became the father of Seraiah . Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak .

verses.z: 當耶和華藉尼布甲尼撒的手擄掠猶大和耶路撒冷人的時候，這約薩答也被[擄去]。
verses.e: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar .

verses.z: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
verses.e: The sons of Levi : Gershom , Kohath , and Merari .

verses.z: 革順的兒子名叫立尼、示每。
verses.e: These are the names of the sons of Gershom : Libni and Shimei .

verses.z: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
verses.e: The sons of Kohath were Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel .

verses.z: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示。這是按着利未人宗族分的各家。
verses.e: The sons of Merari : Mahli and Mushi . These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers ' households .

verses.z: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
verses.e: The sons of Kohath : Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel .

verses.z: 革順的兒子是立尼；立尼的兒子是雅哈；雅哈的兒子是薪瑪；
verses.e: Of Gershom : Libni his son , Jahath his son , Zimmah his son ,

verses.z: 薪瑪的兒子是約亞；約亞的兒子是易多；易多的兒子是謝拉；謝拉的兒子是耶特賴。
verses.e: Joah his son , Iddo his son , Zerah his son , and Jeatherai his son .

verses.z: 哥轄的兒子是亞米拿達；亞米拿達的兒子是可拉；可拉的兒子是亞惜；
verses.e: The sons of Kohath : Amminadab his son , Korah his son , Assir his son ,

verses.z: 亞惜的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是以比雅撒；以比雅撒的兒子是亞惜；
verses.e: Elkanah his son , Ebiasaph his son , Assir his son ,

verses.z: 亞惜的兒子是他哈；他哈的兒子是烏列；烏列的兒子是烏西雅；烏西雅的兒子是少羅。
verses.e: Tahath his son , Uriel his son , Uzziah his son , and Shaul his son .

verses.z: 以利加拿的兒子是亞瑪賽和亞希摩。
verses.e: The sons of Elkanah : Amasai and Ahimoth .

verses.z: 亞希摩的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是瑣菲；瑣菲的兒子是拿哈；
verses.e: As for Elkanah , the sons of Elkanah : Zophai his son , Nahath his son ,

verses.z: 拿哈的兒子是以利押；以利押的兒子是耶羅罕；耶羅罕的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是撒母耳。
verses.e: Eliab his son , Jeroham his son , and Elkanah his son .

verses.z: 撒母耳的長子是約珥，次子是亞比亞。
verses.e: The sons of Samuel : the firstborn , Joel , and the second , Abijah .

verses.z: 米拉利的兒子是抹利；抹利的兒子是立尼；立尼的兒子是示每；示每的兒子是烏撒；
verses.e: The sons of Merari : Mahli , Libni his son , Shimei his son , Uzzah his son ,

verses.z: 暗蘭的兒子是亞倫、摩西，還有女兒米利暗。亞倫的兒子是拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
verses.e: The children of Amram : Aaron , Moses , and Miriam . The sons of Aaron : Nadab , Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .

verses.z: 烏撒的兒子是示米亞；示米亞的兒子是哈基雅；哈基雅的兒子是亞帥雅。
verses.e: Shimea his son , Haggiah his son , Asaiah his son .

verses.z: 約櫃安設之後，大衛派人在耶和華殿中管理歌唱的事。
verses.e: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD's house after the ark came to rest there .

verses.z: 他們就在會幕前當歌唱的差，及至所羅門在耶路撒冷建造了耶和華的殿，他們便按着班次供職。
verses.e: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD's house in Jerusalem . They performed the duties of their office according to their order .

verses.z: 供職的人和他們的子孫記在下面：哥轄的子孫中有歌唱的希幔。希幔是約珥的兒子；約珥是撒母耳的兒子；
verses.e: These are those who served , and their sons . Of the sons of the Kohathites : Heman the singer , the son of Joel , the son of Samuel ,

verses.z: 撒母耳是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是耶羅罕的兒子；耶羅罕是以列的兒子；以列是陀亞的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Eliel , the son of Toah ,

verses.z: 陀亞是蘇弗的兒子；蘇弗是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是瑪哈的兒子；瑪哈是亞瑪賽的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Zuph , the son of Elkanah , the son of Mahath , the son of Amasai ,

verses.z: 亞瑪賽是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是約珥的兒子；約珥是亞撒利雅的兒子；亞撒利雅是西番雅的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Elkanah , the son of Joel , the son of Azariah , the son of Zephaniah ,

verses.z: 西番雅是他哈的兒子；他哈是亞惜的兒子；亞惜是以比雅撒的兒子；以比雅撒是可拉的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Tahath , the son of Assir , the son of Ebiasaph , the son of Korah ,

verses.z: 可拉是以斯哈的兒子；以斯哈是哥轄的兒子；哥轄是利未的兒子；利未是以色列的兒子。
verses.e: the son of Izhar , the son of Kohath , the son of Levi , the son of Israel .

verses.z: 希幔的族兄亞薩是比利家的兒子，亞薩在希幔右邊供職。比利家是示米亞的兒子；
verses.e: His brother Asaph , who stood on his right hand , even Asaph the son of Berechiah , the son of Shimea ,

verses.z: 以利亞撒生非尼哈；非尼哈生亞比書；
verses.e: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas , Phinehas became the father of Abishua ,

verses.z: 示米亞是米迦勒的兒子；米迦勒是巴西雅的兒子；巴西雅是瑪基雅的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Michael , the son of Baaseiah , the son of Malchijah ,

verses.z: 瑪基雅是伊特尼的兒子；伊特尼是謝拉的兒子；謝拉是亞大雅的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Ethni , the son of Zerah , the son of Adaiah ,

verses.z: 亞大雅是以探的兒子；以探是薪瑪的兒子；薪瑪是示每的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Ethan , the son of Zimmah , the son of Shimei ,

verses.z: 示每是雅哈的兒子；雅哈是革順的兒子。革順是利未的兒子。
verses.e: the son of Jahath , the son of Gershom , the son of Levi .

verses.z: 他們的族弟兄米拉利的子孫，在他們左邊供職的有以探。以探是基示的兒子；基示是亞伯底的兒子；亞伯底是瑪鹿的兒子；
verses.e: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari : Ethan the son of Kishi , the son of Abdi , the son of Malluch ,

verses.z: 瑪鹿是哈沙比雅的兒子；哈沙比雅是亞瑪謝的兒子；亞瑪謝是希勒家的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Hashabiah , the son of Amaziah , the son of Hilkiah ,

verses.z: 希勒家是暗西的兒子；暗西是巴尼的兒子；巴尼是沙麥的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Amzi , the son of Bani , the son of Shemer ,

verses.z: 沙麥是末力的兒子；末力是母示的兒子；母示是米拉利的兒子；米拉利是利未的兒子。
verses.e: the son of Mahli , the son of Mushi , the son of Merari , the son of Levi .

verses.z: 他們的族弟兄利未人也被派辦上帝殿中的一切事。
verses.e: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God's house .

verses.z: 亞倫和他的子孫在燔祭壇和香壇上獻祭燒香，又在至聖所辦理一切的事，為以色列人贖罪，是照上帝僕人摩西所吩咐的。
verses.e: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering , and on the altar of incense , for all the work of the most holy place , and to make atonement for Israel , according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded .

verses.z: 亞比書生布基；布基生烏西；
verses.e: Abishua became the father of Bukki . Bukki became the father of Uzzi .

verses.z: 亞倫的兒子是以利亞撒；以利亞撒的兒子是非尼哈；非尼哈的兒子是亞比書；
verses.e: These are the sons of Aaron : Eleazar his son , Phinehas his son , Abishua his son ,

verses.z: 亞比書的兒子是布基；布基的兒子是烏西；烏西的兒子是西拉希雅；
verses.e: Bukki his son , Uzzi his son , Zerahiah his son ,

verses.z: 西拉希雅的兒子是米拉約；米拉約的兒子是亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅的兒子是亞希突；
verses.e: Meraioth his son , Amariah his son , Ahitub his son ,

verses.z: 亞希突的兒子是撒督；撒督的兒子是亞希瑪斯。
verses.e: Zadok his son , and Ahimaaz his son .

verses.z: 他們的住處按着境內的營寨，記在下面：哥轄族亞倫的子孫[先]拈鬮得地，
verses.e: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders : to the sons of Aaron , of the families of the Kohathites ( for theirs was the first lot ) ,

verses.z: 在猶大地中得了希伯崙和四圍的郊野；
verses.e: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah , and its pasture lands around it ;

verses.z: 只是屬城的田地和村莊都為耶孚尼的兒子迦勒所得。
verses.e: but the fields of the city and its villages , they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh .

verses.z: 亞倫的子孫得了逃城希伯崙，又得了立拿與其郊野，雅提珥、以實提莫與其郊野；
verses.e: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge , Hebron , Libnah also with its pasture lands , Jattir , Eshtemoa with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 希崙與其郊野，底璧與其郊野，
verses.e: Hilen with its pasture lands , Debir with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 亞珊與其郊野，伯‧示麥與其郊野。
verses.e: Ashan with its pasture lands , and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands ;

verses.z: 烏西生西拉希雅；西拉希雅生米拉約；
verses.e: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah . Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth .

verses.z: 在便雅憫支派的地中，得了迦巴與其郊野，阿勒篾與其郊野，亞拿突與其郊野。他們諸家所得的城共十三座。
verses.e: and out of the tribe of Benjamin , Geba with its pasture lands , Allemeth with its pasture lands , and Anathoth with its pasture lands . All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities .

verses.z: 哥轄族其餘的人又拈鬮，在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。
verses.e: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot , out of the family of the tribe , out of the half-tribe , the half of Manasseh , ten cities .

verses.z: 革順族按着宗族，在以薩迦支派的地中，亞設支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊內瑪拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。
verses.e: To the sons of Gershom , according to their families , out of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .

verses.z: 米拉利族按着宗族拈鬮，在呂便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布倫支派的地中，得了十二座城。
verses.e: To the sons of Merari were given by lot , according to their families , out of the tribe of Reuben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun , twelve cities .

verses.z: 以色列人將這些城與其郊野給了利未人。
verses.e: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands .

verses.z: 這以上錄名的城，在猶大、西緬、便雅憫三支派的地中，以色列人拈鬮給了他們。
verses.e: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin , these cities which are mentioned by name .

verses.z: 哥轄族中有幾家在以法蓮支派的地中也得了城邑，
verses.e: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim .

verses.z: 在以法蓮山地得了逃城示劍與其郊野，又得了基色與其郊野，
verses.e: They gave to them the cities of refuge , Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 約緬與其郊野，伯‧和崙與其郊野，
verses.e: Jokmeam with its pasture lands , Beth Horon with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 亞雅崙與其郊野，迦特‧臨門與其郊野。
verses.e: Aijalon with its pasture lands , Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands ;

verses.z: 米拉約生亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅生亞希突；
verses.e: Meraioth became the father of Amariah . Amariah became the father of Ahitub .

verses.z: 哥轄族其餘的人在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了亞乃與其郊野，比連與其郊野。
verses.e: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh , Aner with its pasture lands , and Bileam with its pasture lands , for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath .

verses.z: 革順族在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥蘭與其郊野，亞斯他錄與其郊野；
verses.e: To the sons of Gershom were given , out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh , Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands , and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands ;

verses.z: 又在以薩迦支派的地中得了基低斯與其郊野，大比拉與其郊野，
verses.e: and out of the tribe of Issachar , Kedesh with its pasture lands , Daberath with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 拉末與其郊野，亞年與其郊野；
verses.e: Ramoth with its pasture lands , and Anem with its pasture lands ;

verses.z: 在亞設支派的地中得了瑪沙與其郊野，押頓與其郊野，
verses.e: and out of the tribe of Asher , Mashal with its pasture lands , Abdon with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 戶割與其郊野，利合與其郊野；
verses.e: Hukok with its pasture lands , and Rehob with its pasture lands ;

verses.z: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯與其郊野，哈們與其郊野，基列亭與其郊野。
verses.e: and out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands , Hammon with its pasture lands , and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands .

verses.z: 還有米拉利族的人在西布倫支派的地中得了臨摩挪與其郊野，他泊與其郊野；
verses.e: To the rest of the Levites , the sons of Merari , were given , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Rimmono with its pasture lands , and Tabor with its pasture lands ;

verses.z: 又在耶利哥的約旦河東，在呂便支派的地中得了曠野的比悉與其郊野，雅哈撒與其郊野，
verses.e: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho , on the east side of the Jordan , were given them out of the tribe of Reuben : Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands , Jahzah with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 基底莫與其郊野，米法押與其郊野；
verses.e: Kedemoth with its pasture lands , and Mephaath with its pasture lands ;

verses.z: 亞希突生撒督；撒督生亞希瑪斯；
verses.e: Ahitub became the father of Zadok . Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz .

verses.z: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末與其郊野，瑪哈念與其郊野，
verses.e: and out of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands , Mahanaim with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 希實本與其郊野，雅謝與其郊野。
verses.e: Heshbon with its pasture lands , and Jazer with its pasture lands .

verses.z: 亞希瑪斯生亞撒利雅；亞撒利雅生約哈難；
verses.e: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah . Azariah became the father of Johanan .

verses.z: 以薩迦的兒子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述、伸崙，共四人。
verses.e: Of the sons of Issachar : Tola , Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .

verses.z: 耶疊的兒子是比勒罕；比勒罕的兒子是耶烏施、便雅憫、以忽、基拿拿、細坦、他施、亞希沙哈。
verses.e: The son of Jediael : Bilhan . The sons of Bilhan : Jeush , Benjamin , Ehud , Chenaanah , Zethan , Tarshish , and Ahishahar .

verses.z: 這都是耶疊的兒子，都是族長，是大能的勇士；他們的子孫能上陣打仗的，共有一萬七千二百人。
verses.e: All these were sons of Jediael , according to the heads of their fathers ' households , mighty men of valor , seventeen thousand two hundred , who were able to go out in the army for war .

verses.z: 還有以珥的兒子書品、戶品，並亞黑的兒子戶伸。
verses.e: So were Shuppim , Huppim , the sons of Ir , Hushim , and the sons of Aher .

verses.z: 拿弗他利的兒子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龍。這都是辟拉的子孫。
verses.e: The sons of Naphtali : Jahziel , Guni , Jezer , Shallum , and the sons of Bilhah .

verses.z: 瑪拿西的兒子亞斯列是他妾亞蘭人所生的，又生了基列之父瑪吉。
verses.e: The sons of Manasseh : Asriel , whom his concubine the Aramitess bore . She bore Machir the father of Gilead .

verses.z: 瑪吉娶的妻是戶品、書品的妹子，名叫瑪迦。瑪拿西的次子名叫西羅非哈；西羅非哈但有幾個女兒。
verses.e: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim , whose sister's name was Maacah . The name of the second was Zelophehad ; and Zelophehad had daughters .

verses.z: 瑪吉的妻瑪迦生了一個兒子，起名叫毗利施。毗利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的兒子是烏蘭和利金。
verses.e: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son , and she named him Peresh . The name of his brother was Sheresh ; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem .

verses.z: 烏蘭的兒子是比但。這都是基列的子孫。基列是瑪吉的兒子，瑪吉是瑪拿西的兒子。
verses.e: The sons of Ulam : Bedan . These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh .

verses.z: 基列的妹子哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亞比以謝、瑪拉。（
verses.e: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod , Abiezer , and Mahlah .

verses.z: 示米大的兒子是亞現、示劍、利克希、阿尼安。）
verses.e: The sons of Shemida were Ahian , Shechem , Likhi , and Aniam .

verses.z: 陀拉的兒子是烏西、利法雅、耶勒、雅買、易伯散、示母利，都是陀拉的族長，是大能的勇士。到大衛年間，他們的人數共有二萬二千六百名。
verses.e: The sons of Tola : Uzzi , Rephaiah , Jeriel , Jahmai , Ibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their fathers ' houses , of Tola ; mighty men of valor in their generations . Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 以法蓮的兒子是書提拉；書提拉的兒子是比列；比列的兒子是他哈；他哈的兒子是以拉大；以拉大的兒子是他哈；
verses.e: The sons of Ephraim : Shuthelah , Bered his son , Tahath his son , Eleadah his son , Tahath his son ,

verses.z: 他哈的兒子是撒拔；撒拔的兒子是書提拉。以法蓮又生以謝、以列；這二人因為下去奪取迦特人的牲畜，被本地的迦特人殺了。
verses.e: Zabad his son , Shuthelah his son , Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed , because they came down to take away their livestock .

verses.z: 他們的父親以法蓮為他們悲哀了多日，他的弟兄都來安慰他。
verses.e: Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brothers came to comfort him .

verses.z: 以法蓮與妻同房，他妻就懷孕生了一子，以法蓮因為家裏遭禍，就給這兒子起名叫比利亞。
verses.e: He went in to his wife , and she conceived and bore a son , and he named him Beriah , because there was trouble with his house .

verses.z: 他的女兒名叫舍伊拉，就是建築上伯‧和崙、下伯‧和崙與烏羨‧舍伊拉的。
verses.e: His daughter was Sheerah , who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper , and Uzzen Sheerah .

verses.z: 比利亞的兒子是利法和利悉。利悉的兒子是他拉；他拉的兒子是他罕；
verses.e: Rephah was his son , Resheph his son , Telah his son , Tahan his son ,

verses.z: 他罕的兒子是拉但；拉但的兒子是亞米忽；亞米忽的兒子是以利沙瑪；
verses.e: Ladan his son , Ammihud his son , Elishama his son ,

verses.z: 以利沙瑪的兒子是嫩；嫩的兒子是約書亞。
verses.e: Nun his son , and Joshua his son .

verses.z: 以法蓮人的地業和住處是伯特利與其村莊；東邊拿蘭，西邊基色與其村莊；示劍與其村莊，直到迦薩與其村莊；
verses.e: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns , and eastward Naaran , and westward Gezer with its towns ; Shechem also and its towns , to Azzah and its towns ;

verses.z: 還有靠近瑪拿西人的境界，伯‧善與其村莊；他納與其村莊；米吉多與其村莊；多珥與其村莊。以色列兒子約瑟的子孫住在這些地方。
verses.e: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh , Beth Shean and its towns , Taanach and its towns , Megiddo and its towns , and Dor and its towns . The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these .

verses.z: 烏西的兒子是伊斯拉希；伊斯拉希的兒子是米迦勒、俄巴底亞、約珥、伊示雅，共五人，都是族長。
verses.e: The son of Uzzi : Izrahiah . The sons of Izrahiah : Michael , Obadiah , Joel , and Isshiah , five ; all of them chief men .

verses.z: 亞設的兒子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韋、比利亞，還有他們的妹子西拉。
verses.e: The sons of Asher : Imnah , Ishvah , Ishvi , and Beriah . Serah was their sister .

verses.z: 比利亞的兒子是希別、瑪結；瑪結是比撒威的父親。
verses.e: The sons of Beriah : Heber and Malchiel , who was the father of Birzaith .

verses.z: 希別生雅弗勒、朔默、何坦，和他們的妹子書雅。
verses.e: Heber became the father of Japhlet , Shomer , Hotham , and Shua their sister .

verses.z: 雅弗勒的兒子是巴薩、賓哈、亞施法。這都是雅弗勒的兒子。
verses.e: The sons of Japhlet : Pasach , Bimhal , and Ashvath . These are the children of Japhlet .

verses.z: 朔默的兒子是亞希、羅迦、耶戶巴、亞蘭。
verses.e: The sons of Shemer : Ahi , Rohgah , Jehubbah , and Aram .

verses.z: 朔默兄弟希連的兒子是瑣法、音那、示利斯、亞抹。
verses.e: The sons of Helem his brother : Zophah , Imna , Shelesh , and Amal .

verses.z: 瑣法的兒子是書亞、哈尼弗、書阿勒、比利、音拉、
verses.e: The sons of Zophah : Suah , Harnepher , Shual , Beri , Imrah ,

verses.z: 比悉、河得、珊瑪、施沙、益蘭、比拉。
verses.e: Bezer , Hod , Shamma , Shilshah , Ithran , and Beera .

verses.z: 益帖的兒子是耶孚尼、毗斯巴、亞拉。
verses.e: The sons of Jether : Jephunneh , Pispa , and Ara .

verses.z: 烏拉的兒子是亞拉、漢尼業、利寫。
verses.e: The sons of Ulla : Arah , Hanniel , and Rizia .

verses.z: 他們所率領的，按着宗族出戰的軍隊，共有三萬六千人，因為他們的妻和子眾多。
verses.e: With them , by their generations , after their fathers ' houses , were bands of the army for war , thirty-six thousand ; for they had many wives and sons .

verses.z: 這都是亞設的子孫，都是族長，是精壯大能的勇士，也是首領中的頭目，按着家譜計算，他們的子孫能出戰的共有二萬六千人。
verses.e: All these were the children of Asher , heads of the fathers ' houses , choice and mighty men of valor , chief of the princes . The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men .

verses.z: 他們的族弟兄在以薩迦各族中都是大能的勇士，按着家譜計算共有八萬七千人。
verses.e: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar , mighty men of valor , listed in all by genealogy , were eighty-seven thousand .

verses.z: 便雅憫[的兒子]是比拉、比結、耶疊，共三人。
verses.e: The sons of Benjamin : Bela , Becher , and Jediael , three .

verses.z: 比拉的兒子是以斯本、烏西、烏薛、耶利摩、以利，共五人，都是族長，是大能的勇士。按着家譜計算，他們的子孫共有二萬二千零三十四人。
verses.e: The sons of Bela : Ezbon , Uzzi , Uzziel , Jerimoth , and Iri , five ; heads of fathers ' houses , mighty men of valor ; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four .

verses.z: 比結的兒子是細米拉、約阿施、以利以謝、以利約乃、暗利、耶利摩、亞比雅、亞拿突、亞拉篾。這都是比結的兒子。
verses.e: The sons of Becher : Zemirah , Joash , Eliezer , Elioenai , Omri , Jeremoth , Abijah , Anathoth , and Alemeth . All these were the sons of Becher .

verses.z: 他們都是族長，是大能的勇士。按着家譜計算，他們的子孫共有二萬零二百人。
verses.e: They were listed by genealogy , after their generations , heads of their fathers ' houses , mighty men of valor , twenty thousand two hundred .

verses.z: 便雅憫的長子比拉，次子亞實別，三子亞哈拉，
verses.e: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn , Ashbel the second , Aharah the third ,

verses.z: 耶烏斯、沙迦、米瑪。他這些兒子都是族長。
verses.e: Jeuz , Shachia , and Mirmah . These were his sons , heads of fathers ' households .

verses.z: 他的妻戶伸給他生的兒子有亞比突、以利巴力。
verses.e: By Hushim , he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal .

verses.z: 以利巴力的兒子是希伯、米珊、沙麥。沙麥建立阿挪和羅德二城與其村莊。
verses.e: The sons of Elpaal : Eber , Misham , and Shemed , who built Ono and Lod , with its towns ;

verses.z: 又有比利亞和示瑪是亞雅崙居民的族長，是驅逐迦特人的。
verses.e: and Beriah and Shema , who were heads of fathers ' households of the inhabitants of Aijalon , who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath ;

verses.z: 亞希約、沙煞、耶利末、
verses.e: and Ahio , Shashak , Jeremoth ,

verses.z: 西巴第雅、亞拉得、亞得、
verses.e: Zebadiah , Arad , Eder ,

verses.z: 米迦勒、伊施巴、約哈都是比利亞的兒子。
verses.e: Michael , Ishpah , Joha , the sons of Beriah ,

verses.z: 西巴第雅、米書蘭、希西基、希伯、
verses.e: Zebadiah , Meshullam , Hizki , Heber ,

verses.z: 伊施米萊、伊斯利亞、約巴都是以利巴力的兒子。
verses.e: Ishmerai , Izliah , Jobab , the sons of Elpaal ,

verses.z: 雅金、細基利、撒底、
verses.e: Jakim , Zichri , Zabdi ,

verses.z: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。
verses.e: Nohah the fourth , and Rapha the fifth .

verses.z: 以利乃、洗勒太、以列、
verses.e: Elienai , Zillethai , Eliel ,

verses.z: 亞大雅、比拉雅、申拉都是示每的兒子。
verses.e: Adaiah , Beraiah , Shimrath , the sons of Shimei ,

verses.z: 伊施班、希伯、以列、
verses.e: Ishpan , Eber , Eliel ,

verses.z: 亞伯頓、細基利、哈難、
verses.e: Abdon , Zichri , Hanan ,

verses.z: 哈拿尼雅、以攔、安陀提雅、
verses.e: Hananiah , Elam , Anthothijah ,

verses.z: 伊弗底雅、毗努伊勒都是沙煞的兒子。
verses.e: Iphdeiah , Penuel , the sons of Shashak ,

verses.z: 珊示萊、示哈利、亞他利雅、
verses.e: Shamsherai , Shehariah , Athaliah ,

verses.z: 雅利西、以利亞、細基利都是耶羅罕的兒子。
verses.e: Jaareshiah , Elijah , Zichri , and the sons of Jeroham .

verses.z: 這些人都是著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: These were heads of fathers ' households throughout their generations , chief men . These lived in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；
verses.e: The father of Gibeon , whose wife's name was Maacah , lived in Gibeon

verses.z: 比拉的兒子是亞大、基拉、亞比忽、
verses.e: Bela had sons : Addar , Gera , Abihud ,

verses.z: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、拿答、
verses.e: with his firstborn son Abdon , Zur , Kish , Baal , Nadab ,

verses.z: 基多、亞希約、撒迦、米基羅。
verses.e: Gedor , Ahio , Zecher ,

verses.z: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。
verses.e: and Mikloth , who became the father of Shimeah . They also lived with their families in Jerusalem , near their relatives .

verses.z: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施‧巴力。
verses.e: Ner became the father of Kish . Kish became the father of Saul . Saul became the father of Jonathan , Malchishua , Abinadab , and Eshbaal .

verses.z: 約拿單的兒子是米力‧巴力；米力‧巴力生米迦。
verses.e: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal . Merib-baal became the father of Micah .

verses.z: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯；
verses.e: The sons of Micah : Pithon , Melech , Tarea , and Ahaz .

verses.z: 亞哈斯生耶何阿達；耶何阿達生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；
verses.e: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah . Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth , Azmaveth , and Zimri . Zimri became the father of Moza .

verses.z: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞的兒子是拉法；拉法的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。
verses.e: Moza became the father of Binea . Raphah was his son , Eleasah his son , and Azel his son .

verses.z: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。
verses.e: Azel had six sons , whose names are these : Azrikam , Bocheru , Ishmael , Sheariah , Obadiah , and Hanan . All these were the sons of Azel .

verses.z: 亞悉兄弟以設的長子是烏蘭，次子耶烏施，三子是以利法列。
verses.e: The sons of Eshek his brother : Ulam his firstborn , Jeush the second , and Eliphelet the third .

verses.z: 亞比書、乃幔、亞何亞、
verses.e: Abishua , Naaman , Ahoah ,

verses.z: 烏蘭的兒子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他們有許多的子孫，共一百五十名，都是便雅憫人。
verses.e: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor , archers , and had many sons , and grandsons , one hundred fifty . All these were of the sons of Benjamin .

verses.z: 基拉、示孚汛、戶蘭。
verses.e: Gera , Shephuphan , and Huram .

verses.z: 以忽的兒子作迦巴居民的族長，被擄到瑪拿轄；
verses.e: These are the sons of Ehud . These are the heads of fathers ' households of the inhabitants of Geba , who were carried captive to Manahath :

verses.z: 以忽的兒子乃幔、亞希亞、基拉也被擄去。基拉生烏撒、亞希忽。
verses.e: Naaman , Ahijah , and Gera , who carried them captive ; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud .

verses.z: 沙哈連休他二妻戶伸和巴拉之後，在摩押地生了兒子。
verses.e: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab , after he had sent them away . Hushim and Baara were his wives .

verses.z: 他與妻賀得同房，生了約巴、洗比雅、米沙、瑪拉干、
verses.e: By Hodesh his wife , he became the father of Jobab , Zibia , Mesha , Malcam ,

verses.z: 以色列人都按家譜計算，寫在以色列諸王記上。猶大人因犯罪就被擄到巴比倫。
verses.e: So all Israel were listed by genealogies ; and behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel . Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience .

verses.z: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
verses.e: Of the priests : Jedaiah , Jehoiarib , Jachin ,

verses.z: 還有管理上帝殿希勒家的兒子亞薩利雅。希勒家是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是撒督的兒子；撒督是米拉約的兒子；米拉約是亞希突的兒子。
verses.e: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah , the son of Meshullam , the son of Zadok , the son of Meraioth , the son of Ahitub , the ruler of God's house ;

verses.z: 有瑪基雅的曾孫、巴施戶珥的孫子、耶羅罕的兒子亞大雅，又有亞第業的兒子瑪賽；亞第業是雅希細拉的兒子；雅希細拉是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是米實利密的兒子；米實利密是音麥的兒子。
verses.e: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham , the son of Pashhur , the son of Malchijah ; and Maasai the son of Adiel , the son of Jahzerah , the son of Meshullam , the son of Meshillemith , the son of Immer ;

verses.z: 他們和眾弟兄都是族長，共有一千七百六十人，是善於做上帝殿使用之工的。
verses.e: and their brothers , heads of their fathers ' houses , one thousand seven hundred sixty ; they were very able men for the work of the service of God's house .

verses.z: 利未人米拉利的子孫中，有哈沙比雅的曾孫、押利甘的孫子、哈述的兒子示瑪雅。
verses.e: Of the Levites : Shemaiah the son of Hasshub , the son of Azrikam , the son of Hashabiah , of the sons of Merari ;

verses.z: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，並亞薩的曾孫、細基利的孫子、米迦的兒子瑪探雅，
verses.e: and Bakbakkar , Heresh , Galal , and Mattaniah the son of Mica , the son of Zichri , the son of Asaph ,

verses.z: 又有耶杜頓的曾孫、迦拉的孫子、示瑪雅的兒子俄巴底，還有以利加拿的孫子、亞撒的兒子比利家。他們都住在尼陀法人的村莊。
verses.e: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah , the son of Galal , the son of Jeduthun ; and Berechiah the son of Asa , the son of Elkanah , who lived in the villages of the Netophathites .

verses.z: 守門的是沙龍、亞谷、達們、亞希幔，和他們的弟兄；沙龍為長。
verses.e: The gatekeepers : Shallum , Akkub , Talmon , Ahiman , and their brothers ( Shallum was the chief ) ,

verses.z: 從前這些人看守朝東的王門，如今是利未營中守門的。
verses.e: who previously served in the king's gate eastward . They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi .

verses.z: 可拉的曾孫、以比雅撒的孫子、可利的兒子沙龍，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，並守會幕的門。他們的祖宗曾管理耶和華的營盤，又把守營門。
verses.e: Shallum was the son of Kore , the son of Ebiasaph , the son of Korah , and his brothers , of his father's house , the Korahites , were over the work of the service , keepers of the thresholds of the tent . Their fathers had been over the LORD's camp , keepers of the entry .

verses.z: 先從巴比倫回來，住在自己地業城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提寧[的首領]。
verses.e: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel , the priests , the Levites , and the temple servants .

verses.z: 從前以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈管理他們，耶和華也與他同在。
verses.e: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past , and the LORD was with him .

verses.z: 米施利米雅的兒子撒迦利雅是看守會幕之門的。
verses.e: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 被選守門的人共有二百一十二名。他們在自己的村莊，按着家譜計算，是大衛和先見撒母耳所派當這緊要職任的。
verses.e: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve . These were listed by genealogy in their villages , whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust .

verses.z: 他們和他們的子孫按着班次看守耶和華殿的門，就是會幕的門。
verses.e: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD's house , even the house of the tent , as guards .

verses.z: 在東西南北，四方都有守門的。
verses.e: On the four sides were the gatekeepers , toward the east , west , north , and south .

verses.z: 他們的族弟兄住在村莊，每七日來與他們換班。
verses.e: Their brothers , in their villages , were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them ,

verses.z: 這四個門領都是利未人，各有緊要的職任，看守上帝殿的倉庫。
verses.e: for the four chief gatekeepers , who were Levites , were in an office of trust , and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God's house .

verses.z: 他們住在上帝殿的四圍，是因委託他們守殿，要每日早晨開門。
verses.e: They stayed around God's house , because that was their duty ; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning .

verses.z: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着數目拿出拿入；
verses.e: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service , for these were brought in by count , and these were taken out by count .

verses.z: 又有人管理器具和聖所的器皿，並細麵、酒、油、乳香、香料。
verses.e: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture , and over all the vessels of the sanctuary , over the fine flour , the wine , the oil , the frankincense , and the spices .

verses.z: 住在耶路撒冷的有猶大人、便雅憫人、以法蓮人、瑪拿西人。
verses.e: In Jerusalem , there lived of the children of Judah , of the children of Benjamin , and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh :

verses.z: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。
verses.e: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices .

verses.z: 利未人瑪他提雅是可拉族沙龍的長子，他緊要的職任是管理盤中烤的物。
verses.e: Mattithiah , one of the Levites , who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite , had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans .

verses.z: 他們族弟兄哥轄子孫中，有管理陳設餅的，每安息日預備擺列。
verses.e: Some of their brothers , of the sons of the Kohathites , were over the show bread , to prepare it every Sabbath .

verses.z: 歌唱的有利未人的族長，住在[屬殿的]房屋，晝夜供職，不做別樣的工。
verses.e: These are the singers , heads of fathers ' households of the Levites , who lived in the rooms and were free from other service , for they were employed in their work day and night .

verses.z: 以上都是利未人著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: These were heads of fathers ' households of the Levites , throughout their generations , chief men . They lived at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；
verses.e: Jeiel the father of Gibeon , whose wife's name was Maacah , lived in Gibeon .

verses.z: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
verses.e: His firstborn son was Abdon , then Zur , Kish , Baal , Ner , Nadab ,

verses.z: 基多、亞希約、撒迦利雅、米基羅。
verses.e: Gedor , Ahio , Zechariah , and Mikloth .

verses.z: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。
verses.e: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam . They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem , near their relatives .

verses.z: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施‧巴力。
verses.e: Ner became the father of Kish . Kish became the father of Saul . Saul became the father of Jonathan , Malchishua , Abinadab , and Eshbaal .

verses.z: 猶大兒子法勒斯的子孫中有烏太。烏太是亞米忽的兒子；亞米忽是暗利的兒子；暗利是音利的兒子；音利是巴尼的兒子。
verses.e: Uthai the son of Ammihud , the son of Omri , the son of Imri , the son of Bani , of the children of Perez the son of Judah .

verses.z: 約拿單的兒子是米力‧巴力；米力‧巴力生米迦。
verses.e: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal . Merib-baal became the father of Micah .

verses.z: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯。
verses.e: The sons of Micah : Pithon , Melech , Tahrea , and Ahaz .

verses.z: 亞哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；
