verses.e: Ahaz became the father of Jarah . Jarah became the father of Alemeth , Azmaveth , and Zimri . Zimri became the father of Moza .

verses.z: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞生利法雅；利法雅的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。
verses.e: Moza became the father of Binea , Rephaiah his son , Eleasah his son , and Azel his son .

verses.z: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。
verses.e: Azel had six sons , whose names are Azrikam , Bocheru , Ishmael , Sheariah , Obadiah , and Hanan . These were the sons of Azel .

verses.z: 示羅的子孫中有長子亞帥雅和他的眾子。
verses.e: Of the Shilonites : Asaiah the firstborn and his sons .

verses.z: 謝拉的子孫中有耶烏利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。
verses.e: Of the sons of Zerah : Jeuel and their brothers , six hundred ninety .

verses.z: 便雅憫人中有哈西努的曾孫、何達威雅的孫子、米書蘭的兒子撒路，
verses.e: Of the sons of Benjamin : Sallu the son of Meshullam , the son of Hodaviah , the son of Hassenuah ;

verses.z: 又有耶羅罕的兒子伊比尼雅，米基立的孫子、烏西的兒子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孫、流珥的孫子、示法提雅的兒子米書蘭，
verses.e: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham , and Elah the son of Uzzi , the son of Michri ; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah , the son of Reuel , the son of Ibnijah ;

verses.z: 和他們的族弟兄，按着家譜[計算]共有九百五十六名。這些人都是他們的族長。
verses.e: and their brothers , according to their generations , nine hundred fifty-six . All these men were heads of fathers ' households by their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 奉上帝旨意，蒙召作耶穌基督使徒的保羅，同兄弟所提尼，
verses.e: Paul , called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God , and our brother Sosthenes ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，我藉我們主耶穌基督的名勸你們都說一樣的話。你們中間也不可分黨，只要一心一意，彼此相合。
verses.e: Now I beg you , brothers , through the name of our Lord , Jesus Christ , that you all speak the same thing , and that there be no divisions among you , but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment .

verses.z: 因為革來氏[家裏]的人曾對我提起弟兄們來，說你們中間有紛爭。
verses.e: For it has been reported to me concerning you , my brothers , by those who are from Chloe's household , that there are contentions among you .

verses.z: 我的意思就是你們各人說：「我是屬保羅的」；「我是屬亞波羅的」；「我是屬磯法的」；「我是屬基督的」。
verses.e: Now I mean this , that each one of you says , " I follow Paul , " " I follow Apollos , " " I follow Cephas , " and , " I follow Christ . "

verses.z: 基督是分開的嗎？保羅為你們釘了十字架嗎？你們是奉保羅的名受了洗嗎？
verses.e: Is Christ divided ? Was Paul crucified for you ? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul ?

verses.z: 我感謝上帝，除了基利司布並該猶以外，我沒有給你們一個人施洗，
verses.e: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius ,

verses.z: 免得有人說，你們是奉我的名受洗。
verses.e: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name .

verses.z: 我也給司提法那家施過洗，此外給別人施洗沒有，我卻記不清。
verses.e: ( I also baptized the household of Stephanas ; besides them , I don't know whether I baptized any other . )

verses.z: 基督差遣我，原不是為施洗，乃是為傳福音，並不用智慧的言語，免得基督的十字架落了空。
verses.e: For Christ sent me not to baptize , but to preach the Good News — not in wisdom of words , so that the cross of Christ wouldn't be made void .

verses.z: 因為十字架的道理，在那滅亡的人為愚拙；在我們得救的人，卻為上帝的大能。
verses.e: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying , but to us who are being saved it is the power of God .

verses.z: 就如[經上]所記：我要滅絕智慧人的智慧，廢棄聰明人的聰明。
verses.e: For it is written , " I will destroy the wisdom of the wise . I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing . "

verses.z: 寫信給在哥林多上帝的教會，就是在基督耶穌裏成聖、蒙召作聖徒的，以及所有在各處求告我主耶穌基督之名的人。基督是他們的[主]，也是我們的[主]。
verses.e: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth — those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus , called saints , with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place , both theirs and ours :

verses.z: 智慧人在哪裏？文士在哪裏？這世上的辯士在哪裏？上帝豈不是叫這世上的智慧變成愚拙嗎？
verses.e: Where is the wise ? Where is the scribe ? Where is the debater of this age ? Hasn't God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?

verses.z: 世人憑自己的智慧，既不認識上帝，上帝就樂意用[人所當作]愚拙的道理拯救那些信的人；這就是上帝的智慧了。
verses.e: For seeing that in the wisdom of God , the world through its wisdom didn't know God , it was God's good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe .

verses.z: 猶太人是要神蹟，希臘人是求智慧，
verses.e: For Jews ask for signs , Greeks seek after wisdom ,

verses.z: 我們卻是傳釘十字架的基督，在猶太人為絆腳石，在外邦人為愚拙；
verses.e: but we preach Christ crucified , a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks ,

verses.z: 但在那蒙召的，無論是猶太人、希臘人，基督總為上帝的能力，上帝的智慧。
verses.e: but to those who are called , both Jews and Greeks , Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God ;

verses.z: 因上帝的愚拙總比人智慧，上帝的軟弱總比人強壯。
verses.e: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men , and the weakness of God is stronger than men .

verses.z: 弟兄們哪，可見你們蒙召的，按着肉體有智慧的不多，有能力的不多，有尊貴的也不多。
verses.e: For you see your calling , brothers , that not many are wise according to the flesh , not many mighty , and not many noble ;

verses.z: 上帝卻揀選了世上愚拙的，叫有智慧的羞愧；又揀選了世上軟弱的，叫那強壯的羞愧。
verses.e: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise . God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong .

verses.z: 上帝也揀選了世上卑賤的，被人厭惡的，以及那無有的，為要廢掉那有的，
verses.e: God chose the lowly things of the world , and the things that are despised , and the things that don't exist , that he might bring to nothing the things that exist ,

verses.z: 使一切有血氣的，在上帝面前一個也不能自誇。
verses.e: that no flesh should boast before God .

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安從上帝我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們。
verses.e: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 但你們得在基督耶穌裏是本乎上帝，上帝又使他成為我們的智慧、公義、聖潔、救贖。
verses.e: Because of him , you are in Christ Jesus , who was made to us wisdom from God , and righteousness and sanctification , and redemption ,

verses.z: 如[經上]所記：「誇口的，當指着主誇口。」
verses.e: that , as it is written , " He who boasts , let him boast in the Lord . "

verses.z: 我常為你們感謝我的上帝，因上帝在基督耶穌裏所賜給你們的恩惠；
verses.e: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 又因你們在他裏面凡事富足，口才、知識都全備，
verses.e: that in everything you were enriched in him , in all speech and all knowledge —

verses.z: 正如[我為]基督[作]的見證，在你們心裏得以堅固，
verses.e: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you —

verses.z: 以致你們在恩賜上沒有一樣不及人的，等候我們的主耶穌基督顯現。
verses.e: so that you come behind in no gift , waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 他也必堅固你們到底，叫你們在我們主耶穌基督的日子無可責備。
verses.e: who will also confirm you until the end , blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 上帝是信實的，你們原是被他所召，好與他兒子－我們的主耶穌基督一同得分。
verses.e: God is faithful , through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son , Jesus Christ our Lord .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不曉得，我們的祖宗從前都在雲下，都從海中經過，
verses.e: Now I would not have you ignorant , brothers , that our fathers were all under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;

verses.z: 你們也不要發怨言，像他們有發怨言的，就被滅命的所滅。
verses.e: Don't grumble , as some of them also grumbled , and perished by the destroyer .

verses.z: 他們遭遇這些事都要作為鑑戒，並且寫[在經上]，正是警戒我們這末世的人。
verses.e: Now all these things happened to them by way of example , and they were written for our admonition , on whom the ends of the ages have come .

verses.z: 所以，自己以為站得穩的，須要謹慎，免得跌倒。
verses.e: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn't fall .

verses.z: 你們所遇見的試探，無非是人所能受的。上帝是信實的，必不叫你們受試探過於所能受的；在受試探的時候，總要給你們開一條出路，叫你們能忍受得住。
verses.e: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man . God is faithful , who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able , but will with the temptation also make the way of escape , that you may be able to endure it .

verses.z: 我所親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們要逃避拜偶像的事。
verses.e: Therefore , my beloved , flee from idolatry .

verses.z: 我好像對明白人說的，你們要審察我的話。
verses.e: I speak as to wise men . Judge what I say .

verses.z: 我們所祝福的杯，豈不是同領基督的血嗎？我們所擘開的餅，豈不是同領基督的身體嗎？
verses.e: The cup of blessing which we bless , isn't it a sharing of the blood of Christ ? The bread which we break , isn't it a sharing of the body of Christ ?

verses.z: 我們雖多，仍是一個餅，一個身體，因為我們都是分受這一個餅。
verses.e: Because there is one loaf of bread , we , who are many , are one body ; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread .

verses.z: 你們看屬肉體的以色列人，那吃祭物的豈不是在祭壇上有分嗎？
verses.e: Consider Israel according to the flesh . Don't those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar ?

verses.z: 我是怎麼說呢？豈是說祭偶像之物算得甚麼呢？或說偶像算得甚麼呢？
verses.e: What am I saying then ? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything , or that an idol is anything ?

verses.z: 都在雲裏、海裏受洗歸了摩西；
verses.e: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea ;

verses.z: 我乃是說，外邦人所獻的祭是祭鬼，不是祭上帝。我不願意你們與鬼相交。
verses.e: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice , they sacrifice to demons and not to God , and I don't desire that you would have fellowship with demons .

verses.z: 你們不能喝主的杯又喝鬼的杯，不能吃主的筵席又吃鬼的筵席。
verses.e: You can't both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons . You can't both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons .

verses.z: 我們可惹主的憤恨嗎？我們比他還有能力嗎？
verses.e: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy ? Are we stronger than he ?

verses.z: 凡事都可行，但不都有益處。凡事都可行，但不都造就人。
verses.e: " All things are lawful for me , " but not all things are profitable . " All things are lawful for me , " but not all things build up .

verses.z: 無論何人，不要求自己的益處，乃要求別人的益處。
verses.e: Let no one seek his own , but each one his neighbor's good .

verses.z: 凡市上所賣的，你們只管吃，不要為良心的緣故問甚麼話，
verses.e: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop , eat , asking no question for the sake of conscience ,

verses.z: 因為地和其中所充滿的都屬乎主。
verses.e: for " the earth is the Lord's , and its fullness . "

verses.z: 倘有一個不信的人請你們[赴席]，你們若願意去，凡擺在你們面前的，只管吃，不要為良心的緣故問甚麼話。
verses.e: But if one of those who don't believe invites you to a meal , and you are inclined to go , eat whatever is set before you , asking no questions for the sake of conscience .

verses.z: 若有人對你們說：「這是獻過祭的物」，就要為那告訴你們的人，並為良心的緣故不吃。
verses.e: But if anyone says to you , " This was offered to idols , " don't eat it for the sake of the one who told you , and for the sake of conscience . For " the earth is the Lord's , with all its fullness . "

verses.z: 我說的良心不是你的，乃是他的。我這自由為甚麼被別人的良心論斷呢？
verses.e: Conscience , I say , not your own , but the other's conscience . For why is my liberty judged by another conscience ?

verses.z: 並且都吃了一樣的靈食，
verses.e: and all ate the same spiritual food ;

verses.z: 我若謝恩而吃，為甚麼因我謝恩的物被人毀謗呢？
verses.e: If I partake with thankfulness , why am I denounced for something I give thanks for ?

verses.z: 所以，你們或吃或喝，無論做甚麼，都要為榮耀上帝而行。
verses.e: Whether therefore you eat or drink , or whatever you do , do all to the glory of God .

verses.z: 不拘是猶太人，是希臘人，是上帝的教會，你們都不要使他跌倒；
verses.e: Give no occasion for stumbling , whether to Jews , to Greeks , or to the assembly of God ;

verses.z: 就好像我凡事都叫眾人喜歡，不求自己的益處，只求眾人的益處，叫他們得救。
verses.e: even as I also please all men in all things , not seeking my own profit , but the profit of the many , that they may be saved .

verses.z: 也都喝了一樣的靈水。所喝的，是出於隨着他們的靈磐石；那磐石就是基督。
verses.e: and all drank the same spiritual drink . For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them , and the rock was Christ .

verses.z: 但他們中間多半是上帝不喜歡的人，所以在曠野倒斃。
verses.e: However with most of them , God was not well pleased , for they were overthrown in the wilderness .

verses.z: 這些事都是我們的鑑戒，叫我們不要貪戀惡事，像他們那樣貪戀的；
verses.e: Now these things were our examples , to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted .

verses.z: 也不要拜偶像，像他們有人拜的。如[經上]所記：「百姓坐下吃喝，起來玩耍。」
verses.e: Don't be idolaters , as some of them were . As it is written , " The people sat down to eat and drink , and rose up to play . "

verses.z: 我們也不要行姦淫，像他們有人行的，一天就倒斃了二萬三千人；
verses.e: Let's not commit sexual immorality , as some of them committed , and in one day twenty-three thousand fell .

verses.z: 也不要試探主，像他們有人試探的，就被蛇所滅。
verses.e: Let's not test Christ , as some of them tested , and perished by the serpents .

verses.z: 你們該效法我，像我效法基督一樣。
verses.e: Be imitators of me , even as I also am of Christ .

verses.z: 因此，女人為天使的緣故，應當在頭上有服權柄的[記號]。
verses.e: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head , because of the angels .

verses.z: 然而照主的安排，女也不是無男，男也不是無女。
verses.e: Nevertheless , neither is the woman independent of the man , nor the man independent of the woman , in the Lord .

verses.z: 因為女人原是由男人而出，男人也是由女人而出；但萬有都是出乎上帝。
verses.e: For as woman came from man , so a man also comes through a woman ; but all things are from God .

verses.z: 你們自己審察，女人禱告上帝，不蒙着頭是合宜的嗎？
verses.e: Judge for yourselves . Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled ?

verses.z: 你們的本性不也指示你們，男人若有長頭髮，便是他的羞辱嗎？
verses.e: Doesn't even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair , it is a dishonor to him ?

verses.z: 但女人有長頭髮，乃是她的榮耀，因為這頭髮是給她作蓋頭的。
verses.e: But if a woman has long hair , it is a glory to her , for her hair is given to her for a covering .

verses.z: 若有人想要辯駁，我們卻沒有這樣的規矩，上帝的眾教會也是沒有的。
verses.e: But if any man seems to be contentious , we have no such custom , neither do God's assemblies .

verses.z: 我現今吩咐你們的話，不是稱讚你們；因為你們聚會不是受益，乃是招損。
verses.e: But in giving you this command I don't praise you , because you come together not for the better but for the worse .

verses.z: 第一，我聽說，你們聚會的時候彼此分門別類，我也稍微地信這話。
verses.e: For first of all , when you come together in the assembly , I hear that divisions exist among you , and I partly believe it .

verses.z: 在你們中間不免有分門結黨的事，好叫那些有經驗的人顯明出來。
verses.e: For there also must be factions among you , that those who are approved may be revealed among you .

verses.z: 我稱讚你們，因你們凡事記念我，又堅守我所傳給你們的。
verses.e: Now I praise you , brothers , that you remember me in all things , and hold firm the traditions , even as I delivered them to you .

verses.z: 你們聚會的時候，算不得吃主的晚餐；
verses.e: When therefore you assemble yourselves together , it is not the Lord's supper that you eat .

verses.z: 因為吃的時候，各人先吃自己的飯，甚至這個飢餓，那個酒醉。
verses.e: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first . One is hungry , and another is drunken .

verses.z: 你們要吃喝，難道沒有家嗎？還是藐視上帝的教會，叫那沒有的羞愧呢？我向你們可怎麼說呢？可因此稱讚你們嗎？我不稱讚！
verses.e: What , don't you have houses to eat and to drink in ? Or do you despise God's assembly and put them to shame who don't have enough ? What shall I tell you ? Shall I praise you ? In this I don't praise you .

verses.z: 我當日傳給你們的，原是從主領受的，就是主耶穌被賣的那一夜，拿起餅來，
verses.e: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you , that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread .

verses.z: 祝謝了，就擘開，說：「這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。」
verses.e: When he had given thanks , he broke it and said , " Take , eat . This is my body , which is broken for you . Do this in memory of me . "

verses.z: 飯後，也照樣拿起杯來，說：「這杯是用我的血所立的新約，你們每逢喝的時候，要如此行，為的是記念我。」
verses.e: In the same way he also took the cup after supper , saying , " This cup is the new covenant in my blood . Do this , as often as you drink , in memory of me . "

verses.z: 你們每逢吃這餅，喝這杯，是表明主的死，直等到他來。
verses.e: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup , you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes .

verses.z: 所以，無論何人，不按理吃主的餅，喝主的杯，就是干犯主的身、主的血了。
verses.e: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord's cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord .

verses.z: 人應當自己省察，然後吃這餅、喝這杯。
verses.e: But let a man examine himself , and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup .

verses.z: 因為人吃喝，若不分辨是[主的]身體，就是吃喝自己的罪了。
verses.e: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn't discern the Lord's body .

verses.z: 我願意你們知道，基督是各人的頭；男人是女人的頭；上帝是基督的頭。
verses.e: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ , and the head of the woman is man , and the head of Christ is God .

verses.z: 因此，在你們中間有好些軟弱的與患病的，死的也不少。
verses.e: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly , and not a few sleep .

verses.z: 我們若是先分辨自己，就不至於受審。
verses.e: For if we discerned ourselves , we wouldn't be judged .

verses.z: 我們受審的時候，乃是被主懲治，免得我們和世人一同定罪。
verses.e: But when we are judged , we are disciplined by the Lord , that we may not be condemned with the world .

verses.z: 所以我弟兄們，你們聚會吃的時候，要彼此等待。
verses.e: Therefore , my brothers , when you come together to eat , wait for one another .

verses.z: 若有人飢餓，可以在家裏先吃，免得你們聚會，自己取罪。其餘的事，我來的時候再安排。
verses.e: But if anyone is hungry , let him eat at home , lest your coming together be for judgment . The rest I will set in order whenever I come .

verses.z: 凡男人禱告或是講道，若蒙着頭，就羞辱自己的頭。
verses.e: Every man praying or prophesying , having his head covered , dishonors his head .

verses.z: 凡女人禱告或是講道，若不蒙着頭，就羞辱自己的頭，因為這就如同剃了頭髮一樣。
verses.e: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head . For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved .

verses.z: 女人若不蒙着頭，就該剪了頭髮；女人若以剪髮、剃髮為羞愧，就該蒙着頭。
verses.e: For if a woman is not covered , let her hair also be cut off . But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved , let her be covered .

verses.z: 男人本不該蒙着頭，因為他是上帝的形像和榮耀；但女人是男人的榮耀。
verses.e: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered , because he is the image and glory of God , but the woman is the glory of the man .

verses.z: 起初，男人不是由女人而出，女人乃是由男人而出；
verses.e: For man is not from woman , but woman from man ;

verses.z: 並且男人不是為女人造的，女人乃是為男人造的。
verses.e: for man wasn't created for the woman , but woman for the man .

verses.z: 弟兄們，論到屬靈的[恩賜]，我不願意你們不明白。
verses.e: Now concerning spiritual things , brothers , I don't want you to be ignorant .

verses.z: 又叫一人能行異能，又叫一人能作先知，又叫一人能辨別諸靈，又叫一人能說方言，又叫一人能翻方言。
verses.e: and to another workings of miracles , and to another prophecy , and to another discerning of spirits , to another different kinds of languages , and to another the interpretation of languages .

verses.z: 這一切都是這位[聖]靈所運行、隨己意分給各人的。
verses.e: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these , distributing to each one separately as he desires .

verses.z: 就如身子是一個，卻有許多肢體；而且肢體雖多，仍是一個身子；基督也是這樣。
verses.e: For as the body is one and has many members , and all the members of the body , being many , are one body ; so also is Christ .

verses.z: 我們不拘是猶太人，是希臘人，是為奴的，是自主的，都從一位[聖]靈受洗，成了一個身體，飲於一位[聖]靈。
verses.e: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body , whether Jews or Greeks , whether bond or free ; and were all given to drink into one Spirit .

verses.z: 身子原不是一個肢體，乃是許多肢體。
verses.e: For the body is not one member , but many .

verses.z: 設若腳說：「我不是手，所以不屬乎身子，」它不能因此就不屬乎身子。
verses.e: If the foot would say , " Because I'm not the hand , I'm not part of the body , " it is not therefore not part of the body .

verses.z: 設若耳說：「我不是眼，所以不屬乎身子，」它也不能因此就不屬乎身子。
verses.e: If the ear would say , " Because I'm not the eye , I'm not part of the body , " it's not therefore not part of the body .

verses.z: 若全身是眼，從哪裏聽聲呢？若全身是耳，從哪裏聞味呢？
verses.e: If the whole body were an eye , where would the hearing be ? If the whole were hearing , where would the smelling be ?

verses.z: 但如今，上帝隨自己的意思把肢體俱各安排在身上了。
verses.e: But now God has set the members , each one of them , in the body , just as he desired .

verses.z: 若都是一個肢體，身子在哪裏呢？
verses.e: If they were all one member , where would the body be ?

verses.z: 你們作外邦人的時候，隨事被牽引，受迷惑，去服事那啞巴偶像，這是你們知道的。
verses.e: You know that when you were heathen , you were led away to those mute idols , however you might be led .

verses.z: 但如今肢體是多的，身子卻是一個。
verses.e: But now they are many members , but one body .

verses.z: 眼不能對手說：「我用不着你。」頭也不能對腳說：「我用不着你。」
verses.e: The eye can't tell the hand , " I have no need for you , " or again the head to the feet , " I have no need for you . "

verses.z: 不但如此，身上肢體人以為軟弱的，更是不可少的。
verses.e: No , much rather , those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary .

verses.z: 身上肢體，我們看為不體面的，越發給它加上體面；不俊美的，越發得着俊美。
verses.e: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable , on those we bestow more abundant honor ; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty ,

verses.z: 我們俊美的肢體，自然用不着裝飾；但上帝配搭這身子，把加倍的體面給那有缺欠的肢體，
verses.e: while our presentable parts have no such need . But God composed the body together , giving more abundant honor to the inferior part ,

verses.z: 免得身上分門別類，總要肢體彼此相顧。
verses.e: that there should be no division in the body , but that the members should have the same care for one another .

verses.z: 若一個肢體受苦，所有的肢體就一同受苦；若一個肢體得榮耀，所有的肢體就一同快樂。
verses.e: When one member suffers , all the members suffer with it . When one member is honored , all the members rejoice with it .

verses.z: 你們就是基督的身子，並且各自作肢體。
verses.e: Now you are the body of Christ , and members individually .

verses.z: 上帝在教會所設立的：第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教師，其次是行異能的，再次是得恩賜醫病的，幫助人的，治理事的，說方言的。
verses.e: God has set some in the assembly : first apostles , second prophets , third teachers , then miracle workers , then gifts of healings , helps , governments , and various kinds of languages .

verses.z: 豈都是使徒嗎？豈都是先知嗎？豈都是教師嗎？豈都是行異能的嗎？
verses.e: Are all apostles ? Are all prophets ? Are all teachers ? Are all miracle workers ?

verses.z: 所以我告訴你們，被上帝的靈感動的，沒有說「耶穌是可咒詛」的；若不是被[聖]靈感動的，也沒有能說「耶穌是主」的。
verses.e: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God's Spirit says , " Jesus is accursed . " No one can say , " Jesus is Lord , " but by the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 豈都是得恩賜醫病的嗎？豈都是說方言的嗎？豈都是翻方言的嗎？
verses.e: Do all have gifts of healings ? Do all speak with various languages ? Do all interpret ?

verses.z: 你們要切切地求那更大的恩賜。我現今把最妙的道指示你們。
verses.e: But earnestly desire the best gifts . Moreover , I show a most excellent way to you .

verses.z: 恩賜原有分別，[聖]靈卻是一位。
verses.e: Now there are various kinds of gifts , but the same Spirit .

verses.z: 職事也有分別，主卻是一位。
verses.e: There are various kinds of service , and the same Lord .

verses.z: 功用也有分別，上帝卻是一位，在眾人裏面運行一切的事。
verses.e: There are various kinds of workings , but the same God who works all things in all .

verses.z: [聖]靈顯在各人身上，是叫人得益處。
verses.e: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all .

verses.z: 這人蒙[聖]靈賜他智慧的言語，那人也蒙這位[聖]靈賜他知識的言語，
verses.e: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom , and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit ,

verses.z: 又有一人蒙這位[聖]靈賜他信心，還有一人蒙這位[聖]靈賜他醫病的恩賜，
verses.e: to another faith by the same Spirit , and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit ,

verses.z: 我若能說萬人的方言，並天使的話語，卻沒有愛，我就成了鳴的鑼，響的鈸一般。
verses.e: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels , but don't have love , I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal .

verses.z: 等那完全的來到，這有限的必歸於無有了。
verses.e: but when that which is complete has come , then that which is partial will be done away with .

verses.z: 我作孩子的時候，話語像孩子，心思像孩子，意念像孩子，既成了人，就把孩子的事丟棄了。
verses.e: When I was a child , I spoke as a child , I felt as a child , I thought as a child . Now that I have become a man , I have put away childish things .

verses.z: 我們如今彷彿對着鏡子觀看，模糊不清，到那時就要面對面了。我如今所知道的有限，到那時就全知道，如同主知道我一樣。
verses.e: For now we see in a mirror , dimly , but then face to face . Now I know in part , but then I will know fully , even as I was also fully known .

verses.z: 如今常存的有信，有望，有愛這三樣，其中最大的是愛。
verses.e: But now faith , hope , and love remain — these three . The greatest of these is love .

verses.z: 我若有先知講道[之能]，也明白各樣的奧祕，各樣的知識，而且有全備的信，叫我能夠移山，卻沒有愛，我就算不得甚麼。
verses.e: If I have the gift of prophecy , and know all mysteries and all knowledge , and if I have all faith , so as to remove mountains , but don't have love , I am nothing .

verses.z: 我若將所有的賙濟[窮人]，又捨己身叫人焚燒，卻沒有愛，仍然與我無益。
verses.e: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor , and if I give my body to be burned , but don't have love , it profits me nothing .

verses.z: 愛是恆久忍耐，又有恩慈；愛是不嫉妒；愛是不自誇，不張狂，
verses.e: Love is patient and is kind . Love doesn't envy . Love doesn't brag , is not proud ,

verses.z: 不做害羞的事，不求自己的益處，不輕易發怒，不計算[人的]惡，
verses.e: doesn't behave itself inappropriately , doesn't seek its own way , is not provoked , takes no account of evil ;

verses.z: 不喜歡不義，只喜歡真理；
verses.e: doesn't rejoice in unrighteousness , but rejoices with the truth ;

verses.z: 凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。
verses.e: bears all things , believes all things , hopes all things , and endures all things .

verses.z: 愛是永不止息。先知講道之能終必歸於無有；說方言之能終必停止；知識也終必歸於無有。
verses.e: Love never fails . But where there are prophecies , they will be done away with . Where there are various languages , they will cease . Where there is knowledge , it will be done away with .

verses.z: 我們現在所知道的有限，先知所講的也有限，
verses.e: For we know in part and we prophesy in part ;

verses.z: 你們要追求愛，也要切慕屬靈的[恩賜]，其中更要羨慕的，是作先知講道。
verses.e: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts , but especially that you may prophesy .

verses.z: 世上的聲音，或者甚多，卻沒有一樣是無意思的。
verses.e: There are , it may be , so many kinds of languages in the world , and none of them is without meaning .

verses.z: 我若不明白那聲音的意思，這說話的人必以我為化外之人，我也以他為化外之人。
verses.e: If then I don't know the meaning of the language , I would be to him who speaks a foreigner , and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me .

verses.z: 你們也是如此，既是切慕屬靈的[恩賜]，就當求多得造就教會的恩賜。
verses.e: So also you , since you are zealous for spiritual gifts , seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly .

verses.z: 所以那說方言的，就當求着能翻出來。
verses.e: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret .

verses.z: 我若用方言禱告，是我的靈禱告，但我的悟性沒有果效。
verses.e: For if I pray in another language , my spirit prays , but my understanding is unfruitful .

verses.z: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我要用靈禱告，也要用悟性禱告；我要用靈歌唱，也要用悟性歌唱。
verses.e: What should I do ? I will pray with the spirit , and I will pray with the understanding also . I will sing with the spirit , and I will sing with the understanding also .

verses.z: 不然，你用靈祝謝，那在座不通方言的人，既然不明白你的話，怎能在你感謝的時候說「阿們」呢？
verses.e: Otherwise , if you bless with the spirit , how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the " Amen " at your giving of thanks , seeing he doesn't know what you say ?

verses.z: 你感謝的固然是好，無奈不能造就別人。
verses.e: For you most certainly give thanks well , but the other person is not built up .

verses.z: 我感謝上帝，我說方言比你們眾人還多。
verses.e: I thank my God , I speak with other languages more than you all .

verses.z: 但在教會中，寧可用悟性說五句教導人的話，強如說萬句方言。
verses.e: However , in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding , that I might instruct others also , than ten thousand words in another language .

verses.z: 那說方言的，原不是對人說，乃是對上帝說，因為沒有人聽出來。然而，他在心靈裏卻是講說各樣的奧祕。
verses.e: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men , but to God , for no one understands , but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries .

verses.z: 弟兄們，在心志上不要作小孩子。然而，在惡事上要作嬰孩，在心志上總要作大人。
verses.e: Brothers , don't be children in thoughts , yet in malice be babies , but in thoughts be mature .

verses.z: 律法上記着：主說：我要用外邦人的舌頭和外邦人的嘴唇向這百姓說話；雖然如此，他們還是不聽從我。
verses.e: In the law it is written , " By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people . They won't even listen to me that way , says the Lord . "

verses.z: 這樣看來，說方言不是為信的人作證據，乃是為不信的人；作先知講道不是為不信的人[作證據]，乃是為信的人。
verses.e: Therefore other languages are for a sign , not to those who believe , but to the unbelieving ; but prophesying is for a sign , not to the unbelieving , but to those who believe .

verses.z: 所以，全教會聚在一處的時候，若都說方言，偶然有不通方言的，或是不信的人進來，豈不說你們癲狂了嗎？
verses.e: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages , and unlearned or unbelieving people come in , won't they say that you are crazy ?

verses.z: 若都作先知講道，偶然有不信的，或是不通方言的人進來，就被眾人勸醒，被眾人審明，
verses.e: But if all prophesy , and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in , he is reproved by all , and he is judged by all .

verses.z: 他心裏的隱情顯露出來，就必將臉伏地，敬拜上帝，說：「上帝真是在你們中間了。」
verses.e: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed . So he will fall down on his face and worship God , declaring that God is among you indeed .

verses.z: 弟兄們，這卻怎麼樣呢？你們聚會的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教訓，或有啟示，或有方言，或有翻出來的話，凡事都當造就人。
verses.e: What is it then , brothers ? When you come together , each one of you has a psalm , has a teaching , has a revelation , has another language , or has an interpretation . Let all things be done to build each other up .

verses.z: 若有說方言的，只好兩個人，至多三個人，且要輪流着說，也要一個人翻出來。
verses.e: If any man speaks in another language , let there be two , or at the most three , and in turn ; and let one interpret .

verses.z: 若沒有人翻，就當在會中閉口，只對自己和上帝說就是了。
verses.e: But if there is no interpreter , let him keep silent in the assembly , and let him speak to himself and to God .

verses.z: 至於作先知講道的，只好兩個人或是三個人，其餘的就當[慎思]明辨。
verses.e: Let two or three of the prophets speak , and let the others discern .

verses.z: 但作先知講道的，是對人說，要造就、安慰、勸勉人。
verses.e: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification , exhortation , and consolation .

verses.z: 若旁邊坐着的得了啟示，那先說話的就當閉口不言。
verses.e: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by , let the first keep silent .

verses.z: 因為你們都可以一個一個地作先知講道，叫眾人學道理，叫眾人得勸勉。
verses.e: For you all can prophesy one by one , that all may learn and all may be exhorted .

verses.z: 先知的靈原是順服先知的；
verses.e: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets ,

verses.z: 因為上帝不是叫人混亂，乃是叫人安靜。
verses.e: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace , as in all the assemblies of the saints .

verses.z: 婦女在會中要閉口不言，像在聖徒的眾教會一樣，因為不准她們說話。她們總要順服，正如律法所說的。
verses.e: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies , for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission , as the law also says ,

verses.z: 她們若要學甚麼，可以在家裏問自己的丈夫，因為婦女在會中說話原是可恥的。
verses.e: if they desire to learn anything . " Let them ask their own husbands at home , for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly . "

verses.z: 上帝的道理豈是從你們出來嗎？豈是單臨到你們嗎？
verses.e: What ! ? Was it from you that the word of God went out ? Or did it come to you alone ?

verses.z: 若有人以為自己是先知，或是屬靈的，就該知道，我所寫給你們的是主的命令。
verses.e: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual , let him recognize the things which I write to you , that they are the commandment of the Lord .

verses.z: 若有不知道的，就由他不知道吧！
verses.e: But if anyone is ignorant , let him be ignorant .

verses.z: 所以我弟兄們，你們要切慕作先知講道，也不要禁止說方言。
verses.e: Therefore , brothers , desire earnestly to prophesy , and don't forbid speaking with other languages .

verses.z: 說方言的，是造就自己；作先知講道的，乃是造就教會。
verses.e: He who speaks in another language edifies himself , but he who prophesies edifies the assembly .

verses.z: 凡事都要規規矩矩地按着次序行。
verses.e: Let all things be done decently and in order .

verses.z: 我願意你們都說方言，更願意你們作先知講道；因為說方言的，若不翻出來，使教會被造就，那作先知講道的，就比他強了。
verses.e: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages , but even more that you would prophesy . For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages , unless he interprets , that the assembly may be built up .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我到你們那裏去，若只說方言，不用啟示，或知識，或預言，或教訓，給你們講解，我與你們有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: But now , brothers , if I come to you speaking with other languages , what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation , or of knowledge , or of prophesying , or of teaching ?

verses.z: 就是那有聲無氣的物，或簫，或琴，若發出來的聲音沒有分別，怎能知道所吹所彈的是甚麼呢？
verses.e: Even lifeless things that make a sound , whether pipe or harp , if they didn't give a distinction in the sounds , how would it be known what is piped or harped ?

verses.z: 若吹無定的號聲，誰能預備打仗呢？
verses.e: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound , who would prepare himself for war ?

verses.z: 你們也是如此。舌頭若不說容易明白的話，怎能知道所說的是甚麼呢？這就是向空說話了。
verses.e: So also you , unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand , how would it be known what is spoken ? For you would be speaking into the air .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我如今把先前所傳給你們的福音告訴你們知道；這福音你們也領受了，又靠着站立得住，
verses.e: Now I declare to you , brothers , the Good News which I preached to you , which also you received , in which you also stand ,

verses.z: 然而，我今日成了何等人，是蒙上帝的恩才成的，並且他所賜我的恩不是徒然的。我比眾使徒格外勞苦；這原不是我，乃是上帝的恩與我同在。
verses.e: But by the grace of God I am what I am . His grace which was given to me was not futile , but I worked more than all of them ; yet not I , but the grace of God which was with me .

verses.z: 不拘是我，是眾使徒，我們如此傳，你們也如此信了。
verses.e: Whether then it is I or they , so we preach , and so you believed .

verses.z: 既傳基督是從死裏復活了，怎麼在你們中間有人說沒有死人復活的事呢？
verses.e: Now if Christ is preached , that he has been raised from the dead , how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead ?

verses.z: 若沒有死人復活的事，基督也就沒有復活了。
verses.e: But if there is no resurrection of the dead , neither has Christ been raised .

verses.z: 若基督沒有復活，我們所傳的便是枉然，你們所信的也是枉然；
verses.e: If Christ has not been raised , then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain .

verses.z: 並且明顯我們是為上帝妄作見證的，因我們見證上帝是叫基督復活了。若死人真不復活，上帝也就沒有叫基督復活了。
verses.e: Yes , we are also found false witnesses of God , because we testified about God that he raised up Christ , whom he didn't raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised .

verses.z: 因為死人若不復活，基督也就沒有復活了。
verses.e: For if the dead aren't raised , neither has Christ been raised .

verses.z: 基督若沒有復活，你們的信便是徒然，你們仍在罪裏。
verses.e: If Christ has not been raised , your faith is vain ; you are still in your sins .

verses.z: 就是在基督裏睡了的人也滅亡了。
verses.e: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished .

verses.z: 我們若靠基督只在今生有指望，就算比眾人更可憐。
verses.e: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life , we are of all men most pitiable .

verses.z: 並且你們若不是徒然相信，能以持守我所傳給你們的，就必因這福音得救。
verses.e: by which also you are saved , if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you — unless you believed in vain .

verses.z: 但基督已經從死裏復活，成為睡了之人初熟的果子。
verses.e: But now Christ has been raised from the dead . He became the first fruit of those who are asleep .

verses.z: 死既是因一人而來，死人復活也是因一人而來。
verses.e: For since death came by man , the resurrection of the dead also came by man .

verses.z: 在亞當裏眾人都死了；照樣，在基督裏眾人也都要復活。
verses.e: For as in Adam all die , so also in Christ all will be made alive .

verses.z: 但各人是按着自己的次序復活：初熟的果子是基督；以後，在他來的時候，是那些屬基督的。
verses.e: But each in his own order : Christ the first fruits , then those who are Christ's at his coming .

verses.z: 再後，末期到了，那時基督既將一切執政的、掌權的、有能的都毀滅了，就把國交與父上帝。
verses.e: Then the end comes , when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father , when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power .

verses.z: 因為基督必要作王，等上帝把一切仇敵都放在他的腳下。
verses.e: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet .

verses.z: 儘末了所毀滅的仇敵就是死。
verses.e: The last enemy that will be abolished is death .

verses.z: 因為[經上]說：「上帝叫萬物都服在他的腳下。」既說萬物都服了他，明顯那叫萬物服他的，不在其內了。
verses.e: For , " He put all things in subjection under his feet . " But when he says , " All things are put in subjection " , it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him .

verses.z: 萬物既服了他，那時子也要自己服那叫萬物服他的，叫上帝在萬物之上，為萬物之主。
verses.e: When all things have been subjected to him , then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him , that God may be all in all .

verses.z: 不然，那些為死人受洗的，將來怎樣呢？若死人總不復活，因何為他們受洗呢？
verses.e: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead ? If the dead aren't raised at all , why then are they baptized for the dead ?

verses.z: 我當日所領受又傳給你們的：第一，就是基督照聖經所說，為我們的罪死了，
verses.e: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received : that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures ,

verses.z: 我們又因何時刻冒險呢？
verses.e: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour ?

verses.z: 弟兄們，我在我主基督耶穌裏，指着你們所誇的口極力地說，我是天天[冒]死。
verses.e: I affirm , by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord , I die daily .

verses.z: 我若當日像尋常人，在以弗所同野獸戰鬥，那於我有甚麼益處呢？若死人不復活，我們就吃吃喝喝吧！因為明天要死了。
verses.e: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes , what does it profit me ? If the dead are not raised , then " let's eat and drink , for tomorrow we die . "

verses.z: 你們不要自欺；濫交是敗壞善行。
verses.e: Don't be deceived ! " Evil companionships corrupt good morals . "

verses.z: 你們要醒悟為善，不要犯罪，因為有人不認識上帝。我說這話是要叫你們羞愧。
verses.e: Wake up righteously and don't sin , for some have no knowledge of God . I say this to your shame .

verses.z: 或有人問：「死人怎樣復活，帶着甚麼身體來呢？」
verses.e: But someone will say , " How are the dead raised ? " and , " With what kind of body do they come ? "

verses.z: 無知的人哪，你所種的，若不死就不能生。
verses.e: You foolish one , that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies .

verses.z: 並且你所種的不是那將來的形體，不過是子粒，即如麥子，或是別樣的穀。
verses.e: That which you sow , you don't sow the body that will be , but a bare grain , maybe of wheat , or of some other kind .

verses.z: 但上帝隨自己的意思給他一個形體，並叫各等子粒各有自己的形體。
verses.e: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him , and to each seed a body of its own .

verses.z: 凡肉體各有不同：人是一樣，獸又是一樣，鳥又是一樣，魚又是一樣。
verses.e: All flesh is not the same flesh , but there is one flesh of men , another flesh of animals , another of fish , and another of birds .

verses.z: 而且埋葬了；又照聖經所說，第三天復活了，
verses.e: that he was buried , that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures ,

verses.z: 有天上的形體，也有地上的形體；但天上形體的榮光是一樣，地上形體的榮光又是一樣。
verses.e: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies ; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial .

verses.z: 日有日的榮光，月有月的榮光，星有星的榮光；這星和那星的榮光也有分別。
verses.e: There is one glory of the sun , another glory of the moon , and another glory of the stars ; for one star differs from another star in glory .

verses.z: 死人復活也是這樣：所種的是必朽壞的，復活的是不朽壞的；
verses.e: So also is the resurrection of the dead . The body is sown perishable ; it is raised imperishable .

verses.z: 所種的是羞辱的，復活的是榮耀的；所種的是軟弱的，復活的是強壯的；
verses.e: It is sown in dishonor ; it is raised in glory . It is sown in weakness ; it is raised in power .

verses.z: 所種的是血氣的身體，復活的是靈性的身體。若有血氣的身體，也必有靈性的身體。
verses.e: It is sown a natural body ; it is raised a spiritual body . There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body .

verses.z: [經上]也是這樣記着說：「首先的人亞當成了有靈的活人」；末後的亞當成了叫人活的靈。
verses.e: So also it is written , " The first man Adam became a living soul . " The last Adam became a life-giving spirit .

verses.z: 但屬靈的不在先，屬血氣的在先，以後才有屬靈的。
verses.e: However , that which is spiritual isn't first , but that which is natural , then that which is spiritual .

verses.z: 頭一個人是出於地，乃屬土；第二個人是出於天。
verses.e: The first man is of the earth , made of dust . The second man is the Lord from heaven .

verses.z: 那屬土的怎樣，凡屬土的也就怎樣；屬天的怎樣，凡屬天的也就怎樣。
verses.e: As is the one made of dust , such are those who are also made of dust ; and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .

verses.z: 我們既有屬土的形狀，將來也必有屬天的形狀。
verses.e: As we have borne the image of those made of dust , let's also bear the image of the heavenly .

verses.z: 並且顯給磯法看，然後顯給十二使徒看；
verses.e: and that he appeared to Cephas , then to the twelve .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我告訴你們說，血肉[之體]不能承受上帝的國，必朽壞的不能承受不朽壞的。
verses.e: Now I say this , brothers , that flesh and blood can't inherit God's Kingdom ; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable .

verses.z: 我如今把一件奧祕的事告訴你們：我們不是都要睡覺，乃是都要改變，
verses.e: Behold , I tell you a mystery . We will not all sleep , but we will all be changed ,

verses.z: 就在一霎時，眨眼之間，號筒末次吹響的時候。因號筒要響，死人要復活成為不朽壞的，我們也要改變。
verses.e: in a moment , in the twinkling of an eye , at the last trumpet . For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible , and we will be changed .

verses.z: 這必朽壞的總要變成不朽壞的，這必死的總要變成不死的。
verses.e: For this perishable body must become imperishable , and this mortal must put on immortality .

verses.z: 這必朽壞的既變成不朽壞的，這必死的既變成不死的，那時[經上]所記「死被得勝吞滅」的話就應驗了。
verses.e: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable , and this mortal will have put on immortality , then what is written will happen : " Death is swallowed up in victory . "

verses.z: 死啊！你得勝的權勢在哪裏？死啊！你的毒鉤在哪裏？
verses.e: " Death , where is your sting ? Hades , where is your victory ? "

verses.z: 死的毒鉤就是罪，罪的權勢就是律法。
verses.e: The sting of death is sin , and the power of sin is the law .

verses.z: 感謝上帝，使我們藉着我們的主耶穌基督得勝。
verses.e: But thanks be to God , who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 所以，我親愛的弟兄們，你們務要堅固，不可搖動，常常竭力多做主工；因為知道，你們的勞苦在主裏面不是徒然的。
verses.e: Therefore , my beloved brothers , be steadfast , immovable , always abounding in the Lord's work , because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord .

verses.z: 後來一時顯給五百多弟兄看，其中一大半到如今還在，卻也有已經睡了的。
verses.e: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once , most of whom remain until now , but some have also fallen asleep .

verses.z: 以後顯給雅各看，再顯給眾使徒看，
verses.e: Then he appeared to James , then to all the apostles ,

verses.z: 末了也顯給我看；我如同未到產期而生的人一般。
verses.e: and last of all , as to the child born at the wrong time , he appeared to me also .

verses.z: 我原是使徒中最小的，不配稱為使徒，因為我從前逼迫上帝的教會。
verses.e: For I am the least of the apostles , who is not worthy to be called an apostle , because I persecuted the assembly of God .

verses.z: 論到為聖徒捐錢，我從前怎樣吩咐加拉太的眾教會，你們也當怎樣行。
verses.e: Now concerning the collection for the saints : as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia , you do likewise .

verses.z: 若是提摩太來到，你們要留心，叫他在你們那裏無所懼怕；因為他勞力做主的工，像我一樣。
verses.e: Now if Timothy comes , see that he is with you without fear , for he does the work of the Lord , as I also do .

verses.z: 所以，無論誰都不可藐視他，只要送他平安前行，叫他到我這裏來，因我指望他和弟兄們同來。
verses.e: Therefore let no one despise him . But set him forward on his journey in peace , that he may come to me ; for I expect him with the brothers .

verses.z: 至於兄弟亞波羅，我再三地勸他同弟兄們到你們那裏去；但這時他決不願意去，幾時有了機會他必去。
verses.e: Now concerning Apollos the brother , I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers , but it was not at all his desire to come now ; but he will come when he has an opportunity .

verses.z: 你們務要警醒，在真道上站立得穩，要作大丈夫，要剛強。
verses.e: Watch ! Stand firm in the faith ! Be courageous ! Be strong !

verses.z: 凡你們所做的都要憑愛心而做。
verses.e: Let all that you do be done in love .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們曉得司提法那一家，是亞該亞初結的果子，並且他們專以服事聖徒為念。
verses.e: Now I beg you , brothers — you know the house of Stephanas , that it is the first fruits of Achaia , and that they have set themselves to serve the saints —

verses.z: 我勸你們順服這樣的人，並一切同工同勞的人。
verses.e: that you also be in subjection to such , and to everyone who helps in the work and labors .

verses.z: 司提法那和福徒拿都，並亞該古到這裏來，我很喜歡；因為你們待我有不及之處，他們補上了。
verses.e: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas , Fortunatus , and Achaicus ; for that which was lacking on your part , they supplied .

verses.z: 他們叫我和你們心裏都快活。這樣的人，你們務要敬重。
verses.e: For they refreshed my spirit and yours . Therefore acknowledge those who are like that .

verses.z: 亞細亞的眾教會問你們安。亞居拉和百基拉並在他們家裏的教會，因主多多地問你們安。
verses.e: The assemblies of Asia greet you . Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord , together with the assembly that is in their house .

verses.z: 每逢七日的第一日，各人要照自己的進項抽出來留着，免得我來的時候現湊。
verses.e: On the first day of every week , let each one of you save as he may prosper , that no collections are made when I come .

verses.z: 眾弟兄都問你們安。你們要親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。
verses.e: All the brothers greet you . Greet one another with a holy kiss .

verses.z: 我－保羅親筆問安。
verses.e: This greeting is by me , Paul , with my own hand .

verses.z: 若有人不愛主，這人可詛可咒。主必要來！
verses.e: If any man doesn't love the Lord Jesus Christ , let him be cursed . Come , Lord !

verses.z: 願主耶穌基督的恩[常]與你們眾人同在！
verses.e: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you .

verses.z: 我在基督耶穌裏的愛與你們眾人同在。阿們！
verses.e: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus . Amen .

verses.z: 及至我來到了，你們寫信舉薦誰，我就打發他們，把你們的捐資送到耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: When I arrive , I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 若我也該去，他們可以和我同去。
verses.e: If it is appropriate for me to go also , they will go with me .

verses.z: 我要從馬其頓經過；既經過了，就要到你們那裏去，
verses.e: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia , for I am passing through Macedonia .

verses.z: 或者和你們同住幾時，或者也過冬。無論我往哪裏去，你們就可以給我送行。
verses.e: But with you it may be that I will stay with you , or even winter with you , that you may send me on my journey wherever I go .

verses.z: 我如今不願意路過見你們；主若許我，我就指望和你們同住幾時。
verses.e: For I do not wish to see you now in passing , but I hope to stay a while with you , if the Lord permits .

verses.z: 但我要仍舊住在以弗所，直等到五旬節；
verses.e: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost ,

verses.z: 因為有寬大又有功效的門為我開了，並且反對的人也多。
verses.e: for a great and effective door has opened to me , and there are many adversaries .

verses.z: 弟兄們，從前我到你們那裏去，並沒有用高言大智對你們宣傳上帝的奧祕。
verses.e: When I came to you , brothers , I didn't come with excellence of speech or of wisdom , proclaiming to you the testimony of God .

verses.z: 只有上帝藉着聖靈向我們顯明了，因為聖靈參透萬事，就是上帝深奧的事也參透了。
verses.e: But to us , God revealed them through the Spirit . For the Spirit searches all things , yes , the deep things of God .

verses.z: 除了在人裏頭的靈，誰知道人的事？像這樣，除了上帝的靈，也沒有人知道上帝的事。
verses.e: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him ? Even so , no one knows the things of God except God's Spirit .

verses.z: 我們所領受的，並不是世上的靈，乃是從上帝來的靈，叫我們能知道上帝開恩賜給我們的事。
verses.e: But we received not the spirit of the world , but the Spirit which is from God , that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God .

verses.z: 並且我們講說這些事，不是用人智慧所指教的言語，乃是用[聖]靈所指教的言語，將屬靈的話解釋屬靈的事。
verses.e: We also speak these things , not in words which man's wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches , comparing spiritual things with spiritual things .

verses.z: 然而，屬血氣的人不領會上帝[聖]靈的事，反倒以為愚拙，並且不能知道，因為這些事惟有屬靈的人才能看透。
verses.e: Now the natural man doesn't receive the things of God's Spirit , for they are foolishness to him ; and he can't know them , because they are spiritually discerned .

verses.z: 屬靈的人能看透萬事，卻沒有一人能看透了他。
verses.e: But he who is spiritual discerns all things , and he himself is to be judged by no one .

verses.z: 誰曾知道主的心去教導他呢？但我們是有基督的心了。
verses.e: " For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him ? " But we have Christ's mind .

verses.z: 因為我曾定了主意，在你們中間不知道別的，只知道耶穌基督並他釘十字架。
verses.e: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified .

verses.z: 我在你們那裏，又軟弱，又懼怕又甚戰兢。
verses.e: I was with you in weakness , in fear , and in much trembling .

verses.z: 我說的話、講的道，不是用智慧委婉的言語，乃是用聖靈和大能的明證，
verses.e: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom , but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power ,

verses.z: 叫你們的信不在乎人的智慧，只在乎上帝的大能。
verses.e: that your faith wouldn't stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .

verses.z: 然而，在完全的人中，我們也講智慧。但不是這世上的智慧，也不是這世上有權有位、將要敗亡之人的智慧。
verses.e: We speak wisdom , however , among those who are full grown , yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing .

verses.z: 我們講的，乃是從前所隱藏、上帝奧祕的智慧，就是上帝在萬世以前預定使我們得榮耀的。
verses.e: But we speak God's wisdom in a mystery , the wisdom that has been hidden , which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory ,

verses.z: 這智慧世上有權有位的人沒有一個知道的，他們若知道，就不把榮耀的主釘在十字架上了。
verses.e: which none of the rulers of this world has known . For had they known it , they wouldn't have crucified the Lord of glory .

verses.z: 如[經上]所記：上帝為愛他的人所預備的是眼睛未曾看見，耳朵未曾聽見，人心也未曾想到的。
verses.e: But as it is written , " Things which an eye didn't see , and an ear didn't hear , which didn't enter into the heart of man , these God has prepared for those who love him . "

verses.z: 弟兄們，我從前對你們說話，不能把你們當作屬靈的，只得把你們當作屬肉體，在基督裏為嬰孩的。
verses.e: Brothers , I couldn't speak to you as to spiritual , but as to fleshly , as to babies in Christ .

verses.z: 我照上帝所給我的恩，好像一個聰明的工頭，立好了根基，有別人在上面建造；只是各人要謹慎怎樣在上面建造。
verses.e: According to the grace of God which was given to me , as a wise master builder I laid a foundation , and another builds on it . But let each man be careful how he builds on it .

verses.z: 因為那已經立好的根基就是耶穌基督，此外沒有人能立別的根基。
verses.e: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid , which is Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 若有人用金、銀、寶石、草木、禾稭在這根基上建造，
verses.e: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold , silver , costly stones , wood , hay , or straw ,

verses.z: 各人的工程必然顯露，因為那日子要將它表明出來，有火發現；這火要試驗各人的工程怎樣。
verses.e: each man's work will be revealed . For the Day will declare it , because it is revealed in fire ; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man's work is .

verses.z: 人在那根基上所建造的工程若存得住，他就要得賞賜。
verses.e: If any man's work remains which he built on it , he will receive a reward .

verses.z: 人的工程若被燒了，他就要受虧損，自己卻要得救；雖然得救，乃像從火裏經過的一樣。
verses.e: If any man's work is burned , he will suffer loss , but he himself will be saved , but as through fire .

verses.z: 豈不知你們是上帝的殿，上帝的靈住在你們裏頭嗎？
verses.e: Don't you know that you are God's temple and that God's Spirit lives in you ?

verses.z: 若有人毀壞上帝的殿，上帝必要毀壞那人；因為上帝的殿是聖的，這殿就是你們。
verses.e: If anyone destroys God's temple , God will destroy him ; for God's temple is holy , which you are .

verses.z: 人不可自欺。你們中間若有人在這世界自以為有智慧，倒不如變作愚拙，好成為有智慧的。
verses.e: Let no one deceive himself . If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world , let him become a fool that he may become wise .

verses.z: 因這世界的智慧，在上帝看是愚拙。如[經上]記着說：「主叫有智慧的，中了自己的詭計」；
verses.e: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God . For it is written , " He has taken the wise in their craftiness . "

verses.z: 我是用奶餵你們，沒有用飯餵你們。那時你們不能吃，就是如今還是不能。
verses.e: I fed you with milk , not with solid food , for you weren't yet ready . Indeed , you aren't ready even now ,

verses.z: 又說：「主知道智慧人的意念是虛妄的。」
verses.e: And again , " The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise , that it is worthless . "

verses.z: 所以無論誰，都不可拿人誇口，因為萬有全是你們的。
verses.e: Therefore let no one boast in men . For all things are yours ,

verses.z: 或保羅，或亞波羅，或磯法，或世界，或生，或死，或現今的事，或將來的事，全是你們的；
verses.e: whether Paul , or Apollos , or Cephas , or the world , or life , or death , or things present , or things to come . All are yours ,

verses.z: 並且你們是屬基督的，基督又是屬上帝的。
verses.e: and you are Christ's , and Christ is God's .

verses.z: 你們仍是屬肉體的，因為在你們中間有嫉妒、紛爭，這豈不是屬乎肉體、照着世人的樣子行嗎？
verses.e: for you are still fleshly . For insofar as there is jealousy , strife , and factions among you , aren't you fleshly , and don't you walk in the ways of men ?

verses.z: 有說：「我是屬保羅的」；有說：「我是屬亞波羅的。」這豈不是你們和世人一樣嗎？
verses.e: For when one says , " I follow Paul , " and another , " I follow Apollos , " aren't you fleshly ?

verses.z: 亞波羅算甚麼？保羅算甚麼？無非是執事，照主所賜給他們各人的，引導你們相信。
verses.e: Who then is Apollos , and who is Paul , but servants through whom you believed , and each as the Lord gave to him ?

verses.z: 我栽種了，亞波羅澆灌了，惟有上帝叫他生長。
verses.e: I planted . Apollos watered . But God gave the increase .

verses.z: 可見栽種的，算不得甚麼，澆灌的，也算不得甚麼；只在那叫他生長的上帝。
verses.e: So then neither he who plants is anything , nor he who waters , but God who gives the increase .

verses.z: 栽種的和澆灌的，都是一樣，但將來各人要照自己的工夫得自己的賞賜。
verses.e: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same , but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor .

verses.z: 因為我們是與上帝同工的；你們是上帝所耕種的田地，所建造的房屋。
verses.e: For we are God's fellow workers . You are God's farming , God's building .

verses.z: 人應當以我們為基督的執事，為上帝奧祕事的管家。
verses.e: So let a man think of us as Christ's servants and stewards of God's mysteries .

verses.z: 我們為基督的緣故算是愚拙的，你們在基督裏倒是聰明的；我們軟弱，你們倒強壯；你們有榮耀，我們倒被藐視。
verses.e: We are fools for Christ's sake , but you are wise in Christ . We are weak , but you are strong . You have honor , but we have dishonor .

verses.z: 直到如今，我們還是又飢又渴，又赤身露體，又挨打，又沒有一定的住處，
verses.e: Even to this present hour we hunger , thirst , are naked , are beaten , and have no certain dwelling place .

verses.z: 並且勞苦，親手做工。被人咒罵，我們就祝福；被人逼迫，我們就忍受；
verses.e: We toil , working with our own hands . When people curse us , we bless . Being persecuted , we endure .

verses.z: 被人毀謗，我們就善勸。直到如今，人還把我們看作世界上的污穢，萬物中的渣滓。
verses.e: Being defamed , we entreat . We are made as the filth of the world , the dirt wiped off by all , even until now .

verses.z: 我寫這話，不是叫你們羞愧，乃是警戒你們，好像我所親愛的兒女一樣。
verses.e: I don't write these things to shame you , but to admonish you as my beloved children .

verses.z: 你們學基督的，師傅雖有一萬，為父的卻是不多，因我在基督耶穌裏用福音生了你們。
verses.e: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ , you don't have many fathers . For in Christ Jesus , I became your father through the Good News .

verses.z: 所以，我求你們效法我。
verses.e: I beg you therefore , be imitators of me .

verses.z: 因此我已打發提摩太到你們那裏去。他在主裏面，是我所親愛、有忠心的兒子。他必提醒你們，記念我在基督裏怎樣行事，在各處各教會中怎樣教導人。
verses.e: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you , who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord , who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ , even as I teach everywhere in every assembly .

verses.z: 有些人自高自大，以為我不到你們那裏去；
verses.e: Now some are puffed up , as though I were not coming to you .

verses.z: 然而，主若許我，我必快到你們那裏去，並且我所要知道的，不是那些自高自大之人的言語，乃是他們的權能。
verses.e: But I will come to you shortly , if the Lord is willing . And I will know , not the word of those who are puffed up , but the power .

verses.z: 所求於管家的，是要他有忠心。
verses.e: Here , moreover , it is required of stewards that they be found faithful .

verses.z: 因為上帝的國不在乎言語，乃在乎權能。
verses.e: For God's Kingdom is not in word , but in power .

verses.z: 你們願意怎麼樣呢？是願意我帶着刑杖到你們那裏去呢？還是要我存慈愛溫柔的心呢？
verses.e: What do you want ? Shall I come to you with a rod , or in love and a spirit of gentleness ?

verses.z: 我被你們論斷，或被別人論斷，我都以為極小的事；連我自己也不論斷自己。
verses.e: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you , or by a human court . Yes , I don't even judge my own self .

verses.z: 我雖不覺得自己有錯，卻也不能因此得以稱義；但判斷我的乃是主。
verses.e: For I know nothing against myself . Yet I am not justified by this , but he who judges me is the Lord .

verses.z: 所以，時候未到，甚麼都不要論斷，只等主來，他要照出暗中的隱情，顯明人心的意念。那時，各人要從上帝那裏得着稱讚。
verses.e: Therefore judge nothing before the time , until the Lord comes , who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts . Then each man will get his praise from God .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我為你們的緣故，拿這些事轉比自己和亞波羅，叫你們效法我們不可過於[聖經]所記，免得你們自高自大，貴重這個，輕看那個。
verses.e: Now these things , brothers , I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes , that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written , that none of you be puffed up against one another .

verses.z: 使你與人不同的是誰呢？你有甚麼不是領受的呢？若是領受的，為何自誇，彷彿不是領受的呢？
verses.e: For who makes you different ? And what do you have that you didn't receive ? But if you did receive it , why do you boast as if you had not received it ?

verses.z: 你們已經飽足了！已經豐富了！不用我們，自己就作王了！我願意你們果真作王，叫我們也得與你們一同作王。
verses.e: You are already filled . You have already become rich . You have come to reign without us . Yes , and I wish that you did reign , that we also might reign with you !

verses.z: 我想上帝把我們使徒明明列在末後，好像定死罪的囚犯；因為我們成了一臺戲，給世人和天使觀看。
verses.e: For I think that God has displayed us , the apostles , last of all , like men sentenced to death . For we are made a spectacle to the world , both to angels and men .

verses.z: 風聞在你們中間有淫亂的事。這樣的淫亂連外邦人中也沒有，就是有人收了他的繼母。
verses.e: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you , and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles , that one has his father's wife .

verses.z: 此話不是指這世上一概行淫亂的，或貪婪的，勒索的，或拜偶像的；若是這樣，你們除非離開世界方可。
verses.e: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world , or with the covetous and extortionists , or with idolaters , for then you would have to leave the world .

verses.z: 但如今我寫信給你們說，若有稱為弟兄是行淫亂的，或貪婪的，或拜偶像的，或辱罵的，或醉酒的，或勒索的，這樣的人不可與他相交，就是與他吃飯都不可。
verses.e: But as it is , I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner , or covetous , or an idolater , or a slanderer , or a drunkard , or an extortionist . Don't even eat with such a person .

verses.z: 因為審判[教]外的人與我何干？[教]內的人豈不是你們審判的嗎？
verses.e: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside ? Don't you judge those who are within ?

verses.z: 至於外人有上帝審判他們。你們應當把那惡人從你們中間趕出去。
verses.e: But those who are outside , God judges . " Put away the wicked man from among yourselves . "

verses.z: 你們還是自高自大，並不哀痛，把行這事的人從你們中間趕出去。
verses.e: You are arrogant , and didn't mourn instead , that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you .

verses.z: 我身子雖不在你們那裏，心卻在你們那裏，好像我親自與你們同在，已經判斷了行這事的人。
verses.e: For I most certainly , as being absent in body but present in spirit , have already , as though I were present , judged him who has done this thing .

verses.z: 就是你們聚會的時候，我的心也同在。奉我們主耶穌的名，並用我們主耶穌的權能，
verses.e: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 要把這樣的人交給撒但，敗壞他的肉體，使他的靈魂在主耶穌的日子可以得救。
verses.e: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh , that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus .

verses.z: 你們這自誇是不好的。豈不知一點麵酵能使全團發起來嗎？
verses.e: Your boasting is not good . Don't you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump ?

verses.z: 你們既是無酵的麵，應當把舊酵除淨，好使你們成為新團；因為我們逾越節的[羔羊]基督已經被殺獻祭了。
verses.e: Purge out the old yeast , that you may be a new lump , even as you are unleavened . For indeed Christ , our Passover , has been sacrificed in our place .

verses.z: 所以，我們守這節不可用舊酵，也不可用惡毒、邪惡的酵，只用誠實真正的無酵餅。
verses.e: Therefore let's keep the feast , not with old yeast , neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness , but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth .

verses.z: 我先前寫信給你們說，不可與淫亂的人相交。
verses.e: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners ;

verses.z: 你們中間有彼此相爭的事，怎敢在不義的人面前求審，不在聖徒面前求審呢？
verses.e: Dare any of you , having a matter against his neighbor , go to law before the unrighteous , and not before the saints ?

verses.z: 偷竊的、貪婪的、醉酒的、辱罵的、勒索的，都不能承受上帝的國。
verses.e: nor thieves , nor covetous , nor drunkards , nor slanderers , nor extortionists , will inherit God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 你們中間也有人從前是這樣；但如今你們奉主耶穌基督的名，並藉着我們上帝的靈，已經洗淨，成聖，稱義了。
verses.e: Some of you were such , but you were washed . You were sanctified . You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus , and in the Spirit of our God .

verses.z: 凡事我都可行，但不都有益處。凡事我都可行，但無論哪一件，我總不受它的轄制。
verses.e: " All things are lawful for me , " but not all things are expedient . " All things are lawful for me , " but I will not be brought under the power of anything .

verses.z: 食物是為肚腹，肚腹是為食物；但上帝要叫這兩樣都廢壞。身子不是為淫亂，乃是為主；主也是為身子。
verses.e: " Foods for the belly , and the belly for foods , " but God will bring to nothing both it and them . But the body is not for sexual immorality , but for the Lord , and the Lord for the body .

verses.z: 並且上帝已經叫主復活，也要用自己的能力叫我們復活。
verses.e: Now God raised up the Lord , and will also raise us up by his power .

verses.z: 豈不知你們的身子是基督的肢體嗎？我可以將基督的肢體作為娼妓的肢體嗎？斷乎不可！
verses.e: Don't you know that your bodies are members of Christ ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute ? May it never be !

verses.z: 豈不知與娼妓聯合的，便是與她成為一體嗎？因為主說：「二人要成為一體。」
verses.e: Or don't you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body ? For , " The two " , he says , " will become one flesh . "

verses.z: 但與主聯合的，便是與主成為一靈。
verses.e: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit .

verses.z: 你們要逃避淫行。人所犯的，無論甚麼罪，都在身子以外，惟有行淫的，是得罪自己的身子。
verses.e: Flee sexual immorality ! " Every sin that a man does is outside the body , " but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body .

verses.z: 豈不知你們的身子就是聖靈的殿嗎？這聖靈是從上帝而來，住在你們裏頭的；並且你們不是自己的人，
verses.e: Or don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you , whom you have from God ? You are not your own ,

verses.z: 豈不知聖徒要審判世界嗎？若世界為你們所審，難道你們不配審判這最小的事嗎？
verses.e: Don't you know that the saints will judge the world ? And if the world is judged by you , are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters ?

verses.z: 因為你們是重價買來的。所以，要在你們的身子上榮耀上帝。
verses.e: for you were bought with a price . Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit , which are God's .

verses.z: 豈不知我們要審判天使嗎？何況今生的事呢？
verses.e: Don't you know that we will judge angels ? How much more , things that pertain to this life ?

verses.z: 既是這樣，你們若有今生的事當審判，是派教會所輕看的人審判嗎？
verses.e: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life , do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly ?

verses.z: 我說這話是要叫你們羞恥。難道你們中間沒有一個智慧人能審斷弟兄們的事嗎？
verses.e: I say this to move you to shame . Isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers ?

verses.z: 你們竟是弟兄與弟兄告狀，而且告在不信[主]的人面前。
verses.e: But brother goes to law with brother , and that before unbelievers !

verses.z: 你們彼此告狀，這已經是你們的大錯了。為甚麼不情願受欺呢？為甚麼不情願吃虧呢？
verses.e: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another . Why not rather be wronged ? Why not rather be defrauded ?

verses.z: 你們倒是欺壓人、虧負人，況且所欺壓所虧負的就是弟兄。
verses.e: No , but you yourselves do wrong and defraud , and that against your brothers .

verses.z: 你們豈不知不義的人不能承受上帝的國嗎？不要自欺！無論是淫亂的、拜偶像的、姦淫的、作孌童的、親男色的、
verses.e: Or don't you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God's Kingdom ? Don't be deceived . Neither the sexually immoral , nor idolaters , nor adulterers , nor male prostitutes , nor homosexuals ,

verses.z: 論到你們信上所提的事，[我說]男不近女倒好。
verses.e: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me : it is good for a man not to touch a woman .

verses.z: 至於那已經嫁娶的，我吩咐他們；其實不是我吩咐，乃是主吩咐說：妻子不可離開丈夫，
verses.e: But to the married I command — not I , but the Lord — that the wife not leave her husband

verses.z: 若是離開了，不可再嫁，或是仍同丈夫和好。丈夫也不可離棄妻子。
verses.e: ( but if she departs , let her remain unmarried , or else be reconciled to her husband ) , and that the husband not leave his wife .

verses.z: 我對其餘的人說（不是主說）：倘若某弟兄有不信的妻子，妻子也情願和他同住，他就不要離棄妻子。
verses.e: But to the rest I — not the Lord — say , if any brother has an unbelieving wife , and she is content to live with him , let him not leave her .

verses.z: 妻子有不信的丈夫，丈夫也情願和她同住，她就不要離棄丈夫。
verses.e: The woman who has an unbelieving husband , and he is content to live with her , let her not leave her husband .

verses.z: 因為不信的丈夫就因着妻子成了聖潔，並且不信的妻子就因着丈夫成了聖潔。不然，你們的兒女就不潔淨，但如今他們是聖潔的了。
verses.e: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife , and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband . Otherwise your children would be unclean , but now they are holy .

verses.z: 倘若那不信的人要離去，就由他離去吧！無論是弟兄，是姊妹，遇着這樣的事都不必拘束。上帝召我們原是要我們和睦。
verses.e: Yet if the unbeliever departs , let there be separation . The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases , but God has called us in peace .

verses.z: 你這作妻子的，怎麼知道不能救你的丈夫呢？你這作丈夫的，怎麼知道不能救你的妻子呢？
verses.e: For how do you know , wife , whether you will save your husband ? Or how do you know , husband , whether you will save your wife ?

verses.z: 只要照主所分給各人的，和上帝所召各人的而行。我吩咐各教會都是這樣。
verses.e: Only , as the Lord has distributed to each man , as God has called each , so let him walk . So I command in all the assemblies .

verses.z: 有人已受割禮蒙召呢，就不要廢割禮；有人未受割禮蒙召呢，就不要受割禮。
verses.e: Was anyone called having been circumcised ? Let him not become uncircumcised . Has anyone been called in uncircumcision ? Let him not be circumcised .

verses.z: 受割禮算不得甚麼，不受割禮也算不得甚麼，只要守上帝的誡命就是了。
verses.e: Circumcision is nothing , and uncircumcision is nothing , but what matters is keeping God's commandments .

verses.z: 但要免淫亂的事，男子當各有自己的妻子；女子也當各有自己的丈夫。
verses.e: But , because of sexual immoralities , let each man have his own wife , and let each woman have her own husband .

verses.z: 各人蒙召的時候是甚麼身分，仍要守住這身分。
verses.e: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called .

verses.z: 你是作奴隸蒙召的嗎？不要因此憂慮；若能以自由，就求自由更好。
verses.e: Were you called being a bondservant ? Don't let that bother you , but if you get an opportunity to become free , use it .

verses.z: 因為作奴僕蒙召於主的，就是主所釋放的人；作自由之人蒙召的，就是基督的奴僕。
verses.e: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord's free man . Likewise he who was called being free is Christ's bondservant .

verses.z: 你們是重價買來的，不要作人的奴僕。
verses.e: You were bought with a price . Don't become bondservants of men .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們各人蒙召的時候是甚麼身分，仍要在上帝面前守住這身分。
verses.e: Brothers , let each man , in whatever condition he was called , stay in that condition with God .

verses.z: 論到童身的人，我沒有主的命令，但我既蒙主憐恤能作忠心的人，就把自己的意見告訴[你們]。
verses.e: Now concerning virgins , I have no commandment from the Lord , but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy .

verses.z: 因現今的艱難，據我看來，人不如守素安常才好。
verses.e: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us , it's good for a man to remain as he is .

verses.z: 你有妻子纏着呢，就不要求脫離；你沒有妻子纏着呢，就不要求妻子。
verses.e: Are you bound to a wife ? Don't seek to be freed . Are you free from a wife ? Don't seek a wife .

verses.z: 你若娶妻，並不是犯罪；處女若出嫁，也不是犯罪。然而這等人肉身必受苦難，我卻願意你們免這苦難。
verses.e: But if you marry , you have not sinned . If a virgin marries , she has not sinned . Yet such will have oppression in the flesh , and I want to spare you .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我對你們說：時候減少了。從此以後，那有妻子的，要像沒有妻子；
verses.e: But I say this , brothers : the time is short . From now on , both those who have wives may be as though they had none ;

verses.z: 丈夫當用合宜之分待妻子；妻子待丈夫也要如此。
verses.e: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her , and likewise also the wife her husband .

verses.z: 哀哭的，要像不哀哭；快樂的，要像不快樂；置買的，要像無有所得；
verses.e: and those who weep , as though they didn't weep ; and those who rejoice , as though they didn't rejoice ; and those who buy , as though they didn't possess ;

verses.z: 用世物的，要像不用世物，因為這世界的樣子將要過去了。
verses.e: and those who use the world , as not using it to the fullest . For the mode of this world passes away .

verses.z: 我願你們無所掛慮。沒有娶妻的，是為主的事掛慮，想怎樣叫主喜悅。
verses.e: But I desire to have you to be free from cares . He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord , how he may please the Lord ;

verses.z: 娶了妻的，是為世上的事掛慮，想怎樣叫妻子喜悅。
verses.e: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world , how he may please his wife .

verses.z: 婦人和處女也有分別。沒有出嫁的，是為主的事掛慮，要身體、靈魂都聖潔；已經出嫁的，是為世上的事掛慮，想怎樣叫丈夫喜悅。
verses.e: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin . The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord , that she may be holy both in body and in spirit . But she who is married cares about the things of the world — how she may please her husband .

verses.z: 我說這話是為你們的益處，不是要牢籠你們，乃是要叫你們行合宜的事，得以殷勤服事主，沒有分心的事。
verses.e: This I say for your own benefit , not that I may ensnare you , but for that which is appropriate , and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction .

verses.z: 若有人以為自己待他的女兒不合宜，女兒也過了年歲，事又當行，他就可隨意辦理，不算有罪，叫二人成親就是了。
verses.e: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin , if she is past the flower of her age , and if need so requires , let him do what he desires . He doesn't sin . Let them marry .

verses.z: 倘若人心裏堅定，沒有不得已的事，並且由得自己作主，心裏又決定了留下女兒[不出嫁]，如此行也好。
verses.e: But he who stands steadfast in his heart , having no urgency , but has power over his own will , and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin , does well .

verses.z: 這樣看來，叫自己的女兒出嫁是好，不叫她出嫁更是好。
verses.e: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well , and he who doesn't give her in marriage does better .

verses.z: 丈夫活着的時候，妻子是被約束的；丈夫若死了，妻子就可以自由，隨意再嫁，只是要嫁這在主裏面的人。
verses.e: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives ; but if the husband is dead , she is free to be married to whomever she desires , only in the Lord .

verses.z: 妻子沒有權柄主張自己的身子，乃在丈夫；丈夫也沒有權柄主張自己的身子，乃在妻子。
verses.e: The wife doesn't have authority over her own body , but the husband does . Likewise also the husband doesn't have authority over his own body , but the wife does .

verses.z: 然而按我的意見，若常守節更有福氣。我也想自己是被上帝的靈感動了。
verses.e: But she is happier if she stays as she is , in my judgment , and I think that I also have God's Spirit .

verses.z: 夫妻不可彼此虧負，除非兩相情願，暫時分房，為要專心禱告方可；以後仍要同房，免得撒但趁着你們情不自禁，引誘你們。
verses.e: Don't deprive one another , unless it is by consent for a season , that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer , and may be together again , that Satan doesn't tempt you because of your lack of self-control .

verses.z: 我說這話，原是准[你們]的，不是命[你們]的。
verses.e: But this I say by way of concession , not of commandment .

verses.z: 我願意眾人像我一樣；只是各人領受上帝的恩賜，一個是這樣，一個是那樣。
verses.e: Yet I wish that all men were like me . However , each man has his own gift from God , one of this kind , and another of that kind .

verses.z: 我對着沒有嫁娶的和寡婦說，若他們常像我就好。
verses.e: But I say to the unmarried and to widows , it is good for them if they remain even as I am .

verses.z: 倘若自己禁止不住，就可以嫁娶。與其慾火攻心，倒不如嫁娶為妙。
verses.e: But if they don't have self-control , let them marry . For it's better to marry than to burn with passion .

verses.z: 論到祭偶像之物，我們曉得我們都有知識。但知識是叫人自高自大，惟有愛心能造就人。
verses.e: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols : We know that we all have knowledge . Knowledge puffs up , but love builds up .

verses.z: 若有人見你這有知識的，在偶像的廟裏坐席，這人的良心若是軟弱，豈不放膽去吃那祭偶像之物嗎？
verses.e: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol's temple , won't his conscience , if he is weak , be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols ?

verses.z: 因此，基督為他死的那軟弱弟兄，也就因你的知識沉淪了。
verses.e: And through your knowledge , he who is weak perishes , the brother for whose sake Christ died .

verses.z: 你們這樣得罪弟兄們，傷了他們軟弱的良心，就是得罪基督。
verses.e: Thus , sinning against the brothers , and wounding their conscience when it is weak , you sin against Christ .

verses.z: 所以，食物若叫我弟兄跌倒，我就永遠不吃肉，免得叫我弟兄跌倒了。
verses.e: Therefore , if food causes my brother to stumble , I will eat no meat forever more , that I don't cause my brother to stumble .

verses.z: 若有人以為自己知道甚麼，按他所當知道的，他仍是不知道。
verses.e: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything , he doesn't yet know as he ought to know .

verses.z: 若有人愛上帝，這人乃是上帝所知道的。
verses.e: But anyone who loves God is known by him .

verses.z: 論到吃祭偶像之物，我們知道偶像在世上算不得甚麼，也知道上帝只有一位，再沒有別的上帝。
verses.e: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols , we know that no idol is anything in the world , and that there is no other God but one .

verses.z: 雖有稱為神的，或在天，或在地，就如那許多的神，許多的主；
verses.e: For though there are things that are called " gods " , whether in the heavens or on earth — as there are many " gods " and many " lords " —

verses.z: 然而我們只有一位上帝，就是父－萬物都本於他；我們也歸於他－並有一位主，就是耶穌基督－萬物都是藉着他有的；我們也是藉着他有的。
verses.e: yet to us there is one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we for him ; and one Lord , Jesus Christ , through whom are all things , and we live through him .

verses.z: 但人不都有這等知識。有人到如今因拜慣了偶像，就以為所吃的是祭偶像之物。他們的良心既然軟弱，也就污穢了。
verses.e: However , that knowledge isn't in all men . But some , with consciousness of an idol until now , eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol , and their conscience , being weak , is defiled .

verses.z: 其實食物不能叫上帝看中我們，因為我們不吃也無損，吃也無益。
verses.e: But food will not commend us to God . For neither , if we don't eat are we the worse , nor if we eat are we the better .

verses.z: 只是你們要謹慎，恐怕你們這自由竟成了那軟弱人的絆腳石。
verses.e: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak .

verses.z: 我不是自由的嗎？我不是使徒嗎？我不是見過我們的主耶穌嗎？你們不是我在主裏面所做之工嗎？
verses.e: Am I not free ? Am I not an apostle ? Haven't I seen Jesus Christ , our Lord ? Aren't you my work in the Lord ?

verses.z: 不全是為我們說的嗎？分明是為我們說的。因為耕種的當存着指望去耕種；打場的也當存得[糧]的指望去打場。
verses.e: or does he say it assuredly for our sake ? Yes , it was written for our sake , because he who plows ought to plow in hope , and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope .

verses.z: 我們若把屬靈的種子撒在你們中間，就是從你們收割奉養肉身之物，這還算大事嗎？
verses.e: If we sowed to you spiritual things , is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things ?

verses.z: 若別人在你們身上有這權柄，何況我們呢？然而，我們沒有用過這權柄，倒凡事忍受，免得基督的福音被阻隔。
verses.e: If others partake of this right over you , don't we yet more ? Nevertheless we didn't use this right , but we bear all things , that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ .

verses.z: 你們豈不知為聖事勞碌的就吃殿中的物嗎？伺候祭壇的就分領壇上的物嗎？
verses.e: Don't you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple , and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar ?

verses.z: 主也是這樣命定，叫傳福音的靠着福音養生。
verses.e: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News .

verses.z: 但這權柄我全沒有用過。我寫這話，並非要你們這樣待我，因為我寧可死也不叫人使我所誇的落了空。
verses.e: But I have used none of these things , and I don't write these things that it may be done so in my case ; for I would rather die , than that anyone should make my boasting void .

verses.z: 我傳福音原沒有可誇的，因為我是不得已的。若不傳福音，我便有禍了。
verses.e: For if I preach the Good News , I have nothing to boast about , for necessity is laid on me ; but woe is to me if I don't preach the Good News .

verses.z: 我若甘心做這事，就有賞賜；若不甘心，責任卻已經託付我了。
verses.e: For if I do this of my own will , I have a reward . But if not of my own will , I have a stewardship entrusted to me .

verses.z: 既是這樣，我的賞賜是甚麼呢？就是我傳福音的時候叫人不花錢得福音，免得用盡我傳福音的權柄。
verses.e: What then is my reward ? That when I preach the Good News , I may present the Good News of Christ without charge , so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News .

verses.z: 我雖是自由的，無人轄管；然而我甘心作了眾人的僕人，為要多得人。
verses.e: For though I was free from all , I brought myself under bondage to all , that I might gain the more .

verses.z: 假若在別人，我不是使徒，在你們，我總是使徒，因為你們在主裏正是我作使徒的印證。
verses.e: If to others I am not an apostle , yet at least I am to you ; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord .

verses.z: 向猶太人，我就作猶太人，為要得猶太人；向律法以下的人，我雖不在律法以下，還是作律法以下的人，為要得律法以下的人。
verses.e: To the Jews I became as a Jew , that I might gain Jews ; to those who are under the law , as under the law , that I might gain those who are under the law ;

verses.z: 向沒有律法的人，我就作沒有律法的人，為要得沒有律法的人；其實我在上帝面前，不是沒有律法；在基督面前，正在律法之下。
verses.e: to those who are without law , as without law ( not being without law toward God , but under law toward Christ ) , that I might win those who are without law .

verses.z: 向軟弱的人，我就作軟弱的人，為要得軟弱的人。向甚麼樣的人，我就作甚麼樣的人。無論如何，總要救些人。
verses.e: To the weak I became as weak , that I might gain the weak . I have become all things to all men , that I may by all means save some .

verses.z: 凡我所行的，都是為福音的緣故，為要與人同得這福音[的好處]。
verses.e: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News , that I may be a joint partaker of it .

verses.z: 豈不知在場上賽跑的都跑，但得獎賞的只有一人？你們也當這樣跑，好叫你們得着獎賞。
verses.e: Don't you know that those who run in a race all run , but one receives the prize ? Run like that , so that you may win .

verses.z: 凡較力爭勝的，諸事都有節制，他們不過是要得能壞的冠冕；我們卻是要得不能壞的冠冕。
verses.e: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things . Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown , but we an incorruptible .

verses.z: 所以，我奔跑不像無定向的；我鬥拳不像打空氣的。
verses.e: I therefore run like that , not aimlessly . I fight like that , not beating the air ,

verses.z: 我是攻克己身，叫身服我，恐怕我傳[福音]給別人，自己反被棄絕了。
verses.e: but I beat my body and bring it into submission , lest by any means , after I have preached to others , I myself should be disqualified .

verses.z: 我對那盤問我的人就是這樣分訴：
verses.e: My defense to those who examine me is this :

verses.z: 難道我們沒有權柄[靠福音]吃喝嗎？
verses.e: Have we no right to eat and to drink ?

verses.z: 難道我們沒有權柄娶[信主的]姊妹為妻，帶着一同往來，彷彿其餘的使徒和主的弟兄並磯法一樣嗎？
verses.e: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer , even as the rest of the apostles , and the brothers of the Lord , and Cephas ?

verses.z: 獨有我與巴拿巴沒有權柄不做工嗎？
verses.e: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work ?

verses.z: 有誰當兵自備糧餉呢？有誰栽葡萄園不吃園裏的果子呢？有誰牧養牛羊不吃牛羊的奶呢？
verses.e: What soldier ever serves at his own expense ? Who plants a vineyard , and doesn't eat of its fruit ? Or who feeds a flock , and doesn't drink from the flock's milk ?

verses.z: 我說這話，豈是照人的意見；律法不也是這樣說嗎？
verses.e: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men ? Or doesn't the law also say the same thing ?

verses.z: 就如摩西的律法記着說：「牛[在場上]踹穀的時候，不可籠住牠的嘴。」難道上帝所掛念的是牛嗎？
verses.e: For it is written in the law of Moses , " You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain . " Is it for the oxen that God cares ,

verses.z: 論到從起初原有的生命之道，就是我們所聽見、所看見、親眼看過、親手摸過的。（
verses.e: That which was from the beginning , that which we have heard , that which we have seen with our eyes , that which we saw , and our hands touched , concerning the Word of life

verses.z: 我們若說自己沒有犯過罪，便是以上帝為說謊的，他的道也不在我們心裏了。
verses.e: If we say that we haven't sinned , we make him a liar , and his word is not in us .

verses.z: 這生命已經顯現出來，我們也看見過，現在又作見證，將原與父同在、且顯現與我們那永遠的生命傳給你們。）
verses.e: ( and the life was revealed , and we have seen , and testify , and declare to you the life , the eternal life , which was with the Father , and was revealed to us ) ;

verses.z: 我們將所看見、所聽見的傳給你們，使你們與我們相交。我們乃是與父並他兒子耶穌基督相交的。
verses.e: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you , that you also may have fellowship with us . Yes , and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son , Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 我們將這些話寫給你們，使你們的喜樂充足。
verses.e: And we write these things to you , that our joy may be fulfilled .

verses.z: 上帝就是光，在他毫無黑暗。這是我們從主所聽見、又報給你們的信息。
verses.e: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you , that God is light , and in him is no darkness at all .

verses.z: 我們若說是與上帝相交，卻仍在黑暗裏行，就是說謊話，不行真理了。
verses.e: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness , we lie and don't tell the truth .

verses.z: 我們若在光明中行，如同上帝在光明中，就彼此相交，他兒子耶穌的血也洗淨我們一切的罪。
verses.e: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light , we have fellowship with one another , and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son , cleanses us from all sin .

verses.z: 我們若說自己無罪，便是自欺，真理不在我們心裏了。
verses.e: If we say that we have no sin , we deceive ourselves , and the truth is not in us .

verses.z: 我們若認自己的罪，上帝是信實的，是公義的，必要赦免我們的罪，洗淨我們一切的不義。
verses.e: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .

verses.z: 我小子們哪，我將這些話寫給你們，是要叫你們不犯罪。若有人犯罪，在父那裏我們有一位中保，就是那義者耶穌基督。
verses.e: My little children , I write these things to you so that you may not sin . If anyone sins , we have a Counselor with the Father , Jesus Christ , the righteous .

verses.z: 愛弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在他並沒有絆跌的緣由。
verses.e: He who loves his brother remains in the light , and there is no occasion for stumbling in him .

verses.z: 惟獨恨弟兄的，是在黑暗裏，且在黑暗裏行，也不知道往哪裏去，因為黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。
verses.e: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness , and walks in the darkness , and doesn't know where he is going , because the darkness has blinded his eyes .

verses.z: 小子們哪，我寫信給你們，因為你們的罪藉着主名得了赦免。
verses.e: I write to you , little children , because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake .

verses.z: 父老啊，我寫信給你們，因為你們認識那從起初原有的。少年人哪，我寫信給你們，因為你們勝了那惡者。
verses.e: I write to you , fathers , because you know him who is from the beginning . I write to you , young men , because you have overcome the evil one . I write to you , little children , because you know the Father .

verses.z: 小子們哪，我曾寫信給你們，因為你們認識父。父老啊，我曾寫信給你們，因為你們認識那從起初原有的。少年人哪，我曾寫信給你們；因為你們剛強，上帝的道常存在你們心裏；你們也勝了那惡者。
verses.e: I have written to you , fathers , because you know him who is from the beginning . I have written to you , young men , because you are strong , and the word of God remains in you , and you have overcome the evil one .

verses.z: 不要愛世界和世界上的事。人若愛世界，愛父的心就不在他裏面了。
verses.e: Don't love the world or the things that are in the world . If anyone loves the world , the Father's love isn't in him .

verses.z: 因為，凡世界上的事，就像肉體的情慾、眼目的情慾，並今生的驕傲，都不是從父來的，乃是從世界來的。
verses.e: For all that is in the world — the lust of the flesh , the lust of the eyes , and the pride of life — isn't the Father's , but is the world's .

verses.z: 這世界和其上的情慾都要過去，惟獨遵行上帝旨意的，是永遠常存。
verses.e: The world is passing away with its lusts , but he who does God's will remains forever .

verses.z: 小子們哪，如今是末時了。你們曾聽見說，那敵基督的要來；現在已經有好些敵基督的出來了，從此我們就知道如今是末時了。
verses.e: Little children , these are the end times , and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming , even now many antichrists have arisen . By this we know that it is the final hour .

verses.z: 他們從我們中間出去，卻不是屬我們的；若是屬我們的，就必仍舊與我們同在；[他們出去]，顯明都不是屬我們的。
verses.e: They went out from us , but they didn't belong to us ; for if they had belonged to us , they would have continued with us . But they left , that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us .

verses.z: 他為我們的罪作了挽回祭，不是單為我們的罪，也是為普天下人的罪。
verses.e: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins , and not for ours only , but also for the whole world .

verses.z: 你們從那聖者受了[恩]膏，並且知道這一切的事。
verses.e: You have an anointing from the Holy One , and you all have knowledge .

verses.z: 我寫信給你們，不是因你們不知道真理，正是因你們知道，並且知道沒有虛謊是從真理出來的。
