verses.e: I have not written to you because you don't know the truth , but because you know it , and because no lie is of the truth .

verses.z: 誰是說謊話的呢？不是那不認耶穌為基督的嗎？不認父與子的，這就是敵基督的。
verses.e: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ ? This is the Antichrist , he who denies the Father and the Son .

verses.z: 凡不認子的，就沒有父；認子的，連父也有了。
verses.e: Whoever denies the Son doesn't have the Father . He who confesses the Son has the Father also .

verses.z: 論到你們，務要將那從起初所聽見的，常存在心裏。若將從起初所聽見的存在心裏，你們就必住在子裏面，也必住在父裏面。
verses.e: Therefore , as for you , let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning . If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you , you also will remain in the Son , and in the Father .

verses.z: 主所應許我們的就是永生。
verses.e: This is the promise which he promised us , the eternal life .

verses.z: 我將這些話寫給你們，是指着那引誘你們的人說的。
verses.e: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray .

verses.z: 你們從主所受的[恩]膏常存在你們心裏，並不用人教訓你們，自有主的[恩]膏在凡事上教訓你們。這[恩]膏是真的，不是假的；你們要按這[恩]膏的教訓住在主裏面。
verses.e: As for you , the anointing which you received from him remains in you , and you don't need for anyone to teach you . But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things , and is true , and is no lie , and even as it taught you , you will remain in him .

verses.z: 小子們哪，你們要住在主裏面。這樣，他若顯現，我們就可以坦然無懼；當他來的時候，在他面前也不至於慚愧。
verses.e: Now , little children , remain in him , that when he appears , we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming .

verses.z: 你們若知道他是公義的，就知道凡行公義之人都是他所生的。
verses.e: If you know that he is righteous , you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him .

verses.z: 我們若遵守他的誡命，就曉得是認識他。
verses.e: This is how we know that we know him : if we keep his commandments .

verses.z: 人若說「我認識他」，卻不遵守他的誡命，便是說謊話的，真理也不在他心裏了。
verses.e: One who says , " I know him , " and doesn't keep his commandments , is a liar , and the truth isn't in him .

verses.z: 凡遵守主道的，愛上帝的心在他裏面實在是完全的。從此，我們知道我們是在主裏面。
verses.e: But God's love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word . This is how we know that we are in him :

verses.z: 人若說他住在主裏面，就該自己照主所行的去行。
verses.e: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我寫給你們的，不是一條新命令，乃是你們從起初所受的舊命令；這舊命令就是你們所聽見的道。
verses.e: Brothers , I write no new commandment to you , but an old commandment which you had from the beginning . The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning .

verses.z: 再者，我寫給你們的，是一條新命令，在主是真的，在你們也是真的；因為黑暗漸漸過去，真光已經照耀。
verses.e: Again , I write a new commandment to you , which is true in him and in you , because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines .

verses.z: 人若說自己在光明中，卻恨他的弟兄，他到如今還是在黑暗裏。
verses.e: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now .

verses.z: 你看父賜給我們是何等的慈愛，使我們得稱為上帝的兒女；我們也真是他的兒女。世人所以不認識我們，是因未曾認識他。
verses.e: See how great a love the Father has given to us , that we should be called children of God ! For this cause the world doesn't know us , because it didn't know him .

verses.z: 從此就顯出誰是上帝的兒女，誰是魔鬼的兒女。凡不行義的就不屬上帝，不愛弟兄的也是如此。
verses.e: In this the children of God are revealed , and the children of the devil . Whoever doesn't do righteousness is not of God , neither is he who doesn't love his brother .

verses.z: 我們應當彼此相愛。這就是你們從起初所聽見的命令。
verses.e: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning , that we should love one another —

verses.z: 不可像該隱；他是屬那惡者，殺了他的兄弟。為甚麼殺了他呢？因自己的行為是惡的，兄弟的行為是善的。
verses.e: unlike Cain , who was of the evil one and killed his brother . Why did he kill him ? Because his deeds were evil , and his brother's righteous .

verses.z: 弟兄們，世人若恨你們，不要以為希奇。
verses.e: Don't be surprised , my brothers , if the world hates you .

verses.z: 我們因為愛弟兄，就曉得是已經出死入生了。沒有愛心的，仍住在死中。
verses.e: We know that we have passed out of death into life , because we love the brothers . He who doesn't love his brother remains in death .

verses.z: 凡恨他弟兄的，就是殺人的；你們曉得凡殺人的，沒有永生存在他裏面。
verses.e: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer , and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him .

verses.z: 主為我們捨命，我們從此就知道何為愛；我們也當為弟兄捨命。
verses.e: By this we know love , because he laid down his life for us . And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers .

verses.z: 凡有世上財物的，看見弟兄窮乏，卻塞住憐恤的心，愛上帝的心怎能存在他裏面呢？
verses.e: But whoever has the world's goods and sees his brother in need , then closes his heart of compassion against him , how does God's love remain in him ?

verses.z: 小子們哪，我們相愛，不要只在言語和舌頭上，總要在行為和誠實上。
verses.e: My little children , let's not love in word only , or with the tongue only , but in deed and truth .

verses.z: 從此就知道我們是屬真理的，並且我們的心在上帝面前可以安穩。
verses.e: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him ,

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們現在是上帝的兒女，將來如何，還未顯明；但我們知道，主若顯現，我們必要像他，因為必得見他的真體。
verses.e: Beloved , now we are children of God . It is not yet revealed what we will be ; but we know that when he is revealed , we will be like him , for we will see him just as he is .

verses.z: 我們的心若責備我們，上帝比我們的心大，一切事沒有不知道的。
verses.e: because if our heart condemns us , God is greater than our heart , and knows all things .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們的心若不責備我們，就可以向上帝坦然無懼了。
verses.e: Beloved , if our hearts don't condemn us , we have boldness toward God ;

verses.z: 並且我們一切所求的，就從他得着；因為我們遵守他的命令，行他所喜悅的事。
verses.e: so whatever we ask , we receive from him , because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight .

verses.z: 上帝的命令就是叫我們信他兒子耶穌基督的名，且照他所賜給我們的命令彼此相愛。
verses.e: This is his commandment , that we should believe in the name of his Son , Jesus Christ , and love one another , even as he commanded .

verses.z: 遵守上帝命令的，就住在上帝裏面，上帝也住在他裏面。我們所以知道上帝住在我們裏面是因他所賜給我們的[聖]靈。
verses.e: He who keeps his commandments remains in him , and he in him . By this we know that he remains in us , by the Spirit which he gave us .

verses.z: 凡向他有這指望的，就潔淨自己，像他潔淨一樣。
verses.e: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself , even as he is pure .

verses.z: 凡犯罪的，就是違背律法；違背律法就是罪。
verses.e: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness . Sin is lawlessness .

verses.z: 你們知道主曾顯現，是要除掉人的罪，在他並沒有罪。
verses.e: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins , and no sin is in him .

verses.z: 凡住在他裏面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾看見他，也未曾認識他。
verses.e: Whoever remains in him doesn't sin . Whoever sins hasn't seen him and doesn't know him .

verses.z: 小子們哪，不要被人誘惑。行義的才是義人，正如主是義的一樣。
verses.e: Little children , let no one lead you astray . He who does righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .

verses.z: 犯罪的是屬魔鬼，因為魔鬼從起初就犯罪。上帝的兒子顯現出來，為要除滅魔鬼的作為。
verses.e: He who sins is of the devil , for the devil has been sinning from the beginning . To this end the Son of God was revealed : that he might destroy the works of the devil .

verses.z: 凡從上帝生的，就不犯罪，因上帝的道存在他心裏；他也不能犯罪，因為他是由上帝生的。
verses.e: Whoever is born of God doesn't commit sin , because his seed remains in him , and he can't sin , because he is born of God .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，一切的靈，你們不可都信，總要試驗那些靈是出於上帝的不是，因為世上有許多假先知已經出來了。
verses.e: Beloved , don't believe every spirit , but test the spirits , whether they are of God , because many false prophets have gone out into the world .

verses.z: 不是我們愛上帝，乃是上帝愛我們，差他的兒子為我們的罪作了挽回祭，這就是愛了。
verses.e: In this is love , not that we loved God , but that he loved us , and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，上帝既是這樣愛我們，我們也當彼此相愛。
verses.e: Beloved , if God loved us in this way , we also ought to love one another .

verses.z: 從來沒有人見過上帝，我們若彼此相愛，上帝就住在我們裏面，愛他的心在我們裏面得以完全了。
verses.e: No one has seen God at any time . If we love one another , God remains in us , and his love has been perfected in us .

verses.z: 上帝將他的靈賜給我們，從此就知道我們是住在他裏面，他也住在我們裏面。
verses.e: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us , because he has given us of his Spirit .

verses.z: 父差子作世人的救主；這是我們所看見且作見證的。
verses.e: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world .

verses.z: 凡認耶穌為上帝兒子的，上帝就住在他裏面，他也住在上帝裏面。
verses.e: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God , God remains in him , and he in God .

verses.z: 上帝愛我們的心，我們也知道也信。上帝就是愛；住在愛裏面的，就是住在上帝裏面，上帝也住在他裏面。
verses.e: We know and have believed the love which God has for us . God is love , and he who remains in love remains in God , and God remains in him .

verses.z: 這樣，愛在我們裏面得以完全，我們就可以在審判的日子坦然無懼。因為他如何，我們在這世上也如何。
verses.e: In this , love has been made perfect among us , that we may have boldness in the day of judgment , because as he is , even so we are in this world .

verses.z: 愛裏沒有懼怕；愛既完全，就把懼怕除去。因為懼怕裏含着刑罰，懼怕的人在愛裏未得完全。
verses.e: There is no fear in love ; but perfect love casts out fear , because fear has punishment . He who fears is not made perfect in love .

verses.z: 我們愛，因為上帝先愛我們。
verses.e: We love him , because he first loved us .

verses.z: 凡靈認耶穌基督是成了肉身來的，就是出於上帝的；從此你們可以認出上帝的靈來。
verses.e: By this you know the Spirit of God : every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God ,

verses.z: 人若說「我愛上帝」，卻恨他的弟兄，就是說謊話的；不愛他所看見的弟兄，就不能愛沒有看見的上帝。
verses.e: If a man says , " I love God , " and hates his brother , he is a liar ; for he who doesn't love his brother whom he has seen , how can he love God whom he has not seen ?

verses.z: 愛上帝的，也當愛弟兄，這是我們從上帝所受的命令。
verses.e: This commandment we have from him , that he who loves God should also love his brother .

verses.z: 凡靈不認耶穌，就不是出於上帝，這是那敵基督者的靈。你們從前聽見他要來，現在已經在世上了。
verses.e: and every spirit who doesn't confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God ; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist , of whom you have heard that it comes . Now it is in the world already .

verses.z: 小子們哪，你們是屬上帝的，並且勝了他們；因為那在你們裏面的，比那在世界上的更大。
verses.e: You are of God , little children , and have overcome them , because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world .

verses.z: 他們是屬世界的，所以論世界的事，世人也聽從他們。
verses.e: They are of the world . Therefore they speak of the world , and the world hears them .

verses.z: 我們是屬上帝的，認識上帝的就聽從我們；不屬上帝的就不聽從我們。從此我們可以認出真理的靈和謬妄的靈來。
verses.e: We are of God . He who knows God listens to us . He who is not of God doesn't listen to us . By this we know the spirit of truth , and the spirit of error .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們應當彼此相愛，因為愛是從上帝來的。凡有愛心的，都是由上帝而生，並且認識上帝。
verses.e: Beloved , let's love one another , for love is of God ; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God .

verses.z: 沒有愛心的，就不認識上帝，因為上帝就是愛。
verses.e: He who doesn't love doesn't know God , for God is love .

verses.z: 上帝差他獨生子到世間來，使我們藉着他得生，上帝愛我們的心在此就顯明了。
verses.e: By this God's love was revealed in us , that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him .

verses.z: 凡信耶穌是基督的，都是從上帝而生，凡愛生他之上帝的，也必愛從上帝生的。
verses.e: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God . Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him .

verses.z: 信上帝兒子的，就有這見證在他心裏；不信上帝的，就是將上帝當作說謊的，因不信上帝為他兒子作的見證。
verses.e: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself . He who doesn't believe God has made him a liar , because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son .

verses.z: 這見證就是上帝賜給我們永生；這[永]生也是在他兒子裏面。
verses.e: The testimony is this : that God gave to us eternal life , and this life is in his Son .

verses.z: 人有了[上帝的]兒子就有生命，沒有上帝的兒子就沒有生命。
verses.e: He who has the Son has the life . He who doesn't have God's Son doesn't have the life .

verses.z: 我將這些話寫給你們信奉上帝兒子之名的人，要叫你們知道自己有永生。
verses.e: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God , that you may know that you have eternal life , and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God .

verses.z: 我們若照他的旨意求甚麼，他就聽我們，這是我們向他所存坦然無懼的心。
verses.e: This is the boldness which we have toward him , that if we ask anything according to his will , he listens to us .

verses.z: 既然知道他聽我們一切所求的，就知道我們所求於他的，無不得着。
verses.e: And if we know that he listens to us , whatever we ask , we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him .

verses.z: 人若看見弟兄犯了不至於死的罪，就當為他祈求，[上帝]必將生命賜給他；有至於死的罪，我不說當為這罪祈求。
verses.e: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death , he shall ask , and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death . There is sin leading to death . I don't say that he should make a request concerning this .

verses.z: 凡不義的事都是罪，也有不至於死的罪。
verses.e: All unrighteousness is sin , and there is sin not leading to death .

verses.z: 我們知道凡從上帝生的，必不犯罪，從上帝生的，必保守自己，那惡者也就無法害他。
verses.e: We know that whoever is born of God doesn't sin , but he who was born of God keeps himself , and the evil one doesn't touch him .

verses.z: 我們知道，我們是屬上帝的，全世界都臥在那惡者手下。
verses.e: We know that we are of God , and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one .

verses.z: 我們若愛上帝，又遵守他的誡命，從此就知道我們愛上帝的兒女。
verses.e: By this we know that we love the children of God , when we love God and keep his commandments .

verses.z: 我們也知道，上帝的兒子已經來到，且將智慧賜給我們，使我們認識那位真實的，我們也在那位真實的裏面，就是在他兒子耶穌基督裏面。這是真神，也是永生。
verses.e: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding , that we know him who is true ; and we are in him who is true , in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God and eternal life .

verses.z: 小子們哪，你們要自守，遠避偶像！
verses.e: Little children , keep yourselves from idols .

verses.z: 我們遵守上帝的誡命，這就是愛他了，並且他的誡命不是難守的。
verses.e: For this is loving God , that we keep his commandments . His commandments are not grievous .

verses.z: 因為凡從上帝生的，就勝過世界；使我們勝了世界的，就是我們的信心。
verses.e: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world . This is the victory that has overcome the world : your faith .

verses.z: 勝過世界的是誰呢？不是那信耶穌是上帝兒子的嗎？
verses.e: Who is he who overcomes the world , but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God ?

verses.z: 這藉着水和血而來的，就是耶穌基督；不是單用水，乃是用水又用血，
verses.e: This is he who came by water and blood , Jesus Christ ; not with the water only , but with the water and the blood . It is the Spirit who testifies , because the Spirit is the truth .

verses.z: 並且有[聖]靈作見證，因為[聖]靈就是真理。
verses.e: For there are three who testify :

verses.z: 作見證的原來有三：就是[聖]靈、水，與血，這三樣也都歸於一。
verses.e: the Spirit , the water , and the blood ; and the three agree as one .

verses.z: 我們既領受人的見證，上帝的見證更該領受了，因上帝的見證是為他兒子作的。
verses.e: If we receive the witness of men , the witness of God is greater ; for this is God's testimony which he has testified concerning his Son .

verses.z: 大衛王年紀老邁，雖用被遮蓋，仍不覺暖。
verses.e: Now King David was old and advanced in years ; and they covered him with clothes , but he couldn't keep warm .

verses.z: 惟獨先知拿單和比拿雅並勇士，與他的兄弟所羅門，他都沒有請。
verses.e: but he didn't call Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah , and the mighty men , and Solomon his brother .

verses.z: 拿單對所羅門的母親拔示巴說：「哈及的兒子亞多尼雅作王了，你沒有聽見嗎？我們的主大衛卻不知道。
verses.e: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon , saying , " Haven't you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns , and David our lord doesn't know it ?

verses.z: 現在我可以給你出個主意，好保全你和你兒子所羅門的性命。
verses.e: Now therefore come , please let me give you counsel , that you may save your own life and your son Solomon's life .

verses.z: 你進去見大衛王，對他說：『我主我王啊，你不曾向婢女起誓說：你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上嗎？現在亞多尼雅怎麼作了王呢？』
verses.e: Go in to King David , and tell him , ' Didn't you , my lord the king , swear to your servant , saying , " Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me , and he shall sit on my throne " ? Why then does Adonijah reign ? '

verses.z: 你還與王說話的時候，我也隨後進去，證實你的話。」
verses.e: Behold , while you are still talking there with the king , I will also come in after you and confirm your words . "

verses.z: 拔示巴進入內室見王，王甚老邁，書念的童女亞比煞正伺候王。
verses.e: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room . The king was very old ; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king .

verses.z: 拔示巴向王屈身下拜；王說：「你要甚麼？」
verses.e: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king . The king said , " What would you like ? "

verses.z: 她說：「我主啊，你曾向婢女指着耶和華－你的上帝起誓[說]：『你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上。』
verses.e: She said to him , " My lord , you swore by the LORD your God to your servant , ' Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me , and he shall sit on my throne . '

verses.z: 現在亞多尼雅作王了，我主我王卻不知道。
verses.e: Now , behold , Adonijah reigns ; and you , my lord the king , don't know it .

verses.z: 他宰了許多牛羊、肥犢，請了王的眾子和祭司亞比亞他，並元帥約押；惟獨王的僕人所羅門，他沒有請。
verses.e: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance , and has called all the sons of the king , Abiathar the priest , and Joab the captain of the army ; but he hasn't called Solomon your servant .

verses.z: 所以臣僕對他說：「不如為我主我王尋找一個處女，使她伺候王，奉養王，睡在王的懷中，好叫我主我王得暖。」
verses.e: Therefore his servants said to him , " Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king . Let her stand before the king , and cherish him ; and let her lie in your bosom , that my lord the king may keep warm . "

verses.z: 我主我王啊，以色列眾人的眼目都仰望你，等你曉諭他們，在我主我王之後誰坐你的位。
verses.e: You , my lord the king , the eyes of all Israel are on you , that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him .

verses.z: 若不然，到我主我王與列祖同睡以後，我和我兒子所羅門必算為罪人了。」
verses.e: Otherwise it will happen , when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers , that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals . "

verses.z: 拔示巴還與王說話的時候，先知拿單也進來了。
verses.e: Behold , while she was still talking with the king , Nathan the prophet came in .

verses.z: 有人奏告王說：「先知拿單來了。」拿單進到王前，臉伏於地。
verses.e: They told the king , saying , " Behold , Nathan the prophet ! " When he had come in before the king , he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground .

verses.z: 拿單說：「我主我王果然應許亞多尼雅說『你必接續我作王，坐在我的位上』嗎？
verses.e: Nathan said , " My lord , King , have you said , ' Adonijah shall reign after me , and he shall sit on my throne ' ?

verses.z: 他今日下去，宰了許多牛羊、肥犢，請了王的眾子和軍長，並祭司亞比亞他；他們正在亞多尼雅面前吃喝，說：『願亞多尼雅王萬歲！』
verses.e: For he has gone down today , and has slain cattle , fatlings , and sheep in abundance , and has called all the king's sons , the captains of the army , and Abiathar the priest . Behold , they are eating and drinking before him , and saying , ' Long live King Adonijah ! '

verses.z: 惟獨我，就是你的僕人和祭司撒督，耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，並王的僕人所羅門，他都沒有請。
verses.e: But he hasn't called me , even me your servant , Zadok the priest , Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and your servant Solomon .

verses.z: 這事果然出乎我主我王嗎？王卻沒有告訴僕人們，在我主我王之後誰坐你的位。」
verses.e: Was this thing done by my lord the king , and you haven't shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him ? "

verses.z: 大衛王吩咐說：「叫拔示巴來。」拔示巴就進來，站在王面前。
verses.e: Then King David answered , " Call Bathsheba in to me . " She came into the king's presence and stood before the king .

verses.z: 王起誓說：「我指着救我性命脫離一切苦難、永生的耶和華起誓。
verses.e: The king vowed and said , " As the LORD lives , who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity ,

verses.z: 於是在以色列全境尋找美貌的童女，尋得書念的一個童女亞比煞，就帶到王那裏。
verses.e: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel , and found Abishag the Shunammite , and brought her to the king .

verses.z: 我既然指着耶和華－以色列的上帝向你起誓說：你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上。我今日就必照這話而行。」
verses.e: most certainly as I swore to you by the LORD , the God of Israel , saying , ' Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me , and he shall sit on my throne in my place ; ' I will most certainly do this today . "

verses.z: 於是，拔示巴臉伏於地，向王下拜，說：「願我主大衛王萬歲！」
verses.e: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king , and said , " Let my lord King David live forever ! "

verses.z: 大衛王又吩咐說：「將祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅召來！」他們就都來到王面前。
verses.e: King David said , " Call to me Zadok the priest , Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada . " They came before the king .

verses.z: 王對他們說：「要帶領你們主的僕人，使我兒子所羅門騎我的騾子，送他下到基訓；
verses.e: The king said to them , " Take with you the servants of your lord , and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule , and bring him down to Gihon .

verses.z: 在那裏，祭司撒督和先知拿單要膏他作以色列的王；你們也要吹角，說：『願所羅門王萬歲！』
verses.e: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel . Blow the trumpet , and say , ' Long live King Solomon ! '

verses.z: 然後要跟隨他上來，使他坐在我的位上，接續我作王。我已立他作以色列和猶大的君。」
verses.e: Then come up after him , and he shall come and sit on my throne ; for he shall be king in my place . I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah . "

verses.z: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅對王說：「阿們！願耶和華－我主我王的上帝也這樣命定。
verses.e: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king , and said , " Amen . May the LORD , the God of my lord the king , say so .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣與我主我王同在，願他照樣與所羅門同在，使他的國位比我主大衛王的國位更大。」
verses.e: As the LORD has been with my lord the king , even so may he be with Solomon , and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David . "

verses.z: 於是，祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都下去使所羅門騎大衛王的騾子，將他送到基訓。
verses.e: So Zadok the priest , Nathan the prophet , Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David's mule , and brought him to Gihon .

verses.z: 祭司撒督就從帳幕中取了盛膏油的角來，用膏膏所羅門。人就吹角，眾民都說：「願所羅門王萬歲！」
verses.e: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent , and anointed Solomon . They blew the trumpet ; and all the people said , " Long live King Solomon ! "

verses.z: 這童女極其美貌，她奉養王，伺候王，王卻沒有與她親近。
verses.e: The young lady was very beautiful ; and she cherished the king , and served him ; but the king didn't know her intimately .

verses.z: 眾民跟隨他上來，且吹笛，大大歡呼，聲音震地。
verses.e: All the people came up after him , and the people piped with pipes , and rejoiced with great joy , so that the earth shook with their sound .

verses.z: 亞多尼雅和所請的眾客筵宴方畢，聽見這聲音；約押聽見角聲就說：「城中為何有這響聲呢？」
verses.e: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating . When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet , he said , " Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar ? "

verses.z: 他正說話的時候，祭司亞比亞他的兒子約拿單來了。亞多尼雅對他說：「進來吧！你是個忠義的人，必是報好信息。」
verses.e: While he yet spoke , behold , Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came ; and Adonijah said , " Come in ; for you are a worthy man , and bring good news . "

verses.z: 約拿單對亞多尼雅說：「我們的主大衛王誠然立所羅門為王了。
verses.e: Jonathan answered Adonijah , " Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king .

verses.z: 王差遣祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都去使所羅門騎王的騾子。
verses.e: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest , Nathan the prophet , Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites and the Pelethites ; and they have caused him to ride on the king's mule .

verses.z: 祭司撒督和先知拿單在基訓已經膏他作王。眾人都從那裏歡呼着上來，聲音使城震動，這就是你們所聽見的聲音；
verses.e: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon . They have come up from there rejoicing , so that the city rang again . This is the noise that you have heard .

verses.z: 並且所羅門登了國位。
verses.e: Also , Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom .

verses.z: 王的臣僕也來為我們的主大衛王祝福，說：『願王的上帝使所羅門的名比王的名更尊榮；使他的國位比王的國位更大。』王就在床上屈身下拜。
verses.e: Moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord King David , saying , ' May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name , and make his throne greater than your throne ; ' and the king bowed himself on the bed .

verses.z: 王又說：『耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的；因他賜我一人今日坐在我的位上，我也親眼看見了。』」
verses.e: Also thus said the king , ' Blessed be the LORD , the God of Israel , who has given one to sit on my throne today , my eyes even seeing it . ' "

verses.z: 亞多尼雅的眾客[聽見這話]就都驚懼，起來四散。
verses.e: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid , and rose up , and each man went his way .

verses.z: 那時，哈及的兒子亞多尼雅自尊，說：「我必作王」，就為自己預備車輛、馬兵，又派五十人在他前頭奔走。
verses.e: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself , saying , " I will be king . " Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen , and fifty men to run before him .

verses.z: 亞多尼雅懼怕所羅門，就起來，去抓住祭壇的角。
verses.e: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon ; and he arose , and went , and hung onto the horns of the altar .

verses.z: 有人告訴所羅門說：「亞多尼雅懼怕所羅門王，現在抓住祭壇的角，說：『願所羅門王今日向我起誓，必不用刀殺僕人。』」
verses.e: Solomon was told , " Behold , Adonijah fears King Solomon ; for , behold , he is hanging onto the horns of the altar , saying , ' Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword . ' "

verses.z: 所羅門說：「他若作忠義的人，連一根頭髮也不致落在地上；他若行惡，必要死亡。」
verses.e: Solomon said , " If he shows himself a worthy man , not a hair of his shall fall to the earth ; but if wickedness is found in him , he shall die . "

verses.z: 於是所羅門王差遣人，使亞多尼雅從壇上下來，他就來，向所羅門王下拜；所羅門對他說：「你回家去吧！」
verses.e: So King Solomon sent , and they brought him down from the altar . He came and bowed down to King Solomon ; and Solomon said to him , " Go to your house . "

verses.z: 他父親素來沒有使他憂悶，說：「你是做甚麼呢？」他甚俊美，生在押沙龍之後。
verses.e: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying , " Why have you done so ? " and he was also a very handsome man ; and he was born after Absalom .

verses.z: 亞多尼雅與洗魯雅的兒子約押，和祭司亞比亞他商議；二人就順從他，幫助他。
verses.e: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest ; and they followed Adonijah and helped him .

verses.z: 但祭司撒督、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅、先知拿單、示每、利以，並大衛的勇士都不順從亞多尼雅。
verses.e: But Zadok the priest , Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , Nathan the prophet , Shimei , Rei , and the mighty men who belonged to David , were not with Adonijah .

verses.z: 一日，亞多尼雅在隱‧羅結旁、瑣希列磐石那裏宰了牛羊、肥犢，請他的諸弟兄，就是王的眾子，並所有作王臣僕的猶大人；
verses.e: Adonijah killed sheep , cattle , and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth , which is beside En Rogel ; and he called all his brothers , the king's sons , and all the men of Judah , the king's servants ;

verses.z: 示巴女王聽見所羅門因耶和華之名所得的名聲，就來要用難解的話試問所羅門。
verses.e: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD's name , she came to test him with hard questions .

verses.z: 於是，示巴女王將一百二十他連得金子和寶石，與極多的香料，送給所羅門王。她送給王的香料，以後奉來的不再有這樣多。（
verses.e: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold , and a very great quantity of spices , and precious stones . Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon .

verses.z: 希蘭的船隻從俄斐運了金子來，又從俄斐運了許多檀香木和寶石來。
verses.e: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones .

verses.z: 王用檀香木為耶和華殿和王宮做欄杆，又為歌唱的人做琴瑟。以後再沒有這樣的檀香木進國來，也沒有人看見過，直到如今。）
verses.e: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD's house and for the king's house , harps also and stringed instruments for the singers ; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day .

verses.z: 示巴女王一切所要所求的，所羅門王都送給她，另外照自己的厚意餽送她。於是女王和她臣僕轉回本國去了。
verses.e: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatever she asked , in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty . So she turned and went to her own land , she and her servants .

verses.z: 所羅門每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他連得。
verses.e: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold ,

verses.z: 另外還有商人和雜族的諸王，與國中的省長[所進的金子]。
verses.e: in addition to that which the traders brought , and the traffic of the merchants , and of all the kings of the mixed people , and of the governors of the country .

verses.z: 所羅門王用錘出來的金子打成擋牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
verses.e: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold ; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler .

verses.z: 又用錘出來的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三彌那，都放在黎巴嫩林宮裏。
verses.e: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold ; three minas of gold went to one shield ; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon .

verses.z: 王用象牙製造一個寶座，用精金包裹。
verses.e: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the finest gold .

verses.z: 寶座有六層臺階，座的後背是圓的，兩旁有扶手，靠近扶手有兩個獅子站立。
verses.e: There were six steps to the throne , and the top of the throne was round behind ; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat , and two lions standing beside the armrests .

verses.z: 跟隨她到耶路撒冷的人甚多，又有駱駝馱着香料、寶石，和許多金子。她來見了所羅門王，就把心裏所有的對所羅門都說出來。
verses.e: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan , with camels that bore spices , very much gold , and precious stones ; and when she had come to Solomon , she talked with him about all that was in her heart .

verses.z: 六層臺階上有十二個獅子站立，每層有兩個：左邊一個，右邊一個；在列國中沒有這樣做的。
verses.e: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps . Nothing like it was made in any kingdom .

verses.z: 所羅門王一切的飲器都是金子的。黎巴嫩林宮裏的一切器皿都是精金的。所羅門年間，銀子算不了甚麼。
verses.e: All King Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold . None were of silver , because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon .

verses.z: 因為王有他施船隻與希蘭的船隻一同航海，三年一次，裝載金銀、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回來。
verses.e: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram's fleet . Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold , silver , ivory , apes , and peacocks .

verses.z: 所羅門王的財寶與智慧勝過天下的列王。
verses.e: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom .

verses.z: 普天下的王都求見所羅門，要聽上帝賜給他智慧的話。
verses.e: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart .

verses.z: 他們各帶貢物，就是金器、銀器、衣服、軍械、香料、騾馬，每年有一定之例。
verses.e: Year after year , every man brought his tribute , vessels of silver , vessels of gold , clothing , armor , spices , horses , and mules .

verses.z: 所羅門聚集戰車馬兵，有戰車一千四百輛，馬兵一萬二千名，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裏。
verses.e: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen . He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen . He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 王在耶路撒冷使銀子多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
verses.e: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem , and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland .

verses.z: 所羅門的馬是從埃及帶來的，是王的商人一群一群按着定價買來的。
verses.e: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt . The king's merchants received them in droves , each drove at a price .

verses.z: 從埃及買來的車，每輛價銀六百[舍客勒]，馬每匹一百五十[舍客勒]。赫人諸王和亞蘭諸王所買的車馬，也是按這價值經他們手買來的。
verses.e: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver , and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels ; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria .

verses.z: 所羅門王將她所問的都答上了，沒有一句不明白、不能答的。
verses.e: Solomon answered all her questions . There wasn't anything hidden from the king which he didn't tell her .

verses.z: 示巴女王見所羅門大有智慧，和他所建造的宮室，
verses.e: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon , the house that he had built ,

verses.z: 席上的珍饈美味，群臣分列而坐，僕人兩旁侍立，以及他們的衣服裝飾和酒政的[衣服裝飾]，又見他上耶和華殿的臺階，就詫異得神不守舍；
verses.e: the food of his table , the sitting of his servants , the attendance of his officials , their clothing , his cup bearers , and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD's house , there was no more spirit in her .

verses.z: 對王說：「我在本國裏所聽見論到你的事和你的智慧實在是真的！
verses.e: She said to the king , " It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom .

verses.z: 我先不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了才知道人所告訴我的還不到一半。你的智慧和你的福分越過我所聽見的風聲。
verses.e: However , I didn't believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it . Behold , not even half was told me ! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard .

verses.z: 你的臣子、你的僕人常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話是有福的！
verses.e: Happy are your men , happy are these your servants who stand continually before you , who hear your wisdom .

verses.z: 耶和華－你的上帝是應當稱頌的！他喜悅你，使你坐以色列的國位；因為他永遠愛以色列，所以立你作王，使你秉公行義。」
verses.e: Blessed is the LORD your God , who delighted in you , to set you on the throne of Israel . Because the LORD loved Israel forever , therefore he made you king , to do justice and righteousness . "

verses.z: 所羅門王在法老的女兒之外，又寵愛許多外邦女子，就是摩押女子、亞捫女子、以東女子、西頓女子、赫人女子。
verses.e: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women , together with the daughter of Pharaoh : women of the Moabites , Ammonites , Edomites , Sidonians , and Hittites ,

verses.z: 耶和華曾吩咐他不可隨從別神，他卻沒有遵守耶和華所吩咐的。
verses.e: and had commanded him concerning this thing , that he should not go after other gods ; but he didn't keep that which the LORD commanded .

verses.z: 所以耶和華對他說：「你既行了這事，不遵守我所吩咐你守的約和律例，我必將你的國奪回，賜給你的臣子。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon , " Because this is done by you , and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded you , I will surely tear the kingdom from you , and will give it to your servant .

verses.z: 然而，因你父親大衛的緣故，我不在你活着的日子行這事，必從你兒子的手中將國奪回。
verses.e: Nevertheless , I will not do it in your days , for David your father's sake ; but I will tear it out of your son's hand .

verses.z: 只是我不將全國奪回，要因我僕人大衛和我所選擇的耶路撒冷，還留一支派給你的兒子。」
verses.e: However , I will not tear away all the kingdom ; but I will give one tribe to your son , for David my servant's sake , and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen . "

verses.z: 耶和華使以東人哈達興起，作所羅門的敵人；他是以東王的後裔。
verses.e: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon : Hadad the Edomite . He was one of the king's offspring in Edom .

verses.z: 先前大衛攻擊以東，元帥約押上去葬埋陣亡的人，將以東的男丁都殺了。
verses.e: For when David was in Edom , and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain , and had struck every male in Edom

verses.z: 約押和以色列眾人在以東住了六個月，直到將以東的男丁盡都剪除。
verses.e: ( for Joab and all Israel remained there six months , until he had cut off every male in Edom ) ,

verses.z: 那時哈達還是幼童；他和他父親的臣僕，幾個以東人逃往埃及。
verses.e: Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him , to go into Egypt , when Hadad was still a little child .

verses.z: 他們從米甸起行，到了巴蘭；從巴蘭帶着幾個人來到埃及見埃及王法老；法老為他派定糧食，又給他房屋田地。
verses.e: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran ; and they took men with them out of Paran , and they came to Egypt , to Pharaoh king of Egypt , who gave him a house , and appointed him food , and gave him land .

verses.z: 哈達在法老面前大蒙恩惠，以致法老將王后答比匿的妹子賜他為妻。
verses.e: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .

verses.z: 論到這些國的人，耶和華曾曉諭以色列人說：「你們不可與她們往來相通，因為她們必誘惑你們的心去隨從她們的神。」所羅門卻戀愛這些女子。
verses.e: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel , " You shall not go among them , neither shall they come among you , for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods . " Solomon joined to these in love .

verses.z: 答比匿的妹子給哈達生了一個兒子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使基努拔在法老的宮裏斷奶，基努拔就與法老的眾子一同住在法老的宮裏。
verses.e: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son , whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house ; and Genubath was in Pharaoh's house among the sons of Pharaoh .

verses.z: 哈達在埃及聽見大衛與他列祖同睡，元帥約押也死了，就對法老說：「求王容我回本國去。」
verses.e: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers , and that Joab the captain of the army was dead , Hadad said to Pharaoh , " Let me depart , that I may go to my own country . "

verses.z: 法老對他說：「你在我這裏有甚麼缺乏，你竟要回你本國去呢？」他回答說：「我沒有缺乏甚麼，只是求王容我回去。」
verses.e: Then Pharaoh said to him , " But what have you lacked with me , that behold , you seek to go to your own country ? " He answered , " Nothing , however only let me depart . "

verses.z: 上帝又使以利亞大的兒子利遜興起，作所羅門的敵人。他先前逃避主人瑣巴王哈大底謝。
verses.e: God raised up an adversary to him , Rezon the son of Eliada , who had fled from his lord , Hadadezer king of Zobah .

verses.z: 大衛擊殺瑣巴人的時候，利遜招聚了一群人，自己作他們的頭目，往大馬士革居住，在那裏作王。
verses.e: He gathered men to himself , and became captain over a troop , when David killed them of Zobah . They went to Damascus and lived there , and reigned in Damascus .

verses.z: 所羅門活着的時候，哈達為患之外，利遜也作以色列的敵人。他恨惡以色列人，且作了亞蘭人的王。
verses.e: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , in addition to the mischief of Hadad . He abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .

verses.z: 所羅門的臣僕、尼八的兒子耶羅波安也舉手攻擊王。他是以法蓮支派的洗利達人，他母親是寡婦，名叫洗魯阿。
verses.e: Jeroboam the son of Nebat , an Ephraimite of Zeredah , a servant of Solomon , whose mother's name was Zeruah , a widow , also lifted up his hand against the king .

verses.z: 他舉手攻擊王的緣故，乃由先前所羅門建造米羅，修補他父親大衛城的破口。
verses.e: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king : Solomon built Millo , and repaired the breach of his father David's city .

verses.z: 耶羅波安是大有才能的人。所羅門見這少年人殷勤，就派他監管約瑟家的一切工程。
verses.e: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor ; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious , and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph .

verses.z: 一日，耶羅波安出了耶路撒冷，示羅人先知亞希雅在路上遇見他；[亞希雅]身上穿着一件新衣。他們二人在田野，以外並無別人。
verses.e: At that time , when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way . Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment ; and the two of them were alone in the field .

verses.z: 所羅門有妃七百，都是公主；還有嬪三百。這些妃嬪誘惑他的心。
verses.e: He had seven hundred wives , princesses , and three hundred concubines . His wives turned his heart away .

verses.z: 亞希雅將自己穿的那件新衣撕成十二片，
verses.e: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him , and tore it in twelve pieces .

verses.z: 對耶羅波安說：「你可以拿十片。耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『我必將國從所羅門手裏奪回，將十個支派賜給你。（
verses.e: He said to Jeroboam , " Take ten pieces ; for the LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' Behold , I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

verses.z: 我因僕人大衛和我在以色列眾支派中所選擇的耶路撒冷城的緣故，仍給所羅門留一個支派。）
verses.e: ( but he shall have one tribe , for my servant David's sake and for Jerusalem's sake , the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel ) ,

verses.z: 因為他離棄我，敬拜西頓人的女神亞斯她錄、摩押的神基抹，和亞捫人的神米勒公，沒有遵從我的道，行我眼中看為正的事，[守]我的律例典章，像他父親大衛一樣。
verses.e: because they have forsaken me , and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians , Chemosh the god of Moab , and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon . They have not walked in my ways , to do that which is right in my eyes , and to keep my statutes and my ordinances , as David his father did .

verses.z: 但我不從他手裏將全國奪回；使他終身為君，是因我所揀選的僕人大衛謹守我的誡命律例。
verses.e: " ' However , I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand , but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake whom I chose , who kept my commandments and my statutes ,

verses.z: 我必從他兒子的手裏將國奪回，以十個支派賜給你，
verses.e: but I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand and will give it to you , even ten tribes .

verses.z: 還留一個支派給他的兒子，使我僕人大衛在我所選擇立我名的耶路撒冷城裏，在我面前長有燈光。
verses.e: I will give one tribe to his son , that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem , the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there .

verses.z: 我必揀選你，使你照心裏一切所願的，作王治理以色列。
verses.e: I will take you , and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires , and shall be king over Israel .

verses.z: 你若聽從我一切所吩咐你的，遵行我的道，行我眼中看為正的事，謹守我的律例誡命，像我僕人大衛所行的，我就與你同在，為你立堅固的家，像我為大衛所立的一樣，將以色列人賜給你。
verses.e: It shall be , if you will listen to all that I command you , and will walk in my ways , and do that which is right in my eyes , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did , that I will be with you , and will build you a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel to you .

verses.z: 我必因所羅門所行的使大衛後裔受患難，但不至於永遠。』」
verses.e: I will afflict the offspring of David for this , but not forever . ' "

verses.z: 所羅門年老的時候，他的妃嬪誘惑他的心去隨從別神，不效法他父親大衛誠誠實實地順服耶和華－他的上帝。
verses.e: When Solomon was old , his wives turned away his heart after other gods ; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God , as the heart of David his father was .

verses.z: 所羅門因此想要殺耶羅波安。耶羅波安卻起身逃往埃及；到了埃及王示撒那裏，就住在埃及，直到所羅門死了。
verses.e: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam , but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt , to Shishak king of Egypt , and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon .

verses.z: 所羅門其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的智慧都寫在所羅門記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon , and all that he did , and his wisdom , aren't they written in the book of the acts of Solomon ?

verses.z: 所羅門在耶路撒冷作以色列眾人的王共四十年。
verses.e: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years .

verses.z: 所羅門與他列祖同睡，葬在他父親大衛的城裏。他兒子羅波安接續他作王。
verses.e: Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in his father David's city ; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 因為所羅門隨從西頓人的女神亞斯她錄和亞捫人可憎的神米勒公。
verses.e: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .

verses.z: 所羅門行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，不效法他父親大衛專心順從耶和華。
verses.e: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and didn't go fully after the LORD , as David his father did .

verses.z: 所羅門為摩押可憎的神基抹和亞捫人可憎的神摩洛，在耶路撒冷對面的山上建築邱[壇]。
verses.e: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab , on the mountain that is before Jerusalem , and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 他為那些向自己的神燒香獻祭的外邦女子，就是他娶來的妃嬪也是這樣行。
verses.e: So he did for all his foreign wives , who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods .

verses.z: 耶和華向所羅門發怒，因為他的心偏離向他兩次顯現的耶和華－以色列的上帝。
verses.e: The LORD was angry with Solomon , because his heart was turned away from the LORD , the God of Israel , who had appeared to him twice ,

verses.z: 羅波安往示劍去；因為以色列人都到了示劍要立他作王。
verses.e: Rehoboam went to Shechem , for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king .

verses.z: 那同他長大的少年人說：「這民對王說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些。』王要對他們如此說：『我的小拇指頭比我父親的腰還粗。
verses.e: The young men who had grown up with him said to him , " Tell these people who spoke to you , saying , ' Your father made our yoke heavy , but make it lighter to us ' — tell them , ' My little finger is thicker than my father's waist .

verses.z: 我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛！我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭]責打你們！』」
verses.e: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke , but I will add to your yoke . My father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions . ' "

verses.z: 耶羅波安和眾百姓遵着羅波安王所說「你們第三日再來見我」的那話，第三日他們果然來了。
verses.e: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king asked , saying , " Come to me again the third day . "

verses.z: 王用嚴厲的話回答百姓，不用老年人給他所出的主意，
verses.e: The king answered the people roughly , and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him ,

verses.z: 照着少年人所出的主意對民說：「我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛！我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭]責打你們！」
verses.e: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men , saying , " My father made your yoke heavy , but I will add to your yoke . My father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions . "

verses.z: 王不肯依從百姓，這事乃出於耶和華，為要應驗他藉示羅人亞希雅對尼八的兒子耶羅波安所說的話。
verses.e: So the king didn't listen to the people ; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD , that he might establish his word , which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

verses.z: 以色列眾民見王不依從他們，就對王說：我們與大衛有甚麼分兒呢？與耶西的兒子並沒有關涉。以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！大衛家啊，自己顧自己吧！於是，以色列人都回自己家裏去了，
verses.e: When all Israel saw that the king didn't listen to them , the people answered the king , saying , " What portion have we in David ? We don't have an inheritance in the son of Jesse . To your tents , Israel ! Now see to your own house , David . " So Israel departed to their tents .

verses.z: 惟獨住猶大城邑的以色列人，羅波安仍作他們的王。
verses.e: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .

verses.z: 羅波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的亞多蘭往以色列人那裏去，以色列人就用石頭打死他。羅波安王急忙上車，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the men subject to forced labor ; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones . King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 這樣，以色列人背叛大衛家，直到今日。
verses.e: So Israel rebelled against David's house to this day .

verses.z: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安先前躲避所羅門王，逃往埃及，住在那裏（他聽見這事。）
verses.e: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it ( for he was yet in Egypt , where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon , and Jeroboam lived in Egypt ;

verses.z: 以色列眾人聽見耶羅波安回來了，就打發人去請他到會眾面前，立他作以色列眾人的王。除了猶大支派以外，沒有順從大衛家的。
verses.e: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned , they sent and called him to the congregation , and made him king over all Israel . There was no one who followed David's house , except for the tribe of Judah only .

verses.z: 羅波安來到耶路撒冷，招聚猶大全家和便雅憫支派的人共十八萬，都是挑選的戰士，要與以色列家爭戰，好將國奪回，再歸所羅門的兒子羅波安。
verses.e: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem , he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin , a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors , to fight against the house of Israel , to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon .

verses.z: 但上帝的話臨到神人示瑪雅，說：
verses.e: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God , saying ,

verses.z: 「你去告訴所羅門的兒子猶大王羅波安和猶大、便雅憫全家，並其餘的民說：
verses.e: " Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon , king of Judah , and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin , and to the rest of the people , saying ,

verses.z: 『耶和華如此說：你們不可上去與你們的弟兄以色列人爭戰。各歸各家去吧！因為這事出於我。』」眾人就聽從耶和華的話，遵着耶和華的命回去了。
verses.e: ' The LORD says , " You shall not go up or fight against your brothers , the children of Israel . Everyone return to his house ; for this thing is from me . " ' " So they listened to the LORD's word , and returned and went their way , according to the LORD's word .

verses.z: 耶羅波安在以法蓮山地建築示劍，就住在其中；又從示劍出去，建築毗努伊勒。
verses.e: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim , and lived in it ; and he went out from there and built Penuel .

verses.z: 耶羅波安心裏說：「恐怕這國仍歸大衛家；
verses.e: Jeroboam said in his heart , " Now the kingdom will return to David's house .

verses.z: 這民若上耶路撒冷去，在耶和華的殿裏獻祭，他們的心必歸向他們的主－猶大王羅波安，就把我殺了，仍歸猶大王羅波安。」
verses.e: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD's house at Jerusalem , then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord , even to Rehoboam king of Judah ; and they will kill me , and return to Rehoboam king of Judah . "

verses.z: [耶羅波安]王就籌劃定妥，鑄造了兩個金牛犢，對眾民說：「以色列人哪，你們上耶路撒冷去實在是難；這就是領你們出埃及地的神。」
verses.e: So the king took counsel , and made two calves of gold ; and he said to them , " It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem . Look and behold your gods , Israel , which brought you up out of the land of Egypt ! "

verses.z: 他就把牛犢一隻安在伯特利，一隻安在但。
verses.e: He set the one in Bethel , and the other he put in Dan .

verses.z: 以色列人打發人去請他來，他就和以色列會眾都來見羅波安，對他說：
verses.e: and they sent and called him ) , Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came , and spoke to Rehoboam , saying ,

verses.z: 這事叫百姓陷在罪裏，因為他們往但去[拜那牛犢]。
verses.e: This thing became a sin , for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there .

verses.z: 耶羅波安在邱壇那裏建殿，將那不屬利未人的凡民立為祭司。
verses.e: He made houses of high places , and made priests from among all the people , who were not of the sons of Levi .

verses.z: 耶羅波安定八月十五日為節期，像在猶大的節期一樣，自己上壇[獻祭]。他在伯特利也這樣向他所鑄的牛犢獻祭，又將立為邱壇的祭司安置在伯特利。
verses.e: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month , on the fifteenth day of the month , like the feast that is in Judah , and he went up to the altar . He did so in Bethel , sacrificing to the calves that he had made , and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made .

verses.z: 他在八月十五日，就是他私自所定的月日，為以色列人立作節期的日子，在伯特利上壇燒香。
verses.e: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month , even in the month which he had devised of his own heart ; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel , and went up to the altar to burn incense .

verses.z: 「你父親使我們負重軛，[做苦工]，現在求你使我們做的苦工、負的重軛輕鬆些，我們就事奉你。」
verses.e: " Your father made our yoke difficult . Now therefore make the hard service of your father , and his heavy yoke which he put on us , lighter , and we will serve you . "

verses.z: 羅波安對他們說：「你們暫且去，第三日再來見我。」民就去了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Depart for three days , then come back to me . " So the people departed .

verses.z: 羅波安之父所羅門在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，羅波安王和他們商議，說：「你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆這民。」
verses.e: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , " What counsel do you give me to answer these people ? "

verses.z: 老年人對他說：「現在王若服事這民如僕人，用好話回答他們，他們就永遠作王的僕人。」
verses.e: They replied , " If you will be a servant to this people today , and will serve them , and answer them with good words , then they will be your servants forever . "

verses.z: 王卻不用老年人給他出的主意，就和那些與他一同長大、在他面前侍立的少年人商議，
verses.e: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him , and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him , who stood before him .

verses.z: 說：「這民對我說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些。』你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆他們。」
verses.e: He said to them , " What counsel do you give , that we may answer these people who have spoken to me , saying , ' Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter ' ? "

verses.z: 那時，有一個神人奉耶和華的命從猶大來到伯特利。耶羅波安正站在壇旁要燒香；
verses.e: Behold , a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD's word to Bethel ; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense .

verses.z: 於是神人從別的路回去，不從伯特利來的原路回去。
verses.e: So he went another way , and didn't return by the way that he came to Bethel .

verses.z: 有一個老先知住在伯特利，他兒子們來，將神人當日在伯特利所行的一切事和向王所說的話都告訴了父親。
verses.e: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel , and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel . They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king .

verses.z: 父親問他們說：「神人從哪條路去了呢？」兒子們[就告訴他]；原來他們看見那從猶大來的神人所去的路。
verses.e: Their father said to them , " Which way did he go ? " Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went , who came from Judah .

verses.z: 老先知就吩咐他兒子們說：「你們為我備驢。」他們備好了驢，他就騎上，
verses.e: He said to his sons , " Saddle the donkey for me . " So they saddled the donkey for him ; and he rode on it .

verses.z: 去追趕神人，遇見他坐在橡樹底下，就問他說：「你是從猶大來的神人不是？」他說：「是。」
verses.e: He went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak . He said to him , " Are you the man of God who came from Judah ? " He said , " I am . "

verses.z: 老先知對他說：「請你同我回家吃飯。」
verses.e: Then he said to him , " Come home with me and eat bread . "

verses.z: 神人說：「我不可同你回去進你的家，也不可在這裏同你吃飯喝水；
verses.e: He said , " I may not return with you , nor go in with you . I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place .

verses.z: 因為有耶和華的話囑咐我說：『你在那裏不可吃飯喝水，也不可從你去的原路回來。』」
verses.e: For it was said to me by the LORD's word , ' You shall eat no bread or drink water there , and don't turn again to go by the way that you came . ' "

verses.z: 老先知對他說：「我也是先知，和你一樣。有天使奉耶和華的命對我說：『你去把他帶回你的家，叫他吃飯喝水。』」這都是老先知誆哄他。
verses.e: He said to him , " I also am a prophet as you are ; and an angel spoke to me by the LORD's word , saying , ' Bring him back with you into your house , that he may eat bread and drink water . ' " He lied to him .

verses.z: 於是神人同老先知回去，在他家裏吃飯喝水。
verses.e: So he went back with him , ate bread in his house , and drank water .

verses.z: 神人奉耶和華的命向壇呼叫，說：「壇哪，壇哪！耶和華如此說：大衛家裏必生一個兒子，名叫約西亞，他必將邱壇的祭司，就是在你上面燒香的，殺在你上面，人的骨頭也必燒在你上面。」
verses.e: He cried against the altar by the LORD's word , and said , " Altar ! Altar ! The LORD says : ' Behold , a son will be born to David's house , Josiah by name . On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you , and they will burn men's bones on you . ' "

verses.z: 二人坐席的時候，耶和華的話臨到那帶神人回來的先知，
verses.e: As they sat at the table , the LORD's word came to the prophet who brought him back ;

verses.z: 他就對那從猶大來的神人說：「耶和華如此說：你既違背耶和華的話，不遵守耶和華－你上帝的命令，
verses.e: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah , saying , " The LORD says , ' Because you have been disobedient to the LORD's word , and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you ,

verses.z: 反倒回來，在耶和華禁止你吃飯喝水的地方吃了喝了，因此你的屍身不得入你列祖的墳墓。」
verses.e: but came back , and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you , " Eat no bread , and drink no water , " your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers . ' "

verses.z: 吃喝完了，老先知為所帶回來的先知備驢。
verses.e: After he had eaten bread and after he drank , he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back .

verses.z: 他就去了，在路上有個獅子遇見他，將他咬死，屍身倒在路上，驢站在屍身旁邊，獅子也站在屍身旁邊。
verses.e: When he had gone , a lion met him by the way and killed him . His body was thrown on the path , and the donkey stood by it . The lion also stood by the body .

verses.z: 有人從那裏經過，看見屍身倒在路上，獅子站在屍身旁邊，就來到老先知所住的城裏述說這事。
verses.e: Behold , men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path , and the lion standing by the body ; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived .

verses.z: 那帶神人回來的先知聽見這事，就說：「這是那違背了耶和華命令的神人，所以耶和華把他交給獅子；獅子抓傷他，咬死他，是應驗耶和華對他說的話。」
verses.e: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it , he said , " It is the man of God who was disobedient to the LORD's word . Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion , which has mauled him and slain him , according to the LORD's word which he spoke to him . "

verses.z: 老先知就吩咐他兒子們說：「你們為我備驢。」他們就備了驢。
verses.e: He said to his sons , saying , " Saddle the donkey for me , " and they saddled it .

verses.z: 他去了，看見神人的屍身倒在路上，驢和獅子站在屍身旁邊，獅子卻沒有吃屍身，也沒有抓傷驢。
verses.e: He went and found his body thrown on the path , and the donkey and the lion standing by the body . The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey .

verses.z: 老先知就把神人的屍身馱在驢上，帶回自己的城裏，要哀哭他，葬埋他；
verses.e: The prophet took up the body of the man of God , and laid it on the donkey , and brought it back . He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn , and to bury him .

verses.z: 當日，神人設個預兆，說：「這壇必破裂，壇上的灰必傾撒，這是耶和華說的預兆。」
verses.e: He gave a sign the same day , saying , " This is the sign which the LORD has spoken : Behold , the altar will be split apart , and the ashes that are on it will be poured out . "

verses.z: 就把他的屍身葬在自己的墳墓裏，哀哭他，[說]：「哀哉！我兄啊。」
verses.e: He laid his body in his own grave ; and they mourned over him , saying , " Alas , my brother ! "

verses.z: 安葬之後，老先知對他兒子們說：「我死了，你們要葬我在神人的墳墓裏，使我的屍骨靠近他的屍骨，
verses.e: After he had buried him , he spoke to his sons , saying , " When I am dead , bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried . Lay my bones beside his bones .

verses.z: 因為他奉耶和華的命指着伯特利的壇和撒馬利亞各城有邱壇之殿所說的話必定應驗。」
verses.e: For the saying which he cried by the LORD's word against the altar in Bethel , and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria , will surely happen . "

verses.z: 這事以後，耶羅波安仍不離開他的惡道，將凡民立為邱壇的祭司；凡願意的，他都分別為聖，立為邱壇的祭司。
verses.e: After this thing , Jeroboam didn't turn from his evil way , but again made priests of the high places from among all the people . Whoever wanted to , he consecrated him , that there might be priests of the high places .

verses.z: 這事叫耶羅波安的家陷在罪裏，甚至他的家從地上除滅了。
verses.e: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam , even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth .

verses.z: 耶羅波安王聽見神人向伯特利的壇所呼叫的話，就從壇上伸手，說：「拿住他吧！」王向神人所伸的手就枯乾了，不能彎回；
verses.e: When the king heard the saying of the man of God , which he cried against the altar in Bethel , Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar , saying , " Seize him ! " His hand , which he put out against him , dried up , so that he could not draw it back again to himself .

verses.z: 壇也破裂了，壇上的灰傾撒了，正如神人奉耶和華的命所設的預兆。
verses.e: The altar was also split apart , and the ashes poured out from the altar , according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD's word .

verses.z: 王對神人說：「請你為我禱告，求耶和華－你上帝的恩典使我的手復原。」於是神人祈禱耶和華，王的手就復了原，仍如尋常一樣。
verses.e: The king answered the man of God , " Now intercede for the favor of the LORD your God , and pray for me , that my hand may be restored me again . " The man of God interceded with the LORD , and the king's hand was restored to him again , and became as it was before .

verses.z: 王對神人說：「請你同我回去[吃飯]，加添心力，我也必給你賞賜。」
verses.e: The king said to the man of God , " Come home with me and refresh yourself , and I will give you a reward . "

verses.z: 神人對王說：「你就是把你的宮一半給我，我也不同你進去，也不在這地方吃飯喝水；
verses.e: The man of God said to the king , " Even if you gave me half of your house , I would not go in with you , neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place ;

verses.z: 因為有耶和華的話囑咐我，說不可在伯特利吃飯喝水，也不可從你去的原路回來。」
verses.e: for so was it commanded me by the LORD's word , saying , ' You shall eat no bread , drink no water , and don't return by the way that you came . ' "

verses.z: 那時，耶羅波安的兒子亞比雅病了。
verses.e: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick .

verses.z: 因此，我必使災禍臨到耶羅波安的家，將屬耶羅波安的男丁，無論困住的、自由的都從以色列中剪除，必除盡耶羅波安的家，如人除盡糞土一般。
verses.e: therefore , behold , I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam , and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall , he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel , and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam , as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone .

verses.z: 凡屬耶羅波安的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鳥吃。這是耶和華說的。』
verses.e: The dogs will eat he who belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city ; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field , for the LORD has spoken it . " '

verses.z: 所以你起身回家去吧！你的腳一進城，你兒子就必死了。
verses.e: Arise therefore , and go to your house . When your feet enter into the city , the child will die .

verses.z: 以色列眾人必為他哀哭，將他葬埋。凡屬耶羅波安的人，惟有他得入墳墓；因為在耶羅波安的家中，只有他向耶和華－以色列的上帝顯出善行。
verses.e: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him ; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave , because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD , the God of Israel , in the house of Jeroboam .

verses.z: 耶和華必另立一王治理以色列。到了日期，他必剪除耶羅波安的家；那日期已經到了。
verses.e: Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam . This is the day ! What ? Even now .

verses.z: 耶和華必擊打以色列人，使他們搖動，像水中的蘆葦一般；又將他們從耶和華賜給他們列祖的美地上拔出來，分散在大河那邊；因為他們做木偶，惹耶和華發怒。
verses.e: For the LORD will strike Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water ; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers , and will scatter them beyond the River , because they have made their Asherah poles , provoking the LORD to anger .

verses.z: 因耶羅波安所犯的罪，又使以色列人陷在罪裏，耶和華必將以色列人交給[仇敵]。」
verses.e: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam , which he has sinned , and with which he has made Israel to sin . "

verses.z: 耶羅波安的妻起身回去，到了得撒，剛到門檻，兒子就死了。
verses.e: Jeroboam's wife arose and departed , and came to Tirzah . As she came to the threshold of the house , the child died .

verses.z: 以色列眾人將他葬埋，為他哀哭，正如耶和華藉他僕人先知亞希雅所說的話。
verses.e: All Israel buried him and mourned for him , according to the LORD's word , which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet .

verses.z: 耶羅波安其餘的事，他怎樣爭戰，怎樣作王，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam , how he fought and how he reigned , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 耶羅波安對他的妻說：「你可以起來改裝，使人不知道你是耶羅波安的妻，往示羅去，在那裏有先知亞希雅。他曾告訴我說，你必作這民的王。
verses.e: Jeroboam said to his wife , " Please get up and disguise yourself , so that you won't be recognized as Jeroboam's wife . Go to Shiloh . Behold , Ahijah the prophet is there , who said that I would be king over this people .

verses.z: 耶羅波安作王二十二年，就與他列祖同睡。他兒子拿答接續他作王。
verses.e: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years ; then he slept with his fathers , and Nadab his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 所羅門的兒子羅波安作猶大王。他登基的時候年四十一歲，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和華從以色列眾支派中所選擇立他名的城，作王十七年。羅波安的母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。
verses.e: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah . Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess .

verses.z: 猶大人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，犯罪觸動他的憤恨，比他們列祖更甚。
verses.e: Judah did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed , above all that their fathers had done .

verses.z: 因為他們在各高岡上，各青翠樹下築壇，立柱像和木偶。
verses.e: For they also built for themselves high places , sacred pillars , and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree .

verses.z: 國中也有孌童。猶大人效法耶和華在以色列人面前所趕出的外邦人，行一切可憎惡的事。
verses.e: There were also sodomites in the land . They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD drove out before the children of Israel .

verses.z: 羅波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上來攻取耶路撒冷，
verses.e: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam , Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 奪了耶和華殿和王宮裏的寶物，盡都帶走，又奪去所羅門製造的金盾牌。
verses.e: and he took away the treasures of the LORD's house and the treasures of the king's house . He even took away all of it , including all the gold shields which Solomon had made .

verses.z: 羅波安王製造銅盾牌代替那金盾牌，交給守王宮門的護衛長看守。
verses.e: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place , and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard , who kept the door of the king's house .

verses.z: 王每逢進耶和華的殿，護衛兵就拿這盾牌，隨後仍將盾牌送回，放在護衛房。
verses.e: It was so , that as often as the king went into the LORD's house , the guard bore them , and brought them back into the guard room .

verses.z: 羅波安其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 現在你要帶十個餅，與幾個薄餅，和一瓶蜜去見他，他必告訴你兒子將要怎樣。」
verses.e: Take with you ten loaves of bread , some cakes , and a jar of honey , and go to him . He will tell you what will become of the child . "

verses.z: 羅波安與耶羅波安時常爭戰。
verses.e: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually .

verses.z: 羅波安與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。他兒子亞比央接續他作王。
verses.e: Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in David's city . His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess . Abijam his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 耶羅波安的妻就這樣行，起身往示羅去，到了亞希雅的家。亞希雅因年紀老邁，眼目發直，不能看見。
verses.e: Jeroboam's wife did so , and arose and went to Shiloh , and came to Ahijah's house . Now Ahijah could not see , for his eyes were set by reason of his age .

verses.z: 耶和華先曉諭亞希雅說：「耶羅波安的妻要來問你，因她兒子病了，你當如此如此告訴她。她進來的時候必裝作別的婦人。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Ahijah , " Behold , Jeroboam's wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son , for he is sick . Tell her such and such ; for it will be , when she comes in , that she will pretend to be another woman . "

verses.z: 她剛進門，亞希雅聽見她腳步的響聲，就說：「耶羅波安的妻，進來吧！你為何裝作別的婦人呢？我奉差遣將凶事告訴你。
verses.e: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door , he said , " Come in , Jeroboam's wife ! Why do you pretend to be another ? For I am sent to you with heavy news .

verses.z: 你回去告訴耶羅波安[說]：『耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：我從民中將你高舉，立你作我民以色列的君，
verses.e: Go , tell Jeroboam , ' The LORD , the God of Israel , says : " Because I exalted you from among the people , and made you prince over my people Israel ,

verses.z: 將國從大衛家奪回賜給你；你卻不效法我僕人大衛，遵守我的誡命，一心順從我，行我眼中看為正的事。
verses.e: and tore the kingdom away from David's house , and gave it to you ; and yet you have not been as my servant David , who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do that only which was right in my eyes ,

verses.z: 你竟行惡，比那在你以先的更甚，為自己立了別神，鑄了偶像，惹我發怒，將我丟在背後。
verses.e: but have done evil above all who were before you , and have gone and made for yourself other gods , molten images , to provoke me to anger , and have cast me behind your back ,

verses.z: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安王十八年，亞比央登基作猶大王，
verses.e: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat , Abijam began to reign over Judah .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他祖母名叫瑪迦，是押沙龍的女兒。
verses.e: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom .

verses.z: 亞撒效法他祖大衛行耶和華眼中看為正的事，
verses.e: Asa did that which was right in the LORD's eyes , as David his father did .

verses.z: 從國中除去孌童，又除掉他列祖所造的一切偶像；
verses.e: He put away the sodomites out of the land , and removed all the idols that his fathers had made .

verses.z: 並且貶了他祖母瑪迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亞舍拉。亞撒砍下她的偶像，燒在汲淪溪邊，
verses.e: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen , because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah . Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron .

verses.z: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去。亞撒一生卻向耶和華存誠實的心。
verses.e: But the high places were not taken away . Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days .

verses.z: 亞撒將他父親所分別為聖與自己所分別為聖的金銀和器皿都奉到耶和華的殿裏。
verses.e: He brought into the LORD's house the things that his father had dedicated , and the things that he himself had dedicated : silver , gold , and utensils .

verses.z: 亞撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常爭戰。
verses.e: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .

verses.z: 以色列王巴沙上來要攻擊猶大，修築拉瑪，不許人從猶大王亞撒那裏出入。
verses.e: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah , and built Ramah , that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .

verses.z: 於是亞撒將耶和華殿和王宮府庫裏所剩下的金銀都交在他臣僕手中，打發他們往住大馬士革的亞蘭王－希旬的孫子、他伯利們的兒子便‧哈達那裏去，
verses.e: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of the LORD's house , and the treasures of the king's house , and delivered it into the hand of his servants . Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad , the son of Tabrimmon , the son of Hezion , king of Syria , who lived at Damascus , saying ,

verses.z: 說：「你父曾與我父立約，我與你也要立約。現在我將金銀送你為禮物，求你廢掉你與以色列王巴沙所立的約，使他離開我。」
verses.e: " Let there be a treaty between me and you , like that between my father and your father . Behold , I have sent to you a present of silver and gold . Go , break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me . "

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母親名叫瑪迦，是押沙龍的女兒。
verses.e: He reigned three years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom .

verses.z: 便‧哈達聽從亞撒王的話，派軍長去攻擊以色列的城邑；他們就攻破以雲、但、亞伯‧伯‧瑪迦、基尼烈全境、拿弗他利全境。
verses.e: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel , and struck Ijon , and Dan , and Abel Beth Maacah , and all Chinneroth , with all the land of Naphtali .

verses.z: 巴沙聽見，就停工不修築拉瑪了，仍住在得撒。
verses.e: When Baasha heard of it , he stopped building Ramah , and lived in Tirzah .

verses.z: 於是亞撒王宣告猶大眾人，不准一個推辭，吩咐他們將巴沙修築拉瑪所用的石頭、木頭都運去，用以修築便雅憫的迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.e: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah . No one was exempted . They carried away the stones of Ramah , and its timber , with which Baasha had built ; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin , and Mizpah .

verses.z: 亞撒其餘的事，凡他所行的，並他的勇力與他所建築的城邑，都寫在猶大列王記上。亞撒年老的時候，腳上有病。
verses.e: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .

verses.z: 亞撒與他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子約沙法接續他作王。
verses.e: Asa slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in his father David's city ; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒第二年，耶羅波安的兒子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，
verses.e: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah ; and he reigned over Israel two years .

verses.z: 拿答行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行他父親所行的，犯他父親使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and walked in the way of his father , and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 以薩迦人亞希雅的兒子巴沙背叛拿答，在非利士的基比頓殺了他。那時拿答和以色列眾人正圍困基比頓。
verses.e: Baasha the son of Ahijah , of the house of Issachar , conspired against him ; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines ; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon .

verses.z: 在猶大王亞撒第三年巴沙殺了他，篡了他的位。
verses.e: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah , Baasha killed him and reigned in his place .

verses.z: 巴沙一作王就殺了耶羅波安的全家，凡有氣息的沒有留下一個，都滅盡了，正應驗耶和華藉他僕人示羅人亞希雅所說的話。
verses.e: As soon as he was king , he struck all the house of Jeroboam . He didn't leave to Jeroboam any who breathed , until he had destroyed him , according to the saying of the LORD , which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite ;

verses.z: 亞比央行他父親在他以前所行的一切惡，他的心不像他祖大衛的心，誠誠實實地順服耶和華－他的上帝。
verses.e: He walked in all the sins of his father , which he had done before him ; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God , as the heart of David his father .

verses.z: 這是因為耶羅波安所犯的罪使以色列人陷在罪裏，惹動耶和華－以色列上帝的怒氣。
verses.e: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned , and with which he made Israel to sin , because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD , the God of Israel , to anger .

verses.z: 拿答其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 亞撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常爭戰。
verses.e: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒第三年，亞希雅的兒子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列眾人的王共二十四年。
verses.e: In the third year of Asa king of Judah , Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行耶羅波安所行的道，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and walked in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 然而耶和華－他的上帝因大衛的緣故，仍使他在耶路撒冷有燈光，叫他兒子接續他作王，堅立耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Nevertheless for David's sake , the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem , to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 因為大衛除了赫人烏利亞那件事，都是行耶和華眼中看為正的事，一生沒有違背耶和華一切所吩咐的。
verses.e: because David did that which was right in the LORD's eyes , and didn't turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life , except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite .

verses.z: 羅波安在世的日子常與耶羅波安爭戰。
verses.e: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life .

verses.z: 亞比央其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在猶大列王記上。亞比央常與耶羅波安爭戰。
verses.e: The rest of the acts of Abijam , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam .

verses.z: 亞比央與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛的城裏。他兒子亞撒接續他作王。
verses.e: Abijam slept with his fathers , and they buried him in David's city ; and Asa his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 以色列王耶羅波安二十年，亞撒登基作猶大王，
verses.e: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel , Asa began to reign over Judah .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到哈拿尼的兒子耶戶，責備巴沙說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha , saying ,

verses.z: 心利就進去殺了他，篡了他的位。這是猶大王亞撒二十七年的事。
verses.e: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned in his place .

verses.z: 心利一坐王位就殺了巴沙的全家，連他的親屬、朋友也沒有留下一個男丁。
verses.e: When he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , he attacked all the house of Baasha . He didn't leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends .

verses.z: 心利這樣滅絕巴沙的全家，正如耶和華藉先知耶戶責備巴沙的話。
verses.e: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha , according to the LORD's word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet ,

verses.z: 這是因巴沙和他兒子以拉的一切罪，就是他們使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，以虛無[的神]惹耶和華－以色列上帝的怒氣。
verses.e: for all the sins of Baasha , and the sins of Elah his son , which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin , to provoke the LORD , the God of Israel , to anger with their vanities .

verses.z: 以拉其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Elah , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那時民正安營圍攻非利士的基比頓。
verses.e: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah , Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah . Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines .

verses.z: 民在營中聽說心利背叛，又殺了王，故此以色列眾人當日在營中立元帥暗利作以色列王。
verses.e: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired , and had also killed the king . Therefore all Israel made Omri , the captain of the army , king over Israel that day in the camp .

verses.z: 暗利率領以色列眾人，從基比頓上去，圍困得撒。
verses.e: Omri went up from Gibbethon , and all Israel with him , and they besieged Tirzah .

verses.z: 心利見城破失，就進了王宮的衛所，放火焚燒宮殿，自焚而死。
verses.e: When Zimri saw that the city was taken , he went into the fortified part of the king's house and burned the king's house over him with fire , and died ,

verses.z: 這是因他犯罪，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行耶羅波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD's sight , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin .

verses.z: 「我既從塵埃中提拔你，立你作我民以色列的君，你竟行耶羅波安所行的道，使我民以色列陷在罪裏，惹我發怒，
verses.e: " Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel , and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin , to provoke me to anger with their sins ,

verses.z: 心利其餘的事和他背叛的情形都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri , and his treason that he committed , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 那時，以色列民分為兩半：一半隨從基納的兒子提比尼，要立他作王；一半隨從暗利。
verses.e: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts : half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath , to make him king , and half followed Omri .

verses.z: 但隨從暗利的民勝過隨從基納的兒子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。
verses.e: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath ; so Tibni died , and Omri reigned .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年；在得撒作王六年。
verses.e: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah , Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years . He reigned six years in Tirzah .

verses.z: 暗利用二他連得銀子向撒瑪買了撒馬利亞山，在山上造[城]，就按着山的原主撒瑪的名，給所造的城起名叫撒馬利亞。
verses.e: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver ; and he built on the hill , and called the name of the city which he built , Samaria , after the name of Shemer , the owner of the hill .

verses.z: 暗利行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，比他以前的列王作惡更甚。
verses.e: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and dealt wickedly above all who were before him .

verses.z: 因他行了尼八的兒子耶羅波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，以虛無[的神]惹耶和華－以色列上帝的怒氣。
verses.e: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin , to provoke the LORD , the God of Israel , to anger with their vanities .

verses.z: 暗利其餘的事和他所顯出的勇力都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did , and his might that he showed , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 暗利與他列祖同睡，葬在撒馬利亞。他兒子亞哈接續他作王。
verses.e: So Omri slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria ; and Ahab his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒三十八年，暗利的兒子亞哈登基作了以色列王。暗利的兒子亞哈在撒馬利亞作以色列王二十二年。
verses.e: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah , Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel . Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years .

verses.z: 我必除盡你和你的家，使你的家像尼八的兒子耶羅波安的家一樣。
verses.e: behold , I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house ; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

verses.z: 暗利的兒子亞哈行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，比他以前的列王更甚，
verses.e: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the LORD's sight above all that were before him .

verses.z: 犯了尼八的兒子耶羅波安所犯的罪；他還以為輕，又娶了西頓王謁巴力的女兒耶洗別為妻，去事奉敬拜巴力，
verses.e: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians , and went and served Baal and worshiped him .

verses.z: 在撒馬利亞建造巴力的廟，在廟裏為巴力築壇。
verses.e: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal , which he had built in Samaria .

verses.z: 亞哈又做亞舍拉，他所行的惹耶和華－以色列上帝的怒氣，比他以前的以色列諸王更甚。
verses.e: Ahab made the Asherah ; and Ahab did more yet to provoke the LORD , the God of Israel , to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him .

verses.z: 亞哈[在位]的時候，有伯特利人希伊勒重修耶利哥[城]；立根基的時候，喪了長子亞比蘭；安門的時候，喪了幼子西割，正如耶和華藉嫩的兒子約書亞所說的話。
verses.e: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho . He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn , and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub , according to the LORD's word , which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun .

verses.z: 凡屬巴沙的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鳥吃。」
verses.e: The dogs will eat Baasha's descendants who die in the city ; and he who dies of his in the field , the birds of the sky will eat . "

verses.z: 巴沙其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha , and what he did , and his might , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 巴沙與他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他兒子以拉接續他作王。
verses.e: Baasha slept with his fathers , and was buried in Tirzah ; and Elah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到哈拿尼的兒子先知耶戶，責備巴沙和他的家，因他行耶和華眼中看為惡的一切事，以他手所做的惹耶和華發怒，像耶羅波安的家一樣，又因他殺了耶羅波安的全家。
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house , both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD's sight , to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands , in being like the house of Jeroboam , and because he struck him .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒二十六年，巴沙的兒子以拉在得撒登基作以色列王共二年。
verses.e: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah , Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years .

verses.z: 有管理他一半戰車的臣子心利背叛他。當他在得撒家宰亞雜家裏喝醉的時候，
verses.e: His servant Zimri , captain of half his chariots , conspired against him . Now he was in Tirzah , drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza , who was over the household in Tirzah ;

verses.z: 基列寄居的提斯比人以利亞對亞哈說：「我指着所事奉永生耶和華－以色列的上帝起誓，這幾年我若不禱告，必不降露，不下雨。」
verses.e: Elijah the Tishbite , who was one of the settlers of Gilead , said to Ahab , " As the LORD , the God of Israel , lives , before whom I stand , there shall not be dew nor rain these years , but according to my word . "

verses.z: 以利亞就起身往撒勒法去。到了城門，見有一個寡婦在那裏撿柴，以利亞呼叫她說：「求你用器皿取點水來給我喝。」
verses.e: So he arose and went to Zarephath ; and when he came to the gate of the city , behold , a widow was there gathering sticks . He called to her and said , " Please get me a little water in a jar , that I may drink . "

verses.z: 她去取水的時候，以利亞又呼叫她說：「也求你拿點餅來給我！」
verses.e: As she was going to get it , he called to her and said , " Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand . "

verses.z: 她說：「我指着永生耶和華－你的上帝起誓，我沒有餅，罈內只有一把麵，瓶裏只有一點油；我現在找兩根柴，回家要為我和我兒子做[餅]；我們吃了，死就死吧！」
verses.e: She said , " As the LORD your God lives , I don't have anything baked , but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar . Behold , I am gathering two sticks , that I may go in and bake it for me and my son , that we may eat it , and die . "

verses.z: 以利亞對她說：「不要懼怕！可以照你所說的去做吧！只要先為我做一個小餅拿來給我，然後為你和你的兒子做餅。
verses.e: Elijah said to her , " Don't be afraid . Go and do as you have said ; but make me a little cake from it first , and bring it out to me , and afterward make some for you and for your son .

verses.z: 因為耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：罈內的麵必不減少，瓶裏的油必不缺短，直到耶和華使雨降在地上的日子。」
verses.e: For the LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' The jar of meal will not run out , and the jar of oil will not fail , until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth . ' "

verses.z: 婦人就照以利亞的話去行。她和她家中的人，並以利亞，吃了許多日子。
verses.e: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah ; and she , he , and her household ate many days .

verses.z: 罈內的麵果不減少，瓶裏的油也不缺短，正如耶和華藉以利亞所說的話。
verses.e: The jar of meal didn't run out and the jar of oil didn't fail , according to the LORD's word , which he spoke by Elijah .

verses.z: 這事以後，作那家主母的婦人，她兒子病了；病得甚重，以致身無氣息。
verses.e: After these things , the son of the woman , the mistress of the house , became sick ; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him .

verses.z: 婦人對以利亞說：「神人哪，我與你何干？你竟到我這裏來，使[上帝]想念我的罪，以致我的兒子死呢？」
verses.e: She said to Elijah , " What have I to do with you , you man of God ? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory , and to kill my son ! "

verses.z: 以利亞對她說：「把你兒子交給我。」以利亞就從婦人懷中將孩子接過來，抱到他所住的樓中，放在自己的床上，
verses.e: He said to her , " Give me your son . " He took him out of her bosom , and carried him up into the room where he stayed , and laid him on his own bed .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到以利亞說：
verses.e: Then the LORD's word came to him , saying ,

verses.z: 就求告耶和華說：「耶和華－我的上帝啊，我寄居在這寡婦的家裏，你就降禍與她，使她的兒子死了嗎？」
verses.e: He cried to the LORD and said , " LORD my God , have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying , by killing her son ? "

verses.z: 以利亞三次伏在孩子的身上，求告耶和華說：「耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你使這孩子的靈魂仍入他的身體！」
verses.e: He stretched himself on the child three times , and cried to the LORD and said , " LORD my God , please let this child's soul come into him again . "

verses.z: 耶和華應允以利亞的話，孩子的靈魂仍入他的身體，他就活了。
verses.e: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah ; and the soul of the child came into him again , and he revived .

verses.z: 以利亞將孩子從樓上抱下來，進屋子交給他母親，說：「看哪，你的兒子活了！」
