verses.e: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house , and delivered him to his mother ; and Elijah said , " Behold , your son lives . "

verses.z: 婦人對以利亞說：「現在我知道你是神人，耶和華藉你口所說的話是真的。」
verses.e: The woman said to Elijah , " Now I know that you are a man of God , and that the LORD's word in your mouth is truth . "

verses.z: 「你離開這裏往東去，藏在約旦河東邊的基立溪旁。
verses.e: " Go away from here , turn eastward , and hide yourself by the brook Cherith , that is before the Jordan .

verses.z: 你要喝那溪裏的水，我已吩咐烏鴉在那裏供養你。」
verses.e: You shall drink from the brook . I have commanded the ravens to feed you there . "

verses.z: 於是以利亞照着耶和華的話，去住在約旦河東的基立溪旁。
verses.e: So he went and did according to the LORD's word , for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan .

verses.z: 烏鴉早晚給他叼餅和肉來，他也喝那溪裏的水。
verses.e: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning , and bread and meat in the evening ; and he drank from the brook .

verses.z: 過了些日子，溪水就乾了，因為雨沒有下在地上。
verses.e: After a while , the brook dried up , because there was no rain in the land .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到他說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to him , saying ,

verses.z: 「你起身往西頓的撒勒法去，住在那裏；我已吩咐那裏的一個寡婦供養你。」
verses.e: " Arise , go to Zarephath , which belongs to Sidon , and stay there . Behold , I have commanded a widow there to sustain you . "

verses.z: 過了許久，到第三年，耶和華的話臨到以利亞說：「你去，使亞哈得見你；我要降雨在地上。」
verses.e: After many days , the LORD's word came to Elijah , in the third year , saying , " Go , show yourself to Ahab ; and I will send rain on the earth . "

verses.z: 我指着永生耶和華－你的上帝起誓，無論哪一邦哪一國，我主都打發人去找你。若說你沒有在那裏，就必使那邦那國的人起誓說，實在是找不着你。
verses.e: As the LORD your God lives , there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you . When they said , ' He is not here , ' he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn't find you .

verses.z: 現在你說，要去告訴你主人說，以利亞[在這裏]；
verses.e: Now you say , ' Go , tell your lord , " Behold , Elijah is here . " '

verses.z: 恐怕我一離開你，耶和華的靈就提你到我所不知道的地方去。這樣，我去告訴亞哈，他若找不着你，就必殺我；僕人卻是自幼敬畏耶和華的。
verses.e: It will happen , as soon as I leave you , that the LORD's Spirit will carry you I don't know where ; and so when I come and tell Ahab , and he can't find you , he will kill me . But I , your servant , have feared the LORD from my youth .

verses.z: 耶洗別殺耶和華眾先知的時候，我將耶和華的一百個先知藏了，每五十人藏在一個洞裏，拿餅和水供養他們，豈沒有人將這事告訴我主嗎？
verses.e: Wasn't it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the LORD's prophets , how I hid one hundred men of the LORD's prophets with fifty to a cave , and fed them with bread and water ?

verses.z: 現在你說，要去告訴你主人說，以利亞[在這裏]，他必殺我。」
verses.e: Now you say , ' Go , tell your lord , " Behold , Elijah is here " . ' He will kill me . "

verses.z: 以利亞說：「我指着所事奉永生的萬軍之耶和華起誓，我今日必使亞哈得見我。」
verses.e: Elijah said , " As the LORD of Armies lives , before whom I stand , I will surely show myself to him today . "

verses.z: 於是俄巴底去迎着亞哈，告訴他；亞哈就去迎着以利亞。
verses.e: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab , and told him ; and Ahab went to meet Elijah .

verses.z: 亞哈見了以利亞，便說：「使以色列遭災的就是你嗎？」
verses.e: When Ahab saw Elijah , Ahab said to him , " Is that you , you troubler of Israel ? "

verses.z: 以利亞說：「使以色列遭災的不是我，乃是你和你父家；因為你們離棄耶和華的誡命，去隨從巴力。
verses.e: He answered , " I have not troubled Israel , but you and your father's house , in that you have forsaken the LORD's commandments and you have followed the Baals .

verses.z: 現在你當差遣人，招聚以色列眾人和事奉巴力的那四百五十個先知，並耶洗別所供養事奉亞舍拉的那四百個先知，使他們都上迦密山去見我。」
verses.e: Now therefore send , and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel , and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal , and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah , who eat at Jezebel's table . "

verses.z: 以利亞就去，要使亞哈得見他。那時，撒馬利亞有大饑荒；
verses.e: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab . The famine was severe in Samaria .

verses.z: 亞哈就差遣人招聚以色列眾人和先知都上迦密山。
verses.e: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel , and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel .

verses.z: 以利亞前來對眾民說：「你們心持兩意要到幾時呢？若耶和華是上帝，就當順從耶和華；若巴力是上帝，就當順從巴力。」眾民一言不答。
verses.e: Elijah came near to all the people , and said , " How long will you waver between the two sides ? If the LORD is God , follow him ; but if Baal , then follow him . " The people didn't say a word .

verses.z: 以利亞對眾民說：「作耶和華先知的只剩下我一個人；巴力的先知卻有四百五十個人。
verses.e: Then Elijah said to the people , " I , even I only , am left as a prophet of the LORD ; but Baal's prophets are four hundred fifty men .

verses.z: 當給我們兩隻牛犢，巴力的先知可以挑選一隻，切成塊子，放在柴上，不要點火；我也預備一隻牛犢放在柴上，也不點火。
verses.e: Let them therefore give us two bulls ; and let them choose one bull for themselves , and cut it in pieces , and lay it on the wood , and put no fire under ; and I will dress the other bull , and lay it on the wood , and put no fire under it .

verses.z: 你們求告你們神的名，我也求告耶和華的名。那降火顯應的神，就是上帝。」眾民回答說：「這話甚好。」
verses.e: You call on the name of your god , and I will call on the LORD's name . The God who answers by fire , let him be God . " All the people answered , " What you say is good . "

verses.z: 以利亞對巴力的先知說：「你們既是人多，當先挑選一隻牛犢，預備好了，就求告你們神的名，卻不要點火。」
verses.e: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal , " Choose one bull for yourselves , and dress it first , for you are many ; and call on the name of your god , but put no fire under it . "

verses.z: 他們將所得的牛犢預備好了，從早晨到午間，求告巴力的名說：「巴力啊，求你應允我們！」卻沒有聲音，沒有應允的。他們在所築的壇四圍踊跳。
verses.e: They took the bull which was given them , and they dressed it , and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon , saying , " Baal , hear us ! " But there was no voice , and nobody answered . They leaped about the altar which was made .

verses.z: 到了正午，以利亞嬉笑他們，說：「大聲求告吧！因為他是神，他或默想，或走到一邊，或行路，或睡覺，你們當叫醒他。」
verses.e: At noon , Elijah mocked them , and said , " Cry aloud , for he is a god . Either he is deep in thought , or he has gone somewhere , or he is on a journey , or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened . "

verses.z: 他們大聲求告，按着他們的規矩，用刀槍自割、自刺，直到身體流血。
verses.e: They cried aloud , and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them .

verses.z: 從午後直到獻晚祭的時候，他們狂呼亂叫，卻沒有聲音，沒有應允的，也沒有理會的。
verses.e: When midday was past , they prophesied until the time of the evening offering ; but there was no voice , no answer , and nobody paid attention .

verses.z: 亞哈將他的家宰俄巴底召了來。（俄巴底甚是敬畏耶和華，
verses.e: Ahab called Obadiah , who was over the household . ( Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly ;

verses.z: 以利亞對眾民說：「你們到我這裏來。」眾民就到他那裏。他便重修已經毀壞耶和華的壇。
verses.e: Elijah said to all the people , " Come near to me ! " ; and all the people came near to him . He repaired the LORD's altar that had been thrown down .

verses.z: 以利亞照雅各子孫支派的數目，取了十二塊石頭（耶和華的話曾臨到雅各說：「你的名要叫以色列」），
verses.e: Elijah took twelve stones , according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob , to whom the LORD's word came , saying , " Israel shall be your name . "

verses.z: 用這些石頭為耶和華的名築一座壇，在壇的四圍挖溝，可容穀種二細亞，
verses.e: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD's name . He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed .

verses.z: 又在壇上擺好了柴，把牛犢切成塊子放在柴上，對眾人說：「你們用四個桶盛滿水，倒在燔祭和柴上」；
verses.e: He put the wood in order , and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood . He said , " Fill four jars with water , and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood . "

verses.z: 又說：「倒第二次。」他們就倒第二次；又說：「倒第三次。」他們就倒第三次。
verses.e: He said , " Do it a second time ; " and they did it the second time . He said , " Do it a third time ; " and they did it the third time .

verses.z: 水流在壇的四圍，溝裏也滿了水。
verses.e: The water ran around the altar ; and he also filled the trench with water .

verses.z: 到了獻[晚]祭的時候，先知以利亞近前來，說：「亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的上帝，耶和華啊，求你今日使人知道你是以色列的上帝，也知道我是你的僕人，又是奉你的命行這一切事。
verses.e: At the time of the evening offering , Elijah the prophet came near and said , " LORD , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Israel , let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant , and that I have done all these things at your word .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，應允我！使這民知道你－耶和華是上帝，又知道是你叫這民的心回轉。」
verses.e: Hear me , LORD , hear me , that this people may know that you , LORD , are God , and that you have turned their heart back again . "

verses.z: 於是，耶和華降下火來，燒盡燔祭、木柴、石頭、塵土，又燒乾溝裏的水。
verses.e: Then the LORD's fire fell and consumed the burnt offering , the wood , the stones , and the dust ; and it licked up the water that was in the trench .

verses.z: 眾民看見了，就俯伏在地，說：「耶和華是上帝！耶和華是上帝！」
verses.e: When all the people saw it , they fell on their faces . They said , " The LORD , he is God ! The LORD , he is God ! "

verses.z: 耶洗別殺耶和華眾先知的時候，俄巴底將一百個先知藏了，每五十人藏在一個洞裏，拿餅和水供養他們。）
verses.e: for when Jezebel cut off the LORD's prophets , Obadiah took one hundred prophets , and hid them fifty to a cave , and fed them with bread and water . )

verses.z: 以利亞對他們說：「拿住巴力的先知，不容一人逃脫！」眾人就拿住他們。以利亞帶他們到基順河邊，在那裏殺了他們。
verses.e: Elijah said to them , " Seize the prophets of Baal ! Don't let one of them escape ! " They seized them ; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon , and killed them there .

verses.z: 以利亞對亞哈說：「你現在可以上去吃喝，因為有多雨的響聲了。」
verses.e: Elijah said to Ahab , " Get up , eat and drink ; for there is the sound of abundance of rain . "

verses.z: 亞哈就上去吃喝。以利亞上了迦密山頂，屈身在地，將臉伏在兩膝之中；
verses.e: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink . Elijah went up to the top of Carmel ; and he bowed himself down on the earth , and put his face between his knees .

verses.z: 對僕人說：「你上去，向海觀看。」僕人就上去觀看，說：「沒有甚麼。」他說：「你再去觀看。」如此七次。
verses.e: He said to his servant , " Go up now and look toward the sea . " He went up and looked , then said , " There is nothing . " He said , " Go again " seven times .

verses.z: 第七次僕人說：「我看見有一小片雲從海裏上來，不過如人手那樣大。」以利亞說：「你上去告訴亞哈，當套車下去，免得被雨阻擋。」
verses.e: On the seventh time , he said , " Behold , a small cloud , like a man's hand , is rising out of the sea . " He said , " Go up , tell Ahab , ' Get ready and go down , so that the rain doesn't stop you . ' "

verses.z: 霎時間，天因風雲黑暗，降下大雨。亞哈就坐車往耶斯列去了。
verses.e: In a little while , the sky grew black with clouds and wind , and there was a great rain . Ahab rode , and went to Jezreel .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈降在以利亞身上，他就束上腰，奔在亞哈前頭，直到耶斯列的城門。
verses.e: The LORD's hand was on Elijah ; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel .

verses.z: 亞哈對俄巴底說：「我們走遍這地，到一切水泉旁和一切溪邊，或者找得着青草，可以救活騾馬，免得絕了牲畜。」
verses.e: Ahab said to Obadiah , " Go through the land , to all the springs of water , and to all the brooks . Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive , that we not lose all the animals . "

verses.z: 於是二人分地遊行，亞哈獨走一路，俄巴底獨走一路。
verses.e: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it . Ahab went one way by himself , and Obadiah went another way by himself .

verses.z: 俄巴底在路上恰與以利亞相遇，俄巴底認出他來，就俯伏在地，說：「你是我主以利亞不是？」
verses.e: As Obadiah was on the way , behold , Elijah met him . He recognized him , and fell on his face , and said , " Is it you , my lord Elijah ? "

verses.z: 回答說：「是。你去告訴你主人說，以利亞[在這裏]。」
verses.e: He answered him , " It is I . Go , tell your lord , ' Behold , Elijah is here ! ' "

verses.z: 俄巴底說：「僕人有甚麼罪，你竟要將我交在亞哈手裏，使他殺我呢？
verses.e: He said , " How have I sinned , that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab , to kill me ?

verses.z: 亞哈將以利亞一切所行的和他用刀殺眾先知的事都告訴耶洗別。
verses.e: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done , and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword .

verses.z: 他說：「我為耶和華－萬軍之上帝大發熱心；因為以色列人背棄了你的約，毀壞了你的壇，用刀殺了你的先知，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。」
verses.e: He said , " I have been very jealous for the LORD , the God of Armies ; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant , thrown down your altars , and killed your prophets with the sword . I , even I only , am left ; and they seek my life , to take it away . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「你出來站在山上，在我面前。」那時耶和華從那裏經過，在他面前有烈風大作，崩山碎石，耶和華卻不在風中；風後地震，耶和華卻不在其中；
verses.e: He said , " Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD . " Behold , the LORD passed by , and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD ; but the LORD was not in the wind . After the wind there was an earthquake ; but the LORD was not in the earthquake .

verses.z: 地震後有火，耶和華也不在火中；火後有微小的聲音。
verses.e: After the earthquake a fire passed ; but the LORD was not in the fire . After the fire , there was a still small voice .

verses.z: 以利亞聽見，就用外衣蒙上臉，出來站在洞口。有聲音向他說：「以利亞啊，你在這裏做甚麼？」
verses.e: When Elijah heard it , he wrapped his face in his mantle , went out , and stood in the entrance of the cave . Behold , a voice came to him , and said , " What are you doing here , Elijah ? "

verses.z: 他說：「我為耶和華－萬軍之上帝大發熱心；因為以色列人背棄了你的約，毀壞了你的壇，用刀殺了你的先知，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。」
verses.e: He said , " I have been very jealous for the LORD , the God of Armies ; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant , thrown down your altars , and killed your prophets with the sword . I , even I only , am left ; and they seek my life , to take it away . "

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「你回去，從曠野往大馬士革去。到了那裏，就要膏哈薛作亞蘭王，
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Go , return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus . When you arrive , anoint Hazael to be king over Syria .

verses.z: 又膏寧示的孫子耶戶作以色列王，並膏亞伯‧米何拉人沙法的兒子以利沙作先知接續你。
verses.e: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel ; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place .

verses.z: 將來躲避哈薛之刀的，必被耶戶所殺；躲避耶戶之刀的，必被以利沙所殺。
verses.e: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael , Jehu will kill ; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu , Elisha will kill .

verses.z: 但我在以色列人中[為自己]留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的，未曾與巴力親嘴的。」
verses.e: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel , all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal , and every mouth which has not kissed him . "

verses.z: 於是，以利亞離開那裏走了，遇見沙法的兒子以利沙耕地；在他前頭有十二對[牛]，自己趕着第十二對。以利亞到他那裏去，將自己的外衣搭在他身上。
verses.e: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat , who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him , and he with the twelfth . Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him .

verses.z: 耶洗別就差遣人去見以利亞，告訴他說：「明日約在這時候，我若不使你的性命像那些人的性命一樣，願神明重重地降罰與我。」
verses.e: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah , saying , " So let the gods do to me , and more also , if I don't make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time ! "

verses.z: 以利沙就離開牛，跑到以利亞那裏，說：「求你容我先與父母親嘴，然後我便跟隨你。」以利亞對他說：「你回去吧，我向你做了甚麼呢？」
verses.e: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah , and said , " Let me please kiss my father and my mother , and then I will follow you . " He said to him , " Go back again ; for what have I done to you ? "

verses.z: 以利沙就離開他回去，宰了一對牛，用套牛的器具煮肉給民吃，隨後就起身跟隨以利亞，服事他。
verses.e: He returned from following him , and took the yoke of oxen , killed them , and boiled their meat with the oxen's equipment , and gave to the people ; and they ate . Then he arose , and went after Elijah , and served him .

verses.z: 以利亞見這光景就起來逃命，到了猶大的別是巴，將僕人留在那裏，
verses.e: When he saw that , he arose and ran for his life , and came to Beersheba , which belongs to Judah , and left his servant there .

verses.z: 自己在曠野走了一日的路程，來到一棵羅騰樹下，就坐在那裏求死，說：「耶和華啊，罷了！求你取我的性命，因為我不勝於我的列祖。」
verses.e: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness , and came and sat down under a juniper tree . Then he requested for himself that he might die , and said , " It is enough . Now , O LORD , take away my life ; for I am not better than my fathers . "

verses.z: 他就躺在羅騰樹下，睡着了。有一個天使拍他，說：「起來吃吧！」
verses.e: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree ; and behold , an angel touched him , and said to him , " Arise and eat ! "

verses.z: 他觀看，見頭旁有一瓶水與炭火燒的餅，他就吃了喝了，仍然躺下。
verses.e: He looked , and behold , there was at his head a cake baked on the coals , and a jar of water . He ate and drank , and lay down again .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者第二次來拍他，說：「起來吃吧！因為你當走的路甚遠。」
verses.e: The LORD's angel came again the second time , and touched him , and said , " Arise and eat , because the journey is too great for you . "

verses.z: 他就起來吃了喝了，仗着這飲食的力，走了四十晝夜，到了上帝的山，就是何烈山。
verses.e: He arose , and ate and drank , and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb , God's Mountain .

verses.z: 他在那裏進了一個洞，就住在洞中。耶和華的話臨到他說：「以利亞啊，你在這裏做甚麼？」
verses.e: He came to a cave there , and camped there ; and behold , the LORD's word came to him , and he said to him , " What are you doing here , Elijah ? "

verses.z: 大衛的死期臨近了，就囑咐他兒子所羅門說：
verses.e: Now the days of David came near that he should die ; and he commanded Solomon his son , saying ,

verses.z: 大衛與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城。
verses.e: David slept with his fathers , and was buried in David's city .

verses.z: 大衛作以色列王四十年：在希伯崙作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
verses.e: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years ; he reigned seven years in Hebron , and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 所羅門坐他父親大衛的位，他的國甚是堅固。
verses.e: Solomon sat on David his father's throne ; and his kingdom was firmly established .

verses.z: 哈及的兒子亞多尼雅去見所羅門的母親拔示巴，拔示巴問他說：「你來是為平安嗎？」回答說：「是為平安」；
verses.e: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon . She said , " Do you come peaceably ? " He said , " Peaceably .

verses.z: 又說：「我有話對你說。」拔示巴說：「你說吧。」
verses.e: He said moreover , I have something to tell you . " She said , " Say on . "

verses.z: 亞多尼雅說：「你知道國原是歸我的，以色列眾人也都仰望我作王，不料，國反歸了我兄弟，因他得國是出乎耶和華。
verses.e: He said , " You know that the kingdom was mine , and that all Israel set their faces on me , that I should reign . However , the kingdom is turned around , and has become my brother's ; for it was his from the LORD .

verses.z: 現在我有一件事求你，望你不要推辭。」拔示巴說：「你說吧。」
verses.e: Now I ask one petition of you . Don't deny me . " She said to him , " Say on . "

verses.z: 他說：「求你請所羅門王將書念的女子亞比煞賜我為妻，因他必不推辭你。」
verses.e: He said , " Please speak to Solomon the king ( for he will not tell you ' no ' ) , that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife . "

verses.z: 拔示巴說：「好，我必為你對王提說。」
verses.e: Bathsheba said , " All right . I will speak for you to the king . "

verses.z: 於是，拔示巴去見所羅門王，要為亞多尼雅提說；王起來迎接，向她下拜，就坐在位上，吩咐人為王母設一座位，她便坐在王的右邊。
verses.e: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon , to speak to him for Adonijah . The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her , and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother ; and she sat on his right hand .

verses.z: 「我現在要走世人必走的路。所以，你當剛強，作大丈夫，
verses.e: " I am going the way of all the earth . You be strong therefore , and show yourself a man ;

verses.z: 拔示巴說：「我有一件小事求你，望你不要推辭。」王說：「請母親說，我必不推辭。」
verses.e: Then she said , " I ask one small petition of you ; don't deny me . " The king said to her , " Ask on , my mother , for I will not deny you . "

verses.z: 拔示巴說：「求你將書念的女子亞比煞賜給你哥哥亞多尼雅為妻。」
verses.e: She said , " Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife . "

verses.z: 所羅門王對他母親說：「為何單替他求書念的女子亞比煞呢？也可以為他求國吧！他是我的哥哥，他有祭司亞比亞他和洗魯雅的兒子約押[為輔佐]。」
verses.e: King Solomon answered his mother , " Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah ? Ask for him the kingdom also , for he is my elder brother ; even for him , and for Abiathar the priest , and for Joab the son of Zeruiah . "

verses.z: 所羅門王就指着耶和華起誓說：「亞多尼雅這話是自己送命，不然，願上帝重重地降罰與我。
verses.e: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD , saying , " God do so to me , and more also , if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life .

verses.z: 耶和華堅立我，使我坐在父親大衛的位上，照着所應許的話為我建立家室；現在我指着永生的耶和華起誓，亞多尼雅今日必被治死。」
verses.e: Now therefore as the LORD lives , who has established me and set me on my father David's throne , and who has made me a house as he promised , surely Adonijah shall be put to death today . "

verses.z: 於是所羅門王差遣耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，將亞多尼雅殺死。
verses.e: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada ; and he fell on him , so that he died .

verses.z: 王對祭司亞比亞他說：「你回亞拿突歸自己的田地去吧！你本是該死的，但因你在我父親大衛面前抬過主耶和華的[約]櫃，又與我父親同受一切苦難，所以我今日不將你殺死。」
verses.e: To Abiathar the priest the king said , " Go to Anathoth , to your own fields , for you are worthy of death . But I will not at this time put you to death , because you bore the Lord GOD's ark before David my father , and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted . "

verses.z: 所羅門就革除亞比亞他，不許他作耶和華的祭司。這樣，便應驗耶和華在示羅論以利家所說的話。
verses.e: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to the LORD , that he might fulfill the LORD's word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh .

verses.z: 約押雖然沒有歸從押沙龍，卻歸從了亞多尼雅。他聽見這風聲，就逃到耶和華的帳幕，抓住祭壇的角。
verses.e: This news came to Joab ; for Joab had followed Adonijah , although he didn't follow Absalom . Joab fled to the LORD's Tent , and held onto the horns of the altar .

verses.z: 有人告訴所羅門王說：「約押逃到耶和華的帳幕，現今在祭壇的旁邊。」所羅門就差遣耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，說：「你去將他殺死。」
verses.e: King Solomon was told , " Joab has fled to the LORD's Tent ; and behold , he is by the altar . " Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , saying , " Go , fall on him . "

verses.z: 遵守耶和華－你上帝所吩咐的，照着摩西律法上所寫的行主的道，謹守他的律例、誡命、典章、法度。這樣，你無論做甚麼事，不拘往何處去，盡都亨通。
verses.e: and keep the instruction of the LORD your God , to walk in his ways , to keep his statutes , his commandments , his ordinances , and his testimonies , according to that which is written in the law of Moses , that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself .

verses.z: 比拿雅來到耶和華的帳幕，對約押說：「王吩咐說，你出來吧！」他說：「我不出去，我要死在這裏。」比拿雅就去回覆王，說約押如此如此回答我。
verses.e: Benaiah came to the LORD's Tent , and said to him , " The king says , ' Come out ! ' " He said , " No ; but I will die here . " Benaiah brought the king word again , saying , " This is what Joab said , and this is how he answered me . "

verses.z: 王說：「你可以照着他的話行，殺死他，將他葬埋，好叫約押流無辜人血的罪不歸我和我的父家了。
verses.e: The king said to him , " Do as he has said , and fall on him , and bury him , that you may take away the blood , which Joab shed without cause , from me and from my father's house .

verses.z: 耶和華必使約押流人血的罪歸到他自己的頭上；因為他用刀殺了兩個比他又義又好的人，就是以色列元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥和猶大元帥益帖的兒子亞瑪撒，我父親大衛卻不知道。
verses.e: The LORD will return his blood on his own head , because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he , and killed them with the sword , and my father David didn't know it : Abner the son of Ner , captain of the army of Israel , and Amasa the son of Jether , captain of the army of Judah .

verses.z: 故此，流這二人血的罪必歸到約押和他後裔的頭上，直到永遠；惟有大衛和他的後裔，並他的家與國，必從耶和華那裏得平安，直到永遠。」
verses.e: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever . But for David , for his offspring , for his house , and for his throne , there will be peace forever from the LORD . "

verses.z: 於是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅上去，將約押殺死，葬在曠野約押自己的墳墓裏。
verses.e: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him , and killed him ; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness .

verses.z: 王就立耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅作元帥，代替約押，又使祭司撒督代替亞比亞他。
verses.e: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army ; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar .

verses.z: 王差遣人將示每召來，對他說：「你要在耶路撒冷建造房屋居住，不可出來往別處去。
verses.e: The king sent and called for Shimei , and said to him , " Build yourself a house in Jerusalem , and live there , and don't go anywhere else .

verses.z: 你當確實地知道，你何日出來過汲淪溪，何日必死！你的罪必歸到自己的頭上。」
verses.e: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron , know for certain that you will surely die . Your blood will be on your own head . "

verses.z: 示每對王說：「這話甚好！我主我王怎樣說，僕人必怎樣行。」於是示每多日住在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Shimei said to the king , " What you say is good . As my lord the king has said , so will your servant do . " Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days .

verses.z: 過了三年，示每的兩個僕人逃到迦特王瑪迦的兒子亞吉那裏去。有人告訴示每說：「你的僕人在迦特。」
verses.e: At the end of three years , two of Shimei's slaves ran away to Achish , son of Maacah , king of Gath . They told Shimei , saying , " Behold , your slaves are in Gath . "

verses.z: 耶和華必成就向我所應許的話說：『你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，盡心盡意誠誠實實地行在我面前，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。』
verses.e: Then the LORD may establish his word which he spoke concerning me , saying , ' If your children are careful of their way , to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul , there shall not fail you , ' he said , ' a man on the throne of Israel . '

verses.z: 示每起來，備上驢，往迦特到亞吉那裏去找他的僕人，就從迦特帶他僕人回來。
verses.e: Shimei arose , saddled his donkey , and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves ; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath .

verses.z: 有人告訴所羅門說：「示每出耶路撒冷往迦特去，回來了。」
verses.e: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath , and had come again .

verses.z: 王就差遣人將示每召了來，對他說：「我豈不是叫你指着耶和華起誓，並且警戒你說『你當確實地知道，你哪日出來往別處去，那日必死』嗎？你也對我說：『這話甚好，我必聽從。』
verses.e: The king sent and called for Shimei , and said to him , " Didn't I adjure you by the LORD and warn you , saying , ' Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else , you shall surely die ' ? You said to me , ' The saying that I have heard is good . '

verses.z: 現在你為何不遵守你指着耶和華起的誓和我所吩咐你的命令呢？」
verses.e: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD and the commandment that I have instructed you with ? "

verses.z: 王又對示每說：「你向我父親大衛所行的一切惡事，你自己心裏也知道，所以耶和華必使你的罪惡歸到自己的頭上；
verses.e: The king said moreover to Shimei , " You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father . Therefore the LORD will return your wickedness on your own head .

verses.z: 惟有所羅門王必得福，並且大衛的國位必在耶和華面前堅定，直到永遠。」
verses.e: But King Solomon will be blessed , and David's throne will be established before the LORD forever . "

verses.z: 於是王吩咐耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，他就去殺死示每。這樣，便堅定了所羅門的國位。
verses.e: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada ; and he went out , and fell on him , so that he died . The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon .

verses.z: 你知道洗魯雅的兒子約押向我所行的，就是殺了以色列的兩個元帥：尼珥的兒子押尼珥和益帖的兒子亞瑪撒。他在太平之時流這二人的血，如在爭戰之時一樣，將這血染了腰間束的帶和腳上穿的鞋。
verses.e: " Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me , even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel , to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether , whom he killed , and shed the blood of war in peace , and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet .

verses.z: 所以你要照你的智慧行，不容他白頭安然下陰間。
verses.e: Do therefore according to your wisdom , and don't let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace .

verses.z: 你當恩待基列人巴西萊的眾子，使他們常與你同席吃飯；因為我躲避你哥哥押沙龍的時候，他們[拿食物]來迎接我。
verses.e: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite , and let them be among those who eat at your table ; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother .

verses.z: 在你這裏有巴戶琳的便雅憫人，基拉的兒子示每；我往瑪哈念去的那日，他用狠毒的言語咒罵我，後來卻下約旦河迎接我，我就指着耶和華向他起誓說：『我必不用刀殺你。』
verses.e: " Behold , there is with you Shimei the son of Gera , the Benjamite of Bahurim , who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim ; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan , and I swore to him by the LORD , saying , ' I will not put you to death with the sword . '

verses.z: 現在你不要以他為無罪。你是聰明人，必知道怎樣待他，使他白頭見殺，流血下到陰間。」
verses.e: Now therefore don't hold him guiltless , for you are a wise man ; and you will know what you ought to do to him , and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood . "

verses.z: 亞蘭王便‧哈達聚集他的全軍，率領三十二個王，帶着車馬上來圍攻撒馬利亞；
verses.e: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together ; and there were thirty-two kings with him , with horses and chariots . He went up and besieged Samaria , and fought against it .

verses.z: 便‧哈達又差遣人去見亞哈說：「撒馬利亞的塵土若夠跟從我的人每人捧一捧的，願神明重重地降罰與我！」
verses.e: Ben Hadad sent to him , and said , " The gods do so to me , and more also , if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me . "

verses.z: 以色列王說：「你告訴他說，才頂[盔]貫[甲]的，休要像摘[盔]卸[甲]的誇口。」
verses.e: The king of Israel answered , " Tell him , ' Don't let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off . ' "

verses.z: 便‧哈達和諸王正在帳幕裏喝酒，聽見這話，就對他臣僕說：「擺隊吧！」他們就擺隊攻城。
verses.e: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking , he and the kings in the pavilions , he said to his servants , " Prepare to attack ! " So they prepared to attack the city .

verses.z: 有一個先知來見以色列王亞哈，說：「耶和華如此說：『這一大群人你看見了嗎？今日我必將他們交在你手裏，你就知道我是耶和華。』」
verses.e: Behold , a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel , and said , " The LORD says , ' Have you seen all this great multitude ? Behold , I will deliver it into your hand today . Then you will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 亞哈說：「藉着誰呢？」他回答說：「耶和華說，藉着跟從省長的少年人。」亞哈說：「要誰率領呢？」他說：「要你親自率領。」
verses.e: Ahab said , " By whom ? " He said , " The LORD says , ' By the young men of the princes of the provinces . ' " Then he said , " Who shall begin the battle ? " He answered , " You . "

verses.z: 於是亞哈數點跟從省長的少年人，共有二百三十二名，後又數點以色列的眾兵，共有七千名。
verses.e: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces , and they were two hundred and thirty-two . After them , he mustered all the people , even all the children of Israel , being seven thousand .

verses.z: 午間，他們就出城；便‧哈達和幫助他的三十二個王正在帳幕裏痛飲。
verses.e: They went out at noon . But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions , he and the kings , the thirty-two kings who helped him .

verses.z: 跟從省長的少年人先出城；便‧哈達差遣人去[探望]，他們回報說：「有人從撒馬利亞出來了。」
verses.e: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first ; and Ben Hadad sent out , and they told him , saying , " Men are coming out from Samaria . "

verses.z: 他說：「他們若為講和出來，要活捉他們；若為打仗出來，也要活捉他們。」
verses.e: He said , " If they have come out for peace , take them alive ; or if they have come out for war , take them alive . "

verses.z: 跟從省長的少年人出城，軍兵跟隨他們；
verses.e: So these went out of the city , the young men of the princes of the provinces , and the army which followed them .

verses.z: 又差遣使者進城見以色列王亞哈，對他說：「便‧哈達如此說：
verses.e: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him , " Ben Hadad says ,

verses.z: 各人遇見敵人就殺。亞蘭人逃跑，以色列人追趕他們；亞蘭王便‧哈達騎着馬和馬兵一同逃跑。
verses.e: They each killed his man . The Syrians fled , and Israel pursued them . Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen .

verses.z: 以色列王出城攻打車馬，大大擊殺亞蘭人。
verses.e: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots , and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter .

verses.z: 那先知來見以色列王，對他說：「你當自強，留心怎樣防備；因為到明年這時候，亞蘭王必上來攻擊你。」
verses.e: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him , " Go , strengthen yourself , and plan what you must do , for at the return of the year , the king of Syria will come up against you . "

verses.z: 亞蘭王的臣僕對亞蘭王說：「以色列人的神是山神，所以他們勝過我們；但在平原與他們打仗，我們必定得勝。
verses.e: The servants of the king of Syria said to him , " Their god is a god of the hills ; therefore they were stronger than we . But let's fight against them in the plain , and surely we will be stronger than they .

verses.z: 王當這樣行：把諸王革去，派軍長代替他們，
verses.e: Do this thing : take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their place .

verses.z: 又照着王喪失軍兵之數，再招募一軍，馬補馬，車補車，我們在平原與他們打仗，必定得勝。」王便聽臣僕的話去行。
verses.e: Muster an army like the army that you have lost , horse for horse and chariot for chariot . We will fight against them in the plain , and surely we will be stronger than they are . " He listened to their voice and did so .

verses.z: 次年，便‧哈達果然點齊亞蘭人上亞弗去，要與以色列人打仗。
verses.e: At the return of the year , Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人也點齊軍兵，預備食物，迎着亞蘭人出去，對着他們安營，好像兩小群山羊羔；亞蘭人卻滿了地面。
verses.e: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions , and went against them . The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats , but the Syrians filled the country .

verses.z: 有神人來見以色列王，說：「耶和華如此說：『亞蘭人既說我－耶和華是山神，不是平原的神，所以我必將這一大群人都交在你手中，你們就知道我是耶和華。』」
verses.e: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel , and said , " The LORD says , ' Because the Syrians have said , " The LORD is a god of the hills , but he is not a god of the valleys , " therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand , and you shall know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 以色列人與亞蘭人相對安營七日，到第七日兩軍交戰；那一日以色列人殺了亞蘭人步兵十萬，
verses.e: They encamped opposite each other for seven days . Then on the seventh day the battle was joined ; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day .

verses.z: 你的金銀都要歸我，你妻子兒女中最美的也要歸我。」
verses.e: ' Your silver and your gold are mine . Your wives also and your children , even the best , are mine . ' "

verses.z: 其餘的逃入亞弗城；城牆塌倒，壓死剩下的二萬七千人。便‧哈達也逃入城，藏在嚴密的屋子裏。
verses.e: But the rest fled to Aphek , into the city ; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left . Ben Hadad fled and came into the city , into an inner room .

verses.z: 他的臣僕對他說：「我們聽說以色列王都是仁慈的王，現在我們不如腰束麻布，頭套繩索，出去投降以色列王，或者他存留王的性命。」
verses.e: His servants said to him , " See now , we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings . Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads , and go out to the king of Israel . Maybe he will save your life . "

verses.z: 於是他們腰束麻布，頭套繩索，去見以色列王，說：「王的僕人便‧哈達說，求王存留我的性命。」亞哈說：「他還活着嗎？他是我的兄弟。」
verses.e: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads , and came to the king of Israel , and said , " Your servant Ben Hadad says , ' Please let me live . ' " He said , " Is he still alive ? He is my brother . "

verses.z: 這些人留心探出他的口氣來，便急忙就着他的話說：「便‧哈達是王的兄弟！」王說：「你們去請他來。」便‧哈達出來見王，王就請他上車。
verses.e: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase ; and they said , " Your brother Ben Hadad . " Then he said , " Go , bring him . " Then Ben Hadad came out to him ; and he caused him to come up into the chariot .

verses.z: 便‧哈達對王說：「我父從你父那裏所奪的城邑，我必歸還。你可以在大馬士革立街市，像我父在撒馬利亞所立的一樣。」亞哈說：「我照此立約，放你回去」，就與他立約，放他去了。
verses.e: Ben Hadad said to him , " The cities which my father took from your father I will restore . You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus , as my father made in Samaria . " " I " , said Ahab , " will let you go with this covenant . " So he made a covenant with him and let him go .

verses.z: 有先知的一個門徒奉耶和華的命對他的同伴說：「你打我吧！」那人不肯打他。
verses.e: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by the LORD's word , " Please strike me ! " The man refused to strike him .

verses.z: 他就對那人說：「你既不聽從耶和華的話，你一離開我，必有獅子咬死你。」那人一離開他，果然遇見獅子，把他咬死了。
verses.e: Then he said to him , " Because you have not obeyed the LORD's voice , behold , as soon as you have departed from me , a lion will kill you . " As soon as he had departed from him , a lion found him and killed him .

verses.z: 先知的門徒又遇見一個人，對他說：「你打我吧！」那人就打他，將他打傷。
verses.e: Then he found another man , and said , " Please strike me . " The man struck him and wounded him .

verses.z: 他就去了，用頭巾蒙眼，改換面目，在路旁等候王。
verses.e: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way , and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes .

verses.z: 王從那裏經過，他向王呼叫說：「僕人在陣上的時候，有人帶了一個人來，對我說：『你看守這人，若把他失了，你的性命必代替他的性命；不然，你必交出一他連得銀子來。』
verses.e: As the king passed by , he cried to the king , and he said , " Your servant went out into the middle of the battle ; and behold , a man came over and brought a man to me , and said , ' Guard this man ! If by any means he is missing , then your life shall be for his life , or else you shall pay a talent of silver . '

verses.z: 以色列王回答說：「我主我王啊，可以依着你的話，我與我所有的都歸你。」
verses.e: The king of Israel answered , " It is according to your saying , my lord , O king . I am yours , and all that I have . "

verses.z: 僕人正在忙亂之間，那人就不見了。」以色列王對他說：「你自己定妥了，必照樣判斷你。」
verses.e: As your servant was busy here and there , he was gone . " The king of Israel said to him , " So shall your judgment be . You yourself have decided it . "

verses.z: 他急忙除掉蒙眼的頭巾，以色列王就認出他是一個先知。
verses.e: He hurried , and took the headband away from his eyes ; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets .

verses.z: 他對王說：「耶和華如此說：『因你將我定要滅絕的人放去，你的命就必代替他的命，你的民也必代替他的民。』」
verses.e: He said to him , " The LORD says , ' Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction , therefore your life will take the place of his life , and your people take the place of his people . ' "

verses.z: 於是以色列王悶悶不樂地回到撒馬利亞，進了他的宮。
verses.e: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry , and came to Samaria .

verses.z: 使者又來說：「便‧哈達如此說：我已差遣人去見你，要你將你的金銀、妻子、兒女都給我。
verses.e: The messengers came again and said , " Ben Hadad says , ' I sent indeed to you , saying , " You shall deliver me your silver , your gold , your wives , and your children ;

verses.z: 但明日約在這時候，我還要差遣臣僕到你那裏，搜查你的家和你僕人的家，將你眼中一切所喜愛的都拿了去。」
verses.e: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time , and they will search your house and the houses of your servants . Whatever is pleasant in your eyes , they will put it in their hand , and take it away . " ' "

verses.z: 以色列王召了國中的長老來，對他們說：「請你們看看，這人是怎樣地謀害[我]，他先差遣人到我這裏來，要我的妻子、兒女，和金銀，我並沒有推辭他。」
verses.e: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land , and said , " Please notice how this man seeks mischief ; for he sent to me for my wives , and for my children , and for my silver , and for my gold ; and I didn't deny him . "

verses.z: 長老和百姓對王說：「不要聽從他，也不要應允他。」
verses.e: All the elders and all the people said to him , " Don't listen , and don't consent . "

verses.z: 故此，以色列王對便‧哈達的使者說：「你們告訴我主我王說：王頭一次差遣人向僕人所要的，僕人都依從；但這次所要的，我不能依從。」使者就去回覆便‧哈達。
verses.e: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad , " Tell my lord the king , ' All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do , but this thing I cannot do . ' " The messengers departed and brought him back the message .

verses.z: 這事以後，又有一事。耶斯列人拿伯在耶斯列有一個葡萄園，靠近撒馬利亞王亞哈的宮。
verses.e: After these things , Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel , next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria .

verses.z: 又叫兩個匪徒坐在拿伯對面，作見證告他說：『你謗瀆上帝和王了』；隨後就把他拉出去用石頭打死。」
verses.e: Set two men , wicked fellows , before him , and let them testify against him , saying , ' You cursed God and the king ! ' Then carry him out , and stone him to death . "

verses.z: 那些與拿伯同城居住的長老貴冑得了耶洗別的信，就照信而行，
verses.e: The men of his city , even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city , did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them .

verses.z: 宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民間的高位上。
verses.e: They proclaimed a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people .

verses.z: 有兩個匪徒來，坐在拿伯的對面，當着眾民作見證告他說：「拿伯謗瀆上帝和王了！」眾人就把他拉到城外，用石頭打死。
verses.e: The two men , the wicked fellows , came in and sat before him . The wicked fellows testified against him , even against Naboth , in the presence of the people , saying , " Naboth cursed God and the king ! " Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones .

verses.z: 於是打發人去見耶洗別，說：「拿伯被石頭打死了。」
verses.e: Then they sent to Jezebel , saying , " Naboth has been stoned and is dead . "

verses.z: 耶洗別聽見拿伯被石頭打死，就對亞哈說：「你起來得耶斯列人拿伯不肯為價銀給你的葡萄園吧！現在他已經死了。」
verses.e: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead , Jezebel said to Ahab , " Arise , take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , which he refused to give you for money ; for Naboth is not alive , but dead . "

verses.z: 亞哈聽見拿伯死了，就起來，下去要得耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄園。
verses.e: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead , Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , to take possession of it .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到提斯比人以利亞說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,

verses.z: 「你起來，去見住撒馬利亞的以色列王亞哈，他下去要得拿伯的葡萄園，現今正在那園裏。
verses.e: " Arise , go down to meet Ahab king of Israel , who dwells in Samaria . Behold , he is in the vineyard of Naboth , where he has gone down to take possession of it .

verses.z: 你要對他說：『耶和華如此說：你殺了人，又得他的產業嗎？』又要對他說：『耶和華如此說：狗在何處舔拿伯的血，也必在何處舔你的血。』」
verses.e: You shall speak to him , saying , ' The LORD says , " Have you killed and also taken possession ? " ' You shall speak to him , saying , ' The LORD says , " In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth , dogs will lick your blood , even yours . " ' "

verses.z: 亞哈對拿伯說：「你將你的葡萄園給我作菜園，因為是靠近我的宮；我就把更好的葡萄園換給你，或是你要銀子，我就按着價值給你。」
verses.e: Ahab spoke to Naboth , saying , " Give me your vineyard , that I may have it for a garden of herbs , because it is near my house ; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it . Or , if it seems good to you , I will give you its worth in money . "

verses.z: 亞哈對以利亞說：「我仇敵啊，你找到我嗎？」他回答說：「我找到你了；因為你賣了自己，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事。
verses.e: Ahab said to Elijah , " Have you found me , my enemy ? " He answered , " I have found you , because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in the LORD's sight .

verses.z: [耶和華說]：『我必使災禍臨到你，將你除盡。凡屬你的男丁，無論困住的、自由的，都從以色列中剪除。
verses.e: Behold , I will bring evil on you , and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall , and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel .

verses.z: 我必使你的家像尼八的兒子耶羅波安的家，又像亞希雅的兒子巴沙的家；因為你惹我發怒，又使以色列人陷在罪裏。』
verses.e: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah , for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger , and have made Israel to sin . "

verses.z: 論到耶洗別，耶和華也說：『狗在耶斯列的外郭必吃耶洗別的肉。
verses.e: The LORD also spoke of Jezebel , saying , " The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel .

verses.z: 凡屬亞哈的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鳥吃。』」（
verses.e: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city ; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field . "

verses.z: 從來沒有像亞哈的，因他自賣，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，受了王后耶洗別的聳動；
verses.e: But there was no one like Ahab , who sold himself to do that which was evil in the LORD's sight , whom Jezebel his wife stirred up .

verses.z: 就照耶和華在以色列人面前所趕出的亞摩利人，行了最可憎惡的事，信從偶像。）
verses.e: He did very abominably in following idols , according to all that the Amorites did , whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel .

verses.z: 亞哈聽見這話，就撕裂衣服，禁食，身穿麻布，睡臥也穿着麻布，並且緩緩而行。
verses.e: When Ahab heard those words , he tore his clothes , put sackcloth on his body , fasted , lay in sackcloth , and went about despondently .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到提斯比人以利亞說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,

verses.z: 「亞哈在我面前這樣自卑，你看見了嗎？因他在我面前自卑，他還在世的時候，我不降這禍；到他兒子的時候，我必降這禍與他的家。」
verses.e: " See how Ahab humbles himself before me ? Because he humbles himself before me , I will not bring the evil in his days ; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son's day . "

verses.z: 拿伯對亞哈說：「我敬畏耶和華，萬不敢將我先人留下的產業給你。」
verses.e: Naboth said to Ahab , " May the LORD forbid me , that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you ! "

verses.z: 亞哈因耶斯列人拿伯說「我不敢將我先人留下的產業給你」，就悶悶不樂地回宮，躺在床上，轉臉向內，也不吃飯。
verses.e: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him , for he had said , " I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers . " He laid himself down on his bed , and turned away his face , and would eat no bread .

verses.z: 王后耶洗別來問他說：「你為甚麼心裏這樣憂悶，不吃飯呢？」
verses.e: But Jezebel his wife came to him , and said to him , " Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「因我向耶斯列人拿伯說：『你將你的葡萄園給我，我給你價銀，或是你願意，我就把[別的]葡萄園換給你』；他卻說：『我不將我的葡萄園給你。』」
verses.e: He said to her , " Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite , and said to him , ' Give me your vineyard for money ; or else , if it pleases you , I will give you another vineyard for it . ' He answered , ' I will not give you my vineyard . ' "

verses.z: 王后耶洗別對亞哈說：「你現在是治理以色列國不是？只管起來，心裏暢暢快快地吃飯，我必將耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄園給你。」
verses.e: Jezebel his wife said to him , " Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel ? Arise , and eat bread , and let your heart be merry . I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite . "

verses.z: 於是託亞哈的名寫信，用王的印印上，送給那些與拿伯同城居住的長老貴冑。
verses.e: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name and sealed them with his seal , and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city , who lived with Naboth .

verses.z: 信上寫着說：「你們當宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民間的高位上，
verses.e: She wrote in the letters , saying , " Proclaim a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people .

verses.z: 亞蘭國和以色列國三年沒有爭戰。
verses.e: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel .

verses.z: 以色列王和猶大王約沙法在撒馬利亞城門前的空場上，各穿朝服，坐在位上，所有的先知都在他們面前說預言。
verses.e: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne , arrayed in their robes , in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria ; and all the prophets were prophesying before them .

verses.z: 基拿拿的兒子西底家造了兩個鐵角，說：「耶和華如此說：『你要用這角牴觸亞蘭人，直到將他們滅盡。』」
verses.e: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron , and said , " The LORD says , ' With these you will push the Syrians , until they are consumed . ' "

verses.z: 所有的先知也都這樣預言說：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得勝，因為耶和華必將那城交在王的手中。」
verses.e: All the prophets prophesied so , saying , " Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper ; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king . "

verses.z: 那去召米該雅的使者對米該雅說：「眾先知一口同音地都向王說吉言，你不如與他們說一樣的話，也說吉言。」
verses.e: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him , saying , " See now , the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth . Please let your word be like the word of one of them , and speak good . "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，耶和華對我說甚麼，我就說甚麼。」
verses.e: Micaiah said , " As the LORD lives , what the LORD says to me , that I will speak . "

verses.z: 米該雅到王面前，王問他說：「米該雅啊，我們上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他回答說：「可以上去，必然得勝，耶和華必將那城交在王的手中。」
verses.e: When he had come to the king , the king said to him , " Micaiah , shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle , or shall we forbear ? " He answered him , " Go up and prosper ; and the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king . "

verses.z: 王對他說：「我當囑咐你幾次，你才奉耶和華的名向我說實話呢？」
verses.e: The king said to him , " How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD's name ? "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「我看見以色列眾民散在山上，如同沒有牧人的羊群一般。耶和華說：『這民沒有主人，他們可以平平安安地各歸各家去。』」
verses.e: He said , " I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd . The LORD said , ' These have no master . Let them each return to his house in peace . ' "

verses.z: 以色列王對約沙法說：「我豈沒有告訴你，這人指着我所說的預言，不說吉語單說凶言嗎？」
verses.e: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , " Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me , but evil ? "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「你要聽耶和華的話！我看見耶和華坐在寶座上，天上的萬軍侍立在他左右。
verses.e: Micaiah said , " Therefore hear the LORD's word . I saw the LORD sitting on his throne , and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left .

verses.z: 到第三年，猶大王約沙法下去見以色列王。
verses.e: In the third year , Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華說：『誰去引誘亞哈上基列的拉末去陣亡呢？』這個就這樣說，那個就那樣說。
verses.e: The LORD said , ' Who will entice Ahab , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead ? ' One said one thing , and another said another .

verses.z: 隨後有一個神靈出來，站在耶和華面前，說：『我去引誘他。』
verses.e: A spirit came out and stood before the LORD , and said , ' I will entice him . '

verses.z: 耶和華問他說：『你用何法呢？』他說：『我去，要在他眾先知口中作謊言的靈。』耶和華說：『這樣，你必能引誘他，你去如此行吧！』
verses.e: The LORD said to him , ' How ? ' He said , ' I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . ' He said , ' You will entice him , and will also prevail . Go out and do so . '

verses.z: 現在耶和華使謊言的靈入了你這些先知的口，並且耶和華已經命定降禍與你。」
verses.e: Now therefore , behold , the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets ; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you . "

verses.z: 基拿拿的兒子西底家前來，打米該雅的臉，說：「耶和華的靈從哪裏離開我與你說話呢？」
verses.e: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek , and said , " Which way did the LORD's Spirit go from me to speak to you ? "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「你進嚴密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看見了。」
verses.e: Micaiah said , " Behold , you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself . "

verses.z: 以色列王說：「將米該雅帶回，交給邑宰亞們和王的兒子約阿施，說
verses.e: The king of Israel said , " Take Micaiah , and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son .

verses.z: 王如此說，把這個人下在監裏，使他受苦，吃不飽喝不足，等候我平平安安地回來。」
verses.e: Say , ' The king says , " Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I come in peace . " ' "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「你若能平平安安地回來，那就是耶和華沒有藉我說這話了」；又說：「眾民哪，你們都要聽！」
verses.e: Micaiah said , " If you return at all in peace , the LORD has not spoken by me . " He said , " Listen , all you people ! "

verses.z: 以色列王和猶大王約沙法上基列的拉末去了。
verses.e: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead .

verses.z: 以色列王對臣僕說：「你們不知道基列的拉末是屬我們的嗎？我們豈可靜坐不動，不從亞蘭王手裏奪回來嗎？」
verses.e: The king of Israel said to his servants , " You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours , and we do nothing , and don't take it out of the hand of the king of Syria ? "

verses.z: 以色列王對約沙法說：「我要改裝上陣，你可以仍穿王服。」以色列王就改裝上陣。
verses.e: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , " I will disguise myself and go into the battle , but you put on your robes . " The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle .

verses.z: 先是亞蘭王吩咐他的三十二個車兵長說：「他們的[兵將]，無論大小，你們都不可與他們爭戰，只要與以色列王爭戰。」
verses.e: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots , saying , " Don't fight with small nor great , except only with the king of Israel . "

verses.z: 車兵長看見約沙法，便說：「這必是以色列王！」就轉過去與他爭戰，約沙法便呼喊。
verses.e: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat , they said , " Surely that is the king of Israel ! " and they came over to fight against him . Jehoshaphat cried out .

verses.z: 車兵長見不是以色列王，就轉去不追他了。
verses.e: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel , they turned back from pursuing him .

verses.z: 有一人隨便開弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲縫裏。王對趕車的說：「我受了重傷，你轉過車來，拉我出陣吧！」
verses.e: A certain man drew his bow at random , and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor . Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot , " Turn around , and carry me out of the battle , for I am severely wounded . "

verses.z: 那日，陣勢越戰越猛，有人扶王站在車上，抵擋亞蘭人。到晚上，王就死了，血從傷處流在車中。
verses.e: The battle increased that day . The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians , and died at evening . The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot .

verses.z: 約在日落的時候，有號令傳遍軍中，說：「各歸本城，各歸本地吧！」
verses.e: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun , saying , " Every man to his city , and every man to his country ! "

verses.z: 王既死了，眾人將他送到撒馬利亞，就葬在那裏；
verses.e: So the king died , and was brought to Samaria ; and they buried the king in Samaria .

verses.z: 又有人把他的車洗在撒馬利亞的池旁（妓女[在那裏]洗澡），狗來舔他的血，正如耶和華所說的話。
verses.e: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria ; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves , according to the LORD's word which he spoke .

verses.z: 亞哈其餘的事，凡他所行的和他所修造的象牙宮，並所建築的一切城邑，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab , and all that he did , and the ivory house which he built , and all the cities that he built , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 亞哈問約沙法說：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末嗎？」約沙法對以色列王說：「你我不分彼此，我的民與你的民一樣，我的馬與你的馬一樣。」
verses.e: He said to Jehoshaphat , " Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead ? " Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , " I am as you are , my people as your people , my horses as your horses . "

verses.z: 亞哈與他列祖同睡。他兒子亞哈謝接續他作王。
verses.e: So Ahab slept with his fathers ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 以色列王亞哈第四年，亞撒的兒子約沙法登基作了猶大王。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel .

verses.z: 約沙法登基的時候年三十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母親名叫阿蘇巴，乃示利希的女兒。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign ; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .

verses.z: 約沙法行他父親亞撒所行的道，不偏離左右，行耶和華眼中看為正的事；只是邱壇還沒有廢去，百姓仍在那裏獻祭燒香。
verses.e: He walked in all the way of Asa his father . He didn't turn away from it , doing that which was right in the LORD's eyes . However , the high places were not taken away . The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places .

verses.z: 約沙法與以色列王和好。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel .

verses.z: 約沙法其餘的事和他所顯出的勇力，並他怎樣爭戰，都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , and his might that he showed , and how he fought , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 約沙法將他父親亞撒在世所剩下的孌童都從國中除去了。
verses.e: The remnant of the sodomites , that remained in the days of his father Asa , he put away out of the land .

verses.z: 那時以東沒有王，有總督治理。
verses.e: There was no king in Edom . A deputy ruled .

verses.z: 約沙法製造他施船隻，要往俄斐去，將金子運來；只是沒有去，因為船在以旬‧迦別破壞了。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold , but they didn't go , for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber .

verses.z: 亞哈的兒子亞哈謝對約沙法說：「容我的僕人和你的僕人坐船同去吧！」約沙法卻不肯。
verses.e: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat , " Let my servants go with your servants in the ships . " But Jehoshaphat would not .

verses.z: 約沙法對以色列王說：「請你先求問耶和華。」
verses.e: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , " Please inquire first for the LORD's word . "

verses.z: 約沙法與列祖同睡。葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子約蘭接續他作王。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in his father David's city . Jehoram his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 猶大王約沙法十七年，亞哈的兒子亞哈謝在撒馬利亞登基，作以色列王共二年。
verses.e: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and he reigned two years over Israel .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他的父母，又行尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的事。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and walked in the way of his father , and in the way of his mother , and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , in which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 他照他父親一切所行的，事奉敬拜巴力，惹耶和華－以色列上帝的怒氣。
verses.e: He served Baal and worshiped him , and provoked the LORD , the God of Israel , to anger in all the ways that his father had done so .

verses.z: 於是以色列王招聚先知，約有四百人，問他們說：「我上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他們說：「可以上去，因為主必將那城交在王的手裏。」
verses.e: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said to them , " Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle , or should I refrain ? " They said , " Go up ; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king . "

verses.z: 約沙法說：「這裏不是還有耶和華的先知，我們可以求問他嗎？」
verses.e: But Jehoshaphat said , " Isn't there here a prophet of the LORD , that we may inquire of him ? "

verses.z: 以色列王對約沙法說：「還有一個人，是音拉的兒子米該雅，我們可以託他求問耶和華。只是我恨他；因為他指着我所說的預言，不說吉語，單說凶言。」約沙法說：「王不必這樣說。」
verses.e: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , " There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD , Micaiah the son of Imlah ; but I hate him , for he does not prophesy good concerning me , but evil . " Jehoshaphat said , " Don't let the king say so . "

verses.z: 以色列王就召了一個太監來，說：「你快去，將音拉的兒子米該雅召來。」
verses.e: Then the king of Israel called an officer , and said , " Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah . "

verses.z: 所羅門與埃及王法老結親，娶了法老的女兒為妻，接她進入大衛城，直等到造完了自己的宮和耶和華的殿，並耶路撒冷周圍的城牆。
verses.e: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt . He took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her into David's city until he had finished building his own house , the LORD's house , and the wall around Jerusalem .

verses.z: 所羅門因為求這事，就蒙主喜悅。
verses.e: This request pleased the Lord , that Solomon had asked this thing .

verses.z: 上帝對他說：「你既然求這事，不為自己求壽、求富，也不求滅絕你仇敵的性命，單求智慧可以聽訟，
verses.e: God said to him , " Because you have asked this thing , and have not asked for yourself long life , nor have you asked for riches for yourself , nor have you asked for the life of your enemies , but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice ,

verses.z: 我就應允你所求的，賜你聰明智慧，甚至在你以前沒有像你的，在你以後也沒有像你的。
verses.e: behold , I have done according to your word . Behold , I have given you a wise and understanding heart , so that there has been no one like you before you , and after you none will arise like you .

verses.z: 你所沒有求的，我也賜給你，就是富足、尊榮，使你在世的日子，列王中沒有一個能比你的。
verses.e: I have also given you that which you have not asked , both riches and honor , so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days .

verses.z: 你若效法你父親大衛，遵行我的道，謹守我的律例、誡命，我必使你長壽。」
verses.e: If you will walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as your father David walked , then I will lengthen your days . "

verses.z: 所羅門醒了，不料是個夢。他就回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和華的約櫃前，獻燔祭和平安祭，又為他眾臣僕設擺筵席。
verses.e: Solomon awoke ; and behold , it was a dream . Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the LORD's covenant , and offered up burnt offerings , offered peace offerings , and made a feast for all his servants .

verses.z: 一日，有兩個妓女來，站在王面前。
verses.e: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king , and stood before him .

verses.z: 一個說：「我主啊，我和這婦人同住一房；她在房中的時候，我生了一個男孩。
verses.e: The one woman said , " Oh , my lord , I and this woman dwell in one house . I delivered a child with her in the house .

verses.z: 我生孩子後第三日，這婦人也生了孩子。我們是同住的，除了我們二人之外，房中再沒有別人。
verses.e: The third day after I delivered , this woman delivered also . We were together . There was no stranger with us in the house , just us two in the house .

verses.z: 夜間，這婦人睡着的時候，壓死了她的孩子。
verses.e: This woman's child died in the night , because she lay on it .

verses.z: 當那些日子，百姓仍在邱壇獻祭，因為還沒有為耶和華的名建殿。
verses.e: However , the people sacrificed in the high places , because there was not yet a house built for the LORD's name .

verses.z: 她半夜起來，趁我睡着，從我旁邊把我的孩子抱去，放在她懷裏，將她的死孩子放在我懷裏。
verses.e: She arose at midnight , and took my son from beside me while your servant slept , and laid it in her bosom , and laid her dead child in my bosom .

verses.z: 天要亮的時候，我起來要給我的孩子吃奶，不料，孩子死了；及至天亮，我細細地察看，不是我所生的孩子。」
verses.e: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child , behold , he was dead ; but when I had looked at him in the morning , behold , it was not my son whom I bore . "

verses.z: 那婦人說：「不然，活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的。」這婦人說：「不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的。」她們在王面前如此爭論。
verses.e: The other woman said , " No ! But the living one is my son , and the dead one is your son . " The first one said , " No ! But the dead one is your son , and the living one is my son . " They argued like this before the king .

verses.z: 王說：「這婦人說『活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的』，那婦人說『不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的』」，
verses.e: Then the king said , " One says , ' This is my son who lives , and your son is the dead one ; ' and the other says , ' No ! But your son is the dead one , and my son is the living one . ' "

verses.z: 就吩咐說：「拿刀來！」人就拿刀來。
verses.e: The king said , " Get me a sword . " So they brought a sword before the king .

verses.z: 王說：「將活孩子劈成兩半，一半給那婦人，一半給這婦人。」
verses.e: The king said , " Divide the living child in two , and give half to the one , and half to the other . "

verses.z: 活孩子的母親為自己的孩子心裏急痛，就說：「求我主將活孩子給那婦人吧，萬不可殺他！」那婦人說：「這孩子也不歸我，也不歸你，把他劈了吧！」
verses.e: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king , for her heart yearned over her son , and she said , " Oh , my lord , give her the living child , and in no way kill him ! " But the other said , " He shall be neither mine nor yours . Divide him . "

verses.z: 王說：「將活孩子給這婦人，萬不可殺他；這婦人實在是他的母親。」
verses.e: Then the king answered , " Give the first woman the living child , and definitely do not kill him . She is his mother . "

verses.z: 以色列眾人聽見王這樣判斷，就都敬畏他；因為見他心裏有上帝的智慧，能以斷案。
verses.e: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged ; and they feared the king , for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice .

verses.z: 所羅門愛耶和華，遵行他父親大衛的律例，只是還在邱壇獻祭燒香。
verses.e: Solomon loved the LORD , walking in the statutes of David his father , except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places .

verses.z: 所羅門王上基遍去獻祭；因為在那裏有極大的邱壇，他在那壇上獻一千犧牲作燔祭。
verses.e: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there , for that was the great high place . Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar .

verses.z: 在基遍，夜間夢中，耶和華向所羅門顯現，對他說：「你願我賜你甚麼？你可以求。」
verses.e: In Gibeon , the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night ; and God said , " Ask for what I should give you . "

verses.z: 所羅門說：「你僕人－我父親大衛用誠實、公義、正直的心行在你面前，你就向他大施恩典，又為他存留大恩，賜他一個兒子坐在他的位上，正如今日一樣。
verses.e: Solomon said , " You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness , because he walked before you in truth , in righteousness , and in uprightness of heart with you . You have kept for him this great loving kindness , that you have given him a son to sit on his throne , as it is today .

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，如今你使僕人接續我父親大衛作王；但我是幼童，不知道應當怎樣出入。
verses.e: Now , LORD my God , you have made your servant king instead of David my father . I am just a little child . I don't know how to go out or come in .

verses.z: 僕人住在你所揀選的民中，這民多得不可勝數。
verses.e: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen , a great people , that can't be numbered or counted for multitude .

verses.z: 所以求你賜我智慧，可以判斷你的民，能辨別是非。不然，誰能判斷這眾多的民呢？」
verses.e: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people , that I may discern between good and evil ; for who is able to judge this great people of yours ? "

verses.z: 所羅門作以色列眾人的王。
verses.e: King Solomon was king over all Israel .

verses.z: 在亞魯泊有便‧希悉，他管理梭哥和希弗全地；
verses.e: Ben Hesed , in Arubboth ( Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him ) ;

verses.z: 在多珥山岡有便‧亞比拿達，他娶了所羅門的女兒她法為妻；
verses.e: Ben Abinadab , in all the height of Dor ( he had Taphath , Solomon's daughter , as wife ) ;

verses.z: 在他納和米吉多，並靠近撒拉他拿、耶斯列下邊的伯‧善全地，從伯‧善到亞伯‧米何拉直到約念之外，有亞希律的兒子巴拿；
verses.e: Baana the son of Ahilud , in Taanach and Megiddo , and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan , beneath Jezreel , from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah , as far as beyond Jokmeam ;

verses.z: 在基列的拉末有便‧基別，他管理在基列的瑪拿西子孫睚珥的城邑，巴珊的亞珥歌伯地的大城六十座，都有城牆和銅閂；
verses.e: Ben Geber , in Ramoth Gilead ( the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh , which are in Gilead , belonged to him ; and the region of Argob , which is in Bashan , sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars , belonged to him ) ;

verses.z: 在瑪哈念有易多的兒子亞希拿達；
verses.e: Ahinadab the son of Iddo , in Mahanaim ;

verses.z: 在拿弗他利有亞希瑪斯，他也娶了所羅門的一個女兒巴實抹為妻；
verses.e: Ahimaaz , in Naphtali ( he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife ) ;

verses.z: 在亞設和亞祿有戶篩的兒子巴拿；
verses.e: Baana the son of Hushai , in Asher and Bealoth ;

verses.z: 在以薩迦有帕路亞的兒子約沙法；
verses.e: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah , in Issachar ;

verses.z: 在便雅憫有以拉的兒子示每；
verses.e: Shimei the son of Ela , in Benjamin ;

verses.z: 在基列地，就是[從前屬]亞摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地，有烏利的兒子基別一人管理。
verses.e: Geber the son of Uri , in the land of Gilead , the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan ; and he was the only officer who was in the land .

verses.z: 他的臣子記在下面：撒督的兒子亞撒利雅作祭司，
verses.e: These were the princes whom he had : Azariah the son of Zadok , the priest ;

verses.z: 猶大人和以色列人如同海邊的沙那樣多，都吃喝快樂。
verses.e: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude , eating and drinking and making merry .

verses.z: 所羅門統管諸國，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。所羅門在世的日子，這些國都進貢服事他。
verses.e: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines , and to the border of Egypt . They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life .

verses.z: 所羅門每日所用的食物：細麵三十歌珥，粗麵六十歌珥，
verses.e: Solomon's provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour , sixty measures of meal ,

verses.z: 肥牛十隻，草場的牛二十隻，羊一百隻，還有鹿、羚羊、誁子，並肥禽。
verses.e: ten head of fat cattle , twenty head of cattle out of the pastures , and one hundred sheep , in addition to deer , gazelles , roebucks , and fattened fowl .

verses.z: 所羅門管理大河西邊的諸王，以及從提弗薩直到迦薩的全地，四境盡都平安。
verses.e: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River , from Tiphsah even to Gaza , over all the kings on this side of the River ; and he had peace on all sides around him .

verses.z: 所羅門在世的日子，從但到別是巴的猶大人和以色列人都在自己的葡萄樹下和無花果樹下安然居住。
verses.e: Judah and Israel lived safely , every man under his vine and under his fig tree , from Dan even to Beersheba , all the days of Solomon .

verses.z: 所羅門有套車的馬四萬，還有馬兵一萬二千。
verses.e: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen .

verses.z: 那十二個官吏各按各月供給所羅門王，並一切與他同席之人的食物，一無所缺。
verses.e: Those officers provided food for King Solomon , and for all who came to King Solomon's table , every man in his month . They let nothing be lacking .

verses.z: 眾人各按各分，將養馬與快馬的大麥和乾草送到[官吏]那裏。
verses.e: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were , each man according to his duty .

verses.z: 上帝賜給所羅門極大的智慧聰明和廣大的心，如同海沙[不可測量]。
verses.e: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom , understanding , and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore .

verses.z: 示沙的兩個兒子以利何烈、亞希亞作書記，亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官，
verses.e: Elihoreph and Ahijah , the sons of Shisha , scribes ; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , the recorder ;

verses.z: 所羅門的智慧超過東方人和埃及人的一切智慧。
verses.e: Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt .

verses.z: 他的智慧勝過萬人，勝過以斯拉人以探，並瑪曷的兒子希幔、甲各、達大的智慧。他的名聲傳揚在四圍的列國。
verses.e: For he was wiser than all men — wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite , Heman , Calcol , and Darda , the sons of Mahol ; and his fame was in all the nations all around .

verses.z: 他作箴言三千句，詩歌一千零五首。
verses.e: He spoke three thousand proverbs , and his songs numbered one thousand five .

verses.z: 他講論草木，自黎巴嫩的香柏樹直到牆上長的牛膝草，又講論飛禽走獸、昆蟲水族。
verses.e: He spoke of trees , from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall ; he also spoke of animals , of birds , of creeping things , and of fish .

verses.z: 天下列王聽見所羅門的智慧，就都差人來聽他的智慧話。
verses.e: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon , sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom .

verses.z: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅作元帥，撒督和亞比亞他作祭司[長]，
verses.e: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army ; Zadok and Abiathar were priests ;

verses.z: 拿單的兒子亞撒利雅作眾吏長，王的朋友拿單的兒子撒布得作領袖，
verses.e: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers ; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister , the king's friend ;

verses.z: 亞希煞作家宰，亞比大的兒子亞多尼蘭掌管服苦的人。
verses.e: Ahishar was over the household ; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor .

verses.z: 所羅門在以色列全地立了十二個官吏，使他們供給王和王家的食物，每年各人供給一月。
verses.e: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel , who provided food for the king and his household . Each man had to make provision for a month in the year .

verses.z: 他們的名字記在下面：在以法蓮山地有便‧戶珥；
verses.e: These are their names : Ben Hur , in the hill country of Ephraim ;

verses.z: 在瑪迦斯、沙賓、伯‧示麥、以倫‧伯‧哈南有便‧底甲；
verses.e: Ben Deker , in Makaz , in Shaalbim , Beth Shemesh , and Elon Beth Hanan ;

verses.z: 泰爾王希蘭，平素愛大衛；他聽見以色列人膏所羅門，接續他父親作王，就差遣臣僕來見他。
verses.e: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon , for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father , and Hiram had always loved David .

verses.z: 於是希蘭照着所羅門所要的，給他香柏木和松木；
verses.e: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire .

verses.z: 所羅門給希蘭麥子二萬歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所羅門每年都是這樣給希蘭。
verses.e: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household , and twenty cors of pure oil . Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year .

verses.z: 耶和華照着所應許的賜智慧給所羅門。希蘭與所羅門和好，彼此立約。
verses.e: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him . There was peace between Hiram and Solomon , and the two of them made a treaty together .

verses.z: 所羅門王從以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三萬，
verses.e: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .

verses.z: 派他們輪流每月一萬人上黎巴嫩去；一個月在黎巴嫩，兩個月在家裏。亞多尼蘭掌管他們。
verses.e: He sent them to Lebanon , ten thousand a month by courses : for a month they were in Lebanon , and two months at home ; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor .

verses.z: 所羅門用七萬扛抬的，八萬在山上鑿石頭的。
verses.e: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens , and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains ,

verses.z: 此外，所羅門用三千三百督工的，監管工人。
verses.e: besides Solomon's chief officers who were over the work : three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work .

verses.z: 王下令，人就鑿出又大又寶貴的石頭來，用以立殿的根基。
verses.e: The king commanded , and they cut out large stones , costly stones , to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone .

verses.z: 所羅門的匠人和希蘭的匠人，並迦巴勒人，都將石頭鑿好，預備木料和石頭建殿。
verses.e: Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders and the Gebalites cut them , and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house .

verses.z: 所羅門也差遣人去見希蘭，說：
verses.e: Solomon sent to Hiram , saying ,

verses.z: 「你知道我父親大衛因四圍的爭戰，不能為耶和華－他上帝的名建殿，直等到耶和華使仇敵都服在他腳下。
verses.e: " You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which were around him on every side , until the LORD put his enemies under the soles of his feet .

verses.z: 現在耶和華－我的上帝使我四圍平安，沒有仇敵，沒有災禍。
verses.e: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side . There is no enemy and no evil occurrence .

verses.z: 我定意要為耶和華－我上帝的名建殿，是照耶和華應許我父親大衛的話說：『我必使你兒子接續你坐你的位，他必為我的名建殿。』
verses.e: Behold , I intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God , as the LORD spoke to David my father , saying , ' Your son , whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name . '

verses.z: 所以求你吩咐你的僕人在黎巴嫩為我砍伐香柏木，我的僕人也必幫助他們，我必照你所定的，給你僕人的工價；因為你知道，在我們中間沒有人像西頓人善於砍伐樹木。」
verses.e: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon . My servants will be with your servants ; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say . For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians . "

verses.z: 希蘭聽見所羅門的話，就甚喜悅，說：「今日應當稱頌耶和華；因他賜給大衛一個有智慧的兒子，治理這眾多的民。」
verses.e: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon , he rejoiced greatly , and said , " Blessed is the LORD today , who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people . "

verses.z: 希蘭打發人去見所羅門，說：「你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都聽見了；論到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心願而行。
verses.e: Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , " I have heard the message which you have sent to me . I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning cypress timber .

verses.z: 我的僕人必將這木料從黎巴嫩運到海裏，紮成筏子，浮海運到你所指定我的地方，在那裏拆開，你就可以收取；你也要成全我的心願，將食物給我的家。」
verses.e: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea . I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me , and will cause them to be broken up there , and you will receive them . You will accomplish my desire , in giving food for my household . "

verses.z: 以色列人出埃及地後四百八十年，所羅門作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，開工建造耶和華的殿。
verses.e: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt , in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel , in the month Ziv , which is the second month , he began to build the LORD's house .

verses.z: 靠着殿所造的旁屋，每層高五肘，香柏木的棟樑擱在殿牆[坎上]。
verses.e: He built the floors all along the house , each five cubits high ; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到所羅門說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to Solomon , saying ,

verses.z: 「論到你所建的這殿，你若遵行我的律例，謹守我的典章，遵從我的一切誡命，我必向你應驗我所應許你父親大衛的話。
verses.e: " Concerning this house which you are building , if you will walk in my statutes , and execute my ordinances , and keep all my commandments to walk in them , then I will establish my word with you , which I spoke to David your father .

verses.z: 我必住在以色列人中間，並不丟棄我民以色列。」
verses.e: I will dwell among the children of Israel , and will not forsake my people Israel . "

verses.z: 所羅門建造殿宇。
verses.e: So Solomon built the house and finished it .

verses.z: 殿裏面用香柏木板貼牆，從地到棚頂都用木板遮蔽，又用松木板鋪地。
verses.e: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar ; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling , he covered them on the inside with wood . He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards .

verses.z: 內殿，就是至聖所，長二十肘，從地到[棚頂]用香柏木板遮蔽。
verses.e: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling . He built this within , for an inner sanctuary , even for the most holy place .

verses.z: 內殿前的外殿，長四十肘。
verses.e: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long .

verses.z: 殿裏一點石頭都不顯露，一概用香柏木遮蔽；上面刻着野瓜和初開的花。
verses.e: There was cedar on the house within , carved with buds and open flowers . All was cedar . No stone was visible .

verses.z: 殿裏預備了內殿，好安放耶和華的約櫃。
verses.e: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within , to set the ark of the LORD's covenant there .

verses.z: 所羅門王為耶和華所建的殿，長六十肘，寬二十肘，高三十肘。
verses.e: The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits , and its width twenty , and its height thirty cubits .

verses.z: 內殿長二十肘，寬二十肘，高二十肘，牆面都貼上精金；又用香柏木做壇，包上精金。
verses.e: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length , and twenty cubits in width , and twenty cubits in its height . He overlaid it with pure gold . He covered the altar with cedar .

verses.z: 所羅門用精金貼了殿內的牆，又用金鍊子掛在內殿前[門扇]，用金包裹。
verses.e: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold . He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary , and he overlaid it with gold .

verses.z: 全殿都貼上金子，直到貼完；內殿前的壇，也都用金包裹。
verses.e: He overlaid the whole house with gold , until all the house was finished . He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold .

verses.z: 他用橄欖木做兩個基路伯，各高十肘，安在內殿。
verses.e: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood , each ten cubits high .

verses.z: 這一個基路伯有兩個翅膀，各長五肘，從這翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有十肘；
verses.e: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub , and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub . From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits .

verses.z: 那一個基路伯[的兩個翅膀]也是十肘，兩個基路伯的尺寸、形像都是一樣。
verses.e: The other cherub was ten cubits . Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form .

verses.z: 這基路伯高十肘，那基路伯也是如此。
verses.e: One cherub was ten cubits high , and so was the other cherub .

verses.z: 他將兩個基路伯安在內殿裏；基路伯的翅膀是張開的，這基路伯的一個翅膀挨着這邊的牆，那基路伯的一個翅膀挨着那邊的牆，裏邊的兩個翅膀在殿中間彼此相接；
verses.e: He set the cherubim within the inner house . The wings of the cherubim were stretched out , so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall ; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house .

verses.z: 又用金子包裹二基路伯。
verses.e: He overlaid the cherubim with gold .

verses.z: 內殿、外殿周圍的牆上都刻着基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花。
verses.e: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim , palm trees , and open flowers , inside and outside .

verses.z: 殿前的廊子長二十肘，與殿的寬窄一樣，闊十肘；
verses.e: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits , which was along the width of the house . Ten cubits was its width in front of the house .

verses.z: 內殿、外殿的地板都貼上金子。
verses.e: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold , inside and outside .

verses.z: 又用橄欖木製造內殿的門扇、門楣、門框；門口[有牆的]五分之一。
verses.e: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary , he made doors of olive wood . The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall .

verses.z: 在橄欖木做的兩門扇上刻着基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花，都貼上金子。
verses.e: So he made two doors of olive wood ; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim , palm trees , and open flowers , and overlaid them with gold . He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees .

verses.z: 又用橄欖木製造外殿的門框，門口有[牆的]四分之一。
verses.e: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood , out of a fourth part of the wall ,

verses.z: 用松木做門兩扇。這扇分兩扇，是摺疊的；那扇分兩扇，也是摺疊的。
verses.e: and two doors of cypress wood . The two leaves of the one door were folding , and the two leaves of the other door were folding .

verses.z: 上面刻着基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花，都用金子貼了。
verses.e: He carved cherubim , palm trees , and open flowers ; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work .

verses.z: 他又用鑿成的石頭三層、香柏木一層建築內院。
verses.e: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams .

verses.z: [所羅門在位]第四年西弗月，立了耶和華殿的根基。
verses.e: The foundation of the LORD's house was laid in the fourth year , in the month Ziv .

verses.z: 到十一年布勒月，就是八月，殿和一切屬殿的都按着樣式造成。他建殿的工夫共有七年。
verses.e: In the eleventh year , in the month Bul , which is the eighth month , the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications . So he spent seven years building it .

verses.z: 又為殿做了嚴緊的窗櫺。
verses.e: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house .

verses.z: 靠着殿牆，圍着外殿內殿，造了三層旁屋；
verses.e: Against the wall of the house , he built floors all around , against the walls of the house all around , both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary ; and he made side rooms all around .

verses.z: 下層寬五肘，中層寬六肘，上層寬七肘。殿外旁屋[的樑木]擱在殿牆坎上，免得插入殿牆。
verses.e: The lowest floor was five cubits wide , and the middle was six cubits wide , and the third was seven cubits wide ; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around , that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house .

verses.z: 建殿是用山中鑿成的石頭。建殿的時候，鎚子、斧子，和別樣鐵器的響聲都沒有聽見。
verses.e: The house , when it was under construction , was built of stone prepared at the quarry ; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction .

verses.z: 在殿右邊當中的旁屋有門，門內有旋螺的樓梯，可以上到第二層，從第二層可以上到第三層。
verses.e: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house . They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor , and out of the middle into the third .

verses.z: 所羅門建殿，安置香柏木的棟樑，又用香柏木板遮蓋。
verses.e: So he built the house and finished it ; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar .

verses.z: 所羅門為自己建造宮室，十三年方才造成；
verses.e: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years , and he finished all his house .

verses.z: 根基是寶貴的大石頭，有長十肘的，有長八肘的；
verses.e: The foundation was of costly stones , even great stones , stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits .

verses.z: 上面有香柏木和按着尺寸鑿成寶貴的石頭。
verses.e: Above were costly stones , even cut stone , according to measure , and cedar wood .

verses.z: 大院周圍有鑿成的石頭三層、香柏木一層，都照耶和華殿的內院和殿廊的樣式。
verses.e: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams , like the inner court of the LORD's house and the porch of the house .

verses.z: 所羅門王差遣人往泰爾去，將戶蘭召了來。
verses.e: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre .

verses.z: 他是拿弗他利支派中一個寡婦的兒子，他父親是泰爾人，作銅匠的。戶蘭滿有智慧、聰明、技能，善於各樣銅作。他來到所羅門王那裏，做王一切所要做的。
verses.e: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali , and his father was a man of Tyre , a worker in bronze ; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze . He came to King Solomon and performed all his work .

verses.z: 他製造兩根銅柱，每根高十八肘，圍十二肘；
verses.e: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze , eighteen cubits high apiece ; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them .

verses.z: 又用銅鑄了兩個柱頂安在柱上，各高五肘。
verses.e: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars . The height of the one capital was five cubits , and the height of the other capital was five cubits .

verses.z: 柱頂上有裝修的網子和擰成的鍊索，每頂七個。
verses.e: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars : seven for the one capital , and seven for the other capital .

verses.z: 網子周圍有兩行[石榴]遮蓋柱頂，兩個柱頂都是如此。
verses.e: So he made the pillars ; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network , to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars ; and he did so for the other capital .

verses.z: 廊子的柱頂徑四肘，刻着百合花。
verses.e: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work , four cubits .

verses.z: 又建造黎巴嫩林宮，長一百肘，寬五十肘，高三十肘，有香柏木柱三行，柱上有香柏木柁樑。
verses.e: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon . Its length was one hundred cubits , its width fifty cubits , and its height thirty cubits , on four rows of cedar pillars , with cedar beams on the pillars .

verses.z: 兩柱頂的鼓肚上挨着網子，各有兩行石榴環繞，兩行共有二百。
verses.e: There were capitals above also on the two pillars , close by the belly which was beside the network . There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital .

verses.z: 他將兩根柱子立在殿廊前頭：右邊立一根，起名叫雅斤；左邊立一根，起名叫波阿斯。
verses.e: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple . He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin ; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz .

verses.z: 在柱頂上刻着百合花。這樣，造柱子的工就完畢了。
verses.e: On the tops of the pillars was lily work . So the work of the pillars was finished .

verses.z: 他又鑄一個銅海，樣式是圓的，高五肘，徑十肘，圍三十肘。
verses.e: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim , round in shape . Its height was five cubits ; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it .

verses.z: 在海邊之下，周圍有野瓜的樣式；每肘十瓜，共有兩行，是鑄海的時候鑄上的。
