verses.e: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits , encircling the sea . The buds were in two rows , cast when it was cast .

verses.z: 有十二隻[銅]牛馱海：三隻向北，三隻向西，三隻向南，三隻向東；海在牛上，牛尾都向內。
verses.e: It stood on twelve oxen , three looking toward the north , and three looking toward the west , and three looking toward the south , and three looking toward the east ; and the sea was set on them above , and all their hindquarters were inward .

verses.z: 海厚一掌，邊如杯邊，又如百合花，可容二千罷特。
verses.e: It was a hand width thick . Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup , like the flower of a lily . It held two thousand baths .

verses.z: 他用銅製造十個[盆]座，每座長四肘，寬四肘，高三肘。
verses.e: He made the ten bases of bronze . The length of one base was four cubits , four cubits its width , and three cubits its height .

verses.z: 座的造法是這樣：四面都有心子，心子在邊子當中，
verses.e: The work of the bases was like this : they had panels ; and there were panels between the ledges ;

verses.z: 心子上有獅子和牛，並基路伯；邊上有[小]座，獅子和牛以下有垂下的瓔珞。
verses.e: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions , oxen , and cherubim ; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above ; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work .

verses.z: 其上以香柏木為蓋，每行柱子十五根，共有四十五根。
verses.e: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars , fifteen in a row .

verses.z: 每[盆]座有四個銅輪和銅軸。[小]座的四角上在盆以下，有鑄成的盆架，其旁都有瓔珞。
verses.e: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze ; and its four feet had supports . The supports were cast beneath the basin , with wreaths at the side of each .

verses.z: 小座高一肘，口是圓的，彷彿座的樣式，[徑]一肘半，在口上有雕工，心子是方的，不是圓的。
verses.e: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit . Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal , a cubit and a half ; and also on its opening were engravings , and their panels were square , not round .

verses.z: 四個輪子在心子以下，輪軸與座相連，每輪高一肘半。
verses.e: The four wheels were underneath the panels ; and the axles of the wheels were in the base . The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit .

verses.z: 輪的樣式如同車輪；軸、輞、輻、轂都是鑄的。
verses.e: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel . Their axles , their rims , their spokes , and their hubs were all of cast metal .

verses.z: 每座四角上都有盆架，是與座一同鑄成的。
verses.e: There were four supports at the four corners of each base . Its supports were of the base itself .

verses.z: 座上有圓架，高半肘；座上有撐子和心子，是與座一同鑄的。
verses.e: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high ; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same .

verses.z: 在撐子和心子上刻着基路伯、獅子，和棕樹，周圍有瓔珞。
verses.e: On the plates of its supports and on its panels , he engraved cherubim , lions , and palm trees , each in its space , with wreaths all around .

verses.z: 十個盆座都是這樣，鑄法、尺寸、樣式相同。
verses.e: He made the ten bases in this way : all of them had one casting , one measure , and one form .

verses.z: 又用銅製造十個盆，每盆可容四十罷特。盆徑四肘，在那十座上，每座安設一盆。
verses.e: He made ten basins of bronze . One basin contained forty baths . Every basin measured four cubits . One basin was on every one of the ten bases .

verses.z: 五個安在殿門的右邊，五個放在殿[門]的左邊；又將海放在殿[門]的右旁，就是南邊。
verses.e: He set the bases , five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house . He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south .

verses.z: 有窗戶三層，窗與窗相對。
verses.e: There were beams in three rows , and window was facing window in three ranks .

verses.z: 戶蘭又造了盆、鏟子，和盤子。這樣，他為所羅門王做完了耶和華殿的一切工。
verses.e: Hiram made the pots , the shovels , and the basins . So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in the LORD's house :

verses.z: 所[造的]就是：兩根柱子和柱上兩個如球的頂；並兩個蓋柱頂的網子；
verses.e: the two pillars ; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars ; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars ;

verses.z: 和四百石榴，安在兩個網子上，每網兩行，蓋着兩個柱上如球的頂；
verses.e: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks ; two rows of pomegranates for each network , to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars ;

verses.z: 十個座和其上的十個盆；
verses.e: the ten bases ; the ten basins on the bases ;

verses.z: 海和海下的十二隻牛；
verses.e: the one sea ; the twelve oxen under the sea ;

verses.z: 盆、鏟子、盤子。這一切都是戶蘭給所羅門王用光亮的銅為耶和華的殿造成的，
verses.e: the pots ; the shovels ; and the basins . All of these vessels , which Hiram made for King Solomon in the LORD's house , were of burnished bronze .

verses.z: 是[遵]王[命]在約旦平原、疏割和撒拉但中間藉膠泥鑄成的。
verses.e: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan , in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan .

verses.z: 這一切所羅門都沒有[過秤]；因為甚多，銅的輕重也無法可查。
verses.e: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed , because there were so many of them . The weight of the bronze could not be determined .

verses.z: 所羅門又造耶和華殿裏的金壇和陳設餅的金桌子；
verses.e: Solomon made all the vessels that were in the LORD's house : the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on , of gold ;

verses.z: 內殿前的精金燈臺：右邊五個，左邊五個，並其上的金花、燈盞、蠟剪，
verses.e: and the lamp stands , five on the right side and five on the left , in front of the inner sanctuary , of pure gold ; and the flowers , the lamps , and the tongs , of gold ;

verses.z: 所有的門框都是厚木見方的，有窗戶三層，窗與窗相對。
verses.e: All the doors and posts were made square with beams ; and window was facing window in three ranks .

verses.z: 與精金的杯、盤、鑷子、調羹、火鼎，以及至聖所、內殿的門樞，和外殿的門樞。
verses.e: the cups , the snuffers , the basins , the spoons , and the fire pans , of pure gold ; and the hinges , both for the doors of the inner house , the most holy place , and for the doors of the house , of the temple , of gold .

verses.z: 所羅門王做完了耶和華殿的一切工，就把他父大衛分別為聖的金銀和器皿都帶來放在耶和華殿的府庫裏。
verses.e: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in the LORD's house was finished . Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated — the silver , the gold , and the vessels — and put them in the treasuries of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 並建造有柱子的廊子，長五十肘，寬三十肘；在這廊前又有廊子，廊外有柱子和臺階。
verses.e: He made the hall of pillars . Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits , with a porch before them , and pillars and a threshold before them .

verses.z: 又建造一廊，其中設立審判的座位，這廊從地到頂都用香柏木遮蔽。
verses.e: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge , even the porch of judgment ; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor .

verses.z: 廊後院內有所羅門住的宮室；工作與這工作相同。所羅門又為所娶法老的女兒建造一宮，做法與這廊子一樣。
verses.e: His house where he was to dwell , the other court within the porch , was of the same construction . He made also a house for Pharaoh's daughter ( whom Solomon had taken as wife ) , like this porch .

verses.z: 建造這一切所用的石頭都是寶貴的，是按着尺寸鑿成的，是用鋸裏外鋸齊的；從根基直到檐石，從外頭直到大院，都是如此。
verses.e: All these were of costly stones , even of stone cut according to measure , sawed with saws , inside and outside , even from the foundation to the coping , and so on the outside to the great court .

verses.z: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老和各支派的首領，並以色列的族長，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城－就是錫安－運上來。
verses.e: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes , the princes of the fathers ' households of the children of Israel , to King Solomon in Jerusalem , to bring up the ark of the LORD's covenant out of David's city , which is Zion .

verses.z: 祭司從聖所出來的時候，有雲充滿耶和華的殿；
verses.e: It came to pass , when the priests had come out of the holy place , that the cloud filled the LORD's house ,

verses.z: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了殿。
verses.e: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud ; for the LORD's glory filled the LORD's house .

verses.z: 那時所羅門說：耶和華曾說，他必住在幽暗之處。
verses.e: Then Solomon said , " The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .

verses.z: 我已經建造殿宇作你的居所，為你永遠的住處。
verses.e: I have surely built you a house of habitation , a place for you to dwell in forever . "

verses.z: 王轉臉為以色列會眾祝福，以色列會眾就都站立。
verses.e: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel ; and all the assembly of Israel stood .

verses.z: 所羅門說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的！因他親口向我父大衛所應許的，也親手成就了。
verses.e: He said , " Blessed is the LORD , the God of Israel , who spoke with his mouth to David your father , and has with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,

verses.z: 他說：『自從我領我民以色列出埃及以來，我未曾在以色列各支派中選擇一城建造殿宇－為我名的[居所]，但揀選大衛治理我民以色列。』」
verses.e: ' Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt , I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house , that my name might be there ; but I chose David to be over my people Israel . '

verses.z: 所羅門說：「我父大衛曾立意，要為耶和華－以色列上帝的名建殿。
verses.e: " Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華卻對我父大衛說：『你立意為我的名建殿，這意思甚好。
verses.e: But the LORD said to David my father , ' Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name , you did well that it was in your heart .

verses.z: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的兒子必為我名建殿。』
verses.e: Nevertheless , you shall not build the house ; but your son who shall come out of your body , he shall build the house for my name . '

verses.z: 以他念月，就是七月，在節前，以色列人都聚集到所羅門王那裏。
verses.e: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim , which is the seventh month .

verses.z: 現在耶和華成就了他所應許的話，使我接續我父大衛坐以色列的國位，又為耶和華－以色列上帝的名建造了殿。
verses.e: The LORD has established his word that he spoke ; for I have risen up in the place of David my father , and I sit on the throne of Israel , as the LORD promised , and have built the house for the name of the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 我也在其中為[約]櫃預備一處。[約]櫃內有耶和華的約，就是他領我們列祖出埃及地的時候，與他們所立的約。」
verses.e: There I have set a place for the ark , in which is the LORD's covenant , which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt . "

verses.z: 所羅門當着以色列會眾，站在耶和華的壇前，向天舉手說：
verses.e: Solomon stood before the LORD's altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel , and spread out his hands toward heaven ;

verses.z: 「耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，天上地下沒有神可比你的！你向那盡心行在你面前的僕人守約施慈愛；
verses.e: and he said , " LORD , the God of Israel , there is no God like you , in heaven above , or on earth beneath ; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart ;

verses.z: 向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話現在應驗了。你親口應許，親手成就，正如今日一樣。
verses.e: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him . Yes , you spoke with your mouth , and have fulfilled it with your hand , as it is today .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，你所應許你僕人－我父大衛的話說：『你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，在我面前行事像你所行的一樣，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。』現在求你應驗這話。
verses.e: Now therefore , may LORD , the God of Israel , keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him , saying , ' There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel , if only your children take heed to their way , to walk before me as you have walked before me . '

verses.z: 以色列的上帝啊，求你成就向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話。
verses.e: " Now therefore , God of Israel , please let your word be verified , which you spoke to your servant David my father .

verses.z: 「上帝果真住在地上嗎？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何況我所建的這殿呢？
verses.e: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth ? Behold , heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain you ; how much less this house that I have built !

verses.z: 惟求耶和華－我的上帝垂顧僕人的禱告祈求，俯聽僕人今日在你面前的祈禱呼籲。
verses.e: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication , LORD my God , to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today ;

verses.z: 願你晝夜看顧這殿，就是你應許立為你名的居所；求你垂聽僕人向此處禱告的話。
verses.e: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day , even toward the place of which you have said , ' My name shall be there ; ' to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place .

verses.z: 以色列長老來到，祭司便抬起[約]櫃，
verses.e: All the elders of Israel came , and the priests picked up the ark .

verses.z: 你僕人和你民以色列向此處祈禱的時候，求你在天上你的居所垂聽，垂聽而赦免。
verses.e: Listen to the supplication of your servant , and of your people Israel , when they pray toward this place . Yes , hear in heaven , your dwelling place ; and when you hear , forgive .

verses.z: 「人若得罪鄰舍，有人叫他起誓，他來到這殿在你的壇前起誓，
verses.e: " If a man sins against his neighbor , and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear , and he comes and swears before your altar in this house ,

verses.z: 求你在天上垂聽，判斷你的僕人：定惡人有罪，照他所行的報應在他頭上；定義人有理，照他的義賞賜他。
verses.e: then hear in heaven , and act , and judge your servants , condemning the wicked , to bring his way on his own head , and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .

verses.z: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，敗在仇敵面前，又歸向你，承認你的名，在這殿裏祈求禱告，
verses.e: " When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you , if they turn again to you and confess your name , and pray and make supplication to you in this house ,

verses.z: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他們歸回你賜給他們列祖之地。
verses.e: then hear in heaven , and forgive the sin of your people Israel , and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers .

verses.z: 「你的民因得罪你，你懲罰他們，使天閉塞不下雨；他們若向此處禱告，承認你的名，離開他們的罪，
verses.e: " When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you , if they pray toward this place and confess your name , and turn from their sin when you afflict them ,

verses.z: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你僕人以色列民的罪，將當行的善道指教他們，且降雨在你的地，就是你賜給你民為業之地。
verses.e: then hear in heaven , and forgive the sin of your servants , and of your people Israel , when you teach them the good way in which they should walk ; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance .

verses.z: 「國中若有饑荒、瘟疫、旱風、霉爛、蝗蟲、螞蚱，或有仇敵犯境圍困城邑，無論遭遇甚麼災禍疾病，
verses.e: " If there is famine in the land , if there is pestilence , if there is blight , mildew , locust or caterpillar ; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities , whatever plague , whatever sickness there is ,

verses.z: 你的民以色列，或是眾人，或是一人，自覺有罪，向這殿舉手，無論祈求甚麼，禱告甚麼，
verses.e: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man , or by all your people Israel , who shall each know the plague of his own heart , and spread out his hands toward this house ,

verses.z: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他們（惟有你知道世人的心），
verses.e: then hear in heaven , your dwelling place , and forgive , and act , and give to every man according to all his ways , whose heart you know ( for you , even you only , know the hearts of all the children of men ) ;

verses.z: 祭司和利未人將耶和華的[約]櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。
verses.e: They brought up the LORD's ark , the Tent of Meeting , and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent . The priests and the Levites brought these up .

verses.z: 使他們在你賜給我們列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。
verses.e: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers .

verses.z: 「論到不屬你民以色列的外邦人，為你名從遠方而來，
verses.e: " Moreover , concerning the foreigner , who is not of your people Israel , when he comes out of a far country for your name's sake

verses.z: （他們聽人論說你的大名和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂）向這殿禱告，
verses.e: ( for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm ) , when he comes and prays toward this house ,

verses.z: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下萬民都認識你的名，敬畏你像你的民以色列一樣；又使他們知道我建造的這殿是稱為你名下的。
verses.e: hear in heaven , your dwelling place , and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for ; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name , to fear you , as do your people Israel , and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name .

verses.z: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，無論往何處去與仇敵爭戰，向耶和華所選擇的城與我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
verses.e: " If your people go out to battle against their enemy , by whatever way you shall send them , and they pray to the LORD toward the city which you have chosen , and toward the house which I have built for your name ,

verses.z: 求你在天上垂聽他們的禱告祈求，使他們得勝。
verses.e: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .

verses.z: 「你的民若得罪你（世上沒有不犯罪的人），你向他們發怒，將他們交給仇敵擄到仇敵之地，或遠或近，
verses.e: If they sin against you ( for there is no man who doesn't sin ) , and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy , far off or near ;

verses.z: 他們若在擄到之地想起罪來，回心轉意，懇求你說：『我們有罪了，我們悖逆了，我們作惡了』；
verses.e: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive , and turn again , and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive , saying , ' We have sinned and have done perversely ; we have dealt wickedly , '

verses.z: 他們若在擄到之地盡心盡性歸服你，又向自己的地，就是你賜給他們列祖之地和你所選擇的城，並我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
verses.e: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive , and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers , the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name ,

verses.z: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽他們的禱告祈求，為他們伸冤；
verses.e: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven , your dwelling place , and maintain their cause ;

verses.z: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裏的以色列全會眾，一同在[約]櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。
verses.e: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel , who were assembled to him , were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude .

verses.z: 饒恕得罪你的民，赦免他們的一切過犯，使他們在擄他們的人面前蒙憐恤。
verses.e: and forgive your people who have sinned against you , and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you ; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive , that they may have compassion on them

verses.z: 因為他們是你的子民，你的產業，是你從埃及領出來脫離鐵爐的。
verses.e: ( for they are your people and your inheritance , which you brought out of Egypt , from the middle of the iron furnace ) ;

verses.z: 願你的眼目看顧僕人，聽你民以色列的祈求，無論何時向你祈求，願你垂聽。
verses.e: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel , to listen to them whenever they cry to you .

verses.z: 主耶和華啊，你將他們從地上的萬民中分別出來作你的產業，是照你領我們列祖出埃及的時候，藉你僕人摩西所應許的話。」
verses.e: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance , as you spoke by Moses your servant , when you brought our fathers out of Egypt , Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 所羅門在耶和華的壇前屈膝跪着，向天舉手，在耶和華面前禱告祈求已畢，就起來，
verses.e: It was so , that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD , he arose from before the LORD's altar , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven .

verses.z: 站着，大聲為以色列全會眾祝福，說：
verses.e: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,

verses.z: 「耶和華是應當稱頌的！因為他照着一切所應許的賜平安給他的民以色列人，凡藉他僕人摩西應許賜福的話，一句都沒有落空。
verses.e: " Blessed be the LORD , who has given rest to his people Israel , according to all that he promised . There has not failed one word of all his good promise , which he promised by Moses his servant .

verses.z: 願耶和華－我們的上帝與我們同在，像與我們列祖同在一樣，不撇下我們，不丟棄我們，
verses.e: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers . Let him not leave us or forsake us ,

verses.z: 使我們的心歸向他，遵行他的道，謹守他吩咐我們列祖的誡命、律例、典章。
verses.e: that he may incline our hearts to him , to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , his statutes , and his ordinances , which he commanded our fathers .

verses.z: 我在耶和華面前祈求的這些話，願耶和華－我們的上帝晝夜垂念，每日為他僕人與他民以色列伸冤，
verses.e: Let these my words , with which I have made supplication before the LORD , be near to the LORD our God day and night , that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel , as every day requires ;

verses.z: 祭司將耶和華的約櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。
verses.e: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD's covenant to its place , into the inner sanctuary of the house , to the most holy place , even under the cherubim's wings .

verses.z: 使地上的萬民都知道惟獨耶和華是上帝，並無別神。
verses.e: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD himself is God . There is no one else .

verses.z: 所以你們當向耶和華－我們的上帝存誠實的心，遵行他的律例，謹守他的誡命，[至終]如今日一樣。」
verses.e: " Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as it is today . "

verses.z: 王和以色列眾民一同在耶和華面前獻祭。
verses.e: The king , and all Israel with him , offered sacrifice before the LORD .

verses.z: 所羅門向耶和華獻平安祭，用牛二萬二千，羊十二萬。這樣，王和以色列眾民為耶和華的殿行奉獻之禮。
verses.e: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings , which he offered to the LORD , twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD's house .

verses.z: 當日，王因耶和華殿前的銅壇太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便將耶和華殿前院子當中分別為聖，在那裏獻燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。
verses.e: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before the LORD's house ; for there he offered the burnt offering , the meal offering , and the fat of the peace offerings , because the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offering , the meal offering , and the fat of the peace offerings .

verses.z: 那時，所羅門和以色列眾人，就是從哈馬口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成為大會，在耶和華－我們的上帝面前守節七日又七日，共十四日。
verses.e: So Solomon held the feast at that time , and all Israel with him , a great assembly , from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt , before the LORD our God , seven days and seven more days , even fourteen days .

verses.z: 第八日，王遣散眾民；他們都為王祝福。因見耶和華向他僕人大衛和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜樂，各歸各家去了。
verses.e: On the eighth day he sent the people away ; and they blessed the king , and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had shown to David his servant , and to Israel his people .

verses.z: 基路伯張着翅膀在[約]櫃之上，遮掩[約]櫃和抬櫃的槓。
verses.e: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark , and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above .

verses.z: 這槓甚長，槓頭在內殿前的聖所可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裏。
verses.e: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary , but they were not seen outside . They are there to this day .

verses.z: 約櫃裏惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及地後，耶和華與他們立約的時候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。
verses.e: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb , when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，並一切所願意建造的都完畢了，
verses.e: When Solomon had finished the building of the LORD's house , the king's house , and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do ,

verses.z: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，這兩所二十年才完畢了。
verses.e: At the end of twenty years , in which Solomon had built the two houses , the LORD's house and the king's house

verses.z: 泰爾王希蘭曾照所羅門所要的，資助他香柏木、松木，和金子；所羅門王就把加利利地的二十座城給了希蘭。
verses.e: ( now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees , and with gold , according to all his desire ) , King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .

verses.z: 希蘭從泰爾出來，察看所羅門給他的城邑，就不喜悅，
verses.e: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him ; and they didn't please him .

verses.z: 說：「我兄啊，你給我的是甚麼城邑呢？」他就給這城邑之地起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。
verses.e: He said , " What cities are these which you have given me , my brother ? " He called them the land of Cabul to this day .

verses.z: 希蘭給所羅門一百二十他連得金子。
verses.e: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold .

verses.z: 所羅門王挑取服苦的人，是為建造耶和華的殿、自己的宮、米羅、耶路撒冷的城牆、夏瑣、米吉多，並基色。
verses.e: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted : to build the LORD's house , his own house , Millo , Jerusalem's wall , Hazor , Megiddo , and Gezer .

verses.z: 先前埃及王法老上來攻取基色，用火焚燒，殺了城內居住的迦南人，將城賜給他女兒所羅門的妻作妝奩。
verses.e: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , taken Gezer , burned it with fire , killed the Canaanites who lived in the city , and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter , Solomon's wife .

verses.z: 所羅門建造基色、下伯‧和崙、
verses.e: Solomon built in the land Gezer , Beth Horon the lower ,

verses.z: 巴拉，並國中曠野裏的達莫，
verses.e: Baalath , Tamar in the wilderness ,

verses.z: 又建造所有的積貨城，並屯車和馬兵的城，與耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全國中所願建造的。
verses.e: all the storage cities that Solomon had , the cities for his chariots , the cities for his horsemen , and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and in all the land of his dominion .

verses.z: 耶和華就二次向所羅門顯現，如先前在基遍向他顯現一樣，
verses.e: The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time , as he had appeared to him at Gibeon .

verses.z: 至於國中所剩下不屬以色列人的亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
verses.e: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites , the Hittites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites , who were not of the children of Israel —

verses.z: 就是以色列人不能滅盡的，所羅門挑取他們的後裔作服苦的奴僕，直到今日。
verses.e: their children who were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy — of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day .

verses.z: 惟有以色列人，所羅門不使他們作奴僕，乃是作他的戰士、臣僕、統領、軍長、車兵長、馬兵長。
verses.e: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants ; but they were the men of war , his servants , his princes , his captains , and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen .

verses.z: 所羅門有五百五十督工的，監管工人。
verses.e: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon's work , who ruled over the people who labored in the work .

verses.z: 法老的女兒從大衛城搬到[所羅門]為她建造的宮裏。那時，所羅門才建造米羅。
verses.e: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of David's city to her house which Solomon had built for her . Then he built Millo .

verses.z: 所羅門每年三次在他為耶和華所築的壇上獻燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和華面前[的壇上]燒香。這樣，他建造殿的工程完畢了。
verses.e: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year , burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD . So he finished the house .

verses.z: 所羅門王在以東地紅海邊，靠近以祿的以旬‧迦別製造船隻。
verses.e: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber , which is beside Eloth , on the shore of the Red Sea , in the land of Edom .

verses.z: 希蘭差遣他的僕人，就是熟悉泛海的船家，與所羅門的僕人一同坐船航海。
verses.e: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants , sailors who had knowledge of the sea , with the servants of Solomon .

verses.z: 他們到了俄斐，從那裏得了四百二十他連得金子，運到所羅門王那裏。
verses.e: They came to Ophir , and fetched from there gold , four hundred and twenty talents , and brought it to King Solomon .

verses.z: 對他說：「你向我所禱告祈求的，我都應允了。我已將你所建的這殿分別為聖，使我的名永遠在其中；我的眼、我的心也必常在那裏。
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me . I have made this house holy , which you have built , to put my name there forever ; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually .

verses.z: 你若效法你父大衛，存誠實正直的心行在我面前，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，謹守我的律例典章，
verses.e: As for you , if you will walk before me as David your father walked , in integrity of heart and in uprightness , to do according to all that I have commanded you , and will keep my statutes and my ordinances ,

verses.z: 我就必堅固你的國位在以色列中，直到永遠，正如我應許你父大衛說：『你[的子孫]必不斷人坐以色列的國位。』
verses.e: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever , as I promised to David your father , saying , ' There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel . '

verses.z: 倘若你們和你們的子孫轉去不跟從我，不守我指示你們的誡命律例，去事奉敬拜別神，
verses.e: But if you turn away from following me , you or your children , and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you , but go and serve other gods and worship them ,

verses.z: 我就必將以色列人從我賜給他們的地上剪除，並且我為己名所分別為聖的殿也必捨棄不顧，使以色列人在萬民中作笑談，被譏誚。
verses.e: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them ; and I will cast this house , which I have made holy for my name , out of my sight ; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples .

verses.z: 這殿雖然甚高，將來經過的人必驚訝、嗤笑，說：『耶和華為何向這地和這殿如此行呢？』
verses.e: Though this house is so high , yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss ; and they will say , ' Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house ? '

verses.z: 人必回答說：『是因此地的人離棄領他們列祖出埃及地之耶和華－他們的上帝，去親近別神，事奉敬拜他，所以耶和華使這一切災禍臨到他們。』」
verses.e: and they will answer , ' Because they abandoned the LORD their God , who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt , and embraced other gods , and worshiped them , and served them . Therefore the LORD has brought all this evil on them . ' "

verses.z: 耶穌基督的使徒彼得寫信給那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亞細亞、庇推尼寄居的，
verses.e: Peter , an apostle of Jesus Christ , to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus , Galatia , Cappadocia , Asia , and Bithynia ,

verses.z: 論到這救恩，那預先說你們要得恩典的眾先知早已詳細地尋求考察，
verses.e: Concerning this salvation , the prophets sought and searched diligently . They prophesied of the grace that would come to you ,

verses.z: 就是考察在他們心裏基督的靈，預先證明基督受苦難，後來得榮耀，是指着甚麼時候，並怎樣的時候。
verses.e: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them .

verses.z: 他們得了啟示，知道他們所傳講的一切事，不是為自己，乃是為你們。那靠着從天上差來的聖靈傳福音給你們的人，現在將這些事報給你們；天使也願意詳細察看這些事。
verses.e: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves , but you , in these things , which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven ; which things angels desire to look into .

verses.z: 所以要約束你們的心，謹慎自守，專心盼望耶穌基督顯現的時候所帶來給你們的恩。
verses.e: Therefore prepare your minds for action . Be sober , and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ —

verses.z: 你們既作順命的兒女，就不要效法從前蒙昧無知的時候那放縱私慾的樣子。
verses.e: as children of obedience , not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance ,

verses.z: 那召你們的既是聖潔，你們在一切所行的事上也要聖潔。
verses.e: but just as he who called you is holy , you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior ,

verses.z: 因為[經上]記着說：「你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。」
verses.e: because it is written , " You shall be holy , for I am holy . "

verses.z: 你們既稱那不偏待人、按各人行為審判人的[主]為父，就當存敬畏的心度你們在世寄居的日子，
verses.e: If you call on him as Father , who without respect of persons judges according to each man's work , pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear ,

verses.z: 知道你們得贖，脫去你們祖宗所傳流虛妄的行為，不是憑着能壞的金銀等物，
verses.e: knowing that you were redeemed , not with corruptible things like silver or gold , from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers ,

verses.z: 乃是憑着基督的寶血，如同無瑕疵、無玷污的羔羊之血。
verses.e: but with precious blood , as of a lamb without blemish or spot , the blood of Christ ,

verses.z: 就是照父上帝的先見被揀選，藉着[聖]靈得成聖潔，以致順服耶穌基督，又蒙他血所灑的人。願恩惠、平安多多地加給你們。
verses.e: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father , in sanctification of the Spirit , that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood : Grace to you and peace be multiplied .

verses.z: 基督在創世以前是預先被[上帝]知道的，卻在這末世才為你們顯現。
verses.e: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world , but was revealed in this last age for your sake ,

verses.z: 你們也因着他，信那叫他從死裏復活、又給他榮耀的上帝，叫你們的信心和盼望都在於上帝。
verses.e: who through him are believers in God , who raised him from the dead and gave him glory , so that your faith and hope might be in God .

verses.z: 你們既因順從真理，潔淨了自己的心，以致愛弟兄沒有虛假，就當從心裏彼此切實相愛。
verses.e: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection , love one another from the heart fervently ,

verses.z: 你們蒙了重生，不是由於能壞的種子，乃是由於不能壞的種子，是藉着上帝活潑常存的道。
verses.e: having been born again , not of corruptible seed , but of incorruptible , through the word of God , which lives and remains forever .

verses.z: 因為凡有血氣的，盡都如草；他的美榮都像草上的花。草必枯乾，花必凋謝；
verses.e: For , " All flesh is like grass , and all of man's glory like the flower in the grass . The grass withers , and its flower falls ;

verses.z: 惟有主的道是永存的。所傳給你們的福音就是這道。
verses.e: but the Lord's word endures forever . " This is the word of Good News which was preached to you .

verses.z: 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父上帝！他曾照自己的大憐憫，藉耶穌基督從死裏復活，重生了我們，叫我們有活潑的盼望，
verses.e: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead ,

verses.z: 可以得着不能朽壞、不能玷污、不能衰殘、為你們存留在天上的基業。
verses.e: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn't fade away , reserved in Heaven for you ,

verses.z: 你們這因信蒙上帝能力保守的人，必能得着所預備、到末世要顯現的救恩。
verses.e: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time .

verses.z: 因此，你們是大有喜樂；但如今，在百般的試煉中暫時憂愁，
verses.e: In this you greatly rejoice , though now for a little while , if need be , you have been grieved in various trials ,

verses.z: 叫你們的信心既被試驗，就比那被火試驗仍然能壞的金子更顯寶貴，可以在耶穌基督顯現的時候得着稱讚、榮耀、尊貴。
verses.e: that the proof of your faith , which is more precious than gold that perishes , even though it is tested by fire , may be found to result in praise , glory , and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ —

verses.z: 你們雖然沒有見過他，卻是愛他；如今雖不得看見，卻因信他就有說不出來、滿有榮光的大喜樂；
verses.e: whom , not having known , you love . In him , though now you don't see him , yet believing , you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory ,

verses.z: 並且得着你們信心的果效，就是靈魂的救恩。
verses.e: receiving the result of your faith , the salvation of your souls .

verses.z: 所以，你們既除去一切的惡毒、詭詐，並假善、嫉妒，和一切毀謗的話，
verses.e: Putting away therefore all wickedness , all deceit , hypocrisies , envies , and all evil speaking ,

verses.z: 你們從前算不得子民，現在卻作了上帝的子民；從前未曾蒙憐恤，現在卻蒙了憐恤。
verses.e: In the past , you were not a people , but now are God's people , who had not obtained mercy , but now have obtained mercy .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們是客旅，是寄居的。我勸你們要禁戒肉體的私慾；這私慾是與靈魂爭戰的。
verses.e: Beloved , I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul ,

verses.z: 你們在外邦人中，應當品行端正，叫那些毀謗你們是作惡的，因看見你們的好行為，便在鑒察的日子歸榮耀給上帝。
verses.e: having good behavior among the nations , so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers , they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation .

verses.z: 你們為主的緣故，要順服人的一切制度，或是在上的君王，
verses.e: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake : whether to the king , as supreme ,

verses.z: 或是君王所派罰惡賞善的臣宰。
verses.e: or to governors , as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well .

verses.z: 因為上帝的旨意原是要你們行善，可以堵住那糊塗無知人的口。
verses.e: For this is the will of God , that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men .

verses.z: 你們雖是自由的，卻不可藉着自由遮蓋惡毒，總要作上帝的僕人。
verses.e: Live as free people , yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness , but as bondservants of God .

verses.z: 務要尊敬眾人，親愛教中的弟兄，敬畏上帝，尊敬君王。
verses.e: Honor all men . Love the brotherhood . Fear God . Honor the king .

verses.z: 你們作僕人的，凡事要存敬畏的心順服主人；不但順服那善良溫和的，就是那乖僻的也要順服。
verses.e: Servants , be in subjection to your masters with all respect , not only to the good and gentle , but also to the wicked .

verses.z: 倘若人為叫良心對得住上帝，就忍受冤屈的苦楚，這是可喜愛的。
verses.e: For it is commendable if someone endures pain , suffering unjustly , because of conscience toward God .

verses.z: 就要愛慕那純淨的靈奶，像才生的嬰孩愛慕奶一樣，叫你們因此漸長，以致得救。
verses.e: as newborn babies , long for the pure spiritual milk , that with it you may grow ,

verses.z: 你們若因犯罪受責打，能忍耐，有甚麼可誇的呢？但你們若因行善受苦，能忍耐，這在上帝看是可喜愛的。
verses.e: For what glory is it if , when you sin , you patiently endure beating ? But if when you do well , you patiently endure suffering , this is commendable with God .

verses.z: 你們蒙召原是為此；因基督也為你們受過苦，給你們留下榜樣，叫你們跟隨他的腳蹤行。
verses.e: For you were called to this , because Christ also suffered for us , leaving you an example , that you should follow his steps ,

verses.z: 他並沒有犯罪，口裏也沒有詭詐。
verses.e: who didn't sin , " neither was deceit found in his mouth . "

verses.z: 他被罵不還口；受害不說威嚇的話，只將自己交託那按公義審判人的[主]。
verses.e: When he was cursed , he didn't curse back . When he suffered , he didn't threaten , but committed himself to him who judges righteously .

verses.z: 他被掛在木頭上，親身擔當了我們的罪，使我們既然在罪上死，就得以在義上活。因他受的鞭傷，你們便得了醫治。
verses.e: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree , that we , having died to sins , might live to righteousness . You were healed by his wounds .

verses.z: 你們從前好像迷路的羊，如今卻歸到你們靈魂的牧人監督了。
verses.e: For you were going astray like sheep ; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls .

verses.z: 你們若嘗過主恩的滋味，[就必如此]。
verses.e: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious .

verses.z: 主乃活石，固然是被人所棄的，卻是被上帝所揀選、所寶貴的。
verses.e: Come to him , a living stone , rejected indeed by men , but chosen by God , precious .

verses.z: 你們來到主面前，也就像活石，被建造成為靈宮，作聖潔的祭司，藉着耶穌基督奉獻上帝所悅納的靈祭。
verses.e: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house , to be a holy priesthood , to offer up spiritual sacrifices , acceptable to God through Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 因為經上說：看哪，我把所揀選、所寶貴的房角石安放在錫安；信靠他的人必不至於羞愧。
verses.e: Because it is contained in Scripture , " Behold , I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone , chosen and precious . He who believes in him will not be disappointed . "

verses.z: 所以，他在你們信的人就為寶貴，在那不信的人[有話說]：匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。
verses.e: For you who believe therefore is the honor , but for those who are disobedient , " The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone , "

verses.z: 又說：作了絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石。他們既不順從，就在道理上絆跌；他們這樣絆跌也是預定的。
verses.e: and , " a stumbling stone and a rock of offense . " For they stumble at the word , being disobedient , to which also they were appointed .

verses.z: 惟有你們是被揀選的族類，是有君尊的祭司，是聖潔的國度，是屬[上帝]的子民，要叫你們宣揚那召你們出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
verses.e: But you are a chosen race , a royal priesthood , a holy nation , a people for God's own possession , that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light .

verses.z: 你們作妻子的要順服自己的丈夫；這樣，若有不信從道理的丈夫，他們雖然不聽道，也可以因妻子的品行被感化過來；
verses.e: In the same way , wives , be in subjection to your own husbands , so that , even if any don't obey the Word , they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word ,

verses.z: 因為[經上]說：人若愛生命，願享美福，須要禁止舌頭不出惡言，嘴唇不說詭詐的話；
verses.e: For , " He who would love life and see good days , let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit .

verses.z: 也要離惡行善，尋求和睦，一心追趕。
verses.e: Let him turn away from evil and do good . Let him seek peace and pursue it .

verses.z: 因為，主的眼看顧義人；主的耳聽他們的祈禱。惟有行惡的人，主向他們變臉。
verses.e: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous , and his ears open to their prayer ; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil . "

verses.z: 你們若是熱心行善，有誰害你們呢？
verses.e: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good ?

verses.z: 你們就是為義受苦，也是有福的。不要怕人的威嚇，也不要驚慌；
verses.e: But even if you should suffer for righteousness ' sake , you are blessed . " Don't fear what they fear , neither be troubled . "

verses.z: 只要心裏尊主基督為聖。有人問你們心中盼望的緣由，就要常作準備，以溫柔、敬畏的心回答各人；
verses.e: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts . Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you , with humility and fear ,

verses.z: 存着無虧的良心，叫你們在何事上被毀謗，就在何事上可以叫那誣賴你們在基督裏有好品行的人自覺羞愧。
verses.e: having a good conscience . Thus , while you are spoken against as evildoers , they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ .

verses.z: 上帝的旨意若是叫你們因行善受苦，總強如因行惡受苦。
verses.e: For it is better , if it is God's will , that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil .

verses.z: 因基督也曾一次為罪受苦，就是義的代替不義的，為要引我們到上帝面前。按着肉體說，他被治死；按着靈性說，他復活了。
verses.e: Because Christ also suffered for sins once , the righteous for the unrighteous , that he might bring you to God , being put to death in the flesh , but made alive in the Spirit ,

verses.z: 他藉這靈曾去傳道給那些在監獄裏的靈聽，
verses.e: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison ,

verses.z: 這正是因看見你們有貞潔的品行和敬畏的心。
verses.e: seeing your pure behavior in fear .

verses.z: 就是那從前在挪亞預備方舟、上帝容忍等待的時候，不信從的人。當時進入方舟，藉着水得救的不多，只有八個人。
verses.e: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built . In it , few , that is , eight souls , were saved through water .

verses.z: 這水所表明的洗禮，現在藉着耶穌基督復活也拯救你們；[這洗禮]本不在乎除掉肉體的污穢，只求在上帝面前有無虧的良心。
verses.e: This is a symbol of baptism , which now saves you — not the putting away of the filth of the flesh , but the answer of a good conscience toward God — through the resurrection of Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 耶穌已經進入天堂，在上帝的右邊；眾天使和有權柄的，並有能力的，都服從了他。
verses.e: who is at the right hand of God , having gone into heaven , angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him .

verses.z: 你們不要以外面的辮頭髮，戴金飾，穿美衣為妝飾，
verses.e: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair , and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing ,

verses.z: 只要以裏面存着長久溫柔、安靜的心為妝飾；這在上帝面前是極寶貴的。
verses.e: but from the hidden person of the heart , in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit , which is very precious in God's sight .

verses.z: 因為古時仰賴上帝的聖潔婦人正是以此為妝飾，順服自己的丈夫，
verses.e: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves , being in subjection to their own husbands .

verses.z: 就如撒拉聽從亞伯拉罕，稱他為主。你們若行善，不因恐嚇而害怕，便是撒拉的女兒了。
verses.e: So Sarah obeyed Abraham , calling him lord , whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror .

verses.z: 你們作丈夫的也要按情理和[妻子]同住；因她比你軟弱，與你一同承受生命之恩的，所以要敬重她。這樣，便叫你們的禱告沒有阻礙。
verses.e: You husbands , in the same way , live with your wives according to knowledge , giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel , as also being joint heirs of the grace of life , that your prayers may not be hindered .

verses.z: 總而言之，你們都要同心，彼此體恤，相愛如弟兄，存慈憐謙卑的心。
verses.e: Finally , all of you be like-minded , compassionate , loving as brothers , tenderhearted , courteous ,

verses.z: 不以惡報惡，以辱罵還辱罵，倒要祝福；因你們是為此蒙召，好叫你們承受福氣。
verses.e: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult ; but instead blessing , knowing that you were called to this , that you may inherit a blessing .

verses.z: 基督既在肉身受苦，你們也當將這樣的心志作為兵器，因為在肉身受過苦的，就已經與罪斷絕了。
verses.e: Therefore , since Christ suffered for us in the flesh , arm yourselves also with the same mind ; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin ,

verses.z: 各人要照所得的恩賜彼此服事，作上帝百般恩賜的好管家。
verses.e: As each has received a gift , employ it in serving one another , as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms .

verses.z: 若有講道的，要按着上帝的聖言講；若有服事[人]的，要按着上帝所賜的力量服事，叫上帝在凡事上因耶穌基督得榮耀。[原來]榮耀、權能都是他的，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: If anyone speaks , let it be as it were the very words of God . If anyone serves , let it be as of the strength which God supplies , that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ , to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，有火煉的試驗臨到你們，不要以為奇怪（似乎是遭遇非常的事），
verses.e: Beloved , don't be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you , as though a strange thing happened to you .

verses.z: 倒要歡喜；因為你們是與基督一同受苦，使你們在他榮耀顯現的時候，也可以歡喜快樂。
verses.e: But because you are partakers of Christ's sufferings , rejoice , that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy .

verses.z: 你們若為基督的名受辱罵，便是有福的；因為上帝榮耀的靈常住在你們身上。
verses.e: If you are insulted for the name of Christ , you are blessed , because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you . On their part he is blasphemed , but on your part he is glorified .

verses.z: 你們中間卻不可有人因為殺人、偷竊、作惡、好管閒事而受苦。
verses.e: But let none of you suffer as a murderer , or a thief , or an evil doer , or a meddler in other men's matters .

verses.z: 若為作基督徒受苦，卻不要羞恥，倒要因這名歸榮耀給上帝。
verses.e: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian , let him not be ashamed ; but let him glorify God in this matter .

verses.z: 因為時候到了，審判要從上帝的家起首。若是先從我們起首，那不信從上帝福音的人將有何等的結局呢？
verses.e: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God . If it begins first with us , what will happen to those who don't obey the Good News of God ?

verses.z: 若是義人僅僅得救，那不虔敬和犯罪的人將有何地可站呢？
verses.e: " If it is hard for the righteous to be saved , what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner ? "

verses.z: 所以，那照上帝旨意受苦的人要一心為善，將自己靈魂交與那信實的造化之主。
verses.e: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him , as to a faithful Creator .

verses.z: 你們存這樣的心，從今以後就可以不從人的情慾，只從上帝的旨意在世度餘下的光陰。
verses.e: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men , but for the will of God .

verses.z: 因為往日隨從外邦人的心意行邪淫、惡慾、醉酒、荒宴、群飲，並可惡拜偶像的事，時候已經夠了。
verses.e: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles , and having walked in lewdness , lusts , drunken binges , orgies , carousings , and abominable idolatries .

verses.z: 他們在這些事上，見你們不與他們同奔那放蕩無度的路，就以為怪，毀謗你們。
verses.e: They think it is strange that you don't run with them into the same excess of riot , speaking evil of you .

verses.z: 他們必在那將要審判活人死人的主面前交帳。
verses.e: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead .

verses.z: 為此，就是死人也曾有福音傳給他們，要叫他們的肉體按着人受審判，他們的靈性卻靠上帝活着。
verses.e: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead , that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh , but live as to God in the spirit .

verses.z: 萬物的結局近了。所以，你們要謹慎自守，警醒禱告。
verses.e: But the end of all things is near . Therefore be of sound mind , self-controlled , and sober in prayer .

verses.z: 最要緊的是彼此切實相愛，因為愛能遮掩許多的罪。
verses.e: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves , for love covers a multitude of sins .

verses.z: 你們要互相款待，不發怨言。
verses.e: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling .

verses.z: 我這作長老、作基督受苦的見證、同享後來所要顯現之榮耀的，勸你們中間與我同作長老的人：
verses.e: Therefore I exhort the elders among you , as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ , and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed :

verses.z: 那賜諸般恩典的上帝曾在基督裏召你們，得享他永遠的榮耀，等你們暫受苦難之後，必要親自成全你們，堅固你們，賜力量給你們。
verses.e: But may the God of all grace , who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus , after you have suffered a little while , perfect , establish , strengthen , and settle you .

verses.z: 願權能歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 我略略地寫了這信，託我所看為忠心的兄弟西拉轉交你們，勸勉你們，又證明這恩是上帝的真恩。你們務要在這恩上站立得住。
verses.e: Through Silvanus , our faithful brother , as I consider him , I have written to you briefly , exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand .

verses.z: 在巴比倫與你們同蒙揀選的教會問你們安。我兒子馬可也問你們安。
verses.e: She who is in Babylon , chosen together with you , greets you . So does Mark , my son .

verses.z: 你們要用愛心彼此親嘴問安。願平安歸與你們凡在基督裏的人！
verses.e: Greet one another with a kiss of love . Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus . Amen .

verses.z: 務要牧養在你們中間上帝的群羊，按着上帝[旨意]照管他們；不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心；也不是因為貪財，乃是出於樂意；
verses.e: shepherd the flock of God which is among you , exercising the oversight , not under compulsion , but voluntarily ; not for dishonest gain , but willingly ;

verses.z: 也不是轄制所託付你們的，乃是作群羊的榜樣。
verses.e: not as lording it over those entrusted to you , but making yourselves examples to the flock .

verses.z: 到了牧長顯現的時候，你們必得那永不衰殘的榮耀冠冕。
verses.e: When the chief Shepherd is revealed , you will receive the crown of glory that doesn't fade away .

verses.z: 你們年幼的，也要順服年長的。就是你們眾人也都要以謙卑束腰，彼此順服；因為上帝阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
verses.e: Likewise , you younger ones , be subject to the elder . Yes , all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another ; for " God resists the proud , but gives grace to the humble . "

verses.z: 所以，你們要自卑，服在上帝大能的手下，到了時候，他必叫你們升高。
verses.e: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time ,

verses.z: 你們要將一切的憂慮卸給上帝，因為他顧念你們。
verses.e: casting all your worries on him , because he cares for you .

verses.z: 務要謹守，警醒。[因為]你們的仇敵魔鬼，如同吼叫的獅子，遍地遊行，尋找可吞吃的人。
verses.e: Be sober and self-controlled . Be watchful . Your adversary , the devil , walks around like a roaring lion , seeking whom he may devour .

verses.z: 你們要用堅固的信心抵擋他，因為知道你們在世上的眾弟兄也是經歷這樣的苦難。
verses.e: Withstand him steadfast in your faith , knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings .

verses.z: 以法蓮山地的拉瑪‧瑣非有一個以法蓮人，名叫以利加拿，是蘇弗的玄孫，託戶的曾孫，以利戶的孫子，耶羅罕的兒子。
verses.e: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim , of the hill country of Ephraim , and his name was Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Elihu , the son of Tohu , the son of Zuph , an Ephraimite .

verses.z: 哈拿心裏愁苦，就痛痛哭泣，祈禱耶和華，
verses.e: She was in bitterness of soul , and prayed to the LORD , weeping bitterly .

verses.z: 許願說：「萬軍之耶和華啊，你若垂顧婢女的苦情，眷念不忘婢女，賜我一個兒子，我必使他終身歸與耶和華，不用剃頭刀剃他的頭。」
verses.e: She vowed a vow , and said , " LORD of Armies , if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me , and not forget your servant , but will give to your servant a boy , then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life , and no razor shall come on his head . "

verses.z: 哈拿在耶和華面前不住地祈禱，以利定睛看她的嘴。（
verses.e: As she continued praying before the LORD , Eli saw her mouth .

verses.z: 原來哈拿心中默禱，只動嘴唇，不出聲音，因此以利以為她喝醉了。）
verses.e: Now Hannah spoke in her heart . Only her lips moved , but her voice was not heard . Therefore Eli thought she was drunk .

verses.z: 以利對她說：「你要醉到幾時呢？你不應該喝酒。」
verses.e: Eli said to her , " How long will you be drunk ? Get rid of your wine ! "

verses.z: 哈拿回答說：「主啊，不是這樣。我是心裏愁苦的婦人，清酒濃酒都沒有喝，但在耶和華面前傾心吐意。
verses.e: Hannah answered , " No , my lord , I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit . I have not been drinking wine or strong drink , but I poured out my soul before the LORD .

verses.z: 不要將婢女看作不正經的女子。我因被人激動，愁苦太多，所以祈求到如今。」
verses.e: Don't consider your servant a wicked woman ; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation . "

verses.z: 以利說：「你可以平平安安地回去。願以色列的上帝允准你向他所求的！」
verses.e: Then Eli answered , " Go in peace ; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him . "

verses.z: 哈拿說：「願婢女在你眼前蒙恩。」於是婦人走去吃飯，面上再不帶愁容了。
verses.e: She said , " Let your servant find favor in your sight . " So the woman went her way and ate ; and her facial expression wasn't sad any more .

verses.z: 次日清早，他們起來，在耶和華面前敬拜，就回拉瑪。到了家裏，以利加拿和妻哈拿同房，耶和華顧念哈拿，
verses.e: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped the LORD , then returned and came to their house to Ramah . Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife ; and the LORD remembered her .

verses.z: 他有兩個妻：一名哈拿，一名毗尼拿。毗尼拿有兒女，哈拿沒有兒女。
verses.e: He had two wives . The name of one was Hannah , and the name of the other Peninnah . Peninnah had children , but Hannah had no children .

verses.z: 哈拿就懷孕。日期滿足，生了一個兒子，給他起名叫撒母耳，[說]：「這是我從耶和華那裏求來的。」
verses.e: When the time had come , Hannah conceived , and bore a son ; and she named him Samuel , saying , " Because I have asked him of the LORD . "

verses.z: 以利加拿和他全家都上示羅去，要向耶和華獻年祭，並還所許的願。
verses.e: The man Elkanah , and all his house , went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow .

verses.z: 哈拿卻沒有上去，對丈夫說：「等孩子斷了奶，我便帶他上去朝見耶和華，使他永遠住在那裏。」
verses.e: But Hannah didn't go up , for she said to her husband , " Not until the child is weaned ; then I will bring him , that he may appear before the LORD , and stay there forever . "

verses.z: 她丈夫以利加拿說：「就隨你的意行吧！可以等兒子斷了奶。但願耶和華應驗他的話。」於是婦人在家裏乳養兒子，直到斷了奶；
verses.e: Elkanah her husband said to her , " Do what seems good to you . Wait until you have weaned him ; only may the LORD establish his word . " So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him .

verses.z: 既斷了奶，就把孩子帶上示羅，到了耶和華的殿；又帶了三隻公牛，一伊法細麵，一皮袋酒。（那時，孩子還小。）
verses.e: When she had weaned him , she took him up with her , with three bulls , and one ephah of meal , and a container of wine , and brought him to the LORD's house in Shiloh . The child was young .

verses.z: 宰了一隻公牛，就領孩子到以利面前。
verses.e: They killed the bull , and brought the child to Eli .

verses.z: 婦人說：「主啊，我敢在你面前起誓，從前在你這裏站着祈求耶和華的那婦人，就是我。
verses.e: She said , " Oh , my lord , as your soul lives , my lord , I am the woman who stood by you here , praying to the LORD .

verses.z: 我祈求為要得這孩子；耶和華已將我所求的賜給我了。
verses.e: I prayed for this child , and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him .

verses.z: 所以，我將這孩子歸與耶和華，使他終身歸與耶和華。」於是在那裏敬拜耶和華。
verses.e: Therefore I have also given him to the LORD . As long as he lives he is given to the LORD . " He worshiped the LORD there .

verses.z: 這人每年從本城上到示羅，敬拜祭祀萬軍之耶和華；在那裏有以利的兩個兒子何弗尼、非尼哈當耶和華的祭司。
verses.e: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of Armies in Shiloh . The two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , priests to the LORD , were there .

verses.z: 以利加拿每逢獻祭的日子，將[祭肉]分給他的妻毗尼拿和毗尼拿所生的兒女；
verses.e: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed , he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters ;

verses.z: 給哈拿的卻是雙分，因為他愛哈拿。無奈耶和華不使哈拿生育。
verses.e: but he gave a double portion to Hannah , for he loved Hannah , but the LORD had shut up her womb .

verses.z: 毗尼拿見耶和華不使哈拿生育，就作她的對頭，大大激動她，要使她生氣。
verses.e: Her rival provoked her severely , to irritate her , because the LORD had shut up her womb .

verses.z: 每年上到耶和華殿的時候，以利加拿都以雙分給哈拿；毗尼拿仍是激動她，以致她哭泣不吃飯。
verses.e: So year by year , when she went up to the LORD's house , her rival provoked her . Therefore she wept , and didn't eat .

verses.z: 她丈夫以利加拿對她說：「哈拿啊，你為何哭泣，不吃飯，心裏愁悶呢？有我不比十個兒子還好嗎？」
verses.e: Elkanah her husband said to her , " Hannah , why do you weep ? Why don't you eat ? Why is your heart grieved ? Am I not better to you than ten sons ? "

verses.z: 他們在示羅吃喝完了，哈拿就站起來。祭司以利在耶和華殿的門框旁邊，坐在自己的位上。
verses.e: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh . Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of the LORD's temple .

verses.z: 撒母耳拿瓶膏油倒在掃羅的頭上，與他親嘴，說：「這不是耶和華膏你作他產業的君嗎？
verses.e: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head , then kissed him and said , " Hasn't the LORD anointed you to be prince over his inheritance ?

verses.z: 掃羅到了那山，有一班先知遇見他，上帝的靈大大感動他，他就在先知中受感說話。
verses.e: When they came there to the hill , behold , a band of prophets met him ; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him , and he prophesied among them .

verses.z: 素來認識掃羅的，看見他和先知一同受感說話，就彼此說：「基士的兒子遇見甚麼了？掃羅也列在先知中嗎？」
verses.e: When all who knew him before saw that , behold , he prophesied with the prophets , then the people said to one another , " What is this that has come to the son of Kish ? Is Saul also among the prophets ? "

verses.z: 那地方有一個人說：「這些人的父親是誰呢？」此後有句俗語說：「掃羅也列在先知中嗎？」
verses.e: One from the same place answered , " Who is their father ? " Therefore it became a proverb , " Is Saul also among the prophets ? "

verses.z: 掃羅受感說話已畢，就上邱壇去了。
verses.e: When he had finished prophesying , he came to the high place .

verses.z: 掃羅的叔叔問掃羅和他僕人說：「你們往哪裏去了？」回答說：「找驢去了。我們見沒有驢，就到了撒母耳那裏。」
verses.e: Saul's uncle said to him and to his servant , " Where did you go ? " He said , " To seek the donkeys . When we saw that they were not found , we came to Samuel . "

verses.z: 掃羅的叔叔說：「請將撒母耳向你們所說的話告訴我。」
verses.e: Saul's uncle said , " Please tell me what Samuel said to you . "

verses.z: 掃羅對他叔叔說：「他明明地告訴我們驢已經找着了。」至於撒母耳所說的國事，掃羅卻沒有告訴叔叔。
verses.e: Saul said to his uncle , " He told us plainly that the donkeys were found . " But concerning the matter of the kingdom , of which Samuel spoke , he didn't tell him .

verses.z: 撒母耳將百姓招聚到米斯巴耶和華那裏，
verses.e: Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpah ;

verses.z: 對他們說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『我領你們以色列人出埃及，救你們脫離埃及人的手，又救你們脫離欺壓你們各國之人的手。』
verses.e: and he said to the children of Israel , " The LORD , the God of Israel , says ' I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you . '

verses.z: 你們今日卻厭棄了救你們脫離一切災難的上帝，說：『求你立一個王治理我們。』現在你們應當按着支派、宗族都站在耶和華面前。」
verses.e: But you have today rejected your God , who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses ; and you have said to him , ' No ! Set a king over us ! ' Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands . "

verses.z: 你今日與我離別之後，在便雅憫境內的泄撒，靠近拉結的墳墓，要遇見兩個人。他們必對你說：『你去找的那幾頭驢已經找着了。現在你父親不為驢掛心，反為你擔憂，說：我為兒子怎麼才好呢？』
verses.e: When you have departed from me today , then you will find two men by Rachel's tomb , on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah . They will tell you , ' The donkeys which you went to look for have been found ; and behold , your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you , saying , " What shall I do for my son ? " '

verses.z: 於是，撒母耳使以色列眾支派近前來掣籤，就掣出便雅憫支派來；
verses.e: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near , and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen .

verses.z: 又使便雅憫支派按着宗族近前來，就掣出瑪特利族，從其中又掣出基士的兒子掃羅。眾人尋找他卻尋不着，
verses.e: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen . Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen ; but when they looked for him , he could not be found .

verses.z: 就問耶和華說：「那人到這裏來了沒有？」耶和華說：「他藏在器具中了。」
verses.e: Therefore they asked of the LORD further , " Is there yet a man to come here ? " The LORD answered , " Behold , he has hidden himself among the baggage . "

verses.z: 眾人就跑去從那裏領出他來。他站在百姓中間，身體比眾民高過一頭。
verses.e: They ran and got him there . When he stood among the people , he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward .

verses.z: 撒母耳對眾民說：「你們看耶和華所揀選的人，眾民中有可比他的嗎？」眾民就大聲歡呼說：「願王萬歲！」
verses.e: Samuel said to all the people , " Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen , that there is no one like him among all the people ? " All the people shouted and said , " Long live the king ! "

verses.z: 撒母耳將國法對百姓說明，又記在書上，放在耶和華面前，然後遣散眾民，各回各家去了。
verses.e: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom , and wrote it in a book and laid it up before the LORD . Samuel sent all the people away , every man to his house .

verses.z: 掃羅往基比亞回家去，有上帝感動的一群人跟隨他。
verses.e: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah ; and the army went with him , whose hearts God had touched .

verses.z: 但有些匪徒說：「這人怎能救我們呢？」就藐視他，沒有送他禮物；掃羅卻不理會。
verses.e: But certain worthless fellows said , " How could this man save us ? " They despised him , and brought him no tribute . But he held his peace .

verses.z: 你從那裏往前行，到了他泊的橡樹那裏，必遇見三個往伯特利去拜上帝的人：一個帶着三隻山羊羔，一個帶着三個餅，一個帶着一皮袋酒。
verses.e: " Then you will go on forward from there , and you will come to the oak of Tabor . Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel : one carrying three young goats , and another carrying three loaves of bread , and another carrying a container of wine .

verses.z: 他們必問你安，給你兩個餅，你就從他們手中接過來。
verses.e: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread , which you shall receive from their hand .

verses.z: 此後你到上帝的山，在那裏有非利士人的防兵。你到了城的時候，必遇見一班先知從邱壇下來，前面有鼓瑟的、擊鼓的、吹笛的、彈琴的，他們都受感說話。
verses.e: " After that you will come to the hill of God , where the garrison of the Philistines is ; and it will happen , when you have come there to the city , that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute , a tambourine , a pipe , and a harp before them ; and they will be prophesying .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈必大大感動你，你就與他們一同受感說話；你要變為新人。
verses.e: Then the LORD's Spirit will come mightily on you , then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man .

verses.z: 這兆頭臨到你，你就可以趁時而做，因為上帝與你同在。
verses.e: Let it be , when these signs have come to you , that you do what is appropriate for the occasion ; for God is with you .

verses.z: 你當在我以先下到吉甲，我也必下到那裏獻燔祭和平安祭。你要等候七日，等我到了那裏，指示你當行的事。」
verses.e: " Go down ahead of me to Gilgal ; and behold , I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings . Wait seven days , until I come to you and show you what you are to do . "

verses.z: 掃羅轉身離別撒母耳，上帝就賜他一個新心。當日這一切兆頭都應驗了。
verses.e: It was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart ; and all those signs happened that day .

verses.z: 亞捫人[的王]拿轄上來，對着基列‧雅比安營。雅比眾人對拿轄說：「你與我們立約，我們就服事你。」
verses.e: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead ; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash , " Make a covenant with us , and we will serve you . "

verses.z: 於是雅比人對亞捫人說：「明日我們出來歸順你們，你們可以隨意待我們。」
verses.e: Therefore the men of Jabesh said , " Tomorrow we will come out to you , and you shall do with us all that seems good to you . "

verses.z: 第二日，掃羅將百姓分為三隊，在晨更的時候入了亞捫人的營，擊殺他們直到太陽近午，剩下的人都逃散，沒有二人同在一處的。
verses.e: On the next day , Saul put the people in three companies ; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning watch , and struck the Ammonites until the heat of the day . Those who remained were scattered , so that no two of them were left together .

verses.z: 百姓對撒母耳說：「那說『掃羅豈能管理我們』的是誰呢？可以將他交出來，我們好殺死他。」
verses.e: The people said to Samuel , " Who is he who said , ' Shall Saul reign over us ? ' Bring those men , that we may put them to death ! "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「今日耶和華在以色列中施行拯救，所以不可殺人。」
verses.e: Saul said , " No man shall be put to death today ; for today the LORD has rescued Israel . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對百姓說：「我們要往吉甲去，在那裏立國。」
verses.e: Then Samuel said to the people , " Come ! Let's go to Gilgal , and renew the kingdom there . "

verses.z: 眾百姓就到了吉甲那裏，在耶和華面前立掃羅為王，又在耶和華面前獻平安祭。掃羅和以色列眾人大大歡喜。
verses.e: All the people went to Gilgal ; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal . There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly .

verses.z: 亞捫人拿轄說：「你們若由我剜出你們各人的右眼，以此凌辱以色列眾人，我就與你們立約。」
verses.e: Nahash the Ammonite said to them , " On this condition I will make it with you , that all your right eyes be gouged out . I will make this dishonor all Israel . "

verses.z: 雅比的長老對他說：「求你寬容我們七日，等我們打發人往以色列的全境去；若沒有人救我們，我們就出來歸順你。」
verses.e: The elders of Jabesh said to him , " Give us seven days , that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel ; and then , if there is no one to save us , we will come out to you . "

verses.z: 使者到了掃羅住的基比亞，將這話說給百姓聽，百姓就都放聲而哭。
verses.e: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul , and spoke these words in the ears of the people , then all the people lifted up their voice and wept .

verses.z: 掃羅正從田間趕牛回來，問說：「百姓為甚麼哭呢？」眾人將雅比人的話告訴他。
verses.e: Behold , Saul came following the oxen out of the field ; and Saul said , " What ails the people that they weep ? " They told him the words of the men of Jabesh .

verses.z: 掃羅聽見這話，就被上帝的靈大大感動，甚是發怒。
verses.e: God's Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words , and his anger burned hot .

verses.z: 他將一對牛切成塊子，託付使者傳送以色列的全境，說：「凡不出來跟隨掃羅和撒母耳的，也必這樣切開他的牛。」於是耶和華使百姓懼怕，他們就都出來，如同一人。
verses.e: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces , then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers , saying , " Whoever doesn't come out after Saul and after Samuel , so shall it be done to his oxen . " The dread of the LORD fell on the people , and they came out as one man .

verses.z: 掃羅在比色數點他們：以色列人有三十萬，猶大人有三萬。
verses.e: He counted them in Bezek ; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .

verses.z: 眾人對那使者說：「你們要回覆基列‧雅比人說，明日太陽近午的時候，你們必得解救。」使者回去告訴雅比人，他們就歡喜了。
verses.e: They said to the messengers who came , " Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead , ' Tomorrow , by the time the sun is hot , you will be rescued . ' " The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh ; and they were glad .

verses.z: 撒母耳對以色列眾人說：「你們向我所求的，我已應允了，為你們立了一個王；
verses.e: Samuel said to all Israel , " Behold , I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me , and have made a king over you .

verses.z: 他們就呼求耶和華說：『我們離棄耶和華，事奉巴力和亞斯她錄，是有罪了。現在求你救我們脫離仇敵的手，我們必事奉你。』
verses.e: They cried to the LORD , and said , ' We have sinned , because we have forsaken the LORD and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth ; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies , and we will serve you . '

verses.z: 耶和華就差遣耶路‧巴力、比但、耶弗他、撒母耳救你們脫離四圍仇敵的手，你們才安然居住。
verses.e: The LORD sent Jerubbaal , Bedan , Jephthah , and Samuel , and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side ; and you lived in safety .

verses.z: 你們見亞捫人的王拿轄來攻擊你們，就對我說：『我們定要一個王治理我們。』其實耶和華－你們的上帝是你們的王。
verses.e: " When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you , you said to me , ' No , but a king shall reign over us , ' when the LORD your God was your king .

verses.z: 現在，你們所求所選的王在這裏。看哪，耶和華已經為你們立王了。
verses.e: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen and whom you have asked for . Behold , the LORD has set a king over you .

verses.z: 你們若敬畏耶和華，事奉他，聽從他的話，不違背他的命令，你們和治理你們的王也都順從耶和華－你們的上帝就好了。
verses.e: If you will fear the LORD , and serve him , and listen to his voice , and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD , then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of the LORD your God .

verses.z: 倘若不聽從耶和華的話，違背他的命令，耶和華的手必攻擊你們，像從前攻擊你們列祖一樣。
verses.e: But if you will not listen to the LORD's voice , but rebel against the commandment of the LORD , then the LORD's hand will be against you , as it was against your fathers .

verses.z: 現在你們要站住，看耶和華在你們眼前要行一件大事。
verses.e: " Now therefore stand still and see this great thing , which the LORD will do before your eyes .

verses.z: 這不是割麥子的時候嗎？我求告耶和華，他必打雷降雨，使你們又知道又看出，你們求立王的事是在耶和華面前犯大罪了。」
verses.e: Isn't it wheat harvest today ? I will call to the LORD , that he may send thunder and rain ; and you will know and see that your wickedness is great , which you have done in the LORD's sight , in asking for a king . "

verses.z: 於是撒母耳求告耶和華，耶和華就在這日打雷降雨，眾民便甚懼怕耶和華和撒母耳。
verses.e: So Samuel called to the LORD , and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day . Then all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel .

verses.z: 眾民對撒母耳說：「求你為僕人們禱告耶和華－你的上帝，免得我們死亡；因為我們求立王的事正是罪上加罪了。」
verses.e: All the people said to Samuel , " Pray for your servants to the LORD your God , that we not die ; for we have added to all our sins this evil , to ask for a king . "

verses.z: 現在有這王在你們前面行。我已年老髮白，我的兒子都在你們這裏。我從幼年直到今日都在你們前面行。
verses.e: Now , behold , the king walks before you . I am old and gray-headed . Behold , my sons are with you . I have walked before you from my youth to this day .

verses.z: 撒母耳對百姓說：「不要懼怕！你們雖然行了這惡，卻不要偏離耶和華，只要盡心事奉他。
verses.e: Samuel said to the people , " Don't be afraid . You have indeed done all this evil ; yet don't turn away from following the LORD , but serve the LORD with all your heart .

verses.z: 若偏離[耶和華]去順從那不能救人的虛神是無益的。
verses.e: Don't turn away to go after vain things which can't profit or deliver , for they are vain .

verses.z: 耶和華既喜悅選你們作他的子民，就必因他的大名不撇棄你們。
verses.e: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name's sake , because it has pleased the LORD to make you a people for himself .

verses.z: 至於我，斷不停止為你們禱告，以致得罪耶和華。我必以善道正路指教你們。
verses.e: Moreover , as for me , far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you ; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way .

verses.z: 只要你們敬畏耶和華，誠誠實實地盡心事奉他，想念他向你們所行的事何等大。
verses.e: Only fear the LORD , and serve him in truth with all your heart ; for consider what great things he has done for you .

verses.z: 你們若仍然作惡，你們和你們的王必一同滅亡。」
verses.e: But if you keep doing evil , you will be consumed , both you and your king . "

verses.z: 我在這裏，你們要在耶和華和他的受膏者面前給我作見證。我奪過誰的牛，搶過誰的驢，欺負過誰，虐待過誰，從誰手裏受過賄賂因而眼瞎呢？若有，我必償還。」
verses.e: Here I am . Witness against me before the LORD and before his anointed . Whose ox have I taken ? Whose donkey have I taken ? Whom have I defrauded ? Whom have I oppressed ? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes ? I will restore it to you . "

verses.z: 眾人說：「你未曾欺負我們，虐待我們，也未曾從誰手裏受過甚麼。」
verses.e: They said , " You have not defrauded us , nor oppressed us , neither have you taken anything from anyone's hand . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對他們說：「你們在我手裏沒有找着甚麼，有耶和華和他的受膏者今日為證。」他們說：「願他為證。」
verses.e: He said to them , " The LORD is witness against you , and his anointed is witness today , that you have not found anything in my hand . " They said , " He is witness . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對百姓說：「從前立摩西、亞倫，又領你們列祖出埃及地的是耶和華。
verses.e: Samuel said to the people , " It is the LORD who appointed Moses and Aaron , and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 現在你們要站住，等我在耶和華面前對你們講論耶和華向你們和你們列祖所行一切公義的事。
verses.e: Now therefore stand still , that I may plead with you before the LORD concerning all the righteous acts of the LORD , which he did to you and to your fathers .

verses.z: 從前雅各到了埃及，後來你們列祖呼求耶和華，耶和華就差遣摩西、亞倫領你們列祖出埃及，使他們在這地方居住。
verses.e: " When Jacob had come into Egypt , and your fathers cried to the LORD , then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron , who brought your fathers out of Egypt , and made them to dwell in this place .

verses.z: 他們卻忘記耶和華－他們的上帝，他就把他們付與夏瑣將軍西西拉的手裏，和非利士人並摩押王的手裏。於是這些人常來攻擊他們。
verses.e: But they forgot the LORD their God ; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera , captain of the army of Hazor , and into the hand of the Philistines , and into the hand of the king of Moab ; and they fought against them .

verses.z: 掃羅登基年[四十歲]；作以色列王二年的時候，
verses.e: Saul was thirty years old when he became king , and he reigned over Israel forty-two years .

verses.z: 剛獻完燔祭，撒母耳就到了。掃羅出去迎接他，要問他好。
verses.e: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering , behold , Samuel came ; and Saul went out to meet him , that he might greet him .

verses.z: 撒母耳說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」掃羅說：「因為我見百姓離開我散去，你也不照所定的日期來到，而且非利士人聚集在密抹。
verses.e: Samuel said , " What have you done ? " Saul said , " Because I saw that the people were scattered from me , and that you didn't come within the days appointed , and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash ,

verses.z: 所以我心裏說：恐怕我沒有禱告耶和華。非利士人下到吉甲攻擊我，我就勉強獻上燔祭。」
verses.e: therefore I said , ' Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal , and I haven't entreated the favor of the LORD . ' I forced myself therefore , and offered the burnt offering . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「你做了糊塗事了，沒有遵守耶和華－你上帝所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和華必在以色列中堅立你的王位，直到永遠。
verses.e: Samuel said to Saul , " You have done foolishly . You have not kept the commandment of the LORD your God , which he commanded you ; for now the LORD would have established your kingdom on Israel forever .

verses.z: 現在你的王位必不長久。耶和華已經尋着一個合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因為你沒有遵守耶和華所吩咐你的。」
verses.e: But now your kingdom will not continue . The LORD has sought for himself a man after his own heart , and the LORD has appointed him to be prince over his people , because you have not kept that which the LORD commanded you . "

verses.z: 撒母耳就起來，從吉甲上到便雅憫的基比亞。掃羅數點跟隨他的，約有六百人。
verses.e: Samuel arose , and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin . Saul counted the people who were present with him , about six hundred men .

verses.z: 掃羅和他兒子約拿單，並跟隨他們的人，都住在便雅憫的迦巴；但非利士人安營在密抹。
verses.e: Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people who were present with them , stayed in Geba of Benjamin ; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .

verses.z: 有掠兵從非利士營中出來，分為三隊：一隊往俄弗拉向書亞地去，
verses.e: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies : one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah , to the land of Shual ;

verses.z: 一隊往伯‧和崙去，一隊往洗波音谷對面的地境向曠野去。
verses.e: another company turned the way to Beth Horon ; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .

verses.z: 那時，以色列全地沒有一個鐵匠；因為非利士人說，恐怕希伯來人製造刀槍。
verses.e: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel , for the Philistines said , " Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears " ;

verses.z: 就從以色列中揀選了三千人：二千跟隨掃羅在密抹和伯特利山，一千跟隨約拿單在便雅憫的基比亞；其餘的人掃羅都打發各回各家去了。
verses.e: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel , of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel , and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin . He sent the rest of the people to their own tents .

verses.z: 以色列人要磨鋤、犂、斧、鏟，就下到非利士人那裏去磨。
verses.e: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines , each man to sharpen his own plowshare , mattock , ax , and sickle .

verses.z: 但有銼可以銼鏟、犂、三齒叉、斧子，並趕牛錐。
verses.e: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks , plowshares , pitchforks , axes , and goads .

verses.z: 所以到了爭戰的日子，跟隨掃羅和約拿單的人沒有一個手裏有刀有槍的，惟獨掃羅和他兒子約拿單有。
verses.e: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan ; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them .

verses.z: 非利士人的一隊防兵到了密抹的隘口。
verses.e: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash .

verses.z: 約拿單攻擊在迦巴的非利士人的防營，非利士人聽見了。掃羅就在遍地吹角，意思說，要使希伯來人聽見。
verses.e: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba , and the Philistines heard of it . Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , " Let the Hebrews hear ! "

verses.z: 以色列眾人聽見掃羅攻擊非利士人的防營，又聽見以色列人為非利士人所憎惡，就跟隨掃羅聚集在吉甲。
verses.e: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines , and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines . The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal .

verses.z: 非利士人聚集，要與以色列人爭戰，有車三萬輛，馬兵六千，步兵像海邊的沙那樣多，就上來在伯‧亞文東邊的密抹安營。
verses.e: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel : thirty thousand chariots , six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude . They came up and encamped in Michmash , eastward of Beth Aven .

verses.z: 以色列百姓見自己危急窘迫，就藏在山洞、叢林、石穴、隱密處，和坑中。
verses.e: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble ( for the people were distressed ) , then the people hid themselves in caves , in thickets , in rocks , in tombs , and in pits .

verses.z: 有些希伯來人過了約旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。掃羅還是在吉甲，百姓都戰戰兢兢地跟隨他。
verses.e: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead ; but as for Saul , he was yet in Gilgal , and all the people followed him trembling .

verses.z: 掃羅照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七日。撒母耳還沒有來到吉甲，百姓也離開掃羅散去了。
verses.e: He stayed seven days , according to the time set by Samuel ; but Samuel didn't come to Gilgal , and the people were scattering from him .

verses.z: 掃羅說：「把燔祭和平安祭帶到我這裏來。」掃羅就獻上燔祭。
verses.e: Saul said , " Bring the burnt offering to me here , and the peace offerings . " He offered the burnt offering .

verses.z: 有一日，掃羅的兒子約拿單對拿他兵器的少年人說：「我們不如過到那邊，到非利士人的防營那裏去。」但他沒有告訴父親。
verses.e: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor , " Come ! Let's go over to the Philistines ' garrison that is on the other side . " But he didn't tell his father .

verses.z: 他們若說：『你們上到我們這裏來』，這話就是我們的證據；我們便上去，因為耶和華將他們交在我們手裏了。」
verses.e: But if they say this , ' Come up to us ! ' then we will go up , for the LORD has delivered them into our hand . This shall be the sign to us . "

verses.z: 二人就使非利士的防兵看見。非利士人說：「希伯來人從所藏的洞穴裏出來了！」
verses.e: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines ; and the Philistines said , " Behold , the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves ! "

verses.z: 防兵對約拿單和拿兵器的人說：「你們上到這裏來，我們有一件事指示你們。」約拿單就對拿兵器的人說：「你跟隨我上去，因為耶和華將他們交在以色列人手裏了。」
verses.e: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer , and said , " Come up to us , and we will show you something ! " Jonathan said to his armor bearer , " Come up after me , for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel . "

verses.z: 約拿單就爬上去，拿兵器的人跟隨他。約拿單殺倒非利士人，拿兵器的人也隨着殺他們。
verses.e: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet , and his armor bearer after him , and they fell before Jonathan ; and his armor bearer killed them after him .

verses.z: 約拿單和拿兵器的人起頭所殺的約有二十人，都在一畝地的半犂溝之內。
verses.e: That first slaughter , which Jonathan and his armor bearer made , was about twenty men , within as it were half a furrow's length in an acre of land .

verses.z: 於是在營中、在田野、在眾民內都有戰兢，防兵和掠兵也都戰兢，地也震動，戰兢之勢甚大。
verses.e: There was a trembling in the camp , in the field , and among all the people ; the garrison and the raiders also trembled ; and the earth quaked , so there was an exceedingly great trembling .

verses.z: 在便雅憫的基比亞，掃羅的守望兵看見非利士的軍眾潰散，四圍亂竄。
verses.e: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked ; and behold , the multitude melted away and scattered .

verses.z: 掃羅就對跟隨他的民說：「你們查點查點，看從我們這裏出去的是誰？」他們一查點，就知道約拿單和拿兵器的人沒有在這裏。
verses.e: Then Saul said to the people who were with him , " Count now , and see who is missing from us . " When they had counted , behold , Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there .

verses.z: 那時上帝的[約]櫃在以色列人那裏。掃羅對亞希亞說：「你將上帝的[約]櫃運了來。」
verses.e: Saul said to Ahijah , " Bring God's ark here . " For God's ark was with the children of Israel at that time .

verses.z: 掃羅正與祭司說話的時候，非利士營中的喧嚷越發大了；掃羅就對祭司說：「停手吧！」
verses.e: While Saul talked to the priest , the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased ; and Saul said to the priest , " Withdraw your hand ! "

verses.z: 掃羅在基比亞的儘邊，坐在米磯崙的石榴樹下，跟隨他的約有六百人。
verses.e: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron ; and the people who were with him were about six hundred men ,

verses.z: 掃羅和跟隨他的人都聚集，來到戰場，看見非利士人用刀互相擊殺，大大惶亂。
verses.e: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together , and came to the battle ; and behold , they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion .

verses.z: 從前由四方來跟隨非利士軍的希伯來人現在也轉過來，幫助跟隨掃羅和約拿單的以色列人了。
verses.e: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around , even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan .

verses.z: 那藏在以法蓮山地的以色列人聽說非利士人逃跑，就出來緊緊地追殺他們。
verses.e: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim , when they heard that the Philistines fled , even they also followed hard after them in the battle .

verses.z: 那日，耶和華使以色列人得勝，一直戰到伯‧亞文。
verses.e: So the LORD saved Israel that day ; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven .

verses.z: 掃羅叫百姓起誓說，凡不等到晚上向敵人報完了仇吃甚麼的，必受咒詛。因此這日百姓沒有吃甚麼，就極其困憊。
verses.e: The men of Israel were distressed that day ; for Saul had adjured the people , saying , " Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening , and I am avenged of my enemies . " So none of the people tasted food .

verses.z: 眾民進入樹林，見有蜜在地上。
verses.e: All the people came into the forest ; and there was honey on the ground .

verses.z: 他們進了樹林，見有蜜流下來，卻沒有人敢用手[取蜜]入口，因為他們怕那誓言。
verses.e: When the people had come to the forest , behold , honey was dripping , but no one put his hand to his mouth , for the people feared the oath .

verses.z: 約拿單沒有聽見他父親叫百姓起誓，所以伸手中的杖，用杖頭蘸在蜂房裏，轉手送入口內，眼睛就明亮了。
verses.e: But Jonathan didn't hear when his father commanded the people with the oath . Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb , and put his hand to his mouth ; and his eyes brightened .

verses.z: 百姓中有一人對他說：「你父親曾叫百姓嚴嚴地起誓說，今日吃甚麼的，必受咒詛；因此百姓就疲乏了。」
verses.e: Then one of the people answered , and said , " Your father directly commanded the people with an oath , saying , ' Cursed is the man who eats food today . ' " So the people were faint .

verses.z: 約拿單說：「我父親連累你們了。你看，我嘗了這一點蜜，眼睛就明亮了。
verses.e: Then Jonathan said , " My father has troubled the land . Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey .

verses.z: 在那裏有亞希突的兒子亞希亞，穿着以弗得。（亞希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的兒子，以利的孫子。以利從前在示羅作耶和華的祭司。）約拿單去了，百姓卻不知道。
verses.e: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub , Ichabod's brother , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh , wearing an ephod . The people didn't know that Jonathan was gone .

verses.z: 今日百姓若任意吃了從仇敵所奪的物，擊殺的非利士人豈不更多嗎？」
verses.e: How much more , if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found ? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines . "

verses.z: 這日，以色列人擊殺非利士人，從密抹直到亞雅崙。百姓甚是疲乏，
verses.e: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon . The people were very faint ;

verses.z: 就急忙將所奪的牛羊和牛犢宰於地上，肉還帶血就吃了。
verses.e: and the people pounced on the plunder , and took sheep , cattle , and calves , and killed them on the ground ; and the people ate them with the blood .

verses.z: 有人告訴掃羅說：「百姓吃帶血的肉，得罪耶和華了。」掃羅說：「你們有罪了，今日要將大石頭滾到我這裏來。」
verses.e: Then they told Saul , saying , " Behold , the people are sinning against the LORD , in that they eat meat with the blood . " He said , " You have dealt treacherously . Roll a large stone to me today ! "

verses.z: 掃羅又說：「你們散在百姓中，對他們說，你們各人將牛羊牽到我這裏來宰了吃，不可吃帶血的肉得罪耶和華。」這夜，百姓就把牛羊牽到那裏宰了。
