verses.e: Saul said , " Disperse yourselves among the people , and tell them , ' Every man bring me here his ox , and every man his sheep , and kill them here , and eat ; and don't sin against the LORD in eating meat with the blood . ' " All the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and killed them there .

verses.z: 掃羅為耶和華築了一座壇，這是他初次為耶和華築的壇。
verses.e: Saul built an altar to the LORD . This was the first altar that he built to the LORD .

verses.z: 掃羅說：「我們不如夜裏下去追趕非利士人，搶掠他們，直到天亮，不留他們一人。」眾民說：「你看怎樣好就去行吧！」祭司說：「我們先當親近上帝。」
verses.e: Saul said , " Let's go down after the Philistines by night , and take plunder among them until the morning light . Let's not leave a man of them . " They said , " Do whatever seems good to you . " Then the priest said , " Let's draw near here to God . "

verses.z: 掃羅求問上帝說：「我下去追趕非利士人可以不可以？你將他們交在以色列人手裏不交？」這日上帝沒有回答他。
verses.e: Saul asked counsel of God : " Shall I go down after the Philistines ? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel ? " But he didn't answer him that day .

verses.z: 掃羅說：「你們百姓中的長老都上這裏來，查明今日是誰犯了罪。
verses.e: Saul said , " Draw near here , all you chiefs of the people , and know and see in whom this sin has been today .

verses.z: 我指着救以色列－永生的耶和華起誓，就是我兒子約拿單犯了罪，他也必死。」但百姓中無一人回答他。
verses.e: For as the LORD lives , who saves Israel , though it is in Jonathan my son , he shall surely die . " But there was not a man among all the people who answered him .

verses.z: 約拿單要從隘口過到非利士防營那裏去。這隘口兩邊各有一個山峰：一名播薛，一名西尼；
verses.e: Between the passes , by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines ' garrison , there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side ; and the name of the one was Bozez , and the name of the other Seneh .

verses.z: 掃羅就對以色列眾人說：「你們站在一邊，我與我兒子約拿單也站在一邊。」百姓對掃羅說：「你看怎樣好就去行吧！」
verses.e: Then he said to all Israel , " You be on one side , and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side . " The people said to Saul , " Do what seems good to you . "

verses.z: 掃羅禱告耶和華－以色列的上帝說：「求你指示實情。」於是[掣籤]掣出掃羅和約拿單來；百姓盡都無事。
verses.e: Therefore Saul said to the LORD , the God of Israel , " Show the right . " Jonathan and Saul were chosen , but the people escaped .

verses.z: 掃羅說：「你們再[掣籤]，看是我，是我兒子約拿單」，就掣出約拿單來。
verses.e: Saul said , " Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . " Jonathan was selected .

verses.z: 掃羅對約拿單說：「你告訴我，你做了甚麼事？」約拿單說：「我實在以手裏的杖，用杖頭蘸了一點蜜嘗了一嘗。這樣我就死嗎？」
verses.e: Then Saul said to Jonathan , " Tell me what you have done ! " Jonathan told him , and said , " I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand ; and behold , I must die . "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「約拿單哪，你定要死！若不然，願上帝重重地降罰與我。」
verses.e: Saul said , " God do so and more also ; for you shall surely die , Jonathan . "

verses.z: 百姓對掃羅說：「約拿單在以色列人中這樣大行拯救，豈可使他死呢？斷乎不可！我們指着永生的耶和華起誓，連他的一根頭髮也不可落地，因為他今日與上帝一同做事。」於是百姓救約拿單免了死亡。
verses.e: The people said to Saul , " Shall Jonathan die , who has worked this great salvation in Israel ? Far from it ! As the LORD lives , there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground , for he has worked with God today ! " So the people rescued Jonathan , so he didn't die .

verses.z: 掃羅回去，不追趕非利士人；非利士人也回本地去了。
verses.e: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines ; and the Philistines went to their own place .

verses.z: 掃羅執掌以色列的國權，常常攻擊他四圍的一切仇敵，就是摩押人、亞捫人、以東人，和瑣巴諸王，並非利士人。他無論往何處去，都打敗仇敵。
verses.e: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel , he fought against all his enemies on every side : against Moab , and against the children of Ammon , and against Edom , and against the kings of Zobah , and against the Philistines . Wherever he turned himself , he defeated them .

verses.z: 掃羅奮勇攻擊亞瑪力人，救了以色列人脫離搶掠他們之人的手。
verses.e: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites , and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them .

verses.z: 掃羅的兒子是約拿單、亦施韋、麥基舒亞。他的兩個女兒：長女名米拉，次女名米甲。
verses.e: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , Ishvi , and Malchishua ; and the names of his two daughters were these : the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal .

verses.z: 一峰向北，與密抹相對，一峰向南，與迦巴相對。
verses.e: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash , and the other on the south in front of Geba .

verses.z: 掃羅的妻名叫亞希暖，是亞希瑪斯的女兒。掃羅的元帥名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的兒子；尼珥是掃羅的叔叔。
verses.e: The name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz . The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner , Saul's uncle .

verses.z: 掃羅的父親基士，押尼珥的父親尼珥，都是亞別的兒子。
verses.e: Kish was the father of Saul , and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel .

verses.z: 掃羅平生常與非利士人大大爭戰。掃羅遇見有能力的人或勇士，都招募了來跟隨他。
verses.e: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul ; and when Saul saw any mighty man or any valiant man , he took him into his service .

verses.z: 約拿單對拿兵器的少年人說：「我們不如過到未受割禮人的防營那裏去，或者耶和華為我們施展能力；因為耶和華使人得勝，不在乎人多人少。」
verses.e: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor , " Come ! Let's go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised . It may be that the LORD will work for us , for there is no restraint on the LORD to save by many or by few . "

verses.z: 拿兵器的對他說：「隨你的心意行吧。你可以上去，我必跟隨你，與你同心。」
verses.e: His armor bearer said to him , " Do all that is in your heart . Go , and behold , I am with you according to your heart . "

verses.z: 約拿單說：「我們要過到那些人那裏去，使他們看見我們。
verses.e: Then Jonathan said , " Behold , we will pass over to the men , and we will reveal ourselves to them .

verses.z: 他們若對我們說：『你們站住，等我們到你們那裏去』，我們就站住，不上他們那裏去。
verses.e: If they say this to us , ' Wait until we come to you ! ' then we will stand still in our place and will not go up to them .

verses.z: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「耶和華差遣我膏你為王，治理他的百姓以色列；所以你當聽從耶和華的話。
verses.e: Samuel said to Saul , " The LORD sent me to anoint you to be king over his people , over Israel . Now therefore listen to the voice of the LORD's words .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到撒母耳說：
verses.e: Then the LORD's word came to Samuel , saying ,

verses.z: 「我立掃羅為王，我後悔了；因為他轉去不跟從我，不遵守我的命令。」撒母耳便甚憂愁，終夜哀求耶和華。
verses.e: " It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king , for he has turned back from following me , and has not performed my commandments . " Samuel was angry ; and he cried to the LORD all night .

verses.z: 撒母耳清早起來，迎接掃羅。有人告訴撒母耳說：「掃羅到了迦密，在那裏立了紀念碑，又轉身下到吉甲。」
verses.e: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning ; and Samuel was told , saying , " Saul came to Carmel , and behold , he set up a monument for himself , turned , passed on , and went down to Gilgal . "

verses.z: 撒母耳到了掃羅那裏，掃羅對他說：「願耶和華賜福與你，耶和華的命令我已遵守了。」
verses.e: Samuel came to Saul ; and Saul said to him , " You are blessed by the LORD ! I have performed the commandment of the LORD . "

verses.z: 撒母耳說：「我耳中聽見有羊叫、牛鳴，是從哪裏來的呢？」
verses.e: Samuel said , " Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean ? "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「這是百姓從亞瑪力人那裏帶來的；因為他們愛惜上好的牛羊，要獻與耶和華－你的上帝；其餘的，我們都滅盡了。」
verses.e: Saul said , " They have brought them from the Amalekites ; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle , to sacrifice to the LORD your God . We have utterly destroyed the rest . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「你住口吧！等我將耶和華昨夜向我所說的話告訴你。」掃羅說：「請講。」
verses.e: Then Samuel said to Saul , " Stay , and I will tell you what the LORD said to me last night . " He said to him , " Say on . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「從前你雖然以自己為小，豈不是被立為以色列支派的元首嗎？耶和華膏你作以色列的王。
verses.e: Samuel said , " Though you were little in your own sight , weren't you made the head of the tribes of Israel ? The LORD anointed you king over Israel ;

verses.z: 耶和華差遣你，吩咐你說，你去擊打那些犯罪的亞瑪力人，將他們滅絕淨盡。
verses.e: and the LORD sent you on a journey , and said , ' Go , and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites , and fight against them until they are consumed . '

verses.z: 你為何沒有聽從耶和華的命令，急忙擄掠財物，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事呢？」
verses.e: Why then didn't you obey the LORD's voice , but took the plunder , and did that which was evil in the LORD's sight ? "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：『以色列人出埃及的時候，在路上亞瑪力人怎樣待他們，怎樣抵擋他們，我都沒忘。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says , ' I remember what Amalek did to Israel , how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt .

verses.z: 掃羅對撒母耳說：「我實在聽從了耶和華的命令，行了耶和華所差遣我行的路，擒了亞瑪力王亞甲來，滅盡了亞瑪力人。
verses.e: Saul said to Samuel , " But I have obeyed the LORD's voice , and have gone the way which the LORD sent me , and have brought Agag the king of Amalek , and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites .

verses.z: 百姓卻在所當滅的物中，取了最好的牛羊，要在吉甲獻與耶和華－你的上帝。」
verses.e: But the people took of the plunder , sheep and cattle , the best of the devoted things , to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal . "

verses.z: 撒母耳說：耶和華喜悅燔祭和[平安]祭，豈如喜悅人聽從他的話呢？聽命勝於獻祭；順從勝於公羊的脂油。
verses.e: Samuel said , " Has the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices , as in obeying the LORD's voice ? Behold , to obey is better than sacrifice , and to listen than the fat of rams .

verses.z: 悖逆的罪與行邪術的罪相等；頑梗的罪與拜虛神和偶像的罪相同。你既厭棄耶和華的命令，耶和華也厭棄你作王。
verses.e: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft , and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim . Because you have rejected the LORD's word , he has also rejected you from being king . "

verses.z: 掃羅對撒母耳說：「我有罪了，我因懼怕百姓，聽從他們的話，就違背了耶和華的命令和你的言語。
verses.e: Saul said to Samuel , " I have sinned ; for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD and your words , because I feared the people and obeyed their voice .

verses.z: 現在求你赦免我的罪，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和華。」
verses.e: Now therefore , please pardon my sin , and turn again with me , that I may worship the LORD . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「我不同你回去；因為你厭棄耶和華的命令，耶和華也厭棄你作以色列的王。」
verses.e: Samuel said to Saul , " I will not return with you ; for you have rejected the LORD's word , and the LORD has rejected you from being king over Israel . "

verses.z: 撒母耳轉身要走，掃羅就扯住他外袍的衣襟，衣襟就撕斷了。
verses.e: As Samuel turned around to go away , Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe , and it tore .

verses.z: 撒母耳對他說：「如此，今日耶和華使以色列國與你斷絕，將這國賜與比你更好的人。
verses.e: Samuel said to him , " The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today , and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you .

verses.z: 以色列的大能者必不致說謊，也不致後悔；因為他迥非世人，決不後悔。」
verses.e: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent ; for he is not a man , that he should repent . "

verses.z: 現在你要去擊打亞瑪力人，滅盡他們所有的，不可憐惜他們，將男女、孩童、吃奶的，並牛、羊、駱駝，和驢盡行殺死。』」
verses.e: Now go and strike Amalek , and utterly destroy all that they have , and don't spare them ; but kill both man and woman , infant and nursing baby , ox and sheep , camel and donkey . ' "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「我有罪了，雖然如此，求你在我百姓的長老和以色列人面前抬舉我，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和華－你的上帝。」
verses.e: Then he said , " I have sinned ; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel , and come back with me , that I may worship the LORD your God . "

verses.z: 於是撒母耳轉身跟隨掃羅回去，掃羅就敬拜耶和華。
verses.e: So Samuel went back with Saul ; and Saul worshiped the LORD .

verses.z: 撒母耳說：「要把亞瑪力王亞甲帶到我這裏來。」亞甲就歡歡喜喜地來到他面前，心裏說，死亡的苦難必定過去了。
verses.e: Then Samuel said , " Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me ! " Agag came to him cheerfully . Agag said , " Surely the bitterness of death is past . "

verses.z: 撒母耳說：「你既用刀使婦人喪子，這樣，你母親在婦人中也必喪子。」於是，撒母耳在吉甲耶和華面前將亞甲殺死。
verses.e: Samuel said , " As your sword has made women childless , so your mother will be childless among women ! " Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal .

verses.z: 撒母耳回了拉瑪。掃羅上他所住的基比亞，回自己的家去了。
verses.e: Then Samuel went to Ramah ; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul .

verses.z: 撒母耳直到死的日子，再沒有見掃羅；但撒母耳為掃羅悲傷，是因耶和華後悔立他為以色列的王。
verses.e: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death , but Samuel mourned for Saul . The LORD grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel .

verses.z: 於是掃羅招聚百姓在提拉因，數點他們，共有步兵二十萬，另有猶大人一萬。
verses.e: Saul summoned the people , and counted them in Telaim , two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah .

verses.z: 掃羅到了亞瑪力的[京]城，在谷中設下埋伏。
verses.e: Saul came to the city of Amalek , and set an ambush in the valley .

verses.z: 掃羅對基尼人說：「你們離開亞瑪力人下去吧，恐怕我將你們和亞瑪力人一同殺滅；因為以色列人出埃及的時候，你們曾恩待他們。」於是基尼人離開亞瑪力人去了。
verses.e: Saul said to the Kenites , " Go , depart , go down from among the Amalekites , lest I destroy you with them ; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt . " So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites .

verses.z: 掃羅擊打亞瑪力人，從哈腓拉直到埃及前的書珥，
verses.e: Saul struck the Amalekites , from Havilah as you go to Shur , which is before Egypt .

verses.z: 生擒了亞瑪力王亞甲，用刀殺盡亞瑪力的眾民。
verses.e: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive , and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword .

verses.z: 掃羅和百姓卻憐惜亞甲，也愛惜上好的牛、羊、牛犢、羊羔，並一切美物，不肯滅絕。凡下賤瘦弱的，盡都殺了。
verses.e: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep , of the cattle , of the fat calves , of the lambs , and all that was good , and were not willing to utterly destroy them ; but everything that was vile and refuse , that they destroyed utterly .

verses.z: 耶和華對撒母耳說：「我既厭棄掃羅作以色列的王，你為他悲傷要到幾時呢？你將膏油盛滿了角，我差遣你往伯利恆人耶西那裏去；因為我在他眾子之內，預定一個作王的。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Samuel , " How long will you mourn for Saul , since I have rejected him from being king over Israel ? Fill your horn with oil , and go . I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite , for I have provided a king for myself among his sons . "

verses.z: 耶西叫他七個兒子都從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：「這都不是耶和華所揀選的。」
verses.e: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel . Samuel said to Jesse , " The LORD has not chosen these . "

verses.z: 撒母耳對耶西說：「你的兒子都在這裏嗎？」他回答說：「還有個小的，現在放羊。」撒母耳對耶西說：「你打發人去叫他來；他若不來，我們必不坐席。」
verses.e: Samuel said to Jesse , " Are all your children here ? " He said , " There remains yet the youngest . Behold , he is keeping the sheep . " Samuel said to Jesse , " Send and get him , for we will not sit down until he comes here . "

verses.z: 耶西就打發人去叫了他來。他面色光紅，雙目清秀，容貌俊美。耶和華說：「這就是他，你起來膏他。」
verses.e: He sent , and brought him in . Now he was ruddy , with a handsome face and good appearance . The LORD said , " Arise ! Anoint him , for this is he . "

verses.z: 撒母耳就用角裏的膏油，在他諸兄中膏了他。從這日起，耶和華的靈就大大感動大衛。撒母耳起身回拉瑪去了。
verses.e: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers . Then the LORD's Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward . So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈離開掃羅，有惡魔從耶和華那裏來擾亂他。
verses.e: Now the LORD's Spirit departed from Saul , and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him .

verses.z: 掃羅的臣僕對他說：「現在有惡魔從上帝那裏來擾亂你。
verses.e: Saul's servants said to him , " See now , an evil spirit from God troubles you .

verses.z: 我們的主可以吩咐面前的臣僕，找一個善於彈琴的來，等上帝那裏來的惡魔臨到你身上的時候，使他用手彈琴，你就好了。」
verses.e: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp . Then when the evil spirit from God is on you , he will play with his hand , and you will be well . "

verses.z: 掃羅對臣僕說：「你們可以為我找一個善於彈琴的，帶到我這裏來。」
verses.e: Saul said to his servants , " Provide me now a man who can play well , and bring him to me . "

verses.z: 其中有一個少年人說：「我曾見伯利恆人耶西的一個兒子善於彈琴，是大有勇敢的戰士，說話合宜，容貌俊美，耶和華也與他同在。」
verses.e: Then one of the young men answered and said , " Behold , I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing , a mighty man of valor , a man of war , prudent in speech , and a handsome person ; and the LORD is with him . "

verses.z: 於是掃羅差遣使者去見耶西，說：「請你打發你放羊的兒子大衛到我這裏來。」
verses.e: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse , and said , " Send me David your son , who is with the sheep . "

verses.z: 撒母耳說：「我怎能去呢？掃羅若聽見，必要殺我。」耶和華說：「你可以帶一隻牛犢去，就說：『我來是要向耶和華獻祭。』
verses.e: Samuel said , " How can I go ? If Saul hears it , he will kill me . " The LORD said , " Take a heifer with you , and say , ' I have come to sacrifice to the LORD . '

verses.z: 耶西就把幾個餅和一皮袋酒，並一隻山羊羔，都馱在驢上，交給他兒子大衛，送與掃羅。
verses.e: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread , a container of wine , and a young goat , and sent them by David his son to Saul .

verses.z: 大衛到了掃羅那裏，就侍立在掃羅面前。掃羅甚喜愛他，他就作了掃羅拿兵器的人。
verses.e: David came to Saul and stood before him . He loved him greatly ; and he became his armor bearer .

verses.z: 掃羅差遣人去見耶西，說：「求你容大衛侍立在我面前，因為他在我眼前蒙了恩。」
verses.e: Saul sent to Jesse , saying , " Please let David stand before me , for he has found favor in my sight . "

verses.z: 從上帝那裏來的惡魔臨到掃羅身上的時候，大衛就拿琴，用手而彈，掃羅便舒暢爽快，惡魔離了他。
verses.e: When the spirit from God was on Saul , David took the harp and played with his hand ; so Saul was refreshed and was well , and the evil spirit departed from him .

verses.z: 你要請耶西來吃祭肉，我就指示你所當行的事。我所指給你的人，你要膏他。」
verses.e: Call Jesse to the sacrifice , and I will show you what you shall do . You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you . "

verses.z: 撒母耳就照耶和華的話去行。到了伯利恆，那城裏的長老都戰戰兢兢地出來迎接他，問他說：「你是為平安來的嗎？」
verses.e: Samuel did that which the LORD spoke , and came to Bethlehem . The elders of the city came to meet him trembling , and said , " Do you come peaceably ? "

verses.z: 他說：「為平安來的，我是給耶和華獻祭。你們當自潔，來與我同吃祭肉。」撒母耳就使耶西和他眾子自潔，請他們來吃祭肉。
verses.e: He said , " Peaceably ; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD . Sanctify yourselves , and come with me to the sacrifice . " He sanctified Jesse and his sons , and called them to the sacrifice .

verses.z: 他們來的時候，撒母耳看見以利押，就心裏說，耶和華的受膏者必定在他面前。
verses.e: When they had come , he looked at Eliab , and said , " Surely the LORD's anointed is before him . "

verses.z: 耶和華卻對撒母耳說：「不要看他的外貌和他身材高大，我不揀選他。因為，[耶和華]不像人看人：人是看外貌；耶和華是看內心。」
verses.e: But the LORD said to Samuel , " Don't look on his face , or on the height of his stature , because I have rejected him ; for I don't see as man sees . For man looks at the outward appearance , but the LORD looks at the heart . "

verses.z: 耶西叫亞比拿達從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：「耶和華也不揀選他。」
verses.e: Then Jesse called Abinadab , and made him pass before Samuel . He said , " The LORD has not chosen this one , either . "

verses.z: 耶西又叫沙瑪從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：「耶和華也不揀選他。」
verses.e: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by . He said , " The LORD has not chosen this one , either . "

verses.z: 非利士人招聚他們的軍旅，要來爭戰；聚集在屬猶大的梭哥，安營在梭哥和亞西加中間的以弗‧大憫。
verses.e: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle ; and they were gathered together at Socoh , which belongs to Judah , and encamped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephesdammim .

verses.z: 那非利士人又說：「我今日向以色列人的軍隊罵陣。你們叫一個人出來，與我戰鬥。」
verses.e: The Philistine said , " I defy the armies of Israel today ! Give me a man , that we may fight together ! "

verses.z: 掃羅和以色列眾人聽見非利士人的這些話，就驚惶，極其害怕。
verses.e: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine , they were dismayed and greatly afraid .

verses.z: 大衛是猶大伯利恆的以法他人耶西的兒子。耶西有八個兒子。當掃羅的時候，耶西已經老邁。
verses.e: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah , whose name was Jesse ; and he had eight sons . The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul .

verses.z: 耶西的三個大兒子跟隨掃羅出征。這出征的三個兒子：長子名叫以利押，次子名叫亞比拿達，三子名叫沙瑪。
verses.e: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle ; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn , and next to him Abinadab , and the third Shammah .

verses.z: 大衛是最小的；那三個大兒子跟隨掃羅。
verses.e: David was the youngest ; and the three oldest followed Saul .

verses.z: 大衛有時離開掃羅，回伯利恆放他父親的羊。
verses.e: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem .

verses.z: 那非利士人早晚都出來站着，如此四十日。
verses.e: The Philistine came near morning and evening , and presented himself forty days .

verses.z: 一日，耶西對他兒子大衛說：「你拿一伊法烘了的穗子和十個餅，速速地送到營裏去，交給你哥哥們；
verses.e: Jesse said to David his son , " Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves , and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers ;

verses.z: 再拿這十塊奶餅，送給他們的千夫長，且問你哥哥們好，向他們要一封信來。」
verses.e: and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand ; and see how your brothers are doing , and bring back news . "

verses.z: 掃羅與大衛的三個哥哥和以色列眾人，在以拉谷與非利士人打仗。
verses.e: Now Saul , and they , and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah , fighting with the Philistines .

verses.z: 掃羅和以色列人也聚集，在以拉谷安營，擺列隊伍，要與非利士人打仗。
verses.e: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together , and encamped in the valley of Elah , and set the battle in array against the Philistines .

verses.z: 大衛早晨起來，將羊交託一個看守的人，照着他父親所吩咐的話，帶着食物去了。到了輜重營，軍兵剛出到戰場，吶喊要戰。
verses.e: David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper , and took the provisions and went , as Jesse had commanded him . He came to the place of the wagons as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle .

verses.z: 以色列人和非利士人都擺列隊伍，彼此相對。
verses.e: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array , army against army .

verses.z: 大衛把他帶來的食物留在看守物件人的手下，跑到戰場，問他哥哥們安。
verses.e: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army , and came and greeted his brothers .

verses.z: 與他們說話的時候，那討戰的，就是屬迦特的非利士人歌利亞，從非利士隊中出來，說從前所說的話；大衛都聽見了。
verses.e: As he talked with them , behold , the champion , the Philistine of Gath , Goliath by name , came up out of the ranks of the Philistines , and said the same words ; and David heard them .

verses.z: 以色列眾人看見那人，就逃跑，極其害怕。
verses.e: All the men of Israel , when they saw the man , fled from him and were terrified .

verses.z: 以色列人彼此說：「這上來的人你看見了嗎？他上來是要向以色列人罵陣。若有能殺他的，王必賞賜他大財，將自己的女兒給他為妻，並在以色列人中免他父家納糧當差。」
verses.e: The men of Israel said , " Have you seen this man who has come up ? He has surely come up to defy Israel . The king will give great riches to the man who kills him , and will give him his daughter , and will make his father's house tax-free in Israel . "

verses.z: 大衛問站在旁邊的人說：「有人殺這非利士人，除掉以色列人的恥辱，怎樣待他呢？這未受割禮的非利士人是誰呢？竟敢向永生上帝的軍隊罵陣嗎？」
verses.e: David spoke to the men who stood by him , saying , " What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel ? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine , that he should defy the armies of the living God ? "

verses.z: 百姓照先前的話回答他說：「有人能殺這非利士人，必如此如此待他。」
verses.e: The people answered him in this way , saying , " So shall it be done to the man who kills him . "

verses.z: 大衛的長兄以利押聽見大衛與他們所說的話，就向他發怒，說：「你下來做甚麼呢？在曠野的那幾隻羊，你交託了誰呢？我知道你的驕傲和你心裏的惡意，你下來特為要看爭戰！」
verses.e: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men ; and Eliab's anger burned against David , and he said , " Why have you come down ? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness ? I know your pride and the evil of your heart ; for you have come down that you might see the battle . "

verses.z: 大衛說：「我做了甚麼呢？我來豈沒有緣故嗎？」
verses.e: David said , " What have I now done ? Is there not a cause ? "

verses.z: 非利士人站在這邊山上，以色列人站在那邊山上，當中有谷。
verses.e: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side , and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side : and there was a valley between them .

verses.z: 大衛就離開他轉向別人，照先前的話而問；百姓仍照先前的話回答他。
verses.e: He turned away from him toward another , and spoke like that again ; and the people answered him again the same way .

verses.z: 有人聽見大衛所說的話，就告訴了掃羅；掃羅便打發人叫他來。
verses.e: When the words were heard which David spoke , they rehearsed them before Saul ; and he sent for him .

verses.z: 大衛對掃羅說：「人都不必因那非利士人膽怯。你的僕人要去與那非利士人戰鬥。」
verses.e: David said to Saul , " Let no man's heart fail because of him . Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine . "

verses.z: 掃羅對大衛說：「你不能去與那非利士人戰鬥；因為你年紀太輕，他自幼就作戰士。」
verses.e: Saul said to David , " You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him ; for you are but a youth , and he a man of war from his youth . "

verses.z: 大衛對掃羅說：「你僕人為父親放羊，有時來了獅子，有時來了熊，從群中啣一隻羊羔去。
verses.e: David said to Saul , " Your servant was keeping his father's sheep ; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock ,

verses.z: 我就追趕牠，擊打牠，將羊羔從牠口中救出來。牠起來要害我，我就揪着牠的鬍子，將牠打死。
verses.e: I went out after him , struck him , and rescued it out of his mouth . When he arose against me , I caught him by his beard , struck him , and killed him .

verses.z: 你僕人曾打死獅子和熊，這未受割禮的非利士人向永生上帝的軍隊罵陣，也必像獅子和熊一般。」
verses.e: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear . This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them , since he has defied the armies of the living God . "

verses.z: 大衛又說：「耶和華救我脫離獅子和熊的爪，也必救我脫離這非利士人的手。」掃羅對大衛說：「你可以去吧！耶和華必與你同在。」
verses.e: David said , " The LORD , who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear , will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine . " Saul said to David , " Go ! The LORD will be with you . "

verses.z: 掃羅就把自己的戰衣給大衛穿上，將銅盔給他戴上，又給他穿上鎧甲。
verses.e: Saul dressed David with his clothing . He put a helmet of bronze on his head , and he clad him with a coat of mail .

verses.z: 大衛把刀跨在戰衣外，試試能走不能走；因為素來沒有穿慣，就對掃羅說：「我穿戴這些不能走，因為素來沒有穿慣。」於是摘脫了。
verses.e: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move , for he had not tested it . David said to Saul , " I can't go with these , for I have not tested them . " Then David took them off .

verses.z: 從非利士營中出來一個討戰的人，名叫歌利亞，是迦特人，身高六肘零一虎口；
verses.e: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath of Gath , whose height was six cubits and a span went out .

verses.z: 他手中拿杖，又在溪中挑選了五塊光滑石子，放在袋裏，就是牧人帶的囊裏；手中拿着甩石的機弦，就去迎那非利士人。
verses.e: He took his staff in his hand , and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook , and put them in the pouch of his shepherd's bag which he had . His sling was in his hand ; and he came near to the Philistine .

verses.z: 非利士人也漸漸地迎着大衛來，拿盾牌的走在前頭。
verses.e: The Philistine walked and came near to David ; and the man who bore the shield went before him .

verses.z: 非利士人觀看，見了大衛，就藐視他；因為他年輕，面色光紅，容貌俊美。
verses.e: When the Philistine looked around and saw David , he disdained him ; for he was but a youth , and ruddy , and had a good looking face .

verses.z: 非利士人對大衛說：「你拿杖到我這裏來，我豈是狗呢？」非利士人就指着自己的神咒詛大衛。
verses.e: The Philistine said to David , " Am I a dog , that you come to me with sticks ? " The Philistine cursed David by his gods .

verses.z: 非利士人又對大衛說：「來吧！我將你的肉給空中的飛鳥、田野的走獸吃。」
verses.e: The Philistine said to David , " Come to me , and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the animals of the field . "

verses.z: 大衛對非利士人說：「你來攻擊我，是靠着刀槍和[銅]戟；我來攻擊你，是靠着萬軍之耶和華的名，就是你所怒罵帶領以色列軍隊的上帝。
verses.e: Then David said to the Philistine , " You come to me with a sword , with a spear , and with a javelin ; but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Armies , the God of the armies of Israel , whom you have defied .

verses.z: 今日耶和華必將你交在我手裏。我必殺你，斬你的頭，又將非利士軍兵的屍首給空中的飛鳥、地上的野獸吃，使普天下的人都知道以色列中有上帝；
verses.e: Today , the LORD will deliver you into my hand . I will strike you and take your head from off you . I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky and to the wild animals of the earth , that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel ,

verses.z: 又使這眾人知道耶和華使人得勝，不是用刀用槍，因為爭戰的勝敗全在乎耶和華。他必將你們交在我們手裏。」
verses.e: and that all this assembly may know that the LORD doesn't save with sword and spear ; for the battle is the LORD's , and he will give you into our hand . "

verses.z: 非利士人起身，迎着大衛前來。大衛急忙迎着非利士人，往戰場跑去。
verses.e: When the Philistine arose , and walked and came near to meet David , David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine .

verses.z: 大衛用手從囊中掏出一塊石子來，用機弦甩去，打中非利士人的額，石子進入額內，他就仆倒，面伏於地。
verses.e: David put his hand in his bag , took a stone and slung it , and struck the Philistine in his forehead . The stone sank into his forehead , and he fell on his face to the earth .

verses.z: 頭戴銅盔，身穿鎧甲，甲重五千舍客勒；
verses.e: He had a helmet of bronze on his head , and he wore a coat of mail ; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze .

verses.z: 這樣，大衛用機弦甩石，勝了那非利士人，打死他；大衛手中卻沒有刀。
verses.e: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone , and struck the Philistine and killed him ; but there was no sword in David's hand .

verses.z: 大衛跑去，站在非利士人身旁，將他的刀從鞘中拔出來，殺死他，割了他的頭。非利士眾人看見他們討戰的勇士死了，就都逃跑。
verses.e: Then David ran , stood over the Philistine , took his sword , drew it out of its sheath , killed him , and cut off his head with it . When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead , they fled .

verses.z: 以色列人和猶大人便起身吶喊，追趕非利士人，直到迦特和以革倫的城門。被殺的非利士人倒在沙拉音的路上，直到迦特和以革倫。
verses.e: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted , and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron . The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim , even to Gath and to Ekron .

verses.z: 以色列人追趕非利士人回來，就奪了他們的營盤。
verses.e: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines , and they plundered their camp .

verses.z: 大衛將那非利士人的頭拿到耶路撒冷，卻將他軍裝放在自己的帳棚裏。
verses.e: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem , but he put his armor in his tent .

verses.z: 掃羅看見大衛去攻擊非利士人，就問元帥押尼珥說：「押尼珥啊，那少年人是誰的兒子？」押尼珥說：「我敢在王面前起誓，我不知道。」
verses.e: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine , he said to Abner , the captain of the army , " Abner , whose son is this youth ? " Abner said , " As your soul lives , O king , I can't tell . "

verses.z: 王說：「你可以問問那幼年人是誰的兒子。」
verses.e: The king said , " Inquire whose son the young man is ! "

verses.z: 大衛打死非利士人回來，押尼珥領他到掃羅面前，他手中拿着非利士人的頭。
verses.e: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand .

verses.z: 掃羅問他說：「少年人哪，你是誰的兒子？」大衛說：「我是你僕人伯利恆人耶西的兒子。」
verses.e: Saul said to him , " Whose son are you , you young man ? " David answered , " I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite . "

verses.z: 腿上有銅護膝，兩肩之中背負銅戟；
verses.e: He had bronze shin armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders .

verses.z: 槍桿粗如織布的機軸，鐵槍頭重六百舍客勒。有一個拿盾牌的人在他前面走。
verses.e: The staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam ; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron . His shield bearer went before him .

verses.z: 歌利亞對着以色列的軍隊站立，呼叫說：「你們出來擺列隊伍做甚麼呢？我不是非利士人嗎？你們不是掃羅的僕人嗎？可以從你們中間揀選一人，使他下到我這裏來。
verses.e: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel , and said to them , " Why have you come out to set your battle in array ? Am I not a Philistine , and you servants to Saul ? Choose a man for yourselves , and let him come down to me .

verses.z: 他若能與我戰鬥，將我殺死，我們就作你們的僕人；我若勝了他，將他殺死，你們就作我們的僕人，服事我們。」
verses.e: If he is able to fight with me and kill me , then will we be your servants ; but if I prevail against him and kill him , then you will be our servants and serve us . "

verses.z: 大衛對掃羅說完了話，約拿單的心與大衛的心深相契合。約拿單愛大衛，如同愛自己的性命。
verses.e: When he had finished speaking to Saul , the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .

verses.z: 次日，從上帝那裏來的惡魔大大降在掃羅身上，他就在家中胡言亂語。大衛照常彈琴，掃羅手裏拿着槍。
verses.e: On the next day , an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul , and he prophesied in the middle of the house . David played with his hand , as he did day by day . Saul had his spear in his hand ;

verses.z: 掃羅把槍一掄，心裏說，我要將大衛刺透，釘在牆上。大衛躲避他兩次。
verses.e: and Saul threw the spear , for he said , " I will pin David to the wall ! " David escaped from his presence twice .

verses.z: 掃羅懼怕大衛；因為耶和華離開自己，與大衛同在。
verses.e: Saul was afraid of David , because the LORD was with him , and had departed from Saul .

verses.z: 所以掃羅使大衛離開自己，立他為千夫長，他就領兵出入。
verses.e: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence , and made him his captain over a thousand ; and he went out and came in before the people .

verses.z: 大衛做事無不精明，耶和華也與他同在。
verses.e: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways ; and the LORD was with him .

verses.z: 掃羅見大衛做事精明，就甚怕他。
verses.e: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely , he stood in awe of him .

verses.z: 但以色列和猶大眾人都愛大衛，因為他領他們出入。
verses.e: But all Israel and Judah loved David ; for he went out and came in before them .

verses.z: 掃羅對大衛說：「我將大女兒米拉給你為妻，只要你為我奮勇，為耶和華爭戰。」掃羅心裏說：「我不好親手害他，要藉非利士人的手害他。」
verses.e: Saul said to David , " Behold , my elder daughter Merab . I will give her to you as wife . Only be valiant for me , and fight the LORD's battles . " For Saul said , " Don't let my hand be on him , but let the hand of the Philistines be on him . "

verses.z: 大衛對掃羅說：「我是誰，我是甚麼出身，我父家在以色列中是何等的家，豈敢作王的女婿呢？」
verses.e: David said to Saul , " Who am I , and what is my life , or my father's family in Israel , that I should be son-in-law to the king ? "

verses.z: 掃羅的女兒米拉到了當給大衛的時候，掃羅卻給了米何拉人亞得列為妻。
verses.e: But at the time when Merab , Saul's daughter , should have been given to David , she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife .

verses.z: 那日掃羅留住大衛，不容他再回父家。
verses.e: Saul took him that day , and wouldn't let him go home to his father's house any more .

verses.z: 掃羅的次女米甲愛大衛。有人告訴掃羅，掃羅就喜悅。
verses.e: Michal , Saul's daughter , loved David ; and they told Saul , and the thing pleased him .

verses.z: 掃羅心裏說：「我將這女兒給大衛，作他的網羅，好藉非利士人的手害他。」所以掃羅對大衛說：「你今日可以第二次作我的女婿。」
verses.e: Saul said , I will give her to him , that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him . Therefore Saul said to David a second time , " You shall today be my son-in-law . "

verses.z: 掃羅吩咐臣僕[說]：「你們暗中對大衛說：『王喜悅你，王的臣僕也都喜愛你，所以你當作王的女婿。』」
verses.e: Saul commanded his servants , " Talk with David secretly , and say , ' Behold , the king has delight in you , and all his servants love you . Now therefore be the king's son-in-law . ' "

verses.z: 掃羅的臣僕就照這話說給大衛聽。大衛說：「你們以為作王的女婿是一件小事嗎？我是貧窮卑微的人。」
verses.e: Saul's servants spoke those words in the ears of David . David said , " Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king's son-in-law , since I am a poor man and little known ? "

verses.z: 掃羅的臣僕回奏說，大衛所說的如此如此。
verses.e: The servants of Saul told him , saying , " David spoke like this . "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「你們要對大衛這樣說：『王不要甚麼聘禮，只要一百非利士人的陽皮，好在王的仇敵身上報仇。』」掃羅的意思要使大衛喪在非利士人的手裏。
verses.e: Saul said , " Tell David , ' The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines , to be avenged of the king's enemies . ' " Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines .

verses.z: 掃羅的臣僕將這話告訴大衛，大衛就歡喜作王的女婿。日期還沒有到，
verses.e: When his servants told David these words , it pleased David well to be the king's son-in-law . Before the deadline ,

verses.z: 大衛和跟隨他的人起身前往，殺了二百非利士人，將陽皮滿數交給王，為要作王的女婿。於是掃羅將女兒米甲給大衛為妻。
verses.e: David arose and went , he and his men , and killed two hundred men of the Philistines . Then David brought their foreskins , and they gave them in full number to the king , that he might be the king's son-in-law . Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife .

verses.z: 掃羅見耶和華與大衛同在，又知道女兒米甲愛大衛，
verses.e: Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David ; and Michal , Saul's daughter , loved him .

verses.z: 就更怕大衛，常作大衛的仇敵。
verses.e: Saul was even more afraid of David ; and Saul was David's enemy continually .

verses.z: 約拿單愛大衛如同愛自己的性命，就與他結盟。
verses.e: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant , because he loved him as his own soul .

verses.z: 每逢非利士軍長出來[打仗]，大衛比掃羅的臣僕做事精明，因此他的名被人尊重。
verses.e: Then the princes of the Philistines went out ; and as often as they went out , David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul , so that his name was highly esteemed .

verses.z: 約拿單從身上脫下外袍，給了大衛，又將戰衣、刀、弓、腰帶都給了他。
verses.e: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing , even including his sword , his bow , and his sash .

verses.z: 掃羅無論差遣大衛往何處去，他都做事精明。掃羅就立他作戰士長，眾百姓和掃羅的臣僕無不喜悅。
verses.e: David went out wherever Saul sent him , and behaved himself wisely ; and Saul set him over the men of war . It was good in the sight of all the people , and also in the sight of Saul's servants .

verses.z: 大衛打死了那非利士人，同眾人回來的時候，婦女們從以色列各城裏出來，歡歡喜喜，打鼓擊磬，歌唱跳舞，迎接掃羅王。
verses.e: As they came , when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , the women came out of all the cities of Israel , singing and dancing , to meet King Saul with tambourines , with joy , and with instruments of music .

verses.z: 眾婦女舞蹈唱和，說：「掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬。」
verses.e: The women sang to one another as they played , and said , " Saul has slain his thousands , and David his ten thousands . "

verses.z: 掃羅甚發怒，不喜悅這話，就說：「將萬萬歸大衛，千千歸我，只剩下王位沒有給他了。」
verses.e: Saul was very angry , and this saying displeased him . He said , " They have credited David with ten thousands , and they have only credited me with thousands . What can he have more but the kingdom ? "

verses.z: 從這日起，掃羅就怒視大衛。
verses.e: Saul watched David from that day and forward .

verses.z: 掃羅對他兒子約拿單和眾臣僕說，要殺大衛；掃羅的兒子約拿單卻甚喜愛大衛。
verses.e: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants , that they should kill David . But Jonathan , Saul's son , greatly delighted in David .

verses.z: 掃羅用槍想要刺透大衛，釘在牆上，他卻躲開，掃羅的槍刺入牆內。當夜大衛逃走，躲避了。
verses.e: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear , but he slipped away out of Saul's presence ; and he stuck the spear into the wall . David fled and escaped that night .

verses.z: 掃羅打發人到大衛的房屋那裏窺探他，要等到天亮殺他。大衛的妻米甲對他說：「你今夜若不逃命，明日你要被殺。」
verses.e: Saul sent messengers to David's house to watch him and to kill him in the morning . Michal , David's wife , told him , saying , " If you don't save your life tonight , tomorrow you will be killed . "

verses.z: 於是米甲將大衛從窗戶裏縋下去，大衛就逃走，躲避了。
verses.e: So Michal let David down through the window . He went away , fled , and escaped .

verses.z: 米甲把家中的神像放在床上，頭枕在山羊毛裝的枕頭上，用被遮蓋。
verses.e: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed , and put a pillow of goats ' hair at its head and covered it with clothes .

verses.z: 掃羅打發人去捉拿大衛，米甲說：「他病了。」
verses.e: When Saul sent messengers to take David , she said , " He is sick . "

verses.z: 掃羅又打發人去看大衛，說：「當連床將他抬來，我好殺他。」
verses.e: Saul sent the messengers to see David , saying , " Bring him up to me in the bed , that I may kill him . "

verses.z: 使者進去，看見床上有神像，頭枕在山羊毛裝的枕頭上。
verses.e: When the messengers came in , behold , the teraphim was in the bed , with the pillow of goats ' hair at its head .

verses.z: 掃羅對米甲說：「你為甚麼這樣欺哄我，放我仇敵逃走呢？」米甲回答說：「他對我說：『你放我走，不然我要殺你。』」
verses.e: Saul said to Michal , " Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go , so that he has escaped ? " Michal answered Saul , " He said to me , ' Let me go ! Why should I kill you ? ' "

verses.z: 大衛逃避，來到拉瑪見撒母耳，將掃羅向他所行的事述說了一遍。他和撒母耳就往拿約去居住。
verses.e: Now David fled and escaped , and came to Samuel at Ramah , and told him all that Saul had done to him . He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth .

verses.z: 有人告訴掃羅，說大衛在拉瑪的拿約。
verses.e: Saul was told , saying , " Behold , David is at Naioth in Ramah . "

verses.z: 約拿單告訴大衛說：「我父掃羅想要殺你，所以明日早晨你要小心，到一個僻靜地方藏身。
verses.e: Jonathan told David , saying , " Saul my father seeks to kill you . Now therefore , please take care of yourself in the morning , live in a secret place , and hide yourself .

verses.z: 掃羅打發人去捉拿大衛。去的人見有一班先知都受感說話，撒母耳站在其中監管他們；打發去的人也受上帝的靈感動說話。
verses.e: Saul sent messengers to seize David ; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying , and Samuel standing as head over them , God's Spirit came on Saul's messengers , and they also prophesied .

verses.z: 有人將這事告訴掃羅，他又打發人去，他們也受感說話。掃羅第三次打發人去，他們也受感說話。
verses.e: When Saul was told , he sent other messengers , and they also prophesied . Saul sent messengers again the third time , and they also prophesied .

verses.z: 然後掃羅自己往拉瑪去，到了西沽的大井，問人說：「撒母耳和大衛在哪裏呢？」有人說：「在拉瑪的拿約。」
verses.e: Then he also went to Ramah , and came to the great well that is in Secu : and he asked , " Where are Samuel and David ? " One said , " Behold , they are at Naioth in Ramah . "

verses.z: 他就往拉瑪的拿約去。上帝的靈也感動他，一面走一面說話，直到拉瑪的拿約。
verses.e: He went there to Naioth in Ramah . Then God's Spirit came on him also , and he went on , and prophesied , until he came to Naioth in Ramah .

verses.z: 他就脫了衣服，在撒母耳面前受感說話，一晝一夜露體躺臥。因此有句俗語說：「掃羅也列在先知中嗎？」
verses.e: He also stripped off his clothes . He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night . Therefore they say , " Is Saul also among the prophets ? "

verses.z: 我就出到你所藏的田裏，站在我父親旁邊與他談論。我看他情形怎樣，我必告訴你。」
verses.e: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are , and I will talk with my father about you ; and if I see anything , I will tell you . "

verses.z: 約拿單向他父親掃羅替大衛說好話，說：「王不可得罪王的僕人大衛；因為他未曾得罪你，他所行的都與你大有益處。
verses.e: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father , and said to him , " Don't let the king sin against his servant , against David ; because he has not sinned against you , and because his works have been very good toward you ;

verses.z: 他拚命殺那非利士人，耶和華為以色列眾人大行拯救；那時你看見，甚是歡喜，現在為何無故要殺大衛，流無辜人的血，自己取罪呢？」
verses.e: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine , and the LORD worked a great victory for all Israel . You saw it and rejoiced . Why then will you sin against innocent blood , to kill David without a cause ? "

verses.z: 掃羅聽了約拿單的話，就指着永生的耶和華起誓說：「我必不殺他。」
verses.e: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan ; and Saul swore , " As the LORD lives , he shall not be put to death . "

verses.z: 約拿單叫大衛來，把這一切事告訴他，帶他去見掃羅。他就仍然侍立在掃羅面前。
verses.e: Jonathan called David , and Jonathan showed him all those things . Then Jonathan brought David to Saul , and he was in his presence as before .

verses.z: 此後又有爭戰的事。大衛出去與非利士人打仗，大大殺敗他們，他們就在他面前逃跑。
verses.e: There was war again . David went out and fought with the Philistines , and killed them with a great slaughter ; and they fled before him .

verses.z: 從耶和華那裏來的惡魔又降在掃羅身上（掃羅手裏拿槍坐在屋裏），大衛就用手彈琴。
verses.e: An evil spirit from the LORD was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand ; and David was playing music with his hand .

verses.z: 哈拿禱告說：我的心因耶和華快樂；我的角因耶和華高舉。我的口向仇敵張開；我因耶和華的救恩歡欣。
verses.e: Hannah prayed , and said , " My heart exults in the LORD ! My horn is exalted in the LORD . My mouth is enlarged over my enemies , because I rejoice in your salvation .

verses.z: 與耶和華爭競的，必被打碎；耶和華必從天上以雷攻擊他，必審判地極的人，將力量賜與所立的王，高舉受膏者的角。
verses.e: Those who strive with the LORD shall be broken to pieces . He will thunder against them in the sky . " The LORD will judge the ends of the earth . He will give strength to his king , and exalt the horn of his anointed . "

verses.z: 以利加拿往拉瑪回家去了。那孩子在祭司以利面前事奉耶和華。
verses.e: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house . The child served the LORD before Eli the priest .

verses.z: 以利的兩個兒子是惡人，不認識耶和華。
verses.e: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men . They didn't know the LORD .

verses.z: 這二祭司待百姓是這樣的規矩：凡有人獻祭，正煮肉的時候，祭司的僕人就來，手拿三齒的叉子，
verses.e: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice , the priest's servant came while the meat was boiling , with a fork of three teeth in his hand ;

verses.z: 將叉子往罐裏，或鼎裏，或釜裏，或鍋裏一插，插上來的肉，祭司都取了去。凡上到示羅的以色列人，他們都是這樣看待。
verses.e: and he stabbed it into the pan , or kettle , or cauldron , or pot . The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself . They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh .

verses.z: 又在未燒脂油以前，祭司的僕人就來對獻祭的人說：「將肉給祭司，叫他烤吧。他不要煮過的，要生的。」
verses.e: Yes , before they burned the fat , the priest's servant came , and said to the man who sacrificed , " Give meat to roast for the priest ; for he will not accept boiled meat from you , but raw . "

verses.z: 獻祭的人若說：「必須先燒脂油，然後你可以隨意取肉。」僕人就說：「你立時給我，不然我便搶去。」
verses.e: If the man said to him , " Let the fat be burned first , and then take as much as your soul desires ; " then he would say , " No , but you shall give it to me now ; and if not , I will take it by force . "

verses.z: 如此，這二少年人的罪在耶和華面前甚重了，因為他們藐視耶和華的祭物。
verses.e: The sin of the young men was very great before the LORD ; for the men despised the LORD's offering .

verses.z: 那時，撒母耳還是孩子，穿着細麻布的以弗得，侍立在耶和華面前。
verses.e: But Samuel ministered before the LORD , being a child , clothed with a linen ephod .

verses.z: 他母親每年為他做一件小外袍，同着丈夫上來獻年祭的時候帶來給他。
verses.e: Moreover his mother made him a little robe , and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .

verses.z: 只有耶和華為聖；除他以外沒有可比的，也沒有磐石像我們的上帝。
verses.e: There is no one as holy as the LORD , for there is no one besides you , nor is there any rock like our God .

verses.z: 以利為以利加拿和他的妻祝福，說：「願耶和華由這婦人再賜你後裔，代替你從耶和華求來的孩子。」他們就回本鄉去了。
verses.e: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife , and said , " May the LORD give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of the LORD . " Then they went to their own home .

verses.z: 耶和華眷顧哈拿，她就懷孕生了三個兒子，兩個女兒。那孩子撒母耳在耶和華面前漸漸長大。
verses.e: The LORD visited Hannah , and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters . The child Samuel grew before the LORD .

verses.z: 以利年甚老邁，聽見他兩個兒子待以色列眾人的事，又聽見他們與會幕門前伺候的婦人苟合，
verses.e: Now Eli was very old ; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel , and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 他就對他們說：「你們為何行這樣的事呢？我從這眾百姓聽見你們的惡行。
verses.e: He said to them , " Why do you do such things ? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people .

verses.z: 我兒啊，不可這樣！我聽見你們的風聲不好，你們使耶和華的百姓犯了罪。
verses.e: No , my sons ; for it is not a good report that I hear ! You make the LORD's people disobey .

verses.z: 人若得罪人，有士師審判他；人若得罪耶和華，誰能為他祈求呢？」然而他們還是不聽父親的話，因為耶和華想要殺他們。
verses.e: If one man sins against another , God will judge him ; but if a man sins against the LORD , who will intercede for him ? " Notwithstanding , they didn't listen to the voice of their father , because the LORD intended to kill them .

verses.z: 孩子撒母耳漸漸長大，耶和華與人越發喜愛他。
verses.e: The child Samuel grew on , and increased in favor both with the LORD and also with men .

verses.z: 有神人來見以利，對他說：「耶和華如此說：『你祖父在埃及法老家[作奴僕]的時候，我不是向他們顯現嗎？
verses.e: A man of God came to Eli and said to him , " The LORD says , ' Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh's house ?

verses.z: 在以色列眾支派中，我不是揀選人作我的祭司，使他燒香，在我壇上獻祭，在我面前穿以弗得，又將以色列人所獻的火祭都賜給你父家嗎？
verses.e: Didn't I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest , to go up to my altar , to burn incense , to wear an ephod before me ? Didn't I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire ?

verses.z: 我所吩咐獻在我居所的祭物，你們為何踐踏？尊重你的兒子過於尊重我，將我民以色列所獻美好的祭物肥己呢？』
verses.e: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering , which I have commanded in my habitation , and honor your sons above me , to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people ? '

verses.z: 人不要誇口說驕傲的話，也不要出狂妄的言語；因耶和華是大有智識的上帝，人的行為被他衡量。
verses.e: " Don't keep talking so exceedingly proudly . Don't let arrogance come out of your mouth , for the LORD is a God of knowledge . By him actions are weighed .

verses.z: 因此，耶和華－以色列的上帝說：『我曾說，你和你父家必永遠行在我面前；現在我卻說，決不容你們這樣行。因為尊重我的，我必重看他；藐視我的，他必被輕視。
verses.e: " Therefore the LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever . ' But now the LORD says , ' Far be it from me ; for those who honor me I will honor , and those who despise me will be cursed .

verses.z: 日子必到，我要折斷你的膀臂和你父家的膀臂，使你家中沒有一個老年人。
verses.e: Behold , the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father's house , that there will not be an old man in your house .

verses.z: 在[上帝]使以色列人享福的時候，你必看見我居所的敗落。在你家中必永遠沒有一個老年人。
verses.e: You will see the affliction of my habitation , in all the wealth which I will give Israel . There shall not be an old man in your house forever .

verses.z: 我必不從我壇前滅盡你家中的人；那未滅的必使你眼目乾癟、心中憂傷。你家中所生的人都必死在中年。
verses.e: The man of yours whom I don't cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart . All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age .

verses.z: 你的兩個兒子何弗尼、非尼哈所遭遇的事可作你的證據：他們二人必一日同死。
verses.e: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons , on Hophni and Phinehas : in one day they will both die .

verses.z: 我要為自己立一個忠心的祭司；他必照我的心意而行。我要為他建立堅固的家；他必永遠行在我的受膏者面前。
verses.e: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind . I will build him a sure house . He will walk before my anointed forever .

verses.z: 你家所剩下的人都必來叩拜他，求塊銀子，求個餅，說：求你賜我祭司的職分，好叫我得點餅吃。』」
verses.e: It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread , and will say , " Please put me into one of the priests ' offices , that I may eat a morsel of bread . " ' "

verses.z: 勇士的弓都已折斷；跌倒的人以力量束腰。
verses.e: " The bows of the mighty men are broken . Those who stumbled are armed with strength .

verses.z: 素來飽足的，反作用人求食；飢餓的，再不飢餓。不生育的，生了七個兒子；多有兒女的，反倒衰微。
verses.e: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread . Those who were hungry are satisfied . Yes , the barren has borne seven . She who has many children languishes .

verses.z: 耶和華使人死，也使人活，使人下陰間，也使人往上升。
verses.e: " The LORD kills and makes alive . He brings down to Sheol and brings up .

verses.z: 他使人貧窮，也使人富足，使人卑微，也使人高貴。
verses.e: The LORD makes poor and makes rich . He brings low , he also lifts up .

verses.z: 他從灰塵裏抬舉貧寒人，從糞堆中提拔窮乏人，使他們與王子同坐，得着榮耀的座位。地的柱子屬於耶和華；他將世界立在其上。
verses.e: He raises up the poor out of the dust . He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory . For the pillars of the earth are the LORD's . He has set the world on them .

verses.z: 他必保護聖民的腳步，使惡人在黑暗中寂然不動；人都不能靠力量得勝。
verses.e: He will keep the feet of his holy ones , but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness ; for no man will prevail by strength .

verses.z: 大衛從拉瑪的拿約逃跑，來到約拿單那裏，對他說：「我做了甚麼？有甚麼罪孽呢？在你父親面前犯了甚麼罪，他竟尋索我的性命呢？」
verses.e: David fled from Naioth in Ramah , and came and said to Jonathan , " What have I done ? What is my iniquity ? What is my sin before your father , that he seeks my life ? "

verses.z: 大衛對約拿單說：「你父親若用厲言回答你，誰來告訴我呢？」
verses.e: Then David said to Jonathan , " Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly ? "

verses.z: 約拿單對大衛說：「你我且往田野去。」二人就往田野去了。
verses.e: Jonathan said to David , " Come ! Let's go out into the field . " They both went out into the field .

verses.z: 約拿單對大衛說：「願耶和華－以色列的上帝[為證]。明日約在這時候，或第三日，我探我父親的意思，若向你有好意，我豈不打發人告訴你嗎？
verses.e: Jonathan said to David , " By the LORD , the God of Israel , when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow , or the third day , behold , if there is good toward David , won't I then send to you and disclose it to you ?

verses.z: 我父親若有意害你，我不告訴你使你平平安安地走，願耶和華重重地降罰與我。願耶和華與你同在，如同從前與我父親同在一樣。
verses.e: The LORD do so to Jonathan and more also , should it please my father to do you evil , if I don't disclose it to you and send you away , that you may go in peace . May the LORD be with you as he has been with my father .

verses.z: 你要照耶和華的慈愛恩待我，不但我活着的時候免我死亡，
verses.e: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of the LORD while I still live , that I not die ;

verses.z: 就是我死後，耶和華從地上剪除你仇敵的時候，你也永不可向我家絕了恩惠。」
verses.e: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever , no , not when the LORD has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth . "

verses.z: 於是約拿單與大衛家結盟，[說]：「願耶和華藉大衛的仇敵追討[背約]的罪。」
verses.e: So Jonathan made a covenant with David's house , saying , " The LORD will require it at the hand of David's enemies . "

verses.z: 約拿單因愛大衛如同愛自己的性命，就使他再起誓。
verses.e: Jonathan caused David to swear again , for the love that he had to him ; for he loved him as he loved his own soul .

verses.z: 約拿單對他說：「明日是初一，你的座位空設，人必理會你不在那裏。
verses.e: Then Jonathan said to him , " Tomorrow is the new moon , and you will be missed , because your seat will be empty .

verses.z: 你等三日，就要速速下去，到你從前遇事所藏的地方，在以色磐石那裏等候。
verses.e: When you have stayed three days , go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started , and remain by the stone Ezel .

verses.z: 約拿單回答說：「斷然不是！你必不致死。我父做事，無論大小，沒有不叫我知道的。怎麼獨有這事隱瞞我呢？決不如此。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Far from it ; you will not die . Behold , my father does nothing either great or small , but that he discloses it to me . Why would my father hide this thing from me ? It is not so . "

verses.z: 我要向磐石旁邊射三箭，如同射箭靶一樣。
verses.e: I will shoot three arrows on its side , as though I shot at a mark .

verses.z: 我要打發童子，[說]：『去把箭找來。』我若對童子說：『箭在後頭，把箭拿來』，你就可以回來；我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你必平安無事。
verses.e: Behold , I will send the boy , saying , ' Go , find the arrows ! ' If I tell the boy , ' Behold , the arrows are on this side of you . Take them ; ' then come , for there is peace to you and no danger , as the LORD lives .

verses.z: 我若對童子說：『箭在前頭』，你就要去，因為是耶和華打發你去的。
verses.e: But if I say this to the boy , ' Behold , the arrows are beyond you , ' then go your way , for the LORD has sent you away .

verses.z: 至於你我今日所說的話，有耶和華在你我中間[為證]，直到永遠。」
verses.e: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of , behold , the LORD is between you and me forever . "

verses.z: 大衛就去藏在田野。到了初一日，王坐席要吃飯。
verses.e: So David hid himself in the field . When the new moon had come , the king sat himself down to eat food .

verses.z: 王照常坐在靠牆的位上，約拿單侍立，押尼珥坐在掃羅旁邊，大衛的座位空設。
verses.e: The king sat on his seat , as at other times , even on the seat by the wall ; and Jonathan stood up , and Abner sat by Saul's side , but David's place was empty .

verses.z: 然而這日掃羅沒有說甚麼，他想大衛遇事，偶染不潔，他必定是不潔。
verses.e: Nevertheless Saul didn't say anything that day , for he thought , " Something has happened to him . He is not clean . Surely he is not clean . "

verses.z: 初二日大衛的座位還空設。掃羅問他兒子約拿單說：「耶西的兒子為何昨日、今日沒有來吃飯呢？」
verses.e: On the next day after the new moon , the second day , David's place was empty . Saul said to Jonathan his son , " Why didn't the son of Jesse come to eat , either yesterday , or today ? "

verses.z: 約拿單回答掃羅說：「大衛切求我容他往伯利恆去。
verses.e: Jonathan answered Saul , " David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem .

verses.z: 他說：『求你容我去，因為我家在城裏有獻祭的事；我長兄吩咐我去。如今我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你容我去見我的弟兄』；所以大衛沒有赴王的席。」
verses.e: He said , ' Please let me go , for our family has a sacrifice in the city . My brother has commanded me to be there . Now , if I have found favor in your eyes , please let me go away and see my brothers . ' Therefore he has not come to the king's table . "

verses.z: 大衛又起誓說：「你父親準知我在你眼前蒙恩。他心裏說，不如不叫約拿單知道，恐怕他愁煩。我指着永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓，我離死不過一步。」
verses.e: David swore moreover , and said , " Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes ; and he says , ' Don't let Jonathan know this , lest he be grieved ; ' but truly as the LORD lives , and as your soul lives , there is but a step between me and death . "

verses.z: 掃羅向約拿單發怒，對他說：「你這頑梗背逆之婦人所生的，我豈不知道你喜悅耶西的兒子，自取羞辱，以致你母親露體蒙羞嗎？
verses.e: Then Saul's anger burned against Jonathan , and he said to him , " You son of a perverse rebellious woman , don't I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame , and to the shame of your mother's nakedness ?

verses.z: 耶西的兒子若在世間活着，你和你的國位必站立不住。現在你要打發人去，將他捉拿交給我；他是該死的。」
verses.e: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth , you will not be established , nor will your kingdom . Therefore now send and bring him to me , for he shall surely die ! "

verses.z: 約拿單對父親掃羅說：「他為甚麼該死呢？他做了甚麼呢？」
verses.e: Jonathan answered Saul his father , and said to him , " Why should he be put to death ? What has he done ? "

verses.z: 掃羅向約拿單掄槍要刺他，約拿單就知道他父親決意要殺大衛。
verses.e: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him . By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death .

verses.z: 於是約拿單氣忿忿地從席上起來，在這初二日沒有吃飯。他因見父親羞辱大衛，就為大衛愁煩。
verses.e: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger , and ate no food the second day of the month ; for he was grieved for David , because his father had treated him shamefully .

verses.z: 次日早晨，約拿單按着與大衛約會的時候出到田野，有一個童子跟隨。
verses.e: In the morning , Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David , and a little boy with him .

verses.z: 約拿單對童子說：「你跑去，把我所射的箭找來。」童子跑去，約拿單就把箭射在童子前頭。
verses.e: He said to his boy , " Run , find now the arrows which I shoot . " As the boy ran , he shot an arrow beyond him .

verses.z: 童子到了約拿單落箭之地，約拿單呼叫童子說：「箭不是在你前頭嗎？」
verses.e: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot , Jonathan cried after the boy , and said , " Isn't the arrow beyond you ? "

verses.z: 約拿單又呼叫童子說：「速速地去，不要遲延！」童子就拾起箭來，回到主人那裏。
verses.e: Jonathan cried after the boy , " Go fast ! Hurry ! Don't delay ! " Jonathan's boy gathered up the arrows , and came to his master .

verses.z: 童子卻不知道這是甚麼意思，只有約拿單和大衛知道。
verses.e: But the boy didn't know anything . Only Jonathan and David knew the matter .

verses.z: 約拿單對大衛說：「你心裏所求的，我必為你成就。」
verses.e: Then Jonathan said to David , " Whatever your soul desires , I will even do it for you . "

verses.z: 約拿單將弓箭交給童子，吩咐說：「你拿到城裏去。」
verses.e: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy , and said to him , " Go , carry them to the city . "

verses.z: 童子一去，大衛就從[磐石]的南邊出來，俯伏在地，拜了三拜；二人親嘴，彼此哭泣，大衛哭得更慟。
verses.e: As soon as the boy was gone , David arose out of the south , and fell on his face to the ground , and bowed himself three times . They kissed one another and wept with one another , and David wept the most .

verses.z: 約拿單對大衛說：「我們二人曾指着耶和華的名起誓說：『願耶和華在你我中間，並你我後裔中間[為證]，直到永遠。』如今你平平安安地去吧！」大衛就起身走了；約拿單也回城裏去了。
verses.e: Jonathan said to David , " Go in peace , because we have both sworn in the LORD's name , saying , ' The LORD is between me and you , and between my offspring and your offspring , forever . ' " He arose and departed ; and Jonathan went into the city .

verses.z: 大衛對約拿單說：「明日是初一，我當與王同席，求你容我去藏在田野，直到第三日晚上。
verses.e: David said to Jonathan , " Behold , tomorrow is the new moon , and I should not fail to dine with the king ; but let me go , that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening .

verses.z: 你父親若見我不在席上，你就說：『大衛切求我許他回本城伯利恆去，因為他全家在那裏獻年祭。』
verses.e: If your father misses me at all , then say , ' David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem , his city ; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family . '

verses.z: 你父親若說好，僕人就平安了；他若發怒，你就知道他決意要害我。
verses.e: If he says , ' It is well , ' your servant shall have peace ; but if he is angry , then know that evil is determined by him .

verses.z: 求你施恩與僕人，因你在耶和華面前曾與僕人結盟。我若有罪，不如你自己殺我，何必將我交給你父親呢？」
verses.e: Therefore deal kindly with your servant , for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the LORD with you ; but if there is iniquity in me , kill me yourself , for why should you bring me to your father ? "

verses.z: 約拿單說：「斷無此事！我若知道我父親決意害你，我豈不告訴你呢？」
verses.e: Jonathan said , " Far be it from you ; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you , then wouldn't I tell you that ? "

verses.z: 大衛到了挪伯祭司亞希米勒那裏，亞希米勒戰戰兢兢地出來迎接他，問他說：「你為甚麼獨自來，沒有人跟隨呢？」
verses.e: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest . Ahimelech came to meet David trembling , and said to him , " Why are you alone , and no man with you ? "

verses.z: 那日大衛起來，躲避掃羅，逃到迦特王亞吉那裏。
verses.e: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul , and went to Achish the king of Gath .

verses.z: 亞吉的臣僕對亞吉說：「這不是[以色列]國王大衛嗎？那裏的婦女跳舞唱和，不是指着他說『掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬』嗎？」
verses.e: The servants of Achish said to him , " Isn't this David the king of the land ? Didn't they sing to one another about him in dances , saying , ' Saul has slain his thousands , and David his ten thousands ' ? "

verses.z: 大衛將這話放在心裏，甚懼怕迦特王亞吉，
verses.e: David laid up these words in his heart , and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath .

verses.z: 就在眾人面前改變了尋常的舉動，在他們手下假裝瘋癲，在城門的門扇上胡寫亂畫，使唾沫流在鬍子上。
verses.e: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands , and scribbled on the doors of the gate , and let his spittle fall down on his beard .

verses.z: 亞吉對臣僕說：「你們看，這人是瘋子。為甚麼帶他到我這裏來呢？
verses.e: Then Achish said to his servants , " Look , you see the man is insane . Why then have you brought him to me ?

verses.z: 我豈缺少瘋子，你們帶這人來在我面前瘋癲嗎？這人豈可進我的家呢？」
verses.e: Do I lack madmen , that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence ? Should this fellow come into my house ? "

verses.z: 大衛回答祭司亞希米勒說：「王吩咐我一件事說：『我差遣你委託你的這件事，不要使人知道。』故此我已派定少年人在某處等候我。
verses.e: David said to Ahimelech the priest , " The king has commanded me to do something , and has said to me , ' Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you , and what I have commanded you . I have sent the young men to a certain place . '

verses.z: 現在你手下有甚麼？求你給我五個餅或是別樣的食物。」
verses.e: Now therefore what is under your hand ? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand , or whatever is available . "

verses.z: 祭司對大衛說：「我手下沒有尋常的餅，只有聖餅；若少年人沒有親近婦人才可以給。」
verses.e: The priest answered David , and said , " I have no common bread , but there is holy bread ; if only the young men have kept themselves from women . "

verses.z: 大衛對祭司說：「實在約有三日我們沒有親近婦人；我出來的時候，雖是尋常行路，少年人的器皿還是潔淨的；何況今日不更是潔淨嗎？」
verses.e: David answered the priest , and said to him , " Truly , women have been kept from us as usual these three days . When I came out , the vessels of the young men were holy , though it was only a common journey . How much more then today shall their vessels be holy ? "

verses.z: 祭司就拿聖[餅]給他；因為在那裏沒有別樣餅，只有更換新餅，從耶和華面前撤下來的陳設餅。（
verses.e: So the priest gave him holy bread ; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before the LORD , to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away .

verses.z: 當日有掃羅的一個臣子留在耶和華面前。他名叫多益，是以東人，作掃羅的司牧長。）
verses.e: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the LORD ; and his name was Doeg the Edomite , the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul .

verses.z: 大衛問亞希米勒說：「你手下有槍有刀沒有？因為王的事甚急，連刀劍器械我都沒有帶。」
verses.e: David said to Ahimelech , " Isn't there here under your hand spear or sword ? For I haven't brought my sword or my weapons with me , because the king's business required haste . "

verses.z: 祭司說：「你在以拉谷殺非利士人歌利亞的那刀在這裏，裹在布中，放在以弗得後邊，你要就可以拿去；除此以外，再沒有別的。」大衛說：「這刀沒有可比的！求你給我。」
verses.e: The priest said , " Behold , the sword of Goliath the Philistine , whom you killed in the valley of Elah , is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod . If you would like to take that , take it , for there is no other except that here . " David said , " There is none like that . Give it to me . "

verses.z: 大衛就離開那裏，逃到亞杜蘭洞。他的弟兄和他父親的全家聽見了，就都下到他那裏。
verses.e: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam's cave . When his brothers and all his father's house heard it , they went down there to him .

verses.z: 亞希米勒為他求問耶和華，又給他食物，並給他[殺]非利士人歌利亞的刀。」
verses.e: He inquired of the LORD for him , gave him food , and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine . "

verses.z: 王就打發人將祭司亞希突的兒子亞希米勒和他父親的全家，就是住挪伯的祭司都召了來；他們就來見王。
verses.e: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father's house , the priests who were in Nob ; and they all came to the king .

verses.z: 掃羅說：「亞希突的兒子，要聽我的話！」他回答說：「主啊，我在這裏。」
verses.e: Saul said , " Hear now , you son of Ahitub . " He answered , " Here I am , my lord . "

verses.z: 掃羅對他說：「你為甚麼與耶西的兒子結黨害我，將食物和刀給他，又為他求問上帝，使他起來謀害我，就如今日的光景？」
verses.e: Saul said to him , " Why have you conspired against me , you and the son of Jesse , in that you have given him bread , and a sword , and have inquired of God for him , that he should rise against me , to lie in wait , as it is today ? "

verses.z: 亞希米勒回答王說：「王的臣僕中有誰比大衛忠心呢？他是王的女婿，又是王的參謀，並且在王家中是尊貴的。
verses.e: Then Ahimelech answered the king , and said , " Who among all your servants is so faithful as David , who is the king's son-in-law , captain of your body guard , and honored in your house ?

verses.z: 我豈是從今日才為他求問上帝呢？斷不是這樣！王不要將罪歸我和我父的全家；因為這事，無論大小，僕人都不知道。」
verses.e: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him ? Be it far from me ! Don't let the king impute anything to his servant , nor to all the house of my father ; for your servant knew nothing of all this , less or more . "

verses.z: 王說：「亞希米勒啊，你和你父的全家都是該死的！」
verses.e: The king said , " You shall surely die , Ahimelech , you and all your father's house . "

verses.z: 王就吩咐左右的侍衛說：「你們去殺耶和華的祭司；因為他們幫助大衛，又知道大衛逃跑，竟沒有告訴我。」掃羅的臣子卻不肯伸手殺耶和華的祭司。
verses.e: The king said to the guard who stood about him , " Turn and kill the priests of the LORD , because their hand also is with David , and because they knew that he fled and didn't disclose it to me . " But the servants of the king wouldn't put out their hand to fall on the priests of the LORD .

verses.z: 王吩咐多益說：「你去殺祭司吧！」以東人多益就去殺祭司，那日殺了穿細麻布以弗得的八十五人；
verses.e: The king said to Doeg , " Turn and attack the priests ! " Doeg the Edomite turned , and he attacked the priests , and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod .

verses.z: 又用刀將祭司城挪伯中的男女、孩童、吃奶的，和牛、羊、驢盡都殺滅。
verses.e: He struck Nob , the city of the priests , with the edge of the sword — both men and women , children and nursing babies , and cattle , donkeys , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .

verses.z: 凡受窘迫的、欠債的、心裏苦惱的都聚集到大衛那裏；大衛就作他們的頭目，跟隨他的約有四百人。
verses.e: Everyone who was in distress , everyone who was in debt , and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him ; and he became captain over them . There were with him about four hundred men .

verses.z: 亞希突的兒子亞希米勒有一個兒子，名叫亞比亞他，逃到大衛那裏。
verses.e: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub , named Abiathar , escaped and fled after David .

verses.z: 亞比亞他將掃羅殺耶和華祭司的事告訴大衛。
verses.e: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain the LORD's priests .

verses.z: 大衛對亞比亞他說：「那日我見以東人多益在那裏，就知道他必告訴掃羅。你父的全家[喪]命，都是因我的緣故。
verses.e: David said to Abiathar , " I knew on that day , when Doeg the Edomite was there , that he would surely tell Saul . I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father's house .

verses.z: 你可以住在我這裏，不要懼怕。因為尋索你命的就是尋索我的命；你在我這裏可得保全。」
verses.e: Stay with me . Don't be afraid , for he who seeks my life seeks your life . You will be safe with me . "

verses.z: 大衛從那裏往摩押的米斯巴去，對摩押王說：「求你容我父母搬來，住在你們這裏，等我知道上帝要為我怎樣行。」
verses.e: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab ; and he said to the king of Moab , " Please let my father and my mother come out to you , until I know what God will do for me . "

verses.z: 大衛領他父母到摩押王面前。大衛住山寨多少日子，他父母也住摩押王那裏多少日子。
verses.e: He brought them before the king of Moab ; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold .

verses.z: 先知迦得對大衛說：「你不要住在山寨，要往猶大地去。」大衛就離開那裏，進入哈列的樹林。
verses.e: The prophet Gad said to David , " Don't stay in the stronghold . Depart , and go into the land of Judah . " Then David departed , and came into the forest of Hereth .

verses.z: 掃羅在基比亞的拉瑪，坐在垂絲柳樹下，手裏拿着槍，眾臣僕侍立在左右。掃羅聽見大衛和跟隨他的人在何處，
verses.e: Saul heard that David was discovered , with the men who were with him . Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah , under the tamarisk tree in Ramah , with his spear in his hand , and all his servants were standing around him .

verses.z: 就對左右侍立的臣僕說：「便雅憫人哪，你們要聽我的話！耶西的兒子能將田地和葡萄園賜給你們各人嗎？能立你們各人作千夫長百夫長嗎？
verses.e: Saul said to his servants who stood around him , " Hear now , you Benjamites ! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards ? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds ?

verses.z: 你們竟都結黨害我！我的兒子與耶西的兒子結盟的時候，無人告訴我；我的兒子挑唆我的臣子謀害我，就如今日的光景，也無人告訴我，為我憂慮。」
verses.e: Is that why all of you have conspired against me , and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you who is sorry for me , or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as it is today ? "

verses.z: 那時以東人多益站在掃羅的臣僕中，對他說：「我曾看見耶西的兒子到了挪伯，亞希突的兒子亞希米勒那裏。
verses.e: Then Doeg the Edomite , who stood by the servants of Saul , answered and said , " I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob , to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛說：「非利士人攻擊基伊拉，搶奪禾場。」
verses.e: David was told , " Behold , the Philistines are fighting against Keilah , and are robbing the threshing floors . "

verses.z: 大衛禱告說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，你僕人聽真了掃羅要往基伊拉來，為我的緣故滅城。
verses.e: Then David said , " O LORD , the God of Israel , your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake .

verses.z: 基伊拉人將我交在掃羅手裏不交？掃羅照着你僕人所聽的話下來不下來？耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，求你指示僕人！」耶和華說：「掃羅必下來。」
verses.e: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand ? Will Saul come down , as your servant has heard ? LORD , the God of Israel , I beg you , tell your servant . " The LORD said , " He will come down . "

verses.z: 大衛又說：「基伊拉人將我和跟隨我的人交在掃羅手裏不交？」耶和華說：「必交出來。」
verses.e: Then David said , " Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul ? " The LORD said , " They will deliver you up . "

verses.z: 大衛和跟隨他的約有六百人，就起身出了基伊拉，往他們所能往的地方去。有人告訴掃羅，大衛離開基伊拉逃走；於是掃羅不出來了。
verses.e: Then David and his men , who were about six hundred , arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go . Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah ; and he gave up going there .

verses.z: 大衛住在曠野的山寨裏，常在西弗曠野的山地。掃羅天天尋索大衛，上帝卻不將大衛交在他手裏。
verses.e: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds , and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph . Saul sought him every day , but God didn't deliver him into his hand .

verses.z: 大衛知道掃羅出來尋索他的命。那時，他住在西弗曠野的樹林裏；
verses.e: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life . David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods .

verses.z: 掃羅的兒子約拿單起身，往那樹林裏去見大衛，使他倚靠上帝得以堅固，
verses.e: Jonathan , Saul's son , arose and went to David into the woods , and strengthened his hand in God .

verses.z: 對他說：「不要懼怕！我父掃羅的手必不加害於你；你必作以色列的王，我也作你的宰相。這事我父掃羅知道了。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Don't be afraid , for the hand of Saul my father won't find you ; and you will be king over Israel , and I will be next to you ; and Saul my father knows that also . "

verses.z: 於是二人在耶和華面前立約。大衛仍住在樹林裏，約拿單回家去了。
verses.e: They both made a covenant before the LORD . Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house .

verses.z: 西弗人上到基比亞見掃羅，說：「大衛不是在我們那裏的樹林裏山寨中、曠野南邊的哈基拉山藏着嗎？
verses.e: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah , saying , " Doesn't David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods , in the hill of Hachilah , which is on the south of the desert ?

verses.z: 所以大衛求問耶和華說：「我去攻打那些非利士人可以不可以？」耶和華對大衛說：「你可以去攻打非利士人，拯救基伊拉。」
verses.e: Therefore David inquired of the LORD , saying , " Shall I go and strike these Philistines ? " The LORD said to David , " Go strike the Philistines , and save Keilah . "

verses.z: 王啊，請你隨你的心願下來，我們必親自將他交在王的手裏。」
verses.e: Now therefore , O king , come down . According to all the desire of your soul to come down ; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king's hand . "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「願耶和華賜福與你們，因你們顧恤我。
verses.e: Saul said , " You are blessed by the LORD , for you have had compassion on me .

verses.z: 請你們回去，再確實查明他的住處和行蹤，是誰看見他在那裏，因為我聽見人說他甚狡猾。
verses.e: Please go make yet more sure , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who has seen him there ; for I have been told that he is very cunning .

verses.z: 所以要看準他藏匿的地方，回來據實地告訴我，我就與你們同去。他若在猶大的境內，我必從千門萬戶中搜出他來。」
verses.e: See therefore , and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself ; and come again to me with certainty , and I will go with you . It shall happen , if he is in the land , that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah . "

verses.z: 西弗人就起身，在掃羅以先往西弗去。大衛和跟隨他的人卻在瑪雲曠野南邊的亞拉巴。
verses.e: They arose , and went to Ziph before Saul ; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon , in the Arabah on the south of the desert .

verses.z: 掃羅和跟隨他的人去尋找大衛；有人告訴大衛，他就下到磐石，住在瑪雲的曠野。掃羅聽見，便在瑪雲的曠野追趕大衛。
verses.e: Saul and his men went to seek him . When David was told , he went down to the rock , and stayed in the wilderness of Maon . When Saul heard that , he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon .

verses.z: 掃羅在山這邊走，大衛和跟隨他的人在山那邊走。大衛急忙躲避掃羅；因為掃羅和跟隨他的人，四面圍住大衛和跟隨他的人，要拿獲他們。
verses.e: Saul went on this side of the mountain , and David and his men on that side of the mountain ; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul , for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them .

verses.z: 忽有使者來報告掃羅說：「非利士人犯境搶掠，請王快快回去！」
verses.e: But a messenger came to Saul , saying , " Hurry and come , for the Philistines have made a raid on the land ! "

verses.z: 於是掃羅不追趕大衛，回去攻打非利士人。因此那地方名叫西拉‧哈瑪希羅結。
verses.e: So Saul returned from pursuing David , and went against the Philistines . Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth .

verses.z: 大衛從那裏上去，住在隱‧基底的山寨裏。
verses.e: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi .

verses.z: 跟隨大衛的人對他說：「我們在猶大地這裏尚且懼怕，何況往基伊拉去攻打非利士人的軍旅呢？」
verses.e: David's men said to him , " Behold , we are afraid here in Judah . How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines ? "

verses.z: 大衛又求問耶和華。耶和華回答說：「你起身下基伊拉去，我必將非利士人交在你手裏。」
verses.e: Then David inquired of the LORD yet again . The LORD answered him , and said , " Arise , go down to Keilah ; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand . "

verses.z: 大衛和跟隨他的人往基伊拉去，與非利士人打仗，大大殺敗他們，又奪獲他們的牲畜。這樣，大衛救了基伊拉的居民。
verses.e: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines , and brought away their livestock , and killed them with a great slaughter . So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah .

verses.z: 亞希米勒的兒子亞比亞他逃到基伊拉見大衛的時候，手裏拿着以弗得。
verses.e: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah , he came down with an ephod in his hand .

verses.z: 有人告訴掃羅說：「大衛到了基伊拉。」掃羅說：「他進了有門有閂的城，困閉在裏頭；這是上帝將他交在我手裏了。」
verses.e: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah . Saul said , " God has delivered him into my hand , for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars . "

verses.z: 於是掃羅招聚眾民，要下去攻打基伊拉城，圍困大衛和跟隨他的人。
verses.e: Saul summoned all the people to war , to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men .

verses.z: 大衛知道掃羅設計謀害他，就對祭司亞比亞他說：「將以弗得拿過來。」
verses.e: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him . He said to Abiathar the priest , " Bring the ephod here . "

verses.z: 掃羅追趕非利士人回來，有人告訴他說：「大衛在隱‧基底的曠野。」
verses.e: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines , he was told , " Behold , David is in the wilderness of En Gedi . "

verses.z: 今日你親眼看見在洞中，耶和華將你交在我手裏；有人叫我殺你，我卻愛惜你，說：『我不敢伸手害我的主，因為他是耶和華的受膏者。』
verses.e: Behold , today your eyes have seen how the LORD had delivered you today into my hand in the cave . Some urged me to kill you , but I spared you . I said , ' I will not stretch out my hand against my lord , for he is the LORD's anointed . '

verses.z: 我父啊，看看你外袍的衣襟在我手中。我割下你的衣襟，沒有殺你；你由此可以知道我沒有惡意叛逆你。你雖然獵取我的命，我卻沒有得罪你。
verses.e: Moreover , my father , behold , yes , see the skirt of your robe in my hand ; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn't kill you , know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand . I have not sinned against you , though you hunt for my life to take it .

verses.z: 願耶和華在你我中間判斷是非，在你身上為我伸冤，我卻不親手加害於你。
verses.e: May the LORD judge between me and you , and may the LORD avenge me of you ; but my hand will not be on you .

verses.z: 古人有句俗語說：『惡事出於惡人。』我卻不親手加害於你。
verses.e: As the proverb of the ancients says , ' Out of the wicked comes wickedness ; ' but my hand will not be on you .

verses.z: 以色列王出來要尋找誰呢？追趕誰呢？不過追趕一條死狗，一個虼蚤就是了。
verses.e: Against whom has the king of Israel come out ? Whom do you pursue ? A dead dog ? A flea ?

verses.z: 願耶和華在你我中間施行審判，斷定是非，並且鑒察，為我伸冤，救我脫離你的手。」
verses.e: May the LORD therefore be judge , and give sentence between me and you , and see , and plead my cause , and deliver me out of your hand . "

verses.z: 大衛向掃羅說完這話，掃羅說：「我兒大衛，這是你的聲音嗎？」就放聲大哭，
verses.e: It came to pass , when David had finished speaking these words to Saul , that Saul said , " Is that your voice , my son David ? " Saul lifted up his voice and wept .

verses.z: 對大衛說：「你比我公義；因為你以善待我，我卻以惡待你。
verses.e: He said to David , " You are more righteous than I ; for you have done good to me , whereas I have done evil to you .

verses.z: 你今日顯明是以善待我；因為耶和華將我交在你手裏，你卻沒有殺我。
verses.e: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me , because when the LORD had delivered me up into your hand , you didn't kill me .

verses.z: 人若遇見仇敵，豈肯放他平安無事地去呢？願耶和華因你今日向我所行的，以善報你。
verses.e: For if a man finds his enemy , will he let him go away unharmed ? Therefore may the LORD reward you good for that which you have done to me today .

verses.z: 掃羅就從以色列人中挑選三千精兵，率領他們往野羊的磐石去，尋索大衛和跟隨他的人。
verses.e: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats .

verses.z: 我也知道你必要作王，以色列的國必堅立在你手裏。
verses.e: Now , behold , I know that you will surely be king , and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand .

verses.z: 現在你要指着耶和華向我起誓，不剪除我的後裔，在我父家不滅沒我的名。」
verses.e: Swear now therefore to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my offspring after me , and that you will not destroy my name out of my father's house . "

verses.z: 於是大衛向掃羅起誓，掃羅就回家去；大衛和跟隨他的人上山寨去了。
verses.e: David swore to Saul . Saul went home , but David and his men went up to the stronghold .

verses.z: 到了路旁的羊圈，在那裏有洞，掃羅進去大解。大衛和跟隨他的人正藏在洞裏的深處。
verses.e: He came to the sheep pens by the way , where there was a cave ; and Saul went in to relieve himself . Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave .

verses.z: 跟隨的人對大衛說：「耶和華曾應許你說：『我要將你的仇敵交在你手裏，你可以任意待他。』如今時候到了！」大衛就起來，悄悄地割下掃羅外袍的衣襟。
verses.e: David's men said to him , " Behold , the day of which the LORD said to you , ' Behold , I will deliver your enemy into your hand , and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you . ' " Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe secretly .

verses.z: 隨後大衛心中自責，因為割下掃羅的衣襟；
verses.e: Afterward , David's heart struck him because he had cut off Saul's skirt .

verses.z: 對跟隨他的人說：「我的主乃是耶和華的受膏者，我在耶和華面前萬不敢伸手害他，因他是耶和華的受膏者。」
verses.e: He said to his men , " The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord , the LORD's anointed , to stretch out my hand against him , since he is the LORD's anointed . "

verses.z: 大衛用這話攔住跟隨他的人，不容他們起來害掃羅。掃羅起來，從洞裏出去行路。
verses.e: So David checked his men with these words , and didn't allow them to rise against Saul . Saul rose up out of the cave , and went on his way .

verses.z: 隨後大衛也起來，從洞裏出去，呼叫掃羅說：「我主，我王！」掃羅回頭觀看，大衛就屈身、臉伏於地下拜。
verses.e: David also arose afterward , and went out of the cave and cried after Saul , saying , " My lord the king ! " When Saul looked behind him , David bowed with his face to the earth , and showed respect .

verses.z: 大衛對掃羅說：「你為何聽信人的讒言，說大衛想要害你呢？
verses.e: David said to Saul , " Why do you listen to men's words , saying , ' Behold , David seeks to harm you ' ?

verses.z: 撒母耳死了，以色列眾人聚集，為他哀哭，將他葬在拉瑪－他自己的墳墓裏。大衛起身，下到巴蘭的曠野。
verses.e: Samuel died ; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him , and buried him at his house at Ramah . Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran .

verses.z: 拿八回答大衛的僕人說：「大衛是誰？耶西的兒子是誰？近來悖逆主人奔逃的僕人甚多，
verses.e: Nabal answered David's servants and said , " Who is David ? Who is the son of Jesse ? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days .

verses.z: 我豈可將飲食和為我剪羊毛人所宰的肉給我不知道從哪裏來的人呢？」
verses.e: Shall I then take my bread , my water , and my meat that I have killed for my shearers , and give it to men who I don't know where they come from ? "

verses.z: 大衛的僕人就轉身從原路回去，照這話告訴大衛。
verses.e: So David's young men turned on their way and went back , and came and told him all these words .

verses.z: 大衛向跟隨他的人說：「你們各人都要帶上刀！」眾人就都帶上刀，大衛也帶上刀。跟隨大衛上去的約有四百人，留下二百人看守器具。
verses.e: David said to his men , " Every man put on his sword ! " Every man put on his sword . David also put on his sword . About four hundred men followed David , and two hundred stayed by the baggage .

verses.z: 有拿八的一個僕人告訴拿八的妻亞比該說：「大衛從曠野打發使者來問我主人的安，主人卻辱罵他們。
verses.e: But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal's wife , saying , " Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master ; and he insulted them .

verses.z: 但是那些人待我們甚好；我們在田野與他們來往的時候，沒有受他們的欺負，也未曾失落甚麼。
verses.e: But the men were very good to us , and we were not harmed , and we didn't miss anything as long as we went with them , when we were in the fields .

verses.z: 我們在他們那裏牧羊的時候，他們晝夜作我們的保障。
verses.e: They were a wall to us both by night and by day , all the while we were with them keeping the sheep .

verses.z: 所以你當籌劃，看怎樣行才好；不然，禍患定要臨到我主人和他全家。他性情凶暴，無人敢與他說話。」
verses.e: Now therefore know and consider what you will do ; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house , for he is such a worthless fellow that one can't speak to him . "

verses.z: 亞比該急忙將二百餅，兩皮袋酒，五隻收拾好了的羊，五細亞烘好了的穗子，一百葡萄餅，二百無花果餅，都馱在驢上，
verses.e: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread , two containers of wine , five sheep ready dressed , five seahs of parched grain , one hundred clusters of raisins , and two hundred cakes of figs , and laid them on donkeys .

verses.z: 對僕人說：「你們前頭走，我隨着你們去。」這事她卻沒有告訴丈夫拿八。
verses.e: She said to her young men , " Go on before me . Behold , I am coming after you . " But she didn't tell her husband , Nabal .

verses.z: 在瑪雲有一個人，他的產業在迦密，是一個大富戶，有三千綿羊，一千山羊；他正在迦密剪羊毛。
