verses.e: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel ; and the man was very great . He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats ; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel .

verses.z: 亞比該騎着驢，正下山坡，見大衛和跟隨他的人從對面下來，亞比該就迎接他們。
verses.e: As she rode on her donkey , and came down hidden by the mountain , behold , David and his men came down toward her , and she met them .

verses.z: 大衛曾說：「我在曠野為那人看守所有的，以致他一樣不失落，實在是徒然了！他向我以惡報善。
verses.e: Now David had said , " Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness , so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him . He has returned me evil for good .

verses.z: 凡屬拿八的男丁，我若留一個到明日早晨，願上帝重重降罰與我！」
verses.e: God do so to the enemies of David , and more also , if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall . "

verses.z: 亞比該見大衛，便急忙下驢，在大衛面前臉伏於地叩拜，
verses.e: When Abigail saw David , she hurried and got off her donkey , and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground .

verses.z: 俯伏在大衛的腳前，說：「我主啊，願這罪歸我！求你容婢女向你進言，更求你聽婢女的話。
verses.e: She fell at his feet and said , " On me , my lord , on me be the blame ! Please let your servant speak in your ears . Hear the words of your servant .

verses.z: 我主不要理這壞人拿八，他的性情與他的名相稱；他名叫拿八，他為人果然愚頑。但我主所打發的僕人，婢女並沒有看見。
verses.e: Please don't let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow , Nabal , for as his name is , so is he . Nabal is his name , and folly is with him ; but I , your servant , didn't see my lord's young men whom you sent .

verses.z: 我主啊，耶和華既然阻止你親手報仇，取流血的罪，所以我指着永生的耶和華、又敢在你面前起誓說：『願你的仇敵和謀害你的人都像拿八一樣。』
verses.e: Now therefore , my lord , as the LORD lives and as your soul lives , since the LORD has withheld you from blood guiltiness and from avenging yourself with your own hand , now therefore let your enemies and those who seek evil to my lord be as Nabal .

verses.z: 如今求你將婢女送來的禮物給跟隨你的僕人。
verses.e: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord , let it be given to the young men who follow my lord .

verses.z: 求你饒恕婢女的罪過。耶和華必為我主建立堅固的家，因我主為耶和華爭戰；並且在你平生的日子查不出有甚麼過來。
verses.e: Please forgive the trespass of your servant . For the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house , because my lord fights the LORD's battles . Evil will not be found in you all your days .

verses.z: 雖有人起來追逼你，尋索你的性命，你的性命卻在耶和華－你的上帝那裏蒙保護，如包裹寶器一樣；你仇敵的性命，耶和華必拋去，如用機弦甩石一樣。
verses.e: Though men may rise up to pursue you and to seek your soul , yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD your God . He will sling out the souls of your enemies as from a sling's pocket .

verses.z: 那人名叫拿八，是迦勒族的人；他的妻名叫亞比該，是聰明俊美的婦人。拿八為人剛愎凶惡。
verses.e: Now the name of the man was Nabal ; and the name of his wife Abigail . This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face ; but the man was surly and evil in his doings . He was of the house of Caleb .

verses.z: 我主現在若不親手報仇流無辜人的血，到了耶和華照所應許你的話賜福與你，立你作以色列的王，那時我主必不致心裏不安，覺得良心有虧。耶和華賜福與我主的時候，求你記念婢女。」
verses.e: It will come to pass , when the LORD has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you , and has appointed you prince over Israel ,

that this shall be no grief to you , nor offense of heart to my lord , either that you have shed blood without cause , or that my lord has avenged himself . When the LORD has dealt well with my lord , then remember your servant . "

verses.z: 大衛對亞比該說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的，因為他今日使你來迎接我。
verses.e: David said to Abigail , " Blessed is the LORD , the God of Israel , who sent you today to meet me !

verses.z: 你和你的見識也當稱讚；因為你今日攔阻我親手報仇、流人的血。
verses.e: Blessed is your discretion , and blessed are you , who have kept me today from blood guiltiness , and from avenging myself with my own hand .

verses.z: 我指着阻止我加害於你的耶和華－以色列永生的上帝起誓，你若不速速地來迎接我，到明日早晨，凡屬拿八的男丁必定不留一個。」
verses.e: For indeed , as the LORD the God of Israel lives , who has withheld me from harming you , unless you had hurried and come to meet me , surely there wouldn't have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall . "

verses.z: 大衛受了亞比該送來的禮物，就對她說：「我聽了你的話，准了你的情面，你可以平平安安地回家吧！」
verses.e: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him . Then he said to her , " Go up in peace to your house . Behold , I have listened to your voice and have granted your request . "

verses.z: 亞比該到拿八那裏，見他在家裏設擺筵席，如同王的筵席；拿八快樂大醉。亞比該無論大小事都沒有告訴他，就等到次日早晨。
verses.e: Abigail came to Nabal ; and behold , he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king . Nabal's heart was merry within him , for he was very drunk . Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light .

verses.z: 到了早晨，拿八醒了酒，他的妻將這些事都告訴他，他就魂不附體，身僵如石頭一般。
verses.e: In the morning , when the wine had gone out of Nabal , his wife told him these things ; and his heart died within him , and he became as a stone .

verses.z: 過了十天，耶和華擊打拿八，他就死了。
verses.e: About ten days later , the LORD struck Nabal , so that he died .

verses.z: 大衛聽見拿八死了，就說：「應當稱頌耶和華，因他伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止僕人行惡；也使拿八的惡歸到拿八的頭上。」於是大衛打發人去，與亞比該說，要娶她為妻。
verses.e: When David heard that Nabal was dead , he said , " Blessed is the LORD , who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal , and has kept back his servant from evil . The LORD has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head . " David sent and spoke concerning Abigail , to take her to himself as wife .

verses.z: 大衛在曠野聽見說拿八剪羊毛，
verses.e: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep .

verses.z: 大衛的僕人到了迦密見亞比該，對她說：「大衛打發我們來見你，想要娶你為妻。」
verses.e: When David's servants had come to Abigail to Carmel , they spoke to her , saying , " David has sent us to you , to take you to him as wife . "

verses.z: 亞比該就起來，俯伏在地，說：「我情願作婢女，洗我主僕人的腳。」
verses.e: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth , and said , " Behold , your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord . "

verses.z: 亞比該立刻起身，騎上驢，帶着五個使女，跟從大衛的使者去了，就作了大衛的妻。
verses.e: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her ; and she went after the messengers of David , and became his wife .

verses.z: 大衛先娶了耶斯列人亞希暖，她們二人都作了他的妻。
verses.e: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel ; and they both became his wives .

verses.z: 掃羅已將他的女兒米甲，就是大衛的妻，給了迦琳人拉億的兒子帕提為妻。
verses.e: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter , David's wife , to Palti the son of Laish , who was of Gallim .

verses.z: 大衛就打發十個僕人，吩咐他們說：「你們上迦密去見拿八，提我的名問他安。
verses.e: David sent ten young men ; and David said to the young men , " Go up to Carmel , and go to Nabal , and greet him in my name .

verses.z: 要對那富戶如此說：『願你平安，願你家平安，願你一切所有的都平安。
verses.e: Tell him , ' Long life to you ! Peace be to you ! Peace be to your house ! Peace be to all that you have !

verses.z: 現在我聽說有人為你剪羊毛，你的牧人在迦密的時候和我們在一處，我們沒有欺負他們，他們也未曾失落甚麼。
verses.e: Now I have heard that you have shearers . Your shepherds have now been with us , and we didn't harm them . Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel .

verses.z: 可以問你的僕人，他們必告訴你。所以願我的僕人在你眼前蒙恩，因為是在好日子來的。求你隨手取點賜與僕人和你兒子大衛。』」
verses.e: Ask your young men , and they will tell you . Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes , for we come on a good day . Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David . ' "

verses.z: 大衛的僕人到了，將這話提大衛的名都告訴了拿八，就住了口。
verses.e: When David's young men came , they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David , and waited .

verses.z: 西弗人到基比亞見掃羅，說：「大衛不是在曠野前的哈基拉山藏着嗎？」
verses.e: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah , saying , " Doesn't David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah , which is before the desert ? "

verses.z: 大衛又說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，他或被耶和華擊打，或是死期到了，或是出戰陣亡；
verses.e: David said , " As the LORD lives , the LORD will strike him ; or his day shall come to die , or he shall go down into battle and perish .

verses.z: 我在耶和華面前，萬不敢伸手害耶和華的受膏者。現在你可以將他頭旁的槍和水瓶拿來，我們就走。」
verses.e: The LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORD's anointed ; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water , and let's go . "

verses.z: 大衛從掃羅的頭旁拿了槍和水瓶，二人就走了，沒有人看見，沒有人知道，也沒有人醒起，都睡着了，因為耶和華使他們沉沉地睡了。
verses.e: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul's head , and they went away . No man saw it , or knew it , nor did any awake ; for they were all asleep , because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen on them .

verses.z: 大衛過到那邊去，遠遠地站在山頂上，與他們相離甚遠。
verses.e: Then David went over to the other side , and stood on the top of the mountain far away , a great space being between them ;

verses.z: 大衛呼叫百姓和尼珥的兒子押尼珥說：「押尼珥啊，你為何不答應呢？」押尼珥說：「你是誰？竟敢呼叫王呢？」
verses.e: and David cried to the people , and to Abner the son of Ner , saying , " Don't you answer , Abner ? " Then Abner answered , " Who are you who calls to the king ? "

verses.z: 大衛對押尼珥說：「你不是個勇士嗎？以色列中誰能比你呢？民中有人進來要害死王－你的主，你為何沒有保護王－你的主呢？
verses.e: David said to Abner , " Aren't you a man ? Who is like you in Israel ? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king ? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king .

verses.z: 你這樣是不好的！我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你們都是該死的；因為沒有保護你們的主，就是耶和華的受膏者。現在你看看王頭旁的槍和水瓶在哪裏。」
verses.e: This thing isn't good that you have done . As the LORD lives , you are worthy to die , because you have not kept watch over your lord , the LORD's anointed . Now see where the king's spear is , and the jar of water that was at his head . "

verses.z: 掃羅聽出是大衛的聲音，就說：「我兒大衛，這是你的聲音嗎？」大衛說：「主－我的王啊，是我的聲音」；
verses.e: Saul recognized David's voice , and said , " Is this your voice , my son David ? " David said , " It is my voice , my lord , O king . "

verses.z: 又說：「我做了甚麼？我手裏有甚麼惡事？我主竟追趕僕人呢？
verses.e: He said , " Why does my lord pursue his servant ? For what have I done ? What evil is in my hand ?

verses.z: 求我主我王聽僕人的話：若是耶和華激發你攻擊我，願耶和華收納祭物；若是人激發你，願他在耶和華面前受咒詛；因為他現今趕逐我，不容我在耶和華的產業上有分，說：『你去事奉別神吧！』
verses.e: Now therefore , please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant . If it is so that the LORD has stirred you up against me , let him accept an offering . But if it is the children of men , they are cursed before the LORD ; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn't cling to the LORD's inheritance , saying , ' Go , serve other gods ! '

verses.z: 掃羅就起身，帶領以色列人中挑選的三千精兵下到西弗的曠野，要在那裏尋索大衛。
verses.e: Then Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph , having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him , to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph .

verses.z: 現在求王不要使我的血流在離耶和華遠的地方。以色列王出來是尋找一個虼蚤，如同人在山上獵取一個鷓鴣一般。」
verses.e: Now therefore , don't let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of the LORD ; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea , as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains . "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「我有罪了！我兒大衛，你可以回來，因你今日看我的性命為寶貴；我必不再加害於你。我是糊塗人，大大錯了。」
verses.e: Then Saul said , " I have sinned . Return , my son David ; for I will no more do you harm , because my life was precious in your eyes today . Behold , I have played the fool , and have erred exceedingly . "

verses.z: 大衛說：「王的槍在這裏，可以吩咐一個僕人過來拿去。
verses.e: David answered , " Behold the spear , O king ! Let one of the young men come over and get it .

verses.z: 今日耶和華將王交在我手裏，我卻不肯伸手害耶和華的受膏者。耶和華必照各人的公義誠實報應他。
verses.e: The LORD will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness ; because the LORD delivered you into my hand today , and I wouldn't stretch out my hand against the LORD's anointed .

verses.z: 我今日重看你的性命，願耶和華也重看我的性命，並且拯救我脫離一切患難。」
verses.e: Behold , as your life was respected today in my eyes , so let my life be respected in the LORD's eyes , and let him deliver me out of all oppression . "

verses.z: 掃羅對大衛說：「我兒大衛，願你得福！你必做大事，也必得勝。」於是大衛起行，掃羅回他的本處去了。
verses.e: Then Saul said to David , " You are blessed , my son David . You will both do mightily , and will surely prevail . " So David went his way , and Saul returned to his place .

verses.z: 掃羅在曠野前的哈基拉山，在道路上安營。大衛住在曠野，聽說掃羅到曠野來追尋他，
verses.e: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah , which is before the desert , by the way . But David stayed in the wilderness , and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness .

verses.z: 就打發人去探聽，便知道掃羅果然來到。
verses.e: David therefore sent out spies , and understood that Saul had certainly come .

verses.z: 大衛起來，到掃羅安營的地方，看見掃羅和他的元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥睡臥之處；掃羅睡在輜重營裏，百姓安營在他周圍。
verses.e: Then David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped ; and David saw the place where Saul lay , with Abner the son of Ner , the captain of his army . Saul lay within the place of the wagons , and the people were encamped around him .

verses.z: 大衛對赫人亞希米勒和洗魯雅的兒子約押的兄弟亞比篩說：「誰同我下到掃羅營裏去？」亞比篩說：「我同你下去。」
verses.e: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite , and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah , brother of Joab , saying , " Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp ? " Abishai said , " I will go down with you . "

verses.z: 於是大衛和亞比篩夜間到了百姓那裏，見掃羅睡在輜重營裏；他的槍在頭旁，插在地上。押尼珥和百姓睡在他周圍。
verses.e: So David and Abishai came to the people by night ; and , behold , Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons , with his spear stuck in the ground at his head ; and Abner and the people lay around him .

verses.z: 亞比篩對大衛說：「現在上帝將你的仇敵交在你手裏，求你容我拿槍將他刺透在地，一刺就成，不用再刺。」
verses.e: Then Abishai said to David , " God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today . Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke , and I will not strike him the second time . "

verses.z: 大衛對亞比篩說：「不可害死他。有誰伸手害耶和華的受膏者而無罪呢？」
verses.e: David said to Abishai , " Don't destroy him , for who can stretch out his hand against the LORD's anointed , and be guiltless ? "

verses.z: 大衛心裏說：「必有一日我死在掃羅手裏，不如逃奔非利士地去。掃羅見我不在以色列的境內，就必絕望，不再尋索我；這樣我可以脫離他的手。」
verses.e: David said in his heart , " I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul . There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines ; and Saul will despair of me , to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel . So I will escape out of his hand . "

verses.z: 亞吉說：「你們今日侵奪了甚麼地方呢？」大衛說：「侵奪了猶大的南方、耶拉篾的南方、基尼的南方。」
verses.e: Achish said , " Against whom have you made a raid today ? " David said , " Against the South of Judah , against the South of the Jerahmeelites , and against the South of the Kenites . "

verses.z: 無論男女，大衛沒有留下一個帶到迦特來。他說：「恐怕他們將我們的事告訴人，說大衛住在非利士地的時候常常這樣行。」
verses.e: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath , saying , " Lest they should tell about us , saying , ' David did this , and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines . ' "

verses.z: 亞吉信了大衛，心裏說：「大衛使本族以色列人憎惡他，所以他必永遠作我的僕人了。」
verses.e: Achish believed David , saying , " He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him . Therefore he will be my servant forever . "

verses.z: 於是大衛起身，和跟隨他的六百人投奔迦特王－瑪俄的兒子亞吉去了。
verses.e: David arose and passed over , he and the six hundred men who were with him , to Achish the son of Maoch , king of Gath .

verses.z: 大衛和他的兩個妻，就是耶斯列人亞希暖和作過拿八妻的迦密人亞比該，並跟隨他的人，連各人的眷屬，都住在迦特的亞吉那裏。
verses.e: David lived with Achish at Gath , he and his men , every man with his household , even David with his two wives , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess , Nabal's wife .

verses.z: 有人告訴掃羅說：「大衛逃到迦特。」掃羅就不再尋索他了。
verses.e: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath , so he stopped looking for him .

verses.z: 大衛對亞吉說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在京外的城邑中賜我一個地方居住。僕人何必與王同住京都呢？」
verses.e: David said to Achish , " If now I have found favor in your eyes , let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country , that I may dwell there . For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you ? "

verses.z: 當日亞吉將洗革拉賜給他，因此洗革拉屬猶大王，直到今日。
verses.e: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day : therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day .

verses.z: 大衛在非利士地住了一年零四個月。
verses.e: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months .

verses.z: 大衛和跟隨他的人上去，侵奪基述人、基色人、亞瑪力人之地。這幾族歷來住在那地，從書珥直到埃及。
verses.e: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites , the Girzites , and the Amalekites ; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old , on the way to Shur , even to the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 大衛擊殺那地的人，無論男女都沒有留下一個，又奪獲牛、羊、駱駝、驢，並衣服，回來見亞吉。
verses.e: David struck the land , and saved no man or woman alive , and took away the sheep , the cattle , the donkeys , the camels , and the clothing . Then he returned , and came to Achish .

verses.z: 那時，非利士人聚集軍旅，要與以色列人打仗。亞吉對大衛說：「你當知道，你和跟隨你的人都要隨我出戰。」
verses.e: In those days , the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare , to fight with Israel . Achish said to David , " Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army , you and your men . "

verses.z: 掃羅向婦人指着耶和華起誓說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你必不因這事受刑。」
verses.e: Saul swore to her by the LORD , saying , " As the LORD lives , no punishment will happen to you for this thing . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「我為你招誰上來呢？」回答說：「為我招撒母耳上來。」
verses.e: Then the woman said , " Whom shall I bring up to you ? " He said , " Bring Samuel up for me . "

verses.z: 婦人看見撒母耳，就大聲呼叫，對掃羅說：「你是掃羅，為甚麼欺哄我呢？」
verses.e: When the woman saw Samuel , she cried with a loud voice ; and the woman spoke to Saul , saying , " Why have you deceived me ? For you are Saul ! "

verses.z: 王對婦人說：「不要懼怕，你看見了甚麼呢？」婦人對掃羅說：「我看見有神從地裏上來。」
verses.e: The king said to her , " Don't be afraid ! What do you see ? " The woman said to Saul , " I see a god coming up out of the earth . "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「他是怎樣的形狀？」婦人說：「有一個老人上來，身穿長衣。」掃羅知道是撒母耳，就屈身，臉伏於地下拜。
verses.e: He said to her , " What does he look like ? " She said , " An old man comes up . He is covered with a robe . " Saul perceived that it was Samuel , and he bowed with his face to the ground , and showed respect .

verses.z: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「你為甚麼攪擾我，招我上來呢？」掃羅回答說：「我甚窘急；因為非利士人攻擊我，上帝也離開我，不再藉先知或夢回答我。因此請你上來，好指示我應當怎樣行。」
verses.e: Samuel said to Saul , " Why have you disturbed me , to bring me up ? " Saul answered , " I am very distressed ; for the Philistines make war against me , and God has departed from me , and answers me no more , by prophets , or by dreams . Therefore I have called you , that you may make known to me what I shall do . "

verses.z: 撒母耳說：「耶和華已經離開你，且與你為敵，你何必問我呢？
verses.e: Samuel said , " Why then do you ask me , since the LORD has departed from you and has become your adversary ?

verses.z: 耶和華照他藉我說的話，已經從你手裏奪去國權，賜與別人，就是大衛。
verses.e: The LORD has done to you as he spoke by me . The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor , even to David .

verses.z: 因你沒有聽從耶和華的命令；他惱怒亞瑪力人，你沒有滅絕他們，所以今日耶和華向你這樣行，
verses.e: Because you didn't obey the LORD's voice , and didn't execute his fierce wrath on Amalek , therefore the LORD has done this thing to you today .

verses.z: 並且耶和華必將你和以色列人交在非利士人的手裏。明日你和你眾子必與我在一處了；耶和華必將以色列的軍兵交在非利士人手裏。」
verses.e: Moreover the LORD will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines ; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me . The LORD will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 大衛對亞吉說：「僕人所能做的事，王必知道。」亞吉對大衛說：「這樣，我立你永遠作我的護衛長。」
verses.e: David said to Achish , " Therefore you will know what your servant can do . " Achish said to David , " Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever . "

verses.z: 掃羅猛然仆倒，挺身在地，因撒母耳的話甚是懼怕；那一晝一夜，沒有吃甚麼，就毫無氣力。
verses.e: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth , and was terrified , because of Samuel's words . There was no strength in him , for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long .

verses.z: 婦人到掃羅面前，見他極其驚恐，對他說：「婢女聽從你的話，不顧惜自己的性命，遵從你所吩咐的。
verses.e: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled , and said to him , " Behold , your servant has listened to your voice , and I have put my life in my hand , and have listened to your words which you spoke to me .

verses.z: 現在求你聽婢女的話，容我在你面前擺上一點食物，你吃了，可以有氣力行路。」
verses.e: Now therefore , please listen also to the voice of your servant , and let me set a morsel of bread before you . Eat , that you may have strength when you go on your way . "

verses.z: 掃羅不肯，說：「我不吃。」但他的僕人和婦人再三勸他，他才聽了他們的話，從地上起來，坐在床上。
verses.e: But he refused , and said , " I will not eat . " But his servants , together with the woman , constrained him ; and he listened to their voice . So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed .

verses.z: 婦人急忙將家裏的一隻肥牛犢宰了，又拿麵摶成無酵餅烤了，
verses.e: The woman had a fattened calf in the house . She hurried and killed it ; and she took flour and kneaded it , and baked unleavened bread of it .

verses.z: 擺在掃羅和他僕人面前。他們吃完，當夜就起身走了。
verses.e: She brought it before Saul and before his servants , and they ate . Then they rose up and went away that night .

verses.z: 那時撒母耳已經死了，以色列眾人為他哀哭，葬他在拉瑪，就是在他本城裏。掃羅曾在國內不容有交鬼的和行巫術的人。
verses.e: Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land .

verses.z: 非利士人聚集，來到書念安營；掃羅聚集以色列眾人在基利波安營。
verses.e: The Philistines gathered themselves together , and came and encamped in Shunem ; and Saul gathered all Israel together , and they encamped in Gilboa .

verses.z: 掃羅看見非利士的軍旅就懼怕，心中發顫。
verses.e: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines , he was afraid , and his heart trembled greatly .

verses.z: 掃羅求問耶和華，耶和華卻不藉夢，或烏陵，或先知回答他。
verses.e: When Saul inquired of the LORD , the LORD didn't answer him by dreams , by Urim , or by prophets .

verses.z: 掃羅吩咐臣僕說：「當為我找一個交鬼的婦人，我好去問她。」臣僕說：「在隱‧多珥有一個交鬼的婦人。」
verses.e: Then Saul said to his servants , " Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit , that I may go to her and inquire of her . " His servants said to him , " Behold , there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor . "

verses.z: 於是掃羅改了裝，穿上別的衣服，帶着兩個人，夜裏去見那婦人。掃羅說：「求你用交鬼的法術，將我所告訴你的死人，為我招上來。」
verses.e: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing , and went , he and two men with him , and they came to the woman by night . Then he said , " Please consult for me by the familiar spirit , and bring me up whomever I shall name to you . "

verses.z: 婦人對他說：「你知道掃羅從國中剪除交鬼的和行巫術的。你為何陷害我的性命，使我死呢？」
verses.e: The woman said to him , " Behold , you know what Saul has done , how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land . Why then do you lay a snare for my life , to cause me to die ? "

verses.z: 非利士人將他們的軍旅聚到亞弗；以色列人在耶斯列的泉旁安營。
verses.e: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek ; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel .

verses.z: 故此你和跟隨你的人，就是你本主的僕人，要明日早晨起來，等到天亮回去吧！」
verses.e: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you ; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light , depart . "

verses.z: 於是大衛和跟隨他的人早晨起來，回往非利士地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。
verses.e: So David rose up early , he and his men , to depart in the morning , to return into the land of the Philistines ; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel .

verses.z: 非利士人的首領各率軍隊，或百或千，挨次前進；大衛和跟隨他的人同着亞吉跟在後邊。
verses.e: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands ; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish .

verses.z: 非利士人的首領說：「這些希伯來人[在這裏]做甚麼呢？」亞吉對他們說：「這不是以色列王掃羅的臣子大衛嗎？他在我這裏有些年日了。自從他投降我直到今日，我未曾見他有過錯。」
verses.e: Then the princes of the Philistines said , " What about these Hebrews ? " Achish said to the princes of the Philistines , " Isn't this David , the servant of Saul the king of Israel , who has been with me these days , or rather these years ? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today . "

verses.z: 非利士人的首領向亞吉發怒，對他說：「你要叫這人回你所安置他的地方，不可叫他同我們出戰，恐怕他在陣上反為我們的敵人。他用甚麼與他主人復和呢？豈不是用我們這些人的首級嗎？
verses.e: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him ; and the princes of the Philistines said to him , " Make the man return , that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him , and let him not go down with us to battle , lest in the battle he become an adversary to us . For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord ? Should it not be with the heads of these men ?

verses.z: 從前以色列的婦女跳舞唱和說：『掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬』，所說的不是這個大衛嗎？」
verses.e: Isn't this David , of whom people sang to one another in dances , saying , ' Saul has slain his thousands , and David his ten thousands ' ? "

verses.z: 亞吉叫大衛來，對他說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你是正直人。你隨我在軍中出入，我看你甚好。自從你投奔我到如今，我未曾見你有甚麼過失；只是眾首領不喜悅你。
verses.e: Then Achish called David and said to him , " As the LORD lives , you have been upright , and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight ; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day . Nevertheless , the lords don't favor you .

verses.z: 現在你可以平平安安地回去，免得非利士人的首領不歡喜你。」
verses.e: Therefore now return , and go in peace , that you not displease the lords of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 大衛對亞吉說：「我做了甚麼呢？自從僕人到你面前，直到今日，你查出我有甚麼過錯，使我不去攻擊主－我王的仇敵呢？」
verses.e: David said to Achish , " But what have I done ? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day , that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king ? "

verses.z: 亞吉說：「我知道你在我眼前是好人，如同上帝的使者一般；只是非利士人的首領說：『這人不可同我們出戰。』
verses.e: Achish answered David , " I know that you are good in my sight , as an angel of God . Notwithstanding , the princes of the Philistines have said , ' He shall not go up with us to the battle . '

verses.z: 童子撒母耳在以利面前事奉耶和華。當那些日子，耶和華的言語稀少，不常有默示。
verses.e: The child Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli . The LORD's word was rare in those days . There were not many visions , then .

verses.z: 耶和華又來站着，像前三次呼喚說：「撒母耳啊！撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答說：「請說，僕人敬聽！」
verses.e: The LORD came , and stood , and called as at other times , " Samuel ! Samuel ! " Then Samuel said , " Speak ; for your servant hears . "

verses.z: 耶和華對撒母耳說：「我在以色列中必行一件事，叫聽見的人都必耳鳴。
verses.e: The LORD said to Samuel , " Behold , I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle .

verses.z: 我指着以利家所說的話，到了時候，我必始終應驗在以利身上。
verses.e: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house , from the beginning even to the end .

verses.z: 我曾告訴他必永遠降罰與他的家，因他知道兒子作孽，自招咒詛，卻不禁止他們。
verses.e: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew , because his sons brought a curse on themselves , and he didn't restrain them .

verses.z: 所以我向以利家起誓說：『以利家的罪孽，雖獻祭奉禮物，永不能得贖去。』」
verses.e: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever . "

verses.z: 撒母耳睡到天亮，就開了耶和華的殿門，不敢將默示告訴以利。
verses.e: Samuel lay until the morning , and opened the doors of the LORD's house . Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision .

verses.z: 以利呼喚撒母耳說：「我兒撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答說：「我在這裏！」
verses.e: Then Eli called Samuel and said , " Samuel , my son ! " He said , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 以利說：「[耶和華]對你說甚麼，你不要向我隱瞞；你若將上帝對你所說的隱瞞一句，願他重重地降罰與你。」
verses.e: He said , " What is the thing that he has spoken to you ? Please don't hide it from me . God do so to you , and more also , if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you . "

verses.z: 撒母耳就把一切話都告訴了以利，並沒有隱瞞。以利說：「這是出於耶和華，願他憑自己的意旨而行。」
verses.e: Samuel told him every bit , and hid nothing from him . He said , " It is the LORD . Let him do what seems good to him . "

verses.z: 撒母耳長大了，耶和華與他同在，使他所說的話一句都不落空。
verses.e: Samuel grew , and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground .

verses.z: 一日，以利睡臥在自己的地方；他眼目昏花，看不分明。
verses.e: At that time , when Eli was laid down in his place ( now his eyes had begun to grow dim , so that he could not see ) ,

verses.z: 從但到別是巴所有的以色列人都知道耶和華立撒母耳為先知。
verses.e: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華又在示羅顯現；因為耶和華將自己的話默示撒母耳，撒母耳就把這話傳遍以色列地。
verses.e: The LORD appeared again in Shiloh ; for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the LORD's word .

verses.z: 上帝的燈在上帝耶和華殿內[約]櫃那裏，還沒有熄滅，撒母耳已經睡了。
verses.e: and God's lamp hadn't yet gone out , and Samuel had laid down in the LORD's temple where God's ark was ,

verses.z: 耶和華呼喚撒母耳。撒母耳說：「我在這裏！」
verses.e: The LORD called Samuel . He said , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 就跑到以利那裏，說：「你呼喚我？我在這裏。」以利回答說：「我沒有呼喚你，你去睡吧。」他就去睡了。
verses.e: He ran to Eli and said , " Here I am ; for you called me . " He said , " I didn't call . Lie down again . " He went and lay down .

verses.z: 耶和華又呼喚撒母耳。撒母耳起來，到以利那裏，說：「你呼喚我？我在這裏。」以利回答說：「我的兒，我沒有呼喚你，你去睡吧。」
verses.e: The LORD called yet again , " Samuel ! " Samuel arose and went to Eli and said , " Here I am ; for you called me . " He answered , " I didn't call , my son . Lie down again . "

verses.z: 那時撒母耳還未認識耶和華，也未得耶和華的默示。
verses.e: Now Samuel didn't yet know the LORD , neither was the LORD's word yet revealed to him .

verses.z: 耶和華第三次呼喚撒母耳。撒母耳起來，到以利那裏，說：「你又呼喚我？我在這裏。」以利才明白是耶和華呼喚童子。
verses.e: The LORD called Samuel again the third time . He arose and went to Eli and said , " Here I am ; for you called me . " Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child .

verses.z: 因此以利對撒母耳說：「你仍去睡吧；若再呼喚你，你就說：『耶和華啊，請說，僕人敬聽！』」撒母耳就去，仍睡在原處。
verses.e: Therefore Eli said to Samuel , " Go , lie down . It shall be , if he calls you , that you shall say , ' Speak , LORD ; for your servant hears . ' " So Samuel went and lay down in his place .

verses.z: 第三日，大衛和跟隨他的人到了洗革拉。亞瑪力人已經侵奪南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚燒，
verses.e: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day , the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag , and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire ,

verses.z: 大衛卻帶着四百人往前追趕，有二百人疲乏，不能過比梭溪，所以留在那裏。
verses.e: But David pursued , he and four hundred men ; for two hundred stayed behind , who were so faint that they couldn't go over the brook Besor .

verses.z: 這四百人在田野遇見一個埃及人，就帶他到大衛面前，給他餅吃，給他水喝，
verses.e: They found an Egyptian in the field , and brought him to David , and gave him bread , and he ate ; and they gave him water to drink .

verses.z: 又給他一塊無花果餅，兩個葡萄餅。他吃了，就精神復原；因為他三日三夜沒有吃餅，沒有喝水。
verses.e: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins . When he had eaten , his spirit came again to him ; for he had eaten no bread , and drank no water for three days and three nights .

verses.z: 大衛問他說：「你是屬誰的？你是哪裏的人？」他回答說：「我是埃及的少年人，是亞瑪力人的奴僕；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇棄了。
verses.e: David asked him , " To whom do you belong ? Where are you from ? " He said , " I am a young man of Egypt , servant to an Amalekite ; and my master left me , because three days ago I got sick .

verses.z: 我們侵奪了基利提的南方和屬猶大的地，並迦勒地的南方，又用火燒了洗革拉。」
verses.e: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites , and on that which belongs to Judah , and on the South of Caleb ; and we burned Ziklag with fire . "

verses.z: 大衛問他說：「你肯領我們到敵軍那裏不肯？」他回答說：「你要向我指着上帝起誓，不殺我，也不將我交在我主人手裏，我就領你下到敵軍那裏。」
verses.e: David said to him , " Will you bring me down to this troop ? " He said , " Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master , and I will bring you down to this troop . "

verses.z: 那人領大衛下去，見他們散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因為從非利士地和猶大地所擄來的財物甚多。
verses.e: When he had brought him down , behold , they were spread around over all the ground , eating , drinking , and dancing , because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines , and out of the land of Judah .

verses.z: 大衛從黎明直到次日晚上，擊殺他們，除了四百騎駱駝的少年人之外，沒有一個逃脫的。
verses.e: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day . Not a man of them escaped from there , except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled .

verses.z: 亞瑪力人所擄去的財物，大衛全都奪回，並救回他的兩個妻來。
verses.e: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken , and David rescued his two wives .

verses.z: 凡亞瑪力人所擄去的，無論大小、兒女、財物，大衛都奪回來，沒有失落一個。
verses.e: There was nothing lacking to them , neither small nor great , neither sons nor daughters , neither plunder , nor anything that they had taken . David brought them all back .

verses.z: 擄了城內的婦女和其中的大小人口，卻沒有殺一個，都帶着走了。
verses.e: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it , both small and great . They didn't kill any , but carried them off and went their way .

verses.z: 大衛所奪來的牛群羊群，跟隨他的人趕在[原有的]群畜前邊，說：「這是大衛的掠物。」
verses.e: David took all the flocks and the herds , which they drove before those other livestock , and said , " This is David's plunder . "

verses.z: 大衛到了那疲乏不能跟隨、留在比梭溪的二百人那裏。他們出來迎接大衛並跟隨的人。大衛前來問他們安。
verses.e: David came to the two hundred men , who were so faint that they could not follow David , whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor ; and they went out to meet David , and to meet the people who were with him . When David came near to the people , he greeted them .

verses.z: 跟隨大衛人中的惡人和匪類說：「這些人既然沒有和我們同去，我們所奪的財物就不分給他們，只將他們各人的妻子兒女給他們，使他們帶去就是了。」
verses.e: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said , " Because they didn't go with us , we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered , except to every man his wife and his children , that he may lead them away and depart . "

verses.z: 大衛說：「弟兄們，耶和華所賜給我們的，不可不分給他們；因為他保佑我們，將那攻擊我們的敵軍交在我們手裏。
verses.e: Then David said , " Do not do so , my brothers , with that which the LORD has given to us , who has preserved us , and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand .

verses.z: 這事誰肯依從你們呢？上陣的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；應當大家平分。」
verses.e: Who will listen to you in this matter ? For as his share is who goes down to the battle , so shall his share be who stays with the baggage . They shall share alike . "

verses.z: 大衛定此為以色列的律例典章，從那日直到今日。
verses.e: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day .

verses.z: 大衛到了洗革拉，從掠物中取些送給他朋友猶大的長老，說：「這是從耶和華仇敵那裏奪來的，送你們為禮物。」
verses.e: When David came to Ziklag , he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah , even to his friends , saying , " Behold , a present for you from the plunder of the LORD's enemies . "

verses.z: 他送禮物給住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；
verses.e: He sent it to those who were in Bethel , to those who were in Ramoth of the South , to those who were in Jattir ,

verses.z: 住亞羅珥的，息末的，以實提莫的；
verses.e: to those who were in Aroer , to those who were in Siphmoth , to those who were in Eshtemoa ,

verses.z: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；
verses.e: to those who were in Racal , to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites , to those who were in the cities of the Kenites ,

verses.z: 大衛和跟隨他的人到了那城，不料，城已燒毀，他們的妻子兒女都被擄去了。
verses.e: When David and his men came to the city , behold , it was burned with fire ; and their wives , their sons , and their daughters were taken captive .

verses.z: 住何珥瑪的，歌拉珊的，亞撻的；
verses.e: to those who were in Hormah , to those who were in Borashan , to those who were in Athach ,

verses.z: 住希伯崙的，並大衛和跟隨他的人素來所到之處的人。
verses.e: to those who were in Hebron , and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay .

verses.z: 大衛和跟隨他的人就放聲大哭，直哭得沒有氣力。
verses.e: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep .

verses.z: 大衛的兩個妻－耶斯列人亞希暖和作過拿八妻的迦密人亞比該，也被擄去了。
verses.e: David's two wives were taken captive , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite .

verses.z: 大衛甚是焦急，因眾人為自己的兒女苦惱，說：「要用石頭打死他。」大衛卻倚靠耶和華－他的上帝，心裏堅固。
verses.e: David was greatly distressed , for the people spoke of stoning him , because the souls of all the people were grieved , every man for his sons and for his daughters ; but David strengthened himself in the LORD his God .

verses.z: 大衛對亞希米勒的兒子祭司亞比亞他說：「請你將以弗得拿過來。」亞比亞他就將以弗得拿到大衛面前。
verses.e: David said to Abiathar the priest , the son of Ahimelech , " Please bring the ephod here to me . " Abiathar brought the ephod to David .

verses.z: 大衛求問耶和華說：「我追趕敵軍，追得上追不上呢？」耶和華說：「你可以追，必追得上，都救得回來。」
verses.e: David inquired of the LORD , saying , " If I pursue after this troop , will I overtake them ? " He answered him , " Pursue , for you will surely overtake them , and will without fail recover all . "

verses.z: 於是，大衛和跟隨他的六百人來到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那裏。
verses.e: So David went , he and the six hundred men who were with him , and came to the brook Besor , where those who were left behind stayed .

verses.z: 非利士人與以色列人爭戰。以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波有被殺仆倒的。
verses.e: Now the Philistines fought against Israel ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa .

verses.z: 又將掃羅的軍裝放在亞斯她錄廟裏，將他的屍身釘在伯‧珊的城牆上。
verses.e: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth , and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan .

verses.z: 基列‧雅比的居民聽見非利士人向掃羅所行的事，
verses.e: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul ,

verses.z: 他們中間所有的勇士就起身，走了一夜，將掃羅和他兒子的屍身從伯‧珊城牆上取下來，送到雅比那裏，用火燒了；
verses.e: all the valiant men arose , went all night , and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan ; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there .

verses.z: 將他們骸骨葬在雅比的垂絲柳樹下，就禁食七日。
verses.e: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .

verses.z: 非利士人緊追掃羅和他兒子們，就殺了掃羅的兒子約拿單、亞比拿達、麥基舒亞。
verses.e: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons ; and the Philistines killed Jonathan , Abinadab , and Malchishua , the sons of Saul .

verses.z: 勢派甚大，掃羅被弓箭手追上，射傷甚重，
verses.e: The battle went hard against Saul , and the archers overtook him ; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers .

verses.z: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人說：「你拔出刀來，將我刺死，免得那些未受割禮的人來刺我，凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚懼怕，不肯刺他；掃羅就自己伏在刀上死了。
verses.e: Then Saul said to his armor bearer , " Draw your sword , and thrust me through with it , lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me ! " But his armor bearer would not , for he was terrified . Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it .

verses.z: 拿兵器的人見掃羅已死，也伏在刀上死了。
verses.e: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead , he likewise fell on his sword , and died with him .

verses.z: 這樣，掃羅和他三個兒子，與拿他兵器的人，以及跟隨他的人，都一同死亡。
verses.e: So Saul died with his three sons , his armor bearer , and all his men that same day together .

verses.z: 住平原那邊並約旦河西的以色列人，見以色列軍兵逃跑，掃羅和他兒子都死了，也就棄城逃跑。非利士人便來住在其中。
verses.e: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley , and those who were beyond the Jordan , saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead , they abandoned the cities and fled ; and the Philistines came and lived in them .

verses.z: 次日，非利士人來剝那被殺之人的衣服，看見掃羅和他三個兒子仆倒在基利波山，
verses.e: On the next day , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa .

verses.z: 就割下他的首級，剝了他的軍裝，打發人到非利士地的四境，報信與他們廟裏的偶像和眾民；
verses.e: They cut off his head , stripped off his armor , and sent into the land of the Philistines all around , to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people .

verses.z: 以色列人出去與非利士人打仗，安營在以便以謝；非利士人安營在亞弗。
verses.e: The word of Samuel came to all Israel . Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle , and encamped beside Ebenezer ; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek .

verses.z: 非利士人和以色列人打仗，以色列人敗了，各向各家奔逃，被殺的人甚多，以色列的步兵仆倒了三萬。
verses.e: The Philistines fought , and Israel was defeated , and each man fled to his tent . There was a very great slaughter ; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell .

verses.z: 上帝的[約]櫃被擄去，以利的兩個兒子何弗尼、非尼哈也都被殺了。
verses.e: God's ark was taken ; and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were slain .

verses.z: 當日，有一個便雅憫人從陣上逃跑，衣服撕裂，頭蒙灰塵，來到示羅。
verses.e: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day , with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head .

verses.z: 到了的時候，以利正在道旁坐在自己的位上觀望，為上帝的[約]櫃心裏擔憂。那人進城報信，合城的人就都呼喊起來。
verses.e: When he came , behold , Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching , for his heart trembled for God's ark . When the man came into the city and told about it , all the city cried out .

verses.z: 以利聽見呼喊的聲音就問說：「這喧嚷是甚麼緣故呢？」那人急忙來報信給以利。
verses.e: When Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , " What does the noise of this tumult mean ? " The man hurried , and came and told Eli .

verses.z: 那時以利九十八歲了，眼目發直，不能看見。
verses.e: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old . His eyes were set , so that he could not see .

verses.z: 那人對以利說：「我是從陣上來的，今日我從陣上逃回。」以利說：「我兒，事情怎樣？」
verses.e: The man said to Eli , " I am he who came out of the army , and I fled today out of the army . " He said , " How did the matter go , my son ? "

verses.z: 報信的回答說：「以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，民中被殺的甚多！你的兩個兒子何弗尼、非尼哈也都死了，並且上帝的[約]櫃被擄去。」
verses.e: He who brought the news answered , " Israel has fled before the Philistines , and there has been also a great slaughter among the people . Your two sons also , Hophni and Phinehas , are dead , and God's ark has been captured . "

verses.z: 他一提上帝的[約]櫃，以利就從他的位上往後跌倒，在門旁折斷頸項而死；因為他年紀老邁，身體沉重。以利作以色列的士師四十年。
verses.e: When he made mention of God's ark , Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate ; and his neck broke , and he died , for he was an old man and heavy . He had judged Israel forty years .

verses.z: 以利的兒婦、非尼哈的妻懷孕將到產期，她聽見上帝的[約]櫃被擄去，公公和丈夫都死了，就猛然疼痛，曲身生產；
verses.e: His daughter-in-law , Phinehas ' wife , was with child , near to giving birth . When she heard the news that God's ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead , she bowed herself and gave birth ; for her pains came on her .

verses.z: 非利士人向以色列人擺陣。兩軍交戰的時候，以色列人敗在非利士人面前；非利士人在戰場上殺了他們的軍兵約有四千人。
verses.e: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel . When they joined battle , Israel was defeated by the Philistines , who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field .

verses.z: 將要死的時候，旁邊站着的婦人們對她說：「不要怕！你生了男孩子了。」她卻不回答，也不放在心上。
verses.e: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her , " Don't be afraid , for you have given birth to a son . " But she didn't answer , neither did she regard it .

verses.z: 她給孩子起名叫以迦博，說：「榮耀離開以色列了！」這是因上帝的[約]櫃被擄去，又因她公公和丈夫都死了。
verses.e: She named the child Ichabod , saying , " The glory has departed from Israel ! " because God's ark was taken , and because of her father-in-law and her husband .

verses.z: 她又說：「榮耀離開以色列，因為上帝的約櫃被擄去了。」
verses.e: She said , " The glory has departed from Israel ; for God's ark has been taken . "

verses.z: 百姓回到營裏，以色列的長老說：「耶和華今日為何使我們敗在非利士人面前呢？我們不如將耶和華的約櫃從示羅抬到我們這裏來，好在我們中間救我們脫離敵人的手。」
verses.e: When the people had come into the camp , the elders of Israel said , " Why has the LORD defeated us today before the Philistines ? Let's get the ark of the LORD's covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us , that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies . "

verses.z: 於是百姓打發人到示羅，從那裏將坐在二基路伯上萬軍之耶和華的約櫃抬來。以利的兩個兒子何弗尼、非尼哈與上帝的約櫃同來。
verses.e: So the people sent to Shiloh , and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Armies , who sits above the cherubim ; and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were there with the ark of the covenant of God .

verses.z: 耶和華的約櫃到了營中，以色列眾人就大聲歡呼，地便震動。
verses.e: When the ark of the LORD's covenant came into the camp , all Israel shouted with a great shout , so that the earth resounded .

verses.z: 非利士人聽見歡呼的聲音，就說：「在希伯來人營裏大聲歡呼，是甚麼緣故呢？」隨後就知道耶和華的[約]櫃到了營中。
verses.e: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout , they said , " What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean ? " They understood that the LORD's ark had come into the camp .

verses.z: 非利士人就懼怕起來，說：「有神到了他們營中」；又說：「我們有禍了！向來不曾有這樣的事。
verses.e: The Philistines were afraid , for they said , " God has come into the camp . " They said , " Woe to us ! For there has not been such a thing before .

verses.z: 我們有禍了！誰能救我們脫離這些大能之神的手呢？從前在曠野用各樣災殃擊打埃及人的，就是這些神。
verses.e: Woe to us ! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods ? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness .

verses.z: 非利士人哪，你們要剛強，要作大丈夫，免得作希伯來人的奴僕，如同他們作你們的奴僕一樣。你們要作大丈夫，與他們爭戰。」
verses.e: Be strong and behave like men , O you Philistines , that you not be servants to the Hebrews , as they have been to you . Strengthen yourselves like men , and fight ! "

verses.z: 非利士人將上帝的[約]櫃從以便以謝抬到亞實突。
verses.e: Now the Philistines had taken God's ark , and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod .

verses.z: 他們就把上帝的[約]櫃送到以革倫。上帝的[約]櫃到了，以革倫人就喊嚷起來說：「他們將以色列上帝的[約]櫃運到我們這裏，要害我們和我們的眾民！」
verses.e: So they sent God's ark to Ekron . As God's ark came to Ekron , the Ekronites cried out , saying , " They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us , to kill us and our people . "

verses.z: 於是打發人去請非利士的眾首領來，說：「願你們將以色列上帝的[約]櫃送回原處，免得害了我們和我們的眾民！」原來上帝的手重重攻擊那城，城中的人有因驚慌而死的；
verses.e: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and they said , " Send the ark of the God of Israel away , and let it go again to its own place , that it not kill us and our people . " For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city . The hand of God was very heavy there .

verses.z: 未曾死的人都生了痔瘡。合城呼號，聲音上達於天。
verses.e: The men who didn't die were struck with the tumors ; and the cry of the city went up to heaven .

verses.z: 非利士人將上帝的[約]櫃抬進大袞廟，放在大袞的旁邊。
verses.e: The Philistines took God's ark , and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon .

verses.z: 次日清早，亞實突人起來，見大袞仆倒在耶和華的[約]櫃前，臉伏於地，就把大袞仍立在原處。
verses.e: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day , behold , Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD's ark . They took Dagon and set him in his place again .

verses.z: 又次日清早起來，見大袞仆倒在耶和華的[約]櫃前，臉伏於地，並且大袞的頭和兩手都在門檻上折斷，只剩下大袞的[殘體]。（
verses.e: When they arose early on the following morning , behold , Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD's ark ; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold . Only Dagon's torso was intact .

verses.z: 因此，大袞的祭司和一切進亞實突、大袞廟的人都不踏大袞廟的門檻，直到今日。）
verses.e: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon's house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day .

verses.z: 耶和華的手重重加在亞實突人身上，敗壞他們，使他們生痔瘡。亞實突和亞實突的四境都是如此。
verses.e: But the LORD's hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod , and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors , even Ashdod and its borders .

verses.z: 亞實突人見這光景，就說：「以色列上帝的[約]櫃不可留在我們這裏，因為他的手重重加在我們和我們神大袞的身上」；
verses.e: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so , they said , " The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us , for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god . "

verses.z: 就打發人去請非利士的眾首領來聚集，問他們說：「我們向以色列上帝的[約]櫃應當怎樣行呢？」他們回答說：「可以將以色列上帝的[約]櫃運到迦特去。」於是將以色列上帝的[約]櫃運到那裏去。
verses.e: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and said , " What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel ? " They answered , " Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath . " They carried the ark of the God of Israel there .

verses.z: 運到之後，耶和華的手攻擊那城，使那城的人大大驚慌，無論大小都生痔瘡。
verses.e: It was so , that after they had carried it there , the LORD's hand was against the city with a very great confusion ; and he struck the men of the city , both small and great , so that tumors broke out on them .

verses.z: 耶和華的[約]櫃在非利士人之地七個月。
verses.e: The LORD's ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months .

verses.z: 非利士人就這樣行：將兩隻有乳的母牛套在車上，將牛犢關在家裏，
verses.e: The men did so , and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart , and shut up their calves at home .

verses.z: 把耶和華的[約]櫃和裝金老鼠並金痔瘡像的匣子都放在車上。
verses.e: They put the LORD's ark on the cart , and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors .

verses.z: 牛直行大道，往伯‧示麥去，一面走一面叫，不偏左右。非利士的首領跟在後面，直到伯‧示麥的境界。
verses.e: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh . They went along the highway , lowing as they went , and didn't turn away to the right hand or to the left ; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh .

verses.z: 伯‧示麥人正在平原收割麥子，舉目看見[約]櫃，就歡喜了。
verses.e: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley ; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark , and rejoiced to see it .

verses.z: 車到了伯‧示麥人約書亞的田間，就站住了。在那裏有一塊大磐石，他們把車劈了，將兩隻母牛獻給耶和華為燔祭。
verses.e: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh , and stood there , where there was a great stone . Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 利未人將耶和華的[約]櫃和裝金物的匣子拿下來，放在大磐石上。當日伯‧示麥人將燔祭和[平安]祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: The Levites took down the LORD's ark and the box that was with it , in which the jewels of gold were , and put them on the great stone ; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to the LORD .

verses.z: 非利士人的五個首領看見，當日就回以革倫去了。
verses.e: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it , they returned to Ekron the same day .

verses.z: 非利士人獻給耶和華作賠罪的金痔瘡像，就是這些：一個是為亞實突，一個是為迦薩，一個是為亞實基倫，一個是為迦特，一個是為以革倫。
verses.e: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to the LORD : for Ashdod one , for Gaza one , for Ashkelon one , for Gath one , for Ekron one ;

verses.z: 金老鼠的數目是照非利士五個首領的城邑，就是堅固的城邑和鄉村，以及大磐石。這磐石是放耶和華[約]櫃的，到今日還在伯‧示麥人約書亞的田間。
verses.e: and the golden mice , according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords , both of fortified cities and of country villages , even to the great stone on which they set down the LORD's ark . That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh .

verses.z: 耶和華因伯‧示麥人擅觀他的[約]櫃，就擊殺了他們七十人；那時有五萬人在那裏。百姓因耶和華大大擊殺他們，就哀哭了。
verses.e: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh , because they had looked into the LORD's ark , he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men . Then the people mourned , because the LORD had struck the people with a great slaughter .

verses.z: 非利士人將祭司和占卜的聚了來，問他們說：「我們向耶和華的[約]櫃應當怎樣行？請指示我們用何法將[約]櫃送回原處。」
verses.e: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners , saying , " What shall we do with the LORD's ark ? Show us how we should send it to its place . "

verses.z: 伯‧示麥人說：「誰能在耶和華這聖潔的上帝面前侍立呢？這[約]櫃可以從我們這裏送到誰那裏去呢？」
verses.e: The men of Beth Shemesh said , " Who is able to stand before the LORD , this holy God ? To whom shall he go up from us ? "

verses.z: 於是打發人去見基列‧耶琳的居民，說：「非利士人將耶和華的[約]櫃送回來了，你們下來將[約]櫃接到你們那裏去吧！」
verses.e: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim , saying , " The Philistines have brought back the LORD's ark . Come down and bring it up to yourselves . "

verses.z: 他們說：「若要將以色列上帝的[約]櫃送回去，不可空空地送去，必要給他獻賠罪的禮物，然後你們可得痊癒，並知道他的手為何不離開你們。」
verses.e: They said , " If you send away the ark of the God of Israel , don't send it empty ; but by all means return a trespass offering to him . Then you will be healed , and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you . "

verses.z: 非利士人說：「應當用甚麼獻為賠罪的禮物呢？」他們回答說：「當照非利士首領的數目，用五個金痔瘡，五個金老鼠，因為在你們眾人和你們首領的身上都是一樣的災。
verses.e: Then they said , " What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him ? " They said , " Five golden tumors and five golden mice , for the number of the lords of the Philistines ; for one plague was on you all , and on your lords .

verses.z: 所以當製造你們痔瘡的像和毀壞你們田地老鼠的像，並要歸榮耀給以色列的上帝，或者他向你們和你們的神，並你們的田地，把手放輕些。
verses.e: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land ; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel . Perhaps he will release his hand from you , from your gods , and from your land .

verses.z: 你們為何硬着心像埃及人和法老一樣呢？上帝在埃及人中間行奇事，埃及人豈不釋放以色列人，他們就去了嗎？
verses.e: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts ? When he had worked wonderfully among them , didn't they let the people go , and they departed ?

verses.z: 現在你們應當造一輛新車，將兩隻未曾負軛有乳的母牛套在車上，使牛犢回家去，離開母牛。
verses.e: " Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke ; and tie the cows to the cart , and bring their calves home from them ;

verses.z: 把耶和華的[約]櫃放在車上，將所獻賠罪的金物裝在匣子裏，放在櫃旁，將櫃送去。
verses.e: and take the LORD's ark and lay it on the cart . Put the jewels of gold , which you return him for a trespass offering , in a box by its side ; and send it away , that it may go .

verses.z: 你們要看看：車若直行以色列的境界到伯‧示麥去，這大災就是耶和華降在我們身上的；若不然，便可以知道不是他的手擊打我們，是我們偶然遇見的。」
verses.e: Behold , if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh , then he has done us this great evil ; but if not , then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us . It was a chance that happened to us . "

verses.z: 基列‧耶琳人就下來，將耶和華的[約]櫃接上去，放在山上亞比拿達的家中，分派他兒子以利亞撒看守耶和華的[約]櫃。
verses.e: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took the LORD's ark , and brought it into Abinadab's house on the hill , and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep the LORD's ark .

verses.z: 撒母耳正獻燔祭的時候，非利士人前來要與以色列人爭戰。當日，耶和華大發雷聲，驚亂非利士人，他們就敗在以色列人面前。
verses.e: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering , the Philistines came near to battle against Israel ; but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them ; and they were struck down before Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人從米斯巴出來，追趕非利士人，擊殺他們，直到伯‧甲的下邊。
verses.e: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines , and struck them until they came under Beth Kar .

verses.z: 撒母耳將一塊石頭立在米斯巴和善的中間，給石頭起名叫以便以謝，說：「到如今耶和華都幫助我們。」
verses.e: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen , and called its name Ebenezer , saying , " The LORD helped us until now . "

verses.z: 從此，非利士人就被制伏，不敢再入以色列人的境內。撒母耳作士師的時候，耶和華的手攻擊非利士人。
verses.e: So the Philistines were subdued , and they stopped coming within the border of Israel . The LORD's hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel .

verses.z: 非利士人所取以色列人的城邑，從以革倫直到迦特，都歸以色列人了。屬這些城的四境，以色列人也從非利士人手下收回。那時以色列人與亞摩利人和好。
verses.e: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel , from Ekron even to Gath ; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines . There was peace between Israel and the Amorites .

verses.z: 撒母耳平生作以色列的士師。
verses.e: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life .

verses.z: 他每年巡行到伯特利、吉甲、米斯巴，在這幾處審判以色列人。
verses.e: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel , Gilgal , and Mizpah ; and he judged Israel in all those places .

verses.z: 隨後回到拉瑪，因為他的家在那裏；也在那裏審判以色列人，且為耶和華築了一座壇。
verses.e: His return was to Ramah , for his house was there , and he judged Israel there ; and he built an altar to the LORD there .

verses.z: [約]櫃在基列‧耶琳許久。過了二十年，以色列全家都傾向耶和華。
verses.e: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim , the time was long — for it was twenty years ; and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD .

verses.z: 撒母耳對以色列全家說：「你們若一心歸順耶和華，就要把外邦的神和亞斯她錄從你們中間除掉，專心歸向耶和華，單單地事奉他。他必救你們脫離非利士人的手。」
verses.e: Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel , saying , " If you are returning to the LORD with all your heart , then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you , and direct your hearts to the LORD , and serve him only ; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 以色列人就除掉諸巴力和亞斯她錄，單單地事奉耶和華。
verses.e: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth , and served the LORD only .

verses.z: 撒母耳說：「要使以色列眾人聚集在米斯巴，我好為你們禱告耶和華。」
verses.e: Samuel said , " Gather all Israel to Mizpah , and I will pray to the LORD for you . "

verses.z: 他們就聚集在米斯巴，打水澆在耶和華面前，當日禁食，說：「我們得罪了耶和華。」於是撒母耳在米斯巴審判以色列人。
verses.e: They gathered together to Mizpah , and drew water , and poured it out before the LORD , and fasted on that day , and said there , " We have sinned against the LORD . " Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah .

verses.z: 非利士人聽見以色列人聚集在米斯巴，非利士的首領就上來要攻擊以色列人。以色列人聽見，就懼怕非利士人。
verses.e: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah , the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel . When the children of Israel heard it , they were afraid of the Philistines .

verses.z: 以色列人對撒母耳說：「願你不住地為我們呼求耶和華－我們的上帝，救我們脫離非利士人的手。」
verses.e: The children of Israel said to Samuel , " Don't stop crying to the LORD our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 撒母耳就把一隻吃奶的羊羔獻與耶和華作全牲的燔祭，為以色列人呼求耶和華；耶和華就應允他。
verses.e: Samuel took a suckling lamb , and offered it for a whole burnt offering to the LORD . Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel , and the LORD answered him .

verses.z: 撒母耳年紀老邁，就立他兒子作以色列的士師。
verses.e: When Samuel was old , he made his sons judges over Israel .

verses.z: 撒母耳將耶和華的話都傳給求他立王的百姓，說：
verses.e: Samuel told all the LORD's words to the people who asked him for a king .

verses.z: 「管轄你們的王必這樣行：他必派你們的兒子為他趕車、跟馬，奔走在車前；
verses.e: He said , " This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you : he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants , for his chariots and to be his horsemen ; and they will run before his chariots .

verses.z: 又派他們作千夫長、五十夫長，為他耕種田地，收割莊稼，打造軍器和車上的器械；
verses.e: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties ; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest ; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots .

verses.z: 必取你們的女兒為他製造香膏，做飯烤餅；
verses.e: He will take your daughters to be perfumers , to be cooks , and to be bakers .

verses.z: 也必取你們最好的田地、葡萄園、橄欖園賜給他的臣僕。
verses.e: He will take your fields , your vineyards , and your olive groves , even your best , and give them to his servants .

verses.z: 你們的糧食和葡萄園所出的，他必取十分之一給他的太監和臣僕；
verses.e: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards , and give it to his officers and to his servants .

verses.z: 又必取你們的僕人婢女，健壯的少年人和你們的驢，供他的差役。
verses.e: He will take your male servants , your female servants , your best young men , and your donkeys , and assign them to his own work .

verses.z: 你們的羊群他必取十分之一，你們也必作他的僕人。
verses.e: He will take one tenth of your flocks ; and you will be his servants .

verses.z: 那時你們必因所選的王哀求耶和華，耶和華卻不應允你們。」
verses.e: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves ; and the LORD will not answer you in that day . "

verses.z: 百姓竟不肯聽撒母耳的話，說：「不然！我們定要一個王治理我們，
verses.e: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel ; and they said , " No , but we will have a king over us ,

verses.z: 長子名叫約珥，次子名叫亞比亞；他們在別是巴作士師。
verses.e: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel , and the name of his second , Abijah . They were judges in Beersheba .

verses.z: 使我們像列國一樣，有王治理我們，統領我們，為我們爭戰。」
verses.e: that we also may be like all the nations ; and that our king may judge us , and go out before us , and fight our battles . "

verses.z: 撒母耳聽見百姓這一切話，就將這話陳明在耶和華面前。
verses.e: Samuel heard all the words of the people , and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華對撒母耳說：「你只管依從他們的話，為他們立王。」撒母耳對以色列人說：「你們各歸各城去吧！」
verses.e: The LORD said to Samuel , " Listen to their voice , and make them a king . " Samuel said to the men of Israel , " Everyone go to your own city . "

verses.z: 他兒子不行他的道，貪圖財利，收受賄賂，屈枉正直。
verses.e: His sons didn't walk in his ways , but turned away after dishonest gain , took bribes , and perverted justice .

verses.z: 以色列的長老都聚集，來到拉瑪見撒母耳，
verses.e: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah .

verses.z: 對他說：「你年紀老邁了，你兒子不行你的道。現在求你為我們立一個王治理我們，像列國一樣。」
verses.e: They said to him , " Behold , you are old , and your sons don't walk in your ways . Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations . "

verses.z: 撒母耳不喜悅他們說「立一個王治理我們」，他就禱告耶和華。
verses.e: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said , " Give us a king to judge us . " Samuel prayed to the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華對撒母耳說：「百姓向你說的一切話，你只管依從；因為他們不是厭棄你，乃是厭棄我，不要我作他們的王。
verses.e: The LORD said to Samuel , " Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you ; for they have not rejected you , but they have rejected me as the king over them .

verses.z: 自從我領他們出埃及到如今，他們常常離棄我，事奉別神。現在他們向你所行的，是照他們素來所行的。
verses.e: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day , in that they have forsaken me and served other gods , so they also do to you .

verses.z: 故此你要依從他們的話，只是當警戒他們，告訴他們將來那王怎樣管轄他們。」
verses.e: Now therefore , listen to their voice . However , you shall protest solemnly to them , and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them . "

verses.z: 有一個便雅憫人，名叫基士，是便雅憫人亞斐亞的玄孫，比歌拉的曾孫，洗羅的孫子，亞別的兒子，是個大能的勇士。
verses.e: Now there was a man of Benjamin , whose name was Kish the son of Abiel , the son of Zeror , the son of Becorath , the son of Aphiah , the son of a Benjamite , a mighty man of valor .

verses.z: 掃羅對僕人說：「你說的是，我們可以去。」於是他們往神人所住的城裏去了。
verses.e: Then Saul said to his servant , " Well said . Come ! Let's go . " So they went to the city where the man of God was .

verses.z: 他們上坡要進城，就遇見幾個少年女子出來打水，問她們說：「先見在這裏沒有？」
verses.e: As they went up the ascent to the city , they found young maidens going out to draw water , and said to them , " Is the seer here ? "

verses.z: 女子回答說：「在這裏，他在你們前面。快去吧！他今日正到城裏，因為今日百姓要在邱壇獻祭。
verses.e: They answered them and said , " He is . Behold , he is before you . Hurry now , for he has come today into the city ; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place .

verses.z: 在他還沒有上邱壇吃祭物之先，你們一進城必遇見他；因他未到，百姓不能吃，必等他先祝祭，然後請的客才吃。現在你們上去，這時候必遇見他。」
verses.e: As soon as you have come into the city , you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat ; for the people will not eat until he comes , because he blesses the sacrifice . Afterwards those who are invited eat . Now therefore go up ; for at this time you will find him . "

verses.z: 二人就上去；將進城的時候，撒母耳正迎着他們來，要上邱壇去。
verses.e: They went up to the city . As they came within the city , behold , Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place .

verses.z: 掃羅未到的前一日，耶和華已經指示撒母耳說：
verses.e: Now the LORD had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came , saying ,

verses.z: 「明日這時候，我必使一個人從便雅憫地到你這裏來，你要膏他作我民以色列的君。他必救我民脫離非利士人的手；因我民的哀聲上達於我，我就眷顧他們。」
verses.e: " Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin , and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel . He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines ; for I have looked upon my people , because their cry has come to me . "

verses.z: 撒母耳看見掃羅的時候，耶和華對他說：「看哪，這人就是我對你所說的，他必治理我的民。」
verses.e: When Samuel saw Saul , the LORD said to him , " Behold , the man of whom I spoke to you ! He will have authority over my people . "

verses.z: 掃羅在城門裏走到撒母耳跟前，說：「請告訴我，先見的寓所在哪裏？」
verses.e: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway , and said , " Please tell me where the seer's house is . "

verses.z: 撒母耳回答說：「我就是先見。你在我前面上邱壇去，因為你們今日必與我同席；明日早晨我送你去，將你心裏的事都告訴你。
verses.e: Samuel answered Saul and said , " I am the seer . Go up before me to the high place , for you are to eat with me today . In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart .

verses.z: 他有一個兒子，名叫掃羅，又健壯、又俊美，在以色列人中沒有一個能比他的；身體比眾民高過一頭。
verses.e: He had a son whose name was Saul , an impressive young man ; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he . From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people .

verses.z: 至於你前三日所丟的那幾頭驢，你心裏不必掛念，已經找着了。以色列眾人所仰慕的是誰呢？不是仰慕你和你父的全家嗎？」
verses.e: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago , don't set your mind on them , for they have been found . For whom does all Israel desire ? Is it not you and all your father's house ? "

verses.z: 掃羅說：「我不是以色列支派中至小的便雅憫人嗎？我家不是便雅憫支派中至小的家嗎？你為何對我說這樣的話呢？」
verses.e: Saul answered , " Am I not a Benjamite , of the smallest of the tribes of Israel ? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin ? Why then do you speak to me like this ? "

verses.z: 撒母耳領掃羅和他僕人進了客堂，使他們在請來的客中坐首位；客約有三十個人。
verses.e: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room , and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited , who were about thirty persons .

verses.z: 撒母耳對廚役說：「我交給你收存的那一分[祭肉]現在可以拿來。」
verses.e: Samuel said to the cook , " Bring the portion which I gave you , of which I said to you , ' Set it aside . ' "

verses.z: 廚役就把收存的腿拿來，擺在掃羅面前，撒母耳說：「這是所留下的，放在你面前。吃吧！因我請百姓的時候，特意為你存留這肉到此時。」當日，掃羅就與撒母耳同席。
verses.e: The cook took up the thigh , and that which was on it , and set it before Saul . Samuel said , " Behold , that which has been reserved ! Set it before yourself and eat ; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time , for I said , ' I have invited the people . ' " So Saul ate with Samuel that day .

verses.z: 眾人從邱壇下來進城，撒母耳和掃羅在房頂上說話。
verses.e: When they had come down from the high place into the city , he talked with Saul on the housetop .

verses.z: 次日清早起來，黎明的時候，掃羅在房頂上。撒母耳呼叫他說：「起來吧，我好送你回去。」掃羅就起來，和撒母耳一同出去。
verses.e: They arose early ; and about daybreak , Samuel called to Saul on the housetop , saying , " Get up , that I may send you away . " Saul arose , and they both went outside , he and Samuel , together .

verses.z: 二人下到城角，撒母耳對掃羅說：「要吩咐僕人先走（僕人就先走了）；你且站在這裏，等我將上帝的話傳與你聽。」
verses.e: As they were going down at the end of the city , Samuel said to Saul , " Tell the servant to go on ahead of us . " He went ahead , then Samuel said , " But stand still first , that I may cause you to hear God's message . "

verses.z: 掃羅的父親基士丟了幾頭驢，他就吩咐兒子掃羅說：「你帶一個僕人去尋找驢。」
verses.e: The donkeys of Kish , Saul's father , were lost . Kish said to Saul his son , " Now take one of the servants with you , and arise , go look for the donkeys . "

verses.z: 掃羅就走過以法蓮山地，又過沙利沙地，都沒有找着；又過沙琳地，驢也不在那裏；又過便雅憫地，還沒有找着。
verses.e: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim , and passed through the land of Shalishah , but they didn't find them . Then they passed through the land of Shaalim , and they weren't there . Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites , but they didn't find them .

verses.z: 到了蘇弗地，掃羅對跟隨他的僕人說：「我們不如回去，恐怕我父親不為驢掛心，反為我們擔憂。」
verses.e: When they had come to the land of Zuph , Saul said to his servant who was with him , " Come ! Let's return , lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us . "

verses.z: 僕人說：「這城裏有一位神人，是眾人所尊重的，凡他所說的全都應驗。我們不如往他那裏去，或者他能將我們當走的路指示我們。」
verses.e: The servant said to him , " Behold now , there is a man of God in this city , and he is a man who is held in honor . All that he says surely happens . Now let's go there . Perhaps he can tell us which way to go . "

verses.z: 掃羅對僕人說：「我們若去，有甚麼可以送那人呢？我們囊中的食物都吃盡了，也沒有禮物可以送那神人，我們還有甚麼沒有？」
verses.e: Then Saul said to his servant , " But behold , if we go , what should we bring the man ? For the bread is spent in our sacks , and there is not a present to bring to the man of God . What do we have ? "

verses.z: 僕人回答掃羅說：「我手裏有銀子一舍客勒的四分之一，可以送那神人，請他指示我們當走的路。」（
verses.e: The servant answered Saul again and said , " Behold , I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver . I will give that to the man of God , to tell us our way . "

verses.z: 從前以色列中，若有人去問上帝，就說：「我們問先見去吧！」現在稱為「先知」的，從前稱為「先見」。）
verses.e: ( In earlier times in Israel , when a man went to inquire of God , he said , " Come ! Let's go to the seer ; " for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer . )

verses.z: 保羅、西拉、提摩太寫信給帖撒羅尼迦在父上帝和主耶穌基督裏的教會。願恩惠、平安歸與你們！
verses.e: Paul , Silvanus , and Timothy , to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ : Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 等候他兒子從天降臨，就是他從死裏復活的－那位救我們脫離將來忿怒的耶穌。
verses.e: and to wait for his Son from heaven , whom he raised from the dead : Jesus , who delivers us from the wrath to come .

verses.z: 我們為你們眾人常常感謝上帝，禱告的時候提到你們，
verses.e: We always give thanks to God for all of you , mentioning you in our prayers ,

verses.z: 在上帝－我們的父面前，不住地記念你們因信心所做的工夫，因愛心所受的勞苦，因盼望我們主耶穌基督所存的忍耐。
verses.e: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ , before our God and Father .

verses.z: 被上帝所愛的弟兄啊，我知道你們是蒙揀選的；
verses.e: We know , brothers loved by God , that you are chosen ,

verses.z: 因為我們的福音傳到你們那裏，不獨在乎言語，也在乎權能和聖靈，並充足的信心。正如你們知道，我們在你們那裏，為你們的緣故是怎樣為人。
verses.e: and that our Good News came to you not in word only , but also in power , and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance . You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake .

verses.z: 並且你們在大難之中，蒙了聖靈所賜的喜樂，領受真道就效法我們，也效法了主；
verses.e: You became imitators of us and of the Lord , having received the word in much affliction , with joy of the Holy Spirit ,

verses.z: 甚至你們作了馬其頓和亞該亞所有信[主]之人的榜樣。
verses.e: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia .

verses.z: 因為主的道從你們那裏已經傳揚出來。你們向上帝的信心不但在馬其頓和亞該亞，就是在各處也都傳開了，所以不用我們說甚麼話。
verses.e: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared , not only in Macedonia and Achaia , but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out , so that we need not to say anything .

verses.z: 因為他們自己已經報明我們是怎樣進到你們那裏，你們是怎樣離棄偶像，歸向上帝，要服事那又真又活的上帝，
verses.e: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you , and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們自己原曉得我們進到你們那裏並不是徒然的。
verses.e: For you yourselves know , brothers , our visit to you wasn't in vain ,

verses.z: 我們向你們信[主]的人，是何等聖潔、公義、無可指摘，有你們作見證，也有上帝作見證。
verses.e: You are witnesses with God how holy , righteously , and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe .

verses.z: 你們也曉得，我們怎樣勸勉你們，安慰你們，囑咐你們各人，好像父親待自己的兒女一樣，
verses.e: As you know , we exhorted , comforted , and implored every one of you , as a father does his own children ,

verses.z: 要叫你們行事對得起那召你們進他國、得他榮耀的上帝。
verses.e: to the end that you should walk worthily of God , who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory .

verses.z: 為此，我們也不住地感謝上帝，因你們聽見我們所傳上帝的道就領受了；不以為是人的道，乃以為是上帝的道。這道實在是上帝的，並且運行在你們信[主]的人心中。
verses.e: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God , you accepted it not as the word of men , but as it is in truth , God's word , which also works in you who believe .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們曾效法猶太中在基督耶穌裏上帝的各教會；因為你們也受了本地人的苦害，像他們受了猶太人的苦害一樣。
verses.e: For you , brothers , became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus ; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen , even as they did from the Jews

verses.z: 這猶太人殺了主耶穌和先知，又把我們趕出去。他們不得上帝的喜悅，且與眾人為敵，
verses.e: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets , and drove us out , and don't please God , and are contrary to all men ,

verses.z: 不許我們傳道給外邦人使外邦人得救，常常充滿自己的罪惡。[上帝的]忿怒臨在他們身上已經到了極處。
verses.e: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved , to fill up their sins always . But wrath has come on them to the uttermost .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我們暫時與你們離別，是面目離別，心裏卻不離別；我們極力地想法子，很願意見你們的面。
verses.e: But we , brothers , being bereaved of you for a short season in presence , not in heart , tried even harder to see your face with great desire ,

verses.z: 所以我們有意到你們那裏；我－保羅有一兩次要去，只是撒但阻擋了我們。
verses.e: because we wanted to come to you — indeed , I , Paul , once and again — but Satan hindered us .

verses.z: 我們的盼望和喜樂，並所誇的冠冕是甚麼呢？豈不是我們主耶穌來的時候、你們在他面前站[立得住]嗎？
verses.e: For what is our hope , or joy , or crown of rejoicing ? Isn't it even you , before our Lord Jesus at his coming ?

verses.z: 我們從前在腓立比被害受辱，這是你們知道的；然而還是靠我們的上帝放開膽量，在大爭戰中把上帝的福音傳給你們。
verses.e: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated , as you know , at Philippi , we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict .

verses.z: 因為你們就是我們的榮耀，我們的喜樂。
verses.e: For you are our glory and our joy .

verses.z: 我們的勸勉不是出於錯誤，不是出於污穢，也不是用詭詐。
verses.e: For our exhortation is not of error , nor of uncleanness , nor in deception .

verses.z: 但上帝既然驗中了我們，把福音託付我們，我們就照樣講，不是要討人喜歡，乃是要討那察驗我們心的上帝喜歡。
verses.e: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News , so we speak — not as pleasing men , but God , who tests our hearts .

verses.z: 因為我們從來沒有用過諂媚的話，這是你們知道的；也沒有藏着貪心，這是上帝可以作見證的。
verses.e: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery , as you know , nor a cloak of covetousness ( God is witness ) ,

verses.z: 我們作基督的使徒，雖然可以叫人尊重，卻沒有向你們或向別人求榮耀；
verses.e: nor seeking glory from men ( neither from you nor from others ) , when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ .

verses.z: 只在你們中間存心溫柔，如同母親乳養自己的孩子。
verses.e: But we were gentle among you , like a nursing mother cherishes her own children .

verses.z: 我們既是這樣愛你們，不但願意將上帝的福音給你們，連自己的性命也願意給你們，因你們是我們所疼愛的。
verses.e: Even so , affectionately longing for you , we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only , but also our own souls , because you had become very dear to us .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們記念我們的辛苦勞碌，晝夜做工，傳上帝的福音給你們，免得叫你們一人受累。
verses.e: For you remember , brothers , our labor and travail ; for working night and day , that we might not burden any of you , we preached to you the Good News of God .

verses.z: 我們既不能再忍，就願意獨自等在雅典，
verses.e: Therefore when we couldn't stand it any longer , we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone ,

verses.z: 我們晝夜切切地祈求，要見你們的面，補滿你們信心的不足。
verses.e: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith ?

verses.z: 願上帝－我們的父和我們的主耶穌一直引領我們到你們那裏去。
verses.e: Now may our God and Father himself , and our Lord Jesus Christ , direct our way to you .

verses.z: 又願主叫你們彼此相愛的心，並愛眾人的心都能增長，充足，如同我們愛你們一樣，
verses.e: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men , even as we also do toward you ,

verses.z: 好使你們當我們主耶穌同他眾聖徒來的時候，在我們父上帝面前，心裏堅固，成為聖潔，無可責備。
verses.e: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints .

verses.z: 打發我們的兄弟在基督福音上作上帝執事的提摩太前去，堅固你們，並在你們所信的道上勸慰你們，
verses.e: and sent Timothy , our brother and God's servant in the Good News of Christ , to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith ,

verses.z: 免得有人被諸般患難搖動。因為你們自己知道，我們受患難原是命定的。
verses.e: that no one would be moved by these afflictions . For you know that we are appointed to this task .

verses.z: 我們在你們那裏的時候，預先告訴你們，我們必受患難，以後果然應驗了，你們也知道。
verses.e: For most certainly , when we were with you , we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction , even as it happened , and you know .

verses.z: 為此，我既不能再忍，就打發人去，要曉得你們的信心如何，恐怕那誘惑人的到底誘惑了你們，叫我們的勞苦歸於徒然。
verses.e: For this cause I also , when I couldn't stand it any longer , sent that I might know your faith , for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you , and our labor would have been in vain .

verses.z: 但提摩太剛才從你們那裏回來，將你們信心和愛心的好消息報給我們，又說你們常常記念我們，切切地想見我們，如同我們想見你們一樣。
verses.e: But Timothy has just now come to us from you , and brought us glad news of your faith and love , and that you have good memories of us always , longing to see us , even as we also long to see you .

verses.z: 所以，弟兄們，我們在一切困苦患難之中，因着你們的信心就得了安慰。
verses.e: For this cause , brothers , we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith .

verses.z: 你們若靠主站立得穩，我們就活了。
verses.e: For now we live , if you stand fast in the Lord .

verses.z: 我們在上帝面前，因着你們甚是喜樂；為這一切喜樂，可用何等的感謝為你們報答上帝呢？
verses.e: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you , for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，我還有話說：我們靠着主耶穌求你們，勸你們，你們既然受了我們的教訓，知道該怎樣行可以討上帝的喜悅，就要照你們現在所行的更加勉勵。
verses.e: Finally then , brothers , we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus , that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God , that you abound more and more .

verses.z: 你們向馬其頓全地的眾弟兄固然是這樣行，但我勸弟兄們要更加勉勵。
verses.e: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia . But we exhort you , brothers , that you abound more and more ;

verses.z: 又要立志作安靜人，辦自己的事，親手做工，正如我們從前所吩咐你們的，
verses.e: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life , and to do your own business , and to work with your own hands , even as we instructed you ,

verses.z: 叫你們可以向外人行事端正，自己也就沒有甚麼缺乏了。
verses.e: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside , and may have need of nothing .

verses.z: 論到睡了的人，我們不願意弟兄們不知道，恐怕你們憂傷，像那些沒有指望的人一樣。
verses.e: But we don't want you to be ignorant , brothers , concerning those who have fallen asleep , so that you don't grieve like the rest , who have no hope .

verses.z: 我們若信耶穌死而復活了，那已經在耶穌裏睡了的人，上帝也必將他們與耶穌一同帶來。
verses.e: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again , even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus .

verses.z: 我們現在照主的話告訴你們一件事：我們這活着還存留到主降臨的人，斷不能在那已經睡了的人之先。
verses.e: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord , that we who are alive , who are left until the coming of the Lord , will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep .

verses.z: 因為主必親自從天降臨，有呼叫的聲音和天使長的聲音，又有上帝的號[吹響]；那在基督裏死了的人必先復活。
verses.e: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout , with the voice of the archangel and with God's trumpet . The dead in Christ will rise first ,

verses.z: 以後我們這活着還存留的人必和他們一同被提到雲裏，在空中與主相遇。這樣，我們就要和主永遠同在。
verses.e: then we who are alive , who are left , will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air . So we will be with the Lord forever .

verses.z: 所以，你們當用這些話彼此勸慰。
verses.e: Therefore comfort one another with these words .

verses.z: 你們原曉得，我們憑主耶穌傳給你們甚麼命令。
verses.e: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus .

verses.z: 上帝的旨意就是要你們成為聖潔，遠避淫行；
verses.e: For this is the will of God : your sanctification , that you abstain from sexual immorality ,

verses.z: 要你們各人曉得怎樣用聖潔、尊貴守着自己的身體，
verses.e: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor ,

verses.z: 不放縱私慾的邪情，像那不認識上帝的外邦人。
verses.e: not in the passion of lust , even as the Gentiles who don't know God ,

verses.z: 不要一個人在這事上越分，欺負他的弟兄；因為這一類的事，主必報應，正如我預先對你們說過、又切切囑咐你們的。
verses.e: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter ; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things , as also we forewarned you and testified .

verses.z: 上帝召我們，本不是要我們沾染污穢，乃是要我們成為聖潔。
verses.e: For God called us not for uncleanness , but in sanctification .

verses.z: 所以，那棄絕的，不是棄絕人，乃是棄絕那賜聖靈給你們的上帝。
verses.e: Therefore he who rejects this doesn't reject man , but God , who has also given his Holy Spirit to you .

verses.z: 論到弟兄們相愛，不用人寫信給你們；因為你們自己蒙了上帝的教訓，叫你們彼此相愛。
verses.e: But concerning brotherly love , you have no need that one write to you . For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，論到時候、日期，不用寫信給你們，
verses.e: But concerning the times and the seasons , brothers , you have no need that anything be written to you .

verses.z: 他替我們死，叫我們無論醒着，睡着，都與他同活。
verses.e: who died for us , that , whether we wake or sleep , we should live together with him .

verses.z: 所以，你們該彼此勸慰，互相建立，正如你們素常所行的。
verses.e: Therefore exhort one another , and build each other up , even as you also do .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我們勸你們敬重那在你們中間勞苦的人，就是在主裏面治理你們、勸戒你們的；
verses.e: But we beg you , brothers , to know those who labor among you , and are over you in the Lord and admonish you ,

verses.z: 又因他們所做的工，用愛心格外尊重他們。你們也要彼此和睦。
verses.e: and to respect and honor them in love for their work's sake . Be at peace among yourselves .

verses.z: 我們又勸弟兄們，要警戒不守規矩的人，勉勵灰心的人，扶助軟弱的人，也要向眾人忍耐。
verses.e: We exhort you , brothers : Admonish the disorderly ; encourage the faint-hearted ; support the weak ; be patient toward all .

verses.z: 你們要謹慎，無論是誰都不可以惡報惡；或是彼此相待，或是待眾人，常要追求良善。
verses.e: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone , but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all .

verses.z: 要常常喜樂，
verses.e: Always rejoice .

verses.z: 不住地禱告，
verses.e: Pray without ceasing .

verses.z: 凡事謝恩；因為這是上帝在基督耶穌裏向你們所定的旨意。
verses.e: In everything give thanks , for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you .

verses.z: 不要消滅[聖]靈[的感動]；
verses.e: Don't quench the Spirit .

verses.z: 因為你們自己明明曉得，主的日子來到，好像夜間的賊一樣。
verses.e: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night .

verses.z: 不要藐視先知的講論。
verses.e: Don't despise prophecies .

verses.z: 但要凡事察驗；善美的要持守，
verses.e: Test all things , and hold firmly that which is good .

verses.z: 各樣的惡事要禁戒不做。
verses.e: Abstain from every form of evil .

verses.z: 願賜平安的上帝親自使你們全然成聖！又願你們的靈與魂與身子得蒙保守，在我們主耶穌基督降臨的時候，完全無可指摘！
verses.e: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely . May your whole spirit , soul , and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 那召你們的本是信實的，他必成就這事。
verses.e: He who calls you is faithful , who will also do it .

verses.z: 請弟兄們為我們禱告。
verses.e: Brothers , pray for us .

verses.z: 與眾弟兄親嘴問安，務要聖潔。
verses.e: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss .

verses.z: 我指着主囑咐你們，要把這信念給眾弟兄聽。
verses.e: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers .

verses.z: 願我主耶穌基督的恩[常]與你們同在！
verses.e: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
