verses.z: 人正說「平安穩妥」的時候，災禍忽然臨到他們，如同產難臨到懷胎的婦人一樣，他們絕不能逃脫。
verses.e: For when they are saying , " Peace and safety , " then sudden destruction will come on them , like birth pains on a pregnant woman . Then they will in no way escape .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們卻不在黑暗裏，叫那日子臨到你們像賊一樣。
verses.e: But you , brothers , aren't in darkness , that the day should overtake you like a thief .

verses.z: 你們都是光明之子，都是白晝之子。我們不是屬黑夜的，也不是屬幽暗的。
verses.e: You are all children of light and children of the day . We don't belong to the night , nor to darkness ,

verses.z: 所以，我們不要睡覺像別人一樣，總要警醒謹守。
verses.e: so then let's not sleep , as the rest do , but let's watch and be sober .

verses.z: 因為睡了的人是在夜間睡，醉了的人是在夜間醉。
verses.e: For those who sleep , sleep in the night ; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night .

verses.z: 但我們既然屬乎白晝，就應當謹守，把信和愛當作護心鏡遮胸，把得救的盼望當作頭盔戴上。
verses.e: But since we belong to the day , let's be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love , and for a helmet , the hope of salvation .

verses.z: 因為上帝不是預定我們受刑，乃是預定我們藉着我們主耶穌基督得救。
verses.e: For God didn't appoint us to wrath , but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 奉我們救主上帝和我們的盼望基督耶穌之命，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅
verses.e: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope ,

verses.z: 行淫和親男色的，搶人口和說謊話的，並起假誓的，或是為別樣敵正道的事設立的。
verses.e: for the sexually immoral , for homosexuals , for slave-traders , for liars , for perjurers , and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine ,

verses.z: 這是照着可稱頌之上帝交託我榮耀福音說的。
verses.e: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God , which was committed to my trust .

verses.z: 我感謝那給我力量的我們主基督耶穌，因他以我有忠心，派我服事他。
verses.e: I thank him who enabled me , Christ Jesus our Lord , because he counted me faithful , appointing me to service ,

verses.z: 我從前是褻瀆[上帝]的，逼迫[人]的，侮慢[人]的；然而我還蒙了憐憫，因我是不信不明白的時候而做的。
verses.e: although I used to be a blasphemer , a persecutor , and insolent . However , I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief .

verses.z: 並且我主的恩是格外豐盛，使我在基督耶穌裏有信心和愛心。
verses.e: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 「基督耶穌降世，為要拯救罪人。」這話是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是個罪魁。
verses.e: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance , that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners , of whom I am chief .

verses.z: 然而，我蒙了憐憫，是因耶穌基督要在我這罪魁身上顯明他一切的忍耐，給後來信他得永生的人作榜樣。
verses.e: However , for this cause I obtained mercy , that in me first , Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life .

verses.z: 但願尊貴、榮耀歸與那不能朽壞、不能看見、永世的君王、獨一的上帝，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: Now to the King eternal , immortal , invisible , to God who alone is wise , be honor and glory forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 我兒提摩太啊，我照從前指着你的預言，將這命令交託你，叫你因此可以打那美好的仗。
verses.e: I commit this instruction to you , my child Timothy , according to the prophecies which were given to you before , that by them you may wage the good warfare ,

verses.z: 常存信心和無虧的良心。有人丟棄良心，就在真道上如同船破壞了一般。
verses.e: holding faith and a good conscience , which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith ,

verses.z: 寫信給那因信主作我真兒子的提摩太。願恩惠、憐憫、平安從父上帝和我們主基督耶穌歸與你！
verses.e: to Timothy , my true child in faith : Grace , mercy , and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .

verses.z: 其中有許米乃和亞歷山大；我已經把他們交給撒但，使他們受責罰就不再謗瀆了。
verses.e: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander , whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme .

verses.z: 我往馬其頓去的時候，曾勸你仍住在以弗所，好囑咐那幾個人不可傳異教，
verses.e: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia , stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine ,

verses.z: 也不可聽從荒渺無憑的話語和無窮的家譜；這等事只生辯論，並不發明上帝在信上所立的章程。
verses.e: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies , which cause disputes rather than God's stewardship , which is in faith .

verses.z: 但命令的總歸就是愛；這愛是從清潔的心和無虧的良心，無偽的信心生出來的。
verses.e: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart , a good conscience , and sincere faith ,

verses.z: 有人偏離這些，反去講虛浮的話，
verses.e: from which things some , having missed the mark , have turned away to vain talking ,

verses.z: 想要作教法師，卻不明白自己所講說的所論定的。
verses.e: desiring to be teachers of the law , though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm .

verses.z: 我們知道律法原是好的，只要人用得合宜；
verses.e: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully ,

verses.z: 因為律法不是為義人設立的，乃是為不法和不服的，不虔誠和犯罪的，不聖潔和戀世俗的，弒父母和殺人的，
verses.e: as knowing this , that law is not made for a righteous person , but for the lawless and insubordinate , for the ungodly and sinners , for the unholy and profane , for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers , for manslayers ,

verses.z: 我勸你，第一要為萬人懇求、禱告、代求、祝謝；
verses.e: I exhort therefore , first of all , that petitions , prayers , intercessions , and givings of thanks be made for all men ,

verses.z: 只要有善行，這才與自稱是敬上帝的女人相宜。
verses.e: but with good works , which is appropriate for women professing godliness .

verses.z: 女人要沉靜學道，一味地順服。
verses.e: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission .

verses.z: 我不許女人講道，也不許她轄管男人，只要沉靜。
verses.e: But I don't permit a woman to teach , nor to exercise authority over a man , but to be in quietness .

verses.z: 因為先造的是亞當，後造的是夏娃，
verses.e: For Adam was formed first , then Eve .

verses.z: 且不是亞當被引誘，乃是女人被引誘，陷在罪裏。
verses.e: Adam wasn't deceived , but the woman , being deceived , has fallen into disobedience ;

verses.z: 然而，女人若常存信心、愛心，又聖潔自守，就必在生產上得救。
verses.e: but she will be saved through her childbearing , if they continue in faith , love , and holiness with sobriety .

verses.z: 為君王和一切在位的，[也該如此]，使我們可以敬虔、端正、平安無事地度日。
verses.e: for kings and all who are in high places , that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence .

verses.z: 這是好的，在上帝我們救主面前可蒙悅納。
verses.e: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior ,

verses.z: 他願意萬人得救，明白真道。
verses.e: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth .

verses.z: 因為只有一位上帝，在上帝和人中間，只有一位中保，乃是[降世]為人的基督耶穌；
verses.e: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men , the man Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 他捨自己作萬人的贖價，到了時候，這事必證明出來。
verses.e: who gave himself as a ransom for all , the testimony at the proper time ,

verses.z: 我為此奉派作傳道的，作使徒，作外邦人的師傅，教導他們相信，學習真道。我說的是真話，並不是謊言。
verses.e: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle — I am telling the truth in Christ , not lying — a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth .

verses.z: 我願男人無忿怒，無爭論，舉起聖潔的手，隨處禱告；
verses.e: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray , lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting .

verses.z: 又願女人廉恥、自守，以正派衣裳為妝飾，不以編髮、黃金、珍珠，和貴價的衣裳為妝飾，
verses.e: In the same way , that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing , with modesty and propriety , not with braided hair , gold , pearls , or expensive clothing ,

verses.z: 「人若想要得監督的職分，就是羨慕善工。」這話是可信的。
verses.e: This is a faithful saying : someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work .

verses.z: 這等人也要先受試驗，若沒有可責之處，然後叫他們作執事。
verses.e: Let them also first be tested ; then let them serve if they are blameless .

verses.z: 女執事也是如此：必須端莊，不說讒言，有節制，凡事忠心。
verses.e: Their wives in the same way must be reverent , not slanderers , temperate , and faithful in all things .

verses.z: 執事只要作一個婦人的丈夫，好好管理兒女和自己的家。
verses.e: Let servants be husbands of one wife , ruling their children and their own houses well .

verses.z: 因為善作執事的，自己就得到美好的地步，並且在基督耶穌裏的真道上大有膽量。
verses.e: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 我指望快到你那裏去，所以先將這些事寫給你。
verses.e: These things I write to you , hoping to come to you shortly ,

verses.z: 倘若我耽延日久，你也可以知道在上帝的家中當怎樣行。這家就是永生上帝的教會，真理的柱石和根基。
verses.e: but if I wait long , that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God's house , which is the assembly of the living God , the pillar and ground of the truth .

verses.z: 大哉，敬虔的奧祕，無人不以為然！就是上帝在肉身顯現，被聖靈稱義，被天使看見，被傳於外邦，被世人信服，被接在榮耀裏。
verses.e: Without controversy , the mystery of godliness is great : God was revealed in the flesh , justified in the spirit , seen by angels , preached among the nations , believed on in the world , and received up in glory .

verses.z: 作監督的，必須無可指責，只作一個婦人的丈夫，有節制，自守，端正，樂意接待遠人，善於教導；
verses.e: The overseer therefore must be without reproach , the husband of one wife , temperate , sensible , modest , hospitable , good at teaching ;

verses.z: 不因酒滋事，不打人，只要溫和，不爭競，不貪財；
verses.e: not a drinker , not violent , not greedy for money , but gentle , not quarrelsome , not covetous ;

verses.z: 好好管理自己的家，使兒女凡事端莊順服。
verses.e: one who rules his own house well , having children in subjection with all reverence ;

verses.z: 人若不知道管理自己的家，焉能照管上帝的教會呢？
verses.e: ( for how could someone who doesn't know how to rule his own house take care of God's assembly ? )

verses.z: 初入教的不可作監督，恐怕他自高自大，就落在魔鬼[所受]的刑罰裏。
verses.e: not a new convert , lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil .

verses.z: 監督也必須在教外有好名聲，恐怕被人毀謗，落在魔鬼的網羅裏。
verses.e: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside , to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil .

verses.z: 作執事的，也是如此：必須端莊，不一口兩舌，不好喝酒，不貪不義之財；
verses.e: Servants , in the same way , must be reverent , not double-tongued , not addicted to much wine , not greedy for money ,

verses.z: 要存清潔的良心，固守真道的奧祕。
verses.e: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience .

verses.z: 聖靈明說，在後來的時候，必有人離棄真道，聽從那引誘人的[邪]靈和鬼魔的道理。
verses.e: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith , paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons ,

verses.z: 我們勞苦努力，正是為此，因我們的指望在乎永生的上帝；他是萬人的救主，更是信徒的救主。
verses.e: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach , because we have set our trust in the living God , who is the Savior of all men , especially of those who believe .

verses.z: 這些事，你要吩咐人，也要教導人。
verses.e: Command and teach these things .

verses.z: 不可叫人小看你年輕，總要在言語、行為、愛心、信心、清潔上，都作信徒的榜樣。
verses.e: Let no man despise your youth ; but be an example to those who believe , in word , in your way of life , in love , in spirit , in faith , and in purity .

verses.z: 你要以宣讀、勸勉、教導為念，直等到我來。
verses.e: Until I come , pay attention to reading , to exhortation , and to teaching .

verses.z: 你不要輕忽所得的恩賜，就是從前藉着預言、在眾長老按手的時候賜給你的。
verses.e: Don't neglect the gift that is in you , which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders .

verses.z: 這些事你要殷勤去做，並要在此專心，使眾人看出你的長進來。
verses.e: Be diligent in these things . Give yourself wholly to them , that your progress may be revealed to all .

verses.z: 你要謹慎自己和自己的教訓，要在這些事上恆心；因為這樣行，又能救自己，又能救聽你的人。
verses.e: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching . Continue in these things , for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you .

verses.z: 這是因為說謊之人的假冒；這等人的良心如同被熱鐵烙慣了一般。
verses.e: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies , branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron ,

verses.z: 他們禁止嫁娶，又禁戒食物，就是上帝所造、叫那信而明白真道的人感謝着領受的。
verses.e: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth .

verses.z: 凡上帝所造的物都是好的，若感謝着領受，就沒有一樣可棄的，
verses.e: For every creature of God is good , and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving .

verses.z: 都因上帝的道和人的祈求成為聖潔了。
verses.e: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer .

verses.z: 你若將這些事提醒弟兄們，便是基督耶穌的好執事，在真道的話語和你向來所服從的善道上得了教育。
verses.e: If you instruct the brothers of these things , you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus , nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed .

verses.z: 只是要棄絕那世俗的言語和老婦荒渺的話，在敬虔上操練自己。
verses.e: But refuse profane and old wives ' fables . Exercise yourself toward godliness .

verses.z: 「操練身體，益處還少；惟獨敬虔，凡事都有益處，因有今生和來生的應許。」
verses.e: For bodily exercise has some value , but godliness has value in all things , having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come .

verses.z: 這話是可信的，是十分可佩服的。
verses.e: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance .

verses.z: 不可嚴責老年人，只要勸他如同父親；勸少年人如同弟兄；
verses.e: Don't rebuke an older man , but exhort him as a father ; the younger men as brothers ;

verses.z: 又有行善的名聲，就如養育兒女，接待遠人，洗聖徒的腳，救濟遭難的人，竭力行各樣善事。
verses.e: being approved by good works , if she has brought up children , if she has been hospitable to strangers , if she has washed the saints ' feet , if she has relieved the afflicted , and if she has diligently followed every good work .

verses.z: 至於年輕的寡婦，就可以辭她；因為她們的情慾發動，違背基督的時候就想要嫁人。
verses.e: But refuse younger widows , for when they have grown wanton against Christ , they desire to marry ,

verses.z: 她們被定罪，是因廢棄了當初所許的願；
verses.e: having condemnation , because they have rejected their first pledge .

verses.z: 並且她們又習慣懶惰，挨家閒遊；不但是懶惰，又說長道短，好管閒事，說些不當說的話。
verses.e: Besides , they also learn to be idle , going about from house to house . Not only idle , but also gossips and busybodies , saying things which they ought not .

verses.z: 所以我願意年輕的[寡婦]嫁人，生養兒女，治理家務，不給敵人辱罵的把柄。
verses.e: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry , bear children , rule the household , and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting .

verses.z: 因為已經有轉去隨從撒但的。
verses.e: For already some have turned away after Satan .

verses.z: 信[主]的婦女，若家中有寡婦，自己就當救濟她們，不可累着教會，好使教會能救濟那真[無倚靠的]寡婦。
verses.e: If any man or woman who believes has widows , let them relieve them , and don't let the assembly be burdened , that it might relieve those who are widows indeed .

verses.z: 那善於管理教會的長老，當以為配受加倍的敬奉；那勞苦傳道教導人的，更當如此。
verses.e: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor , especially those who labor in the word and in teaching .

verses.z: 因為經上說：「牛[在場上]踹穀的時候，不可籠住牠的嘴」；又說：「工人得工價是應當的。」
verses.e: For the Scripture says , " You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain . " And , " The laborer is worthy of his wages . "

verses.z: 控告長老的呈子，非有兩三個見證就不要收。
verses.e: Don't receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses .

verses.z: 勸老年婦女如同母親；勸少年婦女如同姊妹；總要清清潔潔的。
verses.e: the elder women as mothers ; the younger as sisters , in all purity .

verses.z: 犯罪的人，當在眾人面前責備他，叫其餘的人也可以懼怕。
verses.e: Those who sin , reprove in the sight of all , that the rest also may be in fear .

verses.z: 我在上帝和基督耶穌並蒙揀選的天使面前囑咐你：要遵守這些話，不可存成見，行事也不可有偏心。
verses.e: I command you in the sight of God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , and the chosen angels , that you observe these things without prejudice , doing nothing by partiality .

verses.z: 給人行按手的禮，不可急促；不要在別人的罪上有分，要保守自己清潔。
verses.e: Lay hands hastily on no one . Don't be a participant in other people's sins . Keep yourself pure .

verses.z: 因你胃口不清，屢次患病，再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用點酒。
verses.e: Be no longer a drinker of water only , but use a little wine for your stomach's sake and your frequent infirmities .

verses.z: 有些人的罪是明顯的，[如同]先到審判案前；有些人的罪是隨後跟了去的。
verses.e: Some men's sins are evident , preceding them to judgment , and some also follow later .

verses.z: 這樣，善行也有明顯的，那不明顯的也不能隱藏。
verses.e: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious , and those that are otherwise can't be hidden .

verses.z: 要尊敬那真為寡婦的。
verses.e: Honor widows who are widows indeed .

verses.z: 若寡婦有兒女，或有孫子孫女，便叫他們先在自己家中學着行孝，報答親恩，因為這在上帝面前是可悅納的。
verses.e: But if any widow has children or grandchildren , let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents , for this is acceptable in the sight of God .

verses.z: 那獨居無靠、真為寡婦的，是仰賴上帝，晝夜不住地祈求禱告。
verses.e: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate , has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day .

verses.z: 但那好宴樂的寡婦正活着的時候也是死的。
verses.e: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives .

verses.z: 這些事你要囑咐她們，叫她們無可指責。
verses.e: Also command these things , that they may be without reproach .

verses.z: 人若不看顧親屬，就是背了真道，比不信的人還不好，不看顧自己家裏的人，更是如此。
verses.e: But if anyone doesn't provide for his own , and especially his own household , he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever .

verses.z: 寡婦記在冊子上，必須年紀到六十歲，從來只作一個丈夫的妻子，
verses.e: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old , having been the wife of one man ,

verses.z: 凡在軛下作僕人的，當以自己主人配受十分的恭敬，免得上帝的名和道理被人褻瀆。
verses.e: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor , that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed .

verses.z: 貪財是萬惡之根。有人貪戀錢財，就被引誘離了真道，用許多愁苦把自己刺透了。
verses.e: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil . Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed , and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows .

verses.z: 但你這屬上帝的人要逃避這些事，追求公義、敬虔、信心、愛心、忍耐、溫柔。
verses.e: But you , man of God , flee these things , and follow after righteousness , godliness , faith , love , perseverance , and gentleness .

verses.z: 你要為真道打那美好的仗，持定永生。你為此被召，也在許多見證人面前，已經作了那美好的見證。
verses.e: Fight the good fight of faith . Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called , and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses .

verses.z: 我在叫萬物生活的上帝面前，並在向本丟‧彼拉多作過那美好見證的基督耶穌面前囑咐你：
verses.e: I command you before God who gives life to all things , and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession ,

verses.z: 要守這命令，毫不玷污，無可指責，直到我們的主耶穌基督顯現。
verses.e: that you keep the commandment without spot , blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 到了日期，那可稱頌、獨有權能的萬王之王、萬主之主，
verses.e: which at the right time he will show , who is the blessed and only Ruler , the King of kings and Lord of lords .

verses.z: 就是那獨一不死、住在人不能靠近的光裏，是人未曾看見、也是不能看見的，要將他顯明出來。但願尊貴和永遠的權能都歸給他。阿們！
verses.e: He alone has immortality , dwelling in unapproachable light , whom no man has seen nor can see , to whom be honor and eternal power . Amen .

verses.z: 你要囑咐那些今世富足的人，不要自高，也不要倚靠無定的錢財；只要倚靠那厚賜百物給我們享受的上帝。
verses.e: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant , nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches , but on the living God , who richly provides us with everything to enjoy ;

verses.z: 又要囑咐他們行善，在好事上富足，甘心施捨，樂意供給人，
verses.e: that they do good , that they be rich in good works , that they be ready to distribute , willing to share ;

verses.z: 為自己積成美好的根基，預備將來，叫他們持定那真正的生命。
verses.e: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come , that they may lay hold of eternal life .

verses.z: 僕人有信道的主人，不可因為與他是弟兄就輕看他；更要加意服事他；因為得服事之益處的，是信道蒙愛的。你要以此教訓人，勸勉人。
verses.e: Those who have believing masters , let them not despise them because they are brothers , but rather let them serve them , because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved . Teach and exhort these things .

verses.z: 提摩太啊，你要保守所託付你的，躲避世俗的虛談和那敵真道、似是而非的學問。
verses.e: Timothy , guard that which is committed to you , turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge ,

verses.z: 已經有人自稱有這學問，就偏離了真道。願恩惠[常]與你們同在！
verses.e: which some profess , and thus have wandered from the faith . Grace be with you . Amen .

verses.z: 若有人傳異教，不服從我們主耶穌基督純正的話與那合乎敬虔的道理，
verses.e: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn't consent to sound words , the words of our Lord Jesus Christ , and to the doctrine which is according to godliness ,

verses.z: 他是自高自大，一無所知，專好問難，爭辯言詞，從此就生出嫉妒、紛爭、毀謗、妄疑，
verses.e: he is conceited , knowing nothing , but obsessed with arguments , disputes , and word battles , from which come envy , strife , insulting , evil suspicions ,

verses.z: 並那壞了心術、失喪真理之人的爭競。他們以敬虔為得利的門路。
verses.e: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth , who suppose that godliness is a means of gain . Withdraw yourself from such .

verses.z: 然而，敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了；
verses.e: But godliness with contentment is great gain .

verses.z: 因為我們沒有帶甚麼到世上來，也不能帶甚麼去。
verses.e: For we brought nothing into the world , and we certainly can't carry anything out .

verses.z: 只要有衣有食，就當知足。
verses.e: But having food and clothing , we will be content with that .

verses.z: 但那些想要發財的人，就陷在迷惑、落在網羅和許多無知有害的私慾裏，叫人沉在敗壞和滅亡中。
verses.e: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation , a snare , and many foolish and harmful lusts , such as drown men in ruin and destruction .

verses.z: 大衛的兒子所羅門國位堅固；耶和華－他的上帝與他同在，使他甚為尊大。
verses.e: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom , and the LORD his God was with him , and made him exceedingly great .

verses.z: 求你賜我智慧聰明，我好在這民前出入；不然，誰能判斷這眾多的民呢？」
verses.e: Now give me wisdom and knowledge , that I may go out and come in before this people ; for who can judge this great people of yours ? "

verses.z: 上帝對所羅門說：「我已立你作我民的王。你既有這心意，並不求資財、豐富、尊榮，也不求滅絕那恨你之人的性命，又不求大壽數，只求智慧聰明好判斷我的民；
verses.e: God said to Solomon , " Because this was in your heart , and you have not asked riches , wealth , honor , or the life of those who hate you , nor yet have you asked for long life ; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself , that you may judge my people , over whom I have made you king ,

verses.z: 我必賜你智慧聰明，也必賜你資財、豐富、尊榮。在你以前的列王都沒有這樣，在你以後也必沒有這樣的。」
verses.e: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you . I will give you riches , wealth , and honor , such as none of the kings have had who have been before you , and none after you will have . "

verses.z: 於是，所羅門從基遍邱壇會幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。
verses.e: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon , from before the Tent of Meeting , to Jerusalem ; and he reigned over Israel .

verses.z: 所羅門聚集戰車馬兵，有戰車一千四百輛，馬兵一萬二千名，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裏。
verses.e: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen . He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities , and with the king at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 王在耶路撒冷使金銀多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
verses.e: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem , and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland .

verses.z: 所羅門的馬是從埃及帶來的，是王的商人一群一群按着定價買來的。
verses.e: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue . The king's merchants purchased them from Kue .

verses.z: 他們從埃及買來的車，每輛價銀六百[舍客勒]，馬每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人諸王和亞蘭諸王所買的車馬，也是按這價值經他們手買來的。
verses.e: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty . They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings .

verses.z: 所羅門吩咐以色列眾人，就是千夫長、百夫長、審判官、首領與族長都來。
verses.e: Solomon spoke to all Israel , to the captains of thousands and of hundreds , to the judges , and to every prince in all Israel , the heads of the fathers ' households .

verses.z: 所羅門和會眾都往基遍的邱壇去，因那裏有上帝的會幕，就是耶和華僕人摩西在曠野所製造的。
verses.e: Then Solomon , and all the assembly with him , went to the high place that was at Gibeon ; for God's Tent of Meeting was there , which the LORD's servant Moses had made in the wilderness .

verses.z: 只是上帝的[約]櫃，大衛已經從基列‧耶琳搬到他所預備的[地方]，因他曾在耶路撒冷為[約]櫃支搭了帳幕，
verses.e: But David had brought God's ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it ; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 並且戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列所造的銅壇也在基遍耶和華的會幕前。所羅門和會眾都就近壇前。
verses.e: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , had made was there before the LORD's tabernacle ; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there .

verses.z: 所羅門上到耶和華面前會幕的銅壇那裏，獻一千犧牲為燔祭。
verses.e: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD , which was at the Tent of Meeting , and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it .

verses.z: 當夜，上帝向所羅門顯現，對他說：「你願我賜你甚麼，你可以求。」
verses.e: That night , God appeared to Solomon and said to him , " Ask for what you want me to give you . "

verses.z: 所羅門對上帝說：「你曾向我父大衛大施慈愛，使我接續他作王。
verses.e: Solomon said to God , " You have shown great loving kindness to David my father , and have made me king in his place .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝啊，現在求你成就向我父大衛所應許的話；因你立我作這民的王，他們如同地上塵沙那樣多。
verses.e: Now , LORD God , let your promise to David my father be established ; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude .

verses.z: 羅波安往示劍去，因為以色列人都到了示劍，要立他作王。
verses.e: Rehoboam went to Shechem , for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king .

verses.z: 那同他長大的少年人說：「這民對王說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些』；王要對他們如此說：『我的小拇指比我父親的腰還粗；
verses.e: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him , saying , " Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you , saying , ' Your father made our yoke heavy , but make it lighter on us ; ' thus you shall say to them , ' My little finger is thicker than my father's waist .

verses.z: 我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛；我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭責打你們]。』」
verses.e: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke , I will add to your yoke . My father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions . ' "

verses.z: 耶羅波安和眾百姓遵着羅波安王所說「你們第三日再來見我」的那話，第三日他們果然來了。
verses.e: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king asked , saying , " Come to me again the third day . "

verses.z: 羅波安王用嚴厲的話回覆他們，不用老年人所出的主意，
verses.e: The king answered them roughly ; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men ,

verses.z: 照着少年人所出的主意對他們說：「我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛；我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭責打你們]。」
verses.e: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men , saying , " My father made your yoke heavy , but I will add to it . My father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions . "

verses.z: 王不肯依從百姓；這事乃出於上帝，為要應驗耶和華藉示羅人亞希雅對尼八兒子耶羅波安所說的話。
verses.e: So the king didn't listen to the people ; for it was brought about by God , that the LORD might establish his word , which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

verses.z: 以色列眾民見王不依從他們，就對王說：我們與大衛有甚麼分兒呢？與耶西的兒子並沒有關涉！以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！大衛家啊，自己顧自己吧！於是，以色列眾人都回自己家裏去了。
verses.e: When all Israel saw that the king didn't listen to them , the people answered the king , saying , " What portion do we have in David ? We don't have an inheritance in the son of Jesse ! Every man to your tents , Israel ! Now see to your own house , David . " So all Israel departed to their tents .

verses.z: 惟獨住在猶大城邑的以色列人，羅波安仍作他們的王。
verses.e: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .

verses.z: 羅波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多蘭往以色列人那裏去，以色列人就用石頭打死他。羅波安王急忙上車，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram , who was over the men subject to forced labor ; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones . King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 這樣，以色列人背叛大衛家，直到今日。
verses.e: So Israel rebelled against David's house to this day .

verses.z: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安先前躲避所羅門王，逃往埃及，住在那裏；他聽見這事，就從埃及回來。
verses.e: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it ( for he was in Egypt , where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon ) , Jeroboam returned out of Egypt .

verses.z: 以色列人打發人去請他，他就和以色列眾人來見羅波安，對他說：
verses.e: They sent and called him ; and Jeroboam and all Israel came , and they spoke to Rehoboam , saying ,

verses.z: 「你父親使我們負重軛[做苦工]，現在求你使我們做的苦工負的重軛輕鬆些，我們就事奉你。」
verses.e: " Your father made our yoke grievous . Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us , lighter , and we will serve you . "

verses.z: 羅波安對他們說：「第三日再來見我吧！」民就去了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Come again to me after three days . " So the people departed .

verses.z: 羅波安之父所羅門在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，羅波安王和他們商議，說：「你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆這民。」
verses.e: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men , who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , " What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people ? "

verses.z: 老年人對他說：「王若恩待這民，使他們喜悅，用好話回覆他們，他們就永遠作王的僕人。」
verses.e: They spoke to him , saying , " If you are kind to these people , please them , and speak good words to them , then they will be your servants forever . "

verses.z: 王卻不用老年人給他出的主意，就和那些與他一同長大、在他面前侍立的少年人商議，
verses.e: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him , and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him , who stood before him .

verses.z: 說：「這民對我說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些』；你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆他們。」
verses.e: He said to them , " What counsel do you give , that we may give an answer to these people , who have spoken to me , saying , ' Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter ' ? "

verses.z: 羅波安來到耶路撒冷，招聚猶大家和便雅憫家，共十八萬人，都是挑選的戰士，要與以色列人爭戰，好將國奪回再歸自己。
verses.e: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem , he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin , one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors , to fight against Israel , to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam .

verses.z: 瑣拉、亞雅崙、希伯崙。這都是猶大和便雅憫的堅固城。
verses.e: Zorah , Aijalon , and Hebron , which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin .

verses.z: 羅波安又堅固各處的保障，在其中安置軍長，又預備下糧食、油、酒。
verses.e: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food , oil and wine .

verses.z: 他在各城裏[預備]盾牌和槍，且使城極其堅固。猶大和便雅憫都歸了他。
verses.e: He put shields and spears in every city , and made them exceedingly strong . Judah and Benjamin belonged to him .

verses.z: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都從四方來歸羅波安。
verses.e: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory .

verses.z: 利未人撇下他們的郊野和產業，來到猶大與耶路撒冷，是因耶羅波安和他的兒子拒絕他們，不許他們供祭司職分事奉耶和華。
verses.e: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions , and came to Judah and Jerusalem ; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off , that they should not execute the priest's office to the LORD .

verses.z: 耶羅波安為邱壇、為鬼魔、為自己所鑄造的牛犢設立祭司。
verses.e: He himself appointed priests for the high places , for the male goat and calf idols which he had made .

verses.z: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意尋求耶和華－以色列上帝的，都隨從利未人，來到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和華－他們列祖的上帝。
verses.e: After them , out of all the tribes of Israel , those who set their hearts to seek the LORD , the God of Israel , came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD , the God of their fathers .

verses.z: 這樣，就堅固猶大國，使所羅門的兒子羅波安強盛三年，因為他們三年遵行大衛和所羅門的道。
verses.e: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years , for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon .

verses.z: 羅波安娶大衛兒子耶利摩的女兒瑪哈拉為妻，又娶耶西兒子以利押的女兒亞比孩為妻。
verses.e: Rehoboam took a wife for himself , Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse .

verses.z: 從她生了幾個兒子，就是耶烏施、示瑪利雅、撒罕。
verses.e: She bore him sons : Jeush , Shemariah , and Zaham .

verses.z: 但耶和華的話臨到神人示瑪雅說：
verses.e: But the LORD's word came to Shemaiah the man of God , saying ,

verses.z: 後來又娶押沙龍的女兒瑪迦，從她生了亞比雅、亞太、細撒、示羅密。
verses.e: After her , he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom ; and she bore him Abijah , Attai , Ziza , and Shelomith .

verses.z: 羅波安娶十八個妻，立六十個妾，生二十八個兒子，六十個女兒；他卻愛押沙龍的女兒瑪迦，比愛別的妻妾更甚。
verses.e: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines ; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines , and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters .

verses.z: 羅波安立瑪迦的兒子亞比雅作太子，在他弟兄中為首，因為[想要]立他接續作王。
verses.e: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief , the prince among his brothers , for he intended to make him king .

verses.z: 羅波安辦事精明，使他眾子分散在猶大和便雅憫全地各堅固城裏，又賜他們許多糧食，[為他們]多尋妻子。
verses.e: He dealt wisely , and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin , to every fortified city . He gave them food in abundance ; and he sought many wives for them .

verses.z: 「你去告訴所羅門的兒子猶大王羅波安和住猶大、便雅憫的以色列眾人說，
verses.e: " Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon , king of Judah , and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin , saying ,

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：『你們不可上去與你們的弟兄爭戰，各歸各家去吧！因為這事出於我。』」眾人就聽從耶和華的話歸回，不去與耶羅波安爭戰。
verses.e: ' The LORD says , " You shall not go up , nor fight against your brothers ! Every man return to his house ; for this thing is of me . " ' " So they listened to the LORD's words , and returned from going against Jeroboam .

verses.z: 羅波安住在耶路撒冷，在猶大地修築城邑，
verses.e: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem , and built cities for defense in Judah .

verses.z: 為保障修築伯利恆、以坦、提哥亞、
verses.e: He built Bethlehem , Etam , Tekoa ,

verses.z: 伯‧夙、梭哥、亞杜蘭、
verses.e: Beth Zur , Soco , Adullam ,

verses.z: 迦特、瑪利沙、西弗、
verses.e: Gath , Mareshah , Ziph ,

verses.z: 亞多萊音、拉吉、亞西加、
verses.e: Adoraim , Lachish , Azekah ,

verses.z: 羅波安的國堅立，他強盛的時候就離棄耶和華的律法，以色列人也都隨從他。
verses.e: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong , he abandoned the LORD's law , and all Israel with him .

verses.z: 羅波安王製造銅盾牌代替那金盾牌，交給守王宮門的護衛長看守。
verses.e: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place , and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard , who kept the door of the king's house .

verses.z: 王每逢進耶和華的殿，護衛兵就拿這盾牌，隨後仍將盾牌送回，放在護衛房。
verses.e: As often as the king entered into the LORD's house , the guard came and bore them , then brought them back into the guard room .

verses.z: 王自卑的時候，耶和華的怒氣就轉消了，不將他滅盡，並且在猶大中間也有善益的事。
verses.e: When he humbled himself , the LORD's wrath turned from him , so as not to destroy him altogether . Moreover , there were good things found in Judah .

verses.z: 羅波安王自強，在耶路撒冷作王。他登基的時候年四十一歲，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和華從以色列眾支派中所選擇立他名的城，作王十七年。羅波安的母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。
verses.e: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned ; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there . His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess .

verses.z: 羅波安行惡，因他不立定心意尋求耶和華。
verses.e: He did that which was evil , because he didn't set his heart to seek the LORD .

verses.z: 羅波安所行的事，自始至終不都寫在先知示瑪雅和先見易多的史記上嗎？羅波安與耶羅波安時常爭戰。
verses.e: Now the acts of Rehoboam , first and last , aren't they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer , in the genealogies ? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually .

verses.z: 羅波安與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城裏。他兒子亞比雅接續他作王。
verses.e: Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried in David's city ; and Abijah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 羅波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上來攻打耶路撒冷，因為王和民得罪了耶和華。
verses.e: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam , Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , because they had trespassed against the LORD ,

verses.z: 示撒帶戰車一千二百輛，馬兵六萬，並且跟從他出埃及的路比人、蘇基人，和古實人，多得不可勝數。
verses.e: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen . The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt : the Lubim , the Sukkiim , and the Ethiopians .

verses.z: 他攻取了猶大的堅固城，就來到耶路撒冷。
verses.e: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah , and came to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 那時，猶大的首領因為示撒就聚集在耶路撒冷。有先知示瑪雅去見羅波安和眾首領，對他們說：「耶和華如此說：『你們離棄了我，所以我使你們落在示撒手裏。』」
verses.e: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah , who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak , and said to them , " The LORD says , ' You have forsaken me , therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak . ' "

verses.z: 於是王和以色列的眾首領都自卑說：「耶和華是公義的。」
verses.e: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves ; and they said , " The LORD is righteous . "

verses.z: 耶和華見他們自卑，耶和華的話就臨到示瑪雅說：「他們既自卑，我必不滅絕他們；必使他們略得拯救，我不藉着示撒的手將我的怒氣倒在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves , the LORD's word came to Shemaiah , saying , " They have humbled themselves . I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance , and my wrath won't be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .

verses.z: 然而他們必作示撒的僕人，好叫他們知道，服事我與服事外邦人有何分別。」
verses.e: Nevertheless they will be his servants , that they may know my service , and the service of the kingdoms of the countries . "

verses.z: 於是，埃及王示撒上來攻取耶路撒冷，奪了耶和華殿和王宮裏的寶物，盡都帶走，又奪去所羅門製造的金盾牌。
verses.e: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the LORD's house and the treasures of the king's house . He took it all away . He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made .

verses.z: 耶羅波安王十八年，亞比雅登基作猶大王，
verses.e: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam , Abijah began to reign over Judah .

verses.z: 至於我們，耶和華是我們的上帝，我們並沒有離棄他。我們有事奉耶和華的祭司，都是亞倫的後裔，並有利未人各盡其職，
verses.e: " But as for us , the LORD is our God , and we have not forsaken him . We have priests serving the LORD , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites in their work .

verses.z: 每日早晚向耶和華獻燔祭，燒美香，又在精[金]的桌子上擺陳設餅；又有金燈臺和燈盞，每晚點起，因為我們遵守耶和華－我們上帝的命；惟有你們離棄了他。
verses.e: They burn to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense . They also set the show bread in order on the pure table , and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps , to burn every evening ; for we keep the instruction of the LORD our God , but you have forsaken him .

verses.z: 率領我們的是上帝，我們這裏也有上帝的祭司拿號向你們吹出大聲。以色列人哪，不要與耶和華－你們列祖的上帝爭戰，因你們必不能亨通。」
verses.e: Behold , God is with us at our head , and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you . Children of Israel , don't fight against the LORD , the God of your fathers ; for you will not prosper . "

verses.z: 耶羅波安卻在猶大人的後頭設伏兵。這樣，以色列人在猶大人的前頭，伏兵在猶大人的後頭。
verses.e: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them ; so they were before Judah , and the ambush was behind them .

verses.z: 猶大人回頭觀看，見前後都有敵兵，就呼求耶和華，祭司也吹號。
verses.e: When Judah looked back , behold , the battle was before and behind them ; and they cried to the LORD , and the priests sounded with the trumpets .

verses.z: 於是猶大人吶喊；猶大人吶喊的時候，上帝就使耶羅波安和以色列眾人敗在亞比雅與猶大人面前。
verses.e: Then the men of Judah gave a shout . As the men of Judah shouted , God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah .

verses.z: 以色列人在猶大人面前逃跑，上帝將他們交在猶大人手裏。
verses.e: The children of Israel fled before Judah , and God delivered them into their hand .

verses.z: 亞比雅和他的軍兵大大殺戮以色列人，以色列人仆倒死亡的精兵有五十萬。
verses.e: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter , so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain .

verses.z: 那時，以色列人被制伏了，猶大人得勝，是因倚靠耶和華－他們列祖的上帝。
verses.e: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time , and the children of Judah prevailed , because they relied on the LORD , the God of their fathers .

verses.z: 亞比雅追趕耶羅波安，攻取了他的幾座城，就是伯特利和屬伯特利的鎮市，耶沙拿和屬耶沙拿的鎮市，以法拉音和屬以法拉音的鎮市。
verses.e: Abijah pursued Jeroboam , and took cities from him : Bethel with its villages , Jeshanah with its villages , and Ephron with its villages .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母親名叫米該亞，是基比亞人烏列的女兒。亞比雅常與耶羅波安爭戰。
verses.e: He reigned three years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah . There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam .

verses.z: 亞比雅在世的時候，耶羅波安不能再強盛；耶和華攻擊他，他就死了。
verses.e: Jeroboam didn't recover strength again in the days of Abijah . The LORD struck him , and he died .

verses.z: 亞比雅卻漸漸強盛，娶妻妾十四個，生了二十二個兒子，十六個女兒。
verses.e: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives , and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters .

verses.z: 亞比雅其餘的事和他的言行都寫在先知易多的傳上。
verses.e: The rest of the acts of Abijah , his ways , and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo .

verses.z: 有一次亞比雅率領挑選的兵四十萬擺陣，都是勇敢的戰士；耶羅波安也挑選大能的勇士八十萬，對亞比雅擺陣。
verses.e: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war , even four hundred thousand chosen men ; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men , who were mighty men of valor .

verses.z: 亞比雅站在以法蓮山地中的洗瑪臉山上，說：「耶羅波安和以色列眾人哪，要聽我說！
verses.e: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim , which is in the hill country of Ephraim , and said , " Hear me , Jeroboam and all Israel :

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝曾立鹽約，將以色列國永遠賜給大衛和他的子孫，你們不知道嗎？
verses.e: Ought you not to know that the LORD , the God of Israel , gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever , even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?

verses.z: 無奈大衛兒子所羅門的臣僕、尼八兒子耶羅波安起來背叛他的主人。
verses.e: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat , the servant of Solomon the son of David , rose up , and rebelled against his lord .

verses.z: 有些無賴的匪徒聚集跟從他，逞強攻擊所羅門的兒子羅波安；那時羅波安還幼弱，不能抵擋他們。
verses.e: Worthless men were gathered to him , wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon , when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted , and could not withstand them .

verses.z: 「現在你們有意抗拒大衛子孫手下所治耶和華的國，你們的人也甚多，你們那裏又有耶羅波安為你們所造當作神的金牛犢。
verses.e: " Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David . You are a great multitude , and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you .

verses.z: 你們不是驅逐耶和華的祭司亞倫的後裔和利未人嗎？不是照着外邦人的惡俗為自己立祭司嗎？無論何人牽一隻公牛犢、七隻公綿羊將自己分別出來，就可作虛無之神的祭司。
verses.e: Haven't you driven out the priests of the LORD , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites , and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands ? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods .

verses.z: 亞比雅與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城裏。他兒子亞撒接續他作王。亞撒年間，國中太平十年。
verses.e: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in David's city ; and Asa his son reigned in his place . In his days , the land was quiet ten years .

verses.z: 於是亞撒出去與他迎敵，就在瑪利沙的洗法谷彼此擺陣。
verses.e: Then Asa went out to meet him , and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .

verses.z: 亞撒呼求耶和華－他的上帝說：「耶和華啊，惟有你能幫助軟弱的，勝過強盛的。耶和華－我們的上帝啊，求你幫助我們；因為我們仰賴你，奉你的名來攻擊這大軍。耶和華啊，你是我們的上帝，不要容人勝過你。」
verses.e: Asa cried to the LORD his God , and said , " LORD , there is no one besides you to help , between the mighty and him who has no strength . Help us , LORD our God ; for we rely on you , and in your name are we come against this multitude . LORD , you are our God . Don't let man prevail against you . "

verses.z: 於是耶和華使古實人敗在亞撒和猶大人面前，古實人就逃跑了；
verses.e: So the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah ; and the Ethiopians fled .

verses.z: 亞撒和跟隨他的軍兵追趕他們，直到基拉耳。古實人被殺的甚多，不能再強盛，因為敗在耶和華與他軍兵面前。猶大人就奪了許多財物，
verses.e: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar . So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves , for they were destroyed before the LORD and before his army . Judah's army carried away very much booty .

verses.z: 又打破基拉耳四圍的城邑；耶和華使其中的人都甚恐懼。猶大人又將所有的城擄掠一空，因其中的財物甚多，
verses.e: They struck all the cities around Gerar , for the fear of the LORD came on them . They plundered all the cities , for there was much plunder in them .

verses.z: 又毀壞了群畜的圈，奪取許多的羊和駱駝，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock , and carried away sheep and camels in abundance , then returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 亞撒行耶和華－他上帝眼中看為善為正的事，
verses.e: Asa did that which was good and right in the LORD his God's eyes ,

verses.z: 除掉外邦神的壇和邱壇，打碎柱像，砍下木偶，
verses.e: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places , broke down the pillars , cut down the Asherah poles ,

verses.z: 吩咐猶大人尋求耶和華－他們列祖的上帝，遵行他的律法、誡命；
verses.e: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD , the God of their fathers , and to obey his law and command .

verses.z: 又在猶大各城邑除掉邱壇和日像，那時國享太平；
verses.e: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images ; and the kingdom was quiet before him .

verses.z: 又在猶大建造了幾座堅固城。國中太平數年，沒有戰爭，因為耶和華賜他平安。
verses.e: He built fortified cities in Judah ; for the land was quiet , and he had no war in those years , because the LORD had given him rest .

verses.z: 他對猶大人說：「我們要建造這些城邑，四圍築牆，蓋樓，安門，做閂；地還屬我們，是因尋求耶和華－我們的上帝；我們既尋求他，他就賜我們四境平安。」於是建造城邑，諸事亨通。
verses.e: For he said to Judah , " Let's build these cities and make walls around them , with towers , gates , and bars . The land is yet before us , because we have sought the LORD our God . We have sought him , and he has given us rest on every side . " So they built and prospered .

verses.z: 亞撒的軍兵，出自猶大拿盾牌拿槍的三十萬人；出自便雅憫拿盾牌拉弓的二十八萬人。這都是大能的勇士。
verses.e: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears , and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows . All these were mighty men of valor .

verses.z: 有古實王謝拉率領軍兵一百萬，戰車三百輛，出來攻擊猶大人，到了瑪利沙。
verses.e: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots , and he came to Mareshah .

verses.z: 上帝的靈感動俄德的兒子亞撒利雅。
verses.e: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded .

verses.z: 亞撒十五年三月，他們都聚集在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month , in the fifteenth year of Asa's reign .

verses.z: 當日他們從所取的擄物中，將牛七百隻、羊七千隻獻給耶和華。
verses.e: They sacrificed to the LORD in that day , of the plunder which they had brought , seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep .

verses.z: 他們就立約，要盡心盡性地尋求耶和華－他們列祖的上帝。
verses.e: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD , the God of their fathers , with all their heart and with all their soul ;

verses.z: 凡不尋求耶和華－以色列上帝的，無論大小、男女，必被治死。
verses.e: and that whoever would not seek the LORD , the God of Israel , should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .

verses.z: 他們就大聲歡呼，吹號吹角，向耶和華起誓。
verses.e: They swore to the LORD with a loud voice , with shouting , with trumpets , and with cornets .

verses.z: 猶大眾人為所起的誓歡喜；因他們是盡心起誓，盡意尋求耶和華，耶和華就被他們尋見，且賜他們四境平安。
verses.e: All Judah rejoiced at the oath , for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire ; and he was found by them . Then the LORD gave them rest all around .

verses.z: 亞撒王貶了他祖母瑪迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亞舍拉。亞撒砍下她的偶像，搗得粉碎，燒在汲淪溪邊。
verses.e: Also Maacah , the mother of Asa the king , he removed from being queen mother , because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah ; so Asa cut down her image , ground it into dust , and burned it at the brook Kidron .

verses.z: 只是邱壇還沒有從以色列中廢去，然而亞撒的心一生誠實。
verses.e: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel ; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days .

verses.z: 亞撒將他父所分別為聖、與自己所分別為聖的金銀和器皿都奉到上帝的殿裏。
verses.e: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated , silver , gold , and vessels into God's house .

verses.z: 從這時直到亞撒三十五年，都沒有爭戰的事。
verses.e: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa's reign .

verses.z: 他出來迎接亞撒，對他說：「亞撒和猶大、便雅憫眾人哪，要聽我說：你們若順從耶和華，耶和華必與你們同在；你們若尋求他，就必尋見；你們若離棄他，他必離棄你們。
verses.e: He went out to meet Asa , and said to him , " Hear me , Asa , and all Judah and Benjamin ! The LORD is with you while you are with him ; and if you seek him , he will be found by you ; but if you forsake him , he will forsake you .

verses.z: 以色列人不信真神，沒有訓誨的祭司，也沒有律法，已經好久了；
verses.e: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God , without a teaching priest , and without law .

verses.z: 但他們在急難的時候歸向耶和華－以色列的上帝，尋求他，他就被他們尋見。
verses.e: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD , the God of Israel , and sought him , he was found by them .

verses.z: 那時，出入的人不得平安，列國的居民都遭大亂；
verses.e: In those times there was no peace to him who went out , nor to him who came in ; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands .

verses.z: 這國攻擊那國，這城攻擊那城，互相破壞，因為上帝用各樣災難擾亂他們。
verses.e: They were broken in pieces , nation against nation , and city against city ; for God troubled them with all adversity .

verses.z: 現在你們要剛強，不要手軟，因你們所行的必得賞賜。」
verses.e: But you be strong ! Don't let your hands be slack , for your work will be rewarded . "

verses.z: 亞撒聽見這話和俄德[兒子]先知亞撒利雅的預言，就壯起膽來，在猶大、便雅憫全地，並以法蓮山地所奪的各城，將可憎之物盡都除掉，又在耶和華[殿]的廊前重新修築耶和華的壇；
verses.e: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet , he took courage , and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin , and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim ; and he renewed the LORD's altar that was before the LORD's porch .

verses.z: 又招聚猶大、便雅憫的眾人，並他們中間寄居的以法蓮人、瑪拿西人、西緬人。有許多以色列人歸降亞撒，因見耶和華－他的上帝與他同在。
verses.e: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and those who lived with them out of Ephraim , Manasseh , and Simeon ; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him .

verses.z: 亞撒三十六年，以色列王巴沙上來攻擊猶大，修築拉瑪，不許人從猶大王亞撒那裏出入。
verses.e: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa's reign , Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah , and built Ramah , that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .

verses.z: 亞撒因此惱恨先見，將他囚在監裏。那時亞撒也虐待一些人民。
verses.e: Then Asa was angry with the seer , and put him in the prison ; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing . Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time .

verses.z: 亞撒所行的事，自始至終都寫在猶大和以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Behold , the acts of Asa , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

verses.z: 亞撒作王三十九年，他腳上有病，而且甚重。病的時候沒有求耶和華，只求醫生。
verses.e: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign , Asa was diseased in his feet . His disease was exceedingly great ; yet in his disease he didn't seek the LORD , but just the physicians .

verses.z: 他作王四十一年而死，與他列祖同睡，
verses.e: Asa slept with his fathers , and died in the forty-first year of his reign .

verses.z: 葬在大衛城自己所鑿的墳墓裏，放在床上，其床堆滿各樣馨香的香料，就是按做香的作法調和的香料，又為他燒了許多的物件。
verses.e: They buried him in his own tomb , which he had dug out for himself in David's city , and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers ' art ; and they made a very great fire for him .

verses.z: 於是亞撒從耶和華殿和王宮的府庫裏拿出金銀來，送與住大馬士革的亞蘭王便‧哈達，說：
verses.e: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the LORD's house and of the king's house , and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria , who lived at Damascus , saying ,

verses.z: 「你父曾與我父立約，我與你也要立約。現在我將金銀送給你，求你廢掉你與以色列王巴沙所立的約，使他離開我。」
verses.e: " Let there be a treaty between me and you , as there was between my father and your father . Behold , I have sent you silver and gold . Go , break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me . "

verses.z: 便‧哈達聽從亞撒王的話，派軍長去攻擊以色列的城邑。他們就攻破以雲、但、亞伯‧瑪音，和拿弗他利一切的積貨城。
verses.e: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel ; and they struck Ijon , Dan , Abel Maim , and all the storage cities of Naphtali .

verses.z: 巴沙聽見就停工，不修築拉瑪了。
verses.e: When Baasha heard of it , he stopped building Ramah , and let his work cease .

verses.z: 於是亞撒王率領猶大眾人，將巴沙修築拉瑪所用的石頭、木頭都運去，用以修築迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.e: Then Asa the king took all Judah , and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah , with which Baasha had built ; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them .

verses.z: 那時，先見哈拿尼來見猶大王亞撒，對他說：「因你仰賴亞蘭王，沒有仰賴耶和華－你的上帝，所以亞蘭王的軍兵脫離了你的手。
verses.e: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah , and said to him , " Because you have relied on the king of Syria , and have not relied on the LORD your God , therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand .

verses.z: 古實人、路比人的軍隊不是甚大嗎？戰車馬兵不是極多嗎？只因你仰賴耶和華，他便將他們交在你手裏。
verses.e: Weren't the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army , with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen ? Yet , because you relied on the LORD , he delivered them into your hand .

verses.z: 耶和華的眼目遍察全地，要顯大能幫助向他心存誠實的人。你這事行得愚昧；此後，你必有爭戰的事。」
verses.e: For the LORD's eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth , to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him . You have done foolishly in this ; for from now on you will have wars . "

verses.z: 亞撒的兒子約沙法接續他作王，奮勇自強，防備以色列人，
verses.e: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place , and strengthened himself against Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華使猶大四圍的列國都甚恐懼，不敢與約沙法爭戰。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah , so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat .

verses.z: 有些非利士人與約沙法送禮物，納貢銀。阿拉伯人也送他公綿羊七千七百隻，公山羊七千七百隻。
verses.e: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute . The Arabians also brought him flocks : seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats .

verses.z: 約沙法日漸強大，在猶大建造營寨和積貨城。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly ; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah .

verses.z: 他在猶大城邑中有許多工程，又在耶路撒冷有戰士，就是大能的勇士。
verses.e: He had many works in the cities of Judah ; and men of war , mighty men of valor , in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他們的數目，按着宗族，記在下面：猶大族的千夫長押拿為首率領大能的勇士－三十萬；
verses.e: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers ' houses : From Judah , the captains of thousands : Adnah the captain , and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor ;

verses.z: 其次是，千夫長約哈難率領[大能的勇士]－二十八萬；
verses.e: and next to him Jehohanan the captain , and with him two hundred eighty thousand ;

verses.z: 其次是，細基利的兒子亞瑪斯雅（他為耶和華犧牲自己）率領大能的勇士－二十萬。
verses.e: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri , who willingly offered himself to the LORD , and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor .

verses.z: 便雅憫族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率領拿弓箭和盾牌的－二十萬；
verses.e: From Benjamin : Eliada , a mighty man of valor , and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield ;

verses.z: 其次是，約薩拔率領預備打仗的－十八萬。
verses.e: and next to him Jehozabad , and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war .

verses.z: 這都是伺候王的，還有王在猶大全地堅固城所安置的不在其內。
verses.e: These were those who waited on the king , in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah .

verses.z: 安置軍兵在猶大一切堅固城裏，又安置防兵在猶大地和他父亞撒所得以法蓮的城邑中。
verses.e: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah , and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim , which Asa his father had taken .

verses.z: 耶和華與約沙法同在；因為他行他祖大衛初行的道，不尋求巴力，
verses.e: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and didn't seek the Baals ,

verses.z: 只尋求他父親的上帝，遵行他的誡命，不效法以色列人的行為。
verses.e: but sought the God of his father , and walked in his commandments , and not in the ways of Israel .

verses.z: 所以耶和華堅定他的國，猶大眾人給他進貢；約沙法大有尊榮資財。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand . All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat , and he had riches and honor in abundance .

verses.z: 他高興遵行耶和華的道，並且從猶大除掉一切邱壇和木偶。
verses.e: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD . Furthermore , he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah .

verses.z: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便‧亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦業、米該亞往猶大各城去教訓百姓。
verses.e: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes , even Ben Hail , Obadiah , Zechariah , Nethanel , and Micaiah , to teach in the cities of Judah ;

verses.z: 同着他們有利未人示瑪雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亞撒黑、示米拉末、約拿單、亞多尼雅、多比雅、駝‧巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙瑪、約蘭同着他們。
verses.e: and with them Levites , even Shemaiah , Nethaniah , Zebadiah , Asahel , Shemiramoth , Jehonathan , Adonijah , Tobijah , and Tobadonijah , the Levites ; and with them Elishama and Jehoram , the priests .

verses.z: 他們帶着耶和華的律法書，走遍猶大各城教訓百姓。
verses.e: They taught in Judah , having the book of the LORD's law with them . They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people .

verses.z: 約沙法大有尊榮資財，就與亞哈結親。
verses.e: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance ; and he allied himself with Ahab .

verses.z: 基拿拿的兒子西底家造了兩個鐵角，說：「耶和華如此說：『你要用這角牴觸亞蘭人，直到將他們滅盡。』」
verses.e: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said , " The LORD says , ' With these you shall push the Syrians , until they are consumed . ' "

verses.z: 所有的先知也都這樣預言說：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得勝，因為耶和華必將那城交在王的手中。」
verses.e: All the prophets prophesied so , saying , " Go up to Ramoth Gilead , and prosper ; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king . "

verses.z: 那去召米該雅的使者對米該雅說：「眾先知一口同音地都向王說吉言，你不如與他們說一樣的話，也說吉言。」
verses.e: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him , saying , " Behold , the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth . Let your word therefore , please be like one of theirs , and speak good . "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，我的上帝說甚麼，我就說甚麼。」
verses.e: Micaiah said , " As the LORD lives , I will say what my God says . "

verses.z: 米該雅到王面前，王問他說：「米該雅啊，我們上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他說：「可以上去，必然得勝，敵人必交在你們手裏。」
verses.e: When he had come to the king , the king said to him , " Micaiah , shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? " He said , " Go up , and prosper . They shall be delivered into your hand . "

verses.z: 王對他說：「我當囑咐你幾次，你才奉耶和華的名向我說實話呢？」
verses.e: The king said to him , " How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD's name ? "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「我看見以色列眾民散在山上，如同沒有牧人的羊群一般。耶和華說：『這民沒有主人，他們可以平平安安地各歸各家去。』」
verses.e: He said , " I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd . The LORD said , ' These have no master . Let them each return to his house in peace . ' "

verses.z: 以色列王對約沙法說：「我豈沒有告訴你，這人指着我所說的預言，不說吉語，單說凶言嗎？」
verses.e: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , " Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me , but evil ? "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「你們要聽耶和華的話。我看見耶和華坐在寶座上，天上的萬軍侍立在他左右。
verses.e: Micaiah said , " Therefore hear the LORD's word : I saw the LORD sitting on his throne , and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left .

verses.z: 耶和華說：『誰去引誘以色列王亞哈上基列的拉末去陣亡呢？』這個就這樣說，那個就那樣說。
verses.e: The LORD said , ' Who will entice Ahab king of Israel , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead ? ' One spoke saying in this way , and another saying in that way .

verses.z: 過了幾年，他下到撒馬利亞去見亞哈；亞哈為他和跟從他的人宰了許多牛羊，勸他與自己同去攻取基列的拉末。
verses.e: After some years , he went down to Ahab to Samaria . Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance , and for the people who were with him , and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead .

verses.z: 隨後，有一個神靈出來，站在耶和華面前說：『我去引誘他。』耶和華問他說：『你用何法呢？』
verses.e: A spirit came out , stood before the LORD , and said , ' I will entice him . ' " The LORD said to him , ' How ? '

verses.z: 他說：『我去，要在他眾先知口中作謊言的靈。』耶和華說：『這樣，你必能引誘他，你去如此行吧！』
verses.e: " He said , ' I will go , and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . ' " He said , ' You will entice him , and will prevail also . Go and do so . '

verses.z: 現在耶和華使謊言的靈入了你這些先知的口，並且耶和華已經命定降禍與你。」
verses.e: " Now therefore , behold , the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets ; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you . "

verses.z: 基拿拿的兒子西底家前來打米該雅的臉，說：「耶和華的靈從哪裏離開我與你說話呢？」
verses.e: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near , and struck Micaiah on the cheek , and said , " Which way did the LORD's Spirit go from me to speak to you ? "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「你進嚴密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看見了。」
verses.e: Micaiah said , " Behold , you shall see on that day , when you go into an inner room to hide yourself . "

verses.z: 以色列王說：「將米該雅帶回，交給邑宰亞們和王的兒子約阿施，說：
verses.e: The king of Israel said , " Take Micaiah , and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king's son ;

verses.z: 『王如此說：把這個人下在監裏，使他受苦，吃不飽喝不足，等候我平平安安地回來。』」
verses.e: and say , ' The king says , " Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I return in peace . " ' "

verses.z: 米該雅說：「你若能平安回來，那就是耶和華沒有藉我說這話了」；又說：「眾民哪，你們都要聽！」
verses.e: Micaiah said , " If you return at all in peace , the LORD has not spoken by me . " He said , " Listen , you people , all of you ! "

verses.z: 以色列王和猶大王約沙法上基列的拉末去了。
verses.e: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead .

verses.z: 以色列王對約沙法說：「我要改裝上陣，你可以仍穿王服。」於是以色列王改裝，他們就上陣去了。
verses.e: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , " I will disguise myself , and go into the battle ; but you put on your robes . " So the king of Israel disguised himself ; and they went into the battle .

verses.z: 以色列王亞哈問猶大王約沙法說：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末嗎？」他回答說：「你我不分彼此，我的民與你的民一樣，必與你同去爭戰。」
verses.e: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah , " Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead ? " He answered him , " I am as you are , and my people as your people . We will be with you in the war . "

verses.z: 先是亞蘭王吩咐車兵長說：「他們的[兵將]，無論大小，你們都不可與他們爭戰，只要與以色列王爭戰。」
verses.e: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots , saying , " Don't fight with small nor great , except only with the king of Israel . "

verses.z: 車兵長看見約沙法便說，這必是以色列王，就轉過去與他爭戰。約沙法一呼喊，耶和華就幫助他，上帝又感動他們離開他。
verses.e: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat , they said , " It is the king of Israel ! " Therefore they turned around to fight against him . But Jehoshaphat cried out , and the LORD helped him ; and God moved them to depart from him .

verses.z: 車兵長見不是以色列王，就轉去不追他了。
verses.e: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel , they turned back from pursuing him .

verses.z: 有一人隨便開弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲縫裏。王對趕車的說：「我受了重傷，你轉過車來，拉我出陣吧！」
verses.e: A certain man drew his bow at random , and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor . Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot , " Turn around and carry me out of the battle , for I am severely wounded . "

verses.z: 那日陣勢越戰越猛，以色列王勉強站在車上抵擋亞蘭人，直到晚上。約在日落的時候，王就死了。
verses.e: The battle increased that day . However , the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening ; and at about sunset , he died .

verses.z: 約沙法對以色列王說：「請你先求問耶和華。」
verses.e: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , " Please inquire first for the LORD's word . "

verses.z: 於是以色列王招聚先知四百人，問他們說：「我們上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他們說：「可以上去，因為上帝必將那城交在王的手裏。」
verses.e: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , four hundred men , and said to them , " Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? " They said , " Go up , for God will deliver it into the hand of the king . "

verses.z: 約沙法說：「這裏不是還有耶和華的先知，我們可以求問他嗎？」
verses.e: But Jehoshaphat said , " Isn't there here a prophet of the LORD besides , that we may inquire of him ? "

verses.z: 以色列王對約沙法說：「還有一個人，是音拉的兒子米該雅。我們可以託他求問耶和華，只是我恨他；因為他指着我所說的預言，不說吉語，常說凶言。」約沙法說：「王不必這樣說。」
verses.e: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , " There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD ; but I hate him , for he never prophesies good concerning me , but always evil . He is Micaiah the son of Imla . " Jehoshaphat said , " Don't let the king say so . "

verses.z: 以色列王就召了一個太監來，說：「你快去將音拉的兒子米該雅召來。」
verses.e: Then the king of Israel called an officer , and said , " Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly . "

verses.z: 以色列王和猶大王約沙法在撒馬利亞城門前的空場上，各穿朝服坐在位上，所有的先知都在他們面前說預言。
verses.e: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne , arrayed in their robes , and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria ; and all the prophets were prophesying before them .

verses.z: 猶大王約沙法平平安安地回耶路撒冷，到宮裏去了。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 住在各城裏你們的弟兄，若有爭訟的事來到你們這裏，或為流血，或犯律法、誡命、律例、典章，你們要警戒他們，免得他們得罪耶和華，以致他的忿怒臨到你們和你們的弟兄；這樣行，你們就沒有罪了。
verses.e: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and ordinances , you must warn them , that they not be guilty toward the LORD , and so wrath come on you and on your brothers . Do this , and you will not be guilty .

verses.z: 凡屬耶和華的事，有大祭司亞瑪利雅管理你們；凡屬王的事，有猶大支派的族長以實瑪利的兒子西巴第雅管理你們；在你們面前有利未人作官長。你們應當壯膽辦事，願耶和華與善人同在。」
verses.e: Behold , Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , in all the king's matters . Also the Levites shall be officers before you . Deal courageously , and may the LORD be with the good . "

verses.z: 先見哈拿尼的兒子耶戶出來迎接約沙法王，對他說：「你豈當幫助惡人，愛那恨惡耶和華的人呢？因此耶和華的忿怒臨到你。
verses.e: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to King Jehoshaphat , " Should you help the wicked , and love those who hate the LORD ? Because of this , wrath is on you from before the LORD .

verses.z: 然而你還有善行，因你從國中除掉木偶，立定心意尋求上帝。」
verses.e: Nevertheless there are good things found in you , in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land , and have set your heart to seek God . "

verses.z: 約沙法住在耶路撒冷，以後又出巡民間，從別是巴直到以法蓮山地，引導民歸向耶和華－他們列祖的上帝；
verses.e: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem ; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim , and brought them back to the LORD , the God of their fathers .

verses.z: 又在猶大國中遍地的堅固城裏設立審判官，
verses.e: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah , city by city ,

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們辦事應當謹慎；因為你們判斷不是為人，乃是為耶和華。判斷的時候，他必與你們同在。
verses.e: and said to the judges , " Consider what you do , for you don't judge for man , but for the LORD ; and he is with you in the judgment .

verses.z: 現在你們應當敬畏耶和華，謹慎辦事；因為耶和華－我們的上帝沒有不義，不偏待人，也不受賄賂。」
verses.e: Now therefore let the fear of the LORD be on you . Take heed and do it ; for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of bribes . "

verses.z: 約沙法從利未人和祭司，並以色列族長中派定人，在耶路撒冷為耶和華判斷，聽[民間的]爭訟，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites , priests , and heads of the fathers ' households of Israel to give judgment for the LORD and for controversies . They returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 約沙法囑咐他們說：「你們當敬畏耶和華，忠心誠實辦事。
verses.e: He commanded them , saying , " You shall do this in the fear of the LORD , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .

verses.z: 所羅門定意要為耶和華的名建造殿宇，又為自己的國建造宮室。
verses.e: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the LORD's name , and a house for his kingdom .

verses.z: 你的僕人砍伐樹木，我必給他們打好了的小麥二萬歌珥，大麥二萬歌珥，酒二萬罷特，油二萬罷特。」
verses.e: Behold , I will give to your servants , the cutters who cut timber , twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat , twenty thousand baths of barley , twenty thousand baths of wine , and twenty thousand baths of oil . "

verses.z: 泰爾王希蘭寫信回答所羅門說：「耶和華因為愛他的子民，所以立你作他們的王」；
verses.e: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , " Because the LORD loves his people , he has made you king over them . "

verses.z: 又說：「創造天地的耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的！他賜給大衛王一個有智慧的兒子，使他有謀略聰明，可以為耶和華建造殿宇，又為自己的國建造宮室。
verses.e: Huram continued , " Blessed be the LORD , the God of Israel , who made heaven and earth , who has given to David the king a wise son , endowed with discretion and understanding , who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom .

verses.z: 「現在我打發一個精巧有聰明的人去，他是我父親希蘭所用的，
verses.e: Now I have sent a skillful man , endowed with understanding , Huram-abi ,

verses.z: 是但[支派]一個婦人的兒子。他父親是泰爾人，他善用金、銀、銅、鐵、石、木，和紫色、藍色、朱紅色[線]與細麻製造各物，並精於雕刻，又能想出各樣的巧工。請你派定這人，與你的巧匠和你父－我主大衛的巧匠一同做工。
verses.e: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan ; and his father was a man of Tyre . He is skillful to work in gold , in silver , in bronze , in iron , in stone , in timber , in purple , in blue , in fine linen , and in crimson , also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device , that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men , and with the skillful men of my lord David your father .

verses.z: 我主所說的小麥、大麥、酒、油，願我主運來給眾僕人。
verses.e: " Now therefore , the wheat , the barley , the oil , and the wine which my lord has spoken of , let him send to his servants ;

verses.z: 我們必照你所需用的，從黎巴嫩砍伐樹木，紮成筏子，浮海運到約帕；你可以從那裏運到耶路撒冷。」
verses.e: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon , as much as you need . We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa ; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 所羅門仿照他父大衛數點住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五萬三千六百名；
verses.e: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel , after the census with which David his father had counted them ; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 使七萬人扛抬材料，八萬人在山上鑿石頭，三千六百人督理工作。
verses.e: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens , eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains , and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work .

verses.z: 所羅門就挑選七萬扛抬的，八萬在山上鑿石頭的，三千六百督工的。
verses.e: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens , eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains , and three thousand six hundred to oversee them .

verses.z: 所羅門差人去見泰爾王希蘭，說：「你曾運香柏木與我父大衛建宮居住，[求你也這樣待我]。
verses.e: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre , saying , " As you dealt with David my father , and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell , so deal with me .

verses.z: 我要為耶和華－我上帝的名建造殿宇，分別為聖獻給他，在他面前焚燒美香，常擺陳設餅，每早晚、安息日、月朔，並耶和華－我們上帝所定的節期獻燔祭。這是以色列人永遠的[定例]。
verses.e: Behold , I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God , to dedicate it to him , to burn before him incense of sweet spices , for the continual show bread , and for the burnt offerings morning and evening , on the Sabbaths , on the new moons , and on the set feasts of the LORD our God . This is an ordinance forever to Israel .

verses.z: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大；因為我們的上帝至大，超乎諸神。
verses.e: " The house which I am building will be great , for our God is greater than all gods .

verses.z: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，誰能為他建造殿宇呢？我是誰？能為他建造殿宇嗎？不過在他面前燒香而已。
verses.e: But who is able to build him a house , since heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain him ? Who am I then , that I should build him a house , except just to burn incense before him ?

verses.z: 現在求你差一個巧匠來，就是善用金、銀、銅、鐵，和紫色、朱紅色、藍色[線]，並精於雕刻之工的巧匠，與我父大衛在猶大和耶路撒冷所預備的巧匠一同做工；
verses.e: " Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold , in silver , in bronze , in iron , and in purple , crimson , and blue , and who knows how to engrave engravings , to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem , whom David my father provided .

verses.z: 又求你從黎巴嫩運些香柏木、松木、檀香木到我這裏來，因我知道你的僕人善於砍伐黎巴嫩的樹木。我的僕人也必與你的僕人同工。
verses.e: " Send me also cedar trees , cypress trees , and algum trees out of Lebanon , for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon . Behold , my servants will be with your servants ,

verses.z: 這樣，可以給我預備許多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。
verses.e: even to prepare me timber in abundance ; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful .

verses.z: 此後，摩押人和亞捫人，又有米烏尼人，一同來攻擊約沙法。
verses.e: After this , the children of Moab , the children of Ammon , and with them some of the Ammonites , came against Jehoshaphat to battle .

verses.z: 從前以色列人出埃及地的時候，你不容以色列人侵犯亞捫人、摩押人，和西珥山人，以色列人就離開他們，不滅絕他們。
verses.e: Now , behold , the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir , whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt , but they turned away from them , and didn't destroy them ;

verses.z: 看哪，他們怎樣報復我們，要來驅逐我們出離你的地，就是你賜給我們為業之地。
verses.e: behold , how they reward us , to come to cast us out of your possession , which you have given us to inherit .

verses.z: 我們的上帝啊，你不懲罰他們嗎？因為我們無力抵擋這來攻擊我們的大軍，我們也不知道怎樣行，我們的眼目單仰望你。」
verses.e: Our God , will you not judge them ? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us . We don't know what to do , but our eyes are on you . "

verses.z: 猶大眾人和他們的嬰孩、妻子、兒女都站在耶和華面前。
verses.e: All Judah stood before the LORD , with their little ones , their wives , and their children .

verses.z: 那時，耶和華的靈在會中臨到利未人亞薩的後裔－瑪探雅的玄孫，耶利的曾孫，比拿雅的孫子，撒迦利雅的兒子雅哈悉。
verses.e: Then the LORD's Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah , the son of Benaiah , the son of Jeiel , the son of Mattaniah , the Levite , of the sons of Asaph , in the middle of the assembly ;

verses.z: 他說：「猶大眾人、耶路撒冷的居民，和約沙法王，你們請聽。耶和華對你們如此說：『不要因這大軍恐懼驚惶；因為勝敗不在乎你們，乃在乎上帝。
verses.e: and he said , " Listen , all Judah , and you inhabitants of Jerusalem , and you , King Jehoshaphat . The LORD says to you , ' Don't be afraid , and don't be dismayed because of this great multitude ; for the battle is not yours , but God's .

verses.z: 明日你們要下去迎敵，他們是從洗斯坡上來，你們必在耶魯伊勒曠野前的谷口遇見他們。
verses.e: Tomorrow , go down against them . Behold , they are coming up by the ascent of Ziz . You will find them at the end of the valley , before the wilderness of Jeruel .

verses.z: 猶大和耶路撒冷人哪，這次你們不要爭戰，要擺陣站着，看耶和華為你們施行拯救。不要恐懼，也不要驚惶。明日當出去迎敵，因為耶和華與你們同在。』」
verses.e: You will not need to fight this battle . Set yourselves , stand still , and see the salvation of the LORD with you , O Judah and Jerusalem . Don't be afraid , nor be dismayed . Go out against them tomorrow , for the LORD is with you . ' "

verses.z: 約沙法就面伏於地，猶大眾人和耶路撒冷的居民也俯伏在耶和華面前，叩拜耶和華。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground ; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the LORD , worshiping the LORD .

verses.z: 哥轄族和可拉族的利未人都起來，用極大的聲音讚美耶和華以色列的上帝。
verses.e: The Levites , of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites , stood up to praise the LORD , the God of Israel , with an exceedingly loud voice .

verses.z: 有人來報告約沙法說：「從海外亞蘭那邊有大軍來攻擊你，如今他們在哈洗遜‧他瑪，就是隱‧基底。」
verses.e: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat , saying , " A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria . Behold , they are in Hazazon Tamar " ( that is , En Gedi ) .

verses.z: 次日清早，眾人起來往提哥亞的曠野去。出去的時候，約沙法站着說：「猶大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪，要聽我說：信耶和華－你們的上帝就必立穩；信他的先知就必亨通。」
verses.e: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa . As they went out , Jehoshaphat stood and said , " Listen to me , Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem ! Believe in the LORD your God , so you will be established ! Believe his prophets , so you will prosper . "

verses.z: 約沙法既與民商議了，就設立歌唱的人，頌讚耶和華，使他們穿上聖潔的禮服，走在軍前讚美耶和華說：「當稱謝耶和華，因他的慈愛永遠長存！」
verses.e: When he had taken counsel with the people , he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army , and say , " Give thanks to the LORD , for his loving kindness endures forever . "

verses.z: 眾人方唱歌讚美的時候，耶和華就派伏兵擊殺那來攻擊猶大人的亞捫人、摩押人，和西珥山人，他們就被打敗了。
verses.e: When they began to sing and to praise , the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon , Moab , and Mount Seir , who had come against Judah ; and they were struck .

verses.z: 因為亞捫人和摩押人起來，擊殺住西珥山的人，將他們滅盡；滅盡住西珥山的人之後，他們又彼此自相擊殺。
verses.e: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them . When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir , everyone helped to destroy each other .

verses.z: 猶大人來到曠野的望樓，向那大軍觀看，見屍橫遍地，沒有一個逃脫的。
verses.e: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness , they looked at the multitude ; and behold , they were dead bodies fallen to the earth , and there were none who escaped .

verses.z: 約沙法和他的百姓就來收取敵人的財物，在屍首中見了許多財物、珍寶，他們剝脫下來的多得不可攜帶；因為甚多，直收取了三日。
verses.e: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder , they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels , which they stripped off for themselves , more than they could carry away . They took plunder for three days , it was so much .

verses.z: 第四日眾人聚集在比拉迦谷，在那裏稱頌耶和華。因此那地方名叫比拉迦谷，直到今日。
verses.e: On the fourth day , they assembled themselves in Beracah Valley , for there they blessed the LORD . Therefore the name of that place was called " Beracah Valley " to this day .

verses.z: 猶大人和耶路撒冷人都歡歡喜喜地回耶路撒冷，約沙法率領他們；因為耶和華使他們戰勝仇敵，就歡喜快樂。
verses.e: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , with Jehoshaphat in front of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy ; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies .

verses.z: 他們彈琴、鼓瑟、吹號來到耶路撒冷，進了耶和華的殿。
verses.e: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments , harps , and trumpets to the LORD's house .

verses.z: 列邦諸國聽見耶和華戰敗以色列的仇敵，就甚懼怕。
verses.e: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel .

verses.z: 約沙法便懼怕，定意尋求耶和華，在猶大全地宣告禁食。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat was alarmed , and set himself to seek the LORD . He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah .

verses.z: 這樣，約沙法的國得享太平，因為上帝賜他四境平安。
verses.e: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet , for his God gave him rest all around .

verses.z: 約沙法作猶大王，登基的時候年三十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母親名叫阿蘇巴，乃示利希的女兒。
verses.e: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah . He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign . He reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .

verses.z: 約沙法效法他父亞撒所行的，不偏左右，行耶和華眼中看為正的事。
verses.e: He walked in the way of Asa his father , and didn't turn away from it , doing that which was right in the LORD's eyes .

verses.z: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去，百姓也沒有立定心意歸向他們列祖的上帝。
verses.e: However the high places were not taken away , and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers .

verses.z: 約沙法其餘的事，自始至終都寫在哈拿尼的兒子耶戶的書上，也載入以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , first and last , behold , they are written in the history of Jehu the son of Hanani , which is included in the book of the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 此後，猶大王約沙法與以色列王亞哈謝交好；亞哈謝行惡太甚。
verses.e: After this , Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel . The same did very wickedly .

verses.z: 二王合夥造船要往他施去，遂在以旬‧迦別造船。
verses.e: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish . They made the ships in Ezion Geber .

verses.z: 那時瑪利沙人、多大瓦的兒子以利以謝向約沙法預言說：「因你與亞哈謝交好，耶和華必破壞你所造的。」後來那船果然破壞，不能往他施去了。
verses.e: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat , saying , " Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah , the LORD has destroyed your works . " The ships were wrecked , so that they were not able to go to Tarshish .

verses.z: 於是猶大人聚會，求耶和華[幫助]。猶大各城都有人出來尋求耶和華。
verses.e: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from the LORD . They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek the LORD .

verses.z: 約沙法就在猶大和耶路撒冷的會中，站在耶和華殿的新院前，
verses.e: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem , in the LORD's house , before the new court ;

verses.z: 說：「耶和華－我們列祖的上帝啊，你不是天上的上帝嗎？你不是萬邦萬國的主宰嗎？在你手中有大能大力，無人能抵擋你。
verses.e: and he said , " LORD , the God of our fathers , aren't you God in heaven ? Aren't you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations ? Power and might are in your hand , so that no one is able to withstand you .

verses.z: 我們的上帝啊，你不是曾在你民以色列人面前驅逐這地的居民，將這地賜給你朋友亞伯拉罕的後裔永遠為業嗎？
verses.e: Didn't you , our God , drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel , and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever ?

verses.z: 他們住在這地，又為你的名建造聖所，說：
verses.e: They lived in it , and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name , saying ,

verses.z: 『倘有禍患臨到我們，或刀兵災殃，或瘟疫饑荒，我們在急難的時候，站在這殿前向你呼求，你必垂聽而拯救，因為你的名在這殿裏。』
verses.e: ' If evil comes on us — the sword , judgment , pestilence , or famine — we will stand before this house , and before you ( for your name is in this house ) , and cry to you in our affliction , and you will hear and save . '

verses.z: 約沙法與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子約蘭接續他作王。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in David's city ; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 這樣，以東人背叛猶大，脫離他的權下，直到今日。那時，立拿人也背叛了，因為約蘭離棄耶和華－他列祖的上帝。
verses.e: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day . Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand , because he had forsaken the LORD , the God of his fathers .

verses.z: 他又在猶大諸山建築邱壇，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，誘惑猶大人。
verses.e: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah , and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute , and led Judah astray .

verses.z: 先知以利亞達信與約蘭說：「耶和華－你祖大衛的上帝如此說：『因為你不行你父約沙法和猶大王亞撒的道，
verses.e: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , " the LORD , the God of David your father , says , ' Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,

verses.z: 乃行以色列諸王的道，使猶大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，像亞哈家一樣，又殺了你父家比你好的諸兄弟。
verses.e: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab's house did , and also have slain your brothers of your father's house , who were better than yourself ,

verses.z: 故此，耶和華降大災與你的百姓和你的妻子、兒女，並你一切所有的。
verses.e: behold , the LORD will strike your people with a great plague , including your children , your wives , and all your possessions ;

verses.z: 你的腸子必患病，日加沉重，以致你的腸子墜落下來。』」
verses.e: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels , until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness , day by day . ' "

verses.z: 以後，耶和華激動非利士人和靠近古實的阿拉伯人來攻擊約蘭。
verses.e: The LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians ;

verses.z: 他們上來攻擊猶大，侵入境內，擄掠了王宮裏所有的財貨和他的妻子、兒女，除了他小兒子約哈斯之外，沒有留下一個兒子。
verses.e: and they came up against Judah , broke into it , and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king's house , including his sons and his wives , so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz , the youngest of his sons .

verses.z: 這些事以後，耶和華使約蘭的腸子患不能醫治的病。
