verses.e: because your heart was tender , and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants , and have humbled yourself before me , and have torn your clothes and wept before me , I also have heard you , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我必使你平平安安地歸到墳墓，到你列祖那裏，我要降與這地和其上居民的一切災禍，你也不致親眼看見。』」他們就回覆王去了。
verses.e: " Behold , I will gather you to your fathers , and you will be gathered to your grave in peace . Your eyes won't see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants . " ' " They brought back this message to the king .

verses.z: 王差遣人招聚猶大和耶路撒冷的眾長老來。
verses.e: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他作王第八年，尚且年幼，就尋求他祖大衛的上帝。到了十二年才潔淨猶大和耶路撒冷，除掉邱壇、木偶、雕刻的像，和鑄造的像。
verses.e: For in the eighth year of his reign , while he was yet young , he began to seek after the God of David his father ; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places , the Asherah poles , the engraved images , and the molten images .

verses.z: 王和猶大眾人，與耶路撒冷的居民，並祭司利未人，以及所有的百姓，無論大小，都一同上到耶和華的殿；王就把殿裏所得的約書念給他們聽。
verses.e: The king went up to the LORD's house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem — the priests , the Levites , and all the people , both great and small — and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 王站在他的地位上，在耶和華面前立約，要盡心盡性地順從耶和華，遵守他的誡命、法度、律例，成就這書上所記的約言；
verses.e: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before the LORD , to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments , his testimonies , and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul , to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book .

verses.z: 又使住耶路撒冷和便雅憫的人都服從[這約]。於是耶路撒冷的居民都遵行他們列祖之上帝的約。
verses.e: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand . The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God , the God of their fathers .

verses.z: 約西亞從以色列各處將一切可憎之物盡都除掉，使以色列境內的人都事奉耶和華－他們的上帝。約西亞在世的日子，就跟從耶和華－他們列祖的上帝，總不離開。
verses.e: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel , and made all who were found in Israel to serve , even to serve the LORD their God . All his days they didn't depart from following the LORD , the God of their fathers .

verses.z: 眾人在他面前拆毀巴力的壇，砍斷壇上高高的日像，又把木偶和雕刻的像，並鑄造的像打碎成灰，撒在祭偶像人的墳上，
verses.e: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence ; and he cut down the incense altars that were on high above them . He broke the Asherah poles , the engraved images , and the molten images in pieces , made dust of them , and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them .

verses.z: 將他們祭司的骸骨燒在壇上，潔淨了猶大和耶路撒冷；
verses.e: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars , and purged Judah and Jerusalem .

verses.z: 又在瑪拿西、以法蓮、西緬、拿弗他利各城，和四圍破壞之處，[都這樣行]；
verses.e: He did this in the cities of Manasseh , Ephraim , and Simeon , even to Naphtali , around in their ruins .

verses.z: 又拆毀祭壇，把木偶和雕刻的像打碎成灰，砍斷以色列遍地所有的日像，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: He broke down the altars , beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder , and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel , then returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 約西亞王十八年，淨地淨殿之後，就差遣亞薩利雅的兒子沙番、邑宰瑪西雅、約哈斯的兒子史官約亞去修理耶和華－他上帝的殿。
verses.e: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land and the house , he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of the LORD his God .

verses.z: 他們就去見大祭司希勒家，將奉到上帝殿的銀子交給他；這銀子是看守殿門的利未人從瑪拿西、以法蓮，和一切以色列剩下的人，以及猶大、便雅憫眾人，並耶路撒冷的居民收來的。
verses.e: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God's house , which the Levites , the keepers of the threshold , had gathered from the hands of Manasseh , Ephraim , of all the remnant of Israel , of all Judah and Benjamin , and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 約西亞在耶路撒冷向耶和華守逾越節。正月十四日，就宰了逾越節[的羊羔]。
verses.e: Josiah kept a Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem . They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month .

verses.z: 這樣，供獻的事齊備了。祭司站在自己的地方，利未人按着班次站立，都是照王所吩咐的。
verses.e: So the service was prepared , and the priests stood in their place , and the Levites by their divisions , according to the king's commandment .

verses.z: 利未人宰了逾越節[的羊羔]，祭司從他們手裏[接過血來]灑在壇上；利未人剝皮，
verses.e: They killed the Passover lambs , and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands , and the Levites skinned them .

verses.z: 將燔祭搬來，按着宗族的班次分給眾民，好照摩西書上所寫的，獻給耶和華；獻牛也是這樣。
verses.e: They removed the burnt offerings , that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers ' houses of the children of the people , to offer to the LORD , as it is written in the book of Moses . They did the same with the cattle .

verses.z: 他們按着常例，用火烤逾越節的[羊羔]。別的聖物用鍋，用釜，用罐煮了，速速地送給眾民。
verses.e: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance . They boiled the holy offerings in pots , in cauldrons , and in pans , and carried them quickly to all the children of the people .

verses.z: 然後為自己和祭司預備[祭物]；因為祭司亞倫的子孫獻燔祭和脂油，直到晚上。所以利未人為自己和祭司亞倫的子孫，預備[祭物]。
verses.e: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests , because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night . Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron .

verses.z: 歌唱的亞薩之子孫，照着大衛、亞薩、希幔，和王的先見耶杜頓所吩咐的，站在自己的地位上。守門的看守各門，不用離開他們的職事，因為他們的弟兄利未人給他們預備[祭物]。
verses.e: The singers , the sons of Asaph , were in their place , according to the commandment of David , Asaph , Heman , and Jeduthun the king's seer ; and the gatekeepers were at every gate . They didn't need to depart from their service , because their brothers the Levites prepared for them .

verses.z: 當日，供奉耶和華的事齊備了，就照約西亞王的吩咐守逾越節，獻燔祭在耶和華的壇上。
verses.e: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day , to keep the Passover , and to offer burnt offerings on the LORD's altar , according to the commandment of King Josiah .

verses.z: 當時在耶路撒冷的以色列人守逾越節，又守除酵節七日。
verses.e: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time , and the feast of unleavened bread seven days .

verses.z: 自從先知撒母耳以來，在以色列中沒有守過這樣的逾越節，以色列諸王也沒有守過，像約西亞、祭司、利未人、在那裏的猶大人，和以色列人，以及耶路撒冷居民所守的逾越節。
verses.e: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet , nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept — with the priests , the Levites , and all Judah and Israel who were present , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 這逾越節是約西亞作王十八年守的。
verses.e: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah .

verses.z: 王分派祭司各盡其職，又勉勵他們辦耶和華殿中的事；
verses.e: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 這事以後，約西亞修完了殿，有埃及王尼哥上來，要攻擊靠近幼發拉底河的迦基米施；約西亞出去抵擋他。
verses.e: After all this , when Josiah had prepared the temple , Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates , and Josiah went out against him .

verses.z: 他差遣使者來見約西亞，說：「猶大王啊，我與你何干？我今日來不是要攻擊你，乃是要攻擊與我爭戰之家，並且上帝吩咐我速行，你不要[干預]上帝的事，免得他毀滅你，因為上帝是與我同在。」
verses.e: But he sent ambassadors to him , saying , " What have I to do with you , you king of Judah ? I come not against you today , but against the house with which I have war . God has commanded me to make haste . Beware that it is God who is with me , that he not destroy you . "

verses.z: 約西亞卻不肯轉去離開他，改裝要與他打仗，不聽從上帝藉尼哥之口所說的話，便來到米吉多平原爭戰。
verses.e: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him , but disguised himself , that he might fight with him , and didn't listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God , and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo .

verses.z: 弓箭手射中約西亞王。王對他的臣僕說：「我受了重傷，你拉我出陣吧！」
verses.e: The archers shot at King Josiah ; and the king said to his servants , " Take me away , because I am seriously wounded ! "

verses.z: 他的臣僕扶他下了戰車，上了次車，送他到耶路撒冷，他就死了，葬在他列祖的墳墓裏。猶大人和耶路撒冷人都為他悲哀。
verses.e: So his servants took him out of the chariot , and put him in the second chariot that he had , and brought him to Jerusalem ; and he died , and was buried in the tombs of his fathers . All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah .

verses.z: 耶利米為約西亞作哀歌。所有歌唱的男女也唱哀歌，追悼約西亞，直到今日；而且在以色列中成了定例。這歌載在哀歌書上。
verses.e: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah , and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day ; and they made them an ordinance in Israel . Behold , they are written in the lamentations .

verses.z: 約西亞其餘的事和他遵着耶和華律法上所記而行的善事，
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds , according to that which is written in the LORD's law ,

verses.z: 並他自始至終所行的，都寫在以色列和猶大列王記上。
verses.e: and his acts , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .

verses.z: 又對那歸耶和華為聖、教訓以色列人的利未人說：「你們將聖[約]櫃安放在以色列王大衛兒子所羅門建造的殿裏，不必再用肩扛抬。現在要事奉耶和華－你們的上帝，服事他的民以色列。
verses.e: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel , who were holy to the LORD , " Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built . It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders . Now serve the LORD your God and his people Israel .

verses.z: 你們應當按着宗族，照着班次，遵以色列王大衛和他兒子所羅門所寫的，自己預備。
verses.e: Prepare yourselves after your fathers ' houses by your divisions , according to the writing of David king of Israel , and according to the writing of Solomon his son .

verses.z: 要按着你們的弟兄，這民宗族的班次，站在聖所，[每班中]要利未宗族的幾個人。
verses.e: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers ' houses of your brothers the children of the people , and let there be for each a portion of a fathers ' house of the Levites .

verses.z: 要宰逾越節[的羊羔]，潔淨自己，為你們的弟兄預備了，好遵守耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的話。」
verses.e: Kill the Passover lamb , sanctify yourselves , and prepare for your brothers , to do according to the LORD's word by Moses . "

verses.z: 約西亞從群畜中賜給在那裏所有的人民，綿羊羔和山羊羔三萬隻，牛三千隻，作逾越節的祭物；這都是出自王的產業中。
verses.e: Josiah gave to the children of the people , of the flock , lambs and young goats , all of them for the Passover offerings , to all who were present , to the number of thirty thousand , and three thousand bulls . These were of the king's substance .

verses.z: 約西亞的眾首領也樂意將犧牲給百姓和祭司利未人；又有管理上帝殿的希勒家、撒迦利亞、耶歇將[羊羔]二千六百隻，牛三百隻，給祭司作逾越節的祭物。
verses.e: His princes gave a free will offering to the people , to the priests , and to the Levites . Hilkiah , Zechariah , and Jehiel , the rulers of God's house , gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock , and three hundred head of cattle .

verses.z: 利未人的族長歌楠雅和他兩個兄弟示瑪雅、拿坦業，與哈沙比雅、耶利、約撒拔將[羊羔]五千隻，牛五百隻，給利未人作逾越節的祭物。
verses.e: Conaniah also , and Shemaiah and Nethanel , his brothers , and Hashabiah , Jeiel , and Jozabad , the chiefs of the Levites , gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle .

verses.z: 國民立約西亞的兒子約哈斯在耶路撒冷接續他父作王。
verses.e: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father's place in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 過了一年，尼布甲尼撒差遣人將約雅斤和耶和華殿裏各樣寶貴的器皿帶到巴比倫，就立約雅斤的叔叔西底家作猶大和耶路撒冷的王。
verses.e: At the return of the year , King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon , with the valuable vessels of the LORD's house , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem .

verses.z: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年，
verses.e: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 行耶和華－他上帝眼中看為惡的事。先知耶利米以耶和華的話勸他，他仍不在耶利米面前自卑。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD his God's sight . He didn't humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the LORD's mouth .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒曾使他指着上帝起誓，他卻背叛，強項硬心，不歸服耶和華－以色列的上帝。
verses.e: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar , who had made him swear by God ; but he stiffened his neck , and hardened his heart against turning to the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 眾祭司長和百姓也大大犯罪，效法外邦人一切可憎的事，污穢耶和華在耶路撒冷分別為聖的殿。
verses.e: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations ; and they polluted the LORD's house which he had made holy in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 耶和華－他們列祖的上帝因為愛惜自己的民和他的居所，從早起來差遣使者去警戒他們。
verses.e: The LORD , the God of their fathers , sent to them by his messengers , rising up early and sending , because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place ;

verses.z: 他們卻嘻笑上帝的使者，藐視他的言語，譏誚他的先知，以致耶和華的忿怒向他的百姓發作，無法可救。
verses.e: but they mocked the messengers of God , despised his words , and scoffed at his prophets , until the LORD's wrath arose against his people , until there was no remedy .

verses.z: 所以，耶和華使迦勒底人的王來攻擊他們，在他們聖殿裏用刀殺了他們的壯丁，不憐恤他們的少男處女、老人白叟。耶和華將他們都交在迦勒底王手裏。
verses.e: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans , who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary , and had no compassion on young man or virgin , old man or infirm . He gave them all into his hand .

verses.z: 迦勒底王將上帝殿裏的大小器皿與耶和華殿裏的財寶，並王和眾首領的財寶，都帶到巴比倫去了。
verses.e: All the vessels of God's house , great and small , and the treasures of the LORD's house , and the treasures of the king and of his princes , all these he brought to Babylon .

verses.z: 迦勒底人焚燒上帝的殿，拆毀耶路撒冷的城牆，用火燒了城裏的宮殿，毀壞了城裏寶貴的器皿。
verses.e: They burned God's house , broke down the wall of Jerusalem , burned all its palaces with fire , and destroyed all of its valuable vessels .

verses.z: 約哈斯登基的時候年二十三歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。
verses.e: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 凡脫離刀劍的，迦勒底王都擄到巴比倫去，作他和他子孫的僕婢，直到波斯國興起來。
verses.e: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon , and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia ,

verses.z: 這就應驗耶和華藉耶利米口所說的話：地享受安息；因為地土荒涼便守安息，直滿了七十年。
verses.e: to fulfill the LORD's word by Jeremiah's mouth , until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths . As long as it lay desolate , it kept Sabbath , to fulfill seventy years .

verses.z: 波斯王塞魯士元年，耶和華為要應驗藉耶利米口所說的話，就激動波斯王塞魯士的心，使他下詔通告全國，說：
verses.e: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia , that the LORD's word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished , the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia , so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom , and put it also in writing , saying ,

verses.z: 「波斯王塞魯士如此說：耶和華－天上的上帝已將天下萬國賜給我，又囑咐我在猶大的耶路撒冷為他建造殿宇。你們中間凡作他子民的，可以上去，願耶和華－他的上帝與他同在。」
verses.e: " Cyrus king of Persia says , ' The LORD , the God of heaven , has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me ; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem , which is in Judah . Whoever there is among you of all his people , the LORD his God be with him , and let him go up . ' "

verses.z: 埃及王在耶路撒冷廢了他，又罰[猶大]國銀子一百他連得，金子一他連得。
verses.e: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem , and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold .

verses.z: 埃及王尼哥立約哈斯的哥哥以利雅敬作猶大和耶路撒冷的王，改名叫約雅敬，又將約哈斯帶到埃及去了。
verses.e: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem , and changed his name to Jehoiakim . Neco took Joahaz his brother , and carried him to Egypt .

verses.z: 約雅敬登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年，行耶和華－他上帝眼中看為惡的事。
verses.e: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . He did that which was evil in the LORD his God's sight .

verses.z: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒上來攻擊他，用銅鍊鎖着他，要將他帶到巴比倫去。
verses.e: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him , and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒又將耶和華殿裏的器皿帶到巴比倫，放在他神的廟裏。
verses.e: Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of the LORD's house to Babylon , and put them in his temple at Babylon .

verses.z: 約雅敬其餘的事和他所行可憎的事，並他一切的行為，都寫在以色列和猶大列王記上。他兒子約雅斤接續他作王。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and his abominations which he did , and that which was found in him , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah ; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 約雅斤登基的時候年八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月零十天，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事。
verses.e: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem . He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight .

verses.z: 他又製造一座銅壇，長二十肘，寬二十肘，高十肘；
verses.e: Then he made an altar of bronze , twenty cubits long , twenty cubits wide , and ten cubits high .

verses.z: 將海安在[殿門的]右邊，就是南邊。
verses.e: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward , toward the south .

verses.z: 戶蘭又造了盆、鏟、碗。這樣，他為所羅門王做完了上帝殿的工。
verses.e: Huram made the pots , the shovels , and the basins . So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God's house :

verses.z: [所造的]就是：兩根柱子和柱上兩個如球的頂，並兩個蓋柱頂的網子
verses.e: the two pillars , the bowls , the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars , the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars ,

verses.z: 和四百石榴，安在兩個網子上（每網兩行蓋着兩個柱上如球的頂）。
verses.e: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks — two rows of pomegranates for each network , to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars .

verses.z: 盆座和其上的盆，
verses.e: He also made the bases , and he made the basins on the bases —

verses.z: 海和海下的十二隻牛，
verses.e: one sea , and the twelve oxen under it .

verses.z: 盆、鏟子、肉鍤子，與耶和華殿裏的一切器皿，都是巧匠戶蘭用光亮的銅為所羅門王造成的，
verses.e: Huram-abi also made the pots , the shovels , the forks , and all its vessels for King Solomon , for the LORD's house , of bright bronze .

verses.z: 是在約旦平原疏割和撒利但中間藉膠泥鑄成的。
verses.e: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan , in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah .

verses.z: 所羅門製造的這一切甚多，銅的輕重無法可查。
verses.e: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance , so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined .

verses.z: 所羅門又造上帝殿裏的金壇和陳設餅的桌子，
verses.e: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God's house : the golden altar , the tables with the show bread on them ,

verses.z: 又鑄一個[銅]海，樣式是圓的，高五肘，徑十肘，圍三十肘；
verses.e: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim . It was round , five cubits high , and thirty cubits in circumference .

verses.z: 並精金的燈臺和燈盞，可以照例點在內殿前。
verses.e: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary , of pure gold ;

verses.z: 燈臺上的花和燈盞，並蠟剪都是金的，且是純金的；
verses.e: and the flowers , the lamps , and the tongs of gold that was purest gold ;

verses.z: 又用精金製造鑷子、盤子、調羹、火鼎。至於殿門和至聖所的門扇，並殿的門扇，都是金子妝飾的。
verses.e: and the snuffers , the basins , the spoons , and the fire pans of pure gold . As for the entry of the house , its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold .

verses.z: 海周圍有野瓜的樣式，每肘十瓜，共有兩行，是鑄海的時候鑄上的；
verses.e: Under it was the likeness of oxen , which encircled it , for ten cubits , encircling the sea . The oxen were in two rows , cast when it was cast .

verses.z: 有十二隻[銅]牛馱海：三隻向北，三隻向西，三隻向南，三隻向東；海在牛上，牛尾向內；
verses.e: It stood on twelve oxen , three looking toward the north , three looking toward the west , three looking toward the south , and three looking toward the east ; and the sea was set on them above , and all their hindquarters were inward .

verses.z: 海厚一掌，邊如杯邊，又如百合花，可容三千罷特；
verses.e: It was a handbreadth thick . Its brim was made like the brim of a cup , like the flower of a lily . It received and held three thousand baths .

verses.z: 又製造十個盆：五個放在右邊，五個放在左邊，獻燔祭所用之物都洗在其內；但海是為祭司沐浴的。
verses.e: He also made ten basins , and put five on the right hand and five on the left , to wash in them . The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them , but the sea was for the priests to wash in .

verses.z: 他又照所定的樣式造十個金燈臺，放在殿裏：五個在右邊，五個在左邊；
verses.e: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them ; and he set them in the temple , five on the right hand and five on the left .

verses.z: 又造十張桌子，放在殿裏：五張在右邊，五張在左邊；又造一百個金碗；
verses.e: He made also ten tables , and placed them in the temple , five on the right side and five on the left . He made one hundred basins of gold .

verses.z: 又建立祭司院和大院，並院門，用銅包裹門扇；
verses.e: Furthermore he made the court of the priests , the great court , and doors for the court , and overlaid their doors with bronze .

verses.z: 所羅門做完了耶和華殿的一切工，就把他父大衛分別為聖的金銀和器皿都帶來，放在上帝殿的府庫裏。
verses.e: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the LORD's house was finished . Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated , even the silver , the gold , and all the vessels , and put them in the treasuries of God's house .

verses.z: [約]櫃裏惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及後，耶和華與他們立約的時候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。
verses.e: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb , when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of Egypt .

verses.z: 當時，在那裏所有的祭司都已自潔，並不分班供職。
verses.e: When the priests had come out of the holy place ( for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves , and didn't keep their divisions ;

verses.z: 他們出聖所的時候，歌唱的利未人亞薩、希幔、耶杜頓，和他們的眾子眾弟兄都穿細麻布衣服，站在壇的東邊，敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，同着他們有一百二十個祭司吹號。
verses.e: also the Levites who were the singers , all of them , even Asaph , Heman , Jeduthun , and their sons and their brothers , arrayed in fine linen , with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps , stood at the east end of the altar , and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets ) ;

verses.z: 吹號的、歌唱的都一齊發聲，聲合為一，讚美感謝耶和華。吹號、敲鈸，用各種樂器，揚聲讚美耶和華[說]：耶和華本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！那時，耶和華的殿有雲充滿，
verses.e: when the trumpeters and singers were as one , to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD ; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music , and praised the LORD , saying , " For he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever ! " then the house was filled with a cloud , even the LORD's house ,

verses.z: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了上帝的殿。
verses.e: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud ; for the LORD's glory filled God's house .

verses.z: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老、各支派的首領，並以色列的族長招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城－就是錫安－運上來。
verses.e: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes , the princes of the fathers ' households of the children of Israel , to Jerusalem , to bring up the ark of the LORD's covenant out of David's city , which is Zion .

verses.z: 於是以色列眾人在七月節[前]都聚集到王那裏。
verses.e: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast , which was in the seventh month .

verses.z: 以色列眾長老來到，利未人便抬起[約]櫃。
verses.e: All the elders of Israel came . The Levites took up the ark .

verses.z: 祭司利未人將[約]櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。
verses.e: They brought up the ark , the Tent of Meeting , and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent . The Levitical priests brought these up .

verses.z: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裏的以色列全會眾都在[約]櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。
verses.e: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark , sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude .

verses.z: 祭司將耶和華的[約]櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。
verses.e: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD's covenant to its place , into the inner sanctuary of the house , to the most holy place , even under the wings of the cherubim .

verses.z: 基路伯張着翅膀在[約]櫃之上，遮掩[約]櫃和抬櫃的槓。
verses.e: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark , and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above .

verses.z: 這槓甚長，槓頭在內殿前可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裏。
verses.e: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary , but they were not seen outside ; and it is there to this day .

verses.z: 那時，所羅門說：耶和華曾說他必住在幽暗之處。
verses.e: Then Solomon said , " The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .

verses.z: 「現在耶和華成就了他所應許的話，使我接續我父大衛坐以色列的國位，是照耶和華所說的，又為耶和華－以色列上帝的名建造了殿。
verses.e: " The LORD has performed his word that he spoke ; for I have risen up in the place of David my father , and sit on the throne of Israel , as the LORD promised , and have built the house for the name of the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 我將[約]櫃安置在其中，櫃內有耶和華的約，就是他與以色列人所立的約。」
verses.e: There I have set the ark , in which is the LORD's covenant , which he made with the children of Israel . "

verses.z: 所羅門當着以色列會眾，站在耶和華的壇前，舉起手來，
verses.e: He stood before the LORD's altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel , and spread out his hands

verses.z: （所羅門曾造一個銅臺，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘，放在院中）就站在臺上，當着以色列的會眾跪下，向天舉手，
verses.e: ( for Solomon had made a bronze platform , five cubits long , five cubits wide , and three cubits high , and had set it in the middle of the court ; and he stood on it , and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel , and spread out his hands toward heaven ) .

verses.z: 說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，天上地下沒有神可比你的！你向那盡心行在你面前的僕人守約施慈愛；
verses.e: Then he said , " LORD , the God of Israel , there is no God like you in heaven or on earth — you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart ;

verses.z: 向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話現在應驗了。你親口應許，親手成就，正如今日一樣。
verses.e: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him . Yes , you spoke with your mouth , and have fulfilled it with your hand , as it is today .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，你所應許你僕人－我父大衛的話說：『你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一樣，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。』現在求你應驗這話。
verses.e: " Now therefore , LORD , the God of Israel , keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him , saying , ' There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel , if only your children take heed to their way , to walk in my law as you have walked before me . '

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，求你成就向你僕人大衛所應許的話。
verses.e: Now therefore , LORD , the God of Israel , let your word be verified , which you spoke to your servant David .

verses.z: 「上帝果真與世人同住在地上嗎？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何況我所建的這殿呢？
verses.e: " But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth ? Behold , heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain you ; how much less this house which I have built !

verses.z: 惟求耶和華－我的上帝垂顧僕人的禱告祈求，俯聽僕人在你面前的祈禱呼籲。
verses.e: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication , LORD my God , to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you ;

verses.z: 但我已經建造殿宇作你的居所，為你永遠的住處。
verses.e: But I have built you a house and home , a place for you to dwell in forever . "

verses.z: 願你晝夜看顧這殿，就是你應許立為你名的居所；求你垂聽僕人向此處禱告的話。
verses.e: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night , even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name , to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place .

verses.z: 你僕人和你民以色列向此處祈禱的時候，求你從天上你的居所垂聽，垂聽而赦免。
verses.e: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel , when they pray toward this place . Yes , hear from your dwelling place , even from heaven ; and when you hear , forgive .

verses.z: 「人若得罪鄰舍，有人叫他起誓，他來到這殿，在你的壇前起誓，
verses.e: " If a man sins against his neighbor , and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear , and he comes and swears before your altar in this house ,

verses.z: 求你從天上垂聽，判斷你的僕人，定惡人有罪，照他所行的報應在他頭上；定義人有理，照他的義賞賜他。
verses.e: then hear from heaven , act , and judge your servants , bringing retribution to the wicked , to bring his way on his own head ; and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .

verses.z: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，敗在仇敵面前，又回心轉意承認你的名，在這殿裏向你祈求禱告，
verses.e: " If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you , and they turn again and confess your name , and pray and make supplication before you in this house ,

verses.z: 求你從天上垂聽，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他們歸回你賜給他們和他們列祖之地。
verses.e: then hear from heaven , and forgive the sin of your people Israel , and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers .

verses.z: 「你的民因得罪你，你懲罰他們，使天閉塞不下雨，他們若向此處禱告，承認你的名，離開他們的罪，
verses.e: " When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you , if they pray toward this place and confess your name , and turn from their sin when you afflict them ,

verses.z: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你僕人和你民以色列的罪，將當行的善道指教他們，且降雨在你的地，就是你賜給你民為業之地。
verses.e: then hear in heaven , and forgive the sin of your servants , your people Israel , when you teach them the good way in which they should walk , and send rain on your land , which you have given to your people for an inheritance .

verses.z: 「國中若有饑荒、瘟疫、旱風、霉爛、蝗蟲、螞蚱，或有仇敵犯境，圍困城邑，無論遭遇甚麼災禍疾病，
verses.e: " If there is famine in the land , if there is pestilence , if there is blight or mildew , locust or caterpillar ; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities ; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is —

verses.z: 你的民以色列，或是眾人，或是一人，自覺災禍甚苦，向這殿舉手，無論祈求甚麼，禱告甚麼，
verses.e: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man , or by all your people Israel , who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow , and shall spread out his hands toward this house ,

verses.z: 王轉臉為以色列會眾祝福，以色列會眾就都站立。
verses.e: The king turned his face , and blessed all the assembly of Israel ; and all the assembly of Israel stood .

verses.z: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他們（惟有你知道世人的心），
verses.e: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive , and give to every man according to all his ways , whose heart you know ( for you , even you only , know the hearts of the children of men ) ,

verses.z: 使他們在你賜給我們列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。
verses.e: that they may fear you , to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers .

verses.z: 「論到不屬你民以色列的外邦人，為你的大名和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂，從遠方而來，向這殿禱告，
verses.e: " Moreover , concerning the foreigner , who is not of your people Israel , when he comes from a far country for your great name's sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm , when they come and pray toward this house ,

verses.z: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下萬民都認識你的名，敬畏你，像你的民以色列一樣，又使他們知道我建造的這殿是稱為你名下的。
verses.e: then hear from heaven , even from your dwelling place , and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for ; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you , as do your people Israel , and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name .

verses.z: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，無論往何處去與仇敵爭戰，向你所選擇的城與我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
verses.e: " If your people go out to battle against their enemies , by whatever way you send them , and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen , and the house which I have built for your name ;

verses.z: 求你從天上垂聽他們的禱告祈求，使他們得勝。
verses.e: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .

verses.z: 「你的民若得罪你（世上沒有不犯罪的人），你向他們發怒，將他們交給仇敵擄到或遠或近之地；
verses.e: " If they sin against you ( for there is no man who doesn't sin ) , and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near ;

verses.z: 他們若在擄到之地想起罪來，回心轉意，懇求你說：『我們有罪了，我們悖逆了，我們作惡了』；
verses.e: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive , and turn again , and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity , saying , ' We have sinned , we have done perversely , and have dealt wickedly ; '

verses.z: 他們若在擄到之地盡心盡性歸服你，又向自己的地，就是你賜給他們列祖之地和你所選擇的城，並我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
verses.e: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity , where they have been taken captive , and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers , and the city which you have chosen , and toward the house which I have built for your name ;

verses.z: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽你民的禱告祈求，為他們伸冤，赦免他們的過犯。
verses.e: then hear from heaven , even from your dwelling place , their prayer and their petitions , and maintain their cause , and forgive your people who have sinned against you .

verses.z: 所羅門說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的！因他親口向我父大衛所應許的，也親手成就了。
verses.e: He said , " Blessed be the LORD , the God of Israel , who spoke with his mouth to David my father , and has with his hands fulfilled it , saying ,

verses.z: 「我的上帝啊，現在求你睜眼看，側耳聽在此處所獻的禱告。
verses.e: " Now , my God , let , I beg you , your eyes be open , and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝啊，求你起來，和你有能力的[約]櫃同入安息之所。耶和華上帝啊，願你的祭司披上救恩；願你的聖民蒙福歡樂。
verses.e: " Now therefore arise , LORD God , into your resting place , you , and the ark of your strength . Let your priests , LORD God , be clothed with salvation , and let your saints rejoice in goodness .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝啊，求你不要厭棄你的受膏者，要記念向你僕人大衛所施的慈愛。」
verses.e: " LORD God , don't turn away the face of your anointed . Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant . "

verses.z: 他說：『自從我領我民出埃及地以來，我未曾在以色列眾支派中選擇一城建造殿宇為我名的居所，也未曾揀選一人作我民以色列的君；
verses.e: ' Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt , I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in , that my name might be there , and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel ;

verses.z: 但選擇耶路撒冷為我名的居所，又揀選大衛治理我民以色列。』」
verses.e: but now I have chosen Jerusalem , that my name might be there ; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel . '

verses.z: 所羅門說：「我父大衛曾立意要為耶和華－以色列上帝的名建殿，
verses.e: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華卻對我父大衛說：『你立意要為我的名建殿，這意思甚好；
verses.e: But the LORD said to David my father , ' Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name , you did well that it was in your heart ;

verses.z: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的兒子必為我名建殿。』
verses.e: nevertheless you shall not build the house , but your son who will come out of your body , he shall build the house for my name . '

verses.z: 所羅門祈禱已畢，就有火從天上降下來，燒盡燔祭和別的祭。耶和華的榮光充滿了殿；
verses.e: Now when Solomon had finished praying , fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices ; and the LORD's glory filled the house .

verses.z: 七月二十三日，王遣散眾民；他們因見耶和華向大衛和所羅門與他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜樂，各歸各家去了。
verses.e: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month , he sent the people away to their tents , joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David , to Solomon , and to Israel his people .

verses.z: 所羅門造成了耶和華殿和王宮；在耶和華殿和王宮凡他心中所要做的，都順順利利地做成了。
verses.e: Thus Solomon finished the LORD's house and the king's house ; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the LORD's house and in his own house .

verses.z: 夜間耶和華向所羅門顯現，對他說：「我已聽了你的禱告，也選擇這地方作為祭祀我的殿宇。
verses.e: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon by night , and said to him , " I have heard your prayer , and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice .

verses.z: 我若使天閉塞不下雨，或使蝗蟲吃這地的出產，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，
verses.e: " If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain , or if I command the locust to devour the land , or if I send pestilence among my people ,

verses.z: 這稱為我名下的子民，若是自卑、禱告，尋求我的面，轉離他們的惡行，我必從天上垂聽，赦免他們的罪，醫治他們的地。
verses.e: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves , pray , seek my face , and turn from their wicked ways , then I will hear from heaven , will forgive their sin , and will heal their land .

verses.z: 我必睜眼看、側耳聽在此處所獻的禱告。
verses.e: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place .

verses.z: 現在我已選擇這殿，分別為聖，使我的名永在其中，我的眼、我的心也必常在那裏。
verses.e: For now I have chosen and made this house holy , that my name may be there forever ; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually .

verses.z: 你若在我面前效法你父大衛所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，謹守我的律例典章，
verses.e: " As for you , if you will walk before me as David your father walked , and do according to all that I have commanded you , and will keep my statutes and my ordinances ,

verses.z: 我就必堅固你的國位，正如我與你父大衛所立的約，說：『你[的子孫]必不斷人作以色列的王。』
verses.e: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom , according as I covenanted with David your father , saying , ' There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel . '

verses.z: 「倘若你們轉去丟棄我指示你們的律例誡命，去事奉敬拜別神，
verses.e: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you , and go and serve other gods and worship them ,

verses.z: 因耶和華的榮光充滿了耶和華殿，所以祭司不能進殿。
verses.e: The priests could not enter into the LORD's house , because the LORD's glory filled the LORD's house .

verses.z: 我就必將以色列人從我賜給他們的地上拔出根來，並且我為己名所分別為聖的殿也必捨棄不顧，使他在萬民中作笑談，被譏誚。
verses.e: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them ; and this house , which I have made holy for my name , I will cast out of my sight , and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples .

verses.z: 這殿雖然甚高，將來經過的人必驚訝說：『耶和華為何向這地和這殿如此行呢？』
verses.e: This house , which is so high , everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say , ' Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house ? '

verses.z: 人必回答說：『是因此地的人離棄耶和華－他們列祖的上帝，就是領他們出埃及地的上帝，去親近別神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和華使這一切災禍臨到他們。』」
verses.e: They shall answer , ' Because they abandoned the LORD , the God of their fathers , who brought them out of the land of Egypt , and took other gods , worshiped them , and served them . Therefore he has brought all this evil on them . ' "

verses.z: 那火降下、耶和華的榮光在殿上的時候，以色列眾人看見，就在鋪石地俯伏叩拜，稱謝耶和華[說]：耶和華本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: All the children of Israel looked on , when the fire came down , and the LORD's glory was on the house . They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement , worshiped , and gave thanks to the LORD , saying , " For he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever ! "

verses.z: 王和眾民在耶和華面前獻祭。
verses.e: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD .

verses.z: 所羅門王用牛二萬二千，羊十二萬獻祭。這樣，王和眾民為上帝的殿行奉獻之禮。
verses.e: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the people dedicated God's house .

verses.z: 祭司侍立，各供其職；利未人也拿着耶和華的樂器，就是大衛王造出來、藉利未人頌讚耶和華的。（他的慈愛永遠長存！）祭司在眾人面前吹號，以色列人都站立。
verses.e: The priests stood , according to their positions ; the Levites also with instruments of music of the LORD , which David the king had made to give thanks to the LORD , when David praised by their ministry , saying " For his loving kindness endures forever . " The priests sounded trumpets before them ; and all Israel stood .

verses.z: 所羅門因他所造的銅壇容不下燔祭、素祭，和脂油，便將耶和華殿前院子當中分別為聖，在那裏獻燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。
verses.e: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before the LORD's house holy ; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings , because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering , the meal offering , and the fat .

verses.z: 那時所羅門和以色列眾人，就是從哈馬口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成為大會，守節七日。
verses.e: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days , and all Israel with him , a very great assembly , from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt .

verses.z: 第八日設立嚴肅會，行奉獻壇的禮七日，守節七日。
verses.e: On the eighth day , they held a solemn assembly ; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .

verses.z: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，二十年才完畢了。
verses.e: At the end of twenty years , in which Solomon had built the LORD's house and his own house ,

verses.z: 所羅門王有二百五十督工的，監管工人。
verses.e: These were the chief officers of King Solomon , even two-hundred fifty , who ruled over the people .

verses.z: 所羅門將法老的女兒帶出大衛城，上到為她建造的宮裏；因所羅門說：「耶和華[約]櫃所到之處都為聖地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大衛的宮裏。」
verses.e: Solomon brought up Pharaoh's daughter out of David's city to the house that he had built for her ; for he said , " My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel , because the places where the LORD's ark has come are holy . "

verses.z: 所羅門在耶和華的壇上，就是在廊子前他所築的壇上，與耶和華獻燔祭；
verses.e: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD's altar which he had built before the porch ,

verses.z: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，並一年三節，就是除酵節、七七節、住棚節，獻每日所當獻的祭。
verses.e: even as the duty of every day required , offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths , on the new moons , and on the set feasts , three times per year , during the feast of unleavened bread , during the feast of weeks , and during the feast of booths .

verses.z: 所羅門照着他父大衛所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他們各供己事，又使利未人各盡其職，讚美[耶和華]，在祭司面前做每日所當做的；又派守門的按着班次看守各門，因為神人大衛是這樣吩咐的。
verses.e: He appointed , according to the ordinance of David his father , the divisions of the priests to their service , and the Levites to their offices , to praise and to minister before the priests , as the duty of every day required , the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate , for David the man of God had so commanded .

verses.z: 王所吩咐眾祭司和利未人的，無論是管府庫或辦別的事，他們都不違背。
verses.e: They didn't depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures .

verses.z: 所羅門建造耶和華的殿，從立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱備。這樣，耶和華的殿全然完畢。
verses.e: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD's house until it was finished . So the LORD's house was completed .

verses.z: 那時，所羅門往以東地靠海的以旬‧迦別和以祿去。
verses.e: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth , on the seashore in the land of Edom .

verses.z: 希蘭差遣他的臣僕，將船隻和熟悉泛海的僕人送到所羅門那裏。他們同着所羅門的僕人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他連得金子，運到所羅門王那裏。
verses.e: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants ; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir , and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold , and brought them to King Solomon .

verses.z: 以後所羅門重新修築希蘭送給他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那裏。
verses.e: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon , and caused the children of Israel to dwell there .

verses.z: 所羅門往哈馬瑣巴去，攻取了那地方。
verses.e: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah , and prevailed against it .

verses.z: 所羅門建造曠野裏的達莫，又建造哈馬所有的積貨城，
verses.e: He built Tadmor in the wilderness , and all the storage cities , which he built in Hamath .

verses.z: 又建造上伯‧和崙、下伯‧和崙作為保障，都有牆，有門，有閂；
verses.e: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower , fortified cities with walls , gates , and bars ;

verses.z: 又建造巴拉和所有的積貨城，並屯車輛馬兵的城，與耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全國中所願意建造的。
verses.e: and Baalath , and all the storage cities that Solomon had , and all the cities for his chariots , the cities for his horsemen , and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem , in Lebanon , and in all the land of his dominion .

verses.z: 至於國中所剩下不屬以色列人的赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
verses.e: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites , the Amorites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites , who were not of Israel —

verses.z: 就是以色列人未曾滅絕的，所羅門挑取他們的後裔作服苦的[奴僕]，直到今日。
verses.e: of their children who were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel didn't consume — of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day .

verses.z: 惟有以色列人，所羅門不使他們當奴僕做工，乃是作他的戰士、軍長的統領、車兵長、馬兵長。
verses.e: But of the children of Israel , Solomon made no servants for his work , but they were men of war , chief of his captains , and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen .

verses.z: 示巴女王聽見所羅門的名聲，就來到耶路撒冷，要用難解的話試問所羅門；跟隨她的人甚多，又有駱駝馱着香料、寶石，和許多金子。她來見了所羅門，就把心裏所有的對所羅門都說出來。
verses.e: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon , she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem , with a very great caravan , including camels that bore spices , gold in abundance , and precious stones . When she had come to Solomon , she talked with him about all that was in her heart .

verses.z: 希蘭的僕人和所羅門的僕人從俄斐運了金子來，也運了檀香木和寶石來。
verses.e: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon , who brought gold from Ophir , also brought algum trees and precious stones .

verses.z: 王用檀香木為耶和華殿和王宮做臺，又為歌唱的人做琴瑟；猶大地從來沒有見過這樣的。
verses.e: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD's house and for the king's house , and harps and stringed instruments for the singers . There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah .

verses.z: 所羅門王按示巴女王所帶來的，還她禮物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送給她。於是女王和她臣僕轉回本國去了。
verses.e: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatever she asked , more than that which she had brought to the king . So she turned and went to her own land , she and her servants .

verses.z: 所羅門每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他連得，
verses.e: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold ,

verses.z: 另外還有商人所進的金子，並且阿拉伯諸王與[屬]國的省長都帶金銀給所羅門。
verses.e: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought . All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon .

verses.z: 所羅門王用錘出來的金子打成擋牌二百面，每面用金子六百[舍客勒]；
verses.e: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold . Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield .

verses.z: 又用錘出來的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百[舍客勒]，都放在黎巴嫩林宮裏。
verses.e: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold . Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield . The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon .

verses.z: 王用象牙製造一個大寶座，用精金包裹。
verses.e: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with pure gold .

verses.z: 寶座有六層臺階，又有金腳凳，與寶座相連。寶座兩旁有扶手，靠近扶手有兩個獅子站立。
verses.e: There were six steps to the throne , with a footstool of gold , which were fastened to the throne , and armrests on either side by the place of the seat , and two lions standing beside the armrests .

verses.z: 六層臺階上有十二個獅子站立，每層有兩個：左邊一個，右邊一個；在列國中沒有這樣做的。
verses.e: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps . There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom .

verses.z: 所羅門將她所問的都答上了，沒有一句不明白、不能答的。
verses.e: Solomon answered all her questions . There wasn't anything hidden from Solomon which he didn't tell her .

verses.z: 所羅門王一切的飲器都是金的，黎巴嫩林宮裏的一切器皿都是精金的。所羅門年間，銀子算不了甚麼。
verses.e: All King Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold . Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon .

verses.z: 因為王的船隻與希蘭的僕人一同往他施去；他施船隻三年一次裝載金、銀、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回來。
verses.e: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram's servants . Once every three years , the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold , silver , ivory , apes , and peacocks .

verses.z: 所羅門王的財寶與智慧勝過天下的列王。
verses.e: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom .

verses.z: 普天下的王都求見所羅門，要聽上帝賜給他智慧的話。
verses.e: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .

verses.z: 他們各帶貢物，就是金器、銀器、衣服、軍械、香料、騾馬，每年有一定之例。
verses.e: They each brought tribute : vessels of silver , vessels of gold , clothing , armor , spices , horses , and mules every year .

verses.z: 所羅門有套車的馬四千棚，有馬兵一萬二千，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裏。
verses.e: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 所羅門統管諸王，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。
verses.e: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines , and to the border of Egypt .

verses.z: 王在耶路撒冷使銀子多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
verses.e: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones , and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland .

verses.z: 有人從埃及和各國為所羅門趕馬群來。
verses.e: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands .

verses.z: 所羅門其餘的事，自始至終，不都寫在先知拿單的書上和示羅人亞希雅的預言書上，並先見易多論尼八兒子耶羅波安的默示書上嗎？
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon , first and last , aren't they written in the history of Nathan the prophet , and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite , and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat ?

verses.z: 示巴女王見所羅門的智慧和他所建造的宮室、
verses.e: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon , the house that he had built ,

verses.z: 所羅門在耶路撒冷作以色列眾人的王共四十年。
verses.e: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years .

verses.z: 所羅門與他列祖同睡，葬在他父大衛城裏。他兒子羅波安接續他作王。
verses.e: Solomon slept with his fathers , and he was buried in his father David's city ; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 席上的珍饈美味、群臣分列而坐、僕人兩旁侍立，以及他們的衣服裝飾、酒政，和酒政的衣服裝飾，又見他上耶和華殿的臺階，就詫異得神不守舍，
verses.e: the food of his table , the seating of his servants , the attendance of his ministers , their clothing , his cup bearers and their clothing , and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD's house , there was no more spirit in her .

verses.z: 對王說：「我在本國裏所聽見論到你的事和你的智慧實在是真的！
verses.e: She said to the king , " It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom .

verses.z: 我先不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告訴我的，還不到一半；你的實跡越過我所聽見的名聲。
verses.e: However I didn't believe their words until I came , and my eyes had seen it ; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn't told me . You exceed the fame that I heard !

verses.z: 你的群臣、你的僕人常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話是有福的。
verses.e: Happy are your men , and happy are these your servants , who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom .

verses.z: 耶和華－你的上帝是應當稱頌的！他喜悅你，使你坐他的國位，為耶和華－你的上帝作王；因為你的上帝愛以色列人，要永遠堅立他們，所以立你作他們的王，使你秉公行義。」
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD your God , who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God , because your God loved Israel , to establish them forever . Therefore he made you king over them , to do justice and righteousness . "

verses.z: 於是示巴女王將一百二十他連得金子和寶石，與極多的香料送給所羅門王；她送給王的香料，[以後]再沒有這樣的。
verses.e: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold , spices in great abundance , and precious stones . There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon .

verses.z: 奉上帝旨意作基督耶穌使徒的保羅和兄弟提摩太，寫信給在哥林多上帝的教會，並亞該亞遍處的眾聖徒。
verses.e: Paul , an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God , and Timothy our brother , to the assembly of God which is at Corinth , with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia :

verses.z: 他曾救我們脫離那極大的死亡，現在仍要救我們，並且我們指望他將來還要救我們。
verses.e: who delivered us out of so great a death , and does deliver , on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us ,

verses.z: 你們以祈禱幫助我們，好叫許多人為我們謝恩，就是為我們因許多人所得的恩。
verses.e: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication ; that , for the gift given to us by means of many , thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf .

verses.z: 我們所誇的是自己的良心，見證我們憑着上帝的聖潔和誠實；在世為人不靠人的聰明，乃靠上帝的恩惠，向你們更是這樣。
verses.e: For our boasting is this : the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God , not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God , we behaved ourselves in the world , and more abundantly toward you .

verses.z: 我們現在寫給你們的話，並不外乎你們所念的、所認識的，我也盼望你們到底還是要認識；
verses.e: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge , and I hope you will acknowledge to the end —

verses.z: 正如你們已經有幾分認識我們，以我們誇口，好像我們在我們主耶穌的日子以你們誇口一樣。
verses.e: as also you acknowledged us in part — that we are your boasting , even as you also are ours , in the day of our Lord Jesus .

verses.z: 我既然這樣深信，就早有意到你們那裏去，叫你們再得益處；
verses.e: In this confidence , I was determined to come first to you , that you might have a second benefit ,

verses.z: 也要從你們那裏經過，往馬其頓去，再從馬其頓回到你們那裏，叫你們給我送行往猶太去。
verses.e: and by you to pass into Macedonia , and again from Macedonia to come to you , and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea .

verses.z: 我有此意，豈是反覆不定嗎？我所起的意，豈是從情慾起的，叫我忽是忽非嗎？
verses.e: When I therefore planned this , did I show fickleness ? Or the things that I plan , do I plan according to the flesh , that with me there should be the " Yes , yes " and the " No , no ? "

verses.z: 我指着信實的上帝說，我們向你們所傳的道，並沒有是而又非的。
verses.e: But as God is faithful , our word toward you was not " Yes and no . "

verses.z: 因為我和西拉並提摩太，在你們中間所傳上帝的兒子耶穌基督，總沒有是而又非的，在他只有一是。
verses.e: For the Son of God , Jesus Christ , who was preached among you by us — by me , Silvanus , and Timothy — was not " Yes and no , " but in him is " Yes . "

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安從上帝我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
verses.e: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 上帝的應許，不論有多少，在基督都是是的。所以藉着他也都是實在的，叫上帝因我們得榮耀。
verses.e: For however many are the promises of God , in him is the " Yes . " Therefore also through him is the " Amen " , to the glory of God through us .

verses.z: 那在基督裏堅固我們和你們，並且膏我們的就是上帝。
verses.e: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God ,

verses.z: 他又用印印了我們，並賜[聖]靈在我們心裏作憑據。
verses.e: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts .

verses.z: 我呼籲上帝給我的心作見證，我沒有往哥林多去是為要寬容你們。
verses.e: But I call God for a witness to my soul , that to spare you , I didn't come to Corinth .

verses.z: 我們並不是轄管你們的信心，乃是幫助你們的快樂，因為你們憑信才站立得住。
verses.e: We don't control your faith , but are fellow workers with you for your joy . For you stand firm in faith .

verses.z: 願頌讚歸與我們的主耶穌基督的父上帝，就是發慈悲的父，賜各樣安慰的上帝。
verses.e: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of mercies and God of all comfort ,

verses.z: 我們在一切患難中，他就安慰我們，叫我們能用上帝所賜的安慰去安慰那遭各樣患難的人。
verses.e: who comforts us in all our affliction , that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction , through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God .

verses.z: 我們既多受基督的苦楚，就靠基督多得安慰。
verses.e: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us , even so our comfort also abounds through Christ .

verses.z: 我們受患難呢，是為叫你們得安慰，得拯救；我們得安慰呢，也是為叫你們得安慰；這安慰能叫你們忍受我們所受的那樣苦楚。
verses.e: But if we are afflicted , it is for your comfort and salvation . If we are comforted , it is for your comfort , which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer .

verses.z: 我們為你們所存的盼望是確定的，因為知道你們既是同受苦楚，也必同得安慰。
verses.e: Our hope for you is steadfast , knowing that , since you are partakers of the sufferings , so you are also of the comfort .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我們不要你們不曉得，我們從前在亞細亞遭遇苦難，被壓太重，力不能勝，甚至連活命的指望都絕了；
verses.e: For we don't desire to have you uninformed , brothers , concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia : that we were weighed down exceedingly , beyond our power , so much that we despaired even of life .

verses.z: 自己心裏也斷定是必死的，叫我們不靠自己，只靠叫死人復活的上帝。
verses.e: Yes , we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves , that we should not trust in ourselves , but in God who raises the dead ,

verses.z: 我－保羅，就是與你們見面的時候是謙卑的，不在你們那裏的時候向你們是勇敢的，如今親自藉着基督的溫柔、和平勸你們。
verses.e: Now I Paul , myself , entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ , I who in your presence am lowly among you , but being absent am bold toward you .

verses.z: 因為有人說：「他的信又沉重又厲害，及至見面，卻是氣貌不揚，言語粗俗的。」
verses.e: For , " His letters " , they say , " are weighty and strong , but his bodily presence is weak , and his speech is despised . "

verses.z: 這等人當想，我們不在那裏的時候，信上的言語如何，見面的時候，行事也必如何。
verses.e: Let such a person consider this , that what we are in word by letters when we are absent , such are we also in deed when we are present .

verses.z: 因為我們不敢將自己和那自薦的人同列相比。他們用自己度量自己，用自己比較自己，乃是不通達的。
verses.e: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves . But they themselves , measuring themselves by themselves , and comparing themselves with themselves , are without understanding .

verses.z: 我們不願意分外誇口，只要照上帝所量給我們的界限搆到你們那裏。
verses.e: But we will not boast beyond proper limits , but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us , which reach even to you .

verses.z: 我們並非過了自己的界限，好像搆不到你們那裏；因為我們早到你們那裏，傳了基督的福音。
verses.e: For we don't stretch ourselves too much , as though we didn't reach to you . For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ ,

verses.z: 我們不仗着別人所勞碌的，分外誇口；但指望你們信心增長的時候，所量給我們的界限，就可以因着你們更加開展，
verses.e: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men's labors , but having hope that as your faith grows , we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence ,

verses.z: 得以將福音傳到你們以外的地方；並不是在別人界限之內，藉着他現成的事誇口。
verses.e: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you , not to boast in what someone else has already done .

verses.z: 但誇口的，當指着主誇口。
verses.e: But " he who boasts , let him boast in the Lord . "

verses.z: 因為蒙悅納的，不是自己稱許的，乃是主所稱許的。
verses.e: For it isn't he who commends himself who is approved , but whom the Lord commends .

verses.z: 有人以為我是憑着血氣行事，我也以為必須用勇敢待這等人；求你們不要叫我在你們那裏的時候，有這樣的勇敢。
verses.e: Yes , I beg you that I may not , when present , show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some , who consider us to be walking according to the flesh .

verses.z: 因為我們雖然在血氣中行事，卻不憑着血氣爭戰。
verses.e: For though we walk in the flesh , we don't wage war according to the flesh ;

verses.z: 我們爭戰的兵器本不是屬血氣的，乃是在上帝面前有能力，可以攻破堅固的營壘，
verses.e: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh , but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds ,

verses.z: 將各樣的計謀，各樣攔阻人認識上帝的那些自高之事，一概攻破了，又將人所有的心意奪回，使他都順服基督。
verses.e: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ ,

verses.z: 並且我已經預備好了，等你們十分順服的時候，要責罰那一切不順服的人。
verses.e: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full .

verses.z: 你們是看眼前的嗎？倘若有人自信是屬基督的，他要再想想，他如何屬基督，我們也是如何屬基督的。
verses.e: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face ? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ's , let him consider this again with himself , that even as he is Christ's , so we also are Christ's .

verses.z: 主賜給我們權柄，是要造就你們，並不是要敗壞你們；我就是為這權柄稍微誇口，也不至於慚愧。
verses.e: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority , which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down , I will not be ashamed ,

verses.z: 我[說這話]，免得你們以為我寫信是要威嚇你們；
verses.e: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters .

verses.z: 但願你們寬容我這一點愚妄，其實你們原是寬容我的。
verses.e: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness , but indeed you do bear with me .

verses.z: 既有基督的誠實在我裏面，就無人能在亞該亞一帶地方阻擋我這自誇。
verses.e: As the truth of Christ is in me , no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia .

verses.z: 為甚麼呢？是因我不愛你們嗎？這有上帝知道。
verses.e: Why ? Because I don't love you ? God knows .

verses.z: 我現在所做的，後來還要做，為要斷絕那些尋機會人的機會，使他們在所誇的事上也不過與我們一樣。
verses.e: But what I do , that I will continue to do , that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity , that in which they boast , they may be recognized just like us .

verses.z: 那等人是假使徒，行事詭詐，裝作基督使徒的模樣。
verses.e: For such men are false apostles , deceitful workers , masquerading as Christ's apostles .

verses.z: 這也不足為怪，因為連撒但也裝作光明的天使。
verses.e: And no wonder , for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light .

verses.z: 所以他的差役，若裝作仁義的差役，也不算希奇。他們的結局必然照着他們的行為。
verses.e: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness , whose end will be according to their works .

verses.z: 我再說，人不可把我看作愚妄的。縱然如此，也要把我當作愚妄人接納，叫我可以略略自誇。
verses.e: I say again , let no one think me foolish . But if so , yet receive me as foolish , that I also may boast a little .

verses.z: 我說的話不是奉主命說的，乃是像愚妄人放膽自誇；
verses.e: That which I speak , I don't speak according to the Lord , but as in foolishness , in this confidence of boasting .

verses.z: 既有好些人憑着血氣自誇，我也要自誇了。
verses.e: Seeing that many boast after the flesh , I will also boast .

verses.z: 你們既是精明人，就能甘心忍耐愚妄人。
verses.e: For you bear with the foolish gladly , being wise .

verses.z: 我為你們起的憤恨，原是上帝那樣的憤恨。因為我曾把你們許配一個丈夫，要把你們如同貞潔的童女，獻給基督。
verses.e: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy . For I promised you in marriage to one husband , that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ .

verses.z: 假若有人強你們作奴僕，或侵吞你們，或擄掠你們，或侮慢你們，或打你們的臉，你們都能忍耐他。
verses.e: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage , if he devours you , if he takes you captive , if he exalts himself , or if he strikes you on the face .

verses.z: 我說這話是羞辱自己，好像我們從前是軟弱的。然而，人在何事上勇敢，（我說句愚妄話，）我也勇敢。
verses.e: To my shame , I speak as though we had been weak . Yet in whatever way anyone is bold ( I speak in foolishness ) , I am bold also .

verses.z: 他們是希伯來人嗎？我也是。他們是以色列人嗎？我也是。他們是亞伯拉罕的後裔嗎？我也是。
verses.e: Are they Hebrews ? So am I . Are they Israelites ? So am I . Are they the offspring of Abraham ? So am I .

verses.z: 他們是基督的僕人嗎？（我說句狂話，）我更是。我比他們多受勞苦，多下監牢，受鞭打是過重的，冒死是屢次有的。
verses.e: Are they servants of Christ ? ( I speak as one beside himself . ) I am more so : in labors more abundantly , in prisons more abundantly , in stripes above measure , and in deaths often .

verses.z: 被猶太人鞭打五次，每次四十減去一下；
verses.e: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews .

verses.z: 被棍打了三次；被石頭打了一次；遇着船壞三次，一晝一夜在深海裏。
verses.e: Three times I was beaten with rods . Once I was stoned . Three times I suffered shipwreck . I have been a night and a day in the deep .

verses.z: 又屢次行遠路，遭江河的危險、盜賊的危險、同族的危險、外邦人的危險、城裏的危險、曠野的危險、海中的危險、假弟兄的危險。
verses.e: I have been in travels often , perils of rivers , perils of robbers , perils from my countrymen , perils from the Gentiles , perils in the city , perils in the wilderness , perils in the sea , perils among false brothers ;

verses.z: 受勞碌、受困苦，多次不得睡，又飢又渴，多次不得食，受寒冷，赤身露體。
verses.e: in labor and travail , in watchings often , in hunger and thirst , in fastings often , and in cold and nakedness .

verses.z: 除了這外面的事，還有為眾教會掛心的事，天天壓在我身上。
verses.e: Besides those things that are outside , there is that which presses on me daily : anxiety for all the assemblies .

verses.z: 有誰軟弱，我不軟弱呢？有誰跌倒，我不焦急呢？
verses.e: Who is weak , and I am not weak ? Who is caused to stumble , and I don't burn with indignation ?

verses.z: 我只怕你們的心或偏於邪，失去那向基督所存純一清潔的心，就像蛇用詭詐誘惑了夏娃一樣。
verses.e: But I am afraid that somehow , as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness , so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ .

verses.z: 我若必須自誇，就誇那關乎我軟弱的事便了。
verses.e: If I must boast , I will boast of the things that concern my weakness .

verses.z: 那永遠可稱頌之主耶穌的父上帝知道我不說謊。
verses.e: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ , he who is blessed forever more , knows that I don't lie .

verses.z: 在大馬士革的亞哩達王手下的提督把守大馬士革城，要捉拿我，
verses.e: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes ' city , desiring to arrest me .

verses.z: 我就從窗戶中，在筐子裏，從城牆上被人縋下去，脫離了他的手。
verses.e: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall , and escaped his hands .

verses.z: 假如有人來另傳一個耶穌，不是我們所傳過的；或者你們另受一個靈，不是你們所受過的；或者另得一個福音，不是你們所得過的；你們容讓他也就罷了。
verses.e: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn't preach , or if you receive a different spirit which you didn't receive , or a different " good news " which you didn't accept , you put up with that well enough .

verses.z: 但我想，我一點不在那些最大的使徒以下。
verses.e: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles .

verses.z: 我的言語雖然粗俗，我的知識卻不粗俗。這是我們在凡事上向你們眾人顯明出來的。
verses.e: But though I am unskilled in speech , yet I am not unskilled in knowledge . No , in every way we have been revealed to you in all things .

verses.z: 我因為白白傳上帝的福音給你們，就自居卑微，叫你們高升，這算是我犯罪嗎？
verses.e: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted , because I preached to you God's Good News free of charge ?

verses.z: 我虧負了別的教會，向他們取了工價來給你們效力。
verses.e: I robbed other assemblies , taking wages from them that I might serve you .

verses.z: 我在你們那裏缺乏的時候，並沒有累着你們一個人；因我所缺乏的，那從馬其頓來的弟兄們都補足了。我向來凡事謹守，後來也必謹守，總不至於累着你們。
verses.e: When I was present with you and was in need , I wasn't a burden on anyone , for the brothers , when they came from Macedonia , supplied the measure of my need . In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you , and I will continue to do so .

verses.z: 我自誇固然無益，但我是不得已的。如今我要說到主的顯現和啟示。
verses.e: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast , but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord .

verses.z: 我為基督的緣故，就以軟弱、凌辱、急難、逼迫、困苦為可喜樂的；因我甚麼時候軟弱，甚麼時候就剛強了。
verses.e: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses , in injuries , in necessities , in persecutions , and in distresses , for Christ's sake . For when I am weak , then am I strong .

verses.z: 我成了愚妄人，是被你們強逼的。我本該被你們稱許才是。我雖算不了甚麼，卻沒有一件事在那些最大的使徒以下。
verses.e: I have become foolish in boasting . You compelled me , for I ought to have been commended by you , for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles , though I am nothing .

verses.z: 我在你們中間，用百般的忍耐，藉着神蹟、奇事、異能顯出使徒的憑據來。
verses.e: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance , in signs and wonders and mighty works .

verses.z: 除了我不累着你們這一件事，你們還有甚麼事不及別的教會呢？這不公之處，求你們饒恕我吧。
verses.e: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies , unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you ? Forgive me this wrong !

verses.z: 如今，我打算第三次到你們那裏去，也必不累着你們；因我所求的是你們，不是你們的[財物]。兒女不該為父母積財，父母該為兒女積財。
verses.e: Behold , this is the third time I am ready to come to you , and I will not be a burden to you ; for I seek not your possessions , but you . For the children ought not to save up for the parents , but the parents for the children .

verses.z: 我也甘心樂意為你們的靈魂費財費力。難道我越發愛你們，就越發少得你們的愛嗎？
verses.e: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls . If I love you more abundantly , am I loved the less ?

verses.z: 罷了，我自己並沒有累着你們，[你們卻有人說]，我是詭詐，用心計牢籠你們。
verses.e: Even so , I myself didn't burden you . But you might say that being crafty , I caught you with deception .

verses.z: 我所差到你們那裏去的人，我藉着他們一個人佔過你們的便宜嗎？
verses.e: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you ?

verses.z: 我勸了提多[到你們那裏去]，又差那位兄弟與他同去。提多佔過你們的便宜嗎？我們行事，不同是一個心靈嗎？不同是一個腳蹤嗎？
verses.e: I exhorted Titus , and I sent the brother with him . Did Titus take any advantage of you ? Didn't we walk in the same spirit ? Didn't we walk in the same steps ?

verses.z: 你們到如今，還想我們是向你們分訴；我們本是在基督裏當上帝面前說話。親愛的[弟兄]啊，一切的事都是為造就你們。
verses.e: Again , do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you ? In the sight of God we speak in Christ . But all things , beloved , are for your edifying .

verses.z: 我認得一個在基督裏的人，他前十四年被提到第三層天上去；（或在身內，我不知道；或在身外，我也不知道；只有上帝知道。）
verses.e: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago — whether in the body , I don't know , or whether out of the body , I don't know ; God knows .

verses.z: 我怕我再來的時候，見你們不合我所想望的，你們見我也不合你們所想望的；又怕有紛爭、嫉妒、惱怒、結黨、毀謗、讒言、狂傲、混亂的事。
verses.e: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come , I might find you not the way I want to , and that I might be found by you as you don't desire , that perhaps there would be strife , jealousy , outbursts of anger , factions , slander , whisperings , proud thoughts , or riots ,

verses.z: 且怕我來的時候，我的上帝叫我在你們面前慚愧，又因許多人從前犯罪，行污穢、姦淫、邪蕩的事不肯悔改，我就憂愁。
verses.e: that again when I come my God would humble me before you , and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now , and not repented of the uncleanness , sexual immorality , and lustfulness which they committed .

verses.z: 我認得這人；（或在身內，或在身外，我都不知道，只有上帝知道。）
verses.e: I know such a man ( whether in the body , or outside of the body , I don't know ; God knows ) ,

verses.z: 他被提到樂園裏，聽見隱祕的言語，是人不可說的。
verses.e: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words , which it is not lawful for a man to utter .

verses.z: 為這人，我要誇口；但是為我自己，除了[我的]軟弱以外，我並不誇口。
verses.e: On behalf of such a one I will boast , but on my own behalf I will not boast , except in my weaknesses .

verses.z: 我就是願意誇口也不算狂，因為我必說實話；只是我禁止不說，恐怕有人把我看高了，過於他在我身上所看見、所聽見的。
verses.e: For if I would desire to boast , I will not be foolish ; for I will speak the truth . But I refrain , so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me .

verses.z: 又恐怕我因所得的啟示甚大，就過於自高，所以有一根刺加在我肉體上，就是撒但的差役要攻擊我，免得我過於自高。
verses.e: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations , that I should not be exalted excessively , a thorn in the flesh was given to me : a messenger of Satan to torment me , that I should not be exalted excessively .

verses.z: 為這事，我三次求過主，叫這刺離開我。
verses.e: Concerning this thing , I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me .

verses.z: 他對我說：「我的恩典夠你用的，因為我的能力是在人的軟弱上顯得完全。」所以，我更喜歡誇自己的軟弱，好叫基督的能力覆庇我。
verses.e: He has said to me , " My grace is sufficient for you , for my power is made perfect in weakness . " Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses , that the power of Christ may rest on me .

verses.z: 這是我第三次要到你們那裏去。「憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都要定準。」
verses.e: This is the third time I am coming to you . " At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established . "

verses.z: 所以，我不在你們那裏的時候，把這話寫給你們，好叫我見你們的時候，不用照主所給我的權柄嚴厲地待你們。這權柄原是為造就人，並不是為敗壞人。
verses.e: For this cause I write these things while absent , that I may not deal sharply when present , according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down .

verses.z: 還有末了的話：願弟兄們都喜樂。要作完全人；要受安慰；要同心合意；要彼此和睦。如此，仁愛和平的上帝必常與你們同在。
verses.e: Finally , brothers , rejoice ! Be perfected . Be comforted . Be of the same mind . Live in peace , and the God of love and peace will be with you .

verses.z: 你們親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。
verses.e: Greet one another with a holy kiss .

verses.z: 眾聖徒都問你們安。
verses.e: All the saints greet you .

verses.z: 願主耶穌基督的恩惠、上帝的慈愛、聖靈的感動[常]與你們眾人同在！
verses.e: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ , God's love , and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all . Amen .

verses.z: 我從前說過，如今不在你們那裏又說，正如我第二次見你們的時候所說的一樣，就是對那犯了罪的和其餘的人說：「我若再來，必不寬容。」
verses.e: I have warned previously , and I warn again , as when I was present the second time , so now , being absent , I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again , I will not spare ,

verses.z: 你們既然尋求基督在我裏面說話的憑據，[我必不寬容]。因為，基督在你們身上不是軟弱的，在你們裏面是有大能的。
verses.e: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak , but is powerful in you .

verses.z: 他因軟弱被釘在十字架上，卻因上帝的大能仍然活着。我們也是這樣同他軟弱，但因上帝向你們所顯的大能，也必與他同活。
verses.e: For he was crucified through weakness , yet he lives through the power of God . For we also are weak in him , but we will live with him through the power of God toward you .

verses.z: 你們總要自己省察有信心沒有，也要自己試驗。豈不知你們若不是可棄絕的，就有耶穌基督在你們心裏嗎？
verses.e: Examine your own selves , whether you are in the faith . Test your own selves . Or don't you know about your own selves , that Jesus Christ is in you ? — unless indeed you are disqualified .

verses.z: 我卻盼望你們曉得，我們不是可棄絕的人。
verses.e: But I hope that you will know that we aren't disqualified .

verses.z: 我們求上帝，叫你們一件惡事都不做；這不是要顯明我們是蒙悅納的，是要你們行事端正，任憑人看我們是被棄絕的吧！
verses.e: Now I pray to God that you do no evil ; not that we may appear approved , but that you may do that which is honorable , though we may seem to have failed .

verses.z: 我們凡事不能敵擋真理，只能扶助真理。
verses.e: For we can do nothing against the truth , but for the truth .

verses.z: 即便我們軟弱，你們剛強，我們也歡喜；並且我們所求的，就是你們作完全人。
verses.e: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong . We also pray for this : your becoming perfect .

verses.z: 我自己定了主意再到你們那裏去，必須大家沒有憂愁。
verses.e: But I determined this for myself , that I would not come to you again in sorrow .

verses.z: 你們赦免誰，我也赦免誰。我若有所赦免的，是在基督面前為你們赦免的，
verses.e: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything . For if indeed I have forgiven anything , I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ ,

verses.z: 免得撒但趁着機會勝過我們，因我們並非不曉得他的詭計。
verses.e: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan , for we are not ignorant of his schemes .

verses.z: 我從前為基督的福音到了特羅亞，主也給我開了門。
verses.e: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ , and when a door was opened to me in the Lord ,

verses.z: 那時，因為沒有遇見兄弟提多，我心裏不安，便辭別那裏的人往馬其頓去了。
verses.e: I had no relief for my spirit , because I didn't find Titus my brother , but taking my leave of them , I went out into Macedonia .

verses.z: 感謝上帝！常率領我們在基督裏誇勝，並藉着我們在各處顯揚那因認識基督而有的香氣。
verses.e: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ , and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place .

verses.z: 因為我們在上帝面前，無論在得救的人身上或滅亡的人身上，都有基督馨香之氣。
verses.e: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are saved and in those who perish :

verses.z: 在這等人，就作了死的香氣叫他死；在那等人，就作了活的香氣叫他活。這事誰能當得起呢？
verses.e: to the one a stench from death to death , to the other a sweet aroma from life to life . Who is sufficient for these things ?

verses.z: 我們不像那許多人，為利混亂上帝的道；乃是由於誠實，由於上帝，在上帝面前憑着基督講道。
verses.e: For we are not as so many , peddling the word of God . But as of sincerity , but as of God , in the sight of God , we speak in Christ .

verses.z: 倘若我叫你們憂愁，除了我叫那憂愁的人以外，誰能叫我快樂呢？
verses.e: For if I make you grieve , then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me ?

verses.z: 我曾把這事寫給你們，恐怕我到的時候，應該叫我快樂的那些人，反倒叫我憂愁。我也深信，你們眾人都以我的快樂為自己的快樂。
verses.e: And I wrote this very thing to you , so that when I came , I wouldn't have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice ; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you .

verses.z: 我先前心裏難過痛苦，多多地流淚，寫信給你們，不是叫你們憂愁，乃是叫你們知道我格外地疼愛你們。
verses.e: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears , not that you should be made to grieve , but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you .

verses.z: 若有叫人憂愁的，他不但叫我憂愁，也是叫你們眾人有幾分憂愁。我說幾分，恐怕說得太重。
verses.e: But if any has caused sorrow , he has caused sorrow not to me , but in part ( that I not press too heavily ) to you all .

verses.z: 這樣的人受了眾人的責罰也就夠了，
verses.e: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one ;

verses.z: 倒不如赦免他，安慰他，免得他憂愁太過，甚至沉淪了。
verses.e: so that , on the contrary , you should rather forgive him and comfort him , lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow .

verses.z: 所以我勸你們，要向他顯出堅定不移的愛心來。
verses.e: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him .

verses.z: 為此我先前也寫信給你們，要試驗你們，看你們凡事順從不順從。
verses.e: For to this end I also wrote , that I might know the proof of you , whether you are obedient in all things .

verses.z: 我們豈是又舉薦自己嗎？豈像別人用人的薦信給你們或用你們的薦信給人嗎？
verses.e: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves ? Or do we need , as do some , letters of commendation to you or from you ?

verses.z: 那從前有榮光的，因這極大的榮光就算不得有榮光了；
verses.e: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect , by reason of the glory that surpasses .

verses.z: 若那廢掉的有榮光，這長存的就更有榮光了。
verses.e: For if that which passes away was with glory , much more that which remains is in glory .

verses.z: 我們既有這樣的盼望，就大膽講說，
verses.e: Having therefore such a hope , we use great boldness of speech ,

verses.z: 不像摩西將帕子蒙在臉上，叫以色列人不能定睛看到那將廢者[的]結局。
verses.e: and not as Moses , who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn't look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away .

verses.z: 但他們的心地剛硬，直到今日誦讀舊約的時候，這帕子還沒有揭去。這帕子在基督裏已經廢去了。
verses.e: But their minds were hardened , for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains , because in Christ it passes away .

verses.z: 然而直到今日，每逢誦讀摩西[書]的時候，帕子還在他們心上。
verses.e: But to this day , when Moses is read , a veil lies on their heart .

verses.z: 但他們的心幾時歸向主，帕子就幾時除去了。
verses.e: But whenever someone turns to the Lord , the veil is taken away .

verses.z: 主就是那靈；主的靈在哪裏，那裏就得以自由。
verses.e: Now the Lord is the Spirit ; and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty .

verses.z: 我們眾人既然敞着臉得以看見主的榮光，好像從鏡子裏返照，就變成主的形狀，榮上加榮，如同從主的靈變成的。
verses.e: But we all , with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror , are transformed into the same image from glory to glory , even as from the Lord , the Spirit .

verses.z: 你們就是我們的薦信，寫在我們的心裏，被眾人所知道所念誦的。
verses.e: You are our letter , written in our hearts , known and read by all men ,

verses.z: 你們明顯是基督的信，藉着我們修成的。不是用墨寫的，乃是用永生上帝的靈寫的；不是寫在石版上，乃是寫在心版上。
verses.e: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ , served by us , written not with ink , but with the Spirit of the living God ; not in tablets of stone , but in tablets that are hearts of flesh .

verses.z: 我們因基督，所以在上帝面前才有這樣的信心。
verses.e: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God ,

verses.z: 並不是我們憑自己能承擔甚麼事；我們所能承擔的，乃是出於上帝。
verses.e: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves ; but our sufficiency is from God ,

verses.z: 他叫我們能承當這新約的執事，不是憑着字句，乃是憑着精意；因為那字句是叫人死，精意是叫人活。
verses.e: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant , not of the letter but of the Spirit . For the letter kills , but the Spirit gives life .

verses.z: 那用字刻在石頭上屬死的職事尚且有榮光，甚至以色列人因摩西面上的榮光，不能定睛看他的臉；這榮光原是漸漸退去的，
verses.e: But if the service of death , written engraved on stones , came with glory , so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face , which was passing away ,

verses.z: 何況那屬靈的職事豈不更有榮光嗎？
verses.e: won't service of the Spirit be with much more glory ?

verses.z: 若是定罪的職事有榮光，那稱義的職事榮光就越發大了。
verses.e: For if the service of condemnation has glory , the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory .

verses.z: 我們既然蒙憐憫，受了這職分，就不喪膽，
verses.e: Therefore , seeing we have this ministry , even as we obtained mercy , we don't faint .

verses.z: 身上常帶着耶穌的死，使耶穌的生也顯明在我們身上。
verses.e: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus , that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body .

verses.z: 因為我們這活着的人是常為耶穌被交於死地，使耶穌的生在我們這必死的身上顯明出來。
verses.e: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus ' sake , that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh .

verses.z: 這樣看來，死是在我們身上發動，生卻在你們身上發動。
verses.e: So then death works in us , but life in you .

verses.z: 但我們既有信心，正如[經上]記着說：「我因信，所以如此說話。」我們也信，所以也說話。
verses.e: But having the same spirit of faith , according to that which is written , " I believed , and therefore I spoke . " We also believe , and therefore we also speak ,

verses.z: 自己知道那叫主耶穌復活的，也必叫我們與耶穌一同復活，並且叫我們與你們一同站在他面前。
verses.e: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus , and will present us with you .

verses.z: 凡事都是為你們，好叫恩惠因人多越發加增，感謝格外顯多，以致榮耀歸與上帝。
verses.e: For all things are for your sakes , that the grace , being multiplied through the many , may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God .

verses.z: 所以，我們不喪膽。外體雖然毀壞，內心卻一天新似一天。
verses.e: Therefore we don't faint , but though our outward person is decaying , yet our inward person is renewed day by day .

verses.z: 我們這至暫至輕的苦楚，要為我們成就極重無比、永遠的榮耀。
verses.e: For our light affliction , which is for the moment , works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory ,

verses.z: 原來我們不是顧念所見的，乃是顧念所不見的；因為所見的是暫時的，所不見的是永遠的。
verses.e: while we don't look at the things which are seen , but at the things which are not seen . For the things which are seen are temporal , but the things which are not seen are eternal .

verses.z: 乃將那些暗昧可恥的事棄絕了；不行詭詐，不謬講上帝的道理，只將真理表明出來，好在上帝面前把自己薦與各人的良心。
verses.e: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame , not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully , but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God .

verses.z: 如果我們的福音蒙蔽，就是蒙蔽在滅亡的人身上。
verses.e: Even if our Good News is veiled , it is veiled in those who are dying ,

verses.z: 此等不信之人被這世界的神弄瞎了心眼，不叫基督榮耀福音的光照着他們。基督本是上帝的像。
verses.e: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving , that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ , who is the image of God , should not dawn on them .

verses.z: 我們原不是傳自己，乃是傳基督耶穌為主，並且自己因耶穌作你們的僕人。
verses.e: For we don't preach ourselves , but Christ Jesus as Lord , and ourselves as your servants for Jesus ' sake ,

verses.z: 那吩咐光從黑暗裏照出來的上帝，已經照在我們心裏，叫我們得知上帝榮耀的光顯在耶穌基督的面上。
verses.e: seeing it is God who said , " Light will shine out of darkness , " who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 我們有這寶貝放在瓦器裏，要顯明這莫大的能力是出於上帝，不是出於我們。
verses.e: But we have this treasure in clay vessels , that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves .

verses.z: 我們四面受敵，卻不被困住；心裏作難，卻不致失望；
verses.e: We are pressed on every side , yet not crushed ; perplexed , yet not to despair ;

verses.z: 遭逼迫，卻不被丟棄；打倒了，卻不致死亡。
verses.e: pursued , yet not forsaken ; struck down , yet not destroyed ;

verses.z: 我們原知道，我們這地上的帳棚若拆毀了，必得上帝所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。
verses.e: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved , we have a building from God , a house not made with hands , eternal , in the heavens .

verses.z: 因為我們眾人必要在基督臺前顯露出來，叫各人按着本身所行的，或善或惡受報。
