verses.e: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done , whether good or bad .

verses.z: 我們既知道主是可畏的，所以勸人。但我們在上帝面前是顯明的，盼望在你們的良心裏也是顯明的。
verses.e: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord , we persuade men , but we are revealed to God , and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences .

verses.z: 我們不是向你們再舉薦自己，乃是叫你們因我們有可誇之處，好對那憑外貌不憑內心誇口的人，有言可答。
verses.e: For we are not commending ourselves to you again , but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf , that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart .

verses.z: 我們若果顛狂，是為上帝；若果謹守，是為你們。
verses.e: For if we are beside ourselves , it is for God . Or if we are of sober mind , it is for you .

verses.z: 原來基督的愛激勵我們；因我們想，一人既替眾人死，眾人就都死了；
verses.e: For the love of Christ compels us ; because we judge thus : that one died for all , therefore all died .

verses.z: 並且他替眾人死，是叫那些活着的人不再為自己活，乃為替他們死而復活的[主]活。
verses.e: He died for all , that those who live should no longer live to themselves , but to him who for their sakes died and rose again .

verses.z: 所以，我們從今以後，不憑着外貌認人了。雖然憑着外貌認過基督，如今卻不再[這樣]認他了。
verses.e: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on . Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh , yet now we know him so no more .

verses.z: 若有人在基督裏，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。
verses.e: Therefore if anyone is in Christ , he is a new creation . The old things have passed away . Behold , all things have become new .

verses.z: 一切都是出於上帝；他藉着基督使我們與他和好，又將勸人與他和好的職分賜給我們。
verses.e: But all things are of God , who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ , and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation ;

verses.z: 這就是上帝在基督裏，叫世人與自己和好，不將他們的過犯歸到他們身上，並且將這和好的道理託付了我們。
verses.e: namely , that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself , not reckoning to them their trespasses , and having committed to us the word of reconciliation .

verses.z: 我們在這帳棚裏歎息，深想得那從天上來的房屋，好像穿上[衣服]；
verses.e: For most certainly in this we groan , longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven ,

verses.z: 所以，我們作基督的使者，就好像上帝藉我們勸你們一般。我們替基督求你們與上帝和好。
verses.e: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ , as though God were entreating by us : we beg you on behalf of Christ , be reconciled to God .

verses.z: 上帝使那無罪的，替我們成為罪，好叫我們在他裏面成為上帝的義。
verses.e: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf , so that in him we might become the righteousness of God .

verses.z: 倘若穿上，被遇見的時候就不至於赤身了。
verses.e: if indeed being clothed , we will not be found naked .

verses.z: 我們在這帳棚裏歎息勞苦，並非願意脫下這個，乃是願意穿上那個，好叫這必死的被生命吞滅了。
verses.e: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan , being burdened , not that we desire to be unclothed , but that we desire to be clothed , that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life .

verses.z: 為此，培植我們的就是上帝，他又賜給我們[聖]靈作憑據。
verses.e: Now he who made us for this very thing is God , who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit .

verses.z: 所以，我們時常坦然無懼，並且曉得我們住在身內，便與主相離。
verses.e: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body , we are absent from the Lord ;

verses.z: 因我們行事為人是憑着信心，不是憑着眼見。
verses.e: for we walk by faith , not by sight .

verses.z: 我們坦然無懼，是更願意離開身體與主同住。
verses.e: We are courageous , I say , and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord .

verses.z: 所以，無論是住在身內，離開身外，我們立了志向，要得主的喜悅。
verses.e: Therefore also we make it our aim , whether at home or absent , to be well pleasing to him .

verses.z: 我們與[上帝]同工的，也勸你們不可徒受他的恩典。
verses.e: Working together , we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain .

verses.z: 似乎憂愁，卻是常常快樂的；似乎貧窮，卻是叫許多人富足的；似乎一無所有，卻是樣樣都有的。
verses.e: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing , as poor yet making many rich , as having nothing and yet possessing all things .

verses.z: 哥林多人哪，我們向你們，口是張開的，心是寬宏的。
verses.e: Our mouth is open to you , Corinthians . Our heart is enlarged .

verses.z: 你們狹窄，原不在乎我們，是在乎自己的心腸狹窄。
verses.e: You are not restricted by us , but you are restricted by your own affections .

verses.z: 你們也要照樣用寬宏的心報答我。我這話正像對自己的孩子說的。
verses.e: Now in return — I speak as to my children — you also open your hearts .

verses.z: 你們和不信的原不相配，不要同負一軛。義和不義有甚麼相交呢？光明和黑暗有甚麼相通呢？
verses.e: Don't be unequally yoked with unbelievers , for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have ? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness ?

verses.z: 基督和彼列有甚麼相和呢？信[主]的和不信[主]的有甚麼相干呢？
verses.e: What agreement does Christ have with Belial ? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever ?

verses.z: 上帝的殿和偶像有甚麼相同呢？因為我們是永生上帝的殿，就如上帝曾說：我要在他們中間居住，在他們中間來往；我要作他們的上帝；他們要作我的子民。
verses.e: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols ? For you are a temple of the living God . Even as God said , " I will dwell in them and walk in them . I will be their God and they will be my people . "

verses.z: 又說：你們務要從他們中間出來，與他們分別；不要沾不潔淨的物，我就收納你們。
verses.e: Therefore " ' Come out from among them , and be separate , ' says the Lord . ' Touch no unclean thing . I will receive you .

verses.z: 我要作你們的父；你們要作我的兒女。這是全能的主說的。
verses.e: I will be to you a Father . You will be to me sons and daughters , ' says the Lord Almighty . "

verses.z: 因為他說：「在悅納的時候，我應允了你；在拯救的日子，我搭救了你。」看哪，現在正是悅納的時候！現在正是拯救的日子；
verses.e: For he says , " At an acceptable time I listened to you . In a day of salvation I helped you . " Behold , now is the acceptable time . Behold , now is the day of salvation .

verses.z: 我們凡事都不叫人有妨礙，免得這職分被人毀謗；
verses.e: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything , that our service may not be blamed ,

verses.z: 反倒在各樣的事上表明自己是上帝的用人，就如在許多的忍耐、患難、窮乏、困苦、
verses.e: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God : in great endurance , in afflictions , in hardships , in distresses ,

verses.z: 鞭打、監禁、擾亂、勤勞、警醒、不食、
verses.e: in beatings , in imprisonments , in riots , in labors , in watchings , in fastings ,

verses.z: 廉潔、知識、恆忍、恩慈、聖靈的感化、無偽的愛心、
verses.e: in pureness , in knowledge , in perseverance , in kindness , in the Holy Spirit , in sincere love ,

verses.z: 真實的道理、上帝的大能；仁義的兵器在左在右；
verses.e: in the word of truth , in the power of God , by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left ,

verses.z: 榮耀、羞辱，惡名、美名；似乎是誘惑人的，卻是誠實的；
verses.e: by glory and dishonor , by evil report and good report , as deceivers and yet true ,

verses.z: 似乎不為人所知，卻是人所共知的；似乎要死，卻是活着的；似乎受責罰，卻是不致喪命的；
verses.e: as unknown and yet well known , as dying and behold — we live , as punished and not killed ,

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們既有這等應許，就當潔淨自己，除去身體、靈魂一切的污穢，敬畏上帝，得以成聖。
verses.e: Having therefore these promises , beloved , let's cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit , perfecting holiness in the fear of God .

verses.z: 因為依着上帝的意思憂愁，就生出沒有後悔的懊悔來，以致得救；但世俗的憂愁是叫人死。
verses.e: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation , which brings no regret . But the sorrow of the world produces death .

verses.z: 你看，你們依着上帝的意思憂愁，從此就生出何等的殷勤、自訴、自恨、恐懼、想念、熱心、責罰。在這一切事上，你們都表明自己是潔淨的。
verses.e: For behold , this same thing , that you were grieved in a godly way , what earnest care it worked in you . Yes , what defense , indignation , fear , longing , zeal , and vindication ! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter .

verses.z: 我雖然從前寫信給你們，卻不是為那虧負人的，也不是為那受人虧負的，乃要在上帝面前把你們顧念我們的熱心表明出來。
verses.e: So although I wrote to you , I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong , nor for his cause that suffered the wrong , but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God .

verses.z: 故此，我們得了安慰。並且在安慰之中，因你們眾人使提多心裏暢快歡喜，我們就更加歡喜了。
verses.e: Therefore we have been comforted . In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus , because his spirit has been refreshed by you all .

verses.z: 我若對提多誇獎了你們甚麼，也覺得沒有慚愧；因我對提多誇獎你們的話成了真的，正如我對你們所說的話也都是真的。
verses.e: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf , I was not disappointed . But as we spoke all things to you in truth , so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth .

verses.z: 並且提多想起你們眾人的順服，是怎樣恐懼戰兢地接待他，他愛你們的心腸就越發熱了。
verses.e: His affection is more abundantly toward you , while he remembers all of your obedience , how with fear and trembling you received him .

verses.z: 我如今歡喜，能在凡事上為你們放心。
verses.e: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you .

verses.z: 你們要心地寬大收納我們。我們未曾虧負誰，未曾敗壞誰，未曾佔誰的便宜。
verses.e: Open your hearts to us . We wronged no one . We corrupted no one . We took advantage of no one .

verses.z: 我說這話，不是要定你們的罪。我已經說過，你們常在我們心裏，情願與你們同生同死。
verses.e: I say this not to condemn you , for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together .

verses.z: 我大大地放膽，向你們說話；我因你們多多誇口，滿得安慰；我們在一切患難中分外地快樂。
verses.e: Great is my boldness of speech toward you . Great is my boasting on your behalf . I am filled with comfort . I overflow with joy in all our affliction .

verses.z: 我們從前就是到了馬其頓的時候，身體也不得安寧，周圍遭患難，外有爭戰，內有懼怕。
verses.e: For even when we had come into Macedonia , our flesh had no relief , but we were afflicted on every side . Fightings were outside . Fear was inside .

verses.z: 但那安慰喪氣之人的上帝藉着提多來安慰了我們；
verses.e: Nevertheless , he who comforts the lowly , God , comforted us by the coming of Titus ,

verses.z: 不但藉着他來，也藉着他從你們所得的安慰，安慰了我們；因他把你們的想念、哀慟，和向我的熱心，都告訴了我，叫我更加歡喜。
verses.e: and not by his coming only , but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing , your mourning , and your zeal for me , so that I rejoiced still more .

verses.z: 我先前寫信叫你們憂愁，我後來雖然懊悔，如今卻不懊悔；因我知道，那信叫你們憂愁不過是暫時的。
verses.e: For though I grieved you with my letter , I do not regret it , though I did regret it . For I see that my letter made you grieve , though just for a while .

verses.z: 如今我歡喜，不是因你們憂愁，是因你們從憂愁中生出懊悔來。你們依着上帝的意思憂愁，凡事就不至於因我們受虧損了。
verses.e: I now rejoice , not that you were grieved , but that you were grieved to repentance . For you were grieved in a godly way , that you might suffer loss by us in nothing .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我把上帝賜給馬其頓眾教會的恩告訴你們，
verses.e: Moreover , brothers , we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia ,

verses.z: 我在這事上把我的意見告訴你們，是與你們有益；因為你們下手辦這事，而且起此心意，已經有一年了，
verses.e: I give advice in this : it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago , not only to do , but also to be willing .

verses.z: 如今就當辦成這事。既有願做的心，也當照你們所有的去辦成。
verses.e: But now complete the doing also , that as there was the readiness to be willing , so there may be the completion also out of your ability .

verses.z: 因為人若有願做的心，必蒙悅納，乃是照他所有的，並不是照他所無的。
verses.e: For if the readiness is there , it is acceptable according to what you have , not according to what you don't have .

verses.z: 我原不是要別人輕省，你們受累，
verses.e: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed ,

verses.z: 乃要均平，就是要你們的富餘，現在[可以補]他們的不足，使他們的富餘，[將來]也可以[補]你們的不足，這就均平了。
verses.e: but for equality . Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack , that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack , that there may be equality .

verses.z: 如[經上]所記：多[收]的也沒有餘；少[收]的也沒有缺。
verses.e: As it is written , " He who gathered much had nothing left over , and he who gathered little had no lack . "

verses.z: 多謝上帝，感動提多的心，叫他待你們殷勤，像我一樣。
verses.e: But thanks be to God , who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus .

verses.z: 他固然是聽了我的勸，但自己更是熱心，情願往你們那裏去。
verses.e: For he indeed accepted our exhortation , but being himself very earnest , he went out to you of his own accord .

verses.z: 我們還打發一位兄弟和他同去，這人在福音上得了眾教會的稱讚。
verses.e: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies .

verses.z: 不但這樣，他也被眾教會挑選，和我們同行，把所託與我們的這捐資送到了，可以榮耀主，又表明我們樂意的心。
verses.e: Not only so , but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace , which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself , and to show our readiness .

verses.z: 就是他們在患難中受大試煉的時候，仍有滿足的快樂，在極窮之間還格外顯出他們樂捐的厚恩。
verses.e: how in a severe ordeal of affliction , the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity .

verses.z: 這就免得有人因我們收的捐銀很多，就挑我們的不是。
verses.e: We are avoiding this , that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us .

verses.z: 我們留心行光明的事，不但在主面前，就在人面前也是這樣。
verses.e: Having regard for honorable things , not only in the sight of the Lord , but also in the sight of men .

verses.z: 我們又打發一位兄弟同去；這人的熱心，我們在許多事上屢次試驗過。現在他因為深信你們，就更加熱心了。
verses.e: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things , but now much more earnest , by reason of the great confidence which he has in you .

verses.z: 論到提多，他是我的同伴，一同為你們勞碌的。論到那兩位兄弟，他們是眾教會的使者，是基督的榮耀。
verses.e: As for Titus , he is my partner and fellow worker for you . As for our brothers , they are the apostles of the assemblies , the glory of Christ .

verses.z: 所以，你們務要在眾教會面前顯明你們愛心的憑據，並我所誇獎你們的憑據。
verses.e: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies , and of our boasting on your behalf .

verses.z: 我可以證明，他們是按着力量，而且也過了力量，自己甘心樂意地捐助，
verses.e: For according to their power , I testify , yes and beyond their power , they gave of their own accord ,

verses.z: 再三地求我們，准他們在這供給聖徒的恩情上有分；
verses.e: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints .

verses.z: 並且他們所做的，不但照我們所想望的，更照上帝的旨意先把自己獻給主，又歸附了我們。
verses.e: This was not as we had expected , but first they gave their own selves to the Lord , and to us through the will of God .

verses.z: 因此我勸提多，既然在你們中間開辦這慈惠的事，就當辦成了。
verses.e: So we urged Titus , that as he had made a beginning before , so he would also complete in you this grace .

verses.z: 你們既然在信心、口才、知識、熱心，和待我們的愛心上，都格外顯出滿足來，就當在這慈惠的事上也格外顯出滿足來。
verses.e: But as you abound in everything — in faith , utterance , knowledge , all earnestness , and in your love to us — see that you also abound in this grace .

verses.z: 我說這話，不是吩咐你們，乃是藉着別人的熱心試驗你們愛心的實在。
verses.e: I speak not by way of commandment , but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love .

verses.z: 你們知道我們主耶穌基督的恩典：他本來富足，卻為你們成了貧窮，叫你們因他的貧窮，可以成為富足。
verses.e: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ , that though he was rich , yet for your sakes he became poor , that you through his poverty might become rich .

verses.z: 論到供給聖徒的事，我不必寫信給你們；
verses.e: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints ,

verses.z: 那賜種給撒種的，賜糧給人吃的，必多多加給你們種地的種子，又增添你們仁義的果子；
verses.e: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food , supply and multiply your seed for sowing , and increase the fruits of your righteousness ,

verses.z: 叫你們凡事富足，可以多多施捨，就藉着我們使感謝歸於上帝。
verses.e: you being enriched in everything for all generosity , which produces thanksgiving to God through us .

verses.z: 因為辦這供給的事，不但補聖徒的缺乏，而且叫許多人越發感謝上帝。
verses.e: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints , but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God ,

verses.z: 他們從這供給的事上得了憑據，知道你們承認基督順服他的福音，多多地捐錢給他們和眾人，便將榮耀歸與上帝。
verses.e: seeing that through the proof given by this service , they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all ,

verses.z: 他們也因上帝極大的恩賜顯在你們心裏，就切切地想念你們，為你們祈禱。
verses.e: while they themselves also , with supplication on your behalf , yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you .

verses.z: 感謝上帝，因他有說不盡的恩賜！
verses.e: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift !

verses.z: 因為我知道你們樂意的心，常對馬其頓人誇獎你們，說亞該亞人預備好了，已經有一年了；並且你們的熱心激動了許多人。
verses.e: for I know your readiness , of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia , that Achaia has been prepared for the past year . Your zeal has stirred up very many of them .

verses.z: 但我打發那幾位弟兄去，要叫你們照我的話預備妥當，免得我們在這事上誇獎你們的話落了空。
verses.e: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect , that , just as I said , you may be prepared ,

verses.z: 萬一有馬其頓人與我同去，見你們沒有預備，就叫我們所確信的，反成了羞愧；你們羞愧，更不用說了。
verses.e: lest by any means , if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared , we ( to say nothing of you ) would be disappointed in this confident boasting .

verses.z: 因此，我想不得不求那幾位弟兄先到你們那裏去，把從前所應許的捐資預備妥當，就顯出你們所捐的是出於樂意，不是出於勉強。
verses.e: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before , that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity , and not of greediness .

verses.z: 「少種的少收，多種的多收」，這話是真的。
verses.e: Remember this : he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly . He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully .

verses.z: 各人要隨本心所酌定的，不要作難，不要勉強，因為捐得樂意的人是上帝所喜愛的。
verses.e: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart , not grudgingly or under compulsion , for God loves a cheerful giver .

verses.z: 上帝能將各樣的恩惠多多地加給你們，使你們凡事常常充足，能多行各樣善事。
verses.e: And God is able to make all grace abound to you , that you , always having all sufficiency in everything , may abound to every good work .

verses.z: 如[經上]所記：他施捨[錢財]，賙濟貧窮；他的仁義存到永遠。
verses.e: As it is written , " He has scattered abroad . He has given to the poor . His righteousness remains forever . "

verses.z: 作長老的寫信給蒙揀選的太太和她的兒女，就是我誠心所愛的；不但我愛，也是一切知道真理之人所愛的。
verses.e: The elder , to the chosen lady and her children , whom I love in truth , and not I only , but also all those who know the truth ,

verses.z: 若有人到你們那裏，不是傳這教訓，不要接他到家裏，也不要問他的安；
verses.e: If anyone comes to you and doesn't bring this teaching , don't receive him into your house , and don't welcome him ,

verses.z: 因為問他安的，就在他的惡行上有分。
verses.e: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds .

verses.z: 我還有許多事要寫給你們，卻不願意用紙墨[寫出來]，但盼望到你們那裏，與你們當面談論，使你們的喜樂滿足。
verses.e: Having many things to write to you , I don't want to do so with paper and ink , but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face , that our joy may be made full .

verses.z: 你那蒙揀選之姊妹的兒女都問你安。
verses.e: The children of your chosen sister greet you . Amen .

verses.z: 愛你們是為真理的緣故，這真理存在我們裏面，也必永遠與我們同在。
verses.e: for the truth's sake , which remains in us , and it will be with us forever :

verses.z: 恩惠、憐憫、平安從父上帝和他兒子耶穌基督在真理和愛心上必常與我們同在！
verses.e: Grace , mercy , and peace will be with us , from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ , the Son of the Father , in truth and love .

verses.z: 我見你的兒女，有照我們從父所受之命令遵行真理的，就甚歡喜。
verses.e: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth , even as we have been commanded by the Father .

verses.z: 太太啊，我現在勸你，我們大家要彼此相愛。這並不是我寫一條新命令給你，乃是我們從起初所受的命令。
verses.e: Now I beg you , dear lady , not as though I wrote to you a new commandment , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .

verses.z: 我們若照他的命令行，這就是愛。你們從起初所聽見當行的，就是這命令。
verses.e: This is love , that we should walk according to his commandments . This is the commandment , even as you heard from the beginning , that you should walk in it .

verses.z: 因為世上有許多迷惑人的出來，他們不認耶穌基督是成了肉身來的；這就是那迷惑人、敵基督的。
verses.e: For many deceivers have gone out into the world , those who don't confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh . This is the deceiver and the Antichrist .

verses.z: 你們要小心，不要失去你們所做的工，乃要得着滿足的賞賜。
verses.e: Watch yourselves , that we don't lose the things which we have accomplished , but that we receive a full reward .

verses.z: 凡越過基督的教訓不常守着的，就沒有上帝；常守這教訓的，就有父又有子。
verses.e: Whoever transgresses and doesn't remain in the teaching of Christ doesn't have God . He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son .

verses.z: 亞哈死後，摩押背叛以色列。
verses.e: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab .

verses.z: 以利亞回答說：「我若是神人，願火從天上降下來，燒滅你和你那五十人！」於是有火從天上降下來，燒滅五十夫長和他那五十人。
verses.e: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty , " If I am a man of God , then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty ! " Then fire came down from the sky , and consumed him and his fifty .

verses.z: 王第二次差遣一個五十夫長，帶領五十人去見以利亞。五十夫長對以利亞說：「神人哪，王吩咐你快快下來！」
verses.e: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty . He answered him , " Man of God , the king has said , ' Come down quickly ! ' "

verses.z: 以利亞回答說：「我若是神人，願火從天上降下來，燒滅你和你那五十人！」於是上帝的火從天上降下來，燒滅五十夫長和他那五十人。
verses.e: Elijah answered them , " If I am a man of God , then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty ! " Then God's fire came down from the sky , and consumed him and his fifty .

verses.z: 王第三次差遣一個五十夫長，帶領五十人去。這五十夫長上去，雙膝跪在以利亞面前，哀求他說：「神人哪，願我的性命和你這五十個僕人的性命在你眼前看為寶貴！
verses.e: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty . The third captain of fifty went up , and came and fell on his knees before Elijah , and begged him , and said to him , " Man of God , please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight .

verses.z: 已經有火從天上降下來，燒滅前兩次來的五十夫長和他們各自帶的五十人；現在願我的性命在你眼前看為寶貴！」
verses.e: Behold , fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties . But now let my life be precious in your sight . "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者對以利亞說：「你同着他下去，不要怕他！」以利亞就起來，同着他下去見王，
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to Elijah , " Go down with him . Don't be afraid of him . " Then he arose and went down with him to the king .

verses.z: 對王說：「耶和華如此說：『你差人去問以革倫神巴力‧西卜，豈因以色列中沒有上帝可以求問嗎？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死！』」
verses.e: He said to him , " The LORD says , ' Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub , the god of Ekron , is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word ? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up , but you will surely die . ' "

verses.z: 亞哈謝果然死了，正如耶和華藉以利亞所說的話。因他沒有兒子，[他兄弟]約蘭接續他作王，正在猶大王約沙法的兒子約蘭第二年。
verses.e: So he died according to the LORD's word which Elijah had spoken . Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , because he had no son .

verses.z: 亞哈謝其餘所行的事都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 亞哈謝在撒馬利亞，一日從樓上的欄杆裏掉下來，就病了；於是差遣使者說：「你們去問以革倫的神巴力‧西卜，我這病能好不能好。」
verses.e: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria , and was sick . So he sent messengers , and said to them , " Go , inquire of Baal Zebub , the god of Ekron , whether I will recover of this sickness . "

verses.z: 但耶和華的使者對提斯比人以利亞說：「你起來，去迎着撒馬利亞王的使者，對他們說：『你們去問以革倫神巴力‧西卜，豈因以色列中沒有上帝嗎？』
verses.e: But the LORD's angel said to Elijah the Tishbite , " Arise , go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria , and tell them , ' Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub , the god of Ekron ?

verses.z: 所以耶和華如此說：『你必不下你所上的床，必定要死！』」以利亞就去了。
verses.e: Now therefore the LORD says , " You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up , but you will surely die . " ' " Then Elijah departed .

verses.z: 使者回來見王，王問他們說：「你們為甚麼回來呢？」
verses.e: The messengers returned to him , and he said to them , " Why is it that you have returned ? "

verses.z: 使者回答說：「有一個人迎着我們來，對我們說：『你們回去見差你們來的王，對他說：耶和華如此說，你差人去問以革倫神巴力‧西卜，豈因以色列中沒有上帝嗎？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死。』」
verses.e: They said to him , " A man came up to meet us , and said to us , ' Go , return to the king who sent you , and tell him , " The LORD says , ' Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub , the god of Ekron ? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up , but you will surely die . ' " ' "

verses.z: 王問他們說：「迎着你們來告訴你們這話的，是怎樣的人？」
verses.e: He said to them , " What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words ? "

verses.z: 回答說：「他身穿毛衣，腰束皮帶。」王說：「這必是提斯比人以利亞。」
verses.e: They answered him , " He was a hairy man , and wearing a leather belt around his waist . " He said , " It's Elijah the Tishbite . "

verses.z: 於是，王差遣五十夫長，帶領五十人去見以利亞，他就上到以利亞那裏；以利亞正坐在山頂上。五十夫長對他說：「神人哪，王吩咐你下來！」
verses.e: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him . He went up to him ; and behold , he was sitting on the top of the hill . He said to him , " Man of God , the king has said , ' Come down ! ' "

verses.z: 亞哈有七十個兒子在撒馬利亞。耶戶寫信送到撒馬利亞，通知耶斯列的首領，就是長老和教養亞哈[眾子]的人，說：
verses.e: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria . Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria , to the rulers of Jezreel , even the elders , and to those who brought up Ahab's sons , saying ,

verses.z: 由此可知，耶和華指着亞哈家所說的話一句沒有落空，因為耶和華藉他僕人以利亞所說的話都成就了。」
verses.e: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of the LORD's word , which the LORD spoke concerning Ahab's house . For the LORD has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah . "

verses.z: 凡亞哈家在耶斯列所剩下的人和他的大臣、密友、祭司，耶戶盡都殺了，沒有留下一個。
verses.e: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab's house in Jezreel , with all his great men , his familiar friends , and his priests , until he left him no one remaining .

verses.z: 耶戶起身往撒馬利亞去。在路上、牧人剪羊毛之處，
verses.e: He arose and departed , and went to Samaria . As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way ,

verses.z: 遇見猶大王亞哈謝的弟兄，問他們說：「你們是誰？」回答說：「我們是亞哈謝的弟兄，現在下去要問王和太后的眾子安。」
verses.e: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah , and said , " Who are you ? " They answered , " We are the brothers of Ahaziah . We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen . "

verses.z: 耶戶吩咐說：「活捉他們！」跟從的人就活捉了他們，將他們殺在剪羊毛之處的坑邊，共四十二人，沒有留下一個。
verses.e: He said , " Take them alive ! " They took them alive , and killed them at the pit of the shearing house , even forty-two men . He didn't leave any of them .

verses.z: 耶戶從那裏前行，恰遇利甲的兒子約拿達來迎接他，耶戶問他安，對他說：「你誠心待我像我誠心待你嗎？」約拿達回答說：「是。」耶戶說：「若是這樣，你向我伸手」，他就伸手；耶戶拉他上車。
verses.e: When he had departed from there , he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him . He greeted him , and said to him , " Is your heart right , as my heart is with your heart ? " Jehonadab answered , " It is . " " If it is , give me your hand . " He gave him his hand ; and he took him up to him into the chariot .

verses.z: 耶戶說：「你和我同去，看我為耶和華怎樣熱心」；於是請他坐在車上，
verses.e: He said , " Come with me , and see my zeal for the LORD . " So they made him ride in his chariot .

verses.z: 到了撒馬利亞，就把撒馬利亞的亞哈家剩下的人都殺了，直到滅盡，正如耶和華對以利亞所說的。
verses.e: When he came to Samaria , he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria , until he had destroyed them , according to the LORD's word which he spoke to Elijah .

verses.z: 耶戶招聚眾民，對他們說：「亞哈事奉巴力還冷淡，耶戶卻更熱心。
verses.e: Jehu gathered all the people together , and said to them , " Ahab served Baal a little , but Jehu will serve him much .

verses.z: 現在我要給巴力獻大祭。應當叫巴力的眾先知和一切拜巴力的人，並巴力的眾祭司，都到我這裏來，不可缺少一個；凡不來的必不得活。」耶戶這樣行，是用詭計要殺盡拜巴力的人。
verses.e: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal , all of his worshipers , and all of his priests . Let no one be absent , for I have a great sacrifice to Baal . Whoever is absent , he shall not live . " But Jehu did deceptively , intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal .

verses.z: 「你們那裏既有你們主人的眾子和車馬、器械、堅固城，
verses.e: " Now as soon as this letter comes to you , since your master's sons are with you , and you have chariots and horses , a fortified city also , and armor ,

verses.z: 耶戶說：「要為巴力宣告嚴肅會！」於是宣告了。
verses.e: Jehu said , " Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal ! " So they proclaimed it .

verses.z: 耶戶差人走遍以色列地；凡拜巴力的人都來齊了，沒有一個不來的。他們進了巴力廟，巴力廟中從前邊直到後邊都滿了人。
verses.e: Jehu sent through all Israel ; and all the worshipers of Baal came , so that there was not a man left that didn't come . They came into the house of Baal ; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another .

verses.z: 耶戶吩咐掌管禮服的人說：「拿出禮服來，給一切拜巴力的人穿。」他就拿出禮服來給了他們。
verses.e: He said to him who kept the wardrobe , " Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal ! " So he brought robes out to them .

verses.z: 耶戶和利甲的兒子約拿達進了巴力廟，對拜巴力的人說：「你們察看察看，在你們這裏不可有耶和華的僕人，只可容留拜巴力的人。」
verses.e: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal . Then he said to the worshipers of Baal , " Search , and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you , but only the worshipers of Baal . "

verses.z: 耶戶和約拿達進去，獻[平安]祭和燔祭。耶戶先安派八十人在廟外，吩咐說：「我將這些人交在你們手中，若有一人脫逃，[誰放的]必叫他償命！」
verses.e: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings . Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside , and said , " If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape , he who lets him go , his life shall be for the life of him . "

verses.z: 耶戶獻完了燔祭，就[出來]吩咐護衛兵和眾軍長說：「你們進去殺他們，不容一人出來！」護衛兵和軍長就用刀殺他們，將屍首拋出去，便到巴力廟的城去了，
verses.e: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering , Jehu said to the guard and to the captains , " Go in and kill them ! Let no one escape . " So they struck them with the edge of the sword . The guard and the captains threw the bodies out , and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal .

verses.z: 將巴力廟中的柱像都拿出來燒了；
verses.e: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them .

verses.z: 毀壞了巴力柱像，拆毀了巴力廟作為廁所，直到今日。
verses.e: They broke down the pillar of Baal , and broke down the house of Baal , and made it a latrine , to this day .

verses.z: 這樣，耶戶在以色列中滅了巴力。
verses.e: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel .

verses.z: 只是耶戶不離開尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，就是拜伯特利和但的金牛犢。
verses.e: However , Jehu didn't depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin — the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan .

verses.z: 接了這信，就可以在你們主人的眾子中選擇一個賢能合宜的，使他坐他父親的位，你們也可以為你們主人的家爭戰。」
verses.e: select the best and fittest of your master's sons , set him on his father's throne , and fight for your master's house . "

verses.z: 耶和華對耶戶說：「因你辦好我眼中看為正的事，照我的心意待亞哈家，你的子孫必接續你坐以色列的國位，直到四代。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Jehu , " Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes , and have done to Ahab's house according to all that was in my heart , your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation . "

verses.z: 只是耶戶不盡心遵守耶和華－以色列上帝的律法，不離開耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD , the God of Israel , with all his heart . He didn't depart from the sins of Jeroboam , with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 在那些日子，耶和華才割裂以色列國，使哈薛攻擊以色列的境界，
verses.e: In those days the LORD began to cut away parts of Israel ; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

verses.z: 乃是約旦河東、基列全地，從靠近亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥起，就是基列和巴珊的迦得人、呂便人、瑪拿西人之地。
verses.e: from the Jordan eastward , all the land of Gilead , the Gadites , and the Reubenites , and the Manassites , from Aroer , which is by the valley of the Arnon , even Gilead and Bashan .

verses.z: 耶戶其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu , and all that he did , and all his might , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 耶戶與他列祖同睡，葬在撒馬利亞；他兒子約哈斯接續他作王。
verses.e: Jehu slept with his fathers ; and they buried him in Samaria . Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 耶戶在撒馬利亞作以色列王二十八年。
verses.e: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years .

verses.z: 他們卻甚懼怕，彼此說：「二王在他面前尚且站立不住，我們怎能站得住呢？」
verses.e: But they were exceedingly afraid , and said , " Behold , the two kings didn't stand before him ! How then shall we stand ? "

verses.z: 家宰、邑宰，和長老，並教養[眾子]的人，打發人去見耶戶，說：「我們是你的僕人，凡你所吩咐我們的都必遵行，我們不立誰作王，你看怎樣好就怎樣行。」
verses.e: He who was over the household , and he who was over the city , the elders also , and those who raised the children , sent to Jehu , saying , " We are your servants , and will do all that you ask us . We will not make any man king . You do that which is good in your eyes . "

verses.z: 耶戶又給他們寫信說：「你們若歸順我，聽從我的話，明日這時候，要將你們主人眾子的首級帶到耶斯列來見我。」那時王的兒子七十人都住在教養他們那城中的尊貴人家裏。
verses.e: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them , saying , " If you are on my side , and if you will listen to my voice , take the heads of the men who are your master's sons , and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time . " Now the king's sons , being seventy persons , were with the great men of the city , who brought them up .

verses.z: 信一到，他們就把王的七十個兒子殺了，將首級裝在筐裏，送到在耶斯列的耶戶那裏。
verses.e: When the letter came to them , they took the king's sons and killed them , even seventy people , and put their heads in baskets , and sent them to him to Jezreel .

verses.z: 有使者來告訴耶戶說：「他們將王眾子的首級送來了。」耶戶說：「將首級在城門口堆作兩堆，擱到明日。」
verses.e: A messenger came and told him , " They have brought the heads of the king's sons . " He said , " Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning . "

verses.z: 次日早晨，耶戶出來，站着對眾民說：「你們都是公義的，我背叛我主人，將他殺了；這些人卻是誰殺的呢？
verses.e: In the morning , he went out and stood , and said to all the people , " You are righteous . Behold , I conspired against my master and killed him , but who killed all these ?

verses.z: 亞哈謝的母親亞她利雅見她兒子死了，就起來剿滅王室。
verses.e: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring .

verses.z: 祭司便將耶和華殿裏所藏大衛王的槍和盾牌交給百夫長。
verses.e: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David's , which were in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 護衛兵手中各拿兵器，在壇和殿那裏，從殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四圍。
verses.e: The guard stood , every man with his weapons in his hand , from the right side of the house to the left side of the house , along by the altar and the house , around the king .

verses.z: 祭司領王子出來，給他戴上冠冕，將律法[書交給他]，膏他作王；眾人就拍掌說：「願王萬歲！」
verses.e: Then he brought out the king's son , and put the crown on him , and gave him the covenant ; and they made him king and anointed him ; and they clapped their hands , and said , " Long live the king ! "

verses.z: 亞她利雅聽見護衛兵和民的聲音，就到民那裏，進耶和華的殿，
verses.e: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people , she came to the people into the LORD's house ;

verses.z: 看見王照例站在柱旁，百夫長和吹號的人侍立在王左右，國中的眾民歡樂吹號；亞她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫說：「反了！反了！」
verses.e: and she looked , and behold , the king stood by the pillar , as the tradition was , with the captains and the trumpets by the king ; and all the people of the land rejoiced , and blew trumpets . Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried , " Treason ! Treason ! "

verses.z: 祭司耶何耶大吩咐管轄軍兵的百夫長說：「將她趕出班外，凡跟隨她的必用刀殺死！」因為祭司說「不可在耶和華殿裏殺她」，
verses.e: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army , and said to them , " Bring her out between the ranks . Kill anyone who follows her with the sword . " For the priest said , " Don't let her be slain in the LORD's house . "

verses.z: 眾兵就閃開讓她去；她從馬路上王宮去，便在那裏被殺。
verses.e: So they seized her ; and she went by the way of the horses ' entry to the king's house , and she was slain there .

verses.z: 耶何耶大使王和民與耶和華立約，作耶和華的民；又使王與民立約。
verses.e: Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people , that they should be the LORD's people ; also between the king and the people .

verses.z: 於是國民都到巴力廟，拆毀了廟，打碎壇和像，又在壇前將巴力的祭司瑪坦殺了。祭司耶何耶大派官看守耶和華的殿，
verses.e: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal , and broke it down . They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly , and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . The priest appointed officers over the LORD's house .

verses.z: 又率領百夫長和迦利人與護衛兵，以及國中的眾民，請王從耶和華殿下來，由護衛兵的門進入王宮，他就坐了王位。
verses.e: He took the captains over hundreds , and the Carites , and the guard , and all the people of the land ; and they brought down the king from the LORD's house , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house . He sat on the throne of the kings .

verses.z: 但約蘭王的女兒，亞哈謝的妹子約示巴，將亞哈謝的兒子約阿施從那被殺的王子中偷出來，把他和他的乳母都[藏]在臥房裏，躲避亞她利雅，免得被殺。
verses.e: But Jehosheba , the daughter of King Joram , sister of Ahaziah , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him away from among the king's sons who were slain , even him and his nurse , and put them in the bedroom ; and they hid him from Athaliah , so that he was not slain .

verses.z: 國民都歡樂，閤城都安靜。眾人已將亞她利雅在王宮那裏用刀殺了。
verses.e: So all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was quiet . They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king's house .

verses.z: 約阿施登基的時候年方七歲。
verses.e: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign .

verses.z: 約阿施和他的乳母藏在耶和華的殿裏六年；亞她利雅篡了國位。
verses.e: He was with her hidden in the LORD's house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land .

verses.z: 第七年，耶何耶大打發人叫迦利人和護衛兵的眾百夫長來，領他們進了耶和華的殿，與他們立約，使他們在耶和華殿裏起誓，又將王的兒子指給他們看，
verses.e: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard , and brought them to him into the LORD's house ; and he made a covenant with them , and made a covenant with them in the LORD's house , and showed them the king's son .

verses.z: 吩咐他們說：「你們當這樣行：凡安息日進班的三分之一要看守王宮，
verses.e: He commanded them , saying , " This is what you must do : a third of you , who come in on the Sabbath , shall be keepers of the watch of the king's house ;

verses.z: 三分之一要在蘇珥門，三分之一要在護衛兵院的後門。這樣把守王宮，攔阻閒人。
verses.e: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur ; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard . So you shall keep the watch of the house , and be a barrier .

verses.z: 你們安息日所有出班的三分之二要在耶和華的殿裏護衛王；
verses.e: The two companies of you , even all who go out on the Sabbath , shall keep the watch of the LORD's house around the king .

verses.z: 各人手拿兵器，四圍護衛王。凡擅入你們班次的必當治死，王出入的時候，你們當跟隨他。」
verses.e: You shall surround the king , every man with his weapons in his hand ; and he who comes within the ranks , let him be slain . Be with the king when he goes out , and when he comes in . "

verses.z: 眾百夫長就照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各帶所管安息日進班出班的人來見祭司耶何耶大。
verses.e: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded ; and they each took his men , those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath , and came to Jehoiada the priest .

verses.z: 耶戶第七年，約阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母親名叫西比亞，是別是巴人。
verses.e: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu , and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba .

verses.z: 他們見櫃裏的銀子多了，便叫王的書記和大祭司上來，將耶和華殿裏的銀子數算包起來。
verses.e: When they saw that there was much money in the chest , the king's scribe and the high priest came up , and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 把所平的銀子交給督工的，就是耶和華殿裏辦事的人；他們把銀子轉交修理耶和華殿的木匠和工人，
verses.e: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work , who had the oversight of the LORD's house ; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD's house ,

verses.z: 並瓦匠、石匠，又買木料和鑿成的石頭，修理耶和華殿的破壞之處，以及修理殿的各樣使用。
verses.e: and to the masons and the stone cutters , and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD's house , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .

verses.z: 但那奉到耶和華殿的銀子，沒有用以做耶和華殿裏的銀杯、蠟剪、碗、號，和別樣的金銀器皿，
verses.e: But there were not made for the LORD's house cups of silver , snuffers , basins , trumpets , any vessels of gold or vessels of silver , of the money that was brought into the LORD's house ;

verses.z: 乃將那銀子交給督工的人修理耶和華的殿；
verses.e: for they gave that to those who did the work , and repaired the LORD's house with it .

verses.z: 且將銀子交給辦事的人轉交做工的人，不與他們算賬，因為他們辦事誠實。
verses.e: Moreover they didn't demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work ; for they dealt faithfully .

verses.z: 惟有贖愆祭、贖罪祭的銀子沒有奉到耶和華的殿，都歸祭司。
verses.e: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD's house . It was the priests ' .

verses.z: 那時，亞蘭王哈薛上來攻打迦特，攻取了，就定意上來攻打耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath , and took it ; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 猶大王約阿施將他列祖猶大王約沙法、約蘭、亞哈謝所分別為聖的物和自己所分別為聖的物，並耶和華殿與王宮府庫裏所有的金子都送給亞蘭王哈薛；哈薛就不上耶路撒冷來了。
verses.e: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah , his fathers , kings of Judah , had dedicated , and his own holy things , and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD's house , and of the king's house , and sent it to Hazael king of Syria ; and he went away from Jerusalem .

verses.z: 約阿施其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 約阿施在祭司耶何耶大教訓他的時候，就行耶和華眼中看為正的事；
verses.e: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD's eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him .

verses.z: 約阿施的臣僕起來背叛，在下悉拉的米羅宮那裏將他殺了。
verses.e: His servants arose and made a conspiracy , and struck Joash at the house of Millo , on the way that goes down to Silla .

verses.z: 殺他的那臣僕就是示米押的兒子約撒甲和朔默的兒子約薩拔。眾人將他葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子亞瑪謝接續他作王。
verses.e: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath , and Jehozabad the son of Shomer , his servants , struck him , and he died ; and they buried him with his fathers in David's city ; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去，百姓仍在那裏獻祭燒香。
verses.e: However , the high places were not taken away . The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places .

verses.z: 約阿施對眾祭司說：「凡奉到耶和華殿分別為聖之物所值通用的銀子，或各人當納的身價，或樂意奉到耶和華殿的銀子，
verses.e: Jehoash said to the priests , " All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD's house , in current money , the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated , and all the money that it comes into any man's heart to bring into the LORD's house ,

verses.z: 你們當從所認識的人收了來，修理殿的一切破壞之處。」
verses.e: let the priests take it to them , each man from his donor ; and they shall repair the damage to the house , wherever any damage is found . "

verses.z: 無奈到了約阿施王二十三年，祭司仍未修理殿的破壞之處。
verses.e: But it was so , that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house .

verses.z: 所以約阿施王召了大祭司耶何耶大和眾祭司來，對他們說：「你們怎麼不修理殿的破壞之處呢？從今以後，你們不要從所認識的人再收銀子，要將所收的交出來，修理殿的破壞之處。」
verses.e: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and for the other priests , and said to them , " Why aren't you repairing the damage to the house ? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers , but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house . "

verses.z: 眾祭司答應不再收百姓的銀子，也不修理殿的破壞之處。
verses.e: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people , and not repair the damage to the house .

verses.z: 祭司耶何耶大取了一個櫃子，在櫃蓋上鑽了一個窟窿，放於壇旁，在進耶和華殿的右邊；守門的祭司將奉到耶和華殿的一切銀子投在櫃裏。
verses.e: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one comes into the LORD's house ; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD's house into it .

verses.z: 猶大王亞哈謝的兒子約阿施二十三年，耶戶的兒子約哈斯在撒馬利亞登基作以色列王十七年。
verses.e: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah , king of Judah , Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years .

verses.z: 猶大王約阿施三十七年，約哈斯的兒子約阿施在撒馬利亞登基作以色列王十六年。
verses.e: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah , Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，不離開尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的一切罪，仍然去行。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight . He didn't depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin ; but he walked in them .

verses.z: 約阿施其餘的事，凡他所行的和他與猶大王亞瑪謝爭戰的勇力，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 約阿施與他列祖同睡，耶羅波安坐了他的位。約阿施與以色列諸王一同葬在撒馬利亞。
verses.e: Joash slept with his fathers ; and Jeroboam sat on his throne . Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 以利沙得了必死的病，以色列王約阿施下來看他，伏在他臉上哭泣，說：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的戰車馬兵啊！」
verses.e: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died ; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him , and wept over him , and said , " My father , my father , the chariots of Israel and its horsemen ! "

verses.z: 以利沙對他說：「你取弓箭來。」王就取了弓箭來；
verses.e: Elisha said to him , " Take bow and arrows ; " and he took bow and arrows for himself .

verses.z: 又對以色列王說：「你用手拿弓。」王就用手拿[弓]。以利沙按手在王的手上，
verses.e: He said to the king of Israel , " Put your hand on the bow ; " and he put his hand on it . Elisha laid his hands on the king's hands .

verses.z: 說：「你開朝東的窗戶。」他就開了。以利沙說：「射箭吧！」他就射箭。以利沙說：「這是耶和華的得勝箭，就是戰勝亞蘭人的箭；因為你必在亞弗攻打亞蘭人，直到滅盡他們。」
verses.e: He said , " Open the window eastward ; " and he opened it . Then Elisha said , " Shoot ! " and he shot . He said , " The LORD's arrow of victory , even the arrow of victory over Syria ; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them . "

verses.z: 以利沙又說：「取幾枝箭來。」他就取了來。以利沙說：「打地吧！」他打了三次，便止住了。
verses.e: He said , " Take the arrows ; " and he took them . He said to the king of Israel , " Strike the ground ; " and he struck three times , and stopped .

verses.z: 神人向他發怒，說：「應當擊打五六次，就能攻打亞蘭人直到滅盡；現在只能打敗亞蘭人三次。」
verses.e: The man of God was angry with him , and said , " You should have struck five or six times . Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it , but now you will strike Syria just three times . "

verses.z: 約哈斯行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，總不離開。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin . He didn't depart from it .

verses.z: 以利沙死了，人將他葬埋。到了新年，有一群摩押人犯境，
verses.e: Elisha died , and they buried him . Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year .

verses.z: 有人正葬死人，忽然看見一群人，就把死人拋在以利沙的墳墓裏，一碰着以利沙的骸骨，死人就復活，站起來了。
verses.e: As they were burying a man , behold , they saw a band of raiders ; and they threw the man into Elisha's tomb . As soon as the man touched Elisha's bones , he revived , and stood up on his feet .

verses.z: 約哈斯年間，亞蘭王哈薛屢次欺壓以色列人。
verses.e: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz .

verses.z: 耶和華卻因與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的約，仍施恩給以色列人，憐恤他們，眷顧他們，不肯滅盡他們，尚未趕逐他們離開自己面前。
verses.e: But the LORD was gracious to them , and had compassion on them , and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and would not destroy them and he didn't cast them from his presence as yet .

verses.z: 亞蘭王哈薛死了，他兒子便‧哈達接續他作王。
verses.e: Hazael king of Syria died ; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 從前哈薛和約阿施的父親約哈斯爭戰，攻取了些城邑，現在約哈斯的兒子約阿施三次打敗哈薛的兒子便‧哈達，就收回了以色列的城邑。
verses.e: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war . Joash struck him three times , and recovered the cities of Israel .

verses.z: 於是，耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，將他們屢次交在亞蘭王哈薛和他兒子便‧哈達的手裏。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Israel , and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria , and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael , continually .

verses.z: 約哈斯懇求耶和華，耶和華就應允他，因為見以色列人所受亞蘭王的欺壓。
verses.e: Jehoahaz begged the LORD , and the LORD listened to him ; for he saw the oppression of Israel , how the king of Syria oppressed them .

verses.z: 耶和華賜給以色列人一位拯救者，使他們脫離亞蘭人的手；於是以色列人仍舊安居在家裏。
verses.e: ( The LORD gave Israel a savior , so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians ; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before .

verses.z: 然而他們不離開耶羅波安家使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，仍然去行，並且在撒馬利亞留下亞舍拉。
verses.e: Nevertheless they didn't depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , with which he made Israel to sin , but walked in them ; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria . )

verses.z: 亞蘭王滅絕約哈斯的民，踐踏他們如禾場上的塵沙，只給約哈斯留下五十馬兵，十輛戰車，一萬步兵。
verses.e: For he didn't leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen , and ten chariots , and ten thousand footmen ; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing .

verses.z: 約哈斯其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz , and all that he did , and his might , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 約哈斯與他列祖同睡，葬在撒馬利亞。他兒子約阿施接續他作王。
verses.e: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers ; and they buried him in Samaria ; and Joash his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 以色列王約哈斯的兒子約阿施第二年，猶大王約阿施的兒子亞瑪謝登基。
verses.e: In the second year of Joash , son of Joahaz , king of Israel , Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign .

verses.z: 你打敗了以東人就心高氣傲，你以此為榮耀，在家裏安居就罷了，為何要惹禍，使自己和猶大國一同敗亡呢？」
verses.e: You have indeed struck Edom , and your heart has lifted you up . Enjoy the glory of it , and stay at home ; for why should you meddle to your harm , that you fall , even you , and Judah with you ? "

verses.z: 亞瑪謝卻不肯聽這話。於是以色列王約阿施上來，在猶大的伯‧示麥與猶大王亞瑪謝相見[於戰場]。
verses.e: But Amaziah would not listen . So Jehoash king of Israel went up ; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh , which belongs to Judah .

verses.z: 猶大人敗在以色列人面前，各自逃回家裏去了。
verses.e: Judah was defeated by Israel ; and each man fled to his tent .

verses.z: 以色列王約阿施在伯‧示麥擒住亞哈謝的孫子、約阿施的兒子猶大王亞瑪謝，就來到耶路撒冷，拆毀耶路撒冷的城牆，從以法蓮門直到角門共四百肘，
verses.e: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah , at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem , then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate , four hundred cubits .

verses.z: 又將耶和華殿裏與王宮府庫裏所有的金銀和器皿都拿了去，並帶人去為質，就回撒馬利亞去了。
verses.e: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the LORD's house and in the treasures of the king's house , the hostages also , and returned to Samaria .

verses.z: 約阿施其餘所行的事和他的勇力，並與猶大王亞瑪謝爭戰的事，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did , and his might , and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 約阿施與他列祖同睡，葬在撒馬利亞，以色列諸王的墳地裏。他兒子耶羅波安接續他作王。
verses.e: Jehoash slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel ; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 以色列王約哈斯的兒子約阿施死後，猶大王約阿施的兒子亞瑪謝又活了十五年。
verses.e: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz , king of Israel , fifteen years .

verses.z: 亞瑪謝其餘的事都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 耶路撒冷有人背叛亞瑪謝，他就逃到拉吉；叛黨卻打發人到拉吉將他殺了。
verses.e: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem , and he fled to Lachish ; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there .

verses.z: 他登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母親名叫約耶但，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.e: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign ; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 人就用馬將他的屍首馱到耶路撒冷，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。
verses.e: They brought him on horses , and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David's city .

verses.z: 猶大眾民立亞瑪謝的兒子亞撒利雅接續他父作王，那時他年十六歲。
verses.e: All the people of Judah took Azariah , who was sixteen years old , and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah .

verses.z: 亞瑪謝與他列祖同睡之後，亞撒利雅收回以拉他仍歸猶大，又重新修理。
verses.e: He built Elath and restored it to Judah . After that the king slept with his fathers .

verses.z: 猶大王約阿施的兒子亞瑪謝十五年，以色列王約阿施的兒子耶羅波安在撒馬利亞登基，作王四十一年。
verses.e: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah , Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，不離開尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的一切罪。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight . He didn't depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 他收回以色列邊界之地，從哈馬口直到亞拉巴海，正如耶和華－以色列的上帝藉他僕人迦特希弗人亞米太的兒子先知約拿所說的。
verses.e: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah , according to the LORD , the God of Israel's word , which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai , the prophet , who was from Gath Hepher .

verses.z: 因為耶和華看見以色列人甚是艱苦，無論困住的、自由的都沒有了，也無人幫助以色列人。
verses.e: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel , that it was very bitter for all , slave and free ; and there was no helper for Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華並沒有說要將以色列的名從天下塗抹，乃藉約阿施的兒子耶羅波安拯救他們。
verses.e: The LORD didn't say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky ; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash .

verses.z: 耶羅波安其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，他怎樣爭戰，怎樣收回大馬士革和[先前屬]猶大的哈馬歸以色列，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam , and all that he did , and his might , how he fought , and how he recovered Damascus , and Hamath , which had belonged to Judah , for Israel , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 耶羅波安與他列祖以色列諸王同睡。他兒子撒迦利雅接續他作王。
verses.e: Jeroboam slept with his fathers , even with the kings of Israel ; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 亞瑪謝行耶和華眼中看為正的事，但不如他祖大衛，乃效法他父約阿施一切所行的；
verses.e: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes , yet not like David his father . He did according to all that Joash his father had done .

verses.z: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去，百姓仍在那裏獻祭燒香。
verses.e: However the high places were not taken away . The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places .

verses.z: 國一堅定，就把殺他父王的臣僕殺了，
verses.e: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand , he killed his servants who had slain the king his father ,

verses.z: 卻沒有治死殺王之人的兒子，是照摩西律法書上耶和華所吩咐的說：「不可因子殺父，也不可因父殺子，各人要為本身的罪而死。」
verses.e: but the children of the murderers he didn't put to death , according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses , as the LORD commanded , saying , " The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers ; but every man shall die for his own sin . "

verses.z: 亞瑪謝在鹽谷殺了以東人一萬，又攻取了西拉，改名叫約帖，直到今日。
verses.e: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt , and took Sela by war , and called its name Joktheel , to this day .

verses.z: 那時，亞瑪謝差遣使者去見耶戶的孫子約哈斯的兒子以色列王約阿施，說：「你來，我們二人相見[於戰場]。」
verses.e: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash , the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , " Come , let's look one another in the face . "

verses.z: 以色列王約阿施差遣使者去見猶大王亞瑪謝，說：「黎巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去見黎巴嫩的香柏樹，說：將你的女兒給我兒子為妻。後來黎巴嫩有一個野獸經過，把蒺藜踐踏了。
verses.e: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , " The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , ' Give your daughter to my son as wife . ' Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by , and trampled down the thistle .

verses.z: 以色列王耶羅波安二十七年，猶大王亞瑪謝的兒子亞撒利雅登基，
verses.e: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel , Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign .

verses.z: 雅比的兒子沙龍背叛他，在百姓面前擊殺他，篡了他的位。
verses.e: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him , and struck him before the people and killed him , and reigned in his place .

verses.z: 撒迦利雅其餘的事都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 這是從前耶和華應許耶戶說：「你的子孫必坐以色列的國位直到四代。」這話果然應驗了。
verses.e: This was the LORD's word which he spoke to Jehu , saying , " Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel . " So it came to pass .

verses.z: 猶大王烏西雅三十九年，雅比的兒子沙龍登基在撒馬利亞作王一個月。
verses.e: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah , and he reigned for a month in Samaria .

verses.z: 迦底的兒子米拿現從得撒上撒馬利亞，殺了雅比的兒子沙龍，篡了他的位。
verses.e: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah , came to Samaria , struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria , killed him , and reigned in his place .

verses.z: 沙龍其餘的事和他背叛的情形都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum , and his conspiracy which he made , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 那時米拿現從得撒起攻打提斐薩和其四境，擊殺城中一切的人，剖開其中所有的孕婦，都因他們沒有給他開城。
verses.e: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas , from Tirzah . He attacked it because they didn't open their gates to him , and he ripped up all their women who were with child .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒利雅三十九年，迦底的兒子米拿現登基，在撒馬利亞作以色列王十年。
verses.e: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah , Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，終身不離開尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight . He didn't depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 亞述王普勒來攻擊以色列國，米拿現給他一千他連得銀子，請普勒幫助他堅定國位。
verses.e: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land , and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver , that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand .

verses.z: 他登基的時候年十六歲，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母親名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.e: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 米拿現向以色列一切大富戶索要銀子，使他們各出五十舍客勒，就給了亞述王。於是亞述王回去，不在國中停留。
verses.e: Menahem exacted the money from Israel , even from all the mighty men of wealth , from each man fifty shekels of silver , to give to the king of Assyria . So the king of Assyria turned back , and didn't stay there in the land .

verses.z: 米拿現其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

verses.z: 米拿現與他列祖同睡。他兒子比加轄接續他作王。
verses.e: Menahem slept with his fathers , and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒利雅五十年，米拿現的兒子比加轄在撒馬利亞登基作以色列王二年。
verses.e: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah , Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，不離開尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight . He didn't depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 比加轄的將軍、利瑪利的兒子比加背叛他，在撒馬利亞王宮裏的衛所殺了他。亞珥歌伯和亞利耶並基列的五十人幫助比加；比加擊殺他，篡了他的位。
verses.e: Pekah the son of Remaliah , his captain , conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria , in the fortress of the king's house , with Argob and Arieh ; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites . He killed him , and reigned in his place .

verses.z: 比加轄其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒利雅五十二年，利瑪利的兒子比加在撒馬利亞登基作以色列王二十年。
verses.e: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah , Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，不離開尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight . He didn't depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 以色列王比加年間，亞述王提革拉‧毗列色來奪了以雲、亞伯‧伯‧瑪迦、亞挪、基低斯、夏瑣、基列、加利利，和拿弗他利全地，將這些地方的居民都擄到亞述去了。
verses.e: In the days of Pekah king of Israel , Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon , Abel Beth Maacah , Janoah , Kedesh , Hazor , Gilead , and Galilee , all the land of Naphtali ; and he carried them captive to Assyria .

verses.z: 亞撒利雅行耶和華眼中看為正的事，效法他父親亞瑪謝一切所行的；
verses.e: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes , according to all that his father Amaziah had done .

verses.z: 烏西雅的兒子約坦二十年，以拉的兒子何細亞背叛利瑪利的兒子比加，擊殺他，篡了他的位。
verses.e: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah , attacked him , killed him , and reigned in his place , in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah .

verses.z: 比加其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在以色列諸王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 以色列王利瑪利的兒子比加第二年，猶大王烏西雅的兒子約坦登基。
verses.e: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel , Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign .

verses.z: 他登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他母親名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女兒。
verses.e: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok .

verses.z: 約坦行耶和華眼中看為正的事，效法他父親烏西雅一切所行的；
verses.e: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes . He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done .

verses.z: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去，百姓仍在那裏獻祭燒香。約坦建立耶和華殿的上門。
verses.e: However the high places were not taken away . The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places . He built the upper gate of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 約坦其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 在那些日子，耶和華才使亞蘭王利汛和利瑪利的兒子比加去攻擊猶大。
verses.e: In those days , the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah .

verses.z: 約坦與他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子亞哈斯接續他作王。
verses.e: Jotham slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in his father David's city ; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去，百姓仍在那裏獻祭燒香。
verses.e: However , the high places were not taken away . The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places .

verses.z: 耶和華降災與王，使他長大痲瘋，直到死日，他就住在別的宮裏。他的兒子約坦管理家事，治理國民。
verses.e: The LORD struck the king , so that he was a leper to the day of his death , and lived in a separate house . Jotham , the king's son , was over the household , judging the people of the land .

verses.z: 亞撒利雅其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 亞撒利雅與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子約坦接續他作王。
verses.e: Azariah slept with his fathers ; and they buried him with his fathers in David's city ; and Jotham his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 猶大王亞撒利雅三十八年，耶羅波安的兒子撒迦利雅在撒馬利亞作以色列王六個月。
verses.e: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah , Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他列祖所行的，不離開尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , as his fathers had done . He didn't depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin .

verses.z: 利瑪利的兒子比加十七年，猶大王約坦的兒子亞哈斯登基。
verses.e: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah , Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign .

verses.z: 亞哈斯王上大馬士革去迎接亞述王提革拉‧毗列色，在大馬士革看見一座壇，就照壇的規模樣式作法[畫了圖樣]，送到祭司烏利亞那裏。
verses.e: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria , and saw the altar that was at Damascus ; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it .

verses.z: 祭司烏利亞照着亞哈斯王從大馬士革送來的圖樣，在亞哈斯王沒有從大馬士革回來之先，建築一座壇。
verses.e: Urijah the priest built an altar . According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus , so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus .

verses.z: 王從大馬士革回來看見壇，就近前來，在壇上獻祭；
verses.e: When the king had come from Damascus , the king saw the altar ; and the king came near to the altar , and offered on it .

verses.z: 燒燔祭、素祭、澆奠祭，將平安祭牲的血灑在壇上，
verses.e: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering , poured his drink offering , and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar .

verses.z: 又將耶和華面前的銅壇從耶和華殿和[新]壇的中間搬到[新]壇的北邊。
verses.e: The bronze altar , which was before the LORD , he brought from the front of the house , from between his altar and the LORD's house , and put it on the north side of his altar .

verses.z: 亞哈斯王吩咐祭司烏利亞說：「早晨的燔祭、晚上的素祭，王的燔祭、素祭，國內眾民的燔祭、素祭、奠祭都要燒在大壇上。燔祭牲和[平安]祭牲的血也要灑在這壇上，只是銅壇我要用以求問[耶和華]。」
verses.e: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest , saying , " On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering , the evening meal offering , the king's burnt offering and his meal offering , with the burnt offering of all the people of the land , their meal offering , and their drink offerings ; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering , and all the blood of the sacrifice ; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by . "

verses.z: 祭司烏利亞就照着亞哈斯王所吩咐的行了。
verses.e: Urijah the priest did so , according to all that King Ahaz commanded .

verses.z: 亞哈斯王打掉盆座[四面鑲着]的心子，把盆從座上挪下來，又將銅海從馱海的銅牛上搬下來，放在鋪石地；
verses.e: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases , and removed the basin from off them , and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it , and put it on a pavement of stone .

verses.z: 又因亞述王的緣故，將耶和華殿為安息日所蓋的廊子和王從外入殿的廊子挪移，圍繞耶和華的殿。
verses.e: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house , and the king's outer entrance to the LORD's house , because of the king of Assyria .

verses.z: 亞哈斯其餘所行的事都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 他登基的時候年二十歲，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大衛行耶和華－他上帝眼中看為正的事，
verses.e: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . He didn't do that which was right in the LORD his God's eyes , like David his father .

verses.z: 亞哈斯與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子希西家接續他作王。
verses.e: Ahaz slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in David's city ; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 卻效法以色列諸王所行的，又照着耶和華從以色列人面前趕出的外邦人所行可憎的事，使他的兒子經火，
verses.e: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and even made his son to pass through the fire , according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel .

verses.z: 並在邱壇上、山岡上、各青翠樹下獻祭燒香。
verses.e: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places , on the hills , and under every green tree .

verses.z: 亞蘭王利汛和以色列王利瑪利的兒子比加上來攻打耶路撒冷，圍困亞哈斯，卻不能勝他。
verses.e: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war . They besieged Ahaz , but could not overcome him .

verses.z: 當時亞蘭王利汛收回以拉他歸與亞蘭，將猶大人從以拉他趕出去。亞蘭人就來到以拉他，住在那裏，直到今日。
verses.e: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria , and drove the Jews from Elath ; and the Syrians came to Elath , and lived there to this day .

verses.z: 亞哈斯差遣使者去見亞述王提革拉‧毗列色，說：「我是你的僕人、你的兒子。現在亞蘭王和以色列王攻擊我，求你來救我脫離他們的手。」
verses.e: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria , saying , " I am your servant and your son . Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel , who rise up against me . "

verses.z: 亞哈斯將耶和華殿裏和王宮府庫裏所有的金銀都送給亞述王為禮物。
verses.e: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD's house , and in the treasures of the king's house , and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria .

verses.z: 亞述王應允了他，就上去攻打大馬士革，將城攻取，殺了利汛，把[居民]擄到吉珥。
verses.e: The king of Assyria listened to him ; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it , and carried its people captive to Kir , and killed Rezin .

verses.z: 猶大王亞哈斯十二年，以拉的兒子何細亞在撒馬利亞登基作以色列王九年。
verses.e: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah , Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years .

verses.z: 在各高岡上、各青翠樹下立柱像和木偶；
verses.e: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree ;

verses.z: 在邱壇上燒香，效法耶和華在他們面前趕出的外邦人所行的，又行惡事惹動耶和華的怒氣；
verses.e: and there they burned incense in all the high places , as the nations whom the LORD carried away before them did ; and they did wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger ;

verses.z: 且事奉偶像，就是耶和華警戒他們不可行的。
verses.e: and they served idols , of which the LORD had said to them , " You shall not do this thing . "

verses.z: 但耶和華藉眾先知、先見勸戒以色列人和猶大人說：「當離開你們的惡行，謹守我的誡命律例，遵行我吩咐你們列祖，並藉我僕人眾先知所傳給你們的律法。」
verses.e: Yet the LORD testified to Israel and to Judah , by every prophet and every seer , saying , " Turn from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets . "

verses.z: 他們卻不聽從，竟硬着頸項，效法他們列祖，不信服耶和華－他們的上帝，
verses.e: Notwithstanding , they would not listen , but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn't believe in the LORD their God .

verses.z: 厭棄他的律例和他與他們列祖所立的約，並勸戒他們的話，隨從虛無[的神]，自己成為虛妄，效法周圍的外邦人，就是耶和華囑咐他們不可效法的；
verses.e: They rejected his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers , and his testimonies which he testified to them ; and they followed vanity , and became vain , and followed the nations that were around them , concerning whom the LORD had commanded them that they should not do like them .

verses.z: 離棄耶和華－他們上帝的一切誡命，為自己鑄了兩個牛犢的像，立了亞舍拉，敬拜天上的萬象，事奉巴力，
verses.e: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God , and made molten images for themselves , even two calves , and made an Asherah , and worshiped all the army of the sky , and served Baal .

verses.z: 又使他們的兒女經火，用占卜，行法術賣了自己，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，惹動他的怒氣。
verses.e: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire , used divination and enchantments , and sold themselves to do that which was evil in the LORD's sight , to provoke him to anger .

verses.z: 所以耶和華向以色列人大大發怒，從自己面前趕出他們，只剩下猶大一個支派。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel , and removed them out of his sight . There was none left but the tribe of Judah only .

verses.z: 猶大人也不遵守耶和華－他們上帝的誡命，隨從以色列人所立的條規。
verses.e: Also Judah didn't keep the commandments of the LORD their God , but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made .

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，只是不像在他以前的以色列諸王。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him .

verses.z: 耶和華就厭棄以色列全族，使他們受苦，把他們交在搶奪他們的人手中，以致趕出他們離開自己面前，
verses.e: The LORD rejected all the offspring of Israel , afflicted them , and delivered them into the hands of raiders , until he had cast them out of his sight .

verses.z: 將以色列國從大衛家奪回；他們就立尼八的兒子耶羅波安作王。耶羅波安引誘以色列人不隨從耶和華，陷在大罪裏。
verses.e: For he tore Israel from David's house ; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king ; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following the LORD , and made them sin a great sin .

verses.z: 以色列人犯耶羅波安所犯的一切罪，總不離開，
verses.e: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did ; they didn't depart from them

verses.z: 以致耶和華從自己面前趕出他們，正如藉他僕人眾先知所說的。這樣，以色列人從本地被擄到亞述，直到今日。
verses.e: until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight , as he said by all his servants the prophets . So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day .

verses.z: 亞述王從巴比倫、古他、亞瓦、哈馬，和西法瓦音遷移人來，安置在撒馬利亞的城邑，代替以色列人；他們就得了撒馬利亞，住在其中。
verses.e: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon , from Cuthah , from Avva , and from Hamath and Sepharvaim , and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel ; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities .

verses.z: 他們才住那裏的時候，不敬畏耶和華，所以耶和華叫獅子進入他們中間，咬死了些人。
verses.e: So it was , at the beginning of their dwelling there , that they didn't fear the LORD . Therefore the LORD sent lions among them , which killed some of them .

verses.z: 有人告訴亞述王說：「你所遷移安置在撒馬利亞各城的那些民，不知道那地之神的規矩，所以那神叫獅子進入他們中間，咬死他們。」
verses.e: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria , saying , " The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don't know the law of the god of the land . Therefore he has sent lions among them ; and behold , they kill them , because they don't know the law of the god of the land . "

verses.z: 亞述王就吩咐說：「叫所擄來的祭司回去一個，使他住在那裏，將那地之神的規矩指教那些民。」
verses.e: Then the king of Assyria commanded , saying , " Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there ; and let him go and dwell there , and let him teach them the law of the god of the land . "

verses.z: 於是有一個從撒馬利亞擄去的祭司回來，住在伯特利，指教他們怎樣敬畏耶和華。
verses.e: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel , and taught them how they should fear the LORD .

verses.z: 然而，各族之人在所住的城裏各為自己製造神像，安置在撒馬利亞人所造有邱壇的殿中。
verses.e: However every nation made gods of their own , and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made , every nation in their cities in which they lived .

verses.z: 亞述王撒縵以色上來攻擊何細亞，何細亞就服事他，給他進貢。
verses.e: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him ; and Hoshea became his servant , and brought him tribute .

verses.z: 巴比倫人造疏割‧比訥像；古他人造匿甲像；哈馬人造亞示瑪像；
verses.e: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth , and the men of Cuth made Nergal , and the men of Hamath made Ashima ,

verses.z: 亞瓦人造匿哈和他珥他像；西法瓦音人用火焚燒兒女，獻給西法瓦音的神亞得米勒和亞拿米勒。
verses.e: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak ; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech , the gods of Sepharvaim .

verses.z: 他們懼怕耶和華，也從他們中間立邱壇的祭司，為他們在有邱壇的殿中獻祭。
verses.e: So they feared the LORD , and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves , who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places .

verses.z: 他們又懼怕耶和華，又事奉自己的神，從何邦遷移，就隨何邦的風俗。
verses.e: They feared the LORD , and also served their own gods , after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away .

verses.z: 他們直到如今仍照先前的風俗去行，不[專心]敬畏耶和華，不[全]守自己的規矩、典章，也不遵守耶和華吩咐雅各後裔的律法、誡命。（雅各，就是從前耶和華起名叫以色列的。）
verses.e: To this day they do what they did before . They don't fear the LORD , and they do not follow the statutes , or the ordinances , or the law , or the commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob , whom he named Israel ;

verses.z: 耶和華曾與他們立約，囑咐他們說：「不可敬畏別神，不可跪拜事奉他，也不可向他獻祭。
verses.e: with whom the LORD had made a covenant and commanded them , saying , " You shall not fear other gods , nor bow yourselves to them , nor serve them , nor sacrifice to them ;

verses.z: 但那用大能和伸出來的膀臂領你們出埃及地的耶和華，你們當敬畏，跪拜，向他獻祭。
verses.e: but you shall fear the LORD , who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm , and you shall bow yourselves to him , and you shall sacrifice to him .

verses.z: 他給你們寫的律例、典章、律法、誡命，你們應當永遠謹守遵行，不可敬畏別神。
verses.e: The statutes and the ordinances , and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you , you shall observe to do forever more . You shall not fear other gods .

verses.z: 我－[耶和華]與你們所立的約你們不可忘記，也不可敬畏別神。
verses.e: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you . You shall not fear other gods .

verses.z: 但要敬畏耶和華－你們的上帝，他必救你們脫離一切仇敵的手。」
verses.e: But you shall fear the LORD your God , and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies . "

verses.z: 何細亞背叛，差人去見埃及王梭，不照往年所行的與亞述王進貢。亞述王知道了，就把他鎖禁，囚在監裏。
verses.e: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea ; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year . Therefore the king of Assyria seized him , and bound him in prison .

verses.z: 他們卻不聽從，仍照先前的風俗去行。
verses.e: However they didn't listen , but they did what they did before .

verses.z: 如此這些民又懼怕耶和華，又事奉他們的偶像。他們子子孫孫也都照樣行，效法他們的祖宗，直到今日。
verses.e: So these nations feared the LORD , and also served their engraved images . Their children did likewise , and so did their children's children . They do as their fathers did to this day .

verses.z: 亞述王上來攻擊以色列遍地，上到撒馬利亞，圍困三年。
verses.e: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land , went up to Samaria , and besieged it three years .

verses.z: 何細亞第九年亞述王攻取了撒馬利亞，將以色列人擄到亞述，把他們安置在哈臘與歌散的哈博河邊，並米底亞人的城邑。
verses.e: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria , and placed them in Halah , and on the Habor , the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes .

verses.z: 這是因以色列人得罪那領他們出埃及地、脫離埃及王法老手的耶和華－他們的上帝，去敬畏別神，
verses.e: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God , who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and had feared other gods ,

verses.z: 隨從耶和華在他們面前所趕出外邦人的風俗和以色列諸王所立的條規。
verses.e: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel , and of the kings of Israel , which they made .

verses.z: 以色列人暗中行不正的事，違背耶和華－他們的上帝，在他們所有的城邑，從瞭望樓直到堅固城，建築邱壇；
verses.e: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against the LORD their God ; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities , from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city ;

verses.z: 以色列王以拉的兒子何細亞第三年，猶大王亞哈斯的兒子希西家登基。
verses.e: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign .

verses.z: 過了三年就攻取了城。希西家第六年，以色列王何細亞第九年，撒馬利亞被攻取了。
verses.e: At the end of three years they took it . In the sixth year of Hezekiah , which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel , Samaria was taken .

verses.z: 亞述王將以色列人擄到亞述，把他們安置在哈臘與歌散的哈博河邊，並米底亞人的城邑；
verses.e: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria , and put them in Halah , and on the Habor , the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes ,

verses.z: 都因他們不聽從耶和華－他們上帝的話，違背他的約，就是耶和華僕人摩西吩咐他們所當守的。
verses.e: because they didn't obey the LORD their God's voice , but transgressed his covenant , even all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded , and would not hear it or do it .

verses.z: 希西家王十四年，亞述王西拿基立上來攻擊猶大的一切堅固城，將城攻取。
verses.e: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah , Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them .

verses.z: 猶大王希西家差人往拉吉去見亞述王，說：「我有罪了，求你離開我；凡你罰我的，我必承當。」於是亞述王罰猶大王希西家銀子三百他連得，金子三十他連得。
verses.e: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish , saying , " I have offended you . Withdraw from me . That which you put on me , I will bear . " The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold .

verses.z: 希西家就把耶和華殿裏和王宮府庫裏所有的銀子都給了[他]。
verses.e: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the LORD's house and in the treasures of the king's house .

verses.z: 那時，猶大王希西家將耶和華殿門上的[金子]和他自己包在柱上的[金子]都刮下來，給了亞述王。
verses.e: At that time , Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the LORD's temple , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid , and gave it to the king of Assyria .

verses.z: 亞述王從拉吉差遣他珥探、拉伯撒利，和拉伯沙基率領大軍往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那裏去。他們上到耶路撒冷，就站在上池的水溝旁，在漂布地的大路上。
verses.e: The king of Assyria sent Tartan , Rabsaris , and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem . They went up and came to Jerusalem . When they had come up , they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool , which is in the highway of the fuller's field .

verses.z: 他們呼叫王的時候，就有希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬，並書記舍伯那和亞薩的兒子史官約亞，出來見他們。
verses.e: When they had called to the king , Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , who was over the household , and Shebnah the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them .

verses.z: 拉伯沙基說：「你們去告訴希西家說，亞述大王如此說：『你所倚靠的有甚麼可仗賴的呢？
verses.e: Rabshakeh said to them , " Say now to Hezekiah , ' The great king , the king of Assyria , says , " What confidence is this in which you trust ?

verses.z: 他登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母親名叫亞比，是撒迦利雅的女兒。
verses.e: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah .

verses.z: 你說有打仗的計謀和能力，[我看]不過是虛話。你到底倚靠誰才背叛我呢？
verses.e: You say ( but they are but vain words ) , ' There is counsel and strength for war . ' Now on whom do you trust , that you have rebelled against me ?

verses.z: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那壓傷的葦杖；人若靠這杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是這樣。
verses.e: Now , behold , you trust in the staff of this bruised reed , even in Egypt . If a man leans on it , it will go into his hand and pierce it . So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust on him .

verses.z: 你們若對我說：我們倚靠耶和華－我們的上帝，希西家豈不是將上帝的邱壇和祭壇廢去，且對猶大和耶路撒冷的人說：你們當在耶路撒冷這壇前敬拜嗎？
verses.e: But if you tell me , ' We trust in the LORD our God , ' isn't that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away , and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem , ' You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem ' ?

verses.z: 現在你把當頭給我主亞述王，我給你二千匹馬，看你這一面騎馬的人夠不夠。
verses.e: Now therefore , please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them .

verses.z: 若不然，怎能打敗我主臣僕中最小的軍長呢？你竟倚靠埃及的戰車馬兵嗎？
