verses.e: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants , and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

verses.z: 現在我上來攻擊毀滅這地，豈沒有耶和華的意思嗎？耶和華吩咐我說：你上去攻擊毀滅這地吧！』」
verses.e: Have I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it ? The LORD said to me , ' Go up against this land , and destroy it . ' " ' "

verses.z: 希勒家的兒子以利亞敬和舍伯那，並約亞，對拉伯沙基說：「求你用亞蘭言語和僕人說話，因為我們懂得；不要用猶大言語和我們說話，達到城上百姓的耳中。」
verses.e: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , Shebnah , and Joah , said to Rabshakeh , " Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language , for we understand it . Don't speak with us in the Jews ' language , in the hearing of the people who are on the wall . "

verses.z: 拉伯沙基說：「我主差遣我來，豈是單對你和你的主說這些話嗎？不也是對這些坐在城上、要與你們一同吃自己糞、喝自己尿的人說嗎？」
verses.e: But Rabshakeh said to them , " Has my master sent me to your master and to you , to speak these words ? Hasn't he sent me to the men who sit on the wall , to eat their own dung , and to drink their own urine with you ? "

verses.z: 於是拉伯沙基站着，用猶大言語大聲喊着說：「你們當聽亞述大王的話！
verses.e: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews ' language , and spoke , saying , " Hear the word of the great king , the king of Assyria .

verses.z: 王如此說：『你們不要被希西家欺哄了；因他不能救你們脫離我的手。
verses.e: The king says , ' Don't let Hezekiah deceive you , for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand .

verses.z: 希西家行耶和華眼中看為正的事，效法他祖大衛一切所行的。
verses.e: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes , according to all that David his father had done .

verses.z: 也不要聽希西家使你們倚靠耶和華，說耶和華必要拯救我們，這城必不交在亞述王的手中。』
verses.e: Don't let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD , saying , " The LORD will surely deliver us , and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria . "

verses.z: 不要聽希西家的話！因亞述王如此說：『你們要與我和好，出來投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄樹和無花果樹的果子，喝自己井裏的水。
verses.e: Don't listen to Hezekiah . ' For the king of Assyria says , ' Make your peace with me , and come out to me ; and everyone of you eat from his own vine , and everyone from his own fig tree , and everyone drink water from his own cistern ;

verses.z: 等我來領你們到一個地方與你們本地一樣，就是有五穀和新酒之地，有糧食和葡萄園之地，有橄欖樹和蜂蜜之地，好使你們存活，不至於死。希西家勸導你們，說耶和華必拯救我們；你們不要聽他的話。
verses.e: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of grain and new wine , a land of bread and vineyards , a land of olive trees and of honey , that you may live and not die . Don't listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you , saying , " The LORD will deliver us . "

verses.z: 列國的神有哪一個救他本國脫離亞述王的手呢？
verses.e: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?

verses.z: 哈馬、亞珥拔的神在哪裏呢？西法瓦音、希拿、以瓦的神在哪裏呢？他們曾救撒馬利亞脫離我的手嗎？
verses.e: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad ? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivvah ? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand ?

verses.z: 這些國的神有誰曾救自己的國脫離我的手呢？難道耶和華能救耶路撒冷脫離我的手嗎？』」
verses.e: Who are they among all the gods of the countries , that have delivered their country out of my hand , that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand ? ' "

verses.z: 百姓靜默不言，並不回答一句，因為王曾吩咐說：「不要回答他。」
verses.e: But the people stayed quiet , and answered him not a word ; for the king's commandment was , " Don't answer him . "

verses.z: 當下，希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並亞薩的兒子史官約亞，都撕裂衣服，來到希西家那裏，將拉伯沙基的話告訴了他。
verses.e: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , who was over the household , came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn , and told him Rabshakeh's words .

verses.z: 他廢去邱壇，毀壞柱像，砍下木偶，打碎摩西所造的銅蛇，因為到那時以色列人仍向銅蛇燒香。希西家叫銅蛇為銅塊。
verses.e: He removed the high places , broke the pillars , and cut down the Asherah . He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made , because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it ; and he called it Nehushtan .

verses.z: 希西家倚靠耶和華－以色列的上帝，在他前後的猶大列王中沒有一個及他的。
verses.e: He trusted in the LORD , the God of Israel , so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah , nor among them that were before him .

verses.z: 因為他專靠耶和華，總不離開，謹守耶和華所吩咐摩西的誡命。
verses.e: For he joined with the LORD . He didn't depart from following him , but kept his commandments , which the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華與他同在，他無論往何處去盡都亨通。他背叛、不肯事奉亞述王。
verses.e: The LORD was with him . Wherever he went , he prospered . He rebelled against the king of Assyria , and didn't serve him .

verses.z: 希西家攻擊非利士人，直到迦薩，並迦薩的四境，從瞭望樓到堅固城。
verses.e: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders , from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city .

verses.z: 希西家王第四年，就是以色列王以拉的兒子何細亞第七年，亞述王撒縵以色上來圍困撒馬利亞；
verses.e: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah , which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it .

verses.z: 希西家王聽見，就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，進了耶和華的殿；
verses.e: When King Hezekiah heard it , he tore his clothes , covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the LORD's house .

verses.z: 「你們對猶大王希西家如此說：『不要聽你所倚靠的上帝欺哄你，說耶路撒冷必不交在亞述王的手中。
verses.e: " Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this : ' Don't let your God in whom you trust deceive you , saying , Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria .

verses.z: 你總聽說亞述諸王向列國所行的，乃是盡行滅絕，難道你還能得救嗎？
verses.e: Behold , you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly . Will you be delivered ?

verses.z: 我列祖所毀滅的，就是歌散、哈蘭、利色，和屬提‧拉撒的伊甸人，這些國的神何曾拯救這些國呢？
verses.e: Have the gods of the nations delivered them , which my fathers have destroyed — Gozan , Haran , Rezeph , and the children of Eden who were in Telassar ?

verses.z: 哈馬的王、亞珥拔的王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿，和以瓦的王都在哪裏呢？』」
verses.e: Where is the king of Hamath , the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivvah ? ' "

verses.z: 希西家從使者手裏接過書信來，看完了，就上耶和華的殿，將書信在耶和華面前展開。
verses.e: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it . Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD's house , and spread it before the LORD .

verses.z: 希西家向耶和華禱告說：「坐在二基路伯上耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，你是天下萬國的上帝，你曾創造天地。
verses.e: Hezekiah prayed before the LORD , and said , " LORD , the God of Israel , who are enthroned above the cherubim , you are the God , even you alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth . You have made heaven and earth .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你側耳而聽！耶和華啊，求你睜眼而看！要聽西拿基立打發使者來辱罵永生上帝的話。
verses.e: Incline your ear , LORD , and hear . Open your eyes , LORD , and see . Hear the words of Sennacherib , which he has sent to defy the living God .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，亞述諸王果然使列國和列國之地變為荒涼，
verses.e: Truly , LORD , the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands ,

verses.z: 將列國的神像都扔在火裏；因為它本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木頭石頭的，所以滅絕它。
verses.e: and have cast their gods into the fire ; for they were no gods , but the work of men's hands , wood and stone . Therefore they have destroyed them .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，現在求你救我們脫離亞述王的手，使天下萬國都知道惟獨你－耶和華是上帝！」
verses.e: Now therefore , LORD our God , save us , I beg you , out of his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you , LORD , are God alone . "

verses.z: 使家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並祭司中的長老，都披上麻布，去見亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞，
verses.e: He sent Eliakim , who was over the household , Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests , covered with sackcloth , to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz .

verses.z: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞就打發人去見希西家，說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『你既然求我攻擊亞述王西拿基立，我已聽見了。』
verses.e: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , " The LORD , the God of Israel , says ' You have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria , and I have heard you .

verses.z: 耶和華論他這樣說：錫安的處女藐視你，嗤笑你；耶路撒冷的女子向你搖頭。
verses.e: This is the word that the LORD has spoken concerning him : ' The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you . The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you .

verses.z: 你辱罵誰？褻瀆誰？揚起聲來，高舉眼目攻擊誰呢？乃是攻擊以色列的聖者！
verses.e: Whom have you defied and blasphemed ? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high ? Against the Holy One of Israel !

verses.z: 你藉你的使者辱罵主，並說：我率領許多戰車上山頂，到黎巴嫩極深之處；我要砍伐其中高大的香柏樹和佳美的松樹；我必上極高之處，進入肥田的樹林。
verses.e: By your messengers , you have defied the Lord , and have said , " With the multitude of my chariots , I have come up to the height of the mountains , to the innermost parts of Lebanon , and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees ; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place , the forest of his fruitful field .

verses.z: 我已經在外邦挖井喝水；我必用腳掌踏乾埃及的一切河。
verses.e: I have dug and drunk strange waters , and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet . "

verses.z: [耶和華說]，我早先所做的，古時所立的，就是現在藉你使堅固城荒廢，變為亂堆，這事你豈沒有聽見嗎？
verses.e: Haven't you heard how I have done it long ago , and formed it of ancient times ? Now I have brought it to pass , that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps .

verses.z: 所以其中的居民力量甚小，驚惶羞愧。他們像野草，像青菜，如房頂上的草，又如未長成而枯乾的禾稼。
verses.e: Therefore their inhabitants had little power . They were dismayed and confounded . They were like the grass of the field and like the green herb , like the grass on the housetops and like grain blasted before it has grown up .

verses.z: 你坐下，你出去，你進來，你向我發烈怒，我都知道。
verses.e: But I know your sitting down , your going out , your coming in , and your raging against me .

verses.z: 因你向我發烈怒，又因你狂傲[的話]達到我耳中，我就要用鉤子鉤上你的鼻子，把嚼環放在你口裏，使你從你來的路轉回去。
verses.e: Because of your raging against me , and because your arrogance has come up into my ears , therefore I will put my hook in your nose , and my bridle in your lips , and I will turn you back by the way by which you came . '

verses.z: 「以色列人哪，我賜你們一個證據：你們今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自長的；至於後年，你們要耕種收割，栽植葡萄園，吃其中的果子。
verses.e: " This will be the sign to you : This year , you will eat that which grows of itself , and in the second year that which springs from that ; and in the third year sow and reap , and plant vineyards and eat their fruit .

verses.z: 對他說：「希西家如此說：『今日是急難、責罰、凌辱的日子，就如婦人將要生產嬰孩，卻沒有力量生產。
verses.e: They said to him , " Hezekiah says , ' Today is a day of trouble , of rebuke , and of rejection ; for the children have come to the point of birth , and there is no strength to deliver them .

verses.z: 猶大家所逃脫餘剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上結果。
verses.e: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward , and bear fruit upward .

verses.z: 必有餘剩的民從耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脫的人從錫安山而來。耶和華的熱心必成就這事。
verses.e: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out , and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape . The LORD's zeal will perform this .

verses.z: 「所以，耶和華論亞述王如此說：『他必不得來到這城，也不在這裏射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不築壘攻城。
verses.e: " Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria , ' He will not come to this city , nor shoot an arrow there . He will not come before it with shield , nor cast up a mound against it .

verses.z: 他從哪條路來，必從那條路回去，必不得來到這城。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: He will return the same way that he came , and he will not come to this city , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 因我為自己的緣故，又為我僕人大衛的緣故，必保護拯救這城。』」
verses.e: ' For I will defend this city to save it , for my own sake and for my servant David's sake . ' "

verses.z: 當夜，耶和華的使者出去，在亞述營中殺了十八萬五千人。清早有人起來，一看，都是死屍了。
verses.e: That night , the LORD's angel went out and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians . When men arose early in the morning , behold , these were all dead bodies .

verses.z: 亞述王西拿基立就拔營回去，住在尼尼微。
verses.e: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , went home , and lived at Nineveh .

verses.z: 一日在他的神尼斯洛廟裏叩拜，[他兒子]亞得米勒和沙利色用刀殺了他，就逃到亞拉臘地。他兒子以撒哈頓接續他作王。
verses.e: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god , Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword ; and they escaped into the land of Ararat . Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 或者耶和華－你的上帝聽見拉伯沙基的一切話，就是他主人亞述王打發他來辱罵永生上帝的話，耶和華－你的上帝聽見這話，就發斥責。故此，求你為餘剩的民揚聲禱告。』」
verses.e: It may be the LORD your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God , and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard . Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left . ' "

verses.z: 希西家王的臣僕就去見以賽亞。
verses.e: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah .

verses.z: 以賽亞對他們說：「要這樣對你們的主人說，耶和華如此說：『你聽見亞述王的僕人褻瀆我的話，不要懼怕。
verses.e: Isaiah said to them , " Tell your master this : ' The LORD says , " Don't be afraid of the words that you have heard , with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .

verses.z: 我必驚動他的心，他要聽見風聲就歸回本地。我必使他在那裏倒在刀下。』」
verses.e: Behold , I will put a spirit in him , and he will hear news , and will return to his own land . I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land . " ' "

verses.z: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇見亞述王攻打立拿，原來他早聽見亞述王拔營離開拉吉。
verses.e: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah ; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish .

verses.z: 亞述王聽見人論古實王特哈加說：「他出來要與你爭戰。」於是亞述王又打發使者去見希西家，吩咐他們說：
verses.e: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , " Behold , he has come out to fight against you , " he sent messengers again to Hezekiah , saying ,

verses.z: 耶和華要用旋風接以利亞升天的時候，以利亞與以利沙從吉甲前往。
verses.e: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven , Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal .

verses.z: 以利亞說：「你所求的難得。[雖然如此]，我被接去離開你的時候，你若看見我，就必得着；不然，必得不着了。」
verses.e: He said , " You have asked a hard thing . If you see me when I am taken from you , it will be so for you ; but if not , it will not be so . "

verses.z: 他們正走着說話，忽有火車火馬將二人隔開，以利亞就乘旋風升天去了。
verses.e: As they continued on and talked , behold , a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them ; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven .

verses.z: 以利沙看見，就呼叫說：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的戰車馬兵啊！」以後不再見他了。於是以利沙把自己的衣服撕為兩片。
verses.e: Elisha saw it , and he cried , " My father , my father , the chariots of Israel and its horsemen ! " He saw him no more . Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces .

verses.z: 他拾起以利亞身上掉下來的外衣，回去站在約旦河邊。
verses.e: He also took up Elijah's mantle that fell from him , and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan .

verses.z: 他用以利亞身上掉下來的外衣打水，說：「耶和華－以利亞的上帝在哪裏呢？」打水之後，水也左右分開，以利沙就過來了。
verses.e: He took Elijah's mantle that fell from him , and struck the waters , and said , " Where is the LORD , the God of Elijah ? " When he also had struck the waters , they were divided apart , and Elisha went over .

verses.z: 住耶利哥的先知門徒從對面看見他，就說：「[感動]以利亞的靈感動以利沙了。」他們就來迎接他，在他面前俯伏於地，
verses.e: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him , they said , " The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha . " They came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .

verses.z: 對他說：「僕人們這裏有五十個壯士，求你容他們去尋找你師傅，或者耶和華的靈將他提起來，投在某山某谷。」以利沙說：「你們不必打發人去。」
verses.e: They said to him , " See now , there are with your servants fifty strong men . Please let them go and seek your master . Perhaps the LORD's Spirit has taken him up , and put him on some mountain or into some valley . " He said , " Don't send them . "

verses.z: 他們再三催促他，他難以推辭，就說：「你們打發人去吧！」他們便打發五十人去，尋找了三天，也沒有找着。
verses.e: When they urged him until he was ashamed , he said , " Send them . " Therefore they sent fifty men ; and they searched for three days , but didn't find him .

verses.z: 以利沙仍然在耶利哥等候他們回到他那裏；他對他們說：「我豈沒有告訴你們不必去嗎？」
verses.e: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho ; and he said to them , " Didn't I tell you , ' Don't go ' ? "

verses.z: 耶利哥城的人對以利沙說：「這城的地勢美好，我主看見了；只是水惡劣，土產不熟而落。」
verses.e: The men of the city said to Elisha , " Behold , please , the situation of this city is pleasant , as my lord sees ; but the water is bad , and the land is barren . "

verses.z: 以利亞對以利沙說：「耶和華差我往伯特利去，你可以在這裏等候。」以利沙說：「我指着永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不離開你。」於是二人下到伯特利。
verses.e: Elijah said to Elisha , " Please wait here , for the LORD has sent me as far as Bethel . " Elisha said , " As the LORD lives , and as your soul lives , I will not leave you . " So they went down to Bethel .

verses.z: 以利沙說：「你們拿一個新瓶來，裝鹽給我」；他們就拿來給他。
verses.e: He said , " Bring me a new jar , and put salt in it . " Then they brought it to him .

verses.z: 他出到水源，將鹽倒在水中，說：「耶和華如此說：『我治好了這水，從此必不再使人死，也不再使地土不生產。』」
verses.e: He went out to the spring of the waters , and threw salt into it , and said , " The LORD says , ' I have healed these waters . There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland . ' "

verses.z: 於是那水治好了，直到今日，正如以利沙所說的。
verses.e: So the waters were healed to this day , according to Elisha's word which he spoke .

verses.z: 以利沙從那裏上伯特利去，正上去的時候，有些童子從城裏出來，戲笑他說：「禿頭的上去吧！禿頭的上去吧！」
verses.e: He went up from there to Bethel . As he was going up by the way , some youths came out of the city and mocked him , and said to him , " Go up , you baldy ! Go up , you baldy ! "

verses.z: 他回頭看見，就奉耶和華的名咒詛他們。於是有兩個母熊從林中出來，撕裂他們中間四十二個童子。
verses.e: He looked behind him and saw them , and cursed them in the LORD's name . Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths .

verses.z: 以利沙從伯特利上迦密山，又從迦密山回到撒馬利亞。
verses.e: He went from there to Mount Carmel , and from there he returned to Samaria .

verses.z: 住伯特利的先知門徒出來見以利沙，對他說：「耶和華今日要接你的師傅離開你，你知道不知道？」他說：「我知道，你們不要作聲。」
verses.e: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha , and said to him , " Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today ? " He said , " Yes , I know it . Hold your peace . "

verses.z: 以利亞對以利沙說：「耶和華差遣我往耶利哥去，你可以在這裏等候。」以利沙說：「我指着永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不離開你。」於是二人到了耶利哥。
verses.e: Elijah said to him , " Elisha , please wait here , for the LORD has sent me to Jericho . " He said , " As the LORD lives , and as your soul lives , I will not leave you . " So they came to Jericho .

verses.z: 住耶利哥的先知門徒就近以利沙，對他說：「耶和華今日要接你的師傅離開你，你知道不知道？」他說：「我知道，你們不要作聲。」
verses.e: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha , and said to him , " Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today ? " He answered , " Yes , I know it . Hold your peace . "

verses.z: 以利亞對以利沙說：「耶和華差遣我往約旦河去，你可以在這裏等候。」以利沙說：「我指着永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不離開你。」於是二人一同前往。
verses.e: Elijah said to him , " Please wait here , for the LORD has sent me to the Jordan . " He said , " As the LORD lives , and as your soul lives , I will not leave you . " Then they both went on .

verses.z: 有先知門徒去了五十人，遠遠地站在他們對面；二人在約旦河邊站住。
verses.e: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance ; and they both stood by the Jordan .

verses.z: 以利亞將自己的外衣捲起來，用以打水，水就左右分開，二人走乾地而過。
verses.e: Elijah took his mantle , and rolled it up , and struck the waters ; and they were divided here and there , so that they both went over on dry ground .

verses.z: 過去之後，以利亞對以利沙說：「我未曾被接去離開你，你要我為你做甚麼，只管求我。」以利沙說：「願[感動]你的靈加倍地感動我。」
verses.e: When they had gone over , Elijah said to Elisha , " Ask what I shall do for you , before I am taken from you . " Elisha said , " Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me . "

verses.z: 那時，希西家病得要死。亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞去見他，對他說：「耶和華如此說：『你當留遺命與你的家，因為你必死，不能活了。』」
verses.e: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying . Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him , and said to him , " The LORD says , ' Set your house in order ; for you will die , and not live . ' "

verses.z: 希西家回答說：「日影向前進十度容易，我要日影往後退十度。」
verses.e: Hezekiah answered , " It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps . No , but let the shadow return backward ten steps . "

verses.z: 先知以賽亞求告耶和華，耶和華就使亞哈斯的日晷向前進的日影，往後退了十度。
verses.e: Isaiah the prophet cried to the LORD ; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward , by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz .

verses.z: 那時，巴比倫王巴拉但的兒子米羅達‧巴拉但聽見希西家病而痊癒，就送書信和禮物給他。
verses.e: At that time Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present to Hezekiah , for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick .

verses.z: 希西家聽從使者的話，就把他寶庫的金子、銀子、香料、貴重的膏油，和他武庫的一切軍器，並他所有的財寶，都給他們看。他家中和他全國之內，希西家沒有一樣不給他們看的。
verses.e: Hezekiah listened to them , and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things — the silver , the gold , the spices , and the precious oil , and the house of his armor , and all that was found in his treasures . There was nothing in his house , or in all his dominion , that Hezekiah didn't show them .

verses.z: 於是先知以賽亞來見希西家王，問他說：「這些人說甚麼？他們從哪裏來見你？」希西家說：「他們從遠方的巴比倫來。」
verses.e: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah , and said to him , " What did these men say ? From where did they come to you ? " Hezekiah said , " They have come from a far country , even from Babylon . "

verses.z: 以賽亞說：「他們在你家裏看見了甚麼？」希西家說：「凡我家中所有的，他們都看見了；我財寶中沒有一樣不給他們看的。」
verses.e: He said , " What have they seen in your house ? " Hezekiah answered , " They have seen all that is in my house . There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them . "

verses.z: 以賽亞對希西家說：「你要聽耶和華的話，
verses.e: Isaiah said to Hezekiah , " Hear the LORD's word .

verses.z: 日子必到，凡你家裏所有的，並你列祖積蓄到如今的，都要被擄到巴比倫去，不留下一樣。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: ' Behold , the days come that all that is in your house , and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day , will be carried to Babylon . Nothing will be left , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 並且從你本身所生的眾子，其中必有被擄去在巴比倫王宮裏當太監的。」
verses.e: ' They will take away some of your sons who will issue from you , whom you will father ; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon . ' "

verses.z: 希西家對以賽亞說：「你所說耶和華的話甚好！若在我的年日中有太平和穩固的景況，豈不是好嗎？」
verses.e: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah , " The LORD's word which you have spoken is good . " He said moreover , " Isn't it so , if peace and truth will be in my days ? "

verses.z: 希西家就轉臉朝牆，禱告耶和華說：
verses.e: Then he turned his face to the wall , and prayed to the LORD , saying ,

verses.z: 希西家其餘的事和他的勇力，他怎樣挖池、挖溝、引水入城，都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and all his might , and how he made the pool , and the conduit , and brought water into the city , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 希西家與他列祖同睡。他兒子瑪拿西接續他作王。
verses.e: Hezekiah slept with his fathers , and Manasseh his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 「耶和華啊，求你記念我在你面前怎樣存完全的心，按誠實行事，又做你眼中所看為善的。」希西家就痛哭了。
verses.e: " Remember now , LORD , I beg you , how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in your sight . " And Hezekiah wept bitterly .

verses.z: 以賽亞出來，還沒有到中院，耶和華的話就臨到他，說：
verses.e: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city , the LORD's word came to him , saying ,

verses.z: 「你回去告訴我民的君希西家說：耶和華－你祖大衛的上帝如此說：『我聽見了你的禱告，看見了你的眼淚，我必醫治你；到第三日，你必上到耶和華的殿。
verses.e: " Turn back , and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people , ' The LORD , the God of David your father , says , " I have heard your prayer . I have seen your tears . Behold , I will heal you . On the third day , you will go up to the LORD's house .

verses.z: 我必加增你十五年的壽數，並且我要救你和這城脫離亞述王的手。我為自己和我僕人大衛的緣故，必保護這城。』」
verses.e: I will add to your days fifteen years . I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria . I will defend this city for my own sake , and for my servant David's sake . " ' "

verses.z: 以賽亞說：「當取一塊無花果餅來。」人就取了來，貼在瘡上，王便痊癒了。
verses.e: Isaiah said , " Take a cake of figs . " They took and laid it on the boil , and he recovered .

verses.z: 希西家問以賽亞說：「耶和華必醫治我，到第三日，我能上耶和華的殿，有甚麼兆頭呢？」
verses.e: Hezekiah said to Isaiah , " What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me , and that I will go up to the LORD's house the third day ? "

verses.z: 以賽亞說：「耶和華必成就他所說的。這是他給你的兆頭：你要日影向前進十度呢？是要往後退十度呢？」
verses.e: Isaiah said , " This will be the sign to you from the LORD , that the LORD will do the thing that he has spoken : should the shadow go forward ten steps , or go back ten steps ? "

verses.z: 瑪拿西登基的時候年十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母親名叫協西巴。
verses.e: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Hephzibah .

verses.z: 耶和華藉他僕人眾先知說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke by his servants the prophets , saying ,

verses.z: 「因猶大王瑪拿西行這些可憎的惡事比先前亞摩利人所行的更甚，使猶大人拜他的偶像，陷在罪裏；
verses.e: " Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations , and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did , who were before him , and has also made Judah to sin with his idols ;

verses.z: 所以耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：我必降禍與耶路撒冷和猶大，叫一切聽見的人無不耳鳴。
verses.e: therefore the LORD the God of Israel says , ' Behold , I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it , both his ears will tingle .

verses.z: 我必用量撒馬利亞的準繩和亞哈家的線鉈拉在耶路撒冷上，必擦淨耶路撒冷，如人擦盤，將盤倒扣。
verses.e: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plumb line of Ahab's house ; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish , wiping it and turning it upside down .

verses.z: 我必棄掉所餘剩的子民，把他們交在仇敵手中，使他們成為一切仇敵擄掠之物；
verses.e: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies . They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies ,

verses.z: 是因他們自從列祖出埃及直到如今，常行我眼中看為惡的事，惹動我的怒氣。」
verses.e: because they have done that which is evil in my sight , and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt , even to this day . ' "

verses.z: 瑪拿西行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，使猶大人陷在罪裏，又流許多無辜人的血，充滿了耶路撒冷，從這邊直到那邊。
verses.e: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much , until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another ; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin , in doing that which was evil in the LORD's sight .

verses.z: 瑪拿西其餘的事，凡他所行的和他所犯的罪都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and all that he did , and his sin that he sinned , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 瑪拿西與他列祖同睡，葬在自己宮院烏撒的園內；他兒子亞們接續他作王。
verses.e: Manasseh slept with his fathers , and was buried in the garden of his own house , in the garden of Uzza ; and Amon his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 亞們登基的時候年二十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母親名叫米舒利密，是約提巴人哈魯斯的女兒。
verses.e: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign ; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah .

verses.z: 瑪拿西行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法耶和華在以色列人面前趕出的外邦人所行可憎的事。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel .

verses.z: 亞們行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，與他父親瑪拿西所行的一樣；
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , as Manasseh his father did .

verses.z: 行他父親一切所行的，敬奉他父親所敬奉的偶像，
verses.e: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in , and served the idols that his father served , and worshiped them ;

verses.z: 離棄耶和華－他列祖的上帝，不遵行耶和華的道。
verses.e: and he abandoned the LORD , the God of his fathers , and didn't walk in the way of the LORD .

verses.z: 亞們王的臣僕背叛他，在宮裏殺了他。
verses.e: The servants of Amon conspired against him , and put the king to death in his own house .

verses.z: 但國民殺了那些背叛亞們王的人，立他兒子約西亞接續他作王。
verses.e: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place .

verses.z: 亞們其餘所行的事都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 亞們葬在烏撒的園內自己的墳墓裏。他兒子約西亞接續他作王。
verses.e: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza , and Josiah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 重新建築他父希西家所毀壞的邱壇，又為巴力築壇，做亞舍拉像，效法以色列王亞哈所行的，且敬拜事奉天上的萬象；
verses.e: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed ; and he raised up altars for Baal , and made an Asherah , as Ahab king of Israel did , and worshiped all the army of the sky , and served them .

verses.z: 在耶和華殿宇中築壇。耶和華曾指着這殿說：「我必立我的名在耶路撒冷。」
verses.e: He built altars in the LORD's house , of which the LORD said , " I will put my name in Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 他在耶和華殿的兩院中為天上的萬象築壇，
verses.e: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 並使他的兒子經火，又觀兆，用法術，立交鬼的和行巫術的，多行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，惹動他的怒氣；
verses.e: He made his son to pass through the fire , practiced sorcery , used enchantments , and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards . He did much evil in the LORD's sight , to provoke him to anger .

verses.z: 又在殿內立雕刻的亞舍拉像。耶和華曾對大衛和他兒子所羅門說：「我在以色列眾支派中所選擇的耶路撒冷和這殿，必立我的名，直到永遠。
verses.e: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which the LORD said to David and to Solomon his son , " In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , I will put my name forever ;

verses.z: 以色列人若謹守遵行我一切所吩咐他們的和我僕人摩西所吩咐他們的一切律法，我就不再使他們挪移離開我所賜給他們列祖之地。」
verses.e: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers , if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them , and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them . "

verses.z: 他們卻不聽從。瑪拿西引誘他們行惡，比耶和華在以色列人面前所滅的列國更甚。
verses.e: But they didn't listen , and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel .

verses.z: 約西亞登基的時候年八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母親名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亞大雅的女兒。
verses.e: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath .

verses.z: 書記沙番又對王說：「祭司希勒家遞給我一卷書。」沙番就在王面前讀那書。
verses.e: Shaphan the scribe told the king , saying , " Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me . " Then Shaphan read it before the king .

verses.z: 王聽見律法書上的話，便撕裂衣服，
verses.e: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law , he tore his clothes .

verses.z: 吩咐祭司希勒家與沙番的兒子亞希甘、米該亞的兒子亞革波、書記沙番和王的臣僕亞撒雅，說：
verses.e: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest , Ahikam the son of Shaphan , Achbor the son of Micaiah , Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah the king's servant , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們去為我、為民、為猶大眾人，以這書上的話求問耶和華；因為我們列祖沒有聽從這書上的言語，沒有遵着書上所吩咐我們的去行，耶和華就向我們大發烈怒。」
verses.e: " Go inquire of the LORD for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found ; for great is the LORD's wrath that is kindled against us , because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book , to do according to all that which is written concerning us . "

verses.z: 於是，祭司希勒家和亞希甘、亞革波、沙番、亞撒雅都去見女先知戶勒大。戶勒大是掌管禮服沙龍的妻；沙龍是哈珥哈斯的孫子、特瓦的兒子。戶勒大住在耶路撒冷第二區。他們請問於她。
verses.e: So Hilkiah the priest , Ahikam , Achbor , Shaphan , and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah , the son of Harhas , keeper of the wardrobe ( now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter ) ; and they talked with her .

verses.z: 她對他們說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『你們可以回覆那差遣你們來見我的人說，
verses.e: She said to them , " The LORD the God of Israel says , ' Tell the man who sent you to me ,

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：我必照着猶大王所讀那書上的一切話，降禍與這地和其上的居民。
verses.e: " The LORD says , ' Behold , I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants , even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read .

verses.z: 因為他們離棄我，向別神燒香，用他們手所做的惹我發怒，所以我的忿怒必向這地發作，總不止息。』
verses.e: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands , therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place , and it will not be quenched . ' "

verses.z: 然而，差遣你們來求問耶和華的猶大王，你們要這樣回覆他說：『耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：至於你所聽見的話，
verses.e: But to the king of Judah , who sent you to inquire of the LORD , tell him , " The LORD the God of Israel says , ' Concerning the words which you have heard ,

verses.z: 就是聽見我指着這地和其上的居民所說、要使這地變為荒場、民受咒詛的話，你便心裏敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我應允了你。這是我－耶和華說的。
verses.e: because your heart was tender , and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants , that they should become a desolation and a curse , and have torn your clothes and wept before me , I also have heard you , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 約西亞行耶和華眼中看為正的事，行他祖大衛一切所行的，不偏左右。
verses.e: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes , and walked in all the ways of David his father , and didn't turn away to the right hand or to the left .

verses.z: 我必使你平平安安地歸到墳墓到你列祖那裏；我要降與這地的一切災禍，你也不致親眼看見。』」他們就回覆王去了。
verses.e: ' Therefore behold , I will gather you to your fathers , and you will be gathered to your grave in peace . Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place . ' " ' " So they brought this message back to the king .

verses.z: 約西亞王十八年，王差遣米書蘭的孫子、亞薩利的兒子－書記沙番上耶和華殿去，吩咐他說：
verses.e: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah , the king sent Shaphan , the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam , the scribe , to the LORD's house , saying ,

verses.z: 「你去見大祭司希勒家，使他將奉到耶和華殿的銀子，就是守門的從民中收聚的銀子，數算數算，
verses.e: " Go up to Hilkiah the high priest , that he may count the money which is brought into the LORD's house , which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people .

verses.z: 交給耶和華殿裏辦事的人，使他們轉交耶和華殿裏做工的人，好修理殿的破壞之處，
verses.e: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of the LORD's house ; and let them give it to the workers who are in the LORD's house , to repair the damage to the house ,

verses.z: 就是轉交木匠和工人，並瓦匠，又買木料和鑿成的石頭修理殿宇，
verses.e: to the carpenters , and to the builders , and to the masons , and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house .

verses.z: 將銀子交在辦事的人手裏，不與他們算帳，因為他們辦事誠實。」
verses.e: However , no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand , for they deal faithfully . "

verses.z: 大祭司希勒家對書記沙番說：「我在耶和華殿裏得了律法書。」希勒家將書遞給沙番，沙番就看了。
verses.e: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe , " I have found the book of the law in the LORD's house . " Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan , and he read it .

verses.z: 書記沙番到王那裏，回覆王說：「你的僕人已將殿裏的銀子倒出數算，交給耶和華殿裏辦事的人了。」
verses.e: Shaphan the scribe came to the king , and brought the king word again , and said , " Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house , and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of the LORD's house . "

verses.z: 王差遣人招聚猶大和耶路撒冷的眾長老來。
verses.e: The king sent , and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 又污穢欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不許人在那裏使兒女經火獻給摩洛；
verses.e: He defiled Topheth , which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom , that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech .

verses.z: 又將猶大列王在耶和華殿門旁、太監拿單‧米勒靠近遊廊的屋子、向日頭所獻的馬廢去，且用火焚燒日車。
verses.e: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun , at the entrance of the LORD's house , by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court ; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire .

verses.z: 猶大列王在亞哈斯樓頂上所築的壇和瑪拿西在耶和華殿兩院中所築的壇，王都拆毀打碎了，就把灰倒在汲淪溪中。
verses.e: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz , which the kings of Judah had made , and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the LORD's house , and beat them down from there , and cast their dust into the brook Kidron .

verses.z: 從前以色列王所羅門在耶路撒冷前、邪僻山右邊為西頓人可憎的神亞斯她錄、摩押人可憎的神基抹、亞捫人可憎的神米勒公所築的邱壇，王都污穢了，
verses.e: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem , which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption , which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians , and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab , and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 又打碎柱像，砍下木偶，將人的骨頭充滿了那地方。
verses.e: He broke in pieces the pillars , cut down the Asherah poles , and filled their places with men's bones .

verses.z: 他將伯特利的壇，就是叫以色列人陷在罪裏、尼八的兒子耶羅波安所築的那壇，都拆毀焚燒，打碎成灰，並焚燒了亞舍拉。
verses.e: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , even that altar and the high place he broke down ; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust , and burned the Asherah .

verses.z: 約西亞回頭，看見山上的墳墓，就打發人將墳墓裏的骸骨取出來，燒在壇上，污穢了壇，正如從前神人宣傳耶和華的話。
verses.e: As Josiah turned himself , he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain ; and he sent , and took the bones out of the tombs , and burned them on the altar , and defiled it , according to the LORD's word which the man of God proclaimed , who proclaimed these things .

verses.z: 約西亞問說：「我所看見的是甚麼碑？」那城裏的人回答說：「先前有神人從猶大來，預先說王現在向伯特利壇所行的事，這就是他的墓碑。」
verses.e: Then he said , " What monument is that which I see ? " The men of the city told him , " It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel . "

verses.z: 約西亞說：「由他吧！不要挪移他的骸骨。」他們就不動他的骸骨，也不動從撒馬利亞來那先知的骸骨。
verses.e: He said , " Let him be ! Let no one move his bones . " So they let his bones alone , with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria .

verses.z: 從前以色列諸王在撒馬利亞的城邑建築邱壇的殿，惹動[耶和華]的怒氣，現在約西亞都廢去了，就如他在伯特利所行的一般；
verses.e: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria , which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger , Josiah took away , and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel .

verses.z: 王和猶大眾人與耶路撒冷的居民，並祭司、先知，和所有的百姓，無論大小，都一同上到耶和華的殿；王就把耶和華殿裏所得的約書念給他們聽。
verses.e: The king went up to the LORD's house , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him — with the priests , the prophets , and all the people , both small and great ; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 又將邱壇的祭司都殺在壇上，並在壇上燒人的骨頭，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there , on the altars , and burned men's bones on them ; and he returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 王吩咐眾民說：「你們當照這約書上所寫的，向耶和華－你們的上帝守逾越節。」
verses.e: The king commanded all the people , saying , " Keep the Passover to the LORD your God , as it is written in this book of the covenant . "

verses.z: 自從士師治理以色列人和以色列王、猶大王的時候，[直到如今]，實在沒有守過這樣的逾越節；
verses.e: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel , nor in all the days of the kings of Israel , nor of the kings of Judah ;

verses.z: 只有約西亞王十八年在耶路撒冷向耶和華守這逾越節。
verses.e: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah , this Passover was kept to the LORD in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 凡猶大國和耶路撒冷所有交鬼的、行巫術的，與家中的神像和偶像，並一切可憎之物，約西亞盡都除掉，成就了祭司希勒家在耶和華殿裏所得律法書上所寫的話。
verses.e: Moreover , Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits , the wizards , and the teraphim , and the idols , and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem , that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 在約西亞以前沒有王像他盡心、盡性、盡力地歸向耶和華，遵行摩西的一切律法；在他以後也沒有興起一個王像他。
verses.e: There was no king like him before him , who turned to the LORD with all his heart , and with all his soul , and with all his might , according to all the law of Moses ; and there was none like him who arose after him .

verses.z: 然而，耶和華向猶大所發猛烈的怒氣仍不止息，是因瑪拿西諸事惹動他。
verses.e: Notwithstanding , the LORD didn't turn from the fierceness of his great wrath , with which his anger burned against Judah , because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我必將猶大人從我面前趕出，如同趕出以色列人一般；我必棄掉我從前所選擇的這城－耶路撒冷和我所說立我名的殿。」
verses.e: The LORD said , " I will also remove Judah out of my sight , as I have removed Israel ; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen , even Jerusalem , and the house of which I said , ' My name shall be there . ' "

verses.z: 約西亞其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 約西亞年間，埃及王法老尼哥上到幼發拉底河攻擊亞述王；約西亞王去抵擋他。埃及王遇見約西亞在米吉多，就殺了他。
verses.e: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates ; and King Josiah went against him , but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him .

verses.z: 王站在柱旁，在耶和華面前立約，要盡心盡性地順從耶和華，遵守他的誡命、法度、律例，成就這書上所記的約言。眾民都服從這約。
verses.e: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to walk after the LORD and to keep his commandments , his testimonies , and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul , to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book ; and all the people agreed to the covenant .

verses.z: 他的臣僕用車將他的屍首從米吉多送到耶路撒冷，葬在他自己的墳墓裏。國民膏約西亞的兒子約哈斯接續他父親作王。
verses.e: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo , brought him to Jerusalem , and buried him in his own tomb . The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and anointed him , and made him king in his father's place .

verses.z: 約哈斯登基的時候年二十三歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
verses.e: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .

verses.z: 約哈斯行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , according to all that his fathers had done .

verses.z: 法老尼哥將約哈斯鎖禁在哈馬地的利比拉，不許他在耶路撒冷作王，又罰[猶大]國銀子一百他連得，金子一他連得。
verses.e: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath , that he might not reign in Jerusalem ; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold .

verses.z: 法老尼哥立約西亞的兒子以利亞敬接續他父親約西亞作王，給他改名叫約雅敬，卻將約哈斯帶到埃及，他就死在那裏。
verses.e: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father , and changed his name to Jehoiakim ; but he took Jehoahaz away , and he came to Egypt and died there .

verses.z: 約雅敬將金銀給法老，遵着法老的命向國民徵取金銀，按着各人的力量派定，索要金銀，好給法老尼哥。
verses.e: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh ; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh . He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land , from everyone according to his assessment , to give it to Pharaoh Necoh .

verses.z: 約雅敬登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫西布大，是魯瑪人毗大雅的女兒。
verses.e: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah .

verses.z: 約雅敬行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , according to all that his fathers had done .

verses.z: 王吩咐大祭司希勒家和副祭司，並把門的，將那為巴力和亞舍拉，並天上萬象所造的器皿，都從耶和華殿裏搬出來，在耶路撒冷外汲淪溪旁的田間燒了，把灰拿到伯特利去。
verses.e: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the threshold , to bring out of the LORD's temple all the vessels that were made for Baal , for the Asherah , and for all the army of the sky ; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron , and carried their ashes to Bethel .

verses.z: 從前猶大列王所立拜偶像的祭司，在猶大城邑的邱壇和耶路撒冷的周圍燒香，現在王都廢去，又廢去向巴力和日、月、行星，並天上萬象燒香的人；
verses.e: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem ; those also who burned incense to Baal , to the sun , to the moon , to the planets , and to all the army of the sky .

verses.z: 又從耶和華殿裏將亞舍拉搬到耶路撒冷外汲淪溪邊焚燒，打碎成灰，將灰撒在平民的墳上；
verses.e: He brought out the Asherah from the LORD's house , outside of Jerusalem , to the brook Kidron , and burned it at the brook Kidron , and beat it to dust , and cast its dust on the graves of the common people .

verses.z: 又拆毀耶和華殿裏孌童的屋子，就是婦女為亞舍拉織帳子的屋子，
verses.e: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the LORD's house , where the women wove hangings for the Asherah .

verses.z: 並且從猶大的城邑帶眾祭司來，污穢祭司燒香的邱壇，從迦巴直到別是巴，又拆毀城門旁的邱壇，這邱壇在邑宰約書亞門前，進城門的左邊。
verses.e: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah , and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beersheba ; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city .

verses.z: 但是邱壇的祭司不登耶路撒冷耶和華的壇，只在他們弟兄中間吃無酵餅。
verses.e: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn't come up to the LORD's altar in Jerusalem , but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers .

verses.z: 約雅敬年間，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒上[到猶大]；約雅敬服事他三年，然後背叛他。
verses.e: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years . Then he turned and rebelled against him .

verses.z: 那時，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的軍兵上到耶路撒冷，圍困城。
verses.e: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem , and the city was besieged .

verses.z: 當他軍兵圍困城的時候，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒就親自來了。
verses.e: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it ,

verses.z: 猶大王約雅斤和他母親、臣僕、首領、太監一同出城，投降巴比倫王；巴比倫王便拿住他。那時是巴比倫王第八年。
verses.e: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon — he , his mother , his servants , his princes , and his officers ; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign .

verses.z: 巴比倫王將耶和華殿和王宮裏的寶物都拿去了，將以色列王所羅門所造耶和華殿裏的金器都毀壞了，正如耶和華所說的；
verses.e: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD's house and the treasures of the king's house , and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD's temple , as the LORD had said .

verses.z: 又將耶路撒冷的眾民和眾首領，並所有大能的勇士，共一萬人，連一切木匠、鐵匠都擄了去；除了國中極貧窮的人以外，沒有剩下的；
verses.e: He carried away all Jerusalem , and all the princes , and all the mighty men of valor , even ten thousand captives , and all the craftsmen and the smiths . No one remained except the poorest people of the land .

verses.z: 並將約雅斤和王母、后妃、太監，與國中的大官，都從耶路撒冷擄到巴比倫去了；
verses.e: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon , with the king's mother , the king's wives , his officers , and the chief men of the land . He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon .

verses.z: 又將一切勇士七千人和木匠、鐵匠一千人，都是能上陣的勇士，全擄到巴比倫去了。
verses.e: All the men of might , even seven thousand , and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand , all of them strong and fit for war , even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon .

verses.z: 巴比倫王立[約雅斤]的叔叔瑪探雅代替他作王，給瑪探雅改名叫西底家。
verses.e: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah , Jehoiachin's father's brother , king in his place , and changed his name to Zedekiah .

verses.z: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
verses.e: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .

verses.z: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .

verses.z: 耶和華使迦勒底軍、亞蘭軍、摩押軍，和亞捫人的軍來攻擊約雅敬，毀滅猶大，正如耶和華藉他僕人眾先知所說的。
verses.e: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans , bands of the Syrians , bands of the Moabites , and bands of the children of Ammon , and sent them against Judah to destroy it , according to the LORD's word which he spoke by his servants the prophets .

verses.z: 因此耶和華的怒氣在耶路撒冷和猶大發作，以致將人民從自己面前趕出。
verses.e: For through the anger of the LORD , this happened in Jerusalem and Judah , until he had cast them out from his presence . Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon .

verses.z: 這禍臨到猶大人，誠然是耶和華所命的，要將他們從自己面前趕出，是因瑪拿西所犯的一切罪；
verses.e: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah , to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh , according to all that he did ,

verses.z: 又因他流無辜人的血，充滿了耶路撒冷；耶和華決不肯赦免。
verses.e: and also for the innocent blood that he shed ; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood , and the LORD would not pardon .

verses.z: 約雅敬其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 約雅敬與他列祖同睡。他兒子約雅斤接續他作王。
verses.e: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers , and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 埃及王不再從他國中出來；因為巴比倫王將埃及王所管之地，從埃及小河直到幼發拉底河都奪去了。
verses.e: The king of Egypt didn't come out of his land any more ; for the king of Babylon had taken , from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates , all that belonged to the king of Egypt .

verses.z: 約雅斤登基的時候年十八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。他母親名叫尼護施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿單的女兒。
verses.e: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem three months . His mother's name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 約雅斤行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他父親一切所行的。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , according to all that his father had done .

verses.z: 西底家背叛巴比倫王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。
verses.e: In the ninth year of his reign , in the tenth month , in the tenth day of the month , Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came , he and all his army , against Jerusalem , and encamped against it ; and they built forts against it around it .

verses.z: 跟從護衛長迦勒底的全軍就拆毀耶路撒冷四圍的城牆。
verses.e: All the army of the Chaldeans , who were with the captain of the guard , broke down the walls around Jerusalem .

verses.z: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將城裏所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及大眾所剩下的人，都擄去了。
verses.e: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon — all the rest of the multitude .

verses.z: 但護衛長留下些民中最窮的，使他們修理葡萄園，耕種田地。
verses.e: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields .

verses.z: 耶和華殿的銅柱，並耶和華殿的[盆]座和銅海，迦勒底人都打碎了，將那銅運到巴比倫去了，
verses.e: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD's house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD's house , and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon .

verses.z: 又帶去鍋、鏟子、蠟剪、調羹，並所用的一切銅器，
verses.e: They took away the pots , the shovels , the snuffers , the spoons , and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered .

verses.z: 火鼎、碗，無論金的銀的，護衛長也都帶去了。
verses.e: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans , the basins , that which was of gold , for gold , and that which was of silver , for silver .

verses.z: 所羅門為耶和華殿所造的兩根[銅]柱、一個[銅]海，和幾個[盆]座，這一切的銅，多得無法可稱。
verses.e: The two pillars , the one sea , and the bases , which Solomon had made for the LORD's house , the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed .

verses.z: 這一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有銅頂，高三肘；銅頂的周圍有網子和石榴，都是銅的。那一根柱子，照此一樣，也有網子。
verses.e: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits , and a capital of bronze was on it . The height of the capital was three cubits , with network and pomegranates on the capital around it , all of bronze ; and the second pillar with its network was like these .

verses.z: 護衛長拿住大祭司西萊雅、副祭司西番亞，和三個把門的，
verses.e: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest , Zephaniah the second priest , and the three keepers of the threshold ;

verses.z: 又從城中拿住一個管理兵丁的官，並在城裏所遇常見王面的五個人和檢點國民軍長的書記，以及城裏遇見的國民六十個人。
verses.e: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war ; and five men of those who saw the king's face , who were found in the city ; and the scribe , the captain of the army , who mustered the people of the land , and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city .

verses.z: 於是城被圍困，直到西底家王十一年。
verses.e: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah .

verses.z: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦將這些人帶到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裏。
verses.e: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them , and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah .

verses.z: 巴比倫王就把他們擊殺在哈馬地的利比拉。這樣，猶大人被擄去離開本地。
verses.e: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath . So Judah was carried away captive out of his land .

verses.z: 至於猶大國剩下的民，就是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒所剩下的，巴比倫王立了沙番的孫子、亞希甘的兒子基大利作他們的省長。
verses.e: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left , even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , the son of Shaphan , governor .

verses.z: 眾軍長和屬他們的人聽見巴比倫王立了基大利作省長，於是軍長尼探雅的兒子以實瑪利、加利亞的兒子約哈難、尼陀法人單戶蔑的兒子西萊雅、瑪迦人的兒子雅撒尼亞，和屬他們的人都到米斯巴見基大利。
verses.e: Now when all the captains of the forces , they and their men , heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor , they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah , even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , Johanan the son of Kareah , Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite , and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite , they and their men .

verses.z: 基大利向他們和屬他們的人起誓說：「你們不必懼怕迦勒底臣僕，只管住在這地服事巴比倫王，就可以得福。」
verses.e: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men , and said to them , " Don't be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans . Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon , and it will be well with you . "

verses.z: 七月間，宗室以利沙瑪的孫子、尼探雅的兒子以實瑪利帶着十個人來，殺了基大利和同他在米斯巴的猶大人與迦勒底人。
verses.e: But in the seventh month , Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , the son of Elishama , of the royal offspring came , and ten men with him , and struck Gedaliah so that he died , with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah .

verses.z: 於是眾民，無論大小，連眾軍長；因為懼怕迦勒底人，都起身往埃及去了。
verses.e: All the people , both small and great , and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt ; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans .

verses.z: 猶大王約雅斤被擄後三十七年，巴比倫王以未‧米羅達元年十二月二十七日，使猶大王約雅斤抬頭，提他出監；
verses.e: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah , in the twelfth month , on the twenty-seventh day of the month , Evilmerodach king of Babylon , in the year that he began to reign , released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison ,

verses.z: 又對他說恩言，使他的位高過與他一同在巴比倫眾王的位，
verses.e: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon ,

verses.z: 給他脫了囚服。他終身常在[巴比倫]王面前吃飯。
verses.e: and changed his prison garments . Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life ;

verses.z: 四月初九日，城裏有大饑荒，甚至百姓都沒有糧食。
verses.e: On the ninth day of the fourth month , the famine was severe in the city , so that there was no bread for the people of the land .

verses.z: 王賜他所需用的食物，日日賜他一分，終身都是這樣。
verses.e: and for his allowance , there was a continual allowance given him from the king , every day a portion , all the days of his life .

verses.z: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜間從靠近王園兩城中間的門[逃跑]。迦勒底人正在四圍攻城，[王]就向亞拉巴逃走。
verses.e: Then a breach was made in the city , and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls , which was by the king's garden ( now the Chaldeans were against the city around it ) ; and the king went by the way of the Arabah .

verses.z: 迦勒底的軍隊追趕王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全軍都離開他四散了。
verses.e: But the Chaldean army pursued the king , and overtook him in the plains of Jericho ; and all his army was scattered from him .

verses.z: 迦勒底人就拿住王，帶他到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裏審判他。
verses.e: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah ; and they passed judgment on him .

verses.z: 在西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖着他，帶到巴比倫去。
verses.e: They killed Zedekiah's sons before his eyes , then put out Zedekiah's eyes , bound him in fetters , and carried him to Babylon .

verses.z: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比倫王的臣僕、護衛長尼布撒拉旦來到耶路撒冷，
verses.e: Now in the fifth month , on the seventh day of the month , which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard , a servant of the king of Babylon , came to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 用火焚燒耶和華的殿和王宮，又焚燒耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大戶家的房屋。
verses.e: He burned the LORD's house , the king's house , and all the houses of Jerusalem . He burned every great house with fire .

verses.z: 猶大王約沙法十八年，亞哈的兒子約蘭在撒馬利亞登基作了以色列王十二年。
verses.e: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned twelve years .

verses.z: 以色列王說：「哀哉！耶和華招聚我們這三王，乃要交在摩押人的手裏。」
verses.e: The king of Israel said , " Alas ! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab . "

verses.z: 約沙法說：「這裏不是有耶和華的先知嗎？我們可以託他求問耶和華。」以色列王的一個臣子回答說：「這裏有沙法的兒子以利沙，就是從前服事以利亞的。」
verses.e: But Jehoshaphat said , " Isn't there a prophet of the LORD here , that we may inquire of the LORD by him ? " One of the king of Israel's servants answered , " Elisha the son of Shaphat , who poured water on the hands of Elijah , is here . "

verses.z: 約沙法說：「他必有耶和華的話。」於是以色列王和約沙法，並以東王都下去見他。
verses.e: Jehoshaphat said , " The LORD's word is with him . " So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him .

verses.z: 以利沙對以色列王說：「我與你何干？去問你父親的先知和你母親的先知吧！」以色列王對他說：「不要這樣說，耶和華招聚我們這三王，乃要交在摩押人的手裏。」
verses.e: Elisha said to the king of Israel , " What have I to do with you ? Go to the prophets of your father , and to the prophets of your mother . " The king of Israel said to him , " No , for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab . "

verses.z: 以利沙說：「我指着所事奉永生的萬軍耶和華起誓，我若不看猶大王約沙法的情面，必不理你，不顧你。
verses.e: Elisha said , " As the LORD of Armies lives , before whom I stand , surely , were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , I would not look toward you , nor see you .

verses.z: 現在你們給我找一個彈琴的來。」彈琴的時候，耶和華的靈就降在以利沙身上。
verses.e: But now bring me a musician . " When the musician played , the LORD's hand came on him .

verses.z: 他便說：「耶和華如此說：『你們要在這谷中滿處挖溝；
verses.e: He said , " The LORD says , ' Make this valley full of trenches . '

verses.z: 因為耶和華如此說：你們雖不見風，不見雨，這谷必滿了水，使你們和牲畜有水喝。』
verses.e: For the LORD says , ' You will not see wind , neither will you see rain , yet that valley will be filled with water , and you will drink , both you and your livestock and your other animals .

verses.z: 在耶和華眼中這還算為小事，他也必將摩押人交在你們手中。
verses.e: This is an easy thing in the LORD's sight . He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand .

verses.z: 你們必攻破一切堅城美邑，砍伐各種佳樹，塞住一切水泉，用石頭糟踏一切美田。」
verses.e: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city , and shall fell every good tree , and stop all springs of water , and mar every good piece of land with stones . ' "

verses.z: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，但不致像他父母所行的，因為除掉他父所造巴力的柱像。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , but not like his father and like his mother , for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made .

verses.z: 次日早晨，約在獻祭的時候，有水從以東而來，遍地就滿了水。
verses.e: In the morning , about the time of offering the sacrifice , behold , water came by the way of Edom , and the country was filled with water .

verses.z: 摩押眾人聽見這三王上來要與他們爭戰，凡能頂盔貫甲的，無論老少，盡都聚集站在邊界上。
verses.e: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them , they gathered themselves together , all who were able to put on armor , young and old , and stood on the border .

verses.z: 次日早晨，日光照在水上，摩押人起來，看見對面水紅如血，
verses.e: They rose up early in the morning , and the sun shone on the water , and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood .

verses.z: 就說：「這是血啊！必是三王互相擊殺，俱都滅亡。摩押人哪，我們現在去搶奪財物吧！」
verses.e: They said , " This is blood . The kings are surely destroyed , and they have struck each other . Now therefore , Moab , to the plunder ! "

verses.z: 摩押人到了以色列營，以色列人就起來攻打他們，以致他們在以色列人面前逃跑。以色列人往前追殺摩押人，直殺入摩押的境內，
verses.e: When they came to the camp of Israel , the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites , so that they fled before them ; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites .

verses.z: 拆毀摩押的城邑，各人拋石填滿一切美田，塞住一切水泉，砍伐各種佳樹，只剩下吉珥‧哈列設的石[牆]；甩石的兵在四圍攻打那城。
verses.e: They beat down the cities ; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone , and filled it . They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees , until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones ; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it .

verses.z: 摩押王見陣勢甚大，難以對敵，就率領七百拿刀的兵，要衝過陣去到以東王那裏，卻是不能；
verses.e: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him , he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword , to break through to the king of Edom ; but they could not .

verses.z: 便將那應當接續他作王的長子，在城上獻為燔祭。以色列人遭遇[耶和華的]大怒，於是三王離開摩押王，各回本國去了。
verses.e: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place , and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall . There was great wrath against Israel ; and they departed from him , and returned to their own land .

verses.z: 然而，他貼近尼八的兒子耶羅波安使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，總不離開。
verses.e: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , with which he made Israel to sin . He didn't depart from them .

verses.z: 摩押王米沙牧養許多羊，[每年]將十萬羊羔的毛和十萬公綿羊的毛給以色列王進貢。
verses.e: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder ; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams .

verses.z: 亞哈死後，摩押王背叛以色列王。
verses.e: But when Ahab was dead , the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel .

verses.z: 那時約蘭王出撒馬利亞，數點以色列眾人。
verses.e: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time , and mustered all Israel .

verses.z: 前行的時候，差人去見猶大王約沙法，說：「摩押王背叛我，你肯同我去攻打摩押嗎？」他說：「我肯上去，你我不分彼此，我的民與你的民一樣，我的馬與你的馬一樣。」
verses.e: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , saying , " The king of Moab has rebelled against me . Will you go with me against Moab to battle ? " He said , " I will go up . I am as you are , my people as your people , my horses as your horses . "

verses.z: 約蘭說：「我們從哪條路上去呢？」回答說：「從以東曠野的路上去。」
verses.e: Then he said , " Which way shall we go up ? " Jehoram answered , " The way of the wilderness of Edom . "

verses.z: 於是，以色列王和猶大王，並以東王，都一同去繞行七日的路程；軍隊和所帶的牲畜沒有水喝。
verses.e: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom , and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route . There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them .

verses.z: 有一個先知門徒的妻哀求以利沙說：「你僕人－我丈夫死了，他敬畏耶和華是你所知道的。現在有債主來，要取我兩個兒子作奴僕。」
verses.e: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha , saying , " Your servant my husband is dead . You know that your servant feared the LORD . Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves . "

verses.z: 我們可以為他在牆上蓋一間小樓，在其中安放床榻、桌子、椅子、燈臺，他來到我們這裏，就可以住在其間。」
verses.e: Please , let's make a little room on the roof . Let's set a bed , a table , a chair , and a lamp stand for him there . When he comes to us , he can stay there . "

verses.z: 一日，以利沙來到那裏，就進了那樓躺臥。
verses.e: One day he came there , and he went to the room and lay there .

verses.z: 以利沙吩咐僕人基哈西說：「你叫這書念婦人來。」他就把婦人叫了來，婦人站在以利沙面前。
verses.e: He said to Gehazi his servant , " Call this Shunammite . " When he had called her , she stood before him .

verses.z: 以利沙吩咐僕人說：「你對她說：你既為我們費了許多心思，可以為你做甚麼呢？你向王或元帥有所求的沒有？」她回答說：「我在我本鄉安居無事。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Say now to her , ' Behold , you have cared for us with all this care . What is to be done for you ? Would you like to be spoken for to the king , or to the captain of the army ? ' " She answered , " I dwell among my own people . "

verses.z: 以利沙[對僕人]說：「究竟當為她做甚麼呢？」基哈西說：「她沒有兒子，她丈夫也老了。」
verses.e: He said , " What then is to be done for her ? " Gehazi answered , " Most certainly she has no son , and her husband is old . "

verses.z: 以利沙說：「再叫她來。」於是叫了她來，她就站在門口。
verses.e: He said , " Call her . " When he had called her , she stood in the door .

verses.z: 以利沙說：「明年到這時候，你必抱一個兒子。」她說：「神人，我主啊，不要那樣欺哄婢女。」
verses.e: He said , " At this season next year , you will embrace a son . " She said , " No , my lord , you man of God , do not lie to your servant . "

verses.z: 婦人果然懷孕，到了那時候，生了一個兒子，正如以利沙所說的。
verses.e: The woman conceived , and bore a son at that season when the time came around , as Elisha had said to her .

verses.z: 孩子漸漸長大，一日到他父親和收割的人那裏，
verses.e: When the child was grown , one day he went out to his father to the reapers .

verses.z: 他對父親說：「我的頭啊，我的頭啊！」他父親對僕人說：「把他抱到他母親那裏。」
verses.e: He said to his father , " My head ! My head ! " He said to his servant , " Carry him to his mother . "

verses.z: 以利沙問她說：「我可以為你做甚麼呢？你告訴我，你家裏有甚麼？」她說：「婢女家中除了一瓶油之外，沒有甚麼。」
verses.e: Elisha said to her , " What should I do for you ? Tell me , what do you have in the house ? " She said , " Your servant has nothing in the house , except a pot of oil . "

verses.z: 僕人抱去，交給他母親；孩子坐在母親的膝上，到晌午就死了。
verses.e: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees until noon , and then died .

verses.z: 他母親抱他上了樓，將他放在神人的床上，關上[門]出來，
verses.e: She went up and laid him on the man of God's bed , and shut the door on him , and went out .

verses.z: 呼叫她丈夫說：「你叫一個僕人給我牽一匹驢來，我要快快地去見神人，就回來。」
verses.e: She called to her husband and said , " Please send me one of the servants , and one of the donkeys , that I may run to the man of God and come again . "

verses.z: 丈夫說：「今日不是月朔，也不是安息日，你為何要去見他呢？」婦人說：「平安無事。」
verses.e: He said , " Why would you want to go to him today ? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath . " She said , " It's all right . "

verses.z: 於是備上驢，對僕人說：「你快快趕着走，我若不吩咐你，就不要遲慢。」
verses.e: Then she saddled a donkey , and said to her servant , " Drive , and go forward ! Don't slow down for me , unless I ask you to . "

verses.z: 婦人就往迦密山去見神人。神人遠遠地看見她，對僕人基哈西說：「看哪，書念的婦人來了！
verses.e: So she went , and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel . When the man of God saw her afar off , he said to Gehazi his servant , " Behold , there is the Shunammite .

verses.z: 你跑去迎接她，問她說：你平安嗎？你丈夫平安嗎？孩子平安嗎？」她說：「平安。」
verses.e: Please run now to meet her , and ask her , ' Is it well with you ? Is it well with your husband ? Is it well with your child ? ' " She answered , " It is well . "

verses.z: 婦人上了山，到神人那裏，就抱住神人的腳。基哈西前來要推開她，神人說：「由她吧！因為她心裏愁苦，耶和華向我隱瞞，沒有指示我。」
verses.e: When she came to the man of God to the hill , she caught hold of his feet . Gehazi came near to thrust her away ; but the man of God said , " Leave her alone , for her soul is troubled within her ; and the LORD has hidden it from me , and has not told me . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「我何嘗向我主求過兒子呢？我豈沒有說過，不要欺哄我嗎？」
verses.e: Then she said , " Did I ask you for a son , my lord ? Didn't I say , ' Do not deceive me ' ? "

verses.z: 以利沙吩咐基哈西說：「你束上腰，手拿我的杖前去；若遇見人，不要向他問安；人若向你問安，也不要回答；要把我的杖放在孩子臉上。」
verses.e: Then he said to Gehazi , " Tuck your cloak into your belt , take my staff in your hand , and go your way . If you meet any man , don't greet him ; and if anyone greets you , don't answer him again . Then lay my staff on the child's face . "

verses.z: 以利沙說：「你去，向你眾鄰舍借空器皿，不要少借；
verses.e: Then he said , " Go , borrow empty containers from all your neighbors . Don't borrow just a few containers .

verses.z: 孩子的母親說：「我指着永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不離開你。」於是以利沙起身，隨着她去了。
verses.e: The child's mother said , " As the LORD lives , and as your soul lives , I will not leave you . " So he arose , and followed her .

verses.z: 基哈西先去，把杖放在孩子臉上，卻沒有聲音，也沒有動靜。基哈西就迎着以利沙回來，告訴他說：「孩子還沒有醒過來。」
verses.e: Gehazi went ahead of them , and laid the staff on the child's face ; but there was no voice and no hearing . Therefore he returned to meet him , and told him , " The child has not awakened . "

verses.z: 以利沙來到，進了屋子，看見孩子死了，放在自己的床上。
verses.e: When Elisha had come into the house , behold , the child was dead , and lying on his bed .

verses.z: 他就關上門，只有自己和孩子在裏面，他便祈禱耶和華，
verses.e: He went in therefore , and shut the door on them both , and prayed to the LORD .

verses.z: 上床伏在孩子身上，口對口，眼對眼，手對手；既伏在孩子身上，孩子的身體就漸漸溫和了。
verses.e: He went up and lay on the child , and put his mouth on his mouth , and his eyes on his eyes , and his hands on his hands . He stretched himself on him ; and the child's flesh grew warm .

verses.z: 然後他下來，在屋裏來往走了一趟，又上去伏在孩子身上，孩子打了七個噴嚏，就睜開眼睛了。
verses.e: Then he returned , and walked in the house once back and forth , then went up and stretched himself out on him . Then the child sneezed seven times , and the child opened his eyes .

verses.z: 以利沙叫基哈西說：「你叫這書念婦人來」；於是叫了她來。以利沙說：「將你兒子抱起來。」
verses.e: He called Gehazi , and said , " Call this Shunammite ! " So he called her . When she had come in to him , he said , " Take up your son . "

verses.z: 婦人就進來，在以利沙腳前俯伏於地，抱起她兒子出去了。
verses.e: Then she went in , fell at his feet , and bowed herself to the ground ; then she picked up her son , and went out .

verses.z: 以利沙又來到吉甲，那地正有饑荒。先知門徒坐在他面前，他吩咐僕人說：「你將大鍋放在火上，給先知門徒熬湯。」
verses.e: Elisha came again to Gilgal . There was a famine in the land ; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him ; and he said to his servant , " Get the large pot , and boil stew for the sons of the prophets . "

verses.z: 有一個人去到田野掐菜，遇見一棵野瓜籐，就摘了一兜野瓜回來，切了擱在熬湯的鍋中，因為他們不知道是甚麼東西；
verses.e: One went out into the field to gather herbs , and found a wild vine , and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it , and came and cut them up into the pot of stew ; for they didn't recognize them .

verses.z: 回到家裏，關上門，你和你兒子在裏面將油倒在所有的器皿裏，倒滿了的放在一邊。」
verses.e: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons , and pour oil into all those containers ; and set aside those which are full . "

verses.z: 倒出來給眾人吃，吃的時候，都喊叫說：「神人哪，鍋中有致死的毒物！」所以眾人不能吃了。
verses.e: So they poured out for the men to eat . As they were eating some of the stew , they cried out and said , " Man of God , there is death in the pot ! " And they could not eat it .

verses.z: 以利沙說：「拿點麵來」，就把麵撒在鍋中，說：「倒出來，給眾人吃吧！」鍋中就沒有毒了。
verses.e: But he said , " Then bring meal . " He threw it into the pot ; and he said , " Serve it to the people , that they may eat . " And there was nothing harmful in the pot .

verses.z: 有一個人從巴力‧沙利沙來，帶着初熟大麥做的餅二十個，並新穗子，裝在口袋裏送給神人。神人說：「把這些給眾人吃。」
verses.e: A man from Baal Shalishah came , and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits : twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack . Elisha said , " Give to the people , that they may eat . "

verses.z: 僕人說：「這一點豈可擺給一百人吃呢？」以利沙說：「你只管給眾人吃吧！因為耶和華如此說，眾人必吃了，還剩下。」
verses.e: His servant said , " What , should I set this before a hundred men ? " But he said , " Give it to the people , that they may eat ; for the LORD says , ' They will eat , and will have some left over . ' "

verses.z: 僕人就擺在眾人面前，他們吃了，果然還剩下，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over , according to the LORD's word .

verses.z: 於是，婦人離開以利沙去了，關上門，自己和兒子在裏面；兒子把[器皿]拿來，她就倒油。
verses.e: So she went from him , and shut the door on herself and on her sons . They brought the containers to her , and she poured oil .

verses.z: 器皿都滿了，她對兒子說：「再給我拿器皿來。」兒子說：「再沒有器皿了。」油就止住了。
verses.e: When the containers were full , she said to her son , " Bring me another container . " He said to her , " There isn't another container . " Then the oil stopped flowing .

verses.z: 婦人去告訴神人，神人說：「你去賣油還債，所剩的你和你兒子可以靠着度日。」
verses.e: Then she came and told the man of God . He said , " Go , sell the oil , and pay your debt ; and you and your sons live on the rest . "

verses.z: 一日，以利沙走到書念，在那裏有一個大戶的婦人強留他吃飯。此後，以利沙每從那裏經過就進去吃飯。
verses.e: One day Elisha went to Shunem , where there was a prominent woman ; and she persuaded him to eat bread . So it was , that as often as he passed by , he turned in there to eat bread .

verses.z: 婦人對丈夫說：「我看出那常從我們這裏經過的是聖潔的神人。
verses.e: She said to her husband , " See now , I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually .

verses.z: 亞蘭王的元帥乃縵在他主人面前為尊為大，因耶和華曾藉他使亞蘭人得勝；他又是大能的勇士，只是長了大痲瘋。
verses.e: Now Naaman , captain of the army of the king of Syria , was a great man with his master , and honorable , because by him the LORD had given victory to Syria ; he was also a mighty man of valor , but he was a leper .

verses.z: 以利沙打發一個使者，對乃縵說：「你去在約旦河中沐浴七回，你的肉就必復原，而得潔淨。」
verses.e: Elisha sent a messenger to him , saying , " Go and wash in the Jordan seven times , and your flesh shall come again to you , and you shall be clean . "

verses.z: 乃縵卻發怒走了，說：「我想他必定出來見我，站着求告耶和華－他上帝的名，在患處以上搖手，治好這大痲瘋。
verses.e: But Naaman was angry , and went away and said , " Behold , I thought , ' He will surely come out to me , and stand , and call on the name of the LORD his God , and wave his hand over the place , and heal the leper . '

verses.z: 大馬士革的河亞罷拿和法珥法豈不比以色列的一切水更好嗎？我在那裏沐浴不得潔淨嗎？」於是氣忿忿地轉身去了。
verses.e: Aren't Abanah and Pharpar , the rivers of Damascus , better than all the waters of Israel ? Couldn't I wash in them and be clean ? " So he turned and went away in a rage .

verses.z: 他的僕人進前來，對他說：「我父啊，先知若吩咐你做一件大事，你豈不做嗎？何況說你去沐浴而得潔淨呢？」
verses.e: His servants came near and spoke to him , and said , " My father , if the prophet had asked you do some great thing , wouldn't you have done it ? How much rather then , when he says to you , ' Wash , and be clean ' ? "

verses.z: 於是乃縵下去，照着神人的話，在約旦河裏沐浴七回；他的肉復原，好像小孩子的肉，他就潔淨了。
verses.e: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan , according to the saying of the man of God ; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child , and he was clean .

verses.z: 乃縵帶着一切跟隨他的人，回到神人那裏，站在他面前，說：「如今我知道，除了以色列之外，普天下沒有上帝。現在求你收點僕人的禮物。」
verses.e: He returned to the man of God , he and all his company , and came , and stood before him ; and he said , " See now , I know that there is no God in all the earth , but in Israel . Now therefore , please take a gift from your servant . "

verses.z: 以利沙說：「我指着所事奉永生的耶和華起誓，我必不受。」乃縵再三地求他，他卻不受。
verses.e: But he said , " As the LORD lives , before whom I stand , I will receive none . " He urged him to take it ; but he refused .

verses.z: 乃縵說：「你若不肯受，請將兩騾子馱的土賜給僕人。從今以後，僕人必不再將燔祭或[平安]祭獻與別神，只獻給耶和華。
verses.e: Naaman said , " If not , then , please let two mules ' load of earth be given to your servant ; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods , but to the LORD .

verses.z: 惟有一件事，願耶和華饒恕你僕人：我主人進臨門廟叩拜的時候，我用手攙他在臨門廟，我也屈身。我在臨門廟屈身的這事，願耶和華饒恕我。」
verses.e: In this thing may the LORD pardon your servant : when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there , and he leans on my hand , and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon . When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon , may the LORD pardon your servant in this thing . "

verses.z: 以利沙對他說：「你可以平平安安地回去！」乃縵就離開他去了；走了不遠，
verses.e: He said to him , " Go in peace . " So he departed from him a little way .

verses.z: 先前亞蘭人成群地出去，從以色列國擄了一個小女子，這女子就服事乃縵的妻。
verses.e: The Syrians had gone out in bands , and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl , and she waited on Naaman's wife .

verses.z: 神人以利沙的僕人基哈西[心裏]說：「我主人不願從這亞蘭人乃縵手裏受他帶來的禮物，我指着永生的耶和華起誓，我必跑去追上他，向他要些。」
verses.e: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God , said , " Behold , my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian , in not receiving at his hands that which he brought . As the LORD lives , I will run after him , and take something from him . "

verses.z: 於是基哈西追趕乃縵。乃縵看見有人追趕，就急忙下車迎着他，說：「都平安嗎？」
verses.e: So Gehazi followed after Naaman . When Naaman saw one running after him , he came down from the chariot to meet him , and said , " Is all well ? "

verses.z: 說：「都平安。我主人打發我來說：『剛才有兩個少年人，是先知門徒，從以法蓮山地來見我，請你賜他們一他連得銀子，兩套衣裳。』」
verses.e: He said , " All is well . My master has sent me , saying , ' Behold , even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim . Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing . ' "

verses.z: 乃縵說：「請受二他連得」；再三地請受，便將二他連得銀子裝在兩個口袋裏，又將兩套衣裳交給兩個僕人；他們就在基哈西前頭抬着走。
verses.e: Naaman said , " Be pleased to take two talents . " He urged him , and bound two talents of silver in two bags , with two changes of clothing , and laid them on two of his servants ; and they carried them before him .

verses.z: 到了山岡，基哈西從他們手中接過來，放在屋裏，打發他們回去。
verses.e: When he came to the hill , he took them from their hand , and stored them in the house . Then he let the men go , and they departed .

verses.z: 基哈西進去，站在他主人面前。以利沙問他說：「基哈西你從哪裏來？」回答說：「僕人沒有往哪裏去。」
verses.e: But he went in , and stood before his master . Elisha said to him , " Where did you come from , Gehazi ? " He said , " Your servant went nowhere . "

verses.z: 以利沙對他說：「那人下車轉回迎你的時候，我的心豈沒有去呢？這豈是受銀子、衣裳、[買]橄欖園、葡萄園、牛羊、僕婢的時候呢？
verses.e: He said to him , " Didn't my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you ? Is it a time to receive money , and to receive garments , and olive groves and vineyards , and sheep and cattle , and male servants and female servants ?

verses.z: 因此，乃縵的大痲瘋必沾染你和你的後裔，直到永遠。」基哈西從以利沙面前退出去，就長了大痲瘋，像雪[那樣白]。
verses.e: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever . " He went out from his presence a leper , as white as snow .

verses.z: 她對主母說：「巴不得我主人去見撒馬利亞的先知，必能治好他的大痲瘋。」
verses.e: She said to her mistress , " I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria ! Then he would heal him of his leprosy . "

verses.z: 乃縵進去，告訴他主人說，以色列國的女子如此如此說。
verses.e: Someone went in and told his lord , saying , " The girl who is from the land of Israel said this . "

verses.z: 亞蘭王說：「你可以去，我也達信於以色列王。」於是乃縵帶銀子十他連得，金子六千[舍客勒]，衣裳十套，就去了；
verses.e: The king of Syria said , " Go now , and I will send a letter to the king of Israel . " He departed , and took with him ten talents of silver , six thousand pieces of gold , and ten changes of clothing .

verses.z: 且帶信給以色列王，信上說：「我打發臣僕乃縵去見你，你接到這信，就要治好他的大痲瘋。」
verses.e: He brought the letter to the king of Israel , saying , " Now when this letter has come to you , behold , I have sent Naaman my servant to you , that you may heal him of his leprosy . "

verses.z: 以色列王看了信就撕裂衣服，說：「我豈是上帝，能使人死使人活呢？這人竟打發人來，叫我治好他的大痲瘋。你們看一看，這人何以尋隙攻擊我呢？」
verses.e: When the king of Israel had read the letter , he tore his clothes and said , " Am I God , to kill and to make alive , that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy ? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me . "

verses.z: 神人以利沙聽見以色列王撕裂衣服，就打發人去見王，說：「你為甚麼撕了衣服呢？可使那人到我這裏來，他就知道以色列中有先知了。」
verses.e: It was so , when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes , that he sent to the king , saying , " Why have you torn your clothes ? Let him come now to me , and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel . "

verses.z: 於是，乃縵帶着車馬到了以利沙的家，站在門前。
verses.e: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots , and stood at the door of the house of Elisha .

verses.z: 先知門徒對以利沙說：「看哪，我們同你所住的地方過於窄小，
verses.e: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha , " See now , the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us .

verses.z: 以色列王差人去[窺探]神人所告訴所警戒他去的地方，就防備未受其害，不止一兩次。
verses.e: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of ; and he saved himself there , not once or twice .

verses.z: 亞蘭王因這事心裏驚疑，召了臣僕來，對他們說：「我們這裏有誰幫助以色列王，你們不指給我嗎？」
verses.e: The king of Syria's heart was very troubled about this . He called his servants , and said to them , " Won't you show me which of us is for the king of Israel ? "

verses.z: 有一個臣僕說：「我主，我王！無人幫助他，只有以色列中的先知以利沙，將王在臥房所說的話告訴以色列王了。」
verses.e: One of his servants said , " No , my lord , O king ; but Elisha , the prophet who is in Israel , tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom . "

verses.z: 王說：「你們去探他在哪裏，我好打發人去捉拿他。」有人告訴王說：「他在多坍。」
verses.e: He said , " Go and see where he is , that I may send and get him . " He was told , " Behold , he is in Dothan . "

verses.z: 王就打發車馬和大軍往那裏去，夜間到了，圍困那城。
verses.e: Therefore he sent horses , chariots , and a great army there . They came by night and surrounded the city .

verses.z: 神人的僕人清早起來出去，看見車馬軍兵圍困了城。僕人對神人說：「哀哉！我主啊，我們怎樣行才好呢？」
verses.e: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out , behold , an army with horses and chariots was around the city . His servant said to him , " Alas , my master ! What shall we do ? "

verses.z: 神人說：「不要懼怕！與我們同在的比與他們同在的更多。」
verses.e: He answered , " Don't be afraid , for those who are with us are more than those who are with them . "

verses.z: 以利沙禱告說：「耶和華啊，求你開這少年人的眼目，使他能看見。」耶和華開他的眼目，他就看見滿山有火車火馬圍繞以利沙。
verses.e: Elisha prayed , and said , " LORD , please open his eyes , that he may see . " the LORD opened the young man's eyes , and he saw ; and behold , the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha .

verses.z: 敵人下到以利沙那裏，以利沙禱告耶和華說：「求你使這些人的眼目昏迷。」耶和華就照以利沙的話，使他們的眼目昏迷。
verses.e: When they came down to him , Elisha prayed to the LORD , and said , " Please strike this people with blindness . " He struck them with blindness according to Elisha's word .

verses.z: 以利沙對他們說：「這不是那道，也不是那城；你們跟我去，我必領你們到所尋找的人那裏。」於是領他們到了撒馬利亞。
verses.e: Elisha said to them , " This is not the way , neither is this the city . Follow me , and I will bring you to the man whom you seek . " He led them to Samaria .

verses.z: 求你容我們往約旦河去，各人從那裏取一根木料建造房屋居住。」他說：「你們去吧！」
verses.e: Please let us go to the Jordan , and each man take a beam from there , and let's make us a place there , where we may live . " He answered , " Go ! "

verses.z: 他們進了撒馬利亞，以利沙[禱告]說：「耶和華啊，求你開這些人的眼目，使他們能看見。」耶和華開他們的眼目，他們就看見了，不料，是在撒馬利亞的城中。
