verses.e: When they had come into Samaria , Elisha said , " LORD , open these men's eyes , that they may see . " The LORD opened their eyes , and they saw ; and behold , they were in the middle of Samaria .

verses.z: 以色列王見了他們，就問以利沙說：「我父啊，我可以擊殺他們嗎？」
verses.e: The king of Israel said to Elisha , when he saw them , " My father , shall I strike them ? Shall I strike them ? "

verses.z: 回答說：「不可擊殺他們！就是你用刀用弓擄來的，豈可擊殺他們嗎？當在他們面前設擺飲食，使他們吃喝回到他們的主人那裏。」
verses.e: He answered , " You shall not strike them . Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow ? Set bread and water before them , that they may eat and drink , then go to their master . "

verses.z: 王就為他們預備了許多食物；他們吃喝完了，打發他們回到他們主人那裏。從此，亞蘭軍不再犯以色列境了。
verses.e: He prepared a great feast for them . After they ate and drank , he sent them away and they went to their master . So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel .

verses.z: 此後，亞蘭王便‧哈達聚集他的全軍，上來圍困撒馬利亞。
verses.e: After this , Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army , and went up and besieged Samaria .

verses.z: 於是撒馬利亞被圍困，有饑荒，甚至一個驢頭值銀八十[舍客勒]，二升鴿子糞值銀五[舍客勒]。
verses.e: There was a great famine in Samaria . Behold , they besieged it until a donkey's head was sold for eighty pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a kab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver .

verses.z: 一日，以色列王在城上經過，有一個婦人向他呼叫說：「我主，我王啊！求你幫助。」
verses.e: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall , a woman cried to him , saying , " Help , my lord , O king ! "

verses.z: 王說：「耶和華不幫助你，我從何處幫助你？是從禾場，是從酒醡呢？」
verses.e: He said , " If the LORD doesn't help you , where could I get help for you ? From the threshing floor , or from the wine press ? "

verses.z: 王問婦人說：「你有甚麼苦處？」她回答說：「這婦人對我說：『將你的兒子取來，我們今日可以吃，明日可以吃我的兒子。』
verses.e: Then the king asked her , " What is your problem ? " She answered , " This woman said to me , ' Give your son , that we may eat him today , and we will eat my son tomorrow . '

verses.z: 我們就煮了我的兒子吃了。次日我對她說：『要將你的兒子取來，我們可以吃。』她卻將她的兒子藏起來了。」
verses.e: So we boiled my son and ate him ; and I said to her on the next day , ' Give up your son , that we may eat him ; ' and she has hidden her son . "

verses.z: 有一人說：「求你與僕人同去。」回答說：「我可以去。」
verses.e: One said , " Please be pleased to go with your servants . " He answered , " I will go . "

verses.z: 王聽見婦人的話，就撕裂衣服；（王在城上經過）百姓看見王貼身穿着麻衣。
verses.e: When the king heard the words of the woman , he tore his clothes . Now he was passing by on the wall , and the people looked , and behold , he had sackcloth underneath on his body .

verses.z: 王說：「我今日若容沙法的兒子以利沙的頭仍在他項上，願上帝重重地降罰與我！」
verses.e: Then he said , " God do so to me , and more also , if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today . "

verses.z: 那時，以利沙正坐在家中，長老也與他同坐。[王]打發一個伺候他的人去；他還沒有到，以利沙對長老說：「你們看這兇手之子，打發人來斬我的頭；你們看着使者來到，就關上門，用門將他推出去。在他後頭不是有他主人腳步的響聲嗎？」
verses.e: But Elisha was sitting in his house , and the elders were sitting with him . Then the king sent a man from before him ; but before the messenger came to him , he said to the elders , " Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head ? Behold , when the messenger comes , shut the door , and hold the door shut against him . Isn't the sound of his master's feet behind him ? "

verses.z: 正說話的時候，使者來到，[王也到了]，說：「這災禍是從耶和華那裏來的，我何必再仰望耶和華呢？」
verses.e: While he was still talking with them , behold , the messenger came down to him . Then he said , " Behold , this evil is from the LORD . Why should I wait for the LORD any longer ? "

verses.z: 於是以利沙與他們同去。到了約旦河，就砍伐樹木。
verses.e: So he went with them . When they came to the Jordan , they cut down wood .

verses.z: 有一人砍樹的時候，斧頭掉在水裏，他就呼叫說：「哀哉！我主啊，這斧子是借的。」
verses.e: But as one was cutting down a tree , the ax head fell into the water . Then he cried out and said , " Alas , my master ! For it was borrowed . "

verses.z: 神人問說：「掉在哪裏了？」他將那地方指給以利沙看。以利沙砍了一根木頭，拋在水裏，斧頭就漂上來了。
verses.e: The man of God asked , " Where did it fall ? " He showed him the place . He cut down a stick , threw it in there , and made the iron float .

verses.z: 以利沙說：「拿起來吧！」那人就伸手拿起來了。
verses.e: He said , " Take it . " So he put out his hand and took it .

verses.z: 亞蘭王與以色列人爭戰，和他的臣僕商議說：「我要在某處某處安營。」
verses.e: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel ; and he took counsel with his servants , saying , " My camp will be in such and such a place . "

verses.z: 神人打發人去見以色列王，說：「你要謹慎，不要從某處經過，因為亞蘭人從那裏下來了。」
verses.e: The man of God sent to the king of Israel , saying , " Beware that you not pass this place , for the Syrians are coming down there . "

verses.z: 以利沙說：「你們要聽耶和華的話，耶和華如此說：明日約到這時候，在撒馬利亞城門口，一細亞細麵要[賣]銀一舍客勒，二細亞大麥也要[賣]銀一舍客勒。」
verses.e: Elisha said , " Hear the LORD's word . The LORD says , ' Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel , and two seahs of barley for a shekel , in the gate of Samaria . ' "

verses.z: 他們就去叫守城門的，告訴他們說：「我們到了亞蘭人的營，不見一人在那裏，也無人聲，只有拴着的馬和驢，帳棚都照舊。」
verses.e: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers ; and they told them , " We came to the camp of the Syrians , and , behold , there was no man there , not even a man's voice , but the horses tied , and the donkeys tied , and the tents as they were . "

verses.z: 守城門的叫了眾守門的人來，他們就進去與王家報信。
verses.e: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king's household within .

verses.z: 王夜間起來，對臣僕說：「我告訴你們亞蘭人向我們如何行。他們知道我們飢餓，所以離營，埋伏在田野，說：『以色列人出城的時候，我們就活捉他們，得以進城。』」
verses.e: The king arose in the night , and said to his servants , " I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us . They know that we are hungry . Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field , saying , ' When they come out of the city , we shall take them alive , and get into the city . ' "

verses.z: 有一個臣僕對王說：「我們不如用城裏剩下之馬中的五匹馬（馬和城裏剩下的以色列人都是一樣，快要滅絕），打發人去窺探。」
verses.e: One of his servants answered , " Please let some people take five of the horses that remain , which are left in the city . Behold , they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it . Behold , they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed . Let's send and see . "

verses.z: 於是取了兩輛車和馬，王差人去追尋亞蘭軍，說：「你們去窺探窺探。」
verses.e: Therefore they took two chariots with horses ; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army , saying , " Go and see . "

verses.z: 他們就追尋到約旦河，看見滿道上都是亞蘭人急跑時丟棄的衣服器具，使者就回來報告王。
verses.e: They went after them to the Jordan ; and behold , all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste . The messengers returned and told the king .

verses.z: 眾人就出去，擄掠亞蘭人的營盤。於是一細亞細麵[賣]銀一舍客勒，二細亞大麥也[賣]銀一舍客勒，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians . So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , according to the LORD's word .

verses.z: 王派攙扶他的那軍長在城門口彈壓，眾人在那裏將他踐踏，他就死了，正如神人在王下來見他的時候所說的。
verses.e: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate ; and the people trampled over him in the gate , and he died as the man of God had said , who spoke when the king came down to him .

verses.z: 神人曾對王說：「明日約到這時候，在撒馬利亞城門口，二細亞大麥要[賣]銀一舍客勒，一細亞細麵也要[賣]銀一舍客勒。」
verses.e: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , " Two seahs of barley for a shekel , and a seah of fine flour for a shekel , shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria ; "

verses.z: 那軍長對神人說：「即便耶和華使天開了窗戶，也不能有這事。」神人說：「你必親眼看見，卻不得吃。」
verses.e: and that captain answered the man of God , and said , " Now , behold , if the LORD made windows in heaven , might such a thing be ? " and he said , " Behold , you will see it with your eyes , but will not eat of it . "

verses.z: 有一個攙扶王的軍長對神人說：「即便耶和華使天開了窗戶，也不能有這事。」以利沙說：「你必親眼看見，卻不得吃。」
verses.e: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God , and said , " Behold , if the LORD made windows in heaven , could this thing be ? " He said , " Behold , you will see it with your eyes , but will not eat of it . "

verses.z: 這話果然應驗在他身上；因為眾人在城門口將他踐踏，他就死了。
verses.e: It happened like that to him , for the people trampled over him in the gate , and he died .

verses.z: 在城門那裏有四個長大痲瘋的人，他們彼此說：「我們為何坐在這裏等死呢？
verses.e: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate . They said to one another , " Why do we sit here until we die ?

verses.z: 我們若說，進城去吧！城裏有饑荒，必死在那裏；若在這裏坐着不動，也必是死。來吧，我們去投降亞蘭人的軍隊，他們若留我們的活命，就活着；若殺我們，就死了吧！」
verses.e: If we say , ' We will enter into the city , ' then the famine is in the city , and we will die there . If we sit still here , we also die . Now therefore come , and let's surrender to the army of the Syrians . If they save us alive , we will live ; and if they kill us , we will only die . "

verses.z: 黃昏的時候，他們起來往亞蘭人的營盤去；到了營邊，不見一人在那裏。
verses.e: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians . When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians , behold , no man was there .

verses.z: 因為主使亞蘭人的軍隊聽見車馬的聲音，是大軍的聲音；他們就彼此說：「這必是以色列王賄買赫人的諸王和埃及人的諸王來攻擊我們。」
verses.e: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses , even the noise of a great army ; and they said to one another , " Behold , the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us . "

verses.z: 所以，在黃昏的時候他們起來逃跑，撇下帳棚、馬、驢，營盤照舊，只顧逃命。
verses.e: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight , and left their tents , their horses , and their donkeys , even the camp as it was , and fled for their life .

verses.z: 那些長大痲瘋的到了營邊，進了帳棚，吃了喝了，且從其中拿出金銀和衣服來，去收藏了；回來又進了一座帳棚，從其中拿出財物來去收藏了。
verses.e: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp , they went into one tent , and ate and drank , then carried away silver , gold , and clothing and went and hid it . Then they came back , and entered into another tent and carried things from there also , and went and hid them .

verses.z: 那時，他們彼此說：「我們所做的不好！今日是有好信息的日子，我們竟不作聲！若等到天亮，罪必臨到我們。來吧，我們與王家報信去！」
verses.e: Then they said to one another , " We aren't doing right . Today is a day of good news , and we keep silent . If we wait until the morning light , punishment will overtake us . Now therefore come , let's go and tell the king's household . "

verses.z: 以利沙曾對所救活之子的那婦人說：「你和你的全家要起身往你可住的地方去住，因為耶和華命饑荒降在這地七年。」
verses.e: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life , saying , " Arise , and go , you and your household , and stay for a while wherever you can ; for the LORD has called for a famine . It will also come on the land for seven years . "

verses.z: 以利沙對哈薛說：「你回去告訴他說，這病必能好；但耶和華指示我，他必要死。」
verses.e: Elisha said to him , " Go , tell him , ' You will surely recover ; ' however the LORD has shown me that he will surely die . "

verses.z: 神人定睛看着哈薛，甚至他慚愧。神人就哭了；
verses.e: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him , until he was ashamed . Then the man of God wept .

verses.z: 哈薛說：「我主為甚麼哭？」回答說：「因為我知道你必苦害以色列人，用火焚燒他們的保障，用刀殺死他們的壯丁，摔死他們的嬰孩，剖開他們的孕婦。」
verses.e: Hazael said , " Why do you weep , my lord ? " He answered , " Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel . You will set their strongholds on fire , and you will kill their young men with the sword , and will dash their little ones in pieces , and rip up their pregnant women . "

verses.z: 哈薛說：「你僕人算甚麼，不過是一條狗，焉能行這大事呢？」以利沙回答說：「耶和華指示我，你必作亞蘭王。」
verses.e: Hazael said , " But what is your servant , who is but a dog , that he could do this great thing ? " Elisha answered , " The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Syria . "

verses.z: 哈薛離開以利沙，回去見他的主人。主人問他說：「以利沙對你說甚麼？」回答說：「他告訴我你必能好。」
verses.e: Then he departed from Elisha , and came to his master , who said to him , " What did Elisha say to you ? " He answered , " He told me that you would surely recover . "

verses.z: 次日，哈薛拿被窩浸在水中，蒙住王的臉，王就死了。於是哈薛篡了他的位。
verses.e: On the next day , he took a thick cloth , dipped it in water , and spread it on the king's face , so that he died . Then Hazael reigned in his place .

verses.z: 以色列王亞哈的兒子約蘭第五年，猶大王約沙法還在位的時候，約沙法的兒子約蘭登基作了猶大王。
verses.e: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel , Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then , Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign .

verses.z: 約蘭登基的時候年三十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王八年。
verses.e: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign . He reigned eight years in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他行以色列諸王所行的，與亞哈家一樣；因為他娶了亞哈的女兒為妻，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事。
verses.e: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel , as did Ahab's house , for he married Ahab's daughter . He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight .

verses.z: 耶和華卻因他僕人大衛的緣故，仍不肯滅絕猶大，照他所應許大衛的話，永遠賜燈光與他的子孫。
verses.e: However , the LORD would not destroy Judah , for David his servant's sake , as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always .

verses.z: 婦人就起身，照神人的話帶着全家往非利士地去，住了七年。
verses.e: The woman arose , and did according to the man of God's word . She went with her household , and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years .

verses.z: 約蘭年間，以東人背叛猶大，脫離他的權下，自己立王。
verses.e: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah , and made a king over themselves .

verses.z: 約蘭率領所有的戰車往撒益去，夜間起來，攻打圍困他的以東人和車[兵]長；猶大兵就逃跑，各回各家去了。
verses.e: Then Joram crossed over to Zair , and all his chariots with him ; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots ; and the people fled to their tents .

verses.z: 這樣，以東人背叛猶大，脫離他的權下，直到今日。那時立拿人也背叛了。
verses.e: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day . Then Libnah revolted at the same time .

verses.z: 約蘭其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在猶大列王記上。
verses.e: The rest of the acts of Joram , and all that he did , aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

verses.z: 約蘭與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子亞哈謝接續他作王。
verses.e: Joram slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in David's city ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 以色列王亞哈的兒子約蘭十二年，猶大王約蘭的兒子亞哈謝登基。
verses.e: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel , Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign .

verses.z: 他登基的時候年二十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王一年。他母親名叫亞她利雅，是以色列王暗利的孫女。
verses.e: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign ; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel .

verses.z: 亞哈謝效法亞哈家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，與亞哈家一樣，因為他是亞哈家的女婿。
verses.e: He walked in the way of Ahab's house and did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , as did Ahab's house , for he was the son-in-law of Ahab's house .

verses.z: 他與亞哈的兒子約蘭同往基列的拉末去，與亞蘭王哈薛爭戰。亞蘭人打傷了約蘭，
verses.e: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead , and the Syrians wounded Joram .

verses.z: 約蘭王回到耶斯列，醫治在拉末與亞蘭王哈薛打仗的時候所受的傷。猶大王約蘭的兒子亞哈謝因為亞哈的兒子約蘭病了，就下到耶斯列看望他。
verses.e: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah , when he fought against Hazael king of Syria . Ahaziah the son of Jehoram , king of Judah , went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel , because he was sick .

verses.z: 七年完了，那婦人從非利士地回來，就出去為自己的房屋田地哀告王。
verses.e: At the end of seven years , the woman returned from the land of the Philistines . Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land .

verses.z: 那時王正與神人的僕人基哈西說：「請你將以利沙所行的一切大事告訴我。」
verses.e: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God , saying , " Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done . "

verses.z: 基哈西告訴王以利沙如何使死人復活，恰巧以利沙所救活、她兒子的那婦人為自己的房屋田地來哀告王。基哈西說：「我主我王，這就是那婦人，這是她的兒子，就是以利沙所救活的。」
verses.e: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead , behold , the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land . Gehazi said , " My lord , O king , this is the woman , and this is her son , whom Elisha restored to life . "

verses.z: 王問那婦人，她就把那事告訴王。於是王為她派一個太監，說：「凡屬這婦人的都還給她，自從她離開本地直到今日，她田地的出產也都還給她。」
verses.e: When the king asked the woman , she told him . So the king appointed to her a certain officer , saying , " Restore all that was hers , and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land , even until now . "

verses.z: 以利沙來到大馬士革，亞蘭王便‧哈達正患病。有人告訴王說：「神人來到這裏了。」
verses.e: Elisha came to Damascus ; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick . He was told , " The man of God has come here . "

verses.z: 王就吩咐哈薛說：「你帶着禮物去見神人，託他求問耶和華，我這病能好不能好？」
verses.e: The king said to Hazael , " Take a present in your hand , and go meet the man of God , and inquire of the LORD by him , saying , ' Will I recover from this sickness ? ' "

verses.z: 於是哈薛用四十個駱駝，馱着大馬士革的各樣美物為禮物，去見以利沙。到了他那裏，站在他面前，說：「你兒子亞蘭王便‧哈達打發我來見你，他問說：『我這病能好不能好？』」
verses.e: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him , even of every good thing of Damascus , forty camels ' burden , and came and stood before him and said , " Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you , saying , ' Will I recover from this sickness ? ' "

verses.z: 先知以利沙叫了一個先知門徒來，吩咐他說：「你束上腰，手拿這瓶膏油往基列的拉末去。
verses.e: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets , and said to him , " Put your belt on your waist , take this vial of oil in your hand , and go to Ramoth Gilead .

verses.z: 耶洗別必在耶斯列田裏被狗所吃，無人葬埋。』」[說完了]，少年人就開門逃跑了。
verses.e: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel , and there shall be no one to bury her . ' " Then he opened the door and fled .

verses.z: 耶戶出來，回到他主人的臣僕那裏，有一人問他說：「平安嗎？這狂妄的人來見你有甚麼事呢？」回答說：「你們認得那人，也知道他說甚麼。」
verses.e: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him , " Is all well ? Why did this madman come to you ? " He said to them , " You know the man and how he talks . "

verses.z: 他們說：「這是假話，你據實地告訴我們。」回答說：「他如此如此對我說。他說：『耶和華如此說：我膏你作以色列王。』」
verses.e: They said , " That is a lie . Tell us now . " He said , " He said to me , ' The LORD says , I have anointed you king over Israel . ' "

verses.z: 他們就急忙各將自己的衣服鋪在上層臺階，使耶戶坐在其上；他們吹角，說：「耶戶作王了！」
verses.e: Then they hurried , and each man took his cloak , and put it under him on the top of the stairs , and blew the trumpet , saying , " Jehu is king . "

verses.z: 這樣，寧示的孫子、約沙法的兒子耶戶背叛約蘭。先是約蘭和以色列眾人因為亞蘭王哈薛的緣故，把守基列的拉末；
verses.e: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram . ( Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead , he and all Israel , because of Hazael king of Syria ;

verses.z: 但約蘭王回到耶斯列，醫治與亞蘭王哈薛打仗所受的傷。耶戶說：「若合你們的意思，就不容人逃出城往耶斯列報信去。」
verses.e: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . ) Jehu said , " If this is your thinking , then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel . "

verses.z: 於是耶戶坐車往耶斯列去，因為約蘭病臥在那裏。猶大王亞哈謝已經下去看望他。
verses.e: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel , for Joram lay there . Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram .

verses.z: 有一個守望的人站在耶斯列的樓上，看見耶戶帶着一群人來，就說：「我看見一群人。」約蘭說：「打發一個騎馬的去迎接他們，問說：平安不平安？」
verses.e: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel , and he spied the company of Jehu as he came , and said , " I see a company . " Joram said , " Take a horseman , and send to meet them , and let him say , ' Is it peace ? ' "

verses.z: 騎馬的就去迎接耶戶，說：「王問說，平安不平安？」耶戶說：「平安不平安與你何干？你轉在我後頭吧！」守望的人又說：「使者到了他們那裏，卻不回來。」
verses.e: So one went on horseback to meet him , and said , " the king says , ' Is it peace ? ' " Jehu said , " What do you have to do with peace ? Fall in behind me ! " The watchman said , " The messenger came to them , but he isn't coming back . "

verses.z: 王又打發一個騎馬的去。這人到了他們那裏，說：「王問說，平安不平安？」耶戶說：「平安不平安與你何干？你轉在我後頭吧！」
verses.e: Then he sent out a second on horseback , who came to them and said , " The king says , ' Is it peace ? ' " Jehu answered , " What do you have to do with peace ? Fall in behind me ! "

verses.z: 到了那裏，要尋找寧示的孫子、約沙法的兒子耶戶，使他從同僚中起來，帶他進嚴密的屋子，
verses.e: When you come there , find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi , and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers , and take him to an inner room .

verses.z: 守望的人又說：「他到了他們那裏，也不回來；車趕得甚猛，像寧示的孫子耶戶的趕法。」
verses.e: The watchman said , " He came to them , and isn't coming back . The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi , for he drives furiously . "

verses.z: 約蘭吩咐說：「套車！」人就給他套車。以色列王約蘭和猶大王亞哈謝各坐自己的車出去迎接耶戶，在耶斯列人拿伯的田那裏遇見他。
verses.e: Joram said , " Get ready ! " They got his chariot ready . Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out , each in his chariot ; and they went out to meet Jehu , and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite's land .

verses.z: 約蘭見耶戶就說：「耶戶啊，平安嗎？」耶戶說：「你母親耶洗別的淫行邪術這樣多，焉能平安呢？」
verses.e: When Joram saw Jehu , he said , " Is it peace , Jehu ? " He answered , " What peace , so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound ? "

verses.z: 約蘭就轉車逃跑，對亞哈謝說：「亞哈謝啊，反了！」
verses.e: Joram turned his hands and fled , and said to Ahaziah , " This is treason , Ahaziah ! "

verses.z: 耶戶開滿了弓，射中約蘭的脊背，箭從心窩穿出，約蘭就仆倒在車上。
verses.e: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength , and struck Joram between his arms ; and the arrow went out at his heart , and he sunk down in his chariot .

verses.z: 耶戶對他的軍長畢甲說：「你把他拋在耶斯列人拿伯的田間。你當追想，你我一同坐車跟隨他父亞哈的時候，耶和華對亞哈所說的預言，
verses.e: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain , " Pick him up , and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite ; for remember how , when you and I rode together after Ahab his father , the LORD laid this burden on him :

verses.z: 說：『我昨日看見拿伯的血和他眾子的血，我必在這塊田上報應你。』這是耶和華說的，現在你要照着耶和華的話，把他拋在這田間。」
verses.e: ' Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth , and the blood of his sons , ' says the LORD ; ' and I will repay you in this plot of ground , ' says the LORD . Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground , according to the LORD's word . "

verses.z: 猶大王亞哈謝見這光景，就從園亭之路逃跑。耶戶追趕他，說：「把這人也殺在車上。」到了靠近以伯蓮的姑珥坡上[擊傷了他]。他逃到米吉多，就死在那裏。
verses.e: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house . Jehu followed after him , and said , " Strike him also in the chariot ! " They struck him at the ascent of Gur , which is by Ibleam . He fled to Megiddo , and died there .

verses.z: 他的臣僕用車將他的屍首送到耶路撒冷，葬在大衛城他自己的墳墓裏，與他列祖同葬。
verses.e: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem , and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David's city .

verses.z: 亞哈謝登基作猶大王的時候，是在亞哈的兒子約蘭第十一年。
verses.e: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab , Ahaziah began to reign over Judah .

verses.z: 將瓶裏的膏油倒在他頭上，說：『耶和華如此說：我膏你作以色列王。』[說完了]，就開門逃跑，不要遲延。」
verses.e: Then take the vial of oil , and pour it on his head , and say , ' The LORD says , " I have anointed you king over Israel . " ' Then open the door , flee , and don't wait . "

verses.z: 耶戶到了耶斯列；耶洗別聽見就擦粉、梳頭，從窗戶裏往外觀看。
verses.e: When Jehu had come to Jezreel , Jezebel heard of it ; and she painted her eyes , and adorned her head , and looked out at the window .

verses.z: 耶戶進門的時候，耶洗別說：「殺主人的心利啊，平安嗎？」
verses.e: As Jehu entered in at the gate , she said , " Do you come in peace , Zimri , you murderer of your master ? "

verses.z: 耶戶抬頭向窗戶觀看，說：「誰順從我？」有兩三個太監從窗戶往外看他。
verses.e: He lifted up his face to the window , and said , " Who is on my side ? Who ? " Two or three eunuchs looked out at him .

verses.z: 耶戶說：「把她扔下來！」他們就把她扔下來。她的血濺在牆上和馬上；於是把她踐踏了。
verses.e: He said , " Throw her down ! " So they threw her down ; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall , and on the horses . Then he trampled her under foot .

verses.z: 耶戶進去，吃了喝了，吩咐說：「你們把這被咒詛的婦人葬埋了，因為她是王的女兒。」
verses.e: When he had come in , he ate and drank . Then he said , " See now to this cursed woman , and bury her ; for she is a king's daughter . "

verses.z: 他們就去葬埋她，只尋得她的頭骨和腳，並手掌。
verses.e: They went to bury her , but they found no more of her than the skull , the feet , and the palms of her hands .

verses.z: 他們回去告訴耶戶，耶戶說：「這正應驗耶和華藉他僕人提斯比人以利亞所說的話，說：『在耶斯列田間，狗必吃耶洗別的肉；
verses.e: Therefore they came back , and told him . He said , " This is the LORD's word , which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , ' The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel ,

verses.z: 耶洗別的屍首必在耶斯列田間如同糞土，甚至人不能說這是耶洗別。』」
verses.e: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel's land , so that they won't say , " This is Jezebel . " ' "

verses.z: 於是那少年先知往基列的拉末去了。
verses.e: So the young man , the young prophet , went to Ramoth Gilead .

verses.z: 到了那裏，看見眾軍長都坐着，就說：「將軍哪，我有話對你說。」耶戶說：「我們眾人裏，你要對哪一個說呢？」回答說：「將軍哪，我要對你說。」
verses.e: When he came , behold , the captains of the army were sitting . Then he said , " I have a message for you , captain . " Jehu said , " To which one of us ? " He said , " To you , O captain . "

verses.z: 耶戶就起來，進了屋子，少年人將膏油倒在他頭上，對他說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『我膏你作耶和華民以色列的王。
verses.e: He arose , and went into the house . Then he poured the oil on his head , and said to him , " The LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD , even over Israel .

verses.z: 你要擊殺你主人亞哈的全家，我好在耶洗別身上伸我僕人眾先知和耶和華一切僕人流血的冤。
verses.e: You must strike your master Ahab's house , that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets , and the blood of all the servants of the LORD , at the hand of Jezebel .

verses.z: 亞哈全家必都滅亡，凡屬亞哈的男丁，無論是困住的、自由的，我必從以色列中剪除，
verses.e: For the whole house of Ahab will perish . I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall , both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel .

verses.z: 使亞哈的家像尼八兒子耶羅波安的家，又像亞希雅兒子巴沙的家。
verses.e: I will make Ahab's house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah .

verses.z: 作耶穌基督僕人和使徒的西門‧彼得寫信給那因我們的上帝和救主耶穌基督之義、與我們同得一樣寶貴信心的人。
verses.e: Simon Peter , a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ , to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior , Jesus Christ :

verses.z: 所以弟兄們，應當更加殷勤，使你們所蒙的恩召和揀選堅定不移。你們若行這幾樣，就永不失腳；
verses.e: Therefore , brothers , be more diligent to make your calling and election sure . For if you do these things , you will never stumble .

verses.z: 這樣，必叫你們豐豐富富地得以進入我們主－救主耶穌基督永遠的國。
verses.e: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior , Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 你們雖然曉得這些事，並且在你們已有的真道上堅固，我卻要將這些事常常提醒你們。
verses.e: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things , though you know them and are established in the present truth .

verses.z: 我以為應當趁我還在這帳棚的時候提醒你們，激發你們；
verses.e: I think it right , as long as I am in this tent , to stir you up by reminding you ,

verses.z: 因為知道我脫離這帳棚的時候快到了，正如我們主耶穌基督所指示我的。
verses.e: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly , even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me .

verses.z: 並且，我要盡心竭力，使你們在我去世以後時常記念這些事。
verses.e: Yes , I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure .

verses.z: 我們從前將我們主耶穌基督的大能和他降臨的事告訴你們，並不是隨從乖巧捏造的虛言，乃是親眼見過他的威榮。
verses.e: For we didn't follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty .

verses.z: 他從父上帝得尊貴榮耀的時候，從極大榮光之中有聲音出來，向他說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。」
verses.e: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory , " This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased . "

verses.z: 我們同他在聖山的時候，親自聽見這聲音從天上出來。
verses.e: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain .

verses.z: 我們並有先知更確的預言，如同燈照在暗處。你們在這預言上留意，直等到天發亮，晨星在你們心裏出現的時候，才是好的。
verses.e: We have the more sure word of prophecy ; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place , until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts ,

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安，因你們認識上帝和我們主耶穌，多多地加給你們。
verses.e: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord ,

verses.z: 第一要緊的，該知道經上所有的預言沒有可隨私意解說的；
verses.e: knowing this first , that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation .

verses.z: 因為預言從來沒有出於人意的，乃是人被聖靈感動，說出上帝的話來。
verses.e: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man , but holy men of God spoke , being moved by the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 上帝的神能已將一切關乎生命和虔敬的事賜給我們，皆因我們認識那用自己榮耀和美德召我們的主。
verses.e: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness , through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue ,

verses.z: 因此，他已將又寶貴又極大的應許賜給我們，叫我們既脫離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就得與上帝的性情有分。
verses.e: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises ; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature , having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust .

verses.z: 正因這緣故，你們要分外地殷勤；有了信心，又要加上德行；有了德行，又要加上知識；
verses.e: Yes , and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence , in your faith supply moral excellence ; and in moral excellence , knowledge ;

verses.z: 有了知識，又要加上節制；有了節制，又要加上忍耐；有了忍耐，又要加上虔敬；
verses.e: and in knowledge , self-control ; and in self-control , perseverance ; and in perseverance , godliness ;

verses.z: 有了虔敬，又要加上愛弟兄的心；有了愛弟兄的心，又要加上愛[眾人的心]。
verses.e: and in godliness , brotherly affection ; and in brotherly affection , love .

verses.z: 你們若充充足足地有這幾樣，就必使你們在認識我們的主耶穌基督上不至於閒懶不結果子了。
verses.e: For if these things are yours and abound , they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 人若沒有這幾樣，就是眼瞎，只看見近處的，忘了他舊日的罪已經得了潔淨。
verses.e: For he who lacks these things is blind , seeing only what is near , having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins .

verses.z: 從前在百姓中有假先知起來，將來在你們中間也必有假師傅，私自引進陷害人的異端，連買他們的主他們也不承認，自取速速地滅亡。
verses.e: But false prophets also arose among the people , as false teachers will also be among you , who will secretly bring in destructive heresies , denying even the Master who bought them , bringing on themselves swift destruction .

verses.z: 那些隨肉身、縱污穢的情慾、輕慢主治之人的，更是如此。他們膽大任性，毀謗在尊位的，也不知懼怕。
verses.e: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority . Daring , self-willed , they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries ,

verses.z: 就是天使，雖然力量權能更大，還不用毀謗的話在主面前告他們。
verses.e: whereas angels , though greater in might and power , don't bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord .

verses.z: 但這些人好像沒有靈性，生來就是畜類，以備捉拿宰殺的。他們毀謗所不曉得的事，正在敗壞人的時候，自己必遭遇敗壞。
verses.e: But these , as unreasoning creatures , born natural animals to be taken and destroyed , speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant , will in their destroying surely be destroyed ,

verses.z: 行的不義，就得了不義的工價。這些人喜愛白晝宴樂，他們已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正與你們一同坐席，就以自己的詭詐為快樂。
verses.e: receiving the wages of unrighteousness ; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime , spots and defects , reveling in their deceit while they feast with you ;

verses.z: 他們滿眼是淫色，止不住犯罪，引誘那心不堅固的人，心中習慣了貪婪，正是被咒詛的種類。
verses.e: having eyes full of adultery , and who can't cease from sin , enticing unsettled souls , having a heart trained in greed , accursed children !

verses.z: 他們離棄正路，就走差了，隨從比珥之子巴蘭的路。巴蘭就是那貪愛不義之工價的[先知]，
verses.e: Forsaking the right way , they went astray , having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor , who loved the wages of wrongdoing ;

verses.z: 他卻為自己的過犯受了責備；那不能說話的驢以人言攔阻先知的狂妄。
verses.e: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience . A speechless donkey spoke with a man's voice and stopped the madness of the prophet .

verses.z: 這些人是無水的井，是狂風催逼的霧氣，有墨黑的幽暗為他們存留。
verses.e: These are wells without water , clouds driven by a storm , for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever .

verses.z: 他們說虛妄矜誇的大話，用肉身的情慾和邪淫的事引誘那些剛才脫離妄行的人。
verses.e: For , uttering great swelling words of emptiness , they entice in the lusts of the flesh , by licentiousness , those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error ;

verses.z: 他們應許人得以自由，自己卻作敗壞的奴僕，因為人被誰制伏就是誰的奴僕。
verses.e: promising them liberty , while they themselves are bondservants of corruption ; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him .

verses.z: 將有許多人隨從他們邪淫的行為，便叫真道因他們的緣故被毀謗。
verses.e: Many will follow their immoral ways , and as a result , the way of the truth will be maligned .

verses.z: 倘若他們因認識主－救主耶穌基督，得以脫離世上的污穢，後來又在其中被纏住、制伏，他們末後的景況就比先前更不好了。
verses.e: For if , after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ , they are again entangled in it and overcome , the last state has become worse for them than the first .

verses.z: 他們曉得義路，竟背棄了傳給他們的聖命，倒不如不曉得為妙。
verses.e: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness , than after knowing it , to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them .

verses.z: 俗語說得真不錯：狗所吐的，牠轉過來又吃；豬洗淨了又回到泥裏去滾；這話在他們身上正合式。
verses.e: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb , " The dog turns to his own vomit again , " and " the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire . "

verses.z: 他們因有貪心，要用捏造的言語在你們身上取利。他們的刑罰，自古以來並不遲延；他們的滅亡也必速速來到。
verses.e: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words : whose sentence now from of old doesn't linger , and their destruction will not slumber .

verses.z: 就是天使犯了罪，上帝也沒有寬容，曾把他們丟在地獄，交在黑暗坑中，等候審判。
verses.e: For if God didn't spare angels when they sinned , but cast them down to Tartarus , and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment ;

verses.z: 上帝也沒有寬容上古的世代，曾叫洪水臨到那不敬虔的世代，卻保護了傳義道的挪亞一家八口。
verses.e: and didn't spare the ancient world , but preserved Noah with seven others , a preacher of righteousness , when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly ,

verses.z: 又判定所多瑪、蛾摩拉，將二城傾覆，焚燒成灰，作為後世不敬虔人的鑑戒；
verses.e: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes , condemned them to destruction , having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way ,

verses.z: 只搭救了那常為惡人淫行憂傷的義人羅得。（
verses.e: and delivered righteous Lot , who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

verses.z: 因為那義人住在他們中間，看見聽見他們不法的事，他的義心就天天傷痛。）
verses.e: ( for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds ) ,

verses.z: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脫離試探，把不義的人留在刑罰之下，等候審判的日子。
verses.e: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment ,

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我現在寫給你們的是第二封信。這兩封都是提醒你們，激發你們誠實的心，
verses.e: This is now , beloved , the second letter that I have written to you ; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

verses.z: 但主的日子要像賊來到一樣。那日，天必大有響聲廢去，有形質的都要被烈火銷化，地和其上的物都要燒盡了。
verses.e: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night , in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise , and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat ; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up .

verses.z: 這一切既然都要如此銷化，你們為人該當怎樣聖潔，怎樣敬虔，
verses.e: Therefore , since all these things will be destroyed like this , what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness ,

verses.z: 切切仰望上帝的日子來到。在那日，天被火燒就銷化了，有形質的都要被烈火鎔化。
verses.e: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God , which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved , and the elements will melt with fervent heat ?

verses.z: 但我們照他的應許，盼望新天新地，有義居在其中。
verses.e: But , according to his promise , we look for new heavens and a new earth , in which righteousness dwells .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們既盼望這些事，就當殷勤，使自己沒有玷污，無可指摘，安然見主；
verses.e: Therefore , beloved , seeing that you look for these things , be diligent to be found in peace , without defect and blameless in his sight .

verses.z: 並且要以我主長久忍耐為得救的因由，就如我們所親愛的兄弟保羅，照着所賜給他的智慧寫了信給你們。
verses.e: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation ; even as our beloved brother Paul also , according to the wisdom given to him , wrote to you ,

verses.z: 他一切的信上也都是講論這事。信中有些難明白的，那無學問、不堅固的人強解，如強解別的經書一樣，就自取沉淪。
verses.e: as also in all of his letters , speaking in them of these things . In those , there are some things that are hard to understand , which the ignorant and unsettled twist , as they also do to the other Scriptures , to their own destruction .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們既然預先知道這事，就當防備，恐怕被惡人的錯謬誘惑，就從自己堅固的地步上墜落。
verses.e: You therefore , beloved , knowing these things beforehand , beware , lest being carried away with the error of the wicked , you fall from your own steadfastness .

verses.z: 你們卻要在我們主－救主耶穌基督的恩典和知識上有長進。願榮耀歸給他，從今直到永遠。阿們！
verses.e: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ . To him be the glory both now and forever . Amen .

verses.z: 叫你們記念聖先知預先所說的話和主救主的命令，就是使徒所傳給你們的。
verses.e: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us , the apostles of the Lord and Savior ,

verses.z: 第一要緊的，該知道在末世必有好譏誚的人隨從自己的私慾出來譏誚說：
verses.e: knowing this first , that in the last days mockers will come , walking after their own lusts

verses.z: 「主要降臨的應許在哪裏呢？因為從列祖睡了以來，萬物與起初創造的時候仍是一樣。」
verses.e: and saying , " Where is the promise of his coming ? For , from the day that the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation . "

verses.z: 他們故意忘記，從太古，憑上帝的命有了天，並從水而出、藉水而成的地。
verses.e: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old , and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God ,

verses.z: 故此，當時的世界被水淹沒就消滅了。
verses.e: by which means the world that existed then , being overflowed with water , perished .

verses.z: 但現在的天地還是憑着那命存留，直留到不敬虔之人受審判遭沉淪的日子，用火焚燒。
verses.e: But the heavens that exist now and the earth , by the same word have been stored up for fire , being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，有一件事你們不可忘記，就是主看一日如千年，千年如一日。
verses.e: But don't forget this one thing , beloved , that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years , and a thousand years as one day .

verses.z: 主所應許的[尚未成就]，有人以為他是耽延，其實不是耽延，乃是寬容你們，不願有一人沉淪，乃願人人都悔改。
verses.e: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise , as some count slowness ; but he is patient with us , not wishing that anyone should perish , but that all should come to repentance .

verses.z: 掃羅死後，大衛擊殺亞瑪力人回來，在洗革拉住了兩天。
verses.e: After the death of Saul , when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites , and David had stayed two days in Ziklag ,

verses.z: 我準知他仆倒必不能活，就去將他殺死，把他頭上的冠冕、臂上的鐲子拿到我主這裏。」
verses.e: So I stood beside him and killed him , because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen . I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm , and have brought them here to my lord . "

verses.z: 大衛就撕裂衣服，跟隨他的人也是如此，
verses.e: Then David took hold on his clothes and tore them ; and all the men who were with him did likewise .

verses.z: 而且悲哀哭號，禁食到晚上，是因掃羅和他兒子約拿單，並耶和華的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。
verses.e: They mourned , wept , and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son , and for the people of the LORD , and for the house of Israel , because they had fallen by the sword .

verses.z: 大衛問報信的少年人說：「你是哪裏的人？」他說：「我是亞瑪力客人的兒子。」
verses.e: David said to the young man who told him , " Where are you from ? " He answered , " I am the son of a foreigner , an Amalekite . "

verses.z: 大衛說：「你伸手殺害耶和華的受膏者，怎麼不畏懼呢？」
verses.e: David said to him , " Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy the LORD's anointed ? "

verses.z: 大衛叫了一個少年人來，說：「你去殺他吧！」
verses.e: David called one of the young men and said , " Go near , and cut him down ! " He struck him so that he died .

verses.z: 大衛對他說：「你流人血的罪歸到自己的頭上，因為你親口作見證說：『我殺了耶和華的受膏者。』」少年人就把他殺了。
verses.e: David said to him , " Your blood be on your head , for your mouth has testified against you , saying , ' I have slain the LORD's anointed . ' "

verses.z: 大衛作哀歌，弔掃羅和他兒子約拿單，
verses.e: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

verses.z: 且吩咐將這歌教導猶大人。這歌名叫「弓歌」，寫在雅煞珥書上。
verses.e: ( and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow ; behold , it is written in the book of Jashar ) :

verses.z: [歌中說]：以色列啊，你尊榮者在山上被殺！大英雄何竟死亡！
verses.e: " Your glory , Israel , was slain on your high places ! How the mighty have fallen !

verses.z: 第三天，有一人從掃羅的營裏出來，衣服撕裂，頭蒙灰塵，到大衛面前伏地叩拜。
verses.e: on the third day , behold , a man came out of the camp from Saul , with his clothes torn and earth on his head . When he came to David , he fell to the earth and showed respect .

verses.z: 不要在迦特報告；不要在亞實基倫街上傳揚；免得非利士的女子歡樂；免得未受割禮之人的女子矜誇。
verses.e: Don't tell it in Gath . Don't publish it in the streets of Ashkelon , lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice , lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph .

verses.z: 基利波山哪，願你那裏沒有雨露！願你田地無土產可作供物！因為英雄的盾牌在那裏被污丟棄；掃羅的盾牌彷彿未曾抹油。
verses.e: You mountains of Gilboa , let there be no dew or rain on you , and no fields of offerings ; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away , the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil .

verses.z: 約拿單的弓箭非流敵人的血不退縮；掃羅的刀劍非剖勇士的油不收回。
verses.e: From the blood of the slain , from the fat of the mighty , Jonathan's bow didn't turn back . Saul's sword didn't return empty .

verses.z: 掃羅和約拿單－活時相悅相愛，死時也不分離－他們比鷹更快，比獅子還強。
verses.e: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives . In their death , they were not divided . They were swifter than eagles . They were stronger than lions .

verses.z: 以色列的女子啊，當為掃羅哭號！他曾使你們穿朱紅色的美衣，使你們衣服有黃金的妝飾。
verses.e: You daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you delicately in scarlet , who put ornaments of gold on your clothing .

verses.z: 英雄何竟在陣上仆倒！約拿單何竟在山上被殺！
verses.e: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle ! Jonathan was slain on your high places .

verses.z: 我兄約拿單哪，我為你悲傷！我甚喜悅你！你向我發的愛情奇妙非常，過於婦女的愛情。
verses.e: I am distressed for you , my brother Jonathan . You have been very pleasant to me . Your love to me was wonderful , surpassing the love of women .

verses.z: 英雄何竟仆倒！戰具何竟滅沒！
verses.e: How the mighty have fallen , and the weapons of war have perished ! "

verses.z: 大衛問他說：「你從哪裏來？」他說：「我從以色列的營裏逃來。」
verses.e: David said to him , " Where do you come from ? " He said to him , " I have escaped out of the camp of Israel . "

verses.z: 大衛又問他說：「事情怎樣？請你告訴我。」他回答說：「百姓從陣上逃跑，也有許多人仆倒死亡；掃羅和他兒子約拿單也死了。」
verses.e: David said to him , " How did it go ? Please tell me . " He answered , " The people have fled from the battle , and many of the people also have fallen and are dead . Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also . "

verses.z: 大衛問報信的少年人說：「你怎麼知道掃羅和他兒子約拿單死了呢？」
verses.e: David said to the young man who told him , " How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead ? "

verses.z: 報信的少年人說：「我偶然到基利波山，看見掃羅伏在自己槍上，有戰車、馬兵緊緊地追他。
verses.e: The young man who told him said , " As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa , behold , Saul was leaning on his spear ; and behold , the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him .

verses.z: 他回頭看見我，就呼叫我。我說：『我在這裏。』
verses.e: When he looked behind him , he saw me and called to me . I answered , ' Here I am . '

verses.z: 他問我說：『你是甚麼人？』我說：『我是亞瑪力人。』
verses.e: He said to me , ' Who are you ? ' I answered him , ' I am an Amalekite . '

verses.z: 他說：『請你來，將我殺死；因為痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。』
verses.e: He said to me , ' Please stand beside me , and kill me , for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me . '

verses.z: 此後，亞捫人的王死了，他兒子哈嫩接續他作王。
verses.e: After this , the king of the children of Ammon died , and Hanun his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對着亞捫人擺陣。
verses.e: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother ; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 約押對亞比篩說：「亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。
verses.e: He said , " If the Syrians are too strong for me , then you shall help me ; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you , then I will come and help you .

verses.z: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和上帝的城邑作大丈夫。願耶和華憑他的意旨而行！」
verses.e: Be courageous , and let's be strong for our people and for the cities of our God ; and may the LORD do what seems good to him . "

verses.z: 於是，約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。
verses.e: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians , and they fled before him .

verses.z: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就離開亞捫人那裏，回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled , they likewise fled before Abishai , and entered into the city . Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就又聚集。
verses.e: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel , they gathered themselves together .

verses.z: 哈大底謝差遣人，將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來；他們到了希蘭，哈大底謝的將軍朔法率領他們。
verses.e: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River ; and they came to Helam , with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人，過約旦河，來到希蘭。亞蘭人迎着大衛擺陣，與他打仗。
verses.e: David was told that ; and he gathered all Israel together , passed over the Jordan , and came to Helam . The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him .

verses.z: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑；大衛殺了亞蘭七百輛戰車[的人]，四萬馬兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。
verses.e: The Syrians fled before Israel ; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen , and struck Shobach the captain of their army , so that he died there .

verses.z: 屬哈大底謝的諸王見自己被以色列人打敗，就與以色列人和好，歸服他們。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
verses.e: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel , they made peace with Israel and served them . So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more .

verses.z: 大衛說：「我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」於是大衛差遣臣僕，為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內。
verses.e: David said , " I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash , as his father showed kindness to me . " So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father . David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 但亞捫人的首領對他們的主哈嫩說：「大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親嗎？他差臣僕來不是詳察窺探、要傾覆這城嗎？」
verses.e: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord , " Do you think that David honors your father , in that he has sent comforters to you ? Hasn't David sent his servants to you to search the city , to spy it out , and to overthrow it ? "

verses.z: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕的鬍鬚剃去一半，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。
verses.e: So Hanun took David's servants , shaved off one half of their beards , and cut off their garments in the middle , even to their buttocks , and sent them away .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，（因為他們甚覺羞恥），告訴他們說：「可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。」
verses.e: When they told David this , he sent to meet them , for the men were greatly ashamed . The king said , " Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown , and then return . "

verses.z: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，就打發人去，招募伯‧利合的亞蘭人和瑣巴的亞蘭人，步兵二萬，與瑪迦王的人一千、陀伯人一萬二千。
verses.e: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David , the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah , twenty thousand footmen , and the king of Maacah with one thousand men , and the men of Tob twelve thousand men .

verses.z: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。
verses.e: When David heard of it , he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men .

verses.z: 亞捫人出來，在城門前擺陣；瑣巴與利合的亞蘭人、陀伯人，並瑪迦人，另在郊野擺陣。
verses.e: The children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate . The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field .

verses.z: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對着亞蘭人擺陣。
verses.e: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians .

verses.z: 過了一年，到列王出戰的時候，大衛又差派約押，率領臣僕和以色列眾人出[戰]。他們就打敗亞捫人，圍攻拉巴。大衛仍住在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: At the return of the year , at the time when kings go out , David sent Joab and his servants with him , and all Israel ; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah . But David stayed at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛說：「烏利亞沒有回家去。」大衛就問烏利亞說：「你從遠路上來，為甚麼不回家去呢？」
verses.e: When they had told David , saying , " Uriah didn't go down to his house , " David said to Uriah , " Haven't you come from a journey ? Why didn't you go down to your house ? "

verses.z: 烏利亞對大衛說：「[約]櫃和以色列與猶大兵都住在棚裏，我主約押和我主的僕人都在田野安營，我豈可回家吃喝、與妻子同寢呢？我敢在王面前起誓：我決不行這事！」
verses.e: Uriah said to David , " The ark , Israel , and Judah , are staying in tents ; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field . Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink , and to lie with my wife ? As you live , and as your soul lives , I will not do this thing ! "

verses.z: 大衛吩咐烏利亞說：「你今日仍住在這裏，明日我打發你去。」於是烏利亞那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: David said to Uriah , " Stay here today also , and tomorrow I will let you depart . " So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day .

verses.z: 大衛召了烏利亞來，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，烏利亞出去與他主的僕人一同住宿，還沒有回到家裏去。
verses.e: When David had called him , he ate and drank before him ; and he made him drunk . At evening , he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord , but didn't go down to his house .

verses.z: 次日早晨，大衛寫信與約押，交烏利亞隨手帶去。
verses.e: In the morning , David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah .

verses.z: 信內寫着說：「要派烏利亞前進，到陣勢極險之處，你們便退後，使他被殺。」
verses.e: He wrote in the letter , saying , " Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle , and retreat from him , that he may be struck and die . "

verses.z: 約押圍城的時候，知道敵人那裏有勇士，便將烏利亞派在那裏。
verses.e: When Joab kept watch on the city , he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were .

verses.z: 城裏的人出來和約押打仗；大衛的僕人中有幾個被殺的，赫人烏利亞也死了。
verses.e: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab . Some of the people fell , even of David's servants ; and Uriah the Hittite died also .

verses.z: 於是，約押差人去將爭戰的一切事告訴大衛，
verses.e: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war ;

verses.z: 又囑咐使者說：「你把爭戰的一切事對王說完了，
verses.e: and he commanded the messenger , saying , " When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king ,

verses.z: 一日，太陽平西，大衛從床上起來，在王宮的平頂上遊行，看見一個婦人沐浴，容貌甚美，
verses.e: At evening , David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king's house . From the roof , he saw a woman bathing , and the woman was very beautiful to look at .

verses.z: 王若發怒，問你說：『你們打仗為甚麼挨近城牆呢？豈不知敵人必從城上射箭嗎？
verses.e: it shall be that , if the king's wrath arise , and he asks you , ' Why did you go so near to the city to fight ? Didn't you know that they would shoot from the wall ?

verses.z: 從前打死耶路‧比設兒子亞比米勒的是誰呢？豈不是一個婦人從城上拋下一塊上磨石來，打在他身上，他就死在提備斯嗎？你們為甚麼挨近城牆呢？』你就說：『王的僕人－赫人烏利亞也死了。』」
verses.e: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth ? Didn't a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall , so that he died at Thebez ? Why did you go so near the wall ? ' then you shall say , ' Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead . ' "

verses.z: 使者起身，來見大衛，照着約押所吩咐他的話奏告大衛。
verses.e: So the messenger went , and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for .

verses.z: 使者對大衛說：「敵人強過我們，出到郊野與我們打仗，我們追殺他們，直到城門口。
verses.e: The messenger said to David , " The men prevailed against us , and came out to us into the field ; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate .

verses.z: 射箭的從城上射王的僕人，射死幾個，赫人烏利亞也死了。」
verses.e: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall ; and some of the king's servants are dead , and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead . "

verses.z: 王向使者說：「你告訴約押說：『不要因這事愁悶，刀劍或吞滅這人或吞滅那人，沒有一定的；你只管竭力攻城，將城傾覆。』可以用這話勉勵約押。」
verses.e: Then David said to the messenger , " Tell Joab , ' Don't let this thing displease you , for the sword devours one as well as another . Make your battle stronger against the city , and overthrow it . ' Encourage him . "

verses.z: 烏利亞的妻聽見丈夫烏利亞死了，就為他哀哭。
verses.e: When Uriah's wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead , she mourned for her husband .

verses.z: 哀哭的日子過了，大衛差人將她接到宮裏，她就作了大衛的妻，給大衛生了一個兒子。但大衛所行的這事，耶和華甚不喜悅。
verses.e: When the mourning was past , David sent and took her home to his house , and she became his wife and bore him a son . But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD .

verses.z: 大衛就差人打聽那婦人是誰。有人說：「她是以連的女兒，赫人烏利亞的妻拔示巴。」
verses.e: David sent and inquired after the woman . One said , " Isn't this Bathsheba , the daughter of Eliam , Uriah the Hittite's wife ? "

verses.z: 大衛差人去，將婦人接來；那時她的月經才得潔淨。她來了，大衛與她同房，她就回家去了。
verses.e: David sent messengers , and took her ; and she came in to him , and he lay with her ( for she was purified from her uncleanness ) ; and she returned to her house .

verses.z: 於是她懷了孕，打發人去告訴大衛說：「我懷了孕。」
verses.e: The woman conceived ; and she sent and told David , and said , " I am with child . "

verses.z: 大衛差人到約押那裏，[說]：「你打發赫人烏利亞到我這裏來。」約押就打發烏利亞去見大衛。
verses.e: David sent to Joab , " Send me Uriah the Hittite . " Joab sent Uriah to David .

verses.z: 烏利亞來了，大衛問約押好，也問兵好，又問爭戰的事怎樣。
verses.e: When Uriah had come to him , David asked him how Joab did , and how the people fared , and how the war prospered .

verses.z: 大衛對烏利亞說：「你回家去，洗洗腳吧！」烏利亞出了王宮，隨後王送他一分[食]物。
verses.e: David said to Uriah , " Go down to your house and wash your feet . " Uriah departed out of the king's house , and a gift from the king was sent after him .

verses.z: 烏利亞卻和他主人的僕人一同睡在宮門外，沒有回家去。
verses.e: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord , and didn't go down to his house .

verses.z: 耶和華差遣拿單去見大衛。拿單到了大衛那裏，對他說：「在一座城裏有兩個人：一個是富戶，一個是窮人。
verses.e: The LORD sent Nathan to David . He came to him , and said to him , " There were two men in one city : the one rich , and the other poor .

verses.z: 你既藐視我，娶了赫人烏利亞的妻為妻，所以刀劍必永不離開你的家。』
verses.e: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house , because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite's wife to be your wife . '

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：『我必從你家中興起禍患攻擊你；我必在你眼前把你的妃嬪賜給別人，他在日光之下就與她們同寢。
verses.e: " This is what the LORD says : ' Behold , I will raise up evil against you out of your own house ; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor , and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun .

verses.z: 你在暗中行這事，我卻要在以色列眾人面前，日光之下，報應你。』」
verses.e: For you did this secretly , but I will do this thing before all Israel , and before the sun . ' "

verses.z: 大衛對拿單說：「我得罪耶和華了！」拿單說：「耶和華已經除掉你的罪，你必不至於死。
verses.e: David said to Nathan , " I have sinned against the LORD . " Nathan said to David , " The LORD also has put away your sin . You will not die .

verses.z: 只是你行這事，叫耶和華的仇敵大得褻瀆的機會，故此，你所得的孩子必定要死。」
verses.e: However , because by this deed you have given great occasion to the LORD's enemies to blaspheme , the child also who is born to you will surely die . "

verses.z: 拿單就回家去了。耶和華擊打烏利亞妻給大衛所生的孩子，使他得重病。
verses.e: Then Nathan departed to his house . The LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bore to David , and he was very sick .

verses.z: 所以大衛為這孩子懇求上帝，而且禁食，進入[內室]，終夜躺在地上。
verses.e: David therefore begged God for the child ; and David fasted , and went in and lay all night on the ground .

verses.z: 他家中的老臣來到他旁邊，要把他從地上扶起來，他卻不肯起來，也不同他們吃飯。
verses.e: The elders of his house arose beside him , to raise him up from the earth ; but he would not , and he didn't eat bread with them .

verses.z: 到第七日，孩子死了。大衛的臣僕不敢告訴他孩子死了，因他們說：「孩子還活着的時候，我們勸他，他尚且不肯聽我們的話，若告訴他孩子死了，豈不更加憂傷嗎？」
verses.e: On the seventh day , the child died . David's servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead , for they said , " Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spoke to him and he didn't listen to our voice . How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead ? "

verses.z: 大衛見臣僕彼此低聲說話，就知道孩子死了，問臣僕說：「孩子死了嗎？」他們說：「死了。」
verses.e: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together , David perceived that the child was dead ; and David said to his servants , " Is the child dead ? " They said , " He is dead . "

verses.z: 富戶有許多牛群羊群；
verses.e: The rich man had very many flocks and herds ,

verses.z: 大衛就從地上起來，沐浴，抹膏，換了衣裳，進耶和華的殿敬拜；然後回宮，吩咐人擺飯，他便吃了。
verses.e: Then David arose from the earth , and washed and anointed himself , and changed his clothing ; and he came into the LORD's house , and worshiped . Then he came to his own house ; and when he requested , they set bread before him and he ate .

verses.z: 臣僕問他說：「你所行的是甚麼意思？孩子活着的時候，你禁食哭泣；孩子死了，你倒起來吃飯。」
verses.e: Then his servants said to him , " What is this that you have done ? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive , but when the child was dead , you rose up and ate bread . "

verses.z: 大衛說：「孩子還活着，我禁食哭泣；因為我想，或者耶和華憐恤我，使孩子不死也未可知。
verses.e: He said , " While the child was yet alive , I fasted and wept ; for I said , ' Who knows whether the LORD will not be gracious to me , that the child may live ? '

verses.z: 孩子死了，我何必禁食，我豈能使他返回呢？我必往他那裏去，他卻不能回我這裏來。」
verses.e: But now he is dead . Why should I fast ? Can I bring him back again ? I will go to him , but he will not return to me . "

verses.z: 大衛安慰他的妻拔示巴，與她同寢，她就生了兒子，給他起名叫所羅門。耶和華也喜愛他，
verses.e: David comforted Bathsheba his wife , and went in to her , and lay with her . She bore a son , and he called his name Solomon . The LORD loved him ;

verses.z: 就藉先知拿單賜他一個名字，叫耶底底亞，因為耶和華[愛他]。
verses.e: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet , and he named him Jedidiah , for the LORD's sake .

verses.z: 約押攻取亞捫人的京城拉巴。
verses.e: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and took the royal city .

verses.z: 約押打發使者去見大衛，說：「我攻打拉巴，取其水城。
verses.e: Joab sent messengers to David , and said , " I have fought against Rabbah . Yes , I have taken the city of waters .

verses.z: 現在你要聚集其餘的軍兵來，安營圍攻這城，恐怕我取了這城，人就以我的名叫這城。」
verses.e: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together , and encamp against the city and take it ; lest I take the city , and it be called by my name . "

verses.z: 於是大衛聚集眾軍，往拉巴去攻城，就取了這城，
verses.e: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah , and fought against it and took it .

verses.z: 窮人除了所買來養活的一隻小母羊羔之外，別無所有。羊羔在他家裏和他兒女一同長大，吃他所吃的，喝他所喝的，睡在他懷中，在他看來如同女兒一樣。
verses.e: but the poor man had nothing , except one little ewe lamb , which he had bought and raised . It grew up together with him and with his children . It ate of his own food , drank of his own cup , and lay in his bosom , and was like a daughter to him .

verses.z: 奪了亞捫人之王所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他連得，又嵌着寶石。人將這冠冕戴在大衛頭上。大衛從城裏奪了許多財物，
verses.e: He took the crown of their king from off his head ; and its weight was a talent of gold , and in it were precious stones ; and it was set on David's head . He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city .

verses.z: 將城裏的人拉出來，放在鋸下，或鐵耙下，或鐵斧下，或叫他經過磚窯；大衛待亞捫各城的居民都是如此。其後，大衛和眾軍都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: He brought out the people who were in it , and put them to work under saws , under iron picks , under axes of iron , and made them go to the brick kiln ; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon . Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 有一客人來到這富戶家裏；富戶捨不得從自己的牛群羊群中取一隻預備給客人吃，卻取了那窮人的羊羔，預備給客人吃。」
verses.e: A traveler came to the rich man , and he didn't want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him , but took the poor man's lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him . "

verses.z: 大衛就甚惱怒那人，對拿單說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，行這事的人該死！
verses.e: David's anger burned hot against the man , and he said to Nathan , " As the LORD lives , the man who has done this deserves to die !

verses.z: 他必償還羊羔四倍；因為他行這事，沒有憐恤的心。」
verses.e: He must restore the lamb fourfold , because he did this thing and because he had no pity ! "

verses.z: 拿單對大衛說：「你就是那人！耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『我膏你作以色列的王，救你脫離掃羅的手。
verses.e: Nathan said to David , " You are the man ! This is what the LORD , the God of Israel , says : ' I anointed you king over Israel , and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul .

verses.z: 我將你主人的家業賜給你，將你主人的妻交在你懷裏，又將以色列和猶大家賜給你；你若還以為不足，我早就加倍地賜給你。
verses.e: I gave you your master's house and your master's wives into your bosom , and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah ; and if that would have been too little , I would have added to you many more such things .

verses.z: 你為甚麼藐視耶和華的命令，行他眼中看為惡的事呢？你借亞捫人的刀殺害赫人烏利亞，又娶了他的妻為妻。
verses.e: Why have you despised the LORD's word , to do that which is evil in his sight ? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword , have taken his wife to be your wife , and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 大衛的兒子押沙龍有一個美貌的妹子，名叫她瑪。大衛的兒子暗嫩愛她。
verses.e: After this , Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister , whose name was Tamar ; and Amnon the son of David loved her .

verses.z: 暗嫩對她瑪說：「你把食物拿進臥房，我好從你手裏接過來吃。」她瑪就把所做的餅拿進臥房，到她哥哥暗嫩那裏，
verses.e: Amnon said to Tamar , " Bring the food into the room , that I may eat from your hand . " Tamar took the cakes which she had made , and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother .

verses.z: 拿着餅上前給他吃，他便拉住她瑪，說：「我妹妹，你來與我同寢。」
verses.e: When she had brought them near to him to eat , he took hold of her and said to her , " Come , lie with me , my sister ! "

verses.z: 她瑪說：「我哥哥，不要玷辱我。以色列人中不當這樣行，你不要做這醜事；
verses.e: She answered him , " No , my brother , do not force me ! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel . Don't you do this folly !

verses.z: 你[玷辱了我]，我何以掩蓋我的羞恥呢？你在以色列中也成了愚妄人。你可以求王，他必不禁止我歸你。」
verses.e: As for me , where would I carry my shame ? And as for you , you will be as one of the fools in Israel . Now therefore , please speak to the king ; for he will not withhold me from you . "

verses.z: 但暗嫩不肯聽她的話，因比她力大，就玷辱她，與她同寢。
verses.e: However , he would not listen to her voice ; but being stronger than she , he forced her and lay with her .

verses.z: 隨後，暗嫩極其恨她，那恨她的心比先前愛她的心更甚，對她說：「你起來，去吧！」
verses.e: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred ; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her . Amnon said to her , " Arise , be gone ! "

verses.z: 她瑪說：「不要這樣！你趕出我去的這罪比你才行的更重！」但暗嫩不肯聽她的話，
verses.e: She said to him , " Not so , because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me ! " But he would not listen to her .

verses.z: 就叫伺候自己的僕人來，說：「將這個女子趕出去！她一出去，你就關門，上閂。」
verses.e: Then he called his servant who ministered to him , and said , " Now put this woman out from me , and bolt the door after her . "

verses.z: 那時她瑪穿着彩衣，因為沒有出嫁的公主都是這樣穿。暗嫩的僕人就把她趕出去，關門上閂。
verses.e: She had a garment of various colors on her , for the king's daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes . Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her .

verses.z: 她瑪把灰塵撒在頭上，撕裂所穿的彩衣，以手抱頭，一面行走，一面哭喊。
verses.e: Tamar put ashes on her head , and tore her garment of various colors that was on her ; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way , crying aloud as she went .

verses.z: 暗嫩為他妹子她瑪憂急成病。她瑪還是處女，暗嫩以為難向她行事。
verses.e: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar , for she was a virgin , and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her .

verses.z: 她胞兄押沙龍問她說：「莫非你哥哥暗嫩與你親近了嗎？我妹妹，暫且不要作聲，他是你的哥哥，不要將這事放在心上。」她瑪就孤孤單單地住在她胞兄押沙龍家裏。
verses.e: Absalom her brother said to her , " Has Amnon your brother been with you ? But now hold your peace , my sister . He is your brother . Don't take this thing to heart . " So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house .

verses.z: 大衛王聽見這事，就甚發怒。
verses.e: But when King David heard of all these things , he was very angry .

verses.z: 押沙龍並不和他哥哥暗嫩說好說歹；因為暗嫩玷辱他妹妹她瑪，所以押沙龍恨惡他。
verses.e: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad ; for Absalom hated Amnon , because he had forced his sister Tamar .

verses.z: 過了二年，在靠近以法蓮的巴力‧夏瑣有人為押沙龍剪羊毛；押沙龍請王的眾子與他同去。
verses.e: After two full years , Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor , which is beside Ephraim ; and Absalom invited all the king's sons .

verses.z: 押沙龍來見王，說：「現在有人為僕人剪羊毛，請王和王的臣僕與僕人同去。」
verses.e: Absalom came to the king and said , " See now , your servant has sheep shearers . Please let the king and his servants go with your servant . "

verses.z: 王對押沙龍說：「我兒，我們不必都去，恐怕使你耗費太多。」押沙龍再三請王，王仍是不肯去，只為他祝福。
verses.e: The king said to Absalom , " No , my son , let's not all go , lest we be burdensome to you . " He pressed him ; however he would not go , but blessed him .

verses.z: 押沙龍說：「王若不去，求王許我哥哥暗嫩同去。」王說：「何必要他去呢？」
verses.e: Then Absalom said , " If not , please let my brother Amnon go with us . " The king said to him , " Why should he go with you ? "

verses.z: 押沙龍再三求王，王就許暗嫩和王的眾子與他同去。
verses.e: But Absalom pressed him , and he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him .

verses.z: 押沙龍吩咐僕人說：「你們注意，看暗嫩飲酒暢快的時候，我對你們說殺暗嫩，你們便殺他，不要懼怕。這不是我吩咐你們的嗎？你們只管壯膽奮勇！」
verses.e: Absalom commanded his servants , saying , " Mark now , when Amnon's heart is merry with wine ; and when I tell you , ' Strike Amnon , ' then kill him . Don't be afraid . Haven't I commanded you ? Be courageous , and be valiant ! "

verses.z: 押沙龍的僕人就照押沙龍所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王的眾子都起來，各人騎上騾子，逃跑了。
verses.e: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded . Then all the king's sons arose , and every man got up on his mule and fled .

verses.z: 暗嫩有一個朋友，名叫約拿達，是大衛長兄示米亞的兒子。這約拿達為人極其狡猾；
verses.e: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah , David's brother ; and Jonadab was a very subtle man .

verses.z: 他們還在路上，有風聲傳到大衛那裏，說：「押沙龍將王的眾子都殺了，沒有留下一個。」
verses.e: While they were on the way , the news came to David , saying , " Absalom has slain all the king's sons , and there is not one of them left ! "

verses.z: 王就起來，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。王的臣僕也都撕裂衣服，站在旁邊。
verses.e: Then the king arose , and tore his garments , and lay on the earth ; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn .

verses.z: 大衛的長兄，示米亞的兒子約拿達說：「我主，不要以為王的眾子－少年人都殺了，只有暗嫩一個人死了。自從暗嫩玷辱押沙龍妹子她瑪的那日，押沙龍就定意殺暗嫩了。
verses.e: Jonadab the son of Shimeah , David's brother , answered , " Don't let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men , the king's sons , for Amnon only is dead ; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar .

verses.z: 現在，我主我王，不要把這事放在心上，以為王的眾子都死了，只有暗嫩一個人死了。」
verses.e: Now therefore don't let my lord the king take the thing to his heart , to think that all the king's sons are dead ; for only Amnon is dead . "

verses.z: 押沙龍逃跑了。守望的少年人舉目觀看，見有許多人從山坡的路上來。
verses.e: But Absalom fled . The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked , and behold , many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him .

verses.z: 約拿達對王說：「看哪，王的眾子都來了，果然與你僕人所說的相合。」
verses.e: Jonadab said to the king , " Behold , the king's sons are coming ! It is as your servant said . "

verses.z: 話才說完，王的眾子都到了，放聲大哭；王和臣僕也都哭得甚慟。
verses.e: As soon as he had finished speaking , behold , the king's sons came , and lifted up their voices and wept . The king also and all his servants wept bitterly .

verses.z: 押沙龍逃到基述王亞米忽的兒子達買那裏去了。大衛天天為他兒子悲哀。
verses.e: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur , king of Geshur . David mourned for his son every day .

verses.z: 押沙龍逃到基述，在那裏住了三年。
verses.e: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur , and was there three years .

verses.z: 暗嫩死了以後，大衛王得了安慰，心裏切切想念押沙龍。
verses.e: King David longed to go out to Absalom , for he was comforted concerning Amnon , since he was dead .

verses.z: 他問暗嫩說：「王的兒子啊，為何一天比一天瘦弱呢？請你告訴我。」暗嫩回答說：「我愛我兄弟押沙龍的妹子她瑪。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Why , son of the king , are you so sad from day to day ? Won't you tell me ? " Amnon said to him , " I love Tamar , my brother Absalom's sister . "

verses.z: 約拿達說：「你不如躺在床上裝病；你父親來看你，就對他說：『求父叫我妹子她瑪來，在我眼前預備食物，遞給我吃，使我看見，好從她手裏接過來吃。』」
verses.e: Jonadab said to him , " Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick . When your father comes to see you , tell him , ' Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat , and prepare the food in my sight , that I may see it and eat it from her hand . ' "

verses.z: 於是暗嫩躺臥裝病。王來看他，他對王說：「求父叫我妹子她瑪來，在我眼前為我做兩個餅，我好從她手裏接過來吃。」
verses.e: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick . When the king came to see him , Amnon said to the king , " Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight , that I may eat from her hand . "

verses.z: 大衛就打發人到宮裏，對她瑪說：「你往你哥哥暗嫩的屋裏去，為他預備食物。」
verses.e: Then David sent home to Tamar , saying , " Go now to your brother Amnon's house , and prepare food for him . "

verses.z: 她瑪就到她哥哥暗嫩的屋裏；暗嫩正躺臥。她瑪摶麵，在他眼前做餅，且烤熟了，
verses.e: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house ; and he was lying down . She took dough , kneaded it , made cakes in his sight , and baked the cakes .

verses.z: 在他面前將餅從鍋裏倒出來，他卻不肯吃，便說：「眾人離開我出去吧！」眾人就都離開他，出去了。
verses.e: She took the pan and poured them out before him , but he refused to eat . Amnon said , " Have all men leave me . " Then every man went out from him .

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子約押，知道王心裏想念押沙龍，
verses.e: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom .

verses.z: 王說：「凡難為你的，你就帶他到我這裏來，他必不再攪擾你。」
verses.e: The king said , " Whoever says anything to you , bring him to me , and he will not bother you any more . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「願王記念耶和華－你的上帝，不許報血仇的人施行滅絕，恐怕他們滅絕我的兒子。」王說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓：你的兒子連一根頭髮也不致落在地上。」
verses.e: Then she said , " Please let the king remember the LORD your God , that the avenger of blood destroy not any more , lest they destroy my son . " He said , " As the LORD lives , not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「求我主我王容婢女再說一句話。」王說：「你說吧！」
verses.e: Then the woman said , " Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king . " He said , " Say on . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「王為何也起意要害上帝的民呢？王不使那逃亡的人回來，王的這話就是自證己錯了！
verses.e: The woman said , " Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God ? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty , in that the king does not bring home again his banished one .

verses.z: 我們都是必死的，如同水潑在地上，不能收回。上帝並不奪取人的性命，乃設法使逃亡的人不致成為趕出、回不來的。
verses.e: For we must die , and are like water spilled on the ground , which can't be gathered up again ; neither does God take away life , but devises means , that he who is banished not be an outcast from him .

verses.z: 我來將這話告訴我主我王，是因百姓使我懼怕。婢女想，不如將這話告訴王，或者王成就婢女所求的。
verses.e: Now therefore , seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king , it is because the people have made me afraid . Your servant said , ' I will now speak to the king ; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant . '

verses.z: 人要將我和我兒子從上帝的地業上一同除滅，王必應允救我脫離他的手。
verses.e: For the king will hear , to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God .

verses.z: 婢女又想，我主我王的話必安慰我；因為我主我王能辨別是非，如同上帝的使者一樣。惟願耶和華－你的上帝與你同在！」
verses.e: Then your servant said , ' Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest ; for as an angel of God , so is my lord the king to discern good and bad . May the LORD , your God , be with you . ' "

verses.z: 王對婦人說：「我要問你一句話，你一點不要瞞我。」婦人說：「願我主我王說。」
verses.e: Then the king answered the woman , " Please don't hide anything from me that I ask you . " The woman said , " Let my lord the king now speak . "

verses.z: 王說：「你這些話莫非是約押的主意嗎？」婦人說：「我敢在我主我王面前起誓：王的話正對，不偏左右，是王的僕人約押吩咐我的，這些話是他教導我的。
verses.e: The king said , " Is the hand of Joab with you in all this ? " The woman answered , " As your soul lives , my lord the king , no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken ; for your servant Joab urged me , and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant .

verses.z: 就打發人往提哥亞去，從那裏叫了一個聰明的婦人來，對她說：「請你假裝居喪的，穿上孝衣，不要用膏抹身，要裝作為死者許久悲哀的婦人；
verses.e: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there , and said to her , " Please act like a mourner , and put on mourning clothing , please , and don't anoint yourself with oil ; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead .

verses.z: 王的僕人約押如此行，為要挽回這事。我主的智慧卻如上帝使者的智慧，能知世上一切事。」
verses.e: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter . My lord is wise , according to the wisdom of an angel of God , to know all things that are in the earth . "

verses.z: 王對約押說：「我應允你這事。你可以去，把那少年人押沙龍帶回來。」
verses.e: The king said to Joab , " Behold now , I have granted this thing . Go therefore , and bring the young man Absalom back . "

verses.z: 約押就面伏於地叩拜，祝謝於王，又說：「王既應允僕人所求的，僕人今日知道在我主我王眼前蒙恩了。」
verses.e: Joab fell to the ground on his face , showed respect , and blessed the king . Joab said , " Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight , my lord , O king , in that the king has performed the request of his servant . "

verses.z: 於是約押起身往基述去，將押沙龍帶回耶路撒冷。
verses.e: So Joab arose and went to Geshur , and brought Absalom to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 王說：「使他回自己家裏去，不要見我的面。」押沙龍就回自己家裏去，沒有見王的面。
verses.e: The king said , " Let him return to his own house , but let him not see my face . " So Absalom returned to his own house , and didn't see the king's face .

verses.z: 以色列全地之中，無人像押沙龍那樣俊美，得人的稱讚，從腳底到頭頂毫無瑕疵。
verses.e: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty . From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him .

verses.z: 他的頭髮甚重，每到年底剪髮一次；所剪下來的，按王的平稱一稱，重二百舍客勒。
verses.e: When he cut the hair of his head ( now it was at every year's end that he cut it ; because it was heavy on him , therefore he cut it ) , he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels , after the king's weight .

verses.z: 押沙龍生了三個兒子，一個女兒。女兒名叫她瑪，是個容貌俊美的女子。
verses.e: Three sons were born to Absalom , and one daughter , whose name was Tamar . She was a woman with a beautiful face .

verses.z: 押沙龍住在耶路撒冷足有二年，沒有見王的面。
verses.e: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem , and he didn't see the king's face .

verses.z: 押沙龍打發人去叫約押來，要託他去見王，約押卻不肯來。第二次打發人去叫他，他仍不肯來。
verses.e: Then Absalom sent for Joab , to send him to the king , but he would not come to him . Then he sent again a second time , but he would not come .

verses.z: 進去見王，對王如此如此說。」於是約押將當說的話教導了婦人。
verses.e: Go in to the king and speak like this to him . " So Joab put the words in her mouth .

verses.z: 所以押沙龍對僕人說：「你們看，約押有一塊田，與我的田相近，其中有大麥，你們去放火燒了。」押沙龍的僕人就去放火燒了那田。
verses.e: Therefore he said to his servants , " Behold , Joab's field is near mine , and he has barley there . Go and set it on fire . " So Absalom's servants set the field on fire .

verses.z: 於是約押起來，到了押沙龍家裏，問他說：「你的僕人為何放火燒了我的田呢？」
verses.e: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house , and said to him , " Why have your servants set my field on fire ? "

verses.z: 押沙龍回答約押說：「我打發人去請你來，好託你去見王，替我說：『我為何從基述回來呢？不如仍在那裏。』現在要許我見王的面；我若有罪，任憑王殺我就是了。」
verses.e: Absalom answered Joab , " Behold , I sent to you , saying , ' Come here , that I may send you to the king , to say , " Why have I come from Geshur ? It would be better for me to be there still . Now therefore , let me see the king's face ; and if there is iniquity in me , let him kill me . " ' "

verses.z: 於是約押去見王，將這話奏告王，王便叫押沙龍來。押沙龍來見王，在王面前俯伏於地，王就與押沙龍親嘴。
verses.e: So Joab came to the king and told him ; and when he had called for Absalom , he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king ; and the king kissed Absalom .

verses.z: 提哥亞婦人到王面前，伏地叩拜，說：「王啊，求你拯救！」
verses.e: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , showed respect , and said , " Help , O king ! "

verses.z: 王問她說：「你有甚麼事呢？」回答說：「婢女實在是寡婦，我丈夫死了。
verses.e: The king said to her , " What ails you ? " She answered , " Truly I am a widow , and my husband is dead .

verses.z: 我有兩個兒子，一日在田間爭鬥，沒有人解勸，這個就打死那個。
verses.e: Your servant had two sons ; and they both fought together in the field , and there was no one to part them , but the one struck the other and killed him .

verses.z: 現在全家的人都起來攻擊婢女，說：『你將那打死兄弟的交出來，我們好治死他，償他打死兄弟的命，滅絕那承受家業的。』這樣，他們要將我剩下的炭火滅盡，不與我丈夫留名留後在世上。」
verses.e: Behold , the whole family has risen against your servant , and they say , ' Deliver him who struck his brother , that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed , and so destroy the heir also . ' Thus they would quench my coal which is left , and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth . "

verses.z: 王對婦人說：「你回家去吧！我必為你下令。」
verses.e: The king said to the woman , " Go to your house , and I will give a command concerning you . "

verses.z: 提哥亞婦人又對王說：「我主我王，願這罪歸我和我父家，與王和王的位無干。」
verses.e: The woman of Tekoa said to the king , " My lord , O king , may the iniquity be on me , and on my father's house ; and may the king and his throne be guiltless . "

verses.z: 此後，押沙龍為自己預備車馬，又派五十人在他前頭奔走。
verses.e: After this , Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself , and fifty men to run before him .

verses.z: 押沙龍打發探子走遍以色列各支派，說：「你們一聽見角聲就說：『押沙龍在希伯崙作王了！』」
verses.e: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , " As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet , then you shall say , ' Absalom is king in Hebron ! ' "

verses.z: 押沙龍在耶路撒冷請了二百人與他同去，都是誠誠實實去的，並不知道其中的真情。
verses.e: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem , who were invited , and went in their simplicity ; and they didn't know anything .

verses.z: 押沙龍獻祭的時候，打發人去將大衛的謀士、基羅人亞希多弗從他本城請了來。於是叛逆的勢派甚大；因為隨從押沙龍的人民，日漸增多。
verses.e: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite , David's counselor , from his city , even from Giloh , while he was offering the sacrifices . The conspiracy was strong , for the people increased continually with Absalom .

verses.z: 有人報告大衛說：「以色列人的心都歸向押沙龍了！」
verses.e: A messenger came to David , saying , " The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom . "

verses.z: 大衛就對耶路撒冷跟隨他的臣僕說：「我們要起來逃走，不然都不能躲避押沙龍了；要速速地去，恐怕他忽然來到，加害於我們，用刀殺盡合城的人。」
verses.e: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem , " Arise ! Let's flee , or else none of us will escape from Absalom . Hurry to depart , lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us , and strike the city with the edge of the sword . "

verses.z: 王的臣僕對王說：「我主我王所定的，僕人都願遵行。」
verses.e: The king's servants said to the king , " Behold , your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses . "

verses.z: 於是王帶着全家的人出去了，但留下十個妃嬪看守宮殿。
verses.e: The king went out , and all his household after him . The king left ten women , who were concubines , to keep the house .

verses.z: 王出去，眾民都跟隨他，到伯墨哈，就住下了。
verses.e: The king went out , and all the people after him ; and they stayed in Beth Merhak .

verses.z: 王的臣僕都在他面前過去。基利提人、比利提人，就是從迦特跟隨王來的六百人，也都在他面前過去。
verses.e: All his servants passed on beside him ; and all the Cherethites , and all the Pelethites , and all the Gittites , six hundred men who came after him from Gath , passed on before the king .

verses.z: 王對迦特人以太說：「你是外邦逃來的人，為甚麼與我們同去呢？你可以回去與[新]王同住，[或者回]你本地去吧！
verses.e: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite , " Why do you also go with us ? Return , and stay with the king ; for you are a foreigner and also an exile . Return to your own place .

verses.z: 押沙龍常常早晨起來，站在城門的道旁，凡有爭訟要去求王判斷的，押沙龍就叫他過來，問他說：「你是哪一城的人？」回答說：「僕人是以色列某支派的人。」
verses.e: Absalom rose up early , and stood beside the way of the gate . When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment , then Absalom called to him , and said , " What city are you from ? " He said , " Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel . "

verses.z: 你來的日子不多，我今日怎好叫你與我們一同飄流、沒有一定的住處呢？你不如帶你的弟兄回去吧！[願耶和華]用慈愛誠實待你。」
verses.e: Whereas you came but yesterday , should I today make you go up and down with us , since I go where I may ? Return , and take back your brothers . Mercy and truth be with you . "

verses.z: 以太對王說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，又敢在王面前起誓：無論生死，王在哪裏，僕人也必在那裏。」
verses.e: Ittai answered the king and said , " As the LORD lives , and as my lord the king lives , surely in what place my lord the king is , whether for death or for life , your servant will be there also . "

verses.z: 大衛對以太說：「你前去過[河]吧！」於是迦特人以太帶着跟隨他的人和所有的[婦人]孩子，就都過去了。
verses.e: David said to Ittai , " Go and pass over . " Ittai the Gittite passed over , and all his men , and all the little ones who were with him .

verses.z: 本地的人都放聲大哭。眾民盡都過去，王也過了汲淪溪；眾民往曠野去了。
verses.e: All the country wept with a loud voice , and all the people passed over . The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron , and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness .

verses.z: 撒督和抬上帝約櫃的利未人也一同來了，將上帝的[約]櫃放下。亞比亞他上來，等着眾民從城裏出來過去。
verses.e: Behold , Zadok also came , and all the Levites with him , bearing the ark of the covenant of God ; and they set down God's ark ; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city .

verses.z: 王對撒督說：「你將上帝的[約]櫃抬回城去。我若在耶和華眼前蒙恩，他必使我回來，再見[約]櫃和他的居所。
verses.e: The king said to Zadok , " Carry God's ark back into the city . If I find favor in the LORD's eyes , he will bring me again , and show me both it and his habitation ;

verses.z: 倘若他說：『我不喜悅你』，看哪，我在這裏，願他憑自己的意旨待我！」
