verses.e: but if he says , ' I have no delight in you , ' behold , here I am . Let him do to me as seems good to him . "

verses.z: 王又對祭司撒督說：「你不是先見嗎？你可以安然回城；你兒子亞希瑪斯和亞比亞他的兒子約拿單都可以與你同去。
verses.e: The king said also to Zadok the priest , " Aren't you a seer ? Return into the city in peace , and your two sons with you , Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar .

verses.z: 我在曠野的渡口那裏等你們報信給我。」
verses.e: Behold , I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me . "

verses.z: 於是撒督和亞比亞他將上帝的[約]櫃抬回耶路撒冷，他們就住在那裏。
verses.e: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God's ark to Jerusalem again ; and they stayed there .

verses.z: 押沙龍對他說：「你的事有情有理，無奈王沒有委人聽你伸訴。」
verses.e: Absalom said to him , " Behold , your matters are good and right ; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you . "

verses.z: 大衛蒙頭赤腳上橄欖山，一面上一面哭。跟隨他的人也都蒙頭哭着上去；
verses.e: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives , and wept as he went up ; and he had his head covered and went barefoot . All the people who were with him each covered his head , and they went up , weeping as they went up .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛說：「亞希多弗也在叛黨之中，隨從押沙龍。」大衛禱告說：「耶和華啊，求你使亞希多弗的計謀變為愚拙！」
verses.e: Someone told David , saying , " Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . " David said , " LORD , please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness . "

verses.z: 大衛到了[山]頂、敬拜上帝的地方，見亞基人戶篩，衣服撕裂，頭蒙灰塵來迎接他。
verses.e: When David had come to the top , where God was worshiped , behold , Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head .

verses.z: 大衛對他說：「你若與我同去，必累贅我；
verses.e: David said to him , " If you pass on with me , then you will be a burden to me ;

verses.z: 你若回城去，對押沙龍說：『王啊，我願作你的僕人；我向來作你父親的僕人，現在我也照樣作你的僕人。』這樣，你就可以為我破壞亞希多弗的計謀。
verses.e: but if you return to the city , and tell Absalom , ' I will be your servant , O king . As I have been your father's servant in time past , so I will now be your servant ; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel . '

verses.z: 祭司撒督和亞比亞他豈不都在那裏嗎？你在王宮裏聽見甚麼，就要告訴祭司撒督和亞比亞他。
verses.e: Don't you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you ? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king's house , tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests .

verses.z: 撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯，亞比亞他的兒子約拿單，也都在那裏。凡你們所聽見的可以託這二人來報告我。」
verses.e: Behold , they have there with them their two sons , Ahimaaz , Zadok's son , and Jonathan , Abiathar's son . Send to me everything that you shall hear by them . "

verses.z: 於是，大衛的朋友戶篩進了城；押沙龍也進了耶路撒冷。
verses.e: So Hushai , David's friend , came into the city ; and Absalom came into Jerusalem .

verses.z: 押沙龍又說：「恨不得我作國中的士師！凡有爭訟求審判的到我這裏來，我必秉公判斷。」
verses.e: Absalom said moreover , " Oh that I were made judge in the land , that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me , and I would do him justice ! "

verses.z: 若有人近前來要拜押沙龍，押沙龍就伸手拉住他，與他親嘴。
verses.e: It was so , that when any man came near to bow down to him , he stretched out his hand , took hold of him , and kissed him .

verses.z: 以色列人中，凡去見王求判斷的，押沙龍都是如此待他們。這樣，押沙龍暗中得了以色列人的心。
verses.e: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment . So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel .

verses.z: 滿了四十年，押沙龍對王說：「求你准我往希伯崙去，還我向耶和華所許的願。
verses.e: At the end of forty years , Absalom said to the king , " Please let me go and pay my vow , which I have vowed to the LORD , in Hebron .

verses.z: 因為僕人住在亞蘭的基述，曾許願說：『耶和華若使我再回耶路撒冷，我必事奉他。』」
verses.e: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria , saying , ' If the LORD shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem , then I will serve the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 王說：「你平平安安地去吧！」押沙龍就起身，往希伯崙去了。
verses.e: The king said to him , " Go in peace . " So he arose and went to Hebron .

verses.z: 大衛剛過[山]頂，見米非波設的僕人洗巴拉着備好了的兩匹驢，驢上馱着二百麵餅，一百葡萄餅，一百個夏天的果餅，一皮袋酒來迎接他。
verses.e: When David was a little past the top , behold , Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled , and on them two hundred loaves of bread , and one hundred clusters of raisins , and one hundred summer fruits , and a container of wine .

verses.z: 王說：「洗魯雅的兒子，我與你們有何關涉呢？他咒罵是因耶和華吩咐他說：『你要咒罵大衛。』如此，誰敢說你為甚麼這樣行呢？」
verses.e: The king said , " What have I to do with you , you sons of Zeruiah ? Because he curses , and because the LORD has said to him , ' Curse David , ' who then shall say , ' Why have you done so ? ' "

verses.z: 大衛又對亞比篩和眾臣僕說：「我親生的兒子尚且尋索我的性命，何況這便雅憫人呢？由他咒罵吧！因為這是耶和華吩咐他的。
verses.e: David said to Abishai and to all his servants , " Behold , my son , who came out of my bowels , seeks my life . How much more this Benjamite , now ? Leave him alone , and let him curse ; for the LORD has invited him .

verses.z: 或者耶和華見我遭難，為我今日被這人咒罵，就施恩與我。」
verses.e: It may be that the LORD will look on the wrong done to me , and that the LORD will repay me good for the cursing of me today . "

verses.z: 於是大衛和跟隨他的人往前行走。示每在大衛對面山坡，一面行走一面咒罵，又拿石頭砍他，拿土揚他。
verses.e: So David and his men went by the way ; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went , threw stones at him , and threw dust .

verses.z: 王和跟隨他的眾人疲疲乏乏地到了一個地方，就在那裏歇息歇息。
verses.e: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary ; and he refreshed himself there .

verses.z: 押沙龍和以色列眾人來到耶路撒冷；亞希多弗也與他同來。
verses.e: Absalom and all the people , the men of Israel , came to Jerusalem , and Ahithophel with him .

verses.z: 大衛的朋友亞基人戶篩去見押沙龍，對他說：「願王萬歲！願王萬歲！」
verses.e: When Hushai the Archite , David's friend , had come to Absalom , Hushai said to Absalom , " Long live the king ! Long live the king ! "

verses.z: 押沙龍問戶篩說：「這是你恩待朋友嗎？為甚麼不與你的朋友同去呢？」
verses.e: Absalom said to Hushai , " Is this your kindness to your friend ? Why didn't you go with your friend ? "

verses.z: 戶篩對押沙龍說：「不然，耶和華和這民，並以色列眾人所揀選的，我必歸順他，與他同住。
verses.e: Hushai said to Absalom , " No ; but whomever the LORD and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen , I will be his , and I will stay with him .

verses.z: 再者，我當服事誰呢？豈不是前王的兒子嗎？我怎樣服事你父親，也必照樣服事你。」
verses.e: Again , whom should I serve ? Shouldn't I serve in the presence of his son ? As I have served in your father's presence , so I will be in your presence . "

verses.z: 王問洗巴說：「你帶這些來是甚麼意思呢？」洗巴說：「驢是給王的家眷騎的；麵餅和夏天的果餅是給少年人吃的；酒是給在曠野疲乏人喝的。」
verses.e: The king said to Ziba , " What do you mean by these ? " Ziba said , " The donkeys are for the king's household to ride on ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat ; and the wine , that those who are faint in the wilderness may drink . "

verses.z: 押沙龍對亞希多弗說：「你們出個主意，我們怎樣行才好？」
verses.e: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel , " Give your counsel what we shall do . "

verses.z: 亞希多弗對押沙龍說：「你父所留下看守宮殿的妃嬪，你可以與她們親近。以色列眾人聽見你父親憎惡你，凡歸順你人的手就更堅強。」
verses.e: Ahithophel said to Absalom , " Go in to your father's concubines that he has left to keep the house . Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father . Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong . "

verses.z: 於是人為押沙龍在宮殿的平頂上支搭帳棚；押沙龍在以色列眾人眼前，與他父的妃嬪親近。
verses.e: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house , and Absalom went in to his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel .

verses.z: 那時亞希多弗所出的主意好像人問上帝的話一樣；他昔日給大衛，今日給押沙龍所出的主意，都是這樣。
verses.e: The counsel of Ahithophel , which he gave in those days , was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God . All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom .

verses.z: 王問說：「你主人的兒子在哪裏呢？」洗巴回答王說：「他仍在耶路撒冷，因他說：『以色列人今日必將我父的國歸還我。』」
verses.e: The king said , " Where is your master's son ? " Ziba said to the king , " Behold , he is staying in Jerusalem ; for he said , ' Today the house of Israel will restore me the kingdom of my father . ' "

verses.z: 王對洗巴說：「凡屬米非波設的都歸你了。」洗巴說：「我叩拜我主我王，願我在你眼前蒙恩。」
verses.e: Then the king said to Ziba , " Behold , all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours . " Ziba said , " I bow down . Let me find favor in your sight , my lord , O king . "

verses.z: 大衛王到了巴戶琳，見有一個人出來，是掃羅族基拉的兒子，名叫示每。他一面走一面咒罵，
verses.e: When King David came to Bahurim , behold , a man of the family of Saul's house came out , whose name was Shimei , the son of Gera . He came out and cursed as he came .

verses.z: 又拿石頭砍大衛王和王的臣僕；眾民和勇士都在王的左右。
verses.e: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David , and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left .

verses.z: 示每咒罵說：「你這流人血的壞人哪，去吧去吧！
verses.e: Shimei said when he cursed , " Be gone , be gone , you man of blood , and wicked fellow !

verses.z: 你流掃羅全家的血，接續他作王；耶和華把這罪歸在你身上，將這國交給你兒子押沙龍。現在你自取其禍，因為你是流人血的人。」
verses.e: The LORD has returned on you all the blood of Saul's house , in whose place you have reigned ! The LORD has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son ! Behold , you are caught by your own mischief , because you are a man of blood ! "

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩對王說：「這死狗豈可咒罵我主我王呢？求你容我過去，割下他的頭來。」
verses.e: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king , " Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king ? Please let me go over and take off his head . "

verses.z: 亞希多弗又對押沙龍說：「求你准我挑選一萬二千人，今夜我就起身追趕大衛，
verses.e: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom , " Let me now choose twelve thousand men , and I will arise and pursue after David tonight .

verses.z: 雖有人膽大如獅子，他的心也必消化；因為以色列人都知道你父親是英雄，跟隨他的人也都是勇士。
verses.e: Even he who is valiant , whose heart is as the heart of a lion , will utterly melt ; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man , and those who are with him are valiant men .

verses.z: 依我之計，不如將以色列眾人－從但直到別是巴，如同海邊的沙那樣多－聚集到你這裏來，你也親自率領他們出戰。
verses.e: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you , from Dan even to Beersheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude ; and that you go to battle in your own person .

verses.z: 這樣，我們在何處遇見他，就下到他那裏，如同露水下在地上一般，連他帶跟隨他的人，一個也不留下。
verses.e: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found , and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground , then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him .

verses.z: 他若進了哪一座城，以色列眾人必帶繩子去，將那城拉到河裏，甚至連一塊小石頭都不剩下。」
verses.e: Moreover , if he has gone into a city , then all Israel will bring ropes to that city , and we will draw it into the river , until there isn't one small stone found there . "

verses.z: 押沙龍和以色列眾人說：「亞基人戶篩的計謀比亞希多弗的計謀更好！」這是因耶和華定意破壞亞希多弗的良謀，為要降禍與押沙龍。
verses.e: Absalom and all the men of Israel said , " The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . " For the LORD had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the LORD might bring evil on Absalom .

verses.z: 戶篩對祭司撒督和亞比亞他說：「亞希多弗為押沙龍和以色列的長老所定的計謀是如此如此，我所定的計謀是如此如此。
verses.e: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , " Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way ; and I have counseled this way .

verses.z: 現在你們要急速打發人去，告訴大衛說：『今夜不可住在曠野的渡口，務要過河，免得王和跟隨他的人都被吞滅。』」
verses.e: Now therefore send quickly , and tell David , saying , ' Don't lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness , but by all means pass over , lest the king be swallowed up , and all the people who are with him . ' "

verses.z: 那時，約拿單和亞希瑪斯在隱‧羅結那裏等候，不敢進城，恐怕被人看見。有一個使女出來，將這話告訴他們，他們就去報信給大衛王。
verses.e: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel ; and a female servant used to go and report to them , and they went and told King David ; for they couldn't risk being seen coming into the city .

verses.z: 然而有一個童子看見他們，就去告訴押沙龍。他們急忙跑到巴戶琳某人的家裏；那人院中有一口井，他們就下到井裏。
verses.e: But a boy saw them , and told Absalom . Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim , who had a well in his court ; and they went down there .

verses.z: 那家的婦人用蓋蓋上井口，又在上頭鋪上碎麥，事就沒有洩漏。
verses.e: The woman took and spread the covering over the well's mouth , and spread out crushed grain on it ; and nothing was known .

verses.z: 趁他疲乏手軟，我忽然追上他，使他驚惶；跟隨他的民必都逃跑，我就單殺王一人，
verses.e: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted , and will make him afraid . All the people who are with him will flee . I will strike the king only ,

verses.z: 押沙龍的僕人來到那家，問婦人說：「亞希瑪斯和約拿單在哪裏？」婦人說：「他們過了河了。」僕人找他們，找不着，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.e: Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house ; and they said , " Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan ? " The woman said to them , " They have gone over the brook of water . " When they had sought and could not find them , they returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他們走後，二人從井裏上來，去告訴大衛王說：「亞希多弗如此如此定計害你，你們務要起來，快快過河。」
verses.e: After they had departed , they came up out of the well and went and told King David ; and they said to David , " Arise and pass quickly over the water ; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you . "

verses.z: 於是大衛和跟隨他的人都起來，過約旦河。到了天亮，無一人不過約旦河的。
verses.e: Then David arose , and all the people who were with him , and they passed over the Jordan . By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan .

verses.z: 亞希多弗見不依從他的計謀，就備上驢，歸回本城；到了家，留下遺言，便吊死了，葬在他父親的墳墓裏。
verses.e: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed , he saddled his donkey , arose , and went home to his city , set his house in order , and hanged himself ; and he died , and was buried in the tomb of his father .

verses.z: 大衛到了瑪哈念，押沙龍和跟隨他的以色列人也都過了約旦河。
verses.e: Then David came to Mahanaim . Absalom passed over the Jordan , he and all the men of Israel with him .

verses.z: 押沙龍立亞瑪撒作元帥，代替約押。亞瑪撒是[以實瑪利]人以特拉的兒子。以特拉曾與拿轄的女兒亞比該親近；這亞比該與約押的母親洗魯雅是姊妹。
verses.e: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab . Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite , who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah , Joab's mother .

verses.z: 押沙龍和以色列人都安營在基列地。
verses.e: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead .

verses.z: 大衛到了瑪哈念，亞捫族的拉巴人拿轄的兒子朔比，羅‧底巴人亞‧米利的兒子瑪吉，基列的羅基琳人巴西萊，
verses.e: When David had come to Mahanaim , Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar , and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim ,

verses.z: 帶着被、褥、盆、碗、瓦器、小麥、大麥、麥麵、炒[穀]、豆子、紅豆、炒[豆]、
verses.e: brought beds , basins , earthen vessels , wheat , barley , meal , parched grain , beans , lentils , roasted grain ,

verses.z: 蜂蜜、奶油、綿羊、奶餅，供給大衛和跟隨他的人吃；他們說：「民在曠野，必飢渴困乏了。」
verses.e: honey , butter , sheep , and cheese of the herd , for David and for the people who were with him to eat ; for they said , " The people are hungry , weary , and thirsty in the wilderness . "

verses.z: 使眾民都歸順你。你所尋找的人[既然死了]，眾民就如已經歸順你；這樣，也都平安無事了。」
verses.e: and I will bring back all the people to you . The man whom you seek is as if all returned . All the people shall be in peace . "

verses.z: 押沙龍和以色列的長老都以這話為美。
verses.e: The saying pleased Absalom well , and all the elders of Israel .

verses.z: 押沙龍說：「要召亞基人戶篩來，我們也要聽他怎樣說。」
verses.e: Then Absalom said , " Now call Hushai the Archite also , and let's hear likewise what he says . "

verses.z: 戶篩到了押沙龍面前，押沙龍向他說：「亞希多弗是如此如此說的，我們照着他的話行可以不可以？若不可，你就說吧！」
verses.e: When Hushai had come to Absalom , Absalom spoke to him , saying , " Ahithophel has spoken like this . Shall we do what he says ? If not , speak up . "

verses.z: 戶篩對押沙龍說：「亞希多弗這次所定的謀不善。」
verses.e: Hushai said to Absalom , " The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good . "

verses.z: 戶篩又說：「你知道，你父親和跟隨他的人都是勇士，現在他們心裏惱怒，如同田野丟崽子的母熊一般，而且你父親是個戰士，必不和民一同住宿。
verses.e: Hushai said moreover , " You know your father and his men , that they are mighty men , and they are fierce in their minds , like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field . Your father is a man of war , and will not lodge with the people .

verses.z: 他現今或藏在坑中或在別處，若有人首先被殺，凡聽見的必說：『跟隨押沙龍的民被殺了。』
verses.e: Behold , he is now hidden in some pit , or in some other place . It will happen , when some of them have fallen at the first , that whoever hears it will say , ' There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom ! '

verses.z: 大衛數點跟隨他的人，立千夫長、百夫長率領他們。
verses.e: David counted the people who were with him , and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them .

verses.z: 有個人看見，就告訴約押說：「我看見押沙龍掛在橡樹上了。」
verses.e: A certain man saw it , and told Joab , and said , " Behold , I saw Absalom hanging in an oak . "

verses.z: 約押對報信的人說：「你既看見他，為甚麼不將他打死落在地上呢？[你若打死他]，我就賞你十[舍客勒]銀子，一條帶子。」
verses.e: Joab said to the man who told him , " Behold , you saw it , and why didn't you strike him there to the ground ? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash . "

verses.z: 那人對約押說：「我就是得你一千[舍客勒]銀子，我也不敢伸手害王的兒子；因為我們聽見王囑咐你和亞比篩並以太說：『你們要謹慎，不可害那少年人押沙龍。』
verses.e: The man said to Joab , " Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand , I still wouldn't stretch out my hand against the king's son ; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai , saying , ' Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom . '

verses.z: 我若妄為害了他的性命，就是你自己也必與我為敵（原來，無論何事都瞞不過王。）」
verses.e: Otherwise , if I had dealt falsely against his life ( and there is no matter hidden from the king ) , then you yourself would have set yourself against me . "

verses.z: 約押說：「我不能與你留連。」約押手拿三杆短槍，趁押沙龍在橡樹上還活着，就刺透他的心。
verses.e: Then Joab said , " I'm not going to wait like this with you . " He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom's heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak .

verses.z: 給約押拿兵器的十個少年人圍繞押沙龍，將他殺死。
verses.e: Ten young men who bore Joab's armor surrounded and struck Absalom , and killed him .

verses.z: 約押吹角，攔阻眾人，他們就回來，不再追趕以色列人。
verses.e: Joab blew the trumpet , and the people returned from pursuing after Israel ; for Joab held the people back .

verses.z: 他們將押沙龍丟在林中一個大坑裏，上頭堆起一大堆石頭。以色列眾人都逃跑，各回各家去了。
verses.e: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest , and raised over him a very great heap of stones . Then all Israel fled , each to his own tent .

verses.z: 押沙龍活着的時候，在王谷立了一根[石]柱，因他說：「我沒有兒子為我留名。」他就以自己的名稱那[石]柱叫押沙龍柱，直到今日。
verses.e: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king's valley , for he said , " I have no son to keep my name in memory . " He called the pillar after his own name . It is called Absalom's monument , to this day .

verses.z: 撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯說：「容我跑去，將耶和華向仇敵給王報仇的信息報與王知。」
verses.e: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said , " Let me now run and carry the king news , how the LORD has avenged him of his enemies . "

verses.z: 大衛打發軍兵出戰，分為三隊：一隊在約押手下，一隊在洗魯雅的兒子、約押兄弟亞比篩手下，一隊在迦特人以太手下。大衛對軍兵說：「我必與你們一同出戰。」
verses.e: David sent the people out , a third part under the hand of Joab , and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah , Joab's brother , and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite . The king said to the people , " I will also surely go out with you myself . "

verses.z: 約押對他說：「你今日不可去報信，改日可以報信；因為今日王的兒子死了，所以你不可去報信。」
verses.e: Joab said to him , " You must not be the bearer of news today , but you must carry news another day . But today you must carry no news , because the king's son is dead . "

verses.z: 約押對古示人說：「你去將你所看見的告訴王。」古示人在約押面前下拜，就跑去了。
verses.e: Then Joab said to the Cushite , " Go , tell the king what you have seen ! " The Cushite bowed himself to Joab , and ran .

verses.z: 撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯又對約押說：「無論怎樣，求你容我隨着古示人跑去。」約押說：「我兒，你報這信息，既不得賞賜，何必要跑去呢？」
verses.e: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab , " But come what may , please let me also run after the Cushite . " Joab said , " Why do you want to run , my son , since you will have no reward for the news ? "

verses.z: 他[又說]：「無論怎樣，我要跑去。」約押說：「你跑去吧！」亞希瑪斯就從平原往前跑，跑過古示人去了。
verses.e: " But come what may , " he said , " I will run . " He said to him , " Run ! " Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain , and outran the Cushite .

verses.z: 大衛正坐在城甕裏。守望的人上城門樓的頂上，舉目觀看，見有一個人獨自跑來。
verses.e: Now David was sitting between the two gates ; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall , and lifted up his eyes and looked , and , behold , a man running alone .

verses.z: 守望的人就大聲告訴王。王說：「他若獨自來，必是報口信的。」那人跑得漸漸近了。
verses.e: The watchman shouted and told the king . The king said , " If he is alone , there is news in his mouth . " He came closer and closer .

verses.z: 守望的人又見一人跑來，就對守城門的人說：「又有一人獨自跑來。」王說：「這也必是報信的。」
verses.e: The watchman saw another man running ; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said , " Behold , a man running alone ! " The king said , " He also brings news . "

verses.z: 守望的人說：「我看前頭人的跑法，好像撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯的跑法一樣。」王說：「他是個好人，必是報好信息。」
verses.e: The watchman said , " I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok . " The king said , " He is a good man , and comes with good news . "

verses.z: 亞希瑪斯向王呼叫說：「平安了！」就在王面前臉伏於地叩拜，說：「耶和華－你的上帝是應當稱頌的，因他已將那舉手攻擊我主我王的人交給王了。」
verses.e: Ahimaaz called , and said to the king , " All is well . " He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth , and said , " Blessed is the LORD your God , who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king ! "

verses.z: 王問說：「少年人押沙龍平安不平安？」亞希瑪斯回答說：「約押打發王的僕人，那時僕人聽見眾民大聲喧嘩，卻不知道是甚麼事。」
verses.e: The king said , " Is it well with the young man Absalom ? " Ahimaaz answered , " When Joab sent the king's servant , even me your servant , I saw a great tumult , but I don't know what it was . "

verses.z: 軍兵卻說：「你不可出戰。若是我們逃跑，敵人必不介意；我們陣亡一半，敵人也不介意。因為你一人強似我們萬人，你不如在城裏預備幫助我們。」
verses.e: But the people said , " You shall not go out , for if we flee away , they will not care for us , neither if half of us die , will they care for us . But you are worth ten thousand of us . Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city . "

verses.z: 王說：「你退去，站在旁邊。」他就退去，站在旁邊。
verses.e: The king said , " Come and stand here . " He came and stood still .

verses.z: 古示人也來到，說：「有信息報給我主我王！耶和華今日向一切興起攻擊你的人給你報仇了。」
verses.e: Behold , the Cushite came . The Cushite said , " Good news for my lord the king , for the LORD has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you . "

verses.z: 王問古示人說：「少年人押沙龍平安不平安？」古示人回答說：「願我主我王的仇敵，和一切興起要殺害你的人，都與那少年人一樣。」
verses.e: The king said to the Cushite , " Is it well with the young man Absalom ? " The Cushite answered , " May the enemies of my lord the king , and all who rise up against you to do you harm , be as that young man is . "

verses.z: 王就心裏傷慟，上城門樓去哀哭，一面走一面說：「我兒押沙龍啊！我兒，我兒押沙龍啊！我恨不得替你死，押沙龍啊，我兒！我兒！」
verses.e: The king was much moved , and went up to the room over the gate and wept . As he went , he said , " My son Absalom ! My son , my son Absalom ! I wish I had died instead of you , Absalom , my son , my son ! "

verses.z: 王向他們說：「你們以為怎樣好，我就怎樣行。」於是王站在城門旁，軍兵或百或千地挨次出去了。
verses.e: The king said to them , " I will do what seems best to you . " The king stood beside the gate , and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands .

verses.z: 王囑咐約押、亞比篩、以太說：「你們要為我的緣故寬待那少年人押沙龍。」王為押沙龍囑咐眾將的話，兵都聽見了。
verses.e: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai , saying , " Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom . " All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom .

verses.z: 兵就出到田野迎着以色列人，在以法蓮樹林裏交戰。
verses.e: So the people went out into the field against Israel ; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim .

verses.z: 以色列人敗在大衛的僕人面前；那日陣亡的甚多，共有二萬人。
verses.e: The people of Israel were struck there before David's servants , and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men .

verses.z: 因為在那裏四面打仗，死於樹林的比死於刀劍的更多。
verses.e: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country , and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .

verses.z: 押沙龍偶然遇見大衛的僕人。押沙龍騎着騾子，從大橡樹密枝底下經過，他的頭[髮]被樹枝繞住，就懸掛起來，所騎的騾子便離他去了。
verses.e: Absalom happened to meet David's servants . Absalom was riding on his mule , and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak ; and his head caught hold of the oak , and he was hanging between the sky and earth ; and the mule that was under him went on .

verses.z: 有人告訴約押說：「王為押沙龍哭泣悲哀。」
verses.e: Joab was told , " Behold , the king weeps and mourns for Absalom . "

verses.z: 我們膏押沙龍治理我們，他已經陣亡。現在為甚麼不出一言請王回來呢？」
verses.e: Absalom , whom we anointed over us , is dead in battle . Now therefore why don't you speak a word of bringing the king back ? "

verses.z: 大衛王差人去見祭司撒督和亞比亞他，說：「你們當向猶大長老說：『以色列眾人已經有話請王回宮，你們為甚麼落在他們後頭呢？
verses.e: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , saying , " Speak to the elders of Judah , saying , ' Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house , since the speech of all Israel has come to the king , to return him to his house ?

verses.z: 你們是我的弟兄，是我的骨肉，為甚麼在人後頭請王回來呢？』
verses.e: You are my brothers . You are my bone and my flesh . Why then are you the last to bring back the king ? '

verses.z: 也要對亞瑪撒說：『你不是我的骨肉嗎？我若不立你替約押常作元帥，願上帝重重地降罰與我！』」
verses.e: Say to Amasa , ' Aren't you my bone and my flesh ? God do so to me , and more also , if you aren't captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab . ' "

verses.z: 如此就挽回猶大眾人的心，如同一人的心。他們便打發人去見王，說：「請王和王的一切臣僕回來。」
verses.e: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah , even as one man , so that they sent to the king , saying , " Return , you and all your servants . "

verses.z: 王就回來，到了約旦河。猶大人來到吉甲，要去迎接王，請他過約旦河。
verses.e: So the king returned , and came to the Jordan . Judah came to Gilgal , to go to meet the king , to bring the king over the Jordan .

verses.z: 巴戶琳的便雅憫人、基拉的兒子示每急忙與猶大人一同下去迎接大衛王。
verses.e: Shimei the son of Gera , the Benjamite , who was of Bahurim , hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David .

verses.z: 跟從示每的有一千便雅憫人，還有掃羅家的僕人洗巴和他十五個兒子，二十個僕人；他們都詵過約旦河迎接王。
verses.e: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him , and Ziba the servant of Saul's house , and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him ; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king .

verses.z: 有擺渡船過去，渡王的家眷，任王使用。王要過約旦河的時候，基拉的兒子示每就俯伏在王面前，
verses.e: A ferry boat went to bring over the king's household , and to do what he thought good . Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan .

verses.z: 對王說：「我主我王出耶路撒冷的時候，僕人行悖逆的事，現在求我主不要因此加罪與僕人，不要記念，也不要放在心上。
verses.e: He said to the king , " Don't let my lord impute iniquity to me , or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem , that the king should take it to his heart .

verses.z: 眾民聽說王為他兒子憂愁，他們得勝的歡樂卻變成悲哀。
verses.e: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people , for the people heard it said that day , " The king grieves for his son . "

verses.z: 僕人明知自己有罪，所以約瑟全家之中，今日我首先下來迎接我主我王。」
verses.e: For your servant knows that I have sinned . Therefore behold , I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king . "

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩說：「示每既咒罵耶和華的受膏者，不應當治死他嗎？」
verses.e: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered , " Shouldn't Shimei be put to death for this , because he cursed the LORD's anointed ? "

verses.z: 大衛說：「洗魯雅的兒子，我與你們有何關涉，使你們今日與我反對呢？今日在以色列中豈可治死人呢？我豈不知今日我作以色列的王嗎？」
verses.e: David said , " What have I to do with you , you sons of Zeruiah , that you should be adversaries to me today ? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel ? For don't I know that I am king over Israel today ? "

verses.z: 於是王對示每說：「你必不死。」王就向他起誓。
verses.e: The king said to Shimei , " You will not die . " The king swore to him .

verses.z: 掃羅的孫子米非波設也下去迎接王。他自從王去的日子，直到王平平安安地回來，沒有修腳，沒有剃鬍鬚，也沒有洗衣服。
verses.e: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king ; and he had neither groomed his feet , nor trimmed his beard , nor washed his clothes , from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace .

verses.z: 他來到耶路撒冷迎接王的時候，王問他說：「米非波設，你為甚麼沒有與我同去呢？」
verses.e: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king , the king said to him , " Why didn't you go with me , Mephibosheth ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「我主我王，僕人是瘸腿的。那日我想要備驢騎上，與王同去，無奈我的僕人欺哄了我，
verses.e: He answered , " My lord , O king , my servant deceived me . For your servant said , ' I will saddle a donkey for myself , that I may ride on it and go with the king , ' because your servant is lame .

verses.z: 又在我主我王面前讒毀我。然而我主我王如同上帝的使者一般，你看怎樣好，就怎樣行吧！
verses.e: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king , but my lord the king is as an angel of God . Therefore do what is good in your eyes .

verses.z: 因為我祖全家的人，在我主我王面前都算為死人，王卻使僕人在王的席上同人吃飯，我現在向王還能辨理訴冤嗎？」
verses.e: For all my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king ; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table . What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king ? "

verses.z: 王對他說：「你何必再提你的事呢？我說，你與洗巴均分地土。」
verses.e: The king said to him , " Why do you speak any more of your matters ? I say , you and Ziba divide the land . "

verses.z: 那日眾民暗暗地進城，就如敗陣逃跑、慚愧的民一般。
verses.e: The people sneaked into the city that day , as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle .

verses.z: 米非波設對王說：「我主我王既平平安安地回宮，就任憑洗巴都取了也可以。」
verses.e: Mephibosheth said to the king , " Yes , let him take all , because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house . "

verses.z: 基列人巴西萊從羅基琳下來，要送王過約旦河，就與王一同過了約旦河。
verses.e: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim ; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan .

verses.z: 巴西萊年紀老邁，已經八十歲了。王住在瑪哈念的時候，他就拿食物來供給王；他原是大富戶。
verses.e: Now Barzillai was a very aged man , even eighty years old . He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim , for he was a very great man .

verses.z: 王對巴西萊說：「你與我同去，我要在耶路撒冷那裏養你的老。」
verses.e: The king said to Barzillai , " Come over with me , and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 巴西萊對王說：「我在世的年日還能有多少，使我與王同上耶路撒冷呢？
verses.e: Barzillai said to the king , " How many are the days of the years of my life , that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem ?

verses.z: 僕人現在八十歲了，還能嘗出飲食的滋味、辨別美惡嗎？還能聽男女歌唱的聲音嗎？僕人何必累贅我主我王呢？
verses.e: I am eighty years old , today . Can I discern between good and bad ? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink ? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more ? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king ?

verses.z: 僕人只要送王過約旦河，王何必賜我這樣的恩典呢？
verses.e: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king . Why should the king repay me with such a reward ?

verses.z: 求你准我回去，好死在我本城，[葬在]我父母的墓旁。這裏有王的僕人金罕，讓他同我主我王過去，可以隨意待他。」
verses.e: Please let your servant turn back again , that I may die in my own city , by the grave of my father and my mother . But behold , your servant Chimham ; let him go over with my lord the king ; and do to him what shall seem good to you . "

verses.z: 王說：「金罕可以與我同去，我必照你的心願待他。你向我求甚麼，我都必為你成就。」
verses.e: The king answered , " Chimham shall go over with me , and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you . Whatever you request of me , that I will do for you . "

verses.z: 於是眾民過約旦河，王也過去。王與巴西萊親嘴，為他祝福，巴西萊就回本地去了。
verses.e: All the people went over the Jordan , and the king went over . Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him ; and he returned to his own place .

verses.z: 王蒙着臉，大聲哭號說：「我兒押沙龍啊！押沙龍，我兒，我兒啊！」
verses.e: The king covered his face , and the king cried with a loud voice , " My son Absalom , Absalom , my son , my son ! "

verses.z: 王過去，到了吉甲，金罕也跟他過去。猶大眾民和以色列民的一半也都送王過去。
verses.e: So the king went over to Gilgal , and Chimham went over with him . All the people of Judah brought the king over , and also half the people of Israel .

verses.z: 以色列眾人來見王，對他說：「我們弟兄猶大人為甚麼暗暗送王和王的家眷，並跟隨王的人過約旦河？」
verses.e: Behold , all the men of Israel came to the king , and said to the king , " Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away , and brought the king and his household , over the Jordan , and all David's men with him ? "

verses.z: 猶大眾人回答以色列人說：「因為王與我們是親屬，你們為何因這事發怒呢？我們吃了王的甚麼呢？王賞賜了我們甚麼呢？」
verses.e: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel , " Because the king is a close relative to us . Why then are you angry about this matter ? Have we eaten at all at the king's cost ? Or has he given us any gift ? "

verses.z: 以色列人回答猶大人說：「按支派，我們與王有十分的情分；在大衛身上，我們也比你們更有情分。你們為何藐視我們，請王回來不先與我們商量呢？」但猶大人的話比以色列人的話更硬。
verses.e: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah , and said , " We have ten parts in the king , and we have also more claim to David than you . Why then did you despise us , that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king ? " The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel .

verses.z: 約押進去見王，說：「你今日使你一切僕人臉面慚愧了！他們今日救了你的性命和你兒女妻妾的性命，
verses.e: Joab came into the house to the king , and said , " Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life , and the lives of your sons and of your daughters , and the lives of your wives , and the lives of your concubines ;

verses.z: 你卻愛那恨你的人，恨那愛你的人。你今日明明地不以將帥、僕人為念。我今日看明，若押沙龍活着，我們都死亡，你就喜悅了。
verses.e: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you . For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you . For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today , then it would have pleased you well .

verses.z: 現在你當出去，安慰你僕人的心。我指着耶和華起誓：你若不出去，今夜必無一人與你同在一處；這禍患就比你從幼年到如今所遭的更甚！」
verses.e: Now therefore arise , go out and speak to comfort your servants ; for I swear by the LORD , if you don't go out , not a man will stay with you this night . That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now . "

verses.z: 於是王起來，坐在城門口。眾民聽說王坐在城門口，就都到王面前。以色列人已經逃跑，各回各家去了。
verses.e: Then the king arose and sat in the gate . The people were all told , " Behold , the king is sitting in the gate . " All the people came before the king . Now Israel had fled every man to his tent .

verses.z: 以色列眾支派的人紛紛議論說：「王曾救我們脫離仇敵的手，又救我們脫離非利士人的手，現在他躲避押沙龍逃走了。
verses.e: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , " The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies , and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines ; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom .

verses.z: 此後，大衛問耶和華說：「我上猶大的一個城去可以嗎？」耶和華說：「可以。」大衛說：「我上哪一個城去呢？」耶和華說：「上希伯崙去。」
verses.e: After this , David inquired of the LORD , saying , " Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah ? " The LORD said to him , " Go up . " David said , " Where shall I go up ? " He said , " To Hebron . "

verses.z: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設登基的時候年四十歲，作以色列王二年；惟獨猶大家歸從大衛。
verses.e: Ishbosheth , Saul's son , was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel , and he reigned two years . But the house of Judah followed David .

verses.z: 大衛在希伯崙作猶大家的王，共七年零六個月。
verses.e: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months .

verses.z: 尼珥的兒子押尼珥和掃羅的兒子伊施波設的僕人從瑪哈念出來，往基遍去。
verses.e: Abner the son of Ner , and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul , went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon .

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子約押和大衛的僕人也出來，在基遍池旁與他們相遇；一班坐在池這邊，一班坐在池那邊。
verses.e: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David's servants went out , and met them by the pool of Gibeon ; and they sat down , the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool .

verses.z: 押尼珥對約押說：「讓少年人起來，在我們面前戲耍吧！」約押說：「可以。」
verses.e: Abner said to Joab , " Please let the young men arise and compete before us ! " Joab said , " Let them arise ! "

verses.z: 就按着定數起來：屬掃羅兒子伊施波設的便雅憫人過去十二名，大衛的僕人也過去十二名，
verses.e: Then they arose and went over by number : twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul , and twelve of David's servants .

verses.z: 彼此揪頭，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫做希利甲‧哈素林，就在基遍。
verses.e: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow's side ; so they fell down together . Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim .

verses.z: 那日的戰事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人敗在大衛的僕人面前。
verses.e: The battle was very severe that day ; and Abner was beaten , and the men of Israel , before David's servants .

verses.z: 在那裏有洗魯雅的三個兒子：約押、亞比篩、亞撒黑。亞撒黑腳快如野鹿一般；
verses.e: The three sons of Zeruiah were there : Joab , Abishai , and Asahel . Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle .

verses.z: 亞撒黑追趕押尼珥，直追趕他不偏左右。
verses.e: Asahel pursued Abner . He didn't turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner .

verses.z: 於是大衛和他的兩個妻－一個是耶斯列人亞希暖，一個是作過迦密人拿八妻的亞比該－都上那裏去了。
verses.e: So David went up there with his two wives , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite .

verses.z: 押尼珥回頭說：「你是亞撒黑嗎？」回答說：「是。」
verses.e: Then Abner looked behind him and said , " Is that you , Asahel ? " He answered , " It is . "

verses.z: 押尼珥對他說：「你或轉向左轉向右，拿住一個少年人，剝去他的戰衣。」亞撒黑卻不肯轉開不追趕他。
verses.e: Abner said to him , " Turn away to your right hand or to your left , and grab one of the young men , and take his armor . " But Asahel would not turn away from following him .

verses.z: 押尼珥又對亞撒黑說：「你轉開不追趕我吧！我何必殺你呢？若殺你，有甚麼臉見你哥哥約押呢？」
verses.e: Abner said again to Asahel , " Turn away from following me . Why should I strike you to the ground ? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face ? "

verses.z: 亞撒黑仍不肯轉開。故此，押尼珥就用槍鐏刺入他的肚腹，甚至槍從背後透出，亞撒黑就在那裏仆倒而死。眾人趕到亞撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。
verses.e: However , he refused to turn away . Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body , so that the spear came out behind him ; and he fell down there and died in the same place . As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .

verses.z: 約押和亞比篩追趕押尼珥，日落的時候，到了通基遍曠野的路旁，基亞對面的亞瑪山。
verses.e: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner . The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah , that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon .

verses.z: 便雅憫人聚集，跟隨押尼珥站在一個山頂上。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band , and stood on the top of a hill .

verses.z: 押尼珥呼叫約押說：「刀劍豈可永遠殺人嗎？你豈不知終久必有苦楚嗎？你要等何時才叫百姓回去、不追趕弟兄呢？」
verses.e: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , " Shall the sword devour forever ? Don't you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? How long will it be then , before you ask the people to return from following their brothers ? "

verses.z: 約押說：「我指着永生的上帝起誓：你若不說[戲耍的]那句話，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追趕弟兄了。」
verses.e: Joab said , " As God lives , if you had not spoken , surely then in the morning the people would have gone away , and not each followed his brother . "

verses.z: 於是約押吹角，眾民就站住，不再追趕以色列人，也不再打仗了。
verses.e: So Joab blew the trumpet ; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more , and they fought no more .

verses.z: 押尼珥和跟隨他的人整夜經過亞拉巴，過約旦河，走過畢倫，到了瑪哈念。
verses.e: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah ; and they passed over the Jordan , and went through all Bithron , and came to Mahanaim .

verses.z: 大衛也將跟隨他的人和他們各人的眷屬一同帶上去，住在希伯崙的城邑中。
verses.e: David brought up his men who were with him , every man with his household . They lived in the cities of Hebron .

verses.z: 約押追趕押尼珥回來，聚集眾民，見大衛的僕人中缺少了十九個人和亞撒黑。
verses.e: Joab returned from following Abner ; and when he had gathered all the people together , nineteen men of David's and Asahel were missing .

verses.z: 但大衛的僕人殺了便雅憫人和跟隨押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。
verses.e: But David's servants had struck Benjamin Abner's men so that three hundred sixty men died .

verses.z: 眾人將亞撒黑送到伯利恆，葬在他父親的墳墓裏。約押和跟隨他的人走了一夜，天亮的時候到了希伯崙。
verses.e: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father , which was in Bethlehem . Joab and his men went all night , and the day broke on them at Hebron .

verses.z: 猶大人來到希伯崙，在那裏膏大衛作猶大家的王。有人告訴大衛說：「葬埋掃羅的是基列‧雅比人。」
verses.e: The men of Judah came , and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah . They told David , " The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul . "

verses.z: 大衛就差人去見基列‧雅比人，對他們說：「你們厚待你們的主－掃羅，將他葬埋。願耶和華賜福與你們！
verses.e: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead , and said to them , " Blessed are you by the LORD , that you have shown this kindness to your lord , even to Saul , and have buried him .

verses.z: 你們既行了這事，願耶和華以慈愛誠實待你們，我也要為此厚待你們。
verses.e: Now may the LORD show loving kindness and truth to you . I also will reward you for this kindness , because you have done this thing .

verses.z: 現在你們的主－掃羅死了，猶大家已經膏我作他們的王，所以你們要剛強奮勇。」
verses.e: Now therefore let your hands be strong , and be valiant ; for Saul your lord is dead , and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them . "

verses.z: 掃羅的元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥，曾將掃羅的兒子伊施波設帶過[河]，到瑪哈念，
verses.e: Now Abner the son of Ner , captain of Saul's army , had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim .

verses.z: 立他作王，治理基列、亞書利、耶斯列、以法蓮、便雅憫，和以色列眾人。
verses.e: He made him king over Gilead , over the Ashurites , over Jezreel , over Ephraim , over Benjamin , and over all Israel .

verses.z: 在那裏恰巧有一個匪徒，名叫示巴，是便雅憫人比基利的兒子。他吹角，說：「我們與大衛無分，與耶西的兒子無涉。以色列人哪，你們各回各家去吧！」
verses.e: There happened to be there a wicked fellow , whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri , a Benjamite ; and he blew the trumpet , and said , " We have no portion in David , neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse . Every man to his tents , Israel ! "

verses.z: 亞瑪撒沒有防備約押手裏所拿的刀；約押用刀刺入他的肚腹，他的腸子流在地上，沒有再刺他，就死了。約押和他兄弟亞比篩往前追趕比基利的兒子示巴。
verses.e: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand . So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground , and didn't strike him again ; and he died . Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri .

verses.z: 有約押的一個少年人站在亞瑪撒屍身旁邊，[對眾人]說：「誰喜悅約押，誰歸順大衛，就當跟隨約押去。」
verses.e: One of Joab's young men stood by him , and said , " He who favors Joab , and he who is for David , let him follow Joab ! "

verses.z: 亞瑪撒在道路上滾在自己的血裏。那人見眾民[經過]都站住，就把亞瑪撒的屍身從路上挪到田間，用衣服遮蓋。
verses.e: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway . When the man saw that all the people stood still , he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field , and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still .

verses.z: 屍身從路上挪移之後，眾民就都跟隨約押去追趕比基利的兒子示巴。
verses.e: When he was removed out of the highway , all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri .

verses.z: 他走遍以色列各支派，直到伯‧瑪迦的亞比拉，並比利人的全地；那些地方的人也都聚集跟隨他。
verses.e: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel , to Beth Maacah , and all the Berites . They were gathered together , and went also after him .

verses.z: 約押和跟隨的人到了伯‧瑪迦的亞比拉，圍困示巴，就對着城築壘；跟隨約押的眾民[用錘]撞城，要使城塌陷。
verses.e: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah , and they cast up a mound against the city , and it stood against the rampart ; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down .

verses.z: 有一個聰明婦人從城上呼叫說：「聽啊，聽啊，請約押近前來，我好與他說話。」
verses.e: Then a wise woman cried out of the city , " Hear , hear ! Please say to Joab , ' Come near here , that I may speak with you . ' "

verses.z: 約押就近前來，婦人問他說：「你是約押不是？」他說：「我是。」婦人說：「求你聽婢女的話。」約押說：「我聽。」
verses.e: He came near to her ; and the woman said , " Are you Joab ? " He answered , " I am . " Then she said to him , " Hear the words of your servant . " He answered , " I'm listening . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「古時有話說，當先在亞比拉求問，然後事就定妥。
verses.e: Then she spoke , saying , " They used to say in old times , ' They shall surely ask counsel at Abel , ' and so they settled a matter .

verses.z: 我們這城的人在以色列人中是和平、忠厚的。你為何要毀壞以色列中的大城，吞滅耶和華的產業呢？」
verses.e: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel . You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel . Why will you swallow up the LORD's inheritance ? "

verses.z: 於是以色列人都離開大衛，跟隨比基利的兒子示巴。但猶大人從約旦河直到耶路撒冷，都緊緊跟隨他們的王。
verses.e: So all the men of Israel went up from following David , and followed Sheba the son of Bichri ; but the men of Judah joined with their king , from the Jordan even to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 約押回答說：「我決不吞滅毀壞，
verses.e: Joab answered , " Far be it , far be it from me , that I should swallow up or destroy .

verses.z: 乃因以法蓮山地的一個人－比基利的兒子示巴－舉手攻擊大衛王，你們若將他一人交出來，我便離城而去。」婦人對約押說：「那人的首級必從城牆上丟給你。」
verses.e: The matter is not so . But a man of the hill country of Ephraim , Sheba the son of Bichri by name , has lifted up his hand against the king , even against David . Just deliver him , and I will depart from the city . " The woman said to Joab , " Behold , his head will be thrown to you over the wall . "

verses.z: 婦人就憑她的智慧去勸眾人。他們便割下比基利的兒子示巴的首級，丟給約押。約押吹角，眾人就離城而散，各歸各家去了。約押回耶路撒冷，到王那裏。
verses.e: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom . They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri , and threw it out to Joab . He blew the trumpet , and they were dispersed from the city , every man to his tent . Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king .

verses.z: 約押作以色列全軍的元帥；耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人；
verses.e: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel , Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites ,

verses.z: 亞多蘭掌管服苦的人；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
verses.e: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor , Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder ,

verses.z: 示法作書記；撒督和亞比亞他作祭司[長]；
verses.e: Sheva was scribe , Zadok and Abiathar were priests ,

verses.z: 睚珥人以拉作大衛的宰相。
verses.e: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David .

verses.z: 大衛王來到耶路撒冷，進了宮殿，就把從前留下看守宮殿的十個妃嬪禁閉在[冷宮]，養活她們，不與她們親近。她們如同寡婦被禁，直到死的日子。
verses.e: David came to his house at Jerusalem ; and the king took the ten women his concubines , whom he had left to keep the house , and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance , but didn't go in to them . So they were shut up to the day of their death , living in widowhood .

verses.z: 王對亞瑪撒說：「你要在三日之內將猶大人招聚了來，你也回到這裏來。」
verses.e: Then the king said to Amasa , " Call me the men of Judah together within three days , and be here present . "

verses.z: 亞瑪撒就去招聚猶大人，卻耽延過了王所限的日期。
verses.e: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together , but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him .

verses.z: 大衛對亞比篩說：「現在恐怕比基利的兒子示巴加害於我們比押沙龍更甚。你要帶領你主的僕人追趕他，免得他得了堅固城，躲避我們。」
verses.e: David said to Abishai , " Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did . Take your lord's servants and pursue after him , lest he get himself fortified cities , and escape out of our sight . "

verses.z: 約押的人和基利提人、比利提人，並所有的勇士，都跟着亞比篩，從耶路撒冷出去追趕比基利的兒子示巴。
verses.e: Joab's men went out after him with the Cherethites , the Pelethites , and all the mighty men ; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri .

verses.z: 他們到了基遍的大磐石那裏，亞瑪撒來迎接他們。那時約押穿着戰衣，腰束佩刀的帶子，刀在鞘內；約押前行，刀從鞘內掉出來。
verses.e: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa came to meet them . Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on , and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath ; and as he went along it fell out .

verses.z: 約押[左手拾起刀來]，對亞瑪撒說：「我兄弟，你好啊！」就用右手抓住亞瑪撒的鬍子，要與他親嘴。
verses.e: Joab said to Amasa , " Is it well with you , my brother ? " Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him .

verses.z: 大衛年間有饑荒，一連三年，大衛就求問耶和華。耶和華說：「這饑荒是因掃羅和他流人血之家殺死基遍人。」
verses.e: There was a famine in the days of David for three years , year after year ; and David sought the face of the LORD . The LORD said , " It is for Saul , and for his bloody house , because he put the Gibeonites to death . "

verses.z: 愛雅的女兒利斯巴用麻布在磐石上搭棚，從動手收割的時候直到天降雨在屍身上的時候，日間不容空中的雀鳥落在屍身上，夜間不讓田野的走獸前來糟踐。
verses.e: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock , from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky . She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day , nor the animals of the field by night .

verses.z: 有人將掃羅的妃嬪愛雅女兒利斯巴所行的這事告訴大衛。
verses.e: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , the concubine of Saul , had done .

verses.z: 大衛就去，從基列‧雅比人那裏將掃羅和他兒子約拿單的骸骨搬了來（是因非利士人從前在基利波殺掃羅，將屍身懸掛在伯‧珊的街市上，基列‧雅比人把屍身偷了去。）
verses.e: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead , who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan , where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa ;

verses.z: 大衛將掃羅和他兒子約拿單的骸骨從那裏搬了來，又收殮被懸掛七人的骸骨，
verses.e: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son . They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged .

verses.z: 將掃羅和他兒子約拿單的骸骨葬在便雅憫的洗拉，在掃羅父親基士的墳墓裏；眾人行了王所吩咐的。此後上帝垂聽國民所求的。
verses.e: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela , in the tomb of Kish his father ; and they performed all that the king commanded . After that , God answered prayer for the land .

verses.z: 非利士人與以色列人打仗；大衛帶領僕人下去，與非利士人接戰，大衛就疲乏了。
verses.e: The Philistines had war again with Israel ; and David went down , and his servants with him , and fought against the Philistines . David grew faint ;

verses.z: 偉人的一個兒子以實‧比諾要殺大衛；他的銅槍重三百[舍客勒]，又佩着新[刀]。
verses.e: and Ishbibenob , who was of the sons of the giant , the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight , he being armed with a new sword , thought he would kill David .

verses.z: 但洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩幫助大衛，攻打非利士人，將他殺死。當日，跟隨大衛的人向大衛起誓說：「以後你不可再與我們一同出戰，恐怕熄滅以色列的燈。」
verses.e: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him , and struck the Philistine and killed him . Then the men of David swore to him , saying , " Don't go out with us to battle any more , so that you don't quench the lamp of Israel . "

verses.z: 後來，以色列人在歌伯與非利士人打仗，戶沙人西比該殺了偉人的一個兒子撒弗。
verses.e: After this , there was again war with the Philistines at Gob . Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph , who was of the sons of the giant .

verses.z: 又在歌伯與非利士人打仗，伯利恆人雅雷俄珥金的兒子伊勒哈難殺了迦特人歌利亞。這人的槍桿粗如織布的機軸。
verses.e: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob , and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite's brother , the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam .

verses.z: 原來這基遍人不是以色列人，乃是亞摩利人中所剩的；以色列人曾向他們起誓，[不殺滅他們]，掃羅卻為以色列人和猶大人發熱心，想要殺滅他們。大衛王召了他們來，
verses.e: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them ( now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel , but of the remnant of the Amorites , and the children of Israel had sworn to them ; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah ) ;

verses.z: 又在迦特打仗，那裏有一個身量高大的人，手腳都是六指，共有二十四個指頭；他也是偉人的兒子。
verses.e: There was again war at Gath , where there was a man of great stature , who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot , twenty-four in number , and he also was born to the giant .

verses.z: 這人向以色列人罵陣，大衛的哥哥示米亞的兒子約拿單就殺了他。
verses.e: When he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimei , David's brother , killed him .

verses.z: 這四個人是迦特偉人的兒子，都死在大衛和他僕人的手下。
verses.e: These four were born to the giant in Gath ; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants .

verses.z: 問他們說：「我當為你們怎樣行呢？可用甚麼贖這罪，使你們為耶和華的產業祝福呢？」
verses.e: and David said to the Gibeonites , " What should I do for you ? And with what should I make atonement , that you may bless the LORD's inheritance ? "

verses.z: 基遍人回答說：「我們和掃羅與他家的事並不關乎金銀，也不要因我們的緣故殺一個以色列人。」大衛說：「你們怎樣說，我就為你們怎樣行。」
verses.e: The Gibeonites said to him , " It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house ; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel . " He said , " I will do for you whatever you say . "

verses.z: 他們對王說：「那從前謀害我們、要滅我們、使我們不得再住以色列境內的人，
verses.e: They said to the king , " The man who consumed us and who plotted against us , that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel ,

verses.z: 現在願將他的子孫七人交給我們，我們好在耶和華面前，將他們懸掛在耶和華揀選掃羅的基比亞。」王說：「我必交給你們。」
verses.e: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us , and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul , the chosen of the LORD . " The king said , " I will give them . "

verses.z: 王因為曾與掃羅的兒子約拿單指着耶和華起誓[結盟]，就愛惜掃羅的孫子、約拿單的兒子米非波設，[不交出來]，
verses.e: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul , because of the LORD's oath that was between them , between David and Jonathan the son of Saul .

verses.z: 卻把愛雅的女兒利斯巴給掃羅所生的兩個兒子亞摩尼、米非波設，和掃羅女兒米甲[的姊姊]給米何拉人巴西萊兒子亞得列所生的五個兒子
verses.e: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , whom she bore to Saul , Armoni and Mephibosheth ; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul , whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite .

verses.z: 交在基遍人的手裏。基遍人就把他們，在耶和華面前，懸掛在山上，這七人就一同死亡。被殺的時候正是收割的日子，就是動手割大麥的時候。
verses.e: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites ; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD , and all seven of them fell together . They were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , at the beginning of barley harvest .

verses.z: 當耶和華救大衛脫離一切仇敵和掃羅之手的日子，他向耶和華念這詩，
verses.e: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies , and out of the hand of Saul ,

verses.z: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨；有黑雲在他腳下。
verses.e: He bowed the heavens also , and came down . Thick darkness was under his feet .

verses.z: 他坐着基路伯飛行，在風的翅膀上顯現。
verses.e: He rode on a cherub , and flew . Yes , he was seen on the wings of the wind .

verses.z: 他以黑暗和聚集的水、天空的厚雲為他四圍的行宮。
verses.e: He made darkness a shelter around himself , gathering of waters , and thick clouds of the skies .

verses.z: 因他面前的光輝炭都着了。
verses.e: At the brightness before him , coals of fire were kindled .

verses.z: 耶和華從天上打雷；至高者發出聲音。
verses.e: The LORD thundered from heaven . The Most High uttered his voice .

verses.z: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散，發出閃電，使他們擾亂。
verses.e: He sent out arrows and scattered them , lightning and confused them .

verses.z: 耶和華的斥責一發，鼻孔的氣一出，海底就出現，大地的根基也顯露。
verses.e: Then the channels of the sea appeared . The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD's rebuke , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils .

verses.z: 他從高天伸手抓住我，把我從大水中拉上來。
verses.e: He sent from on high and he took me . He drew me out of many waters .

verses.z: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人，因為他們比我強盛。
verses.e: He delivered me from my strong enemy , from those who hated me , for they were too mighty for me .

verses.z: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我；但耶和華是我的倚靠。
verses.e: They came on me in the day of my calamity , but the LORD was my support .

verses.z: 說：耶和華是我的巖石，我的山寨，我的救主，
verses.e: and he said : " The LORD is my rock , my fortress , and my deliverer , even mine ;

verses.z: 他又領我到寬闊之處；他救拔我，因他喜悅我。
verses.e: He also brought me out into a large place . He delivered me , because he delighted in me .

verses.z: 耶和華按着我的公義報答我，按着我手中的清潔賞賜我。
verses.e: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness . He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands .

verses.z: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道，未曾作惡離開我的上帝。
verses.e: For I have kept the LORD's ways , and have not wickedly departed from my God .

verses.z: 他的一切典章常在我面前；他的律例，我也未曾離棄。
verses.e: For all his ordinances were before me . As for his statutes , I didn't depart from them .

verses.z: 我在他面前作了完全人；我也保守自己遠離我的罪孽。
verses.e: I was also perfect toward him . I kept myself from my iniquity .

verses.z: 所以耶和華按我的公義，按我在他眼前的清潔賞賜我。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness , According to my cleanness in his eyesight .

verses.z: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他；完全的人，你以完全待他；
verses.e: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful . With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect .

verses.z: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他；乖僻的人，你以彎曲待他。
verses.e: With the pure you will show yourself pure . With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd .

verses.z: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救；但你的眼目察看高傲的人，使他降卑。
verses.e: You will save the afflicted people , but your eyes are on the arrogant , that you may bring them down .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是我的燈；耶和華必照明我的黑暗。
verses.e: For you are my lamp , LORD . The LORD will light up my darkness .

verses.z: 我的上帝，我的磐石，我所投靠的。他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角，是我的高臺，是我的避難所。我的救主啊，你是救我脫離強暴的。
verses.e: God is my rock in whom I take refuge ; my shield , and the horn of my salvation , my high tower , and my refuge . My savior , you save me from violence .

verses.z: 我藉着你衝入敵軍，藉着我的上帝跳過牆垣。
verses.e: For by you , I run against a troop . By my God , I leap over a wall .

verses.z: 至於上帝，他的道是完全的；耶和華的話是煉淨的。凡投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
verses.e: As for God , his way is perfect . The LORD's word is tested . He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him .

verses.z: 除了耶和華，誰是上帝呢？除了我們的上帝，誰是磐石呢？
verses.e: For who is God , besides the LORD ? Who is a rock , besides our God ?

verses.z: 上帝是我堅固的保障；他引導完全人行他的路。
verses.e: God is my strong fortress . He makes my way perfect .

verses.z: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的[蹄]，又使我在高處安穩。
verses.e: He makes his feet like hinds ' feet , and sets me on my high places .

verses.z: 他教導我的手能以爭戰，甚至我的膀臂能開銅弓。
verses.e: He teaches my hands to war , so that my arms bend a bow of bronze .

verses.z: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌；你的溫和使我為大。
verses.e: You have also given me the shield of your salvation . Your gentleness has made me great .

verses.z: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊；我的腳未曾滑跌。
verses.e: You have enlarged my steps under me . My feet have not slipped .

verses.z: 我追趕我的仇敵，滅絕了他們，未滅以先，我沒有歸回。
verses.e: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them . I didn't turn again until they were consumed .

verses.z: 我滅絕了他們，打傷了他們，使他們不能起來；他們都倒在我的腳下。
verses.e: I have consumed them , and struck them through , so that they can't arise . Yes , they have fallen under my feet .

verses.z: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華，這樣，我必從仇敵手中被救出來。
verses.e: I call on the LORD , who is worthy to be praised ; So shall I be saved from my enemies .

verses.z: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰；你也使那起來攻擊我的都服在我以下。
verses.e: For you have armed me with strength for the battle . You have subdued under me those who rose up against me .

verses.z: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑，叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
verses.e: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me , that I might cut off those who hate me .

verses.z: 他們仰望，卻無人拯救；就是呼求耶和華，他也不應允。
verses.e: They looked , but there was no one to save ; even to the LORD , but he didn't answer them .

verses.z: 我搗碎他們，如同地上的灰塵，踐踏他們，四散在地，如同街上的泥土。
verses.e: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth . I crushed them as the mire of the streets , and spread them abroad .

verses.z: 你救我脫離我百姓的爭競，保護我作列國的元首；我素不認識的民必事奉我。
verses.e: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people . You have kept me to be the head of the nations . A people whom I have not known will serve me .

verses.z: 外邦人要投降我，一聽見我的名聲就必順從我。
verses.e: The foreigners will submit themselves to me . As soon as they hear of me , they will obey me .

verses.z: 外邦人要衰殘，戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。
verses.e: The foreigners will fade away , and will come trembling out of their close places .

verses.z: 耶和華是活神，願我的磐石被人稱頌！願上帝－那拯救我的磐石被人尊崇！
verses.e: The LORD lives ! Blessed be my rock ! Exalted be God , the rock of my salvation ,

verses.z: 這位上帝就是那為我伸冤、使眾民服在我以下的。
verses.e: even the God who executes vengeance for me , who brings down peoples under me ,

verses.z: 你救我脫離仇敵，又把我舉起，高過那些起來攻擊我的；你救我脫離強暴的人。
verses.e: who brings me away from my enemies . Yes , you lift me up above those who rise up against me . You deliver me from the violent man .

verses.z: 曾有死亡的波浪環繞我，匪類的急流使我驚懼，
verses.e: For the waves of death surrounded me . The floods of ungodliness made me afraid .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你，歌頌你的名。
verses.e: Therefore I will give thanks to you , LORD , among the nations , and will sing praises to your name .

verses.z: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他[所立]的王，施慈愛給他的受膏者，就是給大衛和他的後裔，直到永遠！
verses.e: He gives great deliverance to his king , and shows loving kindness to his anointed , to David and to his offspring , forever more . "

verses.z: 陰間的繩索纏繞我，死亡的網羅臨到我。
verses.e: The cords of Sheol were around me . The snares of death caught me .

verses.z: 我在急難中求告耶和華，向我的上帝呼求。他從殿中聽了我的聲音；我的呼求入了他的耳中。
verses.e: In my distress , I called on the LORD . Yes , I called to my God . He heard my voice out of his temple . My cry came into his ears .

verses.z: 那時因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖；天的根基也震動搖撼。
verses.e: Then the earth shook and trembled . The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken , because he was angry .

verses.z: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰；從他口中發火焚燒，連炭也着了。
verses.e: Smoke went up out of his nostrils . Consuming fire came out of his mouth . Coals were kindled by it .

verses.z: 以下是大衛末了的話。耶西的兒子大衛得居高位，是雅各上帝所膏的，作以色列的美歌者，說：
verses.e: Now these are the last words of David . David the son of Jesse says , the man who was raised on high says , the anointed of the God of Jacob , the sweet psalmist of Israel :

verses.z: 他起來擊殺非利士人，直到手臂疲乏，手黏住刀把。那日耶和華使[以色列]人大獲全勝；眾民在以利亞撒後頭專奪財物。
verses.e: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary , and his hand froze to the sword ; and the LORD worked a great victory that day ; and the people returned after him only to take plunder .

verses.z: 其次是哈拉人亞基的兒子沙瑪。一日，非利士人聚集成群，在一塊長滿紅豆的田裏，眾民就在非利士人面前逃跑。
verses.e: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite . The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils ; and the people fled from the Philistines .

verses.z: 沙瑪卻站在那田間擊殺非利士人，救護了那田。耶和華使[以色列]人大獲全勝。
verses.e: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it , and killed the Philistines ; and the LORD worked a great victory .

verses.z: 收割的時候，有三十個勇士中的三個人下到亞杜蘭洞見大衛。非利士的軍兵在利乏音谷安營。
verses.e: Three of the thirty chief men went down , and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam ; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim .

verses.z: 那時大衛在山寨，非利士人的防營在伯利恆。
verses.e: David was then in the stronghold ; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem .

verses.z: 大衛渴想，說：「甚願有人將伯利恆城門旁、井裏的水打來給我喝。」
verses.e: David said longingly , " Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem , which is by the gate ! "

verses.z: 這三個勇士就闖過非利士人的營盤，從伯利恆城門旁的井裏打水，拿來奉給大衛。他卻不肯喝，將水奠在耶和華面前，
verses.e: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines , and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David ; but he would not drink of it , but poured it out to the LORD .

verses.z: 說：「耶和華啊，這三個人冒死[去打水]；[這水]好像他們的血一般，我斷不敢喝。」如此，大衛不肯喝。這是三個勇士所做的事。
verses.e: He said , " Be it far from me , LORD , that I should do this ! Isn't this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go ? " Therefore he would not drink it . The three mighty men did these things .

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子、約押的兄弟亞比篩是這三個勇士的首領；他舉槍殺了三百人，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
verses.e: Abishai , the brother of Joab , the son of Zeruiah , was chief of the three . He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them , and had a name among the three .

verses.z: 他在這三個勇士裏是最尊貴的，所以作他們的首領，只是不及前三個勇士。
verses.e: Wasn't he most honorable of the three ? Therefore he was made their captain . However he wasn't included as one of the three .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈藉着我說：他的話在我口中。
verses.e: " The LORD's Spirit spoke by me . His word was on my tongue .

verses.z: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅行過大能的事；他殺了摩押人亞利伊勒的兩個兒子，又在下雪的時候下坑裏去，殺了一個獅子，
verses.e: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel , who had done mighty deeds , killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab . He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow .

verses.z: 又殺了一個強壯的埃及人；埃及人手裏拿着槍，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，從埃及人手裏奪過槍來，用那槍將他殺死。
verses.e: He killed a huge Egyptian , and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand ; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand , and killed him with his own spear .

verses.z: 這是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅所行的事，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
verses.e: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things , and had a name among the three mighty men .

verses.z: 他比那三十個勇士都尊貴，只是不及前三個勇士。大衛立他作護衛長。
verses.e: He was more honorable than the thirty , but he didn't attain to the three . David set him over his guard .

verses.z: 三十個勇士裏有約押的兄弟亞撒黑，伯利恆人朵多的兒子伊勒哈難，
verses.e: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty : Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem ,

verses.z: 哈律人沙瑪，哈律人以利加，
verses.e: Shammah the Harodite , Elika the Harodite ,

verses.z: 帕勒提人希利斯，提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉，
verses.e: Helez the Paltite , Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite ,

verses.z: 亞拿突人亞比以謝，戶沙人米本乃，
verses.e: Abiezer the Anathothite , Mebunnai the Hushathite ,

verses.z: 亞合人撒們，尼陀法人瑪哈萊，
verses.e: Zalmon the Ahohite , Maharai the Netophathite ,

verses.z: 尼陀法人巴拿的兒子希立，便雅憫族、基比亞人利拜的兒子以太，
verses.e: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite , Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin ,

verses.z: 以色列的上帝、以色列的磐石曉諭我說：那以公義治理人民的，敬畏上帝執掌權柄，
verses.e: The God of Israel said , the Rock of Israel spoke to me , ' One who rules over men righteously , who rules in the fear of God ,

verses.z: 比拉頓人比拿雅，迦實溪人希太，
verses.e: Benaiah a Pirathonite , Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash .

verses.z: 伯亞拉巴人亞比亞本，巴魯米人押斯瑪弗，
verses.e: Abialbon the Arbathite , Azmaveth the Barhumite ,

verses.z: 沙本人以利雅哈巴，雅善兒子中的約拿單，
verses.e: Eliahba the Shaalbonite , the sons of Jashen , Jonathan ,

verses.z: 哈拉人沙瑪，哈拉人沙拉的兒子亞希暗，
verses.e: Shammah the Hararite , Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite ,

verses.z: 瑪迦人亞哈拜的兒子以利法列，基羅人亞希多弗的兒子以連，
verses.e: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai , the son of the Maacathite , Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite ,

verses.z: 迦密人希斯萊，亞巴人帕萊，
verses.e: Hezro the Carmelite , Paarai the Arbite ,

verses.z: 瑣巴人拿單的兒子以甲，迦得人巴尼，
verses.e: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah , Bani the Gadite ,

verses.z: 亞捫人洗勒，比錄人拿哈萊（是給洗魯雅的兒子約押拿兵器的），
verses.e: Zelek the Ammonite , Naharai the Beerothite , armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah ,

verses.z: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
verses.e: Ira the Ithrite , Gareb the Ithrite ,

verses.z: 赫人烏利亞，共有三十七人。
verses.e: and Uriah the Hittite : thirty-seven in all .

verses.z: 他必像日出的晨光，如無雲的清晨，雨後的晴光，使地[發生]嫩草。
verses.e: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises , a morning without clouds , when the tender grass springs out of the earth , through clear shining after rain . '

verses.z: 我家在上帝面前並非如此；上帝卻與我立永遠的約。這約凡事堅穩，關乎我的一切救恩和我一切所想望的，他豈不為我成就嗎？
verses.e: Isn't my house so with God ? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant , ordered in all things , and sure , for it is all my salvation and all my desire . Won't he make it grow ?

verses.z: 但匪類都必像荊棘被丟棄；人不敢用手拿它；
verses.e: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away , because they can't be taken with the hand .

verses.z: 拿它的人必帶鐵器和槍桿，終久它必被火焚燒。
verses.e: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear . They will be utterly burned with fire in their place . "

verses.z: 大衛勇士的名字記在下面：他革捫人約設‧巴設，又稱伊斯尼人亞底挪，他是軍長的統領，一時擊殺了八百人。
verses.e: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had : Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite , chief of the captains ; he was called Adino the Eznite , who killed eight hundred at one time .

verses.z: 其次是亞合人朵多的兒子以利亞撒。從前非利士人聚集要打仗，以色列人迎着上去，有跟隨大衛的三個勇士向非利士人罵陣，其中有以利亞撒。
verses.e: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite , one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle , and the men of Israel had gone away .

verses.z: 耶和華又向以色列人發怒，就激動大衛，使他吩咐人去數點以色列人和猶大人。
verses.e: Again the LORD's anger burned against Israel , and he moved David against them , saying , " Go , count Israel and Judah . "

verses.z: 大衛數點百姓以後，就心中自責，禱告耶和華說：「我行這事大有罪了。耶和華啊，求你除掉僕人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
verses.e: David's heart struck him after he had counted the people . David said to the LORD , " I have sinned greatly in that which I have done . But now , the LORD , put away , I beg you , the iniquity of your servant ; for I have done very foolishly . "

verses.z: 大衛早晨起來，耶和華的話臨到先知迦得，就是大衛的先見，說：
verses.e: When David rose up in the morning , the LORD's word came to the prophet Gad , David's seer , saying ,

verses.z: 「你去告訴大衛，說耶和華如此說：『我有三樣災，隨你選擇一樣，我好降與你。』」
verses.e: " Go and speak to David , ' The LORD says , " I offer you three things . Choose one of them , that I may do it to you . " ' "

verses.z: 於是迦得來見大衛，對他說：「你願意國中有七年的饑荒呢？是在你敵人面前逃跑，被追趕三個月呢？是在你國中有三日的瘟疫呢？現在你要揣摩思想，我好回覆那差我來的。」
verses.e: So Gad came to David , and told him , saying , " Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land ? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you ? Or shall there be three days ' pestilence in your land ? Now answer , and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me . "

verses.z: 大衛對迦得說：「我甚為難！我願落在耶和華的手裏，因為他有豐盛的憐憫。我不願落在人的手裏。」
verses.e: David said to Gad , " I am in distress . Let us fall now into the LORD's hand , for his mercies are great . Let me not fall into man's hand . "

verses.z: 於是，耶和華降瘟疫與以色列人，自早晨到所定的時候；從但直到別是巴，民間死了七萬人。
verses.e: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time ; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba .

verses.z: 天使向耶路撒冷伸手要滅城的時候，耶和華後悔，就不降這災了，吩咐滅民的天使說：「夠了！住手吧！」那時耶和華的使者在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場那裏。
verses.e: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it , the LORD relented of the disaster , and said to the angel who destroyed the people , " It is enough . Now withdraw your hand . " The LORD's angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite .

verses.z: 大衛看見滅民的天使，就禱告耶和華說：「我犯了罪，行了惡；但這群羊做了甚麼呢？願你的手攻擊我和我的父家。」
verses.e: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people , and said , " Behold , I have sinned , and I have done perversely ; but these sheep , what have they done ? Please let your hand be against me , and against my father's house . "

verses.z: 當日，迦得來見大衛，對他說：「你上去，在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場上為耶和華築一座壇。」
verses.e: Gad came that day to David and said to him , " Go up , build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite . "

verses.z: 大衛就照着迦得奉耶和華名所說的話上去了。
verses.e: David went up according to the saying of Gad , as the LORD commanded .

verses.z: 大衛就吩咐跟隨他的元帥約押說：「你去走遍以色列眾支派，從但直到別是巴，數點百姓，我好知道他們的數目。」
verses.e: The king said to Joab the captain of the army , who was with him , " Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel , from Dan even to Beersheba , and count the people , that I may know the sum of the people . "

verses.z: 亞勞拿觀看，見王和他臣僕前來，就迎接出去，臉伏於地，向王下拜，
verses.e: Araunah looked out , and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him . Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground .

verses.z: 說：「我主我王為何來到僕人這裏呢？」大衛說：「我要買你這禾場，為耶和華築一座壇，使民間的瘟疫止住。」
verses.e: Araunah said , " Why has my lord the king come to his servant ? " David said , " To buy your threshing floor , to build an altar to the LORD , that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people . "

verses.z: 亞勞拿對大衛說：「我主我王，你喜悅用甚麼，就拿去獻祭。看哪，這裏有牛可以作燔祭，有打糧的器具和套牛的軛可以當柴燒。
verses.e: Araunah said to David , " Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him . Behold , the cattle for the burnt offering , and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood .

verses.z: 王啊，這一切，我亞勞拿都奉給你」；又對王說：「願耶和華－你的上帝悅納你。」
verses.e: All this , O king , does Araunah give to the king . " Araunah said to the king , " May the LORD your God accept you . "

verses.z: 王對亞勞拿說：「不然。我必要按着價值向你買；我不肯用白得之物作燔祭獻給耶和華－我的上帝。」大衛就用五十舍客勒銀子買了那禾場與牛。
verses.e: The king said to Araunah , " No , but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price . I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing . " So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver .

verses.z: 大衛在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭。如此，耶和華垂聽國民所求的，瘟疫在以色列人中就止住了。
verses.e: David built an altar to the LORD there , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . So the LORD was entreated for the land , and the plague was removed from Israel .

verses.z: 約押對王說：「無論百姓多少，願耶和華－你的上帝再加增百倍，使我主我王親眼得見。我主我王何必喜悅行這事呢？」
verses.e: Joab said to the king , " Now may the LORD your God add to the people , however many they may be , one hundred times ; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it . But why does my lord the king delight in this thing ? "

verses.z: 但王的命令勝過約押和眾軍長。約押和眾軍長就從王面前出去，數點以色列的百姓。
verses.e: Notwithstanding , the king's word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army . Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel .

verses.z: 他們過了約旦河，在迦得谷中、城的右邊亞羅珥安營，與雅謝相對，
verses.e: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer , on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad , and to Jazer ;

verses.z: 又到了基列和他停‧合示地，又到了但‧雅安，繞到西頓，
verses.e: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi ; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon ,

verses.z: 來到泰爾的保障，並希未人和迦南人的各城，又到猶大南方的別是巴。
verses.e: and came to the stronghold of Tyre , and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites ; and they went out to the south of Judah , at Beersheba .

verses.z: 他們走遍全地，過了九個月零二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。
verses.e: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .

verses.z: 約押將百姓的總數奏告於王：以色列拿刀的勇士有八十萬；猶大有五十萬。
verses.e: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king ; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword , and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men .

verses.z: 掃羅家和大衛家爭戰許久。大衛家日見強盛；掃羅家日見衰弱。
verses.e: Now there was long war between Saul's house and David's house . David grew stronger and stronger , but Saul's house grew weaker and weaker .
to transfer the kingdom from Saul's house , and to set up David's throne over Israel and over Judah , from Dan even to Beersheba . "

verses.z: 伊施波設懼怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。
verses.e: He could not answer Abner another word , because he was afraid of him .

verses.z: 押尼珥打發人去見大衛，替他說：「這國歸誰呢？」又說：「你與我立約，我必幫助你，使以色列人都歸服你。」
verses.e: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf , saying , " Whose is the land ? " and saying , " Make your alliance with me , and behold , my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you . "

verses.z: 大衛說：「好！我與你立約。但有一件，你來見我面的時候，若不將掃羅的女兒米甲帶來，必不得見我的面。」
verses.e: David said , " Good . I will make a treaty with you , but one thing I require of you . That is , you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal , Saul's daughter , when you come to see my face . "

verses.z: 大衛就打發人去見掃羅的兒子伊施波設，說：「你要將我的妻米甲歸還我；她是我從前用一百非利士人的陽皮所聘定的。」
verses.e: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth , Saul's son , saying , " Deliver me my wife Michal , whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 伊施波設就打發人去，將米甲從拉億的兒子、她丈夫帕鐵那裏接回來。
verses.e: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband , Paltiel the son of Laish .

verses.z: 米甲的丈夫跟着她，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴戶琳。押尼珥說：「你回去吧！」帕鐵就回去了。
verses.e: Her husband went with her , weeping as he went , and followed her to Bahurim . Then Abner said to him , " Go ! Return ! " and he returned .

verses.z: 押尼珥對以色列長老說：「從前你們願意大衛作王治理你們，
verses.e: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel , saying , " In times past , you sought for David to be king over you .

verses.z: 現在你們可以照心願而行。因為耶和華曾論到大衛說：『我必藉我僕人大衛的手，救我民以色列脫離非利士人和眾仇敵的手。』」
verses.e: Now then do it ! For the LORD has spoken of David , saying , ' By the hand of my servant David , I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines , and out of the hand of all their enemies . ' "

verses.z: 押尼珥也用這話說給便雅憫人聽，又到希伯崙，將以色列人和便雅憫全家一切所喜悅的事說給大衛聽。
verses.e: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin ; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin .

verses.z: 大衛在希伯崙得了幾個兒子：長子暗嫩是耶斯列人亞希暖所生的；
verses.e: Sons were born to David in Hebron . His firstborn was Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess ;

verses.z: 押尼珥帶着二十個人來到希伯崙見大衛，大衛就為押尼珥和他帶來的人設擺筵席。
verses.e: So Abner came to David to Hebron , and twenty men with him . David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast .

verses.z: 押尼珥對大衛說：「我要起身去招聚以色列眾人來見我主我王，與你立約，你就可以照着心願作王。」於是大衛送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。
verses.e: Abner said to David , " I will arise and go , and will gather all Israel to my lord the king , that they may make a covenant with you , and that you may reign over all that your soul desires . " David sent Abner away ; and he went in peace .

verses.z: 約押和大衛的僕人攻擊敵軍，帶回許多的掠物。那時押尼珥不在希伯崙大衛那裏，因大衛已經送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
verses.e: Behold , David's servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them ; but Abner was not with David in Hebron , for he had sent him away , and he had gone in peace .

verses.z: 約押和跟隨他的全軍到了，就有人告訴約押說：「尼珥的兒子押尼珥來見王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。」
verses.e: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come , they told Joab , " Abner the son of Ner came to the king , and he has sent him away , and he has gone in peace . "

verses.z: 約押去見王說：「你這是做甚麼呢？押尼珥來見你，你為何送他去，他就蹤影不見了呢？
verses.e: Then Joab came to the king and said , " What have you done ? Behold , Abner came to you . Why is it that you have sent him away , and he is already gone ?

verses.z: 你當曉得，尼珥的兒子押尼珥來是要誆哄你，要知道你的出入和你一切所行的事。」
verses.e: You know Abner the son of Ner . He came to deceive you , and to know your going out and your coming in , and to know all that you do . "

verses.z: 約押從大衛那裏出來，就打發人去追趕押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，將他帶回來，大衛卻不知道。
verses.e: When Joab had come out from David , he sent messengers after Abner , and they brought him back from the well of Sirah ; but David didn't know it .

verses.z: 押尼珥回到希伯崙，約押領他到城門的甕洞，假作要與他說機密話，就在那裏刺透他的肚腹，他便死了。這是報殺他兄弟亞撒黑的仇。
verses.e: When Abner had returned to Hebron , Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly , and struck him there in the body , so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother .

verses.z: 大衛聽見了，就說：「流尼珥的兒子押尼珥的血，這罪在耶和華面前必永不歸我和我的國。
verses.e: Afterward , when David heard it , he said , " I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner .

verses.z: 願流他血的罪歸到約押頭上和他父的全家；又願約押家不斷有患漏症的，長大痲瘋的，架柺而行的，被刀殺死的，缺乏飲食的。」
verses.e: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father's house . Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge , or who is a leper , or who leans on a staff , or who falls by the sword , or who lacks bread . "

verses.z: 次子基利押是作過迦密人拿八的妻亞比該所生的；三子押沙龍是基述王達買的女兒瑪迦所生的；
verses.e: and his second , Chileab , of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite ; and the third , Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur ;

verses.z: 約押和他兄弟亞比篩殺了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍爭戰的時候殺了他們的兄弟亞撒黑。
verses.e: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner , because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle .

verses.z: 大衛吩咐約押和跟隨他的眾人說：「你們當撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥[棺]前哀哭。」大衛王也跟在棺後。
verses.e: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him , " Tear your clothes , and clothe yourselves with sackcloth , and mourn in front of Abner . " King David followed the bier .

verses.z: 他們將押尼珥葬在希伯崙。王在押尼珥的墓旁放聲而哭，眾民也都哭了。
verses.e: They buried Abner in Hebron ; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner's grave ; and all the people wept .

verses.z: 王為押尼珥舉哀，說：押尼珥何竟像愚頑人死呢？
verses.e: The king lamented for Abner , and said , " Should Abner die as a fool dies ?

verses.z: 你手未曾捆綁，腳未曾鎖住。你死，如人死在罪孽之輩手下一樣。於是眾民又為押尼珥哀哭。
verses.e: Your hands weren't bound , and your feet weren't put into fetters . As a man falls before the children of iniquity , so you fell . " All the people wept again over him .

verses.z: 日頭未落的時候，眾民來勸大衛吃飯，但大衛起誓說：「我若在日頭未落以前吃飯，或吃別物，願上帝重重地降罰與我！」
verses.e: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day ; but David swore , saying , " God do so to me , and more also , if I taste bread or anything else , until the sun goes down . "

verses.z: 眾民知道了就都喜悅。凡王所行的，眾民無不喜悅。
verses.e: All the people took notice of it , and it pleased them , as whatever the king did pleased all the people .

verses.z: 那日，以色列眾民才知道殺尼珥的兒子押尼珥並非出於王意。
verses.e: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner .

verses.z: 王對臣僕說：「你們豈不知今日以色列人中死了一個作元帥的大丈夫嗎？
verses.e: The king said to his servants , " Don't you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel ?

verses.z: 我雖然受膏為王，今日還是軟弱；這洗魯雅的兩個兒子比我剛強。願耶和華照着惡人所行的惡報應他。」
verses.e: I am weak today , though anointed king . These men , the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me . May the LORD reward the evildoer according to his wickedness . "

verses.z: 四子亞多尼雅是哈及所生的；五子示法提雅是亞比她所生的；
verses.e: and the fourth , Adonijah the son of Haggith ; and the fifth , Shephatiah the son of Abital ;

verses.z: 六子以特念是大衛的妻以格拉所生的。大衛這六個兒子都是在希伯崙生的。
verses.e: and the sixth , Ithream , of Eglah , David's wife . These were born to David in Hebron .

verses.z: 掃羅家和大衛家爭戰的時候，押尼珥在掃羅家大有權勢。
verses.e: While there was war between Saul's house and David's house , Abner made himself strong in Saul's house .

verses.z: 掃羅有一妃嬪，名叫利斯巴，是愛亞的女兒。一日，伊施波設對押尼珥說：「你為甚麼與我父的妃嬪同房呢？」
verses.e: Now Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah ; and Ishbosheth said to Abner , " Why have you gone in to my father's concubine ? "

verses.z: 押尼珥因伊施波設的話就甚發怒，說：「我豈是猶大的狗頭呢？我恩待你父掃羅的家和他的弟兄、朋友，不將你交在大衛手裏，今日你竟為這婦人責備我嗎？
verses.e: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth's words , and said , " Am I a dog's head that belongs to Judah ? Today I show kindness to your father Saul's house , to his brothers , and to his friends , and have not delivered you into the hand of David ; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman !
