verses.z: 我若不照着耶和華起誓應許大衛的話行，廢去掃羅的位，建立大衛的位，使他治理以色列和猶大，從但直到別是巴，願上帝重重地降罰與我！」
verses.e: God do so to Abner , and more also , if , as the LORD has sworn to David , I don't do even so to him :

verses.z: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設聽見押尼珥死在希伯崙，手就發軟；以色列眾人也都驚惶。
verses.e: When Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron , his hands became feeble , and all the Israelites were troubled .

verses.z: 從前有人報告我說，掃羅死了，他自以為報好消息；我就拿住他，將他殺在洗革拉，這就作了他報消息的賞賜。
verses.e: when someone told me , ' Behold , Saul is dead , ' thinking that he brought good news , I seized him and killed him in Ziklag , which was the reward I gave him for his news .

verses.z: 何況惡人將義人殺在他的床上，我豈不向你們討流他血的罪、從世上除滅你們呢？」
verses.e: How much more , when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed , should I not now require his blood from your hand , and rid the earth of you ? "

verses.z: 於是大衛吩咐少年人將他們殺了，砍斷他們的手腳，掛在希伯崙的池旁，卻將伊施波設的首級葬在希伯崙押尼珥的墳墓裏。
verses.e: David commanded his young men , and they killed them , cut off their hands and their feet , and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron . But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner's grave in Hebron .

verses.z: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設有兩個軍長，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅憫支派、比錄人臨門的兒子。比錄也屬便雅憫。
verses.e: Saul's son had two men who were captains of raiding bands . The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab , the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite , of the children of Benjamin ( for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin ;

verses.z: 比錄人早先逃到基他音，在那裏寄居，直到今日。
verses.e: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim , and have lived as foreigners there until today ) .

verses.z: 掃羅的兒子約拿單有一個兒子名叫米非波設，是瘸腿的。掃羅和約拿單[死亡]的消息從耶斯列傳到的時候，他才五歲。他乳母抱着他逃跑；因為跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。
verses.e: Now Jonathan , Saul's son , had a son who was lame in his feet . He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel ; and his nurse picked him up and fled . As she hurried to flee , he fell and became lame . His name was Mephibosheth .

verses.z: 一日，比錄人臨門的兩個兒子利甲和巴拿出去，約在午熱的時候到了伊施波設的家；伊施波設正睡午覺。
verses.e: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite , Rechab and Baanah , went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon .

verses.z: 他們進了房子，假作要取麥子，就刺透伊施波設的肚腹，逃跑了。
verses.e: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat , and they struck him in the body ; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped .

verses.z: 他們進房子的時候，伊施波設正在臥房裏躺在床上，他們將他殺死，割了他的首級，拿着首級在亞拉巴走了一夜，
verses.e: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom , they struck him , killed him , beheaded him , and took his head , and went by the way of the Arabah all night .

verses.z: 將伊施波設的首級拿到希伯崙見大衛王，說：「王的仇敵掃羅曾尋索王的性命。看哪，這是他兒子伊施波設的首級；耶和華今日為我主我王在掃羅和他後裔的身上報了仇。」
verses.e: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron , and said to the king , " Behold , the head of Ishbosheth , the son of Saul , your enemy , who sought your life ! The LORD has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring . "

verses.z: 大衛對比錄人臨門的兒子利甲和他兄弟巴拿說：「我指着救我性命脫離一切苦難、永生的耶和華起誓：
verses.e: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother , the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite , and said to them , " As the LORD lives , who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity ,

verses.z: 以色列眾支派來到希伯崙見大衛，說：「我們原是你的骨肉。
verses.e: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke , saying , " Behold , we are your bone and your flesh .

verses.z: 大衛日見強盛，因為耶和華－萬軍之上帝與他同在。
verses.e: David grew greater and greater , for the LORD , the God of Armies , was with him .

verses.z: 泰爾王希蘭將香柏木運到大衛那裏，又差遣使者和木匠、石匠給大衛建造宮殿。
verses.e: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , with cedar trees , carpenters , and masons ; and they built David a house .

verses.z: 大衛就知道耶和華堅立他作以色列王，又為自己的民以色列使他的國興旺。
verses.e: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake .

verses.z: 大衛離開希伯崙之後，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生兒女。
verses.e: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem , after he had come from Hebron ; and more sons and daughters were born to David .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷所生的兒子是沙母亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門、
verses.e: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem : Shammua , Shobab , Nathan , Solomon ,

verses.z: 益轄、以利書亞、尼斐、雅非亞、
verses.e: Ibhar , Elishua , Nepheg , Japhia ,

verses.z: 以利沙瑪、以利雅大、以利法列。
verses.e: Elishama , Eliada , and Eliphelet .

verses.z: 非利士人聽見人膏大衛作以色列王，非利士眾人就上來尋索大衛；大衛聽見，就下到保障。
verses.e: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines went up to seek David , but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold .

verses.z: 非利士人來了，布散在利乏音谷。
verses.e: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .

verses.z: 大衛求問耶和華說：「我可以上去攻打非利士人嗎？你將他們交在我手裏嗎？」耶和華說：「你可以上去，我必將非利士人交在你手裏。」
verses.e: David inquired of the LORD , saying , " Shall I go up against the Philistines ? Will you deliver them into my hand ? " The LORD said to David , " Go up ; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand . "

verses.z: 從前掃羅作我們王的時候，率領以色列人出入的是你；耶和華也曾應許你說：『你必牧養我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
verses.e: In times past , when Saul was king over us , it was you who led Israel out and in . The LORD said to you , ' You will be shepherd of my people Israel , and you will be prince over Israel . ' "

verses.z: 大衛來到巴力‧毗拉心，在那裏擊殺非利士人，說：「耶和華在我面前沖破敵人，如同水沖去一般。」因此稱那地方為巴力‧毗拉心。
verses.e: David came to Baal Perazim , and David struck them there . Then he said , " The LORD has broken my enemies before me , like the breach of waters . " Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim .

verses.z: 非利士人將偶像撇在那裏，大衛和跟隨他的人拿去了。
verses.e: They left their images there , and David and his men took them away .

verses.z: 非利士人又上來，布散在利乏音谷。
verses.e: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .

verses.z: 大衛求問耶和華；耶和華說：「不要一直地上去，要轉到他們後頭，從桑林對面攻打他們。
verses.e: When David inquired of the LORD , he said , " You shall not go up . Circle around behind them , and attack them in front of the mulberry trees .

verses.z: 你聽見桑樹梢上有腳步的聲音，就要急速前去，因為那時耶和華已經在你前頭去攻打非利士人的軍隊。」
verses.e: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees , then stir yourself up ; for then the LORD has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 大衛就遵着耶和華所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，從迦巴直到基色。
verses.e: David did so , as the LORD commanded him , and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer .

verses.z: 於是以色列的長老都來到希伯崙見大衛王，大衛在希伯崙耶和華面前與他們立約，他們就膏大衛作以色列的王。
verses.e: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron , and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD ; and they anointed David king over Israel .

verses.z: 大衛登基的時候年三十歲，在位四十年；
verses.e: David was thirty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned forty years .

verses.z: 在希伯崙作猶大王七年零六個月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和猶大王三十三年。
verses.e: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months , and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah .

verses.z: 大衛和跟隨他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人對大衛說：「你若不趕出瞎子、瘸子，必不能進這地方」；心裏想大衛決不能進去。
verses.e: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites , the inhabitants of the land , who spoke to David , saying , " The blind and the lame will keep you out of here , " thinking , " David can't come in here . "

verses.z: 然而大衛攻取錫安的保障，就是大衛的城。
verses.e: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion . This is David's city .

verses.z: 當日，大衛說：「誰攻打耶布斯人，當上水溝[攻打]我心裏所恨惡的瘸子、瞎子。」從此有俗語說：「在那裏有瞎子、瘸子，他不能進屋去。」
verses.e: David said on that day , " Whoever strikes the Jebusites , let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind , who are hated by David's soul . " Therefore they say , " The blind and the lame can't come into the house . "

verses.z: 大衛住在保障裏，給保障起名叫大衛城。大衛又從米羅以裏，周圍築牆。
verses.e: David lived in the stronghold , and called it David's city . David built around from Millo and inward .

verses.z: 大衛又聚集以色列中所有挑選的人三萬。
verses.e: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .

verses.z: 於是大衛不肯將耶和華的[約]櫃運進大衛的城，卻運到迦特人俄別‧以東的家中。
verses.e: So David would not move the LORD's ark to be with him in David's city ; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite's house .

verses.z: 耶和華的[約]櫃在迦特人俄別‧以東家中三個月；耶和華賜福給俄別‧以東和他的全家。
verses.e: The LORD's ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite's house three months ; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom and all his house .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛王說：「耶和華因為[約]櫃賜福給俄別‧以東的家和一切屬他的。」大衛就去，歡歡喜喜地將上帝的[約]櫃從俄別‧以東家中抬到大衛的城裏。
verses.e: King David was told , " The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-Edom , and all that belongs to him , because of God's ark . " So David went and brought up God's ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David's city with joy .

verses.z: 抬耶和華[約]櫃的人走了六步，大衛就獻牛與肥羊為祭。
verses.e: When those who bore the LORD's ark had gone six paces , he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf .

verses.z: 大衛穿着細麻布的以弗得，在耶和華面前極力跳舞。
verses.e: David danced before the LORD with all his might ; and David was clothed in a linen ephod .

verses.z: 這樣，大衛和以色列的全家歡呼吹角，將耶和華的[約]櫃抬上來。
verses.e: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD's ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet .

verses.z: 耶和華的[約]櫃進了大衛城的時候，掃羅的女兒米甲從窗戶裏觀看，見大衛王在耶和華面前踴躍跳舞，心裏就輕視他。
verses.e: As the LORD's ark came into David's city , Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD ; and she despised him in her heart .

verses.z: 眾人將耶和華的[約]櫃請進去，安放在所預備的地方，就是在大衛所搭的帳幕裏。大衛在耶和華面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
verses.e: They brought in the LORD's ark , and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it ; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

verses.z: 大衛獻完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉萬軍之耶和華的名給民祝福，
verses.e: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 並且分給以色列眾人，無論男女，每人一個餅，一塊[肉]，一個葡萄餅；眾人就各回各家去了。
verses.e: He gave to all the people , even among the whole multitude of Israel , both to men and women , to everyone a portion of bread , dates , and raisins . So all the people departed , each to his own house .

verses.z: 大衛起身，率領跟隨他的眾人前往，要從巴拉‧猶大將上帝的[約]櫃運來；這[約]櫃就是坐在二基路伯上萬軍之耶和華留名的[約]櫃。
verses.e: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah , to bring up from there God's ark , which is called by the Name , even the name of the LORD of Armies who sits above the cherubim .

verses.z: 大衛回家要給眷屬祝福；掃羅的女兒米甲出來迎接他，說：「以色列王今日在臣僕的婢女眼前露體，如同一個輕賤人無恥露體一樣，有好大的榮耀啊！」
verses.e: Then David returned to bless his household . Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , " How glorious the king of Israel was today , who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants ' maids , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself ! "

verses.z: 大衛對米甲說：「這是在耶和華面前；耶和華已揀選我，廢了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和華民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和華面前跳舞。
verses.e: David said to Michal , " It was before the LORD , who chose me above your father , and above all his house , to appoint me prince over the people of the LORD , over Israel . Therefore I will celebrate before the LORD .

verses.z: 我也必更加卑微，自己看為輕賤。你所說的那些婢女，她們倒要尊敬我。」
verses.e: I will be yet more undignified than this , and will be worthless in my own sight . But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me . "

verses.z: 掃羅的女兒米甲，直到死日，沒有生養兒女。
verses.e: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death .

verses.z: 他們將上帝的[約]櫃從岡上亞比拿達的家裏抬出來，放在新車上；亞比拿達的兩個兒子烏撒和亞希約趕這新車。
verses.e: They set God's ark on a new cart , and brought it out of Abinadab's house that was on the hill ; and Uzzah and Ahio , the sons of Abinadab , drove the new cart .

verses.z: 他們將上帝的[約]櫃從岡上亞比拿達家裏抬出來的時候，亞希約在櫃前行走。
verses.e: They brought it out of Abinadab's house which was in the hill , with God's ark ; and Ahio went before the ark .

verses.z: 大衛和以色列的全家在耶和華面前，用松木製造的各樣[樂器]和琴、瑟、鼓、鈸、鑼，作樂跳舞。
verses.e: David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood , with harps , with stringed instruments , with tambourines , with castanets , and with cymbals .

verses.z: 到了拿艮的禾場，因為牛失前蹄，烏撒就伸[手]扶住上帝的[約]櫃。
verses.e: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon , Uzzah reached for God's ark and took hold of it , for the cattle stumbled .

verses.z: 上帝耶和華向烏撒發怒，因這錯誤擊殺他，他就死在上帝的[約]櫃旁。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Uzzah , and God struck him there for his error ; and he died there by God's ark .

verses.z: 大衛因耶和華擊殺烏撒，心裏愁煩，就稱那地方為毗列斯‧烏撒，直到今日。
verses.e: David was displeased because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah ; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day .

verses.z: 那日，大衛懼怕耶和華，說：「耶和華的[約]櫃怎可運到我這裏來？」
verses.e: David was afraid of the LORD that day ; and he said , " How could the LORD's ark come to me ? "

verses.z: 王住在自己宮中，耶和華使他安靖，不被四圍的仇敵擾亂。
verses.e: When the king lived in his house , and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around ,

verses.z: 我必為我民以色列選定一個地方，栽培他們，使他們住自己的地方，不再遷移；凶惡之子也不像從前擾害他們，
verses.e: I will appoint a place for my people Israel , and will plant them , that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more . The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more , as at the first ,

verses.z: 並不像我命士師治理我民以色列的時候一樣。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敵擾亂，並且我－耶和華應許你，必為你建立家室。
verses.e: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel . I will cause you to rest from all your enemies . Moreover the LORD tells you that the LORD will make you a house .

verses.z: 你壽數滿足、與你列祖同睡的時候，我必使你的後裔接續你的位；我也必堅定他的國。
verses.e: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers , I will set up your offspring after you , who will proceed out of your body , and I will establish his kingdom .

verses.z: 他必為我的名建造殿宇；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。
verses.e: He will build a house for my name , and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever .

verses.z: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖責打他，用人的鞭責罰他。
verses.e: I will be his father , and he will be my son . If he commits iniquity , I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men ;

verses.z: 但我的慈愛仍不離開他，像離開在你面前所廢棄的掃羅一樣。
verses.e: but my loving kindness will not depart from him , as I took it from Saul , whom I put away before you .

verses.z: 你的家和你的國必在我面前永遠堅立。你的國位也必堅定，直到永遠。』」
verses.e: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you . Your throne will be established forever . " ' "

verses.z: 拿單就按這一切話，照這默示，告訴大衛。
verses.e: Nathan spoke to David all these words , and according to all this vision .

verses.z: 於是大衛王進去，坐在耶和華面前，說：「主耶和華啊，我是誰？我的家算甚麼？你竟使我到這地步呢？
verses.e: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD ; and he said , " Who am I , Lord GOD , and what is my house , that you have brought me this far ?

verses.z: 主耶和華啊，這在你眼中還看為小，又應許你僕人的家至於久遠。主耶和華啊，這豈是人所常遇的事嗎？
verses.e: This was yet a small thing in your eyes , Lord GOD , but you have spoken also of your servant's house for a great while to come ; and this among men , Lord GOD !

verses.z: 那時，王對先知拿單說：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宮中，上帝的[約]櫃反在幔子裏。」
verses.e: the king said to Nathan the prophet , " See now , I dwell in a house of cedar , but God's ark dwells within curtains . "

verses.z: 主耶和華啊，我還有何言可以對你說呢？因為你知道你的僕人。
verses.e: What more can David say to you ? For you know your servant , Lord GOD .

verses.z: 你行這大事使僕人知道，是因你所應許的話，也是照你的心意。
verses.e: For your word's sake , and according to your own heart , you have worked all this greatness , to make your servant know it .

verses.z: 主耶和華啊，你本為大，照我們耳中聽見，沒有可比你的；除你以外再無上帝。
verses.e: Therefore you are great , LORD God . For there is no one like you , neither is there any God besides you , according to all that we have heard with our ears .

verses.z: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你從埃及救贖他們作自己的子民，又在你贖出來的民面前行大而可畏的事，[驅逐]列邦人和他們的神，顯出你的大名。
verses.e: What one nation in the earth is like your people , even like Israel , whom God went to redeem to himself for a people , and to make himself a name , and to do great things for you , and awesome things for your land , before your people , whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt , from the nations and their gods ?

verses.z: 你曾堅立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永遠；你－耶和華也作了他們的上帝。
verses.e: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever ; and you , LORD , became their God .

verses.z: 「耶和華上帝啊，你所應許僕人和僕人家的話，求你堅定，直到永遠；照你所說的而行。
verses.e: " Now , LORD God , the word that you have spoken concerning your servant , and concerning his house , confirm it forever , and do as you have spoken .

verses.z: 願人永遠尊你的名為大，說：『萬軍之耶和華是治理以色列的上帝。』這樣，你僕人大衛的家必在你面前堅立。
verses.e: Let your name be magnified forever , saying , ' The LORD of Armies is God over Israel ; and the house of your servant David will be established before you . '

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，因你啟示你的僕人說：『我必為你建立家室』，所以僕人大膽向你如此祈禱。
verses.e: For you , LORD of Armies , the God of Israel , have revealed to your servant , saying , ' I will build you a house . ' Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you .

verses.z: 「主耶和華啊，惟有你是上帝。你的話是真實的；你也應許將這福氣賜給僕人。
verses.e: " Now , O Lord GOD , you are God , and your words are truth , and you have promised this good thing to your servant .

verses.z: 現在求你賜福與僕人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和華啊，這是你所應許的。願你永遠賜福與僕人的家！」
verses.e: Now therefore , let it please you to bless the house of your servant , that it may continue forever before you ; for you , Lord GOD , have spoken it . Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing . "

verses.z: 拿單對王說：「你可以照你的心意而行，因為耶和華與你同在。」
verses.e: Nathan said to the king , " Go , do all that is in your heart , for the LORD is with you . "

verses.z: 當夜，耶和華的話臨到拿單說：
verses.e: That same night , the LORD's word came to Nathan , saying ,

verses.z: 「你去告訴我僕人大衛，說耶和華如此說：『你豈可建造殿宇給我居住呢？
verses.e: " Go and tell my servant David , ' The LORD says , " Should you build me a house for me to dwell in ?

verses.z: 自從我領以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住過殿宇，常在會幕和帳幕中行走。
verses.e: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt , even to this day , but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle .

verses.z: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派[的士師]，就是我吩咐牧養我民以色列的說：你們為何不給我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
verses.e: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel , did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel , saying , ' Why have you not built me a house of cedar ? ' " '

verses.z: 「現在，你要告訴我僕人大衛，說萬軍之耶和華如此說：『我從羊圈中將你召來，叫你不再跟從羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
verses.e: Now therefore tell my servant David this : ' The LORD of Armies says , " I took you from the sheep pen , from following the sheep , to be prince over my people , over Israel .

verses.z: 你無論往哪裏去，我常與你同在，剪除你的一切仇敵。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一樣。
verses.e: I have been with you wherever you went , and have cut off all your enemies from before you . I will make you a great name , like the name of the great ones who are in the earth .

verses.z: 此後，大衛攻打非利士人，把他們治服，從他們手下奪取了京城的權柄；
verses.e: After this , David struck the Philistines and subdued them ; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines .

verses.z: 就打發他兒子約蘭去見大衛王，問他的安，為他祝福，因為他殺敗了哈大底謝（原來陀以與哈大底謝常常爭戰）。約蘭帶了金銀銅的器皿來，
verses.e: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him ; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . Joram brought with him vessels of silver , vessels of gold , and vessels of bronze .

verses.z: 大衛王將這些器皿和他治服各國所得來的金銀都分別為聖，獻給耶和華，
verses.e: King David also dedicated these to the LORD , with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued —

verses.z: 就是從亞蘭、摩押、亞捫、非利士、亞瑪力人所得來的，以及從瑣巴王利合的兒子哈大底謝所掠之物。
verses.e: of Syria , of Moab , of the children of Ammon , of the Philistines , of Amalek , and of the plunder of Hadadezer , son of Rehob , king of Zobah .

verses.z: 大衛在鹽谷擊殺了亞蘭一萬八千人回來，就得了大名；
verses.e: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt .

verses.z: 又在以東全地設立防營，以東人就都歸服大衛。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
verses.e: He put garrisons in Edom . Throughout all Edom , he put garrisons , and all the Edomites became servants to David . The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went .

verses.z: 大衛作以色列眾人的王，又向眾民秉公行義。
verses.e: David reigned over all Israel ; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people .

verses.z: 洗魯雅的兒子約押作元帥；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
verses.e: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army , Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder ,

verses.z: 亞希突的兒子撒督和亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒作祭司[長]；西萊雅作書記；
verses.e: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests , Seraiah was scribe ,

verses.z: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人。大衛的眾子都作領袖。
verses.e: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites ; and David's sons were chief ministers .

verses.z: 又攻打摩押人，使他們躺臥在地上，用繩量一量：量二繩的殺了，量一繩的存留。摩押人就歸服大衛，給他進貢。
verses.e: He defeated Moab , and measured them with the line , making them to lie down on the ground ; and he measured two lines to put to death , and one full line to keep alive . The Moabites became servants to David , and brought tribute .

verses.z: 瑣巴王利合的兒子哈大底謝往大河去，要奪回他的國權。大衛就攻打他，
verses.e: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob , king of Zobah , as he went to recover his dominion at the River .

verses.z: 擒拿了他的馬兵一千七百，步兵二萬，將拉戰車的馬砍斷蹄筋，但留下一百輛車的馬。
verses.e: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen . David hamstrung the chariot horses , but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots .

verses.z: 大馬士革的亞蘭人來幫助瑣巴王哈大底謝，大衛就殺了亞蘭人二萬二千。
verses.e: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah , David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians .

verses.z: 於是大衛在大馬士革的亞蘭地設立防營，亞蘭人就歸服他，給他進貢。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
verses.e: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus ; and the Syrians became servants to David , and brought tribute . The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went .

verses.z: 他奪了哈大底謝臣僕所拿的金盾牌，帶到耶路撒冷。
verses.e: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 大衛王又從屬哈大底謝的比他和比羅他城中奪取了許多的銅。
verses.e: From Betah and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , King David took a great quantity of bronze .

verses.z: 哈馬王陀以聽見大衛殺敗哈大底謝的全軍，
verses.e: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer ,

verses.z: 大衛問說：「掃羅家還有剩下的人沒有？我要因約拿單的緣故向他施恩。」
verses.e: David said , " Is there yet any who is left of Saul's house , that I may show him kindness for Jonathan's sake ? "

verses.z: 你和你的眾子、僕人要為你主人的兒子米非波設耕種田地，把所產的拿來供他食用；他卻要常與我同席吃飯。」洗巴有十五個兒子，二十個僕人。
verses.e: Till the land for him — you , your sons , and your servants . Bring in the harvest , that your master's son may have bread to eat ; but Mephibosheth your master's son will always eat bread at my table . " Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .

verses.z: 洗巴對王說：「凡我主我王吩咐僕人的，僕人都必遵行。」王又說：「米非波設必與我同席吃飯，如王的兒子一樣。」
verses.e: Then Ziba said to the king , " According to all that my lord the king commands his servant , so your servant will do . " So Mephibosheth ate at the king's table like one of the king's sons .

verses.z: 米非波設有一個小兒子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家裏的人都作了米非波設的僕人。
verses.e: Mephibosheth had a young son , whose name was Mica . All who lived in Ziba's house were servants to Mephibosheth .

verses.z: 於是米非波設住在耶路撒冷，常與王同席吃飯。他兩腿都是瘸的。
verses.e: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem , for he ate continually at the king's table . He was lame in both his feet .

verses.z: 掃羅家有一個僕人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他來見大衛，王問他說：「你是洗巴嗎？」回答說：「僕人是。」
verses.e: There was of Saul's house a servant whose name was Ziba , and they called him to David ; and the king said to him , " Are you Ziba ? " He said , " I am your servant . "

verses.z: 王說：「掃羅家還有人沒有？我要照上帝的慈愛恩待他。」洗巴對王說：「還有約拿單的一個兒子，是瘸腿的。」
verses.e: The king said , " Is there not yet any of Saul's house , that I may show the kindness of God to him ? " Ziba said to the king , " Jonathan still has a son , who is lame in his feet . "

verses.z: 王說：「他在哪裏？」洗巴對王說：「他在羅‧底巴，亞米利的兒子瑪吉家裏。」
verses.e: The king said to him , " Where is he ? " Ziba said to the king , " Behold , he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel , in Lo Debar . "

verses.z: 於是大衛王打發人去，從羅‧底巴亞米利的兒子瑪吉家裏召了他來。
verses.e: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel , from Lo Debar .

verses.z: 掃羅的孫子、約拿單的兒子米非波設來見大衛，伏地叩拜。大衛說：「米非波設！」米非波設說：「僕人在此。」
verses.e: Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan , the son of Saul , came to David , fell on his face , and showed respect . David said , " Mephibosheth ? " He answered , " Behold , your servant ! "

verses.z: 大衛說：「你不要懼怕，我必因你父親約拿單的緣故施恩與你，將你祖父掃羅的一切田地都歸還你；你也可以常與我同席吃飯。」
verses.e: David said to him , " Don't be afraid , for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father's sake , and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father . You will eat bread at my table continually . "

verses.z: 米非波設又叩拜，說：「僕人算甚麼，不過如死狗一般，竟蒙王這樣眷顧！」
verses.e: He bowed down , and said , " What is your servant , that you should look at such a dead dog as I am ? "

verses.z: 王召了掃羅的僕人洗巴來，對他說：「我已將屬掃羅和他的一切家產都賜給你主人的兒子了。
verses.e: Then the king called to Ziba , Saul's servant , and said to him , " All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master's son .

verses.z: 保羅、西拉、提摩太寫信給帖撒羅尼迦、在上帝－我們的父與主耶穌基督裏的教會。
verses.e: Paul , Silvanus , and Timothy , to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ :

verses.z: 這正是主降臨、要在他聖徒的身上得榮耀、又在一切信的人身上顯為希奇的那日子。我們對你們作的見證，你們也信了。
verses.e: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed , because our testimony to you was believed .

verses.z: 因此，我們常為你們禱告，願我們的上帝看你們配得過所蒙的召，又用大能成就你們一切所羨慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫，
verses.e: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling , and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power ,

verses.z: 叫我們主耶穌的名在你們身上得榮耀，你們也在他身上得榮耀，都照着我們的上帝並主耶穌基督的恩。
verses.e: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you , and you in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安從父上帝和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
verses.e: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我們該為你們常常感謝上帝，這本是合宜的；因你們的信心格外增長，並且你們眾人彼此相愛的心也都充足。
verses.e: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you , brothers , even as it is appropriate , because your faith grows exceedingly , and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds ,

verses.z: 甚至我們在上帝的各教會裏為你們誇口，都因你們在所受的一切逼迫患難中，仍舊存忍耐和信心。
verses.e: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure .

verses.z: 這正是上帝公義判斷的明證，叫你們可算配得上帝的國；你們就是為這國受苦。
verses.e: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God , to the end that you may be counted worthy of God's Kingdom , for which you also suffer .

verses.z: 上帝既是公義的，就必將患難報應那加患難給你們的人，
verses.e: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you ,

verses.z: 也必使你們這受患難的人與我們同得平安。那時，主耶穌同他有能力的天使從天上在火焰中顯現，
verses.e: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire ,

verses.z: 要報應那不認識上帝和那不聽從我主耶穌福音的人。
verses.e: punishing those who don't know God , and to those who don't obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus ,

verses.z: 他們要受刑罰，就是永遠沉淪，離開主的面和他權能的榮光。
verses.e: who will pay the penalty : eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，論到我們主耶穌基督降臨和我們到他那裏聚集，
verses.e: Now , brothers , concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him , we ask you

verses.z: 並且在那沉淪的人身上行各樣出於不義的詭詐；因他們不領受愛真理的心，使他們得救。
verses.e: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost , because they didn't receive the love of the truth , that they might be saved .

verses.z: 故此，上帝就給他們一個生發錯誤的心，叫他們信從虛謊，
verses.e: Because of this , God sends them a powerful delusion , that they should believe a lie ,

verses.z: 使一切不信真理、倒喜愛不義的人都被定罪。
verses.e: that they all might be judged who didn't believe the truth , but had pleasure in unrighteousness .

verses.z: 主所愛的弟兄們哪，我們本該常為你們感謝上帝；因為他從起初揀選了你們，叫你們因信真道，又被聖靈感動，成為聖潔，能以得救。
verses.e: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you , brothers loved by the Lord , because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth ,

verses.z: 上帝藉我們所傳的福音召你們到這地步，好得着我們主耶穌基督的榮光。
verses.e: to which he called you through our Good News , for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 所以，弟兄們，你們要站立得穩，凡所領受的教訓，不拘是我們口傳的，是信上寫的，都要堅守。
verses.e: So then , brothers , stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us , whether by word or by letter .

verses.z: 但願我們主耶穌基督和那愛我們、開恩將永遠的安慰並美好的盼望賜給我們的父上帝，
verses.e: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself , and God our Father , who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace ,

verses.z: 安慰你們的心，並且在一切善行善言上堅固你們。
verses.e: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word .

verses.z: 我勸你們：無論有靈、有言語、有冒我名的書信，說主的日子現在到了，不要輕易動心，也不要驚慌。
verses.e: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled , either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us , saying that the day of Christ has already come .

verses.z: 人不拘用甚麼法子，你們總不要被他誘惑；因為那日子以前，必有離道反教的事，並有那大罪人，就是沉淪之子，顯露出來。
verses.e: Let no one deceive you in any way . For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first , and the man of sin is revealed , the son of destruction .

verses.z: 他是抵擋主，高抬自己，超過一切稱為神的和一切受人敬拜的，甚至坐在上帝的殿裏，自稱是上帝。
verses.e: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped , so that he sits as God in the temple of God , setting himself up as God .

verses.z: 我還在你們那裏的時候，曾把這些事告訴你們，你們不記得嗎？
verses.e: Don't you remember that when I was still with you , I told you these things ?

verses.z: 現在你們也知道，那攔阻他的是甚麼，是叫他到了的時候才可以顯露。
verses.e: Now you know what is restraining him , to the end that he may be revealed in his own season .

verses.z: 因為那不法的隱意已經發動，只是現在有一個攔阻的，等到那攔阻的被除去，
verses.e: For the mystery of lawlessness already works . Only there is one who restrains now , until he is taken out of the way .

verses.z: 那時這不法的人必顯露出來。主耶穌要用口中的氣滅絕他，用降臨的榮光廢掉他。
verses.e: Then the lawless one will be revealed , whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming ;

verses.z: 這不法的人來，是照撒但的運動，行各樣的異能、神蹟，和一切虛假的奇事，
verses.e: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，我還有話說：請你們為我們禱告，好叫主的道理快快行開，得着榮耀，正如在你們中間一樣，
verses.e: Finally , brothers , pray for us , that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified , even as also with you ,

verses.z: 我們在你們那裏的時候，曾吩咐你們說，若有人不肯做工，就不可吃飯。
verses.e: For even when we were with you , we commanded you this : " If anyone is not willing to work , don't let him eat . "

verses.z: 因我們聽說，在你們中間有人不按規矩而行，甚麼工都不做，反倒專管閒事。
verses.e: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion , who don't work at all , but are busybodies .

verses.z: 我們靠主耶穌基督吩咐、勸戒這樣的人，要安靜做工，吃自己的飯。
verses.e: Now those who are that way , we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ , that they work with quietness and eat their own bread .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們行善不可喪志。
verses.e: But you , brothers , don't be weary in doing what is right .

verses.z: 若有人不聽從我們這信上的話，要記下他，不和他交往，叫他自覺羞愧。
verses.e: If any man doesn't obey our word in this letter , note that man and have no company with him , to the end that he may be ashamed .

verses.z: 但不要以他為仇人，要勸他如弟兄。
verses.e: Don't count him as an enemy , but admonish him as a brother .

verses.z: 願賜平安的主隨時隨事親自給你們平安！願主[常]與你們眾人同在！
verses.e: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways . The Lord be with you all .

verses.z: 我－保羅親筆問你們安。凡我的信都以此為記，我的筆跡就是這樣。
verses.e: I , Paul , write this greeting with my own hand , which is the sign in every letter . This is how I write .

verses.z: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩[常]與你們眾人同在！
verses.e: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .

verses.z: 也叫我們脫離無理之惡人的手；因為人不都是有信心。
verses.e: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men ; for not all have faith .

verses.z: 但主是信實的，要堅固你們，保護你們脫離那惡者。
verses.e: But the Lord is faithful , who will establish you and guard you from the evil one .

verses.z: 我們靠主深信，你們現在是遵行我們所吩咐的，後來也必要遵行。
verses.e: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you , that you both do and will do the things we command .

verses.z: 願主引導你們的心，叫你們愛上帝，並學基督的忍耐！
verses.e: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and into the perseverance of Christ .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我們奉主耶穌基督的名吩咐你們，凡有弟兄不按規矩而行，不遵守從我們所受的教訓，就當遠離他。
verses.e: Now we command you , brothers , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us .

verses.z: 你們自己原知道應當怎樣效法我們。因為我們在你們中間，未嘗不按規矩而行，
verses.e: For you know how you ought to imitate us . For we didn't behave ourselves rebelliously among you ,

verses.z: 也未嘗白吃人的飯，倒是辛苦勞碌，晝夜做工，免得叫你們一人受累。
verses.e: neither did we eat bread from anyone's hand without paying for it , but in labor and travail worked night and day , that we might not burden any of you .

verses.z: 這並不是因我們沒有權柄，乃是要給你們作榜樣，叫你們效法我們。
verses.e: This was not because we don't have the right , but to make ourselves an example to you , that you should imitate us .

verses.z: 奉上帝旨意，照着在基督耶穌裏生命的應許，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅
verses.e: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God , according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 但如今藉着我們救主基督耶穌的顯現才表明出來了。他已經把死廢去，藉着福音，將不能壞的生命彰顯出來。
verses.e: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior , Christ Jesus , who abolished death , and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News .

verses.z: 我為這福音奉派作傳道的，作使徒，作師傅。
verses.e: For this I was appointed as a preacher , an apostle , and a teacher of the Gentiles .

verses.z: 為這緣故，我也受這些苦難。然而我不以為恥；因為知道我所信的是誰，也深信他能保全我所交付他的，直到那日。
verses.e: For this cause I also suffer these things . Yet I am not ashamed , for I know him whom I have believed , and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day .

verses.z: 你從我聽的那純正話語的規模，要用在基督耶穌裏的信心和愛心，常常守着。
verses.e: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me , in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 從前所交託你的善道，你要靠着那住在我們裏面的聖靈牢牢地守着。
verses.e: That good thing which was committed to you , guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us .

verses.z: 凡在亞細亞的人都離棄我，這是你知道的，其中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
verses.e: This you know , that all who are in Asia turned away from me , of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes .

verses.z: 願主憐憫阿尼色弗一家的人；因他屢次使我暢快，不以我的鎖鍊為恥，
verses.e: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus , for he often refreshed me , and was not ashamed of my chain ,

verses.z: 反倒在羅馬的時候，殷勤地找我，並且找着了。
verses.e: but when he was in Rome , he sought me diligently and found me

verses.z: 願主使他在那日得主的憐憫。他在以弗所怎樣多多地服事我，是你明明知道的。
verses.e: ( the Lord grant to him to find the Lord's mercy in that day ) ; and in how many things he served at Ephesus , you know very well .

verses.z: 寫信給我親愛的兒子提摩太。願恩惠、憐憫、平安從父上帝和我們主基督耶穌歸與你！
verses.e: to Timothy , my beloved child : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .

verses.z: 我感謝上帝，就是我接續祖先用清潔的良心所事奉的上帝。祈禱的時候，不住的想念你，
verses.e: I thank God , whom I serve as my forefathers did , with a pure conscience . How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions , night and day

verses.z: 記念你的眼淚，晝夜切切地想要見你，好叫我滿心快樂。
verses.e: longing to see you , remembering your tears , that I may be filled with joy ;

verses.z: 想到你心裏無偽之信，這信是先在你外祖母羅以和你母親友妮基心裏的，我深信也在你的心裏。
verses.e: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you , which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and , I am persuaded , in you also .

verses.z: 為此我提醒你，使你將上帝藉我按手所給你的恩賜再如火挑旺起來。
verses.e: For this cause , I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands .

verses.z: 因為上帝賜給我們，不是膽怯的心，乃是剛強、仁愛、謹守的心。
verses.e: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear , but of power , love , and self-control .

verses.z: 你不要以給我們的主作見證為恥，也不要以我這為主被囚的為恥；總要按上帝的能力，與我為福音同受苦難。
verses.e: Therefore don't be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord , nor of me his prisoner ; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God ,

verses.z: 上帝救了我們，以聖召召我們，不是按我們的行為，乃是按他的旨意和恩典；這恩典是萬古之先，在基督耶穌裏賜給我們的，
verses.e: who saved us and called us with a holy calling , not according to our works , but according to his own purpose and grace , which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal ,

verses.z: 我兒啊，你要在基督耶穌的恩典上剛強起來。
verses.e: You therefore , my child , be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 所以，我為選民凡事忍耐，叫他們也可以得着那在基督耶穌裏的救恩和永遠的榮耀。
verses.e: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones ' sake , that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory .

verses.z: 有可信的話說：我們若與基督同死，也必與他同活；
verses.e: This saying is trustworthy : " For if we died with him , we will also live with him .

verses.z: 我們若[能]忍耐，也必和他一同作王。我們若不認他，他也必不認我們；
verses.e: If we endure , we will also reign with him . If we deny him , he also will deny us .

verses.z: 我們縱然失信，他仍是可信的，因為他不能背乎自己。
verses.e: If we are faithless , he remains faithful ; for he can't deny himself . "

verses.z: 你要使眾人回想這些事，在主面前囑咐他們：不可為言語爭辯；這是沒有益處的，只能敗壞聽見的人。
verses.e: Remind them of these things , charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don't argue about words to no profit , to the subverting of those who hear .

verses.z: 你當竭力在上帝面前得蒙喜悅，作無愧的工人，按着正意分解真理的道。
verses.e: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God , a workman who doesn't need to be ashamed , properly handling the Word of Truth .

verses.z: 但要遠避世俗的虛談，因為這等人必進到更不敬虔的地步。
verses.e: But shun empty chatter , for it will go further in ungodliness ,

verses.z: 他們的話如同毒瘡，越爛越大；其中有許米乃和腓理徒，
verses.e: and those words will consume like gangrene , of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus :

verses.z: 他們偏離了真道，說復活的事已過，就敗壞好些人的信心。
verses.e: men who have erred concerning the truth , saying that the resurrection is already past , and overthrowing the faith of some .

verses.z: 然而，上帝堅固的根基立住了；上面有這印記說：「主認識誰是他的人」；又說：「凡稱呼主名的人總要離開不義。」
verses.e: However , God's firm foundation stands , having this seal : " The Lord knows those who are his , " and , " Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness . "

verses.z: 你在許多見證人面前聽見我所教訓的，也要交託那忠心能教導別人的人。
verses.e: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses , commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also .

verses.z: 在大戶人家，不但有金器銀器，也有木器瓦器；有作為貴重的，有作為卑賤的。
verses.e: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver , but also of wood and of clay . Some are for honor and some for dishonor .

verses.z: 人若自潔，脫離卑賤的事，就必作貴重的器皿，成為聖潔，合乎主用，預備行各樣的善事。
verses.e: If anyone therefore purges himself from these , he will be a vessel for honor , sanctified , and suitable for the master's use , prepared for every good work .

verses.z: 你要逃避少年的私慾，同那清心禱告主的人追求公義、信德、仁愛、和平。
verses.e: Flee from youthful lusts ; but pursue righteousness , faith , love , and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart .

verses.z: 惟有那愚拙無學問的辯論，總要棄絕，因為知道這等事是起爭競的。
verses.e: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings , knowing that they generate strife .

verses.z: 然而主的僕人不可爭競，只要溫溫和和地待眾人，善於教導，存心忍耐，
verses.e: The Lord's servant must not quarrel , but be gentle toward all , able to teach , patient ,

verses.z: 用溫柔勸戒那抵擋的人；或者上帝給他們悔改的心，可以明白真道，
verses.e: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him . Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth ,

verses.z: 叫他們這已經被魔鬼任意擄去的，可以醒悟，脫離他的網羅。
verses.e: and they may recover themselves out of the devil's snare , having been taken captive by him to do his will .

verses.z: 你要和[我]同受苦難，好像基督耶穌的精兵。
verses.e: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 凡在軍中當兵的，不將世務纏身，好叫那招他當兵的人喜悅。
verses.e: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life , that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier .

verses.z: 人若在場上比武，非按規矩，就不能得冠冕。
verses.e: Also , if anyone competes in athletics , he isn't crowned unless he has competed by the rules .

verses.z: 勞力的農夫理當先得糧食。
verses.e: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops .

verses.z: 我所說的話，你要思想，因為凡事主必給你聰明。
verses.e: Consider what I say , and may the Lord give you understanding in all things .

verses.z: 你要記念耶穌基督乃是大衛的後裔，他從死裏復活，正合乎我所傳的福音。
verses.e: Remember Jesus Christ , risen from the dead , of the offspring of David , according to my Good News ,

verses.z: 我為這福音受苦難，甚至被捆綁，像犯人一樣。然而上帝的道卻不被捆綁。
verses.e: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal . But God's word isn't chained .

verses.z: 你該知道，末世必有危險的日子來到。
verses.e: But know this : that in the last days , grievous times will come .

verses.z: 但你已經服從了我的教訓、品行、志向、信心、寬容、愛心、忍耐，
verses.e: But you followed my teaching , conduct , purpose , faith , patience , love , steadfastness ,

verses.z: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的逼迫、苦難。我所忍受是何等的逼迫；但從這一切苦難中，主都把我救出來了。
verses.e: persecutions , and sufferings — those things that happened to me at Antioch , Iconium , and Lystra . I endured those persecutions . The Lord delivered me out of them all .

verses.z: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶穌裏敬虔度日的也都要受逼迫。
verses.e: Yes , and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution .

verses.z: 只是作惡的和迷惑人的，必越久越惡，他欺哄人，也被人欺哄。
verses.e: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse , deceiving and being deceived .

verses.z: 但你所學習的，所確信的，要存在心裏；因為你知道是跟誰學的，
verses.e: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of , knowing from whom you have learned them .

verses.z: 並且知道你是從小明白聖經，這聖經能使你因信基督耶穌，有得救的智慧。
verses.e: From infancy , you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 聖經都是上帝所默示的，於教訓、督責、使人歸正、教導人學義都是有益的，
verses.e: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching , for reproof , for correction , and for instruction in righteousness ,

verses.z: 叫屬上帝的人得以完全，預備行各樣的善事。
verses.e: that each person who belongs to God may be complete , thoroughly equipped for every good work .

verses.z: 因為那時，人要專顧自己，貪愛錢財，自誇，狂傲，謗讟，違背父母，忘恩負義，心不聖潔，
verses.e: For men will be lovers of self , lovers of money , boastful , arrogant , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,

verses.z: 無親情，不解怨，好說讒言，不能自約，性情凶暴，不愛良善，
verses.e: without natural affection , unforgiving , slanderers , without self-control , fierce , not lovers of good ,

verses.z: 賣主賣友，任意妄為，自高自大，愛宴樂，不愛上帝，
verses.e: traitors , headstrong , conceited , lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God ,

verses.z: 有敬虔的外貌，卻背了敬虔的實意；這等人你要躲開。
verses.e: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power . Turn away from these , also .

verses.z: 那偷進人家、牢籠無知婦女的，正是這等人。這些婦女擔負罪惡，被各樣的私慾引誘，
verses.e: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins , led away by various lusts ,

verses.z: 常常學習，終久不能明白真道。
verses.e: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth .

verses.z: 從前雅尼和佯庇怎樣敵擋摩西，這等人也怎樣敵擋真道。他們的心地壞了，在真道上是可廢棄的。
verses.e: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses , so these also oppose the truth , men corrupted in mind , who concerning the faith are rejected .

verses.z: 然而他們不能再這樣敵擋；因為他們的愚昧必在眾人面前顯露出來，像那二人一樣。
verses.e: But they will proceed no further . For their folly will be evident to all men , as theirs also came to be .

verses.z: 我在上帝面前，並在將來審判活人死人的基督耶穌面前，憑着他的顯現和他的國度囑咐你：
verses.e: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ , who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom :

verses.z: 因為底馬貪愛現今的世界，就離棄我往帖撒羅尼迦去了；革勒士往加拉太去；提多往撻馬太去；
verses.e: for Demas left me , having loved this present world , and went to Thessalonica ; Crescens to Galatia ; and Titus to Dalmatia .

verses.z: 獨有路加在我這裏。你來的時候，要把馬可帶來，因為他在傳道的事上於我有益處。
verses.e: Only Luke is with me . Take Mark and bring him with you , for he is useful to me for service .

verses.z: 我已經打發推基古往以弗所去。
verses.e: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus .

verses.z: 我在特羅亞留於加布的那件外衣，你來的時候可以帶來，那些書也要帶來，更要緊的是那些皮卷。
verses.e: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come — and the books , especially the parchments .

verses.z: 銅匠亞歷山大多多地害我；主必照他所行的報應他。
verses.e: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me . The Lord will repay him according to his deeds .

verses.z: 你也要防備他，因為他極力敵擋了我們的話。
verses.e: Beware of him , for he greatly opposed our words .

verses.z: 我初次申訴，沒有人前來幫助，竟都離棄我；但願這罪不歸與他們。
verses.e: At my first defense , no one came to help me , but all left me . May it not be held against them .

verses.z: 惟有主站在我旁邊，加給我力量，使福音被我盡都傳明，叫外邦人都聽見；我也從獅子口裏被救出來。
verses.e: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me , that through me the message might be fully proclaimed , and that all the Gentiles might hear . So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .

verses.z: 主必救我脫離諸般的凶惡，也必救我進他的天國。願榮耀歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
verses.e: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom . To him be the glory forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 問百基拉、亞居拉，和阿尼色弗一家的人安。
verses.e: Greet Prisca and Aquila , and the house of Onesiphorus .

verses.z: 務要傳道，無論得時不得時，總要專心，並用百般的忍耐、各樣的教訓責備人，警戒人，勸勉人。
verses.e: preach the word ; be urgent in season and out of season ; reprove , rebuke , and exhort with all patience and teaching .

verses.z: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特羅非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
verses.e: Erastus remained at Corinth , but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick .

verses.z: 你要趕緊在冬天以前到我這裏來。有友布羅、布田、利奴、革老底亞，和眾弟兄都問你安。
verses.e: Be diligent to come before winter . Eubulus salutes you , as do Pudens , Linus , Claudia , and all the brothers .

verses.z: 願主與你的靈同在！願恩惠[常]與你們同在！
verses.e: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Grace be with you . Amen .

verses.z: 因為時候要到，人必厭煩純正的道理，耳朵發癢，就隨從自己的情慾增添好些師傅，
verses.e: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine , but having itching ears , will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts ,

verses.z: 並且掩耳不聽真道，偏向荒渺的言語。
verses.e: and will turn away their ears from the truth , and turn away to fables .

verses.z: 你卻要凡事謹慎，忍受苦難，做傳道的工夫，盡你的職分。
verses.e: But you be sober in all things , suffer hardship , do the work of an evangelist , and fulfill your ministry .

verses.z: 我現在被澆奠，我離世的時候到了。
verses.e: For I am already being offered , and the time of my departure has come .

verses.z: 那美好的仗我已經打過了，當跑的路我已經跑盡了，所信的道我已經守住了。
verses.e: I have fought the good fight . I have finished the course . I have kept the faith .

verses.z: 從此以後，有公義的冠冕為我存留，就是按着公義審判的主到了那日要賜給我的；不但賜給我，也賜給凡愛慕他顯現的人。
verses.e: From now on , the crown of righteousness is stored up for me , which the Lord , the righteous judge , will give to me on that day ; and not to me only , but also to all those who have loved his appearing .

verses.z: 你要趕緊地到我這裏來。
verses.e: Be diligent to come to me soon ,

verses.z: 作長老的寫信給親愛的該猶，就是我誠心所愛的。
verses.e: The elder to Gaius the beloved , whom I love in truth .

verses.z: 所以我若去，必要提說他所行的事，就是他用惡言妄論我們。還不以此為足，他自己不接待弟兄，有人願意接待，他也禁止，並且將接待弟兄的人趕出教會。
verses.e: Therefore , if I come , I will call attention to his deeds which he does , unjustly accusing us with wicked words . Not content with this , he doesn't receive the brothers himself , and those who would , he forbids and throws out of the assembly .

verses.z: 親愛的[兄弟]啊，不要效法惡，只要效法善。行善的屬乎上帝；行惡的未曾見過上帝。
verses.e: Beloved , don't imitate that which is evil , but that which is good . He who does good is of God . He who does evil hasn't seen God .

verses.z: 低米丟[行善]，有眾人給他作見證，又有真理給他作見證，就是我們也給他作見證。你也知道我們的見證是真的。
verses.e: Demetrius has the testimony of all , and of the truth itself ; yes , we also testify , and you know that our testimony is true .

verses.z: 我原有許多事要寫給你，卻不願意用筆墨寫給你，
verses.e: I had many things to write to you , but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen ;

verses.z: 但盼望快快地見你，我們就當面談論。
verses.e: but I hope to see you soon . Then we will speak face to face . Peace be to you . The friends greet you . Greet the friends by name .

verses.z: 願你平安。眾位朋友都問你安。請你替我按着姓名問眾位朋友安。
親愛的[兄弟]啊，我願你凡事興盛，身體健壯，正如你的靈魂興盛一樣。
verses.e: Beloved , I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy , even as your soul prospers .

verses.z: 有弟兄來證明你心裏存的真理，正如你按真理而行，我就甚喜樂。
verses.e: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth , even as you walk in truth .

verses.z: 我聽見我的兒女們按真理而行，我的喜樂就沒有比這個大的。
verses.e: I have no greater joy than this : to hear about my children walking in truth .

verses.z: 親愛的[兄弟]啊，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的都是忠心的。
verses.e: Beloved , you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers .

verses.z: 他們在教會面前證明了你的愛；你若配得過上帝，幫助他們往前行，這就好了。
verses.e: They have testified about your love before the assembly . You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God ,

verses.z: 因他們是為主的名出外，對於外邦人一無所取。
verses.e: because for the sake of the Name they went out , taking nothing from the Gentiles .

verses.z: 所以我們應該接待這樣的人，叫我們與他們一同為真理做工。
verses.e: We therefore ought to receive such , that we may be fellow workers for the truth .

verses.z: 我曾略略地寫信給教會，但那在教會中好為首的丟特腓不接待我們。
verses.e: I wrote to the assembly , but Diotrephes , who loves to be first among them , doesn't accept what we say .

verses.z: 提阿非羅啊，我已經作了前書，論到耶穌開頭一切所行所教訓的，
verses.e: The first book I wrote , Theophilus , concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach ,

verses.z: 當他往上去，他們定睛望天的時候，忽然有兩個人身穿白衣，站在旁邊，說：
verses.e: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went , behold , two men stood by them in white clothing ,

verses.z: 「加利利人哪，你們為甚麼站着望天呢？這離開你們被接升天的耶穌，你們見他怎樣往天上去，他還要怎樣來。」
verses.e: who also said , " You men of Galilee , why do you stand looking into the sky ? This Jesus , who was received up from you into the sky , will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky . "

verses.z: 有一座山，名叫橄欖山，離耶路撒冷不遠，約有安息日可走的路程。當下，門徒從那裏回耶路撒冷去，
verses.e: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet , which is near Jerusalem , a Sabbath day's journey away .

verses.z: 進了城，就上了所住的一間樓房；在那裏有彼得、約翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多馬、巴多羅買、馬太、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、奮銳黨的西門，和雅各的兒子猶大。
verses.e: When they had come in , they went up into the upper room where they were staying , that is Peter , John , James , Andrew , Philip , Thomas , Bartholomew , Matthew , James the son of Alphaeus , Simon the Zealot , and Judas the son of James .

verses.z: 這些人同着幾個婦人和耶穌的母親馬利亞，並耶穌的弟兄，都同心合意地恆切禱告。
verses.e: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication , along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus , and with his brothers .

verses.z: 那時，有許多人[聚會]，約有一百二十名，彼得就在弟兄中間站起來，
verses.e: In these days , Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples ( and the number of names was about one hundred twenty ) , and said ,

verses.z: 說：「弟兄們！聖靈藉大衛的口，在聖經上預言領人捉拿耶穌的猶大，這話是必須應驗的。
verses.e: " Brothers , it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled , which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas , who was guide to those who took Jesus .

verses.z: 他本來列在我們數中，並且在[使徒的]職任上得了一分。
verses.e: For he was counted with us , and received his portion in this ministry .

verses.z: 這人用他作惡的工價買了一塊田，以後身子仆倒，肚腹崩裂，腸子都流出來。
verses.e: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness ; and falling headlong , his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out .

verses.z: 住在耶路撒冷的眾人都知道這事，所以按着他們那裏的話給那塊田起名叫亞革大馬，就是「血田」的意思。
verses.e: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ' Akeldama , ' that is , ' The field of blood . '

verses.z: 直到他藉着聖靈吩咐所揀選的使徒，以後被接上升的日子為止。
verses.e: until the day in which he was received up , after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen .

verses.z: 因為詩篇上寫着，說：願他的住處變為荒場，無人在內居住；又說：願別人得他的職分。
verses.e: For it is written in the book of Psalms , ' Let his habitation be made desolate . Let no one dwell in it ; ' and , ' Let another take his office . '

verses.z: 所以，主耶穌在我們中間始終出入的時候，
verses.e: " Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us ,

verses.z: 就是從約翰施洗起，直到主離開我們被接上升的日子為止，必須從那常與我們作伴的人中立一位與我們同作耶穌復活的見證。」
verses.e: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us , of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection . "

verses.z: 於是選舉兩個人，就是那叫做巴撒巴，又稱呼猶士都的約瑟，和馬提亞。
verses.e: They put forward two : Joseph called Barsabbas , who was also called Justus , and Matthias .

verses.z: 眾人就禱告說：「主啊，你知道萬人的心，求你從這兩個人中，指明你所揀選的是誰，叫他得這使徒的位分。這位分猶大已經丟棄，往自己的地方去了。」
verses.e: They prayed and said , " You , Lord , who know the hearts of all men , show which one of these two you have chosen
to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away , that he might go to his own place . "

verses.z: 於是眾人為他們搖籤，搖出馬提亞來；他就和十一個使徒同列。
verses.e: They drew lots for them , and the lot fell on Matthias ; and he was counted with the eleven apostles .

verses.z: 他受害之後，用許多的憑據將自己活活地顯給使徒看，四十天之久向他們顯現，講說上帝國的事。
verses.e: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered , by many proofs , appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 耶穌和他們聚集的時候，囑咐他們說：「不要離開耶路撒冷，要等候父所應許的，就是你們聽見我說過的。
verses.e: Being assembled together with them , he commanded them , " Don't depart from Jerusalem , but wait for the promise of the Father , which you heard from me .

verses.z: 約翰是用水施洗，但不多幾日，你們要受聖靈的洗。」
verses.e: For John indeed baptized in water , but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now . "

verses.z: 他們聚集的時候，問耶穌說：「主啊，你復興以色列國就在這時候嗎？」
verses.e: Therefore , when they had come together , they asked him , " Lord , are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「父憑着自己的權柄所定的時候、日期，不是你們可以知道的。
verses.e: He said to them , " It isn't for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority .

verses.z: 但聖靈降臨在你們身上，你們就必得着能力，並要在耶路撒冷、猶太全地，和撒馬利亞，直到地極，作我的見證。」
verses.e: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you . You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem , in all Judea and Samaria , and to the uttermost parts of the earth . "

verses.z: 說了這話，他們正看的時候，他就被取上升，有一朵雲彩把他接去，便看不見他了。
verses.e: When he had said these things , as they were looking , he was taken up , and a cloud received him out of their sight .

verses.z: 在凱撒利亞有一個人，名叫哥尼流，是「意大利營」的百夫長。
verses.e: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea , Cornelius by name , a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment ,

verses.z: 覺得餓了，想要吃。那家的人正預備飯的時候，彼得魂遊象外，
verses.e: He became hungry and desired to eat , but while they were preparing , he fell into a trance .

verses.z: 看見天開了，有一物降下，好像一塊大布，繫着四角，縋在地上，
verses.e: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him , like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth ,

verses.z: 裏面有地上各樣四足的走獸和昆蟲，並天上的飛鳥；
verses.e: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth , wild animals , reptiles , and birds of the sky .

verses.z: 又有聲音向他說：「彼得，起來，宰了吃！」
verses.e: A voice came to him , " Rise , Peter , kill and eat ! "

verses.z: 彼得卻說：「主啊，這是不可的！凡俗物和不潔淨的物，我從來沒有吃過。」
verses.e: But Peter said , " Not so , Lord ; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean . "

verses.z: 第二次有聲音向他說：「上帝所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。」
verses.e: A voice came to him again the second time , " What God has cleansed , you must not call unclean . "

verses.z: 這樣一連三次，那物隨即收回天上去了。
verses.e: This was done three times , and immediately the thing was received up into heaven .

verses.z: 彼得心裏正在猜疑之間，不知所看見的異象是甚麼意思。哥尼流所差來的人已經訪問到西門的家，站在門外，
verses.e: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean , behold , the men who were sent by Cornelius , having made inquiry for Simon's house , stood before the gate ,

verses.z: 喊着問：「有稱呼彼得的西門住在這裏沒有？」
verses.e: and called and asked whether Simon , who was also called Peter , was lodging there .

verses.z: 彼得還思想那異象的時候，[聖]靈向他說：「有三個人來找你。
verses.e: While Peter was pondering the vision , the Spirit said to him , " Behold , three men seek you .

verses.z: 他是個虔誠人，他和全家都敬畏上帝，多多賙濟百姓，常常禱告上帝。
verses.e: a devout man , and one who feared God with all his house , who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people , and always prayed to God .

verses.z: 起來，下去，和他們同往，不要疑惑，因為是我差他們來的。」
verses.e: But arise , get down , and go with them , doubting nothing ; for I have sent them . "

verses.z: 於是彼得下去見那些人，說：「我就是你們所找的人。你們來是為甚麼緣故？」
verses.e: Peter went down to the men , and said , " Behold , I am he whom you seek . Why have you come ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「百夫長哥尼流是個義人，敬畏上帝，為猶太通國所稱讚。他蒙一位聖天使指示，叫他請你到他家裏去，聽你的話。」
verses.e: They said , " Cornelius , a centurion , a righteous man and one who fears God , and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews , was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house , and to listen to what you say . "

verses.z: 彼得就請他們進去，住了一宿。次日，起身和他們同去，還有約帕的幾個弟兄同着他去；
verses.e: So he called them in and provided a place to stay . On the next day Peter arose and went out with them , and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him .

verses.z: 又次日，他們進入凱撒利亞，哥尼流已經請了他的親屬密友等候他們。
verses.e: On the next day they entered into Caesarea . Cornelius was waiting for them , having called together his relatives and his near friends .

verses.z: 彼得一進去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他腳前拜他。
verses.e: When Peter entered , Cornelius met him , fell down at his feet , and worshiped him .

verses.z: 彼得卻拉他，說：「你起來，我也是人。」
verses.e: But Peter raised him up , saying , " Stand up ! I myself am also a man . "

verses.z: 彼得和他說着話進去，見有好些人在那裏聚集，
verses.e: As he talked with him , he went in and found many gathered together .

verses.z: 就對他們說：「你們知道，猶太人和別國的人親近來往本是不合例的，但上帝已經指示我，無論甚麼人都不可看作俗而不潔淨的。
verses.e: He said to them , " You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation , but God has shown me that I shouldn't call any man unholy or unclean .

verses.z: 所以我被請的時候，就不推辭而來。現在請問：你們叫我來有甚麼意思呢？」
verses.e: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for . I ask therefore , why did you send for me ? "

verses.z: 有一天，約在申初，他在異象中明明看見上帝的一個使者進去，到他那裏，說：「哥尼流。」
verses.e: At about the ninth hour of the day , he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him , " Cornelius ! "

verses.z: 哥尼流說：「前四天，這個時候，我在家中守着申初的禱告，忽然有一個人穿着光明的衣裳，站在我面前，
verses.e: Cornelius said , " Four days ago , I was fasting until this hour ; and at the ninth hour , I prayed in my house , and behold , a man stood before me in bright clothing

verses.z: 說：『哥尼流，你的禱告已蒙垂聽，你的賙濟達到上帝面前已蒙記念了。
verses.e: and said , ' Cornelius , your prayer is heard , and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God .

verses.z: 你當打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來，他住在海邊一個硝皮匠西門的家裏。』
verses.e: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon , who is also called Peter . He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon , by the seaside . When he comes , he will speak to you . '

verses.z: 所以我立時打發人去請你。你來了很好；現今我們都在上帝面前，要聽主所吩咐你的一切話。」
verses.e: Therefore I sent to you at once , and it was good of you to come . Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God . "

verses.z: 彼得就開口說：「我真看出上帝是不偏待人。
verses.e: Peter opened his mouth and said , " Truly I perceive that God doesn't show favoritism ;

verses.z: 原來，各國中那敬畏主、行義的人都為主所悅納。
verses.e: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him .

verses.z: 上帝藉着耶穌基督（他是萬有的主）傳和平的福音，將這道賜給以色列人。
verses.e: The word which he sent to the children of Israel , preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ — he is Lord of all —

verses.z: 這話在約翰宣傳洗禮以後，從加利利起，傳遍了猶太。
verses.e: you yourselves know what happened , which was proclaimed throughout all Judea , beginning from Galilee , after the baptism which John preached ;

verses.z: 上帝怎樣以聖靈和能力膏拿撒勒人耶穌，這都是你們知道的。他周流四方，行善事，醫好凡被魔鬼壓制的人，因為上帝與他同在。
verses.e: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power , who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil , for God was with him .

verses.z: 他在猶太人之地，並耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我們作見證。他們竟把他掛在木頭上殺了。
verses.e: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem ; whom they also killed , hanging him on a tree .

verses.z: 哥尼流定睛看他，驚怕說：「主啊，甚麼事呢？」天使說：「你的禱告和你的賙濟達到上帝面前，已蒙記念了。
verses.e: He , fastening his eyes on him and being frightened , said , " What is it , Lord ? " He said to him , " Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God .

verses.z: 第三日，上帝叫他復活，顯現出來；
verses.e: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed ,

verses.z: 不是顯現給眾人看，乃是顯現給上帝預先所揀選為他作見證的人看，就是我們這些在他從死裏復活以後和他同吃同喝的人。
verses.e: not to all the people , but to witnesses who were chosen before by God , to us , who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead .

verses.z: 他吩咐我們傳道給眾人，證明他是上帝所立定的，要作審判活人、死人的主。
verses.e: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead .

verses.z: 眾先知也為他作見證說：『凡信他的人必因他的名得蒙赦罪。』」
verses.e: All the prophets testify about him , that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins . "

verses.z: 彼得還說這話的時候，聖靈降在一切聽道的人身上。
verses.e: While Peter was still speaking these words , the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word .

verses.z: 那些奉割禮、和彼得同來的信徒，見聖靈的恩賜也澆在外邦人身上，就都希奇；
verses.e: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed , as many as came with Peter , because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles .

verses.z: 因聽見他們說方言，稱讚上帝為大。
verses.e: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God . Then Peter answered ,

verses.z: 於是彼得說：「這些人既受了聖靈，與我們一樣，誰能禁止用水給他們施洗呢？」
verses.e: " Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water ? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us . "

verses.z: 就吩咐奉耶穌基督的名給他們施洗。他們又請彼得住了幾天。
verses.e: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ . Then they asked him to stay some days .

verses.z: 現在你當打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來。
verses.e: Now send men to Joppa , and get Simon , who is also called Peter .

verses.z: 他住在海邊一個硝皮匠西門的家裏，房子在海邊上。」
verses.e: He is staying with a tanner named Simon , whose house is by the seaside .

verses.z: 向他說話的天使去後，哥尼流叫了兩個家人和常伺候他的一個虔誠兵來，
verses.e: When the angel who spoke to him had departed , Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually .

verses.z: 把這事都述說給他們聽，就打發他們往約帕去。
verses.e: Having explained everything to them , he sent them to Joppa .

verses.z: 第二天，他們行路將近那城。彼得約在午正，上房頂去禱告，
verses.e: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city , Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon .

verses.z: 使徒和在猶太的眾弟兄聽說外邦人也領受了上帝的道。
verses.e: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .

verses.z: 這樣一連三次，就都收回天上去了。
verses.e: This was done three times , and all were drawn up again into heaven .

verses.z: 正當那時，有三個人站在我們所住的房門前，是從凱撒利亞差來見我的。
verses.e: Behold , immediately three men stood before the house where I was , having been sent from Caesarea to me .

verses.z: 聖靈吩咐我和他們同去，不要疑惑。同着我去的，還有這六位弟兄，我們都進了那人的家。
verses.e: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating . These six brothers also accompanied me , and we entered into the man's house .

verses.z: 那人就告訴我們，他如何看見一位天使站在他屋裏，說：『你打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來，
verses.e: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him , ' Send to Joppa and get Simon , who is called Peter ,

verses.z: 他有話告訴你，可以叫你和你的全家得救。』
verses.e: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved , you and all your house . '

verses.z: 我一開講，聖靈便降在他們身上，正像當初降在我們身上一樣。
verses.e: As I began to speak , the Holy Spirit fell on them , even as on us at the beginning .

verses.z: 我就想起主的話說：『約翰是用水施洗，但你們要受聖靈的洗。』
verses.e: I remembered the word of the Lord , how he said , ' John indeed baptized in water , but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit . '

verses.z: 上帝既然給他們恩賜，像在我們信主耶穌基督的時候給了我們一樣；我是誰，能攔阻上帝呢？」
verses.e: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ , who was I , that I could withstand God ? "

verses.z: 眾人聽見這話，就不言語了，只歸榮耀與上帝，說：「這樣看來，上帝也賜恩給外邦人，叫他們悔改得生命了。」
verses.e: When they heard these things , they held their peace and glorified God , saying , " Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life ! "

verses.z: 那些因司提反的事遭患難四散的門徒直走到腓尼基和塞浦路斯，並安提阿；他們不向別人講道，只向猶太人講。
verses.e: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia , Cyprus , and Antioch , speaking the word to no one except to Jews only .

verses.z: 及至彼得上了耶路撒冷，那些奉割禮的門徒和他爭辯說：
verses.e: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem , those who were of the circumcision contended with him ,

verses.z: 但內中有塞浦路斯和古利奈人，他們到了安提阿也向希臘人傳講主耶穌。
verses.e: But there were some of them , men of Cyprus and Cyrene , who , when they had come to Antioch , spoke to the Hellenists , preaching the Lord Jesus .

verses.z: 主與他們同在，信而歸主的人就很多了。
verses.e: The hand of the Lord was with them , and a great number believed and turned to the Lord .

verses.z: 這風聲傳到耶路撒冷教會人的耳中，他們就打發巴拿巴出去，走到安提阿為止。
verses.e: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem . They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch ,

verses.z: 他到了那裏，看見上帝所賜的恩就歡喜，勸勉眾人，立定心志，恆久靠主。
verses.e: who , when he had come , and had seen the grace of God , was glad . He exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord .

verses.z: 這巴拿巴原是個好人，被聖靈充滿，大有信心。於是有許多人歸服了主。
verses.e: For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith , and many people were added to the Lord .

verses.z: 他又往大數去找掃羅，
verses.e: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul .

verses.z: 找着了，就帶他到安提阿去。他們足有一年的工夫和教會一同聚集，教訓了許多人。門徒稱為「基督徒」是從安提阿起首。
verses.e: When he had found him , he brought him to Antioch . For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly , and taught many people . The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch .

verses.z: 當那些日子，有幾位先知從耶路撒冷下到安提阿。
verses.e: Now in these days , prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch .

verses.z: 內中有一位，名叫亞迦布，站起來，藉着[聖]靈指明天下將有大饑荒。（這事到克勞第年間果然有了。）
verses.e: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world , which also happened in the days of Claudius .

verses.z: 於是門徒定意照各人的力量捐錢，送去供給住在猶太的弟兄。
verses.e: As any of the disciples had plenty , each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea ;

verses.z: 「你進入未受割禮之人的家和他們一同吃飯了。」
verses.e: saying , " You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them ! "

verses.z: 他們就這樣行，把捐項託巴拿巴和掃羅送到眾長老那裏。
verses.e: which they also did , sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul .

verses.z: 彼得就開口把這事挨次給他們講解說：
verses.e: But Peter began , and explained to them in order , saying ,

verses.z: 「我在約帕城裏禱告的時候，魂遊象外，看見異象，有一物降下，好像一塊大布，繫着四角，從天縋下，直來到我跟前。
verses.e: " I was in the city of Joppa praying , and in a trance I saw a vision : a certain container descending , like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners . It came as far as me .

verses.z: 我定睛觀看，見內中有地上四足的牲畜和野獸、昆蟲，並天上的飛鳥。
verses.e: When I had looked intently at it , I considered , and saw the four-footed animals of the earth , wild animals , creeping things , and birds of the sky .

verses.z: 我且聽見有聲音向我說：『彼得，起來，宰了吃！』
verses.e: I also heard a voice saying to me , ' Rise , Peter , kill and eat ! '

verses.z: 我說：『主啊，這是不可的！凡俗而不潔淨的物從來沒有入過我的口。』
verses.e: But I said , ' Not so , Lord , for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth . '

verses.z: 第二次，有聲音從天上說：『上帝所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。』
verses.e: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven , ' What God has cleansed , don't you call unclean . '

verses.z: 那時，希律王下手苦害教會中幾個人，
verses.e: Now about that time , King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly .

verses.z: 過了第一層第二層監牢，就來到臨街的鐵門，那門自己開了。他們出來，走過一條街，天使便離開他去了。
verses.e: When they were past the first and the second guard , they came to the iron gate that leads into the city , which opened to them by itself . They went out and went down one street , and immediately the angel departed from him .

verses.z: 彼得醒悟過來，說：「我現在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脫離希律的手和猶太百姓一切所盼望的。」
verses.e: When Peter had come to himself , he said , " Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from everything the Jewish people were expecting . "

verses.z: 想了一想，就往那稱呼馬可的約翰、他母親馬利亞家去，在那裏有好些人聚集禱告。
verses.e: Thinking about that , he came to the house of Mary , the mother of John who was called Mark , where many were gathered together and were praying .

verses.z: 彼得敲外門，有一個使女，名叫羅大，出來探聽，
verses.e: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer .

verses.z: 聽得是彼得的聲音，就歡喜的顧不得開門，跑進去告訴眾人說：「彼得站在門外。」
verses.e: When she recognized Peter's voice , she didn't open the gate for joy , but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate .

verses.z: 他們說：「你是瘋了！」使女極力地說：「真是他！」他們說：「必是他的天使！」
verses.e: They said to her , " You are crazy ! " But she insisted that it was so . They said , " It is his angel . "

verses.z: 彼得不住地敲門。他們開了門，看見他，就甚驚奇。
verses.e: But Peter continued knocking . When they had opened , they saw him and were amazed .

verses.z: 彼得擺手，不要他們作聲，就告訴他們主怎樣領他出監；又說：「你們把這事告訴雅各和眾弟兄。」於是出去，往別處去了。
verses.e: But he , beckoning to them with his hand to be silent , declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison . He said , " Tell these things to James and to the brothers . " Then he departed and went to another place .

verses.z: 到了天亮，兵丁擾亂得很，不知道彼得往哪裏去了。
verses.e: Now as soon as it was day , there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter .

verses.z: 希律找他，找不着，就審問看守的人，吩咐把他們拉去殺了。後來希律離開猶太，下凱撒利亞去，住在那裏。
verses.e: When Herod had sought for him and didn't find him , he examined the guards , then commanded that they should be put to death . He went down from Judea to Caesarea , and stayed there .

verses.z: 用刀殺了約翰的哥哥雅各。
verses.e: He killed James , the brother of John , with the sword .

verses.z: 希律惱怒泰爾、西頓的人。他們那一帶地方是從王的地土得糧，因此就託了王的內侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心來求和。
verses.e: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon . They came with one accord to him and , having made Blastus , the king's personal aide , their friend , they asked for peace , because their country depended on the king's country for food .

verses.z: 希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，對他們講論一番。
verses.e: On an appointed day , Herod dressed himself in royal clothing , sat on the throne , and gave a speech to them .

verses.z: 百姓喊着說：「這是神的聲音，不是人的聲音。」
verses.e: The people shouted , " The voice of a god , and not of a man ! "

verses.z: 希律不歸榮耀給上帝，所以主的使者立刻罰他，他被蟲所咬，氣就絕了。
verses.e: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him , because he didn't give God the glory . Then he was eaten by worms and died .

verses.z: 上帝的道日見興旺，越發廣傳。
verses.e: But the word of God grew and multiplied .

verses.z: 巴拿巴和掃羅辦完了他們供給的事，就從耶路撒冷回來，帶着稱呼馬可的約翰同去。
verses.e: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service , also taking with them John who was called Mark .

verses.z: 他見猶太人喜歡這事，又去捉拿彼得。那時正是除酵的日子。
verses.e: When he saw that it pleased the Jews , he proceeded to seize Peter also . This was during the days of unleavened bread .

verses.z: 希律拿了彼得，收在監裏，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四個人，意思要在逾越節後把他提出來，當着百姓[辦他]。
verses.e: When he had arrested him , he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him , intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover .

verses.z: 於是彼得被囚在監裏；教會卻為他切切地禱告上帝。
verses.e: Peter therefore was kept in the prison , but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him .

verses.z: 希律將要提他出來的前一夜，彼得被兩條鐵鍊鎖着，睡在兩個兵丁當中；看守的人也在門外看守。
verses.e: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out , Peter was sleeping between two soldiers , bound with two chains . Guards in front of the door kept the prison .

verses.z: 忽然，有主的一個使者站在旁邊，屋裏有光照耀，天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，說：「快快起來！」那鐵鍊就從他手上脫落下來。
verses.e: And behold , an angel of the Lord stood by him , and a light shone in the cell . He struck Peter on the side and woke him up , saying , " Stand up quickly ! " His chains fell off his hands .

verses.z: 天使對他說：「束上帶子，穿上鞋。」他就那樣做。天使又說：「披上外衣，跟着我來。」
verses.e: The angel said to him , " Get dressed and put on your sandals . " He did so . He said to him , " Put on your cloak and follow me . "

verses.z: 彼得就出來跟着他，不知道天使所做是真的，只當見了異象。
verses.e: And he went out and followed him . He didn't know that what was being done by the angel was real , but thought he saw a vision .

verses.z: 在安提阿的教會中，有幾位先知和教師，就是巴拿巴和稱呼尼結的西面、古利奈人路求，與分封之王希律同養的馬念，並掃羅。
verses.e: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers : Barnabas , Simeon who was called Niger , Lucius of Cyrene , Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch , and Saul .

verses.z: 說：「你這充滿各樣詭詐奸惡，魔鬼的兒子，眾善的仇敵，你混亂主的正道還不止住嗎？
verses.e: and said , " You son of the devil , full of all deceit and all cunning , you enemy of all righteousness , will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?

verses.z: 現在主的手加在你身上，你要瞎眼，暫且不見日光。」他的眼睛立刻昏蒙黑暗，四下裏求人拉着手領他。
verses.e: Now , behold , the hand of the Lord is on you , and you will be blind , not seeing the sun for a season ! " Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him . He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand .

verses.z: 方伯看見所做的事，很希奇主的道，就信了。
verses.e: Then the proconsul , when he saw what was done , believed , being astonished at the teaching of the Lord .

verses.z: 保羅和他的同人從帕弗開船，來到旁非利亞的別加，約翰就離開他們，回耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia . John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他們離了別加往前行，來到彼西底的安提阿，在安息日進會堂坐下。
verses.e: But they , passing on from Perga , came to Antioch of Pisidia . They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down .

verses.z: 讀完了律法和先知[的書]，管會堂的叫人過去，對他們說：「二位兄台，若有甚麼勸勉眾人的話，請說。」
verses.e: After the reading of the law and the prophets , the rulers of the synagogue sent to them , saying , " Brothers , if you have any word of exhortation for the people , speak . "

verses.z: 保羅就站起來，舉手，說：「以色列人和一切敬畏上帝的人，請聽。
verses.e: Paul stood up , and gesturing with his hand said , " Men of Israel , and you who fear God , listen .

verses.z: 這以色列民的上帝揀選了我們的祖宗，當民寄居埃及的時候抬舉他們，用大能的手領他們出來；
verses.e: The God of this people chose our fathers , and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt , and with an uplifted arm , he led them out of it .

verses.z: 又在曠野容忍他們，約有四十年。
verses.e: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness .

verses.z: 既滅了迦南地七族的人，就把那地分給他們為業；
verses.e: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan , he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years .

verses.z: 他們事奉主、禁食的時候，聖靈說：「要為我分派巴拿巴和掃羅，去做我召他們所做的工。」
verses.e: As they served the Lord and fasted , the Holy Spirit said , " Separate Barnabas and Saul for me , for the work to which I have called them . "

verses.z: 此後給他們設立士師，約有四百五十年，直到先知撒母耳的時候。
verses.e: After these things , he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet .

verses.z: 後來他們求一個王，上帝就將便雅憫支派中基士的兒子掃羅，給他們作王四十年。
verses.e: Afterward they asked for a king , and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish , a man of the tribe of Benjamin , for forty years .

verses.z: 既廢了掃羅，就選立大衛作他們的王，又為他作見證說：『我尋得耶西的兒子大衛，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。』
verses.e: When he had removed him , he raised up David to be their king , to whom he also testified , ' I have found David the son of Jesse , a man after my heart , who will do all my will . '

verses.z: 從這人的後裔中，上帝已經照着所應許的，為以色列人立了一位救主，就是耶穌。
verses.e: From this man's offspring , God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise ,

verses.z: 在他沒有出來以先，約翰向以色列眾民宣講悔改的洗禮。
verses.e: before his coming , when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel .

verses.z: 約翰將行盡他的程途說：『你們以為我是誰？我不是[基督]；只是有一位在我以後來的，我解他腳上的鞋帶也是不配的。』
verses.e: As John was fulfilling his course , he said , ' What do you suppose that I am ? I am not he . But behold , one comes after me , the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie . '

verses.z: 「弟兄們，亞伯拉罕的子孫和你們中間敬畏上帝的人哪，這救世的道是傳給我們的。
verses.e: " Brothers , children of the stock of Abraham , and those among you who fear God , the word of this salvation is sent out to you .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷居住的人和他們的官長，因為不認識基督，也不明白每安息日所讀眾先知的書，就把基督定了死罪，正應了先知的預言；
verses.e: For those who dwell in Jerusalem , and their rulers , because they didn't know him , nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath , fulfilled them by condemning him .

verses.z: 雖然查不出他有當死的罪來，還是求彼拉多殺他；
verses.e: Though they found no cause for death , they still asked Pilate to have him killed .

verses.z: 既成就了[經上]指着他所記的一切話，就把他從木頭上取下來，放在墳墓裏。
verses.e: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him , they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb .

verses.z: 於是禁食禱告，按手在他們[頭]上，就打發他們去了。
verses.e: Then , when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .

verses.z: 上帝卻叫他從死裏復活。
verses.e: But God raised him from the dead ,

verses.z: 那從加利利同他上耶路撒冷的人多日看見他，這些人如今在民間是他的見證。
verses.e: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem , who are his witnesses to the people .

verses.z: 我們也報好信息給你們，就是那應許祖宗的話，
verses.e: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers ,

verses.z: 上帝已經向我們這作兒女的應驗，叫耶穌復活了。正如詩篇第二篇上記着說：你是我的兒子，我今日生你。
verses.e: that God has fulfilled this to us , their children , in that he raised up Jesus . As it is also written in the second psalm , ' You are my Son . Today I have become your father . '

verses.z: 論到上帝叫他從死裏復活，不再歸於朽壞，就這樣說：我必將[所應許]大衛那聖潔、可靠的[恩典]賜給你們。
verses.e: " Concerning that he raised him up from the dead , now no more to return to corruption , he has spoken thus : ' I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David . '

verses.z: 又有一篇上說：你必不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
verses.e: Therefore he says also in another psalm , ' You will not allow your Holy One to see decay . '

verses.z: 「大衛在世的時候遵行了上帝的旨意，就睡了，歸到他祖宗那裏，已見朽壞；
verses.e: For David , after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God , fell asleep , was laid with his fathers , and saw decay .

verses.z: 惟獨上帝所復活的，他並未見朽壞。
verses.e: But he whom God raised up saw no decay .

verses.z: 所以，弟兄們，你們當曉得：赦罪的道是由這人傳給你們的。
verses.e: Be it known to you therefore , brothers , that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins ;

verses.z: 你們靠摩西的律法，在一切不得稱義的事上信靠這人，就都得稱義了。
verses.e: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things , from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses .

verses.z: 他們既被聖靈差遣，就下到西流基，從那裏坐船往塞浦路斯去。
verses.e: So , being sent out by the Holy Spirit , they went down to Seleucia . From there they sailed to Cyprus .

verses.z: 所以，你們務要小心，免得先知書上所說的臨到你們。
verses.e: Beware therefore , lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets :

verses.z: 主[說]：你們這輕慢的人要觀看，要驚奇，要滅亡；因為在你們的時候，我行一件事，雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。」
verses.e: ' Behold , you scoffers ! Wonder and perish , for I work a work in your days , a work which you will in no way believe , if one declares it to you . ' "

verses.z: 他們出會堂的時候，眾人請他們到下安息日再講這話給他們聽。
verses.e: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue , the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath .

verses.z: 散會以後，猶太人和敬虔進猶太教的人多有跟從保羅、巴拿巴的。二人對他們講道，勸他們務要恆久在上帝的恩中。
verses.e: Now when the synagogue broke up , many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas ; who , speaking to them , urged them to continue in the grace of God .

verses.z: 到下安息日，合城的人幾乎都來聚集，要聽上帝的道。
verses.e: The next Sabbath , almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God .

verses.z: 但猶太人看見人這樣多，就滿心嫉妒，硬駁保羅所說的話，並且毀謗。
verses.e: But when the Jews saw the multitudes , they were filled with jealousy , and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul , and blasphemed .
