verses.z: 保羅和巴拿巴放膽說：「上帝的道先講給你們原是應當的；只因你們棄絕這道，斷定自己不配得永生，我們就轉向外邦人去。
verses.e: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly , and said , " It was necessary that God's word should be spoken to you first . Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves , and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life , behold , we turn to the Gentiles .

verses.z: 因為主曾這樣吩咐我們說：我已經立你作外邦人的光，叫你施行救恩，直到地極。」
verses.e: For so has the Lord commanded us , saying , ' I have set you as a light for the Gentiles , that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth . ' "

verses.z: 外邦人聽見這話，就歡喜了，讚美上帝的道；凡預定得永生的人都信了。
verses.e: As the Gentiles heard this , they were glad and glorified the word of God . As many as were appointed to eternal life believed .

verses.z: 於是主的道傳遍了那一帶地方。
verses.e: The Lord's word was spread abroad throughout all the region .

verses.z: 到了撒拉米，就在猶太人各會堂裏傳講上帝的道，也有約翰作他們的幫手。
verses.e: When they were at Salamis , they proclaimed God's word in the Jewish synagogues . They also had John as their attendant .

verses.z: 但猶太人挑唆虔敬、尊貴的婦女和城內有名望的人，逼迫保羅、巴拿巴，將他們趕出境外。
verses.e: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city , and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and threw them out of their borders .

verses.z: 二人對着眾人跺下腳上的塵土，就往以哥念去了。
verses.e: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them , and came to Iconium .

verses.z: 門徒滿心喜樂，又被聖靈充滿。
verses.e: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 經過全島，直到帕弗，在那裏遇見一個有法術、假充先知的猶太人，名叫巴‧耶穌。
verses.e: When they had gone through the island to Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus ,

verses.z: 這人常和方伯士求‧保羅同在。士求‧保羅是個通達人，他請了巴拿巴和掃羅來，要聽上帝的道。
verses.e: who was with the proconsul , Sergius Paulus , a man of understanding . This man summoned Barnabas and Saul , and sought to hear the word of God .

verses.z: 只是那行法術的以呂馬（這名翻出來就是行法術的意思）敵擋使徒，要叫方伯不信真道。
verses.e: But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith .

verses.z: 掃羅又名保羅，被聖靈充滿，定睛看他，
verses.e: But Saul , who is also called Paul , filled with the Holy Spirit , fastened his eyes on him

verses.z: 二人在以哥念同進猶太人的會堂，在那裏講的，叫猶太人和希臘人信的很多。
verses.e: In Iconium , they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews , and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed .

verses.z: 就大聲說：「你起來，兩腳站直！」那人就跳起來，而且行走。
verses.e: said with a loud voice , " Stand upright on your feet ! " He leaped up and walked .

verses.z: 眾人看見保羅所做的事，就用呂高尼的話大聲說：「有神藉着人形降臨在我們中間了。」
verses.e: When the multitude saw what Paul had done , they lifted up their voice , saying in the language of Lycaonia , " The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men ! "

verses.z: 於是稱巴拿巴為宙斯，稱保羅為希耳米，因為他說話領首。
verses.e: They called Barnabas " Jupiter " , and Paul " Mercury " , because he was the chief speaker .

verses.z: 有城外宙斯[廟]的祭司牽着牛，拿着花圈，來到門前，要同眾人[向使徒]獻祭。
verses.e: The priest of Jupiter , whose temple was in front of their city , brought oxen and garlands to the gates , and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes .

verses.z: 巴拿巴、保羅二使徒聽見，就撕開衣裳，跳進眾人中間，喊着說：
verses.e: But when the apostles , Barnabas and Paul , heard of it , they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude , crying out ,

verses.z: 「諸君，為甚麼做這事呢？我們也是人，性情和你們一樣。我們傳福音給你們，是叫你們離棄這些虛妄，歸向那創造天、地、海，和其中萬物的永生上帝。
verses.e: " Men , why are you doing these things ? We also are men of the same nature as you , and bring you good news , that you should turn from these vain things to the living God , who made the sky , the earth , the sea , and all that is in them ;

verses.z: 他在從前的世代，任憑萬國各行其道；
verses.e: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways .

verses.z: 然而為自己未嘗不顯出證據來，就如常施恩惠，從天降雨，賞賜豐年，叫你們飲食飽足，滿心喜樂。」
verses.e: Yet he didn't leave himself without witness , in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness . "

verses.z: 二人說了這些話，僅僅地攔住眾人不獻祭與他們。
verses.e: Even saying these things , they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them .

verses.z: 但有些猶太人從安提阿和以哥念來，挑唆眾人，就用石頭打保羅，以為他是死了，便拖到城外。
verses.e: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there , and having persuaded the multitudes , they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city , supposing that he was dead .

verses.z: 但那不順從的猶太人聳動外邦人，叫他們心裏惱恨弟兄。
verses.e: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers .

verses.z: 門徒正圍着他，他就起來，走進城去。第二天，同巴拿巴往特庇去，
verses.e: But as the disciples stood around him , he rose up , and entered into the city . On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe .

verses.z: 對那城裏[的人]傳了福音，使好些人作門徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，
verses.e: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples , they returned to Lystra , Iconium , and Antioch ,

verses.z: 堅固門徒的心，勸他們恆守所信的道；又說：「我們進入上帝的國，必須經歷許多艱難。」
verses.e: strengthening the souls of the disciples , exhorting them to continue in the faith , and that through many afflictions we must enter into God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 二人在各教會中選立了長老，又禁食禱告，就把他們交託所信的主。
verses.e: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly , and had prayed with fasting , they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed .

verses.z: 二人經過彼西底，來到旁非利亞。
verses.e: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia .

verses.z: 在別加講了道，就下亞大利去，
verses.e: When they had spoken the word in Perga , they went down to Attalia .

verses.z: 從那裏坐船，往安提阿去。當初，他們被眾人所託、蒙上帝之恩、要辦現在所做之工，就是在這地方。
verses.e: From there they sailed to Antioch , from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled .

verses.z: 到了那裏，聚集了會眾，就述說上帝藉他們所行的一切事，並上帝怎樣為外邦人開了信道的門。
verses.e: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together , they reported all the things that God had done with them , and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations .

verses.z: 二人就在那裏同門徒住了多日。
verses.e: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time .

verses.z: 二人在那裏住了多日，倚靠主放膽講道，主藉他們的手施行神蹟奇事，證明他的恩道。
verses.e: Therefore they stayed there a long time , speaking boldly in the Lord , who testified to the word of his grace , granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands .

verses.z: 城裏的眾人就分了黨，有附從猶太人的，有附從使徒的。
verses.e: But the multitude of the city was divided . Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles .

verses.z: 那時，外邦人和猶太人，並他們的官長，一齊擁上來，要凌辱使徒，用石頭打他們。
verses.e: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews , with their rulers , made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them ,

verses.z: 使徒知道了，就逃往呂高尼的路司得、特庇兩個城和周圍地方去，
verses.e: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia , Lystra , Derbe , and the surrounding region .

verses.z: 在那裏傳福音。
verses.e: There they preached the Good News .

verses.z: 路司得城裏坐着一個兩腳無力的人，生來是瘸腿的，從來沒有走過。
verses.e: At Lystra a certain man sat , impotent in his feet , a cripple from his mother's womb , who never had walked .

verses.z: 他聽保羅講道，保羅定睛看他，見他有信心，可得痊癒，
verses.e: He was listening to Paul speaking , who , fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole ,

verses.z: 有幾個人從猶太下來，教訓弟兄們說：「你們若不按摩西的規條受割禮，不能得救。」
verses.e: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers , " Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses , you can't be saved . "

verses.z: 現在為甚麼試探上帝，要把我們祖宗和我們所不能負的軛放在門徒的頸項上呢？
verses.e: Now therefore why do you tempt God , that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?

verses.z: 我們得救乃是因主耶穌的恩，和他們一樣，這是我們所信的。」
verses.e: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus , just as they are . "

verses.z: 眾人都默默無聲，聽巴拿巴和保羅述說上帝藉他們在外邦人中所行的神蹟奇事。
verses.e: All the multitude kept silence , and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them .

verses.z: 他們住了聲，雅各就說：「諸位弟兄，請聽我的話。
verses.e: After they were silent , James answered , " Brothers , listen to me .

verses.z: 方才西門述說上帝當初怎樣眷顧外邦人，從他們中間選取百姓歸於自己的名下；
verses.e: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name .

verses.z: 眾先知的話也與這意思相合。
verses.e: This agrees with the words of the prophets . As it is written ,

verses.z: 正如[經上]所寫的：此後，我要回來，重新修造大衛倒塌的帳幕，把那破壞的重新修造建立起來，
verses.e: ' After these things I will return . I will again build the tabernacle of David , which has fallen . I will again build its ruins . I will set it up

verses.z: 叫餘剩的人，就是凡稱為我名下的外邦人，都尋求主。
verses.e: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord : all the Gentiles who are called by my name , says the Lord , who does all these things . '

verses.z: 這話是從創世以來顯明這事的主說的。
verses.e: " All of God's works are known to him from eternity .

verses.z: 「所以據我的意見，不可難為那歸服上帝的外邦人；
verses.e: Therefore my judgment is that we don't trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God ,

verses.z: 保羅、巴拿巴與他們大大地紛爭辯論；[眾門徒]就定規，叫保羅、巴拿巴和本會中幾個人，為所辯論的，上耶路撒冷去見使徒和長老。
verses.e: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them , they appointed Paul , Barnabas , and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question .

verses.z: 只要寫信，吩咐他們禁戒偶像的污穢和姦淫，並勒死的牲畜和血。
verses.e: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols , from sexual immorality , from what is strangled , and from blood .

verses.z: 因為從古以來，摩西[的書]在各城有人傳講，每逢安息日，在會堂裏誦讀。」
verses.e: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him , being read in the synagogues every Sabbath . "

verses.z: 那時，使徒和長老並全教會定意從他們中間揀選人，差他們和保羅、巴拿巴同往安提阿去；[所揀選的]就是稱呼巴撒巴的猶大和西拉。這兩個人在弟兄中是作首領的。
verses.e: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders , with the whole assembly , to choose men out of their company , and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas : Judas called Barsabbas , and Silas , chief men among the brothers .

verses.z: 於是寫信交付他們，內中說：「使徒和作長老的弟兄們問安提阿、敘利亞、基利家外邦眾弟兄的安。
verses.e: They wrote these things by their hand : " The apostles , the elders , and the brothers , to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch , Syria , and Cilicia : greetings .

verses.z: 我們聽說，有幾個人從我們這裏出去，用言語攪擾你們，惑亂你們的心。其實我們並沒有吩咐他們。
verses.e: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words , unsettling your souls , saying , ' You must be circumcised and keep the law , ' to whom we gave no commandment ;

verses.z: 所以，我們同心定意，揀選幾個人，差他們同我們所親愛的巴拿巴和保羅往你們那裏去。
verses.e: it seemed good to us , having come to one accord , to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul ,

verses.z: 這二人是為我主耶穌基督的名不顧性命的。
verses.e: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 我們就差了猶大和西拉，他們也要親口訴說這些事。
verses.e: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas , who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth .

verses.z: 因為聖靈和我們定意不將別的重擔放在你們身上，惟有幾件事是不可少的，
verses.e: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit , and to us , to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things :

verses.z: 就是禁戒祭偶像的物和血，並勒死的牲畜和姦淫。這幾件你們若能自己禁戒不犯就好了。願你們平安！」
verses.e: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols , from blood , from things strangled , and from sexual immorality , from which if you keep yourselves , it will be well with you . Farewell . "

verses.z: 於是教會送他們起行。他們經過腓尼基、撒馬利亞，隨處傳說外邦人歸主的事，叫眾弟兄都甚歡喜。
verses.e: They , being sent on their way by the assembly , passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles . They caused great joy to all the brothers .

verses.z: 他們既奉了差遣，就下安提阿去，聚集眾人，交付書信。
verses.e: So , when they were sent off , they came to Antioch . Having gathered the multitude together , they delivered the letter .

verses.z: 眾人念了，因為信上安慰的話就歡喜了。
verses.e: When they had read it , they rejoiced over the encouragement .

verses.z: 猶大和西拉也是先知，就用許多話勸勉弟兄，堅固他們。
verses.e: Judas and Silas , also being prophets themselves , encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them .

verses.z: 住了些日子，弟兄們打發他們平平安安地回到差遣他們的人那裏去。
verses.e: After they had spent some time there , they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles .
But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch , teaching and preaching the word of the Lord , with many others also .

verses.z: 但保羅和巴拿巴仍住在安提阿，和許多別人一同教訓人，傳主的道。
verses.e: After some days Paul said to Barnabas , " Let's return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord , to see how they are doing . "

verses.z: 過了些日子，保羅對巴拿巴說：「我們可以回到從前宣傳主道的各城，看望弟兄們景況如何。」
verses.e: Barnabas planned to take John , who was called Mark , with them also .

verses.z: 巴拿巴有意要帶稱呼馬可的約翰同去；
verses.e: But Paul didn't think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia , and didn't go with them to do the work .

verses.z: 但保羅因為馬可從前在旁非利亞離開他們，不和他們同去做工，就以為不可帶他去。
verses.e: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other . Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus ,

verses.z: 於是二人起了爭論，甚至彼此分開。巴拿巴帶着馬可，坐船往塞浦路斯去；
verses.e: but Paul chose Silas and went out , being commended by the brothers to the grace of God .

verses.z: 到了耶路撒冷，教會和使徒並長老都接待他們，他們就述說上帝同他們所行的一切事。
verses.e: When they had come to Jerusalem , they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders , and they reported everything that God had done with them .

verses.z: 保羅揀選了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄們把他交於主的恩中。
verses.e: He went through Syria and Cilicia , strengthening the assemblies .

verses.z: 他就走遍敘利亞、基利家，堅固眾教會。
惟有幾個信徒，是法利賽教門的人，起來說：「必須給外邦人行割禮，吩咐他們遵守摩西的律法。」
verses.e: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up , saying , " It is necessary to circumcise them , and to command them to keep the law of Moses . "

verses.z: 使徒和長老聚會商議這事；
verses.e: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter .

verses.z: 辯論已經多了，彼得就起來，說：「諸位弟兄，你們知道上帝早已在你們中間揀選了我，叫外邦人從我口中得聽福音之道，而且相信。
verses.e: When there had been much discussion , Peter rose up and said to them , " Brothers , you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe .

verses.z: 知道人心的上帝也為他們作了見證，賜聖靈給他們，正如給我們一樣；
verses.e: God , who knows the heart , testified about them , giving them the Holy Spirit , just like he did to us .

verses.z: 又藉着信潔淨了他們的心，並不分他們我們。
verses.e: He made no distinction between us and them , cleansing their hearts by faith .

verses.z: 保羅來到特庇，又到路司得。在那裏有一個門徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之猶太婦人的兒子，他父親卻是希臘人。
verses.e: He came to Derbe and Lystra ; and behold , a certain disciple was there , named Timothy , the son of a Jewess who believed , but his father was a Greek .

verses.z: 保羅既看見這異象，我們隨即想要往馬其頓去，以為上帝召我們傳福音給那裏的人聽。
verses.e: When he had seen the vision , immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia , concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them .

verses.z: 於是從特羅亞開船，一直行到撒摩特喇，第二天到了尼亞坡里。
verses.e: Setting sail therefore from Troas , we made a straight course to Samothrace , and the day following to Neapolis ;

verses.z: 從那裏來到腓立比，就是馬其頓這一方的頭一個城，也是[羅馬]的駐防城。我們在這城裏住了幾天。
verses.e: and from there to Philippi , which is a city of Macedonia , the foremost of the district , a Roman colony . We were staying some days in this city .

verses.z: 當安息日，我們出城門，到了河邊，知道那裏有一個禱告的地方，我們就坐下對那聚會的婦女講道。
verses.e: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside , where we supposed there was a place of prayer , and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together .

verses.z: 有一個賣紫色布疋的婦人，名叫呂底亞，是推雅推喇城的人，素來敬拜上帝。她聽見了，主就開導她的心，叫她留心聽保羅所講的話。
verses.e: A certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , one who worshiped God , heard us . The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul .

verses.z: 她和她一家既領了洗，便求我們說：「你們若以為我是真信主的，請到我家裏來住」；於是強留我們。
verses.e: When she and her household were baptized , she begged us , saying , " If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord , come into my house and stay . " So she persuaded us .

verses.z: 後來，我們往那禱告的地方去。有一個使女迎着面來，她被巫鬼所附，用法術，叫她主人們大得財利。
verses.e: As we were going to prayer , a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us , who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling .

verses.z: 她跟隨保羅和我們，喊着說：「這些人是至高上帝的僕人，對你們傳說救人的道。」
verses.e: Following Paul and us , she cried out , " These men are servants of the Most High God , who proclaim to us a way of salvation ! "

verses.z: 她一連多日這樣喊叫，保羅就心中厭煩，轉身對那鬼說：「我奉耶穌基督的名，吩咐你從她身上出來！」那鬼當時就出來了。
verses.e: She was doing this for many days . But Paul , becoming greatly annoyed , turned and said to the spirit , " I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her ! " It came out that very hour .

verses.z: 使女的主人們見得利的指望沒有了，便揪住保羅和西拉，拉他們到市上去見首領；
verses.e: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone , they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers .

verses.z: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄都稱讚他。
verses.e: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him .

verses.z: 又帶到官長面前說：「這些人原是猶太人，竟騷擾我們的城，
verses.e: When they had brought them to the magistrates , they said , " These men , being Jews , are agitating our city

verses.z: 傳我們羅馬人所不可受不可行的規矩。」
verses.e: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe , being Romans . "

verses.z: 眾人就一同起來攻擊他們。官長吩咐剝了他們的衣裳，用棍打；
verses.e: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them , then commanded them to be beaten with rods .

verses.z: 打了許多棍，便將他們下在監裏，囑咐禁卒嚴緊看守。
verses.e: When they had laid many stripes on them , they threw them into prison , charging the jailer to keep them safely .

verses.z: 禁卒領了這樣的命，就把他們下在內監裏，兩腳上了木狗。
verses.e: Having received such a command , he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks .

verses.z: 約在半夜，保羅和西拉禱告，唱詩讚美上帝，眾囚犯也側耳而聽。
verses.e: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God , and the prisoners were listening to them .

verses.z: 忽然，地大震動，甚至監牢的地基都搖動了，監門立刻全開，眾囚犯的鎖鍊也都鬆開了。
verses.e: Suddenly there was a great earthquake , so that the foundations of the prison were shaken ; and immediately all the doors were opened , and everyone's bonds were loosened .

verses.z: 禁卒一醒，看見監門全開，以為囚犯已經逃走，就拔刀要自殺。
verses.e: The jailer , being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open , drew his sword and was about to kill himself , supposing that the prisoners had escaped .

verses.z: 保羅大聲呼叫說：「不要傷害自己！我們都在這裏。」
verses.e: But Paul cried with a loud voice , saying , " Don't harm yourself , for we are all here ! "

verses.z: 禁卒叫人拿燈來，就跳進去，戰戰兢兢地俯伏在保羅、西拉面前；
verses.e: He called for lights , sprang in , fell down trembling before Paul and Silas ,

verses.z: 保羅要帶他同去，只因那些地方的猶太人都知道他父親是希臘人，就給他行了割禮。
verses.e: Paul wanted to have him go out with him , and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts , for they all knew that his father was a Greek .

verses.z: 又領他們出來，說：「二位先生，我當怎樣行才可以得救？」
verses.e: brought them out , and said , " Sirs , what must I do to be saved ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「當信主耶穌，你和你一家都必得救。」
verses.e: They said , " Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ , and you will be saved , you and your household . "

verses.z: 他們就把主的道講給他和他全家的人聽。
verses.e: They spoke the word of the Lord to him , and to all who were in his house .

verses.z: 當夜，就在那時候，禁卒把他們帶去，洗他們的傷；他和屬乎他的人立時都受了洗。
verses.e: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes , and was immediately baptized , he and all his household .

verses.z: 於是禁卒領他們上自己家裏去，給他們擺上飯。他和全家，因為信了上帝，都很喜樂。
verses.e: He brought them up into his house and set food before them , and rejoiced greatly with all his household , having believed in God .

verses.z: 到了天亮，官長打發差役來，說：「釋放那兩個人吧。」
verses.e: But when it was day , the magistrates sent the sergeants , saying , " Let those men go . "

verses.z: 禁卒就把這話告訴保羅說：「官長打發人來叫釋放你們，如今可以出監，平平安安地去吧。」
verses.e: The jailer reported these words to Paul , saying , " The magistrates have sent to let you go ; now therefore come out and go in peace . "

verses.z: 保羅卻說：「我們是羅馬人，並沒有定罪，他們就在眾人面前打了我們，又把我們下在監裏，現在要私下攆我們出去嗎？這是不行的。叫他們自己來領我們出去吧！」
verses.e: But Paul said to them , " They have beaten us publicly without a trial , men who are Romans , and have cast us into prison ! Do they now release us secretly ? No , most certainly , but let them come themselves and bring us out ! "

verses.z: 差役把這話回稟官長。官長聽見他們是羅馬人，就害怕了，
verses.e: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates , and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans ,

verses.z: 於是來勸他們，領他們出來，請他們離開那城。
verses.e: and they came and begged them . When they had brought them out , they asked them to depart from the city .

verses.z: 他們經過各城，把耶路撒冷使徒和長老所定的條規交給門徒遵守。
verses.e: As they went on their way through the cities , they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 二人出了監，往呂底亞家裏去，見了弟兄們，勸慰他們一番，就走了。
verses.e: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia's house . When they had seen the brothers , they encouraged them , then departed .

verses.z: 於是眾教會信心越發堅固，人數天天加增。
verses.e: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith , and increased in number daily .

verses.z: 聖靈既然禁止他們在亞細亞講道，他們就經過弗呂家、加拉太一帶地方。
verses.e: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia , they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia .

verses.z: 到了每西亞的邊界，他們想要往庇推尼去，耶穌的靈卻不許。
verses.e: When they had come opposite Mysia , they tried to go into Bithynia , but the Spirit didn't allow them .

verses.z: 他們就越過每西亞，下到特羅亞去。
verses.e: Passing by Mysia , they came down to Troas .

verses.z: 在夜間有異象現與保羅。有一個馬其頓人站着求他說：「請你過到馬其頓來幫助我們。」
verses.e: A vision appeared to Paul in the night . There was a man of Macedonia standing , begging him and saying , " Come over into Macedonia and help us . "

verses.z: 保羅和西拉經過暗妃坡里、亞波羅尼亞，來到帖撒羅尼迦，在那裏有猶太人的會堂。
verses.e: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where there was a Jewish synagogue .

verses.z: 弟兄們隨即在夜間打發保羅和西拉往庇哩亞去。二人到了，就進入猶太人的會堂。
verses.e: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea . When they arrived , they went into the Jewish synagogue .

verses.z: 這地方的人賢於帖撒羅尼迦的人，甘心領受這道，天天考查聖經，要曉得這道是與不是。
verses.e: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so .

verses.z: 所以他們中間多有相信的，又有希臘尊貴的婦女，男子也不少。
verses.e: Many of them therefore believed ; also of the prominent Greek women , and not a few men .

verses.z: 但帖撒羅尼迦的猶太人知道保羅又在庇哩亞傳上帝的道，也就往那裏去，聳動攪擾眾人。
verses.e: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also , they came there likewise , agitating the multitudes .

verses.z: 當時弟兄們便打發保羅往海邊去，西拉和提摩太仍住在庇哩亞。
verses.e: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea , and Silas and Timothy still stayed there .

verses.z: 送保羅的人帶他到了雅典，既領了保羅的命，叫西拉和提摩太速速到他這裏來，就回去了。
verses.e: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens . Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly , they departed .

verses.z: 保羅在雅典等候他們的時候，看見滿城都是偶像，就心裏着急；
verses.e: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols .

verses.z: 於是在會堂裏與猶太人和虔敬的人，並每日在市上所遇見的人，辯論。
verses.e: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons , and in the marketplace every day with those who met him .

verses.z: 還有伊壁鳩魯和斯多亞兩門的學士，與他爭論。有的說：「這胡言亂語的要說甚麼？」有的說：「他似乎是傳說外邦鬼神的。」這話是因保羅傳講耶穌與復活的道。
verses.e: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him . Some said , " What does this babbler want to say ? " Others said , " He seems to be advocating foreign deities , " because he preached Jesus and the resurrection .

verses.z: 他們就把他帶到亞略‧巴古，說：「你所講的這新道，我們也可以知道嗎？
verses.e: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus , saying , " May we know what this new teaching is , which you are speaking about ?

verses.z: 保羅照他素常的規矩進去，一連三個安息日，本着聖經與他們辯論，
verses.e: Paul , as was his custom , went in to them ; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures ,

verses.z: 因為你有些奇怪的事傳到我們耳中，我們願意知道這些事是甚麼意思。」（
verses.e: For you bring certain strange things to our ears . We want to know therefore what these things mean . "

verses.z: 雅典人和住在那裏的客人都不顧別的事，只將新聞說說聽聽。）
verses.e: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else , but either to tell or to hear some new thing .

verses.z: 保羅站在亞略‧巴古當中，說：「眾位雅典人哪，我看你們凡事很敬畏鬼神。
verses.e: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said , " You men of Athens , I perceive that you are very religious in all things .

verses.z: 我遊行的時候，觀看你們所敬拜的，遇見一座壇，上面寫着『未識之神』。你們所不認識而敬拜的，我現在告訴你們。
verses.e: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship , I also found an altar with this inscription : ' TO AN UNKNOWN GOD . ' What therefore you worship in ignorance , I announce to you .

verses.z: 創造宇宙和其中萬物的上帝，既是天地的主，就不住人手所造的殿，
verses.e: The God who made the world and all things in it , he , being Lord of heaven and earth , doesn't dwell in temples made with hands .

verses.z: 也不用人手服事，好像缺少甚麼；自己倒將生命、氣息、萬物，賜給萬人。
verses.e: He isn't served by men's hands , as though he needed anything , seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things .

verses.z: 他從一本造出萬族的人，住在全地上，並且預先定準他們的年限和所住的疆界，
verses.e: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth , having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings ,

verses.z: 要叫他們尋求上帝，或者可以揣摩而得，其實他離我們各人不遠；
verses.e: that they should seek the Lord , if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him , though he is not far from each one of us .

verses.z: 我們生活、動作、存留，都在乎他。就如你們作詩的，有人說：『我們也是他所生的。』
verses.e: ' For in him we live , move , and have our being . ' As some of your own poets have said , ' For we are also his offspring . '

verses.z: 我們既是上帝所生的，就不當以為上帝的神性像人用手藝、心思所雕刻的金、銀、石。
verses.e: Being then the offspring of God , we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold , or silver , or stone , engraved by art and design of man .

verses.z: 講解陳明基督必須受害，從死裏復活；又說：「我所傳與你們的這位耶穌就是基督。」
verses.e: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead , and saying , " This Jesus , whom I proclaim to you , is the Christ . "

verses.z: 世人蒙昧無知的時候，上帝並不監察，如今卻吩咐各處的人都要悔改。
verses.e: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked . But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent ,

verses.z: 因為他已經定了日子，要藉着他所設立的人按公義審判天下，並且叫他從死裏復活，給萬人作可信的憑據。」
verses.e: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained ; of which he has given assurance to all men , in that he has raised him from the dead . "

verses.z: 眾人聽見從死裏復活的話，就有譏誚他的；又有人說：「我們再聽你講這個吧！」
verses.e: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead , some mocked ; but others said , " We want to hear you again concerning this . "

verses.z: 於是保羅從他們當中出去了。
verses.e: Thus Paul went out from among them .

verses.z: 但有幾個人貼近他，信了[主]，其中有亞略‧巴古的官丟尼修，並一個婦人，名叫大馬哩，還有別人一同信從。
verses.e: But certain men joined with him and believed , including Dionysius the Areopagite , and a woman named Damaris , and others with them .

verses.z: 他們中間有些人聽了勸，就附從保羅和西拉，並有許多虔敬的希臘人，尊貴的婦女也不少。
verses.e: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas : of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and not a few of the chief women .

verses.z: 但那[不信的]猶太人心裏嫉妒，招聚了些市井匪類，搭夥成群，聳動合城的人闖進耶孫的家，要將保羅、西拉帶到百姓那裏。
verses.e: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd , set the city in an uproar . Assaulting the house of Jason , they sought to bring them out to the people .

verses.z: 找不着他們，就把耶孫和幾個弟兄拉到地方官那裏，喊叫說：「那攪亂天下的也到這裏來了，
verses.e: When they didn't find them , they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city , crying , " These who have turned the world upside down have come here also ,

verses.z: 耶孫收留他們。這些人都違背凱撒的命令，說另有一個王耶穌。」
verses.e: whom Jason has received . These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king , Jesus ! "

verses.z: 眾人和地方官聽見這話，就驚慌了；
verses.e: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things .

verses.z: 於是取了耶孫和其餘之人的保狀，就釋放了他們。
verses.e: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest , they let them go .

verses.z: 這事以後，保羅離了雅典，來到哥林多。
verses.e: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth .

verses.z: 有我與你同在，必沒有人下手害你，因為在這城裏我有許多的百姓。」
verses.e: for I am with you , and no one will attack you to harm you , for I have many people in this city . "

verses.z: 保羅在那裏住了一年零六個月，將上帝的道教訓他們。
verses.e: He lived there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .

verses.z: 到迦流作亞該亞方伯的時候，猶太人同心起來攻擊保羅，拉他到公堂，
verses.e: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia , the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat ,

verses.z: 說：「這個人勸人不按着律法敬拜上帝。」
verses.e: saying , " This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law . "

verses.z: 保羅剛要開口，迦流就對猶太人說：「你們這些猶太人！如果是為冤枉或奸惡的事，我理當耐性聽你們。
verses.e: But when Paul was about to open his mouth , Gallio said to the Jews , " If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime , you Jews , it would be reasonable that I should bear with you ;

verses.z: 但所爭論的，若是關乎言語、名目，和你們的律法，你們自己去辦吧！這樣的事我不願意審問」；
verses.e: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law , look to it yourselves . For I don't want to be a judge of these matters . "

verses.z: 就把他們攆出公堂。
verses.e: So he drove them from the judgment seat .

verses.z: 眾人便揪住管會堂的所提尼，在堂前打他。這些事迦流都不管。
verses.e: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes , the ruler of the synagogue , and beat him before the judgment seat . Gallio didn't care about any of these things .

verses.z: 保羅又住了多日，就辭別了弟兄，坐船往敘利亞去；百基拉、亞居拉和他同去。他因為許過願，就在堅革哩剪了頭髮。
verses.e: Paul , having stayed after this many more days , took his leave of the brothers , and sailed from there for Syria , together with Priscilla and Aquila . He shaved his head in Cenchreae , for he had a vow .

verses.z: 到了以弗所，保羅就把他們留在那裏，自己進了會堂，和猶太人辯論。
verses.e: He came to Ephesus , and he left them there ; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews .

verses.z: 遇見一個猶太人，名叫亞居拉，他生在本都；因為克勞第命猶太人都離開羅馬，新近帶着妻百基拉，從意大利來。保羅就投奔了他們。
verses.e: He found a certain Jew named Aquila , a man of Pontus by race , who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla , because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome . He came to them ,

verses.z: 眾人請他多住些日子，他卻不允，
verses.e: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time , he declined ;

verses.z: 就辭別他們，說：「上帝若許我，我還要回到你們這裏」；於是開船離了以弗所。
verses.e: but taking his leave of them , he said , " I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem , but I will return again to you if God wills . " Then he set sail from Ephesus .

verses.z: 在凱撒利亞下了船，就上[耶路撒冷]去問教會安，隨後下安提阿去。
verses.e: When he had landed at Caesarea , he went up and greeted the assembly , and went down to Antioch .

verses.z: 住了些日子，又離開那裏，挨次經過加拉太和弗呂家地方，堅固眾門徒。
verses.e: Having spent some time there , he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia , in order , establishing all the disciples .

verses.z: 有一個猶太人，名叫亞波羅，來到以弗所。他生在亞歷山大，是有學問的，最能講解聖經。
verses.e: Now a certain Jew named Apollos , an Alexandrian by race , an eloquent man , came to Ephesus . He was mighty in the Scriptures .

verses.z: 這人已經在主的道上受了教訓，心裏火熱，將耶穌的事詳細講論教訓人；只是他單曉得約翰的洗禮。
verses.e: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord ; and being fervent in spirit , he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus , although he knew only the baptism of John .

verses.z: 他在會堂裏放膽講道；百基拉、亞居拉聽見，就接他來，將上帝的道給他講解更加詳細。
verses.e: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue . But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him , they took him aside , and explained to him the way of God more accurately .

verses.z: 他想要往亞該亞去，弟兄們就勉勵他，並寫信請門徒接待他。他到了那裏，多幫助那蒙恩信主的人，
verses.e: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia , the brothers encouraged him ; and wrote to the disciples to receive him . When he had come , he greatly helped those who had believed through grace ;

verses.z: 在眾人面前極有能力駁倒猶太人，引聖經證明耶穌是基督。
verses.e: for he powerfully refuted the Jews , publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ .

verses.z: 他們本是製造帳棚為業。保羅因與他們同業，就和他們同住做工。
verses.e: and because he practiced the same trade , he lived with them and worked , for by trade they were tent makers .

verses.z: 每逢安息日，保羅在會堂裏辯論，勸化猶太人和希臘人。
verses.e: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks .

verses.z: 西拉和提摩太從馬其頓來的時候，保羅為道迫切，向猶太人證明耶穌是基督。
verses.e: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia , Paul was compelled by the Spirit , testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ .

verses.z: 他們既抗拒、毀謗，保羅就抖着衣裳，說：「你們的罪歸到你們自己頭上，與我無干。從今以後，我要往外邦人那裏去。」
verses.e: When they opposed him and blasphemed , he shook out his clothing and said to them , " Your blood be on your own heads ! I am clean . From now on , I will go to the Gentiles ! "

verses.z: 於是離開那裏，到了一個人的家中；這人名叫提多‧猶士都，是敬拜上帝的，他的家靠近會堂。
verses.e: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus , one who worshiped God , whose house was next door to the synagogue .

verses.z: 管會堂的基利司布和全家都信了主，還有許多哥林多人聽了，就相信受洗。
verses.e: Crispus , the ruler of the synagogue , believed in the Lord with all his house . Many of the Corinthians , when they heard , believed and were baptized .

verses.z: 夜間，主在異象中對保羅說：「不要怕，只管講，不要閉口，
verses.e: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision , " Don't be afraid , but speak and don't be silent ;

verses.z: 亞波羅在哥林多的時候，保羅經過了上邊一帶地方，就來到以弗所；在那裏遇見幾個門徒，
verses.e: While Apollos was at Corinth , Paul , having passed through the upper country , came to Ephesus and found certain disciples .

verses.z: 這樣有兩年之久，叫一切住在亞細亞的，無論是猶太人，是希臘人，都聽見主的道。
verses.e: This continued for two years , so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus , both Jews and Greeks .

verses.z: 上帝藉保羅的手行了些非常的奇事；
verses.e: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul ,

verses.z: 甚至有人從保羅身上拿手巾或圍裙放在病人身上，病就退了，惡鬼也出去了。
verses.e: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out .

verses.z: 那時，有幾個遊行各處、念咒趕鬼的猶太人，向那被惡鬼附的人擅自稱主耶穌的名，說：「我奉保羅所傳的耶穌觢令你們出來！」
verses.e: But some of the itinerant Jews , exorcists , took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus , saying , " We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches . "

verses.z: 做這事的，有猶太祭司長士基瓦的七個兒子。
verses.e: There were seven sons of one Sceva , a Jewish chief priest , who did this .

verses.z: 惡鬼回答他們說：「耶穌我認識，保羅我也知道。你們卻是誰呢？」
verses.e: The evil spirit answered , " Jesus I know , and Paul I know , but who are you ? "

verses.z: 惡鬼所附的人就跳在他們身上，勝了其中二人，制伏他們，叫他們赤着身子受了傷，從那房子裏逃出去了。
verses.e: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them , overpowered them , and prevailed against them , so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded .

verses.z: 凡住在以弗所的，無論是猶太人，是希臘人，都知道這事，也都懼怕；主耶穌的名從此就尊大了。
verses.e: This became known to all , both Jews and Greeks , who lived at Ephesus . Fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .

verses.z: 那已經信的，多有人來承認訴說自己所行的事。
verses.e: Many also of those who had believed came , confessing and declaring their deeds .

verses.z: 平素行邪術的，也有許多人把書拿來，堆積在眾人面前焚燒。他們算計書價，便知道共合五萬塊錢。
verses.e: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all . They counted their price , and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver .

verses.z: 問他們說：「你們信的時候受了聖靈沒有？」他們回答說：「沒有，也未曾聽見有聖靈[賜下來]。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed ? " They said to him , " No , we haven't even heard that there is a Holy Spirit . "

verses.z: 主的道大大興旺，而且得勝，就是這樣。
verses.e: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty .

verses.z: 這些事完了，保羅心裏定意經過了馬其頓、亞該亞，就往耶路撒冷去；又說：「我到了那裏以後，也必須往羅馬去看看。」
verses.e: Now after these things had ended , Paul determined in the Spirit , when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia , to go to Jerusalem , saying , " After I have been there , I must also see Rome . "

verses.z: 於是從幫助他的人中打發提摩太、以拉都二人往馬其頓去，自己暫時等在亞細亞。
verses.e: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him , Timothy and Erastus , he himself stayed in Asia for a while .

verses.z: 那時，因為這道起的擾亂不小。
verses.e: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way .

verses.z: 有一個銀匠，名叫底米丟，是製造亞底米神銀龕的，他使這樣手藝人生意發達。
verses.e: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis , brought no little business to the craftsmen ,

verses.z: 他聚集他們和同行的工人，說：「眾位，你們知道我們是倚靠這生意發財。
verses.e: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation , and said , " Sirs , you know that by this business we have our wealth .

verses.z: 這保羅不但在以弗所，也幾乎在亞細亞全地，引誘迷惑許多人，說：『人手所做的，不是神。』這是你們所看見所聽見的。
verses.e: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone , but almost throughout all Asia , this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people , saying that they are no gods that are made with hands .

verses.z: 這樣，不獨我們這事業被人藐視，就是大女神亞底米的廟也要被人輕忽，連亞細亞全地和普天下所敬拜的大女神之威榮也要消滅了。」
verses.e: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute , but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worships . "

verses.z: 眾人聽見，就怒氣填胸，喊着說：「大哉，以弗所人的亞底米啊！」
verses.e: When they heard this they were filled with anger , and cried out , saying , " Great is Artemis of the Ephesians ! "

verses.z: 滿城都轟動起來。眾人拿住與保羅同行的馬其頓人該猶和亞里達古，齊心擁進戲園裏去。
verses.e: The whole city was filled with confusion , and they rushed with one accord into the theater , having seized Gaius and Aristarchus , men of Macedonia , Paul's companions in travel .

verses.z: 保羅說：「這樣，你們受的是甚麼洗呢？」他們說：「是約翰的洗。」
verses.e: He said , " Into what then were you baptized ? " They said , " Into John's baptism . "

verses.z: 保羅想要進去，到百姓那裏，門徒卻不許他去。
verses.e: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people , the disciples didn't allow him .

verses.z: 還有亞細亞幾位首領，是保羅的朋友，打發人來勸他，不要冒險到戲園裏去。
verses.e: Certain also of the Asiarchs , being his friends , sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater .

verses.z: 聚集的人紛紛亂亂，有喊叫這個的，有喊叫那個的；大半不知道是為甚麼聚集。
verses.e: Some therefore cried one thing , and some another , for the assembly was in confusion . Most of them didn't know why they had come together .

verses.z: 有人把亞歷山大從眾人中帶出來，猶太人推他往前，亞歷山大就擺手，要向百姓分訴；
verses.e: They brought Alexander out of the multitude , the Jews putting him forward . Alexander beckoned with his hand , and would have made a defense to the people .

verses.z: 只因他們認出他是猶太人，就大家同聲喊着說：「大哉！以弗所人的亞底米啊。」如此約有兩小時。
verses.e: But when they perceived that he was a Jew , all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out , " Great is Artemis of the Ephesians ! "

verses.z: 那城裏的書記安撫了眾人，就說：「以弗所人哪，誰不知道以弗所人的城是看守大亞底米的廟和從宙斯那裏落下來的[像]呢？
verses.e: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude , he said , " You men of Ephesus , what man is there who doesn't know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis , and of the image which fell down from Zeus ?

verses.z: 這事既是駁不倒的，你們就當安靜，不可造次。
verses.e: Seeing then that these things can't be denied , you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash .

verses.z: 你們把這些人帶來，他們並沒有偷竊廟中之物，也沒有謗讟我們的女神。
verses.e: For you have brought these men here , who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess .

verses.z: 若是底米丟和他同行的人有控告人的事，自有放告的日子，也有方伯可以彼此對告。
verses.e: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone , the courts are open and there are proconsuls . Let them press charges against one another .

verses.z: 你們若問別的事，就可以照常例聚集斷定。
verses.e: But if you seek anything about other matters , it will be settled in the regular assembly .

verses.z: 保羅說：「約翰所行的是悔改的洗，告訴百姓當信那在他以後要來的，就是耶穌。」
verses.e: Paul said , " John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance , saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him , that is , in Christ Jesus . "

verses.z: 今日的擾亂本是無緣無故，我們難免被查問。論到這樣聚眾，我們也說不出所以然來。」
verses.e: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today's riot , there being no cause . Concerning it , we wouldn't be able to give an account of this commotion . "

verses.z: 說了這話，便叫眾人散去。
verses.e: When he had thus spoken , he dismissed the assembly .

verses.z: 他們聽見這話，就奉主耶穌的名受洗。
verses.e: When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .

verses.z: 保羅按手在他們[頭]上，聖靈便降在他們身上，他們就說方言，又說預言。
verses.e: When Paul had laid his hands on them , the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied .

verses.z: 一共約有十二個人。
verses.e: They were about twelve men in all .

verses.z: 保羅進會堂，放膽講道，一連三個月，辯論上帝國的事，勸化眾人。
verses.e: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months , reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 後來，有些人心裏剛硬不信，在眾人面前毀謗這道，保羅就離開他們，也叫門徒與他們分離，便在推喇奴的學房天天辯論。
verses.e: But when some were hardened and disobedient , speaking evil of the Way before the multitude , he departed from them and separated the disciples , reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus .

verses.z: 五旬節到了，門徒都聚集在一處。
verses.e: Now when the day of Pentecost had come , they were all with one accord in one place .

verses.z: 弗呂家、旁非利亞、埃及的人，並靠近古利奈的利比亞一帶地方的人，從羅馬來的客旅中，或是猶太人，或是進[猶太]教的人，
verses.e: Phrygia , Pamphylia , Egypt , the parts of Libya around Cyrene , visitors from Rome , both Jews and proselytes ,

verses.z: 克里特和阿拉伯人，都聽見他們用我們的鄉談，講說上帝的大作為。」
verses.e: Cretans and Arabians — we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God ! "

verses.z: 眾人就都驚訝猜疑，彼此說：「這是甚麼意思呢？」
verses.e: They were all amazed and were perplexed , saying to one another , " What does this mean ? "

verses.z: 還有人譏誚說：「他們無非是新酒灌滿了。」
verses.e: Others , mocking , said , " They are filled with new wine . "

verses.z: 彼得和十一個使徒站起，高聲說：「猶太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，這件事你們當知道，也當側耳聽我的話。
verses.e: But Peter , standing up with the eleven , lifted up his voice and spoke out to them , " You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem , let this be known to you , and listen to my words .

verses.z: 你們想這些人是醉了；其實不是醉了，因為時候剛到巳初。
verses.e: For these aren't drunken , as you suppose , seeing it is only the third hour of the day .

verses.z: 這正是先知約珥所說的：
verses.e: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel :

verses.z: 上帝說：在末後的日子，我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。你們的兒女要說預言；你們的少年人要見異象；老年人要做異夢。
verses.e: ' It will be in the last days , says God , that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh . Your sons and your daughters will prophesy . Your young men will see visions . Your old men will dream dreams .

verses.z: 在那些日子，我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女，他們就要說預言。
verses.e: Yes , and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days , I will pour out my Spirit , and they will prophesy .

verses.z: 在天上，我要顯出奇事；在地下，我要顯出神蹟；有血，有火，有煙霧。
verses.e: I will show wonders in the sky above , and signs on the earth beneath : blood , and fire , and billows of smoke .

verses.z: 忽然，從天上有響聲下來，好像一陣大風吹過，充滿了他們所坐的屋子，
verses.e: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .

verses.z: 日頭要變為黑暗，月亮要變為血；這都在主大而明顯的日子未到以前。
verses.e: The sun will be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes .

verses.z: 到那時候，凡求告主名的，就必得救。
verses.e: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved . '

verses.z: 「以色列人哪，請聽我的話：上帝藉着拿撒勒人耶穌在你們中間施行異能、奇事、神蹟，將他證明出來，這是你們自己知道的。
verses.e: " Men of Israel , hear these words ! Jesus of Nazareth , a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you , even as you yourselves know ,

verses.z: 他既按着上帝的定旨先見被交與人，你們就藉着無法之人的手，把他釘在十字架上，殺了。
verses.e: him , being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God , you have taken by the hand of lawless men , crucified and killed ;

verses.z: 上帝卻將死的痛苦解釋了，叫他復活，因為他原不能被死拘禁。
verses.e: whom God raised up , having freed him from the agony of death , because it was not possible that he should be held by it .

verses.z: 大衛指着他說：我看見主常在我眼前；他在我右邊，叫我不至於搖動。
verses.e: For David says concerning him , ' I saw the Lord always before my face , for he is on my right hand , that I should not be moved .

verses.z: 所以，我心裏歡喜，我的靈快樂；並且我的肉身要安居在指望中。
verses.e: Therefore my heart was glad , and my tongue rejoiced . Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope ,

verses.z: 因你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間，也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
verses.e: because you will not leave my soul in Hades , neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay .

verses.z: 你已將生命的道路指示我，必叫我因見你的面得着滿足的快樂。
verses.e: You made known to me the ways of life . You will make me full of gladness with your presence . '

verses.z: 「弟兄們！先祖大衛的事，我可以明明地對你們說：他死了，也葬埋了，並且他的墳墓直到今日還在我們這裏。
verses.e: " Brothers , I may tell you freely of the patriarch David , that he both died and was buried , and his tomb is with us to this day .

verses.z: 又有舌頭如火焰顯現出來，分開落在他們各人頭上。
verses.e: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them , and one sat on each of them .

verses.z: 大衛既是先知，又曉得上帝曾向他起誓，要從他的後裔中立一位坐在他的寶座上，
verses.e: Therefore , being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body , according to the flesh , he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne ,

verses.z: 就預先看明這事，講論基督復活說：他的靈魂不撇在陰間；他的肉身也不見朽壞。
verses.e: he foreseeing this , spoke about the resurrection of the Christ , that his soul wasn't left in Hades , and his flesh didn't see decay .

verses.z: 這耶穌，上帝已經叫他復活了，我們都為這事作見證。
verses.e: This Jesus God raised up , to which we all are witnesses .

verses.z: 他既被上帝的右手高舉，又從父受了所應許的聖靈，就把你們所看見所聽見的，澆灌下來。
verses.e: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God , and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit , he has poured out this which you now see and hear .

verses.z: 大衛並沒有升到天上，但自己說：主對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，
verses.e: For David didn't ascend into the heavens , but he says himself , ' The Lord said to my Lord , " Sit by my right hand

verses.z: 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
verses.e: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet . " '

verses.z: 「故此，以色列全家當確實地知道，你們釘在十字架上的這位耶穌，上帝已經立他為主，為基督了。」
verses.e: " Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ , this Jesus whom you crucified . "

verses.z: 眾人聽見這話，覺得扎心，就對彼得和其餘的使徒說：「弟兄們，我們當怎樣行？」
verses.e: Now when they heard this , they were cut to the heart , and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles , " Brothers , what shall we do ? "

verses.z: 彼得說：「你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈；
verses.e: Peter said to them , " Repent and be baptized , every one of you , in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins , and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 因為這應許是給你們和你們的兒女，並一切在遠方的人，就是主－我們上帝所召來的。」
verses.e: For the promise is to you and to your children , and to all who are far off , even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself . "

verses.z: 他們就都被聖靈充滿，按着[聖]靈所賜的口才說起別國的話來。
verses.e: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages , as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak .

verses.z: 彼得還用許多話作見證，勸勉他們說：「你們當救自己脫離這彎曲的世代。」
verses.e: With many other words he testified and exhorted them , saying , " Save yourselves from this crooked generation ! "

verses.z: 於是領受他話的人就受了洗。那一天，[門徒]約添了三千人，
verses.e: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized . There were added that day about three thousand souls .

verses.z: 都恆心遵守使徒的教訓，彼此交接，擘餅，祈禱。
verses.e: They continued steadfastly in the apostles ' teaching and fellowship , in the breaking of bread , and prayer .

verses.z: 眾人都懼怕；使徒又行了許多奇事神蹟。
verses.e: Fear came on every soul , and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles .

verses.z: 信的人都在一處，凡物公用，
verses.e: All who believed were together , and had all things in common .

verses.z: 並且賣了田產、家業，照各人所需用的分給各人。
verses.e: They sold their possessions and goods , and distributed them to all , according as anyone had need .

verses.z: 他們天天同心合意恆切地在殿裏，且在家中擘餅，存着歡喜、誠實的心用飯，
verses.e: Day by day , continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple , and breaking bread at home , they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart ,

verses.z: 讚美上帝，得眾民的喜愛。主將得救的人天天加給他們。
verses.e: praising God and having favor with all the people . The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved .

verses.z: 那時，有虔誠的猶太人從天下各國來，住在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews , devout men , from every nation under the sky .

verses.z: 這聲音一響，眾人都來聚集，各人聽見門徒用眾人的鄉談說話，就甚納悶；
verses.e: When this sound was heard , the multitude came together and were bewildered , because everyone heard them speaking in his own language .

verses.z: 都驚訝希奇說：「看哪，這說話的不都是加利利人嗎？
verses.e: They were all amazed and marveled , saying to one another , " Behold , aren't all these who speak Galileans ?

verses.z: 我們各人怎麼聽見他們說我們生來所用的鄉談呢？
verses.e: How do we hear , everyone in our own native language ?

verses.z: 我們帕提亞人、米底亞人、以攔人，和住在美索不達米亞、猶太、加帕多家、本都、亞細亞、
verses.e: Parthians , Medes , Elamites , and people from Mesopotamia , Judea , Cappadocia , Pontus , Asia ,

verses.z: 亂定之後，保羅請門徒來，勸勉他們，就辭別起行，往馬其頓去。
verses.e: After the uproar had ceased , Paul sent for the disciples , took leave of them , and departed to go into Macedonia .

verses.z: 保羅下去，伏在他身上，抱着他，說：「你們不要發慌，他的靈魂還在身上。」
verses.e: Paul went down and fell upon him , and embracing him said , " Don't be troubled , for his life is in him . "

verses.z: 保羅又上去，擘餅，吃了，談論許久，直到天亮，這才走了。
verses.e: When he had gone up , had broken bread and eaten , and had talked with them a long while , even until break of day , he departed .

verses.z: 有人把那童子活活地領來，得的安慰不小。
verses.e: They brought the boy in alive , and were greatly comforted .

verses.z: 我們先上船，開往亞朔去，意思要在那裏接保羅；因為他是這樣安排的，他自己打算要步行。
verses.e: But we , going ahead to the ship , set sail for Assos , intending to take Paul aboard there ; for he had so arranged , intending himself to go by land .

verses.z: 他既在亞朔與我們相會，我們就接他上船，來到米推利尼。
verses.e: When he met us at Assos , we took him aboard and came to Mitylene .

verses.z: 從那裏開船，次日到了基阿的對面；又次日，在撒摩靠岸；又次日，來到米利都。
verses.e: Sailing from there , we came the following day opposite Chios . The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium , and the day after we came to Miletus .

verses.z: 乃因保羅早已定意越過以弗所，免得在亞細亞耽延，他急忙前走，巴不得趕五旬節能到耶路撒冷。
verses.e: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus , that he might not have to spend time in Asia ; for he was hastening , if it were possible for him , to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost .

verses.z: 保羅從米利都打發人往以弗所去，請教會的長老來。
verses.e: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly .

verses.z: 他們來了，保羅就說：「你們知道，自從我到亞細亞的日子以來，在你們中間始終為人如何，
verses.e: When they had come to him , he said to them , " You yourselves know , from the first day that I set foot in Asia , how I was with you all the time ,

verses.z: 服事主，凡事謙卑，眼中流淚，又因猶太人的謀害，經歷試煉。
verses.e: serving the Lord with all humility , with many tears , and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews ;

verses.z: 走遍了那一帶地方，用許多話勸勉門徒，然後來到希臘。
verses.e: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words , he came into Greece .

verses.z: 你們也知道，凡與你們有益的，我沒有一樣避諱不說的，或在眾人面前，或在各人家裏，我都教導你們；
verses.e: how I didn't shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable , teaching you publicly and from house to house ,

verses.z: 又對猶太人和希臘人證明當向上帝悔改，信靠我主耶穌基督。
verses.e: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus .

verses.z: 現在我往耶路撒冷去，心甚迫切，不知道在那裏要遇見甚麼事；
verses.e: Now , behold , I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem , not knowing what will happen to me there ;

verses.z: 但知道聖靈在各城裏向我指證，說有捆鎖與患難等待我。
verses.e: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me .

verses.z: 我卻不以性命為念，也不看為寶貴，只要行完我的路程，成就我從主耶穌所領受的職事，證明上帝恩惠的福音。
verses.e: But these things don't count ; nor do I hold my life dear to myself , so that I may finish my race with joy , and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus , to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God .

verses.z: 「我素常在你們中間來往，傳講上帝國[的道]；如今我曉得，你們以後都不得再見我的面了。
verses.e: " Now , behold , I know that you all , among whom I went about preaching God's Kingdom , will see my face no more .

verses.z: 所以我今日向你們證明，你們中間無論何人死亡，罪不在我身上。
verses.e: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men ,

verses.z: 因為上帝的旨意，我並沒有一樣避諱不傳給你們的。
verses.e: for I didn't shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God .

verses.z: 聖靈立你們作全群的監督，你們就當為自己謹慎，也為全群謹慎，牧養上帝的教會，就是他用自己血所買來的。
verses.e: Take heed , therefore , to yourselves and to all the flock , in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers , to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood .

verses.z: 我知道，我去之後必有兇暴的豺狼進入你們中間，不愛惜羊群。
verses.e: For I know that after my departure , vicious wolves will enter in among you , not sparing the flock .

verses.z: 在那裏住了三個月，將要坐船往敘利亞去，猶太人設計要害他，他就定意從馬其頓回去。
verses.e: When he had spent three months there , and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria , he determined to return through Macedonia .

verses.z: 就是你們中間，也必有人起來說悖謬的話，要引誘門徒跟從他們。
verses.e: Men will arise from among your own selves , speaking perverse things , to draw away the disciples after them .

verses.z: 所以你們應當警醒，記念我三年之久晝夜不住地流淚、勸戒你們各人。
verses.e: Therefore watch , remembering that for a period of three years I didn't cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears .

verses.z: 如今我把你們交託上帝和他恩惠的道；這道能建立你們，叫你們和一切成聖的人同得基業。
verses.e: Now , brothers , I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace , which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified .

verses.z: 我未曾貪圖一個人的金、銀、衣服。
verses.e: I coveted no one's silver , gold , or clothing .

verses.z: 我這兩隻手常供給我和同人的需用，這是你們自己知道的。
verses.e: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities , and those who were with me .

verses.z: 我凡事給你們作榜樣，叫你們知道應當這樣勞苦，扶助軟弱的人，又當記念主耶穌的話，說：『施比受更為有福。』」
verses.e: In all things I gave you an example , that so laboring you ought to help the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , that he himself said , ' It is more blessed to give than to receive . ' "

verses.z: 保羅說完了這話，就跪下同眾人禱告。
verses.e: When he had spoken these things , he knelt down and prayed with them all .

verses.z: 眾人痛哭，抱着保羅的頸項，和他親嘴。
verses.e: They all wept freely , and fell on Paul's neck and kissed him ,

verses.z: 叫他們最傷心的，就是他說「以後不能再見我的面」那句話，於是送他上船去了。
verses.e: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken , that they should see his face no more . Then they accompanied him to the ship .

verses.z: 同他到亞細亞去的，有庇哩亞人畢羅斯的兒子所巴特，帖撒羅尼迦人亞里達古和西公都，還有特庇人該猶，並提摩太，又有亞細亞人推基古和特羅非摩。
verses.e: These accompanied him as far as Asia : Sopater of Beroea , Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians , Gaius of Derbe , Timothy , and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia .

verses.z: 這些人先走，在特羅亞等候我們。
verses.e: But these had gone ahead , and were waiting for us at Troas .

verses.z: 過了除酵的日子，我們從腓立比開船，五天到了特羅亞，和他們相會，在那裏住了七天。
verses.e: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread , and came to them at Troas in five days , where we stayed seven days .

verses.z: 七日的第一日，我們聚會擘餅的時候，保羅因為要次日起行，就與他們講論，直講到半夜。
verses.e: On the first day of the week , when the disciples were gathered together to break bread , Paul talked with them , intending to depart on the next day ; and continued his speech until midnight .

verses.z: 我們聚會的那座樓上，有好些燈燭。
verses.e: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together .

verses.z: 有一個少年人，名叫猶推古，坐在窗臺上，困倦沉睡。保羅講了多時，少年人睡熟了，就從三層樓上掉下去；扶起他來，已經死了。
verses.e: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window , weighed down with deep sleep . As Paul spoke still longer , being weighed down by his sleep , he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead .

verses.z: 我們離別了眾人，就開船一直行到哥士。第二天到了羅底，從那裏到帕大喇，
verses.e: When we had departed from them and had set sail , we came with a straight course to Cos , and the next day to Rhodes , and from there to Patara .

verses.z: 我們在那裏多住了幾天，有一個先知，名叫亞迦布，從猶太下來，
verses.e: As we stayed there some days , a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea .

verses.z: 到了我們這裏，就拿保羅的腰帶捆上自己的手腳，說：「聖靈說：猶太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆綁這腰帶的主人，把他交在外邦人手裏。」
verses.e: Coming to us and taking Paul's belt , he bound his own feet and hands , and said , " The Holy Spirit says : ' So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt , and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles . ' "

verses.z: 我們和那本地的人聽見這話，都苦勸保羅不要上耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: When we heard these things , both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 保羅說：「你們為甚麼這樣痛哭，使我心碎呢？我為主耶穌的名，不但被人捆綁，就是死在耶路撒冷也是願意的。」
verses.e: Then Paul answered , " What are you doing , weeping and breaking my heart ? For I am ready not only to be bound , but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus . "

verses.z: 保羅既不聽勸，我們便住了口，只說：「願主的旨意成就」，便了。
verses.e: When he would not be persuaded , we ceased , saying , " The Lord's will be done . "

verses.z: 過了幾日，我們收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 有凱撒利亞的幾個門徒和我們同去，帶我們到一個久為門徒的家裏，叫我們與他同住；他名叫拿孫，是塞浦路斯人。
verses.e: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us , bringing one Mnason of Cyprus , an early disciple , with whom we would stay .

verses.z: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄們歡歡喜喜地接待我們。
verses.e: When we had come to Jerusalem , the brothers received us gladly .

verses.z: 第二天，保羅同我們去見雅各；長老們也都在那裏。
verses.e: The day following , Paul went in with us to James ; and all the elders were present .

verses.z: 保羅問了他們安，便將上帝用他傳教，在外邦人中間所行之事，一一地述說了。
verses.e: When he had greeted them , he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry .

verses.z: 遇見一隻船要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。
verses.e: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia , we went aboard and set sail .

verses.z: 他們聽見，就歸榮耀與上帝，對保羅說：「兄台，你看猶太人中信主的有多少萬，並且都為律法熱心。
verses.e: They , when they heard it , glorified God . They said to him , " You see , brother , how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed , and they are all zealous for the law .

verses.z: 他們聽見人說，你教訓一切在外邦的猶太人離棄摩西，對他們說，不要給孩子行割禮，也不要遵行條規。
verses.e: They have been informed about you , that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses , telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs .

verses.z: 眾人必聽見你來了，這可怎麼辦呢？
verses.e: What then ? The assembly must certainly meet , for they will hear that you have come .

verses.z: 你就照着我們的話行吧！我們這裏有四個人，都有願在身。
verses.e: Therefore do what we tell you . We have four men who have taken a vow .

verses.z: 你帶他們去，與他們一同行潔淨的禮，替他們拿出規費，叫他們得以剃頭。這樣，眾人就可知道，先前所聽見你的事都是虛的；並可知道，你自己為人，循規蹈矩，遵行律法。
verses.e: Take them and purify yourself with them , and pay their expenses for them , that they may shave their heads . Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you , but that you yourself also walk keeping the law .

verses.z: 至於信主的外邦人，我們已經寫信擬定，叫他們謹忌那祭偶像之物，和血，並勒死的牲畜，與姦淫。」
verses.e: But concerning the Gentiles who believe , we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing , except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols , from blood , from strangled things , and from sexual immorality . "

verses.z: 於是保羅帶着那四個人，第二天與他們一同行了潔淨的禮，進了殿，報明潔淨的日期滿足，只等[祭司]為他們各人獻祭。
verses.e: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple , declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification , until the offering was offered for every one of them .

verses.z: 那七日將完，從亞細亞來的猶太人看見保羅在殿裏，就聳動了眾人，下手拿他，
verses.e: When the seven days were almost completed , the Jews from Asia , when they saw him in the temple , stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him ,

verses.z: 喊叫說：「以色列人來幫助，這就是在各處教訓眾人糟踐[我們]百姓和律法，並這地方的。他又帶着希臘人進殿，污穢了這聖地。」（
verses.e: crying out , " Men of Israel , help ! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people , and the law , and this place . Moreover , he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place ! "

verses.z: 這話是因他們曾看見以弗所人特羅非摩同保羅在城裏，以為保羅帶他進了殿。）
verses.e: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city , and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple .

verses.z: 望見塞浦路斯，就從南邊行過，往敘利亞去，我們就在泰爾上岸，因為船要在那裏卸貨。
verses.e: When we had come in sight of Cyprus , leaving it on the left hand , we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre , for the ship was there to unload her cargo .

verses.z: 合城都震動，百姓一齊跑來，拿住保羅，拉他出殿，殿門立刻都關了。
verses.e: All the city was moved and the people ran together . They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple . Immediately the doors were shut .

verses.z: 他們正想要殺他，有人報信給營裏的千夫長說：「耶路撒冷合城都亂了。」
verses.e: As they were trying to kill him , news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar .

verses.z: 千夫長立時帶着兵丁和幾個百夫長，跑下去到他們那裏。他們見了千夫長和兵丁，就止住不打保羅。
verses.e: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them . They , when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers , stopped beating Paul .

verses.z: 於是千夫長上前拿住他，吩咐用兩條鐵鍊捆鎖；又問他是甚麼人，做的是甚麼事。
verses.e: Then the commanding officer came near , arrested him , commanded him to be bound with two chains , and inquired who he was and what he had done .

verses.z: 眾人有喊叫這個的，有喊叫那個的；千夫長因為這樣亂嚷，得不着實情，就吩咐人將保羅帶進營樓去。
verses.e: Some shouted one thing and some another , among the crowd . When he couldn't find out the truth because of the noise , he commanded him to be brought into the barracks .

verses.z: 到了臺階上，眾人擠得兇猛，兵丁只得將保羅抬起來。
verses.e: When he came to the stairs , he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd ;

verses.z: 眾人跟在後面，喊着說：「除掉他！」
verses.e: for the multitude of the people followed after , crying out , " Away with him ! "

verses.z: 將要帶他進營樓，保羅對千夫長說：「我對你說句話可以不可以？」他說：「你懂得希臘話嗎？
verses.e: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks , he asked the commanding officer , " May I speak to you ? " He said , " Do you know Greek ?

verses.z: 你莫非是從前作亂、帶領四千兇徒往曠野去的那埃及人嗎？」
verses.e: Aren't you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins ? "

verses.z: 保羅說：「我本是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，並不是無名小城的人。求你准我對百姓說話。」
verses.e: But Paul said , " I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia , a citizen of no insignificant city . I beg you , allow me to speak to the people . "

verses.z: 找着了門徒，就在那裏住了七天。他們被聖靈感動，對保羅說：「不要上耶路撒冷去。」
verses.e: Having found disciples , we stayed there seven days . These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 千夫長准了。保羅就站在臺階上，向百姓擺手，他們都靜默無聲，保羅便用希伯來話對他們說：
verses.e: When he had given him permission , Paul , standing on the stairs , beckoned with his hand to the people . When there was a great silence , he spoke to them in the Hebrew language , saying ,

verses.z: 過了這幾天，我們就起身前行。他們眾人同妻子兒女，送我們到城外，我們都跪在岸上禱告，彼此辭別。
verses.e: When those days were over , we departed and went on our journey . They all , with wives and children , brought us on our way until we were out of the city . Kneeling down on the beach , we prayed .

verses.z: 我們上了船，他們就回家去了。
verses.e: After saying goodbye to each other , we went on board the ship , and they returned home again .

verses.z: 我們從泰爾行盡了水路，來到多利買，就問那裏的弟兄安，和他們同住了一天。
verses.e: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre , we arrived at Ptolemais . We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day .

verses.z: 第二天，我們離開那裏，來到凱撒利亞，就進了傳福音的腓利家裏，和他同住。他是那七個[執事]裏的一個。
verses.e: On the next day , we who were Paul's companions departed and came to Caesarea . We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist , who was one of the seven , and stayed with him .

verses.z: 他有四個女兒，都是處女，是說預言的。
verses.e: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied .

verses.z: 「諸位父兄請聽，我現在對你們分訴。」
verses.e: " Brothers and fathers , listen to the defense which I now make to you . "

verses.z: 我說：『主啊，我當做甚麼？』主說：『起來，進大馬士革去，在那裏，要將所派你做的一切事告訴你。』
verses.e: I said , ' What shall I do , Lord ? ' The Lord said to me , ' Arise , and go into Damascus . There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do . '

verses.z: 我因那光的榮耀不能看見，同行的人就拉着我手進了大馬士革。
verses.e: When I couldn't see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of those who were with me , I came into Damascus .

verses.z: 那[裏]有一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，按着律法是虔誠人，為一切住在那裏的猶太人所稱讚。
verses.e: " One Ananias , a devout man according to the law , well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus ,

verses.z: 他來見我，站在旁邊，對我說：『兄弟掃羅，你可以看見。』我當時往上一看，就看見了他。
verses.e: came to me , and standing by me said to me , ' Brother Saul , receive your sight ! ' In that very hour I looked up at him .

verses.z: 他又說：『我們祖宗的上帝揀選了你，叫你明白他的旨意，又得見那義者，聽他口中所出的聲音。
verses.e: He said , ' The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will , and to see the Righteous One , and to hear a voice from his mouth .

verses.z: 因為你要將所看見的，所聽見的，對着萬人為他作見證。
verses.e: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard .

verses.z: 現在你為甚麼耽延呢？起來，求告他的名受洗，洗去你的罪。』」
verses.e: Now why do you wait ? Arise , be baptized , and wash away your sins , calling on the name of the Lord . '

verses.z: 「後來，我回到耶路撒冷，在殿裏禱告的時候，魂遊象外，
verses.e: " When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple , I fell into a trance

verses.z: 看見主向我說：『你趕緊地離開耶路撒冷，不可遲延；因你為我作的見證，這裏的人必不領受。』
verses.e: and saw him saying to me , ' Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly , because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you . '

verses.z: 我就說：『主啊，他們知道我從前把信你的人收在監裏，又在各會堂裏鞭打他們。
verses.e: I said , ' Lord , they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you .

verses.z: 眾人聽他說的是希伯來話，就更加安靜了。
verses.e: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language , they were even more quiet . He said ,

verses.z: 並且你的見證人司提反被害流血的時候，我也站在旁邊歡喜；又看守害死他之人的衣裳。』
verses.e: When the blood of Stephen , your witness , was shed , I also was standing by , consenting to his death , and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him . '

verses.z: 主向我說：『你去吧！我要差你遠遠地往外邦人那裏去。』」
verses.e: " He said to me , ' Depart , for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles . ' "

verses.z: 眾人聽他說到這句話，就高聲說：「這樣的人，從世上除掉他吧！他是不當活着的。」
verses.e: They listened to him until he said that ; then they lifted up their voice and said , " Rid the earth of this fellow , for he isn't fit to live ! "

verses.z: 眾人喧嚷，摔掉衣裳，把塵土向空中揚起來。
verses.e: As they cried out , threw off their cloaks , and threw dust into the air ,

verses.z: 千夫長就吩咐將保羅帶進營樓去，叫人用鞭子拷問他，要知道他們向他這樣喧嚷是為甚麼緣故。
verses.e: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks , ordering him to be examined by scourging , that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that .

verses.z: 剛用皮條捆上，保羅對旁邊站着的百夫長說：「人是羅馬人，又沒有定罪，你們就鞭打他，有這個例嗎？」
verses.e: When they had tied him up with straps , Paul asked the centurion who stood by , " Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman , and not found guilty ? "

verses.z: 百夫長聽見這話，就去見千夫長，告訴他說：「你要做甚麼？這人是羅馬人。」
verses.e: When the centurion heard it , he went to the commanding officer and told him , " Watch what you are about to do , for this man is a Roman ! "

verses.z: 千夫長就來問保羅說：「你告訴我，你是羅馬人嗎？」保羅說：「是。」
verses.e: The commanding officer came and asked him , " Tell me , are you a Roman ? " He said , " Yes . "

verses.z: 千夫長說：「我用許多銀子才入了羅馬的民籍。」保羅說：「我生來就是。」
verses.e: The commanding officer answered , " I bought my citizenship for a great price . " Paul said , " But I was born a Roman . "

verses.z: 於是那些要拷問保羅的人就離開他去了。千夫長既知道他是羅馬人，又因為捆綁了他，也害怕了。
verses.e: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him , and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman , because he had bound him .

verses.z: 保羅說：「我原是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，長在這城裏，在迦瑪列門下，按着我們祖宗嚴緊的律法受教，熱心事奉上帝，像你們眾人今日一樣。
verses.e: " I am indeed a Jew , born in Tarsus of Cilicia , but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel , instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers , being zealous for God , even as you all are today .

verses.z: 第二天，千夫長為要知道猶太人控告保羅的實情，便解開他，吩咐祭司長和全公會的人都聚集，將保羅帶下來，叫他站在他們面前。
verses.e: But on the next day , desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews , he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together , and brought Paul down and set him before them .

verses.z: 我也曾逼迫奉這道的人，直到死地，無論男女都鎖拿下監。
verses.e: I persecuted this Way to the death , binding and delivering into prisons both men and women ,

verses.z: 這是大祭司和眾長老都可以給我作見證的。我又領了他們達與弟兄的書信，往大馬士革去，要把在那裏[奉這道]的人鎖拿，帶到耶路撒冷受刑。」
verses.e: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify , from whom also I received letters to the brothers , and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished .

verses.z: 「我將到大馬士革，正走的時候，約在晌午，忽然從天上發大光，四面照着我。
verses.e: " As I made my journey and came close to Damascus , about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky .

verses.z: 我就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對我說：『掃羅！掃羅！你為甚麼逼迫我？』
verses.e: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me , ' Saul , Saul , why are you persecuting me ? '

verses.z: 我回答說：『主啊，你是誰？』他說：『我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶穌。』
verses.e: I answered , ' Who are you , Lord ? ' He said to me , ' I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom you persecute . '

verses.z: 與我同行的人看見了那光，卻沒有聽明那位對我說話的聲音。
verses.e: " Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid , but they didn't understand the voice of him who spoke to me .

verses.z: 保羅定睛看着公會的人，說：「弟兄們，我在上帝面前行事為人都是憑着良心，直到今日。」
verses.e: Paul , looking steadfastly at the council , said , " Brothers , I have lived before God in all good conscience until today . "

verses.z: 那時大起爭吵，千夫長恐怕保羅被他們扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他從眾人當中搶出來，帶進營樓去。
verses.e: When a great argument arose , the commanding officer , fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them , commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks .

verses.z: 當夜，主站在保羅旁邊，說：「放心吧！你怎樣在耶路撒冷為我作見證，也必怎樣在羅馬[為我]作見證。」
verses.e: The following night , the Lord stood by him and said , " Cheer up , Paul , for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem , so you must testify also at Rome . "

verses.z: 到了天亮，猶太人同謀起誓，說：「若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。」
verses.e: When it was day , some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse , saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul .

verses.z: 這樣同心起誓的有四十多人。
verses.e: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy .

verses.z: 他們來見祭司長和長老，說：「我們已經起了一個大誓，若不先殺保羅就不吃甚麼。
verses.e: They came to the chief priests and the elders , and said , " We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul .

verses.z: 現在你們和公會要知會千夫長，叫他帶下保羅到你們這裏來，假作要詳細察考他的事；我們已經預備好了，不等他來到跟前就殺他。」
verses.e: Now therefore , you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow , as though you were going to judge his case more exactly . We are ready to kill him before he comes near . "

verses.z: 保羅的外甥聽見他們設下埋伏，就來到營樓裏告訴保羅。
verses.e: But Paul's sister's son heard they were lying in wait , and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul .

verses.z: 保羅請一個百夫長來，說：「你領這少年人去見千夫長，他有事告訴他。」
verses.e: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said , " Bring this young man to the commanding officer , for he has something to tell him . "

verses.z: 於是把他領去見千夫長，說：「被囚的保羅請我到他那裏，求我領這少年人來見你；他有事告訴你。」
verses.e: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said , " Paul , the prisoner , summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you . He has something to tell you . "

verses.z: 千夫長就拉着他的手，走到一旁，私下問他說：「你有甚麼事告訴我呢？」
verses.e: The commanding officer took him by the hand , and going aside , asked him privately , " What is it that you have to tell me ? "

verses.z: 大祭司亞拿尼亞就吩咐旁邊站着的人打他的嘴。
verses.e: The high priest , Ananias , commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth .

verses.z: 他說：「猶太人已經約定，要求你明天帶下保羅到公會裏去，假作要詳細查問他的事。
verses.e: He said , " The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow , as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him .

verses.z: 你切不要隨從他們；因為他們有四十多人埋伏，已經起誓說，若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。現在預備好了，只等你應允。」
verses.e: Therefore don't yield to them , for more than forty men lie in wait for him , who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him . Now they are ready , looking for the promise from you . "

verses.z: 於是千夫長打發少年人走，囑咐他說：「不要告訴人你將這事報給我了。」
verses.e: So the commanding officer let the young man go , charging him , " Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me . "

verses.z: 千夫長便叫了兩個百夫長來，說：「預備步兵二百，馬兵七十，長槍手二百，今夜亥初往凱撒利亞去；
verses.e: He called to himself two of the centurions , and said , " Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea , with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears , at the third hour of the night . "

verses.z: 也要預備牲口叫保羅騎上，護送到巡撫腓力斯那裏去。」
verses.e: He asked them to provide mounts , that they might set Paul on one , and bring him safely to Felix the governor .

verses.z: 千夫長又寫了文書，
verses.e: He wrote a letter like this :

verses.z: 大略說：「克勞第‧呂西亞，請巡撫腓力斯大人安。
verses.e: " Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix : Greetings .

verses.z: 這人被猶太人拿住，將要殺害，我得知他是羅馬人，就帶兵丁下去救他出來。
verses.e: " This man was seized by the Jews , and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him , having learned that he was a Roman .

verses.z: 因要知道他們告他的緣故，我就帶他下到他們的公會去，
verses.e: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him , I brought him down to their council .

verses.z: 便查知他被告是因他們律法的辯論，並沒有甚麼該死該綁的罪名。
verses.e: I found him to be accused about questions of their law , but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment .

verses.z: 保羅對他說：「你這粉飾的牆，上帝要打你！你坐堂為的是按律法審問我，你竟違背律法，吩咐人打我嗎？」
verses.e: Then Paul said to him , " God will strike you , you whitewashed wall ! Do you sit to judge me according to the law , and command me to be struck contrary to the law ? "

verses.z: 後來有人把要害他的計謀告訴我，我就立時解他到你那裏去，又吩咐告他的人在你面前告他。」
verses.e: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man , I sent him to you immediately , charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you . Farewell . "

verses.z: 於是，兵丁照所吩咐他們的，將保羅夜裏帶到安提帕底。
verses.e: So the soldiers , carrying out their orders , took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris .

verses.z: 第二天，讓馬兵護送，他們就回營樓去。
verses.e: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him , and returned to the barracks .

verses.z: 馬兵來到凱撒利亞，把文書呈給巡撫，便叫保羅站在他面前。
verses.e: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor , they also presented Paul to him .

verses.z: 巡撫看了文書，問保羅是哪省的人，既曉得他是基利家人，
verses.e: When the governor had read it , he asked what province he was from . When he understood that he was from Cilicia , he said ,

verses.z: 就說：「等告你的人來到，我要細聽你的事」；便吩咐人把他看守在希律的衙門裏。
verses.e: " I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive . " He commanded that he be kept in Herod's palace .

verses.z: 站在旁邊的人說：「你辱罵上帝的大祭司嗎？」
verses.e: Those who stood by said , " Do you malign God's high priest ? "

verses.z: 保羅說：「弟兄們，我不曉得他是大祭司；[經上]記着說：『不可毀謗你百姓的官長。』」
verses.e: Paul said , " I didn't know , brothers , that he was high priest . For it is written , ' You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people . ' "

verses.z: 保羅看出大眾一半是撒都該人，一半是法利賽人，就在公會中大聲說：「弟兄們，我是法利賽人，也是法利賽人的子孫。我現在受審問，是為盼望死人復活。」
verses.e: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees , he cried out in the council , " Men and brothers , I am a Pharisee , a son of Pharisees . Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged ! "

verses.z: 說了這話，法利賽人和撒都該人就爭論起來，會眾分為兩黨。
verses.e: When he had said this , an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees , and the crowd was divided .

verses.z: 因為撒都該人說，沒有復活，也沒有天使和鬼魂；法利賽人卻說，兩樣都有。
verses.e: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection , nor angel , nor spirit ; but the Pharisees confess all of these .

verses.z: 於是大大地喧嚷起來。有幾個法利賽黨的文士站起來爭辯說：「我們看不出這人有甚麼惡處，倘若有鬼魂或是天使對他說過話，怎麼樣呢？」
verses.e: A great clamor arose , and some of the scribes of the Pharisees ' part stood up , and contended , saying , " We find no evil in this man . But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him , let's not fight against God ! "

verses.z: 過了五天，大祭司亞拿尼亞同幾個長老，和一個辯士帖土羅下來，向巡撫控告保羅。
verses.e: After five days , the high priest , Ananias , came down with certain elders and an orator , one Tertullus . They informed the governor against Paul .

verses.z: 巡撫點頭叫保羅說話。他就說：「我知道你在這國裏斷事多年，所以我樂意為自己分訴。
verses.e: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 你查問就可以知道，從我上耶路撒冷禮拜到今日不過有十二天。
verses.e: In the temple they didn't find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd , either in the synagogues or in the city .

verses.z: 他們並沒有看見我在殿裏，或是在會堂裏，或是在城裏，和人辯論，聳動眾人。
verses.e: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me .

verses.z: 他們現在所告我的事並不能對你證實了。
verses.e: But this I confess to you , that according to the Way , which they call a sect , so I serve the God of our fathers , believing all things which are according to the law , and which are written in the prophets ;

verses.z: 但有一件事，我向你承認，就是他們所稱為異端的道，我正按着那道事奉我祖宗的上帝，又信合乎[律法]的和[先知書]上一切所記載的，
verses.e: having hope toward God , which these also themselves look for , that there will be a resurrection of the dead , both of the just and unjust .

verses.z: 並且靠着上帝，盼望死人，無論善惡，都要復活，就是他們自己也有這個盼望。
verses.e: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men .

verses.z: 我因此自己勉勵，對上帝對人，常存無虧的良心。
verses.e: Now after some years , I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation , and offerings ;

verses.z: 過了幾年，我帶着賙濟本國的捐項和供獻的物上去。
verses.e: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple , not with a mob , nor with turmoil .

verses.z: 正獻的時候，他們看見我在殿裏已經潔淨了，並沒有聚眾，也沒有吵嚷，惟有幾個從亞細亞來的猶太人。
verses.e: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me .

verses.z: 他們若有告我的事，就應當到你面前來告我。
verses.e: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council ,

verses.z: 保羅被提了來，帖土羅就告他說：
verses.e: When he was called , Tertullus began to accuse him , saying , " Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace , and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight ,

verses.z: 即或不然，這些人若看出我站在公會前，有妄為的地方，他們自己也可以說明。
verses.e: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them , ' Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today ! ' "

verses.z: 縱然有，也不過一句話，就是我站在他們中間大聲說：『我今日在你們面前受審，是為死人復活[的道理]。』」
verses.e: But Felix , having more exact knowledge concerning the Way , deferred them , saying , " When Lysias , the commanding officer , comes down , I will decide your case . "

verses.z: 腓力斯本是詳細曉得這道，就支吾他們說：「且等千夫長呂西亞下來，我要審斷你們的事。」
verses.e: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges , and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him .

verses.z: 於是吩咐百夫長看守保羅，並且寬待他，也不攔阻他的親友來供給他。
verses.e: After some days , Felix came with Drusilla his wife , who was a Jewess , and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 過了幾天，腓力斯和他夫人－猶太的女子土西拉－一同來到，就叫了保羅來，聽他講論信基督耶穌的道。
verses.e: As he reasoned about righteousness , self-control , and the judgment to come , Felix was terrified , and answered , " Go your way for this time , and when it is convenient for me , I will summon you . "

verses.z: 保羅講論公義、節制，和將來的審判。腓力斯甚覺恐懼，說：「你暫且去吧，等我得便再叫你來。」
verses.e: Meanwhile , he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul , that he might release him . Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him .

verses.z: 腓力斯又指望保羅送他銀錢，所以屢次叫他來，和他談論。
