verses.e: But when two years were fulfilled , Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus , and desiring to gain favor with the Jews , Felix left Paul in bonds .

verses.z: 過了兩年，波求‧非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要討猶太人的喜歡，就留保羅在監裏。
「腓力斯大人，我們因你得以大享太平，並且這一國的弊病，因着你的先見得以更正了；我們隨時隨地滿心感謝不盡。
verses.e: we accept it in all ways and in all places , most excellent Felix , with all thankfulness .

verses.z: 惟恐多說，你嫌煩絮，只求你寬容聽我們說幾句話。
verses.e: But that I don't delay you , I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words .

verses.z: 我們看這個人，如同瘟疫一般，是鼓動普天下眾猶太人生亂的，又是拿撒勒教黨裏的一個頭目，
verses.e: For we have found this man to be a plague , an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world , and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes .

verses.z: 連[聖]殿他也想要污穢；我們把他捉住了。
verses.e: He even tried to profane the temple , and we arrested him .
By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him . "

verses.z: 你自己究問他，就可以知道我們告他的一切事了。」
verses.e: The Jews also joined in the attack , affirming that these things were so .

verses.z: 眾猶太人也隨着告他說：「事情誠然是這樣。」
verses.e: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak , Paul answered , " Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years , I cheerfully make my defense ,

verses.z: 非斯都到了任，過了三天，就從凱撒利亞上耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: Festus therefore , having come into the province , after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea .

verses.z: 保羅說：「我站在凱撒的堂前，這就是我應當受審的地方。我向猶太人並沒有行過甚麼不義的事，這也是你明明知道的。
verses.e: But Paul said , " I am standing before Caesar's judgment seat , where I ought to be tried . I have done no wrong to the Jews , as you also know very well .

verses.z: 我若行了不義的事，犯了甚麼該死的罪，就是死，我也不辭。他們所告我的事若都不實，就沒有人可以把我交給他們。我要上告於凱撒。」
verses.e: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death , I don't refuse to die ; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of , no one can give me up to them . I appeal to Caesar ! "

verses.z: 非斯都和議會商量了，就說：「你既上告於凱撒，可以往凱撒那裏去。」
verses.e: Then Festus , when he had conferred with the council , answered , " You have appealed to Caesar . To Caesar you shall go . "

verses.z: 過了些日子，亞基帕王和百妮基氏來到凱撒利亞，問非斯都安。
verses.e: Now when some days had passed , King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus .

verses.z: 在那裏住了多日，非斯都將保羅的事告訴王，說：「這裏有一個人，是腓力斯留在監裏的。
verses.e: As he stayed there many days , Festus laid Paul's case before the king , saying , " There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix ;

verses.z: 我在耶路撒冷的時候，祭司長和猶太的長老將他的事稟報了我，求我定他的罪。
verses.e: about whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , asking for a sentence against him .

verses.z: 我對他們說，無論甚麼人，被告還沒有和原告對質，未得機會分訴所告他的事，就先定他的罪，這不是羅馬人的條例。
verses.e: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him .

verses.z: 及至他們都來到這裏，我就不耽延，第二天便坐堂，吩咐把那人提上來。
verses.e: When therefore they had come together here , I didn't delay , but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought .

verses.z: 告他的人站着告他；所告的，並沒有我所逆料的那等惡事。
verses.e: When the accusers stood up , they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed ;

verses.z: 不過是有幾樣辯論，為他們自己敬鬼神的事，又為一個人名叫耶穌，是已經死了，保羅卻說他是活着的。
verses.e: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus , who was dead , whom Paul affirmed to be alive .

verses.z: 祭司長和猶太人的首領向他控告保羅，
verses.e: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul , and they begged him ,

verses.z: 這些事當怎樣究問，我心裏作難，所以問他說：『你願意上耶路撒冷去，在那裏為這些事聽審嗎？』
verses.e: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things , I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters .

verses.z: 但保羅求我留下他，要聽皇上審斷，我就吩咐把他留下，等我解他到凱撒那裏去。」
verses.e: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor , I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar . "

verses.z: 亞基帕對非斯都說：「我自己也願聽這人辯論。」非斯都說：「明天你可以聽。」
verses.e: Agrippa said to Festus , " I also would like to hear the man myself . " " Tomorrow , " he said , " you shall hear him . "

verses.z: 第二天，亞基帕和百妮基大張威勢而來，同着眾千夫長和城裏的尊貴人進了公廳。非斯都吩咐一聲，就有人將保羅帶進來。
verses.e: So on the next day , when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp , and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city , at the command of Festus , Paul was brought in .

verses.z: 非斯都說：「亞基帕王和在這裏的諸位啊，你們看這人，就是一切猶太人，在耶路撒冷和這裏，曾向我懇求、呼叫說：『不可容他再活着。』
verses.e: Festus said , " King Agrippa , and all men who are here present with us , you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me , both at Jerusalem and here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .

verses.z: 但我查明他沒有犯甚麼該死的罪，並且他自己上告於皇帝，所以我定意把他解去。
verses.e: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death , and as he himself appealed to the emperor , I determined to send him ,

verses.z: 論到這人，我沒有確實的事可以奏明主上。因此，我帶他到你們面前，也特意帶他到你亞基帕王面前，為要在查問之後有所陳奏。
verses.e: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord . Therefore I have brought him out before you , and especially before you , King Agrippa , that , after examination I may have something to write .

verses.z: 據我看來，解送囚犯，不指明他的罪案是不合理的。」
verses.e: For it seems to me unreasonable , in sending a prisoner , not to also specify the charges against him . "

verses.z: 又央告他，求他的情，將保羅提到耶路撒冷來，他們要在路上埋伏殺害他。
verses.e: asking a favor against him , that he would summon him to Jerusalem , plotting to kill him on the way .

verses.z: 非斯都卻回答說：「保羅押在凱撒利亞，我自己快要往那裏去」；
verses.e: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea , and that he himself was about to depart shortly .

verses.z: 又說：「你們中間有權勢的人與我一同下去，那人若有甚麼不是，就可以告他。」
verses.e: " Let them therefore " , he said , " that are in power among you go down with me , and if there is anything wrong in the man , let them accuse him . "

verses.z: 非斯都在他們那裏住了不過十天八天，就下凱撒利亞去；第二天坐堂，吩咐將保羅提上來。
verses.e: When he had stayed among them more than ten days , he went down to Caesarea , and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat , and commanded Paul to be brought .

verses.z: 保羅來了，那些從耶路撒冷下來的猶太人周圍站着，將許多重大的事控告他，都是不能證實的。
verses.e: When he had come , the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him , bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove ,

verses.z: 保羅分訴說：「無論猶太人的律法，或是[聖]殿，或是凱撒，我都沒有干犯。」
verses.e: while he said in his defense , " Neither against the law of the Jews , nor against the temple , nor against Caesar , have I sinned at all . "

verses.z: 但非斯都要討猶太人的喜歡，就問保羅說：「你願意上耶路撒冷去，在那裏聽我審斷這事嗎？」
verses.e: But Festus , desiring to gain favor with the Jews , answered Paul and said , " Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things ? "

verses.z: 亞基帕對保羅說：「准你為自己辯明。」於是保羅伸手分訴，說：「
verses.e: Agrippa said to Paul , " You may speak for yourself . " Then Paul stretched out his hand , and made his defense .

verses.z: 我在耶路撒冷也曾這樣行了。既從祭司長得了權柄，我就把許多聖徒囚在監裏。他們被殺，我也出名定案。
verses.e: I also did this in Jerusalem . I both shut up many of the saints in prisons , having received authority from the chief priests ; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them .

verses.z: 在各會堂，我屢次用刑強逼他們說褻瀆的話，又分外惱恨他們，甚至追逼他們，直到外邦的城邑。」
verses.e: Punishing them often in all the synagogues , I tried to make them blaspheme . Being exceedingly enraged against them , I persecuted them even to foreign cities .

verses.z: 「那時，我領了祭司長的權柄和命令，往大馬士革去。
verses.e: " Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests ,

verses.z: 王啊，我在路上，晌午的時候，看見從天發光，比日頭還亮，四面照着我並與我同行的人。
verses.e: at noon , O king , I saw on the way a light from the sky , brighter than the sun , shining around me and those who traveled with me .

verses.z: 我們都仆倒在地，我就聽見有聲音用希伯來話向我說：『掃羅！掃羅！為甚麼逼迫我？你用腳踢刺是難的！』
verses.e: When we had all fallen to the earth , I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language , ' Saul , Saul , why are you persecuting me ? It is hard for you to kick against the goads . '

verses.z: 我說：『主啊，你是誰？』主說：『我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
verses.e: " I said , ' Who are you , Lord ? ' " He said , ' I am Jesus , whom you are persecuting .

verses.z: 你起來站着，我特意向你顯現，要派你作執事，作見證，將你所看見的事和我將要指示你的事證明出來。
verses.e: But arise , and stand on your feet , for I have appeared to you for this purpose : to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you ;

verses.z: 我也要救你脫離百姓和外邦人的手。
verses.e: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles , to whom I send you ,

verses.z: 我差你到他們那裏去，要叫他們的眼睛得開，從黑暗中歸向光明，從撒但權下歸向上帝；又因信我，得蒙赦罪，和一切成聖的人同得基業。』」
verses.e: to open their eyes , that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God , that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me . '

verses.z: 「亞基帕王啊，我故此沒有違背那從天上來的異象；
verses.e: " Therefore , King Agrippa , I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision ,

verses.z: 亞基帕王啊，猶太人所告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分訴，實為萬幸；
verses.e: " I think myself happy , King Agrippa , that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am accused by the Jews ,

verses.z: 先在大馬士革，後在耶路撒冷和猶太全地，以及外邦，勸勉他們應當悔改歸向上帝，行事與悔改的心相稱。
verses.e: but declared first to them of Damascus , at Jerusalem , and throughout all the country of Judea , and also to the Gentiles , that they should repent and turn to God , doing works worthy of repentance .

verses.z: 因此，猶太人在殿裏拿住我，想要殺我。
verses.e: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me .

verses.z: 然而我蒙上帝的幫助，直到今日還站得住，對着尊貴、卑賤、老幼作見證；所講的並不外乎眾先知和摩西所說將來必成的事，
verses.e: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God , I stand to this day testifying both to small and great , saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen ,

verses.z: 就是基督必須受害，並且因從死裏復活，要首先把光明的道傳給百姓和外邦人。」
verses.e: how the Christ must suffer , and how , by the resurrection of the dead , he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles . "

verses.z: 保羅這樣分訴，非斯都大聲說：「保羅，你癲狂了吧。你的學問太大，反叫你癲狂了！」
verses.e: As he thus made his defense , Festus said with a loud voice , " Paul , you are crazy ! Your great learning is driving you insane ! "

verses.z: 保羅說：「非斯都大人，我不是癲狂，我說的乃是真實明白話。
verses.e: But he said , " I am not crazy , most excellent Festus , but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness .

verses.z: 王也曉得這些事，所以我向王放膽直言，我深信這些事沒有一件向王隱藏的，因都不是在背地裏做的。
verses.e: For the king knows of these things , to whom also I speak freely . For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him , for this has not been done in a corner .

verses.z: 亞基帕王啊，你信先知嗎？我知道你是信的。」
verses.e: King Agrippa , do you believe the prophets ? I know that you believe . "

verses.z: 亞基帕對保羅說：「你想少微一勸，便叫我作基督徒啊！」
verses.e: Agrippa said to Paul , " With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian ? "

verses.z: 保羅說：「無論是少勸是多勸，我向上帝所求的，不但你一個人，就是今天一切聽我的，都要像我一樣，只是不要像我有這些鎖鍊。」
verses.e: Paul said , " I pray to God , that whether with little or with much , not only you , but also all that hear me today , might become such as I am , except for these bonds . "

verses.z: 更可幸的，是你熟悉猶太人的規矩和他們的辯論；所以求你耐心聽我。
verses.e: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews . Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently .

verses.z: 於是，王和巡撫並百妮基與同坐的人都起來，
verses.e: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice , and those who sat with them .

verses.z: 退到裏面，彼此談論說：「這人並沒有犯甚麼該死該綁的罪。」
verses.e: When they had withdrawn , they spoke to one another , saying , " This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds . "

verses.z: 亞基帕又對非斯都說：「這人若沒有上告於凱撒，就可以釋放了。」
verses.e: Agrippa said to Festus , " This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar . "

verses.z: 我從起初在本國的民中，並在耶路撒冷，自幼為人如何，猶太人都知道。
verses.e: " Indeed , all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up , which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 他們若肯作見證就曉得，我從起初是按着我們教中最嚴緊的教門作了法利賽人。
verses.e: having known me from the first , if they are willing to testify , that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee .

verses.z: 現在我站在這裏受審，是因為指望上帝向我們祖宗所應許的；
verses.e: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers ,

verses.z: 這應許，我們十二個支派，晝夜切切地事奉[上帝]，都指望得着。王啊，我被猶太人控告，就是因這指望。
verses.e: which our twelve tribes , earnestly serving night and day , hope to attain . Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews , King Agrippa !

verses.z: 上帝叫死人復活，你們為甚麼看作不可信的呢？
verses.e: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead ?

verses.z: 從前我自己以為應當多方攻擊拿撒勒人耶穌的名，
verses.e: " I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth .

verses.z: [非斯都]既然定規了，叫我們坐船往意大利去，便將保羅和別的囚犯交給御營裏的一個百夫長，名叫猶流。
verses.e: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy , they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius , of the Augustan band .

verses.z: 「眾位，我看這次行船，不但貨物和船要受損傷，大遭破壞，連我們的性命也難保。」
verses.e: and said to them , " Sirs , I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss , not only of the cargo and the ship , but also of our lives . "

verses.z: 但百夫長信從掌船的和船主，不信從保羅所說的。
verses.e: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul .

verses.z: 且因在這海口過冬不便，船上的人就多半說，不如開船離開這地方，或者能到菲尼基過冬。菲尼基是克里特的一個海口，一面朝東北，一面朝東南。
verses.e: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in , the majority advised going to sea from there , if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there , which is a port of Crete , looking southwest and northwest .

verses.z: 這時，微微起了南風，他們以為得意，就起了錨，貼近克里特行去。
verses.e: When the south wind blew softly , supposing that they had obtained their purpose , they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete , close to shore .

verses.z: 不多幾時，狂風從島上撲下來；那風名叫「友拉革羅」。
verses.e: But before long , a stormy wind beat down from shore , which is called Euroclydon .

verses.z: 船被風抓住，敵不住風，我們就任風颳去。
verses.e: When the ship was caught and couldn't face the wind , we gave way to it and were driven along .

verses.z: 貼着一個小島的背風岸奔行，那島名叫高大，在那裏僅僅收住了小船。
verses.e: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda , we were able , with difficulty , to secure the boat .

verses.z: 既然把小船拉上來，就用纜索捆綁船底，又恐怕在賽耳底沙灘上擱了淺，就落下篷來，任船飄去。
verses.e: After they had hoisted it up , they used cables to help reinforce the ship . Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars , they lowered the sea anchor , and so were driven along .

verses.z: 我們被風浪逼得甚急，第二天眾人就把[貨物]拋在海裏。
verses.e: As we labored exceedingly with the storm , the next day they began to throw things overboard .

verses.z: 到第三天，他們又親手把船上的器具拋棄了。
verses.e: On the third day , they threw out the ship's tackle with their own hands .

verses.z: 有一隻亞大米田的船，要沿着亞細亞一帶地方的海邊走，我們就上了那船開行；有馬其頓的帖撒羅尼迦人亞里達古和我們同去。
verses.e: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium , which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia , we put to sea , Aristarchus , a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us .

verses.z: 太陽和星辰多日不顯露，又有狂風大浪催逼，我們得救的指望就都絕了。
verses.e: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days , and no small storm pressed on us , all hope that we would be saved was now taken away .

verses.z: 眾人多日沒有吃甚麼，保羅就出來站在他們中間，說：「眾位，你們本該聽我的話，不離開克里特，免得遭這樣的傷損破壞。
verses.e: When they had been long without food , Paul stood up in the middle of them and said , " Sirs , you should have listened to me , and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss .

verses.z: 現在我還勸你們放心，你們的性命一個也不失喪，惟獨失喪這船。
verses.e: Now I exhort you to cheer up , for there will be no loss of life among you , but only of the ship .

verses.z: 因我所屬所事奉的上帝，他的使者昨夜站在我旁邊，說：
verses.e: For there stood by me this night an angel , belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve ,

verses.z: 『保羅，不要害怕，你必定站在凱撒面前，並且與你同船的人，上帝都賜給你了。』
verses.e: saying , ' Don't be afraid , Paul . You must stand before Caesar . Behold , God has granted you all those who sail with you . '

verses.z: 所以眾位可以放心，我信上帝他怎樣對我說，事情也要怎樣成就。
verses.e: Therefore , sirs , cheer up ! For I believe God , that it will be just as it has been spoken to me .

verses.z: 只是我們必要撞在一個島上。」
verses.e: But we must run aground on a certain island . "

verses.z: 到了第十四天夜間，船在亞得里亞海飄來飄去。約到半夜，水手以為漸近旱地，
verses.e: But when the fourteenth night had come , as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea , about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land .

verses.z: 就探深淺，探得有十二丈；稍往前行，又探深淺，探得有九丈。
verses.e: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms . After a little while , they took soundings again , and found fifteen fathoms .

verses.z: 恐怕撞在石頭上，就從船尾拋下四個錨，盼望天亮。
verses.e: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground , they let go four anchors from the stern , and wished for daylight .

verses.z: 第二天，到了西頓；猶流寬待保羅，准他往朋友那裏去，受他們的照應。
verses.e: The next day , we touched at Sidon . Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself .

verses.z: 水手想要逃出船去，把小船放在海裏，假作要從船頭拋錨的樣子。
verses.e: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea , pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow ,

verses.z: 保羅對百夫長和兵丁說：「這些人若不等在船上，你們必不能得救。」
verses.e: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers , " Unless these stay in the ship , you can't be saved . "

verses.z: 於是兵丁砍斷小船的繩子，由它飄去。
verses.e: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off .

verses.z: 天漸亮的時候，保羅勸眾人都吃飯，說：「你們懸望忍餓不吃甚麼，已經十四天了。
verses.e: While the day was coming on , Paul begged them all to take some food , saying , " Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting , having taken nothing .

verses.z: 所以我勸你們吃飯，這是關乎你們救命的事；因為你們各人連一根頭髮也不至於損壞。」
verses.e: Therefore I beg you to take some food , for this is for your safety ; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads . "

verses.z: 保羅說了這話，就拿着餅，在眾人面前祝謝了上帝，擘開吃。
verses.e: When he had said this and had taken bread , he gave thanks to God in the presence of all ; then he broke it and began to eat .

verses.z: 於是他們都放下心，也就吃了。
verses.e: Then they all cheered up , and they also took food .

verses.z: 我們在船上的共有二百七十六個人。
verses.e: In all , we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship .

verses.z: 他們吃飽了，就把船上的麥子拋在海裏，為要叫船輕一點。
verses.e: When they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , throwing out the wheat into the sea .

verses.z: 到了天亮，他們不認識那地方，但見一個海灣，有岸可登，就商議能把船攏進去不能。
verses.e: When it was day , they didn't recognize the land , but they noticed a certain bay with a beach , and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it .

verses.z: 從那裏又開船，因為風不順，就貼着塞浦路斯背風岸行去。
verses.e: Putting to sea from there , we sailed under the lee of Cyprus , because the winds were contrary .

verses.z: 於是砍斷纜索，棄錨在海裏；同時也鬆開舵繩，拉起頭篷，順着風向岸行去。
verses.e: Casting off the anchors , they left them in the sea , at the same time untying the rudder ropes . Hoisting up the foresail to the wind , they made for the beach .

verses.z: 但遇着兩水夾流的地方，就把船擱了淺；船頭膠住不動，船尾被浪的猛力衝壞。
verses.e: But coming to a place where two seas met , they ran the vessel aground . The bow struck and remained immovable , but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves .

verses.z: 兵丁的意思要把囚犯殺了，恐怕有洑水脫逃的。
verses.e: The soldiers ' counsel was to kill the prisoners , so that none of them would swim out and escape .

verses.z: 但百夫長要救保羅，不准他們任意而行，就吩咐會洑水的，跳下水去先上岸；
verses.e: But the centurion , desiring to save Paul , stopped them from their purpose , and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land ;

verses.z: 其餘的人可以用板子或船上的零碎東西上岸。這樣，眾人都得了救，上了岸。
verses.e: and the rest should follow , some on planks and some on other things from the ship . So they all escaped safely to the land .

verses.z: 過了基利家、旁非利亞前面的海，就到了呂家的每拉。
verses.e: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia , we came to Myra , a city of Lycia .

verses.z: 在那裏，百夫長遇見一隻亞歷山大的船，要往意大利去，便叫我們上了那船。
verses.e: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy , and he put us on board .

verses.z: 一連多日，船行得慢，僅僅來到革尼土的對面。因為被風攔阻，就貼着克里特背風岸，從撒摩尼對面行過。
verses.e: When we had sailed slowly many days , and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus , the wind not allowing us further , we sailed under the lee of Crete , opposite Salmone .

verses.z: 我們沿岸行走，僅僅來到一個地方，名叫佳澳；離那裏不遠，有拉西亞城。
verses.e: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens , near the city of Lasea .

verses.z: 走的日子多了，已經過了禁食的節期，行船又危險，保羅就勸眾人說：
verses.e: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by , Paul admonished them

verses.z: 我們既已得救，才知道那島名叫馬耳他。
verses.e: When we had escaped , then they learned that the island was called Malta .

verses.z: 他們又多方地尊敬我們；到了開船的時候，也把我們所需用的送到船上。
verses.e: They also honored us with many honors ; and when we sailed , they put on board the things that we needed .

verses.z: 過了三個月，我們上了亞歷山大的船往前行；這船以「宙斯雙子」為記，是在那海島過了冬的。
verses.e: After three months , we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island , whose figurehead was " The Twin Brothers . "

verses.z: 到了敘拉古，我們停泊三日；
verses.e: Touching at Syracuse , we stayed there three days .

verses.z: 又從那裏繞行，來到利基翁。過了一天，起了南風，第二天就來到部丟利。
verses.e: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium . After one day , a south wind sprang up , and on the second day we came to Puteoli ,

verses.z: 在那裏遇見弟兄們，請我們與他們同住了七天。這樣，我們來到羅馬。
verses.e: where we found brothers , and were entreated to stay with them for seven days . So we came to Rome .

verses.z: 那裏的弟兄們一聽見我們的信息就出來，到亞比烏市和三館地方迎接我們。保羅見了他們，就感謝上帝，放心壯膽。
verses.e: From there the brothers , when they heard of us , came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns . When Paul saw them , he thanked God and took courage .

verses.z: 進了羅馬城，保羅蒙准和一個看守他的兵另住在一處。
verses.e: When we entered into Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard , but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him .

verses.z: 過了三天，保羅請猶太人的首領來。他們來了，就對他們說：「弟兄們，我雖沒有做甚麼事干犯本國的百姓和我們祖宗的規條，卻被鎖綁，從耶路撒冷解在羅馬人的手裏。
verses.e: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews . When they had come together , he said to them , " I , brothers , though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers , still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans ,

verses.z: 他們審問了我，就願意釋放我；因為在我身上，並沒有該死的罪。
verses.e: who , when they had examined me , desired to set me free , because there was no cause of death in me .

verses.z: 無奈猶太人不服，我不得已，只好上告於凱撒，並非有甚麼事要控告我本國的百姓。
verses.e: But when the Jews spoke against it , I was constrained to appeal to Caesar , not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation .

verses.z: 土人看待我們，有非常的情分；因為當時下雨，天氣又冷，就生火接待我們眾人。
verses.e: The natives showed us uncommon kindness ; for they kindled a fire and received us all , because of the present rain and because of the cold .

verses.z: 因此，我請你們來見面說話，我原為以色列人所指望的，被這鍊子捆鎖。」
verses.e: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you . For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain . "

verses.z: 他們說：「我們並沒有接着從猶太來論你的信，也沒有弟兄到這裏來報給我們說你有甚麼不好處。
verses.e: They said to him , " We neither received letters from Judea concerning you , nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you .

verses.z: 但我們願意聽你的意見如何；因為這教門，我們曉得是到處被毀謗的。」
verses.e: But we desire to hear from you what you think . For , as concerning this sect , it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against . "

verses.z: 他們和保羅約定了日子，就有許多人到他的寓處來。保羅從早到晚，對他們講論這事，證明上帝國[的道]，引摩西的律法和先知的書，以耶穌的事勸勉他們。
verses.e: When they had appointed him a day , many people came to him at his lodging . He explained to them , testifying about God's Kingdom , and persuading them concerning Jesus , both from the law of Moses and from the prophets , from morning until evening .

verses.z: 他所說的話，有信的，有不信的。
verses.e: Some believed the things which were spoken , and some disbelieved .

verses.z: 他們彼此不合，就散了；未散以先，保羅說了一句話，說：「聖靈藉先知以賽亞向你們祖宗所說的話是不錯的。
verses.e: When they didn't agree among themselves , they departed after Paul had spoken one message : " The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers ,

verses.z: 他說：你去告訴這百姓說：你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得；
verses.e: saying , ' Go to this people and say , in hearing , you will hear , but will in no way understand . In seeing , you will see , but will in no way perceive .

verses.z: 因為這百姓油蒙了心，耳朵發沉，眼睛閉着；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。
verses.e: For this people's heart has grown callous . Their ears are dull of hearing . Their eyes they have closed . Lest they should see with their eyes , hear with their ears , understand with their heart , and would turn again , then I would heal them . '

verses.z: 所以你們當知道，上帝這救恩，如今傳給外邦人，他們也必聽受。」
verses.e: " Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations , and they will listen . "
When he had said these words , the Jews departed , having a great dispute among themselves .

verses.z: 那時，保羅拾起一捆柴，放在火上，有一條毒蛇，因為熱了出來，咬住他的手。
verses.e: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire , a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand .

verses.z: 保羅在自己所租的房子裏住了足足兩年。凡來見他的人，他全都接待，
verses.e: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him ,

verses.z: 放膽傳講上帝國[的道]，將主耶穌基督的事教導人，並沒有人禁止。
verses.e: preaching God's Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness , without hindrance .

verses.z: 土人看見那毒蛇懸在他手上，就彼此說：「這人必是個兇手，雖然從海裏救上來，天理還不容他活着。」
verses.e: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand , they said to one another , " No doubt this man is a murderer , whom , though he has escaped from the sea , yet Justice has not allowed to live . "

verses.z: 保羅竟把那毒蛇甩在火裏，並沒有受傷。
verses.e: However he shook off the creature into the fire , and wasn't harmed .

verses.z: 土人想他必要腫起來，或是忽然仆倒死了；看了多時，見他無害，就轉念，說：「他是個神。」
verses.e: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly , but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him , they changed their minds and said that he was a god .

verses.z: 離那地方不遠，有田產是島長部百流的；他接納我們，盡情款待三日。
verses.e: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island , named Publius , who received us and courteously entertained us for three days .

verses.z: 當時，部百流的父親患熱病和痢疾躺着。保羅進去，[為他]禱告，按手在他身上，治好了他。
verses.e: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery . Paul entered in to him , prayed , and laying his hands on him , healed him .

verses.z: 從此，島上其餘的病人也來，得了醫治。
verses.e: Then when this was done , the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured .

verses.z: 申初禱告的時候，彼得、約翰上[聖]殿去。
verses.e: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer , the ninth hour .

verses.z: 認得他是那素常坐在殿的美門口求賙濟的，就因他所遇着的事滿心希奇、驚訝。
verses.e: They recognized him , that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple . They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him .

verses.z: 那人正在稱為所羅門的廊下，拉着彼得、約翰；眾百姓一齊跑到他們那裏，很覺希奇。
verses.e: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John , all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon's , greatly wondering .

verses.z: 彼得看見，就對百姓說：「以色列人哪，為甚麼把這事當作希奇呢？為甚麼定睛看我們，以為我們憑自己的能力和虔誠使這人行走呢？
verses.e: When Peter saw it , he responded to the people , " You men of Israel , why do you marvel at this man ? Why do you fasten your eyes on us , as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk ?

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的上帝，就是我們列祖的上帝，已經榮耀了他的僕人耶穌；你們卻把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要釋放他，你們竟在彼拉多面前棄絕了他。
verses.e: The God of Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , the God of our fathers , has glorified his Servant Jesus , whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate , when he had determined to release him .

verses.z: 你們棄絕了那聖潔公義者，反求着釋放一個兇手給你們。
verses.e: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you ,

verses.z: 你們殺了那生命的主，上帝卻叫他從死裏復活了；我們都是為這事作見證。
verses.e: and killed the Prince of life , whom God raised from the dead , to which we are witnesses .

verses.z: 我們因信他的名，他的名便叫你們所看見所認識的這人健壯了；正是他所賜的信心，叫這人在你們眾人面前全然好了。
verses.e: By faith in his name , his name has made this man strong , whom you see and know . Yes , the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我曉得你們做這事是出於不知，你們的官長也是如此。
verses.e: " Now , brothers , I know that you did this in ignorance , as did also your rulers .

verses.z: 但上帝曾藉眾先知的口，預言基督將要受害，就這樣應驗了。
verses.e: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets , that Christ should suffer , he thus fulfilled .

verses.z: 所以，你們當悔改歸正，使你們的罪得以塗抹，
verses.e: " Repent therefore , and turn again , that your sins may be blotted out , so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord ,

verses.z: 有一個人，生來是瘸腿的，天天被人抬來，放在殿的一個門口（那門名叫美[門]），要求進殿的人賙濟。
verses.e: A certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was being carried , whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple .

verses.z: 這樣，那安舒的日子就必從主面前來到；主也必差遣所預定給你們的基督（耶穌）降臨。
verses.e: and that he may send Christ Jesus , who was ordained for you before ,

verses.z: 天必留他，等到萬物復興的時候，就是上帝從創世以來、藉着聖先知的口所說的。
verses.e: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things , which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets .

verses.z: 摩西曾說：『主－上帝要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我，凡他向你們所說的，你們都要聽從。
verses.e: For Moses indeed said to the fathers , ' The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers , like me . You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you .

verses.z: 凡不聽從那先知的，必要從民中全然滅絕。』
verses.e: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people . '

verses.z: 從撒母耳以來的眾先知，凡說預言的，也都說到這些日子。
verses.e: Yes , and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after , as many as have spoken , also told of these days .

verses.z: 你們是先知的子孫，也承受上帝與你們祖宗所立的約，就是對亞伯拉罕說：『地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。』
verses.e: You are the children of the prophets , and of the covenant which God made with our fathers , saying to Abraham , ' All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring . '

verses.z: 上帝既興起他的僕人，就先差他到你們這裏來，賜福給你們，叫你們各人回轉，離開罪惡。」
verses.e: God , having raised up his servant Jesus , sent him to you first to bless you , in turning away every one of you from your wickedness . "

verses.z: 他看見彼得、約翰將要進殿，就求他們賙濟。
verses.e: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple , he asked to receive gifts for the needy .

verses.z: 彼得、約翰定睛看他；彼得說：「你看我們！」
verses.e: Peter , fastening his eyes on him , with John , said , " Look at us . "

verses.z: 那人就留意看他們，指望得着甚麼。
verses.e: He listened to them , expecting to receive something from them .

verses.z: 彼得說：「金銀我都沒有，只把我所有的給你：我奉拿撒勒人耶穌基督的名，叫你起來行走！」
verses.e: But Peter said , " I have no silver or gold , but what I have , that I give you . In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , get up and walk ! "

verses.z: 於是拉着他的右手，扶他起來；他的腳和踝子骨立刻健壯了，
verses.e: He took him by the right hand and raised him up . Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength .

verses.z: 就跳起來，站着，又行走，同他們進了殿，走着，跳着，讚美上帝。
verses.e: Leaping up , he stood and began to walk . He entered with them into the temple , walking , leaping , and praising God .

verses.z: 百姓都看見他行走，讚美上帝；
verses.e: All the people saw him walking and praising God .

verses.z: 使徒對百姓說話的時候，祭司們和守殿官，並撒都該人忽然來了。
verses.e: As they spoke to the people , the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them ,

verses.z: 你們眾人和以色列百姓都當知道，站在你們面前的這人得痊癒是因你們所釘十字架、上帝叫他從死裏復活的拿撒勒人耶穌基督的名。
verses.e: may it be known to you all , and to all the people of Israel , that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom you crucified , whom God raised from the dead , this man stands here before you whole in him .

verses.z: 他是你們匠人所棄的石頭，已成了房角的頭塊石頭。
verses.e: He is ' the stone which was regarded as worthless by you , the builders , which has become the head of the corner . '

verses.z: 除他以外，別無拯救；因為在天下人間，沒有賜下別的名，我們可以靠着得救。」
verses.e: There is salvation in no one else , for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men , by which we must be saved ! "

verses.z: 他們見彼得、約翰的膽量，又看出他們原是沒有學問的小民，就希奇，認明他們是跟過耶穌的；
verses.e: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John , and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men , they marveled . They recognized that they had been with Jesus .

verses.z: 又看見那治好了的人和他們一同站着，就無話可駁。
verses.e: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .

verses.z: 於是吩咐他們從公會出去，就彼此商議說：
verses.e: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,

verses.z: 「我們當怎樣辦這兩個人呢？因為他們誠然行了一件明顯的神蹟，凡住耶路撒冷的人都知道，我們也不能說沒有。
verses.e: saying , " What shall we do to these men ? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them , as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem , and we can't deny it .

verses.z: 惟恐這事越發傳揚在民間，我們必須恐嚇他們，叫他們不再奉這名對人講論。」
verses.e: But so that this spreads no further among the people , let's threaten them , that from now on they don't speak to anyone in this name . "

verses.z: 於是叫了他們來，禁止他們總不可奉耶穌的名講論教訓人。
verses.e: They called them , and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus .

verses.z: 彼得、約翰說：「聽從你們，不聽從上帝，這在上帝面前合理不合理，你們自己酌量吧！
verses.e: But Peter and John answered them , " Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God , judge for yourselves ,

verses.z: 因他們教訓百姓，本着耶穌，傳說死人復活，就很煩惱，
verses.e: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead .

verses.z: 我們所看見所聽見的，不能不說。」
verses.e: for we can't help telling the things which we saw and heard . "

verses.z: 官長為百姓的緣故，想不出法子刑罰他們，又恐嚇一番，把他們釋放了。這是因眾人為所行的奇事都歸榮耀與上帝。
verses.e: When they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding no way to punish them , because of the people ; for everyone glorified God for that which was done .

verses.z: 原來藉着神蹟醫好的那人有四十多歲了。
verses.e: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old .

verses.z: 二人既被釋放，就到會友那裏去，把祭司長和長老所說的話都告訴他們。
verses.e: Being let go , they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them .

verses.z: 他們聽見了，就同心合意地高聲向上帝說：「主啊！你是造天、地、海，和其中萬物的，
verses.e: When they heard it , they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said , " O Lord , you are God , who made the sky , the earth , the sea , and all that is in them ;

verses.z: 你曾藉着聖靈，[託]你僕人－我們祖宗大衛的口，說：外邦為甚麼爭鬧？萬民為甚麼謀算虛妄的事？
verses.e: who by the mouth of your servant David , said , ' Why do the nations rage , and the peoples plot a vain thing ?

verses.z: 世上的君王一齊起來，臣宰也聚集，要敵擋主，並主的受膏者。
verses.e: The kings of the earth take a stand , and the rulers plot together , against the Lord , and against his Christ . '

verses.z: 希律和本丟‧彼拉多，外邦人和以色列民，果然在這城裏聚集，要攻打你所膏的聖僕耶穌，
verses.e: " For truly , both Herod and Pontius Pilate , with the Gentiles and the people of Israel , were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus , whom you anointed ,

verses.z: 成就你手和你意旨所預定必有的事。
verses.e: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen .

verses.z: 他們恐嚇我們，現在求主鑒察，一面叫你僕人大放膽量講你的道，一面伸出你的手來醫治疾病，並且使神蹟奇事因着你聖僕耶穌的名行出來。」
verses.e: Now , Lord , look at their threats , and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness ,

verses.z: 於是下手拿住他們；因為天已經晚了，就把他們押到第二天。
verses.e: They laid hands on them , and put them in custody until the next day , for it was now evening .
while you stretch out your hand to heal ; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus . "

verses.z: 禱告完了，聚會的地方震動，他們就都被聖靈充滿，放膽講論上帝的道。
verses.e: When they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were gathered together . They were all filled with the Holy Spirit , and they spoke the word of God with boldness .

verses.z: 那許多信的人都是一心一意的，沒有一人說他的東西有一樣是自己的，都是大家公用。
verses.e: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul . Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own , but they had all things in common .

verses.z: 使徒大有能力，見證主耶穌復活；眾人也都蒙大恩。
verses.e: With great power , the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus . Great grace was on them all .

verses.z: 內中也沒有一個缺乏的；因為人人將田產房屋都賣了，把所賣的價銀拿來，
verses.e: For neither was there among them any who lacked , for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them , and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold ,

verses.z: 放在使徒腳前，照各人所需用的，分給各人。
verses.e: and laid them at the apostles ' feet ; and distribution was made to each , according as anyone had need .

verses.z: 有一個利未人，生在塞浦路斯，名叫約瑟，使徒稱他為巴拿巴（巴拿巴翻出來就是勸慰子）。
verses.e: Joses , who by the apostles was also called Barnabas ( which is , being interpreted , Son of Encouragement ) , a Levite , a man of Cyprus by race ,

verses.z: 他有田地，也賣了，把價銀拿來，放在使徒腳前。
verses.e: having a field , sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles ' feet .

verses.z: 但聽道之人有許多信的，男丁數目約到五千。
verses.e: But many of those who heard the word believed , and the number of the men came to be about five thousand .

verses.z: 第二天，官府、長老，和文士在耶路撒冷聚會，
verses.e: In the morning , their rulers , elders , and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 又有大祭司亞那和該亞法、約翰、亞歷山大，並大祭司的親族都在那裏，
verses.e: Annas the high priest was there , with Caiaphas , John , Alexander , and as many as were relatives of the high priest .

verses.z: 叫使徒站在當中，就問他們說：「你們用甚麼能力，奉誰的名做這事呢？」
verses.e: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them , they inquired , " By what power , or in what name , have you done this ? "

verses.z: 那時彼得被聖靈充滿，對他們說：
verses.e: Then Peter , filled with the Holy Spirit , said to them , " You rulers of the people and elders of Israel ,

verses.z: 「治民的官府和長老啊，倘若今日因為在殘疾人身上所行的善事查問我們他是怎麼得了痊癒，
verses.e: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man , by what means this man has been healed ,

verses.z: 有一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，同他的妻子撒非喇賣了田產，
verses.e: But a certain man named Ananias , with Sapphira his wife , sold a possession ,

verses.z: 婦人立刻仆倒在彼得腳前，斷了氣。那些少年人進來，見她已經死了，就抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁邊。
verses.e: She fell down immediately at his feet and died . The young men came in and found her dead , and they carried her out and buried her by her husband .

verses.z: 全教會和聽見這事的人都甚懼怕。
verses.e: Great fear came on the whole assembly , and on all who heard these things .

verses.z: 主藉使徒的手在民間行了許多神蹟奇事；他們都同心合意地在所羅門的廊下。
verses.e: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people . They were all with one accord in Solomon's porch .

verses.z: 其餘的人沒有一個敢貼近他們，百姓卻尊重他們。
verses.e: None of the rest dared to join them ; however , the people honored them .

verses.z: 信而歸主的人越發增添，連男帶女很多。
verses.e: More believers were added to the Lord , multitudes of both men and women .

verses.z: 甚至有人將病人抬到街上，放在床上或褥子上，指望彼得過來的時候，或者得他的影兒照在甚麼人身上。
verses.e: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses , so that as Peter came by , at least his shadow might overshadow some of them .

verses.z: 還有許多人帶着病人和被污鬼纏磨的，從耶路撒冷四圍的城邑來，全都得了醫治。
verses.e: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem , bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits ; and they were all healed .

verses.z: 大祭司和他的一切同人，就是撒都該教門的人，都起來，滿心忌恨，
verses.e: But the high priest rose up , and all those who were with him ( which is the sect of the Sadducees ) , and they were filled with jealousy

verses.z: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外監。
verses.e: and laid hands on the apostles , then put them in public custody .

verses.z: 但主的使者夜間開了監門，領他們出來，
verses.e: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night , and brought them out and said ,

verses.z: 把價銀私自留下幾分，他的妻子也知道，其餘的幾分拿來放在使徒腳前。
verses.e: and kept back part of the price , his wife also being aware of it , then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles ' feet .

verses.z: 說：「你們去站在殿裏，把這生命的道都講給百姓聽。」
verses.e: " Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life . "

verses.z: 使徒聽了這話，天將亮的時候就進殿裏去教訓人。大祭司和他的同人來了，叫齊公會的人和以色列族的眾長老，就差人到監裏去，要把使徒提出來。
verses.e: When they heard this , they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught . But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together , with all the senate of the children of Israel , and sent to the prison to have them brought .

verses.z: 但差役到了，不見他們在監裏，就回來稟報說：
verses.e: But the officers who came didn't find them in the prison . They returned and reported ,

verses.z: 「我們看見監牢關得極妥當，看守的人也站在門外；及至開了門，裏面一個人都不見。」
verses.e: " We found the prison shut and locked , and the guards standing before the doors , but when we opened them , we found no one inside ! "

verses.z: 守殿官和祭司長聽見這話，心裏犯難，不知這事將來如何。
verses.e: Now when the high priest , the captain of the temple , and the chief priests heard these words , they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this .

verses.z: 有一個人來稟報說：「你們收在監裏的人，現在站在殿裏教訓百姓。」
verses.e: One came and told them , " Behold , the men whom you put in prison are in the temple , standing and teaching the people . "

verses.z: 於是守殿官和差役去帶使徒來，並沒有用強暴，因為怕百姓用石頭打他們。
verses.e: Then the captain went with the officers , and brought them without violence , for they were afraid that the people might stone them .

verses.z: 帶到了，便叫使徒站在公會前；大祭司問他們說：
verses.e: When they had brought them , they set them before the council . The high priest questioned them ,

verses.z: 「我們不是嚴嚴地禁止你們，不可奉這名教訓人嗎？你們倒把你們的道理充滿了耶路撒冷，想要叫這人的血歸到我們身上！」
verses.e: saying , " Didn't we strictly command you not to teach in this name ? Behold , you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching , and intend to bring this man's blood on us . "

verses.z: 彼得和眾使徒回答說：「順從上帝，不順從人，是應當的。
verses.e: But Peter and the apostles answered , " We must obey God rather than men .

verses.z: 彼得說：「亞拿尼亞！為甚麼撒但充滿了你的心，叫你欺哄聖靈，把田地的價銀私自留下幾分呢？
verses.e: But Peter said , " Ananias , why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land ?

verses.z: 你們掛在木頭上殺害的耶穌，我們祖宗的上帝已經叫他復活。
verses.e: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus , whom you killed , hanging him on a tree .

verses.z: 上帝且用右手將他高舉，叫他作君王，作救主，將悔改的心和赦罪的恩賜給以色列人。
verses.e: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior , to give repentance to Israel , and remission of sins .

verses.z: 我們為這事作見證；上帝賜給順從之人的聖靈也為這事作見證。」
verses.e: We are his witnesses of these things ; and so also is the Holy Spirit , whom God has given to those who obey him . "

verses.z: 公會的人聽見就極其惱怒，想要殺他們。
verses.e: But they , when they heard this , were cut to the heart , and were determined to kill them .

verses.z: 但有一個法利賽人，名叫迦瑪列，是眾百姓所敬重的教法師，在公會中站起來，吩咐人把使徒暫且帶到外面去，
verses.e: But one stood up in the council , a Pharisee named Gamaliel , a teacher of the law , honored by all the people , and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while .

verses.z: 就對眾人說：「以色列人哪，論到這些人，你們應當小心怎樣辦理。
verses.e: He said to them , " You men of Israel , be careful concerning these men , what you are about to do .

verses.z: 從前杜達起來，自誇為大，附從他的人約有四百，他被殺後，附從他的全都散了，歸於無有。
verses.e: For before these days Theudas rose up , making himself out to be somebody ; to whom a number of men , about four hundred , joined themselves . He was slain ; and all , as many as obeyed him , were dispersed and came to nothing .

verses.z: 此後，報名上冊的時候，又有加利利的猶大起來，引誘些百姓跟從他；他也滅亡，附從他的人也都四散了。
verses.e: After this man , Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment , and drew away some people after him . He also perished , and all , as many as obeyed him , were scattered abroad .

verses.z: 現在，我勸你們不要管這些人，任憑他們吧！他們所謀的、所行的，若是出於人，必要敗壞；
verses.e: Now I tell you , withdraw from these men and leave them alone . For if this counsel or this work is of men , it will be overthrown .

verses.z: 若是出於上帝，你們就不能敗壞他們，恐怕你們倒是攻擊上帝了。」
verses.e: But if it is of God , you will not be able to overthrow it , and you would be found even to be fighting against God ! "

verses.z: 田地還沒有賣，不是你自己的嗎？既賣了，價銀不是你作主嗎？你怎麼心裏起這意念呢？你不是欺哄人，是欺哄上帝了。」
verses.e: While you kept it , didn't it remain your own ? After it was sold , wasn't it in your power ? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart ? You haven't lied to men , but to God . "

verses.z: 公會的人聽從了他，便叫使徒來，把他們打了，又吩咐他們不可奉耶穌的名講道，就把他們釋放了。
verses.e: They agreed with him . Summoning the apostles , they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .

verses.z: 他們離開公會，心裏歡喜，因被算是配為這名受辱。
verses.e: They therefore departed from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus ' name .

verses.z: 他們就每日在殿裏、在家裏不住地教訓人，傳耶穌是基督。
verses.e: Every day , in the temple and at home , they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus , the Christ .

verses.z: 亞拿尼亞聽見這話，就仆倒，斷了氣；聽見的人都甚懼怕。
verses.e: Ananias , hearing these words , fell down and died . Great fear came on all who heard these things .

verses.z: 有些少年人起來，把他包裹，抬出去埋葬了。
verses.e: The young men arose and wrapped him up , and they carried him out and buried him .

verses.z: 約過了三小時，他的妻子進來，還不知道這事。
verses.e: About three hours later , his wife , not knowing what had happened , came in .

verses.z: 彼得對她說：「你告訴我，你們賣田地的價銀就是這些嗎？」她說：「就是這些。」
verses.e: Peter answered her , " Tell me whether you sold the land for so much . " She said , " Yes , for so much . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「你們為甚麼同心試探主的靈呢？埋葬你丈夫之人的腳已到門口，他們也要把你抬出去。」
verses.e: But Peter asked her , " How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord ? Behold , the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door , and they will carry you out . "

verses.z: 那時，門徒增多，有說希臘話的猶太人向希伯來人發怨言，因為在天天的供給上忽略了他們的寡婦。
verses.e: Now in those days , when the number of the disciples was multiplying , a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews , because their widows were neglected in the daily service .

verses.z: 司提反是以智慧和[聖]靈說話，眾人敵擋不住，
verses.e: They weren't able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke .

verses.z: 就買出人來說：「我們聽見他說謗讟摩西和上帝的話。」
verses.e: Then they secretly induced men to say , " We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God . "

verses.z: 他們又聳動了百姓、長老，並文士，就忽然來捉拿他，把他帶到公會去，
verses.e: They stirred up the people , the elders , and the scribes , and came against him and seized him , then brought him in to the council ,

verses.z: 設下假見證，說：「這個人說話，不住地糟踐聖所和律法。
verses.e: and set up false witnesses who said , " This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law .

verses.z: 我們曾聽見他說，這拿撒勒人耶穌要毀壞此地，也要改變摩西所交給我們的規條。」
verses.e: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place , and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us . "

verses.z: 在公會裏坐着的人都定睛看他，見他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。
verses.e: All who sat in the council , fastening their eyes on him , saw his face like it was the face of an angel .

verses.z: 十二使徒叫眾門徒來，對他們說：「我們撇下上帝的道去管理飯食，原是不合宜的。
verses.e: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said , " It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables .

verses.z: 所以弟兄們，當從你們中間選出七個有好名聲、被[聖]靈充滿、智慧充足的人，我們就派他們管理這事。
verses.e: Therefore , select from among you , brothers , seven men of good report , full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom , whom we may appoint over this business .

verses.z: 但我們要專心以祈禱、傳道為事。」
verses.e: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word . "

verses.z: 大眾都喜悅這話，就揀選了司提反，乃是大有信心、聖靈充滿的人，又揀選腓利、伯羅哥羅、尼迦挪、提門、巴米拿，並進[猶太]教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
verses.e: These words pleased the whole multitude . They chose Stephen , a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit , Philip , Prochorus , Nicanor , Timon , Parmenas , and Nicolaus , a proselyte of Antioch ,

verses.z: 叫他們站在使徒面前。使徒禱告了，就按手在他們頭上。
verses.e: whom they set before the apostles . When they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .

verses.z: 上帝的道興旺起來；在耶路撒冷門徒數目加增的甚多，也有許多祭司信從了這道。
verses.e: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem . A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .

verses.z: 司提反滿得恩惠、能力，在民間行了大奇事和神蹟。
verses.e: Stephen , full of faith and power , performed great wonders and signs among the people .

verses.z: 當時有稱利百地拿會堂的幾個人，並有古利奈、亞歷山大、基利家、亞細亞各處會堂的幾個人，都起來和司提反辯論。
verses.e: But some of those who were of the synagogue called " The Libertines " , and of the Cyrenians , of the Alexandrians , and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose , disputing with Stephen .

verses.z: 大祭司就說：「這些事果然有嗎？」
verses.e: The high priest said , " Are these things so ? "

verses.z: 救他脫離一切苦難，又使他在埃及王法老面前得恩典，有智慧。法老就派他作埃及國的宰相兼管全家。
verses.e: and delivered him out of all his afflictions , and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh , king of Egypt . He made him governor over Egypt and all his house .

verses.z: 後來埃及和迦南全地遭遇饑荒，大受艱難，我們的祖宗就絕了糧。
verses.e: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan , and great affliction . Our fathers found no food .

verses.z: 雅各聽見在埃及有糧，就打發我們的祖宗初次往那裏去。
verses.e: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt , he sent out our fathers the first time .

verses.z: 第二次約瑟與弟兄們相認，他的親族也被法老知道了。
verses.e: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers , and Joseph's family was revealed to Pharaoh .

verses.z: 約瑟就打發弟兄請父親雅各和全家七十五個人都來。
verses.e: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives , seventy-five souls .

verses.z: 於是雅各下了埃及，後來他和我們的祖宗都死在那裏；
verses.e: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died , himself and our fathers ;

verses.z: 又被帶到示劍，葬於亞伯拉罕在示劍用銀子從哈抹子孫買來的墳墓裏。
verses.e: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem .

verses.z: 「及至上帝應許亞伯拉罕的日期將到，以色列民在埃及興盛眾多，
verses.e: " But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham , the people grew and multiplied in Egypt ,

verses.z: 直到有不曉得約瑟的新王興起。
verses.e: until there arose a different king who didn't know Joseph .

verses.z: 他用詭計待我們的宗族，苦害我們的祖宗，叫他們丟棄嬰孩，使嬰孩不能存活。
verses.e: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers , and forced them to abandon their babies , so that they wouldn't stay alive .

verses.z: 司提反說：「諸位父兄請聽！當日我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕在美索不達米亞還未住哈蘭的時候，榮耀的上帝向他顯現，
verses.e: He said , " Brothers and fathers , listen . The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia , before he lived in Haran ,

verses.z: 那時，摩西生下來，俊美非凡，在他父親家裏撫養了三個月。
verses.e: At that time Moses was born , and was exceedingly handsome to God . He was nourished three months in his father's house .

verses.z: 他被丟棄的時候，法老的女兒拾了去，養為自己的兒子。
verses.e: When he was abandoned , Pharaoh's daughter took him up and reared him as her own son .

verses.z: 摩西學了埃及人一切的學問，說話行事都有才能。
verses.e: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians . He was mighty in his words and works .

verses.z: 「他將到四十歲，心中起意去看望他的弟兄以色列人；
verses.e: But when he was forty years old , it came into his heart to visit his brothers , the children of Israel .

verses.z: [到了那裏]，見他們一個人受冤屈，就護庇他，為那受欺壓的人報仇，打死了那埃及人。
verses.e: Seeing one of them suffer wrong , he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed , striking the Egyptian .

verses.z: 他以為弟兄必明白上帝是藉他的手搭救他們；他們卻不明白。
verses.e: He supposed that his brothers understood that God , by his hand , was giving them deliverance ; but they didn't understand .

verses.z: 第二天，遇見兩個[以色列]人爭鬥，就勸他們和睦，說：『你們二位是弟兄，為甚麼彼此欺負呢？』
verses.e: " The day following , he appeared to them as they fought , and urged them to be at peace again , saying , ' Sirs , you are brothers . Why do you wrong one another ? '

verses.z: 那欺負鄰舍的把他推開，說：『誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？
verses.e: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away , saying , ' Who made you a ruler and a judge over us ?

verses.z: 難道你要殺我，像昨天殺那埃及人嗎？』
verses.e: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday ? '

verses.z: 摩西聽見這話就逃走了，寄居於米甸；在那裏生了兩個兒子。
verses.e: Moses fled at this saying , and became a stranger in the land of Midian , where he became the father of two sons .

verses.z: 對他說：『你要離開本地和親族，往我所要指示你的地方去。』
verses.e: and said to him , ' Get out of your land and away from your relatives , and come into a land which I will show you . '

verses.z: 「過了四十年，在西奈山的曠野，有一位天使從荊棘火焰中向摩西顯現。
verses.e: " When forty years were fulfilled , an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai , in a flame of fire in a bush .

verses.z: 摩西見了那異象，便覺希奇，正進前觀看的時候，有主的聲音說：
verses.e: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight . As he came close to see , the voice of the Lord came to him ,

verses.z: 『我是你列祖的上帝，就是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』摩西戰戰兢兢，不敢觀看。
verses.e: ' I am the God of your fathers : the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . ' Moses trembled and dared not look .

verses.z: 主對他說：『把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站之地是聖地。
verses.e: The Lord said to him , ' Take off your sandals , for the place where you stand is holy ground .

verses.z: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了，他們悲歎的聲音，我也聽見了。我下來要救他們。你來！我要差你往埃及去。』
verses.e: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt , and have heard their groaning . I have come down to deliver them . Now come , I will send you into Egypt . '

verses.z: 這摩西就是百姓棄絕說『誰立你作我們的首領和審判官』的；上帝卻藉那在荊棘中顯現之使者的手差派他作首領、作救贖的。
verses.e: " This Moses whom they refused , saying , ' Who made you a ruler and a judge ? ' — God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush .

verses.z: 這人領百姓出來，在埃及，在紅海，在曠野，四十年間行了奇事神蹟。
verses.e: This man led them out , having worked wonders and signs in Egypt , in the Red Sea , and in the wilderness for forty years .

verses.z: 那曾對以色列人說『上帝要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我』的，就是這位摩西。
verses.e: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel , ' The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers , like me . '

verses.z: 這人曾在曠野會中和西奈山上，與那對他說話的天使同在，又與我們的祖宗同在，並且領受活潑的聖言傳給我們。
verses.e: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai , and with our fathers , who received living revelations to give to us ,

verses.z: 我們的祖宗不肯聽從，反棄絕他，心裏歸向埃及，
verses.e: to whom our fathers wouldn't be obedient , but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt ,

verses.z: 他就離開迦勒底人之地，住在哈蘭。他父親死了以後，[上帝]使他從那裏搬到你們現在所住之地。
verses.e: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran . From there , when his father was dead , God moved him into this land where you are now living .

verses.z: 對亞倫說：『你且為我們造些神像，在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。』
verses.e: saying to Aaron , ' Make us gods that will go before us , for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt , we don't know what has become of him . '

verses.z: 那時，他們造了一個牛犢，又拿祭物獻給那像，歡喜自己手中的工作。
verses.e: They made a calf in those days , and brought a sacrifice to the idol , and rejoiced in the works of their hands .

verses.z: 上帝就轉臉不顧，任憑他們事奉天上的日月星辰，正如先知書上所寫的說：以色列家啊，你們四十年間在曠野，豈是將犧牲和祭物獻給我嗎？
verses.e: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky , as it is written in the book of the prophets , ' Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness , O house of Israel ?

verses.z: 你們抬着摩洛的帳幕和理番神的星，就是你們所造為要敬拜的像。[因此]，我要把你們遷到巴比倫外去。
verses.e: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch , the star of your god Rephan , the figures which you made to worship , so I will carry you away beyond Babylon . '

verses.z: 「我們的祖宗在曠野，有法櫃的帳幕，是[上帝]吩咐摩西叫他照所看見的樣式做的。
verses.e: " Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness , even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen ;

verses.z: 這帳幕，我們的祖宗相繼承受。當上帝在他們面前趕出外邦人去的時候，他們同約書亞把帳幕搬進承受為業之地，直存到大衛的日子。
verses.e: which also our fathers , in their turn , brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David ,

verses.z: 大衛在上帝面前蒙恩，祈求為雅各的上帝預備居所；
verses.e: who found favor in the sight of God , and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob .

verses.z: 卻是所羅門為上帝造成殿宇。
verses.e: But Solomon built him a house .

verses.z: 其實，至高者並不住人手所造的，就如先知所言：
verses.e: However , the Most High doesn't dwell in temples made with hands , as the prophet says ,

verses.z: 主說：天是我的座位，地是我的腳凳；你們要為我造何等的殿宇？哪裏是我安息的地方呢？
verses.e: ' heaven is my throne , and the earth a footstool for my feet . What kind of house will you build me ? ' says the Lord . ' Or what is the place of my rest ?

verses.z: 在這地方，上帝並沒有給他產業，連立足之地也沒有給他；但應許要將這地賜給他和他的後裔為業；那時他還沒有兒子。
verses.e: He gave him no inheritance in it , no , not so much as to set his foot on . He promised that he would give it to him for a possession , and to his offspring after him , when he still had no child .

verses.z: 這一切不都是我手所造的嗎？
verses.e: Didn't my hand make all these things ? '

verses.z: 「你們這硬着頸項、心與耳未受割禮的人，常時抗拒聖靈！你們的祖宗怎樣，你們也怎樣。
verses.e: " You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears , you always resist the Holy Spirit ! As your fathers did , so you do .

verses.z: 哪一個先知不是你們祖宗逼迫呢？他們也把預先傳說那義者要來的人殺了；如今你們又把那義者賣了，殺了。
verses.e: Which of the prophets didn't your fathers persecute ? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One , of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers .

verses.z: 你們受了天使所傳的律法，竟不遵守。」
verses.e: You received the law as it was ordained by angels , and didn't keep it ! "

verses.z: 眾人聽見這話就極其惱怒，向司提反咬牙切齒。
verses.e: Now when they heard these things , they were cut to the heart , and they gnashed at him with their teeth .

verses.z: 但司提反被聖靈充滿，定睛望天，看見上帝的榮耀，又看見耶穌站在上帝的右邊，
verses.e: But he , being full of the Holy Spirit , looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God , and Jesus standing on the right hand of God ,

verses.z: 就說：「我看見天開了，人子站在上帝的右邊。」
verses.e: and said , " Behold , I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God ! "

verses.z: 眾人大聲喊叫，摀着耳朵，齊心擁上前去，
verses.e: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears , then rushed at him with one accord .

verses.z: 把他推到城外，用石頭打他。作見證的人把衣裳放在一個少年人名叫掃羅的腳前。
verses.e: They threw him out of the city and stoned him . The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul .

verses.z: 他們正用石頭打的時候，司提反呼籲[主]說：「求主耶穌接收我的靈魂！」
verses.e: They stoned Stephen as he called out , saying , " Lord Jesus , receive my spirit ! "

verses.z: 上帝說：『他的後裔必寄居外邦，那裏的人要叫他們作奴僕，苦待他們四百年。』
verses.e: God spoke in this way : that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land , and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years .

verses.z: 又跪下大聲喊着說：「主啊，不要將這罪歸於他們！」說了這話，就睡了。掃羅也喜悅他被害。
verses.e: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice , " Lord , don't hold this sin against them ! " When he had said this , he fell asleep .

verses.z: 上帝又說：『使他們作奴僕的那國，我要懲罰。以後他們要出來，在這地方事奉我。』
verses.e: ' I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage , ' said God , ' and after that they will come out and serve me in this place . '

verses.z: 上帝又賜他割禮的約。於是[亞伯拉罕]生了以撒，第八日給他行了割禮。以撒生雅各；雅各生十二位先祖。
verses.e: He gave him the covenant of circumcision . So Abraham became the father of Isaac , and circumcised him the eighth day . Isaac became the father of Jacob , and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs .

verses.z: 「先祖嫉妒約瑟，把他賣到埃及去；上帝卻與他同在，
verses.e: " The patriarchs , moved with jealousy against Joseph , sold him into Egypt . God was with him

verses.z: 從這日起，耶路撒冷的教會大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，門徒都分散在猶太和撒馬利亞各處。
verses.e: Saul was consenting to his death . A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day . They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria , except for the apostles .

verses.z: 無論大小都聽從他，說：「這人就是那稱為上帝的大能者。」
verses.e: to whom they all listened , from the least to the greatest , saying , " This man is that great power of God . "

verses.z: 他們聽從他，因他久用邪術，使他們驚奇。
verses.e: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries .

verses.z: 及至他們信了腓利所傳上帝國的福音和耶穌基督的名，連男帶女就受了洗。
verses.e: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God's Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .

verses.z: 西門自己也信了；既受了洗，就常與腓利在一處，看見他所行的神蹟和大異能，就甚驚奇。
verses.e: Simon himself also believed . Being baptized , he continued with Philip . Seeing signs and great miracles occurring , he was amazed .

verses.z: 使徒在耶路撒冷聽見撒馬利亞人領受了上帝的道，就打發彼得、約翰往他們那裏去。
verses.e: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent Peter and John to them ,

verses.z: 兩個人到了，就為他們禱告，要叫他們受聖靈。
verses.e: who , when they had come down , prayed for them , that they might receive the Holy Spirit ;

verses.z: 因為聖靈還沒有降在他們一個人身上，他們只奉主耶穌的名受了洗。
verses.e: for as yet he had fallen on none of them . They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 於是使徒按手在他們[頭]上，他們就受了聖靈。
verses.e: Then they laid their hands on them , and they received the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 西門看見使徒按手，便有聖靈賜下，就拿錢給使徒，
verses.e: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles ' hands , he offered them money ,

verses.z: 說：「把這權柄也給我，叫我手按着誰，誰就可以受聖靈。」
verses.e: saying , " Give me also this power , that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit . "

verses.z: 有虔誠的人把司提反埋葬了，為他捶胸大哭。
verses.e: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him .

verses.z: 彼得說：「你的銀子和你一同滅亡吧！因你想上帝的恩賜是可以用錢買的。
verses.e: But Peter said to him , " May your silver perish with you , because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money !

verses.z: 你在這道上無分無關；因為在上帝面前，你的心不正。
verses.e: You have neither part nor lot in this matter , for your heart isn't right before God .

verses.z: 你當懊悔你這罪惡，祈求主，或者你心裏的意念可得赦免。
verses.e: Repent therefore of this , your wickedness , and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you .

verses.z: 我看出你正在苦膽之中，被罪惡捆綁。」
verses.e: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity . "

verses.z: 西門說：「願你們為我求主，叫你們所說的，沒有一樣臨到我身上。」
verses.e: Simon answered , " Pray for me to the Lord , that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me . "

verses.z: 使徒既證明主道，而且傳講，就回耶路撒冷去，一路在撒馬利亞好些村莊傳揚福音。
verses.e: They therefore , when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans .

verses.z: 有主的一個使者對腓利說：「起來！向南走，往那從耶路撒冷下迦薩的路上去。」那路是曠野。
verses.e: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip , saying , " Arise , and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza . This is a desert . "

verses.z: 腓利就起身去了，不料，有一個衣索匹亞人，是個有大權的太監，在衣索匹亞女王甘大基的手下總管銀庫，他上耶路撒冷禮拜去了。
verses.e: He arose and went ; and behold , there was a man of Ethiopia , a eunuch of great authority under Candace , queen of the Ethiopians , who was over all her treasure , who had come to Jerusalem to worship .

verses.z: 現在回來，在車上坐着，念先知以賽亞的書。
verses.e: He was returning and sitting in his chariot , and was reading the prophet Isaiah .

verses.z: 聖靈對腓利說：「你去！貼近那車走。」
verses.e: The Spirit said to Philip , " Go near , and join yourself to this chariot . "

verses.z: 掃羅卻殘害教會，進各人的家，拉着男女下在監裏。
verses.e: But Saul ravaged the assembly , entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison .

verses.z: 腓利就跑到太監那裏，聽見他念先知以賽亞的書，便問他說：「你所念的，你明白嗎？」
verses.e: Philip ran to him , and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet , and said , " Do you understand what you are reading ? "

verses.z: 他說：「沒有人指教我，怎能明白呢？」於是請腓利上車，與他同坐。
verses.e: He said , " How can I , unless someone explains it to me ? " He begged Philip to come up and sit with him .

verses.z: 他所念的那段經，說：他像羊被牽到宰殺之地，又像羊羔在剪毛的人手下無聲；他也是這樣不開口。
verses.e: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this , " He was led as a sheep to the slaughter . As a lamb before his shearer is silent , so he doesn't open his mouth .

verses.z: 他卑微的時候，人不按公義審判他；誰能述說他的世代？因為他的生命從地上奪去。
verses.e: In his humiliation , his judgment was taken away . Who will declare His generation ? For his life is taken from the earth . "

verses.z: 太監對腓利說：「請問，先知說這話是指着誰？是指着自己呢？是指着別人呢？」
verses.e: The eunuch answered Philip , " Who is the prophet talking about ? About himself , or about someone else ? "

verses.z: 腓利就開口從這經上起，對他傳講耶穌。
verses.e: Philip opened his mouth , and beginning from this Scripture , preached to him about Jesus .

verses.z: 二人正往前走，到了有水的地方，太監說：「看哪，這裏有水，我受洗有甚麼妨礙呢？」
verses.e: As they went on the way , they came to some water ; and the eunuch said , " Behold , here is water . What is keeping me from being baptized ? "
He commanded the chariot to stand still , and they both went down into the water , both Philip and the eunuch , and he baptized him .

verses.z: 於是吩咐車站住，腓利和太監二人同下水裏去，腓利就給他施洗。
verses.e: When they came up out of the water , the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away , and the eunuch didn't see him any more , for he went on his way rejoicing .

verses.z: 從水裏上來，主的靈把腓利提了去，太監也不再見他了，就歡歡喜喜地走路。
verses.e: But Philip was found at Azotus . Passing through , he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea .

verses.z: 那些分散的人往各處去傳道。
verses.e: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word .

verses.z: 後來有人在亞鎖都遇見腓利；他走遍那地方，在各城宣傳福音，直到凱撒利亞。
腓利下撒馬利亞城去，宣講基督。
verses.e: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ .

verses.z: 眾人聽見了，又看見腓利所行的神蹟，就同心合意地聽從他的話。
verses.e: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did .

verses.z: 因為有許多人被污鬼附着，那些鬼大聲呼叫，從他們身上出來；還有許多癱瘓的、瘸腿的，都得了醫治。
verses.e: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them . They came out , crying with a loud voice . Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed .

verses.z: 在那城裏，就大有歡喜。
verses.e: There was great joy in that city .

verses.z: 有一個人，名叫西門，向來在那城裏行邪術，妄自尊大，使撒馬利亞的百姓驚奇；
verses.e: But there was a certain man , Simon by name , who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria , making himself out to be some great one ,

verses.z: 掃羅仍然向主的門徒口吐威嚇凶煞的話，去見大祭司，
verses.e: But Saul , still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord , went to the high priest

verses.z: 當下，在大馬士革有一個門徒，名叫亞拿尼亞。主在異象中對他說：「亞拿尼亞。」他說：「主，我在這裏。」
verses.e: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias . The Lord said to him in a vision , " Ananias ! " He said , " Behold , it's me , Lord . "

verses.z: 主對他說：「起來！往直街去，在猶大的家裏，訪問一個大數人，名叫掃羅。他正禱告，
verses.e: The Lord said to him , " Arise and go to the street which is called Straight , and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul , a man of Tarsus . For behold , he is praying ,

verses.z: 又看見了一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，進來按手在他身上，叫他能看見。」
verses.e: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him , that he might receive his sight . "

verses.z: 亞拿尼亞回答說：「主啊，我聽見許多人說，這人怎樣在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的聖徒，
verses.e: But Ananias answered , " Lord , I have heard from many about this man , how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 並且他在這裏有從祭司長得來的權柄捆綁一切求告你名的人。」
verses.e: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name . "

verses.z: 主對亞拿尼亞說：「你只管去！他是我所揀選的器皿，要在外邦人和君王，並以色列人面前宣揚我的名。
verses.e: But the Lord said to him , " Go your way , for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings , and the children of Israel .

verses.z: 我也要指示他，為我的名必須受許多的苦難。」
verses.e: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name's sake . "

verses.z: 亞拿尼亞就去了，進入那家，把手按在掃羅身上，說：「兄弟掃羅，在你來的路上向你顯現的主，就是耶穌，打發我來，叫你能看見，又被聖靈充滿。」
verses.e: Ananias departed and entered into the house . Laying his hands on him , he said , " Brother Saul , the Lord , who appeared to you on the road by which you came , has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit . "

verses.z: 掃羅的眼睛上，好像有鱗立刻掉下來，他就能看見。於是起來受了洗；
verses.e: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes , and he received his sight . He arose and was baptized .

verses.z: 吃過飯就健壯了。掃羅和大馬士革的門徒同住了些日子，
verses.e: He took food and was strengthened . Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus .

verses.z: 求文書給大馬士革的各會堂，若是找着信奉這道的人，無論男女，都准他捆綁帶到耶路撒冷。
verses.e: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus , that if he found any who were of the Way , whether men or women , he might bring them bound to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 就在各會堂裏宣傳耶穌，說他是上帝的兒子。
verses.e: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ , that he is the Son of God .

verses.z: 凡聽見的人都驚奇，說：「在耶路撒冷殘害求告這名的，不是這人嗎？並且他到這裏來，特要捆綁他們，帶到祭司長那裏。」
verses.e: All who heard him were amazed , and said , " Isn't this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name ? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests ! "

verses.z: 但掃羅越發有能力，駁倒住大馬士革的猶太人，證明耶穌是基督。
verses.e: But Saul increased more in strength , and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus , proving that this is the Christ .

verses.z: 過了好些日子，猶太人商議要殺掃羅，
verses.e: When many days were fulfilled , the Jews conspired together to kill him ,

verses.z: 但他們的計謀被掃羅知道了。他們又晝夜在城門守候，要殺他。
verses.e: but their plot became known to Saul . They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him ,

verses.z: 他的門徒就在夜間用筐子把他從城牆上縋下去。
verses.e: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall , lowering him in a basket .

verses.z: 掃羅到了耶路撒冷，想與門徒結交，他們卻都怕他，不信他是門徒。
verses.e: When Saul had come to Jerusalem , he tried to join himself to the disciples ; but they were all afraid of him , not believing that he was a disciple .

verses.z: 惟有巴拿巴接待他，領去見使徒，把他在路上怎麼看見主，主怎麼向他說話，他在大馬士革怎麼奉耶穌的名放膽傳道，都述說出來。
verses.e: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles , and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way , and that he had spoken to him , and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus .

verses.z: 於是掃羅在耶路撒冷和門徒出入來往，
verses.e: He was with them entering into Jerusalem ,

verses.z: 奉主的名放膽傳道，並與說希臘話的猶太人講論辯駁；他們卻想法子要殺他。
verses.e: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus . He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists , but they were seeking to kill him .

verses.z: 掃羅行路，將到大馬士革，忽然從天上發光，四面照着他；
verses.e: As he traveled , he got close to Damascus , and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him .

verses.z: 弟兄們知道了就送他下凱撒利亞，打發他往大數去。
verses.e: When the brothers knew it , they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus .

verses.z: 那時，猶太、加利利、撒馬利亞各處的教會都得平安，被建立；凡事敬畏主，蒙聖靈的安慰，人數就增多了。
verses.e: So the assemblies throughout all Judea , Galilee , and Samaria had peace and were built up . They were multiplied , walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 彼得周流四方的時候，也到了居住呂大的聖徒那裏；
verses.e: As Peter went throughout all those parts , he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda .

verses.z: 遇見一個人，名叫以尼雅，得了癱瘓，在褥子上躺臥八年。
verses.e: There he found a certain man named Aeneas , who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed .

verses.z: 彼得對他說：「以尼雅，耶穌基督醫好你了，起來！收拾你的褥子。」他就立刻起來了。
verses.e: Peter said to him , " Aeneas , Jesus Christ heals you . Get up and make your bed ! " Immediately he arose .

verses.z: 凡住呂大和沙崙的人都看見了他，就歸服主。
verses.e: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him , and they turned to the Lord .

verses.z: 在約帕有一個女徒，名叫大比大，翻[希臘]話就是多加；她廣行善事，多施賙濟。
verses.e: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha , which when translated means Dorcas . This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did .

verses.z: 當時，她患病而死，有人把她洗了，停在樓上。
verses.e: In those days , she became sick and died . When they had washed her , they laid her in an upper room .

verses.z: 呂大原與約帕相近；門徒聽見彼得在那裏，就打發兩個人去見他，央求他說：「快到我們那裏去，不要耽延。」
verses.e: As Lydda was near Joppa , the disciples , hearing that Peter was there , sent two men to him , imploring him not to delay in coming to them .

verses.z: 彼得就起身和他們同去；到了，便有人領他上樓。眾寡婦都站在彼得旁邊哭，拿多加與她們同在時所做的裏衣外衣給他看。
verses.e: Peter got up and went with them . When he had come , they brought him into the upper room . All the widows stood by him weeping , and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them .

verses.z: 他就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對他說：「掃羅！掃羅！你為甚麼逼迫我？」
verses.e: He fell on the earth , and heard a voice saying to him , " Saul , Saul , why do you persecute me ? "

verses.z: 彼得叫她們都出去，就跪下禱告，轉身對着死人說：「大比大，起來！」她就睜開眼睛，見了彼得，便坐起來。
verses.e: Peter sent them all out , and knelt down and prayed . Turning to the body , he said , " Tabitha , get up ! " She opened her eyes , and when she saw Peter , she sat up .

verses.z: 彼得伸手扶她起來，叫眾聖徒和寡婦進去，把多加活活地交給他們。
verses.e: He gave her his hand and raised her up . Calling the saints and widows , he presented her alive .

verses.z: 這事傳遍了約帕，就有許多人信了主。
verses.e: This became known throughout all Joppa , and many believed in the Lord .

verses.z: 此後，彼得在約帕一個硝皮匠西門的家裏住了多日。
verses.e: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon .

verses.z: 他說：「主啊！你是誰？」主說：「我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
verses.e: He said , " Who are you , Lord ? " The Lord said , " I am Jesus , whom you are persecuting .

verses.z: 起來！進城去，你所當做的事，必有人告訴你。」
verses.e: But rise up and enter into the city , then you will be told what you must do . "

verses.z: 同行的人站在那裏，說不出話來，聽見聲音，卻看不見人。
verses.e: The men who traveled with him stood speechless , hearing the sound , but seeing no one .

verses.z: 掃羅從地上起來，睜開眼睛，竟不能看見甚麼。有人拉他的手，領他進了大馬士革；
verses.e: Saul arose from the ground , and when his eyes were opened , he saw no one . They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus .

verses.z: 三日不能看見，也不吃也不喝。
verses.e: He was without sight for three days , and neither ate nor drank .

verses.z: 當猶大王烏西雅，以色列王約阿施的兒子耶羅波安在位的時候，大地震前二年，提哥亞牧人中的阿摩司得默示論以色列。
verses.e: The words of Amos , who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa , which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel , two years before the earthquake .

verses.z: 我卻要降火在泰爾的城內，燒滅其中的宮殿。
verses.e: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre , and it will devour its palaces . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：以東三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罰；因為她拿刀追趕兄弟，毫無憐憫，發怒撕裂，永懷忿怒。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of Edom , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment , because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity , and his anger raged continually , and he kept his wrath forever ;

verses.z: 我卻要降火在提幔，燒滅波斯拉的宮殿。
verses.e: but I will send a fire on Teman , and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：亞捫人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他們的刑罰；因為他們剖開基列的孕婦，擴張自己的境界。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment , because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead , that they may enlarge their border .

verses.z: 我卻要在爭戰吶喊的日子，旋風狂暴的時候，點火在拉巴的城內，燒滅其中的宮殿。
verses.e: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah , and it will devour its palaces , with shouting in the day of battle , with a storm in the day of the whirlwind ;

verses.z: 他們的王和首領必一同被擄去。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: and their king will go into captivity , he and his princes together , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 他說：耶和華必從錫安吼叫，從耶路撒冷發聲；牧人的草場要悲哀；迦密的山頂要枯乾。
verses.e: He said : " The LORD will roar from Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem ; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn , and the top of Carmel will wither . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：大馬士革三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罰；因為她以打糧食的鐵器打過基列。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of Damascus , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment , because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron ;

verses.z: 我卻要降火在哈薛的家中，燒滅便‧哈達的宮殿。
verses.e: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael , and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad .

verses.z: 我必折斷大馬士革的門閂，剪除亞文平原的居民和伯‧伊甸掌權的。亞蘭人必被擄到吉珥。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will break the bar of Damascus , and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven , and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden ; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：迦薩三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罰；因為她擄掠眾民交給以東。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of Gaza , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment , because they carried away captive the whole community , to deliver them up to Edom ;

verses.z: 我卻要降火在迦薩的城內，燒滅其中的宮殿。
verses.e: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , and it will devour its palaces .

verses.z: 我必剪除亞實突的居民和亞實基倫掌權的，也必反手攻擊以革倫。非利士人所餘剩的必都滅亡。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod , and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon ; and I will turn my hand against Ekron ; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：泰爾三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罰；因為她將眾民交給以東，並不記念弟兄的盟約。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of Tyre , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment ; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom , and didn't remember the brotherly covenant ;

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：摩押三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罰；因為她將以東王的骸骨焚燒成灰。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of Moab , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment , because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime ;

verses.z: 我也將你們從埃及地領上來，在曠野引導你們四十年，使你們得亞摩利人之地為業。
verses.e: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness , to possess the land of the Amorite .

verses.z: 我從你們子弟中興起先知，又從你們少年人中興起拿細耳人。以色列人哪，不是這樣嗎？這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I raised up some of your sons for prophets , and some of your young men for Nazirites . Isn't this true , you children of Israel ? " says the LORD .

verses.z: 你們卻給拿細耳人酒喝，囑咐先知說：不要說預言。
verses.e: " But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink , and commanded the prophets , saying , ' Don't prophesy ! '

verses.z: 看哪，在你們所住之地，我必壓[你們]，如同裝滿禾捆的車壓[物]一樣。
verses.e: Behold , I will crush you in your place , as a cart crushes that is full of grain .

verses.z: 快跑的不能逃脫；有力的不能用力；剛勇的也不能自救。
verses.e: Flight will perish from the swift . The strong won't strengthen his force . The mighty won't deliver himself .

verses.z: 拿弓的不能站立；腿快的不能逃脫；騎馬的也不能自救。
verses.e: He who handles the bow won't stand . He who is swift of foot won't escape . He who rides the horse won't deliver himself .

verses.z: 到那日，勇士中最有膽量的，必赤身逃跑。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我卻要降火在摩押，燒滅加略的宮殿。摩押必在鬨嚷吶喊吹角之中死亡。
verses.e: but I will send a fire on Moab , and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth ; and Moab will die with tumult , with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet ;

verses.z: 我必剪除摩押中的審判者，將其中的一切首領和他一同殺戮。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: and I will cut off the judge from among them , and will kill all its princes with him , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：猶大人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他們的刑罰；因為他們厭棄耶和華的訓誨，不遵守他的律例。他們列祖所隨從虛假的[偶像]使他們走迷了。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of Judah , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment , because they have rejected the LORD's law , and have not kept his statutes , and their lies have led them astray , after which their fathers walked ;

verses.z: 我卻要降火在猶大，燒滅耶路撒冷的宮殿。
verses.e: but I will send a fire on Judah , and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：以色列人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他們的刑罰；因他們為銀子賣了義人，為一雙鞋賣了窮人。
verses.e: The LORD says : " For three transgressions of Israel , yes , for four , I will not turn away its punishment , because they have sold the righteous for silver , and the needy for a pair of sandals ;

verses.z: 他們見窮人頭上所蒙的灰也都垂涎，阻礙謙卑人的道路。父子同一個女子行淫，褻瀆我的聖名。
verses.e: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed . A man and his father use the same maiden , to profane my holy name .

verses.z: 他們在各壇旁鋪人所當的衣服，臥在其上，又在他們神的廟中喝受罰之人的酒。
verses.e: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge . In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined .

verses.z: 我從以色列人面前除滅亞摩利人。他雖高大如香柏樹，堅固如橡樹，我卻上滅他的果子，下絕他的根本。
