verses.e: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them , whose height was like the height of the cedars , and he was strong as the oaks ; yet I destroyed his fruit from above , and his roots from beneath .

verses.z: 以色列人哪，你們全家是我從埃及地領上來的，當聽耶和華攻擊你們的話：
verses.e: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you , children of Israel , against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt , saying :

verses.z: 那些以強暴搶奪財物、積蓄在自己家中的人不知道行正直的事。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Indeed they don't know to do right , " says the LORD , " Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces . "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：敵人必來圍攻這地，使你的勢力衰微，搶掠你的家宅。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says : " An adversary will overrun the land ; and he will pull down your strongholds , and your fortresses will be plundered . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「牧人怎樣從獅子口中搶回兩條[羊]腿或半個耳朵，住撒馬利亞的以色列人躺臥在床角上或鋪繡花毯的榻上，他們得救也不過如此。」
verses.e: The LORD says : " As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs , or a piece of an ear , so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch , and on the silken cushions of a bed . "

verses.z: 主耶和華－萬軍之上帝說：當聽這話，警戒雅各家。
verses.e: " Listen , and testify against the house of Jacob , " says the Lord GOD , the God of Armies .

verses.z: 我討以色列罪的日子，也要討伯特利祭壇的罪；壇角必被砍下，墜落於地。
verses.e: " For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him , I will also visit the altars of Bethel ; and the horns of the altar will be cut off , and fall to the ground .

verses.z: 我要拆毀過冬和過夏的房屋。象牙的房屋也必毀滅；高大的房屋都歸無有。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will strike the winter house with the summer house ; and the houses of ivory will perish , and the great houses will have an end , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 在地上萬族中，我只認識你們；因此，我必追討你們的一切罪孽。
verses.e: " I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth . Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins . "

verses.z: 二人若不同心，豈能同行呢？
verses.e: Do two walk together , unless they have agreed ?

verses.z: 獅子若非抓食，豈能在林中咆哮呢？少壯獅子若無所得，豈能從洞中發聲呢？
verses.e: Will a lion roar in the thicket , when he has no prey ? Does a young lion cry out of his den , if he has caught nothing ?

verses.z: 若沒有機檻，雀鳥豈能陷在網羅裏呢？網羅若無所得，豈能從地上翻起呢？
verses.e: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth , where no snare is set for him ? Does a snare spring up from the ground , when there is nothing to catch ?

verses.z: 城中若吹角，百姓豈不驚恐呢？災禍若臨到一城，豈非耶和華所降的嗎？
verses.e: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city , without the people being afraid ? Does evil happen to a city , and the LORD hasn't done it ?

verses.z: 主耶和華若不將奧祕指示他的僕人－眾先知，就一無所行。
verses.e: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing , unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets .

verses.z: 獅子吼叫，誰不懼怕呢？主耶和華發命，誰能不說預言呢？
verses.e: The lion has roared . Who will not fear ? The Lord GOD has spoken . Who can but prophesy ?

verses.z: 要在亞實突的宮殿中和埃及地的宮殿裏傳揚說：你們要聚集在撒馬利亞的山上，就看見城中有何等大的擾亂與欺壓的事。
verses.e: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod , and in the palaces in the land of Egypt , and say , " Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria , and see what unrest is in her , and what oppression is among them . "

verses.z: 你們住撒馬利亞山如巴珊母牛的啊，當聽我的話－你們欺負貧寒的，壓碎窮乏的，對家主說：拿[酒]來，我們喝吧！
verses.e: Listen to this word , you cows of Bashan , who are on the mountain of Samaria , who oppress the poor , who crush the needy , who tell their husbands , " Bring us drinks ! "

verses.z: 我降瘟疫在你們中間，像在埃及一樣；用刀殺戮你們的少年人，使你們的馬匹被擄掠，營中[屍首]的臭氣撲鼻；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt . I have slain your young men with the sword , and have carried away your horses . I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp , yet you haven't returned to me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我傾覆你們中間的[城邑]，如同我從前傾覆所多瑪、蛾摩拉一樣，使你們好像從火中抽出來的一根柴；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " I have overthrown some of you , as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah , and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire ; yet you haven't returned to me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 以色列啊，我必向你如此行；以色列啊，我既這樣行，你當預備迎見你的上帝。
verses.e: " Therefore I will do this to you , Israel ; because I will do this to you , prepare to meet your God , Israel .

verses.z: 那創山、造風、將心意指示人、使晨光變為幽暗、腳踏在地之高處的，他的名是耶和華－萬軍之上帝。
verses.e: For , behold , he who forms the mountains , creates the wind , declares to man what is his thought , who makes the morning darkness , and treads on the high places of the earth : The LORD , the God of Armies , is his name . "

verses.z: 主耶和華指着自己的聖潔起誓說：日子快到，人必用鉤子將你們鉤去，用魚鉤將你們餘剩的鉤去。
verses.e: The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness , " Behold , the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks , and the last of you with fish hooks .

verses.z: 你們各人必從破口直往前行，投入哈門。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: You will go out at the breaks in the wall , everyone straight before her ; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 以色列人哪，任你們往伯特利去犯罪，到吉甲加增罪過；每日早晨獻上你們的祭物，每三日奉上你們的十分之一。
verses.e: " Go to Bethel , and sin ; to Gilgal , and sin more . Bring your sacrifices every morning , your tithes every three days ,

verses.z: 任你們獻有酵的感謝祭，把甘心祭宣傳報告給眾人，因為是你們所喜愛的。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened , and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them ; for this pleases you , you children of Israel , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我使你們在一切城中牙齒乾淨，在你們各處糧食缺乏，你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities , and lack of bread in every town ; yet you haven't returned to me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 在收割的前三月，我使雨停止，不降在你們那裏；我降雨在這城，不降雨在那城；這塊地有雨，那塊地無雨；無雨的就枯乾了。
verses.e: " I also have withheld the rain from you , when there were yet three months to the harvest ; and I caused it to rain on one city , and caused it not to rain on another city . One field was rained on , and the field where it didn't rain withered .

verses.z: 這樣，兩三城的人湊到一城去找水，卻喝不足；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water , and were not satisfied ; yet you haven't returned to me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我以旱[風]、霉爛攻擊你們，你們園中許多菜蔬、葡萄樹、無花果樹、橄欖樹都被剪蟲所吃；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards , and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees ; yet you haven't returned to me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 以色列家啊，要聽我為你們所作的哀歌：
verses.e: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you , O house of Israel :

verses.z: 你們怨恨那在城門口責備人的，憎惡那說正直話的。
verses.e: They hate him who reproves in the gate , and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly .

verses.z: 你們踐踏貧民，向他們勒索麥子；你們用鑿過的石頭建造房屋，卻不得住在其內；栽種美好的葡萄園，卻不得喝所出的酒。
verses.e: Therefore , because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat , you have built houses of cut stone , but you will not dwell in them . You have planted pleasant vineyards , but you shall not drink their wine .

verses.z: 我知道你們的罪過何等多，你們的罪惡何等大。你們苦待義人，收受賄賂，在城門口屈枉窮乏人。
verses.e: For I know how many are your offenses , and how great are your sins — you who afflict the just , who take a bribe , and who turn away the needy in the courts .

verses.z: 所以通達人見這樣的時勢必靜默不言，因為時勢真惡。
verses.e: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time , for it is an evil time .

verses.z: 你們要求善，不要求惡，就必存活。這樣，耶和華－萬軍之上帝必照你們所說的與你們同在。
verses.e: Seek good , and not evil , that you may live ; and so the LORD , the God of Armies , will be with you , as you say .

verses.z: 要惡惡好善，在城門口秉公行義；或者耶和華－萬軍之上帝向約瑟的餘民施恩。
verses.e: Hate evil , love good , and establish justice in the courts . It may be that the LORD , the God of Armies , will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph . "

verses.z: 主耶和華－萬軍之上帝如此說：在一切寬闊處必有哀號的聲音；在各街市上必有人說：哀哉！哀哉！又必叫農夫來哭號，叫善唱哀歌的來舉哀。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD , the God of Armies , the Lord , says : " Wailing will be in all the wide ways . They will say in all the streets , ' Alas ! Alas ! ' They will call the farmer to mourning , and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing .

verses.z: 在各葡萄園必有哀號的聲音，因為我必從你中間經過。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: In all vineyards there will be wailing , for I will pass through the middle of you , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 想望耶和華日子來到的有禍了！你們為何想望耶和華的日子呢？那日黑暗沒有光明，
verses.e: " Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD ! Why do you long for the day of the LORD ? It is darkness , and not light .

verses.z: 景況好像人躲避獅子又遇見熊，或是進房屋以手靠牆，就被蛇咬。
verses.e: As if a man fled from a lion , and a bear met him ; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall , and a snake bit him .

verses.z: 以色列民跌倒，不得再起；躺在地上，無人攙扶。
verses.e: " The virgin of Israel has fallen ; She shall rise no more . She is cast down on her land ; there is no one to raise her up . "

verses.z: 耶和華的日子不是黑暗沒有光明嗎？不是幽暗毫無光輝嗎？
verses.e: Won't the day of the LORD be darkness , and not light ? Even very dark , and no brightness in it ?

verses.z: 我厭惡你們的節期，也不喜悅你們的嚴肅會。
verses.e: I hate , I despise your feasts , and I can't stand your solemn assemblies .

verses.z: 你們雖然向我獻燔祭和素祭，我卻不悅納，也不顧你們用肥畜獻的平安祭；
verses.e: Yes , though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings , I will not accept them ; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals .

verses.z: 要使你們歌唱的聲音遠離我，因為我不聽你們彈琴的響聲。
verses.e: Take away from me the noise of your songs ! I will not listen to the music of your harps .

verses.z: 惟願公平如大水滾滾，使公義如江河滔滔。
verses.e: But let justice roll on like rivers , and righteousness like a mighty stream .

verses.z: 「以色列家啊，你們在曠野四十年，豈是將祭物和供物獻給我呢？
verses.e: " Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years , house of Israel ?

verses.z: 你們抬着為自己所造之摩洛的帳幕和偶像的龕，並你們的神星。
verses.e: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images , the star of your god , which you made for yourselves .

verses.z: 所以我要把你們擄到大馬士革以外。」這是耶和華－名為萬軍之上帝說的。
verses.e: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus , " says the LORD , whose name is the God of Armies .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：以色列家的城發出一千[兵]的，只剩一百；發出一百的，只剩十個。
verses.e: For the Lord GOD says : " The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left , and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel . "

verses.z: 耶和華向以色列家如此說：你們要尋求我，就必存活。
verses.e: For the LORD says to the house of Israel : " Seek me , and you will live ;

verses.z: 不要往伯特利尋求，不要進入吉甲，不要過到別是巴；因為吉甲必被擄掠，伯特利也必歸於無有。
verses.e: but don't seek Bethel , nor enter into Gilgal , and don't pass to Beersheba ; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity , and Bethel shall come to nothing .

verses.z: 要尋求耶和華，就必存活，免得他在約瑟家像火發出，在伯特利焚燒，無人撲滅。
verses.e: Seek the LORD , and you will live , lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph , and it devour , and there be no one to quench it in Bethel .

verses.z: 你們這使公平變為茵蔯、將公義丟棄於地的，
verses.e: You who turn justice to wormwood , and cast down righteousness to the earth !

verses.z: 要[尋求]那造昴星和參星，使死蔭變為晨光，使白日變為黑夜，命海水來澆在地上的－耶和華是他的名；
verses.e: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion , and turns the shadow of death into the morning , and makes the day dark with night ; who calls for the waters of the sea , and pours them out on the surface of the earth , the LORD is his name ,

verses.z: 他使力強的忽遭滅亡，以致保障遭遇毀壞。
verses.e: who brings sudden destruction on the strong , so that destruction comes on the fortress .

verses.z: 國為列國之首，人最著名，且為以色列家所歸向，在錫安和撒馬利亞山安逸無慮的，有禍了！
verses.e: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion , and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria , the notable men of the chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel come !

verses.z: 死人的伯叔，就是燒他屍首的，要將這屍首搬到房外，問房屋內間的人說：「你那裏還有人沒有？」他必說：「沒有」；又說：「不要作聲，因為我們不可提耶和華的名。」
verses.e: " When a man's relative carries him , even he who burns him , to bring bodies out of the house , and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house , ' Is there yet any with you ? ' And he says , ' No ; ' then he will say , ' Hush ! Indeed we must not mention the LORD's name . '

verses.z: 看哪，耶和華出令，大房就被攻破，小屋就被打裂。
verses.e: " For , behold , the LORD commands , and the great house will be smashed to pieces , and the little house into bits .

verses.z: 馬豈能在崖石上奔跑？人豈能[在那裏]用牛耕種呢？你們卻使公平變為苦膽，使公義的果子變為茵蔯。
verses.e: Do horses run on the rocky crags ? Does one plow there with oxen ? But you have turned justice into poison , and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness ,

verses.z: 你們喜愛虛浮的事，[自誇]說：我們不是憑自己的力量取了角嗎？
verses.e: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing , who say , ' Haven't we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength ? '

verses.z: 耶和華、萬軍之上帝說：以色列家啊，我必興起一國攻擊你們；他們必欺壓你們，從哈馬口直到亞拉巴的河。
verses.e: For , behold , I will raise up against you a nation , house of Israel , " says the LORD , the God of Armies ; " and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah . "

verses.z: 你們要過到甲尼察看，從那裏往大[城]哈馬去，又下到非利士人的迦特，看那些國比你們的國還強嗎？境界比你們的境界還寬嗎？
verses.e: Go to Calneh , and see . From there go to Hamath the great . Then go down to Gath of the Philistines . Are they better than these kingdoms ? Is their border greater than your border ?

verses.z: 你們以為降禍的日子還遠，坐在位上盡行強暴。
verses.e: Alas for you who put far away the evil day , and cause the seat of violence to come near ,

verses.z: 你們躺臥在象牙床上，舒身在榻上，吃群中的羊羔，棚裏的牛犢；
verses.e: who lie on beds of ivory , and stretch themselves on their couches , and eat the lambs out of the flock , and the calves out of the middle of the stall ,

verses.z: 彈琴鼓瑟唱消閑的歌曲，為自己製造樂器，如同大衛[所造]的；
verses.e: who strum on the strings of a harp , who invent for themselves instruments of music , like David ;

verses.z: 以大碗喝酒，用上等的油抹身，卻不為約瑟的苦難擔憂。
verses.e: who drink wine in bowls , and anoint themselves with the best oils , but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph .

verses.z: 所以這些人必在被擄的人中首先被擄；舒身的人荒宴之樂必消滅了。
verses.e: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive . The feasting and lounging will end .

verses.z: 主耶和華－萬軍之上帝指着自己起誓說：我憎惡雅各的榮華，厭棄他的宮殿；因此，我必將城和其中所有的都交付[敵人]。
verses.e: " The Lord GOD has sworn by himself , " says the LORD , the God of Armies : " I abhor the pride of Jacob , and detest his fortresses . Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it .

verses.z: 那時，若在一房之內剩下十個人，也都必死。
verses.e: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house , they will die .

verses.z: 主耶和華指示我一件事：為王割菜之後，菜又發生；剛發生的時候，主造蝗蟲。
verses.e: Thus the Lord GOD showed me : behold , he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth ; and behold , it was the latter growth after the king's harvest .

verses.z: 伯特利的祭司亞瑪謝打發人到以色列王耶羅波安那裏，說：「阿摩司在以色列家中圖謀背叛你；他所說的一切話，這國擔當不起；
verses.e: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel , saying , " Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel . The land is not able to bear all his words .

verses.z: 因為阿摩司如此說：『耶羅波安必被刀殺；以色列民定被擄去離開本地。』」
verses.e: For Amos says , ' Jeroboam will die by the sword , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land . ' "

verses.z: 亞瑪謝又對阿摩司說：「你這先見哪，要逃往猶大地去，在那裏糊口，在那裏說預言，
verses.e: Amaziah also said to Amos , " You seer , go , flee away into the land of Judah , and there eat bread , and prophesy there ,

verses.z: 卻不要在伯特利再說預言；因為這裏有王的聖所，有王的宮殿。」
verses.e: but don't prophesy again any more at Bethel ; for it is the king's sanctuary , and it is a royal house ! "

verses.z: 阿摩司對亞瑪謝說：「我原不是先知，也不是先知的門徒。我是牧人，又是修理桑樹的。
verses.e: Then Amos answered Amaziah , " I was no prophet , neither was I a prophet's son , but I was a herdsman , and a farmer of sycamore figs ;

verses.z: 耶和華選召我，使我不跟從羊群，對我說：『你去向我民以色列說預言。』
verses.e: and the LORD took me from following the flock , and the LORD said to me , ' Go , prophesy to my people Israel . '

verses.z: 亞瑪謝啊，現在你要聽耶和華的話。你說：『不要向以色列說預言，也不要向以撒家滴下[預言]。』
verses.e: Now therefore listen to the LORD's word : ' You say , Don't prophesy against Israel , and don't preach against the house of Isaac . '

verses.z: 所以耶和華如此說：『你的妻子必在城中作妓女；你的兒女必倒在刀下。你的地必有人用繩子量了分取；你自己必死在污穢之地。以色列民定被擄去離開本地。』」
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says : ' Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city , and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword , and your land shall be divided by line ; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land . ' "

verses.z: 蝗蟲吃盡那地的青物，我就說：「主耶和華啊，求你赦免；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？」
verses.e: When they finished eating the grass of the land , then I said , " Lord GOD , forgive , I beg you ! How could Jacob stand ? For he is small . "

verses.z: 耶和華就後悔說：「這災可以免了。」
verses.e: The LORD relented concerning this . " It shall not be , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 主耶和華又指示我一件事：他命火來懲罰以色列，火就吞滅深淵，險些將地燒滅。
verses.e: Thus the Lord GOD showed me : behold , the Lord GOD called for judgment by fire ; and it dried up the great deep , and would have devoured the land .

verses.z: 我就說：「主耶和華啊，求你止息；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？」
verses.e: Then I said , " Lord GOD , stop , I beg you ! How could Jacob stand ? For he is small . "

verses.z: 耶和華就後悔說：「這災也可免了。」
verses.e: The LORD relented concerning this . " This also shall not be , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 他又指示我一件事：有一道牆是按準繩建築的，主手拿準繩站在其上。
verses.e: Thus he showed me : behold , the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line , with a plumb line in his hand .

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「阿摩司啊，你看見甚麼？」我說：「看見準繩。」主說：「我要吊起準繩在我民以色列中，我必不再寬恕他們。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Amos , what do you see ? " I said , " A plumb line . " Then the Lord said , " Behold , I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel . I will not again pass by them any more .

verses.z: 以撒的邱壇必然淒涼；以色列的聖所必然荒廢。我必興起，用刀攻擊耶羅波安的家。」
verses.e: The high places of Isaac will be desolate , the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste ; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword . "

verses.z: 主耶和華又指示我一件事：我看見一筐夏天的果子。
verses.e: Thus the Lord GOD showed me : behold , a basket of summer fruit .

verses.z: 我必使你們的節期變為悲哀，歌曲變為哀歌。眾人腰束麻布，頭上光禿，使這場悲哀如喪獨生子，至終如痛苦的日子一樣。
verses.e: I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation ; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies , and baldness on every head . I will make it like the mourning for an only son , and its end like a bitter day .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：日子將到，我必命饑荒降在地上。人飢餓非因無餅，乾渴非因無水，乃因不聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: Behold , the days come , " says the Lord GOD , " that I will send a famine in the land , not a famine of bread , nor a thirst for water , but of hearing the LORD's words .

verses.z: 他們必飄流，從這海到那海，從北邊到東邊，往來奔跑，尋求耶和華的話，卻尋不着。
verses.e: They will wander from sea to sea , and from the north even to the east ; they will run back and forth to seek the LORD's word , and will not find it .

verses.z: 當那日，美貌的處女和少年的男子必因乾渴發昏。
verses.e: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst .

verses.z: 那指着撒馬利亞牛犢起誓的說：但哪，我們指着你那裏的活神起誓；又說：我們指着別是巴的神道起誓。這些人都必仆倒，永不再起來。
verses.e: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria , and say , ' As your god , Dan , lives , ' and , ' As the way of Beersheba lives , ' they will fall , and never rise up again . "

verses.z: 他說：「阿摩司啊，你看見甚麼？」我說：「看見一筐夏天的果子。」耶和華說：「我民以色列的結局到了，我必不再寬恕他們。」
verses.e: He said , " Amos , what do you see ? " I said , " A basket of summer fruit . " Then the LORD said to me , " The end has come on my people Israel . I will not again pass by them any more .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：「那日，殿中的詩歌變為哀號；必有許多屍首在各處拋棄，無人作聲。」
verses.e: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day , " says the Lord GOD . " The dead bodies will be many . In every place they will throw them out with silence .

verses.z: 你們這些要吞吃窮乏人、使困苦人衰敗的，當聽我的話！
verses.e: Hear this , you who desire to swallow up the needy , and cause the poor of the land to fail ,

verses.z: 你們說：月朔幾時過去，我們好賣糧；安息日幾時過去，我們好擺開麥子；[賣出]用小升斗，[收銀]用大戥子，用詭詐的天平欺哄人，
verses.e: saying , ' When will the new moon be gone , that we may sell grain ? And the Sabbath , that we may market wheat , making the ephah small , and the shekel large , and dealing falsely with balances of deceit ;

verses.z: 好用銀子買貧寒人，用一雙鞋換窮乏人，將壞了的麥子賣給人。
verses.e: that we may buy the poor for silver , and the needy for a pair of sandals , and sell the sweepings with the wheat ? ' "

verses.z: 耶和華指着雅各的榮耀起誓說：他們的一切行為，我必永遠不忘。
verses.e: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob , " Surely I will never forget any of their works .

verses.z: 地豈不因這事震動？其上的居民不也悲哀嗎？地必全然像尼羅河漲起，如同埃及河湧上落下。
verses.e: Won't the land tremble for this , and everyone mourn who dwells in it ? Yes , it will rise up wholly like the River ; and it will be stirred up and sink again , like the River of Egypt .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：到那日，我必使日頭在午間落下，使地在白晝黑暗。
verses.e: It will happen in that day , " says the Lord GOD , " that I will cause the sun to go down at noon , and I will darken the earth in the clear day .

verses.z: 我看見主站在祭壇旁邊；他說：你要擊打柱頂，使門檻震動，打碎柱頂，落在眾人頭上；所剩下的人，我必用刀殺戮，無一人能逃避，無一人能逃脫。
verses.e: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar , and he said , " Strike the tops of the pillars , that the thresholds may shake . Break them in pieces on the head of all of them . I will kill the last of them with the sword . Not one of them will flee away . Not one of them will escape .

verses.z: 我民中的一切罪人說：災禍必追不上我們，也迎不着我們。他們必死在刀下。
verses.e: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword , who say , ' Evil won't overtake nor meet us . '

verses.z: 到那日，我必建立大衛倒塌的帳幕，堵住其中的破口，把那破壞的建立起來，重新修造，像古時一樣，
verses.e: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches , and I will raise up its ruins , and I will build it as in the days of old ,

verses.z: 使以色列人得以東所餘剩的和所有稱為我名下的國。此乃行這事的耶和華說的。
verses.e: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name , " says the LORD who does this .

verses.z: 耶和華說：日子將到，耕種的必接續收割的；踹葡萄的必接續撒種的；大山要滴下甜酒；小山都必流奶。
verses.e: " Behold , the days come , " says the LORD , " that the plowman shall overtake the reaper , and the one treading grapes him who sows seed ; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains , and flow from the hills .

verses.z: 我必使我民以色列被擄的歸回；他們必重修荒廢的城邑居住，栽種葡萄園，喝其中所出的酒，修造果木園，吃其中的果子。
verses.e: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity , and they will rebuild the ruined cities , and inhabit them ; and they will plant vineyards , and drink wine from them . They shall also make gardens , and eat their fruit .

verses.z: 我要將他們栽於本地，他們不再從我所賜給他們的地上拔出來。這是耶和華－你的上帝說的。
verses.e: I will plant them on their land , and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them , " says the LORD your God .

verses.z: 他們雖然挖透陰間，我的手必取出他們來；雖然爬上天去，我必拿下他們來；
verses.e: Though they dig into Sheol , there my hand will take them ; and though they climb up to heaven , there I will bring them down .

verses.z: 雖然藏在迦密山頂，我必搜尋，捉出他們來；雖然從我眼前藏在海底，我必命蛇咬他們；
verses.e: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out from there ; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea , there I will command the serpent , and it will bite them .

verses.z: 雖被仇敵擄去，我必命刀劍殺戮他們；我必向他們定住眼目，降禍不降福。
verses.e: Though they go into captivity before their enemies , there I will command the sword , and it will kill them . I will set my eyes on them for evil , and not for good .

verses.z: 主－萬軍之耶和華摸地，地就消化，凡住在地上的都必悲哀。地必全然像尼羅河漲起，如同埃及河落下。
verses.e: For the Lord , the GOD of Armies , is he who touches the land and it melts , and all who dwell in it will mourn ; and it will rise up wholly like the River , and will sink again , like the River of Egypt .

verses.z: 那在天上建造樓閣、在地上安定穹蒼、命海水澆在地上的－耶和華是他的名。
verses.e: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens , and has founded his vault on the earth ; he who calls for the waters of the sea , and pours them out on the surface of the earth — the LORD is his name .

verses.z: 耶和華說：以色列人哪，我豈不看你們如古實人嗎？我豈不是領以色列人出埃及地，領非利士人出迦斐託，領亞蘭人出吉珥嗎？
verses.e: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me , children of Israel ? " says the LORD . " Haven't I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt , and the Philistines from Caphtor , and the Syrians from Kir ?

verses.z: 主耶和華的眼目察看這有罪的國，必將這國從地上滅絕，卻不將雅各家滅絕淨盡。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Behold , the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom , and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth , except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我必出令，將以色列家分散在列國中，好像用篩子篩[穀]，連一粒也不落在地上。
verses.e: " For behold , I will command , and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve , yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth .

verses.z: 奉上帝旨意，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅和兄弟提摩太
verses.e: Paul , an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God , and Timothy our brother ,

verses.z: 好叫你們行事為人對得起主，凡事蒙他喜悅，在一切善事上結果子，漸漸地多知道上帝；
verses.e: that you may walk worthily of the Lord , to please him in all respects , bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God ,

verses.z: 照他榮耀的權能，得以在各樣的力上加力，好叫你們凡事歡歡喜喜地忍耐寬容；
verses.e: strengthened with all power , according to the might of his glory , for all endurance and perseverance with joy ,

verses.z: 又感謝父，叫我們能與眾聖徒在光明中同得基業。
verses.e: giving thanks to the Father , who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light ,

verses.z: 他救了我們脫離黑暗的權勢，把我們遷到他愛子的國裏；
verses.e: who delivered us out of the power of darkness , and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love ,

verses.z: 我們在愛子裏得蒙救贖，罪過得以赦免。
verses.e: in whom we have our redemption , the forgiveness of our sins .

verses.z: 愛子是那不能看見之上帝的像，是首生的，在一切被造的以先。
verses.e: He is the image of the invisible God , the firstborn of all creation .

verses.z: 因為萬有都是靠他造的，無論是天上的，地上的；能看見的，不能看見的；或是有位的，主治的，執政的，掌權的；一概都是藉着他造的，又是為他造的。
verses.e: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth , visible things and invisible things , whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers . All things have been created through him and for him .

verses.z: 他在萬有之先；萬有也靠他而立。
verses.e: He is before all things , and in him all things are held together .

verses.z: 他也是教會全體之首。他是元始，是從死裏首先復生的，使他可以在凡事上居首位。
verses.e: He is the head of the body , the assembly , who is the beginning , the firstborn from the dead , that in all things he might have the preeminence .

verses.z: 因為[父]喜歡叫一切的豐盛在他裏面居住。
verses.e: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him ,

verses.z: 寫信給歌羅西的聖徒，在基督裏有忠心的弟兄。願恩惠、平安從上帝我們的父歸與你們！
verses.e: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae : Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 既然藉着他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，便藉着他叫萬有－無論是地上的、天上的－都與自己和好了。
verses.e: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him , whether things on the earth or things in the heavens , having made peace through the blood of his cross .

verses.z: 你們從前與上帝隔絕，因着惡行，心裏[與他]為敵。
verses.e: You , being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds ,

verses.z: 但如今他藉着基督的肉身受死，叫你們與自己和好，都成了聖潔，沒有瑕疵，無可責備，把你們引到自己面前。
verses.e: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death , to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him ,

verses.z: 只要你們在所信的道上恆心，根基穩固，堅定不移，不致被引動失去福音的盼望。這福音就是你們所聽過的，也是傳與普天下萬人聽的，我－保羅也作了這福音的執事。
verses.e: if it is so that you continue in the faith , grounded and steadfast , and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard , which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven , of which I , Paul , was made a servant .

verses.z: 現在我為你們受苦，倒覺歡樂；並且為基督的身體，就是為教會，要在我肉身上補滿基督患難的缺欠。
verses.e: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake , and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake , which is the assembly ,

verses.z: 我照上帝為你們所賜我的職分作了教會的執事，要把上帝的道理傳得全備，
verses.e: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God ,

verses.z: 這道理就是歷世歷代所隱藏的奧祕；但如今向他的聖徒顯明了。
verses.e: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations . But now it has been revealed to his saints ,

verses.z: 上帝願意叫他們知道，這奧祕在外邦人中有何等豐盛的榮耀，就是基督在你們心裏成了[有]榮耀的盼望。
verses.e: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles , which is Christ in you , the hope of glory .

verses.z: 我們傳揚他，是用諸般的智慧，勸戒各人，教導各人，要把各人在基督裏完完全全地引到上帝面前。
verses.e: We proclaim him , admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom , that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus ;

verses.z: 我也為此勞苦，照着他在我裏面運用的大能盡心竭力。
verses.e: for which I also labor , striving according to his working , which works in me mightily .

verses.z: 我們感謝上帝我們主耶穌基督的父，常常為你們禱告；
verses.e: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you ,

verses.z: 因聽見你們在基督耶穌裏的信心，並向眾聖徒的愛心，
verses.e: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints ,

verses.z: 是為那給你們存在天上的盼望；這盼望就是你們從前在福音真理的道上所聽見的。
verses.e: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens , of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

verses.z: 這福音傳到你們那裏，也傳到普天之下，並且結果，增長，如同在你們中間，自從你們聽見福音，真知道上帝恩惠的日子一樣。
verses.e: which has come to you , even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing , as it does in you also , since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth ,

verses.z: 正如你們從我們所親愛、一同作僕人的以巴弗所學的。他為我們作了基督忠心的執事，
verses.e: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant , who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf ,

verses.z: 也把你們因[聖]靈所存的愛心告訴了我們。
verses.e: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit .

verses.z: 因此，我們自從聽見的日子，也就為你們不住地禱告祈求，願你們在一切屬靈的智慧悟性上，滿心知道上帝的旨意；
verses.e: For this cause , we also , since the day we heard this , don't cease praying and making requests for you , that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding ,

verses.z: 我願意你們曉得，我為你們和老底嘉人，並一切沒有與我親自見面的人，是何等地盡心竭力；
verses.e: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea , and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh ;

verses.z: 你們在他裏面也得了豐盛。他是各樣執政掌權者的元首。
verses.e: and in him you are made full , who is the head of all principality and power .

verses.z: 你們在他裏面也受了不是人手所行的割禮，乃是基督使你們脫去肉體[情慾]的割禮。
verses.e: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands , in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh , in the circumcision of Christ ,

verses.z: 你們既受洗與他一同埋葬，也就在此與他一同復活，都因信那叫他從死裏復活上帝的功用。
verses.e: having been buried with him in baptism , in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God , who raised him from the dead .

verses.z: 你們從前在過犯和未受割禮的肉體中死了，上帝赦免了你們一切過犯，便叫你們與基督一同活過來；
verses.e: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh . He made you alive together with him , having forgiven us all our trespasses ,

verses.z: 又塗抹了在律例上所寫、攻擊我們、有礙於我們的字據，把它撤去，釘在十字架上。
verses.e: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us . He has taken it out of the way , nailing it to the cross .

verses.z: 既將一切執政的、掌權的擄來，明顯給眾人看，就仗着十字架誇勝。
verses.e: Having stripped the principalities and the powers , he made a show of them openly , triumphing over them in it .

verses.z: 所以，不拘在飲食上，或節期、月朔、安息日都不可讓人論斷你們。
verses.e: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking , or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day ,

verses.z: 這些原是後事的影兒；那形體卻是基督。
verses.e: which are a shadow of the things to come ; but the body is Christ's .

verses.z: 不可讓人因着故意謙虛和敬拜天使，就奪去你們的獎賞。這等人拘泥在所見過的，隨着自己的慾心，無故地自高自大，
verses.e: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels , dwelling in the things which he has not seen , vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind ,

verses.z: 不持定元首。全身既然靠着他，筋節得以相助聯絡，就因上帝大得長進。
verses.e: and not holding firmly to the Head , from whom all the body , being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments , grows with God's growth .

verses.z: 要叫他們的心得安慰，因愛心互相聯絡，以致豐豐足足在悟性中有充足的信心，使他們真知上帝的奧祕，就是基督；
verses.e: that their hearts may be comforted , they being knit together in love , and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding , that they may know the mystery of God , both of the Father and of Christ ,

verses.z: 你們若是與基督同死，脫離了世上的小學，為甚麼仍像在世俗中活着、服從那「不可拿、不可嘗、不可摸」等類的規條呢？
verses.e: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world , why , as though living in the world , do you subject yourselves to ordinances ,
" Don't handle , nor taste , nor touch "

verses.z: 這都是照人所吩咐、所教導的。說到這一切，正用的時候就都敗壞了。
verses.e: ( all of which perish with use ) , according to the precepts and doctrines of men ?

verses.z: 這些規條使人徒有智慧之名，用私意崇拜，自表謙卑，苦待己身，其實在克制肉體的情慾上是毫無功效。
verses.e: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship , humility , and severity to the body , but aren't of any value against the indulgence of the flesh .

verses.z: 所積蓄的一切智慧知識，都在他裏面藏着。
verses.e: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden .

verses.z: 我說這話，免得有人用花言巧語迷惑你們。
verses.e: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech .

verses.z: 我身子雖與你們相離，心卻與你們同在，見你們循規蹈矩，信基督的心也堅固，我就歡喜了。
verses.e: For though I am absent in the flesh , yet I am with you in the spirit , rejoicing and seeing your order , and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ .

verses.z: 你們既然接受了主基督耶穌，就當遵他而行，
verses.e: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord , walk in him ,

verses.z: 在他裏面生根建造，信心堅固，正如你們所領的教訓，感謝的心也更增長了。
verses.e: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith , even as you were taught , abounding in it in thanksgiving .

verses.z: 你們要謹慎，恐怕有人用他的理學和虛空的妄言，不照着基督，乃照人間的遺傳和世上的小學就把你們擄去。
verses.e: Be careful that you don't let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit , after the tradition of men , after the elemental spirits of the world , and not after Christ .

verses.z: 因為上帝本性一切的豐盛都有形有體地居住在基督裏面，
verses.e: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily ,

verses.z: 所以，你們若真與基督一同復活，就當求在上面的事；那裏有基督坐在上帝的右邊。
verses.e: If then you were raised together with Christ , seek the things that are above , where Christ is , seated on the right hand of God .

verses.z: 穿上了新人。這新人在知識上漸漸更新，正如造他主的形像。
verses.e: and have put on the new man , who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator ,

verses.z: 在此並不分希臘人、猶太人，受割禮的、未受割禮的，化外人、西古提人，為奴的、自主的，惟有基督是包括一切，又住在各人之內。
verses.e: where there can't be Greek and Jew , circumcision and uncircumcision , barbarian , Scythian , bondservant , or free person ; but Christ is all , and in all .

verses.z: 所以，你們既是上帝的選民，聖潔蒙愛的人，就要存憐憫、恩慈、謙虛、溫柔、忍耐的心。
verses.e: Put on therefore , as God's chosen ones , holy and beloved , a heart of compassion , kindness , lowliness , humility , and perseverance ;

verses.z: 倘若這人與那人有嫌隙，總要彼此包容，彼此饒恕；主怎樣饒恕了你們，你們也要怎樣饒恕人。
verses.e: bearing with one another , and forgiving each other , if any man has a complaint against any ; even as Christ forgave you , so you also do .

verses.z: 在這一切之外，要存着愛心，愛心就是聯絡全德的。
verses.e: Above all these things , walk in love , which is the bond of perfection .

verses.z: 又要叫基督的平安在你們心裏作主；你們也為此蒙召，歸為一體；且要存感謝的心。
verses.e: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts , to which also you were called in one body , and be thankful .

verses.z: 當用各樣的智慧，把基督的道理豐豐富富地存在心裏，用詩章、頌詞、靈歌，彼此教導，互相勸戒，心被恩感，歌頌上帝。
verses.e: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly ; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms , hymns , and spiritual songs , singing with grace in your heart to the Lord .

verses.z: 無論做甚麼，或說話或行事，都要奉主耶穌的名，藉着他感謝父上帝。
verses.e: Whatever you do , in word or in deed , do all in the name of the Lord Jesus , giving thanks to God the Father through him .

verses.z: 你們作妻子的，當順服自己的丈夫，這在主裏面是相宜的。
verses.e: Wives , be in subjection to your husbands , as is fitting in the Lord .

verses.z: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，不可苦待她們。
verses.e: Husbands , love your wives , and don't be bitter against them .

verses.z: 你們要思念上面的事，不要思念地上的事。
verses.e: Set your mind on the things that are above , not on the things that are on the earth .

verses.z: 你們作兒女的，要凡事聽從父母，因為這是主所喜悅的。
verses.e: Children , obey your parents in all things , for this pleases the Lord .

verses.z: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，恐怕他們失了志氣。
verses.e: Fathers , don't provoke your children , so that they won't be discouraged .

verses.z: 你們作僕人的，要凡事聽從你們肉身的主人，不要只在眼前事奉，像是討人喜歡的，總要存心誠實敬畏主。
verses.e: Servants , obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh , not just when they are looking , as men pleasers , but in singleness of heart , fearing God .

verses.z: 無論做甚麼，都要從心裏做，像是給主做的，不是給人做的，
verses.e: And whatever you do , work heartily , as for the Lord and not for men ,

verses.z: 因你們知道從主那裏必得着基業為賞賜；你們所事奉的乃是主基督。
verses.e: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance ; for you serve the Lord Christ .

verses.z: 那行不義的必受不義的報應；[主]並不偏待人。
verses.e: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done , and there is no partiality .

verses.z: 因為你們已經死了，你們的生命與基督一同藏在上帝裏面。
verses.e: For you died , and your life is hidden with Christ in God .

verses.z: 基督是我們的生命，他顯現的時候，你們也要與他一同顯現在榮耀裏。
verses.e: When Christ , our life , is revealed , then you will also be revealed with him in glory .

verses.z: 所以，要治死你們在地上的肢體，就如淫亂、污穢、邪情、惡慾，和貪婪（貪婪就與拜偶像一樣）。
verses.e: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth : sexual immorality , uncleanness , depraved passion , evil desire , and covetousness , which is idolatry .

verses.z: 因這些事，上帝的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。
verses.e: For these things ' sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience .

verses.z: 當你們在這些事中活着的時候，也曾這樣行過。
verses.e: You also once walked in those , when you lived in them ,

verses.z: 但現在你們要棄絕這一切的事，以及惱恨、忿怒、惡毒、毀謗，並口中污穢的言語。
verses.e: but now you must put them all away : anger , wrath , malice , slander , and shameful speaking out of your mouth .

verses.z: 不要彼此說謊；因你們已經脫去舊人和舊人的行為，
verses.e: Don't lie to one another , seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings ,

verses.z: 你們作主人的，要公公平平地待僕人，因為知道你們也有一位主在天上。
verses.e: Masters , give to your servants that which is just and equal , knowing that you also have a Master in heaven .

verses.z: 與我一同坐監的亞里達古問你們安。巴拿巴的表弟馬可也問你們安。（說到這馬可，你們已經受了吩咐；他若到了你們那裏，你們就接待他。）
verses.e: Aristarchus , my fellow prisoner , greets you , and Mark the cousin of Barnabas ( concerning whom you received instructions , " if he comes to you , receive him " ) ,

verses.z: 耶數又稱為猶士都，也問你們安。奉割禮的人中，只有這三個人是為上帝的國與我一同做工的，也是叫我心裏得安慰的。
verses.e: and Jesus who is called Justus . These are my only fellow workers for God's Kingdom who are of the circumcision , men who have been a comfort to me .

verses.z: 有你們那裏的人，作基督耶穌僕人的以巴弗問你們安。他在禱告之間，常為你們竭力地祈求，願你們在上帝一切的旨意上得以完全，信心充足，能站立得穩。
verses.e: Epaphras , who is one of you , a servant of Christ , salutes you , always striving for you in his prayers , that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God .

verses.z: 他為你們和老底嘉並希拉坡里的弟兄多多地勞苦，這是我可以給他作見證的。
verses.e: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you , and for those in Laodicea , and for those in Hierapolis .

verses.z: 所親愛的醫生路加和底馬問你們安。
verses.e: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you .

verses.z: 請問老底嘉的弟兄和寧法，並她家裏的教會安。
verses.e: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea , with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house .

verses.z: 你們念了這書信，便交給老底嘉的教會，叫他們也念；你們也要念從老底嘉來的書信。
verses.e: When this letter has been read among you , cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans , and that you also read the letter from Laodicea .

verses.z: 要對亞基布說：「務要謹慎，盡你從主所受的職分。」
verses.e: Tell Archippus , " Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord , that you fulfill it . "

verses.z: 我－保羅親筆問你們安。你們要記念我的捆鎖。願恩惠[常]與你們同在！
verses.e: I , Paul , write this greeting with my own hand . Remember my chains . Grace be with you . Amen .

verses.z: 你們要恆切禱告，在此警醒感恩。
verses.e: Continue steadfastly in prayer , watching in it with thanksgiving ,

verses.z: 也要為我們禱告，求上帝給我們開傳道的門，能以講基督的奧祕（我為此被捆鎖），
verses.e: praying together for us also , that God may open to us a door for the word , to speak the mystery of Christ , for which I am also in bonds ,

verses.z: 叫我按着所該說的話將這奧祕發明出來。
verses.e: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak .

verses.z: 你們要愛惜光陰，用智慧與外人交往。
verses.e: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside , redeeming the time .

verses.z: 你們的言語要常常帶着和氣，[好像]用鹽調和，就可知道該怎樣回答各人。
verses.e: Let your speech always be with grace , seasoned with salt , that you may know how you ought to answer each one .

verses.z: 有我親愛的兄弟推基古要將我一切的事都告訴你們。他是忠心的執事，和我一同作主的僕人。
verses.e: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus , the beloved brother , faithful servant , and fellow bondservant in the Lord .

verses.z: 我特意打發他到你們那裏去，好叫你們知道我們的光景，又叫他安慰你們的心。
verses.e: I am sending him to you for this very purpose , that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts ,

verses.z: 我又打發一位親愛忠心的兄弟阿尼西謀同去；他也是你們那裏的人。他們要把這裏一切的事都告訴你們。
verses.e: together with Onesimus , the faithful and beloved brother , who is one of you . They will make known to you everything that is going on here .

verses.z: 猶大王約雅敬在位第三年，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來到耶路撒冷，將城圍困。
verses.e: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah , Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it .

verses.z: 太監長對但以理說：「我懼怕我主我王，他已經派定你們的飲食，倘若他見你們的面貌比你們同歲的少年人肌瘦，怎麼好呢？這樣，你們就使我的頭在王那裏難保。」
verses.e: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel , " I fear my lord the king , who has appointed your food and your drink . For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age ? Then you would endanger my head with the king . "

verses.z: 但以理對太監長所派管理但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅的委辦說：
verses.e: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah :

verses.z: 「求你試試僕人們十天，給我們素菜吃，白水喝，
verses.e: " Test your servants , I beg you , ten days ; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink .

verses.z: 然後看看我們的面貌和用王膳那少年人的面貌，就照你所看的待僕人吧！」
verses.e: Then let our faces be examined before you , and the face of the youths who eat of the king's delicacies ; and as you see , deal with your servants . "

verses.z: 委辦便允准他們這件事，試看他們十天。
verses.e: So he listened to them in this matter , and tested them for ten days .

verses.z: 過了十天，見他們的面貌比用王膳的一切少年人更加俊美肥胖。
verses.e: At the end of ten days , their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king's delicacies .

verses.z: 於是委辦撤去派他們用的膳，飲的酒，給他們素菜吃。
verses.e: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink , and gave them vegetables .

verses.z: 這四個少年人，上帝在各樣文字學問上賜給他們聰明知識；但以理又明白各樣的異象和夢兆。
verses.e: Now as for these four youths , God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom ; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒王預定帶進少年人來的日期滿了，太監長就把他們帶到王面前。
verses.e: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in , the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar .

verses.z: 王與他們談論，見少年人中無一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅，所以留他們在王面前侍立。
verses.e: The king talked with them ; and among them all was found no one like Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah . Therefore they stood before the king .

verses.z: 主將猶大王約雅敬，並上帝殿中器皿的幾分交付他手。他就把這器皿帶到示拿地，收入他神的廟裏，放在他神的庫中。
verses.e: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand , with some of the vessels of the house of God ; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god . He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god .

verses.z: 王考問他們一切事，就見他們的智慧聰明比通國的術士和用法術的勝過十倍。
verses.e: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them , he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm .

verses.z: 到塞魯士王元年，但以理還在。
verses.e: Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus .

verses.z: 王吩咐太監長亞施毗拿，從以色列人的宗室和貴冑中帶進幾個人來，
verses.e: The king spoke to Ashpenaz , the master of his eunuchs , that he should bring in some of the children of Israel , even of the royal offspring and of the nobles :

verses.z: 就是年少沒有殘疾、相貌俊美、通達各樣學問、知識聰明俱備、足能侍立在王宮裏的，要教他們迦勒底的文字言語。
verses.e: youths in whom was no defect , but well-favored , skillful in all wisdom , endowed with knowledge , understanding science , and who had the ability to stand in the king's palace ; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans .

verses.z: 王派定將自己所用的膳和所飲的酒，每日賜他們一分，養他們三年。滿了三年，好叫他們在王面前侍立。
verses.e: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king's delicacies and of the wine which he drank , and that they should be nourished three years , that at its end they should stand before the king .

verses.z: 他們中間有猶大族的人：但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅。
verses.e: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah .

verses.z: 太監長給他們起名：稱但以理為伯提沙撒，稱哈拿尼雅為沙得拉，稱米沙利為米煞，稱亞撒利雅為亞伯尼歌。
verses.e: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them : to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar ; to Hananiah , Shadrach ; to Mishael , Meshach ; and to Azariah , Abednego .

verses.z: 但以理卻立志不以王的膳和王所飲的酒玷污自己，所以求太監長容他不玷污自己。
verses.e: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king's delicacies , nor with the wine which he drank . Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself .

verses.z: 上帝使但以理在太監長眼前蒙恩惠，受憐憫。
verses.e: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs .

verses.z: 波斯王塞魯士第三年，有事顯給稱為伯提沙撒的但以理。這事是真的，是指着大爭戰；但以理通達這事，明白這異象。
verses.e: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel , whose name was called Belteshazzar ; and the message was true , even a great warfare . He understood the message , and had understanding of the vision .

verses.z: 忽然，有一手按在我身上，使我用膝和手掌支持微起。
verses.e: Behold , a hand touched me , which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands .

verses.z: 他對我說：「大蒙眷愛的但以理啊，要明白我與你所說的話，只管站起來，因為我現在奉差遣來到你這裏。」他對我說這話，我便戰戰兢兢地立起來。
verses.e: He said to me , " Daniel , you greatly beloved man , understand the words that I speak to you , and stand upright , for I have been sent to you , now . " When he had spoken this word to me , I stood trembling .

verses.z: 他就說：「但以理啊，不要懼怕！因為從你第一日專心求明白[將來的事]，又在你上帝面前刻苦己心，你的言語已蒙應允；我是因你的言語而來。
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Don't be afraid , Daniel ; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand , and to humble yourself before your God , your words were heard . I have come for your words ' sake .

verses.z: 但波斯國的[魔]君攔阻我二十一日。忽然有大君中的一位米迦勒來幫助我，我就停留在波斯諸王那裏。
verses.e: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days ; but , behold , Michael , one of the chief princes , came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia .

verses.z: 現在我來，要使你明白本國之民日後必遭遇的事，因為這異象關乎後來[許多的]日子。」
verses.e: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days , for the vision is yet for many days . "

verses.z: 他向我這樣說，我就臉面朝地，啞口無聲。
verses.e: When he had spoken these words to me , I set my face toward the ground and was mute .

verses.z: 不料，有一位像人的，摸我的嘴唇，我便開口向那站在我面前的說：「我主啊，因見這異象，我大大愁苦，毫無氣力。
verses.e: Behold , one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips . Then I opened my mouth , and spoke and said to him who stood before me , " My lord , by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me , and I retain no strength .

verses.z: 我主的僕人怎能與我主說話呢？我[一見異象]就渾身無力，毫無氣息。」
verses.e: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord ? For as for me , immediately there remained no strength in me . There was no breath left in me . "

verses.z: 有一位形狀像人的又摸我，使我有力量。
verses.e: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again , and he strengthened me .

verses.z: 他說：「大蒙眷愛的人哪，不要懼怕，願你平安！你總要堅強。」他一向我說話，我便覺得有力量，說：「我主請說，因你使我有力量。」
verses.e: He said , " Greatly beloved man , don't be afraid . Peace be to you . Be strong . Yes , be strong . " When he spoke to me , I was strengthened , and said , " Let my lord speak , for you have strengthened me . "

verses.z: 當那時，我－但以理悲傷了三個七日。
verses.e: In those days I , Daniel , was mourning three whole weeks .

verses.z: 他就說：「你知道我為何來見你嗎？現在我要回去與波斯的[魔]君爭戰，我去後，希臘的[魔]君必來。
verses.e: Then he said , " Do you know why I have come to you ? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia . When I go out , behold , the prince of Greece will come .

verses.z: 但我要將那錄在真確書上的事告訴你。除了你們的[大]君米迦勒之外，沒有幫助我抵擋這兩[魔]君的。」
verses.e: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth . There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince .

verses.z: 美味我沒有吃，酒肉沒有入我的口，也沒有用油抹我的身，直到滿了三個七日。
verses.e: I ate no pleasant food . No meat or wine came into my mouth . I didn't anoint myself at all , until three whole weeks were fulfilled .

verses.z: 正月二十四日，我在底格里斯大河邊，
verses.e: In the twenty-fourth day of the first month , as I was by the side of the great river , which is Hiddekel ,

verses.z: 舉目觀看，見有一人身穿細麻衣，腰束烏法精金帶。
verses.e: I lifted up my eyes and looked , and behold , there was a man clothed in linen , whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz .

verses.z: 他身體如水蒼玉，面貌如閃電，眼目如火把，手和腳如光明的銅，說話的聲音如大眾的聲音。
verses.e: His body also was like beryl , and his face as the appearance of lightning , and his eyes as flaming torches . His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze . The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude .

verses.z: 這異象惟有我－但以理一人看見，同着我的人沒有看見。他們卻大大戰兢，逃跑隱藏，
verses.e: I , Daniel , alone saw the vision , for the men who were with me didn't see the vision , but a great quaking fell on them , and they fled to hide themselves .

verses.z: 只剩下我一人。我見了這大異象便渾身無力，面貌失色，毫無氣力。
verses.e: So I was left alone and saw this great vision . No strength remained in me ; for my face grew deathly pale , and I retained no strength .

verses.z: 我卻聽見他說話的聲音，一聽見就面伏在地沉睡了。
verses.e: Yet I heard the voice of his words . When I heard the voice of his words , then I fell into a deep sleep on my face , with my face toward the ground .

verses.z: [又說]：「當米底亞王大流士元年，我曾起來扶助米迦勒，使他堅強。」
verses.e: " As for me , in the first year of Darius the Mede , I stood up to confirm and strengthen him .

verses.z: 「北方王的二子必動干戈，招聚許多軍兵。這軍兵前去，如洪水氾濫，又必再去爭戰，直到南方王的保障。
verses.e: His sons will wage war , and will assemble a multitude of great forces which will come on , and overflow , and pass through . They will return and wage war , even to his fortress .

verses.z: 南方王必發烈怒，出來與北方王爭戰，擺列大軍；北方王的軍兵必交付他手。
verses.e: " The king of the south will be moved with anger and will come out and fight with him , even with the king of the north . He will send out a great multitude , and the multitude will be given into his hand .

verses.z: 他的眾軍高傲，他的心也必自高；他雖使數萬人仆倒，卻不得[常]勝。
verses.e: The multitude will be carried off , and his heart will be exalted . He will cast down tens of thousands , but he won't prevail .

verses.z: 「北方王必回來擺列大軍，比先前的更多。滿了所定的年數，他必率領大軍，帶極多的軍裝來。
verses.e: The king of the north will return , and will send out a multitude greater than the former . He will come on at the end of the times , even of years , with a great army and with abundant supplies .

verses.z: 那時，必有許多人起來攻擊南方王，並且你本國的強暴人必興起，要應驗那異象，他們卻要敗亡。
verses.e: " In those times many will stand up against the king of the south . Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision , but they will fall .

verses.z: 北方王必來築壘攻取堅固城；南方的軍兵必站立不住，就是選擇的精兵也無力站住。
verses.e: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound , and take a well-fortified city . The forces of the south won't stand , neither will his select troops , neither will there be any strength to stand .

verses.z: 來攻擊他的，必任意而行，無人在北方王面前站立得住。他必站在那榮美之地，用手施行毀滅。
verses.e: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will , and no one will stand before him . He will stand in the glorious land , and destruction will be in his hand .

verses.z: 「他必定意用全國之力而來，立公正的約，照約而行，將自己的女兒給南方王為妻，想要敗壞他，這計卻不得成就，與自己毫無益處。
verses.e: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom , and with him equitable conditions . He will perform them . He will give him the daughter of women , to destroy the kingdom , but she will not stand , and won't be for him .

verses.z: 其後他必轉回奪取了許多海島。但有一大帥，除掉他令人受的羞辱，並且使這羞辱歸他本身。
verses.e: After this he will turn his face to the islands , and will take many , but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease . Yes , moreover , he will cause his reproach to turn on him .

verses.z: 他就必轉向本地的保障，卻要絆跌仆倒，歸於無有。
verses.e: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land ; but he will stumble and fall , and won't be found .

verses.z: 現在我將真事指示你：「波斯還有三王興起，第四王必富足遠勝諸王。他因富足成為強盛，就必激動大眾攻擊希臘國。
verses.e: " Now I will show you the truth . Behold , three more kings will stand up in Persia . The fourth will be far richer than all of them . When he has grown strong through his riches , he will stir up all against the realm of Greece .

verses.z: 「那時，必有一人興起接續他為王，使橫征暴斂的人通行國中的榮美地。這王不多日就必滅亡，卻不因忿怒，也不因爭戰。」
verses.e: " Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place ; but within few days he shall be destroyed , not in anger , and not in battle .

verses.z: 「必有一個卑鄙的人興起接續為王，人未曾將國的尊榮給他，他卻趁人坦然無備的時候，用諂媚的話得國。
verses.e: " In his place a contemptible person will stand up , to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom ; but he will come in time of security , and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries .

verses.z: 必有無數的軍兵勢如洪水，在他面前沖沒敗壞；同盟的君也必如此。
verses.e: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him , and will be broken . Yes , also the prince of the covenant .

verses.z: 與那君結盟之後，他必行詭詐，因為他必上來以微小的軍成為強盛。
verses.e: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully ; for he will come up and will become strong with few people .

verses.z: 趁人坦然無備的時候，他必來到國中極肥美之地，行他列祖和他列祖之祖所未曾行的，將擄物、掠物，和財寶散給眾人，又要設計攻打保障，然而這都是暫時的。
verses.e: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province . He will do that which his fathers have not done , nor his fathers ' fathers . He will scatter among them prey , plunder , and wealth . Yes , he will devise his plans against the strongholds , but only for a time .

verses.z: 「他必奮勇向前，率領大軍攻擊南方王；南方王也必以極大極強的軍兵與他爭戰，卻站立不住，因為有人設計謀害南方王。
verses.e: " He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army ; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army , but he won't stand ; for they will devise plans against him .

verses.z: 吃王膳的，必敗壞他；他的軍隊必被沖沒，而且被殺的甚多。
verses.e: Yes , those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him , and his army will be swept away . Many will fall down slain .

verses.z: 至於這二王，他們心懷惡計，同席說謊，[計謀]卻不成就；因為到了定期，事就了結。
verses.e: As for both these kings , their hearts will be to do evil , and they will speak lies at one table ; but it won't prosper , for the end will still be at the appointed time .

verses.z: 北方王必帶許多財寶回往本國，他的心反對聖約，[任意]而行，回到本地。
verses.e: Then he will return into his land with great wealth . His heart will be against the holy covenant . He will take action , and return to his own land .

verses.z: 「到了定期，他必返回，來到南方。後一次卻不如前一次，
verses.e: " He will return at the appointed time and come into the south ; but it won't be in the latter time as it was in the former .

verses.z: 必有一個勇敢的王興起，執掌大權，隨意而行。
verses.e: A mighty king will stand up , who will rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .

verses.z: 因為基提戰船必來攻擊他，他就喪膽而回，又要惱恨聖約，[任意]而行；他必回來聯絡背棄聖約的人。
verses.e: For ships of Kittim will come against him . Therefore he will be grieved , and will return , and have indignation against the holy covenant , and will take action . He will even return , and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant .

verses.z: 他必興兵，這兵必褻瀆聖地，就是保障，除掉常獻的[燔祭]，設立那行毀壞可憎的。
verses.e: " Forces from him will profane the sanctuary , even the fortress , and will take away the continual burnt offering . Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate .

verses.z: 作惡違背[聖]約的人，他必用巧言勾引；惟獨認識上帝的子民必剛強行事。
verses.e: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries ; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action .

verses.z: 民間的智慧人必訓誨多人；然而他們多日必倒在刀下，或被火燒，或被擄掠搶奪。
verses.e: " Those who are wise among the people will instruct many ; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame , by captivity and by plunder , many days .

verses.z: 他們仆倒的時候，稍得扶助，卻有許多人用諂媚的話親近他們。
verses.e: Now when they fall , they will be helped with a little help ; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries .

verses.z: 智慧人中有些仆倒的，為要熬煉其餘的人，使他們清淨潔白，直到末了；因為到了定期，事就了結。
verses.e: Some of those who are wise will fall — to refine them , and to purify , and to make them white , even to the time of the end , because it is yet for the time appointed .

verses.z: 「王必任意而行，自高自大，超過所有的神，又用奇異的話攻擊萬神之神。他必行事亨通，直到[主的]忿怒完畢，因為所定的事必然成就。
verses.e: " The king will do according to his will . He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god , and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods . He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished , for that which is determined will be done .

verses.z: 他必不顧他列祖的神，也不顧婦女所羨慕的神，無論何神他都不顧；因為他必自大，高過一切。
verses.e: He won't regard the gods of his fathers , or the desire of women , or regard any god ; for he will magnify himself above all .

verses.z: 他倒要敬拜保障的神，用金、銀、寶石和可愛之物敬奉他列祖所不認識的神。
verses.e: But in their place , he will honor the god of fortresses . He will honor a god whom his fathers didn't know with gold , silver , and with precious stones and pleasant things .

verses.z: 他必靠外邦神的幫助，攻破最堅固的保障。凡承認他的，他必將榮耀加給他們，使他們管轄許多人，又為賄賂分地[與他們]。
verses.e: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god . He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him . He will cause them to rule over many , and will divide the land for a price .

verses.z: 他興起的時候，他的國必破裂，向天的四方分開，卻不歸他的後裔，治國的權勢也都不及他；因為他的國必被拔出，歸與他後裔之外的人。
verses.e: When he stands up , his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky , but not to his posterity , nor according to his dominion with which he ruled ; for his kingdom will be plucked up , even for others besides these .

verses.z: 「到末了，南方王要與他交戰。北方王必用戰車、馬兵，和許多戰船，勢如暴風來攻擊他，也必進入列國，如洪水氾濫。
verses.e: " At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him ; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind , with chariots , with horsemen , and with many ships . He will enter into the countries , and will overflow and pass through .

verses.z: 又必進入那榮美之地，有許多[國]就被傾覆，但以東人、摩押人，和一大半亞捫人必脫離他的手。
verses.e: He will enter also into the glorious land , and many countries will be overthrown ; but these will be delivered out of his hand : Edom , Moab , and the chief of the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 他必伸手攻擊列國；埃及地也不得脫離。
verses.e: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries . The land of Egypt won't escape .

verses.z: 他必把持埃及的金銀財寶和各樣的寶物。利比亞人和古實人都必跟從他。
verses.e: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver , and over all the precious things of Egypt . The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps .

verses.z: 但從東方和北方必有消息擾亂他，他就大發烈怒出去，要將多人殺滅淨盡。
verses.e: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him ; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many .

verses.z: 他必在海和榮美的聖山中間設立他如宮殿的帳幕；然而到了他的結局，必無人能幫助他。」
verses.e: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain ; yet he will come to his end , and no one will help him .

verses.z: 「南方的王必強盛，他將帥中必有一個比他更強盛，執掌權柄，他的權柄甚大。
verses.e: " The king of the south will be strong . One of his princes will become stronger than him , and have dominion . His dominion will be a great dominion .

verses.z: 過些年後，他們必互相連合，南方王的女兒必就了北方王來立約；但這女子幫助之力存立不住，王和他所倚靠之力也不能存立。這女子和引導她來的，並生她的，以及當時扶助她的，都必交與[死地]。
verses.e: At the end of years they will join themselves together ; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement , but she will not retain the strength of her arm . He will also not stand , nor will his arm ; but she will be given up , with those who brought her , and he who became the father of her , and he who strengthened her in those times .

verses.z: 但這女子的本家必另生一子繼續王位，他必率領軍隊進入北方王的保障，攻擊他們，而且得勝；
verses.e: " But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place , who will come to the army and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north , and will deal against them and will prevail .

verses.z: 並將他們的神像和鑄成的偶像，與金銀的寶器掠到埃及去。數年之內，他不去攻擊北方的王。
verses.e: He will also carry their gods with their molten images , and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold , captive into Egypt . He will refrain some years from the king of the north .

verses.z: 北方的王必入南方王的國，卻要仍回本地。
verses.e: He will come into the realm of the king of the south , but he will return into his own land .

verses.z: 「那時，保佑你本國之民的天使長米迦勒必站起來，並且有大艱難，從有國以來直到此時，沒有這樣的。你本國的民中，凡名錄在冊上的，必得拯救。
verses.e: " At that time Michael will stand up , the great prince who stands for the children of your people ; and there will be a time of trouble , such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time . At that time your people will be delivered , everyone who is found written in the book .

verses.z: 必有許多人使自己清淨潔白，且被熬煉；但惡人仍必行惡，一切惡人都不明白，惟獨智慧人能明白。
verses.e: Many will purify themselves , and make themselves white , and be refined , but the wicked will do wickedly ; and none of the wicked will understand , but those who are wise will understand .

verses.z: 從除掉常獻的[燔祭]，並設立那行毀壞可憎之物的時候，必有一千二百九十日。
verses.e: " From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up , there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days .

verses.z: 等到一千三百三十五日的，那人便為有福。
verses.e: Blessed is he who waits , and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days .

verses.z: 「你且去等候結局，因為你必安歇。到了末期，你必起來，享受你的[福]分。」
verses.e: " But go your way until the end ; for you will rest , and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days . "

verses.z: 睡在塵埃中的，必有多人復醒。其中有得永生的，有受羞辱永遠被憎惡的。
verses.e: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake , some to everlasting life , and some to shame and everlasting contempt .

verses.z: 智慧人必發光如同天上的光；那使多人歸義的，必發光如星，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse . Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever .

verses.z: 但以理啊，你要隱藏這話，封閉這書，直到末時。必有多人來往奔跑，知識就必增長。」
verses.e: But you , Daniel , shut up the words and seal the book , even to the time of the end . Many will run back and forth , and knowledge will be increased . "

verses.z: 我－但以理觀看，見另有兩個人站立：一個在河這邊，一個在河那邊。
verses.e: Then I , Daniel , looked , and behold , two others stood , one on the river bank on this side , and the other on the river bank on that side .

verses.z: 有一個問那站在河水以上、穿細麻衣的說：「這奇異的事到幾時才應驗呢？」
verses.e: One said to the man clothed in linen , who was above the waters of the river , " How long will it be to the end of these wonders ? "

verses.z: 我聽見那站在河水以上、穿細麻衣的，向天舉起左右手，指着活到永遠的[主]起誓說：「要到一載、二載、半載，打破聖民權力的時候，這一切事就都應驗了。」
verses.e: I heard the man clothed in linen , who was above the waters of the river , when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven , and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time , times , and a half ; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people , all these things will be finished .

verses.z: 我聽見這話，卻不明白，就說：「我主啊，這些事的結局是怎樣呢？」
verses.e: I heard , but I didn't understand . Then I said , " My lord , what will be the outcome of these things ? "

verses.z: 他說：「但以理啊，你只管去；因為這話已經隱藏封閉，直到末時。
verses.e: He said , " Go your way , Daniel ; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他做了夢，心裏煩亂，不能睡覺。
verses.e: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar , Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams ; and his spirit was troubled , and his sleep went from him .

verses.z: 迦勒底人在王面前回答說：「世上沒有人能將王所問的事說出來；因為沒有君王、大臣、掌權的向術士，或用法術的，或迦勒底人問過這樣的事。
verses.e: The Chaldeans answered the king and said , " There is not a man on the earth who can show the king's matter , because no king , lord , or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician , enchanter , or Chaldean .

verses.z: 王所問的事甚難。除了不與世人同居的神明，沒有人在王面前能說出來。」
verses.e: It is a rare thing that the king requires , and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods , whose dwelling is not with flesh . "

verses.z: 因此，王氣忿忿地大發烈怒，吩咐滅絕巴比倫所有的哲士。
verses.e: Because of this , the king was angry and very furious , and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed .

verses.z: 於是命令發出，哲士將要見殺，人就尋找但以理和他的同伴，要殺他們。
verses.e: So the decree went out , and the wise men were to be slain . They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain .

verses.z: 王的護衛長亞略出來，要殺巴比倫的哲士，但以理就用婉言回答他，
verses.e: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king's guard , who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon .

verses.z: 向王的護衛長亞略說：「王的命令為何這樣緊急呢？」亞略就將情節告訴但以理。
verses.e: He answered Arioch the king's captain , " Why is the decree so urgent from the king ? " Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel .

verses.z: 但以理遂進去求王寬限，就可以將[夢的]講解告訴王。
verses.e: Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time , and he would show the king the interpretation .

verses.z: 但以理回到他的居所，將這事告訴他的同伴哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅，
verses.e: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah , his companions :

verses.z: 要他們祈求天上的上帝施憐憫，將這奧祕的事指明，免得但以理和他的同伴與巴比倫其餘的哲士一同滅亡。
verses.e: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret , that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon .

verses.z: 這奧祕的事就在夜間異象中給但以理顯明，但以理便稱頌天上的上帝。
verses.e: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night . Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven .

verses.z: 王吩咐人將術士、用法術的、行邪術的，和迦勒底人召來，要他們將王的夢告訴王，他們就來站在王前。
verses.e: Then the king commanded that the magicians , the enchanters , the sorcerers , and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams . So they came in and stood before the king .

verses.z: 但以理說：「上帝的名是應當稱頌的！從亙古直到永遠，因為智慧能力都屬乎他。
verses.e: Daniel answered , " Blessed be the name of God forever and ever ; for wisdom and might are his .

verses.z: 他改變時候、日期，廢王，立王，將智慧賜與智慧人，將知識賜與聰明人。
verses.e: He changes the times and the seasons . He removes kings and sets up kings . He gives wisdom to the wise , and knowledge to those who have understanding .

verses.z: 他顯明深奧隱秘的事，知道暗中所有的，光明也與他同居。
verses.e: He reveals the deep and secret things . He knows what is in the darkness , and the light dwells with him .

verses.z: 我列祖的上帝啊，我感謝你，讚美你；因你將智慧才能賜給我，允准我們所求的，把王的事給我們指明。」
verses.e: I thank you and praise you , O God of my fathers , who have given me wisdom and might , and have now made known to me what we desired of you ; for you have made known to us the king's matter . "

verses.z: 於是，但以理進去見亞略，就是王所派滅絕巴比倫哲士的，對他說：「不要滅絕巴比倫的哲士，求你領我到王面前，我要將[夢的]講解告訴王。」
verses.e: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch , whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon . He went and said this to him : " Don't destroy the wise men of Babylon . Bring me in before the king , and I will show to the king the interpretation . "

verses.z: 亞略就急忙將但以理領到王面前，對王說：「我在被擄的猶大人中遇見一人，他能將[夢的]講解告訴王。」
verses.e: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste , and said this to him : " I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation . "

verses.z: 王問稱為伯提沙撒的但以理說：「你能將我所做的夢和夢的講解告訴我嗎？」
verses.e: The king answered Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , " Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen , and its interpretation ? "

verses.z: 但以理在王面前回答說：「王所問的那奧祕事，哲士、用法術的、術士、觀兆的都不能告訴王，
verses.e: Daniel answered before the king , and said , " The secret which the king has demanded can't be shown to the king by wise men , enchanters , magicians , or soothsayers ;

verses.z: 只有一位在天上的上帝能顯明奧祕的事。他已將日後必有的事指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的夢和你在床上腦中的異象是這樣：
verses.e: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets , and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days . Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these :

verses.z: 王啊，你在床上想到後來的事，那顯明奧祕事的主把將來必有的事指示你。
verses.e: " As for you , O king , your thoughts came on your bed , what should happen hereafter ; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen .

verses.z: 王對他們說：「我做了一夢，心裏煩亂，要知道這是甚麼夢。」
verses.e: The king said to them , " I have dreamed a dream , and my spirit is troubled to know the dream . "

verses.z: 至於那奧祕的事顯明給我，並非因我的智慧勝過一切活人，乃為使王知道[夢的]講解和心裏的思念。
verses.e: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king , and that you may know the thoughts of your heart .

verses.z: 「王啊，你夢見一個大像，這像甚高，極其光耀，站在你面前，形狀甚是可怕。
verses.e: " You , O king , saw , and behold , a great image . This image , which was mighty , and whose brightness was excellent , stood before you ; and its appearance was terrifying .

verses.z: 這像的頭是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是銀的，肚腹和腰是銅的，
verses.e: As for this image , its head was of fine gold , its chest and its arms of silver , its belly and its thighs of bronze ,

verses.z: 腿是鐵的，腳是半鐵半泥的。
verses.e: its legs of iron , its feet part of iron and part of clay .

verses.z: 你觀看，見有一塊非人手鑿出來的石頭打在這像半鐵半泥的腳上，把腳砸碎；
verses.e: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands , which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay , and broke them in pieces .

verses.z: 於是金、銀、銅、鐵、泥都一同砸得粉碎，成如夏天禾場上的糠詷，被風吹散，無處可尋。打碎這像的石頭變成一座大山，充滿天下。
verses.e: Then the iron , the clay , the bronze , the silver , and the gold were broken in pieces together , and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors . The wind carried them away , so that no place was found for them . The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth .

verses.z: 「這就是那夢；我們在王面前要講解那夢。
verses.e: " This is the dream ; and we will tell its interpretation before the king .

verses.z: 王啊，你是諸王之王。天上的上帝已將國度、權柄、能力、尊榮都賜給你。
verses.e: You , O king , are king of kings , to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom , the power , the strength , and the glory .

verses.z: 凡世人所住之地的走獸，並天空的飛鳥，他都交付你手，使你掌管這一切。你就是那金頭。
verses.e: Wherever the children of men dwell , he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand , and has made you rule over them all . You are the head of gold .

verses.z: 在你以後必另興一國，不及於你；又有第三國，就是銅的，必掌管天下。
verses.e: " After you , another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you ; and another third kingdom of bronze , which will rule over all the earth .

verses.z: 迦勒底人用亞蘭的言語對王說：「願王萬歲！請將那夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解。」
verses.e: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language , " O king , live forever ! Tell your servants the dream , and we will show the interpretation . "

verses.z: 第四國，必堅壯如鐵，鐵能打碎剋制百物，又能壓碎一切，那國也必打碎壓制[列國]。
verses.e: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron , because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things ; and as iron that crushes all these , it will break in pieces and crush .

verses.z: 你既見像的腳和腳指頭，一半是窯匠的泥，一半是鐵，那國將來也必分開。你既見鐵與泥攙雜，那國也必有鐵的力量。
verses.e: Whereas you saw the feet and toes , part of potters ' clay and part of iron , it will be a divided kingdom ; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron , because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay .

verses.z: 那腳指頭，既是半鐵半泥，那國也必半強半弱。
verses.e: As the toes of the feet were part of iron , and part of clay , so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle .

verses.z: 你既見鐵與泥攙雜，那國民也必與各種人攙雜，卻不能彼此相合，正如鐵與泥不能相合一樣。
verses.e: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay , they will mingle themselves with the seed of men ; but they won't cling to one another , even as iron does not mix with clay .

verses.z: 當那列王在位的時候，天上的上帝必另立一國，永不敗壞，也不歸別國的人，卻要打碎滅絕那一切國，這國必存到永遠。
verses.e: " In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed , nor will its sovereignty be left to another people ; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms , and it will stand forever .

verses.z: 你既看見非人手鑿出來的一塊石頭從山而出，打碎金、銀、銅、鐵、泥，那就是至大的上帝把後來必有的事給王指明。這夢準是這樣，這講解也是確實的。」
verses.e: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands , and that it broke in pieces the iron , the bronze , the clay , the silver , and the gold , the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter . The dream is certain , and its interpretation sure . "

verses.z: 當時，尼布甲尼撒王俯伏在地，向但以理下拜，並且吩咐人給他奉上供物和香品。
verses.e: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face , worshiped Daniel , and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him .

verses.z: 王對但以理說：「你既能顯明這奧祕的事，你們的上帝誠然是萬神之神、萬王之主，又是顯明奧祕事的。」
verses.e: The king answered to Daniel , and said , " Of a truth your God is the God of gods , and the Lord of kings , and a revealer of secrets , since you have been able to reveal this secret . "

verses.z: 於是王高抬但以理，賞賜他許多上等禮物，派他管理巴比倫全省，又立他為總理，掌管巴比倫的一切哲士。
verses.e: Then the king made Daniel great and gave him many great gifts , and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon .

verses.z: 但以理求王，王就派沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌管理巴比倫省的事務，只是但以理常在朝中侍立。
verses.e: Daniel requested of the king , and he appointed Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon , but Daniel was in the king's gate .

verses.z: 王回答迦勒底人說：「夢我已經忘了，你們若不將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必被凌遲，你們的房屋必成為糞堆；
verses.e: The king answered the Chaldeans , " The thing has gone from me . If you don't make known to me the dream and its interpretation , you will be cut in pieces , and your houses will be made a dunghill .

verses.z: 你們若將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必從我這裏得贈品和賞賜，並大尊榮。現在你們要將夢和夢的講解告訴我。」
verses.e: But if you show the dream and its interpretation , you will receive from me gifts , rewards , and great honor . Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation . "

verses.z: 他們第二次對王說：「請王將夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解。」
verses.e: They answered the second time and said , " Let the king tell his servants the dream , and we will show the interpretation . "

verses.z: 王回答說：「我准知道你們是故意遲延，因為你們知道那夢我已經忘了。
verses.e: The king answered , " I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time , because you see the thing has gone from me .

verses.z: 你們若不將夢告訴我，只有一法待你們；因為你們預備了謊言亂語向我說，要等候時勢改變。現在你們要將夢告訴我，因我知道你們能將夢的講解告訴我。」
verses.e: But if you don't make known to me the dream , there is but one law for you ; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me , until the situation changes . Therefore tell me the dream , and I will know that you can show me its interpretation . "

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒王造了一個金像，高六十肘，寬六肘，立在巴比倫省杜拉平原。
verses.e: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold , whose height was sixty cubits and its width six cubits . He set it up in the plain of Dura , in the province of Babylon .

verses.z: 王啊，你曾降旨說，凡聽見角、笛、琵琶、琴、瑟、笙，和各樣樂器聲音的都當俯伏敬拜金像。
verses.e: You , O king , have made a decree that every man who hears the sound of the horn , flute , zither , lyre , harp , pipe , and all kinds of music shall fall down and worship the golden image ;

verses.z: 凡不俯伏敬拜的，必扔在烈火的窯中。
verses.e: and whoever doesn't fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace .

verses.z: 現在有幾個猶大人，就是王所派管理巴比倫省事務的沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌；王啊，這些人不理你，不事奉你的神，也不敬拜你所立的金像。」
verses.e: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon : Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego . These men , O king , have not respected you . They don't serve your gods , and don't worship the golden image which you have set up . "

verses.z: 當時，尼布甲尼撒沖沖大怒，吩咐人把沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌帶過來，他們就把那些人帶到王面前。
verses.e: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and fury commanded that Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego be brought . Then these men were brought before the king .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒問他們說：「沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌，你們不事奉我的神，也不敬拜我所立的金像，是故意的嗎？
verses.e: Nebuchadnezzar answered them , " Is it true , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego , that you don't serve my gods and you don't worship the golden image which I have set up ?

verses.z: 你們再聽見角、笛、琵琶、琴、瑟、笙，和各樣樂器的聲音，若俯伏敬拜我所造的像，卻還可以；若不敬拜，必立時扔在烈火的窯中，有何神能救你們脫離我手呢？」
verses.e: Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn , flute , zither , lyre , harp , pipe , and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made , good ; but if you don't worship , you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace . Who is that god who will deliver you out of my hands ? "

verses.z: 沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌對王說：「尼布甲尼撒啊，這件事我們不必回答你，
verses.e: Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego answered the king , " Nebuchadnezzar , we have no need to answer you in this matter .

verses.z: 即便如此，我們所事奉的上帝能將我們從烈火的窯中救出來。王啊，他也必救我們脫離你的手；
verses.e: If it happens , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace ; and he will deliver us out of your hand , O king .

verses.z: 即或不然，王啊，你當知道我們決不事奉你的神，也不敬拜你所立的金像。」
verses.e: But if not , let it be known to you , O king , that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up . "

verses.z: 當時，尼布甲尼撒怒氣填胸，向沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌變了臉色，吩咐人把窯燒熱，比尋常更加七倍；
verses.e: Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury , and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego . He spoke , and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒王差人將總督、欽差、巡撫、臬司、藩司、謀士、法官，和各省的官員都召了來，為尼布甲尼撒王所立的像行開光之禮。
verses.e: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the local governors , the deputies , and the governors , the judges , the treasurers , the counselors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .

verses.z: 又吩咐他軍中的幾個壯士，將沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌捆起來，扔在烈火的窯中。
verses.e: He commanded certain mighty men who were in his army to bind Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego , and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace .

verses.z: 這三人穿着褲子、內袍、外衣，和[別的]衣服，被捆起來扔在烈火的窯中。
verses.e: Then these men were bound in their pants , their tunics , and their mantles , and their other clothes , and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace .

verses.z: 因為王命緊急，窯又甚熱，那抬沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌的人都被火焰燒死。
verses.e: Therefore because the king's commandment was urgent and the furnace exceedingly hot , the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego .

verses.z: 沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌這三個人都被捆着落在烈火的窯中。
verses.e: These three men , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego , fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace .

verses.z: 那時，尼布甲尼撒王驚奇，急忙起來，對謀士說：「我們捆起來扔在火裏的不是三個人嗎？」他們回答王說：「王啊，是。」
verses.e: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished and rose up in haste . He spoke and said to his counselors , " Didn't we cast three men bound into the middle of the fire ? " They answered the king , " True , O king . "

verses.z: 王說：「看哪，我見有四個人，並沒有捆綁，在火中遊行，也沒有受傷；那第四個的相貌好像神子。」
verses.e: He answered , " Look , I see four men loose , walking in the middle of the fire , and they are unharmed . The appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods . "

verses.z: 於是，尼布甲尼撒就近烈火窯門，說：「至高上帝的僕人沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌出來，上這裏來吧！」沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌就從火中出來了。
verses.e: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace . He spoke and said , " Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego , you servants of the Most High God , come out , and come here ! " Then Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego came out of the middle of the fire .

verses.z: 那些總督、欽差、巡撫，和王的謀士一同聚集看這三個人，見火無力傷他們的身體，頭髮也沒有燒焦，衣裳也沒有變色，並沒有火燎的氣味。
verses.e: The local governors , the deputies , and the governors , and the king's counselors , being gathered together , saw these men , that the fire had no power on their bodies . The hair of their head wasn't singed . Their pants weren't changed . The smell of fire wasn't even on them .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒說：「沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌的上帝是應當稱頌的！他差遣使者救護倚靠他的僕人，他們不遵王命，捨去己身，在他們上帝以外不肯事奉敬拜別神。
verses.e: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said , " Blessed be the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abednego , who has sent his angel and delivered his servants who trusted in him , and have changed the king's word , and have yielded their bodies , that they might not serve nor worship any god except their own God .

verses.z: 現在我降旨，無論何方、何國、何族的人，謗讟沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌之上帝的，必被凌遲，他的房屋必成糞堆，因為沒有別神能這樣施行拯救。」
