verses.z: 你用這銀子，隨心所欲，或買牛羊，或買清酒濃酒，凡你心所想的都可以買；你和你的家屬在耶和華－你上帝的面前吃喝快樂。
verses.e: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires : for cattle , or for sheep , or for wine , or for strong drink , or for whatever your soul asks of you . You shall eat there before the LORD your God , and you shall rejoice , you and your household .

verses.z: 「住在你城裏的利未人，你不可丟棄他，因為他在你們中間無分無業。
verses.e: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates , for he has no portion nor inheritance with you .

verses.z: 每逢三年的末一年，你要將本年的土產十分之一都取出來，積存在你的城中。
verses.e: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year , and shall store it within your gates .

verses.z: 在你城裏無分無業的利未人，和你城裏寄居的，並孤兒寡婦，都可以來，吃得飽足。這樣，耶和華－你的上帝必在你手裏所辦的一切事上賜福與你。」
verses.e: The Levite , because he has no portion nor inheritance with you , as well as the foreigner living among you , the fatherless , and the widow who are within your gates shall come , and shall eat and be satisfied ; that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do .

verses.z: 「凡可憎的物都不可吃。
verses.e: You shall not eat any abominable thing .

verses.z: 可吃的牲畜就是牛、綿羊、山羊、
verses.e: These are the animals which you may eat : the ox , the sheep , the goat ,

verses.z: 鹿、羚羊、誁子、野山羊、麋鹿、黃羊、青羊。
verses.e: the deer , the gazelle , the roebuck , the wild goat , the ibex , the antelope , and the chamois .

verses.z: 凡分蹄成為兩瓣又倒嚼的走獸，你們都可以吃。
verses.e: Every animal that parts the hoof , and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud , among the animals , you may eat .

verses.z: 但那些倒嚼或是分蹄之中不可吃的乃是駱駝、觠子、沙番－因為是倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
verses.e: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud , or of those who have the hoof split : the camel , the hare , and the rabbit . Because they chew the cud but don't part the hoof , they are unclean to you .

verses.z: 豬－因為是分蹄卻不倒嚼，就與你們不潔淨。這些獸的肉，你們不可吃，死的也不可摸。
verses.e: The pig , because it has a split hoof but doesn't chew the cud , is unclean to you . You shall not eat their meat . You shall not touch their carcasses .

verses.z: 「水中可吃的乃是這些：凡有翅有鱗的都可以吃；
verses.e: These you may eat of all that are in the waters : you may eat whatever has fins and scales .

verses.z: 「每逢七年末一年，你要施行豁免。
verses.e: At the end of every seven years , you shall cancel debts .

verses.z: 你總要給他，給他的時候心裏不可愁煩；因耶和華－你的上帝必在你這一切所行的，並你手裏所辦的事上，賜福與你。
verses.e: You shall surely give , and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him , because it is for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to .

verses.z: 原來那地上的窮人永不斷絕；所以我吩咐你說：『總要向你地上困苦窮乏的弟兄鬆開手。』」
verses.e: For the poor will never cease out of the land . Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother , to your needy , and to your poor , in your land .

verses.z: 「你弟兄中，若有一個希伯來男人或希伯來女人被賣給你，服事你六年，到第七年就要任他自由出去。
verses.e: If your brother , a Hebrew man , or a Hebrew woman , is sold to you and serves you six years , then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you .

verses.z: 你任他自由的時候，不可使他空手而去，
verses.e: When you let him go free from you , you shall not let him go empty .

verses.z: 要從你羊群、禾場、酒醡之中多多地給他；耶和華－你的上帝怎樣賜福與你，你也要照樣給他。
verses.e: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock , out of your threshing floor , and out of your wine press . As the LORD your God has blessed you , you shall give to him .

verses.z: 要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕，耶和華－你的上帝將你救贖；因此，我今日吩咐你這件事。
verses.e: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt , and the LORD your God redeemed you . Therefore I command you this thing today .

verses.z: 他若對你說：『我不願意離開你』，是因他愛你和你的家，且因在你那裏很好，
verses.e: It shall be , if he tells you , " I will not go out from you , " because he loves you and your house , because he is well with you ,

verses.z: 你就要拿錐子將他的耳朵在門上刺透，他便永為你的奴僕了。你待婢女也要這樣。
verses.e: then you shall take an awl , and thrust it through his ear to the door , and he shall be your servant forever . Also to your female servant you shall do likewise .

verses.z: 你任他自由的時候，不可以為難事，因他服事你六年，較比雇工的工價多加一倍了。耶和華－你的上帝就必在你所做的一切事上賜福與你。」
verses.e: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you , for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years . The LORD your God will bless you in all that you do .

verses.z: 「你牛群羊群中頭生的，凡是公的，都要分別為聖，歸耶和華－你的上帝。牛群中頭生的，不可用牠耕地；羊群中頭生的，不可剪毛。
verses.e: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to the LORD your God . You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd , nor shear the firstborn of your flock .

verses.z: 豁免的定例乃是這樣：凡債主要把所借給鄰舍的豁免了；不可向鄰舍和弟兄追討，因為耶和華的豁免[年]已經宣告了。
verses.e: This is the way it shall be done : every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor . He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother , because the LORD's release has been proclaimed .

verses.z: 這頭生的，你和你的家屬，每年要在耶和華所選擇的地方，在耶和華－你上帝面前吃。
verses.e: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose , you and your household .

verses.z: 這頭生的若有甚麼殘疾，[就如]瘸腿的、瞎眼的，無論有甚麼惡殘疾，都不可獻給耶和華－你的上帝；
verses.e: If it has any defect — is lame or blind , or has any defect whatever , you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God .

verses.z: 可以在你城裏吃；潔淨人與不潔淨人都[可以吃]，就如吃羚羊與鹿一般。
verses.e: You shall eat it within your gates . The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike , as the gazelle and as the deer .

verses.z: 只是不可吃牠的血；要倒在地上，如同倒水一樣。」
verses.e: Only you shall not eat its blood . You shall pour it out on the ground like water .

verses.z: 若借給外邦人，你可以向他追討；但借給你弟兄，無論是甚麼，你要鬆手豁免了。
verses.e: Of a foreigner you may require it ; but whatever of yours is with your brother , your hand shall release .

verses.z: 你若留意聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，謹守遵行我今日所吩咐你這一切的命令，就必在你們中間沒有窮人了（在耶和華－你上帝所賜你為業的地上，耶和華必大大賜福與你。）
verses.e: However there will be no poor with you ( for the LORD will surely bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess )
if only you diligently listen to the LORD your God's voice , to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today .

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你的上帝必照他所應許你的賜福與你。你必借給許多國民，卻不致向[他們]借貸；你必管轄許多國民，他們卻不能管轄你。
verses.e: For the LORD your God will bless you , as he promised you . You will lend to many nations , but you will not borrow . You will rule over many nations , but they will not rule over you .

verses.z: 「在耶和華－你上帝所賜你的地上，無論哪一座城裏，你弟兄中若有一個窮人，你不可忍着心、揝着手不幫補你窮乏的弟兄。
verses.e: If a poor man , one of your brothers , is with you within any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God gives you , you shall not harden your heart , nor shut your hand from your poor brother ;

verses.z: 總要向他鬆開手，照他所缺乏的借給他，補他的不足。
verses.e: but you shall surely open your hand to him , and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need , which he lacks .

verses.z: 你要謹慎，不可心裏起惡念，說：『第七年的豁免年快到了』，你便惡眼看你窮乏的弟兄，甚麼都不給他，以致他因你求告耶和華，罪便歸於你了。
verses.e: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart , saying , " The seventh year , the year of release , is at hand , " and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing ; and he cry to the LORD against you , and it be sin to you .

verses.z: 「你要注意亞筆月，向耶和華－你的上帝守逾越節，因為耶和華－你的上帝在亞筆月夜間領你出埃及。
verses.e: Observe the month of Abib , and keep the Passover to the LORD your God ; for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night .

verses.z: 你要照耶和華－你上帝所賜你的福，手裏拿着甘心祭，獻在耶和華－你的上帝面前，守七七節。
verses.e: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand , which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you .

verses.z: 你和你兒女、僕婢，並住在你城裏的利未人，以及在你們中間寄居的與孤兒寡婦，都要在耶和華－你上帝所選擇立為他名的居所，在耶和華－你的上帝面前歡樂。
verses.e: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God : you , your son , your daughter , your male servant , your female servant , the Levite who is within your gates , the foreigner , the fatherless , and the widow who are among you , in the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there .

verses.z: 你也要記念你在埃及作過奴僕。你要謹守遵行這些律例。」
verses.e: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt . You shall observe and do these statutes .

verses.z: 「你把禾場的[穀]、酒醡的[酒]收藏以後，就要守住棚節七日。
verses.e: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days , after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press .

verses.z: 守節的時候，你和你兒女、僕婢，並住在你城裏的利未人，以及寄居的與孤兒寡婦，都要歡樂。
verses.e: You shall rejoice in your feast , you , your son , your daughter , your male servant , your female servant , the Levite , the foreigner , the fatherless , and the widow who are within your gates .

verses.z: 在耶和華所選擇的地方，你當向耶和華－你的上帝守節七日；因為耶和華－你上帝在你一切的土產上和你手裏所辦的事上要賜福與你，你就非常地歡樂。
verses.e: You shall keep a feast to the LORD your God seven days in the place which the LORD chooses , because the LORD your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands , and you shall be altogether joyful .

verses.z: 你一切的男丁要在除酵節、七七節、住棚節，一年三次，在耶和華－你上帝所選擇的地方朝見他，卻不可空手朝見。
verses.e: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses : in the feast of unleavened bread , in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of booths . They shall not appear before the LORD empty .

verses.z: 各人要按自己的力量，照耶和華－你上帝所賜的福分，奉獻禮物。」
verses.e: Every man shall give as he is able , according to the LORD your God's blessing which he has given you .

verses.z: 「你要在耶和華－你上帝所賜的各城裏，按着各支派設立審判官和官長。他們必按公義的審判判斷百姓。
verses.e: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates , which the LORD your God gives you , according to your tribes ; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment .

verses.z: 不可屈枉正直；不可看人的外貌。也不可受賄賂；因為賄賂能叫智慧人的眼變瞎了，又能顛倒義人的話。
verses.e: You shall not pervert justice . You shall not show partiality . You shall not take a bribe , for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous .

verses.z: 你當在耶和華所選擇要立為他名的居所，從牛群羊群中，將逾越[節的祭牲]獻給耶和華－你的上帝。
verses.e: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God , of the flock and the herd , in the place which the LORD shall choose to cause his name to dwell there .

verses.z: 你要追求至公至義，好叫你存活，承受耶和華－你上帝所賜你的地。
verses.e: You shall follow that which is altogether just , that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you .

verses.z: 「你為耶和華－你的上帝築壇，不可在壇旁栽甚麼樹木作為木偶。
verses.e: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the LORD your God's altar , which you shall make for yourselves .

verses.z: 也不可為自己設立柱像；這是耶和華－你上帝所恨惡的。
verses.e: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates .

verses.z: 你吃[這祭牲]，不可吃有酵的餅；七日之內要吃無酵餅，就是困苦餅－你本是急忙出了埃及地－要叫你一生一世記念你從埃及地出來的日子。
verses.e: You shall eat no leavened bread with it . You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days , even the bread of affliction ( for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste ) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life .

verses.z: 在你四境之內，七日不可見麵酵，頭一日晚上所獻的肉，一點不可留到早晨。
verses.e: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days ; neither shall any of the meat , which you sacrifice the first day at evening , remain all night until the morning .

verses.z: 在耶和華－你上帝所賜的各城中，你不可獻逾越[節的祭]；
verses.e: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you ;

verses.z: 只當在耶和華－你上帝所選擇要立為他名的居所，晚上日落的時候，乃是你出埃及的時候，獻逾越[節的祭]。
verses.e: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in , there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening , at the going down of the sun , at the season that you came out of Egypt .

verses.z: 當在耶和華－你上帝所選擇的地方把肉烤了吃，次日早晨就回到你的帳棚去。
verses.e: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses . In the morning you shall return to your tents .

verses.z: 你要吃無酵餅六日，第七日要向耶和華－你的上帝守嚴肅會，不可做工。」
verses.e: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread . On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God . You shall do no work .

verses.z: 「你要計算七七日：從你開鐮收割禾稼時算起，共計七七日。
verses.e: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks . From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks .

verses.z: 「凡有殘疾，或有甚麼惡病的牛羊，你都不可獻給耶和華－你的上帝，因為這是耶和華－你上帝所憎惡的。
verses.e: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil ; for that is an abomination to the LORD your God .

verses.z: 他們在耶和華所選擇的地方指示你的判語，你必照着他們所指教你的一切話謹守遵行。
verses.e: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which the LORD chooses . You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you .

verses.z: 要按他們所指教你的律法，照他們所斷定的去行；他們所指示你的判語，你不可偏離左右。
verses.e: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you , and according to the judgment which they shall tell you , you shall do . You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you , to the right hand , nor to the left .

verses.z: 若有人擅敢不聽從那侍立在耶和華－你上帝面前的祭司，或不聽從審判官，那人就必治死；這樣，便將那惡從以色列中除掉。
verses.e: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God , or to the judge , even that man shall die . You shall put away the evil from Israel .

verses.z: 眾百姓都要聽見害怕，不再擅敢行事。」
verses.e: All the people shall hear and fear , and do no more presumptuously .

verses.z: 「到了耶和華－你上帝所賜你的地，得了那地居住的時候，若說：『我要立王治理我，像四圍的國一樣。』
verses.e: When you have come to the land which the LORD your God gives you , and possess it and dwell in it , and say , " I will set a king over me , like all the nations that are around me , "

verses.z: 你總要立耶和華－你上帝所揀選的人為王。必從你弟兄中立一人；不可立你弟兄以外的人為王。
verses.e: you shall surely set him whom the LORD your God chooses as king over yourselves . You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers . You may not put a foreigner over you , who is not your brother .

verses.z: 只是王不可為自己加添馬匹，也不可使百姓回埃及去，為要加添他的馬匹，因耶和華曾吩咐你們說：『不可再回那條路去。』
verses.e: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself , nor cause the people to return to Egypt , to the end that he may multiply horses ; because the LORD has said to you , " You shall not go back that way again . "

verses.z: 他也不可為自己多立妃嬪，恐怕他的心偏邪；也不可為自己多積金銀。
verses.e: He shall not multiply wives to himself , that his heart not turn away . He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold .

verses.z: 他登了國位，就要將祭司利未人面前的這律法[書]，為自己抄錄一本，
verses.e: It shall be , when he sits on the throne of his kingdom , that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book , out of that which is before the Levitical priests .

verses.z: 存在他那裏，要平生誦讀，好學習敬畏耶和華－他的上帝，謹守遵行這律法[書]上的一切言語和這些律例，
verses.e: It shall be with him , and he shall read from it all the days of his life , that he may learn to fear the LORD his God , to keep all the words of this law and these statutes , to do them ;

verses.z: 「在你們中間，在耶和華－你上帝所賜你的諸城中，無論哪座城裏，若有人，或男或女，行耶和華－你上帝眼中看為惡的事，違背了他的約，
verses.e: If there is found among you , within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you , a man or woman who does that which is evil in the LORD your God's sight in transgressing his covenant ,

verses.z: 免得他向弟兄心高氣傲，偏左偏右，離了這誡命。這樣，他和他的子孫便可在以色列中，在國位上年長日久。」
verses.e: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers , and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand , or to the left , to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom , he and his children , in the middle of Israel .

verses.z: 去事奉敬拜別神，或拜日頭，或拜月亮，或拜天象，是主不曾吩咐的；
verses.e: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them , or the sun , or the moon , or any of the stars of the sky , which I have not commanded ,

verses.z: 有人告訴你，你也聽見了，就要細細地探聽，果然是真，準有這可憎惡的事行在以色列中，
verses.e: and you are told , and you have heard of it , then you shall inquire diligently . Behold , if it is true , and the thing certain , that such abomination is done in Israel ,

verses.z: 你就要將行這惡事的男人或女人拉到城門[外]，用石頭將他打死。
verses.e: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates , even that same man or woman ; and you shall stone them to death with stones .

verses.z: 要憑兩三個人的口作見證將那當死的人治死；不可憑一個人的口作見證將他治死。
verses.e: At the mouth of two witnesses , or three witnesses , he who is to die shall be put to death . At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death .

verses.z: 見證人要先下手，然後眾民也下手將他治死。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
verses.e: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death , and afterward the hands of all the people . So you shall remove the evil from among you .

verses.z: 「你城中若起了爭訟的事，或因流血，或因爭競，或因毆打，是你難斷的案件，你就當起來，往耶和華－你上帝所選擇的地方
verses.e: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment , between blood and blood , between plea and plea , and between stroke and stroke , being matters of controversy within your gates , then you shall arise , and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses .

verses.z: 去見祭司利未人，並當時的審判官，求問他們，他們必將判語指示你。
verses.e: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days . You shall inquire , and they shall give you the verdict .

verses.z: 「祭司利未人和利未全支派必在以色列中無分無業；他們所吃用的就是獻給耶和華的火祭和一切所捐的。
verses.e: The priests and the Levites — all the tribe of Levi — shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel . They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire and his portion .

verses.z: 你們中間不可有人使兒女經火，也不可有占卜的、觀兆的、用法術的、行邪術的、
verses.e: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , one who uses divination , one who tells fortunes , or an enchanter , or a sorcerer ,

verses.z: 用迷術的、交鬼的、行巫術的、過陰的。
verses.e: or a charmer , or someone who consults with a familiar spirit , or a wizard , or a necromancer .

verses.z: 凡行這些事的都為耶和華所憎惡；因那些國民行這可憎惡的事，所以耶和華－你的上帝將他們從你面前趕出。
verses.e: For whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD . Because of these abominations , the LORD your God drives them out from before you .

verses.z: 你要在耶和華－你的上帝面前作完全人。」
verses.e: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「因你所要趕出的那些國民都聽信觀兆的和占卜的，至於你，耶和華－你的上帝從來不許你這樣行。
verses.e: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners ; but as for you , the LORD your God has not allowed you so to do .

verses.z: 耶和華－你的上帝要從你們弟兄中間給你興起一位先知，像我，你們要聽從他。
verses.e: The LORD your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you , of your brothers , like me . You shall listen to him .

verses.z: 正如你在何烈山大會的日子求耶和華－你上帝一切的話，說：『求你不再叫我聽見耶和華－我上帝的聲音，也不再叫我看見這大火，免得我死亡。』
verses.e: This is according to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly , saying , " Let me not hear again the LORD my God's voice , neither let me see this great fire any more , that I not die . "

verses.z: 耶和華就對我說：『他們所說的是。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " They have well said that which they have spoken .

verses.z: 我必在他們弟兄中間給他們興起一位先知，像你。我要將當說的話傳給他；他要將我一切所吩咐的都傳給他們。
verses.e: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers , like you . I will put my words in his mouth , and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him .

verses.z: 誰不聽他奉我名所說的話，我必討誰的罪。
verses.e: It shall happen , that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name , I will require it of him .

verses.z: 他們在弟兄中必沒有產業；耶和華是他們的產業，正如耶和華所應許他們的。
verses.e: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers . The LORD is their inheritance , as he has spoken to them .

verses.z: 若有先知擅敢託我的名說我所未曾吩咐他說的話，或是奉別神的名說話，那先知就必治死。』
verses.e: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name , which I have not commanded him to speak , or who speaks in the name of other gods , that same prophet shall die . "

verses.z: 你心裏若說：『耶和華所未曾吩咐的話，我們怎能知道呢？』
verses.e: You may say in your heart , " How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken ? "

verses.z: 先知託耶和華的名說話，所說的若不成就，也無效驗，這就是耶和華所未曾吩咐的，是那先知擅自說的，你不要怕他。」
verses.e: When a prophet speaks in the LORD's name , if the thing doesn't follow , nor happen , that is the thing which the LORD has not spoken . The prophet has spoken it presumptuously . You shall not be afraid of him .

verses.z: 祭司從百姓所當得的分乃是這樣：凡獻牛或羊為祭的，要把前腿和兩腮並脾胃給祭司。
verses.e: This shall be the priests ' due from the people , from those who offer a sacrifice , whether it be ox or sheep , that they shall give to the priest : the shoulder , the two cheeks , and the inner parts .

verses.z: 初收的五穀、新酒和油，並初剪的羊毛，也要給他；
verses.e: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain , of your new wine , and of your oil , and the first of the fleece of your sheep .

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你的上帝從你各支派中將他揀選出來，使他和他子孫永遠奉耶和華的名侍立，事奉。
verses.e: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the LORD's name , him and his sons forever .

verses.z: 「利未人無論寄居在以色列中的哪一座城，若從那裏出來，一心願意到耶和華所選擇的地方，
verses.e: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives , and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which the LORD shall choose ,

verses.z: 就要奉耶和華－他上帝的名事奉，像他眾弟兄利未人侍立在耶和華面前事奉一樣。
verses.e: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God , as all his brothers the Levites do , who stand there before the LORD .

verses.z: 除了他賣祖父產業所得的以外，還要得一分祭物與他們同吃。」
verses.e: They shall have like portions to eat , in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions .

verses.z: 「你到了耶和華－你上帝所賜之地，那些國民所行可憎惡的事，你不可學着行。
verses.e: When you have come into the land which the LORD your God gives you , you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations .

verses.z: 「耶和華－你上帝將列國之民剪除的時候，耶和華－你上帝也將他們的地賜給你，你接着住他們的城邑並他們的房屋，
verses.e: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God gives you , and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses ,

verses.z: 免得無辜之人的血流在耶和華－你上帝所賜你為業的地上，流血的罪就歸於你。
verses.e: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance , leaving blood guilt on you .

verses.z: 「若有人恨他的鄰舍，埋伏着起來擊殺他，以致於死，便逃到這些城的一座城，
verses.e: But if any man hates his neighbor , lies in wait for him , rises up against him , strikes him mortally so that he dies , and he flees into one of these cities ;

verses.z: 本城的長老就要打發人去，從那裏帶出他來，交在報血仇的手中，將他治死。
verses.e: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there , and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood , that he may die .

verses.z: 你眼不可顧惜他，卻要從以色列中除掉流無辜血的罪，使你可以得福。」
verses.e: Your eye shall not pity him , but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you .

verses.z: 「在耶和華－你上帝所賜你承受為業之地，不可挪移你鄰舍的地界，那是先人所定的。」
verses.e: You shall not remove your neighbor's landmark , which they of old time have set , in your inheritance which you shall inherit , in the land that the LORD your God gives you to possess .

verses.z: 「人無論犯甚麼罪，作甚麼惡，不可憑一個人的口作見證，總要憑兩三個人的口作見證才可定案。
verses.e: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity , or for any sin that he sins . At the mouth of two witnesses , or at the mouth of three witnesses , shall a matter be established .

verses.z: 若有凶惡的見證人起來，見證某人作惡，
verses.e: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing ,

verses.z: 這兩個爭訟的人就要站在耶和華面前，和當時的祭司，並審判官面前，
verses.e: then both the men , between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the LORD , before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days ;

verses.z: 審判官要細細地查究，若見證人果然是作假見證的，以假見證陷害弟兄，
verses.e: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition ; and behold , if the witness is a false witness , and has testified falsely against his brother ,

verses.z: 你們就要待他如同他想要待的弟兄。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
verses.e: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother . So you shall remove the evil from among you .

verses.z: 就要在耶和華－你上帝所賜你為業的地上分定三座城。
verses.e: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land , which the LORD your God gives you to possess .

verses.z: 別人聽見都要害怕，就不敢在你們中間再行這樣的惡了。
verses.e: Those who remain shall hear , and fear , and will never again commit any such evil among you .

verses.z: 你眼不可顧惜，要以命償命，以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳。」
verses.e: Your eyes shall not pity : life for life , eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot .

verses.z: 要將耶和華－你上帝使你承受為業的地分為三段；又要預備道路，使誤殺人的，都可以逃到那裏去。
verses.e: You shall prepare the way , and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit into three parts , that every man slayer may flee there .

verses.z: 「誤殺人的逃到那裏可以存活，定例乃是這樣：凡素無仇恨，無心殺了人的，
verses.e: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live : Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally , and didn't hate him in time past —

verses.z: 就如人與鄰舍同入樹林砍伐樹木，手拿斧子一砍，本想砍下樹木，不料，斧頭脫了把，飛落在鄰舍身上，以致於死，這人逃到那些城的一座城，就可以存活，
verses.e: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree , and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies — he shall flee to one of these cities and live .

verses.z: 免得報血仇的，心中火熱追趕他，因路遠就追上，將他殺死；其實他不該死，因為他與被殺的素無仇恨。
verses.e: Otherwise , the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him , because the way is long , and strike him mortally , even though he was not worthy of death , because he didn't hate him in time past .

verses.z: 所以我吩咐你說，要分定三座城。
verses.e: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves .

verses.z: 耶和華－你上帝若照他向你列祖所起的誓擴張你的境界，將所應許賜你列祖的地全然給你，
verses.e: If the LORD your God enlarges your border , as he has sworn to your fathers , and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers ;

verses.z: 你若謹守遵行我今日所吩咐的這一切誡命，愛耶和華－你的上帝，常常遵行他的道，就要在這三座城之外，再添三座城，
verses.e: and if you keep all this commandment to do it , which I command you today , to love the LORD your God , and to walk ever in his ways , then you shall add three cities more for yourselves , in addition to these three .

verses.z: 「此後，我們轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去，是照耶和華所吩咐我的。我們在西珥山繞行了許多日子。
verses.e: Then we turned , and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea , as the LORD spoke to me ; and we encircled Mount Seir many days .

verses.z: 先前，有以米人住在那裏，民數眾多，身體高大，像亞衲人一樣。
verses.e: ( The Emim lived there before , a great and numerous people , and tall as the Anakim .

verses.z: 這以米人像亞衲人；也算為利乏音人；摩押人稱他們為以米人。
verses.e: These also are considered to be Rephaim , as the Anakim ; but the Moabites call them Emim .

verses.z: 先前，何利人也住在西珥，但以掃的子孫將他們除滅，得了他們的地，接着居住，就如以色列在耶和華賜給他為業之地所行的一樣。）
verses.e: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past , but the children of Esau succeeded them . They destroyed them from before them , and lived in their place , as Israel did to the land of his possession , which the LORD gave to them . )

verses.z: 現在，起來過撒烈溪！於是我們過了撒烈溪。
verses.e: " Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered . " We went over the brook Zered .

verses.z: 自從離開加低斯‧巴尼亞，到過了撒烈溪的時候，共有三十八年，等那世代的兵丁都從營中滅盡，正如耶和華向他們所起的誓。
verses.e: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years , until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp , as the LORD swore to them .

verses.z: 耶和華的手也攻擊他們，將他們從營中除滅，直到滅盡。
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's hand was against them , to destroy them from the middle of the camp , until they were consumed .

verses.z: 「兵丁從民中都滅盡死亡以後，
verses.e: So , when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people ,

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐我說：
verses.e: the LORD spoke to me , saying ,

verses.z: 『你今天要從摩押的境界亞珥經過，
verses.e: " You are to pass over Ar , the border of Moab , today .

verses.z: 走近亞捫人之地，不可擾害他們，也不可與他們爭戰。亞捫人的地，我不賜給你們為業，因我已將那地賜給羅得的子孫為業。』（
verses.e: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon , don't bother them , nor contend with them ; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession , because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession . "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to me , saying ,

verses.z: 那地也算為利乏音人之地，先前利乏音人住在那裏，亞捫人稱他們為散送冥。
verses.e: ( That also is considered a land of Rephaim . Rephaim lived there in the past , but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim ,

verses.z: 那民眾多，身體高大，像亞衲人一樣，但耶和華從亞捫人面前除滅他們，亞捫人就得了他們的地，接着居住。
verses.e: a great people , many , and tall , as the Anakim ; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel , and they succeeded them , and lived in their place ,

verses.z: 正如耶和華從前為住西珥的以掃子孫將何利人從他們面前除滅、他們得了何利人的地、接着居住一樣，直到今日。
verses.e: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir , when he destroyed the Horites from before them ; and they succeeded them , and lived in their place even to this day .

verses.z: 從迦斐託出來的迦斐託人將先前住在鄉村直到迦薩的亞衛人除滅，接着居住。）
verses.e: Then the Avvim , who lived in villages as far as Gaza : the Caphtorim , who came out of Caphtor , destroyed them and lived in their place . )

verses.z: 你們起來前往，過亞嫩谷；我已將亞摩利人希實本王西宏和他的地交在你手中，你要與他爭戰，得他的地為業。
verses.e: " Rise up , take your journey , and pass over the valley of the Arnon . Behold , I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite , king of Heshbon , and his land ; begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle .

verses.z: 從今日起，我要使天下萬民聽見你的名聲都驚恐懼怕，且因你發顫傷慟。」
verses.e: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky , who shall hear the report of you , and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you . "

verses.z: 「我從基底莫的曠野差遣使者去見希實本王西宏，用和睦的話說：
verses.e: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace , saying ,

verses.z: 『求你容我從你的地經過，只走大道，不偏左右。
verses.e: " Let me pass through your land . I will go along by the highway . I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left .

verses.z: 你可以賣糧給我吃，也可以賣水給我喝，只要容我步行過去，
verses.e: You shall sell me food for money , that I may eat ; and give me water for money , that I may drink . Just let me pass through on my feet ,

verses.z: 就如住西珥的以掃子孫和住亞珥的摩押人待我一樣，等我過了約旦河，好進入耶和華－我們上帝所賜給我們的地。』
verses.e: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir , and the Moabites who dwell in Ar , did to me , until I pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us . "

verses.z: 『你們繞行這山的日子夠了，要轉向北去。
verses.e: " You have encircled this mountain long enough . Turn northward .

verses.z: 但希實本王西宏不容我們從他那裏經過；因為耶和華－你的上帝使他心中剛硬，性情頑梗，為要將他交在你手中，像今日一樣。
verses.e: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him , for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate , that he might deliver him into your hand , as it is today .

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：『從此起首，我要將西宏和他的地交給你；你要得他的地為業。』
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Behold , I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you . Begin to possess , that you may inherit his land . "

verses.z: 那時，西宏和他的眾民出來攻擊我們，在雅雜與我們交戰。
verses.e: Then Sihon came out against us , he and all his people , to battle at Jahaz .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝將他交給我們，我們就把他和他的兒子，並他的眾民，都擊殺了。
verses.e: The LORD our God delivered him up before us ; and we struck him , his sons , and all his people .

verses.z: 我們奪了他的一切城邑，將有人煙的各城，連女人帶孩子，盡都毀滅，沒有留下一個。
verses.e: We took all his cities at that time , and utterly destroyed every inhabited city , with the women and the little ones . We left no one remaining .

verses.z: 惟有牲畜和所奪的各城，並其中的財物，都取為自己的掠物。
verses.e: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves , with the plunder of the cities which we had taken .

verses.z: 從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和華－我們的上帝都交給我們了，沒有一座城高得使我們不能攻取的。
verses.e: From Aroer , which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon , and the city that is in the valley , even to Gilead , there was not a city too high for us . The LORD our God delivered up all before us .

verses.z: 惟有亞捫人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，並山地的城邑，與耶和華－我們上帝所禁止我們去的地方，都沒有挨近。」
verses.e: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn't come near : all the banks of the river Jabbok , and the cities of the hill country , and wherever the LORD our God forbade us .

verses.z: 你吩咐百姓說：你們弟兄以掃的子孫住在西珥，你們要經過他們的境界。他們必懼怕你們，所以你們要分外謹慎。
verses.e: Command the people , saying , ' You are to pass through the border of your brothers , the children of Esau , who dwell in Seir ; and they will be afraid of you . Therefore be careful .

verses.z: 不可與他們爭戰；他們的地，連腳掌可踏之處，我都不給你們，因我已將西珥山賜給以掃為業。
verses.e: Don't contend with them ; for I will not give you any of their land , no , not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on , because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession .

verses.z: 你們要用錢向他們買糧吃，也要用錢向他們買水喝。
verses.e: You shall purchase food from them for money , that you may eat . You shall also buy water from them for money , that you may drink . ' "

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你的上帝在你手裏所辦的一切事上已賜福與你。你走這大曠野，他都知道了。這四十年，耶和華－你的上帝常與你同在，故此你一無所缺。』
verses.e: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands . He has known your walking through this great wilderness . These forty years , the LORD your God has been with you . You have lacked nothing .

verses.z: 「於是，我們離了我們弟兄以掃子孫所住的西珥，從亞拉巴的路，經過以拉他、以旬‧迦別，轉向摩押曠野的路去。
verses.e: So we passed by from our brothers , the children of Esau , who dwell in Seir , from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber . We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐我說：『不可擾害摩押人，也不可與他們爭戰。他們的地，我不賜給你為業，因我已將亞珥賜給羅得的子孫為業。』（
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Don't bother Moab , neither contend with them in battle ; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession , because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession . "

verses.z: 「你出去與仇敵爭戰的時候，看見馬匹、車輛，並有比你多的人民，不要怕他們，因為領你出埃及地的耶和華－你上帝與你同在。
verses.e: When you go out to battle against your enemies , and see horses , chariots , and a people more numerous than you , you shall not be afraid of them ; for the LORD your God , who brought you up out of the land of Egypt , is with you .

verses.z: 「你臨近一座城、要攻打的時候，先要對城[裏的民]宣告和睦的話。
verses.e: When you draw near to a city to fight against it , then proclaim peace to it .

verses.z: 他們若以和睦的話回答你，給你開了城，城裏所有的人都要給你效勞，服事你；
verses.e: It shall be , if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you , then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you , and shall serve you .

verses.z: 若不肯與你和好，反要與你打仗，你就要圍困那城。
verses.e: If it will make no peace with you , but will make war against you , then you shall besiege it .

verses.z: 耶和華－你的上帝把城交付你手，你就要用刀殺盡這城的男丁。
verses.e: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand , you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword ;

verses.z: 惟有婦女、孩子、牲畜，和城內一切的財物，你可以取為自己的掠物。耶和華－你上帝把你仇敵的財物賜給你，你可以吃用。
verses.e: but the women , the little ones , the livestock , and all that is in the city , even all its plunder , you shall take for plunder for yourself . You may use the plunder of your enemies , which the LORD your God has given you .

verses.z: 離你甚遠的各城，不是這些國民的城，你都要這樣待他。
verses.e: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you , which are not of the cities of these nations .

verses.z: 但這些國民的城，耶和華－你上帝既賜你為業，其中凡有氣息的，一個不可存留；
verses.e: But of the cities of these peoples that the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance , you shall save alive nothing that breathes ;

verses.z: 只要照耶和華－你上帝所吩咐的將這赫人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人都滅絕淨盡，
verses.e: but you shall utterly destroy them : the Hittite , the Amorite , the Canaanite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite , as the LORD your God has commanded you ;

verses.z: 免得他們教導你們學習一切可憎惡的事，就是他們向自己神所行的，以致你們得罪耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations , which they have done for their gods ; so would you sin against the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你若許久圍困、攻打所要取的一座城，就不可舉斧子砍壞樹木；因為你可以吃那樹上的果子，不可砍伐。田間的樹木豈是人，叫你糟蹋嗎？
verses.e: When you shall besiege a city a long time , in making war against it to take it , you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them ; for you may eat of them . You shall not cut them down , for is the tree of the field man , that it should be besieged by you ?

verses.z: 你們將要上陣的時候，祭司要到百姓面前宣告
verses.e: It shall be , when you draw near to the battle , that the priest shall approach and speak to the people ,

verses.z: 惟獨你所知道不是結果子的樹木可以毀壞、砍伐，用以修築營壘，攻擊那與你打仗的城，直到攻塌了。」
verses.e: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food , you shall destroy and cut them down . You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you , until it falls .

verses.z: 說：『以色列人哪，你們當聽，你們今日將要與仇敵爭戰，不要膽怯，不要懼怕戰兢，也不要因他們驚恐；
verses.e: and shall tell them , " Hear , Israel , you draw near today to battle against your enemies . Don't let your heart faint ! Don't be afraid , nor tremble , neither be scared of them ;

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你們的上帝與你們同去，要為你們與仇敵爭戰，拯救你們。』
verses.e: for the LORD your God is he who goes with you , to fight for you against your enemies , to save you . "

verses.z: 官長也要對百姓宣告說：『誰建造房屋，尚未奉獻，他可以回家去，恐怕他陣亡，別人去奉獻。
verses.e: The officers shall speak to the people , saying , " What man is there who has built a new house , and has not dedicated it ? Let him go and return to his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man dedicate it .

verses.z: 誰種葡萄園，尚未用所結的果子，他可以回家去，恐怕他陣亡，別人去用。
verses.e: What man is there who has planted a vineyard , and has not used its fruit ? Let him go and return to his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man use its fruit .

verses.z: 誰聘定了妻，尚未迎娶，他可以回家去，恐怕他陣亡，別人去娶。』
verses.e: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife , and has not taken her ? Let him go and return to his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man take her . "

verses.z: 官長又要對百姓宣告說：『誰懼怕膽怯，他可以回家去，恐怕他弟兄的心消化，和他一樣。』
verses.e: The officers shall speak further to the people , and they shall say , " What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted ? Let him go and return to his house , lest his brother's heart melt as his heart . "

verses.z: 官長對百姓宣告完了，就當派軍長率領他們。
verses.e: It shall be , when the officers have finished speaking to the people , that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people .

verses.z: 「在耶和華－你上帝所賜你為業的地上，若遇見被殺的人倒在田野，不知道是誰殺的，
verses.e: If someone is found slain in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess , lying in the field , and it isn't known who has struck him ,

verses.z: 「你出去與仇敵爭戰的時候，耶和華－你的上帝將他們交在你手中，你就擄了他們去。
verses.e: When you go out to battle against your enemies , and the LORD your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive ,

verses.z: 若在被擄的人中見有美貌的女子，戀慕她，要娶她為妻，
verses.e: and see among the captives a beautiful woman , and you are attracted to her , and desire to take her as your wife ,

verses.z: 就可以領她到你家裏去；她便要剃頭髮，修指甲，
verses.e: then you shall bring her home to your house . She shall shave her head and trim her nails .

verses.z: 脫去被擄時所穿的衣服，住在你家裏哀哭父母一個整月，然後可以與她同房。你作她的丈夫，她作你的妻子。
verses.e: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity , and shall remain in your house , and bewail her father and her mother a full month . After that you shall go in to her and be her husband , and she shall be your wife .

verses.z: 後來你若不喜悅她，就要由她隨意出去，決不可為錢賣她，也不可當婢女待她，因為你玷污了她。」
verses.e: It shall be , if you have no delight in her , then you shall let her go where she desires ; but you shall not sell her at all for money . You shall not deal with her as a slave , because you have humbled her .

verses.z: 「人若有二妻，一為所愛，一為所惡，所愛的、所惡的都給他生了兒子，但長子是所惡之妻生的。
verses.e: If a man has two wives , the one beloved and the other hated , and they have borne him children , both the beloved and the hated , and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated ,

verses.z: 到了把產業分給兒子承受的時候，不可將所愛之妻生的兒子立為長子，在所惡之妻生的兒子以上，
verses.e: then it shall be , in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has , that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated , who is the firstborn ;

verses.z: 卻要認所惡之妻生的兒子為長子，將產業多加一分給他；因這兒子是他力量強壯的時候生的，長子的名分本當歸他。」
verses.e: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn , the son of the hated , by giving him a double portion of all that he has ; for he is the beginning of his strength . The right of the firstborn is his .

verses.z: 「人若有頑梗悖逆的兒子，不聽從父母的話，他們雖懲治他，他仍不聽從，
verses.e: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother , and though they chasten him , will not listen to them ,

verses.z: 父母就要抓住他，將他帶到本地的城門、本城的長老那裏，
verses.e: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place .

verses.z: 長老和審判官就要出去，從被殺的人那裏量起，直量到四圍的城邑，
verses.e: then your elders and your judges shall come out , and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain .

verses.z: 對長老說：『我們這兒子頑梗悖逆，不聽從我們的話，是貪食好酒的人。』
verses.e: They shall tell the elders of his city , " This our son is stubborn and rebellious . He will not obey our voice . He is a glutton and a drunkard . "

verses.z: 本城的眾人就要用石頭將他打死。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉，以色列眾人都要聽見害怕。」
verses.e: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones . So you shall remove the evil from among you . All Israel shall hear , and fear .

verses.z: 「人若犯該死的罪，被治死了，你將他掛在木頭上，
verses.e: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death , and he is put to death , and you hang him on a tree ,

verses.z: 他的屍首不可留在木頭上過夜，必要當日將他葬埋，免得玷污了耶和華－你上帝所賜你為業之地。因為被掛的人是在上帝面前受咒詛的。
verses.e: his body shall not remain all night on the tree , but you shall surely bury him the same day ; for he who is hanged is accursed of God . Don't defile your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance .

verses.z: 看哪城離被殺的人最近，那城的長老就要從牛群中取一隻未曾耕地、未曾負軛的母牛犢，
verses.e: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd , which hasn't been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke .

verses.z: 把母牛犢牽到流水、未曾耕種的山谷去，在谷中打折母牛犢的頸項。
verses.e: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water , which is neither plowed nor sown , and shall break the heifer's neck there in the valley .

verses.z: 祭司利未的子孫要近前來；因為耶和華－你的上帝揀選了他們事奉他，奉耶和華的名祝福，所有爭訟毆打的事都要憑他們判斷。
verses.e: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near , for them the LORD your God has chosen to minister to him , and to bless in the LORD's name ; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided .

verses.z: 那城的眾長老，就是離被殺的人最近的，要在那山谷中，在所打折頸項的母牛犢以上洗手，
verses.e: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley .

verses.z: 禱告說：『我們的手未曾流這[人的]血；我們的眼也未曾看見這事。
verses.e: They shall answer and say , " Our hands have not shed this blood , neither have our eyes seen it .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你赦免你所救贖的以色列民，不要使流無辜血的罪歸在你的百姓以色列中間。』這樣，流血的罪必得赦免。
verses.e: Forgive , LORD , your people Israel , whom you have redeemed , and don't allow innocent blood among your people Israel . " The blood shall be forgiven them .

verses.z: 你行耶和華眼中看為正的事，就可以從你們中間除掉流無辜血的罪。」
verses.e: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you , when you shall do that which is right in the LORD's eyes .

verses.z: 「你若看見弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯為不見，總要把牠牽回來交給你的弟兄。
verses.e: You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them . You shall surely bring them again to your brother .

verses.z: 不可並用牛、驢耕地。
verses.e: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together .

verses.z: 不可穿羊毛、細麻兩樣攙雜料做的衣服。
verses.e: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together .

verses.z: 「你要在所披的外衣上四圍做繸子。」
verses.e: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself .

verses.z: 「人若娶妻，與她同房之後恨惡她，
verses.e: If any man takes a wife , and goes in to her , hates her ,

verses.z: 信口說她，將醜名加在她身上，說：『我娶了這女子，與她同房，見她沒有貞潔的憑據』；
verses.e: accuses her of shameful things , gives her a bad name , and says , " I took this woman , and when I came near to her , I didn't find in her the tokens of virginity ; "

verses.z: 女子的父母就要把女子貞潔的憑據拿出來，帶到本城門長老那裏。
verses.e: then the young lady's father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady's virginity to the elders of the city in the gate .

verses.z: 女子的父親要對長老說：『我將我的女兒給這人為妻，他恨惡她，
verses.e: The young lady's father shall tell the elders , " I gave my daughter to this man as his wife , and he hates her .

verses.z: 信口說她，說：我見你的女兒沒有貞潔的憑據；其實這就是我女兒貞潔的憑據。』父母就把那布鋪在本城的長老面前。
verses.e: Behold , he has accused her of shameful things , saying , ' I didn't find in your daughter the tokens of virginity ; ' and yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity . " They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city .

verses.z: 本城的長老要拿住那人，懲治他，
verses.e: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him .

verses.z: 並要罰他一百[舍客勒]銀子，給女子的父親，因為他將醜名加在以色列的一個處女身上。女子仍作他的妻，終身不可休她。
verses.e: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver , and give them to the father of the young lady , because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel . She shall be his wife . He may not put her away all his days .

verses.z: 你弟兄若離你遠，或是你不認識他，就要牽到你家去，留在你那裏，等你弟兄來尋找就還給他。
verses.e: If your brother isn't near to you , or if you don't know him , then you shall bring it home to your house , and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it , and you shall restore it to him .

verses.z: 但這事若是真的，女子沒有貞潔的憑據，
verses.e: But if this thing is true , that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady ,

verses.z: 就要將女子帶到她父家的門口，本城的人要用石頭將她打死；因為她在父家行了淫亂，在以色列中做了醜事。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
verses.e: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father's house , and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones , because she has done folly in Israel , to play the prostitute in her father's house . So you shall remove the evil from among you .

verses.z: 「若遇見人與有丈夫的婦人行淫，就要將姦夫淫婦一併治死。這樣，就把那惡從以色列中除掉。
verses.e: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband , then they shall both die , the man who lay with the woman and the woman . So you shall remove the evil from Israel .

verses.z: 「若有處女已經許配丈夫，有人在城裏遇見她，與她行淫，
verses.e: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband , and a man finds her in the city , and lies with her ,

verses.z: 你們就要把這二人帶到本城門，用石頭打死－女子是因為雖在城裏卻沒有喊叫；男子是因為玷污別人的妻。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
verses.e: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city , and you shall stone them to death with stones ; the lady , because she didn't cry , being in the city ; and the man , because he has humbled his neighbor's wife . So you shall remove the evil from among you .

verses.z: 「若有男子在田野遇見已經許配人的女子，強與她行淫，只要將那男子治死。
verses.e: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field , and the man forces her and lies with her , then only the man who lay with her shall die ;

verses.z: 但不可辦女子；她本沒有該死的罪，這事就類乎人起來攻擊鄰舍，將他殺了一樣。
verses.e: but to the lady you shall do nothing . There is in the lady no sin worthy of death ; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him , even so is this matter ;

verses.z: 因為男子是在田野遇見那已經許配人的女子，女子喊叫，並無人救她。
verses.e: for he found her in the field , the pledged to be married lady cried , and there was no one to save her .

verses.z: 「若有男子遇見沒有許配人的處女，抓住她，與她行淫，被人看見，
verses.e: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin , who is not pledged to be married , grabs her and lies with her , and they are found ,

verses.z: 這男子就要拿五十[舍客勒]銀子給女子的父親；因他玷污了這女子，就要娶她為妻，終身不可休她。
verses.e: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady's father fifty shekels of silver . She shall be his wife , because he has humbled her . He may not put her away all his days .

verses.z: 你的弟兄無論失落甚麼，或是驢，或是衣服，你若遇見，都要這樣行，不可佯為不見。
verses.e: So you shall do with his donkey . So you shall do with his garment . So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother's , which he has lost and you have found . You may not hide yourself .

verses.z: 「人不可娶繼母為妻；不可掀開他父親的衣襟。」
verses.e: A man shall not take his father's wife , and shall not uncover his father's skirt .

verses.z: 你若看見弟兄的牛或驢跌倒在路上，不可佯為不見，總要幫助他拉起來。
verses.e: You shall not see your brother's donkey or his ox fallen down by the way , and hide yourself from them . You shall surely help him to lift them up again .

verses.z: 「婦女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿婦女的衣服，因為這樣行都是耶和華－你上帝所憎惡的。
verses.e: A woman shall not wear men's clothing , neither shall a man put on women's clothing ; for whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你若路上遇見鳥窩，或在樹上或在地上，裏頭有雛或有蛋，母鳥伏在雛上或在蛋上，你不可連母帶雛一併取去。
verses.e: If you come across a bird's nest on the way , in any tree or on the ground , with young ones or eggs , and the hen sitting on the young , or on the eggs , you shall not take the hen with the young .

verses.z: 總要放母，只可取雛；這樣你就可以享福，日子得以長久。
verses.e: You shall surely let the hen go , but the young you may take for yourself , that it may be well with you , and that you may prolong your days .

verses.z: 「你若建造房屋，要在房上的四圍安欄杆，免得有人從房上掉下來，流血的罪就歸於你家。
verses.e: When you build a new house , then you shall make a railing around your roof , so that you don't bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there .

verses.z: 「不可把兩樣種子種在你的葡萄園裏，免得你撒種所結的和葡萄園的果子都要充公。
verses.e: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed , lest all the fruit be defiled , the seed which you have sown , and the increase of the vineyard .

verses.z: 「凡外腎受傷的，或被閹割的，不可入耶和華的會。
verses.e: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into the LORD's assembly .

verses.z: 「你們中間，若有人夜間偶然夢遺，不潔淨，就要出到營外，不可入營；
verses.e: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night , then shall he go outside of the camp . He shall not come within the camp ;

verses.z: 到傍晚的時候，他要用水洗澡，及至日落了才可以入營。
verses.e: but it shall be , when evening comes , he shall bathe himself in water . When the sun is down , he shall come within the camp .

verses.z: 「你在營外也該定出一個地方作為便所。
verses.e: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself .

verses.z: 在你器械之中當預備一把鍬，你出營外便溺以後，用以鏟土，轉身掩蓋。
verses.e: You shall have a trowel among your weapons . It shall be , when you relieve yourself , you shall dig with it , and shall turn back and cover your excrement ;

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你的上帝常在你營中行走，要救護你，將仇敵交給你，所以你的營理當聖潔，免得他見你那裏有污穢，就離開你。」
verses.e: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp , to deliver you , and to give up your enemies before you . Therefore your camp shall be holy , that he may not see an unclean thing in you , and turn away from you .

verses.z: 「若有奴僕脫了主人的手，逃到你那裏，你不可將他交付他的主人。
verses.e: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you .

verses.z: 他必在你那裏與你同住，在你的城邑中，要由他選擇一個所喜悅的地方居住；你不可欺負他。
verses.e: He shall dwell with you , among you , in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates , where it pleases him best . You shall not oppress him .

verses.z: 「以色列的女子中不可有妓女；以色列的男子中不可有孌童。
verses.e: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel , neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel .

verses.z: 娼妓所得的錢，或孌童所得的價，你不可帶入耶和華－你上帝的殿還願，因為這兩樣都是耶和華－你上帝所憎惡的。
verses.e: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute , or the wages of a male prostitute , into the house of the LORD your God for any vow ; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你借給你弟兄的，或是錢財或是糧食，無論甚麼可生利的物，都不可取利。
verses.e: You shall not lend on interest to your brother : interest of money , interest of food , interest of anything that is lent on interest .

verses.z: 「私生子不可入耶和華的會；他的子孫，直到十代，也不可入耶和華的會。
verses.e: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into the LORD's assembly ; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into the LORD's assembly .

verses.z: 借給外邦人可以取利，只是借給你弟兄不可取利。這樣，耶和華－你上帝必在你所去得為業的地上和你手裏所辦的一切事上賜福與你。
verses.e: You may charge a foreigner interest ; but you shall not charge your brother interest , that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to , in the land where you go in to possess it .

verses.z: 「你向耶和華－你的上帝許願，償還不可遲延；因為耶和華－你的上帝必定向你追討，你不償還就有罪。
verses.e: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God , you shall not be slack to pay it , for the LORD your God will surely require it of you ; and it would be sin in you .

verses.z: 你若不許願，倒無罪。
verses.e: But if you refrain from making a vow , it shall be no sin in you .

verses.z: 你嘴裏所出的，就是你口中應許甘心所獻的，要照你向耶和華－你上帝所許的願謹守遵行。
verses.e: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips . Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering , which you have promised with your mouth , you must do .

verses.z: 「你進了鄰舍的葡萄園，可以隨意吃飽了葡萄，只是不可裝在器皿中。
verses.e: When you come into your neighbor's vineyard , then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure ; but you shall not put any in your container .

verses.z: 你進了鄰舍站着的禾稼，可以用手摘穗子，只是不可用鐮刀割取禾稼。」
verses.e: When you come into your neighbor's standing grain , then you may pluck the ears with your hand ; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor's standing grain .

verses.z: 「亞捫人或是摩押人不可入耶和華的會；他們的子孫，雖過十代，也永不可入耶和華的會。
verses.e: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into the LORD's assembly ; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into the LORD's assembly forever ,

verses.z: 因為你們出埃及的時候，他們沒有拿食物和水在路上迎接你們，又因他們雇了美索不達米亞的毗奪人比珥的兒子巴蘭來咒詛你們。
verses.e: because they didn't meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt , and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia , to curse you .

verses.z: 然而耶和華－你的上帝不肯聽從巴蘭，卻使那咒詛的言語變為祝福的話，因為耶和華－你的上帝愛你。
verses.e: Nevertheless the LORD your God wouldn't listen to Balaam , but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing to you , because the LORD your God loved you .

verses.z: 你一生一世永不可求他們的平安和他們的利益。
verses.e: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever .

verses.z: 「不可憎惡以東人，因為他是你的弟兄。不可憎惡埃及人，因為你在他的地上作過寄居的。
verses.e: You shall not abhor an Edomite , for he is your brother . You shall not abhor an Egyptian , because you lived as a foreigner in his land .

verses.z: 他們第三代子孫可以入耶和華的會。」
verses.e: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD's assembly .

verses.z: 「你出兵攻打仇敵，就要遠避諸惡。
verses.e: When you go out and camp against your enemies , then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing .

verses.z: 「人若娶妻以後，見她有甚麼不合理的事，不喜悅她，就可以寫休書交在她手中，打發她離開夫家。
verses.e: When a man takes a wife and marries her , then it shall be , if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her , that he shall write her a certificate of divorce , put it in her hand , and send her out of his house .

verses.z: 「你借給鄰舍，不拘是甚麼，不可進他家拿他的當頭。
verses.e: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan , you shall not go into his house to get his pledge .

verses.z: 要站在外面，等那向你借貸的人把當頭拿出來交給你。
verses.e: You shall stand outside , and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you .

verses.z: 他若是窮人，你不可留他的當頭過夜。
verses.e: If he is a poor man , you shall not sleep with his pledge .

verses.z: 日落的時候，總要把當頭還他，使他用那件衣服蓋着睡覺，他就為你祝福；這在耶和華－你上帝面前就是你的義了。
verses.e: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down , that he may sleep in his garment and bless you . It shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「困苦窮乏的雇工，無論是你的弟兄或是在你城裏寄居的，你不可欺負他。
verses.e: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy , whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates .

verses.z: 要當日給他工價，不可等到日落－因為他窮苦，把心放在工價上－恐怕他因你求告耶和華，罪便歸你了。
verses.e: In his day you shall give him his wages , neither shall the sun go down on it , for he is poor and sets his heart on it , lest he cry against you to the LORD , and it be sin to you .

verses.z: 「不可因子殺父，也不可因父殺子；凡被殺的都為本身的罪。
verses.e: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers . Every man shall be put to death for his own sin .

verses.z: 「你不可向寄居的和孤兒屈枉正直，也不可拿寡婦的衣裳作當頭。
verses.e: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice , nor take a widow's clothing in pledge ;

verses.z: 要記念你在埃及作過奴僕。耶和華－你的上帝從那裏將你救贖，所以我吩咐你這樣行。
verses.e: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt , and the LORD your God redeemed you there . Therefore I command you to do this thing .

verses.z: 「你在田間收割莊稼，若忘下一捆，不可回去再取，要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。這樣，耶和華－你上帝必在你手裏所辦的一切事上賜福與你。
verses.e: When you reap your harvest in your field , and have forgotten a sheaf in the field , you shall not go again to get it . It shall be for the foreigner , for the fatherless , and for the widow , that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands .

verses.z: 婦人離開夫家以後，可以去嫁別人。
verses.e: When she has departed out of his house , she may go and be another man's wife .

verses.z: 你打橄欖樹，枝上剩下的，不可再打；要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。
verses.e: When you beat your olive tree , you shall not go over the boughs again . It shall be for the foreigner , for the fatherless , and for the widow .

verses.z: 你摘葡萄園的[葡萄]，所剩下的，不可再摘；要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。
verses.e: When you harvest your vineyard , you shall not glean it after yourselves . It shall be for the foreigner , for the fatherless , and for the widow .

verses.z: 你也要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕，所以我吩咐你這樣行。
verses.e: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt . Therefore I command you to do this thing .

verses.z: 後夫若恨惡她，寫休書交在她手中，打發她離開夫家，或是娶她為妻的後夫死了，
verses.e: If the latter husband hates her , and writes her a certificate of divorce , puts it in her hand , and sends her out of his house ; or if the latter husband dies , who took her to be his wife ;

verses.z: 打發她去的前夫不可在婦人玷污之後再娶她為妻，因為這是耶和華所憎惡的；不可使耶和華－你上帝所賜為業之地被玷污了。」
verses.e: her former husband , who sent her away , may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled ; for that would be an abomination to the LORD . You shall not cause the land to sin , which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance .

verses.z: 「新娶妻之人不可從軍出征，也不可託他辦理甚麼公事，可以在家清閒一年，使他所娶的妻快活。
verses.e: When a man takes a new wife , he shall not go out in the army , neither shall he be assigned any business . He shall be free at home one year , and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken .

verses.z: 「不可拿人的[全]盤磨石或是上磨石作當頭，因為這是拿[人的]命作當頭。
verses.e: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge , for he takes a life in pledge .

verses.z: 「若遇見人拐帶以色列中的一個弟兄，當奴才待他，或是賣了他，那拐帶人的就必治死。這樣，便將那惡從你們中間除掉。
verses.e: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel , and he deals with him as a slave , or sells him , then that thief shall die . So you shall remove the evil from among you .

verses.z: 「在大痲瘋的災病上，你們要謹慎，照祭司利未人一切所指教你們的留意遵行。我怎樣吩咐他們，你們要怎樣遵行。
verses.e: Be careful in the plague of leprosy , that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you . As I commanded them , so you shall observe to do .

verses.z: 當記念出埃及後，在路上，耶和華－你上帝向米利暗所行的事。
verses.e: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam , by the way as you came out of Egypt .

verses.z: 「人若有爭訟，來聽審判，[審判官]就要定義人有理，定惡人有罪。
verses.e: If there is a controversy between men , and they come to judgment and the judges judge them , then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked .

verses.z: 在以色列中，他的名必稱為脫鞋之家。」
verses.e: His name shall be called in Israel , " The house of him who had his sandal removed . "

verses.z: 「若有二人爭鬥，這人的妻近前來，要救她丈夫脫離那打她丈夫之人的手，抓住那人的下體，
verses.e: When men strive against each other , and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him , and puts out her hand , and grabs him by his private parts ,

verses.z: 就要砍斷婦人的手，眼不可顧惜她。
verses.e: then you shall cut off her hand . Your eye shall have no pity .

verses.z: 「你囊中不可有一大一小兩樣的法碼。
verses.e: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights , one heavy and one light .

verses.z: 你家裏不可有一大一小兩樣的升斗。
verses.e: You shall not have in your house diverse measures , one large and one small .

verses.z: 當用對準公平的法碼，公平的升斗。這樣，在耶和華－你上帝所賜你的地上，你的日子就可以長久。
verses.e: You shall have a perfect and just weight . You shall have a perfect and just measure , that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you .

verses.z: 因為行非義之事的人都是耶和華－你上帝所憎惡的。」
verses.e: For all who do such things , all who do unrighteously , are an abomination to the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你要記念你們出埃及的時候，亞瑪力人在路上怎樣待你。
verses.e: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt ,

verses.z: 他們在路上遇見你，趁你疲乏困倦擊殺你儘後邊軟弱的人，並不敬畏上帝。
verses.e: how he met you by the way , and struck the rearmost of you , all who were feeble behind you , when you were faint and weary ; and he didn't fear God .

verses.z: 所以耶和華－你上帝使你不被四圍一切的仇敵擾亂，在耶和華－你上帝賜你為業的地上得享平安。那時，你要將亞瑪力的名號從天下塗抹了，不可忘記。」
verses.e: Therefore it shall be , when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around , in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it , that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky . You shall not forget .

verses.z: 惡人若該受責打，審判官就要叫他當面伏在地上，按着他的罪照數責打。
verses.e: It shall be , if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten , that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face , according to his wickedness , by number .

verses.z: 只可打他四十下，不可過數；若過數，便是輕賤你的弟兄了。
verses.e: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes . He shall not give more , lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes , then your brother will be degraded in your sight .

verses.z: 「牛在場上踹穀的時候，不可籠住牠的嘴。」
verses.e: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain .

verses.z: 「弟兄同居，若死了一個，沒有兒子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，她丈夫的兄弟當盡弟兄的本分，娶她為妻，與她同房。
verses.e: If brothers dwell together , and one of them dies and has no son , the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger . Her husband's brother shall go in to her , and take her as his wife , and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her .

verses.z: 婦人生的長子必歸死兄的名下，免得他的名在以色列中塗抹了。
verses.e: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead , that his name not be blotted out of Israel .

verses.z: 那人若不願意娶他哥哥的妻，他哥哥的妻就要到城門長老那裏，說：『我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中興起他哥哥的名字，不給我盡弟兄的本分。』
verses.e: If the man doesn't want to take his brother's wife , then his brother's wife shall go up to the gate to the elders , and say , " My husband's brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel . He will not perform the duty of a husband's brother to me . "

verses.z: 本城的長老就要召那人來問他，他若執意說：『我不願意娶她』，
verses.e: Then the elders of his city shall call him , and speak to him . If he stands and says , " I don't want to take her , "

verses.z: 他哥哥的妻就要當着長老到那人的跟前，脫了他的鞋，吐唾沫在他臉上，說：『凡不為哥哥建立家室的都要這樣待他。』
verses.e: then his brother's wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders , and loose his sandal from off his foot , and spit in his face . She shall answer and say , " So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother's house . "

verses.z: 「你進去得了耶和華－你上帝所賜你為業之地居住，
verses.e: It shall be , when you have come in to the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance , possess it , and dwell in it ,

verses.z: 耶和華啊，現在我把你所賜給我地上初熟的土產奉了來。』隨後你要把筐子放在耶和華－你上帝面前，向耶和華－你的上帝下拜。
verses.e: Now , behold , I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground , which you , the LORD , have given me . " You shall set it down before the LORD your God , and worship before the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你和利未人，並在你們中間寄居的，要因耶和華－你上帝所賜你和你家的一切福分歡樂。
verses.e: You shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you , and to your house , you , and the Levite , and the foreigner who is among you .

verses.z: 「每逢三年，就是十分取一之年，你取完了一切土產的十分之一，要分給利未人和寄居的，與孤兒寡婦，使他們在你城中可以吃得飽足。
verses.e: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year , which is the year of tithing , then you shall give it to the Levite , to the foreigner , to the fatherless , and to the widow , that they may eat within your gates and be filled .

verses.z: 你又要在耶和華－你上帝面前說：『我已將聖物從我家裏拿出來，給了利未人和寄居的，與孤兒寡婦，是照你所吩咐我的一切命令。你的命令我都沒有違背，也沒有忘記。
verses.e: You shall say before the LORD your God , " I have put away the holy things out of my house , and also have given them to the Levite , to the foreigner , to the fatherless , and to the widow , according to all your commandment which you have commanded me . I have not transgressed any of your commandments , neither have I forgotten them .

verses.z: 我守喪的時候，沒有吃這聖物；不潔淨的時候，也沒有拿出來，又沒有為死人送去。我聽從了耶和華－我上帝的話，都照你所吩咐的行了。
verses.e: I have not eaten of it in my mourning , neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean , nor given of it for the dead . I have listened to the LORD my God's voice . I have done according to all that you have commanded me .

verses.z: 求你從天上、你的聖所垂看，賜福給你的百姓以色列與你所賜給我們的地，就是你向我們列祖起誓賜我們流奶與蜜之地。』」
verses.e: Look down from your holy habitation , from heaven , and bless your people Israel , and the ground which you have given us , as you swore to our fathers , a land flowing with milk and honey . "

verses.z: 「耶和華－你的上帝今日吩咐你行這些律例典章，所以你要盡心盡性謹守遵行。
verses.e: Today the LORD your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances . You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul .

verses.z: 你今日認耶和華為你的上帝，應許遵行他的道，謹守他的律例、誡命、典章，聽從他的話。
verses.e: You have declared today that the LORD is your God , and that you would walk in his ways , keep his statutes , his commandments , and his ordinances , and listen to his voice .

verses.z: 耶和華今日照他所應許你的，也認你為他的子民，使你謹守他的一切誡命，
verses.e: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession , as he has promised you , and that you should keep all his commandments .

verses.z: 又使你得稱讚、美名、尊榮，超乎他所造的萬民之上，並照他所應許的使你歸耶和華－你上帝為聖潔的民。」
verses.e: He will make you high above all nations that he has made , in praise , in name , and in honor , and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God , as he has spoken .

verses.z: 就要從耶和華－你上帝賜你的地上將所收的各種初熟的土產取些來，盛在筐子裏，往耶和華－你上帝所選擇要立為他名的居所去，
verses.e: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground , which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you . You shall put it in a basket , and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there .

verses.z: 見當時作祭司的，對他說：『我今日向耶和華－你上帝明認，我已來到耶和華向我們列祖起誓應許賜給我們的地。』
verses.e: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days , and tell him , " I profess today to the LORD your God , that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us . "

verses.z: 祭司就從你手裏取過筐子來，放在耶和華－你上帝的壇前。
verses.e: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand , and set it down before the LORD your God's altar .

verses.z: 你要在耶和華－你上帝面前說：『我祖原是一個將亡的亞蘭人，下到埃及寄居。他人口稀少，在那裏卻成了又大又強、人數很多的國民。
verses.e: You shall answer and say before the LORD your God , " My father was a Syrian ready to perish . He went down into Egypt , and lived there , few in number . There he became a great , mighty , and populous nation .

verses.z: 埃及人惡待我們，苦害我們，將苦工加在我們身上。
verses.e: The Egyptians mistreated us , afflicted us , and imposed hard labor on us .

verses.z: 於是我們哀求耶和華－我們列祖的上帝，耶和華聽見我們的聲音，看見我們所受的困苦、勞碌、欺壓，
verses.e: Then we cried to the LORD , the God of our fathers . The LORD heard our voice , and saw our affliction , our toil , and our oppression .

verses.z: 他就用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並大可畏的事與神蹟奇事，領我們出了埃及，
verses.e: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand , with an outstretched arm , with great terror , with signs , and with wonders ;

verses.z: 將我們領進這地方，把這流奶與蜜之地賜給我們。
verses.e: and he has brought us into this place , and has given us this land , a land flowing with milk and honey .

verses.z: 摩西和以色列的眾長老吩咐百姓說：「你們要遵守我今日所吩咐的一切誡命。
verses.e: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people , saying , " Keep all the commandment which I command you today .

verses.z: 所以要聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，遵行他的誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的。」
verses.e: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God's voice , and do his commandments and his statutes , which I command you today . "

verses.z: 當日，摩西囑咐百姓說：
verses.e: Moses commanded the people the same day , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們過了約旦河，西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、約瑟、便雅憫六個支派的人都要站在基利心山上為百姓祝福。
verses.e: " These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people , when you have crossed over the Jordan : Simeon , Levi , Judah , Issachar , Joseph , and Benjamin .

verses.z: 呂便、迦得、亞設、西布倫、但、拿弗他利六個支派的人都要站在以巴路山上宣布咒詛。
verses.e: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse : Reuben , Gad , Asher , Zebulun , Dan , and Naphtali .

verses.z: 利未人要向以色列眾人高聲說：
verses.e: With a loud voice , the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel ,

verses.z: 「『有人製造耶和華所憎惡的偶像，或雕刻，或鑄造，就是工匠手所做的，在暗中設立，那人必受咒詛！』百姓都要答應說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image , an abomination to the LORD , the work of the hands of the craftsman , and sets it up in secret . ' All the people shall answer and say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『輕慢父母的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『挪移鄰舍地界的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who removes his neighbor's landmark . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『使瞎子走差路的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『向寄居的和孤兒寡婦屈枉正直的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner , fatherless , and widow . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 你們過約旦河，到了耶和華－你上帝所賜給你的地，當天要立起幾塊大石頭，墁上石灰，
verses.e: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you , that you shall set yourself up great stones , and coat them with plaster .

verses.z: 「『與繼母行淫的，必受咒詛！因為掀開他父親的衣襟。』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who lies with his father's wife , because he dishonors his father's bed . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『與獸淫合的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『與異母同父，或異父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who lies with his sister , his father's daughter or his mother's daughter . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『與岳母行淫的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『暗中殺人的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『受賄賂害死無辜之人的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . '

verses.z: 「『不堅守遵行這律法言語的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』」
verses.e: ' Cursed is he who doesn't uphold the words of this law by doing them . ' All the people shall say , ' Amen . ' "

verses.z: 把這律法的一切話寫在石頭上。你過了河，可以進入耶和華－你上帝所賜你流奶與蜜之地，正如耶和華－你列祖之上帝所應許你的。
verses.e: You shall write on them all the words of this law , when you have passed over , that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you , a land flowing with milk and honey , as the LORD , the God of your fathers , has promised you .

verses.z: 你們過了約旦河，就要在以巴路山上照我今日所吩咐的，將這些石頭立起來，墁上石灰。
verses.e: It shall be , when you have crossed over the Jordan , that you shall set up these stones , which I command you today , on Mount Ebal , and you shall coat them with plaster .

verses.z: 在那裏要為耶和華－你的上帝築一座石壇；在石頭上不可動鐵[器]。
verses.e: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God , an altar of stones . You shall not use any iron tool on them .

verses.z: 要用沒有鑿過的石頭築耶和華－你上帝的壇，在壇上要將燔祭獻給耶和華－你的上帝。
verses.e: You shall build the LORD your God's altar of uncut stones . You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God .

verses.z: 又要獻平安祭，且在那裏吃，在耶和華－你的上帝面前歡樂。
verses.e: You shall sacrifice peace offerings , and shall eat there . You shall rejoice before the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你要將這律法的一切話明明地寫在石頭上。」
verses.e: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly . "

verses.z: 摩西和祭司利未人曉諭以色列眾人說：「以色列啊，要默默靜聽。你今日成為耶和華－你上帝的百姓了。
verses.e: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel , saying , " Be silent and listen , Israel ! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你若留意聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，謹守遵行他的一切誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下萬民之上。
verses.e: It shall happen , if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God's voice , to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today , that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth .

verses.z: 天下萬民見你歸在耶和華的名下，就要懼怕你。
verses.e: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD's name , and they will be afraid of you .

verses.z: 你在耶和華向你列祖起誓應許賜你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所產的，都綽綽有餘。
verses.e: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body , in the fruit of your livestock , and in the fruit of your ground , in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you .

verses.z: 耶和華必為你開天上的府庫，按時降雨在你的地上。在你手裏所辦的一切事上賜福與你。你必借給許多國民，卻不致向他們借貸。
verses.e: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky , to give the rain of your land in its season , and to bless all the work of your hand . You will lend to many nations , and you will not borrow .

verses.z: 你若聽從耶和華－你上帝的誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，謹守遵行，不偏左右，也不隨從事奉別神，耶和華就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。」
verses.e: The LORD will make you the head , and not the tail . You will be above only , and you will not be beneath , if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today , to observe and to do ,
and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today , to the right hand or to the left , to go after other gods to serve them .

verses.z: 「你若不聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，不謹守遵行他的一切誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，這以下的咒詛都必追隨你，臨到你身上：
verses.e: But it shall come to pass , if you will not listen to the LORD your God's voice , to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today , that all these curses will come on you and overtake you .

verses.z: 你在城裏必受咒詛，在田間也必受咒詛。
verses.e: You will be cursed in the city , and you will be cursed in the field .

verses.z: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必受咒詛。
verses.e: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed .

verses.z: 你身所生的，地所產的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必受咒詛。
verses.e: The fruit of your body , the fruit of your ground , the increase of your livestock , and the young of your flock will be cursed .

verses.z: 你出也受咒詛，入也受咒詛。
verses.e: You will be cursed when you come in , and you will be cursed when you go out .

verses.z: 你若聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，這以下的福必追隨你，臨到你身上：
verses.e: All these blessings will come upon you , and overtake you , if you listen to the LORD your God's voice .

verses.z: 耶和華因你行惡離棄他，必在你手裏所辦的一切事上，使咒詛、擾亂、責罰臨到你，直到你被毀滅，速速地滅亡。
verses.e: The LORD will send on you cursing , confusion , and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do , until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly , because of the evil of your doings , by which you have forsaken me .

verses.z: 耶和華必使瘟疫貼在你身上，直到他將你從所進去得為業的地上滅絕。
verses.e: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you , until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it .

verses.z: 耶和華要用癆病、熱病、火症、瘧疾、刀劍、旱[風]、霉爛攻擊你。這都要追趕你，直到你滅亡。
verses.e: The LORD will strike you with consumption , with fever , with inflammation , with fiery heat , with the sword , with blight , and with mildew . They will pursue you until you perish .

verses.z: 你頭上的天要變為銅，腳下的地要變為鐵。
verses.e: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze , and the earth that is under you will be iron .

verses.z: 耶和華要使那降在你地上的雨變為塵沙，從天臨在你身上，直到你滅亡。
verses.e: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust . It will come down on you from the sky , until you are destroyed .

verses.z: 「耶和華必使你敗在仇敵面前，你從一條路去攻擊他們，必從七條路逃跑。你必在天下萬國中拋來拋去。
verses.e: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies . You will go out one way against them , and will flee seven ways before them . You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth .

verses.z: 你的屍首必給空中的飛鳥和地上的走獸作食物，並無人鬨趕。
verses.e: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky , and to the animals of the earth ; and there will be no one to frighten them away .

verses.z: 耶和華必用埃及人的瘡並痔瘡、牛皮癬與疥攻擊你，使你不能醫治。
verses.e: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt , with the tumors , with the scurvy , and with the itch , of which you can not be healed .

verses.z: 耶和華必用癲狂、眼瞎、心驚攻擊你。
verses.e: The LORD will strike you with madness , with blindness , and with astonishment of heart .

verses.z: 你必在午間摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一樣。你所行的必不亨通，時常遭遇欺壓、搶奪，無人搭救。
verses.e: You will grope at noonday , as the blind gropes in darkness , and you shall not prosper in your ways . You will only be oppressed and robbed always , and there will be no one to save you .

verses.z: 你在城裏必蒙福，在田間也必蒙福。
verses.e: You shall be blessed in the city , and you shall be blessed in the field .

verses.z: 你聘定了妻，別人必與她同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其內；你栽種葡萄園，也不得用其中的果子。
verses.e: You will betroth a wife , and another man shall lie with her . You will build a house , and you won't dwell in it . You will plant a vineyard , and not use its fruit .

verses.z: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃牠的肉；你的驢在你眼前被搶奪，不得歸還；你的羊歸了仇敵，無人搭救。
verses.e: Your ox will be slain before your eyes , and you will not eat any of it . Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face , and will not be restored to you . Your sheep will be given to your enemies , and you will have no one to save you .

verses.z: 你的兒女必歸與別國的民；你的眼目終日切望，甚至失明，你手中無力拯救。
verses.e: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people . Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long . There will be no power in your hand .

verses.z: 你的土產和你勞碌得來的，必被你所不認識的國民吃盡。你時常被欺負，受壓制，
verses.e: A nation which you don't know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work . You will only be oppressed and crushed always ,

verses.z: 甚至你因眼中所看見的，必致瘋狂。
verses.e: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad .

verses.z: 耶和華必攻擊你，使你膝上腿上，從腳掌到頭頂，長毒瘡無法醫治。
verses.e: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil , of which you cannot be healed , from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head .

verses.z: 「耶和華必將你和你所立的王領到你和你列祖素不認識的國去；在那裏你必事奉木頭石頭的神。
verses.e: The LORD will bring you , and your king whom you will set over yourselves , to a nation that you have not known , you nor your fathers . There you will serve other gods of wood and stone .

verses.z: 你在耶和華領你到的各國中，要令人驚駭、笑談、譏誚。
verses.e: You will become an astonishment , a proverb , and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away .

verses.z: 你帶到田間的種子雖多，收進來的卻少，因為被蝗蟲吃了。
verses.e: You will carry much seed out into the field , and will gather little in , for the locust will consume it .

verses.z: 你栽種、修理葡萄園，卻不得收[葡萄]，也不得喝[葡萄]酒，因為被蟲子吃了。
verses.e: You will plant vineyards and dress them , but you will neither drink of the wine , nor harvest , because worms will eat them .

verses.z: 你身所生的，地所產的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必蒙福。
verses.e: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body , the fruit of your ground , the fruit of your animals , the increase of your livestock , and the young of your flock .

verses.z: 你全境有橄欖樹，卻不得其油抹身，因為樹上的橄欖不熟自落了。
verses.e: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders , but you won't anoint yourself with the oil , for your olives will drop off .

verses.z: 你生兒養女，卻不算是你的，因為必被擄去。
verses.e: You will father sons and daughters , but they will not be yours , for they will go into captivity .

verses.z: 你所有的樹木和你地裏的出產必被蝗蟲所吃。
verses.e: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground .

verses.z: 在你中間寄居的，必漸漸上升，比你高而又高；你必漸漸下降，低而又低。
verses.e: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher , and you will come down lower and lower .

verses.z: 他必借給你，你卻不能借給他；他必作首，你必作尾。
verses.e: He will lend to you , and you won't lend to him . He will be the head , and you will be the tail .

verses.z: 這一切咒詛必追隨你，趕上你，直到你滅亡；因為你不聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，不遵守他所吩咐的誡命律例。
verses.e: All these curses will come on you , and will pursue you and overtake you , until you are destroyed , because you didn't listen to the LORD your God's voice , to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you .

verses.z: 這些咒詛必在你和你後裔的身上成為異蹟奇事，直到永遠！
verses.e: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever .

verses.z: 「因為你富有的時候，不歡心樂意地事奉耶和華－你的上帝，
