verses.e: Because you didn't serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart , by reason of the abundance of all things ;

verses.z: 所以你必在飢餓、乾渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和華所打發來攻擊你的仇敵。他必把鐵軛加在你的頸項上，直到將你滅絕。
verses.e: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you , in hunger , in thirst , in nakedness , and in lack of all things . He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you .

verses.z: 「耶和華要從遠方、地極帶一國的民，如鷹飛來攻擊你。這民的言語，你不懂得。
verses.e: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away , from the end of the earth , as the eagle flies : a nation whose language you will not understand ,

verses.z: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必蒙福。
verses.e: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed .

verses.z: 這民的面貌凶惡，不顧恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。
verses.e: a nation of fierce facial expressions , that doesn't respect the elderly , nor show favor to the young .

verses.z: 他們必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所產的，直到你滅亡。你的五穀、新酒，和油，以及牛犢、羊羔，都不給你留下，直到將你滅絕。
verses.e: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground , until you are destroyed . They also won't leave you grain , new wine , oil , the increase of your livestock , or the young of your flock , until they have caused you to perish .

verses.z: 他們必將你困在你各城裏，直到你所倚靠、高大堅固的城牆都被攻塌。他們必將你困在耶和華－你上帝所賜你遍地的各城裏。
verses.e: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land . They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you .

verses.z: 你在仇敵圍困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和華－你上帝所賜給你的兒女之肉。
verses.e: You will eat the fruit of your own body , the flesh of your sons and of your daughters , whom the LORD your God has given you , in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you .

verses.z: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的人必惡眼看他弟兄和他懷中的妻，並他餘剩的兒女；
verses.e: The man who is tender among you , and very delicate , his eye will be evil toward his brother , toward the wife whom he loves , and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining ,

verses.z: 甚至在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中，他要吃兒女的肉，不肯分一點給他的親人，因為他一無所剩。
verses.e: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat , because he has nothing left to him , in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates .

verses.z: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的婦人，是因嬌嫩柔弱不肯把腳踏地的，必惡眼看她懷中的丈夫和她的兒女。
verses.e: The tender and delicate woman among you , who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness , her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves , toward her son , toward her daughter ,

verses.z: 她兩腿中間出來的嬰孩與她所要生的兒女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中將他們暗暗地吃了。
verses.e: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet , and toward her children whom she bears ; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates .

verses.z: 「這書上所寫律法的一切話是叫你敬畏耶和華－你上帝可榮可畏的名。你若不謹守遵行，耶和華就必將奇災，就是至大至長的災，至重至久的病，加在你和你後裔的身上，
verses.e: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that you may fear this glorious and fearful name , THE LORD your God ,
then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful , even great plagues , and of long duration , and severe sicknesses , and of long duration .

verses.z: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。
verses.e: You shall be blessed when you come in , and you shall be blessed when you go out .

verses.z: 也必使你所懼怕、埃及人的病都臨到你，貼在你身上，
verses.e: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt , which you were afraid of ; and they will cling to you .

verses.z: 又必將沒有寫在這律法書上的各樣疾病、災殃降在你身上，直到你滅亡。
verses.e: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law , the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed .

verses.z: 你們先前雖然像天上的星那樣多，卻因不聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，所剩的人數就稀少了。
verses.e: You will be left few in number , even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude , because you didn't listen to the LORD your God's voice .

verses.z: 先前耶和華怎樣喜悅善待你們，使你們眾多，也要照樣喜悅毀滅你們，使你們滅亡；並且你們從所要進去得的地上必被拔除。
verses.e: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good , and to multiply you , so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you . You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess .

verses.z: 耶和華必使你們分散在萬民中，從地這邊到地那邊，你必在那裏事奉你和你列祖素不認識、木頭石頭的神。
verses.e: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples , from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth . There you will serve other gods which you have not known , you nor your fathers , even wood and stone .

verses.z: 在那些國中，你必不得安逸，也不得落腳之地；耶和華卻使你在那裏心中跳動，眼目失明，精神消耗。
verses.e: Among these nations you will find no ease , and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot ; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart , failing of eyes , and pining of soul .

verses.z: 你的性命必懸懸無定；你晝夜恐懼，自料性命難保。
verses.e: Your life will hang in doubt before you . You will be afraid night and day , and will have no assurance of your life .

verses.z: 你因心裏所恐懼的，眼中所看見的，早晨必說，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必說，巴不得到早晨才好。
verses.e: In the morning you will say , " I wish it were evening ! " and at evening you will say , " I wish it were morning ! " for the fear of your heart which you will fear , and for the sights which your eyes will see .

verses.z: 耶和華必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告訴你不得再見的路；在那裏你必賣己身與仇敵作奴婢，卻無人買。」
verses.e: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships , by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again . There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves , and nobody will buy you .

verses.z: 「仇敵起來攻擊你，耶和華必使他們在你面前被你殺敗；他們從一條路來攻擊你，必從七條路逃跑。
verses.e: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you . They will come out against you one way , and will flee before you seven ways .

verses.z: 在你倉房裏，並你手所辦的一切事上，耶和華所命的福必臨到你。耶和華－你上帝也要在所給你的地上賜福與你。
verses.e: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns , and in all that you put your hand to . He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you .

verses.z: 你若謹守耶和華－你上帝的誡命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作為自己的聖民。
verses.e: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself , as he has sworn to you , if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God , and walk in his ways .

verses.z: 這是耶和華在摩押地吩咐摩西與以色列人立約的話，是在他和他們於何烈山所立的約之外。
verses.e: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab , in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb .

verses.z: 「今日，你們的首領、族長、長老、官長、以色列的男丁，你們的妻子兒女，和營中寄居的，以及為你們劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和華－你們的上帝面前，
verses.e: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God : your heads , your tribes , your elders , and your officers , even all the men of Israel ,
your little ones , your wives , and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps , from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water ,

verses.z: 為要你順從耶和華－你上帝今日與你所立的約，向你所起的誓。
verses.e: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God , and into his oath , which the LORD your God makes with you today ,

verses.z: 這樣，他要照他向你所應許的話，又向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的上帝。
verses.e: that he may establish you today as his people , and that he may be your God , as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .

verses.z: 我不但與你們立這約，起這誓，
verses.e: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only ,

verses.z: 凡與我們一同站在耶和華－我們上帝面前的，並今日不在我們這裏的人，我也與他們立這約，起這誓。
verses.e: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God , and also with those who are not here with us today

verses.z: 「我們曾住過埃及地，也從列國經過；這是你們知道的。
verses.e: ( for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt , and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed ;

verses.z: 你們也看見他們中間可憎之物，並他們木、石、金、銀的偶像。
verses.e: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood , stone , silver , and gold , which were among them ) ;

verses.z: 惟恐你們中間，或男或女，或族長或支派長，今日心裏偏離耶和華－我們的上帝，去事奉那些國的神；又怕你們中間有[惡]根生出苦菜和茵蔯來，
verses.e: lest there should be among you man , woman , family , or tribe whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God , to go to serve the gods of those nations ; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison ;

verses.z: 聽見這咒詛的話，心裏仍是自誇說：『我雖然行事心裏頑梗，連累眾人，卻還是平安。』
verses.e: and it happen , when he hears the words of this curse , that he bless himself in his heart , saying , " I shall have peace , though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart , " to destroy the moist with the dry .

verses.z: 摩西召了以色列眾人來，對他們說：「耶和華在埃及地，在你們眼前向法老和他眾臣僕，並他全地所行的一切事，你們都看見了，
verses.e: Moses called to all Israel , and said to them : Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh , and to all his servants , and to all his land ;

verses.z: 耶和華必不饒恕他；耶和華的怒氣與憤恨要向他發作，如煙冒出，將這書上所寫的一切咒詛都加在他身上。耶和華又要從天下塗抹他的名，
verses.e: The LORD will not pardon him , but then the LORD's anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man , and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him , and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky .

verses.z: 也必照着寫在律法書上、約中的一切咒詛將他從以色列眾支派中分別出來，使他受禍。
verses.e: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel , according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law .

verses.z: 你們的後代，就是以後興起來的子孫，和遠方來的外人，看見這地的災殃，並耶和華所降與這地的疾病，
verses.e: The generation to come — your children who will rise up after you , and the foreigner who will come from a far land — will say , when they see the plagues of that land , and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick ,

verses.z: 又看見遍地有硫磺，有鹽鹵，有火跡，沒有耕種，沒有出產，連草都不生長－好像耶和華在忿怒中所傾覆的所多瑪、蛾摩拉、押瑪、洗扁一樣－
verses.e: that all of its land is sulfur , salt , and burning , that it is not sown , doesn't produce , nor does any grass grow in it , like the overthrow of Sodom , Gomorrah , Admah , and Zeboiim , which the LORD overthrew in his anger , and in his wrath .

verses.z: 所看見的人，連萬國人，都必問說：『耶和華為何向此地這樣行呢？這樣大發烈怒是甚麼意思呢？』
verses.e: Even all the nations will say , " Why has the LORD done this to this land ? What does the heat of this great anger mean ? "

verses.z: 人必回答說：『是因這地的人離棄了耶和華－他們列祖的上帝，領他們出埃及地的時候與他們所立的約，
verses.e: Then men will say , " Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD , the God of their fathers , which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt ,

verses.z: 去事奉敬拜素不認識的別神，是耶和華所未曾給他們安排的。
verses.e: and went and served other gods and worshiped them , gods that they didn't know and that he had not given to them .

verses.z: 所以耶和華的怒氣向這地發作，將這書上所寫的一切咒詛都降在這地上。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD's anger burned against this land , to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book .

verses.z: 耶和華在怒氣、忿怒、大惱恨中將他們從本地拔出來，扔在別的地上，像今日一樣。』
verses.e: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger , in wrath , and in great indignation , and thrust them into another land , as it is today . "

verses.z: 「隱祕的事是屬耶和華－我們上帝的；惟有明顯的事是永遠屬我們和我們子孫的，好叫我們遵行這律法上的一切話。」
verses.e: The secret things belong to the LORD our God ; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever , that we may do all the words of this law .

verses.z: 就是你親眼看見的大試驗和神蹟，並那些大奇事。
verses.e: the great trials which your eyes saw , the signs , and those great wonders .

verses.z: 但耶和華到今日沒有使你們心能明白，眼能看見，耳能聽見。
verses.e: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know , eyes to see , and ears to hear , to this day .

verses.z: 我領你們在曠野四十年，你們身上的衣服並沒有穿破，腳上的鞋也沒有穿壞。
verses.e: I have led you forty years in the wilderness . Your clothes have not grown old on you , and your sandals have not grown old on your feet .

verses.z: 你們沒有吃餅，也沒有喝清酒濃酒。這要使你們知道，耶和華是你們的上帝。
verses.e: You have not eaten bread , neither have you drunk wine or strong drink , that you may know that I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你們來到這地方，希實本王西宏、巴珊王噩都出來與我們交戰，我們就擊殺了他們，
verses.e: When you came to this place , Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle , and we struck them .

verses.z: 取了他們的地給呂便支派、迦得支派，和瑪拿西半支派為業。
verses.e: We took their land , and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to the half-tribe of the Manassites .

verses.z: 所以你們要謹守遵行這約的話，好叫你們在一切所行的事上亨通。
verses.e: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them , that you may prosper in all that you do .

verses.z: 「以後，我們轉回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的眾民都出來，在以得來與我們交戰。
verses.e: Then we turned , and went up the way to Bashan . Og the king of Bashan came out against us , he and all his people , to battle at Edrei .

verses.z: 就是奪了平原的各城、基列全地、巴珊全地，直到撒迦和以得來，都是巴珊王噩國內的城邑。（
verses.e: We took all the cities of the plain , and all Gilead , and all Bashan , to Salecah and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan .

verses.z: 利乏音人所剩下的只有巴珊王噩。他的床是鐵的，長九肘，寬四肘，都是以人肘為度。現今豈不是在亞捫人的拉巴嗎？）」
verses.e: ( For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim . Behold , his bedstead was a bedstead of iron . Isn't it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon ? Nine cubits was its length , and four cubits its width , after the cubit of a man . )

verses.z: 「那時，我們得了這地。從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥起，我將基列山地的一半，並其中的城邑，都給了呂便人和迦得人。
verses.e: This land we took in possession at that time : from Aroer , which is by the valley of the Arnon , and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities , I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites ;

verses.z: 其餘的基列地和巴珊全地，就是噩王的國，我給了瑪拿西半支派。亞珥歌伯全地乃是巴珊全地；這叫做利乏音人之地。
verses.e: and the rest of Gilead , and all Bashan , the kingdom of Og , I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh — all the region of Argob , even all Bashan . ( The same is called the land of Rephaim .

verses.z: 瑪拿西的子孫睚珥佔了亞珥歌伯全境，直到基述人和瑪迦人的交界，就按自己的名稱這巴珊地為哈倭特‧睚珥，直到今日。
verses.e: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob , to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites , and called them , even Bashan , after his own name , Havvoth Jair , to this day . )

verses.z: 我又將基列給了瑪吉。
verses.e: I gave Gilead to Machir .

verses.z: 從基列到亞嫩谷，以谷中為界，直到亞捫人交界的雅博河，我給了呂便人和迦得人，
verses.e: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon , the middle of the valley , and its border , even to the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon ;

verses.z: 又將亞拉巴和靠近約旦河之地，從基尼烈直到亞拉巴海，就是鹽海，並毗斯迦山根東邊之地，[都給了他們]。
verses.e: the Arabah also , and the Jordan and its border , from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah , the Salt Sea , under the slopes of Pisgah eastward .

verses.z: 「那時，我吩咐你們說：『耶和華－你們的上帝已將這地賜給你們為業；你們所有的勇士都要帶着兵器，在你們的弟兄以色列人前面過去。
verses.e: I commanded you at that time , saying , " The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it . All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers , the children of Israel .

verses.z: 但你們的妻子、孩子、牲畜（我知道你們有許多的牲畜）可以住在我所賜給你們的各城裏。
verses.e: But your wives , and your little ones , and your livestock , ( I know that you have much livestock ) , shall live in your cities which I have given you ,

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：『不要怕他！因我已將他和他的眾民，並他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像從前待住希實本的亞摩利王西宏一樣。』
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Don't fear him ; for I have delivered him , with all his people and his land , into your hand . You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites , who lived at Heshbon . "

verses.z: 等到你們弟兄在約旦河那邊，也得耶和華－你們上帝所賜給他們的地，又使他們得享平安，與你們一樣，你們才可以回到我所賜給你們為業之地。』
verses.e: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers , as to you , and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan . Then you shall each return to his own possession , which I have given you . "

verses.z: 那時我吩咐約書亞說：『你親眼看見了耶和華－你上帝向這二王所行的；耶和華也必向你所要去的各國照樣行。
verses.e: I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , " Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings . So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over .

verses.z: 你不要怕他們，因那為你爭戰的是耶和華－你的上帝。』」
verses.e: You shall not fear them ; for the LORD your God himself fights for you . "

verses.z: 「那時，我懇求耶和華說：
verses.e: I begged GOD at that time , saying ,

verses.z: 『主耶和華啊，你已將你的大力大能顯給僕人看。在天上，在地下，有甚麼神能像你行事、像你有大能的作為呢？
verses.e: " Lord GOD , you have begun to show your servant your greatness , and your strong hand . For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours , and mighty acts like yours ?

verses.z: 求你容我過去，看約旦河那邊的美地，就是那佳美的山地和黎巴嫩。』
verses.e: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan , that fine mountain , and Lebanon . "

verses.z: 但耶和華因你們的緣故向我發怒，不應允我，對我說：『罷了！你不要向我再提這事。
verses.e: But the LORD was angry with me because of you , and didn't listen to me . The LORD said to me , " That is enough ! Speak no more to me of this matter .

verses.z: 你且上毗斯迦山頂去，向東、西、南、北舉目觀望，因為你必不能過這約旦河。
verses.e: Go up to the top of Pisgah , and lift up your eyes westward , and northward , and southward , and eastward , and see with your eyes ; for you shall not go over this Jordan .

verses.z: 你卻要囑咐約書亞，勉勵他，使他膽壯；因為他必在這百姓前面過去，使他們承受你所要觀看之地。』
verses.e: But commission Joshua , and encourage him , and strengthen him ; for he shall go over before this people , and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see . "

verses.z: 於是我們住在伯‧毗珥對面的谷中。」
verses.e: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor .

verses.z: 於是耶和華－我們的上帝也將巴珊王噩和他的眾民都交在我們手中；我們殺了他們，沒有留下一個。
verses.e: So the LORD our God also delivered into our hand Og , the king of Bashan , and all his people . We struck him until no one was left to him remaining .

verses.z: 那時，我們奪了他所有的城，共有六十座，沒有一座城不被我們所奪。這為亞珥歌伯的全境，就是巴珊地噩王的國。
verses.e: We took all his cities at that time . There was not a city which we didn't take from them : sixty cities , all the region of Argob , the kingdom of Og in Bashan .

verses.z: 這些城都有堅固的高牆，有門有閂。此外還有許多無城牆的鄉村。
verses.e: All these were cities fortified with high walls , gates , and bars , in addition to a great many villages without walls .

verses.z: 我們將這些都毀滅了，像從前待希實本王西宏一樣，把有人煙的各城，連女人帶孩子，盡都毀滅；
verses.e: We utterly destroyed them , as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon , utterly destroying every inhabited city , with the women and the little ones .

verses.z: 惟有一切牲畜和城中的財物都取為自己的掠物。
verses.e: But all the livestock , and the plunder of the cities , we took for plunder for ourselves .

verses.z: 那時，我們從約旦河東兩個亞摩利王的手將亞嫩谷直到黑門山之地奪過來（
verses.e: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan , from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon .

verses.z: 這黑門山，西頓人稱為西連，亞摩利人稱為示尼珥），
verses.e: ( The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion , and the Amorites call it Senir . )

verses.z: 「我所陳明在你面前的這一切咒詛都臨到你身上；你在耶和華－你上帝追趕你到的萬國中必心裏追念祝福的話；
verses.e: It shall happen , when all these things have come on you , the blessing and the curse , which I have set before you , and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you ,

if you will obey the LORD your God's voice , to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law , if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul .

verses.z: 「我今日所吩咐你的誡命不是你難行的，也不是離你遠的；
verses.e: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant .

verses.z: 不是在天上，使你說：『誰替我們上天取下來，使我們聽見可以遵行呢？』
verses.e: It is not in heaven , that you should say , " Who will go up for us to heaven , bring it to us , and proclaim it to us , that we may do it ? "

verses.z: 也不是在海外，使你說：『誰替我們過海取了來，使我們聽見可以遵行呢？』
verses.e: Neither is it beyond the sea , that you should say , " Who will go over the sea for us , bring it to us , and proclaim it to us , that we may do it ? "

verses.z: 這話卻離你甚近，就在你口中，在你心裏，使你可以遵行。
verses.e: But the word is very near to you , in your mouth and in your heart , that you may do it .

verses.z: 「看哪，我今日將生與福，死與禍，陳明在你面前。
verses.e: Behold , I have set before you today life and prosperity , and death and evil .

verses.z: 吩咐你愛耶和華－你的上帝，遵行他的道，謹守他的誡命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人數增多，耶和華－你上帝就必在你所要進去得為業的地上賜福與你。
verses.e: For I command you today to love the LORD your God , to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments , his statutes , and his ordinances , that you may live and multiply , and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it .

verses.z: 倘若你心裏偏離，不肯聽從，卻被勾引去敬拜事奉別神，
verses.e: But if your heart turns away , and you will not hear , but are drawn away and worship other gods , and serve them ,

verses.z: 我今日明明告訴你們，你們必要滅亡；在你過約旦河、進去得為業的地上，你的日子必不長久。
verses.e: I declare to you today that you will surely perish . You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it .

verses.z: 我今日呼天喚地向你作見證；我將生死禍福陳明在你面前，所以你要揀選生命，使你和你的後裔都得存活；
verses.e: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death , the blessing and the curse . Therefore choose life , that you may live , you and your descendants ,

verses.z: 你和你的子孫若盡心盡性歸向耶和華－你的上帝，照着我今日一切所吩咐的聽從他的話；
verses.e: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today , you and your children , with all your heart and with all your soul ,

verses.z: 且愛耶和華－你的上帝，聽從他的話，專靠他；因為他是你的生命，你的日子長久也在乎他。這樣，你就可以在耶和華向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許所賜的地上居住。」
verses.e: to love the LORD your God , to obey his voice , and to cling to him ; for he is your life , and the length of your days , that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give them .

verses.z: 那時，耶和華－你的上帝必憐恤你，救回你這被擄的子民；耶和華－你的上帝要回轉過來，從分散你到的萬民中將你招聚回來。
verses.e: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity , have compassion on you , and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you .

verses.z: 你被趕散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和華－你的上帝也必從那裏將你招聚回來。
verses.e: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens , from there the LORD your God will gather you , and from there he will bring you back .

verses.z: 耶和華－你的上帝必領你進入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得着；又必善待你，使你的人數比你列祖眾多。
verses.e: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed , and you will possess it . He will do you good , and increase your numbers more than your fathers .

verses.z: 耶和華－你上帝必將你心裏和你後裔心裏的污穢除掉，好叫你盡心盡性愛耶和華－你的上帝，使你可以存活。
verses.e: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart , and the heart of your offspring , to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul , that you may live .

verses.z: 耶和華－你的上帝必將這一切咒詛加在你仇敵和恨惡你、逼迫你的人身上。
verses.e: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you , who persecuted you .

verses.z: 你必歸回，聽從耶和華的話，遵行他的一切誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
verses.e: You shall return and obey the LORD's voice , and do all his commandments which I command you today .

verses.z: 你若聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，謹守這律法書上所寫的誡命律例，又盡心盡性歸向耶和華－你的上帝，他必使你手裏所辦的一切事，並你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所產的，都綽綽有餘；因為耶和華必再喜悅你，降福與你，像從前喜悅你列祖一樣。
verses.e: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand , in the fruit of your body , in the fruit of your livestock , and in the fruit of your ground , for good ; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good , as he rejoiced over your fathers ,

verses.z: 摩西去告訴以色列眾人
verses.e: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel .

verses.z: 摩西吩咐他們說：「每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚節的時候，
verses.e: Moses commanded them , saying , " At the end of every seven years , in the set time of the year of release , in the feast of booths ,

verses.z: 以色列眾人來到耶和華－你上帝所選擇的地方朝見他。那時，你要在以色列眾人面前將這律法念給他們聽。
verses.e: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose , you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing .

verses.z: 要招聚他們男、女、孩子，並城裏寄居的，使他們聽，使他們學習，好敬畏耶和華－你們的上帝，謹守、遵行這律法的一切話，
verses.e: Assemble the people , the men and the women and the little ones , and the foreigners who are within your gates , that they may hear , learn , fear the LORD your God , and observe to do all the words of this law ,

verses.z: 也使他們未曾曉得[這律法]的兒女得以聽見，學習敬畏耶和華－你們的上帝，在你們過約旦河要得為業之地，存活的日子，常常這樣行。」
verses.e: and that their children , who have not known , may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God , as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你的死期臨近了；要召約書亞來，你們二人站在會幕裏，我好囑咐他。」於是摩西和約書亞去站在會幕裏。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Behold , your days approach that you must die . Call Joshua , and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting , that I may commission him . " Moses and Joshua went , and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 耶和華在[會]幕裏雲柱中顯現，雲柱停在[會]幕門以上。
verses.e: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud , and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent's door .

verses.z: 耶和華又對摩西說：「你必和你列祖同睡。這百姓要起來，在他們所要去的地上，在那地的人中，隨從外邦神行邪淫，離棄我，違背我與他們所立的約。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Behold , you shall sleep with your fathers . This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them , and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them .

verses.z: 那時，我的怒氣必向他們發作；我也必離棄他們，掩面不顧他們，以致他們被吞滅，並有許多的禍患災難臨到他們。那日他們必說：『這些禍患臨到我們，豈不是因我們的上帝不在我們中間嗎？』
verses.e: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day , and I will forsake them , and I will hide my face from them , and they shall be devoured , and many evils and troubles shall come on them ; so that they will say in that day , ' Haven't these evils come on us because our God is not among us ? '

verses.z: 那時，因他們偏向別神所行的一切惡，我必定掩面不顧他們。
verses.e: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done , in that they have turned to other gods .

verses.z: 現在你要寫一篇歌，教導以色列人，傳給他們，使這歌見證他們的不是；
verses.e: " Now therefore write this song for yourselves , and teach it to the children of Israel . Put it in their mouths , that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel .

verses.z: 說：「我現在一百二十歲了，不能照常出入；耶和華也曾對我說：『你必不得過這約旦河。』
verses.e: He said to them , " I am one hundred twenty years old today . I can no more go out and come in . The LORD has said to me , ' You shall not go over this Jordan . '

verses.z: 因為我將他們領進我向他們列祖起誓應許那流奶與蜜之地，他們在那裏吃得飽足，身體肥胖，就必偏向別神，事奉他們，藐視我，背棄我的約。
verses.e: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers , flowing with milk and honey , and they have eaten and filled themselves , and grown fat , then they will turn to other gods , and serve them , and despise me , and break my covenant .

verses.z: 那時，有許多禍患災難臨到他們，這歌必在他們面前作見證，他們後裔的口中必念誦不忘。我未領他們到我所起誓應許之地以先，他們所懷的意念我都知道了。」
verses.e: It will happen , when many evils and troubles have come on them , that this song will testify before them as a witness ; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants ; for I know their ways and what they are doing today , before I have brought them into the land which I promised them . "

verses.z: 當日摩西就寫了一篇歌，教導以色列人。
verses.e: So Moses wrote this song the same day , and taught it to the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華囑咐嫩的兒子約書亞說：「你當剛強壯膽，因為你必領以色列人進我所起誓應許他們的地；我必與你同在。」
verses.e: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun , and said , " Be strong and courageous ; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them . I will be with you . "

verses.z: 摩西將這律法的話寫在書上，及至寫完了，
verses.e: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book , until they were finished ,

verses.z: 就吩咐抬耶和華約櫃的利未人說：
verses.e: Moses commanded the Levites , who bore the ark of the LORD's covenant , saying ,

verses.z: 「將這律法書放在耶和華－你們上帝的約櫃旁，可以在那裏見證以色列人的不是；
verses.e: " Take this book of the law , and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God's covenant , that it may be there for a witness against you .

verses.z: 因為我知道你們是悖逆的，是硬着頸項的。我今日還活着與你們同在，你們尚且悖逆耶和華，何況我死後呢？
verses.e: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck . Behold , while I am yet alive with you today , you have been rebellious against the LORD . How much more after my death ?

verses.z: 你們要將你們支派的眾長老和官長都招聚了來，我好將這些話說與他們聽，並呼天喚地見證他們的不是。
verses.e: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers , that I may speak these words in their ears , and call heaven and earth to witness against them .

verses.z: 我知道我死後，你們必全然敗壞，偏離我所吩咐你們的道，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，以手所做的惹他發怒；日後必有禍患臨到你們。」
verses.e: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn away from the way which I have commanded you ; and evil will happen to you in the latter days , because you will do that which is evil in the LORD's sight , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands . "

verses.z: 耶和華－你們的上帝必引導你們過去，將這些國民在你們面前滅絕，你們就得他們的地。約書亞必引導你們過去，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: The LORD your God himself will go over before you . He will destroy these nations from before you , and you shall dispossess them . Joshua will go over before you , as the LORD has spoken .

verses.z: 摩西將這一篇歌的話都說與以色列全會眾聽。
verses.e: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song , until they were finished .

verses.z: 耶和華必待他們，如同從前待他所滅絕的亞摩利二王西宏與噩以及他們的國一樣。
verses.e: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og , the kings of the Amorites , and to their land , when he destroyed them .

verses.z: 耶和華必將他們交給你們；你們要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他們。
verses.e: The LORD will deliver them up before you , and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you .

verses.z: 你們當剛強壯膽，不要害怕，也不要畏懼他們，因為耶和華－你的上帝和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。」
verses.e: Be strong and courageous . Don't be afraid or scared of them , for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you . He will not fail you nor forsake you . "

verses.z: 摩西召了約書亞來，在以色列眾人眼前對他說：「你當剛強壯膽！因為，你要和這百姓一同進入耶和華向他們列祖起誓應許所賜之地；你也要使他們承受那地為業。
verses.e: Moses called to Joshua , and said to him in the sight of all Israel , " Be strong and courageous , for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them ; and you shall cause them to inherit it .

verses.z: 耶和華必在你前面行；他必與你同在，必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。」
verses.e: The LORD himself is who goes before you . He will be with you . He will not fail you nor forsake you . Don't be afraid . Don't be discouraged . "

verses.z: 摩西將這律法寫出來，交給抬耶和華約櫃的祭司利未子孫和以色列的眾長老。
verses.e: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi , who bore the ark of the LORD's covenant , and to all the elders of Israel .

verses.z: 諸天哪，側耳，我要說話；願地也聽我口中的言語。
verses.e: Give ear , you heavens , and I will speak . Let the earth hear the words of my mouth .

verses.z: 耶和華遇見他在曠野－荒涼野獸吼叫之地，就環繞他，看顧他，保護他，如同保護眼中的瞳人。
verses.e: He found him in a desert land , in the waste howling wilderness . He surrounded him . He cared for him . He kept him as the apple of his eye .

verses.z: 又如鷹攪動巢窩，在雛鷹以上兩翅搧展，接取雛鷹，背在兩翼之上。
verses.e: As an eagle that stirs up her nest , that flutters over her young , he spread abroad his wings , he took them , he bore them on his feathers .

verses.z: 這樣，耶和華獨自引導他，並無外邦神與他同在。
verses.e: The LORD alone led him . There was no foreign god with him .

verses.z: 耶和華使他乘駕地的高處，得吃田間的土產；又使他從磐石中咂蜜，從堅石中吸油；
verses.e: He made him ride on the high places of the earth . He ate the increase of the field . He caused him to suck honey out of the rock , oil out of the flinty rock ;

verses.z: 也吃牛的奶油，羊的奶，羊羔的脂油，巴珊所出的公綿羊和山羊，與上好的麥子，也喝葡萄汁釀的酒。
verses.e: butter from the herd , and milk from the flock , with fat of lambs , rams of the breed of Bashan , and goats , with the finest of the wheat . From the blood of the grape , you drank wine .

verses.z: 但耶書崙漸漸肥胖，粗壯，光潤，踢跳，[奔跑]，便離棄造他的上帝，輕看救他的磐石；
verses.e: But Jeshurun grew fat , and kicked . You have grown fat . You have grown thick . You have become sleek . Then he abandoned God who made him , and rejected the Rock of his salvation .

verses.z: 敬拜別[神]，觸動上帝的憤恨，行可憎惡的事，惹了他的怒氣。
verses.e: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods . They provoked him to anger with abominations .

verses.z: 所祭祀的鬼魔並非真神，乃是素不認識的神，是近來新興的，是你列祖所不畏懼的。
verses.e: They sacrificed to demons , not God , to gods that they didn't know , to new gods that came up recently , which your fathers didn't dread .

verses.z: 你輕忽生你的磐石，忘記產你的上帝。
verses.e: Of the Rock who became your father , you are unmindful , and have forgotten God who gave you birth .

verses.z: 耶和華看見他的兒女惹動他，就厭惡[他們]，說：
verses.e: The LORD saw and abhorred , because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters .

verses.z: 我的教訓要淋漓如雨；我的言語要滴落如露，如細雨降在嫩草上，如甘霖降在菜蔬中。
verses.e: My doctrine will drop as the rain . My speech will condense as the dew , as the misty rain on the tender grass , as the showers on the herb .

verses.z: 我要向他們掩面，看他們的結局如何。他們本是極乖僻的族類，心中無誠實的兒女。
verses.e: He said , " I will hide my face from them . I will see what their end will be ; for they are a very perverse generation , children in whom is no faithfulness .

verses.z: 他們以那「不算為神」的觸動我的憤恨，以虛無[的神]惹了我的怒氣。我也要以那「不成子民」的觸動他們的憤恨，以愚昧的國民惹了他們的怒氣。
verses.e: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God . They have provoked me to anger with their vanities . I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people . I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation .

verses.z: 因為在我怒中有火燒起，直燒到極深的陰間，把地和地的出產盡都焚燒，山的根基也燒着了。
verses.e: For a fire is kindled in my anger , that burns to the lowest Sheol , devours the earth with its increase , and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire .

verses.z: 我要將禍患堆在他們身上，把我的箭向他們射盡。
verses.e: " I will heap evils on them . I will spend my arrows on them .

verses.z: [他們必]因飢餓消瘦，被炎熱苦毒吞滅。我要打發野獸用牙齒咬他們，並土中腹行的，用毒氣害他們。
verses.e: They shall be wasted with hunger , and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction . I will send the teeth of animals on them , with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust .

verses.z: 外頭有刀劍，內室有驚恐，使人喪亡，使少男、童女、吃奶的、白髮的，[盡都滅絕]。
verses.e: Outside the sword will bereave , and in the rooms , terror on both young man and virgin , the nursing infant with the gray-haired man .

verses.z: 我說，我必將他們分散遠方，使他們的名號從人間除滅。
verses.e: I said that I would scatter them afar . I would make their memory to cease from among men ;

verses.z: 惟恐仇敵惹動我，只怕敵人錯看，說：是我們手的能力，並非耶和華所行的。
verses.e: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy , lest their adversaries should judge wrongly , lest they should say , ' Our hand is exalted ; the LORD has not done all this . ' "

verses.z: 因為以色列民毫無計謀，心中沒有聰明。
verses.e: For they are a nation void of counsel . There is no understanding in them .

verses.z: 惟願他們有智慧，能明白這事，肯思念他們的結局。
verses.e: Oh that they were wise , that they understood this , that they would consider their latter end !

verses.z: 我要宣告耶和華的名；你們要將大德歸與我們的上帝。
verses.e: For I will proclaim the LORD's name . Ascribe greatness to our God !

verses.z: 若不是他們的磐石賣了他們，若不是耶和華交出他們，一人焉能追趕他們千人？二人焉能使萬人逃跑呢？
verses.e: How could one chase a thousand , and two put ten thousand to flight , unless their Rock had sold them , and the LORD had delivered them up ?

verses.z: 據我們的仇敵自己斷定，他們的磐石不如我們的磐石。
verses.e: For their rock is not as our Rock , even our enemies themselves concede .

verses.z: 他們的葡萄樹是所多瑪的葡萄樹，蛾摩拉田園所生的；他們的葡萄是毒葡萄，全掛都是苦的。
verses.e: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom , of the fields of Gomorrah . Their grapes are poison grapes . Their clusters are bitter .

verses.z: 他們的酒是大蛇的毒氣，是虺蛇殘害的惡毒。
verses.e: Their wine is the poison of serpents , the cruel venom of asps .

verses.z: 這不都是積蓄在我這裏，封鎖在我府庫中嗎？
verses.e: " Isn't this laid up in store with me , sealed up among my treasures ?

verses.z: 他們失腳的時候，伸冤報應在我；因他們遭災的日子近了；那要臨在他們身上的必速速來到。
verses.e: Vengeance is mine , and recompense , at the time when their foot slides , for the day of their calamity is at hand . Their doom rushes at them . "

verses.z: 耶和華見他百姓毫無能力，無論困住的、自由的都沒有[剩下]，就必為他們伸冤，為他的僕人後悔。
verses.e: For the LORD will judge his people , and have compassion on his servants , when he sees that their power is gone , that there is no one remaining , shut up or left at large .

verses.z: 他必說：他們的神，他們所投靠的磐石，
verses.e: He will say , " Where are their gods , the rock in which they took refuge ,

verses.z: 就是向來吃他們祭牲的脂油，喝他們奠祭之酒的，在哪裏呢？他可以興起幫助你們，護衛你們。
verses.e: which ate the fat of their sacrifices , and drank the wine of their drink offering ? Let them rise up and help you ! Let them be your protection .

verses.z: 你們如今要知道：我，惟有我是上帝；在我以外並無別神。我使人死，我使人活；我損傷，我也醫治，並無人能從我手中救出來。
verses.e: " See now that I myself am he . There is no god with me . I kill and I make alive . I wound and I heal . There is no one who can deliver out of my hand .

verses.z: 他是磐石，他的作為完全；他所行的無不公平，是誠實無偽的上帝，又公義，又正直。
verses.e: The Rock : his work is perfect , for all his ways are just . A God of faithfulness who does no wrong , just and right is he .

verses.z: 我向天舉手說：我憑我的永生起誓：
verses.e: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare , as I live forever ,

verses.z: 我若磨我閃亮的刀，手掌審判之權，就必報復我的敵人，報應恨我的人。
verses.e: if I sharpen my glittering sword , my hand grasps it in judgment ; I will take vengeance on my adversaries , and will repay those who hate me .

verses.z: 我要使我的箭飲血飲醉，就是被殺被擄之人的血。我的刀要吃肉，乃是仇敵中首領之頭的肉。
verses.e: I will make my arrows drunk with blood . My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives , from the head of the leaders of the enemy . "

verses.z: 你們外邦人當與主的百姓一同歡呼；因他要伸他僕人流血的冤，報應他的敵人，潔淨他的地，救贖他的百姓。
verses.e: Rejoice , you nations , with his people , for he will avenge the blood of his servants . He will take vengeance on his adversaries , and will make atonement for his land and for his people .

verses.z: 摩西和嫩的兒子約書亞去將這歌的一切話說給百姓聽。
verses.e: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people , he and Joshua the son of Nun .

verses.z: 摩西向以色列眾人說完了這一切的話，
verses.e: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel .

verses.z: 又說：「我今日所警教你們的，你們都要放在心上；要吩咐你們的子孫謹守遵行這律法上的話。
verses.e: He said to them , " Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today , which you shall command your children to observe to do , all the words of this law .

verses.z: 因為這不是虛空、與你們無關的事，乃是你們的生命；在你們過約旦河要得為業的地上必因這事日子得以長久。」
verses.e: For it is no vain thing for you , because it is your life , and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land , where you go over the Jordan to possess it . "

verses.z: 當日，耶和華吩咐摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day , saying ,

verses.z: 「你上這亞巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地與耶利哥相對，觀看我所要賜給以色列人為業的迦南地。
verses.e: " Go up into this mountain of Abarim , to Mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab , that is across from Jericho ; and see the land of Canaan , which I give to the children of Israel for a possession .

verses.z: 這乖僻彎曲的世代向他行事邪僻；有這弊病就不是他的兒女。
verses.e: They have dealt corruptly with him . They are not his children , because of their defect . They are a perverse and crooked generation .

verses.z: 你必死在你所登的山上，歸你列祖去，像你哥哥亞倫死在何珥山上，歸他的列祖一樣。
verses.e: Die on the mountain where you go up , and be gathered to your people , as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor , and was gathered to his people ;

verses.z: 因為你們在尋的曠野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中沒有尊我為聖，得罪了我。
verses.e: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh , in the wilderness of Zin ; because you didn't uphold my holiness among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 我所賜給以色列人的地，你可以遠遠地觀看，卻不得進去。」
verses.e: For you shall see the land from a distance ; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel . "

verses.z: 愚昧無知的民哪，你們這樣報答耶和華嗎？他豈不是你的父、將你買來的嗎？他是製造你、建立你的。
verses.e: Is this the way you repay the LORD , foolish and unwise people ? Isn't he your father who has bought you ? He has made you and established you .

verses.z: 你當追想上古之日，思念歷代之年；問你的父親，他必指示你；問你的長者，他必告訴你。
verses.e: Remember the days of old . Consider the years of many generations . Ask your father , and he will show you ; your elders , and they will tell you .

verses.z: 至高者將地業賜給列邦，將世人分開，就照以色列人的數目立定萬民的疆界。
verses.e: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance , when he separated the children of men , he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華的分本是他的百姓；他的產業本是雅各。
verses.e: For the LORD's portion is his people . Jacob is the lot of his inheritance .

verses.z: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先為以色列人所祝的福：
verses.e: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death .

verses.z: 他們要將你的典章教訓雅各，將你的律法教訓以色列。他們要把香焚在你面前，把全牲的燔祭獻在你的壇上。
verses.e: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances , and Israel your law . They shall put incense before you , and whole burnt offering on your altar .

verses.z: 求耶和華降福在他的財物上，悅納他手裏所辦的事。那些起來攻擊他和恨惡他的人，願你刺透他們的腰，使他們不得再起來。
verses.e: LORD , bless his skills . Accept the work of his hands . Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him , of those who hate him , that they not rise again . "

verses.z: 論便雅憫說：耶和華所親愛的必同耶和華安然居住；耶和華終日遮蔽他，也住在他兩肩之中。
verses.e: About Benjamin he said , " The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him . He covers him all day long . He dwells between his shoulders . "

verses.z: 論約瑟說：願他的地蒙耶和華賜福，得天上的寶物、甘露，以及地裏所藏的泉水；
verses.e: About Joseph he said , " His land is blessed by the LORD , for the precious things of the heavens , for the dew , for the deep that couches beneath ,

verses.z: 得太陽所曬熟的美果，月亮所養成的寶物；
verses.e: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun , for the precious things that the moon can yield ,

verses.z: 得上古之山的至寶，永世之嶺的寶物；
verses.e: for the best things of the ancient mountains , for the precious things of the everlasting hills ,

verses.z: 得地和其中所充滿的寶物，並住荊棘中上主的喜悅。願[這些福]都歸於約瑟的頭上，歸於那與弟兄迥別之人的頂上。
verses.e: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness , the good will of him who lived in the bush . Let this come on the head of Joseph , on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers .

verses.z: 他為牛群中頭生的，有威嚴；他的角是野牛的角，用以牴觸萬邦，直到地極。這角是以法蓮的萬萬，瑪拿西的千千。
verses.e: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd . His horns are the horns of the wild ox . With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth . They are the ten thousands of Ephraim . They are the thousands of Manasseh . "

verses.z: 論西布倫說：西布倫哪，你出外可以歡喜。以薩迦啊，在你帳棚裏可以快樂。
verses.e: About Zebulun he said , " Rejoice , Zebulun , in your going out ; and Issachar , in your tents .

verses.z: 他們要將列邦召到山上，在那裏獻公義的祭；因為他們要吸取海裏的豐富，並沙中所藏的珍寶。
verses.e: They will call the peoples to the mountain . There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness , for they will draw out the abundance of the seas , the hidden treasures of the sand . "

verses.z: 他說：耶和華從西奈而來，從西珥向他們顯現，從巴蘭山發出光輝，從萬萬聖者中來臨，從他右手為百姓傳出烈火的律法。
verses.e: He said , " The LORD came from Sinai , and rose from Seir to them . He shone from Mount Paran . He came from the ten thousands of holy ones . At his right hand was a fiery law for them .

verses.z: 論迦得說：使迦得擴張的應當稱頌！迦得住如母獅；他撕裂膀臂，連頭頂也撕裂。
verses.e: About Gad he said , " He who enlarges Gad is blessed . He dwells as a lioness , and tears the arm and the crown of the head .

verses.z: 他為自己選擇頭一段地，因在那裏有設立律法者的分存留。他與百姓的首領同來；他施行耶和華的公義和耶和華與以色列所立的典章。
verses.e: He provided the first part for himself , for the lawgiver's portion was reserved for him . He came with the heads of the people . He executed the righteousness of the LORD , His ordinances with Israel . "

verses.z: 論但說：但為小獅子，從巴珊跳出來。
verses.e: About Dan he said , " Dan is a lion's cub that leaps out of Bashan . "

verses.z: 論拿弗他利說：拿弗他利啊，你足沾恩惠，滿得耶和華的福，可以得西方和南方為業。
verses.e: About Naphtali he said , " Naphtali , satisfied with favor , full of the LORD's blessing , Possess the west and the south . "

verses.z: 論亞設說：願亞設享受多子的福樂，得他弟兄的喜悅，可以把腳蘸在油中。
verses.e: About Asher he said , " Asher is blessed with children . Let him be acceptable to his brothers . Let him dip his foot in oil .

verses.z: 你的門閂是銅的，鐵的。你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。
verses.e: Your bars will be iron and bronze . As your days , so your strength will be .

verses.z: 耶書崙哪，沒有能比上帝的。他為幫助你，乘在天空，顯其威榮，駕行穹蒼。
verses.e: " There is no one like God , Jeshurun , who rides on the heavens for your help , in his excellency on the skies .

verses.z: 永生的上帝是[你的]居所；他永久的膀臂在你以下。他在你前面攆出仇敵，說：毀滅吧。
verses.e: The eternal God is your dwelling place . Underneath are the everlasting arms . He thrust out the enemy from before you , and said , ' Destroy ! '

verses.z: 以色列安然居住；雅各的本源獨居五穀新酒之地。他的天也滴甘露。
verses.e: Israel dwells in safety , the fountain of Jacob alone , In a land of grain and new wine . Yes , his heavens drop down dew .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你是有福的！誰像你這蒙耶和華所拯救的百姓呢？他是你的盾牌，幫助你，是你威榮的刀劍。你的仇敵必投降你；你必踏在他們的高處。
verses.e: You are happy , Israel ! Who is like you , a people saved by the LORD , the shield of your help , the sword of your excellency ? Your enemies will submit themselves to you . You will tread on their high places . "

verses.z: 他疼愛百姓；眾聖徒都在他手中。他們坐在他的腳下，領受他的言語。
verses.e: Yes , he loves the people . All his saints are in your hand . They sat down at your feet . Each receives your words .

verses.z: 摩西將律法傳給我們，作為雅各會眾的產業。
verses.e: Moses commanded us a law , an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob .

verses.z: 百姓的眾首領，以色列的各支派，一同聚會的時候，耶和華在耶書崙中為王。
verses.e: He was king in Jeshurun , when the heads of the people were gathered , all the tribes of Israel together .

verses.z: 願呂便存活，不致死亡；願他人數不致稀少。
verses.e: " Let Reuben live , and not die ; Nor let his men be few . "

verses.z: 為猶大祝福說：求耶和華俯聽猶大的聲音，引導他歸於本族；他曾用手為自己爭戰，你必幫助他攻擊敵人。
verses.e: This is for Judah . He said , " Hear , LORD , the voice of Judah . Bring him in to his people . With his hands he contended for himself . You shall be a help against his adversaries . "

verses.z: 論利未說：[耶和華啊]，你的土明和烏陵都在你的虔誠人那裏。你在瑪撒曾試驗他，在米利巴水與他爭論。
verses.e: About Levi he said , " Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one , whom you proved at Massah , with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah .

verses.z: 他論自己的父母說：我未曾看見；他也不承認弟兄，也不認識自己的兒女。這是因利未人遵行你的話，謹守你的約。
verses.e: He said of his father , and of his mother , ' I have not seen him . ' He didn't acknowledge his brothers , nor did he know his own children ; for they have observed your word , and keep your covenant .

verses.z: 摩西從摩押平原登尼波山，上了那與耶利哥相對的毗斯迦山頂。耶和華把基列全地直到但，
verses.e: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo , to the top of Pisgah , that is opposite Jericho . The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan ,

verses.z: 以後以色列中再沒有興起先知像摩西的。他是耶和華面對面所認識的。
verses.e: Since then , there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses , whom the LORD knew face to face ,

verses.z: 耶和華打發他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣僕，並他的全地，行各樣神蹟奇事，
verses.e: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt , to Pharaoh , and to all his servants , and to all his land ,

verses.z: 又在以色列眾人眼前顯大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。
verses.e: and in all the mighty hand , and in all the awesome deeds , which Moses did in the sight of all Israel .

verses.z: 拿弗他利全地，以法蓮、瑪拿西的地，猶大全地直到西海，
verses.e: and all Naphtali , and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh , and all the land of Judah , to the Western Sea ,

verses.z: 南地和棕樹城耶利哥的平原，直到瑣珥，都指給他看。
verses.e: and the south , and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees , to Zoar .

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「這就是我向亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許之地，說：『我必將這地賜給你的後裔。』現在我使你眼睛看見了，你卻不得過到那裏去。」
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " This is the land which I swore to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , saying , ' I will give it to your offspring . ' I have caused you to see it with your eyes , but you shall not go over there . "

verses.z: 於是，耶和華的僕人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab , according to the LORD's word .

verses.z: 耶和華將他埋葬在摩押地、伯‧毗珥對面的谷中，只是到今日沒有人知道他的墳墓。
verses.e: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor , but no man knows where his tomb is to this day .

verses.z: 摩西死的時候年一百二十歲；眼目沒有昏花，精神沒有衰敗。
verses.e: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died . His eye was not dim , nor his strength gone .

verses.z: 以色列人在摩押平原為摩西哀哭了三十日，為摩西居喪哀哭的日子就滿了。
verses.e: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days , until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended .

verses.z: 嫩的兒子約書亞；因為摩西曾按手在他[頭]上，就被智慧的靈充滿，以色列人便聽從他，照着耶和華吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.e: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom , for Moses had laid his hands on him . The children of Israel listened to him , and did as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 「以色列人哪，現在我所教訓你們的律例典章，你們要聽從遵行，好叫你們存活，得以進入耶和華－你們列祖之上帝所賜給你們的地，承受為業。
verses.e: Now , Israel , listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you , to do them , that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD , the God of your fathers , gives you .

verses.z: 你在何烈山站在耶和華－你上帝面前的那日，耶和華對我說：『你為我招聚百姓，我要叫他們聽見我的話，使他們存活在世的日子，可以學習敬畏我，又可以教訓兒女這樣行。』
verses.e: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb , when the LORD said to me , " Assemble the people to me , and I will make them hear my words , that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth , and that they may teach their children . "

verses.z: 那時你們近前來，站在山下；山上有火焰沖天，並有昏黑、密雲、幽暗。
verses.e: You came near and stood under the mountain . The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky , with darkness , cloud , and thick darkness .

verses.z: 耶和華從火焰中對你們說話，你們只聽見聲音，卻沒有看見形像。
verses.e: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire : you heard the voice of words , but you saw no form ; you only heard a voice .

verses.z: 他將所吩咐你們當守的約指示你們，就是十條誡，並將這誡寫在兩塊石版上。
verses.e: He declared to you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even the ten commandments . He wrote them on two stone tablets .

verses.z: 那時耶和華又吩咐我將律例典章教訓你們，使你們在所要過去得為業的地上遵行。」
verses.e: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances , that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it .

verses.z: 「所以，你們要分外謹慎；因為耶和華在何烈山、從火中對你們說話的那日，你們沒有看見甚麼形像。
verses.e: Be very careful , for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire ,

verses.z: 惟恐你們敗壞自己，雕刻偶像，彷彿甚麼男像女像，
verses.e: lest you corrupt yourselves , and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure , the likeness of male or female ,

verses.z: 或地上走獸的像，或空中飛鳥的像，
verses.e: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth , the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky ,

verses.z: 或地上爬物的像，或地底下水中魚的像。
verses.e: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground , the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth ;

verses.z: 又恐怕你向天舉目觀看，見耶和華－你的上帝為天下萬民所擺列的日月星，就是天上的萬象，自己便被勾引敬拜事奉它。
verses.e: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky , and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars , even all the army of the sky , you are drawn away and worship them , and serve them , which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky .

verses.z: 所吩咐你們的話，你們不可加添，也不可刪減，好叫你們遵守我所吩咐的，就是耶和華－你們上帝的命令。
verses.e: You shall not add to the word which I command you , neither shall you take away from it , that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you .

verses.z: 耶和華將你們從埃及領出來，脫離鐵爐，要特作自己產業的子民，像今日一樣。
verses.e: But the LORD has taken you , and brought you out of the iron furnace , out of Egypt , to be to him a people of inheritance , as it is today .

verses.z: 耶和華又因你們的緣故向我發怒，起誓必不容我過約旦河，也不容我進入耶和華－你上帝所賜你為業的那美地。
verses.e: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes , and swore that I should not go over the Jordan , and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance ;

verses.z: 我只得死在這地，不能過約旦河；但你們必過去得那美地。
verses.e: but I must die in this land . I must not go over the Jordan , but you shall go over and possess that good land .

verses.z: 你們要謹慎，免得忘記耶和華－你們上帝與你們所立的約，為自己雕刻偶像，就是耶和華－你上帝所禁止你做的偶像；
verses.e: Be careful , lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God , which he made with you , and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you .

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你的上帝乃是烈火，是忌邪的上帝。
verses.e: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire , a jealous God .

verses.z: 「你們在那地住久了，生子生孫，就雕刻偶像，彷彿甚麼形像，敗壞自己，行耶和華－你上帝眼中看為惡的事，惹他發怒。
verses.e: When you father children and children's children , and you have been long in the land , and then corrupt yourselves , and make a carved image in the form of anything , and do that which is evil in the LORD your God's sight to provoke him to anger ,

verses.z: 我今日呼天喚地向你們作見證，你們必在過約旦河得為業的地上速速滅盡！你們不能在那地上長久，必盡行除滅。
verses.e: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today , that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it . You will not prolong your days on it , but will utterly be destroyed .

verses.z: 耶和華必使你們分散在萬民中；在他所領你們到的萬國裏，你們剩下的人數稀少。
verses.e: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples , and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away .

verses.z: 在那裏，你們必事奉人手所造的神，就是用木石造成、不能看、不能聽、不能吃、不能聞的神。
verses.e: There you will serve gods , the work of men's hands , wood and stone , which neither see , nor hear , nor eat , nor smell .

verses.z: 但你們在那裏必尋求耶和華－你的上帝。你盡心盡性尋求他的時候，就必尋見。
verses.e: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God , and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul .

verses.z: 耶和華因巴力‧毗珥的事所行的，你們親眼看見了。凡隨從巴力‧毗珥的人，耶和華－你們的上帝都從你們中間除滅了。
verses.e: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor ; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you .

verses.z: 日後你遭遇一切患難的時候，你必歸回耶和華－你的上帝，聽從他的話。
verses.e: When you are in oppression , and all these things have come on you , in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice .

verses.z: 耶和華－你上帝原是有憐憫的上帝；他總不撇下你，不滅絕你，也不忘記他起誓與你列祖所立的約。
verses.e: For the LORD your God is a merciful God . He will not fail you nor destroy you , nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them .

verses.z: 「你且考察在你以前的世代，自上帝造人在世以來，從天這邊到天那邊，曾有何民聽見上帝在火中說話的聲音，像你聽見還能存活呢？這樣的大事何曾有、何曾聽見呢？
verses.e: For ask now of the days that are past , which were before you , since the day that God created man on the earth , and from the one end of the sky to the other , whether there has been anything as great as this thing is , or has been heard like it ?
Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire , as you have heard , and live ?

verses.z: 上帝何曾從別的國中將一國的人民領出來，用試驗、神蹟、奇事、爭戰、大能的手，和伸出來的膀臂，並大可畏的事，像耶和華－你們的上帝在埃及，在你們眼前為你們所行的一切事呢？
verses.e: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation , by trials , by signs , by wonders , by war , by a mighty hand , by an outstretched arm , and by great terrors , according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes ?

verses.z: 這是顯給你看，要使你知道，惟有耶和華－他是上帝，除他以外，再無別神。
verses.e: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God . There is no one else besides him .

verses.z: 他從天上使你聽見他的聲音，為要教訓你，又在地上使你看見他的烈火，並且聽見他從火中所說的話。
verses.e: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice , that he might instruct you . On earth he made you to see his great fire ; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire .

verses.z: 因他愛你的列祖，所以揀選他們的後裔，用大能親自領你出了埃及，
verses.e: Because he loved your fathers , therefore he chose their offspring after them , and brought you out with his presence , with his great power , out of Egypt ;

verses.z: 要將比你強大的國民從你面前趕出，領你進去，將他們的地賜你為業，像今日一樣。
verses.e: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you , to bring you in , to give you their land for an inheritance , as it is today .

verses.z: 所以，今日你要知道，也要記在心上，天上地下惟有耶和華他是上帝，除他以外，再無別神。
verses.e: Know therefore today , and take it to heart , that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath . There is no one else .

verses.z: 惟有你們專靠耶和華－你們上帝的人，今日全都存活。
verses.e: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today .

verses.z: 我今日將他的律例誡命曉諭你，你要遵守，使你和你的子孫可以得福，並使你的日子在耶和華－你上帝所賜的地上得以長久。」
verses.e: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today , that it may go well with you and with your children after you , and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time .

verses.z: 「那時，摩西在約旦河東，向日出之地，分定三座城，
verses.e: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise ,

verses.z: 使那素無仇恨、無心殺了人的，可以逃到這三城之中的一座城，就得存活：
verses.e: that the man slayer might flee there , who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn't hate him in time past , and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live :

verses.z: 為呂便人分定曠野平原的比悉；為迦得人分定基列的拉末；為瑪拿西人分定巴珊的哥蘭。」
verses.e: Bezer in the wilderness , in the plain country , for the Reubenites ; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites ; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites .

verses.z: 摩西在以色列人面前所陳明的律法－
verses.e: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel .

verses.z: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及後所傳給他們的法度、律例、典章；
verses.e: These are the testimonies , and the statutes , and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt ,

verses.z: 在約旦河東伯‧毗珥對面的谷中，在住希實本、亞摩利王西宏之地；這西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及後所擊殺的。
verses.e: beyond the Jordan , in the valley opposite Beth Peor , in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites , who lived at Heshbon , whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt .

verses.z: 他們得了他的地，又得了巴珊王噩的地，就是兩個亞摩利王，在約旦河東向日出之地。
verses.e: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan , the two kings of the Amorites , who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise ;

verses.z: 從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥，直到西雲山，就是黑門山。
verses.e: from Aroer , which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon , even to Mount Siyon ( also called Hermon ) ,

verses.z: 還有約旦河東的全亞拉巴，直到亞拉巴海，靠近毗斯迦山根。
verses.e: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward , even to the sea of the Arabah , under the slopes of Pisgah .

verses.z: 我照着耶和華－我上帝所吩咐的將律例典章教訓你們，使你們在所要進去得為業的地上遵行。
verses.e: Behold , I have taught you statutes and ordinances , even as the LORD my God commanded me , that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it .

verses.z: 所以你們要謹守遵行；這就是你們在萬民眼前的智慧、聰明。他們聽見這一切律例，必說：『這大國的人真是有智慧，有聰明！』
verses.e: Keep therefore and do them ; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say , " Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people . "

verses.z: 哪一大國的人有神與他們相近，像耶和華－我們的上帝、在我們求告他的時候與我們相近呢？
verses.e: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him ?

verses.z: 又哪一大國有這樣公義的律例典章、像我今日在你們面前所陳明的這一切律法呢？
verses.e: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today ?

verses.z: 「你只要謹慎，殷勤保守你的心靈，免得忘記你親眼所看見的事，又免得你一生、這事離開你的心；總要傳給你的子子孫孫。
verses.e: Only be careful , and keep your soul diligently , lest you forget the things which your eyes saw , and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life ; but make them known to your children and your children's children —

verses.z: 摩西將以色列眾人召了來，對他們說：「以色列人哪，我今日曉諭你們的律例典章，你們要聽，可以學習，謹守遵行。
verses.e: Moses called to all Israel , and said to them , " Hear , Israel , the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today , that you may learn them , and observe to do them . "

verses.z: 愛我、守我誡命的，我必向他們發慈愛，直到千代。
verses.e: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments .

verses.z: 「『不可妄稱耶和華－你上帝的名；因為妄稱耶和華名的，耶和華必不以他為無罪。
verses.e: " You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God ; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name .

verses.z: 「『當照耶和華－你上帝所吩咐的守安息日為聖日。
verses.e: " Observe the Sabbath day , to keep it holy , as the LORD your God commanded you .

verses.z: 六日要勞碌做你一切的工，
verses.e: You shall labor six days , and do all your work ;

verses.z: 但第七日是向耶和華－你上帝當守的安息日。[這一日]，你和你的兒女、僕婢、牛、驢、牲畜，並在你城裏寄居的客旅，無論何工都不可做，使你的僕婢可以和你一樣安息。
verses.e: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God , in which you shall not do any work — neither you , nor your son , nor your daughter , nor your male servant , nor your female servant , nor your ox , nor your donkey , nor any of your livestock , nor your stranger who is within your gates ; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you .

verses.z: 你也要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕；耶和華－你上帝用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂將你從那裏領出來。因此，耶和華－你的上帝吩咐你守安息日。
verses.e: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt , and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm . Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day .

verses.z: 「『當照耶和華－你上帝所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，並使你的日子在耶和華－你上帝所賜你的地上得以長久。
verses.e: " Honor your father and your mother , as the LORD your God commanded you , that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you .

verses.z: 「『不可殺人。
verses.e: " You shall not murder .

verses.z: 「『不可姦淫。
verses.e: " You shall not commit adultery .

verses.z: 「『不可偷盜。
verses.e: " You shall not steal .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝在何烈山與我們立約。
verses.e: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .

verses.z: 「『不可作假見證陷害人。
verses.e: " You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor .

verses.z: 「『不可貪戀人的妻子；也不可貪圖人的房屋、田地、僕婢、牛、驢，並他一切所有的。』
verses.e: " You shall not covet your neighbor's wife . Neither shall you desire your neighbor's house , his field , or his male servant , or his female servant , his ox , or his donkey , or anything that is your neighbor's . "

verses.z: 「這些話是耶和華在山上，從火中、雲中、幽暗中，大聲曉諭你們全會眾的；此外並沒有添別的話。他就把這話寫在兩塊石版上，交給我了。」
verses.e: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire , of the cloud , and of the thick darkness , with a great voice . He added no more . He wrote them on two stone tablets , and gave them to me .

verses.z: 「那時，火焰燒山，你們聽見從黑暗中出來的聲音；你們支派中所有的首領和長老都來就近我，
verses.e: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness , while the mountain was burning with fire , you came near to me , even all the heads of your tribes , and your elders ;

verses.z: 說：『看哪，耶和華－我們上帝將他的榮光和他的大能顯給我們看，我們又聽見他的聲音從火中出來。今日我們得見上帝與人說話，人還存活。
verses.e: and you said , " Behold , the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire . We have seen today that God does speak with man , and he lives .

verses.z: 現在這大火將要燒滅我們，我們何必冒死呢？若再聽見耶和華－我們上帝的聲音就必死亡。
verses.e: Now therefore , why should we die ? For this great fire will consume us . If we hear the LORD our God's voice any more , then we shall die .

verses.z: 凡屬血氣的，曾有何人聽見永生上帝的聲音從火中出來，像我們聽見還能存活呢？
verses.e: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire , as we have , and lived ?

verses.z: 求你近前去，聽耶和華－我們上帝所要說的一切話，將他對你說的話都傳給我們，我們就聽從遵行。』
verses.e: Go near , and hear all that the LORD our God shall say , and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you ; and we will hear it , and do it . "

verses.z: 「你們對我說的話，耶和華都聽見了。耶和華對我說：『這百姓的話，我聽見了；他們所說的都是。
verses.e: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me ; and the LORD said to me , " I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you . They have well said all that they have spoken .

verses.z: 惟願他們存這樣的心敬畏我，常遵守我的一切誡命，使他們和他們的子孫永遠得福。
verses.e: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always , that it might be well with them and with their children forever !

verses.z: 這約不是與我們列祖立的，乃是與我們今日在這裏存活之人立的。
verses.e: The LORD didn't make this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us , who are all of us here alive today .

verses.z: 你去對他們說：你們回帳棚去吧！
verses.e: " Go tell them , ' Return to your tents . '

verses.z: 至於你，可以站在我這裏，我要將一切誡命、律例、典章傳給你；你要教訓他們，使他們在我賜他們為業的地上遵行。』
verses.e: But as for you , stand here by me , and I will tell you all the commandments , and the statutes , and the ordinances , which you shall teach them , that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess . "

verses.z: 所以，你們要照耶和華－你們上帝所吩咐的謹守遵行，不可偏離左右。
verses.e: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you . You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left .

verses.z: 耶和華－你們上帝所吩咐你們行的，你們都要去行，使你們可以存活得福，並使你們的日子在所要承受的地上得以長久。」
verses.e: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you , that you may live and that it may be well with you , and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess .

verses.z: 耶和華在山上，從火中，面對面與你們說話－
verses.e: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire ,

verses.z: 那時我站在耶和華和你們中間，要將耶和華的話傳給你們；因為你們懼怕那火，沒有上山－說：
verses.e: ( I stood between the LORD and you at that time , to show you the LORD's word ; for you were afraid because of the fire , and didn't go up onto the mountain ) saying ,

verses.z: 「『我是耶和華－你的上帝，曾將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來。
verses.e: " I am the LORD your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .

verses.z: 「『除了我以外，你不可有別的神。
verses.e: " You shall have no other gods before me .

verses.z: 「『不可為自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚麼[形像]，彷彿上天、下地和地底下、水中的[百物]。
verses.e: " You shall not make a carved image for yourself — any likeness of what is in heaven above , or what is in the earth beneath , or that is in the water under the earth .

verses.z: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因為我耶和華－你的上帝是忌邪的上帝。恨我的，我必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代；
verses.e: You shall not bow yourself down to them , nor serve them , for I , the LORD your God , am a jealous God , visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

verses.z: 「這是耶和華－你們上帝所吩咐教訓你們的誡命、律例、典章，使你們在所要過去得為業的地上遵行，
verses.e: Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the ordinances , which the LORD your God commanded to teach you , that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess ;

verses.z: 「耶和華－你的上帝領你進他向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許給你的地。那裏有城邑，又大又美，非你所建造的；
verses.e: It shall be , when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give you , great and goodly cities which you didn't build ,

verses.z: 有房屋，裝滿各樣美物，非你所裝滿的；有鑿成的水井，非你所鑿成的；還有葡萄園、橄欖園，非你所栽種的；你吃了而且飽足。
verses.e: and houses full of all good things which you didn't fill , and cisterns dug out which you didn't dig , vineyards and olive trees which you didn't plant , and you shall eat and be full ;

verses.z: 那時你要謹慎，免得你忘記將你從埃及地、為奴之家領出來的耶和華。
verses.e: then beware lest you forget the LORD , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .

verses.z: 你要敬畏耶和華－你的上帝，事奉他，指着他的名起誓。
verses.e: You shall fear the LORD your God ; and you shall serve him , and shall swear by his name .

verses.z: 不可隨從別神，就是你們四圍國民的神；
verses.e: You shall not go after other gods , of the gods of the peoples who are around you ,

verses.z: 因為在你們中間的耶和華－你上帝是忌邪的上帝，惟恐耶和華－你上帝的怒氣向你發作，就把你從地上除滅。
verses.e: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God , lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you , and he destroy you from off the face of the earth .

verses.z: 「你們不可試探耶和華－你們的上帝，像你們在瑪撒那樣試探他。
verses.e: You shall not tempt the LORD your God , as you tempted him in Massah .

verses.z: 要留意遵守耶和華－你們上帝所吩咐的誡命、法度、律例。
verses.e: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he has commanded you .

verses.z: 耶和華眼中看為正、看為善的，你都要遵行，使你可以享福，並可以進去得耶和華向你列祖起誓應許的那美地，
verses.e: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD's sight , that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers ,

verses.z: 照耶和華所說的，從你面前攆出你的一切仇敵。
verses.e: to thrust out all your enemies from before you , as the LORD has spoken .

verses.z: 好叫你和你子子孫孫一生敬畏耶和華－你的上帝，謹守他的一切律例誡命，就是我所吩咐你的，使你的日子得以長久。
verses.e: that you might fear the LORD your God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command you — you , your son , and your son's son , all the days of your life ; and that your days may be prolonged .

verses.z: 「日後，你的兒子問你說：『耶和華－我們上帝吩咐你們的這些法度、律例、典章是甚麼意思呢？』
verses.e: When your son asks you in time to come , saying , " What do the testimonies , the statutes , and the ordinances , which the LORD our God has commanded you mean ? "

verses.z: 你就告訴你的兒子說：『我們在埃及作過法老的奴僕；耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及領出來，
verses.e: then you shall tell your son , " We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt . The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand ;

verses.z: 在我們眼前，將重大可怕的神蹟奇事施行在埃及地和法老並他全家的身上，
verses.e: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt , on Pharaoh , and on all his house , before our eyes ;

verses.z: 將我們從那裏領出來，要領我們進入他向我們列祖起誓應許之地，把這地賜給我們。
verses.e: and he brought us out from there , that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he swore to our fathers .

verses.z: 耶和華又吩咐我們遵行這一切律例，要敬畏耶和華－我們的上帝，使我們常得好處，蒙他保全我們的生命，像今日一樣。
verses.e: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes , to fear the LORD our God , for our good always , that he might preserve us alive , as we are today .

verses.z: 我們若照耶和華－我們上帝所吩咐的一切誡命謹守遵行，這就是我們的義了。』」
verses.e: It shall be righteousness to us , if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God , as he has commanded us . "

verses.z: 以色列啊，你要聽，要謹守遵行，使你可以在那流奶與蜜之地得以享福，人數極其增多，正如耶和華－你列祖的上帝所應許你的。
verses.e: Hear therefore , Israel , and observe to do it , that it may be well with you , and that you may increase mightily , as the LORD , the God of your fathers , has promised to you , in a land flowing with milk and honey .

verses.z: 「以色列啊，你要聽！耶和華－我們上帝是獨一的主。
verses.e: Hear , Israel : The LORD is our God . The LORD is one .

verses.z: 你要盡心、盡性、盡力愛耶和華－你的上帝。
verses.e: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart , with all your soul , and with all your might .

verses.z: 我今日所吩咐你的話都要記在心上，
verses.e: These words , which I command you today , shall be on your heart ;

verses.z: 也要殷勤教訓你的兒女。無論你坐在家裏，行在路上，躺下，起來，都要談論。
verses.e: and you shall teach them diligently to your children , and shall talk of them when you sit in your house , and when you walk by the way , and when you lie down , and when you rise up .

verses.z: 也要繫在手上為記號，戴在額上為經文；
verses.e: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand , and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes .

verses.z: 又要寫在你房屋的門框上，並你的城門上。」
verses.e: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates .

verses.z: 「耶和華－你上帝領你進入要得為業之地，從你面前趕出許多國民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七國的民，都比你強大。
verses.e: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it , and casts out many nations before you — the Hittite , the Girgashite , the Amorite , the Canaanite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite — seven nations greater and mightier than you ;

verses.z: 向恨他的人當面報應他們，將他們滅絕。凡恨他的人必報應他們，決不遲延。
verses.e: and repays those who hate him to their face , to destroy them . He will not be slack to him who hates him . He will repay him to his face .

verses.z: 所以，你要謹守遵行我今日所吩咐你的誡命、律例、典章。」
verses.e: You shall therefore keep the commandments , the statutes , and the ordinances which I command you today , to do them .

verses.z: 「你們果然聽從這些典章，謹守遵行，耶和華－你上帝就必照他向你列祖所起的誓守約，施慈愛。
verses.e: It shall happen , because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them , that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers .

verses.z: 他必愛你，賜福與你，使你人數增多，也必在他向你列祖起誓應許給你的地上賜福與你身所生的，地所產的，並你的五穀、新酒，和油，以及牛犢、羊羔。
verses.e: He will love you , bless you , and multiply you . He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground , your grain and your new wine and your oil , the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock , in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you .

verses.z: 你必蒙福勝過萬民；你們的男女沒有不能生養的，牲畜也沒有不能生育的。
verses.e: You will be blessed above all peoples . There won't be male or female barren among you , or among your livestock .

verses.z: 耶和華必使一切的病症離開你；你所知道埃及各樣的惡疾，他不加在你身上，只加在一切恨你的人身上。
verses.e: The LORD will take away from you all sickness ; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt , which you know , on you , but will lay them on all those who hate you .

verses.z: 耶和華－你上帝所要交給你的一切人民，你要將他們除滅；你眼不可顧惜他們。你也不可事奉他們的神，因這必成為你的網羅。
verses.e: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you . Your eye shall not pity them . You shall not serve their gods ; for that would be a snare to you .

verses.z: 「你若心裏說，這些國的民比我更多，我怎能趕出他們呢？
verses.e: If you shall say in your heart , " These nations are more than I ; how can I dispossess them ? "

verses.z: 你不要懼怕他們，要牢牢記念耶和華－你上帝向法老和埃及全地所行的事，
verses.e: you shall not be afraid of them . You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt :

verses.z: 就是你親眼所看見的大試驗、神蹟、奇事，和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂，都是耶和華－你上帝領你出來所用的。耶和華－你上帝必照樣待你所懼怕的一切人民。
verses.e: the great trials which your eyes saw , the signs , the wonders , the mighty hand , and the outstretched arm , by which the LORD your God brought you out . So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid .

verses.z: 耶和華－你上帝將他們交給你擊殺，那時你要把他們滅絕淨盡，不可與他們立約，也不可憐恤他們。
verses.e: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you , and you strike them , then you shall utterly destroy them . You shall make no covenant with them , nor show mercy to them .

verses.z: 並且耶和華－你上帝必打發黃蜂飛到他們中間，直到那剩下而藏躲的人從你面前滅亡。
verses.e: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them , until those who are left , and hide themselves , perish from before you .

verses.z: 你不要因他們驚恐，因為耶和華－你上帝在你們中間是大而可畏的上帝。
verses.e: You shall not be scared of them ; for the LORD your God is among you , a great and awesome God .

verses.z: 耶和華－你上帝必將這些國的民從你面前漸漸趕出；你不可把他們速速滅盡，恐怕野地的獸多起來害你。
verses.e: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little . You may not consume them at once , lest the animals of the field increase on you .

verses.z: 耶和華－你上帝必將他們交給你，大大地擾亂他們，直到他們滅絕了；
verses.e: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you , and will confuse them with a great confusion , until they are destroyed .

verses.z: 又要將他們的君王交在你手中，你就使他們的名從天下消滅。必無一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你將他們滅絕了。
verses.e: He will deliver their kings into your hand , and you shall make their name perish from under the sky . No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them .

verses.z: 他們雕刻的神像，你們要用火焚燒；其上的金銀，你不可貪圖，也不可收取，免得你因此陷入網羅；這原是耶和華－你上帝所憎惡的。
verses.e: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire . You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them , nor take it for yourself , lest you be snared in it ; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God .

verses.z: 可憎的物，你不可帶進家去；不然，你就成了當毀滅的，與那物一樣。你要十分厭惡，十分憎嫌，因為這是當毀滅的物。」
verses.e: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it . You shall utterly detest it . You shall utterly abhor it ; for it is a devoted thing .

verses.z: 不可與他們結親。不可將你的女兒嫁他們的兒子，也不可叫你的兒子娶他們的女兒；
verses.e: You shall not make marriages with them . You shall not give your daughter to his son , nor shall you take his daughter for your son .

verses.z: 因為他必使你兒子轉離不跟從主，去事奉別神，以致耶和華的怒氣向你們發作，就速速地將你們滅絕。
verses.e: For that would turn away your sons from following me , that they may serve other gods . So the LORD's anger would be kindled against you , and he would destroy you quickly .

verses.z: 你們卻要這樣待他們：拆毀他們的祭壇，打碎他們的柱像，砍下他們的木偶，用火焚燒他們雕刻的偶像。
verses.e: But you shall deal with them like this : you shall break down their altars , dash their pillars in pieces , cut down their Asherah poles , and burn their engraved images with fire .

verses.z: 因為你歸耶和華－你上帝為聖潔的民；耶和華－你上帝從地上的萬民中揀選你，特作自己的子民。
verses.e: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God . The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession , above all peoples who are on the face of the earth .

verses.z: 「耶和華專愛你們，揀選你們，並非因你們的人數多於別民，原來你們的人數在萬民中是最少的。
verses.e: The LORD didn't set his love on you nor choose you , because you were more in number than any people ; for you were the fewest of all peoples ;

verses.z: 只因耶和華愛你們，又因要守他向你們列祖所起的誓，就用大能的手領你們出來，從為奴之家救贖你們脫離埃及王法老的手。
verses.e: but because the LORD loves you , and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers , the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage , from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt .

verses.z: 所以，你要知道耶和華－你的上帝，他是上帝，是信實的上帝；向愛他、守他誡命的人守約，施慈愛，直到千代；
verses.e: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God , the faithful God , who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments ,

verses.z: 「我今日所吩咐的一切誡命，你們要謹守遵行，好叫你們存活，人數增多，且進去得耶和華向你們列祖起誓應許的那地。
verses.e: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today , that you may live , and multiply , and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers .

verses.z: 你吃得飽足，就要稱頌耶和華－你的上帝，因他將那美地賜給你了。」
verses.e: You shall eat and be full , and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you .

verses.z: 「你要謹慎，免得忘記耶和華－你的上帝，不守他的誡命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；
verses.e: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God , in not keeping his commandments , his ordinances , and his statutes , which I command you today ;

verses.z: 恐怕你吃得飽足，建造美好的房屋居住，
verses.e: lest , when you have eaten and are full , and have built fine houses and lived in them ;

verses.z: 你的牛羊加多，你的金銀增添，並你所有的全都加增，
verses.e: and when your herds and your flocks multiply , and your silver and your gold is multiplied , and all that you have is multiplied ;

verses.z: 你就心高氣傲，忘記耶和華－你的上帝，就是將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來的，
verses.e: then your heart might be lifted up , and you forget the LORD your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage ;

verses.z: 引你經過那大而可怕的曠野，[那裏]有火蛇、蠍子、乾旱無水之地。他曾為你使水從堅硬的磐石中流出來，
verses.e: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness , with venomous snakes and scorpions , and thirsty ground where there was no water ; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint ;

verses.z: 又在曠野將你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，是要苦煉你，試驗你，叫你終久享福；
verses.e: who fed you in the wilderness with manna , which your fathers didn't know , that he might humble you , and that he might prove you , to do you good at your latter end ;

verses.z: [恐怕]你心裏說：『這貨財是我力量、我能力得來的。』
verses.e: and lest you say in your heart , " My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth . "

verses.z: 你要記念耶和華－你的上帝，因為得貨財的力量是他給你的，為要堅定他向你列祖起誓所立的約，像今日一樣。
verses.e: But you shall remember the LORD your God , for it is he who gives you power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers , as it is today .

verses.z: 你若忘記耶和華－你的上帝，隨從別神，事奉敬拜，你們必定滅亡；這是我今日警戒你們的。
verses.e: It shall be , if you shall forget the LORD your God , and walk after other gods , and serve them and worship them , I testify against you today that you shall surely perish .

verses.z: 你也要記念耶和華－你的上帝在曠野引導你這四十年，是要苦煉你，試驗你，要知道你心內如何，肯守他的誡命不肯。
verses.e: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness , that he might humble you , to test you , to know what was in your heart , whether you would keep his commandments or not .

verses.z: 耶和華在你們面前怎樣使列國的民滅亡，你們也必照樣滅亡，因為你們不聽從耶和華－你們上帝的話。」
verses.e: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you , so you shall perish , because you wouldn't listen to the LORD your God's voice .

verses.z: 他苦煉你，任你飢餓，將你和你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，使你知道，人活着不是單靠食物，乃是靠耶和華口裏所出的一切話。
verses.e: He humbled you , allowed you to be hungry , and fed you with manna , which you didn't know , neither did your fathers know , that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only , but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD's mouth .

verses.z: 這四十年，你的衣服沒有穿破，你的腳也沒有腫。
verses.e: Your clothing didn't grow old on you , neither did your foot swell , these forty years .

verses.z: 你當心裏思想，耶和華－你上帝管教你，好像人管教兒子一樣。
verses.e: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son , so the LORD your God disciplines you .

verses.z: 你要謹守耶和華－你上帝的誡命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。
verses.e: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God , to walk in his ways , and to fear him .

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你上帝領你進入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，從山谷中流出水來。
verses.e: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land , a land of brooks of water , of springs , and underground water flowing into valleys and hills ;

verses.z: 那地有小麥、大麥、葡萄樹、無花果樹、石榴樹、橄欖樹，和蜜。
verses.e: a land of wheat , barley , vines , fig trees , and pomegranates ; a land of olive trees and honey ;

verses.z: 你在那地不缺食物，一無所缺。那地的石頭是鐵，山內可以挖銅。
