verses.e: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity , you shall not lack anything in it ; a land whose stones are iron , and out of whose hills you may dig copper .

verses.z: 「以色列啊，你當聽！你今日要過約旦河，進去趕出比你強大的國民，得着廣大堅固、高得頂天的城邑。
verses.e: Hear , Israel ! You are to pass over the Jordan today , to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself , cities great and fortified up to the sky ,

verses.z: 耶和華把那兩塊石版交給我，是上帝用指頭寫的。版上[所寫的]是照耶和華在大會的日子、在山上、從火中對你們所說的一切話。
verses.e: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God's finger . On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly .

verses.z: 過了四十晝夜，耶和華把那兩塊石版，就是約版，交給我。
verses.e: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets , even the tablets of the covenant .

verses.z: 對我說：『你起來，趕快下去！因為你從埃及領出來的百姓已經敗壞了自己；他們快快地偏離了我所吩咐的道，為自己鑄成了偶像。』
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Arise , get down quickly from here ; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves . They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them . They have made a molten image for themselves ! "

verses.z: 「耶和華又對我說：『我看這百姓是硬着頸項的百姓。
verses.e: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me , saying , " I have seen these people , and behold , they are a stiff-necked people .

verses.z: 你且由着我，我要滅絕他們，將他們的名從天下塗抹，使你的後裔比他們成為更大更強的國。』
verses.e: Leave me alone , that I may destroy them , and blot out their name from under the sky ; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they . "

verses.z: 於是我轉身下山，山被火燒着，兩塊約版在我兩手之中。
verses.e: So I turned and came down from the mountain , and the mountain was burning with fire . The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands .

verses.z: 我一看見你們得罪了耶和華－你們的上帝，鑄成了牛犢，快快地偏離了耶和華所吩咐你們的道，
verses.e: I looked , and behold , you had sinned against the LORD your God . You had made yourselves a molded calf . You had quickly turned away from the way which the LORD had commanded you .

verses.z: 我就把那兩塊版從我手中扔下去，在你們眼前摔碎了。
verses.e: I took hold of the two tablets , and threw them out of my two hands , and broke them before your eyes .

verses.z: 因你們所犯的一切罪，行了耶和華眼中看為惡的事，惹他發怒，我就像從前俯伏在耶和華面前四十晝夜，沒有吃飯，也沒有喝水。
verses.e: I fell down before the LORD , as at the first , forty days and forty nights . I neither ate bread nor drank water , because of all your sin which you sinned , in doing that which was evil in the LORD's sight , to provoke him to anger .

verses.z: 我因耶和華向你們大發烈怒，要滅絕你們，就甚害怕；但那次耶和華又應允了我。
verses.e: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you . But the LORD listened to me that time also .

verses.z: 那民是亞衲族的人，又大又高，是你所知道的；也曾聽見有人指着他們說：『誰能在亞衲族人面前站立得住呢？』
verses.e: a people great and tall , the sons of the Anakim , whom you know , and of whom you have heard say , " Who can stand before the sons of Anak ? "

verses.z: 耶和華也向亞倫甚是發怒，要滅絕他；那時我又為亞倫祈禱。
verses.e: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him . I prayed for Aaron also at the same time .

verses.z: 我把那叫你們犯罪所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，又搗碎磨得很細，以致細如灰塵，我就把這灰塵撒在從山上流下來的溪水中。
verses.e: I took your sin , the calf which you had made , and burned it with fire , and crushed it , grinding it very small , until it was as fine as dust . I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain .

verses.z: 「你們在他備拉、瑪撒、基博羅‧哈他瓦又惹耶和華發怒。
verses.e: At Taberah , at Massah , and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath .

verses.z: 耶和華打發你們離開加低斯‧巴尼亞，說：『你們上去得我所賜給你們的地。』那時你們違背了耶和華－你們上帝的命令，不信服他，不聽從他的話。
verses.e: When the LORD sent you from Kadesh Barnea , saying , " Go up and possess the land which I have given you , " you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God , and you didn't believe him or listen to his voice .

verses.z: 自從我認識你們以來，你們常常悖逆耶和華。
verses.e: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you .

verses.z: 「我因耶和華說要滅絕你們，就在耶和華面前照舊俯伏四十晝夜。
verses.e: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down , because the LORD had said he would destroy you .

verses.z: 我祈禱耶和華說：『主耶和華啊，求你不要滅絕你的百姓。他們是你的產業，是你用大力救贖的，用大能從埃及領出來的。
verses.e: I prayed to the LORD , and said , " Lord GOD , don't destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness , that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand .

verses.z: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，不要想念這百姓的頑梗、邪惡、罪過，
verses.e: Remember your servants , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob . Don't look at the stubbornness of this people , nor at their wickedness , nor at their sin ,

verses.z: 免得你領我們出來的那地之人說，耶和華因為不能將這百姓領進他所應許之地，又因恨他們，所以領他們出去，要在曠野殺他們。
verses.e: lest the land you brought us out from say , ' Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them , and because he hated them , he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness . '

verses.z: 其實他們是你的百姓，你的產業，是你用大能和伸出來的膀臂領出來的。』」
verses.e: Yet they are your people and your inheritance , which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm . "

verses.z: 你今日當知道，耶和華－你的上帝在你前面過去，如同烈火，要滅絕他們，將他們制伏在你面前。這樣，你就要照耶和華所說的趕出他們，使他們速速滅亡。
verses.e: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire . He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you . So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly , as the LORD has spoken to you .

verses.z: 「耶和華－你的上帝將這些國民從你面前攆出以後，你心裏不可說：『耶和華將我領進來得這地是因我的義。』其實，耶和華將他們從你面前趕出去是因他們的惡。
verses.e: Don't say in your heart , after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you , " For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land ; " because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations .

verses.z: 你進去得他們的地，並不是因你的義，也不是因你心裏正直，乃是因這些國民的惡，耶和華－你的上帝將他們從你面前趕出去，又因耶和華要堅定他向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓所應許的話。
verses.e: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land ; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you , and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .

verses.z: 「你當知道，耶和華－你上帝將這美地賜你為業，並不是因你的義；你本是硬着頸項的百姓。
verses.e: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn't give you this good land to possess for your righteousness , for you are a stiff-necked people .

verses.z: 你當記念不忘，你在曠野怎樣惹耶和華－你上帝發怒。自從你出了埃及地的那日，直到你們來到這地方，你們時常悖逆耶和華。
verses.e: Remember , and don't forget , how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness . From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place , you have been rebellious against the LORD .

verses.z: 你們在何烈山又惹耶和華發怒；他惱怒你們，要滅絕你們。
verses.e: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath , and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you .

verses.z: 我上了山，要領受兩塊石版，就是耶和華與你們立約的版。那時我在山上住了四十晝夜，沒有吃飯，也沒有喝水。
verses.e: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets , even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you , then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights . I neither ate bread nor drank water .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷作王、大衛的兒子、傳道者的言語。
verses.e: The words of the Preacher , the son of David , king in Jerusalem :

verses.z: 豈有一件事人能指着說這是新的？[哪知]，在我們以前的世代早已有了。
verses.e: Is there a thing of which it may be said , " Behold , this is new " ? It has been long ago , in the ages which were before us .

verses.z: 已過的[世代]，無人記念；將來的[世代]，後來的人也不記念。
verses.e: There is no memory of the former ; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come , among those that shall come after .

verses.z: 我傳道者在耶路撒冷作過以色列的王。
verses.e: I , the Preacher , was king over Israel in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 我專心用智慧尋求、查究天下所做的一切事，[乃知]上帝叫世人所經練的是極重的勞苦。
verses.e: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky . It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with .

verses.z: 我見日光之下所做的一切事，都是虛空，都是捕風。
verses.e: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun ; and behold , all is vanity and a chasing after wind .

verses.z: 彎曲的，不能變直；缺少的，不能足數。
verses.e: That which is crooked can't be made straight ; and that which is lacking can't be counted .

verses.z: 我心裏議論說：我得了大智慧，勝過我以前在耶路撒冷的眾人，而且我心中多經歷智慧和知識的事。
verses.e: I said to myself , " Behold , I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem . Yes , my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge . "

verses.z: 我又專心察明智慧、狂妄，和愚昧，乃知這也是捕風。
verses.e: I applied my heart to know wisdom , and to know madness and folly . I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind .

verses.z: 因為多有智慧，就多有愁煩；加增知識的，就加增憂傷。
verses.e: For in much wisdom is much grief ; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow .

verses.z: 傳道者說：虛空的虛空，虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。
verses.e: " Vanity of vanities , " says the Preacher ; " Vanity of vanities , all is vanity . "

verses.z: 人一切的勞碌，就是他在日光之下的勞碌，有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun ?

verses.z: 一代過去，一代又來，地卻永遠長存。
verses.e: One generation goes , and another generation comes ; but the earth remains forever .

verses.z: 日頭出來，日頭落下，急歸所出之地。
verses.e: The sun also rises , and the sun goes down , and hurries to its place where it rises .

verses.z: 風往南颳，又向北轉，不住地旋轉，而且返回轉行原道。
verses.e: The wind goes toward the south , and turns around to the north . It turns around continually as it goes , and the wind returns again to its courses .

verses.z: 江河都往海裏流，海卻不滿；江河從何處流，仍歸還何處。
verses.e: All the rivers run into the sea , yet the sea is not full . To the place where the rivers flow , there they flow again .

verses.z: 萬事令人厭煩，人不能說盡。眼看，看不飽；耳聽，聽不足。
verses.e: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering . The eye is not satisfied with seeing , nor the ear filled with hearing .

verses.z: 已有的事後必再有；已行的事後必再行。日光之下並無新事。
verses.e: That which has been is that which shall be , and that which has been done is that which shall be done ; and there is no new thing under the sun .

verses.z: 死蒼蠅使做香的膏油發出臭氣；[這樣]，一點愚昧也能敗壞智慧和尊榮。
verses.e: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor ; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor .

verses.z: 鐵器鈍了，若不將刃磨快，就必多費氣力；但得智慧指教，便有益處。
verses.e: If the ax is blunt , and one doesn't sharpen the edge , then he must use more strength ; but skill brings success .

verses.z: 未行法術以先，蛇若咬人，後行法術也是無益。
verses.e: If the snake bites before it is charmed , then is there no profit for the charmer's tongue .

verses.z: 智慧人的口說出恩言；愚昧人的嘴吞滅自己。
verses.e: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious ; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips .

verses.z: 他口中的言語起頭是愚昧；他話的末尾是奸惡的狂妄。
verses.e: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness ; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness .

verses.z: 愚昧人多有言語，人卻不知將來有甚麼事；他身後的事誰能告訴他呢？
verses.e: A fool also multiplies words . Man doesn't know what will be ; and that which will be after him , who can tell him ?

verses.z: 凡愚昧人，他的勞碌使自己困乏，因為連進城的路，他也不知道。
verses.e: The labor of fools wearies every one of them ; for he doesn't know how to go to the city .

verses.z: 邦國啊，你的王若是孩童，你的群臣早晨宴樂，你就有禍了！
verses.e: Woe to you , land , when your king is a child , and your princes eat in the morning !

verses.z: 邦國啊，你的王若是貴冑之子，你的群臣按時吃喝，為要補力，不為酒醉，你就有福了！
verses.e: Happy are you , land , when your king is the son of nobles , and your princes eat in due season , for strength , and not for drunkenness !

verses.z: 因人懶惰，房頂塌下；因人手懶，房屋滴漏。
verses.e: By slothfulness the roof sinks in ; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks .

verses.z: 設擺筵席是為喜笑。酒能使人快活；錢能叫萬事應心。
verses.e: A feast is made for laughter , and wine makes the life glad ; and money is the answer for all things .

verses.z: 智慧人的心居右；愚昧人的心居左。
verses.e: A wise man's heart is at his right hand , but a fool's heart at his left .

verses.z: 你不可咒詛君王，也不可心懷此念；在你臥房也不可咒詛富戶。因為空中的鳥必傳揚這聲音，有翅膀的也必述說這事。
verses.e: Don't curse the king , no , not in your thoughts ; and don't curse the rich in your bedroom , for a bird of the sky may carry your voice , and that which has wings may tell the matter .

verses.z: 並且愚昧人行路顯出無知，對眾人說，他是愚昧人。
verses.e: Yes also when the fool walks by the way , his understanding fails him , and he says to everyone that he is a fool .

verses.z: 掌權者的心若向你發怒，不要離開你的本位，因為柔和能免大過。
verses.e: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you , don't leave your place ; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest .

verses.z: 我見日光之下有一件禍患，似乎出於掌權的錯誤，
verses.e: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler .

verses.z: 就是愚昧人立在高位；富足人坐在低位。
verses.e: Folly is set in great dignity , and the rich sit in a low place .

verses.z: 我見過僕人騎馬，王子像僕人在地上步行。
verses.e: I have seen servants on horses , and princes walking like servants on the earth .

verses.z: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中；拆牆垣的，必為蛇所咬。
verses.e: He who digs a pit may fall into it ; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake .

verses.z: 鑿開石頭的，必受損傷；劈開木頭的，必遭危險。
verses.e: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them . Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it .

verses.z: 當將你的糧食撒在水面，因為日久必能得着。
verses.e: Cast your bread on the waters ; for you shall find it after many days .

verses.z: 所以，你當從心中除掉愁煩，從肉體克去邪惡；因為一生的開端和幼年之時，都是虛空的。
verses.e: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart , and put away evil from your flesh ; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity .

verses.z: 你要分給七人，或分給八人，因為你不知道將來有甚麼災禍臨到地上。
verses.e: Give a portion to seven , yes , even to eight ; for you don't know what evil will be on the earth .

verses.z: 雲若滿了雨，就必傾倒在地上。樹若向南倒，或向北倒，樹倒在何處，就存在何處。
verses.e: If the clouds are full of rain , they empty themselves on the earth ; and if a tree falls toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falls , there shall it be .

verses.z: 看風的，必不撒種；望雲的，必不收割。
verses.e: He who observes the wind won't sow ; and he who regards the clouds won't reap .

verses.z: 風從何道來，骨頭在懷孕婦人的胎中如何長成，你尚且不得知道；這樣，行萬事之上帝的作為，你更不得知道。
verses.e: As you don't know what is the way of the wind , nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child ; even so you don't know the work of God who does all .

verses.z: 早晨要撒你的種，晚上也不要歇你的手，因為你不知道哪一樣發旺；或是早撒的，或是晚撒的，或是兩樣都好。
verses.e: In the morning sow your seed , and in the evening don't withhold your hand ; for you don't know which will prosper , whether this or that , or whether they both will be equally good .

verses.z: 光本是佳美的，眼見日光也是可悅的。
verses.e: Truly the light is sweet , and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun .

verses.z: 人活多年，就當快樂多年；然而也當想到黑暗的日子。因為這日子必多，所要來的都是虛空。
verses.e: Yes , if a man lives many years , let him rejoice in them all ; but let him remember the days of darkness , for they shall be many . All that comes is vanity .

verses.z: 少年人哪，你在幼年時當快樂。在幼年的日子，使你的心歡暢，行你心所願行的，看你眼所愛看的；卻要知道，為這一切的事，上帝必審問你。
verses.e: Rejoice , young man , in your youth , and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth , and walk in the ways of your heart , and in the sight of your eyes ; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment .

verses.z: 你趁着年幼、衰敗的日子尚未來到，就是你所說，我毫無喜樂的那些年日未曾臨近之先，當記念造你的主。
verses.e: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth , before the evil days come , and the years draw near , when you will say , " I have no pleasure in them ; "

verses.z: 傳道者專心尋求可喜悅的言語，是憑正直寫的誠實話。
verses.e: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words , and that which was written blamelessly , words of truth .

verses.z: 智慧人的言語好像刺棍；會中之師的[言語]又像釘穩的釘子，都是一個牧者所賜的。
verses.e: The words of the wise are like goads ; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies , which are given from one shepherd .

verses.z: 我兒，還有一層，你當受勸戒：著書多，沒有窮盡；讀書多，身體疲倦。
verses.e: Furthermore , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .

verses.z: 這些事都已聽見了，總意就是：敬畏上帝，謹守他的誡命，這是人所當盡的[本分]。
verses.e: This is the end of the matter . All has been heard . Fear God and keep his commandments ; for this is the whole duty of man .

verses.z: 因為人所做的事，連一切隱藏的事，無論是善是惡，上帝都必審問。
verses.e: For God will bring every work into judgment , with every hidden thing , whether it is good , or whether it is evil .

verses.z: 不要等到日頭、光明、月亮、星宿變為黑暗，雨後雲彩反回，
verses.e: Before the sun , the light , the moon , and the stars are darkened , and the clouds return after the rain ;

verses.z: 看守房屋的發顫，有力的屈身，推磨的稀少就止息，從窗戶往外看的都昏暗；
verses.e: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble , and the strong men shall bow themselves , and the grinders cease because they are few , and those who look out of the windows are darkened ,

verses.z: 街門關閉，推磨的響聲微小，雀鳥一叫，人就起來，唱歌的女子也都衰微。
verses.e: and the doors shall be shut in the street ; when the sound of the grinding is low , and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird , and all the daughters of music shall be brought low ;

verses.z: 人怕高處，路上有驚慌，杏樹開花，蚱蜢成為重擔，人所願的也都廢掉；因為人歸他永遠的家，弔喪的在街上往來。
verses.e: yes , they shall be afraid of heights , and terrors will be on the way ; and the almond tree shall blossom , and the grasshopper shall be a burden , and desire shall fail ; because man goes to his everlasting home , and the mourners go about the streets ;

verses.z: 銀鍊折斷，金罐破裂，瓶子在泉旁損壞，水輪在井口破爛，
verses.e: before the silver cord is severed , or the golden bowl is broken , or the pitcher is broken at the spring , or the wheel broken at the cistern ,

verses.z: 塵土仍歸於地，靈仍歸於賜靈的上帝。
verses.e: and the dust returns to the earth as it was , and the spirit returns to God who gave it .

verses.z: 傳道者說：「虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。」
verses.e: " Vanity of vanities , " says the Preacher . " All is vanity ! "

verses.z: 再者，傳道者因有智慧，仍將知識教訓眾人；又默想，又考查，又陳說許多箴言。
verses.e: Further , because the Preacher was wise , he still taught the people knowledge . Yes , he pondered , sought out , and set in order many proverbs .

verses.z: 我心裏說：「來吧，我以喜樂試試你，你好享福！」誰知，這也是虛空。
verses.e: I said in my heart , " Come now , I will test you with mirth ; therefore enjoy pleasure ; " and behold , this also was vanity .

verses.z: 凡我眼所求的，我沒有留下不給它的；我心所樂的，我沒有禁止不享受的；因我的心為我一切所勞碌的快樂，這就是我從勞碌中所得的分。
verses.e: Whatever my eyes desired , I didn't keep from them . I didn't withhold my heart from any joy , for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor , and this was my portion from all my labor .

verses.z: 後來，我察看我手所經營的一切事和我勞碌所成的功。誰知都是虛空，都是捕風；在日光之下毫無益處。
verses.e: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked , and at the labor that I had labored to do ; and behold , all was vanity and a chasing after wind , and there was no profit under the sun .

verses.z: 我轉念觀看智慧、狂妄，和愚昧。在王以後而來的人還能做甚麼呢？也不過行早先所行的就是了。
verses.e: I turned myself to consider wisdom , madness , and folly ; for what can the king's successor do ? Just that which has been done long ago .

verses.z: 我便看出智慧勝過愚昧，如同光明勝過黑暗。
verses.e: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly , as far as light excels darkness .

verses.z: 智慧人的眼目光明，愚昧人在黑暗裏行。我卻看明有一件事，這兩等人都必遇見。
verses.e: The wise man's eyes are in his head , and the fool walks in darkness — and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all .

verses.z: 我就心裏說：「愚昧人所遇見的，我也必遇見，我為何更有智慧呢？」我心裏說，這也是虛空。
verses.e: Then I said in my heart , " As it happens to the fool , so will it happen even to me ; and why was I then more wise ? " Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity .

verses.z: 智慧人和愚昧人一樣，永遠無人記念，因為日後都被忘記；可歎智慧人死亡，與愚昧人無異。
verses.e: For of the wise man , even as of the fool , there is no memory forever , since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten . Indeed , the wise man must die just like the fool !

verses.z: 我所以恨惡生命；因為在日光之下所行的事我都以為煩惱，都是虛空，都是捕風。
verses.e: So I hated life , because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me ; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind .

verses.z: 我恨惡一切的勞碌，就是我在日光之下的勞碌，因為我得來的必留給我以後的人。
verses.e: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun , because I must leave it to the man who comes after me .

verses.z: 那人是智慧是愚昧，誰能知道？他竟要管理我勞碌所得的，就是我在日光之下用智慧所得的。這也是虛空。
verses.e: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool ? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored , and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun . This also is vanity .

verses.z: 我指嬉笑說：「這是狂妄。」論喜樂說：「有何功效呢？」
verses.e: I said of laughter , " It is foolishness ; " and of mirth , " What does it accomplish ? "

verses.z: 故此，我轉想我在日光之下所勞碌的一切工作，心便絕望。
verses.e: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun .

verses.z: 因為有人用智慧、知識、靈巧所勞碌得來的，卻要留給未曾勞碌的人為分。這也是虛空，也是大患。
verses.e: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom , with knowledge , and with skillfulness ; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it . This also is vanity and a great evil .

verses.z: 人在日光之下勞碌累心，在他一切的勞碌上得着甚麼呢？
verses.e: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart , in which he labors under the sun ?

verses.z: 因為他日日憂慮，他的勞苦成為愁煩，連夜間心也不安。這也是虛空。
verses.e: For all his days are sorrows , and his travail is grief ; yes , even in the night his heart takes no rest . This also is vanity .

verses.z: 人莫強如吃喝，且在勞碌中享福，我看這也是出於上帝的手。
verses.e: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink , and make his soul enjoy good in his labor . This also I saw , that it is from the hand of God .

verses.z: 論到吃用、享福，誰能勝過我呢？
verses.e: For who can eat , or who can have enjoyment , more than I ?

verses.z: 上帝喜悅誰，就給誰智慧、知識，和喜樂；惟有罪人，上帝使他勞苦，叫他將所收聚的、所堆積的歸給上帝所喜悅的人。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
verses.e: For to the man who pleases him , God gives wisdom , knowledge , and joy ; but to the sinner he gives travail , to gather and to heap up , that he may give to him who pleases God . This also is vanity and a chasing after wind .

verses.z: 我心裏察究，如何用酒使我肉體舒暢，我心卻仍以智慧引導[我]；又如何持住愚昧，等我看明世人，在天下一生當行何事為美。
verses.e: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine , my heart yet guiding me with wisdom , and how to lay hold of folly , until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives .

verses.z: 我為自己動大工程，建造房屋，栽種葡萄園，
verses.e: I made myself great works . I built myself houses . I planted myself vineyards .

verses.z: 修造園囿，在其中栽種各樣果木樹；
verses.e: I made myself gardens and parks , and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit .

verses.z: 挖造水池，用以澆灌嫩小的樹木。
verses.e: I made myself pools of water , to water the forest where trees were grown .

verses.z: 我買了僕婢，也有生在家中的僕婢；又有許多牛群羊群，勝過以前在耶路撒冷眾人所有的。
verses.e: I bought male servants and female servants , and had servants born in my house . I also had great possessions of herds and flocks , above all who were before me in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 我又為自己積蓄金銀和君王的財寶，並各省的財寶；又得唱歌的男女和世人所喜愛的物，並許多的妃嬪。
verses.e: I also gathered silver and gold for myself , and the treasure of kings and of the provinces . I got myself male and female singers , and the delights of the sons of men : musical instruments of all sorts .

verses.z: 這樣，我就日見昌盛，勝過以前在耶路撒冷的眾人。我的智慧仍然存留。
verses.e: So I was great , and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem . My wisdom also remained with me .

verses.z: 凡事都有定期，天下萬務都有定時。
verses.e: For everything there is a season , and a time for every purpose under heaven :

verses.z: 我見上帝叫世人勞苦，使他們在其中受經練。
verses.e: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with .

verses.z: 上帝造萬物，各按其時成為美好，又將永生安置在世人心裏。然而上帝從始至終的作為，人不能參透。
verses.e: He has made everything beautiful in its time . He has also set eternity in their hearts , yet so that man can't find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end .

verses.z: 我知道世人，莫強如終身喜樂行善；
verses.e: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice , and to do good as long as they live .

verses.z: 並且人人吃喝，在他一切勞碌中享福，這也是上帝的恩賜。
verses.e: Also that every man should eat and drink , and enjoy good in all his labor , is the gift of God .

verses.z: 我知道上帝一切所做的都必永存；無所增添，無所減少。上帝這樣行，是要人在他面前存敬畏的心。
verses.e: I know that whatever God does , it shall be forever . Nothing can be added to it , nor anything taken from it ; and God has done it , that men should fear before him .

verses.z: 現今的事早先就有了，將來的事早已也有了，並且上帝使已過的事重新再來。
verses.e: That which is has been long ago , and that which is to be has been long ago . God seeks again that which is passed away .

verses.z: 我又見日光之下，在審判之處有奸惡，在公義之處也有奸惡。
verses.e: Moreover I saw under the sun , in the place of justice , that wickedness was there ; and in the place of righteousness , that wickedness was there .

verses.z: 我心裏說，上帝必審判義人和惡人；因為在那裏，各樣事務，一切工作，都有定時。
verses.e: I said in my heart , " God will judge the righteous and the wicked ; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work . "

verses.z: 我心裏說，[這乃]為世人的緣故，是上帝要試驗他們，使他們覺得自己[不過像]獸一樣。
verses.e: I said in my heart , " As for the sons of men , God tests them , so that they may see that they themselves are like animals .

verses.z: 因為世人遭遇的，獸也遭遇，所遭遇的都是一樣：這個怎樣死，那個也怎樣死，氣息都是一樣。人不能強於獸，都是虛空。
verses.e: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals . Even one thing happens to them . As the one dies , so the other dies . Yes , they have all one breath ; and man has no advantage over the animals , for all is vanity .

verses.z: 生有時，死有時；栽種有時，拔出所栽種的也有時；
verses.e: a time to be born , and a time to die ; a time to plant , and a time to pluck up that which is planted ;

verses.z: 都歸一處，都是出於塵土，也都歸於塵土。
verses.e: All go to one place . All are from the dust , and all turn to dust again .

verses.z: 誰知道人的靈是往上升，獸的魂是下入地呢？
verses.e: Who knows the spirit of man , whether it goes upward , and the spirit of the animal , whether it goes downward to the earth ? "

verses.z: 故此，我見人莫強如在他經營的事上喜樂，因為這是他的分。他身後的事誰能使他回來得見呢？
verses.e: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works , for that is his portion ; for who can bring him to see what will be after him ?

verses.z: 殺戮有時，醫治有時；拆毀有時，建造有時；
verses.e: a time to kill , and a time to heal ; a time to break down , and a time to build up ;

verses.z: 哭有時，笑有時；哀慟有時，跳舞有時；
verses.e: a time to weep , and a time to laugh ; a time to mourn , and a time to dance ;

verses.z: 拋擲石頭有時，堆聚石頭有時；懷抱有時，不懷抱有時；
verses.e: a time to cast away stones , and a time to gather stones together ; a time to embrace , and a time to refrain from embracing ;

verses.z: 尋找有時，失落有時；保守有時，捨棄有時；
verses.e: a time to seek , and a time to lose ; a time to keep , and a time to cast away ;

verses.z: 撕裂有時，縫補有時；靜默有時，言語有時；
verses.e: a time to tear , and a time to sew ; a time to keep silence , and a time to speak ;

verses.z: 喜愛有時，恨惡有時；爭戰有時，和好有時。
verses.e: a time to love , and a time to hate ; a time for war , and a time for peace .

verses.z: [這樣看來]，做事的人在他的勞碌上有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors ?

verses.z: 我又轉念，見日光之下所行的一切欺壓。看哪，受欺壓的流淚，且無人安慰；欺壓他們的有勢力，也無人安慰他們。
verses.e: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun : and behold , the tears of those who were oppressed , and they had no comforter ; and on the side of their oppressors there was power ; but they had no comforter .

verses.z: 若是跌倒，這人可以扶起他的同伴；若是孤身跌倒，沒有別人扶起他來，這人就有禍了。
verses.e: For if they fall , the one will lift up his fellow ; but woe to him who is alone when he falls , and doesn't have another to lift him up .

verses.z: 再者，二人同睡就都暖和，一人獨睡怎能暖和呢？
verses.e: Again , if two lie together , then they have warmth ; but how can one keep warm alone ?

verses.z: 有人攻勝孤身一人，若有二人便能敵擋他；三股合成的繩子不容易折斷。
verses.e: If a man prevails against one who is alone , two shall withstand him ; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken .

verses.z: 貧窮而有智慧的少年人勝過年老不肯納諫的愚昧王。
verses.e: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn't know how to receive admonition any more .

verses.z: 這人是從監牢中出來作王，在他國中，生來原是貧窮的。
verses.e: For out of prison he came out to be king ; yes , even in his kingdom he was born poor .

verses.z: 我見日光之下一切行動的活人都隨從那第二位，就是起來代替老王的少年人。
verses.e: I saw all the living who walk under the sun , that they were with the youth , the other , who succeeded him .

verses.z: 他所治理的眾人就是他的百姓，多得無數；在他後來的人尚且不喜悅他。這真是虛空，也是捕風。
verses.e: There was no end of all the people , even of all them over whom he was — yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him . Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind .

verses.z: 因此，我讚歎那早已死的死人，勝過那還活着的活人。
verses.e: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive .

verses.z: 並且我以為那未曾生的，就是未見過日光之下惡事的，比這兩等人更強。
verses.e: Yes , better than them both is him who has not yet been , who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .

verses.z: 我又見人為一切的勞碌和各樣靈巧的工作就被鄰舍嫉妒。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
verses.e: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man's neighbor . This also is vanity and a striving after wind .

verses.z: 愚昧人抱着手，吃自己的肉。
verses.e: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself .

verses.z: 滿了一把，得享安靜，強如滿了兩把，勞碌捕風。
verses.e: Better is a handful , with quietness , than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind .

verses.z: 我又轉念，見日光之下有一件虛空的事：
verses.e: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun .

verses.z: 有人孤單無二，無子無兄，竟勞碌不息，眼目也不以錢財為足。[他說]：「我勞勞碌碌，刻苦自己，不享福樂，到底是為誰呢？」這也是虛空，是極重的勞苦。
verses.e: There is one who is alone , and he has neither son nor brother . There is no end to all of his labor , neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth . " For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment ? " This also is vanity . Yes , it is a miserable business .

verses.z: 兩個人總比一個人好，因為二人勞碌同得美好的果效。
verses.e: Two are better than one , because they have a good reward for their labor .

verses.z: 你到上帝的殿要謹慎腳步；因為近前聽，勝過愚昧人獻祭，他們本不知道所做的是惡。
verses.e: Guard your steps when you go to God's house ; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools , for they don't know that they do evil .

verses.z: 貪愛銀子的，不因得銀子知足；貪愛豐富的，也不因得利益知足。這也是虛空。
verses.e: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver , nor he who loves abundance , with increase . This also is vanity .

verses.z: 貨物增添，吃的人也增添，物主得甚麼益處呢？不過眼看而已！
verses.e: When goods increase , those who eat them are increased ; and what advantage is there to its owner , except to feast on them with his eyes ?

verses.z: 勞碌的人不拘吃多吃少，睡得香甜；富足人的豐滿卻不容他睡覺。
verses.e: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet , whether he eats little or much ; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep .

verses.z: 我見日光之下有一宗大禍患，就是財主積存資財，反害自己。
verses.e: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun : wealth kept by its owner to his harm .

verses.z: 因遭遇禍患，這些資財就消滅；那人若生了兒子，手裏也一無所有。
verses.e: Those riches perish by misfortune , and if he has fathered a son , there is nothing in his hand .

verses.z: 他怎樣從母胎赤身而來，也必照樣赤身而去；他所勞碌得來的，手中分毫不能帶去。
verses.e: As he came out of his mother's womb , naked shall he go again as he came , and shall take nothing for his labor , which he may carry away in his hand .

verses.z: 他來的情形怎樣，他去的情形也怎樣。這也是一宗大禍患。他為風勞碌有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: This also is a grievous evil , that in all points as he came , so shall he go . And what profit does he have who labors for the wind ?

verses.z: 並且他終身在黑暗中吃喝，多有煩惱，又有病患嘔氣。
verses.e: All his days he also eats in darkness , he is frustrated , and has sickness and wrath .

verses.z: 我所見為善為美的，就是人在上帝賜他一生的日子吃喝，享受日光之下勞碌得來的好處，因為這是他的分。
verses.e: Behold , that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink , and to enjoy good in all his labor , in which he labors under the sun , all the days of his life which God has given him ; for this is his portion .

verses.z: 上帝賜人資財豐富，使他能以吃用，能取自己的分，在他勞碌中喜樂，這乃是上帝的恩賜。
verses.e: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth , and has given him power to eat of it , and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labor — this is the gift of God .

verses.z: 你在上帝面前不可冒失開口，也不可心急發言；因為上帝在天上，你在地下，所以你的言語要寡少。
verses.e: Don't be rash with your mouth , and don't let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God ; for God is in heaven , and you on earth . Therefore let your words be few .

verses.z: 他不多思念自己一生的年日，因為上帝應他的心使他喜樂。
verses.e: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life , because God occupies him with the joy of his heart .

verses.z: 事務多，就令人做夢；言語多，就顯出愚昧。
verses.e: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares , so a fool's speech with a multitude of words .

verses.z: 你向上帝許願，償還不可遲延，因他不喜悅愚昧人，所以你許的願應當償還。
verses.e: When you vow a vow to God , don't defer to pay it ; for he has no pleasure in fools . Pay that which you vow .

verses.z: 你許願不還，不如不許。
verses.e: It is better that you should not vow , than that you should vow and not pay .

verses.z: 不可任你的口使肉體犯罪，也不可在祭司面前說是錯許了。為何使上帝因你的聲音發怒，敗壞你手所做的呢？
verses.e: Don't allow your mouth to lead you into sin . Don't protest before the messenger that this was a mistake . Why should God be angry at your voice , and destroy the work of your hands ?

verses.z: 多夢和多言，其中多有虛幻，你只要敬畏上帝。
verses.e: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities , as well as in many words ; but you must fear God .

verses.z: 你若在一省之中見窮人受欺壓，並奪去公義公平的事，不要因此詫異；因有一位高過居高位的鑒察，在他們以上還有更高的。
verses.e: If you see the oppression of the poor , and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district , don't marvel at the matter , for one official is eyed by a higher one , and there are officials over them .

verses.z: 況且地的益處歸眾人，就是君王也受田地的供應。
verses.e: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all . The king profits from the field .

verses.z: 我見日光之下有一宗禍患重壓在人身上，
verses.e: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , and it is heavy on men :

verses.z: 先前所有的，早已起了名，並知道何為人，他也不能與那比自己力大的相爭。
verses.e: Whatever has been , its name was given long ago ; and it is known what man is ; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he .

verses.z: 加增虛浮的事既多，這與人有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: For there are many words that create vanity . What does that profit man ?

verses.z: 人一生虛度的日子，就如影兒經過，誰知道甚麼與他有益呢？誰能告訴他身後在日光之下有甚麼事呢？
verses.e: For who knows what is good for man in life , all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow ? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun ?

verses.z: 就是人蒙上帝賜他資財、豐富、尊榮，以致他心裏所願的一樣都不缺，只是上帝使他不能吃用，反有外人來吃用。這是虛空，也是禍患。
verses.e: a man to whom God gives riches , wealth , and honor , so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires , yet God gives him no power to eat of it , but an alien eats it . This is vanity , and it is an evil disease .

verses.z: 人若生一百個兒子，活許多歲數，以致他的年日甚多，心裏卻不得滿享福樂，又不得埋葬；據我說，那不到期而落的胎比他倒好。
verses.e: If a man fathers a hundred children , and lives many years , so that the days of his years are many , but his soul is not filled with good , and moreover he has no burial , I say that a stillborn child is better than he ;

verses.z: 因為虛虛而來，暗暗而去，名字被黑暗遮蔽，
verses.e: for it comes in vanity , and departs in darkness , and its name is covered with darkness .

verses.z: 並且沒有見過天日，也毫無知覺；這胎，比那人倒享安息。
verses.e: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it . This has rest rather than the other .

verses.z: 那人雖然活千年，再活千年，卻不享福，眾人豈不都歸一個地方去嗎？
verses.e: Yes , though he live a thousand years twice told , and yet fails to enjoy good , don't all go to one place ?

verses.z: 人的勞碌都為口腹，心裏卻不知足。
verses.e: All the labor of man is for his mouth , and yet the appetite is not filled .

verses.z: 這樣看來，智慧人比愚昧人有甚麼長處呢？窮人在眾人面前知道如何行，有甚麼長處呢？
verses.e: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool ? What has the poor man , that knows how to walk before the living ?

verses.z: 眼睛所看的比心裏妄想的倒好。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
verses.e: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire . This also is vanity and a chasing after wind .

verses.z: 名譽強如美好的膏油；人死的日子勝過人生的日子。
verses.e: A good name is better than fine perfume ; and the day of death better than the day of one's birth .

verses.z: 不要說：先前的日子強過如今的日子，是甚麼緣故呢？你這樣問，不是出於智慧。
verses.e: Don't say , " Why were the former days better than these ? " For you do not ask wisely about this .

verses.z: 智慧和產業並好，而且見天日的人得智慧更為有益。
verses.e: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance . Yes , it is more excellent for those who see the sun .

verses.z: 因為智慧護庇人，好像銀錢護庇人一樣。惟獨智慧能保全智慧人的生命。這就是知識的益處。
verses.e: For wisdom is a defense , even as money is a defense ; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it .

verses.z: 你要察看上帝的作為；因上帝使為曲的，誰能變為直呢？
verses.e: Consider the work of God , for who can make that straight which he has made crooked ?

verses.z: 遇亨通的日子你當喜樂；遭患難的日子你當思想；因為上帝使這兩樣並列，為的是叫人查不出身後有甚麼事。
verses.e: In the day of prosperity be joyful , and in the day of adversity consider ; yes , God has made the one side by side with the other , to the end that man should not find out anything after him .

verses.z: 有義人行義，反致滅亡；有惡人行惡，倒享長壽。這都是我在虛度之日中所見過的。
verses.e: All this I have seen in my days of vanity : there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness , and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing .

verses.z: 不要行義過分，也不要過於自逞智慧，何必自取敗亡呢？
verses.e: Don't be overly righteous , neither make yourself overly wise . Why should you destroy yourself ?

verses.z: 不要行惡過分，也不要為人愚昧，何必不到期而死呢？
verses.e: Don't be too wicked , neither be foolish . Why should you die before your time ?

verses.z: 你持守這個為美，那個也不要鬆手；因為敬畏上帝的人，必從這兩樣出來。
verses.e: It is good that you should take hold of this . Yes , also don't withdraw your hand from that ; for he who fears God will come out of them all .

verses.z: 智慧使有智慧的人比城中十個官長更有能力。
verses.e: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city .

verses.z: 往遭喪的家去，強如往宴樂的家去；因為[死]是眾人的結局，活人也必將這事放在心上。
verses.e: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting ; for that is the end of all men , and the living should take this to heart .

verses.z: 時常行善而不犯罪的義人，世上實在沒有。
verses.e: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn't sin .

verses.z: 人所說的一切話，你不要放在心上，恐怕聽見你的僕人咒詛你。
verses.e: Also don't take heed to all words that are spoken , lest you hear your servant curse you ;

verses.z: 因為你心裏知道，自己也曾屢次咒詛別人。
verses.e: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others .

verses.z: 我曾用智慧試驗這一切事；我說，要得智慧，智慧卻離我遠。
verses.e: All this I have proved in wisdom . I said , " I will be wise ; " but it was far from me .

verses.z: 萬事[之理]，離[我]甚遠，而且最深，誰能測透呢？
verses.e: That which is , is far off and exceedingly deep . Who can find it out ?

verses.z: 我轉念，一心要知道，要考察，要尋求智慧和[萬事的]理由；又要知道邪惡為愚昧，愚昧為狂妄。
verses.e: I turned around , and my heart sought to know and to search out , and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things , and to know that wickedness is stupidity , and that foolishness is madness .

verses.z: 我得知有等婦人比死還苦：她的心是網羅，手是鎖鍊。凡蒙上帝喜悅的人必能躲避她；有罪的人卻被她纏住了。
verses.e: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps , whose hands are chains . Whoever pleases God shall escape from her ; but the sinner will be ensnared by her .

verses.z: 傳道者說：「看哪，一千男子中，我找到一個[正直人]，但眾女子中，沒有找到一個。」我[將這事]一一比較，要尋求其理，我心仍要尋找，卻未曾找到。
verses.e: " Behold , I have found this , " says the Preacher , " to one another , to find an explanation
which my soul still seeks , but I have not found . I have found one man among a thousand , but I have not found a woman among all those .

verses.z: 我所找到的只有一件，就是上帝造人原是正直，但他們尋出許多巧計。
verses.e: Behold , I have only found this : that God made mankind upright ; but they search for many inventions . "

verses.z: 憂愁強如喜笑；因為面帶愁容，終必使心喜樂。
verses.e: Sorrow is better than laughter ; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good .

verses.z: 智慧人的心在遭喪之家；愚昧人的心在快樂之家。
verses.e: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning ; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth .

verses.z: 聽智慧人的責備，強如聽愚昧人的歌唱。
verses.e: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools .

verses.z: 愚昧人的笑聲，好像鍋下燒荊棘的爆聲；這也是虛空。
verses.e: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot , so is the laughter of the fool . This also is vanity .

verses.z: 勒索使智慧人變為愚妄；賄賂能敗壞人的慧心。
verses.e: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish ; and a bribe destroys the understanding .

verses.z: 事情的終局強如事情的起頭；存心忍耐的，勝過居心驕傲的。
verses.e: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning . The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit .

verses.z: 你不要心裏急躁惱怒，因為惱怒存在愚昧人的懷中。
verses.e: Don't be hasty in your spirit to be angry , for anger rests in the bosom of fools .

verses.z: 誰如智慧人呢？誰知道事情的解釋呢？人的智慧使他的臉發光，並使他臉上的暴氣改變。
verses.e: Who is like the wise man ? And who knows the interpretation of a thing ? A man's wisdom makes his face shine , and the hardness of his face is changed .

verses.z: 我見惡人埋葬，歸入[墳墓]；又見行正直事的離開聖地，在城中被人忘記。這也是虛空。
verses.e: So I saw the wicked buried . Indeed they came also from holiness . They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this . This also is vanity .

verses.z: 因為斷定罪名不立刻施刑，所以世人滿心作惡。
verses.e: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily , therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil .

verses.z: 罪人雖然作惡百次，倒享長久的年日；然而我準知道，敬畏上帝的，就是在他面前敬畏的人，終久必得福樂。
verses.e: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times , and lives long , yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God , who are reverent before him .

verses.z: 惡人卻不得福樂，也不得長久的年日；這年日好像影兒，因他不敬畏上帝。
verses.e: But it shall not be well with the wicked , neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow , because he doesn't fear God .

verses.z: 世上有一件虛空的事，就是義人所遭遇的，反照惡人所行的；又有惡人所遭遇的，反照義人所行的。我說，這也是虛空。
verses.e: There is a vanity which is done on the earth , that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked . Again , there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous . I said that this also is vanity .

verses.z: 我就稱讚快樂，原來人在日光之下，莫強如吃喝快樂；因為他在日光之下，上帝賜他一生的年日，要從勞碌中，時常享受所得的。
verses.e: Then I commended mirth , because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat , to drink , and to be joyful : for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun .

verses.z: 我專心求智慧，要看世上所做的事。（有晝夜不睡覺不合眼的。）
verses.e: When I applied my heart to know wisdom , and to see the business that is done on the earth ( even though eyes see no sleep day or night ) ,

verses.z: 我就看明上帝一切的作為，知道人查不出日光之下所做的事；任憑他費多少力尋查，都查不出來，就是智慧人雖想知道，也是查不出來。
verses.e: then I saw all the work of God , that man can't find out the work that is done under the sun , because however much a man labors to seek it out , yet he won't find it . Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it , he won't be able to find it .

verses.z: 我[勸你]遵守王的命令；既指上帝起誓，理當如此。
verses.e: I say , " Keep the king's command ! " because of the oath to God .

verses.z: 不要急躁離開王的面前，不要固執行惡，因為他凡事都隨自己的心意而行。
verses.e: Don't be hasty to go out of his presence . Don't persist in an evil thing , for he does whatever pleases him ,

verses.z: 王的話本有權力，誰敢問他說「你做甚麼」呢？
verses.e: for the king's word is supreme . Who can say to him , " What are you doing ? "

verses.z: 凡遵守命令的，必不經歷禍患；智慧人的心能辨明時候和定理。
verses.e: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm , and his wise heart will know the time and procedure .

verses.z: 各樣事務[成就]都有時候和定理，因為人的苦難重壓在他身上。
verses.e: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose , although the misery of man is heavy on him .

verses.z: 他不知道將來的事，因為將來如何，誰能告訴他呢？
verses.e: For he doesn't know that which will be ; for who can tell him how it will be ?

verses.z: 無人有權力掌管生命，將生命留住；也無人有權力掌管死期；這場爭戰，無人能免；邪惡也不能救那好行邪惡的人。
verses.e: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit ; neither does he have power over the day of death . There is no discharge in war ; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it .

verses.z: 這一切我都見過，也專心查考日光之下所做的一切事。有時這人管轄那人，令人受害。
verses.e: All this I have seen , and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun . There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt .

verses.z: 我將這一切事放在心上，詳細考究，就知道義人和智慧人，並他們的作為都在上帝手中；或是愛，或是恨，都在他們的前面，人不能知道。
verses.e: For all this I laid to my heart , even to explore all this : that the righteous , and the wise , and their works , are in the hand of God ; whether it is love or hatred , man doesn't know it ; all is before them .

verses.z: 凡你手所當做的事要盡力去做；因為在你所必去的陰間沒有工作，沒有謀算，沒有知識，也沒有智慧。
verses.e: Whatever your hand finds to do , do it with your might ; for there is no work , nor plan , nor knowledge , nor wisdom , in Sheol , where you are going .

verses.z: 我又轉念：見日光之下，快跑的未必能贏；力戰的未必得勝；智慧的未必得糧食；明哲的未必得資財；靈巧的未必得喜悅。所臨到眾人的是在乎當時的機會。
verses.e: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favor to men of skill ; but time and chance happen to them all .

verses.z: 原來人也不知道自己的定期。魚被惡網圈住，鳥被網羅捉住，禍患忽然臨到的時候，世人陷在其中也是如此。
verses.e: For man also doesn't know his time . As the fish that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare , even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falls suddenly on them .

verses.z: 我見日光之下有一樣智慧，據我看乃是廣大，
verses.e: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way , and it seemed great to me .

verses.z: 就是有一小城，其中的人數稀少，有大君王來攻擊，修築營壘，將城圍困。
verses.e: There was a little city , and few men within it ; and a great king came against it , besieged it , and built great bulwarks against it .

verses.z: 城中有一個貧窮的智慧人，他用智慧救了那城，卻沒有人記念那窮人。
verses.e: Now a poor wise man was found in it , and he by his wisdom delivered the city ; yet no man remembered that same poor man .

verses.z: 我就說，智慧勝過勇力；然而那貧窮人的智慧被人藐視，他的話也無人聽從。
verses.e: Then I said , " Wisdom is better than strength . " Nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .

verses.z: 寧可在安靜之中聽智慧人的言語，不聽掌管愚昧人的喊聲。
verses.e: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools .

verses.z: 智慧勝過打仗的兵器；但一個罪人能敗壞許多善事。
verses.e: Wisdom is better than weapons of war ; but one sinner destroys much good .

verses.z: 凡臨到眾人的事都是一樣：義人和惡人都遭遇一樣的事；好人，潔淨人和不潔淨人，獻祭的與不獻祭的，也是一樣。好人如何，罪人也如何；起誓的如何，怕起誓的也如何。
verses.e: All things come alike to all . There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked ; to the good , to the clean , to the unclean , to him who sacrifices , and to him who doesn't sacrifice . As is the good , so is the sinner ; he who takes an oath , as he who fears an oath .

verses.z: 在日光之下所行的一切事上有一件禍患，就是眾人所遭遇的都是一樣，並且世人的心充滿了惡；活着的時候心裏狂妄，後來就歸死人那裏去了。
verses.e: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun , that there is one event to all . Yes also , the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .

verses.z: 與一切活人相連的，那人還有指望，因為活着的狗比死了的獅子更強。
verses.e: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope ; for a living dog is better than a dead lion .

verses.z: 活着的人知道必死；死了的人毫無所知，也不再得賞賜；他們的名無人記念。
verses.e: For the living know that they will die , but the dead don't know anything , neither do they have any more a reward ; for their memory is forgotten .

verses.z: 他們的愛，他們的恨，他們的嫉妒，早都消滅了。在日光之下所行的一切事上，他們永不再有分了。
verses.e: Also their love , their hatred , and their envy has perished long ago ; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun .

verses.z: 你只管去歡歡喜喜吃你的飯，心中快樂喝你的酒，因為上帝已經悅納你的作為。
verses.e: Go your way — eat your bread with joy , and drink your wine with a merry heart ; for God has already accepted your works .

verses.z: 你的衣服當時常潔白，你頭上也不要缺少膏油。
verses.e: Let your garments be always white , and don't let your head lack oil .

verses.z: 在你一生虛空的年日，就是上帝賜你在日光之下虛空的年日，當同你所愛的妻，快活度日，因為那是你生前在日光之下勞碌的事上所得的分。
verses.e: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity , which he has given you under the sun , all your days of vanity , for that is your portion in life , and in your labor in which you labor under the sun .

verses.z: 奉上帝旨意，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅，寫信給在以弗所的聖徒，就是在基督耶穌裏有忠心的人。
verses.e: Paul , an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God , to the saints who are at Ephesus , and the faithful in Christ Jesus :

verses.z: 要照所安排的，在日期滿足的時候，使天上、地上、一切所有的都在基督裏面同歸於一。
verses.e: to an administration of the fullness of the times , to sum up all things in Christ , the things in the heavens and the things on the earth , in him .

verses.z: 我們也在他裏面得了基業；這原是那位隨己意行、做萬事的，照着他旨意所預定的，
verses.e: We were also assigned an inheritance in him , having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will ,

verses.z: 叫他的榮耀從我們這首先在基督裏有盼望的人可以得着稱讚。
verses.e: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory , we who had before hoped in Christ .

verses.z: 你們既聽見真理的道，就是那叫你們得救的福音，也[信了]基督，既然信他，就受了所應許的聖靈為印記。
verses.e: In him you also , having heard the word of the truth , the Good News of your salvation — in whom , having also believed , you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit ,

verses.z: 這聖靈是我們得基業的憑據，直等到[上帝]之民被贖，使他的榮耀得着稱讚。
verses.e: who is a pledge of our inheritance , to the redemption of God's own possession , to the praise of his glory .

verses.z: 因此，我既聽見你們信從主耶穌，親愛眾聖徒，
verses.e: For this cause I also , having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints ,

verses.z: 就為你們不住地感謝上帝。禱告的時候，常提到你們，
verses.e: don't cease to give thanks for you , making mention of you in my prayers ,

verses.z: 求我們主耶穌基督的上帝，榮耀的父，將那賜人智慧和啟示的靈賞給你們，使你們真知道他，
verses.e: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of glory , may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him ,

verses.z: 並且照明你們心中的眼睛，使你們知道他的恩召有何等指望，他在聖徒中得的基業有何等豐盛的榮耀；
verses.e: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened , that you may know what is the hope of his calling , and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints ,

verses.z: 並[知道]他向我們這信的人所顯的能力是何等浩大，
verses.e: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe , according to that working of the strength of his might

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安從上帝我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
verses.e: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 就是照他在基督身上所運行的大能大力，使他從死裏復活，叫他在天上坐在自己的右邊，
verses.e: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places ,

verses.z: 遠超過一切執政的、掌權的、有能的、主治的，和一切有名的；不但是今世的，連來世的也都超過了。
verses.e: far above all rule , authority , power , dominion , and every name that is named , not only in this age , but also in that which is to come .

verses.z: 又將萬有服在他的腳下，使他為教會作萬有之首。
verses.e: He put all things in subjection under his feet , and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly ,

verses.z: 教會是他的身體，是那充滿萬有者所充滿的。
verses.e: which is his body , the fullness of him who fills all in all .

verses.z: 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父上帝！他在基督裏曾賜給我們天上各樣屬靈的福氣：
verses.e: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ ,

verses.z: 就如上帝從創立世界以前，在基督裏揀選了我們，使我們在他面前成為聖潔，無有瑕疵；
verses.e: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world , that we would be holy and without defect before him in love ,

verses.z: 又因愛我們，就按着自己的意旨所喜悅的，預定我們藉着耶穌基督得兒子的名分，
verses.e: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself , according to the good pleasure of his desire ,

verses.z: 使他榮耀的恩典得着稱讚；這恩典是他在愛子裏所賜給我們的。
verses.e: to the praise of the glory of his grace , by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved .

verses.z: 我們藉這愛子的血得蒙救贖，過犯得以赦免，乃是照他豐富的恩典。
verses.e: In him we have our redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of our trespasses , according to the riches of his grace

verses.z: 這恩典是上帝用諸般智慧聰明，充充足足賞給我們的；
verses.e: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence ,

verses.z: 都是照他自己所預定的美意，叫我們知道他旨意的奧祕，
verses.e: making known to us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

verses.z: 你們死在過犯罪惡之中，[他叫你們活過來]。
verses.e: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins ,

verses.z: 我們原是他的工作，在基督耶穌裏造成的，為要叫我們行善，就是上帝所預備叫我們行的。
verses.e: For we are his workmanship , created in Christ Jesus for good works , which God prepared before that we would walk in them .

verses.z: 所以你們應當記念：你們從前按肉體是外邦人，是稱為沒受割禮的；這名原是那些憑人手在肉身上稱為受割禮之人所起的。
verses.e: Therefore remember that once you , the Gentiles in the flesh , who are called " uncircumcision " by that which is called " circumcision " ( in the flesh , made by hands ) ,

verses.z: 那時，你們與基督無關，在以色列國民以外，在所應許的諸約上是局外人，並且[活]在世上沒有指望，沒有上帝。
verses.e: that you were at that time separate from Christ , alienated from the commonwealth of Israel , and strangers from the covenants of the promise , having no hope and without God in the world .

verses.z: 你們從前遠離[上帝]的人，如今卻在基督耶穌裏，靠着他的血，已經得親近了。
verses.e: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ .

verses.z: 因他使我們和睦，將兩下合而為一，拆毀了中間隔斷的牆；
verses.e: For he is our peace , who made both one , and broke down the middle wall of separation ,

verses.z: 而且以自己的身體廢掉冤仇，就是那[記]在律法上的規條，為要將兩下藉着自己造成一個新人，[如此]便成就了和睦。
verses.e: having abolished in his flesh the hostility , the law of commandments contained in ordinances , that he might create in himself one new man of the two , making peace ,

verses.z: 既在十字架上滅了冤仇，便藉這十字架使兩下歸為一體，與上帝和好了，
verses.e: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross , having killed the hostility through it .

verses.z: 並且來傳和平的福音給你們遠處的人，也給那近處的人。
verses.e: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near .

verses.z: 因為我們兩下藉着他被一個[聖]靈所感，得以進到父面前。
verses.e: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father .

verses.z: 這樣，你們不再作外人和客旅，是與聖徒同國，是上帝家裏的人了；
verses.e: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners , but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God ,

verses.z: 那時，你們在其中行事為人，隨從今世的風俗，順服空中掌權者的首領，就是現今在悖逆之子心中運行的[邪]靈。
verses.e: in which you once walked according to the course of this world , according to the prince of the power of the air , the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience .

verses.z: 並且被建造在使徒和先知的根基上，有基督耶穌自己為房角石，
verses.e: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone ;

verses.z: 各房靠他聯絡得合式，漸漸成為主的聖殿。
verses.e: in whom the whole building , fitted together , grows into a holy temple in the Lord ;

verses.z: 你們也靠他同被建造，成為上帝藉着聖靈居住的所在。
verses.e: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit .

verses.z: 我們從前也都在他們中間，放縱肉體的私慾，隨着肉體和心中所喜好的去行，本為可怒之子，和別人一樣。
verses.e: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh , doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind , and were by nature children of wrath , even as the rest .

verses.z: 然而，上帝既有豐富的憐憫，因他愛我們的大愛，
verses.e: But God , being rich in mercy , for his great love with which he loved us ,

verses.z: 當我們死在過犯中的時候，便叫我們與基督一同活過來。你們得救是本乎恩。
verses.e: even when we were dead through our trespasses , made us alive together with Christ — by grace you have been saved —

verses.z: 他又叫我們與基督耶穌一同復活，一同坐在天上，
verses.e: and raised us up with him , and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 要將他極豐富的恩典，就是他在基督耶穌裏向我們所施的恩慈，顯明給後來的世代看。
verses.e: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus ;

verses.z: 你們得救是本乎恩，也因着信；這並不是出於自己，乃是上帝所賜的；
verses.e: for by grace you have been saved through faith , and that not of yourselves ; it is the gift of God ,

verses.z: 也不是出於行為，免得有人自誇。
verses.e: not of works , that no one would boast .

verses.z: 因此，我－保羅為你們外邦人作了基督耶穌被囚的，[替你們祈禱]。
verses.e: For this cause I , Paul , am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles ,

verses.z: 為要藉着教會使天上執政的、掌權的，現在得知上帝百般的智慧。
verses.e: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places ,

verses.z: 這是照上帝從萬世以前，在我們主基督耶穌裏所定的旨意。
verses.e: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord .

verses.z: 我們因信耶穌，就在他裏面放膽無懼，篤信不疑地來到上帝面前。
verses.e: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him .

verses.z: 所以，我求你們不要因我為你們所受的患難喪膽，這原是你們的榮耀。
verses.e: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you , which are your glory .

verses.z: 因此，我在父面前屈膝，（
verses.e: For this cause , I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 天上地上的各家，都是從他得名。）
verses.e: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named ,

verses.z: 求他按着他豐盛的榮耀，藉着他的靈，叫你們心裏的力量剛強起來，
verses.e: that he would grant you , according to the riches of his glory , that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person ,

verses.z: 使基督因你們的信，住在你們心裏，叫你們的愛心有根有基，
verses.e: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith , to the end that you , being rooted and grounded in love ,

verses.z: 能以和眾聖徒一同明白基督的愛是何等長闊高深，
verses.e: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth ,

verses.z: 並知道這愛是過於人所能測度的，便叫上帝一切所充滿的，充滿了你們。
verses.e: and to know Christ's love which surpasses knowledge , that you may be filled with all the fullness of God .

verses.z: 諒必你們曾聽見上帝賜恩給我，將關切你們的職分託付我，
verses.e: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you ,

verses.z: 上帝能照着運行在我們心裏的大力充充足足地成就一切，超過我們所求所想的。
verses.e: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think , according to the power that works in us ,

verses.z: 但願他在教會中，並在基督耶穌裏，得着榮耀，直到世世代代，永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations , forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 用啟示使我知道[福音的]奧祕，正如我以前略略寫過的。
verses.e: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me , as I wrote before in few words ,

verses.z: 你們念了，就能曉得我深知基督的奧祕。
verses.e: by which , when you read , you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ ,

verses.z: 這奧祕在以前的世代沒有叫人知道，像如今藉着聖靈啟示他的聖使徒和先知一樣。
verses.e: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men , as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit ,

verses.z: [這奧祕]就是外邦人在基督耶穌裏，藉着福音，得以同為後嗣，同為一體，同蒙應許。
verses.e: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body , and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News ,

verses.z: 我作了這福音的執事，是照上帝的恩賜，這恩賜是照他運行的大能賜給我的。
verses.e: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power .

verses.z: 我本來比眾聖徒中最小的還小，然而他還賜我這恩典，叫我把基督那測不透的豐富傳給外邦人，
verses.e: To me , the very least of all saints , was this grace given , to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ,

verses.z: 又使眾人都明白，這歷代以來隱藏在創造萬物之上帝裏的奧祕是如何安排的，
verses.e: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God , who created all things through Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 我為主被囚的勸你們：既然蒙召，行事為人就當與蒙召的恩相稱。
verses.e: I therefore , the prisoner in the Lord , beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called ,

verses.z: 那降下的，就是遠升諸天之上要充滿萬有的。）
verses.e: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens , that he might fill all things .

verses.z: 他所賜的，有使徒，有先知，有傳福音的，有牧師和教師，
verses.e: He gave some to be apostles ; and some , prophets ; and some , evangelists ; and some , shepherds and teachers ;

verses.z: 為要成全聖徒，各盡其職，建立基督的身體，
verses.e: for the perfecting of the saints , to the work of serving , to the building up of the body of Christ ,

verses.z: 直等到我們眾人在真道上同歸於一，認識上帝的兒子，得以長大成人，滿有基督長成的身量，
verses.e: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God , to a full grown man , to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ ,

verses.z: 使我們不再作小孩子，中了人的詭計和欺騙的法術，被一切異教之風搖動，飄來飄去，就隨從各樣的異端；
verses.e: that we may no longer be children , tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine , by the trickery of men , in craftiness , after the wiles of error ;

verses.z: 惟用愛心說誠實話，凡事長進，連於元首基督，
verses.e: but speaking truth in love , we may grow up in all things into him who is the head , Christ ,

verses.z: 全身都靠他聯絡得合式，百節各按各職，照着各體的功用彼此相助，便叫身體漸漸增長，在愛中建立自己。
verses.e: from whom all the body , being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies , according to the working in measure of each individual part , makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love .

verses.z: 所以我說，且在主裏確實地說，你們行事不要再像外邦人存虛妄的心行事。
verses.e: This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk , in the futility of their mind ,

verses.z: 他們心地昏昧，與上帝所賜的生命隔絕了，都因自己無知，心裏剛硬；
verses.e: being darkened in their understanding , alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them , because of the hardening of their hearts .

verses.z: 良心既然喪盡，就放縱私慾，貪行種種的污穢。
verses.e: They , having become callous , gave themselves up to lust , to work all uncleanness with greediness .

verses.z: 凡事謙虛、溫柔、忍耐，用愛心互相寬容，
verses.e: with all lowliness and humility , with patience , bearing with one another in love ,

verses.z: 你們學了基督，卻不是這樣。
verses.e: But you didn't learn Christ that way ,

verses.z: 如果你們聽過他的道，領了他的教，學了他的真理，
verses.e: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him , even as truth is in Jesus :

verses.z: 就要脫去你們從前行為上的舊人，這舊人是因私慾的迷惑漸漸變壞的；
verses.e: that you put away , as concerning your former way of life , the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit ,

verses.z: 又要將你們的心志改換一新，
verses.e: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind ,

verses.z: 並且穿上新人；這新人是照着上帝[的形像]造的，有真理的仁義和聖潔。
verses.e: and put on the new man , who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth .

verses.z: 所以，你們要棄絕謊言，各人與鄰舍說實話，因為我們是互相為肢體。
verses.e: Therefore , putting away falsehood , speak truth each one with his neighbor , for we are members of one another .

verses.z: 生氣卻不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，
verses.e: " Be angry , and don't sin . " Don't let the sun go down on your wrath ,

verses.z: 也不可給魔鬼留地步。
verses.e: and don't give place to the devil .

verses.z: 從前偷竊的，不要再偷；總要勞力，親手做正經事，就可有[餘]分給那缺少的人。
verses.e: Let him who stole steal no more ; but rather let him labor , producing with his hands something that is good , that he may have something to give to him who has need .

verses.z: 污穢的言語一句不可出口，只要隨事說造就人的好話，叫聽見的人得益處。
verses.e: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth , but only what is good for building others up as the need may be , that it may give grace to those who hear .

verses.z: 用和平彼此聯絡，竭力保守[聖]靈所賜合而為一的心。
verses.e: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .

verses.z: 不要叫上帝的聖靈擔憂；你們原是受了他的印記，等候得贖的日子來到。
verses.e: Don't grieve the Holy Spirit of God , in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption .

verses.z: 一切苦毒、惱恨、忿怒、嚷鬧、毀謗，並一切的惡毒，都當從你們中間除掉；
verses.e: Let all bitterness , wrath , anger , outcry , and slander be put away from you , with all malice .

verses.z: 並要以恩慈相待，存憐憫的心，彼此饒恕，正如上帝在基督裏饒恕了你們一樣。
verses.e: And be kind to one another , tender hearted , forgiving each other , just as God also in Christ forgave you .

verses.z: 身體只有一個，[聖]靈只有一個，正如你們蒙召同有一個指望。
verses.e: There is one body and one Spirit , even as you also were called in one hope of your calling ,

verses.z: 一主，一信，一洗，
verses.e: one Lord , one faith , one baptism ,

verses.z: 一上帝，就是眾人的父，超乎眾人之上，貫乎眾人之中，也住在眾人之內。
verses.e: one God and Father of all , who is over all and through all and in us all .

verses.z: 我們各人蒙恩，都是照基督所量給各人的恩賜。
verses.e: But to each one of us , the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ .

verses.z: 所以[經上]說：他升上高天的時候，擄掠了仇敵，將各樣的恩賜賞給人。（
verses.e: Therefore he says , " When he ascended on high , he led captivity captive , and gave gifts to people . "

verses.z: 既說升上，豈不是先降在地下嗎？
verses.e: Now this , " He ascended " , what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth ?

verses.z: 所以，你們該效法上帝，好像蒙慈愛的兒女一樣。
verses.e: Be therefore imitators of God , as beloved children .

verses.z: 總要察驗何為主所喜悅的事。
verses.e: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord .

verses.z: 那暗昧無益的事，不要與人同行，倒要責備[行這事的人]；
verses.e: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness , but rather even reprove them .

verses.z: 因為他們暗中所行的，就是提起來也是可恥的。
verses.e: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret .

verses.z: 凡事受了責備，就被光顯明出來，因為一切能顯明的就是光。
verses.e: But all things , when they are reproved , are revealed by the light , for everything that reveals is light .

verses.z: 所以[主]說：你這睡着的人當醒過來，從死裏復活！基督就要光照你了。
verses.e: Therefore he says , " Awake , you who sleep , and arise from the dead , and Christ will shine on you . "

verses.z: 你們要謹慎行事，不要像愚昧人，當像智慧人。
verses.e: Therefore watch carefully how you walk , not as unwise , but as wise ,

verses.z: 要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。
verses.e: redeeming the time , because the days are evil .

verses.z: 不要作糊塗人，要明白主的旨意如何。
verses.e: Therefore , don't be foolish , but understand what the will of the Lord is .

verses.z: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放蕩；乃要被[聖]靈充滿。
verses.e: Don't be drunken with wine , in which is dissipation , but be filled with the Spirit ,

verses.z: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌彼此對說，口唱心和地讚美主。
verses.e: speaking to one another in psalms , hymns , and spiritual songs ; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord ;

verses.z: 也要憑愛心行事，正如基督愛我們，為我們捨了自己，當作馨香的供物和祭物，獻與上帝。
verses.e: Walk in love , even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us , an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance .

verses.z: 凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常常感謝父上帝。
verses.e: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God , even the Father ;

verses.z: 又當存敬畏基督的心，彼此順服。
verses.e: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ .

verses.z: 你們作妻子的，[當順服]自己的丈夫，如同[順服]主。
verses.e: Wives , be subject to your own husbands , as to the Lord .

verses.z: 因為丈夫是妻子的頭，如同基督是教會的頭；他又是[教會]全體的救主。
verses.e: For the husband is the head of the wife , as Christ also is the head of the assembly , being himself the savior of the body .

verses.z: 教會怎樣順服基督，妻子也要怎樣凡事順服丈夫。
verses.e: But as the assembly is subject to Christ , so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything .

verses.z: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，正如基督愛教會，為教會捨己。
verses.e: Husbands , love your wives , even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her ,

verses.z: 要用水藉着道把教會洗淨，成為聖潔，
verses.e: that he might sanctify her , having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word ,

verses.z: 可以獻給自己，作個榮耀的教會，毫無玷污、皺紋等類的病，乃是聖潔沒有瑕疵的。
verses.e: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously , not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing , but that she should be holy and without defect .

verses.z: 丈夫也當照樣愛妻子，如同愛自己的身子；愛妻子便是愛自己了。
verses.e: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies . He who loves his own wife loves himself .

verses.z: 從來沒有人恨惡自己的身子，總是保養顧惜，正像基督待教會一樣，
verses.e: For no man ever hated his own flesh , but nourishes and cherishes it , even as the Lord also does the assembly ,

verses.z: 至於淫亂並一切污穢，或是貪婪，在你們中間連提都不可，方合聖徒的體統。
verses.e: But sexual immorality , and all uncleanness or covetousness , let it not even be mentioned among you , as becomes saints ;

verses.z: 因我們是他身上的肢體。
verses.e: because we are members of his body , of his flesh and bones .

verses.z: 為這個緣故，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
verses.e: " For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife . Then the two will become one flesh . "

verses.z: 這是極大的奧祕，但我是指着基督和教會說的。
verses.e: This mystery is great , but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly .

verses.z: 然而，你們各人都當愛妻子，如同愛自己一樣。妻子也當敬重她的丈夫。
verses.e: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself ; and let the wife see that she respects her husband .

verses.z: 淫詞、妄語，和戲笑的話都不相宜；總要說感謝的話。
verses.e: nor filthiness , nor foolish talking , nor jesting , which are not appropriate , but rather giving of thanks .

verses.z: 因為你們確實地知道，無論是淫亂的，是污穢的，是有貪心的，在基督和上帝的國裏都是無分的。有貪心的，就與拜偶像的一樣。
verses.e: Know this for sure , that no sexually immoral person , nor unclean person , nor covetous man ( who is an idolater ) , has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God .

verses.z: 不要被人虛浮的話欺哄；因這些事，上帝的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。
verses.e: Let no one deceive you with empty words , for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience .

verses.z: 所以，你們不要與他們同夥。
verses.e: Therefore don't be partakers with them .

verses.z: 從前你們是暗昧的，但如今在主裏面是光明的，行事為人就當像光明的子女。
verses.e: For you were once darkness , but are now light in the Lord . Walk as children of light ,

verses.z: 光明所結的果子就是一切良善、公義、誠實。
verses.e: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth ,

verses.z: 你們作兒女的，要在主裏聽從父母，這是理所當然的。
verses.e: Children , obey your parents in the Lord , for this is right .

verses.z: 我還有末了的話：你們要靠着主，倚賴他的大能大力作剛強的人。
verses.e: Finally , be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might .

verses.z: 要穿戴上帝[所賜]的全副軍裝，就能抵擋魔鬼的詭計。
verses.e: Put on the whole armor of God , that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .

verses.z: 因我們並不是與屬血氣的爭戰，乃是與那些執政的、掌權的、管轄這幽暗世界的，以及天空屬靈氣的惡魔爭戰。
verses.e: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood , but against the principalities , against the powers , against the world's rulers of the darkness of this age , and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places .

verses.z: 所以，要拿起上帝[所賜]的全副軍裝，好在磨難的日子抵擋[仇敵]，並且成就了一切，還能站立得住。
verses.e: Therefore put on the whole armor of God , that you may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .

verses.z: 所以要站穩了，用真理當作帶子束腰，用公義當作護心鏡遮胸，
verses.e: Stand therefore , having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist , and having put on the breastplate of righteousness ,

verses.z: 又用平安的福音當作預備走路的鞋穿在腳上。
verses.e: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace ,

verses.z: 此外，又拿着信德當作盾牌，可以滅盡那惡者一切的火箭；
verses.e: above all , taking up the shield of faith , with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one .

verses.z: 並戴上救恩的頭盔，拿着[聖]靈的寶劍，就是上帝的道；
verses.e: And take the helmet of salvation , and the sword of the Spirit , which is the word of God ;

verses.z: 靠着[聖]靈，隨時多方禱告祈求；並要在此警醒不倦，為眾聖徒祈求，
verses.e: with all prayer and requests , praying at all times in the Spirit , and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints .

verses.z: 也為我祈求，使我得着口才，能以放膽開口講明福音的奧祕，
verses.e: Pray for me , that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth , to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News ,

verses.z: 「要孝敬父母，使你得福，在世長壽。」這是第一條帶應許的誡命。
verses.e: " Honor your father and mother , " which is the first commandment with a promise :

verses.z: （我為這福音的奧祕作了帶鎖鍊的使者，）並使我照着當盡的本分放膽講論。
verses.e: for which I am an ambassador in chains ; that in it I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .

verses.z: 今有所親愛、忠心事奉主的兄弟推基古，他要把我的事情，並我的景況如何全告訴你們，叫你們知道。
verses.e: But that you also may know my affairs , how I am doing , Tychicus , the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord , will make known to you all things .

verses.z: 我特意打發他到你們那裏去，好叫你們知道我們的光景，又叫他安慰你們的心。
verses.e: I have sent him to you for this very purpose , that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts .

verses.z: 願平安、仁愛、信心從父上帝和主耶穌基督歸與弟兄們！
verses.e: Peace be to the brothers , and love with faith , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 並願所有誠心愛我們主耶穌基督的人都蒙恩惠！
verses.e: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love . Amen .
" that it may be well with you , and you may live long on the earth . "

verses.z: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，只要照着主的教訓和警戒養育他們。
verses.e: You fathers , don't provoke your children to wrath , but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord .

verses.z: 你們作僕人的，要懼怕戰兢，用誠實的心聽從你們肉身的主人，好像聽從基督一般。
verses.e: Servants , be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters , with fear and trembling , in singleness of your heart , as to Christ ,

verses.z: 不要只在眼前事奉，像是討人喜歡的，要像基督的僕人，從心裏遵行上帝的旨意。
verses.e: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you , as men pleasers , but as servants of Christ , doing the will of God from the heart ,

verses.z: 甘心事奉，好像服事主，不像服事人。
verses.e: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men ,

verses.z: 因為曉得各人所行的善事，不論是為奴的，是自主的，都必按所行的得主的賞賜。
verses.e: knowing that whatever good thing each one does , he will receive the same good again from the Lord , whether he is bound or free .

verses.z: 你們作主人的，待僕人也是一理，不要威嚇他們。因為知道，他們和你們同有一位主在天上；他並不偏待人。
verses.e: You masters , do the same things to them , and give up threatening , knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven , and there is no partiality with him .

verses.z: 亞哈隨魯作王，從印度直到古實，統管一百二十七省。
verses.e: Now in the days of Ahasuerus ( this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia , over one hundred twenty-seven provinces ) ,

verses.z: 第七日，亞哈隨魯王飲酒，心中快樂，就吩咐在他面前侍立的七個太監米戶幔、比斯他、哈波拿、比革他、亞拔他、西達、甲迦，
verses.e: On the seventh day , when the heart of the king was merry with wine , he commanded Mehuman , Biztha , Harbona , Bigtha , and Abagtha , Zethar , and Carcass , the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king ,

verses.z: 請王后瓦實提頭戴王后的冠冕到王面前，使各等臣民看她的美貌，因為她容貌甚美。
verses.e: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown , to show the people and the princes her beauty ; for she was beautiful .

verses.z: 王后瓦實提卻不肯遵太監所傳的王命而來，所以王甚發怒，心如火燒。
verses.e: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by the eunuchs . Therefore the king was very angry , and his anger burned in him .

verses.z: 那時，在王左右常見王面、國中坐高位的，有波斯和米底亞的七個大臣，就是甲示拿、示達、押瑪他、他施斯、米力、瑪西拿、米母干，都是達時務的明哲人。按王的常規，辦事必先詢問知例明法的人。王問他們說：
verses.e: Then the king said to the wise men , who knew the times ( for it was the king's custom to consult those who knew law and judgment ;
and next to him were Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , who saw the king's face , and sat first in the kingdom ) ,

verses.z: 「王后瓦實提不遵太監所傳的王命，照例應當怎樣辦理呢？」
verses.e: " What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law , because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs ? "

verses.z: 米母干在王和眾首領面前回答說：「王后瓦實提這事，不但得罪王，並且有害於王各省的臣民；
verses.e: Memucan answered before the king and the princes , " Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king , but also to all the princes , and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus .

verses.z: 因為王后這事必傳到眾婦人的耳中，說：『亞哈隨魯王吩咐王后瓦實提到王面前，她卻不來』，她們就藐視自己的丈夫。
verses.e: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women , causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported , ' King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him , but she didn't come . '

verses.z: 今日波斯和米底亞的眾夫人聽見王后這事，必向王的大臣[照樣]行；從此必大開藐視和忿怒之端。
verses.e: Today , the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen's deed will tell all the king's princes . This will cause much contempt and wrath .

verses.z: 王若以為美，就降旨寫在波斯和米底亞人的例中，永不更改，不准瓦實提再到王面前，將她王后的位分賜給比她還好的人。
verses.e: " If it pleases the king , let a royal commandment go from him , and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes , so that it cannot be altered , that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus ; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she .

verses.z: 亞哈隨魯王在書珊城的宮登基；
verses.e: in those days , when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Susa the palace ,

verses.z: 所降的旨意傳遍通國（國度本來廣大），所有的婦人，無論丈夫貴賤都必尊敬他。」
verses.e: When the king's decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom ( for it is great ) , all the wives will give their husbands honor , both great and small . "

verses.z: 王和眾首領都以米母干的話為美，王就照這話去行，
verses.e: This advice pleased the king and the princes , and the king did according to the word of Memucan :

verses.z: 發詔書，用各省的文字、各族的方言通知各省，使為丈夫的在家中作主，各說本地的方言。
verses.e: for he sent letters into all the king's provinces , into every province according to its writing , and to every people in their language , that every man should rule his own house , speaking in the language of his own people .

verses.z: 在位第三年，為他一切首領臣僕設擺筵席，有波斯和米底亞的權貴，就是各省的貴冑與首領，在他面前。
verses.e: in the third year of his reign , he made a feast for all his princes and his servants ; the army of Persia and Media , the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him .

verses.z: 他把他榮耀之國的豐富和他美好威嚴的尊貴給他們看了許多日，就是一百八十日。
verses.e: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days , even one hundred eighty days .

verses.z: 這日子滿了，又為所有住書珊城的大小人民在御園的院子裏設擺筵席七日。
verses.e: When these days were fulfilled , the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace , both great and small , in the court of the garden of the king's palace .

verses.z: 有白色、綠色、藍色的[帳子]，用細麻繩、紫色繩從銀環內繫在白玉石柱上；有金銀的床榻擺在紅、白、黃、黑玉石的鋪石地上。
verses.e: There were hangings of white and blue material , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars . The couches were of gold and silver , on a pavement of red , white , yellow , and black marble .

verses.z: 用金器皿賜酒，器皿各有不同。御酒甚多，足顯王的厚意。
verses.e: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds , including royal wine in abundance , according to the bounty of the king .

verses.z: 喝酒有例，不准勉強人，因王吩咐宮裏的一切臣宰，讓人各隨己意。
verses.e: In accordance with the law , the drinking was not compulsory ; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house , that they should do according to every man's pleasure .

verses.z: 王后瓦實提在亞哈隨魯王的宮內也為婦女設擺筵席。
verses.e: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus .

verses.z: 亞哈隨魯王使旱地和海島的人民都進貢。
verses.e: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea .

verses.z: 他以權柄能力所行的，並他抬舉末底改使他高升的事，豈不都寫在米底亞和波斯王的歷史上嗎？
verses.e: Aren't all the acts of his power and of his might , and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai , to which the king advanced him , written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia ?

verses.z: 猶大人末底改作亞哈隨魯王的宰相，在猶大人中為大，得他眾弟兄的喜悅，為本族的人求好處，向他們說和平的話。
verses.e: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus , and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers , seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants .

verses.z: 這事以後，亞哈隨魯王的忿怒止息，就想念瓦實提和她所行的，並怎樣降旨辦她。
verses.e: After these things , when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .

verses.z: 以斯帖未曾將籍貫宗族告訴人，因為末底改囑咐她不可叫人知道。
verses.e: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives , because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known .

verses.z: 末底改天天在女院前邊行走，要知道以斯帖平安不平安，並後事如何。
verses.e: Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women's house , to find out how Esther was doing , and what would become of her .

verses.z: 眾女子照例先潔淨身體十二個月：六個月用沒藥油，六個月用香料和潔身之物。滿了日期，然後挨次進去見亞哈隨魯王。
verses.e: Each young woman's turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months ( for so were the days of their purification accomplished , six months with oil of myrrh , and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women ) .

verses.z: 女子進去見王是這樣：從女院到王宮的時候，凡她所要的都必給她。
verses.e: The young woman then came to the king like this : whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women's house to the king's house .

verses.z: 晚上進去，次日回到女子第二院，交給掌管妃嬪的太監沙甲；除非王喜愛她，再提名召她，就不再進去見王。
verses.e: In the evening she went , and on the next day she returned into the second women's house , to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king's eunuch , who kept the concubines . She came in to the king no more , unless the king delighted in her , and she was called by name .

verses.z: 末底改叔叔亞比孩的女兒，就是末底改收為自己女兒的以斯帖，按次序當進去見王的時候，除了掌管女子的太監希該所派定給她的，她別無所求。凡看見以斯帖的都喜悅她。
verses.e: Now when the turn of Esther , the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai , who had taken her for his daughter , came to go in to the king , she required nothing but what Hegai the king's eunuch , the keeper of the women , advised . Esther obtained favor in the sight of all those who looked at her .

verses.z: 亞哈隨魯王第七年十月，就是提別月，以斯帖被引入宮見王。
