verses.e: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month , which is the month Tebeth , in the seventh year of his reign .

verses.z: 王愛以斯帖過於愛眾女，她在王眼前蒙寵愛比眾處女更甚。王就把王后的冠冕戴在她頭上，立她為王后，代替瓦實提。
verses.e: The king loved Esther more than all the women , and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins ; so that he set the royal crown on her head , and made her queen instead of Vashti .

verses.z: 王因以斯帖的緣故給眾首領和臣僕設擺大筵席，又豁免各省的[租稅]，並照王的厚意大頒賞賜。
verses.e: Then the king made a great feast for all his princes and his servants , even Esther's feast ; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces , and gave gifts according to the king's bounty .

verses.z: 第二次招聚處女的時候，末底改坐在朝門。
verses.e: When the virgins were gathered together the second time , Mordecai was sitting in the king's gate .

verses.z: 於是王的侍臣對王說：「不如為王尋找美貌的處女。
verses.e: Then the king's servants who served him said , " Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king .

verses.z: 以斯帖照着末底改所囑咐的，還沒有將籍貫宗族告訴人；因為以斯帖遵*末底改的命，如撫養她的時候一樣。
verses.e: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people , as Mordecai had commanded her ; for Esther obeyed Mordecai , like she did when she was brought up by him .

verses.z: 當那時候，末底改坐在朝門，王的太監中有兩個守門的，辟探和提列，惱恨亞哈隨魯王，想要下手害他。

verses.z: 末底改知道了，就告訴王后以斯帖。以斯帖奉末底改的名，報告於王；
verses.e: This thing became known to Mordecai , who informed Esther the queen ; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai's name .

verses.z: 究察這事，果然是實，就把二人掛在木頭上，將這事在王面前寫於歷史上。
verses.e: When this matter was investigated , and it was found to be so , they were both hanged on a gallows ; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king's presence .

verses.z: 王可以派官在國中的各省招聚美貌的處女到書珊城的女院，交給掌管女子的太監希該，給她們當用的香品。
verses.e: Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom , that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to the citadel of Susa , to the women's house , to the custody of Hegai the king's eunuch , keeper of the women . Let cosmetics be given them ;

verses.z: 王所喜愛的女子可以立為王后，代替瓦實提。」王以這事為美，就如此行。
verses.e: and let the maiden who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti . " The thing pleased the king , and he did so .

verses.z: 書珊城有一個猶大人，名叫末底改，是便雅憫人基士的曾孫，示每的孫子，睚珥的兒子。
verses.e: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai , the son of Jair , the son of Shimei , the son of Kish , a Benjamite ,

verses.z: 從前巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒將猶大王耶哥尼雅和百姓從耶路撒冷擄去，末底改也在其內。
verses.e: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah , whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away .

verses.z: 末底改撫養他叔叔的女兒哈大沙（後名以斯帖），因為她沒有父母。這女子又容貌俊美；她父母死了，末底改就收她為自己的女兒。
verses.e: He brought up Hadassah , that is , Esther , his uncle's daughter ; for she had neither father nor mother . The maiden was fair and beautiful ; and when her father and mother were dead , Mordecai took her for his own daughter .

verses.z: 王的諭旨傳出，就招聚許多女子到書珊城，交給掌管女子的希該；以斯帖也送入王宮，交付希該。
verses.e: So , when the king's commandment and his decree was heard , and when many maidens were gathered together to the citadel of Susa , to the custody of Hegai , Esther was taken into the king's house , to the custody of Hegai , keeper of the women .

verses.z: 希該喜悅以斯帖，就恩待她，急忙給她需用的香品和她所當得的分，又派所當得的七個宮女服事她，使她和她的宮女搬入女院上好的房屋。
verses.e: The maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness from him . He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food , and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king's house . He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women's house .

verses.z: 這事以後，亞哈隨魯王抬舉亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼，使他高升，叫他的爵位超過與他同事的一切臣宰。
verses.e: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , and advanced him , and set his seat above all the princes who were with him .

verses.z: 於是王從自己手上摘下戒指給猶大人的仇敵－亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼。
verses.e: The king took his ring from his hand , and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews ' enemy .

verses.z: 王對哈曼說：「這銀子仍賜給你，這民也交給你，你可以隨意待他們。」
verses.e: The king said to Haman , " The silver is given to you , the people also , to do with them as it seems good to you . "

verses.z: 正月十三日，就召了王的書記來，照着哈曼一切所吩咐的，用各省的文字、各族的方言，奉亞哈隨魯王的名寫旨意，傳與總督和各省的省長，並各族的首領；又用王的戒指蓋印，
verses.e: Then the king's scribes were called in on the first month , on the thirteenth day of the month ; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king's local governors , and to the governors who were over every province , and to the princes of every people , to every province according to its writing , and to every people in their language . It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus , and it was sealed with the king's ring .

verses.z: 交給驛卒傳到王的各省，吩咐將猶大人，無論老少婦女孩子，在一日之間，十二月，就是亞達月十三日，全然剪除，殺戮滅絕，並奪他們的財為掠物。
verses.e: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king's provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to plunder their possessions .

verses.z: 抄錄這旨意，頒行各省，宣告各族，使他們預備等候那日。
verses.e: A copy of the letter , that the decree should be given out in every province , was published to all the peoples , that they should be ready against that day .

verses.z: 驛卒奉王命急忙起行，旨意也傳遍書珊城。王同哈曼坐下飲[酒]，書珊城的民卻都慌亂。
verses.e: The couriers went out in haste by the king's commandment , and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa . The king and Haman sat down to drink ; but the city of Susa was perplexed .

verses.z: 在朝門的一切臣僕都跪拜哈曼，因為王如此吩咐；惟獨末底改不跪不拜。
verses.e: All the king's servants who were in the king's gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman , for the king had so commanded concerning him . But Mordecai didn't bow down or pay him homage .

verses.z: 在朝門的臣僕問末底改說：「你為何違背王的命令呢？」
verses.e: Then the king's servants who were in the king's gate said to Mordecai , " Why do you disobey the king's commandment ? "

verses.z: 他們天天勸他，他還是不聽，他們就告訴哈曼，要看末底改的事站得住站不住，因他已經告訴他們自己是猶大人。
verses.e: Now it came to pass , when they spoke daily to him , and he didn't listen to them , that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai's reason would stand ; for he had told them that he was a Jew .

verses.z: 哈曼見末底改不跪不拜，他就怒氣填胸。
verses.e: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn't bow down nor pay him homage , Haman was full of wrath .

verses.z: 他們已將末底改的本族告訴哈曼；他以為下手害末底改一人是小事，就要滅絕亞哈隨魯王通國所有的猶大人，就是末底改的本族。
verses.e: But he scorned the thought of laying hands on Mordecai alone , for they had made known to him Mordecai's people . Therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , even Mordecai's people .

verses.z: 亞哈隨魯王十二年正月，就是尼散月，人在哈曼面前，按日日月月掣普珥，就是掣籤，要定何月何日為吉，擇定了十二月，就是亞達月。
verses.e: In the first month , which is the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus , they cast Pur , that is , the lot , before Haman from day to day , and from month to month , and chose the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .

verses.z: 哈曼對亞哈隨魯王說：「有一種民散居在王國各省的民中；他們的律例與萬民的律例不同，也不守王的律例，所以容留他們與王無益。
verses.e: Haman said to King Ahasuerus , " There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom , and their laws are different from other people's . They don't keep the king's laws . Therefore it is not for the king's profit to allow them to remain .

verses.z: 王若以為美，請下旨意滅絕他們；我就捐一萬他連得銀子交給掌管國帑的人，納入王的府庫。」
verses.e: If it pleases the king , let it be written that they be destroyed ; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king's business , to bring it into the king's treasuries . "

verses.z: 末底改知道所做的這一切事，就撕裂衣服，穿麻衣，蒙灰塵，在城中行走，痛哭哀號。
verses.e: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done , Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes , and went out into the middle of the city , and wailed loudly and bitterly .

verses.z: 以斯帖就吩咐哈他革去見末底改，[說]：
verses.e: Then Esther spoke to Hathach , and gave him a message to Mordecai :

verses.z: 「王的一切臣僕和各省的人民都知道有一個定例：若不蒙召，擅入內院見王的，無論男女必被治死；除非王向他伸出金杖，不得存活。現在我沒有蒙召進去見王已經三十日了。」
verses.e: " All the king's servants and the people of the king's provinces know that whoever , whether man or woman , comes to the king into the inner court without being called , there is one law for him , that he be put to death , except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter , that he may live . I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days . "

verses.z: 人就把以斯帖這話告訴末底改。
verses.e: They told Esther's words to Mordecai .

verses.z: 末底改託人回覆以斯帖說：「你莫想在王宮裏強過一切猶大人，得免這禍。
verses.e: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther : " Don't think to yourself that you will escape in the king's house any more than all the Jews .

verses.z: 此時你若閉口不言，猶大人必從別處得解脫，蒙拯救；你和你父家必致滅亡。焉知你得了王后的位分不是為現今的機會嗎？」
verses.e: For if you remain silent now , then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place , but you and your father's house will perish . Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this ? "

verses.z: 以斯帖就吩咐人回報末底改說：
verses.e: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai ,

verses.z: 「你當去招聚書珊城所有的猶大人，為我禁食三晝三夜，不吃不喝；我和我的宮女也要這樣禁食。然後我違例進去見王，我若死就死吧！」
verses.e: " Go , gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa , and fast for me , and neither eat nor drink three days , night or day . I and my maidens will also fast the same way . Then I will go in to the king , which is against the law ; and if I perish , I perish . "

verses.z: 於是末底改照以斯帖一切所吩咐的去行。
verses.e: So Mordecai went his way , and did according to all that Esther had commanded him .

verses.z: 到了朝門前[停住腳步]，因為穿麻衣的不可進朝門。
verses.e: He came even before the king's gate , for no one is allowed inside the king's gate clothed with sackcloth .

verses.z: 王的諭旨所到的各省各處，猶大人大大悲哀，禁食哭泣哀號，穿麻衣躺在灰中的甚多。
verses.e: In every province , wherever the king's commandment and his decree came , there was great mourning among the Jews , and fasting , and weeping , and wailing ; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes .

verses.z: 王后以斯帖的宮女和太監來把這事告訴以斯帖，她甚是憂愁，就送衣服給末底改穿，要他脫下麻衣，他卻不受。
verses.e: Esther's maidens and her eunuchs came and told her this , and the queen was exceedingly grieved . She sent clothing to Mordecai , to replace his sackcloth , but he didn't receive it .

verses.z: 以斯帖就把王所派伺候她的一個太監，名叫哈他革召來，吩咐他去見末底改，要知道這是甚麼事，是甚麼緣故。
verses.e: Then Esther called for Hathach , one of the king's eunuchs , whom he had appointed to attend her , and commanded him to go to Mordecai , to find out what this was , and why it was .

verses.z: 於是哈他革出到朝門前的寬闊處見末底改。
verses.e: So Hathach went out to Mordecai , to the city square which was before the king's gate .

verses.z: 末底改將自己所遇的事，並哈曼為滅絕猶大人應許捐入王庫的銀數都告訴了他；
verses.e: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him , and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the destruction of the Jews .

verses.z: 又將所抄寫傳遍書珊城要滅絕猶大人的旨意交給哈他革，要給以斯帖看，又要給她說明，並囑咐她進去見王，為本族的人在王面前懇切祈求。
verses.e: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them , to show it to Esther , and to declare it to her , and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him , and to make request before him for her people .

verses.z: 哈他革回來，將末底改的話告訴以斯帖；
verses.e: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai .

verses.z: 第三日，以斯帖穿上朝服，進王宮的內院，對殿站立。王在殿裏坐在寶座上，對着殿門。
verses.e: Now on the third day , Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king's house , next to the king's house . The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house , next to the entrance of the house .

verses.z: 哈曼暫且忍耐回家，叫人請他朋友和他妻子細利斯來。
verses.e: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself , and went home . There , he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife .

verses.z: 哈曼將他富厚的榮耀、眾多的兒女，和王抬舉他使他超乎首領臣僕之上，都述說給他們聽。
verses.e: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches , the multitude of his children , all the things in which the king had promoted him , and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king .

verses.z: 哈曼又說：「王后以斯帖預備筵席，除了我之外不許別人隨王赴席。明日王后又請我隨王赴席；
verses.e: Haman also said , " Yes , Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself ; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king .

verses.z: 只是我見猶大人末底改坐在朝門，雖有這一切[榮耀]，也與我無益。」
verses.e: Yet all this avails me nothing , so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate . "

verses.z: 他的妻細利斯和他一切的朋友對他說：「不如立一個五丈高的木架，明早求王將末底改掛在其上，然後你可以歡歡喜喜地隨王赴席。」哈曼以這話為美，就叫人做了木架。
verses.e: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him , " Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high , and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it . Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet . " This pleased Haman , so he had the gallows made .

verses.z: 王見王后以斯帖站在院內，就施恩於她，向她伸出手中的金杖；以斯帖便向前摸杖頭。
verses.e: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court , she obtained favor in his sight ; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand . So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter .

verses.z: 王對她說：「王后以斯帖啊，你要甚麼？你求甚麼，就是國的一半也必賜給你。」
verses.e: Then the king asked her , " What would you like , queen Esther ? What is your request ? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom . "

verses.z: 以斯帖說：「王若以為美，就請王帶着哈曼今日赴我所預備的筵席。」
verses.e: Esther said , " If it seems good to the king , let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him . "

verses.z: 王說：「叫哈曼速速照以斯帖的話去行。」於是王帶着哈曼赴以斯帖所預備的筵席。
verses.e: Then the king said , " Bring Haman quickly , so that it may be done as Esther has said . " So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared .

verses.z: 在酒席筵前，王又問以斯帖說：「你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你求甚麼，就是國的一半也必[為你]成就。」
verses.e: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine , " What is your petition ? It shall be granted you . What is your request ? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed . "

verses.z: 以斯帖回答說：「我有所要，我有所求。
verses.e: Then Esther answered and said , " My petition and my request is this .

verses.z: 我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若願意賜我所要的，准我所求的，就請王帶着哈曼再赴我所要預備的筵席。明日我必照王所問的說明。」
verses.e: If I have found favor in the sight of the king , and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request , let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them , and I will do tomorrow as the king has said . "

verses.z: 那日哈曼心中快樂，歡歡喜喜地出來；但見末底改在朝門不站起來，連身也不動，就滿心惱怒末底改。
verses.e: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart , but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate , that he didn't stand up nor move for him , he was filled with wrath against Mordecai .

verses.z: 那夜王睡不着覺，就吩咐人取歷史來，念給他聽。
verses.e: On that night , the king couldn't sleep . He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought , and they were read to the king .

verses.z: 王對哈曼說：「你速速將這衣服和馬，照你所說的，向坐在朝門的猶大人末底改去行。凡你所說的，一樣不可缺。」
verses.e: Then the king said to Haman , " Hurry and take the clothing and the horse , as you have said , and do this for Mordecai the Jew , who sits at the king's gate . Let nothing fail of all that you have spoken . "

verses.z: 於是哈曼將朝服給末底改穿上，使他騎上馬，走遍城裏的街市，在他面前宣告說：「王所喜悅尊榮的人，就如此待他。」
verses.e: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse , and arrayed Mordecai , and had him ride through the city square , and proclaimed before him , " Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor ! "

verses.z: 末底改仍回到朝門，哈曼卻憂憂悶悶地蒙着頭，急忙回家去了，
verses.e: Mordecai came back to the king's gate , but Haman hurried to his house , mourning and having his head covered .

verses.z: 將所遇的一切事詳細說給他的妻細利斯和他的眾朋友聽。他的智慧人和他的妻細利斯對他說：「你在末底改面前始而敗落，他如果是猶大人，你必不能勝他，終必在他面前敗落。」
verses.e: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him . Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him , " If Mordecai , before whom you have begun to fall , is of Jewish descent , you will not prevail against him , but you will surely fall before him . "

verses.z: 他們還與哈曼說話的時候，王的太監來催哈曼快去赴以斯帖所預備的筵席。
verses.e: While they were yet talking with him , the king's eunuchs came , and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared .

verses.z: 正遇見書上寫着[說]：王的太監中有兩個守門的，辟探和提列，想要下手害亞哈隨魯王，末底改將這事告訴[王后]。
verses.e: It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king's eunuchs , who were doorkeepers , who had tried to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus .

verses.z: 王說：「末底改行了這事，賜他甚麼尊榮爵位沒有？」伺候王的臣僕回答說：「沒有賜他甚麼。」
verses.e: The king said , " What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this ? " Then the king's servants who attended him said , " Nothing has been done for him . "

verses.z: 王說：「誰在院子裏？」（那時哈曼正進王宮的外院，要求王將末底改掛在他所預備的木架上。）
verses.e: The king said , " Who is in the court ? " Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king's house , to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him .

verses.z: 臣僕說：「哈曼站在院內。」王說：「叫他進來。」
verses.e: The king's servants said to him , " Behold , Haman stands in the court . " The king said , " Let him come in . "

verses.z: 哈曼就進去。王問他說：「王所喜悅尊榮的人，當如何待他呢？」哈曼心裏說：「王所喜悅尊榮的，不是我是誰呢？」
verses.e: So Haman came in . The king said to him , " What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor ? " Now Haman said in his heart , " Who would the king delight to honor more than myself ? "

verses.z: 哈曼就回答說：「王所喜悅尊榮的，
verses.e: Haman said to the king , " For the man whom the king delights to honor ,

verses.z: 當將王常穿的朝服和戴冠的御馬，
verses.e: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear , and the horse that the king rides on , and on the head of which a royal crown is set .

verses.z: 都交給王極尊貴的一個大臣，命他將衣服給王所喜悅尊榮的人穿上，使他騎上馬，走遍城裏的街市，在他面前宣告說：王所喜悅尊榮的人，就如此待他。」
verses.e: Let the clothing and the horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes , that they may array the man whom the king delights to honor with them , and have him ride on horseback through the city square , and proclaim before him , ' Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor ! ' "

verses.z: 王帶着哈曼來赴王后以斯帖的筵席。
verses.e: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen .

verses.z: 於是人將哈曼掛在他為末底改所預備的木架上。王的忿怒這才止息。
verses.e: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai . Then the king's wrath was pacified .

verses.z: 這第二次在酒席筵前，王又問以斯帖說：「王后以斯帖啊，你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你求甚麼，*就是國的一半也必[為你]成就。」
verses.e: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine , " What is your petition , queen Esther ? It shall be granted you . What is your request ? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed . "

verses.z: 王后以斯帖回答說：「我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若以為美，我所願的，是願王將我的性命賜給我；我所求的，是求王將我的本族賜給我。
verses.e: Then Esther the queen answered , " If I have found favor in your sight , O king , and if it pleases the king , let my life be given me at my petition , and my people at my request .

verses.z: 因我和我的本族被賣了，要剪除殺戮滅絕我們。我們若被賣為奴為婢，我也閉口不言；但王的損失，敵人萬不能補足。」
verses.e: For we are sold , I and my people , to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish . But if we had been sold for male and female slaves , I would have held my peace , although the adversary could not have compensated for the king's loss . "

verses.z: 亞哈隨魯王問王后以斯帖說：「擅敢起意如此行的是誰？這人在哪裏呢？」
verses.e: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen , " Who is he , and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so ? "

verses.z: 以斯帖說：「仇人敵人就是這惡人哈曼！」哈曼在王和王后面前就甚驚惶。
verses.e: Esther said , " An adversary and an enemy , even this wicked Haman ! " Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen .

verses.z: 王便大怒，起來離開酒席往御園去了。哈曼見王定意要加罪與他，就起來，求王后以斯帖救命。
verses.e: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden . Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen , for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king .

verses.z: 王從御園回到酒席之處，見哈曼伏在以斯帖所靠的榻上；王說：「他竟敢在宮內、在我面前凌辱王后嗎？」這話一出王口，人就蒙了哈曼的臉。
verses.e: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine ; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was . Then the king said , " Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house ? " As the word went out of the king's mouth , they covered Haman's face .

verses.z: 伺候王的一個太監名叫哈波拿，說：「哈曼為那救王有功的末底改做了五丈高的木架，現今立在哈曼家裏。」王說：「把哈曼掛在其上。」
verses.e: Then Harbonah , one of the eunuchs who were with the king , said , " Behold , the gallows fifty cubits high , which Haman has made for Mordecai , who spoke good for the king , is standing at Haman's house . " The king said , " Hang him on it ! "

verses.z: 當日，亞哈隨魯王把猶大人仇敵哈曼的家產賜給王后以斯帖。末底改也來到王面前，因為以斯帖已經告訴王，末底改是她的親屬。
verses.e: On that day , King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman , the Jews ' enemy , to Esther the queen . Mordecai came before the king ; for Esther had told what he was to her .

verses.z: 末底改奉亞哈隨魯王的名寫諭旨，用王的戒指蓋印，交給騎御馬圈快馬的驛卒，傳[到各處]。
verses.e: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus , and sealed it with the king's ring , and sent letters by courier on horseback , riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds .

verses.z: 諭旨中，王准各省各城的猶大人在一日之間，十二月，就是亞達月十三日，聚集保護性命，剪除殺戮滅絕那要攻擊猶大人的一切仇敵和他們的妻子兒女，奪取他們的財為掠物。
verses.e: In those letters , the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives — to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them , their little ones and women , and to plunder their possessions ,
on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus , on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .

verses.z: 抄錄這諭旨，頒行各省，宣告各族，使猶大人預備等候那日，在仇敵身上報仇。
verses.e: A copy of the letter , that the decree should be given out in every province , was published to all the peoples , that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies .

verses.z: 於是騎快馬的驛卒被王命催促，急忙起行；諭旨也傳遍書珊城。
verses.e: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out , hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment . The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa .

verses.z: 末底改穿着藍色白色的朝服，頭戴大金冠冕，又穿紫色細麻布的外袍，從王面前出來；書珊城的人民都歡呼快樂。
verses.e: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white , and with a great crown of gold , and with a robe of fine linen and purple ; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad .

verses.z: 猶大人有光榮，歡喜快樂而得尊貴。
verses.e: The Jews had light , gladness , joy , and honor .

verses.z: 王的諭旨所到的各省各城，猶大人都歡喜快樂，設擺筵宴，以那日為吉日。那國的人民，有許多因懼怕猶大人，就入了猶大籍。
verses.e: In every province and in every city , wherever the king's commandment and his decree came , the Jews had gladness , joy , a feast and a holiday . Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews , for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them .

verses.z: 王摘下自己的戒指，就是從哈曼追回的，給了末底改。以斯帖派末底改管理哈曼的家產。
verses.e: The king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it to Mordecai . Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .

verses.z: 以斯帖又俯伏在王腳前，流淚哀告，求他除掉亞甲族哈曼害猶大人的惡謀。
verses.e: Esther spoke yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite , and his plan that he had planned against the Jews .

verses.z: 王向以斯帖伸出金杖；以斯帖就起來，站在王前，
verses.e: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter . So Esther arose , and stood before the king .

verses.z: 說：「亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼設謀傳旨，要殺滅在王各省的猶大人。現今王若願意，我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若以為美，若喜悅我，請王另下旨意，廢除哈曼所傳的那旨意。
verses.e: She said , " If it pleases the king , and if I have found favor in his sight , and the thing seems right to the king , and I am pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman , the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king's provinces .

verses.z: 我何忍見我本族的人受害？何忍見我同宗的人被滅呢？」
verses.e: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people ? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives ? "

verses.z: 亞哈隨魯王對王后以斯帖和猶大人末底改說：「因哈曼要下手害猶大人，我已將他的家產賜給以斯帖，人也將哈曼掛在木架上。
verses.e: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , " See , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews .

verses.z: 現在你們可以隨意奉王的名寫諭旨給猶大人，用王的戒指蓋印；因為奉王名所寫、用王戒指蓋印的諭旨，人都不能廢除。」
verses.e: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you , in the king's name , and seal it with the king's ring ; for the writing which is written in the king's name , and sealed with the king's ring , may not be reversed by any man . "

verses.z: 三月，就是西彎月二十三日，將王的書記召來，按着末底改所吩咐的，用各省的文字、各族的方言，並猶大人的文字方言寫諭旨，傳給那從印度直到古實一百二十七省的猶大人和總督省長首領。
verses.e: Then the king's scribes were called at that time , in the third month , which is the month Sivan , on the twenty-third day of the month ; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews , and to the local governors , and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia , one hundred twenty-seven provinces , to every province according to its writing , and to every people in their language , and to the Jews in their writing , and in their language .

verses.z: 十二月，乃亞達月十三日，王的諭旨將要舉行，就是猶大人的仇敵盼望轄制他們的日子，猶大人反倒轄制恨他們的人。
verses.e: Now in the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , on the thirteenth day of the month , when the king's commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution , on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them , ( but it turned out that the opposite happened , that the Jews conquered those who hated them ) ,

verses.z: 這十人都是哈米大他的孫子、猶大人仇敵哈曼的兒子。猶大人卻沒有下手奪取財物。
verses.e: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha , the Jews ' enemy , but they didn't lay their hand on the plunder .

verses.z: 當日，將書珊城被殺的人數呈在王前。
verses.e: On that day , the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king .

verses.z: 王對王后以斯帖說：「猶大人在書珊城殺滅了五百人，又殺了哈曼的十個兒子，在王的各省不知如何呢？現在你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你還求甚麼，也必[為你]成就。」
verses.e: The king said to Esther the queen , " The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa , including the ten sons of Haman ; what then have they done in the rest of the king's provinces ! Now what is your petition ? It shall be granted you . What is your further request ? It shall be done . "

verses.z: 以斯帖說：「王若以為美，求你准書珊的猶大人，明日也照今日的旨意行，並將哈曼十個兒子的屍首掛在木架上。」
verses.e: Then Esther said , " If it pleases the king , let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today's decree , and let Haman's ten sons be hanged on the gallows . "

verses.z: 王便允准如此行。旨意傳在書珊，人就把哈曼十個兒子的屍首掛起來了。
verses.e: The king commanded this to be done . A decree was given out in Susa ; and they hanged Haman's ten sons .

verses.z: 亞達月十四日，書珊的猶大人又聚集在書珊，殺了三百人，卻沒有下手奪取財物。
verses.e: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar , and killed three hundred men in Susa ; but they didn't lay their hand on the plunder .

verses.z: 在王各省其餘的猶大人也都聚集保護性命，殺了恨他們的人七萬五千，卻沒有下手奪取財物。這樣，就脫離仇敵，得享平安。
verses.e: The other Jews who were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together , defended their lives , had rest from their enemies , and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them ; but they didn't lay their hand on the plunder .

verses.z: 亞達月十三日，[行了這事]；十四日安息，以這日為設筵歡樂的日子。
verses.e: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar ; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness .

verses.z: 但書珊的猶大人，這十三日、十四日聚集[殺戮仇敵]；十五日安息，以這日為設筵歡樂的日子。
verses.e: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month ; and on the fifteenth day of that month , they rested , and made it a day of feasting and gladness .

verses.z: 所以住無城牆鄉村的猶大人，如今都以亞達月十四日為設筵歡樂的吉日，彼此餽送禮物。
verses.e: Therefore the Jews of the villages , who live in the unwalled towns , make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting , a holiday , and a day of sending presents of food to one another .

verses.z: 猶大人在亞哈隨魯王各省的城裏聚集，下手擊殺那要害他們的人。無人能敵擋他們，因為各族都懼怕他們。
verses.e: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus , to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them . No one could withstand them , because the fear of them had fallen on all the people .

verses.z: 末底改記錄這事，寫信與亞哈隨魯王各省遠近所有的猶大人，
verses.e: Mordecai wrote these things , and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus , both near and far ,

verses.z: 囑咐他們每年守亞達月十四、十五兩日，
verses.e: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly ,

verses.z: 以這月的兩日為猶大人脫離仇敵得平安、轉憂為喜、轉悲為樂的吉日。在這兩日設筵歡樂，彼此餽送禮物，賙濟窮人。
verses.e: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies , and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness , and from mourning into a holiday ; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness , and of sending presents of food to one another , and gifts to the needy .

verses.z: 於是，猶大人按着末底改所寫與他們的信，應承照初次所守的守為永例；
verses.e: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun , as Mordecai had written to them ,

verses.z: 是因猶大人的仇敵亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼設謀殺害猶大人，掣普珥，就是掣籤，為要殺盡滅絕他們；
verses.e: because Haman the son of Hammedatha , the Agagite , the enemy of all the Jews , had plotted against the Jews to destroy them , and had cast " Pur " , that is the lot , to consume them and to destroy them ;

verses.z: 這事報告於王，王便降旨使哈曼謀害猶大人的惡事歸到他自己的頭上，並吩咐把他和他的眾子都掛在木架上。
verses.e: but when this became known to the king , he commanded by letters that his wicked plan , which he had planned against the Jews , should return on his own head , and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows .

verses.z: 照着普珥的名字，猶大人就稱這兩日為「普珥日」。他們因這信上的話，又因所看見所遇見的事，
verses.e: Therefore they called these days " Purim " , from the word " Pur . " Therefore because of all the words of this letter , and of that which they had seen concerning this matter , and that which had come to them ,

verses.z: 就應承自己與後裔，並歸附他們的人，每年按時必守這兩日，永遠不廢。
verses.e: the Jews established and imposed on themselves , on their descendants , and on all those who joined themselves to them , so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year ;

verses.z: 各省各城、家家戶戶、世世代代紀念遵守這兩日，使這「普珥日」在猶大人中不可廢掉，在他們後裔中也不可忘記。
verses.e: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation , every family , every province , and every city ; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews , nor their memory perish from their offspring .

verses.z: 亞比孩的女兒－王后以斯帖和猶大人末底改以全權寫第二封信，堅囑猶大人守這「普珥日」，
verses.e: Then Esther the queen , the daughter of Abihail , and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim .

verses.z: 各省的首領、總督、省長，和辦理王事的人，因懼怕末底改，就都幫助猶大人。
verses.e: All the princes of the provinces , the local governors , the governors , and those who did the king's business helped the Jews , because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them .

verses.z: 用和平誠實話寫信給亞哈隨魯[王]國中一百二十七省所有的猶大人，
verses.e: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth ,

verses.z: 勸他們按時守這「普珥日」，禁食呼求，是照猶大人末底改和王后以斯帖所囑咐的，也照猶大人為自己與後裔所應承的。
verses.e: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times , as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed , and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning .

verses.z: 以斯帖命定守「普珥日」，這事也記錄在書上。
verses.e: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim ; and it was written in the book .

verses.z: 末底改在朝中為大，名聲傳遍各省，日漸昌盛。
verses.e: For Mordecai was great in the king's house , and his fame went out throughout all the provinces , for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater .

verses.z: 猶大人用刀擊殺一切仇敵，任意殺滅恨他們的人。
verses.e: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword , and with slaughter and destruction , and did what they wanted to those who hated them .

verses.z: 在書珊城，猶大人殺滅了五百人；
verses.e: In the citadel of Susa , the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men .

verses.z: 又殺巴珊大他、達分、亞斯帕他、
verses.e: They killed Parshandatha , Dalphon , Aspatha ,

verses.z: 破拉他、亞大利雅、亞利大他、
verses.e: Poratha , Adalia , Aridatha ,

verses.z: 帕瑪斯他、亞利賽、亞利代、瓦耶撒他；
verses.e: Parmashta , Arisai , Aridai , and Vaizatha ,

verses.z: 以色列的眾子，各帶家眷，和雅各一同來到埃及。他們的名字記在下面。
verses.e: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel , who came into Egypt ( every man and his household came with Jacob ) :

verses.z: 來吧，我們不如用巧計待他們，恐怕他們多起來，日後若遇甚麼爭戰的事，就連合我們的仇敵攻擊我們，離開這地去了。」
verses.e: Come , let's deal wisely with them , lest they multiply , and it happen that when any war breaks out , they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us , and escape out of the land . "

verses.z: 於是埃及人派督工的轄制他們，加重擔苦害他們。他們為法老建造兩座積貨城，就是比東和蘭塞。
verses.e: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens . They built storage cities for Pharaoh : Pithom and Raamses .

verses.z: 只是越發苦害他們，他們越發多起來，越發蔓延；埃及人就因以色列人愁煩。
verses.e: But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and the more they spread out . They started to dread the children of Israel .

verses.z: 埃及人嚴嚴地使以色列人做工，
verses.e: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve ,

verses.z: 使他們因做苦工覺得命苦；無論是和泥，是做磚，是做田間各樣的工，在一切的工上都嚴嚴地待他們。
verses.e: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick , and in all kinds of service in the field , all their service , in which they ruthlessly made them serve .

verses.z: 有希伯來的兩個收生婆，一名施弗拉，一名普阿；埃及王對她們說：
verses.e: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives , of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah , and the name of the other Puah ,

verses.z: 「你們為希伯來婦人收生，看她們臨盆的時候，若是男孩，就把他殺了；若是女孩，就留她存活。」
verses.e: and he said , " When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women , and see them on the birth stool , if it is a son , then you shall kill him ; but if it is a daughter , then she shall live . "

verses.z: 但是收生婆敬畏上帝，不照埃及王的吩咐行，竟存留男孩的性命。
verses.e: But the midwives feared God , and didn't do what the king of Egypt commanded them , but saved the baby boys alive .

verses.z: 埃及王召了收生婆來，說：「你們為甚麼做這事，存留男孩的性命呢？」
verses.e: The king of Egypt called for the midwives , and said to them , " Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive ? "

verses.z: 收生婆對法老說：「因為希伯來婦人與埃及婦人不同；希伯來婦人本是健壯的，收生婆還沒有到，她們已經生產了。」
verses.e: The midwives said to Pharaoh , " Because the Hebrew women aren't like the Egyptian women ; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them . "

verses.z: 有呂便、西緬、利未、猶大、
verses.e: Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah ,

verses.z: 上帝厚待收生婆。以色列人多起來，極其強盛。
verses.e: God dealt well with the midwives , and the people multiplied , and grew very mighty .

verses.z: 收生婆因為敬畏上帝，上帝便叫她們成立家室。
verses.e: Because the midwives feared God , he gave them families .

verses.z: 法老吩咐他的眾民說：「以色列人所生的男孩，你們都要丟在河裏；一切的女孩，你們要存留她的性命。」
verses.e: Pharaoh commanded all his people , saying , " You shall cast every son who is born into the river , and every daughter you shall save alive . "

verses.z: 以薩迦、西布倫、便雅憫、
verses.e: Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,

verses.z: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亞設。
verses.e: Dan and Naphtali , Gad and Asher .

verses.z: 凡從雅各而生的，共有七十人。約瑟已經在埃及。
verses.e: All the souls who came out of Jacob's body were seventy souls , and Joseph was in Egypt already .

verses.z: 約瑟和他的弟兄，並那一代的人，都死了。
verses.e: Joseph died , as did all his brothers , and all that generation .

verses.z: 以色列人生養眾多，並且繁茂，極其強盛，滿了那地。
verses.e: The children of Israel were fruitful , and increased abundantly , and multiplied , and grew exceedingly mighty ; and the land was filled with them .

verses.z: 有不認識約瑟的新王起來，治理埃及，
verses.e: Now there arose a new king over Egypt , who didn't know Joseph .

verses.z: 對他的百姓說：「看哪，這以色列民比我們還多，又比我們強盛。
verses.e: He said to his people , " Behold , the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你進去見法老。我使他和他臣僕的心剛硬，為要在他們中間顯我這些神蹟，
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Go in to Pharaoh , for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants , that I may show these my signs among them ;

verses.z: 法老對他們說：「我容你們和你們[婦人]孩子去的時候，耶和華與你們同在吧！你們要謹慎；因為有禍在你們眼前，
verses.e: He said to them , " The LORD be with you if I let you go with your little ones ! See , evil is clearly before your faces .

verses.z: 不可都去！你們這壯年人去事奉耶和華吧，因為這是你們所求的。」於是把他們從法老面前攆出去。
verses.e: Not so ! Go now you who are men , and serve the LORD ; for that is what you desire ! " Then they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向埃及地伸杖，使蝗蟲到埃及地上來，吃地上一切的菜蔬，就是冰雹所剩的。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts , that they may come up on the land of Egypt , and eat every herb of the land , even all that the hail has left . "

verses.z: 摩西就向埃及地伸杖，那一晝一夜，耶和華使東風颳在埃及地上；到了早晨，東風把蝗蟲颳了來。
verses.e: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt , and the LORD brought an east wind on the land all that day , and all night ; and when it was morning , the east wind brought the locusts .

verses.z: 蝗蟲上來，落在埃及的四境，甚是厲害；以前沒有這樣的，以後也必沒有。
verses.e: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt , and rested in all the borders of Egypt . They were very grievous . Before them there were no such locusts as they , nor will there ever be again .

verses.z: 因為這蝗蟲遮滿地面，甚至地都黑暗了，又吃地上一切的菜蔬和冰雹所剩樹上的果子。埃及遍地，無論是樹木，是田間的菜蔬，連一點青的也沒有留下。
verses.e: For they covered the surface of the whole earth , so that the land was darkened , and they ate every herb of the land , and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left . There remained nothing green , either tree or herb of the field , through all the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 於是法老急忙召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「我得罪耶和華－你們的上帝，又得罪了你們。
verses.e: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste , and he said , " I have sinned against the LORD your God , and against you .

verses.z: 現在求你，只這一次，饒恕我的罪，求耶和華－你們的上帝使我脫離這一次的死亡。」
verses.e: Now therefore please forgive my sin again , and pray to the LORD your God , that he may also take away from me this death . "

verses.z: 摩西就離開法老去求耶和華。
verses.e: Moses went out from Pharaoh , and prayed to the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華轉了極大的西風，把蝗蟲颳起，吹入紅海；在埃及的四境連一個也沒有留下。
verses.e: The LORD sent an exceedingly strong west wind , which took up the locusts , and drove them into the Red Sea . There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt .

verses.z: 並要叫你將我向埃及人所做的事，和在他們中間所行的神蹟，傳於你兒子和你孫子的耳中，好叫你們知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son , and of your son's son , what things I have done to Egypt , and my signs which I have done among them ; that you may know that I am the LORD . "

verses.z: 但耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人去。
verses.e: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart , and he didn't let the children of Israel go .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向天伸杖，使埃及地黑暗；這黑暗似乎摸得着。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Stretch out your hand toward the sky , that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt , even darkness which may be felt . "

verses.z: 摩西向天伸杖，埃及遍地就烏黑了三天。
verses.e: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky , and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days .

verses.z: 三天之久，人不能相見，誰也不敢起來離開本處；惟有以色列人家中都有亮光。
verses.e: They didn't see one another , and nobody rose from his place for three days ; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings .

verses.z: 法老就召摩西來，說：「你們去事奉耶和華；只是你們的羊群牛群要留下；你們的[婦人]孩子可以和你們同去。」
verses.e: Pharaoh called to Moses , and said , " Go , serve the LORD . Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind . Let your little ones also go with you . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「你總要把祭物和燔祭牲交給我們，使我們可以祭祀耶和華－我們的上帝。
verses.e: Moses said , " You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings , that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God .

verses.z: 我們的牲畜也要帶去，連一蹄也不留下；因為我們要從其中取出來，事奉耶和華－我們的上帝。我們未到那裏，還不知道用甚麼事奉耶和華。」
verses.e: Our livestock also shall go with us . Not a hoof shall be left behind , for of it we must take to serve the LORD our God ; and we don't know with what we must serve the LORD , until we come there . "

verses.z: 但耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不肯容他們去。
verses.e: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart , and he wouldn't let them go .

verses.z: 法老對摩西說：「你離開我去吧，你要小心，不要再見我的面！因為你見我面的那日你就必死！」
verses.e: Pharaoh said to him , " Get away from me ! Be careful to see my face no more ; for in the day you see my face you shall die ! "

verses.z: 摩西說：「你說得好！我必不再見你的面了。」
verses.e: Moses said , " You have spoken well . I will see your face again no more . "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫就進去見法老，對他說：「耶和華－希伯來人的上帝這樣說：『你在我面前不肯自卑要到幾時呢？容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh , and said to him , " This is what the LORD , the God of the Hebrews , says : ' How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me ? Let my people go , that they may serve me .

verses.z: 你若不肯容我的百姓去，明天我要使蝗蟲進入你的境內，
verses.e: Or else , if you refuse to let my people go , behold , tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country ,

verses.z: 遮滿地面，甚至看不見地，並且吃那冰雹所剩的和田間所長的一切樹木。
verses.e: and they shall cover the surface of the earth , so that one won't be able to see the earth . They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped , which remains to you from the hail , and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field .

verses.z: 你的宮殿和你眾臣僕的房屋，並一切埃及人的房屋，都要被蝗蟲佔滿了；自從你祖宗和你祖宗的祖宗在世以來，直到今日，沒有見過這樣的[災]。』」摩西就轉身離開法老出去。
verses.e: Your houses shall be filled , and the houses of all your servants , and the houses of all the Egyptians , as neither your fathers nor your fathers ' fathers have seen , since the day that they were on the earth to this day . ' " He turned , and went out from Pharaoh .

verses.z: 法老的臣僕對法老說：「這人為我們的網羅要到幾時呢？容這些人去事奉耶和華－他們的上帝吧！埃及已經敗壞了，你還不知道嗎？」
verses.e: Pharaoh's servants said to him , " How long will this man be a snare to us ? Let the men go , that they may serve the LORD , their God . Don't you yet know that Egypt is destroyed ? "

verses.z: 於是摩西、亞倫被召回來見法老；法老對他們說：「你們去事奉耶和華－你們的上帝；但那要去的是誰呢？」
verses.e: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh , and he said to them , " Go , serve the LORD your God ; but who are those who will go ? "

verses.z: 摩西說：「我們要和我們老的少的、兒子女兒同去，且把羊群牛群一同帶去，因為我們務要向耶和華守節。」
verses.e: Moses said , " We will go with our young and with our old . We will go with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds ; for we must hold a feast to the LORD . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「我再使一樣的災殃臨到法老和埃及，然後他必容你們離開這地。他容你們去的時候，總要催逼你們都從這地出去。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh , and on Egypt ; afterwards he will let you go . When he lets you go , he will surely thrust you out altogether .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫在法老面前行了這一切奇事；耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人出離他的地。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh , but the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart , and he didn't let the children of Israel go out of his land .

verses.z: 你要傳於百姓的耳中，叫他們男女各人向鄰舍要金器銀器。」
verses.e: Speak now in the ears of the people , and let every man ask of his neighbor , and every woman of her neighbor , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold . "

verses.z: 耶和華叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，並且摩西在埃及地、法老臣僕，和百姓的眼中看為極大。
verses.e: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians . Moreover , the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt , in the sight of Pharaoh's servants , and in the sight of the people .

verses.z: 摩西說：「耶和華這樣說：『約到半夜，我必出去巡行埃及遍地。
verses.e: Moses said , " This is what the LORD says : ' About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt ,

verses.z: 凡在埃及地，從坐寶座的法老直到磨子後的婢女所有的長子，以及一切頭生的牲畜，都必死。
verses.e: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die , from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne , even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill , and all the firstborn of livestock .

verses.z: 埃及遍地必有大哀號；從前沒有這樣的，後來也必沒有。
verses.e: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt , such as there has not been , nor will be any more .

verses.z: 至於以色列中，無論是人是牲畜，連狗也不敢向他們搖舌，好叫你們知道耶和華是將埃及人和以色列人分別出來。』
verses.e: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won't even bark or move its tongue , against man or animal , that you may know that the LORD makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel .

verses.z: 你這一切臣僕都要俯伏來見我，說：『求你和跟從你的百姓都出去』，然後我要出去。」於是，摩西氣忿忿地離開法老，出去了。
verses.e: All these servants of yours will come down to me , and bow down themselves to me , saying , " Get out , with all the people who follow you ; " and after that I will go out . ' " He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「法老必不聽你們，使我的奇事在埃及地多起來。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Pharaoh won't listen to you , that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt . "

verses.z: 耶和華在埃及地曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt , saying ,

verses.z: 不可剩下一點留到早晨；若留到早晨，要用火燒了。
verses.e: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning ; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire .

verses.z: 你們吃羊羔當腰間束帶，腳上穿鞋，手中拿杖，趕緊地吃；這是耶和華的逾越節。
verses.e: This is how you shall eat it : with your belt on your waist , your sandals on your feet , and your staff in your hand ; and you shall eat it in haste : it is the LORD's Passover .

verses.z: 因為那夜我要巡行埃及地，把埃及地一切頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都擊殺了，又要敗壞埃及一切的神。我是耶和華。
verses.e: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night , and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both man and animal . I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 這血要在你們所住的房屋上作記號；我一見這血，就越過你們去。我擊殺埃及地[頭生]的時候，災殃必不臨到你們身上滅你們。」
verses.e: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are . When I see the blood , I will pass over you , and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 「你們要記念這日，守為耶和華的節，作為你們世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: This day shall be a memorial for you . You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD . You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever .

verses.z: 你們要吃無酵餅七日。頭一日要把酵從你們各家中除去；因為從頭一日起，到第七日為止，凡吃有酵之餅的，必從以色列中剪除。
verses.e: " ' Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread ; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses , for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day , that soul shall be cut off from Israel .

verses.z: 頭一日你們當有聖會，第七日也當有聖會。這兩日之內，除了預備各人所要吃的以外，無論何工都不可做。
verses.e: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation , and in the seventh day a holy convocation ; no kind of work shall be done in them , except that which every man must eat , only that may be done by you .

verses.z: 你們要守無酵節，因為我正當這日把你們的軍隊從埃及地領出來。所以，你們要守這日，作為世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread ; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt . Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever .

verses.z: 從正月十四日晚上，直到二十一日晚上，你們要吃無酵餅。
verses.e: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at evening , you shall eat unleavened bread , until the twenty first day of the month at evening .

verses.z: 在你們各家中，七日之內不可有酵；因為凡吃有酵之物的，無論是寄居的，是本地的，必從以色列的會中剪除。
verses.e: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days , for whoever eats that which is leavened , that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel , whether he is a foreigner , or one who is born in the land .

verses.z: 「你們要以本月為正月，為一年之首。
verses.e: " This month shall be to you the beginning of months . It shall be the first month of the year to you .

verses.z: 有酵的物，你們都不可吃；在你們一切住處要吃無酵餅。」
verses.e: You shall eat nothing leavened . In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread . ' "

verses.z: 於是，摩西召了以色列的眾長老來，對他們說：「你們要按着家口取出羊羔，把這逾越節[的羊羔]宰了。
verses.e: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel , and said to them , " Draw out , and take lambs according to your families , and kill the Passover .

verses.z: 拿一把牛膝草，蘸盆裏的血，打在門楣上和左右的門框上。你們誰也不可出自己的房門，直到早晨。
verses.e: You shall take a bunch of hyssop , and dip it in the blood that is in the basin , and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin . None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning .

verses.z: 因為耶和華要巡行擊殺埃及人，他看見血在門楣上和左右的門框上，就必越過那門，不容滅命的進你們的房屋，擊殺你們。
verses.e: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians ; and when he sees the blood on the lintel , and on the two door posts , the LORD will pass over the door , and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you .

verses.z: 這例，你們要守着，作為你們和你們子孫永遠的定例。
verses.e: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever .

verses.z: 日後，你們到了耶和華按着所應許賜給你們的那地，就要守這禮。
verses.e: It shall happen when you have come to the land which the LORD will give you , as he has promised , that you shall keep this service .

verses.z: 你們的兒女問你們說：『行這禮是甚麼意思？』
verses.e: It will happen , when your children ask you , ' What do you mean by this service ? '

verses.z: 你們就說：『這是獻給耶和華逾越節的祭。當以色列人在埃及的時候，他擊殺埃及人，越過以色列人的房屋，救了我們各家。』」於是百姓低頭下拜。
verses.e: that you shall say , ' It is the sacrifice of the LORD's Passover , who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt , when he struck the Egyptians , and spared our houses . ' " The people bowed their heads and worshiped .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西、亞倫，以色列人就怎樣行。
verses.e: The children of Israel went and did so ; as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron , so they did .

verses.z: 到了半夜，耶和華把埃及地所有的長子，就是從坐寶座的法老，直到被擄囚在監裏之人的長子，以及一切頭生的牲畜，盡都殺了。
verses.e: At midnight , the LORD struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon , and all the firstborn of livestock .

verses.z: 你們吩咐以色列全會眾說：本月初十日，各人要按着父家取羊羔，一家一隻。
verses.e: Speak to all the congregation of Israel , saying , ' On the tenth day of this month , they shall take to them every man a lamb , according to their fathers ' houses , a lamb for a household ;

verses.z: 法老和一切臣僕，並埃及眾人，夜間都起來了。在埃及有大哀號，無一家不死一個人的。
verses.e: Pharaoh rose up in the night , he , and all his servants , and all the Egyptians ; and there was a great cry in Egypt , for there was not a house where there was not one dead .

verses.z: 夜間，法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「起來！連你們帶以色列人，從我民中出去，依你們所說的，去事奉耶和華吧！
verses.e: He called for Moses and Aaron by night , and said , " Rise up , get out from among my people , both you and the children of Israel ; and go , serve the LORD , as you have said !

verses.z: 也依你們所說的，連羊群牛群帶着走吧！並要為我祝福。」
verses.e: Take both your flocks and your herds , as you have said , and be gone ; and bless me also ! "

verses.z: 埃及人催促百姓，打發他們快快出離那地，因為埃及人說：「我們都要死了。」
verses.e: The Egyptians were urgent with the people , to send them out of the land in haste , for they said , " We are all dead men . "

verses.z: 百姓就拿着沒有酵的生麵，把摶麵盆包在衣服中，扛在肩頭上。
verses.e: The people took their dough before it was leavened , their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders .

verses.z: 以色列人照着摩西的話行，向埃及人要金器、銀器，和衣裳。
verses.e: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses ; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and clothing .

verses.z: 耶和華叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，以致埃及人給他們所要的。他們就把埃及人的[財物]奪去了。
verses.e: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians , so that they let them have what they asked . They plundered the Egyptians .

verses.z: 以色列人從蘭塞起行，往疏割去；除了[婦人]孩子，步行的男人約有六十萬。
verses.e: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth , about six hundred thousand on foot who were men , in addition to children .

verses.z: 又有許多閒雜人，並有羊群牛群，和他們一同上去。
verses.e: A mixed multitude went up also with them , with flocks , herds , and even very much livestock .

verses.z: 他們用埃及帶出來的生麵烤成無酵餅。這生麵原沒有發起；因為他們被催逼離開埃及，不能耽延，也沒有為自己預備甚麼食物。
verses.e: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt ; for it wasn't leavened , because they were thrust out of Egypt , and couldn't wait , and they had not prepared any food for themselves .

verses.z: 若是一家的人太少，吃不了一隻羊羔，本人就要和他隔壁的鄰舍共取一隻。你們預備羊羔，要按着人數和飯量計算。
verses.e: and if the household is too little for a lamb , then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls . You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat .

verses.z: 以色列人住在埃及共有四百三十年。
verses.e: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years .

verses.z: 正滿了四百三十年的那一天，耶和華的軍隊都從埃及地出來了。
verses.e: At the end of four hundred thirty years , to the day , all of the LORD's armies went out from the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 這夜是耶和華的夜；因耶和華領他們出了埃及地，所以當向耶和華謹守，是以色列眾人世世代代該謹守的。
verses.e: It is a night to be much observed to the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt . This is that night of the LORD , to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：「逾越節的例是這樣：外邦人都不可吃這羊羔。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron , " This is the ordinance of the Passover . No foreigner shall eat of it ,

verses.z: 但各人用銀子買的奴僕，既受了割禮就可以吃。
verses.e: but every man's servant who is bought for money , when you have circumcised him , then shall he eat of it .

verses.z: 寄居的和雇工人都不可吃。
verses.e: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it .

verses.z: 應當在一個房子裏吃；不可把一點肉從房子裏帶到外頭去。羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。
verses.e: It must be eaten in one house . You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house . Do not break any of its bones .

verses.z: 以色列全會眾都要守這禮。
verses.e: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it .

verses.z: 若有外人寄居在你們中間，願向耶和華守逾越節，他所有的男子務要受割禮，然後才容他前來遵守，他也就像本地人一樣；但未受割禮的，都不可吃這羊羔。
verses.e: When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you , and would like to keep the Passover to the LORD , let all his males be circumcised , and then let him come near and keep it . He shall be as one who is born in the land ; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it .

verses.z: 本地人和寄居在你們中間的外人同歸一例。」
verses.e: One law shall be to him who is born at home , and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you . "

verses.z: 要無殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，你們或從綿羊裏取，或從山羊裏取，都可以。
verses.e: Your lamb shall be without defect , a male a year old . You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西、亞倫，以色列眾人就怎樣行了。
verses.e: All the children of Israel did so . As the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron , so they did .

verses.z: 正當那日，耶和華將以色列人按着他們的軍隊，從埃及地領出來。
verses.e: That same day , the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies .

verses.z: 要留到本月十四日，在黃昏的時候，以色列全會眾把羊羔宰了。
verses.e: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month ; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening .

verses.z: 各家要取點血，塗在吃羊羔的房屋左右的門框上和門楣上。
verses.e: They shall take some of the blood , and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel , on the houses in which they shall eat it .

verses.z: 當夜要吃羊羔的肉；用火烤了，與無酵餅和苦菜同吃。
verses.e: They shall eat the meat in that night , roasted with fire , with unleavened bread . They shall eat it with bitter herbs .

verses.z: 不可吃生的，斷不可吃水煮的，要帶着頭、腿、五臟，用火烤了吃。
verses.e: Don't eat it raw , nor boiled at all with water , but roasted with fire ; with its head , its legs and its inner parts .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 所以你每年要按着日期守這例。』」
verses.e: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year .

verses.z: 「將來，耶和華照他向你和你祖宗所起的誓將你領進迦南人之地，把這地賜給你，
verses.e: " It shall be , when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite , as he swore to you and to your fathers , and will give it to you ,

verses.z: 那時你要將一切頭生的，並牲畜中頭生的，歸給耶和華；公的都要屬耶和華。
verses.e: that you shall set apart to the LORD all that opens the womb , and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have . The males shall be the LORD's .

verses.z: 凡頭生的驢，你要用羊羔代贖；若不代贖，就要打折牠的頸項。凡你兒子中頭生的都要贖出來。
verses.e: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb ; and if you will not redeem it , then you shall break its neck ; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons .

verses.z: 日後，你的兒子問你說：『這是甚麼意思？』你就說：『耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及為奴之家領出來。
verses.e: It shall be , when your son asks you in time to come , saying , ' What is this ? ' that you shall tell him , ' By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage .

verses.z: 那時法老幾乎不容我們去，耶和華就把埃及地所有頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都殺了。因此，我把一切頭生的公[牲畜]獻給耶和華為祭，但將頭生的兒子都贖出來。
verses.e: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go , the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of livestock . Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb , being males ; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem . '

verses.z: 這要在你手上作記號，在你額上作經文，因為耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及領出來。』」
verses.e: It shall be for a sign on your hand , and for symbols between your eyes ; for by strength of hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt . "

verses.z: 法老容百姓去的時候，非利士地的道路雖近，上帝卻不領他們從那裏走；因為上帝說：「恐怕百姓遇見打仗後悔，就回埃及去。」
verses.e: When Pharaoh had let the people go , God didn't lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near ; for God said , " Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war , and they return to Egypt " ;

verses.z: 所以上帝領百姓繞道而行，走紅海曠野的路。以色列人出埃及地，都帶着兵器上去。
verses.e: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea ; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 摩西把約瑟的骸骨一同帶去；因為約瑟曾叫以色列人嚴嚴地起誓，[對他們]說：「上帝必眷顧你們，你們要把我的骸骨從這裏一同帶上去。」
verses.e: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him , for he had made the children of Israel swear , saying , " God will surely visit you , and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you . "

verses.z: 「以色列中凡頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都是我的，要分別為聖歸我。」
verses.e: " Sanctify to me all the firstborn , whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel , both of man and of animal . It is mine . "

verses.z: 他們從疏割起行，在曠野邊的以倘安營。
verses.e: They took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .

verses.z: 日間，耶和華在雲柱中領他們的路；夜間，在火柱中光照他們，使他們日夜都可以行走。
verses.e: The LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud , to lead them on their way , and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light , that they might go by day and by night :

verses.z: 日間雲柱，夜間火柱，總不離開百姓的面前。
verses.e: the pillar of cloud by day , and the pillar of fire by night , didn't depart from before the people .

verses.z: 摩西對百姓說：「你們要記念從埃及為奴之家出來的這日，因為耶和華用大能的手將你們從這地方領出來。有酵的餅都不可吃。
verses.e: Moses said to the people , " Remember this day , in which you came out of Egypt , out of the house of bondage ; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place . No leavened bread shall be eaten .

verses.z: 亞筆月間的這日是你們出來的日子。
verses.e: Today you go out in the month Abib .

verses.z: 將來耶和華領你進迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、希未人、耶布斯人之地，就是他向你的祖宗起誓應許給你那流奶與蜜之地，那時你要在這月間守這禮。
verses.e: It shall be , when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Amorite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite , which he swore to your fathers to give you , a land flowing with milk and honey , that you shall keep this service in this month .

verses.z: 你要吃無酵餅七日，到第七日要向耶和華守節。
verses.e: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread , and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD .

verses.z: 這七日之久，要吃無酵餅；在你四境之內不可見有酵的餅，也不可見發酵的物。
verses.e: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days ; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you . No yeast shall be seen with you , within all your borders .

verses.z: 當那日，你要告訴你的兒子說：『這是因耶和華在我出埃及的時候為我所行的事。
verses.e: You shall tell your son in that day , saying , ' It is because of that which the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt . '

verses.z: 這要在你手上作記號，在你額上作紀念，使耶和華的律法常在你口中，因為耶和華曾用大能的手將你從埃及領出來。
verses.e: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand , and for a memorial between your eyes , that the LORD's law may be in your mouth ; for with a strong hand the LORD has brought you out of Egypt .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 法老臨近的時候，以色列人舉目看見埃及人趕來，就甚懼怕，向耶和華哀求。
verses.e: When Pharaoh came near , the children of Israel lifted up their eyes , and behold , the Egyptians were marching after them ; and they were very afraid . The children of Israel cried out to the LORD .

verses.z: 他們對摩西說：「難道在埃及沒有墳地，你把我們帶來死在曠野嗎？你為甚麼這樣待我們，將我們從埃及領出來呢？
verses.e: They said to Moses , " Because there were no graves in Egypt , have you taken us away to die in the wilderness ? Why have you treated us this way , to bring us out of Egypt ?

verses.z: 我們在埃及豈沒有對你說過，不要攪擾我們，容我們服事埃及人嗎？因為服事埃及人比死在曠野還好。」
verses.e: Isn't this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt , saying , ' Leave us alone , that we may serve the Egyptians ' ? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness . "

verses.z: 摩西對百姓說：「不要懼怕，只管站住！看耶和華今天向你們所要施行的救恩。因為，你們今天所看見的埃及人必永遠不再看見了。
verses.e: Moses said to the people , " Don't be afraid . Stand still , and see the salvation of the LORD , which he will work for you today ; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today .

verses.z: 耶和華必為你們爭戰；你們只管靜默，不要作聲。」
verses.e: The LORD will fight for you , and you shall be still . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你為甚麼向我哀求呢？你吩咐以色列人往前走。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Why do you cry to me ? Speak to the children of Israel , that they go forward .

verses.z: 你舉手向海伸杖，把水分開。以色列人要下海中走乾地。
verses.e: Lift up your rod , and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it . Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground .

verses.z: 我要使埃及人的心剛硬，他們就跟着下去。我要在法老和他的全軍、車輛、馬兵上得榮耀。
verses.e: Behold , I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians , and they will go in after them . I will get myself honor over Pharaoh , and over all his armies , over his chariots , and over his horsemen .

verses.z: 我在法老和他的車輛、馬兵上得榮耀的時候，埃及人就知道我是耶和華了。」
verses.e: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh , over his chariots , and over his horsemen . "

verses.z: 在以色列營前行走上帝的使者，轉到他們後邊去；雲柱也從他們前邊轉到他們後邊立住。
verses.e: The angel of God , who went before the camp of Israel , moved and went behind them ; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them , and stood behind them .

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人轉回，安營在比‧哈希錄前，密奪和海的中間，對着巴力‧洗分，靠近海邊安營。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth , between Migdol and the sea , before Baal Zephon . You shall encamp opposite it by the sea .

verses.z: 在埃及營和以色列營中間有雲柱，一邊黑暗，一邊發光，終夜兩下不得相近。
verses.e: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel . There was the cloud and the darkness , yet it gave light by night . One didn't come near the other all night .

verses.z: 摩西向海伸杖，耶和華便用大東風，使海水一夜退去，水便分開，海就成了乾地。
verses.e: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea , and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night , and made the sea dry land , and the waters were divided .

verses.z: 以色列人下海中走乾地，水在他們的左右作了牆垣。
verses.e: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground ; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left .

verses.z: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵都跟着下到海中。
verses.e: The Egyptians pursued , and went in after them into the middle of the sea : all of Pharaoh's horses , his chariots , and his horsemen .

verses.z: 到了晨更的時候，耶和華從雲火柱中向埃及的軍兵觀看，使埃及的軍兵混亂了；
verses.e: In the morning watch , the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud , and confused the Egyptian army .

verses.z: 又使他們的車輪脫落，難以行走，以致埃及人說：「我們從以色列人面前逃跑吧！因耶和華為他們攻擊我們了。」
verses.e: He took off their chariot wheels , and they drove them heavily ; so that the Egyptians said , " Let's flee from the face of Israel , for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians ! "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向海伸杖，叫水仍合在埃及人並他們的車輛、馬兵身上。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Stretch out your hand over the sea , that the waters may come again on the Egyptians , on their chariots , and on their horsemen . "

verses.z: 摩西就向海伸杖，到了天一亮，海水仍舊復原。埃及人避水逃跑的時候，耶和華把他們推翻在海中，
verses.e: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea , and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared ; and the Egyptians fled against it . The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea .

verses.z: 水就回流，淹沒了車輛和馬兵。那些跟着以色列人下海法老的全軍，連一個也沒有剩下。
verses.e: The waters returned , and covered the chariots and the horsemen , even all Pharaoh's army that went in after them into the sea . There remained not so much as one of them .

verses.z: 以色列人卻在海中走乾地；水在他們的左右作了牆垣。
verses.e: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea , and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left .

verses.z: 法老必說：『以色列人在地中繞迷了，曠野把他們困住了。』
verses.e: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel , ' They are entangled in the land . The wilderness has shut them in . '

verses.z: 當日，耶和華這樣拯救以色列人脫離埃及人的手，以色列人看見埃及人的死屍都在海邊了。
verses.e: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians ; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore .

verses.z: 以色列人看見耶和華向埃及人所行的大事，就敬畏耶和華，又信服他和他的僕人摩西。
verses.e: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians , and the people feared the LORD ; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses .

verses.z: 我要使法老的心剛硬，他要追趕他們，我便在法老和他全軍身上得榮耀；埃及人就知道我是耶和華。」於是以色列人這樣行了。
verses.e: I will harden Pharaoh's heart , and he will follow after them ; and I will get honor over Pharaoh , and over all his armies ; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD . " They did so .

verses.z: 有人告訴埃及王說：「百姓逃跑。」法老和他的臣僕就向百姓變心，說：「我們容以色列人去，不再服事我們，這做的是甚麼事呢？」
verses.e: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled ; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people , and they said , " What is this we have done , that we have let Israel go from serving us ? "

verses.z: 法老就預備他的車輛，帶領軍兵同去，
verses.e: He prepared his chariot , and took his army with him ;

verses.z: 並帶着六百輛特選的車和埃及所有的車，每輛都有車兵長。
verses.e: and he took six hundred chosen chariots , and all the chariots of Egypt , with captains over all of them .

verses.z: 耶和華使埃及王法老的心剛硬，他就追趕以色列人，因為以色列人是昂然無懼地出埃及。
verses.e: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and he pursued the children of Israel ; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand .

verses.z: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛、馬兵，與軍兵就在海邊上，靠近比‧哈希錄，對着巴力‧洗分，在他們安營的地方追上了。
verses.e: The Egyptians pursued them . All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , his horsemen , and his army overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pihahiroth , before Baal Zephon .

verses.z: 那時，摩西和以色列人向耶和華唱歌說：我要向耶和華歌唱，因他大大戰勝，將馬和騎馬的投在海中。
verses.e: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD , and said , " I will sing to the LORD , for he has triumphed gloriously . He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea .

verses.z: 你叫風一吹，海就把他們淹沒；他們如鉛沉在大水之中。
verses.e: You blew with your wind . The sea covered them . They sank like lead in the mighty waters .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，眾神之中，誰能像你？誰能像你－至聖至榮，可頌可畏，施行奇事？
verses.e: Who is like you , LORD , among the gods ? Who is like you , glorious in holiness , fearful in praises , doing wonders ?

verses.z: 你伸出右手，地便吞滅他們。
verses.e: You stretched out your right hand . The earth swallowed them .

verses.z: 你憑慈愛領了你所贖的百姓；你憑能力引他們到了你的聖所。
verses.e: " You , in your loving kindness , have led the people that you have redeemed . You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation .

verses.z: 外邦人聽見就發顫；疼痛抓住非利士的居民。
verses.e: The peoples have heard . They tremble . Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia .

verses.z: 那時，以東的族長驚惶，摩押的英雄被戰兢抓住，迦南的居民[心]都消化了。
verses.e: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed . Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab . All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away .

verses.z: 驚駭恐懼臨到他們。耶和華啊，因你膀臂的大能，他們如石頭寂然不動，等候你的百姓過去，等候你所贖的百姓過去。
verses.e: Terror and dread falls on them . By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone , until your people pass over , LORD , until the people you have purchased pass over .

verses.z: 你要將他們領進去，栽於你產業的山上－耶和華啊，就是你為自己所造的住處；主啊，就是你手所建立的聖所。
verses.e: You will bring them in , and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance , the place , LORD , which you have made for yourself to dwell in : the sanctuary , Lord , which your hands have established .

verses.z: 耶和華必作王，直到永永遠遠！
verses.e: The LORD will reign forever and ever . "

verses.z: 法老的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵下到海中，耶和華使海水回流，淹沒他們；惟有以色列人在海中走乾地。
verses.e: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea , and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them ; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea .

verses.z: 耶和華是我的力量，我的詩歌，也成了我的拯救。這是我的上帝，我要讚美他，是我父親的上帝，我要尊崇他。
verses.e: The LORD is my strength and song . He has become my salvation . This is my God , and I will praise him ; my father's God , and I will exalt him .

verses.z: 亞倫的姊姊，女先知米利暗，手裏拿着鼓；眾婦女也跟她出去拿鼓跳舞。
verses.e: Miriam the prophetess , the sister of Aaron , took a tambourine in her hand ; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances .

verses.z: 米利暗應聲說：你們要歌頌耶和華，因他大大戰勝，將馬和騎馬的投在海中。
verses.e: Miriam answered them , " Sing to the LORD , for he has triumphed gloriously . He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea . "

verses.z: 摩西領以色列人從紅海往前行，到了書珥的曠野，在曠野走了三天，找不着水。
verses.e: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea , and they went out into the wilderness of Shur ; and they went three days in the wilderness , and found no water .

verses.z: 到了瑪拉，不能喝那裏的水；因為水苦，所以那地名叫瑪拉。
verses.e: When they came to Marah , they couldn't drink from the waters of Marah , for they were bitter . Therefore its name was called Marah .

verses.z: 百姓就向摩西發怨言，說：「我們喝甚麼呢？」
verses.e: The people murmured against Moses , saying , " What shall we drink ? "

verses.z: 摩西呼求耶和華，耶和華指示他一棵樹。他把樹丟在水裏，水就變甜了。耶和華在那裏為他們定了律例、典章，在那裏試驗他們；
verses.e: Then he cried to the LORD . The LORD showed him a tree , and he threw it into the waters , and the waters were made sweet . There he made a statute and an ordinance for them , and there he tested them .

verses.z: 又說：「你若留意聽耶和華－你上帝的話，又行我眼中看為正的事，留心聽我的誡命，守我一切的律例，我就不將所加與埃及人的疾病加在你身上，因為我－耶和華是醫治你的。」
verses.e: He said , " If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God's voice , and will do that which is right in his eyes , and will pay attention to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians ; for I am the LORD who heals you . "

verses.z: 他們到了以琳，在那裏有十二股水泉，七十棵棕樹；他們就在那裏的水邊安營。
verses.e: They came to Elim , where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees . They encamped there by the waters .

verses.z: 耶和華是戰士；他的名是耶和華。
verses.e: The LORD is a man of war . The LORD is his name .

verses.z: 法老的車輛、軍兵，耶和華已拋在海中；他特選的軍長都沉於紅海。
verses.e: He has cast Pharaoh's chariots and his army into the sea . His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea .

verses.z: 深水淹沒他們；他們如同石頭墜到深處。
verses.e: The deeps cover them . They went down into the depths like a stone .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的右手施展能力，顯出榮耀；耶和華啊，你的右手摔碎仇敵。
verses.e: Your right hand , LORD , is glorious in power . Your right hand , LORD , dashes the enemy in pieces .

verses.z: 你大發威嚴，推翻那些起來攻擊你的；你發出烈怒[如火]，燒滅他們像燒碎稭一樣。
verses.e: In the greatness of your excellency , you overthrow those who rise up against you . You send out your wrath . It consumes them as stubble .

verses.z: 你發鼻中的氣，水便聚起成堆，大水直立如壘，海中的深水凝結。
verses.e: With the blast of your nostrils , the waters were piled up . The floods stood upright as a heap . The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea .

verses.z: 仇敵說：我要追趕，我要追上；我要分擄物，我要在他們身上稱我的心願。我要拔出刀來，親手殺滅他們。
verses.e: The enemy said , ' I will pursue . I will overtake . I will divide the plunder . My desire will be satisfied on them . I will draw my sword . My hand will destroy them . '

verses.z: 以色列全會眾從以琳起行，在出埃及後第二個月十五日到了以琳和西奈中間、汛的曠野。
verses.e: They took their journey from Elim , and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin , which is between Elim and Sinai , on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 亞倫正對以色列全會眾說話的時候，他們向曠野觀看，不料，耶和華的榮光在雲中顯現。
verses.e: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel , they looked toward the wilderness , and behold , the LORD's glory appeared in the cloud .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「我已經聽見以色列人的怨言。你告訴他們說：『到黃昏的時候，你們要吃肉，早晨必有食物得飽，你們就知道我是耶和華－你們的上帝。』」
verses.e: " I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel . Speak to them , saying , ' At evening you shall eat meat , and in the morning you shall be filled with bread . Then you will know that I am the LORD your God . ' "

verses.z: 到了晚上，有鵪鶉飛來，遮滿了營；早晨在營四圍的地上有露水。
verses.e: In the evening , quail came up and covered the camp ; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp .

verses.z: 露水上升之後，不料，野地面上有如白霜的小圓物。
verses.e: When the dew that lay had gone , behold , on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing , small as the frost on the ground .

verses.z: 以色列人看見，不知道是甚麼，就彼此對問說：「這是甚麼呢？」摩西對他們說：「這就是耶和華給你們吃的食物。
verses.e: When the children of Israel saw it , they said to one another , " What is it ? " For they didn't know what it was . Moses said to them , " It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat .

verses.z: 耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：你們要按着各人的飯量，為帳棚裏的人，按着人數收起來，各拿一俄梅珥。」
verses.e: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded : ' Gather of it everyone according to his eating ; an omer a head , according to the number of your persons , you shall take it , every man for those who are in his tent . ' "

verses.z: 以色列人就這樣行；有多收的，有少收的。
verses.e: The children of Israel did so , and some gathered more , some less .

verses.z: 及至用俄梅珥量一量，多收的也沒有餘，少收的也沒有缺；各人按着自己的飯量收取。
verses.e: When they measured it with an omer , he who gathered much had nothing over , and he who gathered little had no lack . They each gathered according to his eating .

verses.z: 摩西對他們說：「所收的，不許甚麼人留到早晨。」
verses.e: Moses said to them , " Let no one leave of it until the morning . "

verses.z: 以色列全會眾在曠野向摩西、亞倫發怨言，
verses.e: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness ;

verses.z: 然而他們不聽摩西的話，內中有留到早晨的，就生蟲變臭了；摩西便向他們發怒。
verses.e: Notwithstanding they didn't listen to Moses , but some of them left of it until the morning , so it bred worms and became foul ; and Moses was angry with them .

verses.z: 他們每日早晨，按着各人的飯量收取，日頭一發熱，就消化了。
verses.e: They gathered it morning by morning , everyone according to his eating . When the sun grew hot , it melted .

verses.z: 到第六天，他們收了雙倍的食物，每人兩俄梅珥。會眾的官長來告訴摩西；
verses.e: On the sixth day , they gathered twice as much bread , two omers for each one ; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses .

verses.z: 摩西對他們說：「耶和華這樣說：『明天是聖安息日，是向耶和華守的聖安息日。你們要烤的就烤了，要煮的就煮了，所剩下的都留到早晨。』」
verses.e: He said to them , " This is that which the LORD has spoken , ' Tomorrow is a solemn rest , a holy Sabbath to the LORD . Bake that which you want to bake , and boil that which you want to boil ; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning . ' "

verses.z: 他們就照摩西的吩咐留到早晨，也不臭，裏頭也沒有蟲子。
verses.e: They laid it up until the morning , as Moses ordered , and it didn't become foul , and there were no worms in it .

verses.z: 摩西說：「你們今天吃這個吧！因為今天是向耶和華守的安息日；你們在田野必找不着了。
verses.e: Moses said , " Eat that today , for today is a Sabbath to the LORD . Today you shall not find it in the field .

verses.z: 六天可以收取，第七天乃是安息日，那一天必沒有了。」
verses.e: Six days you shall gather it , but on the seventh day is the Sabbath . In it there shall be none . "

verses.z: 第七天，百姓中有人出去收，甚麼也找不着。
verses.e: On the seventh day , some of the people went out to gather , and they found none .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你們不肯守我的誡命和律法，要到幾時呢？
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws ?

verses.z: 你們看！耶和華既將安息日賜給你們，所以第六天他賜給你們兩天的食物，第七天各人要住在自己的地方，不許甚麼人出去。」
verses.e: Behold , because the LORD has given you the Sabbath , therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days . Everyone stay in his place . Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day . "

verses.z: 說：「巴不得我們早死在埃及地、耶和華的手下；那時我們坐在肉鍋旁邊，吃得飽足。你們將我們領出來，到這曠野，是要叫這全會眾都餓死啊！」
verses.e: and the children of Israel said to them , " We wish that we had died by the LORD's hand in the land of Egypt , when we sat by the meat pots , when we ate our fill of bread , for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger . "

verses.z: 於是百姓第七天安息了。
verses.e: So the people rested on the seventh day .

verses.z: 這食物，以色列家叫嗎哪；樣子像芫荽子，顏色是白的，滋味如同攙蜜的薄餅。
verses.e: The house of Israel called its name " Manna " , and it was like coriander seed , white ; and its taste was like wafers with honey .

verses.z: 摩西說：「耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：『要將一滿俄梅珥嗎哪留到世世代代，使後人可以看見我當日將你們領出埃及地，在曠野所給你們吃的食物。』」
verses.e: Moses said , " This is the thing which the LORD has commanded , ' Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations , that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness , when I brought you out of the land of Egypt . ' "

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫說：「你拿一個罐子，盛一滿俄梅珥嗎哪，存在耶和華面前，要留到世世代代。」
verses.e: Moses said to Aaron , " Take a pot , and put an omer-full of manna in it , and lay it up before the LORD , to be kept throughout your generations . "

verses.z: 耶和華怎麼吩咐摩西，亞倫就怎麼行，把嗎哪放在法[櫃]前存留。
verses.e: As the LORD commanded Moses , so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony , to be kept .

verses.z: 以色列人吃嗎哪共四十年，直到進了有人居住之地，就是迦南的境界。（
verses.e: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years , until they came to an inhabited land . They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。）
verses.e: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「我要將糧食從天降給你們。百姓可以出去，每天收每天的分，我好試驗他們遵不遵我的法度。
verses.e: Then the LORD said to Moses , " Behold , I will rain bread from the sky for you , and the people shall go out and gather a day's portion every day , that I may test them , whether they will walk in my law or not .

verses.z: 到第六天，他們要把所收進來的預備好了，比每天所收的多一倍。」
verses.e: It shall come to pass on the sixth day , that they shall prepare that which they bring in , and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily . "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫對以色列眾人說：「到了晚上，你們要知道是耶和華將你們從埃及地領出來的。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel , " At evening , you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 早晨，你們要看見耶和華的榮耀，因為耶和華聽見你們向他所發的怨言了。我們算甚麼，你們竟向我們發怨言呢？」
verses.e: In the morning , you shall see the LORD's glory ; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD . Who are we , that you murmur against us ? "

verses.z: 摩西又說：「耶和華晚上必給你們肉吃，早晨必給你們食物得飽；因為你們向耶和華發的怨言，他都聽見了。我們算甚麼，你們的怨言不是向我們發的，乃是向耶和華發的。」
verses.e: Moses said , " Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening , and in the morning bread to satisfy you , because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him . And who are we ? Your murmurings are not against us , but against the LORD . "

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫說：「你告訴以色列全會眾說：『你們就近耶和華面前，因為他已經聽見你們的怨言了。』」
verses.e: Moses said to Aaron , " Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel , ' Come close to the LORD , for he has heard your murmurings . ' "

verses.z: 以色列全會眾都遵耶和華的吩咐，按着站口從汛的曠野往前行，在利非訂安營。百姓沒有水喝，
verses.e: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin , starting according to the LORD's commandment , and encamped in Rephidim ; but there was no water for the people to drink .

verses.z: 於是約書亞照着摩西對他所說的話行，和亞瑪力人爭戰。摩西、亞倫，與戶珥都上了山頂。
verses.e: So Joshua did as Moses had told him , and fought with Amalek ; and Moses , Aaron , and Hur went up to the top of the hill .

verses.z: 摩西何時舉手，以色列人就得勝，何時垂手，亞瑪力人就得勝。
verses.e: When Moses held up his hand , Israel prevailed . When he let down his hand , Amalek prevailed .

verses.z: 但摩西的手發沉，他們就搬石頭來，放在他以下，他就坐在上面。亞倫與戶珥扶着他的手，一個在這邊，一個在那邊，他的手就穩住，直到日落的時候。
verses.e: But Moses ' hands were heavy ; so they took a stone , and put it under him , and he sat on it . Aaron and Hur held up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side . His hands were steady until sunset .

verses.z: 約書亞用刀殺了亞瑪力王和他的百姓。
