verses.e: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「我要將亞瑪力的名號從天下全然塗抹了；你要將這話寫在書上作紀念，又念給約書亞聽。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Write this for a memorial in a book , and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua : that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky . "

verses.z: 摩西築了一座壇，起名叫「耶和華尼西」，
verses.e: Moses built an altar , and called its name " The LORD our Banner " .

verses.z: 又說：「耶和華已經起了誓，必世世代代和亞瑪力人爭戰。」
verses.e: He said , " The LORD has sworn : ' The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation . ' "

verses.z: 所以與摩西爭鬧，說：「給我們水喝吧！」摩西對他們說：「你們為甚麼與我爭鬧？為甚麼試探耶和華呢？」
verses.e: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses , and said , " Give us water to drink . " Moses said to them , " Why do you quarrel with me ? Why do you test the LORD ? "

verses.z: 百姓在那裏甚渴，要喝水，就向摩西發怨言，說：「你為甚麼將我們從埃及領出來，使我們和我們的兒女並牲畜都渴死呢？」
verses.e: The people were thirsty for water there ; so the people murmured against Moses , and said , " Why have you brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us , our children , and our livestock with thirst ? "

verses.z: 摩西就呼求耶和華說：「我向這百姓怎樣行呢？他們幾乎要拿石頭打死我。」
verses.e: Moses cried to the LORD , saying , " What shall I do with these people ? They are almost ready to stone me . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你手裏拿着你先前擊打河水的杖，帶領以色列的幾個長老，從百姓面前走過去。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Walk on before the people , and take the elders of Israel with you , and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile , and go .

verses.z: 我必在何烈的磐石那裏，站在你面前。你要擊打磐石，從磐石裏必有水流出來，使百姓可以喝。」摩西就在以色列的長老眼前這樣行了。
verses.e: Behold , I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb . You shall strike the rock , and water will come out of it , that the people may drink . " Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .

verses.z: 他給那地方起名叫瑪撒，又叫米利巴；因以色列人爭鬧，又因他們試探耶和華，說：「耶和華是在我們中間不是？」
verses.e: He called the name of the place Massah , and Meribah , because the children of Israel quarreled , and because they tested the LORD , saying , " Is the LORD among us , or not ? "

verses.z: 那時，亞瑪力人來在利非訂，和以色列人爭戰。
verses.e: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim .

verses.z: 摩西對約書亞說：「你為我們選出人來，出去和亞瑪力人爭戰。明天我手裏要拿着上帝的杖，站在山頂上。」
verses.e: Moses said to Joshua , " Choose men for us , and go out to fight with Amalek . Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God's rod in my hand . "

verses.z: 摩西的岳父，米甸祭司葉忒羅，聽見上帝為摩西和上帝的百姓以色列所行的一切事，就是耶和華將以色列從埃及領出來的事，
verses.e: Now Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses ' father-in-law , heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people , how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt .

verses.z: 葉忒羅說：「耶和華是應當稱頌的；他救了你們脫離埃及人和法老的手，將這百姓從埃及人的手下救出來。
verses.e: Jethro said , " Blessed be the LORD , who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of Pharaoh ; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians .

verses.z: 我現今在埃及人向這百姓發狂傲的事上得知，耶和華比萬神都大。」
verses.e: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly . "

verses.z: 摩西的岳父葉忒羅把燔祭和[平安]祭獻給上帝。亞倫和以色列的眾長老都來了，與摩西的岳父在上帝面前吃飯。
verses.e: Jethro , Moses ' father-in-law , took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God . Aaron came with all the elders of Israel , to eat bread with Moses ' father-in-law before God .

verses.z: 第二天，摩西坐着審判百姓，百姓從早到晚都站在摩西的左右。
verses.e: On the next day , Moses sat to judge the people , and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening .

verses.z: 摩西的岳父看見他向百姓所做的一切事，就說：「你向百姓做的是甚麼事呢？你為甚麼獨自坐着，眾百姓從早到晚都站在你的左右呢？」
verses.e: When Moses ' father-in-law saw all that he did to the people , he said , " What is this thing that you do for the people ? Why do you sit alone , and all the people stand around you from morning to evening ? "

verses.z: 摩西對岳父說：「這是因百姓到我這裏來求問上帝。
verses.e: Moses said to his father-in-law , " Because the people come to me to inquire of God .

verses.z: 他們有事的時候就到我這裏來，我便在兩造之間施行審判；我又叫他們知道上帝的律例和法度。」
verses.e: When they have a matter , they come to me , and I judge between a man and his neighbor , and I make them know the statutes of God , and his laws . "

verses.z: 摩西的岳父說：「你這做的不好。
verses.e: Moses ' father-in-law said to him , " The thing that you do is not good .

verses.z: 你和這些百姓必都疲憊；因為這事太重，你獨自一人辦理不了。
verses.e: You will surely wear away , both you , and this people that is with you ; for the thing is too heavy for you . You are not able to perform it yourself alone .

verses.z: 現在你要聽我的話。我為你出個主意，願上帝與你同在。你要替百姓到上帝面前，將案件奏告上帝；
verses.e: Listen now to my voice . I will give you counsel , and God be with you . You represent the people before God , and bring the causes to God .

verses.z: 便帶着摩西的妻子西坡拉，就是摩西從前打發回去的，
verses.e: Jethro , Moses ' father-in-law , received Zipporah , Moses ' wife , after he had sent her away ,

verses.z: 又要將律例和法度教訓他們，指示他們當行的道，當做的事；
verses.e: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws , and shall show them the way in which they must walk , and the work that they must do .

verses.z: 並要從百姓中揀選有才能的人，就是敬畏上帝、誠實無妄、恨不義之財的人，派他們作千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長，管理百姓，
verses.e: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God : men of truth , hating unjust gain ; and place such over them , to be rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .

verses.z: 叫他們隨時審判百姓，大事都要呈到你這裏，小事他們自己可以審判。這樣，你就輕省些，他們也可以同當此任。
verses.e: Let them judge the people at all times . It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you , but every small matter they shall judge themselves . So shall it be easier for you , and they shall share the load with you .

verses.z: 你若這樣行，上帝也這樣吩咐你，你就能受得住，這百姓也都平平安安歸回他們的住處。」
verses.e: If you will do this thing , and God commands you so , then you will be able to endure , and all these people also will go to their place in peace . "

verses.z: 於是，摩西聽從他岳父的話，按着他所說的去行。
verses.e: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law , and did all that he had said .

verses.z: 摩西從以色列人中揀選了有才能的人，立他們為百姓的首領，作千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長。
verses.e: Moses chose able men out of all Israel , and made them heads over the people , rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .

verses.z: 他們隨時審判百姓，有難斷的案件就呈到摩西那裏，但各樣小事他們自己審判。
verses.e: They judged the people at all times . They brought the hard cases to Moses , but every small matter they judged themselves .

verses.z: 此後，摩西讓他的岳父去，他就往本地去了。
verses.e: Moses let his father-in-law depart , and he went his way into his own land .

verses.z: 又帶着西坡拉的兩個兒子，一個名叫革舜，因為摩西說：「我在外邦作了寄居的」；
verses.e: and her two sons . The name of one son was Gershom , for Moses said , " I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land " .

verses.z: 一個名叫以利以謝，因為[他說]：「我父親的上帝幫助了我，救我脫離法老的刀。」
verses.e: The name of the other was Eliezer , for he said , " My father's God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh's sword . "

verses.z: 摩西的岳父葉忒羅帶着摩西的妻子和兩個兒子來到上帝的山，就是摩西在曠野安營的地方。
verses.e: Jethro , Moses ' father-in-law , came with Moses ' sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped , at the Mountain of God .

verses.z: 他對摩西說：「我是你岳父葉忒羅，帶着你的妻子和兩個兒子來到你這裏。」
verses.e: He said to Moses , " I , your father-in-law Jethro , have come to you with your wife , and her two sons with her . "

verses.z: 摩西迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，與他親嘴，彼此問安，都進了帳棚。
verses.e: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law , and bowed and kissed him . They asked each other of their welfare , and they came into the tent .

verses.z: 摩西將耶和華為以色列的緣故向法老和埃及人所行的一切事，以及路上所遭遇的一切艱難，並耶和華怎樣搭救他們，都述說與他岳父聽。
verses.e: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake , all the hardships that had come on them on the way , and how the LORD delivered them .

verses.z: 葉忒羅因耶和華待以色列的一切好處，就是拯救他們脫離埃及人的手，便甚歡喜。
verses.e: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel , in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians .

verses.z: 以色列人出埃及地以後，滿了三個月的那一天，就來到西奈的曠野。
verses.e: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt , on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai .

verses.z: 耶和華又對摩西說：「你往百姓那裏去，叫他們今天明天自潔，又叫他們洗衣服。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Go to the people , and sanctify them today and tomorrow , and let them wash their garments ,

verses.z: 到第三天要預備好了，因為第三天耶和華要在眾百姓眼前降臨在西奈山上。
verses.e: and be ready for the third day ; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai .

verses.z: 你要在山的四圍給百姓定界限，說：『你們當謹慎，不可上山去，也不可摸山的邊界；凡摸這山的，必要治死他。
verses.e: You shall set bounds to the people all around , saying , ' Be careful that you don't go up onto the mountain , or touch its border . Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death .

verses.z: 不可用手摸他，必用石頭打死，或用[箭]射透；無論是人是牲畜，都不得活。到角聲拖長的時候，他們才可到山根來。』」
verses.e: No hand shall touch him , but he shall surely be stoned or shot through ; whether it is animal or man , he shall not live . ' When the trumpet sounds long , they shall come up to the mountain . "

verses.z: 摩西下山往百姓那裏去，叫他們自潔，他們就洗衣服。
verses.e: Moses went down from the mountain to the people , and sanctified the people ; and they washed their clothes .

verses.z: 他對百姓說：「到第三天要預備好了。不可親近女人。」
verses.e: He said to the people , " Be ready by the third day . Don't have sexual relations with a woman . "

verses.z: 到了第三天早晨，在山上有雷轟、閃電，和密雲，並且角聲甚大，營中的百姓盡都發顫。
verses.e: On the third day , when it was morning , there were thunders and lightnings , and a thick cloud on the mountain , and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet ; and all the people who were in the camp trembled .

verses.z: 摩西率領百姓出營迎接上帝，都站在山下。
verses.e: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God ; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain .

verses.z: 西奈全山冒煙，因為耶和華在火中降於山上。山的煙氣上騰，如燒窯一般，遍山大大地震動。
verses.e: All of Mount Sinai smoked , because the LORD descended on it in fire ; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mountain quaked greatly .

verses.z: 角聲漸漸地高而又高，摩西就說話，上帝有聲音答應他。
verses.e: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder , Moses spoke , and God answered him by a voice .

verses.z: 他們離了利非訂，來到西奈的曠野，就在那裏的山下安營。
verses.e: When they had departed from Rephidim , and had come to the wilderness of Sinai , they encamped in the wilderness ; and there Israel encamped before the mountain .

verses.z: 耶和華降臨在西奈山頂上，耶和華召摩西上山頂，摩西就上去。
verses.e: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai , to the top of the mountain . The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain , and Moses went up .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你下去囑咐百姓，不可闖過來到我面前觀看，恐怕他們有多人死亡；
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Go down , warn the people , lest they break through to the LORD to gaze , and many of them perish .

verses.z: 又叫親近我的祭司自潔，恐怕我忽然出來[擊殺]他們。」
verses.e: Let the priests also , who come near to the LORD , sanctify themselves , lest the LORD break out on them . "

verses.z: 摩西對耶和華說：「百姓不能上西奈山，因為你已經囑咐我們說：『要在山的四圍定界限，叫山成聖。』」
verses.e: Moses said to the LORD , " The people can't come up to Mount Sinai , for you warned us , saying , ' Set bounds around the mountain , and sanctify it . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「下去吧，你要和亞倫一同上來；只是祭司和百姓不可闖過來上到我面前，恐怕我忽然出來[擊殺]他們。」
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Go down ! You shall bring Aaron up with you , but don't let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD , lest he break out against them . "

verses.z: 於是摩西下到百姓那裏告訴他們。
verses.e: So Moses went down to the people , and told them .

verses.z: 摩西到上帝那裏，耶和華從山上呼喚他說：「你要這樣告訴雅各家，曉諭以色列人說：
verses.e: Moses went up to God , and the LORD called to him out of the mountain , saying , " This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob , and tell the children of Israel :

verses.z: 『我向埃及人所行的事，你們都看見了，且看見我如鷹將你們背在翅膀上，帶來歸我。
verses.e: ' You have seen what I did to the Egyptians , and how I bore you on eagles ' wings , and brought you to myself .

verses.z: 如今你們若實在聽從我的話，遵守我的約，就要在萬民中作屬我的子民，因為全地都是我的。
verses.e: Now therefore , if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant , then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples ; for all the earth is mine ;

verses.z: 你們要歸我作祭司的國度，為聖潔的國民。』這些話你要告訴以色列人。」
verses.e: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation . ' These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel . "

verses.z: 摩西去召了民間的長老來，將耶和華所吩咐他的話都在他們面前陳明。
verses.e: Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him .

verses.z: 百姓都同聲回答說：「凡耶和華所說的，我們都要遵行。」摩西就將百姓的話回覆耶和華。
verses.e: All the people answered together , and said , " All that the LORD has spoken we will do . " Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「我要在密雲中臨到你那裏，叫百姓在我與你說話的時候可以聽見，也可以永遠信你了。」於是，摩西將百姓的話奏告耶和華。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Behold , I come to you in a thick cloud , that the people may hear when I speak with you , and may also believe you forever . " Moses told the words of the people to the LORD .

verses.z: 有一個利未家的人娶了一個利未女子為妻。
verses.e: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife .

verses.z: 孩子漸長，婦人把他帶到法老的女兒那裏，就作了她的兒子。她給孩子起名叫摩西，意思說：「因我把他從水裏拉出來。」
verses.e: The child grew , and she brought him to Pharaoh's daughter , and he became her son . She named him Moses , and said , " Because I drew him out of the water . "

verses.z: 後來，摩西長大，他出去到他弟兄那裏，看他們的重擔，見一個埃及人打希伯來人的一個弟兄。
verses.e: In those days , when Moses had grown up , he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens . He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew , one of his brothers .

verses.z: 他左右觀看，見沒有人，就把埃及人打死了，藏在沙土裏。
verses.e: He looked this way and that way , and when he saw that there was no one , he killed the Egyptian , and hid him in the sand .

verses.z: 第二天他出去，見有兩個希伯來人爭鬥，就對那欺負人的說：「你為甚麼打你同族的人呢？」
verses.e: He went out the second day , and behold , two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other . He said to him who did the wrong , " Why do you strike your fellow ? "

verses.z: 那人說：「誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？難道你要殺我，像殺那埃及人嗎？」摩西便懼怕，說：「這事必是被人知道了。」
verses.e: He said , " Who made you a prince and a judge over us ? Do you plan to kill me , as you killed the Egyptian ? " Moses was afraid , and said , " Surely this thing is known . "

verses.z: 法老聽見這事，就想殺摩西，但摩西躲避法老，逃往米甸地居住。
verses.e: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing , he sought to kill Moses . But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh , and lived in the land of Midian , and he sat down by a well .

verses.z: 一日，他在井旁坐下。米甸的祭司有七個女兒；她們來打水，打滿了槽，要飲父親的群羊。
verses.e: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters . They came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father's flock .

verses.z: 有牧羊的人來，把她們趕走了，摩西卻起來幫助她們，又飲了她們的群羊。
verses.e: The shepherds came and drove them away ; but Moses stood up and helped them , and watered their flock .

verses.z: 她們來到父親流珥那裏；他說：「今日你們為何來得這麼快呢？」
verses.e: When they came to Reuel , their father , he said , " How is it that you have returned so early today ? "

verses.z: 她們說：「有一個埃及人救我們脫離牧羊人的手，並且為我們打水飲了群羊。」
verses.e: They said , " An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and moreover he drew water for us , and watered the flock . "

verses.z: 那女人懷孕，生一個兒子，見他俊美，就藏了他三個月，
verses.e: The woman conceived and bore a son . When she saw that he was a fine child , she hid him three months .

verses.z: 他對女兒們說：「那個人在哪裏？你們為甚麼撇下他呢？你們去請他來吃飯。」
verses.e: He said to his daughters , " Where is he ? Why is it that you have left the man ? Call him , that he may eat bread . "

verses.z: 摩西甘心和那人同住；那人把他的女兒西坡拉給摩西為妻。
verses.e: Moses was content to dwell with the man . He gave Moses Zipporah , his daughter .

verses.z: 西坡拉生了一個兒子，摩西給他起名叫革舜，意思說：「因我在外邦作了寄居的。」
verses.e: She bore a son , and he named him Gershom , for he said , " I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land . "

verses.z: 過了多年，埃及王死了。以色列人因做苦工，就歎息哀求，他們的哀聲達於上帝。
verses.e: In the course of those many days , the king of Egypt died , and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up to God because of the bondage .

verses.z: 上帝聽見他們的哀聲，就記念他與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的約。
verses.e: God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .

verses.z: 上帝看顧以色列人，也知道他們的[苦情]。
verses.e: God saw the children of Israel , and God understood .

verses.z: 後來不能再藏，就取了一個蒲草箱，抹上石漆和石油，將孩子放在裏頭，把箱子擱在河邊的蘆荻中。
verses.e: When she could no longer hide him , she took a papyrus basket for him , and coated it with tar and with pitch . She put the child in it , and laid it in the reeds by the river's bank .

verses.z: 孩子的姊姊遠遠站着，要知道他究竟怎麼樣。
verses.e: His sister stood far off , to see what would be done to him .

verses.z: 法老的女兒來到河邊洗澡，她的使女們在河邊行走。她看見箱子在蘆荻中，就打發一個婢女拿來。
verses.e: Pharaoh's daughter came down to bathe at the river . Her maidens walked along by the riverside . She saw the basket among the reeds , and sent her servant to get it .

verses.z: 她打開箱子，看見那孩子。孩子哭了，她就可憐他，說：「這是希伯來人的一個孩子。」
verses.e: She opened it , and saw the child , and behold , the baby cried . She had compassion on him , and said , " This is one of the Hebrews ' children . "

verses.z: 孩子的姊姊對法老的女兒說：「我去在希伯來婦人中叫一個奶媽來，為你奶這孩子，可以不可以？」
verses.e: Then his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter , " Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women , that she may nurse the child for you ? "

verses.z: 法老的女兒說：「可以。」童女就去叫了孩子的母親來。
verses.e: Pharaoh's daughter said to her , " Go . " The young woman went and called the child's mother .

verses.z: 法老的女兒對她說：「你把這孩子抱去，為我奶他，我必給你工價。」婦人就抱了孩子去奶他。
verses.e: Pharaoh's daughter said to her , " Take this child away , and nurse him for me , and I will give you your wages . " The woman took the child , and nursed it .

verses.z: 上帝吩咐這一切的話說：
verses.e: God spoke all these words , saying ,

verses.z: 但第七日是向耶和華－你上帝當守的安息日。[這一日]你和你的兒女、僕婢、牲畜，並你城裏寄居的客旅，無論何工都不可做；
verses.e: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God . You shall not do any work in it , you , nor your son , nor your daughter , your male servant , nor your female servant , nor your livestock , nor your stranger who is within your gates ;

verses.z: 因為六日之內，耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物，第七日便安息，所以耶和華賜福與安息日，定為聖日。
verses.e: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that is in them , and rested the seventh day ; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day , and made it holy .

verses.z: 「當孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和華－你上帝所賜你的地上得以長久。
verses.e: " Honor your father and your mother , that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you .

verses.z: 「不可殺人。
verses.e: " You shall not murder .

verses.z: 「不可姦淫。
verses.e: " You shall not commit adultery .

verses.z: 「不可偷盜。
verses.e: " You shall not steal .

verses.z: 「不可作假見證陷害人。
verses.e: " You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor .

verses.z: 「不可貪戀人的房屋；也不可貪戀人的妻子、僕婢、牛驢，並他一切所有的。」
verses.e: " You shall not covet your neighbor's house . You shall not covet your neighbor's wife , nor his male servant , nor his female servant , nor his ox , nor his donkey , nor anything that is your neighbor's . "

verses.z: 眾百姓見雷轟、閃電、角聲、山上冒煙，就都發顫，遠遠地站立，
verses.e: All the people perceived the thunderings , the lightnings , the sound of the trumpet , and the mountain smoking . When the people saw it , they trembled , and stayed at a distance .

verses.z: 對摩西說：「求你和我們說話，我們必聽；不要上帝和我們說話，恐怕我們死亡。」
verses.e: They said to Moses , " Speak with us yourself , and we will listen ; but don't let God speak with us , lest we die . "

verses.z: 「我是耶和華－你的上帝，曾將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來。
verses.e: " I am the LORD your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .

verses.z: 摩西對百姓說：「不要懼怕；因為上帝降臨是要試驗你們，叫你們時常敬畏他，不致犯罪。」
verses.e: Moses said to the people , " Don't be afraid , for God has come to test you , and that his fear may be before you , that you won't sin . "

verses.z: 於是百姓遠遠地站立；摩西就挨近上帝所在的幽暗之中。
verses.e: The people stayed at a distance , and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你要向以色列人這樣說：『你們自己看見我從天上和你們說話了。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " This is what you shall tell the children of Israel : ' You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven .

verses.z: 你們不可做甚麼[神像]與我相配，不可為自己做金銀的神像。
verses.e: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me .

verses.z: 你要為我築土壇，在上面以牛羊獻為燔祭和平安祭。凡記下我名的地方，我必到那裏賜福給你。
verses.e: You shall make an altar of earth for me , and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings , your sheep and your cattle . In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you .

verses.z: 你若為我築一座石壇，不可用鑿成的石頭，因你在上頭一動家具，就把壇污穢了。
verses.e: If you make me an altar of stone , you shall not build it of cut stones ; for if you lift up your tool on it , you have polluted it .

verses.z: 你上我的壇，不可用臺階，免得露出你的下體來。』」
verses.e: You shall not go up by steps to my altar , that your nakedness may not be exposed to it . '

verses.z: 「除了我以外，你不可有別的神。
verses.e: " You shall have no other gods before me .

verses.z: 「不可為自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚麼形像彷彿上天、下地，和地底下、水中的[百物]。
verses.e: " You shall not make for yourselves an idol , nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above , or that is in the earth beneath , or that is in the water under the earth :

verses.z: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因為我耶和華－你的上帝是忌邪的上帝。恨我的，我必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；
verses.e: you shall not bow yourself down to them , nor serve them , for I , the LORD your God , am a jealous God , visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children , on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me ,

verses.z: 愛我、守我誡命的，我必向他們發慈愛，直到千代。
verses.e: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments .

verses.z: 「不可妄稱耶和華－你上帝的名；因為妄稱耶和華名的，耶和華必不以他為無罪。
verses.e: " You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God , for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name .

verses.z: 「當記念安息日，守為聖日。
verses.e: " Remember the Sabbath day , to keep it holy .

verses.z: 六日要勞碌做你一切的工，
verses.e: You shall labor six days , and do all your work ,

verses.z: 「你在百姓面前所要立的典章是這樣：
verses.e: " Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them :

verses.z: 若另娶一個，那女子的吃食、衣服，並好合的事，仍不可減少。
verses.e: If he takes another wife to himself , he shall not diminish her food , her clothing , and her marital rights .

verses.z: 若不向她行這三樣，她就可以不用錢贖，白白地出去。」
verses.e: If he doesn't do these three things for her , she may go free without paying any money .

verses.z: 「打人以致打死的，必要把他治死。
verses.e: " One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death ,

verses.z: 人若不是埋伏着[殺人]，乃是上帝交在他手中，我就設下一個地方，他可以往那裏逃跑。
verses.e: but not if it is unintentional , but God allows it to happen ; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee .

verses.z: 人若任意用詭計殺了他的鄰舍，就是逃到我的壇那裏，也當捉去把他治死。
verses.e: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him , you shall take him from my altar , that he may die .

verses.z: 「打父母的，必要把他治死。
verses.e: " Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death .

verses.z: 「拐帶人口，或是把人賣了，或是留在他手下，必要把他治死。
verses.e: " Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him , or if he is found in his hand , he shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 「咒罵父母的，必要把他治死。
verses.e: " Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 「人若彼此相爭，這個用石頭或是拳頭打那個，尚且不至於死，不過躺臥在床，
verses.e: " If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone , or with his fist , and he doesn't die , but is confined to bed ;

verses.z: 若再能起來扶杖而出，那打他的可算無罪；但要將他耽誤的工夫用錢賠補，並要將他全然醫好。
verses.e: if he rises again and walks around with his staff , then he who struck him shall be cleared ; only he shall pay for the loss of his time , and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed .

verses.z: 你若買希伯來人作奴僕，他必服事你六年；第七年他可以自由，白白地出去。
verses.e: " If you buy a Hebrew servant , he shall serve six years , and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything .

verses.z: 「人若用棍子打奴僕或婢女，立時死在他的手下，他必要受刑。
verses.e: " If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod , and he dies under his hand , the man shall surely be punished .

verses.z: 若過一兩天才死，就可以不受刑，因為是用錢買的。
verses.e: Notwithstanding , if his servant gets up after a day or two , he shall not be punished , for the servant is his property .

verses.z: 「人若彼此爭鬥，傷害有孕的婦人，甚至墜胎，隨後卻無別害，那傷害她的，總要按婦人的丈夫所要的，照審判官所斷的，受罰。
verses.e: " If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely , and yet no harm follows , he shall be surely fined as much as the woman's husband demands and the judges allow .

verses.z: 若有別害，就要以命償命，
verses.e: But if any harm follows , then you must take life for life ,

verses.z: 以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳，
verses.e: eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot ,

verses.z: 以烙還烙，以傷還傷，以打還打。
verses.e: burning for burning , wound for wound , and bruise for bruise .

verses.z: 「人若打壞了他奴僕或是婢女的一隻眼，就要因他的眼放他去得以自由。
verses.e: " If a man strikes his servant's eye , or his maid's eye , and destroys it , he shall let him go free for his eye's sake .

verses.z: 若打掉了他奴僕或是婢女的一個牙，就要因他的牙放他去得以自由。」
verses.e: If he strikes out his male servant's tooth , or his female servant's tooth , he shall let the servant go free for his tooth's sake .

verses.z: 「牛若觸死男人或是女人，總要用石頭打死那牛，卻不可吃牠的肉；牛的主人可算無罪。
verses.e: " If a bull gores a man or a woman to death , the bull shall surely be stoned , and its meat shall not be eaten ; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible .

verses.z: 倘若那牛素來是觸人的，有人報告了牛主，他竟不把牛拴着，以致把男人或是女人觸死，就要用石頭打死那牛，牛主也必治死。
verses.e: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past , and this has been testified to its owner , and he has not kept it in , but it has killed a man or a woman , the bull shall be stoned , and its owner shall also be put to death .

verses.z: 他若孤身來就可以孤身去；他若有妻，他的妻就可以同他出去。
verses.e: If he comes in by himself , he shall go out by himself . If he is married , then his wife shall go out with him .

verses.z: 若罰他贖[命]的價銀，他必照所罰的贖他的命。
verses.e: If a ransom is imposed on him , then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed .

verses.z: 牛無論觸了人的兒子或是女兒，必照這例辦理。
verses.e: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter , according to this judgment it shall be done to him .

verses.z: 牛若觸了奴僕或是婢女，必將銀子三十舍客勒給他們的主人，也要用石頭把牛打死。
verses.e: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant , thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master , and the ox shall be stoned .

verses.z: 「人若敞着井口，或挖井不遮蓋，有牛或驢掉在裏頭，
verses.e: " If a man opens a pit , or if a man digs a pit and doesn't cover it , and a bull or a donkey falls into it ,

verses.z: 井主要拿錢賠還本主人，死牲畜要歸自己。
verses.e: the owner of the pit shall make it good . He shall give money to its owner , and the dead animal shall be his .

verses.z: 「這人的牛若傷了那人的牛，以至於死，他們要賣了活牛，平分價值，也要平分死牛。
verses.e: " If one man's bull injures another's , so that it dies , then they shall sell the live bull , and divide its price ; and they shall also divide the dead animal .

verses.z: 人若知道這牛素來是觸人的，主人竟不把牛拴着，他必要以牛還牛，死牛要歸自己。」
verses.e: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past , and its owner has not kept it in , he shall surely pay bull for bull , and the dead animal shall be his own .

verses.z: 他主人若給他妻子，妻子給他生了兒子或女兒，妻子和兒女要歸主人，他要獨自出去。
verses.e: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters , the wife and her children shall be her master's , and he shall go out by himself .

verses.z: 倘或奴僕明說：『我愛我的主人和我的妻子兒女，不願意自由出去。』
verses.e: But if the servant shall plainly say , ' I love my master , my wife , and my children . I will not go out free ; '

verses.z: 他的主人就要帶他到審判官那裏，又要帶他到門前，靠近門框，用錐子穿他的耳朵，他就永遠服事主人。
verses.e: then his master shall bring him to God , and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost , and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl , and he shall serve him forever .

verses.z: 「人若賣女兒作婢女，婢女不可像男僕那樣出去。
verses.e: " If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant , she shall not go out as the male servants do .

verses.z: 主人選定她歸自己，若不喜歡她，就要許她贖身；主人既然用詭詐待她，就沒有權柄賣給外邦人。
verses.e: If she doesn't please her master , who has married her to himself , then he shall let her be redeemed . He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people , since he has dealt deceitfully with her .

verses.z: 主人若選定她給自己的兒子，就當待她如同女兒。
verses.e: If he marries her to his son , he shall deal with her as a daughter .

verses.z: 「人若偷牛或羊，無論是宰了，是賣了，他就要以五牛賠一牛，四羊賠一羊。
verses.e: " If a man steals an ox or a sheep , and kills it or sells it , he shall pay five oxen for an ox , and four sheep for a sheep .

verses.z: 「人若將驢，或牛，或羊，或別的牲畜，交付鄰舍看守，牲畜或死，或受傷，或被趕去，無人看見，
verses.e: " If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey , an ox , a sheep , or any animal to keep , and it dies or is injured , or driven away , no man seeing it ;

verses.z: 那看守的人要憑着耶和華起誓，手裏未曾拿鄰舍的物，本主就要罷休，看守的人不必賠還。
verses.e: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both , he has not put his hand on his neighbor's goods ; and its owner shall accept it , and he shall not make restitution .

verses.z: 牲畜若從看守的那裏被偷去，他就要賠還本主；
verses.e: But if it is stolen from him , the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner .

verses.z: 若被[野獸]撕碎，看守的要帶來當作證據，所撕的不必賠還。
verses.e: If it is torn in pieces , let him bring it for evidence . He shall not make good that which was torn .

verses.z: 「人若向鄰舍借甚麼，所借的或受傷，或死，本主沒有同在一處，借的人總要賠還；
verses.e: " If a man borrows anything of his neighbor's , and it is injured , or dies , its owner not being with it , he shall surely make restitution .

verses.z: 若本主同在一處，他就不必賠還；若是雇的，也不必賠還，本是為雇價來的。」
verses.e: If its owner is with it , he shall not make it good . If it is a leased thing , it came for its lease .

verses.z: 「人若引誘沒有受聘的處女，與她行淫，他總要交出聘禮，娶她為妻。
verses.e: " If a man entices a virgin who isn't pledged to be married , and lies with her , he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife .

verses.z: 若女子的父親決不肯將女子給他，他就要按處女的聘禮，交出錢來。
verses.e: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him , he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins .

verses.z: 「行邪術的女人，不可容她存活。
verses.e: " You shall not allow a sorceress to live .

verses.z: 「凡與獸淫合的，總要把他治死。
verses.e: " Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 人若遇見賊挖窟窿，把賊打了，以至於死，就不能為他有流血的罪。
verses.e: If the thief is found breaking in , and is struck so that he dies , there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him .

verses.z: 「祭祀別神，不單單祭祀耶和華的，那人必要滅絕。
verses.e: " He who sacrifices to any god , except to the LORD only , shall be utterly destroyed .

verses.z: 「不可虧負寄居的，也不可欺壓他，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。
verses.e: " You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him , for you were aliens in the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 不可苦待寡婦和孤兒；
verses.e: " You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child .

verses.z: 若是苦待他們一點，他們向我一哀求，我總要聽他們的哀聲，
verses.e: If you take advantage of them at all , and they cry at all to me , I will surely hear their cry ;

verses.z: 並要發烈怒，用刀殺你們，使你們的妻子為寡婦，兒女為孤兒。
verses.e: and my wrath will grow hot , and I will kill you with the sword ; and your wives shall be widows , and your children fatherless .

verses.z: 「我民中有貧窮人與你同住，你若借錢給他，不可如放債的向他取利。
verses.e: " If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor , you shall not be to him as a creditor . You shall not charge him interest .

verses.z: 你即或拿鄰舍的衣服作當頭，必在日落以先歸還他；
verses.e: If you take your neighbor's garment as collateral , you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down ,

verses.z: 因他只有這一件當蓋頭，是他蓋身的衣服，[若是沒有]，他拿甚麼睡覺呢？他哀求我，我就應允，因為我是有恩惠的。
verses.e: for that is his only covering , it is his garment for his skin . What would he sleep in ? It will happen , when he cries to me , that I will hear , for I am gracious .

verses.z: 「不可毀謗上帝；也不可毀謗你百姓的官長。
verses.e: " You shall not blaspheme God , nor curse a ruler of your people .

verses.z: 「你要從你莊稼中的[穀]和[酒]醡中滴出來的酒拿來獻上，不可遲延。「你要將頭生的兒子歸給我。
verses.e: " You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses . " You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me .

verses.z: 若太陽已經出來，就為他有流血的罪。賊若被拿，總要賠還。若他一無所有，就要被賣，頂他所偷的物。
verses.e: If the sun has risen on him , he is guilty of bloodshed . He shall make restitution . If he has nothing , then he shall be sold for his theft .

verses.z: 你牛羊[頭生的]，也要這樣；七天當跟着母，第八天要歸給我。
verses.e: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep . It shall be with its mother seven days , then on the eighth day you shall give it to me .

verses.z: 「你們要在我面前為聖潔的人。因此，田間被野獸撕裂牲畜的肉，你們不可吃，要丟給狗吃。」
verses.e: " You shall be holy men to me , therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field . You shall cast it to the dogs .

verses.z: 若他所偷的，或牛，或驢，或羊，仍在他手下存活，他就要加倍賠還。
verses.e: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive , whether it is ox , donkey , or sheep , he shall pay double .

verses.z: 「人若在田間或在葡萄園裏放牲畜，任憑牲畜上別人的田裏去吃，就必拿自己田間上好的和葡萄園上好的賠還。
verses.e: " If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose , and it grazes in another man's field , he shall make restitution from the best of his own field , and from the best of his own vineyard .

verses.z: 「若點火焚燒荊棘，以致將別人堆積的禾捆，站着的禾稼，或是田園，都燒盡了，那點火的必要賠還。
verses.e: " If fire breaks out , and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain , or the standing grain , or the field are consumed ; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution .

verses.z: 「人若將銀錢或家具交付鄰舍看守，這物從那人的家被偷去，若把賊找到了，賊要加倍賠還；
verses.e: " If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep , and it is stolen out of the man's house , if the thief is found , he shall pay double .

verses.z: 若找不到賊，那家主必就近審判官，要[看看]他拿了原主的物件沒有。
verses.e: If the thief isn't found , then the master of the house shall come near to God , to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor's goods .

verses.z: 「兩個人的案件，無論是為甚麼過犯，或是為牛，為驢，為羊，為衣裳，或是為甚麼失掉之物，有一人說：『這是我的』，兩造就要將案件稟告審判官，審判官定誰有罪，誰就要加倍賠還。
verses.e: For every matter of trespass , whether it is for ox , for donkey , for sheep , for clothing , or for any kind of lost thing , about which one says , ' This is mine , ' the cause of both parties shall come before God . He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor .

verses.z: 「不可隨夥佈散謠言；不可與惡人連手妄作見證。
verses.e: " You shall not spread a false report . Don't join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness .

verses.z: 「六年你要耕種田地，收藏土產，
verses.e: " For six years you shall sow your land , and shall gather in its increase ,

verses.z: 只是第七年要叫地歇息，不耕不種，使你民中的窮人有吃的；他們所剩下的，野獸可以吃。你的葡萄園和橄欖園也要照樣辦理。
verses.e: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow , that the poor of your people may eat ; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat . In the same way , you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove .

verses.z: 「六日你要做工，第七日要安息，使牛、驢可以歇息，並使你婢女的兒子和寄居的都可以舒暢。
verses.e: " Six days you shall do your work , and on the seventh day you shall rest , that your ox and your donkey may have rest , and the son of your servant , and the alien may be refreshed .

verses.z: 「凡我對你們說的話，你們要謹守。別神的名，你不可提，也不可從你口中傳說。」
verses.e: " Be careful to do all things that I have said to you ; and don't invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth .

verses.z: 「一年三次，你要向我守節。
verses.e: " You shall observe a feast to me three times a year .

verses.z: 你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期，吃無酵餅七天。誰也不可空手朝見我，因為你是這月出了埃及。
verses.e: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread . Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread , as I commanded you , at the time appointed in the month Abib ( for in it you came out of Egypt ) , and no one shall appear before me empty .

verses.z: 又[要守]收割節，所收的是你田間所種、勞碌得來初熟之物。並在年底收藏，[要守]收藏節。
verses.e: And the feast of harvest , the first fruits of your labors , which you sow in the field ; and the feast of ingathering , at the end of the year , when you gather in your labors out of the field .

verses.z: 一切的男丁要一年三次朝見主耶和華。
verses.e: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「不可將我祭牲的血和有酵的餅一同獻上；也不可將我節上[祭牲]的脂油留到早晨。
verses.e: " You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread . The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning .

verses.z: 「地裏首先初熟之物要送到耶和華－你上帝的殿。「不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
verses.e: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God . " You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk .

verses.z: 不可隨眾行惡；不可在爭訟的事上隨眾偏行，作見證屈枉[正直]；
verses.e: " You shall not follow a crowd to do evil . You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice .

verses.z: 「看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保護你，領你到我所預備的地方去。
verses.e: " Behold , I send an angel before you , to keep you by the way , and to bring you into the place which I have prepared .

verses.z: 他是奉我名來的；你們要在他面前謹慎，聽從他的話，不可惹他，因為他必不赦免你們的過犯。
verses.e: Pay attention to him , and listen to his voice . Don't provoke him , for he will not pardon your disobedience , for my name is in him .

verses.z: 「你若實在聽從他的話，照着我一切所說的去行，我就向你的仇敵作仇敵，向你的敵人作敵人。
verses.e: But if you indeed listen to his voice , and do all that I speak , then I will be an enemy to your enemies , and an adversary to your adversaries .

verses.z: 「我的使者要在你前面行，領你到亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、迦南人、希未人、耶布斯人那裏去，我必將他們剪除。
verses.e: For my angel shall go before you , and bring you in to the Amorite , the Hittite , the Perizzite , the Canaanite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite ; and I will cut them off .

verses.z: 你不可跪拜他們的神，不可事奉他，也不可效法他們的行為，卻要把神像盡行拆毀，打碎他們的柱像。
verses.e: You shall not bow down to their gods , nor serve them , nor follow their practices , but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars .

verses.z: 你們要事奉耶和華－你們的上帝，他必賜福與你的糧與你的水，也必從你們中間除去疾病。
verses.e: You shall serve the LORD your God , and he will bless your bread and your water , and I will take sickness away from among you .

verses.z: 你境內必沒有墜胎的，不生產的。我要使你滿了你年日的數目。
verses.e: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land . I will fulfill the number of your days .

verses.z: 凡你所到的地方，我要使那裏的眾民在你面前驚駭，擾亂，又要使你一切仇敵轉背[逃跑]。
verses.e: I will send my terror before you , and will confuse all the people to whom you come , and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you .

verses.z: 我要打發黃蜂飛在你前面，把希未人、迦南人、赫人攆出去。
verses.e: I will send the hornet before you , which will drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before you .

verses.z: 我不在一年之內將他們從你面前攆出去，恐怕地成為荒涼，野地的獸多起來害你。
verses.e: I will not drive them out from before you in one year , lest the land become desolate , and the animals of the field multiply against you .

verses.z: 也不可在爭訟的事上偏護窮人。
verses.e: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause .

verses.z: 我要漸漸地將他們從你面前攆出去，等到你的人數加多，承受那地為業。
verses.e: Little by little I will drive them out from before you , until you have increased and inherit the land .

verses.z: 我要定你的境界，從紅海直到非利士海，又從曠野直到大河。我要將那地的居民交在你手中，你要將他們從你面前攆出去。
verses.e: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines , and from the wilderness to the River ; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand , and you shall drive them out before you .

verses.z: 不可和他們並他們的神立約。
verses.e: You shall make no covenant with them , nor with their gods .

verses.z: 他們不可住在你的地上，恐怕他們使你得罪我。你若事奉他們的神，這必成為你的網羅。」
verses.e: They shall not dwell in your land , lest they make you sin against me , for if you serve their gods , it will surely be a snare to you . "

verses.z: 「若遇見你仇敵的牛或驢失迷了路，總要牽回來交給他。
verses.e: " If you meet your enemy's ox or his donkey going astray , you shall surely bring it back to him again .

verses.z: 若看見恨你人的驢壓臥在重馱之下，不可走開，務要和驢主一同抬開[重馱]。
verses.e: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden , don't leave him . You shall surely help him with it .

verses.z: 「不可在窮人爭訟的事上屈枉正直。
verses.e: " You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits .

verses.z: 當遠離虛假的事。不可殺無辜和有義的人，因我必不以惡人為義。
verses.e: " Keep far from a false charge , and don't kill the innocent and righteous ; for I will not justify the wicked .

verses.z: 不可受賄賂；因為賄賂能叫明眼人變瞎了，又能顛倒義人的話。
verses.e: " You shall take no bribe , for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous .

verses.z: 「不可欺壓寄居的；因為你們在埃及地作過寄居的，知道寄居的心。」
verses.e: " You shall not oppress an alien , for you know the heart of an alien , since you were aliens in the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你和亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都要上到我這裏來，遠遠地下拜。
verses.e: He said to Moses , " Come up to the LORD , you , and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel ; and worship from a distance .

verses.z: 他們看見以色列的上帝，他腳下彷彿有平鋪的藍寶石，如同天色明淨。
verses.e: They saw the God of Israel . Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone , like the skies for clearness .

verses.z: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他們觀看上帝；他們又吃又喝。
verses.e: He didn't lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel . They saw God , and ate and drank .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你上山到我這裏來，住在這裏，我要將石版並我所寫的律法和誡命賜給你，使你可以教訓百姓。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Come up to me on the mountain , and stay here , and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written , that you may teach them . "

verses.z: 摩西和他的幫手約書亞起來，上了上帝的山。
verses.e: Moses rose up with Joshua , his servant , and Moses went up onto God's Mountain .

verses.z: 摩西對長老說：「你們在這裏等着，等到我們再回來，有亞倫、戶珥與你們同在。凡有爭訟的，都可以就近他們去。」
verses.e: He said to the elders , " Wait here for us , until we come again to you . Behold , Aaron and Hur are with you . Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them . "

verses.z: 摩西上山，有雲彩把山遮蓋。
verses.e: Moses went up on the mountain , and the cloud covered the mountain .

verses.z: 耶和華的榮耀停於西奈山；雲彩遮蓋山六天，第七天他從雲中召摩西。
verses.e: The LORD's glory settled on Mount Sinai , and the cloud covered it six days . The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud .

verses.z: 耶和華的榮耀在山頂上，在以色列人眼前，形狀如烈火。
verses.e: The appearance of the LORD's glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 摩西進入雲中上山，在山上四十晝夜。
verses.e: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud , and went up on the mountain ; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights .

verses.z: 惟獨你可以親近耶和華；他們卻不可親近；百姓也不可和你一同上來。」
verses.e: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD , but they shall not come near . The people shall not go up with him . "

verses.z: 摩西下山，將耶和華的命令典章都述說與百姓聽。眾百姓齊聲說：「耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。」
verses.e: Moses came and told the people all the LORD's words , and all the ordinances ; and all the people answered with one voice , and said , " All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do . "

verses.z: 摩西將耶和華的命令都寫上。清早起來，在山下築一座壇，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，
verses.e: Moses wrote all the LORD's words , then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain , with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 又打發以色列人中的少年人去獻燔祭，又向耶和華獻牛為平安祭。
verses.e: He sent young men of the children of Israel , who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD .

verses.z: 摩西將血一半盛在盆中，一半灑在壇上；
verses.e: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins , and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar .

verses.z: 又將約書念給百姓聽。他們說：「耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。」
verses.e: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people , and they said , " We will do all that the LORD has said , and be obedient . "

verses.z: 摩西將血灑在百姓身上，說：「你看！這是立約的血，是耶和華按這一切話與你們立約[的憑據]。」
verses.e: Moses took the blood , and sprinkled it on the people , and said , " Look , this is the blood of the covenant , which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words . "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都上了山。
verses.e: Then Moses , Aaron , Nadab , Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel went up .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「要用皂莢木做一櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
verses.e: " They shall make an ark of acacia wood . Its length shall be two and a half cubits , its width a cubit and a half , and a cubit and a half its height .

verses.z: 要裏外包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
verses.e: You shall overlay it with pure gold . You shall overlay it inside and outside , and you shall make a gold molding around it .

verses.z: 也要鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上；這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
verses.e: You shall cast four rings of gold for it , and put them in its four feet . Two rings shall be on the one side of it , and two rings on the other side of it .

verses.z: 要用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹。
verses.e: You shall make poles of acacia wood , and overlay them with gold .

verses.z: 要把槓穿在櫃旁的環內，以便抬櫃。
verses.e: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark .

verses.z: 這槓要常在櫃的環內，不可抽出來。
verses.e: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark . They shall not be taken from it .

verses.z: 必將我所要賜給你的法[版]放在櫃裏。
verses.e: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark .

verses.z: 要用精金做施恩座，長二肘半，寬一肘半。
verses.e: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold . Two and a half cubits shall be its length , and a cubit and a half its width .

verses.z: 要用金子錘出兩個基路伯來，安在施恩座的兩頭。
verses.e: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold . You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat .

verses.z: 這頭做一個基路伯，那頭做一個基路伯，二基路伯要接連一塊，在施恩座的兩頭。
verses.e: Make one cherub at the one end , and one cherub at the other end . You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat .

verses.z: 「你告訴以色列人當為我送禮物來；凡甘心樂意的，你們就可以收下歸我。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , that they take an offering for me . From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering .

verses.z: 二基路伯要高張翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要臉對臉，朝着施恩座。
verses.e: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward , covering the mercy seat with their wings , with their faces toward one another . The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat .

verses.z: 要將施恩座安在櫃的上邊，又將我所要賜給你的法[版]放在櫃裏。
verses.e: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark , and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you .

verses.z: 我要在那裏與你相會，又要從法櫃施恩座上二基路伯中間，和你說我所要吩咐你傳給以色列人的一切事。」
verses.e: There I will meet with you , and I will tell you from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant , all that I command you for the children of Israel .

verses.z: 「要用皂莢木做一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半。
verses.e: " You shall make a table of acacia wood . Its length shall be two cubits , and its width a cubit , and its height one and a half cubits .

verses.z: 要包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
verses.e: You shall overlay it with pure gold , and make a gold molding around it .

verses.z: 桌子的四圍各做一掌寬的橫樑，橫樑上鑲着金牙邊。
verses.e: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it . You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it .

verses.z: 要做四個金環，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四腳上的四角。
verses.e: You shall make four rings of gold for it , and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet .

verses.z: 安環子的地方要挨近橫樑，可以穿槓抬桌子。
verses.e: The rings shall be close to the rim , for places for the poles to carry the table .

verses.z: 要用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
verses.e: You shall make the poles of acacia wood , and overlay them with gold , that the table may be carried with them .

verses.z: 要做桌子上的盤子、調羹，並奠[酒]的爵和瓶；這都要用精金製作。
verses.e: You shall make its dishes , its spoons , its ladles , and its bowls with which to pour out offerings . You shall make them of pure gold .

verses.z: 所要收的禮物：就是金、銀、銅，
verses.e: This is the offering which you shall take from them : gold , silver , bronze ,

verses.z: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常擺陳設餅。」
verses.e: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always .

verses.z: 「要用精金做一個燈臺。燈臺的座和幹與杯、球、花，都要接連一塊錘出來。
verses.e: " You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold . The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work . Its base , its shaft , its cups , its buds , and its flowers shall be of one piece with it .

verses.z: 燈臺兩旁要杈出六個枝子：這旁三個，那旁三個。
verses.e: There shall be six branches going out of its sides : three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side , and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side ;

verses.z: 這旁每枝上有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花；那旁每枝上也有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花。從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子都是如此。
verses.e: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch , a bud and a flower ; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch , a bud and a flower , so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand ;

verses.z: 燈臺上有四個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花。
verses.e: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms , its buds and its flowers ;

verses.z: 燈臺每兩個枝子以下有球與枝子接連一塊。燈臺出的六個枝子都是如此。
verses.e: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it , and a bud under two branches of one piece with it , and a bud under two branches of one piece with it , for the six branches going out of the lamp stand .

verses.z: 球和枝子要接連一塊，都是一塊精金錘出來的。
verses.e: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it , all of it one beaten work of pure gold .

verses.z: 要做燈臺的七個燈盞。祭司要點這燈，使燈光對照。
verses.e: You shall make its lamps seven , and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it .

verses.z: 燈臺的蠟剪和蠟花盤也是要精金的。
verses.e: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold .

verses.z: 做燈臺和這一切的器具要用精金一他連得。
verses.e: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold , with all these accessories .

verses.z: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，細麻，山羊[毛]，
verses.e: blue , purple , scarlet , fine linen , goats ' hair ,

verses.z: 要謹慎做這些物件，都要照着在山上指示你的樣式。」
verses.e: See that you make them after their pattern , which has been shown to you on the mountain .

verses.z: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
verses.e: rams ' skins dyed red , sea cow hides , acacia wood ,

verses.z: 點燈的油並做膏油和香的香料，
verses.e: oil for the light , spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense ,

verses.z: 紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。
verses.e: onyx stones , and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate .

verses.z: 又當為我造聖所，使我可以住在他們中間。
verses.e: Let them make me a sanctuary , that I may dwell among them .

verses.z: 製造帳幕和其中的一切器具都要照我所指示你的樣式。」
verses.e: According to all that I show you , the pattern of the tabernacle , and the pattern of all of its furniture , even so you shall make it .

verses.z: 「你要用十幅幔子做帳幕。這些幔子要用撚的細麻和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]製造，並用巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
verses.e: " Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , with cherubim . You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman .

verses.z: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上要做五十個鈕扣；在那相連的幔子[末幅]邊上也做五十個鈕扣。
verses.e: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling , and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling .

verses.z: 又要做五十個銅鉤，鉤在鈕扣中，使罩棚連成一個。
verses.e: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze , and put the clasps into the loops , and couple the tent together , that it may be one .

verses.z: 罩棚的幔子所餘那垂下來的半幅幔子，要垂在帳幕的後頭。
verses.e: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent — the half curtain that remains — shall hang over the back of the tabernacle .

verses.z: 罩棚的幔子所餘長的，這邊一肘，那邊一肘，要垂在帳幕的兩旁，遮蓋帳幕。
verses.e: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side , of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent , shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side , to cover it .

verses.z: 又要用染紅的公羊皮做罩棚的蓋；再用海狗皮做一層罩棚上的頂蓋。
verses.e: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams ' skins dyed red , and a covering of sea cow hides above .

verses.z: 「你要用皂莢木做帳幕的豎板。
verses.e: " You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood , standing upright .

verses.z: 每塊要長十肘，寬一肘半；
verses.e: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board , and one and a half cubits the width of each board .

verses.z: 每塊必有兩榫相對。帳幕一切的板都要這樣做。
verses.e: There shall be two tenons in each board , joined to one another : thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle .

verses.z: 帳幕的南面要做板二十塊。
verses.e: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle , for the south side southward .

verses.z: 在這二十塊板底下要做四十個帶卯的銀座，兩卯接這塊板上的兩榫，兩卯接那塊板上的兩榫。
verses.e: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards ; two sockets under one board for its two tenons , and two sockets under another board for its two tenons .

verses.z: 每幅幔子要長二十八肘，寬四肘，幔子都要一樣的尺寸。
verses.e: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits , and the width of each curtain four cubits : all the curtains shall have one measure .

verses.z: 帳幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十塊
verses.e: For the second side of the tabernacle , on the north side , twenty boards ,

verses.z: 和帶卯的銀座四十個；這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
verses.e: and their forty sockets of silver ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .

verses.z: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，要做板六塊。
verses.e: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards .

verses.z: 帳幕後面的拐角要做板兩塊。
verses.e: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side .

verses.z: 板的下半截要雙的，上半截要整的，直頂到第一個環子；兩塊都要這樣做兩個拐角。
verses.e: They shall be double beneath , and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring : thus shall it be for them both ; they shall be for the two corners .

verses.z: 必有八塊板和十六個帶卯的銀座；這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
verses.e: There shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .

verses.z: 「你要用皂莢木做閂：為帳幕這面的板做五閂，
verses.e: " You shall make bars of acacia wood : five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,

verses.z: 為帳幕那面的板做五閂，又為帳幕後面的板做五閂。
verses.e: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle , for the far side westward .

verses.z: 板腰間的中閂要從這一頭通到那一頭。
verses.e: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end .

verses.z: 板要用金子包裹，又要做板上的金環套閂；閂也要用金子包裹。
verses.e: You shall overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars . You shall overlay the bars with gold .

verses.z: 這五幅幔子要幅幅相連；那五幅幔子也要幅幅相連。
verses.e: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another , and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another .

verses.z: 要照着在山上指示你的樣式立起帳幕。
verses.e: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain .

verses.z: 「你要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
verses.e: " You shall make a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , with cherubim . It shall be the work of a skillful workman .

verses.z: 要把幔子掛在四根包金的皂莢木柱子上，柱子上當有金鉤，柱子安在四個帶卯的銀座上。
verses.e: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold ; their hooks shall be of gold , on four sockets of silver .

verses.z: 要使幔子垂在鉤子下，把法櫃抬進幔子內；這幔子要將聖所和至聖所隔開。
verses.e: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps , and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil . The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you .

verses.z: 又要把施恩座安在至聖所內的法櫃上，
verses.e: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place .

verses.z: 把桌子安在幔子外帳幕的北面；把燈臺安在帳幕的南面，彼此相對。
verses.e: You shall set the table outside the veil , and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south . You shall put the table on the north side .

verses.z: 「你要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾。
verses.e: " You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , the work of the embroiderer .

verses.z: 要用皂莢木為簾子做五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上當有金鉤；又要為柱子用銅鑄造五個帶卯的座。」
verses.e: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia , and overlay them with gold . Their hooks shall be of gold . You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them .

verses.z: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上要做藍色的鈕扣；在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也要照樣做。
verses.e: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling , and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling .

verses.z: 要在這相連的幔子上做五十個鈕扣；在那相連的幔子上也做五十個鈕扣，都要兩兩相對。
verses.e: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain , and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling . The loops shall be opposite one another .

verses.z: 又要做五十個金鉤，用鉤使幔子相連，這才成了一個帳幕。
verses.e: You shall make fifty clasps of gold , and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps . The tabernacle shall be a unit .

verses.z: 「你要用山羊[毛]織十一幅幔子，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
verses.e: " You shall make curtains of goats ' hair for a covering over the tabernacle . You shall make eleven curtains .

verses.z: 每幅幔子要長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幔子都要一樣的尺寸。
verses.e: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the width of each curtain four cubits : the eleven curtains shall have one measure .

verses.z: 要把五幅幔子連成一幅，又把六幅幔子連成一幅，這第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面摺上去。
verses.e: You shall couple five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves , and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent .

verses.z: 「你要用皂莢木做壇。這壇要四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘。
verses.e: " You shall make the altar of acacia wood , five cubits long , and five cubits wide . The altar shall be square . Its height shall be three cubits .

verses.z: 帷子的柱子要二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。
verses.e: Its pillars shall be twenty , and their sockets twenty , of bronze . The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver .

verses.z: 北面也當有帷子，長一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。
verses.e: Likewise for the length of the north side , there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long , and its pillars twenty , and their sockets twenty , of bronze ; the hooks of the pillars , and their fillets , of silver .

verses.z: 院子的西面當有帷子，寬五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，帶卯的座十個。
verses.e: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits ; their pillars ten , and their sockets ten .

verses.z: 院子的東面要寬五十肘。
verses.e: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits .

verses.z: [門]這邊的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
verses.e: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits ; their pillars three , and their sockets three .

verses.z: [門]那邊的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
verses.e: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits ; their pillars three , and their sockets three .

verses.z: 院子的門當有簾子，長二十肘，要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織成，柱子四根，帶卯的座四個。
verses.e: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , the work of the embroiderer ; their pillars four , and their sockets four .

verses.z: 院子四圍一切的柱子都要用銀杆連絡，柱子上的鉤子要用銀做，帶卯的座要用銅做。
verses.e: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver ; their hooks of silver , and their sockets of bronze .

verses.z: 院子要長一百肘，寬五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用撚的細麻做，帶卯的座要用銅做。
verses.e: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits , and the width fifty throughout , and the height five cubits , of fine twined linen , and their sockets of bronze .

verses.z: 帳幕各樣用處的器具，並帳幕一切的橛子，和院子裏一切的橛子，都要用銅做。」
verses.e: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service , and all its pins , and all the pins of the court , shall be of bronze .

verses.z: 要在壇的四拐角上做四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。
verses.e: You shall make its horns on its four corners . Its horns shall be of one piece with it . You shall overlay it with bronze .

verses.z: 「你要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點着。
verses.e: " You shall command the children of Israel , that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light , to cause a lamp to burn continually .

verses.z: 在會幕中法[櫃]前的幔外，亞倫和他的兒子，從晚上到早晨，要在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作以色列人世世代代永遠的定例。」
verses.e: In the Tent of Meeting , outside the veil which is before the covenant , Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD : it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 要做盆，收去壇上的灰，又做鏟子、盤子、肉鍤子、火鼎；壇上一切的器具都用銅做。
verses.e: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes ; and its shovels , its basins , its meat hooks , and its fire pans . You shall make all its vessels of bronze .

verses.z: 要為壇做一個銅網，在網的四角上做四個銅環，
verses.e: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze . On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners .

verses.z: 把網安在壇四面的圍腰板以下，使網從下達到壇的半腰。
verses.e: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath , that the net may reach halfway up the altar .

verses.z: 又要用皂莢木為壇做槓，用銅包裹。
verses.e: You shall make poles for the altar , poles of acacia wood , and overlay them with bronze .

verses.z: 這槓要穿在壇兩旁的環子內，用以抬壇。
verses.e: Its poles shall be put into the rings , and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it .

verses.z: 要用板做壇，壇是空的，都照着在山上指示你的樣式做。」
verses.e: You shall make it hollow with planks . They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain .

verses.z: 「你要做帳幕的院子。院子的南面要用撚的細麻做帷子，長一百肘。
verses.e: " You shall make the court of the tabernacle : for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side .

verses.z: 「你要從以色列人中，使你的哥哥亞倫和他的兒子拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪一同就近你，給我供祭司的職分。
verses.e: " Bring Aaron your brother , and his sons with him , near to you from among the children of Israel , that he may minister to me in the priest's office : Aaron , with Nadab , Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar , Aaron's sons .

verses.z: 六個名字在這塊寶石上，六個名字在那塊寶石上，都照他們生來的次序。
verses.e: Six of their names on the one stone , and the names of the six that remain on the other stone , in the order of their birth .

verses.z: 要用刻寶石的手工，彷彿刻圖書，按着以色列兒子的名字，刻這兩塊寶石，要鑲在金槽上。
verses.e: With the work of an engraver in stone , like the engravings of a signet , you shall engrave the two stones , according to the names of the children of Israel . You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold .

verses.z: 要將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人做紀念石。亞倫要在兩肩上擔他們的名字，在耶和華面前作為紀念。
verses.e: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod , to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel . Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial .

verses.z: 要用金子做二槽，
verses.e: You shall make settings of gold ,

verses.z: 又拿精金，用擰工彷彿擰繩子，做兩條鍊子，把這擰成的鍊子搭在二槽上。」
verses.e: and two chains of pure gold ; you shall make them like cords of braided work . You shall put the braided chains on the settings .

verses.z: 「你要用巧匠的手工做一個決斷的胸牌。要和以弗得一樣的做法：用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做成。
verses.e: " You shall make a breastplate of judgment , the work of the skillful workman ; like the work of the ephod you shall make it ; of gold , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , you shall make it .

verses.z: 這胸牌要四方的，疊為兩層，長一虎口，寬一虎口。
verses.e: It shall be square and folded double ; a span shall be its length , and a span its width .

verses.z: 要在上面鑲寶石四行：第一行是紅寶石、紅璧璽、紅玉；
verses.e: You shall set in it settings of stones , four rows of stones : a row of ruby , topaz , and beryl shall be the first row ;

verses.z: 第二行是綠寶石、藍寶石、金鋼石；
verses.e: and the second row a turquoise , a sapphire , and an emerald ;

verses.z: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶；
verses.e: and the third row a jacinth , an agate , and an amethyst ;

verses.z: 你要給你哥哥亞倫做聖衣為榮耀，為華美。
verses.e: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother , for glory and for beauty .

verses.z: 第四行是水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉。這都要鑲在金槽中。
verses.e: and the fourth row a chrysolite , an onyx , and a jasper . They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings .

verses.z: 這些寶石都要按着以色列十二個兒子的名字，彷彿刻圖書，刻十二個支派的名字。
verses.e: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names ; like the engravings of a signet , everyone according to his name , they shall be for the twelve tribes .

verses.z: 要在胸牌上用精金擰成如繩的鍊子。
verses.e: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords , of braided work of pure gold .

verses.z: 在胸牌上也要做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭。
verses.e: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold , and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate .

verses.z: 要把那兩條擰成的金鍊子，穿過胸牌兩頭的環子。
verses.e: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate .

verses.z: 又要把鍊子的那兩頭接在兩槽上，安在以弗得前面肩帶上。
verses.e: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings , and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart .

verses.z: 要做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭，在以弗得裏面的邊上。
verses.e: You shall make two rings of gold , and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate , on its edge , which is toward the side of the ephod inward .

verses.z: 又要做兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，挨近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
verses.e: You shall make two rings of gold , and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath , in its forepart , close by its coupling , above the skillfully woven band of the ephod .

verses.z: 要用藍細帶子把胸牌的環子與以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不可與以弗得離縫。
verses.e: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod , and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod .

verses.z: 亞倫進聖所的時候，要將決斷胸牌，就是刻着以色列兒子名字的，帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常作紀念。
verses.e: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart , when he goes in to the holy place , for a memorial before the LORD continually .

verses.z: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫做衣服，使他分別為聖，可以給我供祭司的職分。
verses.e: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they make Aaron's garments to sanctify him , that he may minister to me in the priest's office .

verses.z: 又要將烏陵和土明放在決斷的胸牌裏；亞倫進到耶和華面前的時候，要帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常將以色列人的決斷牌帶在胸前。」
verses.e: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim ; and they shall be on Aaron's heart , when he goes in before the LORD . Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually .

verses.z: 「你要做以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
verses.e: " You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue .

verses.z: 袍上要為頭留一領口，口的周圍織出領邊來，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
verses.e: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it . It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole , as it were the hole of a coat of mail , that it not be torn .

verses.z: 袍子周圍底邊上要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]做石榴。在袍子周圍的石榴中間要有金鈴鐺：
verses.e: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , all around its hem ; with bells of gold between and around them :

verses.z: 一個金鈴鐺一個石榴，一個金鈴鐺一個石榴，在袍子周圍的底邊上。
verses.e: a golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , around the hem of the robe .

verses.z: 亞倫供職的時候要穿這袍子。他進聖所到耶和華面前，以及出來的時候，袍上的響聲必被聽見，使他不至於死亡。
verses.e: It shall be on Aaron to minister : and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD , and when he comes out , that he not die .

verses.z: 「你要用精金做一面牌，在上面按刻圖書之法刻着『歸耶和華為聖』。
verses.e: " You shall make a plate of pure gold , and engrave on it , like the engravings of a signet , ' HOLY TO THE LORD . '

verses.z: 要用一條藍細帶子將牌繫在冠冕的前面。
verses.e: You shall put it on a lace of blue , and it shall be on the sash . It shall be on the front of the sash .

verses.z: 這牌必在亞倫的額上，亞倫要擔當干犯聖物[條例]的罪孽；這聖物是以色列人在一切的聖禮物上所分別為聖的。這牌要常在他的額上，使他們可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
verses.e: It shall be on Aaron's forehead , and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts ; and it shall be always on his forehead , that they may be accepted before the LORD .

verses.z: 要用雜色細麻[線]織內袍，用細麻布做冠冕，又用繡花的手工做腰帶。
verses.e: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen . You shall make a turban of fine linen . You shall make a sash , the work of the embroiderer .

verses.z: 所要做的就是胸牌、以弗得、外袍、雜色的內袍、冠冕、腰帶，使你哥哥亞倫和他兒子[穿]這聖服，可以給我供祭司的職分。
verses.e: These are the garments which they shall make : a breastplate , an ephod , a robe , a fitted tunic , a turban , and a sash . They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons , that he may minister to me in the priest's office .

verses.z: 「你要為亞倫的兒子做內袍、腰帶、裹頭巾，為榮耀，為華美。
verses.e: " You shall make tunics for Aaron's sons . You shall make sashes for them . You shall make headbands for them , for glory and for beauty .

verses.z: 要把這些給你的哥哥亞倫和他的兒子穿戴，又要膏他們，將他們分別為聖，好給我供祭司的職分。
verses.e: You shall put them on Aaron your brother , and on his sons with him , and shall anoint them , and consecrate them , and sanctify them , that they may minister to me in the priest's office .

verses.z: 要給他們做細麻布褲子，遮掩下體；褲子當從腰達到大腿。
verses.e: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh . They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs .

verses.z: 亞倫和他兒子進入會幕，或就近壇，在聖所供職的時候必穿上，免得擔罪而死。這要為亞倫和他的後裔作永遠的定例。」
verses.e: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons , when they go in to the Tent of Meeting , or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place , that they don't bear iniquity , and die . This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him .

verses.z: 要用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並細麻去做。
verses.e: They shall use the gold , and the blue , and the purple , and the scarlet , and the fine linen .

verses.z: 「他們要拿金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻，用巧匠的手工做以弗得。
verses.e: " They shall make the ephod of gold , blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen , the work of the skillful workman .

verses.z: 以弗得當有兩條肩帶，接上兩頭，使它相連。
verses.e: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it , that it may be joined together .

verses.z: 其上巧工織的帶子，要和以弗得一樣的做法，用以束上，與以弗得接連一塊，要用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做成。
verses.e: The skillfully woven band , which is on it , shall be like its work and of the same piece ; of gold , blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen .

verses.z: 要取兩塊紅瑪瑙，在上面刻以色列兒子的名字：
verses.e: You shall take two onyx stones , and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 「你使亞倫和他兒子成聖，給我供祭司的職分，要如此行：取一隻公牛犢，兩隻無殘疾的公綿羊，
verses.e: " This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy , to minister to me in the priest's office : take one young bull and two rams without defect ,

verses.z: 「你要把公牛牽到會幕前，亞倫和他兒子要按手在公牛的頭上。
verses.e: " You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting ; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull .

verses.z: 你要在耶和華面前，在會幕門口，宰這公牛。
verses.e: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 要取些公牛的血，用指頭抹在壇的四角上，把血都倒在壇腳那裏。
verses.e: You shall take of the blood of the bull , and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger ; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar .

verses.z: 要把一切蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上。
verses.e: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards , the cover of the liver , the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , and burn them on the altar .

verses.z: 只是公牛的皮、肉、糞都要用火燒在營外。這牛是贖罪祭。
verses.e: But the meat of the bull , and its skin , and its dung , you shall burn with fire outside of the camp . It is a sin offering .

verses.z: 「你要牽一隻公綿羊來，亞倫和他兒子要按手在這羊的頭上。
verses.e: " You shall also take the one ram , and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram .

verses.z: 要宰這羊，把血灑在壇的周圍。
verses.e: You shall kill the ram , and you shall take its blood , and sprinkle it around on the altar .

verses.z: 要把羊切成塊子，洗淨五臟和腿，連塊子帶頭，都放在一處。
verses.e: You shall cut the ram into its pieces , and wash its innards , and its legs , and put them with its pieces , and with its head .

verses.z: 要把全羊燒在壇上，是給耶和華獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar : it is a burnt offering to the LORD ; it is a pleasant aroma , an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 「你要將那一隻公綿羊牽來，亞倫和他兒子要按手在羊的頭上。
verses.e: " You shall take the other ram , and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram .

verses.z: 無酵餅和調油的無酵餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅；這都要用細麥麵做成。
verses.e: unleavened bread , unleavened cakes mixed with oil , and unleavened wafers anointed with oil . You shall make them of fine wheat flour .

verses.z: 你要宰這羊，取點血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上和他兒子的右耳垂上，又抹在他們右手的大拇指上和右腳的大拇指上；並要把血灑在壇的四圍。
verses.e: Then you shall kill the ram , and take some of its blood , and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron , and on the tip of the right ear of his sons , and on the thumb of their right hand , and on the big toe of their right foot ; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar .

verses.z: 你要取點膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子和他兒子的衣服上，他們和他們的衣服就一同成聖。
verses.e: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it on Aaron , and on his garments , and on his sons , and on the garments of his sons with him : and he shall be made holy , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons ' garments with him .

verses.z: 「你要取這羊的脂油和肥尾巴，並蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油並右腿（這是承接聖職所獻的羊）。
verses.e: Also you shall take some of the ram's fat , the fat tail , the fat that covers the innards , the cover of the liver , the two kidneys , the fat that is on them , and the right thigh ( for it is a ram of consecration ) ,

verses.z: 再從耶和華面前裝無酵餅的筐子中取一個餅，一個調油的餅和一個薄餅，
verses.e: and one loaf of bread , one cake of oiled bread , and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD .

verses.z: 都放在亞倫的手上和他兒子的手上，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
verses.e: You shall put all of this in Aaron's hands , and in his sons ' hands , and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.z: 要從他們手中接過來，燒在耶和華面前壇上的燔祭上，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: You shall take them from their hands , and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering , for a pleasant aroma before the LORD : it is an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 「你要取亞倫承接聖職所獻公羊的胸，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，這就可以作你的分。
verses.e: " You shall take the breast of Aaron's ram of consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD . It shall be your portion .

verses.z: 那搖祭的胸和舉祭的腿，就是承接聖職所搖的、所舉的，是歸亞倫和他兒子的。這些你都要成為聖，
verses.e: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering , which is waved , and which is raised up , of the ram of consecration , even of that which is for Aaron , and of that which is for his sons .

verses.z: 作亞倫和他子孫從以色列人中永遠所得的分，因為是舉祭。這要從以色列人的平安祭中，作為獻給耶和華的舉祭。
verses.e: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel ; for it is a wave offering . It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings , even their wave offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 「亞倫的聖衣要留給他的子孫，可以穿着受膏，又穿着承接聖職。
verses.e: " The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him , to be anointed in them , and to be consecrated in them .

verses.z: 這餅要裝在一個筐子裏，連筐子帶來，又把公牛和兩隻公綿羊牽來。
verses.e: You shall put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bull and the two rams .

verses.z: 他的子孫接續他當祭司的，每逢進會幕在聖所供職的時候，要穿七天。
verses.e: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on , when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place .

verses.z: 「你要將承接聖職所獻公羊的肉煮在聖處。
verses.e: " You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place .

verses.z: 亞倫和他兒子要在會幕門口吃這羊的肉和筐內的餅。
verses.e: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram , and the bread that is in the basket , at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 他們吃那些贖罪之物，好承接聖職，使他們成聖；只是外人不可吃，因為這是聖物。
verses.e: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made , to consecrate and sanctify them ; but a stranger shall not eat of it , because they are holy .

verses.z: 那承接聖職所獻的肉或餅，若有一點留到早晨，就要用火燒了，不可吃這物，因為是聖物。
verses.e: If anything of the meat of the consecration , or of the bread , remains to the morning , then you shall burn the remainder with fire . It shall not be eaten , because it is holy .

verses.z: 「你要這樣照我一切所吩咐的，向亞倫和他兒子行承接聖職的禮七天。
verses.e: " You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons , according to all that I have commanded you . You shall consecrate them seven days .

verses.z: 每天要獻公牛一隻為贖罪祭。你潔淨壇的時候，壇就潔淨了；且要用膏抹壇，使壇成聖。
verses.e: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement . You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it . You shall anoint it , to sanctify it .

verses.z: 要潔淨壇七天，使壇成聖，壇就成為至聖。凡挨着壇的都成為聖。」
verses.e: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar , and sanctify it ; and the altar shall be most holy . Whatever touches the altar shall be holy .

verses.z: 「你每天所要獻在壇上的就是兩隻一歲的羊羔；
verses.e: " Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar : two lambs a year old day by day continually .

verses.z: 早晨要獻這一隻，黃昏的時候要獻那一隻。
verses.e: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning ; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening ;

verses.z: 要使亞倫和他兒子到會幕門口來，用水洗身。
verses.e: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting , and shall wash them with water .

verses.z: 和這一隻羊羔同獻的，要用細麵[伊法]十分之一與搗成的油一欣四分之一調和，又用酒一欣四分之一作為奠祭。
verses.e: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil , and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering .

verses.z: 那一隻羊羔要在黃昏的時候獻上，照着早晨的素祭和奠祭的禮辦理，作為獻給耶和華馨香的火祭。
verses.e: The other lamb you shall offer at evening , and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering , for a pleasant aroma , an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 這要在耶和華面前、會幕門口，作你們世世代代常獻的燔祭。我要在那裏與你們相會，和你們說話。
verses.e: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD , where I will meet with you , to speak there to you .

verses.z: 我要在那裏與以色列人相會，[會幕]就要因我的榮耀成為聖。
verses.e: There I will meet with the children of Israel ; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory .

verses.z: 我要使會幕和壇成聖，也要使亞倫和他的兒子成聖，給我供祭司的職分。
verses.e: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar . I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest's office .

verses.z: 我要住在以色列人中間，作他們的上帝。
verses.e: I will dwell among the children of Israel , and will be their God .

verses.z: 他們必知道我是耶和華－他們的上帝，是將他們從埃及地領出來的，為要住在他們中間。我是耶和華－他們的上帝。」
verses.e: They shall know that I am the LORD their God , who brought them out of the land of Egypt , that I might dwell among them : I am the LORD their God .

verses.z: 要給亞倫穿上內袍和以弗得的外袍，並以弗得，又帶上胸牌，束上以弗得巧工織的帶子。
verses.e: You shall take the garments , and put on Aaron the tunic , the robe of the ephod , the ephod , and the breastplate , and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod .

verses.z: 把冠冕戴在他頭上，將聖冠加在冠冕上，
verses.e: You shall set the turban on his head , and put the holy crown on the turban .

verses.z: 就把膏油倒在他頭上膏他。
verses.e: Then you shall take the anointing oil , and pour it on his head , and anoint him .

verses.z: 要叫他的兒子來，給他們穿上內袍。
verses.e: You shall bring his sons , and put tunics on them .

verses.z: 給亞倫和他兒子束上腰帶，包上裹頭巾，他們就憑永遠的定例得了祭司的職任。又要將亞倫和他兒子分別為聖。
verses.e: You shall clothe them with belts , Aaron and his sons , and bind headbands on them . They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute . You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons .

verses.z: 摩西牧養他岳父米甸祭司葉忒羅的羊群；一日領羊群往野外去，到了上帝的山，就是何烈山。
verses.e: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro , his father-in-law , the priest of Midian , and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness , and came to God's mountain , to Horeb .

verses.z: 故此，我要打發你去見法老，使你可以將我的百姓以色列人從埃及領出來。」
verses.e: Come now therefore , and I will send you to Pharaoh , that you may bring my people , the children of Israel , out of Egypt . "

verses.z: 摩西對上帝說：「我是甚麼人，竟能去見法老，將以色列人從埃及領出來呢？」
verses.e: Moses said to God , " Who am I , that I should go to Pharaoh , and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt ? "

verses.z: 上帝說：「我必與你同在。你將百姓從埃及領出來之後，你們必在這山上事奉我；這就是我打發你去的證據。」
verses.e: He said , " Certainly I will be with you . This will be the token to you , that I have sent you : when you have brought the people out of Egypt , you shall serve God on this mountain . "

verses.z: 摩西對上帝說：「我到以色列人那裏，對他們說：『你們祖宗的上帝打發我到你們這裏來。』他們若問我說：『他叫甚麼名字？』我要對他們說甚麼呢？」
verses.e: Moses said to God , " Behold , when I come to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' The God of your fathers has sent me to you , ' and they ask me , ' What is his name ? ' what should I tell them ? "

verses.z: 上帝對摩西說：「我是自有永有的」；又說：「你要對以色列人這樣說：『那自有的打發我到你們這裏來。』」
verses.e: God said to Moses , " I AM WHO I AM , " and he said , " You shall tell the children of Israel this : ' I AM has sent me to you . ' "

verses.z: 上帝又對摩西說：「你要對以色列人這樣說：『耶和華－你們祖宗的上帝，就是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，打發我到你們這裏來。』耶和華是我的名，直到永遠；這也是我的紀念，直到萬代。
verses.e: God said moreover to Moses , " You shall tell the children of Israel this , ' The LORD , the God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , has sent me to you . ' This is my name forever , and this is my memorial to all generations .
