verses.z: 你去招聚以色列的長老，對他們說：『耶和華－你們祖宗的上帝，就是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，向我顯現，說：我實在眷顧了你們，我也[看見]埃及人怎樣待你們。
verses.e: Go and gather the elders of Israel together , and tell them , ' The LORD , the God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Jacob , has appeared to me , saying , " I have surely visited you , and seen that which is done to you in Egypt .

verses.z: 我也說：要將你們從埃及的困苦中領出來，往迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地去，就是到流奶與蜜之地。』
verses.e: I have said , I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite , the Hittite , the Amorite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite , to a land flowing with milk and honey . " '

verses.z: 他們必聽你的話。你和以色列的長老要去見埃及王，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的上帝遇見了我們，現在求你容我們往曠野去，走三天的路程，為要祭祀耶和華－我們的上帝。』
verses.e: They will listen to your voice . You shall come , you and the elders of Israel , to the king of Egypt , and you shall tell him , ' The LORD , the God of the Hebrews , has met with us . Now please let us go three days ' journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the LORD , our God . '

verses.z: 我知道雖用大能的手，埃及王也不容你們去。
verses.e: I know that the king of Egypt won't give you permission to go , no , not by a mighty hand .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者從荊棘裏火焰中向摩西顯現。摩西觀看，不料，荊棘被火燒着，卻沒有燒毀。
verses.e: The LORD's angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush . He looked , and behold , the bush burned with fire , and the bush was not consumed .

verses.z: 我必伸手在埃及中間施行我一切的奇事，攻擊那地，然後他才容你們去。
verses.e: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them , and after that he will let you go .

verses.z: 我必叫你們在埃及人眼前蒙恩，你們去的時候就不至於空手而去。
verses.e: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians , and it will happen that when you go , you shall not go empty-handed .

verses.z: 但各婦女必向她的鄰舍，並居住在她家裏的女人，要金器銀器和衣裳，好給你們的兒女穿戴。這樣你們就把埃及人的[財物]奪去了。」
verses.e: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor , and of her who visits her house , jewels of silver , jewels of gold , and clothing . You shall put them on your sons , and on your daughters . You shall plunder the Egyptians . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「我要過去看這大異象，這荊棘為何沒有燒壞呢？」
verses.e: Moses said , " I will go now , and see this great sight , why the bush is not burned . "

verses.z: 耶和華上帝見他過去要看，就從荊棘裏呼叫說：「摩西！摩西！」他說：「我在這裏。」
verses.e: When the LORD saw that he came over to see , God called to him out of the middle of the bush , and said , " Moses ! Moses ! " He said , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 上帝說：「不要近前來。當把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站之地是聖地」；
verses.e: He said , " Don't come close . Take off your sandals , for the place you are standing on is holy ground . "

verses.z: 又說：「我是你父親的上帝，是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。」摩西蒙上臉，因為怕看上帝。
verses.e: Moreover he said , " I am the God of your father , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . " Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了；他們因受督工的轄制所發的哀聲，我也聽見了。我原知道他們的痛苦，
verses.e: The LORD said , " I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt , and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters , for I know their sorrows .

verses.z: 我下來是要救他們脫離埃及人的手，領他們出了那地，到美好、寬闊、流奶與蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地。
verses.e: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians , and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land , to a land flowing with milk and honey ; to the place of the Canaanite , the Hittite , the Amorite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite .

verses.z: 現在以色列人的哀聲達到我耳中，我也看見埃及人怎樣欺壓他們。
verses.e: Now , behold , the cry of the children of Israel has come to me . Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them .

verses.z: 「你要用皂莢木做一座燒香的壇。
verses.e: " You shall make an altar to burn incense on . You shall make it of acacia wood .

verses.z: 亞倫一年一次要在壇的角上行贖罪之禮。他一年一次要用贖罪祭牲的血在壇上行贖罪之禮，作為世世代代的定例。這壇在耶和華面前為至聖。」
verses.e: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year ; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations . It is most holy to the LORD . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要按以色列人被數的，計算總數，你數的時候，他們各人要為自己的生命把贖價奉給耶和華，免得數的時候在他們中間有災殃。
verses.e: " When you take a census of the children of Israel , according to those who are counted among them , then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when you count them , that there be no plague among them when you count them .

verses.z: 凡過去歸那些被數之人的，每人要按聖所的平，拿銀子半舍客勒；這半舍客勒是奉給耶和華的禮物（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
verses.e: They shall give this , everyone who passes over to those who are counted , half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary ( the shekel is twenty gerahs ) ; half a shekel for an offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 凡過去歸那些被數的人，從二十歲以外的，要將這禮物奉給耶和華。
verses.e: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted , from twenty years old and upward , shall give the offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 他們為贖生命將禮物奉給耶和華，富足的不可多出，貧窮的也不可少出，各人要出半舍客勒。
verses.e: The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less , than the half shekel , when they give the offering of the LORD , to make atonement for your souls .

verses.z: 你要從以色列人收這贖罪銀，作為會幕的使用，可以在耶和華面前為以色列人作紀念，贖生命。」
verses.e: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel , and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting ; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD , to make atonement for your souls . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要用銅做洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要將盆放在會幕和壇的中間，在盆裏盛水。
verses.e: " You shall also make a basin of bronze , and its base of bronze , in which to wash . You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar , and you shall put water in it .

verses.z: 亞倫和他的兒子要在這盆裏洗手洗腳。
verses.e: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it .

verses.z: 這壇要四方的，長一肘，寬一肘，高二肘；壇的四角要與壇接連一塊。
verses.e: Its length shall be a cubit , and its width a cubit . It shall be square , and its height shall be two cubits . Its horns shall be of one piece with it .

verses.z: 他們進會幕，或是就近壇前供職給耶和華獻火祭的時候，必用水洗濯，免得死亡。
verses.e: When they go into the Tent of Meeting , they shall wash with water , that they don't die ; or when they come near to the altar to minister , to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 他們洗手洗腳就免得死亡。這要作亞倫和他後裔世世代代永遠的定例。」
verses.e: So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they not die . This shall be a statute forever to them , even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要取上品的香料，就是流質的沒藥五百[舍客勒]，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，
verses.e: " Also take fine spices : of liquid myrrh , five hundred shekels ; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much , even two hundred and fifty ; and of fragrant cane , two hundred and fifty ;

verses.z: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着聖所的平，又取橄欖油一欣，
verses.e: and of cassia five hundred , according to the shekel of the sanctuary ; and a hin of olive oil .

verses.z: 按做香之法調和做成聖膏油。
verses.e: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil , a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer : it shall be a holy anointing oil .

verses.z: 要用這膏油抹會幕和法櫃，
verses.e: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting , the ark of the covenant ,

verses.z: 桌子與桌子的一切器具，燈臺和燈臺的器具，並香壇、
verses.e: the table and all its articles , the lamp stand and its accessories , the altar of incense ,

verses.z: 燔祭壇，和壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座。
verses.e: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils , and the basin with its base .

verses.z: 要使這些物成為聖，好成為至聖；凡挨着的都成為聖。
verses.e: You shall sanctify them , that they may be most holy . Whatever touches them shall be holy .

verses.z: 要用精金把壇的上面與壇的四圍，並壇的四角，包裹；又要在壇的四圍鑲上金牙邊。
verses.e: You shall overlay it with pure gold , its top , its sides around it , and its horns ; and you shall make a gold molding around it .

verses.z: 要膏亞倫和他的兒子，使他們成為聖，可以給我供祭司的職分。
verses.e: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons , and sanctify them , that they may minister to me in the priest's office .

verses.z: 你要對以色列人說：『這油，我要世世代代以為聖膏油。
verses.e: You shall speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations .

verses.z: 不可倒在別人的身上，也不可按這調和之法做與此相似的。這膏油是聖的，你們也要以為聖。
verses.e: It shall not be poured on man's flesh , and do not make any like it , according to its composition . It is holy . It shall be holy to you .

verses.z: 凡調和與此相似的，或將這膏膏在別人身上的，這人要從民中剪除。』」
verses.e: Whoever compounds any like it , or whoever puts any of it on a stranger , he shall be cut off from his people . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你要取馨香的香料，就是拿他弗、施喜列、喜利比拿；這馨香的香料和淨乳香各樣要一般大的分量。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Take to yourself sweet spices , gum resin , onycha , and galbanum : sweet spices with pure frankincense . There shall be an equal weight of each .

verses.z: 你要用這些加上鹽，按做香之法做成清淨聖潔的香。
verses.e: You shall make incense of it , a perfume after the art of the perfumer , seasoned with salt , pure and holy .

verses.z: 這香要取點搗得極細，放在會幕內、法[櫃]前，我要在那裏與你相會。你們要以這香為至聖。
verses.e: You shall beat some of it very small , and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting , where I will meet with you . It shall be to you most holy .

verses.z: 你們不可按這調和之法為自己做香；要以這香為聖，歸耶和華。
verses.e: You shall not make this incense , according to its composition , for yourselves : it shall be to you holy for the LORD .

verses.z: 凡做香和這香一樣，為要聞香味的，這人要從民中剪除。」
verses.e: Whoever shall make any like that , to smell of it , he shall be cut off from his people . "

verses.z: 要做兩個金環安在牙子邊以下，在壇的兩旁，兩根橫撐上，作為穿槓的用處，以便抬壇。
verses.e: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding ; on its two ribs , on its two sides you shall make them ; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it .

verses.z: 要用皂莢木做槓，用金包裹。
verses.e: You shall make the poles of acacia wood , and overlay them with gold .

verses.z: 要把壇放在法櫃前的幔子外，對着法[櫃]上的施恩座，就是我要與你相會的地方。
verses.e: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant , before the mercy seat that is over the covenant , where I will meet with you .

verses.z: 亞倫在壇上要燒馨香料做的香；每早晨他收拾燈的時候，要燒這香。
verses.e: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning . When he tends the lamps , he shall burn it .

verses.z: 黃昏點燈的時候，他要在耶和華面前燒這香，作為世世代代常燒的香。
verses.e: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening , he shall burn it , a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations .

verses.z: 在這壇上不可奉上異樣的香，不可獻燔祭、素祭，也不可澆上奠祭。
verses.e: You shall offer no strange incense on it , nor burnt offering , nor meal offering ; and you shall pour no drink offering on it .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子用以供祭司職分的聖衣，
verses.e: the finely worked garments — the holy garments for Aaron the priest , the garments of his sons to minister in the priest's office —

verses.z: 膏油和為聖所用馨香的香料。他們都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。」
verses.e: the anointing oil , and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place : according to all that I have commanded you they shall do . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要吩咐以色列人說：『你們務要守我的安息日；因為這是你我之間世世代代的證據，使你們知道我－耶和華是叫你們成為聖的。
verses.e: " Speak also to the children of Israel , saying , ' Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths ; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations , that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you .

verses.z: 所以你們要守安息日，以為聖日。凡干犯這日的，必要把他治死；凡在這日做工的，必從民中剪除。
verses.e: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore , for it is holy to you . Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death ; for whoever does any work therein , that soul shall be cut off from among his people .

verses.z: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息聖日，是向耶和華守為聖的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。』
verses.e: Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest , holy to the LORD . Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日為永遠的約。
verses.e: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath , to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations , for a perpetual covenant .

verses.z: 這是我和以色列人永遠的證據；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，第七日便安息舒暢。」
verses.e: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever ; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth , and on the seventh day he rested , and was refreshed . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華在西奈山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊法版交給他，是上帝用指頭寫的石版。
verses.e: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai , he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant , stone tablets , written with God's finger .

verses.z: 「看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，我已經提他的名召他。
verses.e: " Behold , I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah .

verses.z: 我也以我的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧，有聰明，有知識，能做各樣的工，
verses.e: I have filled him with the Spirit of God , in wisdom , and in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all kinds of workmanship ,

verses.z: 能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，
verses.e: to devise skillful works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in bronze ,

verses.z: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的工。
verses.e: and in cutting of stones for setting , and in carving of wood , to work in all kinds of workmanship .

verses.z: 我分派但支派中、亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯與他同工。凡心裏有智慧的，我更使他們有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，
verses.e: Behold , I myself have appointed with him Oholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan ; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded you :

verses.z: 就是會幕和法櫃，並其上的施恩座，與[會]幕中一切的器具，
verses.e: the Tent of Meeting , the ark of the covenant , the mercy seat that is on it , all the furniture of the Tent ,

verses.z: 桌子和桌子的器具，精[金]的燈臺和燈臺的一切器具並香壇，
verses.e: the table and its vessels , the pure lamp stand with all its vessels , the altar of incense ,

verses.z: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具，並洗濯盆與盆座，
verses.e: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels , the basin and its base ,

verses.z: 百姓見摩西遲延不下山，就大家聚集到亞倫那裏，對他說：「起來！為我們做神[像]，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。」
verses.e: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain , the people gathered themselves together to Aaron , and said to him , " Come , make us gods , which shall go before us ; for as for this Moses , the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we don't know what has become of him . "

verses.z: 你且由着我，我要向他們發烈怒，將他們滅絕，使你的後裔成為大國。」
verses.e: Now therefore leave me alone , that my wrath may burn hot against them , and that I may consume them ; and I will make of you a great nation . "

verses.z: 摩西便懇求耶和華－他的上帝說：「耶和華啊，你為甚麼向你的百姓發烈怒呢？這百姓是你用大力和大能的手從埃及地領出來的。
verses.e: Moses begged the LORD his God , and said , " LORD , why does your wrath burn hot against your people , that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand ?

verses.z: 為甚麼使埃及人議論說『他領他們出去，是要降禍與他們，把他們殺在山中，將他們從地上除滅』？求你轉意，不發你的烈怒，後悔，不降禍與你的百姓。
verses.e: Why should the Egyptians talk , saying , ' He brought them out for evil , to kill them in the mountains , and to consume them from the surface of the earth ' ? Turn from your fierce wrath , and turn away from this evil against your people .

verses.z: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列。你曾指着自己起誓說：『我必使你們的後裔像天上的星那樣多，並且我所應許的這全地，必給你們的後裔，他們要永遠承受為業。』」
verses.e: Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , your servants , to whom you swore by your own self , and said to them , ' I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky , and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring , and they shall inherit it forever . ' "

verses.z: 於是耶和華後悔，不把所說的禍降與他的百姓。
verses.e: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people .

verses.z: 摩西轉身下山，手裏拿着兩塊法版。這版是兩面寫的，這面那面都有字，
verses.e: Moses turned , and went down from the mountain , with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand ; tablets that were written on both their sides . They were written on one side and on the other .

verses.z: 是上帝的工作，字是上帝寫的，刻在版上。
verses.e: The tablets were the work of God , and the writing was the writing of God , engraved on the tablets .

verses.z: 約書亞一聽見百姓呼喊的聲音，就對摩西說：「在營裏有爭戰的聲音。」
verses.e: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said to Moses , " There is the noise of war in the camp . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「這不是人打勝仗的聲音，也不是人打敗仗的聲音；我所聽見的乃是人歌唱的聲音。」
verses.e: He said , " It isn't the voice of those who shout for victory . It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome ; but the noise of those who sing that I hear . "

verses.z: 摩西挨近營前就看見牛犢，又看見人跳舞，便發烈怒，把兩塊版扔在山下摔碎了，
verses.e: As soon as he came near to the camp , he saw the calf and the dancing . Then Moses ' anger grew hot , and he threw the tablets out of his hands , and broke them beneath the mountain .

verses.z: 亞倫對他們說：「你們去摘下你們妻子、兒女耳上的金環，拿來給我。」
verses.e: Aaron said to them , " Take off the golden rings , which are in the ears of your wives , of your sons , and of your daughters , and bring them to me . "

verses.z: 又將他們所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。
verses.e: He took the calf which they had made , and burned it with fire , ground it to powder , and scattered it on the water , and made the children of Israel drink it .

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫說：「這百姓向你做了甚麼？你竟使他們陷在大罪裏！」
verses.e: Moses said to Aaron , " What did these people do to you , that you have brought a great sin on them ? "

verses.z: 亞倫說：「求我主不要發烈怒。這百姓[專於]作惡，是你知道的。
verses.e: Aaron said , " Don't let the anger of my lord grow hot . You know the people , that they are set on evil .

verses.z: 他們對我說：『你為我們做神[像]，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。』
verses.e: For they said to me , ' Make us gods , which shall go before us . As for this Moses , the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we don't know what has become of him . '

verses.z: 我對他們說：『凡有金環的可以摘下來』，他們就給了我。我把金環扔在火中，這牛犢便出來了。」
verses.e: I said to them , ' Whoever has any gold , let them take it off . ' So they gave it to me ; and I threw it into the fire , and out came this calf . "

verses.z: 摩西見百姓放肆（亞倫縱容他們，使他們在仇敵中間被譏刺），
verses.e: When Moses saw that the people were out of control , ( for Aaron had let them lose control , causing derision among their enemies ) ,

verses.z: 就站在營門中，說：「凡屬耶和華的，都[要到]我這裏來！」於是利未的子孫都到他那裏聚集。
verses.e: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , " Whoever is on the LORD's side , come to me ! " All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him .

verses.z: 他對他們說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝這樣說：『你們各人把刀跨在腰間，在營中往來，從這門到那門，各人殺他的弟兄與同伴並鄰舍。』」
verses.e: He said to them , " The LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' Every man put his sword on his thigh , and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp , and every man kill his brother , and every man his companion , and every man his neighbor . ' "

verses.z: 利未的子孫照摩西的話行了。那一天百姓中被殺的約有三千。
verses.e: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses . About three thousand men fell of the people that day .

verses.z: 摩西說：「今天你們要自潔，歸耶和華為聖，各人攻擊他的兒子和弟兄，使耶和華賜福與你們。」
verses.e: Moses said , " Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD , for every man was against his son and against his brother , that he may give you a blessing today . "

verses.z: 百姓就都摘下他們耳上的金環，拿來給亞倫。
verses.e: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears , and brought them to Aaron .

verses.z: 到了第二天，摩西對百姓說：「你們犯了大罪。我如今要上耶和華那裏去，或者可以為你們贖罪。」
verses.e: On the next day , Moses said to the people , " You have sinned a great sin . Now I will go up to the LORD . Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin . "

verses.z: 摩西回到耶和華那裏，說：「唉！這百姓犯了大罪，為自己做了金像。
verses.e: Moses returned to the LORD , and said , " Oh , this people have sinned a great sin , and have made themselves gods of gold .

verses.z: 倘或你肯赦免他們的罪......不然，求你從你所寫的冊上塗抹我的名。」
verses.e: Yet now , if you will , forgive their sin — and if not , please blot me out of your book which you have written . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「誰得罪我，我就從我的冊上塗抹誰的名。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Whoever has sinned against me , I will blot him out of my book .

verses.z: 現在你去領這百姓，往我所告訴你的[地方]去，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是到我追討的日子，我必追討他們的罪。」
verses.e: Now go , lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you . Behold , my angel shall go before you . Nevertheless , in the day when I punish , I will punish them for their sin . "

verses.z: 耶和華殺百姓的緣故是因他們同亞倫做了牛犢。
verses.e: The LORD struck the people , because of what they did with the calf , which Aaron made .

verses.z: 亞倫從他們手裏接過來，鑄了一隻牛犢，用雕刻的器具做成。他們就說：「以色列啊，這是領你出埃及地的神。」
verses.e: He received what they handed him , fashioned it with an engraving tool , and made it a molded calf . Then they said , " These are your gods , Israel , which brought you up out of the land of Egypt . "

verses.z: 亞倫看見，就在牛犢面前築壇，且宣告說：「明日要向耶和華守節。」
verses.e: When Aaron saw this , he built an altar before it ; and Aaron made a proclamation , and said , " Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD . "

verses.z: 次日清早，百姓起來獻燔祭和平安祭，就坐下吃喝，起來玩耍。
verses.e: They rose up early on the next day , and offered burnt offerings , and brought peace offerings ; and the people sat down to eat and to drink , and rose up to play .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「下去吧，因為你的百姓，就是你從埃及地領出來的，已經敗壞了。
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , " Go , get down ; for your people , whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt , have corrupted themselves !

verses.z: 他們快快偏離了我所吩咐的道，為自己鑄了一隻牛犢，向它下拜獻祭，說：『以色列啊，這就是領你出埃及地的神。』」
verses.e: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them . They have made themselves a molded calf , and have worshiped it , and have sacrificed to it , and said , ' These are your gods , Israel , which brought you up out of the land of Egypt . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「我看這百姓真是硬着頸項的百姓。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " I have seen these people , and behold , they are a stiff-necked people .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「我曾起誓應許亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各說：『要將迦南地賜給你的後裔。』現在你和你從埃及地所領出來的百姓，要從這裏往那地去。
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , " Depart , go up from here , you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt , to the land of which I swore to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , saying , ' I will give it to your offspring . '

verses.z: 眾百姓看見雲柱立在[會]幕門前，就都起來，各人在自己帳棚的門口下拜。
verses.e: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent , and all the people rose up and worshiped , everyone at their tent door .

verses.z: 耶和華與摩西面對面說話，好像人與朋友說話一般。摩西轉到營裏去，惟有他的幫手－一個少年人嫩的兒子約書亞不離開[會]幕。
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face , as a man speaks to his friend . He turned again into the camp , but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , didn't depart from the Tent .

verses.z: 摩西對耶和華說：「你吩咐我說：『將這百姓領上去』，卻沒有叫我知道你要打發誰與我同去，只說：『我按你的名認識你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。』
verses.e: Moses said to the LORD , " Behold , you tell me , ' Bring up this people ; ' and you haven't let me know whom you will send with me . Yet you have said , ' I know you by name , and you have also found favor in my sight . '

verses.z: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你將你的道指示我，使我可以認識你，好在你眼前蒙恩。求你想到這民是你的民。」
verses.e: Now therefore , if I have found favor in your sight , please show me your way , now , that I may know you , so that I may find favor in your sight ; and consider that this nation is your people . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我必親自[和你同]去，使你得安息。」
verses.e: He said , " My presence will go with you , and I will give you rest . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「你若不親自[和我同]去，就不要把我們從這裏領上去。
verses.e: Moses said to him , " If your presence doesn't go with me , don't carry us up from here .

verses.z: 人在何事上得以知道我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩呢？豈不是因你與我們同去、使我和你的百姓與地上的萬民有分別嗎？」
verses.e: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight , I and your people ? Isn't it that you go with us , so that we are separated , I and your people , from all the people who are on the surface of the earth ? "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你這所求的我也要行；因為你在我眼前蒙了恩，並且我按你的名認識你。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " I will do this thing also that you have spoken ; for you have found favor in my sight , and I know you by name . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「求你顯出你的榮耀給我看。」
verses.e: Moses said , " Please show me your glory . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我要顯我一切的恩慈，在你面前經過，宣告我的名。我要恩待誰就恩待誰；要憐憫誰就憐憫誰」；
verses.e: He said , " I will make all my goodness pass before you , and will proclaim the LORD's name before you . I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious , and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy . "

verses.z: 我要差遣使者在你前面，攆出迦南人、亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
verses.e: I will send an angel before you ; and I will drive out the Canaanite , the Amorite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite .

verses.z: 又說：「你不能看見我的面，因為人見我的面不能存活。」
verses.e: He said , " You cannot see my face , for man may not see me and live . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「看哪，在我這裏有地方，你要站在磐石上。
verses.e: The LORD also said , " Behold , there is a place by me , and you shall stand on the rock .

verses.z: 我的榮耀經過的時候，我必將你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，等我過去，
verses.e: It will happen , while my glory passes by , that I will put you in a cleft of the rock , and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by ;

verses.z: 然後我要將我的手收回，你就得見我的背，卻不得見我的面。」
verses.e: then I will take away my hand , and you will see my back ; but my face shall not be seen . "

verses.z: 領你到那流奶與蜜之地。我自己不同你們上去；因為你們是硬着頸項的百姓，恐怕我在路上把你們滅絕。」
verses.e: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey ; but I will not go up among you , for you are a stiff-necked people , lest I consume you on the way . "

verses.z: 百姓聽見這凶信就悲哀，也沒有人佩戴妝飾。
verses.e: When the people heard this evil news , they mourned ; and no one put on his jewelry .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你告訴以色列人說：『[耶和華說]：你們是硬着頸項的百姓，我若一霎時臨到你們中間，必滅絕你們。現在你們要把身上的妝飾摘下來，使我可以知道怎樣待你們。』」
verses.e: The LORD had said to Moses , " Tell the children of Israel , ' You are a stiff-necked people . If I were to go up among you for one moment , I would consume you . Therefore now take off your jewelry from you , that I may know what to do to you . ' "

verses.z: 以色列人從住何烈山以後，就把身上的妝飾摘得乾淨。
verses.e: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward .

verses.z: 摩西素常將帳棚支搭在營外，離營卻遠，他稱這帳棚為會幕。凡求問耶和華的，就到營外的會幕那裏去。
verses.e: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp , far away from the camp , and he called it " The Tent of Meeting . " Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting , which was outside the camp .

verses.z: 當摩西出營到[會]幕去的時候，百姓就都起來，各人站在自己帳棚的門口，望着摩西，直等到他進了[會]幕。
verses.e: When Moses went out to the Tent , all the people rose up , and stood , everyone at their tent door , and watched Moses , until he had gone into the Tent .

verses.z: 摩西進[會]幕的時候，雲柱降下來，立在[會]幕的門前，[耶和華]便與摩西說話。
verses.e: When Moses entered into the Tent , the pillar of cloud descended , stood at the door of the Tent , and the LORD spoke with Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前你摔碎的那版一樣；其上的字我要寫在這版上。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Chisel two stone tablets like the first . I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets , which you broke .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我要立約，要在百姓面前行奇妙的事，是在遍地萬國中所未曾行的。在你四圍的外邦人就要看見耶和華的作為，因我向你所行的是可畏懼的事。
verses.e: He said , " Behold , I make a covenant : before all your people I will do marvels , such as have not been worked in all the earth , nor in any nation ; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD ; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you .

verses.z: 「我今天所吩咐你的，你要謹守。我要從你面前攆出亞摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
verses.e: Observe that which I command you today . Behold , I will drive out before you the Amorite , the Canaanite , the Hittite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite .

verses.z: 你要謹慎，不可與你所去那地的居民立約，恐怕成為你們中間的網羅；
verses.e: Be careful , lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going , lest it be for a snare among you ;

verses.z: 卻要拆毀他們的祭壇，打碎他們的柱像，砍下他們的木偶。
verses.e: but you shall break down their altars , and dash in pieces their pillars , and you shall cut down their Asherah poles ;

verses.z: 不可敬拜別神；因為耶和華是忌邪的上帝，名為忌邪者。
verses.e: for you shall worship no other god ; for the LORD , whose name is Jealous , is a jealous God .

verses.z: 只怕你與那地的居民立約，百姓隨從他們的神，就行邪淫，祭祀他們的神，有人叫你，你便吃他的祭物，
verses.e: " Don't make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land , lest they play the prostitute after their gods , and sacrifice to their gods , and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice ;

verses.z: 又為你的兒子娶他們的女兒為妻，他們的女兒隨從她們的神，就行邪淫，使你的兒子也隨從她們的神行邪淫。
verses.e: and you take of their daughters to your sons , and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods , and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods .

verses.z: 「不可為自己鑄造神[像]。
verses.e: " You shall make no cast idols for yourselves .

verses.z: 「你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期吃無酵餅七天，因為你是這亞筆月內出了埃及。
verses.e: " You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread . Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread , as I commanded you , at the time appointed in the month Abib ; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt .

verses.z: 凡頭生的都是我的；一切牲畜頭生的，無論是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
verses.e: " All that opens the womb is mine ; and all your livestock that is male , the firstborn of cow and sheep .

verses.z: 明日早晨，你要預備好了，上西奈山，在山頂上站在我面前。
verses.e: Be ready by the morning , and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai , and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain .

verses.z: 頭生的驢要用羊羔代贖，若不代贖就要打折牠的頸項。凡頭生的兒子都要贖出來。誰也不可空手朝見我。
verses.e: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb . If you will not redeem it , then you shall break its neck . You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons . No one shall appear before me empty .

verses.z: 「你六日要做工，第七日要安息，雖在耕種收割的時候也要安息。
verses.e: " Six days you shall work , but on the seventh day you shall rest : in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest .

verses.z: 在收割初熟麥子的時候要守七七節；又在年底要守收藏節。
verses.e: " You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest , and the feast of harvest at the year's end .

verses.z: 你們一切男丁要一年三次朝見主耶和華－以色列的上帝。
verses.e: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 我要從你面前趕出外邦人，擴張你的境界。你一年三次上去朝見耶和華－你上帝的時候，必沒有人貪慕你的地土。
verses.e: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders ; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD , your God , three times in the year .

verses.z: 「你不可將我祭物的血和有酵的餅一同獻上。逾越節的祭物也不可留到早晨。
verses.e: " You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread . The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning .

verses.z: 地裏首先初熟之物要送到耶和華－你上帝的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
verses.e: " You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God . " You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk . "

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你要將這些話寫上，因為我是按這話與你和以色列人立約。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Write these words ; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel . "

verses.z: 摩西在耶和華那裏四十晝夜，也不吃飯也不喝水。耶和華將這約的話，就是十條誡，寫在兩塊版上。
verses.e: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights ; he neither ate bread , nor drank water . He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant , the ten commandments .

verses.z: 摩西手裏拿着兩塊法版下西奈山的時候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和華和他說話就發了光。
verses.e: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses ' hand , when he came down from the mountain , Moses didn't know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him .

verses.z: 誰也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山根也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。」
verses.e: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain . Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain . "

verses.z: 亞倫和以色列眾人看見摩西的面皮發光就怕挨近他。
verses.e: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses , behold , the skin of his face shone ; and they were afraid to come near him .

verses.z: 摩西叫他們來；於是亞倫和會眾的官長都到他那裏去，摩西就與他們說話。
verses.e: Moses called to them , and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him ; and Moses spoke to them .

verses.z: 隨後以色列眾人都近前來，他就把耶和華在西奈山與他所說的一切話都吩咐他們。
verses.e: Afterward all the children of Israel came near , and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai .

verses.z: 摩西與他們說完了話就用帕子蒙上臉。
verses.e: When Moses was done speaking with them , he put a veil on his face .

verses.z: 但摩西進到耶和華面前與他說話就揭去帕子，及至出來的時候便將耶和華所吩咐的告訴以色列人。
verses.e: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him , he took the veil off , until he came out ; and he came out , and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded .

verses.z: 以色列人看見摩西的面皮發光。摩西又用帕子蒙上臉，等到他進去與耶和華說話[就揭去帕子]。
verses.e: The children of Israel saw Moses ' face , that the skin of Moses ' face shone ; so Moses put the veil on his face again , until he went in to speak with him .

verses.z: 摩西就鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣。清晨起來，照耶和華所吩咐的上西奈山去，手裏拿着兩塊石版。
verses.e: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first ; then Moses rose up early in the morning , and went up to Mount Sinai , as the LORD had commanded him , and took in his hand two stone tablets .

verses.z: 耶和華在雲中降臨，和摩西一同站在那裏，宣告耶和華的名。
verses.e: The LORD descended in the cloud , and stood with him there , and proclaimed the LORD's name .

verses.z: 耶和華在他面前宣告[說]：「耶和華，耶和華，是有憐憫有恩典的上帝，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和誠實，
verses.e: The LORD passed by before him , and proclaimed , " The LORD ! The LORD , a merciful and gracious God , slow to anger , and abundant in loving kindness and truth ,

verses.z: 為千萬人存留慈愛，赦免罪孽、過犯，和罪惡，萬不以[有罪的]為無罪，必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。」
verses.e: keeping loving kindness for thousands , forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin ; and who will by no means clear the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children , and on the children's children , on the third and on the fourth generation . "

verses.z: 摩西急忙伏地下拜，
verses.e: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshiped .

verses.z: 說：「主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在我們中間同行，因為這是硬着頸項的百姓。又求你赦免我們的罪孽和罪惡，以我們為你的產業。」
verses.e: He said , " If now I have found favor in your sight , Lord , please let the Lord go among us , even though this is a stiff-necked people ; pardon our iniquity and our sin , and take us for your inheritance . "

verses.z: 摩西招聚以色列全會眾，對他們說：「這是耶和華所吩咐的話，叫你們照着行：
verses.e: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel , and said to them , " These are the words which the LORD has commanded , that you should do them .

verses.z: 「你們中間凡心裏有智慧的都要來做耶和華一切所吩咐的：
verses.e: " ' Let every wise-hearted man among you come , and make all that the LORD has commanded :

verses.z: 就是帳幕和帳幕的罩棚，並帳幕的蓋、鉤子、板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，
verses.e: the tabernacle , its outer covering , its roof , its clasps , its boards , its bars , its pillars , and its sockets ;

verses.z: 櫃和櫃的槓，施恩座和遮掩[櫃]的幔子，
verses.e: the ark , and its poles , the mercy seat , the veil of the screen ;

verses.z: 桌子和桌子的槓與桌子的一切器具，並陳設餅，
verses.e: the table with its poles and all its vessels , and the show bread ;

verses.z: 燈臺和燈臺的器具，燈盞並點燈的油，
verses.e: the lamp stand also for the light , with its vessels , its lamps , and the oil for the light ;

verses.z: 香壇和壇的槓，膏油和馨香的香料，並帳幕門口的簾子，
verses.e: and the altar of incense with its poles , the anointing oil , the sweet incense , the screen for the door , at the door of the tabernacle ;

verses.z: 燔祭壇和壇的銅網，壇的槓並壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
verses.e: the altar of burnt offering , with its grating of bronze , its poles , and all its vessels , the basin and its base ;

verses.z: 院子的帷子和帷子的柱子，帶卯的座和院子的門簾，
verses.e: the hangings of the court , its pillars , their sockets , and the screen for the gate of the court ;

verses.z: 帳幕的橛子並院子的橛子，和這兩處的繩子，
verses.e: the pins of the tabernacle , the pins of the court , and their cords ;

verses.z: 精工做的禮服和祭司亞倫並他兒子在聖所用以供祭司職分的聖衣。」
verses.e: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place — the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons — to minister in the priest's office . ' "

verses.z: 六日要做工，第七日乃為聖日，當向耶和華守為安息聖日。凡這日之內做工的，必把他治死。
verses.e: ' Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you , a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD : whoever does any work in it shall be put to death .

verses.z: 以色列全會眾從摩西面前退去。
verses.e: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses .

verses.z: 凡心裏受感和甘心樂意的都拿耶和華的禮物來，用以做會幕和其中一切的使用，又用以做聖衣。
verses.e: They came , everyone whose heart stirred him up , and everyone whom his spirit made willing , and brought the LORD's offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting , and for all of its service , and for the holy garments .

verses.z: 凡心裏樂意獻禮物的，連男帶女，各將金器，就是胸前鍼、耳環、打印的戒指，和手釧帶來獻給耶和華。
verses.e: They came , both men and women , as many as were willing-hearted , and brought brooches , earrings , signet rings , and armlets , all jewels of gold ; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD .

verses.z: 凡有藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，細麻，山羊[毛]，染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都拿了來；
verses.e: Everyone with whom was found blue , purple , scarlet , fine linen , goats ' hair , rams ' skins dyed red , and sea cow hides , brought them .

verses.z: 凡獻銀子和銅給耶和華為禮物的都拿了來；凡有皂莢木可做甚麼使用的也拿了來。
verses.e: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD's offering ; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service , brought it .

verses.z: 凡心中有智慧的婦女親手紡線，把所紡的藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和細麻都拿了來。
verses.e: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands , and brought that which they had spun : the blue , the purple , the scarlet , and the fine linen .

verses.z: 凡有智慧、心裏受感的婦女就紡山羊[毛]。
verses.e: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats ' hair .

verses.z: 眾官長把紅瑪瑙和別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得與胸牌上的，都拿了來；
verses.e: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate ;

verses.z: 又拿香料做香，拿油點燈，做膏油。
verses.e: with the spice and the oil for the light , for the anointing oil , and for the sweet incense .

verses.z: 以色列人，無論男女，凡甘心樂意獻禮物給耶和華的，都將禮物拿來，做耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的一切工。
verses.e: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD ; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work , which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses .

verses.z: 當安息日，不可在你們一切的住處生火。」
verses.e: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day . ' "

verses.z: 摩西對以色列人說：「猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，耶和華已經提他的名召他，
verses.e: Moses said to the children of Israel , " Behold , the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah .

verses.z: 又以上帝的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧、聰明、知識，能做各樣的工，
verses.e: He has filled him with the Spirit of God , in wisdom , in understanding , in knowledge , and in all kinds of workmanship ;

verses.z: 能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，
verses.e: and to make skillful works , to work in gold , in silver , in bronze ,

verses.z: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的巧工。
verses.e: in cutting of stones for setting , and in carving of wood , to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship .

verses.z: 耶和華又使他，和但支派中亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯，心裏靈明，能教導人。
verses.e: He has put in his heart that he may teach , both he and Oholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan .

verses.z: 耶和華使他們的心滿有智慧，能做各樣的工，無論是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和細麻、繡花的工，並機匠的工，他們都能做，也能想出奇巧的工。
verses.e: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship , of the engraver , of the skillful workman , and of the embroiderer , in blue , in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen , and of the weaver , even of those who do any workmanship , and of those who make skillful works .

verses.z: 摩西對以色列全會眾說：「耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：
verses.e: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel , saying , " This is the thing which the LORD commanded , saying ,

verses.z: 你們中間要拿禮物獻給耶和華，凡樂意獻的可以拿耶和華的禮物來，就是金、銀、銅，
verses.e: ' Take from among you an offering to the LORD . Whoever is of a willing heart , let him bring it as the LORD's offering : gold , silver , bronze ,

verses.z: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，細麻，山羊[毛]，
verses.e: blue , purple , scarlet , fine linen , goats ' hair ,

verses.z: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
verses.e: rams ' skins dyed red , sea cow hides , acacia wood ,

verses.z: 點燈的油，並做膏油和香的香料，
verses.e: oil for the light , spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense ,

verses.z: 紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。」
verses.e: onyx stones , and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate .

verses.z: 「比撒列和亞何利亞伯，並一切心裏有智慧的，就是蒙耶和華賜智慧聰明、叫他知道做聖所各樣使用之工的，都要照耶和華所吩咐的做工。」
verses.e: " Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man , in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary , according to all that the LORD has commanded . "

verses.z: 他使這五幅幔子幅幅相連，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相連；
verses.e: He coupled five curtains to one another , and the other five curtains he coupled to one another .

verses.z: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上做藍色的鈕扣，在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也照樣做；
verses.e: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling . Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling .

verses.z: 在這相連的幔子上做五十個鈕扣，在那相連的幔子上也做五十個鈕扣，都是兩兩相對；
verses.e: He made fifty loops in the one curtain , and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling . The loops were opposite to one another .

verses.z: 又做五十個金鉤，使幔子相連。這才成了一個帳幕。
verses.e: He made fifty clasps of gold , and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps : so the tabernacle was a unit .

verses.z: 他用山羊[毛]織十一幅幔子，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
verses.e: He made curtains of goats ' hair for a covering over the tabernacle . He made them eleven curtains .

verses.z: 每幅幔子長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幔子都是一樣的尺寸。
verses.e: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits the width of each curtain . The eleven curtains had one measure .

verses.z: 他把五幅幔子連成一幅，又把六幅幔子連成一幅；
verses.e: He coupled five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves .

verses.z: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上做五十個鈕扣，在那相連的幔子[末幅]邊上也做五十個鈕扣；
verses.e: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling , and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling .

verses.z: 又做五十個銅鉤，使罩棚連成一個；
verses.e: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together , that it might be a unit .

verses.z: 並用染紅的公羊皮做罩棚的蓋，再用海狗皮做一層罩棚上的頂蓋。
verses.e: He made a covering for the tent of rams ' skins dyed red , and a covering of sea cow hides above .

verses.z: 凡耶和華賜他心裏有智慧、而且受感前來做這工的，摩西把他們和比撒列並亞何利亞伯一同召來。
verses.e: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab , and every wise-hearted man , in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom , even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it .

verses.z: 他用皂莢木做帳幕的豎板。
verses.e: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood , standing up .

verses.z: 每塊長十肘，寬一肘半；
verses.e: Ten cubits was the length of a board , and a cubit and a half the width of each board .

verses.z: 每塊有兩榫相對。帳幕一切的板都是這樣做。
verses.e: Each board had two tenons , joined to one another . He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way .

verses.z: 帳幕的南面做板二十塊。
verses.e: He made the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards for the south side southward .

verses.z: 在這二十塊板底下又做四十個帶卯的銀座：兩卯接這塊板上的兩榫，兩卯接那塊板上的兩榫。
verses.e: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards : two sockets under one board for its two tenons , and two sockets under another board for its two tenons .

verses.z: 帳幕的第二面，就是北面，也做板二十塊
verses.e: For the second side of the tabernacle , on the north side , he made twenty boards

verses.z: 和帶卯的銀座四十個：這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
verses.e: and their forty sockets of silver : two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .

verses.z: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，做板六塊。
verses.e: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards .

verses.z: 帳幕後面的拐角做板兩塊。
verses.e: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part .

verses.z: 板的下半截是雙的，上半截是整的，直到第一個環子；在帳幕的兩個拐角上都是這樣做。
verses.e: They were double beneath , and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring . He did this to both of them in the two corners .

verses.z: 這些人就從摩西收了以色列人為做聖所並聖所使用之工所拿來的禮物。百姓每早晨還把甘心獻的禮物拿來。
verses.e: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary , with which to make it . They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning .

verses.z: 有八塊板和十六個帶卯的銀座，每塊板底下有兩卯。
verses.e: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets — under every board two sockets .

verses.z: 他用皂莢木做閂：為帳幕這面的板做五閂，
verses.e: He made bars of acacia wood : five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,

verses.z: 為帳幕那面的板做五閂，又為帳幕後面的板做五閂，
verses.e: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward .

verses.z: 使板腰間的中閂從這一頭通到那一頭。
verses.e: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other .

verses.z: 用金子將板包裹，又做板上的金環套閂；閂也用金子包裹。
verses.e: He overlaid the boards with gold , and made their rings of gold as places for the bars , and overlaid the bars with gold .

verses.z: 他用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
verses.e: He made the veil of blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen , with cherubim . He made it the work of a skillful workman .

verses.z: 為幔子做四根皂莢木柱子，用金包裹，柱子上有金鉤，又為柱子鑄了四個帶卯的銀座。
verses.e: He made four pillars of acacia for it , and overlaid them with gold . Their hooks were of gold . He cast four sockets of silver for them .

verses.z: 拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾；
verses.e: He made a screen for the door of the tent , of blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen , the work of an embroiderer ;

verses.z: 又為簾子做五根柱子和柱子上的鉤子，用金子把柱頂和柱子上的杆子包裹。柱子有五個帶卯的座，是銅的。
verses.e: and the five pillars of it with their hooks . He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold , and their five sockets were of bronze .

verses.z: 凡做聖所一切工的智慧人各都離開他所做的工，
verses.e: All the wise men , who performed all the work of the sanctuary , each came from his work which he did .

verses.z: 來對摩西說：「百姓為耶和華吩咐使用之工所拿來的，富富有餘。」
verses.e: They spoke to Moses , saying , " The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make . "

verses.z: 摩西傳命，他們就在全營中宣告說：「無論男女，不必再為聖所拿甚麼禮物來。」這樣才攔住百姓不再拿禮物來。
verses.e: Moses gave a commandment , and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp , saying , " Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary . " So the people were restrained from bringing .

verses.z: 因為他們所有的材料夠做一切當做的物，而且有餘。
verses.e: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work , and too much .

verses.z: 他們中間，凡心裏有智慧做工的，用十幅幔子做帳幕。這幔子是比撒列用撚的細麻和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]製造的，並用巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
verses.e: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , blue , purple , and scarlet . They made them with cherubim , the work of a skillful workman .

verses.z: 每幅幔子長二十八肘，寬四肘，都是一樣的尺寸。
verses.e: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits , and the width of each curtain four cubits . All the curtains had one measure .

verses.z: 比撒列用皂莢木做櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
verses.e: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood . Its length was two and a half cubits , and its width a cubit and a half , and a cubit and a half its height .

verses.z: 他用皂莢木做一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半，
verses.e: He made the table of acacia wood . Its length was two cubits , and its width was a cubit , and its height was a cubit and a half .

verses.z: 又包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
verses.e: He overlaid it with pure gold , and made a gold molding around it .

verses.z: 桌子的四圍各做一掌寬的橫樑，橫樑上鑲着金牙邊，
verses.e: He made a border of a hand's width around it , and made a golden molding on its border around it .

verses.z: 又鑄了四個金環，安在桌子四腳的四角上。
verses.e: He cast four rings of gold for it , and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet .

verses.z: 安環子的地方是挨近橫梁，可以穿槓抬桌子。
verses.e: The rings were close by the border , the places for the poles to carry the table .

verses.z: 他用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹，以便抬桌子；
verses.e: He made the poles of acacia wood , and overlaid them with gold , to carry the table .

verses.z: 又用精金做桌子上的器皿，就是盤子、調羹，並奠[酒]的瓶和爵。
verses.e: He made the vessels which were on the table , its dishes , its spoons , its bowls , and its pitchers with which to pour out , of pure gold .

verses.z: 他用精金做一個燈臺；這燈臺的座和幹，與杯、球、花，都是接連一塊錘出來的。
verses.e: He made the lamp stand of pure gold . He made the lamp stand of beaten work . Its base , its shaft , its cups , its buds , and its flowers were of one piece with it .

verses.z: 燈臺兩旁杈出六個枝子：這旁三個，那旁三個。
verses.e: There were six branches going out of its sides : three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side , and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side :

verses.z: 這旁每枝上有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花；那旁每枝上也有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花。從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子都是如此。
verses.e: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch , a bud and a flower , and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch , a bud and a flower ; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand .

verses.z: 裏外包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊，
verses.e: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside , and made a molding of gold for it around it .

verses.z: 燈臺上有四個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花。
verses.e: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms , its buds and its flowers ;

verses.z: 燈臺每兩個枝子以下有球，與枝子接連一塊；燈臺杈出的六個枝子都是如此。
verses.e: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it , and a bud under two branches of one piece with it , and a bud under two branches of one piece with it , for the six branches going out of it .

verses.z: 球和枝子是接連一塊，都是一塊精金錘出來的。
verses.e: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it . The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold .

verses.z: 用精金做燈臺的七個燈盞，並燈臺的蠟剪和蠟花盤。
verses.e: He made its seven lamps , and its snuffers , and its snuff dishes , of pure gold .

verses.z: 他用精金一他連得做燈臺和燈臺的一切器具。
verses.e: He made it of a talent of pure gold , with all its vessels .

verses.z: 他用皂莢木做香壇，是四方的，長一肘，寬一肘，高二肘，壇的四角與壇接連一塊；
verses.e: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood . It was square : its length was a cubit , and its width a cubit . Its height was two cubits . Its horns were of one piece with it .

verses.z: 又用精金把壇的上面與壇的四面並壇的四角包裹，又在壇的四圍鑲上金牙邊。
verses.e: He overlaid it with pure gold : its top , its sides around it , and its horns . He made a gold molding around it .

verses.z: 做兩個金環，安在牙子邊以下，在壇的兩旁、兩根橫撐上，作為穿槓的用處，以便抬壇。
verses.e: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown , on its two ribs , on its two sides , for places for poles with which to carry it .

verses.z: 用皂莢木做槓，用金包裹。
verses.e: He made the poles of acacia wood , and overlaid them with gold .

verses.z: 又按做香之法做聖膏油和馨香料的淨香。
verses.e: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices , after the art of the perfumer .

verses.z: 又鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上：這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
verses.e: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet — two rings on its one side , and two rings on its other side .

verses.z: 用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹。
verses.e: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold .

verses.z: 把槓穿在櫃旁的環內，以便抬櫃。
verses.e: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .

verses.z: 用精金做施恩座，長二肘半，寬一肘半。
verses.e: He made a mercy seat of pure gold . Its length was two and a half cubits , and a cubit and a half its width .

verses.z: 用金子錘出兩個基路伯來，安在施恩座的兩頭，
verses.e: He made two cherubim of gold . He made them of beaten work , at the two ends of the mercy seat :

verses.z: 這頭做一個基路伯，那頭做一個基路伯，二基路伯接連一塊，在施恩座的兩頭。
verses.e: one cherub at the one end , and one cherub at the other end . He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends .

verses.z: 二基路伯高張翅膀，遮掩施恩座；基路伯是臉對臉，朝着施恩座。
verses.e: The cherubim spread out their wings above , covering the mercy seat with their wings , with their faces toward one another . The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat .

verses.z: 他用皂莢木做燔祭壇，是四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘，
verses.e: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood . It was square . Its length was five cubits , its width was five cubits , and its height was three cubits .

verses.z: 帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
verses.e: their pillars were twenty , and their sockets twenty , of bronze ; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver .

verses.z: 北面也[有帷子]，[寬]一百肘。帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
verses.e: For the north side one hundred cubits , their pillars twenty , and their sockets twenty , of bronze ; the hooks of the pillars , and their fillets , of silver .

verses.z: [院子的]西面有帷子，[寬]五十肘。帷子的柱子十根，帶卯的座十個；柱子的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
verses.e: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits , their pillars ten , and their sockets ten ; the hooks of the pillars , and their fillets , of silver .

verses.z: [院子的]東面，[寬]五十肘。
verses.e: For the east side eastward fifty cubits ,

verses.z: 門這邊的帷子十五肘，那邊也是一樣。帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。在門的左右各有帷子十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
verses.e: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits ; their pillars three , and their sockets three ;
and so for the other side : on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits ; their pillars three , and their sockets three .

verses.z: 院子四面的帷子都是用撚的細麻做的。
verses.e: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen .

verses.z: 柱子帶卯的座是銅的，柱子上的鉤子和杆子是銀的，柱頂是用銀子包的。院子一切的柱子都是用銀杆連絡的。
verses.e: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze . The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver . Their capitals were overlaid with silver . All the pillars of the court had silver bands .

verses.z: 院子的門簾是以繡花的手工，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻織的，寬二十肘，高五肘，與院子的帷子相配。
verses.e: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer , of blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen . Twenty cubits was the length , and the height along the width was five cubits , like the hangings of the court .

verses.z: 帷子的柱子四根，帶卯的銅座四個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子是銀的；柱頂是用銀子包的。
verses.e: Their pillars were four , and their sockets four , of bronze ; their hooks of silver , and the overlaying of their capitals , and their fillets , of silver .

verses.z: 在壇的四拐角上做四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。
verses.e: He made its horns on its four corners . Its horns were of one piece with it , and he overlaid it with bronze .

verses.z: 帳幕一切的橛子和院子四圍的橛子都是銅的。
verses.e: All the pins of the tabernacle , and around the court , were of bronze .

verses.z: 這是法[櫃]的帳幕中利未人所用[物件]的總數，是照摩西的吩咐，經祭司亞倫的兒子以他瑪的手數點的。
verses.e: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle , even the Tabernacle of the Testimony , as they were counted , according to the commandment of Moses , for the service of the Levites , by the hand of Ithamar , the son of Aaron the priest .

verses.z: 凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的都是猶大支派戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列做的。
verses.e: Bezalel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah , made all that the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 與他同工的有但支派中亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯；他是雕刻匠，又是巧匠，又能用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和細麻繡花。
verses.e: With him was Oholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan , an engraver , and a skillful workman , and an embroiderer in blue , in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen .

verses.z: 為聖所一切工作使用所獻的金子，按聖所的平，有二十九他連得並七百三十舍客勒。
verses.e: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary , even the gold of the offering , was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary .

verses.z: 會中被數的人所出的銀子，按聖所的平，有一百他連得並一千七百七十五舍客勒。
verses.e: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary :

verses.z: 凡過去歸那些被數之人的，從二十歲以外，有六十萬零三千五百五十人。按聖所的平，每人出銀半舍客勒，就是一比加。
verses.e: a beka a head , that is , half a shekel , according to the shekel of the sanctuary , for everyone who passed over to those who were counted , from twenty years old and upward , for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men .

verses.z: 用那一百他連得銀子鑄造聖所帶卯的座和幔子[柱子]帶卯的座；一百他連得共一百帶卯的座，每帶卯的座用一他連得。
verses.e: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil : one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents , one talent per socket .

verses.z: 用那一千七百七十五[舍客勒銀子]做柱子上的鉤子，包裹柱頂並柱子上的杆子。
verses.e: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars , overlaid their capitals , and made fillets for them .

verses.z: 所獻的銅有七十他連得並二千四百舍客勒。
verses.e: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels .

verses.z: 他做壇上的盆、鏟子、盤子、肉鍤子、火鼎；這一切器具都是用銅做的。
verses.e: He made all the vessels of the altar : the pots , the shovels , the basins , the forks , and the fire pans . He made all its vessels of bronze .

verses.z: 用這銅做會幕門帶卯的座和銅壇，並壇上的銅網和壇的一切器具，
verses.e: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting , the bronze altar , the bronze grating for it , all the vessels of the altar ,

verses.z: 並院子四圍帶卯的座和院門帶卯的座，與帳幕一切的橛子和院子四圍所有的橛子。
verses.e: the sockets around the court , the sockets of the gate of the court , all the pins of the tabernacle , and all the pins around the court .

verses.z: 又為壇做一個銅網，安在壇四面的圍腰板以下，從下達到壇的半腰。
verses.e: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze , under the ledge around it beneath , reaching halfway up .

verses.z: 為銅網的四角鑄四個環子，作為穿槓的用處。
verses.e: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating , to be places for the poles .

verses.z: 用皂莢木做槓，用銅包裹，
verses.e: He made the poles of acacia wood , and overlaid them with bronze .

verses.z: 把槓穿在壇兩旁的環子內，用以抬壇，並用板做壇；壇是空的。
verses.e: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar , with which to carry it . He made it hollow with planks .

verses.z: 他用銅做洗濯盆和盆座，是用會幕門前伺候的婦人之鏡子做的。
verses.e: He made the basin of bronze , and its base of bronze , out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 他做[帳幕]的院子。院子的南面用撚的細麻做帷子，[寬]一百肘。
verses.e: He made the court : for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen , one hundred cubits ;

verses.z: 比撒列用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]做精緻的衣服，在聖所用以供職，又為亞倫做聖衣，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: Of the blue , purple , and scarlet , they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 上面鑲着寶石四行：第一行是紅寶石、紅璧璽、紅玉；
verses.e: They set in it four rows of stones . A row of ruby , topaz , and beryl was the first row ;

verses.z: 第二行是綠寶石、藍寶石、金鋼石；
verses.e: and the second row , a turquoise , a sapphire , and an emerald ;

verses.z: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶；
verses.e: and the third row , a jacinth , an agate , and an amethyst ;

verses.z: 第四行是水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉。這都鑲在金槽中。
verses.e: and the fourth row , a chrysolite , an onyx , and a jasper . They were enclosed in gold settings .

verses.z: 這些寶石都是按着以色列十二個兒子的名字，彷彿刻圖書，刻十二個支派的名字。
verses.e: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names ; like the engravings of a signet , everyone according to his name , for the twelve tribes .

verses.z: 在胸牌上，用精金擰成如繩子的鍊子。
verses.e: They made on the breastplate chains like cords , of braided work of pure gold .

verses.z: 又做兩個金槽和兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭。
verses.e: They made two settings of gold , and two gold rings , and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate .

verses.z: 把那兩條擰成的金鍊子穿過胸牌兩頭的環子，
verses.e: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate .

verses.z: 又把鍊子的那兩頭接在兩槽上，安在以弗得前面肩帶上。
verses.e: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings , and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod , in its front .

verses.z: 做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭，在以弗得裏面的邊上，
verses.e: They made two rings of gold , and put them on the two ends of the breastplate , on its edge , which was toward the side of the ephod inward .

verses.z: 他用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做以弗得；
verses.e: He made the ephod of gold , blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen .

verses.z: 又做兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，挨近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
verses.e: They made two more rings of gold , and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath , in its front , close by its coupling , above the skillfully woven band of the ephod .

verses.z: 用一條藍細帶子把胸牌的環子和以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不可與以弗得離縫，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 他用織工做以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
verses.e: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work , all of blue .

verses.z: 袍上留一領口，口的周圍織出領邊來，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
verses.e: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail , with a binding around its opening , that it should not be torn .

verses.z: 在袍子底邊上，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的[細麻]做石榴，
verses.e: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue , purple , scarlet , and twined linen .

verses.z: 又用精金做鈴鐺，把鈴鐺釘在袍子周圍底邊上的石榴中間：
verses.e: They made bells of pure gold , and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe , between the pomegranates ;

verses.z: 一個鈴鐺一個石榴，一個鈴鐺一個石榴，在袍子周圍底邊上用以供職，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: a bell and a pomegranate , a bell and a pomegranate , around the skirts of the robe , to minister in , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 他用織成的細麻布為亞倫和他的兒子做內袍，
verses.e: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons ,

verses.z: 並用細麻布做冠冕和華美的裹頭巾，用撚的細麻布做褲子，
verses.e: the turban of fine linen , the linen headbands of fine linen , the linen trousers of fine twined linen ,

verses.z: 又用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻，以繡花的手工做腰帶，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: the sash of fine twined linen , blue , purple , and scarlet , the work of the embroiderer , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 把金子錘成薄片，剪出線來，與藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，用巧匠的手工一同繡上。
verses.e: They beat the gold into thin plates , and cut it into wires , to work it in with the blue , the purple , the scarlet , and the fine linen , the work of the skillful workman .

verses.z: 他用精金做聖冠上的牌，在上面按刻圖書之法，刻着「歸耶和華為聖」。
verses.e: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote on it an inscription , like the engravings of a signet : " HOLY TO THE LORD " .

verses.z: 又用一條藍細帶子將牌繫在冠冕上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: They tied to it a lace of blue , to fasten it on the turban above , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 帳幕，就是會幕，一切的工就這樣做完了。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照樣做了。
verses.e: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished . The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses ; so they did .

verses.z: 他們送到摩西那裏。帳幕和帳幕的一切器具，就是鉤子、板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，
verses.e: They brought the tabernacle to Moses : the tent , with all its furniture , its clasps , its boards , its bars , its pillars , its sockets ,

verses.z: 染紅公羊皮的蓋、海狗皮的頂蓋，和遮掩[櫃]的幔子，
verses.e: the covering of rams ' skins dyed red , the covering of sea cow hides , the veil of the screen ,

verses.z: 法櫃和櫃的槓並施恩座，
verses.e: the ark of the covenant with its poles , the mercy seat ,

verses.z: 桌子和桌子的一切器具並陳設餅，
verses.e: the table , all its vessels , the show bread ,

verses.z: 精[金]的燈臺和擺列的燈盞，與燈臺的一切器具，並點燈的油，
verses.e: the pure lamp stand , its lamps , even the lamps to be set in order , all its vessels , the oil for the light ,

verses.z: 金壇、膏油、馨香的香料、會幕的門簾，
verses.e: the golden altar , the anointing oil , the sweet incense , the screen for the door of the Tent ,

verses.z: 銅壇和壇上的銅網，壇的槓並壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
verses.e: the bronze altar , its grating of bronze , its poles , all of its vessels , the basin and its base ,

verses.z: 又為以弗得做兩條相連的肩帶，接連在以弗得的兩頭。
verses.e: They made shoulder straps for it , joined together . It was joined together at the two ends .

verses.z: 院子的帷子和柱子，並帶卯的座，院子的門簾、繩子、橛子，並帳幕和會幕中一切使用的器具，
verses.e: the hangings of the court , its pillars , its sockets , the screen for the gate of the court , its cords , its pins , and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle , for the Tent of Meeting ,

verses.z: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子在聖所用以供祭司職分的聖衣。
verses.e: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest's office .

verses.z: 這一切工作都是以色列人照耶和華所吩咐摩西做的。
verses.e: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did all the work .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣吩咐的，他們就怎樣做了。摩西看見一切的工都做成了，就給他們祝福。
verses.e: Moses saw all the work , and behold , they had done it as the LORD had commanded . They had done so ; and Moses blessed them .

verses.z: 其上巧工織的帶子和以弗得一樣的做法，用以束上，與以弗得接連一塊，是用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做的，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: The skillfully woven band that was on it , with which to fasten it on , was of the same piece , like its work : of gold , of blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 又琢出兩塊紅瑪瑙，鑲在金槽上，彷彿刻圖書，按着以色列兒子的名字雕刻；
verses.e: They worked the onyx stones , enclosed in settings of gold , engraved with the engravings of a signet , according to the names of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人做紀念石，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod , to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一樣的做法，用金[線]與藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做的。
verses.e: He made the breastplate , the work of a skillful workman , like the work of the ephod : of gold , of blue , purple , scarlet , and fine twined linen .

verses.z: 胸牌是四方的，疊為兩層；這兩層長一虎口，寬一虎口，
verses.e: It was square . They made the breastplate double . Its length was a span , and its width a span , being double .

verses.z: 摩西回答說：「他們必不信我，也不聽我的話，必說：『耶和華並沒有向你顯現。』」
verses.e: Moses answered , " But , behold , they will not believe me , nor listen to my voice ; for they will say , ' The LORD has not appeared to you . ' "

verses.z: 摩西對耶和華說：「主啊，我素日不是能言的人，就是從你對僕人說話以後，也是這樣。我本是拙口笨舌的。」
verses.e: Moses said to the LORD , " O Lord , I am not eloquent , neither before now , nor since you have spoken to your servant ; for I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue . "

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「誰造人的口呢？誰使人口啞、耳聾、目明、眼瞎呢？豈不是我－耶和華嗎？
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Who made man's mouth ? Or who makes one mute , or deaf , or seeing , or blind ? Isn't it I , the LORD ?

verses.z: 現在去吧，我必賜你口才，指教你所當說的話。」
verses.e: Now therefore go , and I will be with your mouth , and teach you what you shall speak . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「主啊，你願意打發誰，就打發誰去吧！」
verses.e: Moses said , " Oh , Lord , please send someone else . "

verses.z: 耶和華向摩西發怒說：「不是有你的哥哥利未人亞倫嗎？我知道他是能言的；現在他出來迎接你，他一見你，心裏就歡喜。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Moses , and he said , " What about Aaron , your brother , the Levite ? I know that he can speak well . Also , behold , he is coming out to meet you . When he sees you , he will be glad in his heart .

verses.z: 你要將當說的話傳給他；我也要賜你和他口才，又要指教你們所當行的事。
verses.e: You shall speak to him , and put the words in his mouth . I will be with your mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what you shall do .

verses.z: 他要替你對百姓說話；你要以他當作口，他要以你當作上帝。
verses.e: He will be your spokesman to the people . It will happen that he will be to you a mouth , and you will be to him as God .

verses.z: 你手裏要拿這杖，好行神蹟。」
verses.e: You shall take this rod in your hand , with which you shall do the signs . "

verses.z: 於是，摩西回到他岳父葉忒羅那裏，對他說：「求你容我回去見我在埃及的弟兄，看他們還在不在。」葉忒羅對摩西說：「你可以平平安安地去吧！」
verses.e: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law , and said to him , " Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt , and see whether they are still alive . " Jethro said to Moses , " Go in peace . "

verses.z: 耶和華在米甸對摩西說：「你要回埃及去，因為尋索你命的人都死了。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses in Midian , " Go , return into Egypt ; for all the men who sought your life are dead . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你手裏是甚麼？」他說：「是杖。」
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " What is that in your hand ? " He said , " A rod . "

verses.z: 摩西就帶着妻子和兩個兒子，叫他們騎上驢，回埃及地去。摩西手裏拿着上帝的杖。
verses.e: Moses took his wife and his sons , and set them on a donkey , and he returned to the land of Egypt . Moses took God's rod in his hand .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你回到埃及的時候，要留意將我指示你的一切奇事行在法老面前。但我要使他的心剛硬，他必不容百姓去。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " When you go back into Egypt , see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand , but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go .

verses.z: 你要對法老說：『耶和華這樣說：以色列是我的兒子，我的長子。
verses.e: You shall tell Pharaoh , ' The LORD says , Israel is my son , my firstborn ,

verses.z: 我對你說過：容我的兒子去，好事奉我。你還是不肯容他去。看哪，我要殺你的長子。』」
verses.e: and I have said to you , " Let my son go , that he may serve me ; " and you have refused to let him go . Behold , I will kill your firstborn son . ' "

verses.z: 摩西在路上住宿的地方，耶和華遇見他，想要殺他。
verses.e: On the way at a lodging place , the LORD met Moses and wanted to kill him .

verses.z: 西坡拉就拿一塊火石，割下他兒子的陽皮，丟在摩西腳前，說：「你真是我的血郎了。」
verses.e: Then Zipporah took a flint , and cut off the foreskin of her son , and cast it at his feet ; and she said , " Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me . "

verses.z: 這樣，耶和華才放了他。西坡拉說：「你因割禮就是血郎了。」
verses.e: So he let him alone . Then she said , " You are a bridegroom of blood , " because of the circumcision .

verses.z: 耶和華對亞倫說：「你往曠野去迎接摩西。」他就去，在上帝的山遇見摩西，和他親嘴。
verses.e: The LORD said to Aaron , " Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . " He went , and met him on God's mountain , and kissed him .

verses.z: 摩西將耶和華打發他所說的言語和囑咐他所行的神蹟都告訴了亞倫。
verses.e: Moses told Aaron all the LORD's words with which he had sent him , and all the signs with which he had instructed him .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫就去招聚以色列的眾長老。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「丟在地上。」他一丟下去，就變作蛇；摩西便跑開。
verses.e: He said , " Throw it on the ground . " He threw it on the ground , and it became a snake ; and Moses ran away from it .

verses.z: 亞倫將耶和華對摩西所說的一切話述說了一遍，又在百姓眼前行了那些神蹟，
verses.e: Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .

verses.z: 百姓就信了。以色列人聽見耶和華眷顧他們，鑒察他們的困苦，就低頭下拜。
verses.e: The people believed , and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel , and that he had seen their affliction , then they bowed their heads and worshiped .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「伸出手來，拿住牠的尾巴，牠必在你手中仍變為杖；
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Stretch out your hand , and take it by the tail . " He stretched out his hand , and took hold of it , and it became a rod in his hand .

verses.z: 如此好叫他們信耶和華－他們祖宗的上帝，就是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，是向你顯現了。」
verses.e: " This is so that they may believe that the LORD , the God of their fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , has appeared to you . "

verses.z: 耶和華又對他說：「把手放在懷裏。」他就把手放在懷裏，及至抽出來，不料，手長了大痲瘋，有雪[那樣]白。
verses.e: The LORD said furthermore to him , " Now put your hand inside your cloak . " He put his hand inside his cloak , and when he took it out , behold , his hand was leprous , as white as snow .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「再把手放在懷裏。」他就再把手放在懷裏，及至從懷裏抽出來，不料，手已經復原，與周身的肉一樣；
verses.e: He said , " Put your hand inside your cloak again . " He put his hand inside his cloak again , and when he took it out of his cloak , behold , it had turned again as his other flesh .

verses.z: 又說：「倘或他們不聽你的話，也不信頭一個神蹟，他們必信第二個神蹟。
verses.e: " It will happen , if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .

verses.z: 這兩個神蹟若都不信，也不聽你的話，你就從河裏取些水，倒在旱地上，你從河裏取的水必在旱地上變作血。」
verses.e: It will happen , if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice , that you shall take of the water of the river , and pour it on the dry land . The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 又要抹燔祭壇和一切器具，使壇成聖，就都成為至聖。
verses.e: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering , with all its vessels , and sanctify the altar , and the altar will be most holy .

verses.z: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使盆成聖。
verses.e: You shall anoint the basin and its base , and sanctify it .

verses.z: 要使亞倫和他兒子到會幕門口來，用水洗身。
verses.e: " You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting , and shall wash them with water .

verses.z: 要給亞倫穿上聖衣，又膏他，使他成聖，可以給我供祭司的職分；
verses.e: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments ; and you shall anoint him , and sanctify him , that he may minister to me in the priest's office .

verses.z: 又要使他兒子來，給他們穿上內袍。
verses.e: You shall bring his sons , and put tunics on them .

verses.z: 怎樣膏他們的父親，也要照樣膏他們，使他們給我供祭司的職分。他們世世代代凡受膏的，就永遠當祭司的職任。」
verses.e: You shall anoint them , as you anointed their father , that they may minister to me in the priest's office . Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations . "

verses.z: 摩西這樣行，都是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: Moses did so . According to all that the LORD commanded him , so he did .

verses.z: 第二年正月初一日，帳幕就立起來。
verses.e: In the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , the tabernacle was raised up .

verses.z: 摩西立起帳幕，安上帶卯的座，立上板，穿上閂，立起柱子。
verses.e: Moses raised up the tabernacle , and laid its sockets , and set up its boards , and put in its bars , and raised up its pillars .

verses.z: 在帳幕以上搭罩棚，把罩棚的頂蓋蓋在其上，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: He spread the covering over the tent , and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 「正月初一日，你要立起帳幕，
verses.e: " On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 又把法[版]放在櫃裏，把槓穿在櫃的兩旁，把施恩座安在櫃上。
verses.e: He took and put the covenant into the ark , and set the poles on the ark , and put the mercy seat above on the ark .

verses.z: 把櫃抬進帳幕，掛上遮掩[櫃]的幔子，把法櫃遮掩了，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: He brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the veil of the screen , and screened the ark of the covenant , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 又把桌子安在會幕內，在帳幕北邊，在幔子外。
verses.e: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting , on the north side of the tabernacle , outside of the veil .

verses.z: 在桌子上將餅陳設在耶和華面前，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 又把燈臺安在會幕內，在帳幕南邊，與桌子相對，
verses.e: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting , opposite the table , on the south side of the tabernacle .

verses.z: 在耶和華面前點燈，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: He lit the lamps before the LORD , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 把金壇安在會幕內的幔子前，
verses.e: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil ;

verses.z: 在壇上燒了馨香料做的香，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 又掛上帳幕的門簾。
verses.e: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle .

verses.z: 在會幕的帳幕門前，安設燔祭壇，把燔祭和素祭獻在其上，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting , and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 把法櫃安放在裏面，用幔子將櫃遮掩。
verses.e: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it , and you shall screen the ark with the veil .

verses.z: 把洗濯盆安在會幕和壇的中間，盆中盛水，以便洗濯。
verses.e: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar , and put water therein , with which to wash .

verses.z: 摩西和亞倫並亞倫的兒子在這盆裏洗手洗腳。
verses.e: Moses , Aaron , and his sons washed their hands and their feet there .

verses.z: 他們進會幕或就近壇的時候，便都洗濯，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: When they went into the Tent of Meeting , and when they came near to the altar , they washed , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 在帳幕和壇的四圍立了院帷，把院子的門簾掛上。這樣，摩西就完了工。
verses.e: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar , and set up the screen of the gate of the court . So Moses finished the work .

verses.z: 當時，雲彩遮蓋會幕，耶和華的榮光就充滿了帳幕。
verses.e: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting , and the LORD's glory filled the tabernacle .

verses.z: 摩西不能進會幕；因為雲彩停在其上，並且耶和華的榮光充滿了帳幕。
verses.e: Moses wasn't able to enter into the Tent of Meeting , because the cloud stayed on it , and the LORD's glory filled the tabernacle .

verses.z: 每逢雲彩從帳幕收上去，以色列人就起程前往；
verses.e: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward , throughout all their journeys ;

verses.z: 雲彩若不收上去，他們就不起程，直等到雲彩收上去。
verses.e: but if the cloud wasn't taken up , then they didn't travel until the day that it was taken up .

verses.z: 日間，耶和華的雲彩是在帳幕以上；夜間，雲中有火，在以色列全家的眼前。在他們所行的路上都是這樣。
verses.e: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day , and there was fire in the cloud by night , in the sight of all the house of Israel , throughout all their journeys .

verses.z: 把桌子搬進去，擺設上面的物。把燈臺搬進去，點其上的燈。
verses.e: You shall bring in the table , and set in order the things that are on it . You shall bring in the lamp stand , and light its lamps .

verses.z: 把[燒]香的金壇安在法櫃前，掛上帳幕的門簾。
verses.e: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant , and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle .

verses.z: 把燔祭壇安在帳幕門前。
verses.e: " You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 把洗濯盆安在會幕和壇的中間，在盆裏盛水。
verses.e: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar , and shall put water therein .

verses.z: 又在四圍立院帷，把院子的門簾掛上。
verses.e: You shall set up the court around it , and hang up the screen of the gate of the court .

verses.z: 用膏油把帳幕和其中所有的都抹上，使帳幕和一切器具成聖，就都成聖。
verses.e: " You shall take the anointing oil , and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it , and shall make it holy , and all its furniture , and it will be holy .

verses.z: 後來摩西、亞倫去對法老說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝這樣說：『容我的百姓去，在曠野向我守節。』」
verses.e: Afterward Moses and Aaron came , and said to Pharaoh , " This is what the LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' Let my people go , that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness . ' "

verses.z: 督工的和官長出來對百姓說：「法老這樣說：『我不給你們草。
verses.e: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers , and they spoke to the people , saying , " This is what Pharaoh says : ' I will not give you straw .

verses.z: 你們自己在哪裏能找草，就往那裏去找吧！但你們的工一點不可減少。』」
verses.e: Go yourselves , get straw where you can find it , for nothing of your work shall be diminished . ' "

verses.z: 於是百姓散在埃及遍地，撿碎稭當作草。
verses.e: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw .

verses.z: 督工的催着說：「你們一天當完一天的工，與先前有草一樣。」
verses.e: The taskmasters were urgent saying , " Fulfill your work quota daily , as when there was straw ! "

verses.z: 法老督工的，責打他所派以色列人的官長，說：「你們昨天今天為甚麼沒有照向來的數目做磚、完你們的工作呢？」
verses.e: The officers of the children of Israel , whom Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them , were beaten , and were asked , " Why haven't you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today , in making brick as before ? "

verses.z: 以色列人的官長就來哀求法老說：「為甚麼這樣待你的僕人？
verses.e: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh , saying , " Why do you deal this way with your servants ?

verses.z: 督工的不把草給僕人，並且對我們說：『做磚吧！』看哪，你僕人挨了打，其實是你百姓的錯。」
verses.e: No straw is given to your servants , and they tell us , ' Make brick ! ' and behold , your servants are beaten ; but the fault is in your own people . "

verses.z: 但法老說：「你們是懶惰的！你們是懶惰的！所以說：『容我們去祭祀耶和華。』
verses.e: But Pharaoh said , " You are idle ! You are idle ! Therefore you say , ' Let's go and sacrifice to the LORD . '

verses.z: 現在你們去做工吧！草是不給你們的，磚卻要如數交納。」
verses.e: Go therefore now , and work ; for no straw shall be given to you ; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks ! "

verses.z: 以色列人的官長聽說「你們每天做磚的工作一點不可減少」，就知道是遭遇禍患了。
verses.e: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said , " You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks ! "

verses.z: 法老說：「耶和華是誰，使我聽他的話，容以色列人去呢？我不認識耶和華，也不容以色列人去！」
verses.e: Pharaoh said , " Who is the LORD , that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go ? I don't know the LORD , and moreover I will not let Israel go . "

verses.z: 他們離了法老出來，正遇見摩西、亞倫站在對面，
verses.e: They met Moses and Aaron , who stood along the way , as they came out from Pharaoh .

verses.z: 就向他們說：「願耶和華鑒察你們，施行判斷；因你們使我們在法老和他臣僕面前有了臭名，把刀遞在他們手中殺我們。」
verses.e: They said to them , " May the LORD look at you and judge , because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of his servants , to put a sword in their hand to kill us ! "

verses.z: 摩西回到耶和華那裏，說：「主啊，你為甚麼苦待這百姓呢？為甚麼打發我去呢？
