verses.e: Moses returned to the LORD , and said , " Lord , why have you brought trouble on this people ? Why is it that you have sent me ?

verses.z: 自從我去見法老，奉你的名說話，他就苦待這百姓，你一點也沒有拯救他們。」
verses.e: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name , he has brought trouble on this people . You have not rescued your people at all ! "

verses.z: 他們說：「希伯來人的上帝遇見了我們。求你容我們往曠野去，走三天的路程，祭祀耶和華－我們的上帝，免得他用瘟疫、刀兵攻擊我們。」
verses.e: They said , " The God of the Hebrews has met with us . Please let us go three days ' journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the LORD , our God , lest he fall on us with pestilence , or with the sword . "

verses.z: 埃及王對他們說：「摩西、亞倫！你們為甚麼叫百姓曠工呢？你們去擔你們的擔子吧！」
verses.e: The king of Egypt said to them , " Why do you , Moses and Aaron , take the people from their work ? Get back to your burdens ! "

verses.z: 又說：「看哪，這地的以色列人如今眾多，你們竟叫他們歇下擔子！」
verses.e: Pharaoh said , " Behold , the people of the land are now many , and you make them rest from their burdens . "

verses.z: 當天，法老吩咐督工的和官長說：
verses.e: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們不可照常把草給百姓做磚，叫他們自己去撿草。
verses.e: " You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick , as before . Let them go and gather straw for themselves .

verses.z: 他們素常做磚的數目，你們仍舊向他們要，一點不可減少；因為他們是懶惰的，所以呼求說：『容我們去祭祀我們的上帝。』
verses.e: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before . You shall not diminish anything of it , for they are idle . Therefore they cry , saying , ' Let's go and sacrifice to our God . '

verses.z: 你們要把更重的工夫加在這些人身上，叫他們勞碌，不聽虛謊的言語。」
verses.e: Let heavier work be laid on the men , that they may labor in it . Don't let them pay any attention to lying words . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「現在你必看見我向法老所行的事，使他因我大能的手容以色列人去，且把他們趕出他的地。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh , for by a strong hand he shall let them go , and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你進去對埃及王法老說，要容以色列人出他的地。」
verses.e: " Go in , speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt , that he let the children of Israel go out of his land . "

verses.z: 摩西在耶和華面前說：「以色列人尚且不聽我的話，法老怎肯聽我這拙口笨舌的人呢？」
verses.e: Moses spoke before the LORD , saying , " Behold , the children of Israel haven't listened to me . How then shall Pharaoh listen to me , when I have uncircumcised lips ? "

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西、亞倫往以色列人和埃及王法老那裏去，把以色列人從埃及地領出來。
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , and gave them a command to the children of Israel , and to Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 以色列人家長的名字記在下面。以色列長子呂便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米；這是呂便的各家。
verses.e: These are the heads of their fathers ' houses . The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel : Hanoch , and Pallu , Hezron , and Carmi ; these are the families of Reuben .

verses.z: 西緬的兒子是耶母利、雅憫、阿轄、雅斤、瑣轄，和迦南女子的兒子掃羅；這是西緬的各家。
verses.e: The sons of Simeon : Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman ; these are the families of Simeon .

verses.z: 利未眾子的名字按着他們的後代記在下面：就是革順、哥轄、米拉利。利未一生的歲數是一百三十七歲。
verses.e: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations : Gershon , and Kohath , and Merari ; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years .

verses.z: 革順的兒子按着家室是立尼、示每。
verses.e: The sons of Gershon : Libni and Shimei , according to their families .

verses.z: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。哥轄一生的歲數是一百三十三歲。
verses.e: The sons of Kohath : Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel ; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years .

verses.z: 米拉利的兒子是抹利和母示；這是利未的家，都按着他們的後代。
verses.e: The sons of Merari : Mahli and Mushi . These are the families of the Levites according to their generations .

verses.z: 上帝曉諭摩西說：「我是耶和華。
verses.e: God spoke to Moses , and said to him , " I am the LORD .

verses.z: 暗蘭娶了他父親的妹妹約基別為妻，她給他生了亞倫和摩西。暗蘭一生的歲數是一百三十七歲。
verses.e: Amram took Jochebed his father's sister to himself as wife ; and she bore him Aaron and Moses . The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years .

verses.z: 以斯哈的兒子是可拉、尼斐、細基利。
verses.e: The sons of Izhar : Korah , and Nepheg , and Zichri .

verses.z: 烏薛的兒子是米沙利、以利撒反、西提利。
verses.e: The sons of Uzziel : Mishael , Elzaphan , and Sithri .

verses.z: 亞倫娶了亞米拿達的女兒，拿順的妹妹，以利沙巴為妻，她給他生了拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
verses.e: Aaron took Elisheba , the daughter of Amminadab , the sister of Nahshon , as his wife ; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu , Eleazar and Ithamar .

verses.z: 可拉的兒子是亞惜、以利加拿、亞比亞撒；這是可拉的各家。
verses.e: The sons of Korah : Assir , Elkanah , and Abiasaph ; these are the families of the Korahites .

verses.z: 亞倫的兒子以利亞撒娶了普鐵的一個女兒為妻，她給他生了非尼哈。這是利未人的家長，都按着他們的家。
verses.e: Eleazar Aaron's son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife ; and she bore him Phinehas . These are the heads of the fathers ' houses of the Levites according to their families .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「將以色列人按着他們的軍隊從埃及地領出來。」這是對那亞倫、摩西說的。
verses.e: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said , " Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies . "

verses.z: 對埃及王法老說要將以色列人從埃及領出來的，就是這摩西、亞倫。
verses.e: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt . These are that Moses and Aaron .

verses.z: 當耶和華在埃及地對摩西說話的日子，
verses.e: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt ,

verses.z: 他向摩西說：「我是耶和華；我對你說的一切話，你都要告訴埃及王法老。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " I am the LORD . Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you . "

verses.z: 我從前向亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各顯現為全能的上帝；至於我名耶和華，他們未曾知道。
verses.e: I appeared to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , as God Almighty ; but by my name the LORD I was not known to them .

verses.z: 摩西在耶和華面前說：「看哪，我是拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯聽我呢？」
verses.e: Moses said before the LORD , " Behold , I am of uncircumcised lips , and how shall Pharaoh listen to me ? "

verses.z: 我與他們堅定所立的約，要把他們寄居的迦南地賜給他們。
verses.e: I have also established my covenant with them , to give them the land of Canaan , the land of their travels , in which they lived as aliens .

verses.z: 我也聽見以色列人被埃及人苦待的哀聲，我也記念我的約。
verses.e: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel , whom the Egyptians keep in bondage , and I have remembered my covenant .

verses.z: 所以你要對以色列人說：『我是耶和華；我要用伸出來的膀臂重重地刑罰埃及人，救贖你們脫離他們的重擔，不做他們的苦工。
verses.e: Therefore tell the children of Israel , ' I am the LORD , and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians , and I will rid you out of their bondage , and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm , and with great judgments .

verses.z: 我要以你們為我的百姓，我也要作你們的上帝。你們要知道我是耶和華－你們的上帝，是救你們脫離埃及人之重擔的。
verses.e: I will take you to myself for a people . I will be your God ; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God , who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians .

verses.z: 我起誓應許給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的那地，我要把你們領進去，將那地賜給你們為業。我是耶和華。』」
verses.e: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob ; and I will give it to you for a heritage : I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 摩西將這話告訴以色列人，只是他們因苦工愁煩，不肯聽他的話。
verses.e: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel , but they didn't listen to Moses for anguish of spirit , and for cruel bondage .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「我使你在法老面前代替上帝，你的哥哥亞倫是替你說話的。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Behold , I have made you as God to Pharaoh ; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫進去見法老，就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫把杖丟在法老和臣僕面前，杖就變作蛇。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh , and they did so , as the LORD had commanded . Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants , and it became a serpent .

verses.z: 於是法老召了博士和術士來；他們是埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。
verses.e: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers . They also , the magicians of Egypt , did the same thing with their enchantments .

verses.z: 他們各人丟下自己的杖，杖就變作蛇；但亞倫的杖吞了他們的杖。
verses.e: For they each cast down their rods , and they became serpents ; but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods .

verses.z: 法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽從摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: Pharaoh's heart was hardened , and he didn't listen to them , as the LORD had spoken .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「法老心裏固執，不肯容百姓去。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Pharaoh's heart is stubborn . He refuses to let the people go .

verses.z: 明日早晨，他出來往水邊去，你要往河邊迎接他，手裏要拿着那變過蛇的杖，
verses.e: Go to Pharaoh in the morning . Behold , he is going out to the water . You shall stand by the river's bank to meet him . You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand .

verses.z: 對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的上帝打發我來見你，說：容我的百姓去，好在曠野事奉我。到如今你還是不聽。
verses.e: You shall tell him , ' The LORD , the God of the Hebrews , has sent me to you , saying , " Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness . Behold , until now you haven't listened . "

verses.z: 耶和華這樣說：我要用我手裏的杖擊打河中的水，水就變作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: The LORD says , " In this you shall know that I am the LORD . Behold : I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river , and they shall be turned to blood .

verses.z: 河裏的魚必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厭惡吃這河裏的水。』」
verses.e: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul . The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：「你對亞倫說：『把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他們的江、河、池、塘以上，叫水都變作血。在埃及遍地，無論在木器中，石器中，都必有血。』」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Tell Aaron , ' Take your rod , and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt , over their rivers , over their streams , and over their pools , and over all their ponds of water , that they may become blood . There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone . ' "

verses.z: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要說。你的哥哥亞倫要對法老說，容以色列人出他的地。
verses.e: You shall speak all that I command you ; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh , that he let the children of Israel go out of his land .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫在法老和臣僕眼前舉杖擊打河裏的水，河裏的水都變作血了。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron did so , as the LORD commanded ; and he lifted up the rod , and struck the waters that were in the river , in the sight of Pharaoh , and in the sight of his servants ; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood .

verses.z: 河裏的魚死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃這河裏的水；埃及遍地都有了血。
verses.e: The fish that were in the river died . The river became foul . The Egyptians couldn't drink water from the river . The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments . So Pharaoh's heart was hardened , and he didn't listen to them , as the LORD had spoken .

verses.z: 法老轉身進宮，也不把這事放在心上。
verses.e: Pharaoh turned and went into his house , and he didn't even take this to heart .

verses.z: 埃及人都在河的兩邊挖地，要得水喝，因為他們不能喝這河裏的水。
verses.e: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink ; for they couldn't drink the river water .

verses.z: 耶和華擊打河以後滿了七天。
verses.e: Seven days were fulfilled , after the LORD had struck the river .

verses.z: 我要使法老的心剛硬，也要在埃及地多行神蹟奇事。
verses.e: I will harden Pharaoh's heart , and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 但法老必不聽你們；我要伸手重重地刑罰埃及，將我的軍隊以色列民從埃及地領出來。
verses.e: But Pharaoh will not listen to you , so I will lay my hand on Egypt , and bring out my armies , my people the children of Israel , out of the land of Egypt by great judgments .

verses.z: 我伸手攻擊埃及，將以色列人從他們中間領出來的時候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt , and bring the children of Israel out from among them . "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫這樣行；耶和華怎樣吩咐他們，他們就照樣行了。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron did so . As the LORD commanded them , so they did .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫與法老說話的時候，摩西八十歲，亞倫八十三歲。
verses.e: Moses was eighty years old , and Aaron eighty-three years old , when they spoke to Pharaoh .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 「法老若對你們說：『你們行件奇事吧！』你就吩咐亞倫說：『把杖丟在法老面前，使杖變作蛇。』」
verses.e: " When Pharaoh speaks to you , saying , ' Perform a miracle ! ' then you shall tell Aaron , ' Take your rod , and cast it down before Pharaoh , and it will become a serpent . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你進去見法老，對他說：『耶和華這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , " Go in to Pharaoh , and tell him , ' This is what the LORD says , " Let my people go , that they may serve me .

verses.z: 他說：「明天。」摩西說：「可以照你的話吧，好叫你知道沒有像耶和華－我們上帝的。
verses.e: Pharaoh said , " Tomorrow . " Moses said , " Let it be according to your word , that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God .

verses.z: 青蛙要離開你和你的宮殿，並你的臣僕與你的百姓，只留在河裏。」
verses.e: The frogs shall depart from you , and from your houses , and from your servants , and from your people . They shall remain in the river only . "

verses.z: 於是摩西、亞倫離開法老出去。摩西為擾害法老的青蛙呼求耶和華。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh , and Moses cried to the LORD concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh .

verses.z: 耶和華就照摩西的話行。凡在房裏、院中、田間的青蛙都死了。
verses.e: The LORD did according to the word of Moses , and the frogs died out of the houses , out of the courts , and out of the fields .

verses.z: 眾人把青蛙聚攏成堆，遍地就都腥臭。
verses.e: They gathered them together in heaps , and the land stank .

verses.z: 但法老見災禍鬆緩，就硬着心，不肯聽他們，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite , he hardened his heart , and didn't listen to them , as the LORD had spoken .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你對亞倫說：『伸出你的杖擊打地上的塵土，使塵土在埃及遍地變作虱子。』」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Tell Aaron , ' Stretch out your rod , and strike the dust of the earth , that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt . ' "

verses.z: 他們就這樣行。亞倫伸杖擊打地上的塵土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及遍地的塵土都變成虱子了。
verses.e: They did so ; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and struck the dust of the earth , and there were lice on man , and on animal ; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 行法術的也用邪術要生出虱子來，卻是不能。於是在人身上和牲畜身上都有了虱子。
verses.e: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice , but they couldn't . There were lice on man , and on animal .

verses.z: 行法術的就對法老說：「這是上帝的手段。」法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
verses.e: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh , " This is God's finger ; " but Pharaoh's heart was hardened , and he didn't listen to them , as the LORD had spoken .

verses.z: 你若不肯容他們去，我必使青蛙糟蹋你的四境。
verses.e: If you refuse to let them go , behold , I will plague all your borders with frogs .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你清早起來，法老來到水邊，你站在他面前，對他說：『耶和華這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh ; behold , he comes out to the water ; and tell him , ' This is what the LORD says , " Let my people go , that they may serve me .

verses.z: 你若不容我的百姓去，我要叫成群的蒼蠅到你和你臣僕並你百姓的身上，進你的房屋，並且埃及人的房屋和他們所住的地都要滿了成群的蒼蠅。
verses.e: Else , if you will not let my people go , behold , I will send swarms of flies on you , and on your servants , and on your people , and into your houses . The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies , and also the ground they are on .

verses.z: 當那日，我必分別我百姓所住的歌珊地，使那裏沒有成群的蒼蠅，好叫你知道我是天下的耶和華。
verses.e: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen , in which my people dwell , that no swarms of flies shall be there , to the end you may know that I am the LORD on the earth .

verses.z: 我要將我的百姓和你的百姓分別出來。明天必有這神蹟。』」
verses.e: I will put a division between my people and your people . This sign shall happen by tomorrow . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華就這樣行。蒼蠅成了大群，進入法老的宮殿，和他臣僕的房屋；埃及遍地就因這成群的蒼蠅敗壞了。
verses.e: The LORD did so ; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh , and into his servants ' houses . In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies .

verses.z: 法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「你們去，在這地祭祀你們的上帝吧！」
verses.e: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , " Go , sacrifice to your God in the land ! "

verses.z: 摩西說：「這樣行本不相宜，因為我們要把埃及人所厭惡的祭祀耶和華－我們的上帝；若把埃及人所厭惡的在他們眼前獻為祭，他們豈不拿石頭打死我們嗎？
verses.e: Moses said , " It isn't appropriate to do so ; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God . Behold , if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes , won't they stone us ?

verses.z: 我們要往曠野去，走三天的路程，照着耶和華－我們上帝所要吩咐我們的祭祀他。」
verses.e: We will go three days ' journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the LORD our God , as he shall command us . "

verses.z: 法老說：「我容你們去，在曠野祭祀耶和華－你們的上帝；只是不要走得很遠。求你們為我祈禱。」
verses.e: Pharaoh said , " I will let you go , that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness , only you shall not go very far away . Pray for me . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「我要出去求耶和華，使成群的蒼蠅明天離開法老和法老的臣僕並法老的百姓；法老卻不可再行詭詐，不容百姓去祭祀耶和華。」
verses.e: Moses said , " Behold , I am going out from you . I will pray to the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people , tomorrow ; only don't let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD . "

verses.z: 河裏要滋生青蛙；這青蛙要上來進你的宮殿和你的臥房，上你的床榻，進你臣僕的房屋，上你百姓的身上，進你的爐訿和你的摶麵盆，
verses.e: The river will swarm with frogs , which will go up and come into your house , and into your bedroom , and on your bed , and into the house of your servants , and on your people , and into your ovens , and into your kneading troughs .

verses.z: 於是摩西離開法老去求耶和華。
verses.e: Moses went out from Pharaoh , and prayed to the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華就照摩西的話行，叫成群的蒼蠅離開法老和他的臣僕並他的百姓，一個也沒有留下。
verses.e: The LORD did according to the word of Moses , and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people . There remained not one .

verses.z: 這一次法老又硬着心，不容百姓去。
verses.e: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also , and he didn't let the people go .

verses.z: 又要上你和你百姓並你眾臣僕的身上。』」
verses.e: The frogs shall come up both on you , and on your people , and on all your servants . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：「你對亞倫說：『把你的杖伸在江、河、池以上，使青蛙到埃及地上來。』」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Tell Aaron , ' Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers , over the streams , and over the pools , and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt . ' "

verses.z: 亞倫便伸杖在埃及的諸水以上，青蛙就上來，遮滿了埃及地。
verses.e: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 行法術的也用他們的邪術照樣而行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。
verses.e: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments , and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「請你們求耶和華使這青蛙離開我和我的民，我就容百姓去祭祀耶和華。」
verses.e: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron , and said , " Entreat the LORD , that he take away the frogs from me and from my people ; and I will let the people go , that they may sacrifice to the LORD . "

verses.z: 摩西對法老說：「任憑你吧，我要何時為你和你的臣僕並你的百姓祈求，除滅青蛙離開你和你的宮殿只留在河裏呢？」
verses.e: Moses said to Pharaoh , " I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you , and for your servants , and for your people , that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses , and remain in the river only . "

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你進去見法老，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的上帝這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.e: Then the LORD said to Moses , " Go in to Pharaoh , and tell him , ' This is what the LORD , the God of the Hebrews , says : " Let my people go , that they may serve me .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫取了爐灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天揚起來，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。
verses.e: They took ashes of the furnace , and stood before Pharaoh ; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky ; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal .

verses.z: 行法術的在摩西面前站立不住，因為在他們身上和一切埃及人身上都有這瘡。
verses.e: The magicians couldn't stand before Moses because of the boils ; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians .

verses.z: 耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不聽他們，正如耶和華對摩西所說的。
verses.e: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh , and he didn't listen to them , as the LORD had spoken to Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你清早起來，站在法老面前，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的上帝這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh , and tell him , ' This is what the LORD , the God of the Hebrews , says : " Let my people go , that they may serve me .

verses.z: 因為這一次我要叫一切的災殃臨到你和你臣僕並你百姓的身上，叫你知道在普天下沒有像我的。
verses.e: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart , against your officials , and against your people ; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth .

verses.z: 我若伸手用瘟疫攻擊你和你的百姓，你早就從地上除滅了。
verses.e: For now I would have stretched out my hand , and struck you and your people with pestilence , and you would have been cut off from the earth ;

verses.z: 其實，我叫你存立，是特要向你顯我的大能，並要使我的名傳遍天下。
verses.e: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand : to show you my power , and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth ,

verses.z: 你還向我的百姓自高，不容他們去嗎？
verses.e: because you still exalt yourself against my people , that you won't let them go .

verses.z: 到明天約在這時候，我必叫重大的冰雹降下，自從埃及開國以來，沒有這樣的冰雹。
verses.e: Behold , tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now .

verses.z: 現在你要打發人把你的牲畜和你田間一切所有的催進來；凡在田間不收回家的，無論是人是牲畜，冰雹必降在他們身上，他們就必死。』」
verses.e: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter . The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field , and isn't brought home , and they will die . " ' "

verses.z: 你若不肯容他們去，仍舊強留他們，
verses.e: For if you refuse to let them go , and hold them still ,

verses.z: 法老的臣僕中，懼怕耶和華這話的，便叫他的奴僕和牲畜跑進家來。
verses.e: Those who feared the LORD's word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses .

verses.z: 但那不把耶和華這話放在心上的，就將他的奴僕和牲畜留在田裏。
verses.e: Whoever didn't respect the LORD's word left his servants and his livestock in the field .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向天伸杖，使埃及遍地的人身上和牲畜身上，並田間各樣菜蔬上，都有冰雹。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Stretch out your hand toward the sky , that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt , on man , and on animal , and on every herb of the field , throughout the land of Egypt . "

verses.z: 摩西向天伸杖，耶和華就打雷下雹，有火閃到地上；耶和華下雹在埃及地上。
verses.e: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens , and the LORD sent thunder and hail ; and lightning flashed down to the earth . The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 那時，雹與火攙雜，甚是厲害，自從埃及成國以來，遍地沒有這樣的。
verses.e: So there was very severe hail , and lightning mixed with the hail , such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation .

verses.z: 在埃及遍地，雹擊打了田間所有的人和牲畜，並一切的菜蔬，又打壞田間一切的樹木。
verses.e: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field , both man and animal ; and the hail struck every herb of the field , and broke every tree of the field .

verses.z: 惟獨以色列人所住的歌珊地沒有冰雹。
verses.e: Only in the land of Goshen , where the children of Israel were , there was no hail .

verses.z: 法老打發人召摩西、亞倫來，對他們說：「這一次我犯了罪了。耶和華是公義的；我和我的百姓是邪惡的。
verses.e: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron , and said to them , " I have sinned this time . The LORD is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .

verses.z: 這雷轟和冰雹已經夠了。請你們求耶和華，我就容你們去，不再留住你們。」
verses.e: Pray to the LORD ; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail . I will let you go , and you shall stay no longer . "

verses.z: 摩西對他說：「我一出城，就要向耶和華舉手[禱告]；雷必止住，也不再有冰雹，叫你知道全地都是屬耶和華的。
verses.e: Moses said to him , " As soon as I have gone out of the city , I will spread out my hands to the LORD . The thunders shall cease , and there will not be any more hail ; that you may know that the earth is the LORD's .

verses.z: 耶和華的手加在你田間的牲畜上，就是在馬、驢、駱駝、牛群、羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。
verses.e: behold , the LORD's hand is on your livestock which are in the field , on the horses , on the donkeys , on the camels , on the herds , and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence .

verses.z: 至於你和你的臣僕，我知道你們還是不懼怕耶和華上帝。」（
verses.e: But as for you and your servants , I know that you don't yet fear the LORD God . "

verses.z: 那時，麻和大麥被[雹]擊打；因為大麥已經吐穗，麻也開了花。
verses.e: The flax and the barley were struck , for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming .

verses.z: 只是小麥和粗麥沒有被擊打，因為還沒有長成。）
verses.e: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck , for they had not grown up .

verses.z: 摩西離了法老出城，向耶和華舉手[禱告]；雷和雹就止住，雨也不再澆在地上了。
verses.e: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh , and spread out his hands to the LORD ; and the thunders and hail ceased , and the rain was not poured on the earth .

verses.z: 法老見雨和雹與雷止住，就越發犯罪；他和他的臣僕都硬着心。
verses.e: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased , he sinned yet more , and hardened his heart , he and his servants .

verses.z: 法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人去，正如耶和華藉着摩西所說的。
verses.e: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened , and he didn't let the children of Israel go , just as the LORD had spoken through Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華要分別以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡屬以色列人的，一樣都不死。』」
verses.e: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt ; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華就定了時候，說：「明天耶和華必在此地行這事。」
verses.e: The LORD appointed a set time , saying , " Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land . "

verses.z: 第二天，耶和華就行這事。埃及的牲畜[幾乎]都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜，一個都沒有死。
verses.e: The LORD did that thing on the next day ; and all the livestock of Egypt died , but of the livestock of the children of Israel , not one died .

verses.z: 法老打發人去[看]，誰知以色列人的牲畜連一個都沒有死。法老的心卻是固執，不容百姓去。
verses.e: Pharaoh sent , and , behold , there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead . But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn , and he didn't let the people go .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西、亞倫說：「你們取幾捧爐灰，摩西要在法老面前向天揚起來。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron , " Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace , and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh .

verses.z: 這灰要在埃及全地變作塵土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。」
verses.e: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt , and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal , throughout all the land of Egypt . "

verses.z: 當三十年四[月]初五[日]，以西結在迦巴魯河邊被擄的人中，天就開了，得見上帝的異象。
verses.e: Now in the thirtieth year , in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I was among the captives by the river Chebar , the heavens were opened , and I saw visions of God .

verses.z: 至於臉的形像：[前面]各有人的臉，右面各有獅子的臉，左面各有牛的臉，[後面]各有鷹的臉。
verses.e: As for the likeness of their faces , they had the face of a man . The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side . The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side . The four of them also had the face of an eagle .

verses.z: 各展開上邊的兩個翅膀相接，各以[下邊的]兩個[翅膀]遮體。
verses.e: Such were their faces . Their wings were spread out above . Two wings of each one touched another , and two covered their bodies .

verses.z: 他們俱各直往前行。靈往哪裏去，他們就往那裏去，行走並不轉身。
verses.e: Each one went straight forward . Where the spirit was to go , they went . They didn't turn when they went .

verses.z: 至於四活物的形像，就如燒着火炭的形狀，又如火把的形狀。[火]在四活物中間上去下來，這火有光輝，從火中發出閃電。
verses.e: As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , like the appearance of torches . The fire went up and down among the living creatures . The fire was bright , and lightning went out of the fire .

verses.z: 這活物往來奔走，好像電光一閃。
verses.e: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning .

verses.z: 我正觀看活物的時候，見活物的臉旁各有一輪在地上。
verses.e: Now as I saw the living creatures , behold , there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures , for each of the four faces of it .

verses.z: 輪的形狀和顏色好像水蒼玉。四輪都是一個樣式，形狀和作法好像輪中套輪。
verses.e: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl . The four of them had one likeness . Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel .

verses.z: 輪行走的時候，向四方都能直行，並不掉轉。
verses.e: When they went , they went in their four directions . They didn't turn when they went .

verses.z: 至於輪輞，高而可畏；四個輪輞周圍滿有眼睛。
verses.e: As for their rims , they were high and dreadful ; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around .

verses.z: 活物行走，輪也在旁邊行走；活物從地上升，輪也都上升。
verses.e: When the living creatures went , the wheels went beside them . When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up .

verses.z: 正是約雅斤王被擄去第五年四月初五日，
verses.e: In the fifth of the month , which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin's captivity ,

verses.z: 靈往哪裏去，活物就往那裏去；活物上升，輪也在活物旁邊上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
verses.e: Wherever the spirit was to go , they went . The spirit was to go there . The wheels were lifted up beside them ; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels .

verses.z: 那些行走，這些也行走；那些站住，這些也站住；那些從地上升，輪也在旁邊上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
verses.e: When those went , these went . When those stood , these stood . When those were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up beside them ; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels .

verses.z: 活物的頭以上有穹蒼的形像，看着像可畏的水晶，鋪張在活物的頭以上。
verses.e: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse , like an awesome crystal to look at , stretched out over their heads above .

verses.z: 穹蒼以下，活物的翅膀直張，彼此相對；每活物有兩個翅膀遮體。
verses.e: Under the expanse , their wings were straight , one toward the other . Each one had two which covered on this side , and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side .

verses.z: 活物行走的時候，我聽見翅膀的響聲，像大水的聲音，像全能者的聲音，也像軍隊鬨嚷的聲音。活物站住的時候，便將翅膀垂下。
verses.e: When they went , I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters , like the voice of the Almighty , a noise of tumult like the noise of an army . When they stood , they let down their wings .

verses.z: 在他們頭以上的穹蒼之上有聲音。他們站住的時候，便將翅膀垂下。
verses.e: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads . When they stood , they let down their wings .

verses.z: 在他們頭以上的穹蒼之上有寶座的形像，彷彿藍寶石；在寶座形像以上有彷彿人的形狀。
verses.e: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne , as the appearance of a sapphire stone . On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above .

verses.z: 我見從他腰以上有彷彿光耀的精金，周圍都有火的形狀，又見從他腰以下有彷彿火的形狀，周圍也有光輝。
verses.e: I saw as it were glowing metal , as the appearance of fire within it all around , from the appearance of his waist and upward ; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire , and there was brightness around him .

verses.z: 下雨的日子，雲中虹的形狀怎樣，周圍光輝的形狀也是怎樣。這就是耶和華榮耀的形像。我一看見就俯伏在地，又聽見一位說話的聲音。
verses.e: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain , so was the appearance of the brightness all around . This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD's glory . When I saw it , I fell on my face , and I heard a voice of one that spoke .

verses.z: 在迦勒底人之地、迦巴魯河邊，耶和華的話特特臨到布西的兒子祭司以西結；耶和華的靈降在他身上。
verses.e: the LORD's word came to Ezekiel the priest , the son of Buzi , in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar ; and the LORD's hand was there on him .

verses.z: 我觀看，見狂風從北方颳來，隨着有一朵包括閃爍火的大雲，周圍有光輝；從其中的火內發出好像光耀的精金；
verses.e: I looked , and behold , a stormy wind came out of the north : a great cloud , with flashing lightning , and a brightness around it , and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal , out of the middle of the fire .

verses.z: 又從其中顯出四個活物的形像來。他們的形狀是這樣：有人的形像，
verses.e: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures . This was their appearance : They had the likeness of a man .

verses.z: 各有四個臉面，四個翅膀。
verses.e: Everyone had four faces , and each one of them had four wings .

verses.z: 他們的腿是直的，腳掌好像牛犢之蹄，都燦爛如光明的銅。
verses.e: Their feet were straight feet . The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot ; and they sparkled like burnished bronze .

verses.z: 在四面的翅膀以下有人的手。這四個活物的臉和翅膀乃是這樣：
verses.e: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides . The four of them had their faces and their wings like this :

verses.z: 翅膀彼此相接，行走並不轉身，俱各直往前行。
verses.e: Their wings were joined to one another . They didn't turn when they went . Each one went straight forward .

verses.z: 我觀看，見基路伯頭上的穹蒼之中，顯出藍寶石的形狀，彷彿寶座的形像。
verses.e: Then I looked , and see , in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone , as the appearance of the likeness of a throne .

verses.z: 至於四輪的形狀，都是一個樣式，彷彿輪中套輪。
verses.e: As for their appearance , the four of them had one likeness , like a wheel within a wheel .

verses.z: 輪行走的時候，向四方都能直行，並不掉轉。頭向何方，他們也隨向何方，行走的時候並不掉轉。
verses.e: When they went , they went in their four directions . They didn't turn as they went , but to the place where the head looked they followed it . They didn't turn as they went .

verses.z: 他們全身，連背帶手和翅膀，並輪周圍都滿了眼睛。這四個基路伯的輪子都是如此。
verses.e: Their whole body , including their backs , their hands , their wings , and the wheels , were full of eyes all around , even the wheels that the four of them had .

verses.z: 至於這些輪子，我耳中聽見說是旋轉的。
verses.e: As for the wheels , they were called in my hearing , " the whirling wheels " .

verses.z: 基路伯各有四臉：第一是基路伯的臉，第二是人的臉，第三是獅子的臉，第四是鷹的臉。
verses.e: Every one of them had four faces . The first face was the face of the cherub . The second face was the face of a man . The third face was the face of a lion . The fourth was the face of an eagle .

verses.z: 基路伯升上去了；這是我在迦巴魯河邊所見的活物。
verses.e: The cherubim mounted up . This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar .

verses.z: 基路伯行走，輪也在旁邊行走。基路伯展開翅膀，離地上升，輪也不轉離他們旁邊。
verses.e: When the cherubim went , the wheels went beside them ; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth , the wheels also didn't turn from beside them .

verses.z: 那些站住，這些也站住；那些上升，這些也一同上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
verses.e: When they stood , these stood . When they mounted up , these mounted up with them ; for the spirit of the living creature was in them .

verses.z: 耶和華的榮耀從殿的門檻那裏出去，停在基路伯以上。
verses.e: The LORD's glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim .

verses.z: 基路伯出去的時候，就展開翅膀，在我眼前離地上升。輪也在他們的旁邊，都停在耶和華殿的東門口。在他們以上有以色列上帝的榮耀。
verses.e: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out , with the wheels beside them . Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD's house ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .

verses.z: 主對那穿細麻衣的人說：「你進去，在旋轉的輪內基路伯以下，從基路伯中間將火炭取滿兩手，撒在城上。」我就見他進去。
verses.e: He spoke to the man clothed in linen , and said , " Go in between the whirling wheels , even under the cherub , and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim , and scatter them over the city . " He went in as I watched .

verses.z: 這是我在迦巴魯河邊所見、以色列上帝榮耀以下的活物，我就知道他們是基路伯。
verses.e: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar ; and I knew that they were cherubim .

verses.z: 各有四個臉面，四個翅膀，翅膀以下有人手的樣式。
verses.e: Every one had four faces , and every one four wings . The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .

verses.z: 至於他們臉的模樣，並身體的形像，是我從前在迦巴魯河邊所看見的。他們俱各直往前行。
verses.e: As for the likeness of their faces , they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar , their appearances and themselves . They each went straight forward .

verses.z: 那人進去的時候，基路伯站在殿的右邊，雲彩充滿了內院。
verses.e: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in ; and the cloud filled the inner court .

verses.z: 耶和華的榮耀從基路伯那裏上升，[停]在門檻以上；殿內滿了雲彩，院宇也被耶和華榮耀的光輝充滿。
verses.e: The LORD's glory mounted up from the cherub , and stood over the threshold of the house ; and the house was filled with the cloud , and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD's glory .

verses.z: 基路伯翅膀的響聲聽到外院，好像全能上帝說話的聲音。
verses.e: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court , as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks .

verses.z: 他吩咐那穿細麻衣的人說：「要從旋轉的輪內基路伯中間取火。」那人就進去站在一個輪子旁邊。
verses.e: It came to pass , when he commanded the man clothed in linen , saying , " Take fire from between the whirling wheels , from between the cherubim , " that he went in and stood beside a wheel .

verses.z: 有一個基路伯從基路伯中伸手到基路伯中間的火那裏，取些放在那穿細麻衣的人兩手中，那人就拿出去了。
verses.e: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim , and took some of it , and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen , who took it and went out .

verses.z: 在基路伯翅膀之下，顯出有人手的樣式。
verses.e: The form of a man's hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings .

verses.z: 我又觀看，見基路伯旁邊有四個輪子。這基路伯旁有一個輪子，那基路伯旁有一個輪子，每基路伯都是如此；輪子的顏色彷彿水蒼玉。
verses.e: I looked , and behold , there were four wheels beside the cherubim , one wheel beside one cherub , and another wheel beside another cherub . The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone .

verses.z: 靈將我舉起，帶到耶和華殿向東的東門。誰知，在門口有二十五個人，我見其中有民間的首領押朔的兒子雅撒尼亞和比拿雅的兒子毗拉提。
verses.e: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD's house , which looks eastward . Behold , twenty-five men were at the door of the gate ; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .

verses.z: 你們必倒在刀下；我必在以色列的境界審判你們，你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: You will fall by the sword . I will judge you in the border of Israel . Then you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 這城必不作你們的鍋，你們也不作其中的肉。我必在以色列的境界審判你們，
verses.e: This will not be your cauldron , neither will you be the meat in the middle of it . I will judge you in the border of Israel .

verses.z: 你們就知道我是耶和華；因為你們沒有遵行我的律例，也沒有順從我的典章，卻隨從你們四圍列國的惡規。」
verses.e: You will know that I am the LORD , for you have not walked in my statutes . You have not executed my ordinances , but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you . " ' "

verses.z: 我正說預言的時候，比拿雅的兒子毗拉提死了。於是我俯伏在地，大聲呼叫說：「哎！主耶和華啊，你要將以色列剩下的人滅絕淨盡嗎？」
verses.e: When I prophesied , Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died . Then I fell down on my face , and cried with a loud voice , and said , " Ah Lord GOD ! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel ? "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，耶路撒冷的居民對你的弟兄、你的本族、你的親屬、以色列全家，就是對大眾說：『你們遠離耶和華吧！這地是賜給我們為業的。』
verses.e: " Son of man , your brothers , even your brothers , the men of your relatives , and all the house of Israel , all of them , are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said , ' Go far away from the LORD . This land has been given to us for a possession . '

verses.z: 所以你當說：『耶和華如此說：我雖將以色列全家遠遠遷移到列國中，將他們分散在列邦內，我還要在他們所到的列邦，暫作他們的聖所。』
verses.e: " Therefore say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations , and whereas I have scattered them among the countries , yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come . " '

verses.z: 你當說：『主耶和華如此說：我必從萬民中招聚你們，從分散的列國內聚集你們，又要將以色列地賜給你們。』
verses.e: " Therefore say , ' The Lord GOD says : " I will gather you from the peoples , and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel . "

verses.z: 他們必到那裏，也必從其中除掉一切可憎可厭的物。
verses.e: " ' They will come there , and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there .

verses.z: 我要使他們有合一的心，也要將新靈放在他們裏面，又從他們肉體中除掉石心，賜給他們肉心，
verses.e: I will give them one heart , and I will put a new spirit within them . I will take the stony heart out of their flesh , and will give them a heart of flesh ,

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「人子啊，這就是圖謀罪孽的人，在這城中給人設惡謀。
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , these are the men who devise iniquity , and who give wicked counsel in this city ;

verses.z: 使他們順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章。他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的上帝。
verses.e: that they may walk in my statutes , and keep my ordinances , and do them . They will be my people , and I will be their God .

verses.z: 至於那些心中隨從可憎可厭之物的，我必照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will bring their way on their own heads , ' says the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 於是，基路伯展開翅膀，輪子都在他們旁邊；在他們以上有以色列上帝的榮耀。
verses.e: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings , and the wheels were beside them . The glory of the God of Israel was over them above .

verses.z: 耶和華的榮耀從城中上升，停在城東的那座山上。
verses.e: The LORD's glory went up from the middle of the city , and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city .

verses.z: 靈將我舉起，在異象中藉着上帝的靈將我帶進迦勒底地，到被擄的人那裏；我所見的異象就離我上升去了。
verses.e: The Spirit lifted me up , and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to the captives . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .

verses.z: 我便將耶和華所指示我的一切事都說給被擄的人聽。
verses.e: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me .

verses.z: 他們說：『蓋房屋的時候尚未臨近；這城是鍋，我們是肉。』
verses.e: who say , ' The time is not near to build houses . This is the cauldron , and we are the meat . '

verses.z: 人子啊，因此你當說預言，說預言攻擊他們。」
verses.e: Therefore prophesy against them . Prophesy , son of man . "

verses.z: 耶和華的靈降在我身上，對我說：「你當說，耶和華如此說：以色列家啊，你們口中所說的，心裏所想的，我都知道。
verses.e: The LORD's Spirit fell on me , and he said to me , " Speak , ' The LORD says : " Thus you have said , house of Israel ; for I know the things that come into your mind .

verses.z: 你們在這城中殺人增多，使被殺的人充滿街道。
verses.e: You have multiplied your slain in this city , and you have filled its streets with the slain . "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：你們殺在城中的人就是肉，這城就是鍋；你們卻要從其中被帶出去。
verses.e: " ' Therefore the Lord GOD says : " Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it , they are the meat , and this is the cauldron ; but you will be brought out of the middle of it .

verses.z: 你們怕刀劍，我必使刀劍臨到你們。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: You have feared the sword ; and I will bring the sword on you , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我必從這城中帶出你們去，交在外邦人的手中，且要在你們中間施行審判。
verses.e: " I will bring you out of the middle of it , and deliver you into the hands of strangers , and will execute judgments among you .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word also came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 你要對他們說：『主耶和華如此說：這是[關乎]耶路撒冷的君王和他周圍以色列全家的預表。』
verses.e: " Say to them , ' The Lord GOD says : " This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem , and all the house of Israel among whom they are . " '

verses.z: 你要說：『我作你們的預兆：我怎樣行，他們所遭遇的也必怎樣，他們必被擄去。』
verses.e: " Say , ' I am your sign . As I have done , so will it be done to them . They will go into exile , into captivity .

verses.z: 他們中間的君王也必在天黑的時候將物件搭在肩頭上帶出去。他們要挖通了牆，從其中帶出去。他必蒙住臉，眼看不見地。
verses.e: " ' The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark , and will go out . They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way . He will cover his face , because he will not see the land with his eyes .

verses.z: 我必將我的網撒在他身上，他必在我的網羅中纏住。我必帶他到迦勒底人之地的巴比倫；他雖死在那裏，卻看不見那地。
verses.e: I will also spread my net on him , and he will be taken in my snare . I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans ; yet he will not see it , though he will die there .

verses.z: 周圍一切幫助他的和他所有的軍隊，我必分散四方，也要拔刀追趕他們。
verses.e: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him , and all his bands . I will draw out the sword after them .

verses.z: 我將他們四散在列國、分散在列邦的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries .

verses.z: 我卻要留下他們幾個人得免刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫，使他們在所到的各國中述說他們一切可憎的事，人就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword , from the famine , and from the pestilence , that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come . Then they will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你吃飯必膽戰，喝水必惶惶憂慮。
verses.e: " Son of man , eat your bread with quaking , and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness .

verses.z: 你要對這地的百姓說：主耶和華論耶路撒冷和以色列地的居民如此說，他們吃飯必憂慮，喝水必驚惶。因其中居住的眾人所行強暴的事，這地必然荒廢，一無所存。
verses.e: Tell the people of the land , ' The Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel : " They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay , that her land may be desolate , and all that is therein , because of the violence of all those who dwell therein .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你住在悖逆的家中。他們有眼睛看不見，有耳朵聽不見，因為他們是悖逆之家。
verses.e: " Son of man , you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house , who have eyes to see , and don't see , who have ears to hear , and don't hear ; for they are a rebellious house .

verses.z: 有居民的城邑必變為荒場，地也必變為荒廢；你們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste , and the land will be a desolation . Then you will know that I am the LORD . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，在你們以色列地怎麼有這俗語，說『日子遲延，一切異象都落了空』呢？
verses.e: " Son of man , what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel , saying , ' The days are prolonged , and every vision fails ' ?

verses.z: 你要告訴他們說：『主耶和華如此說：我必使這俗語止息，以色列中不再用這俗語。』你卻要對他們說：『日子臨近，一切的異象必都應驗。』
verses.e: Tell them therefore , ' The Lord GOD says : " I will make this proverb to cease , and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel ; " ' but tell them , ' " The days are at hand , and the fulfillment of every vision .

verses.z: 從此，在以色列家中必不再有虛假的異象和奉承的占卜。
verses.e: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel .

verses.z: 我－耶和華說話，所說的必定成就，不再耽延。你們這悖逆之家，我所說的話必趁你們在世的日子成就。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: For I am the LORD . I will speak , and the word that I speak will be performed . It will be no more deferred ; for in your days , rebellious house , I will speak the word and will perform it , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Again the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，以色列家的人說：『他所見的異象是關乎後來許多的日子，所說的預言是指着極遠的時候。』
verses.e: " Son of man , behold , they of the house of Israel say , ' The vision that he sees is for many days to come , and he prophesies of times that are far off . '

verses.z: 所以你要對他們說：『主耶和華如此說：我的話沒有一句再耽延的，我所說的必定成就。這是主耶和華說的。』」
verses.e: " Therefore tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " None of my words will be deferred any more , but the word which I speak will be performed , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 所以人子啊，你要預備擄去使用的物件，在白日當他們眼前從你所住的地方移到別處去；他們雖是悖逆之家，或者可以揣摩思想。
verses.e: " Therefore , you son of man , prepare your baggage for moving , and move by day in their sight . You shall move from your place to another place in their sight . It may be they will consider , though they are a rebellious house .

verses.z: 你要在白日當他們眼前帶出你的物件去，好像預備擄去使用的物件。到了晚上，你要在他們眼前親自出去，像被擄的人出去一樣。
verses.e: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight , as baggage for moving . You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight , as when men go out into exile .

verses.z: 你要在他們眼前挖通了牆，從其中將[物件]帶出去。
verses.e: Dig through the wall in their sight , and carry your baggage out that way .

verses.z: 到天黑時，你要當他們眼前搭在肩頭上帶出去，並要蒙住臉看不見地，因為我立你作以色列家的預兆。」
verses.e: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder , and carry it out in the dark . You shall cover your face , so that you don't see the land , for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel . "

verses.z: 我就照着所吩咐的去行，白日帶出我的物件，好像預備擄去使用的物件。到了晚上，我用手挖通了牆。天黑的時候，就當他們眼前搭在肩頭上帶出去。
verses.e: I did so as I was commanded . I brought out my baggage by day , as baggage for moving , and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand . I brought it out in the dark , and bore it on my shoulder in their sight .

verses.z: 次日早晨，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: In the morning , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，以色列家，就是那悖逆之家，豈不是問你說：『你做甚麼呢？』
verses.e: " Son of man , hasn't the house of Israel , the rebellious house , said to you , ' What are you doing ? '

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 因為他們誘惑我的百姓，說：『平安！』其實沒有平安，就像有人立起牆壁，他們倒用未泡透的[灰]抹上。
verses.e: " ' Because , even because they have seduced my people , saying , " Peace ; " and there is no peace . When one builds up a wall , behold , they plaster it with whitewash .

verses.z: 所以你要對那些抹上未泡透[灰]的人說：『牆要倒塌，必有暴雨漫過。大冰雹啊，你們要降下，狂風也要吹裂這牆。』
verses.e: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall . There will be an overflowing shower ; and you , great hailstones , will fall . A stormy wind will tear it .

verses.z: 這牆倒塌之後，人豈不問你們說：『你們抹上未泡透的[灰]在哪裏呢？』」
verses.e: Behold , when the wall has fallen , won't it be said to you , " Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it ? "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：「我要發怒，使狂風吹裂這牆，在怒中使暴雨漫過，又發怒降下大冰雹，毀滅這牆。
verses.e: " ' Therefore the Lord GOD says : " I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath . There will be an overflowing shower in my anger , and great hailstones in wrath to consume it .

verses.z: 我要這樣拆毀你們那未泡透[灰]所抹的牆，拆平到地，以致根基露出，牆必倒塌，你們也必在其中滅亡；你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash , and bring it down to the ground , so that its foundation will be uncovered . It will fall , and you will be consumed in the middle of it . Then you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 我要這樣向牆和用未泡透[灰]抹牆的人成就我怒中所定的，並要對你們說：『牆和抹牆的人都沒有了。』
verses.e: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall , and on those who have plastered it with whitewash . I will tell you , ' The wall is no more , nor those who plastered it —

verses.z: 這[抹牆的]就是以色列的先知，他們指着耶路撒冷說預言，為這城見了平安的異象，其實沒有平安。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: to wit , the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem , and who see visions of peace for her , and there is no peace , ' " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要面向本民中、從己心發預言的女子說預言，攻擊她們，
verses.e: You , son of man , set your face against the daughters of your people , who prophesy out of their own heart ; and prophesy against them ,

verses.z: 說主耶和華如此說：『這些婦女有禍了！她們為眾人的膀臂縫靠枕，給高矮之人做下垂的頭巾，為要獵取人的性命。難道你們要獵取我百姓的性命，為利己將人救活嗎？
verses.e: and say , " The Lord GOD says : ' Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls ! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves ?

verses.z: 你們為兩把大麥，為幾塊餅，在我民中褻瀆我，對肯聽謊言的民說謊，殺死不該死的人，救活不該活的人。』」
verses.e: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread , to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live , by your lying to my people who listen to lies . '

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要說預言攻擊以色列中說預言的先知，對那些本己心發預言的說：『你們當聽耶和華的話。』」
verses.e: " Son of man , prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy , and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart , ' Hear the LORD's word :

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：「看哪，我與你們的靠枕反對，就是你們用以獵取人、使人的性命[如鳥]飛的。我要將靠枕從你們的膀臂上扯去，釋放你們獵取[如鳥]飛的人。
verses.e: " Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Behold , I am against your magic bands , with which you hunt the souls to make them fly , and I will tear them from your arms . I will let the souls fly free , even the souls whom you ensnare like birds .

verses.z: 我也必撕裂你們下垂的頭巾，救我百姓脫離你們的手，不再被獵取，落在你們手中。你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand ; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared . Then you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 我不使義人傷心，你們卻以謊話使他傷心，又堅固惡人的手，使他不回頭離開惡道得以救活。
verses.e: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous , whom I have not made sad ; and strengthened the hands of the wicked , that he should not return from his wicked way , and be saved alive .

verses.z: 你們就不再見虛假的異象，也不再行占卜的事；我必救我的百姓脫離你們的手；你們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination . I will deliver my people out of your hand . Then you will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「愚頑的先知有禍了，他們隨從自己的心意，卻一無所見。
verses.e: The Lord GOD says , " Woe to the foolish prophets , who follow their own spirit , and have seen nothing !

verses.z: 以色列啊，你的先知好像荒場中的狐狸，
verses.e: Israel , your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places .

verses.z: 沒有上去堵擋破口，也沒有為以色列家重修牆垣，使他們當耶和華的日子在陣上站立得住。
verses.e: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel , to stand in the battle in the LORD's day .

verses.z: 這些人所見的是虛假，是謊詐的占卜。他們說是耶和華說的，其實耶和華並沒有差遣他們，他們倒使人指望那話必然立定。
verses.e: They have seen falsehood and lying divination , who say , ' The LORD says ; ' but the LORD has not sent them . They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed .

verses.z: 你們豈不是見了虛假的異象嗎？豈不是說了謊詐的占卜嗎？你們說，這是耶和華說的，其實我沒有說。」
verses.e: Haven't you seen a false vision , and haven't you spoken a lying divination , in that you say , ' The LORD says ; ' but I have not spoken ? "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：「因你們說的是虛假，見的是謊詐，我就與你們反對。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " ' Therefore the Lord GOD says : " Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies , therefore , behold , I am against you , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我的手必攻擊那見虛假異象、用謊詐占卜的先知，他們必不列在我百姓的會中，不錄在以色列家的冊上，也不進入以色列地；你們就知道我是主耶和華。
verses.e: " My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations . They will not be in the council of my people , neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel , neither will they enter into the land of Israel . Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 有幾個以色列長老到我這裏來，坐在我面前。
verses.e: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me .

verses.z: 他們必擔當自己的罪孽。先知的罪孽和求問之人的罪孽都是一樣，
verses.e: They will bear their iniquity . The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him ,

verses.z: 好使以色列家不再走迷離開我，不再因各樣的罪過玷污自己，只要作我的子民，我作他們的上帝。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me , neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions ; but that they may be my people , and I may be their God , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，若有一國犯罪干犯我，我也向他伸手折斷他們的杖，就是斷絕他們的糧，使饑荒臨到那地，將人與牲畜從其中剪除；
verses.e: " Son of man , when a land sins against me by committing a trespass , and I stretch out my hand on it , and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it , and cut off from it man and animal —

verses.z: 其中雖有挪亞、但以理、約伯這三人，他們只能因他們的義救自己的性命。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: though these three men , Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我若使惡獸經過糟踐那地，使地荒涼，以致因這些獸，人都不得經過；
verses.e: " If I cause evil animals to pass through the land , and they ravage it and it is made desolate , so that no man may pass through because of the animals —

verses.z: 雖有這三人在其中，主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，他們連兒帶女都不能得救，只能自己得救，那地仍然荒涼。
verses.e: though these three men were in it , as I live , " says the Lord GOD , " they would deliver neither sons nor daughters . They only would be delivered , but the land would be desolate .

verses.z: 或者我使刀劍臨到那地，說：刀劍哪，要經過那地，以致我將人與牲畜從其中剪除；
verses.e: " Or if I bring a sword on that land , and say , ' Sword , go through the land , so that I cut off from it man and animal ' —

verses.z: 雖有這三人在其中，主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，他們連兒帶女都不能得救，只能自己得救。
verses.e: though these three men were in it , as I live , " says the Lord GOD , " they would deliver neither sons nor daughters , but they only would be delivered themselves .

verses.z: 或者我叫瘟疫流行那地，使我滅命的忿怒傾在其上，好將人與牲畜從其中剪除；
verses.e: " Or if I send a pestilence into that land , and pour out my wrath on it in blood , to cut off from it man and animal —

verses.z: 耶和華的話就臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 雖有挪亞、但以理、約伯在其中，主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，他們連兒帶女都不能救，只能因他們的義救自己的性命。」
verses.e: though Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , as I live , " says the Lord GOD , " they would deliver neither son nor daughter ; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「我將這四樣大災－就是刀劍、饑荒、惡獸、瘟疫降在耶路撒冷，將人與牲畜從其中剪除，豈不更重嗎？
verses.e: For the Lord GOD says : " How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem — the sword , the famine , the evil animals , and the pestilence — to cut off from it man and animal !

verses.z: 然而其中必有剩下的人，他們連兒帶女必帶到你們這裏來，你們看見他們所行所為的，要因我降給耶路撒冷的一切災禍，便得了安慰。
verses.e: Yet , behold , there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out , both sons and daughters . Behold , they will come out to you , and you will see their way and their doings . Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem , even concerning all that I have brought on it .

verses.z: 你們看見他們所行所為的，得了安慰，就知道我在耶路撒冷中所行的並非無故。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: They will comfort you , when you see their way and their doings ; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「人子啊，這些人已將他們的假神接到心裏，把陷於罪的絆腳石放在面前，我豈能絲毫被他們求問嗎？
verses.e: " Son of man , these men have taken their idols into their heart , and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face . Should I be inquired of at all by them ?

verses.z: 所以你要告訴他們：『主耶和華如此說：以色列家的人中，凡將他的假神接到心裏，把陷於罪的絆腳石放在面前，又就了先知來的，我－耶和華在他所求的事上，必按他眾多的假神回答他，
verses.e: Therefore speak to them and tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet , I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols ,

verses.z: 好在以色列家的心事上捉住他們，因為他們都藉着假神與我生疏。』
verses.e: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart , because they are all estranged from me through their idols . " '

verses.z: 「所以你要告訴以色列家說：『主耶和華如此說：回頭吧！離開你們的偶像，轉臉莫從你們一切可憎的事。』
verses.e: " Therefore tell the house of Israel , ' The Lord GOD says : " Return , and turn yourselves from your idols ! Turn away your faces from all your abominations .

verses.z: 因為以色列家的人，或在以色列中寄居的外人，凡與我隔絕，將他的假神接到心裏，把陷於罪的絆腳石放在面前，又就了先知來要為自己的事求問我的，我－耶和華必親自回答他。
verses.e: " ' " For everyone of the house of Israel , or of the strangers who live in Israel , who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart , and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face , and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me , I the LORD will answer him by myself .

verses.z: 我必向那人變臉，使他作了警戒，笑談，令人驚駭，並且我要將他從我民中剪除；你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment , for a sign and a proverb , and I will cut him off from among my people . Then you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 先知若被迷惑說一句預言，是我－耶和華任那先知受迷惑，我也必向他伸手，將他從我民以色列中除滅。
verses.e: " ' " If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word , I , the LORD , have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand on him , and will destroy him from among my people Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，葡萄樹比別樣樹有甚麼強處？葡萄枝比眾樹枝有甚麼好處？
verses.e: " Son of man , what is the vine tree more than any tree , the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest ?

verses.z: 其上可以取木料做甚麼工用，可以取來做釘子掛甚麼器皿嗎？
verses.e: Will wood be taken of it to make anything ? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it ?

verses.z: 看哪，已經拋在火中當作柴燒，火既燒了兩頭，中間也被燒了，還有益於工用嗎？
verses.e: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel ; the fire has devoured both its ends , and the middle of it is burned . Is it profitable for any work ?

verses.z: 完全的時候尚且不合乎甚麼工用，何況被火燒壞，還能合乎甚麼工用嗎？」
verses.e: Behold , when it was whole , it was suitable for no work . How much less , when the fire has devoured it , and it has been burned , will it yet be suitable for any work ? "

verses.z: 所以，主耶和華如此說：「眾樹以內的葡萄樹，我怎樣使它在火中當柴，也必照樣待耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says : " As the vine wood among the trees of the forest , which I have given to the fire for fuel , so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 我必向他們變臉；他們雖從火中出來，火卻要燒滅他們。我向他們變臉的時候，你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will set my face against them . They will go out from the fire , but the fire will still devour them . Then you will know that I am the LORD , when I set my face against them .

verses.z: 我必使地土荒涼，因為他們行事干犯我。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I will make the land desolate , because they have acted unfaithfully , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Again the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 我也使你身穿繡花衣服，腳穿海狗皮鞋，並用細麻布給你束腰，用絲綢為衣披在你身上，
verses.e: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you . I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk .

verses.z: 又用妝飾打扮你，將鐲子戴在你手上，將金鍊戴在你項上。
verses.e: I decked you with ornaments , put bracelets on your hands , and put a chain on your neck .

verses.z: 我也將環子戴在你鼻子上，將耳環戴在你耳朵上，將華冠戴在你頭上。
verses.e: I put a ring on your nose , earrings in your ears , and a beautiful crown on your head .

verses.z: 這樣，你就有金銀的妝飾，穿的是細麻衣和絲綢，並繡花衣；吃的是細麵、蜂蜜，並油。你也極其美貌，發達到王后的尊榮。
verses.e: Thus you were decked with gold and silver . Your clothing was of fine linen , silk , and embroidered work . You ate fine flour , honey , and oil . You were exceedingly beautiful , and you prospered to royal estate .

verses.z: 你美貌的名聲傳在列邦中，你十分美貌，是因我加在你身上的威榮。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty ; for it was perfect , through my majesty which I had put on you , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「只是你仗着自己的美貌，又因你的名聲就行邪淫。你縱情淫亂，使過路的任意而行。
verses.e: " ' " But you trusted in your beauty , and played the prostitute because of your renown , and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by . It was his .

verses.z: 你用衣服為自己在高處結彩，在其上行邪淫。[這樣的事]將來必沒有，也必不再行了。
verses.e: You took some of your garments , and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors , and played the prostitute on them . This shouldn't happen , neither shall it be .

verses.z: 你又將我所給你那華美的金銀、寶器為自己製造人像，與他行邪淫；
verses.e: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver , which I had given you , and made for yourself images of men , and played the prostitute with them .

verses.z: 又用你的繡花衣服給他披上，並將我的膏油和香料擺在他跟前；
verses.e: You took your embroidered garments , covered them , and set my oil and my incense before them .

verses.z: 又將我賜給你的食物，就是我賜給你吃的細麵、油，和蜂蜜，都擺在他跟前為馨香[的供物]。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: My bread also which I gave you , fine flour , oil , and honey , with which I fed you , you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma ; and so it was , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要使耶路撒冷知道她那些可憎的事，
verses.e: " Son of man , cause Jerusalem to know her abominations ;

verses.z: 並且你將給我所生的兒女焚獻給他。
verses.e: " ' " Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters , whom you have borne to me , and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured . Was your prostitution a small matter ,

verses.z: 你行淫亂豈是小事，竟將我的兒女殺了，使他們經[火]歸與他嗎？
verses.e: that you have slain my children and delivered them up , in causing them to pass through the fire to them ?

verses.z: 你行這一切可憎和淫亂的事，並未追念你幼年赤身露體滾在血中的日子。」
verses.e: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth , when you were naked and bare , and were wallowing in your blood .

verses.z: 「你行這一切惡事之後（主耶和華說：你有禍了！有禍了！）
verses.e: " ' " It has happened after all your wickedness — woe , woe to you ! " says the Lord GOD —

verses.z: 又為自己建造圓頂花樓，在各街上做了高臺。
verses.e: " that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place , and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street .

verses.z: 你在一切市口上建造高臺，使你的美貌變為可憎的，又與一切過路的多行淫亂。
verses.e: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way , and have made your beauty an abomination , and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by , and multiplied your prostitution .

verses.z: 你也和你鄰邦放縱情慾的埃及人行淫，加增你的淫亂，惹我發怒。
verses.e: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians , your neighbors , great of flesh ; and have multiplied your prostitution , to provoke me to anger .

verses.z: 因此我伸手攻擊你，減少你應用的[糧食]，又將你交給恨你的非利士眾女，使她們任意待你。她們見你的淫行，為你羞恥。
verses.e: See therefore , I have stretched out my hand over you , and have diminished your portion , and delivered you to the will of those who hate you , the daughters of the Philistines , who are ashamed of your lewd way .

verses.z: 你因貪色無厭，又與亞述人行淫，與他們行淫之後，仍不滿意，
verses.e: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians , because you were insatiable ; yes , you have played the prostitute with them , and yet you weren't satisfied .

verses.z: 並且多行淫亂，直到那貿易之地，就是迦勒底，你仍不滿意。
verses.e: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants , to Chaldea ; and yet you weren't satisfied with this .

verses.z: 說主耶和華對耶路撒冷如此說：你根本，你出世，是在迦南地；你父親是亞摩利人，你母親是赫人。
verses.e: and say , ' The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem : " Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite . An Amorite was your father , and your mother was a Hittite .

verses.z: 「主耶和華說：你行這一切事，都是不知羞恥妓女所行的，可見你的心是何等懦弱！
verses.e: " ' " How weak is your heart , " says the Lord GOD , " since you do all these things , the work of an impudent prostitute ;

verses.z: 因你在一切市口上建造圓頂花樓，在各街上做了高臺，你卻藐視賞賜，不像妓女。
verses.e: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way , and make your lofty place in every street , and have not been as a prostitute , in that you scorn pay .

verses.z: 哎！你這行淫的妻啊，寧肯接外人，不接丈夫。
verses.e: " ' " Adulterous wife , who takes strangers instead of her husband !

verses.z: 凡妓女是得人贈送，你反倒贈送你所愛的人，賄賂他們從四圍來與你行淫。
verses.e: People give gifts to all prostitutes ; but you give your gifts to all your lovers , and bribe them , that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution .

verses.z: 你行淫與[別的]婦女相反，因為不是人從你行淫；你既贈送人，人並不贈送你；所以你與別的婦女相反。」
verses.e: You are different from other women in your prostitution , in that no one follows you to play the prostitute ; and whereas you give hire , and no hire is given to you , therefore you are different . " '

verses.z: 「你這妓女啊，要聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: " Therefore , prostitute , hear the LORD's word :

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：因你的污穢傾洩了，你與你所愛的行淫露出下體，又因你拜一切可憎的偶像，流兒女的血獻給他，
verses.e: ' The Lord GOD says , " Because your filthiness was poured out , and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers ; and because of all the idols of your abominations , and for the blood of your children , that you gave to them ;

verses.z: 我就要將你一切相歡相愛的和你一切所恨的都聚集來，從四圍攻擊你；又將你的下體露出，使他們看盡了。
verses.e: therefore see , I will gather all your lovers , with whom you have taken pleasure , and all those whom you have loved , with all those whom you have hated . I will even gather them against you on every side , and will uncover your nakedness to them , that they may see all your nakedness .

verses.z: 我也要審判你，好像[官長]審判淫婦和流人血的婦女一樣。我因忿怒忌恨，使流血的罪歸到你身上。
verses.e: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged ; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy .

verses.z: 我又要將你交在他們手中；他們必拆毀你的圓頂花樓，毀壞你的高臺，剝去你的衣服，奪取你的華美寶器，留下你赤身露體。
verses.e: I will also give you into their hand , and they will throw down your vaulted place , and break down your lofty places . They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels . They will leave you naked and bare .

verses.z: 論到你出世的景況，在你初生的日子沒有為你斷臍帶，也沒有用水洗你，使你潔淨，絲毫沒有撒鹽在你身上，也沒有用布裹你。
verses.e: As for your birth , in the day you were born your navel was not cut . You weren't washed in water to cleanse you . You weren't salted at all , nor wrapped in blankets at all .

verses.z: 他們也必帶多人來攻擊你，用石頭打死你，用刀劍刺透你，
verses.e: They will also bring up a company against you , and they will stone you with stones , and thrust you through with their swords .

verses.z: 用火焚燒你的房屋，在許多婦人眼前向你施行審判。我必使你不再行淫，也不再贈送與人。
verses.e: They will burn your houses with fire , and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women . I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute , and you will also give no hire any more .

verses.z: 這樣，我就止息向你發的忿怒，我的忌恨也要離開你，我要安靜不再惱怒。
verses.e: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest , and my jealousy will depart from you . I will be quiet , and will not be angry any more .

verses.z: 因你不追念你幼年的日子，在這一切的事上向我發烈怒，所以我必照你所行的報應在你頭上，你就不再貪淫，行那一切可憎的事。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: " ' " Because you have not remembered the days of your youth , but have raged against me in all these things ; therefore , behold , I also will bring your way on your head , " says the Lord GOD : " and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations .

verses.z: 「凡說俗語的必用俗語攻擊你，說：『母親怎樣，女兒也怎樣。』
verses.e: " ' " Behold , everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you , saying , ' As is the mother , so is her daughter . '

verses.z: 你正是你母親的女兒，厭棄丈夫和兒女；你正是你姊妹的姊妹，厭棄丈夫和兒女。你母親是赫人，你父親是亞摩利人。
verses.e: You are the daughter of your mother , who loathes her husband and her children ; and you are the sister of your sisters , who loathed their husbands and their children . Your mother was a Hittite , and your father an Amorite .

verses.z: 你的姊姊是撒馬利亞，她和她的眾女住在你左邊；你的妹妹是所多瑪，她和她的眾女住在你右邊。
verses.e: Your elder sister is Samaria , who dwells at your left hand , she and her daughters ; and your younger sister , who dwells at your right hand , is Sodom with her daughters .

verses.z: 你沒有效法她們的行為，也沒有照她們可憎的事去做，你以那為小事，你一切所行的倒比她們更壞。
verses.e: Yet you have not walked in their ways , nor done their abominations ; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，你妹妹所多瑪與她的眾女尚未行你和你眾女所行的事。
verses.e: As I live , " says the Lord GOD , " Sodom your sister has not done , she nor her daughters , as you have done , you and your daughters .

verses.z: 看哪，你妹妹所多瑪的罪孽是這樣：她和她的眾女都心驕氣傲，糧食飽足，大享安逸，並沒有扶助困苦和窮乏人的手。
verses.e: " ' " Behold , this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom : pride , fullness of bread , and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters . She also didn't strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .

verses.z: 誰的眼也不可憐你，為你做一件這樣的事憐恤你；但你初生的日子扔在田野，是因你被厭惡。
verses.e: No eye pitied you , to do any of these things to you , to have compassion on you ; but you were cast out in the open field , because you were abhorred in the day that you were born .

verses.z: 她們狂傲，在我面前行可憎的事，我看見便將她們除掉。
verses.e: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me . Therefore I took them away when I saw it .

verses.z: 撒馬利亞沒有犯你一半的罪，你行可憎的事比她更多，使你的姊妹因你所行一切可憎的事，倒顯為義。
verses.e: Samaria hasn't committed half of your sins ; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they , and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done .

verses.z: 你既斷定你姊妹為義，就要擔當自己的羞辱；因你所犯的罪比她們更為可憎，她們就比你更顯為義；你既使你的姊妹顯為義，你就要抱愧擔當自己的羞辱。」
verses.e: You also bear your own shame yourself , in that you have given judgment for your sisters ; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they , they are more righteous than you . Yes , be also confounded , and bear your shame , in that you have justified your sisters .

verses.z: 「我必叫她們被擄的歸回，就是叫所多瑪和她的眾女，撒馬利亞和她的眾女，並你們中間被擄的，都要歸回，
verses.e: " ' " I will reverse their captivity , the captivity of Sodom and her daughters , and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters , and the captivity of your captives among them ;

verses.z: 好使你擔當自己的羞辱，並因你一切所行的使她們得安慰，你就抱愧。
verses.e: that you may bear your own shame , and may be ashamed because of all that you have done , in that you are a comfort to them .

verses.z: 你的妹妹所多瑪和她的眾女必歸回原位；撒馬利亞和她的眾女，你和你的眾女，也必歸回原位。
verses.e: Your sisters , Sodom and her daughters , will return to their former estate ; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate ; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate .

verses.z: 在你驕傲的日子，你的惡行沒有顯露以先，你的口就不提你的妹妹所多瑪。那受了凌辱的亞蘭眾女和亞蘭四圍非利士的眾女都恨惡你，藐視你。
verses.e: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride ,
before your wickedness was uncovered , as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria , and of all who are around her , the daughters of the Philistines , who despise you all around .

verses.z: 耶和華說：你貪淫和可憎的事，你已經擔當了。」
verses.e: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 「主耶和華如此說：你這輕看誓言、背棄盟約的，我必照你所行的待你。
verses.e: " ' For the Lord GOD says : " I will also deal with you as you have done , who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant .

verses.z: 「我從你旁邊經過，見你滾在血中，就對你說：[你雖]在血中，仍可存活；[你雖]在血中，仍可存活。
verses.e: " ' " When I passed by you , and saw you wallowing in your blood , I said to you , ' Though you are in your blood , live ! ' Yes , I said to you , ' Though you are in your blood , live ! '

verses.z: 然而我要追念在你幼年時與你所立的約，也要與你立定永約。
verses.e: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth , and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you .

verses.z: 你接待你姊姊和你妹妹的時候，你要追念你所行的，自覺慚愧；並且我要將她們賜你為女兒，卻不是按着前約。
verses.e: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters , your elder sisters and your younger ; and I will give them to you for daughters , but not by your covenant .

verses.z: 我要堅定與你所立的約（你就知道我是耶和華），
verses.e: I will establish my covenant with you . Then you will know that I am the LORD ;

verses.z: 好使你在我赦免你一切所行的時候，心裏追念，自覺抱愧，又因你的羞辱就不再開口。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: that you may remember , and be confounded , and never open your mouth any more because of your shame , when I have forgiven you all that you have done , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 我使你生長好像田間所長的，你就漸漸長大，以致極其俊美，兩乳成形，頭髮長成，你卻仍然赤身露體。
verses.e: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field , and you increased and grew great , and you attained to excellent beauty . Your breasts were formed , and your hair grew ; yet you were naked and bare .

verses.z: 「我從你旁邊經過，看見你的時候正動愛情，便用衣襟搭在你身上，遮蓋你的赤體；又向你起誓，與你結盟，你就歸於我。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " ' " Now when I passed by you , and looked at you , behold , your time was the time of love ; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness . Yes , I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you , " says the Lord GOD , " and you became mine .

verses.z: 那時我用水洗你，洗淨你身上的血，又用油抹你。
verses.e: " ' " Then I washed you with water . Yes , I thoroughly washed away your blood from you , and I anointed you with oil .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 葡萄樹雖然栽種，豈能發旺呢？一經東風，豈不全然枯乾嗎？必在生長的畦中枯乾了。」
verses.e: Yes , behold , being planted , will it prosper ? Won't it utterly wither when the east wind touches it ? It will wither in the ground where it grew . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「你對那悖逆之家說：你們不知道這些事是甚麼意思嗎？你要告訴他們說，巴比倫王曾到耶路撒冷，將其中的君王和首領帶到巴比倫自己那裏去。
verses.e: " Say now to the rebellious house , ' Don't you know what these things mean ? ' Tell them , ' Behold , the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem , and took its king , and its princes , and brought them to him to Babylon .

verses.z: 從以色列的宗室中取一人與他立約，使他發誓，並將國中有勢力的人擄去，
verses.e: He took one of the royal offspring , and made a covenant with him . He also brought him under an oath , and took away the mighty of the land ,

verses.z: 使國低微不能自強，惟因守盟約得以存立。
verses.e: that the kingdom might be brought low , that it might not lift itself up , but that by keeping his covenant it might stand .

verses.z: 他卻背叛巴比倫王，打發使者往埃及去，要他們給他馬匹和多民。他豈能亨通呢？行這樣事的人豈能逃脫呢？他背約豈能逃脫呢？
verses.e: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt , that they might give him horses and many people . Will he prosper ? Will he who does such things escape ? Will he break the covenant , and still escape ?

verses.z: 他輕看向王所起的誓，背棄王與他所立的約。主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，他定要死在立他作王、巴比倫王的京都。
verses.e: " ' As I live , ' says the Lord GOD , ' surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king , whose oath he despised , and whose covenant he broke , even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die .

verses.z: 敵人築壘造臺，與他打仗的時候，為要剪除多人，法老雖領大軍隊和大群眾，還是不能幫助他。
verses.e: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won't help him in the war , when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons .

verses.z: 他輕看誓言，背棄盟約，已經投降，卻又做這一切的事，他必不能逃脫。」
verses.e: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant ; and behold , he had given his hand , and yet has done all these things . He won't escape .

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：「我指着我的永生起誓，他既輕看指我所起的誓，背棄指我所立的約，我必要使這罪歸在他頭上。
verses.e: " Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' As I live , I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要向以色列家出謎語，設比喻，
verses.e: " Son of man , tell a riddle , and speak a parable to the house of Israel ;

verses.z: 我必將我的網撒在他身上，他必在我的網羅中纏住。我必帶他到巴比倫，並要在那裏因他干犯我的罪刑罰他。
verses.e: I will spread my net on him , and he will be taken in my snare . I will bring him to Babylon , and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me .

verses.z: 他的一切軍隊，凡逃跑的，都必倒在刀下；所剩下的，也必分散四方。你們就知道說這話的是我－耶和華。」
verses.e: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword , and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind . Then you will know that I , the LORD , have spoken it . '

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「我要將香柏樹梢擰去栽上，就是從儘尖的嫩枝中折一嫩枝，栽於極高的山上；
verses.e: " The Lord GOD says : ' I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar , and will plant it . I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one , and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain .

verses.z: 在以色列高處的山栽上。它就生枝子，結果子，成為佳美的香柏樹，各類飛鳥都必宿在其下，就是宿在枝子的蔭下。
verses.e: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel ; and it will produce boughs , and bear fruit , and be a good cedar . Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches .

verses.z: 田野的樹木都必知道我－耶和華使高樹矮小，矮樹高大；青樹枯乾，枯樹發旺。我－耶和華如此說，也如此行了。」
verses.e: All the trees of the field will know that I , the LORD , have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree flourish . " ' I , the LORD , have spoken and have done it . ' "

verses.z: 說主耶和華如此說：有一大鷹，翅膀大，翎毛長，羽毛豐滿，彩色俱備，來到黎巴嫩，將香柏樹梢擰去，
verses.e: and say , ' The Lord GOD says : " A great eagle with great wings and long feathers , full of feathers which had various colors , came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar .

verses.z: 就是折去香柏樹儘尖的嫩枝，叼到貿易之地，放在買賣城中；
verses.e: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs , and carried it to a land of traffic . He planted it in a city of merchants .

verses.z: 又將以色列地的枝子栽於肥田裏，插在大水旁，如插柳樹，
verses.e: " ' " He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil . He placed it beside many waters . He set it as a willow tree .

verses.z: 就漸漸生長，成為蔓延矮小的葡萄樹。其枝轉向那鷹，其根在鷹以下，於是成了葡萄樹，生出枝子，發出小枝。
verses.e: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature , whose branches turned toward him , and its roots were under him . So it became a vine , produced branches , and shot out sprigs .

verses.z: 「又有一大鷹，翅膀大，羽毛多。這葡萄樹從栽種的畦中向這鷹彎過根來，發出枝子，好得它的澆灌。
verses.e: " ' " There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers . Behold , this vine bent its roots toward him , and shot out its branches toward him , from the ground where it was planted , that he might water it .

verses.z: 這樹栽於肥田多水的旁邊，好生枝子，結果子，成為佳美的葡萄樹。
verses.e: It was planted in a good soil by many waters , that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit , that it might be a good vine . " '

verses.z: 你要說，主耶和華如此說：這葡萄樹豈能發旺呢？鷹豈不拔出它的根來，芟除它的果子，使它枯乾，使它發的嫩葉都枯乾了嗎？也不用大力和多民，就拔出它的根來。
verses.e: " Say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Will it prosper ? Won't he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit , that it may wither , that all its fresh springing leaves may wither ? It can't be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me again , saying ,

verses.z: 「他若生一個兒子，作強盜，是流人血的，不行以上所說之善，反行其中之惡，乃在山上吃過[祭偶像之物]，並玷污鄰舍的妻，
verses.e: " If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood , and who does any one of these things ,
or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor's wife ,

verses.z: 虧負困苦和窮乏的人，搶奪人的物，未曾將當頭還給人，仰望偶像，並行可憎的事，
verses.e: has wronged the poor and needy , has taken by robbery , has not restored the pledge , and has lifted up his eyes to the idols , has committed abomination ,

verses.z: 向借錢的[弟兄]取利，向借糧的弟兄多要－這人豈能存活呢？他必不能存活。他行這一切可憎的事，必要死亡，他的罪必歸到他身上。
verses.e: has lent with interest , and has taken increase from the poor , shall he then live ? He shall not live . He has done all these abominations . He shall surely die . His blood will be on him .

verses.z: 「他若生一個兒子，見父親所犯的一切罪便懼怕，不照樣去做；
verses.e: " Now , behold , if he fathers a son who sees all his father's sins which he has done , and fears , and doesn't do likewise ,
