verses.z: 未曾在山上吃過[祭偶像之物]，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污鄰舍的妻，
verses.e: who hasn't eaten on the mountains , hasn't lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , hasn't defiled his neighbor's wife ,

verses.z: 未曾虧負人，未曾取人的當頭，未曾搶奪人的物件，卻將食物給飢餓的人吃，將衣服給赤身的人穿，
verses.e: hasn't wronged any , hasn't taken anything to pledge , hasn't taken by robbery , but has given his bread to the hungry , and has covered the naked with a garment ;

verses.z: 縮手不害貧窮人，未曾向借錢的[弟兄]取利，也未曾向借糧的[弟兄]多要；他順從我的典章，遵行我的律例，就不因父親的罪孽死亡，定要存活。
verses.e: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor , who hasn't received interest or increase , has executed my ordinances , has walked in my statutes ; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father . He shall surely live .

verses.z: 至於他父親；因為欺人太甚，搶奪弟兄，在本國的民中行不善，他必因自己的罪孽死亡。
verses.e: As for his father , because he cruelly oppressed , robbed his brother , and did that which is not good among his people , behold , he will die in his iniquity .

verses.z: 「你們還說：『兒子為何不擔當父親的罪孽呢？』兒子行正直與合理的事，謹守遵行我的一切律例，他必定存活。
verses.e: " Yet you say , ' Why doesn't the son bear the iniquity of the father ? ' When the son has done that which is lawful and right , and has kept all my statutes , and has done them , he will surely live .

verses.z: 「你們在以色列地怎麼用這俗語說『父親吃了酸葡萄，兒子的牙酸倒了』呢？」
verses.e: " What do you mean , that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel , saying , ' The fathers have eaten sour grapes , and the children's teeth are set on edge ' ?

verses.z: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。兒子必不擔當父親的罪孽，父親也不擔當兒子的罪孽。義人的善果必歸自己，惡人的惡報也必歸自己。
verses.e: The soul who sins , he shall die . The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father , neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son . The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him , and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him .

verses.z: 「惡人若回頭離開所做的一切罪惡，謹守我一切的律例，行正直與合理的事，他必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.e: " But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed , and keeps all my statutes , and does that which is lawful and right , he shall surely live . He shall not die .

verses.z: 他所犯的一切罪過都不被記念，因所行的義，他必存活。
verses.e: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him . In his righteousness that he has done , he shall live .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：惡人死亡，豈是我喜悅的嗎？不是喜悅他回頭離開所行的道存活嗎？
verses.e: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked ? " says the Lord GOD , " and not rather that he should return from his way , and live ?

verses.z: 義人若轉離義行而作罪孽，照着惡人所行一切可憎的事而行，他豈能存活嗎？他所行的一切義都不被記念；他必因所犯的罪、所行的惡死亡。
verses.e: " But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness , and commits iniquity , and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does , should he live ? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered . In his trespass that he has trespassed , and in his sin that he has sinned , in them he shall die .

verses.z: 「你們還說：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，你們當聽，我的道豈不公平嗎？你們的道豈不是不公平嗎？
verses.e: " Yet you say , ' The way of the Lord is not equal . ' Hear now , house of Israel : Is my way not equal ? Aren't your ways unequal ?

verses.z: 義人若轉離義行而作罪孽死亡，他是因所作的罪孽死亡。
verses.e: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness , and commits iniquity , and dies in it , then he dies in his iniquity that he has done .

verses.z: 再者，惡人若回頭離開所行的惡，行正直與合理的事，他必將性命救活了。
verses.e: Again , when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed , and does that which is lawful and right , he will save his soul alive .

verses.z: 因為他思量，回頭離開所犯的一切罪過，必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.e: Because he considers , and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed , he shall surely live . He shall not die .

verses.z: 以色列家還說：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，我的道豈不公平嗎？你們的道豈不是不公平嗎？」
verses.e: Yet the house of Israel says , ' The way of the Lord is not fair . ' House of Israel , aren't my ways fair ? Aren't your ways unfair ?

verses.z: 主耶和華說：「我指着我的永生起誓，你們在以色列中，必不再有用這俗語的[因由]。
verses.e: " As I live , " says the Lord GOD , " you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel .

verses.z: 所以主耶和華說：「以色列家啊，我必按你們各人所行的審判你們。你們當回頭離開所犯的一切罪過。這樣，罪孽必不使你們敗亡。
verses.e: " Therefore I will judge you , house of Israel , everyone according to his ways , " says the Lord GOD . " Return , and turn yourselves from all your transgressions , so iniquity will not be your ruin .

verses.z: 你們要將所犯的一切罪過盡行拋棄，自做一個新心和新靈。以色列家啊，你們何必死亡呢？
verses.e: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed ; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit . For why will you die , house of Israel ?

verses.z: 主耶和華說：我不喜悅那死人之死，所以你們當回頭而存活。」
verses.e: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies , " says the Lord GOD . " Therefore turn yourselves , and live !

verses.z: 看哪，世人都是屬我的；為父的怎樣屬我，為子的也照樣屬我；犯罪的，他必死亡。
verses.e: Behold , all souls are mine ; as the soul of the father , so also the soul of the son is mine . The soul who sins , he shall die .

verses.z: 「人若是公義，且行正直與合理的事：
verses.e: " But if a man is just , and does that which is lawful and right ,

verses.z: 未曾在山上吃過[祭偶像之物]，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污鄰舍的妻，未曾在婦人的經期內親近她，
verses.e: and has not eaten on the mountains , hasn't lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , hasn't defiled his neighbor's wife , hasn't come near a woman in her impurity ,

verses.z: 未曾虧負人，乃將欠債之人的當頭還給他；未曾搶奪人的物件，卻將食物給飢餓的人吃，將衣服給赤身的人穿；
verses.e: and has not wronged any , but has restored to the debtor his pledge , has taken nothing by robbery , has given his bread to the hungry , and has covered the naked with a garment ;

verses.z: 未曾向借錢的[弟兄]取利，也未曾向借糧的[弟兄]多要，縮手不作罪孽，在兩人之間，按至理判斷；
verses.e: he who hasn't lent to them with interest , hasn't taken any increase from them , who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity , has executed true justice between man and man ,

verses.z: 遵行我的律例，謹守我的典章，按誠實行事－這人是公義的，必定存活。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: has walked in my statutes , and has kept my ordinances , to deal truly ; he is just , he shall surely live , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 你當為以色列的王作起哀歌，
verses.e: " Moreover , take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel ,

verses.z: 你的母親先前如葡萄樹，極其茂盛，栽於水旁。因為水多，就多結果子，滿生枝子；
verses.e: " ' Your mother was like a vine in your blood , planted by the waters . It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters .

verses.z: 生出堅固的枝幹，可作掌權者的杖。這枝幹高舉在茂密的枝中，而且它生長高大，枝子繁多，[遠遠]可見。
verses.e: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled . Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs . They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches .

verses.z: 但這葡萄樹因忿怒被拔出摔在地上；東風吹乾其上的果子，堅固的枝幹折斷枯乾，被火燒毀了；
verses.e: But it was plucked up in fury . It was cast down to the ground , and the east wind dried up its fruit . Its strong branches were broken off and withered . The fire consumed them .

verses.z: 如今栽於曠野乾旱無水之地。
verses.e: Now it is planted in the wilderness , in a dry and thirsty land .

verses.z: 火也從它枝幹中發出，燒滅果子，以致沒有堅固的枝幹可做掌權者的杖。這是哀歌，也必用以作哀歌。
verses.e: Fire has gone out of its branches . It has devoured its fruit , so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule . ' This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation . "

verses.z: 說：你的母親是甚麼呢？是個母獅子，蹲伏在獅子中間，在少壯獅子中養育小獅子。
verses.e: and say , ' What was your mother ? A lioness . She couched among lions , in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs .

verses.z: 在牠小獅子中養大一個，成了少壯獅子，學會抓食而吃人。
verses.e: She brought up one of her cubs . He became a young lion . He learned to catch the prey . He devoured men .

verses.z: 列國聽見了就把牠捉在他們的坑中，用鉤子拉到埃及地去。
verses.e: The nations also heard of him . He was taken in their pit ; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 母獅見自己等候失了指望，就從牠小獅子中又將一個養為少壯獅子。
verses.e: " ' Now when she saw that she had waited , and her hope was lost , then she took another of her cubs , and made him a young lion .

verses.z: 牠在眾獅子中走來走去，成了少壯獅子，學會抓食而吃人。
verses.e: He went up and down among the lions . He became a young lion . He learned to catch the prey . He devoured men .

verses.z: 牠知道列國的宮殿，又使他們的城邑變為荒場；因牠咆哮的聲音，遍地和其中所有的就都荒廢。
verses.e: He knew their palaces , and laid waste their cities . The land was desolate with its fullness , because of the noise of his roaring .

verses.z: 於是四圍邦國各省的人來攻擊牠，將網撒在牠身上，捉在他們的坑中。
verses.e: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces . They spread their net over him . He was taken in their pit .

verses.z: 他們用鉤子鉤住牠，將牠放在籠中，帶到巴比倫王那裏，將牠放入堅固之所，使牠的聲音在以色列山上不再聽見。
verses.e: They put him in a cage with hooks , and brought him to the king of Babylon . They brought him into strongholds , so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，你站起來，我要和你說話。」
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , stand on your feet , and I will speak with you . "

verses.z: 他將書卷在我面前展開，內外都寫着字，其上所寫的有哀號、歎息、悲痛的話。
verses.e: He spread it before me . It was written within and without ; and lamentations , mourning , and woe were written in it .

verses.z: 他對我說話的時候，靈就進入我裏面，使我站起來，我便聽見那位對我說話的[聲音]。
verses.e: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me , and set me on my feet ; and I heard him who spoke to me .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，我差你往悖逆的國民以色列人那裏去。他們是悖逆我的，他們和他們的列祖違背我，直到今日。
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , I send you to the children of Israel , to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me . They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day .

verses.z: 這眾子面無羞恥，心裏剛硬。我差你往他們那裏去，你要對他們說：主耶和華如此說。
verses.e: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted . I am sending you to them , and you shall tell them , ' This is what the Lord GOD says . '

verses.z: 他們或聽，或不聽，（他們是悖逆之家），必知道在他們中間有了先知。
verses.e: They , whether they will hear , or whether they will refuse — for they are a rebellious house — yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them .

verses.z: 人子啊，雖有荊棘和蒺藜在你那裏，你又住在蠍子中間，總不要怕他們，也不要怕他們的話；他們雖是悖逆之家，還不要怕他們的話，也不要因他們的臉色驚惶。
verses.e: You , son of man , don't be afraid of them , neither be afraid of their words , though briers and thorns are with you , and you dwell among scorpions . Don't be afraid of their words , nor be dismayed at their looks , though they are a rebellious house .

verses.z: 他們或聽，或不聽，你只管將我的話告訴他們；他們是極其悖逆的。
verses.e: You shall speak my words to them , whether they will hear or whether they will refuse ; for they are most rebellious .

verses.z: 「人子啊，要聽我對你所說的話，不要悖逆像那悖逆之家，你要開口吃我所賜給你的。」
verses.e: But you , son of man , hear what I tell you . Don't be rebellious like that rebellious house . Open your mouth , and eat that which I give you . "

verses.z: 我觀看，見有一隻手向我伸出來，手中有一書卷。
verses.e: When I looked , behold , a hand was stretched out to me ; and behold , a scroll of a book was in it .

verses.z: 第七年五[月]初十[日]，有以色列的幾個長老來求問耶和華，坐在我面前。
verses.e: In the seventh year , in the fifth month , the tenth day of the month , some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD , and sat before me .

verses.z: 這樣，我就使他們出埃及地，領他們到曠野，
verses.e: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness .

verses.z: 將我的律例賜給他們，將我的典章指示他們；人若遵行就必因此活着。
verses.e: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances , which if a man does , he will live in them .

verses.z: 又將我的安息日賜給他們，好在我與他們中間為證據，使他們知道我－耶和華是叫他們成為聖的。
verses.e: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths , to be a sign between me and them , that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them .

verses.z: 以色列家卻在曠野悖逆我，不順從我的律例，厭棄我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），大大干犯我的安息日。「我就說，要在曠野將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，滅絕他們。
verses.e: " ' " But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness . They didn't walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances , which if a man keeps , he shall live in them . They greatly profaned my Sabbaths . Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness , to consume them .

verses.z: 我卻為我名的緣故，沒有這樣行，免得我的名在我領他們出埃及的列國人眼前被褻瀆。
verses.e: But I worked for my name's sake , that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations , in whose sight I brought them out .

verses.z: 並且我在曠野向他們起誓，必不領他們進入我所賜給他們流奶與蜜之地（那地在萬國中是有榮耀的）；
verses.e: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands ,

verses.z: 因為他們厭棄我的典章，不順從我的律例，干犯我的安息日，他們的心隨從自己的偶像。
verses.e: because they rejected my ordinances , and didn't walk in my statutes , and profaned my Sabbaths ; for their heart went after their idols .

verses.z: 雖然如此，我眼仍顧惜他們，不毀滅他們，不在曠野將他們滅絕淨盡。
verses.e: Nevertheless my eye spared them , and I didn't destroy them . I didn't make a full end of them in the wilderness .

verses.z: 「我在曠野對他們的兒女說：不要遵行你們父親的律例，不要謹守他們的惡規，也不要因他們的偶像玷污自己。
verses.e: I said to their children in the wilderness , ' Don't walk in the statutes of your fathers . Don't observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols .

verses.z: 我是耶和華－你們的上帝，你們要順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章，
verses.e: I am the LORD your God . Walk in my statutes , keep my ordinances , and do them .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 且以我的安息日為聖。這日在我與你們中間為證據，使你們知道我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: Make my Sabbaths holy . They shall be a sign between me and you , that you may know that I am the LORD your God . '

verses.z: 只是[他們的]兒女悖逆我，不順從我的律例，也不謹守遵行我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），干犯我的安息日。「我就說，要將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，在曠野向他們成就我怒中所定的。
verses.e: " ' " But the children rebelled against me . They didn't walk in my statutes , and didn't keep my ordinances to do them , which if a man does , he shall live in them . They profaned my Sabbaths . Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them , to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness .

verses.z: 雖然如此，我卻為我名的緣故縮手沒有這樣行，免得我的名在我領他們出埃及的列國人眼前被褻瀆。
verses.e: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name's sake , that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations , in whose sight I brought them out .

verses.z: 並且我在曠野向他們起誓，必將他們分散在列國，四散在列邦；
verses.e: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness , that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries ,

verses.z: 因為他們不遵行我的典章，竟厭棄我的律例，干犯我的安息日，眼目仰望他們父親的偶像。
verses.e: because they had not executed my ordinances , but had rejected my statutes , and had profaned my Sabbaths , and their eyes were after their fathers ' idols .

verses.z: 我也任他們遵行不美的律例，謹守不能使人活着的惡規。
verses.e: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good , and ordinances in which they couldn't live .

verses.z: 因他們將一切頭生的經[火]，我就任憑他們在這供獻的事上玷污自己，好叫他們淒涼，使他們知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I polluted them in their own gifts , in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire , that I might make them desolate , to the end that they might know that I am the LORD . " '

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要告訴以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：你們的列祖在得罪我的事上褻瀆我；
verses.e: " Therefore , son of man , speak to the house of Israel , and tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " Moreover , in this your fathers have blasphemed me , in that they have committed a trespass against me .

verses.z: 因為我領他們到了我起誓應許賜給他們的地，他們看見各高山、各茂密樹，就在那裏獻祭，奉上惹我發怒的供物，也在那裏焚燒馨香的祭牲，並澆上奠祭。
verses.e: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them , then they saw every high hill and every thick tree , and they offered there their sacrifices , and there they presented the provocation of their offering . There they also made their pleasant aroma , and there they poured out their drink offerings .

verses.z: 我就對他們說：你們所上的那高處叫甚麼呢？（那高處的名字叫巴麻直到今日。）
verses.e: Then I said to them , ' What does the high place where you go mean ? ' So its name is called Bamah to this day . " '

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要告訴以色列的長老說，主耶和華如此說：你們來是求問我嗎？主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你們求問。
verses.e: " Son of man , speak to the elders of Israel , and tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " Is it to inquire of me that you have come ? As I live , " says the Lord GOD , " I will not be inquired of by you . " '

verses.z: 所以你要對以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：你們仍照你們列祖所行的玷污自己嗎？仍照他們可憎的事行邪淫嗎？
verses.e: " Therefore tell the house of Israel , ' The Lord GOD says : " Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers ? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations ?

verses.z: 你們奉上供物使你們兒子經火的時候，仍將一切偶像玷污自己，直到今日嗎？以色列家啊，我豈被你們求問嗎？主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你們求問。
verses.e: When you offer your gifts , when you make your sons pass through the fire , do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day ? Should I be inquired of by you , house of Israel ? As I live , says the Lord GOD , I will not be inquired of by you !

verses.z: 「你們說：我們要像外邦人和列國的宗族一樣，去事奉木頭與石頭。你們所起的這心意萬不能成就。」
verses.e: " ' " That which comes into your mind will not be at all , in that you say , ' We will be as the nations , as the families of the countries , to serve wood and stone . '

verses.z: 主耶和華說：「我指着我的永生起誓，我總要作王，用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並傾出來的忿怒，治理你們。
verses.e: As I live , " says the Lord GOD , " surely with a mighty hand , with an outstretched arm , and with wrath poured out , I will be king over you .

verses.z: 我必用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並傾出來的忿怒，將你們從萬民中領出來，從分散的列國內聚集你們。
verses.e: I will bring you out from the peoples , and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand , with an outstretched arm , and with wrath poured out .

verses.z: 我必帶你們到外邦人的曠野，在那裏當面刑罰你們。
verses.e: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples , and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face .

verses.z: 我怎樣在埃及地的曠野刑罰你們的列祖，也必照樣刑罰你們。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt , so I will enter into judgment with you , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我必使你們從杖下經過，使你們被約拘束。
verses.e: " I will cause you to pass under the rod , and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant .

verses.z: 我必從你們中間除淨叛逆和得罪我的人，將他們從所寄居的地方領出來，他們卻不得入以色列地。你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me . I will bring them out of the land where they live , but they shall not enter into the land of Israel . Then you will know that I am the LORD . "

verses.z: 「以色列家啊，至於你們，主耶和華如此說：從此以後若不聽從我，就任憑你們去事奉偶像，只是不可再因你們的供物和偶像褻瀆我的聖名。
verses.e: " ' As for you , house of Israel , the Lord GOD says : " Go , everyone serve his idols , and hereafter also , if you will not listen to me ; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols .

verses.z: 人子啊，你要審問審問他們嗎？你當使他們知道他們列祖那些可憎的事，
verses.e: " Will you judge them , son of man ? Will you judge them ? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers .

verses.z: 「主耶和華說：在我的聖山，就是以色列高處的山，所有以色列的全家都要事奉我。我要在那裏悅納你們，向你們要供物和初熟的土產，並一切的聖物。
verses.e: For in my holy mountain , in the mountain of the height of Israel , " says the Lord GOD , " there all the house of Israel , all of them , shall serve me in the land . There I will accept them , and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings , with all your holy things .

verses.z: 我從萬民中領你們出來，從分散的列國內聚集你們，那時我必悅納你們好像馨香之祭，要在外邦人眼前在你們身上顯為聖。
verses.e: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered . I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations .

verses.z: 我領你們進入以色列地，就是我起誓應許賜給你們列祖之地，那時你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel , into the country which I swore to give to your fathers .

verses.z: 你們在那裏要追念玷污自己的行動作為，又要因所做的一切惡事厭惡自己。
verses.e: There you will remember your ways , and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves . Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：以色列家啊，我為我名的緣故，不照着你們的惡行和你們的壞事待你們；你們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: You will know that I am the LORD , when I have dealt with you for my name's sake , not according to your evil ways , nor according to your corrupt doings , you house of Israel , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要面向南方，向南滴下預言攻擊南方田野的樹林。
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face toward the south , and preach toward the south , and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south .

verses.z: 對南方的樹林說，要聽耶和華的話。主耶和華如此說：我必使火在你中間着起，燒滅你中間的一切青樹和枯樹，猛烈的火焰必不熄滅。從南到北，人的臉面都被燒焦。
verses.e: Tell the forest of the south , ' Hear the LORD's word : The Lord GOD says , " Behold , I will kindle a fire in you , and it will devour every green tree in you , and every dry tree . The burning flame will not be quenched , and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it .

verses.z: 凡有血氣的都必知道是我－耶和華使火着起，這火必不熄滅。」
verses.e: All flesh will see that I , the LORD , have kindled it . It will not be quenched . " ' "

verses.z: 於是我說：「哎！主耶和華啊，人都指着我說：他豈不是說比喻的嗎？」
verses.e: Then I said , " Ah Lord GOD ! They say of me , ' Isn't he a speaker of parables ? ' "

verses.z: 對他們說，主耶和華如此說：當日我揀選以色列，向雅各家的後裔起誓，在埃及地將自己向他們顯現，說：我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: Tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " In the day when I chose Israel , and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob , and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt , when I swore to them , saying , ' I am the LORD your God ; '

verses.z: 那日我向他們起誓，必領他們出埃及地，到我為他們察看的流奶與蜜之地；那地在萬國中是有榮耀的。
verses.e: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands .

verses.z: 我對他們說，你們各人要拋棄眼所喜愛那可憎之物，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: I said to them , ' Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes . Don't defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt . I am the LORD your God . '

verses.z: 他們卻悖逆我，不肯聽從我，不拋棄他們眼所喜愛那可憎之物，不離棄埃及的偶像。「我就說，我要將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，在埃及地向他們成就我怒中所定的。
verses.e: " ' " But they rebelled against me and wouldn't listen to me . They didn't all throw away the abominations of their eyes . They also didn't forsake the idols of Egypt . Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them , to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 我卻為我名的緣故沒有這樣行，免得我名在他們所住的列國人眼前被褻瀆；我領他們出埃及地，在這列國人的眼前將自己向他們顯現。
verses.e: But I worked for my name's sake , that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were , in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 磨快為要行殺戮，擦亮為要像閃電。我們豈可快樂嗎？[罰]我子的杖藐視各樹。
verses.e: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter . It is polished that it may be as lightning . Should we then make mirth ? The rod of my son condemns every tree .

verses.z: 這刀已經交給人擦亮，為要應手使用。這刀已經磨快擦亮，好交在行殺戮的人手中。
verses.e: It is given to be polished , that it may be handled . The sword is sharpened . Yes , it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer . " '

verses.z: 人子啊，你要呼喊哀號，因為這刀臨到我的百姓和以色列一切的首領。他們和我的百姓都交在刀下，所以你要拍腿[歎息]。
verses.e: Cry and wail , son of man ; for it is on my people . It is on all the princes of Israel . They are delivered over to the sword with my people . Therefore beat your thigh .

verses.z: 有試驗的事；若那藐視的杖歸於無有，怎麼樣呢？這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " For there is a trial . What if even the rod that condemns will be no more ? " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要拍掌預言。我－[耶和華]要使這刀，就是致死傷的刀，一連三次加倍[刺人]，進入他們的內屋，使大人受死傷的就是這刀。
verses.e: " You therefore , son of man , prophesy , and strike your hands together . Let the sword be doubled the third time , the sword of the fatally wounded . It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded , which enters into their rooms .

verses.z: 我設立這恐嚇人的刀，攻擊他們的一切城門，使他們的心消化，加增他們跌倒的事。哎！這刀造得像閃電，磨得尖利，要行殺戮。
verses.e: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates , that their heart may melt , and their stumblings be multiplied . Ah ! It is made as lightning . It is pointed for slaughter .

verses.z: 刀啊，你歸在右邊，擺在左邊；你面向哪方，就向那方[殺戮]。
verses.e: Gather yourselves together . Go to the right . Set yourselves in array . Go to the left , wherever your face is set .

verses.z: 我也要拍掌，並要使我的忿怒止息。這是我－耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I will also strike my hands together , and I will cause my wrath to rest . I , the LORD , have spoken it . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me again , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要定出兩條路，好使巴比倫王的刀來。這兩條路必從一地分出來，又要在通城的路口上畫出一隻手來。
verses.e: " Also , you son of man , appoint two ways , that the sword of the king of Babylon may come . They both will come out of one land , and mark out a place . Mark it out at the head of the way to the city .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要面向耶路撒冷和聖所滴下預言，攻擊以色列地。
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face toward Jerusalem , and preach toward the sanctuaries , and prophesy against the land of Israel .

verses.z: 你要定出一條路，使刀來到亞捫人的拉巴；又要定出一條路，使刀來到猶大的堅固城耶路撒冷。
verses.e: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified .

verses.z: 因為巴比倫王站在岔路那裏，在兩條路口上要占卜。他搖籤求問神像，察看[犧牲的]肝；
verses.e: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way , at the head of the two ways , to use divination . He shook the arrows back and forth . He consulted the teraphim . He looked in the liver .

verses.z: 在右手中拿着為耶路撒冷占卜的籤，使他安設撞城錘，張口叫殺，揚聲吶喊，築壘造臺，以撞城錘，攻打城門。
verses.e: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem , to set battering rams , to open the mouth in the slaughter , to lift up the voice with shouting , to set battering rams against the gates , to cast up mounds , and to build forts .

verses.z: 據那些曾起誓的猶大人看來，這是虛假的占卜；但巴比倫王要使他們想起罪孽，以致將他們捉住。」
verses.e: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight , who have sworn oaths to them ; but he brings iniquity to memory , that they may be taken .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「因你們的過犯顯露，使你們的罪孽被記念，以致你們的罪惡在行為上都彰顯出來；又因你們被記念，就被捉住。
verses.e: " Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered , in that your transgressions are uncovered , so that in all your doings your sins appear ; because you have come to memory , you will be taken with the hand .

verses.z: 你這受死傷行惡的以色列王啊，罪孽的盡頭到了，受報的日子已到。
verses.e: " ' You , deadly wounded wicked one , the prince of Israel , whose day has come , in the time of the iniquity of the end ,

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：當除掉冠，摘下冕，景況必不再像先前；要使卑者升為高，使高者降為卑。
verses.e: the Lord GOD says : " Remove the turban , and take off the crown . This will not be as it was . Exalt that which is low , and humble that which is high .

verses.z: 我要將[這國]傾覆，傾覆，而又傾覆；這[國]也必不再有，直等到那應得的人來到，我就賜給[他]。」
verses.e: I will overturn , overturn , overturn it . This also will be no more , until he comes whose right it is ; and I will give it . " '

verses.z: 「人子啊，要發預言說：主耶和華論到亞捫人和他們的凌辱，吩咐我如此說：有刀，有拔出來的刀，已經擦亮，為行殺戮，使他像閃電以行吞滅。
verses.e: " You , son of man , prophesy and say , ' The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon , and concerning their reproach : " A sword ! A sword is drawn ! It is polished for the slaughter , to cause it to devour , that it may be as lightning ;

verses.z: 人為你見虛假的異象，行謊詐的占卜，使你倒在受死傷之惡人的頸項上。他們罪孽到了盡頭，受報的日子已到。
verses.e: while they see for you false visions , while they divine lies to you , to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded , whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end .

verses.z: 對以色列地說，耶和華如此說：我與你為敵，並要拔刀出鞘，從你中間將義人和惡人一併剪除。
verses.e: Tell the land of Israel , ' The LORD says : " Behold , I am against you , and will draw my sword out of its sheath , and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked .

verses.z: 你將刀收入鞘吧！在你受造之處、生長之地，我必刑罰你。
verses.e: Cause it to return into its sheath . In the place where you were created , in the land of your birth , I will judge you .

verses.z: 我必將我的惱恨倒在你身上，將我烈怒的火噴在你身上；又將你交在善於殺滅的畜類人手中。
verses.e: I will pour out my indignation on you . I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath . I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men , skillful to destroy .

verses.z: 你必當柴被火焚燒；你的血必[流]在國中。你必不再被記念，因為這是我－耶和華說的。」
verses.e: You will be for fuel to the fire . Your blood will be in the middle of the land . You will be remembered no more ; for I , the LORD , have spoken it . " ' "

verses.z: 我既要從你中間剪除義人和惡人，所以我的刀要出鞘，自南至北攻擊一切有血氣的；
verses.e: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked , therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north .

verses.z: 一切有血氣的就知道我－耶和華已經拔刀出鞘，必不再入鞘。
verses.e: All flesh will know that I , the LORD , have drawn my sword out of its sheath . It will not return any more . " '

verses.z: 人子啊，你要歎息，在他們眼前彎着腰，苦苦地歎息。
verses.e: " Therefore sigh , you son of man . You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness .

verses.z: 他們問你說：『為何歎息呢？』你就說：『因為有風聲、[災禍]要來。人心都必消化，手都發軟，精神衰敗，膝弱如水。看哪，這[災禍]臨近，必然成就。這是主耶和華說的。』」
verses.e: It shall be , when they ask you , ' Why do you sigh ? ' that you shall say , ' Because of the news , for it comes ! Every heart will melt , all hands will be feeble , every spirit will faint , and all knees will be weak as water . Behold , it comes , and it shall be done , says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要預言。耶和華吩咐我如此說：有刀、有刀，是磨快擦亮的；
verses.e: " Son of man , prophesy , and say , ' The LORD says : " A sword ! A sword ! It is sharpened , and also polished .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 在你中間有露[繼]母下體羞辱父親的，有玷辱月經不潔淨之婦人的。
verses.e: In you have they uncovered their fathers ' nakedness . In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity .

verses.z: 這人與鄰舍的妻行可憎的事；那人貪淫玷污兒婦；還有玷辱同父之姊妹的。
verses.e: One has committed abomination with his neighbor's wife , and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law . Another in you has humbled his sister , his father's daughter .

verses.z: 在你中間有為流人血受賄賂的；有向借錢的[弟兄]取利，向借糧的[弟兄]多要的。且因貪得無饜，欺壓鄰舍奪取財物，竟忘了我。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood . You have taken interest and increase , and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression , and have forgotten me , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「看哪，我因你所得不義之財和你中間所流的血，就拍掌[歎息]。
verses.e: " ' " Behold , therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made , and at the blood which has been shed within you .

verses.z: 到了我懲罰你的日子，你的心還能忍受嗎？你的手還能有力嗎？我－耶和華說了這話，就必照着行。
verses.e: Can your heart endure , or can your hands be strong , in the days that I will deal with you ? I , the LORD , have spoken it , and will do it .

verses.z: 我必將你分散在列國，四散在列邦。我也必從你中間除掉你的污穢。
verses.e: I will scatter you among the nations , and disperse you through the countries . I will purge your filthiness out of you .

verses.z: 你必在列國人的眼前因自己所行的被褻瀆，你就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations . Then you will know that I am the LORD . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，以色列家在我看為渣滓。他們都是爐中的銅、錫、鐵、鉛，都是銀渣滓。
verses.e: " Son of man , the house of Israel has become dross to me . All of them are bronze , tin , iron , and lead in the middle of the furnace . They are the dross of silver .

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：因你們都成為渣滓，我必聚集你們在耶路撒冷中。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Because you have all become dross , therefore , behold , I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要審問審問這流人血的城嗎？當使她知道她一切可憎的事。
verses.e: " You , son of man , will you judge ? Will you judge the bloody city ? Then cause her to know all her abominations .

verses.z: 人怎樣將銀、銅、鐵、鉛、錫聚在爐中，吹火鎔化；照樣，我也要發怒氣和忿怒，將你們聚集放在城中，鎔化你們。
verses.e: As they gather silver , bronze , iron , lead , and tin into the middle of the furnace , to blow the fire on it , to melt it , so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath , and I will lay you there and melt you .

verses.z: 我必聚集你們，把我烈怒的火吹在你們身上，你們就在其中鎔化。
verses.e: Yes , I will gather you , and blow on you with the fire of my wrath , and you will be melted in the middle of it .

verses.z: 銀子怎樣鎔化在爐中，你們也必照樣鎔化在城中，你們就知道我－耶和華是將忿怒倒在你們身上了。」
verses.e: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace , so you will be melted in the middle of it ; and you will know that I , the LORD , have poured out my wrath on you . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要對這地說：你是未得潔淨之地，在惱恨的日子也沒有雨下在你以上。
verses.e: " Son of man , tell her , ' You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation . '

verses.z: 其中的先知同謀背叛，如咆哮的獅子抓撕掠物。他們吞滅人民，搶奪財寶，使這地多有寡婦。
verses.e: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it , like a roaring lion ravening the prey . They have devoured souls . They take treasure and precious things . They have made many widows within it .

verses.z: 其中的祭司強解我的律法，褻瀆我的聖物，不分別聖的和俗的，也不使人分辨潔淨的和不潔淨的，又遮眼不顧我的安息日；我也在他們中間被褻慢。
verses.e: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things . They have made no distinction between the holy and the common , neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean , and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths . So I am profaned among them .

verses.z: 其中的首領彷彿豺狼抓撕掠物，殺人流血，傷害人命，要得不義之財。
verses.e: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey , to shed blood and to destroy souls , that they may get dishonest gain .

verses.z: 其中的先知為百姓用未泡透的[灰]抹牆，就是為他們見虛假的異象，用謊詐的占卜，說：『主耶和華如此說』，其實耶和華沒有說。
verses.e: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash , seeing false visions , and divining lies to them , saying , ' The Lord GOD says , ' when the LORD has not spoken .

verses.z: 國內眾民一味地欺壓，慣行搶奪，虧負困苦窮乏的，背理欺壓寄居的。
verses.e: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery . Yes , they have troubled the poor and needy , and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully .

verses.z: 你要說，主耶和華如此說：哎！這城有流人血的事在其中，叫她受報的日期來到，又做偶像玷污自己，陷害自己。
verses.e: You shall say , ' The Lord GOD says : " A city that sheds blood within herself , that her time may come , and that makes idols against herself to defile her !

verses.z: 我在他們中間尋找一人重修牆垣，在我面前為這國站在破口防堵，使我不滅絕這國，卻找不着一個。
verses.e: " I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land , that I would not destroy it ; but I found no one .

verses.z: 所以我將惱恨倒在他們身上，用烈怒的火滅了他們，照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them . I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath . I have brought their own way on their heads , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 你因流了人的血，就為有罪；你做了偶像，就玷污自己，使你受報之日臨近，報應之年來到。所以我叫你受列國的凌辱和列邦的譏誚。
verses.e: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed , and are defiled in your idols which you have made ! You have caused your days to draw near , and have come to the end of your years . Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations , and a mocking to all the countries .

verses.z: 你這名臭、多亂的城啊，那些離你近、離你遠的都必譏誚你。
verses.e: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you , you infamous one , full of tumult .

verses.z: 「看哪，以色列的首領各逞其能，在你中間流人之血。
verses.e: " ' " Behold , the princes of Israel , everyone according to his power , have been in you to shed blood .

verses.z: 在你中間有輕慢父母的，有欺壓寄居的，有虧負孤兒寡婦的。
verses.e: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt . Among you they have oppressed the foreigner . In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow .

verses.z: 你藐視了我的聖物，干犯了我的安息日。
verses.e: You have despised my holy things , and have profaned my Sabbaths .

verses.z: 在你中間有讒謗人、流人血的；有在山上吃過[祭偶像之物]的，有行淫亂的。
verses.e: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood . In you they have eaten on the mountains . They have committed lewdness among you .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came again to me , saying ,

verses.z: 他們就露了她的下體，擄掠她的兒女，用刀殺了她，使她在婦女中留下臭名，因他們向她施行審判。
verses.e: These uncovered her nakedness . They took her sons and her daughters , and they killed her with the sword . She became a byword among women ; for they executed judgments on her .

verses.z: 「她妹妹阿荷利巴雖然看見了，卻還貪戀，比她姊姊更醜；行淫亂比她姊姊更多。
verses.e: " Her sister Oholibah saw this , yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she , and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister .

verses.z: 她貪戀鄰邦的亞述人，就是穿極華美的衣服，騎着馬的省長、副省長，都是可愛的少年人。

verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance , and has greatly offended , and taken revenge on them , "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊以東，剪除人與牲畜，使以東從提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要變為荒涼，直到底但。
verses.e: therefore the Lord GOD says , " I will stretch out my hand on Edom , and will cut off man and animal from it ; and I will make it desolate from Teman . They will fall by the sword even to Dedan .

verses.z: 我必藉我民以色列的手報復以東；以色列民必照我的怒氣，按我的忿怒在以東施報，以東人就知道是我施報。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel . They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath . Then they will know my vengeance , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「因非利士人向猶大人報仇，就是以恨惡的心報仇雪恨，永懷仇恨，要毀滅他們，
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " Because the Philistines have taken revenge , and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility , "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊非利士人，剪除基利提人，滅絕沿海剩下的居民。
verses.e: therefore the Lord GOD says , " Behold , I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines , and I will cut off the Cherethites , and destroy the remnant of the sea coast .

verses.z: 我向他們大施報應，發怒斥責他們。我報復他們的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes . Then they will know that I am the LORD , when I lay my vengeance on them . " ' "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要面向亞捫人說預言，攻擊他們，
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face toward the children of Ammon , and prophesy against them .

verses.z: 說：你們當聽主耶和華的話。主耶和華如此說：我的聖所被褻瀆，以色列地變荒涼，猶大家被擄掠；那時，你便因這些事說：『阿哈！』
verses.e: Tell the children of Ammon , ' Hear the word of the Lord GOD ! The Lord GOD says , " Because you said , ' Aha ! ' against my sanctuary when it was profaned , and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate , and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity ,

verses.z: 所以我必將你的地交給東方人為業；他們必在你的地上安營居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。
verses.e: therefore , behold , I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession . They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you . They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk .

verses.z: 我必使拉巴為駱駝場，使亞捫人的地為羊群躺臥之處，你們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks . Then you will know that I am the LORD . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「因你拍手頓足，以滿心的恨惡向以色列地歡喜，
verses.e: For the Lord GOD says : " Because you have clapped your hands , stamped with the feet , and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel ,

verses.z: 所以我伸手攻擊你，將你交給列國作為擄物。我必從萬民中剪除你，使你從萬國中敗亡。我必除滅你，你就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: therefore , behold , I have stretched out my hand on you , and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations . I will cut you off from the peoples , and I will cause you to perish out of the countries . I will destroy you . Then you will know that I am the LORD . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「因摩押和西珥人說：『看哪，猶大家與列國無異』，
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " Because Moab and Seir say , ' Behold , the house of Judah is like all the nations , '

verses.z: 所以我要破開摩押邊界上的城邑，就是摩押人看為本國之榮耀的伯‧耶西末、巴力‧免、基列亭，
verses.e: therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities which are on its frontiers , the glory of the country , Beth Jeshimoth , Baal Meon , and Kiriathaim ,

verses.z: 第十一年[十一]月初一日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: In the eleventh year , in the first of the month , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 因他的馬匹眾多，塵土揚起遮蔽你。他進入你的城門，好像人進入已有破口之城。那時，你的牆垣必因騎馬的和戰車、輜重車的響聲震動。
verses.e: By reason of the abundance of his horses , their dust will cover you . Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen , of the wagons , and of the chariots , when he enters into your gates , as men enter into a city which is broken open .

verses.z: 他的馬蹄必踐踏你一切的街道；他必用刀殺戮你的居民。你堅固的柱子必倒在地上。
verses.e: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses . He will kill your people with the sword . The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground .

verses.z: 人必以你的財寶為擄物，以你的貨財為掠物，破壞你的牆垣，拆毀你華美的房屋，將你的石頭、木頭、塵土都拋在水中。
verses.e: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise . They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses . They will lay your stones , your timber , and your dust in the middle of the waters .

verses.z: 我必使你唱歌的聲音止息；人也不再聽見你彈琴的聲音。
verses.e: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease . The sound of your harps won't be heard any more .

verses.z: 我必使你成為淨光的磐石，作曬網的地方。你不得再被建造，因為這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I will make you a bare rock . You will be a place for the spreading of nets . You will be built no more ; for I the LORD have spoken it , ' says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 主耶和華對泰爾如此說：「在你中間行殺戮，受傷之人唉哼的時候，因你傾倒的響聲，海島豈不都震動嗎？
verses.e: " The Lord GOD says to Tyre : ' Won't the islands shake at the sound of your fall , when the wounded groan , when the slaughter is made within you ?

verses.z: 那時靠海的君王必都下位，除去朝服，脫下花衣，披上戰兢，坐在地上，時刻發抖，為你驚駭。
verses.e: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones , and lay aside their robes , and strip off their embroidered garments . They will clothe themselves with trembling . They will sit on the ground , and will tremble every moment , and be astonished at you .

verses.z: 他們必為你作起哀歌說：你這有名之城，素為航海之人居住，在海上為最堅固的；平日你和居民使一切住在那裏的人無不驚恐；現在何竟毀滅了？
verses.e: They will take up a lamentation over you , and tell you , " How you are destroyed , who were inhabited by seafaring men , the renowned city , who was strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants , who caused their terror to be on all who lived there ! "

verses.z: 如今在你這傾覆的日子，海島都必戰兢；海中的群島見你歸於無有就都驚惶。」
verses.e: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall . Yes , the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure . '

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「泰爾啊，我使你變為荒涼，如無人居住的城邑；又使深水漫過你，大水淹沒你。
verses.e: " For the Lord GOD says : ' When I make you a desolate city , like the cities that are not inhabited , when I bring up the deep on you , and the great waters cover you ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，因泰爾向耶路撒冷說：『阿哈，那作眾民之門的已經破壞，向我開放；她既變為荒場，我必豐盛。』
verses.e: " Son of man , because Tyre has said against Jerusalem , ' Aha ! She is broken ! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me . I will be replenished , now that she is laid waste ; '

verses.z: 那時，我要叫你下入陰府，與古時的人一同在地的深處、久已荒涼之地居住，使你不再有居民。我也要在活人之地顯榮耀。
verses.e: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit , to the people of old time , and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth , in the places that are desolate of old , with those who go down to the pit , that you be not inhabited ; and I will set glory in the land of the living .

verses.z: 我必叫你令人驚恐，不再存留於世；人雖尋找你，卻永尋不見。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I will make you a terror , and you will no more have any being . Though you are sought for , yet you will never be found again , ' says the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 所以，主耶和華如此說：泰爾啊，我必與你為敵，使許多國民上來攻擊你，如同海使波浪湧上來一樣。
verses.e: therefore the Lord GOD says , ' Behold , I am against you , Tyre , and will cause many nations to come up against you , as the sea causes its waves to come up .

verses.z: 他們必破壞泰爾的牆垣，拆毀她的城樓。我也要刮淨塵土，使她成為淨光的磐石。
verses.e: They will destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers . I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her a bare rock .

verses.z: 她必在海中作曬網的地方，也必成為列國的擄物。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea ; for I have spoken it , ' says the Lord GOD . ' She will become plunder for the nations .

verses.z: 屬泰爾城邑的居民必被刀劍殺滅，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword . Then they will know that I am the LORD . '

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「我必使諸王之王的巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領馬匹車輛、馬兵、軍隊，和許多人民從北方來攻擊[你]泰爾。
verses.e: " For the Lord GOD says : ' Behold , I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , king of kings , from the north , with horses , with chariots , with horsemen , and an army with many people .

verses.z: 他必用刀劍殺滅屬你城邑的居民，也必造臺築壘舉盾牌攻擊你。
verses.e: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword . He will make forts against you , cast up a mound against you , and raise up the buckler against you .

verses.z: 他必安設撞城錘攻破你的牆垣，用鐵器拆毀你的城樓。
verses.e: He will set his battering engines against your walls , and with his axes he will break down your towers .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came again to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「波斯人、路德人、弗人在你軍營中作戰士；他們在你中間懸掛盾牌和頭盔，彰顯你的尊榮。
verses.e: " ' " Persia , Lud , and Put were in your army , your men of war . They hung the shield and helmet in you . They showed your beauty .

verses.z: 亞發人和你的軍隊都在你四圍的牆上，你的望樓也有勇士；他們懸掛盾牌，成全你的美麗。
verses.e: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around , and valiant men were in your towers . They hung their shields on your walls all around . They have perfected your beauty .

verses.z: 「他施人因你多有各類的財物，就作你的客商，拿銀、鐵、錫、鉛兌換你的貨物。
verses.e: " ' " Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches . They traded for your wares with silver , iron , tin , and lead .

verses.z: 雅完人、土巴人、米設人都與你交易；他們用人口和銅器兌換你的貨物。
verses.e: " ' " Javan , Tubal , and Meshech were your traders . They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise .

verses.z: 陀迦瑪族用馬和戰馬並騾子兌換你的貨物。
verses.e: " ' " They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses , war horses , and mules .

verses.z: 底但人與你交易，許多海島作你的碼頭；他們拿象牙、烏木與你兌換。
verses.e: " ' " The men of Dedan traded with you . Many islands were the market of your hand . They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange .

verses.z: 亞蘭人因你的工作很多，就作你的客商；他們用綠寶石、紫色[布]繡貨、細麻布、珊瑚、紅寶石兌換你的貨物。
verses.e: " ' " Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks . They traded for your wares with emeralds , purple , embroidered work , fine linen , coral , and rubies .

verses.z: 猶大和以色列地的人都與你交易；他們用米匿的麥子、餅、蜜、油、乳香兌換你的貨物。
verses.e: " ' " Judah and the land of Israel were your traders . They traded wheat of Minnith , confections , honey , oil , and balm for your merchandise .

verses.z: 大馬士革人因你的工作很多，又因你多有各類的財物，就拿黑本酒和白羊毛與你交易。
verses.e: " ' " Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches , with the wine of Helbon , and white wool .

verses.z: 威但人和雅完人拿紡成的線、亮鐵、桂皮、菖蒲兌換你的貨物。
verses.e: " ' " Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares ; wrought iron , cassia , and calamus were among your merchandise .

verses.z: 「人子啊，要為泰爾作起哀歌，
verses.e: " You , son of man , take up a lamentation over Tyre ;

verses.z: 底但人用高貴的毯子、鞍、屜與你交易。
verses.e: " ' " Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding .

verses.z: 阿拉伯人和基達的一切首領都作你的客商，用羊羔、公綿羊、公山羊與你交易。
verses.e: " ' " Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs , rams , and goats . In these , they were your merchants .

verses.z: 示巴和拉瑪的商人與你交易，他們用各類上好的香料、各類的寶石，和黃金兌換你的貨物。
verses.e: " ' " The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders . They traded for your wares with the best of all spices , all precious stones , and gold .

verses.z: 哈蘭人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人，和亞述人、基抹人與你交易。
verses.e: " ' " Haran , Canneh , Eden , the traders of Sheba , Asshur and Chilmad , were your traders .

verses.z: 這些商人以美好的貨物包在繡花藍色包袱內，又有華麗的衣服裝在香柏木的箱子裏，用繩捆着與你交易。
verses.e: These were your traders in choice wares , in wrappings of blue and embroidered work , and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords , among your merchandise .

verses.z: 他施的船隻接連成幫為你運貨，你便在海中豐富極其榮華。
verses.e: " ' " The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise . You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas .

verses.z: 盪槳的已經把你盪到大水之處，東風在海中將你打破。
verses.e: Your rowers have brought you into great waters . The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas .

verses.z: 你的資財、物件、貨物、水手、掌舵的、補縫的、經營交易的，並你中間的戰士和人民，在你破壞的日子必都沉在海中。
verses.e: Your riches , your wares , your merchandise , your mariners , your pilots , your repairers of ship seams , the dealers in your merchandise , and all your men of war who are in you , with all your company which is among you , will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin .

verses.z: 你掌舵的呼號之聲一發，郊野都必震動。
verses.e: At the sound of the cry of your pilots , the pasture lands will shake .

verses.z: 凡盪槳的和水手，並一切泛海掌舵的，都必下船登岸。
verses.e: All who handle the oars , the mariners and all the pilots of the sea , will come down from their ships . They will stand on the land ,

verses.z: 說：你居住海口，是眾民的商埠；你的交易通到許多的海島。主耶和華如此說：泰爾啊，你曾說：我是全然美麗的。
verses.e: and tell Tyre , ' You who dwell at the entry of the sea , who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands , the Lord GOD says : " You , Tyre , have said , ' I am perfect in beauty . '

verses.z: 他們必為你放聲痛哭，把塵土撒在頭上，在灰中打滾；
verses.e: and will cause their voice to be heard over you , and will cry bitterly . They will cast up dust on their heads . They will wallow in the ashes .

verses.z: 又為你使頭上光禿，用麻布束腰，號咷痛哭，苦苦悲哀。
verses.e: They will make themselves bald for you , and clothe themselves with sackcloth . They will weep for you in bitterness of soul , with bitter mourning .

verses.z: 他們哀號的時候，為你作起哀歌哀哭，[說]：有何城如泰爾？有何城如她在海中成為寂寞的呢？
verses.e: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you , and lament over you , saying , ' Who is there like Tyre , like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea ? '

verses.z: 你由海上運出貨物，就使許多國民充足；你以許多資財、貨物使地上的君王豐富。
verses.e: When your wares came from the seas , you filled many peoples . You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise .

verses.z: 你在深水中被海浪打破的時候，你的貨物和你中間的一切人民，就都沉下去了。
verses.e: In the time that you were broken by the seas , in the depths of the waters , your merchandise and all your company fell within you .

verses.z: 海島的居民為你驚奇；他們的君王都甚恐慌，面帶愁容。
verses.e: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you , and their kings are horribly afraid . They are troubled in their face .

verses.z: 各國民中的客商都向你發嘶聲；你令人驚恐，不再存留於世，直到永遠。」
verses.e: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you . You have come to a terrible end , and you will be no more . " ' "

verses.z: 你的境界在海中，造你的使你全然美麗。
verses.e: Your borders are in the heart of the seas . Your builders have perfected your beauty .

verses.z: 他們用示尼珥的松樹做你的一切板，用黎巴嫩的香柏樹做桅杆，
verses.e: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir . They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you .

verses.z: 用巴珊的橡樹做你的槳，用象牙鑲嵌基提海島的黃楊木為坐板。
verses.e: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan . They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim .

verses.z: 你的篷帆是用埃及繡花細麻布做的，可以做你的大旗；你的涼棚是用以利沙島的藍色、紫色[布]做的。
verses.e: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt , that it might be to you for a banner . Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning .

verses.z: 西頓和亞發的居民作你盪槳的。泰爾啊，你中間的智慧人作掌舵的。
verses.e: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers . Your wise men , Tyre , were in you . They were your pilots .

verses.z: 迦巴勒的老者和聰明人都在你中間作補縫的；一切泛海的船隻和水手都在你中間經營交易的事。
verses.e: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you . All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came again to me , saying ,

verses.z: 你必死在外邦人手中，與未受割禮的人一樣，因為這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers ; for I have spoken it , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你為泰爾王作起哀歌，說主耶和華如此說：你無所不備，智慧充足，全然美麗。
verses.e: " Son of man , take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre , and tell him , ' The Lord GOD says : " You were the seal of full measure , full of wisdom , and perfect in beauty .

verses.z: 你曾在伊甸上帝的園中，佩戴各樣寶石，就是紅寶石、紅璧璽、金鋼石、水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉、藍寶石、綠寶石、紅玉，和黃金；又有精美的鼓笛在你那裏，都是在你受造之日預備齊全的。
verses.e: You were in Eden , the garden of God . Every precious stone adorned you : ruby , topaz , emerald , chrysolite , onyx , jasper , sapphire , turquoise , and beryl . Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you . They were prepared in the day that you were created .

verses.z: 你是那受膏遮掩[約櫃]的基路伯；我將你安置在上帝的聖山上；你在發[光如]火[的寶]石中間往來。
verses.e: You were the anointed cherub who covers . Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God . You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire .

verses.z: 你從受造之日所行的都完全，後來在你中間又察出不義。
verses.e: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created , until unrighteousness was found in you .

verses.z: 因你貿易很多，就被強暴的事充滿，以致犯罪，所以我因你褻瀆[聖地]，就從上帝的山驅逐你。遮掩[約櫃]的基路伯啊，我已將你從發[光如]火[的寶]石中除滅。
verses.e: By the abundance of your commerce , your insides were filled with violence , and you have sinned . Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God's mountain . I have destroyed you , covering cherub , from the middle of the stones of fire .

verses.z: 你因美麗心中高傲，又因榮光敗壞智慧，我已將你摔倒在地，使你倒在君王面前，好叫他們目睹眼見。
verses.e: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty . You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor . I have cast you to the ground . I have laid you before kings , that they may see you .

verses.z: 你因罪孽眾多，貿易不公，就褻瀆你那裏的聖所。故此，我使火從你中間發出，燒滅你，使你在所有觀看的人眼前變為地上的爐灰。
verses.e: By the multitude of your iniquities , in the unrighteousness of your commerce , you have profaned your sanctuaries . Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you . It has devoured you . I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you .

verses.z: 各國民中，凡認識你的，都必為你驚奇。你令人驚恐，不再存留於世，直到永遠。」
verses.e: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you . You have become a terror , and you will exist no more . " ' "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你對泰爾君王說，主耶和華如此說：因你心裏高傲，說：我是神；我在海中坐神之位。你雖然居心自比神，也不過是人，並不是神！
verses.e: " Son of man , tell the prince of Tyre , ' The Lord GOD says : " Because your heart is lifted up , and you have said , ' I am a god , I sit in the seat of God , in the middle of the seas ; ' yet you are man , and no god , though you set your heart as the heart of a god —

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要向西頓預言攻擊她，
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face toward Sidon , and prophesy against it ,

verses.z: 說主耶和華如此說：西頓哪，我與你為敵，我必在你中間得榮耀。我在你中間施行審判、顯為聖的時候，人就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: and say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I am against you , Sidon . I will be glorified among you . Then they will know that I am the LORD , when I have executed judgments in her , and am sanctified in her .

verses.z: 我必使瘟疫進入西頓，使血流在她街上。被殺的必在其中仆倒，四圍有刀劍臨到她，人就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: For I will send pestilence into her , and blood into her streets . The wounded will fall within her , with the sword on her on every side . Then they will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「四圍恨惡以色列家的人，必不再向他們作刺人的荊棘，傷人的蒺藜，人就知道我是主耶和華。」
verses.e: " ' " There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel , nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them . Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「我將分散在萬民中的以色列家招聚回來，向他們在列邦人眼前顯為聖的時候，他們就在我賜給我僕人雅各之地，仍然居住。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered , and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations , then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob .

verses.z: 他們要在這地上安然居住。我向四圍恨惡他們的眾人施行審判以後，他們要蓋造房屋，栽種葡萄園，安然居住，就知道我是耶和華－他們的上帝。」
verses.e: They will dwell in it securely . Yes , they will build houses , plant vineyards , and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt . Then they will know that I am the LORD their God . " ' "

verses.z: 看哪，你比但以理更有智慧，甚麼祕事都不能向你隱藏。
verses.e: behold , you are wiser than Daniel . There is no secret that is hidden from you .

verses.z: 你靠自己的智慧聰明得了金銀財寶，收入庫中。
verses.e: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches , and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries .

verses.z: 你靠自己的大智慧和貿易增添資財，又因資財心裏高傲。
verses.e: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches , and your heart is lifted up because of your riches — "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：因你居心自比神，
verses.e: " ' therefore the Lord GOD says : " Because you have set your heart as the heart of God ,

verses.z: 我必使外邦人，就是列國中的強暴人臨到你這裏；他們必拔刀砍壞你用智慧得來的美物，褻瀆你的榮光。
verses.e: therefore , behold , I will bring strangers on you , the terrible of the nations . They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom . They will defile your brightness .

verses.z: 他們必使你下坑；你必死在海中，與被殺的人一樣。
verses.e: They will bring you down to the pit . You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas .

verses.z: 在殺你的人面前你還能說「我是神」嗎？其實你在殺害你的人手中，不過是人，並不是神。
verses.e: Will you yet say before him who kills you , ' I am God ' ? But you are man , and not God , in the hand of him who wounds you .

verses.z: 第十年十[月]十二[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: In the tenth year , in the tenth month , on the twelfth day of the month , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 所以我必與你並你的江河為敵，使埃及地，從色弗尼塔直到古實境界，全然荒廢淒涼。
verses.e: therefore , behold , I am against you and against your rivers . I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation , from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia .

verses.z: 人的腳、獸的蹄都不經過，四十年之久並無人居住。
verses.e: No foot of man will pass through it , nor will any animal foot pass through it . It won't be inhabited for forty years .

verses.z: 我必使埃及地在荒涼的國中成為荒涼，使埃及城在荒廢的城中變為荒廢，共有四十年。我必將埃及人分散在列國，四散在列邦。」
verses.e: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate . Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years . I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「滿了四十年，我必招聚分散在各國民中的埃及人。
verses.e: " ' For the Lord GOD says : " At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered .

verses.z: 我必叫埃及被擄的人回來，使他們歸回本地巴忒羅。在那裏必成為低微的國，
verses.e: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt , and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros , into the land of their birth . There they will be a lowly kingdom .

verses.z: 必為列國中最低微的，也不再自高於列國之上。我必減少他們，以致不再轄制列國。
verses.e: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms . It won't lift itself up above the nations any more . I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations .

verses.z: 埃及必不再作以色列家所倚靠的；以色列家仰望埃及人的時候，便思念罪孽。他們就知道我是主耶和華。」
verses.e: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel , bringing iniquity to memory , when they turn to look after them . Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD . " ' "

verses.z: 二十七年正[月]初一[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year , in the first month , in the first day of the month , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒使他的軍兵大大效勞，攻打泰爾，以致頭都光禿，肩都磨破；然而他和他的軍兵攻打泰爾，並沒有從那裏得甚麼酬勞。
verses.e: " Son of man , Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre . Every head was made bald , and every shoulder was worn ; yet he had no wages , nor did his army , from Tyre , for the service that he had served against it .

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必將埃及地賜給巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒；他必擄掠埃及群眾，搶其中的財為擄物，奪其中的貨為掠物，這就可以作他軍兵的酬勞。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Behold , I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon . He will carry off her multitude , take her plunder , and take her prey . That will be the wages for his army .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老預言攻擊他和埃及全地，
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him and against all Egypt .

verses.z: 我將埃及地賜給他，酬他所效的勞，因王與軍兵是為我勤勞。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served , because they worked for me , ' says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「當那日，我必使以色列家的角發生，又必使你－以西結在他們中間得以開口；他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: " In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel , and I will open your mouth among them . Then they will know that I am the LORD . "

verses.z: 說主耶和華如此說：埃及王法老啊，我與你這臥在自己河中的大魚為敵。你曾說：這河是我的，是我為自己造的。
verses.e: Speak and say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I am against you , Pharaoh king of Egypt , the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers , that has said , ' My river is my own , and I have made it for myself . '

verses.z: 我－[耶和華]必用鉤子鉤住你的腮頰，又使江河中的魚貼住你的鱗甲；我必將你和所有貼住你鱗甲的魚，從江河中拉上來，
verses.e: I will put hooks in your jaws , and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales . I will bring you up out of the middle of your rivers , with all the fish of your rivers which stick to your scales .

verses.z: 把你並江河中的魚都拋在曠野；你必倒在田間，不被收殮，不被掩埋。我已將你給地上野獸、空中飛鳥作食物。
verses.e: I'll cast you out into the wilderness , you and all the fish of your rivers . You'll fall on the open field . You won't be brought together or gathered . I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky .

verses.z: 「埃及一切的居民，因向以色列家成了蘆葦的杖，就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' " All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD , because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel .

verses.z: 他們用手持住你，你就斷折，傷了他們的肩；他們倚靠你，你就斷折，閃了他們的腰。
verses.e: When they took hold of you by your hand , you broke and tore all their shoulders . When they leaned on you , you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs . "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必使刀劍臨到你，從你中間將人與牲畜剪除。
verses.e: " ' Therefore the Lord GOD says : " Behold , I will bring a sword on you , and will cut off man and animal from you .

verses.z: 埃及地必荒廢淒涼，他們就知道我是耶和華。「因為法老說：『這河是我的，是我所造的』，
verses.e: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste . Then they will know that I am the LORD . " ' " Because he has said , ' The river is mine , and I have made it , '

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，要吃你所得的，要吃這書卷，好去對以色列家講說。」
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , eat what you find . Eat this scroll , and go , speak to the house of Israel . "

verses.z: 他又對我說：「人子啊，我對你所說的一切話，要心裏領會，耳中聽聞。
verses.e: Moreover he said to me , " Son of man , receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you .

verses.z: 你往你本國被擄的子民那裏去，他們或聽，或不聽，你要對他們講說，告訴他們這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: Go to them of the captivity , to the children of your people , and speak to them , and tell them , ' This is what the Lord GOD says , ' whether they will hear , or whether they will refuse . "

verses.z: 那時，靈將我舉起，我就聽見在我身後有震動轟轟的聲音，[說]：「從耶和華的所在顯出來的榮耀是該稱頌的！」
verses.e: Then the Spirit lifted me up , and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing , saying , " Blessed be the LORD's glory from his place . "

verses.z: 我又[聽見]那活物翅膀相碰，與活物旁邊輪子旋轉震動轟轟的響聲。
verses.e: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another , and the noise of the wheels beside them , even the noise of a great rushing .

verses.z: 於是靈將我舉起，帶我而去。我心中甚苦，靈性忿激，並且耶和華的靈在我身上大有能力。
verses.e: So the Spirit lifted me up , and took me away ; and I went in bitterness , in the heat of my spirit ; and the LORD's hand was strong on me .

verses.z: 我就來到提勒‧亞畢，住在迦巴魯河邊被擄的人那裏，到他們所住的地方，在他們中間憂憂悶悶地坐了七日。
verses.e: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar , and to where they lived ; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days .

verses.z: 過了七日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: At the end of seven days , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，我立你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要聽我口中的話，替我警戒他們。
verses.e: " Son of man , I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel . Therefore hear the word from my mouth , and warn them from me .

verses.z: 我何時指着惡人說：他必要死；你若不警戒他，也不勸戒他，使他離開惡行，拯救他的性命，這惡人必死在罪孽之中；我卻要向你討他喪命的罪。
verses.e: When I tell the wicked , ' You will surely die ; ' and you give him no warning , nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way , to save his life , that wicked man will die in his iniquity ; but I will require his blood at your hand .

verses.z: 倘若你警戒惡人，他仍不轉離罪惡，也不離開惡行，他必死在罪孽之中，你卻救自己脫離了罪。
verses.e: Yet if you warn the wicked , and he doesn't turn from his wickedness , nor from his wicked way , he will die in his iniquity ; but you have delivered your soul . "

verses.z: 於是我開口，他就使我吃這書卷，
verses.e: So I opened my mouth , and he caused me to eat the scroll .

verses.z: 再者，義人何時離義而犯罪，我將絆腳石放在他面前，他就必死；因你沒有警戒他，他必死在罪中，他素來所行的義不被記念；我卻要向你討他喪命的罪。
verses.e: " Again , when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity , and I lay a stumbling block before him , he will die . Because you have not given him warning , he will die in his sin , and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered ; but I will require his blood at your hand .

verses.z: 倘若你警戒義人，使他不犯罪，他就不犯罪；他因受警戒就必存活，你也救自己脫離了罪。」
verses.e: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man , that the righteous not sin , and he does not sin , he will surely live , because he took warning ; and you have delivered your soul . "

verses.z: 耶和華的靈在那裏降在我身上。他對我說：「你起來往平原去，我要在那裏和你說話。」
verses.e: The LORD's hand was there on me ; and he said to me , " Arise , go out into the plain , and I will talk with you there . "

verses.z: 於是我起來往平原去，不料，耶和華的榮耀正如我在迦巴魯河邊所見的一樣，停在那裏，我就俯伏於地。
verses.e: Then I arose , and went out into the plain , and behold , the LORD's glory stood there , like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar . Then I fell on my face .

verses.z: 靈就進入我裏面，使我站起來。耶和華對我說：「你進房屋去，將門關上。
verses.e: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet . He spoke with me , and said to me , " Go , shut yourself inside your house .

verses.z: 人子啊，人必用繩索捆綁你，你就不能出去在他們中間來往。
verses.e: But you , son of man , behold , they will put ropes on you , and will bind you with them , and you will not go out among them .

verses.z: 我必使你的舌頭貼住上膛，以致你啞口，不能作責備他們的人；他們原是悖逆之家。
verses.e: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them , for they are a rebellious house .

verses.z: 但我對你說話的時候，必使你開口，你就要對他們說：『主耶和華如此說。』聽的可以聽，不聽的任他不聽，因為他們是悖逆之家。」
verses.e: But when I speak with you , I will open your mouth , and you shall tell them , ' This is what the Lord GOD says . ' He who hears , let him hear ; and he who refuses , let him refuse ; for they are a rebellious house . "

verses.z: 又對我說：「人子啊，要吃我所賜給你的這書卷，充滿你的肚腹。」我就吃了，口中覺得其甜如蜜。
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it . " Then I ate it . It was as sweet as honey in my mouth .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，你往以色列家那裏去，將我的話對他們講說。
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , go to the house of Israel , and speak my words to them .

verses.z: 你奉差遣不是往那說話深奧、言語難懂的民那裏去，乃是往以色列家去；
verses.e: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language , but to the house of Israel —

verses.z: 不是往那說話深奧、言語難懂的多國去，他們的話語是你不懂得的。我若差你往他們那裏去，他們必聽從你。
verses.e: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language , whose words you can't understand . Surely , if I sent you to them , they would listen to you .

verses.z: 以色列家卻不肯聽從你，因為他們不肯聽從我；原來以色列全家是額堅心硬的人。
verses.e: But the house of Israel will not listen to you , for they will not listen to me ; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted .

verses.z: 看哪，我使你的臉硬過他們的臉，使你的額硬過他們的額。
verses.e: Behold , I have made your face hard against their faces , and your forehead hard against their foreheads .

verses.z: 我使你的額像金鋼鑽，比火石更硬。他們雖是悖逆之家，你不要怕他們，也不要因他們的臉色驚惶。」
verses.e: I have made your forehead as a diamond , harder than flint . Don't be afraid of them , neither be dismayed at their looks , though they are a rebellious house . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came again to me , saying ,

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：我必藉巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的手，除滅埃及眾人。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease , by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon .

verses.z: 他和隨從他的人，就是列國中強暴的，必進來毀滅這地。他們必拔刀攻擊埃及，使遍地有被殺的人。
verses.e: He and his people with him , the terrible of the nations , will be brought in to destroy the land . They will draw their swords against Egypt , and fill the land with the slain .

verses.z: 我必使江河乾涸，將地賣在惡人的手中；我必藉外邦人的手，使這地和其中所有的變為淒涼。這是我－耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will make the rivers dry , and will sell the land into the hand of evil men . I will make the land desolate , and all that is therein , by the hand of foreigners . I , the LORD , have spoken it . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：我必毀滅偶像，從挪弗除滅神像；必不再有君王出自埃及地。我要使埃及地的人懼怕。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " I will also destroy the idols , and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis . There will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt . I will put a fear in the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 我必使巴忒羅荒涼，在瑣安中使火着起，向挪施行審判。
verses.e: I will make Pathros desolate , and will set a fire in Zoan , and will execute judgments on No .

verses.z: 我必將我的忿怒倒在埃及的保障上，就是訓上，並要剪除挪的眾人。
verses.e: I will pour my wrath on Sin , the stronghold of Egypt . I will cut off the multitude of No .

verses.z: 我必在埃及中使火着起；訓必大大痛苦；挪必被攻破；挪弗白日見仇敵。
verses.e: I will set a fire in Egypt Sin will be in great anguish . No will be broken up . Memphis will have adversaries in the daytime .

verses.z: 亞文和比伯實的少年人必倒在刀下；這些[城的人]必被擄掠。
verses.e: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword . They will go into captivity .

verses.z: 我在答比匿折斷埃及的諸軛，使她因勢力而有的驕傲在其中止息。那時，日光必退去；至於這城，必有密雲遮蔽，其中的女子必被擄掠。
verses.e: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself , when I break the yokes of Egypt there . The pride of her power will cease in her . As for her , a cloud will cover her , and her daughters will go into captivity .

verses.z: 我必這樣向埃及施行審判，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt . Then they will know that I am the LORD . " ' "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要發預言說，主耶和華如此說：哀哉這日！你們應當哭號。
verses.e: " Son of man , prophesy , and say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Wail , ' Alas for the day ! '

verses.z: 十一年正[月]初七[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: In the eleventh year , in the first month , in the seventh day of the month , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，我已打折埃及王法老的膀臂；沒有敷藥，也沒有用布纏好，使他有力持刀。
verses.e: " Son of man , I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt . Behold , it has not been bound up , to apply medicines , to put a bandage to bind it , that it may become strong to hold the sword .

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：看哪，我與埃及王法老為敵，必將他有力的膀臂和已打折的膀臂全行打斷，使刀從他手中墜落。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Behold , I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and will break his arms , the strong arm , and that which was broken . I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand .

verses.z: 我必將埃及人分散在列國，四散在列邦。
verses.e: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .

verses.z: 我必使巴比倫王的膀臂有力，將我的刀交在他手中；卻要打斷法老的膀臂，他就在巴比倫王面前唉哼，如同受死傷的人一樣。
verses.e: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and put my sword in his hand ; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh , and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man .

verses.z: 我必扶持巴比倫王的膀臂，法老的膀臂卻要下垂；我將我的刀交在巴比倫王手中，他必舉刀攻擊埃及地，他們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon , but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down . Then they will know that I am the LORD when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 我必將埃及人分散在列國，四散在列邦；他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries . Then they will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 因為耶和華的日子臨近，就是密雲之日，列國[受罰]之期。
verses.e: For the day is near , even the LORD's day is near . It will be a day of clouds , a time of the nations .

verses.z: 必有刀劍臨到埃及；在埃及被殺之人仆倒的時候，古實人就有痛苦，人民必被擄掠，基址必被拆毀。
verses.e: A sword will come on Egypt , and anguish will be in Ethiopia , when the slain fall in Egypt . They take away her multitude , and her foundations are broken down .

verses.z: 古實人、弗人、路德人、雜族的人民，並古巴人，以及同盟之地的人都要與埃及人一同倒在刀下。」
verses.e: " ' " Ethiopia , Put , Lud , all the mixed people , Cub , and the children of the land that is allied with them , will fall with them by the sword . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：扶助埃及的也必傾倒。埃及因勢力而有的驕傲必降低微；其中的人民，從色弗尼塔起必倒在刀下。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " ' The LORD says : " They also who uphold Egypt will fall . The pride of her power will come down . They will fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 埃及地在荒涼的國中必成為荒涼；埃及城在荒廢的城中也變為荒廢。
verses.e: " They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate . Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted .

verses.z: 我在埃及中使火着起；幫助埃及的，都被滅絕。那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: They will know that I am the LORD when I have set a fire in Egypt , and all her helpers are destroyed .

verses.z: 「到那日，必有使者坐船，從我面前出去，使安逸無慮的古實人驚懼；必有痛苦臨到他們，好像埃及[遭災]的日子一樣。看哪，這事臨近了！
verses.e: " ' " In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid . There will be anguish on them , as in the day of Egypt ; for , behold , it comes . "

verses.z: 十一年三[月]初一[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: In the eleventh year , in the third month , in the first day of the month , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：「因它高大，樹尖插入雲中，心驕氣傲，
verses.e: " Therefore thus said the Lord GOD : ' Because he is exalted in stature , and he has set his top among the thick branches , and his heart is lifted up in his height ,

verses.z: 我就必將它交給列國中大有威勢的人；他必定辦它。我因它的罪惡，已經驅逐它。
verses.e: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations . He will surely deal with him . I have driven him out for his wickedness .

verses.z: 外邦人，就是列邦中強暴的，將它砍斷棄掉。它的枝條落在山間和一切谷中，它的枝子折斷，落在地的一切河旁。地上的眾民已經走去，離開它的蔭下。
verses.e: Foreigners , the tyrants of the nations , have cut him off and have left him . His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys , and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land . All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him .

verses.z: 空中的飛鳥都要宿在這敗落的樹上，田野的走獸都要臥在它的枝條下，
verses.e: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin , and all the animals of the field will be on his branches ,

verses.z: 好使水旁的諸樹不因高大而自尊，也不將樹尖插入雲中，並且那些得水滋潤、有勢力的，也不得高大自立。因為它們在世人中，和下坑的人都被交與死亡，到陰府去了。」
verses.e: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature , and don't set their top among the thick boughs . Their mighty ones don't stand up on their height , even all who drink water ; for they are all delivered to death , to the lower parts of the earth , among the children of men , with those who go down to the pit . '

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「它下陰間的那日，我便使人悲哀。我為它遮蓋深淵，使江河凝結，大水停流；我也使黎巴嫩為它悽慘，田野的諸樹都因它發昏。
verses.e: " The Lord GOD says : ' In the day when he went down to Sheol , I caused a mourning . I covered the deep for him , and I restrained its rivers . The great waters were stopped . I caused Lebanon to mourn for him , and all the trees of the field fainted for him .

verses.z: 我將它扔到陰間，與下坑的人一同下去。那時，列國聽見它墜落的響聲就都震動，並且伊甸的一切樹－就是黎巴嫩得水滋潤、最佳最美的樹－都在陰府受了安慰。
verses.e: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall , when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit . All the trees of Eden , the choice and best of Lebanon , all that drink water , were comforted in the lower parts of the earth .

verses.z: 它們也與它同下陰間，到被殺的人那裏。它們曾作它的膀臂，在列國中它的蔭下居住。
verses.e: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword ; yes , those who were his arm , who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations .

verses.z: 在這樣榮耀威勢上，在伊甸[園]諸樹中，誰能與你相比呢？然而你要與伊甸的諸樹一同下到陰府，在未受割禮的人中，與被殺的人一同躺臥。「法老和他的群眾乃是如此。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: " ' To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden ? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth . You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised , with those who are slain by the sword . " ' This is Pharaoh and all his multitude , ' says the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老和他的眾人說：在威勢上誰能與你相比呢？
verses.e: " Son of man , tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude : ' Whom are you like in your greatness ?

verses.z: 亞述王曾如黎巴嫩中的香柏樹，枝條榮美，影密如林，極其高大，樹尖插入雲中。
verses.e: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches , and with a forest-like shade , of high stature ; and its top was among the thick boughs .

verses.z: 眾水使它生長；深水使它長大。所栽之地有江河圍流，汊出的水道延到田野諸樹。
verses.e: The waters nourished it . The deep made it to grow . Its rivers ran all around its plantation . It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field .

verses.z: 所以它高大超過田野諸樹；發旺的時候，枝子繁多，因得大水之力枝條長長。
verses.e: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field ; and its boughs were multiplied . Its branches became long by reason of many waters , when it spread them out .

verses.z: 空中的飛鳥都在枝子上搭窩；田野的走獸都在枝條下生子；所有大國的人民都在它蔭下居住。
verses.e: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs . Under its branches , all the animals of the field gave birth to their young . All great nations lived under its shadow .

verses.z: 樹大條長，成為榮美，因為根在眾水之旁。
verses.e: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness , in the length of its branches ; for its root was by many waters .

verses.z: 上帝園中的香柏樹不能遮蔽它；松樹不及它的枝子；楓樹不及它的枝條；上帝園中的樹都沒有它榮美。
verses.e: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it . The cypress trees were not like its branches . The pine trees were not like its branches ; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty .

verses.z: 我使它的枝條蕃多，成為榮美，以致上帝伊甸園中的樹都嫉妒它。」
verses.e: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches , so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied it . '

verses.z: 十二年十二月初一日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: In the twelfth year , in the twelfth month , in the first day of the month , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 我在許多國民和君王面前[向你]掄我的刀，國民就必因你驚奇，君王也必因你極其恐慌。在你仆倒的日子，他們各人為自己的性命時刻戰兢。」
verses.e: Yes , I will make many peoples amazed at you , and their kings will be horribly afraid for you , when I brandish my sword before them . They will tremble at every moment , every man for his own life , in the day of your fall . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「巴比倫王的刀必臨到你。
verses.e: For the Lord GOD says : " The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you .

verses.z: 我必藉勇士的刀使你的眾民仆倒；這勇士都是列國中強暴的。他們必使埃及的驕傲歸於無有；埃及的眾民必被滅絕。
verses.e: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty . They are all the ruthless of the nations . They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing , and all its multitude will be destroyed .

verses.z: 我必從埃及多水旁除滅所有的走獸；人腳獸蹄必不再攪渾這水。
verses.e: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters . The foot of man won't trouble them any more , nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them .

verses.z: 那時，我必使埃及河澄清，江河像油緩流。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: Then I will make their waters clear , and cause their rivers to run like oil , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我使埃及地變為荒廢淒涼；這地缺少從前所充滿的，又擊殺其中一切的居民。那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: " When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste , a land destitute of that of which it was full , when I strike all those who dwell therein , then they will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「人必用這哀歌去哀哭，列國的女子為埃及和她的群眾也必以此悲哀。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: " ' " This is the lamentation with which they will lament . The daughters of the nations will lament with this . They will lament with it over Egypt , and over all her multitude , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 十二年[十二]月十五日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: Also in the twelfth year , in the fifteenth day of the month , the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要為埃及群眾哀號，又要將埃及和有名之國的女子，並下坑的人，一同扔到陰府去。
verses.e: " Son of man , wail for the multitude of Egypt , and cast them down , even her and the daughters of the famous nations , to the lower parts of the earth , with those who go down into the pit .

verses.z: 你埃及的美麗勝過誰呢？你下去與未受割禮的人一同躺臥吧！
verses.e: Whom do you pass in beauty ? Go down , and be laid with the uncircumcised .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要為埃及王法老作哀歌，說：從前你在列國中，如同少壯獅子；現在你卻像海中的大魚。你衝出江河，用爪攪動諸水，使江河渾濁。
verses.e: " Son of man , take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt , and tell him , ' You were likened to a young lion of the nations ; yet you are as a monster in the seas . You broke out with your rivers , and troubled the waters with your feet , and fouled their rivers . ' "

verses.z: 他們必在被殺的人中仆到。她被交給刀劍，要把她和她的群眾拉去。
verses.e: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword . She is delivered to the sword . Draw her away with all her multitudes .

verses.z: 強盛的勇士要在陰間對埃及王和幫助他的說話；他們是未受割禮被殺的人，已經下去，躺臥不動。
