verses.e: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him . They have gone down . The uncircumcised lie still , slain by the sword .

verses.z: 「亞述和她的眾民都在那裏，她[民]的墳墓在她四圍；他們都是被殺倒在刀下的。
verses.e: " Asshur is there with all her company . Her graves are all around her . All of them are slain , fallen by the sword ,

verses.z: 他們的墳墓在坑中極深之處。她的眾民在她墳墓的四圍，都是被殺倒在刀下的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐。
verses.e: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit , and her company is around her grave , all of them slain , fallen by the sword , who caused terror in the land of the living .

verses.z: 「以攔也在那裏，她的群眾在她墳墓的四圍，都是被殺倒在刀下、未受割禮而下陰府的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐，並且與下坑的人一同擔當羞辱。
verses.e: " There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave ; all of them slain , fallen by the sword , who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth , who caused their terror in the land of the living , and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit .

verses.z: 人給她和她的群眾在被殺的人中設立床榻。她[民]的墳墓在她四圍，他們都是未受割禮被刀殺的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐，並且與下坑的人一同擔當羞辱。以攔已經放在被殺的人中。
verses.e: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude . Her graves are around her , all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword ; for their terror was caused in the land of the living , and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit . He is put among those who are slain .

verses.z: 「米設、土巴，和她們的群眾都在那裏。她[民]的墳墓在她四圍，他們都是未受割禮被刀殺的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐。
verses.e: " There is Meshech , Tubal , and all their multitude . Their graves are around them , all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword ; for they caused their terror in the land of the living .

verses.z: 他們不得與那未受割禮仆倒的勇士一同躺臥；這些勇士帶着兵器下陰間，頭枕刀劍，骨頭上有本身的罪孽；[他們]曾在活人之地使勇士驚恐。
verses.e: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised , who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads . Their iniquities are on their bones ; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living .

verses.z: 「法老啊，你必在未受割禮的人中敗壞，與那些被殺的人一同躺臥。
verses.e: " But you will be broken among the uncircumcised , and will lie with those who are slain by the sword .

verses.z: 「以東也在那裏。她君王和一切首領雖然仗着勢力，還是放在被殺的人中；他們必與未受割禮的和下坑的人一同躺臥。
verses.e: " There is Edom , her kings , and all her princes , who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword . They will lie with the uncircumcised , and with those who go down to the pit .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：我必用多國的人民，將我的網撒在你身上，把你拉上來。
verses.e: The Lord GOD says : " I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples . They will bring you up in my net .

verses.z: 「在那裏有北方的眾王子和一切西頓人，都與被殺的人下去。他們雖然仗着勢力使人驚恐，還是蒙羞。他們未受割禮，和被刀殺的一同躺臥，與下坑的人一同擔當羞辱。
verses.e: " There are the princes of the north , all of them , and all the Sidonians , who have gone down with the slain . They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might . They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword , and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit .

verses.z: 「法老看見他們，便為他被殺的軍隊受安慰。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude , even Pharaoh and all his army , slain by the sword , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我任憑法老在活人之地使人驚恐，法老和他的群眾必放在未受割禮和被殺的人中。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: " For I have put his terror in the land of the living . He will be laid among the uncircumcised , with those who are slain by the sword , even Pharaoh and all his multitude , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我必將你丟在地上，拋在田野，使空中的飛鳥都落在你身上，使遍地的野獸吃你得飽。
verses.e: I will leave you on the land . I will cast you out on the open field , and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you . I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you .

verses.z: 我必將你的肉丟在山間，用你高大的[屍首]填滿山谷。
verses.e: I will lay your flesh on the mountains , and fill the valleys with your height .

verses.z: 我又必用你的血澆灌你所游泳之地，漫過山頂；河道都必充滿。
verses.e: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood , even to the mountains . The watercourses will be full of you .

verses.z: 我將你撲滅的時候，要把天遮蔽，使眾星昏暗，以密雲遮掩太陽，月亮也不放光。
verses.e: When I extinguish you , I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark . I will cover the sun with a cloud , and the moon won't give its light .

verses.z: 我必使天上的亮光都在你以上變為昏暗，使你的地上黑暗。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you , and set darkness on your land , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「我使你敗亡[的風聲]傳到你所不認識的各國。那時，我必使多民的心因你愁煩。
verses.e: " I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples , when I bring your destruction among the nations , into the countries which you have not known .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要對以色列家說：『你們常說：我們的過犯罪惡在我們身上，我們必因此消滅，怎能存活呢？』
verses.e: " You , son of man , tell the house of Israel : ' You say this , " Our transgressions and our sins are on us , and we pine away in them . How then can we live ? " '

verses.z: 你對他們說，主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我斷不喜悅惡人死亡，惟喜悅惡人轉離所行的道而活。以色列家啊，你們轉回，轉回吧！離開惡道，何必死亡呢？
verses.e: Tell them , ' " As I live , " says the Lord GOD , " I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked , but that the wicked turn from his way and live . Turn , turn from your evil ways ! For why will you die , house of Israel ? " '

verses.z: 人子啊，你要對本國的人民說：義人的義，在犯罪之日不能救他；至於惡人的惡，在他轉離惡行之日也不能使他傾倒；義人在犯罪之日也不能因他的義存活。
verses.e: " You , son of man , tell the children of your people , ' The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience . And as for the wickedness of the wicked , he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness ; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins .

verses.z: 我對義人說：『你必定存活！』他若倚靠他的義而作罪孽，他所行的義都不被記念。他必因所作的罪孽死亡。
verses.e: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live , if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity , none of his righteous deeds will be remembered ; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed .

verses.z: 再者，我對惡人說：『你必定死亡！』他若轉離他的罪，行正直與合理的事：
verses.e: Again , when I say to the wicked , " You will surely die , " if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right ,

verses.z: 還人的當頭和所搶奪的，遵行生命的律例，不作罪孽，他必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.e: if the wicked restore the pledge , give again that which he had taken by robbery , walk in the statutes of life , committing no iniquity , he will surely live . He will not die .

verses.z: 他所犯的一切罪必不被記念。他行了正直與合理的事，必定存活。
verses.e: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him . He has done that which is lawful and right . He will surely live .

verses.z: 「你本國的子民還說：『主的道不公平。』其實他們的道不公平。
verses.e: " ' Yet the children of your people say , " The way of the Lord is not fair ; " but as for them , their way is not fair .

verses.z: 義人轉離他的義而作罪孽，就必因此死亡。
verses.e: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity , he will even die therein .

verses.z: 惡人轉離他的惡，行正直與合理的事，就必因此存活。
verses.e: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right , he will live by it .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要告訴本國的子民說：我使刀劍臨到哪一國，那一國的民從他們中間選立一人為守望的。
verses.e: " Son of man , speak to the children of your people , and tell them , ' When I bring the sword on a land , and the people of the land take a man from among them , and set him for their watchman ,

verses.z: 你們還說：『主的道不公平。』以色列家啊，我必按你們各人所行的審判你們。」
verses.e: Yet you say , " The way of the Lord is not fair . " House of Israel , I will judge every one of you after his ways . ' "

verses.z: 我們被擄之後十二年十[月]初五[日]，有人從耶路撒冷逃到我這裏，說：「城已攻破。」
verses.e: In the twelfth year of our captivity , in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month , one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me , saying , " The city has been defeated ! "

verses.z: 逃來的人未到前一日的晚上，耶和華的靈降在我身上，開我的口。到第二日早晨，那人來到我這裏，我口就開了，不再緘默。
verses.e: Now the LORD's hand had been on me in the evening , before he who had escaped came ; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning ; and my mouth was opened , and I was no longer mute .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，住在以色列荒廢之地的人說：『亞伯拉罕獨自一人能得這地為業，我們人數眾多，這地[更]是給我們為業的。』
verses.e: " Son of man , those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak , saying , ' Abraham was one , and he inherited the land ; but we are many . The land is given us for inheritance . '

verses.z: 所以你要對他們說，主耶和華如此說：你們吃帶血的物，仰望偶像，並且殺人流血，你們還能得這地為業嗎？
verses.e: Therefore tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " You eat with the blood , and lift up your eyes to your idols , and shed blood . So should you possess the land ?

verses.z: 你們倚仗自己的刀劍行可憎的事，人人玷污鄰舍的妻，你們還能得這地為業嗎？
verses.e: You stand on your sword , you work abomination , and every one of you defiles his neighbor's wife . So should you possess the land ? " '

verses.z: 你要對他們這樣說，主耶和華如此說：我指着我的永生起誓，在荒場中的，必倒在刀下；在田野間的，必交給野獸吞吃；在保障和洞裏的，必遭瘟疫而死。
verses.e: " You shall tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " As I live , surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword . I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured , and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence .

verses.z: 我必使這地荒涼，令人驚駭；她因勢力而有的驕傲也必止息。以色列的山都必荒涼，無人經過。
verses.e: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment . The pride of her power will cease . The mountains of Israel will be desolate , so that no one will pass through .

verses.z: 我因他們所行一切可憎的事使地荒涼，令人驚駭。那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: Then they will know that I am the LORD , when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed . " '

verses.z: 他見刀劍臨到那地，若吹角警戒眾民，
verses.e: if , when he sees the sword come on the land , he blows the trumpet and warns the people ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你本國的子民在牆垣旁邊、在房屋門口談論你。弟兄對弟兄彼此說：『來吧！聽聽有甚麼話從耶和華而出。』
verses.e: " As for you , son of man , the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses , and speak to one another , everyone to his brother , saying , ' Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD . '

verses.z: 他們來到你這裏如同民來[聚會]，坐在你面前彷彿是我的民。他們聽你的話卻不去行；因為他們的口多顯愛情，心卻追隨財利。
verses.e: They come to you as the people come , and they sit before you as my people , and they hear your words , but don't do them ; for with their mouth they show much love , but their heart goes after their gain .

verses.z: 他們看你如善於奏樂、聲音幽雅之人所唱的雅歌，他們聽你的話卻不去行。
verses.e: Behold , you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice , and can play well on an instrument ; for they hear your words , but they don't do them .

verses.z: 看哪，所說的快要應驗；應驗了，他們就知道在他們中間有了先知。」
verses.e: " When this comes to pass — behold , it comes — then they will know that a prophet has been among them . "

verses.z: 凡聽見角聲不受警戒的，刀劍若來除滅了他，他的罪就必歸到自己的頭上。
verses.e: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn't heed the warning , if the sword comes and takes him away , his blood will be on his own head .

verses.z: 他聽見角聲，不受警戒，他的罪必歸到自己的身上；他若受警戒，便是救了自己的性命。
verses.e: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn't take warning . His blood will be on him ; whereas if he had heeded the warning , he would have delivered his soul .

verses.z: 倘若守望的人見刀劍臨到，不吹角，以致民不受警戒，刀劍來殺了他們中間的一個人，他雖然死在罪孽之中，我卻要向守望的人討他喪命的罪。
verses.e: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn't blow the trumpet , and the people aren't warned , and the sword comes and takes any person from among them , he is taken away in his iniquity , but his blood I will require at the watchman's hand . '

verses.z: 「人子啊，我照樣立你作以色列家守望的人。所以你要聽我口中的話，替我警戒他們。
verses.e: " So you , son of man , I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel . Therefore hear the word from my mouth , and give them warnings from me .

verses.z: 我對惡人說：『惡人哪，你必要死！』你－以西結若不開口警戒惡人，使他離開所行的道，這惡人必死在罪孽之中，我卻要向你討他喪命的罪。
verses.e: When I tell the wicked , ' O wicked man , you will surely die , ' and you don't speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man will die in his iniquity , but I will require his blood at your hand .

verses.z: 倘若你警戒惡人轉離所行的道，他仍不轉離，他必死在罪孽之中，你卻救自己脫離了罪。」
verses.e: Nevertheless , if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it , and he doesn't turn from his way ; he will die in his iniquity , but you have delivered your soul .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：我必與牧人為敵，必向他們的手追討我的羊，使他們不再牧放群羊；牧人也不再牧養自己。我必救我的羊脫離他們的口，不再作他們的食物。」
verses.e: The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I am against the shepherds . I will require my sheep at their hand , and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep . The shepherds won't feed themselves any more . I will deliver my sheep from their mouth , that they may not be food for them . "

verses.z: 「主耶和華如此說：看哪，我必親自尋找我的羊，將牠們尋見。
verses.e: " ' For the Lord GOD says : " Behold , I myself , even I , will search for my sheep , and will seek them out .

verses.z: 牧人在羊群四散的日子怎樣尋找他的羊，我必照樣尋找我的羊。這些羊在密雲黑暗的日子散到各處，我必從那裏救回牠們來。
verses.e: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad , so I will seek out my sheep . I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day .

verses.z: 我必從萬民中領出牠們，從各國內聚集牠們，引導牠們歸回故土，也必在以色列山上－一切溪水旁邊、境內一切可居之處－牧養牠們。
verses.e: I will bring them out from the peoples , and gather them from the countries , and will bring them into their own land . I will feed them on the mountains of Israel , by the watercourses , and in all the inhabited places of the country .

verses.z: 我必在美好的草場牧養牠們。牠們的圈必在以色列高處的山上，牠們必在佳美之圈中躺臥，也在以色列山肥美的草場吃草。
verses.e: I will feed them with good pasture , and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel . There they will lie down in a good fold . They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：我必親自作我羊的牧人，使牠們得以躺臥。
verses.e: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep , and I will cause them to lie down , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 失喪的，我必尋找；被逐的，我必領回；受傷的，我必纏裹；有病的，我必醫治；只是肥的壯的，我必除滅，也要秉公牧養牠們。
verses.e: " I will seek that which was lost , and will bring back that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick ; but I will destroy the fat and the strong . I will feed them in justice . " '

verses.z: 「我的羊群哪，論到你們，主耶和華如此說：我必在羊與羊中間、公綿羊與公山羊中間施行判斷。
verses.e: " As for you , O my flock , the Lord GOD says : ' Behold , I judge between sheep and sheep , the rams and the male goats .

verses.z: 你們這些[肥壯的羊]，在美好的草場吃草還以為小事嗎？剩下的草，你們竟用蹄踐踏了；你們喝清水，剩下的水，你們竟用蹄攪渾了。
verses.e: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture , but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture ? And to have drunk of the clear waters , but must you foul the residue with your feet ?

verses.z: 至於我的羊，只得吃你們所踐踏的，喝你們所攪渾的。
verses.e: As for my sheep , they eat that which you have trodden with your feet , and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet . '

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要向以色列的牧人發預言，攻擊他們，說，主耶和華如此說：禍哉！以色列的牧人只知牧養自己。牧人豈不當牧養群羊嗎？
verses.e: " Son of man , prophesy against the shepherds of Israel . Prophesy , and tell them , even the shepherds , ' The Lord GOD says : " Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves ! Shouldn't the shepherds feed the sheep ?

verses.z: 「所以，主耶和華如此說：我必在肥羊和瘦羊中間施行判斷。
verses.e: " Therefore the Lord GOD says to them : ' Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep .

verses.z: 因為你們用脅用肩擁擠一切瘦弱的，又用角牴觸，以致使牠們四散。
verses.e: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder , and push all the diseased with your horns , until you have scattered them abroad ,

verses.z: 所以，我必拯救我的群羊不再作掠物；我也必在羊和羊中間施行判斷。
verses.e: therefore I will save my flock , and they will no more be a prey . I will judge between sheep and sheep .

verses.z: 我必立一牧人照管他們，牧養他們，就是我的僕人大衛。他必牧養他們，作他們的牧人。
verses.e: I will set up one shepherd over them , and he will feed them , even my servant David . He will feed them , and he will be their shepherd .

verses.z: 我－耶和華必作他們的上帝，我的僕人大衛必在他們中間作王。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I , the LORD , will be their God , and my servant David prince among them . I , the LORD , have spoken it .

verses.z: 「我必與他們立平安的約，使惡獸從境內斷絕，他們就必安居在曠野，躺臥在林中。
verses.e: " ' I will make with them a covenant of peace , and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land . They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods .

verses.z: 我必使他們與我山的四圍成為福源，我也必叫時雨落下，必有福[如]甘霖而降。
verses.e: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing . I will cause the shower to come down in its season . There will be showers of blessing .

verses.z: 田野的樹必結果，地也必有出產；他們必在故土安然居住。我折斷他們所負的軛，救他們脫離那以他們為奴之人的手；那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: The tree of the field will yield its fruit , and the earth will yield its increase , and they will be secure in their land . Then they will know that I am the LORD , when I have broken the bars of their yoke , and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them .

verses.z: 他們必不再作外邦人的掠物，地上的野獸也不再吞吃他們；卻要安然居住，無人驚嚇。
verses.e: They will no more be a prey to the nations , neither will the animals of the earth devour them ; but they will dwell securely , and no one will make them afraid .

verses.z: 我必給他們興起有名的植物；他們在境內不再為饑荒所滅，也不再受外邦人的羞辱，
verses.e: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown , and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land , and not bear the shame of the nations any more .

verses.z: 你們吃脂油、穿羊毛、宰肥壯的，卻不牧養群羊。
verses.e: You eat the fat . You clothe yourself with the wool . You kill the fatlings , but you don't feed the sheep .

verses.z: 必知道我、耶和華－他們的上帝是與他們同在的，並知道他們－以色列家是我的民。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: They will know that I , the LORD , their God am with them , and that they , the house of Israel , are my people , says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 你們作我的羊，我草場上的羊，乃是以色列人，我也是你們的上帝。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: You my sheep , the sheep of my pasture , are men , and I am your God , ' says the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 瘦弱的，你們沒有養壯；有病的，你們沒有醫治；受傷的，你們沒有纏裹；被逐的，你們沒有領回；失喪的，你們沒有尋找；但用強暴嚴嚴地轄制。
verses.e: You haven't strengthened the diseased . You haven't healed that which was sick . You haven't bound up that which was broken . You haven't brought back that which was driven away . You haven't sought that which was lost , but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor .

verses.z: 因無牧人，羊就分散；既分散，便作了一切野獸的食物。
verses.e: They were scattered , because there was no shepherd . They became food to all the animals of the field , and were scattered .

verses.z: 我的羊在諸山間、在各高岡上流離，在全地上分散，無人去尋，無人去找。
verses.e: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill . Yes , my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth . There was no one who searched or sought . "

verses.z: 「所以，你們這些牧人要聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: " ' Therefore , you shepherds , hear the LORD's word :

verses.z: 主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我的羊因無牧人就成為掠物，也作了一切野獸的食物。我的牧人不尋找我的羊；這些牧人只知牧養自己，並不牧養我的羊。
verses.e: " As I live , " says the Lord GOD , " surely because my sheep became a prey , and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field , because there was no shepherd , and my shepherds didn't search for my sheep , but the shepherds fed themselves , and didn't feed my sheep ,

verses.z: 所以你們這些牧人要聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: therefore , you shepherds , hear the LORD's word ! "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「因為你曾說：『這二國這二邦必歸於我，我必得為業』（其實耶和華仍在那裏），
verses.e: " ' " Because you have said , ' These two nations and these two countries will be mine , and we will possess it , ' although the LORD was there ,

verses.z: 所以主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必照你的怒氣和你從仇恨中向他們所發的嫉妒待你。我審判你的時候，必將自己顯明在他們中間。
verses.e: therefore , as I live , " says the Lord GOD , " I will do according to your anger , and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them ; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you .

verses.z: 你也必知道我－耶和華聽見了你的一切毀謗，就是你攻擊以色列山的話，說：『這些山荒涼，是歸我們吞滅的。』
verses.e: You will know that I , the LORD , have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel , saying , ' They have been laid desolate . They have been given to us to devour . '

verses.z: 你們也用口向我誇大，增添與我反對的話，我都聽見了。
verses.e: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth , and have multiplied your words against me . I have heard it . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：全地歡樂的時候，我必使你荒涼。
verses.e: The Lord GOD says : " When the whole earth rejoices , I will make you desolate .

verses.z: 你怎樣因以色列家的地業荒涼而喜樂，我必照你所行的待你。西珥山哪，你和以東全地必都荒涼。你們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate , so I will do to you . You will be desolate , Mount Seir , and all Edom , even all of it . Then they will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要面向西珥山發預言，攻擊它，
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face against Mount Seir , and prophesy against it ,

verses.z: 對它說，主耶和華如此說：西珥山哪，我與你為敵，必向你伸手攻擊你，使你荒涼，令人驚駭。
verses.e: and tell it , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I am against you , Mount Seir , and I will stretch out my hand against you . I will make you a desolation and an astonishment .

verses.z: 我必使你的城邑變為荒場，成為淒涼。你就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will lay your cities waste , and you will be desolate . Then you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 因為你永懷仇恨，在以色列人遭災、罪孽到了盡頭的時候，將他們交與刀劍，
verses.e: " ' " Because you have had a perpetual hostility , and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time of the iniquity of the end ,

verses.z: 所以主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭遇流血的報應，罪必追趕你；你既不恨惡殺人流血，所以這罪必追趕你。
verses.e: therefore , as I live , " says the Lord GOD , " I will prepare you for blood , and blood will pursue you . Since you have not hated blood , therefore blood will pursue you .

verses.z: 我必使西珥山荒涼，令人驚駭，來往經過的人我必剪除。
verses.e: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation . I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns .

verses.z: 我必使西珥山滿有被殺的人。被刀殺的，必倒在你小山和山谷，並一切的溪水中。
verses.e: I will fill its mountains with its slain . The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses .

verses.z: 我必使你永遠荒涼，使你的城邑無人居住，你的民就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will make you a perpetual desolation , and your cities will not be inhabited . Then you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要對以色列山發預言說：以色列山哪，要聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: You , son of man , prophesy to the mountains of Israel , and say , " You mountains of Israel , hear the LORD's word .

verses.z: 我必使以色列全家的人數在你上面增多，城邑有人居住，荒場再被建造。
verses.e: I will multiply men on you , all the house of Israel , even all of it . The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built .

verses.z: 我必使人和牲畜在你上面加增；他們必生養眾多。我要使你照舊有人居住，並要賜福與你比先前更多，你就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: I will multiply man and animal on you . They will increase and be fruitful . I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before , and you will do better than at your beginnings . Then you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 我必使人，就是我的民以色列，行在你上面。他們必得你為業；你也不再使他們喪子。
verses.e: Yes , I will cause men to walk on you , even my people Israel . They will possess you , and you will be their inheritance , and you will never again bereave them of their children . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：因為人對你說：『你是吞吃人的，又使國民喪子』，
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " Because they say to you , ' You are a devourer of men , and have been a bereaver of your nation ; '

verses.z: 所以主耶和華說：你必不再吞吃人，也不再使國民喪子。
verses.e: therefore you shall devour men no more , and not bereave your nation any more , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我使你不再聽見各國的羞辱，不再受萬民的辱罵，也不再使國民絆跌。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: " I won't let you hear the shame of the nations any more . You won't bear the reproach of the peoples any more , and you won't cause your nation to stumble any more , " says the Lord GOD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，以色列家住在本地的時候，在行動作為上玷污那地。他們的行為在我面前，好像正在經期的婦人那樣污穢。
verses.e: " Son of man , when the house of Israel lived in their own land , they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds . Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity .

verses.z: 所以我因他們在那地上流人的血，又因他們以偶像玷污那地，就把我的忿怒傾在他們身上。
verses.e: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land , and because they had defiled it with their idols .

verses.z: 我將他們分散在列國，四散在列邦，按他們的行動作為懲罰他們。
verses.e: I scattered them among the nations , and they were dispersed through the countries . I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：因仇敵說：『阿哈！這永久的山岡都歸我們為業了！』
verses.e: The Lord GOD says : ' Because the enemy has said against you , " Aha ! " and , " The ancient high places are ours in possession ! " '

verses.z: 他們到了所去的列國，就使我的聖名被褻瀆；因為人談論他們說，這是耶和華的民，是從耶和華的地出來的。
verses.e: When they came to the nations where they went , they profaned my holy name , in that men said of them , ' These are the LORD's people , and have left his land . '

verses.z: 我卻顧惜我的聖名，就是以色列家在所到的列國中所褻瀆的。
verses.e: But I had respect for my holy name , which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went .

verses.z: 「所以，你要對以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：以色列家啊，我行這事不是為你們，乃是為我的聖名，就是在你們到的列國中所褻瀆的。
verses.e: " Therefore tell the house of Israel , ' The Lord GOD says : " I don't do this for your sake , house of Israel , but for my holy name , which you have profaned among the nations where you went .

verses.z: 我要使我的大名顯為聖；這名在列國中已被褻瀆，就是你們在他們中間所褻瀆的。我在他們眼前，在你們身上顯為聖的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will sanctify my great name , which has been profaned among the nations , which you have profaned among them . Then the nations will know that I am the LORD , " says the Lord GOD , " when I am proven holy in you before their eyes .

verses.z: 我必從各國收取你們，從列邦聚集你們，引導你們歸回本地。
verses.e: " ' " For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries , and will bring you into your own land .

verses.z: 我必用清水灑在你們身上，你們就潔淨了。我要潔淨你們，使你們脫離一切的污穢，棄掉一切的偶像。
verses.e: I will sprinkle clean water on you , and you will be clean . I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols .

verses.z: 我也要賜給你們一個新心，將新靈放在你們裏面，又從你們的肉體中除掉石心，賜給你們肉心。
verses.e: I will also give you a new heart , and I will put a new spirit within you . I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh , and I will give you a heart of flesh .

verses.z: 我必將我的靈放在你們裏面，使你們順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章。
verses.e: I will put my Spirit within you , and cause you to walk in my statutes . You will keep my ordinances and do them .

verses.z: 你們必住在我所賜給你們列祖之地。你們要作我的子民，我要作你們的上帝。
verses.e: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers . You will be my people , and I will be your God .

verses.z: 我必救你們脫離一切的污穢，也必命五穀豐登，不使你們遭遇饑荒。
verses.e: I will save you from all your uncleanness . I will call for the grain and will multiply it , and lay no famine on you .

verses.z: 所以要發預言說，主耶和華如此說：因為敵人使你荒涼，四圍吞吃，好叫你歸與其餘的外邦人為業，並且多嘴多舌的人提起你來，百姓也說你有臭名。
verses.e: therefore prophesy , and say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Because , even because they have made you desolate , and swallowed you up on every side , that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations , and you are taken up in the lips of talkers , and the evil report of the people ; "

verses.z: 我必使樹木多結果子，田地多出土產，好叫你們不再因饑荒受外邦人的譏誚。
verses.e: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field , that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations .

verses.z: 那時，你們必追想你們的惡行和你們不善的作為，就因你們的罪孽和可憎的事厭惡自己。
verses.e: " ' " Then you will remember your evil ways , and your deeds that were not good ; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：你們要知道，我這樣行不是為你們。以色列家啊，當為自己的行為抱愧蒙羞。
verses.e: I don't do this for your sake , " says the Lord GOD . " Let it be known to you . Be ashamed and confounded for your ways , house of Israel . "

verses.z: 「主耶和華如此說：我潔淨你們，使你們脫離一切罪孽的日子，必使城邑有人居住，荒場再被建造。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities , I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built .

verses.z: 過路的人雖看為荒廢之地，現今這荒廢之地仍得耕種。
verses.e: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by .

verses.z: 他們必說：『這先前為荒廢之地，現在成如伊甸園；這荒廢淒涼、毀壞的城邑現在堅固有人居住。』
verses.e: They will say , ' This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden . The waste , desolate , and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited . '

verses.z: 那時，在你們四圍其餘的外邦人必知道我－耶和華修造那毀壞之處，培植那荒廢之地。我－耶和華說過，也必成就。
verses.e: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I , the LORD , have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate . I , the LORD , have spoken it , and I will do it . "

verses.z: 「主耶和華如此說：我要加增以色列家的人數，多如羊群。他們必為這事向我求問，我要給他們成就。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " For this , moreover , I will be inquired of by the house of Israel , to do it for them : I will increase them with men like a flock .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷在守節作祭物所獻的羊群怎樣多，照樣，荒涼的城邑必被人群充滿。他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: As the flock for sacrifice , as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts , so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men . Then they will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 故此，以色列山要聽主耶和華的話。大山小岡、水溝山谷、荒廢之地、被棄之城，為四圍其餘的外邦人所佔據、所譏刺的，
verses.e: therefore , you mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord GOD : The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills , to the watercourses and to the valleys , to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken , which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around ;

verses.z: 主耶和華對你們如此說：我真發憤恨如火，責備那其餘的外邦人和以東的眾人。他們快樂滿懷，心存恨惡，將我的地歸自己為業，又看為被棄的掠物。
verses.e: therefore the Lord GOD says : " Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations , and against all Edom , that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart , with despite of soul , to cast it out for a prey . " '

verses.z: 所以，你要指着以色列地說預言，對大山小岡、水溝山谷說，主耶和華如此說：我發憤恨和忿怒說，因你們曾受外邦人的羞辱，
verses.e: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel , and tell the mountains , the hills , the watercourses and the valleys , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath , because you have borne the shame of the nations . "

verses.z: 所以我起誓說：你們四圍的外邦人總要擔當自己的羞辱。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says : " I have sworn , ' Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame . '

verses.z: 「以色列山哪，你必發枝條，為我的民以色列結果子，因為他們快要來到。
verses.e: " ' " But you , mountains of Israel , you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel ; for they are at hand to come .

verses.z: 看哪，我是幫助你的，也必向你轉意，使你得以耕種。
verses.e: For , behold , I am for you , and I will come to you , and you will be tilled and sown .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈降在我身上。耶和華藉他的靈帶我出去，將我放在平原中；這平原遍滿骸骨。
verses.e: The LORD's hand was on me , and he brought me out in the LORD's Spirit , and set me down in the middle of the valley ; and it was full of bones .

verses.z: 於是我遵命說預言，氣息就進入骸骨，骸骨便活了，並且站起來，成為極大的軍隊。
verses.e: So I prophesied as he commanded me , and the breath came into them , and they lived , and stood up on their feet , an exceedingly great army .

verses.z: 主對我說：「人子啊，這些骸骨就是以色列全家。他們說：『我們的骨頭枯乾了，我們的指望失去了，我們滅絕淨盡了。』
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Son of man , these bones are the whole house of Israel . Behold , they say , ' Our bones are dried up , and our hope is lost . We are completely cut off . '

verses.z: 所以你要發預言對他們說，主耶和華如此說：『我的民哪，我必開你們的墳墓，使你們從墳墓中出來，領你們進入以色列地。
verses.e: Therefore prophesy , and tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I will open your graves , and cause you to come up out of your graves , my people ; and I will bring you into the land of Israel .

verses.z: 我的民哪，我開你們的墳墓，使你們從墳墓中出來，你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: You will know that I am the LORD , when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves , my people .

verses.z: 我必將我的靈放在你們裏面，你們就要活了。我將你們安置在本地，你們就知道我－耶和華如此說，也如此成就了。這是耶和華說的。』」
verses.e: I will put my Spirit in you , and you will live . Then I will place you in your own land ; and you will know that I , the LORD , have spoken it and performed it , " says the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came again to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要取一根木杖，在其上寫『為猶大和他的同伴以色列人』；又取一根木杖，在其上寫『為約瑟，就是為以法蓮，又為他的同伴以色列全家』。
verses.e: " You , son of man , take one stick and write on it , ' For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions . ' Then take another stick , and write on it , ' For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions . '

verses.z: 你要使這兩根木杖接連為一，在你手中成為一根。
verses.e: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick , that they may become one in your hand .

verses.z: 你本國的子民問你說：『這是甚麼意思？你不指示我們嗎？』
verses.e: " When the children of your people speak to you , saying , ' Won't you show us what you mean by these ? '

verses.z: 你就對他們說：『主耶和華如此說：我要將約瑟和他同伴以色列支派的杖，就是那在以法蓮手中的，與猶大的杖一同接連為一，在我手中成為一根。』
verses.e: tell them , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim , and the tribes of Israel his companions ; and I will put them with it , with the stick of Judah , and make them one stick , and they will be one in my hand .

verses.z: 他使我從骸骨的四圍經過，誰知在平原的骸骨甚多，而且極其枯乾。
verses.e: He caused me to pass by them all around ; and behold , there were very many in the open valley , and behold , they were very dry .

verses.z: 你所寫的那兩根杖要在他們眼前拿在手中，
verses.e: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes . " '

verses.z: 要對他們說，主耶和華如此說：我要將以色列人從他們所到的各國收取，又從四圍聚集他們，引導他們歸回本地。
verses.e: Say to them , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land .

verses.z: 我要使他們在那地，在以色列山上成為一國，有一王作他們眾民的王。他們不再為二國，決不再分為二國；
verses.e: I will make them one nation in the land , on the mountains of Israel . One king will be king to them all . They will no longer be two nations . They won't be divided into two kingdoms any more at all .

verses.z: 也不再因偶像和可憎的物，並一切的罪過玷污自己。我卻要救他們出離一切的住處，就是他們犯罪的地方；我要潔淨他們，如此，他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的上帝。
verses.e: They won't defile themselves any more with their idols , nor with their detestable things , nor with any of their transgressions ; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned , and will cleanse them . So they will be my people , and I will be their God .

verses.z: 「我的僕人大衛必作他們的王；眾民必歸一個牧人。他們必順從我的典章，謹守遵行我的律例。
verses.e: " ' " My servant David will be king over them . They all will have one shepherd . They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes , and do them .

verses.z: 他們必住在我賜給我僕人雅各的地上，就是你們列祖所住之地。他們和他們的子孫，並子孫的子孫，都永遠住在那裏。我的僕人大衛必作他們的王，直到永遠。
verses.e: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant , in which your fathers lived . They will dwell therein , they , and their children , and their children's children , forever . David my servant will be their prince forever .

verses.z: 並且我要與他們立平安的約，作為永約。我也要將他們安置在[本地]，使他們的人數增多，又在他們中間設立我的聖所，直到永遠。
verses.e: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them . It will be an everlasting covenant with them . I will place them , multiply them , and will set my sanctuary among them forever more .

verses.z: 我的居所必在他們中間；我要作他們的上帝，他們要作我的子民。
verses.e: My tent also will be with them . I will be their God , and they will be my people .

verses.z: 我的聖所在以色列人中間直到永遠，外邦人就必知道我是叫以色列成為聖的耶和華。」
verses.e: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel , when my sanctuary is among them forever more . " ' "

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，這些骸骨能復活嗎？」我說：「主耶和華啊，你是知道的。」
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , can these bones live ? " I answered , " Lord GOD , you know . "

verses.z: 他又對我說：「你向這些骸骨發預言說：枯乾的骸骨啊，要聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: Again he said to me , " Prophesy over these bones , and tell them , ' You dry bones , hear the LORD's word .

verses.z: 主耶和華對這些骸骨如此說：『我必使氣息進入你們裏面，你們就要活了。
verses.e: The Lord GOD says to these bones : " Behold , I will cause breath to enter into you , and you will live .

verses.z: 我必給你們加上筋，使你們長肉，又將皮遮蔽你們，使氣息進入你們裏面，你們就要活了；你們便知道我是耶和華。』」
verses.e: I will lay sinews on you , and will bring up flesh on you , and cover you with skin , and put breath in you , and you will live . Then you will know that I am the LORD . " ' "

verses.z: 於是，我遵命說預言。正說預言的時候，不料，有響聲，有地震；骨與骨互相聯絡。
verses.e: So I prophesied as I was commanded . As I prophesied , there was a noise , and behold , there was an earthquake . Then the bones came together , bone to its bone .

verses.z: 我觀看，見骸骨上有筋，也長了肉，又有皮遮蔽其上，只是還沒有氣息。
verses.e: I saw , and , behold , there were sinews on them , and flesh came up , and skin covered them above ; but there was no breath in them .

verses.z: 主對我說：「人子啊，你要發預言，向風發預言，說主耶和華如此說：氣息啊，要從四方而來，吹在這些被殺的人身上，使他們活了。」
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Prophesy to the wind , prophesy , son of man , and tell the wind , ' The Lord GOD says : " Come from the four winds , breath , and breathe on these slain , that they may live . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「到那時，你心必起意念，圖謀惡計，
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind , and you will devise an evil plan .

verses.z: 說：『我要上那無城牆的鄉村，我要到那安靜的民那裏，他們都沒有城牆，無門、無閂，安然居住。
verses.e: You will say , ' I will go up to the land of unwalled villages . I will go to those who are at rest , who dwell securely , all of them dwelling without walls , and having neither bars nor gates ,

verses.z: 我去要搶財為擄物，奪貨為掠物，反手攻擊那從前荒涼、現在有人居住之地，又攻擊那住世界中間、從列國招聚、得了牲畜財貨的民。』
verses.e: to take the plunder and to take prey ; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited , and against the people who are gathered out of the nations , who have gotten livestock and goods , who dwell in the middle of the earth . '

verses.z: 示巴人、底但人、他施的客商，和其間的少壯獅子都必問你說：『你來要搶財為擄物嗎？你聚集軍隊要奪貨為掠物嗎？要奪取金銀，擄去牲畜、財貨嗎？要搶奪許多財寶為擄物嗎？』
verses.e: Sheba , Dedan , and the merchants of Tarshish , with all its young lions , will ask you , ' Have you come to take the plunder ? Have you assembled your company to take the prey , to carry away silver and gold , to take away livestock and goods , to take great plunder ? ' " '

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要因此發預言，對歌革說，主耶和華如此說：到我民以色列安然居住之日，你豈不知道嗎？
verses.e: " Therefore , son of man , prophesy , and tell Gog , ' The Lord GOD says : " In that day when my people Israel dwells securely , will you not know it ?

verses.z: 你必從本地，從北方的極處率領許多國的民來，都騎着馬，乃一大隊極多的軍兵。
verses.e: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north , you , and many peoples with you , all of them riding on horses , a great company and a mighty army .

verses.z: 歌革啊，你必上來攻擊我的民以色列，如密雲遮蓋地面。末後的日子，我必帶你來攻擊我的地，到我在外邦人眼前，在你身上顯為聖的時候，好叫他們認識我。
verses.e: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land . It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land , that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you , Gog , before their eyes . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：我在古時藉我的僕人以色列的先知所說的，就是你嗎？當日他們多年預言我必帶你來攻擊以色列人。」
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel , who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them ?

verses.z: 主耶和華說：「歌革上來攻擊以色列地的時候，我的怒氣要從鼻孔裏發出。
verses.e: It will happen in that day , when Gog comes against the land of Israel , " says the Lord GOD , " that my wrath will come up into my nostrils .

verses.z: 我發憤恨和烈怒如火說：那日在以色列地必有大震動，
verses.e: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken . Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel ,

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要面向瑪各地的歌革，就是羅施、米設、土巴的王發預言攻擊他，
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face toward Gog , of the land of Magog , the prince of Rosh , Meshech , and Tubal , and prophesy against him ,

verses.z: 甚至海中的魚、天空的鳥、田野的獸，並地上的一切昆蟲，和其上的眾人，因見我的面就都震動；山嶺必崩裂，陡巖必塌陷，牆垣都必坍倒。」
verses.e: so that the fish of the sea , the birds of the sky , the animals of the field , all creeping things who creep on the earth , and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence . Then the mountains will be thrown down , the steep places will fall , and every wall will fall to the ground .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：「我必命我的諸山發刀劍來攻擊歌革；人都要用刀劍殺害弟兄。
verses.e: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains , " says the Lord GOD . " Every man's sword will be against his brother .

verses.z: 我必用瘟疫和流血的事刑罰他。我也必將暴雨、大雹與火，並硫磺降與他和他的軍隊，並他所率領的眾民。
verses.e: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood . I will rain on him , on his hordes , and on the many peoples who are with him , torrential rains with great hailstones , fire , and sulfur .

verses.z: 我必顯為大，顯為聖，在多國人的眼前顯現；他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself , and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations . Then they will know that I am the LORD . " '

verses.z: 說主耶和華如此說：羅施、米設、土巴的王歌革啊，我與你為敵。
verses.e: and say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I am against you , Gog , prince of Rosh , Meshech , and Tubal .

verses.z: 我必用鉤子鉤住你的腮頰，調轉你，將你和你的軍兵、馬匹、馬兵帶出來，都披掛整齊，成了大隊，有大小盾牌，各拿刀劍。
verses.e: I will turn you around , and put hooks into your jaws , and I will bring you out , with all your army , horses and horsemen , all of them clothed in full armor , a great company with buckler and shield , all of them handling swords ;

verses.z: 波斯人、古實人，和弗人，各拿盾牌，頭上戴盔；
verses.e: Persia , Cush , and Put with them , all of them with shield and helmet ;

verses.z: 歌篾人和他的軍隊，北方極處的陀迦瑪族和他的軍隊，這許多國的民都同着你。
verses.e: Gomer , and all his hordes ; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north , and all his hordes — even many peoples with you .

verses.z: 「那聚集到你這裏的各隊都當準備；你自己也要準備，作他們的大帥。
verses.e: " ' " Be prepared , yes , prepare yourself , you , and all your companies who are assembled to you , and be a guard to them .

verses.z: 過了多日，你必被差派。到末後之年，你必來到脫離刀劍從列國收回之地，到以色列常久荒涼的山上；但那從列國中招聚出來的必在其上安然居住。
verses.e: After many days you will be visited . In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword , that is gathered out of many peoples , on the mountains of Israel , which have been a continual waste ; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely , all of them .

verses.z: 你和你的軍隊，並同着你許多國的民，必如暴風上來，如密雲遮蓋地面。」
verses.e: You will ascend . You will come like a storm . You will be like a cloud to cover the land , you and all your hordes , and many peoples with you . "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要向歌革發預言攻擊他，說主耶和華如此說：羅施、米設、土巴的王歌革啊，我與你為敵。
verses.e: " You , son of man , prophesy against Gog , and say , ' The Lord GOD says : " Behold , I am against you , Gog , prince of Rosh , Meshech , and Tubal .

verses.z: 甚至他們不必從田野撿柴，也不必從樹林伐木；因為他們要用器械燒火，並且搶奪那搶奪他們的人，擄掠那擄掠他們的人。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: so that they will take no wood out of the field , and not cut down any out of the forests ; for they will make fires with the weapons . They will plunder those who plundered them , and rob those who robbed them , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「當那日，我必將以色列[地]的谷，就是海東人所經過的谷，賜給歌革為墳地，使經過的人到此停步。在那裏人必葬埋歌革和他的群眾，就稱那地為哈們‧歌革谷。
verses.e: " ' " It will happen in that day , that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel , the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea ; and it will stop those who pass through . They will bury Gog and all his multitude there , and they will call it ' The valley of Hamon Gog ' .

verses.z: 以色列家的人必用七個月葬埋他們，為要潔淨全地。
verses.e: " ' " The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months , that they may cleanse the land .

verses.z: 全地的居民都必葬埋他們。當我得榮耀的日子，這事必叫他們得名聲。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: Yes , all the people of the land will bury them ; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 他們必分派人時常巡查遍地，與過路的人一同葬埋那剩在地面上的屍首，好潔淨全地。過了七個月，他們還要巡查。
verses.e: " ' " They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land . Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land , to cleanse it . After the end of seven months they will search .

verses.z: 巡查遍地的人要經過全地，見有人的骸骨，就在旁邊立一標記，等葬埋的人來將骸骨葬在哈們‧歌革谷。
verses.e: Those who search through the land will pass through ; and when anyone sees a man's bone , then he will set up a sign by it , until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog .

verses.z: 他們必這樣潔淨那地，並有一城名叫哈摩那。
verses.e: Hamonah will also be the name of a city . Thus they will cleanse the land . " '

verses.z: 「人子啊，主耶和華如此說：你要對各類的飛鳥和田野的走獸說：你們聚集來吧，要從四方聚到我為你們獻祭之地，就是在以色列山上獻大祭之地，好叫你們吃肉、喝血。
verses.e: " You , son of man , the Lord GOD says : ' Speak to the birds of every sort , and to every animal of the field , " Assemble yourselves , and come ; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you , even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel , that you may eat meat and drink blood .

verses.z: 你們必吃勇士的肉，喝地上首領的血，就如吃公綿羊、羊羔、公山羊、公牛，都是巴珊的肥畜。
verses.e: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty , and drink the blood of the princes of the earth , of rams , of lambs , and of goats , of bulls , all of them fatlings of Bashan .

verses.z: 你們吃我為你們所獻的祭，必吃飽了脂油，喝醉了血。
verses.e: You shall eat fat until you are full , and drink blood until you are drunk , of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you .

verses.z: 我必調轉你，領你前往，使你從北方的極處上來，帶你到以色列的山上。
verses.e: I will turn you around , will lead you on , and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north ; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel .

verses.z: 你們必在我席上飽吃馬匹和[坐]車[的人]，並勇士和一切的戰士。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers , with mighty men , and with all men of war , " says the Lord GOD . '

verses.z: 「我必顯我的榮耀在列國中；萬民就必看見我所行的審判與我在他們身上所加的手。
verses.e: " I will set my glory among the nations . Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed , and my hand that I have laid on them .

verses.z: 這樣，從那日以後，以色列家必知道我是耶和華－他們的上帝。
verses.e: So the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God , from that day and forward .

verses.z: 列國人也必知道以色列家被擄掠是因他們的罪孽。他們得罪我，我就掩面不顧，將他們交在敵人手中，他們便都倒在刀下。
verses.e: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity , because they trespassed against me , and I hid my face from them ; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries , and they all fell by the sword .

verses.z: 我是照他們的污穢和罪過待他們，並且我掩面不顧他們。」
verses.e: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions . I hid my face from them .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「我要使雅各被擄的人歸回，要憐憫以色列全家，又為我的聖名發熱心。
verses.e: " Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel . I will be jealous for my holy name .

verses.z: 他們在本地安然居住，無人驚嚇，是我將他們從萬民中領回，從仇敵之地召來。我在許多國的民眼前，在他們身上顯為聖的時候，他們要擔當自己的羞辱和干犯我的一切罪。
verses.e: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me , when they dwell securely in their land . No one will make them afraid
when I have brought them back from the peoples , gathered them out of their enemies ' lands , and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations .

verses.z: 因我使他們被擄到外邦人中，後又聚集他們歸回本地，他們就知道我是耶和華－他們的上帝；我必不再留他們一人在外邦。
verses.e: They will know that I am the LORD their God , in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations , and have gathered them to their own land . Then I will leave none of them captive any more .

verses.z: 我也不再掩面不顧他們，因我已將我的靈澆灌以色列家。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I won't hide my face from them any more , for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel , ' says the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 我必從你左手打落你的弓，從你右手打掉你的箭。
verses.e: I will strike your bow out of your left hand , and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand .

verses.z: 你和你的軍隊，並同着你的列國人，都必倒在以色列的山上。我必將你給各類的鷙鳥和田野的走獸作食物。
verses.e: You will fall on the mountains of Israel , you , and all your hordes , and the peoples who are with you . I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured .

verses.z: 你必倒在田野，因為我曾說過。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: You will fall on the open field , for I have spoken it , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 我要降火在瑪各和海島安然居住的人身上，他們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: " I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands . Then they will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「我要在我民以色列中顯出我的聖名，也不容我的聖名再被褻瀆，列國人就知道我是耶和華－以色列中的聖者。
verses.e: " ' " I will make my holy name known among my people Israel . I won't allow my holy name to be profaned any more . Then the nations will know that I am the LORD , the Holy One in Israel .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：這日事情臨近，也必成就，乃是我所說的日子。
verses.e: Behold , it comes , and it will be done , " says the Lord GOD . " This is the day about which I have spoken .

verses.z: 「住以色列城邑的人必出去撿器械，就是大小盾牌、弓箭、梃杖、槍矛，都當柴燒火，直燒七年，
verses.e: " ' " Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them , both the shields and the bucklers , the bows and the arrows , and the war clubs and the spears , and they will make fires with them for seven years ;

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要拿一塊磚，擺在你面前，將一座耶路撒冷城畫在其上，
verses.e: " You also , son of man , take a tile , and lay it before yourself , and portray on it a city , even Jerusalem .

verses.z: 你所吃的要按分兩吃，每日二十舍客勒，按時而吃。
verses.e: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight , twenty shekels a day . From time to time you shall eat it .

verses.z: 你喝水也要按制子，[每日喝]一欣六分之一，按時而喝。
verses.e: You shall drink water by measure , the sixth part of a hin . From time to time you shall drink .

verses.z: 你吃這餅像吃大麥餅一樣，要用人糞在眾人眼前燒烤。」
verses.e: You shall eat it as barley cakes , and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「以色列人在我所趕他們到的各國中，也必這樣吃不潔淨的食物。」
verses.e: The LORD said , " Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean , among the nations where I will drive them . "

verses.z: 我說：「哎！主耶和華啊，我素來未曾被玷污，從幼年到如今沒有吃過自死的，或被野獸撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。」
verses.e: Then I said , " Ah Lord GOD ! Behold , my soul has not been polluted ; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself , or is torn of animals . No abominable meat has come into my mouth ! "

verses.z: 於是他對我說：「看哪，我給你牛糞代替人糞，你要將你的餅烤在其上。」
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Behold , I have given you cow's dung for man's dung , and you shall prepare your bread on it . "

verses.z: 他又對我說：「人子啊，我必在耶路撒冷折斷他們的杖，就是斷絕他們的糧。他們吃餅要按分兩，憂慮而吃；喝水也要按制子，驚惶而喝；
verses.e: Moreover he said to me , " Son of man , behold , I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem . They will eat bread by weight , and with fearfulness . They will drink water by measure , and in dismay ;

verses.z: 使他們缺糧缺水，彼此驚惶，因自己的罪孽消滅。」
verses.e: that they may lack bread and water , be dismayed one with another , and pine away in their iniquity .

verses.z: 又圍困這城，造臺築壘，安營攻擊，在四圍安設撞錘攻城，
verses.e: Lay siege against it , build forts against it , and cast up a mound against it . Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around .

verses.z: 又要拿個鐵鏊，放在你和城的中間，作為鐵牆。你要對面攻擊這城，使城被困；這樣，好作以色列家的預兆。
verses.e: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city . Then set your face toward it . It will be besieged , and you shall lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .

verses.z: 「你要向左側臥，承當以色列家的罪孽；要[按]你向左側臥的日數，擔當他們的罪孽。
verses.e: " Moreover lie on your left side , and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it . According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it , you shall bear their iniquity .

verses.z: 因為我已將他們作孽的年數定為你[向左側臥]的日數，就是三百九十日，你要這樣擔當以色列家的罪孽。
verses.e: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days , even three hundred ninety days . So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel .

verses.z: 再者，你滿了這些日子，還要向右側臥，擔當猶大家的罪孽。我給你定規[側臥]四十日，一日頂一年。
verses.e: " Again , when you have accomplished these , you shall lie on your right side , and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah . I have appointed forty days , each day for a year , to you .

verses.z: 你要露出膀臂，面向被困的耶路撒冷，說預言攻擊這城。
verses.e: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem , with your arm uncovered ; and you shall prophesy against it .

verses.z: 我用繩索捆綁你，使你不能輾轉，直等你滿了困[城]的日子。
verses.e: Behold , I put ropes on you , and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other , until you have accomplished the days of your siege .

verses.z: 「你要取小麥、大麥、豆子、紅豆、小米、粗麥，裝在一個器皿中，用以為自己做餅；要[按]你側臥的三百九十日吃這餅。
verses.e: " Take for yourself also wheat , barley , beans , lentils , millet , and spelt , and put them in one vessel . Make bread of it . According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side , even three hundred ninety days , you shall eat of it .

verses.z: 我們被擄掠第二十五年，耶路撒冷城攻破後十四年，正在年初，月之初十日，耶和華的靈降在我身上，他把我帶到以色列地。
verses.e: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity , in the beginning of the year , in the tenth day of the month , in the fourteenth year after the city was struck , in the same day , the LORD's hand was on me , and he brought me there .

verses.z: 東門洞有衛房：這旁三間，那旁三間，都是一樣的尺寸；這邊的柱子和那邊的柱子，也是一樣的尺寸。
verses.e: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side , and three on that side . The three of them were of one measure . The posts had one measure on this side and on that side .

verses.z: 他量門口，寬十肘，長十三肘。
verses.e: He measured the width of the opening of the gate , ten cubits ; and the length of the gate , thirteen cubits ;

verses.z: 衛房前[展出]的境界：[這邊]一肘，那邊一肘；衛房這邊六肘，那邊六肘。
verses.e: and a border before the lodges , one cubit on this side , and a border , one cubit on that side ; and the side rooms , six cubits on this side , and six cubits on that side .

verses.z: 又量門洞，從這衛房頂[的後檐]到那衛房頂[的後檐]，寬二十五肘；[衛房]門與門相對。
verses.e: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other , a width of twenty-five cubits , door against door .

verses.z: 又量廊子六十肘，牆柱外是院子，有廊為界，在門洞兩邊。
verses.e: He also made posts , sixty cubits ; and the court reached to the posts , around the gate .

verses.z: 從大門口到內廊前，共五十肘。
verses.e: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits .

verses.z: 衛房和門洞兩旁柱間並廊子，都有嚴緊的窗櫺；裏邊都有窗櫺，柱上有雕刻的棕樹。
verses.e: There were closed windows to the side rooms , and to their posts within the gate all around , and likewise to the arches . Windows were around inward . Palm trees were on each post .

verses.z: 他帶我到外院，見院的四圍有鋪石地；鋪石地上有屋子三十間。
verses.e: Then he brought me into the outer court . Behold , there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around . Thirty rooms were on the pavement .

verses.z: 鋪石地，就是矮鋪石地在各門洞兩旁，以門洞的長短為度。
verses.e: The pavement was by the side of the gates , corresponding to the length of the gates , even the lower pavement .

verses.z: 他從下門量到內院外，共寬一百肘，東面北面都是如此。
verses.e: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside , one hundred cubits , both on the east and on the north .

verses.z: 在上帝的異象中帶我到以色列地，安置在至高的山上；在山上的南邊有彷彿一座城建立。
verses.e: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel , and set me down on a very high mountain , on which was something like the frame of a city to the south .

verses.z: 他量外院朝北的門，長寬若干。
verses.e: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north .

verses.z: 門洞的衛房，這旁三間，那旁三間。門洞的柱子和廊子，與第一門的尺寸一樣。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
verses.e: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side . Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate : its length was fifty cubits , and the width twenty-five cubits .

verses.z: 其窗櫺和廊子，並雕刻的棕樹，與朝東的門尺寸一樣。登七層臺階上到這門，前面有廊子。
verses.e: Its windows , its arches , and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east . They went up to it by seven steps . Its arches were before them .

verses.z: 內院有門與這門相對，北面東面都是如此。他從這門量到那門，共一百肘。
verses.e: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate , on the north and on the east . He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate .

verses.z: 他帶我往南去，見朝南有門，又照先前的尺寸量門洞的柱子和廊子。
verses.e: He led me toward the south ; and behold , there was a gate toward the south . He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements .

verses.z: 門洞兩旁與廊子的周圍都有窗櫺，和先量的窗櫺一樣。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
verses.e: There were windows in it and in its arches all around , like the other windows : the length was fifty cubits , and the width twenty-five cubits .

verses.z: 登七層臺階上到這門，前面有廊子；柱上有雕刻的棕樹，這邊一棵，那邊一棵。
verses.e: There were seven steps to go up to it , and its arches were before them . It had palm trees , one on this side , and another on that side , on its posts .

verses.z: 內院朝南有門。從這門量到朝南的那門，共一百肘。
verses.e: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south . He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south .

verses.z: 他帶我從南門到內院，就照先前的尺寸量南門。
verses.e: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate . He measured the south gate according to these measurements ;

verses.z: 衛房和柱子，並廊子都照先前的尺寸。門洞兩旁與廊子的周圍都有窗櫺。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
verses.e: with its lodges , its posts , and its arches , according to these measurements . There were windows in it and in its arches all around . It was fifty cubits long , and twenty-five cubits wide .

verses.z: 他帶我到那裏，見有一人，顏色如銅，手拿麻繩和量度的竿，站在門口。
verses.e: He brought me there ; and , behold , there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze , with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed ; and he stood in the gate .

verses.z: 周圍有廊子，長二十五肘，寬五肘。
verses.e: There were arches all around , twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide .

verses.z: 廊子朝着外院，柱上有雕刻的棕樹。登八層臺階上到這門。
verses.e: Its arches were toward the outer court . Palm trees were on its posts . The ascent to it had eight steps .

verses.z: 他帶我到內院的東面，就照先前的尺寸量東門。
verses.e: He brought me into the inner court toward the east . He measured the gate according to these measurements ;

verses.z: 衛房和柱子，並廊子都照先前的尺寸。門洞兩旁與廊子的周圍都有窗櫺。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
verses.e: with its lodges , its posts , and its arches , according to these measurements . There were windows in it and in its arches all around . It was fifty cubits long , and twenty-five cubits wide .

verses.z: 廊子朝着外院。門洞兩旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕樹。登八層臺階上到這門。
verses.e: Its arches were toward the outer court . Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side . The ascent to it had eight steps .

verses.z: 他帶我到北門，就照先前的尺寸量那門，
verses.e: He brought me to the north gate , and he measured it according to these measurements —

verses.z: 就是量衛房和柱子，並廊子。門洞周圍都有窗櫺；門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
verses.e: its lodges , its posts , and its arches . There were windows in it all around . The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits .

verses.z: 廊柱朝着外院。門洞兩旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕樹。登八層臺階上到這門。
verses.e: Its posts were toward the outer court . Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side . The ascent to it had eight steps .

verses.z: 門洞的柱旁有屋子和門；祭司在那裏洗燔祭牲。
verses.e: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates . They washed the burnt offering there .

verses.z: 在門廊內，這邊有兩張桌子，那邊有兩張桌子，在其上可以宰殺燔祭牲、贖罪祭牲，和贖愆祭牲。
verses.e: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side , on which to kill the burnt offering , the sin offering , and the trespass offering .

verses.z: 那人對我說：「人子啊，凡我所指示你的，你都要用眼看，用耳聽，並要放在心上。我帶你到這裏來，特為要指示你；凡你所見的，你都要告訴以色列家。」
verses.e: The man said to me , " Son of man , see with your eyes , and hear with your ears , and set your heart on all that I will show you ; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you . Declare all that you see to the house of Israel . "

verses.z: 上到朝北的門口，這邊有兩張桌子，門廊那邊也有兩張桌子。
verses.e: On the one side outside , as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north , were two tables ; and on the other side , which belonged to the porch of the gate , were two tables .

verses.z: 門這邊有四張桌子，那邊有四張桌子，共八張；在其上祭司宰殺[犧牲]。
verses.e: Four tables were on this side , and four tables on that side , by the side of the gate : eight tables , on which they killed the sacrifices .

verses.z: 為燔祭牲有四張桌子，是鑿過的石頭做成的，長一肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘。祭司將宰殺燔祭牲和[平安]祭牲所用的器皿放在其上。
verses.e: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering , a cubit and a half long , a cubit and a half wide , and one cubit high . They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them .

verses.z: 有鉤子，寬一掌，釘在廊內的四圍。桌子上有犧牲的肉。
verses.e: The hooks , a hand width long , were fastened within all around . The meat of the offering was on the tables .

verses.z: 在北門旁，內院裏有屋子，為歌唱的人而設。這屋子朝南；在南門旁，又有一間朝北。
verses.e: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court , which was at the side of the north gate . They faced toward the south . One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north .

verses.z: 他對我說：「這朝南的屋子是為看守殿宇的祭司；
verses.e: He said to me , " This room , which faces toward the south , is for the priests who perform the duty of the house .

verses.z: 那朝北的屋子是為看守祭壇的祭司。這些祭司是利未人中撒督的子孫，近前來事奉耶和華的。」
verses.e: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar . These are the sons of Zadok , who from among the sons of Levi come near to the LORD to minister to him . "

verses.z: 他又量內院，長一百肘，寬一百肘，是見方的。祭壇在殿前。
verses.e: He measured the court , one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide , square . The altar was before the house .

verses.z: 於是他帶我到殿前的廊子，量廊子的牆柱。這面厚五肘，那面厚五肘。門兩旁，這邊三肘，那邊三肘。
verses.e: Then he brought me to the porch of the house , and measured each post of the porch , five cubits on this side , and five cubits on that side . The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side .

verses.z: 廊子長二十肘，寬十一肘。上廊子有臺階。靠近牆柱又有柱子，這邊一根，那邊一根。
verses.e: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits , even by the steps by which they went up to it . There were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .

verses.z: 我見殿四圍有牆。那人手拿量度的竿，長六肘，每肘是一肘零一掌。他用竿量牆，厚一竿，高一竿。
verses.e: Behold , there was a wall on the outside of the house all around , and in the man's hand a measuring reed six cubits long , of a cubit and a hand width each . So he measured the thickness of the building , one reed ; and the height , one reed .

verses.z: 他到了朝東的門，就上門的臺階，量門的這檻，寬一竿；又量門的那檻，寬一竿。
verses.e: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east , and went up its steps . He measured the threshold of the gate , one reed wide ; and the other threshold , one reed wide .

verses.z: 又有衛房，每房長一竿，寬一竿，相隔五肘。門檻，就是挨着向殿的廊門檻，寬一竿。
verses.e: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide . Between the lodges was five cubits . The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed .

verses.z: 他又量向殿門的廊子，寬一竿。
verses.e: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house , one reed .

verses.z: 又量門廊，寬八肘，牆柱厚二肘；那門的廊子向着殿。
verses.e: Then he measured the porch of the gate , eight cubits ; and its posts , two cubits ; and the porch of the gate was toward the house .

verses.z: 他帶我到殿那裏量牆柱：這面厚六肘，那面厚六肘，寬窄與會幕相同。
verses.e: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts , six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side , which was the width of the tent .

verses.z: 在旁屋與對面的房屋中間有[空地]，寬二十肘。
verses.e: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side .

verses.z: 旁屋的門都向餘地：一門向北，一門向南。周圍的餘地寬五肘。
verses.e: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left , one door toward the north , and another door toward the south . The width of the open area was five cubits all around .

verses.z: 在西面空地之後有房子，寬七十肘，長九十肘，牆四圍厚五肘。
verses.e: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide ; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around , and its length ninety cubits .

verses.z: 這樣，他量殿，長一百肘，又量空地和那房子並牆，共長一百肘。
verses.e: So he measured the temple , one hundred cubits long ; and the separate place , and the building , with its walls , one hundred cubits long ;

verses.z: 殿的前面和兩旁的空地，寬一百肘。
verses.e: also the width of the face of the temple , and of the separate place toward the east , one hundred cubits .

verses.z: 他量空地後面的那房子，並兩旁的樓廊，共長一百肘。
verses.e: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back , and its galleries on the one side and on the other side , one hundred cubits from the inner temple , and the porches of the court ,

verses.z: 內殿、院廊、門檻、嚴緊的窗櫺，並對着門檻的三層樓廊，從地到窗櫺（窗櫺都有蔽子），
verses.e: the thresholds , and the closed windows , and the galleries around on their three stories , opposite the threshold , with wood ceilings all around , and from the ground up to the windows , ( now the windows were covered ) ,

verses.z: 直到門以上，就是到內殿和外殿內外四圍牆壁，都按尺寸用木板遮蔽。
verses.e: to the space above the door , even to the inner house , and outside , and by all the wall all around inside and outside , by measure .

verses.z: 牆上雕刻基路伯和棕樹。每二基路伯中間有一棵棕樹，每基路伯有二臉。
verses.e: It was made with cherubim and palm trees . A palm tree was between cherub and cherub , and every cherub had two faces ,

verses.z: 這邊有人臉向着棕樹，那邊有獅子臉向着棕樹，殿內周圍都是如此。
verses.e: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side , and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side . It was made like this through all the house all around .

verses.z: 門口寬十肘。門兩旁，這邊五肘，那邊五肘。他量殿長四十肘，寬二十肘。
verses.e: The width of the entrance was ten cubits , and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side , and five cubits on the other side . He measured its length , forty cubits , and the width , twenty cubits .

verses.z: 從地至門以上，都有基路伯和棕樹。殿牆就是這樣。
verses.e: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door . The wall of the temple was like this .

verses.z: 殿的門柱是方的。至聖所的前面，形狀和[殿]的形狀一樣。
verses.e: The door posts of the nave were squared . As for the face of the nave , its appearance was as the appearance of the temple .

verses.z: 壇是木頭做的，高三肘，長二肘。壇角和壇面，並四旁，都是木頭做的。他對我說：「這是耶和華面前的桌子。」
verses.e: The altar was of wood , three cubits high , and its length two cubits . Its corners , its base , and its walls were of wood . He said to me , " This is the table that is before the LORD . "

verses.z: 殿和至聖所的門各有兩扇。
verses.e: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors .

verses.z: 每扇分兩扇，這兩扇是摺疊的。這邊門分兩扇，那邊門也分兩扇。
verses.e: The doors had two leaves each , two turning leaves : two for the one door , and two leaves for the other .

verses.z: 殿的門扇上雕刻基路伯和棕樹，與刻在牆上的一般。在外頭廊前有木檻。
verses.e: There were made on them , on the doors of the nave , cherubim and palm trees , like those made on the walls . There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside .

verses.z: 廊這邊那邊都有嚴緊的窗櫺和棕樹；殿的旁屋和檻就是這樣。
verses.e: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side , on the sides of the porch . This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged .

verses.z: 他到內殿量牆柱，各厚二肘。門口寬六肘，門兩旁各寬七肘。
verses.e: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance , two cubits ; and the entrance , six cubits ; and the width of the entrance , seven cubits .

verses.z: 他量內殿，長二十肘，寬二十肘。他對我說：「這是至聖所。」
verses.e: He measured its length , twenty cubits , and the width , twenty cubits , before the nave . He said to me , " This is the most holy place . "

verses.z: 他又量殿牆，厚六肘；圍着殿有旁屋，各寬四肘。
verses.e: Then he measured the wall of the house , six cubits ; and the width of every side room , four cubits , all around the house on every side .

verses.z: 旁屋有三層，層疊而上，每層排列三十間。旁屋[的梁木]擱在殿牆坎上，免得插入殿牆。
verses.e: The side rooms were in three stories , one over another , and thirty in each story . They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around , that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house .

verses.z: 這圍[殿]的旁屋越高越寬；因旁屋圍殿懸疊而上，所以越上越寬，從下一層，由中一層，到上一層。
verses.e: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels , because the walls were narrower at the higher levels . Therefore the width of the house increased upward ; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level .

verses.z: 我又見圍着殿有高月臺。旁屋的根基，高足一竿，就是六大肘。
verses.e: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around . The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits .

verses.z: 旁屋的外牆厚五肘。旁屋之外還有餘地。
verses.e: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits . That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house .

verses.z: 他帶我出來向北，到外院，又帶我進入聖屋；這聖屋一排順着空地，一排與北邊[鋪石地]之屋相對。
verses.e: Then he brought me out into the outer court , the way toward the north . Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place , and which was opposite the building toward the north .

verses.z: 向南在內院牆裏有聖屋，一排與鋪石地之屋相對，一排順着空地。
verses.e: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east , before the separate place , and before the building , there were rooms .

verses.z: 這聖屋前的夾道與北邊聖屋的[夾道]長寬一樣；出入之處與北屋門的樣式相同。
verses.e: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north . Their length and width were the same . All their exits had the same arrangement and doors .

verses.z: 正在牆前、夾道的東頭，有門可以進入，與向南聖屋的門一樣。
verses.e: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way , even the way directly before the wall toward the east , as one enters into them .

verses.z: 他對我說：「順着空地的南屋北屋，都是聖屋；親近耶和華的祭司當在那裏吃至聖的物，也當在那裏放至聖的物，就是素祭、贖罪祭，和贖愆祭，因此處為聖。
verses.e: Then he said to me , " The north rooms and the south rooms , which are opposite the separate place , are the holy rooms , where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things . There they shall lay the most holy things , with the meal offering , the sin offering , and the trespass offering ; for the place is holy .

verses.z: 祭司進去出了聖所的時候，不可直到外院，但要在聖屋放下他們供職的衣服，因為是聖衣；要穿上別的衣服才可以到屬民的[外院]。」
verses.e: When the priests enter in , then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there ; for they are holy . Then they shall put on other garments , and shall approach that which is for the people . "

verses.z: 他量完了內殿，就帶我出朝東的門，量院的四圍。
verses.e: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house , he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east , and measured it all around .

verses.z: 他用量度的竿量四圍，量東面五百肘，
verses.e: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds , with the measuring reed all around .

verses.z: 用竿量北面五百肘，
verses.e: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around .

verses.z: 用竿量南面五百肘，
verses.e: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed .

verses.z: 又轉到西面，用竿量五百肘。
verses.e: He turned about to the west side , and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed .

verses.z: 這聖屋長一百肘，寬五十肘，有向北的門。
verses.e: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door , and the width was fifty cubits .

verses.z: 他量四面，四圍有牆，長五百[肘]，寬五百[肘]，為要分別聖地與俗地。
verses.e: He measured it on the four sides . It had a wall around it , the length five hundred cubits , and the width five hundred cubits , to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common .

verses.z: 對着內院那二十[肘寬之空地]，又對着外院的鋪石地，在第三層樓上有樓廊對着樓廊。
verses.e: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court , and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court , was gallery against gallery in the three stories .

verses.z: 在聖屋前有一條夾道，寬十肘，長一百肘。房門都向北。
verses.e: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits ' width inward , a way of one cubit ; and their doors were toward the north .

verses.z: 聖屋因為樓廊佔去些地方，所以上層比中下兩層窄些。
verses.e: Now the upper rooms were shorter ; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building .

verses.z: 聖屋有三層，卻無柱子，不像外院[的屋子]有柱子；所以[上層]比中下兩層更窄。
verses.e: For they were in three stories , and they didn't have pillars as the pillars of the courts . Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground .

verses.z: 聖屋外，東邊有牆，靠着外院，長五十肘。
verses.e: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms , toward the outer court before the rooms , was fifty cubits long .

verses.z: 靠着外院的聖屋長五十肘。殿北面[的聖屋]長一百肘。
verses.e: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits . Behold , those facing the temple were one hundred cubits .

verses.z: 在聖屋以下，東頭有進入之處，就是從外院進入之處。
verses.e: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side , as one goes into them from the outer court .

verses.z: 以後，他帶我到一座門，就是朝東的門。
verses.e: Afterward he brought me to the gate , even the gate that looks toward the east .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要將這殿指示以色列家，使他們因自己的罪孽慚愧，也要他們量殿的尺寸。
verses.e: " You , son of man , show the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities ; and let them measure the pattern .

verses.z: 他們若因自己所行的一切事慚愧，你就將殿的規模、樣式、出入之處，和一切形狀、典章、禮儀、法則指示他們，在他們眼前寫上，使他們遵照殿的一切規模典章去做。
verses.e: If they are ashamed of all that they have done , make known to them the form of the house , its fashion , its exits , its entrances , its structure , all its ordinances , all its forms , and all its laws ; and write it in their sight , that they may keep the whole form of it , and all its ordinances , and do them .

verses.z: 殿的法則乃是如此：殿在山頂上，四圍的全界要稱為至聖。這就是殿的法則。」
verses.e: " This is the law of the house . On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy . Behold , this is the law of the house .

verses.z: 以下量祭壇，是以肘為度（這肘是一肘零一掌）。底座高一肘，邊寬一肘，四圍起邊高一掌，這是壇的座。
verses.e: " These are the measurements of the altar by cubits ( the cubit is a cubit and a hand width ) : the bottom shall be a cubit , and the width a cubit , and its border around its edge a span ; and this shall be the base of the altar .

verses.z: 從底座到下層磴臺，高二肘，邊寬一肘。從小磴臺到大磴臺，高四肘，邊寬一肘。
verses.e: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits , and the width one cubit ; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits , and the width a cubit .

verses.z: 壇上的供臺，高四肘。供臺的四拐角上都有角。
verses.e: The upper altar shall be four cubits ; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns .

verses.z: 供臺長十二[肘]，寬十二肘，四面見方。
verses.e: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide , square in its four sides .

verses.z: 磴臺長十四[肘]，寬十四肘，四面見方。四圍起邊高半肘，底座四圍的邊寬一肘。臺階朝東。
verses.e: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides ; and the border about it shall be half a cubit ; and its bottom shall be a cubit around ; and its steps shall look toward the east . "

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，主耶和華如此說：建造祭壇，為要在其上獻燔祭灑血，造成的時候典章如下：
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , the Lord GOD says : ' These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it , to offer burnt offerings on it , and to sprinkle blood on it .

verses.z: 主耶和華說，你要將一隻公牛犢作為贖罪祭，給祭司利未人撒督的後裔，就是那親近我、事奉我的。
verses.e: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok , who are near to me , to minister to me , ' says the Lord GOD , ' a young bull for a sin offering .

verses.z: 以色列上帝的榮光從東而來。他的聲音如同多水的聲音；地就因他的榮耀發光。
verses.e: Behold , the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east . His voice was like the sound of many waters ; and the earth was illuminated with his glory .

verses.z: 你要取些公牛的血，抹在壇的四角和磴臺的四拐角，並四圍所起的邊上。你這樣潔淨壇，壇就潔淨了。
verses.e: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns , and on the four corners of the ledge , and on the border all around . You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way .

verses.z: 你又要將那作贖罪祭的公牛[犢]燒在殿外、聖地之外預定之處。
verses.e: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering , and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house , outside of the sanctuary .

verses.z: 次日，要將無殘疾的公山羊獻為贖罪祭；要潔淨壇，像用公牛[犢]潔淨的一樣。
verses.e: " On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering ; and they shall cleanse the altar , as they cleansed it with the bull .

verses.z: 潔淨了壇，就要將一隻無殘疾的公牛犢和羊群中一隻無殘疾的公綿羊
verses.e: When you have finished cleansing it , you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect .

verses.z: 奉到耶和華前。祭司要撒鹽在其上，獻與耶和華為燔祭。
verses.e: You shall bring them near to the LORD , and the priests shall cast salt on them , and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 七日內，每日要預備一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，也要預備一隻公牛犢和羊群中的一隻公綿羊，都要沒有殘疾的。
verses.e: " Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering . They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock , without defect .

verses.z: 七日祭司潔淨壇，壇就潔淨了；要這樣把壇分別為聖。
verses.e: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it . So shall they consecrate it .

verses.z: 滿了七日，自八日以後，祭司要在壇上獻你們的燔祭和平安祭；我必悅納你們。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: When they have accomplished the days , it shall be that on the eighth day and onward , the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings . Then I will accept you , ' says the Lord GOD . "

verses.z: 其狀如從前他來滅城的時候我所見的異象，那異象如我在迦巴魯河邊所見的異象，我就俯伏在地。
verses.e: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw , even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city ; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar ; and I fell on my face .

verses.z: 耶和華的榮光從朝東的門照入殿中。
verses.e: The LORD's glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east .

verses.z: 靈將我舉起，帶入內院，不料，耶和華的榮光充滿了殿。
verses.e: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court ; and behold , the LORD's glory filled the house .

verses.z: 我聽見有一位從殿中對我說話。有一人站在我旁邊。
verses.e: I heard one speaking to me out of the house , and a man stood by me .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，這是我寶座之地，是我腳掌所踏之地。我要在這裏住，在以色列人中直到永遠。以色列家和他們的君王必不再玷污我的聖名，就是行邪淫、在[錫安的]高處[葬埋]他們君王的屍首，
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet , where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever . The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name , neither they nor their kings , by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places ;

verses.z: 使他們的門檻挨近我的門檻，他們的門框挨近我的門框；他們與我中間僅隔一牆，並且行可憎的事，玷污了我的聖名，所以我發怒滅絕他們。
verses.e: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post . There was a wall between me and them ; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed . Therefore I have consumed them in my anger .

verses.z: 現在他們當從我面前遠除邪淫和他們君王的屍首，我就住在他們中間直到永遠。
verses.e: Now let them put away their prostitution , and the dead bodies of their kings far from me . Then I will dwell among them forever .

verses.z: 他又帶我回到聖地朝東的外門；那門關閉了。
verses.e: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary , which looks toward the east ; and it was shut .

verses.z: 「當以色列人走迷的時候，有利未人遠離我，就是走迷離開我、隨從他們的偶像，他們必擔當自己的罪孽。
verses.e: " ' " But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray , who went astray from me after their idols , they will bear their iniquity .

verses.z: 然而他們必在我的聖地當僕役，照管殿門，在殿中供職；必為民宰殺燔祭牲和[平安]祭牲，必站在民前伺候他們。
verses.e: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary , having oversight at the gates of the house , and ministering in the house . They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people , and they shall stand before them to minister to them .

verses.z: 因為這些利未人曾在偶像前伺候這民，成了以色列家罪孽的絆腳石，所以我向他們起誓：他們必擔當自己的罪孽。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: Because they ministered to them before their idols , and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel , therefore I have lifted up my hand against them , " says the Lord GOD , " and they will bear their iniquity .

verses.z: 他們不可親近我，給我供祭司的職分，也不可挨近我的一件聖物，就是至聖的物；他們卻要擔當自己的羞辱和所行可憎之事的報應。
verses.e: They shall not come near to me , to execute the office of priest to me , nor to come near to any of my holy things , to the things that are most holy ; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed .

verses.z: 然而我要使他們看守殿宇，辦理其中的一切事，並做其內一切當做之工。」
