verses.e: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house , for all its service and for all that will be done therein .

verses.z: 「以色列人走迷離開我的時候，祭司利未人撒督的子孫仍看守我的聖所。他們必親近我，事奉我，並且侍立在我面前，將脂油與血獻給我。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " ' " But the Levitical priests , the sons of Zadok , who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me , shall come near to me to minister to me . They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 他們必進入我的聖所，就近我的桌前事奉我，守我所吩咐的。
verses.e: " They shall enter into my sanctuary , and they shall come near to my table , to minister to me , and they shall keep my instruction .

verses.z: 他們進內院門必穿細麻衣。在內院門和殿內供職的時候不可穿羊毛衣服。
verses.e: " ' " It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court , they shall be clothed with linen garments . No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court , and within .

verses.z: 他們頭上要戴細麻布裹頭巾，腰穿細麻布褲子；不可穿使身體出汗[的衣服]。
verses.e: They shall have linen turbans on their heads , and shall have linen trousers on their waists . They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat .

verses.z: 他們出到外院的民那裏，當脫下供職的衣服，放在聖屋內，穿上別的衣服，免得因聖衣使民成聖。
verses.e: When they go out into the outer court , even into the outer court to the people , they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms . They shall put on other garments , that they not sanctify the people with their garments .

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「這門必須關閉，不可敞開，誰也不可由其中進入；因為耶和華－以色列的上帝已經由其中進入，所以必須關閉。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " This gate shall be shut . It shall not be opened , no man shall enter in by it ; for the LORD , the God of Israel , has entered in by it . Therefore it shall be shut .

verses.z: 不可剃頭，也不可容髮綹長長，只可剪髮。
verses.e: " ' " They shall not shave their heads , or allow their locks to grow long . They shall only cut off the hair of their heads .

verses.z: 祭司進內院的時候都不可喝酒。
verses.e: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court .

verses.z: 不可娶寡婦和被休的婦人為妻，只可娶以色列後裔中的處女，或是祭司遺留的寡婦。
verses.e: They shall not take for their wives a widow , or her who is put away ; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel , or a widow who is the widow of a priest .

verses.z: 他們要使我的民知道聖俗的分別，又使他們分辨潔淨的和不潔淨的。
verses.e: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common , and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean .

verses.z: 有爭訟的事，他們應當站立判斷，要按我的典章判斷。在我一切的節期必守我的律法、條例，也必以我的安息日為聖日。
verses.e: " ' " In a controversy they shall stand to judge . They shall judge it according to my ordinances . They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts . They shall make my Sabbaths holy .

verses.z: 他們不可挨近死屍沾染自己，只可為父親、母親、兒子、女兒、弟兄，和未嫁人的姊妹沾染自己。
verses.e: " ' " They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves ; but for father , or for mother , or for son , or for daughter , for brother , or for sister who has had no husband , they may defile themselves .

verses.z: 祭司潔淨之後，必再計算七日。
verses.e: After he is cleansed , they shall reckon to him seven days .

verses.z: 當他進內院，進聖所，在聖所中事奉的日子，要為自己獻贖罪祭。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary , into the inner court , to minister in the sanctuary , he shall offer his sin offering , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 「祭司必有產業，我是他們的產業。不可在以色列中給他們基業；我是他們的基業。
verses.e: " ' They shall have an inheritance : I am their inheritance ; and you shall give them no possession in Israel . I am their possession .

verses.z: 素祭、贖罪祭，和贖愆祭他們都可以吃，以色列中一切永獻的物都要歸他們。
verses.e: They shall eat the meal offering , and the sin offering , and the trespass offering ; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs .

verses.z: 至於王，他必按王的位分，坐在其內，在耶和華面前吃餅。他必由這門的廊而入，也必由此而出。」
verses.e: As for the prince , he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before the LORD . He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate , and shall go out the same way . "

verses.z: 首先初熟之物和一切所獻的供物都要歸給祭司。你們也要用初熟的麥子磨麵給祭司；這樣，福氣就必臨到你們的家了。
verses.e: The first of all the first fruits of every thing , and every offering of everything , of all your offerings , shall be for the priest . You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough , to cause a blessing to rest on your house .

verses.z: 無論是鳥是獸，凡自死的，或是撕裂的，祭司都不可吃。」
verses.e: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn , whether it is bird or animal .

verses.z: 他又帶我由北門來到殿前。我觀看，見耶和華的榮光充滿耶和華的殿，我就俯伏在地。
verses.e: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house ; and I looked , and behold , the LORD's glory filled the LORD's house ; so I fell on my face .

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「人子啊，我對你所說耶和華殿中的一切典章法則，你要放在心上，用眼看，用耳聽，並要留心殿宇和聖地一切出入之處。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Son of man , mark well , and see with your eyes , and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of the LORD's house and all its laws ; and mark well the entrance of the house , with every exit of the sanctuary .

verses.z: 你要對那悖逆的以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：以色列家啊，你們行一切可憎的事，當夠了吧！
verses.e: You shall tell the rebellious , even the house of Israel , ' The Lord GOD says : " You house of Israel , let that be enough of all your abominations ,

verses.z: 你們把我的食物，就是脂油和血獻上的時候，將身心未受割禮的外邦人領進我的聖地，玷污了我的殿；又背了我的約，在你們一切可憎的事上，加上[這一層]。
verses.e: in that you have brought in foreigners , uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh , to be in my sanctuary , to profane it , even my house , when you offer my bread , the fat and the blood ; and they have broken my covenant , to add to all your abominations .

verses.z: 你們也沒有看守我的聖物，卻派別人在聖地替你們看守我所吩咐你們的。
verses.e: You have not performed the duty of my holy things ; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves . "

verses.z: 「主耶和華如此說：以色列中的外邦人，就是身心未受割禮的，都不可入我的聖地。」
verses.e: The Lord GOD says , " No foreigner , uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh , shall enter into my sanctuary , of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 你們拈鬮分地為業，要獻上一分給耶和華為聖供地，長二萬五千[肘]，寬一萬[肘]。這分以內，四圍都為聖地。
verses.e: " ' " Moreover , when you divide by lot the land for inheritance , you shall offer an offering to the LORD , a holy portion of the land . The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds , and the width shall be ten thousand . It shall be holy in all its border all around .

verses.z: 「你們要用公道天平、公道伊法、公道罷特。
verses.e: " You shall have just balances , a just ephah , and a just bath .

verses.z: 伊法與罷特大小要一樣。罷特可盛賀梅珥十分之一，伊法也可盛賀梅珥十分之一，都以賀梅珥的大小為準。
verses.e: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure , that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer , and the ephah one tenth of a homer . Its measure shall be the same as the homer .

verses.z: 舍客勒是二十季拉；二十舍客勒，二十五舍客勒，十五舍客勒，為你們的彌那。
verses.e: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs . Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina .

verses.z: 「你們當獻的供物乃是這樣：一賀梅珥麥子要獻伊法六分之一；一賀梅珥大麥要獻伊法六分之一。
verses.e: " ' " This is the offering that you shall offer : the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat , and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley ,

verses.z: 你們獻所分定的油，按油的罷特，一柯珥油要獻罷特十分之一（原來十罷特就是一賀梅珥）。
verses.e: and the set portion of oil , of the bath of oil , one tenth of a bath out of the cor , which is ten baths , even a homer ( for ten baths are a homer ) ,

verses.z: 從以色列滋潤的草場上每二百羊中，要獻一隻羊羔。這都可作素祭、燔祭、平安祭，為民贖罪。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred , from the well-watered pastures of Israel — for a meal offering , for a burnt offering , and for peace offerings , to make atonement for them , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 此地的民都要奉上這供物給以色列中的王。
verses.e: " All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel .

verses.z: 王的本分是在節期、月朔、安息日，就是以色列家一切的節期，奉上燔祭、素祭、奠祭。他要預備贖罪祭、素祭、燔祭，和平安祭，為以色列家贖罪。」
verses.e: It shall be the prince's part to give the burnt offerings , the meal offerings , and the drink offerings , in the feasts , and on the new moons , and on the Sabbaths , in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel . He shall prepare the sin offering , the meal offering , the burnt offering , and the peace offerings , to make atonement for the house of Israel . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「正[月]初一[日]，你要取無殘疾的公牛犢，潔淨聖所。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " In the first month , on the first day of the month , you shall take a young bull without defect , and you shall cleanse the sanctuary .

verses.z: 祭司要取些贖罪祭牲的血，抹在殿的門柱上和壇磴臺的四角上，並內院的門框上。
verses.e: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house , and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar , and on the posts of the gate of the inner court .

verses.z: 其中有作為聖所之地，[長]五百[肘]，[寬]五百[肘]，四面見方。四圍再有五十肘為郊野之地。
verses.e: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place , and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around .

verses.z: 本月初七日也要為誤犯罪的和愚蒙犯罪的如此行，為殿贖罪。
verses.e: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs , and for him who is simple . So you shall make atonement for the house .

verses.z: 「正月十四日，你們要守逾越節，守節七日，要吃無酵餅。
verses.e: " ' " In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month , you shall have the Passover , a feast of seven days ; unleavened bread shall be eaten .

verses.z: 當日，王要為自己和國內的眾民預備一隻公牛作贖罪祭。
verses.e: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering .

verses.z: 這節的七日，每日他要為耶和華預備無殘疾的公牛七隻、公綿羊七隻為燔祭。每日又要預備公山羊一隻為贖罪祭。
verses.e: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD , seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days ; and a male goat daily for a sin offering .

verses.z: 他也要預備素祭，就是為一隻公牛同獻一伊法[細麵]，為一隻公綿羊同獻一伊法[細麵]，每一伊法[細麵]加油一欣。
verses.e: He shall prepare a meal offering , an ephah for a bull , an ephah for a ram , and a hin of oil to an ephah .

verses.z: 七月十五日守節的時候，七日他都要如此行，照[逾越節的]贖罪祭、燔祭、素祭，和油的條例一樣。」
verses.e: " ' " In the seventh month , on the fifteenth day of the month , during the feast , he shall do like that for seven days . He shall make the same provision for sin offering , the burnt offering , the meal offering , and the oil . "

verses.z: 要以肘為度量地，長二萬五千[肘]，寬一萬[肘]。其中有聖所，是至聖的。
verses.e: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand , and a width of ten thousand . In it shall be the sanctuary , which is most holy .

verses.z: 這是全地的一分聖地，要歸與供聖所職事的祭司，就是親近事奉耶和華的，作為他們房屋之地與聖所之聖地。
verses.e: It is a holy portion of the land ; it shall be for the priests , the ministers of the sanctuary , who come near to minister to the LORD . It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary .

verses.z: 又有一分，長二萬五千[肘]，寬一萬[肘]，要歸與在殿中供職的利未人，作為二十間房屋之業。
verses.e: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites , the ministers of the house , as a possession for themselves , for twenty rooms .

verses.z: 也要分定屬城的地業，寬五千[肘]，長二萬五千[肘]，挨着那分聖供地，要歸以色列全家。
verses.e: " ' " You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long , side by side with the offering of the holy portion . It shall be for the whole house of Israel .

verses.z: 歸王[之地]要在聖供地和屬城之地的兩旁，就是聖供地和屬城之地的旁邊，西至西頭，東至東頭，從西到東，其長與[每支派的]分一樣。
verses.e: " ' " What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city , in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city , on the west side westward , and on the east side eastward , and in length corresponding to one of the portions , from the west border to the east border .

verses.z: 這地在以色列中必歸王為業。我所立的王必不再欺壓我的民，卻要按支派將地分給以色列家。
verses.e: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel . My princes shall no more oppress my people , but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「以色列的王啊，你們應當知足，要除掉強暴和搶奪的事，施行公平和公義，不再勒索我的民。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " Enough , you princes of Israel ! Remove violence and plunder , and execute justice and righteousness ! Stop dispossessing my people ! " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「內院朝東的門，在辦理事務的六日內必須關閉；惟有安息日和月朔必須敞開。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days ; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened , and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened .

verses.z: 民進入，王也要在民中進入；民出去，王也要一同出去。
verses.e: The prince shall go in with them when they go in . When they go out , he shall go out .

verses.z: 「在節期和聖會的日子同獻的素祭，要為一隻公牛獻一伊法[細麵]，為一隻公綿羊獻一伊法[細麵]，為羊羔照他的力量而獻，一伊法[細麵]加油一欣。
verses.e: " ' " In the feasts and in the appointed holidays , the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull , and an ephah for a ram , and for the lambs as he is able to give , and a hin of oil to an ephah .

verses.z: 王預備甘心獻的燔祭或平安祭，就是向耶和華甘心獻的，當有人為他開朝東的門。他就預備燔祭和平安祭，與安息日預備的一樣，[獻畢]就出去。他出去之後，當有人將門關閉。」
verses.e: When the prince prepares a free will offering , a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to the LORD , one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east ; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings , as he does on the Sabbath day . Then he shall go out ; and after his going out one shall shut the gate .

verses.z: 「每日，你要預備無殘疾一歲的羊羔一隻，獻與耶和華為燔祭；要每早晨預備。
verses.e: " ' " You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD daily . Morning by morning you shall prepare it .

verses.z: 每早晨也要預備同獻的素祭，[細麵]一伊法六分之一，並油一欣三分之一，調和細麵。這素祭要常獻與耶和華為永遠的定例。
verses.e: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning , the sixth part of an ephah , and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour ; a meal offering to the LORD continually by a perpetual ordinance .

verses.z: 每早晨要這樣預備羊羔、素祭，並油為常獻的燔祭。」
verses.e: Thus they shall prepare the lamb , the meal offering , and the oil , morning by morning , for a continual burnt offering . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「王若將產業賜給他的兒子，就成了他兒子的產業，那是他們承受為業的。
verses.e: " ' The Lord GOD says : " If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons , it is his inheritance . It shall belong to his sons . It is their possession by inheritance .

verses.z: 倘若王將一分產業賜給他的臣僕，就成了他臣僕的產業；到自由之年仍要歸與王。至於王的產業，必歸與他的兒子。
verses.e: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants , it shall be his to the year of liberty ; then it shall return to the prince ; but as for his inheritance , it shall be for his sons .

verses.z: 王不可奪取民的產業，以致驅逐他們離開所承受的；他要從自己的地業中，將產業賜給他兒子，免得我的民分散，各人離開所承受的。」
verses.e: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance , to thrust them out of their possession . He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession , that my people not each be scattered from his possession . " ' "

verses.z: 那帶我的，將我從門旁進入之處、領進為祭司預備的聖屋，是朝北的，見後頭西邊有一塊地。
verses.e: Then he brought me through the entry , which was at the side of the gate , into the holy rooms for the priests , which looked toward the north . Behold , there was a place on the back part westward .

verses.z: 王要從這門的廊進入，站在門框旁邊。祭司要為他預備燔祭和平安祭，他就要在門檻那裏敬拜，然後出去。這門直到晚上不可關閉。
verses.e: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside , and shall stand by the post of the gate ; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings , and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate . Then he shall go out , but the gate shall not be shut until the evening .

verses.z: 他對我說：「這是祭司煮贖愆祭、贖罪祭，烤素祭之地，免得帶到外院，使民成聖。」
verses.e: He said to me , " This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering , and where they shall bake the meal offering , that they not bring them out into the outer court , to sanctify the people . "

verses.z: 他又帶我到外院，使我經過院子的四拐角，見每拐角各有一個院子。
verses.e: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court ; and behold , in every corner of the court there was a court .

verses.z: 院子四拐角的院子，周圍有牆，每院長四十[肘]，寬三十[肘]。四拐角院子的尺寸都是一樣，
verses.e: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed , forty cubits long and thirty wide . These four in the corners were the same size .

verses.z: 其中周圍有一排房子，房子內有煮[肉]的地方。
verses.e: There was a wall around in them , around the four , and boiling places were made under the walls all around .

verses.z: 他對我說：「這都是煮[肉]的房子，殿內的僕役要在這裏煮民的祭物。」
verses.e: Then he said to me , " These are the boiling houses , where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people . "

verses.z: 在安息日和月朔，國內的居民要在這門口，耶和華面前敬拜。
verses.e: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons .

verses.z: 安息日，王所獻與耶和華的燔祭要用無殘疾的羊羔六隻，無殘疾的公綿羊一隻；
verses.e: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to the LORD shall be on the Sabbath day , six lambs without defect and a ram without defect ;

verses.z: 同獻的素祭要為公綿羊獻一伊法[細麵]，為羊羔照他的力量而獻，一伊法[細麵]加油一欣。
verses.e: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram , and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give , and a hin of oil to an ephah .

verses.z: 當月朔，要獻無殘疾的公牛犢一隻，羊羔六隻，公綿羊一隻，都要無殘疾的。
verses.e: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect , six lambs , and a ram . They shall be without defect .

verses.z: 他也要預備素祭，為公牛獻一伊法[細麵]，為公綿羊獻一伊法[細麵]，為羊羔照他的力量而獻，一伊法[細麵]加油一欣。
verses.e: He shall prepare a meal offering : an ephah for the bull , and an ephah for the ram , and for the lambs according as he is able , and a hin of oil to an ephah .

verses.z: 王進入的時候必由這門的廊而入，也必由此而出。
verses.e: When the prince enters , he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate , and he shall go out by its way .

verses.z: 「在各節期，國內居民朝見耶和華的時候，從北門進入敬拜的，必由南門而出；從南門進入的，必由北門而出。不可從所入的門而出，必要直往前行，[由對門]而出。
verses.e: " ' " But when the people of the land come before the LORD in the appointed feasts , he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate ; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate . He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in , but shall go out straight before him .

verses.z: 他帶我回到殿門，見殿的門檻下有水往東流出（原來殿面朝東）。這水從檻下，由殿的右邊，在祭壇的南邊往下流。
verses.e: He brought me back to the door of the temple ; and behold , waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward , for the front of the temple faced toward the east . The waters came down from underneath , from the right side of the temple , on the south of the altar .

verses.z: 必有漁夫站在河邊，從隱‧基底直到隱‧以革蓮，都作曬網之處。那魚各從其類，好像大海的魚甚多。
verses.e: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it . From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets . Their fish will be after their kinds , as the fish of the great sea , exceedingly many .

verses.z: 只是泥濘之地與窪濕之處不得治好，必為鹽地。
verses.e: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed . They will be given up to salt .

verses.z: 在河這邊與那邊的岸上必生長各類的樹木；[其果]可作食物，葉子不枯乾，果子不斷絕。每月必結新果子，因為這水是從聖所流出來的。樹上的果子必作食物，葉子乃為治病。」
verses.e: By the river banks , on both sides , will grow every tree for food , whose leaf won't wither , neither will its fruit fail . It will produce new fruit every month , because its waters issue out of the sanctuary . Its fruit will be for food , and its leaf for healing . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：「你們要照地的境界，按以色列十二支派分地為業。約瑟[必得兩]分。
verses.e: The Lord GOD says : " This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel . Joseph shall have two portions .

verses.z: 你們承受這地為業，要彼此均分；因為我曾起誓應許將這地賜與你們的列祖；這地必歸你們為業。
verses.e: You shall inherit it , one as well as another ; for I swore to give it to your fathers . This land will fall to you for inheritance .

verses.z: 「地的四界乃是如此：北界從大海往希特倫，直到西達達口。
verses.e: " This shall be the border of the land : " On the north side , from the great sea , by the way of Hethlon , to the entrance of Zedad ;

verses.z: 又往哈馬、比羅他、西伯蓮（西伯蓮在大馬士革與哈馬兩界中間），到浩蘭邊界的哈撒‧哈提干。
verses.e: Hamath , Berothah , Sibraim ( which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath ) , to Hazer Hatticon , which is by the border of Hauran .

verses.z: 這樣，境界從海邊往大馬士革地界上的哈薩‧以難，北邊以哈馬地為界。這是北界。
verses.e: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus ; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath . This is the north side .

verses.z: 「東界在浩蘭、大馬士革、基列，和以色列地的中間，就是約旦河。你們要從[北]界量到東海。這是東界。
verses.e: " The east side , between Hauran , Damascus , Gilead , and the land of Israel , shall be the Jordan ; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure . This is the east side .

verses.z: 「南界是從他瑪到米利巴‧加低斯的水，延到[埃及]小河，直到大海。這是南界。
verses.e: " The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh , to the brook , to the great sea . This is the south side southward .

verses.z: 他帶我出北門，又領我從外邊轉到朝東的外門，見水從右邊流出。
verses.e: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward , and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate , by the way of the gate that looks toward the east . Behold , waters ran out on the right side .

verses.z: 「西界就是大海，從[南]界直到哈馬口對面之地。這是西界。
verses.e: " The west side shall be the great sea , from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath . This is the west side .

verses.z: 「你們要按着以色列的支派彼此分這地。
verses.e: " So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 要拈鬮分這地為業，歸與自己和你們中間寄居的外人，就是在你們中間生養兒女的外人。你們要看他們如同以色列人中所生的一樣；他們在以色列支派中要與你們同得地業。
verses.e: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you , who will father children among you . Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel . They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 外人寄居在哪支派中，你們就在那裏分給他地業。這是主耶和華說的。」
verses.e: In whatever tribe the stranger lives , there you shall give him his inheritance , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 他手拿準繩往東出去的時候，量了一千肘，使我詵過水，水到踝子骨。
verses.e: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand , he measured one thousand cubits , and he caused me to pass through the waters , waters that were to the ankles .

verses.z: 他又量了一千[肘]，使我詵過水，水就到膝；再量了一千[肘]，使我詵過[水]，水便到腰；
verses.e: Again he measured one thousand , and caused me to pass through the waters , waters that were to the knees . Again he measured one thousand , and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist .

verses.z: 又量了一千[肘]，水便成了河，使我不能詵過。因為水勢漲起，成為可洑的水，不可詵的河。
verses.e: Afterward he measured one thousand ; and it was a river that I could not pass through , for the waters had risen , waters to swim in , a river that could not be walked through .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，你看見了甚麼？」他就帶我回到河邊。
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , have you seen this ? " Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river .

verses.z: 我回到河邊的時候，見在河這邊與那邊的岸上有極多的樹木。
verses.e: Now when I had returned , behold , on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other .

verses.z: 他對我說：「這水往東方流去，必下到亞拉巴，直到海。所發出來的[水]必流入[鹽]海，使水變甜。
verses.e: Then he said to me , " These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah . Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out ; and the waters will be healed .

verses.z: 這河水所到之處，凡滋生的動物都必生活，並且因這流來的水必有極多的魚，[海水]也變甜了。這河水所到之處，百物都必生活。
verses.e: It will happen that every living creature which swarms , in every place where the rivers come , will live . Then there will be a very great multitude of fish ; for these waters have come there , and the waters of the sea will be healed , and everything will live wherever the river comes .

verses.z: 眾支派按名所得[之地]記在下面：從北頭，由希特倫往哈馬口，到大馬士革地界上的哈薩‧以難。北邊靠着哈馬地（各支派[的地]都有東西的邊界），是但的一[分]。
verses.e: " Now these are the names of the tribes : From the north end , beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath , Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus , northward beside Hamath ( and they shall have their sides east and west ) , Dan , one portion .

verses.z: 這聖供地要歸與祭司，北[長]二萬五千[肘]，西寬一萬[肘]，東寬一萬[肘]，南長二萬五千[肘]。耶和華的聖地當在其中。
verses.e: For these , even for the priests , shall be the holy offering : toward the north twenty-five thousand in length , and toward the west ten thousand in width , and toward the east ten thousand in width , and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length ; and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it .

verses.z: 這地要歸與撒督的子孫中成為聖的祭司，就是那守我所吩咐的。當以色列人走迷的時候，他們不像那些利未人走迷了。
verses.e: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok , who have kept my instruction , who didn't go astray when the children of Israel went astray , as the Levites went astray .

verses.z: 這要歸與他們為供地，是全地中至聖的。供地挨着利未人的地界。
verses.e: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land , a most holy thing , by the border of the Levites .

verses.z: 利未人所得的地要長二萬五千[肘]，寬一萬[肘]，與祭司的地界相等，都長二萬五千[肘]，寬一萬[肘]。
verses.e: " Alongside the border of the priests , the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width . All the length shall be twenty-five thousand , and the width ten thousand .

verses.z: 這地不可賣，不可換，初熟之物也不可歸與別人，因為是歸耶和華為聖的。
verses.e: They shall sell none of it , nor exchange it , nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated , for it is holy to the LORD .

verses.z: 這二萬五千[肘]前面所剩下五千[肘]寬之地要作俗用，作為造城蓋房郊野之地。城要在當中。
verses.e: " The five thousand cubits that are left in the width , in front of the twenty-five thousand , shall be for common use , for the city , for dwelling and for pasture lands ; and the city shall be in the middle of it .

verses.z: 城的尺寸乃是如此：北面四千五百[肘]，南面四千五百[肘]，東面四千五百[肘]，西面四千五百[肘]。
verses.e: These shall be its measurements : the north side four thousand and five hundred , and the south side four thousand and five hundred , and on the east side four thousand and five hundred , and the west side four thousand and five hundred .

verses.z: 城必有郊野，向北二百五十[肘]，向南二百五十[肘]，向東二百五十[肘]，向西二百五十[肘]。
verses.e: The city shall have pasture lands : toward the north two hundred fifty , and toward the south two hundred fifty , and toward the east two hundred fifty , and toward the west two hundred fifty .

verses.z: 靠着聖供地的餘地，東長一[萬]肘，西長一萬[肘]，要與聖供地相等；其中的土產要作城內工人的食物。
verses.e: The remainder of the length , alongside the holy offering , shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward ; and it shall be alongside the holy offering . Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city .

verses.z: 所有以色列支派中，在城內做工的，都要耕種這地。
verses.e: Those who labor in the city , out of all the tribes of Israel , shall cultivate it .

verses.z: 挨着但的地界，從東到西，是亞設的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Dan , from the east side to the west side , Asher , one portion .

verses.z: 你們所獻的聖供地連歸城之地，是四方的：長二萬五千[肘]，寬二萬五千[肘]。
verses.e: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand . You shall offer it as a holy offering , with the possession of the city .

verses.z: 聖供地連歸城之地，兩邊的餘地要歸與王。供地東邊，[南北]二萬五千[肘]，東至東界，西邊[南北]二萬五千[肘]，西至西界，與各分之地相同，都要歸王。聖供地和殿的聖地要在其中，
verses.e: " The remainder shall be for the prince , on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city ; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border , and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border , alongside the portions , it shall be for the prince . The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it .

verses.z: 並且利未人之地，與歸城之地的東西兩邊延長之地（這兩地在王地中間），就是在猶大和便雅憫兩界中間，要歸與王。
verses.e: Moreover , from the possession of the Levites , and from the possession of the city , being in the middle of that which is the prince's , between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin , shall be for the prince .

verses.z: 論到其餘的支派，從東到西，是便雅憫的一[分]。
verses.e: " As for the rest of the tribes : from the east side to the west side , Benjamin , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着便雅憫的地界，從東到西，是西緬的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Benjamin , from the east side to the west side , Simeon , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着西緬的地界，從東到西，是以薩迦的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Simeon , from the east side to the west side , Issachar , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着以薩迦的地界，從東到西，是西布倫的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Issachar , from the east side to the west side , Zebulun , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着西布倫的地界，從東到西，是迦得的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Zebulun , from the east side to the west side , Gad , one portion .

verses.z: 迦得地的南界是從他瑪到米利巴‧加低斯的水，延到埃及小河，直到大海。
verses.e: " By the border of Gad , at the south side southward , the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh , to the brook , to the great sea .

verses.z: 這就是你們要拈鬮分給以色列支派為業之地，乃是他們各支派所得之分。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: " This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance , and these are their several portions , says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 挨着亞設的地界，從東到西，是拿弗他利的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Asher , from the east side even to the west side , Naphtali , one portion .

verses.z: 城的北面四千五百[肘]。出城之處如下；
verses.e: " These are the exits of the city : On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure ;

verses.z: 城的各門要按以色列支派的名字。北面有三門，一為呂便門，一為猶大門，一為利未門；
verses.e: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel , three gates northward : the gate of Reuben , one ; the gate of Judah , one ; the gate of Levi , one .

verses.z: 東面四千五百[肘]，有三門，一為約瑟門，一為便雅憫門，一為但門；
verses.e: " At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds , and three gates : even the gate of Joseph , one ; the gate of Benjamin , one ; the gate of Dan , one .

verses.z: 南面四千五百[肘]，有三門，一為西緬門，一為以薩迦門，一為西布倫門；
verses.e: " At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure , and three gates : the gate of Simeon , one ; the gate of Issachar , one ; the gate of Zebulun , one .

verses.z: 西面四千五百[肘]，有三門，一為迦得門，一為亞設門，一為拿弗他利門。
verses.e: " At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds , with their three gates : the gate of Gad , one ; the gate of Asher , one ; the gate of Naphtali , one .

verses.z: 城四圍共一萬八千[肘]。從此以後，這城的名字必稱為「耶和華的所在」。
verses.e: " It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference ; and the name of the city from that day shall be , ' The LORD is there . '

verses.z: 挨着拿弗他利的地界，從東到西，是瑪拿西的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Naphtali , from the east side to the west side , Manasseh , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着瑪拿西的地界，從東到西，是以法蓮的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Manasseh , from the east side to the west side , Ephraim , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着以法蓮的地界，從東到西，是呂便的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Ephraim , from the east side even to the west side , Reuben , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着呂便的地界，從東到西，是猶大的一[分]。
verses.e: " By the border of Reuben , from the east side to the west side , Judah , one portion .

verses.z: 挨着猶大的地界，從東到西，必有你們所當獻的供地，寬二萬五千[肘]。從東界到西界，長短與各分之地相同，聖地當在其中。
verses.e: " By the border of Judah , from the east side to the west side , shall be the offering which you shall offer , twenty-five thousand reeds in width , and in length as one of the portions , from the east side to the west side ; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it .

verses.z: 你們獻與耶和華的供地要長二萬五千[肘]，寬一萬[肘]。
verses.e: " The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length , and ten thousand in width .

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要拿一把快刀，當作剃頭刀，用這刀剃你的頭髮和你的鬍鬚，用天平將鬚髮平分。
verses.e: " You , son of man , take a sharp sword . You shall take it as a barber's razor to yourself , and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard . Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair .

verses.z: 在你中間父親要吃兒子，兒子要吃父親。我必向你施行審判，我必將你所剩下的分散四方。」
verses.e: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you , and the sons will eat their fathers . I will execute judgments on you ; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds .

verses.z: 主耶和華說：「我指着我的永生起誓，因你用一切可憎的物、可厭的事玷污了我的聖所，故此，我定要使[你人數]減少，我眼必不顧惜你，也不可憐你。
verses.e: Therefore as I live , ' says the Lord GOD , ' surely , because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things , and with all your abominations , therefore I will also diminish you . My eye won't spare , and I will have no pity .

verses.z: 你的民三分之一必遭瘟疫而死，在你中間必因饑荒消滅；三分之一必在你四圍倒在刀下；我必將三分之一分散四方，並要拔刀追趕他們。
verses.e: A third part of you will die with the pestilence , and they will be consumed with famine within you . A third part will fall by the sword around you . A third part I will scatter to all the winds , and will draw out a sword after them .

verses.z: 「我要這樣成就怒中所定的；我向他們發的忿怒止息了，自己就得着安慰。我在他們身上成就怒中所定的那時，他們就知道我－耶和華所說的是出於熱心；
verses.e: " ' Thus my anger will be accomplished , and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest , and I will be comforted . They will know that I , the LORD , have spoken in my zeal , when I have accomplished my wrath on them .

verses.z: 並且我必使你在四圍的列國中，在經過的眾人眼前，成了荒涼和羞辱。
verses.e: " ' Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you , in the sight of all that pass by .

verses.z: 這樣，我必以怒氣和忿怒，並烈怒的責備，向你施行審判。那時，你就在四圍的列國中成為羞辱、譏刺、警戒、驚駭。這是我－耶和華說的。
verses.e: So it will be a reproach and a taunt , an instruction and an astonishment , to the nations that are around you , when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath , and in wrathful rebukes — I , the LORD , have spoken it —

verses.z: 那時，我要將滅人、使人饑荒的惡箭，就是射去滅人的，射在你們身上，並要加增你們的饑荒，斷絕你們所倚靠的糧食；
verses.e: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction , which I will send to destroy you . I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread .

verses.z: 又要使饑荒和惡獸到你那裏，叫你喪子，瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那裏；我也要使刀劍臨到你。這是我－耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I will send on you famine and evil animals , and they will bereave you . Pestilence and blood will pass through you . I will bring the sword on you . I , the LORD , have spoken it . ' "

verses.z: 圍困[城]的日子滿了，你要將三分之一在城中用火焚燒，將三分之一在城的四圍用刀砍碎，將三分之一任風吹散；我也要拔刀追趕。
verses.e: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city , when the days of the siege are fulfilled . You shall take a third part , and strike with the sword around it . A third part you shall scatter to the wind , and I will draw out a sword after them .

verses.z: 你要從其中取幾根包在衣襟裏，
verses.e: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe .

verses.z: 再從這幾根中取些扔在火中焚燒，從裏面必有火出來燒入以色列全家。
verses.e: Of these again you shall take , and cast them into the middle of the fire , and burn them in the fire . From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel .

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：這就是耶路撒冷。我曾將她安置在列邦之中；列國都在她的四圍。
verses.e: " The Lord GOD says : ' This is Jerusalem . I have set her in the middle of the nations , and countries are around her .

verses.z: 她行惡，違背我的典章，過於列國；干犯我的律例，過於四圍的列邦，因為她棄掉我的典章。至於我的律例，她並沒有遵行。
verses.e: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations , and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her ; for they have rejected my ordinances , and as for my statutes , they have not walked in them . '

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：因為你們紛爭過於四圍的列國，也不遵行我的律例，不謹守我的典章，並以遵從四圍列國的惡規尚不滿意，
verses.e: " Therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you , and have not walked in my statutes , neither have kept my ordinances , neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you ;

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：看哪，我與你反對，必在列國的眼前，在你中間，施行審判；
verses.e: therefore the Lord GOD says : ' Behold , I , even I , am against you ; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations .

verses.z: 並且因你一切可憎的事，我要在你中間行我所未曾行的，以後我也不再照着行。
verses.e: I will do in you that which I have not done , and which I will not do anything like it any more , because of all your abominations .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 他們必知道我是耶和華；我說要使這災禍臨到他們身上，並非空話。
verses.e: They will know that I am the LORD . I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them . " '

verses.z: 「主耶和華如此說：你當拍手頓足，說：哀哉！以色列家行這一切可憎的惡事，他們必倒在刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫之下。
verses.e: " The Lord GOD says : ' Strike with your hand , and stamp with your foot , and say , " Alas ! " , because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel ; for they will fall by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence .

verses.z: 在遠處的，必遭瘟疫而死；在近處的，必倒在刀劍之下；那存留被圍困的，必因饑荒而死；我必這樣在他們身上成就我怒中所定的。
verses.e: He who is far off will die of the pestilence . He who is near will fall by the sword . He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine . Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them .

verses.z: 他們被殺的人[倒在]他們祭壇四圍的偶像中，就是各高岡、各山頂、各青翠樹下、各茂密的橡樹下，乃是他們獻馨香的祭牲給一切偶像的地方。那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: You will know that I am the LORD when their slain men are among their idols around their altars , on every high hill , on all the tops of the mountains , under every green tree , and under every thick oak — the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols .

verses.z: 我必伸手攻擊他們，使他們的地從曠野到第伯拉他一切住處極其荒涼，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste , from the wilderness toward Diblah , throughout all their habitations . Then they will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 「人子啊，你要面向以色列的眾山說預言，
verses.e: " Son of man , set your face toward the mountains of Israel , and prophesy to them ,

verses.z: 說：以色列的眾山哪，要聽主耶和華的話。主耶和華對大山、小岡、水溝、山谷如此說：我必使刀劍臨到你們，也必毀滅你們的邱壇。
verses.e: and say , ' You mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord GOD ! The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills , to the watercourses and to the valleys : " Behold , I , even I , will bring a sword on you , and I will destroy your high places .

verses.z: 你們的祭壇必然荒涼，你們的日像必被打碎。我要使你們被殺的人倒在你們的偶像面前；
verses.e: Your altars will become desolate , and your incense altars will be broken . I will cast down your slain men before your idols .

verses.z: 我也要將以色列人的屍首放在他們的偶像面前，將你們的骸骨拋散在你們祭壇的四圍。
verses.e: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols . I will scatter your bones around your altars .

verses.z: 在你們一切的住處，城邑要變為荒場，邱壇必然淒涼，使你們的祭壇荒廢，將你們的偶像打碎。你們的日像被砍倒，你們的工作被毀滅。
verses.e: In all your dwelling places , the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate , so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate , and your idols may be broken and cease , and your incense altars may be cut down , and your works may be abolished .

verses.z: 被殺的人必倒在你們中間，你們就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: The slain will fall among you , and you will know that I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「你們分散在各國的時候，我必在列邦中使你們有剩下脫離刀劍的人。
verses.e: " ' " Yet I will leave a remnant , in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations , when you are scattered through the countries .

verses.z: 那脫離[刀劍]的人必在所擄到的各國中記念我，為他們心中何等傷破，是因他們起淫心，遠離我，眼對偶像行邪淫。他們因行一切可憎的惡事，必厭惡自己。
verses.e: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive , how I have been broken with their lewd heart , which has departed from me , and with their eyes , which play the prostitute after their idols . Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「看哪，看哪，日子快到了；所定的災已經發出！杖已經開花，驕傲已經發芽。
verses.e: " ' Behold , the day ! Behold , it comes ! Your doom has gone out . The rod has blossomed . Pride has budded .

verses.z: 強暴興起，成了罰惡的杖。以色列人，或是他們的群眾，或是他們的財寶，無一[存留]；他們中間也沒有得尊榮的。
verses.e: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness . None of them will remain , nor of their multitude , nor of their wealth . There will be nothing of value among them .

verses.z: 時候到了，日子近了，買主不可歡喜，賣主不可愁煩，因為烈怒已經臨到他們眾人身上。
verses.e: The time has come ! The day draws near . Don't let the buyer rejoice , nor the seller mourn ; for wrath is on all its multitude .

verses.z: 賣主雖然存活，卻不能歸回再得所賣的，因為這異象關乎他們眾人。誰都不得歸回，也沒有人在他的罪孽中堅立自己。」
verses.e: For the seller won't return to that which is sold , although they are still alive ; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it . None will return . None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life .

verses.z: 「他們已經吹角，預備齊全，卻無一人出戰，因為我的烈怒臨到他們眾人身上。
verses.e: They have blown the trumpet , and have made all ready ; but no one goes to the battle , for my wrath is on all its multitude .

verses.z: 在外有刀劍；在內有瘟疫、饑荒。在田野的，必遭刀劍而死；在城中的，必有饑荒、瘟疫吞滅他。
verses.e: " ' The sword is outside , and the pestilence and the famine within . He who is in the field will die by the sword . He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence .

verses.z: 其中所逃脫的就必逃脫，各人因自己的罪孽在山上發出悲聲，好像谷中的鴿子哀鳴。
verses.e: But of those who escape , they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys , all of them moaning , everyone in his iniquity .

verses.z: 手都發軟，膝弱如水。
verses.e: All hands will be feeble , and all knees will be weak as water .

verses.z: 要用麻布束腰，被戰兢所蓋；各人臉上羞愧，頭上光禿。
verses.e: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth , and horror will cover them . Shame will be on all faces , and baldness on all their heads .

verses.z: 他們要將銀子拋在街上，金子看如污穢之物。當耶和華發怒的日子，他們的金銀不能救他們，不能使心裏知足，也不能使肚腹飽滿，因為這金銀作了他們罪孽的絆腳石。
verses.e: They will cast their silver in the streets , and their gold will be as an unclean thing . Their silver and their gold won't be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD's wrath . They won't satisfy their souls or fill their bellies ; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity .

verses.z: 「人子啊，主耶和華對以色列地如此說：結局到了，結局到了地的四境！
verses.e: " You , son of man , the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel , ' An end ! The end has come on the four corners of the land .

verses.z: 論到耶和華妝飾華美[的殿]，他建立得威嚴，他們卻在其中製造可憎可厭的偶像，所以[這殿]我使他們看如污穢之物。
verses.e: As for the beauty of his ornament , he set it in majesty ; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein . Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing .

verses.z: 我必將[這殿]交付外邦人為掠物，交付地上的惡人為擄物；他們也必褻瀆[這殿]。
verses.e: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey , and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder ; and they will profane it .

verses.z: 我必轉臉不顧以色列人，他們褻瀆我隱密之[所]，強盜也必進去褻瀆。
verses.e: I will also turn my face from them , and they will profane my secret place . Robbers will enter into it , and profane it .

verses.z: 「要製造鎖鍊；因為這地遍滿流血的罪，城邑充滿強暴的事。
verses.e: " ' Make chains , for the land is full of bloody crimes , and the city is full of violence .

verses.z: 所以，我必使列國中最惡的人來佔據他們的房屋；我必使強暴人的驕傲止息，他們的聖所都要被褻瀆。
verses.e: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations , and they will possess their houses . I will also make the pride of the strong to cease . Their holy places will be profaned .

verses.z: 毀滅臨近了；他們要求平安，卻無平安可得。
verses.e: Destruction comes ! They will seek peace , and there will be none .

verses.z: 災害加上災害，風聲接連風聲；他們必向先知求異象，但祭司講的律法、長老設的謀略都必斷絕。
verses.e: Mischief will come on mischief , and rumor will be on rumor . They will seek a vision of the prophet ; but the law will perish from the priest , and counsel from the elders .

verses.z: 君要悲哀，王要披淒涼為衣，國民的手都發顫。我必照他們的行為待他們，按他們應得的審判他們，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
verses.e: The king will mourn , and the prince will be clothed with desolation . The hands of the people of the land will be troubled . I will do to them after their way , and according to their own judgments I will judge them . Then they will know that I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 現在你的結局已經臨到，我必使我的怒氣歸與你，也必按你的行為審判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罰你。
verses.e: Now the end is on you , and I will send my anger on you , and will judge you according to your ways . I will bring on you all your abominations .

verses.z: 我眼必不顧惜你，也不可憐你，卻要按你所行的報應你，照你中間可憎的事刑罰你。你就知道我是耶和華。
verses.e: My eye will not spare you , neither will I have pity ; but I will bring your ways on you , and your abominations will be among you . Then you will know that I am the LORD . '

verses.z: 「主耶和華如此說：有一災，獨有一災；看哪，臨近了！
verses.e: " The Lord GOD says : ' A disaster ! A unique disaster ! Behold , it comes .

verses.z: 結局來了，結局來了，向你興起。看哪，來到了！
verses.e: An end has come . The end has come ! It awakes against you . Behold , it comes .

verses.z: 境內的居民哪，所定的災臨到你，時候到了，日子近了，乃是鬨嚷並非在山上歡呼的日子。
verses.e: Your doom has come to you , inhabitant of the land ! The time has come ! The day is near , a day of tumult , and not of joyful shouting , on the mountains .

verses.z: 我快要將我的忿怒傾在你身上，向你成就我怒中所定的，按你的行為審判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罰你。
verses.e: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you , and accomplish my anger against you , and will judge you according to your ways . I will bring on you all your abominations .

verses.z: 我眼必不顧惜你，也不可憐你，必按你所行的報應你，照你中間可憎的事刑罰你。你就知道擊打你的是我耶和華。
verses.e: My eye won't spare , neither will I have pity . I will punish you according to your ways . Your abominations will be among you . Then you will know that I , the LORD , strike .

verses.z: 第六年六[月]初五[日]，我坐在家中；猶大的眾長老坐在我面前。在那裏主耶和華的靈降在我身上。
verses.e: In the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in my house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , the Lord GOD's hand fell on me there .

verses.z: 我進去一看，誰知，在四面牆上畫着各樣爬物和可憎的走獸，並以色列家一切的偶像。
verses.e: So I went in and looked , and saw every form of creeping things , abominable animals , and all the idols of the house of Israel , portrayed around on the wall .

verses.z: 在這些像前有以色列家的七十個長老站立，沙番的兒子雅撒尼亞也站在其中。各人手拿香爐，煙雲的香氣上騰。
verses.e: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them . In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood , every man with his censer in his hand ; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，以色列家的長老暗中在各人畫像屋裏所行的，你看見了嗎？他們常說：『耶和華看不見我們；耶和華已經離棄這地。』」
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Son of man , have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark , every man in his rooms of imagery ? For they say , ' The LORD doesn't see us . The LORD has forsaken the land . ' "

verses.z: 他又說：「你還要看見他們另外行大可憎的事。」
verses.e: He said also to me , " You will again see more of the great abominations which they do . "

verses.z: 他領我到耶和華殿外院朝北的門口。誰知，在那裏有婦女坐着，為搭模斯哭泣。
verses.e: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD's house which was toward the north ; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，你看見了嗎？你還要看見比這更可憎的事。」
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Have you seen this , son of man ? You will again see yet greater abominations than these . "

verses.z: 他又領我到耶和華殿的內院。誰知，在耶和華的殿門口、廊子和祭壇中間，約有二十五個人背向耶和華的殿，面向東方拜日頭。
verses.e: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house ; and I saw at the door of the LORD's temple , between the porch and the altar , there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD's temple and their faces toward the east . They were worshiping the sun toward the east .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，你看見了嗎？猶大家在此行這可憎的事還算為小嗎？他們在這地遍行強暴，再三惹我發怒，他們手拿枝條舉向鼻前。
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Have you seen this , son of man ? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here ? For they have filled the land with violence , and have turned again to provoke me to anger . Behold , they put the branch to their nose .

verses.z: 因此，我也要以忿怒行事，我眼必不顧惜，也不可憐他們；他們雖向我耳中大聲呼求，我還是不聽。」
verses.e: Therefore I will also deal in wrath . My eye won't spare , neither will I have pity . Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice , yet I will not hear them . "

verses.z: 我觀看，見有形像彷彿火的形狀，從他腰以下的形狀有火，從他腰以上有光輝的形狀，彷彿光耀的精金。
verses.e: Then I saw , and behold , a likeness as the appearance of fire — from the appearance of his waist and downward , fire , and from his waist and upward , as the appearance of brightness , as it were glowing metal .

verses.z: 他伸出彷彿一隻手的樣式，抓住我的一綹頭髮，靈就將我舉到天地中間，在上帝的異象中，帶我到耶路撒冷朝北的內[院]門口，在那裏有觸動[主]怒偶像的坐位，就是惹動忌邪的。
verses.e: He stretched out the form of a hand , and took me by a lock of my head ; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky , and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem , to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north , where there was the seat of the image of jealousy , which provokes to jealousy .

verses.z: 誰知，在那裏有以色列上帝的榮耀，形狀與我在平原所見的一樣。
verses.e: Behold , the glory of the God of Israel was there , according to the appearance that I saw in the plain .

verses.z: 上帝對我說：「人子啊，你舉目向北觀看。」我就舉目向北觀看，見祭壇門的北邊，在門口有這[惹]忌邪的偶像；
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Son of man , lift up your eyes now the way toward the north . " So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north , and saw , northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry .

verses.z: 又對我說：「人子啊，以色列家所行的，就是在此行這大可憎的事，使我遠離我的聖所，你看見了嗎？你還要看見另有大可憎的事。」
verses.e: He said to me , " Son of man , do you see what they do ? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here , that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? But you will again see yet other great abominations . "

verses.z: 他領我到院門口。我觀看，見牆上有個窟窿。
verses.e: He brought me to the door of the court ; and when I looked , behold , a hole in the wall .

verses.z: 他對我說：「人子啊，你要挖牆。」我一挖牆，見有一門。
verses.e: Then he said to me , " Son of man , dig now in the wall . " When I had dug in the wall , I saw a door .

verses.z: 他說：「你進去，看他們在這裏所行可憎的惡事。」
verses.e: He said to me , " Go in , and see the wicked abominations that they do here . "

verses.z: 他向我耳中大聲喊叫說：「要使那監管這城的人手中各拿滅命的兵器前來。」
verses.e: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice , saying , " Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near , each man with his destroying weapon in his hand . "

verses.z: 故此，我眼必不顧惜，也不可憐他們，要照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。」
verses.e: As for me also , my eye won't spare , neither will I have pity , but I will bring their way on their head . "

verses.z: 那穿細麻衣、腰間帶着墨盒子的人將這事回覆說：「我已經照你所吩咐的行了。」
verses.e: Behold , the man clothed in linen , who had the inkhorn by his side , reported the matter , saying , " I have done as you have commanded me . "

verses.z: 忽然有六個人從朝北的上門而來，各人手拿殺人的兵器；內中有一人身穿細麻衣，腰間帶着墨盒子。他們進來，站在銅祭壇旁。
verses.e: Behold , six men came from the way of the upper gate , which lies toward the north , every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand . One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen , with a writer's inkhorn by his side . They went in , and stood beside the bronze altar .

verses.z: 以色列上帝的榮耀本在基路伯上，現今從那裏升到殿的門檻。上帝將那身穿細麻衣、腰間帶着墨盒子的人召來。
verses.e: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub , whereupon it was , to the threshold of the house ; and he called to the man clothed in linen , who had the writer's inkhorn by his side .

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「你去走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行可憎之事歎息哀哭的人，畫記號在額上。」
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Go through the middle of the city , through the middle of Jerusalem , and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it . "

verses.z: 我耳中聽見他對其餘的人說：「要跟隨他走遍全城，以行擊殺。你們的眼不要顧惜，也不要可憐他們。
verses.e: To the others he said in my hearing , " Go through the city after him , and strike . Don't let your eye spare , neither have pity .

verses.z: 要將年老的、年少的，並處女、嬰孩，和婦女，從聖所起全都殺盡，只是凡有記號的人不要挨近他。」於是他們從殿前的長老殺起。
verses.e: Kill utterly the old man , the young man , the virgin , little children and women ; but don't come near any man on whom is the mark . Begin at my sanctuary . " Then they began at the old men who were before the house .

verses.z: 他對他們說：「要污穢這殿，使院中充滿被殺的人。你們出去吧！」他們就出去，在城中擊殺。
verses.e: He said to them , " Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain . Go out ! " They went out , and struck in the city .

verses.z: 他們擊殺的時候，我被留下，我就俯伏在地，說：「哎！主耶和華啊，你將忿怒傾在耶路撒冷，豈要將以色列所剩下的人都滅絕嗎？」
verses.e: While they were killing , and I was left , I fell on my face , and cried , and said , " Ah Lord GOD ! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem ? "

verses.z: 他對我說：「以色列家和猶大家的罪孽極其重大。遍地有流血的事，滿城有冤屈，因為他們說：『耶和華已經離棄這地，他看不見我們。』
verses.e: Then he said to me , " The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great , and the land is full of blood , and the city full of perversion ; for they say , ' The LORD has forsaken the land , and the LORD doesn't see . '

verses.z: 波斯王塞魯士元年，耶和華為要應驗藉耶利米口所說的話，就激動波斯王塞魯士的心，使他下詔通告全國說：
verses.e: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia , that the LORD's word by Jeremiah's mouth might be accomplished , the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia , so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom , and put it also in writing , saying ,

verses.z: 金碗三十個，銀碗之次的四百一十個，別樣的器皿一千件。
verses.e: thirty bowls of gold , four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind , and one thousand other vessels .

verses.z: 金銀器皿共有五千四百件。被擄的人從巴比倫上耶路撒冷的時候，設巴薩將這一切都帶上來。
verses.e: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred . Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 「波斯王塞魯士如此說：『耶和華天上的上帝已將天下萬國賜給我，又囑咐我在猶大的耶路撒冷為他建造殿宇。
verses.e: " Cyrus king of Persia says , ' The LORD , the God of heaven , has given me all the kingdoms of the earth ; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem , which is in Judah .

verses.z: 在你們中間凡作他子民的，可以上猶大的耶路撒冷，在耶路撒冷重建耶和華－以色列上帝的殿（只有他是上帝）。願上帝與這人同在。
verses.e: Whoever there is among you of all his people , may his God be with him , and let him go up to Jerusalem , which is in Judah , and build the house of the LORD , the God of Israel ( he is God ) , which is in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 凡剩下的人，無論寄居何處，那地的人要用金銀、財物、牲畜幫助他，另外也要為耶路撒冷上帝的殿甘心獻上禮物。』」
verses.e: Whoever is left , in any place where he lives , let the men of his place help him with silver , with gold , with goods , and with animals , in addition to the free will offering for God's house which is in Jerusalem . ' "

verses.z: 於是，猶大和便雅憫的族長、祭司、利未人，就是一切被上帝激動他心的人，都起來要上耶路撒冷去建造耶和華的殿。
verses.e: Then the heads of fathers ' households of Judah and Benjamin , the priests and the Levites , all whose spirit God had stirred to go up , rose up to build the LORD's house which is in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他們四圍的人就拿銀器、金子、財物、牲畜、珍寶幫助他們，另外還有甘心獻的禮物。
verses.e: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver , with gold , with goods , with animals , and with precious things , in addition to all that was willingly offered .

verses.z: 塞魯士王也將耶和華殿的器皿拿出來，這器皿是尼布甲尼撒從耶路撒冷掠來、放在自己神之廟中的。
verses.e: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of the LORD's house , which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem , and had put in the house of his gods ;

verses.z: 波斯王塞魯士派庫官米提利達將這器皿拿出來，按數交給猶大的首領設巴薩。
verses.e: even those , Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer , and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah .

verses.z: 器皿的數目記在下面：金盤三十個，銀盤一千個，刀二十九把，
verses.e: This is the number of them : thirty platters of gold , one thousand platters of silver , twenty-nine knives ,

verses.z: 以斯拉禱告，認罪，哭泣，俯伏在上帝殿前的時候，有以色列中的男女孩童聚集到以斯拉那裏，成了大會，眾民無不痛哭。
verses.e: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession , weeping and casting himself down before God's house , there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children ; for the people wept very bitterly .

verses.z: 祭司以斯拉站起來，對他們說：「你們有罪了；因你們娶了外邦的女子為妻，增添以色列人的罪惡。
verses.e: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them , " You have trespassed , and have married foreign women , increasing the guilt of Israel .

verses.z: 現在當向耶和華－你們列祖的上帝認罪，遵行他的旨意，離絕這些國的民和外邦的女子。」
verses.e: Now therefore make confession to the LORD , the God of your fathers and do his pleasure . Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women . "

verses.z: 會眾都大聲回答說：「我們必照着你的話行，
verses.e: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice , " We must do as you have said concerning us .

verses.z: 只是百姓眾多，又逢大雨的時令，我們不能站在外頭，這也不是一兩天辦完的事，因我們在這事上犯了大罪；
verses.e: But the people are many , and it is a time of much rain , and we are not able to stand outside . This is not a work of one day or two , for we have greatly transgressed in this matter .

verses.z: 不如為全會眾派首領辦理。凡我們城邑中娶外邦女子為妻的，當按所定的日期，同着本城的長老和士師而來，直到辦完這事，上帝的烈怒就轉離我們了。」
verses.e: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly , and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times , and with them the elders of every city and its judges , until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us , until this matter is resolved . "

verses.z: 惟有亞撒黑的兒子約拿單，特瓦的兒子雅哈謝阻擋這事，並有米書蘭和利未人沙比太幫助他們。
verses.e: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this ; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them .

verses.z: 被擄歸回的人如此而行。祭司以斯拉和些族長按着宗族都指名見派；在十月初一日，一同在座查辦這事，
verses.e: The children of the captivity did so . Ezra the priest , with certain heads of fathers ' households , after their fathers ' houses , and all of them by their names , were set apart ; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter .

verses.z: 到正月初一日，才查清娶外邦女子的人數。
verses.e: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month .

verses.z: 在祭司中查出娶外邦女子為妻的，就是耶書亞的子孫約薩達的兒子，和他弟兄瑪西雅、以利以謝、雅立、基大利；
verses.e: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women : of the sons of Jeshua , the son of Jozadak , and his brothers : Maaseiah , Eliezer , Jarib , and Gedaliah .

verses.z: 他們便應許必休他們的妻。他們因有罪，就[獻]群中的一隻公綿羊贖罪。
verses.e: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives ; and being guilty , they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt .

verses.e: Then Ezra arose , and made the chiefs of the priests , the Levites , and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word . So they swore .

verses.z: 以斯拉從上帝殿前起來，進入以利亞實的兒子約哈難的屋裏，到了那裏不吃飯，也不喝水；因為被擄歸回之人所犯的罪，心裏悲傷。
verses.e: Then Ezra rose up from before God's house , and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib . When he came there , he didn't eat bread or drink water , for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles .

verses.z: 他們通告猶大和耶路撒冷被擄歸回的人，叫他們在耶路撒冷聚集。
verses.e: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity , that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 凡不遵首領和長老所議定、三日之內不來的，就必抄他的家，使他離開被擄歸回之人的會。
verses.e: and that whoever didn't come within three days , according to the counsel of the princes and the elders , all his possessions should be forfeited , and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity .

verses.z: 於是，猶大和便雅憫眾人，三日之內都聚集在耶路撒冷。那日正是九月二十日，眾人都坐在上帝殿前的寬闊處；因這事，又因下大雨，就都戰兢。
verses.e: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days . It was the ninth month , on the twentieth day of the month ; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God's house , trembling because of this matter , and because of the great rain .

verses.z: 這三家的人在族譜之中尋查自己的譜系，卻尋不着，因此算為不潔，不准供祭司的職任。
verses.e: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy , but they were not found ; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood .

verses.z: 省長對他們說：「不可吃至聖的物，直到有用烏陵和土明決疑的祭司興起來。」
verses.e: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim .

verses.z: 會眾共有四萬二千三百六十名。
verses.e: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty ,

verses.z: 此外，還有他們的僕婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百名。
verses.e: in addition to their male servants and their female servants , of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven ; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women .

verses.e: their camels , four hundred thirty-five ; their donkeys , six thousand seven hundred twenty .

verses.z: 有些族長到了耶路撒冷耶和華殿的地方，便為上帝的殿甘心獻上禮物，要重新建造。
verses.e: Some of the heads of fathers ' households , when they came to the LORD's house which is in Jerusalem , offered willingly for God's house to set it up in its place .

verses.z: 他們量力捐入工程庫的金子六萬一千達利克，銀子五千彌拿，並祭司的禮服一百件。
verses.e: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold , five thousand minas of silver , and one hundred priests ' garments .

verses.e: So the priests and the Levites , with some of the people , the singers , the gatekeepers , and the temple servants , lived in their cities , and all Israel in their cities .

verses.e: When the seventh month had come , and the children of Israel were in the cities , the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 匠人立耶和華殿根基的時候，祭司皆穿禮服吹號，亞薩的子孫利未人敲鈸，照以色列王大衛所定的例，都站着讚美耶和華。
verses.e: When the builders laid the foundation of the LORD's temple , they set the priests in their vestments with trumpets , with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals , to praise the LORD , according to the directions of David king of Israel .

verses.z: 他們彼此唱和，讚美稱謝耶和華[說]：他本為善，他向以色列人永發慈愛。他們讚美耶和華的時候，眾民大聲呼喊，因耶和華殿的根基已經立定。
verses.e: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to the LORD , " For he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel . " All the people shouted with a great shout , when they praised the LORD , because the foundation of the LORD's house had been laid .

verses.z: 然而有許多祭司、利未人、族長，就是見過舊殿的老年人，現在親眼看見立這殿的根基，便大聲哭號，也有許多人大聲歡呼，
verses.e: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers ' households , the old men who had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice . Many also shouted aloud for joy ,

verses.z: 甚至百姓不能分辨歡呼的聲音和哭號的聲音；因為眾人大聲呼喊，聲音聽到遠處。
verses.e: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people ; for the people shouted with a loud shout , and the noise was heard far away .

verses.z: 約薩達兒子耶書亞和他的弟兄眾祭司，並撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯與他的弟兄，都起來建築以色列上帝的壇，要照神人摩西律法書上所寫的，在壇上獻燔祭。
verses.e: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives , and built the altar of the God of Israel , to offer burnt offerings on it , as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God .

verses.z: 他們在原有的根基上築壇，因懼怕鄰國的民，又在其上向耶和華早晚獻燔祭，
verses.e: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands , they set the altar on its base ; and they offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD , even burnt offerings morning and evening .

verses.z: 又照律法書上所寫的守住棚節，按數照例[獻]每日所當獻的燔祭；
verses.e: They kept the feast of booths , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the ordinance , as the duty of every day required ;

verses.z: 其後獻常獻的燔祭，並在月朔與耶和華的一切聖節獻祭，又向耶和華獻各人的甘心祭。
verses.e: and afterward the continual burnt offering , the offerings of the new moons , of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated , and of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 從七月初一日起，他們就向耶和華獻燔祭。但耶和華殿的根基尚未立定。
verses.e: From the first day of the seventh month , they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD ; but the foundation of the LORD's temple was not yet laid .

verses.z: 他們又將銀子給石匠、木匠，把糧食、酒、油給西頓人、泰爾人，使他們將香柏樹從黎巴嫩運到海裏，浮海運到約帕，是照波斯王塞魯士所允准的。
verses.e: They also gave money to the masons and to the carpenters . They also gave food , drink , and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea , to Joppa , according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia .

verses.z: 百姓到了耶路撒冷上帝殿的地方。第二年二月，撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯，約薩達的兒子耶書亞和其餘的弟兄，就是祭司、利未人，並一切被擄歸回耶路撒冷的人，都興工建造；又派利未人，從二十歲以外的，督理建造耶和華殿的工作。
verses.e: Now in the second year of their coming to God's house at Jerusalem , in the second month , Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites , and all those who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem , began the work and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to have the oversight of the work of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 於是猶大的後裔，就是耶書亞和他的子孫與弟兄，甲篾和他的子孫，利未人希拿達的子孫與弟兄，都一同起來，督理那在上帝殿做工的人。
verses.e: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together to have the oversight of the workmen in God's house : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brothers the Levites .

verses.z: 猶大和便雅憫的敵人聽說被擄歸回的人為耶和華－以色列的上帝建造殿宇，
verses.e: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to the LORD , the God of Israel ,

verses.z: 和尊大的亞斯那巴所遷移、安置在撒馬利亞城，並大河西一帶地方的人等，
verses.e: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria , and in the rest of the country beyond the River , and so forth , wrote .

verses.z: 上奏亞達薛西王說：「河西的臣民云云：
verses.e: This is the copy of the letter that they sent : To King Artaxerxes , from your servants , the people beyond the River .

verses.z: 王該知道，從王那裏上到我們這裏的猶大人，已經到耶路撒冷重建這反叛惡劣的城，築立根基，建造城牆。
verses.e: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem . They are building the rebellious and bad city , and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations .

verses.z: 如今王該知道，他們若建造這城，城牆完畢就不再與王進貢，交課，納稅，終久王必受虧損。
verses.e: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished , they will not pay tribute , custom , or toll , and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings .

verses.z: 我們既食御鹽，不忍見王吃虧，因此奏告於王。
verses.e: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king's dishonor , therefore we have sent and informed the king ,

verses.z: 請王考察先王的實錄，必在其上查知這城是反叛的城，與列王和各省有害；自古以來，其中常有悖逆的事，因此這城曾被拆毀。
verses.e: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers . You will see in the book of the records , and know that this city is a rebellious city , and hurtful to kings and provinces , and that they have started rebellions within it in the past . That is why this city was destroyed .

verses.z: 我們謹奏王知，這城若再建造，城牆完畢，河西之地王就無分了。」
verses.e: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished , then you will have no possession beyond the River .

verses.z: 那時王諭覆省長利宏、書記伸帥，和他們的同黨，就是住撒馬利亞並河西一帶地方的人，說：「願你們平安云云。
verses.e: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria , and in the rest of the country beyond the River : Peace .

verses.z: 你們所上的本，已經明讀在我面前。
verses.e: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me .

verses.z: 我已命人考查，得知此城古來果然背叛列王，其中常有反叛悖逆的事。
verses.e: I decreed , and search has been made , and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past , and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it .

verses.z: 就去見所羅巴伯和以色列的族長，對他們說：「請容我們與你們一同建造；因為我們尋求你們的上帝，與你們一樣。自從亞述王以撒哈頓帶我們上這地以來，我們常祭祀上帝。」
verses.e: they came near to Zerubbabel , and to the heads of fathers ' households , and said to them , " Let us build with you , for we seek your God as you do ; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria , who brought us up here . "

verses.z: 從前耶路撒冷也有大君王統管河西全[地]，人就給他們進貢，交課，納稅。
verses.e: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River ; and tribute , custom , and toll was paid to them .

verses.z: 現在你們要出告示命這些人停工，使這城不得建造，等我降旨。
verses.e: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease , and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me .

verses.z: 你們當謹慎，不可遲延，為何容害加重，使王受虧損呢？」
verses.e: Be careful that you not be slack doing so . Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?

verses.z: 亞達薛西王的上諭讀在利宏和書記伸帥，並他們的同黨面前，他們就急忙往耶路撒冷去見猶大人，用勢力強迫他們停工。
verses.e: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes ' letter was read before Rehum , Shimshai the scribe , and their companions , they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews , and made them to cease by force of arms .

verses.z: 於是，在耶路撒冷上帝殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大流士第二年。
verses.e: Then work stopped on God's house which is at Jerusalem . It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia .

verses.z: 但所羅巴伯、耶書亞，和其餘以色列的族長對他們說：「我們建造上帝的殿與你們無干，我們自己為耶和華－以色列的上帝協力建造，是照波斯王塞魯士所吩咐的。」
verses.e: But Zerubbabel , Jeshua , and the rest of the heads of fathers ' households of Israel said to them , " You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God ; but we ourselves together will build to the LORD , the God of Israel , as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us . "

verses.z: 那地的民，就在猶大人建造的時候，使他們的手發軟，擾亂他們；
verses.e: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah , and troubled them in building .

verses.z: 從波斯王塞魯士年間，直到波斯王大流士登基的時候，賄買謀士，要敗壞他們的謀算。
verses.e: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia , even until the reign of Darius king of Persia .

verses.z: 在亞哈隨魯才登基的時候，上本控告猶大和耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.e: In the reign of Ahasuerus , in the beginning of his reign , they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem .

verses.z: 亞達薛西年間，比施蘭、米特利達、他別，和他們的同黨上本奏告波斯王亞達薛西。本章是用亞蘭[文字]，亞蘭[方言]。
verses.e: In the days of Artaxerxes , Bishlam , Mithredath , Tabeel , and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia ; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language .

verses.z: 省長利宏、書記伸帥要控告耶路撒冷人，也上本奏告亞達薛西王。
verses.e: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows .

verses.z: 省長利宏、書記伸帥，和同黨的底拿人、亞法薩提迦人、他毗拉人、亞法撒人、亞基衛人、巴比倫人、書珊迦人、底亥人、以攔人，
verses.e: Then Rehum the chancellor , Shimshai the scribe , and the rest of their companions , the Dinaites , and the Apharsathchites , the Tarpelites , the Apharsites , the Archevites , the Babylonians , the Shushanchites , the Dehaites , the Elamites ,

verses.z: 那時，先知哈該和易多的孫子撒迦利亞奉以色列上帝的名向猶大和耶路撒冷的猶大人說勸勉的話。
verses.e: Now the prophets , Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo , prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem . They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel .

verses.z: 又問他們的名字，要記錄他們首領的名字，奏告於王。
verses.e: We asked them their names also , to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head .

verses.z: 他們回答說：『我們是天地之上帝的僕人，重建前多年所建造的殿，就是以色列的一位大君王建造修成的。
verses.e: Thus they returned us answer , saying , " We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are building the house that was built these many years ago , which a great king of Israel built and finished .

verses.z: 只因我們列祖惹天上的上帝發怒，上帝把他們交在迦勒底人巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他就拆毀這殿，又將百姓擄到巴比倫。
verses.e: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon .

verses.z: 然而巴比倫王塞魯士元年，他降旨允准建造上帝的這殿。
verses.e: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon , Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God .

verses.z: 上帝殿中的金、銀器皿，就是尼布甲尼撒從耶路撒冷的殿中掠去帶到巴比倫廟裏的，塞魯士王從巴比倫廟裏取出來，交給派為省長的，名叫設巴薩，
verses.e: The gold and silver vessels of God's house , which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon , those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon , and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar , whom he had made governor .

verses.z: 對他說可以將這些器皿帶去，放在耶路撒冷的殿中，在原處建造上帝的殿。
verses.e: He said to him , ' Take these vessels , go , put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let God's house be built in its place . '

verses.z: 於是這設巴薩來建立耶路撒冷上帝殿的根基。這殿從那時直到如今尚未造成。』
verses.e: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God's house which is in Jerusalem . Since that time even until now it has been being built , and yet it is not completed .

verses.z: 現在王若以為美，請察巴比倫王的府庫，看塞魯士王降旨允准在耶路撒冷建造上帝的殿沒有，王的心意如何？請降旨曉諭我們。」
verses.e: Now therefore , if it seems good to the king , let a search be made in the king's treasure house , which is there at Babylon , whether it is so that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem ; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter . "

verses.z: 於是撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約薩達的兒子耶書亞都起來動手建造耶路撒冷上帝的殿，有上帝的先知在那裏幫助他們。
verses.e: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God's house which is at Jerusalem ; and with them were the prophets of God , helping them .

verses.z: 當時河西的總督達乃和示他‧波斯乃，並他們的同黨來問說：「誰降旨讓你們建造這殿，修成這牆呢？」
verses.e: At the same time Tattenai , the governor beyond the River , came to them , with Shetharbozenai and their companions , and asked them , " Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall ? "

verses.z: 我們便告訴他們建造這殿的人叫甚麼名字。
verses.e: They also asked for the names of the men who were making this building .

verses.z: 上帝的眼目看顧猶大的長老，以致總督等沒有叫他們停工，直到這事奏告大流士，得着他的回諭。
verses.e: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews , and they didn't make them cease until the matter should come to Darius , and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it .

verses.z: 河西的總督達乃和示他‧波斯乃，並他們的同黨，就是住河西的亞法薩迦人，上本奏告大流士王。
verses.e: The copy of the letter that Tattenai , the governor beyond the River , and Shetharbozenai , and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River , sent to Darius the king follows .

verses.z: 本上寫着說：「願大流士王諸事平安。
verses.e: They sent a letter to him , in which was written : To Darius the king , all peace .

verses.z: 王該知道，我們往猶大省去，到了至大上帝的殿，這殿是用大石建造的。樑木插入牆內，工作甚速，他們手下亨通。
verses.e: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls . This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands .

verses.z: 我們就問那些長老說：『誰降旨讓你們建造這殿，修成這牆呢？』
verses.e: Then we asked those elders , and said to them thus , " Who gave you a decree to build this house , and to finish this wall ? "

verses.z: 於是大流士王降旨，要尋察典籍庫內，就是在巴比倫藏寶物之處；
verses.e: Then Darius the king made a decree , and the house of the archives , where the treasures were laid up in Babylon , was searched .

verses.z: 好叫他們獻馨香的祭給天上的上帝，又為王和王眾子的壽命祈禱。
verses.e: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king and of his sons .

verses.z: 我再降旨，無論誰更改這命令，必從他房屋中拆出一根樑來，把他舉起，懸在其上，又使他的房屋成為糞堆。
verses.e: I have also made a decree that whoever alters this message , let a beam be pulled out from his house , and let him be lifted up and fastened on it ; and let his house be made a dunghill for this .

verses.z: 若有王和民伸手更改這[命令]，拆毀這殿，願那使耶路撒冷的殿作為他名居所的上帝將他們滅絕。我－大流士降這旨意，當速速遵行。」
verses.e: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this , to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem . I Darius have made a decree . Let it be done with all diligence .

verses.z: 於是，河西總督達乃和示他‧波斯乃，並他們的同黨，因大流士王所發的命令，就急速遵行。
verses.e: Then Tattenai , the governor beyond the River , Shetharbozenai , and their companions did accordingly with all diligence , because Darius the king had sent a decree .

verses.z: 猶大長老因先知哈該和易多的孫子撒迦利亞所說勸勉的話就建造這殿，凡事亨通。他們遵着以色列上帝的命令和波斯王塞魯士、大流士、亞達薛西的旨意，建造完畢。
verses.e: The elders of the Jews built and prospered , through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo . They built and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel , and according to the decree of Cyrus , Darius , and Artaxerxes king of Persia .

verses.z: 大流士王第六年，亞達月初三日，這殿修成了。
verses.e: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar , which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king .

verses.z: 以色列的祭司和利未人，並其餘被擄歸回的人都歡歡喜喜地行奉獻上帝殿的禮。
verses.e: The children of Israel , the priests , the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy .

verses.z: 行奉獻上帝殿的禮就獻公牛一百隻，公綿羊二百隻，綿羊羔四百隻，又照以色列支派的數目獻公山羊十二隻，為以色列眾人作贖罪祭；
verses.e: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve male goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 且派祭司和利未人按着班次在耶路撒冷事奉上帝，是照摩西[律法]書上所寫的。
verses.e: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses , for the service of God which is at Jerusalem , as it is written in the book of Moses .

verses.z: 正月十四日，被擄歸回的人守逾越節。
verses.e: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month .

verses.z: 在米底亞省亞馬他城的宮內尋得一卷，其中記着說：
verses.e: A scroll was found at Achmetha , in the palace that is in the province of Media , and in it this was written for a record :

verses.z: 原來，祭司和利未人一同自潔，無一人不潔淨。利未人為被擄歸回的眾人和他們的弟兄眾祭司，並為自己宰逾越節[的羊羔]。
verses.e: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together , all of them were pure . They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity , for their brothers the priests , and for themselves .

verses.z: 從擄到之地歸回的以色列人和一切除掉所染外邦人污穢、歸附他們、要尋求耶和華－以色列上帝的人都吃[這羊羔]，
verses.e: The children of Israel who had returned out of the captivity , and all who had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land to seek the LORD , the God of Israel , ate ,

verses.z: 歡歡喜喜地守除酵節七日；因為耶和華使他們歡喜，又使亞述王的心轉向他們，堅固他們的手，作以色列上帝殿的工程。
verses.e: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy ; because the LORD had made them joyful , and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them , to strengthen their hands in the work of God , the God of Israel's house .

verses.z: 「塞魯士王元年，他降旨論到耶路撒冷上帝的殿，要建造這殿為獻祭之處，堅立殿的根基。殿高六十肘，寬六十肘，
verses.e: In the first year of Cyrus the king , Cyrus the king made a decree : Concerning God's house at Jerusalem , let the house be built , the place where they offer sacrifices , and let its foundations be strongly laid , with its height sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits ;

verses.z: 用三層大石頭，一層新木頭，經費要出於王庫；
verses.e: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber . Let the expenses be given out of the king's house .

verses.z: 並且上帝殿的金銀器皿，就是尼布甲尼撒從耶路撒冷的殿中掠到巴比倫的，要歸還帶到耶路撒冷的殿中，各按原處放在上帝的殿裏。」
verses.e: Also let the gold and silver vessels of God's house , which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon , be restored and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem , everything to its place . You shall put them in God's house .

verses.z: 「現在河西的總督達乃和示他‧波斯乃，並你們的同黨，就是住河西的亞法薩迦人，你們當遠離他們。
verses.e: Now therefore , Tattenai , governor beyond the River , Shetharbozenai , and your companions the Apharsachites , who are beyond the River , you must stay far from there .

verses.z: 不要攔阻上帝殿的工作，任憑猶大人的省長和猶大人的長老在原處建造上帝的這殿。
verses.e: Leave the work of this house of God alone ; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place .

verses.z: 我又降旨，吩咐你們向猶大人的長老為建造上帝的殿當怎樣行，就是從河西的款項中，急速撥取貢銀作他們的經費，免得耽誤工作。
verses.e: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God : that of the king's goods , even of the tribute beyond the River , expenses must be given with all diligence to these men , that they not be hindered .

verses.z: 他們與天上的上帝獻燔祭所需用的公牛犢、公綿羊、綿羊羔，並所用的麥子、鹽、酒、油，都要照耶路撒冷祭司的話，每日供給他們，不得有誤；
verses.e: That which they have need of , including young bulls , rams , and lambs , for burnt offerings to the God of heaven ; also wheat , salt , wine , and oil , according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem , let it be given them day by day without fail ,

verses.z: 這事以後，波斯王亞達薛西年間，有個以斯拉，他是西萊雅的兒子，西萊雅是亞撒利雅的兒子，亞撒利雅是希勒家的兒子，
verses.e: Now after these things , in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia , Ezra the son of Seraiah , the son of Azariah , the son of Hilkiah ,

verses.z: 以斯拉定志考究遵行耶和華的律法，又將律例典章教訓以色列人。
verses.e: For Ezra had set his heart to seek the LORD's law , and to do it , and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel .

verses.z: 祭司以斯拉是通達耶和華誡命和賜以色列之律例的文士。亞達薛西王賜給他們諭旨，上面寫着說：
verses.e: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest , the scribe , even the scribe of the words of the LORD's commandments , and of his statutes to Israel :

verses.z: 「諸王之王亞達薛西，達於祭司以斯拉通達天上上帝律法大德的文士，云云。
verses.e: Artaxerxes , king of kings , To Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the perfect God of heaven . Now

verses.z: 住在我國中的以色列人、祭司、利未人，凡甘心上耶路撒冷去的，我降旨准他們與你同去。
