verses.e: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm , who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem , go with you .

verses.z: 王與七個謀士既然差你去，照你手中上帝的律法書察問猶大和耶路撒冷的景況；
verses.e: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of your God which is in your hand ,

verses.z: 又帶金銀，就是王和謀士甘心獻給住耶路撒冷、以色列上帝的，
verses.e: and to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,

verses.z: 並帶你在巴比倫全省所得的金銀，和百姓、祭司樂意獻給耶路撒冷－他們上帝殿的禮物。
verses.e: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon , with the free will offering of the people and of the priests , offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 所以你當用這金銀，急速買公牛、公綿羊、綿羊羔，和同獻的素祭奠祭之物，獻在耶路撒冷－你們上帝殿的壇上。
verses.e: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls , rams , and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings , and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 剩下的金銀，你和你的弟兄看着怎樣好，就怎樣用，總要遵着你們上帝的旨意。
verses.e: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , do that according to the will of your God .

verses.z: 所交給你上帝殿中使用的器皿，你要交在耶路撒冷上帝面前。
verses.e: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God , deliver before the God of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 希勒家是沙龍的兒子，沙龍是撒督的兒子，撒督是亞希突的兒子，
verses.e: the son of Shallum , the son of Zadok , the son of Ahitub ,

verses.z: 你上帝殿裏若再有需用的經費，你可以從王的府庫裏支取。
verses.e: Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God , which you may have occasion to give , give it out of the king's treasure house .

verses.z: 「我－亞達薛西王又降旨與河西的一切庫官，說：『通達天上上帝律法的文士祭司以斯拉，無論向你們要甚麼，你們要速速地備辦，
verses.e: I , even I , Artaxerxes the king , make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the River , that whatever Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , requires of you , it shall be done with all diligence ,

verses.z: 就是銀子直到一百他連得，麥子一百柯珥，酒一百罷特，油一百罷特，鹽不計其數，也要給他。
verses.e: up to one hundred talents of silver , and to one hundred cors of wheat , and to one hundred baths of wine , and to one hundred baths of oil , and salt without prescribing how much .

verses.z: 凡天上之上帝所吩咐的，當為天上上帝的殿詳細辦理。為何使忿怒臨到王和王眾子的國呢？
verses.e: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven , let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven ; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons ?

verses.z: 我又曉諭你們，至於祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的，和尼提寧，並在上帝殿當差的人，不可叫他們進貢，交課，納稅。』
verses.e: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute , custom , or toll on any of the priests , Levites , singers , gatekeepers , temple servants , or laborers of this house of God .

verses.z: 「以斯拉啊，要照着你上帝賜你的智慧，將所有明白你上帝律法的人立為士師、審判官，治理河西的百姓，使他們教訓一切不明白[上帝]律法的人。
verses.e: You , Ezra , according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand , appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River , who all know the laws of your God ; and teach him who doesn't know them .

verses.z: 凡不遵行你上帝律法和王命令的人就當速速定他的罪，或治死，或充軍，或抄家，或囚禁。」
verses.e: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king , let judgment be executed on him with all diligence , whether it is to death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .

verses.z: 以斯拉說：「耶和華－我們列祖的上帝是應當稱頌的！因他使王起這心意修飾耶路撒冷耶和華的殿，
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD , the God of our fathers , who has put such a thing as this in the king's heart , to beautify the LORD's house which is in Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 又在王和謀士，並大能的軍長面前施恩於我。因耶和華－我上帝的手幫助我，我就得以堅強，從以色列中招聚首領，與我一同上來。」
verses.e: and has extended loving kindness to me before the king and his counselors , and before all the king's mighty princes . I was strengthened according to the LORD my God's hand on me , and I gathered together chief men out of Israel to go up with me .

verses.z: 亞希突是亞瑪利雅的兒子，亞瑪利雅是亞撒利雅的兒子，亞撒利雅是米拉約的兒子，
verses.e: the son of Amariah , the son of Azariah , the son of Meraioth ,

verses.z: 米拉約是西拉希雅的兒子，西拉希雅是烏西的兒子，烏西是布基的兒子，
verses.e: the son of Zerahiah , the son of Uzzi , the son of Bukki ,

verses.z: 布基是亞比書的兒子，亞比書是非尼哈的兒子，非尼哈是以利亞撒的兒子，以利亞撒是大祭司亞倫的兒子。
verses.e: the son of Abishua , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the chief priest —

verses.z: 這以斯拉從巴比倫上來，他是敏捷的文士，通達耶和華－以色列上帝所賜摩西的律法書。王允准他一切所求的，是因耶和華－他上帝的手幫助他。
verses.e: this Ezra went up from Babylon . He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses , which the LORD , the God of Israel , had given ; and the king granted him all his request , according to the LORD his God's hand on him .

verses.z: 亞達薛西王第七年，以色列人、祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的、尼提寧，有上耶路撒冷的。
verses.e: Some of the children of Israel , including some of the priests , the Levites , the singers , the gatekeepers , and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .

verses.z: 王第七年五月，以斯拉到了耶路撒冷。
verses.e: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month , which was in the seventh year of the king .

verses.z: 正月初一日，他從巴比倫起程；因他上帝施恩的手幫助他，五月初一日就到了耶路撒冷。
verses.e: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon ; and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem , according to the good hand of his God on him .

verses.z: 當亞達薛西王年間，同我從巴比倫上來的人，他們的族長和他們的家譜記在下面：
verses.e: Now these are the heads of their fathers ' households , and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon , in the reign of Artaxerxes the king :

verses.z: 屬示羅密的子孫有約細斐的兒子，同着他有男丁一百六十；
verses.e: Of the sons of Shelomith , the son of Josiphiah ; and with him one hundred sixty males .

verses.z: 屬比拜的子孫有比拜的兒子撒迦利亞，同着他有男丁二十八；
verses.e: Of the sons of Bebai , Zechariah the son of Bebai ; and with him twenty-eight males .

verses.z: 屬押甲的子孫有哈加坦的兒子約哈難，同着他有男丁一百一十；
verses.e: Of the sons of Azgad , Johanan the son of Hakkatan ; and with him one hundred ten males .

verses.z: 屬亞多尼干的子孫，就是末尾的，他們的名字是以利法列、耶利、示瑪雅，同着他們有男丁六十；
verses.e: Of the sons of Adonikam , who were the last , their names are : Eliphelet , Jeuel , and Shemaiah ; and with them sixty males .

verses.z: 屬比革瓦伊的子孫有烏太和撒布，同着他們有男丁七十。
verses.e: Of the sons of Bigvai , Uthai and Zabbud ; and with them seventy males .

verses.z: 我招聚這些人在流入亞哈瓦的河邊，我們在那裏住了三日。我查看百姓和祭司，見沒有利未人在那裏，
verses.e: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava ; and there we encamped three days . Then I looked around at the people and the priests , and found there were none of the sons of Levi .

verses.z: 就召首領以利以謝、亞列、示瑪雅、以利拿單、雅立、以利拿單、拿單、撒迦利亞、米書蘭，又召教習約雅立和以利拿單。
verses.e: Then I sent for Eliezer , for Ariel , for Shemaiah , for Elnathan , for Jarib , for Elnathan , for Nathan , for Zechariah , and for Meshullam , chief men ; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan , who were teachers .

verses.z: 我打發他們往迦西斐雅地方去見那裏的首領易多，又告訴他們當向易多和他的弟兄尼提寧說甚麼話，叫他們為我們上帝的殿帶使用的人來。
verses.e: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia ; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia , that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God .

verses.z: 蒙我們上帝施恩的手幫助我們，他們在以色列的曾孫、利未的孫子、抹利的後裔中帶一個通達人來；還有示利比和他的眾子與弟兄共一十八人。
verses.e: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion , of the sons of Mahli , the son of Levi , the son of Israel , namely Sherebiah , with his sons and his brothers , eighteen ;

verses.z: 又有哈沙比雅，同着他有米拉利的子孫耶篩亞，並他的眾子和弟兄共二十人。
verses.e: and Hashabiah , and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari , his brothers and their sons , twenty ;

verses.z: 屬非尼哈的子孫有革順；屬以他瑪的子孫有但以理；屬大衛的子孫有哈突；
verses.e: Of the sons of Phinehas , Gershom . Of the sons of Ithamar , Daniel . Of the sons of David , Hattush .

verses.z: 從前大衛和眾首領派尼提寧服事利未人，現在從這尼提寧中也帶了二百二十人來，都是按名指定的。
verses.e: and of the temple servants , whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites , two hundred twenty temple servants . All of them were mentioned by name .

verses.z: 那時，我在亞哈瓦河邊宣告禁食，為要在我們上帝面前克苦己心，求他使我們和[婦人]孩子，並一切所有的，都得平坦的道路。
verses.e: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava , that we might humble ourselves before our God , to seek from him a straight way for us , for our little ones , and for all our possessions .

verses.z: 我求王撥步兵馬兵幫助我們抵擋路上的仇敵，本以為羞恥；因我曾對王說：「我們上帝施恩的手必幫助一切尋求他的；但他的能力和忿怒必攻擊一切離棄他的。」
verses.e: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way , because we had spoken to the king , saying , " The hand of our God is on all those who seek him , for good ; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him . "

verses.z: 所以我們禁食祈求我們的上帝，他就應允了我們。
verses.e: So we fasted and begged our God for this , and he granted our request .

verses.z: 我分派祭司長十二人，就是示利比、哈沙比雅，和他們的弟兄十人，
verses.e: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests , even Sherebiah , Hashabiah , and ten of their brothers with them ,

verses.z: 將王和謀士、軍長，並在那裏的以色列眾人為我們上帝殿所獻的金銀和器皿，都秤了交給他們。
verses.e: and weighed to them the silver , the gold , and the vessels , even the offering for the house of our God , which the king , his counselors , his princes , and all Israel there present , had offered .

verses.z: 我秤了交在他們手中的銀子有六百五十他連得；銀器重一百他連得；金子一百他連得；
verses.e: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver , one hundred talents of silver vessels , one hundred talents of gold ,

verses.z: 金碗二十個，重一千達利克；上等光銅的器皿兩個，寶貴如金。
verses.e: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics , and two vessels of fine bright bronze , precious as gold .

verses.z: 我對他們說：「你們歸耶和華為聖，器皿也為聖；金銀是甘心獻給耶和華－你們列祖之上帝的。
verses.e: I said to them , " You are holy to the LORD , and the vessels are holy . The silver and the gold are a free will offering to the LORD , the God of your fathers .

verses.z: 你們當警醒看守，直到你們在耶路撒冷耶和華殿的庫內，在祭司長和利未族長，並以色列的各族長面前過了秤。」
verses.e: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests , the Levites , and the princes of the fathers ' households of Israel at Jerusalem , in the rooms of the LORD's house . "

verses.z: 屬巴錄的後裔，就是示迦尼的子孫有撒迦利亞，同着他，按家譜計算，男丁一百五十人；
verses.e: Of the sons of Shecaniah , of the sons of Parosh , Zechariah ; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty .

verses.z: 於是，祭司、利未人按着分量接受金銀和器皿，要帶到耶路撒冷我們上帝的殿裏。
verses.e: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver , the gold , and the vessels , to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God .

verses.z: 正月十二日，我們從亞哈瓦河邊起行，要往耶路撒冷去。我們上帝的手保佑我們，救我們脫離仇敵和路上埋伏之人的手。
verses.e: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month , to go to Jerusalem . The hand of our God was on us , and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way .

verses.z: 我們到了耶路撒冷，在那裏住了三日。
verses.e: We came to Jerusalem , and stayed there three days .

verses.z: 第四日，在我們上帝的殿裏把金銀和器皿都秤了，交在祭司烏利亞的兒子米利末的手中。同着他有非尼哈的兒子以利亞撒，還有利未人耶書亞的兒子約撒拔和賓內的兒子挪亞底。
verses.e: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest ; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas ; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua , and Noadiah the son of Binnui , the Levites .

verses.z: 當時都點了數目，按着分量寫在冊上。
verses.e: Everything was counted and weighed ; and all the weight was written at that time .

verses.z: 從擄到之地歸回的人向以色列的上帝獻燔祭，就是為以色列眾人獻公牛十二隻，公綿羊九十六隻，綿羊羔七十七隻，又獻公山羊十二隻作贖罪祭，這都是向耶和華焚獻的。
verses.e: The children of the captivity , who had come out of exile , offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel : twelve bulls for all Israel , ninety-six rams , seventy-seven lambs , and twelve male goats for a sin offering . All this was a burnt offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 他們將王的諭旨交給王所派的總督與河西的省長，他們就幫助百姓，又供給上帝殿裏所需用的。
verses.e: They delivered the king's commissions to the king's local governors and to the governors beyond the River . So they supported the people and God's house .

verses.z: 屬巴哈‧摩押的子孫有西拉希雅的兒子以利約乃，同着他有男丁二百；
verses.e: Of the sons of Pahathmoab , Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah ; and with him two hundred males .

verses.z: 屬示迦尼的子孫有雅哈悉的兒子，同着他有男丁三百；
verses.e: Of the sons of Shecaniah , the son of Jahaziel ; and with him three hundred males .

verses.z: 屬亞丁的子孫有約拿單的兒子以別，同着他有男丁五十；
verses.e: Of the sons of Adin , Ebed the son of Jonathan ; and with him fifty males .

verses.z: 屬以攔的子孫有亞他利雅的兒子耶篩亞，同着他有男丁七十；
verses.e: Of the sons of Elam , Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah ; and with him seventy males .

verses.z: 屬示法提雅的子孫有米迦勒的兒子西巴第雅，同着他有男丁八十；
verses.e: Of the sons of Shephatiah , Zebadiah the son of Michael ; and with him eighty males .

verses.z: 屬約押的子孫有耶歇的兒子俄巴底亞，同着他有男丁二百一十八；
verses.e: Of the sons of Joab , Obadiah the son of Jehiel ; and with him two hundred eighteen males .

verses.z: 這事做完了，眾首領來見我，說：「以色列民和祭司並利未人，沒有離絕迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、亞捫人、摩押人、埃及人、亞摩利人，仍效法這些國的民，行可憎的事。
verses.e: Now when these things were done , the princes came near to me , saying , " The people of Israel , the priests , and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands , following their abominations , even those of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Perizzites , the Jebusites , the Ammonites , the Moabites , the Egyptians , and the Amorites .

verses.z: 「我們的上帝啊，既是如此，我們還有甚麼話可說呢？因為我們已經離棄你的命令，
verses.e: " Now , our God , what shall we say after this ? For we have forsaken your commandments ,

verses.z: 就是你藉你僕人眾先知所吩咐的說：『你們要去得為業之地是污穢之地；因列國之民的污穢和可憎的事，叫全地從這邊直到那邊滿了污穢。
verses.e: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets , saying , ' The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands , through their abominations , which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness .

verses.z: 所以不可將你們的女兒嫁他們的兒子，也不可為你們的兒子娶他們的女兒，永不可求他們的平安和他們的利益，這樣你們就可以強盛，吃這地的美物，並遺留這地給你們的子孫永遠為業。』
verses.e: Now therefore don't give your daughters to their sons . Don't take their daughters to your sons , nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever , that you may be strong and eat the good of the land , and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever . '

verses.z: 上帝啊，我們因自己的惡行和大罪，遭遇了這一切的事，並且你刑罰我們輕於我們罪所當得的，又給我們留下這些人。
verses.e: " After all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt , since you , our God , have punished us less than our iniquities deserve , and have given us such a remnant ,

verses.z: 我們豈可再違背你的命令，與這行可憎之事的民結親呢？[若這樣行]，你豈不向我們發怒，將我們滅絕，以致沒有一個剩下逃脫的人嗎？
verses.e: shall we again break your commandments , and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations ? Wouldn't you be angry with us until you had consumed us , so that there would be no remnant , nor any to escape ?

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，因你是公義的，我們這剩下的人才得逃脫，正如今日的光景。看哪，我們在你面前有罪惡，因此無人在你面前站立得住。」
verses.e: LORD , the God of Israel , you are righteous ; for we are left a remnant that has escaped , as it is today . Behold , we are before you in our guiltiness ; for no one can stand before you because of this . "

verses.z: 因他們為自己和兒子娶了這些外邦女子為妻，以致聖潔的種類和這些國的民混雜；而且首領和官長在這事上為罪魁。」
verses.e: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons , so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands . Yes , the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass . "

verses.z: 我一聽見這事，就撕裂衣服和外袍，拔了頭髮和鬍鬚，驚懼憂悶而坐。
verses.e: When I heard this thing , I tore my garment and my robe , and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard , and sat down confounded .

verses.z: 凡為以色列上帝言語戰兢的，都因這被擄歸回之人所犯的罪聚集到我這裏來。我就驚懼憂悶而坐，直到獻晚祭的時候。
verses.e: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me because of the trespass of the exiles ; and I sat confounded until the evening offering .

verses.z: 獻晚祭的時候我起來，心中愁苦，穿着撕裂的衣袍，雙膝跪下向耶和華－我的上帝舉手，
verses.e: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation , even with my garment and my robe torn ; and I fell on my knees , and spread out my hands to the LORD my God ;

verses.z: 說：「我的上帝啊，我抱愧蒙羞，不敢向我上帝仰面；因為我們的罪孽滅頂，我們的罪惡滔天。
verses.e: and I said , " My God , I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you , my God , for our iniquities have increased over our head , and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens .

verses.z: 從我們列祖直到今日，我們的罪惡甚重；因我們的罪孽，我們和君王、祭司都交在外邦列王的手中，殺害、擄掠、搶奪、臉上蒙羞正如今日的光景。
verses.e: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day ; and for our iniquities we , our kings , and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands , to the sword , to captivity , to plunder , and to confusion of face , as it is this day .

verses.z: 現在耶和華－我們的上帝暫且施恩與我們，給我們留些逃脫的人，使我們[安穩]如釘子釘在他的聖所，我們的上帝好光照我們的眼目，使我們在受轄制之中稍微復興。
verses.e: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from the LORD our God , to leave us a remnant to escape , and to give us a stake in his holy place , that our God may lighten our eyes , and revive us a little in our bondage .

verses.z: 我們是奴僕，然而在受轄制之中，我們的上帝仍沒有丟棄我們，在波斯王眼前向我們施恩，叫我們復興，能重建我們上帝的殿，修其毀壞之處，使我們在猶大和耶路撒冷有牆垣。
verses.e: For we are bondservants ; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage , but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia , to revive us , to set up the house of our God , and to repair its ruins , and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 作使徒的保羅（不是由於人，也不是藉着人，乃是藉着耶穌基督，與叫他從死裏復活的父上帝）
verses.e: Paul , an apostle — not from men , nor through man , but through Jesus Christ , and God the Father , who raised him from the dead —

verses.z: 我現在是要得人的心呢？還是要得上帝的心呢？我豈是討人的喜歡嗎？若仍舊討人的喜歡，我就不是基督的僕人了。
verses.e: For am I now seeking the favor of men , or of God ? Or am I striving to please men ? For if I were still pleasing men , I wouldn't be a servant of Christ .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我告訴你們，我素來所傳的福音不是出於人的意思。
verses.e: But I make known to you , brothers , concerning the Good News which was preached by me , that it is not according to man .

verses.z: 因為我不是從人領受的，也不是人教導我的，乃是從耶穌基督啟示來的。
verses.e: For I didn't receive it from man , nor was I taught it , but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 你們聽見我從前在猶太教中所行的事，怎樣極力逼迫殘害上帝的教會。
verses.e: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews ' religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it .

verses.z: 我又在猶太教中，比我本國許多同歲的人更有長進，為我祖宗的遺傳更加熱心。
verses.e: I advanced in the Jews ' religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen , being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers .

verses.z: 然而，那把我從母腹裏分別出來、又施恩召我的上帝，
verses.e: But when it was the good pleasure of God , who separated me from my mother's womb and called me through his grace ,

verses.z: 既然樂意將他兒子啟示在我心裏，叫我把他傳在外邦人中，我就沒有與屬血氣的人商量，
verses.e: to reveal his Son in me , that I might preach him among the Gentiles , I didn't immediately confer with flesh and blood ,

verses.z: 也沒有上耶路撒冷去見那些比我先作使徒的，惟獨往阿拉伯去，後又回到大馬士革。
verses.e: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me , but I went away into Arabia . Then I returned to Damascus .

verses.z: 過了三年，才上耶路撒冷去見磯法，和他同住了十五天。
verses.e: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter , and stayed with him fifteen days .

verses.z: 至於別的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都沒有看見。
verses.e: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James , the Lord's brother .

verses.z: 和一切與我同在的眾弟兄，寫信給加拉太的各教會。
verses.e: and all the brothers who are with me , to the assemblies of Galatia :

verses.z: 我寫給你們的不是謊話，這是我在上帝面前說的。
verses.e: Now about the things which I write to you , behold , before God , I'm not lying .

verses.z: 以後我到了敘利亞和基利家境內。
verses.e: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia .

verses.z: 那時，猶太信基督的各教會都沒有見過我的面。
verses.e: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ ,

verses.z: 不過聽說那從前逼迫我們的，現在傳揚他原先所殘害的真道。
verses.e: but they only heard , " He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy . "

verses.z: 他們就為我的緣故，歸榮耀給上帝。
verses.e: So they glorified God in me .

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安從父上帝與我們的主耶穌基督歸與你們！
verses.e: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 基督照我們父上帝的旨意，為我們的罪捨己，要救我們脫離這罪惡的世代。
verses.e: who gave himself for our sins , that he might deliver us out of this present evil age , according to the will of our God and Father —

verses.z: 但願榮耀歸於上帝，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: to whom be the glory forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 我希奇你們這麼快離開那藉着基督之恩召你們的，去從別的福音。
verses.e: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different " good news " ,

verses.z: 那並不是[福音]，不過有些人攪擾你們，要把基督的福音更改了。
verses.e: but there isn't another " good news . " Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ .

verses.z: 但無論是我們，是天上來的使者，若傳福音給你們，與我們所傳給你們的不同，他就應當被咒詛。
verses.e: But even though we , or an angel from heaven , should preach to you any " good news " other than that which we preached to you , let him be cursed .

verses.z: 我們已經說了，現在又說，若有人傳福音給你們，與你們所領受的不同，他就應當被咒詛。
verses.e: As we have said before , so I now say again : if any man preaches to you any " good news " other than that which you received , let him be cursed .

verses.z: 過了十四年，我同巴拿巴又上耶路撒冷去，並帶着提多同去。
verses.e: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas , taking Titus also with me .

verses.z: 只是願意我們記念窮人；這也是我本來熱心去行的。
verses.e: They only asked us to remember the poor — which very thing I was also zealous to do .

verses.z: 後來，磯法到了安提阿；因他有可責之處，我就當面抵擋他。
verses.e: But when Peter came to Antioch , I resisted him to his face , because he stood condemned .

verses.z: 從雅各那裏來的人未到以先，他和外邦人一同吃飯，及至他們來到，他因怕奉割禮的人，就退去與外邦人隔開了。
verses.e: For before some people came from James , he ate with the Gentiles . But when they came , he drew back and separated himself , fearing those who were of the circumcision .

verses.z: 其餘的猶太人也都隨着他裝假，甚至連巴拿巴也隨夥裝假。
verses.e: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy , so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy .

verses.z: 但我一看見他們行的不正，與福音的真理不合，就在眾人面前對磯法說：「你既是猶太人，若隨外邦人行事，不隨猶太人行事，怎麼還勉強外邦人隨猶太人呢？」
verses.e: But when I saw that they didn't walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News , I said to Peter before them all , " If you , being a Jew , live as the Gentiles do , and not as the Jews do , why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do ?

verses.z: 我們這生來的猶太人，不是外邦的罪人；
verses.e: " We , being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners ,

verses.z: 既知道人稱義不是因行律法，乃是因信耶穌基督，連我們也信了基督耶穌，使我們因信基督稱義，不因行律法稱義；因為凡有血氣的，沒有一人因行律法稱義。
verses.e: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ , even we believed in Christ Jesus , that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law , because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law .

verses.z: 我們若求在基督裏稱義，卻仍舊是罪人，難道基督是叫人犯罪的嗎？斷乎不是！
verses.e: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ , we ourselves also were found sinners , is Christ a servant of sin ? Certainly not !

verses.z: 我素來所拆毀的，若重新建造，這就證明自己是犯罪的人。
verses.e: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed , I prove myself a law-breaker .

verses.z: 我因律法，就向律法死了，叫我可以向上帝活着。
verses.e: For I through the law died to the law , that I might live to God .

verses.z: 我是奉啟示上去的，把我在外邦人中所傳的福音對弟兄們陳說；卻是背地裏對那有名望之人說的，惟恐我現在，或是從前，徒然奔跑。
verses.e: I went up by revelation , and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles , but privately before those who were respected , for fear that I might be running , or had run , in vain .

verses.z: 我已經與基督同釘十字架，現在活着的不再是我，乃是基督在我裏面活着；並且我如今在肉身活着，是因信上帝的兒子而活；他是愛我，為我捨己。
verses.e: I have been crucified with Christ , and it is no longer I who live , but Christ lives in me . That life which I now live in the flesh , I live by faith in the Son of God , who loved me and gave himself up for me .

verses.z: 我不廢掉上帝的恩；義若是藉着律法得的，基督就是徒然死了。
verses.e: I don't reject the grace of God . For if righteousness is through the law , then Christ died for nothing ! "

verses.z: 但與我同去的提多，雖是希臘人，也沒有勉強他受割禮；
verses.e: But not even Titus , who was with me , being a Greek , was compelled to be circumcised .

verses.z: 因為有偷着引進來的假弟兄，私下窺探我們在基督耶穌裏的自由，要叫我們作奴僕。
verses.e: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in , who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage ,

verses.z: 我們就是一刻的工夫也沒有容讓順服他們，為要叫福音的真理仍存在你們中間。
verses.e: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection , not for an hour , that the truth of the Good News might continue with you .

verses.z: 至於那些有名望的，不論他是何等人，都與我無干。上帝不以外貌取人。那些有名望的，並沒有加增我甚麼，
verses.e: But from those who were reputed to be important — whatever they were , it makes no difference to me ; God doesn't show partiality to man — they , I say , who were respected imparted nothing to me ,

verses.z: 反倒看見了主託我傳福音給那未受割禮的人，正如託彼得傳福音給那受割禮的人。（
verses.e: but to the contrary , when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised , even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised —

verses.z: 那感動彼得、叫他為受割禮之人作使徒的，也感動我，叫我為外邦人作使徒；）
verses.e: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles —

verses.z: 又知道所賜給我的恩典，那稱為[教會]柱石的雅各、磯法、約翰，就向我和巴拿巴用右手行相交之禮，叫我們往外邦人那裏去，他們往受割禮的人那裏去。
verses.e: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me , James and Cephas and John , those who were reputed to be pillars , gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship , that we should go to the Gentiles , and they to the circumcision .

verses.z: 無知的加拉太人哪，耶穌基督釘十字架，已經活畫在你們眼前，誰又迷惑了你們呢？
verses.e: Foolish Galatians , who has bewitched you not to obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified ?

verses.z: 凡以行律法為本的，都是被咒詛的；因為[經上]記着：「凡不常照律法書上所記一切之事去行的，就被咒詛。」
verses.e: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse . For it is written , " Cursed is everyone who doesn't continue in all things that are written in the book of the law , to do them . "

verses.z: 沒有一個人靠着律法在上帝面前稱義，這是明顯的；因為[經上]說：「義人必因信得生。」
verses.e: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident , for , " The righteous will live by faith . "

verses.z: 律法原不本乎信，只[說]：「行這些事的，就必因此活着。」
verses.e: The law is not of faith , but , " The man who does them will live by them . "

verses.z: 基督既為我們受了咒詛，就贖出我們脫離律法的咒詛；因為[經上]記着：「凡掛在木頭上都是被咒詛的。」
verses.e: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law , having become a curse for us . For it is written , " Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree , "

verses.z: 這便叫亞伯拉罕的福，因基督耶穌可以臨到外邦人，使我們因信得着所應許的[聖]靈。
verses.e: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus , that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我且照着人的常話說：雖然是人的文約，若已經立定了，就沒有能廢棄或加增的。
verses.e: Brothers , speaking of human terms , though it is only a man's covenant , yet when it has been confirmed , no one makes it void or adds to it .

verses.z: 所應許的原是向亞伯拉罕和他子孫說的。上帝並不是說「眾子孫」，指着許多人，乃是說「你那一個子孫」，指着一個人，就是基督。
verses.e: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring . He doesn't say , " To descendants " , as of many , but as of one , " To your offspring " , which is Christ .

verses.z: 我是這麼說，上帝預先所立的約，不能被那四百三十年以後的律法廢掉，叫應許歸於虛空。
verses.e: Now I say this : A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ , the law , which came four hundred thirty years after , does not annul , so as to make the promise of no effect .

verses.z: 因為承受產業，若本乎律法，就不本乎應許；但上帝是憑着應許把產業賜給亞伯拉罕。
verses.e: For if the inheritance is of the law , it is no more of promise ; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise .

verses.z: 這樣說來，律法是為甚麼有的呢？原是為過犯添上的，等候那蒙應許的子孫來到，並且是藉天使經中保之手設立的。
verses.e: Then why is there the law ? It was added because of transgressions , until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made . It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator .

verses.z: 我只要問你們這一件：你們受了[聖]靈，是因行律法呢？是因聽信[福音]呢？
verses.e: I just want to learn this from you : Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law , or by hearing of faith ?

verses.z: 但中保本不是為一面作的；上帝卻是一位。
verses.e: Now a mediator is not between one , but God is one .

verses.z: 這樣，律法是與上帝的應許反對嗎？斷乎不是！若曾傳一個能叫人得生的律法，義就誠然本乎律法了。
verses.e: Is the law then against the promises of God ? Certainly not ! For if there had been a law given which could make alive , most certainly righteousness would have been of the law .

verses.z: 但聖經把眾人都圈在罪裏，使所應許的[福]因信耶穌基督，歸給那信的人。
verses.e: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin , that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe .

verses.z: 但這[因]信[得救的理]還未來以先，我們被看守在律法之下，直圈到那將來的真道顯明出來。
verses.e: But before faith came , we were kept in custody under the law , confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed .

verses.z: 這樣，律法是我們訓蒙的師傅，[引我們]到基督那裏，使我們因信稱義。
verses.e: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ , that we might be justified by faith .

verses.z: 但這[因]信[得救的理]既然來到，我們從此就不在師傅的手下了。
verses.e: But now that faith has come , we are no longer under a tutor .

verses.z: 所以，你們因信基督耶穌都是上帝的兒子。
verses.e: For you are all children of God , through faith in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 你們受洗歸入基督的都是披戴基督了。
verses.e: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ .

verses.z: 並不分猶太人、希臘人，自主的、為奴的，或男或女，因為你們在基督耶穌裏都成為一了。
verses.e: There is neither Jew nor Greek , there is neither slave nor free man , there is neither male nor female ; for you are all one in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 你們既屬乎基督，就是亞伯拉罕的後裔，是照着應許承受產業的了。
verses.e: If you are Christ's , then you are Abraham's offspring and heirs according to promise .

verses.z: 你們既靠[聖]靈入門，如今還靠肉身成全嗎？你們是這樣的無知嗎？
verses.e: Are you so foolish ? Having begun in the Spirit , are you now completed in the flesh ?

verses.z: 你們受苦如此之多，都是徒然的嗎？難道果真是徒然的嗎？
verses.e: Did you suffer so many things in vain , if it is indeed in vain ?

verses.z: 那賜給你們[聖]靈，又在你們中間行異能的，是因你們行律法呢？是因你們聽信[福音]呢？
verses.e: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you , does he do it by the works of the law , or by hearing of faith ?

verses.z: 正如「亞伯拉罕信上帝，這就算為他的義」。
verses.e: Even so , Abraham " believed God , and it was counted to him for righteousness . "

verses.z: 所以，你們要知道：那以信為本的人，就是亞伯拉罕的子孫。
verses.e: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham .

verses.z: 並且聖經既然預先看明，上帝要叫外邦人因信稱義，就早已傳福音給亞伯拉罕，[說]：「萬國都必因你得福。」
verses.e: The Scripture , foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith , preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham , saying , " In you all the nations will be blessed . "

verses.z: 可見那以信為本的人和有信心的亞伯拉罕一同得福。
verses.e: So then , those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham .

verses.z: 我說那承受產業的，雖然是全業的主人，但為孩童的時候卻與奴僕毫無分別，
verses.e: But I say that so long as the heir is a child , he is no different from a bondservant , though he is lord of all ,

verses.z: 你們謹守日子、月份、節期、年份，
verses.e: You observe days , months , seasons , and years .

verses.z: 我為你們害怕，惟恐我在你們身上是枉費了工夫。
verses.e: I am afraid for you , that I might have wasted my labor for you .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我勸你們要像我一樣，因為我也像你們一樣。你們一點沒有虧負我。
verses.e: I beg you , brothers , become as I am , for I also have become as you are . You did me no wrong ,

verses.z: 你們知道我頭一次傳福音給你們，是因為身體有疾病。
verses.e: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time .

verses.z: 你們為我身體的緣故受試煉，沒有輕看我，也沒有厭棄我，反倒接待我，如同上帝的使者，如同基督耶穌。
verses.e: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh , you didn't despise nor reject ; but you received me as an angel of God , even as Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 你們當日所誇的福氣在哪裏呢？那時你們若能行，就是把自己的眼睛剜出來給我，也都情願。這是我可以給你們作見證的。
verses.e: What was the blessing you enjoyed ? For I testify to you that , if possible , you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me .

verses.z: 如今我將真理告訴你們，就成了你們的仇敵嗎？
verses.e: So then , have I become your enemy by telling you the truth ?

verses.z: 那些人熱心待你們，卻不是好意，是要離間你們，叫你們熱心待他們。
verses.e: They zealously seek you in no good way . No , they desire to alienate you , that you may seek them .

verses.z: 在善事上，常用熱心待人原是好的，卻不單我與你們同在的時候才這樣。
verses.e: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause , and not only when I am present with you .

verses.z: 我小子啊，我為你們再受生產之苦，直等到基督成形在你們心裏。
verses.e: My little children , of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you —

verses.z: 乃在師傅和管家的手下，直等他父親預定的時候來到。
verses.e: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father .

verses.z: 我巴不得現今在你們那裏，改換口氣，因我為你們心裏作難。
verses.e: but I could wish to be present with you now , and to change my tone , for I am perplexed about you .

verses.z: 你們這願意在律法以下的人，請告訴我，你們豈沒有聽見律法嗎？
verses.e: Tell me , you that desire to be under the law , don't you listen to the law ?

verses.z: 因為[律法上]記着，亞伯拉罕有兩個兒子，一個是使女生的，一個是自主之婦人生的。
verses.e: For it is written that Abraham had two sons , one by the servant , and one by the free woman .

verses.z: 然而，那使女所生的是按着血氣生的；那自主之婦人所生的是憑着應許生的。
verses.e: However , the son by the servant was born according to the flesh , but the son by the free woman was born through promise .

verses.z: 這都是比方：那兩個婦人就是兩約。一約是出於西奈山，生子為奴，乃是夏甲。
verses.e: These things contain an allegory , for these are two covenants . One is from Mount Sinai , bearing children to bondage , which is Hagar .

verses.z: 這夏甲二字是指着阿拉伯的西奈山，與現在的耶路撒冷同類，因耶路撒冷和她的兒女都是為奴的。
verses.e: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia , and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now , for she is in bondage with her children .

verses.z: 但那在上的耶路撒冷是自主的，她是我們的母。
verses.e: But the Jerusalem that is above is free , which is the mother of us all .

verses.z: 因為[經上]記着：不懷孕、不生養的，你要歡樂；未曾經過產難的，你要高聲歡呼；因為沒有丈夫的，比有丈夫的兒女更多。
verses.e: For it is written , " Rejoice , you barren who don't bear . Break out and shout , you who don't travail . For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband . "

verses.z: 弟兄們，我們是憑着應許作兒女，如同以撒一樣。
verses.e: Now we , brothers , as Isaac was , are children of promise .

verses.z: 當時，那按着血氣生的逼迫了那按着[聖]靈生的，現在也是這樣。
verses.e: But as then , he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit , so also it is now .

verses.z: 我們為孩童的時候，受管於世俗小學之下，也是如此。
verses.e: So we also , when we were children , were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world .

verses.z: 然而經上是怎麼說的呢？[是說]：「把使女和她兒子趕出去！因為使女的兒子不可與自主婦人的兒子一同承受產業。」
verses.e: However , what does the Scripture say ? " Throw out the servant and her son , for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman . "

verses.z: 弟兄們，這樣看來，我們不是使女的兒女，乃是自主婦人的兒女了。
verses.e: So then , brothers , we are not children of a servant , but of the free woman .

verses.z: 及至時候滿足，上帝就差遣他的兒子，為女子所生，且生在律法以下，
verses.e: But when the fullness of the time came , God sent out his Son , born to a woman , born under the law ,

verses.z: 要把律法以下的人贖出來，叫我們得着兒子的名分。
verses.e: that he might redeem those who were under the law , that we might receive the adoption as children .

verses.z: 你們既為兒子，上帝就差他兒子的靈進入你們的心，呼叫：「阿爸！父！」
verses.e: And because you are children , God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts , crying , " Abba , Father ! "

verses.z: 可見，從此以後，你不是奴僕，乃是兒子了；既是兒子，就靠着上帝為後嗣。
verses.e: So you are no longer a bondservant , but a son ; and if a son , then an heir of God through Christ .

verses.z: 但從前你們不認識上帝的時候，是給那些本來不是神的作奴僕；
verses.e: However at that time , not knowing God , you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods .

verses.z: 現在你們既然認識上帝，更可說是被上帝所認識的，怎麼還要歸回那懦弱無用的小學，情願再給他作奴僕呢？
verses.e: But now that you have come to know God , or rather to be known by God , why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles , to which you desire to be in bondage all over again ?

verses.z: 基督釋放了我們，叫我們得以自由。所以要站立得穩，不要再被奴僕的軛挾制。
verses.e: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free , and don't be entangled again with a yoke of bondage .

verses.z: 我在主裏很信你們必不懷別樣的心；但攪擾你們的，無論是誰，必擔當他的罪名。
verses.e: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way . But he who troubles you will bear his judgment , whoever he is .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我若仍舊傳割禮，為甚麼還受逼迫呢？若是這樣，那十字架討厭的地方就沒有了。
verses.e: But I , brothers , if I still preach circumcision , why am I still persecuted ? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed .

verses.z: 恨不得那攪亂你們的人把自己割絕了。
verses.e: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們蒙召是要得自由，只是不可將你們的自由當作放縱情慾的機會，總要用愛心互相服事。
verses.e: For you , brothers , were called for freedom . Only don't use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh , but through love be servants to one another .

verses.z: 因為全律法都包在「愛人如己」這一句話之內了。
verses.e: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word , in this : " You shall love your neighbor as yourself . "

verses.z: 你們要謹慎，若相咬相吞，只怕要彼此消滅了。
verses.e: But if you bite and devour one another , be careful that you don't consume one another .

verses.z: 我說，你們當順着[聖]靈而行，就不放縱肉體的情慾了。
verses.e: But I say , walk by the Spirit , and you won't fulfill the lust of the flesh .

verses.z: 因為情慾和[聖]靈相爭，[聖]靈和情慾相爭，這兩個是彼此相敵，使你們不能做所願意做的。
verses.e: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit , and the Spirit against the flesh ; and these are contrary to one another , that you may not do the things that you desire .

verses.z: 但你們若被[聖]靈引導，就不在律法以下。
verses.e: But if you are led by the Spirit , you are not under the law .

verses.z: 情慾的事都是顯而易見的，就如姦淫、污穢、邪蕩、
verses.e: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious , which are : adultery , sexual immorality , uncleanness , lustfulness ,

verses.z: 我－保羅告訴你們，若受割禮，基督就與你們無益了。
verses.e: Behold , I , Paul , tell you that if you receive circumcision , Christ will profit you nothing .

verses.z: 拜偶像、邪術、仇恨、爭競、忌恨、惱怒、結黨、紛爭、異端、
verses.e: idolatry , sorcery , hatred , strife , jealousies , outbursts of anger , rivalries , divisions , heresies ,

verses.z: 嫉妒、醉酒、荒宴等類。我從前告訴你們，現在又告訴你們，行這樣事的人必不能承受上帝的國。
verses.e: envy , murders , drunkenness , orgies , and things like these ; of which I forewarn you , even as I also forewarned you , that those who practice such things will not inherit God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 聖靈所結的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信實、
verses.e: But the fruit of the Spirit is love , joy , peace , patience , kindness , goodness , faith ,

verses.z: 溫柔、節制。這樣的事沒有律法禁止。
verses.e: gentleness , and self-control . Against such things there is no law .

verses.z: 凡屬基督耶穌的人，是已經把肉體連肉體的邪情私慾同釘在十字架上了。
verses.e: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts .

verses.z: 我們若是靠[聖]靈得生，就當靠[聖]靈行事。
verses.e: If we live by the Spirit , let's also walk by the Spirit .

verses.z: 不要貪圖虛名，彼此惹氣，互相嫉妒。
verses.e: Let's not become conceited , provoking one another , and envying one another .

verses.z: 我再指着凡受割禮的人確實地說，他是欠着行全律法的債。
verses.e: Yes , I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law .

verses.z: 你們這要靠律法稱義的，是與基督隔絕，從恩典中墜落了。
verses.e: You are alienated from Christ , you who desire to be justified by the law . You have fallen away from grace .

verses.z: 我們靠着[聖]靈，憑着信心，等候所盼望的義。
verses.e: For we through the Spirit , by faith wait for the hope of righteousness .

verses.z: 原來在基督耶穌裏，受割禮不受割禮全無功效，惟獨使人生發仁愛的信心才有功效。
verses.e: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything , but faith working through love .

verses.z: 你們向來跑得好，有誰攔阻你們，叫你們不順從真理呢？
verses.e: You were running well ! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth ?

verses.z: 這樣的勸導不是出於那召你們的。
verses.e: This persuasion is not from him who calls you .

verses.z: 一點麵酵能使全團都發起來。
verses.e: A little yeast grows through the whole lump .

verses.z: 弟兄們，若有人偶然被過犯所勝，你們屬靈的人就當用溫柔的心把他挽回過來；又當自己小心，恐怕也被引誘。
verses.e: Brothers , even if a man is caught in some fault , you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness , looking to yourself so that you also aren't tempted .

verses.z: 所以，有了機會就當向眾人行善，向信徒一家的人更當這樣。
verses.e: So then , as we have opportunity , let's do what is good toward all men , and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith .

verses.z: 請看我親手寫給你們的字是何等的大呢！
verses.e: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand .

verses.z: 凡希圖外貌體面的人都勉強你們受割禮，無非是怕自己為基督的十字架受逼迫。
verses.e: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised , just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ .

verses.z: 他們那些受割禮的，連自己也不守律法；他們願意你們受割禮，不過要藉着你們的肉體誇口。
verses.e: For even they who receive circumcision don't keep the law themselves , but they desire to have you circumcised , so that they may boast in your flesh .

verses.z: 但我斷不以別的誇口，只誇我們主耶穌基督的十字架；因這十字架，就我而論，世界已經釘在十字架上；就世界而論，我已經釘在十字架上。
verses.e: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , through which the world has been crucified to me , and I to the world .

verses.z: 受割禮不受割禮都無關緊要，要緊的就是作新造的人。
verses.e: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything , nor uncircumcision , but a new creation .

verses.z: 凡照此理而行的，願平安、憐憫加給他們，和上帝的以色列民。
verses.e: As many as walk by this rule , peace and mercy be on them , and on God's Israel .

verses.z: 從今以後，人都不要攪擾我，因為我身上帶着耶穌的印記。
verses.e: From now on , let no one cause me any trouble , for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body .

verses.z: 弟兄們，願我主耶穌基督的恩[常]在你們心裏。阿們！
verses.e: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit , brothers . Amen .

verses.z: 你們各人的重擔要互相擔當，如此，就完全了基督的律法。
verses.e: Bear one another's burdens , and so fulfill the law of Christ .

verses.z: 人若無有，自己還以為有，就是自欺了。
verses.e: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing , he deceives himself .

verses.z: 各人應當察驗自己的行為；這樣，他所誇的就專在自己，不在別人了，
verses.e: But let each man examine his own work , and then he will have reason to boast in himself , and not in someone else .

verses.z: 因為各人必擔當自己的擔子。
verses.e: For each man will bear his own burden .

verses.z: 在道理上受教的，當把一切需用的供給施教的人。
verses.e: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches .

verses.z: 不要自欺，上帝是輕慢不得的。人種的是甚麼，收的也是甚麼。
verses.e: Don't be deceived . God is not mocked , for whatever a man sows , that he will also reap .

verses.z: 順着情慾撒種的，必從情慾收敗壞；順着[聖]靈撒種的，必從[聖]靈收永生。
verses.e: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption . But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life .

verses.z: 我們行善，不可喪志；若不灰心，到了時候就要收成。
verses.e: Let's not be weary in doing good , for we will reap in due season if we don't give up .

verses.z: 起初，上帝創造天地。
verses.e: In the beginning , God created the heavens and the earth .

verses.z: 上帝稱旱地為「地」，稱水的聚處為「海」。上帝看着是好的。
verses.e: God called the dry land " earth " , and the gathering together of the waters he called " seas " . God saw that it was good .

verses.z: 上帝說：「地要發生青草和結種子的菜蔬，並結果子的樹木，各從其類，果子都包着核。」事就這樣成了。
verses.e: God said , " Let the earth yield grass , herbs yielding seeds , and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind , with their seeds in it , on the earth ; " and it was so .

verses.z: 於是地發生了青草和結種子的菜蔬，各從其類；並結果子的樹木，各從其類；果子都包着核。上帝看着是好的。
verses.e: The earth yielded grass , herbs yielding seed after their kind , and trees bearing fruit , with their seeds in it , after their kind ; and God saw that it was good .

verses.z: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。
verses.e: There was evening and there was morning , a third day .

verses.z: 上帝說：「天上要有光體，可以分晝夜，作記號，定節令、日子、年歲，
verses.e: God said , " Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night ; and let them be for signs to mark seasons , days , and years ;

verses.z: 並要發光在天空，普照在地上。」事就這樣成了。
verses.e: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth ; " and it was so .

verses.z: 於是上帝造了兩個大光，大的管晝，小的管夜，又[造]眾星，
verses.e: God made the two great lights : the greater light to rule the day , and the lesser light to rule the night . He also made the stars .

verses.z: 就把這些光擺列在天空，普照在地上，
verses.e: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth ,

verses.z: 管理晝夜，分別明暗。上帝看着是好的。
verses.e: and to rule over the day and over the night , and to divide the light from the darkness . God saw that it was good .

verses.z: 有晚上，有早晨，是第四日。
verses.e: There was evening and there was morning , a fourth day .

verses.z: 地是空虛混沌，淵面黑暗；上帝的靈運行在水面上。
verses.e: The earth was formless and empty . Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God's Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters .

verses.z: 上帝說：「水要多多滋生有生命的物；要有雀鳥飛在地面以上，天空之中。」
verses.e: God said , " Let the waters abound with living creatures , and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky . "

verses.z: 上帝就造出大魚和水中所滋生各樣有生命的動物，各從其類；又造出各樣飛鳥，各從其類。上帝看着是好的。
verses.e: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves , with which the waters swarmed , after their kind , and every winged bird after its kind . God saw that it was good .

verses.z: 上帝就賜福給這一切，說：「滋生繁多，充滿海中的水；雀鳥也要多生在地上。」
verses.e: God blessed them , saying , " Be fruitful , and multiply , and fill the waters in the seas , and let birds multiply on the earth . "

verses.z: 有晚上，有早晨，是第五日。
verses.e: There was evening and there was morning , a fifth day .

verses.z: 上帝說：「地要生出活物來，各從其類；牲畜、昆蟲、野獸，各從其類。」事就這樣成了。
verses.e: God said , " Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind , livestock , creeping things , and animals of the earth after their kind ; " and it was so .

verses.z: 於是上帝造出野獸，各從其類；牲畜，各從其類；地上一切昆蟲，各從其類。上帝看着是好的。
verses.e: God made the animals of the earth after their kind , and the livestock after their kind , and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind . God saw that it was good .

verses.z: 上帝說：「我們要照着我們的形像、按着我們的樣式造人，使他們管理海裏的魚、空中的鳥、地上的牲畜，和全地，並地上所爬的一切昆蟲。」
verses.e: God said , " Let's make man in our image , after our likeness . Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea , and over the birds of the sky , and over the livestock , and over all the earth , and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth . "

verses.z: 上帝就照着自己的形像造人，乃是照着他的形像造男造女。
verses.e: God created man in his own image . In God's image he created him ; male and female he created them .

verses.z: 上帝就賜福給他們，又對他們說：「要生養眾多，遍滿地面，治理這地，也要管理海裏的魚、空中的鳥，和地上各樣行動的活物。」
verses.e: God blessed them . God said to them , " Be fruitful , multiply , fill the earth , and subdue it . Have dominion over the fish of the sea , over the birds of the sky , and over every living thing that moves on the earth . "

verses.z: 上帝說：「看哪，我將遍地上一切結種子的菜蔬和一切樹上所結有核的果子全賜給你們作食物。
verses.e: God said , " Behold , I have given you every herb yielding seed , which is on the surface of all the earth , and every tree , which bears fruit yielding seed . It will be your food .

verses.z: 上帝說：「要有光」，就有了光。
verses.e: God said , " Let there be light , " and there was light .

verses.z: 至於地上的走獸和空中的飛鳥，並各樣爬在地上有生命的物，[我將]青草[賜給]牠們作食物。」事就這樣成了。
verses.e: To every animal of the earth , and to every bird of the sky , and to everything that creeps on the earth , in which there is life , I have given every green herb for food ; " and it was so .

verses.z: 上帝看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。
verses.e: God saw everything that he had made , and , behold , it was very good . There was evening and there was morning , a sixth day .

verses.z: 上帝看光是好的，就把光暗分開了。
verses.e: God saw the light , and saw that it was good . God divided the light from the darkness .

verses.z: 上帝稱光為「晝」，稱暗為「夜」。有晚上，有早晨，這是頭一日。
verses.e: God called the light " day " , and the darkness he called " night " . There was evening and there was morning , the first day .

verses.z: 上帝說：「諸水之間要有空氣，將水分為上下。」
verses.e: God said , " Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters , and let it divide the waters from the waters . "

verses.z: 上帝就造出空氣，將空氣以下的水、空氣以上的水分開了。事就這樣成了。
verses.e: God made the expanse , and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse ; and it was so .

verses.z: 上帝稱空氣為「天」。有晚上，有早晨，是第二日。
verses.e: God called the expanse " sky " . There was evening and there was morning , a second day .

verses.z: 上帝說：「天下的水要聚在一處，使旱地露出來。」事就這樣成了。
verses.e: God said , " Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place , and let the dry land appear ; " and it was so .

verses.z: 挪亞的兒子閃、含、雅弗的後代記在下面。洪水以後，他們都生了兒子。
verses.e: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem , Ham , and Japheth . Sons were born to them after the flood .

verses.z: 他國的起頭是巴別、以力、亞甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。
verses.e: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel , Erech , Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .

verses.z: 他從那地出來往亞述去，建造尼尼微、利河伯、迦拉，
verses.e: Out of that land he went into Assyria , and built Nineveh , Rehoboth Ir , Calah ,

verses.z: 和尼尼微、迦拉中間的利鮮，這就是那大城。
verses.e: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah .

verses.z: 麥西生路低人、亞拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.e: Mizraim became the father of Ludim , Anamim , Lehabim , Naphtuhim ,

verses.z: 帕斯魯細人、迦斯路希人、迦斐託人；從迦斐託出來的有非利士人。
verses.e: Pathrusim , Casluhim ( which the Philistines descended from ) , and Caphtorim .

verses.z: 迦南生長子西頓，又生赫
verses.e: Canaan became the father of Sidon ( his firstborn ) , Heth ,

verses.z: 和耶布斯人、亞摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.e: the Jebusites , the Amorites , the Girgashites ,

verses.z: 希未人、亞基人、西尼人、
verses.e: the Hivites , the Arkites , the Sinites ,

verses.z: 亞瓦底人、洗瑪利人、哈馬人，後來迦南的諸族分散了。
verses.e: the Arvadites , the Zemarites , and the Hamathites . Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad .

verses.z: 迦南的境界是從西頓向基拉耳的路上，直到迦薩，又向所多瑪、蛾摩拉、押瑪、洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。
verses.e: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon — as you go toward Gerar — to Gaza — as you go toward Sodom , Gomorrah , Admah , and Zeboiim — to Lasha .

verses.z: 雅弗的兒子是歌篾、瑪各、瑪代、雅完、土巴、米設、提拉。
verses.e: The sons of Japheth were : Gomer , Magog , Madai , Javan , Tubal , Meshech , and Tiras .

verses.z: 這就是含的後裔，各隨他們的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦國。
verses.e: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , according to their languages , in their lands and their nations .

verses.z: 雅弗的哥哥閃，是希伯子孫之祖，他也生了兒子。
verses.e: Children were also born to Shem ( the elder brother of Japheth ) , the father of all the children of Eber .

verses.z: 閃的兒子是以攔、亞述、亞法撒、路德、亞蘭。
verses.e: The sons of Shem were : Elam , Asshur , Arpachshad , Lud , and Aram .

verses.z: 亞蘭的兒子是烏斯、戶勒、基帖、瑪施。
verses.e: The sons of Aram were : Uz , Hul , Gether , and Mash .

verses.z: 亞法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
verses.e: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah . Shelah became the father of Eber .

verses.z: 希伯生了兩個兒子，一個名叫法勒，因為那時人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫約坍。
verses.e: To Eber were born two sons . The name of the one was Peleg , for in his days the earth was divided . His brother's name was Joktan .

verses.z: 約坍生亞摩答、沙列、哈薩瑪非、耶拉、
verses.e: Joktan became the father of Almodad , Sheleph , Hazarmaveth , Jerah ,

verses.z: 哈多蘭、烏薩、德拉、
verses.e: Hadoram , Uzal , Diklah ,

verses.z: 俄巴路、亞比瑪利、示巴、
verses.e: Obal , Abimael , Sheba ,

verses.z: 阿斐、哈腓拉、約巴，這都是約坍的兒子。
verses.e: Ophir , Havilah , and Jobab . All these were the sons of Joktan .

verses.z: 歌篾的兒子是亞實基拿、利法、陀迦瑪。
verses.e: The sons of Gomer were : Ashkenaz , Riphath , and Togarmah .

verses.z: 他們所住的地方是從米沙直到西發東邊的山。
verses.e: Their dwelling extended from Mesha , as you go toward Sephar , the mountain of the east .

verses.z: 這就是閃的子孫，各隨他們的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦國。
verses.e: These are the sons of Shem , by their families , according to their languages , lands , and nations .

verses.z: 這些都是挪亞三個兒子的宗族，各隨他們的支派立國。洪水以後，他們在地上分為邦國。
verses.e: These are the families of the sons of Noah , by their generations , according to their nations . The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood .

verses.z: 雅完的兒子是以利沙、他施、基提、多單。
verses.e: The sons of Javan were : Elishah , Tarshish , Kittim , and Dodanim .

verses.z: 這些人的後裔將各國的地土、海島分開居住，各隨各的方言、宗族立國。
verses.e: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands , everyone after his language , after their families , in their nations .

verses.z: 含的兒子是古實、麥西、弗、迦南。
verses.e: The sons of Ham were : Cush , Mizraim , Put , and Canaan .

verses.z: 古實的兒子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉瑪、撒弗提迦。拉瑪的兒子是示巴、底但。
verses.e: The sons of Cush were : Seba , Havilah , Sabtah , Raamah , and Sabteca . The sons of Raamah were : Sheba and Dedan .

verses.z: 古實又生寧錄，他為世上英雄之首。
verses.e: Cush became the father of Nimrod . He began to be a mighty one in the earth .

verses.z: 他在耶和華面前是個英勇的獵戶，所以俗語說：「像寧錄在耶和華面前是個英勇的獵戶。」
verses.e: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD . Therefore it is said , " like Nimrod , a mighty hunter before the LORD " .

verses.z: 那時，天下人的口音、言語都是一樣。
verses.e: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech .

verses.z: 閃的後代記在下面。洪水以後二年，閃一百歲生了亞法撒。
verses.e: This is the history of the generations of Shem : Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood .

verses.z: 閃生亞法撒之後又活了五百年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 亞法撒活到三十五歲，生了沙拉。
verses.e: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah .

verses.z: 亞法撒生沙拉之後又活了四百零三年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 沙拉活到三十歲，生了希伯。
verses.e: Shelah lived thirty years , and became the father of Eber .

verses.z: 沙拉生希伯之後又活了四百零三年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 希伯活到三十四歲，生了法勒。
verses.e: Eber lived thirty-four years , and became the father of Peleg .

verses.z: 希伯生法勒之後又活了四百三十年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 法勒活到三十歲，生了拉吳。
verses.e: Peleg lived thirty years , and became the father of Reu .

verses.z: 法勒生拉吳之後又活了二百零九年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 他們往東邊遷移的時候，在示拿地遇見一片平原，就住在那裏。
verses.e: As they traveled east , they found a plain in the land of Shinar , and they lived there .

verses.z: 拉吳活到三十二歲，生了西鹿。
verses.e: Reu lived thirty-two years , and became the father of Serug .

verses.z: 拉吳生西鹿之後又活了二百零七年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 西鹿活到三十歲，生了拿鶴。
verses.e: Serug lived thirty years , and became the father of Nahor .

verses.z: 西鹿生拿鶴之後又活了二百年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 拿鶴活到二十九歲，生了他拉。
verses.e: Nahor lived twenty-nine years , and became the father of Terah .

verses.z: 拿鶴生他拉之後又活了一百一十九年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 他拉活到七十歲，生了亞伯蘭、拿鶴、哈蘭。
verses.e: Terah lived seventy years , and became the father of Abram , Nahor , and Haran .

verses.z: 他拉的後代記在下面。他拉生亞伯蘭、拿鶴、哈蘭；哈蘭生羅得。
verses.e: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah . Terah became the father of Abram , Nahor , and Haran . Haran became the father of Lot .

verses.z: 哈蘭死在他的本地迦勒底的吾珥，在他父親他拉之先。
verses.e: Haran died in the land of his birth , in Ur of the Chaldees , while his father Terah was still alive .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭、拿鶴各娶了妻：亞伯蘭的妻子名叫撒萊；拿鶴的妻子名叫密迦，是哈蘭的女兒；哈蘭是密迦和亦迦的父親。
verses.e: Abram and Nahor married wives . The name of Abram's wife was Sarai , and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah , the daughter of Haran , who was also the father of Iscah .

verses.z: 他們彼此商量說：「來吧！我們要做磚，把磚燒透了。」他們就拿磚當石頭，又拿石漆當灰泥。
verses.e: They said to one another , " Come , let's make bricks , and burn them thoroughly . " They had brick for stone , and they used tar for mortar .

verses.z: 撒萊不生育，沒有孩子。
verses.e: Sarai was barren . She had no child .

verses.z: 他拉帶着他兒子亞伯蘭和他孫子哈蘭的兒子羅得，並他兒婦亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊，出了迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去；他們走到哈蘭，就住在那裏。
verses.e: Terah took Abram his son , Lot the son of Haran , his son's son , and Sarai his daughter-in-law , his son Abram's wife . They went from Ur of the Chaldees , to go into the land of Canaan . They came to Haran and lived there .

verses.z: 他拉共活了二百零五歲，就死在哈蘭。
verses.e: The days of Terah were two hundred five years . Terah died in Haran .

verses.z: 他們說：「來吧！我們要建造一座城和一座塔，塔頂通天，為要傳揚我們的名，免得我們分散在全地上。」
verses.e: They said , " Come , let's build ourselves a city , and a tower whose top reaches to the sky , and let's make a name for ourselves , lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth . "

verses.z: 耶和華降臨，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。
verses.e: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower , which the children of men built .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「看哪，他們成為一樣的人民，都是一樣的言語，如今既做起這事來，以後他們所要做的事就沒有不成就的了。
verses.e: The LORD said , " Behold , they are one people , and they all have one language , and this is what they begin to do . Now nothing will be withheld from them , which they intend to do .

verses.z: 我們下去，在那裏變亂他們的口音，使他們的言語彼此不通。」
verses.e: Come , let's go down , and there confuse their language , that they may not understand one another's speech . "

verses.z: 於是耶和華使他們從那裏分散在全地上；他們就停工，不造那城了。
verses.e: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth . They stopped building the city .

verses.z: 因為耶和華在那裏變亂天下人的言語，使眾人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫巴別。
verses.e: Therefore its name was called Babel , because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth . From there , the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth .

verses.z: 耶和華對亞伯蘭說：「你要離開本地、本族、父家，往我所要指示你的地去。
verses.e: Now the LORD said to Abram , " Leave your country , and your relatives , and your father's house , and go to the land that I will show you .

verses.z: 那地遭遇饑荒。因饑荒甚大，亞伯蘭就下埃及去，要在那裏暫居。
verses.e: There was a famine in the land . Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there , for the famine was severe in the land .

verses.z: 將近埃及，就對他妻子撒萊說：「我知道你是容貌俊美的婦人。
verses.e: When he had come near to enter Egypt , he said to Sarai his wife , " See now , I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at .

verses.z: 埃及人看見你必說：『這是他的妻子』，他們就要殺我，卻叫你存活。
verses.e: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you , they will say , ' This is his wife . ' They will kill me , but they will save you alive .

verses.z: 求你說，你是我的妹子，使我因你得平安，我的命也因你存活。」
verses.e: Please say that you are my sister , that it may be well with me for your sake , and that my soul may live because of you . "

verses.z: 及至亞伯蘭到了埃及，埃及人看見那婦人極其美貌。
verses.e: When Abram had come into Egypt , some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful .

verses.z: 法老的臣宰看見了她，就在法老面前誇獎她。那婦人就被帶進法老的宮去。
verses.e: The princes of Pharaoh saw her , and praised her to Pharaoh ; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house .

verses.z: 法老因這婦人就厚待亞伯蘭，亞伯蘭得了許多牛、羊、駱駝、公驢、母驢、僕婢。
verses.e: He dealt well with Abram for her sake . He had sheep , cattle , male donkeys , male servants , female servants , female donkeys , and camels .

verses.z: 耶和華因亞伯蘭妻子撒萊的緣故，降大災與法老和他的全家。
verses.e: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai , Abram's wife .

verses.z: 法老就召了亞伯蘭來，說：「你這向我做的是甚麼事呢？為甚麼沒有告訴我她是你的妻子？
verses.e: Pharaoh called Abram and said , " What is this that you have done to me ? Why didn't you tell me that she was your wife ?

verses.z: 為甚麼說她是你的妹子，以致我把她取來要作我的妻子？現在你的妻子在這裏，可以帶她走吧。」
verses.e: Why did you say , ' She is my sister , ' so that I took her to be my wife ? Now therefore , see your wife , take her , and go your way . "

verses.z: 我必叫你成為大國。我必賜福給你，叫你的名為大；你也要叫別人得福。
verses.e: I will make of you a great nation . I will bless you and make your name great . You will be a blessing .

verses.z: 於是法老吩咐人將亞伯蘭和他妻子，並他所有的都送走了。
verses.e: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him , and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had .

verses.z: 為你祝福的，我必賜福與他；那咒詛你的，我必咒詛他。地上的萬族都要因你得福。」
verses.e: I will bless those who bless you , and I will curse him who treats you with contempt . All the families of the earth will be blessed through you . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭就照着耶和華的吩咐去了；羅得也和他同去。亞伯蘭出哈蘭的時候年七十五歲。
verses.e: So Abram went , as the LORD had told him . Lot went with him . Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭將他妻子撒萊和姪兒羅得，連他們在哈蘭所積蓄的財物、所得的人口，都帶往迦南地去。他們就到了迦南地。
verses.e: Abram took Sarai his wife , Lot his brother's son , all their possessions that they had gathered , and the people whom they had acquired in Haran , and they went to go into the land of Canaan . They entered into the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭經過那地，到了示劍地方、摩利橡樹那裏。那時迦南人住在那地。
verses.e: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem , to the oak of Moreh . At that time , Canaanites were in the land .

verses.z: 耶和華向亞伯蘭顯現，說：「我要把這地賜給你的後裔。」亞伯蘭就在那裏為向他顯現的耶和華築了一座壇。
verses.e: The LORD appeared to Abram and said , " I will give this land to your offspring . " He built an altar there to the LORD , who had appeared to him .

verses.z: 從那裏他又遷到伯特利東邊的山，支搭帳棚；西邊是伯特利，東邊是艾。他在那裏又為耶和華築了一座壇，求告耶和華的名。
verses.e: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent , having Bethel on the west , and Ai on the east . There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD's name .

verses.z: 後來亞伯蘭又漸漸遷往南地去。
verses.e: Abram traveled , still going on toward the South .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭帶着他的妻子與羅得，並一切所有的，都從埃及上南地去。
verses.e: Abram went up out of Egypt — he , his wife , all that he had , and Lot with him — into the South .

verses.z: 羅得舉目看見約旦河的全平原，直到瑣珥，都是滋潤的，那地在耶和華未滅所多瑪、蛾摩拉以先如同耶和華的園子，也像埃及地。
verses.e: Lot lifted up his eyes , and saw all the plain of the Jordan , that it was well-watered everywhere , before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah , like the garden of the LORD , like the land of Egypt , as you go to Zoar .

verses.z: 於是羅得選擇約旦河的全平原，往東遷移；他們就彼此分離了。
verses.e: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself . Lot traveled east , and they separated themselves from one another .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭住在迦南地，羅得住在平原的城邑，漸漸挪移帳棚，直到所多瑪。
verses.e: Abram lived in the land of Canaan , and Lot lived in the cities of the plain , and moved his tent as far as Sodom .

verses.z: 所多瑪人在耶和華面前罪大惡極。
verses.e: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD .

verses.z: 羅得離別亞伯蘭以後，耶和華對亞伯蘭說：「從你所在的地方，你舉目向東西南北觀看；
verses.e: The LORD said to Abram , after Lot was separated from him , " Now , lift up your eyes , and look from the place where you are , northward and southward and eastward and westward ,

verses.z: 凡你所看見的一切地，我都要賜給你和你的後裔，直到永遠。
verses.e: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever .

verses.z: 我也要使你的後裔如同地上的塵沙那樣多，人若能數算地上的塵沙才能數算你的後裔。
verses.e: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth , so that if a man can count the dust of the earth , then your offspring may also be counted .

verses.z: 你起來，縱橫走遍這地，因為我必把這地賜給你。」
verses.e: Arise , walk through the land in its length and in its width ; for I will give it to you . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭就搬了帳棚，來到希伯崙幔利的橡樹那裏居住，在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇。
verses.e: Abram moved his tent , and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre , which are in Hebron , and built an altar there to the LORD .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭的金、銀、牲畜極多。
verses.e: Abram was very rich in livestock , in silver , and in gold .

verses.z: 他從南地漸漸往伯特利去，到了伯特利和艾的中間，就是從前支搭帳棚的地方，
verses.e: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel , to the place where his tent had been at the beginning , between Bethel and Ai ,

verses.z: 也是他起先築壇的地方；他又在那裏求告耶和華的名。
verses.e: to the place of the altar , which he had made there at the first . There Abram called on the LORD's name .

verses.z: 與亞伯蘭同行的羅得也有牛群、羊群、帳棚。
verses.e: Lot also , who went with Abram , had flocks , herds , and tents .

verses.z: 那地容不下他們；因為他們的財物甚多，使他們不能同居。
verses.e: The land was not able to bear them , that they might live together ; for their possessions were so great that they couldn't live together .

verses.z: 當時，迦南人與比利洗人在那地居住。亞伯蘭的牧人和羅得的牧人相爭。
verses.e: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock . The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭就對羅得說：「你我不可相爭，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相爭，因為我們是骨肉。
verses.e: Abram said to Lot , " Please , let there be no strife between you and me , and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen ; for we are relatives .

verses.z: 遍地不都在你眼前嗎？請你離開我：你向左，我就向右；你向右，我就向左。」
verses.e: Isn't the whole land before you ? Please separate yourself from me . If you go to the left hand , then I will go to the right . Or if you go to the right hand , then I will go to the left . "

verses.z: 當暗拉非作示拿王，亞略作以拉撒王，基大老瑪作以攔王，提達作戈印王的時候，
verses.e: In the days of Amraphel , king of Shinar ; Arioch , king of Ellasar ; Chedorlaomer , king of Elam ; and Tidal , king of Goiim ,

verses.z: 西訂谷有許多石漆坑。所多瑪王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑裏的，其餘的人都往山上逃跑。
verses.e: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits ; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled , and some fell there . Those who remained fled to the hills .

verses.z: 四王就把所多瑪和蛾摩拉所有的財物，並一切的糧食都擄掠去了；
verses.e: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah , and all their food , and went their way .

verses.z: 又把亞伯蘭的姪兒羅得和羅得的財物擄掠去了。當時羅得正住在所多瑪。
verses.e: They took Lot , Abram's brother's son , who lived in Sodom , and his goods , and departed .

verses.z: 有一個逃出來的人告訴希伯來人亞伯蘭；亞伯蘭正住在亞摩利人幔利的橡樹那裏。幔利和以實各並亞乃都是弟兄，曾與亞伯蘭聯盟。
verses.e: One who had escaped came and told Abram , the Hebrew . At that time , he lived by the oaks of Mamre , the Amorite , brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner . They were allies of Abram .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭聽見他姪兒被擄去，就率領他家裏生養的精練壯丁三百一十八人，直追到但，
verses.e: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive , he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men , born in his house , and pursued as far as Dan .

verses.z: 便在夜間，自己同僕人分隊殺敗敵人，又追到大馬士革左邊的何把，
verses.e: He divided himself against them by night , he and his servants , and struck them , and pursued them to Hobah , which is on the left hand of Damascus .

verses.z: 將被擄掠的一切財物奪回來，連他姪兒羅得和他的財物，以及婦女、人民也都奪回來。
verses.e: He brought back all the goods , and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods , and the women also , and the other people .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭殺敗基大老瑪和與他同盟的王回來的時候，所多瑪王出來，在沙微谷迎接他；沙微谷就是王谷。
verses.e: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him , at the valley of Shaveh ( that is , the King's Valley ) .

verses.z: 又有撒冷王麥基洗德帶着餅和酒出來迎接；他是至高上帝的祭司。
verses.e: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine . He was priest of God Most High .

verses.z: 他為亞伯蘭祝福，說：「願天地的主、至高的上帝賜福與亞伯蘭！
verses.e: He blessed him , and said , " Blessed be Abram of God Most High , possessor of heaven and earth .

verses.z: 他們都攻打所多瑪王比拉、蛾摩拉王比沙、押瑪王示納、洗扁王善以別，和比拉王；比拉就是瑣珥。
verses.e: they made war with Bera , king of Sodom ; Birsha , king of Gomorrah ; Shinab , king of Admah ; Shemeber , king of Zeboiim ; and the king of Bela ( also called Zoar ) .

verses.z: 至高的上帝把敵人交在你手裏，是應當稱頌的！」亞伯蘭就把所得的拿出十分之一來，給麥基洗德。
verses.e: Blessed be God Most High , who has delivered your enemies into your hand . " Abram gave him a tenth of all .

verses.z: 所多瑪王對亞伯蘭說：「你把人口給我，財物你自己拿去吧！」
verses.e: The king of Sodom said to Abram , " Give me the people , and take the goods for yourself . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭對所多瑪王說：「我已經向天地的主－至高的上帝耶和華起誓：
verses.e: Abram said to the king of Sodom , " I have lifted up my hand to the LORD , God Most High , possessor of heaven and earth ,

verses.z: 凡是你的東西，就是一根線、一根鞋帶，我都不拿，免得你說：『我使亞伯蘭富足！』
verses.e: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours , lest you should say , ' I have made Abram rich . '

verses.z: 只有僕人所吃的，並與我同行的亞乃、以實各、幔利所應得的分，可以任憑他們拿去。」
verses.e: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten , and the portion of the men who went with me : Aner , Eshcol , and Mamre . Let them take their portion . "

verses.z: 這五王都在西訂谷會合；西訂谷就是鹽海。
verses.e: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim ( also called the Salt Sea ) .

verses.z: 他們已經事奉基大老瑪十二年，到十三年就背叛了。
verses.e: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years , and in the thirteenth year they rebelled .

verses.z: 十四年，基大老瑪和同盟的王都來在亞特律‧加寧，殺敗了利乏音人，在哈麥殺敗了蘇西人，在沙微‧基列亭殺敗了以米人，
verses.e: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim , the Zuzim in Ham , the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,

verses.z: 在何利人的西珥山殺敗了何利人，一直殺到靠近曠野的伊勒‧巴蘭。
verses.e: and the Horites in their Mount Seir , to El Paran , which is by the wilderness .

verses.z: 他們回到安‧密巴，就是加低斯，殺敗了亞瑪力全地的人，以及住在哈洗遜‧他瑪的亞摩利人。
verses.e: They returned , and came to En Mishpat ( also called Kadesh ) , and struck all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that lived in Hazazon Tamar .

verses.z: 於是所多瑪王、蛾摩拉王、押瑪王、洗扁王，和比拉王（比拉就是瑣珥）都出來，在西訂谷擺陣，與他們交戰，
verses.e: The king of Sodom , and the king of Gomorrah , the king of Admah , the king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela ( also called Zoar ) went out ; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

verses.z: 就是與以攔王基大老瑪、戈印王提達、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亞略交戰；乃是四王與五王交戰。
verses.e: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam , Tidal king of Goiim , Amraphel king of Shinar , and Arioch king of Ellasar ; four kings against the five .

verses.z: 這事以後，耶和華在異象中有話對亞伯蘭說：「亞伯蘭，你不要懼怕！我是你的盾牌，必大大地賞賜你。」
verses.e: After these things the LORD's word came to Abram in a vision , saying , " Don't be afraid , Abram . I am your shield , your exceedingly great reward . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭就取了這些來，每樣劈開，分成兩半，一半對着一半地擺列，只有鳥沒有劈開。
verses.e: He brought him all these , and divided them in the middle , and laid each half opposite the other ; but he didn't divide the birds .

verses.z: 有鷙鳥下來，落在那死畜的肉上，亞伯蘭就把牠嚇飛了。
verses.e: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses , and Abram drove them away .

verses.z: 日頭正落的時候，亞伯蘭沉沉地睡了；忽然有驚人的大黑暗落在他身上。
verses.e: When the sun was going down , a deep sleep fell on Abram . Now terror and great darkness fell on him .

verses.z: 耶和華對亞伯蘭說：「你要的確知道，你的後裔必寄居別人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他們四百年。
verses.e: He said to Abram , " Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs , and will serve them . They will afflict them four hundred years .

verses.z: 並且他們所要服事的那國，我要懲罰，後來他們必帶着許多財物從那裏出來。
verses.e: I will also judge that nation , whom they will serve . Afterward they will come out with great wealth ;

verses.z: 但你要享大壽數，平平安安地歸到你列祖那裏，被人埋葬。
verses.e: but you will go to your fathers in peace . You will be buried at a good old age .

verses.z: 到了第四代，他們必回到此地，因為亞摩利人的罪孽還沒有滿盈。」
verses.e: In the fourth generation they will come here again , for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full . "

verses.z: 日落天黑，不料有冒煙的爐並燒着的火把從那些肉塊中經過。
verses.e: It came to pass that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold , a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces .

verses.z: 當那日，耶和華與亞伯蘭立約，說：「我已賜給你的後裔，從埃及河直到幼發拉底大河之地，
verses.e: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram , saying , " I have given this land to your offspring , from the river of Egypt to the great river , the river Euphrates :

verses.z: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、
verses.e: the land of the Kenites , the Kenizzites , the Kadmonites ,

verses.z: 亞伯蘭說：「主耶和華啊，我既無子，你還賜我甚麼呢？並且要承受我家業的是大馬士革人以利以謝。」
verses.e: Abram said , " Lord GOD , what will you give me , since I go childless , and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus ? "

verses.z: 赫人、比利洗人、利乏音人、
verses.e: the Hittites , the Perizzites , the Rephaim ,

verses.z: 亞摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人之地。」
verses.e: the Amorites , the Canaanites , the Girgashites , and the Jebusites . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭又說：「你沒有給我兒子；那生在我家中的人就是我的後嗣。」
verses.e: Abram said , " Behold , you have given no children to me : and , behold , one born in my house is my heir . "

verses.z: 耶和華又有話對他說：「這人必不成為你的後嗣；你本身所生的才成為你的後嗣。」
verses.e: Behold , the LORD's word came to him , saying , " This man will not be your heir , but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir . "

verses.z: 於是領他走到外邊，說：「你向天觀看，數算眾星，能數得過來嗎？」又對他說：「你的後裔將要如此。」
verses.e: The LORD brought him outside , and said , " Look now toward the sky , and count the stars , if you are able to count them . " He said to Abram , " So your offspring will be . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭信耶和華，耶和華就以此為他的義。
verses.e: He believed in the LORD , who credited it to him for righteousness .

verses.z: 耶和華又對他說：「我是耶和華，曾領你出了迦勒底的吾珥，為要將這地賜你為業。」
verses.e: He said to Abram , " I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees , to give you this land to inherit it . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭說：「主耶和華啊，我怎能知道必得這地為業呢？」
verses.e: He said , " Lord GOD , how will I know that I will inherit it ? "

verses.z: 他說：「你為我取一隻三年的母牛，一隻三年的母山羊，一隻三年的公綿羊，一隻斑鳩，一隻雛鴿。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Bring me a heifer three years old , a female goat three years old , a ram three years old , a turtledove , and a young pigeon . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊不給他生兒女。撒萊有一個使女，名叫夏甲，是埃及人。
verses.e: Now Sarai , Abram's wife , bore him no children . She had a servant , an Egyptian , whose name was Hagar .

verses.z: 又說：「我必使你的後裔極其繁多，甚至不可勝數」；
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to her , " I will greatly multiply your offspring , that they will not be counted for multitude . "

verses.z: 並說：「你如今懷孕要生一個兒子，可以給他起名叫以實瑪利，因為耶和華聽見了你的苦情。
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to her , " Behold , you are with child , and will bear a son . You shall call his name Ishmael , because the LORD has heard your affliction .

verses.z: 他為人必像野驢。他的手要攻打人，人的手也要攻打他；他必住在眾弟兄的東邊。」
verses.e: He will be like a wild donkey among men . His hand will be against every man , and every man's hand against him . He will live opposed to all of his brothers . "

verses.z: 夏甲就稱那對她說話的耶和華為「看顧人的上帝」。因而說：「在這裏我也看見那看顧我的嗎？」
verses.e: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her , " You are a God who sees , " for she said , " Have I even stayed alive after seeing him ? "

verses.z: 所以這井名叫庇耳‧拉海‧萊。這井正在加低斯和巴列中間。
verses.e: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi . Behold , it is between Kadesh and Bered .

verses.z: 後來夏甲給亞伯蘭生了一個兒子；亞伯蘭給他起名叫以實瑪利。
verses.e: Hagar bore a son for Abram . Abram called the name of his son , whom Hagar bore , Ishmael .

verses.z: 夏甲給亞伯蘭生以實瑪利的時候，亞伯蘭年八十六歲。
verses.e: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram .

verses.z: 撒萊對亞伯蘭說：「耶和華使我不能生育。求你和我的使女同房，或者我可以因她得孩子。」亞伯蘭聽從了撒萊的話。
verses.e: Sarai said to Abram , " See now , the LORD has restrained me from bearing . Please go in to my servant . It may be that I will obtain children by her . " Abram listened to the voice of Sarai .

verses.z: 於是亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊將使女埃及人夏甲給了丈夫為妾；那時亞伯蘭在迦南已經住了十年。
verses.e: Sarai , Abram's wife , took Hagar the Egyptian , her servant , after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan , and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭與夏甲同房，夏甲就懷了孕；她見自己有孕，就小看她的主母。
verses.e: He went in to Hagar , and she conceived . When she saw that she had conceived , her mistress was despised in her eyes .

verses.z: 撒萊對亞伯蘭說：「我因你受屈。我將我的使女放在你懷中，她見自己有了孕，就小看我。願耶和華在你我中間判斷。」
verses.e: Sarai said to Abram , " This wrong is your fault . I gave my servant into your bosom , and when she saw that she had conceived , she despised me . May the LORD judge between me and you . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭對撒萊說：「使女在你手下，你可以隨意待她。」撒萊苦待她，她就從撒萊面前逃走了。
verses.e: But Abram said to Sarai , " Behold , your maid is in your hand . Do to her whatever is good in your eyes . " Sarai dealt harshly with her , and she fled from her face .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者在曠野書珥路上的水泉旁遇見她，
verses.e: The LORD's angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness , by the fountain on the way to Shur .

verses.z: 對她說：「撒萊的使女夏甲，你從哪裏來？要往哪裏去？」夏甲說：「我從我的主母撒萊面前逃出來。」
verses.e: He said , " Hagar , Sarai's servant , where did you come from ? Where are you going ? " She said , " I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai . "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者對她說：「你回到你主母那裏，服在她手下」；
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to her , " Return to your mistress , and submit yourself under her hands . "

verses.z: 亞伯蘭年九十九歲的時候，耶和華向他顯現，對他說：「我是全能的上帝。你當在我面前作完全人，
verses.e: When Abram was ninety-nine years old , the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him , " I am God Almighty . Walk before me and be blameless .

verses.z: 你們所有的男子都要受割禮；這就是我與你並你的後裔所立的約，是你們所當遵守的。
verses.e: This is my covenant , which you shall keep , between me and you and your offspring after you . Every male among you shall be circumcised .

verses.z: 你們都要受割禮；這是我與你們立約的證據。
verses.e: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin . It will be a token of the covenant between me and you .

verses.z: 你們世世代代的男子，無論是家裏生的，是在你後裔之外用銀子從外人買的，生下來第八日，都要受割禮。
verses.e: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you , every male throughout your generations , he who is born in the house , or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring .

verses.z: 你家裏生的和你用銀子買的，都必須受割禮。這樣，我的約就立在你們肉體上作永遠的約。
verses.e: He who is born in your house , and he who is bought with your money , must be circumcised . My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant .

verses.z: 但不受割禮的男子必從民中剪除，因他背了我的約。」
verses.e: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin , that soul shall be cut off from his people . He has broken my covenant . "

verses.z: 上帝又對亞伯拉罕說：「你的妻子撒萊不可再叫撒萊，她的名要叫撒拉。
verses.e: God said to Abraham , " As for Sarai your wife , you shall not call her name Sarai , but her name shall be Sarah .

verses.z: 我必賜福給她，也要使你從她得一個兒子。我要賜福給她，她也要作多國之[母]；必有百姓的君王從她而出。」
verses.e: I will bless her , and moreover I will give you a son by her . Yes , I will bless her , and she will be a mother of nations . Kings of peoples will come from her . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕就俯伏在地喜笑，心裏說：「一百歲的人還能得孩子嗎？撒拉已經九十歲了，還能生養嗎？」
verses.e: Then Abraham fell on his face , and laughed , and said in his heart , " Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old ? Will Sarah , who is ninety years old , give birth ? "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕對上帝說：「但願以實瑪利活在你面前。」
verses.e: Abraham said to God , " Oh that Ishmael might live before you ! "

verses.z: 上帝說：「不然，你妻子撒拉要給你生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫以撒。我要與他堅定所立的約，作他後裔永遠的約。
verses.e: God said , " No , but Sarah , your wife , will bear you a son . You shall call his name Isaac . I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him .

verses.z: 我就與你立約，使你[的後裔]極其繁多。」
verses.e: I will make my covenant between me and you , and will multiply you exceedingly . "

verses.z: 至於以實瑪利，我也應允你：我必賜福給他，使他昌盛，極其繁多。他必生十二個族長；我也要使他成為大國。
verses.e: As for Ishmael , I have heard you . Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly . He will become the father of twelve princes , and I will make him a great nation .

verses.z: 到明年這時節，撒拉必給你生以撒，我要與他堅定所立的約。」
verses.e: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac , whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year . "

verses.z: 上帝和亞伯拉罕說完了話，就離開他上升去了。
verses.e: When he finished talking with him , God went up from Abraham .

verses.z: 正當那日，亞伯拉罕遵着上帝的命，給他的兒子以實瑪利和家裏的一切男子，無論是在家裏生的，是用銀子買的，都行了割禮。
verses.e: Abraham took Ishmael his son , all who were born in his house , and all who were bought with his money : every male among the men of Abraham's house , and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day , as God had said to him .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕受割禮的時候年九十九歲。
verses.e: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .

verses.z: 他兒子以實瑪利受割禮的時候年十三歲。
verses.e: Ishmael , his son , was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .

verses.z: 正當那日，亞伯拉罕和他兒子以實瑪利一同受了割禮。
verses.e: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael , his son , were circumcised .

verses.z: 家裏所有的人，無論是在家裏生的，是用銀子從外人買的，也都一同受了割禮。
verses.e: All the men of his house , those born in the house , and those bought with money from a foreigner , were circumcised with him .

verses.z: 亞伯蘭俯伏在地；上帝又對他說：
verses.e: Abram fell on his face . God talked with him , saying ,

verses.z: 「我與你立約：你要作多國的父。
verses.e: " As for me , behold , my covenant is with you . You will be the father of a multitude of nations .

verses.z: 從此以後，你的名不再叫亞伯蘭，要叫亞伯拉罕，因為我已立你作多國的父。
verses.e: Your name will no more be called Abram , but your name will be Abraham ; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations .

verses.z: 我必使你[的後裔]極其繁多；國度從你而立，君王從你而出。
verses.e: I will make you exceedingly fruitful , and I will make nations of you . Kings will come out of you .

verses.z: 我要與你並你世世代代的後裔堅立我的約，作永遠的約，是要作你和你後裔的上帝。
