verses.e: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God to you and to your offspring after you .

verses.z: 我要將你現在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，賜給你和你的後裔永遠為業，我也必作他們的上帝。」
verses.e: I will give to you , and to your offspring after you , the land where you are traveling , all the land of Canaan , for an everlasting possession . I will be their God . "

verses.z: 上帝又對亞伯拉罕說：「你和你的後裔必世世代代遵守我的約。
verses.e: God said to Abraham , " As for you , you shall keep my covenant , you and your offspring after you throughout their generations .

verses.z: 耶和華在幔利橡樹那裏向亞伯拉罕顯現出來。那時正熱，亞伯拉罕坐在帳棚門口，
verses.e: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre , as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day .

verses.z: 三人中有一位說：「到明年這時候，我必要回到你這裏；你的妻子撒拉必生一個兒子。」撒拉在那人後邊的帳棚門口也聽見了這話。
verses.e: He said , " I will certainly return to you at about this time next year ; and behold , Sarah your wife will have a son . " Sarah heard in the tent door , which was behind him .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕和撒拉年紀老邁，撒拉的月經已斷絕了。
verses.e: Now Abraham and Sarah were old , well advanced in age . Sarah had passed the age of childbearing .

verses.z: 撒拉心裏暗笑，說：「我既已衰敗，我主也老邁，豈能有這喜事呢？」
verses.e: Sarah laughed within herself , saying , " After I have grown old will I have pleasure , my lord being old also ? "

verses.z: 耶和華對亞伯拉罕說：「撒拉為甚麼暗笑，說：『我既已年老，果真能生養嗎？』
verses.e: The LORD said to Abraham , " Why did Sarah laugh , saying , ' Will I really bear a child when I am old ? '

verses.z: 耶和華豈有難成的事嗎？到了日期，明年這時候，我必回到你這裏，撒拉必生一個兒子。」
verses.e: Is anything too hard for the LORD ? At the set time I will return to you , when the season comes around , and Sarah will have a son . "

verses.z: 撒拉就害怕，不承認，說：「我沒有笑。」那位說：「不然，你實在笑了。」
verses.e: Then Sarah denied it , saying , " I didn't laugh , " for she was afraid . He said , " No , but you did laugh . "

verses.z: 三人就從那裏起行，向所多瑪觀看，亞伯拉罕也與他們同行，要送他們一程。
verses.e: The men rose up from there , and looked toward Sodom . Abraham went with them to see them on their way .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我所要做的事豈可瞞着亞伯拉罕呢？
verses.e: The LORD said , " Will I hide from Abraham what I do ,

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕必要成為強大的國；地上的萬國都必因他得福。
verses.e: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation , and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him ?

verses.z: 我眷顧他，為要叫他吩咐他的眾子和他的眷屬遵守我的道，秉公行義，使我所應許亞伯拉罕的話都成就了。」
verses.e: For I have known him , to the end that he may command his children and his household after him , that they may keep the way of the LORD , to do righteousness and justice ; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him . "

verses.z: 舉目觀看，見有三個人在對面站着。他一見，就從帳棚門口跑去迎接他們，俯伏在地，
verses.e: He lifted up his eyes and looked , and saw that three men stood near him . When he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door , and bowed himself to the earth ,

verses.z: 耶和華說：「所多瑪和蛾摩拉的罪惡甚重，聲聞於我。
verses.e: The LORD said , " Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous ,

verses.z: 我現在要下去，察看他們所行的，果然盡像那達到我耳中的聲音一樣嗎？若是不然，我也必知道。」
verses.e: I will go down now , and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me . If not , I will know . "

verses.z: 二人轉身離開那裏，向所多瑪去；但亞伯拉罕仍舊站在耶和華面前。
verses.e: The men turned from there , and went toward Sodom , but Abraham stood yet before the LORD .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕近前來，說：「無論善惡，你都要剿滅嗎？
verses.e: Abraham came near , and said , " Will you consume the righteous with the wicked ?

verses.z: 假若那城裏有五十個義人，你還剿滅那地方嗎？不為城裏這五十個義人饒恕其中的人嗎？
verses.e: What if there are fifty righteous within the city ? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it ?

verses.z: 將義人與惡人同殺，將義人與惡人一樣看待，這斷不是你所行的。審判全地的主豈不行公義嗎？」
verses.e: May it be far from you to do things like that , to kill the righteous with the wicked , so that the righteous should be like the wicked . May that be far from you . Shouldn't the Judge of all the earth do right ? "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我若在所多瑪城裏見有五十個義人，我就為他們的緣故饒恕那地方的眾人。」
verses.e: The LORD said , " If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city , then I will spare the whole place for their sake . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：「我雖然是灰塵，還敢對主說話。
verses.e: Abraham answered , " See now , I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord , although I am dust and ashes .

verses.z: 假若這五十個義人短了五個，你就因為短了五個毀滅全城嗎？」他說：「我在那裏若見有四十五個，也不毀滅那城。」
verses.e: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous ? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five ? " He said , " I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕又對他說：「假若在那裏見有四十個怎麼樣呢？」他說：「為這四十個的緣故，我也不做這事。」
verses.e: He spoke to him yet again , and said , " What if there are forty found there ? " He said , " I will not do it for the forty's sake . "

verses.z: 說：「我主，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要離開僕人往前去。
verses.e: and said , " My lord , if now I have found favor in your sight , please don't go away from your servant .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：「求主不要動怒，容我說，假若在那裏見有三十個怎麼樣呢？」他說：「我在那裏若見有三十個，我也不做這事。」
verses.e: He said , " Oh don't let the Lord be angry , and I will speak . What if there are thirty found there ? " He said , " I will not do it if I find thirty there . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：「我還敢對主說話，假若在那裏見有二十個怎麼樣呢？」他說：「為這二十個的緣故，我也不毀滅那城。」
verses.e: He said , " See now , I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord . What if there are twenty found there ? " He said , " I will not destroy it for the twenty's sake . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：「求主不要動怒，我再說這一次，假若在那裏見有十個呢？」他說：「為這十個的緣故，我也不毀滅那城。」
verses.e: He said , " Oh don't let the Lord be angry , and I will speak just once more . What if ten are found there ? " He said , " I will not destroy it for the ten's sake . "

verses.z: 耶和華與亞伯拉罕說完了話就走了；亞伯拉罕也回到自己的地方去了。
verses.e: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham , and Abraham returned to his place .

verses.z: 容我拿點水來，你們洗洗腳，在樹下歇息歇息。
verses.e: Now let a little water be fetched , wash your feet , and rest yourselves under the tree .

verses.z: 我再拿一點餅來，你們可以加添心力，然後往前去。你們既到僕人這裏來，理當如此。」他們說：「就照你說的行吧。」
verses.e: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart . After that you may go your way , now that you have come to your servant . " They said , " Very well , do as you have said . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕急忙進帳棚見撒拉，說：「你速速拿三細亞細麵調和做餅。」
verses.e: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah , and said , " Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal , knead it , and make cakes . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕又跑到牛群裏，牽了一隻又嫩又好的牛犢來，交給僕人，僕人急忙預備好了。
verses.e: Abraham ran to the herd , and fetched a tender and good calf , and gave it to the servant . He hurried to dress it .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕又取了奶油和奶，並預備好的牛犢來，擺在他們面前，自己在樹下站在旁邊，他們就吃了。
verses.e: He took butter , milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them . He stood by them under the tree , and they ate .

verses.z: 他們問亞伯拉罕說：「你妻子撒拉在哪裏？」他說：「在帳棚裏。」
verses.e: They asked him , " Where is Sarah , your wife ? " He said , " There , in the tent . "

verses.z: 那兩個天使晚上到了所多瑪；羅得正坐在所多瑪城門口，看見他們，就起來迎接，臉伏於地下拜，
verses.e: The two angels came to Sodom at evening . Lot sat in the gate of Sodom . Lot saw them , and rose up to meet them . He bowed himself with his face to the earth ,

verses.z: 只是那二人伸出手來，將羅得拉進屋去，把門關上，
verses.e: But the men reached out their hand , and brought Lot into the house to them , and shut the door .

verses.z: 並且使門外的人，無論老少，眼都昏迷；他們摸來摸去，總尋不着房門。
verses.e: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness , both small and great , so that they wearied themselves to find the door .

verses.z: 二人對羅得說：「你這裏還有甚麼人嗎？無論是女婿是兒女，和這城中一切屬你的人，你都要將他們從這地方帶出去。
verses.e: The men said to Lot , " Do you have anybody else here ? Sons-in-law , your sons , your daughters , and whomever you have in the city , bring them out of the place :

verses.z: 我們要毀滅這地方；因為城內罪惡的聲音在耶和華面前甚大，耶和華差我們來，要毀滅這地方。」
verses.e: for we will destroy this place , because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it . "

verses.z: 羅得就出去，告訴娶了他女兒的女婿們說：「你們起來離開這地方，因為耶和華要毀滅這城。」他女婿們卻以為他說的是戲言。
verses.e: Lot went out , and spoke to his sons-in-law , who were pledged to marry his daughters , and said , " Get up ! Get out of this place , for the LORD will destroy the city ! " But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking .

verses.z: 天明了，天使催逼羅得說：「起來！帶着你的妻子和你在這裏的兩個女兒出去，免得你因這城裏的罪惡同被剿滅。」
verses.e: When the morning came , then the angels hurried Lot , saying , " Get up ! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here , lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city . "

verses.z: 但羅得遲延不走。二人因為耶和華憐恤羅得，就拉着他的手和他妻子的手，並他兩個女兒的手，把他們領出來，安置在城外；
verses.e: But he lingered ; and the men grabbed his hand , his wife's hand , and his two daughters ' hands , the LORD being merciful to him ; and they took him out , and set him outside of the city .

verses.z: 領他們出來以後，就說：「逃命吧！不可回頭看，也不可在平原站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿滅。」
verses.e: It came to pass , when they had taken them out , that he said , " Escape for your life ! Don't look behind you , and don't stay anywhere in the plain . Escape to the mountains , lest you be consumed ! "

verses.z: 羅得對他們說：「我主啊，不要如此！
verses.e: Lot said to them , " Oh , not so , my lord .

verses.z: 你僕人已經在你眼前蒙恩；你又向我顯出莫大的慈愛，救我的性命。我不能逃到山上去，恐怕這災禍臨到我，我便死了。
verses.e: See now , your servant has found favor in your sight , and you have magnified your loving kindness , which you have shown to me in saving my life . I can't escape to the mountain , lest evil overtake me , and I die .

verses.z: 說：「我主啊，請你們到僕人家裏洗洗腳，住一夜，清早起來再走。」他們說：「不！我們要在街上過夜。」
verses.e: and he said , " See now , my lords , please come into your servant's house , stay all night , wash your feet , and you can rise up early , and go on your way . " They said , " No , but we will stay in the street all night . "

verses.z: 看哪，這座城又小又近，容易逃到，這不是一個小的嗎？求你容我逃到那裏，我的性命就得存活。」
verses.e: See now , this city is near to flee to , and it is a little one . Oh let me escape there ( isn't it a little one ? ) , and my soul will live . "

verses.z: 天使對他說：「這事我也應允你；我不傾覆你所說的這城。
verses.e: He said to him , " Behold , I have granted your request concerning this thing also , that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken .

verses.z: 你要速速地逃到那城；因為你還沒有到那裏，我不能做甚麼。」因此那城名叫瑣珥。
verses.e: Hurry , escape there , for I can't do anything until you get there . " Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .

verses.z: 羅得到了瑣珥，日頭已經出來了。
verses.e: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar .

verses.z: 當時，耶和華將硫磺與火從天上耶和華那裏降與所多瑪和蛾摩拉，
verses.e: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky .

verses.z: 把那些城和全平原，並城裏所有的居民，連地上生長的，都毀滅了。
verses.e: He overthrew those cities , all the plain , all the inhabitants of the cities , and that which grew on the ground .

verses.z: 羅得的妻子在後邊回頭一看，就變成了一根鹽柱。
verses.e: But Lot's wife looked back from behind him , and she became a pillar of salt .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，到了他從前站在耶和華面前的地方，
verses.e: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD .

verses.z: 向所多瑪和蛾摩拉與平原的全地觀看，不料，那地方煙氣上騰，如同燒窯一般。
verses.e: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah , and toward all the land of the plain , and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace .

verses.z: 當上帝毀滅平原諸城的時候，他記念亞伯拉罕，正在傾覆羅得所住之城的時候，就打發羅得從傾覆之中出來。
verses.e: When God destroyed the cities of the plain , God remembered Abraham , and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow , when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived .

verses.z: 羅得切切地請他們，他們這才進去，到他屋裏。羅得為他們預備筵席，烤無酵餅，他們就吃了。
verses.e: He urged them greatly , and they came in with him , and entered into his house . He made them a feast , and baked unleavened bread , and they ate .

verses.z: 羅得因為怕住在瑣珥，就同他兩個女兒從瑣珥上去，住在山裏；他和兩個女兒住在一個洞裏。
verses.e: Lot went up out of Zoar , and lived in the mountain , and his two daughters with him ; for he was afraid to live in Zoar . He lived in a cave with his two daughters .

verses.z: 大女兒對小女兒說：「我們的父親老了，地上又無人按着世上的常規進到我們這裏。
verses.e: The firstborn said to the younger , " Our father is old , and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth .

verses.z: 來！我們可以叫父親喝酒，與他同寢。這樣，我們好從他存留後裔。」
verses.e: Come , let's make our father drink wine , and we will lie with him , that we may preserve our father's family line . "

verses.z: 於是，那夜她們叫父親喝酒，大女兒就進去和她父親同寢；她幾時躺下，幾時起來，父親都不知道。
verses.e: They made their father drink wine that night : and the firstborn went in , and lay with her father . He didn't know when she lay down , nor when she arose .

verses.z: 第二天，大女兒對小女兒說：「我昨夜與父親同寢。今夜我們再叫他喝酒，你可以進去與他同寢。這樣，我們好從父親存留後裔。」
verses.e: It came to pass on the next day , that the firstborn said to the younger , " Behold , I lay last night with my father . Let's make him drink wine again tonight . You go in , and lie with him , that we may preserve our father's family line . "

verses.z: 於是，那夜她們又叫父親喝酒，小女兒起來與她父親同寢；她幾時躺下，幾時起來，父親都不知道。
verses.e: They made their father drink wine that night also . The younger went and lay with him . He didn't know when she lay down , nor when she got up .

verses.z: 這樣，羅得的兩個女兒都從她父親懷了孕。
verses.e: Thus both of Lot's daughters were with child by their father .

verses.z: 大女兒生了兒子，給他起名叫摩押，就是現今摩押人的始祖。
verses.e: The firstborn bore a son , and named him Moab . He is the father of the Moabites to this day .

verses.z: 小女兒也生了兒子，給他起名叫便‧亞米，就是現今亞捫人的始祖。
verses.e: The younger also bore a son , and called his name Ben Ammi . He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day .

verses.z: 他們還沒有躺下，所多瑪城裏各處的人，連老帶少，都來圍住那房子，
verses.e: But before they lay down , the men of the city , the men of Sodom , surrounded the house , both young and old , all the people from every quarter .

verses.z: 呼叫羅得說：「今日晚上到你這裏來的人在哪裏呢？把他們帶出來，任我們所為。」
verses.e: They called to Lot , and said to him , " Where are the men who came in to you this night ? Bring them out to us , that we may have sex with them . "

verses.z: 羅得出來，把門關上，到眾人那裏，
verses.e: Lot went out to them through the door , and shut the door after himself .

verses.z: 說：「眾弟兄，請你們不要做這惡事。
verses.e: He said , " Please , my brothers , don't act so wickedly .

verses.z: 我有兩個女兒，還是處女，容我領出來，任憑你們的心願而行；只是這兩個人既然到我舍下，不要向他們做甚麼。」
verses.e: See now , I have two virgin daughters . Please let me bring them out to you , and you may do to them what seems good to you . Only don't do anything to these men , because they have come under the shadow of my roof . "

verses.z: 眾人說：「退去吧！」又說：「這個人來寄居，還想要作官哪！現在我們要害你比害他們更甚。」眾人就向前擁擠羅得，要攻破房門。
verses.e: They said , " Stand back ! " Then they said , " This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner , and he appoints himself a judge . Now we will deal worse with you than with them ! " They pressed hard on the man Lot , and came near to break the door .

verses.z: 天地萬物都造齊了。
verses.e: The heavens , the earth , and all their vast array were finished .

verses.z: 有河從伊甸流出來，滋潤那園子，從那裏分為四道：
verses.e: A river went out of Eden to water the garden ; and from there it was parted , and became the source of four rivers .

verses.z: 第一道名叫比遜，就是環繞哈腓拉全地的。在那裏有金子，
verses.e: The name of the first is Pishon : it flows through the whole land of Havilah , where there is gold ;

verses.z: 並且那地的金子是好的；在那裏又有珍珠和紅瑪瑙。
verses.e: and the gold of that land is good . Bdellium and onyx stone are also there .

verses.z: 第二道河名叫基訓，就是環繞古實全地的。
verses.e: The name of the second river is Gihon . It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush .

verses.z: 第三道河名叫底格里斯，流在亞述的東邊。第四道河就是幼發拉底河。
verses.e: The name of the third river is Hiddekel . This is the one which flows in front of Assyria . The fourth river is the Euphrates .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝將那人安置在伊甸園，使他修理，看守。
verses.e: The LORD God took the man , and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝吩咐他說：「園中各樣樹上的果子，你可以隨意吃，
verses.e: The LORD God commanded the man , saying , " You may freely eat of every tree of the garden ;

verses.z: 只是分別善惡樹上的果子，你不可吃，因為你吃的日子必定死！」
verses.e: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil ; for in the day that you eat of it , you will surely die . "

verses.z: 耶和華上帝說：「那人獨居不好，我要為他造一個配偶幫助他。」
verses.e: The LORD God said , " It is not good for the man to be alone . I will make him a helper comparable to him . "

verses.z: 耶和華上帝用土所造成的野地各樣走獸和空中各樣飛鳥都帶到那人面前，看他叫甚麼。那人怎樣叫各樣的活物，那就是牠的名字。
verses.e: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field , and every bird of the sky , and brought them to the man to see what he would call them . Whatever the man called every living creature became its name .

verses.z: 到第七日，上帝造物的工已經完畢，就在第七日歇了他一切的工，安息了。
verses.e: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done ; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done .

verses.z: 那人便給一切牲畜和空中飛鳥、野地走獸都起了名；只是那人沒有遇見配偶幫助他。
verses.e: The man gave names to all livestock , and to the birds of the sky , and to every animal of the field ; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝使他沉睡，他就睡了；於是取下他的一條肋骨，又把肉合起來。
verses.e: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep . As the man slept , he took one of his ribs , and closed up the flesh in its place .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝就用那人身上所取的肋骨造成一個女人，領她到那人跟前。
verses.e: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man , and brought her to the man .

verses.z: 那人說：這是我骨中的骨，肉中的肉，可以稱她為「女人」，因為她是從「男人」身上取出來的。
verses.e: The man said , " This is now bone of my bones , and flesh of my flesh . She will be called ' woman , ' because she was taken out of Man . "

verses.z: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
verses.e: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother , and will join with his wife , and they will be one flesh .

verses.z: 當時夫妻二人赤身露體，並不羞恥。
verses.e: The man and his wife were both naked , and they were not ashamed .

verses.z: 上帝賜福給第七日，定為聖日；因為在這日，上帝歇了他一切創造的工，就安息了。
verses.e: God blessed the seventh day , and made it holy , because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done .

verses.z: 創造天地的來歷，在耶和華上帝造天地的日子，乃是這樣，
verses.e: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created , in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens .

verses.z: 野地還沒有草木，田間的菜蔬還沒有長起來；因為耶和華上帝還沒有降雨在地上，也沒有人耕地，
verses.e: No plant of the field was yet in the earth , and no herb of the field had yet sprung up ; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth . There was not a man to till the ground ,

verses.z: 但有霧氣從地上騰，滋潤遍地。
verses.e: but a mist went up from the earth , and watered the whole surface of the ground .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝用地上的塵土造人，將生氣吹在他鼻孔裏，他就成了有靈的活人，[名叫亞當]。
verses.e: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground , and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life ; and man became a living soul .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝在東方的伊甸立了一個園子，把所造的人安置在那裏。
verses.e: The LORD God planted a garden eastward , in Eden , and there he put the man whom he had formed .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝使各樣的樹從地裏長出來，可以悅人的眼目，[其上的果子]好作食物。園子當中又有生命樹和分別善惡的樹。
verses.e: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight , and good for food , including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕從那裏向南地遷去，寄居在加低斯和書珥中間的基拉耳。
verses.e: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South , and lived between Kadesh and Shur . He lived as a foreigner in Gerar .

verses.z: 亞比米勒又對亞伯拉罕說：「你見了甚麼才做這事呢？」
verses.e: Abimelech said to Abraham , " What did you see , that you have done this thing ? "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：「我以為這地方的人總不懼怕上帝，必為我妻子的緣故殺我。
verses.e: Abraham said , " Because I thought , ' Surely the fear of God is not in this place . They will kill me for my wife's sake . '

verses.z: 況且她也實在是我的妹子；她與我是同父異母，後來作了我的妻子。
verses.e: Besides , she is indeed my sister , the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother ; and she became my wife .

verses.z: 當上帝叫我離開父家、飄流在外的時候，我對她說：『我們無論走到甚麼地方，你可以對人說：他是我的哥哥；這就是你待我的恩典了。』」
verses.e: When God caused me to wander from my father's house , I said to her , ' This is your kindness which you shall show to me . Everywhere that we go , say of me , " He is my brother . " ' "

verses.z: 亞比米勒把牛、羊、僕婢賜給亞伯拉罕，又把他的妻子撒拉歸還他。
verses.e: Abimelech took sheep and cattle , male servants and female servants , and gave them to Abraham , and restored Sarah , his wife , to him .

verses.z: 亞比米勒又說：「看哪，我的地都在你面前，你可以隨意居住」；
verses.e: Abimelech said , " Behold , my land is before you . Dwell where it pleases you . "

verses.z: 又對撒拉說：「我給你哥哥一千銀子，作為你在閤家人面前遮羞的，你就在眾人面前沒有不是了。」
verses.e: To Sarah he said , " Behold , I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver . Behold , it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you . In front of all you are vindicated . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕禱告上帝，上帝就醫好了亞比米勒和他的妻子，並他的眾女僕，她們便能生育。
verses.e: Abraham prayed to God . So God healed Abimelech , his wife , and his female servants , and they bore children .

verses.z: 因耶和華為亞伯拉罕的妻子撒拉的緣故，已經使亞比米勒家中的婦人不能生育。
verses.e: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech , because of Sarah , Abraham's wife .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕稱他的妻撒拉為妹子，基拉耳王亞比米勒差人把撒拉取了去。
verses.e: Abraham said about Sarah his wife , " She is my sister . " Abimelech king of Gerar sent , and took Sarah .

verses.z: 但夜間，上帝來，在夢中對亞比米勒說：「你是個死人哪！因為你取了那女人來；她原是別人的妻子。」
verses.e: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night , and said to him , " Behold , you are a dead man , because of the woman whom you have taken ; for she is a man's wife . "

verses.z: 亞比米勒卻還沒有親近撒拉；他說：「主啊，連有義的國，你也要毀滅嗎？
verses.e: Now Abimelech had not come near her . He said , " Lord , will you kill even a righteous nation ?

verses.z: 那人豈不是自己對我說『她是我的妹子』嗎？就是女人也自己說：『他是我的哥哥。』我做這事是心正手潔的。」
verses.e: Didn't he tell me , ' She is my sister ' ? She , even she herself , said , ' He is my brother . ' I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands . "

verses.z: 上帝在夢中對他說：「我知道你做這事是心中正直；我也攔阻了你，免得你得罪我，所以我不容你沾着她。
verses.e: God said to him in the dream , " Yes , I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this , and I also withheld you from sinning against me . Therefore I didn't allow you to touch her .

verses.z: 現在你把這人的妻子歸還他；因為他是先知，他要為你禱告，使你存活。你若不歸還他，你當知道，你和你所有的人都必要死。」
verses.e: Now therefore , restore the man's wife . For he is a prophet , and he will pray for you , and you will live . If you don't restore her , know for sure that you will die , you , and all who are yours . "

verses.z: 亞比米勒清早起來，召了眾臣僕來，將這些事都說給他們聽，他們都甚懼怕。
verses.e: Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ear . The men were very scared .

verses.z: 亞比米勒召了亞伯拉罕來，對他說：「你怎麼向我這樣行呢？我在甚麼事上得罪了你，你竟使我和我國裏的人陷在大罪裏？你向我行不當行的事了！」
verses.e: Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said to him , " What have you done to us ? How have I sinned against you , that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done ! "

verses.z: 耶和華按着先前的話眷顧撒拉，便照他所說的給撒拉成就。
verses.e: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said , and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken .

verses.z: 就對亞伯拉罕說：「你把這使女和她兒子趕出去！因為這使女的兒子不可與我的兒子以撒一同承受產業。」
verses.e: Therefore she said to Abraham , " Cast out this servant and her son ! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son , Isaac . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕因他兒子的緣故很憂愁。
verses.e: The thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight on account of his son .

verses.z: 上帝對亞伯拉罕說：「你不必為這童子和你的使女憂愁。凡撒拉對你說的話，你都該聽從；因為從以撒生的，才要稱為你的後裔。
verses.e: God said to Abraham , " Don't let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy , and because of your servant . In all that Sarah says to you , listen to her voice . For your offspring will be named through Isaac .

verses.z: 至於使女的兒子，我也必使他[的後裔]成立一國，因為他是你所生的。」
verses.e: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant , because he is your child . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，拿餅和一皮袋水，給了夏甲，搭在她的肩上，又把孩子[交給她]，打發她走。夏甲就走了，在別是巴的曠野走迷了路。
verses.e: Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread and a container of water , and gave it to Hagar , putting it on her shoulder ; and gave her the child , and sent her away . She departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba .

verses.z: 皮袋的水用盡了，夏甲就把孩子撇在小樹底下，
verses.e: The water in the container was spent , and she put the child under one of the shrubs .

verses.z: 自己走開約有一箭之遠，相對而坐，說：「我不忍見孩子死」，就相對而坐，放聲大哭。
verses.e: She went and sat down opposite him , a good way off , about a bow shot away . For she said , " Don't let me see the death of the child . " She sat opposite him , and lifted up her voice , and wept .

verses.z: 上帝聽見童子的聲音；上帝的使者從天上呼叫夏甲說：「夏甲，你為何這樣呢？不要害怕，上帝已經聽見童子的聲音了。
verses.e: God heard the voice of the boy . The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky , and said to her , " What troubles you , Hagar ? Don't be afraid . For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is .

verses.z: 起來！把童子抱在懷中，我必使他[的後裔]成為大國。」
verses.e: Get up , lift up the boy , and hold him with your hand . For I will make him a great nation . "

verses.z: 上帝使夏甲的眼睛明亮，她就看見一口水井，便去將皮袋盛滿了水，給童子喝。
verses.e: God opened her eyes , and she saw a well of water . She went , filled the container with water , and gave the boy a drink .

verses.z: 當亞伯拉罕年老的時候，撒拉懷了孕；到上帝所說的日期，就給亞伯拉罕生了一個兒子。
verses.e: Sarah conceived , and bore Abraham a son in his old age , at the set time of which God had spoken to him .

verses.z: 上帝保佑童子，他就漸長，住在曠野，成了弓箭手。
verses.e: God was with the boy , and he grew . He lived in the wilderness , and as he grew up , he became an archer .

verses.z: 他住在巴蘭的曠野；他母親從埃及地給他娶了一個妻子。
verses.e: He lived in the wilderness of Paran . His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 當那時候，亞比米勒同他軍長非各對亞伯拉罕說：「凡你所行的事都有上帝的保佑。
verses.e: At that time , Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham , saying , " God is with you in all that you do .

verses.z: 我願你如今在這裏指着上帝對我起誓，不要欺負我與我的兒子，並我的子孫。我怎樣厚待了你，你也要照樣厚待我與你所寄居這地的民。」
verses.e: Now , therefore , swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me , nor with my son , nor with my son's son . But according to the kindness that I have done to you , you shall do to me , and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：「我情願起誓。」
verses.e: Abraham said , " I will swear . "

verses.z: 從前，亞比米勒的僕人霸佔了一口水井，亞伯拉罕為這事指責亞比米勒。
verses.e: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well , which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away .

verses.z: 亞比米勒說：「誰做這事，我不知道，你也沒有告訴我，今日我才聽見了。」
verses.e: Abimelech said , " I don't know who has done this thing . You didn't tell me , and I didn't hear of it until today . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕把羊和牛給了亞比米勒，二人就彼此立約。
verses.e: Abraham took sheep and cattle , and gave them to Abimelech . Those two made a covenant .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕把七隻母羊羔另放在一處。
verses.e: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves .

verses.z: 亞比米勒問亞伯拉罕說：「你把這七隻母羊羔另放在一處，是甚麼意思呢？」
verses.e: Abimelech said to Abraham , " What do these seven ewe lambs , which you have set by themselves , mean ? "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕給撒拉所生的兒子起名叫以撒。
verses.e: Abraham called his son who was born to him , whom Sarah bore to him , Isaac .

verses.z: 他說：「你要從我手裏受這七隻母羊羔，作我挖這口井的證據。」
verses.e: He said , " You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand , that it may be a witness to me , that I have dug this well . "

verses.z: 所以他給那地方起名叫別是巴，因為他們二人在那裏起了誓。
verses.e: Therefore he called that place Beersheba , because they both swore an oath there .

verses.z: 他們在別是巴立了約，亞比米勒就同他軍長非各起身回非利士地去了。
verses.e: So they made a covenant at Beersheba . Abimelech rose up with Phicol , the captain of his army , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕在別是巴栽上一棵垂絲柳樹，又在那裏求告耶和華－永生上帝的名。
verses.e: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba , and there he called on the name of the LORD , the Everlasting God .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。
verses.e: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days .

verses.z: 以撒生下來第八日，亞伯拉罕照着上帝所吩咐的，給以撒行了割禮。
verses.e: Abraham circumcised his son , Isaac , when he was eight days old , as God had commanded him .

verses.z: 他兒子以撒生的時候，亞伯拉罕年一百歲。
verses.e: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son , Isaac , was born to him .

verses.z: 撒拉說：「上帝使我喜笑，凡聽見的必與我一同喜笑」；
verses.e: Sarah said , " God has made me laugh . Everyone who hears will laugh with me . "

verses.z: 又說：「誰能預先對亞伯拉罕說『撒拉要乳養嬰孩』呢？因為在他年老的時候，我給他生了一個兒子。」
verses.e: She said , " Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children ? For I have borne him a son in his old age . "

verses.z: 孩子漸長，就斷了奶。以撒斷奶的日子，亞伯拉罕設擺豐盛的筵席。
verses.e: The child grew and was weaned . Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned .

verses.z: 當時，撒拉看見埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子戲笑，
verses.e: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , whom she had borne to Abraham , mocking .

verses.z: 這些事以後，上帝要試驗亞伯拉罕，就呼叫他說：「亞伯拉罕！」他說：「我在這裏。」
verses.e: After these things , God tested Abraham , and said to him , " Abraham ! " He said , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要殺他的兒子。
verses.e: Abraham stretched out his hand , and took the knife to kill his son .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者從天上呼叫他說：「亞伯拉罕！亞伯拉罕！」他說：「我在這裏。」
verses.e: The LORD's angel called to him out of the sky , and said , " Abraham , Abraham ! " He said , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 天使說：「你不可在這童子身上下手。一點不可害他！現在我知道你是敬畏上帝的了；因為你沒有將你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，留下不給我。」
verses.e: He said , " Don't lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him . For now I know that you fear God , since you have not withheld your son , your only son , from me . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕舉目觀看，不料，有一隻公羊，兩角扣在稠密的小樹中。亞伯拉罕就取了那隻公羊來，獻為燔祭，代替他的兒子。
verses.e: Abraham lifted up his eyes , and looked , and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns . Abraham went and took the ram , and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕給那地方起名叫「耶和華以勒」，直到今日人還說：「在耶和華的山上必有預備。」
verses.e: Abraham called the name of that place " The LORD Will Provide " . As it is said to this day , " On the LORD's mountain , it will be provided . "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者第二次從天上呼叫亞伯拉罕說：
verses.e: The LORD's angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky ,

verses.z: 「耶和華說：『你既行了這事，不留下你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，我便指着自己起誓說：
verses.e: and said , " ' I have sworn by myself , ' says the LORD , ' because you have done this thing , and have not withheld your son , your only son ,

verses.z: 論福，我必賜大福給你；論子孫，我必叫你的子孫多起來，如同天上的星，海邊的沙。你子孫必得着仇敵的城門，
verses.e: that I will bless you greatly , and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens , and like the sand which is on the seashore . Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies .

verses.z: 並且地上萬國都必因你的後裔得福，因為你聽從了我的話。』」
verses.e: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring , because you have obeyed my voice . ' "

verses.z: 於是亞伯拉罕回到他僕人那裏，他們一同起身往別是巴去，亞伯拉罕就住在別是巴。
verses.e: So Abraham returned to his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beersheba . Abraham lived at Beersheba .

verses.z: 上帝說：「你帶着你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，你所愛的以撒，往摩利亞地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他獻為燔祭。」
verses.e: He said , " Now take your son , your only son , Isaac , whom you love , and go into the land of Moriah . Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of . "

verses.z: 這事以後，有人告訴亞伯拉罕說：「密迦給你兄弟拿鶴生了幾個兒子，
verses.e: After these things , Abraham was told , " Behold , Milcah , she also has borne children to your brother Nahor :

verses.z: 長子是烏斯，他的兄弟是布斯和亞蘭的父親基母利，
verses.e: Uz his firstborn , Buz his brother , Kemuel the father of Aram ,

verses.z: 並基薛、哈瑣、必達、益拉、彼土利（彼土利生利百加）。」
verses.e: Chesed , Hazo , Pildash , Jidlaph , and Bethuel . "

verses.z: 這八個人都是密迦給亞伯拉罕的兄弟拿鶴生的。
verses.e: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah . These eight Milcah bore to Nahor , Abraham's brother .

verses.z: 拿鶴的妾名叫流瑪，生了提八、迦含、他轄，和瑪迦。
verses.e: His concubine , whose name was Reumah , also bore Tebah , Gaham , Tahash , and Maacah .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，備上驢，帶着兩個僕人和他兒子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往上帝所指示他的地方去了。
verses.e: Abraham rose early in the morning , and saddled his donkey ; and took two of his young men with him , and Isaac his son . He split the wood for the burnt offering , and rose up , and went to the place of which God had told him .

verses.z: 到了第三日，亞伯拉罕舉目遠遠地看見那地方。
verses.e: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes , and saw the place far off .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕對他的僕人說：「你們和驢在此等候，我與童子往那裏去拜一拜，就回到你們這裏來。」
verses.e: Abraham said to his young men , " Stay here with the donkey . The boy and I will go over there . We will worship , and come back to you . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他兒子以撒身上，自己手裏拿着火與刀；於是二人同行。
verses.e: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son . He took in his hand the fire and the knife . They both went together .

verses.z: 以撒對他父親亞伯拉罕說：「父親哪！」亞伯拉罕說：「我兒，我在這裏。」以撒說：「請看，火與柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪裏呢？」
verses.e: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father , and said , " My father ? " He said , " Here I am , my son . " He said , " Here is the fire and the wood , but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ? "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：「我兒，上帝必自己預備作燔祭的羊羔。」於是二人同行。
verses.e: Abraham said , " God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering , my son . " So they both went together .

verses.z: 他們到了上帝所指示的地方，亞伯拉罕在那裏築壇，把柴擺好，捆綁他的兒子以撒，放在壇的柴上。
verses.e: They came to the place which God had told him of . Abraham built the altar there , and laid the wood in order , bound Isaac his son , and laid him on the altar , on the wood .

verses.z: 撒拉享壽一百二十七歲，這是撒拉一生的歲數。
verses.e: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years . This was the length of Sarah's life .

verses.z: 當時以弗崙正坐在赫人中間。於是，赫人以弗崙在城門出入的赫人面前對亞伯拉罕說：
verses.e: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth . Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth , even of all who went in at the gate of his city , saying ,

verses.z: 「不然，我主請聽。我送給你這塊田，連田間的洞也送給你，在我同族的人面前都給你，可以埋葬你的死人。」
verses.e: " No , my lord , hear me . I give you the field , and I give you the cave that is in it . In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you . Bury your dead . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，
verses.e: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land .

verses.z: 在他們面前對以弗崙說：「你若應允，請聽我的話。我要把田價給你，求你收下，我就在那裏埋葬我的死人。」
verses.e: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land , saying , " But if you will , please hear me . I will give the price of the field . Take it from me , and I will bury my dead there . "

verses.z: 以弗崙回答亞伯拉罕說：
verses.e: Ephron answered Abraham , saying to him ,

verses.z: 「我主請聽。值四百舍客勒銀子的一塊田，在你我中間還算甚麼呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧！」
verses.e: " My lord , listen to me . What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you ? Therefore bury your dead . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕聽從了以弗崙，照着他在赫人面前所說的話，把買賣通用的銀子平了四百舍客勒給以弗崙。
verses.e: Abraham listened to Ephron . Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth , four hundred shekels of silver , according to the current merchants ' standard .

verses.z: 於是，麥比拉、幔利前、以弗崙的那塊田和其中的洞，並田間四圍的樹木，
verses.e: So the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , the cave which was in it , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all of its borders , were deeded

verses.z: 都定準歸與亞伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前並城門出入的人面前買妥的。
verses.e: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth , before all who went in at the gate of his city .

verses.z: 此後，亞伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麥比拉田間的洞裏。（幔利就是希伯崙）。
verses.e: After this , Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre ( that is , Hebron ) , in the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列‧亞巴，就是希伯崙。亞伯拉罕為她哀慟哭號。
verses.e: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba ( also called Hebron ) , in the land of Canaan . Abraham came to mourn for Sarah , and to weep for her .

verses.z: 從此，那塊田和田間的洞就藉着赫人定準歸與亞伯拉罕作墳地。
verses.e: The field , and the cave that is in it , were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place .

verses.z: 後來亞伯拉罕從死人面前起來，對赫人說：
verses.e: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth , saying ,

verses.z: 「我在你們中間是外人，是寄居的。求你們在這裏給我一塊地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。」
verses.e: " I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you . Give me a possession of a burying-place with you , that I may bury my dead out of my sight . "

verses.z: 赫人回答亞伯拉罕說：
verses.e: The children of Heth answered Abraham , saying to him ,

verses.z: 「我主請聽。你在我們中間是一位尊大的王子，只管在我們最好的墳地裏埋葬你的死人；我們沒有一人不容你在他的墳地裏埋葬你的死人。」
verses.e: " Hear us , my lord . You are a prince of God among us . Bury your dead in the best of our tombs . None of us will withhold from you his tomb . Bury your dead . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕就起來，向那地的赫人下拜，
verses.e: Abraham rose up , and bowed himself to the people of the land , to the children of Heth .

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就請聽我的話，為我求瑣轄的兒子以弗崙，
verses.e: He talked with them , saying , " If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight , hear me , and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,

verses.z: 把田頭上那麥比拉洞給我，他可以按着足價賣給我，作我在你們中間的墳地。」
verses.e: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah , which he has , which is in the end of his field . For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕年紀老邁，向來在一切事上耶和華都賜福給他。
verses.e: Abraham was old , and well advanced in age . The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things .

verses.z: 那僕人從他主人的駱駝裏取了十匹駱駝，並帶些他主人各樣的財物，起身往美索不達米亞去，到了拿鶴的城。
verses.e: The servant took ten of his master's camels , and departed , having a variety of good things of his master's with him . He arose , and went to Mesopotamia , to the city of Nahor .

verses.z: 天將晚，眾女子出來打水的時候，他便叫駱駝跪在城外的水井那裏。
verses.e: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening , the time that women go out to draw water .

verses.z: 他說：「耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的上帝啊，求你施恩給我主人亞伯拉罕，使我今日遇見好機會。
verses.e: He said , " LORD , the God of my master Abraham , please give me success today , and show kindness to my master Abraham .

verses.z: 我現今站在井旁，城內居民的女子們正出來打水。
verses.e: Behold , I am standing by the spring of water . The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water .

verses.z: 我向那一個女子說：『請你拿下水瓶來，給我水喝。』她若說：『請喝！我也給你的駱駝喝。』願那女子就作你所預定給你僕人以撒的妻。這樣，我便知道你施恩給我主人了。」
verses.e: Let it happen , that the young lady to whom I will say , ' Please let down your pitcher , that I may drink , ' then she says , ' Drink , and I will also give your camels a drink , ' — let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac . By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master . "

verses.z: 話還沒有說完，不料，利百加肩頭上扛着水瓶出來。利百加是彼土利所生的；彼土利是亞伯拉罕兄弟拿鶴妻子密迦的兒子。
verses.e: Before he had finished speaking , behold , Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham's brother , with her pitcher on her shoulder .

verses.z: 那女子容貌極其俊美，還是處女，也未曾有人親近她。她下到井旁，打滿了瓶，又上來。
verses.e: The young lady was very beautiful to look at , a virgin . No man had known her . She went down to the spring , filled her pitcher , and came up .

verses.z: 僕人跑上前去迎着她，說：「求你將瓶裏的水給我一點喝。」
verses.e: The servant ran to meet her , and said , " Please give me a drink , a little water from your pitcher . "

verses.z: 女子說：「我主請喝！」就急忙拿下瓶來，托在手上給他喝。
verses.e: She said , " Drink , my lord . " She hurried , and let down her pitcher on her hand , and gave him a drink .

verses.z: 女子給他喝了，就說：「我再為你的駱駝打水，叫駱駝也喝足。」
verses.e: When she had finished giving him a drink , she said , " I will also draw for your camels , until they have finished drinking . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕對管理他全業最老的僕人說：「請你把手放在我大腿底下。
verses.e: Abraham said to his servant , the elder of his house , who ruled over all that he had , " Please put your hand under my thigh .

verses.z: 她就急忙把瓶裏的水倒在槽裏，又跑到井旁打水，就為所有的駱駝打上水來。
verses.e: She hurried , and emptied her pitcher into the trough , and ran again to the well to draw , and drew for all his camels .

verses.z: 那人定睛看她，一句話也不說，要曉得耶和華賜他通達的道路沒有。
verses.e: The man looked steadfastly at her , remaining silent , to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not .

verses.z: 駱駝喝足了，那人就拿一個金環，重半舍客勒，兩個金鐲，重十舍客勒，給了那女子，
verses.e: As the camels had finished drinking , the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold ,

verses.z: 說：「請告訴我，你是誰的女兒？你父親家裏有我們住宿的地方沒有？」
verses.e: and said , " Whose daughter are you ? Please tell me . Is there room in your father's house for us to stay ? "

verses.z: 女子說：「我是密迦與拿鶴之子彼土利的女兒」；
verses.e: She said to him , " I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah , whom she bore to Nahor . "

verses.z: 又說：「我們家裏足有糧草，也有住宿的地方。」
verses.e: She said moreover to him , " We have both straw and feed enough , and room to lodge in . "

verses.z: 那人就低頭向耶和華下拜，
verses.e: The man bowed his head , and worshiped the LORD .

verses.z: 說：「耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的上帝是應當稱頌的，因他不斷地以慈愛誠實待我主人。至於我，耶和華在路上引領我，直走到我主人的兄弟家裏。」
verses.e: He said , " Blessed be the LORD , the God of my master Abraham , who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master . As for me , the LORD has led me on the way to the house of my master's relatives . "

verses.z: 女子跑回去，照着這些話告訴她母親和她家裏的人。
verses.e: The young lady ran , and told her mother's house about these words .

verses.z: 利百加有一個哥哥，名叫拉班，看見金環，又看見金鐲在他妹子的手上，並聽見他妹子利百加的話，說那人對我如此如此說。拉班就跑出來往井旁去，到那人跟前，見他仍站在駱駝旁邊的井旁那裏，
verses.e: Rebekah had a brother , and his name was Laban . Laban ran out to the man , to the spring .

verses.z: 我要叫你指着耶和華－天地的主起誓，不要為我兒子娶這迦南地中的女子為妻。
verses.e: I will make you swear by the LORD , the God of heaven and the God of the earth , that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I live .

When he saw the ring , and the bracelets on his sister's hands , and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister , saying , " This is what the man said to me , " he came to the man . Behold , he was standing by the camels at the spring .

verses.z: 便對他說：「你這蒙耶和華賜福的，請進來，為甚麼站在外邊？我已經收拾了房屋，也為駱駝預備了地方。」
verses.e: He said , " Come in , you blessed of the LORD . Why do you stand outside ? For I have prepared the house , and room for the camels . "

verses.z: 那人就進了拉班的家。拉班卸了駱駝，用草料餵上，拿水給那人和跟隨的人洗腳；
verses.e: The man came into the house , and he unloaded the camels . He gave straw and feed for the camels , and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him .

verses.z: 把飯擺在他面前，叫他吃，他卻說：「我不吃，等我說明白我的事情再吃。」拉班說：「請說。」
verses.e: Food was set before him to eat , but he said , " I will not eat until I have told my message . " Laban said , " Speak on . "

verses.z: 他說：「我是亞伯拉罕的僕人。
verses.e: He said , " I am Abraham's servant .

verses.z: 耶和華大大地賜福給我主人，使他昌大，又賜給他羊群、牛群、金銀、僕婢、駱駝，和驢。
verses.e: The LORD has blessed my master greatly . He has become great . The LORD has given him flocks and herds , silver and gold , male servants and female servants , and camels and donkeys .

verses.z: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的時候給我主人生了一個兒子；我主人也將一切所有的都給了這個兒子。
verses.e: Sarah , my master's wife , bore a son to my master when she was old . He has given all that he has to him .

verses.z: 我主人叫我起誓說：『你不要為我兒子娶迦南地的女子為妻。
verses.e: My master made me swear , saying , ' You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites , in whose land I live ,

verses.z: 你要往我父家、我本族那裏去，為我的兒子娶一個妻子。』
verses.e: but you shall go to my father's house , and to my relatives , and take a wife for my son . '

verses.z: 我對我主人說：『恐怕女子不肯跟我來。』
verses.e: I asked my master , ' What if the woman will not follow me ? '

verses.z: 你要往我本地本族去，為我的兒子以撒娶一個妻子。」
verses.e: But you shall go to my country , and to my relatives , and take a wife for my son Isaac . "

verses.z: 他就說：『我所事奉的耶和華必要差遣他的使者與你同去，叫你的道路通達，你就得以在我父家、我本族那裏，給我的兒子娶一個妻子。
verses.e: He said to me , ' The LORD , before whom I walk , will send his angel with you , and prosper your way . You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives , and of my father's house .

verses.z: 只要你到了我本族那裏，我使你起的誓就與你無干。他們若不把女子交給你，我使你起的誓也與你無干。』
verses.e: Then you will be clear from my oath , when you come to my relatives . If they don't give her to you , you shall be clear from my oath . '

verses.z: 「我今日到了井旁，便說：『耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的上帝啊，願你叫我所行的道路通達。
verses.e: I came today to the spring , and said , ' The LORD , the God of my master Abraham , if now you do prosper my way which I go —

verses.z: 我如今站在井旁，對哪一個出來打水的女子說：請你把你瓶裏的水給我一點喝；
verses.e: behold , I am standing by this spring of water . Let it happen , that the maiden who comes out to draw , to whom I will say , " Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink , "

verses.z: 她若說：你只管喝，我也為你的駱駝打水；願那女子就作耶和華給我主人兒子所預定的妻。』
verses.e: then she tells me , " Drink , and I will also draw for your camels , " — let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master's son . '

verses.z: 我心裏的話還沒有說完，利百加就出來，肩頭上扛着水瓶，下到井旁打水。我便對她說：『請你給我水喝。』
verses.e: Before I had finished speaking in my heart , behold , Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder . She went down to the spring , and drew . I said to her , ' Please let me drink . '

verses.z: 她就急忙從肩頭上拿下瓶來，說：『請喝！我也給你的駱駝喝。』我便喝了；她又給我的駱駝喝了。
verses.e: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , ' Drink , and I will also give your camels a drink . ' So I drank , and she also gave the camels a drink .

verses.z: 我問她說：『你是誰的女兒？』她說：『我是密迦與拿鶴之子彼土利的女兒。』我就把環子戴在她鼻子上，把鐲子戴在她兩手上。
verses.e: I asked her , and said , ' Whose daughter are you ? ' She said , ' The daughter of Bethuel , Nahor's son , whom Milcah bore to him . ' I put the ring on her nose , and the bracelets on her hands .

verses.z: 隨後我低頭向耶和華下拜，稱頌耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的上帝；因為他引導我走合式的道路，使我得着我主人兄弟的孫女，給我主人的兒子為妻。
verses.e: I bowed my head , and worshiped the LORD , and blessed the LORD , the God of my master Abraham , who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son .

verses.z: 現在你們若願以慈愛誠實待我主人，就告訴我；若不然，也告訴我，使我可以或向左，或向右。」
verses.e: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master , tell me . If not , tell me , that I may turn to the right hand , or to the left . "

verses.z: 僕人對他說：「倘若女子不肯跟我到這地方來，我必須將你的兒子帶回你原出之地嗎？」
verses.e: The servant said to him , " What if the woman isn't willing to follow me to this land ? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from ? "

verses.z: 拉班和彼土利回答說：「這事乃出於耶和華，我們不能向你說好說歹。
verses.e: Then Laban and Bethuel answered , " The thing proceeds from the LORD . We can't speak to you bad or good .

verses.z: 看哪，利百加在你面前，可以將她帶去，照着耶和華所說的，給你主人的兒子為妻。」
verses.e: Behold , Rebekah is before you . Take her , and go , and let her be your master's son's wife , as the LORD has spoken . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕的僕人聽見他們這話，就向耶和華俯伏在地。
verses.e: When Abraham's servant heard their words , he bowed himself down to the earth to the LORD .

verses.z: 當下僕人拿出金器、銀器，和衣服送給利百加，又將寶物送給她哥哥和她母親。
verses.e: The servant brought out jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and clothing , and gave them to Rebekah . He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother .

verses.z: 僕人和跟從他的人吃了喝了，住了一夜。早晨起來，僕人就說：「請打發我回我主人那裏去吧。」
verses.e: They ate and drank , he and the men who were with him , and stayed all night . They rose up in the morning , and he said , " Send me away to my master . "

verses.z: 利百加的哥哥和她母親說：「讓女子同我們再住幾天，至少十天，然後她可以去。」
verses.e: Her brother and her mother said , " Let the young lady stay with us a few days , at least ten . After that she will go . "

verses.z: 僕人說：「耶和華既賜給我通達的道路，你們不要耽誤我，請打發我走，回我主人那裏去吧。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Don't hinder me , since the LORD has prospered my way . Send me away that I may go to my master . "

verses.z: 他們說：「我們把女子叫來問問她」，
verses.e: They said , " We will call the young lady , and ask her . "

verses.z: 就叫了利百加來，問她說：「你和這人同去嗎？」利百加說：「我去。」
verses.e: They called Rebekah , and said to her , " Will you go with this man ? " She said , " I will go . "

verses.z: 於是他們打發妹子利百加和她的乳母，同亞伯拉罕的僕人，並跟從僕人的，都走了。
verses.e: They sent away Rebekah , their sister , with her nurse , Abraham's servant , and his men .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕對他說：「你要謹慎，不要帶我的兒子回那裏去。
verses.e: Abraham said to him , " Beware that you don't bring my son there again .

verses.z: 他們就給利百加祝福說：我們的妹子啊，願你作千萬人的母！願你的後裔得着仇敵的城門！
verses.e: They blessed Rebekah , and said to her , " Our sister , may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands , and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them . "

verses.z: 利百加和她的使女們起來，騎上駱駝，跟着那僕人，僕人就帶着利百加走了。
verses.e: Rebekah arose with her ladies . They rode on the camels , and followed the man . The servant took Rebekah , and went his way .

verses.z: 那時，以撒住在南地，剛從庇耳‧拉海‧萊回來。
verses.e: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi , for he lived in the land of the South .

verses.z: 天將晚，以撒出來在田間默想，舉目一看，見來了些駱駝。
verses.e: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening . He lifted up his eyes and looked . Behold , there were camels coming .

verses.z: 利百加舉目看見以撒，就急忙下了駱駝，
verses.e: Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she got off the camel .

verses.z: 問那僕人說：「這田間走來迎接我們的是誰？」僕人說：「是我的主人。」利百加就拿帕子蒙上臉。
verses.e: She said to the servant , " Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us ? " The servant said , " It is my master . " She took her veil , and covered herself .

verses.z: 僕人就將所辦的一切事都告訴以撒。
verses.e: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done .

verses.z: 以撒便領利百加進了他母親撒拉的帳棚，娶了她為妻，並且愛她。以撒自從他母親不在了，這才得了安慰。
verses.e: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent , and took Rebekah , and she became his wife . He loved her . So Isaac was comforted after his mother's death .

verses.z: 耶和華－天上的主曾帶領我離開父家和本族的地，對我說話，向我起誓說：『我要將這地賜給你的後裔。』他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以從那裏為我兒子娶一個妻子。
verses.e: The LORD , the God of heaven — who took me from my father's house , and from the land of my birth , who spoke to me , and who swore to me , saying , ' I will give this land to your offspring — he will send his angel before you , and you shall take a wife for my son from there .

verses.z: 倘若女子不肯跟你來，我使你起的誓就與你無干了，只是不可帶我的兒子回那裏去。」
verses.e: If the woman isn't willing to follow you , then you shall be clear from this oath to me . Only you shall not bring my son there again . "

verses.z: 僕人就把手放在他主人亞伯拉罕的大腿底下，為這事向他起誓。
verses.e: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and swore to him concerning this matter .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。
verses.e: Abraham took another wife , and her name was Keturah .

verses.z: 就是亞伯拉罕向赫人買的那塊田。亞伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那裏。
verses.e: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth . Abraham was buried there with Sarah , his wife .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕死了以後，上帝賜福給他的兒子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳‧拉海‧萊居住。
verses.e: After the death of Abraham , God blessed Isaac , his son . Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi .

verses.z: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子是以實瑪利。
verses.e: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael , Abraham's son , whom Hagar the Egyptian , Sarah's servant , bore to Abraham .

verses.z: 以實瑪利兒子們的名字，按着他們的家譜記在下面。以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，又有基達、亞德別、米比衫、
verses.e: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael , by their names , according to the order of their birth : the firstborn of Ishmael , Nebaioth , then Kedar , Adbeel , Mibsam ,

verses.z: 米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、
verses.e: Mishma , Dumah , Massa ,

verses.z: 哈大、提瑪、伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。
verses.e: Hadad , Tema , Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah .

verses.z: 這是以實瑪利眾子的名字，照着他們的村莊、營寨，作了十二族的族長。
verses.e: These are the sons of Ishmael , and these are their names , by their villages , and by their encampments : twelve princes , according to their nations .

verses.z: 以實瑪利享壽一百三十七歲，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖那裏。
verses.e: These are the years of the life of Ishmael : one hundred thirty-seven years . He gave up his spirit and died , and was gathered to his people .

verses.z: 他子孫的住處在他眾弟兄東邊，從哈腓拉直到埃及前的書珥，正在亞述的道上。
verses.e: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt , as you go toward Assyria . He lived opposite all his relatives .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕的兒子以撒的後代記在下面。亞伯拉罕生以撒。
verses.e: This is the history of the generations of Isaac , Abraham's son . Abraham became the father of Isaac .

verses.z: 基土拉給他生了心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴，和書亞。
verses.e: She bore him Zimran , Jokshan , Medan , Midian , Ishbak , and Shuah .

verses.z: 以撒娶利百加為妻的時候正四十歲。利百加是巴旦‧亞蘭地的亞蘭人彼土利的女兒，是亞蘭人拉班的妹子。
verses.e: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah , the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram , the sister of Laban the Syrian , to be his wife .

verses.z: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就為她祈求耶和華；耶和華應允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就懷了孕。
verses.e: Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife , because she was barren . The LORD was entreated by him , and Rebekah his wife conceived .

verses.z: 孩子們在她腹中彼此相爭，她就說：「若是這樣，我為甚麼活着呢？」她就去求問耶和華。
verses.e: The children struggled together within her . She said , " If it is like this , why do I live ? " She went to inquire of the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華對她說：兩國在你腹內；兩族要從你身上出來。這族必強於那族；將來大的要服事小的。
verses.e: The LORD said to her , " Two nations are in your womb . Two peoples will be separated from your body . The one people will be stronger than the other people . The elder will serve the younger . "

verses.z: 生產的日子到了，腹中果然是雙子。
verses.e: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold , there were twins in her womb .

verses.z: 先產的身體發紅，渾身有毛，如同皮衣，他們就給他起名叫以掃。
verses.e: The first came out red all over , like a hairy garment . They named him Esau .

verses.z: 隨後又生了以掃的兄弟，手抓住以掃的腳跟，因此給他起名叫雅各。利百加生下兩個兒子的時候，以撒年正六十歲。
verses.e: After that , his brother came out , and his hand had hold on Esau's heel . He was named Jacob . Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them .

verses.z: 兩個孩子漸漸長大，以掃善於打獵，常在田野；雅各為人安靜，常住在帳棚裏。
verses.e: The boys grew . Esau was a skillful hunter , a man of the field . Jacob was a quiet man , living in tents .

verses.z: 以撒愛以掃，因為常吃他的野味；利百加卻愛雅各。
verses.e: Now Isaac loved Esau , because he ate his venison . Rebekah loved Jacob .

verses.z: 有一天，雅各熬湯，以掃從田野回來累昏了。
verses.e: Jacob boiled stew . Esau came in from the field , and he was famished .

verses.z: 約珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孫是亞書利族、利都是族，和利烏米族。
verses.e: Jokshan became the father of Sheba , and Dedan . The sons of Dedan were Asshurim , Letushim , and Leummim .

verses.z: 以掃對雅各說：「我累昏了，求你把這紅[湯]給我喝。」因此以掃又叫以東。
verses.e: Esau said to Jacob , " Please feed me with some of that red stew , for I am famished . " Therefore his name was called Edom .

verses.z: 雅各說：「你今日把長子的名分賣給我吧。」
verses.e: Jacob said , " First , sell me your birthright . "

verses.z: 以掃說：「我將要死，這長子的名分於我有甚麼益處呢？」
verses.e: Esau said , " Behold , I am about to die . What good is the birthright to me ? "

verses.z: 雅各說：「你今日對我起誓吧。」以掃就對他起了誓，把長子的名分賣給雅各。
verses.e: Jacob said , " Swear to me first . " He swore to him . He sold his birthright to Jacob .

verses.z: 於是雅各將餅和紅豆湯給了以掃，以掃吃了喝了，便起來走了。這就是以掃輕看了他長子的名分。
verses.e: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew . He ate and drank , rose up , and went his way . So Esau despised his birthright .

verses.z: 米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大，和以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
verses.e: The sons of Midian were Ephah , Epher , Hanoch , Abida , and Eldaah . All these were the children of Keturah .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕將一切所有的都給了以撒。
verses.e: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac ,

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕把財物分給他庶出的眾子，趁着自己還在世的時候打發他們離開他的兒子以撒，往東方去。
verses.e: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham's concubines . While he still lived , he sent them away from Isaac his son , eastward , to the east country .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五歲。
verses.e: These are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived : one hundred seventy-five years .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕壽高年邁，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖那裏。
verses.e: Abraham gave up his spirit , and died at a good old age , an old man , and full of years , and was gathered to his people .

verses.z: 他兩個兒子以撒、以實瑪利把他埋葬在麥比拉洞裏。這洞在幔利前、赫人瑣轄的兒子以弗崙的田中，
verses.e: Isaac and Ishmael , his sons , buried him in the cave of Machpelah , in the field of Ephron , the son of Zohar the Hittite , which is near Mamre ,

verses.z: 在亞伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饑荒；這時又有饑荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亞比米勒那裏。
verses.e: There was a famine in the land , in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines , to Gerar .

verses.z: 亞比米勒說：「你向我們做的是甚麼事呢？民中險些有人和你的妻同寢，把我們陷在罪裏。」
verses.e: Abimelech said , " What is this you have done to us ? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife , and you would have brought guilt on us ! "

verses.z: 於是亞比米勒曉諭眾民說：「凡沾着這個人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。」
verses.e: Abimelech commanded all the people , saying , " He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death . "

verses.z: 以撒在那地耕種，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和華賜福給他，
verses.e: Isaac sowed in that land , and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted . The LORD blessed him .

verses.z: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富戶。
verses.e: The man grew great , and grew more and more until he became very great .

verses.z: 他有羊群牛群，又有許多僕人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
verses.e: He had possessions of flocks , possessions of herds , and a great household . The Philistines envied him .

verses.z: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世的日子，他父親的僕人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填滿了土。
verses.e: Now all the wells which his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father , the Philistines had stopped , and filled with earth .

verses.z: 亞比米勒對以撒說：「你離開我們去吧。因為你比我們強盛得多。」
verses.e: Abimelech said to Isaac , " Go away from us , for you are much mightier than we . "

verses.z: 以撒就離開那裏，在基拉耳谷支搭帳棚，住在那裏。
verses.e: Isaac departed from there , encamped in the valley of Gerar , and lived there .

verses.z: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亞伯拉罕死後塞住了，以撒就重新挖出來，仍照他父親所叫的叫那些井的名字。
verses.e: Isaac dug again the wells of water , which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father , for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham . He called their names after the names by which his father had called them .

verses.z: 以撒的僕人在谷中挖[井]，便得了一口活水井。
verses.e: Isaac's servants dug in the valley , and found there a well of flowing water .

verses.z: 耶和華向以撒顯現，說：「你不要下埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地。
verses.e: The LORD appeared to him , and said , " Don't go down into Egypt . Live in the land I will tell you about .

verses.z: 基拉耳的牧人與以撒的牧人爭競，說：「這水是我們的。」以撒就給那井起名叫埃色，因為他們和他相爭。
verses.e: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac's herdsmen , saying , " The water is ours . " So he called the name of the well Esek , because they contended with him .

verses.z: 以撒的僕人又挖了一口井，他們又為這井爭競，因此以撒給這井起名叫西提拿。
verses.e: They dug another well , and they argued over that , also . So he called its name Sitnah .

verses.z: 以撒離開那裏，又挖了一口井，他們不為這井爭競了，他就給那井起名叫利河伯。他說：「耶和華現在給我們寬闊之地，我們必在這地昌盛。」
verses.e: He left that place , and dug another well . They didn't argue over that one . So he called it Rehoboth . He said , " For now the LORD has made room for us , and we will be fruitful in the land . "

verses.z: 以撒從那裏上別是巴去。
verses.e: He went up from there to Beersheba .

verses.z: 當夜耶和華向他顯現，說：「我是你父親亞伯拉罕的上帝，不要懼怕！因為我與你同在，要賜福給你，並要為我僕人亞伯拉罕的緣故，使你的後裔繁多。」
verses.e: The LORD appeared to him the same night , and said , " I am the God of Abraham your father . Don't be afraid , for I am with you , and will bless you , and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham's sake . "

verses.z: 以撒就在那裏築了一座壇，求告耶和華的名，並且支搭帳棚；他的僕人便在那裏挖了一口井。
verses.e: He built an altar there , and called on the LORD's name , and pitched his tent there . There Isaac's servants dug a well .

verses.z: 亞比米勒，同他的朋友亞戶撒和他的軍長非各，從基拉耳來見以撒。
verses.e: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend , and Phicol the captain of his army .

verses.z: 以撒對他們說：「你們既然恨我，打發我走了，為甚麼到我這裏來呢？」
verses.e: Isaac said to them , " Why have you come to me , since you hate me , and have sent me away from you ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「我們明明地看見耶和華與你同在，便說，不如我們兩下彼此起誓，彼此立約，
verses.e: They said , " We saw plainly that the LORD was with you . We said , ' Let there now be an oath between us , even between us and you , and let's make a covenant with you ,

verses.z: 使你不害我們，正如我們未曾害你，一味地厚待你，並且打發你平平安安地走。你是蒙耶和華賜福的了。」
verses.e: that you will do us no harm , as we have not touched you , and as we have done to you nothing but good , and have sent you away in peace . ' You are now the blessed of the LORD . "

verses.z: 你寄居在這地，我必與你同在，賜福給你，因為我要將這些地都賜給你和你的後裔。我必堅定我向你父亞伯拉罕所起的誓。
verses.e: Live in this land , and I will be with you , and will bless you . For I will give to you , and to your offspring , all these lands , and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father .

verses.z: 以撒就為他們設擺筵席，他們便吃了喝了。
verses.e: He made them a feast , and they ate and drank .

verses.z: 他們清早起來彼此起誓。以撒打發他們走，他們就平平安安地離開他走了。
verses.e: They rose up some time in the morning , and swore an oath to one another . Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .

verses.z: 那一天，以撒的僕人來，將挖井的事告訴他說：「我們得了水了。」
verses.e: The same day , Isaac's servants came , and told him concerning the well which they had dug , and said to him , " We have found water . "

verses.z: 他就給那井起名叫示巴；因此那城叫做別是巴，直到今日。
verses.e: He called it " Shibah " . Therefore the name of the city is " Beersheba " to this day .

verses.z: 以掃四十歲的時候娶了赫人比利的女兒猶滴，與赫人以倫的女兒巴實抹為妻。
verses.e: When Esau was forty years old , he took as wife Judith , the daughter of Beeri the Hittite , and Basemath , the daughter of Elon the Hittite .

verses.z: 她們常使以撒和利百加心裏愁煩。
verses.e: They grieved Isaac's and Rebekah's spirits .

verses.z: 我要加增你的後裔，像天上的星那樣多，又要將這些地都賜給你的後裔。並且地上萬國必因你的後裔得福－
verses.e: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky , and will give all these lands to your offspring . In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed ,

verses.z: 都因亞伯拉罕聽從我的話，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令、律例、法度。」
verses.e: because Abraham obeyed my voice , and kept my requirements , my commandments , my statutes , and my laws . "

verses.z: 以撒就住在基拉耳。
verses.e: Isaac lived in Gerar .

verses.z: 那地方的人問到他的妻子，他便說：「那是我的妹子。」原來他怕說：「是我的妻子」；[他心裏想]：「恐怕這地方的人為利百加的緣故殺我」，因為她容貌俊美。
verses.e: The men of the place asked him about his wife . He said , " She is my sister , " for he was afraid to say , " My wife " , lest , he thought , " the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah , because she is beautiful to look at . "

verses.z: 他在那裏住了許久。有一天，非利士人的王亞比米勒從窗戶裏往外觀看，見以撒和他的妻子利百加戲玩。
verses.e: When he had been there a long time , Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window , and saw , and , behold , Isaac was caressing Rebekah , his wife .

verses.z: 亞比米勒召了以撒來，對他說：「她實在是你的妻子，你怎麼說她是你的妹子？」以撒說：「我心裏想，恐怕我因她而死。」
verses.e: Abimelech called Isaac , and said , " Behold , surely she is your wife . Why did you say , ' She is my sister ' ? " Isaac said to him , " Because I said , ' Lest I die because of her . ' "

verses.z: 以撒年老，眼睛昏花，不能看見，就叫了他大兒子以掃來，說：「我兒。」以掃說：「我在這裏。」
verses.e: When Isaac was old , and his eyes were dim , so that he could not see , he called Esau his elder son , and said to him , " My son ? " He said to him , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 你拿到你父親那裏給他吃，使他在未死之先給你祝福。」
verses.e: You shall bring it to your father , that he may eat , so that he may bless you before his death . "

verses.z: 雅各對他母親利百加說：「我哥哥以掃渾身是有毛的，我身上是光滑的；
verses.e: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother , " Behold , Esau my brother is a hairy man , and I am a smooth man .

verses.z: 倘若我父親摸着我，必以我為欺哄人的，我就招咒詛，不得祝福。」
verses.e: What if my father touches me ? I will seem to him as a deceiver , and I would bring a curse on myself , and not a blessing . "

verses.z: 他母親對他說：「我兒，你招的咒詛歸到我身上；你只管聽我的話，去把羊羔給我拿來。」
verses.e: His mother said to him , " Let your curse be on me , my son . Only obey my voice , and go get them for me . "

verses.z: 他便去拿來，交給他母親；他母親就照他父親所愛的做成美味。
verses.e: He went , and got them , and brought them to his mother . His mother made savory food , such as his father loved .

verses.z: 利百加又把家裏所存大兒子以掃上好的衣服給她小兒子雅各穿上，
verses.e: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau , her elder son , which were with her in the house , and put them on Jacob , her younger son .

verses.z: 又用山羊羔皮包在雅各的手上和頸項的光滑處，
verses.e: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands , and on the smooth of his neck .

verses.z: 就把所做的美味和餅交在她兒子雅各的手裏。
verses.e: She gave the savory food and the bread , which she had prepared , into the hand of her son Jacob .

verses.z: 雅各到他父親那裏說：「我父親！」他說：「我在這裏。我兒，你是誰？」
verses.e: He came to his father , and said , " My father ? " He said , " Here I am . Who are you , my son ? "

verses.z: 雅各對他父親說：「我是你的長子以掃；我已照你所吩咐我的行了。請起來坐着，吃我的野味，好給我祝福。」
verses.e: Jacob said to his father , " I am Esau your firstborn . I have done what you asked me to do . Please arise , sit and eat of my venison , that your soul may bless me . "

verses.z: 他說：「我如今老了，不知道哪一天死。
verses.e: He said , " See now , I am old . I don't know the day of my death .

verses.z: 以撒對他兒子說：「我兒，你如何找得這麼快呢？」他說：「因為耶和華－你的上帝使我遇見好機會得着的。」
verses.e: Isaac said to his son , " How is it that you have found it so quickly , my son ? " He said , " Because the LORD your God gave me success . "

verses.z: 以撒對雅各說：「我兒，你近前來，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的兒子以掃不是。」
verses.e: Isaac said to Jacob , " Please come near , that I may feel you , my son , whether you are really my son Esau or not . "

verses.z: 雅各就挨近他父親以撒。以撒摸着他，說：「聲音是雅各的聲音，手卻是以掃的手。」
verses.e: Jacob went near to Isaac his father . He felt him , and said , " The voice is Jacob's voice , but the hands are the hands of Esau . "

verses.z: 以撒就辨不出他來；因為他手上有毛，像他哥哥以掃的手一樣，就給他祝福；
verses.e: He didn't recognize him , because his hands were hairy , like his brother Esau's hands . So he blessed him .

verses.z: 又說：「你真是我兒子以掃嗎？」他說：「我是。」
verses.e: He said , " Are you really my son Esau ? " He said , " I am . "

verses.z: 以撒說：「你遞給我，我好吃我兒子的野味，給你祝福。」雅各就遞給他，他便吃了，又拿酒給他，他也喝了。
verses.e: He said , " Bring it near to me , and I will eat of my son's venison , that my soul may bless you . " He brought it near to him , and he ate . He brought him wine , and he drank .

verses.z: 他父親以撒對他說：「我兒，你上前來與我親嘴。」
verses.e: His father Isaac said to him , " Come near now , and kiss me , my son . "

verses.z: 他就上前與父親親嘴。他父親一聞他衣服上的香氣，就給他祝福，說：我兒的香氣如同耶和華賜福之田地的香氣一樣。
verses.e: He came near , and kissed him . He smelled the smell of his clothing , and blessed him , and said , " Behold , the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed .

verses.z: 願上帝賜你天上的甘露，地上的肥土，並許多五穀新酒。
verses.e: God give you of the dew of the sky , of the fatness of the earth , and plenty of grain and new wine .

verses.z: 願多民事奉你，多國跪拜你。願你作你弟兄的主；你母親的兒子向你跪拜。凡咒詛你的，願他受咒詛；為你祝福的，願他蒙福。
verses.e: Let peoples serve you , and nations bow down to you . Be lord over your brothers . Let your mother's sons bow down to you . Cursed be everyone who curses you . Blessed be everyone who blesses you . "

verses.z: 現在拿你的器械，就是箭囊和弓，往田野去為我打獵，
verses.e: Now therefore , please take your weapons , your quiver and your bow , and go out to the field , and get me venison .

verses.z: 以撒為雅各祝福已畢，雅各從他父親那裏才出來，他哥哥以掃正打獵回來，
verses.e: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob , and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father , Esau his brother came in from his hunting .

verses.z: 也做了美味，拿來給他父親，說：「請父親起來，吃你兒子的野味，好給我祝福。」
verses.e: He also made savory food , and brought it to his father . He said to his father , " Let my father arise , and eat of his son's venison , that your soul may bless me . "

verses.z: 他父親以撒對他說：「你是誰？」他說：「我是你的長子以掃。」
verses.e: Isaac his father said to him , " Who are you ? " He said , " I am your son , your firstborn , Esau . "

verses.z: 以撒就大大地戰兢，說：「你未來之先，是誰得了野味拿來給我呢？我已經吃了，為他祝福；他將來也必蒙福。」
verses.e: Isaac trembled violently , and said , " Who , then , is he who has taken venison , and brought it to me , and I have eaten of all before you came , and have blessed him ? Yes , he will be blessed . "

verses.z: 以掃聽了他父親的話，就放聲痛哭，說：「我父啊，求你也為我祝福！」
verses.e: When Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry , and said to his father , " Bless me , even me also , my father . "

verses.z: 以撒說：「你兄弟已經用詭計來將你的福分奪去了。」
verses.e: He said , " Your brother came with deceit , and has taken away your blessing . "

verses.z: 以掃說：「他名雅各，豈不是正對嗎？因為他欺騙了我兩次：他從前奪了我長子的名分，你看，他現在又奪了我的福分。」以掃又說：「你沒有留下為我可祝的福嗎？」
verses.e: He said , " Isn't he rightly named Jacob ? For he has supplanted me these two times . He took away my birthright . See , now he has taken away my blessing . " He said , " Haven't you reserved a blessing for me ? "

verses.z: 以撒回答以掃說：「我已立他為你的主，使他的弟兄都給他作僕人，並賜他五穀新酒可以養生。我兒，現在我還能為你做甚麼呢？」
verses.e: Isaac answered Esau , " Behold , I have made him your lord , and all his brothers I have given to him for servants . I have sustained him with grain and new wine . What then will I do for you , my son ? "

verses.z: 以掃對他父親說：「父啊，你只有一樣可祝的福嗎？我父啊，求你也為我祝福！」以掃就放聲而哭。
verses.e: Esau said to his father , " Do you have just one blessing , my father ? Bless me , even me also , my father . " Esau lifted up his voice , and wept .

verses.z: 他父親以撒說：地上的肥土必為你所住；天上的甘露必為你所得。
verses.e: Isaac his father answered him , " Behold , your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth , and of the dew of the sky from above .

verses.z: 照我所愛的做成美味，拿來給我吃，使我在未死之先給你祝福。」
verses.e: Make me savory food , such as I love , and bring it to me , that I may eat , and that my soul may bless you before I die . "

verses.z: 你必倚靠刀劍度日，又必事奉你的兄弟；到你強盛的時候，必從你頸項上掙開他的軛。
verses.e: You will live by your sword , and you will serve your brother . It will happen , when you will break loose , that you will shake his yoke from off your neck . "

verses.z: 以掃因他父親給雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心裏說：「為我父親居喪的日子近了，到那時候，我要殺我的兄弟雅各。」
verses.e: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him . Esau said in his heart , " The days of mourning for my father are at hand . Then I will kill my brother Jacob . "

verses.z: 有人把利百加大兒子以掃的話告訴利百加，她就打發人去，叫了她小兒子雅各來，對他說：「你哥哥以掃[想要]殺你，報仇雪恨。
verses.e: The words of Esau , her elder son , were told to Rebekah . She sent and called Jacob , her younger son , and said to him , " Behold , your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you .

verses.z: 現在，我兒，你要聽我的話：起來，逃往哈蘭、我哥哥拉班那裏去，
verses.e: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice . Arise , flee to Laban , my brother , in Haran .

verses.z: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒氣消了。
verses.e: Stay with him a few days , until your brother's fury turns away —

verses.z: 你哥哥向你消了怒氣，忘了你向他所做的事，我便打發人去把你從那裏帶回來。為甚麼一日喪你們二人呢？」
verses.e: until your brother's anger turns away from you , and he forgets what you have done to him . Then I will send , and get you from there . Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day ? "

verses.z: 利百加對以撒說：「我因這赫人的女子連性命都厭煩了；倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子為妻，像這些一樣，我活着還有甚麼益處呢？」
verses.e: Rebekah said to Isaac , " I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth . If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these , of the daughters of the land , what good will my life do me ? "

verses.z: 以撒對他兒子以掃說話，利百加也聽見了。以掃往田野去打獵，要得野味帶來。
verses.e: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son . Esau went to the field to hunt for venison , and to bring it .

verses.z: 利百加就對她兒子雅各說：「我聽見你父親對你哥哥以掃說：
verses.e: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son , saying , " Behold , I heard your father speak to Esau your brother , saying ,

verses.z: 『你去把野獸帶來，做成美味給我吃，我好在未死之先，在耶和華面前給你祝福。』
verses.e: ' Bring me venison , and make me savory food , that I may eat , and bless you before the LORD before my death . '

verses.z: 現在，我兒，你要照着我所吩咐你的，聽從我的話。
verses.e: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice according to that which I command you .

verses.z: 你到羊群裏去，給我拿兩隻肥山羊羔來，我便照你父親所愛的給他做成美味。
verses.e: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there . I will make them savory food for your father , such as he loves .

verses.z: 以撒叫了雅各來，給他祝福，並囑咐他說：「你不要娶迦南的女子為妻。
verses.e: Isaac called Jacob , blessed him , and commanded him , " You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan .

verses.z: 雅各出了別是巴，向哈蘭走去；
verses.e: Jacob went out from Beersheba , and went toward Haran .

verses.z: 到了一個地方，因為太陽落了，就在那裏住宿，便拾起那地方的一塊石頭枕在頭下，在那裏躺臥睡了，
verses.e: He came to a certain place , and stayed there all night , because the sun had set . He took one of the stones of the place , and put it under his head , and lay down in that place to sleep .

verses.z: 夢見一個梯子立在地上，梯子的頭頂着天，有上帝的使者在梯子上，上去下來。
verses.e: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth , and its top reached to heaven . Behold , the angels of God were ascending and descending on it .

verses.z: 耶和華站在梯子以上，說：「我是耶和華－你祖亞伯拉罕的上帝，也是以撒的上帝；我要將你現在所躺臥之地賜給你和你的後裔。
verses.e: Behold , the LORD stood above it , and said , " I am the LORD , the God of Abraham your father , and the God of Isaac . I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring .

verses.z: 你的後裔必像地上的塵沙那樣多，必向東西南北開展；地上萬族必因你和你的後裔得福。
verses.e: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth , and you will spread abroad to the west , and to the east , and to the north , and to the south . In you and in your offspring , all the families of the earth will be blessed .

verses.z: 我也與你同在。你無論往哪裏去，我必保佑你，領你歸回這地，總不離棄你，直到我成全了向你所應許的。」
verses.e: Behold , I am with you , and will keep you , wherever you go , and will bring you again into this land . For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you . "

verses.z: 雅各睡醒了，說：「耶和華真在這裏，我竟不知道！」
verses.e: Jacob awakened out of his sleep , and he said , " Surely the LORD is in this place , and I didn't know it . "

verses.z: 就懼怕，說：「這地方何等可畏！這不是別的，乃是上帝的殿，也是天的門。」
verses.e: He was afraid , and said , " How awesome this place is ! This is none other than God's house , and this is the gate of heaven . "

verses.z: 雅各清早起來，把所枕的石頭立作柱子，澆油在上面。
verses.e: Jacob rose up early in the morning , and took the stone that he had put under his head , and set it up for a pillar , and poured oil on its top .

verses.z: 他就給那地方起名叫伯特利；但那地方起先名叫路斯。
verses.e: He called the name of that place Bethel , but the name of the city was Luz at the first .

verses.z: 你起身往巴旦‧亞蘭去，到你外祖彼土利家裏，在你母舅拉班的女兒中娶一女為妻。
verses.e: Arise , go to Paddan Aram , to the house of Bethuel your mother's father . Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban , your mother's brother .

verses.z: 雅各許願說：「上帝若與我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又給我食物吃，衣服穿，
verses.e: Jacob vowed a vow , saying , " If God will be with me , and will keep me in this way that I go , and will give me bread to eat , and clothing to put on ,

verses.z: 使我平平安安地回到我父親的家，我就必以耶和華為我的上帝。
verses.e: so that I come again to my father's house in peace , and the LORD will be my God ,

verses.z: 我所立為柱子的石頭也必作上帝的殿；凡你所賜給我的，我必將十分之一獻給你。」
verses.e: then this stone , which I have set up for a pillar , will be God's house . Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you . "

verses.z: 願全能的上帝賜福給你，使你生養眾多，成為多族，
verses.e: May God Almighty bless you , and make you fruitful , and multiply you , that you may be a company of peoples ,

verses.z: 將應許亞伯拉罕的福賜給你和你的後裔，使你承受你所寄居的地為業，就是上帝賜給亞伯拉罕的地。」
verses.e: and give you the blessing of Abraham , to you and to your offspring with you , that you may inherit the land where you travel , which God gave to Abraham . "

verses.z: 以撒打發雅各走了，他就往巴旦‧亞蘭去，到亞蘭人彼土利的兒子拉班那裏。拉班是雅各、以掃的母舅。
verses.e: Isaac sent Jacob away . He went to Paddan Aram to Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob's and Esau's mother .

verses.z: 以掃見以撒已經給雅各祝福，而且打發他往巴旦‧亞蘭去，在那裏娶妻，並見祝福的時候囑咐他說：「不要娶迦南的女子為妻」，
verses.e: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram , to take him a wife from there , and that as he blessed him he gave him a command , saying , " You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan ; "

verses.z: 又見雅各聽從父母的話往巴旦‧亞蘭去了，
verses.e: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Paddan Aram .

verses.z: 以掃就曉得他父親以撒看不中迦南的女子，
verses.e: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn't please Isaac , his father .

verses.z: 便往以實瑪利那裏去，在他二妻之外又娶了瑪哈拉為妻。她是亞伯拉罕兒子以實瑪利的女兒，尼拜約的妹子。
verses.e: So Esau went to Ishmael , and took , in addition to the wives that he had , Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael , Abraham's son , the sister of Nebaioth , to be his wife .

verses.z: 雅各起行，到了東方人之地，
verses.e: Then Jacob went on his journey , and came to the land of the children of the east .

verses.z: 雅各看見母舅拉班的女兒拉結和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石頭轉離井口，飲他母舅拉班的羊群。
verses.e: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban , his mother's brother , and the sheep of Laban , his mother's brother , Jacob went near , and rolled the stone from the well's mouth , and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother .

verses.z: 雅各與拉結親嘴，就放聲而哭。
verses.e: Jacob kissed Rachel , and lifted up his voice , and wept .

verses.z: 雅各告訴拉結，自己是她父親的外甥，是利百加的兒子，拉結就跑去告訴她父親。
verses.e: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's relative , and that he was Rebekah's son . She ran and told her father .

verses.z: 拉班聽見外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱着他，與他親嘴，領他到自己的家。雅各將一切的情由告訴拉班。
verses.e: When Laban heard the news of Jacob , his sister's son , he ran to meet Jacob , and embraced him , and kissed him , and brought him to his house . Jacob told Laban all these things .

verses.z: 拉班對他說：「你實在是我的骨肉。」雅各就和他同住了一個月。
verses.e: Laban said to him , " Surely you are my bone and my flesh . " Jacob stayed with him for a month .

verses.z: 拉班對雅各說：「你雖是我的骨肉，豈可白白地服事我？請告訴我，你要甚麼為工價？」
verses.e: Laban said to Jacob , " Because you are my relative , should you therefore serve me for nothing ? Tell me , what will your wages be ? "

verses.z: 拉班有兩個女兒，大的名叫利亞，小的名叫拉結。
verses.e: Laban had two daughters . The name of the elder was Leah , and the name of the younger was Rachel .

verses.z: 利亞的眼睛沒有神氣，拉結卻生得美貌俊秀。
verses.e: Leah's eyes were weak , but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive .

verses.z: 雅各愛拉結，就說：「我願為你小女兒拉結服事你七年。」
verses.e: Jacob loved Rachel . He said , " I will serve you seven years for Rachel , your younger daughter . "

verses.z: 拉班說：「我把她給你，勝似給別人，你與我同住吧！」
verses.e: Laban said , " It is better that I give her to you , than that I should give her to another man . Stay with me . "

verses.z: 看見田間有一口井，有三群羊臥在井旁；因為人飲羊群都是用那井裏的水。井口上的石頭是大的。
verses.e: He looked , and saw a well in the field , and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it . For out of that well they watered the flocks . The stone on the well's mouth was large .

verses.z: 雅各就為拉結服事了七年；他因為深愛拉結，就看這七年如同幾天。
verses.e: Jacob served seven years for Rachel . They seemed to him but a few days , for the love he had for her .

verses.z: 雅各對拉班說：「日期已經滿了，求你把我的妻子給我，我好與她同房。」
verses.e: Jacob said to Laban , " Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in to her . "

verses.z: 拉班就擺設筵席，請齊了那地方的眾人。
verses.e: Laban gathered together all the men of the place , and made a feast .

verses.z: 到晚上，拉班將女兒利亞送來給雅各，雅各就與她同房。
verses.e: In the evening , he took Leah his daughter , and brought her to Jacob . He went in to her .

verses.z: 拉班又將婢女悉帕給女兒利亞作使女。
verses.e: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant .

verses.z: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亞，就對拉班說：「你向我做的是甚麼事呢？我服事你，不是為拉結嗎？你為甚麼欺哄我呢？」
verses.e: In the morning , behold , it was Leah ! He said to Laban , " What is this you have done to me ? Didn't I serve with you for Rachel ? Why then have you deceived me ? "

verses.z: 拉班說：「大女兒還沒有給人，先把小女兒給人，在我們這地方沒有這規矩。
verses.e: Laban said , " It is not done so in our place , to give the younger before the firstborn .

verses.z: 你為這個滿了七日，我就把那個也給你，你再為她服事我七年。」
verses.e: Fulfill the week of this one , and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years . "

verses.z: 雅各就如此行。滿了利亞的七日，拉班便將女兒拉結給雅各為妻。
verses.e: Jacob did so , and fulfilled her week . He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife .

verses.z: 拉班又將婢女辟拉給女兒拉結作使女。
verses.e: Laban gave Bilhah , his servant , to his daughter Rachel to be her servant .

verses.z: 常有羊群在那裏聚集，牧人把石頭轉離井口飲羊，隨後又把石頭放在井口的原處。
verses.e: There all the flocks were gathered . They rolled the stone from the well's mouth , and watered the sheep , and put the stone back on the well's mouth in its place .

verses.z: 雅各也與拉結同房，並且愛拉結勝似愛利亞，於是又服事了拉班七年。
verses.e: He went in also to Rachel , and he loved also Rachel more than Leah , and served with him seven more years .

verses.z: 耶和華見利亞失寵，就使她生育，拉結卻不生育。
verses.e: The LORD saw that Leah was hated , and he opened her womb , but Rachel was barren .

verses.z: 利亞懷孕生子，就給他起名叫呂便，因而說：「耶和華看見我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必愛我。」
verses.e: Leah conceived , and bore a son , and she named him Reuben . For she said , " Because the LORD has looked at my affliction ; for now my husband will love me . "

verses.z: 她又懷孕生子，就說：「耶和華因為聽見我失寵，所以又賜給我這個兒子」，於是給他起名叫西緬。
verses.e: She conceived again , and bore a son , and said , " Because the LORD has heard that I am hated , he has therefore given me this son also . " She named him Simeon .

verses.z: 她又懷孕生子，起名叫利未，說：「我給丈夫生了三個兒子，他必與我聯合。」
verses.e: She conceived again , and bore a son . She said , " Now this time my husband will be joined to me , because I have borne him three sons . " Therefore his name was called Levi .

verses.z: 她又懷孕生子，說：「這回我要讚美耶和華」，因此給他起名叫猶大。這才停了生育。
verses.e: She conceived again , and bore a son . She said , " This time I will praise the LORD . " Therefore she named him Judah . Then she stopped bearing .

verses.z: 雅各對牧人說：「弟兄們，你們是哪裏來的？」他們說：「我們是哈蘭來的。」
verses.e: Jacob said to them , " My relatives , where are you from ? " They said , " We are from Haran . "
