verses.z: 他問他們說：「拿鶴的孫子拉班，你們認識嗎？」他們說：「我們認識。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Do you know Laban , the son of Nahor ? " They said , " We know him . "

verses.z: 雅各說：「他平安嗎？」他們說：「平安。看哪，他女兒拉結領着羊來了。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Is it well with him ? " They said , " It is well . See , Rachel , his daughter , is coming with the sheep . "

verses.z: 雅各說：「日頭還高，不是羊群聚集的時候，你們不如飲羊，再去放一放。」
verses.e: He said , " Behold , it is still the middle of the day , not time to gather the livestock together . Water the sheep , and go and feed them . "

verses.z: 他們說：「我們不能，必等羊群聚齊，人把石頭轉離井口才可飲羊。」
verses.e: They said , " We can't , until all the flocks are gathered together , and they roll the stone from the well's mouth . Then we will water the sheep . "

verses.z: 雅各正和他們說話的時候，拉結領着她父親的羊來了，因為那些羊是她牧放的。
verses.e: While he was yet speaking with them , Rachel came with her father's sheep , for she kept them .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝所造的，惟有蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。蛇對女人說：「上帝豈是真說不許你們吃園中所有樹上的果子嗎？」
verses.e: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made . He said to the woman , " Has God really said , ' You shall not eat of any tree of the garden ' ? "

verses.z: 他說：「我在園中聽見你的聲音，我就害怕；因為我赤身露體，我便藏了。」
verses.e: The man said , " I heard your voice in the garden , and I was afraid , because I was naked ; so I hid myself . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「誰告訴你赤身露體呢？莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那樹上的果子嗎？」
verses.e: God said , " Who told you that you were naked ? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from ? "

verses.z: 那人說：「你所賜給我、與我同居的女人，她把那樹上的果子給我，我就吃了。」
verses.e: The man said , " The woman whom you gave to be with me , she gave me fruit from the tree , and I ate it . "

verses.z: 耶和華上帝對女人說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」女人說：「那蛇引誘我，我就吃了。」
verses.e: The LORD God said to the woman , " What have you done ? " The woman said , " The serpent deceived me , and I ate . "

verses.z: 耶和華上帝對蛇說：你既做了這事，就必受咒詛，比一切的牲畜野獸更甚；你必用肚子行走，終身吃土。
verses.e: The LORD God said to the serpent , " Because you have done this , you are cursed above all livestock , and above every animal of the field . You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life .

verses.z: 我又要叫你和女人彼此為仇；你的後裔和女人的後裔也彼此為仇。女人的後裔要傷你的頭；你要傷他的腳跟。
verses.e: I will put hostility between you and the woman , and between your offspring and her offspring . He will bruise your head , and you will bruise his heel . "

verses.z: 又對女人說：我必多多加增你懷胎的苦楚；你生產兒女必多受苦楚。你必戀慕你丈夫；你丈夫必管轄你。
verses.e: To the woman he said , " I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth . You will bear children in pain . Your desire will be for your husband , and he will rule over you . "

verses.z: 又對亞當說：你既聽從妻子的話，吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那樹上的果子，地必為你的緣故受咒詛；你必終身勞苦才能從地裏得吃的。
verses.e: To Adam he said , " Because you have listened to your wife's voice , and have eaten from the tree , about which I commanded you , saying , ' You shall not eat of it , ' the ground is cursed for your sake . You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life .

verses.z: 地必給你長出荊棘和蒺藜來；你也要吃田間的菜蔬。
verses.e: It will yield thorns and thistles to you ; and you will eat the herb of the field .

verses.z: 你必汗流滿面才得糊口，直到你歸了土，因為你是從土而出的。你本是塵土，仍要歸於塵土。
verses.e: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground , for you were taken out of it . For you are dust , and you shall return to dust . "

verses.z: 女人對蛇說：「園中樹上的果子，我們可以吃，
verses.e: The woman said to the serpent , " We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden ,

verses.z: 亞當給他妻子起名叫夏娃，因為她是眾生之母。
verses.e: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝為亞當和他妻子用皮子做衣服給他們穿。
verses.e: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife , and clothed them .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝說：「那人已經與我們相似，能知道善惡；現在恐怕他伸手又摘生命樹的果子吃，就永遠活着。」
verses.e: The LORD God said , " Behold , the man has become like one of us , knowing good and evil . Now , lest he reach out his hand , and also take of the tree of life , and eat , and live forever — "

verses.z: 耶和華上帝便打發他出伊甸園去，耕種他所自出之土。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden , to till the ground from which he was taken .

verses.z: 於是把他趕出去了；又在伊甸園的東邊安設基路伯和四面轉動發火焰的劍，要把守生命樹的道路。
verses.e: So he drove out the man ; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden , and a flaming sword which turned every way , to guard the way to the tree of life .

verses.z: 惟有園當中那棵樹上的果子，上帝曾說：『你們不可吃，也不可摸，免得你們死。』」
verses.e: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden . God has said , ' You shall not eat of it . You shall not touch it , lest you die . ' "

verses.z: 蛇對女人說：「你們不一定死；
verses.e: The serpent said to the woman , " You won't really die ,

verses.z: 因為上帝知道，你們吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你們便如上帝能知道善惡。」
verses.e: for God knows that in the day you eat it , your eyes will be opened , and you will be like God , knowing good and evil . "

verses.z: 於是女人見那棵樹[的果子]好作食物，也悅人的眼目，且是可喜愛的，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子來吃了，又給她丈夫，她丈夫也吃了。
verses.e: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food , and that it was a delight to the eyes , and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise , she took some of its fruit , and ate . Then she gave some to her husband with her , and he ate it , too .

verses.z: 他們二人的眼睛就明亮了，才知道自己是赤身露體，便拿無花果樹的葉子為自己編做裙子。
verses.e: Their eyes were opened , and they both knew that they were naked . They sewed fig leaves together , and made coverings for themselves .

verses.z: 天起了涼風，耶和華上帝在園中行走。那人和他妻子聽見上帝的聲音，就藏在園裏的樹木中，躲避耶和華上帝的面。
verses.e: They heard the LORD God's voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day , and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝呼喚那人，對他說：「你在哪裏？」
verses.e: The LORD God called to the man , and said to him , " Where are you ? "

verses.z: 拉結見自己不給雅各生子，就嫉妒她姊姊，對雅各說：「你給我孩子，不然我就死了。」
verses.e: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children , Rachel envied her sister . She said to Jacob , " Give me children , or else I will die . "

verses.z: 利亞的使女悉帕給雅各生了一個兒子。
verses.e: Zilpah , Leah's servant , bore Jacob a son .

verses.z: 利亞說：「萬幸！」於是給他起名叫迦得。
verses.e: Leah said , " How fortunate ! " She named him Gad .

verses.z: 利亞的使女悉帕又給雅各生了第二個兒子。
verses.e: Zilpah , Leah's servant , bore Jacob a second son .

verses.z: 利亞說：「我有福啊，眾女子都要稱我是有福的」，於是給他起名叫亞設。
verses.e: Leah said , " Happy am I , for the daughters will call me happy . " She named him Asher .

verses.z: 割麥子的時候，呂便往田裏去，尋見風茄，拿來給他母親利亞。拉結對利亞說：「請你把你兒子的風茄給我些。」
verses.e: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them to his mother , Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , " Please give me some of your son's mandrakes . "

verses.z: 利亞說：「你奪了我的丈夫還算小事嗎？你又要奪我兒子的風茄嗎？」拉結說：「為你兒子的風茄，今夜他可以與你同寢。」
verses.e: Leah said to her , " Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband ? Would you take away my son's mandrakes , also ? " Rachel said , " Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son's mandrakes . "

verses.z: 到了晚上，雅各從田裏回來，利亞出來迎接他，說：「你要與我同寢，因為我實在用我兒子的風茄把你雇下了。」那一夜，雅各就與她同寢。
verses.e: Jacob came from the field in the evening , and Leah went out to meet him , and said , " You must come in to me ; for I have surely hired you with my son's mandrakes . " He lay with her that night .

verses.z: 上帝應允了利亞，她就懷孕，給雅各生了第五個兒子。
verses.e: God listened to Leah , and she conceived , and bore Jacob a fifth son .

verses.z: 利亞說：「上帝給了我價值，因為我把使女給了我丈夫」，於是給他起名叫以薩迦。
verses.e: Leah said , " God has given me my hire , because I gave my servant to my husband . " She named him Issachar .

verses.z: 利亞又懷孕，給雅各生了第六個兒子。
verses.e: Leah conceived again , and bore a sixth son to Jacob .

verses.z: 雅各向拉結生氣，說：「叫你不生育的是上帝，我豈能代替他[作主]呢？」
verses.e: Jacob's anger burned against Rachel , and he said , " Am I in God's place , who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb ? "

verses.z: 利亞說：「上帝賜我厚賞；我丈夫必與我同住，因我給他生了六個兒子」，於是給他起名西布倫。
verses.e: Leah said , " God has endowed me with a good dowry . Now my husband will live with me , because I have borne him six sons . " She named him Zebulun .

verses.z: 後來又生了一個女兒，給她起名叫底拿。
verses.e: Afterwards , she bore a daughter , and named her Dinah .

verses.z: 上帝顧念拉結，應允了她，使她能生育。
verses.e: God remembered Rachel , and God listened to her , and opened her womb .

verses.z: 拉結懷孕生子，說：「上帝除去了我的羞恥」，
verses.e: She conceived , bore a son , and said , " God has taken away my reproach . "

verses.z: 就給他起名叫約瑟，意思說：「願耶和華再增添我一個兒子。」
verses.e: She named him Joseph , saying , " May the LORD add another son to me . "

verses.z: 拉結生約瑟之後，雅各對拉班說：「請打發我走，叫我回到我本鄉本土去。
verses.e: When Rachel had borne Joseph , Jacob said to Laban , " Send me away , that I may go to my own place , and to my country .

verses.z: 請你把我服事你所得的妻子和兒女給我，讓我走；我怎樣服事你，你都知道。」
verses.e: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you , and let me go ; for you know my service with which I have served you . "

verses.z: 拉班對他說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，請你[仍與我同住]，[因為]我已算定，耶和華賜福與我是為你的緣故」；
verses.e: Laban said to him , " If now I have found favor in your eyes , stay here , for I have divined that the LORD has blessed me for your sake . "

verses.z: 又說：「請你定你的工價，我就給你。」
verses.e: He said , " Appoint me your wages , and I will give it . "

verses.z: 雅各對他說：「我怎樣服事你，你的牲畜在我手裏怎樣，是你知道的。
verses.e: Jacob said to him , " You know how I have served you , and how your livestock have fared with me .

verses.z: 拉結說：「有我的使女辟拉在這裏，你可以與她同房，使她生子在我膝下，我便因她也得孩子。」
verses.e: She said , " Behold , my maid Bilhah . Go in to her , that she may bear on my knees , and I also may obtain children by her . "

verses.z: 我未來之先，你所有的很少，現今卻發大眾多，耶和華隨我的腳步賜福與你。如今，我甚麼時候才為自己興家立業呢？」
verses.e: For it was little which you had before I came , and it has increased to a multitude . The LORD has blessed you wherever I turned . Now when will I provide for my own house also ? "

verses.z: 拉班說：「我當給你甚麼呢？」雅各說：「甚麼你也不必給我，只有一件事，你若應承，我便仍舊牧放你的羊群。
verses.e: Laban said , " What shall I give you ? " Jacob said , " You shall not give me anything . If you will do this thing for me , I will again feed your flock and keep it .

verses.z: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把綿羊中凡有點的、有斑的，和黑色的，並山羊中凡有斑的、有點的，都挑出來；將來[這一等的]就算我的工價。
verses.e: I will pass through all your flock today , removing from there every speckled and spotted one , and every black one among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats . This will be my hire .

verses.z: 以後你來查看我的工價，凡在我手裏的山羊不是有點有斑的，綿羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的；這樣便可證出我的公義來。」
verses.e: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter , when you come concerning my hire that is before you . Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats , and black among the sheep , that might be with me , will be considered stolen . "

verses.z: 拉班說：「好啊！我情願照着你的話行。」
verses.e: Laban said , " Behold , let it be according to your word . "

verses.z: 當日，拉班把有紋的、有斑的公山羊，有點的、有斑的、有雜白紋的母山羊，並黑色的綿羊，都挑出來，交在他兒子們的手下，
verses.e: That day , he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted , and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted , every one that had white in it , and all the black ones among the sheep , and gave them into the hand of his sons .

verses.z: 又使自己和雅各相離三天的路程。雅各就牧養拉班其餘的羊。
verses.e: He set three days ' journey between himself and Jacob , and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks .

verses.z: 雅各拿楊樹、杏樹、楓樹的嫩枝，將皮剝成白紋，使枝子露出白的來，
verses.e: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar , almond , and plane tree , peeled white streaks in them , and made the white appear which was in the rods .

verses.z: 將剝了皮的枝子，對着羊群，插在飲羊的水溝裏和水槽裏，羊來喝的時候，牝牡配合。
verses.e: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink . They conceived when they came to drink .

verses.z: 羊對着枝子配合，就生下有紋的、有點的、有斑的來。
verses.e: The flocks conceived before the rods , and the flocks produced streaked , speckled , and spotted .

verses.z: 拉結就把她的使女辟拉給丈夫為妾；雅各便與她同房，
verses.e: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife , and Jacob went in to her .

verses.z: 雅各把羊羔分出來，使拉班的羊與這有紋和黑色的羊相對，把自己的羊另放一處，不叫他和拉班的羊混雜。
verses.e: Jacob separated the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban's flock . He put his own droves apart , and didn't put them into Laban's flock .

verses.z: 到羊群肥壯配合的時候，雅各就把枝子插在水溝裏，使羊對着枝子配合。
verses.e: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived , Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs , that they might conceive among the rods ;

verses.z: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的時候就不插枝子。這樣，瘦弱的就歸拉班，肥壯的就歸雅各。
verses.e: but when the flock were feeble , he didn't put them in . So the feebler were Laban's , and the stronger Jacob's .

verses.z: 於是雅各極其發大，得了許多的羊群、僕婢、駱駝，和驢。
verses.e: The man increased exceedingly , and had large flocks , female servants and male servants , and camels and donkeys .

verses.z: 辟拉就懷孕，給雅各生了一個兒子。
verses.e: Bilhah conceived , and bore Jacob a son .

verses.z: 拉結說：「上帝伸了我的冤，也聽了我的聲音，賜我一個兒子」，因此給他起名叫但。
verses.e: Rachel said , " God has judged me , and has also heard my voice , and has given me a son . " Therefore she called his name Dan .

verses.z: 拉結的使女辟拉又懷孕，給雅各生了第二個兒子。
verses.e: Bilhah , Rachel's servant , conceived again , and bore Jacob a second son .

verses.z: 拉結說：「我與我姊姊大大相爭，並且得勝」，於是給他起名叫拿弗他利。
verses.e: Rachel said , " I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings , and have prevailed . " She named him Naphtali .

verses.z: 利亞見自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕給雅各為妾。
verses.e: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing , she took Zilpah , her servant , and gave her to Jacob as a wife .

verses.z: 雅各聽見拉班的兒子們有話說：「雅各把我們父親所有的都奪了去，並藉着我們父親的，得了這一切的榮耀。」
verses.e: Jacob heard Laban's sons ' words , saying , " Jacob has taken away all that was our father's . He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father's . "

verses.z: 羊配合的時候，我夢中舉目一看，見跳母羊的公羊都是有紋的、有點的、有花斑的。
verses.e: During mating season , I lifted up my eyes , and saw in a dream , and behold , the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked , speckled , and grizzled .

verses.z: 上帝的使者在那夢中呼叫我說：『雅各。』我說：『我在這裏。』
verses.e: The angel of God said to me in the dream , ' Jacob , ' and I said , ' Here I am . '

verses.z: 他說：『你舉目觀看，跳母羊的公羊都是有紋的、有點的、有花斑的；凡拉班向你所做的，我都看見了。
verses.e: He said , ' Now lift up your eyes , and behold , all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked , speckled , and grizzled , for I have seen all that Laban does to you .

verses.z: 我是伯特利的上帝；你在那裏[用油]澆過柱子，向我許過願。現今你起來，離開這地，回你本地去吧！』」
verses.e: I am the God of Bethel , where you anointed a pillar , where you vowed a vow to me . Now arise , get out from this land , and return to the land of your birth . ' "

verses.z: 拉結和利亞回答雅各說：「在我們父親的家裏還有我們可得的分嗎？還有我們的產業嗎？
verses.e: Rachel and Leah answered him , " Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house ?

verses.z: 我們不是被他當作外人嗎？因為他賣了我們，吞了我們的價值。
verses.e: Aren't we considered as foreigners by him ? For he has sold us , and has also used up our money .

verses.z: 上帝從我們父親所奪出來的一切財物，那就是我們和我們孩子們的。現今凡上帝所吩咐你的，你只管去行吧！」
verses.e: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children's . Now then , whatever God has said to you , do . "

verses.z: 雅各起來，使他的兒子和妻子都騎上駱駝，
verses.e: Then Jacob rose up , and set his sons and his wives on the camels ,

verses.z: 又帶着他在巴旦‧亞蘭所得的一切牲畜和財物，往迦南地、他父親以撒那裏去了。
verses.e: and he took away all his livestock , and all his possessions which he had gathered , including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram , to go to Isaac his father , to the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 當時拉班剪羊毛去了，拉結偷了他父親家中的神像。
verses.e: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep ; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's .

verses.z: 雅各見拉班的氣色向他不如從前了。
verses.e: Jacob saw the expression on Laban's face , and , behold , it was not toward him as before .

verses.z: 雅各背着亞蘭人拉班偷走了，並不告訴他，
verses.e: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian , in that he didn't tell him that he was running away .

verses.z: 就帶着所有的逃跑。他起身過大河，面向基列山行去。
verses.e: So he fled with all that he had . He rose up , passed over the River , and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead .

verses.z: 到第三日，有人告訴拉班，雅各逃跑了。
verses.e: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled .

verses.z: 拉班帶領他的眾弟兄去追趕，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。
verses.e: He took his relatives with him , and pursued him seven days ' journey . He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead .

verses.z: 夜間，上帝到亞蘭人拉班那裏，在夢中對他說：「你要小心，不可與雅各說好說歹。」
verses.e: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night , and said to him , " Be careful that you don't speak to Jacob either good or bad . "

verses.z: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帳棚；拉班和他的眾弟兄也在基列山上支搭帳棚。
verses.e: Laban caught up with Jacob . Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain , and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead .

verses.z: 拉班對雅各說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？你背着我偷走了，又把我的女兒們帶了去，如同用刀劍擄去的一般。
verses.e: Laban said to Jacob , " What have you done , that you have deceived me , and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword ?

verses.z: 你為甚麼暗暗地逃跑，偷着走，並不告訴我，叫我可以歡樂、唱歌、擊鼓、彈琴地送你回去？
verses.e: Why did you flee secretly , and deceive me , and didn't tell me , that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs , with tambourine and with harp ;

verses.z: 又不容我與外孫和女兒親嘴？你所行的真是愚昧！
verses.e: and didn't allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters ? Now you have done foolishly .

verses.z: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父親的上帝昨夜對我說：『你要小心，不可與雅各說好說歹。』
verses.e: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you , but the God of your father spoke to me last night , saying , ' Be careful that you don't speak to Jacob either good or bad . '

verses.z: 耶和華對雅各說：「你要回你祖、你父之地，到你親族那裏去，我必與你同在。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Jacob , " Return to the land of your fathers , and to your relatives , and I will be with you . "

verses.z: 現在你雖然想你父家，不得不去，為甚麼又偷了我的神像呢？」
verses.e: Now , you want to be gone , because you greatly longed for your father's house , but why have you stolen my gods ? "

verses.z: 雅各回答拉班說：「恐怕你把你的女兒從我奪去，所以我逃跑。
verses.e: Jacob answered Laban , " Because I was afraid , for I said , ' Lest you should take your daughters from me by force . '

verses.z: 至於你的神像，你在誰那裏搜出來，就不容誰存活。當着我們的眾弟兄，你認一認，在我這裏有甚麼東西是你的，就拿去。」原來雅各不知道拉結偷了那些神像。
verses.e: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live . Before our relatives , discern what is yours with me , and take it . " For Jacob didn't know that Rachel had stolen them .

verses.z: 拉班進了雅各、利亞，並兩個使女的帳棚，都沒有搜出來，就從利亞的帳棚出來，進了拉結的帳棚。
verses.e: Laban went into Jacob's tent , into Leah's tent , and into the tent of the two female servants ; but he didn't find them . He went out of Leah's tent , and entered into Rachel's tent .

verses.z: 拉結已經把神像藏在駱駝的馱簍裏，便坐在上頭。拉班摸遍了那帳棚，並沒有摸着。
verses.e: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim , put them in the camel's saddle , and sat on them . Laban felt around all the tent , but didn't find them .

verses.z: 拉結對她父親說：「現在我身上不便，不能在你面前起來，求我主不要生氣。」這樣，拉班搜尋神像，竟沒有搜出來。
verses.e: She said to her father , " Don't let my lord be angry that I can't rise up before you ; for I'm having my period . " He searched , but didn't find the teraphim .

verses.z: 雅各就發怒斥責拉班說：「我有甚麼過犯，有甚麼罪惡，你竟這樣火速地追我？
verses.e: Jacob was angry , and argued with Laban . Jacob answered Laban , " What is my trespass ? What is my sin , that you have hotly pursued me ?

verses.z: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出甚麼來呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他們在你我中間辨別辨別。
verses.e: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff , what have you found of all your household stuff ? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives , that they may judge between us two .

verses.z: 我在你家這二十年，你的母綿羊、母山羊沒有掉過胎。你群中的公羊，我沒有吃過；
verses.e: " These twenty years I have been with you . Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young , and I haven't eaten the rams of your flocks .

verses.z: 被野獸撕裂的，我沒有帶來給你，是我自己賠上。無論是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。
verses.e: That which was torn of animals , I didn't bring to you . I bore its loss . Of my hand you required it , whether stolen by day or stolen by night .

verses.z: 雅各就打發人，叫拉結和利亞到田野羊群那裏來，
verses.e: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock ,

verses.z: 我白日受盡乾熱，黑夜受盡寒霜，不得合眼睡着，我常是這樣。
verses.e: This was my situation : in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night ; and my sleep fled from my eyes .

verses.z: 我這二十年在你家裏，為你的兩個女兒服事你十四年，為你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工價。
verses.e: These twenty years I have been in your house . I served you fourteen years for your two daughters , and six years for your flock , and you have changed my wages ten times .

verses.z: 若不是我父親以撒所敬畏的上帝，就是亞伯拉罕的上帝與我同在，你如今必定打發我空手而去。上帝看見我的苦情和我的勞碌，就在昨夜責備你。」
verses.e: Unless the God of my father , the God of Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had been with me , surely now you would have sent me away empty . God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands , and rebuked you last night . "

verses.z: 拉班回答雅各說：「這女兒是我的女兒，這些孩子是我的孩子，這些羊群也是我的羊群；凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女兒並她們所生的孩子，我今日能向他們做甚麼呢？
verses.e: Laban answered Jacob , " The daughters are my daughters , the children are my children , the flocks are my flocks , and all that you see is mine ! What can I do today to these my daughters , or to their children whom they have borne ?

verses.z: 來吧！你我二人可以立約，作你我中間的證據。」
verses.e: Now come , let's make a covenant , you and I . Let it be for a witness between me and you . "

verses.z: 雅各就拿一塊石頭立作柱子，
verses.e: Jacob took a stone , and set it up for a pillar .

verses.z: 又對眾弟兄說：「你們堆聚石頭。」他們就拿石頭來堆成一堆，大家便在旁邊吃喝。
verses.e: Jacob said to his relatives , " Gather stones . " They took stones , and made a heap . They ate there by the heap .

verses.z: 拉班稱那石堆為伊迦爾‧撒哈杜他，雅各卻稱那石堆為迦累得。
verses.e: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha , but Jacob called it Galeed .

verses.z: 拉班說：「今日這石堆作你我中間的證據。」因此這地方名叫迦累得，
verses.e: Laban said , " This heap is witness between me and you today . " Therefore it was named Galeed

verses.z: 又叫米斯巴，意思說：「我們彼此離別以後，願耶和華在你我中間鑒察。
verses.e: and Mizpah , for he said , " The LORD watch between me and you , when we are absent one from another .

verses.z: 對她們說：「我看你們父親的氣色向我不如從前了；但我父親的上帝向來與我同在。
verses.e: and said to them , " I see the expression on your father's face , that it is not toward me as before ; but the God of my father has been with me .

verses.z: 你若苦待我的女兒，又在我的女兒以外另娶妻，雖沒有人知道，卻有上帝在你我中間作見證。」
verses.e: If you afflict my daughters , or if you take wives in addition to my daughters , no man is with us ; behold , God is witness between me and you . "

verses.z: 拉班又說：「你看我在你我中間所立的這石堆和柱子。
verses.e: Laban said to Jacob , " See this heap , and see the pillar , which I have set between me and you .

verses.z: 這石堆作證據，這柱子也作證據。我必不過這石堆去害你；你也不可過這石堆和柱子來害我。
verses.e: May this heap be a witness , and the pillar be a witness , that I will not pass over this heap to you , and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me , for harm .

verses.z: 但願亞伯拉罕的上帝和拿鶴的上帝，就是他們父親的上帝，在你我中間判斷。」雅各就指着他父親以撒所敬畏的[上帝]起誓，
verses.e: The God of Abraham , and the God of Nahor , the God of their father , judge between us . " Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father , Isaac .

verses.z: 又在山上獻祭，請眾弟兄來吃飯。他們吃了飯，便在山上住宿。
verses.e: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain , and called his relatives to eat bread . They ate bread , and stayed all night in the mountain .

verses.z: 拉班清早起來，與他外孫和女兒親嘴，給他們祝福，回往自己的地方去了。
verses.e: Early in the morning , Laban rose up , and kissed his sons and his daughters , and blessed them . Laban departed and returned to his place .

verses.z: 你們也知道，我盡了我的力量服事你們的父親。
verses.e: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength .

verses.z: 你們的父親欺哄我，十次改了我的工價；然而上帝不容他害我。
verses.e: Your father has deceived me , and changed my wages ten times , but God didn't allow him to hurt me .

verses.z: 他若說：『有點的歸你作工價』，羊群所生的都有點；他若說：『有紋的歸你作工價』，羊群所生的都有紋。
verses.e: If he said , ' The speckled will be your wages , ' then all the flock bore speckled . If he said , ' The streaked will be your wages , ' then all the flock bore streaked .

verses.z: 這樣，上帝把你們父親的牲畜奪來賜給我了。
verses.e: Thus God has taken away your father's livestock , and given them to me .

verses.z: 雅各仍舊行路，上帝的使者遇見他。
verses.e: Jacob went on his way , and the angels of God met him .

verses.z: 你向僕人所施的一切慈愛和誠實，我一點也不配得；我先前只拿着我的杖過這約旦河，如今我卻成了兩隊了。
verses.e: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses , and of all the truth , which you have shown to your servant ; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan ; and now I have become two companies .

verses.z: 求你救我脫離我哥哥以掃的手；因為我怕他來殺我，連妻子帶兒女一同殺了。
verses.e: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau ; for I fear him , lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children .

verses.z: 你曾說：『我必定厚待你，使你的後裔如同海邊的沙，多得不可勝數。』」
verses.e: You said , ' I will surely do you good , and make your offspring as the sand of the sea , which can't be counted because there are so many . ' "

verses.z: 當夜，雅各在那裏住宿，就從他所有的物中拿禮物要送給他哥哥以掃：
verses.e: He stayed there that night , and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau , his brother :

verses.z: 母山羊二百隻，公山羊二十隻，母綿羊二百隻，公綿羊二十隻，
verses.e: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats , two hundred ewes and twenty rams ,

verses.z: 奶崽子的駱駝三十隻－各帶着崽子，母牛四十隻，公牛十隻，母驢二十匹，驢駒十匹；
verses.e: thirty milk camels and their colts , forty cows , ten bulls , twenty female donkeys and ten foals .

verses.z: 每樣各分一群，交在僕人手下，就對僕人說：「你們要在我前頭過去，使群群相離，有空閒的地方」；
verses.e: He delivered them into the hands of his servants , every herd by itself , and said to his servants , " Pass over before me , and put a space between herd and herd . "

verses.z: 又吩咐儘先走的說：「我哥哥以掃遇見你的時候，問你說：『你是哪家的人？要往哪裏去？你前頭這些是誰的？』
verses.e: He commanded the foremost , saying , " When Esau , my brother , meets you , and asks you , saying , ' Whose are you ? Where are you going ? Whose are these before you ? '

verses.z: 你就說：『是你僕人雅各的，是送給我主以掃的禮物；他自己也在我們後邊。』」
verses.e: Then you shall say , ' They are your servant , Jacob's . It is a present sent to my lord , Esau . Behold , he also is behind us . ' "

verses.z: 又吩咐第二、第三，和一切趕群畜的人說：「你們遇見以掃的時候也要這樣對他說；
verses.e: He commanded also the second , and the third , and all that followed the herds , saying , " This is how you shall speak to Esau , when you find him .

verses.z: 雅各看見他們就說：「這是上帝的軍兵」，於是給那地方起名叫瑪哈念。
verses.e: When he saw them , Jacob said , " This is God's army . " He called the name of that place Mahanaim .

verses.z: 並且你們要說：『你僕人雅各在我們後邊。』」因雅各心裏說：「我藉着在我前頭去的禮物解他的恨，然後再見他的面，或者他容納我。」
verses.e: You shall say , ' Not only that , but behold , your servant , Jacob , is behind us . ' " For , he said , " I will appease him with the present that goes before me , and afterward I will see his face . Perhaps he will accept me . "

verses.z: 於是禮物先過去了；那夜，雅各在隊中住宿。
verses.e: So the present passed over before him , and he himself stayed that night in the camp .

verses.z: 他夜間起來，帶着兩個妻子，兩個使女，並十一個兒子，都過了雅博渡口，
verses.e: He rose up that night , and took his two wives , and his two servants , and his eleven sons , and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok .

verses.z: 先打發他們過河，又打發所有的都過去，
verses.e: He took them , and sent them over the stream , and sent over that which he had .

verses.z: 只剩下雅各一人。有一個人來和他摔跤，直到黎明。
verses.e: Jacob was left alone , and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day .

verses.z: 那人見自己勝不過他，就將他的大腿窩摸了一把，雅各的大腿窩正在摔跤的時候就扭了。
verses.e: When he saw that he didn't prevail against him , the man touched the hollow of his thigh , and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was strained as he wrestled .

verses.z: 那人說：「天黎明了，容我去吧！」雅各說：「你不給我祝福，我就不容你去。」
verses.e: The man said , " Let me go , for the day breaks . " Jacob said , " I won't let you go unless you bless me . "

verses.z: 那人說：「你名叫甚麼？」他說：「我名叫雅各。」
verses.e: He said to him , " What is your name ? " He said , " Jacob " .

verses.z: 那人說：「你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因為你與上帝與人較力，都得了勝。」
verses.e: He said , " Your name will no longer be called Jacob , but Israel ; for you have fought with God and with men , and have prevailed . "

verses.z: 雅各問他說：「請將你的名告訴我。」那人說：「何必問我的名？」於是在那裏給雅各祝福。
verses.e: Jacob asked him , " Please tell me your name . " He said , " Why is it that you ask what my name is ? " So he blessed him there .

verses.z: 雅各打發人先往西珥地去，就是以東地，見他哥哥以掃，
verses.e: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau , his brother , to the land of Seir , the field of Edom .

verses.z: 雅各便給那地方起名叫毗努伊勒，意思說：「我面對面見了上帝，我的性命仍得保全。」
verses.e: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel ; for he said , " I have seen God face to face , and my life is preserved . "

verses.z: 日頭剛出來的時候，雅各經過毗努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。
verses.e: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel , and he limped because of his thigh .

verses.z: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窩的筋，直到今日，因為那人摸了雅各大腿窩的筋。
verses.e: Therefore the children of Israel don't eat the sinew of the hip , which is on the hollow of the thigh , to this day , because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew of the hip .

verses.z: 吩咐他們說：「你們對我主以掃說：『你的僕人雅各這樣說：我在拉班那裏寄居，直到如今。
verses.e: He commanded them , saying , " This is what you shall tell my lord , Esau : ' This is what your servant , Jacob , says . I have lived as a foreigner with Laban , and stayed until now .

verses.z: 我有牛、驢、羊群、僕婢，現在打發人來報告我主，為要在你眼前蒙恩。』」
verses.e: I have cattle , donkeys , flocks , male servants , and female servants . I have sent to tell my lord , that I may find favor in your sight . ' "

verses.z: 所打發的人回到雅各那裏，說：「我們到了你哥哥以掃那裏，他帶着四百人，正迎着你來。」
verses.e: The messengers returned to Jacob , saying , " We came to your brother Esau . He is coming to meet you , and four hundred men are with him . "

verses.z: 雅各就甚懼怕，而且愁煩，便把那與他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、駱駝分做兩隊，
verses.e: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed . He divided the people who were with him , along with the flocks , the herds , and the camels , into two companies .

verses.z: 說：「以掃若來擊殺這一隊，剩下的那一隊還可以逃避。」
verses.e: He said , " If Esau comes to the one company , and strikes it , then the company which is left will escape . "

verses.z: 雅各說：「耶和華－我祖亞伯拉罕的上帝，我父親以撒的上帝啊，你曾對我說：『回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。』
verses.e: Jacob said , " God of my father Abraham , and God of my father Isaac , the LORD , who said to me , ' Return to your country , and to your relatives , and I will do you good , '

verses.z: 雅各舉目觀看，見以掃來了，後頭跟着四百人，他就把孩子們分開交給利亞、拉結，和兩個使女，
verses.e: Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , Esau was coming , and with him four hundred men . He divided the children between Leah , Rachel , and the two servants .

verses.z: 雅各說：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你從我手裏收下這禮物；因為我見了你的面，如同見了上帝的面，並且你容納了我。
verses.e: Jacob said , " Please , no , if I have now found favor in your sight , then receive my present at my hand , because I have seen your face , as one sees the face of God , and you were pleased with me .

verses.z: 求你收下我帶來給你的禮物；因為上帝恩待我，使我充足。」雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。
verses.e: Please take the gift that I brought to you , because God has dealt graciously with me , and because I have enough . " He urged him , and he took it .

verses.z: 以掃說：「我們可以起身前往，我在你前頭走。」
verses.e: Esau said , " Let's take our journey , and let's go , and I will go before you . "

verses.z: 雅各對他說：「我主知道孩子們年幼嬌嫩，牛羊也正在乳養的時候，若是催趕一天，群畜都必死了。
verses.e: Jacob said to him , " My lord knows that the children are tender , and that the flocks and herds with me have their young , and if they overdrive them one day , all the flocks will die .

verses.z: 求我主在僕人前頭走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那裏。」
verses.e: Please let my lord pass over before his servant , and I will lead on gently , according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children , until I come to my lord to Seir . "

verses.z: 以掃說：「容我把跟隨我的人留幾個在你這裏。」雅各說：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」
verses.e: Esau said , " Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me . " He said , " Why ? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord . "

verses.z: 於是，以掃當日起行，回往西珥去了。
verses.e: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir .

verses.z: 雅各就往疏割去，在那裏為自己蓋造房屋，又為牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割。
verses.e: Jacob traveled to Succoth , built himself a house , and made shelters for his livestock . Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth .

verses.z: 雅各從巴旦‧亞蘭回來的時候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示劍城，在城東支搭帳棚，
verses.e: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem , which is in the land of Canaan , when he came from Paddan Aram ; and encamped before the city .

verses.z: 就用一百塊[銀子]向示劍的父親、哈抹的子孫買了支帳棚的那塊地，
verses.e: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent , at the hand of the children of Hamor , Shechem's father , for one hundred pieces of money .

verses.z: 並且叫兩個使女和她們的孩子在前頭，利亞和她的孩子在後頭，拉結和約瑟在儘後頭。
verses.e: He put the servants and their children in front , Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph at the rear .

verses.z: 在那裏築了一座壇，起名叫伊利‧伊羅伊‧以色列。
verses.e: He erected an altar there , and called it El Elohe Israel .

verses.z: 他自己在他們前頭過去，一連七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。
verses.e: He himself passed over in front of them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .

verses.z: 以掃跑來迎接他，將他抱住，又摟着他的頸項，與他親嘴，兩個人就哭了。
verses.e: Esau ran to meet him , embraced him , fell on his neck , kissed him , and they wept .

verses.z: 以掃舉目看見婦人孩子，就說：「這些和你同行的是誰呢？」雅各說：「這些孩子是上帝施恩給你的僕人的。」
verses.e: He lifted up his eyes , and saw the women and the children ; and said , " Who are these with you ? " He said , " The children whom God has graciously given your servant . "

verses.z: 於是兩個使女和她們的孩子前來下拜；
verses.e: Then the servants came near with their children , and they bowed themselves .

verses.z: 利亞和她的孩子也前來下拜；隨後約瑟和拉結也前來下拜。
verses.e: Leah also and her children came near , and bowed themselves . After them , Joseph came near with Rachel , and they bowed themselves .

verses.z: 以掃說：「我所遇見的這些群畜是甚麼意思呢？」雅各說：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」
verses.e: Esau said , " What do you mean by all this company which I met ? " Jacob said , " To find favor in the sight of my lord . "

verses.z: 以掃說：「兄弟啊，我的已經夠了，你的仍歸你吧！」
verses.e: Esau said , " I have enough , my brother ; let that which you have be yours . "

verses.z: 利亞給雅各所生的女兒底拿出去，要見那地的女子們。
verses.e: Dinah , the daughter of Leah , whom she bore to Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .

verses.z: 你們與我們同住吧！這地都在你們面前，只管在此居住，做買賣，置產業。」
verses.e: You shall dwell with us , and the land will be before you . Live and trade in it , and get possessions in it . "

verses.z: 示劍對女兒的父親和弟兄們說：「但願我在你們眼前蒙恩，你們向我要甚麼，我必給你們。
verses.e: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers , " Let me find favor in your eyes , and whatever you will tell me I will give .

verses.z: 任憑向我要多重的聘金和禮物，我必照你們所說的給你們；只要把女子給我為妻。」
verses.e: Ask me a great amount for a dowry , and I will give whatever you ask of me , but give me the young lady as a wife . "

verses.z: 雅各的兒子們因為示劍玷污了他們的妹子底拿，就用詭詐的話回答示劍和他父親哈抹，
verses.e: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke , because he had defiled Dinah their sister ,

verses.z: 對他們說：「我們不能把我們的妹子給沒有受割禮的人為妻，因為那是我們的羞辱。
verses.e: and said to them , " We can't do this thing , to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised ; for that is a reproach to us .

verses.z: 惟有一件才可以應允：若你們所有的男丁都受割禮，和我們一樣，
verses.e: Only on this condition will we consent to you . If you will be as we are , that every male of you be circumcised ,

verses.z: 我們就把女兒給你們，也娶你們的女兒；我們便與你們同住，兩下成為一樣的人民。
verses.e: then will we give our daughters to you ; and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .

verses.z: 倘若你們不聽從我們受割禮，我們就帶着妹子走了。」
verses.e: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised , then we will take our sister , and we will be gone . "

verses.z: 哈抹和他的兒子示劍喜歡這話。
verses.e: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem , Hamor's son .

verses.z: 那少年人做這事並不遲延，因為他喜愛雅各的女兒；他在他父親家中也是人最尊重的。
verses.e: The young man didn't wait to do this thing , because he had delight in Jacob's daughter , and he was honored above all the house of his father .

verses.z: 那地的主－希未人、哈抹的兒子示劍看見她，就拉住她，與她行淫，玷辱她。
verses.e: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite , the prince of the land , saw her . He took her , lay with her , and humbled her .

verses.z: 哈抹和他兒子示劍到本城的門口，對本城的人說：
verses.e: Hamor and Shechem , his son , came to the gate of their city , and talked with the men of their city , saying ,

verses.z: 「這些人與我們和睦，不如許他們在這地居住，做買賣；這地也寬闊，足可容下他們。我們可以娶他們的女兒為妻，也可以把我們的女兒嫁給他們。
verses.e: " These men are peaceful with us . Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it . For behold , the land is large enough for them . Let's take their daughters to us for wives , and let's give them our daughters .

verses.z: 惟有一件事我們必須做，他們才肯應允和我們同住，成為一樣的人民：就是我們中間所有的男丁都要受割禮，和他們一樣。
verses.e: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us , to become one people , if every male among us is circumcised , as they are circumcised .

verses.z: 他們的群畜、貨財，和一切的牲口豈不都歸我們嗎？只要依從他們，他們就與我們同住。」
verses.e: Won't their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours ? Only let's give our consent to them , and they will dwell with us . "

verses.z: 凡從城門出入的人就都聽從哈抹和他兒子示劍的話；於是凡從城門出入的男丁都受了割禮。
verses.e: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor , and to Shechem his son ; and every male was circumcised , all who went out of the gate of his city .

verses.z: 到第三天，眾人正在疼痛的時候，雅各的兩個兒子，就是底拿的哥哥西緬和利未，各拿刀劍，趁着眾人想不到的時候來到城中，把一切男丁都殺了，
verses.e: On the third day , when they were sore , two of Jacob's sons , Simeon and Levi , Dinah's brothers , each took his sword , came upon the unsuspecting city , and killed all the males .

verses.z: 又用刀殺了哈抹和他兒子示劍，把底拿從示劍家裏帶出來就走了。
verses.e: They killed Hamor and Shechem , his son , with the edge of the sword , and took Dinah out of Shechem's house , and went away .

verses.z: 雅各的兒子們因為他們的妹子受了玷污，就來到被殺的人那裏，擄掠那城，
verses.e: Jacob's sons came on the dead , and plundered the city , because they had defiled their sister .

verses.z: 奪了他們的羊群、牛群，和驢，並城裏田間所有的；
verses.e: They took their flocks , their herds , their donkeys , that which was in the city , that which was in the field ,

verses.z: 又把他們一切貨財、孩子、婦女，並各房中所有的，都擄掠去了。
verses.e: and all their wealth . They took captive all their little ones and their wives , and took as plunder everything that was in the house .

verses.z: 示劍的心繫戀雅各的女兒底拿，喜愛這女子，甜言蜜語地安慰她。
verses.e: His soul joined to Dinah , the daughter of Jacob , and he loved the young lady , and spoke kindly to the young lady .

verses.z: 雅各對西緬和利未說：「你們連累我，使我在這地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他們必聚集來擊殺我，我和全家的人都必滅絕。」
verses.e: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , " You have troubled me , to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites . I am few in number . They will gather themselves together against me and strike me , and I will be destroyed , I and my house . "

verses.z: 他們說：「他豈可待我們的妹子如同妓女嗎？」
verses.e: They said , " Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute ? "

verses.z: 示劍對他父親哈抹說：「求你為我聘這女子為妻。」
verses.e: Shechem spoke to his father , Hamor , saying , " Get me this young lady as a wife . "

verses.z: 雅各聽見示劍玷污了他的女兒底拿。那時他的兒子們正和群畜在田野，雅各就閉口不言，等他們回來。
verses.e: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah , his daughter ; and his sons were with his livestock in the field . Jacob held his peace until they came .

verses.z: 示劍的父親哈抹出來見雅各，要和他商議。
verses.e: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him .

verses.z: 雅各的兒子們聽見這事，就從田野回來，人人忿恨，十分惱怒；因示劍在以色列家做了醜事，與雅各的女兒行淫，這本是不該做的事。
verses.e: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it . The men were grieved , and they were very angry , because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter , a thing that ought not to be done .

verses.z: 哈抹和他們商議說：「我兒子示劍的心戀慕這女子，求你們將她給我的兒子為妻。
verses.e: Hamor talked with them , saying , " The soul of my son , Shechem , longs for your daughter . Please give her to him as a wife .

verses.z: 你們與我們彼此結親；你們可以把女兒給我們，也可以娶我們的女兒。
verses.e: Make marriages with us . Give your daughters to us , and take our daughters for yourselves .

verses.z: 上帝對雅各說：「起來！上伯特利去，住在那裏；要在那裏築一座壇給上帝，就是你逃避你哥哥以掃的時候向你顯現的那位。」
verses.e: God said to Jacob , " Arise , go up to Bethel , and live there . Make there an altar to God , who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother . "

verses.z: 且對他說：「你的名原是雅各，從今以後不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。」這樣，他就改名叫以色列。
verses.e: God said to him , " Your name is Jacob . Your name shall not be Jacob any more , but your name will be Israel . " He named him Israel .

verses.z: 上帝又對他說：「我是全能的上帝；你要生養眾多，將來有一族和多國的民從你而生，又有君王從你而出。
verses.e: God said to him , " I am God Almighty . Be fruitful and multiply . A nation and a company of nations will be from you , and kings will come out of your body .

verses.z: 我所賜給亞伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要賜給你與你的後裔。」
verses.e: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac , I will give it to you , and to your offspring after you I will give the land . "

verses.z: 上帝就從那與雅各說話的地方升上去了。
verses.e: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him .

verses.z: 雅各便在那裏立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，澆油。
verses.e: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him , a pillar of stone . He poured out a drink offering on it , and poured oil on it .

verses.z: 雅各就給那地方起名叫伯特利。
verses.e: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him " Bethel " .

verses.z: 他們從伯特利起行，離以法他還有一段路程，拉結臨產甚是艱難。
verses.e: They traveled from Bethel . There was still some distance to come to Ephrath , and Rachel travailed . She had hard labor .

verses.z: 正在艱難的時候，收生婆對她說：「不要怕，你又要得一個兒子了。」
verses.e: When she was in hard labor , the midwife said to her , " Don't be afraid , for now you will have another son . "

verses.z: 她將近於死，靈魂要走的時候，就給她兒子起名叫便‧俄尼；他父親卻給他起名叫便雅憫。
verses.e: As her soul was departing ( for she died ) , she named him Benoni , but his father named him Benjamin .

verses.z: 拉結死了，葬在以法他的路旁；以法他就是伯利恆。
verses.e: Rachel died , and was buried on the way to Ephrath ( also called Bethlehem ) .

verses.z: 雅各就對他家中的人並一切與他同在的人說：「你們要除掉你們中間的外邦神，也要自潔，更換衣裳。
verses.e: Then Jacob said to his household , and to all who were with him , " Put away the foreign gods that are among you , purify yourselves , and change your garments .

verses.z: 雅各在她的墳上立了一統碑，就是拉結的墓碑，到今日還在。
verses.e: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave . The same is the Pillar of Rachel's grave to this day .

verses.z: 以色列起行前往，在以得臺那邊支搭帳棚。
verses.e: Israel traveled , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder .

verses.z: 以色列住在那地的時候，呂便去與他父親的妾辟拉同寢，以色列也聽見了。雅各共有十二個兒子。
verses.e: While Israel lived in that land , Reuben went and lay with Bilhah , his father's concubine , and Israel heard of it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve .

verses.z: 利亞所生的是雅各的長子呂便，還有西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫。
verses.e: The sons of Leah : Reuben ( Jacob's firstborn ) , Simeon , Levi , Judah , Issachar , and Zebulun .

verses.z: 拉結所生的是約瑟、便雅憫。
verses.e: The sons of Rachel : Joseph and Benjamin .

verses.z: 拉結的使女辟拉所生的是但、拿弗他利。
verses.e: The sons of Bilhah ( Rachel's servant ) : Dan and Naphtali .

verses.z: 利亞的使女悉帕所生的是迦得、亞設。這是雅各在巴旦‧亞蘭所生的兒子。
verses.e: The sons of Zilpah ( Leah's servant ) : Gad and Asher . These are the sons of Jacob , who were born to him in Paddan Aram .

verses.z: 雅各來到他父親以撒那裏，到了基列‧亞巴的幔利，乃是亞伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方；基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙。
verses.e: Jacob came to Isaac his father , to Mamre , to Kiriath Arba ( which is Hebron ) , where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners .

verses.z: 以撒共活了一百八十歲。
verses.e: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years .

verses.z: 以撒年紀老邁，日子滿足，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖那裏。他兩個兒子以掃、雅各把他埋葬了。
verses.e: Isaac gave up the spirit and died , and was gathered to his people , old and full of days . Esau and Jacob , his sons , buried him .

verses.z: 我們要起來，上伯特利去，在那裏我要築一座壇給上帝，就是在我遭難的日子應允我[的禱告]、在我行的路上保佑我的那位。」
verses.e: Let's arise , and go up to Bethel . I will make there an altar to God , who answered me in the day of my distress , and was with me on the way which I went . "

verses.z: 他們就把外邦人的神像和他們耳朵上的環子交給雅各；雅各都藏在示劍那裏的橡樹底下。
verses.e: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands , and the rings which were in their ears ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .

verses.z: 他們便起行前往。上帝使那周圍城邑的人都甚驚懼，就不追趕雅各的眾子了。
verses.e: They traveled , and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them , and they didn't pursue the sons of Jacob .

verses.z: 於是雅各和一切與他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
verses.e: So Jacob came to Luz ( that is , Bethel ) , which is in the land of Canaan , he and all the people who were with him .

verses.z: 他在那裏築了一座壇，就給那地方起名叫伊勒‧伯特利；因為他逃避他哥哥的時候，上帝在那裏向他顯現。
verses.e: He built an altar there , and called the place El Beth El ; because there God was revealed to him , when he fled from the face of his brother .

verses.z: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下邊橡樹底下；那棵樹名叫亞倫‧巴古。
verses.e: Deborah , Rebekah's nurse , died , and she was buried below Bethel under the oak ; and its name was called Allon Bacuth .

verses.z: 雅各從巴旦‧亞蘭回來，上帝又向他顯現，賜福與他，
verses.e: God appeared to Jacob again , when he came from Paddan Aram , and blessed him .

verses.z: 以掃就是以東，他的後代記在下面。
verses.e: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau ( that is , Edom ) .

verses.z: 以掃眾子的名字如下。以掃的妻子亞大生以利法；以掃的妻子巴實抹生流珥。
verses.e: these are the names of Esau's sons : Eliphaz , the son of Adah , the wife of Esau ; and Reuel , the son of Basemath , the wife of Esau .

verses.z: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯。
verses.e: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman , Omar , Zepho , and Gatam , and Kenaz .

verses.z: 亭納是以掃兒子以利法的妾；她給以利法生了亞瑪力。這是以掃的妻子亞大的子孫。
verses.e: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz , Esau's son ; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek . These are the descendants of Adah , Esau's wife .

verses.z: 流珥的兒子是拿哈、謝拉、沙瑪、米撒。這是以掃妻子巴實抹的子孫。
verses.e: These are the sons of Reuel : Nahath , Zerah , Shammah , and Mizzah . These were the descendants of Basemath , Esau's wife .

verses.z: 以掃的妻子阿何利巴瑪是祭便的孫女，亞拿的女兒；她給以掃生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。
verses.e: These were the sons of Oholibamah , the daughter of Anah , the daughter of Zibeon , Esau's wife : she bore to Esau Jeush , Jalam , and Korah .

verses.z: 以掃子孫中作族長的記在下面。以掃的長子以利法的子孫中，有提幔族長、阿抹族長、洗玻族長、基納斯族長、
verses.e: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau : the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau : chief Teman , chief Omar , chief Zepho , chief Kenaz ,

verses.z: 可拉族長、迦坦族長、亞瑪力族長。這是在以東地從以利法所出的族長，都是亞大的子孫。
verses.e: chief Korah , chief Gatam , chief Amalek . These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom . These are the sons of Adah .

verses.z: 以掃的兒子流珥的子孫中，有拿哈族長、謝拉族長、沙瑪族長、米撒族長。這是在以東地從流珥所出的族長，都是以掃妻子巴實抹的子孫。
verses.e: These are the sons of Reuel , Esau's son : chief Nahath , chief Zerah , chief Shammah , chief Mizzah . These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom . These are the sons of Basemath , Esau's wife .

verses.z: 以掃的妻子阿何利巴瑪的子孫中，有耶烏施族長、雅蘭族長、可拉族長。這是從以掃妻子，亞拿的女兒，阿何利巴瑪子孫中所出的族長。
verses.e: These are the sons of Oholibamah , Esau's wife : chief Jeush , chief Jalam , chief Korah . These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah , Esau's wife .

verses.z: 以上的族長都是以掃的子孫；以掃就是以東。
verses.e: These are the sons of Esau ( that is , Edom ) , and these are their chiefs .

verses.z: 以掃娶迦南的女子為妻，就是赫人以倫的女兒亞大和希未人祭便的孫女、亞拿的女兒阿何利巴瑪，
verses.e: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan : Adah the daughter of Elon , the Hittite ; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah , the daughter of Zibeon , the Hivite ;

verses.z: 那地原有的居民－何利人西珥的子孫記在下面：就是羅坍、朔巴、祭便、亞拿、
verses.e: These are the sons of Seir the Horite , the inhabitants of the land : Lotan , Shobal , Zibeon , Anah ,

verses.z: 底順、以察、底珊。這是從以東地的何利人西珥子孫中所出的族長。
verses.e: Dishon , Ezer , and Dishan . These are the chiefs who came of the Horites , the children of Seir in the land of Edom .

verses.z: 羅坍的兒子是何利、希幔；羅坍的妹子是亭納。
verses.e: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman . Lotan's sister was Timna .

verses.z: 朔巴的兒子是亞勒文、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示玻、阿南。
verses.e: These are the children of Shobal : Alvan , Manahath , Ebal , Shepho , and Onam .

verses.z: 祭便的兒子是亞雅、亞拿（當時在曠野放他父親祭便的驢，遇着溫泉的，就是這亞拿）。
verses.e: These are the children of Zibeon : Aiah and Anah . This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness , as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father .

verses.z: 亞拿的兒子是底順；亞拿的女兒是阿何利巴瑪。
verses.e: These are the children of Anah : Dishon and Oholibamah , the daughter of Anah .

verses.z: 底順的兒子是欣但、伊是班、益蘭、基蘭。
verses.e: These are the children of Dishon : Hemdan , Eshban , Ithran , and Cheran .

verses.z: 以察的兒子是辟罕、撒番、亞干。
verses.e: These are the children of Ezer : Bilhan , Zaavan , and Akan .

verses.z: 底珊的兒子是烏斯、亞蘭。
verses.e: These are the children of Dishan : Uz and Aran .

verses.z: 從何利人所出的族長記在下面：就是羅坍族長、朔巴族長、祭便族長、亞拿族長、
verses.e: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites : chief Lotan , chief Shobal , chief Zibeon , chief Anah ,

verses.z: 又娶了以實瑪利的女兒、尼拜約的妹子巴實抹。
verses.e: and Basemath , Ishmael's daughter , sister of Nebaioth .

verses.z: 底順族長、以察族長、底珊族長。這是從何利人所出的族長，都在西珥地，按着宗族作族長。
verses.e: chief Dishon , chief Ezer , and chief Dishan . These are the chiefs who came of the Horites , according to their chiefs in the land of Seir .

verses.z: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以東地作王的記在下面。
verses.e: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom , before any king reigned over the children of Israel .

verses.z: 比珥的兒子比拉在以東作王，他的[京]城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.e: Bela , the son of Beor , reigned in Edom . The name of his city was Dinhabah .

verses.z: 比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接續他作王。
verses.e: Bela died , and Jobab , the son of Zerah of Bozrah , reigned in his place .

verses.z: 約巴死了，提幔地的人戶珊接續他作王。
verses.e: Jobab died , and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place .

verses.z: 戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接續他作王；這哈達就是在摩押地殺敗米甸人的，他的[京]城名叫亞未得。
verses.e: Husham died , and Hadad , the son of Bedad , who struck Midian in the field of Moab , reigned in his place . The name of his city was Avith .

verses.z: 哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接續他作王。
verses.e: Hadad died , and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place .

verses.z: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接續他作王。
verses.e: Samlah died , and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river , reigned in his place .

verses.z: 掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒‧哈南接續他作王。
verses.e: Shaul died , and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place .

verses.z: 亞革波的兒子巴勒‧哈南死了，哈達接續他作王，他的[京]城名叫巴烏；他的妻子名叫米希她別，是米‧薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
verses.e: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died , and Hadar reigned in his place . The name of his city was Pau . His wife's name was Mehetabel , the daughter of Matred , the daughter of Mezahab .

verses.z: 亞大給以掃生了以利法；巴實抹生了流珥；
verses.e: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz . Basemath bore Reuel .

verses.z: 從以掃所出的族長，按着他們的宗族、住處、名字記在下面：就是亭納族長、亞勒瓦族長、耶帖族長、
verses.e: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau , according to their families , after their places , and by their names : chief Timna , chief Alvah , chief Jetheth ,

verses.z: 阿何利巴瑪族長、以拉族長、比嫩族長、
verses.e: chief Oholibamah , chief Elah , chief Pinon ,

verses.z: 基納斯族長、提幔族長、米比薩族長、
verses.e: chief Kenaz , chief Teman , chief Mibzar ,

verses.z: 瑪基疊族長、以蘭族長。這是以東人在所得為業的地上，按着他們的住處。（所有的族長都是以東人的始祖以掃的後代。）
verses.e: chief Magdiel , and chief Iram . These are the chiefs of Edom , according to their habitations in the land of their possession . This is Esau , the father of the Edomites .

verses.z: 阿何利巴瑪生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。這都是以掃的兒子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.e: Oholibamah bore Jeush , Jalam , and Korah . These are the sons of Esau , who were born to him in the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 以掃帶着他的妻子、兒女，與家中一切的人口，並他的牛羊、牲畜，和一切貨財，就是他在迦南地所得的，往別處去，離了他兄弟雅各。
verses.e: Esau took his wives , his sons , his daughters , and all the members of his household , with his livestock , all his animals , and all his possessions , which he had gathered in the land of Canaan , and went into a land away from his brother Jacob .

verses.z: 因為二人的財物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他們，所以不能同居。
verses.e: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together , and the land of their travels couldn't bear them because of their livestock .

verses.z: 於是以掃住在西珥山裏；以掃就是以東。
verses.e: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir . Esau is Edom .

verses.z: 以掃是西珥山裏以東人的始祖，他的後代記在下面。
verses.e: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir :

verses.z: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父親寄居的地。
verses.e: Jacob lived in the land of his father's travels , in the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 約瑟將這夢告訴他父親和他哥哥們，他父親就責備他說：「你做的這是甚麼夢！難道我和你母親、你弟兄果然要來俯伏在地，向你下拜嗎？」
verses.e: He told it to his father and to his brothers . His father rebuked him , and said to him , " What is this dream that you have dreamed ? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you ? "

verses.z: 他哥哥們都嫉妒他，他父親卻把這話存在心裏。
verses.e: His brothers envied him , but his father kept this saying in mind .

verses.z: 約瑟的哥哥們往示劍去放他們父親的羊。
verses.e: His brothers went to feed their father's flock in Shechem .

verses.z: 以色列對約瑟說：「你哥哥們不是在示劍放羊嗎？你來，我要打發你往他們那裏去。」約瑟說：「我在這裏。」
verses.e: Israel said to Joseph , " Aren't your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem ? Come , and I will send you to them . " He said to him , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 以色列說：「你去看看你哥哥們平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回來報信給我」；於是打發他出希伯崙谷，他就往示劍去了。
verses.e: He said to him , " Go now , see whether it is well with your brothers , and well with the flock ; and bring me word again . " So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron , and he came to Shechem .

verses.z: 有人遇見他在田野走迷了路，就問他說：「你找甚麼？」
verses.e: A certain man found him , and behold , he was wandering in the field . The man asked him , " What are you looking for ? "

verses.z: 他說：「我找我的哥哥們，求你告訴我，他們在何處放羊。」
verses.e: He said , " I am looking for my brothers . Tell me , please , where they are feeding the flock . "

verses.z: 那人說：「他們已經走了，我聽見他們說要往多坍去。」約瑟就去追趕他哥哥們，遇見他們在多坍。
verses.e: The man said , " They have left here , for I heard them say , ' Let's go to Dothan . ' " Joseph went after his brothers , and found them in Dothan .

verses.z: 他們遠遠地看見他，趁他還沒有走到跟前，大家就同謀要害死他，
verses.e: They saw him afar off , and before he came near to them , they conspired against him to kill him .

verses.z: 彼此說：「你看！那做夢的來了。
verses.e: They said to one another , " Behold , this dreamer comes .

verses.z: 雅各的記略如下。約瑟十七歲與他哥哥們一同牧羊。他是個童子，與他父親的妾辟拉、悉帕的兒子們常在一處。約瑟將他哥哥們的惡行報給他們的父親。
verses.e: This is the history of the generations of Jacob . Joseph , being seventeen years old , was feeding the flock with his brothers . He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah , his father's wives . Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father .

verses.z: 來吧！我們將他殺了，丟在一個坑裏，就說有惡獸把他吃了。我們且看他的夢將來怎麼樣。」
verses.e: Come now therefore , and let's kill him , and cast him into one of the pits , and we will say , ' An evil animal has devoured him . ' We will see what will become of his dreams . "

verses.z: 呂便聽見了，要救他脫離他們的手，說：「我們不可害他的性命」；
verses.e: Reuben heard it , and delivered him out of their hand , and said , " Let's not take his life . "

verses.z: 又說：「不可流[他的]血，可以把他丟在這野地的坑裏，不可下手害他。」呂便的意思是要救他脫離他們的手，把他歸還他的父親。
verses.e: Reuben said to them , " Shed no blood . Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness , but lay no hand on him " — that he might deliver him out of their hand , to restore him to his father .

verses.z: 約瑟到了他哥哥們那裏，他們就剝了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，
verses.e: When Joseph came to his brothers , they stripped Joseph of his tunic , the tunic of many colors that was on him ;

verses.z: 把他丟在坑裏；那坑是空的，裏頭沒有水。
verses.e: and they took him , and threw him into the pit . The pit was empty . There was no water in it .

verses.z: 他們坐下吃飯，舉目觀看，見有一夥[米甸的]以實瑪利人從基列來，用駱駝馱着香料、乳香、沒藥，要帶下埃及去。
verses.e: They sat down to eat bread , and they lifted up their eyes and looked , and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead , with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh , going to carry it down to Egypt .

verses.z: 猶大對眾弟兄說：「我們殺我們的兄弟，藏了他的血有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: Judah said to his brothers , " What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood ?

verses.z: 我們不如將他賣給以實瑪利人，不可下手害他；因為他是我們的兄弟，我們的骨肉。」眾弟兄就聽從了他。
verses.e: Come , and let's sell him to the Ishmaelites , and not let our hand be on him ; for he is our brother , our flesh . " His brothers listened to him .

verses.z: 有些米甸的商人從那裏經過，哥哥們就把約瑟從坑裏拉上來，講定二十舍客勒銀子，把約瑟賣給以實瑪利人。他們就把約瑟帶到埃及去了。
verses.e: Midianites who were merchants passed by , and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit , and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver . The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt .

verses.z: 呂便回到坑邊，見約瑟不在坑裏，就撕裂衣服，
verses.e: Reuben returned to the pit , and saw that Joseph wasn't in the pit ; and he tore his clothes .

verses.z: 以色列原來愛約瑟過於愛他的眾子，因為約瑟是他年老生的；他給約瑟做了一件彩衣。
verses.e: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children , because he was the son of his old age , and he made him a tunic of many colors .

verses.z: 回到兄弟們那裏，說：「童子沒有了。我往哪裏去才好呢？」
verses.e: He returned to his brothers , and said , " The child is no more ; and I , where will I go ? "

verses.z: 他們宰了一隻公山羊，把約瑟的那件彩衣染了血，
verses.e: They took Joseph's tunic , and killed a male goat , and dipped the tunic in the blood .

verses.z: 打發人送到他們的父親那裏，說：「我們撿了這個；請認一認是你兒子的外衣不是？」
verses.e: They took the tunic of many colors , and they brought it to their father , and said , " We have found this . Examine it , now , and see if it is your son's tunic or not . "

verses.z: 他認得，就說：「這是我兒子的外衣。有惡獸把他吃了，約瑟被撕碎了！撕碎了！」
verses.e: He recognized it , and said , " It is my son's tunic . An evil animal has devoured him . Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces . "

verses.z: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰間圍上麻布，為他兒子悲哀了多日。
verses.e: Jacob tore his clothes , and put sackcloth on his waist , and mourned for his son many days .

verses.z: 他的兒女都起來安慰他，他卻不肯受安慰，說：「我必悲哀着下陰間，到我兒子那裏。」約瑟的父親就為他哀哭。
verses.e: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him , but he refused to be comforted . He said , " For I will go down to Sheol to my son , mourning . " His father wept for him .

verses.z: 米甸人帶約瑟到埃及，把他賣給法老的內臣－護衛長波提乏。
verses.e: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh's , the captain of the guard .

verses.z: 約瑟的哥哥們見父親愛約瑟過於愛他們，就恨約瑟，不與他說和睦的話。
verses.e: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers , and they hated him , and couldn't speak peaceably to him .

verses.z: 約瑟做了一夢，告訴他哥哥們，他們就越發恨他。
verses.e: Joseph dreamed a dream , and he told it to his brothers , and they hated him all the more .

verses.z: 約瑟對他們說：「請聽我所做的夢：
verses.e: He said to them , " Please hear this dream which I have dreamed :

verses.z: 我們在田裏捆禾稼，我的捆起來站着，你們的捆來圍着我的捆下拜。」
verses.e: for behold , we were binding sheaves in the field , and behold , my sheaf arose and also stood upright ; and behold , your sheaves came around , and bowed down to my sheaf . "

verses.z: 他的哥哥們回答說：「難道你真要作我們的王嗎？難道你真要管轄我們嗎？」他們就因為他的夢和他的話越發恨他。
verses.e: His brothers asked him , " Will you indeed reign over us ? Will you indeed have dominion over us ? " They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words .

verses.z: 後來他又做了一夢，也告訴他的哥哥們說：「看哪，我又做了一夢，夢見太陽、月亮，與十一個星向我下拜。」
verses.e: He dreamed yet another dream , and told it to his brothers , and said , " Behold , I have dreamed yet another dream : and behold , the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me . "

verses.z: 那時，猶大離開他弟兄下去，到一個亞杜蘭人名叫希拉的家裏去。
verses.e: At that time , Judah went down from his brothers , and visited a certain Adullamite , whose name was Hirah .

verses.z: 俄南所做的在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華也就叫他死了。
verses.e: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD's sight , and he killed him also .

verses.z: 猶大心裏說：「恐怕示拉也死，像他兩個哥哥一樣」，就對他兒婦她瑪說：「你去，在你父親家裏守寡，等我兒子示拉長大。」她瑪就回去，住在她父親家裏。
verses.e: Then Judah said to Tamar , his daughter-in-law , " Remain a widow in your father's house , until Shelah , my son , is grown up ; " for he said , " Lest he also die , like his brothers . " Tamar went and lived in her father's house .

verses.z: 過了許久，猶大的妻子書亞的女兒死了。猶大得了安慰，就和他朋友亞杜蘭人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那裏。
verses.e: After many days , Shua's daughter , the wife of Judah , died . Judah was comforted , and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah , he and his friend Hirah , the Adullamite .

verses.z: 有人告訴她瑪說：「你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。」
verses.e: Tamar was told , " Behold , your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep . "

verses.z: 她瑪見示拉已經長大，還沒有娶她為妻，就脫了她作寡婦的衣裳，用帕子蒙着臉，又遮住身體，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城門口。
verses.e: She took off the garments of her widowhood , and covered herself with her veil , and wrapped herself , and sat in the gate of Enaim , which is on the way to Timnah ; for she saw that Shelah was grown up , and she wasn't given to him as a wife .

verses.z: 猶大看見她，以為是妓女，因為她蒙着臉。
verses.e: When Judah saw her , he thought that she was a prostitute , for she had covered her face .

verses.z: 猶大就轉到她那裏去，說：「來吧！讓我與你同寢。」他原不知道是他的兒婦。她瑪說：「你要與我同寢，把甚麼給我呢？」
verses.e: He turned to her by the way , and said , " Please come , let me come in to you , " for he didn't know that she was his daughter-in-law . She said , " What will you give me , that you may come in to me ? "

verses.z: 猶大說：「我從羊群裏取一隻山羊羔，打發人送來給你。」她瑪說：「在未送以先，你願意給我一個當頭嗎？」
verses.e: He said , " I will send you a young goat from the flock . " She said , " Will you give me a pledge , until you send it ? "

verses.z: 他說：「我給你甚麼當頭呢？」她瑪說：「你的印、你的帶子，和你手裏的杖。」猶大就給了她，與她同寢，她就從猶大懷了孕。
verses.e: He said , " What pledge will I give you ? " She said , " Your signet and your cord , and your staff that is in your hand . " He gave them to her , and came in to her , and she conceived by him .

verses.z: 她瑪起來走了，除去帕子，仍舊穿上作寡婦的衣裳。
verses.e: She arose , and went away , and put off her veil from her , and put on the garments of her widowhood .

verses.z: 猶大在那裏看見一個迦南人名叫書亞的女兒，就娶她為妻，與她同房，
verses.e: There , Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua . He took her , and went in to her .

verses.z: 猶大託他朋友亞杜蘭人送一隻山羊羔去，要從那女人手裏取回當頭來，卻找不着她，
verses.e: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend , the Adullamite , to receive the pledge from the woman's hand , but he didn't find her .

verses.z: 就問那地方的人說：「伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪裏？」他們說：「這裏並沒有妓女。」
verses.e: Then he asked the men of her place , saying , " Where is the prostitute , that was at Enaim by the road ? " They said , " There has been no prostitute here . "

verses.z: 他回去見猶大說：「我沒有找着她，並且那地方的人說：『這裏沒有妓女。』」
verses.e: He returned to Judah , and said , " I haven't found her ; and also the men of the place said , ' There has been no prostitute here . ' "

verses.z: 猶大說：「我把這山羊羔送去了，你竟找不着她。任憑她拿去吧，免得我們被羞辱。」
verses.e: Judah said , " Let her keep it , lest we be shamed . Behold , I sent this young goat , and you haven't found her . "

verses.z: 約過了三個月，有人告訴猶大說：「你的兒婦她瑪作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。」猶大說：「拉出她來，把她燒了！」
verses.e: About three months later , Judah was told , " Tamar , your daughter-in-law , has played the prostitute . Moreover , behold , she is with child by prostitution . " Judah said , " Bring her out , and let her be burned . "

verses.z: 她瑪被拉出來的時候便打發人去見她公公，對他說：「這些東西是誰的，我就是從誰懷的孕。請你認一認，這印和帶子並杖都是誰的？」
verses.e: When she was brought out , she sent to her father-in-law , saying , " I am with child by the man who owns these . " She also said , " Please discern whose these are — the signet , and the cords , and the staff . "

verses.z: 猶大承認說：「她比我更有義，因為我沒有將她給我的兒子示拉。」從此猶大不再與她同寢了。
verses.e: Judah acknowledged them , and said , " She is more righteous than I , because I didn't give her to Shelah , my son . " He knew her again no more .

verses.z: 她瑪將要生產，不料她腹裏是一對雙生。
verses.e: In the time of her travail , behold , twins were in her womb .

verses.z: 到生產的時候，一個孩子伸出一隻手來；收生婆拿紅線拴在他手上，說：「這是頭生的。」
verses.e: When she travailed , one put out a hand , and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand , saying , " This came out first . "

verses.z: 隨後這孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出來了；收生婆說：「你為甚麼搶着來呢？」因此給他起名叫法勒斯。
verses.e: As he drew back his hand , behold , his brother came out , and she said , " Why have you made a breach for yourself ? " Therefore his name was called Perez .

verses.z: 她就懷孕生了兒子，猶大給他起名叫珥。
verses.e: She conceived , and bore a son ; and he named him Er .

verses.z: 後來，他兄弟那手上有紅線的也生出來，就給他起名叫謝拉。
verses.e: Afterward his brother came out , who had the scarlet thread on his hand , and his name was called Zerah .

verses.z: 她又懷孕生了兒子，母親給他起名叫俄南。
verses.e: She conceived again , and bore a son ; and she named him Onan .

verses.z: 她復又生了兒子，給他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的時候，猶大正在基悉。
verses.e: She yet again bore a son , and named him Shelah . He was at Chezib when she bore him .

verses.z: 猶大為長子珥娶妻，名叫她瑪。
verses.e: Judah took a wife for Er , his firstborn , and her name was Tamar .

verses.z: 猶大的長子珥在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華就叫他死了。
verses.e: Er , Judah's firstborn , was wicked in the LORD's sight . So the LORD killed him .

verses.z: 猶大對俄南說：「你當與你哥哥的妻子同房，向她盡你為弟的本分，為你哥哥生子立後。」
verses.e: Judah said to Onan , " Go in to your brother's wife , and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her , and raise up offspring for your brother . "

verses.z: 俄南知道生子不歸自己，所以同房的時候便遺在地，免得給他哥哥留後。
verses.e: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn't be his ; and when he went in to his brother's wife , he spilled his semen on the ground , lest he should give offspring to his brother .

verses.z: 約瑟被帶下埃及去。有一個埃及人，是法老的內臣－護衛長波提乏，從那些帶下他來的以實瑪利人手下買了他去。
verses.e: Joseph was brought down to Egypt . Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh's , the captain of the guard , an Egyptian , bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there .

verses.z: 後來她天天和約瑟說，約瑟卻不聽從她，不與她同寢，也不和她在一處。
verses.e: As she spoke to Joseph day by day , he didn't listen to her , to lie by her , or to be with her .

verses.z: 有一天，約瑟進屋裏去辦事，家中人沒有一個在那屋裏，
verses.e: About this time , he went into the house to do his work , and there were none of the men of the house inside .

verses.z: 婦人就拉住他的衣裳，說：「你與我同寢吧！」約瑟把衣裳丟在婦人手裏，跑到外邊去了。
verses.e: She caught him by his garment , saying , " Lie with me ! " He left his garment in her hand , and ran outside .

verses.z: 婦人看見約瑟把衣裳丟在她手裏跑出去了，
verses.e: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand , and had run outside ,

verses.z: 就叫了家裏的人來，對他們說：「你們看！他帶了一個希伯來人進入我們家裏，要戲弄我們。他到我這裏來，要與我同寢，我就大聲喊叫。
verses.e: she called to the men of her house , and spoke to them , saying , " Behold , he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us . He came in to me to lie with me , and I cried with a loud voice .

verses.z: 他聽見我放聲喊起來，就把衣裳丟在我這裏，跑到外邊去了。」
verses.e: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , he left his garment by me , and ran outside . "

verses.z: 婦人把約瑟的衣裳放在自己那裏，等着他主人回家，
verses.e: She laid up his garment by her , until his master came home .

verses.z: 就對他如此如此說：「你所帶到我們這裏的那希伯來僕人進來要戲弄我，
verses.e: She spoke to him according to these words , saying , " The Hebrew servant , whom you have brought to us , came in to me to mock me ,

verses.z: 我放聲喊起來，他就把衣裳丟在我這裏，跑出去了。」
verses.e: and as I lifted up my voice and cried , he left his garment by me , and ran outside . "

verses.z: 約瑟的主人聽見他妻子對他所說的話，說「你的僕人如此如此待我」，他就生氣，
verses.e: When his master heard the words of his wife , which she spoke to him , saying , " This is what your servant did to me , " his wrath was kindled .

verses.z: 約瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和華與他同在，他就百事順利。
verses.e: The LORD was with Joseph , and he was a prosperous man . He was in the house of his master the Egyptian .

verses.z: 把約瑟下在監裏，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。於是約瑟在那裏坐監。
verses.e: Joseph's master took him , and put him into the prison , the place where the king's prisoners were bound , and he was there in custody .

verses.z: 但耶和華與約瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司獄的眼前蒙恩。
verses.e: But the LORD was with Joseph , and showed kindness to him , and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison .

verses.z: 司獄就把監裏所有的囚犯都交在約瑟的手下；他們在那裏所辦的事都是經他的手。
verses.e: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners who were in the prison . Whatever they did there , he was responsible for it .

verses.z: 凡在約瑟手下的事，司獄一概不察，因為耶和華與約瑟同在；耶和華使他所做的盡都順利。
verses.e: The keeper of the prison didn't look after anything that was under his hand , because the LORD was with him ; and that which he did , the LORD made it prosper .

verses.z: 他主人見耶和華與他同在，又見耶和華使他手裏所辦的盡都順利，
verses.e: His master saw that the LORD was with him , and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand .

verses.z: 約瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，並且主人派他管理家務，把一切所有的都交在他手裏。
verses.e: Joseph found favor in his sight . He ministered to him , and Potiphar made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .

verses.z: 自從主人派約瑟管理家務和他一切所有的，耶和華就因約瑟的緣故賜福與那埃及人的家；凡家裏和田間一切所有的都蒙耶和華賜福。
verses.e: From the time that he made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake . The LORD's blessing was on all that he had , in the house and in the field .

verses.z: 波提乏將一切所有的都交在約瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的飯，別的事一概不知。約瑟原來秀雅俊美。
verses.e: He left all that he had in Joseph's hand . He didn't concern himself with anything , except for the food which he ate . Joseph was well-built and handsome .

verses.z: 這事以後，約瑟主人的妻以目送情給約瑟，說：「你與我同寢吧！」
verses.e: After these things , his master's wife set her eyes on Joseph ; and she said , " Lie with me . "

verses.z: 約瑟不從，對他主人的妻說：「看哪，一切家務，我主人都不知道；他把所有的都交在我手裏。
verses.e: But he refused , and said to his master's wife , " Behold , my master doesn't know what is with me in the house , and he has put all that he has into my hand .

verses.z: 在這家裏沒有比我大的；並且他沒有留下一樣不交給我，只留下了你，因為你是他的妻子。我怎能作這大惡，得罪上帝呢？」
verses.e: No one is greater in this house than I am , and he has not kept back anything from me but you , because you are his wife . How then can I do this great wickedness , and sin against God ? "

verses.z: 有一日，那人和他妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就懷孕，生了該隱，便說：「耶和華使我得了一個男子。」
verses.e: The man knew Eve his wife . She conceived , and gave birth to Cain , and said , " I have gotten a man with the LORD's help . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「你做了甚麼事呢？你兄弟的血有聲音從地裏向我哀告。
verses.e: The LORD said , " What have you done ? The voice of your brother's blood cries to me from the ground .

verses.z: 地開了口，從你手裏接受你兄弟的血。現在你必從這地受咒詛。
verses.e: Now you are cursed because of the ground , which has opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand .

verses.z: 你種地，地不再給你效力；你必流離飄蕩在地上。」
verses.e: From now on , when you till the ground , it won't yield its strength to you . You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth . "

verses.z: 該隱對耶和華說：「我的刑罰太重，過於我所能當的。
verses.e: Cain said to the LORD , " My punishment is greater than I can bear .

verses.z: 你如今趕逐我離開這地，以致不見你面；我必流離飄蕩在地上，凡遇見我的必殺我。」
verses.e: Behold , you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground . I will be hidden from your face , and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth . Whoever finds me will kill me . "

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「凡殺該隱的，必遭報七倍。」耶和華就給該隱立一個記號，免得人遇見他就殺他。
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Therefore whoever slays Cain , vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold . " The LORD appointed a sign for Cain , so that anyone finding him would not strike him .

verses.z: 於是該隱離開耶和華的面，去住在伊甸東邊挪得之地。
verses.e: Cain left the LORD's presence , and lived in the land of Nod , east of Eden .

verses.z: 該隱與妻子同房，他妻子就懷孕，生了以諾。該隱建造了一座城，就按着他兒子的名將那城叫做以諾。
verses.e: Cain knew his wife . She conceived , and gave birth to Enoch . He built a city , and named the city after the name of his son , Enoch .

verses.z: 以諾生以拿；以拿生米戶雅利；米戶雅利生瑪土撒利；瑪土撒利生拉麥。
verses.e: Irad was born to Enoch . Irad became the father of Mehujael . Mehujael became the father of Methushael . Methushael became the father of Lamech .

verses.z: 拉麥娶了兩個妻：一個名叫亞大，一個名叫洗拉。
verses.e: Lamech took two wives : the name of the first one was Adah , and the name of the second one was Zillah .

verses.z: 又生了該隱的兄弟亞伯。亞伯是牧羊的；該隱是種地的。
verses.e: Again she gave birth , to Cain's brother Abel . Abel was a keeper of sheep , but Cain was a tiller of the ground .

verses.z: 亞大生雅八；雅八就是住帳棚、牧養牲畜之人的祖師。
verses.e: Adah gave birth to Jabal , who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock .

verses.z: 雅八的兄弟名叫猶八；他是一切彈琴吹簫之人的祖師。
verses.e: His brother's name was Jubal , who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe .

verses.z: 洗拉又生了土八‧該隱；他是打造各樣銅鐵利器的。土八‧該隱的妹子是拿瑪。
verses.e: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain , the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron . Tubal Cain's sister was Naamah .

verses.z: 拉麥對他兩個妻子說：亞大、洗拉，聽我的聲音；拉麥的妻子，細聽我的話語：壯年人傷我，我把他殺了；少年人損我，我把他害了。
verses.e: Lamech said to his wives , " Adah and Zillah , hear my voice . You wives of Lamech , listen to my speech , for I have slain a man for wounding me , a young man for bruising me .

verses.z: 若殺該隱，遭報七倍，殺拉麥，必遭報七十七倍。
verses.e: If Cain will be avenged seven times , truly Lamech seventy-seven times . "

verses.z: 亞當又與妻子同房，她就生了一個兒子，起名叫塞特，意思說：「上帝另給我立了一個兒子代替亞伯，因為該隱殺了他。」
verses.e: Adam knew his wife again . She gave birth to a son , and named him Seth , saying , " for God has given me another child instead of Abel , for Cain killed him . "

verses.z: 塞特也生了一個兒子，起名叫以挪士。那時候，人才求告耶和華的名。
verses.e: A son was also born to Seth , and he named him Enosh . At that time men began to call on the LORD's name .

verses.z: 有一日，該隱拿地裏的出產為供物獻給耶和華；
verses.e: As time passed , Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground .

verses.z: 亞伯也將他羊群中頭生的和羊的脂油獻上。耶和華看中了亞伯和他的供物，
verses.e: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat . The LORD respected Abel and his offering ,

verses.z: 只是看不中該隱和他的供物。該隱就大大地發怒，變了臉色。
verses.e: but he didn't respect Cain and his offering . Cain was very angry , and the expression on his face fell .

verses.z: 耶和華對該隱說：「你為甚麼發怒呢？你為甚麼變了臉色呢？
verses.e: The LORD said to Cain , " Why are you angry ? Why has the expression of your face fallen ?

verses.z: 你若行得好，豈不蒙悅納？你若行得不好，罪就伏在門前。它必戀慕你，你卻要制伏它。」
verses.e: If you do well , won't it be lifted up ? If you don't do well , sin crouches at the door . Its desire is for you , but you are to rule over it . "

verses.z: 該隱與他兄弟亞伯說話；二人正在田間。該隱起來打他兄弟亞伯，把他殺了。
verses.e: Cain said to Abel , his brother , " Let's go into the field . " While they were in the field , Cain rose up against Abel , his brother , and killed him .

verses.z: 耶和華對該隱說：「你兄弟亞伯在哪裏？」他說：「我不知道！我豈是看守我兄弟的嗎？」
verses.e: The LORD said to Cain , " Where is Abel , your brother ? " He said , " I don't know . Am I my brother's keeper ? "

verses.z: 這事以後，埃及王的酒政和膳長得罪了他們的主－埃及王，
verses.e: After these things , the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord , the king of Egypt .

verses.z: 樹上有三根枝子，好像發了芽，開了花，上頭的葡萄都成熟了。
verses.e: and in the vine were three branches . It was as though it budded , it blossomed , and its clusters produced ripe grapes .

verses.z: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄擠在法老的杯裏，將杯遞在他手中。」
verses.e: Pharaoh's cup was in my hand ; and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand . "

verses.z: 約瑟對他說：「你所做的夢是這樣解：三根枝子就是三天；
verses.e: Joseph said to him , " This is its interpretation : the three branches are three days .

verses.z: 三天之內，法老必提你出監，叫你官復原職，你仍要遞杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一樣。
verses.e: Within three more days , Pharaoh will lift up your head , and restore you to your office . You will give Pharaoh's cup into his hand , the way you did when you were his cup bearer .

verses.z: 但你得好處的時候，求你記念我，施恩與我，在法老面前提說我，救我出這監牢。
verses.e: But remember me when it is well with you . Please show kindness to me , and make mention of me to Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house .

verses.z: 我實在是從希伯來人之地被拐來的；我在這裏也沒有做過甚麼，叫他們把我下在監裏。」
verses.e: For indeed , I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews , and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon . "

verses.z: 膳長見夢解得好，就對約瑟說：「我在夢中見我頭上頂着三筐白餅；
verses.e: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said to Joseph , " I also was in my dream , and behold , three baskets of white bread were on my head .

verses.z: 極上的筐子裏有為法老烤的各樣食物，有飛鳥來吃我頭上筐子裏的食物。」
verses.e: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh , and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head . "

verses.z: 約瑟說：「你的夢是這樣解：三個筐子就是三天；
verses.e: Joseph answered , " This is its interpretation . The three baskets are three days .

verses.z: 三天之內，法老必斬斷你的頭，把你掛在木頭上，必有飛鳥來吃你身上的肉。」
verses.e: Within three more days , Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you , and will hang you on a tree ; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you . "

verses.z: 法老就惱怒酒政和膳長這二臣，
verses.e: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers , the chief cup bearer and the chief baker .

verses.z: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他為眾臣僕設擺筵席，把酒政和膳長提出監來，
verses.e: On the third day , which was Pharaoh's birthday , he made a feast for all his servants , and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants .

verses.z: 使酒政官復原職，他仍舊遞杯在法老手中；
verses.e: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again , and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand ;

verses.z: 但把膳長掛起來，正如約瑟向他們所解的話。
verses.e: but he hanged the chief baker , as Joseph had interpreted to them .

verses.z: 酒政卻不記念約瑟，竟忘了他。
verses.e: Yet the chief cup bearer didn't remember Joseph , but forgot him .

verses.z: 把他們下在護衛長府內的監裏，就是約瑟被囚的地方。
verses.e: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .

verses.z: 護衛長把他們交給約瑟，約瑟便伺候他們；他們有些日子在監裏。
verses.e: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph , and he took care of them . They stayed in prison many days .

verses.z: 被囚在監之埃及王的酒政和膳長二人同夜各做一夢，各夢都有講解。
verses.e: They both dreamed a dream , each man his dream , in one night , each man according to the interpretation of his dream , the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt , who were bound in the prison .

verses.z: 到了早晨，約瑟進到他們那裏，見他們有愁悶的樣子。
verses.e: Joseph came in to them in the morning , and saw them , and saw that they were sad .

verses.z: 他便問法老的二臣，就是與他同囚在他主人府裏的，說：「你們今日為甚麼面帶愁容呢？」
verses.e: He asked Pharaoh's officers who were with him in custody in his master's house , saying , " Why do you look so sad today ? "

verses.z: 他們對他說：「我們各人做了一夢，沒有人能解。」約瑟說：「解夢不是出於上帝嗎？請你們將夢告訴我。」
verses.e: They said to him , " We have dreamed a dream , and there is no one who can interpret it . " Joseph said to them , " Don't interpretations belong to God ? Please tell it to me . "

verses.z: 酒政便將他的夢告訴約瑟說：「我夢見在我面前有一棵葡萄樹，
verses.e: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph , and said to him , " In my dream , behold , a vine was in front of me ,

verses.z: 過了兩年，法老做夢，夢見自己站在河邊，
verses.e: At the end of two full years , Pharaoh dreamed , and behold , he stood by the river .

verses.z: 從前法老惱怒臣僕，把我和膳長下在護衛長府內的監裏。
verses.e: Pharaoh was angry with his servants , and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard , with the chief baker .

verses.z: 我們二人同夜各做一夢，各夢都有講解。
verses.e: We dreamed a dream in one night , he and I . Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream .

verses.z: 在那裏同着我們有一個希伯來的少年人，是護衛長的僕人，我們告訴他，他就把我們的夢圓解，是按着各人的夢圓解的。
verses.e: There was with us there a young man , a Hebrew , servant to the captain of the guard , and we told him , and he interpreted to us our dreams . He interpreted to each man according to his dream .

verses.z: 後來正如他給我們圓解的成就了：我官復原職，膳長被掛起來了。」
verses.e: As he interpreted to us , so it was . He restored me to my office , and he hanged him . "

verses.z: 法老遂即差人去召約瑟，他們便急忙帶他出監，他就剃頭，刮臉，換衣裳，進到法老面前。
verses.e: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph , and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon . He shaved himself , changed his clothing , and came in to Pharaoh .

verses.z: 法老對約瑟說：「我做了一夢，沒有人能解；我聽見人說，你聽了夢就能解。」
verses.e: Pharaoh said to Joseph , " I have dreamed a dream , and there is no one who can interpret it . I have heard it said of you , that when you hear a dream you can interpret it . "

verses.z: 約瑟回答法老說：「這不在乎我，上帝必將平安的話回答法老。」
verses.e: Joseph answered Pharaoh , saying , " It isn't in me . God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace . "

verses.z: 法老對約瑟說：「我夢見我站在河邊，
verses.e: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph , " In my dream , behold , I stood on the brink of the river ;

verses.z: 有七隻母牛從河裏上來，又肥壯又美好，在蘆荻中吃草。
verses.e: and behold , seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river . They fed in the marsh grass ;

verses.z: 隨後又有七隻母牛上來，又軟弱又醜陋又乾瘦，在埃及遍地，我沒有見過這樣不好的。
verses.e: and behold , seven other cattle came up after them , poor and very ugly and thin , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness .

verses.z: 有七隻母牛從河裏上來，又美好又肥壯，在蘆荻中吃[草]。
verses.e: Behold , seven cattle came up out of the river . They were sleek and fat , and they fed in the marsh grass .

verses.z: 這又乾瘦又醜陋的母牛吃盡了那以先的七隻肥母牛，
verses.e: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle ;

verses.z: 吃了以後卻看不出是吃了，那醜陋的樣子仍舊和先前一樣。我就醒了。
verses.e: and when they had eaten them up , it couldn't be known that they had eaten them , but they were still ugly , as at the beginning . So I awoke .

verses.z: 我又夢見一棵麥子，長了七個穗子，又飽滿又佳美，
verses.e: I saw in my dream , and behold , seven heads of grain came up on one stalk , full and good ;

verses.z: 隨後又長了七個穗子，枯槁細弱，被東風吹焦了。
verses.e: and behold , seven heads of grain , withered , thin , and blasted with the east wind , sprung up after them .

verses.z: 這些細弱的穗子吞了那七個佳美的穗子。我將這夢告訴了術士，卻沒有人能給我解說。」
verses.e: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain . I told it to the magicians , but there was no one who could explain it to me . "

verses.z: 約瑟對法老說：「法老的夢乃是一個。上帝已將所要做的事指示法老了。
