verses.e: Joseph said to Pharaoh , " The dream of Pharaoh is one . What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh .

verses.z: 七隻好母牛是七年，七個好穗子也是七年；這夢乃是一個。
verses.e: The seven good cattle are seven years ; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years . The dream is one .

verses.z: 那隨後上來的七隻又乾瘦又醜陋的母牛是七年，那七個虛空、被東風吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七個荒年。
verses.e: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years , and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind ; they will be seven years of famine .

verses.z: 這就是我對法老所說，上帝已將所要做的事顯明給法老了。
verses.e: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh . God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do .

verses.z: 埃及遍地必來七個大豐年，
verses.e: Behold , seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming .

verses.z: 隨後又有七隻母牛從河裏上來，又醜陋又乾瘦，與那七隻母牛一同站在河邊。
verses.e: Behold , seven other cattle came up after them out of the river , ugly and thin , and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river .

verses.z: 隨後又要來七個荒年，甚至在埃及地都忘了先前的豐收，全地必被饑荒所滅。
verses.e: Seven years of famine will arise after them , and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt . The famine will consume the land ,

verses.z: 因那以後的饑荒甚大，便不覺得先前的豐收了。
verses.e: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows ; for it will be very grievous .

verses.z: 至於法老兩回做夢，是因上帝命定這事，而且必速速成就。
verses.e: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh , because the thing is established by God , and God will shortly bring it to pass .

verses.z: 所以，法老當揀選一個有聰明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。
verses.e: " Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man , and set him over the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 法老當這樣行，又派官員管理這地。當七個豐年的時候，征收埃及地的五分之一，
verses.e: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint overseers over the land , and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt's produce in the seven plenteous years .

verses.z: 叫他們把將來豐年一切的糧食聚斂起來，積蓄五穀，收存在各城裏做食物，歸於法老的手下。
verses.e: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come , and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities , and let them keep it .

verses.z: 所積蓄的糧食可以防備埃及地將來的七個荒年，免得這地被饑荒所滅。」
verses.e: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine , which will be in the land of Egypt ; so that the land will not perish through the famine . "

verses.z: 法老和他一切臣僕都以這事為妙。
verses.e: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .

verses.z: 法老對臣僕說：「像這樣的人，有上帝的靈在他裏頭，我們豈能找得着呢？」
verses.e: Pharaoh said to his servants , " Can we find such a one as this , a man in whom is the Spirit of God ? "

verses.z: 法老對約瑟說：「上帝既將這事都指示你，可見沒有人像你這樣有聰明有智慧。
verses.e: Pharaoh said to Joseph , " Because God has shown you all of this , there is no one so discreet and wise as you .

verses.z: 這又醜陋又乾瘦的七隻母牛吃盡了那又美好又肥壯的七隻母牛。法老就醒了。
verses.e: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle . So Pharaoh awoke .

verses.z: 你可以掌管我的家；我的民都必聽從你的話。惟獨在寶座上我比你大。」
verses.e: You shall be over my house . All my people will be ruled according to your word . Only in the throne I will be greater than you . "

verses.z: 法老又對約瑟說：「我派你治理埃及全地。」
verses.e: Pharaoh said to Joseph , " Behold , I have set you over all the land of Egypt . "

verses.z: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在約瑟的手上，給他穿上細麻衣，把金鍊戴在他的頸項上，
verses.e: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand , and put it on Joseph's hand , and arrayed him in robes of fine linen , and put a gold chain about his neck .

verses.z: 又叫約瑟坐他的副車，喝道的在前呼叫說：「跪下。」這樣，法老派他治理埃及全地。
verses.e: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had . They cried before him , " Bow the knee ! " He set him over all the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 法老對約瑟說：「我是法老，在埃及全地，若沒有你的命令，不許人擅自辦事。」
verses.e: Pharaoh said to Joseph , " I am Pharaoh . Without you , no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt . "

verses.z: 法老賜名給約瑟，叫撒發那忒‧巴內亞，又將安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給他為妻。約瑟就出去巡行埃及地。
verses.e: Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphenath-Paneah . He gave him Asenath , the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife . Joseph went out over the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 約瑟見埃及王法老的時候年三十歲。他從法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。
verses.e: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt . Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh , and went throughout all the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 七個豐年之內，地的出產極豐極盛，
verses.e: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly .

verses.z: 約瑟聚斂埃及地七個豐年一切的糧食，把糧食積存在各城裏；各城周圍田地的糧食都積存在本城裏。
verses.e: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt , and laid up the food in the cities . He stored food in each city from the fields around that city .

verses.z: 約瑟積蓄五穀甚多，如同海邊的沙，無法計算，因為穀不可勝數。
verses.e: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea , very much , until he stopped counting , for it was without number .

verses.z: 他又睡着，第二回做夢，夢見一棵麥子長了七個穗子，又肥大又佳美，
verses.e: He slept and dreamed a second time ; and behold , seven heads of grain came up on one stalk , healthy and good .

verses.z: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給約瑟生了兩個兒子。
verses.e: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came , whom Asenath , the daughter of Potiphera priest of On , bore to him .

verses.z: 約瑟給長子起名叫瑪拿西，因為[他說]：「上帝使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。」
verses.e: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh , " For " , he said , " God has made me forget all my toil , and all my father's house . "

verses.z: 他給次子起名叫以法蓮，因為[他說]：「上帝使我在受苦的地方昌盛。」
verses.e: The name of the second , he called Ephraim : " For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction . "

verses.z: 埃及地的七個豐年一完，
verses.e: The seven years of plenty , that were in the land of Egypt , came to an end .

verses.z: 七個荒年就來了。正如約瑟所說的，各地都有饑荒；惟獨埃及全地有糧食。
verses.e: The seven years of famine began to come , just as Joseph had said . There was famine in all lands , but in all the land of Egypt there was bread .

verses.z: 及至埃及全地有了饑荒，眾民向法老哀求糧食，法老對他們說：「你們往約瑟那裏去，凡他所說的，你們都要做。」
verses.e: When all the land of Egypt was famished , the people cried to Pharaoh for bread , and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians , " Go to Joseph . What he says to you , do . "

verses.z: 當時饑荒遍滿天下，約瑟開了各處的倉，糶糧給埃及人；在埃及地饑荒甚大。
verses.e: The famine was over all the surface of the earth . Joseph opened all the store houses , and sold to the Egyptians . The famine was severe in the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 各地的人都往埃及去，到約瑟那裏糴糧，因為天下的饑荒甚大。
verses.e: All countries came into Egypt , to Joseph , to buy grain , because the famine was severe in all the earth .

verses.z: 隨後又長了七個穗子，又細弱又被東風吹焦了。
verses.e: Behold , seven heads of grain , thin and blasted with the east wind , sprung up after them .

verses.z: 這細弱的穗子吞了那七個又肥大又飽滿的穗子。法老醒了，不料是個夢。
verses.e: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears . Pharaoh awoke , and behold , it was a dream .

verses.z: 到了早晨，法老心裏不安，就差人召了埃及所有的術士和博士來；法老就把所做的夢告訴他們，卻沒有人能給法老圓解。
verses.e: In the morning , his spirit was troubled , and he sent and called for all of Egypt's magicians and wise men . Pharaoh told them his dreams , but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh .

verses.z: 那時酒政對法老說：「我今日想起我的罪來。
verses.e: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh , saying , " I remember my faults today .

verses.z: 雅各見埃及有糧，就對兒子們說：「你們為甚麼彼此觀望呢？
verses.e: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt , and Jacob said to his sons , " Why do you look at one another ? "

verses.z: 他們對他說：「我主啊，不是的。僕人們是糴糧來的。
verses.e: They said to him , " No , my lord , but your servants have come to buy food .

verses.z: 我們都是一個人的兒子，是誠實人；僕人們並不是奸細。」
verses.e: We are all one man's sons ; we are honest men . Your servants are not spies . "

verses.z: 約瑟說：「不然，你們必是窺探這地的虛實來的。」
verses.e: He said to them , " No , but you have come to see the nakedness of the land ! "

verses.z: 他們說：「僕人們本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一個人的兒子，頂小的現今在我們的父親那裏，有一個沒有了。」
verses.e: They said , " We , your servants , are twelve brothers , the sons of one man in the land of Canaan ; and behold , the youngest is today with our father , and one is no more . "

verses.z: 約瑟說：「我才說你們是奸細，這話實在不錯。
verses.e: Joseph said to them , " It is like I told you , saying , ' You are spies ! '

verses.z: 我指着法老的性命起誓，若是你們的小兄弟不到這裏來，你們就不得出這地方，從此就可以把你們證驗出來了。
verses.e: By this you shall be tested . By the life of Pharaoh , you shall not go out from here , unless your youngest brother comes here .

verses.z: 須要打發你們中間一個人去，把你們的兄弟帶來。至於你們，都要囚在這裏，好證驗你們的話真不真，若不真，我指着法老的性命起誓，你們一定是奸細。」
verses.e: Send one of you , and let him get your brother , and you shall be bound , that your words may be tested , whether there is truth in you , or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies . "

verses.z: 於是約瑟把他們都下在監裏三天。
verses.e: He put them all together into custody for three days .

verses.z: 到第三天，約瑟對他們說：「我是敬畏上帝的；你們照我的話行就可以存活。
verses.e: Joseph said to them the third day , " Do this , and live , for I fear God .

verses.z: 你們如果是誠實人，可以留你們中間的一個人囚在監裏，但你們可以帶着糧食回去，救你們家裏的饑荒。
verses.e: If you are honest men , then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison ; but you go , carry grain for the famine of your houses .

verses.z: 我聽見埃及有糧，你們可以下去，從那裏為我們糴些來，使我們可以存活，不至於死。」
verses.e: He said , " Behold , I have heard that there is grain in Egypt . Go down there , and buy for us from there , so that we may live , and not die . "

verses.z: 把你們的小兄弟帶到我這裏來，如此，你們的話便有證據，你們也不至於死。」他們就照樣而行。
verses.e: Bring your youngest brother to me ; so will your words be verified , and you won't die . " They did so .

verses.z: 他們彼此說：「我們在兄弟身上實在有罪。他哀求我們的時候，我們見他心裏的愁苦，卻不肯聽，所以這場苦難臨到我們身上。」
verses.e: They said to one another , " We are certainly guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the distress of his soul , when he begged us , and we wouldn't listen . Therefore this distress has come upon us . "

verses.z: 呂便說：「我豈不是對你們說過，不可傷害那孩子嗎？只是你們不肯聽，所以流他血的罪向我們追討。」
verses.e: Reuben answered them , saying , " Didn't I tell you , saying , ' Don't sin against the child , ' and you wouldn't listen ? Therefore also , behold , his blood is required . "

verses.z: 他們不知道約瑟聽得出來，因為在他們中間用通事傳話。
verses.e: They didn't know that Joseph understood them ; for there was an interpreter between them .

verses.z: 約瑟轉身退去，哭了一場，又回來對他們說話，就從他們中間挑出西緬來，在他們眼前把他捆綁。
verses.e: He turned himself away from them , and wept . Then he returned to them , and spoke to them , and took Simeon from among them , and bound him before their eyes .

verses.z: 約瑟吩咐人把糧食裝滿他們的器具，把各人的銀子歸還在各人的口袋裏，又給他們路上用的食物，人就照他的話辦了。
verses.e: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain , and to restore each man's money into his sack , and to give them food for the way . So it was done to them .

verses.z: 他們就把糧食馱在驢上，離開那裏去了。
verses.e: They loaded their donkeys with their grain , and departed from there .

verses.z: 到了住宿的地方，他們中間有一個人打開口袋，要拿料餵驢，才看見自己的銀子仍在口袋裏，
verses.e: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place , he saw his money . Behold , it was in the mouth of his sack .

verses.z: 就對弟兄們說：「我的銀子歸還了，看哪，仍在我口袋裏！」他們就提心吊膽，戰戰兢兢地彼此說：「這是上帝向我們做甚麼呢？」
verses.e: He said to his brothers , " My money is restored ! Behold , it is in my sack ! " Their hearts failed them , and they turned trembling to one another , saying , " What is this that God has done to us ? "

verses.z: 他們來到迦南地、他們的父親雅各那裏，將所遭遇的事都告訴他，說：
verses.e: They came to Jacob their father , to the land of Canaan , and told him all that had happened to them , saying ,

verses.z: 於是，約瑟的十個哥哥都下埃及糴糧去了。
verses.e: Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt .

verses.z: 「那地的主對我們說嚴厲的話，把我們當作窺探那地的奸細。
verses.e: " The man , the lord of the land , spoke roughly with us , and took us for spies of the country .

verses.z: 我們對他說：『我們是誠實人，並不是奸細。
verses.e: We said to him , ' We are honest men . We are no spies .

verses.z: 我們本是弟兄十二人，都是一個父親的兒子，有一個沒有了，頂小的如今同我們的父親在迦南地。』
verses.e: We are twelve brothers , sons of our father ; one is no more , and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan . '

verses.z: 那地的主對我們說：『若要我知道你們是誠實人，可以留下你們中間的一個人在我這裏，你們可以帶着[糧食]回去，救你們家裏的饑荒。
verses.e: The man , the lord of the land , said to us , ' By this I will know that you are honest men : leave one of your brothers with me , and take grain for the famine of your houses , and go your way .

verses.z: 把你們的小兄弟帶到我這裏來，我便知道你們不是奸細，乃是誠實人。這樣，我就把你們的弟兄交給你們，你們也可以在這地做買賣。』」
verses.e: Bring your youngest brother to me . Then I will know that you are not spies , but that you are honest men . So I will deliver your brother to you , and you shall trade in the land . ' "

verses.z: 後來他們倒口袋，不料，各人的銀包都在口袋裏；他們和父親看見銀包就都害怕。
verses.e: As they emptied their sacks , behold , each man's bundle of money was in his sack . When they and their father saw their bundles of money , they were afraid .

verses.z: 他們的父親雅各對他們說：「你們使我喪失我的兒子：約瑟沒有了，西緬也沒有了，你們又要將便雅憫帶去；這些事都歸到我身上了。」
verses.e: Jacob , their father , said to them , " You have bereaved me of my children ! Joseph is no more , Simeon is no more , and you want to take Benjamin away . All these things are against me . "

verses.z: 呂便對他父親說：「我若不帶他回來交給你，你可以殺我的兩個兒子。只管把他交在我手裏，我必帶他回來交給你。」
verses.e: Reuben spoke to his father , saying , " Kill my two sons , if I don't bring him to you . Entrust him to my care , and I will bring him to you again . "

verses.z: 雅各說：「我的兒子不可與你們一同下去；他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你們所行的路上遭害，那便是你們使我白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。」
verses.e: He said , " My son shall not go down with you ; for his brother is dead , and he only is left . If harm happens to him along the way in which you go , then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol . "

verses.z: 但約瑟的兄弟便雅憫，雅各沒有打發他和哥哥們同去，因為雅各說：「恐怕他遭害。」
verses.e: But Jacob didn't send Benjamin , Joseph's brother , with his brothers ; for he said , " Lest perhaps harm happen to him . "

verses.z: 來糴糧的人中有以色列的兒子們，因為迦南地也有饑荒。
verses.e: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came , for the famine was in the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 當時治理埃及地的是約瑟；糶糧給那地眾民的就是他。約瑟的哥哥們來了，臉伏於地，向他下拜。
verses.e: Joseph was the governor over the land . It was he who sold to all the people of the land . Joseph's brothers came , and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth .

verses.z: 約瑟看見他哥哥們，就認得他們，卻裝作生人，向他們說些嚴厲話，問他們說：「你們從哪裏來？」他們說：「我們從迦南地來糴糧。」
verses.e: Joseph saw his brothers , and he recognized them , but acted like a stranger to them , and spoke roughly with them . He said to them , " Where did you come from ? " They said , " From the land of Canaan , to buy food . "

verses.z: 約瑟認得他哥哥們，他們卻不認得他。
verses.e: Joseph recognized his brothers , but they didn't recognize him .

verses.z: 約瑟想起從前所做的那兩個夢，就對他們說：「你們是奸細，來窺探這地的虛實。」
verses.e: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them , and said to them , " You are spies ! You have come to see the nakedness of the land . "

verses.z: 那地的饑荒甚大。
verses.e: The famine was severe in the land .

verses.z: 我們若沒有耽擱，如今第二次都回來了。」
verses.e: for if we hadn't delayed , surely we would have returned a second time by now . "

verses.z: 他們的父親以色列說：「若必須如此，你們就當這樣行：可以將這地土產中最好的乳香、蜂蜜、香料、沒藥、榧子、杏仁都取一點，收在器具裏，帶下去送給那人作禮物，
verses.e: Their father , Israel , said to them , " If it must be so , then do this : Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags , and carry down a present for the man , a little balm , a little honey , spices and myrrh , nuts , and almonds ;

verses.z: 又要手裏加倍地帶銀子，並將歸還在你們口袋內的銀子仍帶在手裏；那或者是錯了。
verses.e: and take double money in your hand , and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks . Perhaps it was an oversight .

verses.z: 也帶着你們的兄弟，起身去見那人。
verses.e: Take your brother also , get up , and return to the man .

verses.z: 但願全能的上帝使你們在那人面前蒙憐憫，釋放你們的那弟兄和便雅憫回來。我若喪了兒子，就喪了吧！」
verses.e: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man , that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin . If I am bereaved of my children , I am bereaved . "

verses.z: 於是，他們拿着那禮物，又手裏加倍地帶銀子，並且帶着便雅憫，起身下到埃及，站在約瑟面前。
verses.e: The men took that present , and they took double money in their hand , and Benjamin ; and got up , went down to Egypt , and stood before Joseph .

verses.z: 約瑟見便雅憫和他們同來，就對家宰說：「將這些人領到屋裏。要宰殺牲畜，預備[筵席]，因為晌午這些人同我吃飯。」
verses.e: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them , he said to the steward of his house , " Bring the men into the house , and butcher an animal , and prepare ; for the men will dine with me at noon . "

verses.z: 家宰就遵着約瑟的命去行，領他們進約瑟的屋裏。
verses.e: The man did as Joseph commanded , and the man brought the men to Joseph's house .

verses.z: 他們因為被領到約瑟的屋裏，就害怕，說：「領我們到這裏來，必是因為頭次歸還在我們口袋裏的銀子，找我們的錯縫，下手害我們，強取我們為奴僕，搶奪我們的驢。」
verses.e: The men were afraid , because they were brought to Joseph's house ; and they said , " Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time , we're brought in ; that he may seek occasion against us , attack us , and seize us as slaves , along with our donkeys . "

verses.z: 他們就挨近約瑟的家宰，在屋門口和他說話，
verses.e: They came near to the steward of Joseph's house , and they spoke to him at the door of the house ,

verses.z: 他們從埃及帶來的糧食吃盡了，他們的父親就對他們說：「你們再去給我糴些糧來。」
verses.e: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt , their father said to them , " Go again , buy us a little more food . "

verses.z: 說：「我主啊，我們頭次下來實在是要糴糧。
verses.e: and said , " Oh , my lord , we indeed came down the first time to buy food .

verses.z: 後來到了住宿的地方，我們打開口袋，不料，各人的銀子，分量足數，仍在各人的口袋內，現在我們手裏又帶回來了。
verses.e: When we came to the lodging place , we opened our sacks , and behold , each man's money was in the mouth of his sack , our money in full weight . We have brought it back in our hand .

verses.z: 另外又帶下銀子來糴糧。不知道先前誰把銀子放在我們的口袋裏。」
verses.e: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food . We don't know who put our money in our sacks . "

verses.z: 家宰說：「你們可以放心，不要害怕，是你們的上帝和你們父親的上帝賜給你們財寶在你們的口袋裏；你們的銀子，我早已收了。」他就把西緬帶出來，交給他們。
verses.e: He said , " Peace be to you . Don't be afraid . Your God , and the God of your father , has given you treasure in your sacks . I received your money . " He brought Simeon out to them .

verses.z: 家宰就領他們進約瑟的屋裏，給他們水洗腳，又給他們草料餵驢。
verses.e: The man brought the men into Joseph's house , and gave them water , and they washed their feet . He gave their donkeys fodder .

verses.z: 他們就預備那禮物，等候約瑟晌午來，因為他們聽見要在那裏吃飯。
verses.e: They prepared the present for Joseph's coming at noon , for they heard that they should eat bread there .

verses.z: 約瑟來到家裏，他們就把手中的禮物拿進屋去給他，又俯伏在地，向他下拜。
verses.e: When Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves down to the earth before him .

verses.z: 約瑟問他們好，又問：「你們的父親－就是你們所說的那老人家平安嗎？他還在嗎？」
verses.e: He asked them of their welfare , and said , " Is your father well , the old man of whom you spoke ? Is he yet alive ? "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「你僕人－我們的父親平安；他還在。」於是他們低頭下拜。
verses.e: They said , " Your servant , our father , is well . He is still alive . " They bowed down humbly .

verses.z: 約瑟舉目看見他同母的兄弟便雅憫，就說：「你們向我所說那頂小的兄弟就是這位嗎？」又說：「小兒啊，願上帝賜恩給你！」
verses.e: He lifted up his eyes , and saw Benjamin , his brother , his mother's son , and said , " Is this your youngest brother , of whom you spoke to me ? " He said , " God be gracious to you , my son . "

verses.z: 猶大對他說：「那人諄諄地告誡我們說：『你們的兄弟若不與你們同來，你們就不得見我的面。』
verses.e: Judah spoke to him , saying , " The man solemnly warned us , saying , ' You shall not see my face , unless your brother is with you . '

verses.z: 約瑟愛弟之情發動，就急忙尋找可哭之地，進入自己的屋裏，哭了一場。
verses.e: Joseph hurried , for his heart yearned over his brother ; and he sought a place to weep . He entered into his room , and wept there .

verses.z: 他洗了臉出來，勉強隱忍，吩咐人擺飯。
verses.e: He washed his face , and came out . He controlled himself , and said , " Serve the meal . "

verses.z: 他們就為約瑟單擺了一席，為那些人又擺了一席，也為和約瑟同吃飯的埃及人另擺了一席，因為埃及人不可和希伯來人一同吃飯；那原是埃及人所厭惡的。
verses.e: They served him by himself , and them by themselves , and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves , because the Egyptians don't eat with the Hebrews , for that is an abomination to the Egyptians .

verses.z: 約瑟使眾弟兄在他面前排列坐席，都按着長幼的次序，眾弟兄就彼此詫異。
verses.e: They sat before him , the firstborn according to his birthright , and the youngest according to his youth , and the men marveled with one another .

verses.z: 約瑟把他面前的食物分出來，送給他們；但便雅憫所得的比別人多五倍。他們就飲酒，和約瑟一同宴樂。
verses.e: He sent portions to them from before him , but Benjamin's portion was five times as much as any of theirs . They drank , and were merry with him .

verses.z: 你若打發我們的兄弟與我們同去，我們就下去給你糴糧；
verses.e: If you'll send our brother with us , we'll go down and buy you food ;

verses.z: 你若不打發他去，我們就不下去，因為那人對我們說：『你們的兄弟若不與你們同來，你們就不得見我的面。』」
verses.e: but if you don't send him , we won't go down , for the man said to us , ' You shall not see my face , unless your brother is with you . ' "

verses.z: 以色列說：「你們為甚麼這樣害我，告訴那人你們還有兄弟呢？」
verses.e: Israel said , " Why did you treat me so badly , telling the man that you had another brother ? "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「那人詳細問到我們和我們的親屬，說：『你們的父親還在嗎？你們還有兄弟嗎？』我們就按着他所問的告訴他，焉能知道他要說『必須把你們的兄弟帶下來』呢？」
verses.e: They said , " The man asked directly concerning ourselves , and concerning our relatives , saying , ' Is your father still alive ? Have you another brother ? ' We just answered his questions . Is there any way we could know that he would say , ' Bring your brother down ' ? "

verses.z: 猶大又對他父親以色列說：「你打發童子與我同去，我們就起身下去，好叫我們和你，並我們的[婦人]孩子，都得存活，不至於死。
verses.e: Judah said to Israel , his father , " Send the boy with me , and we'll get up and go , so that we may live , and not die , both we , and you , and also our little ones .

verses.z: 我為他作保；你可以從我手中追討，我若不帶他回來交在你面前，我情願永遠擔罪。
verses.e: I'll be collateral for him . From my hand will you require him . If I don't bring him to you , and set him before you , then let me bear the blame forever ;

verses.z: 約瑟吩咐家宰說：「把糧食裝滿這些人的口袋，儘着他們的驢所能馱的，又把各人的銀子放在各人的口袋裏，
verses.e: He commanded the steward of his house , saying , " Fill the men's sacks with food , as much as they can carry , and put each man's money in his sack's mouth .

verses.z: 家宰說：「現在就照你們的話行吧！在誰那裏搜出來，誰就作我的奴僕；其餘的都沒有罪。」
verses.e: He said , " Now also let it be according to your words . He with whom it is found will be my slave ; and you will be blameless . "

verses.z: 於是他們各人急忙把口袋卸在地下，各人打開口袋。
verses.e: Then they hurried , and each man took his sack down to the ground , and each man opened his sack .

verses.z: 家宰就搜查，從年長的起到年幼的為止，那杯竟在便雅憫的口袋裏搜出來。
verses.e: He searched , beginning with the oldest , and ending at the youngest . The cup was found in Benjamin's sack .

verses.z: 他們就撕裂衣服，各人把馱子抬在驢上，回城去了。
verses.e: Then they tore their clothes , and each man loaded his donkey , and returned to the city .

verses.z: 猶大和他弟兄們來到約瑟的屋中，約瑟還在那裏，他們就在他面前俯伏於地。
verses.e: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house , and he was still there . They fell on the ground before him .

verses.z: 約瑟對他們說：「你們做的是甚麼事呢？你們豈不知像我這樣的人必能占卜嗎？」
verses.e: Joseph said to them , " What deed is this that you have done ? Don't you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination ? "

verses.z: 猶大說：「我們對我主說甚麼呢？還有甚麼話可說呢？我們怎能自己表白出來呢？上帝已經查出僕人的罪孽了。我們與那在他手中搜出杯來的都是我主的奴僕。」
verses.e: Judah said , " What will we tell my lord ? What will we speak ? How will we clear ourselves ? God has found out the iniquity of your servants . Behold , we are my lord's slaves , both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found . "

verses.z: 約瑟說：「我斷不能這樣行！在誰的手中搜出杯來，誰就作我的奴僕；至於你們，可以平平安安地上你們父親那裏去。」
verses.e: He said , " Far be it from me that I should do so . The man in whose hand the cup is found , he will be my slave ; but as for you , go up in peace to your father . "

verses.z: 猶大挨近他，說：「我主啊，求你容僕人說一句話給我主聽，不要向僕人發烈怒，因為你如同法老一樣。
verses.e: Then Judah came near to him , and said , " Oh , my lord , please let your servant speak a word in my lord's ears , and don't let your anger burn against your servant ; for you are even as Pharaoh .

verses.z: 我主曾問僕人們說：『你們有父親有兄弟沒有？』
verses.e: My lord asked his servants , saying , ' Have you a father , or a brother ? '

verses.z: 並將我的銀杯和那少年人糴糧的銀子一同裝在他的口袋裏。」家宰就照約瑟所說的話行了；
verses.e: Put my cup , the silver cup , in the sack's mouth of the youngest , with his grain money . " He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken .

verses.z: 我們對我主說：『我們有父親，已經年老，還有他老年所生的一個小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母親只撇下他一人，他父親疼愛他。』
verses.e: We said to my lord , ' We have a father , an old man , and a child of his old age , a little one ; and his brother is dead , and he alone is left of his mother ; and his father loves him . '

verses.z: 你對僕人說：『把他帶到我這裏來，叫我親眼看看他。』
verses.e: You said to your servants , ' Bring him down to me , that I may set my eyes on him . '

verses.z: 我們對我主說：『童子不能離開他父親，若是離開，他父親必死。』
verses.e: We said to my lord , ' The boy can't leave his father , for if he should leave his father , his father would die . '

verses.z: 你對僕人說：『你們的小兄弟若不與你們一同下來，你們就不得再見我的面。』
verses.e: You said to your servants , ' Unless your youngest brother comes down with you , you will see my face no more . '

verses.z: 我們上到你僕人－我們父親那裏，就把我主的話告訴了他。
verses.e: When we came up to your servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .

verses.z: 我們的父親說：『你們再去給我糴些糧來。』
verses.e: Our father said , ' Go again and buy us a little food . '

verses.z: 我們就說：『我們不能下去。我們的小兄弟若和我們同往，我們就可以下去。因為，小兄弟若不與我們同往，我們必不得見那人的面。』
verses.e: We said , ' We can't go down . If our youngest brother is with us , then we will go down : for we may not see the man's face , unless our youngest brother is with us . '

verses.z: 你僕人－我父親對我們說：『你們知道我的妻子給我生了兩個兒子。
verses.e: Your servant , my father , said to us , ' You know that my wife bore me two sons .

verses.z: 一個離開我出去了；我說他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也沒有見他。
verses.e: One went out from me , and I said , " Surely he is torn in pieces ; " and I haven't seen him since .

verses.z: 現在你們又要把這個帶去離開我，倘若他遭害，那便是你們使我白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。』
verses.e: If you take this one also from me , and harm happens to him , you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol . '

verses.z: 天一亮就打發那些人帶着驢走了。
verses.e: As soon as the morning was light , the men were sent away , they and their donkeys .

verses.z: 我父親的命與這童子的命相連。如今我回到你僕人－我父親那裏，若沒有童子與我們同在，
verses.e: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father , and the boy is not with us ; since his life is bound up in the boy's life ;

verses.z: 我們的父親見沒有童子，他就必死。這便是我們使你僕人－我們的父親白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。
verses.e: it will happen , when he sees that the boy is no more , that he will die . Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant , our father , with sorrow to Sheol .

verses.z: 因為僕人曾向我父親為這童子作保，說：『我若不帶他回來交給父親，我便在父親面前永遠擔罪。』
verses.e: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father , saying , ' If I don't bring him to you , then I will bear the blame to my father forever . '

verses.z: 現在求你容僕人住下，替這童子作我主的奴僕，叫童子和他哥哥們一同上去。
verses.e: Now therefore , please let your servant stay instead of the boy , my lord's slave ; and let the boy go up with his brothers .

verses.z: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去見我父親呢？恐怕我看見災禍臨到我父親身上。」
verses.e: For how will I go up to my father , if the boy isn't with me ? — lest I see the evil that will come on my father . "

verses.z: 他們出城走了不遠，約瑟對家宰說：「起來，追那些人去，追上了就對他們說：『你們為甚麼以惡報善呢？
verses.e: When they had gone out of the city , and were not yet far off , Joseph said to his steward , " Up , follow after the men . When you overtake them , ask them , ' Why have you rewarded evil for good ?

verses.z: 這不是我主人飲酒的杯嗎？豈不是他占卜用的嗎？你們這樣行是作惡了。』」
verses.e: Isn't this that from which my lord drinks , and by which he indeed divines ? You have done evil in so doing . ' "

verses.z: 家宰追上他們，將這些話對他們說了。
verses.e: He overtook them , and he spoke these words to them .

verses.z: 他們回答說：「我主為甚麼說這樣的話呢？你僕人斷不能做這樣的事。
verses.e: They said to him , " Why does my lord speak such words as these ? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing !

verses.z: 你看，我們從前在口袋裏所見的銀子，尚且從迦南地帶來還你，我們怎能從你主人家裏偷竊金銀呢？
verses.e: Behold , the money , which we found in our sacks ' mouths , we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan . How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord's house ?

verses.z: 你僕人中無論在誰那裏搜出來，就叫他死，我們也作我主的奴僕。」
verses.e: With whomever of your servants it is found , let him die , and we also will be my lord's slaves . "

verses.z: 約瑟在左右站着的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一聲說：「人都要離開我出去！」約瑟和弟兄們相認的時候並沒有一人站在他面前。
verses.e: Then Joseph couldn't control himself before all those who stood before him , and he called out , " Cause everyone to go out from me ! " No one else stood with him , while Joseph made himself known to his brothers .

verses.z: 你和你的兒子孫子，連牛群羊群，並一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，與我相近。
verses.e: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen , and you will be near to me , you , your children , your children's children , your flocks , your herds , and all that you have .

verses.z: 我要在那裏奉養你；因為還有五年的饑荒，免得你和你的眷屬，並一切所有的，都敗落了。』
verses.e: There I will provide for you ; for there are yet five years of famine ; lest you come to poverty , you , and your household , and all that you have . " '

verses.z: 況且你們的眼和我兄弟便雅憫的眼都看見是我親口對你們說話。
verses.e: Behold , your eyes see , and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , that it is my mouth that speaks to you .

verses.z: 你們也要將我在埃及一切的榮耀和你們所看見的事都告訴我父親，又要趕緊地將我父親搬到我這裏來。」
verses.e: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that you have seen . You shall hurry and bring my father down here . "

verses.z: 於是約瑟伏在他兄弟便雅憫的頸項上哭，便雅憫也在他的頸項上哭。
verses.e: He fell on his brother Benjamin's neck and wept , and Benjamin wept on his neck .

verses.z: 他又與眾弟兄親嘴，抱着他們哭，隨後他弟兄們就和他說話。
verses.e: He kissed all his brothers , and wept on them . After that his brothers talked with him .

verses.z: 這風聲傳到法老的宮裏，說：「約瑟的弟兄們來了。」法老和他的臣僕都很喜歡。
verses.e: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh's house , saying , " Joseph's brothers have come . " It pleased Pharaoh well , and his servants .

verses.z: 法老對約瑟說：「你吩咐你的弟兄們說：『你們要這樣行：把馱子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。
verses.e: Pharaoh said to Joseph , " Tell your brothers , ' Do this : Load your animals , and go , travel to the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 將你們的父親和你們的眷屬都搬到我這裏來，我要把埃及地的美物賜給你們，你們也要吃這地肥美的出產。
verses.e: Take your father and your households , and come to me , and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and you will eat the fat of the land . '

verses.z: 現在我吩咐你們要這樣行：從埃及地帶着車輛去，把你們的孩子和妻子，並你們的父親都搬來。
verses.e: Now you are commanded to do this : Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .

verses.z: 他就放聲大哭；埃及人和法老家中的人都聽見了。
verses.e: He wept aloud . The Egyptians heard , and the house of Pharaoh heard .

verses.z: 你們眼中不要愛惜你們的家具，因為埃及全地的美物都是你們的。』」
verses.e: Also , don't concern yourselves about your belongings , for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours . "

verses.z: 以色列的兒子們就如此行。約瑟照着法老的吩咐給他們車輛和路上用的食物，
verses.e: The sons of Israel did so . Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .

verses.z: 又給他們各人一套衣服，惟獨給便雅憫三百銀子，五套衣服；
verses.e: He gave each one of them changes of clothing , but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing .

verses.z: 送給他父親公驢十匹，馱着埃及的美物，母驢十匹，馱着糧食與餅和菜，為他父親路上用。
verses.e: He sent the following to his father : ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt , and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way .

verses.z: 於是約瑟打發他弟兄們回去，又對他們說：「你們不要在路上相爭。」
verses.e: So he sent his brothers away , and they departed . He said to them , " See that you don't quarrel on the way . "

verses.z: 他們從埃及上去，來到迦南地、他們的父親雅各那裏，
verses.e: They went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan , to Jacob their father .

verses.z: 告訴他說：「約瑟還在，並且作埃及全地的宰相。」雅各心裏冰涼，因為不信他們。
verses.e: They told him , saying , " Joseph is still alive , and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt . " His heart fainted , for he didn't believe them .

verses.z: 他們便將約瑟對他們說的一切話都告訴了他。他們父親雅各又看見約瑟打發來接他的車輛，心就甦醒了。
verses.e: They told him all the words of Joseph , which he had said to them . When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him , the spirit of Jacob , their father , revived .

verses.z: 以色列說：「罷了！罷了！我的兒子約瑟還在，趁我未死以先，我要去見他一面。」
verses.e: Israel said , " It is enough . Joseph my son is still alive . I will go and see him before I die . "

verses.z: 約瑟對他弟兄們說：「我是約瑟。我的父親還在嗎？」他弟兄不能回答，因為在他面前都驚惶。
verses.e: Joseph said to his brothers , " I am Joseph ! Does my father still live ? " His brothers couldn't answer him ; for they were terrified at his presence .

verses.z: 約瑟又對他弟兄們說：「請你們近前來。」他們就近前來。他說：「我是你們的兄弟約瑟，就是你們所賣到埃及的。
verses.e: Joseph said to his brothers , " Come near to me , please . " They came near . He said , " I am Joseph , your brother , whom you sold into Egypt .

verses.z: 現在，不要因為把我賣到這裏自憂自恨。這是上帝差我在你們以先來，為要保全生命。
verses.e: Now don't be grieved , nor angry with yourselves , that you sold me here , for God sent me before you to preserve life .

verses.z: 現在這地的饑荒已經二年了，還有五年不能耕種，不能收成。
verses.e: For these two years the famine has been in the land , and there are yet five years , in which there will be no plowing and no harvest .

verses.z: 上帝差我在你們以先來，為要給你們存留餘種在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你們的生命。
verses.e: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth , and to save you alive by a great deliverance .

verses.z: 這樣看來，差我到這裏來的不是你們，乃是上帝。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，並埃及全地的宰相。
verses.e: So now it wasn't you who sent me here , but God , and he has made me a father to Pharaoh , lord of all his house , and ruler over all the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 你們要趕緊上到我父親那裏，對他說：『你兒子約瑟這樣說：上帝使我作全埃及的主，請你下到我這裏來，不要耽延。
verses.e: Hurry , and go up to my father , and tell him , ' This is what your son Joseph says , " God has made me lord of all Egypt . Come down to me . Don't wait .

verses.z: 以色列帶着一切所有的，起身來到別是巴，就獻祭給他父親以撒的上帝。
verses.e: Israel traveled with all that he had , and came to Beersheba , and offered sacrifices to the God of his father , Isaac .

verses.z: 西緬的兒子是耶母利、雅憫、阿轄、雅斤、瑣轄，還有迦南女子所生的掃羅。
verses.e: The sons of Simeon : Jemuel , Jamin , Ohad , Jachin , Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman .

verses.z: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
verses.e: The sons of Levi : Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

verses.z: 猶大的兒子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯、謝拉；惟有珥與俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的兒子是希斯崙、哈母勒。
verses.e: The sons of Judah : Er , Onan , Shelah , Perez , and Zerah ; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan . The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul .

verses.z: 以薩迦的兒子是陀拉、普瓦、約伯、伸崙。
verses.e: The sons of Issachar : Tola , Puvah , Iob , and Shimron .

verses.z: 西布倫的兒子是西烈、以倫、雅利。
verses.e: The sons of Zebulun : Sered , Elon , and Jahleel .

verses.z: 這是利亞在巴旦‧亞蘭給雅各所生的兒子，還有女兒底拿。兒孫共有三十三人。
verses.e: These are the sons of Leah , whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram , with his daughter Dinah . All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three .

verses.z: 迦得的兒子是洗非芸、哈基、書尼、以斯本、以利、亞羅底、亞列利。
verses.e: The sons of Gad : Ziphion , Haggi , Shuni , Ezbon , Eri , Arodi , and Areli .

verses.z: 亞設的兒子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韋、比利亞，還有他們的妹子西拉。比利亞的兒子是希別、瑪結。
verses.e: The sons of Asher : Imnah , Ishvah , Ishvi , Beriah , and Serah their sister . The sons of Beriah : Heber and Malchiel .

verses.z: 這是拉班給他女兒利亞的婢女悉帕從雅各所生的兒孫，共有十六人。
verses.e: These are the sons of Zilpah , whom Laban gave to Leah , his daughter , and these she bore to Jacob , even sixteen souls .

verses.z: 雅各之妻拉結的兒子是約瑟和便雅憫。
verses.e: The sons of Rachel , Jacob's wife : Joseph and Benjamin .

verses.z: 夜間，上帝在異象中對以色列說：「雅各！雅各！」他說：「我在這裏。」
verses.e: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night , and said , " Jacob , Jacob ! " He said , " Here I am . "

verses.z: 約瑟在埃及地生了瑪拿西和以法蓮，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給約瑟生的。
verses.e: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim , whom Asenath , the daughter of Potiphera , priest of On , bore to him .

verses.z: 便雅憫的兒子是比拉、比結、亞實別、基拉、乃幔、以希、羅實、母平、戶平、亞勒。
verses.e: The sons of Benjamin : Bela , Becher , Ashbel , Gera , Naaman , Ehi , Rosh , Muppim , Huppim , and Ard .

verses.z: 這是拉結給雅各所生的兒孫，共有十四人。
verses.e: These are the sons of Rachel , who were born to Jacob : all the souls were fourteen .

verses.z: 但的兒子是戶伸。
verses.e: The son of Dan : Hushim .

verses.z: 拿弗他利的兒子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、示冷。
verses.e: The sons of Naphtali : Jahzeel , Guni , Jezer , and Shillem .

verses.z: 這是拉班給他女兒拉結的婢女辟拉從雅各所生的兒孫，共有七人。
verses.e: These are the sons of Bilhah , whom Laban gave to Rachel , his daughter , and these she bore to Jacob : all the souls were seven .

verses.z: 那與雅各同到埃及的，除了他兒婦之外，凡從他所生的，共有六十六人。
verses.e: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt , who were his direct offspring , in addition to Jacob's sons ' wives , all the souls were sixty-six .

verses.z: 還有約瑟在埃及所生的兩個兒子。雅各家來到埃及的共有七十人。
verses.e: The sons of Joseph , who were born to him in Egypt , were two souls . All the souls of the house of Jacob , who came into Egypt , were seventy .

verses.z: 雅各打發猶大先去見約瑟，請派人引路往歌珊去；於是他們來到歌珊地。
verses.e: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph , to show the way before him to Goshen , and they came into the land of Goshen .

verses.z: 約瑟套車往歌珊去，迎接他父親以色列，及至見了面，就伏在父親的頸項上，哭了許久。
verses.e: Joseph prepared his chariot , and went up to meet Israel , his father , in Goshen . He presented himself to him , and fell on his neck , and wept on his neck a good while .

verses.z: 上帝說：「我是上帝，就是你父親的上帝。你下埃及去不要害怕，因為我必使你在那裏成為大族。
verses.e: He said , " I am God , the God of your father . Don't be afraid to go down into Egypt , for there I will make of you a great nation .

verses.z: 以色列對約瑟說：「我既得見你的面，知道你還在，就是死我也甘心。」
verses.e: Israel said to Joseph , " Now let me die , since I have seen your face , that you are still alive . "

verses.z: 約瑟對他的弟兄和他父的全家說：「我要上去告訴法老，對他說：『我的弟兄和我父的全家從前在迦南地，現今都到我這裏來了。
verses.e: Joseph said to his brothers , and to his father's house , " I will go up , and speak with Pharaoh , and will tell him , ' My brothers , and my father's house , who were in the land of Canaan , have come to me .

verses.z: 他們本是牧羊的人，以養牲畜為業；他們把羊群牛群和一切所有的都帶來了。』
verses.e: These men are shepherds , for they have been keepers of livestock , and they have brought their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have . '

verses.z: 等法老召你們的時候，問你們說：『你們以何事為業？』
verses.e: It will happen , when Pharaoh summons you , and will say , ' What is your occupation ? '

verses.z: 你們要說：『你的僕人，從幼年直到如今，都以養牲畜為業，連我們的祖宗也都以此為業。』這樣，你們可以住在歌珊地，因為凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厭惡。」
verses.e: that you shall say , ' Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now , both we , and our fathers : ' that you may dwell in the land of Goshen ; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians . "

verses.z: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定帶你上來；約瑟必給你送終。」
verses.e: I will go down with you into Egypt . I will also surely bring you up again . Joseph's hand will close your eyes . "

verses.z: 雅各就從別是巴起行。以色列的兒子們使他們的父親雅各和他們的妻子、兒女都坐在法老為雅各送來的車上。
verses.e: Jacob rose up from Beersheba , and the sons of Israel carried Jacob , their father , their little ones , and their wives , in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him .

verses.z: 他們又帶着迦南地所得的牲畜、貨財來到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孫都一同來了。
verses.e: They took their livestock , and their goods , which they had gotten in the land of Canaan , and came into Egypt — Jacob , and all his offspring with him ,

verses.z: 雅各把他的兒子、孫子、女兒、孫女，並他的子子孫孫，一同帶到埃及。
verses.e: his sons , and his sons ' sons with him , his daughters , and his sons ' daughters , and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt .

verses.z: 來到埃及的以色列人名字記在下面。雅各和他的兒孫：雅各的長子是呂便。
verses.e: These are the names of the children of Israel , who came into Egypt , Jacob and his sons : Reuben , Jacob's firstborn .

verses.z: 呂便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米。
verses.e: The sons of Reuben : Hanoch , Pallu , Hezron , and Carmi .

verses.z: 約瑟進去告訴法老說：「我的父親和我的弟兄帶着羊群牛群，並一切所有的，從迦南地來了，如今在歌珊地。」
verses.e: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh , and said , " My father and my brothers , with their flocks , their herds , and all that they own , have come out of the land of Canaan ; and behold , they are in the land of Goshen . "

verses.z: 雅各又給法老祝福，就從法老面前出去了。
verses.e: Jacob blessed Pharaoh , and went out from the presence of Pharaoh .

verses.z: 約瑟遵着法老的命，把埃及國最好的地，就是蘭塞境內的地，給他父親和弟兄居住，作為產業。
verses.e: Joseph placed his father and his brothers , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .

verses.z: 約瑟用糧食奉養他父親和他弟兄，並他父親全家的眷屬，都是照各家的人口奉養他們。
verses.e: Joseph provided his father , his brothers , and all of his father's household with bread , according to the sizes of their families .

verses.z: 饑荒甚大，全地都絕了糧，甚至埃及地和迦南地[的人]因那饑荒的緣故都餓昏了。
verses.e: There was no bread in all the land ; for the famine was very severe , so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine .

verses.z: 約瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的銀子，就是眾人糴糧的銀子，約瑟就把那銀子帶到法老的宮裏。
verses.e: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , for the grain which they bought : and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house .

verses.z: 埃及地和迦南地的銀子都花盡了，埃及眾人都來見約瑟，說：「我們的銀子都用盡了，求你給我們糧食，我們為甚麼死在你面前呢？」
verses.e: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came to Joseph , and said , " Give us bread , for why should we die in your presence ? For our money fails . "

verses.z: 約瑟說：「若是銀子用盡了，可以把你們的牲畜給我，我就為你們的牲畜給你們糧食。」
verses.e: Joseph said , " Give me your livestock ; and I will give you food for your livestock , if your money is gone . "

verses.z: 於是他們把牲畜趕到約瑟那裏，約瑟就拿糧食換了他們的牛、羊、驢、馬；那一年因換他們一切的牲畜，就用糧食養活他們。
verses.e: They brought their livestock to Joseph , and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses , and for the flocks , and for the herds , and for the donkeys : and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year .

verses.z: 那一年過去，第二年他們又來見約瑟，說：「我們不瞞我主，我們的銀子都花盡了，牲畜也都歸了我主。我們在我主眼前，除了我們的身體和田地之外，一無所剩。
verses.e: When that year was ended , they came to him the second year , and said to him , " We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent , and the herds of livestock are my lord's . There is nothing left in the sight of my lord , but our bodies , and our lands .

verses.z: 你何忍見我們人死地荒呢？求你用糧食買我們和我們的地，我們和我們的地就要給法老效力。又求你給我們種子，使我們得以存活，不致死亡，地土也不致荒涼。」
verses.e: Why should we die before your eyes , both we and our land ? Buy us and our land for bread , and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh . Give us seed , that we may live , and not die , and that the land won't be desolate . "

verses.z: 約瑟從他弟兄中挑出五個人來，引他們去見法老。
verses.e: From among his brothers he took five men , and presented them to Pharaoh .

verses.z: 於是，約瑟為法老買了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饑荒所迫，各都賣了自己的田地；那地就都歸了法老。
verses.e: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh , for every man of the Egyptians sold his field , because the famine was severe on them , and the land became Pharaoh's .

verses.z: 至於百姓，約瑟叫他們，從埃及這邊直到埃及那邊，都各歸各城。
verses.e: As for the people , he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it .

verses.z: 惟有祭司的地，約瑟沒有買，因為祭司有從法老所得的常俸。他們吃法老所給的常俸，所以他們不賣自己的地。
verses.e: Only he didn't buy the land of the priests , for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh , and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them . That is why they didn't sell their land .

verses.z: 約瑟對百姓說：「我今日為法老買了你們和你們的地，看哪，這裏有種子給你們，你們可以種地。
verses.e: Then Joseph said to the people , " Behold , I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh . Behold , here is seed for you , and you shall sow the land .

verses.z: 後來打糧食的時候，你們要把五分之一納給法老，四分可以歸你們做地裏的種子，也做你們和你們家口孩童的食物。」
verses.e: It will happen at the harvests , that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh , and four parts will be your own , for seed of the field , for your food , for them of your households , and for food for your little ones . "

verses.z: 他們說：「你救了我們的性命。但願我們在我主眼前蒙恩，我們就作法老的僕人。」
verses.e: They said , " You have saved our lives ! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord , and we will be Pharaoh's servants . "

verses.z: 於是約瑟為埃及地定下常例，直到今日：法老必得五分之一，惟獨祭司的地不歸法老。
verses.e: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day , that Pharaoh should have the fifth . Only the land of the priests alone didn't become Pharaoh's .

verses.z: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他們在那裏置了產業，並且生育甚多。
verses.e: Israel lived in the land of Egypt , in the land of Goshen ; and they got themselves possessions therein , and were fruitful , and multiplied exceedingly .

verses.z: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七歲。
verses.e: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years . So the days of Jacob , the years of his life , were one hundred forty-seven years .

verses.z: 以色列的死期臨近了，他就叫了他兒子約瑟來，說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，請你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈愛和誠實待我，請你不要將我葬在埃及。
verses.e: The time came near that Israel must die , and he called his son Joseph , and said to him , " If now I have found favor in your sight , please put your hand under my thigh , and deal kindly and truly with me . Please don't bury me in Egypt ,

verses.z: 法老問約瑟的弟兄說：「你們以何事為業？」他們對法老說：「你僕人是牧羊的，連我們的祖宗也是牧羊的。」
verses.e: Pharaoh said to his brothers , " What is your occupation ? " They said to Pharaoh , " Your servants are shepherds , both we , and our fathers . "

verses.z: 我與我祖我父同睡的時候，你要將我帶出埃及，葬在他們所葬的地方。」約瑟說：「我必遵着你的命而行。」
verses.e: but when I sleep with my fathers , you shall carry me out of Egypt , and bury me in their burying place . " Joseph said , " I will do as you have said . "

verses.z: 雅各說：「你要向我起誓。」約瑟就向他起了誓，於是以色列在床頭上敬拜[上帝]。
verses.e: Israel said , " Swear to me , " and he swore to him . Then Israel bowed himself on the bed's head .

verses.z: 他們又對法老說：「迦南地的饑荒甚大，僕人的羊群沒有草吃，所以我們來到這地寄居。現在求你容僕人住在歌珊地。」
verses.e: They also said to Pharaoh , " We have come to live as foreigners in the land , for there is no pasture for your servants ' flocks . For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan . Now therefore , please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen . "

verses.z: 法老對約瑟說：「你父親和你弟兄到你這裏來了，
verses.e: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph , saying , " Your father and your brothers have come to you .

verses.z: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父親和你弟兄住在國中最好的地；他們可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他們中間有甚麼能人，就派他們看管我的牲畜。」
verses.e: The land of Egypt is before you . Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land . Let them dwell in the land of Goshen . If you know any able men among them , then put them in charge of my livestock . "

verses.z: 約瑟領他父親雅各進到法老面前，雅各就給法老祝福。
verses.e: Joseph brought in Jacob , his father , and set him before Pharaoh ; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh .

verses.z: 法老問雅各說：「你平生的年日是多少呢？」
verses.e: Pharaoh said to Jacob , " How old are you ? "

verses.z: 雅各對法老說：「我寄居在世的年日是一百三十歲，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖在世寄居的年日。」
verses.e: Jacob said to Pharaoh , " The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years . The days of the years of my life have been few and evil . They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage . "

verses.z: 這事以後，有人告訴約瑟說：「你的父親病了。」他就帶着兩個兒子瑪拿西和以法蓮同去。
verses.e: After these things , someone said to Joseph , " Behold , your father is sick . " He took with him his two sons , Manasseh and Ephraim .

verses.z: 以色列年紀老邁，眼睛昏花，不能看見。約瑟領他們到他跟前，他就和他們親嘴，抱着他們。
verses.e: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age , so that he couldn't see well . Joseph brought them near to him ; and he kissed them , and embraced them .

verses.z: 以色列對約瑟說：「我想不到得見你的面，不料，上帝又使我得見你的兒子。」
verses.e: Israel said to Joseph , " I didn't think I would see your face , and behold , God has let me see your offspring also . "

verses.z: 約瑟把兩個兒子從以色列兩膝中領出來，自己就臉伏於地下拜。
verses.e: Joseph brought them out from between his knees , and he bowed himself with his face to the earth .

verses.z: 隨後，約瑟又拉着他們兩個，以法蓮在他的右手裏，對着以色列的左手，瑪拿西在他的左手裏，對着以色列的右手，領他們到以色列的跟前。
verses.e: Joseph took them both , Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand , and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand , and brought them near to him .

verses.z: 以色列伸出右手來，按在以法蓮的頭上（以法蓮乃是次子），又剪搭過左手來，按在瑪拿西的頭上（瑪拿西原是長子）。
verses.e: Israel stretched out his right hand , and laid it on Ephraim's head , who was the younger , and his left hand on Manasseh's head , guiding his hands knowingly , for Manasseh was the firstborn .

verses.z: 他就給約瑟祝福說：「願我祖亞伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的上帝，就是一生牧養我直到今日的上帝，
verses.e: He blessed Joseph , and said , " The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked , the God who has fed me all my life long to this day ,

verses.z: 救贖我脫離一切患難的那使者，賜福與這兩個童子。願他們歸在我的名下和我祖亞伯拉罕、我父以撒的名下。又願他們在世界中生養眾多。」
verses.e: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil , bless the lads , and let my name be named on them , and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac . Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth . "

verses.z: 約瑟見他父親把右手按在以法蓮的頭上，就不喜悅，便提起他父親的手，要從以法蓮頭上挪到瑪拿西的頭上。
verses.e: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim , it displeased him . He held up his father's hand , to remove it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head .

verses.z: 約瑟對他父親說：「我父，不是這樣。這本是長子，求你把右手按在他的頭上。」
verses.e: Joseph said to his father , " Not so , my father , for this is the firstborn . Put your right hand on his head . "

verses.z: 他父親不從，說：「我知道，我兒，我知道。他也必成為一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟將來比他還大；他兄弟的後裔要成為多族。」
verses.e: His father refused , and said , " I know , my son , I know . He also will become a people , and he also will be great . However , his younger brother will be greater than he , and his offspring will become a multitude of nations . "

verses.z: 有人告訴雅各說：「請看，你兒子約瑟到你這裏來了。」以色列就勉強在床上坐起來。
verses.e: Someone told Jacob , and said , " Behold , your son Joseph comes to you , " and Israel strengthened himself , and sat on the bed .

verses.z: 當日就給他們祝福說：「以色列人要指着你們祝福說：『願上帝使你如以法蓮、瑪拿西一樣。』」於是立以法蓮在瑪拿西以上。
verses.e: He blessed them that day , saying , " Israel will bless in your name , saying , ' God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh ' " He set Ephraim before Manasseh .

verses.z: 以色列又對約瑟說：「我要死了，但上帝必與你們同在，領你們回到你們列祖之地。
verses.e: Israel said to Joseph , " Behold , I am dying , but God will be with you , and bring you again to the land of your fathers .

verses.z: 並且我從前用弓用刀從亞摩利人手下奪的那塊地，我都賜給你，使你比眾弟兄多得一分。」
verses.e: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow . "

verses.z: 對我說：『我必使你生養眾多，成為多民，又要把這地賜給你的後裔，永遠為業。』
verses.e: and said to me , ' Behold , I will make you fruitful , and multiply you , and I will make of you a company of peoples , and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession . '

verses.z: 我未到埃及見你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法蓮和瑪拿西這兩個兒子是我的，正如呂便和西緬是我的一樣。

verses.e: As for me , when I came from Paddan , Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way , when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath , and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath ( also called Bethlehem ) . "

verses.e: Joseph said to his father , " They are my sons , whom God has given me here . " He said , " Please bring them to me , and I will bless them . "

verses.z: 雅各叫了他的兒子們來，說：「你們都來聚集，我好把你們日後必遇的事告訴你們。

verses.z: 圭必不離猶大，杖必不離他兩腳之間，直等細羅來到，萬民都必歸順。
verses.e: The scepter will not depart from Judah , nor the ruler's staff from between his feet , until he comes to whom it belongs . The obedience of the peoples will be to him .

verses.z: 猶大把小驢拴在葡萄樹上，把驢駒拴在美好的葡萄樹上。他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服，在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。
verses.e: Binding his foal to the vine , his donkey's colt to the choice vine , he has washed his garments in wine , his robes in the blood of grapes .

verses.z: 他的眼睛必因酒紅潤；他的牙齒必因奶白亮。
verses.e: His eyes will be red with wine , his teeth white with milk .

verses.z: 西布倫必住在海口，必成為停船的海口；他的境界必延到西頓。
verses.e: " Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea . He will be for a haven of ships . His border will be on Sidon .

verses.z: 以薩迦是個強壯的驢，臥在羊圈之中。
verses.e: " Issachar is a strong donkey , lying down between the saddlebags .

verses.z: 他以安靜為佳，以肥地為美，便低肩背重，成為服苦的僕人。
verses.e: He saw a resting place , that it was good , the land , that it was pleasant . He bows his shoulder to the burden , and becomes a servant doing forced labor .

verses.z: 但必判斷他的民，作以色列支派之一。
verses.e: " Dan will judge his people , as one of the tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺，咬傷馬蹄，使騎馬的墜落於後。
verses.e: Dan will be a serpent on the trail , an adder in the path , that bites the horse's heels , so that his rider falls backward .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我向來等候你的救恩。
verses.e: I have waited for your salvation , LORD .

verses.z: 迦得必被敵軍追逼，他卻要追逼他們的腳跟。
verses.e: " A troop will press on Gad , but he will press on their heel .

verses.z: 雅各的兒子們，你們要聚集而聽，要聽你們父親以色列的話。
verses.e: Assemble yourselves , and hear , you sons of Jacob . Listen to Israel , your father .

verses.z: 亞設之地必出肥美的糧食，且出君王的美味。
verses.e: " Asher's food will be rich . He will produce royal dainties .

verses.z: 拿弗他利是被釋放的母鹿；他出嘉美的言語。
verses.e: " Naphtali is a doe set free , who bears beautiful fawns .

verses.z: 約瑟是多結果子的樹枝，是泉旁多結果的枝子；他的枝條探出牆外。
verses.e: " Joseph is a fruitful vine , a fruitful vine by a spring . His branches run over the wall .

verses.z: 弓箭手將他苦害，向他射箭，逼迫他。
verses.e: The archers have severely grieved him , shot at him , and persecuted him :

verses.z: 但他的弓仍舊堅硬；他的手健壯敏捷。這是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石－就是雅各的大能者。
verses.e: But his bow remained strong . The arms of his hands were made strong , by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob , ( from there is the shepherd , the stone of Israel ) ,

verses.z: 你父親的上帝必幫助你；那全能者必將天上所有的福，地裏所藏的福，以及生產乳養的福，都賜給你。
verses.e: even by the God of your father , who will help you , by the Almighty , who will bless you , with blessings of heaven above , blessings of the deep that lies below , blessings of the breasts , and of the womb .

verses.z: 你父親所祝的福勝過我祖先所祝的福，如永世的山嶺，至極的邊界；這些福必降在約瑟的頭上，臨到那與弟兄迥別之人的頂上。
verses.e: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors , above the boundaries of the ancient hills . They will be on the head of Joseph , on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers .

verses.z: 便雅憫是個撕掠的狼，早晨要吃他所抓的，晚上要分他所奪的。」
verses.e: " Benjamin is a ravenous wolf . In the morning he will devour the prey . At evening he will divide the plunder . "

verses.z: 這一切是以色列的十二支派；這也是他們的父親對他們所說的話，為他們所祝的福，都是按着各人的福分為他們祝福。
verses.e: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel , and this is what their father spoke to them , and blessed them . He blessed everyone according to his own blessing .

verses.z: 他又囑咐他們說：「我將要歸到我列祖那裏，你們要將我葬在赫人以弗崙田間的洞裏，與我祖我父在一處，
verses.e: He instructed them , and said to them , " I am to be gathered to my people . Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite ,

verses.z: 呂便哪，你是我的長子，是我力量強壯的時候生的，本當大有尊榮，權力超眾。
verses.e: " Reuben , you are my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , excelling in dignity , and excelling in power .

verses.z: 就是在迦南地幔利前、麥比拉田間的洞；那洞和田是亞伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙買來為業，作墳地的。
verses.e: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah , which is before Mamre , in the land of Canaan , which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place .

verses.z: 他們在那裏葬了亞伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉，又在那裏葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那裏葬了利亞。
verses.e: There they buried Abraham and Sarah , his wife . There they buried Isaac and Rebekah , his wife , and there I buried Leah :

verses.z: 那塊田和田間的洞原是向赫人買的。」
verses.e: the field and the cave that is therein , which was purchased from the children of Heth . "

verses.z: 雅各囑咐眾子已畢，就把腳收在床上，氣絕而死，歸他列祖那裏去了。
verses.e: When Jacob finished charging his sons , he gathered up his feet into the bed , breathed his last breath , and was gathered to his people .

verses.z: 但你[放縱情慾，]滾沸如水，必不得居首位；因為你上了你父親的床，污穢了我的榻。
verses.e: Boiling over like water , you shall not excel , because you went up to your father's bed , then defiled it . He went up to my couch .

verses.z: 西緬和利未是弟兄；他們的刀劍是殘忍的器具。
verses.e: " Simeon and Levi are brothers . Their swords are weapons of violence .

verses.z: 我的靈啊，不要與他們同謀；我的心哪，不要與他們聯絡；因為他們趁怒殺害人命，任意砍斷牛腿大筋。
verses.e: My soul , don't come into their council . My glory , don't be united to their assembly ; for in their anger they killed men . In their self-will they hamstrung cattle .

verses.z: 他們的怒氣暴烈可咒；他們的忿恨殘忍可詛。我要使他們分居在雅各[家裏]，散住在以色列[地中]。
verses.e: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce ; and their wrath , for it was cruel . I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .

verses.z: 猶大啊，你弟兄們必讚美你；你手必掐住仇敵的頸項；你父親的兒子們必向你下拜。
verses.e: " Judah , your brothers will praise you . Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies . Your father's sons will bow down before you .

verses.z: 猶大是個小獅子；我兒啊，你抓了食便上去。你屈下身去，臥如公獅，蹲如母獅，誰敢惹你？
verses.e: Judah is a lion's cub . From the prey , my son , you have gone up . He stooped down , he crouched as a lion , as a lioness . Who will rouse him up ?

verses.z: 以挪士生該南之後，又活了八百一十五年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years , and became the father of other sons and daughters .

verses.z: 以挪士共活了九百零五歲就死了。
verses.e: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years , then he died .

verses.z: 該南活到七十歲，生了瑪勒列。
verses.e: Kenan lived seventy years , then became the father of Mahalalel .

verses.z: 該南生瑪勒列之後，又活了八百四十年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years , and became the father of other sons and daughters

verses.z: 該南共活了九百一十歲就死了。
verses.e: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years , then he died .

verses.z: 瑪勒列活到六十五歲，生了雅列。
verses.e: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years , then became the father of Jared .

verses.z: 瑪勒列生雅列之後，又活了八百三十年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years , and became the father of other sons and daughters .

verses.z: 瑪勒列共活了八百九十五歲就死了。
verses.e: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years , then he died .

verses.z: 雅列活到一百六十二歲，生了以諾。
verses.e: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years , then became the father of Enoch .

verses.z: 雅列生以諾之後，又活了八百年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years , and became the father of other sons and daughters .

verses.e: He created them male and female , and blessed them . On the day they were created , he named them Adam .

verses.z: 雅列共活了九百六十二歲就死了。
verses.e: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years , then he died .

verses.z: 以諾活到六十五歲，生了瑪土撒拉。
verses.e: Enoch lived sixty-five years , then became the father of Methuselah .

verses.z: 以諾生瑪土撒拉之後，與上帝同行三百年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: After Methuselah's birth , Enoch walked with God for three hundred years , and became the father of more sons and daughters .

verses.z: 以諾共活了三百六十五歲。
verses.e: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years .

verses.z: 以諾與上帝同行，上帝將他取去，他就不在世了。
verses.e: Enoch walked with God , and he was not found , for God took him .

verses.z: 瑪土撒拉活到一百八十七歲，生了拉麥。
verses.e: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years , then became the father of Lamech .

verses.z: 瑪土撒拉生拉麥之後，又活了七百八十二年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years , and became the father of other sons and daughters .

verses.z: 瑪土撒拉共活了九百六十九歲就死了。
verses.e: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years , then he died .

verses.z: 拉麥活到一百八十二歲，生了一個兒子，
verses.e: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years , then became the father of a son .

verses.z: 給他起名叫挪亞，說：「這個兒子必為我們的操作和手中的勞苦安慰我們；這操作勞苦是因為耶和華咒詛地。」
verses.e: He named him Noah , saying , " This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands , caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed . "

verses.z: 亞當活到一百三十歲，生了一個兒子，形像樣式和自己相似，就給他起名叫塞特。
verses.e: Adam lived one hundred thirty years , and became the father of a son in his own likeness , after his image , and named him Seth .

verses.z: 拉麥生挪亞之後，又活了五百九十五年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years , and became the father of other sons and daughters .

verses.z: 拉麥共活了七百七十七歲就死了。
verses.e: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years , then he died .

verses.z: 挪亞五百歲生了閃、含、雅弗。
verses.e: Noah was five hundred years old , then Noah became the father of Shem , Ham , and Japheth .

verses.z: 亞當生塞特之後，又在世八百年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years , and he became the father of other sons and daughters .

verses.z: 亞當共活了九百三十歲就死了。
verses.e: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years , then he died .

verses.z: 塞特活到一百零五歲，生了以挪士。
verses.e: Seth lived one hundred five years , then became the father of Enosh .

verses.z: 塞特生以挪士之後，又活了八百零七年，並且生兒養女。
verses.e: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years , and became the father of other sons and daughters .

verses.z: 塞特共活了九百一十二歲就死了。
verses.e: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years , then he died .

verses.z: 以挪士活到九十歲，生了該南。
verses.e: Enosh lived ninety years , and became the father of Kenan .

verses.z: 約瑟伏在他父親的面上哀哭，與他親嘴。
verses.e: Joseph fell on his father's face , wept on him , and kissed him .

verses.z: 他們到了約旦河外、亞達的禾場，就在那裏大大地號咷痛哭。約瑟為他父親哀哭了七天。
verses.e: They came to the threshing floor of Atad , which is beyond the Jordan , and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation . He mourned for his father seven days .

verses.z: 迦南的居民見亞達禾場上的哀哭，就說：「這是埃及人一場極大的哀哭。」因此那地方名叫亞伯‧麥西，是在約旦河東。
verses.e: When the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , saw the mourning in the floor of Atad , they said , " This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians . " Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim , which is beyond the Jordan .

verses.z: 雅各的兒子們就遵着他父親所吩咐的辦了，
verses.e: His sons did to him just as he commanded them ,

verses.z: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前、麥比拉田間的洞裏；那洞和田是亞伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙買來為業，作墳地的。
verses.e: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan , and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah , which Abraham bought with the field , as a possession for a burial site , from Ephron the Hittite , near Mamre .

verses.z: 約瑟葬了他父親以後，就和眾弟兄，並一切同他上去葬他父親的人，都回埃及去了。
verses.e: Joseph returned into Egypt — he , and his brothers , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .

verses.z: 約瑟的哥哥們見父親死了，就說：「或者約瑟懷恨我們，照着我們從前待他一切的惡足足地報復我們。」
verses.e: When Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead , they said , " It may be that Joseph will hate us , and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him . "

verses.z: 他們就打發人去見約瑟，說：「你父親未死以先吩咐說：
verses.e: They sent a message to Joseph , saying , " Your father commanded before he died , saying ,

verses.z: 『你們要對約瑟這樣說：從前你哥哥們惡待你，求你饒恕他們的過犯和罪惡。』如今求你饒恕你父親上帝之僕人的過犯。」他們對約瑟說這話，約瑟就哭了。
verses.e: ' You shall tell Joseph , " Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers , and their sin , because they did evil to you . " ' Now , please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father . " Joseph wept when they spoke to him .

verses.z: 他的哥哥們又來俯伏在他面前，說：「我們是你的僕人。」
verses.e: His brothers also went and fell down before his face ; and they said , " Behold , we are your servants . "

verses.z: 約瑟對他們說：「不要害怕，我豈能代替上帝呢？
verses.e: Joseph said to them , " Don't be afraid , for am I in the place of God ?

verses.z: 約瑟吩咐伺候他的醫生用香料薰他父親，醫生就用香料薰了以色列。
verses.e: Joseph commanded his servants , the physicians , to embalm his father ; and the physicians embalmed Israel .

verses.z: 從前你們的意思是要害我，但上帝的意思原是好的，要保全許多人的性命，成就今日的光景。
verses.e: As for you , you meant evil against me , but God meant it for good , to save many people alive , as is happening today .

verses.z: 現在你們不要害怕，我必養活你們和你們的[婦人]孩子。」於是約瑟用親愛的話安慰他們。
verses.e: Now therefore don't be afraid . I will provide for you and your little ones . " He comforted them , and spoke kindly to them .

verses.z: 約瑟和他父親的眷屬都住在埃及。約瑟活了一百一十歲。
verses.e: Joseph lived in Egypt , he , and his father's house . Joseph lived one hundred ten years .

verses.z: 約瑟得見以法蓮第三代的子孫。瑪拿西的孫子、瑪吉的兒子也養在約瑟的膝上。
verses.e: Joseph saw Ephraim's children to the third generation . The children also of Machir , the son of Manasseh , were born on Joseph's knees .

verses.z: 約瑟對他弟兄們說：「我要死了，但上帝必定看顧你們，領你們從這地上去，到他起誓所應許給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地。」
verses.e: Joseph said to his brothers , " I am dying , but God will surely visit you , and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob . "

verses.z: 約瑟叫以色列的子孫起誓說：「上帝必定看顧你們；你們要把我的骸骨從這裏搬上去。」
verses.e: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel , saying , " God will surely visit you , and you shall carry up my bones from here . "

verses.z: 約瑟死了，正一百一十歲。人用香料將他薰了，把他收殮在棺材裏，停在埃及。
verses.e: So Joseph died , being one hundred ten years old , and they embalmed him , and he was put in a coffin in Egypt .

verses.z: 薰屍的常例是四十天；那四十天滿了，埃及人為他哀哭了七十天。
verses.e: Forty days were used for him , for that is how many days it takes to embalm . The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days .

verses.z: 為他哀哭的日子過了，約瑟對法老家中的人說：「我若在你們眼前蒙恩，請你們報告法老說：
verses.e: When the days of weeping for him were past , Joseph spoke to Pharaoh's staff , saying , " If now I have found favor in your eyes , please speak in the ears of Pharaoh , saying ,

verses.z: 『我父親要死的時候叫我起誓說：你要將我葬在迦南地，在我為自己所掘的墳墓裏。』現在求你讓我上去葬我父親，以後我必回來。」
verses.e: ' My father made me swear , saying , " Behold , I am dying . Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan . " Now therefore , please let me go up and bury my father , and I will come again . ' "

verses.z: 法老說：「你可以上去，照着你父親叫你起的誓，將他葬埋。」
verses.e: Pharaoh said , " Go up , and bury your father , just like he made you swear . "

verses.z: 於是約瑟上去葬他父親。與他一同上去的，有法老的臣僕和法老家中的長老，並埃及國的長老，
verses.e: Joseph went up to bury his father ; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh , the elders of his house , all the elders of the land of Egypt ,

verses.z: 還有約瑟的全家和他的弟兄們，並他父親的眷屬；只有他們的[婦人]孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。
verses.e: all the house of Joseph , his brothers , and his father's house . Only their little ones , their flocks , and their herds , they left in the land of Goshen .

verses.z: 又有車輛馬兵，和他一同上去；那一幫人甚多。
verses.e: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him . It was a very great company .

verses.z: 當人在世上多起來、又生女兒的時候，
verses.e: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground , and daughters were born to them ,

verses.z: 挪亞生了三個兒子，就是閃、含、雅弗。
verses.e: Noah became the father of three sons : Shem , Ham , and Japheth .

verses.z: 世界在上帝面前敗壞，地上滿了強暴。
verses.e: The earth was corrupt before God , and the earth was filled with violence .

verses.z: 上帝觀看世界，見是敗壞了；凡有血氣的人在地上都敗壞了行為。
verses.e: God saw the earth , and saw that it was corrupt , for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth .

verses.z: 上帝就對挪亞說：「凡有血氣的人，他的盡頭已經來到我面前；因為地上滿了他們的強暴，我要把他們和地一併毀滅。
verses.e: God said to Noah , " I will bring an end to all flesh , for the earth is filled with violence through them . Behold , I will destroy them and the earth .

verses.z: 你要用歌斐木造一隻方舟，分一間一間地造，裏外抹上松香。
verses.e: Make a ship of gopher wood . You shall make rooms in the ship , and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch .

verses.z: 方舟的造法乃是這樣：要長三百肘，寬五十肘，高三十肘。
verses.e: This is how you shall make it . The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits , its width fifty cubits , and its height thirty cubits .

verses.z: 方舟上邊要留透光處，高一肘。方舟的門要開在旁邊。方舟要分上、中、下三層。
verses.e: You shall make a roof in the ship , and you shall finish it to a cubit upward . You shall set the door of the ship in its side . You shall make it with lower , second , and third levels .

verses.z: 看哪，我要使洪水氾濫在地上，毀滅天下；凡地上有血肉、有氣息的活物，無一不死。
verses.e: I , even I , will bring the flood of waters on this earth , to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky . Everything that is in the earth will die .

verses.z: 我卻要與你立約；你同你的妻，與兒子兒婦，都要進入方舟。
verses.e: But I will establish my covenant with you . You shall come into the ship , you , your sons , your wife , and your sons ' wives with you .

verses.z: 凡有血肉的活物，每樣兩個，一公一母，你要帶進方舟，好在你那裏保全生命。
verses.e: Of every living thing of all flesh , you shall bring two of every sort into the ship , to keep them alive with you . They shall be male and female .

verses.z: 上帝的兒子們看見人的女子美貌，就隨意挑選，娶來為妻。
verses.e: God's sons saw that men's daughters were beautiful , and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives .

verses.z: 飛鳥各從其類，牲畜各從其類，地上的昆蟲各從其類，每樣兩個，要到你那裏，好保全生命。
verses.e: Of the birds after their kind , of the livestock after their kind , of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind , two of every sort will come to you , to keep them alive .

verses.z: 你要拿各樣食物積蓄起來，好作你和牠們的食物。」
verses.e: Take with you some of all food that is eaten , and gather it to yourself ; and it will be for food for you , and for them . "

verses.z: 挪亞就這樣行。凡上帝所吩咐的，他都照樣行了。
verses.e: Thus Noah did . He did all that God commanded him .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「人既屬乎血氣，我的靈就不永遠住在他裏面；然而他的日子還可到一百二十年。」
verses.e: The LORD said , " My Spirit will not strive with man forever , because he also is flesh ; so his days will be one hundred twenty years . "

verses.z: 那時候有偉人在地上，後來上帝的兒子們和人的女子們交合生子；那就是上古英武有名的人。
verses.e: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days , and also after that , when God's sons came in to men's daughters and had children with them . Those were the mighty men who were of old , men of renown .

verses.z: 耶和華見人在地上罪惡很大，終日所思想的盡都是惡，
verses.e: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth , and that every imagination of the thoughts of man's heart was continually only evil .

verses.z: 耶和華就後悔造人在地上，心中憂傷。
verses.e: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth , and it grieved him in his heart .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我要將所造的人和走獸，並昆蟲，以及空中的飛鳥，都從地上除滅，因為我造他們後悔了。」
verses.e: The LORD said , " I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground — man , along with animals , creeping things , and birds of the sky — for I am sorry that I have made them . "

verses.z: 惟有挪亞在耶和華眼前蒙恩。
verses.e: But Noah found favor in the LORD's eyes .

verses.z: 挪亞的後代記在下面。挪亞是個義人，在當時的世代是個完全人。挪亞與上帝同行。
verses.e: This is the history of the generations of Noah : Noah was a righteous man , blameless among the people of his time . Noah walked with God .

verses.z: 耶和華對挪亞說：「你和你的全家都要進入方舟；因為在這世代中，我見你在我面前是義人。
verses.e: The LORD said to Noah , " Come with all of your household into the ship , for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation .

verses.z: 過了那七天，洪水氾濫在地上。
verses.e: After the seven days , the floodwaters came on the earth .

verses.z: 當挪亞六百歲，二月十七日那一天，大淵的泉源都裂開了，天上的窗戶也敞開了，
verses.e: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life , in the second month , on the seventeenth day of the month , on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open , and the sky's windows opened .

verses.z: 四十晝夜降大雨在地上。
verses.e: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights .

verses.z: 正當那日，挪亞和他三個兒子閃、含、雅弗，並挪亞的妻子和三個兒婦，都進入方舟。
verses.e: In the same day Noah , and Shem , Ham , and Japheth — the sons of Noah — and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons with them , entered into the ship —

verses.z: 他們和百獸，各從其類，一切牲畜，各從其類，爬在地上的昆蟲，各從其類，一切禽鳥，各從其類，都進入方舟。
verses.e: they , and every animal after its kind , all the livestock after their kind , every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind , and every bird after its kind , every bird of every sort .

verses.z: 凡有血肉、有氣息的活物，都一對一對地到挪亞那裏，進入方舟。
verses.e: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah .

verses.z: 凡有血肉進入方舟的，都是有公有母，正如上帝所吩咐挪亞的。耶和華就把他關在方舟裏頭。
verses.e: Those who went in , went in male and female of all flesh , as God commanded him ; then the LORD shut him in .

verses.z: 洪水氾濫在地上四十天，水往上長，把方舟從地上漂起。
verses.e: The flood was forty days on the earth . The waters increased , and lifted up the ship , and it was lifted up above the earth .

verses.z: 水勢浩大，在地上大大地往上長，方舟在水面上漂來漂去。
verses.e: The waters rose , and increased greatly on the earth ; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters .

verses.z: 水勢在地上極其浩大，天下的高山都淹沒了。
verses.e: The waters rose very high on the earth . All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered .

verses.z: 凡潔淨的畜類，你要帶七公七母；不潔淨的畜類，你要帶一公一母；
verses.e: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you , the male and his female . Of the animals that are not clean , take two , the male and his female .

verses.z: 水勢比山高過十五肘，山嶺都淹沒了。
verses.e: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher , and the mountains were covered .

verses.z: 凡在地上有血肉的動物，就是飛鳥、牲畜、走獸，和爬在地上的昆蟲，以及所有的人，都死了。
verses.e: All flesh died that moved on the earth , including birds , livestock , animals , every creeping thing that creeps on the earth , and every man .

verses.z: 凡在旱地上、鼻孔有氣息的生靈都死了。
verses.e: All on the dry land , in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life , died .

verses.z: 凡地上各類的活物，連人帶牲畜、昆蟲，以及空中的飛鳥，都從地上除滅了，只留下挪亞和那些與他同在方舟裏的。
verses.e: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground , including man , livestock , creeping things , and birds of the sky . They were destroyed from the earth . Only Noah was left , and those who were with him in the ship .

verses.z: 水勢浩大，在地上共一百五十天。
verses.e: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days .

verses.z: 空中的飛鳥也要帶七公七母，可以留種，活在全地上；
verses.e: Also of the birds of the sky , seven and seven , male and female , to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth .

verses.z: 因為再過七天，我要降雨在地上四十晝夜，把我所造的各種活物都從地上除滅。」
verses.e: In seven days , I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights . I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground . "

verses.z: 挪亞就遵着耶和華所吩咐的行了。
verses.e: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him .

verses.z: 當洪水氾濫在地上的時候，挪亞整六百歲。
verses.e: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth .

verses.z: 挪亞就同他的妻和兒子兒婦都進入方舟，躲避洪水。
verses.e: Noah went into the ship with his sons , his wife , and his sons ' wives , because of the floodwaters .

verses.z: 潔淨的畜類和不潔淨的畜類，飛鳥並地上一切的昆蟲，
verses.e: Clean animals , unclean animals , birds , and everything that creeps on the ground

verses.z: 都是一對一對地，有公有母，到挪亞那裏進入方舟，正如上帝所吩咐挪亞的。
verses.e: went by pairs to Noah into the ship , male and female , as God commanded Noah .

verses.z: 上帝記念挪亞和挪亞方舟裏的一切走獸牲畜。上帝叫風吹地，水勢漸落。
verses.e: God remembered Noah , all the animals , and all the livestock that were with him in the ship ; and God made a wind to pass over the earth . The waters subsided .

verses.z: 他又等了七天，再把鴿子從方舟放出去。
verses.e: He waited yet another seven days ; and again he sent the dove out of the ship .

verses.z: 到了晚上，鴿子回到他那裏，嘴裏叼着一個新擰下來的橄欖葉子，挪亞就知道地上的水退了。
verses.e: The dove came back to him at evening and , behold , in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf . So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth .

verses.z: 他又等了七天，放出鴿子去，鴿子就不再回來了。
verses.e: He waited yet another seven days , and sent out the dove ; and she didn't return to him any more .

verses.z: 到挪亞六百零一歲，正月初一日，地上的水都乾了。挪亞撤去方舟的蓋觀看，便見地面上乾了。
verses.e: In the six hundred first year , in the first month , the first day of the month , the waters were dried up from the earth . Noah removed the covering of the ship , and looked . He saw that the surface of the ground was dry .

verses.z: 到了二月二十七日，地就都乾了。
verses.e: In the second month , on the twenty-seventh day of the month , the earth was dry .

verses.z: 上帝對挪亞說：
verses.e: God spoke to Noah , saying ,

verses.z: 「你和你的妻子、兒子、兒婦都可以出方舟。
verses.e: " Go out of the ship , you , your wife , your sons , and your sons ' wives with you .

verses.z: 在你那裏凡有血肉的活物，就是飛鳥、牲畜，和一切爬在地上的昆蟲，都要帶出來，叫牠在地上多多滋生，大大興旺。」
verses.e: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh , including birds , livestock , and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth , that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply on the earth . "

verses.z: 於是挪亞和他的妻子、兒子、兒婦都出來了。
verses.e: Noah went out , with his sons , his wife , and his sons ' wives with him .

verses.z: 一切走獸、昆蟲、飛鳥，和地上所有的動物，各從其類，也都出了方舟。
verses.e: Every animal , every creeping thing , and every bird , whatever moves on the earth , after their families , went out of the ship .

verses.z: 淵源和天上的窗戶都閉塞了，天上的大雨也止住了。
verses.e: The deep's fountains and the sky's windows were also stopped , and the rain from the sky was restrained .

verses.z: 挪亞為耶和華築了一座壇，拿各類潔淨的牲畜、飛鳥獻在壇上為燔祭。
verses.e: Noah built an altar to the LORD , and took of every clean animal , and of every clean bird , and offered burnt offerings on the altar .

verses.z: 耶和華聞那馨香之氣，就心裏說：「我不再因人的緣故咒詛地（人從小時心裏懷着惡念），也不再按着我才行的滅各種的活物了。
verses.e: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma . The LORD said in his heart , " I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake because the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth . I will never again strike every living thing , as I have done .

verses.z: 地還存留的時候，稼穡、寒暑、冬夏、晝夜就永不停息了。」
verses.e: While the earth remains , seed time and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night will not cease . "

verses.z: 水從地上漸退。過了一百五十天，水就漸消。
verses.e: The waters continually receded from the earth . After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded .

verses.z: 七月十七日，方舟停在亞拉臘山上。
verses.e: The ship rested in the seventh month , on the seventeenth day of the month , on Ararat's mountains .

verses.z: 水又漸消，到十月初一日，山頂都現出來了。
verses.e: The waters receded continually until the tenth month . In the tenth month , on the first day of the month , the tops of the mountains were visible .

verses.z: 過了四十天，挪亞開了方舟的窗戶，
verses.e: At the end of forty days , Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made ,

verses.z: 放出一隻烏鴉去；那烏鴉飛來飛去，直到地上的水都乾了。
verses.e: and he sent out a raven . It went back and forth , until the waters were dried up from the earth .

verses.z: 他又放出一隻鴿子去，要看看水從地上退了沒有。
verses.e: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground ,

verses.z: 但遍地上都是水，鴿子找不着落腳之地，就回到方舟挪亞那裏，挪亞伸手把鴿子接進方舟來。
verses.e: but the dove found no place to rest her foot , and she returned into the ship to him , for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth . He put out his hand , and took her , and brought her to him into the ship .

verses.z: 上帝賜福給挪亞和他的兒子，對他們說：「你們要生養眾多，遍滿了地。
verses.e: God blessed Noah and his sons , and said to them , " Be fruitful , multiply , and replenish the earth .

verses.z: 並與你們這裏的一切活物－就是飛鳥、牲畜、走獸，凡從方舟裏出來的活物－立約。
verses.e: and with every living creature that is with you : the birds , the livestock , and every animal of the earth with you , of all that go out of the ship , even every animal of the earth .

verses.z: 我與你們立約，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水滅絕，也不再有洪水毀壞地了。」
verses.e: I will establish my covenant with you : All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood . There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth . "

verses.z: 上帝說：「我與你們並你們這裏的各樣活物所立的永約是有記號的。
verses.e: God said , " This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you , for perpetual generations :

verses.z: 我把虹放在雲彩中，這就可作我與地立約的記號了。
verses.e: I set my rainbow in the cloud , and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth .

verses.z: 我使雲彩蓋地的時候，必有虹現在雲彩中，
verses.e: When I bring a cloud over the earth , that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud ,

verses.z: 我便記念我與你們和各樣有血肉的活物所立的約，水就再不氾濫、毀壞一切有血肉的物了。
verses.e: I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh , and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .

verses.z: 虹必現在雲彩中，我看見，就要記念我與地上各樣有血肉的活物所立的永約。」
verses.e: The rainbow will be in the cloud . I will look at it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth . "

verses.z: 上帝對挪亞說：「這就是我與地上一切有血肉之物立約的記號了。」
verses.e: God said to Noah , " This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth . "

verses.z: 出方舟挪亞的兒子就是閃、含、雅弗。含是迦南的父親。
verses.e: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem , Ham , and Japheth . Ham is the father of Canaan .

verses.z: 這是挪亞的三個兒子，他們的後裔分散在全地。
verses.e: These three were the sons of Noah , and from these the whole earth was populated .

verses.z: 凡地上的走獸和空中的飛鳥都必驚恐，懼怕你們，連地上一切的昆蟲並海裏一切的魚都交付你們的手。
verses.e: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth , and on every bird of the sky . Everything that moves along the ground , and all the fish of the sea , are delivered into your hand .

verses.z: 挪亞作起農夫來，栽了一個葡萄園。
verses.e: Noah began to be a farmer , and planted a vineyard .

verses.z: 他喝了園中的酒便醉了，在帳棚裏赤着身子。
verses.e: He drank of the wine and got drunk . He was uncovered within his tent .

verses.z: 迦南的父親含看見他父親赤身，就到外邊告訴他兩個弟兄。
verses.e: Ham , the father of Canaan , saw the nakedness of his father , and told his two brothers outside .

verses.z: 於是閃和雅弗拿件衣服搭在肩上，倒退着進去，給他父親蓋上；他們背着臉就看不見父親的赤身。
verses.e: Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it on both their shoulders , went in backwards , and covered the nakedness of their father . Their faces were backwards , and they didn't see their father's nakedness .

verses.z: 挪亞醒了酒，知道小兒子向他所做的事，
