verses.e: Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his youngest son had done to him .

verses.z: 就說：迦南當受咒詛，必給他弟兄作奴僕的奴僕；
verses.e: He said , " Canaan is cursed . He will be a servant of servants to his brothers . "

verses.z: 又說：耶和華－閃的上帝是應當稱頌的！願迦南作閃的奴僕。
verses.e: He said , " Blessed be the LORD , the God of Shem . Let Canaan be his servant .

verses.z: 願上帝使雅弗擴張，使他住在閃的帳棚裏；又願迦南作他的奴僕。
verses.e: May God enlarge Japheth . Let him dwell in the tents of Shem . Let Canaan be his servant . "

verses.z: 洪水以後，挪亞又活了三百五十年。
verses.e: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood .

verses.z: 挪亞共活了九百五十歲就死了。
verses.e: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years , and then he died .

verses.z: 凡活着的動物都可以作你們的食物。這一切我都賜給你們，如同菜蔬一樣。
verses.e: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you . As I gave you the green herb , I have given everything to you .

verses.z: 惟獨肉帶着血，那就是牠的生命，你們不可吃。
verses.e: But flesh with its life , that is , its blood , you shall not eat .

verses.z: 流你們血、害你們命的，無論是獸是人，我必討他的罪，就是向各人的弟兄也是如此。
verses.e: I will surely require accounting for your life's blood . At the hand of every animal I will require it . At the hand of man , even at the hand of every man's brother , I will require the life of man .

verses.z: 凡流人血的，他的血也必被人所流，因為上帝造人是照自己的形像造的。
verses.e: Whoever sheds man's blood , his blood will be shed by man , for God made man in his own image .

verses.z: 你們要生養眾多，在地上昌盛繁茂。」
verses.e: Be fruitful and multiply . Increase abundantly in the earth , and multiply in it . "

verses.z: 上帝曉諭挪亞和他的兒子說：
verses.e: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him , saying ,

verses.z: 「我與你們和你們的後裔立約，
verses.e: " As for me , behold , I establish my covenant with you , and with your offspring after you ,

verses.z: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。
verses.e: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw .

verses.z: 他們譏誚君王，笑話首領，嗤笑一切保障，築壘攻取。
verses.e: Yes , they scoff at kings , and princes are a derision to them . They laugh at every stronghold , for they build up an earthen ramp and take it .

verses.z: 他以自己的勢力為神，像風猛然掃過，顯為有罪。
verses.e: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on . They are indeed guilty , whose strength is their god . "

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝，我的聖者啊，你不是從亙古而有嗎？我們必不致死。耶和華啊，你派定他為要刑罰人；磐石啊，你設立他為要懲治人。
verses.e: Aren't you from everlasting , LORD my God , my Holy One ? We will not die . LORD , you have appointed them for judgment . You , Rock , have established him to punish .

verses.z: 你眼目清潔，不看邪僻，不看奸惡；行詭詐的，你為何看着不理呢？惡人吞滅比自己公義的，你為何靜默不語呢？
verses.e: You who have purer eyes than to see evil , and who cannot look on perversity , why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he ,

verses.z: 你為何使人如海中的魚，又如沒有管轄的爬物呢？
verses.e: and make men like the fish of the sea , like the creeping things that have no ruler over them ?

verses.z: 他用鉤鉤住，用網捕獲，用拉網聚集他們；因此，他歡喜快樂，
verses.e: He takes up all of them with the hook . He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet . Therefore he rejoices and is glad .

verses.z: 就向網獻祭，向網燒香，因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。
verses.e: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet , because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good .

verses.z: 他豈可屢次倒空網羅，將列國的人時常殺戮，毫不顧惜呢？
verses.e: Will he therefore continually empty his net , and kill the nations without mercy ?

verses.z: 他說：耶和華啊！我呼求你，你不應允，要到幾時呢？我因強暴哀求你，你還不拯救。
verses.e: LORD , how long will I cry , and you will not hear ? I cry out to you " Violence ! " and will you not save ?

verses.z: 你為何使我看見罪孽？你為何看着奸惡[而不理]呢？毀滅和強暴在我面前，又起了爭端和相鬥的事。
verses.e: Why do you show me iniquity , and look at perversity ? For destruction and violence are before me . There is strife , and contention rises up .

verses.z: 因此律法放鬆，公理也不顯明；惡人圍困義人，所以公理顯然顛倒。
verses.e: Therefore the law is paralyzed , and justice never prevails ; for the wicked surround the righteous ; therefore justice comes out perverted .

verses.z: [耶和華說]：你們要向列國中觀看，大大驚奇；因為在你們的時候，我行一件事，雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。
verses.e: " Look among the nations , watch , and wonder marvelously ; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you .

verses.z: 我必興起迦勒底人，就是那殘忍暴躁之民，通行遍地，佔據那不屬自己的住處。
verses.e: For , behold , I am raising up the Chaldeans , that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth , to possess dwelling places that are not theirs .

verses.z: 他威武可畏，判斷和勢力都任意發出。
verses.e: They are feared and dreaded . Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves .

verses.z: 他的馬比豹更快，比晚上的豺狼更猛。馬兵踴躍爭先，都從遠方而來；他們飛跑如鷹抓食，
verses.e: Their horses also are swifter than leopards , and are more fierce than the evening wolves . Their horsemen press proudly on . Yes , their horsemen come from afar . They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour .

verses.z: 都為行強暴而來，定住臉面向前，將擄掠的人聚集，多如塵沙。
verses.e: All of them come for violence . Their hordes face forward . They gather prisoners like sand .

verses.z: 我要站在守望所，立在望樓上觀看，看耶和華對我說甚麼話，我可用甚麼話向他訴冤。
verses.e: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts , and will look out to see what he will say to me , and what I will answer concerning my complaint .

verses.z: 你圖謀剪除多國的民，犯了罪，使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。
verses.e: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples , and have sinned against your soul .

verses.z: 牆裏的石頭必呼叫；房內的棟樑必應聲。
verses.e: For the stone will cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it .

verses.z: 以人血建城、以罪孽立邑的有禍了！
verses.e: Woe to him who builds a town with blood , and establishes a city by iniquity !

verses.z: 眾民所勞碌得來的被火焚燒，列國由勞乏而得的歸於虛空，不都是出於萬軍之耶和華嗎？
verses.e: Behold , isn't it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire , and the nations weary themselves for vanity ?

verses.z: 認識耶和華榮耀的知識要充滿遍地，好像水充滿洋海一般。
verses.e: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD's glory , as the waters cover the sea .

verses.z: 給人[酒]喝、又加上毒物、使他喝醉、好看見他下體的有禍了！
verses.e: " Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink , pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk , so that you may gaze at their naked bodies !

verses.z: 你滿受羞辱，不得榮耀；你也喝吧，顯出是未受割禮的！耶和華右手的杯必傳到你那裏；你的榮耀就變為大大地羞辱。
verses.e: You are filled with shame , and not glory . You will also drink and be exposed ! The cup of the LORD's right hand will come around to you , and disgrace will cover your glory .

verses.z: 你向黎巴嫩行強暴與殘害驚嚇野獸的事必遮蓋你；因你殺人流血，向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴。
verses.e: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you , and the destruction of the animals will terrify you , because of men's blood and for the violence done to the land , to every city and to those who dwell in them .

verses.z: 雕刻的偶像，人將它刻出來，有甚麼益處呢？鑄造的偶像就是虛謊的師傅。製造者倚靠這啞巴偶像有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: " What value does the engraved image have , that its maker has engraved it ; the molten image , even the teacher of lies , that he who fashions its form trusts in it , to make mute idols ?

verses.z: 對木偶說：醒起！對啞巴石像說：起來！那人有禍了！這個還能教訓人嗎？看哪，是包裹金銀的，其中毫無氣息。
verses.e: Woe to him who says to the wood , ' Awake ! ' or to the mute stone , ' Arise ! ' Shall this teach ? Behold , it is overlaid with gold and silver , and there is no breath at all within it .

verses.z: 他對我說：將這默示明明地寫在版上，使讀的人容易讀。
verses.e: The LORD answered me , " Write the vision , and make it plain on tablets , that he who runs may read it .

verses.z: 惟耶和華在他的聖殿中；全地的人都當在他面前肅敬靜默。
verses.e: But the LORD is in his holy temple . Let all the earth be silent before him ! "

verses.z: 因為這默示有一定的日期，快要應驗，並不虛謊。雖然遲延，還要等候；因為必然臨到，不再遲延。
verses.e: For the vision is yet for the appointed time , and it hurries toward the end , and won't prove false . Though it takes time , wait for it , because it will surely come . It won't delay .

verses.z: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直；惟義人因信得生。
verses.e: Behold , his soul is puffed up . It is not upright in him , but the righteous will live by his faith .

verses.z: 迦勒底人因酒詭詐，狂傲，不住在家中，擴充心欲，好像陰間。他如死不能知足，聚集萬國，堆積萬民都歸自己。
verses.e: Yes , moreover , wine is treacherous : an arrogant man who doesn't stay at home , who enlarges his desire as Sheol ; he is like death and can't be satisfied , but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples .

verses.z: 這些國的民豈不都要提起詩歌並俗語譏刺他說：禍哉！迦勒底人，你增添不屬自己的財物，多多取人的當頭，要到幾時為止呢？
verses.e: Won't all these take up a parable against him , and a taunting proverb against him , and say , ' Woe to him who increases that which is not his , and who enriches himself by extortion ! How long ? '

verses.z: 咬傷你的豈不忽然起來，擾害你的豈不興起，你就作他們的擄物嗎？
verses.e: Won't your debtors rise up suddenly , and wake up those who make you tremble , and you will be their victim ?

verses.z: 因你搶奪許多的國，殺人流血，向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴，所以各國剩下的民都必搶奪你。
verses.e: Because you have plundered many nations , all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men's blood , and for the violence done to the land , to the city and to all who dwell in it .

verses.z: 為本家積蓄不義之財、在高處搭窩、指望免災的有禍了！
verses.e: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house , that he may set his nest on high , that he may be delivered from the hand of evil !

verses.z: 先知哈巴谷的禱告，調用流離歌。
verses.e: A prayer of Habakkuk , the prophet , set to victorious music .

verses.z: 山嶺見你，無不戰懼；大水氾濫過去，深淵發聲，洶湧翻騰。
verses.e: The mountains saw you , and were afraid . The storm of waters passed by . The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high .

verses.z: 因你的箭射出發光，你的槍閃出光耀，日月都在本宮停住。
verses.e: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went , at the shining of your glittering spear .

verses.z: 你發忿恨通行大地，發怒氣責打列國，如同打糧。
verses.e: You marched through the land in wrath . You threshed the nations in anger .

verses.z: 你出來要拯救你的百姓，拯救你的受膏者，打破惡人家長的頭，露出他的腳，直到頸項。（細拉）
verses.e: You went out for the salvation of your people , for the salvation of your anointed . You crushed the head of the land of wickedness . You stripped them head to foot . Selah .

verses.z: 你用[敵人的]戈矛刺透他戰士的頭；他們來如旋風，要將我們分散。他們所喜愛的是暗中吞吃貧民。
verses.e: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears . They came as a whirlwind to scatter me , gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret .

verses.z: 你乘馬踐踏紅海，就是踐踏洶湧的大水。
verses.e: You trampled the sea with your horses , churning mighty waters .

verses.z: 我聽見[耶和華的]聲音，身體戰兢，嘴唇發顫，骨中朽爛；我在所立之處戰兢。我只可安靜等候災難之日臨到，犯境之民上來。
verses.e: I heard , and my body trembled . My lips quivered at the voice . Rottenness enters into my bones , and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble , for the coming up of the people who invade us .

verses.z: 雖然無花果樹不發旺，葡萄樹不結果，橄欖樹也不效力，田地不出糧食，圈中絕了羊，棚內也沒有牛；
verses.e: For even though the fig tree doesn't flourish , nor fruit be in the vines , the labor of the olive fails , the fields yield no food , the flocks are cut off from the fold , and there is no herd in the stalls ,

verses.z: 然而，我要因耶和華歡欣，因救我的上帝喜樂。
verses.e: yet I will rejoice in the LORD . I will be joyful in the God of my salvation !

verses.z: 主耶和華是我的力量；他使我的腳快如母鹿的[蹄]，又使我穩行在高處。這歌交與伶長，用絲弦的樂器。
verses.e: GOD , the Lord , is my strength . He makes my feet like deer's feet , and enables me to go in high places . For the music director , on my stringed instruments .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我聽見你的名聲就懼怕。耶和華啊，求你在這些年間復興你的作為，在這些年間顯明出來；在發怒的時候以憐憫為念。
verses.e: LORD , I have heard of your fame . I stand in awe of your deeds , LORD . Renew your work in the middle of the years . In the middle of the years make it known . In wrath , you remember mercy .

verses.z: 上帝從提幔而來；聖者從巴蘭山臨到。（細拉）他的榮光遮蔽諸天；頌讚充滿大地。
verses.e: God came from Teman , the Holy One from Mount Paran . Selah . His glory covered the heavens , and his praise filled the earth .

verses.z: 他的輝煌如同日光；從他手裏[射出]光線，在其中藏着他的能力。
verses.e: His splendor is like the sunrise . Rays shine from his hand , where his power is hidden .

verses.z: 在他前面有瘟疫流行；在他腳下有熱症發出。
verses.e: Plague went before him , and pestilence followed his feet .

verses.z: 他站立，量了大地，觀看，趕散萬民。永久的山崩裂；長存的嶺塌陷；他的作為與古時一樣。
verses.e: He stood , and shook the earth . He looked , and made the nations tremble . The ancient mountains were crumbled . The age-old hills collapsed . His ways are eternal .

verses.z: 我見古珊的帳棚遭難，米甸的幔子戰兢。
verses.e: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction . The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你乘在馬上，坐在得勝的車上，豈是不喜悅江河、向江河發怒氣、向洋海發憤恨嗎？
verses.e: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers ? Was your anger against the rivers , or your wrath against the sea , that you rode on your horses , on your chariots of salvation ?

verses.z: 你的弓全然顯露，向眾支派所起的誓都是[可信的]。（細拉）你以江河分開大地。
verses.e: You uncovered your bow . You called for your sworn arrows . Selah . You split the earth with rivers .

verses.z: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和華的話藉先知哈該向猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞說：
verses.e: In the second year of Darius the king , in the sixth month , in the first day of the month , the LORD's word came by Haggai the prophet , to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , saying ,

verses.z: 所以為你們的緣故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土產。
verses.e: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew , and the earth withholds its fruit .

verses.z: 我命乾旱臨到地土、山岡、五穀、新酒，和油，並地上的出產、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切勞碌得來的。」
verses.e: I called for a drought on the land , on the mountains , on the grain , on the new wine , on the oil , on that which the ground produces , on men , on livestock , and on all the labor of the hands . "

verses.z: 那時，撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下的百姓，都聽從耶和華－他們上帝的話和先知哈該奉耶和華－他們上帝差來所說的話；百姓也在耶和華面前存敬畏的心。
verses.e: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , with all the remnant of the people , obeyed the LORD their God's voice , and the words of Haggai the prophet , as the LORD their God had sent him ; and the people feared the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者哈該奉耶和華差遣對百姓說：「耶和華說：我與你們同在。」
verses.e: Then Haggai , the LORD's messenger , spoke the LORD's message to the people , saying , " I am with you , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華激動猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下之百姓的心，他們就來為萬軍之耶和華－他們上帝的殿做工。
verses.e: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and the spirit of all the remnant of the people ; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies , their God ,

verses.z: 這是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。
verses.e: in the twenty-fourth day of the month , in the sixth month , in the second year of Darius the king .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「這百姓說，建造耶和華殿的時候尚未來到。」
verses.e: " This is what the LORD of Armies says : These people say , ' The time hasn't yet come , the time for the LORD's house to be built . ' "

verses.z: 那時耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
verses.e: Then the LORD's word came by Haggai the prophet , saying ,

verses.z: 「這殿仍然荒涼，你們自己還住天花板的房屋嗎？
verses.e: " Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses , while this house lies waste ?

verses.z: 現在萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要省察自己的行為。
verses.e: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says : ' Consider your ways .

verses.z: 你們撒的種多，收的卻少；你們吃，卻不得飽；喝，卻不得足；穿衣服，卻不得暖；得工錢的，將工錢[裝]在破漏的囊中。」
verses.e: You have sown much , and bring in little . You eat , but you don't have enough . You drink , but you aren't filled with drink . You clothe yourselves , but no one is warm ; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it . '

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「你們要省察自己的行為。
verses.e: " This is what the LORD of Armies says : ' Consider your ways .

verses.z: 你們要上山取木料，建造這殿，我就因此喜樂，且得榮耀。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Go up to the mountain , bring wood , and build the house . I will take pleasure in it , and I will be glorified , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 你們盼望多得，所得的卻少；你們收到家中，我就吹去。這是為甚麼呢？因為我的殿荒涼，你們各人卻顧自己的房屋。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: " You looked for much , and , behold , it came to little ; and when you brought it home , I blew it away . Why ? " says the LORD of Armies , " Because of my house that lies waste , while each of you is busy with his own house .

verses.z: 七[月]二十一[日]，耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
verses.e: In the seventh month , in the twenty-first day of the month , the LORD's word came by Haggai the prophet , saying ,

verses.z: 大流士王第二年九[月]二十四[日]，耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
verses.e: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month , in the second year of Darius , the LORD's word came by Haggai the prophet , saying ,

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「你要向祭司問律法，
verses.e: " The LORD of Armies says : Ask now the priests concerning the law , saying ,

verses.z: 說：若有人用衣襟兜聖肉，這衣襟挨着餅，或湯，或酒，或油，或別的食物，便算為聖嗎？」祭司說：「不算為聖。」
verses.e: ' If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment , and with his fold touches bread , stew , wine , oil , or any food , will it become holy ? ' " The priests answered , " No . "

verses.z: 哈該又說：「若有人因摸死屍染了污穢，然後挨着這些物的哪一樣，這物算污穢嗎？」祭司說：「必算污穢。」
verses.e: Then Haggai said , " If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these , will it be unclean ? " The priests answered , " It will be unclean . "

verses.z: 於是哈該說：「耶和華說：這民這國，在我面前也是如此；他們手下的各樣工作都是如此；他們在壇上所獻的也是如此。」
verses.e: Then Haggai answered , " ' So is this people , and so is this nation before me , ' says the LORD ; ' and so is every work of their hands . That which they offer there is unclean .

verses.z: 現在你們要追想，此日以前，耶和華的殿沒有一塊石頭壘在石頭上的光景。
verses.e: Now , please consider from this day and backward , before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD's temple .

verses.z: 在那一切日子，有人來到[穀]堆，想得二十[斗]，只得了十[斗]。有人來到酒池，想得五十[桶]，只得了二十[桶]。
verses.e: Through all that time , when one came to a heap of twenty measures , there were only ten . When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty , there were only twenty .

verses.z: 在你們手下的各樣工作上，我以旱風、霉爛、冰雹攻擊你們，你們仍不[歸向]我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I struck you with blight , mildew , and hail in all the work of your hands ; yet you didn't turn to me , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 你們要追想此日以前，就是從這九月二十四日起，追想到立耶和華殿根基的日子。
verses.e: ' Consider , please , from this day and backward , from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month , since the day that the foundation of the LORD's temple was laid , consider it .

verses.z: 倉裏有穀種嗎？葡萄樹、無花果樹、石榴樹、橄欖樹都沒有結果子。從今日起，我必賜福[與你們]。
verses.e: Is the seed yet in the barn ? Yes , the vine , the fig tree , the pomegranate , and the olive tree haven't produced . From today I will bless you . ' "

verses.z: 「你要曉諭猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下的百姓，說：
verses.e: " Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and to the remnant of the people , saying ,

verses.z: 這月二十四日，耶和華的話二次臨到哈該說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要告訴猶大省長所羅巴伯說：我必震動天地。
verses.e: " Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , ' I will shake the heavens and the earth .

verses.z: 我必傾覆列國的寶座，除滅列邦的勢力，並傾覆戰車和坐在其上的。馬必跌倒，騎馬的敗落，各人被弟兄的刀所殺。
verses.e: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms . I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations . I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them . The horses and their riders will come down , everyone by the sword of his brother .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：我僕人撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯啊，到那日，我必以你為印，因我揀選了你。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
verses.e: In that day , says the LORD of Armies , I will take you , Zerubbabel my servant , the son of Shealtiel , ' says the LORD , ' and will make you like a signet ring , for I have chosen you , ' says the LORD of Armies . "

verses.z: 你們中間存留的，有誰見過這殿從前的榮耀呢？現在你們看着如何？豈不在眼中看如無有嗎？」
verses.e: ' Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory ? How do you see it now ? Isn't it in your eyes as nothing ?

verses.z: 耶和華說：「所羅巴伯啊，雖然如此，你當剛強！約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞啊，你也當剛強！這地的百姓，你們都當剛強做工，因為我與你們同在。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: Yet now be strong , Zerubbabel , ' says the LORD . ' Be strong , Joshua son of Jehozadak , the high priest . Be strong , all you people of the land , ' says the LORD , ' and work , for I am with you , ' says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 這是[照着]你們出埃及我與你們立約的話。那時，我的靈住在你們中間，你們不要懼怕。」
verses.e: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt , and my Spirit lived among you . ' Don't be afraid . '

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「過不多時，我必再一次震動天地、滄海，與旱地。
verses.e: For this is what the LORD of Armies says : ' Yet once more , it is a little while , and I will shake the heavens , the earth , the sea , and the dry land ;

verses.z: 我必震動萬國；萬國的珍寶必都運來，我就使這殿滿了榮耀。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
verses.e: and I will shake all nations . The treasure of all nations will come , and I will fill this house with glory , says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「銀子是我的，金子也是我的。
verses.e: The silver is mine , and the gold is mine , ' says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 這殿後來的榮耀必大過先前的榮耀；在這地方我必賜平安。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
verses.e: ' The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former , ' says the LORD of Armies ; ' and in this place I will give peace , ' says the LORD of Armies . "

verses.z: 上帝既在古時藉着眾先知多次多方地曉諭列祖，
verses.e: God , having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways ,

verses.z: 又說：主啊，你起初立了地的根基；天也是你手所造的。
verses.e: And , " You , Lord , in the beginning , laid the foundation of the earth . The heavens are the works of your hands .

verses.z: 天地都要滅沒，你卻要長存。天地都要像衣服漸漸舊了；
verses.e: They will perish , but you continue . They all will grow old like a garment does .

verses.z: 你要將天地捲起來，像一件外衣，天地就都改變了。惟有你永不改變；你的年數沒有窮盡。
verses.e: You will roll them up like a mantle , and they will be changed ; but you are the same . Your years won't fail . "

verses.z: 所有的天使，上帝從來對哪一個說：你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳？
verses.e: But which of the angels has he told at any time , " Sit at my right hand , until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet ? "

verses.z: 天使豈不都是服役的靈、奉差遣為那將要承受救恩的人效力嗎？
verses.e: Aren't they all serving spirits , sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation ?

verses.z: 就在這末世藉着他兒子曉諭我們；又早已立他為承受萬有的，也曾藉着他創造諸世界。
verses.e: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son , whom he appointed heir of all things , through whom also he made the worlds .

verses.z: 他是上帝榮耀所發的光輝，是上帝本體的真像，常用他權能的命令托住萬有。他洗淨了人的罪，就坐在高天至大者的右邊。
verses.e: His Son is the radiance of his glory , the very image of his substance , and upholding all things by the word of his power , who , when he had by himself purified us of our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high ,

verses.z: 他所承受的名，既比天使的名更尊貴，就遠超過天使。
verses.e: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs .

verses.z: 所有的天使，上帝從來對哪一個說：你是我的兒子，我今日生你？又指着哪一個說：我要作他的父，他要作我的子？
verses.e: For to which of the angels did he say at any time , " You are my Son . Today I have become your father ? " and again , " I will be to him a Father , and he will be to me a Son ? "

verses.z: 再者，上帝使長子到世上來的時候，就說：上帝的使者都要拜他。
verses.e: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says , " Let all the angels of God worship him . "

verses.z: 論到使者，又說：上帝以風為使者，以火焰為僕役；
verses.e: Of the angels he says , " He makes his angels winds , and his servants a flame of fire . "

verses.z: 論到子卻說：上帝啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的；你的國權是正直的。
verses.e: But of the Son he says , " Your throne , O God , is forever and ever . The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom .

verses.z: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡；所以上帝，就是你的上帝，用喜樂油膏你，勝過膏你的同伴；
verses.e: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity ; therefore God , your God , has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows . "

verses.z: 律法既是將來美事的影兒，不是本物的真像，總不能藉着每年常獻一樣的祭物叫那近前來的人得以完全。
verses.e: For the law , having a shadow of the good to come , not the very image of the things , can never with the same sacrifices year by year , which they offer continually , make perfect those who draw near .

verses.z: 我們憑這旨意，靠耶穌基督，只一次獻上他的身體，就得以成聖。
verses.e: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .

verses.z: 凡祭司天天站着事奉[上帝]，屢次獻上一樣的祭物，這祭物永不能除罪。
verses.e: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices , which can never take away sins ,

verses.z: 但基督獻了一次永遠的贖罪祭，就在上帝的右邊坐下了。
verses.e: but he , when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever , sat down on the right hand of God ,

verses.z: 從此，等候他仇敵成了他的腳凳。
verses.e: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet .

verses.z: 因為他一次獻祭，便叫那得以成聖的人永遠完全。
verses.e: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified .

verses.z: 聖靈也對我們作見證；因為他既已說過：
verses.e: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us , for after saying ,

verses.z: 主說：那些日子以後，我與他們所立的約乃是這樣：我要將我的律法寫在他們心上，又要放在他們的裏面。
verses.e: " This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days , " says the Lord , " I will put my laws on their heart , I will also write them on their mind ; " then he says ,

verses.z: [以後就說]：我不再記念他們的罪愆和他們的過犯。
verses.e: " I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more . "

verses.z: 這些罪過既已赦免，就不用再為罪獻祭了。
verses.e: Now where remission of these is , there is no more offering for sin .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我們既因耶穌的血得以坦然進入至聖所，
verses.e: Having therefore , brothers , boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus ,

verses.z: 若不然，獻祭的事豈不早已止住了嗎？因為禮拜的人，良心既被潔淨，就不再覺得有罪了。
verses.e: Or else wouldn't they have ceased to be offered , because the worshipers , having been once cleansed , would have had no more consciousness of sins ?

verses.z: 是藉着他給我們開了一條又新又活的路，從幔子經過，這幔子就是他的身體。
verses.e: by the way which he dedicated for us , a new and living way , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh ,

verses.z: 又有一位大祭司治理上帝的家，
verses.e: and having a great priest over God's house ,

verses.z: 並我們心中天良的虧欠已經灑去，身體用清水洗淨了，就當存着誠心和充足的信心來到上帝面前；
verses.e: let's draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith , having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water ,

verses.z: 也要堅守我們所承認的指望，不致搖動，因為那應許我們的是信實的。
verses.e: let's hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering ; for he who promised is faithful .

verses.z: 又要彼此相顧，激發愛心，勉勵行善。
verses.e: Let's consider how to provoke one another to love and good works ,

verses.z: 你們不可停止聚會，好像那些停止慣了的人，倒要彼此勸勉，既知道那日子臨近，就更當如此。
verses.e: not forsaking our own assembling together , as the custom of some is , but exhorting one another , and so much the more as you see the Day approaching .

verses.z: 因為我們得知真道以後，若故意犯罪，贖罪的祭就再沒有了；
verses.e: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth , there remains no more a sacrifice for sins ,

verses.z: 惟有戰懼等候審判和那燒滅眾敵人的烈火。
verses.e: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment , and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries .

verses.z: 人干犯摩西的律法，憑兩三個見證人，尚且不得憐恤而死，
verses.e: A man who disregards Moses ' law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses .

verses.z: 何況人踐踏上帝的兒子，將那使他成聖之約的血當作平常，又褻慢施恩的[聖]靈，你們想，他要受的刑罰該怎樣加重呢！
verses.e: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God , and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing , and has insulted the Spirit of grace ?

verses.z: 但這些[祭物]是叫人每年想起罪來；
verses.e: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins .

verses.z: 因為我們知道誰說：「伸冤在我，我必報應」；又[說]：「主要審判他的百姓。」
verses.e: For we know him who said , " Vengeance belongs to me . I will repay , " says the Lord . Again , " The Lord will judge his people . "

verses.z: 落在永生上帝的手裏，真是可怕的！
verses.e: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God .

verses.z: 你們要追念往日，蒙了光照以後所忍受大爭戰的各樣苦難：
verses.e: But remember the former days , in which , after you were enlightened , you endured a great struggle with sufferings :

verses.z: 一面被毀謗，遭患難，成了戲景，叫眾人觀看；一面陪伴那些受這樣苦難的人。
verses.e: partly , being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions , and partly , becoming partakers with those who were treated so .

verses.z: 因為你們體恤了那些被捆鎖的人，並且你們的家業被人搶去，也甘心忍受，知道自己有更美長存的家業。
verses.e: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions , knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens .

verses.z: 所以，你們不可丟棄勇敢的心；存這樣的心必得大賞賜。
verses.e: Therefore don't throw away your boldness , which has a great reward .

verses.z: 你們必須忍耐，使你們行完了上帝的旨意，就可以得着所應許的。
verses.e: For you need endurance so that , having done the will of God , you may receive the promise .

verses.z: 因為還有一點點時候，那要來的就來，並不遲延；
verses.e: " In a very little while , he who comes will come and will not wait .

verses.z: 只是義人必因信得生。他若退後，我心裏就不喜歡他。
verses.e: But the righteous one will live by faith . If he shrinks back , my soul has no pleasure in him . "

verses.z: 我們卻不是退後入沉淪的那等人，乃是有信心以致靈魂得救的人。
verses.e: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction , but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul .

verses.z: 因為公牛和山羊的血，斷不能除罪。
verses.e: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins .

verses.z: 所以基督到世上來的時候，就說：[上帝啊]，祭物和禮物是你不願意的；你曾給我預備了身體。
verses.e: Therefore when he comes into the world , he says , " You didn't desire sacrifice and offering , but you prepared a body for me .

verses.z: 燔祭和贖罪[祭]是你不喜歡的。
verses.e: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin .

verses.z: 那時我說：上帝啊，我來了，為要照你的旨意行；我的事在經卷上已經記載了。
verses.e: Then I said , ' Behold , I have come ( in the scroll of the book it is written of me ) to do your will , O God . ' "

verses.z: 以上說：「祭物和禮物，燔祭和贖罪祭，是你不願意的，也是你不喜歡的（這都是按着律法獻的）」；
verses.e: Previously saying , " Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn't desire , neither had pleasure in them " ( those which are offered according to the law ) ,

verses.z: 後又說：「我來了為要照你的旨意行」；[可見]他是除去在先的，為要立定在後的。
verses.e: then he has said , " Behold , I have come to do your will . " He takes away the first , that he may establish the second ,

verses.z: 信就是所望之事的實底，是未見之事的確據。
verses.e: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for , proof of things not seen .

verses.z: 因為他等候那座有根基的城，就是上帝所經營所建造的。
verses.e: For he was looking for the city which has foundations , whose builder and maker is God .

verses.z: 因着信，連撒拉自己，雖然過了生育的歲數，還能懷孕，因她以為那應許她的是可信的。
verses.e: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive , and she bore a child when she was past age , since she counted him faithful who had promised .

verses.z: 所以從一個彷彿已死的人就生出[子孫]，如同天上的星那樣眾多，海邊的沙那樣無數。
verses.e: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude , and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore , were fathered by one man , and him as good as dead .

verses.z: 這些人都是存着信心死的，並沒有得着所應許的；卻從遠處望見，且歡喜迎接，又承認自己在世上是客旅，是寄居的。
verses.e: These all died in faith , not having received the promises , but having seen them and embraced them from afar , and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth .

verses.z: 說這樣話的人是表明自己要找一個家鄉。
verses.e: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own .

verses.z: 他們若想念所離開的家鄉，還有可以回去的機會。
verses.e: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out , they would have had enough time to return .

verses.z: 他們卻羨慕一個更美的家鄉，就是在天上的。所以上帝被稱為他們的上帝，並不以為恥，因為他已經給他們預備了一座城。
verses.e: But now they desire a better country , that is , a heavenly one . Therefore God is not ashamed of them , to be called their God , for he has prepared a city for them .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕因着信，被試驗的時候，就把以撒獻上；這便是那歡喜領受應許的，將自己獨生的兒子獻上。
verses.e: By faith , Abraham , being tested , offered up Isaac . Yes , he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son ,

verses.z: [論到這兒子]，曾有話說：「從以撒生的才要稱為你的後裔。」
verses.e: to whom it was said , " Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac , "

verses.z: 他以為上帝還能叫人從死裏復活；他也彷彿從死中得回他的兒子來。
verses.e: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead . Figuratively speaking , he also did receive him back from the dead .

verses.z: 古人在這信上得了美好的證據。
verses.e: For by this , the elders obtained approval .

verses.z: 以撒因着信，就指着將來的事給雅各、以掃祝福。
verses.e: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau , even concerning things to come .

verses.z: 雅各因着信，臨死的時候，給約瑟的兩個兒子各自祝福，扶着杖頭敬拜上帝。
verses.e: By faith Jacob , when he was dying , blessed each of the sons of Joseph , and worshiped , leaning on the top of his staff .

verses.z: 約瑟因着信，臨終的時候，提到以色列族將來要出[埃及]，並為自己的骸骨留下遺命。
verses.e: By faith Joseph , when his end was near , made mention of the departure of the children of Israel , and gave instructions concerning his bones .

verses.z: 摩西生下來，他的父母見他是個俊美的孩子，就因着信，把他藏了三個月，並不怕王命。
verses.e: By faith Moses , when he was born , was hidden for three months by his parents , because they saw that he was a beautiful child ; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment .

verses.z: 摩西因着信，長大了就不肯稱為法老女兒之子。
verses.e: By faith Moses , when he had grown up , refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter ,

verses.z: 他寧可和上帝的百姓同受苦害，也不願暫時享受罪中之樂。
verses.e: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God's people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time ,

verses.z: 他看為基督受的凌辱比埃及的財物更寶貴，因他想望所要得的賞賜。
verses.e: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt ; for he looked to the reward .

verses.z: 他因着信，就離開埃及，不怕王怒；因為他恆心忍耐，如同看見那不能看見的[主]。
verses.e: By faith he left Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king ; for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .

verses.z: 他因着信，就守逾越節，行灑血的禮，免得那滅長子的臨近以色列人。
verses.e: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood , that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them .

verses.z: 他們因着信，過紅海如行乾地；埃及人試着要過去，就被吞滅了。
verses.e: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land . When the Egyptians tried to do so , they were swallowed up .

verses.z: 我們因着信，就知道諸世界是藉上帝話造成的；這樣，所看見的，並不是從顯然之物造出來的。
verses.e: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God , so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible .

verses.z: 以色列人因着信，圍繞耶利哥城七日，城牆就倒塌了。
verses.e: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days .

verses.z: 妓女喇合因着信，曾和和平平地接待探子，就不與那些不順從的人一同滅亡。
verses.e: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn't perish with those who were disobedient , having received the spies in peace .

verses.z: 我又何必再說呢？若要一一細說，基甸、巴拉、參孫、耶弗他、大衛、撒母耳，和眾先知的事，時候就不夠了。
verses.e: What more shall I say ? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon , Barak , Samson , Jephthah , David , Samuel , and the prophets —

verses.z: 他們因着信，制伏了敵國，行了公義，得了應許，堵了獅子的口，
verses.e: who through faith subdued kingdoms , worked out righteousness , obtained promises , stopped the mouths of lions ,

verses.z: 滅了烈火的猛勢，脫了刀劍的鋒刃；軟弱變為剛強，爭戰顯出勇敢，打退外邦的全軍。
verses.e: quenched the power of fire , escaped the edge of the sword , from weakness were made strong , grew mighty in war , and caused foreign armies to flee .

verses.z: 有婦人得自己的死人復活。又有人忍受嚴刑，不肯苟且得釋放，為要得着更美的復活。
verses.e: Women received their dead by resurrection . Others were tortured , not accepting their deliverance , that they might obtain a better resurrection .

verses.z: 又有人忍受戲弄、鞭打、捆鎖、監禁、各等的磨煉，
verses.e: Others were tried by mocking and scourging , yes , moreover by bonds and imprisonment .

verses.z: 被石頭打死，被鋸鋸死，受試探，被刀殺，披着綿羊、山羊的皮各處奔跑，受窮乏、患難、苦害，
verses.e: They were stoned . They were sawn apart . They were tempted . They were slain with the sword . They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins ; being destitute , afflicted , ill-treated —

verses.z: 在曠野、山嶺、山洞、地穴，飄流無定，本是世界不配有的人。
verses.e: of whom the world was not worthy — wandering in deserts , mountains , caves , and the holes of the earth .

verses.z: 這些人都是因信得了美好的證據，卻仍未得着所應許的；
verses.e: These all , having been commended for their faith , didn't receive the promise ,

verses.z: 亞伯因着信，獻祭與上帝，比該隱所獻的更美，因此便得了稱義的見證，就是上帝指他禮物作的見證。他雖然死了，卻因這信，仍舊說話。
verses.e: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain , through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous , God testifying with respect to his gifts ; and through it he , being dead , still speaks .

verses.z: 因為上帝給我們預備了更美的事，叫他們若不與我們同得，就不能完全。
verses.e: God having provided some better thing concerning us , so that apart from us they should not be made perfect .

verses.z: 以諾因着信，被接去，不至於見死，人也找不着他，因為上帝已經把他接去了；只是他被接去以先，已經得了上帝喜悅他的明證。
verses.e: By faith Enoch was taken away , so that he wouldn't see death , and he was not found , because God translated him . For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God .

verses.z: 人非有信，就不能得上帝的喜悅；因為到上帝面前來的人必須信有上帝，且信他賞賜那尋求他的人。
verses.e: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him , for he who comes to God must believe that he exists , and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him .

verses.z: 挪亞因着信，既蒙[上帝]指示他未見的事，動了敬畏的心，預備了一隻方舟，使他全家得救。因此就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那從信而來的義。
verses.e: By faith Noah , being warned about things not yet seen , moved with godly fear , prepared a ship for the saving of his house , through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕因着信，蒙召的時候就遵命出去，往將來要得為業的地方去；出去的時候，還不知往哪裏去。
verses.e: By faith Abraham , when he was called , obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance . He went out , not knowing where he went .

verses.z: 他因着信，就在所應許之地作客，好像在異地居住帳棚，與那同蒙一個應許的以撒、雅各一樣。
verses.e: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise , as in a land not his own , dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob , the heirs with him of the same promise .

verses.z: 我們既有這許多的見證人，如同雲彩圍着我們，就當放下各樣的重擔，脫去容易纏累我們的罪，存心忍耐，奔那擺在我們前頭的路程，
verses.e: Therefore let's also , seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses , lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us , and let's run with perseverance the race that is set before us ,

verses.z: 生身的父都是暫隨己意管教我們；惟有萬靈的父管教我們，是要我們得益處，使我們在他的聖潔上有分。
verses.e: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them , but he for our profit , that we may be partakers of his holiness .

verses.z: 凡管教的事，當時不覺得快樂，反覺得愁苦；後來卻為那經練過的人結出平安的果子，就是義。
verses.e: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous ; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it .

verses.z: 所以，你們要把下垂的手、發酸的腿挺起來；
verses.e: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees ,

verses.z: 也要為自己的腳，把道路修直了，使瘸子不致歪腳，反得痊癒。
verses.e: and make straight paths for your feet , so what is lame may not be dislocated , but rather be healed .

verses.z: 你們要追求與眾人和睦，並要追求聖潔；非聖潔沒有人能見主。
verses.e: Follow after peace with all men , and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord ,

verses.z: 又要謹慎，恐怕有人失了上帝的恩；恐怕有毒根生出來擾亂你們，因此叫眾人沾染污穢；
verses.e: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God , lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it ,

verses.z: 恐怕有淫亂的，有貪戀世俗如以掃的，他因一點食物把自己長子的名分賣了。
verses.e: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person , like Esau , who sold his birthright for one meal .

verses.z: 後來想要承受父所祝的福，竟被棄絕，雖然號哭切求，卻得不着門路使他[父親]的心意回轉。這是你們知道的。
verses.e: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing , he was rejected , for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears .

verses.z: 你們原不是來到那能摸的山；此山有火焰、密雲、黑暗、暴風、
verses.e: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire , and to blackness , darkness , storm ,

verses.z: 角聲與說話的聲音。那些聽見這聲音的，都求不要再向他們說話；
verses.e: the sound of a trumpet , and the voice of words ; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them ,

verses.z: 仰望為我們信心創始成終的耶穌。他因那擺在前面的喜樂，就輕看羞辱，忍受了十字架[的苦難]，便坐在上帝寶座的右邊。
verses.e: looking to Jesus , the author and perfecter of faith , who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising its shame , and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God .

verses.z: 因為他們當不起所命他們的話，說：「靠近這山的，即便是走獸，也要用石頭打死。」
verses.e: for they could not stand that which was commanded , " If even an animal touches the mountain , it shall be stoned " .

verses.z: 所見的極其可怕，甚至摩西說：「我甚是恐懼戰兢。」
verses.e: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said , " I am terrified and trembling . "

verses.z: 你們乃是來到錫安山，永生上帝的城邑，就是天上的耶路撒冷。那裏有千萬的天使，
verses.e: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to innumerable multitudes of angels ,

verses.z: 有名錄在天上諸長子之會所共聚的總會，有審判眾人的上帝和被成全之義人的靈魂，
verses.e: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven , to God the Judge of all , to the spirits of just men made perfect ,

verses.z: 並新約的中保耶穌，以及所灑的血；這血所說的比亞伯的血所說的更美。
verses.e: to Jesus , the mediator of a new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel .

verses.z: 你們總要謹慎，不可棄絕那向你們說話的。因為，那些棄絕在地上警戒他們的尚且不能逃罪，何況我們違背那從天上警戒我們的呢？
verses.e: See that you don't refuse him who speaks . For if they didn't escape when they refused him who warned on the earth , how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven ,

verses.z: 當時他的聲音震動了地，但如今他應許說：「再一次我不單要震動地，還要震動天。」
verses.e: whose voice shook the earth then , but now he has promised , saying , " Yet once more I will shake not only the earth , but also the heavens . "

verses.z: 這再一次的話，是指明被震動的，就是受造之物都要挪去，使那不被震動的常存。
verses.e: This phrase , " Yet once more " signifies the removing of those things that are shaken , as of things that have been made , that those things which are not shaken may remain .

verses.z: 所以我們既得了不能震動的國，就當感恩，照上帝所喜悅的，用虔誠、敬畏的心事奉上帝。
verses.e: Therefore , receiving a Kingdom that can't be shaken , let's have grace , through which we serve God acceptably , with reverence and awe ,

verses.z: 因為我們的上帝乃是烈火。
verses.e: for our God is a consuming fire .

verses.z: 那忍受罪人這樣頂撞的，你們要思想，免得疲倦灰心。
verses.e: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself , that you don't grow weary , fainting in your souls .

verses.z: 你們與罪惡相爭，還沒有抵擋到流血的地步。
verses.e: You have not yet resisted to blood , striving against sin .

verses.z: 你們又忘了那勸你們如同勸兒子的話，說：我兒，你不可輕看主的管教，被他責備的時候也不可灰心；
verses.e: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children , " My son , don't take lightly the chastening of the Lord , nor faint when you are reproved by him ;

verses.z: 因為主所愛的，他必管教，又鞭打凡所收納的兒子。
verses.e: for whom the Lord loves , he disciplines , and chastises every son whom he receives . "

verses.z: 你們所忍受的，是上帝管教你們，待你們如同待兒子。焉有兒子不被父親管教的呢？
verses.e: It is for discipline that you endure . God deals with you as with children , for what son is there whom his father doesn't discipline ?

verses.z: 管教原是眾子所共受的。你們若不受管教，就是私子，不是兒子了。
verses.e: But if you are without discipline , of which all have been made partakers , then you are illegitimate , and not children .

verses.z: 再者，我們曾有生身的父管教我們，我們尚且敬重他，何況萬靈的父，我們豈不更當順服他得生嗎？
verses.e: Furthermore , we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us , and we paid them respect . Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live ?

verses.z: 你們務要常存弟兄相愛的心。
verses.e: Let brotherly love continue .

verses.z: 我們有一祭壇，上面的祭物是那些在帳幕中供職的人不可同吃的。
verses.e: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat .

verses.z: 原來牲畜的血被大祭司帶入聖所作贖罪祭；牲畜的身子被燒在營外。
verses.e: For the bodies of those animals , whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin , are burned outside of the camp .

verses.z: 所以，耶穌要用自己的血叫百姓成聖，也就在城門外受苦。
verses.e: Therefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people through his own blood , suffered outside of the gate .

verses.z: 這樣，我們也當出到營外，就了他去，忍受他所受的凌辱。
verses.e: Let's therefore go out to him outside of the camp , bearing his reproach .

verses.z: 我們在這裏本沒有常存的城，乃是尋求那將來的城。
verses.e: For we don't have here an enduring city , but we seek that which is to come .

verses.z: 我們應當靠着耶穌，常常以頌讚為祭獻給上帝，這就是那承認主名之人嘴唇的果子。
verses.e: Through him , then , let's offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name .

verses.z: 只是不可忘記行善和捐輸的事，因為這樣的祭是上帝所喜悅的。
verses.e: But don't forget to be doing good and sharing , for with such sacrifices God is well pleased .

verses.z: 你們要依從那些引導你們的，且要順服；因他們為你們的靈魂時刻警醒，好像那將來交帳的人。你們要使他們交的時候有快樂，不致憂愁；若憂愁就與你們無益了。
verses.e: Obey your leaders and submit to them , for they watch on behalf of your souls , as those who will give account , that they may do this with joy and not with groaning , for that would be unprofitable for you .

verses.z: 請你們為我們禱告，因我們自覺良心無虧，願意凡事按正道而行。
verses.e: Pray for us , for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience , desiring to live honorably in all things .

verses.z: 我更求你們為我禱告，使我快些回到你們那裏去。
verses.e: I strongly urge you to do this , that I may be restored to you sooner .

verses.z: 不可忘記用愛心接待客旅；因為曾有接待客旅的，不知不覺就接待了天使。
verses.e: Don't forget to show hospitality to strangers , for in doing so , some have entertained angels without knowing it .

verses.z: 但願賜平安的上帝，就是那憑永約之血、使群羊的大牧人－我主耶穌從死裏復活的上帝，
verses.e: Now may the God of peace , who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant , our Lord Jesus ,

verses.z: 在各樣善事上成全你們，叫你們遵行他的旨意；又藉着耶穌基督在你們心裏行他所喜悅的事。願榮耀歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: make you complete in every good work to do his will , working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight , through Jesus Christ , to whom be the glory forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我略略寫信給你們，望你們聽我勸勉的話。
verses.e: But I exhort you , brothers , endure the word of exhortation , for I have written to you in few words .

verses.z: 你們該知道，我們的兄弟提摩太已經釋放了；他若快來，我必同他去見你們。
verses.e: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed , with whom , if he comes shortly , I will see you .

verses.z: 請你們問引導你們的諸位和眾聖徒安。從意大利來的人也問你們安。
verses.e: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints . The Italians greet you .

verses.z: 願恩惠[常]與你們眾人同在。阿們！
verses.e: Grace be with you all . Amen .

verses.z: 你們要記念被捆綁的人，好像與他們同受捆綁；也要記念遭苦害的人，想到自己也在肉身之內。
verses.e: Remember those who are in bonds , as bound with them , and those who are ill-treated , since you are also in the body .

verses.z: 婚姻，人人都當尊重，床也不可污穢；因為苟合行淫的人，上帝必要審判。
verses.e: Let marriage be held in honor among all , and let the bed be undefiled ; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers .

verses.z: 你們存心不可貪愛錢財，要以自己所有的為足；因為主曾說：「我總不撇下你，也不丟棄你。」
verses.e: Be free from the love of money , content with such things as you have , for he has said , " I will in no way leave you , neither will I in any way forsake you . "

verses.z: 所以我們可以放膽說：主是幫助我的，我必不懼怕；人能把我怎麼樣呢？
verses.e: So that with good courage we say , " The Lord is my helper . I will not fear . What can man do to me ? "

verses.z: 從前引導你們、傳上帝之道給你們的人，你們要想念他們，效法他們的信心，留心看他們為人的結局。
verses.e: Remember your leaders , men who spoke to you the word of God , and considering the results of their conduct , imitate their faith .

verses.z: 耶穌基督昨日、今日、一直到永遠，是一樣的。
verses.e: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday , today , and forever .

verses.z: 你們不要被那諸般怪異的教訓勾引了去；因為人心靠恩得堅固才是好的，並不是靠飲食。那在飲食上專心的從來沒有得着益處。
verses.e: Don't be carried away by various and strange teachings , for it is good that the heart be established by grace , not by foods , through which those who were so occupied were not benefited .

verses.z: 所以，我們當越發鄭重所聽見的道理，恐怕我們隨流失去。
verses.e: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard , lest perhaps we drift away .

verses.z: 原來那為萬物所屬、為萬物所本的，要領許多的兒子進榮耀裏去，使救他們的元帥，因受苦難得以完全，本是合宜的。
verses.e: For it became him , for whom are all things and through whom are all things , in bringing many children to glory , to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings .

verses.z: 因那使人成聖的和那些得以成聖的，都是出於一。所以，他稱他們為弟兄也不以為恥，
verses.e: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one , for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers ,

verses.z: 說：我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄，在會中我要頌揚你；
verses.e: saying , " I will declare your name to my brothers . Among the congregation I will sing your praise . "

verses.z: 又說：我要倚賴他；又說：看哪，我與上帝所給我的兒女。
verses.e: Again , " I will put my trust in him . " Again , " Behold , here I am with the children whom God has given me . "

verses.z: 兒女既同有血肉之體，他也照樣親自成了血肉之體，特要藉着死敗壞那掌死權的，就是魔鬼，
verses.e: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood , he also himself in the same way partook of the same , that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death , that is , the devil ,

verses.z: 並要釋放那些一生因怕死而為奴僕的人。
verses.e: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage .

verses.z: 他並不救拔天使，乃是救拔亞伯拉罕的後裔。
verses.e: For most certainly , he doesn't give help to angels , but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham .

verses.z: 所以，他凡事該與他的弟兄相同，為要在上帝的事上成為慈悲忠信的大祭司，為百姓的罪獻上挽回祭。
verses.e: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers , that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God , to make atonement for the sins of the people .

verses.z: 他自己既然被試探而受苦，就能搭救被試探的人。
verses.e: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted , he is able to help those who are tempted .

verses.z: 那藉着天使所傳的話既是確定的；凡干犯悖逆的都受了該受的報應。
verses.e: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast , and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty ,

verses.z: 我們若忽略這麼大的救恩，怎能逃罪呢？這救恩起先是主親自講的，後來是聽見的人給我們證實了。
verses.e: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation — which at the first having been spoken through the Lord , was confirmed to us by those who heard ,

verses.z: 上帝又按自己的旨意，用神蹟、奇事和百般的異能，並聖靈的恩賜，同他們作見證。
verses.e: God also testifying with them , both by signs and wonders , by various works of power , and by gifts of the Holy Spirit , according to his own will ?

verses.z: 我們所說將來的世界，上帝原沒有交給天使管轄。
verses.e: For he didn't subject the world to come , of which we speak , to angels .

verses.z: 但有人在[經上]某處證明說：人算甚麼，你竟顧念他？世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他？
verses.e: But one has somewhere testified , saying , " What is man , that you think of him ? Or the son of man , that you care for him ?

verses.z: 你叫他比天使微小一點，賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕，並將你手所造的都派他管理，
verses.e: You made him a little lower than the angels . You crowned him with glory and honor .

verses.z: 叫萬物都服在他的腳下。既叫萬物都服他，就沒有剩下一樣不服他的。只是如今我們還不見萬物都服他。
verses.e: You have put all things in subjection under his feet . " For in that he subjected all things to him , he left nothing that is not subject to him . But now we don't yet see all things subjected to him .

verses.z: 惟獨見那成為比天使小一點的耶穌；因為受死的苦，就得了尊貴榮耀為冠冕，叫他因着上帝的恩，為人人嘗了死味。
verses.e: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels , Jesus , because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor , that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone .

verses.z: 同蒙天召的聖潔弟兄啊，你們應當思想我們所認為使者、為大祭司的耶穌。
verses.e: Therefore , holy brothers , partakers of a heavenly calling , consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession : Jesus ,

verses.z: 所以，我厭煩那世代的人，說：他們心裏常常迷糊，竟不曉得我的作為！
verses.e: Therefore I was displeased with that generation , and said , ' They always err in their heart , but they didn't know my ways . '

verses.z: 我就在怒中起誓說：他們斷不可進入我的安息。
verses.e: As I swore in my wrath , ' They will not enter into my rest . ' "

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們要謹慎，免得你們中間或有人存着不信的惡心，把永生上帝離棄了。
verses.e: Beware , brothers , lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief , in falling away from the living God ;

verses.z: 總要趁着還有今日，天天彼此相勸，免得你們中間有人被罪迷惑，心裏就剛硬了。
verses.e: but exhort one another day by day , so long as it is called " today " , lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin .

verses.z: 我們若將起初確實的信心堅持到底，就在基督裏有分了。
verses.e: For we have become partakers of Christ , if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end ,

verses.z: [經上]說：「你們今日若聽他的話，就不可硬着心，像惹他發怒的日子一樣。」
verses.e: while it is said , " Today if you will hear his voice , don't harden your hearts , as in the rebellion . "

verses.z: 那時，聽見他話惹他發怒的是誰呢？豈不是跟着摩西從埃及出來的眾人嗎？
verses.e: For who , when they heard , rebelled ? Wasn't it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses ?

verses.z: 上帝四十年之久，又厭煩誰呢？豈不是那些犯罪、屍首倒在曠野的人嗎？
verses.e: With whom was he displeased forty years ? Wasn't it with those who sinned , whose bodies fell in the wilderness ?

verses.z: 又向誰起誓，不容他們進入他的安息呢？豈不是向那些不信從的人嗎？
verses.e: To whom did he swear that they wouldn't enter into his rest , but to those who were disobedient ?

verses.z: 這樣看來，他們不能進入[安息]是因為不信的緣故了。
verses.e: We see that they weren't able to enter in because of unbelief .

verses.z: 他為那設立他的盡忠，如同摩西在上帝的全家盡忠一樣。
verses.e: who was faithful to him who appointed him , as also Moses was in all his house .

verses.z: 他比摩西算是更配多得榮耀，好像建造房屋的比房屋更尊榮；
verses.e: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses , because he who built the house has more honor than the house .

verses.z: 因為房屋都必有人建造，但建造萬物的就是上帝。
verses.e: For every house is built by someone ; but he who built all things is God .

verses.z: 摩西為僕人，在上帝的全家誠然盡忠，為要證明將來必傳說的事。
verses.e: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken ,

verses.z: 但基督為兒子，治理上帝的家；我們若將可誇的盼望和膽量堅持到底，便是他的家了。
verses.e: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house . We are his house , if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end .

verses.z: 聖靈有話說：你們今日若聽他的話，
verses.e: Therefore , even as the Holy Spirit says , " Today if you will hear his voice ,

verses.z: 就不可硬着心，像在曠野惹他發怒、試探他的時候一樣。
verses.e: don't harden your hearts as in the rebellion , in the day of the trial in the wilderness ,

verses.z: 在那裏，你們的祖宗試我探我，並且觀看我的作為有四十年之久。
verses.e: where your fathers tested me and tried me , and saw my deeds for forty years .

verses.z: 我們既蒙留下，有進入他安息的應許，就當畏懼，免得我們中間或有人似乎是趕不上了。
verses.e: Let's fear therefore , lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest .

verses.z: 因為那進入安息的，乃是歇了自己的工，正如上帝歇了他的工一樣。
verses.e: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works , as God did from his .

verses.z: 所以，我們務必竭力進入那安息，免得有人學那不信從的樣子跌倒了。
verses.e: Let's therefore give diligence to enter into that rest , lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience .

verses.z: 上帝的道是活潑的，是有功效的，比一切兩刃的劍更快，甚至魂與靈，骨節與骨髓，都能刺入、剖開，連心中的思念和主意都能辨明。
verses.e: For the word of God is living and active , and sharper than any two-edged sword , piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit , of both joints and marrow , and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart .

verses.z: 並且被造的沒有一樣在他面前不顯然的；原來萬物在那與我們有關係的主眼前，都是赤露敞開的。
verses.e: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight , but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account .

verses.z: 我們既然有一位已經升入高天尊榮的大祭司，就是上帝的兒子耶穌，便當持定所承認的道。
verses.e: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens , Jesus , the Son of God , let's hold tightly to our confession .

verses.z: 因我們的大祭司並非不能體恤我們的軟弱。他也曾凡事受過試探，與我們一樣，只是他沒有犯罪。
verses.e: For we don't have a high priest who can't be touched with the feeling of our infirmities , but one who has been in all points tempted like we are , yet without sin .

verses.z: 所以，我們只管坦然無懼地來到施恩的寶座前，為要得憐恤，蒙恩惠，作隨時的幫助。
verses.e: Let's therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace , that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need .

verses.z: 因為有福音傳給我們，像傳給他們一樣；只是所聽見的道與他們無益，因為他們沒有信心與所聽見的道調和。
verses.e: For indeed we have had good news preached to us , even as they also did , but the word they heard didn't profit them , because it wasn't mixed with faith by those who heard .

verses.z: 但我們已經相信的人得以進入那安息，正如上帝所說：「我在怒中起誓說：『他們斷不可進入我的安息！』」其實造物之工，從創世以來已經成全了。
verses.e: For we who have believed do enter into that rest , even as he has said , " As I swore in my wrath , they will not enter into my rest ; " although the works were finished from the foundation of the world .

verses.z: 論到第七日，有一處說：「到第七日，上帝就歇了他一切的工。」
verses.e: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day , " God rested on the seventh day from all his works ; "

verses.z: 又有一處說：「他們斷不可進入我的安息！」
verses.e: and in this place again , " They will not enter into my rest . "

verses.z: 既有必進安息的人，那先前聽見福音的，因為不信從，不得進去。
verses.e: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it , and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience ,

verses.z: 所以過了多年，就在大衛的書上，又限定一日，如以上所引的說：「你們今日若聽他的話，就不可硬着心。」
verses.e: he again defines a certain day , " today " , saying through David so long a time afterward ( just as has been said ) , " Today if you will hear his voice , don't harden your hearts . "

verses.z: 若是約書亞已叫他們享了安息，後來上帝就不再提別的日子了。
verses.e: For if Joshua had given them rest , he would not have spoken afterward of another day .

verses.z: 這樣看來，必另有一安息日的安息為上帝的子民存留。
verses.e: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God .

verses.z: 凡從人間挑選的大祭司，是奉派替人辦理屬上帝的事，為要獻上禮物和贖罪祭。
verses.e: For every high priest , being taken from among men , is appointed for men in things pertaining to God , that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins .

verses.z: 並蒙上帝照着麥基洗德的等次稱他為大祭司。
verses.e: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek .

verses.z: 論到麥基洗德，我們有好些話，並且難以解明，因為你們聽不進去。
verses.e: About him we have many words to say , and hard to interpret , seeing you have become dull of hearing .

verses.z: 看你們學習的工夫，本該作師傅，誰知還得有人將上帝聖言小學的開端另教導你們，並且成了那必須吃奶、不能吃乾糧的人。
verses.e: For although by this time you should be teachers , you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God . You have come to need milk , and not solid food .

verses.z: 凡只能吃奶的都不熟練仁義的道理，因為他是嬰孩；
verses.e: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness , for he is a baby .

verses.z: 惟獨長大成人的才能吃乾糧；他們的心竅習練得通達，就能分辨好歹了。
verses.e: But solid food is for those who are full grown , who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil .

verses.z: 他能體諒那愚蒙的和失迷的人，因為他自己也是被軟弱所困。
verses.e: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray , because he himself is also surrounded with weakness .

verses.z: 故此，他理當為百姓和自己獻祭贖罪。
verses.e: Because of this , he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people , as well as for himself .

verses.z: 這[大祭司的]尊榮，沒有人自取。惟要蒙上帝所召，像亞倫一樣。
verses.e: Nobody takes this honor on himself , but he is called by God , just like Aaron was .

verses.z: 如此，基督也不是自取榮耀作大祭司，乃是在乎向他說「你是我的兒子，我今日生你」的那一位；
verses.e: So also Christ didn't glorify himself to be made a high priest , but it was he who said to him , " You are my Son . Today I have become your father . "

verses.z: 就如[經上]又有一處說：「你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。」
verses.e: As he says also in another place , " You are a priest forever , after the order of Melchizedek . "

verses.z: 基督在肉體的時候，既大聲哀哭，流淚禱告，懇求那能救他免死的主，就因他的虔誠蒙了應允。
verses.e: He , in the days of his flesh , having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death , and having been heard for his godly fear ,

verses.z: 他雖然為兒子，還是因所受的苦難學了順從。
verses.e: though he was a Son , yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered .

verses.z: 他既得以完全，就為凡順從他的人成了永遠得救的根源，
verses.e: Having been made perfect , he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation ,

verses.z: 所以，我們應當離開基督道理的開端，竭力進到完全的地步，不必再立根基，就如那懊悔死行、信靠上帝、
verses.e: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ , let's press on to perfection — not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works , of faith toward God ,

verses.z: 因為上帝並非不公義，竟忘記你們所做的工和你們為他名所顯的愛心，就是先前伺候聖徒，如今還是伺候。
verses.e: For God is not unrighteous , so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name , in that you served the saints , and still do serve them .

verses.z: 我們願你們各人都顯出這樣的殷勤，使你們有滿足的指望，一直到底。
verses.e: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end ,

verses.z: 並且不懈怠，總要效法那些憑信心和忍耐承受應許的人。
verses.e: that you won't be sluggish , but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises .

verses.z: 當初上帝應許亞伯拉罕的時候，因為沒有比自己更大可以指着起誓的，就指着自己起誓，說：
verses.e: For when God made a promise to Abraham , since he could swear by no one greater , he swore by himself ,

verses.z: 「論福，我必賜大福給你；論子孫，我必叫你的子孫多起來。」
verses.e: saying , " Surely blessing I will bless you , and multiplying I will multiply you . "

verses.z: 這樣，亞伯拉罕既恆久忍耐，就得了所應許的。
verses.e: Thus , having patiently endured , he obtained the promise .

verses.z: 人都是指着比自己大的起誓，並且以起誓為實據，了結各樣的爭論。
verses.e: For men indeed swear by a greater one , and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation .

verses.z: 照樣，上帝願意為那承受應許的人格外顯明他的旨意是不更改的，就起誓為證。
verses.e: In this way God , being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel , interposed with an oath ,

verses.z: 藉這兩件不更改的事，上帝決不能說謊，好叫我們這逃往避難所、持定擺在我們前頭指望的人可以大得勉勵。
verses.e: that by two immutable things , in which it is impossible for God to lie , we may have a strong encouragement , who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us .

verses.z: 我們有這指望，如同靈魂的錨，又堅固又牢靠，且通入幔內。
verses.e: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul , a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil ,

verses.z: 各樣洗禮、按手之禮、死人復活，以及永遠審判各等教訓。
verses.e: of the teaching of baptisms , of laying on of hands , of resurrection of the dead , and of eternal judgment .

verses.z: 作先鋒的耶穌，既照着麥基洗德的等次成了永遠的大祭司，就為我們進入幔內。
verses.e: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us , having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek .

verses.z: 上帝若許我們，我們必如此行。
verses.e: This will we do , if God permits .

verses.z: 論到那些已經蒙了光照、嘗過天恩的滋味、又於聖靈有分，
verses.e: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift , and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit ,

verses.z: 並嘗過上帝善道的滋味、覺悟來世權能的人，
verses.e: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come ,

verses.z: 若是離棄[道]理，就不能叫他們重新懊悔了。因為他們把上帝的兒子重釘十字架，明明地羞辱他。
verses.e: and then fell away , it is impossible to renew them again to repentance ; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again , and put him to open shame .

verses.z: 就如一塊田地，吃過屢次下的雨水，生長菜蔬，合乎耕種的人用，就從上帝得福；
verses.e: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled , receives blessing from God ;

verses.z: 若長荊棘和蒺藜，必被廢棄，近於咒詛，結局就是焚燒。
verses.e: but if it bears thorns and thistles , it is rejected and near being cursed , whose end is to be burned .

verses.z: 親愛的弟兄們，我們雖是這樣說，卻深信你們的行為強過這些，而且近乎得救。
verses.e: But , beloved , we are persuaded of better things for you , and things that accompany salvation , even though we speak like this .

verses.z: 這麥基洗德就是撒冷王，又是至高上帝的祭司，本是長遠為祭司的。他當亞伯拉罕殺敗諸王回來的時候，就迎接他，給他祝福。
verses.e: For this Melchizedek , king of Salem , priest of God Most High , who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him ,

verses.z: 因為麥基洗德迎接亞伯拉罕的時候，利未已經在他先祖的身中。
verses.e: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him .

verses.z: 從前百姓在利未人祭司職任以下受律法，倘若藉這職任能得完全，又何用另外興起一位祭司，照麥基洗德的等次，不照亞倫的等次呢？
verses.e: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood ( for under it the people have received the law ) , what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek , and not be called after the order of Aaron ?

verses.z: 祭司的職任既已更改，律法也必須更改。
verses.e: For the priesthood being changed , there is of necessity a change made also in the law .

verses.z: 因為這話所指的人本屬別的支派，那支派裏從來沒有一人伺候祭壇。
verses.e: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe , from which no one has officiated at the altar .

verses.z: 我們的主分明是從猶大出來的；但這支派，摩西並沒有提到祭司。
verses.e: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah , about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood .

verses.z: 倘若照麥基洗德的樣式，另外興起一位祭司來，[我的話]更是顯而易見的了。
verses.e: This is yet more abundantly evident , if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest ,

verses.z: 他成為祭司，並不是照屬肉體的條例，乃是照無窮之生命的大能。
verses.e: who has been made , not after the law of a fleshly commandment , but after the power of an endless life ;

verses.z: 因為有給他作見證的說：「你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。」
verses.e: for it is testified , " You are a priest forever , according to the order of Melchizedek . "

verses.z: 先前的條例，因軟弱無益，所以廢掉了，
verses.e: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

verses.z: （律法原來一無所成）就引進了更美的指望；靠這指望，我們便可以進到上帝面前。
verses.e: ( for the law made nothing perfect ) , and a bringing in of a better hope , through which we draw near to God .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕也將自己所得來的，取十分之一給他。他頭一個名翻出來就是仁義王，他又名撒冷王，就是平安王的意思。
verses.e: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all ( being first , by interpretation , " king of righteousness " , and then also " king of Salem " , which means " king of peace " ,

verses.z: 再者，[耶穌為祭司]，並不是不起誓立的。
verses.e: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

verses.z: 至於那些祭司，原不是起誓立的，只有耶穌是起誓立的；因為那立他的對他說：「主起了誓，決不後悔，你是永遠為祭司。」
verses.e: ( for they indeed have been made priests without an oath ) , but he with an oath by him that says of him , " The Lord swore and will not change his mind , ' You are a priest forever , according to the order of Melchizedek . ' "

verses.z: 既是起誓立的，耶穌就作了更美之約的中保。
verses.e: By so much , Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant .

verses.z: 那些成為祭司的，數目本來多，是因為有死阻隔，不能長久。
verses.e: Many , indeed , have been made priests , because they are hindered from continuing by death .

verses.z: 這位既是永遠常存的，他祭司的職任就長久不更換。
verses.e: But he , because he lives forever , has his priesthood unchangeable .

verses.z: 凡靠着他進到上帝面前的人，他都能拯救到底；因為他是長遠活着，替他們祈求。
verses.e: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him , seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them .

verses.z: 像這樣聖潔、無邪惡、無玷污、遠離罪人、高過諸天的大祭司，原是與我們合宜的。
verses.e: For such a high priest was fitting for us : holy , guiltless , undefiled , separated from sinners , and made higher than the heavens ;

verses.z: 他不像那些大祭司，每日必須先為自己的罪，後為百姓的罪獻祭；因為他只一次將自己獻上，就把這事成全了。
verses.e: who doesn't need , like those high priests , to offer up sacrifices daily , first for his own sins , and then for the sins of the people . For he did this once for all , when he offered up himself .

verses.z: 律法本是立軟弱的人為大祭司；但在律法以後起誓的話，是立兒子為大祭司，乃是成全到永遠的。
verses.e: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness , but the word of the oath , which came after the law , appoints a Son forever who has been perfected .

verses.z: 他無父，無母，無族譜，無生之始，無命之終，乃是與上帝的兒子相似。
verses.e: without father , without mother , without genealogy , having neither beginning of days nor end of life , but made like the Son of God ) , remains a priest continually .

verses.z: 你們想一想，先祖亞伯拉罕將自己所擄來上等之物取十分之一給他，這人是何等尊貴呢！
verses.e: Now consider how great this man was , to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder .

verses.z: 那得祭司職任的利未子孫，領命照例向百姓取十分之一，這百姓是自己的弟兄，雖是從亞伯拉罕身中生的，還是照例[取十分之一]。
verses.e: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest's office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law , that is , of their brothers , though these have come out of the body of Abraham ,

verses.z: 獨有麥基洗德，不與他們同譜，倒收納亞伯拉罕的十分之一，為那蒙應許的亞伯拉罕祝福。
verses.e: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham , and has blessed him who has the promises .

verses.z: 從來位分大的給位分小的祝福，這是駁不倒的理。
verses.e: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater .

verses.z: 在這裏收十分之一的都是必死的人；但在那裏收十分之一的，有為他作見證的說，他是活的；
verses.e: Here people who die receive tithes , but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives .

verses.z: 並且可說那受十分之一的利未，也是藉着亞伯拉罕納了十分之一。
verses.e: We can say that through Abraham even Levi , who receives tithes , has paid tithes ,

verses.z: 我們所講的事，其中第一要緊的，就是我們有這樣的大祭司，已經坐在天上至大者寶座的右邊，
verses.e: Now in the things which we are saying , the main point is this : we have such a high priest , who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens ,

verses.z: 主又說：那些日子以後，我與以色列家所立的約乃是這樣：我要將我的律法放在他們裏面，寫在他們心上；我要作他們的上帝；他們要作我的子民。
verses.e: " For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , " says the Lord : " I will put my laws into their mind ; I will also write them on their heart . I will be their God , and they will be my people .

verses.z: 他們不用各人教導自己的鄉鄰和自己的弟兄，說：你該認識主；因為他們從最小的到至大的，都必認識我。
verses.e: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother , saying , ' Know the Lord , ' for all will know me , from their least to their greatest .

verses.z: 我要寬恕他們的不義，不再記念他們的罪愆。
verses.e: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness . I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more . "

verses.z: 既說新約，就以前約為舊了；但那漸舊漸衰的，就必快歸無有了。
verses.e: In that he says , " A new covenant " , he has made the first obsolete . But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away .

verses.z: 在聖所，就是真帳幕裏，作執事；這帳幕是主所支的，不是人所支的。
verses.e: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched , not man .

verses.z: 凡大祭司都是為獻禮物和祭物設立的，所以這位大祭司也必須有所獻的。
verses.e: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices . Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer .

verses.z: 他若在地上，必不得為祭司，因為已經有照律法獻禮物的[祭司]。
verses.e: For if he were on earth , he would not be a priest at all , seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law ,

verses.z: 他們供奉的事本是天上事的形狀和影像，正如摩西將要造帳幕的時候，蒙[上帝]警戒他，說：「你要謹慎，作各樣的物件都要照着在山上指示你的樣式。」
verses.e: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things , even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle , for he said , " See , you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain . "

verses.z: 如今耶穌所得的職任是更美的，正如他作更美之約的中保；這約原是憑更美之應許立的。
verses.e: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry , by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant , which on better promises has been given as law .

verses.z: 那前約若沒有瑕疵，就無處尋求後約了。
verses.e: For if that first covenant had been faultless , then no place would have been sought for a second .

verses.z: 所以主指責他的百姓說：日子將到，我要與以色列家和猶大家另立新約，
verses.e: For finding fault with them , he said , " Behold , the days are coming " , says the Lord , " that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah ;

verses.z: 不像我拉着他們祖宗的手，領他們出埃及的時候，與他們所立的約。因為他們不恆心守我的約，我也不理他們。這是主說的。
verses.e: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt ; for they didn't continue in my covenant , and I disregarded them , " says the Lord .

verses.z: 原來前約有禮拜的條例和屬世界的聖幕。
verses.e: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary .

verses.z: 這些事，連那飲食和諸般洗濯的規矩，都不過是屬肉體的條例，命定到振興的時候為止。
verses.e: being only ( with foods and drinks and various washings ) fleshly ordinances , imposed until a time of reformation .

verses.z: 但現在基督已經來到，作了將來美事的大祭司，經過那更大更全備的帳幕，不是人手所造，也不是屬乎這世界的；
verses.e: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things , through the greater and more perfect tabernacle , not made with hands , that is to say , not of this creation ,

verses.z: 並且不用山羊和牛犢的血，乃用自己的血，只一次進入聖所，成了永遠贖罪的事。
verses.e: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves , but through his own blood , entered in once for all into the Holy Place , having obtained eternal redemption .

verses.z: 若山羊和公牛的血，並母牛犢的灰，灑在不潔的人身上，尚且叫人成聖，身體潔淨，
verses.e: For if the blood of goats and bulls , and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled , sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh ,

verses.z: 何況基督藉着永遠的靈，將自己無瑕無疵獻給上帝，他的血豈不更能洗淨你們的心，除去你們的死行，使你們事奉那永生上帝嗎？
verses.e: how much more will the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God , cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?

verses.z: 為此，他作了新約的中保，既然受死贖了人在前約之時所犯的罪過，便叫蒙召之人得着所應許永遠的產業。
verses.e: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant , since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant , that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance .

verses.z: 凡有遺命必須等到留遺命的人死了；
verses.e: For where a last will and testament is , there must of necessity be the death of him who made it .

verses.z: 因為人死了，遺命才有效力，若留遺命的尚在，那遺命還有用處嗎？
verses.e: For a will is in force where there has been death , for it is never in force while he who made it lives .

verses.z: 所以，前約也不是不用血立的；
verses.e: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood .

verses.z: 因為摩西當日照着律法將各樣誡命傳給眾百姓，就拿朱紅色絨和牛膝草，把牛犢山羊的血和水灑在書上，又灑在眾百姓身上，說：
verses.e: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law , he took the blood of the calves and the goats , with water and scarlet wool and hyssop , and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people ,

verses.z: 因為有預備的帳幕，頭一層叫作聖所，裏面有燈臺、桌子，和陳設餅。
verses.e: For a tabernacle was prepared . In the first part were the lamp stand , the table , and the show bread , which is called the Holy Place .

verses.z: 「這血就是上帝與你們立約[的憑據]。」
verses.e: saying , " This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you . "

verses.z: 他又照樣把血灑在帳幕和各樣器皿上。
verses.e: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood .

verses.z: 按着律法，凡物差不多都是用血潔淨的；若不流血，罪就不得赦免了。
verses.e: According to the law , nearly everything is cleansed with blood , and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission .

verses.z: 照着天上樣式做的物件必須用這些祭物去潔淨；但那天上的本物自然當用更美的祭物去潔淨。
verses.e: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these , but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these .

verses.z: 因為基督並不是進了人手所造的聖所（這不過是真聖所的影像），乃是進了天堂，如今為我們顯在上帝面前；
verses.e: For Christ hasn't entered into holy places made with hands , which are representations of the true , but into heaven itself , now to appear in the presence of God for us ;

verses.z: 也不是多次將自己獻上，像那大祭司每年帶着牛羊的血進入聖所，
verses.e: nor yet that he should offer himself often , as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own ,

verses.z: 如果這樣，他從創世以來，就必多次受苦了。但如今在這末世顯現一次，把自己獻為祭，好除掉罪。
verses.e: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world . But now once at the end of the ages , he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself .

verses.z: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死後且有審判。
verses.e: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once , and after this , judgment ,

verses.z: 像這樣，基督既然一次被獻，擔當了多人的罪，將來要向那等候他的人第二次顯現，並與罪無關，乃是為拯救他們。
verses.e: so Christ also , having been offered once to bear the sins of many , will appear a second time , not to deal with sin , but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him .

verses.z: 第二幔子後又有一層帳幕，叫作至聖所，
verses.e: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies ,

verses.z: 有金香爐，有包金的約櫃，櫃裏有盛嗎哪的金罐和亞倫發過芽的杖，並兩塊約版；
verses.e: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold , in which was a golden pot holding the manna , Aaron's rod that budded , and the tablets of the covenant ;

verses.z: 櫃上面有榮耀基路伯的影罩着施恩座。這幾件我現在不能一一細說。
verses.e: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat , of which things we can't speak now in detail .

verses.z: 這些物件既如此預備齊了，眾祭司就常進頭一層帳幕，行拜上帝的禮。
verses.e: Now these things having been thus prepared , the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle , accomplishing the services ,

verses.z: 至於第二層帳幕，惟有大祭司一年一次獨自進去，沒有不帶着血為自己和百姓的過錯獻上。
verses.e: but into the second the high priest alone , once in the year , not without blood , which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people .

verses.z: 聖靈用此指明，頭一層帳幕仍存的時候，進入至聖所的路還未顯明。
verses.e: The Holy Spirit is indicating this , that the way into the Holy Place wasn't yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing .

verses.z: 那頭一層帳幕作現今的一個表樣，所獻的禮物和祭物，就着良心說，都不能叫禮拜的人得以完全。
verses.e: This is a symbol of the present age , where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable , concerning the conscience , of making the worshiper perfect ,

verses.z: 當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家作猶大王，約阿施的兒子耶羅波安作以色列王的時候，耶和華的話臨到備利的兒子何西阿。
verses.e: The LORD's word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel .

verses.z: 然而，以色列的人數必如海沙，不可量，不可數。從前在甚麼地方對他們說「你們不是我的子民」，將來在那裏必對他們說「[你們是]永生上帝的兒子」。
verses.e: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea , which can't be measured or counted ; and it will come to pass that , in the place where it was said to them , ' You are not my people , ' they will be called ' sons of the living God . '

verses.z: 猶大人和以色列人必一同聚集，為自己立一個首領，從這地上去，因為耶斯列的日子必為大日。
verses.e: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together , and they will appoint themselves one head , and will go up from the land ; for great will be the day of Jezreel .

verses.z: 耶和華初次與何西阿說話，對他說：「你去娶淫婦為妻，也收那從淫亂所生的兒女；因為這地大行淫亂，離棄耶和華。」
verses.e: When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea , the LORD said to Hosea , " Go , take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness ; for the land commits great adultery , forsaking the LORD . "

verses.z: 於是，何西阿去娶了滴拉音的女兒歌篾。這婦人懷孕，給他生了一個兒子。
verses.e: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim ; and she conceived , and bore him a son .

verses.z: 耶和華對何西阿說：「給他起名叫耶斯列；因為再過片時，我必討耶戶家在耶斯列殺人流血的罪，也必使以色列家的國滅絕。
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Call his name Jezreel , for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu , and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease .

verses.z: 到那日，我必在耶斯列平原折斷以色列的弓。」
verses.e: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel . "

verses.z: 歌篾又懷孕生了一個女兒，[耶和華]對何西阿說：「給她起名叫羅‧路哈瑪；因為我必不再憐憫以色列家，決不赦免他們。
verses.e: She conceived again , and bore a daughter . Then he said to him , " Call her name Lo-Ruhamah , for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel , that I should in any way pardon them .

verses.z: 我卻要憐憫猶大家，使他們靠耶和華－他們的上帝得救，不使他們靠弓、刀、爭戰、馬匹，與馬兵得救。」
verses.e: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah , and will save them by the LORD their God , and will not save them by bow , sword , battle , horses , or horsemen . "

verses.z: 歌篾給羅‧路哈瑪斷奶以後，又懷孕生了一個兒子。
verses.e: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah , she conceived , and bore a son .

verses.z: [耶和華]說：「給他起名叫羅‧阿米；因為你們不作我的子民，我也不作你們的[上帝]。」
verses.e: He said , " Call his name Lo-Ammi , for you are not my people , and I will not be yours .

verses.z: 以色列是茂盛的葡萄樹，結果繁多。果子越多，就越增添祭壇；地土越肥美，就越造美麗的柱像。
verses.e: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit . According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars . As their land has prospered , they have adorned their sacred stones .

verses.z: 我必隨意懲罰他們。他們為兩樣的罪所纏；列邦的民必聚集攻擊他們。
verses.e: When it is my desire , I will chastise them ; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions .

verses.z: 以法蓮是馴良的母牛犢，喜愛踹[穀]，我卻將軛加在牠肥美的頸項上，我要使以法蓮拉套。猶大必耕田；雅各必耙地。
verses.e: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh , so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck . I will set a rider on Ephraim . Judah will plow . Jacob will break his clods .

verses.z: 你們要為自己栽種公義，就能收割慈愛。現今正是尋求耶和華的時候；你們要開墾荒地，等他臨到，使公義如雨降在你們身上。
verses.e: Sow to yourselves in righteousness , reap according to kindness . Break up your fallow ground , for it is time to seek the LORD , until he comes and rains righteousness on you .

verses.z: 你們耕種的是奸惡，收割的是罪孽，吃的是謊話的果子。因你倚靠自己的行為，仰賴勇士眾多，
verses.e: You have plowed wickedness . You have reaped iniquity . You have eaten the fruit of lies , for you trusted in your way , in the multitude of your mighty men .

verses.z: 所以在這民中必有鬨嚷之聲，你一切的保障必被拆毀，就如沙勒幔在爭戰的日子拆毀伯‧亞比勒，將其中的母子一同摔死。
verses.e: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people , and all your fortresses will be destroyed , as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle . The mother was dashed in pieces with her children .

verses.z: 因他們的大惡，伯特利必使你們遭遇如此。到了黎明，以色列的王必全然滅絕。
verses.e: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness . At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed .

verses.z: 他們心懷二意，現今要定為有罪。耶和華必拆毀他們的祭壇，毀壞他們的柱像。
