verses.e: Their heart is divided . Now they will be found guilty . He will demolish their altars . He will destroy their sacred stones .

verses.z: 他們必說：我們沒有王，因為我們不敬畏耶和華。王能為我們做甚麼呢？
verses.e: Surely now they will say , " We have no king ; for we don't fear the LORD ; and the king , what can he do for us ? "

verses.z: 他們為立約說[謊]言，起假誓；因此，災罰如苦菜滋生在田間的犂溝中。
verses.e: They make promises , swearing falsely in making covenants . Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field .

verses.z: 撒馬利亞的居民必因伯‧亞文的牛犢驚恐；崇拜牛犢的民和喜愛牛犢的祭司都必因榮耀離開它，為它悲哀。
verses.e: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven , for its people will mourn over it , along with its priests who rejoiced over it , for its glory , because it has departed from it .

verses.z: 人必將牛犢帶到亞述當作禮物，獻給耶雷布王。以法蓮必蒙羞；以色列必因自己的計謀慚愧。
verses.e: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king . Ephraim will receive shame , and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel .

verses.z: 至於撒馬利亞，她的王必滅沒，如水面的沫子一樣。
verses.e: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water .

verses.z: 伯‧亞文的邱壇－就是以色列取罪[的地方]必被毀滅；荊棘和蒺藜必長在他們的祭壇上。他們必對大山說：遮蓋我們！對小山說：倒在我們身上！
verses.e: The high places also of Aven , the sin of Israel , will be destroyed . The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars . They will tell the mountains , " Cover us ! " and the hills , " Fall on us ! "

verses.z: 以色列啊，你從基比亞的日子以來時常犯罪。你們的先人曾站在那裏，現今住基比亞的人以為攻擊罪孽之輩的戰事臨不到自己。
verses.e: " Israel , you have sinned from the days of Gibeah . There they remained . The battle against the children of iniquity doesn't overtake them in Gibeah .

verses.z: 以色列年幼的時候，我愛他，就從埃及召出我的兒子來。
verses.e: " When Israel was a child , then I loved him , and called my son out of Egypt .

verses.z: 耶和華必如獅子吼叫，子民必跟隨他。他一吼叫，他們就從西方急速而來。
verses.e: They will walk after the LORD , who will roar like a lion ; for he will roar , and the children will come trembling from the west .

verses.z: 他們必如雀鳥從埃及急速而來，又如鴿子從亞述地來到。我必使他們住自己的房屋。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt , and like a dove out of the land of Assyria ; and I will settle them in their houses , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 以法蓮用謊話，以色列家用詭計圍繞我；猶大卻靠上帝掌權，向聖者有忠心。
verses.e: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood , and the house of Israel with deceit . Judah still strays from God , and is unfaithful to the Holy One .

verses.z: 先知越發招呼他們，他們越發走開，向諸巴力獻祭，給雕刻的偶像燒香。
verses.e: They called to them , so they went from them . They sacrificed to the Baals , and burned incense to engraved images .

verses.z: 我原教導以法蓮行走，用膀臂抱着他們，他們卻不知道是我醫治他們。
verses.e: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk . I took them by their arms , but they didn't know that I healed them .

verses.z: 我用慈繩愛索牽引他們；我待他們如人放鬆[牛的]兩腮夾板，把糧食放在他們面前。
verses.e: I drew them with cords of a man , with ties of love ; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks ; and I bent down to him and I fed him .

verses.z: 他們必不歸回埃及地，亞述人卻要作他們的王，因他們不肯歸向[我]。
verses.e: " They won't return into the land of Egypt ; but the Assyrian will be their king , because they refused to repent .

verses.z: 刀劍必臨到他們的城邑，毀壞門閂，把人吞滅，都因他們[隨從]自己的計謀。
verses.e: The sword will fall on their cities , and will destroy the bars of their gates , and will put an end to their plans .

verses.z: 我的民偏要背道離開我；眾先知雖然招呼他們歸向至上的[主]，卻無人尊崇[主]。
verses.e: My people are determined to turn from me . Though they call to the Most High , he certainly won't exalt them .

verses.z: 以法蓮哪，我怎能捨棄你？以色列啊，我怎能棄絕你？我怎能使你如押瑪？怎能使你如洗扁？我回心轉意，我的憐愛大大發動。
verses.e: " How can I give you up , Ephraim ? How can I hand you over , Israel ? How can I make you like Admah ? How can I make you like Zeboiim ? My heart is turned within me , my compassion is aroused .

verses.z: 我必不發猛烈的怒氣，也不再毀滅以法蓮。因我是上帝，並非世人，是你們中間的聖者；我必不在怒中臨到你們。
verses.e: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger . I will not return to destroy Ephraim , for I am God , and not man — the Holy One among you . I will not come in wrath .

verses.z: 以法蓮吃風，且追趕東風，時常增添虛謊和強暴，與亞述立約，把油送到埃及。
verses.e: Ephraim feeds on wind , and chases the east wind . He continually multiplies lies and desolation . They make a covenant with Assyria , and oil is carried into Egypt .

verses.z: 我已曉諭眾先知，並且加增默示，藉先知設立比喻。
verses.e: I have also spoken to the prophets , and I have multiplied visions ; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables .

verses.z: 基列人沒有罪孽嗎？他們全然是虛假的。人在吉甲獻牛犢為祭，他們的祭壇好像田間犂溝中的亂堆。
verses.e: If Gilead is wicked , surely they are worthless . In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls . Indeed , their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field .

verses.z: 從前雅各逃到亞蘭地，以色列為得妻服事人，為得妻與人放羊。
verses.e: Jacob fled into the country of Aram . Israel served to get a wife . For a wife he tended flocks and herds .

verses.z: 耶和華藉先知領以色列從埃及上來；以色列也藉先知而得保存。
verses.e: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt , and by a prophet he was preserved .

verses.z: 以法蓮大大惹動[主]怒，所以他流血的罪必歸在他身上。主必將那因以法蓮所受的羞辱歸還他。
verses.e: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger . Therefore his blood will be left on him , and his Lord will repay his contempt .

verses.z: 耶和華與猶大爭辯，必照雅各所行的懲罰他，按他所做的報應他。
verses.e: The LORD also has a controversy with Judah , and will punish Jacob according to his ways ; according to his deeds he will repay him .

verses.z: 他在腹中抓住哥哥的腳跟，壯年的時候與上帝較力，
verses.e: In the womb he took his brother by the heel , and in his manhood he contended with God .

verses.z: 與天使較力，並且得勝，哭泣懇求，在伯特利遇見耶和華。耶和華－萬軍之上帝在那裏曉諭我們[以色列]人；耶和華是他可記念的[名]。
verses.e: Indeed , he struggled with the angel , and prevailed ; he wept , and made supplication to him . He found him at Bethel , and there he spoke with us —
even the LORD , the God of Armies . The LORD is his name of renown !

verses.z: 所以你當歸向你的上帝，謹守仁愛、公平，常常等候你的上帝。
verses.e: Therefore turn to your God . Keep kindness and justice , and wait continually for your God .

verses.z: 以法蓮是商人，手裏有詭詐的天平，愛行欺騙。
verses.e: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand . He loves to defraud .

verses.z: 以法蓮說：我果然成了富足，得了財寶；我所勞碌得來的，人必不見有甚麼不義，可算為罪的。
verses.e: Ephraim said , " Surely I have become rich . I have found myself wealth . In all my wealth they won't find in me any iniquity that is sin . "

verses.z: 自從你出埃及地以來，我就是耶和華－你的上帝；我必使你再住帳棚，如在大會的日子一樣。
verses.e: " But I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt . I will yet again make you dwell in tents , as in the days of the solemn feast .

verses.z: 從前以法蓮說話，人都戰兢，他在以色列中居處高位；但他在[事奉]巴力的事上犯罪就死了。
verses.e: When Ephraim spoke , there was trembling . He exalted himself in Israel , but when he became guilty through Baal , he died .

verses.z: 你曾求我說：給我立王和首領。現在你的王在哪裏呢？治理你的在哪裏呢？讓他在你所有的城中拯救你吧！
verses.e: Where is your king now , that he may save you in all your cities ? And your judges , of whom you said , ' Give me a king and princes ' ?

verses.z: 我在怒氣中將王賜你，又在烈怒中將王廢去。
verses.e: I have given you a king in my anger , and have taken him away in my wrath .

verses.z: 以法蓮的罪孽包裹；他的罪惡收藏。
verses.e: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up . His sin is stored up .

verses.z: 產婦的疼痛必臨到他身上；他是無智慧之子，到了產期不當遲延。
verses.e: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him . He is an unwise son , for when it is time , he doesn't come to the opening of the womb .

verses.z: 我必救贖他們脫離陰間，救贖他們脫離死亡。死亡啊，你的災害在哪裏呢？陰間哪，你的毀滅在哪裏呢？在我眼前絕無後悔之事。
verses.e: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol . I will redeem them from death ! Death , where are your plagues ? Sheol , where is your destruction ? " Compassion will be hidden from my eyes .

verses.z: 他在弟兄中雖然茂盛，必有東風颳來，就是耶和華的風從曠野上來。他的泉源必乾；他的源頭必竭；仇敵必擄掠他所積蓄的一切寶器。
verses.e: Though he is fruitful among his brothers , an east wind will come , the breath of the LORD coming up from the wilderness ; and his spring will become dry , and his fountain will be dried up . He will plunder the storehouse of treasure .

verses.z: 撒馬利亞必擔當自己的罪，因為悖逆她的上帝。她必倒在刀下；嬰孩必被摔死；孕婦必被剖開。
verses.e: Samaria will bear her guilt , for she has rebelled against her God . They will fall by the sword . Their infants will be dashed in pieces , and their pregnant women will be ripped open . "

verses.z: 現今他們罪上加罪，用銀子為自己鑄造偶像，就是照自己的聰明製造，都是匠人的工作。有人論說，獻祭的人可以向牛犢親嘴。
verses.e: Now they sin more and more , and have made themselves molten images of their silver , even idols according to their own understanding , all of them the work of the craftsmen . They say of them , ' They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves . '

verses.z: 因此，他們必如早晨的雲霧，又如速散的甘露，像場上的糠詷被狂風吹去，又像煙氣騰於窗外。
verses.e: Therefore they will be like the morning mist , like the dew that passes away early , like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor , and like the smoke out of the chimney .

verses.z: 自從你出埃及地以來，我就是耶和華－你的上帝。在我以外，你不可認識別神；除我以外並沒有救主。
verses.e: " Yet I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt ; and you shall acknowledge no god but me , and besides me there is no savior .

verses.z: 我曾在曠野乾旱之地認識你。
verses.e: I knew you in the wilderness , in the land of great drought .

verses.z: 這些民照[我所賜]的食物得了飽足；既得飽足，心就高傲，忘記了我。
verses.e: According to their pasture , so were they filled ; they were filled , and their heart was exalted . Therefore they have forgotten me .

verses.z: 因此，我向他們如獅子，又如豹伏在道旁。
verses.e: Therefore I am like a lion to them . Like a leopard , I will lurk by the path .

verses.z: 我遇見他們必像丟崽子的母熊，撕裂他們的胸膛。在那裏，我必像母獅吞吃他們；野獸必撕裂他們。
verses.e: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs , and will tear the covering of their heart . There I will devour them like a lioness . The wild animal will tear them .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你與我反對，就是反對幫助你的，自取敗壞。
verses.e: You are destroyed , Israel , because you are against me , against your helper .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你要歸向耶和華－你的上帝；你是因自己的罪孽跌倒了。
verses.e: Israel , return to the LORD your God ; for you have fallen because of your sin .

verses.z: 當歸向耶和華，用言語禱告他說：求你除淨罪孽，悅納善行；這樣，我們就把嘴唇[的]祭[代替]牛犢獻上。
verses.e: Take words with you , and return to the LORD . Tell him , " Forgive all our sins , and accept that which is good ; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips .

verses.z: 我們不向亞述求救，不騎埃及的馬，也不再對我們手所造的說：[你是]我們的上帝。因為孤兒在你－[耶和華]那裏得蒙憐憫。
verses.e: Assyria can't save us . We won't ride on horses ; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , ' Our gods ! ' for in you the fatherless finds mercy . "

verses.z: 我必醫治他們背道的病，甘心愛他們；因為我的怒氣向他們轉消。
verses.e: " I will heal their waywardness . I will love them freely ; for my anger is turned away from them .

verses.z: 我必向以色列如甘露；他必如百合花開放，如黎巴嫩[的樹木]扎根。
verses.e: I will be like the dew to Israel . He will blossom like the lily , and send down his roots like Lebanon .

verses.z: 他的枝條必延長；他的榮華如橄欖樹；他的香氣如黎巴嫩[的香柏樹]。
verses.e: His branches will spread , and his beauty will be like the olive tree , and his fragrance like Lebanon .

verses.z: 曾住在他蔭下的必歸回，發旺如五穀，開花如葡萄樹。他的香氣如黎巴嫩的酒。
verses.e: Men will dwell in his shade . They will revive like the grain , and blossom like the vine . Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon .

verses.z: 以法蓮[必說]：我與偶像還有甚麼關涉呢？我－[耶和華]回答他，也必顧念他。我如青翠的松樹；你的果子從我而得。
verses.e: Ephraim , what have I to do any more with idols ? I answer , and will take care of him . I am like a green cypress tree ; from me your fruit is found . "

verses.z: 誰是智慧人？可以明白這些事；誰是通達人？可以知道這一切。因為，耶和華的道是正直的；義人必在其中行走，罪人卻在其上跌倒。
verses.e: Who is wise , that he may understand these things ? Who is prudent , that he may know them ? For the ways of the LORD are right , and the righteous walk in them , but the rebellious stumble in them .

verses.z: 你們要稱你們的弟兄為阿米，稱你們的姊妹為路哈瑪。
verses.e: " Say to your brothers , ' My people ! ' and to your sisters , ' My loved one ! '

verses.z: 如今我必在她所愛的眼前顯露她的醜態；必無人能救她脫離我的手。
verses.e: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers , and no one will deliver her out of my hand .

verses.z: 我也必使她的宴樂、節期、月朔、安息日，並她的一切大會都止息了。
verses.e: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease : her feasts , her new moons , her Sabbaths , and all her solemn assemblies .

verses.z: 我也必毀壞她的葡萄樹和無花果樹，就是她說「這是我所愛的給我為賞賜」的。我必使這些樹變為荒林，為田野的走獸所吃。
verses.e: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees , about which she has said , ' These are my wages that my lovers have given me , ' and I will make them a forest , and the animals of the field shall eat them .

verses.z: 我必追討她素日給諸巴力燒香的罪；那時她佩帶耳環和別樣妝飾，隨從她所愛的，卻忘記我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will visit on her the days of the Baals , to which she burned incense when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and went after her lovers and forgot me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 後來我必勸導她，領她到曠野，對她說安慰的話。
verses.e: " Therefore behold , I will allure her , and bring her into the wilderness , and speak tenderly to her .

verses.z: 她從那裏出來，我必賜她葡萄園，又賜她亞割谷作為指望的門。她必在那裏應聲，與幼年的日子一樣，與從埃及地上來的時候相同。
verses.e: I will give her vineyards from there , and the valley of Achor for a door of hope ; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth , and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「那日你必稱呼我伊施，不再稱呼我巴力；
verses.e: It will be in that day , " says the LORD , " that you will call me ' my husband , ' and no longer call me ' my master . '

verses.z: 因為我必從我民的口中除掉諸巴力的名號，這名號不再提起。
verses.e: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth , and they will no longer be mentioned by name .

verses.z: 當那日，我必為我的民，與田野的走獸和空中的飛鳥，並地上的昆蟲立約；又必在國中折斷弓刀，止息爭戰，使他們安然躺臥。
verses.e: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field , and with the birds of the sky , and with the creeping things of the ground . I will break the bow , the sword , and the battle out of the land , and will make them lie down safely .

verses.z: 我必聘你永遠歸我為妻，以仁義、公平、慈愛、憐憫聘你歸我；
verses.e: I will betroth you to me forever . Yes , I will betroth you to me in righteousness , in justice , in loving kindness , and in compassion .

verses.z: 你們要與你們的母親大大爭辯；因為她不是我的妻子，我也不是她的丈夫。叫她除掉臉上的淫像和胸間的淫態，
verses.e: Contend with your mother ! Contend , for she is not my wife , neither am I her husband ; and let her put away her prostitution from her face , and her adulteries from between her breasts ;

verses.z: 也以誠實聘你歸我，你就必認識[我]－耶和華。
verses.e: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness ; and you shall know the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華說：那日我必應允，我必應允天，天必應允地；
verses.e: It will happen in that day , that I will respond , " says the LORD . " I will respond to the heavens , and they will respond to the earth ;

verses.z: 地必應允五穀、新酒，和油，這些必應允耶斯列[民]。
verses.e: and the earth will respond to the grain , and the new wine , and the oil ; and they will respond to Jezreel .

verses.z: 我必將她種在這地。素不蒙憐憫的，我必憐憫；本非我民的，我必對他說：你是我的民；他必說：[你是]我的上帝。」
verses.e: I will sow her to me in the earth ; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy ; and I will tell those who were not my people , ' You are my people ; ' and they will say , ' You are My God ! ' "

verses.z: 免得我剝她的衣服，使她赤體，與才生的時候一樣，使她如曠野，如乾旱之地，因渴而死。
verses.e: lest I strip her naked , and make her bare as in the day that she was born , and make her like a wilderness , and set her like a dry land , and kill her with thirst .

verses.z: 我必不憐憫她的兒女，因為他們是從淫亂而生的。
verses.e: Indeed , on her children I will have no mercy , for they are children of unfaithfulness .

verses.z: 他們的母親行了淫亂，懷他們的[母]做了可羞恥的事，因為她說：我要隨從所愛的；我的餅、水、羊毛、麻、油、酒都是他們給的。
verses.e: For their mother has played the prostitute . She who conceived them has done shamefully ; for she said , ' I will go after my lovers , who give me my bread and my water , my wool and my flax , my oil and my drink . '

verses.z: 因此，我必用荊棘堵塞她的道，築牆擋住她，使她找不着路。
verses.e: Therefore behold , I will hedge up your way with thorns , and I will build a wall against her , that she can't find her way .

verses.z: 她必追隨所愛的，卻追不上；她必尋找他們，卻尋不見，便說：我要歸回前夫，因我那時的光景比如今還好。
verses.e: She will follow after her lovers , but she won't overtake them ; and she will seek them , but won't find them . Then she will say , ' I will go and return to my first husband , for then it was better with me than now . '

verses.z: 她不知道是我給她五穀、新酒，和油，又加增她的金銀；她卻以此供奉巴力。
verses.e: For she didn't know that I gave her the grain , the new wine , and the oil , and multiplied to her silver and gold , which they used for Baal .

verses.z: 因此到了收割的日子，出酒的時候，我必將我的五穀、新酒收回，也必將她應當遮體的羊毛和麻奪回來。
verses.e: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time , and my new wine in its season , and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness .

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「你再去愛一個淫婦，就是她情人所愛的；好像以色列人，雖然偏向別神，喜愛葡萄餅，耶和華還是愛他們。」
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Go again , love a woman loved by another , and an adulteress , even as the LORD loves the children of Israel , though they turn to other gods , and love cakes of raisins . "

verses.z: 我便用銀子十五舍客勒，大麥一賀梅珥半，買她歸我。
verses.e: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley .

verses.z: 我對她說：「你當多日為我獨居，不可行淫，不可歸別人為妻，我向你也必這樣。」
verses.e: I said to her , " You shall stay with me many days . You shall not play the prostitute , and you shall not be with any other man . I will also be so toward you . "

verses.z: 以色列人也必多日獨居，無君王，無首領，無祭祀，無柱像，無以弗得，無家中的神像。
verses.e: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king , without prince , without sacrifice , without sacred stone , and without ephod or idols .

verses.z: 後來以色列人必歸回，尋求他們的上帝－耶和華和他們的王大衛。在末後的日子，必以敬畏的心歸向耶和華，領受他的恩惠。
verses.e: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God , and David their king , and shall come with trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days .

verses.z: 以色列人哪，你們當聽耶和華的話。耶和華與這地的居民爭辯，因這地上無誠實，無良善，無人認識上帝。
verses.e: Hear the LORD's word , you children of Israel , for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land : " Indeed there is no truth , nor goodness , nor knowledge of God in the land .

verses.z: 他們吃，卻不得飽；行淫，而不得立後；因為他們離棄耶和華，不遵[他的命]。
verses.e: They will eat , and not have enough . They will play the prostitute , and will not increase ; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD .

verses.z: 姦淫和酒，並新酒，奪去人的心。
verses.e: Prostitution , wine , and new wine take away understanding .

verses.z: 我的民求問木偶，以為木杖能指示他們；因為他們的淫心使他們失迷，他們就行淫離棄上帝，不守約束，
verses.e: My people consult with their wooden idol , and answer to a stick of wood . Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray , and they have been unfaithful to their God .

verses.z: 在各山頂，各高岡的橡樹、楊樹、栗樹之下，獻祭燒香，因為樹影美好。所以，你們的女兒淫亂，你們的新婦行淫。
verses.e: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains , and burn incense on the hills , under oaks , poplars , and terebinths , because its shade is good . Therefore your daughters play the prostitute , and your brides commit adultery .

verses.z: 你們的女兒淫亂，你們的新婦行淫，我卻不懲罰她們；因為你們自己離群與娼妓同居，與妓女一同獻祭。這無知的民必致傾倒。
verses.e: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute , nor your brides when they commit adultery ; because the men consort with prostitutes , and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes ; so the people without understanding will come to ruin .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你雖然行淫，猶大卻不可犯罪。不要往吉甲去，不要上到伯‧亞文，也不要指着永生的耶和華起誓。
verses.e: " Though you , Israel , play the prostitute , yet don't let Judah offend ; and don't come to Gilgal , neither go up to Beth Aven , nor swear , ' As the LORD lives . '

verses.z: 以色列倔強，猶如倔強的母牛；現在耶和華要放他們，如同放羊羔在寬闊之地。
verses.e: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly , like a stubborn heifer . Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow ?

verses.z: 以法蓮親近偶像，任憑他吧！
verses.e: Ephraim is joined to idols . Leave him alone !

verses.z: 他們所喝的已經發酸，他們時常行淫，他們的官長最愛羞恥的事。
verses.e: Their drink has become sour . They play the prostitute continually . Her rulers dearly love their shameful way .

verses.z: 風把他們裹在翅膀裏；他們因所獻的祭必致蒙羞。
verses.e: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings ; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices .

verses.z: 但起[假]誓，不踐前言，殺害，偷盜，姦淫，行強暴，殺人流血，接連不斷。
verses.e: There is cursing , lying , murder , stealing , and committing adultery ; they break boundaries , and bloodshed causes bloodshed .

verses.z: 因此，這地悲哀，其上的民、田野的獸、空中的鳥必都衰微，海中的魚也必消滅。
verses.e: Therefore the land will mourn , and everyone who dwells in it will waste away , with all living things in her , even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky ; yes , the fish of the sea also die .

verses.z: 然而，人都不必爭辯，也不必指責，因為這民與抗拒祭司的人一樣。
verses.e: " Yet let no man bring a charge , neither let any man accuse ; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest .

verses.z: 你這祭司必日間跌倒；先知也必夜間與你一同跌倒；我必滅絕你的母親。
verses.e: You will stumble in the day , and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night ; and I will destroy your mother .

verses.z: 我的民因無知識而滅亡。你棄掉知識，我也必棄掉你，使你不再給我作祭司。你既忘了你上帝的律法，我也必忘記你的兒女。
verses.e: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge . Because you have rejected knowledge , I will also reject you , that you may be no priest to me . Because you have forgotten your God's law , I will also forget your children .

verses.z: 祭司越發增多，就越發得罪我；我必使他們的榮耀變為羞辱。
verses.e: As they were multiplied , so they sinned against me . I will change their glory into shame .

verses.z: 他們吃我民的[贖]罪[祭]，滿心願意我民犯罪。
verses.e: They feed on the sin of my people , and set their heart on their iniquity .

verses.z: 將來民如何，祭司也必如何；我必因他們所行的懲罰他們，照他們所做的報應他們。
verses.e: It will be like people , like priest ; and I will punish them for their ways , and will repay them for their deeds .

verses.z: 眾祭司啊，要聽我的話！以色列家啊，要留心聽！王家啊，要側耳而聽！審判要臨到你們，因你們在米斯巴如網羅，在他泊山如鋪張的網。
verses.e: " Listen to this , you priests ! Listen , house of Israel , and give ear , house of the king ! For the judgment is against you ; for you have been a snare at Mizpah , and a net spread on Tabor .

verses.z: 猶大的首領如同挪移地界的人，我必將忿怒倒在他們身上，如水一般。
verses.e: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark . I will pour out my wrath on them like water .

verses.z: 以法蓮因樂從[人的]命令，就受欺壓，被審判壓碎。
verses.e: Ephraim is oppressed , he is crushed in judgment , because he is intent in his pursuit of idols .

verses.z: 我使以法蓮如蟲蛀之物，使猶大家如朽爛之木。
verses.e: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth , and to the house of Judah like rottenness .

verses.z: 以法蓮見自己有病，猶大見自己有傷，他們就打發人往亞述去見耶雷布王，他卻不能醫治你們，不能治好你們的傷。
verses.e: " When Ephraim saw his sickness , and Judah his wound , then Ephraim went to Assyria , and sent to King Jareb : but he is not able to heal you , neither will he cure you of your wound .

verses.z: 我必向以法蓮如獅子，向猶大家如少壯獅子。我必撕裂而去，我要奪去，無人搭救。
verses.e: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion , and like a young lion to the house of Judah . I myself will tear in pieces and go away . I will carry off , and there will be no one to deliver .

verses.z: 我要回到原處，等他們自覺有罪，尋求我面；他們在急難的時候必切切尋求我。
verses.e: I will go and return to my place , until they acknowledge their offense , and seek my face . In their affliction they will seek me earnestly . "

verses.z: 這些悖逆的人肆行殺戮，[罪孽]極深；我卻斥責他們眾人。
verses.e: The rebels are deep in slaughter , but I discipline all of them .

verses.z: 以法蓮為我所知；以色列不能向我隱藏。以法蓮哪，現在你行淫了，以色列被玷污了。
verses.e: I know Ephraim , and Israel is not hidden from me ; for now , Ephraim , you have played the prostitute . Israel is defiled .

verses.z: 他們所行的使他們不能歸向上帝；因有淫心在他們裏面，他們也不認識耶和華。
verses.e: Their deeds won't allow them to turn to their God , for the spirit of prostitution is within them , and they don't know the LORD .

verses.z: 以色列的驕傲當面見證自己。故此，以色列和以法蓮必因自己的罪孽跌倒；猶大也必與他們一同跌倒。
verses.e: The pride of Israel testifies to his face . Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity . Judah also will stumble with them .

verses.z: 他們必牽着牛羊去尋求耶和華，卻尋不見；他已經轉去離開他們。
verses.e: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD , but they won't find him . He has withdrawn himself from them .

verses.z: 他們向耶和華行事詭詐，生了私子。到了月朔，他們與他們的地業必被吞滅。
verses.e: They are unfaithful to the LORD ; for they have borne illegitimate children . Now the new moon will devour them with their fields .

verses.z: 你們當在基比亞吹角，在拉瑪吹號，在伯‧亞文吹出大聲，[說]：便雅憫哪，[有仇敵]在你後頭！
verses.e: " Blow the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah ! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven , behind you , Benjamin !

verses.z: 在責罰的日子，以法蓮必變為荒場；我在以色列支派中，指示將來必成的事。
verses.e: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke . Among the tribes of Israel , I have made known that which will surely be .

verses.z: 來吧，我們歸向耶和華！他撕裂我們，也必醫治；他打傷我們，也必纏裹。
verses.e: " Come ! Let's return to the LORD ; for he has torn us to pieces , and he will heal us ; he has injured us , and he will bind up our wounds .

verses.z: 在以色列家，我見了可憎的事；在以法蓮那裏有淫行，以色列被玷污。
verses.e: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing . There is prostitution in Ephraim . Israel is defiled .

verses.z: 猶大啊，我使被擄之民歸回的時候，必有為你所命定的收場。
verses.e: " Also , Judah , there is a harvest appointed for you , when I restore the fortunes of my people .

verses.z: 過兩天他必使我們甦醒，第三天他必使我們興起，我們就在他面前得以存活。
verses.e: After two days he will revive us . On the third day he will raise us up , and we will live before him .

verses.z: 我們務要認識耶和華，竭力追求認識他。他出現確如晨[光]；他必臨到我們像甘雨，像滋潤田地的春雨。
verses.e: Let's acknowledge the LORD . Let's press on to know the LORD . As surely as the sun rises , the LORD will appear . He will come to us like the rain , like the spring rain that waters the earth . "

verses.z: 主說：以法蓮哪，我可向你怎樣行呢？猶大啊，我可向你怎樣做呢？因為你們的良善如同早晨的雲霧，又如速散的甘露。
verses.e: " Ephraim , what shall I do to you ? Judah , what shall I do to you ? For your love is like a morning cloud , and like the dew that disappears early .

verses.z: 因此，我藉先知砍伐他們，以我口中的話殺戮他們；我施行的審判如光發出。
verses.e: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets ; I killed them with the words of my mouth . Your judgments are like a flash of lightning .

verses.z: 我喜愛良善，不喜愛祭祀；喜愛認識上帝，勝於燔祭。
verses.e: For I desire mercy , and not sacrifice ; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings .

verses.z: 他們卻如亞當背約，在境內向我行事詭詐。
verses.e: But they , like Adam , have broken the covenant . They were unfaithful to me there .

verses.z: 基列是作孽之人的城，被血沾染。
verses.e: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity ; it is stained with blood .

verses.z: 強盜成群，怎樣埋伏殺人，祭司結黨，也照樣在示劍的路上殺戮，行了邪惡。
verses.e: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man , so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem , committing shameful crimes .

verses.z: 我想醫治以色列的時候，以法蓮的罪孽和撒馬利亞的罪惡就顯露出來。他們行事虛謊，內有賊人入室[偷竊]，外有強盜成群騷擾。
verses.e: When I would heal Israel , then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered , also the wickedness of Samaria ; for they commit falsehood , and the thief enters in , and the gang of robbers ravages outside .

verses.z: 以色列的驕傲當面見證自己，雖遭遇這一切，他們仍不歸向耶和華－他們的上帝，也不尋求他。
verses.e: The pride of Israel testifies to his face ; yet they haven't returned to the LORD their God , nor sought him , for all this .

verses.z: 以法蓮好像鴿子愚蠢無知；他們求告埃及，投奔亞述。
verses.e: " Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove , without understanding . They call to Egypt . They go to Assyria .

verses.z: 他們去的時候，我必將我的網撒在他們身上；我要打下他們，如同空中的鳥。我必按他們會眾所聽見的懲罰他們。
verses.e: When they go , I will spread my net on them . I will bring them down like the birds of the sky . I will chastise them , as their congregation has heard .

verses.z: 他們因離棄我，必定有禍；因違背我，必被毀滅。我雖要救贖他們，他們卻向我說謊。
verses.e: Woe to them ! For they have wandered from me . Destruction to them ! For they have trespassed against me . Though I would redeem them , yet they have spoken lies against me .

verses.z: 他們並不誠心哀求我，乃在床上呼號；他們為求五穀新酒聚集，仍然悖逆我。
verses.e: They haven't cried to me with their heart , but they howl on their beds . They assemble themselves for grain and new wine . They turn away from me .

verses.z: 我雖教導他們，堅固他們的膀臂，他們竟圖謀抗拒我。
verses.e: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms , yet they plot evil against me .

verses.z: 他們歸向，卻不歸向至上者；他們如同翻背的弓。他們的首領必因舌頭的狂傲倒在刀下；這在埃及地必作人的譏笑。
verses.e: They return , but not to the Most High . They are like a faulty bow . Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue . This will be their derision in the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 他們心裏並不思想我記念他們的一切惡；他們所行的現在纏繞他們，都在我面前。
verses.e: They don't consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness . Now their own deeds have engulfed them . They are before my face .

verses.z: 他們行惡使君王歡喜，說謊使首領喜樂。
verses.e: They make the king glad with their wickedness , and the princes with their lies .

verses.z: 他們都是行淫的，像火爐被烤餅的燒熱，從摶麵到發麵的時候，暫不使[火]着旺。
verses.e: They are all adulterers . They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring , from the kneading of the dough , until it is leavened .

verses.z: 在我們王[宴樂]的日子，首領因酒的烈性成病；王與褻慢人拉手。
verses.e: On the day of our king , the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine . He joined his hand with mockers .

verses.z: 首領埋伏的時候，心中熱如火爐，就如烤餅的整夜睡臥，到了早晨火氣炎炎。
verses.e: For they have prepared their heart like an oven , while they lie in wait . Their anger smolders all night . In the morning it burns as a flaming fire .

verses.z: 眾民也熱如火爐，燒滅他們的官長。他們的君王都仆倒而死；他們中間無一人求告我。
verses.e: They are all hot as an oven , and devour their judges . All their kings have fallen . There is no one among them who calls to me .

verses.z: 以法蓮與列邦人攙雜；以法蓮是沒有翻過的餅。
verses.e: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations . Ephraim is a pancake not turned over .

verses.z: 外邦人吞吃他勞力得來的，他卻不知道；頭髮斑白，他也不覺得。
verses.e: Strangers have devoured his strength , and he doesn't realize it . Indeed , gray hairs are here and there on him , and he doesn't realize it .

verses.z: 你用口吹角吧！[敵人]如鷹來攻打耶和華的家；因為這民違背我的約，干犯我的律法。
verses.e: " Put the trumpet to your lips ! Something like an eagle is over the LORD's house , because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law .

verses.z: 他們雖在列邦中賄買人，現在我卻要聚集[懲罰]他們；他們因君王和首領所加的重擔日漸衰微。
verses.e: But although they sold themselves among the nations , I will now gather them ; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones .

verses.z: 以法蓮增添祭壇取罪；因此，祭壇使他犯罪。
verses.e: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning , they became for him altars for sinning .

verses.z: 我為他寫了律法萬條，他卻以為與他毫無關涉。
verses.e: I wrote for him the many things of my law , but they were regarded as a strange thing .

verses.z: 至於獻給我的祭物，他們自食其肉，耶和華卻不悅納他們。現在必記念他們的罪孽，追討他們的罪惡；他們必歸回埃及。
verses.e: As for the sacrifices of my offerings , they sacrifice meat and eat it , but the LORD doesn't accept them . Now he will remember their iniquity , and punish their sins . They will return to Egypt .

verses.z: 以色列忘記造他的主，建造宮殿；猶大多造堅固城，我卻要降火焚燒他的城邑，燒滅其中的宮殿。
verses.e: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces ; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities ; but I will send a fire on his cities , and it will devour its fortresses . "

verses.z: 他們必呼叫我說：我的上帝啊，我們以色列認識你了。
verses.e: They cry to me , ' My God , we , Israel , acknowledge you ! '

verses.z: 以色列丟棄良善；仇敵必追逼他。
verses.e: Israel has cast off that which is good . The enemy will pursue him .

verses.z: 他們立君王，卻不由我；他們立首領，我卻不認。他們用金銀為自己製造偶像，以致被剪除。
verses.e: They have set up kings , but not by me . They have made princes , and I didn't approve . Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols , that they may be cut off .

verses.z: 撒馬利亞啊，耶和華已經丟棄你的牛犢；我的怒氣向拜牛犢的人發作。他們到幾時方能無罪呢？
verses.e: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol ! My anger burns against them ! How long will it be until they are capable of purity ?

verses.z: 這[牛犢]出於以色列，是匠人所造的，並不是神。撒馬利亞的牛犢必被打碎。
verses.e: For this is even from Israel ! The workman made it , and it is no God ; indeed , the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces .

verses.z: 他們所種的是風，所收的是暴風；所種的不成禾稼，就是發苗也不結實；即便結實，外邦人必吞吃。
verses.e: For they sow the wind , and they will reap the whirlwind . He has no standing grain . The stalk will yield no head . If it does yield , strangers will swallow it up .

verses.z: 以色列被吞吃；現今在列國中，好像人不喜悅的器皿。
verses.e: Israel is swallowed up . Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing .

verses.z: 他們投奔亞述，如同獨行的野驢；以法蓮賄買朋黨。
verses.e: For they have gone up to Assyria , like a wild donkey wandering alone . Ephraim has hired lovers for himself .

verses.z: 以色列啊，不要像外邦人歡喜快樂；因為你行邪淫離棄你的上帝，在各穀場上[如妓女]喜愛賞賜。
verses.e: Don't rejoice , Israel , to jubilation like the nations ; for you were unfaithful to your God . You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor .

verses.z: [主說]：我遇見以色列如葡萄在曠野；我看見你們的列祖如無花果樹上春季初熟的果子。他們卻來到巴力‧毗珥專拜那可羞恥的，就成為可憎惡的，與他們所愛的一樣。
verses.e: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness . I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season ; but they came to Baal Peor , and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing , and became abominable like that which they loved .

verses.z: 至於以法蓮人，他們的榮耀必如鳥飛去，必不生產，不懷胎，不成孕。
verses.e: As for Ephraim , their glory will fly away like a bird . There will be no birth , no one with child , and no conception .

verses.z: 縱然養大兒女，我卻必使他們喪子，甚至不留一個。我離棄他們，他們就有禍了。
verses.e: Though they bring up their children , yet I will bereave them , so that not a man shall be left . Indeed , woe also to them when I depart from them !

verses.z: 我看以法蓮如泰爾栽於美地。以法蓮卻要將自己的兒女帶出來，交與行殺戮的人。
verses.e: I have seen Ephraim , like Tyre , planted in a pleasant place ; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你加給他們－加甚麼呢？要使他們胎墜乳乾。
verses.e: Give them — LORD what will you give ? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts .

verses.z: [耶和華說]：他們一切的惡事都在吉甲；我在那裏憎惡他們。因他們所行的惡，我必從我地上趕出他們去，不再憐愛他們；他們的首領都是悖逆的。
verses.e: " All their wickedness is in Gilgal ; for there I hated them . Because of the wickedness of their deeds , I will drive them out of my house ! I will love them no more . All their princes are rebels .

verses.z: 以法蓮受責罰，根本枯乾，必不能結果，即或生產，我必殺他們所生的愛子。
verses.e: Ephraim is struck . Their root has dried up . They will bear no fruit . Even though they give birth , yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb . "

verses.z: 我的上帝必棄絕他們，因為他們不聽從他；他們也必飄流在列國中。
verses.e: My God will cast them away , because they didn't listen to him ; and they will be wanderers among the nations .

verses.z: 穀場和酒醡都不夠以色列人使用；新酒也必缺乏。
verses.e: The threshing floor and the wine press won't feed them , and the new wine will fail her .

verses.z: 他們必不得住耶和華的地；以法蓮卻要歸回埃及，必在亞述吃不潔淨的食物。
verses.e: They won't dwell in the LORD's land ; but Ephraim will return to Egypt , and they will eat unclean food in Assyria .

verses.z: 他們必不得向耶和華奠酒，即便奠酒也不蒙悅納。他們的祭物必如居喪者的食物，凡吃的必被玷污；因他們的食物只為自己的口腹，必不奉入耶和華的殿。
verses.e: They won't pour out wine offerings to the LORD , neither will they be pleasing to him . Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners ; all who eat of it will be polluted ; for their bread will be for their appetite . It will not come into the LORD's house .

verses.z: 在大會的日子，到耶和華的節期，你們怎樣行呢？
verses.e: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly , and in the day of the feast of the LORD ?

verses.z: 看哪，他們逃避災難；埃及人必收殮他們的屍首，摩弗人必葬埋他們的骸骨。他們用銀子做的美物上必長蒺藜；他們的帳棚中必生荊棘。
verses.e: For , behold , when they flee destruction , Egypt will gather them up . Memphis will bury them . Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver . Thorns will be in their tents .

verses.z: 以色列人必知道降罰的日子臨近，報應的時候來到。[民說]：作先知的是愚昧；受靈感的是狂妄，皆因他們多多作孽，大懷怨恨。
verses.e: The days of visitation have come . The days of reckoning have come . Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool , and the man who is inspired to be insane , because of the abundance of your sins , and because your hostility is great .

verses.z: 以法蓮曾作我上帝守望的；至於先知，在他一切的道上作為捕鳥人的網羅，在他上帝的家中懷怨恨。
verses.e: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God . A fowler's snare is on all of his paths , and hostility in the house of his God .

verses.z: 以法蓮深深地敗壞，如在基比亞的日子一樣。耶和華必記念他們的罪孽，追討他們的罪惡。
verses.e: They have deeply corrupted themselves , as in the days of Gibeah . He will remember their iniquity . He will punish them for their sins .

verses.z: 當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家作猶大王的時候，亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論到猶大和耶路撒冷。
verses.e: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz , which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah .

verses.z: 你們這所多瑪的官長啊，要聽耶和華的話！你們這蛾摩拉的百姓啊，要側耳聽我們上帝的訓誨！
verses.e: Hear the LORD's word , you rulers of Sodom ! Listen to the law of our God , you people of Gomorrah !

verses.z: 耶和華說：你們所獻的許多祭物與我何益呢？公綿羊的燔祭和肥畜的脂油，我已經夠了；公牛的血，羊羔的血，公山羊的血，我都不喜悅。
verses.e: " What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me ? " , says the LORD . " I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals . I don't delight in the blood of bulls , or of lambs , or of male goats .

verses.z: 你們來朝見我，誰向你們討這些，使你們踐踏我的院宇呢？
verses.e: When you come to appear before me , who has required this at your hand , to trample my courts ?

verses.z: 你們不要再獻虛浮的供物。香品是我所憎惡的；月朔和安息日，並宣召的大會，也是我所憎惡的；作罪孽，又守嚴肅會，我也不能容忍。
verses.e: Bring no more vain offerings . Incense is an abomination to me . New moons , Sabbaths , and convocations — I can't stand evil assemblies .

verses.z: 你們的月朔和節期，我心裏恨惡，我都以為麻煩；我擔當，便不耐煩。
verses.e: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts . They are a burden to me . I am weary of bearing them .

verses.z: 你們舉手禱告，我必遮眼不看；就是你們多多地祈禱，我也不聽。你們的手都滿了[殺人的]血。
verses.e: When you spread out your hands , I will hide my eyes from you . Yes , when you make many prayers , I will not hear . Your hands are full of blood .

verses.z: 你們要洗濯、自潔，從我眼前除掉你們的惡行，要止住作惡，
verses.e: Wash yourselves . Make yourself clean . Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes . Cease to do evil .

verses.z: 學習行善，尋求公平，解救受欺壓的；給孤兒伸冤，為寡婦辨屈。
verses.e: Learn to do well . Seek justice . Relieve the oppressed . Defend the fatherless . Plead for the widow . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：你們來，我們彼此辯論。你們的罪雖像硃紅，必變成雪白；雖紅如丹顏，必白如羊毛。
verses.e: " Come now , and let's reason together , " says the LORD : " Though your sins are as scarlet , they shall be as white as snow . Though they are red like crimson , they shall be as wool .

verses.z: 你們若甘心聽從，必吃地上的美物，
verses.e: If you are willing and obedient , you will eat the good of the land ;

verses.z: 天哪，要聽！地啊，側耳而聽！因為耶和華說：我養育兒女，將他們養大，他們竟悖逆我。
verses.e: Hear , heavens , and listen , earth ; for the LORD has spoken : " I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me .

verses.z: 若不聽從，反倒悖逆，必被刀劍吞滅。這是耶和華親口說的。
verses.e: but if you refuse and rebel , you will be devoured with the sword ; for the LORD's mouth has spoken it . "

verses.z: 可歎，忠信的城變為妓女！從前充滿了公平，公義居在其中，現今卻有兇手居住。
verses.e: How the faithful city has become a prostitute ! She was full of justice . Righteousness lodged in her , but now there are murderers .

verses.z: 你的銀子變為渣滓；你的酒用水攙對。
verses.e: Your silver has become dross , your wine mixed with water .

verses.z: 你的官長居心悖逆，與盜賊作伴，各都喜愛賄賂，追求贓私。他們不為孤兒伸冤；寡婦的案件也不得呈到他們面前。
verses.e: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves . Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards . They don't defend the fatherless , neither does the cause of the widow come to them .

verses.z: 因此，主－萬軍之耶和華、以色列的大能者說：哎！我要向我的對頭雪恨，向我的敵人報仇。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord , GOD of Armies , the Mighty One of Israel , says : " Ah , I will get relief from my adversaries , and avenge myself on my enemies .

verses.z: 我必反手加在你身上，煉盡你的渣滓，除淨你的雜質。
verses.e: I will turn my hand on you , thoroughly purge away your dross , and will take away all your tin .

verses.z: 我也必復還你的審判官，像起初一樣，復還你的謀士，像起先一般。然後，你必稱為公義之城，忠信之邑。
verses.e: I will restore your judges as at the first , and your counselors as at the beginning . Afterward you shall be called ' The city of righteousness , a faithful town . '

verses.z: 錫安必因公平得蒙救贖；其中歸正的人必因公義得蒙救贖。
verses.e: Zion shall be redeemed with justice , and her converts with righteousness .

verses.z: 但悖逆的和犯罪的必一同敗亡；離棄耶和華的必致消滅。
verses.e: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together , and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed .

verses.z: 那等人必因你們所喜愛的橡樹抱愧；你們必因所選擇的園子蒙羞。
verses.e: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired , and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen .

verses.z: 牛認識主人，驢認識主人的槽，以色列卻不認識；我的民卻不留意。
verses.e: The ox knows his owner , and the donkey his master's crib ; but Israel doesn't know . My people don't consider . "

verses.z: 因為，你們必如葉子枯乾的橡樹，好像無水[澆灌]的園子。
verses.e: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades , and as a garden that has no water .

verses.z: 有權勢的必如麻瓤；他的工作好像火星，都要一同焚毀，無人撲滅。
verses.e: The strong will be like tinder , and his work like a spark . They will both burn together , and no one will quench them . "

verses.z: 嗐！犯罪的國民，擔着罪孽的百姓；行惡的種類，敗壞的兒女！他們離棄耶和華，藐視以色列的聖者，與他生疏，往後退步。
verses.e: Ah sinful nation , a people loaded with iniquity , offspring of evildoers , children who deal corruptly ! They have forsaken the LORD . They have despised the Holy One of Israel . They are estranged and backward .

verses.z: 你們為甚麼屢次悖逆，還要受責打嗎？你們已經滿頭疼痛，全心發昏。
verses.e: Why should you be beaten more , that you revolt more and more ? The whole head is sick , and the whole heart faint .

verses.z: 從腳掌到頭頂，沒有一處完全的，盡是傷口、青腫，與新打的傷痕，都沒有收口，沒有纏裹，也沒有用膏滋潤。
verses.e: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it , but wounds , welts , and open sores . They haven't been closed , bandaged , or soothed with oil .

verses.z: 你們的地土已經荒涼；你們的城邑被火焚毀。你們的田地在你們眼前為外邦人所侵吞，既被外邦人傾覆就成為荒涼。
verses.e: Your country is desolate . Your cities are burned with fire . Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate , as overthrown by strangers .

verses.z: 僅存錫安城，好像葡萄園的草棚，瓜田的茅屋，被圍困的城邑。
verses.e: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard , like a hut in a field of melons , like a besieged city .

verses.z: 若不是萬軍之耶和華給我們稍留餘種，我們早已像所多瑪、蛾摩拉的樣子了。
verses.e: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant , we would have been as Sodom . We would have been like Gomorrah .

verses.z: 禍哉！那些設立不義之律例的和記錄奸詐之判語的，
verses.e: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees , and to the writers who write oppressive decrees

verses.z: 我手已經搆到有偶像的國；這些國雕刻的偶像過於耶路撒冷和撒馬利亞的偶像。
verses.e: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols , whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria ,

verses.z: 我怎樣待撒馬利亞和其中的偶像，豈不照樣待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像嗎？
verses.e: shall I not , as I have done to Samaria and her idols , so do to Jerusalem and her idols ?

verses.z: 主在錫安山和耶路撒冷成就他一切工作的時候，[主說]：「我必罰亞述王自大的心和他高傲眼目的榮耀。」
verses.e: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem , I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria , and the insolence of his arrogant looks .

verses.z: 因為他說：我所成就的事是靠我手的能力和我的智慧，我本有聰明。我挪移列國的地界，搶奪他們所積蓄的財寶；並且我像勇士，使坐寶座的降為卑。
verses.e: For he has said , " By the strength of my hand I have done it , and by my wisdom , for I have understanding . I have removed the boundaries of the peoples , and have robbed their treasures . Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers .

verses.z: 我的手搆到列國的財寶，好像人搆到鳥窩；我也得了全地，好像人拾起所棄的雀蛋。沒有動翅膀的；沒有張嘴的，也沒有鳴叫的。
verses.e: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest , and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned , I have gathered all the earth . There was no one who moved their wing , or that opened their mouth , or chirped . "

verses.z: 斧豈可向用斧砍木的自誇呢？鋸豈可向用鋸的自大呢？好比棍掄起那舉棍的，好比杖舉起那非木的人。
verses.e: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it ? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it ? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up , or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood .

verses.z: 因此，主－萬軍之耶和華必使亞述王的肥壯人變為瘦弱，在他的榮華之下必有火着起，如同焚燒一樣。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord , GOD of Armies , will send among his fat ones leanness ; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire .

verses.z: 以色列的光必如火；他的聖者必如火焰。在一日之間，將亞述王的荊棘和蒺藜焚燒淨盡；
verses.e: The light of Israel will be for a fire , and his Holy One for a flame ; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day .

verses.z: 又將他樹林和肥田的榮耀全然燒盡，好像拿軍旗的昏過去一樣。
verses.e: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field , both soul and body . It will be as when a standard bearer faints .

verses.z: 他林中剩下的樹必稀少，就是孩子也能寫其數。
verses.e: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few , so that a child could write their number .

verses.z: 為要屈枉窮乏人，奪去我民中困苦人的理，以寡婦當作擄物，以孤兒當作掠物。
verses.e: to deprive the needy of justice , and to rob the poor among my people of their rights , that widows may be their plunder , and that they may make the fatherless their prey !

verses.z: 到那日，以色列所剩下的和雅各家所逃脫的，不再倚靠那擊打他們的，卻要誠實倚靠耶和華－以色列的聖者。
verses.e: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel , and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them , but shall lean on the LORD , the Holy One of Israel , in truth .

verses.z: 所剩下的，就是雅各[家]所剩下的，必歸回全能的上帝。
verses.e: A remnant will return , even the remnant of Jacob , to the mighty God .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你的百姓雖多如海沙，[惟有]剩下的歸回。原來滅絕的事已定，必有公義施行，如水漲溢。
verses.e: For though your people , Israel , are like the sand of the sea , only a remnant of them will return . A destruction is determined , overflowing with righteousness .

verses.z: 因為主－萬軍之耶和華在全地之中必成就所定規的結局。
verses.e: For the Lord , GOD of Armies , will make a full end , and that determined , throughout all the earth .

verses.z: 所以，主－萬軍之耶和華如此說：「住錫安我的百姓啊，亞述王雖然用棍擊打你，又照埃及的樣子舉杖攻擊你，你卻不要怕他。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord , GOD of Armies , says , " My people who dwell in Zion , don't be afraid of the Assyrian , though he strike you with the rod , and lift up his staff against you , as Egypt did .

verses.z: 因為還有一點點時候，[向你們]發的忿恨就要完畢，我的怒氣要向他[發作]，使他滅亡。
verses.e: For yet a very little while , and the indignation against you will be accomplished , and my anger will be directed to his destruction . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華要興起鞭來攻擊他，好像在俄立磐石那裏殺戮米甸人一樣。耶和華的杖要向海伸出，把杖舉起，像在埃及一樣。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him , as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb . His rod will be over the sea , and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt .

verses.z: 到那日，亞述王的重擔必離開你的肩頭；他的軛必離開你的頸項；那軛也必因肥壯的緣故撐斷。」
verses.e: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder , and his yoke from off your neck , and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil .

verses.z: 亞述王來到亞葉，經過米磯崙，在密抹安放輜重。
verses.e: He has come to Aiath . He has passed through Migron . At Michmash he stores his baggage .

verses.z: 他們過了隘口，在迦巴住宿。拉瑪人戰兢；掃羅的基比亞人逃跑。
verses.e: They have gone over the pass . They have taken up their lodging at Geba . Ramah trembles . Gibeah of Saul has fled .

verses.z: 到降罰的日子，有災禍從遠方臨到，那時，你們怎樣行呢？你們向誰逃奔求救呢？你們的榮耀存留何處呢？
verses.e: What will you do in the day of visitation , and in the desolation which will come from afar ? To whom will you flee for help ? Where will you leave your wealth ?

verses.z: 迦琳的居民哪，要高聲呼喊！萊煞人哪，須聽！哀哉！困苦的亞拿突啊。
verses.e: Cry aloud with your voice , daughter of Gallim ! Listen , Laishah ! You poor Anathoth !

verses.z: 瑪得米那人躲避；基柄的居民逃遁。
verses.e: Madmenah is a fugitive . The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety .

verses.z: 當那日，亞述王要在挪伯歇兵，向錫安女子的山－就是耶路撒冷的山－掄手[攻他]。
verses.e: This very day he will halt at Nob . He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion , the hill of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 看哪，主－萬軍之耶和華以驚嚇削去樹枝；長高的必被砍下，高大的必被伐倒。
verses.e: Behold , the Lord , GOD of Armies , will lop the boughs with terror . The tall will be cut down , and the lofty will be brought low .

verses.z: 稠密的樹林，他要用鐵器砍下；黎巴嫩[的樹木]必被大能者伐倒。
verses.e: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron , and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One .

verses.z: 他們只得屈身在被擄的人以下，仆倒在被殺的人以下。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
verses.e: They will only bow down under the prisoners , and will fall under the slain . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .

verses.z: 亞述是我怒氣的棍，手中拿我惱恨的杖。
verses.e: Alas Assyrian , the rod of my anger , the staff in whose hand is my indignation !

verses.z: 我要打發他攻擊褻瀆的國民，吩咐他攻擊我所惱怒的百姓，搶財為擄物，奪貨為掠物，將他們踐踏，像街上的泥土一樣。
verses.e: I will send him against a profane nation , and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey , and to tread them down like the mire of the streets .

verses.z: 然而，他不是這樣的意思；他心也不這樣打算。他心裏倒想毀滅，剪除不少的國。
verses.e: However , he doesn't mean so , neither does his heart think so ; but it is in his heart to destroy , and to cut off not a few nations .

verses.z: 他說：我的臣僕豈不都是王嗎？
verses.e: For he says , " Aren't all of my princes kings ?

verses.z: 迦勒挪豈不像迦基米施嗎？哈馬豈不像亞珥拔嗎？撒馬利亞豈不像大馬士革嗎？
verses.e: Isn't Calno like Carchemish ? Isn't Hamath like Arpad ? Isn't Samaria like Damascus ? "

verses.z: 從耶西的本必發一條；從他根生的枝子必結果實。
verses.e: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse , and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit .

verses.z: 到那日，耶西的根立作萬民的大旗；外邦人必尋求他，他安息之所大有榮耀。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse , who stands as a banner of the peoples ; and his resting place will be glorious .

verses.z: 當那日，主必二次伸手救回自己百姓中所餘剩的，就是在亞述、埃及、巴忒羅、古實、以攔、示拿、哈馬，並眾海島所剩下的。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria , from Egypt , from Pathros , from Cush , from Elam , from Shinar , from Hamath , and from the islands of the sea .

verses.z: 他必向列國豎立大旗，招回以色列被趕散的人，又從地的四方聚集分散的猶大人。
verses.e: He will set up a banner for the nations , and will assemble the outcasts of Israel , and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth .

verses.z: 以法蓮的嫉妒就必消散；擾害猶大的必被剪除。以法蓮必不嫉妒猶大，猶大也不擾害以法蓮。
verses.e: The envy also of Ephraim will depart , and those who persecute Judah will be cut off . Ephraim won't envy Judah , and Judah won't persecute Ephraim .

verses.z: 他們要向西飛，撲在非利士人的肩頭上，一同擄掠東方人，伸手按住以東和摩押；亞捫人也必順服他們。
verses.e: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west . Together they will plunder the children of the east . They will extend their power over Edom and Moab , and the children of Ammon will obey them .

verses.z: 耶和華必使埃及海汊枯乾，掄手用暴熱的風使大河分為七條，令人過去不致濕腳。
verses.e: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea ; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River , and will split it into seven streams , and cause men to march over in sandals .

verses.z: 為主餘剩的百姓，就是從亞述剩下回來的，必有一條大道，如當日以色列從埃及地上來一樣。
verses.e: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria , like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈必住在他身上，就是使他有智慧和聰明的靈，謀略和能力的靈，知識和敬畏耶和華的靈。
verses.e: The LORD's Spirit will rest on him : the spirit of wisdom and understanding , the spirit of counsel and might , the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD .

verses.z: 他必以敬畏耶和華為樂；行審判不憑眼見，斷是非也不憑耳聞；
verses.e: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD . He will not judge by the sight of his eyes , neither decide by the hearing of his ears ;

verses.z: 卻要以公義審判貧窮人，以正直判斷世上的謙卑人，以口中的杖擊打世界，以嘴裏的氣殺戮惡人。
verses.e: but he will judge the poor with righteousness , and decide with equity for the humble of the earth . He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth ; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked .

verses.z: 公義必當他的腰帶；信實必當他脅下的帶子。
verses.e: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist , and faithfulness the belt around his waist .

verses.z: 豺狼必與綿羊羔同居，豹子與山羊羔同臥；少壯獅子與牛犢並肥畜同群；小孩子要牽引牠們。
verses.e: The wolf will live with the lamb , and the leopard will lie down with the young goat , the calf , the young lion , and the fattened calf together ; and a little child will lead them .

verses.z: 牛必與熊同食；牛犢必與小熊同臥；獅子必吃草，與牛一樣。
verses.e: The cow and the bear will graze . Their young ones will lie down together . The lion will eat straw like the ox .

verses.z: 吃奶的孩子必玩耍在虺蛇的洞口；斷奶的嬰兒必按手在毒蛇的穴上。
verses.e: The nursing child will play near a cobra's hole , and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper's den .

verses.z: 在我聖山的遍處，這一切都不傷人，不害物；因為認識耶和華的知識要充滿遍地，好像水充滿洋海一般。
verses.e: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain ; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD , as the waters cover the sea .

verses.z: 到那日，你必說：耶和華啊，我要稱謝你！因為你雖然向我發怒，你的怒氣卻已轉消；你又安慰了我。
verses.e: In that day you will say , " I will give thanks to you , the LORD ; for though you were angry with me , your anger has turned away and you comfort me .

verses.z: 看哪！上帝是我的拯救；我要倚靠他，並不懼怕。因為主耶和華是我的力量，是我的詩歌，他也成了我的拯救。
verses.e: Behold , God is my salvation . I will trust , and will not be afraid ; for the LORD , the LORD , is my strength and song ; and he has become my salvation . "

verses.z: 所以，你們必從救恩的泉源歡然取水。
verses.e: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation .

verses.z: 在那日，你們要說：當稱謝耶和華，求告他的名；將他所行的傳揚在萬民中，提說他的名已被尊崇。
verses.e: In that day you will say , " Give thanks to the LORD ! Call on his name ! Declare his doings among the peoples ! Proclaim that his name is exalted !

verses.z: 你們要向耶和華唱歌，因他所行的甚是美好；但願這事普傳天下。
verses.e: Sing to the LORD , for he has done excellent things ! Let this be known in all the earth !

verses.z: 錫安的居民哪，當揚聲歡呼，因為在你們中間的以色列聖者乃為至大。
verses.e: Cry aloud and shout , you inhabitant of Zion , for the Holy One of Israel is great among you ! "

verses.z: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論巴比倫。
verses.e: The burden of Babylon , which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw .

verses.z: 天上的眾星群宿都不發光；日頭一出就變黑暗；月亮也不放光。
verses.e: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light . The sun will be darkened in its going out , and the moon will not cause its light to shine .

verses.z: 我必因邪惡刑罰世界，因罪孽刑罰惡人，使驕傲人的狂妄止息，制伏強暴人的狂傲。
verses.e: I will punish the world for their evil , and the wicked for their iniquity . I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease , and will humble the arrogance of the terrible .

verses.z: 我必使人比精金還少，使人比俄斐純金更少。
verses.e: I will make people more rare than fine gold , even a person than the pure gold of Ophir .

verses.z: 我－萬軍之耶和華在忿恨中發烈怒的日子，必使天震動，使地搖撼，離其本位。
verses.e: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble , and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies ' wrath , and in the day of his fierce anger .

verses.z: 人必像被追趕的鹿，像無人收聚的羊，各歸回本族，各逃到本土。
verses.e: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers , they will each turn to their own people , and will each flee to their own land .

verses.z: 凡被[仇敵]追上的必被刺死；凡被捉住的必被刀殺。
verses.e: Everyone who is found will be thrust through . Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword .

verses.z: 他們的嬰孩必在他們眼前摔碎；他們的房屋必被搶奪；他們的妻子必被玷污。
verses.e: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes . Their houses will be ransacked , and their wives raped .

verses.z: 我必激動米底亞人來攻擊他們。米底亞人不注重銀子，也不喜愛金子。
verses.e: Behold , I will stir up the Medes against them , who will not value silver , and as for gold , they will not delight in it .

verses.z: 他們必用弓擊碎少年人，不憐憫婦人所生的，眼也不顧惜孩子。
verses.e: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces ; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb . Their eyes will not spare children .

verses.z: 巴比倫素來為列國的榮耀，為迦勒底人所矜誇的華美，必像上帝所傾覆的所多瑪、蛾摩拉一樣。
verses.e: Babylon , the glory of kingdoms , the beauty of the Chaldeans ' pride , will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah .

verses.z: 應當在淨光的山豎立大旗，向群眾揚聲招手，使他們進入貴冑的門。
verses.e: Set up a banner on the bare mountain ! Lift up your voice to them ! Wave your hand , that they may go into the gates of the nobles .

verses.z: 其內必永無人煙，世世代代無人居住。阿拉伯人也不在那裏支搭帳棚；牧羊的人也不使羊群臥在那裏。
verses.e: It will never be inhabited , neither will it be lived in from generation to generation . The Arabian will not pitch a tent there , neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there .

verses.z: 只有曠野的走獸臥在那裏；咆哮的獸滿了房屋。鴕鳥住在那裏；野山羊在那裏跳舞。
verses.e: But wild animals of the desert will lie there , and their houses will be full of jackals . Ostriches will dwell there , and wild goats will frolic there .

verses.z: 豺狼必在它宮中呼號；野狗必在它華美殿內吼叫。巴比倫[受罰]的時候臨近；它的日子必不長久。
verses.e: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses , and jackals in the pleasant palaces . Her time is near to come , and her days will not be prolonged .

verses.z: 我吩咐我所挑出來的人；我招呼我的勇士－就是那矜誇高傲之輩，為要成就我怒中所定的。
verses.e: I have commanded my consecrated ones ; yes , I have called my mighty men for my anger , even my proudly exulting ones .

verses.z: 山間有多人的聲音，好像是大國人民。有許多國的民聚集鬨嚷的聲音；這是萬軍之耶和華點齊軍隊，預備打仗。
verses.e: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains , as of a great people ; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together ! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle .

verses.z: 他們從遠方來，從天邊來，就是耶和華並他惱恨的兵器要毀滅這全地。
verses.e: They come from a far country , from the uttermost part of heaven , even the LORD , and the weapons of his indignation , to destroy the whole land .

verses.z: 你們要哀號，因為耶和華的日子臨近了！這日來到，好像毀滅從全能者來到。
verses.e: Wail , for the LORD's day is at hand ! It will come as destruction from the Almighty .

verses.z: 所以，人手都必軟弱；人心都必消化。
verses.e: Therefore all hands will be feeble , and everyone's heart will melt .

verses.z: 他們必驚惶悲痛；愁苦必將他們抓住。他們疼痛，好像產難的婦人一樣，彼此驚奇相看，臉如火焰。
verses.e: They will be dismayed . Pangs and sorrows will seize them . They will be in pain like a woman in labor . They will look in amazement one at another . Their faces will be faces of flame .

verses.z: 耶和華的日子臨到，必有殘忍、忿恨、烈怒，使這地荒涼，從其中除滅罪人。
verses.e: Behold , the day of the LORD comes , cruel , with wrath and fierce anger ; to make the land a desolation , and to destroy its sinners out of it .

verses.z: 耶和華要憐恤雅各，必再揀選以色列，將他們安置在本地。寄居的必與他們聯合，緊貼雅各家。
verses.e: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob , and will yet choose Israel , and set them in their own land . The foreigner will join himself with them , and they will unite with the house of Jacob .

verses.z: 他們都要發言對你說：你也變為軟弱像我們一樣嗎？你也成了我們的樣子嗎？
verses.e: They all will answer and ask you , " Have you also become as weak as we are ? Have you become like us ? "

verses.z: 你的威勢和你琴瑟的聲音都下到陰間。你下鋪的是蟲，上蓋的是蛆。
verses.e: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol , with the sound of your stringed instruments . Maggots are spread out under you , and worms cover you .

verses.z: 明亮之星，早晨之子啊，你何竟從天墜落？你這攻敗列國的何竟被砍倒在地上？
verses.e: How you have fallen from heaven , shining one , son of the dawn ! How you are cut down to the ground , who laid the nations low !

verses.z: 你心裏曾說：我要升到天上；我要高舉我的寶座在上帝眾星以上；我要坐在聚會的山上，在北方的極處。
verses.e: You said in your heart , " I will ascend into heaven ! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God ! I will sit on the mountain of assembly , in the far north !

verses.z: 我要升到高雲之上；我要與至上者同等。
verses.e: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds ! I will make myself like the Most High ! "

verses.z: 然而，你必墜落陰間，到坑中極深之處。
verses.e: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol , to the depths of the pit .

verses.z: 凡看見你的都要定睛看你，留意看你，[說]：使大地戰抖，使列國震動，
verses.e: Those who see you will stare at you . They will ponder you , saying , " Is this the man who made the earth to tremble , who shook kingdoms ,

verses.z: 使世界如同荒野，使城邑傾覆，不釋放被擄的人歸家，是這個人嗎？
verses.e: who made the world like a wilderness , and overthrew its cities , who didn't release his prisoners to their home ? "

verses.z: 列國的君王俱各在自己陰宅的榮耀中安睡。
verses.e: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory , everyone in his own house .

verses.z: 惟獨你被拋棄，不得入你的墳墓，好像可憎的枝子，以被殺的人為衣，就是被刀刺透，墜落坑中石頭那裏的；你又像被踐踏的屍首一樣。
verses.e: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch , clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword , who go down to the stones of the pit ; like a dead body trodden under foot .

verses.z: 外邦人必將他們帶回本土；以色列家必在耶和華的地上得外邦人為僕婢，也要擄掠先前擄掠他們的，轄制先前欺壓他們的。
verses.e: The peoples will take them , and bring them to their place . The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD's land for servants and for handmaids . They will take as captives those whose captives they were ; and they shall rule over their oppressors .

verses.z: 你不得與君王同葬；因為你敗壞你的國，殺戮你的民。惡人後裔的名，必永不提說。
verses.e: You will not join them in burial , because you have destroyed your land . You have killed your people . The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever .

verses.z: 先人既有罪孽，就要預備殺戮他的子孫，免得他們興起來，得了遍地，在世上修滿城邑。
verses.e: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers , that they not rise up and possess the earth , and fill the surface of the world with cities .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必興起攻擊他們，將巴比倫的名號和所餘剩的人，連子帶孫一併剪除。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " I will rise up against them , " says the LORD of Armies , " and cut off from Babylon name and remnant , and son and son's son , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我必使巴比倫為箭豬所得，又變為水池；我要用滅亡的掃帚掃淨它。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: " I will also make it a possession for the porcupine , and pools of water . I will sweep it with the broom of destruction , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華起誓說：我怎樣思想，必照樣成就；我怎樣定意，必照樣成立，
verses.e: The LORD of Armies has sworn , saying , " Surely , as I have thought , so shall it happen ; and as I have purposed , so shall it stand :

verses.z: 就是在我地上打折亞述人，在我山上將他踐踏。他加的軛必離開以色列人；他加的重擔必離開他們的肩頭。
verses.e: that I will break the Assyrian in my land , and tread him under foot on my mountains . Then his yoke will leave them , and his burden leave their shoulders .

verses.z: 這是向全地所定的旨意；這是向萬國所伸出的手。
verses.e: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth . This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華既然定意，誰能廢棄呢？他的手已經伸出，誰能轉回呢？
verses.e: For the LORD of Armies has planned , and who can stop it ? His hand is stretched out , and who can turn it back ? "

verses.z: 亞哈斯王崩的那年，就有以下的默示：
verses.e: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died .

verses.z: 非利士全地啊，不要因擊打你的杖折斷就喜樂。因為從蛇的根必生出毒蛇；牠所生的是火焰的飛龍。
verses.e: Don't rejoice , O Philistia , all of you , because the rod that struck you is broken ; for out of the serpent's root an adder will emerge , and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent .

verses.z: 當耶和華使你脫離愁苦、煩惱，並人勉強你做的苦工，得享安息的日子，
verses.e: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow , from your trouble , and from the hard service in which you were made to serve ,

verses.z: 貧寒人的長子必有所食；窮乏人必安然躺臥。我必以饑荒治死你的根；你所餘剩的人必被殺戮。
verses.e: The firstborn of the poor will eat , and the needy will lie down in safety ; and I will kill your root with famine , and your remnant will be killed .

verses.z: 門哪，應當哀號！城啊，應當呼喊！非利士全地啊，你都消化了！因為有煙從北方出來，他行伍中並無亂隊的。
verses.e: Howl , gate ! Cry , city ! You are melted away , Philistia , all of you ; for smoke comes out of the north , and there is no straggler in his ranks .

verses.z: 可怎樣回答外邦的使者呢？必說：耶和華建立了錫安；他百姓中的困苦人必投奔在其中。
verses.e: What will they answer the messengers of the nation ? That the LORD has founded Zion , and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge .

verses.z: 你必題這詩歌論巴比倫王說：欺壓人的何竟熄滅？強暴的何竟止息？
verses.e: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon , and say , " How the oppressor has ceased ! The golden city has ceased ! "

verses.z: 耶和華折斷了惡人的杖，轄制人的圭，
verses.e: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked , the scepter of the rulers ,

verses.z: 就是在忿怒中連連攻擊眾民的，在怒氣中轄制列國，行逼迫無人阻止的。
verses.e: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke , who ruled the nations in anger , with a persecution that no one restrained .

verses.z: 現在全地得安息，享平靜；人皆發聲歡呼。
verses.e: The whole earth is at rest , and is quiet . They break out in song .

verses.z: 松樹和黎巴嫩的香柏樹都因你歡樂，[說]：自從你仆倒，再無人上來砍伐我們。
verses.e: Yes , the cypress trees rejoice with you , with the cedars of Lebanon , saying , " Since you are humbled , no lumberjack has come up against us . "

verses.z: 你下到陰間，陰間就因你震動來迎接你，又因你驚動在世曾為首領的陰魂，並使那曾為列國君王的，都離位站起。
verses.e: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming . It stirs up the departed spirits for you , even all the rulers of the earth . It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations .

verses.z: 論摩押的默示：一夜之間，摩押的亞珥變為荒廢，歸於無有；一夜之間，摩押的基珥變為荒廢，歸於無有。
verses.e: The burden of Moab . For in a night , Ar of Moab is laid waste , and brought to nothing . For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste , and brought to nothing .

verses.z: 他們上巴益，又往底本，到高處去哭泣。摩押人因尼波和米底巴哀號，各人頭上光禿，鬍鬚剃淨。
verses.e: They have gone up to Bayith , and to Dibon , to the high places , to weep . Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba . Baldness is on all of their heads . Every beard is cut off .

verses.z: 他們在街市上都腰束麻布，在房頂上和寬闊處俱各哀號，眼淚汪汪。
verses.e: In their streets , they clothe themselves in sackcloth . In their streets and on their housetops , everyone wails , weeping abundantly .

verses.z: 希實本和以利亞利悲哀的聲音達到雅雜，所以摩押帶兵器的高聲喊嚷，人心戰兢。
verses.e: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh . Their voice is heard even to Jahaz . Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud . Their souls tremble within them .

verses.z: 我心為摩押悲哀；他的貴冑[逃]到瑣珥，到伊基拉‧施利施亞。他們上魯希坡，隨走隨哭；在何羅念的路上，因毀滅舉起哀聲。
verses.e: My heart cries out for Moab ! Her nobles flee to Zoar , to Eglath Shelishiyah ; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping ; for on the way to Horonaim , they raise up a cry of destruction .

verses.z: 因為寧林的水成為乾涸，青草枯乾，嫩草滅沒，青綠之物，一無所有。
verses.e: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate ; for the grass has withered away , the tender grass fails , there is no green thing .

verses.z: 因此，摩押人所得的財物和所積蓄的都要運過柳樹河。
verses.e: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten , and that which they have stored up , over the brook of the willows .

verses.z: 哀聲遍聞摩押的四境；哀號的聲音達到以基蓮；哀號的聲音達到比珥‧以琳。
verses.e: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab , its wailing to Eglaim , and its wailing to Beer Elim .

verses.z: 底們的水充滿了血；我還要加增底們的[災難]，叫獅子來追上摩押逃脫的民和那地上所餘剩的人。
verses.e: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood ; for I will bring yet more on Dimon , a lion on those of Moab who escape , and on the remnant of the land .

verses.z: 你們當將羊羔奉給那地掌權的，從西拉往曠野，送到錫安城的山。
verses.e: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness , to the mountain of the daughter of Zion .

verses.z: 從肥美的田中奪去了歡喜快樂；在葡萄園裏必無歌唱，也無歡呼的聲音。踹酒的在酒醡中不得踹出酒來；我使他歡呼的聲音止息。
verses.e: Gladness is taken away , and joy out of the fruitful field ; and in the vineyards there will be no singing , neither joyful noise . Nobody will tread out wine in the presses . I have made the shouting stop .

verses.z: 因此，我心腹為摩押哀鳴如琴；我心腸為吉珥‧哈列設也是如此。
verses.e: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab , and my inward parts for Kir Heres .

verses.z: 摩押人朝見的時候，在高處疲乏，又到他聖所祈禱，也不蒙應允。
verses.e: It will happen that when Moab presents himself , when he wearies himself on the high place , and comes to his sanctuary to pray , that he will not prevail .

verses.z: 這是耶和華從前論摩押的話。
verses.e: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past .

verses.z: 但現在耶和華說：「三年之內，照雇工的年數，摩押的榮耀與他的群眾必被藐視，餘剩的人甚少無幾。」
verses.e: But now the LORD has spoken , saying , " Within three years , as a worker bound by contract would count them , the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt , with all his great multitude ; and the remnant will be very small and feeble . "

verses.z: 摩押的居民在亞嫩渡口，必像遊飛的鳥，如拆窩的[雛]。
verses.e: For it will be that as wandering birds , as a scattered nest , so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon .

verses.z: 求你獻謀略，行公平，使你的影子在午間如黑夜，隱藏被趕散的人，不可顯露逃民。
verses.e: Give counsel ! Execute justice ! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday ! Hide the outcasts ! Don't betray the fugitive !

verses.z: 求你容我這被趕散的人和你同居。至於摩押，求你作他的隱密處，脫離滅命者的面。勒索人的歸於無有，毀滅的事止息了，欺壓人的從國中除滅了，
verses.e: Let my outcasts dwell with you ! As for Moab , be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer . For the extortionist is brought to nothing . Destruction ceases . The oppressors are consumed out of the land .

verses.z: 必有寶座因慈愛堅立；必有一位誠誠實實坐在其上，在大衛帳幕中施行審判，尋求公平，速行公義。
verses.e: A throne will be established in loving kindness . One will sit on it in truth , in the tent of David , judging , seeking justice , and swift to do righteousness .

verses.z: 我們聽說摩押人驕傲，是極其驕傲；聽說他狂妄、驕傲、忿怒；他誇大的話是虛空的。
verses.e: We have heard of the pride of Moab , that he is very proud ; even of his arrogance , his pride , and his wrath . His boastings are nothing .

verses.z: 因此，摩押人必為摩押哀號；人人都要哀號。你們摩押人要為吉珥‧哈列設的葡萄餅哀歎，極其憂傷。
verses.e: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab . Everyone will wail . You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth , utterly stricken .

verses.z: 因為希實本的田地和西比瑪的葡萄樹都衰殘了。列國的君主折斷其上美好的枝子；這枝子長到雅謝延到曠野，嫩枝向外探出，直探過鹽海。
verses.e: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah . The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches , which reached even to Jazer , which wandered into the wilderness . Its shoots were spread abroad . They passed over the sea .

verses.z: 因此，我要為西比瑪的葡萄樹哀哭，與雅謝人哀哭一樣。希實本、以利亞利啊，我要以眼淚澆灌你；因為有[交戰]吶喊的聲音臨到你夏天的果子，並你收割的莊稼。
verses.e: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah . I will water you with my tears , Heshbon , and Elealeh : for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen .

verses.z: 論大馬士革的默示：看哪，大馬士革已被廢棄，不再為城，必變作亂堆。
verses.e: The burden of Damascus . " Behold , Damascus is taken away from being a city , and it will be a ruinous heap .

verses.z: 因你忘記救你的上帝，不記念你能力的磐石；所以，你栽上佳美的樹秧子，插上異樣的栽子。
verses.e: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation , and have not remembered the rock of your strength . Therefore you plant pleasant plants , and set out foreign seedlings .

verses.z: 栽種的日子，你周圍圈上籬笆，又到早晨使你所種的開花；但在愁苦極其傷痛的日子，所收割的都飛去了。
verses.e: In the day of your planting , you hedge it in . In the morning , you make your seed blossom , but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow .

verses.z: 唉！多民鬨嚷，好像海浪匉訇；列邦奔騰，好像猛水滔滔；
verses.e: Ah , the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas ; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters !

verses.z: 列邦奔騰，好像多水滔滔；但上帝斥責他們，他們就遠遠逃避，又被追趕，如同山上的風前糠，又如暴風前的旋風土。
verses.e: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters , but he will rebuke them , and they will flee far off , and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind , and like the whirling dust before the storm .

verses.z: 到晚上有驚嚇，未到早晨他們就沒有了。這是擄掠我們之人所得的分，是搶奪我們之人的報應。
verses.e: At evening , behold , terror ! Before the morning , they are no more . This is the portion of those who plunder us , and the lot of those who rob us .

verses.z: 亞羅珥的城邑已被撇棄，必成為牧羊之處；羊在那裏躺臥，無人驚嚇。
verses.e: The cities of Aroer are forsaken . They will be for flocks , which shall lie down , and no one shall make them afraid .

verses.z: 以法蓮不再有保障；大馬士革不再有國權；亞蘭所剩下的必像以色列人的榮耀消滅一樣。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim , and the kingdom from Damascus , and the remnant of Syria . They will be as the glory of the children of Israel , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 到那日，雅各的榮耀必至枵薄；他肥胖的身體必漸瘦弱。
verses.e: " It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin , and the fatness of his flesh will become lean .

verses.z: 就必像收割的人收斂禾稼，用手割取穗子，又像人在利乏音谷拾取遺落的穗子。
verses.e: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat , and his arm reaps the grain . Yes , it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim .

verses.z: 其間所剩下的不多，好像人打橄欖樹－在儘上的枝梢上只剩兩三個果子；在多果樹的旁枝上只剩四五個果子。這是耶和華－以色列的上帝說的。
verses.e: Yet gleanings will be left there , like the shaking of an olive tree , two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough , four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree , " says the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 當那日，人必仰望造他們的主，眼目重看以色列的聖者。
verses.e: In that day , people will look to their Maker , and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 他們必不仰望祭壇，就是自己手所築的，也不重看自己指頭所做的，無論是木偶是日像。
verses.e: They will not look to the altars , the work of their hands ; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made , either the Asherah poles or the incense altars .

verses.z: 在那日，他們的堅固城必像樹林中和山頂上所撇棄的地方，就是從前在以色列人面前被人撇棄的。這樣，地就荒涼了。
verses.e: In that day , their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top , which were forsaken from before the children of Israel ; and it will be a desolation .

verses.z: 唉！古實河外翅膀刷刷響聲之地，
verses.e: Ah , the land of the rustling of wings , which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia ;

verses.z: 差遣使者在水面上，坐蒲草船過海。[先知說]：你們快行的使者，要到高大光滑的民那裏去。自從開國以來，那民極其可畏，是分[地界]踐踏[人]的；他們的地有江河分開。
verses.e: that sends ambassadors by the sea , even in vessels of papyrus on the waters , saying , " Go , you swift messengers , to a nation tall and smooth , to a people awesome from their beginning onward , a nation that measures out and treads down , whose land the rivers divide ! "

verses.z: 世上一切的居民和地上所住的人哪，山上豎立大旗的時候你們要看；吹角的時候你們要聽。
verses.e: All you inhabitants of the world , and you dwellers on the earth , when a banner is lifted up on the mountains , look ! When the trumpet is blown , listen !

verses.z: 耶和華對我這樣說：我要安靜，在我的居所觀看，如同日光中的清熱，又如露水的雲霧在收割的熱天。
verses.e: For the LORD said to me , " I will be still , and I will see in my dwelling place , like clear heat in sunshine , like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest . "

verses.z: 收割之先，花開已謝，花也成了將熟的葡萄；他必用鐮刀削去嫩枝，又砍掉蔓延的枝條，
verses.e: For before the harvest , when the blossom is over , and the flower becomes a ripening grape , he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks , and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches .

verses.z: 都要撇給山間的鷙鳥和地上的野獸。夏天，鷙鳥要宿在其上；冬天，野獸都臥在其中。
verses.e: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains , and for the animals of the earth . The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer , and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter .

verses.z: 到那時，這高大光滑的民，就是從開國以來極其可畏、分[地界]踐踏[人]的，他們的地有江河分開；他們必將禮物奉給萬軍之耶和華，就是奉到錫安山－耶和華安置他名的地方。
verses.e: In that time , a present will be brought to the LORD of Armies from a people tall and smooth , even from a people awesome from their beginning onward , a nation that measures out and treads down , whose land the rivers divide , to the place of the name of the LORD of Armies , Mount Zion .

verses.z: 論埃及的默示：看哪，耶和華乘駕快雲，臨到埃及。埃及的偶像在他面前戰兢；埃及人的心在裏面消化。
verses.e: The burden of Egypt . " Behold , the LORD rides on a swift cloud , and comes to Egypt . The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence ; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it .

verses.z: 國柱必被打碎，所有傭工的，心必愁煩。
verses.e: The pillars will be broken in pieces . All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul .

verses.z: 瑣安的首領極其愚昧；法老大有智慧的謀士，所籌劃的成為愚謀。你們怎敢對法老說：我是智慧人的子孫，我是古王的後裔？
verses.e: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish . The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid . How do you say to Pharaoh , " I am the son of the wise , the son of ancient kings " ?

verses.z: 你的智慧人在哪裏呢？萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意，他們可以知道，可以告訴你吧！
verses.e: Where then are your wise men ? Let them tell you now ; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt .

verses.z: 瑣安的首領都變為愚昧；挪弗的首領都受了迷惑。當埃及支派房角石的，使埃及人走錯了路。
verses.e: The princes of Zoan have become fools . The princes of Memphis are deceived . They have caused Egypt to go astray , those who are the cornerstone of her tribes .

verses.z: 耶和華使乖謬的靈攙入埃及中間；首領使埃及一切所做的都有差錯，好像醉酒之人嘔吐的時候東倒西歪一樣。
verses.e: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her ; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works , like a drunken man staggers in his vomit .

verses.z: 埃及中，無論是頭與尾，棕枝與蘆葦，所做之工都不成就。
verses.e: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt , which head or tail , palm branch or rush , may do .

verses.z: 到那日，埃及人必像婦人一樣，他們必因萬軍之耶和華在埃及以上所掄的手，戰兢懼怕。
verses.e: In that day the Egyptians will be like women . They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies's hand , which he shakes over them .

verses.z: 猶大地必使埃及驚恐，向誰提起猶大地，誰就懼怕。這是因萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意。
verses.e: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt . Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid , because of the plans of the LORD of Armies , which he determines against it .

verses.z: 當那日，埃及地必有五城的人說迦南的方言，又指着萬軍之耶和華起誓。有一城必稱為「滅亡城」。
verses.e: In that day , there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan , and swear to the LORD of Armies . One will be called " The city of destruction . "

verses.z: 當那日，在埃及地中必有為耶和華築的一座壇；在埃及的邊界上必有為耶和華[立]的一根柱。
verses.e: In that day , there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt , and a pillar to the LORD at its border .

verses.z: 我必激動埃及人攻擊埃及人－弟兄攻擊弟兄，鄰舍攻擊鄰舍；這城攻擊那城，這國攻擊那國。
verses.e: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians , and they will fight everyone against his brother , and everyone against his neighbor ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .

verses.z: 這都要在埃及地為萬軍之耶和華作記號和證據。埃及人因為受人的欺壓哀求耶和華，他就差遣一位救主作護衛者，拯救他們。
verses.e: It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt ; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors , and he will send them a savior and a defender , and he will deliver them .

verses.z: 耶和華必被埃及人所認識。在那日，埃及人必認識耶和華，也要獻祭物和供物敬拜他，並向耶和華許願還願。
verses.e: The LORD will be known to Egypt , and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day . Yes , they will worship with sacrifice and offering , and will vow a vow to the LORD , and will perform it .

verses.z: 耶和華必擊打埃及，又擊打又醫治，埃及人就歸向耶和華。他必應允他們的禱告，醫治他們。
verses.e: The LORD will strike Egypt , striking and healing . They will return to the LORD , and he will be entreated by them , and will heal them .

verses.z: 當那日，必有從埃及通亞述去的大道。亞述人要進入埃及，埃及人也進入亞述；埃及人要與亞述人一同敬拜[耶和華]。
verses.e: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria , and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt , and the Egyptian into Assyria ; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians .

verses.z: 當那日，以色列必與埃及、亞述三國一律，使地上的人得福；
verses.e: In that day , Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria , a blessing within the earth ;

verses.z: 因為萬軍之耶和華賜福給他們，說：「埃及－我的百姓，亞述－我手的工作，以色列－我的產業，都有福了！」
verses.e: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them , saying , " Blessed be Egypt my people , Assyria the work of my hands , and Israel my inheritance . "

verses.z: 埃及人的心神必在裏面耗盡；我必敗壞他們的謀略。他們必求問偶像和念咒的、交鬼的、行巫術的。
verses.e: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them . I will destroy their counsel . They will seek the idols , the charmers , those who have familiar spirits , and the wizards .

verses.z: 我必將埃及人交在殘忍主的手中；強暴王必轄制他們。這是主－萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord . A fierce king will rule over them , " says the Lord , GOD of Armies .

verses.z: 海中的水必絕盡，河也消沒乾涸。
verses.e: The waters will fail from the sea , and the river will be wasted and become dry .

verses.z: 江河要變臭；埃及的河水都必減少枯乾。葦子和蘆荻都必衰殘；
verses.e: The rivers will become foul . The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up . The reeds and flags will wither away .

verses.z: 靠尼羅河旁的草田，並沿尼羅河所種的田，都必枯乾。[莊稼]被[風]吹去，歸於無有。
verses.e: The meadows by the Nile , by the brink of the Nile , and all the sown fields of the Nile , will become dry , be driven away , and be no more .

verses.z: 打魚的必哀哭。在尼羅河一切釣魚的必悲傷；在水上撒網的必都衰弱。
verses.e: The fishermen will lament , and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn , and those who spread nets on the waters will languish .

verses.z: 用梳好的麻造物的和織白布的都必羞愧；
verses.e: Moreover those who work in combed flax , and those who weave white cloth , will be confounded .

verses.z: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論到猶大和耶路撒冷。
verses.e: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem .

verses.z: 你當進入巖穴，藏在土中，躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
verses.e: Enter into the rock , and hide in the dust , from before the terror of the LORD , and from the glory of his majesty .

verses.z: 到那日，眼目高傲的必降為卑；性情狂傲的都必屈膝；惟獨耶和華被尊崇。
verses.e: The lofty looks of man will be brought low , the arrogance of men will be bowed down , and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day .

verses.z: 必有萬軍耶和華[降罰]的一個日子，要臨到驕傲狂妄的；一切自高的都必降為卑；
verses.e: For there will be a day of the LORD of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant , and for all that is lifted up , and it shall be brought low —

verses.z: 又臨到黎巴嫩高大的香柏樹和巴珊的橡樹；
verses.e: for all the cedars of Lebanon , that are high and lifted up , for all the oaks of Bashan ,

verses.z: 又臨到一切高山的峻嶺；
verses.e: for all the high mountains , for all the hills that are lifted up ,

verses.z: 又臨到高臺和堅固城牆；
verses.e: for every lofty tower , for every fortified wall ,

verses.z: 又臨到他施的船隻並一切可愛的美物。
verses.e: for all the ships of Tarshish , and for all pleasant imagery .

verses.z: 驕傲的必屈膝；狂妄的必降卑。在那日，惟獨耶和華被尊崇；
verses.e: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down , and the arrogance of men shall be brought low ; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day .

verses.z: 偶像必全然廢棄。
verses.e: The idols shall utterly pass away .

verses.z: 耶和華興起，使地大震動的時候，人就進入石洞，進入土穴，躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
verses.e: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks , and into the holes of the earth , from before the terror of the LORD , and from the glory of his majesty , when he arises to shake the earth mightily .

verses.z: 末後的日子，耶和華殿的山必堅立，超乎諸山，高舉過於萬嶺；萬民都要流歸這山。
