verses.e: It shall happen in the latter days , that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established on the top of the mountains , and shall be raised above the hills ; and all nations shall flow to it .

verses.z: 到那日，人必將為拜而造的金偶像、銀偶像拋給田鼠和蝙蝠。
verses.e: In that day , men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold , which have been made for themselves to worship , to the moles and to the bats ,

verses.z: 到耶和華興起，使地大震動的時候，人好進入磐石洞中和巖石穴裏，躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
verses.e: to go into the caverns of the rocks , and into the clefts of the ragged rocks , from before the terror of the LORD , and from the glory of his majesty , when he arises to shake the earth mightily .

verses.z: 你們休要[倚靠]世人。他鼻孔裏不過有氣息；他在一切事上可算甚麼呢？
verses.e: Stop trusting in man , whose breath is in his nostrils ; for of what account is he ?

verses.z: 必有許多國的民前往，說：來吧，我們登耶和華的山，奔雅各上帝的殿。主必將他的道教訓我們；我們也要行他的路。因為訓誨必出於錫安；耶和華的言語必出於耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Many peoples shall go and say , " Come , let's go up to the mountain of the LORD , to the house of the God of Jacob ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths . " For the law shall go out of Zion , and the LORD's word from Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他必在列國中施行審判，為許多國民斷定是非。他們要將刀打成犂頭，把槍打成鐮刀。這國不舉刀攻擊那國；他們也不再學習戰事。
verses.e: He will judge between the nations , and will decide concerning many peoples . They shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruning hooks . Nation shall not lift up sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .

verses.z: 雅各家啊，來吧！我們在耶和華的光明中行走。
verses.e: House of Jacob , come , and let's walk in the light of the LORD .

verses.z: [耶和華]，你離棄了你百姓雅各家，是因他們充滿了東方的[風俗]，作觀兆的，像非利士人一樣，並與外邦人擊掌。
verses.e: For you have forsaken your people , the house of Jacob , because they are filled from the east , with those who practice divination like the Philistines , and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners .

verses.z: 他們的國滿了金銀，財寶也無窮；他們的地滿了馬匹，車輛也無數。
verses.e: Their land is full of silver and gold , neither is there any end of their treasures . Their land also is full of horses , neither is there any end of their chariots .

verses.z: 他們的地滿了偶像；他們跪拜自己手所造的，就是自己指頭所做的。
verses.e: Their land also is full of idols . They worship the work of their own hands , that which their own fingers have made .

verses.z: 卑賤人屈膝；尊貴人下跪；所以不可饒恕他們。
verses.e: Man is brought low , and mankind is humbled ; therefore don't forgive them .

verses.z: 亞述王撒珥根打發他珥探到亞實突的那年，他珥探就攻打亞實突，將城攻取。
verses.e: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod , when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him , and he fought against Ashdod and took it ;

verses.z: 那時，耶和華曉諭亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞說：「你去解掉你腰間的麻布，脫下你腳上的鞋。」以賽亞就這樣做，露身赤腳行走。
verses.e: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz , saying , " Go , and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist , and take your sandals from off your feet . " He did so , walking naked and barefoot .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我僕人以賽亞怎樣露身赤腳行走三年，作為關乎埃及和古實的預兆奇蹟。
verses.e: The LORD said , " As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia ,

verses.z: 照樣，亞述王也必擄去埃及人，掠去古實人，無論老少，都露身赤腳，現出下體，使埃及蒙羞。
verses.e: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia , young and old , naked and barefoot , and with buttocks uncovered , to the shame of Egypt .

verses.z: 以色列人必因所仰望的古實，所誇耀的埃及，驚惶羞愧。
verses.e: They will be dismayed and confounded , because of Ethiopia their expectation , and of Egypt their glory .

verses.z: 「那時，這沿海一帶的居民必說：『看哪，我們素所仰望的，就是我們為脫離亞述王逃往求救的，不過是如此！我們怎能逃脫呢？』」
verses.e: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day , ' Behold , this is our expectation , where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria . And we , how will we escape ? ' "

verses.z: 論海旁曠野的默示：有[仇敵]從曠野，從可怕之地而來，好像南方的旋風，猛然掃過。
verses.e: The burden of the wilderness of the sea . As whirlwinds in the South sweep through , it comes from the wilderness , from an awesome land .

verses.z: 我被打的禾稼，我場上的穀啊，我從萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝那裏所聽見的，都告訴你們了。
verses.e: You are my threshing , and the grain of my floor ! " That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies , the God of Israel , I have declared to you .

verses.z: 論度瑪的默示：有人聲從西珥呼問我[說]：守望的啊，夜裏如何？守望的啊，夜裏如何？
verses.e: The burden of Dumah . One calls to me out of Seir , " Watchman , what of the night ? Watchman , what of the night ? "

verses.z: 守望的說：早晨將到，黑夜也來。你們若要問就可以問，可以回頭再來。
verses.e: The watchman said , " The morning comes , and also the night . If you will inquire , inquire . Come back again . "

verses.z: 論阿拉伯的默示：底但結伴的客旅啊，你們必在阿拉伯的樹林中住宿。
verses.e: The burden on Arabia . You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia , you caravans of Dedanites .

verses.z: 提瑪地的居民拿水來，送給口渴的，拿餅來迎接逃避的。
verses.e: They brought water to him who was thirsty . The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread .

verses.z: 因為他們逃避刀劍和出了鞘的刀，並上了弦的弓與刀兵的重災。
verses.e: For they fled away from the swords , from the drawn sword , from the bent bow , and from the heat of battle .

verses.z: 主對我這樣說：「一年之內，照雇工的年數，基達的一切榮耀必歸於無有。
verses.e: For the Lord said to me , " Within a year , as a worker bound by contract would count it , all the glory of Kedar will fail ,

verses.z: 弓箭手所餘剩的，就是基達人的勇士，必然稀少，因為這是耶和華－以色列的上帝說的。」
verses.e: and the residue of the number of the archers , the mighty men of the children of Kedar , will be few ; for the LORD , the God of Israel , has spoken it . "

verses.z: 令人悽慘的異象已默示於我。詭詐的行詭詐，毀滅的行毀滅。以攔哪，你要上去！米底亞啊，你要圍困！[主說]：我使一切歎息止住。
verses.e: A grievous vision is declared to me . The treacherous man deals treacherously , and the destroyer destroys . Go up , Elam ; attack ! I have stopped all of Media's sighing .

verses.z: 所以，我滿腰疼痛；痛苦將我抓住，好像產難的婦人一樣。我疼痛甚至不能聽；我驚惶甚至不能看。
verses.e: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish . Pains have seized me , like the pains of a woman in labor . I am in so much pain that I can't hear . I am so dismayed that I can't see .

verses.z: 我心慌張，驚恐威嚇我。我所羨慕的黃昏，變為我的戰兢。
verses.e: My heart flutters . Horror has frightened me . The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me .

verses.z: 他們擺設筵席，派人守望，又吃又喝。首領啊，你們起來，用油抹盾牌。
verses.e: They prepare the table . They set the watch . They eat . They drink . Rise up , you princes , oil the shield !

verses.z: 主對我如此說：你去設立守望的，使他將所看見的述說。
verses.e: For the Lord said to me , " Go , set a watchman . Let him declare what he sees .

verses.z: 他看見軍隊，就是騎馬的一對一對地來，又看見驢隊，駱駝隊，就要側耳細聽。
verses.e: When he sees a troop , horsemen in pairs , a troop of donkeys , a troop of camels , he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness . "

verses.z: 他像獅子吼叫，[說]：主啊，我白日常站在望樓上，整夜立在我守望所。
verses.e: He cried like a lion : " Lord , I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime , and every night I stay at my post .

verses.z: 看哪，有一隊軍兵騎着馬，一對一對地來。他就說：巴比倫傾倒了！傾倒了！他一切雕刻的神像都打碎於地。
verses.e: Behold , here comes a troop of men , horsemen in pairs . " He answered , " Fallen , fallen is Babylon ; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground .

verses.z: 論異象谷的默示：有甚麼事使你這[滿城的人]都上房頂呢？
verses.e: The burden of the valley of vision . What ails you now , that you have all gone up to the housetops ?

verses.z: 又數點耶路撒冷的房屋，將房屋拆毀，修補城牆，
verses.e: You counted the houses of Jerusalem , and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall .

verses.z: 又在兩道城牆中間挖一個聚水池可盛舊池的水，卻不仰望做這事的主，也不顧念從古定這事的。
verses.e: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool . But you didn't look to him who had done this , neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago .

verses.z: 當那日，主－萬軍之耶和華叫人哭泣哀號，頭上光禿，身披麻布。
verses.e: In that day , the Lord , GOD of Armies , called to weeping , to mourning , to baldness , and to dressing in sackcloth ;

verses.z: 誰知，人倒歡喜快樂，宰牛殺羊，吃肉喝酒，[說]：我們吃喝吧！因為明天要死了。
verses.e: and behold , there is joy and gladness , killing cattle and killing sheep , eating meat and drinking wine : " Let's eat and drink , for tomorrow we will die . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華親自默示我[說]：這罪孽直到你們死，斷不得赦免！這是主－萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies revealed himself in my ears , " Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die , " says the Lord , GOD of Armies .

verses.z: 主－萬軍之耶和華這樣說：「你去見掌銀庫的，就是家宰舍伯那，[對他說]：
verses.e: The Lord , GOD of Armies says , " Go , get yourself to this treasurer , even to Shebna , who is over the house , and say ,

verses.z: 『你在這裏做甚麼呢？有甚麼人竟在這裏鑿墳墓，就是在高處為自己鑿墳墓，在磐石中為自己鑿出安身之所？
verses.e: ' What are you doing here ? Who has you here , that you have dug out a tomb here ? ' Cutting himself out a tomb on high , chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock ! "

verses.z: 看哪，耶和華必像[大有力的]人，將你緊緊纏裹，竭力拋去。
verses.e: Behold , the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently . Yes , he will grasp you firmly .

verses.z: 他必將你滾成一團，[拋]在寬闊之地，好像拋球一樣。你這主人家的羞辱，必在那裏坐你榮耀的車，也必在那裏死亡。
verses.e: He will surely wind you around and around , and throw you like a ball into a large country . There you will die , and there the chariots of your glory will be , you disgrace of your lord's house .

verses.z: 我必趕逐你離開官職；你必從你的原位撤下。』
verses.e: I will thrust you from your office . You will be pulled down from your station .

verses.z: 你這滿處吶喊、大有喧嘩的城，歡樂的邑啊，你中間被殺的並不是被刀殺，也不是因打仗死亡。
verses.e: You that are full of shouting , a tumultuous city , a joyous town , your slain are not slain with the sword , neither are they dead in battle .

verses.z: 「到那日，我必召我僕人希勒家的兒子以利亞敬來，
verses.e: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah ,

verses.z: 將你的外袍給他穿上，將你的腰帶給他繫緊，將你的政權交在他手中。他必作耶路撒冷居民和猶大家的父。
verses.e: and I will clothe him with your robe , and strengthen him with your belt . I will commit your government into his hand ; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and to the house of Judah .

verses.z: 我必將大衛家的鑰匙放在他肩頭上。他開，無人能關；他關，無人能開。
verses.e: I will lay the key of David's house on his shoulder . He will open , and no one will shut . He will shut , and no one will open .

verses.z: 我必將他[安穩]，像釘子釘在堅固處；他必作為他父家榮耀的寶座。
verses.e: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place . He will be for a throne of glory to his father's house .

verses.z: 他父家所有的榮耀，連兒女帶子孫，都掛在他身上，好像一切小器皿，從杯子到酒瓶掛上一樣。
verses.e: They will hang on him all the glory of his father's house , the offspring and the issue , every small vessel , from the cups even to all the pitchers .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：當那日，釘在堅固處的釘子必壓斜，被砍斷落地；掛在其上的重擔必被剪斷。因為這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: " In that day , " says the LORD of Armies , " the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way . It will be cut down and fall . The burden that was on it will be cut off , for the LORD has spoken it . "

verses.z: 你所有的官長一同逃跑，都為弓箭手所捆綁。你中間一切被找到的都一同被捆綁；他們本是逃往遠方的。
verses.e: All your rulers fled away together . They were bound by the archers . All who were found by you were bound together . They fled far away .

verses.z: 所以我說：你們轉眼不看我，我要痛哭。不要因我眾民的毀滅，就竭力安慰我。
verses.e: Therefore I said , " Look away from me . I will weep bitterly . Don't labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people .

verses.z: 因為主－萬軍之耶和華使「異象谷」有潰亂、踐踏、煩擾的日子。城被攻破，哀聲達到山間。
verses.e: For it is a day of confusion , and of treading down , and of perplexity from the Lord , GOD of Armies , in the valley of vision , a breaking down of the walls , and a crying to the mountains . "

verses.z: 以攔帶着箭袋，還有坐戰車的和馬兵；吉珥揭開盾牌。
verses.e: Elam carried his quiver , with chariots of men and horsemen ; and Kir uncovered the shield .

verses.z: 你嘉美的谷遍滿戰車，也有馬兵在城門前排列。
verses.e: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots , and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate .

verses.z: 他去掉猶大的遮蓋。那日，你就仰望林庫內的軍器。
verses.e: He took away the covering of Judah ; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest .

verses.z: 你們看見大衛城的破口很多，便聚積下池的水，
verses.e: You saw the breaches of David's city , that they were many ; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool .

verses.z: 論泰爾的默示：他施的船隻都要哀號；因為泰爾變為荒場，甚至沒有房屋，沒有可進之路。這消息是從基提地得來的。
verses.e: The burden of Tyre . Howl , you ships of Tarshish ! For it is laid waste , so that there is no house , no entering in . From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them .

verses.z: 他施的民哪，可以流行你的地，好像尼羅河；不再有腰帶拘緊你。
verses.e: Pass through your land like the Nile , daughter of Tarshish . There is no restraint any more .

verses.z: 耶和華已經向海伸手，震動列國。至於迦南，他已經吩咐拆毀其中的保障。
verses.e: He has stretched out his hand over the sea . He has shaken the kingdoms . The LORD has ordered the destruction of Canaan's strongholds .

verses.z: 他又說：受欺壓西頓的居民哪，你必不得再歡樂。起來！過到基提去；就是在那裏也不得安歇。（
verses.e: He said , " You shall rejoice no more , you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon . Arise , pass over to Kittim . Even there you will have no rest . "

verses.z: 看哪，迦勒底人之地向來沒有這民，這國是亞述人為住曠野的人所立的。現在他們建築戍樓，拆毀泰爾的宮殿，使她成為荒涼。）
verses.e: Behold , the land of the Chaldeans . This people didn't exist . The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness . They set up their towers . They overthrew its palaces . They made it a ruin .

verses.z: 他施的船隻都要哀號，因為你們的保障變為荒場。
verses.e: Howl , you ships of Tarshish , for your stronghold is laid waste !

verses.z: 到那時，泰爾必被忘記七十年，照着一王的年日。七十年後，泰爾的景況必像妓女所唱的歌：
verses.e: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years , according to the days of one king . After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute .

verses.z: 你這被忘記的妓女啊，拿琴周流城內，巧彈多唱，使人再想念你。
verses.e: Take a harp ; go about the city , you prostitute that has been forgotten . Make sweet melody . Sing many songs , that you may be remembered .

verses.z: 七十年後，耶和華必眷顧泰爾，她就仍得利息，與地上的萬國交易。
verses.e: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre . She will return to her wages , and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth .

verses.z: 她的貨財和利息要歸耶和華為聖，必不積攢存留；因為她的貨財必為住在耶和華面前的人所得，使他們吃飽，穿耐久的衣服。
verses.e: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD . It will not be treasured nor laid up ; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD , to eat sufficiently , and for durable clothing .

verses.z: 沿海的居民，就是素來靠航海西頓的商家得豐盛的，你們當靜默無言。
verses.e: Be still , you inhabitants of the coast , you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished .

verses.z: 在大水之上，西曷的糧食、尼羅河的莊稼是泰爾的進項；她作列國的大碼頭。
verses.e: On great waters , the seed of the Shihor , the harvest of the Nile , was her revenue . She was the market of nations .

verses.z: 西頓哪，你當慚愧；因為大海說，就是海中的保障說：我沒有劬勞，也沒有生產，沒有養育男子，也沒有撫養童女。
verses.e: Be ashamed , Sidon ; for the sea has spoken , the stronghold of the sea , saying , " I have not travailed , nor given birth , neither have I nourished young men , nor brought up virgins . "

verses.z: 這風聲傳到埃及；埃及人為泰爾的風聲極其疼痛。
verses.e: When the report comes to Egypt , they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre .

verses.z: 泰爾人哪，你們當過到他施去；沿海的居民哪，你們都當哀號。
verses.e: Pass over to Tarshish ! Wail , you inhabitants of the coast !

verses.z: 這是你們歡樂的城，從上古而有的嗎？其中的居民往遠方寄居。
verses.e: Is this your joyous city , whose antiquity is of ancient days , whose feet carried her far away to travel ?

verses.z: 泰爾本是賜冠冕的。她的商家是王子；她的買賣人是世上的尊貴人。遭遇如此是誰定的呢？
verses.e: Who has planned this against Tyre , the giver of crowns , whose merchants are princes , whose traders are the honorable of the earth ?

verses.z: 是萬軍之耶和華所定的！為要污辱一切高傲的榮耀，使地上一切的尊貴人被藐視。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies has planned it , to stain the pride of all glory , to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth .

verses.z: 看哪，耶和華使地空虛，變為荒涼；又翻轉大地，將居民分散。
verses.e: Behold , the LORD makes the earth empty , makes it waste , turns it upside down , and scatters its inhabitants .

verses.z: 荒涼的城拆毀了；各家關門閉戶，使人都不得進去。
verses.e: The confused city is broken down . Every house is shut up , that no man may come in .

verses.z: 在街上因酒有悲歎的聲音；一切喜樂變為昏暗；地上的歡樂歸於無有。
verses.e: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine . All joy is darkened . The mirth of the land is gone .

verses.z: 城中只有荒涼；城門拆毀淨盡。
verses.e: The city is left in desolation , and the gate is struck with destruction .

verses.z: 在地上的萬民中，必像打過的橄欖樹，又像已摘的葡萄所剩無幾。
verses.e: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples , as the shaking of an olive tree , as the gleanings when the vintage is done .

verses.z: 這些人要高聲歡呼；他們為耶和華的威嚴，從海那裏揚起聲來。
verses.e: These shall lift up their voice . They will shout for the majesty of the LORD . They cry aloud from the sea .

verses.z: 因此，你們要在東方榮耀耶和華，在眾海島榮耀耶和華－以色列上帝的名。
verses.e: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east , even the name of the LORD , the God of Israel , in the islands of the sea !

verses.z: 我們聽見從地極有人歌唱，[說]：榮耀歸於義人。我卻說：我消滅了！我消滅了，我有禍了！詭詐的行詭詐；詭詐的大行詭詐。
verses.e: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs . Glory to the righteous ! But I said , " I pine away ! I pine away ! woe is me ! " The treacherous have dealt treacherously . Yes , the treacherous have dealt very treacherously .

verses.z: 地上的居民哪，恐懼、陷坑、網羅都臨近你。
verses.e: Fear , the pit , and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth .

verses.z: 躲避恐懼聲音的必墜入陷坑；從陷坑上來的必被網羅纏住；因為[天]上的窗戶都開了，地的根基也震動了。
verses.e: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit ; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare ; for the windows on high are opened , and the foundations of the earth tremble .

verses.z: 地全然破壞，盡都崩裂，大大地震動了。
verses.e: The earth is utterly broken . The earth is torn apart . The earth is shaken violently .

verses.z: 那時百姓怎樣，祭司也怎樣；僕人怎樣，主人也怎樣；婢女怎樣，主母也怎樣；買物的怎樣，賣物的也怎樣；放債的怎樣，借債的也怎樣；取利的怎樣，出利的也怎樣。
verses.e: It will be as with the people , so with the priest ; as with the servant , so with his master ; as with the maid , so with her mistress ; as with the buyer , so with the seller ; as with the creditor , so with the debtor ; as with the taker of interest , so with the giver of interest .

verses.z: 地要東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；又搖來搖去，好像吊床。罪過在其上沉重，必然塌陷，不能復起。
verses.e: The earth will stagger like a drunken man , and will sway back and forth like a hammock . Its disobedience will be heavy on it , and it will fall and not rise again .

verses.z: 到那日，耶和華在高處必懲罰高處的眾軍，在地上必懲罰地上的列王。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high , and the kings of the earth on the earth .

verses.z: 他們必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢獄中，並要囚在監牢裏，多日之後便被討罪。
verses.e: They will be gathered together , as prisoners are gathered in the pit , and will be shut up in the prison ; and after many days they will be visited .

verses.z: 那時，月亮要蒙羞，日頭要慚愧；因為萬軍之耶和華必在錫安山，在耶路撒冷作王；在[敬畏]他的長老面前，必有榮耀。
verses.e: Then the moon will be confounded , and the sun ashamed ; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem ; and glory will be before his elders .

verses.z: 地必全然空虛，盡都荒涼；因為這話是耶和華說的。
verses.e: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste ; for the LORD has spoken this word .

verses.z: 地上悲哀衰殘，世界敗落衰殘；地上居高位的人也敗落了。
verses.e: The earth mourns and fades away . The world languishes and fades away . The lofty people of the earth languish .

verses.z: 地被其上的居民污穢；因為他們犯了律法，廢了律例，背了永約。
verses.e: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants , because they have transgressed the laws , violated the statutes , and broken the everlasting covenant .

verses.z: 所以，地被咒詛吞滅；住在其上的顯為有罪。地上的居民被火焚燒，剩下的人稀少。
verses.e: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth , and those who dwell therein are found guilty . Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men are left .

verses.z: 新酒悲哀，葡萄樹衰殘；心中歡樂的俱都歎息。
verses.e: The new wine mourns . The vine languishes . All the merry-hearted sigh .

verses.z: 擊鼓之樂止息；宴樂人的聲音完畢，彈琴之樂也止息了。
verses.e: The mirth of tambourines ceases . The sound of those who rejoice ends . The joy of the harp ceases .

verses.z: 人必不得飲酒唱歌；喝濃酒的，必以為苦。
verses.e: They will not drink wine with a song . Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是我的上帝；我要尊崇你，我要稱讚你的名。因為你以忠信誠實行過奇妙的事，成就你古時所定的。
verses.e: The LORD , you are my God . I will exalt you ! I will praise your name , for you have done wonderful things , things planned long ago , in complete faithfulness and truth .

verses.z: 耶和華的手必按在這山上；摩押人在所居之地必被踐踏，好像乾草被踐踏在糞池的水中。
verses.e: For the LORD's hand will rest in this mountain . Moab will be trodden down in his place , even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill .

verses.z: 他必在其中伸開手，好像洑水的伸開手洑水一樣；但[耶和華]必使他的驕傲和他手所行的詭計一併敗落。
verses.e: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it , like one who swims spreads out hands to swim , but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands .

verses.z: 耶和華使你城上的堅固高臺傾倒，拆平，直到塵埃。
verses.e: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down , laid low , and brought to the ground , even to the dust .

verses.z: 你使城變為亂堆，使堅固城變為荒場，使外邦人宮殿的城不再為城，永遠不再建造。
verses.e: For you have made a city into a heap , a fortified city into a ruin , a palace of strangers to be no city . It will never be built .

verses.z: 所以，剛強的民必榮耀你；強暴之國的城必敬畏你。
verses.e: Therefore a strong people will glorify you . A city of awesome nations will fear you .

verses.z: 因為當強暴人催逼人的時候，如同暴風直吹牆壁，你就作貧窮人的保障，作困乏人急難中的保障，作躲暴風之處，作避炎熱的陰涼。
verses.e: For you have been a stronghold to the poor , a stronghold to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shade from the heat , when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall .

verses.z: 你要壓制外邦人的喧嘩，好像乾燥地的熱氣下落；禁止強暴人的凱歌，好像熱氣被雲影消化。
verses.e: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers ; as the heat by the shade of a cloud , the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low .

verses.z: 在這山上，萬軍之耶和華必為萬民用肥甘設擺筵席，用陳酒和滿髓的肥甘，並澄清的陳酒，設擺筵席。
verses.e: In this mountain , the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat , a feast of choice wines , of choice meat full of marrow , of well refined choice wines .

verses.z: 他又必在這山上除滅遮蓋萬民之物和遮蔽萬國蒙臉的帕子。
verses.e: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples , and the veil that is spread over all nations .

verses.z: 他已經吞滅死亡直到永遠。主耶和華必擦去各人臉上的眼淚，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱，因為這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: He has swallowed up death forever ! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces . He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth , for the LORD has spoken it .

verses.z: 到那日，人必說：「看哪，這是我們的上帝；我們素來等候他，他必拯救我們。這是耶和華，我們素來等候他，我們必因他的救恩歡喜快樂。」
verses.e: It shall be said in that day , " Behold , this is our God ! We have waited for him , and he will save us ! This is the LORD ! We have waited for him . We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation ! "

verses.z: 當那日，在猶大地人必唱這歌[說]：我們有堅固的城。耶和華要將救恩定為城牆，為外郭。
verses.e: In that day , this song will be sung in the land of Judah : " We have a strong city . God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks .

verses.z: 以恩惠待惡人，他仍不學習公義；在正直的地上，他必行事不義，也不注意耶和華的威嚴。
verses.e: Let favor be shown to the wicked , yet he will not learn righteousness . In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully , and will not see the LORD's majesty .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的手高舉，他們仍然不看；卻要看你為百姓發的熱心，因而抱愧，並且有火燒滅你的敵人。
verses.e: LORD , your hand is lifted up , yet they don't see ; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed . Yes , fire will consume your adversaries .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你必派定我們得平安，因為我們所做的事都是你給我們成就的。
verses.e: LORD , you will ordain peace for us , for you have also done all our work for us .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，在你以外曾有別的主管轄我們，但我們專要倚靠你，提你的名。
verses.e: LORD our God , other lords besides you have had dominion over us , but we will only acknowledge your name .

verses.z: 他們死了，必不能再活；他們去世，必不能再起；因為你刑罰他們，毀滅他們，他們的名號就全然消滅。
verses.e: The dead shall not live . The departed spirits shall not rise . Therefore you have visited and destroyed them , and caused all memory of them to perish .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你增添國民，你增添國民；你得了榮耀，又擴張地的四境。
verses.e: You have increased the nation , O LORD . You have increased the nation ! You are glorified ! You have enlarged all the borders of the land .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，他們在急難中尋求你；你的懲罰臨到他們身上，他們就傾心吐膽禱告你。
verses.e: LORD , in trouble they have visited you . They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them .

verses.z: 婦人懷孕，臨產疼痛，在痛苦之中喊叫；耶和華啊，我們在你面前也是如此。
verses.e: Just as a woman with child , who draws near the time of her delivery , is in pain and cries out in her pangs , so we have been before you , LORD .

verses.z: 我們也曾懷孕疼痛，所產的竟像風一樣。我們在地上未曾行甚麼拯救的事；世上的居民也未曾敗落。
verses.e: We have been with child . We have been in pain . We gave birth , it seems , only to wind . We have not worked any deliverance in the earth ; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen .

verses.z: 死人要復活，屍首要興起。睡在塵埃的啊，要醒起歌唱！因你的甘露[好像]菜蔬上的甘露，地也要交出死人來。
verses.e: Your dead shall live . Their dead bodies shall arise . Awake and sing , you who dwell in the dust ; for your dew is like the dew of herbs , and the earth will cast out the departed spirits .

verses.z: 敞開城門，使守信的義民得以進入。
verses.e: Open the gates , that the righteous nation may enter : the one which keeps faith .

verses.z: 我的百姓啊，你們要來進入內室，關上門，隱藏片時，等到忿怒過去。
verses.e: Come , my people , enter into your rooms , and shut your doors behind you . Hide yourself for a little moment , until the indignation is past .

verses.z: 因為耶和華從他的居所出來，要刑罰地上居民的罪孽。地也必露出其中的血，不再掩蓋被殺的人。
verses.e: For , behold , the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity . The earth also will disclose her blood , and will no longer cover her slain .

verses.z: 堅心倚賴[你的]，你必保守他十分平安，因為他倚靠你。
verses.e: You will keep whoever's mind is steadfast in perfect peace , because he trusts in you .

verses.z: 你們當倚靠耶和華直到永遠，因為耶和華是永久的磐石。
verses.e: Trust in the LORD forever ; for in the LORD , the LORD , is an everlasting Rock .

verses.z: 他使住高處的與高城一併敗落，將城拆毀，拆平，直到塵埃，
verses.e: For he has brought down those who dwell on high , the lofty city . He lays it low . He lays it low even to the ground . He brings it even to the dust .

verses.z: 要被腳踐踏，就是被困苦人的腳和窮乏人的腳踐踏。
verses.e: The foot shall tread it down , even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy . "

verses.z: 義人的道是正直的；你為正直的[主]，必修平義人的路。
verses.e: The way of the just is uprightness . You who are upright make the path of the righteous level .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我們在你行審判的路上等候你；我們心裏所羨慕的是你的名，就是你那可記念的[名]。
verses.e: Yes , in the way of your judgments , LORD , we have waited for you . Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul .

verses.z: 夜間，我心中羨慕你；我裏面的靈切切尋求你。因為你在世上行審判的時候，地上的居民就學習公義。
verses.e: With my soul I have desired you in the night . Yes , with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly ; for when your judgments are in the earth , the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness .

verses.z: 到那日，耶和華必用他剛硬有力的大刀刑罰鱷魚－就是那快行的蛇，刑罰鱷魚－就是那曲行的蛇，並殺海中的大魚。
verses.e: In that day , the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan , the fleeing serpent , and leviathan , the twisted serpent ; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea .

verses.z: 因為堅固城變為淒涼，成了撇下離棄的居所，像曠野一樣；牛犢必在那裏吃草，在那裏躺臥，並吃盡其中的樹枝。
verses.e: For the fortified city is solitary , a habitation deserted and forsaken , like the wilderness . The calf will feed there , and there he will lie down , and consume its branches .

verses.z: 枝條枯乾，必被折斷；婦女要來點火燒着。因為這百姓蒙昧無知，所以，創造他們的必不憐恤他們；造成他們的也不施恩與他們。
verses.e: When its boughs are withered , they will be broken off . The women will come and set them on fire , for they are a people of no understanding . Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them , and he who formed them will show them no favor .

verses.z: 以色列人哪，到那日，耶和華必從大河，直到埃及小河，將你們一一地收集，如同人打樹拾果一樣。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt ; and you will be gathered one by one , children of Israel .

verses.z: 當那日，必大發角聲，在亞述地將要滅亡的，並在埃及地被趕散的，都要來，他們就在耶路撒冷聖山上敬拜耶和華。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown ; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria , and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt , shall come ; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 當那日，有出酒的葡萄園，你們要指這園唱歌[說]：
verses.e: In that day , sing to her , " A pleasant vineyard !

verses.z: 我－耶和華是看守葡萄園的；我必時刻澆灌，晝夜看守，免得有人損害。
verses.e: I , the LORD , am its keeper . I will water it every moment . Lest anyone damage it , I will keep it night and day .

verses.z: 我心中不存忿怒。惟願荊棘蒺藜與我交戰，我就勇往直前，把它一同焚燒。
verses.e: Wrath is not in me , but if I should find briers and thorns , I would do battle ! I would march on them and I would burn them together .

verses.z: 不然，讓它持住我的能力，使它與我和好，願它與我和好。
verses.e: Or else let him take hold of my strength , that he may make peace with me . Let him make peace with me . "

verses.z: 將來雅各要扎根，以色列要發芽開花；他們的果實必充滿世界。
verses.e: In days to come , Jacob will take root . Israel will blossom and bud . They will fill the surface of the world with fruit .

verses.z: 主擊打他們，豈像擊打那些擊打他們的人嗎？他們被殺戮，豈像被他們所殺戮的嗎？
verses.e: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them ? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed ?

verses.z: 你打發他們去，是相機宜與他們相爭；颳東風的日子，就用暴風將他們逐去。
verses.e: In measure , when you send them away , you contend with them . He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind .

verses.z: 所以，雅各的罪孽得赦免，他的罪過得除掉的果效，全在乎此：就是他叫祭壇的石頭變為打碎的灰石，以致木偶和日像不再立起。
verses.e: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven , and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin : that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces , so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more .

verses.z: 禍哉！以法蓮的酒徒，住在肥美谷的山上，他們心裏高傲，以所誇的為冠冕，[猶如]將殘之花。
verses.e: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim , and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty , which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine !

verses.z: 他竟命上加命，令上加令，律上加律，例上加例，這裏一點，那裏一點。
verses.e: For it is precept on precept , precept on precept ; line on line , line on line ; here a little , there a little .

verses.z: [先知說]：不然，主要藉異邦人的嘴唇和外邦人的舌頭對這百姓說話。
verses.e: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language ,

verses.z: 他曾對他們說：你們要使疲乏人得安息，這樣才得安息，才得舒暢，他們卻不肯聽。
verses.e: to whom he said , " This is the resting place . Give rest to the weary , " and " This is the refreshing ; " yet they would not hear .

verses.z: 所以，耶和華向他們說的話是命上加命，令上加令，律上加律，例上加例，這裏一點，那裏一點，以致他們前行仰面跌倒，而且跌碎，並陷入網羅被纏住。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD's word will be to them precept on precept , precept on precept ; line on line , line on line ; here a little , there a little ; that they may go , fall backward , be broken , be snared , and be taken .

verses.z: 所以，你們這些褻慢的人，就是轄管住在耶路撒冷這百姓的，要聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: Therefore hear the LORD's word , you scoffers , that rule this people in Jerusalem :

verses.z: 你們曾說：我們與死亡立約，與陰間結盟；敵軍[如水]漲漫經過的時候，必不臨到我們；因我們以謊言為避所，在虛假以下藏身。
verses.e: " Because you have said , ' We have made a covenant with death , and we are in agreement with Sheol . When the overflowing scourge passes through , it won't come to us ; for we have made lies our refuge , and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood . ' "

verses.z: 所以，主耶和華如此說：看哪，我在錫安放一塊石頭作為根基，是試驗過的石頭，是穩固根基，寶貴的房角[石]；信靠的人必不着急。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says , " Behold , I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone , a tried stone , a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation . He who believes shall not act hastily .

verses.z: 我必以公平為準繩，以公義為線鉈。冰雹必沖去謊言的避所；大水必漫過藏身之處。
verses.e: I will make justice the measuring line , and righteousness the plumb line . The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies , and the waters will overflow the hiding place .

verses.z: 你們與死亡所立的約必然廢掉，與陰間所結的盟必立不住。敵軍[如水]漲漫經過的時候，你們必被他踐踏；
verses.e: Your covenant with death shall be annulled , and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand . When the overflowing scourge passes through , then you will be trampled down by it .

verses.z: 每逢經過必將你們擄去。因為每早晨他必經過，白晝黑夜都必如此。明白傳言的必受驚恐。
verses.e: As often as it passes through , it will seize you ; for morning by morning it will pass through , by day and by night ; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message . "

verses.z: 看哪，主有一大能大力者，像一陣冰雹，像毀滅的暴風，像漲溢的大水，他必用手將[冠冕]摔落於地。
verses.e: Behold , the Lord has one who is mighty and strong . Like a storm of hail , a destroying storm , and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing , he will cast them down to the earth with his hand .

verses.z: 原來，床榻短，使人不能舒身；被窩窄，使人不能遮體。
verses.e: For the bed is too short to stretch out on , and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in .

verses.z: 耶和華必興起，像在毗拉心山；他必發怒，像在基遍谷，好做成他的工，就是非常的工；成就他的事，就是奇異的事。
verses.e: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim . He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon ; that he may do his work , his unusual work , and bring to pass his act , his extraordinary act .

verses.z: 現在你們不可褻慢，恐怕捆你們的綁索更結實了；因為我從主－萬軍之耶和華那裏聽見，已經決定在全地上施行滅絕的事。
verses.e: Now therefore don't be scoffers , lest your bonds be made strong ; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord , GOD of Armies , on the whole earth .

verses.z: 你們當側耳聽我的聲音，留心聽我的言語。
verses.e: Give ear , and hear my voice ! Listen , and hear my speech !

verses.z: 那耕地為要撒種的，豈是常常耕地呢？豈是常常開墾耙地呢？
verses.e: Does he who plows to sow plow continually ? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods ?

verses.z: 他拉平了地面，豈不就撒種小茴香，播種大茴香，按行列種小麥，在定處種大麥，在田邊種粗麥呢？
verses.e: When he has leveled its surface , doesn't he plant the dill , and scatter the cumin seed , and put in the wheat in rows , the barley in the appointed place , and the spelt in its place ?

verses.z: 因為他的上帝教導他務農相宜，並且指教他。
verses.e: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him .

verses.z: 原來打小茴香，不用尖利的器具，軋大茴香，也不用碌碡；但用杖打小茴香，用棍打大茴香。
verses.e: For the dill isn't threshed with a sharp instrument , neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin ; but the dill is beaten out with a stick , and the cumin with a rod .

verses.z: 做餅的[糧食]是用磨磨碎，因它不必常打；雖用碌碡和馬打散，卻不磨它。
verses.e: Bread flour must be ground ; so he will not always be threshing it . Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it , his horses don't grind it .

verses.z: 這也是出於萬軍之耶和華－他的謀略奇妙；他的智慧廣大。
verses.e: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies , who is wonderful in counsel , and excellent in wisdom .

verses.z: 以法蓮高傲的酒徒，他的冠冕必被踏在腳下。
verses.e: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot .

verses.z: 那榮美將殘之花，就是在肥美谷山上的，必像夏令以前初熟的無花果；看見這果的就注意，一到手中就吞吃了。
verses.e: The fading flower of his glorious beauty , which is on the head of the fertile valley , shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer , which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it .

verses.z: 到那日，萬軍之耶和華必作他餘剩之民的榮冠華冕，
verses.e: In that day , the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people ,

verses.z: 也作了在位上行審判者公平之靈，並城門口打退仇敵者的力量。
verses.e: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment , and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate .

verses.z: 就是這[地的]人也因酒搖搖晃晃，因濃酒東倒西歪。祭司和先知因濃酒搖搖晃晃，被酒所困，因濃酒東倒西歪。他們錯解默示，謬行審判。
verses.e: They also reel with wine , and stagger with strong drink . The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink . They are swallowed up by wine . They stagger with strong drink . They err in vision . They stumble in judgment .

verses.z: 因為各席上滿了嘔吐的污穢，無一處[乾淨]。
verses.e: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness .

verses.z: [譏誚先知的說]：他要將知識指教誰呢？要使誰明白傳言呢？是那剛斷奶離懷的嗎？
verses.e: Whom will he teach knowledge ? To whom will he explain the message ? Those who are weaned from the milk , and drawn from the breasts ?

verses.z: 唉！亞利伊勒，亞利伊勒，大衛安營的城，任憑你年上加年，節期照常周流。
verses.e: Woe to Ariel ! Ariel , the city where David encamped ! Add year to year ; let the feasts come around ;

verses.z: 因為耶和華將沉睡的靈澆灌你們，封閉你們的眼，蒙蓋你們的頭。你們的眼就是先知；你們的頭就是先見。
verses.e: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep , and has closed your eyes , the prophets ; and he has covered your heads , the seers .

verses.z: 所有的默示，你們看如封住的書卷，人將這書卷交給識字的，說：「請念吧！」他說：「我不能念，因為是封住了。」
verses.e: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed , which men deliver to one who is educated , saying , " Read this , please ; " and he says , " I can't , for it is sealed ; "

verses.z: 又將這書卷交給不識字的人，說：「請念吧！」他說：「我不識字。」
verses.e: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated , saying , " Read this , please ; " and he says , " I can't read . "

verses.z: 主說：因為這百姓親近我，用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我；他們敬畏我，不過是領受人的吩咐。
verses.e: The Lord said , " Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips , but they have removed their heart far from me , and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught ;

verses.z: 所以，我在這百姓中要行奇妙的事，就是奇妙又奇妙的事。他們智慧人的智慧必然消滅，聰明人的聰明必然隱藏。
verses.e: therefore , behold , I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people , even a marvelous work and a wonder ; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish , and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden . "

verses.z: 禍哉！那些向耶和華深藏謀略的，又在暗中行事，說：誰看見我們呢？誰知道我們呢？
verses.e: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD , and whose deeds are in the dark , and who say , " Who sees us ? " and " Who knows us ? "

verses.z: 你們把事顛倒了，豈可看窯匠如泥嗎？被製作的物豈可論製作物的說：他沒有製作我？或是被創造的物論造物的說：他沒有聰明？
verses.e: You turn things upside down ! Should the potter be thought to be like clay , that the thing made should say about him who made it , " He didn't make me ; " or the thing formed say of him who formed it , " He has no understanding " ?

verses.z: 黎巴嫩變為肥田，肥田看如樹林，不是只有一點點時候嗎？
verses.e: Isn't it yet a very little while , and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field , and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest ?

verses.z: 那時，聾子必聽見這書上的話；瞎子的眼必從迷矇黑暗中得以看見。
verses.e: In that day , the deaf will hear the words of the book , and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness .

verses.z: 謙卑人必因耶和華增添歡喜；人間貧窮的必因以色列的聖者快樂。
verses.e: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD , and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 我終必使亞利伊勒困難；她必悲傷哀號，我卻仍以她為亞利伊勒。
verses.e: then I will distress Ariel , and there will be mourning and lamentation . She shall be to me as an altar hearth .

verses.z: 因為，強暴人已歸無有，褻慢人已經滅絕，一切找機會作孽的都被剪除。
verses.e: For the ruthless is brought to nothing , and the scoffer ceases , and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off —

verses.z: 他們在爭訟的事上定[無罪的]為有罪，為城門口責備人的設下網羅，用虛無的事屈枉義人。
verses.e: who cause a person to be indicted by a word , and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate , and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony .

verses.z: 所以，救贖亞伯拉罕的耶和華論雅各家如此說：雅各必不再羞愧，面容也不致變色。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD , who redeemed Abraham , says concerning the house of Jacob : " Jacob shall no longer be ashamed , neither shall his face grow pale .

verses.z: 但他看見他的眾子，就是我手的工作在他那裏，他們必尊我的名為聖，必尊雅各的聖者為聖，必敬畏以色列的上帝。
verses.e: But when he sees his children , the work of my hands , in the middle of him , they will sanctify my name . Yes , they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob , and will stand in awe of the God of Israel .

verses.z: 心中迷糊的必得明白；發怨言的必受訓誨。
verses.e: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding , and those who grumble will receive instruction . "

verses.z: 我必四圍安營攻擊你，屯兵圍困你，築壘攻擊你。
verses.e: I will encamp against you all around you , and will lay siege against you with posted troops . I will raise siege works against you .

verses.z: 你必敗落，從地中說話；你的言語必微細出於塵埃。你的聲音必像那交鬼者的聲音出於地；你的言語低低微微出於塵埃。
verses.e: You will be brought down , and will speak out of the ground . Your speech will mumble out of the dust . Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit , out of the ground , and your speech will whisper out of the dust .

verses.z: 你仇敵的群眾，卻要像細塵；強暴人的群眾，也要像飛糠。這事必頃刻之間忽然臨到。
verses.e: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust , and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away . Yes , it will be in an instant , suddenly .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華必用雷轟、地震、大聲、旋風、暴風，並吞滅的火焰，向她討罪。
verses.e: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder , with earthquake , with great noise , with whirlwind and storm , and with the flame of a devouring fire .

verses.z: 那時，攻擊亞利伊勒列國的群眾，就是一切攻擊亞利伊勒和她的保障，並使她困難的，必如夢景，如夜間的異象；
verses.e: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel , even all who fight against her and her stronghold , and who distress her , will be like a dream , a vision of the night .

verses.z: 又必像飢餓的人夢中吃飯，醒了仍覺腹空；或像口渴的人夢中喝水，醒了仍覺發昏，心裏想喝。攻擊錫安山列國的群眾也必如此。
verses.e: It will be like when a hungry man dreams , and behold , he eats ; but he awakes , and his hunger isn't satisfied ; or like when a thirsty man dreams , and behold , he drinks ; but he awakes , and behold , he is faint , and he is still thirsty . The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that .

verses.z: 你們等候驚奇吧！你們宴樂昏迷吧！他們醉了，卻非因酒；他們東倒西歪，卻非因濃酒。
verses.e: Pause and wonder ! Blind yourselves and be blind ! They are drunken , but not with wine ; they stagger , but not with strong drink .

verses.z: 主－萬軍之耶和華從耶路撒冷和猶大，除掉眾人所倚靠的，所仗賴的，就是所倚靠的糧，所仗賴的水；
verses.e: For , behold , the Lord , GOD of Armies , takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support , the whole supply of bread , and the whole supply of water ;

verses.z: 你們要論義人說：他必享福樂，因為要吃自己行為所結的果子。
verses.e: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them , for they will eat the fruit of their deeds .

verses.z: 惡人有禍了！他必遭災難！因為要照自己手所行的受報應。
verses.e: Woe to the wicked ! Disaster is upon them , for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them .

verses.z: 至於我的百姓，孩童欺壓他們，婦女轄管他們。我的百姓啊，引導你的使你走錯，並毀壞你所行的道路。
verses.e: As for my people , children are their oppressors , and women rule over them . My people , those who lead you cause you to err , and destroy the way of your paths .

verses.z: 耶和華起來辯論，站着審判眾民。
verses.e: The LORD stands up to contend , and stands to judge the peoples .

verses.z: 耶和華必審問他民中的長老和首領，[說]：吃盡葡萄園果子的就是你們；向貧窮人所奪的都在你們家中。
verses.e: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders : " It is you who have eaten up the vineyard . The plunder of the poor is in your houses .

verses.z: 主－萬軍之耶和華說：你們為何壓制我的百姓，搓磨貧窮人的臉呢？
verses.e: What do you mean that you crush my people , and grind the face of the poor ? " says the Lord , GOD of Armies .

verses.z: 耶和華又說：因為錫安的女子狂傲，行走挺項，賣弄眼目，俏步徐行，腳下玎璫，
verses.e: Moreover the LORD said , " Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant , and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes , walking daintily as they go , jingling ornaments on their feet ;

verses.z: 所以，主必使錫安的女子頭長禿瘡；耶和華又使她們赤露下體。
verses.e: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion , and the LORD will make their scalps bald . "

verses.z: 到那日，主必除掉她們華美的腳釧、髮網、月牙圈、
verses.e: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets , the headbands , the crescent necklaces ,

verses.z: 耳環、手鐲、蒙臉的帕子、
verses.e: the earrings , the bracelets , the veils ,

verses.z: 除掉勇士和戰士，審判官和先知，占卜的和長老，
verses.e: the mighty man , the man of war , the judge , the prophet , the diviner , the elder ,

verses.z: 華冠、足鍊、華帶、香盒、符囊、
verses.e: the headdresses , the ankle chains , the sashes , the perfume containers , the charms ,

verses.z: 戒指、鼻環、
verses.e: the signet rings , the nose rings ,

verses.z: 吉服、外套、雲肩、荷包、
verses.e: the fine robes , the capes , the cloaks , the purses ,

verses.z: 手鏡、細麻衣、裹頭巾、蒙身的帕子。
verses.e: the hand mirrors , the fine linen garments , the tiaras , and the shawls .

verses.z: 必有臭爛代替馨香，繩子代替腰帶，光禿代替美髮，麻衣繫腰代替華服，烙傷代替美容。
verses.e: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices , there shall be rottenness ; instead of a belt , a rope ; instead of well set hair , baldness ; instead of a robe , a wearing of sackcloth ; and branding instead of beauty .

verses.z: 你的男丁必倒在刀下；你的勇士必死在陣上。
verses.e: Your men shall fall by the sword , and your mighty in the war .

verses.z: 錫安的城門必悲傷、哀號；她必荒涼坐在地上。
verses.e: Her gates shall lament and mourn . She shall be desolate and sit on the ground .

verses.z: 五十夫長和尊貴人，謀士和有巧藝的，以及妙行法術的。
verses.e: the captain of fifty , the honorable man , the counselor , the skilled craftsman , and the clever enchanter .

verses.z: [主說]：我必使孩童作他們的首領，使嬰孩轄管他們。
verses.e: I will give boys to be their princes , and children shall rule over them .

verses.z: 百姓要彼此欺壓；各人受鄰舍的欺壓。少年人必侮慢老年人；卑賤人必侮慢尊貴人。
verses.e: The people will be oppressed , everyone by another , and everyone by his neighbor . The child will behave himself proudly against the old man , and the wicked against the honorable .

verses.z: 人在父家拉住弟兄，[說]：你有衣服，可以作我們的官長。這敗落的事歸在你手下吧！
verses.e: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father , saying , " You have clothing , you be our ruler , and let this ruin be under your hand . "

verses.z: 那時，他必揚聲說：我不作醫治你們的人；因我家中沒有糧食，也沒有衣服，你們不可立我作百姓的官長。
verses.e: In that day he will cry out , saying , " I will not be a healer ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing . You shall not make me ruler of the people . "

verses.z: 耶路撒冷敗落，猶大傾倒；因為他們的舌頭和行為與耶和華反對，惹了他榮光的眼目。
verses.e: For Jerusalem is ruined , and Judah is fallen ; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD , to provoke the eyes of his glory .

verses.z: 他們的面色證明自己的不正；他們述說自己的罪惡，並不隱瞞，好像所多瑪一樣。他們有禍了！因為作惡自害。
verses.e: The look of their faces testify against them . They parade their sin like Sodom . They don't hide it . Woe to their soul ! For they have brought disaster upon themselves .

verses.z: 耶和華說：禍哉！這悖逆的兒女。他們同謀，卻不由於我，結盟，卻不由於我的靈，以致罪上加罪；
verses.e: " Woe to the rebellious children " , says the LORD , " who take counsel , but not from me ; and who make an alliance , but not with my Spirit , that they may add sin to sin ;

verses.z: 他們對先見說：不要望見[不吉利的事]，對先知說：不要向我們講正直的話；要向我們說柔和的話，言虛幻的事。
verses.e: who tell the seers , " Don't see ! " and the prophets , " Don't prophesy to us right things . Tell us pleasant things . Prophesy deceits .

verses.z: 你們要離棄正道，偏離直路，不要在我們面前再提說以色列的聖者。
verses.e: Get out of the way . Turn away from the path . Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us . "

verses.z: 所以，以色列的聖者如此說：因為你們藐視這[訓誨的]話，倚賴欺壓和乖僻，以此為可靠的，
verses.e: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says , " Because you despise this word , and trust in oppression and perverseness , and rely on it ,

verses.z: 故此，這罪孽在你們身上，好像將要破裂凸出來的高牆，頃刻之間忽然坍塌；
verses.e: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall , swelling out in a high wall , whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant .

verses.z: 要被打碎，好像把窯匠的瓦器打碎，毫不顧惜，甚至碎塊中找不到一片可用以從爐內取火，從池中舀水。
verses.e: He will break it as a potter's vessel is broken , breaking it in pieces without sparing , so that there won't be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth , or to dip up water out of the cistern . "

verses.z: 主耶和華－以色列的聖者曾如此說：你們得救在乎歸回安息；你們得力在乎平靜安穩；你們竟自不肯。
verses.e: For thus said the Lord GOD , the Holy One of Israel , " You will be saved in returning and rest . Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence . " You refused ,

verses.z: 你們卻說：不然，我們要騎馬奔走。所以你們必然奔走；又說：我們要騎飛快的[牲口]。所以追趕你們的，也必飛快。
verses.e: but you said , " No , for we will flee on horses ; " therefore you will flee ; and , " We will ride on the swift ; " therefore those who pursue you will be swift .

verses.z: 一人叱喝，必令千人[逃跑]；五人叱喝，你們都必逃跑；以致剩下的，好像山頂的旗杆，岡上的大旗。
verses.e: One thousand will flee at the threat of one . At the threat of five , you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain , and like a banner on a hill .

verses.z: 耶和華必然等候，要施恩給你們；必然興起，好憐憫你們。因為耶和華是公平的上帝；凡等候他的都是有福的！
verses.e: Therefore the LORD will wait , that he may be gracious to you ; and therefore he will be exalted , that he may have mercy on you , for the LORD is a God of justice . Blessed are all those who wait for him .

verses.z: 百姓必在錫安、在耶路撒冷居住；你不再哭泣。主必因你哀求的聲音施恩給你；他聽見的時候就必應允你。
verses.e: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem . You will weep no more . He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry . When he hears you , he will answer you .

verses.z: 起身下埃及去，並沒有求問我；要靠法老的力量加添自己的力量，並投在埃及的蔭下。
verses.e: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice , to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh , and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt !

verses.z: 主雖然以艱難給你當餅，以困苦給你當水，你的教師卻不再隱藏；你眼必看見你的教師。
verses.e: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction , yet your teachers won't be hidden any more , but your eyes will see your teachers ;

verses.z: 你或向左或向右，你必聽見後邊有聲音說：「這是正路，要行在其間。」
verses.e: and when you turn to the right hand , and when you turn to the left , your ears will hear a voice behind you , saying , " This is the way . Walk in it . "

verses.z: 你雕刻偶像所包的銀子和鑄造偶像所鍍的金子，你要玷污，要拋棄，好像污穢之物，對偶像說：「去吧！」
verses.e: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver , and the plating of your molten images of gold . You shall cast them away as an unclean thing . You shall tell it , " Go away ! "

verses.z: 你將種子撒在地裏，主必降雨在其上，並使地所出的糧肥美豐盛。到那時，你的牲畜必在寬闊的草場吃草。
verses.e: He will give the rain for your seed , with which you will sow the ground ; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful . In that day , your livestock will feed in large pastures .

verses.z: 耕地的牛和驢駒必吃加鹽的料；這料是用木杴和杈子揚淨的。
verses.e: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed , which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork .

verses.z: 在大行殺戮的日子，高臺倒塌的時候，各高山岡陵必有川流河湧。
verses.e: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter , when the towers fall .

verses.z: 當耶和華纏裹他百姓的損處，醫治他民鞭傷的日子，月光必像日光，日光必加七倍，像七日的光一樣。
verses.e: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun , and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter , like the light of seven days , in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people , and heals the wound they were struck with .

verses.z: 看哪，耶和華的名從遠方來，怒氣燒起，密煙上騰。他的嘴唇滿有忿恨；他的舌頭像吞滅的火。
verses.e: Behold , the LORD's name comes from far away , burning with his anger , and in thick rising smoke . His lips are full of indignation . His tongue is as a devouring fire .

verses.z: 他的氣如漲溢的河水，直漲到頸項，要用毀滅的篩籮篩淨列國，並且在眾民的口中必有使人錯行的嚼環。
verses.e: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck , to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction . A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples .

verses.z: 你們必唱歌，像守聖節的夜間一樣，並且心中喜樂，像人吹笛，上耶和華的山，到以色列的磐石那裏。
verses.e: You will have a song , as in the night when a holy feast is kept , and gladness of heart , as when one goes with a flute to come to the LORD's mountain , to Israel's Rock .

verses.z: 所以，法老的力量必作你們的羞辱；投在埃及的蔭下，要為你們的慚愧。
verses.e: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame , and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion .

verses.z: 耶和華必使人聽他威嚴的聲音，又顯他降罰的膀臂和他怒中的忿恨，並吞滅的火焰與霹雷、暴風、冰雹。
verses.e: The LORD will cause his glorious voice to be heard , and will show the descent of his arm , with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire , with a blast , storm , and hailstones .

verses.z: 亞述人必因耶和華的聲音驚惶；耶和華必用杖擊打他。
verses.e: For through the LORD's voice the Assyrian will be dismayed . He will strike him with his rod .

verses.z: 耶和華必將命定的杖加在他身上；每打一下，人必擊鼓彈琴。打仗的時候，耶和華必掄起[手]來，與他交戰。
verses.e: Every stroke of the rod of punishment , which the LORD will lay on him , will be with the sound of tambourines and harps . He will fight with them in battles , brandishing weapons .

verses.z: 原來陀斐特又深又寬，早已為王預備好了；其中堆的是火與許多木柴。耶和華的氣如一股硫磺火使他着起來。
verses.e: For his burning place has long been ready . Yes , it is prepared for the king . He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood . The LORD's breath , like a stream of sulfur , kindles it .

verses.z: 他們的首領已在瑣安；他們的使臣到了哈內斯。
verses.e: For their princes are at Zoan , and their ambassadors have come to Hanes .

verses.z: 他們必因那不利於他們的民蒙羞。那民並非幫助，也非利益，只作羞恥凌辱。
verses.e: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can't profit them , that are not a help nor profit , but a shame , and also a reproach . "

verses.z: 論南方牲畜的默示：他們把財物馱在驢駒的脊背上，將寶物馱在駱駝的肉鞍上，經過艱難困苦之地，就是公獅、母獅、蝮蛇、火焰的飛龍之地，往那不利於他們的民那裏去。
verses.e: The burden of the animals of the South . Through the land of trouble and anguish , of the lioness and the lion , the viper and fiery flying serpent , they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys , and their treasures on the humps of camels , to an unprofitable people .

verses.z: 埃及的幫助是徒然無益的；所以我稱她為「坐而不動的拉哈伯」。
verses.e: For Egypt helps in vain , and to no purpose ; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still .

verses.z: 現今你去，在他們面前將這話刻在版上，寫在書上，以便傳留後世，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: Now go , write it before them on a tablet , and inscribe it in a book , that it may be for the time to come forever and ever .

verses.z: 因為他們是悖逆的百姓、說謊的兒女，不肯聽從耶和華訓誨的兒女。
verses.e: For it is a rebellious people , lying children , children who will not hear the LORD's law ;

verses.z: 禍哉！那些下埃及求幫助的，是因仗賴馬匹，倚靠甚多的車輛，並倚靠強壯的馬兵，卻不仰望以色列的聖者，也不求問耶和華。
verses.e: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help , and rely on horses , and trust in chariots because they are many , and in horsemen because they are very strong , but they don't look to the Holy One of Israel , and they don't seek the LORD !

verses.z: 其實，耶和華有智慧；他必降災禍，並不反悔自己的話，卻要興起攻擊那作惡之家，又攻擊那作孽幫助人的。
verses.e: Yet he also is wise , and will bring disaster , and will not call back his words , but will arise against the house of the evildoers , and against the help of those who work iniquity .

verses.z: 埃及人不過是人，並不是上帝；他們的馬不過是血肉，並不是靈。耶和華一伸手，那幫助人的必絆跌，那受幫助的也必跌倒，都一同滅亡。
verses.e: Now the Egyptians are men , and not God ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the LORD stretches out his hand , both he who helps shall stumble , and he who is helped shall fall , and they all shall be consumed together .

verses.z: 耶和華對我如此說：獅子和少壯獅子護食咆哮，就是喊許多牧人來攻擊牠，牠總不因他們的聲音驚惶，也不因他們的喧嘩縮伏。如此，萬軍之耶和華也必降臨在錫安山岡上爭戰。
verses.e: For the LORD says to me , " As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey , if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him , will not be dismayed at their voice , nor abase himself for their noise , so the LORD of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights .

verses.z: 雀鳥怎樣搧翅[覆雛]，萬軍之耶和華也要照樣保護耶路撒冷。他必保護拯救，要越門保守。
verses.e: As birds hovering , so the LORD of Armies will protect Jerusalem . He will protect and deliver it . He will pass over and preserve it . "

verses.z: 以色列人哪，你們深深地悖逆耶和華，現今要歸向他。
verses.e: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted , children of Israel .

verses.z: 到那日，各人必將他金偶像銀偶像，就是親手所造、陷自己在罪中的，都拋棄了。
verses.e: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold — sin which your own hands have made for you .

verses.z: 亞述人必倒在刀下，並非人的刀；有刀要將他吞滅，並非人的刀。他必逃避這刀；他的少年人必成為服苦的。
verses.e: " The Assyrian will fall by the sword , not of man ; and the sword , not of mankind , shall devour him . He will flee from the sword , and his young men will become subject to forced labor .

verses.z: 他的磐石必因驚嚇挪去；他的首領必因大旗驚惶。這是那有火在錫安、有爐在耶路撒冷的耶和華說的。
verses.e: His rock will pass away by reason of terror , and his princes will be afraid of the banner , " says the LORD , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 看哪，必有一王憑公義行政；必有首領藉公平掌權。
verses.e: Behold , a king shall reign in righteousness , and princes shall rule in justice .

verses.z: 無慮的女子啊，再過一年多，必受騷擾；因為無葡萄可摘，無果子可收。
verses.e: For days beyond a year you will be troubled , you careless women ; for the vintage will fail . The harvest won't come .

verses.z: 安逸的婦女啊，要戰兢；無慮的女子啊，要受騷擾。脫去衣服，赤着身體，腰束[麻布]。
verses.e: Tremble , you women who are at ease ! Be troubled , you careless ones ! Strip yourselves , make yourselves naked , and put sackcloth on your waist .

verses.z: 她們必為美好的田地和多結果的葡萄樹，搥胸哀哭。
verses.e: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields , for the fruitful vine .

verses.z: 荊棘蒺藜必長在我百姓的地上，又長在歡樂的城中和一切快樂的房屋上。
verses.e: Thorns and briers will come up on my people's land ; yes , on all the houses of joy in the joyous city .

verses.z: 因為宮殿必被撇下，多民的城必被離棄；山岡望樓永為洞穴，作野驢所喜樂的，為羊群的草場。
verses.e: For the palace will be forsaken . The populous city will be deserted . The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever , a delight for wild donkeys , a pasture of flocks ,

verses.z: 等到[聖]靈從上澆灌我們，曠野就變為肥田，肥田看如樹林。
verses.e: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high , and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field , and the fruitful field is considered a forest .

verses.z: 那時，公平要居在曠野；公義要居在肥田。
verses.e: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness ; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field .

verses.z: 公義的果效必是平安；公義的效驗必是平穩，直到永遠。
verses.e: The work of righteousness will be peace , and the effect of righteousness , quietness and confidence forever .

verses.z: 我的百姓必住在平安的居所，安穩的住處，平靜的安歇所。
verses.e: My people will live in a peaceful habitation , in safe dwellings , and in quiet resting places ,

verses.z: （但要降冰雹打倒樹林；城必全然拆平。）
verses.e: though hail flattens the forest , and the city is leveled completely .

verses.z: 必有一人像避風所和避暴雨的隱密處，又像河流在乾旱之地，像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。
verses.e: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind , and a covert from the storm , as streams of water in a dry place , as the shade of a large rock in a weary land .

verses.z: 你們在各水邊撒種、牧放牛驢的有福了！
verses.e: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters , who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey .

verses.z: 那能看的人，眼不再昏迷；能聽的人，耳必得聽聞。
verses.e: The eyes of those who see will not be dim , and the ears of those who hear will listen .

verses.z: 冒失人的心必明白知識；結吧人的舌必說話通快。
verses.e: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly .

verses.z: 愚頑人不再稱為高明；吝嗇人不再稱為大方。
verses.e: The fool will no longer be called noble , nor the scoundrel be highly respected .

verses.z: 因為愚頑人必說愚頑話，心裏想作罪孽，慣行褻瀆的事，說錯謬的話攻擊耶和華，使飢餓的人無食可吃，使口渴的人無水可喝。
verses.e: For the fool will speak folly , and his heart will work iniquity , to practice profanity , and to utter error against the LORD , to make empty the soul of the hungry , and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail .

verses.z: 吝嗇人所用的法子是惡的；他圖謀惡計，用謊言毀滅謙卑人；窮乏人講公理的時候，他也是這樣行。
verses.e: The ways of the scoundrel are evil . He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words , even when the needy speaks right .

verses.z: 高明人卻謀高明事，在高明事上也必永存。
verses.e: But the noble devises noble things , and he will continue in noble things .

verses.z: 安逸的婦女啊，起來聽我的聲音！無慮的女子啊，側耳聽我的言語！
verses.e: Rise up , you women who are at ease ! Hear my voice ! You careless daughters , give ear to my speech !

verses.z: 禍哉！你這毀滅人的，自己倒不被毀滅；行事詭詐的，人倒不以詭詐待你。你毀滅罷休了，自己必被毀滅；你行完了詭詐，人必以詭詐待你。
verses.e: Woe to you who destroy , but you weren't destroyed , and who betray , but nobody betrayed you ! When you have finished destroying , you will be destroyed ; and when you have finished betrayal , you will be betrayed .

verses.z: 耶和華說：現在我要起來；我要興起；我要勃然而興。
verses.e: " Now I will arise , " says the LORD . " Now I will lift myself up . Now I will be exalted .

verses.z: 你們要懷的是糠詷，要生的是碎稭；你們的氣就是吞滅自己的火。
verses.e: You will conceive chaff . You will give birth to stubble . Your breath is a fire that will devour you .

verses.z: 列邦必像已燒的石灰，像已割的荊棘在火中焚燒。
verses.e: The peoples will be like the burning of lime , like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire .

verses.z: 你們遠方的人當聽我所行的；你們近處的人當承認我的大能。
verses.e: Hear , you who are far off , what I have done ; and , you who are near , acknowledge my might . "

verses.z: 錫安中的罪人都懼怕；不敬虔的人被戰兢抓住。我們中間誰能與吞滅的火同住？我們中間誰能與永火同住呢？
verses.e: The sinners in Zion are afraid . Trembling has seized the godless ones . Who among us can live with the devouring fire ? Who among us can live with everlasting burning ?

verses.z: 行事公義、說話正直、憎惡欺壓的財利、擺手不受賄賂、塞耳不聽流血的話，閉眼不看邪惡事的，
verses.e: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly , he who despises the gain of oppressions , who gestures with his hands , refusing to take a bribe , who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed , and shuts his eyes from looking at evil —

verses.z: 他必居高處；他的保障是磐石的堅壘；他的糧必不缺乏；他的水必不斷絕。
verses.e: he will dwell on high . His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks . His bread will be supplied . His waters will be sure .

verses.z: 你的眼必見王的榮美，必見遼闊之地。
verses.e: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty . They will see a distant land .

verses.z: 你的心必思想那驚嚇的事，[自問說]：記數目的在哪裏呢？平[貢銀]的在哪裏呢？數戍樓的在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Your heart will meditate on the terror . Where is he who counted ? Where is he who weighed ? Where is he who counted the towers ?

verses.z: 你必不見那強暴的民，就是說話深奧，你不能明白，言語呢喃，你不能懂得的。
verses.e: You will no longer see the fierce people , a people of a deep speech that you can't comprehend , with a strange language that you can't understand .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你施恩於我們；我們等候你。求你每早晨作我們的膀臂，遭難的時候為我們的拯救。
verses.e: LORD , be gracious to us . We have waited for you . Be our strength every morning , our salvation also in the time of trouble .

verses.z: 你要看錫安－我們守聖節的城！你的眼必見耶路撒冷為安靜的居所，為不挪移的帳幕，橛子永不拔出，繩索一根也不折斷。
verses.e: Look at Zion , the city of our appointed festivals . Your eyes will see Jerusalem , a quiet habitation , a tent that won't be removed . Its stakes will never be plucked up , nor will any of its cords be broken .

verses.z: 在那裏，耶和華必顯威嚴與我們同在，當作江河寬闊之地；其中必沒有盪槳搖櫓的船來往，也沒有威武的船經過。
verses.e: But there the LORD will be with us in majesty , a place of wide rivers and streams , in which no galley with oars will go , neither will any gallant ship pass by there .

verses.z: 因為，耶和華是審判我們的；耶和華是給我們設律法的；耶和華是我們的王；他必拯救我們。
verses.e: For the LORD is our judge . The LORD is our lawgiver . The LORD is our king . He will save us .

verses.z: 你的繩索鬆開：不能栽穩桅杆，也不能揚起篷來。那時許多擄來的物被分了；瘸腿的把掠物奪去了。
verses.e: Your rigging is untied . They couldn't strengthen the foot of their mast . They couldn't spread the sail . Then the prey of a great plunder was divided . The lame took the prey .

verses.z: 城內居民必不說：我病了；其中居住的百姓，罪孽都赦免了。
verses.e: The inhabitant won't say , " I am sick . " The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity .

verses.z: 喧嚷的響聲一發，眾民奔逃；你一興起，列國四散。
verses.e: At the noise of the thunder , the peoples have fled . When you lift yourself up , the nations are scattered .

verses.z: 你們所擄的必被斂盡，好像螞蚱吃盡[禾稼]。人要蹦在其上，好像蝗蟲一樣。
verses.e: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers . Men will leap on it as locusts leap .

verses.z: 耶和華被尊崇，因他居在高處；他以公平公義充滿錫安。
verses.e: The LORD is exalted , for he dwells on high . He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness .

verses.z: 你一生一世必得安穩－有豐盛的救恩，並智慧和知識；你以敬畏耶和華為至寶。
verses.e: There will be stability in your times , abundance of salvation , wisdom , and knowledge . The fear of the LORD is your treasure .

verses.z: 看哪，他們的豪傑在外頭哀號；求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。
verses.e: Behold , their valiant ones cry outside ; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly .

verses.z: 大路荒涼，行人止息；[敵人]背約，藐視城邑，不顧人民。
verses.e: The highways are desolate . The traveling man ceases . The covenant is broken . He has despised the cities . He doesn't respect man .

verses.z: 地上悲哀衰殘；黎巴嫩羞愧枯乾；沙崙像曠野；巴珊和迦密[的樹林]凋殘。
verses.e: The land mourns and languishes . Lebanon is confounded and withers away . Sharon is like a desert , and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare .

verses.z: 列國啊，要近前來聽！眾民哪，要側耳而聽！地和其上所充滿的，世界和其中一切所出的都應當聽！
verses.e: Come near , you nations , to hear ! Listen , you peoples . Let the earth and all it contains hear , the world , and everything that comes from it .

verses.z: 晝夜總不熄滅，煙氣永遠上騰，必世世代代成為荒廢，永永遠遠無人經過。
verses.e: It won't be quenched night or day . Its smoke will go up forever . From generation to generation , it will lie waste . No one will pass through it forever and ever .

verses.z: 鵜鶘、箭豬卻要得為業；貓頭鷹、烏鴉要住在其間。耶和華必將空虛的準繩，混沌的線鉈，拉在其上。
verses.e: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it . The owl and the raven will dwell in it . He will stretch the line of confusion over it , and the plumb line of emptiness .

verses.z: 以東人要召貴冑來治國；那裏卻無一個，首領也都歸於無有。
verses.e: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom , but none shall be there ; and all its princes shall be nothing .

verses.z: 以東的宮殿要長荊棘；保障要長蒺藜和刺草；要作野狗的住處，鴕鳥的居所。
verses.e: Thorns will come up in its palaces , nettles and thistles in its fortresses ; and it will be a habitation of jackals , a court for ostriches .

verses.z: 曠野的走獸要和豺狼相遇；野山羊要與伴偶對叫。夜間的怪物必在那裏棲身，自找安歇之處。
verses.e: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves , and the wild goat will cry to his fellow . Yes , the night creature shall settle there , and shall find herself a place of rest .

verses.z: 箭蛇要在那裏做窩，下蛋，菢蛋，生子，聚子在其影下；鷂鷹各與伴偶聚集在那裏。
verses.e: The arrow snake will make her nest there , and lay , hatch , and gather under her shade . Yes , the kites will be gathered there , every one with her mate .

verses.z: 你們要查考宣讀耶和華的書。這都無一缺少，無一沒有伴偶；因為我的口已經吩咐，他的靈將牠們聚集。
verses.e: Search in the book of the LORD , and read : not one of these will be missing . None will lack her mate . For my mouth has commanded , and his Spirit has gathered them .

verses.z: 他也為牠們拈鬮，又親手用準繩給牠們分地；牠們必永得為業，世世代代住在其間。
verses.e: He has cast the lot for them , and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line . They shall possess it forever . From generation to generation they will dwell in it .

verses.z: 因為耶和華向萬國發忿恨，向他們的全軍發烈怒，將他們滅盡，交出他們受殺戮。
verses.e: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations , and angry with all their armies . He has utterly destroyed them . He has given them over for slaughter .

verses.z: 被殺的必然拋棄，屍首臭氣上騰；諸山被他們的血融化。
verses.e: Their slain will also be cast out , and the stench of their dead bodies will come up . The mountains will melt in their blood .

verses.z: 天上的萬象都要消沒；天被捲起，好像書卷。其上的萬象要殘敗，像葡萄樹的葉子殘敗，又像無花果樹的[葉子]殘敗一樣。
verses.e: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved . The sky will be rolled up like a scroll , and all its armies will fade away , as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree .

verses.z: 因為我的刀在天上已經喝足；這刀必臨到以東和我所咒詛的民，要施行審判。
verses.e: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky . Behold , it will come down on Edom , and on the people of my curse , for judgment .

verses.z: 耶和華的刀滿了血，用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血，並公綿羊腰子的脂油滋潤的；因為耶和華在波斯拉有獻祭的事，在以東地大行殺戮。
verses.e: The LORD's sword is filled with blood . It is covered with fat , with the blood of lambs and goats , with the fat of the kidneys of rams ; for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah , and a great slaughter in the land of Edom .

verses.z: 野牛、牛犢，和公牛要一同下來。他們的地喝醉了血；他們的塵土因脂油肥潤。
verses.e: The wild oxen will come down with them , and the young bulls with the mighty bulls ; and their land will be drunken with blood , and their dust made greasy with fat .

verses.z: 因耶和華有報仇之日，為錫安的爭辯有報應之年。
verses.e: For the LORD has a day of vengeance , a year of recompense for the cause of Zion .

verses.z: 以東的河水要變為石油，塵埃要變為硫磺；地土成為燒着的石油，
verses.e: Its streams will be turned into pitch , its dust into sulfur , and its land will become burning pitch .

verses.z: 曠野和乾旱之地必然歡喜；沙漠也必快樂；又像玫瑰開花，
verses.e: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad . The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose .

verses.z: 並且耶和華救贖的民必歸回，歌唱來到錫安；永樂必歸到他們的頭上；他們必得着歡喜快樂，憂愁歎息盡都逃避。
verses.e: Then the LORD's ransomed ones will return , and come with singing to Zion ; and everlasting joy will be on their heads . They will obtain gladness and joy , and sorrow and sighing will flee away . "

verses.z: 必開花繁盛，樂上加樂，而且歡呼。黎巴嫩的榮耀，並迦密與沙崙的華美，必賜給它。人必看見耶和華的榮耀，我們上帝的華美。
verses.e: It will blossom abundantly , and rejoice even with joy and singing . Lebanon's glory will be given to it , the excellence of Carmel and Sharon . They will see the LORD's glory , the excellence of our God .

verses.z: 你們要使軟弱的手堅壯，無力的膝穩固。
verses.e: Strengthen the weak hands , and make the feeble knees firm .

verses.z: 對膽怯的人說：你們要剛強，不要懼怕。看哪，你們的上帝必來報仇，必來施行極大的報應；他必來拯救你們。
verses.e: Tell those who have a fearful heart , " Be strong ! Don't be afraid ! Behold , your God will come with vengeance , God's retribution . He will come and save you .

verses.z: 那時，瞎子的眼必睜開；聾子的耳必開通。
verses.e: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened , and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped .

verses.z: 那時，瘸子必跳躍像鹿；啞巴的舌頭必能歌唱。在曠野必有水發出；在沙漠必有河湧流。
verses.e: Then the lame man will leap like a deer , and the tongue of the mute will sing ; for waters will break out in the wilderness , and streams in the desert .

verses.z: 發光的沙要變為水池；乾渴之地要變為泉源。在野狗躺臥之處，必有青草、蘆葦，和蒲草。
verses.e: The burning sand will become a pool , and the thirsty ground springs of water . Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals , where they lay .

verses.z: 在那裏必有一條大道，稱為聖路。污穢人不得經過，必專為贖民行走；行路的人雖愚昧，也不致失迷。
verses.e: A highway will be there , a road , and it will be called " The Holy Way " . The unclean shall not pass over it , but it will be for those who walk in the Way . Wicked fools shall not go there .

verses.z: 在那裏必沒有獅子，猛獸也不登這路；在那裏都遇不見，只有贖民在那裏行走。
verses.e: No lion will be there , nor will any ravenous animal go up on it . They will not be found there ; but the redeemed will walk there .

verses.z: 希西家王十四年，亞述王西拿基立上來攻擊猶大的一切堅固城，將城攻取。
verses.e: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah , Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them .

verses.z: 現在我上來攻擊毀滅這地，豈沒有耶和華的意思嗎？耶和華吩咐我說，你上去攻擊毀滅這地吧！』」
verses.e: Have I come up now without the LORD against this land to destroy it ? The LORD said to me , " Go up against this land , and destroy it . " ' "

verses.z: 以利亞敬、舍伯那、約亞對拉伯沙基說：「求你用亞蘭言語和僕人說話，因為我們懂得；不要用猶大言語和我們說話，達到城上百姓的耳中。」
verses.e: Then Eliakim , Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh , " Please speak to your servants in Aramaic , for we understand it . Don't speak to us in the Jews ' language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall . "

verses.z: 拉伯沙基說：「我主差遣我來，豈是單對你和你的主說這些話嗎？不也是對這些坐在城上、要與你們一同吃自己糞喝自己尿的人說嗎？」
verses.e: But Rabshakeh said , " Has my master sent me only to your master and to you , to speak these words , and not to the men who sit on the wall , who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you ? "

verses.z: 於是，拉伯沙基站着，用猶大言語大聲喊着說：「你們當聽亞述大王的話。
verses.e: Then Rabshakeh stood , and called out with a loud voice in the Jews ' language , and said , " Hear the words of the great king , the king of Assyria !

verses.z: 王如此說：『你們不要被希西家欺哄了，因他不能拯救你們。
verses.e: The king says , ' Don't let Hezekiah deceive you ; for he will not be able to deliver you .

verses.z: 也不要聽希西家使你們倚靠耶和華說：耶和華必要拯救我們，這城必不交在亞述王的手中。』
verses.e: Don't let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD , saying , " The LORD will surely deliver us . This city won't be given into the hand of the king of Assyria . " '

verses.z: 不要聽希西家的話，因亞述王如此說：『你們要與我和好。出來投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄樹和無花果樹的果子，喝自己井裏的水。
verses.e: Don't listen to Hezekiah , for the king of Assyria says , ' Make your peace with me , and come out to me ; and each of you eat from his vine , and each one from his fig tree , and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern ;

verses.z: 等我來領你們到一個地方，與你們本地一樣，就是有五穀和新酒之地，有糧食和葡萄園之地。
verses.e: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of grain and new wine , a land of bread and vineyards .

verses.z: 你們要謹防，恐怕希西家勸導你們說：耶和華必拯救我們。列國的神有哪一個救他本國脫離亞述王的手呢？
verses.e: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you , saying , " The LORD will deliver us . " Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria ?

verses.z: 哈馬和亞珥拔的神在哪裏呢？西法瓦音的神在哪裏呢？他們曾救撒馬利亞脫離我的手嗎？
verses.e: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad ? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim ? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand ?

verses.z: 亞述王從拉吉差遣拉伯沙基率領大軍往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那裏去。他就站在上池的水溝旁，在漂布地的大路上。
verses.e: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army . He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller's field highway .

verses.z: 這些國的神有誰曾救自己的國脫離我的手呢？難道耶和華能救耶路撒冷脫離我的手嗎？』」
verses.e: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand , that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand ? ' "

verses.z: 百姓靜默不言，並不回答一句，因為王曾吩咐說：「不要回答他。」
verses.e: But they remained silent , and said nothing in reply , for the king's commandment was , " Don't answer him . "

verses.z: 當下希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並亞薩的兒子史官約亞，都撕裂衣服，來到希西家那裏，將拉伯沙基的話告訴了他。
verses.e: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , who was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph the recorder , came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn , and told him the words of Rabshakeh .

verses.z: 於是希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬，並書記舍伯那和亞薩的兒子史官約亞，出來見拉伯沙基。
verses.e: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , who was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him .

verses.z: 拉伯沙基對他們說：「你們去告訴希西家說，亞述大王如此說：『你所倚靠的有甚麼可仗賴的呢？
verses.e: Rabshakeh said to them , " Now tell Hezekiah , ' The great king , the king of Assyria , says , " What confidence is this in which you trust ?

verses.z: 你說，有打仗的計謀和能力，我看不過是虛話。你到底倚靠誰才背叛我呢？
verses.e: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words . Now in whom do you trust , that you have rebelled against me ?

verses.z: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那壓傷的葦杖，人若靠這杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是這樣。
verses.e: Behold , you trust in the staff of this bruised reed , even in Egypt , which if a man leans on it , it will go into his hand and pierce it . So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him .

verses.z: 你若對我說：我們倚靠耶和華－我們的上帝。希西家豈不是將上帝的邱壇和祭壇廢去，且對猶大和耶路撒冷的人說：你們當在這壇前敬拜嗎？
verses.e: But if you tell me , ' We trust in the LORD our God , ' isn't that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away , and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem , ' You shall worship before this altar ' ? "

verses.z: 現在你把當頭給我主亞述王，我給你二千匹馬，看你這一面騎馬的人夠不夠。
verses.e: Now therefore , please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give you two thousand horses , if you are able on your part to set riders on them .

verses.z: 若不然，怎能打敗我主臣僕中最小的軍長呢？你竟倚靠埃及的戰車馬兵嗎？
verses.e: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants , and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

verses.z: 希西家王聽見就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，進了耶和華的殿，
verses.e: When King Hezekiah heard it , he tore his clothes , covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the LORD's house .

verses.z: 「你們對猶大王希西家如此說：『不要聽你所倚靠的上帝欺哄你說：耶路撒冷必不交在亞述王的手中。
verses.e: " Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , ' Don't let your God in whom you trust deceive you , saying , " Jerusalem won't be given into the hand of the king of Assyria . "

verses.z: 你總聽說亞述諸王向列國所行的乃是盡行滅絕，難道你還能得救嗎？
verses.e: Behold , you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly . Shall you be delivered ?

verses.z: 我列祖所毀滅的，就是歌散、哈蘭、利色，和屬提‧拉撒的伊甸人；這些國的神何曾拯救這些國呢？
verses.e: Have the gods of the nations delivered them , which my fathers have destroyed , Gozan , Haran , Rezeph , and the children of Eden who were in Telassar ?

verses.z: 哈馬的王，亞珥拔的王，西法瓦音城的王，希拿和以瓦的王，都在哪裏呢？』」
verses.e: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivvah ? ' "

verses.z: 希西家從使者手裏接過書信來，看完了，就上耶和華的殿，將書信在耶和華面前展開。
verses.e: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it . Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD's house , and spread it before the LORD .

verses.z: 希西家向耶和華禱告說：
verses.e: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD , saying ,

verses.z: 「坐在二基路伯上萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，你－惟有你是天下萬國的上帝，你曾創造天地。
verses.e: " LORD of Armies , the God of Israel , who is enthroned among the cherubim , you are the God , even you alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth . You have made heaven and earth .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你側耳而聽；耶和華啊，求你睜眼而看，要聽西拿基立的一切話，他是打發使者來辱罵永生上帝的。
verses.e: Turn your ear , LORD , and hear . Open your eyes , LORD , and behold . Hear all of the words of Sennacherib , who has sent to defy the living God .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，亞述諸王果然使列國和列國之地變為荒涼，
verses.e: Truly , LORD , the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land ,

verses.z: 將列國的神像都扔在火裏；因為他本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木頭、石頭的，所以滅絕他。
verses.e: and have cast their gods into the fire ; for they were no gods , but the work of men's hands , wood and stone ; therefore they have destroyed them .

verses.z: 使家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並祭司中的長老，都披上麻布，去見亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞，
verses.e: He sent Eliakim , who was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests , covered with sackcloth , to Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，現在求你救我們脫離亞述王的手，使天下萬國都知道惟有你是耶和華。」
verses.e: Now therefore , LORD our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are the LORD , even you only . "

verses.z: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞就打發人去見希西家，說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說，你既然求我攻擊亞述王西拿基立，
verses.e: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , " The LORD , the God of Israel says , ' Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria ,

verses.z: 所以耶和華論他這樣說：錫安的處女藐視你，嗤笑你；耶路撒冷的女子向你搖頭。
verses.e: this is the word which the LORD has spoken concerning him : The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you . The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you .

verses.z: 你辱罵誰，褻瀆誰？揚起聲來，高舉眼目攻擊誰呢？乃是攻擊以色列的聖者。
verses.e: Whom have you defied and blasphemed ? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high ? Against the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 你藉你的臣僕辱罵主說：我率領許多戰車上山頂，到黎巴嫩極深之處；我要砍伐其中高大的香柏樹和佳美的松樹。我必上極高之處，進入肥田的樹林。
verses.e: By your servants , you have defied the Lord , and have said , " With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains , to the innermost parts of Lebanon . I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees . I will enter into its farthest height , the forest of its fruitful field .

verses.z: 我已經挖井喝水；我必用腳掌踏乾埃及的一切河。
verses.e: I have dug and drunk water , and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt . "

verses.z: [耶和華說]：你豈沒有聽見我早先所做的、古時所立的嗎？現在藉你使堅固城荒廢，變為亂堆。
verses.e: " ' Have you not heard how I have done it long ago , and formed it in ancient times ? Now I have brought it to pass , that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities , turning them into ruinous heaps .

verses.z: 所以其中的居民力量甚小，驚惶羞愧。他們像野草，像青菜，如房頂上的草，又如田間未長成的[禾稼]。
verses.e: Therefore their inhabitants had little power . They were dismayed and confounded . They were like the grass of the field , and like the green herb , like the grass on the housetops , and like a field before its crop has grown .

verses.z: 你坐下，你出去，你進來，你向我發烈怒，我都知道。
verses.e: But I know your sitting down , your going out , your coming in , and your raging against me .

verses.z: 因你向我發烈怒，又因你狂傲[的話]達到我耳中，我就要用鉤子鉤上你的鼻子，把嚼環放在你口裏，使你從原路轉回去。
verses.e: Because of your raging against me , and because your arrogance has come up into my ears , therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips , and I will turn you back by the way by which you came .

verses.z: 對他說：「希西家如此說：『今日是急難、責罰、凌辱的日子，就如婦人將要生產嬰孩，卻沒有力量生產。
verses.e: They said to him , " Hezekiah says , ' Today is a day of trouble , and of rebuke , and of rejection ; for the children have come to the birth , and there is no strength to give birth .

verses.z: 「以色列人哪，我賜你們一個證據：你們今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自長的，至於後年，你們要耕種收割，栽植葡萄園，吃其中的果子。
verses.e: " ' This shall be the sign to you : You will eat this year that which grows of itself , and in the second year that which springs from it ; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards , and eat their fruit .

verses.z: 猶大家所逃脫餘剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上結果。
verses.e: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward , and bear fruit upward .

verses.z: 必有餘剩的民從耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脫的人從錫安山而來。萬軍之耶和華的熱心必成就這事。
verses.e: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out , and survivors will escape from Mount Zion . The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this . '

verses.z: 「所以耶和華論亞述王如此說：他必不得來到這城，也不在這裏射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不築壘攻城。
verses.e: " Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria , ' He will not come to this city , nor shoot an arrow there , neither will he come before it with shield , nor cast up a mound against it .

verses.z: 他從哪條路來，必從那條路回去，必不得來到這城。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: He will return the way that he came , and he won't come to this city , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 因我為自己的緣故，又為我僕人大衛的緣故，必保護拯救這城。」
verses.e: ' For I will defend this city to save it , for my own sake , and for my servant David's sake . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者出去，在亞述營中殺了十八萬五千人。清早有人起來一看，都是死屍了。
verses.e: Then the LORD's angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians . When men arose early in the morning , behold , these were all dead bodies .

verses.z: 亞述王西拿基立就拔營回去，住在尼尼微。
