verses.e: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , went away , returned to Nineveh , and stayed there .

verses.z: 一日在他的神－尼斯洛廟裏叩拜，他兒子亞得米勒和沙利色用刀殺了他，就逃到亞拉臘地。他兒子以撒哈頓接續他作王。
verses.e: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god , Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword ; and they escaped into the land of Ararat . Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place .

verses.z: 或者耶和華－你的上帝聽見拉伯沙基的話，就是他主人亞述王打發他來辱罵永生上帝的話；耶和華－你的上帝聽見這話就發斥責。故此，求你為餘剩的民揚聲禱告。』」
verses.e: It may be the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God , and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard . Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left . ' "

verses.z: 希西家王的臣僕就去見以賽亞。
verses.e: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah .

verses.z: 以賽亞對他們說：「要這樣對你們的主人說，耶和華如此說：『你聽見亞述王的僕人褻瀆我的話，不要懼怕。
verses.e: Isaiah said to them , " Tell your master , ' The LORD says , " Don't be afraid of the words that you have heard , with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .

verses.z: 我必驚動他的心；他要聽見風聲就歸回本地，我必使他在那裏倒在刀下。』」
verses.e: Behold , I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news , and will return to his own land . I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land . " ' "

verses.z: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇見亞述王攻打立拿；原來他早聽見亞述王拔營離開拉吉。
verses.e: So Rabshakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah , for he heard that he had departed from Lachish .

verses.z: 亞述王聽見人論古實王特哈加說：「他出來要與你爭戰。」亞述王一聽見，就打發使者去見希西家，吩咐他們說：
verses.e: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , " He has come out to fight against you . " When he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,

verses.z: 那時希西家病得要死，亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞去見他，對他說：「耶和華如此說：你當留遺命與你的家，因為你必死不能活了。」
verses.e: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death . Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , came to him , and said to him , " The LORD says , ' Set your house in order , for you will die , and not live . ' "

verses.z: 我說：正在我中年之日必進入陰間的門；我餘剩的年歲不得享受。
verses.e: I said , " In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol . I am deprived of the residue of my years . "

verses.z: 我說：我必不得見耶和華，就是在活人之地不見耶和華；我與世上的居民不再見面。
verses.e: I said , " I won't see the LORD , the LORD in the land of the living . I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world .

verses.z: 我的住處被遷去離開我，好像牧人的帳棚一樣；我將性命捲起，像織布的捲布一樣。耶和華必將我從機頭剪斷，從早到晚，他要使我完結。
verses.e: My dwelling is removed , and is carried away from me like a shepherd's tent . I have rolled up my life like a weaver . He will cut me off from the loom . From day even to night you will make an end of me .

verses.z: 我使自己安靜直到天亮；他像獅子折斷我一切的骨頭，從早到晚，他要使我完結。
verses.e: I waited patiently until morning . He breaks all my bones like a lion . From day even to night you will make an end of me .

verses.z: 我像燕子呢喃，像白鶴鳴叫，又像鴿子哀鳴；我因仰觀，眼睛困倦。耶和華啊，我受欺壓，求你為我作保。
verses.e: I chattered like a swallow or a crane . I moaned like a dove . My eyes weaken looking upward . Lord , I am oppressed . Be my security . "

verses.z: 我可說甚麼呢？他應許我的，也給我成就了。我因心裏的苦楚，在一生的年日必悄悄而行。
verses.e: What will I say ? He has both spoken to me , and himself has done it . I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul .

verses.z: 主啊，人得存活乃在乎此。我靈存活也全在此。所以求你使我痊癒，仍然存活。
verses.e: Lord , men live by these things ; and my spirit finds life in all of them . You restore me , and cause me to live .

verses.z: 看哪，我受大苦，本為使我得平安；你因愛我的靈魂便救我脫離敗壞的坑，因為你將我一切的罪扔在你的背後。
verses.e: Behold , for peace I had great anguish , but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption ; for you have cast all my sins behind your back .

verses.z: 原來，陰間不能稱謝你，死亡不能頌揚你；下坑的人不能盼望你的誠實。
verses.e: For Sheol can't praise you . Death can't celebrate you . Those who go down into the pit can't hope for your truth .

verses.z: 只有活人，活人必稱謝你，像我今日稱謝你一樣。為父的，必使兒女知道你的誠實。
verses.e: The living , the living , he shall praise you , as I do today . The father shall make known your truth to the children .

verses.z: 希西家就轉臉朝牆，禱告耶和華說：
verses.e: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD ,

verses.z: 耶和華[肯]救我，所以，我們要一生一世在耶和華殿中用絲弦的樂器唱我的詩歌。
verses.e: The LORD will save me . Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 以賽亞說：「當取一塊無花果餅來，貼在瘡上，王必痊癒。」
verses.e: Now Isaiah had said , " Let them take a cake of figs , and lay it for a poultice on the boil , and he shall recover . "

verses.z: 希西家問說：「我能上耶和華的殿，有甚麼兆頭呢？」
verses.e: Hezekiah also had said , " What is the sign that I will go up to the LORD's house ? "

verses.z: 「耶和華啊，求你記念我在你面前怎樣存完全的心，按誠實行事，又做你眼中所看為善的。」希西家就痛哭了。
verses.e: and said , " Remember now , LORD , I beg you , how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in your sight . " Then Hezekiah wept bitterly .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到以賽亞說：
verses.e: Then the LORD's word came to Isaiah , saying ,

verses.z: 「你去告訴希西家說，耶和華－你祖大衛的上帝如此說：我聽見了你的禱告，看見了你的眼淚。我必加增你十五年的壽數；
verses.e: " Go , and tell Hezekiah , ' The LORD , the God of David your father , says , " I have heard your prayer . I have seen your tears . Behold , I will add fifteen years to your life .

verses.z: 並且我要救你和這城脫離亞述王的手，也要保護這城。
verses.e: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria , and I will defend this city .

verses.z: 「我－耶和華必成就我所說的。我先給你一個兆頭，
verses.e: This shall be the sign to you from the LORD , that the LORD will do this thing that he has spoken .

verses.z: 就是叫亞哈斯的日晷，向前進的日影往後退十度。」於是，前進的日影果然在日晷上往後退了十度。
verses.e: Behold , I will cause the shadow on the sundial , which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun , to return backward ten steps . " ' " So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down .

verses.z: 猶大王希西家患病已經痊癒，就作詩說：
verses.e: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah , when he had been sick , and had recovered of his sickness :

verses.z: 那時，巴比倫王巴拉但的兒子米羅達‧巴拉但聽見希西家病而痊癒，就送書信和禮物給他。
verses.e: At that time , Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present to Hezekiah , for he heard that he had been sick , and had recovered .

verses.z: 希西家喜歡見使者，就把自己寶庫的金子、銀子、香料、貴重的膏油，和他武庫的一切軍器，並所有的財寶都給他們看；他家中和全國之內，希西家沒有一樣不給他們看的。
verses.e: Hezekiah was pleased with them , and showed them the house of his precious things , the silver , the gold , the spices , and the precious oil , and all the house of his armor , and all that was found in his treasures . There was nothing in his house , nor in all his dominion , that Hezekiah didn't show them .

verses.z: 於是先知以賽亞來見希西家王，問他說：「這些人說甚麼？他們從哪裏來見你？」希西家說：「他們從遠方的巴比倫來見我。」
verses.e: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah , and asked him , " What did these men say ? From where did they come to you ? " Hezekiah said , " They have come from a country far from me , even from Babylon . "

verses.z: 以賽亞說：「他們在你家裏看見了甚麼？」希西家說：「凡我家中所有的，他們都看見了；我財寶中沒有一樣不給他們看的。」
verses.e: Then he asked , " What have they seen in your house ? " Hezekiah answered , " They have seen all that is in my house . There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them . "

verses.z: 以賽亞對希西家說：「你要聽萬軍之耶和華的話：
verses.e: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah , " Hear the word of the LORD of Armies :

verses.z: 日子必到，凡你家裏所有的，並你列祖積蓄到如今的，都要被擄到巴比倫去，不留下一樣；這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: ' Behold , the days are coming when all that is in your house , and that which your fathers have stored up until today , will be carried to Babylon . Nothing will be left , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 並且從你本身所生的眾子，其中必有被擄去、在巴比倫王宮裏當太監的。」
verses.e: ' They will take away your sons who will issue from you , whom you shall father , and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon's palace . ' "

verses.z: 希西家對以賽亞說：「你所說耶和華的話甚好，因為在我的年日中必有太平和穩固的景況。」
verses.e: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah , " The LORD's word which you have spoken is good . " He said moreover , " For there will be peace and truth in my days . "

verses.z: 在那日，七個女人必拉住一個男人，說：「我們吃自己的食物，穿自己的衣服，但求你許我們歸你名下；求你除掉我們的羞恥。」
verses.e: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day , saying , " We will eat our own bread , and wear our own clothing . Just let us be called by your name . Take away our reproach . "

verses.z: 到那日，耶和華發生的苗必華美尊榮，地的出產必為以色列逃脫的人顯為榮華茂盛。
verses.e: In that day , the LORD's branch will be beautiful and glorious , and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel .

verses.z: 主以公義的靈和焚燒的靈，將錫安女子的污穢洗去，又將耶路撒冷中[殺人]的血除淨。那時，剩在錫安、留在耶路撒冷的，就是一切住耶路撒冷、在生命冊上記名的，必稱為聖。
verses.e: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy , even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem ,
when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion , and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it , by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning .

verses.z: 耶和華也必在錫安全山，並各會眾以上，使白日有煙雲，黑夜有火焰的光。因為在全榮耀之上必有遮蔽。
verses.e: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies , a cloud and smoke by day , and the shining of a flaming fire by night , for over all the glory will be a canopy .

verses.z: 必有亭子，白日可以得蔭避暑，也可以作為藏身之處，躲避狂風暴雨。
verses.e: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat , and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain .

verses.z: 你們的上帝說：你們要安慰，安慰我的百姓。
verses.e: " Comfort , comfort my people , " says your God .

verses.z: 主耶和華必像大能者臨到；他的膀臂必為他掌權。他的賞賜在他那裏；他的報應在他面前。
verses.e: Behold , the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one , and his arm will rule for him . Behold , his reward is with him , and his recompense before him .

verses.z: 他必像牧人牧養自己的羊群，用膀臂聚集羊羔抱在懷中，慢慢引導那乳養小羊的。
verses.e: He will feed his flock like a shepherd . He will gather the lambs in his arm , and carry them in his bosom . He will gently lead those who have their young .

verses.z: 誰曾用手心量諸水，用手虎口量蒼天，用升斗盛大地的塵土，用秤稱山嶺，用天平平岡陵呢？
verses.e: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand , and marked off the sky with his span , and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket , and weighed the mountains in scales , and the hills in a balance ?

verses.z: 誰曾測度耶和華的心，或作他的謀士指教他呢？
verses.e: Who has directed the LORD's Spirit , or has taught him as his counselor ?

verses.z: 他與誰商議，誰教導他，誰將公平的路指示他，又將知識教訓他，將通達的道指教他呢？
verses.e: Who did he take counsel with , and who instructed him , and taught him in the path of justice , and taught him knowledge , and showed him the way of understanding ?

verses.z: 看哪，萬民都像水桶的一滴，又算如天平上的微塵；他舉起眾海島，好像極微之物。
verses.e: Behold , the nations are like a drop in a bucket , and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance . Behold , he lifts up the islands like a very little thing .

verses.z: 黎巴嫩[的樹林]不夠當柴燒；其中的走獸也不夠作燔祭。
verses.e: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn , nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering .

verses.z: 萬民在他面前好像虛無，被他看為不及虛無，乃為虛空。
verses.e: All the nations are like nothing before him . They are regarded by him as less than nothing , and vanity .

verses.z: 你們究竟將誰比上帝，用甚麼形像與上帝比較呢？
verses.e: To whom then will you liken God ? Or what likeness will you compare to him ?

verses.z: 偶像是匠人鑄造，銀匠用金包裹，[為它]鑄造銀鍊。
verses.e: A workman has cast an image , and the goldsmith overlays it with gold , and casts silver chains for it .

verses.z: 要對耶路撒冷說安慰的話，又向她宣告[說]，她爭戰的日子已滿了；她的罪孽赦免了；她為自己的一切罪，從耶和華手中加倍受罰。
verses.e: " Speak comfortably to Jerusalem , and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished , that her iniquity is pardoned , that she has received of the LORD's hand double for all her sins . "

verses.z: 窮乏獻不起[這樣]供物的，就揀選不能朽壞的樹木，為自己尋找巧匠，立起不能搖動的偶像。
verses.e: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot . He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved .

verses.z: 你們豈不曾知道嗎？你們豈不曾聽見嗎？從起初豈沒有人告訴你們嗎？自從立地的根基，你們豈沒有明白嗎？
verses.e: Haven't you known ? Haven't you heard ? Haven't you been told from the beginning ? Haven't you understood from the foundations of the earth ?

verses.z: 上帝坐在地球大圈之上；地上的居民好像蝗蟲。他鋪張穹蒼如幔子，展開諸天如可住的帳棚。
verses.e: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth , and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers ; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain , and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in ,

verses.z: 他使君王歸於虛無，使地上的審判官成為虛空。
verses.e: who brings princes to nothing , who makes the judges of the earth meaningless .

verses.z: 他們是剛才栽上，剛才種上，根也剛才扎在地裏，他一吹在其上，便都枯乾；旋風將他們吹去，像碎稭一樣。
verses.e: They are planted scarcely . They are sown scarcely . Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground . He merely blows on them , and they wither , and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble .

verses.z: 那聖者說：你們將誰比我，叫他與我相等呢？
verses.e: " To whom then will you liken me ? Who is my equal ? " says the Holy One .

verses.z: 你們向上舉目，看誰創造這萬象，按數目領出，他一一稱其名；因他的權能，又因他的大能大力，連一個都不缺。
verses.e: Lift up your eyes on high , and see who has created these , who brings out their army by number . He calls them all by name . By the greatness of his might , and because he is strong in power , not one is lacking .

verses.z: 雅各啊，你為何說，我的道路向耶和華隱藏？以色列啊，你為何言，我的冤屈上帝並不查問？
verses.e: Why do you say , Jacob , and speak , Israel , " My way is hidden from the LORD , and the justice due me is disregarded by my God " ?

verses.z: 你豈不曾知道嗎？你豈不曾聽見嗎？永在的上帝耶和華，創造地極的[主]，並不疲乏，也不困倦；他的智慧無法測度。
verses.e: Haven't you known ? Haven't you heard ? The everlasting God , the LORD , the Creator of the ends of the earth , doesn't faint . He isn't weary . His understanding is unsearchable .

verses.z: 疲乏的，他賜能力；軟弱的，他加力量。
verses.e: He gives power to the weak . He increases the strength of him who has no might .

verses.z: 有人聲喊着說：在曠野預備耶和華的路，在沙漠地修平我們上帝的道。
verses.e: The voice of one who calls out , " Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness ! Make a level highway in the desert for our God .

verses.z: 就是少年人也要疲乏困倦；強壯的也必全然跌倒。
verses.e: Even the youths faint and get weary , and the young men utterly fall ;

verses.z: 但那等候耶和華的必重新得力。他們必如鷹展翅上騰；他們奔跑卻不困倦，行走卻不疲乏。
verses.e: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength . They will mount up with wings like eagles . They will run , and not be weary . They will walk , and not faint .

verses.z: 一切山窪都要填滿，大小山岡都要削平；高高低低的要改為平坦，崎崎嶇嶇的必成為平原。
verses.e: Every valley shall be exalted , and every mountain and hill shall be made low . The uneven shall be made level , and the rough places a plain .

verses.z: 耶和華的榮耀必然顯現；凡有血氣的必一同看見；因為這是耶和華親口說的。
verses.e: The LORD's glory shall be revealed , and all flesh shall see it together ; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it . "

verses.z: 有人聲說：你喊叫吧！有一個說：我喊叫甚麼呢？[說]：凡有血氣的盡都如草；他的美容都像野地的花。
verses.e: The voice of one saying , " Cry out ! " One said , " What shall I cry ? " " All flesh is like grass , and all its glory is like the flower of the field .

verses.z: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘，因為耶和華的氣吹在其上；百姓誠然是草。
verses.e: The grass withers , the flower fades , because the LORD's breath blows on it . Surely the people are like grass .

verses.z: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘，惟有我們上帝的話必永遠立定。
verses.e: The grass withers , the flower fades ; but the word of our God stands forever . "

verses.z: 報好信息給錫安的啊，你要登高山；報好信息給耶路撒冷的啊，你要極力揚聲。揚聲不要懼怕，對猶大的城邑說：看哪，你們的上帝！
verses.e: You who tell good news to Zion , go up on a high mountain . You who tell good news to Jerusalem , lift up your voice with strength ! Lift it up ! Don't be afraid ! Say to the cities of Judah , " Behold , your God ! "

verses.z: 眾海島啊，當在我面前靜默；眾民當重新得力，都要近前來才可以說話，我們可以彼此辯論。
verses.e: " Keep silent before me , islands , and let the peoples renew their strength . Let them come near , then let them speak . Let's meet together for judgment .

verses.z: 你不要害怕，因為我與你同在；不要驚惶，因為我是你的上帝。我必堅固你，我必幫助你；我必用我公義的右手扶持你。
verses.e: Don't you be afraid , for I am with you . Don't be dismayed , for I am your God . I will strengthen you . Yes , I will help you . Yes , I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness .

verses.z: 凡向你發怒的必都抱愧蒙羞；與你相爭的必如無有，並要滅亡。
verses.e: Behold , all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded . Those who strive with you will be like nothing , and shall perish .

verses.z: 與你爭競的，你要找他們也找不着；與你爭戰的必如無有，成為虛無。
verses.e: You will seek them , and won't find them , even those who contend with you . Those who war against you will be as nothing , as a nonexistent thing .

verses.z: 因為我耶和華－你的上帝必攙扶你的右手，對你說：不要害怕！我必幫助你。
verses.e: For I , the LORD your God , will hold your right hand , saying to you , ' Don't be afraid . I will help you . '

verses.z: 你這蟲雅各和你們以色列人，不要害怕！耶和華說：我必幫助你。你的救贖主就是以色列的聖者。
verses.e: Don't be afraid , you worm Jacob , and you men of Israel . I will help you , " says the LORD . " Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 看哪，我已使你成為有快齒打糧的新器具；你要把山嶺打得粉碎，使岡陵如同糠詷。
verses.e: Behold , I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth . You will thresh the mountains , and beat them small , and will make the hills like chaff .

verses.z: 你要把它簸揚，風要吹去；旋風要把它颳散。你倒要以耶和華為喜樂，以以色列的聖者為誇耀。
verses.e: You will winnow them , and the wind will carry them away , and the whirlwind will scatter them . You will rejoice in the LORD . You will glory in the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 困苦窮乏人尋求水卻沒有；他們因口渴，舌頭乾燥。我－耶和華必應允他們；我－以色列的上帝必不離棄他們。
verses.e: The poor and needy seek water , and there is none . Their tongue fails for thirst . I , the LORD , will answer them . I , the God of Israel , will not forsake them .

verses.z: 我要在淨光的高處開江河，在谷中開泉源；我要使沙漠變為水池，使乾地變為湧泉。
verses.e: I will open rivers on the bare heights , and springs in the middle of the valleys . I will make the wilderness a pool of water , and the dry land springs of water .

verses.z: 我要在曠野種上香柏樹、皂莢樹、番石榴樹，和野橄欖樹。我在沙漠要把松樹、杉樹，並黃楊樹一同栽植；
verses.e: I will put cedar , acacia , myrtle , and oil trees in the wilderness . I will set cypress trees , pine , and box trees together in the desert ;

verses.z: 誰從東方興起一人，憑公義召他來到腳前呢？耶和華將列國交給他，使他管轄君王，把他們如灰塵交與他的刀，如風吹的碎稭交與他的弓。
verses.e: Who has raised up one from the east ? Who called him to his feet in righteousness ? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings . He gives them like the dust to his sword , like the driven stubble to his bow .

verses.z: 好叫人看見、知道、思想、明白；這是耶和華的手所做的，是以色列的聖者所造的。
verses.e: that they may see , know , consider , and understand together , that the LORD's hand has done this , and the Holy One of Israel has created it .

verses.z: 耶和華[對假神]說：你們要呈上你們的案件；雅各的君說：你們要聲明你們確實的理由。
verses.e: Produce your cause , " says the LORD . " Bring out your strong reasons ! " says the King of Jacob .

verses.z: 可以聲明，指示我們將來必遇的事，說明先前的是甚麼事，好叫我們思索，得知事的結局，或者把將來的事指示我們。
verses.e: " Let them announce and declare to us what will happen ! Declare the former things , what they are , that we may consider them , and know the latter end of them ; or show us things to come .

verses.z: 要說明後來的事，好叫我們知道你們是神。你們或降福，或降禍，使我們驚奇，一同觀看。
verses.e: Declare the things that are to come hereafter , that we may know that you are gods . Yes , do good , or do evil , that we may be dismayed , and see it together .

verses.z: 看哪，你們屬乎虛無；你們的作為也屬乎虛空。那選擇你們的是可憎惡的。
verses.e: Behold , you are nothing , and your work is nothing . He who chooses you is an abomination .

verses.z: 我從北方興起一人；他是求告我名的，從日出之地而來。他必臨到掌權的，好像臨到灰泥，彷彿窯匠踹泥一樣。
verses.e: " I have raised up one from the north , and he has come , from the rising of the sun , one who calls on my name , and he shall come on rulers as on mortar , and as the potter treads clay .

verses.z: 誰從起初指明這事，使我們知道呢？誰從先前說明，使我們說[他]不錯呢？誰也沒有指明；誰也沒有說明；誰也沒有聽見你們的話。
verses.e: Who has declared it from the beginning , that we may know ? and before , that we may say , ' He is right ' ? Surely , there is no one who declares . Surely , there is no one who shows . Surely , there is no one who hears your words .

verses.z: 我首先對錫安[說]：看哪，我要將一位報好信息的賜給耶路撒冷。
verses.e: I am the first to say to Zion , ' Behold , look at them ; ' and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 我看的時候並沒有人；我問的時候，他們中間也沒有謀士可以回答一句。
verses.e: When I look , there is no man , even among them there is no counselor who , when I ask , can answer a word .

verses.z: 看哪，他們和他們的工作都是虛空，且是虛無。他們所鑄的偶像都是風，都是虛的。
verses.e: Behold , all of their deeds are vanity and nothing . Their molten images are wind and confusion .

verses.z: 他追趕他們，走他所未走的道，坦然前行。
verses.e: He pursues them and passes by safely , even by a way that he had not gone with his feet .

verses.z: 誰行做成就這事，從起初宣召歷代呢？就是我－耶和華！我是首先的，也與末後的同在。
verses.e: Who has worked and done it , calling the generations from the beginning ? I , the LORD , the first , and with the last , I am he . "

verses.z: 海島看見就都害怕；地極也都戰兢，就近前來。
verses.e: The islands have seen , and fear . The ends of the earth tremble . They approach , and come .

verses.z: 他們各人幫助鄰舍，[各人]對弟兄說：壯膽吧！
verses.e: Everyone helps his neighbor . They say to their brothers , " Be strong ! "

verses.z: 木匠勉勵銀匠，用鎚打光的勉勵打砧的，論銲工說，銲得好；又用釘子釘穩，免得[偶像]動搖。
verses.e: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith . He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil , saying of the soldering , " It is good ; " and he fastens it with nails , that it might not totter .

verses.z: 惟你以色列－我的僕人，雅各－我所揀選的，我朋友亞伯拉罕的後裔，
verses.e: " But you , Israel , my servant , Jacob whom I have chosen , the offspring of Abraham my friend ,

verses.z: 你是我從地極所領來的，從地角所召來的，且對你說：你是我的僕人；我揀選你，並不棄絕你。
verses.e: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth , and called from its corners , and said to you , ' You are my servant . I have chosen you and have not cast you away . '

verses.z: 看哪，我的僕人－我所扶持所揀選、心裏所喜悅的！我已將我的靈賜給他；他必將公理傳給外邦。
verses.e: " Behold , my servant , whom I uphold , my chosen , in whom my soul delights : I have put my Spirit on him . He will bring justice to the nations .

verses.z: 航海的和海中所有的，海島和其上的居民，都當向耶和華唱新歌，從地極讚美他。
verses.e: Sing to the LORD a new song , and his praise from the end of the earth , you who go down to the sea , and all that is therein , the islands and their inhabitants .

verses.z: 曠野和其中的城邑，並基達人居住的村莊都當揚聲；西拉的居民當歡呼，在山頂上吶喊。
verses.e: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices , with the villages that Kedar inhabits . Let the inhabitants of Sela sing . Let them shout from the top of the mountains !

verses.z: 他們當將榮耀歸給耶和華，在海島中傳揚他的頌讚。
verses.e: Let them give glory to the LORD , and declare his praise in the islands .

verses.z: 耶和華必像勇士出去，必像戰士激動熱心，要喊叫，大聲吶喊，要用大力攻擊仇敵。
verses.e: The LORD will go out like a mighty man . He will stir up zeal like a man of war . He will raise a war cry . Yes , he will shout aloud . He will triumph over his enemies .

verses.z: 我許久閉口不言，靜默不語；[現在]我要喊叫，像產難的婦人；我要急氣而喘哮。
verses.e: " I have been silent a long time . I have been quiet and restrained myself . Now I will cry out like a travailing woman . I will both gasp and pant .

verses.z: 我要使大山小岡變為荒場，使其上的花草都枯乾；我要使江河變為洲島，使水池都乾涸。
verses.e: I will destroy mountains and hills , and dry up all their herbs . I will make the rivers islands , and will dry up the pools .

verses.z: 我要引瞎子行不認識的道，領他們走不知道的路；在他們面前使黑暗變為光明，使彎曲變為平直。這些事我都要行，並不離棄他們。
verses.e: I will bring the blind by a way that they don't know . I will lead them in paths that they don't know . I will make darkness light before them , and crooked places straight . I will do these things , and I will not forsake them .

verses.z: 倚靠雕刻的偶像，對鑄造的偶像說：你是我們的神；這等人要退後，全然蒙羞。
verses.e: " Those who trust in engraved images , who tell molten images , ' You are our gods , ' will be turned back . They will be utterly disappointed .

verses.z: 你們這耳聾的，聽吧！你們這眼瞎的，看吧！使你們能看見。
verses.e: " Hear , you deaf , and look , you blind , that you may see .

verses.z: 誰比我的僕人眼瞎呢？誰比我差遣的使者耳聾呢？誰瞎眼像那[與我]和好的？誰瞎眼像耶和華的僕人呢？
verses.e: Who is blind , but my servant ? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send ? Who is as blind as he who is at peace , and as blind as the LORD's servant ?

verses.z: 他不喧嚷，不揚聲，也不使街上聽見他的聲音。
verses.e: He will not shout , nor raise his voice , nor cause it to be heard in the street .

verses.z: 你看見許多事卻不領會，耳朵開通卻不聽見。
verses.e: You see many things , but don't observe . His ears are open , but he doesn't listen .

verses.z: 耶和華因自己公義的緣故，喜歡使律法為大，為尊。
verses.e: It pleased the LORD , for his righteousness ' sake , to magnify the law and make it honorable .

verses.z: 但這百姓是被搶被奪的，都牢籠在坑中，隱藏在獄裏；他們作掠物，無人拯救，作擄物，無人說交還。
verses.e: But this is a robbed and plundered people . All of them are snared in holes , and they are hidden in prisons . They have become captives , and no one delivers , and a plunder , and no one says , ' Restore them ! '

verses.z: 你們中間誰肯側耳聽此，誰肯留心而聽，以防將來呢？
verses.e: Who is there among you who will give ear to this ? Who will listen and hear for the time to come ?

verses.z: 誰將雅各交出當作擄物，將以色列交給搶奪的呢？豈不是耶和華嗎？就是我們所得罪的那位。他們不肯遵行他的道，也不聽從他的訓誨。
verses.e: Who gave Jacob as plunder , and Israel to the robbers ? Didn't the LORD , he against whom we have sinned ? For they would not walk in his ways , and they disobeyed his law .

verses.z: 所以，他將猛烈的怒氣和爭戰的勇力傾倒在以色列的身上。在他四圍如火着起，他還不知道，燒着他，他也不介意。
verses.e: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him , and the strength of battle . It set him on fire all around , but he didn't know . It burned him , but he didn't take it to heart . "

verses.z: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷；將殘的燈火，他不吹滅。他憑真實將公理傳開。
verses.e: He won't break a bruised reed . He won't quench a dimly burning wick . He will faithfully bring justice .

verses.z: 他不灰心，也不喪膽，直到他在地上設立公理；海島都等候他的訓誨。
verses.e: He will not fail nor be discouraged , until he has set justice in the earth , and the islands wait for his law . "

verses.z: 創造諸天，鋪張穹蒼，將地和地所出的一併鋪開，賜氣息給地上的眾人，又賜靈性給行在其上之人的上帝耶和華，他如此說：
verses.e: God the LORD , he who created the heavens and stretched them out , he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it , he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it , says :

verses.z: 我－耶和華憑公義召你，必攙扶你的手，保守你，使你作眾民的中保，作外邦人的光，
verses.e: " I , the LORD , have called you in righteousness . I will hold your hand . I will keep you , and make you a covenant for the people , as a light for the nations ,

verses.z: 開瞎子的眼，領被囚的出牢獄，領坐黑暗的出監牢。
verses.e: to open the blind eyes , to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon , and those who sit in darkness out of the prison .

verses.z: 我是耶和華，這是我的名；我必不將我的榮耀歸給假神，也不將我的稱讚歸給雕刻的偶像。
verses.e: " I am the LORD . That is my name . I will not give my glory to another , nor my praise to engraved images .

verses.z: 看哪，先前的事已經成就，現在我將新事說明，這事未發以先，我就說給你們聽。
verses.e: Behold , the former things have happened and I declare new things . I tell you about them before they come up . "

verses.z: 雅各啊，創造你的耶和華，以色列啊，造成你的那位，現在如此說：你不要害怕！因為我救贖了你。我曾提你的名召你，你是屬我的。
verses.e: But now the LORD who created you , Jacob , and he who formed you , Israel , says : " Don't be afraid , for I have redeemed you . I have called you by your name . You are mine .

verses.z: 耶和華說：你們是我的見證，我所揀選的僕人。既是這樣，便可以知道，且信服我，又明白我就是耶和華。在我以前沒有真神；在我以後也必沒有。
verses.e: " You are my witnesses , " says the LORD , " With my servant whom I have chosen ; that you may know and believe me , and understand that I am he . Before me there was no God formed , neither will there be after me .

verses.z: 惟有我是耶和華；除我以外沒有救主。
verses.e: I myself am the LORD . Besides me , there is no savior .

verses.z: 我曾指示，我曾拯救，我曾說明，並且在你們中間沒有別神。所以耶和華說：你們是我的見證。我也是上帝；
verses.e: I have declared , I have saved , and I have shown , and there was no strange god among you . Therefore you are my witnesses " , says the LORD , " and I am God .

verses.z: 自從有日子以來，我就是上帝；誰也不能救人脫離我手。我要行事誰能阻止呢？
verses.e: Yes , since the day was , I am he . There is no one who can deliver out of my hand . I will work , and who can hinder it ? "

verses.z: 耶和華－你們的救贖主、以色列的聖者如此說：因你們的緣故，我已經打發人到巴比倫去；並且我要使迦勒底人如逃民，都坐自己喜樂的船下來。
verses.e: The LORD , your Redeemer , the Holy One of Israel says : " For your sake , I have sent to Babylon , and I will bring all of them down as fugitives , even the Chaldeans , in the ships of their rejoicing .

verses.z: 我是耶和華－你們的聖者，是創造以色列的，是你們的君王。
verses.e: I am the LORD , your Holy One , the Creator of Israel , your King . "

verses.z: 耶和華在滄海中開道，在大水中開路，
verses.e: The LORD , who makes a way in the sea , and a path in the mighty waters ,

verses.z: 使車輛、馬匹、軍兵、勇士都出來，一同躺下，不再起來；他們滅沒，好像熄滅的燈火。
verses.e: who brings out the chariot and horse , the army and the mighty man ( they lie down together , they shall not rise ; they are extinct , they are quenched like a wick ) says :

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你們不要記念從前的事，也不要思想古時的事。
verses.e: " Don't remember the former things , and don't consider the things of old .

verses.z: 看哪，我要做一件新事；如今要發現，你們豈不知道嗎？我必在曠野開道路，在沙漠開江河。
verses.e: Behold , I will do a new thing . It springs out now . Don't you know it ? I will even make a way in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert .

verses.z: 你從水中經過，我必與你同在；你詵過江河，水必不漫過你；你從火中行過，必不被燒，火焰也不着在你身上。
verses.e: When you pass through the waters , I will be with you , and through the rivers , they will not overflow you . When you walk through the fire , you will not be burned , and flame will not scorch you .

verses.z: 野地的走獸必尊重我；野狗和鴕鳥也必如此。因我使曠野有水，使沙漠有河，好賜給我的百姓、我的選民喝。
verses.e: The animals of the field , the jackals and the ostriches , shall honor me , because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen ,

verses.z: 這百姓是我為自己所造的，好述說我的美德。
verses.e: the people which I formed for myself , that they might declare my praise .

verses.z: 雅各啊，你並沒有求告我；以色列啊，你倒厭煩我。
verses.e: Yet you have not called on me , Jacob ; but you have been weary of me , Israel .

verses.z: 你沒有將你的羊帶來給我作燔祭，也沒有用祭物尊敬我；我沒有因供物使你服勞，也沒有因乳香使你厭煩。
verses.e: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings , neither have you honored me with your sacrifices . I have not burdened you with offerings , nor wearied you with frankincense .

verses.z: 你沒有用銀子為我買菖蒲，也沒有用祭物的脂油使我飽足；倒使我因你的罪惡服勞，使我因你的罪孽厭煩。
verses.e: You have bought me no sweet cane with money , nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices , but you have burdened me with your sins . You have wearied me with your iniquities .

verses.z: 惟有我為自己的緣故塗抹你的過犯；我也不記念你的罪惡。
verses.e: I , even I , am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake ; and I will not remember your sins .

verses.z: 你要提醒我，你我可以一同辯論；你可以將[你的理]陳明，自顯為義。
verses.e: Put me in remembrance . Let us plead together . Declare your case , that you may be justified .

verses.z: 你的始祖犯罪；你的師傅違背我。
verses.e: Your first father sinned , and your teachers have transgressed against me .

verses.z: 所以，我要辱沒聖所的首領，使雅各成為咒詛，使以色列成為辱罵。
verses.e: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary ; and I will make Jacob a curse , and Israel an insult . "

verses.z: 因為我是耶和華－你的上帝，是以色列的聖者－你的救主；我已經使埃及作你的贖價，使古實和西巴代替你。
verses.e: For I am the LORD your God , the Holy One of Israel , your Savior . I have given Egypt as your ransom , Ethiopia and Seba in your place .

verses.z: 因我看你為寶為尊；又因我愛你，所以我使人代替你，使列邦人替換你的生命。
verses.e: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight , and I have loved you , therefore I will give people in your place , and nations instead of your life .

verses.z: 不要害怕，因我與你同在；我必領你的後裔從東方來，又從西方招聚你。
verses.e: Don't be afraid , for I am with you . I will bring your offspring from the east , and gather you from the west .

verses.z: 我要對北方說，交出來！對南方說，不要拘留！將我的眾子從遠方帶來，將我的眾女從地極領回，
verses.e: I will tell the north , ' Give them up ! ' and tell the south , ' Don't hold them back ! Bring my sons from far away , and my daughters from the ends of the earth —

verses.z: 就是凡稱為我名下的人，是我為自己的榮耀創造的，是我所做成，所造作的。
verses.e: everyone who is called by my name , and whom I have created for my glory , whom I have formed , yes , whom I have made . ' "

verses.z: 你要將有眼而瞎、有耳而聾的民都帶出來！
verses.e: Bring out the blind people who have eyes , and the deaf who have ears .

verses.z: 任憑萬國聚集；任憑眾民會合。其中誰能將此聲明，並將先前的事說給我們聽呢？他們可以帶出見證來，自顯為是；或者他們聽見便說：這是真的。
verses.e: Let all the nations be gathered together , and let the peoples be assembled . Who among them can declare this , and show us former things ? Let them bring their witnesses , that they may be justified , or let them hear , and say , " That is true . "

verses.z: 我的僕人雅各，我所揀選的以色列啊，現在你當聽。
verses.e: Yet listen now , Jacob my servant , and Israel , whom I have chosen .

verses.z: 誰製造神像，鑄造無益的偶像？
verses.e: Who has fashioned a god , or molds an image that is profitable for nothing ?

verses.z: 看哪，他的同伴都必羞愧。工匠也不過是人，任他們聚會，任他們站立，都必懼怕，一同羞愧。
verses.e: Behold , all his fellows will be disappointed ; and the workmen are mere men . Let them all be gathered together . Let them stand up . They will fear . They will be put to shame together .

verses.z: 鐵匠把鐵在火炭中燒熱，用鎚打鐵器，用他有力的膀臂錘成；他飢餓而無力，不喝水而發倦。
verses.e: The blacksmith takes an ax , works in the coals , fashions it with hammers , and works it with his strong arm . He is hungry , and his strength fails ; he drinks no water , and is faint .

verses.z: 木匠拉線，用筆劃出樣子，用鉋子鉋成形狀，用圓尺劃了模樣，仿照人的體態，做成人形，好住在房屋中。
verses.e: The carpenter stretches out a line . He marks it out with a pencil . He shapes it with planes . He marks it out with compasses , and shapes it like the figure of a man , with the beauty of a man , to reside in a house .

verses.z: 他砍伐香柏樹，又取柞樹和橡樹，在樹林中選定了一棵。他栽種松樹，得雨長養。
verses.e: He cuts down cedars for himself , and takes the cypress and the oak , and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest . He plants a cypress tree , and the rain nourishes it .

verses.z: 這樹，人可用以燒火；他自己取些烤火，又燒着烤餅，而且做神像跪拜，做雕刻的偶像向它叩拜。
verses.e: Then it will be for a man to burn ; and he takes some of it and warms himself . Yes , he burns it and bakes bread . Yes , he makes a god and worships it ; he makes it a carved image , and falls down to it .

verses.z: 他把一分燒在火中，把一分烤肉吃飽。自己烤火說：「啊哈，我暖和了，我見火了。」
verses.e: He burns part of it in the fire . With part of it , he eats meat . He roasts a roast and is satisfied . Yes , he warms himself and says , " Aha ! I am warm . I have seen the fire . "

verses.z: 他用剩下的做了一神，就是雕刻的偶像。他向這偶像俯伏叩拜，禱告它說：「求你拯救我，因你是我的神。」
verses.e: The rest of it he makes into a god , even his engraved image . He bows down to it and worships , and prays to it , and says , " Deliver me , for you are my god ! "

verses.z: 他們不知道，也不思想；因為耶和華閉住他們的眼，不能看見，塞住他們的心，不能明白。
verses.e: They don't know , neither do they consider , for he has shut their eyes , that they can't see , and their hearts , that they can't understand .

verses.z: 誰心裏也不醒悟，也沒有知識，沒有聰明，能說：「我曾拿一分在火中燒了，在炭火上烤過餅；我也烤過肉吃。這剩下的，我豈要做可憎的物嗎？我豈可向木墩子叩拜呢？」
verses.e: No one thinks , neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say , " I have burned part of it in the fire . Yes , I have also baked bread on its coals . I have roasted meat and eaten it . Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination ? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk ? "

verses.z: 造作你，又從你出胎造就你，並要幫助你的耶和華如此說：我的僕人雅各，我所揀選的耶書崙哪，不要害怕！
verses.e: This is what the LORD who made you , and formed you from the womb , who will help you says : " Don't be afraid , Jacob my servant ; and you , Jeshurun , whom I have chosen .

verses.z: 他以灰為食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能說：「我右手中豈不是有虛謊嗎？」
verses.e: He feeds on ashes . A deceived heart has turned him aside ; and he can't deliver his soul , nor say , " Isn't there a lie in my right hand ? "

verses.z: 雅各，以色列啊，你是我的僕人，要記念這些事。以色列啊，你是我的僕人，我造就你必不忘記你。
verses.e: Remember these things , Jacob and Israel , for you are my servant . I have formed you . You are my servant . Israel , you will not be forgotten by me .

verses.z: 我塗抹了你的過犯，像厚雲[消散]；我塗抹了你的罪惡，如薄雲[滅沒]。你當歸向我，因我救贖了你。
verses.e: I have blotted out , as a thick cloud , your transgressions , and , as a cloud , your sins . Return to me , for I have redeemed you .

verses.z: 諸天哪，應當歌唱，因為耶和華做成這事。地的深處啊，應當歡呼；眾山應當發聲歌唱；樹林和其中所有的樹都當如此！因為耶和華救贖了雅各，並要因以色列榮耀自己。
verses.e: Sing , you heavens , for the LORD has done it ! Shout , you lower parts of the earth ! Break out into singing , you mountains , O forest , all of your trees , for the LORD has redeemed Jacob , and will glorify himself in Israel .

verses.z: 從你出胎，造就你的救贖主－耶和華如此說：我－耶和華是創造萬物的，是獨自鋪張諸天、鋪開大地的。誰與我同在呢？
verses.e: The LORD , your Redeemer , and he who formed you from the womb says : " I am the LORD , who makes all things ; who alone stretches out the heavens ; who spreads out the earth by myself ;

verses.z: 使說假話的兆頭失效，使占卜的癲狂，使智慧人退後，使他的知識變為愚拙；
verses.e: who frustrates the signs of the liars , and makes diviners mad ; who turns wise men backward , and makes their knowledge foolish ;

verses.z: 使我僕人的話語立定，我使者的謀算成就。論到耶路撒冷說：必有人居住；論到猶大的城邑說：必被建造，其中的荒場我也必興起。
verses.e: who confirms the word of his servant , and performs the counsel of his messengers ; who says of Jerusalem , ' She will be inhabited ; ' and of the cities of Judah , ' They will be built , ' and ' I will raise up its waste places ; '

verses.z: 對深淵說：你乾了吧！我也要使你的江河乾涸。
verses.e: who says to the deep , ' Be dry , ' and ' I will dry up your rivers , '

verses.z: 論塞魯士說：[他是]我的牧人，必成就我所喜悅的，必下令建造耶路撒冷，發命立穩聖殿的根基。
verses.e: who says of Cyrus , ' He is my shepherd , and shall perform all my pleasure , ' even saying of Jerusalem , ' She will be built ; ' and of the temple , ' Your foundation will be laid . ' "

verses.z: 因為我要將水澆灌口渴的人，將河澆灌乾旱之地。我要將我的靈澆灌你的後裔，將我的福澆灌你的子孫。
verses.e: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty , and streams on the dry ground . I will pour my Spirit on your descendants , and my blessing on your offspring ;

verses.z: 他們要發生在草中，像溪水旁的柳樹。
verses.e: and they will spring up among the grass , as willows by the watercourses .

verses.z: 這個要說：我是屬耶和華的；那個要以雅各的名自稱；又一個要親手寫：歸耶和華的，並自稱為以色列。
verses.e: One will say , ' I am the LORD's . ' Another will be called by the name of Jacob ; and another will write with his hand ' to the LORD , ' and honor the name of Israel . "

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的君，以色列的救贖主－萬軍之耶和華如此說：我是首先的，我是末後的；除我以外再沒有[真]神。
verses.e: This is what the LORD , the King of Israel , and his Redeemer , the LORD of Armies , says : " I am the first , and I am the last ; and besides me there is no God .

verses.z: 自從我設立古時的民，誰能像我宣告，並且指明，又為自己陳說呢？讓他將未來的事和必成的事說明。
verses.e: Who is like me ? Who will call , and will declare it , and set it in order for me , since I established the ancient people ? Let them declare the things that are coming , and that will happen .

verses.z: 你們不要恐懼，也不要害怕。我豈不是從上古就說明指示你們嗎？並且你們是我的見證！除我以外，豈有[真]神嗎？誠然沒有磐石，我不知道一個！
verses.e: Don't fear , neither be afraid . Haven't I declared it to you long ago , and shown it ? You are my witnesses . Is there a God besides me ? Indeed , there is not . I don't know any other Rock . "

verses.z: 製造雕刻偶像的盡都虛空；他們所喜悅的都無益處；他們的見證無所看見，無所知曉，他們便覺羞愧。
verses.e: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain . The things that they delight in will not profit . Their own witnesses don't see , nor know , that they may be disappointed .

verses.z: 我－耶和華所膏的塞魯士；我攙扶他的右手，使列國降伏在他面前。我也要放鬆列王的腰帶，使城門在他面前敞開，不得關閉。我對他如此說：
verses.e: The LORD says to his anointed , to Cyrus , whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor , to open the doors before him , and the gates shall not be shut :

verses.z: 禍哉，那對父親說：你生的是甚麼呢？或對母親說：你產的是甚麼呢？
verses.e: Woe to him who says to a father , ' What have you become the father of ? ' or to a mother , ' What have you given birth to ? ' "

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的聖者，就是造就以色列的如此說：將來的事，你們可以問我；至於我的眾子，並我手的工作，你們可以求我命定。
verses.e: The LORD , the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says : " You ask me about the things that are to come , concerning my sons , and you command me concerning the work of my hands !

verses.z: 我造地，又造人在地上。我親手鋪張諸天；天上萬象也是我所命定的。
verses.e: I have made the earth , and created man on it . I , even my hands , have stretched out the heavens . I have commanded all their army .

verses.z: 我憑公義興起塞魯士，又要修直他一切道路。他必建造我的城，釋放我被擄的民；不是為工價，也不是為賞賜。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: I have raised him up in righteousness , and I will make all his ways straight . He shall build my city , and he shall let my exiles go free , not for price nor reward , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：埃及勞碌得來的和古實的貨物必歸你；身量高大的西巴人必投降你，也要屬你。他們必帶着鎖鍊過來隨從你，又向你下拜，祈求你[說]：上帝真在你們中間，此外再沒有別神；再沒有別的上帝。
verses.e: The LORD says : " The labor of Egypt , and the merchandise of Ethiopia , and the Sabeans , men of stature , will come over to you , and they will be yours . They will go after you . They shall come over in chains . They will bow down to you . They will make supplication to you : ' Surely God is in you ; and there is no one else . There is no other god .

verses.z: 救主－以色列的上帝啊，你實在是自隱的上帝。
verses.e: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself , God of Israel , the Savior . ' "

verses.z: 凡製造偶像的都必抱愧蒙羞，都要一同歸於慚愧。
verses.e: They will be disappointed , yes , confounded , all of them . Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together .

verses.z: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和華的拯救，得永遠的救恩。你們必不蒙羞，也不抱愧，直到永世無盡。
verses.e: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation . You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting .

verses.z: 創造諸天的耶和華，製造成全大地的上帝，他創造堅定大地，並非使地荒涼，是要給人居住。他如此說：我是耶和華，再沒有別神。
verses.e: For the LORD who created the heavens , the God who formed the earth and made it , who established it and didn't create it a waste , who formed it to be inhabited says : " I am the LORD . There is no other .

verses.z: 我沒有在隱密黑暗之地說話；我沒有對雅各的後裔說：你們尋求我是徒然的。我－耶和華所講的是公義，所說的是正直。
verses.e: I have not spoken in secret , in a place of the land of darkness . I didn't say to the offspring of Jacob , ' Seek me in vain . ' I , the LORD , speak righteousness . I declare things that are right .

verses.z: 我必在你前面行，修平崎嶇之地。我必打破銅門，砍斷鐵閂。
verses.e: " I will go before you and make the rough places smooth . I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron .

verses.z: 你們從列國逃脫的人，要一同聚集前來。那些抬着雕刻木偶、禱告不能救人之神的，毫無知識。
verses.e: " Assemble yourselves and come . Draw near together , you who have escaped from the nations . Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image , and pray to a god that can't save .

verses.z: 你們要述說陳明[你們的理]，讓他們彼此商議。誰從古時指明？誰從上古述說？不是我－耶和華嗎？除了我以外，再沒有上帝；我是公義的上帝，又是救主；除了我以外，再沒有別神。
verses.e: Declare and present it . Yes , let them take counsel together . Who has shown this from ancient time ? Who has declared it of old ? Haven't I , the LORD ? There is no other God besides me , a just God and a Savior . There is no one besides me .

verses.z: 地極[的人]都當仰望我，就必得救；因為我是上帝，再沒有別神。
verses.e: " Look to me , and be saved , all the ends of the earth ; for I am God , and there is no other .

verses.z: 我指着自己起誓，我口所出的話是憑公義，並不反回：萬膝必向我跪拜；萬口必憑我起誓。
verses.e: I have sworn by myself . The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness , and will not be revoked , that to me every knee shall bow , every tongue shall take an oath .

verses.z: 人論我說，公義、能力，惟獨在乎耶和華；人都必歸向他。凡向他發怒的必至蒙羞。
verses.e: They will say of me , ' There is righteousness and strength only in the LORD . ' " Even to him will men come . All those who raged against him will be disappointed .

verses.z: 以色列的後裔都必因耶和華得稱為義，並要誇耀。
verses.e: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD , and will rejoice !

verses.z: 我要將暗中的寶物和隱密的財寶賜給你，使你知道提名召你的，就是我－耶和華、以色列的上帝。
verses.e: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places , that you may know that it is I , the LORD , who calls you by your name , even the God of Israel .

verses.z: 因我僕人雅各，我所揀選以色列的緣故，我就提名召你；你雖不認識我，我也加給你名號。
verses.e: For Jacob my servant's sake , and Israel my chosen , I have called you by your name . I have given you a title , though you have not known me .

verses.z: 我是耶和華，在我以外並沒有別神；除了我以外再沒有上帝。你雖不認識我，我必給你束腰。
verses.e: I am the LORD , and there is no one else . Besides me , there is no God . I will strengthen you , though you have not known me ,

verses.z: 從日出之地到日落之處使人都知道除了我以外，沒有別神。我是耶和華；在我以外並沒有別神。
verses.e: that they may know from the rising of the sun , and from the west , that there is no one besides me . I am the LORD , and there is no one else .

verses.z: 我造光，又造暗；我施平安，又降災禍；造作這一切的是我－耶和華。
verses.e: I form the light and create darkness . I make peace and create calamity . I am the LORD , who does all these things .

verses.z: 諸天哪，自上而滴，穹蒼降下公義；地面開裂，產出救恩，使公義一同發生；這都是我－耶和華所造的。
verses.e: Rain , you heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness . Let the earth open , that it may produce salvation , and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it . I , the LORD , have created it .

verses.z: 禍哉，那與造他的主爭論的！他不過是地上瓦片中的一塊瓦片。泥土豈可對摶弄它的說：你做甚麼呢？所做的物豈可說：你沒有手呢？
verses.e: Woe to him who strives with his Maker — a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth ! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it , ' What are you making ? ' or your work , ' He has no hands ' ?

verses.z: 彼勒屈身，尼波彎腰；巴比倫的偶像馱在獸和牲畜上。他們所抬的如今成了重馱，使[牲畜]疲乏，
verses.e: Bel bows down . Nebo stoops . Their idols are carried by animals , and on the livestock . The things that you carried around are heavy loads , a burden for the weary .

verses.z: 我從起初指明末後的事，從古時言明未成的事，說：我的籌算必立定；凡我所喜悅的，我必成就。
verses.e: I declare the end from the beginning , and from ancient times things that are not yet done . I say : My counsel will stand , and I will do all that I please .

verses.z: 我召鷙鳥從東方來，召那成就我籌算的人從遠方來。我已說出，也必成就；我已謀定，也必做成。
verses.e: I call a ravenous bird from the east , the man of my counsel from a far country . Yes , I have spoken . I will also bring it to pass . I have planned . I will also do it .

verses.z: 你們這些心中頑梗、遠離公義的，當聽我言。
verses.e: Listen to me , you stubborn-hearted , who are far from righteousness !

verses.z: 我使我的公義臨近，必不遠離。我的救恩必不遲延；我要為以色列－我的榮耀，在錫安施行救恩。
verses.e: I bring my righteousness near . It is not far off , and my salvation will not wait . I will grant salvation to Zion , my glory to Israel .

verses.z: 都一同彎腰屈身，不能保全重馱，自己倒被擄去。
verses.e: They stoop and they bow down together . They could not deliver the burden , but they have gone into captivity .

verses.z: 雅各家，以色列家一切餘剩的要聽我言：你們自從生下，就蒙[我]保抱，自從出胎，便蒙[我]懷搋。
verses.e: " Listen to me , house of Jacob , and all the remnant of the house of Israel , that have been carried from their birth , that have been carried from the womb .

verses.z: 直到你們年老，我仍這樣；直到你們髮白，我仍懷搋。我已造作，也必保抱；我必懷抱，也必拯救。
verses.e: Even to old age I am he , and even to gray hairs I will carry you . I have made , and I will bear . Yes , I will carry , and will deliver .

verses.z: 你們將誰與我相比，與我同等，可以與我比較，使我們相同呢？
verses.e: " To whom will you compare me , and consider my equal , and compare me , as if we were the same ?

verses.z: 那從囊中抓金子，用天平平銀子的人，雇銀匠製造神像，他們又俯伏，又叩拜。
verses.e: Some pour out gold from the bag , and weigh silver in the balance . They hire a goldsmith , and he makes it a god . They fall down — yes , they worship .

verses.z: 他們將神像抬起，扛在肩上，安置在定處，它就站立，不離本位；人呼求它，它不能答應，也不能救人脫離患難。
verses.e: They bear it on their shoulder . They carry it , and set it in its place , and it stands there . It cannot move from its place . Yes , one may cry to it , yet it can not answer . It cannot save him out of his trouble .

verses.z: 你們當想念這事，自己作大丈夫。悖逆的人哪，要心裏思想。
verses.e: " Remember this , and show yourselves men . Bring it to mind again , you transgressors .

verses.z: 你們要追念上古的事。因為我是上帝，並無別神；[我是]上帝，再沒有能比我的。
verses.e: Remember the former things of old ; for I am God , and there is no other . I am God , and there is none like me .

verses.z: 巴比倫的處女啊，下來坐在塵埃；迦勒底的閨女啊，沒有寶座，要坐在地上；因為你不再稱為柔弱嬌嫩的。
verses.e: " Come down and sit in the dust , virgin daughter of Babylon . Sit on the ground without a throne , daughter of the Chaldeans . For you will no longer be called tender and delicate .

verses.z: 你素來倚仗自己的惡行，說：無人看見我。你的智慧聰明使你偏邪，並且你心裏說：惟有我，除我以外再沒有別的。
verses.e: For you have trusted in your wickedness . You have said , ' No one sees me . ' Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you . You have said in your heart , ' I am , and there is no one else besides me . '

verses.z: 因此，禍患要臨到你身；你不知何時發現，災害落在你身上，你也不能除掉；所不知道的毀滅也必忽然臨到你身。
verses.e: Therefore disaster will come on you . You won't know when it dawns . Mischief will fall on you . You won't be able to put it away . Desolation will come on you suddenly , which you don't understand .

verses.z: 站起來吧！用你從幼年勞神施行的符咒和你許多的邪術；或者可得益處，或者可得強勝。
verses.e: " Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries , in which you have labored from your youth , as if you might profit , as if you might prevail .

verses.z: 你籌劃太多，以致疲倦。讓那些觀天象的，看星宿的，在月朔說預言的，都站起來，救你脫離所要臨到你的事。
verses.e: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels . Now let the astrologers , the stargazers , and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you .

verses.z: 他們要像碎稭被火焚燒，不能救自己脫離火焰之力；這火並非可烤的炭火，也不是可以坐在其前的火。
verses.e: Behold , they are like stubble . The fire will burn them . They won't deliver themselves from the power of the flame . It won't be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by .

verses.z: 你所勞神的事都要這樣與你[無益]；從幼年與你貿易的也都各奔各鄉，無人救你。
verses.e: The things that you labored in will be like this : those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way . There will be no one to save you .

verses.z: 要用磨磨麵，揭去帕子，脫去長衣，露腿詵河。
verses.e: Take the millstones and grind flour . Remove your veil , lift up your skirt , uncover your legs , and wade through the rivers .

verses.z: 你的下體必被露出；你的醜陋必被看見。我要報仇，誰也不寬容。
verses.e: Your nakedness will be uncovered . Yes , your shame will be seen . I will take vengeance , and will spare no one . "

verses.z: 我們救贖主的名是萬軍之耶和華－以色列的聖者。
verses.e: Our Redeemer , the LORD of Armies is his name , is the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 迦勒底的閨女啊，你要默然靜坐，進入暗中，因為你不再稱為列國的主母。
verses.e: " Sit in silence , and go into darkness , daughter of the Chaldeans . For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms .

verses.z: 我向我的百姓發怒，使我的產業被褻瀆，將他們交在你手中，你毫不憐憫他們，把極重的軛加在老年人身上。
verses.e: I was angry with my people . I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand . You showed them no mercy . You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged .

verses.z: 你自己說：我必永為主母，所以你不將這事放在心上，也不思想這事的結局。
verses.e: You said , ' I will be a princess forever , ' so that you didn't lay these things to your heart , nor did you remember the results .

verses.z: 你這專好宴樂、安然居住的，現在當聽這話。你心中說：惟有我，除我以外再沒有別的。我必不致寡居，也不遭喪子之事。
verses.e: " Now therefore hear this , you who are given to pleasures , who sit securely , who say in your heart , ' I am , and there is no one else besides me . I won't sit as a widow , neither will I know the loss of children . '

verses.z: 哪知，喪子、寡居這兩件事在一日轉眼之間必臨到你；正在你多行邪術、廣施符咒的時候，這兩件事必全然臨到你身上。
verses.e: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day : the loss of children and widowhood . They will come on you in their full measure , in the multitude of your sorceries , and the great abundance of your enchantments .

verses.z: 雅各家，稱為以色列名下，從猶大水源出來的，當聽我言！你們指着耶和華的名起誓，提說以色列的上帝，卻不憑誠實，不憑公義。
verses.e: " Hear this , house of Jacob , you who are called by the name of Israel , and have come out of the waters of Judah . You swear by the LORD's name , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness —

verses.z: 我熬煉你，卻不像熬煉銀子；你在苦難的爐中，我揀選你。
verses.e: Behold , I have refined you , but not as silver . I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction .

verses.z: 我為自己的緣故必行這事，我焉能使[我的名]被褻瀆？我必不將我的榮耀歸給假神。
verses.e: For my own sake , for my own sake , I will do it ; for how would my name be profaned ? I will not give my glory to another .

verses.z: 雅各－我所選召的以色列啊，當聽我言：我是耶和華，我是首先的，也是末後的。
verses.e: " Listen to me , O Jacob , and Israel my called : I am he . I am the first . I am also the last .

verses.z: 我手立了地的根基；我右手鋪張諸天；我一招呼便都立住。
verses.e: Yes , my hand has laid the foundation of the earth , and my right hand has spread out the heavens . when I call to them , they stand up together .

verses.z: 你們都當聚集而聽，他們內中誰說過這些事？耶和華所愛的人必向巴比倫行他所喜悅的事；他的膀臂也要[加在]迦勒底人身上。
verses.e: " Assemble yourselves , all of you , and hear ! Who among them has declared these things ? He whom the LORD loves will do what he likes to Babylon , and his arm will be against the Chaldeans .

verses.z: 惟有我曾說過，我又選召他，領他來，他的道路就必亨通。
verses.e: I , even I , have spoken . Yes , I have called him . I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous .

verses.z: 你們要就近我來聽這話：我從起頭並未曾在隱密處說話；自從有這事，我就在那裏。現在，主耶和華差遣我和他的靈來。
verses.e: " Come near to me and hear this : " From the beginning I have not spoken in secret ; from the time that it happened , I was there . " Now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit .

verses.z: 耶和華－你的救贖主，以色列的聖者如此說：我是耶和華－你的上帝，教訓你，使你得益處，引導你所當行的路。
verses.e: The LORD , your Redeemer , the Holy One of Israel , says : " I am the LORD your God , who teaches you to profit , who leads you by the way that you should go .

verses.z: 甚願你素來聽從我的命令！你的平安就如河水；你的公義就如海浪。
verses.e: Oh that you had listened to my commandments ! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea .

verses.z: 你的後裔也必多如[海]沙；你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。他的名在我面前必不剪除，也不滅絕。
verses.e: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains . His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me . "

verses.z: 他們自稱為聖城的人，所倚靠的是名為萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝。
verses.e: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city , and rely on the God of Israel ; the LORD of Armies is his name .

verses.z: 你們要從巴比倫出來，從迦勒底人中逃脫，以歡呼的聲音傳揚說：耶和華救贖了他的僕人雅各！你們要將這事宣揚到地極。
verses.e: Leave Babylon ! Flee from the Chaldeans ! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this , tell it even to the end of the earth ; say , " The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob ! "

verses.z: 耶和華引導他們經過沙漠。他們並不乾渴；他為他們使水從磐石而流，分裂磐石，水就湧出。
verses.e: They didn't thirst when he led them through the deserts . He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them . He also split the rock and the waters gushed out .

verses.z: 耶和華說：惡人必不得平安！
verses.e: " There is no peace " , says the LORD , " for the wicked . "

verses.z: 主說：早先的事，我從古時說明，已經出了我的口，也是我所指示的；我忽然行做，事便成就。
verses.e: I have declared the former things from of old . Yes , they went out of my mouth , and I revealed them . I did them suddenly , and they happened .

verses.z: 因為我素來知道你是頑梗的－你的頸項是鐵的；你的額是銅的。
verses.e: Because I knew that you are obstinate , and your neck is an iron sinew , and your brow bronze ;

verses.z: 所以，我從古時將這事給你說明，在未成以先指示你，免得你說：這些事是我的偶像所行的，是我雕刻的偶像和我鑄造的偶像所命定的。
verses.e: therefore I have declared it to you from of old ; before it came to pass I showed it to you ; lest you should say , ' My idol has done them . My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them . '

verses.z: 你已經聽見，現在要看見這一切；你不說明嗎？從今以後，我將新事，就是你所不知道的隱密事指示你。
verses.e: You have heard it . Now see all this . And you , won't you declare it ? " I have shown you new things from this time , even hidden things , which you have not known .

verses.z: 這事是現今造的，並非從古就有；在今日以先，你也未曾聽見，免得你說：這事我早已知道了。
verses.e: They are created now , and not from of old . Before today , you didn't hear them , lest you should say , ' Behold , I knew them . '

verses.z: 你未曾聽見，未曾知道；你的耳朵從來未曾開通。我原知道你行事極其詭詐，你自從出胎以來，便稱為悖逆的。
verses.e: Yes , you didn't hear . Yes , you didn't know . Yes , from of old your ear was not opened , for I knew that you dealt very treacherously , and were called a transgressor from the womb .

verses.z: 我為我的名暫且忍怒，為我的頌讚向你容忍，不將你剪除。
verses.e: For my name's sake , I will defer my anger , and for my praise , I hold it back for you so that I don't cut you off .

verses.z: 眾海島啊，當聽我言！遠方的眾民哪，留心而聽！自我出胎，耶和華就選召我；自出母腹，他就提我的名。
verses.e: Listen , islands , to me . Listen , you peoples , from afar : the LORD has called me from the womb ; from the inside of my mother , he has mentioned my name .

verses.z: 不飢不渴，炎熱和烈日必不傷害他們；因為憐恤他們的必引導他們，領他們到水泉旁邊。
verses.e: They shall not hunger nor thirst ; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them , for he who has mercy on them will lead them . He will guide them by springs of water .

verses.z: 我必使我的眾山成為大道；我的大路也被修高。
verses.e: I will make all my mountains a road , and my highways shall be exalted .

verses.z: 看哪，這些從遠方來；這些從北方、從西方來；這些從秦國來。
verses.e: Behold , these shall come from afar , and behold , these from the north and from the west , and these from the land of Sinim . "

verses.z: 諸天哪，應當歡呼！大地啊，應當快樂！眾山哪，應當發聲歌唱！因為耶和華已經安慰他的百姓，也要憐恤他困苦之民。
verses.e: Sing , heavens , and be joyful , earth ! Break out into singing , mountains ! For the LORD has comforted his people , and will have compassion on his afflicted .

verses.z: 錫安說：耶和華離棄了我；主忘記了我。
verses.e: But Zion said , " The LORD has forsaken me , and the Lord has forgotten me . "

verses.z: 婦人焉能忘記她吃奶的嬰孩，不憐恤她所生的兒子？即或有忘記的，我卻不忘記你。
verses.e: " Can a woman forget her nursing child , that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb ? Yes , these may forget , yet I will not forget you !

verses.z: 看哪，我將你銘刻在我掌上；你的牆垣常在我眼前。
verses.e: Behold , I have engraved you on the palms of my hands . Your walls are continually before me .

verses.z: 你的兒女必急速[歸回]；毀壞你的，使你荒廢的，必都離你出去，
verses.e: Your children hurry . Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you .

verses.z: 你舉目向四方觀看；他們都聚集來到你這裏。耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓：你必要以他們為妝飾佩戴，以他們為華帶束腰，像新婦一樣。
verses.e: Lift up your eyes all around , and see : all these gather themselves together , and come to you . As I live , " says the LORD , " you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament , and dress yourself with them , like a bride .

verses.z: 至於你荒廢淒涼之處，並你被毀壞之地，現今眾民居住必顯為太窄；吞滅你的必離你遙遠。
verses.e: " For , as for your waste and your desolate places , and your land that has been destroyed , surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants , and those who swallowed you up will be far away .

verses.z: 他使我的口如快刀，將我藏在他手蔭之下；又使我成為磨亮的箭，將我藏在他箭袋之中；
verses.e: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword . He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand . He has made me a polished shaft . He has kept me close in his quiver .

verses.z: 你必聽見喪子之後所生的兒女說：這地方我居住太窄，求你給我地方居住。
verses.e: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears , ' This place is too small for me . Give me a place to live in . '

verses.z: 那時你心裏必說：我既喪子獨居，是被擄的，漂流在外。誰給我生這些？誰將這些養大呢？撇下我一人獨居的時候，這些在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Then you will say in your heart , ' Who has conceived these for me , since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone , an exile , and wandering back and forth ? Who has brought these up ? Behold , I was left alone . Where were these ? ' "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：我必向列國舉手，向萬民豎立大旗；他們必將你的眾子懷中抱來，將你的眾女肩上扛來。
verses.e: The Lord GOD says , " Behold , I will lift up my hand to the nations , and lift up my banner to the peoples . They shall bring your sons in their bosom , and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders .

verses.z: 列王必作你的養父；王后必作你的乳母。他們必將臉伏地，向你下拜，並舔你腳上的塵土。你便知道我是耶和華；等候我的必不致羞愧。
verses.e: Kings shall be your foster fathers , and their queens your nursing mothers . They will bow down to you with their faces to the earth , and lick the dust of your feet . Then you will know that I am the LORD ; and those who wait for me won't be disappointed . "

verses.z: 勇士搶去的豈能奪回？該擄掠的豈能解救嗎？
verses.e: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty , or the lawful captives be delivered ?

verses.z: 但耶和華如此說：就是勇士所擄掠的，也可以奪回；強暴人所搶的，也可以解救。與你相爭的，我必與他相爭；我要拯救你的兒女。
verses.e: But the LORD says , " Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away , and the plunder retrieved from the fierce , for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children .

verses.z: 並且我必使那欺壓你的吃自己的肉，也要以自己的血喝醉，好像喝甜酒一樣。凡有血氣的必都知道我－耶和華是你的救主，是你的救贖主，是雅各的大能者。
verses.e: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh ; and they will be drunk on their own blood , as with sweet wine . Then all flesh shall know that I , the LORD , am your Savior and your Redeemer , the Mighty One of Jacob . "

verses.z: 對我說：你是我的僕人以色列；我必因你得榮耀。
verses.e: He said to me , " You are my servant , Israel , in whom I will be glorified . "

verses.z: 我卻說：我勞碌是徒然；我盡力是虛無虛空。然而，我[當得]的理必在耶和華那裏；我的賞賜必在我上帝那裏。
verses.e: But I said , " I have labored in vain . I have spent my strength in vain for nothing ; yet surely the justice due to me is with the LORD , and my reward with my God . "

verses.z: 耶和華從我出胎，造就我作他的僕人，要使雅各歸向他，使以色列到他那裏聚集。原來耶和華看我為尊貴；我的上帝也成為我的力量。
verses.e: Now the LORD , he who formed me from the womb to be his servant , says to bring Jacob again to him , and to gather Israel to him , for I am honorable in the LORD's eyes , and my God has become my strength .

verses.z: 現在他說：你作我的僕人，使雅各眾支派復興，使以色列中得保全的歸回尚為小事，我還要使你作外邦人的光，叫你施行我的救恩，直到地極。
verses.e: Indeed , he says , " It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to restore the preserved of Israel . I will also give you as a light to the nations , that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth . "

verses.z: 救贖主－以色列的聖者耶和華對那被人所藐視、本國所憎惡、官長所虐待的如此說：君王要看見就站起，首領也要下拜；都因信實的耶和華，就是揀選你－以色列的聖者。
verses.e: The LORD , the Redeemer of Israel , and his Holy One , says to him whom man despises , to him whom the nation abhors , to a servant of rulers : " Kings shall see and rise up , princes , and they shall worship , because of the LORD who is faithful , even the Holy One of Israel , who has chosen you . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：在悅納的時候，我應允了你；在拯救的日子，我濟助了你。我要保護你，使你作眾民的中保；復興遍地，使人承受荒涼之地為業。
verses.e: The LORD says , " I have answered you in an acceptable time . I have helped you in a day of salvation . I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people , to raise up the land , to make them inherit the desolate heritage ,

verses.z: 對那被捆綁的人說：出來吧！對那在黑暗的人說：顯露吧！他們在路上必得飲食，在一切淨光的高處必有食物。
verses.e: saying to those who are bound , ' Come out ! ' ; to those who are in darkness , ' Show yourselves ! ' " They shall feed along the paths , and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights .

verses.z: 我要為我所親愛的唱歌，是我所愛者的歌，論他葡萄園的事：我所親愛的有葡萄園在肥美的山岡上。
verses.e: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard . My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill .

verses.z: 三十畝葡萄園只出一罷特[酒]；一賀梅珥穀種只結一伊法[糧食]。
verses.e: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath , and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah . "

verses.z: 禍哉！那些清早起來追求濃酒，留連到夜深，甚至因酒發燒的人。
verses.e: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning , that they may follow strong drink , who stay late into the night , until wine inflames them !

verses.z: 他們在筵席上彈琴，鼓瑟，擊鼓，吹笛，飲酒，卻不顧念耶和華的作為，也不留心他手所做的。
verses.e: The harp , lyre , tambourine , and flute , with wine , are at their feasts ; but they don't respect the work of the LORD , neither have they considered the operation of his hands .

verses.z: 所以，我的百姓因無知就被擄去；他們的尊貴人甚是飢餓，群眾極其乾渴。
verses.e: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge . Their honorable men are famished , and their multitudes are parched with thirst .

verses.z: 故此，陰間擴張其欲，開了無限量的口；他們的榮耀、群眾、繁華，並快樂的人都落[在其中]。
verses.e: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire , and opened its mouth without measure ; and their glory , their multitude , their pomp , and he who rejoices among them , descend into it .

verses.z: 卑賤人被壓服；尊貴人降為卑；眼目高傲的人也降為卑。
verses.e: So man is brought low , mankind is humbled , and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled ;

verses.z: 惟有萬軍之耶和華因公平而崇高；聖者上帝因公義顯為聖。
verses.e: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice , and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness .

verses.z: 那時，羊羔必來吃草，如同在自己的草場；豐肥人的荒場被遊行的人吃盡。
verses.e: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture , and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich .

verses.z: 禍哉！那些以虛假之細繩牽罪孽的人！他們又像以套繩拉罪惡，
verses.e: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood , and wickedness as with cart rope ,

verses.z: 說：任他急速行，趕快成就他的作為，使我們看看；任以色列聖者所謀劃的臨近成就，使我們知道。
verses.e: who say , " Let him make haste , let him hasten his work , that we may see it ; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come , that we may know it ! "

verses.z: 他刨挖園子，撿去石頭，栽種上等的葡萄樹，在園中蓋了一座樓，又鑿出壓酒池；指望結[好]葡萄，反倒結了野葡萄。
verses.e: He dug it up , gathered out its stones , planted it with the choicest vine , built a tower in the middle of it , and also cut out a wine press in it . He looked for it to yield grapes , but it yielded wild grapes .

verses.z: 禍哉！那些稱惡為善，稱善為惡，以暗為光，以光為暗，以苦為甜，以甜為苦的人。
verses.e: Woe to those who call evil good , and good evil ; who put darkness for light , and light for darkness ; who put bitter for sweet , and sweet for bitter !

verses.z: 禍哉！那些自以為有智慧，自看為通達的人。
verses.e: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes , and prudent in their own sight !

verses.z: 禍哉！那些勇於飲酒，以能力調濃酒的人。
verses.e: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine , and champions at mixing strong drink ;

verses.z: 他們因受賄賂，就稱惡人為義，將義人的義奪去。
verses.e: who acquit the guilty for a bribe , but deny justice for the innocent !

verses.z: 火苗怎樣吞滅碎稭，乾草怎樣落在火焰之中，照樣，他們的根必像朽[物]，他們的花必像灰塵飛騰；因為他們厭棄萬軍之耶和華的訓誨，藐視以色列聖者的言語。
verses.e: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble , and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame , so their root shall be as rottenness , and their blossom shall go up as dust , because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies , and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作。他的手伸出攻擊他們，山嶺就震動；他們的屍首在街市上好像糞土。雖然如此，他的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD's anger burns against his people , and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them . The mountains tremble , and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets . For all this , his anger is not turned away , but his hand is still stretched out .

verses.z: 他必豎立大旗，招遠方的國民，發嘶聲叫他們從地極而來；看哪，他們必急速奔來。
verses.e: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away , and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth . Behold , they will come speedily and swiftly .

verses.z: 其中沒有疲倦的，絆跌的；沒有打盹的，睡覺的；腰帶並不放鬆，鞋帶也不折斷。
verses.e: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them ; no one shall slumber nor sleep , neither shall the belt of their waist be untied , nor the strap of their sandals be broken ,

verses.z: 他們的箭快利，弓也上了弦。馬蹄算如堅石，車輪好像旋風。
verses.e: whose arrows are sharp , and all their bows bent . Their horses ' hoofs will be like flint , and their wheels like a whirlwind .

verses.z: 他們要吼叫，像母獅子，咆哮，像少壯獅子；他們要咆哮抓食，坦然叼去，無人救回。
verses.e: Their roaring will be like a lioness . They will roar like young lions . Yes , they shall roar , and seize their prey and carry it off , and there will be no one to deliver .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的居民和猶大人哪，請你們現今在我與我的葡萄園中，斷定是非。
verses.e: " Now , inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah , please judge between me and my vineyard .

verses.z: 那日，他們要向以色列人吼叫，像海浪匉訇；人若望地，只見黑暗艱難，光明在雲中變為昏暗。
verses.e: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea . If one looks to the land , behold , darkness and distress . The light is darkened in its clouds .

verses.z: 我為我葡萄園所做之外，還有甚麼可做的呢？我指望結[好]葡萄，怎麼倒結了野葡萄呢？
verses.e: What could have been done more to my vineyard , that I have not done in it ? Why , when I looked for it to yield grapes , did it yield wild grapes ?

verses.z: 現在我告訴你們，我要向我葡萄園怎樣行：我必撤去籬笆，使它被吞滅，拆毀牆垣，使它被踐踏。
verses.e: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard . I will take away its hedge , and it will be eaten up . I will break down its wall , and it will be trampled down .

verses.z: 我必使它荒廢，不再修理，不再鋤刨，荊棘蒺藜倒要生長。我也必命雲不降雨在其上。
verses.e: I will lay it a wasteland . It won't be pruned or hoed , but it will grow briers and thorns . I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華的葡萄園就是以色列家；他所喜愛的樹就是猶大人。他指望的是公平，誰知倒有暴虐；指望的是公義，誰知倒有冤聲。
verses.e: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel , and the men of Judah his pleasant plant . He looked for justice , but behold , oppression , for righteousness , but behold , a cry of distress .

verses.z: 禍哉！那些以房接房，以地連地，以致不留餘地的，只顧自己獨居境內。
verses.e: Woe to those who join house to house , who lay field to field , until there is no room , and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land !

verses.z: 我耳聞萬軍之耶和華[說]：必有許多又大又美的房屋成為荒涼，無人居住。
verses.e: In my ears , the LORD of Armies says : " Surely many houses will be desolate , even great and beautiful , unoccupied .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：我休你們的母親，休書在哪裏呢？我將你們賣給我哪一個債主呢？你們被賣，是因你們的罪孽；你們的母親被休，是因你們的過犯。
verses.e: The LORD says , " Where is the bill of your mother's divorce , with which I have put her away ? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you ? Behold , you were sold for your iniquities , and your mother was put away for your transgressions .

verses.z: 你們中間誰是敬畏耶和華、聽從他僕人之話的？這人行在暗中，沒有亮光。當倚靠耶和華的名，仗賴自己的上帝。
verses.e: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant ? He who walks in darkness and has no light , let him trust in the LORD's name , and rely on his God .

verses.z: 凡你們點火，用火把圍繞自己的可以行在你們的火焰裏，並你們所點的火把中。這是我手所定的：你們必躺在悲慘之中。
verses.e: Behold , all you who kindle a fire , who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves , walk in the flame of your fire , and among the torches that you have kindled . You will have this from my hand : you will lie down in sorrow .

verses.z: 我來的時候，為何無人[等候]呢？我呼喚的時候，為何無人答應呢？我的膀臂豈是縮短、不能救贖嗎？我豈無拯救之力嗎？看哪，我一斥責，海就乾了；我使江河變為曠野；其中的魚因無水腥臭，乾渴而死。
verses.e: Why , when I came , was there no one ? When I called , why was there no one to answer ? Is my hand shortened at all , that it can't redeem ? Or have I no power to deliver ? Behold , at my rebuke I dry up the sea . I make the rivers a wilderness . Their fish stink because there is no water , and die of thirst .

verses.z: 我使諸天以黑暗為衣服，以麻布為遮蓋。
verses.e: I clothe the heavens with blackness . I make sackcloth their covering . "

verses.z: 主耶和華賜我受教者的舌頭，使我知道怎樣用言語扶助疲乏的人。主每早晨提醒，提醒我的耳朵，使我能聽，像受教者一樣。
verses.e: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught , that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary . He awakens morning by morning , he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught .

verses.z: 主耶和華開通我的耳朵；我並沒有違背，也沒有退後。
verses.e: The Lord GOD has opened my ear . I was not rebellious . I have not turned back .

verses.z: 人打我的背，我任他打；人拔我腮頰的鬍鬚，我由他拔；人辱我，吐我，我並不掩面。
verses.e: I gave my back to those who beat me , and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair . I didn't hide my face from shame and spitting .

verses.z: 主耶和華必幫助我，所以我不抱愧。我硬着臉面好像堅石；我也知道我必不致蒙羞。
verses.e: For the Lord GOD will help me . Therefore I have not been confounded . Therefore I have set my face like a flint , and I know that I won't be disappointed .

verses.z: 稱我為義的與我相近；誰與我爭論，可以與我一同站立；誰與我作對，可以就近我來。
verses.e: He who justifies me is near . Who will bring charges against me ? Let us stand up together . Who is my adversary ? Let him come near to me .

verses.z: 主耶和華要幫助我；誰能定我有罪呢？他們都像衣服漸漸舊了，為蛀蟲所咬。
verses.e: Behold , the Lord GOD will help me ! Who is he who will condemn me ? Behold , they will all grow old like a garment . The moths will eat them up .

verses.z: 你們這追求公義、尋求耶和華的，當聽我言！你們要追想被鑿而出的磐石，被挖而出的巖穴。
verses.e: " Listen to me , you who follow after righteousness , you who seek the LORD . Look to the rock you were cut from , and to the quarry you were dug from .

verses.z: 使海與深淵的水乾涸、使海的深處變為贖民經過之路的，不是你嗎？
verses.e: Isn't it you who dried up the sea , the waters of the great deep ; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over ?

verses.z: 耶和華救贖的民必歸回，歌唱來到錫安；永樂必歸到他們的頭上。他們必得着歡喜快樂；憂愁歎息盡都逃避。
verses.e: Those ransomed by the LORD will return , and come with singing to Zion . Everlasting joy shall be on their heads . They will obtain gladness and joy . Sorrow and sighing shall flee away .

verses.z: 惟有我，是安慰你們的。你是誰，竟怕那必死的人？怕那要變如草的世人？
verses.e: " I , even I , am he who comforts you . Who are you , that you are afraid of man who shall die , and of the son of man who will be made as grass ?

verses.z: 卻忘記鋪張諸天、立定地基、創造你的耶和華？又因欺壓者圖謀毀滅要發的暴怒，整天害怕，其實那欺壓者的暴怒在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Have you forgotten the LORD your Maker , who stretched out the heavens , and laid the foundations of the earth ? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor , when he prepares to destroy ? Where is the fury of the oppressor ?

verses.z: 被擄去的快得釋放，必不死而下坑；他的食物也不致缺乏。
verses.e: The captive exile will speedily be freed . He will not die and go down into the pit . His bread won't fail .

verses.z: 我是耶和華－你的上帝－攪動大海，使海中的波浪匉訇－萬軍之耶和華是我的名。
verses.e: For I am the LORD your God , who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar . the LORD of Armies is his name .

verses.z: 我將我的話傳給你，用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽定諸天，立定地基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。
verses.e: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand , that I may plant the heavens , and lay the foundations of the earth , and tell Zion , ' You are my people . ' "

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，興起！興起！站起來！你從耶和華手中喝了他忿怒之杯，喝了那使人東倒西歪的爵，以致喝盡。
verses.e: Awake , awake ! Stand up , Jerusalem , you who have drunk from the LORD's hand the cup of his wrath . You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering , and drained it .

verses.z: 她所生育的諸子中，沒有一個引導她的；她所養大的諸子中，沒有一個攙扶她的。
verses.e: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth ; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up .

verses.z: 荒涼、毀滅、饑荒、刀兵，這幾樣臨到你，誰為你舉哀？我如何能安慰你呢？
verses.e: These two things have happened to you — who will grieve with you ? — desolation and destruction , and famine and the sword . How can I comfort you ?

verses.z: 要追想你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕和生養你們的撒拉；因為亞伯拉罕獨自一人的時候，我選召他，賜福與他，使他[人數]增多。
verses.e: Look to Abraham your father , and to Sarah who bore you ; for when he was but one I called him , I blessed him , and made him many .

verses.z: 你的眾子發昏，在各市口上躺臥，好像黃羊在網羅之中，都滿了耶和華的忿怒－你上帝的斥責。
verses.e: Your sons have fainted . They lie at the head of all the streets , like an antelope in a net . They are full of the LORD's wrath , the rebuke of your God .

verses.z: 因此，你這困苦卻非因酒而醉的，要聽我言。
verses.e: Therefore now hear this , you afflicted , and drunken , but not with wine :

verses.z: 你的主耶和華－就是為他百姓辨屈的上帝如此說：看哪，我已將那使人東倒西歪的杯，就是我忿怒的爵，從你手中接過來；你必不致再喝。
verses.e: Your Lord GOD , your God who pleads the cause of his people , says , " Behold , I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering , even the bowl of the cup of my wrath . You will not drink it any more .

verses.z: 我必將這杯遞在苦待你的人手中；他們曾對你說：你屈身，由我們踐踏過去吧！你便以背為地，好像街市，任人經過。
verses.e: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you , who have said to your soul , ' Bow down , that we may walk over you ; ' and you have laid your back as the ground , like a street to those who walk over . "

verses.z: 耶和華已經安慰錫安和錫安一切的荒場，使曠野像伊甸，使沙漠像耶和華的園囿；在其中必有歡喜、快樂、感謝，和歌唱的聲音。
verses.e: For the LORD has comforted Zion . He has comforted all her waste places , and has made her wilderness like Eden , and her desert like the garden of the LORD . Joy and gladness will be found in them , thanksgiving , and the voice of melody .

verses.z: 我的百姓啊，要向我留心；我的國民哪，要向我側耳；因為訓誨必從我而出；我必堅定我的公理為萬民之光。
verses.e: " Listen to me , my people ; and hear me , my nation , for a law will go out from me , and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples .

verses.z: 我的公義臨近；我的救恩發出。我的膀臂要審判萬民；海島都要等候我，倚賴我的膀臂。
verses.e: My righteousness is near . My salvation has gone out , and my arms will judge the peoples . The islands will wait for me , and they will trust my arm .

verses.z: 你們要向天舉目，觀看下地；因為天必像煙雲消散，地必如衣服漸漸舊了；其上的居民也要如此死亡。惟有我的救恩永遠長存；我的公義也不廢掉。
verses.e: Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look at the earth beneath ; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke , and the earth will wear out like a garment . Its inhabitants will die in the same way , but my salvation will be forever , and my righteousness will not be abolished .

verses.z: 知道公義、將我訓誨存在心中的民，要聽我言！不要怕人的辱罵，也不要因人的毀謗驚惶。
verses.e: " Listen to me , you who know righteousness , the people in whose heart is my law . Don't fear the reproach of men , and don't be dismayed at their insults .

verses.z: 因為蛀蟲必咬他們，好像咬衣服；蟲子必咬他們，如同咬羊絨。惟有我的公義永遠長存，我的救恩直到萬代。
verses.e: For the moth will eat them up like a garment , and the worm will eat them like wool ; but my righteousness will be forever , and my salvation to all generations . "

verses.z: 耶和華的膀臂啊，興起！興起！以能力為衣穿上，像古時的年日、上古的世代興起一樣。從前砍碎拉哈伯、刺透大魚的，不是你嗎？
verses.e: Awake , awake , put on strength , arm of the LORD ! Awake , as in the days of old , the generations of ancient times . Isn't it you who cut Rahab in pieces , who pierced the monster ?

verses.z: 錫安哪，興起！興起！披上你的能力！聖城耶路撒冷啊，穿上你華美的衣服！因為從今以後，未受割禮、不潔淨的必不再進入你中間。
verses.e: Awake , awake ! Put on your strength , Zion . Put on your beautiful garments , Jerusalem , the holy city , for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you .

verses.z: 耶和華在萬國眼前露出聖臂；地極的人都看見我們上帝的救恩了。
verses.e: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations . All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God .

verses.z: 你們離開吧！離開吧！從巴比倫出來。不要沾不潔淨的物；要從其中出來。你們扛抬耶和華器皿的人哪，務要自潔。
verses.e: Depart ! Depart ! Go out from there ! Touch no unclean thing ! Go out from among her ! Cleanse yourselves , you who carry the LORD's vessels .

verses.z: 你們出來必不致急忙，也不致奔逃。因為，耶和華必在你們前頭行；以色列的上帝必作你們的後盾。
verses.e: For you shall not go out in haste , neither shall you go by flight ; for the LORD will go before you , and the God of Israel will be your rear guard .

verses.z: 我的僕人行事必有智慧，必被高舉上升，且成為至高。
verses.e: Behold , my servant will deal wisely . He will be exalted and lifted up , and will be very high .

verses.z: 許多人因他驚奇；他的面貌比別人憔悴；他的形容比世人枯槁。
verses.e: Just as many were astonished at you — his appearance was marred more than any man , and his form more than the sons of men —

verses.z: 這樣，他必洗淨許多國民；君王要向他閉口。因所未曾傳與他們的，他們必看見；未曾聽見的，他們要明白。
verses.e: so he will cleanse many nations . Kings will shut their mouths at him ; for they will see that which had not been told them , and they will understand that which they had not heard .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，要抖下塵土！起來坐[在位上]！錫安被擄的居民哪，要解開你頸項的鎖鍊！
verses.e: Shake yourself from the dust ! Arise , sit up , Jerusalem ! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck , captive daughter of Zion !

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「你們是無價被賣的，也必無銀被贖。
verses.e: For the LORD says , " You were sold for nothing ; and you will be redeemed without money . "

verses.z: 主耶和華如此說：起先我的百姓下到埃及，在那裏寄居，又有亞述人無故欺壓他們。
verses.e: For the Lord GOD says : " My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there ; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我的百姓既是無價被擄去，如今我在這裏做甚麼呢？耶和華說：轄制他們的人呼叫，我的名整天受褻瀆。
verses.e: " Now therefore , what do I do here , " says the LORD , " seeing that my people are taken away for nothing ? Those who rule over them mock , " says the LORD , " and my name is blasphemed continually all day long .

verses.z: 所以，我的百姓必知道我的名；到那日[他們必知道]說這話的就是我。看哪，是我！」
verses.e: Therefore my people shall know my name . Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks . Behold , it is I . "

verses.z: 那報佳音，傳平安，報好信，傳救恩的，對錫安說：你的上帝作王了！這人的腳登山何等佳美！
verses.e: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news , who publishes peace , who brings good news , who proclaims salvation , who says to Zion , " Your God reigns ! "

verses.z: 聽啊，你守望之人的聲音，他們揚起聲來，一同歌唱；因為耶和華歸回錫安的時候，他們必親眼看見。
verses.e: Your watchmen lift up their voice . Together they sing ; for they shall see eye to eye when the LORD returns to Zion .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的荒場啊，要發起歡聲，一同歌唱；因為耶和華安慰了他的百姓，救贖了耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Break out into joy ! Sing together , you waste places of Jerusalem ; for the LORD has comforted his people . He has redeemed Jerusalem .

verses.z: 我們所傳的有誰信呢？耶和華的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
verses.e: Who has believed our message ? To whom has the LORD's arm been revealed ?

verses.z: 耶和華卻定意將他壓傷，使他受痛苦。耶和華以他為贖罪祭。他必看見後裔，並且延長年日。耶和華所喜悅的事必在他手中亨通。
verses.e: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him . He has caused him to suffer . When you make his soul an offering for sin , he will see his offspring . He will prolong his days and the LORD's pleasure will prosper in his hand .

verses.z: 他必看見自己勞苦的功效，便心滿意足。有許多人因認識我的義僕得稱為義；並且他要擔當他們的罪孽。
verses.e: After the suffering of his soul , he will see the light and be satisfied . My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself ; and he will bear their iniquities .

verses.z: 所以，我要使他與位大的同分，與強盛的均分擄物。因為他將命傾倒，以致於死；他也被列在罪犯之中。他卻擔當多人的罪，又為罪犯代求。
verses.e: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great . He will divide the plunder with the strong , because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors ; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors .

verses.z: 他在耶和華面前生長如嫩芽，像根出於乾地。他無佳形美容；我們看見他的時候，也無美貌使我們羨慕他。
verses.e: For he grew up before him as a tender plant , and as a root out of dry ground . He has no good looks or majesty . When we see him , there is no beauty that we should desire him .

verses.z: 他被藐視，被人厭棄；多受痛苦，常經憂患。他被藐視，好像被人掩面不看的一樣；我們也不尊重他。
verses.e: He was despised and rejected by men , a man of suffering and acquainted with disease . He was despised as one from whom men hide their face ; and we didn't respect him .

verses.z: 他誠然擔當我們的憂患，背負我們的痛苦；我們卻以為他受責罰，被上帝擊打苦待了。
verses.e: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering ; yet we considered him plagued , struck by God , and afflicted .
