verses.z: 哪知他為我們的過犯受害，為我們的罪孽壓傷。因他受的刑罰，我們得平安；因他受的鞭傷，我們得醫治。
verses.e: But he was pierced for our transgressions . He was crushed for our iniquities . The punishment that brought our peace was on him ; and by his wounds we are healed .

verses.z: 我們都如羊走迷；各人偏行己路；耶和華使我們眾人的罪孽都歸在他身上。
verses.e: All we like sheep have gone astray . Everyone has turned to his own way ; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all .

verses.z: 他被欺壓，在受苦的時候卻不開口；他像羊羔被牽到宰殺之地，又像羊在剪毛的人手下無聲，他也是這樣不開口。
verses.e: He was oppressed , yet when he was afflicted he didn't open his mouth . As a lamb that is led to the slaughter , and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent , so he didn't open his mouth .

verses.z: 因受欺壓和審判，他被奪去，至於他同世的人，誰想他受鞭打、從活人之地被剪除，是因我百姓的罪過呢？
verses.e: He was taken away by oppression and judgment . As for his generation , who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people ?

verses.z: 他雖然未行強暴，口中也沒有詭詐，人還使他與惡人同埋；誰知死的時候與財主同葬。
verses.e: They made his grave with the wicked , and with a rich man in his death , although he had done no violence , nor was any deceit in his mouth .

verses.z: 你這不懷孕、不生養的要歌唱；你這未曾經過產難的要發聲歌唱，揚聲歡呼；因為沒有丈夫的比有丈夫的兒女更多。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Sing , barren , you who didn't give birth ! Break out into singing , and cry aloud , you who didn't travail with child ! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 大山可以挪開，小山可以遷移；但我的慈愛必不離開你；我平安的約也不遷移。這是憐恤你的耶和華說的。
verses.e: For the mountains may depart , and the hills be removed , but my loving kindness will not depart from you , and my covenant of peace will not be removed , " says the LORD who has mercy on you .

verses.z: 你這受困苦、被風飄蕩不得安慰的人哪，我必以彩色安置你的石頭，以藍寶石立定你的根基；
verses.e: " You afflicted , tossed with storms , and not comforted , behold , I will set your stones in beautiful colors , and lay your foundations with sapphires .

verses.z: 又以紅寶石造你的女牆，以紅玉造你的城門，以寶石造你四圍的邊界。
verses.e: I will make your pinnacles of rubies , your gates of sparkling jewels , and all your walls of precious stones .

verses.z: 你的兒女都要受耶和華的教訓；你的兒女必大享平安。
verses.e: All your children will be taught by the LORD , and your children's peace will be great .

verses.z: 你必因公義得堅立，必遠離欺壓，不致害怕；你必遠離驚嚇，驚嚇必不臨近你。
verses.e: You will be established in righteousness . You will be far from oppression , for you will not be afraid , and far from terror , for it shall not come near you .

verses.z: 即或有人聚集，卻不由於我；凡聚集攻擊你的，必因你仆倒。
verses.e: Behold , they may gather together , but not by me . Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you .

verses.z: 吹噓炭火、打造合用器械的鐵匠是我所造；殘害人、行毀滅的也是我所造。
verses.e: " Behold , I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame , and forges a weapon for his work ; and I have created the destroyer to destroy .

verses.z: 凡為攻擊你造成的器械必不利用；凡在審判時興起用舌攻擊你的，你必定他為有罪。這是耶和華僕人的產業，是他們從我所得的義。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail ; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment . This is the heritage of the LORD's servants , and their righteousness is of me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 要擴張你帳幕之地，張大你居所的幔子，不要限止；要放長你的繩子，堅固你的橛子。
verses.e: " Enlarge the place of your tent , and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations ; don't spare ; lengthen your cords , and strengthen your stakes .

verses.z: 因為你要向左向右開展；你的後裔必得多國為業，又使荒涼的城邑有人居住。
verses.e: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left ; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities .

verses.z: 不要懼怕，因你必不致蒙羞；也不要抱愧，因你必不致受辱。你必忘記幼年的羞愧，不再記念你寡居的羞辱。
verses.e: " Don't be afraid , for you will not be ashamed . Don't be confounded , for you will not be disappointed . For you will forget the shame of your youth . You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more .

verses.z: 因為造你的是你的丈夫；萬軍之耶和華是他的名。救贖你的是以色列的聖者；他必稱為全地之上帝。
verses.e: For your Maker is your husband ; the LORD of Armies is his name . The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer . He will be called the God of the whole earth .

verses.z: 耶和華召你，如召被離棄心中憂傷的妻，就是幼年所娶被棄的妻。這是你上帝所說的。
verses.e: For the LORD has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit , even a wife of youth , when she is cast off , " says your God .

verses.z: 我離棄你不過片時，卻要施大恩將你收回。
verses.e: " For a small moment I have forsaken you , but I will gather you with great mercies .

verses.z: 我的怒氣漲溢，頃刻之間向你掩面，卻要以永遠的慈愛憐恤你。這是耶和華－你的救贖主說的。
verses.e: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment , but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you , " says the LORD your Redeemer .

verses.z: 這事在我好像挪亞的洪水。我怎樣起誓不再使挪亞的洪水漫過遍地，我也照樣起誓不再向你發怒，也不斥責你。
verses.e: " For this is like the waters of Noah to me ; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth , so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you , nor rebuke you .

verses.z: 你們一切乾渴的都當就近水來；沒有銀錢的也可以來。你們都來，買了吃；不用銀錢，不用價值，也來買酒和奶。
verses.e: " Hey ! Come , everyone who thirsts , to the waters ! Come , he who has no money , buy , and eat ! Yes , come , buy wine and milk without money and without price .

verses.z: 雨雪從天而降，並不返回，卻滋潤地土，使地上發芽結實，使撒種的有種，使要吃的有糧。
verses.e: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky , and doesn't return there , but waters the earth , and makes it grow and bud , and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater ;

verses.z: 我口所出的話也必如此，決不徒然返回，卻要成就我所喜悅的，在我發他去成就的事上必然亨通。
verses.e: so is my word that goes out of my mouth : it will not return to me void , but it will accomplish that which I please , and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do .

verses.z: 你們必歡歡喜喜而出來，平平安安蒙引導。大山小山必在你們面前發聲歌唱；田野的樹木也都拍掌。
verses.e: For you shall go out with joy , and be led out with peace . The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing ; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands .

verses.z: 松樹長出，代替荊棘；番石榴長出，代替蒺藜。這要為耶和華留名，作為永遠的證據，不能剪除。
verses.e: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up ; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up . It will make a name for the LORD , for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off . "

verses.z: 你們為何花錢買那不足為食物的？用勞碌得來的買那不使人飽足的呢？你們要留意聽我的話就能吃那美物，得享肥甘，心中喜樂。
verses.e: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread , and your labor for that which doesn't satisfy ? Listen diligently to me , and eat that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in richness .

verses.z: 你們當就近我來；側耳而聽，就必得活。我必與你們立永約，就是[應許]大衛那可靠的恩典。
verses.e: Turn your ear , and come to me . Hear , and your soul will live . I will make an everlasting covenant with you , even the sure mercies of David .

verses.z: 我已立他作萬民的見證，為萬民的君王和司令。
verses.e: Behold , I have given him for a witness to the peoples , a leader and commander to the peoples .

verses.z: 你素不認識的國民，你也必召來；素不認識你的國民也必向你奔跑，都因耶和華－你的上帝以色列的聖者，因為他已經榮耀你。
verses.e: Behold , you shall call a nation that you don't know ; and a nation that didn't know you shall run to you , because of the LORD your God , and for the Holy One of Israel ; for he has glorified you . "

verses.z: 當趁耶和華可尋找的時候尋找他，相近的時候求告他。
verses.e: Seek the LORD while he may be found . Call on him while he is near .

verses.z: 惡人當離棄自己的道路；不義的人當除掉自己的意念。歸向耶和華，耶和華就必憐恤他；當歸向我們的上帝，因為上帝必廣行赦免。
verses.e: Let the wicked forsake his way , and the unrighteous man his thoughts . Let him return to the LORD , and he will have mercy on him , to our God , for he will freely pardon .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我的意念非同你們的意念；我的道路非同你們的道路。
verses.e: " For my thoughts are not your thoughts , and your ways are not my ways , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 天怎樣高過地，照樣，我的道路高過你們的道路；我的意念高過你們的意念。
verses.e: " For as the heavens are higher than the earth , so are my ways higher than your ways , and my thoughts than your thoughts .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你們當守公平，行公義；因我的救恩臨近，我的公義將要顯現。
verses.e: The LORD says : " Maintain justice and do what is right , for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed .

verses.z: 他看守的人是瞎眼的，都沒有知識，都是啞巴狗，不能叫喚；但知做夢，躺臥，貪睡，
verses.e: His watchmen are blind . They are all without knowledge . They are all mute dogs . They can't bark — dreaming , lying down , loving to slumber .

verses.z: 這些狗貪食，不知飽足。這些牧人不能明白－各人偏行己路，各從各方求自己的利益。
verses.e: Yes , the dogs are greedy . They can never have enough . They are shepherds who can't understand . They have all turned to their own way , each one to his gain , from every quarter .

verses.z: 他們說：來吧！我去拿酒，我們飽飲濃酒；明日必和今日一樣，就是[宴樂]無量極大之日。
verses.e: " Come , " they say , " I will get wine , and we will fill ourselves with strong drink ; and tomorrow will be as today , great beyond measure . "

verses.z: 謹守安息日而不干犯，禁止己手而不作惡；如此行、如此持守的人便為有福。
verses.e: Blessed is the man who does this , and the son of man who holds it fast ; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil . "

verses.z: 與耶和華聯合的外邦人不要說：耶和華必定將我從他民中分別出來。太監也不要說：我是枯樹。
verses.e: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak , saying , " The LORD will surely separate me from his people . " Do not let the eunuch say , " Behold , I am a dry tree . "

verses.z: 因為耶和華如此說：那些謹守我的安息日，揀選我所喜悅的事，持守我約的太監，
verses.e: For the LORD says , " To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths , choose the things that please me , and hold fast to my covenant ,

verses.z: 我必使他們在我殿中，在我牆內，有記念，有名號，比有兒女的更美。我必賜他們永遠的名，不能剪除。
verses.e: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters . I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off .

verses.z: 還有那些與耶和華聯合的外邦人，要事奉他，要愛耶和華的名，要作他的僕人－就是凡守安息日不干犯，又持守他約的人。
verses.e: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to serve him , and to love the LORD's name , to be his servants , everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it , and holds fast my covenant ,

verses.z: 我必領他們到我的聖山，使他們在禱告我的殿中喜樂。他們的燔祭和[平安]祭，在我壇上必蒙悅納，因我的殿必稱為萬民禱告的殿。
verses.e: I will bring these to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer . Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar ; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples . "

verses.z: 主耶和華，就是招聚以色列被趕散的，說：在這被招聚的人以外，我還要招聚[別人]歸併他們。
verses.e: The Lord GOD , who gathers the outcasts of Israel , says , " I will yet gather others to him , in addition to his own who are gathered . "

verses.z: 田野的諸獸都來吞吃吧！林中的諸獸也要如此。
verses.e: All you animals of the field , come to devour , all you animals in the forest .

verses.z: 義人死亡，無人放在心上；虔誠人被收去，無人思念。這義人被收去是免了[將來的]禍患；
verses.e: The righteous perish , and no one lays it to heart . Merciful men are taken away , and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil .

verses.z: 你因路遠疲倦，卻不說這是枉然；你[以為]有復興之力，所以不覺疲憊。
verses.e: You were wearied with the length of your ways ; yet you didn't say , ' It is in vain . ' You found a reviving of your strength ; therefore you weren't faint .

verses.z: 你怕誰？因誰恐懼？竟說謊，不記念我，又不將這事放在心上。我不是許久閉口不言，你仍不怕我嗎？
verses.e: " Whom have you dreaded and feared , so that you lie , and have not remembered me , nor laid it to your heart ? Haven't I held my peace for a long time , and you don't fear me ?

verses.z: 我要指明你的公義；至於你所行的都必與你無益。
verses.e: I will declare your righteousness ; and as for your works , they will not benefit you .

verses.z: 你哀求的時候，讓你所聚集的拯救你吧！風要把他們颳散，一口氣要把他們都吹去。但那投靠我的必得地土，必承受我的聖山為業。
verses.e: When you cry , let those whom you have gathered deliver you , but the wind will take them . A breath will carry them all away , but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land , and will inherit my holy mountain . "

verses.z: 耶和華要說：你們修築修築，預備道路，將絆腳石從我百姓的路中除掉。
verses.e: He will say , " Build up , build up , prepare the way ! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people . "

verses.z: 因為那至高至上、永遠長存名為聖者的如此說：我住在至高至聖的所在，也與心靈痛悔謙卑的人同居；要使謙卑人的靈甦醒，也使痛悔人的心甦醒。
verses.e: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity , whose name is Holy , says : " I dwell in the high and holy place , with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit , to revive the spirit of the humble , and to revive the heart of the contrite .

verses.z: 我必不永遠相爭，也不長久發怒，恐怕我所造的人與靈性都必發昏。
verses.e: For I will not contend forever , neither will I always be angry ; for the spirit would faint before me , and the souls whom I have made .

verses.z: 因他貪婪的罪孽，我就發怒擊打他；我向他掩面發怒，他卻仍然隨心背道。
verses.e: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him . I hid myself and was angry ; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart .

verses.z: 我看見他所行的道，也要醫治他；又要引導他，使他和那一同傷心的人再得安慰。
verses.e: I have seen his ways , and will heal him . I will lead him also , and restore comforts to him and to his mourners .

verses.z: 我造就嘴唇的果子；願平安康泰歸與遠處的人，也歸與近處的人；並且我要醫治他。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I create the fruit of the lips : Peace , peace , to him who is far off and to him who is near , " says the LORD ; " and I will heal them . "

verses.z: 他們得享平安。素行正直的，各人在墳裏安歇。
verses.e: He enters into peace . They rest in their beds , each one who walks in his uprightness .

verses.z: 惟獨惡人，好像翻騰的海，不得平靜；其中的水常湧出污穢和淤泥來。
verses.e: But the wicked are like the troubled sea ; for it can't rest and its waters cast up mire and mud .

verses.z: 我的上帝說：惡人必不得平安！
verses.e: " There is no peace " , says my God , " for the wicked . "

verses.z: 你們這些巫婆的兒子，姦夫和妓女的種子，都要前來！
verses.e: " But draw near here , you sons of a sorceress , you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes .

verses.z: 你們向誰戲笑？向誰張口吐舌呢？你們豈不是悖逆的兒女，虛謊的種類呢？
verses.e: Whom do you mock ? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue ? Aren't you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood ,

verses.z: 你們在橡樹中間，在各青翠樹下慾火攻心；在山谷間，在石穴下殺了兒女；
verses.e: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks , under every green tree ; who kill the children in the valleys , under the clefts of the rocks ?

verses.z: 在谷中光滑[石頭]裏有你的分。這些就是你所得的分；你也向他澆了奠祭，獻了供物，因這事我豈能容忍嗎？
verses.e: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion . They , they are your lot . You have even poured a drink offering to them . You have offered an offering . Shall I be appeased for these things ?

verses.z: 你在高而又高的山上安設床榻，也上那裏去獻祭。
verses.e: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed . You also went up there to offer sacrifice .

verses.z: 你在門後，在門框後，立起你的紀念；向外人赤露，又上去擴張床榻，與他們立約；你在那裏看見他們的床就甚喜愛。
verses.e: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts , for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me , and have gone up . You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them . You loved what you saw on their bed .

verses.z: 你把油帶到王那裏，又多加香料，打發使者往遠方去，自卑自賤直到陰間，
verses.e: You went to the king with oil , increased your perfumes , sent your ambassadors far off , and degraded yourself even to Sheol .

verses.z: 你要大聲喊叫，不可止息；揚起聲來，好像吹角。向我百姓說明他們的過犯；向雅各家說明他們的罪惡。
verses.e: " Cry aloud ! Don't spare ! Lift up your voice like a trumpet ! Declare to my people their disobedience , and to the house of Jacob their sins .

verses.z: 你心若向飢餓的人發憐憫，使困苦的人得滿足，你的光就必在黑暗中發現；你的幽暗必變如正午。
verses.e: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry , and satisfy the afflicted soul , then your light will rise in darkness , and your obscurity will be as the noonday ;

verses.z: 耶和華也必時常引導你，在乾旱之地使你心滿意足，骨頭強壯。你必像澆灌的園子，又像水流不絕的泉源。
verses.e: and the LORD will guide you continually , satisfy your soul in dry places , and make your bones strong . You will be like a watered garden , and like a spring of water whose waters don't fail .

verses.z: 那些出於你的人必修造久已荒廢之處；你要建立[拆毀]累代的根基。你必稱為補破口的，和重修路徑與人居住的。
verses.e: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places . You will raise up the foundations of many generations . You will be called Repairer of the Breach , Restorer of Paths with Dwellings .

verses.z: 你若在安息日掉轉你的腳步，在我聖日不以[操作]為喜樂，稱安息日為可喜樂的，稱耶和華的聖日為可尊重的；而且尊敬這日，不辦自己的私事，不隨自己的私意，不說自己的私話，
verses.e: " If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath , from doing your pleasure on my holy day , and call the Sabbath a delight , and the holy of the LORD honorable , and honor it , not doing your own ways , nor finding your own pleasure , nor speaking your own words ,

verses.z: 你就以耶和華為樂。耶和華要使你乘駕地的高處，又以你祖雅各的產業養育你。這是耶和華親口說的。
verses.e: then you will delight yourself in the LORD , and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth , and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father ; " for the LORD's mouth has spoken it .

verses.z: 他們天天尋求我，樂意明白我的道，好像行義的國民，不離棄他們上帝的典章，向我求問公義的判語，喜悅親近上帝。
verses.e: Yet they seek me daily , and delight to know my ways . As a nation that did righteousness , and didn't forsake the ordinance of their God , they ask of me righteous judgments . They delight to draw near to God .

verses.z: 他們說：我們禁食，你為何不看見呢？我們刻苦己心，你為何不理會呢？看哪，你們禁食的日子仍求利益，勒逼人為你們做苦工。
verses.e: ' Why have we fasted , ' they say , ' and you don't see ? Why have we afflicted our soul , and you don't notice ? ' " Behold , in the day of your fast you find pleasure , and oppress all your laborers .

verses.z: 你們禁食，卻互相爭競，以凶惡的拳頭打人。你們今日禁食，不得使你們的聲音聽聞於上。
verses.e: Behold , you fast for strife and contention , and to strike with the fist of wickedness . You don't fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high .

verses.z: 這樣禁食豈是我所揀選、使人刻苦己心的日子嗎？豈是叫人垂頭像葦子，用麻布和爐灰鋪在他以下嗎？你這可稱為禁食、為耶和華所悅納的日子嗎？
verses.e: Is this the fast that I have chosen ? A day for a man to humble his soul ? Is it to bow down his head like a reed , and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself ? Will you call this a fast , and an acceptable day to the LORD ?

verses.z: 我所揀選的禁食不是要鬆開凶惡的繩，解下軛上的索，使被欺壓的得自由，折斷一切的軛嗎？
verses.e: " Isn't this the fast that I have chosen : to release the bonds of wickedness , to undo the straps of the yoke , to let the oppressed go free , and that you break every yoke ?

verses.z: 不是要把你的餅分給飢餓的人，將飄流的窮人接到你家中，見赤身的給他[衣服]遮體，顧恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏嗎？
verses.e: Isn't it to distribute your bread to the hungry , and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house ? When you see the naked , that you cover him ; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh ?

verses.z: 這樣，你的光就必發現如早晨的光；你所得的醫治要速速發明。你的公義必在你前面行；耶和華的榮光必作你的後盾。
verses.e: Then your light will break out as the morning , and your healing will appear quickly ; then your righteousness shall go before you , and the LORD's glory will be your rear guard .

verses.z: 那時你求告，耶和華必應允；你呼求，他必說：我在這裏。你若從你中間除掉[重]軛和指摘人的指頭，並發惡言的事，
verses.e: Then you will call , and the LORD will answer . You will cry for help , and he will say , ' Here I am . ' " If you take away from among you the yoke , finger pointing , and speaking wickedly ;

verses.z: 耶和華的膀臂並非縮短，不能拯救，耳朵並非發沉，不能聽見，
verses.e: Behold , the LORD's hand is not shortened , that it can't save ; nor his ear dull , that it can't hear .

verses.z: 我們摸索牆壁，好像瞎子；我們摸索，如同無目之人。我們晌午絆腳，如在黃昏一樣；我們在肥壯人中，像死人一般。
verses.e: We grope for the wall like the blind . Yes , we grope as those who have no eyes . We stumble at noon as if it were twilight . Among those who are strong , we are like dead men .

verses.z: 我們咆哮如熊，哀鳴如鴿；指望公平，卻是沒有；指望救恩，卻遠離我們。
verses.e: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves . We look for justice , but there is none , for salvation , but it is far off from us .

verses.z: 我們的過犯在你面前增多，罪惡作見證告我們；過犯與我們同在。至於我們的罪孽，我們都知道：
verses.e: For our transgressions are multiplied before you , and our sins testify against us ; for our transgressions are with us , and as for our iniquities , we know them :

verses.z: 就是悖逆、不認識耶和華，轉去不跟從我們的上帝，說欺壓和叛逆的話，心懷謊言，隨即說出。
verses.e: transgressing and denying the LORD , and turning away from following our God , speaking oppression and revolt , conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood .

verses.z: 並且公平轉而退後，公義站在遠處；誠實在街上仆倒，正直也不得進入。
verses.e: Justice is turned away backward , and righteousness stands far away ; for truth has fallen in the street , and uprightness can't enter .

verses.z: 誠實少見；離惡的人反成掠物。那時，耶和華看見沒有公平，甚不喜悅。
verses.e: Yes , truth is lacking ; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey . The LORD saw it , and it displeased him that there was no justice .

verses.z: 他見無人[拯救]，無人代求，甚為詫異，就用自己的膀臂施行拯救，以公義扶持自己。
verses.e: He saw that there was no man , and wondered that there was no intercessor . Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him ; and his righteousness sustained him .

verses.z: 他以公義為鎧甲，以拯救為頭盔，以報仇為衣服，以熱心為外袍。
verses.e: He put on righteousness as a breastplate , and a helmet of salvation on his head . He put on garments of vengeance for clothing , and was clad with zeal as a mantle .

verses.z: 他必按人的行為施報，惱怒他的敵人，報復他的仇敵，向眾海島施行報應。
verses.e: According to their deeds , he will repay as appropriate : wrath to his adversaries , recompense to his enemies . He will repay the islands their due .

verses.z: 如此，人從日落之處必敬畏耶和華的名，從日出之地也必敬畏他的榮耀；因為仇敵好像急流的河水沖來，是耶和華之氣所驅逐的。
verses.e: So they will fear the LORD's name from the west , and his glory from the rising of the sun ; for he will come as a rushing stream , which the LORD's breath drives .

verses.z: 但你們的罪孽使你們與上帝隔絕；你們的罪惡使他掩面不聽你們。
verses.e: But your iniquities have separated you and your God , and your sins have hidden his face from you , so that he will not hear .

verses.z: 必有一位救贖主來到錫安－雅各族中轉離過犯的人那裏。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " A Redeemer will come to Zion , and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「至於我與他們所立的約乃是這樣：我加給你的靈，傳給你的話，必不離你的口，也不離你後裔與你後裔之後裔的口，從今直到永遠；這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: " As for me , this is my covenant with them , " says the LORD . " My Spirit who is on you , and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth , nor out of the mouth of your offspring , nor out of the mouth of your offspring's offspring , " says the LORD , " from now on and forever . "

verses.z: 因你們的手被血沾染，你們的指頭被罪孽沾污，你們的嘴唇說謊言，你們的舌頭出惡語。
verses.e: For your hands are defiled with blood , and your fingers with iniquity . Your lips have spoken lies . Your tongue mutters wickedness .

verses.z: 無一人按公義告狀，無一人憑誠實辯白；都倚靠虛妄，說謊言。所懷的是毒害；所生的是罪孽。
verses.e: No one sues in righteousness , and no one pleads in truth . They trust in vanity and speak lies . They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity .

verses.z: 他們菢毒蛇蛋，結蜘蛛網；人吃這蛋必死。這蛋被踏，必出蝮蛇。
verses.e: They hatch adders ' eggs and weave the spider's web . He who eats of their eggs dies ; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper .

verses.z: 所結的網不能成為衣服；所做的也不能遮蓋自己。他們的行為都是罪孽；手所做的都是強暴。
verses.e: Their webs won't become garments . They won't cover themselves with their works . Their works are works of iniquity , and acts of violence are in their hands .

verses.z: 他們的腳奔跑行惡；他們急速流無辜人的血；意念都是罪孽，所經過的路都荒涼毀滅。
verses.e: Their feet run to evil , and they hurry to shed innocent blood . Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity . Desolation and destruction are in their paths .

verses.z: 平安的路，他們不知道；所行的事沒有公平。他們為自己修彎曲的路；凡行此路的都不知道平安。
verses.e: They don't know the way of peace ; and there is no justice in their ways . They have made crooked paths for themselves ; whoever goes in them doesn't know peace .

verses.z: 因此，公平離我們遠，公義追不上我們。我們指望光亮，卻是黑暗，指望光明，卻行幽暗。
verses.e: Therefore justice is far from us , and righteousness doesn't overtake us . We look for light , but see darkness ; for brightness , but we walk in obscurity .

verses.z: 當烏西雅王崩的那年，我見主坐在高高的寶座上。他的衣裳垂下，遮滿聖殿。
verses.e: In the year that King Uzziah died , I saw the Lord sitting on a throne , high and lifted up ; and his train filled the temple .

verses.z: 要使這百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵發沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏明白，回轉過來，便得醫治。」
verses.e: Make the heart of this people fat . Make their ears heavy , and shut their eyes ; lest they see with their eyes , hear with their ears , understand with their heart , and turn again , and be healed . "

verses.z: 我就說：「主啊，這到幾時為止呢？」他說：直到城邑荒涼，無人居住，房屋[空閒]無人，地土極其荒涼。
verses.e: Then I said , " Lord , how long ? " He answered , " Until cities are waste without inhabitant , houses without man , the land becomes utterly waste ,

verses.z: 並且耶和華將人遷到遠方，在這境內撇下的地土很多。
verses.e: and the LORD has removed men far away , and the forsaken places are many within the land .

verses.z: 境內剩下的[人]若還有十分之一，也必被吞滅，像栗樹、橡樹雖被砍伐，樹墩子卻仍存留。這聖潔的種類在國中也是如此。
verses.e: If there is a tenth left in it , that also will in turn be consumed , as a terebinth , and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down , so the holy seed is its stump . "

verses.z: 其上有撒拉弗侍立，各有六個翅膀：用兩個翅膀遮臉，兩個翅膀遮腳，兩個翅膀飛翔；
verses.e: Above him stood the seraphim . Each one had six wings . With two he covered his face . With two he covered his feet . With two he flew .

verses.z: 彼此呼喊說：聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！萬軍之耶和華；他的榮光充滿全地！
verses.e: One called to another , and said , " Holy , holy , holy , is the LORD of Armies ! The whole earth is full of his glory ! "

verses.z: 因呼喊者的聲音，門檻的根基震動，殿充滿了煙雲。
verses.e: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called , and the house was filled with smoke .

verses.z: 那時我說：「禍哉！我滅亡了！因為我是嘴唇不潔的人，又住在嘴唇不潔的民中，又因我眼見大君王－萬軍之耶和華。」
verses.e: Then I said , " Woe is me ! For I am undone , because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips , for my eyes have seen the King , the LORD of Armies ! "

verses.z: 有一撒拉弗飛到我跟前，手裏拿着紅炭，是用火剪從壇上取下來的，
verses.e: Then one of the seraphim flew to me , having a live coal in his hand , which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar .

verses.z: 將炭沾我的口，說：「看哪，這炭沾了你的嘴，你的罪孽便除掉，你的罪惡就赦免了。」
verses.e: He touched my mouth with it , and said , " Behold , this has touched your lips ; and your iniquity is taken away , and your sin forgiven . "

verses.z: 我又聽見主的聲音說：「我可以差遣誰呢？誰肯為我們去呢？」我說：「我在這裏，請差遣我！」
verses.e: I heard the Lord's voice , saying , " Whom shall I send , and who will go for us ? " Then I said , " Here I am . Send me ! "

verses.z: 他說：「你去告訴這百姓說：你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得。
verses.e: He said , " Go , and tell this people , ' You hear indeed , but don't understand . You see indeed , but don't perceive . '

verses.z: 興起，發光！因為你的光已經來到！耶和華的榮耀發現照耀你。
verses.e: " Arise , shine ; for your light has come , and the LORD's glory has risen on you !

verses.z: 外邦人必建築你的城牆；他們的王必服事你。我曾發怒擊打你，現今卻施恩憐恤你。
verses.e: " Foreigners will build up your walls , and their kings will serve you ; for in my wrath I struck you , but in my favor I have had mercy on you .

verses.z: 你的城門必時常開放，晝夜不關；使人把列國的財物帶來歸你，並將他們的君王牽引而來。
verses.e: Your gates also shall be open continually ; they shall not be shut day nor night , that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations , and their kings led captive .

verses.z: 哪一邦哪一國不事奉你，就必滅亡，也必全然荒廢。
verses.e: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish ; yes , those nations shall be utterly wasted .

verses.z: 黎巴嫩的榮耀，就是松樹、杉樹、黃楊樹，都必一同歸你，為要修飾我聖所之地；我也要使我腳踏之處得榮耀。
verses.e: " The glory of Lebanon shall come to you , the cypress tree , the pine , and the box tree together , to beautify the place of my sanctuary ; and I will make the place of my feet glorious .

verses.z: 素來苦待你的，他的子孫都必屈身來就你；藐視你的，都要在你腳下跪拜。他們要稱你為「耶和華的城」，為「以色列聖者的錫安」。
verses.e: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you ; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet . They will call you the LORD's City , the Zion of the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 你雖然被撇棄被厭惡，甚至無人經過，我卻使你變為永遠的榮華，成為累代的喜樂。
verses.e: " Whereas you have been forsaken and hated , so that no one passed through you , I will make you an eternal excellency , a joy of many generations .

verses.z: 你也必吃萬國的奶，又吃君王的奶。你便知道我－耶和華是你的救主，是你的救贖主，雅各的大能者。
verses.e: You will also drink the milk of the nations , and will nurse from royal breasts . Then you will know that I , the LORD , am your Savior , your Redeemer , the Mighty One of Jacob .

verses.z: 我要拿金子代替銅，拿銀子代替鐵，拿銅代替木頭，拿鐵代替石頭；並要以和平為你的官長，以公義為你的監督。
verses.e: For bronze I will bring gold ; for iron I will bring silver ; for wood , bronze , and for stones , iron . I will also make peace your governor , and righteousness your ruler .

verses.z: 你地上不再聽見強暴的事，境內不再聽見荒涼毀滅的事。你必稱你的牆為「拯救」，稱你的門為「讚美」。
verses.e: Violence shall no more be heard in your land , nor desolation or destruction within your borders ; but you will call your walls Salvation , and your gates Praise .

verses.z: 日頭不再作你白晝的光；月亮也不再發光照耀你。耶和華卻要作你永遠的光；你上帝要為你的榮耀。
verses.e: The sun will be no more your light by day , nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you , but the LORD will be your everlasting light , and your God will be your glory .

verses.z: 看哪，黑暗遮蓋大地，幽暗遮蓋萬民，耶和華卻要顯現照耀你；他的榮耀要現在你身上。
verses.e: For behold , darkness will cover the earth , and thick darkness the peoples ; but the LORD will arise on you , and his glory shall be seen on you .

verses.z: 你的日頭不再下落；你的月亮也不退縮；因為耶和華必作你永遠的光。你悲哀的日子也完畢了。
verses.e: Your sun will not go down any more , nor will your moon withdraw itself ; for the LORD will be your everlasting light , and the days of your mourning will end .

verses.z: 你的居民都成為義人，永遠得地為業；是我種的栽子，我手的工作，使我得榮耀。
verses.e: Then your people will all be righteous . They will inherit the land forever , the branch of my planting , the work of my hands , that I may be glorified .

verses.z: 至小的[族]要加增千倍；微弱的國必成為強盛。我－耶和華要按定期速成這事。
verses.e: The little one will become a thousand , and the small one a strong nation . I , the LORD , will do this quickly in its time . "

verses.z: 萬國要來就你的光；君王要來就你發現的光輝。
verses.e: Nations will come to your light , and kings to the brightness of your rising .

verses.z: 你舉目向四方觀看；眾人都聚集來到你這裏。你的眾子從遠方而來；你的眾女也被懷抱而來。
verses.e: " Lift up your eyes all around , and see : they all gather themselves together . They come to you . Your sons will come from far away , and your daughters will be carried in arms .

verses.z: 那時，你看見就有光榮；你心又跳動又寬暢；因為大海豐盛的[貨物]必轉來歸你；列國的財寶也必來歸你。
verses.e: Then you shall see and be radiant , and your heart will thrill and be enlarged ; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you . The wealth of the nations will come to you .

verses.z: 成群的駱駝，並米甸和以法的獨峰駝必遮滿你；示巴的眾人都必來到；要奉上黃金乳香，又要傳說耶和華的讚美。
verses.e: A multitude of camels will cover you , the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah . All from Sheba will come . They will bring gold and frankincense , and will proclaim the praises of the LORD .

verses.z: 基達的羊群都必聚集到你這裏，尼拜約的公羊要供你使用，在我壇上必蒙悅納；我必榮耀我榮耀的殿。
verses.e: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you . The rams of Nebaioth will serve you . They will be accepted as offerings on my altar ; and I will beautify my glorious house .

verses.z: 那些飛來如雲、又如鴿子向窗戶飛回的是誰呢？
verses.e: " Who are these who fly as a cloud , and as the doves to their windows ?

verses.z: 眾海島必等候我，首先是他施的船隻，將你的眾子連他們的金銀從遠方一同帶來，都為耶和華－你上帝的名，又為以色列的聖者，因為他已經榮耀了你。
verses.e: Surely the islands will wait for me , and the ships of Tarshish first , to bring your sons from far away , their silver and their gold with them , for the name of the LORD your God , and for the Holy One of Israel , because he has glorified you .

verses.z: 主耶和華的靈在我身上；因為耶和華用膏膏我，叫我傳好信息給謙卑的人，差遣我醫好傷心的人，報告被擄的得釋放，被囚的出[監牢]；
verses.e: The Lord GOD's Spirit is on me , because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble . He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted , to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound ,

verses.z: 我因耶和華大大歡喜；我的心靠上帝快樂。因他以拯救為衣給我穿上，以公義為袍給我披上，好像新郎戴上華冠，又像新婦佩戴妝飾。
verses.e: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD ! My soul will be joyful in my God , for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation . He has covered me with the robe of righteousness , as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels .

verses.z: 田地怎樣使百穀發芽，園子怎樣使所種的發生，主耶和華必照樣使公義和讚美在萬民中發出。
verses.e: For as the earth produces its bud , and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up , so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations .

verses.z: 報告耶和華的恩年，和我們上帝報仇的日子；安慰一切悲哀的人，
verses.e: to proclaim the year of the LORD's favor and the day of vengeance of our God , to comfort all who mourn ,

verses.z: 賜華冠與錫安悲哀的人，代替灰塵；喜樂油代替悲哀；讚美衣代替憂傷之靈；使他們稱為「公義樹」，是耶和華所栽的，叫他得榮耀。
verses.e: to provide for those who mourn in Zion , to give to them a garland for ashes , the oil of joy for mourning , the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness , that they may be called trees of righteousness , the planting of the LORD , that he may be glorified .

verses.z: 他們必修造已久的荒場，建立先前淒涼之處，重修歷代荒涼之城。
verses.e: They will rebuild the old ruins . They will raise up the former devastated places . They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations .

verses.z: 那時，外人必起來牧放你們的羊群；外邦人必作你們耕種田地的，修理葡萄園的。
verses.e: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks . Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards .

verses.z: 你們倒要稱為耶和華的祭司；人必稱你們為我們上帝的僕役。你們必吃用列國的財物，因得他們的榮耀自誇。
verses.e: But you will be called the LORD's priests . Men will call you the servants of our God . You will eat the wealth of the nations . You will boast in their glory .

verses.z: 你們[必得]加倍[的好處]，代替所受的羞辱；分中所得的喜樂，必代替所受的凌辱。在境內必得加倍[的產業]；永遠之樂必歸與你們。
verses.e: Instead of your shame you will have double . Instead of dishonor , they will rejoice in their portion . Therefore in their land they will possess double . Everlasting joy will be to them .

verses.z: 因為我－耶和華喜愛公平，恨惡搶奪和罪孽；我要憑誠實施行報應，並要與我的百姓立永約。
verses.e: " For I , the LORD , love justice . I hate robbery and iniquity . I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them .

verses.z: 他們的後裔必在列國中被人認識；他們的子孫在眾民中也是如此。凡看見他們的必認他們是耶和華賜福的後裔。
verses.e: Their offspring will be known among the nations , and their offspring among the peoples . All who see them will acknowledge them , that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed . "

verses.z: 我因錫安必不靜默，為耶路撒冷必不息聲，直到他的公義如光輝發出，他的救恩如明燈發亮。
verses.e: For Zion's sake I will not hold my peace , and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest , until her righteousness shines out like the dawn , and her salvation like a burning lamp .

verses.z: 你們當從門經過經過，預備百姓的路；修築修築大道，撿去石頭，為萬民豎立大旗，
verses.e: Go through , go through the gates ! Prepare the way of the people ! Build up , build up the highway ! Gather out the stones ! Lift up a banner for the peoples .

verses.z: 看哪，耶和華曾宣告到地極，對錫安的居民說：你的拯救者來到。他的賞賜在他那裏；他的報應在他面前。
verses.e: Behold , the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth : " Say to the daughter of Zion , ' Behold , your salvation comes ! Behold , his reward is with him , and his recompense before him ! ' "

verses.z: 人必稱他們為「聖民」，為「耶和華的贖民」；你也必稱為「被眷顧、不撇棄的城」。
verses.e: They will call them " The Holy People , The LORD's Redeemed " . You will be called " Sought Out , A City Not Forsaken " .

verses.z: 列國必見你的公義；列王必見你的榮耀。你必得新名的稱呼，是耶和華親口所起的。
verses.e: The nations will see your righteousness , and all kings your glory . You will be called by a new name , which the LORD's mouth will name .

verses.z: 你在耶和華的手中要作為華冠，在你上帝的掌上必作為冕旒。
verses.e: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD's hand , and a royal diadem in your God's hand .

verses.z: 你必不再稱為「撇棄的」；你的地也不再稱為「荒涼的」。你卻要稱為「我所喜悅的」；你的地也必稱為「有夫之婦」。因為耶和華喜悅你，你的地也必歸他。
verses.e: You will not be called Forsaken any more , nor will your land be called Desolate any more ; but you will be called Hephzibah , and your land Beulah ; for the LORD delights in you , and your land will be married .

verses.z: 少年人怎樣娶處女，你的眾民也要照樣娶你；新郎怎樣喜悅新婦，你的上帝也要照樣喜悅你。
verses.e: For as a young man marries a virgin , so your sons will marry you . As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride , so your God will rejoice over you .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，我在你城上設立守望的，他們晝夜必不靜默。呼籲耶和華的，你們不要歇息，
verses.e: I have set watchmen on your walls , Jerusalem . They will never be silent day nor night . You who call on the LORD , take no rest ,

verses.z: 也不要使他歇息，直等他建立耶路撒冷，使耶路撒冷在地上成為可讚美的。
verses.e: and give him no rest until he establishes , and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth .

verses.z: 耶和華指着自己的右手和大能的膀臂起誓說：我必不再將你的五穀給你仇敵作食物；外邦人也不再喝你勞碌得來的新酒。
verses.e: The LORD has sworn by his right hand , and by the arm of his strength , " Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies , and foreigners will not drink your new wine , for which you have labored ,

verses.z: 惟有那收割的要吃，並讚美耶和華；那聚斂的要在我聖所的院內喝。
verses.e: but those who have harvested it will eat it , and praise the LORD . Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary . "

verses.z: 這從以東的波斯拉來，穿紅衣服，裝扮華美，能力廣大，大步行走的是誰呢？就是我，是憑公義說話，以大能施行拯救。
verses.e: Who is this who comes from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing , marching in the greatness of his strength ? " It is I who speak in righteousness , mighty to save . "

verses.z: 他們竟悖逆，使主的聖靈擔憂。他就轉作他們的仇敵，親自攻擊他們。
verses.e: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit . Therefore he turned and became their enemy , and he himself fought against them .

verses.z: 那時，他們想起古時的日子－摩西和他百姓，[說]：將百姓和牧養他全群的人從海裏領上來的在哪裏呢？將他的聖靈降在他們中間的在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Then he remembered the days of old , Moses and his people , saying , " Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock ? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them ? "

verses.z: 使他榮耀的膀臂在摩西的右手邊行動，在他們前面將水分開，要建立自己永遠的名，
verses.e: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses ' right hand ? Who divided the waters before them , to make himself an everlasting name ?

verses.z: 帶領他們經過深處，如馬行走曠野，使他們不致絆跌的在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Who led them through the depths , like a horse in the wilderness , so that they didn't stumble ?

verses.z: 耶和華的靈使他們得安息，彷彿牲畜下到山谷；照樣，你也引導你的百姓，要建立自己榮耀的名。
verses.e: As the livestock that go down into the valley , the LORD's Spirit caused them to rest . So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name .

verses.z: 求你從天上垂顧，從你聖潔榮耀的居所觀看。你的熱心和你大能的作為在哪裏呢？你愛慕的心腸和憐憫向我們止住了。
verses.e: Look down from heaven , and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory . Where are your zeal and your mighty acts ? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕雖然不認識我們，以色列也不承認我們，你卻是我們的父。耶和華啊，你是我們的父；從萬古以來，你名稱為「我們的救贖主」。
verses.e: For you are our Father , though Abraham doesn't know us , and Israel does not acknowledge us . You , LORD , are our Father . Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你為何使我們走差離開你的道，使我們心裏剛硬、不敬畏你呢？求你為你僕人，為你產業支派的緣故，轉回來。
verses.e: O LORD , why do you make us wander from your ways , and harden our heart from your fear ? Return for your servants ' sake , the tribes of your inheritance .

verses.z: 你的聖民不過暫時得這產業；我們的敵人已經踐踏你的聖所。
verses.e: Your holy people possessed it but a little while . Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary .

verses.z: 我們好像你未曾治理的人，又像未曾得稱你名下的人。
verses.e: We have become like those over whom you never ruled , like those who were not called by your name .

verses.z: 你的裝扮為何有紅色？你的衣服為何像踹酒醡的呢？
verses.e: Why is your clothing red , and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat ?

verses.z: 我獨自踹酒醡；眾民中無一人與我同在。我發怒將他們踹下，發烈怒將他們踐踏。他們的血濺在我衣服上，並且污染了我一切的衣裳。
verses.e: " I have trodden the wine press alone . Of the peoples , no one was with me . Yes , I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath . Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments , and I have stained all my clothing .

verses.z: 因為，報仇之日在我心中；救贖我民之年已經來到。
verses.e: For the day of vengeance was in my heart , and the year of my redeemed has come .

verses.z: 我仰望，見無人幫助；我詫異，沒有人扶持。所以，我自己的膀臂為我施行拯救；我的烈怒將我扶持。
verses.e: I looked , and there was no one to help ; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold . Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me . My own wrath upheld me .

verses.z: 我發怒，踹下眾民；發烈怒，使他們沉醉，又將他們的血倒在地上。
verses.e: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath . I poured their lifeblood out on the earth . "

verses.z: 我要照耶和華一切所賜給我們的，提起他的慈愛和美德，並他向以色列家所施的大恩；這恩是照他的憐恤和豐盛的慈愛賜給他們的。
verses.e: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD , according to all that the LORD has given to us , and the great goodness toward the house of Israel , which he has given to them according to his mercies , and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses .

verses.z: 他說：他們誠然是我的百姓，不行虛假的子民；這樣，他就作了他們的救主。
verses.e: For he said , " Surely , they are my people , children who will not deal falsely ; " so he became their Savior .

verses.z: 他們在一切苦難中，他也同受苦難；並且他面前的使者拯救他們；他以慈愛和憐憫救贖他們；在古時的日子常保抱他們，懷搋他們。
verses.e: In all their affliction he was afflicted , and the angel of his presence saved them . In his love and in his pity he redeemed them . He bore them , and carried them all the days of old .

verses.z: 願你裂天而降；願山在你面前震動－
verses.e: Oh that you would tear the heavens , that you would come down , that the mountains might quake at your presence —

verses.z: 你的聖邑變為曠野。錫安變為曠野；耶路撒冷成為荒場。
verses.e: Your holy cities have become a wilderness . Zion has become a wilderness , Jerusalem a desolation .

verses.z: 我們聖潔華美的殿－就是我們列祖讚美你的所在被火焚燒；我們所羨慕的美地盡都荒廢。
verses.e: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire . All our pleasant places are laid waste .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，有這些事，你還忍得住嗎？你仍靜默使我們深受苦難嗎？
verses.e: Will you hold yourself back for these things , LORD ? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely ?

verses.z: 好像火燒乾柴，又像火將水燒開，使你敵人知道你的名，使列國在你面前發顫！
verses.e: as when fire kindles the brushwood , and the fire causes the water to boil . Make your name known to your adversaries , that the nations may tremble at your presence !

verses.z: 你曾行我們不能逆料可畏的事。那時你降臨，山嶺在你面前震動。
verses.e: When you did awesome things which we didn't look for , you came down , and the mountains quaked at your presence .

verses.z: 從古以來，人未曾聽見、未曾耳聞、未曾眼見在你以外有甚麼神為等候他的人行事。
verses.e: For from of old men have not heard , nor perceived by the ear , nor has the eye seen a God besides you , who works for him who waits for him .

verses.z: 你迎接那歡喜行義、記念你道的人；你曾發怒，我們[仍]犯罪；這景況已久，我們還能得救嗎？
verses.e: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness , those who remember you in your ways . Behold , you were angry , and we sinned . We have been in sin for a long time . Shall we be saved ?

verses.z: 我們都像不潔淨的人；所有的義都像污穢的衣服。我們都像葉子漸漸枯乾；我們的罪孽好像風把我們吹去。
verses.e: For we have all become like one who is unclean , and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment . We all fade like a leaf ; and our iniquities , like the wind , take us away .

verses.z: 並且無人求告你的名；無人奮力抓住你。原來你掩面不顧我們，使我們因罪孽消化。
verses.e: There is no one who calls on your name , who stirs himself up to take hold of you ; for you have hidden your face from us , and have consumed us by means of our iniquities .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，現在你仍是我們的父！我們是泥，你是窯匠；我們都是你手的工作。
verses.e: But now , LORD , you are our Father . We are the clay and you our potter . We all are the work of your hand .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你不要大發震怒，也不要永遠記念罪孽。求你垂顧我們，我們都是你的百姓。
verses.e: Don't be furious , LORD . Don't remember iniquity forever . Look and see , we beg you , we are all your people .

verses.z: 素來沒有訪問[我的]，現在求問我；沒有尋找我的，我叫他們遇見；沒有稱為我名下的，我對他們說：我在這裏！我在這裏！
verses.e: " I am inquired of by those who didn't ask . I am found by those who didn't seek me . I said , ' See me , see me , ' to a nation that was not called by my name .

verses.z: 沙崙[平原]必成為羊群的圈；亞割谷必成為牛群躺臥之處，都為尋求我的民所得。
verses.e: Sharon will be a fold of flocks , and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in , for my people who have sought me .

verses.z: 但你們這些離棄耶和華、忘記我的聖山、給時運擺筵席、給天命盛滿調和酒的，
verses.e: " But you who forsake the LORD , who forget my holy mountain , who prepare a table for Fortune , and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny ;

verses.z: 我要命定你們歸在刀下，都必屈身被殺；因為我呼喚，你們沒有答應；我說話，你們沒有聽從；反倒行我眼中看為惡的，揀選我所不喜悅的。
verses.e: I will destine you to the sword , and you will all bow down to the slaughter ; because when I called , you didn't answer . When I spoke , you didn't listen ; but you did that which was evil in my eyes , and chose that in which I didn't delight . "

verses.z: 所以，主耶和華如此說：我的僕人必得吃，你們卻飢餓；我的僕人必得喝，你們卻乾渴；我的僕人必歡喜，你們卻蒙羞。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says , " Behold , my servants will eat , but you will be hungry ; behold , my servants will drink , but you will be thirsty . Behold , my servants will rejoice , but you will be disappointed .

verses.z: 我的僕人因心中高興歡呼，你們卻因心中憂愁哀哭，又因心裏憂傷哀號。
verses.e: Behold , my servants will sing for joy of heart , but you will cry for sorrow of heart , and will wail for anguish of spirit .

verses.z: 你們必留下自己的名，為我選民指着賭咒。主耶和華必殺你們，另起別名稱呼他的僕人。
verses.e: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen , and the Lord GOD will kill you . He will call his servants by another name ,

verses.z: 這樣，在地上為自己求福的，必憑真實的上帝求福；在地上起誓的，必指真實的上帝起誓。因為，從前的患難已經忘記，也從我眼前隱藏了。
verses.e: so that he who blesses himself in the earth will bless himself in the God of truth ; and he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth ; because the former troubles are forgotten , and because they are hidden from my eyes .

verses.z: 看哪！我造新天新地；從前的事不再被記念，也不再追想。
verses.e: " For , behold , I create new heavens and a new earth ; and the former things will not be remembered , nor come into mind .

verses.z: 你們當因我所造的永遠歡喜快樂；因我造耶路撒冷為人所喜，造其中的居民為人所樂。
verses.e: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create ; for , behold , I create Jerusalem to be a delight , and her people a joy .

verses.z: 我必因耶路撒冷歡喜，因我的百姓快樂；其中必不再聽見哭泣的聲音和哀號的聲音。
verses.e: I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and delight in my people ; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more .

verses.z: 我整天伸手招呼那悖逆的百姓；他們隨自己的意念行不善之道。
verses.e: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people , who walk in a way that is not good , after their own thoughts ;

verses.z: 其中必沒有數日[夭亡]的嬰孩，也沒有壽數不滿的老者；因為百歲死的仍算孩童，有百歲[死]的罪人算被咒詛。
verses.e: " No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days , nor an old man who has not filled his days ; for the child will die one hundred years old , and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed .

verses.z: 他們要建造房屋，自己居住；栽種葡萄園，吃其中的果子。
verses.e: They will build houses and inhabit them . They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit .

verses.z: 他們建造的，別人不得住；他們栽種的，別人不得吃；因為我民的日子必像樹木的日子；我選民親手勞碌得來的必長久享用。
verses.e: They will not build and another inhabit . They will not plant and another eat ; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree , and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands .

verses.z: 他們必不徒然勞碌，所生產的，也不遭災害，因為都是蒙耶和華賜福的後裔；他們的子孫也是如此。
verses.e: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity ; for they are the offspring of the LORD's blessed and their descendants with them .

verses.z: 他們尚未求告，我就應允；正說話的時候，我就垂聽。
verses.e: It will happen that before they call , I will answer ; and while they are yet speaking , I will hear .

verses.z: 豺狼必與羊羔同食；獅子必吃草與牛一樣；塵土必作蛇的食物。在我聖山的遍處，這一切都不傷人，不害物。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: The wolf and the lamb will feed together . The lion will eat straw like the ox . Dust will be the serpent's food . They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 這百姓時常當面惹我發怒；在園中獻祭，在壇上燒香；
verses.e: a people who provoke me to my face continually , sacrificing in gardens , and burning incense on bricks ;

verses.z: 在墳墓間坐着，在隱密處住宿，吃豬肉；他們器皿中有可憎之物做的湯；
verses.e: who sit among the graves , and spend nights in secret places ; who eat pig's meat , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels ;

verses.z: 且對人說：你站開吧！不要挨近我，因為我比你聖潔。[主說]：這些人是我鼻中的煙，是整天燒着的火。
verses.e: who say , ' Stay by yourself , don't come near to me , for I am holier than you . ' These are smoke in my nose , a fire that burns all day .

verses.z: 看哪，這都寫在我面前。我必不靜默，必施行報應，必將你們的罪孽和你們列祖的罪孽，就是在山上燒香，在岡上褻瀆我的罪孽，一同報應在他們後人懷中，我先要把他們所行的量給他們；這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Behold , it is written before me : I will not keep silence , but will repay , yes , I will repay into their bosom

your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together " , says the LORD , " who have burned incense on the mountains , and blasphemed me on the hills . Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：葡萄中尋得新酒，人就說：不要毀壞，因為福在其中。我因我僕人的緣故也必照樣而行，不將他們全然毀滅。
verses.e: The LORD says , " As the new wine is found in the cluster , and one says , ' Don't destroy it , for a blessing is in it : ' so I will do for my servants ' sake , that I may not destroy them all .

verses.z: 我必從雅各中領出後裔，從猶大中領出承受我眾山的。我的選民必承受；我的僕人要在那裏居住。
verses.e: I will bring offspring out of Jacob , and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains . My chosen will inherit it , and my servants will dwell there .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：天是我的座位；地是我的腳凳。你們要為我造何等的殿宇？哪裏是我安息的地方呢？
verses.e: The LORD says : " Heaven is my throne , and the earth is my footstool . What kind of house will you build to me ? Where will I rest ?

verses.z: 你們愛慕耶路撒冷的都要與她一同歡喜快樂；你們為她悲哀的都要與她一同樂上加樂；
verses.e: " Rejoice with Jerusalem , and be glad for her , all you who love her . Rejoice for joy with her , all you who mourn over her ;

verses.z: 使你們在她安慰的懷中吃奶得飽，使他們得她豐盛的榮耀，猶如擠奶，滿心喜樂。
verses.e: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts ; that you may drink deeply , and be delighted with the abundance of her glory . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：我要使平安延及她，好像江河，使列國的榮耀延及她，如同漲溢的河。你們要[從中]享受；你們必蒙抱在肋旁，搖弄在膝上。
verses.e: For the LORD says , " Behold , I will extend peace to her like a river , and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream , and you will nurse . You will be carried on her side , and will be dandled on her knees .

verses.z: 母親怎樣安慰兒子，我就照樣安慰你們；你們也必因耶路撒冷得安慰。
verses.e: As one whom his mother comforts , so I will comfort you . You will be comforted in Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 你們看見，就心中快樂；你們的骨頭必得滋潤像嫩草一樣；而且耶和華的手向他僕人所行的必被人知道；他也要向仇敵發惱恨。
verses.e: You will see it , and your heart shall rejoice , and your bones will flourish like the tender grass . The LORD's hand will be known among his servants ; and he will have indignation against his enemies .

verses.z: 看哪，耶和華必在火中降臨；他的車輦像旋風，以烈怒施行報應，以火焰施行責罰；
verses.e: For , behold , the LORD will come with fire , and his chariots will be like the whirlwind ; to give his anger with fierceness , and his rebuke with flames of fire .

verses.z: 因為耶和華在一切有血氣的人身上，必以火與刀施行審判；被耶和華所殺的必多。
verses.e: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh ; and those slain by the LORD will be many .

verses.z: 「那些分別為聖、潔淨自己的，進入園內跟在其中一個人的後頭，吃豬肉和倉鼠並可憎之物，他們必一同滅絕；這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens , following one in the middle , eating pig's meat , abominable things , and the mouse , they shall come to an end together , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 「[我知道]他們的行為和他們的意念。[時候]將到，我必將萬民萬族聚來，看見我的榮耀，
verses.e: " For I know their works and their thoughts . The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages , and they will come , and will see my glory .

verses.z: 我要顯神蹟在他們中間。逃脫的，我要差到列國去，就是到他施、普勒、拉弓的路德和土巴、雅完，並素來沒有聽見我名聲、沒有看見我榮耀遼遠的海島；他們必將我的榮耀傳揚在列國中。
verses.e: " I will set a sign among them , and I will send those who escape of them to the nations , to Tarshish , Pul , and Lud , who draw the bow , to Tubal and Javan , to far-away islands , who have not heard my fame , nor have seen my glory ; and they shall declare my glory among the nations .

verses.z: 耶和華說：這一切都是我手所造的，所以就都有了。但我所看顧的，就是虛心痛悔、因我話而戰兢的人。
verses.e: For my hand has made all these things , and so all these things came to be , " says the LORD : " but I will look to this man , even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit , and who trembles at my word .

verses.z: 他們必將你們的弟兄從列國中送回，使他們或騎馬，或坐車，坐轎，騎騾子，騎獨峰駝，到我的聖山耶路撒冷，作為供物獻給耶和華，好像以色列人用潔淨的器皿盛供物奉到耶和華的殿中；這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD , on horses , in chariots , in litters , on mules , and on camels , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , says the LORD , as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD's house .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我也必從他們中間取人為祭司，為利未人。」
verses.e: Of them I will also select priests and Levites , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我所要造的新天新地，怎樣在我面前長存；你們的後裔和你們的名字也必照樣長存。
verses.e: " For as the new heavens and the new earth , which I will make , shall remain before me , " says the LORD , " so your offspring and your name shall remain .

verses.z: 每逢月朔、安息日，凡有血氣的必來在我面前下拜。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: It shall happen that from one new moon to another , and from one Sabbath to another , all flesh will come to worship before me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 他們必出去觀看那些違背我人的屍首；因為他們的蟲是不死的；他們的火是不滅的；凡有血氣的都必憎惡他們。
verses.e: " They will go out , and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me ; for their worm will not die , nor will their fire be quenched , and they will be loathsome to all mankind . "

verses.z: [假冒為善的]宰牛，好像殺人，獻羊羔，好像打折狗項，獻供物，好像獻豬血，燒乳香，好像稱頌偶像。這等人揀選自己的道路，心裏喜悅行可憎惡的事。
verses.e: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man ; he who sacrifices a lamb , as he who breaks a dog's neck ; he who offers an offering , as he who offers pig's blood ; he who burns frankincense , as he who blesses an idol . Yes , they have chosen their own ways , and their soul delights in their abominations .

verses.z: 我也必揀選迷惑他們的事，使他們所懼怕的臨到他們；因為我呼喚，無人答應；我說話，他們不聽從；反倒行我眼中看為惡的，揀選我所不喜悅的。
verses.e: I also will choose their delusions , and will bring their fears on them , because when I called , no one answered ; when I spoke , they didn't listen , but they did that which was evil in my eyes , and chose that in which I didn't delight . "

verses.z: 你們因耶和華言語戰兢的人當聽他的話：你們的弟兄－就是恨惡你們，因我名趕出你們的，曾說：願耶和華得榮耀，使我們得見你們的喜樂；但蒙羞的究竟是他們！
verses.e: Hear the LORD's word , you who tremble at his word : " Your brothers who hate you , who cast you out for my name's sake , have said , ' Let the LORD be glorified , that we may see your joy ; ' but it is those who shall be disappointed .

verses.z: 有喧嘩的聲音出自城中！有聲音出於殿中！是耶和華向仇敵施行報應的聲音！
verses.e: A voice of tumult from the city , a voice from the temple , a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve .

verses.z: 錫安未曾劬勞就生產，未覺疼痛就生出男孩。
verses.e: " Before she travailed , she gave birth . Before her pain came , she delivered a son .

verses.z: 國豈能一日而生？民豈能一時而產？因為錫安一劬勞便生下兒女，這樣的事誰曾聽見？誰曾看見呢？
verses.e: Who has heard of such a thing ? Who has seen such things ? Shall a land be born in one day ? Shall a nation be born at once ? For as soon as Zion travailed , she gave birth to her children .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我既使她臨產，豈不使她生產呢？你的上帝說：我既使她生產，豈能使她閉[胎]不生呢？
verses.e: Shall I bring to the birth , and not cause to be delivered ? " says the LORD . " Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb ? " says your God .

verses.z: 烏西雅的孫子、約坦的兒子、猶大王亞哈斯[在位]的時候，亞蘭王利汛和利瑪利的兒子、以色列王比加上來攻打耶路撒冷，卻不能攻取。
verses.e: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham , the son of Uzziah , king of Judah , Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah , king of Israel , went up to Jerusalem to war against it , but could not prevail against it .

verses.z: 耶和華又曉諭亞哈斯說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz , saying ,

verses.z: 「你向耶和華－你的上帝求一個兆頭：或求[顯]在深處，或求[顯]在高處。」
verses.e: " Ask a sign of the LORD your God ; ask it either in the depth , or in the height above . "

verses.z: 亞哈斯說：「我不求；我不試探耶和華。」
verses.e: But Ahaz said , " I won't ask . I won't tempt the LORD . "

verses.z: 以賽亞說：「大衛家啊，你們當聽！你們使人厭煩豈算小事，還要使我的上帝厭煩嗎？
verses.e: He said , " Listen now , house of David . Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men , that you will try the patience of my God also ?

verses.z: 因此，主自己要給你們一個兆頭，必有童女懷孕生子，給他起名叫以馬內利。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign . Behold , the virgin will conceive , and bear a son , and shall call his name Immanuel .

verses.z: 到他曉得棄惡擇善的時候，他必吃奶油與蜂蜜。
verses.e: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good .

verses.z: 因為在這孩子還不曉得棄惡擇善之先，你所憎惡的那二王之地必致見棄。
verses.e: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good , the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken .

verses.z: 耶和華必使亞述王[攻擊你]的日子臨到你和你的百姓，並你的父家，自從以法蓮離開猶大以來，未曾有這樣的日子。
verses.e: The LORD will bring on you , on your people , and on your father's house days that have not come , from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah , even the king of Assyria .

verses.z: 「那時，耶和華要發嘶聲，使埃及江河源頭的蒼蠅和亞述地的蜂子飛來；
verses.e: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .

verses.z: 都必飛來，落在荒涼的谷內、磐石的穴裏，和一切荊棘籬笆中，並一切的草場上。
verses.e: They shall come , and shall all rest in the desolate valleys , in the clefts of the rocks , on all thorn hedges , and on all pastures .

verses.z: 有人告訴大衛家說：「亞蘭與以法蓮已經同盟。」王的心和百姓的心就都跳動，好像林中的樹被風吹動一樣。
verses.e: David's house was told , " Syria is allied with Ephraim . " His heart trembled , and the heart of his people , as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind .

verses.z: 「那時，主必用大河外賃的剃頭刀，就是亞述王，剃去頭髮和腳上的毛，並要剃淨鬍鬚。
verses.e: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River , even with the king of Assyria , the head and the hair of the feet ; and it shall also consume the beard .

verses.z: 「那時，一個人要養活一隻母牛犢，兩隻母綿羊；
verses.e: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow , and two sheep .

verses.z: 因為出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境內所剩的人都要吃奶油與蜂蜜。
verses.e: It shall happen , that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter , for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land .

verses.z: 「從前，凡種一千棵葡萄樹、值銀一千[舍客勒]的地方，到那時必長荊棘和蒺藜。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels , will be for briers and thorns .

verses.z: 人上那裏去，必帶弓箭，因為遍地滿了荊棘和蒺藜。
verses.e: People will go there with arrows and with bow , because all the land will be briers and thorns .

verses.z: 所有用鋤刨挖的山地，你因怕荊棘和蒺藜，不敢上那裏去；只可成了放牛之處，為羊踐踏之地。」
verses.e: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe , you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns ; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen , and for sheep to tread on . "

verses.z: 耶和華對以賽亞說：「你和你的兒子施亞雅述出去，到上池的水溝頭，在漂布地的大路上，去迎接亞哈斯，
verses.e: Then the LORD said to Isaiah , " Go out now to meet Ahaz , you , and Shearjashub your son , at the end of the conduit of the upper pool , on the highway of the fuller's field .

verses.z: 對他說：『你要謹慎安靜，不要因亞蘭[王]利汛和利瑪利的兒子這兩個冒煙的火把頭所發的烈怒害怕，也不要心裏膽怯。
verses.e: Tell him , ' Be careful , and keep calm . Don't be afraid , neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches , for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria , and of the son of Remaliah .

verses.z: 因為亞蘭和以法蓮，並利瑪利的兒子，設惡謀害你，
verses.e: Because Syria , Ephraim , and the son of Remaliah , have plotted evil against you , saying ,

verses.z: 說：我們可以上去攻擊猶大，擾亂它，攻破它，在其中立他比勒的兒子為王。
verses.e: " Let's go up against Judah , and tear it apart , and let's divide it among ourselves , and set up a king within it , even the son of Tabeel . "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：這所謀的必立不住，也不得成就。
verses.e: This is what the Lord GOD says : " It shall not stand , neither shall it happen . "

verses.z: 原來亞蘭的首城是大馬士革；大馬士革的首領是利汛。（六十五年之內，以法蓮必然破壞，不再成為國民。）
verses.e: For the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rezin . Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces , so that it shall not be a people .

verses.z: 以法蓮的首城是撒馬利亞；撒馬利亞的首領是利瑪利的兒子。你們若是不信，定然不得立穩。』」
verses.e: The head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son . If you will not believe , surely you shall not be established . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「你取一個大牌，拿人所用的筆，寫上『瑪黑珥‧沙拉勒‧哈施‧罷斯』。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Take a large tablet , and write on it with a man's pen , ' For Maher Shalal Hash Baz ' ;

verses.z: 任憑你們同謀，終歸無有；任憑你們言定，終不成立；因為上帝與我們同在。
verses.e: Take counsel together , and it will be brought to nothing ; speak the word , and it will not stand , for God is with us . "

verses.z: 耶和華以大能的手，指教我不可行這百姓所行的道，對我這樣說：
verses.e: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand , and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people , saying ,

verses.z: 「這百姓說同謀背叛，你們不要說同謀背叛。他們所怕的，你們不要怕，也不要畏懼。
verses.e: " Don't call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy . Don't fear their threats or be terrorized .

verses.z: 但要尊萬軍之耶和華為聖，以他為你們所當怕的，所當畏懼的。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy . He is the one you must fear . He is the one you must dread .

verses.z: 他必作為聖所，卻向以色列兩家作絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石；向耶路撒冷的居民作為圈套和網羅。
verses.e: He will be a sanctuary , but for both houses of Israel , he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall . For the people of Jerusalem , he will be a trap and a snare .

verses.z: 許多人必在其上絆腳跌倒，而且跌碎，並陷入網羅，被纏住。」
verses.e: Many will stumble over it , fall , be broken , be snared , and be captured . "

verses.z: 你要捲起律法[書]，在我門徒中間封住訓誨。
verses.e: Wrap up the covenant . Seal the law among my disciples .

verses.z: 我要等候那掩面不顧雅各家的耶和華；我也要仰望他。
verses.e: I will wait for the LORD , who hides his face from the house of Jacob , and I will look for him .

verses.z: 看哪，我與耶和華所給我的兒女，就是從住在錫安山萬軍之耶和華來的，在以色列中作為預兆和奇蹟。
verses.e: Behold , I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies , who dwells in Mount Zion .

verses.z: 有人對你們說：「當求問那些交鬼的和行巫術的，就是聲音綿蠻，言語微細的。」[你們便回答說]：「百姓不當求問自己的上帝嗎？豈可為活人[求問]死人呢？」
verses.e: When they tell you , " Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards , who chirp and who mutter , " shouldn't a people consult with their God ? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living ?

verses.z: 我要用誠實的見證人，祭司烏利亞和耶比利家的兒子撒迦利亞記錄這事。」
verses.e: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify : Uriah the priest , and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah . "

verses.z: 人當以訓誨和法度為標準；他們所說的，若不與此相符，必不得見晨光。
verses.e: Turn to the law and to the covenant ! If they don't speak according to this word , surely there is no morning for them .

verses.z: 他們必經過這地，受艱難，受飢餓；飢餓的時候，心中焦躁，咒罵自己的君王和自己的上帝。
verses.e: They will pass through it , very distressed and hungry . It will happen that when they are hungry , they will worry , and curse their king and their God . They will turn their faces upward ,

verses.z: 仰觀上天，俯察下地，不料，盡是艱難、黑暗，和幽暗的痛苦。[他們必]被趕入烏黑的黑暗中去。
verses.e: then look to the earth and see distress , darkness , and the gloom of anguish . They will be driven into thick darkness .

verses.z: 我－[以賽亞]與妻子同室；她懷孕生子，耶和華就對我說：「給他起名叫瑪黑珥‧沙拉勒‧哈施‧罷斯；
verses.e: I went to the prophetess , and she conceived , and bore a son . Then the LORD said to me , " Call his name ' Maher Shalal Hash Baz . '

verses.z: 因為在這小孩子不曉得叫父叫母之先，大馬士革的財寶和撒馬利亞的擄物必在亞述王面前搬了去。」
verses.e: For before the child knows how to say , ' My father ' and ' My mother , ' the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria . "

verses.z: 耶和華又曉諭我說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to me yet again , saying ,

verses.z: 「這百姓既厭棄西羅亞緩流的水，喜悅利汛和利瑪利的兒子；
verses.e: " Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly , and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son ;

verses.z: 因此，主必使大河翻騰的水猛然沖來，就是亞述王和他所有的威勢，必漫過一切的水道，漲過兩岸；
verses.e: now therefore , behold , the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River : the king of Assyria and all his glory . It will come up over all its channels , and go over all its banks .

verses.z: 必沖入猶大，漲溢氾濫，直到頸項。以馬內利啊，他展開翅膀，遍滿你的地。」
verses.e: It will sweep onward into Judah . It will overflow and pass through . It will reach even to the neck . The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land , O Immanuel .

verses.z: 列國的人民哪，任憑你們喧嚷，終必破壞；遠方的眾人哪，當側耳而聽！任憑你們束起腰來，終必破壞；你們束起腰來，終必破壞。
verses.e: Make an uproar , you peoples , and be broken in pieces ! Listen , all you from far countries : dress for battle , and be shattered ! Dress for battle , and be shattered !

verses.z: 但那受過痛苦的必不再見幽暗。從前上帝使西布倫地和拿弗他利地被藐視，末後卻使這沿海的路，約旦河外，外邦人的加利利地得着榮耀。
verses.e: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish . In the former time , he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali ; but in the latter time he has made it glorious , by the way of the sea , beyond the Jordan , Galilee of the nations .

verses.z: 磚[牆]塌了，我們卻要鑿石頭建築；桑樹砍了，我們卻要換香柏樹。
verses.e: " The bricks have fallen , but we will build with cut stone . The sycamore fig trees have been cut down , but we will put cedars in their place . "

verses.z: 因此，耶和華要高舉利汛的敵人來攻擊以色列，並要激動以色列的仇敵。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin , and will stir up his enemies ,

verses.z: 東有亞蘭人，西有非利士人；他們張口要吞吃以色列。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
verses.e: The Syrians in front , and the Philistines behind ; and they will devour Israel with open mouth . For all this , his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .

verses.z: 這百姓還沒有歸向擊打他們的主，也沒有尋求萬軍之耶和華。
verses.e: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them , neither have they sought the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 因此，耶和華一日之間必從以色列中剪除頭與尾，棕枝與蘆葦－
verses.e: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail , palm branch and reed , in one day .

verses.z: 長老和尊貴人就是頭，以謊言教人的先知就是尾。
verses.e: The elder and the honorable man is the head , and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail .

verses.z: 因為，引導這百姓的使他們走錯了路；被引導的都必敗亡。
verses.e: For those who lead this people lead them astray ; and those who are led by them are destroyed .

verses.z: 所以，主必不喜悅他們的少年人，也不憐恤他們的孤兒寡婦；因為，各人是褻瀆的，是行惡的，並且各人的口都說愚妄的話。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
verses.e: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men , neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows ; for everyone is profane and an evildoer , and every mouth speaks folly . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .

verses.z: 邪惡像火焚燒，燒滅荊棘和蒺藜，在稠密的樹林中着起來，就成為煙柱，旋轉上騰。
verses.e: For wickedness burns like a fire . It devours the briers and thorns ; yes , it kindles in the thickets of the forest , and they roll upward in a column of smoke .

verses.z: 因萬軍之耶和華的烈怒，地都燒遍；百姓成為火柴；無人憐愛弟兄。
verses.e: Through the LORD of Armies ' wrath , the land is burned up ; and the people are the fuel for the fire . No one spares his brother .

verses.z: 在黑暗中行走的百姓看見了大光；住在死蔭之地的人有光照耀他們。
verses.e: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light . The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death .

verses.z: 有人右邊搶奪，仍受飢餓，左邊吞吃，仍不飽足；各人吃自己膀臂上的肉。
verses.e: One will devour on the right hand , and be hungry ; and he will eat on the left hand , and they will not be satisfied . Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm :

verses.z: 瑪拿西[吞吃]以法蓮；以法蓮[吞吃]瑪拿西，又一同攻擊猶大。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
verses.e: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh , and they together will be against Judah . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .

verses.z: 你使這國民繁多，加增他們的喜樂；他們在你面前歡喜，好像收割的歡喜，像人分擄物那樣的快樂。
verses.e: You have multiplied the nation . You have increased their joy . They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest , as men rejoice when they divide the plunder .

verses.z: 因為他們所負的重軛和肩頭上的杖，並欺壓他們人的棍，你都已經折斷，好像在米甸的日子一樣。
verses.e: For the yoke of his burden , and the staff of his shoulder , the rod of his oppressor , you have broken as in the day of Midian .

verses.z: 戰士在亂殺之間所穿戴的盔甲，並那滾在血中的衣服，都必作為可燒的，當作火柴。
verses.e: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle , and the garments rolled in blood , will be for burning , fuel for the fire .

verses.z: 因有一嬰孩為我們而生；有一子賜給我們。政權必擔在他的肩頭上；他名稱為「奇妙策士、全能的上帝、永在的父、和平的君」。
verses.e: For a child is born to us . A son is given to us ; and the government will be on his shoulders . His name will be called Wonderful Counselor , Mighty God , Everlasting Father , Prince of Peace .

verses.z: 他的政權與平安必加增無窮。他必在大衛的寶座上治理他的國，以公平公義使國堅定穩固，從今直到永遠。萬軍之耶和華的熱心必成就這事。
verses.e: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end , on David's throne , and on his kingdom , to establish it , and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on , even forever . The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this .

verses.z: 主使一言入於雅各[家]，落於以色列[家]。
verses.e: The Lord sent a word into Jacob , and it falls on Israel .

verses.z: 這眾百姓，就是以法蓮和撒馬利亞的居民，都要知道；他們憑驕傲自大的心說：
verses.e: All the people will know , including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria , who say in pride and in arrogance of heart ,

verses.z: 作上帝和主耶穌基督僕人的雅各請散住十二個支派之人的安。
verses.e: James , a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ , to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion : Greetings .

verses.z: 富足的降卑，也該如此；因為他必要過去，如同草上的花一樣。
verses.e: and the rich , in that he is made humble , because like the flower in the grass , he will pass away .

verses.z: 太陽出來，熱風颳起，草就枯乾，花也凋謝，美容就消沒了；那富足的人，在他所行的事上也要這樣衰殘。
verses.e: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass ; and the flower in it falls , and the beauty of its appearance perishes . So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits .

verses.z: 忍受試探的人是有福的，因為他經過試驗以後，必得生命的冠冕；這是[主]應許給那些愛他之人的。
verses.e: Blessed is a person who endures temptation , for when he has been approved , he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him .

verses.z: 人被試探，不可說：「我是被上帝試探」；因為上帝不能被惡試探，他也不試探人。
verses.e: Let no man say when he is tempted , " I am tempted by God , " for God can't be tempted by evil , and he himself tempts no one .

verses.z: 但各人被試探，乃是被自己的私慾牽引誘惑的。
verses.e: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed .

verses.z: 私慾既懷了胎，就生出罪來；罪既長成，就生出死來。
verses.e: Then the lust , when it has conceived , bears sin . The sin , when it is full grown , produces death .

verses.z: 我親愛的弟兄們，不要看錯了。
verses.e: Don't be deceived , my beloved brothers .

verses.z: 各樣美善的恩賜和各樣全備的賞賜都是從上頭來的，從眾光之父那裏降下來的；在他並沒有改變，也沒有轉動的影兒。
verses.e: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above , coming down from the Father of lights , with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow .

verses.z: 他按自己的旨意，用真道生了我們，叫我們在他所造的萬物中好像初熟的果子。
verses.e: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth , that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures .

verses.z: 我親愛的弟兄們，這是你們所知道的。但你們各人要快快地聽，慢慢地說，慢慢地動怒，
verses.e: So , then , my beloved brothers , let every man be swift to hear , slow to speak , and slow to anger ;

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，你們落在百般試煉中，都要以為大喜樂；
verses.e: Count it all joy , my brothers , when you fall into various temptations ,

verses.z: 因為人的怒氣並不成就上帝的義。
verses.e: for the anger of man doesn't produce the righteousness of God .

verses.z: 所以，你們要脫去一切的污穢和盈餘的邪惡，存溫柔的心領受那所栽種的道，就是能救你們靈魂的道。
verses.e: Therefore , putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness , receive with humility the implanted word , which is able to save your souls .

verses.z: 只是你們要行道，不要單單聽道，自己欺哄自己。
verses.e: But be doers of the word , and not only hearers , deluding your own selves .

verses.z: 因為聽道而不行道的，就像人對着鏡子看自己本來的面目，
verses.e: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer , he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror ;

verses.z: 看見，走後，隨即忘了他的相貌如何。
verses.e: for he sees himself , and goes away , and immediately forgets what kind of man he was .

verses.z: 惟有詳細察看那全備、[使人]自由之律法的，並且時常如此，這人既不是聽了就忘，乃是實在行出來，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
verses.e: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues , not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work , this man will be blessed in what he does .

verses.z: 若有人自以為虔誠，卻不勒住他的舌頭，反欺哄自己的心，這人的虔誠是虛的。
verses.e: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn't bridle his tongue , but deceives his heart , this man's religion is worthless .

verses.z: 在上帝我們的父面前，那清潔沒有玷污的虔誠，就是看顧在患難中的孤兒寡婦，並且保守自己不沾染世俗。
verses.e: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this : to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction , and to keep oneself unstained by the world .

verses.z: 因為知道你們的信心經過試驗，就生忍耐。
verses.e: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance .

verses.z: 但忍耐也當成功，使你們成全、完備，毫無缺欠。
verses.e: Let endurance have its perfect work , that you may be perfect and complete , lacking in nothing .

verses.z: 你們中間若有缺少智慧的，應當求那厚賜與眾人、也不斥責人的上帝，[主]就必賜給他。
verses.e: But if any of you lacks wisdom , let him ask of God , who gives to all liberally and without reproach , and it will be given to him .

verses.z: 只要憑着信心求，一點不疑惑；因為那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被風吹動翻騰。
verses.e: But let him ask in faith , without any doubting , for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea , driven by the wind and tossed .

verses.z: 這樣的人不要想從主那裏得甚麼。
verses.e: For that man shouldn't think that he will receive anything from the Lord .

verses.z: 心懷二意的人，在他一切所行的路上都沒有定見。
verses.e: He is a double-minded man , unstable in all his ways .

verses.z: 卑微的弟兄升高，就該喜樂；
verses.e: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position ;

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，你們信奉我們榮耀的主耶穌基督，便不可按着外貌待人。
verses.e: My brothers , don't hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality .

verses.z: 因為凡遵守全律法的，只在一條上跌倒，他就是犯了眾條。
verses.e: For whoever keeps the whole law , and yet stumbles in one point , he has become guilty of all .

verses.z: 原來那說「不可姦淫」的，也說「不可殺人」；你就是不姦淫，卻殺人，仍是成了犯律法的。
verses.e: For he who said , " Do not commit adultery , " also said , " Do not commit murder . " Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder , you have become a transgressor of the law .

verses.z: 你們既然要按[使人]自由的律法受審判，就該照這律法說話行事。
verses.e: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom .

verses.z: 因為那不憐憫人的，也要受無憐憫的審判；憐憫原是向審判誇勝。
verses.e: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy . Mercy triumphs over judgment .

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，若有人說自己有信心，卻沒有行為，有甚麼益處呢？這信心能救他嗎？
verses.e: What good is it , my brothers , if a man says he has faith , but has no works ? Can faith save him ?

verses.z: 若是弟兄或是姊妹，赤身露體，又缺了日用的飲食；
verses.e: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food ,

verses.z: 你們中間有人對他們說：「平平安安地去吧！願你們穿得暖，吃得飽」，卻不給他們身體所需用的，這有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: and one of you tells them , " Go in peace . Be warmed and filled ; " yet you didn't give them the things the body needs , what good is it ?

verses.z: 這樣，信心若沒有行為就是死的。
verses.e: Even so faith , if it has no works , is dead in itself .

verses.z: 必有人說：「你有信心，我有行為；你將你沒有行為的信心指給我看，我便藉着我的行為，將我的信心指給你看。」
verses.e: Yes , a man will say , " You have faith , and I have works . " Show me your faith without works , and I will show you my faith by my works .

verses.z: 你信上帝只有一位，你信的不錯；鬼魔也信，卻是戰驚。
verses.e: You believe that God is one . You do well . The demons also believe — and shudder .

verses.z: 若有一個人帶着金戒指，穿着華美衣服，進你們的會堂去；又有一個窮人穿着骯髒衣服也進去；
verses.e: For if a man with a gold ring , in fine clothing , comes into your synagogue , and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in ,

verses.z: 虛浮的人哪，你願意知道沒有行為的信心是死的嗎？
verses.e: But do you want to know , vain man , that faith apart from works is dead ?

verses.z: 我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕把他兒子以撒獻在壇上，豈不是因行為稱義嗎？
verses.e: Wasn't Abraham our father justified by works , in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar ?

verses.z: 可見，信心是與他的行為並行，而且信心因着行為才得成全。
verses.e: You see that faith worked with his works , and by works faith was perfected .

verses.z: 這就應驗經上所說：「亞伯拉罕信上帝，這就算為他的義。」他又得稱為上帝的朋友。
verses.e: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says , " Abraham believed God , and it was accounted to him as righteousness , " and he was called the friend of God .

verses.z: 這樣看來，人稱義是因着行為，不是單因着信。
verses.e: You see then that by works a man is justified , and not only by faith .

verses.z: 妓女喇合接待使者，又放他們從別的路上出去，不也是一樣因行為稱義嗎？
verses.e: In the same way , wasn't Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way ?

verses.z: 身體沒有靈魂是死的，信心沒有行為也是死的。
verses.e: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead , even so faith apart from works is dead .

verses.z: 你們就重看那穿華美衣服的人，說：「請坐在這好位上」；又對那窮人說：「你站在那裏」，或「坐在我腳凳下邊。」
verses.e: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say , " Sit here in a good place ; " and you tell the poor man , " Stand there , " or " Sit by my footstool "

verses.z: 這豈不是你們偏心待人，用惡意斷定人嗎？
verses.e: haven't you shown partiality among yourselves , and become judges with evil thoughts ?

verses.z: 我親愛的弟兄們，請聽，上帝豈不是揀選了世上的貧窮人，叫他們在信上富足，並承受他所應許給那些愛他之人的國嗎？
verses.e: Listen , my beloved brothers . Didn't God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him ?

verses.z: 你們反倒羞辱貧窮人。那富足人豈不是欺壓你們、拉你們到公堂去嗎？
verses.e: But you have dishonored the poor man . Don't the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts ?

verses.z: 他們不是褻瀆你們所敬奉的尊名嗎？
verses.e: Don't they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called ?

verses.z: 經上記着說：「要愛人如己。」你們若全守這至尊的律法才是好的。
verses.e: However , if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture , " You shall love your neighbor as yourself , " you do well .

verses.z: 但你們若按外貌待人，便是犯罪，被律法定為犯法的。
verses.e: But if you show partiality , you commit sin , being convicted by the law as transgressors .

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，不要多人作師傅，因為曉得我們要受更重的判斷。
verses.e: Let not many of you be teachers , my brothers , knowing that we will receive heavier judgment .

verses.z: 頌讚和咒詛從一個口裏出來！我的弟兄們，這是不應當的！
verses.e: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing . My brothers , these things ought not to be so .

verses.z: 泉源從一個眼裏能發出甜苦兩樣的水嗎？
verses.e: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water ?

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，無花果樹能生橄欖嗎？葡萄樹能結無花果嗎？鹹水裏也不能發出甜水來。
verses.e: Can a fig tree , my brothers , yield olives , or a vine figs ? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water .

verses.z: 你們中間誰是有智慧有見識的呢？他就當在智慧的溫柔上顯出他的善行來。
verses.e: Who is wise and understanding among you ? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom .

verses.z: 你們心裏若懷着苦毒的嫉妒和紛爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。
verses.e: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart , don't boast and don't lie against the truth .

verses.z: 這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。
verses.e: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above , but is earthly , sensual , and demonic .

verses.z: 在何處有嫉妒、紛爭，就在何處有擾亂和各樣的壞事。
verses.e: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are , there is confusion and every evil deed .

verses.z: 惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。
verses.e: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure , then peaceful , gentle , reasonable , full of mercy and good fruits , without partiality , and without hypocrisy .

verses.z: 並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。
verses.e: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace .

verses.z: 原來我們在許多事上都有過失；若有人在話語上沒有過失，他就是完全人，也能勒住自己的全身。
verses.e: For we all stumble in many things . Anyone who doesn't stumble in word is a perfect person , able to bridle the whole body also .

verses.z: 我們若把嚼環放在馬嘴裏，叫牠順服，就能調動牠的全身。
verses.e: Indeed , we put bits into the horses ' mouths so that they may obey us , and we guide their whole body .

verses.z: 看哪，船隻雖然甚大，又被大風催逼，只用小小的舵，就隨着掌舵的意思轉動。
verses.e: Behold , the ships also , though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds , are yet guided by a very small rudder , wherever the pilot desires .

verses.z: 這樣，舌頭在百體裏也是最小的，卻能說大話。看哪，最小的火能點着最大的樹林。
verses.e: So the tongue is also a little member , and boasts great things . See how a small fire can spread to a large forest !

verses.z: 舌頭就是火，在我們百體中，舌頭是個罪惡的世界，能污穢全身，也能把生命的輪子點起來，並且是從地獄裏點着的。
verses.e: And the tongue is a fire . The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue , which defiles the whole body , and sets on fire the course of nature , and is set on fire by Gehenna .

verses.z: 各類的走獸、飛禽、昆蟲、水族，本來都可以制伏，也已經被人制伏了；
verses.e: For every kind of animal , bird , creeping thing , and sea creature is tamed , and has been tamed by mankind ;

verses.z: 惟獨舌頭沒有人能制伏，是不止息的惡物，滿了害死人的毒氣。
verses.e: but nobody can tame the tongue . It is a restless evil , full of deadly poison .

verses.z: 我們用舌頭頌讚那為主、為父的，又用舌頭咒詛那照着上帝形像被造的人。
verses.e: With it we bless our God and Father , and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God .

verses.z: 你們中間的爭戰鬥毆是從哪裏來的呢？不是從你們百體中戰鬥之私慾來的嗎？
verses.e: Where do wars and fightings among you come from ? Don't they come from your pleasures that war in your members ?

verses.z: 務要在主面前自卑，主就必叫你們升高。
verses.e: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord , and he will exalt you .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們不可彼此批評。人若批評弟兄，論斷弟兄，就是批評律法，論斷律法。你若論斷律法，就不是遵行律法，乃是判斷人的。
verses.e: Don't speak against one another , brothers . He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother , speaks against the law and judges the law . But if you judge the law , you are not a doer of the law but a judge .

verses.z: 設立律法和判斷人的，只有一位，就是那能救人也能滅人的。你是誰，竟敢論斷別人呢？
verses.e: Only one is the lawgiver , who is able to save and to destroy . But who are you to judge another ?

verses.z: 嗐！你們有話說：「今天明天我們要往某城裏去，在那裏住一年，做買賣得利。」
verses.e: Come now , you who say , " Today or tomorrow let's go into this city and spend a year there , trade , and make a profit . "

verses.z: 其實明天如何，你們還不知道。你們的生命是甚麼呢？你們原來是一片雲霧，出現少時就不見了。
