verses.e: Yet you don't know what your life will be like tomorrow . For what is your life ? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away .

verses.z: 你們只當說：「主若願意，我們就可以活着，也可以做這事，或做那事。」
verses.e: For you ought to say , " If the Lord wills , we will both live , and do this or that . "

verses.z: 現今你們竟以張狂誇口；凡這樣誇口都是惡的。
verses.e: But now you glory in your boasting . All such boasting is evil .

verses.z: 人若知道行善，卻不去行，這就是他的罪了。
verses.e: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn't do it , to him it is sin .

verses.z: 你們貪戀，還是得不着；你們殺害嫉妒，又鬥毆爭戰，也不能得。你們得不着，是因為你們不求。
verses.e: You lust , and don't have . You murder and covet , and can't obtain . You fight and make war . You don't have , because you don't ask .

verses.z: 你們求也得不着，是因為你們妄求，要浪費在你們的宴樂中。
verses.e: You ask , and don't receive , because you ask with wrong motives , so that you may spend it on your pleasures .

verses.z: 你們這些淫亂的人哪，豈不知與世俗為友就是與上帝為敵嗎？所以凡想要與世俗為友的，就是與上帝為敵了。
verses.e: You adulterers and adulteresses , don't you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God ? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God .

verses.z: 你們想經上所說是徒然的嗎？上帝所賜、住在我們裏面的靈，是戀愛至於嫉妒嗎？
verses.e: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain , " The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously " ?

verses.z: 但他賜更多的恩典，所以經上說：上帝阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
verses.e: But he gives more grace . Therefore it says , " God resists the proud , but gives grace to the humble . "

verses.z: 故此，你們要順服上帝。務要抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。
verses.e: Be subject therefore to God . Resist the devil , and he will flee from you .

verses.z: 你們親近上帝，上帝就必親近你們。有罪的人哪，要潔淨你們的手！心懷二意的人哪，要清潔你們的心！
verses.e: Draw near to God , and he will draw near to you . Cleanse your hands , you sinners . Purify your hearts , you double-minded .

verses.z: 你們要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣，將喜笑變作悲哀，歡樂變作愁悶。
verses.e: Lament , mourn , and weep . Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom .

verses.z: 嗐！你們這些富足人哪，應當哭泣、號咷，因為將有苦難臨到你們身上。
verses.e: Come now , you rich , weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們要把那先前奉主名說話的眾先知當作能受苦能忍耐的榜樣。
verses.e: Take , brothers , for an example of suffering and of perseverance , the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord .

verses.z: 那先前忍耐的人，我們稱他們是有福的。你們聽見過約伯的忍耐，也知道主[給他]的結局，明顯主是滿心憐憫，大有慈悲。
verses.e: Behold , we call them blessed who endured . You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome , and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy .

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，最要緊的是不可起誓；不可指着天起誓，也不可指着地起誓，無論何誓都不可起。你們說話，是，就說是；不是，就說不是，免得你們落在審判之下。
verses.e: But above all things , my brothers , don't swear — not by heaven , or by the earth , or by any other oath ; but let your " yes " be " yes " , and your " no " , " no " , so that you don't fall into hypocrisy .

verses.z: 你們中間有受苦的呢，他就該禱告；有喜樂的呢，他就該歌頌。
verses.e: Is any among you suffering ? Let him pray . Is any cheerful ? Let him sing praises .

verses.z: 你們中間有病了的呢，他就該請教會的長老來；他們可以奉主的名用油抹他，為他禱告。
verses.e: Is any among you sick ? Let him call for the elders of the assembly , and let them pray over him , anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord ;

verses.z: 出於信心的祈禱要救那病人，主必叫他起來；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
verses.e: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick , and the Lord will raise him up . If he has committed sins , he will be forgiven .

verses.z: 所以你們要彼此認罪，互相代求，使你們可以得醫治。義人祈禱所發的力量是大有功效的。
verses.e: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another , that you may be healed . The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective .

verses.z: 以利亞與我們是一樣性情的人，他懇切禱告，求不要下雨，雨就三年零六個月不下在地上。
verses.e: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours , and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain , and it didn't rain on the earth for three years and six months .

verses.z: 他又禱告，天就降下雨來，地也生出土產。
verses.e: He prayed again , and the sky gave rain , and the earth produced its fruit .

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，你們中間若有失迷真道的，有人使他回轉，
verses.e: Brothers , if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back ,

verses.z: 你們的財物壞了，衣服也被蟲子咬了。
verses.e: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten .

verses.z: 這人該知道：叫一個罪人從迷路上轉回便是救一個靈魂不死，並且遮蓋許多的罪。
verses.e: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins .

verses.z: 你們的金銀都長了銹；那銹要證明你們的不是，又要吃你們的肉，如同火燒。你們在這末世只知積攢錢財。
verses.e: Your gold and your silver are corroded , and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire . You have laid up your treasure in the last days .

verses.z: 工人給你們收割莊稼，你們虧欠他們的工錢，這工錢有聲音呼叫，並且那收割之人的冤聲已經入了萬軍之主的耳了。
verses.e: Behold , the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields , which you have kept back by fraud , cry out ; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies .

verses.z: 你們在世上享美福，好宴樂，當宰殺的日子竟嬌養你們的心。
verses.e: You have lived in luxury on the earth , and taken your pleasure . You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter .

verses.z: 你們定了義人的罪，把他殺害，他也不抵擋你們。
verses.e: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one . He doesn't resist you .

verses.z: 弟兄們哪，你們要忍耐，直到主來。看哪，農夫忍耐等候地裏寶貴的出產，直到得了秋雨春雨。
verses.e: Be patient therefore , brothers , until the coming of the Lord . Behold , the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth , being patient over it , until it receives the early and late rain .

verses.z: 你們也當忍耐，堅固你們的心，因為主來的日子近了。
verses.e: You also be patient . Establish your hearts , for the coming of the Lord is at hand .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們不要彼此埋怨，免得受審判。看哪，審判的[主]站在門前了。
verses.e: Don't grumble , brothers , against one another , so that you won't be judged . Behold , the judge stands at the door .

verses.z: 約書亞死後，以色列人求問耶和華說：「我們中間誰當首先上去攻擊迦南人，與他們爭戰？」
verses.e: After the death of Joshua , the children of Israel asked of the LORD , saying , " Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites , to fight against them ? "

verses.z: 猶大人去攻擊住希伯崙的迦南人，殺了示篩、亞希幔、撻買。希伯崙從前名叫基列‧亞巴。
verses.e: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron . ( The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba . ) They struck Sheshai , Ahiman , and Talmai .

verses.z: 他們從那裏去攻擊底壁的居民；底壁從前名叫基列‧西弗。
verses.e: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir . ( The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher . )

verses.z: 迦勒說：「誰能攻打基列‧西弗，將城奪取，我就把我女兒押撒給他為妻。」
verses.e: Caleb said , " I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher , and takes it . "

verses.z: 迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶奪取了那城，迦勒就把女兒押撒給他為妻。
verses.e: Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb's younger brother , took it , so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife .

verses.z: 押撒過門的時候，勸丈夫向她父親求一塊田。押撒一下驢，迦勒問她說：「你要甚麼？」
verses.e: When she came , she got him to ask her father for a field . She got off her donkey ; and Caleb said to her , " What would you like ? "

verses.z: 她說：「求你賜福給我，你既將我安置在南地，求你也給我水泉。」迦勒就把上泉下泉賜給她。
verses.e: She said to him , " Give me a blessing ; because you have set me in the land of the South , give me also springs of water . " Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs .

verses.z: 摩西的內兄是基尼人，他的子孫與猶大人一同離了棕樹城，往亞拉得以南的猶大曠野去，就住在民中。
verses.e: The children of the Kenite , Moses ' brother-in-law , went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah , which is in the south of Arad ; and they went and lived with the people .

verses.z: 猶大和他哥哥西緬同去，擊殺了住洗法的迦南人，將城盡行毀滅，那城的名便叫何珥瑪。
verses.e: Judah went with Simeon his brother , and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath , and utterly destroyed it . The name of the city was called Hormah .

verses.z: 猶大又取了迦薩和迦薩的四境，亞實基倫和亞實基倫的四境，以革倫和以革倫的四境。
verses.e: Also Judah took Gaza with its border , and Ashkelon with its border , and Ekron with its border .

verses.z: 耶和華與猶大同在，猶大就趕出山地的[居民]，只是不能趕出平原的居民，因為他們有鐵車。
verses.e: The LORD was with Judah , and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country ; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley , because they had chariots of iron .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「猶大當先上去，我已將那地交在他手中。」
verses.e: The LORD said , " Judah shall go up . Behold , I have delivered the land into his hand . "

verses.z: 以色列人照摩西所說的，將希伯崙給了迦勒；迦勒就從那裏趕出亞衲族的三個族長。
verses.e: They gave Hebron to Caleb , as Moses had said , and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there .

verses.z: 便雅憫人沒有趕出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人。耶布斯人仍在耶路撒冷與便雅憫人同住，直到今日。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin didn't drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem , but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day .

verses.z: 約瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和華與他們同在。
verses.e: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel , and the LORD was with them .

verses.z: 約瑟家打發人去窺探伯特利（那城起先名叫路斯）。
verses.e: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel . ( The name of the city before that was Luz . )

verses.z: 窺探的人看見一個人從城裏出來，就對他說：「求你將進城的路指示我們，我們必恩待你。」
verses.e: The watchers saw a man come out of the city , and they said to him , " Please show us the entrance into the city , and we will deal kindly with you . "

verses.z: 那人將進城的路指示他們，他們就用刀擊殺了城中的居民，但將那人和他全家放去。
verses.e: He showed them the entrance into the city , and they struck the city with the edge of the sword ; but they let the man and all his family go .

verses.z: 那人往赫人之地去，築了一座城，起名叫路斯。那城到如今還叫這名。
verses.e: The man went into the land of the Hittites , built a city , and called its name Luz , which is its name to this day .

verses.z: 瑪拿西沒有趕出伯‧善和屬伯‧善鄉村的[居民]，他納和屬他納鄉村的[居民]，多珥和屬多珥鄉村的居民，以伯蓮和屬以伯蓮鄉村的居民，米吉多和屬米吉多鄉村的居民；迦南人卻執意住在那些地方。
verses.e: Manasseh didn't drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns , nor Taanach and its towns , nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns , nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns , nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .

verses.z: 及至以色列強盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，沒有把他們全然趕出。
verses.e: When Israel had grown strong , they put the Canaanites to forced labor , and didn't utterly drive them out .

verses.z: 以法蓮沒有趕出住基色的迦南人。於是迦南人仍住在基色，在以法蓮中間。
verses.e: Ephraim didn't drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer , but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them .

verses.z: 猶大對他哥哥西緬說：「請你同我到拈鬮所得之地去，好與迦南人爭戰；以後我也同你到你拈鬮所得之地去。」於是西緬與他同去。
verses.e: Judah said to Simeon his brother , " Come up with me into my lot , that we may fight against the Canaanites ; and I likewise will go with you into your lot . " So Simeon went with him .

verses.z: 西布倫沒有趕出基倫的居民和拿哈拉的居民。於是迦南人仍住在西布倫中間，成了服苦的人。
verses.e: Zebulun didn't drive out the inhabitants of Kitron , nor the inhabitants of Nahalol ; but the Canaanites lived among them , and became subject to forced labor .

verses.z: 亞設沒有趕出亞柯和西頓的居民，亞黑拉和亞革悉的居民，黑巴、亞弗革與利合的居民。
verses.e: Asher didn't drive out the inhabitants of Acco , nor the inhabitants of Sidon , nor of Ahlab , nor of Achzib , nor of Helbah , nor of Aphik , nor of Rehob ;

verses.z: 於是，亞設因為沒有趕出那地的迦南人，就住在他們中間。
verses.e: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land , for they didn't drive them out .

verses.z: 拿弗他利沒有趕出伯‧示麥和伯‧亞納的居民，於是拿弗他利就住在那地的迦南人中間；然而伯‧示麥和伯‧亞納的居民成了服苦的人。
verses.e: Naphtali didn't drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh , nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath ; but he lived among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land . Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor .

verses.z: 亞摩利人強逼但人住在山地，不容他們下到平原；
verses.e: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country , for they would not allow them to come down to the valley ;

verses.z: 亞摩利人卻執意住在希烈山和亞雅崙並沙賓。然而約瑟家勝了他們，使他們成了服苦的人。
verses.e: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres , in Aijalon , and in Shaalbim . Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed , so that they became subject to forced labor .

verses.z: 亞摩利人的境界，是從亞克拉濱坡，從西拉而上。
verses.e: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim , from the rock , and upward .

verses.z: 猶大就上去；耶和華將迦南人和比利洗人交在他們手中。他們在比色擊殺了一萬人，
verses.e: Judah went up , and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand . They struck ten thousand men in Bezek .

verses.z: 又在那裏遇見亞多尼‧比色，與他爭戰，殺敗迦南人和比利洗人。
verses.e: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek , and they fought against him . They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites .

verses.z: 亞多尼‧比色逃跑；他們追趕，拿住他，砍斷他手腳的大拇指。
verses.e: But Adoni-Bezek fled . They pursued him , caught him , and cut off his thumbs and his big toes .

verses.z: 亞多尼‧比色說：「從前有七十個王，手腳的大拇指都被[我]砍斷，在我桌子底下拾取[零碎食物]。現在上帝按着我所行的報應我了。」於是他們將亞多尼‧比色帶到耶路撒冷，他就死在那裏。
verses.e: Adoni-Bezek said , " Seventy kings , having their thumbs and their big toes cut off , scavenged under my table . As I have done , so God has done to me . " They brought him to Jerusalem , and he died there .

verses.z: 猶大人攻打耶路撒冷，將城攻取，用刀殺了城內的人，並且放火燒城。
verses.e: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem , took it , struck it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .

verses.z: 後來猶大人下去，與住山地、南地，和高原的迦南人爭戰。
verses.e: After that , the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country , and in the South , and in the lowland .

verses.z: 亞比米勒以後，有以薩迦人朵多的孫子、普瓦的兒子陀拉興起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法蓮山地的沙密。
verses.e: After Abimelech , Tola the son of Puah , the son of Dodo , a man of Issachar , arose to save Israel . He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim .

verses.z: 以色列人哀求耶和華說：「我們得罪了你；因為離棄了我們上帝，去事奉諸巴力。」
verses.e: The children of Israel cried to the LORD , saying , " We have sinned against you , even because we have forsaken our God , and have served the Baals . "

verses.z: 耶和華對以色列人說：「我豈沒有[救過你們]脫離埃及人、亞摩利人、亞捫人，和非利士人嗎？
verses.e: The LORD said to the children of Israel , " Didn't I save you from the Egyptians , and from the Amorites , from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines ?

verses.z: 西頓人、亞瑪力人、馬雲人也都欺壓你們；你們哀求我，我也拯救你們脫離他們的手。
verses.e: The Sidonians also , and the Amalekites , and the Maonites , oppressed you ; and you cried to me , and I saved you out of their hand .

verses.z: 你們竟離棄我，事奉別神！所以我不再救你們了。
verses.e: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods . Therefore I will save you no more .

verses.z: 你們去哀求所選擇的神；你們遭遇急難的時候，讓他救你們吧！」
verses.e: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen . Let them save you in the time of your distress ! "

verses.z: 以色列人對耶和華說：「我們犯罪了，任憑你隨意待我們吧！只求你今日拯救我們。」
verses.e: The children of Israel said to the LORD , " We have sinned ! Do to us whatever seems good to you ; only deliver us , please , today . "

verses.z: 以色列人就除掉他們中間的外邦神，事奉耶和華。耶和華因以色列人受的苦難，就心中擔憂。
verses.e: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD ; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel .

verses.z: 當時亞捫人聚集，安營在基列。以色列人也聚集，安營在米斯巴。
verses.e: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead . The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah .

verses.z: 基列的民和眾首領彼此商議說：「誰能先去攻打亞捫人，誰必作基列一切居民的領袖。」
verses.e: The people , the princes of Gilead , said to one another , " Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon ? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead . "

verses.z: 陀拉作以色列的士師二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。
verses.e: He judged Israel twenty-three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .

verses.z: 在他以後有基列人睚珥興起，作以色列的士師二十二年。
verses.e: After him Jair , the Gileadite , arose . He judged Israel twenty-two years .

verses.z: 他有三十個兒子，騎着三十匹驢駒。他們有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特‧睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。
verses.e: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts . They had thirty cities , which are called Havvoth Jair to this day , which are in the land of Gilead .

verses.z: 睚珥死了，就葬在加們。
verses.e: Jair died , and was buried in Kamon .

verses.z: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，去事奉諸巴力和亞斯她錄，並亞蘭的神、西頓的神、摩押的神、亞捫人的神、非利士人的神，離棄耶和華，不事奉他。
verses.e: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and served the Baals , the Ashtaroth , the gods of Syria , the gods of Sidon , the gods of Moab , the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines . They abandoned the LORD , and didn't serve him .

verses.z: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在非利士人和亞捫人的手中。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 從那年起，他們擾害欺壓約旦河那邊、住亞摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。
verses.e: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year . For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites , which is in Gilead .

verses.z: 亞捫人又渡過約旦河去攻打猶大和便雅憫，並以法蓮族。以色列人就甚覺窘迫。
verses.e: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah , and against Benjamin , and against the house of Ephraim , so that Israel was very distressed .

verses.z: 基列人耶弗他是個大能的勇士，是妓女的兒子。耶弗他是基列所生的。
verses.e: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor . He was the son of a prostitute . Gilead became the father of Jephthah .

verses.z: 基列的長老回答耶弗他說：「有耶和華在你我中間作見證，我們必定照你的話行。」
verses.e: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah , " The LORD will be witness between us . Surely we will do what you say . "

verses.z: 於是耶弗他同基列的長老回去，百姓就立耶弗他作領袖、作元帥。耶弗他在米斯巴將自己的一切話陳明在耶和華面前。
verses.e: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead , and the people made him head and chief over them . Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpah .

verses.z: 耶弗他打發使者去見亞捫人的王，說：「你與我有甚麼相干，竟來到我國中攻打我呢？」
verses.e: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon , saying , " What do you have to do with me , that you have come to me to fight against my land ? "

verses.z: 亞捫人的王回答耶弗他的使者說：「因為以色列人從埃及上來的時候佔據我的地，從亞嫩河到雅博河，直到約旦河。現在你要好好地將這[地]歸還吧！」
verses.e: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah , " Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt , from the Arnon even to the Jabbok , and to the Jordan . Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably . "

verses.z: 耶弗他又打發使者去見亞捫人的王，
verses.e: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon ;

verses.z: 對他說：「耶弗他如此說，以色列人並沒有佔據摩押地和亞捫人的地。
verses.e: and he said to him , " Jephthah says : Israel didn't take away the land of Moab , nor the land of the children of Ammon ;

verses.z: 以色列人從埃及上來乃是經過曠野到紅海，來到加低斯，
verses.e: but when they came up from Egypt , and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea , and came to Kadesh ,

verses.z: 就打發使者去見以東王，說：『求你容我從你的地經過。』以東王卻不應允。又照樣打發使者去見摩押王，他也不允准。以色列人就住在加低斯。
verses.e: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom , saying , ' Please let me pass through your land ; ' but the king of Edom didn't listen . In the same way , he sent to the king of Moab , but he refused ; so Israel stayed in Kadesh .

verses.z: 他們又經過曠野，繞着以東和摩押地，從摩押地的東邊過來，在亞嫩河邊安營，並沒有入摩押的境內，因為亞嫩河是摩押的邊界。
verses.e: Then they went through the wilderness , and went around the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon ; but they didn't come within the border of Moab , for the Arnon was the border of Moab .

verses.z: 以色列人打發使者去見亞摩利王西宏，就是希實本的王，對他說：『求你容我們從你的地經過，往我們自己的地方去。』
verses.e: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites , the king of Heshbon ; and Israel said to him , ' Please let us pass through your land to my place . '

verses.z: 基列的妻也生了幾個兒子：他妻所生的兒子長大了，就趕逐耶弗他，說：「你不可在我們父家承受產業，因為你是妓女的兒子。」
verses.e: Gilead's wife bore him sons . When his wife's sons grew up , they drove Jephthah out and said to him , " You will not inherit in our father's house , for you are the son of another woman . "

verses.z: 西宏卻不信服以色列人，不容他們經過他的境界，乃招聚他的眾民在雅雜安營，與以色列人爭戰。
verses.e: But Sihon didn't trust Israel to pass through his border ; but Sihon gathered all his people together , and encamped in Jahaz , and fought against Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝將西宏和他的眾民都交在以色列人手中，以色列人就擊殺他們，得了亞摩利人的全地：
verses.e: The LORD , the God of Israel , delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel , and they struck them . So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites , the inhabitants of that country .

verses.z: 從亞嫩河到雅博河，從曠野直到約旦河。
verses.e: They possessed all the border of the Amorites , from the Arnon even to the Jabbok , and from the wilderness even to the Jordan .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝在他百姓以色列面前趕出亞摩利人，你竟要得他們的地嗎？
verses.e: So now the LORD , the God of Israel , has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel , and should you possess them ?

verses.z: 你的神基抹所賜你的地你不是得為業嗎？耶和華－我們的上帝在我們面前所趕出的人，我們就得他的地。
verses.e: Won't you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess ? So whoever the LORD our God has dispossessed from before us , them will we possess .

verses.z: 難道你比摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒還強嗎？他曾與以色列人爭競，或是與他們爭戰嗎？
verses.e: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab ? Did he ever strive against Israel , or did he ever fight against them ?

verses.z: 以色列人住希實本和屬希實本的鄉村，亞羅珥和屬亞羅珥的鄉村，並沿亞嫩河的一切城邑，已經有三百年了；在這三百年之內，你們為甚麼沒有取回這些地方呢？
verses.e: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns , and in Aroer and its towns , and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years ! Why didn't you recover them within that time ?

verses.z: 原來我沒有得罪你，你卻攻打我，惡待我。願審判人的耶和華今日在以色列人和亞捫人中間判斷是非。」
verses.e: Therefore I have not sinned against you , but you do me wrong to war against me . May the LORD the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon . "

verses.z: 但亞捫人的王不肯聽耶弗他打發人說的話。
verses.e: However , the king of the children of Ammon didn't listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈降在耶弗他身上，他就經過基列和瑪拿西，來到基列的米斯巴，又從米斯巴來到亞捫人那裏。
verses.e: Then the LORD's Spirit came on Jephthah , and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh , and passed over Mizpah of Gilead , and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon .

verses.z: 耶弗他就逃避他的弟兄，去住在陀伯地，有些匪徒到他那裏聚集，與他一同出入。
verses.e: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob . Outlaws joined up with Jephthah , and they went out with him .

verses.z: 耶弗他就向耶和華許願，說：「你若將亞捫人交在我手中，
verses.e: Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD , and said , " If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand ,

verses.z: 我從亞捫人那裏平平安安回來的時候，無論甚麼人，先從我家門出來迎接我，就必歸你，我也必將他獻上為燔祭。」
verses.e: then it shall be , that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon , it shall be the LORD's , and I will offer it up for a burnt offering . "

verses.z: 於是耶弗他往亞捫人那裏去，與他們爭戰；耶和華將他們交在他手中，
verses.e: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them ; and the LORD delivered them into his hand .

verses.z: 他就大大殺敗他們，從亞羅珥到米匿，直到亞備勒‧基拉明，攻取了二十座城。這樣亞捫人就被以色列人制伏了。
verses.e: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith , even twenty cities , and to Abelcheramim , with a very great slaughter . So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶弗他回米斯巴到了自己的家，不料，他女兒拿着鼓跳舞出來迎接他，是他獨生的，此外無兒無女。
verses.e: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house ; and behold , his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances . She was his only child . Besides her he had neither son nor daughter .

verses.z: 耶弗他看見她，就撕裂衣服，說：「哀哉！我的女兒啊，你使我甚是愁苦，叫我作難了；因為我已經向耶和華開口[許願]，不能挽回。」
verses.e: When he saw her , he tore his clothes , and said , " Alas , my daughter ! You have brought me very low , and you are one of those who trouble me ; for I have opened my mouth to the LORD , and I can't go back . "

verses.z: 他女兒回答說：「父啊，你既向耶和華開口，就當照你口中所說的向我行，因耶和華已經在仇敵亞捫人身上為你報仇」；
verses.e: She said to him , " My father , you have opened your mouth to the LORD ; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth , because the LORD has taken vengeance for you on your enemies , even on the children of Ammon . "

verses.z: 又對父親說：「有一件事求你允准：容我去兩個月，與同伴在山上，好哀哭我終為處女。」
verses.e: Then she said to her father , " Let this thing be done for me . Leave me alone two months , that I may depart and go down on the mountains , and bewail my virginity , I and my companions . "

verses.z: 耶弗他說：「你去吧！」就容她去兩個月。她便和同伴去了，在山上為她終為處女哀哭。
verses.e: He said , " Go . " He sent her away for two months ; and she departed , she and her companions , and mourned her virginity on the mountains .

verses.z: 兩月已滿，她回到父親那裏，父親就照所許的願向她行了。女兒終身沒有親近男子。
verses.e: At the end of two months , she returned to her father , who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed . She was a virgin . It became a custom in Israel

verses.z: 過了些日子，亞捫人攻打以色列。
verses.e: After a while , the children of Ammon made war against Israel .

verses.z: 此後以色列中有個規矩，每年以色列的女子去為基列人耶弗他的女兒哀哭四天。
verses.e: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year .

verses.z: 亞捫人攻打以色列的時候，基列的長老到陀伯地去，要叫耶弗他回來；
verses.e: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel , the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob .

verses.z: 對耶弗他說：「請你來作我們的元帥，我們好與亞捫人爭戰。」
verses.e: They said to Jephthah , " Come and be our chief , that we may fight with the children of Ammon . "

verses.z: 耶弗他回答基列的長老說：「從前你們不是恨我、趕逐我出離父家嗎？現在你們遭遇急難為何到我這裏來呢？」
verses.e: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead , " Didn't you hate me , and drive me out of my father's house ? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress ? "

verses.z: 基列的長老回答耶弗他說：「現在我們到你這裏來，是要你同我們去，與亞捫人爭戰；你可以作基列一切居民的領袖。」
verses.e: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah , " Therefore we have turned again to you now , that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon . You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead . "

verses.z: 耶弗他對基列的長老說：「你們叫我回去，與亞捫人爭戰，耶和華把他交給我，我可以作你們的領袖嗎？」
verses.e: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead , " If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon , and the LORD delivers them before me , will I be your head ? "

verses.z: 以法蓮人聚集，到了北方，對耶弗他說：「你去與亞捫人爭戰，為甚麼沒有招我們同去呢？我們必用火燒你和你的房屋。」
verses.e: The men of Ephraim were gathered together , and passed northward ; and they said to Jephthah , " Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon , and didn't call us to go with you ? We will burn your house around you with fire ! "

verses.z: 以比讚死了，葬在伯利恆。
verses.e: Ibzan died , and was buried at Bethlehem .

verses.z: 以比讚之後，有西布倫人以倫，作以色列的士師十年。
verses.e: After him , Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel ; and he judged Israel ten years .

verses.z: 西布倫人以倫死了，葬在西布倫地的亞雅崙。
verses.e: Elon the Zebulunite died , and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun .

verses.z: 以倫之後，有比拉頓人希列的兒子押頓作以色列的士師。
verses.e: After him , Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel .

verses.z: 他有四十個兒子，三十個孫子，騎着七十匹驢駒。押頓作以色列的士師八年。
verses.e: He had forty sons and thirty sons ' sons who rode on seventy donkey colts . He judged Israel eight years .

verses.z: 比拉頓人希列的兒子押頓死了，葬在以法蓮地的比拉頓，在亞瑪力人的山地。
verses.e: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died , and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim , in the hill country of the Amalekites .

verses.z: 耶弗他對他們說：「我和我的民與亞捫人大大爭戰；我招你們來，你們竟沒有來救我脫離他們的手。
verses.e: Jephthah said to them , " I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon ; and when I called you , you didn't save me out of their hand .

verses.z: 我見你們不來救我，我就拚命前去攻擊亞捫人，耶和華將他們交在我手中。你們今日為甚麼上我這裏來攻打我呢？」
verses.e: When I saw that you didn't save me , I put my life in my hand , and passed over against the children of Ammon , and the LORD delivered them into my hand . Why then have you come up to me today , to fight against me ? "

verses.z: 於是耶弗他招聚基列人，與以法蓮人爭戰。基列人擊殺以法蓮人，是因他們說：「你們基列人在以法蓮、瑪拿西中間，不過是以法蓮逃亡的人。」
verses.e: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead , and fought with Ephraim . The men of Gilead struck Ephraim , because they said , " You are fugitives of Ephraim , you Gileadites , in the middle of Ephraim , and in the middle of Manasseh . "

verses.z: 基列人把守約旦河的渡口，不容以法蓮人過去。以法蓮逃走的人若說：「容我過去。」基列人就問他說：「你是以法蓮人不是？」他若說：「不是」，
verses.e: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites . Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said , " Let me go over , " the men of Gilead said to him , " Are you an Ephraimite ? " If he said , " No ; "

verses.z: 就對他說：「你說『示播列』。」以法蓮人因為咬不真字音，便說「西播列」。基列人就將他拿住，殺在約旦河的渡口。那時以法蓮人被殺的有四萬二千人。
verses.e: then they said to him , " Now say ' Shibboleth ; ' " and he said " Sibboleth " ; for he couldn't manage to pronounce it correctly , then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan . At that time , forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell .

verses.z: 耶弗他作以色列的士師六年。基列人耶弗他死了，葬在基列的一座城裏。
verses.e: Jephthah judged Israel six years . Then Jephthah the Gileadite died , and was buried in the cities of Gilead .

verses.z: 耶弗他以後，有伯利恆人以比讚作以色列的士師。
verses.e: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel .

verses.z: 他有三十個兒子，三十個女兒；女兒都嫁出去了。他給眾子從外鄉娶了三十個媳婦。他作以色列的士師七年。
verses.e: He had thirty sons . He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan , and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons . He judged Israel seven years .

verses.z: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華將他們交在非利士人手中四十年。
verses.e: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD's sight ; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years .

verses.z: 婦人急忙跑去告訴丈夫說：「那日到我面前來的人，又向我顯現。」
verses.e: The woman hurried and ran , and told her husband , saying to him , " Behold , the man who came to me that day has appeared to me . "

verses.z: 瑪挪亞起來跟隨他的妻來到那人面前，對他說：「與這婦人說話的就是你嗎？」他說：「是我。」
verses.e: Manoah arose and followed his wife , and came to the man , and said to him , " Are you the man who spoke to my wife ? " He said , " I am . "

verses.z: 瑪挪亞說：「願你的話應驗！我們當怎樣待這孩子，他後來當怎樣呢？」
verses.e: Manoah said , " Now let your words happen . What shall the child's way of life and mission be ? "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者對瑪挪亞說：「我告訴婦人的一切事，她都當謹慎。
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to Manoah , " Of all that I said to the woman let her beware .

verses.z: 葡萄樹所結的都不可吃，清酒濃酒都不可喝，一切不潔之物也不可吃。凡我所吩咐的，她都當遵守。」
verses.e: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine , neither let her drink wine or strong drink , nor eat any unclean thing . Let her observe all that I commanded her . "

verses.z: 瑪挪亞對耶和華的使者說：「求你容我們款留你，好為你預備一隻山羊羔。」
verses.e: Manoah said to the LORD's angel , " Please stay with us , that we may make a young goat ready for you . "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者對瑪挪亞說：「你雖然款留我，我卻不吃你的食物，你若預備燔祭就當獻與耶和華。」原來瑪挪亞不知道他是耶和華的使者。
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to Manoah , " Though you detain me , I won't eat your bread . If you will prepare a burnt offering , you must offer it to the LORD . " For Manoah didn't know that he was the LORD's angel .

verses.z: 瑪挪亞對耶和華的使者說：「請將你的名告訴我，到你話應驗的時候，我們好尊敬你。」
verses.e: Manoah said to the LORD's angel , " What is your name , that when your words happen , we may honor you ? "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者對他說：「你何必問我的名，我名是奇妙的。」
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to him , " Why do you ask about my name , since it is incomprehensible ? "

verses.z: 瑪挪亞將一隻山羊羔和素祭在磐石上獻與耶和華，[使者]行奇妙的事；瑪挪亞和他的妻觀看，
verses.e: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering , and offered it on the rock to the LORD . Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched .

verses.z: 那時，有一個瑣拉人，是屬但族的，名叫瑪挪亞。他的妻不懷孕，不生育。
verses.e: There was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah ; and his wife was barren , and childless .

verses.z: 見火焰從壇上往上升，耶和華的使者在壇上的火焰中也升上去了。瑪挪亞和他的妻看見，就俯伏於地。
verses.e: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar , the LORD's angel ascended in the flame of the altar . Manoah and his wife watched ; and they fell on their faces to the ground .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者不再向瑪挪亞和他的妻顯現，瑪挪亞才知道他是耶和華的使者。
verses.e: But the LORD's angel didn't appear to Manoah or to his wife any more . Then Manoah knew that he was the LORD's angel .

verses.z: 瑪挪亞對他的妻說：「我們必要死，因為看見了上帝。」
verses.e: Manoah said to his wife , " We shall surely die , because we have seen God . "

verses.z: 他的妻卻對他說：「耶和華若要殺我們，必不從我們手裏收納燔祭和素祭，並不將這一切事指示我們，今日也不將這些話告訴我們。」
verses.e: But his wife said to him , " If the LORD were pleased to kill us , he wouldn't have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand , and he wouldn't have shown us all these things , nor would he have told us such things as these at this time . "

verses.z: 後來婦人生了一個兒子，給他起名叫參孫。孩子長大，耶和華賜福與他。
verses.e: The woman bore a son and named him Samson . The child grew , and the LORD blessed him .

verses.z: 在瑪哈尼‧但，就是瑣拉和以實陶中間，耶和華的靈才感動他。
verses.e: The LORD's Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan , between Zorah and Eshtaol .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者向那婦人顯現，對她說：「向來你不懷孕，不生育，如今你必懷孕生一個兒子。
verses.e: The LORD's angel appeared to the woman , and said to her , " See now , you are barren and childless ; but you shall conceive and bear a son .

verses.z: 所以你當謹慎，清酒濃酒都不可喝，一切不潔之物也不可吃。
verses.e: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink , and don't eat any unclean thing ;

verses.z: 你必懷孕生一個兒子，不可用剃頭刀剃他的頭，因為這孩子一出胎就歸上帝作拿細耳人。他必起首拯救以色列人脫離非利士人的手。」
verses.e: for , behold , you shall conceive and give birth to a son . No razor shall come on his head , for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb . He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines . "

verses.z: 婦人就回去對丈夫說：「有一個神人到我面前來，他的相貌如上帝使者的相貌，甚是可畏。我沒有問他從哪裏來，他也沒有將他的名告訴我，
verses.e: Then the woman came and told her husband , saying , " A man of God came to me , and his face was like the face of the angel of God , very awesome . I didn't ask him where he was from , neither did he tell me his name ;

verses.z: 卻對我說：『你要懷孕生一個兒子，所以清酒濃酒都不可喝，一切不潔之物也不可吃；因為這孩子從出胎一直到死，必歸上帝作拿細耳人。』」
verses.e: but he said to me , ' Behold , you shall conceive and bear a son ; and now drink no wine nor strong drink . Don't eat any unclean thing , for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death . ' "

verses.z: 瑪挪亞就祈求耶和華說：「主啊，求你再差遣那神人到我們這裏來，好指教我們怎樣待這將要生的孩子。」
verses.e: Then Manoah entreated the LORD , and said , " Oh , Lord , please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us , and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born . "

verses.z: 上帝應允瑪挪亞的話；婦人正坐在田間的時候，上帝的使者又到她那裏，她丈夫瑪挪亞卻沒有同她在一處。
verses.e: God listened to the voice of Manoah , and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field ; but Manoah , her husband , wasn't with her .

verses.z: 參孫下到亭拿，在那裏看見一個女子，是非利士人的女兒。
verses.e: Samson went down to Timnah , and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines .

verses.z: 他父親下去見女子。參孫在那裏設擺筵宴，因為向來少年人都有這個規矩。
verses.e: His father went down to the woman ; and Samson made a feast there , for the young men used to do so .

verses.z: 眾人看見參孫，就請了三十個人陪伴他。
verses.e: When they saw him , they brought thirty companions to be with him .

verses.z: 參孫對他們說：「我給你們出一個謎語，你們在七日筵宴之內，若能猜出意思告訴我，我就給你們三十件裏衣，三十套衣裳；
verses.e: Samson said to them , " Let me tell you a riddle now . If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast , and find it out , then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing ;

verses.z: 你們若不能猜出意思告訴我，你們就給我三十件裏衣，三十套衣裳。」他們說：「請將謎語說給我們聽。」
verses.e: but if you can't tell me the answer , then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing . " They said to him , " Tell us your riddle , that we may hear it . "

verses.z: 參孫對他們說：吃的從吃者出來；甜的從強者出來。他們三日不能猜出謎語的意思。
verses.e: He said to them , " Out of the eater came out food . Out of the strong came out sweetness . " They couldn't in three days declare the riddle .

verses.z: 到第七天，他們對參孫的妻說：「你誆哄你丈夫，探出謎語的意思告訴我們，免得我們用火燒你和你父家。你們請了我們來，是要奪我們所有的嗎？」
verses.e: On the seventh day , they said to Samson's wife , " Entice your husband , that he may declare to us the riddle , lest we burn you and your father's house with fire . Have you called us to impoverish us ? Isn't that so ? "

verses.z: 參孫的妻在丈夫面前啼哭說：「你是恨我，不是愛我，你給我本國的人出謎語，卻沒有將意思告訴我。」參孫回答說：「連我父母我都沒有告訴，豈可告訴你呢？」
verses.e: Samson's wife wept before him , and said , " You just hate me , and don't love me . You've told a riddle to the children of my people , and haven't told it to me . " He said to her , " Behold , I haven't told my father or my mother , so why should I tell you ? "

verses.z: 七日筵宴之內，她在丈夫面前啼哭，到第七天逼着他，他才將謎語的意思告訴他妻，他妻就告訴本國的人。
verses.e: She wept before him the seven days , while their feast lasted ; and on the seventh day , he told her , because she pressed him severely ; and she told the riddle to the children of her people .

verses.z: 到第七天，日頭未落以前，那城裏的人對參孫說：有甚麼比蜜還甜呢？有甚麼比獅子還強呢？參孫對他們說：你們若非用我的母牛犢耕地，就猜不出我謎語的意思來。
verses.e: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down , " What is sweeter than honey ? What is stronger than a lion ? " He said to them , " If you hadn't plowed with my heifer , you wouldn't have found out my riddle . "

verses.z: 耶和華的靈大大感動參孫，他就下到亞實基倫，擊殺了三十個人，奪了他們的衣裳，將[衣裳]給了猜出謎語的人。參孫發怒，就上父家去了。
verses.e: The LORD's Spirit came mightily on him , and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them . He took their plunder , then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle . His anger burned , and he went up to his father's house .

verses.z: 參孫上來稟告他父母說：「我在亭拿看見一個女子，是非利士人的女兒，願你們給我娶來為妻。」
verses.e: He came up , and told his father and his mother , saying , " I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines . Now therefore get her for me as my wife . "

verses.z: 參孫的妻便歸了參孫的陪伴，就是作過他朋友的。
verses.e: But Samson's wife was given to his companion , who had been his friend .

verses.z: 他父母說：「在你弟兄的女兒中，或在本國的民中，豈沒有一個女子，何致你去在未受割禮的非利士人中娶妻呢？」參孫對他父親說：「願你給我娶那女子，因我喜悅她。」
verses.e: Then his father and his mother said to him , " Isn't there a woman among your brothers ' daughters , or among all my people , that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines ? " Samson said to his father , " Get her for me , for she pleases me well . "

verses.z: 他的父母卻不知道這事是出於耶和華，因為他找機會攻擊非利士人。那時，非利士人轄制以色列人。
verses.e: But his father and his mother didn't know that it was of the LORD ; for he sought an occasion against the Philistines . Now at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel .

verses.z: 參孫跟他父母下亭拿去，到了亭拿的葡萄園，見有一隻少壯獅子向他吼叫。
verses.e: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and his mother , and came to the vineyards of Timnah ; and behold , a young lion roared at him .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈大大感動參孫，他雖然手無器械，卻將獅子撕裂，如同撕裂山羊羔一樣。他行這事並沒有告訴父母。
verses.e: The LORD's Spirit came mightily on him , and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands , but he didn't tell his father or his mother what he had done .

verses.z: 參孫下去與女子說話，就喜悅她；
verses.e: He went down and talked with the woman , and she pleased Samson well .

verses.z: 過了些日子，再下去要娶那女子，轉向道旁要看死獅，見有一群蜂子和蜜在死獅之內，
verses.e: After a while he returned to take her , and he went over to see the carcass of the lion ; and behold , there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion , and honey .

verses.z: 就用手取蜜，且吃且走；到了父母那裏，給他父母，他們也吃了；只是沒有告訴這蜜是從死獅之內取來的。
verses.e: He took it into his hands , and went on , eating as he went . He came to his father and mother and gave to them , and they ate , but he didn't tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion's body .

verses.z: 過了些日子，到割麥子的時候，參孫帶着一隻山羊羔去看他的妻，說：「我要進內室見我的妻。」他岳父不容他進去，
verses.e: But after a while , in the time of wheat harvest , Samson visited his wife with a young goat . He said , " I will go in to my wife's room . " But her father wouldn't allow him to go in .

verses.z: 猶大人說：「你們為何上來攻擊我們呢？」他們說：「我們上來是要捆綁參孫；他向我們怎樣行，我們也要向他怎樣行。」
verses.e: The men of Judah said , " Why have you come up against us ? " They said , " We have come up to bind Samson , to do to him as he has done to us . "

verses.z: 於是有三千猶大人下到以坦磐的穴內，對參孫說：「非利士人轄制我們，你不知道嗎？你向我們行的是甚麼事呢？」他回答說：「他們向我怎樣行，我也要向他們怎樣行。」
verses.e: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave in Etam's rock , and said to Samson , " Don't you know that the Philistines are rulers over us ? What then is this that you have done to us ? " He said to them , " As they did to me , so I have done to them . "

verses.z: 猶大人對他說：「我們下來是要捆綁你，將你交在非利士人手中。」參孫說：「你們要向我起誓，應承你們自己不害死我。」
verses.e: They said to him , " We have come down to bind you , that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines . " Samson said to them , " Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves . "

verses.z: 他們說：「我們斷不殺你，只要將你捆綁交在非利士人手中。」於是用兩條新繩捆綁參孫，將他從以坦磐帶上去。
verses.e: They spoke to him , saying , " No , but we will bind you securely and deliver you into their hands ; but surely we will not kill you . " They bound him with two new ropes , and brought him up from the rock .

verses.z: 參孫到了利希，非利士人都迎着喧嚷。耶和華的靈大大感動參孫，他臂上的繩就像火燒的麻一樣，他的綁繩都從他手上脫落下來。
verses.e: When he came to Lehi , the Philistines shouted as they met him . Then the LORD's Spirit came mightily on him , and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burned with fire ; and his bands dropped from off his hands .

verses.z: 他見一塊未乾的驢腮骨，就伸手拾起來，用以擊殺一千人。
verses.e: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey , put out his hand , took it , and struck a thousand men with it .

verses.z: 參孫說：我用驢腮骨殺人成堆，用驢腮骨殺了一千人。
verses.e: Samson said , " With the jawbone of a donkey , heaps on heaps ; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men . "

verses.z: 說完這話，就把那腮骨從手裏拋出去了。那地便叫拉末‧利希。
verses.e: When he had finished speaking , he threw the jawbone out of his hand ; and that place was called Ramath Lehi .

verses.z: 參孫甚覺口渴，就求告耶和華說：「你既藉僕人的手施行這麼大的拯救，豈可任我渴死、落在未受割禮的人手中呢？」
verses.e: He was very thirsty , and called on the LORD and said , " You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant ; and now shall I die of thirst , and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised ? "

verses.z: 上帝就使利希的窪處裂開，有水從其中湧出來。參孫喝了，精神復原；因此那泉名叫隱‧哈歌利，那泉直到今日還在利希。
verses.e: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi , and water came out of it . When he had drunk , his spirit came again , and he revived . Therefore its name was called En Hakkore , which is in Lehi , to this day .

verses.z: 說：「我估定你是極其恨她，因此我將她給了你的陪伴。她的妹子不是比她還美麗嗎？你可以娶來代替她吧！」
verses.e: Her father said , " I most certainly thought that you utterly hated her ; therefore I gave her to your companion . Isn't her younger sister more beautiful than she ? Please , take her instead . "

verses.z: 當非利士人轄制以色列人的時候，參孫作以色列的士師二十年。
verses.e: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines .

verses.z: 參孫說：「這回我加害於非利士人不算有罪。」
verses.e: Samson said to them , " This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them . "

verses.z: 於是參孫去捉了三百隻狐狸，將狐狸尾巴一對一對地捆上，將火把捆在兩條尾巴中間，
verses.e: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took torches , and turned tail to tail , and put a torch in the middle between every two tails .

verses.z: 點着火把，就放狐狸進入非利士人站着的禾稼，將堆集的禾捆和未割的禾稼，並橄欖園盡都燒了。
verses.e: When he had set the torches on fire , he let them go into the standing grain of the Philistines , and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain , and also the olive groves .

verses.z: 非利士人說：「這事是誰做的呢？」有人說：「是亭拿人的女婿參孫，因為他岳父將他的妻給了他的陪伴。」於是非利士人上去，用火燒了婦人和她的父親。
verses.e: Then the Philistines said , " Who has done this ? " They said , " Samson , the son-in-law of the Timnite , because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion . " The Philistines came up , and burned her and her father with fire .

verses.z: 參孫對非利士人說：「你們既然這樣行，我必向你們報仇才肯罷休。」
verses.e: Samson said to them , " If you behave like this , surely I will take revenge on you , and after that I will cease . "

verses.z: 參孫就大大擊殺他們，連腿帶腰都砍斷了。他便下去，住在以坦磐的穴內。
verses.e: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter ; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam's rock .

verses.z: 非利士人上去安營在猶大，布散在利希。
verses.e: Then the Philistines went up , encamped in Judah , and spread themselves in Lehi .

verses.z: 參孫到了迦薩，在那裏看見一個妓女，就與她親近。
verses.e: Samson went to Gaza , and saw there a prostitute , and went in to her .

verses.z: 大利拉對參孫說：「你欺哄我，向我說謊言。現在求你告訴我當用何法捆綁你。」
verses.e: Delilah said to Samson , " Behold , you have mocked me , and told me lies . Now please tell me how you might be bound . "

verses.z: 參孫回答說：「人若用沒有使過的新繩捆綁我，我就軟弱像別人一樣。」
verses.e: He said to her , " If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done , then I will become weak , and be as another man . "

verses.z: 大利拉就用新繩捆綁他，對他說：「參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！」有人預先埋伏在內室裏。參孫將臂上的繩掙斷了，如掙斷一條線一樣。
verses.e: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them , then said to him , " The Philistines are on you , Samson ! " The ambush was waiting in the inner room . He broke them off his arms like a thread .

verses.z: 大利拉對參孫說：「你到如今還是欺哄我，向我說謊言。求你告訴我，當用何法捆綁你。」參孫回答說：「你若將我頭上的七條髮綹，與緯線同織[就可以了]。」
verses.e: Delilah said to Samson , " Until now , you have mocked me and told me lies . Tell me with what you might be bound . " He said to her , " If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom . "

verses.z: 於是大利拉將他的髮綹與緯線同織，用橛子釘住，對他說：「參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！」參孫從睡中醒來，將機上的橛子和緯線一齊都拔出來了。
verses.e: She fastened it with the pin , and said to him , " The Philistines are on you , Samson ! " He awakened out of his sleep , and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric .

verses.z: 大利拉對參孫說：「你既不與我同心，怎麼說你愛我呢？你這三次欺哄我，沒有告訴我，你因何有這麼大的力氣。」
verses.e: She said to him , " How can you say , ' I love you , ' when your heart is not with me ? You have mocked me these three times , and have not told me where your great strength lies . "

verses.z: 大利拉天天用話催逼他，甚至他心裏煩悶要死。
verses.e: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him , his soul was troubled to death .

verses.z: 參孫就把心中所藏的都告訴了她，對她說：「向來人沒有用剃頭刀剃我的頭，因為我自出母胎就歸上帝作拿細耳人；若剃了我的頭髮，我的力氣就離開我，我便軟弱像別人一樣。」
verses.e: He told her all his heart and said to her , " No razor has ever come on my head ; for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother's womb . If I am shaved , then my strength will go from me and I will become weak , and be like any other man . "

verses.z: 大利拉見他把心中所藏的都告訴了她，就打發人到非利士人的首領那裏，對他們說：「他已經把心中所藏的都告訴了我，請你們再上來一次。」於是非利士人的首領手裏拿着銀子，上到婦人那裏。
verses.e: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart , she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines , saying , " Come up this once , for he has told me all his heart . " Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand .

verses.z: 大利拉使參孫枕着她的膝睡覺，叫了一個人來剃除他頭上的七條髮綹。於是大利拉剋制他，他的力氣就離開他了。
verses.e: She made him sleep on her knees ; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head ; and she began to afflict him , and his strength went from him .

verses.z: 有[人告訴]迦薩人說：「參孫到這裏來了！」他們就把他團團圍住，終夜在城門悄悄埋伏，說：「等到天亮我們便殺他。」
verses.e: The Gazites were told , " Samson is here ! " They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city , and were quiet all the night , saying , " Wait until morning light ; then we will kill him . "

verses.z: 大利拉說：「參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！」參孫從睡中醒來，心裏說：「我要像前幾次出去活動身體」；他卻不知道耶和華已經離開他了。
verses.e: She said , " The Philistines are upon you , Samson ! " He awoke out of his sleep , and said , " I will go out as at other times , and shake myself free . " But he didn't know that the LORD had departed from him .

verses.z: 非利士人將他拿住，剜了他的眼睛，帶他下到迦薩，用銅鍊拘索他；他就在監裏推磨。
verses.e: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes ; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze ; and he ground at the mill in the prison .

verses.z: 然而他的頭髮被剃之後，又漸漸長起來了。
verses.e: However , the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved .

verses.z: 非利士人的首領聚集，要給他們的神大袞獻大祭，並且歡樂，因為他們說：「我們的神將我們的仇敵參孫交在我們手中了。」
verses.e: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god , and to rejoice ; for they said , " Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand . "

verses.z: 眾人看見參孫，就讚美他們的神說：「我們的神將毀壞我們地、殺害我們許多人的仇敵交在我們手中了。」
verses.e: When the people saw him , they praised their god ; for they said , " Our god has delivered our enemy and the destroyer of our country , who has slain many of us , into our hand . "

verses.z: 他們正宴樂的時候，就說：「叫參孫來，在我們面前戲耍戲耍。」於是將參孫從監裏提出來，他就在眾人面前戲耍。他們使他站在兩柱中間。
verses.e: When their hearts were merry , they said , " Call for Samson , that he may entertain us . " They called for Samson out of the prison ; and he performed before them . They set him between the pillars ;

verses.z: 參孫向拉他手的童子說：「求你讓我摸着托房的柱子，我要靠一靠。」
verses.e: and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand , " Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests , that I may lean on them . "

verses.z: 那時房內充滿男女，非利士人的眾首領也都在那裏。房的平頂上約有三千男女觀看參孫戲耍。
verses.e: Now the house was full of men and women ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there ; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women , who saw while Samson performed .

verses.z: 參孫求告耶和華說：「主耶和華啊，求你眷念我。上帝啊，求你賜我這一次的力量，使我在非利士人身上報那剜我雙眼的仇。」
verses.e: Samson called to the LORD , and said , " Lord GOD , remember me , please , and strengthen me , please , only this once , God , that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes . "

verses.z: 參孫就抱住托房的那兩根柱子：左手抱一根，右手抱一根，
verses.e: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them , the one with his right hand and the other with his left .

verses.z: 參孫睡到半夜，起來，將城門的門扇、門框、門閂，一齊拆下來，扛在肩上，扛到希伯崙前的山頂上。
verses.e: Samson lay until midnight , then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city , with the two posts , and plucked them up , bar and all , and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron .

verses.z: 說：「我情願與非利士人同死！」就盡力屈身，房子倒塌，壓住首領和房內的眾人。這樣，參孫死時所殺的人比活着所殺的還多。
verses.e: Samson said , " Let me die with the Philistines ! " He bowed himself with all his might ; and the house fell on the lords , and on all the people who were in it . So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life .

verses.z: 參孫的弟兄和他父的全家都下去取他的屍首，抬上來葬在瑣拉和以實陶中間，在他父瑪挪亞的墳墓裏。參孫作以色列的士師二十年。
verses.e: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him , and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father . He judged Israel twenty years .

verses.z: 後來，參孫在梭烈谷喜愛一個婦人，名叫大利拉。
verses.e: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek , whose name was Delilah .

verses.z: 非利士人的首領上去見那婦人，對她說：「求你誆哄參孫，探探他因何有這麼大的力氣，我們用何法能勝他，捆綁剋制他。我們就每人給你一千一百[舍客勒]銀子。」
verses.e: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her , " Entice him , and see in which his great strength lies , and by what means we may prevail against him , that we may bind him to afflict him ; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver . "

verses.z: 大利拉對參孫說：「求你告訴我，你因何有這麼大的力氣，當用何法捆綁剋制你。」
verses.e: Delilah said to Samson , " Please tell me where your great strength lies , and what you might be bound to afflict you . "

verses.z: 參孫回答說：「人若用七條未乾的青繩子捆綁我，我就軟弱像別人一樣。」
verses.e: Samson said to her , " If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried , then shall I become weak , and be as another man . "

verses.z: 於是非利士人的首領拿了七條未乾的青繩子來，交給婦人，她就用繩子捆綁參孫。
verses.e: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried , and she bound him with them .

verses.z: 有人預先埋伏在婦人的內室裏。婦人說：「參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！」參孫就掙斷繩子，如掙斷經火的麻線一般。這樣，他力氣[的根由]人還是不知道。
verses.e: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room . She said to him , " The Philistines are on you , Samson ! " He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire . So his strength was not known .

verses.z: 以法蓮山地有一個人名叫米迦。
verses.e: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim , whose name was Micah .

verses.z: 米迦說：「你可以住在我這裏，我以你為父、為祭司。我每年給你十[舍客勒]銀子，一套衣服和度日的食物。」利未人就進了他的家。
verses.e: Micah said to him , " Dwell with me , and be to me a father and a priest , and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year , a suit of clothing , and your food . " So the Levite went in .

verses.z: 利未人情願與那人同住；那人看這少年人如自己的兒子一樣。
verses.e: The Levite was content to dwell with the man ; and the young man was to him as one of his sons .

verses.z: 米迦分派這少年的利未人作祭司，他就住在米迦的家裏。
verses.e: Micah consecrated the Levite , and the young man became his priest , and was in the house of Micah .

verses.z: 米迦說：「現在我知道耶和華必賜福與我，因我有一個利未人作祭司。」
verses.e: Then Micah said , " Now I know that the LORD will do good to me , since I have a Levite as my priest . "

verses.z: 他對母親說：「你那一千一百[舍客勒]銀子被人拿去，你因此咒詛，並且告訴了我。看哪，這銀子在我這裏，是我拿去了。」他母親說：「我兒啊，願耶和華賜福與你！」
verses.e: He said to his mother , " The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you , about which you uttered a curse , and also spoke it in my ears — behold , the silver is with me . I took it . " His mother said , " May the LORD bless my son ! "

verses.z: 米迦就把這一千一百[舍客勒]銀子還他母親。他母親說：「我分出這銀子來為你獻給耶和華，好雕刻一個像，鑄成一個像。現在我還是交給你。」
verses.e: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother , then his mother said , " I most certainly dedicate the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son , to make a carved image and a molten image . Now therefore I will restore it to you . "

verses.z: 米迦將銀子還他母親，他母親將二百[舍客勒]銀子交給銀匠，雕刻一個像，鑄成一個像，安置在米迦的屋內。
verses.e: When he restored the money to his mother , his mother took two hundred pieces of silver , and gave them to a silversmith , who made a carved image and a molten image out of it . It was in the house of Micah .

verses.z: 這米迦有了神堂，又製造以弗得和家中的神像，分派他一個兒子作祭司。
verses.e: The man Micah had a house of gods , and he made an ephod , and teraphim , and consecrated one of his sons , who became his priest .

verses.z: 那時以色列中沒有王，各人任意而行。
verses.e: In those days there was no king in Israel . Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes .

verses.z: 猶大的伯利恆有一個少年人，是猶大族的利未人，他在那裏寄居。
verses.e: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah , of the family of Judah , who was a Levite ; and he lived there .

verses.z: 這人離開猶大的伯利恆城，要找一個可住的[地方]。行路的時候，到了以法蓮山地，走到米迦的家。
verses.e: The man departed out of the city , out of Bethlehem Judah , to live where he could find a place , and he came to the hill country of Ephraim , to the house of Micah , as he traveled .

verses.z: 米迦問他說：「你從哪裏來？」他回答說：「從猶大的伯利恆來。我是利未人，要找一個可住的[地方]。」
verses.e: Micah said to him , " Where did you come from ? " He said to him , " I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah , and I am looking for a place to live . "

verses.z: 那時，以色列中沒有王。但支派的人仍是尋地居住；因為到那日子，他們還沒有在以色列支派中得地為業。
verses.e: In those days there was no king in Israel . In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in ; for to that day , their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 你們到了那裏，必看見安居無慮的民，地也寬闊。上帝已將那地交在你們手中；那地百物俱全，一無所缺。」
verses.e: When you go , you will come to an unsuspecting people , and the land is large ; for God has given it into your hand , a place where there is no lack of anything that is in the earth . "

verses.z: 於是但族中的六百人，各帶兵器，從瑣拉和以實陶前往，
verses.e: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war .

verses.z: 上到猶大的基列‧耶琳，在基列‧耶琳後邊安營。因此那地方名叫瑪哈尼‧但，直到今日。
verses.e: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah . Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day . Behold , it is behind Kiriath Jearim .

verses.z: 他們從那裏往以法蓮山地去，來到米迦的住宅。
verses.e: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim , and came to the house of Micah .

verses.z: 從前窺探拉億地的五個人對他們的弟兄說：「這宅子裏有以弗得和家中的神像，並雕刻的像與鑄成的像，你們知道嗎？現在你們要想一想當怎樣行。」
verses.e: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers , " Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod , and teraphim , and a carved image , and a molten image ? Now therefore consider what you have to do . "

verses.z: 五人就進入米迦的住宅，到了那少年利未人的房內問他好。
verses.e: They went over there and came to the house of the young Levite man , even to the house of Micah , and asked him how he was doing .

verses.z: 那六百但人各帶兵器，站在門口。
verses.e: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war , who were of the children of Dan , stood by the entrance of the gate .

verses.z: 窺探地的五個人走進去，將雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，並鑄成的像，都拿了去。祭司和帶兵器的六百人，一同站在門口。
verses.e: The five men who went to spy out the land went up , and came in there , and took the engraved image , the ephod , the teraphim , and the molten image ; and the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war .

verses.z: 那五個人進入米迦的住宅，拿出雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，並鑄成的像，祭司就問他們說：「你們做甚麼呢？」
verses.e: When these went into Micah's house , and took the engraved image , the ephod , the teraphim , and the molten image , the priest said to them , " What are you doing ? "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「不要作聲，用手摀口，跟我們去吧！我們必以你為父、為祭司。你作一家的祭司好呢？還是作以色列一族一支派的祭司好呢？」
verses.e: They said to him , " Hold your peace , put your hand on your mouth , and go with us . Be a father and a priest to us . Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man , or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel ? "

verses.z: 但人從瑣拉和以實陶打發本族中的五個勇士，去仔細窺探那地，吩咐他們說：「你們去窺探那地。」他們來到以法蓮山地，進了米迦的住宅，就在那裏住宿。
verses.e: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number , men of valor , from Zorah and from Eshtaol , to spy out the land and to search it . They said to them , " Go , explore the land ! " They came to the hill country of Ephraim , to the house of Micah , and lodged there .

verses.z: 祭司心裏喜悅，便拿着以弗得和家中的神像，並雕刻的像，進入他們中間。
verses.e: The priest's heart was glad , and he took the ephod , the teraphim , and the engraved image , and went with the people .

verses.z: 他們就轉身離開那裏，妻子、兒女、牲畜、財物都在前頭。
verses.e: So they turned and departed , and put the little ones , the livestock , and the goods before them .

verses.z: 離米迦的住宅已遠，米迦的近鄰都聚集來，追趕但人，
verses.e: When they were a good way from the house of Micah , the men who were in the houses near Micah's house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan .

verses.z: 呼叫但人。但人回頭問米迦說：「你聚集這許多人來做甚麼呢？」
verses.e: As they called to the children of Dan , they turned their faces , and said to Micah , " What ails you , that you come with such a company ? "

verses.z: 米迦說：「你們將我所做的神像和祭司都帶了去，我還有所剩的嗎？怎麼還問我說『做甚麼』呢？」
verses.e: He said , " You have taken away my gods which I made , and the priest , and have gone away ! What more do I have ? How can you ask me , ' What ails you ? ' "

verses.z: 但人對米迦說：「你不要使我們聽見你的聲音，恐怕有性暴的人攻擊你，以致你和你的全家盡都喪命。」
verses.e: The children of Dan said to him , " Don't let your voice be heard among us , lest angry fellows fall on you , and you lose your life , with the lives of your household . "

verses.z: 但人還是走他們的路。米迦見他們的勢力比自己強盛，就轉身回家去了。
verses.e: The children of Dan went their way ; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him , he turned and went back to his house .

verses.z: 但人將米迦所做的[神像]和他的祭司都帶到拉億，見安居無慮的民，就用刀殺了那民，又放火燒了那城，
verses.e: They took that which Micah had made , and the priest whom he had , and came to Laish , to a people quiet and unsuspecting , and struck them with the edge of the sword ; then they burned the city with fire .

verses.z: 並無人搭救；因為離西頓遠，他們又與別人沒有來往。城在平原，那平原靠近伯‧利合。但人又在那裏修城居住，
verses.e: There was no deliverer , because it was far from Sidon , and they had no dealings with anyone else ; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob . They built the city and lived in it .

verses.z: 照着他們始祖以色列之子但的名字，給那城起名叫但；原先那城名叫拉億。
verses.e: They called the name of the city Dan , after the name of Dan their father , who was born to Israel ; however the name of the city used to be Laish .

verses.z: 他們臨近米迦的住宅，聽出那少年利未人的口音來，就進去問他說：「誰領你到這裏來？你在這裏做甚麼？你在這裏得甚麼？」
verses.e: When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite ; so they went over there and said to him , " Who brought you here ? What do you do in this place ? What do you have here ? "

verses.z: 但人就為自己設立那雕刻的像。摩西的孫子、革舜的兒子約拿單，和他的子孫作但支派的祭司，直到那地遭擄掠的日子。
verses.e: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image ; and Jonathan , the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land .

verses.z: 上帝的殿在示羅多少日子，但人為自己設立米迦所雕刻的像也在[但]多少日子。
verses.e: So they set up for themselves Micah's engraved image which he made , and it remained all the time that God's house was in Shiloh .

verses.z: 他回答說：「米迦待我如此如此，請我作祭司。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me , and he has hired me , and I have become his priest . "

verses.z: 他們對他說：「請你求問上帝，使我們知道所行的道路通達不通達。」
verses.e: They said to him , " Please ask counsel of God , that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous . "

verses.z: 祭司對他們說：「你們可以平平安安地去，你們所行的道路是在耶和華面前的。」
verses.e: The priest said to them , " Go in peace . Your way in which you go is before the LORD . "

verses.z: 五人就走了，來到拉億，見那裏的民安居無慮，如同西頓人安居一樣。在那地沒有人掌權擾亂他們；他們離西頓人也遠，與別人沒有來往。
verses.e: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there , how they lived in safety , in the way of the Sidonians , quiet and secure ; for there was no one in the land possessing authority , that might put them to shame in anything , and they were far from the Sidonians , and had no dealings with anyone else .

verses.z: 五人回到瑣拉和以實陶，見他們的弟兄；弟兄問他們說：「你們有甚麼話？」
verses.e: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol ; and their brothers asked them , " What do you say ? "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「起來，我們上去攻擊他們吧！我們已經窺探那地，見那地甚好。你們為何靜坐不動呢？要急速前往得那地為業，不可遲延。
verses.e: They said , " Arise , and let's go up against them ; for we have seen the land , and behold , it is very good . Do you stand still ? Don't be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land .

verses.z: 當以色列中沒有王的時候，有住以法蓮山地那邊的一個利未人，娶了一個猶大伯利恆的女子為妾。
verses.e: In those days , when there was no king in Israel , there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim , who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah .

verses.z: 那人不願再住一夜，就備上那兩匹驢，帶着妾起身走了，來到耶布斯的對面（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。）
verses.e: But the man wouldn't stay that night , but he rose up and went near Jebus ( also called Jerusalem ) . With him were a couple of saddled donkeys . His concubine also was with him .

verses.z: 臨近耶布斯的時候，日頭快要落了，僕人對主人說：「我們不如進這耶布斯人的城裏住宿。」
verses.e: When they were by Jebus , the day was far spent ; and the servant said to his master , " Please come and let's enter into this city of the Jebusites , and stay in it . "

verses.z: 主人回答說：「我們不可進不是以色列人住的外邦城，不如過到基比亞去」；
verses.e: His master said to him , " We won't enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel ; but we will pass over to Gibeah . "

verses.z: 又對僕人說：「我們可以到一個地方，或住在基比亞，或住在拉瑪。」
verses.e: He said to his servant , " Come and let's draw near to one of these places ; and we will lodge in Gibeah , or in Ramah . "

verses.z: 他們就往前走。將到便雅憫的基比亞，日頭已經落了；
verses.e: So they passed on and went their way ; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah , which belongs to Benjamin .

verses.z: 他們進入基比亞要在那裏住宿，就坐在城裏的街上，因為無人接他們進家住宿。
verses.e: They went over there , to go in to stay in Gibeah . He went in , and sat down in the street of the city ; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay .

verses.z: 晚上，有一個老年人從田間做工回來。他原是以法蓮山地的人，住在基比亞；那地方的人卻是便雅憫人。
verses.e: Behold , an old man came from his work out of the field at evening . Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim , and he lived in Gibeah ; but the men of the place were Benjamites .

verses.z: 老年人舉目看見客人[坐]在城裏的街上，就問他說：「你從哪裏來？要往哪裏去？」
verses.e: He lifted up his eyes , and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city ; and the old man said , " Where are you going ? Where did you come from ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「我們從猶大的伯利恆來，要往以法蓮山地那邊去。我原是那裏的人，到過猶大的伯利恆，現在我往耶和華的殿去，在這裏無人接我進他的家。
verses.e: He said to him , " We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim . I am from there , and I went to Bethlehem Judah . I am going to the LORD's house ; and there is no one who has taken me into his house .

verses.z: 其實我有糧草可以餵驢，我與我的妾，並我的僕人，有餅有酒，並不缺少甚麼。」
verses.e: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys ; and there is bread and wine also for me , and for your servant , and for the young man who is with your servants . There is no lack of anything . "

verses.z: 妾行淫離開丈夫，回猶大的伯利恆，到了父家，在那裏住了四個月。
verses.e: His concubine played the prostitute against him , and went away from him to her father's house to Bethlehem Judah , and was there for four months .

verses.z: 老年人說：「願你平安！你所需用的我都給你，只是不可在街上過夜。」
verses.e: The old man said , " Peace be to you ! Just let me supply all your needs , but don't sleep in the street . "

verses.z: 於是領他們到家裏，餵上驢，他們就洗腳吃喝。
verses.e: So he brought him into his house , and gave the donkeys fodder . Then they washed their feet , and ate and drank .

verses.z: 他們心裏正歡暢的時候，城中的匪徒圍住房子，連連叩門，對房主老人說：「你把那進你家的人帶出來，我們要與他交合。」
verses.e: As they were making their hearts merry , behold , the men of the city , certain wicked fellows , surrounded the house , beating at the door ; and they spoke to the master of the house , the old man , saying , " Bring out the man who came into your house , that we can have sex with him ! "

verses.z: 那房主出來對他們說：「弟兄們哪，不要這樣作惡；這人既然進了我的家，你們就不要行這醜事。
verses.e: The man , the master of the house , went out to them , and said to them , " No , my brothers , please don't act so wickedly ; since this man has come into my house , don't do this folly .

verses.z: 我有個女兒，還是處女，並有這人的妾，我將她們領出來任憑你們玷辱她們，只是向這人不可行這樣的醜事。」
verses.e: Behold , here is my virgin daughter and his concubine . I will bring them out now . Humble them , and do with them what seems good to you ; but to this man don't do any such folly . "

verses.z: 那些人卻不聽從他的話。那人就把他的妾拉出去交給他們，他們便與她交合，終夜凌辱她，直到天色快亮才放她去。
verses.e: But the men wouldn't listen to him ; so the man grabbed his concubine , and brought her out to them ; and they had sex with her , and abused her all night until the morning . When the day began to dawn , they let her go .

verses.z: 天快亮的時候，婦人回到她主人住宿的房門前，就仆倒在地，直到天亮。
verses.e: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day , and fell down at the door of the man's house where her lord was , until it was light .

verses.z: 早晨，她的主人起來開了房門，出去要行路，不料那婦人仆倒在房門前，兩手搭在門檻上；
verses.e: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house , and went out to go his way ; and behold , the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house , with her hands on the threshold .

verses.z: 就對婦人說：「起來，我們走吧！」婦人卻不回答。那人便將她馱在驢上，起身回本處去了。
verses.e: He said to her , " Get up , and let's get going ! " but no one answered . Then he took her up on the donkey ; and the man rose up , and went to his place .

verses.z: 到了家裏，用刀將妾的屍身切成十二塊，使人拿着傳送以色列的四境。
verses.e: When he had come into his house , he took a knife and cut up his concubine , and divided her , limb by limb , into twelve pieces , and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel .

verses.z: 她丈夫起來，帶着一個僕人、兩匹驢去見她，用好話勸她回來。女子就引丈夫進入父家。她父見了那人，便歡歡喜喜地迎接。
verses.e: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her , to bring her again , having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys . She brought him into her father's house ; and when the father of the young lady saw him , he rejoiced to meet him .

verses.z: 凡看見的人都說：「從以色列人出埃及地，直到今日，這樣的事沒有行過，也沒有見過。現在應當思想，大家商議[當怎樣辦理]。」
verses.e: It was so , that all who saw it said , " Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day ! Consider it , take counsel , and speak . "

verses.z: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父親，將那人留下住了三天。於是二人一同吃喝、住宿。
verses.e: His father-in-law , the young lady's father , kept him there ; and he stayed with him three days . So they ate and drank , and stayed there .

verses.z: 到第四天，利未人清早起來要走，女子的父親對女婿說：「請你吃點飯，加添心力，然後可以行路。」
verses.e: On the fourth day , they got up early in the morning , and he rose up to depart . The young lady's father said to his son-in-law , " Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread , and afterward you shall go your way . "

verses.z: 於是二人坐下一同吃喝。女子的父親對那人說：「請你再住一夜，暢快你的心。」
verses.e: So they sat down , ate , and drank , both of them together . Then the young lady's father said to the man , " Please be pleased to stay all night , and let your heart be merry . "

verses.z: 那人起來要走，他岳父強留他，他又住了一宿。
verses.e: The man rose up to depart ; but his father-in-law urged him , and he stayed there again .

verses.z: 到第五天，他清早起來要走，女子的父親說：「請你[吃點飯]，加添心力，等到日頭偏西再走。」於是二人一同吃飯。
verses.e: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart ; and the young lady's father said , " Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines ; " and they both ate .

verses.z: 那人同他的妾和僕人起來要走，他岳父，就是女子的父親，對他說：「看哪，日頭偏西了，請你再住一夜；天快晚了，可以在這裏住宿，暢快你的心。明天早早起行回家去。」
verses.e: When the man rose up to depart , he , and his concubine , and his servant , his father-in-law , the young lady's father , said to him , " Behold , now the day draws toward evening , please stay all night . Behold , the day is ending . Stay here , that your heart may be merry ; and tomorrow go on your way early , that you may go home . "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者從吉甲上到波金，對[以色列]人說：「我使你們從埃及上來，領你們到我向你們列祖起誓應許之地。我又說：『我永不廢棄與你們所立的約。
verses.e: The LORD's angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim . He said , " I brought you out of Egypt , and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers . I said , ' I will never break my covenant with you .

verses.z: 那世代的人也都歸了自己的列祖。後來有別的世代興起，不知道耶和華，也不知道耶和華為以色列人所行的事。
verses.e: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers , another generation arose after them who didn't know the LORD , nor the work which he had done for Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，去事奉諸巴力，
verses.e: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and served the Baals .

verses.z: 離棄了領他們出埃及地的耶和華－他們列祖的上帝，去叩拜別神，就是四圍列國的神，惹耶和華發怒；
verses.e: They abandoned the LORD , the God of their fathers , who brought them out of the land of Egypt , and followed other gods , of the gods of the peoples who were around them , and bowed themselves down to them ; and they provoked the LORD to anger .

verses.z: 並離棄耶和華，去事奉巴力和亞斯她錄。
verses.e: They abandoned the LORD , and served Baal and the Ashtaroth .

verses.z: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在搶奪他們的人手中，又將他們付與四圍仇敵的手中，甚至他們在仇敵面前再不能站立得住。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them . He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around , so that they could no longer stand before their enemies .

verses.z: 他們無論往何處去，耶和華都以災禍攻擊他們，正如耶和華所說的話，又如耶和華向他們所起的誓；他們便極其困苦。
verses.e: Wherever they went out , the LORD's hand was against them for evil , as the LORD had spoken , and as the LORD had sworn to them ; and they were very distressed .

verses.z: 耶和華興起士師，士師就拯救他們脫離搶奪他們人的手。
verses.e: The LORD raised up judges , who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them .

verses.z: 他們卻不聽從士師，竟隨從叩拜別神，行了邪淫，速速地偏離他們列祖所行的道，不如他們列祖順從耶和華的命令。
verses.e: Yet they didn't listen to their judges ; for they prostituted themselves to other gods , and bowed themselves down to them . They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked , obeying the LORD's commandments . They didn't do so .

verses.z: 耶和華為他們興起士師，就與那士師同在。士師在世的一切日子，耶和華拯救他們脫離仇敵的手。他們因受欺壓擾害，就哀聲歎氣，所以耶和華後悔了。
verses.e: When the LORD raised up judges for them , then the LORD was with the judge , and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge ; for it grieved the LORD because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them .

verses.z: 及至士師死後，他們就轉去行惡，比他們列祖更甚，去事奉叩拜別神，總不斷絕頑梗的惡行。
verses.e: But when the judge was dead , they turned back , and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them . They didn't cease what they were doing , or give up their stubborn ways .

verses.z: 你們也不可與這地的居民立約，要拆毀他們的祭壇。你們竟沒有聽從我的話！為何這樣行呢？』
verses.e: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land . You shall break down their altars . ' But you have not listened to my voice . Why have you done this ?

verses.z: 於是耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作。他說：「因這民違背我吩咐他們列祖所守的約，不聽從我的話，
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Israel ; and he said , " Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers , and has not listened to my voice ,

verses.z: 所以約書亞死的時候所剩下的各族，我必不再從他們面前趕出，
verses.e: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them ;

verses.z: 為要藉此試驗以色列人，看他們肯照他們列祖謹守遵行我的道不肯。」
verses.e: that by them I may test Israel , to see if they will keep the LORD's way to walk therein , as their fathers kept it , or not . "

verses.z: 這樣耶和華留下各族，不將他們速速趕出，也沒有交付約書亞的手。
verses.e: So the LORD left those nations , without driving them out hastily . He didn't deliver them into Joshua's hand .

verses.z: 因此我又說：『我必不將他們從你們面前趕出；他們必作你們肋下的[荊棘]。他們的神必作你們的網羅。』」
verses.e: Therefore I also said , ' I will not drive them out from before you ; but they shall be in your sides , and their gods will be a snare to you . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者向以色列眾人說這話的時候，百姓就放聲而哭；
verses.e: When the LORD's angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel , the people lifted up their voice and wept .

verses.z: 於是給那地方起名叫波金。眾人在那裏向耶和華獻祭。
verses.e: They called the name of that place Bochim , and they sacrificed there to the LORD .

verses.z: 從前約書亞打發以色列百姓去的時候，他們各歸自己的地業，佔據地土。
verses.e: Now when Joshua had sent the people away , the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land .

verses.z: 約書亞在世和約書亞死後，那些見耶和華為以色列人所行大事的長老還在的時候，百姓都事奉耶和華。
verses.e: The people served the LORD all the days of Joshua , and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua , who had seen all the great work of the LORD that he had worked for Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華的僕人、嫩的兒子約書亞，正一百一十歲就死了。
verses.e: Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the LORD , died , being one hundred ten years old .

verses.z: 以色列人將他葬在他地業的境內，就是在以法蓮山地的亭拿‧希烈，在迦實山的北邊。
verses.e: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres , in the hill country of Ephraim , on the north of the mountain of Gaash .

verses.z: 於是以色列從但到別是巴，以及住基列地的眾人都出來，如同一人，聚集在米斯巴耶和華面前。
verses.e: Then all the children of Israel went out , and the congregation was assembled as one man , from Dan even to Beersheba , with the land of Gilead , to the LORD at Mizpah .

verses.z: 我們要在以色列各支派中，一百人挑取十人，一千人挑取百人，一萬人挑取千人，為民運糧，等大眾到了便雅憫的基比亞，就照基比亞人在以色列中所行的醜事征伐他們。」
verses.e: and we will take ten men of one hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel , and one hundred of one thousand , and a thousand out of ten thousand to get food for the people , that they may do , when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin , according to all the folly that the men of Gibeah have done in Israel . "

verses.z: 於是以色列眾人彼此連合如同一人，聚集攻擊那城。
verses.e: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city , knit together as one man .

verses.z: 以色列眾支派打發人去，問便雅憫支派的各家說：「你們中間怎麼做了這樣的惡事呢？
verses.e: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin , saying , " What wickedness is this that has happened among you ?

verses.z: 現在你們要將基比亞的那些匪徒交出來，我們好治死他們，從以色列中除掉這惡。」便雅憫人卻不肯聽從他們弟兄以色列人的話。
verses.e: Now therefore deliver up the men , the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah , that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel . " But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers , the children of Israel .

verses.z: 便雅憫人從他們的各城裏出來，聚集到了基比亞，要與以色列人打仗。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah , to go out to battle against the children of Israel .

verses.z: 那時便雅憫人從各城裏點出拿刀的，共有二萬六千；另外還有基比亞人點出七百精兵。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword , in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah , who were counted seven hundred chosen men .

verses.z: 在眾軍之中有揀選的七百精兵，都是左手便利的，能用機弦甩石打人，毫髮不差。
verses.e: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed . Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss .

verses.z: 便雅憫人之外，點出以色列人拿刀的，共有四十萬，都是戰士。
verses.e: The men of Israel , besides Benjamin , were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword . All these were men of war .

verses.z: 以色列人就起來，到伯特利去求問上帝說：「我們中間誰當首先上去與便雅憫人爭戰呢？」耶和華說：「猶大當先[上去]。」
verses.e: The children of Israel arose , went up to Bethel , and asked counsel of God . They asked , " Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin ? " The LORD said , " Judah first . "

verses.z: 以色列人早晨起來，對着基比亞安營。
verses.e: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah .

verses.z: 以色列民的首領，就是各支派的軍長，都站在上帝百姓的會中；拿刀的步兵共有四十萬。
verses.e: The chiefs of all the people , even of all the tribes of Israel , presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God , four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword .

verses.z: 以色列人出來，要與便雅憫人打仗，就在基比亞前擺陣。
verses.e: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin ; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah .

verses.z: 便雅憫人就從基比亞出來，當日殺死以色列人二萬二千。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah , and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground .

verses.z: 以色列人彼此奮勇，仍在頭一日擺陣的地方又擺陣。
verses.e: The people , the men of Israel , encouraged themselves , and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day .

verses.z: 未擺陣之先，以色列人上去，在耶和華面前哭號，直到晚上，求問耶和華說：「我們再去與我們弟兄便雅憫人打仗可以不可以？」耶和華說：「可以上去攻擊他們。」
verses.e: The children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until evening ; and they asked of the LORD , saying , " Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother ? " The LORD said , " Go up against him . "

verses.z: 第二日，以色列人就上前攻擊便雅憫人。
verses.e: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day .

verses.z: 便雅憫人也在這日從基比亞出來，與以色列人接戰，又殺死他們一萬八千，都是拿刀的。
verses.e: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day , and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men . All these drew the sword .

verses.z: 以色列眾人就上到伯特利，坐在耶和華面前哭號，當日禁食直到晚上；又在耶和華面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
verses.e: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up , and came to Bethel , and wept , and sat there before the LORD , and fasted that day until evening ; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

verses.z: 那時，上帝的約櫃在那裏；亞倫的孫子、以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈侍立在約櫃前。以色列人問耶和華說：「我們當再出去與我們弟兄便雅憫人打仗呢？還是罷兵呢？」耶和華說：「你們當上去，因為明日我必將他們交在你們手中。」
verses.e: The children of Israel asked the LORD ( for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days ,

and Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron , stood before it in those days ) , saying , " Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother , or shall I cease ? " The LORD said , " Go up ; for tomorrow I will deliver him into your hand . "

verses.z: 以色列人在基比亞的四圍設下伏兵。
verses.e: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah .

verses.z: 以色列人上到米斯巴，便雅憫人都聽見了。以色列人說：「請你將這件惡事的情由對我們說明。」
verses.e: ( Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah . ) The children of Israel said , " Tell us , how did this wickedness happen ? "

verses.z: 第三日，以色列人又上去攻擊便雅憫人，在基比亞前擺陣，與前兩次一樣。
verses.e: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day , and set themselves in array against Gibeah , as at other times .

verses.z: 便雅憫人也出來迎敵，就被引誘離城；在田間兩條路上，一通伯特利，一通基比亞，像前兩次，動手殺死以色列人約有三十個。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin went out against the people , and were drawn away from the city ; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times , in the highways , of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah , in the field , about thirty men of Israel .

verses.z: 便雅憫人說：「他們仍舊敗在我們面前。」但以色列人說：「我們不如逃跑，引誘他們離開城到路上來。」
verses.e: The children of Benjamin said , " They are struck down before us , as at the first . " But the children of Israel said , " Let's flee , and draw them away from the city to the highways . "

verses.z: 以色列眾人都起來，在巴力‧他瑪擺陣，以色列的伏兵從馬利‧迦巴埋伏的地方衝上前去。
verses.e: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar . Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place , even out of Maareh Geba .

verses.z: 有以色列人中的一萬精兵，來到基比亞前接戰，勢派甚是凶猛；便雅憫人卻不知道災禍臨近了。
verses.e: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah , and the battle was severe ; but they didn't know that disaster was close to them .

verses.z: 耶和華使以色列人殺敗便雅憫人。那日，以色列人殺死便雅憫人二萬五千一百，都是拿刀的。
verses.e: The LORD struck Benjamin before Israel ; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men . All these drew the sword .

verses.z: 於是便雅憫人知道自己敗了。先是以色列人；因為靠着在基比亞前所設的伏兵，就在便雅憫人面前詐敗。
verses.e: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck , for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah .

verses.z: 伏兵急忙闖進基比亞，用刀殺死全城的人。
