verses.e: The ambushers hurried , and rushed on Gibeah ; then the ambushers spread out , and struck all the city with the edge of the sword .

verses.z: 以色列人預先同伏兵約定在城內放火，以煙氣上騰為號。
verses.e: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city .

verses.z: 以色列人臨退陣的時候，便雅憫人動手殺死以色列人，約有三十個，就說：「他們仍像前次被我們殺敗了。」
verses.e: The men of Israel turned in the battle , and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons ; for they said , " Surely they are struck down before us , as in the first battle . "

verses.z: 那利未人，就是被害之婦人的丈夫，回答說：「我和我的妾到了便雅憫的基比亞住宿。
verses.e: The Levite , the husband of the woman who was murdered , answered , " I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin , I and my concubine , to spend the night .

verses.z: 當煙氣如柱從城中上騰的時候，便雅憫人回頭觀看，見全城的[煙氣]沖天。
verses.e: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke , the Benjamites looked behind them ; and behold , the whole city went up in smoke to the sky .

verses.z: 以色列人又轉身回來，便雅憫人就甚驚惶，因為看見災禍臨到自己了。
verses.e: The men of Israel turned , and the men of Benjamin were dismayed ; for they saw that disaster had come on them .

verses.z: 他們在以色列人面前轉身往曠野逃跑；以色列人在後面追殺。那從各城裏出來的，也都夾攻殺滅他們。
verses.e: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness , but the battle followed hard after them ; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it .

verses.z: 以色列人圍繞便雅憫人，追趕他們，在他們歇腳之處、對着日出之地的基比亞踐踏他們。
verses.e: They surrounded the Benjamites , chased them , and trod them down at their resting place , as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise .

verses.z: 便雅憫人死了的有一萬八千，都是勇士。
verses.e: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell ; all these were men of valor .

verses.z: 其餘的人轉身向曠野逃跑，往臨門磐去。以色列人在道路上殺了他們五千人，如拾取遺穗一樣，追到基頓又殺了他們二千人。
verses.e: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon . They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways , and followed hard after them to Gidom , and struck two thousand men of them .

verses.z: 那日便雅憫死了的共有二萬五千人，都是拿刀的勇士。
verses.e: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword . All these were men of valor .

verses.z: 只剩下六百人，轉身向曠野逃跑，到了臨門磐，就在那裏住了四個月。
verses.e: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon , and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months .

verses.z: 以色列人又轉到便雅憫地，將各城的人和牲畜，並一切所遇見的，都用刀殺盡，又放火燒了一切城邑。
verses.e: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin , and struck them with the edge of the sword — including the entire city , the livestock , and all that they found . Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire .

verses.z: 基比亞人夜間起來，圍了我住的房子，想要殺我，又將我的妾強姦致死。
verses.e: The men of Gibeah rose against me , and surrounded the house by night . They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine , and she is dead .

verses.z: 我就把我妾的屍身切成塊子，使人拿着傳送以色列得為業的全地，因為基比亞人在以色列中行了兇淫醜惡的事。
verses.e: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces , and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel ; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel .

verses.z: 你們以色列人都當籌劃商議。」
verses.e: Behold , you children of Israel , all of you , give here your advice and counsel . "

verses.z: 眾民都起來如同一人，說：「我們連一人都不回自己帳棚、自己房屋去。
verses.e: All the people arose as one man , saying , " None of us will go to his tent , neither will any of us turn to his house .

verses.z: 我們向基比亞人必這樣行，照所掣的籤去攻擊他們。
verses.e: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah : we will go up against it by lot ;

verses.z: 以色列人在米斯巴曾起誓說：「我們都不將女兒給便雅憫人為妻。」
verses.e: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah , saying , " None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife . "

verses.z: 會眾就打發一萬二千大勇士，吩咐他們說：「你們去用刀將基列‧雅比人連婦女帶孩子都擊殺了。
verses.e: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there , and commanded them , saying , " Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword , with the women and the little ones .

verses.z: 所當行的就是這樣：要將一切男子和已嫁的女子盡行殺戮。」
verses.e: This is the thing that you shall do : you shall utterly destroy every male , and every woman who has lain with a man . "

verses.z: 他們在基列‧雅比人中，遇見了四百個未嫁的處女，就帶到迦南地的示羅營裏。
verses.e: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him ; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 全會眾打發人到臨門磐的便雅憫人那裏，向他們說和睦的話。
verses.e: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon , and proclaimed peace to them .

verses.z: 當時便雅憫人回來了，以色列人就把所存活基列‧雅比的女子給他們為妻，還是不夠。
verses.e: Benjamin returned at that time ; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead . There still weren't enough for them .

verses.z: 百姓為便雅憫人後悔，因為耶和華使以色列人缺了一個支派。
verses.e: The people grieved for Benjamin , because the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 會中的長老說：「便雅憫中的女子既然除滅了，我們當怎樣辦理、使那餘剩的人有妻呢？」
verses.e: Then the elders of the congregation said , " How shall we provide wives for those who remain , since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin ? "

verses.z: 又說：「便雅憫逃脫的人當有地業，免得以色列中塗抹了一個支派。
verses.e: They said , " There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin , that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel .

verses.z: 只是我們不能將自己的女兒給他們為妻；因為以色列人曾起誓說，有將女兒給便雅憫人為妻的，必受咒詛。」
verses.e: However , we may not give them wives of our daughters , for the children of Israel had sworn , saying , ' Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin . ' "

verses.z: 他們又說：「在利波拿以南，伯特利以北，在示劍大路以東的示羅，年年有耶和華的節期」；
verses.e: They said , " Behold , there is a feast of the LORD from year to year in Shiloh , which is on the north of Bethel , on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem , and on the south of Lebonah . "

verses.z: 以色列人來到伯特利，坐在上帝面前直到晚上，放聲痛哭，
verses.e: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God , and lifted up their voices , and wept severely .

verses.z: 就吩咐便雅憫人說：「你們去，在葡萄園中埋伏。
verses.e: They commanded the children of Benjamin , saying , " Go and lie in wait in the vineyards ,

verses.z: 若看見示羅的女子出來跳舞，就從葡萄園出來，在示羅的女子中各搶一個為妻，回便雅憫地去。
verses.e: and see , and behold , if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances , then come out of the vineyards , and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh , and go to the land of Benjamin .

verses.z: 他們的父親或是弟兄若來與我們爭競，我們就說：『求你們看我們的情面，施恩給這些人，因我們在爭戰的時候沒有給他們留下女子為妻。這也不是你們將女子給他們的；若是你們給的，就算有罪。』」
verses.e: It shall be , when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us , that we will say to them , ' Grant them graciously to us , because we didn't take for each man his wife in battle , neither did you give them to them ; otherwise you would now be guilty . ' "

verses.z: 於是便雅憫人照樣而行，按着他們的數目從跳舞的女子中搶去為妻，就回自己的地業去，又重修城邑居住。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin did so , and took wives for themselves according to their number , of those who danced , whom they carried off . They went and returned to their inheritance , built the cities , and lived in them .

verses.z: 當時以色列人離開那裏，各歸本支派、本宗族、本地業去了。
verses.e: The children of Israel departed from there at that time , every man to his tribe and to his family , and they each went out from there to his own inheritance .

verses.z: 那時，以色列中沒有王，各人任意而行。
verses.e: In those days there was no king in Israel . Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes .

verses.z: 說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，為何以色列中有這樣缺了一支派的事呢？」
verses.e: They said , " The LORD , the God of Israel , why has this happened in Israel , that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today ? "

verses.z: 次日清早，百姓起來，在那裏築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭。
verses.e: On the next day , the people rose early and built an altar there , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings .

verses.z: 以色列人彼此問說：「以色列各支派中，誰沒有同會眾上到耶和華面前來呢？」先是以色列人起過大誓說，凡不上米斯巴到耶和華面前來的，必將他治死。
verses.e: The children of Israel said , " Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn't come up in the assembly to the LORD ? " For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn't come up to the LORD to Mizpah , saying , " He shall surely be put to death . "

verses.z: 以色列人為他們的弟兄便雅憫後悔，說：「如今以色列中絕了一個支派了。
verses.e: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother , and said , " There is one tribe cut off from Israel today .

verses.z: 我們既在耶和華面前起誓說，必不將我們的女兒給便雅憫人為妻，現在我們當怎樣辦理、使他們剩下的人有妻呢？」
verses.e: How shall we provide wives for those who remain , since we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ? "

verses.z: 又彼此問說：「以色列支派中誰沒有上米斯巴到耶和華面前來呢？」他們就查出基列‧雅比沒有一人進營到會眾那裏；
verses.e: They said , " What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn't come up to the LORD to Mizpah ? " Behold , no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly .

verses.z: 因為百姓被數的時候，沒有一個基列‧雅比人在那裏。
verses.e: For when the people were counted , behold , there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there .

verses.z: 耶和華留下這幾族，為要試驗那不曾知道與迦南爭戰之事的以色列人，
verses.e: Now these are the nations which the LORD left , to test Israel by them , even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan ;

verses.z: 耶和華的靈降在他身上，他就作了以色列的士師，出去爭戰。耶和華將美索不達米亞王古珊‧利薩田交在他手中，他便勝了古珊‧利薩田。
verses.e: The LORD's Spirit came on him , and he judged Israel ; and he went out to war , and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand . His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim .

verses.z: 於是國中太平四十年。基納斯的兒子俄陀聶死了。
verses.e: The land had rest forty years , then Othniel the son of Kenaz died .

verses.z: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華就使摩押王伊磯倫強盛，攻擊以色列人。
verses.e: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel , because they had done that which was evil in the LORD's sight .

verses.z: 伊磯倫招聚亞捫人和亞瑪力人，去攻打以色列人，佔據棕樹城。
verses.e: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself ; and he went and struck Israel , and they possessed the city of palm trees .

verses.z: 於是以色列人服事摩押王伊磯倫十八年。
verses.e: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years .

verses.z: 以色列人呼求耶和華的時候，耶和華就為他們興起一位拯救者，就是便雅憫人基拉的兒子以笏；他是左手便利的。以色列人託他送禮物給摩押王伊磯倫。
verses.e: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD , the LORD raised up a savior for them : Ehud the son of Gera , the Benjamite , a left-handed man . The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab .

verses.z: 以笏打了一把兩刃的劍，長一肘，帶在右腿上衣服裏面。
verses.e: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges , a cubit in length ; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh .

verses.z: 他將禮物獻給摩押王伊磯倫（原來伊磯倫極其肥胖）；
verses.e: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab . Now Eglon was a very fat man .

verses.z: 以笏獻完禮物，便將抬禮物的人打發走了，
verses.e: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute , he sent away the people who carried the tribute .

verses.z: 自己卻從靠近吉甲鑿石之地回來，說：「王啊，我有一件機密事奏告你。」王說：「迴避吧！」於是左右侍立的人都退去了。
verses.e: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal , and said , " I have a secret message for you , O king . " The king said , " Keep silence ! " All who stood by him left him .

verses.z: 好叫以色列的後代又知道又學習未曾曉得的戰事。
verses.e: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know , to teach them war , at least those who knew nothing of it before :

verses.z: 以笏來到王面前；王獨自一人坐在涼樓上。以笏說：「我奉上帝的命報告你一件事。」王就從座位上站起來。
verses.e: Ehud came to him ; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room . Ehud said , " I have a message from God to you . " He arose out of his seat .

verses.z: 以笏便伸左手，從右腿上拔出劍來，刺入王的肚腹，
verses.e: Ehud put out his left hand , and took the sword from his right thigh , and thrust it into his body .

verses.z: 連劍把都刺進去了。劍被肥肉夾住，他沒有從王的肚腹拔出來，且穿通了後身。
verses.e: The handle also went in after the blade ; and the fat closed on the blade , for he didn't draw the sword out of his body ; and it came out behind .

verses.z: 以笏就出到遊廊，將樓門盡都關鎖。
verses.e: Then Ehud went out onto the porch , and shut the doors of the upper room on him , and locked them .

verses.z: 以笏出來之後，王的僕人到了，看見樓門關鎖，就說：「他必是在樓上大解。」
verses.e: After he had gone , his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked . They said , " Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room . "

verses.z: 他們等煩了，見仍不開樓門，就拿鑰匙開了，不料，他們的主人已死，倒在地上。
verses.e: They waited until they were ashamed ; and behold , he didn't open the doors of the upper room . Therefore they took the key and opened them , and behold , their lord had fallen down dead on the floor .

verses.z: 他們耽延的時候，以笏就逃跑了，經過鑿石之地，逃到西伊拉；
verses.e: Ehud escaped while they waited , passed beyond the stone idols , and escaped to Seirah .

verses.z: 到了，就在以法蓮山地吹角。以色列人隨着他下了山地，他在前頭引路，
verses.e: When he had come , he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim ; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country , and he led them .

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們隨我來，因為耶和華已經把你們的仇敵摩押人交在你們手中。」於是他們跟着他下去，把守約旦河的渡口，不容摩押一人過去。
verses.e: He said to them , " Follow me ; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand . " They followed him , and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites , and didn't allow any man to pass over .

verses.z: 那時擊殺了摩押人約有一萬，都是強壯的勇士，沒有一人逃脫。
verses.e: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab , every strong man and every man of valor . No man escaped .

verses.z: 所[留下的]就是非利士的五個首領和一切迦南人、西頓人，並住黎巴嫩山的希未人，從巴力‧黑們山直到哈馬口。
verses.e: the five lords of the Philistines , all the Canaanites , the Sidonians , and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon , from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath .

verses.z: 這樣，摩押就被以色列人制伏了。國中太平八十年。
verses.e: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel . Then the land had rest eighty years .

verses.z: 以笏之後，有亞拿的兒子珊迦，他用趕牛的棍子打死六百非利士人。他也救了以色列人。
verses.e: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath , who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad . He also saved Israel .

verses.z: 留[下]這幾族，為要試驗以色列人，知道他們肯聽從耶和華藉摩西吩咐他們列祖的誡命不肯。
verses.e: They were left to test Israel by them , to know whether they would listen to the LORD's commandments , which he commanded their fathers by Moses .

verses.z: 以色列人竟住在迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中間，
verses.e: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites .

verses.z: 娶他們的女兒為妻，將自己的女兒嫁給他們的兒子，並事奉他們的神。
verses.e: They took their daughters to be their wives , and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods .

verses.z: 以色列人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，忘記耶和華－他們的上帝，去事奉諸巴力和亞舍拉，
verses.e: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , and forgot the LORD their God , and served the Baals and the Asheroth .

verses.z: 所以耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在美索不達米亞王古珊‧利薩田的手中。以色列人服事古珊‧利薩田八年。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD's anger burned against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia ; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years .

verses.z: 以色列人呼求耶和華的時候，耶和華就為他們興起一位拯救者救他們，就是迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶。
verses.e: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD , the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel , who saved them , even Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb's younger brother .

verses.z: 以笏死後，以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，
verses.e: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , when Ehud was dead .

verses.z: 巴拉就招聚西布倫人和拿弗他利人到基低斯，跟他上去的有一萬人。底波拉也同他上去。
verses.e: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh . Ten thousand men followed him ; and Deborah went up with him .

verses.z: 摩西岳父何巴的後裔，基尼人希百曾離開基尼族，到靠近基低斯、撒拿音的橡樹旁支搭帳棚。
verses.e: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites , even from the children of Hobab , Moses ' brother-in-law , and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim , which is by Kedesh .

verses.z: 有人告訴西西拉說：「亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉已經上他泊山了。」
verses.e: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor .

verses.z: 西西拉就聚集所有的鐵車九百輛和跟隨他的全軍，從外邦人的夏羅設出來，到了基順河。
verses.e: Sisera gathered together all his chariots , even nine hundred chariots of iron , and all the people who were with him , from Harosheth of the Gentiles , to the river Kishon .

verses.z: 底波拉對巴拉說：「你起來，今日就是耶和華將西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和華豈不在你前頭行嗎？」於是巴拉下了他泊山，跟隨他有一萬人。
verses.e: Deborah said to Barak , " Go ; for this is the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand . Hasn't the LORD gone out before you ? " So Barak went down from Mount Tabor , and ten thousand men after him .

verses.z: 耶和華使西西拉和他一切車輛全軍潰亂，在巴拉面前被刀殺敗；西西拉下車步行逃跑。
verses.e: The LORD confused Sisera , all his chariots , and all his army , with the edge of the sword before Barak . Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet .

verses.z: 巴拉追趕車輛、軍隊，直到外邦人的夏羅設。西西拉的全軍都倒在刀下，沒有留下一人。
verses.e: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles ; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword . There was not a man left .

verses.z: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希百之妻雅億的帳棚，因為夏瑣王耶賓與基尼人希百家和好。
verses.e: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite ; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite .

verses.z: 雅億出來迎接西西拉，對他說：「請我主進來，不要懼怕」；西西拉就進了她的帳棚。雅億用被將他遮蓋。
verses.e: Jael went out to meet Sisera , and said to him , " Turn in , my lord , turn in to me ; don't be afraid . " He came in to her into the tent , and she covered him with a rug .

verses.z: 西西拉對雅億說：「我渴了，求你給我一點水喝。」雅億就打開皮袋，給他奶子喝，仍舊把他遮蓋。
verses.e: He said to her , " Please give me a little water to drink ; for I am thirsty . " She opened a container of milk , and gave him a drink , and covered him .

verses.z: 耶和華就把他們付與在夏瑣作王的迦南王耶賓手中；他的將軍是西西拉，住在外邦人的夏羅設。
verses.e: The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan , who reigned in Hazor ; the captain of whose army was Sisera , who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles .

verses.z: 西西拉又對雅億說：「請你站在帳棚門口，若有人來問你說：『有人在這裏沒有？』你就說：『沒有。』」
verses.e: He said to her , " Stand in the door of the tent , and if any man comes and inquires of you , and says , ' Is there any man here ? ' you shall say , ' No . ' "

verses.z: 西西拉疲乏沉睡。希百的妻雅億取了帳棚的橛子，手裏拿着錘子，輕悄悄地到他旁邊，將橛子從他鬢邊釘進去，釘入地裏。西西拉就死了。
verses.e: Then Jael , Heber's wife , took a tent peg , and took a hammer in her hand , and went softly to him , and struck the pin into his temples , and it pierced through into the ground , for he was in a deep sleep ; so he fainted and died .

verses.z: 巴拉追趕西西拉的時候，雅億出來迎接他說：「來吧，我將你所尋找的人給你看。」他就進入帳棚，看見西西拉已經死了，倒在地上，橛子還在他鬢中。
verses.e: Behold , as Barak pursued Sisera , Jael came out to meet him , and said to him , " Come , and I will show you the man whom you seek . " He came to her ; and behold , Sisera lay dead , and the tent peg was in his temples .

verses.z: 這樣，上帝使迦南王耶賓被以色列人制伏了。
verses.e: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day .

verses.z: 從此以色列人的手越發有力，勝了迦南王耶賓，直到將他滅絕了。
verses.e: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan , until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan .

verses.z: 耶賓王有鐵車九百輛。他大大欺壓以色列人二十年，以色列人就呼求耶和華。
verses.e: The children of Israel cried to the LORD , for he had nine hundred chariots of iron ; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years .

verses.z: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，當時作以色列的士師。
verses.e: Now Deborah , a prophetess , the wife of Lappidoth , judged Israel at that time .

verses.z: 她住在以法蓮山地拉瑪和伯特利中間，在底波拉的棕樹下。以色列人都上她那裏去聽判斷。
verses.e: She lived under Deborah's palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim ; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment .

verses.z: 她打發人從拿弗他利的基低斯將亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉召了來，對他說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝吩咐你說：『你率領一萬拿弗他利和西布倫人上他泊山去。
verses.e: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali , and said to him , " Hasn't the LORD , the God of Israel , commanded , ' Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor , and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?

verses.z: 我必使耶賓的將軍西西拉率領他的車輛和全軍往基順河，到你那裏去；我必將他交在你手中。』」
verses.e: I will draw to you , to the river Kishon , Sisera , the captain of Jabin's army , with his chariots and his multitude ; and I will deliver him into your hand . ' "

verses.z: 巴拉說：「你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。」
verses.e: Barak said to her , " If you will go with me , then I will go ; but if you will not go with me , I will not go . "

verses.z: 底波拉說：「我必與你同去，只是你在所行的路上得不着榮耀，因為耶和華要將西西拉交在一個婦人手裏。」於是底波拉起來，與巴拉一同往基低斯去了。
verses.e: She said , " I will surely go with you . Nevertheless , the journey that you take won't be for your honor ; for the LORD will sell Sisera into a woman's hand . " Deborah arose , and went with Barak to Kedesh .

verses.z: 那時，底波拉和亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉作歌，說：
verses.e: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day , saying ,

verses.z: 騎白驢的、坐繡花毯子的、行路的，你們都當傳揚！
verses.e: " Speak , you who ride on white donkeys , you who sit on rich carpets , and you who walk by the way .

verses.z: 在遠離弓箭響聲打水之處，人必述說耶和華公義的作為，就是他治理以色列公義的作為。那時耶和華的民下到城門。
verses.e: Far from the noise of archers , in the places of drawing water , there they will rehearse the LORD's righteous acts , the righteous acts of his rule in Israel . " Then the LORD's people went down to the gates .

verses.z: 底波拉啊，興起！興起！你當興起，興起，唱歌。亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉啊，你當奮興，擄掠你的敵人。
verses.e: ' Awake , awake , Deborah ! Awake , awake , utter a song ! Arise , Barak , and lead away your captives , you son of Abinoam . '

verses.z: 那時有餘剩的貴冑和百姓一同下來；耶和華降臨，為我攻擊勇士。
verses.e: " Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down . The LORD came down for me against the mighty .

verses.z: 有根本在亞瑪力[人的地]，從以法蓮[下來]的；便雅憫在民中跟隨你。有掌權的從瑪吉下來；有持杖檢點民數的從西布倫下來；
verses.e: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim , after you , Benjamin , among your peoples . Governors come down out of Machir . Those who handle the marshal's staff came out of Zebulun .

verses.z: 以薩迦的首領與底波拉同來；以薩迦怎樣，巴拉也怎樣。眾人都跟隨巴拉衝下平原；在呂便的溪水旁有心中定大志的。
verses.e: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah . As was Issachar , so was Barak . They rushed into the valley at his feet . By the watercourses of Reuben , there were great resolves of heart .

verses.z: 你為何坐在羊圈內聽群中吹笛的聲音呢？在呂便的溪水旁有心中設大謀的。
verses.e: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds ? To hear the whistling for the flocks ? At the watercourses of Reuben , there were great searchings of heart .

verses.z: 基列人安居在約旦河外。但人為何等在船上？亞設人在海口靜坐，在港口安居。
verses.e: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan . Why did Dan remain in ships ? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea , and lived by his creeks .

verses.z: 西布倫人是拚命敢死的；拿弗他利人在田野的高處也是如此。
verses.e: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death ; Naphtali also , on the high places of the field .

verses.z: 君王都來爭戰。那時迦南諸王在米吉多水旁的他納爭戰，卻未得擄掠銀錢。
verses.e: " The kings came and fought , then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo . They took no plunder of silver .

verses.z: 因為以色列中有軍長率領，百姓也甘心犧牲自己，你們應當頌讚耶和華！
verses.e: " Because the leaders took the lead in Israel , because the people offered themselves willingly , be blessed , LORD !

verses.z: 星宿從天上爭戰，從其軌道攻擊西西拉。
verses.e: From the sky the stars fought . From their courses , they fought against Sisera .

verses.z: 基順古河把敵人沖沒；我的靈啊，應當努力前行。
verses.e: The river Kishon swept them away , that ancient river , the river Kishon . My soul , march on with strength .

verses.z: 那時壯馬馳驅，踢跳，奔騰。
verses.e: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing , the prancing of their strong ones .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者說：應當咒詛米羅斯，大大咒詛其中的居民；因為他們不來幫助耶和華，不來幫助耶和華攻擊勇士。
verses.e: ' Curse Meroz , ' said the LORD's angel . ' Curse bitterly its inhabitants , because they didn't come to help the LORD , to help the LORD against the mighty . '

verses.z: 願基尼人希百的妻雅億比眾婦人多得福氣，比住帳棚的婦人更蒙福祉。
verses.e: " Jael shall be blessed above women , the wife of Heber the Kenite ; blessed shall she be above women in the tent .

verses.z: 西西拉求水，雅億給他奶子，用寶貴的盤子給他奶油。
verses.e: He asked for water . She gave him milk . She brought him butter in a lordly dish .

verses.z: 雅億左手拿着帳棚的橛子，右手拿着匠人的錘子，擊打西西拉，打傷他的頭，把他的鬢角打破穿通。
verses.e: She put her hand to the tent peg , and her right hand to the workmen's hammer . With the hammer she struck Sisera . She struck through his head . Yes , she pierced and struck through his temples .

verses.z: 西西拉在她腳前曲身仆倒，在她腳前曲身倒臥；在那裏曲身，就在那裏死亡。
verses.e: At her feet he bowed , he fell , he lay . At her feet he bowed , he fell . Where he bowed , there he fell down dead .

verses.z: 西西拉的母親從窗戶裏往外觀看，從窗櫺中呼叫說：他的戰車為何耽延不來呢？他的車輪為何行得慢呢？
verses.e: " Through the window she looked out , and cried : Sisera's mother looked through the lattice . ' Why is his chariot so long in coming ? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait ? '

verses.z: 聰明的宮女安慰她，她也自言自語地說：
verses.e: Her wise ladies answered her , Yes , she returned answer to herself ,

verses.z: 君王啊，要聽！王子啊，要側耳而聽！我要向耶和華歌唱；我要歌頌耶和華－以色列的上帝。
verses.e: " Hear , you kings ! Give ear , you princes ! I , even I , will sing to the LORD . I will sing praise to the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 他們莫非得財而分？每人得了一兩個女子？西西拉得了彩衣為擄物，得繡花的彩衣為掠物。這彩衣兩面繡花，乃是披在被擄之人頸項上的。
verses.e: ' Have they not found , have they not divided the plunder ? A lady , two ladies to every man ; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments , a plunder of dyed garments embroidered , of dyed garments embroidered on both sides , on the necks of the plunder ? '

verses.z: 耶和華啊，願你的仇敵都這樣滅亡！願愛你的人如日頭出現，光輝烈烈！這樣，國中太平四十年。
verses.e: " So let all your enemies perish , LORD , but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength . " Then the land had rest forty years .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你從西珥出來，由以東地行走。那時地震天漏，雲也落[雨]。
verses.e: " LORD , when you went out of Seir , when you marched out of the field of Edom , the earth trembled , the sky also dropped . Yes , the clouds dropped water .

verses.z: 山見耶和華的面就震動，西奈山見耶和華－以色列上帝的面也是如此。
verses.e: The mountains quaked at the LORD's presence , even Sinai at the presence of the LORD , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 在亞拿之子珊迦的時候，又在雅億的日子，大道無人行走，都是繞道而行。
verses.e: " In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath , in the days of Jael , the highways were unoccupied . The travelers walked through byways .

verses.z: 以色列中的官長停職，直到我底波拉興起，等我興起作以色列的母。
verses.e: The rulers ceased in Israel . They ceased until I , Deborah , arose ; Until I arose a mother in Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人選擇新神，爭戰的事就臨到城門。那時，以色列四萬人中豈能見盾牌槍矛呢？
verses.e: They chose new gods . Then war was in the gates . Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?

verses.z: 我心傾向以色列的首領，他們在民中甘心犧牲自己。你們應當頌讚耶和華！
verses.e: My heart is toward the governors of Israel , who offered themselves willingly among the people . Bless the LORD !

verses.z: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華就把他們交在米甸人手裏七年。
verses.e: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , so the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years .

verses.z: 又對你們說：『我是耶和華－你們的上帝。你們住在亞摩利人的地，不可敬畏他們的神。你們竟不聽從我的話。』」
verses.e: I said to you , " I am the LORD your God . You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites , in whose land you dwell . " But you have not listened to my voice . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者到了俄弗拉，坐在亞比以謝族人約阿施的橡樹下。約阿施的兒子基甸正在酒醡那裏打麥子，為要防備米甸人。
verses.e: The LORD's angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah , that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite . His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press , to hide it from the Midianites .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者向基甸顯現，對他說：「大能的勇士啊，耶和華與你同在！」
verses.e: The LORD's angel appeared to him , and said to him , " The LORD is with you , you mighty man of valor ! "

verses.z: 基甸說：「主啊，耶和華若與我們同在，我們何致遭遇這一切事呢？我們的列祖不是向我們說『耶和華領我們從埃及上來』嗎？他那樣奇妙的作為在哪裏呢？現在他卻丟棄我們，將我們交在米甸人手裏。」
verses.e: Gideon said to him , " Oh , my lord , if the LORD is with us , why then has all this happened to us ? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of , saying , ' Didn't the LORD bring us up from Egypt ? ' But now the LORD has cast us off , and delivered us into the hand of Midian . "

verses.z: 耶和華觀看基甸，說：「你靠着你這能力去從米甸人手裏拯救以色列人，不是我差遣你去的嗎？」
verses.e: The LORD looked at him , and said , " Go in this your might , and save Israel from the hand of Midian . Haven't I sent you ? "

verses.z: 基甸說：「主啊，我有何能拯救以色列人呢？我家在瑪拿西支派中是至貧窮的。我在我父家是至微小的。」
verses.e: He said to him , " O Lord , how shall I save Israel ? Behold , my family is the poorest in Manasseh , and I am the least in my father's house . "

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「我與你同在，你就必擊打米甸人，如擊打一人一樣。」
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Surely I will be with you , and you shall strike the Midianites as one man . "

verses.z: 基甸說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你給我一個證據，使我知道與我說話的就是主。
verses.e: He said to him , " If now I have found favor in your sight , then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me .

verses.z: 求你不要離開這裏，等我歸回將禮物帶來供在你面前。」主說：「我必等你回來。」
verses.e: Please don't go away until I come to you , and bring out my present , and lay it before you . " He said , " I will wait until you come back . "

verses.z: 基甸去預備了一隻山羊羔，用一伊法細麵做了無酵餅，將肉放在筐內，把湯盛在壺中，帶到橡樹下，獻在使者面前。
verses.e: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal . He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot , and brought it out to him under the oak , and presented it .

verses.z: 米甸人壓制以色列人；以色列人因為米甸人，就在山中挖穴、挖洞、建造營寨。
verses.e: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel ; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains , the caves , and the strongholds .

verses.z: 上帝的使者吩咐基甸說：「將肉和無酵餅放在這磐石上，把湯倒出來。」他就這樣行了。
verses.e: The angel of God said to him , " Take the meat and the unleavened cakes , and lay them on this rock , and pour out the broth . " He did so .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者伸出手內的杖，杖頭挨了肉和無酵餅，就有火從磐石中出來，燒盡了肉和無酵餅。耶和華的使者也就不見了。
verses.e: Then the LORD's angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand , and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes ; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes . Then the LORD's angel departed out of his sight .

verses.z: 基甸見他是耶和華的使者，就說：「哀哉！主耶和華啊，我不好了，因為我覿面看見耶和華的使者。」
verses.e: Gideon saw that he was the LORD's angel ; and Gideon said , " Alas , Lord GOD ! Because I have seen the LORD's angel face to face ! "

verses.z: 耶和華對他說：「你放心，不要懼怕，你必不致死。」
verses.e: The LORD said to him , " Peace be to you ! Don't be afraid . You shall not die . "

verses.z: 於是基甸在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，起名叫「耶和華沙龍」。（這壇在亞比以謝族的俄弗拉直到如今。）
verses.e: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD , and called it " The LORD is Peace . " To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites .

verses.z: 當那夜，耶和華吩咐基甸說：「你取你父親的牛來，就是那七歲的第二隻牛，並拆毀你父親為巴力所築的壇，砍下壇旁的木偶，
verses.e: That same night , the LORD said to him , " Take your father's bull , even the second bull seven years old , and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has , and cut down the Asherah that is by it .

verses.z: 在這磐石上整整齊齊地為耶和華－你的上帝築一座壇，將第二隻牛獻為燔祭，用你所砍下的木偶作柴。」
verses.e: Then build an altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold , in an orderly way , and take the second bull , and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down . "

verses.z: 基甸就從他僕人中挑了十個人，照着耶和華吩咐他的行了。他因怕父家和本城的人，不敢在白晝行這事，就在夜間行了。
verses.e: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants , and did as the LORD had spoken to him . Because he feared his father's household and the men of the city , he could not do it by day , but he did it by night .

verses.z: 城裏的人清早起來，見巴力的壇拆毀，壇旁的木偶砍下，第二隻牛獻在新築的壇上，
verses.e: When the men of the city arose early in the morning , behold , the altar of Baal was broken down , and the Asherah was cut down that was by it , and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built .

verses.z: 就彼此說：「這事是誰做的呢？」他們訪查之後，就說：「這是約阿施的兒子基甸做的。」
verses.e: They said to one another , " Who has done this thing ? " When they inquired and asked , they said , " Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing . "

verses.z: 以色列人每逢撒種之後，米甸人、亞瑪力人，和東方人都上來攻打他們，
verses.e: So it was , when Israel had sown , that the Midianites , the Amalekites , and the children of the east came up against them .

verses.z: 城裏的人對約阿施說：「將你兒子交出來，好治死他；因為他拆毀了巴力的壇，砍下壇旁的木偶。」
verses.e: Then the men of the city said to Joash , " Bring out your son , that he may die , because he has broken down the altar of Baal , and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it . "

verses.z: 約阿施回答站着攻擊他的眾人說：「你們是為巴力爭論嗎？你們要救他嗎？誰為他爭論，趁早將誰治死！巴力若果是神，有人拆毀他的壇，讓他為自己爭論吧！」
verses.e: Joash said to all who stood against him , " Will you contend for Baal ? Or will you save him ? He who will contend for him , let him be put to death by morning ! If he is a god , let him contend for himself , because someone has broken down his altar ! "

verses.z: 所以當日人稱基甸為耶路‧巴力，意思說：「他拆毀巴力的壇，讓巴力與他爭論。」
verses.e: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal , saying , " Let Baal contend against him , because he has broken down his altar . "

verses.z: 那時，米甸人、亞瑪力人，和東方人都聚集過河，在耶斯列平原安營。
verses.e: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together ; and they passed over , and encamped in the valley of Jezreel .

verses.z: 耶和華的靈降在基甸身上，他就吹角；亞比以謝族都聚集跟隨他。
verses.e: But the LORD's Spirit came on Gideon , and he blew a trumpet ; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him .

verses.z: 他打發人走遍瑪拿西地，瑪拿西人也聚集跟隨他；又打發人去見亞設人、西布倫人、拿弗他利人，他們也都出來與他們會合。
verses.e: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh , and they also were gathered together to follow him . He sent messengers to Asher , to Zebulun , and to Naphtali ; and they came up to meet them .

verses.z: 基甸對上帝說：「你若果照着所說的話，藉我手拯救以色列人，
verses.e: Gideon said to God , " If you will save Israel by my hand , as you have spoken ,

verses.z: 我就把一團羊毛放在禾場上：若單是羊毛上有露水，別的地方都是乾的，我就知道你必照着所說的話，藉我手拯救以色列人。」
verses.e: behold , I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor . If there is dew on the fleece only , and it is dry on all the ground , then I'll know that you will save Israel by my hand , as you have spoken . "

verses.z: 次日早晨基甸起來，見果然是這樣；將羊毛擠一擠，從羊毛中擰出滿盆的露水來。
verses.e: It was so ; for he rose up early on the next day , and pressed the fleece together , and wrung the dew out of the fleece , a bowl full of water .

verses.z: 基甸又對上帝說：「求你不要向我發怒，我再說這一次：讓我將羊毛再試一次。但願羊毛是乾的，別的地方都有露水。」
verses.e: Gideon said to God , " Don't let your anger be kindled against me , and I will speak but this once . Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece . Let it now be dry only on the fleece , and on all the ground let there be dew . "

verses.z: 對着他們安營，毀壞土產，直到迦薩，沒有給以色列人留下食物，牛、羊、驢也沒有留下；
verses.e: They encamped against them , and destroyed the increase of the earth , until you come to Gaza . They left no sustenance in Israel , and no sheep , ox , or donkey .

verses.z: 這夜上帝也如此行：獨羊毛上是乾的，別的地方都有露水。
verses.e: God did so that night ; for it was dry on the fleece only , and there was dew on all the ground .

verses.z: 因為那些人帶着牲畜帳棚來，像蝗蟲那樣多，人和駱駝無數，都進入國內，毀壞全地。
verses.e: For they came up with their livestock and their tents . They came in as locusts for multitude . Both they and their camels were without number ; and they came into the land to destroy it .

verses.z: 以色列人因米甸人的緣故，極其窮乏，就呼求耶和華。
verses.e: Israel was brought very low because of Midian ; and the children of Israel cried to the LORD .

verses.z: 以色列人因米甸人的緣故，呼求耶和華，
verses.e: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD because of Midian ,

verses.z: 耶和華就差遣先知到以色列人那裏，對他們說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『我曾領你們從埃及上來，出了為奴之家，
verses.e: The LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel ; and he said to them , " The LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' I brought you up from Egypt , and brought you out of the house of bondage .

verses.z: 救你們脫離埃及人的手，並脫離一切欺壓你們之人的手，把他們從你們面前趕出，將他們的地賜給你們』；
verses.e: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you , and drove them out from before you , and gave you their land .

verses.z: 耶路‧巴力就是基甸，他和一切跟隨的人早晨起來，在哈律泉旁安營。米甸營在他們北邊的平原，靠近摩利岡。
verses.e: Then Jerubbaal , who is Gideon , and all the people who were with him , rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod . Midian's camp was on the north side of them , by the hill of Moreh , in the valley .

verses.z: 倘若你怕下去，就帶你的僕人普拉下到那營裏去。
verses.e: But if you are afraid to go down , go with Purah your servant down to the camp .

verses.z: 你必聽見他們所說的，然後你就有膽量下去攻營。」於是基甸帶着僕人普拉下到營旁。
verses.e: You will hear what they say ; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp . " Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp .

verses.z: 米甸人、亞瑪力人，和一切東方人都布散在平原，如同蝗蟲那樣多。他們的駱駝無數，多如海邊的沙。
verses.e: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude ; and their camels were without number , as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude .

verses.z: 基甸到了，就聽見一人將夢告訴同伴說：「我做了一夢，夢見一個大麥餅滾入米甸營中，到了帳幕，將帳幕撞倒，帳幕就翻轉傾覆了。」
verses.e: When Gideon had come , behold , there was a man telling a dream to his fellow . He said , " Behold , I dreamed a dream ; and behold , a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian , came to the tent , and struck it so that it fell , and turned it upside down , so that the tent lay flat . "

verses.z: 那同伴說：「這不是別的，乃是以色列人約阿施的兒子基甸的刀；上帝已將米甸和全軍都交在他的手中。」
verses.e: His fellow answered , " This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel . God has delivered Midian into his hand , with all the army . "

verses.z: 基甸聽見這夢和夢的講解，就敬拜[上帝]，回到以色列營中，說：「起來吧！耶和華已將米甸的軍隊交在你們手中了。」
verses.e: It was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation , that he worshiped . Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said , " Arise , for the LORD has delivered the army of Midian into your hand ! "

verses.z: 於是基甸將三百人分作三隊，把角和空瓶交在各人手裏（瓶內都藏着火把），
verses.e: He divided the three hundred men into three companies , and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers , with torches within the pitchers .

verses.z: 吩咐他們說：「你們要看我行事：我到了營的旁邊怎樣行，你們也要怎樣行。
verses.e: He said to them , " Watch me , and do likewise . Behold , when I come to the outermost part of the camp , it shall be that , as I do , so you shall do .

verses.z: 我和一切跟隨我的人吹角的時候，你們也要在營的四圍吹角，[喊叫]說：『耶和華和基甸[的刀]！』」
verses.e: When I blow the trumpet , I and all who are with me , then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp , and shout , ' For the LORD and for Gideon ! ' "

verses.z: 基甸和跟隨他的一百人，在三更之初才換更的時候，來到營旁，就吹角，打破手中的瓶。
verses.e: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch , when they had but newly set the watch . Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands .

verses.z: 耶和華對基甸說：「跟隨你的人過多，我不能將米甸人交在他們手中，免得以色列人向我誇大，說：『是我們自己的手救了我們。』
verses.e: The LORD said to Gideon , " The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand , lest Israel brag against me , saying , ' My own hand has saved me . '

verses.z: 三隊的人就都吹角，打破瓶子，左手拿着火把，右手拿着角，喊叫說：「耶和華和基甸的刀！」
verses.e: The three companies blew the trumpets , broke the pitchers , and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow ; and they shouted , " The sword of the LORD and of Gideon ! "

verses.z: 他們在營的四圍各站各的地方；全營的人都亂竄。三百人吶喊，使他們逃跑。
verses.e: They each stood in his place around the camp , and all the army ran ; and they shouted , and put them to flight .

verses.z: 三百人就吹角，耶和華使全營的人用刀互相擊殺，逃到西利拉的伯‧哈示他，直逃到靠近他巴的亞伯‧米何拉。
verses.e: They blew the three hundred trumpets , and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow and against all the army ; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah , as far as the border of Abel Meholah , by Tabbath .

verses.z: 以色列人就從拿弗他利、亞設，和瑪拿西全地聚集來追趕米甸人。
verses.e: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali , out of Asher , and out of all Manasseh , and pursued Midian .

verses.z: 基甸打發人走遍以法蓮山地，說：「你們下來攻擊米甸人，爭先把守約旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉。」於是以法蓮的眾人聚集，把守約旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉，
verses.e: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim , saying , " Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah , even the Jordan ! " So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah , even the Jordan .

verses.z: 捉住了米甸人的兩個首領：一名俄立，一名西伊伯；將俄立殺在俄立磐石上，將西伊伯殺在西伊伯酒醡那裏；又追趕米甸人，將俄立和西伊伯的首級帶過約旦河，到基甸那裏。
verses.e: They took the two princes of Midian , Oreb and Zeeb . They killed Oreb at Oreb's rock , and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb's wine press , as they pursued Midian . Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan .

verses.z: 現在你要向這些人宣告說：『凡懼怕膽怯的，可以離開基列山回去。』」於是有二萬二千人回去，只剩下一萬。
verses.e: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people , saying , ' Whoever is fearful and trembling , let him return and depart from Mount Gilead . ' " So twenty-two thousand of the people returned , and ten thousand remained .

verses.z: 耶和華對基甸說：「人還是過多；你要帶他們下到水旁，我好在那裏為你試試他們。我指點誰說：『這人可以同你去』，他就可以同你去；我指點誰說：『這人不可同你去』，他就不可同你去。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Gideon , " There are still too many people . Bring them down to the water , and I will test them for you there . It shall be , that those whom I tell you , ' This shall go with you , ' shall go with you ; and whoever I tell you , ' This shall not go with you , ' shall not go . "

verses.z: 基甸就帶他們下到水旁。耶和華對基甸說：「凡用舌頭舔水，像狗舔的，要使他單站在一處；凡跪下喝水的，也要使他單站在一處。」
verses.e: So he brought down the people to the water ; and the LORD said to Gideon , " Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue , like a dog laps , you shall set him by himself ; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink . "

verses.z: 於是用手捧着舔水的有三百人，其餘的都跪下喝水。
verses.e: The number of those who lapped , putting their hand to their mouth , was three hundred men ; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water .

verses.z: 耶和華對基甸說：「我要用這舔水的三百人拯救你們，將米甸人交在你手中；其餘的人都可以各歸各處去。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Gideon , " I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped , and deliver the Midianites into your hand . Let all the other people go , each to his own place . "

verses.z: 這三百人就帶着食物和角；其餘的以色列人，基甸都打發他們各歸各的帳棚，只留下這三百人。米甸營在他下邊的平原裏。
verses.e: So the people took food in their hand , and their trumpets ; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents , but retained the three hundred men ; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley .

verses.z: 當那夜，耶和華吩咐基甸說：「起來，下到[米甸]營裏去，因我已將他們交在你手中。
verses.e: That same night , the LORD said to him , " Arise , go down into the camp , for I have delivered it into your hand .

verses.z: 以法蓮人對基甸說：「你去與米甸人爭戰，沒有招我們同去，為甚麼這樣待我們呢？」他們就與基甸大大地爭吵。
verses.e: The men of Ephraim said to him , " Why have you treated us this way , that you didn't call us when you went to fight with Midian ? " They rebuked him sharply .

verses.z: 那時西巴和撒慕拿，並跟隨他們的軍隊都在加各，約有一萬五千人，就是東方人全軍所剩下的；已經被殺約有十二萬拿刀的。
verses.e: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor , and their armies with them , about fifteen thousand men , all who were left of all the army of the children of the east ; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword .

verses.z: 基甸就由挪巴和約比哈東邊，從住帳棚人的路上去，殺敗了米甸人的軍兵，因為他們坦然無懼。
verses.e: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah , and struck the army ; for the army felt secure .

verses.z: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追趕他們，捉住米甸的二王西巴和撒慕拿，驚散全軍。
verses.e: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them . He took the two kings of Midian , Zebah and Zalmunna , and confused all the army .

verses.z: 約阿施的兒子基甸由希列斯坡從陣上回來，
verses.e: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres .

verses.z: 捉住疏割的一個少年人，問他：「疏割的首領長老是誰？」他就將首領長老七十七個人的名字寫出來。
verses.e: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth , and inquired of him ; and he described for him the princes of Succoth , and its elders , seventy-seven men .

verses.z: 基甸到了疏割，對那裏的人說：「你們從前譏誚我說：『西巴和撒慕拿已經在你手裏，你使我們將餅給[跟隨]你的疲乏人嗎？』現在西巴和撒慕拿在這裏。」
verses.e: He came to the men of Succoth , and said , " See Zebah and Zalmunna , concerning whom you taunted me , saying , ' Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand , that we should give bread to your men who are weary ? ' "

verses.z: 於是捉住那城內的長老，用野地的荊條和枳棘責打疏割人；
verses.e: He took the elders of the city , and thorns of the wilderness and briers , and with them he taught the men of Succoth .

verses.z: 又拆了毗努伊勒的樓，殺了那城裏的人。
verses.e: He broke down the tower of Penuel , and killed the men of the city .

verses.z: 基甸問西巴和撒慕拿說：「你們在他泊山所殺的人是甚麼樣式？」回答說：「他們好像你，各人都有王子的樣式。」
verses.e: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna , " What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor ? " They answered , " They were like you . They all resembled the children of a king . "

verses.z: 基甸說：「他們是我同母的弟兄，我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你們從前若存留他們的性命，我如今就不殺你們了。」
verses.e: He said , " They were my brothers , the sons of my mother . As the LORD lives , if you had saved them alive , I would not kill you . "

verses.z: 基甸對他們說：「我所行的豈能比你們所行的呢？以法蓮拾取剩下的葡萄不強過亞比以謝所摘的葡萄嗎？
verses.e: He said to them , " What have I now done in comparison with you ? Isn't the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer ?

verses.z: 於是對他的長子益帖說：「你起來殺他們。」但益帖因為是童子，害怕，不敢拔刀。
verses.e: He said to Jether his firstborn , " Get up and kill them ! " But the youth didn't draw his sword ; for he was afraid , because he was yet a youth .

verses.z: 西巴和撒慕拿說：「你自己起來殺我們吧！因為人如何，力量也是如何。」基甸就起來，殺了西巴和撒慕拿，奪獲他們駱駝項上戴的月牙圈。
verses.e: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said , " You rise and fall on us ; for as the man is , so is his strength . " Gideon arose , and killed Zebah and Zalmunna , and took the crescents that were on their camels ' necks .

verses.z: 以色列人對基甸說：「你既救我們脫離米甸人的手，願你和你的兒孫管理我們。」
verses.e: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon , " Rule over us , both you , your son , and your son's son also ; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian . "

verses.z: 基甸說：「我不管理你們，我的兒子也不管理你們，惟有耶和華管理你們。」
verses.e: Gideon said to them , " I will not rule over you , neither shall my son rule over you . The LORD shall rule over you . "

verses.z: 基甸又對他們說：「我有一件事求你們：請你們各人將所奪的耳環給我。」（原來仇敵是以實瑪利人，都是戴金耳環的。）
verses.e: Gideon said to them , " I do have a request : that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder . " ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )

verses.z: 他們說：「我們情願給你」，就鋪開一件外衣，各人將所奪的耳環丟在其上。
verses.e: They answered , " We will willingly give them . " They spread a garment , and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it .

verses.z: 基甸所要出來的金耳環重一千七百[舍客勒]金子。此外還有米甸王所戴的月環、耳墜，和所穿的紫色衣服，並駱駝項上的[金]鍊子。
verses.e: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold , in addition to the crescents , and the pendants , and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian , and in addition to the chains that were about their camels ' necks .

verses.z: 基甸以此製造了一個以弗得，設立在本城俄弗拉。後來以色列人拜那以弗得行了邪淫；這就作了基甸和他全家的網羅。
verses.e: Gideon made an ephod out of it , and put it in Ophrah , his city . Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there ; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house .

verses.z: 這樣，米甸人被以色列人制伏了，不敢再抬頭。基甸還在的日子，國中太平四十年。
verses.e: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel , and they lifted up their heads no more . The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon .

verses.z: 約阿施的兒子耶路‧巴力回去，住在自己家裏。
verses.e: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house .

verses.z: 上帝已將米甸人的兩個首領俄立和西伊伯交在你們手中；我所行的豈能比你們所行的呢？」基甸說了這話，以法蓮人的怒氣就消了。
verses.e: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian , Oreb and Zeeb ! What was I able to do in comparison with you ? " Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that .

verses.z: 基甸有七十個親生的兒子，因為他有許多的妻。
verses.e: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body , for he had many wives .

verses.z: 他的妾住在示劍，也給他生了一個兒子。基甸與他起名叫亞比米勒。
verses.e: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son , and he named him Abimelech .

verses.z: 約阿施的兒子基甸，年紀老邁而死，葬在亞比以謝族的俄弗拉，在他父親約阿施的墳墓裏。
verses.e: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age , and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father , in Ophrah of the Abiezrites .

verses.z: 基甸死後，以色列人又去隨從諸巴力行邪淫，以巴力‧比利土為他們的神。
verses.e: As soon as Gideon was dead , the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals , and made Baal Berith their god .

verses.z: 以色列人不記念耶和華－他們的上帝，就是拯救他們脫離四圍仇敵之手的，
verses.e: The children of Israel didn't remember the LORD their God , who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side ;

verses.z: 也不照着耶路‧巴力，就是基甸向他們所施的恩惠厚待他的家。
verses.e: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal , that is , Gideon , according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel .

verses.z: 基甸和跟隨他的三百人到約旦河過渡，雖然疲乏，還是追趕。
verses.e: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over , he and the three hundred men who were with him , faint , yet pursuing .

verses.z: 基甸對疏割人說：「求你們拿餅來給跟隨我的人吃，因為他們疲乏了；我們追趕米甸人的兩個王西巴和撒慕拿。」
verses.e: He said to the men of Succoth , " Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me ; for they are faint , and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna , the kings of Midian . "

verses.z: 疏割人的首領回答說：「西巴和撒慕拿已經在你手裏，你使我們將餅給你的軍兵嗎？」
verses.e: The princes of Succoth said , " Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand , that we should give bread to your army ? "

verses.z: 基甸說：「耶和華將西巴和撒慕拿交在我手之後，我就用野地的荊條和枳棘打傷你們。」
verses.e: Gideon said , " Therefore when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand , then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers . "

verses.z: 基甸從那裏上到毗努伊勒，對那裏的人也是這樣說；毗努伊勒人也與疏割人回答他的話一樣。
verses.e: He went up there to Penuel , and spoke to them in the same way ; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered .

verses.z: 他向毗努伊勒人說：「我平平安安回來的時候，我必拆毀這樓。」
verses.e: He spoke also to the men of Penuel , saying , " When I come again in peace , I will break down this tower . "

verses.z: 耶路‧巴力的兒子亞比米勒到了示劍見他的眾母舅，對他們和他外祖全家的人說：
verses.e: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother's brothers , and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother's father , saying ,

verses.z: 樹木對無花果樹說：『請你來作我們的王。』
verses.e: " The trees said to the fig tree , ' Come and reign over us . '

verses.z: 無花果樹回答說：『我豈肯止住所結甜美的果子，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？』
verses.e: " But the fig tree said to them , ' Should I leave my sweetness , and my good fruit , and go to wave back and forth over the trees ? '

verses.z: 樹木對葡萄樹說：『請你來作我們的王。』
verses.e: " The trees said to the vine , ' Come and reign over us . '

verses.z: 葡萄樹回答說：『我豈肯止住使神和人喜樂的新酒，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？』
verses.e: " The vine said to them , ' Should I leave my new wine , which cheers God and man , and go to wave back and forth over the trees ? '

verses.z: 眾樹對荊棘說：『請你來作我們的王。』
verses.e: " Then all the trees said to the bramble , ' Come and reign over us . '

verses.z: 荊棘回答說：『你們若誠誠實實地膏我為王，就要投在我的蔭下；不然，願火從荊棘裏出來，燒滅黎巴嫩的香柏樹。』
verses.e: " The bramble said to the trees , ' If in truth you anoint me king over you , then come and take refuge in my shade ; and if not , let fire come out of the bramble , and devour the cedars of Lebanon . '

verses.z: 「現在你們立亞比米勒為王，若按誠實正直善待耶路‧巴力和他的全家，這就是酬他的勞。
verses.e: " Now therefore , if you have dealt truly and righteously , in that you have made Abimelech king , and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house , and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands

verses.z: 從前我父冒死為你們爭戰，救了你們脫離米甸人的手。
verses.e: ( for my father fought for you , risked his life , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian ;

verses.z: 你們如今起來攻擊我的父家，將他眾子七十人殺在一塊磐石上，又立他婢女所生的兒子亞比米勒為示劍人的王；他原是你們的弟兄。
verses.e: and you have risen up against my father's house today and have slain his sons , seventy persons , on one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his female servant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother ) ;

verses.z: 你們如今若按誠實正直待耶路‧巴力和他的家，就可因亞比米勒得歡樂，他也可因你們得歡樂；
verses.e: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today , then rejoice in Abimelech , and let him also rejoice in you ;

verses.z: 「請你們問示劍的眾人說，是耶路‧巴力的眾子七十人都管理你們好呢？還是一人管理你們好呢？你們又要記念我是你們的骨肉。」
verses.e: " Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem , ' Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal , who are seventy persons , rule over you , or that one rule over you ? ' Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh . "

verses.z: 不然，願火從亞比米勒發出，燒滅示劍人和米羅眾人，又願火從示劍人和米羅人中出來，燒滅亞比米勒。」
verses.e: but if not , let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo ; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech . "

verses.z: 約坦因怕他弟兄亞比米勒，就逃跑，來到比珥，住在那裏。
verses.e: Jotham ran away and fled , and went to Beer and lived there , for fear of Abimelech his brother .

verses.z: 亞比米勒管理以色列人三年。
verses.e: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years .

verses.z: 上帝使惡魔降在亞比米勒和示劍人中間，示劍人就以詭詐待亞比米勒。
verses.e: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem ; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech ,

verses.z: 這是要叫耶路‧巴力七十個兒子所受的殘害歸與他們的哥哥亞比米勒，又叫那流他們血的罪歸與幫助他殺弟兄的示劍人。
verses.e: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come , and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them , and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers .

verses.z: 示劍人在山頂上設埋伏，等候亞比米勒。凡從他們那裏經過的人，他們就搶奪。有人將這事告訴亞比米勒。
verses.e: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains , and they robbed all who came along that way by them ; and Abimelech was told about it .

verses.z: 以別的兒子迦勒和他的弟兄來到示劍，示劍人都信靠他。
verses.e: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem ; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him .

verses.z: 示劍人出城到田間去，摘下葡萄，踹酒，設擺筵宴，進他們神的廟中吃喝，咒詛亞比米勒。
verses.e: They went out into the field , harvested their vineyards , trod the grapes , celebrated , and went into the house of their god and ate and drank , and cursed Abimelech .

verses.z: 以別的兒子迦勒說：「亞比米勒是誰？示劍是誰？使我們服事他呢？他不是耶路‧巴力的兒子嗎？他的幫手不是西布勒嗎？你們可以服事示劍的父親哈抹的後裔。我們為何服事亞比米勒呢？
verses.e: Gaal the son of Ebed said , " Who is Abimelech , and who is Shechem , that we should serve him ? Isn't he the son of Jerubbaal ? Isn't Zebul his officer ? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem , but why should we serve him ?

verses.z: 惟願這民歸我的手下，我就除掉亞比米勒。」迦勒又對亞比米勒說：「增添你的軍兵出來吧。」
verses.e: I wish that this people were under my hand ! Then I would remove Abimelech . " He said to Abimelech , " Increase your army and come out ! "

verses.z: 他的眾母舅便將這一切話為他說給示劍人聽，示劍人的心就歸向亞比米勒。他們說：「他原是我們的弟兄」；
verses.e: His mother's brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words . Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech ; for they said , " He is our brother . "

verses.z: 邑宰西布勒聽見以別的兒子迦勒的話，就發怒，
verses.e: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed , his anger burned .

verses.z: 悄悄地打發人去見亞比米勒，說：「以別的兒子迦勒和他的弟兄到了示劍，煽惑城中的民攻擊你。
verses.e: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily , saying , " Behold , Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem ; and behold , they incite the city against you .

verses.z: 現在你和跟隨你的人今夜起來，在田間埋伏。
verses.e: Now therefore , go up by night , you and the people who are with you , and lie in wait in the field .

verses.z: 到早晨太陽一出，你就起來闖城。迦勒和跟隨他的人出來攻擊你的時候，你便向他們見機而做。」
verses.e: It shall be that in the morning , as soon as the sun is up , you shall rise early and rush on the city . Behold , when he and the people who are with him come out against you , then may you do to them as you shall find occasion . "

verses.z: 於是，亞比米勒和跟隨他的眾人夜間起來，分作四隊，埋伏等候示劍人。
verses.e: Abimelech rose up , and all the people who were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .

verses.z: 以別的兒子迦勒出去，站在城門口。亞比米勒和跟隨他的人從埋伏之處起來。
verses.e: Gaal the son of Ebed went out , and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city . Abimelech rose up , and the people who were with him , from the ambush .

verses.z: 迦勒看見那些人，就對西布勒說：「看哪，有人從山頂上下來了。」西布勒說：「你看見山的影子，以為是人。」
verses.e: When Gaal saw the people , he said to Zebul , " Behold , people are coming down from the tops of the mountains . " Zebul said to him , " You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men . "

verses.z: 迦勒又說：「看哪，有人從高處下來，又有一隊從米惡尼尼橡樹的路上而來。」
verses.e: Gaal spoke again and said , " Behold , people are coming down by the middle of the land , and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim . "

verses.z: 西布勒對他說：「你曾說，亞比米勒是誰，叫我們服事他？你所[誇]的口在哪裏呢？這不是你所藐視的民嗎？你現在出去，與他們交戰吧！」
verses.e: Then Zebul said to him , " Now where is your mouth , that you said , ' Who is Abimelech , that we should serve him ? ' Isn't this the people that you have despised ? Please go out now and fight with them . "

verses.z: 於是迦勒率領示劍人出去，與亞比米勒交戰。
verses.e: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem , and fought with Abimelech .

verses.z: 就從巴力‧比利土的廟中取了七十[舍客勒]銀子給亞比米勒；亞比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟隨他。
verses.e: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith , with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him .

verses.z: 亞比米勒追趕迦勒；迦勒在他面前逃跑，有許多受傷仆倒的，直到城門。
verses.e: Abimelech chased him , and he fled before him , and many fell wounded , even to the entrance of the gate .

verses.z: 亞比米勒住在亞魯瑪。西布勒趕出迦勒和他弟兄，不准他們住在示劍。
verses.e: Abimelech lived at Arumah ; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers , that they should not dwell in Shechem .

verses.z: 次日，民出到田間，有人告訴亞比米勒；
verses.e: On the next day , the people went out into the field ; and they told Abimelech .

verses.z: 他就把他的人分作三隊，埋伏在田間，看見示劍人從城裏出來，就起來擊殺他們。
verses.e: He took the people and divided them into three companies , and laid wait in the field ; and he looked , and behold , the people came out of the city . So , he rose up against them and struck them .

verses.z: 亞比米勒和跟隨他的一隊向前闖去，站在城門口；那兩隊直闖到田間，擊殺了眾人。
verses.e: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city ; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them .

verses.z: 亞比米勒整天攻打城，將城奪取，殺了其中的居民，將城拆毀，撒上了鹽。
verses.e: Abimelech fought against the city all that day ; and he took the city and killed the people in it . He beat down the city and sowed it with salt .

verses.z: 示劍樓的人聽見了，就躲入巴力‧比利土廟的衛所。
verses.e: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it , they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith .

verses.z: 有人告訴亞比米勒說：「示劍樓的人都聚在一處。」
verses.e: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together .

verses.z: 亞比米勒和跟隨他的人就都上撒們山。亞比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根樹枝，扛在肩上，對跟隨他的人說：「你們看我所行的，也當趕緊照樣行。」
verses.e: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon , he and all the people who were with him ; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it up , and laid it on his shoulder . Then he said to the people who were with him , " What you have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done ! "

verses.z: 眾人就各砍一枝，跟隨亞比米勒，把樹枝堆在衛所的四圍，放火燒了衛所，以致示劍樓的人都死了，男女約有一千。
verses.e: All the people likewise each cut down his bough , followed Abimelech , and put them at the base of the stronghold , and set the stronghold on fire over them , so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also , about a thousand men and women .

verses.z: 他往俄弗拉到他父親的家，將他弟兄、耶路‧巴力的眾子七十人都殺在一塊磐石上；只剩下耶路‧巴力的小兒子約坦，因為他躲藏了。
verses.e: He went to his father's house at Ophrah , and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal , being seventy persons , on one stone ; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left , for he hid himself .

verses.z: 亞比米勒到提備斯，向提備斯安營，就攻取了那城。
verses.e: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez , and took it .

verses.z: 城中有一座堅固的樓；城裏的眾人，無論男女，都逃進樓去，關上門，上了樓頂。
verses.e: But there was a strong tower within the city , and all the men and women of the city fled there , and shut themselves in , and went up to the roof of the tower .

verses.z: 亞比米勒到了樓前攻打，挨近樓門，要用火焚燒。
verses.e: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it , and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire .

verses.z: 有一個婦人把一塊上磨石拋在亞比米勒的頭上，打破了他的腦骨。
verses.e: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech's head , and broke his skull .

verses.z: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，對他說：「拔出你的刀來，殺了我吧！免得人議論我說，他為一個婦人所殺。」於是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。
verses.e: Then he called hastily to the young man , his armor bearer , and said to him , " Draw your sword and kill me , that men not say of me , ' A woman killed him . ' His young man thrust him through , and he died . "

verses.z: 以色列人見亞比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。
verses.e: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead , they each departed to his place .

verses.z: 這樣，上帝報應亞比米勒向他父親所行的惡，就是殺了弟兄七十個人的惡。
verses.e: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech , which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers ;

verses.z: 示劍人的一切惡，上帝也都報應在他們頭上；耶路‧巴力的兒子約坦的咒詛歸到他們身上了。
verses.e: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads ; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them .

verses.z: 示劍人和米羅人都一同聚集，往示劍橡樹旁的柱子那裏，立亞比米勒為王。
verses.e: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo , and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem .

verses.z: 有人將這事告訴約坦，他就去站在基利心山頂上，向眾人大聲喊叫說：「示劍人哪，你們要聽我的話，上帝也就聽你們的話。
verses.e: When they told it to Jotham , he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice , cried out , and said to them , " Listen to me , you men of Shechem , that God may listen to you .

verses.z: 有一時，樹木要膏一樹為王，管理他們，就去對橄欖樹說：『請你作我們的王。』
verses.e: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves . They said to the olive tree , ' Reign over us . '

verses.z: 橄欖樹回答說：『我豈肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？』
verses.e: " But the olive tree said to them , ' Should I stop producing my oil , with which they honor God and man by me , and go to wave back and forth over the trees ? '

verses.z: 便雅憫地亞拿突城的祭司中，希勒家的兒子耶利米的話記在下面。
verses.e: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah , one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin .

verses.z: 看哪，我今日立你在列邦列國之上，為要施行拔出、拆毀、毀壞、傾覆，又要建立、栽植。
verses.e: Behold , I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms , to uproot and to tear down , to destroy and to overthrow , to build and to plant . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：「耶利米，你看見甚麼？」我說：「我看見一根杏樹枝。」
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying , " Jeremiah , what do you see ? " I said , " I see a branch of an almond tree . "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「你看得不錯；因為我留意保守我的話，使得成就。」
verses.e: Then the LORD said to me , " You have seen well ; for I watch over my word to perform it . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話第二次臨到我說：「你看見甚麼？」我說：「我看見一個燒開的鍋，從北而傾。」
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me the second time , saying , " What do you see ? " I said , " I see a boiling cauldron ; and it is tipping away from the north . "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「必有災禍從北方發出，臨到這地的一切居民。」
verses.e: Then the LORD said to me , " Out of the north , evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「看哪，我要召北方列國的眾族；他們要來，各安座位在耶路撒冷的城門口，周圍攻擊城牆，又要攻擊猶大的一切城邑。
verses.e: For behold , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , " says the LORD . " They will come , and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem , and against all its walls all around , and against all the cities of Judah .

verses.z: 至於這民的一切惡，就是離棄我、向別神燒香、跪拜自己手所造的，我要發出我的判語，攻擊他們。
verses.e: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness , in that they have forsaken me , and have burned incense to other gods , and worshiped the works of their own hands .

verses.z: 所以你當束腰，起來將我所吩咐你的一切話告訴他們；不要因他們驚惶，免得我使你在他們面前驚惶。
verses.e: " You therefore put your belt on your waist , arise , and say to them all that I command you . Don't be dismayed at them , lest I dismay you before them .

verses.z: 看哪，我今日使你成為堅城、鐵柱、銅牆，與全地和猶大的君王、首領、祭司，並地上的眾民反對。
verses.e: For behold , I have made you today a fortified city , an iron pillar , and bronze walls against the whole land — against the kings of Judah , against its princes , against its priests , and against the people of the land .

verses.z: 他們要攻擊你，卻不能勝你；因為我與你同在，要拯救你。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: They will fight against you , but they will not prevail against you ; for I am with you " , says the LORD , " to rescue you . "

verses.z: 猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞在位十三年，耶和華的話臨到耶利米。
verses.e: The LORD's word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah , in the thirteenth year of his reign .

verses.z: 從猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬在位的時候，直到猶大王約西亞的兒子西底家在位的末年，就是十一年五月間耶路撒冷人被擄的時候，耶和華的話也常臨到耶利米。
verses.e: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah , king of Judah , to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah , the son of Josiah , king of Judah , to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .

verses.z: 耶利米說，耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: Now the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 我未將你造在腹中，我已曉得你；你未出母胎，我已分別你為聖；我已派你作列國的先知。
verses.e: " Before I formed you in the womb , I knew you . Before you were born , I sanctified you . I have appointed you a prophet to the nations . "

verses.z: 我就說：主耶和華啊，我不知怎樣說，因為我是年幼的。
verses.e: Then I said , " Ah , Lord GOD ! Behold , I don't know how to speak ; for I am a child . "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：你不要說我是年幼的，因為我差遣你到誰那裏去，你都要去；我吩咐你說甚麼話，你都要說。
verses.e: But the LORD said to me , " Don't say , ' I am a child ; ' for you must go to whomever I send you , and you must say whatever I command you .

verses.z: 你不要懼怕他們，因為我與你同在，要拯救你。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Don't be afraid because of them , for I am with you to rescue you , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 於是耶和華伸手按我的口，對我說：我已將當說的話傳給你。
verses.e: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth . Then the LORD said to me , " Behold , I have put my words in your mouth .

verses.z: 以色列家啊，要聽耶和華對你們所說的話。
verses.e: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you , house of Israel !

verses.z: 惟耶和華是真上帝，是活上帝，是永遠的王。他一發怒，大地震動；他一惱恨，列國都擔當不起。（
verses.e: But the LORD is the true God . He is the living God , and an everlasting King . At his wrath , the earth trembles . The nations aren't able to withstand his indignation .

verses.z: 你們要對他們如此說：不是那創造天地的神，必從地上從天下被除滅！）
verses.e: " You shall say this to them : ' The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth , and from under the heavens . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華用能力創造大地，用智慧建立世界，用聰明鋪張穹蒼。
verses.e: God has made the earth by his power . He has established the world by his wisdom , and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens .

verses.z: 他一發聲，空中便有多水激動；他使雲霧從地極上騰；他造電隨雨而閃，從他府庫中帶出風來。
verses.e: When he utters his voice , the waters in the heavens roar , and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth . He makes lightnings for the rain , and brings the wind out of his treasuries .

verses.z: 各人都成了畜類，毫無知識；各銀匠都因他雕刻的偶像羞愧。他所鑄的偶像本是虛假的，其中並無氣息，
verses.e: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge . Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image ; for his molten image is falsehood , and there is no breath in them .

verses.z: 都是虛無的，是迷惑人的工作；到追討的時候必被除滅。
verses.e: They are vanity , a work of delusion . In the time of their visitation they will perish .

verses.z: 雅各的分不像這些，因他是造作萬有的[主]。以色列也是他產業的支派，萬軍之耶和華是他的名。
verses.e: The portion of Jacob is not like these ; for he is the maker of all things ; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance . The LORD of Armies is his name .

verses.z: 受圍困的人哪，當收拾你的財物，從國中帶出去。
verses.e: Gather up your wares out of the land , you who live under siege .

verses.z: 因為耶和華如此說：這時候，我必將此地的居民，好像用機弦甩出去，又必加害在他們身上，使他們覺悟。
verses.e: For the LORD says , " Behold , I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time , and will distress them , that they may feel it . "

verses.z: 民[說]：禍哉！我受損傷；我的傷痕極其重大。我卻說：這真是我的痛苦，必須忍受。
verses.e: Woe is me because of my injury ! My wound is serious ; but I said , " Truly this is my grief , and I must bear it . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你們不要效法列國的行為，也不要為天象驚惶，因列國為此事驚惶。
verses.e: The LORD says , " Don't learn the way of the nations , and don't be dismayed at the signs of the sky ; for the nations are dismayed at them .

verses.z: 我的帳棚毀壞；我的繩索折斷。我的兒女離我出去，沒有了。無人再支搭我的帳棚，掛起我的幔子。
verses.e: My tent has been destroyed , and all my cords are broken . My children have gone away from me , and they are no more . There is no one to spread my tent any more , to set up my curtains .

verses.z: 因為牧人都成為畜類，沒有求問耶和華，所以不得順利；他們的羊群也都分散。
verses.e: For the shepherds have become brutish , and have not inquired of the LORD . Therefore they have not prospered , and all their flocks have scattered .

verses.z: 有風聲！看哪，[敵人]來了！有大擾亂從北方出來，要使猶大城邑變為荒涼，成為野狗的住處。
verses.e: The voice of news , behold , it comes , and a great commotion out of the north country , to make the cities of Judah a desolation , a dwelling place of jackals .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我曉得人的道路不由自己，行路的人也不能定自己的腳步。
verses.e: LORD , I know that the way of man is not in himself . It is not in man who walks to direct his steps .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你從寬懲治我，不要在你的怒中懲治我，恐怕使我歸於無有。
verses.e: LORD , correct me , but gently ; not in your anger , lest you reduce me to nothing .

verses.z: 願你將忿怒傾在不認識你的列國中，和不求告你名的各族上；因為他們吞了雅各，不但吞了，而且滅絕，把他的住處變為荒場。
verses.e: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don't know you , and on the families that don't call on your name ; for they have devoured Jacob . Yes , they have devoured him , consumed him , and have laid waste his habitation .

verses.z: 眾民的風俗是虛空的；他們在樹林中用斧子砍伐一棵樹，匠人用手工造成[偶像]。
verses.e: For the customs of the peoples are vanity ; for one cuts a tree out of the forest , the work of the hands of the workman with the ax .

verses.z: 他們用金銀妝飾它，用釘子和錘子釘穩，使它不動搖。
verses.e: They deck it with silver and with gold . They fasten it with nails and with hammers , so that it can't move .

verses.z: 它好像棕樹，是鏇成的，不能說話，不能行走，必須有人抬着。你們不要怕它；它不能降禍，也無力降福。
verses.e: They are like a palm tree , of turned work , and don't speak . They must be carried , because they can't move . Don't be afraid of them ; for they can't do evil , neither is it in them to do good . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，沒有能比你的！你本為大，有大能大力的名。
verses.e: There is no one like you , LORD . You are great , and your name is great in might .

verses.z: 萬國的王啊，誰不敬畏你？敬畏你本是合宜的；因為在列國的智慧人中，雖有政權的尊榮，也不能比你。
verses.e: Who shouldn't fear you , King of the nations ? For it belongs to you . Because among all the wise men of the nations , and in all their royal estate , there is no one like you .

verses.z: 他們盡都是畜類，是愚昧的。偶像的訓誨算甚麼呢？偶像不過是木頭。
verses.e: But they are together brutish and foolish , instructed by idols ! It is just wood .

verses.z: 有銀子打成片，是從他施帶來的，並有從烏法來的金子，都是匠人和銀匠的手工，又有藍色紫色料的衣服，都是巧匠的工作。
verses.e: There is silver beaten into plates , which is brought from Tarshish , and gold from Uphaz , the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith . Their clothing is blue and purple . They are all the work of skillful men .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到耶利米說：
verses.e: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying ,

verses.z: 他們轉去效法他們的先祖，不肯聽我的話，犯罪作孽，又隨從別神，事奉它。以色列家和猶大家背了我與他們列祖所立的約。」
verses.e: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers , who refused to hear my words . They have gone after other gods to serve them . The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers .

verses.z: 所以耶和華如此說：「我必使災禍臨到他們，是他們不能逃脫的。他們必向我哀求，我卻不聽。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says , ' Behold , I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape ; and they will cry to me , but I will not listen to them .

verses.z: 那時，猶大城邑的人和耶路撒冷的居民要去哀求他們燒香所供奉的神；只是遭難的時候，這些神毫不拯救他們。
verses.e: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense , but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble .

verses.z: 猶大啊，你神的數目與你城的數目相等；你為那可恥的巴力所築燒香的壇也與耶路撒冷街道的數目相等。
verses.e: For according to the number of your cities are your gods , Judah ; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing , even altars to burn incense to Baal . '

verses.z: 「所以你不要為這百姓祈禱，不要為他們呼求禱告；因為他們遭難向我哀求的時候，我必不應允。
verses.e: " Therefore don't pray for this people . Don't lift up cry or prayer for them ; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble .

verses.z: 我所親愛的，既行許多淫亂，聖肉也離了你，你在我殿中做甚麼呢？你作惡就喜樂。
verses.e: What has my beloved to do in my house , since she has behaved lewdly with many , and the holy flesh has passed from you ? When you do evil , then you rejoice . "

verses.z: 從前耶和華給你起名叫青橄欖樹，又華美又結好果子；如今他用鬨嚷之聲，點火在其上，枝子也被折斷。
verses.e: The LORD called your name , " A green olive tree , beautiful with goodly fruit . " With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it , and its branches are broken .

verses.z: 原來栽培你的萬軍之耶和華已經說，要降禍攻擊你，是因以色列家和猶大家行惡，向巴力燒香，惹我發怒，是自作自受。」
verses.e: For the LORD of Armies , who planted you , has pronounced evil against you , because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah , which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal .

verses.z: 耶和華指示我，我就知道；你將他們所行的給我指明。
verses.e: The LORD gave me knowledge of it , and I knew it . Then you showed me their doings .

verses.z: 我卻像柔順的羊羔被牽到宰殺之地；我並不知道他們設計謀害我，[說]：我們把樹連果子都滅了吧！將他從活人之地剪除，使他的名不再被紀念。
verses.e: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter . I didn't know that they had devised plans against me , saying , " Let's destroy the tree with its fruit , and let's cut him off from the land of the living , that his name may be no more remembered . "

verses.z: 「當聽這約的話，告訴猶大人和耶路撒冷的居民，
verses.e: " Hear the words of this covenant , and speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 按公義判斷、察驗人肺腑心腸的萬軍之耶和華啊，我卻要見你在他們身上報仇，因我將我的案件向你稟明了。
verses.e: But , LORD of Armies , who judges righteously , who tests the heart and the mind , I will see your vengeance on them ; for to you I have revealed my cause .

verses.z: 所以，耶和華論到尋索你命的亞拿突人如此說：「他們說：你不要奉耶和華的名說預言，免得你死在我們手中。
verses.e: " Therefore the LORD says concerning the men of Anathoth , who seek your life , saying , ' You shall not prophesy in the LORD's name , that you not die by our hand ' —

verses.z: 所以萬軍之耶和華如此說：看哪，我必刑罰他們；他們的少年人必被刀劍殺死，他們的兒女必因饑荒滅亡，
verses.e: therefore the LORD of Armies says , ' Behold , I will punish them . The young men will die by the sword . Their sons and their daughters will die by famine .

verses.z: 並且沒有餘剩的人留給他們；因為在追討之年，我必使災禍臨到亞拿突人。」
verses.e: There will be no remnant to them , for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation . ' "

verses.z: 對他們說，耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：不聽從這約之話的人必受咒詛。
verses.e: and say to them , the LORD , the God of Israel says : ' Cursed is the man who doesn't hear the words of this covenant ,

verses.z: 這約是我將你們列祖從埃及地領出來、脫離鐵爐的那日所吩咐他們的，說：『你們要聽從我的話，照我一切所吩咐的去行。』這樣，你們就作我的子民，我也作你們的上帝；
verses.e: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt , out of the iron furnace , ' saying , ' Obey my voice and do them , according to all which I command you ; so you shall be my people , and I will be your God ;

verses.z: 我好堅定向你們列祖所起的誓，給他們流奶與蜜之地，正如今日一樣。」我就回答說：「耶和華啊，阿們！」
verses.e: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers , to give them a land flowing with milk and honey , ' as it is today . " Then I answered , and said , " Amen , LORD . "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「你要在猶大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上，宣告這一切話說：你們當聽從遵行這約的話。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , saying , ' Hear the words of this covenant , and do them .

verses.z: 因為我將你們列祖從埃及地領出來的那日，直到今日，都是從早起來，切切誥誡他們說：『你們當聽從我的話。』
verses.e: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt , even to this day , rising early and protesting , saying , " Obey my voice . "

verses.z: 他們卻不聽從，不側耳而聽，竟隨從自己頑梗的惡心去行。所以我使這約中一切[咒詛]的話臨到他們身上；這約是我吩咐他們行的，他們卻不去行。」
verses.e: Yet they didn't obey , nor turn their ear , but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart . Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant , which I commanded them to do , but they didn't do them . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「在猶大人和耶路撒冷居民中有同謀背叛的事。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我與你爭辯的時候，你顯為義；但有一件，我還要與你理論：惡人的道路為何亨通呢？大行詭詐的為何得安逸呢？
verses.e: You are righteous , LORD , when I contend with you ; yet I would like to plead a case with you . Why does the way of the wicked prosper ? Why are they all at ease who deal very treacherously ?

verses.z: 許多牧人毀壞我的葡萄園，踐踏我的分，使我美好的分變為荒涼的曠野。
verses.e: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard . They have trodden my portion under foot . They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness .

verses.z: 他們使地荒涼；地既荒涼，便向我悲哀。全地荒涼，因無人介意。
verses.e: They have made it a desolation . It mourns to me , being desolate . The whole land is made desolate , because no one cares .

verses.z: 滅命的都來到曠野中一切淨光的高處；耶和華的刀從地這邊直到地那邊盡行殺滅。凡有血氣的都不得平安。
verses.e: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness ; for the sword of the LORD devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land . No flesh has peace .

verses.z: 他們種的是麥子，收的是荊棘；勞勞苦苦卻毫無益處。因耶和華的烈怒，你們必為自己的土產羞愧。
verses.e: They have sown wheat , and have reaped thorns . They have exhausted themselves , and profit nothing . You will be ashamed of your fruits , because of the LORD's fierce anger . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「一切惡鄰，就是佔據我使百姓以色列所承受產業的，我要將他們拔出本地，又要將猶大家從他們中間拔出來。
verses.e: The LORD says , " Concerning all my evil neighbors , who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit : Behold , I will pluck them up from off their land , and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them .

verses.z: 我拔出他們以後，我必轉過來憐憫他們，把他們再帶回來，各歸本業，各歸故土。
verses.e: It will happen that after I have plucked them up , I will return and have compassion on them . I will bring them again , every man to his heritage , and every man to his land .

verses.z: 他們若殷勤學習我百姓的道，指着我的名起誓[說]：『我指着永生的耶和華起誓』，正如他們從前教我百姓指着巴力起誓，他們就必建立在我百姓中間。
verses.e: It will happen , if they will diligently learn the ways of my people , to swear by my name , ' As the LORD lives ; ' even as they taught my people to swear by Baal , then they will be built up in the middle of my people .

verses.z: 他們若是不聽，我必拔出那國，拔出而且毀滅。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: But if they will not hear , then I will pluck up that nation , plucking up and destroying it , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 你栽培了他們，他們也扎了根，長大，而且結果。他們的口是與你相近，心卻與你遠離。
verses.e: You have planted them . Yes , they have taken root . They grow . Yes , they produce fruit . You are near in their mouth , and far from their heart .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你曉得我，看見我，察驗我向你是怎樣的心。求你將他們拉出來，好像將宰的羊，叫他們等候殺戮的日子。
verses.e: But you , LORD , know me . You see me , and test my heart toward you . Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter , and prepare them for the day of slaughter .

verses.z: 這地悲哀，通國的青草枯乾，要到幾時呢？因其上居民的惡行，牲畜和飛鳥都滅絕了。他們曾說：他看不見我們的結局。
verses.e: How long will the land mourn , and the herbs of the whole country wither ? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein , the animals and birds are consumed ; because they said , " He won't see our latter end . "

verses.z: [耶和華說]：你若與步行的人同跑，尚且覺累，怎能與馬賽跑呢？你在平安之地，雖然安穩，在約旦河邊的叢林要怎樣行呢？
verses.e: " If you have run with the footmen , and they have wearied you , then how can you contend with horses ? Though in a land of peace you are secure , yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan ?

verses.z: 因為連你弟兄和你父家都用奸詐待你。他們也在你後邊大聲喊叫，雖向你說好話，你也不要信他們。
verses.e: For even your brothers , and the house of your father , even they have dealt treacherously with you ! Even they have cried aloud after you ! Don't believe them , though they speak beautiful words to you .

verses.z: 我離了我的殿宇，撇棄我的產業，將我心裏所親愛的交在她仇敵的手中。
verses.e: " I have forsaken my house . I have cast off my heritage . I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies .

verses.z: 我的產業向我如林中的獅子，她發聲攻擊我，因此我恨惡她。
verses.e: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest . She has uttered her voice against me . Therefore I have hated her .

verses.z: 我的產業向我豈如斑點的鷙鳥呢？鷙鳥豈在她四圍攻擊她呢？你們要去聚集田野的百獸，帶來吞吃吧！
verses.e: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey ? Are the birds of prey against her all around ? Go , assemble all the animals of the field . Bring them to devour .

verses.z: 耶和華對我如此說：「你去買一根麻布帶子束腰，不可放在水中。」
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Go , and buy yourself a linen belt , and put it on your waist , and don't put it in water . "

verses.z: 這惡民不肯聽我的話，按自己頑梗的心而行，隨從別神，事奉敬拜，他們也必像這腰帶變為無用。」
