verses.e: This evil people , who refuse to hear my words , who walk in the stubbornness of their heart , and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them , will even be as this belt , which is profitable for nothing .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「腰帶怎樣緊貼人腰，照樣，我也使以色列全家和猶大全家緊貼我，好叫他們屬我為子民，使我得名聲，得頌讚，得榮耀；他們卻不肯聽。」
verses.e: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man , so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me , ' says the LORD ; ' that they may be to me for a people , for a name , for praise , and for glory ; but they would not hear . '

verses.z: 「所以你要對他們說：『耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：各罈都要盛滿了酒。』他們必對你說：『我們豈不確知各罈都要盛滿了酒呢？』
verses.e: " Therefore you shall speak to them this word : ' The LORD , the God of Israel says , " Every container should be filled with wine . " ' They will tell you , ' Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine ? '

verses.z: 你就要對他們說：『耶和華如此說：我必使這地的一切居民，就是坐大衛寶座的君王和祭司，與先知，並耶路撒冷的一切居民，都酩酊大醉。』」
verses.e: Then tell them , ' The LORD says , " Behold , I will fill all the inhabitants of this land , even the kings who sit on David's throne , the priests , the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我要使他們彼此相碰，就是父與子彼此相碰；我必不可憐，不顧惜，不憐憫，以致滅絕他們。」
verses.e: I will dash them one against another , even the fathers and the sons together , " says the LORD : " I will not pity , spare , or have compassion , that I should not destroy them . " ' "

verses.z: 你們當聽，當側耳而聽。不要驕傲，因為耶和華已經說了。
verses.e: Hear , and give ear . Don't be proud , for the LORD has spoken .

verses.z: 耶和華－你們的上帝未使黑暗來到，你們的腳未在昏暗山上絆跌之先，當將榮耀歸給他；免得你們盼望光明，他使光明變為死蔭，成為幽暗。
verses.e: Give glory to the LORD your God , before he causes darkness , and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains , and while you look for light , he turns it into the shadow of death , and makes it deep darkness .

verses.z: 你們若不聽這話，我必因[你們的]驕傲在暗地哭泣；我眼必痛哭流淚，因為耶和華的群眾被擄去了。
verses.e: But if you will not hear it , my soul will weep in secret for your pride . My eye will weep bitterly , and run down with tears , because the LORD's flock has been taken captive .

verses.z: 你要對君王和太后說：你們當自卑，坐在下邊；因你們的頭巾，就是你們的華冠，已經脫落了。
verses.e: Say to the king and to the queen mother , " Humble yourselves . Sit down , for your crowns have come down , even the crown of your glory .

verses.z: 南方的城盡都關閉，無人開放；猶大全被擄掠，且擄掠淨盡。
verses.e: The cities of the South are shut up , and there is no one to open them . Judah is carried away captive : all of them . They are wholly carried away captive .

verses.z: 我就照着耶和華的話，買了一根帶子束腰。
verses.e: So I bought a belt according to the LORD's word , and put it on my waist .

verses.z: 你們要舉目觀看從北方來的人。先前賜給你的群眾，就是你佳美的群眾，如今在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Lift up your eyes , and see those who come from the north . Where is the flock that was given to you , your beautiful flock ?

verses.z: 耶和華立你自己所交的朋友為首，轄制你，那時你還有甚麼話說呢？痛苦豈不將你抓住像產難的婦人嗎？
verses.e: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you ? Won't sorrows take hold of you , as of a woman in travail ?

verses.z: 你若心裏說：這一切事為何臨到我呢？你的衣襟揭起，你的腳跟受傷，是因你的罪孽甚多。
verses.e: If you say in your heart , " Why have these things come on me ? " Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity , and your heels suffer violence .

verses.z: 古實人豈能改變皮膚呢？豹豈能改變斑點呢？若能，你們這習慣行惡的便能行善了。
verses.e: Can the Ethiopian change his skin , or the leopard his spots ? Then may you also do good , who are accustomed to do evil .

verses.z: 所以我必用曠野的風吹散他們，像吹過的碎稭一樣。
verses.e: " Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness .

verses.z: 耶和華說：這是你所當得的，是我量給你的分；因為你忘記我，倚靠虛假。
verses.e: This is your lot , the portion measured to you from me , " says the LORD , " because you have forgotten me , and trusted in falsehood . "

verses.z: 所以我要揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你臉上，顯出你的醜陋。
verses.e: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face , and your shame will appear .

verses.z: 你那些可憎惡之事－就是在田野的山上行姦淫，發嘶聲，做淫亂的事－我都看見了。耶路撒冷啊，你有禍了！你不肯潔淨，還要到幾時呢？
verses.e: I have seen your abominations , even your adulteries and your neighing , the lewdness of your prostitution , on the hills in the field . Woe to you , Jerusalem ! You will not be made clean . How long will it yet be ? "

verses.z: 耶和華的話第二次臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me the second time , saying ,

verses.z: 「要拿着你所買的腰帶，就是你腰上的帶子，起來往幼發拉底河去，將腰帶藏在那裏的磐石穴中。」
verses.e: " Take the belt that you have bought , which is on your waist , and arise , go to the Euphrates , and hide it there in a cleft of the rock . "

verses.z: 我就去，照着耶和華所吩咐我的，將腰帶藏在幼發拉底河邊。
verses.e: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates , as the LORD commanded me .

verses.z: 過了多日，耶和華對我說：「你起來往幼發拉底河去，將我吩咐你藏在那裏的腰帶取出來。」
verses.e: After many days , the LORD said to me , " Arise , go to the Euphrates , and take the belt from there , which I commanded you to hide there . "

verses.z: 我就往幼發拉底河去，將腰帶從我所藏的地方刨出來，見腰帶已經變壞，毫無用了。
verses.e: Then I went to the Euphrates , and dug , and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it ; and behold , the belt was ruined . It was profitable for nothing .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: Then the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「耶和華如此說：我必照樣敗壞猶大的驕傲和耶路撒冷的大驕傲。
verses.e: " The LORD says , ' In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah , and the great pride of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 耶和華論到乾旱[之災]的話臨到耶利米：
verses.e: This is the LORD's word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought :

verses.z: 耶和華對這百姓如此說：這百姓喜愛妄行，不禁止腳步，所以耶和華不悅納他們。現今要記念他們的罪孽，追討他們的罪惡。
verses.e: The LORD says to this people : " Even so they have loved to wander . They have not restrained their feet . Therefore the LORD does not accept them . Now he will remember their iniquity , and punish them for their sins . "

verses.z: 耶和華又對我說：「不要為這百姓祈禱求好處。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Don't pray for this people for their good .

verses.z: 他們禁食的時候，我不聽他們的呼求；他們獻燔祭和素祭，我也不悅納；我卻要用刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫滅絕他們。」
verses.e: When they fast , I will not hear their cry ; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering , I will not accept them ; but I will consume them by the sword , by famine , and by pestilence . "

verses.z: 我就說：「唉！主耶和華啊，那些先知常對他們說：『你們必不看見刀劍，也不遭遇饑荒；耶和華要在這地方賜你們長久的平安。』」
verses.e: Then I said , " Ah , Lord GOD ! Behold , the prophets tell them , ' You will not see the sword , neither will you have famine ; but I will give you assured peace in this place . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「那些先知託我的名說假預言，我並沒有打發他們，沒有吩咐他們，也沒有對他們說話；他們向你們預言的，乃是虛假的異象和占卜，並虛無的事，以及本心的詭詐。
verses.e: Then the LORD said to me , " The prophets prophesy lies in my name . I didn't send them . I didn't command them . I didn't speak to them . They prophesy to you a lying vision , divination , and a thing of nothing , and the deceit of their own heart .

verses.z: 所以耶和華如此說：論到託我名說預言的那些先知，我並沒有打發他們；他們還說這地不能有刀劍饑荒，其實那些先知必被刀劍饑荒滅絕。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name , but I didn't send them , yet they say , ' Sword and famine will not be in this land . ' Those prophets will be consumed by sword and famine .

verses.z: 聽他們說預言的百姓必因饑荒刀劍拋在耶路撒冷的街道上，無人葬埋。他們連妻子帶兒女，都是如此。我必將他們的惡倒在他們身上。」
verses.e: The people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword . They will have no one to bury them — them , their wives , their sons , or their daughters , for I will pour their wickedness on them .

verses.z: 你要將這話對他們說：願我眼淚汪汪，晝夜不息，因為我百姓受了裂口破壞的大傷。
verses.e: " You shall say this word to them : " ' Let my eyes run down with tears night and day , and let them not cease ; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach , with a very grievous wound .

verses.z: 我若出往田間，就見有被刀殺的；我若進入城內，就見有因饑荒患病的；連先知帶祭司在國中往來，也是毫無知識。
verses.e: If I go out into the field , then behold , the slain with the sword ! If I enter into the city , then behold , those who are sick with famine ! For both the prophet and the priest go about in the land , and have no knowledge . ' "

verses.z: 你全然棄掉猶大嗎？你心厭惡錫安嗎？為何擊打我們，以致無法醫治呢？我們指望平安，卻得不着好處；指望痊癒，不料，受了驚惶。
verses.e: Have you utterly rejected Judah ? Has your soul loathed Zion ? Why have you struck us , and there is no healing for us ? We looked for peace , but no good came ; and for a time of healing , and behold , dismay !

verses.z: 猶大悲哀，城門衰敗。眾人披上黑衣坐在地上；耶路撒冷的哀聲上達。
verses.e: " Judah mourns , and its gates languish . They sit in black on the ground . The cry of Jerusalem goes up .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我們承認自己的罪惡，和我們列祖的罪孽，因我們得罪了你。
verses.e: We acknowledge , LORD , our wickedness , and the iniquity of our fathers ; for we have sinned against you .

verses.z: 求你為你名的緣故，不厭惡我們，不辱沒你榮耀的寶座。求你追念，不要背了與我們所立的約。
verses.e: Do not abhor us , for your name's sake . Do not disgrace the throne of your glory . Remember , and don't break your covenant with us .

verses.z: 外邦人虛無[的神]中有能降雨的嗎？天能自降甘霖嗎？耶和華－我們的上帝啊，能如此的不是你嗎？所以，我們仍要等候你，因為這一切都是你所造的。
verses.e: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain ? Or can the sky give showers ? Aren't you he , the LORD our God ? Therefore we will wait for you ; for you have made all these things .

verses.z: 他們的貴冑打發家僮打水；他們來到水池，見沒有水，就拿着空器皿，蒙羞慚愧，抱頭而回。
verses.e: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters . They come to the cisterns , and find no water . They return with their vessels empty . They are disappointed and confounded , and cover their heads .

verses.z: 耕地的也蒙羞抱頭；因為無雨降在地上，地都乾裂。
verses.e: Because of the ground which is cracked , because no rain has been in the land , the plowmen are disappointed . They cover their heads .

verses.z: 田野的母鹿生下小鹿，就撇棄，因為無草。
verses.e: Yes , the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young , because there is no grass .

verses.z: 野驢站在淨光的高處，喘氣好像野狗；因為無草，眼目失明。
verses.e: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights . They pant for air like jackals . Their eyes fail , because there is no vegetation .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我們的罪孽雖然作見證告我們，還求你為你名的緣故行事。我們本是多次背道，得罪了你。
verses.e: Though our iniquities testify against us , work for your name's sake , LORD ; for our rebellions are many . We have sinned against you .

verses.z: 以色列所盼望、在患難時作他救主的啊，你為何在這地像寄居的，又像行路的只住一宵呢？
verses.e: You hope of Israel , its Savior in the time of trouble , why should you be as a foreigner in the land , and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night ?

verses.z: 你為何像受驚的人，像不能救人的勇士呢？耶和華啊，你仍在我們中間；我們也稱為你名下的人，求你不要離開我們。
verses.e: Why should you be like a scared man , as a mighty man who can't save ? Yet you , LORD , are in the middle of us , and we are called by your name . Don't leave us .

verses.z: 耶和華對我說：「雖有摩西和撒母耳站在我面前[代求]，我的心也不顧惜這百姓。你將他們從我眼前趕出，叫他們去吧！
verses.e: Then the LORD said to me , " Though Moses and Samuel stood before me , yet my mind would not turn toward this people . Cast them out of my sight , and let them go out !

verses.z: 我的母親哪，我有禍了！因你生我作為遍地相爭相競的人。我素來沒有借貸與人，人也沒有借貸與我，人人[卻]都咒罵我。
verses.e: Woe is me , my mother , that you have borne me , a man of strife , and a man of contention to the whole earth ! I have not lent , neither have men lent to me ; yet every one of them curses me .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我必要堅固你，使你得好處。災禍苦難臨到的時候，我必要使仇敵央求你。（
verses.e: The LORD said , " Most certainly I will strengthen you for good . Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .

verses.z: 人豈能將銅與鐵，就是北方的鐵折斷呢？）
verses.e: Can one break iron , even iron from the north , and bronze ?

verses.z: 「我必因你在四境之內所犯的一切罪，把你的貨物財寶當掠物，白白地交給[仇敵]。
verses.e: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price , and that for all your sins , even in all your borders .

verses.z: 我也必使仇敵帶[這掠物]到你所不認識的地去，因我怒中起的火要將你們焚燒。」
verses.e: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don't know ; for a fire is kindled in my anger , which will burn on you . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是知道的；求你記念我，眷顧我，向逼迫我的人為我報仇；不要向他們忍怒取我[的命]，要知道我為你的緣故受了凌辱。
verses.e: LORD , you know . Remember me , visit me , and avenge me of my persecutors . You are patient , so don't take me away . Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach .

verses.z: 耶和華－萬軍之上帝啊，我得着你的言語就[當食物]吃了；你的言語是我心中的歡喜快樂，因我是稱為你名下的人。
verses.e: Your words were found , and I ate them . Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart , for I am called by your name , LORD , God of Armies .

verses.z: 我沒有坐在宴樂人的會中，也沒有歡樂；我因你的感動獨自靜坐，因你使我滿心憤恨。
verses.e: I didn't sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice . I sat alone because of your hand , for you have filled me with indignation .

verses.z: 我的痛苦為何長久不止呢？我的傷痕為何無法醫治、不能痊癒呢？難道你待我有詭詐，像流乾的河道嗎？
verses.e: Why is my pain perpetual , and my wound incurable , which refuses to be healed ? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook , like waters that fail ?

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你若歸回，我就將你再帶來，使你站在我面前；你若將寶貴的和下賤的分別出來，你就可以當作我的口。他們必歸向你，你卻不可歸向他們。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says , " If you return , then I will bring you again , that you may stand before me ; and if you take out the precious from the vile , you will be as my mouth . They will return to you , but you will not return to them .

verses.z: 他們問你說：『我們往哪裏去呢？』你便告訴他們，耶和華如此說：定為死亡的，必致死亡；定為刀殺的，必交刀殺；定為饑荒的，必遭饑荒；定為擄掠的，必被擄掠。」
verses.e: It will happen when they ask you , ' Where shall we go out ? ' then you shall tell them , ' The LORD says : " Such as are for death , to death ; such as are for the sword , to the sword ; such as are for the famine , to the famine ; and such as are for captivity , to captivity . " '

verses.z: 我必使你向這百姓成為堅固的銅牆；他們必攻擊你，卻不能勝你；因我與你同在，要拯救你，搭救你。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall . They will fight against you , but they will not prevail against you ; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我必搭救你脫離惡人的手，救贖你脫離強暴人的手。
verses.e: " I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked , and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我命定四樣害他們，就是刀劍殺戮、狗類撕裂、空中的飛鳥，和地上的野獸吞吃毀滅；
verses.e: " I will appoint over them four kinds , " says the LORD : " the sword to kill , the dogs to tear , the birds of the sky , and the animals of the earth , to devour and to destroy .

verses.z: 又必使他們在天下萬國中拋來拋去，都因猶大王希西家的兒子瑪拿西在耶路撒冷所行的事。」
verses.e: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth , because of Manasseh , the son of Hezekiah , king of Judah , for that which he did in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，誰可憐你呢？誰為你悲傷呢？誰轉身問你的安呢？
verses.e: For who will have pity on you , Jerusalem ? Who will mourn you ? Who will come to ask of your welfare ?

verses.z: 耶和華說：你棄絕了我，轉身退後；因此我伸手攻擊你，毀壞你。我後悔甚不耐煩。
verses.e: You have rejected me , " says the LORD . " You have gone backward . Therefore I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you . I am weary of showing compassion .

verses.z: 我在境內各城門口，用簸箕簸了我的百姓，使他們喪掉兒女。我毀滅他們，他們仍不轉離所行的道。
verses.e: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land . I have bereaved them of children . I have destroyed my people . They didn't return from their ways .

verses.z: 他們的寡婦在我面前比海沙更多；我使滅命的午間來，攻擊少年人的母親，使痛苦驚嚇忽然臨到她身上。
verses.e: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas . I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday . I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly .

verses.z: 生過七子的婦人力衰氣絕；尚在白晝，日頭忽落；她抱愧蒙羞。其餘的人，我必在他們敵人跟前，交與刀劍。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: She who has borne seven languishes . She has given up the spirit . Her sun has gone down while it was yet day . She has been disappointed and confounded . I will deliver their residue to the sword before their enemies , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Then the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「你將這一切的話指示這百姓。他們問你說：『耶和華為甚麼說，要降這大災禍攻擊我們呢？我們有甚麼罪孽呢？我們向耶和華－我們的上帝犯了甚麼罪呢？』
verses.e: It will happen , when you tell this people all these words , and they ask you , ' Why has the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us ? ' or ' What is our iniquity ? ' or ' What is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God ? '

verses.z: 你就對他們說：『耶和華說：因為你們列祖離棄我，隨從別神，事奉敬拜，不遵守我的律法，
verses.e: then you shall tell them , ' Because your fathers have forsaken me , ' says the LORD , ' and have walked after other gods , have served them , have worshiped them , have forsaken me , and have not kept my law .

verses.z: 而且你們行惡比你們列祖更甚；因為各人隨從自己頑梗的惡心行事，甚至不聽從我，
verses.e: You have done evil more than your fathers , for behold , you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart , so that you don't listen to me .

verses.z: 所以我必將你們從這地趕出，直趕到你們和你們列祖素不認識的地。你們在那裏必晝夜事奉別神，因為我必不向你們施恩。』」
verses.e: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known , neither you nor your fathers . There you will serve other gods day and night , for I will show you no favor . '

verses.z: 耶和華說：「日子將到，人必不再指着那領以色列人從埃及地上來之永生的耶和華起誓，
verses.e: " Therefore behold , the days come , " says the LORD , " that it will no more be said , ' As the LORD lives , who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt ; '

verses.z: 卻要指着那領以色列人從北方之地，並趕他們到的各國上來之永生的耶和華起誓，並且我要領他們再入我從前賜給他們列祖之地。」
verses.e: but , ' As the LORD lives , who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north , and from all the countries where he had driven them . ' I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我要召許多打魚的把以色列人打上來，然後我要召許多打獵的，從各山上、各岡上、各石穴中獵取他們。
verses.e: " Behold , I will send for many fishermen , " says the LORD , " and they will fish them up . Afterward I will send for many hunters , and they will hunt them from every mountain , from every hill , and out of the clefts of the rocks .

verses.z: 因我的眼目察看他們的一切行為；他們不能在我面前遮掩，他們的罪孽也不能在我眼前隱藏。
verses.e: For my eyes are on all their ways . They are not hidden from my face . Their iniquity isn't concealed from my eyes .

verses.z: 我先要加倍報應他們的罪孽和罪惡；因為他們用可憎之屍玷污我的地土，又用可厭之物充滿我的產業。」
verses.e: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double , because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things , and have filled my inheritance with their abominations . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是我的力量，是我的保障；在苦難之日是我的避難所。列國人必從地極來到你這裏，說：我們列祖所承受的，不過是虛假，是虛空無益之物。
verses.e: LORD , my strength , my stronghold , and my refuge in the day of affliction , the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth , and will say , " Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies , vanity and things in which there is no profit .

verses.z: 「你在這地方不可娶妻，生兒養女。
verses.e: " You shall not take a wife , neither shall you have sons or daughters , in this place . "

verses.z: 人豈可為自己製造神呢？其實這不是神。
verses.e: Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods ? "

verses.z: [耶和華]說：「我要使他們知道，就是這一次使他們知道我的手和我的能力。他們就知道我的名是耶和華了。」
verses.e: " Therefore behold , I will cause them to know , this once I will cause them to know my hand and my might . Then they will know that my name is the LORD . "

verses.z: 因為論到在這地方所生的兒女，又論到在這國中生養他們的父母，耶和華如此說：
verses.e: For the LORD says concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place , and concerning their mothers who bore them , and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land :

verses.z: 他們必死得甚苦，無人哀哭，必不得葬埋，必在地上像糞土，必被刀劍和饑荒滅絕；他們的屍首必給空中的飛鳥和地上的野獸作食物。」
verses.e: " They will die grievous deaths . They will not be lamented , neither will they be buried . They will be as dung on the surface of the ground . They will be consumed by the sword and by famine . Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「不要進入喪家，不要去哀哭，也不要為他們悲傷，因我已將我的平安、慈愛、憐憫從這百姓奪去了。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: For the LORD says , " Don't enter into the house of mourning . Don't go to lament . Don't bemoan them , for I have taken away my peace from this people , " says the LORD , " even loving kindness and tender mercies .

verses.z: 連大帶小，都必在這地死亡，不得葬埋。人必不為他們哀哭，不用刀劃身，也不使頭光禿。
verses.e: Both great and small will die in this land . They will not be buried . Men won't lament for them , cut themselves , or make themselves bald for them .

verses.z: 他們有喪事，人必不為他們擘[餅]，因死人安慰他們；他們喪父喪母，人也不給他們一杯酒安慰他們。
verses.e: Men won't break bread for them in mourning , to comfort them for the dead . Men won't give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother .

verses.z: 你不可進入宴樂的家，與他們同坐吃喝。
verses.e: " You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them , to eat and to drink . "

verses.z: 因為萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：你們還活着的日子在你們眼前，我必使歡喜和快樂的聲音，新郎和新婦的聲音，從這地方止息了。
verses.e: For the LORD of Armies , the God of Israel says : " Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place , before your eyes and in your days , the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride .

verses.z: 猶大的罪是用鐵筆、用金鋼鑽記錄的，銘刻在他們的心版上和壇角上。
verses.e: " The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron , and with the point of a diamond . It is engraved on the tablet of their heart , and on the horns of your altars .

verses.z: 我－耶和華是鑒察人心、試驗人肺腑的，要照各人所行的和他做事的結果報應他。
verses.e: " I , the LORD , search the mind . I try the heart , even to give every man according to his ways , according to the fruit of his doings . "

verses.z: 那不按正道得財的，好像鷓鴣菢不是自己下的[蛋]；到了中年，那財都必離開他，他終久成為愚頑人。
verses.e: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid , so is he who gets riches , and not by right . In the middle of his days , they will leave him . At his end , he will be a fool .

verses.z: 我們的聖所是榮耀的寶座，從太初[安置]在高處。
verses.e: A glorious throne , set on high from the beginning , is the place of our sanctuary .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的盼望啊，凡離棄你的必致蒙羞。[耶和華說]：離開我的，他們的[名字]必寫在土裏，因為他們離棄我這活水的泉源。
verses.e: LORD , the hope of Israel , all who forsake you will be disappointed . Those who depart from me will be written in the earth , because they have forsaken the LORD , the spring of living waters .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你醫治我，我便痊癒，拯救我，我便得救；因你是我所讚美的。
verses.e: Heal me , O LORD , and I will be healed . Save me , and I will be saved ; for you are my praise .

verses.z: 他們對我說：耶和華的話在哪裏呢？叫這話應驗吧！
verses.e: Behold , they ask me , " Where is the LORD's word ? Let it be fulfilled now . "

verses.z: 至於我，那跟從你作牧人[的職分]，我並沒有急忙離棄，也沒有想那災殃的日子；這是你知道的。我口中所出的言語都在你面前。
verses.e: As for me , I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you . I haven't desired the woeful day . You know . That which came out of my lips was before your face .

verses.z: 不要使我因你驚恐；當災禍的日子，你是我的避難所。
verses.e: Don't be a terror to me . You are my refuge in the day of evil .

verses.z: 願那些逼迫我的蒙羞，卻不要使我蒙羞；使他們驚惶，卻不要使我驚惶；使災禍的日子臨到他們，以加倍的毀壞毀壞他們。
verses.e: Let them be disappointed who persecute me , but don't let me be disappointed . Let them be dismayed , but don't let me be dismayed . Bring on them the day of evil , and destroy them with double destruction .

verses.z: 耶和華對我如此說：「你去站在平民的門口，就是猶大君王出入的門，又站在耶路撒冷的各門口，
verses.e: The LORD said this to me : " Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people , through which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out , and in all the gates of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他們的兒女記念他們高岡上、青翠樹旁的壇和木偶。
verses.e: Even their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by the green trees on the high hills .

verses.z: 對他們說：『你們這猶大君王和猶大眾人，並耶路撒冷的一切居民，凡從這些門進入的都當聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: Tell them , ' Hear the LORD's word , you kings of Judah , all Judah , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , that enter in by these gates :

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你們要謹慎，不要在安息日擔甚麼擔子進入耶路撒冷的各門；
verses.e: The LORD says , " Be careful , and bear no burden on the Sabbath day , nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 也不要在安息日從家中擔出擔子去。無論何工都不可做，只要以安息日為聖日，正如我所吩咐你們列祖的。』
verses.e: Don't carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day . Don't do any work , but make the Sabbath day holy , as I commanded your fathers .

verses.z: 他們卻不聽從，不側耳而聽，竟硬着頸項不聽，不受教訓。」
verses.e: But they didn't listen . They didn't turn their ear , but made their neck stiff , that they might not hear , and might not receive instruction .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「你們若留意聽從我，在安息日不擔甚麼擔子進入這城的各門，只以安息日為聖日，在那日無論何工都不做；
verses.e: It will happen , if you diligently listen to me , " says the LORD , " to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day , but to make the Sabbath day holy , to do no work therein ;

verses.z: 那時就有坐大衛寶座的君王和首領，他們與猶大人，並耶路撒冷的居民，或坐車，或騎馬，進入這城的各門，而且這城必存到永遠。
verses.e: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David's throne , riding in chariots and on horses , they and their princes , the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem ; and this city will remain forever .

verses.z: 也必有人從猶大城邑和耶路撒冷四圍的各處，從便雅憫地、高原、山地，並南地而來，都帶燔祭、[平安祭]、素祭，和乳香，並感謝[祭]，到耶和華的殿去。
verses.e: They will come from the cities of Judah , and from the places around Jerusalem , from the land of Benjamin , from the lowland , from the hill country , and from the South , bringing burnt offerings , sacrifices , meal offerings , and frankincense , and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to the LORD's house .

verses.z: 你們若不聽從我，不以安息日為聖日，仍在安息日擔擔子，進入耶路撒冷的各門，我必在各門中點火；這火也必燒毀耶路撒冷的宮殿，不能熄滅。」
verses.e: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy , and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day , then I will kindle a fire in its gates , and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem . It will not be quenched . " ' "

verses.z: 我田野的山哪，我必因你在四境之內所犯的罪，把你的貨物、財寶，並邱壇當掠物交給[仇敵]；
verses.e: My mountain in the field , I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder , and your high places , because of sin , throughout all your borders .

verses.z: 並且你因自己[的罪]必失去我所賜給你的產業。我也必使你在你所不認識的地上服事你的仇敵；因為你使我怒中起火，直燒到永遠。
verses.e: You , even of yourself , will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you . I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don't know , for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：倚靠人血肉的膀臂，心中離棄耶和華的，那人有禍了！
verses.e: The LORD says : " Cursed is the man who trusts in man , relies on strength of flesh , and whose heart departs from the LORD .

verses.z: 因他必像沙漠的杜松，不見福樂來到，卻要住曠野乾旱之處，無人居住的鹼地。
verses.e: For he will be like a bush in the desert , and will not see when good comes , but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness , an uninhabited salt land .

verses.z: 倚靠耶和華、以耶和華為可靠的，那人有福了！
verses.e: " Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD , and whose confidence is in the LORD .

verses.z: 他必像樹栽於水旁，在河邊扎根，炎熱來到，並不懼怕，葉子仍必青翠，在乾旱之年毫無掛慮，而且結果不止。
verses.e: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters , who spreads out its roots by the river , and will not fear when heat comes , but its leaf will be green , and will not be concerned in the year of drought . It won't cease from yielding fruit .

verses.z: 人心比萬物都詭詐，壞到極處，誰能識透呢？
verses.e: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt . Who can know it ?

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到耶利米說：
verses.e: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying ,

verses.z: 他們若行我眼中看為惡的事，不聽從我的話，我就必後悔，不將我所說的福氣賜給他們。
verses.e: if they do that which is evil in my sight , that they don't obey my voice , then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them .

verses.z: 現在你要對猶大人和耶路撒冷的居民說：『耶和華如此說：我造出災禍攻擊你們，定意刑罰你們。你們各人當回頭離開所行的惡道，改正你們的行動作為。』
verses.e: " Now therefore , speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying , ' The LORD says : " Behold , I frame evil against you , and devise a plan against you . Everyone return from his evil way now , and amend your ways and your doings . " '

verses.z: 「他們卻說：『這是枉然。我們要照自己的計謀去行。』各人隨自己頑梗的惡心做事。」
verses.e: But they say , ' It is in vain ; for we will walk after our own plans , and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart . ' "

verses.z: 所以，耶和華如此說：你們且往各國訪問，有誰聽見這樣的事？以色列民行了一件極可憎惡的事。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says : " Ask now among the nations , ' Who has heard such things ? ' The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing .

verses.z: 黎巴嫩的雪從田野的磐石上豈能斷絕呢？從遠處流下的涼水豈能乾涸呢？
verses.e: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field ? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up ?

verses.z: 我的百姓竟忘記我，向假[神]燒香，使他們在所行的路上，在古道上絆跌，使他們行沒有修築的斜路，
verses.e: For my people have forgotten me . They have burned incense to false gods . They have been made to stumble in their ways in the ancient paths , to walk in byways , in a way not built up ,

verses.z: 以致他們的地令人驚駭，常常嗤笑；凡經過這地的必驚駭搖頭。
verses.e: to make their land an astonishment , and a perpetual hissing . Everyone who passes by it will be astonished , and shake his head .

verses.z: 我必在仇敵面前分散他們，好像用東風吹散一樣。遭難的日子，我必以背向他們，不以面向他們。
verses.e: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy . I will show them the back , and not the face , in the day of their calamity .

verses.z: 他們就說：「來吧！我們可以設計謀害耶利米；因為我們有祭司講律法，智慧人設謀略，先知說預言，都不能斷絕。來吧！我們可以用舌頭擊打他，不要理會他的一切話。」
verses.e: Then they said , " Come ! Let's devise plans against Jeremiah ; for the law won't perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let's strike him with the tongue , and let's not give heed to any of his words . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你理會我，且聽那些與我爭競之人的話。
verses.e: Give heed to me , LORD , and listen to the voice of those who contend with me .

verses.z: 「你起來，下到窯匠的家裏去，我在那裏要使你聽我的話。」
verses.e: " Arise , and go down to the potter's house , and there I will cause you to hear my words . "

verses.z: 豈可以惡報善呢？他們竟挖坑要害我的性命！求你記念我怎樣站在你面前為他們代求，要使你的忿怒向他們轉消。
verses.e: Should evil be recompensed for good ? For they have dug a pit for my soul . Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them , to turn away your wrath from them .

verses.z: 故此，願你將他們的兒女交與饑荒和刀劍；願他們的妻無子，且作寡婦；又願他們的男人被死亡所滅，他們的少年人在陣上被刀擊殺。
verses.e: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine , and give them over to the power of the sword . Let their wives become childless and widows . Let their men be killed and their young men struck by the sword in battle .

verses.z: 你使敵軍忽然臨到他們的時候，願人聽見哀聲從他們的屋內發出；因他們挖坑要捉拿我，暗設網羅要絆我的腳。
verses.e: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them ; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，他們要殺我的那一切計謀，你都知道。不要赦免他們的罪孽，也不要從你面前塗抹他們的罪惡，要叫他們在你面前跌倒；願你發怒的時候罰辦他們。
verses.e: Yet , LORD , you know all their counsel against me to kill me . Don't forgive their iniquity . Don't blot out their sin from your sight , Let them be overthrown before you . Deal with them in the time of your anger .

verses.z: 我就下到窯匠的家裏去，正遇他轉輪做器皿。
verses.e: Then I went down to the potter's house , and behold , he was making something on the wheels .

verses.z: 窯匠用泥做的器皿，在他手中做壞了，他又用這泥另做別的器皿；窯匠看怎樣好，就怎樣做。
verses.e: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter , he made it again another vessel , as seemed good to the potter to make it .

verses.z: 耶和華的話就臨到我說：
verses.e: Then the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「耶和華說：以色列家啊，我待你們，豈不能照這窯匠弄泥嗎？以色列家啊，泥在窯匠的手中怎樣，你們在我的手中也怎樣。
verses.e: " House of Israel , can't I do with you as this potter ? " says the LORD . " Behold , as the clay in the potter's hand , so are you in my hand , house of Israel .

verses.z: 我何時論到一邦或一國說，要拔出、拆毀、毀壞；
verses.e: At the instant I speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it ,

verses.z: 我所說的那一邦，若是轉意離開他們的惡，我就必後悔，不將我想要施行的災禍降與他們。
verses.e: if that nation , concerning which I have spoken , turns from their evil , I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them .

verses.z: 我何時論到一邦或一國說，要建立、栽植；
verses.e: At the instant I speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to build and to plant it ,

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「你去買窯匠的瓦瓶，又帶百姓中的長老和祭司中的長老，
verses.e: Thus said the LORD , " Go , and buy a potter's earthen container , and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests ;

verses.z: 「你要在同去的人眼前打碎那瓶，
verses.e: " Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you ,

verses.z: 對他們說：『萬軍之耶和華如此說：我要照樣打碎這民和這城，正如人打碎窯匠的瓦器，以致不能再囫圇。並且人要在陀斐特葬埋[屍首]，甚至無處可葬。
verses.e: and shall tell them , ' The LORD of Armies says : " Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter's vessel , that can't be made whole again . They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我必向這地方和其中的居民如此行，使這城與陀斐特一樣。
verses.e: This is what I will do to this place , " says the LORD , " and to its inhabitants , even making this city as Topheth .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的房屋和猶大君王的宮殿是已經被玷污的，就是他們在其上向天上的萬象燒香、向別神澆奠祭的宮殿房屋，都必與陀斐特一樣。』」
verses.e: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah , which are defiled , will be as the place of Topheth , even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods . " ' "

verses.z: 耶利米從陀斐特－就是耶和華差他去說預言的地方－回來，站在耶和華殿的院中，對眾人說：
verses.e: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth , where the LORD had sent him to prophesy , and he stood in the court of the LORD's house , and said to all the people :

verses.z: 「萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：我必使我所說的一切災禍臨到這城和屬城的一切城邑，因為他們硬着頸項不聽我的話。」
verses.e: " The LORD of Armies , the God of Israel says , ' Behold , I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it , because they have made their neck stiff , that they may not hear my words . ' "

verses.z: 出去到欣嫩子谷、哈珥西的門口那裏，宣告我所吩咐你的話，
verses.e: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom , which is by the entry of the gate Harsith , and proclaim there the words that I will tell you .

verses.z: 說：『猶大君王和耶路撒冷的居民哪，當聽耶和華的話。萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：我必使災禍臨到這地方，凡聽見的人都必耳鳴；
verses.e: Say , ' Hear the LORD's word , kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : The LORD of Armies , the God of Israel says , " Behold , I will bring evil on this place , which whoever hears , his ears will tingle .

verses.z: 因為他們和他們列祖，並猶大君王離棄我，將這地方看為平常，在這裏向素不認識的別神燒香，又使這地方滿了無辜人的血，
verses.e: Because they have forsaken me , and have defiled this place , and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn't know — they , their fathers , and the kings of Judah — and have filled this place with the blood of innocents ,

verses.z: 又建築巴力的邱壇，好在火中焚燒自己的兒子，作為燔祭獻給巴力。這不是我所吩咐的，不是我所提說的，也不是我心所起的意。
verses.e: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal , which I didn't command , nor speak , which didn't even enter into my mind .

verses.z: 耶和華說：因此，日子將到，這地方不再稱為陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒稱為殺戮谷。
verses.e: Therefore , behold , the days come , " says the LORD , " that this place will no more be called ' Topheth ' , nor ' The Valley of the son of Hinnom ' , but ' The valley of Slaughter ' .

verses.z: 我必在這地方使猶大和耶路撒冷的計謀落空，也必使他們在仇敵面前倒於刀下，並尋索其命的人手下。他們的屍首，我必給空中的飛鳥和地上的野獸作食物。
verses.e: " ' " I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place . I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies , and by the hand of those who seek their life . I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth .

verses.z: 我必使這城令人驚駭嗤笑；凡經過的人，必因這城所遭的災驚駭嗤笑。
verses.e: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing . Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues .

verses.z: 我必使他們在圍困窘迫之中，就是仇敵和尋索其命的人窘迫他們的時候，各人吃自己兒女的肉和朋友的肉。』
verses.e: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters . They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies , and those who seek their life , will distress them . " '

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 你們且過到基提海島去察看，打發人往基達去留心查考，看曾有這樣的事沒有。
verses.e: For pass over to the islands of Kittim , and see . Send to Kedar , and consider diligently , and see if there has been such a thing .

verses.z: 豈有一國換了[他的]神嗎？其實這不是神！但我的百姓將他們的榮耀換了那無益的[神]。
verses.e: Has a nation changed its gods , which really are no gods ? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn't profit .

verses.z: 諸天哪，要因此驚奇，極其恐慌，甚為淒涼！這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Be astonished , you heavens , at this and be horribly afraid . Be very desolate , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 因為我的百姓做了兩件惡事，就是離棄我這活水的泉源，為自己鑿出池子，是破裂不能存水的池子。
verses.e: " For my people have committed two evils : they have forsaken me , the spring of living waters , and cut out cisterns for themselves : broken cisterns that can't hold water .

verses.z: 以色列是僕人嗎？是家中生的[奴僕]嗎？為何成為掠物呢？
verses.e: Is Israel a slave ? Is he born into slavery ? Why has he become a captive ?

verses.z: 少壯獅子向他咆哮，大聲吼叫，使他的地荒涼；城邑也都焚燒，無人居住。
verses.e: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices . They have made his land waste . His cities are burned up , without inhabitant .

verses.z: 挪弗人和答比匿人也打破你的頭頂。
verses.e: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head .

verses.z: 這事臨到你身上，不是你自招的嗎？不是因耶和華－你上帝引你行路的時候，你離棄他嗎？
verses.e: " Haven't you brought this on yourself , in that you have forsaken the LORD your God , when he led you by the way ?

verses.z: 現今你為何在埃及路上要喝西曷的水呢？你為何在亞述路上要喝大河的水呢？
verses.e: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt , to drink the waters of the Shihor ? Or why do you go on the way to Assyria , to drink the waters of the River ?

verses.z: 你自己的惡必懲治你；你背道的事必責備你。由此可知可見，你離棄耶和華－你的上帝，不存敬畏我的心，乃為惡事，為苦事。這是主－萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Your own wickedness will correct you , and your backsliding will rebuke you . Know therefore and see that it is an evil and bitter thing , that you have forsaken the LORD your God , and that my fear is not in you , " says the Lord , GOD of Armies .

verses.z: 「你去向耶路撒冷人的耳中喊叫說，耶和華如此說：你幼年的恩愛，婚姻的愛情，你怎樣在曠野，在未曾耕種之地跟隨我，我都記得。
verses.e: " Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem , saying , ' The LORD says , " I remember for you the kindness of your youth , your love as a bride , how you went after me in the wilderness , in a land that was not sown .

verses.z: 我在古時折斷你的軛，解開你的繩索。你說：我必不事奉[耶和華]；因為你在各高岡上、各青翠樹下屈身行淫。
verses.e: " For long ago I broke off your yoke , and burst your bonds . You said , ' I will not serve ; ' for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself , playing the prostitute .

verses.z: 然而，我栽你是上等的葡萄樹，全然是真種子；你怎麼向我變為外邦葡萄樹的壞枝子呢？
verses.e: Yet I had planted you a noble vine , a pure and faithful seed . How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me ?

verses.z: 你雖用鹼、多用肥皂洗濯，你罪孽的痕跡仍然在我面前顯出。這是主耶和華說的。
verses.e: For though you wash yourself with lye , and use much soap , yet your iniquity is marked before me , " says the Lord GOD .

verses.z: 你怎能說：我沒有玷污、沒有隨從眾巴力？你看你谷中的路，就知道你所行的如何。你是快行的獨峰駝，狂奔亂走。
verses.e: " How can you say , ' I am not defiled . I have not gone after the Baals ' ? See your way in the valley . Know what you have done . You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways ,

verses.z: 你是野驢，慣在曠野，慾心發動就吸風；起性的時候誰能使牠轉去呢？凡尋找牠的必不致疲乏；在牠的月份必能尋見。
verses.e: a wild donkey used to the wilderness , that sniffs the wind in her craving . When she is in heat , who can turn her away ? All those who seek her will not weary themselves . In her month , they will find her .

verses.z: 我[說]：你不要使腳上無鞋，喉嚨乾渴。你倒說：這是枉然。我喜愛別[神]，我必隨從他們。
verses.e: " Keep your feet from being bare , and your throat from thirst . But you said , ' It is in vain . No , for I have loved strangers , and I will go after them . '

verses.z: 賊被捉拿，怎樣羞愧，以色列家和他們的君王、首領、祭司、先知也都照樣羞愧。
verses.e: As the thief is ashamed when he is found , so the house of Israel is ashamed — they , their kings , their princes , their priests , and their prophets ,

verses.z: 他們向木頭說：你是我的父；向石頭說：你是生我的。他們以背向我，不以面向我；及至遭遇患難的時候卻說：起來拯救我們。
verses.e: who tell wood , ' You are my father , ' and a stone , ' You have given birth to me , ' for they have turned their back to me , and not their face , but in the time of their trouble they will say , ' Arise , and save us ! '

verses.z: 你為自己做的神在哪裏呢？你遭遇患難的時候，叫他們起來拯救你吧！猶大啊，你神的數目與你城的數目相等。
verses.e: " But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves ? Let them arise , if they can save you in the time of your trouble , for you have as many gods as you have towns , O Judah .

verses.z: 耶和華說：你們為何與我爭辯呢？你們都違背了我。
verses.e: " Why will you contend with me ? You all have transgressed against me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 那時以色列歸耶和華為聖，作為土產初熟的果子；凡吞吃它的必算為有罪，災禍必臨到他們。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Israel was holiness to the LORD , the first fruits of his increase . All who devour him will be held guilty . Evil will come on them , " ' says the LORD . "

verses.z: 我責打你們的兒女是徒然的，他們不受懲治。你們自己的刀吞滅你們的先知，好像殘害的獅子。
verses.e: " I have struck your children in vain . They received no correction . Your own sword has devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .

verses.z: 這世代的人哪，你們要看明耶和華的話。我豈向以色列作曠野呢？或作幽暗之地呢？我的百姓為何說：我們脫離約束，再不歸向你了？
verses.e: Generation , consider the LORD's word . Have I been a wilderness to Israel ? Or a land of thick darkness ? Why do my people say , ' We have broken loose . We will come to you no more ' ?

verses.z: 處女豈能忘記她的妝飾呢？新婦豈能忘記她的美衣呢？我的百姓卻忘記了我無數的日子！
verses.e: " Can a virgin forget her ornaments , or a bride her attire ? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number .

verses.z: 你怎麼修飾你的道路要求愛情呢？就是惡劣的婦人你也叫她們行你的路。
verses.e: How well you prepare your way to seek love ! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways .

verses.z: 並且你的衣襟上有無辜窮人的血；[你殺他們]並不是遇見他們挖窟窿，乃是因這一切的事。
verses.e: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts . You didn't find them breaking in , but it is because of all these things .

verses.z: 你還說：我無辜；耶和華的怒氣必定向我消了。看哪，我必審問你；因你自說：我沒有犯罪。
verses.e: " Yet you said , ' I am innocent . Surely his anger has turned away from me . ' " Behold , I will judge you , because you say , ' I have not sinned . '

verses.z: 你為何東跑西奔要更換你的路呢？你必因埃及蒙羞，像從前因亞述蒙羞一樣。
verses.e: Why do you go about so much to change your ways ? You will be ashamed of Egypt also , as you were ashamed of Assyria .

verses.z: 你也必兩手抱頭從埃及出來；因為耶和華已經棄絕你所倚靠的，你必不因他們得順利。
verses.e: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head ; for the LORD has rejected those in whom you trust , and you won't prosper with them .

verses.z: 雅各家、以色列家的各族啊，你們當聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: Hear the LORD's word , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel !

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你們的列祖見我有甚麼不義，竟遠離我，隨從虛無的神，自己成為虛妄的呢？
verses.e: The LORD says , " What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me , that they have gone far from me , and have walked after worthless vanity , and have become worthless ?

verses.z: 他們也不說：那領我們從埃及地上來，引導我們經過曠野，沙漠有深坑之地，和乾旱死蔭、無人經過、無人居住之地的耶和華在哪裏呢？
verses.e: They didn't say , ' Where is the LORD who brought us up out of the land of Egypt , who led us through the wilderness , through a land of deserts and of pits , through a land of drought and of the shadow of death , through a land that no one passed through , and where no man lived ? '

verses.z: 我領你們進入肥美之地，使你們得吃其中的果子和美物；但你們進入的時候就玷污我的地，使我的產業成為可憎的。
verses.e: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness ; but when you entered , you defiled my land , and made my heritage an abomination .

verses.z: 祭司都不說，耶和華在哪裏呢？傳講律法的都不認識我。官長違背我；先知藉巴力說預言，隨從無益的[神]。
verses.e: The priests didn't say , ' Where is the LORD ? ' and those who handle the law didn't know me . The rulers also transgressed against me , and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我因此必與你們爭辯，也必與你們的子孫爭辯。
verses.e: " Therefore I will yet contend with you , " says the LORD , " and I will contend with your children's children .

verses.z: 祭司音麥的兒子巴施戶珥作耶和華殿的總管，聽見耶利米預言這些事，
verses.e: Now Pashhur , the son of Immer the priest , who was chief officer in the LORD's house , heard Jeremiah prophesying these things .

verses.z: 我聽見了許多人的讒謗，四圍都是驚嚇；就是我知己的朋友也都窺探我，願我跌倒，[說]：告他吧，我們也要告他！或者他被引誘，我們就能勝他，在他身上報仇。
verses.e: For I have heard the defaming of many : " Terror on every side ! Denounce , and we will denounce him ! " say all my familiar friends , those who watch for my fall . " Perhaps he will be persuaded , and we will prevail against him , and we will take our revenge on him . "

verses.z: 然而，耶和華與我同在，好像甚可怕的勇士。因此，逼迫我的必都絆跌，不能得勝；他們必大大蒙羞，就是受永不忘記的羞辱，因為他們行事沒有智慧。
verses.e: But the LORD is with me as an awesome mighty one . Therefore my persecutors will stumble , and they won't prevail . They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely , even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten .

verses.z: 試驗義人、察看人肺腑心腸的萬軍之耶和華啊，求你容我見你在他們身上報仇，因我將我的案件向你稟明了。
verses.e: But the LORD of Armies , who tests the righteous , who sees the heart and the mind , let me see your vengeance on them , for I have revealed my cause to you .

verses.z: 你們要向耶和華唱歌；讚美耶和華！因他救了窮人的性命脫離惡人的手。
verses.e: Sing to the LORD ! Praise the LORD , for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers .

verses.z: 願我生的那日受咒詛；願我母親產我的那日不蒙福！
verses.e: Cursed is the day in which I was born . Don't let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed .

verses.z: 給我父親報信說「你得了兒子」，使我父親甚歡喜的，願那人受咒詛。
verses.e: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father , saying , " A boy is born to you , " making him very glad .

verses.z: 願那人像耶和華所傾覆而不後悔的城邑；願他早晨聽見哀聲，晌午聽見吶喊；
verses.e: Let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew , and didn't repent . Let him hear a cry in the morning , and shouting at noontime ,

verses.z: 因他在我未出胎的時候不殺我，使我母親成了我的墳墓，胎就時常重大。
verses.e: because he didn't kill me from the womb . So my mother would have been my grave , and her womb always great .

verses.z: 我為何出胎見勞碌愁苦，使我的年日因羞愧消滅呢？
verses.e: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow , that my days should be consumed with shame ?

verses.z: 他就打先知耶利米，用耶和華殿裏便雅憫高門內的枷，將他枷在那裏。
verses.e: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin , which was in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 次日，巴施戶珥將耶利米開枷釋放。於是耶利米對他說：「耶和華不是叫你的名為巴施戶珥，乃是叫你瑪歌珥‧米撒畢，
verses.e: On the next day , Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks . Then Jeremiah said to him , " The LORD has not called your name Pashhur , but Magormissabib .

verses.z: 因耶和華如此說：『我必使你自覺驚嚇，你也必使眾朋友驚嚇；他們必倒在仇敵的刀下，你也必親眼看見；我必將猶大人全交在巴比倫王的手中，他要將他們擄到巴比倫去，也要用刀將他們殺戮。
verses.e: For the LORD says , ' Behold , I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends . They will fall by the sword of their enemies , and your eyes will see it . I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he will carry them captive to Babylon , and will kill them with the sword .

verses.z: 並且我要將這城中的一切貨財和勞碌得來的，並一切珍寶，以及猶大君王所有的寶物，都交在他們仇敵的手中；仇敵要當作掠物帶到巴比倫去。
verses.e: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city , and all its gains , and all its precious things , yes , I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies . They will make them captives , take them , and carry them to Babylon .

verses.z: 你這巴施戶珥和一切住在你家中的人都必被擄去；你和你的眾朋友，就是你向他們說假預言的，都必到巴比倫去，要死在那裏，葬在那裏。』」
verses.e: You , Pashhur , and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity . You will come to Babylon , and there you will die , and there you will be buried , you , and all your friends , to whom you have prophesied falsely . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你曾勸導我，我也聽了你的勸導。你比我有力量，且勝了我。我終日成為笑話，人人都戲弄我。
verses.e: LORD , you have persuaded me , and I was persuaded . You are stronger than I , and have prevailed . I have become a laughingstock all day . Everyone mocks me .

verses.z: 我每逢講論的時候，就發出哀聲，我喊叫說：有強暴和毀滅！因為耶和華的話終日成了我的凌辱、譏刺。
verses.e: For as often as I speak , I cry out ; I cry , " Violence and destruction ! " because the LORD's word has been made a reproach to me , and a derision , all day .

verses.z: 我若說：我不再提耶和華，也不再奉他的名講論，我便心裏覺得似乎有燒着的火閉塞在我骨中，我就含忍不住，不能自禁。
verses.e: If I say that I will not make mention of him , or speak any more in his name , then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones . I am weary with holding it in . I can't .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到耶利米。那時，西底家王打發瑪基雅的兒子巴施戶珥和瑪西雅的兒子祭司西番雅去見耶利米，說：
verses.e: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD , when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah , and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah , the priest , saying ,

verses.z: 耶和華說：我向這城變臉，降禍不降福；這城必交在巴比倫王的手中，他必用火焚燒。』」
verses.e: For I have set my face on this city for evil , and not for good , " says the LORD . " It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he will burn it with fire . " '

verses.z: 「至於猶大王的家，你們當聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: " Concerning the house of the king of Judah , hear the LORD's word :

verses.z: 大衛家啊，耶和華如此說：你們每早晨要施行公平，拯救被搶奪的脫離欺壓人的手，恐怕我的忿怒因你們的惡行發作，如火着起，甚至無人能以熄滅。
verses.e: House of David , the LORD says , ' Execute justice in the morning , and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor , lest my wrath go out like fire , and burn so that no one can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .

verses.z: 耶和華說：住山谷和平原磐石上的居民，你們說：誰能下來攻擊我們？誰能進入我們的住處呢？看哪，我與你們為敵。
verses.e: Behold , I am against you , O inhabitant of the valley , and of the rock of the plain , ' says the LORD . ' You that say , " Who would come down against us ? " or , " Who would enter into our homes ? "

verses.z: 耶和華又說：我必按你們做事的結果刑罰你們；我也必使火在耶路撒冷的林中着起，將她四圍所有的盡行燒滅。」
verses.e: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , ' says the LORD ; ' and I will kindle a fire in her forest , and it will devour all that is around her . ' "

verses.z: 「請你為我們求問耶和華；因為巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來攻擊我們，或者耶和華照他一切奇妙的作為待我們，使巴比倫王離開我們上去。」
verses.e: " Please inquire of the LORD for us ; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us . Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works , that he may withdraw from us . "

verses.z: 耶利米對他們說：「你們當對西底家這樣說：
verses.e: Then Jeremiah said to them , " Tell Zedekiah :

verses.z: 『耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：我要使你們手中的兵器，就是你們在城外與巴比倫王和圍困你們的迦勒底人打仗的兵器翻轉過來，又要使這些都聚集在這城中。
verses.e: ' The LORD , the God of Israel says , " Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , with which you fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls ; and I will gather them into the middle of this city .

verses.z: 並且我要在怒氣、忿怒，和大惱恨中，用伸出來的手，並大能的膀臂，親自攻擊你們；
verses.e: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm , even in anger , in wrath , and in great indignation .

verses.z: 又要擊打這城的居民，連人帶牲畜都必遭遇大瘟疫死亡。
verses.e: I will strike the inhabitants of this city , both man and animal . They will die of a great pestilence .

verses.z: 以後我要將猶大王西底家和他的臣僕百姓，就是在城內，從瘟疫、刀劍、饑荒中剩下的人，都交在巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的手中和他們仇敵，並尋索其命的人手中。巴比倫王必用刀擊殺他們，不顧惜，不可憐，不憐憫。這是耶和華說的。』
verses.e: Afterward , " says the LORD , " I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah , his servants , and the people , even those who are left in this city from the pestilence , from the sword , and from the famine , into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of those who seek their life . He will strike them with the edge of the sword . He will not spare them , have pity , or have mercy . " '

verses.z: 「你要對這百姓說：『耶和華如此說：看哪，我將生命的路和死亡的路擺在你們面前。
verses.e: " You shall say to this people , ' The LORD says : " Behold , I set before you the way of life and the way of death .

verses.z: 住在這城裏的必遭刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫而死；但出去歸降圍困你們迦勒底人的必得存活，要以自己的命為掠物。
verses.e: He who remains in this city will die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence , but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you , he will live , and he will escape with his life .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「你下到猶大王的宮中，在那裏說這話，
verses.e: The LORD said , " Go down to the house of the king of Judah , and speak this word there :

verses.z: 不要為死人哭號；不要為他悲傷，卻要為離家出外的人大大哭號；因為他不得再回來，也不得再見他的本國。
verses.e: Don't weep for the dead . Don't bemoan him ; but weep bitterly for him who goes away , for he will return no more , and not see his native country .

verses.z: 因為耶和華論到從這地方出去的猶大王約西亞的兒子沙龍，就是接續他父親約西亞作王的，這樣說：「他必不得再回到這裏來，
verses.e: For the LORD says touching Shallum the son of Josiah , king of Judah , who reigned instead of Josiah his father , and who went out of this place : " He won't return there any more .

verses.z: 卻要死在被擄去的地方，必不得再見這地。」
verses.e: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive . He will see this land no more . "

verses.z: 那行不義蓋房、行不公造樓、白白使用人的手工不給工價的有禍了！
verses.e: " Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness , and his rooms by injustice ; who uses his neighbor's service without wages , and doesn't give him his hire ;

verses.z: 他說：我要為自己蓋廣大的房、寬敞的樓，為自己開窗戶。這樓房的護牆板是香柏木的，樓房是丹色油漆的。
verses.e: who says , ' I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms , ' and cuts out windows for himself , with a cedar ceiling , and painted with red .

verses.z: 難道你作王是在乎[造]香柏木[樓房]爭勝嗎？你的父親豈不是也吃也喝、也施行公平和公義嗎？那時他得了福樂。
verses.e: " Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar ? Didn't your father eat and drink , and do justice and righteousness ? Then it was well with him .

verses.z: 他為困苦和窮乏人伸冤，那時就得了福樂。認識我不在乎此嗎？這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: He judged the cause of the poor and needy ; so then it was well . Wasn't this to know me ? " says the LORD .

verses.z: 惟有你的眼和你的心專顧貪婪，流無辜人的血，行欺壓和強暴。
verses.e: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness , for shedding innocent blood , for oppression , and for doing violence . "

verses.z: 所以，耶和華論到猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬如此說：人必不為他舉哀[說]：哀哉！我的哥哥；或說：哀哉！我的姊姊；也不為他舉哀[說]：哀哉！我的主；或說：哀哉！我主的榮華。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah , king of Judah : " They won't lament for him , saying , ' Ah my brother ! ' or , ' Ah sister ! ' They won't lament for him , saying ' Ah lord ! ' or , ' Ah his glory ! '

verses.z: 他被埋葬，好像埋驢一樣，要拉出去扔在耶路撒冷的城門之外。
verses.e: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey , drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 說：『坐大衛寶座的猶大王啊，你和你的臣僕，並進入城門的百姓，都當聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: ' Hear the LORD's word , king of Judah , who sits on David's throne — you , your servants , and your people who enter in by these gates .

verses.z: 你要上黎巴嫩哀號，在巴珊揚聲，從亞巴琳哀號，因為你所親愛的都毀滅了。
verses.e: " Go up to Lebanon , and cry out . Lift up your voice in Bashan , and cry from Abarim ; for all your lovers have been destroyed .

verses.z: 你興盛的時候，我對你說話；你卻說：我不聽。你自幼年以來總是這樣，不聽從我的話。
verses.e: I spoke to you in your prosperity , but you said , ' I will not listen . ' This has been your way from your youth , that you didn't obey my voice .

verses.z: 你的牧人要被風吞吃，你所親愛的必被擄去；那時你必因你一切的惡抱愧蒙羞。
verses.e: The wind will feed all your shepherds , and your lovers will go into captivity . Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness .

verses.z: 你這住黎巴嫩、在香柏樹上搭窩的，有痛苦臨到你，好像疼痛臨到產難的婦人，那時你何等可憐！
verses.e: Inhabitant of Lebanon , who makes your nest in the cedars , how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you , the pain as of a woman in travail !

verses.z: 耶和華說：「猶大王約雅敬的兒子哥尼雅，雖是我右手上帶印的戒指，我憑我的永生起誓，也必將你從其上摘下來，
verses.e: " As I live , " says the LORD , " though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand , I would still pluck you from there .

verses.z: 並且我必將你交給尋索你命的人和你所懼怕的人手中，就是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒和迦勒底人的手中。
verses.e: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life , and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid , even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans .

verses.z: 我也必將你和生你的母親趕到別國，並不是你們生的地方；你們必死在那裏，
verses.e: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country , where you were not born ; and there you will die .

verses.z: 但心中甚想歸回之地，必不得歸回。」
verses.e: But to the land to which their soul longs to return , there they will not return . "

verses.z: 哥尼雅這人是被輕看、破壞的器皿嗎？是無人喜愛的器皿嗎？他和他的後裔為何被趕到不認識之地呢？
verses.e: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel ? Is he a vessel in which no one delights ? Why are they cast out , he and his offspring , and cast into a land which they don't know ?

verses.z: 地啊，地啊，地啊，當聽耶和華的話！
verses.e: O earth , earth , earth , hear the LORD's word !

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你們要施行公平和公義，拯救被搶奪的脫離欺壓人的手，不可虧負寄居的和孤兒寡婦，不可以強暴待他們，在這地方也不可流無辜人的血。
verses.e: The LORD says : " Execute justice and righteousness , and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor . Do no wrong . Do no violence to the foreigner , the fatherless , or the widow . Don't shed innocent blood in this place .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：要寫明這人算為無子，是平生不得亨通的；因為他後裔中再無一人得亨通，能坐在大衛的寶座上治理猶大。
verses.e: The LORD says , " Record this man as childless , a man who will not prosper in his days ; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper , sitting on David's throne and ruling in Judah . "

verses.z: 你們若認真行這事，就必有坐大衛寶座的君王和他的臣僕百姓，或坐車或騎馬，從這城的各門進入。
verses.e: For if you do this thing indeed , then kings sitting on David's throne will enter in by the gates of this house , riding in chariots and on horses — they , their servants , and their people .

verses.z: 你們若不聽這些話，耶和華說：我指着自己起誓，這城必變為荒場。』
verses.e: But if you will not hear these words , I swear by myself , " says the LORD , " that this house will become a desolation . " ' "

verses.z: 耶和華論到猶大王的家如此說：我看你如基列，如黎巴嫩頂；然而，我必使你變為曠野，為無人居住的城邑。
verses.e: For the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah : " You are Gilead to me , the head of Lebanon . Yet surely I will make you a wilderness , cities which are not inhabited .

verses.z: 我要預備行毀滅的人，各拿器械攻擊你；他們要砍下你佳美的香柏樹，扔在火中。
verses.e: I will prepare destroyers against you , everyone with his weapons , and they will cut down your choice cedars , and cast them into the fire .

verses.z: 「許多國的民要經過這城，各人對鄰舍說：『耶和華為何向這大城如此行呢？』
verses.e: " Many nations will pass by this city , and they will each ask his neighbor , ' Why has the LORD done this to this great city ? '

verses.z: 他們必回答說：『是因離棄了耶和華－他們上帝的約，事奉敬拜別神。』」
verses.e: Then they will answer , ' Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God , worshiped other gods , and served them . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「那些殘害、趕散我草場之羊的牧人有禍了！」
verses.e: " Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture ! " says the LORD .

verses.z: 地滿了行淫的人！因妄自賭咒，地就悲哀；曠野的草場都枯乾了。他們所行的道乃是惡的；他們的勇力使得不正。
verses.e: " For the land is full of adulterers ; for because of the curse the land mourns . The pastures of the wilderness have dried up . Their course is evil , and their might is not right ;

verses.z: 連先知帶祭司都是褻瀆的，就是在我殿中我也看見他們的惡。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: for both prophet and priest are profane . Yes , in my house I have found their wickedness , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 因此，他們的道路必像黑暗中的滑地，他們必被追趕，在這路中仆倒；因為當追討之年，我必使災禍臨到他們。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness . They will be driven on , and fall therein ; for I will bring evil on them , even the year of their visitation , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我在撒馬利亞的先知中曾見愚妄；他們藉巴力說預言，使我的百姓以色列走錯了路。
verses.e: " I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria . They prophesied by Baal , and caused my people Israel to err .

verses.z: 我在耶路撒冷的先知中曾見可憎惡的事；他們行姦淫，做事虛妄，又堅固惡人的手，甚至無人回頭離開他的惡。他們在我面前都像所多瑪；耶路撒冷的居民都像蛾摩拉。
verses.e: In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing : they commit adultery and walk in lies . They strengthen the hands of evildoers , so that no one returns from his wickedness . They have all become to me as Sodom , and its inhabitants as Gomorrah . "

verses.z: 所以萬軍之耶和華論到先知如此說：我必將茵蔯給他們吃，又將苦膽水給他們喝；因為褻瀆的事出於耶路撒冷的先知，流行遍地。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD of Armies says concerning the prophets : " Behold , I will feed them with wormwood , and make them drink poisoned water ; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「這些先知向你們說預言，你們不要聽他們的話。他們以虛空教訓你們，所說的異象是出於自己的心，不是出於耶和華的口。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says , " Don't listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you . They teach you vanity . They speak a vision of their own heart , and not out of the mouth of the LORD .

verses.z: 他們常對藐視我的人說：『耶和華說：你們必享平安』；又對一切按自己頑梗之心而行的人說：『必沒有災禍臨到你們。』」
verses.e: They say continually to those who despise me , ' The LORD has said , " You will have peace ; " ' and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say , ' No evil will come on you . '

verses.z: 有誰站在耶和華的會中得以聽見並會悟他的話呢？有誰留心聽他的話呢？
verses.e: For who has stood in the council of the LORD , that he should perceive and hear his word ? Who has listened to my word , and heard it ?

verses.z: 看哪！耶和華的忿怒好像暴風，已經發出；是暴烈的旋風，必轉到惡人的頭上。
verses.e: Behold , the LORD's storm , his wrath , has gone out . Yes , a whirling storm ! It will burst on the head of the wicked .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝斥責那些牧養他百姓的牧人，如此說：「你們趕散我的羊群，並沒有看顧他們；我必討你們這行惡的罪。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD , the God of Israel , says against the shepherds who feed my people : " You have scattered my flock , driven them away , and have not visited them . Behold , I will visit on you the evil of your doings , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華的怒氣必不轉消，直到他心中所擬定的成就了。末後的日子你們要全然明白。
verses.e: The LORD's anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart . In the latter days , you will understand it perfectly .

verses.z: 我沒有打發那些先知，他們竟自奔跑；我沒有對他們說話，他們竟自預言。
verses.e: I didn't send these prophets , yet they ran . I didn't speak to them , yet they prophesied .

verses.z: 他們若是站在我的會中，就必使我的百姓聽我的話，又使他們回頭離開惡道和他們所行的惡。
verses.e: But if they had stood in my council , then they would have caused my people to hear my words , and would have turned them from their evil way , and from the evil of their doings .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我豈為近處的上帝呢？不也為遠處的上帝嗎？」
verses.e: " Am I a God at hand , " says the LORD , " and not a God afar off ?

verses.z: 耶和華說：「人豈能在隱密處藏身，使我看不見他呢？」耶和華說：「我豈不充滿天地嗎？
verses.e: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can't see him ? " says the LORD . " Don't I fill heaven and earth ? " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我已聽見那些先知所說的，就是託我名說的假預言，他們說：『我做了夢！我做了夢！』
verses.e: " I have heard what the prophets have said , who prophesy lies in my name , saying , ' I had a dream ! I had a dream ! '

verses.z: 說假預言的先知，就是預言本心詭詐的先知，他們這樣存心要到幾時呢？
verses.e: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies , even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart ?

verses.z: 他們各人將所做的夢對鄰舍述說，想要使我的百姓忘記我的名，正如他們列祖因巴力忘記我的名一樣。
verses.e: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor , as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal .

verses.z: 得夢的先知可以述說那夢；得我話的人可以誠實講說我的話。糠詷怎能與麥子比較呢？這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: The prophet who has a dream , let him tell a dream ; and he who has my word , let him speak my word faithfully . What is the straw to the wheat ? " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我的話豈不像火，又像能打碎磐石的大錘嗎？」
verses.e: " Isn't my word like fire ? " says the LORD ; " and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces ?

verses.z: 我要將我羊群中所餘剩的，從我趕他們到的各國內招聚出來，領他們歸回本圈；他們也必生養眾多。
verses.e: " I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them , and will bring them again to their folds ; and they will be fruitful and multiply .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「那些先知各從鄰舍偷竊我的言語，因此我必與他們反對。」
verses.e: " Therefore behold , I am against the prophets , " says the LORD , " who each steal my words from his neighbor .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「那些先知用舌頭，說是耶和華說的；我必與他們反對。」
verses.e: Behold , I am against the prophets , " says the LORD , " who use their tongues , and say , ' He says . '

verses.z: 耶和華說：「那些以幻夢為預言，又述說這夢，以謊言和矜誇使我百姓走錯了路的，我必與他們反對。我沒有打發他們，也沒有吩咐他們。他們與這百姓毫無益處。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: Behold , I am against those who prophesy lying dreams , " says the LORD , " who tell them , and cause my people to err by their lies , and by their vain boasting ; yet I didn't send them or command them . They don't profit this people at all , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 「無論是百姓，是先知，是祭司，問你說：『耶和華有甚麼默示呢？』你就對他們說：『甚麼默示啊？耶和華說：我要撇棄你們。』
verses.e: " When this people , or the prophet , or a priest , asks you , saying , ' What is the message from the LORD ? ' Then you shall tell them , ' " What message ? I will cast you off , " says the LORD . '

verses.z: 無論是先知，是祭司，是百姓，說『耶和華的默示』，我必刑罰那人和他的家。
verses.e: As for the prophet , the priest , and the people , who say , ' The message from the LORD , ' I will even punish that man and his household .

verses.z: 你們各人要對鄰舍，各人要對弟兄如此說：『耶和華回答甚麼？』『耶和華說了甚麼呢？』
verses.e: You will say everyone to his neighbor , and everyone to his brother , ' What has the LORD answered ? ' and , ' What has the LORD said ? '

verses.z: 『耶和華的默示』你們不可再提，各人所說的話必作自己的重擔，因為你們謬用永生上帝、萬軍之耶和華－我們上帝的言語。
verses.e: You will mention the message from the LORD no more , for every man's own word has become his message ; for you have perverted the words of the living God , of the LORD of Armies , our God .

verses.z: 你們要對先知如此說：『耶和華回答你甚麼？』『耶和華說了甚麼呢？』
verses.e: You will say to the prophet , ' What has the LORD answered you ? ' and , ' What has the LORD spoken ? '

verses.z: 你們若說『耶和華的默示』，耶和華就如此說：『因你們說「耶和華的默示」這句話，我也打發人到你們那裏去，告訴你們不可說「耶和華的默示」。』
verses.e: Although you say , ' The message from the LORD , ' therefore the LORD says : ' Because you say this word , " The message from the LORD , " and I have sent to you , telling you not to say , " The message from the LORD , "

verses.z: 所以我必全然忘記你們，將你們和我所賜給你們並你們列祖的城撇棄了；
verses.e: therefore behold , I will utterly forget you , and I will cast you off with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers , away from my presence .

verses.z: 我必設立照管他們的牧人，牧養他們。他們不再懼怕，不再驚惶，也不缺少一個；這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them . They will no longer be afraid or dismayed , neither will any be lacking , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 又必使永遠的凌辱和長久的羞恥臨到你們，是不能忘記的。」
verses.e: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you , and a perpetual shame , which will not be forgotten . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「日子將到，我要給大衛興起一個公義的苗裔；他必掌王權，行事有智慧，在地上施行公平和公義。
verses.e: " Behold , the days come , " says the LORD , " that I will raise to David a righteous Branch ; and he will reign as king and deal wisely , and will execute justice and righteousness in the land .

verses.z: 在他的日子，猶大必得救，以色列也安然居住。他的名必稱為『耶和華－我們的義』。」
verses.e: In his days Judah will be saved , and Israel will dwell safely . This is his name by which he will be called : The LORD our righteousness .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「日子將到，人必不再指着那領以色列人從埃及地上來永生的耶和華起誓，
verses.e: " Therefore , behold , the days come , " says the LORD , " that they will no more say , ' As the LORD lives , who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt ; '

verses.z: 卻要指着那領以色列家的後裔從北方和趕他們到的各國中上來、永生的耶和華起誓。他們必住在本地。」
verses.e: but , ' As the LORD lives , who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country , and from all the countries where I had driven them . ' Then they will dwell in their own land . "

verses.z: 論到那些先知，我心在我裏面憂傷，我骨頭都發顫；因耶和華和他的聖言，我像醉酒的人，像被酒所勝的人。
verses.e: Concerning the prophets : My heart within me is broken . All my bones shake . I am like a drunken man , and like a man whom wine has overcome , because of the LORD , and because of his holy words .

verses.z: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒將猶大王約雅敬的兒子耶哥尼雅和猶大的首領，並工匠、鐵匠從耶路撒冷擄去，帶到巴比倫。這事以後，耶和華指給我看，有兩筐無花果放在耶和華的殿前。
verses.e: The LORD showed me , and behold , two baskets of figs were set before the LORD's temple , after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim , king of Judah , and the princes of Judah , with the craftsmen and smiths , from Jerusalem , and had brought them to Babylon .

verses.z: 我必使刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫臨到他們，直到他們從我所賜給他們和他們列祖之地滅絕。」
verses.e: I will send the sword , the famine , and the pestilence among them , until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers . ' "

verses.z: 一筐是極好的無花果，好像是初熟的；一筐是極壞的無花果，壞得不可吃。
verses.e: One basket had very good figs , like the figs that are first-ripe ; and the other basket had very bad figs , which could not be eaten , they were so bad .

verses.z: 於是耶和華問我說：「耶利米你看見甚麼？」我說：「我看見無花果，好的極好，壞的極壞，壞得不可吃。」
verses.e: Then the LORD asked me , " What do you see , Jeremiah ? " I said , " Figs . The good figs are very good , and the bad are very bad , so bad that they can't be eaten . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：「
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：被擄去的猶大人，就是我打發離開這地到迦勒底人之地去的，我必看顧他們如這好無花果，使他們得好處。
verses.e: " The LORD , the God of Israel says : ' Like these good figs , so I will regard the captives of Judah , whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans , as good .

verses.z: 我要眷顧他們，使他們得好處，領他們歸回這地。我也要建立他們，必不拆毀；栽植他們，並不拔出。
verses.e: For I will set my eyes on them for good , and I will bring them again to this land . I will build them , and not pull them down . I will plant them , and not pluck them up .

verses.z: 我要賜他們認識我的心，知道我是耶和華。他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的上帝，因為他們要一心歸向我。」
verses.e: I will give them a heart to know me , that I am the LORD . They will be my people , and I will be their God ; for they will return to me with their whole heart .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「我必將猶大王西底家和他的首領，以及剩在這地耶路撒冷的餘民，並住在埃及地的猶大人都交出來，好像那極壞、壞得不可吃的無花果。
verses.e: " ' As the bad figs , which can't be eaten , they are so bad , ' surely the LORD says , ' So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah , and his princes , and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land , and those who dwell in the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 我必使他們交出來，在天下萬國中拋來拋去，遭遇災禍；在我趕逐他們到的各處成為凌辱、笑談、譏刺、咒詛。
verses.e: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil , to be a reproach and a proverb , a taunt and a curse , in all places where I will drive them .

verses.z: 猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬第四年，就是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的元年，[耶和華]論猶大眾民的話臨到耶利米。
verses.e: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah , in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah , king of Judah ( this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ) ,

verses.z: 我又要使歡喜和快樂的聲音，新郎和新婦的聲音，推磨的聲音和燈的亮光，從他們中間止息。
verses.e: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride , the sound of the millstones , and the light of the lamp .

verses.z: 這全地必然荒涼，令人驚駭。這些國民要服事巴比倫王七十年。
verses.e: This whole land will be a desolation , and an astonishment ; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years .

verses.z: 七十年滿了以後，我必刑罰巴比倫王和那國民，並迦勒底人之地，因他們的罪孽使那地永遠荒涼。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " It will happen , when seventy years are accomplished , that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation , " says the LORD , " for their iniquity . I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever .

verses.z: 我也必使我向那地所說的話，就是記在這書上的話，是耶利米向這些國民說的預言，都臨到那地。
verses.e: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it , even all that is written in this book , which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations .

verses.z: 因為有多國和大君王必使迦勒底人作奴僕；我也必照他們的行為，按他們手所做的報應他們。」
verses.e: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them , even of them . I will recompense them according to their deeds , and according to the work of their hands . "

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝對我如此說：「你從我手中接這杯忿怒的酒，使我所差遣你去的各國的民喝。
verses.e: For the LORD , the God of Israel , says to me : " Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand , and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it .

verses.z: 他們喝了就要東倒西歪，並要發狂，因我使刀劍臨到他們中間。」
verses.e: They will drink , and reel back and forth , and be insane , because of the sword that I will send among them . "

verses.z: 我就從耶和華的手中接了這杯，給耶和華所差遣我去的各國的民喝，
verses.e: Then I took the cup at the LORD's hand , and made all the nations to drink , to whom the LORD had sent me :

verses.z: 就是耶路撒冷和猶大的城邑，並耶路撒冷的君王與首領，使這城邑荒涼，令人驚駭、嗤笑、咒詛，正如今日一樣。
verses.e: Jerusalem , and the cities of Judah , with its kings and its princes , to make them a desolation , an astonishment , a hissing , and a curse , as it is today ;

verses.z: 又有埃及王法老和他的臣僕、首領，以及他的眾民，
verses.e: Pharaoh king of Egypt , with his servants , his princes , and all his people ;

verses.z: 先知耶利米就將這話對猶大眾人和耶路撒冷的一切居民說：
verses.e: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah , and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem :

verses.z: 並雜族的人民和烏斯地的諸王，與非利士地的諸王（亞實基倫、迦薩、以革倫，以及亞實突剩下的人）；
verses.e: and all the mixed people , and all the kings of the land of Uz , all the kings of the Philistines , Ashkelon , Gaza , Ekron , and the remnant of Ashdod ;

verses.z: 以東、摩押、亞捫人、
verses.e: Edom , Moab , and the children of Ammon ;

verses.z: 泰爾的諸王、西頓的諸王、海島的諸王、
verses.e: and all the kings of Tyre , all the kings of Sidon , and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea ;

verses.z: 底但、提瑪、布斯，和一切剃周圍[頭髮]的；
verses.e: Dedan , Tema , Buz , and all who have the corners of their beard cut off ;

verses.z: 阿拉伯的諸王、住曠野雜族人民的諸王、
verses.e: and all the kings of Arabia , all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness ;

verses.z: 心利的諸王、以攔的諸王、米底亞的諸王、
verses.e: and all the kings of Zimri , all the kings of Elam , and all the kings of the Medes ;

verses.z: 北方遠近的諸王，以及天下地上的萬國喝了，以後示沙克王也要喝。
verses.e: and all the kings of the north , far and near , one with another ; and all the kingdoms of the world , which are on the surface of the earth . The king of Sheshach will drink after them .

verses.z: 「你要對他們說：『萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：你們要喝，且要喝醉，要嘔吐，且要跌倒，不得再起來，都因我使刀劍臨到你們中間。』
verses.e: " You shall tell them , ' The LORD of Armies , the God of Israel says : " Drink , and be drunk , vomit , fall , and rise no more , because of the sword which I will send among you . " '

verses.z: 「他們若不肯從你手接這杯喝，你就要對他們說：『萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們一定要喝！
verses.e: It shall be , if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink , then you shall tell them , ' The LORD of Armies says : " You shall surely drink .

verses.z: 我既從稱為我名下的城起首施行災禍，你們能盡免刑罰嗎？你們必不能免，因為我要命刀劍臨到地上一切的居民。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。』
verses.e: For , behold , I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name ; and should you be utterly unpunished ? You will not be unpunished ; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth , says the LORD of Armies . " '

verses.z: 「從猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞十三年直到今日，這二十三年之內，常有耶和華的話臨到我；我也對你們傳說，就是從早起來傳說，只是你們沒有聽從。
verses.e: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah , even to this day , these twenty-three years , the LORD's word has come to me , and I have spoken to you , rising up early and speaking ; but you have not listened .

verses.z: 「所以你要向他們預言這一切的話，攻擊他們，說：耶和華必從高天吼叫，從聖所發聲，向自己的羊群大聲吼叫；他要向地上一切的居民吶喊，像踹[葡萄]的一樣。
verses.e: " Therefore prophesy against them all these words , and tell them , " ' The LORD will roar from on high , and utter his voice from his holy habitation . He will mightily roar against his fold . He will give a shout , as those who tread grapes , against all the inhabitants of the earth .

verses.z: 必有響聲達到地極，因為耶和華與列國相爭；凡有血氣的，他必審問；至於惡人，他必交給刀劍。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: A noise will come even to the end of the earth ; for the LORD has a controversy with the nations . He will enter into judgment with all flesh . As for the wicked , he will give them to the sword , " ' says the LORD . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：看哪，必有災禍從這國發到那國，並有大暴風從地極颳起。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says , " Behold , evil will go out from nation to nation , and a great storm will be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth . "

verses.z: 「到那日，從地這邊直到地那邊都有耶和華所殺戮的。必無人哀哭，不得收殮，不得葬埋，必在地上成為糞土。
verses.e: The slain of the LORD will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth . They won't be lamented . They won't be gathered or buried . They will be dung on the surface of the ground .

verses.z: 牧人哪，你們當哀號，呼喊；群眾的頭目啊，你們要滾[在灰中]；因為你們被殺戮分散的日子足足來到。你們要跌碎，好像美器打碎一樣。
verses.e: Wail , you shepherds , and cry . Wallow in dust , you leader of the flock ; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come , and you will fall like fine pottery .

verses.z: 牧人無路逃跑；群眾的頭目也無法逃脫。
verses.e: The shepherds will have no way to flee . The leader of the flock will have no escape .

verses.z: 聽啊，有牧人呼喊，有群眾頭目哀號的聲音，因為耶和華使他們的草場變為荒場。
verses.e: A voice of the cry of the shepherds , and the wailing of the leader of the flock , for the LORD destroys their pasture .

verses.z: 耶和華發出猛烈的怒氣，平安的羊圈就都寂靜無聲。
verses.e: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of the LORD .

verses.z: 他離了隱密處像獅子一樣，他們的地，因[刀劍]凶猛的欺壓，又因他猛烈的怒氣都成為可驚駭的。」
verses.e: He has left his covert , as the lion ; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression , and because of his fierce anger .

verses.z: 耶和華也從早起來，差遣他的僕人眾先知到你們這裏來（只是你們沒有聽從，也沒有側耳而聽），
verses.e: The LORD has sent to you all his servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them ( but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear ) ,

verses.z: 說：『你們各人當回頭，離開惡道和所作的惡，便可居住耶和華古時所賜給你們和你們列祖之地，直到永遠。
verses.e: saying , " Return now everyone from his evil way , and from the evil of your doings , and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and to your fathers , from of old and even forever more .

verses.z: 不可隨從別神事奉敬拜，以你們手所做的惹我發怒；這樣，我就不加害與你們。
verses.e: Don't go after other gods to serve them or worship them , and don't provoke me to anger with the work of your hands ; then I will do you no harm . "

verses.z: 然而你們沒有聽從我，竟以手所做的惹我發怒，陷害自己。這是耶和華說的。』」
verses.e: " Yet you have not listened to me , " says the LORD , " that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt . "

verses.z: 所以萬軍之耶和華如此說：「因為你們沒有聽從我的話，
verses.e: Therefore the LORD of Armies says : " Because you have not heard my words ,

verses.z: 我必召北方的眾族和我僕人巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來攻擊這地和這地的居民，並四圍一切的國民。我要將他們盡行滅絕，以致他們令人驚駭、嗤笑，並且永久荒涼。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: behold , I will send and take all the families of the north , " says the LORD , " and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , my servant , and will bring them against this land , and against its inhabitants , and against all these nations around . I will utterly destroy them , and make them an astonishment , and a hissing , and perpetual desolations .

verses.z: 猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬登基的時候，有這話從耶和華臨到[耶利米]說：
verses.e: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah , king of Judah , this word came from the LORD :

verses.z: 猶大的首領聽見這事，就從王宮上到耶和華的殿，坐在耶和華[殿]的新門口。
verses.e: When the princes of Judah heard these things , they came up from the king's house to the LORD's house ; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 祭司、先知對首領和眾民說：「這人是該死的；因為他說預言攻擊這城，正如你們親耳所聽見的。」
verses.e: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people , saying , " This man is worthy of death , for he has prophesied against this city , as you have heard with your ears . "

verses.z: 耶利米就對眾首領和眾民說：「耶和華差遣我預言，攻擊這殿和這城，說你們所聽見的這一切話。
verses.e: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people , saying , " The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard .

verses.z: 現在要改正你們的行動作為，聽從耶和華－你們上帝的話，他就必後悔，不將所說的災禍降與你們。
verses.e: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings , and obey the LORD your God's voice ; then the LORD will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you .

verses.z: 至於我，我在你們手中，你們眼看何為善，何為正，就那樣待我吧！
verses.e: But as for me , behold , I am in your hand . Do with me what is good and right in your eyes .

verses.z: 但你們要確實地知道，若把我治死，就使無辜人的血歸到你們和這城，並其中的居民了；因為耶和華實在差遣我到你們這裏來，將這一切話傳與你們耳中。」
verses.e: Only know for certain that if you put me to death , you will bring innocent blood on yourselves , on this city , and on its inhabitants ; for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears . "

verses.z: 首領和眾民就對祭司、先知說：「這人是不該死的，因為他是奉耶和華－我們上帝的名向我們說話。」
verses.e: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets : " This man is not worthy of death ; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God . "

verses.z: 國中的長老就有幾個人起來，對聚會的眾民說：
verses.e: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up , and spoke to all the assembly of the people , saying ,

verses.z: 「當猶大王希西家的日子，有摩利沙人彌迦對猶大眾人預言說：萬軍之耶和華如此說：錫安必被耕種像一塊田；耶路撒冷必變為亂堆；這殿的山必像叢林的高處。
verses.e: " Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah ; and he spoke to all the people of Judah , saying , ' The LORD of Armies says : " ' Zion will be plowed as a field , and Jerusalem will become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest . '

verses.z: 猶大王希西家和猶大眾人豈是把他治死呢？希西家豈不是敬畏耶和華、懇求他的恩嗎？耶和華就後悔，不把自己所說的災禍降與他們。[若治死這人]，我們就作了大惡，自害己命。」（
verses.e: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death ? Didn't he fear the LORD , and entreat the favor of the LORD , and the LORD relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them ? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way ! "

verses.z: 「耶和華如此說：你站在耶和華殿的院內，對猶大眾城邑的人，就是到耶和華殿來禮拜的，說我所吩咐你的一切話，一字不可刪減。
