verses.e: In those days , and in that time , " says the LORD , " the iniquity of Israel will be sought for , and there will be none , also the sins of Judah , and they won't be found ; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant .

verses.z: 耶和華說：上去攻擊米拉大翁之地，又攻擊比割的居民。要追殺滅盡，照我一切所吩咐你的去行。
verses.e: " Go up against the land of Merathaim , even against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod . Kill and utterly destroy after them , " says the LORD , " and do according to all that I have commanded you .

verses.z: 境內有打仗和大毀滅的響聲。
verses.e: A sound of battle is in the land , and of great destruction .

verses.z: 全地的大錘何竟砍斷破壞？巴比倫在列國中何竟荒涼？
verses.e: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken ! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations !

verses.z: 巴比倫哪，我為你設下網羅，你不知不覺被纏住。你被尋着，也被捉住；因為你與耶和華爭競。
verses.e: I have laid a snare for you , and you are also taken , Babylon , and you weren't aware . You are found , and also caught , because you have fought against the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華已經開了武庫，拿出他惱恨的兵器；因為主－萬軍之耶和華在迦勒底人之地有[當做的事]。
verses.e: The LORD has opened his armory , and has brought out the weapons of his indignation ; for the Lord , GOD of Armies , has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans .

verses.z: 你們要從極遠的邊界來攻擊她，開她的倉廩，將她堆如高堆，毀滅淨盡，絲毫不留。
verses.e: Come against her from the farthest border . Open her storehouses . Cast her up as heaps . Destroy her utterly . Let nothing of her be left .

verses.z: 要殺她的一切牛犢，使他們下去遭遇殺戮。他們有禍了，因為追討他們的日子已經來到。（
verses.e: Kill all her bulls . Let them go down to the slaughter . Woe to them ! For their day has come , the time of their visitation .

verses.z: 有從巴比倫之地逃避出來的人，在錫安揚聲報告耶和華－我們的上帝報仇，就是為他的殿報仇。）
verses.e: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon , to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God , the vengeance of his temple .

verses.z: 「招集一切弓箭手來攻擊巴比倫。要在巴比倫四圍安營，不要容一人逃脫，照着她所做的報應她；她怎樣待人，也要怎樣待她，因為她向耶和華－以色列的聖者發了狂傲。
verses.e: " Call together the archers against Babylon , all those who bend the bow . Encamp against her all around . Let none of it escape . Pay her back according to her work . According to all that she has done , do to her ; for she has been proud against the LORD , against the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 「因有一國從北方上來攻擊她，使她的地荒涼，無人居住，連人帶牲畜都逃走了。」
verses.e: For a nation comes up out of the north against her , which will make her land desolate , and no one will dwell in it . They have fled . They are gone , both man and animal .

verses.z: 所以她的少年人必仆倒在街上。當那日，一切兵丁必默默無聲。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets . All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 主－萬軍之耶和華說：你這狂傲的啊，我與你反對，因為我追討你的日子已經來到。
verses.e: " Behold , I am against you , you proud one , " says the Lord , GOD of Armies ; " for your day has come , the time that I will visit you .

verses.z: 狂傲的必絆跌仆倒，無人扶起。我也必使火在他的城邑中着起來，將他四圍所有的盡行燒滅。
verses.e: The proud one will stumble and fall , and no one will raise him up . I will kindle a fire in his cities , and it will devour all who are around him . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「以色列人和猶大人一同受欺壓；凡擄掠他們的都緊緊抓住他們，不肯釋放。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together . All who took them captive hold them fast . They refuse to let them go .

verses.z: 他們的救贖主大有能力，萬軍之耶和華是他的名。他必伸清他們的冤，好使全地得平安，並攪擾巴比倫的居民。」
verses.e: Their Redeemer is strong . The LORD of Armies is his name . He will thoroughly plead their cause , that he may give rest to the earth , and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「有刀劍臨到迦勒底人和巴比倫的居民，並她的首領與智慧人。
verses.e: " A sword is on the Chaldeans , " says the LORD , " and on the inhabitants of Babylon , on her princes , and on her wise men .

verses.z: 有刀劍臨到矜誇的人，他們就成為愚昧；有刀劍臨到她的勇士，他們就驚惶。
verses.e: A sword is on the boasters , and they will become fools . A sword is on her mighty men , and they will be dismayed .

verses.z: 有刀劍臨到她的馬匹、車輛，和其中雜族的人民；他們必像婦女一樣。有刀劍臨到她的寶物，就被搶奪。
verses.e: A sword is on their horses , on their chariots , and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her ; and they will become as women . A sword is on her treasures , and they will be robbed .

verses.z: 有乾旱臨到她的眾水，就必乾涸；因為這是有雕刻偶像之地，人因偶像而顛狂。
verses.e: A drought is on her waters , and they will be dried up ; for it is a land of engraved images , and they are mad over idols .

verses.z: 所以曠野的走獸和豺狼必住在那裏，鴕鳥也住在其中，永無人煙，世世代代無人居住。」
verses.e: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there . The ostriches will dwell therein . It will be inhabited no more forever , neither will it be lived in from generation to generation .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「當那日子、那時候，以色列人要和猶大人同來，隨走隨哭，尋求耶和華－他們的上帝。
verses.e: " In those days , and in that time , " says the LORD , " the children of Israel will come , they and the children of Judah together ; they will go on their way weeping , and will seek the LORD their God .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「必無人住在那裏，也無人在其中寄居，要像我傾覆所多瑪、蛾摩拉，和鄰近的城邑一樣。
verses.e: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities , " says the LORD , " so no man will dwell there , neither will any son of man live therein .

verses.z: 看哪，有一種民從北方而來，並有一大國和許多君王被激動，從地極來到。
verses.e: " Behold , a people comes from the north . A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth .

verses.z: 他們拿弓和槍，性情殘忍，不施憐憫；他們的聲音像海浪匉訇。巴比倫城啊，他們騎馬，都擺隊伍如上戰場的人，要攻擊你。
verses.e: They take up bow and spear . They are cruel , and have no mercy . Their voice roars like the sea . They ride on horses , everyone set in array , as a man to the battle , against you , daughter of Babylon .

verses.z: 巴比倫王聽見他們的風聲，手就發軟，痛苦將他抓住，疼痛彷彿產難的婦人。
verses.e: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them , and his hands become feeble . Anguish has taken hold of him , pains as of a woman in labor .

verses.z: 「[仇敵]必像獅子從約旦河邊的叢林上來，攻擊堅固的居所。轉眼之間，我要使他們逃跑，離開這地。誰蒙揀選，我就派誰治理這地。誰能比我呢？誰能給我定規日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？
verses.e: Behold , the enemy will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against the strong habitation ; for I will suddenly make them run away from it . Whoever is chosen , I will appoint him over it , for who is like me ? Who will appoint me a time ? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me ? "

verses.z: 你們要聽耶和華攻擊巴比倫所說的謀略和他攻擊迦勒底人之地所定的旨意。仇敵定要將他們群眾微弱的拉去，定要使他們的居所荒涼。
verses.e: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that he has taken against Babylon ; and his purposes that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans : Surely they will drag them away , even the little ones of the flock . Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them .

verses.z: 因巴比倫被取的聲音，地就震動，人在列邦都聽見呼喊的聲音。」
verses.e: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon . The cry is heard among the nations .

verses.z: 他們必訪問錫安，又面向這裏，[說]：『來吧，你們要與耶和華聯合為永遠不忘的約。』
verses.e: They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it , saying , ' Come , and join yourselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten . '

verses.z: 「我的百姓作了迷失的羊，牧人使他們走差路，使他們轉到山上。他們從大山走到小山，竟忘了安歇之處。
verses.e: My people have been lost sheep . Their shepherds have caused them to go astray . They have turned them away on the mountains . They have gone from mountain to hill . They have forgotten their resting place .

verses.z: 凡遇見他們的，就把他們吞滅。敵人說：『我們沒有罪；因他們得罪那作公義居所的耶和華，就是他們列祖所仰望的耶和華。』
verses.e: All who found them have devoured them . Their adversaries said , ' We are not guilty , because they have sinned against the LORD , the habitation of righteousness , even the LORD , the hope of their fathers . '

verses.z: 「我[民哪]，你們要從巴比倫中逃走，從迦勒底人之地出去，要像羊群前面走的公山羊。
verses.e: " Flee out of the middle of Babylon ! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans , and be as the male goats before the flocks .

verses.z: 因我必激動聯合的大國從北方上來攻擊巴比倫，他們要擺陣攻擊她；她必從那裏被攻取。他們的箭好像善射之勇士的箭，一枝也不徒然返回。
verses.e: For , behold , I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country ; and they will set themselves in array against her . She will be taken from there . Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man . None of them will return in vain .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：我必使毀滅的風颳起，攻擊巴比倫和住在立加米的人。
verses.e: The LORD says : " Behold , I will raise up against Babylon , and against those who dwell in Lebkamai , a destroying wind .

verses.z: 耶和華已經彰顯我們的公義。來吧！我們可以在錫安報告耶和華－我們上帝的作為。
verses.e: ' The LORD has produced our righteousness . Come , and let's declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God . '

verses.z: 你們要磨尖了箭頭，抓住盾牌。耶和華定意攻擊巴比倫，將她毀滅，所以激動了米底亞君王的心；因這是耶和華報仇，就是為自己的殿報仇。
verses.e: " Make the arrows sharp ! Hold the shields firmly ! The LORD has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes , because his purpose is against Babylon , to destroy it ; for it is the vengeance of the LORD , the vengeance of his temple .

verses.z: 你們要豎立大旗，攻擊巴比倫的城牆；要堅固瞭望臺，派定守望的設下埋伏；因為耶和華指着巴比倫居民所說的話、所定的意，他已經作成。
verses.e: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon ! Make the watch strong ! Set the watchmen , and prepare the ambushes ; for the LORD has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon .

verses.z: 住在眾水之上多有財寶的啊，你的結局到了！你貪婪之量滿了！
verses.e: You who dwell on many waters , abundant in treasures , your end has come , the measure of your covetousness .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華指着自己起誓[說]：我必使[敵]人充滿你，像螞蚱一樣；他們必吶喊攻擊你。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies has sworn by himself , saying , ' Surely I will fill you with men , as with locusts , and they will lift up a shout against you . '

verses.z: 耶和華用能力創造大地，用智慧建立世界，用聰明鋪張穹蒼。
verses.e: " He has made the earth by his power . He has established the world by his wisdom . By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens .

verses.z: 他一發聲，空中便有多水激動；他使雲霧從地極上騰。他造電隨雨而閃，從他府庫中帶出風來。
verses.e: When he utters his voice , there is a roar of waters in the heavens , and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth . He makes lightning for the rain , and brings the wind out of his treasuries .

verses.z: 各人都成了畜類，毫無知識。各銀匠都因他的偶像羞愧；他所鑄的偶像本是虛假的，其中並無氣息，
verses.e: " Every man has become stupid and without knowledge . Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image , for his molten images are falsehood , and there is no breath in them .

verses.z: 都是虛無的，是迷惑人的工作，到追討的時候，必被除滅。
verses.e: They are vanity , a work of delusion . In the time of their visitation , they will perish .

verses.z: 雅各的分不像這些，因他是造作萬有的[主]；以色列也是他產業的支派。萬軍之耶和華是他的名。
verses.e: The portion of Jacob is not like these , for he formed all things , including the tribe of his inheritance . The LORD of Armies is his name .

verses.z: 我要打發外邦人來到巴比倫，簸揚她，使她的地空虛。在她遭禍的日子，他們要周圍攻擊她。
verses.e: I will send to Babylon strangers , who will winnow her . They will empty her land ; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around .

verses.z: 你是我爭戰的斧子和打仗的兵器；我要用你打碎列國，用你毀滅列邦；
verses.e: " You are my battle ax and weapons of war . With you I will break the nations into pieces . With you I will destroy kingdoms .

verses.z: 用你打碎馬和騎馬的；用你打碎戰車和坐在其上的；
verses.e: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider .

verses.z: 用你打碎男人和女人；用你打碎老年人和少年人；用你打碎壯丁和處女；
verses.e: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein . With you I will break in pieces man and woman . With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth . With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin .

verses.z: 用你打碎牧人和他的群畜；用你打碎農夫和他一對[牛]；用你打碎省長和副省長。
verses.e: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock . With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke . With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我必在你們眼前報復巴比倫人和迦勒底居民在錫安所行的諸惡。」
verses.e: " I will give to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華說：你這行毀滅的山哪，就是毀滅天下的山，我與你反對。我必向你伸手，將你從山巖滾下去，使你成為燒毀的山。
verses.e: " Behold , I am against you , destroying mountain , " says the LORD , " which destroys all the earth . I will stretch out my hand on you , roll you down from the rocks , and will make you a burned mountain .

verses.z: 人必不從你那裏取石頭為房角石，也不取石頭為根基石；你必永遠荒涼。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: They won't take a cornerstone from you , nor a stone for foundations ; but you will be desolate forever , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 要在境內豎立大旗，在各國中吹角，使列國預備攻擊巴比倫，將亞拉臘、米尼、亞實基拿各國招來攻擊她；又派軍長來攻擊她，使馬匹上來如螞蚱，
verses.e: " Set up a standard in the land ! Blow the trumpet among the nations ! Prepare the nations against her ! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat , Minni , and Ashkenaz ! Appoint a marshal against her ! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts !

verses.z: 使列國和米底亞君王，與省長和副省長，並他們所管全地之人，都預備攻擊她。
verses.e: Prepare against her the nations , the kings of the Medes , its governors , and all its deputies , and all the land of their dominion !

verses.z: 地必震動而瘠苦；因耶和華向巴比倫所定的旨意成立了，使巴比倫之地荒涼，無人居住。
verses.e: The land trembles and is in pain ; for the purposes of the LORD against Babylon stand , to make the land of Babylon a desolation , without inhabitant .

verses.z: 拉弓的，要向拉弓的和貫甲挺身的射箭。不要憐惜她的少年人；要滅盡她的全軍。
verses.e: Against him who bends , let the archer bend his bow , also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail . Don't spare her young men ! Utterly destroy all her army !

verses.z: 巴比倫的勇士止息爭戰，藏在堅壘之中。他們的勇力衰盡，好像婦女一樣。巴比倫的住處有火着起，門閂都折斷了。
verses.e: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting , they remain in their strongholds . Their might has failed . They have become as women . Her dwelling places are set on fire . Her bars are broken .

verses.z: 跑報的要彼此相遇，送信的要互相迎接，報告巴比倫王說：城的四方被攻取了，
verses.e: One runner will run to meet another , and one messenger to meet another , to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter .

verses.z: 渡口被佔據了，葦塘被火燒了，兵丁也驚慌了。
verses.e: So the passages are seized . They have burned the reeds with fire . The men of war are frightened . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：巴比倫城好像踹穀的禾場；再過片時，收割她的時候就到了。
verses.e: For the LORD of Armies , the God of Israel says : " The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden . Yet a little while , and the time of harvest comes for her . "

verses.z: 以色列人說：巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒吞滅我，壓碎我，使我成為空虛的器皿。他像大魚將我吞下，用我的美物充滿他的肚腹，又將我趕出去。
verses.e: " Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me . He has crushed me . He has made me an empty vessel . He has , like a monster , swallowed me up . He has filled his mouth with my delicacies . He has cast me out .

verses.z: 錫安的居民要說：巴比倫以強暴待我，損害我的身體，願這罪歸給她。耶路撒冷人要說：願流我們血的罪歸到迦勒底的居民。
verses.e: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon ! " the inhabitant of Zion will say ; and , " May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea ! " will Jerusalem say .

verses.z: 所以，耶和華如此說：我必為你伸冤，為你報仇；我必使巴比倫的海枯竭，使她的泉源乾涸。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says : " Behold , I will plead your cause , and take vengeance for you . I will dry up her sea , and make her fountain dry .

verses.z: 巴比倫必成為亂堆，為野狗的住處，令人驚駭、嗤笑，並且無人居住。
verses.e: Babylon will become heaps , a dwelling place for jackals , an astonishment , and a hissing , without inhabitant .

verses.z: 他們要像少壯獅子咆哮，像小獅子吼叫。
verses.e: They will roar together like young lions . They will growl as lions ' cubs .

verses.z: 他們火熱的時候，我必為他們設擺酒席，使他們沉醉，好叫他們快樂，睡了長覺，永不醒起。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: When they are inflamed , I will make their feast , and I will make them drunk , that they may rejoice , and sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake up , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 他們必在迦勒底人之地被殺仆倒，在巴比倫的街上被刺透。
verses.e: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans , and thrust through in her streets .

verses.z: 我必使他們像羊羔、像公綿羊和公山羊下到宰殺之地。
verses.e: " I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter , like rams with male goats .

verses.z: 示沙克何竟被攻取？天下所稱讚的何竟被佔據？巴比倫在列國中何竟變為荒場？
verses.e: " How Sheshach is taken ! How the praise of the whole earth is seized ! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations !

verses.z: 海水漲起，漫過巴比倫；她被許多海浪遮蓋。
verses.e: The sea has come up on Babylon . She is covered with the multitude of its waves .

verses.z: 她的城邑變為荒場、旱地、沙漠，無人居住，無人經過之地。
verses.e: Her cities have become a desolation , a dry land , and a desert , a land in which no man dwells . No son of man passes by it .

verses.z: 我必刑罰巴比倫的彼勒，使他吐出所吞的。萬民必不再流歸他那裏；巴比倫的城牆也必坍塌了。
verses.e: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon , and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up . The nations will not flow any more to him . Yes , the wall of Babylon will fall .

verses.z: 我的民哪，你們要從其中出去！各人拯救自己，躲避耶和華的烈怒。
verses.e: " My people , go away from the middle of her , and each of you save yourselves from the LORD's fierce anger .

verses.z: 你們不要心驚膽怯，也不要因境內所聽見的風聲懼怕；因為這年有風聲傳來；那年也有風聲[傳來]，境內有強暴的事，官長攻擊官長。
verses.e: Don't let your heart faint . Don't fear for the news that will be heard in the land . For news will come one year , and after that in another year news will come , and violence in the land , ruler against ruler .

verses.z: 日子將到，我必刑罰巴比倫雕刻的偶像。她全地必然抱愧；她被殺的人必在其中仆倒。
verses.e: Therefore behold , the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon ; and her whole land will be confounded . All her slain will fall in the middle of her .

verses.z: 那時，天地和其中所有的，必因巴比倫歡呼，因為行毀滅的要從北方來到她那裏。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Then the heavens and the earth , and all that is therein , will sing for joy over Babylon ; for the destroyers will come to her from the north , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 巴比倫怎樣使以色列被殺的人仆倒，照樣她全地被殺的人也必在巴比倫仆倒。
verses.e: " As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall , so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon .

verses.z: 以色列和猶大雖然境內充滿違背以色列聖者的罪，卻沒有被他的上帝－萬軍之耶和華丟棄。
verses.e: For Israel is not forsaken , nor Judah , by his God , by the LORD of Armies ; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 你們躲避刀劍的要快走，不要站住！要在遠方記念耶和華，心中追想耶路撒冷。
verses.e: You who have escaped the sword , go ! Don't stand still ! Remember the LORD from afar , and let Jerusalem come into your mind . "

verses.z: 我們聽見辱罵就蒙羞，滿面慚愧，因為外邦人進入耶和華殿的聖所。
verses.e: " We are confounded because we have heard reproach . Confusion has covered our faces , for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of the LORD's house . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：日子將到，我必刑罰巴比倫雕刻的偶像，通國受傷的人必唉哼。
verses.e: " Therefore behold , the days come , " says the LORD , " that I will execute judgment on her engraved images ; and through all her land the wounded will groan .

verses.z: 巴比倫雖升到天上，雖使她堅固的高處更堅固，還有行毀滅的從我這裏到她那裏。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky , and though she should fortify the height of her strength , yet destroyers will come to her from me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 有哀號的聲音從巴比倫出來；有大毀滅的響聲從迦勒底人之地發出。
verses.e: " The sound of a cry comes from Babylon , and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans !

verses.z: 因耶和華使巴比倫變為荒場，使其中的大聲滅絕。仇敵彷彿眾水，波浪匉訇，響聲已經發出。
verses.e: For the LORD lays Babylon waste , and destroys out of her the great voice ! Their waves roar like many waters . The noise of their voice is uttered .

verses.z: 這是行毀滅的臨到巴比倫。巴比倫的勇士被捉住，他們的弓折斷了；因為耶和華是施行報應的上帝，必定施行報應。
verses.e: For the destroyer has come on her , even on Babylon . Her mighty men are taken . Their bows are broken in pieces , for the LORD is a God of retribution . He will surely repay .

verses.z: 君王－名為萬軍之耶和華的說：我必使巴比倫的首領、智慧人、省長、副省長，和勇士都沉醉，使他們睡了長覺，永不醒起。
verses.e: I will make her princes , her wise men , her governors , her deputies , and her mighty men drunk . They will sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake up , " says the King , whose name is the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：巴比倫寬闊的城牆必全然傾倒；她高大的城門必被火焚燒。眾民所勞碌的必致虛空；列國所勞碌的被火焚燒，他們都必困乏。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown . Her high gates will be burned with fire . The peoples will labor for vanity , and the nations for the fire ; and they will be weary . "

verses.z: 猶大王西底家在位第四年，上巴比倫去的時候，瑪西雅的孫子、尼利亞的兒子西萊雅與王同去（西萊雅是王宮的大臣），先知耶利米有話吩咐他。
verses.e: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah , the son of Mahseiah , when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign . Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster .

verses.z: 你們要從巴比倫中逃奔，各救自己的性命！不要陷在她的罪孽中一同滅亡；因為這是耶和華報仇的時候，他必向巴比倫施行報應。
verses.e: " Flee out of the middle of Babylon ! Everyone save his own life ! Don't be cut off in her iniquity , for it is the time of the LORD's vengeance . He will give to her a recompense .

verses.z: 耶利米將一切要臨到巴比倫的災禍，就是論到巴比倫的一切話，寫在書上。
verses.e: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon , even all these words that are written concerning Babylon .

verses.z: 耶利米對西萊雅說：「你到了巴比倫務要念這書上的話；
verses.e: Jeremiah said to Seraiah , " When you come to Babylon , then see that you read all these words ,

verses.z: 又說：『耶和華啊，你曾論到這地方說：要剪除，甚至連人帶牲畜沒有在這裏居住的，必永遠荒涼。』
verses.e: and say , ' LORD , you have spoken concerning this place , to cut it off , that no one will dwell in it , neither man nor animal , but that it will be desolate forever . '

verses.z: 你念完了這書，就把一塊石頭拴在書上，扔在幼發拉底河中，
verses.e: It will be , when you have finished reading this book , that you shall bind a stone to it , and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates .

verses.z: 說：『巴比倫因耶和華所要降與她的災禍，必如此沉下去，不再興起，人民也必困乏。』」耶利米的話到此為止。
verses.e: Then you shall say , ' Thus will Babylon sink , and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her ; and they will be weary . ' " Thus far are the words of Jeremiah .

verses.z: 巴比倫素來是耶和華手中的金杯，使天下沉醉；萬國喝了她的酒就顛狂了。
verses.e: Babylon has been a golden cup in the LORD's hand , who made all the earth drunk . The nations have drunk of her wine ; therefore the nations have gone mad .

verses.z: 巴比倫忽然傾覆毀壞；要為她哀號；為止她的疼痛，拿乳香或者可以治好。
verses.e: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed ! Wail for her ! Take balm for her pain . Perhaps she may be healed .

verses.z: 我們想醫治巴比倫，她卻沒有治好。離開她吧！我們各人歸回本國；因為她受的審判通於上天，達到穹蒼。
verses.e: " We would have healed Babylon , but she is not healed . Forsake her , and let's each go into his own country ; for her judgment reaches to heaven , and is lifted up even to the skies .

verses.z: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
verses.e: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign . He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . His mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .

verses.z: 巴比倫王在西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，又在利比拉殺了猶大的一切首領，
verses.e: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes . He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah .

verses.z: 並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖着他，帶到巴比倫去，將他囚在監裏，直到他死的日子。
verses.e: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah ; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters , and carried him to Babylon , and put him in prison until the day of his death .

verses.z: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比倫王面前侍立的護衛長尼布撒拉旦進入耶路撒冷，
verses.e: Now in the fifth month , in the tenth day of the month , which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar , king of Babylon , Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard , who stood before the king of Babylon , came into Jerusalem .

verses.z: 用火焚燒耶和華的殿和王宮，又焚燒耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大戶家的房屋。
verses.e: He burned the LORD's house , and the king's house ; and all the houses of Jerusalem , even every great house , he burned with fire .

verses.z: 跟從護衛長迦勒底的全軍就拆毀耶路撒冷四圍的城牆。
verses.e: All the army of the Chaldeans , who were with the captain of the guard , broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around .

verses.z: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將民中最窮的和城裏所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及大眾所剩下的人，都擄去了。
verses.e: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people , and the rest of the people who were left in the city , and those who fell away , who defected to the king of Babylon , and the rest of the multitude .

verses.z: 但護衛長尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最窮的，使他們修理葡萄園，耕種田地。
verses.e: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers .

verses.z: 耶和華殿的銅柱並殿內的[盆]座和銅海，迦勒底人都打碎了，將那銅運到巴比倫去了，
verses.e: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD's house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD's house in pieces , and carried all of their bronze to Babylon .

verses.z: 又帶去鍋、鏟子、蠟剪、盤子、調羹，並所用的一切銅器、
verses.e: They also took away the pots , the shovels , the snuffers , the basins , the spoons , and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered .

verses.z: 杯、火鼎、碗、盆、燈臺、調羹、爵，無論金的銀的，護衛長也都帶去了。
verses.e: The captain of the guard took away the cups , the fire pans , the basins , the pots , the lamp stands , the spoons , and the bowls ; that which was of gold , as gold , and that which was of silver , as silver .

verses.z: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。
verses.e: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .

verses.z: 所羅門為耶和華殿所造的兩根[銅]柱、一個[銅]海，並座下的十二隻銅牛，這一切的銅多得無法可稱。
verses.e: They took the two pillars , the one sea , and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases , which King Solomon had made for the LORD's house . The bronze of all these vessels was without weight .

verses.z: 這一根柱子高十八肘，厚四指，是空的，圍十二肘。
verses.e: As for the pillars , the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits ; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it ; and its thickness was four fingers . It was hollow .

verses.z: 柱上有銅頂，高五肘；銅頂的周圍有網子和石榴，都是銅的。那一根柱子照此一樣，也有石榴。
verses.e: A capital of bronze was on it ; and the height of the one capital was five cubits , with network and pomegranates on the capital all around , all of bronze . The second pillar also had the same , with pomegranates .

verses.z: 柱子四面有九十六個石榴，在網子周圍，共有一百石榴。
verses.e: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides ; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around .

verses.z: 護衛長拿住大祭司西萊雅、副祭司西番亞，和三個把門的，
verses.e: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest , and Zephaniah the second priest , and the three keepers of the threshold ,

verses.z: 又從城中拿住一個管理兵丁的官，並在城裏所遇常見王面的七個人和檢點國民軍長的書記，以及城裏所遇見的國民六十個人。
verses.e: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war ; and seven men of those who saw the king's face , who were found in the city ; and the scribe of the captain of the army , who mustered the people of the land ; and sixty men of the people of the land , who were found in the middle of the city .

verses.z: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦將這些人帶到利比拉的巴比倫王那裏。
verses.e: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them , and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah .

verses.z: 巴比倫王就把他們擊殺在哈馬地的利比拉。這樣，猶大人被擄去離開本地。
verses.e: The king of Babylon struck them , and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath . So Judah was carried away captive out of his land .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒所擄的民數記在下面：在他第七年擄去猶大人三千零二十三名；
verses.e: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive : in the seventh year , three thousand twenty-three Jews ;

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒十八年從耶路撒冷擄去八百三十二人；
verses.e: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar , he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons ;

verses.z: 因此耶和華的怒氣在耶路撒冷和猶大發作，以致將人民從自己的面前趕出。
verses.e: For through the LORD's anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah , until he had cast them out from his presence . Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon .

verses.z: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，護衛長尼布撒拉旦擄去猶大人七百四十五名；共有四千六百人。
verses.e: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar , Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people . All the people numbered four thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 猶大王約雅斤被擄後三十七年，巴比倫王以未‧米羅達[元]年十二月二十五日，使猶大王約雅斤抬頭，提他出監，
verses.e: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah , in the twelfth month , in the twenty-fifth day of the month , Evilmerodach king of Babylon , in the first year of his reign , lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah , and released him from prison .

verses.z: 又對他說恩言，使他的位高過與他一同在巴比倫眾王的位，
verses.e: He spoke kindly to him , and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon ,

verses.z: 給他脫了囚服。他終身在巴比倫王面前吃飯。
verses.e: and changed his prison garments . Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life .

verses.z: 巴比倫王賜他所需用的食物，日日賜他一分，終身是這樣，直到他死的日子。
verses.e: For his allowance , there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon , every day a portion until the day of his death , all the days of his life .

verses.z: 西底家背叛巴比倫王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。
verses.e: In the ninth year of his reign , in the tenth month , in the tenth day of the month , Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came , he and all his army , against Jerusalem , and encamped against it ; and they built forts against it round about .

verses.z: 於是城被圍困直到西底家王十一年。
verses.e: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah .

verses.z: 四月初九日，城裏有大饑荒，甚至百姓都沒有糧食。
verses.e: In the fourth month , in the ninth day of the month , the famine was severe in the city , so that there was no bread for the people of the land .

verses.z: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜間從靠近王園兩城中間的門，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四圍攻城。他們就往亞拉巴逃去。
verses.e: Then a breach was made in the city , and all the men of war fled , and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls , which was by the king's garden . Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around . The men of war went toward the Arabah ,

verses.z: 迦勒底的軍隊追趕西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全軍都離開他四散了。
verses.e: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho ; and all his army was scattered from him .

verses.z: 迦勒底人就拿住王，帶他到在哈馬地利比拉的巴比倫王那裏；巴比倫王便審判他。
verses.e: Then they took the king , and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath ; and he pronounced judgment on him .

verses.z: 便雅憫人哪，你們要逃出耶路撒冷，在提哥亞吹角，在伯‧哈基琳立號旗；因為有災禍與大毀滅從北方張望。
verses.e: " Flee for safety , you children of Benjamin , out of the middle of Jerusalem ! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem , for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction .

verses.z: 現在我可以向誰說話作見證，使他們聽呢？他們的耳朵未受割禮，不能聽見。看哪，耶和華的話他們以為羞辱，不以為喜悅。
verses.e: To whom should I speak and testify , that they may hear ? Behold , their ear is uncircumcised , and they can't listen . Behold , the LORD's word has become a reproach to them . They have no delight in it .

verses.z: 因此我被耶和華的忿怒充滿，難以含忍。我要傾在街中的孩童和聚會的少年人身上，連夫帶妻，並年老的與日子滿足的都必被擒拿。
verses.e: Therefore I am full of the LORD's wrath . I am weary with holding it in . " Pour it out on the children in the street , and on the assembly of young men together ; for even the husband with the wife will be taken , the aged with him who is full of days .

verses.z: 他們的房屋、田地，和妻子都必轉歸別人；我要伸手攻擊這地的居民。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Their houses will be turned to others , their fields and their wives together ; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land , says the LORD . "

verses.z: 因為他們從最小的到至大的都一味地貪婪，從先知到祭司都行事虛謊。
verses.e: " For from their least even to their greatest , everyone is given to covetousness . From the prophet even to the priest , everyone deals falsely .

verses.z: 他們輕輕忽忽地醫治我百姓的損傷，說：平安了！平安了！其實沒有平安。
verses.e: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially , saying , ' Peace , peace ! ' when there is no peace .

verses.z: 他們行可憎的事知道慚愧嗎？不然，他們毫不慚愧，也不知羞恥。因此，他們必在仆倒的人中仆倒；我向他們討罪的時候，他們必致跌倒。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination ? No , they were not at all ashamed , neither could they blush . Therefore they will fall among those who fall . When I visit them , they will be cast down , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：你們當站在路上察看，訪問古道，哪是善道，便行在其間；這樣，你們心裏必得安息。他們卻說：我們不行[在其間]。
verses.e: The LORD says , " Stand in the ways and see , and ask for the old paths , ' Where is the good way ? ' and walk in it , and you will find rest for your souls . But they said , ' We will not walk in it . '

verses.z: 我設立守望的人照管你們，[說]：要聽角聲。他們卻說：我們不聽。
verses.e: I set watchmen over you , saying , ' Listen to the sound of the trumpet ! ' But they said , ' We will not listen ! '

verses.z: 列國啊，因此你們當聽！會眾啊，要知道他們必遭遇的事。
verses.e: Therefore hear , you nations , and know , congregation , what is among them .

verses.z: 地啊，當聽！我必使災禍臨到這百姓，就是他們意念所結的果子；因為他們不聽從我的言語，至於我的訓誨，他們也厭棄了。
verses.e: Hear , earth ! Behold , I will bring evil on this people , even the fruit of their thoughts , because they have not listened to my words ; and as for my law , they have rejected it .

verses.z: 那秀美嬌嫩的錫安女子，我必剪除。
verses.e: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one , the daughter of Zion .

verses.z: 從示巴出的乳香，從遠方出的菖蒲奉來給我有何益呢？你們的燔祭不蒙悅納；你們的[平安]祭，我也不喜悅。
verses.e: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me , and the sweet cane from a far country ? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable , and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me . "

verses.z: 所以耶和華如此說：我要將絆腳石放在這百姓前面。父親和兒子要一同跌在其上；鄰舍與朋友也都滅亡。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says , " Behold , I will lay stumbling blocks before this people . The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them . The neighbor and his friend will perish . "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：看哪，有一種民從北方而來，並有一大國被激動，從地極來到。
verses.e: The LORD says , " Behold , a people comes from the north country . A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth .

verses.z: 他們拿弓和槍，性情殘忍，不施憐憫；他們的聲音像海浪匉訇。錫安城啊，他們騎馬都擺隊伍，如上戰場的人要攻擊你。
verses.e: They take hold of bow and spear . They are cruel , and have no mercy . Their voice roars like the sea , and they ride on horses , everyone set in array , as a man to the battle , against you , daughter of Zion . "

verses.z: 我們聽見他們的風聲，手就發軟；痛苦將我們抓住，疼痛彷彿產難的婦人。
verses.e: We have heard its report . Our hands become feeble . Anguish has taken hold of us , and pains as of a woman in labor .

verses.z: 你們不要往田野去，也不要行在路上，因四圍有仇敵的刀劍和驚嚇。
verses.e: Don't go out into the field or walk by the way ; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side .

verses.z: 我民哪，應當腰束麻布，滾在灰中。你要悲傷，如喪獨生子痛痛哭號，因為滅命的要忽然臨到我們。
verses.e: Daughter of my people , clothe yourself with sackcloth , and wallow in ashes ! Mourn , as for an only son , most bitter lamentation , for the destroyer will suddenly come on us .

verses.z: 我使你在我民中為高臺，為保障，使你知道試驗他們的行動。
verses.e: " I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people , that you may know and try their way .

verses.z: 他們都是極悖逆的，往來讒謗人。他們是銅是鐵，都行壞事。
verses.e: They are all grievous rebels , going around to slander . They are bronze and iron . All of them deal corruptly .

verses.z: 風箱吹火，鉛被燒毀；他們煉而又煉，終是徒然；因為惡劣的還未除掉。
verses.e: The bellows blow fiercely . The lead is consumed in the fire . In vain they go on refining , for the wicked are not plucked away .

verses.z: 牧人必引他們的羊群到她那裏，在她周圍支搭帳棚，各在自己[所佔]之地[使羊]吃草。
verses.e: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her . They will pitch their tents against her all around . They will feed everyone in his place . "

verses.z: 人必稱他們為被棄的銀渣，因為耶和華已經棄掉他們。
verses.e: Men will call them rejected silver , because the LORD has rejected them . "

verses.z: 你們要準備攻擊她。起來吧，我們可以趁午時上去。哀哉！日已漸斜，晚影拖長了。
verses.e: " Prepare war against her ! Arise ! Let's go up at noon . Woe to us ! For the day declines , for the shadows of the evening are stretched out .

verses.z: 起來吧，我們夜間上去，毀壞她的宮殿。
verses.e: Arise ! Let's go up by night , and let's destroy her palaces . "

verses.z: 因為萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要砍伐樹木，築壘攻打耶路撒冷。這就是那該罰的城，其中盡是欺壓。
verses.e: For the LORD of Armies said , " Cut down trees , and cast up a mound against Jerusalem . This is the city to be visited . She is filled with oppression within herself .

verses.z: 井怎樣湧出水來，這城也照樣湧出惡來；在其間常聽見有強暴毀滅的事，病患損傷也常在我面前。
verses.e: As a well produces its waters , so she produces her wickedness . Violence and destruction is heard in her . Sickness and wounds are continually before me .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，你當受教，免得我心與你生疏，免得我使你荒涼，成為無人居住之地。
verses.e: Be instructed , Jerusalem , lest my soul be alienated from you , lest I make you a desolation , an uninhabited land . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華曾如此說：敵人必擄盡以色列剩下的民，如同摘淨葡萄一樣。你要像摘葡萄的人摘了又摘，回手放在筐子裏。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says , " They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine . Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到耶利米說：
verses.e: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying ,

verses.z: 且來到這稱為我名下的殿，在我面前敬拜；又說：『我們可以自由了。』你們這樣的舉動是要行那些可憎的事嗎？
verses.e: then come and stand before me in this house , which is called by my name , and say , ' We are delivered , ' that you may do all these abominations ?

verses.z: 這稱為我名下的殿在你們眼中豈可看為賊窩嗎？我都看見了。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Has this house , which is called by my name , become a den of robbers in your eyes ? Behold , I myself have seen it , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 你們且往示羅去，就是我先前立為我名的居所，察看我因這百姓以色列的罪惡向那地所行的如何。」
verses.e: " But go now to my place which was in Shiloh , where I caused my name to dwell at the first , and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「現在因你們行了這一切的事，我也從早起來警戒你們，你們卻不聽從；呼喚你們，你們卻不答應。
verses.e: Now , because you have done all these works , " says the LORD , " and I spoke to you , rising up early and speaking , but you didn't hear ; and I called you , but you didn't answer ;

verses.z: 所以我要向這稱為我名下、你們所倚靠的殿，與我所賜給你們和你們列祖的地施行，照我從前向示羅所行的一樣。
verses.e: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name , in which you trust , and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers , as I did to Shiloh .

verses.z: 我必將你們從我眼前趕出，正如趕出你們的眾弟兄，就是以法蓮的一切後裔。」
verses.e: I will cast you out of my sight , as I have cast out all your brothers , even the whole offspring of Ephraim .

verses.z: 「所以，你不要為這百姓祈禱；不要為他們呼求禱告，也不要向我為他們祈求，因我不聽允你。
verses.e: " Therefore don't pray for this people . Don't lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me ; for I will not hear you .

verses.z: 他們在猶大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上所行的，你沒有看見嗎？
verses.e: Don't you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem ?

verses.z: 孩子撿柴，父親燒火，婦女摶麵做餅，獻給天后，又向別神澆奠祭，惹我發怒。」
verses.e: The children gather wood , and the fathers kindle the fire , and the women knead the dough , to make cakes to the queen of the sky , and to pour out drink offerings to other gods , that they may provoke me to anger .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「他們豈是惹我發怒呢？不是自己惹禍，以致臉上慚愧嗎？」
verses.e: Do they provoke me to anger ? " says the LORD . " Don't they provoke themselves , to the confusion of their own faces ? "

verses.z: 「你當站在耶和華殿的門口，在那裏宣傳這話說：你們進這些門敬拜耶和華的一切猶大人，當聽耶和華的話。
verses.e: " Stand in the gate of the LORD's house , and proclaim this word there , and say , ' Hear the LORD's word , all you of Judah , who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 所以主耶和華如此說：「看哪，我必將我的怒氣和忿怒傾在這地方的人和牲畜身上，並田野的樹木和地裏的出產上，必[如火]着起，不能熄滅。」
verses.e: Therefore the Lord GOD says : " Behold , my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place , on man , on animal , on the trees of the field , and on the fruit of the ground ; and it will burn and will not be quenched . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：「你們將燔祭加在[平安]祭上，吃肉吧！
verses.e: The LORD of Armies , the God of Israel says : " Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat .

verses.z: 因為我將你們列祖從埃及地領出來的那日，燔祭[平安]祭的事我並沒有提說，也沒有吩咐他們。
verses.e: For I didn't speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices ;

verses.z: 我只吩咐他們這一件說：『你們當聽從我的話，我就作你們的上帝，你們也作我的子民。你們行我所吩咐的一切道，就可以得福。』
verses.e: but this thing I commanded them , saying , ' Listen to my voice , and I will be your God , and you shall be my people . Walk in all the way that I command you , that it may be well with you . '

verses.z: 他們卻不聽從，不側耳而聽，竟隨從[自己]的計謀和頑梗的惡心，向後不向前。
verses.e: But they didn't listen or turn their ear , but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart , and went backward , and not forward .

verses.z: 自從你們列祖出埃及地的那日，直到今日，我差遣我的僕人眾先知到你們那裏去，每日從早起來差遣他們。
verses.e: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day , I have sent to you all my servants the prophets , daily rising up early and sending them .

verses.z: 你們卻不聽從，不側耳而聽，竟硬着頸項行惡，比你們列祖更甚。
verses.e: Yet they didn't listen to me or incline their ear , but made their neck stiff . They did worse than their fathers .

verses.z: 「你要將這一切的話告訴他們，他們卻不聽從；呼喚他們，他們卻不答應。
verses.e: " You shall speak all these words to them , but they will not listen to you . You shall also call to them , but they will not answer you .

verses.z: 你要對他們說：這就是不聽從耶和華－他們上帝的話、不受教訓的國民；從他們的口中，誠實滅絕了。」
verses.e: You shall tell them , ' This is the nation that has not listened to the LORD their God's voice , nor received instruction . Truth has perished , and is cut off from their mouth . '

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，要剪髮拋棄，在淨光的高處舉哀；因為耶和華丟掉離棄了惹他忿怒的世代。
verses.e: Cut off your hair , and throw it away , and take up a lamentation on the bare heights ; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：你們改正行動作為，我就使你們在這地方仍然居住。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies , the God of Israel says , " Amend your ways and your doings , and I will cause you to dwell in this place .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「猶大人行我眼中看為惡的事，將可憎之物設立在稱為我名下的殿中，污穢這殿。
verses.e: " For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight , " says the LORD . " They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name , to defile it .

verses.z: 他們在欣嫩子谷建築陀斐特的邱壇，好在火中焚燒自己的兒女。這並不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。」
verses.e: They have built the high places of Topheth , which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom , to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire , which I didn't command , nor did it come into my mind .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「因此，日子將到，這地方不再稱為陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒稱為殺戮谷。因為要在陀斐特葬埋[屍首]，甚至無處[可葬]；
verses.e: Therefore behold , the days come " , says the LORD , " that it will no more be called ' Topheth ' or ' The valley of the son of Hinnom ' , but ' The valley of Slaughter ' ; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury .

verses.z: 並且這百姓的屍首必給空中的飛鳥和地上的野獸作食物，並無人鬨趕。
verses.e: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky , and for the animals of the earth . No one will frighten them away .

verses.z: 那時，我必使猶大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上，歡喜和快樂的聲音，新郎和新婦的聲音，都止息了，因為地必成為荒場。」
verses.e: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride ; for the land will become a waste . "

verses.z: 你們不要倚靠虛謊的話，說：『這些是耶和華的殿，是耶和華的殿，是耶和華的殿！』
verses.e: Don't trust in lying words , saying , ' The LORD's temple , the LORD's temple , the LORD's temple , are these . '

verses.z: 「你們若實在改正行動作為，在人和鄰舍中間誠然施行公平，
verses.e: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings , if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor ;

verses.z: 不欺壓寄居的和孤兒寡婦，在這地方不流無辜人的血，也不隨從別神陷害自己，
verses.e: if you don't oppress the foreigner , the fatherless , and the widow , and don't shed innocent blood in this place , and don't walk after other gods to your own hurt ,

verses.z: 我就使你們在這地方仍然居住，就是我古時所賜給你們列祖的地，直到永遠。
verses.e: then I will cause you to dwell in this place , in the land that I gave to your fathers , from of old even forever more .

verses.z: 「看哪，你們倚靠虛謊無益的話。
verses.e: Behold , you trust in lying words that can't profit .

verses.z: 你們偷盜，殺害，姦淫，起假誓，向巴力燒香，並隨從素不認識的別神，
verses.e: Will you steal , murder , commit adultery , swear falsely , burn incense to Baal , and walk after other gods that you have not known ,

verses.z: 耶和華說：「到那時，人必將猶大王的骸骨和他首領的骸骨、祭司的骸骨、先知的骸骨，並耶路撒冷居民的骸骨，都從墳墓中取出來，
verses.e: " At that time , " says the LORD , " they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah , the bones of his princes , the bones of the priests , the bones of the prophets , and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , out of their graves .

verses.z: 所以我必將他們的妻子給別人，將他們的田地給別人為業；因為他們從最小的到至大的都一味地貪婪，從先知到祭司都行事虛謊。
verses.e: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to those who will possess them . For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness ; from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely .

verses.z: 他們輕輕忽忽地醫治我百姓的損傷，說：平安了！平安了！其實沒有平安。
verses.e: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , " Peace , peace , " when there is no peace .

verses.z: 他們行可憎的事知道慚愧嗎？不然，他們毫不慚愧，也不知羞恥。因此他們必在仆倒的人中仆倒；我向他們討罪的時候，他們必致跌倒。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination ? No , they were not at all ashamed . They couldn't blush . Therefore they will fall among those who fall . In the time of their visitation they will be cast down , says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我必使他們全然滅絕；葡萄樹上必沒有葡萄，無花果樹上必沒有果子，葉子也必枯乾。我所賜給他們的，必離開他們過去。
verses.e: " ' I will utterly consume them , says the LORD . No grapes will be on the vine , no figs on the fig tree , and the leaf will fade . The things that I have given them will pass away from them . ' "

verses.z: 我們為何靜坐不動呢？我們當聚集，進入堅固城，在那裏靜默不言；因為耶和華－我們的上帝使我們靜默不言，又將苦膽水給我們喝，都因我們得罪了耶和華。
verses.e: " Why do we sit still ? Assemble yourselves ! Let's enter into the fortified cities , and let's be silent there ; for the LORD our God has put us to silence , and given us poisoned water to drink , because we have sinned against the LORD .

verses.z: 我們指望平安，卻得不着好處；指望痊癒的時候，不料，受了驚惶。
verses.e: We looked for peace , but no good came ; and for a time of healing , and behold , dismay !

verses.z: 聽見從但那裏敵人的馬噴鼻氣，他的壯馬發嘶聲，全地就都震動；因為他們來吞滅這地和其上所有的，吞滅這城與其中的居民。
verses.e: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan . The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones ; for they have come , and have devoured the land and all that is in it , the city and those who dwell therein . "

verses.z: 看哪，我必使毒蛇到你們中間，是不服法術的，必咬你們。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " For , behold , I will send serpents , adders among you , which will not be charmed ; and they will bite you , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 我有憂愁，願能自慰；我心在我裏面發昏。
verses.e: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow ! My heart is faint within me .

verses.z: 聽啊，是我百姓的哀聲從極遠之地而來，[說]：耶和華不在錫安嗎？錫安的王不在其中嗎？[耶和華說]：他們為甚麼以雕刻的偶像和外邦虛無[的神]惹我發怒呢？
verses.e: Behold , the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off : " Isn't the LORD in Zion ? Isn't her King in her ? " " Why have they provoked me to anger with their engraved images , and with foreign idols ? "

verses.z: 拋散在日頭、月亮，和天上眾星之下，就是他們從前所喜愛、所事奉、所隨從、所求問、所敬拜的。這些骸骨不再收殮，不再葬埋，必在地面上成為糞土；
verses.e: They will spread them before the sun , the moon , and all the army of the sky , which they have loved , which they have served , after which they have walked , which they have sought , and which they have worshiped . They will not be gathered or be buried . They will be like dung on the surface of the earth .

verses.z: 麥秋已過，夏令已完，我們還未得救！
verses.e: " The harvest is past . The summer has ended , and we are not saved . "

verses.z: [先知說]：因我百姓的損傷，我也受了損傷。我哀痛，驚惶將我抓住。
verses.e: For the hurt of the daughter of my people , I am hurt . I mourn . Dismay has taken hold of me .

verses.z: 在基列豈沒有乳香呢？在那裏豈沒有醫生呢？我百姓為何不得痊癒呢？
verses.e: Is there no balm in Gilead ? Is there no physician there ? Why then isn't the health of the daughter of my people recovered ?

verses.z: 並且這惡族所剩下的民在我所趕他們到的各處，寧可揀死不揀生。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
verses.e: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family , that remain in all the places where I have driven them , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 你要對他們說，耶和華如此說：人跌倒，不再起來嗎？人轉去，不再轉來嗎？
verses.e: " Moreover you shall tell them , ' The LORD says : " ' Do men fall , and not rise up again ? Does one turn away , and not return ?

verses.z: 這耶路撒冷的民，為何恆久背道呢？他們守定詭詐，不肯回頭。
verses.e: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding ? They cling to deceit . They refuse to return .

verses.z: 我留心聽，聽見他們說不正直的話。無人悔改惡行，說：我做的是甚麼呢？他們各人轉奔己路，如馬直闖戰場。
verses.e: I listened and heard , but they didn't say what is right . No one repents of his wickedness , saying , " What have I done ? " Everyone turns to his course , as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle .

verses.z: 空中的鸛鳥知道[來去的]定期；斑鳩燕子與白鶴也守候當來的時令；我的百姓卻不知道耶和華的法則。
verses.e: Yes , the stork in the sky knows her appointed times . The turtledove , the swallow , and the crane observe the time of their coming ; but my people don't know the LORD's law .

verses.z: 你們怎麼說：我們有智慧，耶和華的律法在我們這裏？看哪，文士的假筆舞弄虛假。
verses.e: " ' How do you say , " We are wise , and the LORD's law is with us " ? But , behold , the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie .

verses.z: 智慧人慚愧，驚惶，被擒拿；他們棄掉耶和華的話，心裏還有甚麼智慧呢？
verses.e: The wise men are disappointed . They are dismayed and trapped . Behold , they have rejected the LORD's word . What kind of wisdom is in them ?

verses.z: 但願我的頭為水，我的眼為淚的泉源，我好為我百姓中被殺的人晝夜哭泣。
verses.e: Oh that my head were waters , and my eyes a spring of tears , that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people !

verses.z: 我要為山嶺哭泣悲哀，為曠野的草場揚聲哀號；因為都已乾焦，甚至無人經過。人也聽不見牲畜鳴叫，空中的飛鳥和[地上的]野獸都已逃去。
verses.e: I will weep and wail for the mountains , and lament for the pastures of the wilderness , because they are burned up , so that no one passes through ; Men can't hear the voice of the livestock . Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled . They are gone .

verses.z: 我必使耶路撒冷變為亂堆，為野狗的住處，也必使猶大的城邑變為荒場，無人居住。
verses.e: " I will make Jerusalem heaps , a dwelling place of jackals . I will make the cities of Judah a desolation , without inhabitant . "

verses.z: 誰是智慧人，可以明白這事？耶和華的口向誰說過，使他可以傳說？遍地為何滅亡，乾焦好像曠野，甚至無人經過呢？
verses.e: Who is wise enough to understand this ? Who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken , that he may declare it ? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness , so that no one passes through ?

verses.z: 耶和華說：「因為這百姓離棄我在他們面前所設立的律法，沒有遵行，也沒有聽從我的話；
verses.e: The LORD says , " Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways ,

verses.z: 只隨從自己頑梗的心行事，照他們列祖所教訓的隨從眾巴力。」
verses.e: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals , which their fathers taught them . "

verses.z: 所以萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：「看哪，我必將茵蔯給這百姓吃，又將苦膽水給他們喝。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD of Armies , the God of Israel , says , " Behold , I will feed them , even this people , with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink .

verses.z: 我要把他們散在列邦中，就是他們和他們列祖素不認識的列邦。我也要使刀劍追殺他們，直到將他們滅盡。」
verses.e: I will scatter them also among the nations , whom neither they nor their fathers have known . I will send the sword after them , until I have consumed them . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們應當思想，將[善]唱哀歌的婦女召來，又打發人召善[哭]的婦女來，
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says , " Consider , and call for the mourning women , that they may come . Send for the skillful women , that they may come .

verses.z: 叫她們速速為我們舉哀，使我們眼淚汪汪，使我們的眼皮湧出水來。
verses.e: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us , that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters .

verses.z: 因為聽見哀聲出於錫安，[說]：我們怎樣敗落了！我們大大地慚愧！我們撇下地土；人也拆毀了我們的房屋。
verses.e: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion , ' How we are ruined ! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the land , because they have cast down our dwellings . ' "

verses.z: 惟願我在曠野有行路人住宿之處，使我可以離開我的民出去；因他們都是行姦淫的，是行詭詐的一黨。
verses.e: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men , that I might leave my people and go from them ! For they are all adulterers , an assembly of treacherous men .

verses.z: 婦女們哪，你們當聽耶和華的話，領受他口中的言語；又當教導你們的兒女舉哀，各人教導鄰舍唱哀歌。
verses.e: Yet hear the LORD's word , you women . Let your ear receive the word of his mouth . Teach your daughters wailing . Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation .

verses.z: 因為死亡上來，進了我們的窗戶，入了我們的宮殿；要從外邊剪除孩童，從街上剪除少年人。
verses.e: For death has come up into our windows . It has entered into our palaces to cut off the children from outside , and the young men from the streets .

verses.z: 你當說，耶和華如此說：人的屍首必倒在田野像糞土，又像收割的人遺落的一把[禾稼]，無人收取。
verses.e: Speak , " The LORD says , " ' The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field , and as the handful after the harvester . No one will gather them . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：「智慧人不要因他的智慧誇口，勇士不要因他的勇力誇口，財主不要因他的財物誇口。
verses.e: The LORD says , " Don't let the wise man glory in his wisdom . Don't let the mighty man glory in his might . Don't let the rich man glory in his riches .

verses.z: 誇口的卻因他有聰明，認識我是耶和華，又知道我喜悅在世上施行慈愛、公平，和公義，以此誇口。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: But let him who glories glory in this , that he has understanding , and knows me , that I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness , justice , and righteousness in the earth , for I delight in these things , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「看哪，日子將到，我要刑罰一切受過割禮、[心]卻未受割禮的，
verses.e: " Behold , the days come , " says the LORD , " that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh :

verses.z: 就是埃及、猶大、以東、亞捫人、摩押人，和一切住在曠野剃周圍[頭髮]的；因為列國人都沒有受割禮，以色列人心中也沒有受割禮。」
verses.e: Egypt , Judah , Edom , the children of Ammon , Moab , and all who have the corners of their hair cut off , who dwell in the wilderness , for all the nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart . "

verses.z: 他們彎起舌頭像弓一樣，為要說謊話。他們在國中增長勢力，不是為行誠實，乃是惡上加惡，並不認識我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: " They bend their tongue , as their bow , for falsehood . They have grown strong in the land , but not for truth ; for they proceed from evil to evil , and they don't know me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 你們各人當謹防鄰舍，不可信靠弟兄；因為弟兄盡行欺騙，鄰舍都往來讒謗人。
verses.e: " Everyone beware of his neighbor , and don't trust in any brother ; for every brother will utterly supplant , and every neighbor will go around like a slanderer .

verses.z: 他們各人欺哄鄰舍，不說真話；他們教舌頭學習說謊，勞勞碌碌地作孽。
verses.e: Friends deceive each other , and will not speak the truth . They have taught their tongue to speak lies . They weary themselves committing iniquity .

verses.z: 你的住處在詭詐的人中；他們因行詭詐，不肯認識我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit . Through deceit , they refuse to know me , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 所以萬軍之耶和華如此說：看哪，我要將他們鎔化熬煉；不然，我因我百姓[的罪]該怎樣行呢？
verses.e: Therefore the LORD of Armies says , " Behold , I will melt them and test them ; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people ?

verses.z: 他們的舌頭是毒箭，說話詭詐；人與鄰舍口說和平話，心卻謀害他。
verses.e: Their tongue is a deadly arrow . It speaks deceit . One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth , but in his heart , he waits to ambush him .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我豈不因這些事討他們的罪呢？豈不報復這樣的國民呢？
verses.e: Shouldn't I punish them for these things ? " says the LORD . " Shouldn't my soul be avenged on a nation such as this ?

verses.z: 太初有道，道與上帝同在，道就是上帝。
verses.e: In the beginning was the Word , and the Word was with God , and the Word was God .

verses.z: 他在世界，世界也是藉着他造的，世界卻不認識他。
verses.e: He was in the world , and the world was made through him , and the world didn't recognize him .

verses.z: 他到自己的地方來，自己的人倒不接待他。
verses.e: He came to his own , and those who were his own didn't receive him .

verses.z: 凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就賜他們權柄作上帝的兒女。
verses.e: But as many as received him , to them he gave the right to become God's children , to those who believe in his name :

verses.z: 這等人不是從血氣生的，不是從情慾生的，也不是從人意生的，乃是從上帝生的。
verses.e: who were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .

verses.z: 道成了肉身，住在我們中間，充充滿滿地有恩典有真理。我們也見過他的榮光，正是父獨生子的榮光。
verses.e: The Word became flesh and lived among us . We saw his glory , such glory as of the only born Son of the Father , full of grace and truth .

verses.z: 約翰為他作見證，喊着說：「這就是我曾說：『那在我以後來的，反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』」
verses.e: John testified about him . He cried out , saying , " This was he of whom I said , ' He who comes after me has surpassed me , for he was before me . ' "

verses.z: 從他豐滿[的恩典]裏，我們都領受了，而且恩上加恩。
verses.e: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace .

verses.z: 律法本是藉着摩西傳的；恩典和真理都是由耶穌基督來的。
verses.e: For the law was given through Moses . Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 從來沒有人看見上帝，只有在父懷裏的獨生子將他表明出來。
verses.e: No one has seen God at any time . The only born Son , who is in the bosom of the Father , has declared him .

verses.z: 約翰所作的見證記在下面：猶太人從耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到約翰那裏，問他說：「你是誰？」
verses.e: This is John's testimony , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , " Who are you ? "

verses.z: 這道太初與上帝同在。
verses.e: The same was in the beginning with God .

verses.z: 他就明說，並不隱瞞，明說：「我不是基督。」
verses.e: He declared , and didn't deny , but he declared , " I am not the Christ . "

verses.z: 他們又問他說：「這樣，你是誰呢？是以利亞嗎？」他說：「我不是。」「是那先知嗎？」他回答說：「不是。」
verses.e: They asked him , " What then ? Are you Elijah ? " He said , " I am not . " " Are you the prophet ? " He answered , " No . "

verses.z: 於是他們說：「你到底是誰，叫我們好回覆差我們來的人。你自己說，你是誰？」
verses.e: They said therefore to him , " Who are you ? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us . What do you say about yourself ? "

verses.z: 他說：「我就是那在曠野有人聲喊着說：『修直主的道路』，正如先知以賽亞所說的。」
verses.e: He said , " I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , ' Make straight the way of the Lord , ' as Isaiah the prophet said . "

verses.z: 那些人是法利賽人差來的；
verses.e: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees .

verses.z: 他們就問他說：「你既不是基督，不是以利亞，也不是那先知，為甚麼施洗呢？」
verses.e: They asked him , " Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ , nor Elijah , nor the prophet ? "

verses.z: 約翰回答說：「我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你們中間，是你們不認識的，
verses.e: John answered them , " I baptize in water , but among you stands one whom you don't know .

verses.z: 就是那在我以後來的，我給他解鞋帶也不配。」
verses.e: He is the one who comes after me , who is preferred before me , whose sandal strap I'm not worthy to loosen . "

verses.z: 這是在約旦河外伯大尼，約翰施洗的地方作的見證。
verses.e: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan , where John was baptizing .

verses.z: 次日，約翰看見耶穌來到他那裏，就說：「看哪，上帝的羔羊，除去世人罪孽的！
verses.e: The next day , he saw Jesus coming to him , and said , " Behold , the Lamb of God , who takes away the sin of the world !

verses.z: 萬物是藉着他造的；凡被造的，沒有一樣不是藉着他造的。
verses.e: All things were made through him . Without him , nothing was made that has been made .

verses.z: 這就是我曾說：『有一位在我以後來、反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』
verses.e: This is he of whom I said , ' After me comes a man who is preferred before me , for he was before me . '

verses.z: 我先前不認識他，如今我來用水施洗，為要叫他顯明給以色列人。」
verses.e: I didn't know him , but for this reason I came baptizing in water , that he would be revealed to Israel . "

verses.z: 約翰又作見證說：「我曾看見聖靈，彷彿鴿子從天降下，住在他的身上。
verses.e: John testified , saying , " I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven , and it remained on him .

verses.z: 我先前不認識他，只是那差我來用水施洗的、對我說：『你看見聖靈降下來，住在誰的身上，誰就是用聖靈施洗的。』
verses.e: I didn't recognize him , but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me , ' On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit . '

verses.z: 我看見了，就證明這是上帝的兒子。」
verses.e: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God . "

verses.z: 再次日，約翰同兩個門徒站在那裏。
verses.e: Again , the next day , John was standing with two of his disciples ,

verses.z: 他見耶穌行走，就說：「看哪，這是上帝的羔羊！」
verses.e: and he looked at Jesus as he walked , and said , " Behold , the Lamb of God ! "

verses.z: 兩個門徒聽見他的話，就跟從了耶穌。
verses.e: The two disciples heard him speak , and they followed Jesus .

verses.z: 耶穌轉過身來，看見他們跟着，就問他們說：「你們要甚麼？」他們說：「拉比，在哪裏住？」（拉比翻出來就是夫子。）
verses.e: Jesus turned and saw them following , and said to them , " What are you looking for ? " They said to him , " Rabbi " ( which is to say , being interpreted , Teacher ) , " where are you staying ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們來看。」他們就去看他在哪裏住，這一天便與他同住；那時約有申正了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Come and see . " They came and saw where he was staying , and they stayed with him that day . It was about the tenth hour .

verses.z: 生命在他裏頭，這生命就是人的光。
verses.e: In him was life , and the life was the light of men .

verses.z: 聽見約翰的話跟從耶穌的那兩個人，一個是西門‧彼得的兄弟安得烈。
verses.e: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew , Simon Peter's brother .

verses.z: 他先找着自己的哥哥西門，對他說：「我們遇見彌賽亞了。」（彌賽亞翻出來就是基督。）
verses.e: He first found his own brother , Simon , and said to him , " We have found the Messiah ! " ( which is , being interpreted , Christ ) .

verses.z: 於是領他去見耶穌。耶穌看着他，說：「你是約翰的兒子西門，你要稱為磯法。」（磯法翻出來就是彼得。）
verses.e: He brought him to Jesus . Jesus looked at him and said , " You are Simon the son of Jonah . You shall be called Cephas " ( which is by interpretation , Peter ) .

verses.z: 又次日，耶穌想要往加利利去，遇見腓力，就對他說：「來跟從我吧。」
verses.e: On the next day , he was determined to go out into Galilee , and he found Philip . Jesus said to him , " Follow me . "

verses.z: 這腓力是伯賽大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。
verses.e: Now Philip was from Bethsaida , the city of Andrew and Peter .

verses.z: 腓力找着拿但業，對他說：「摩西在律法上所寫的和眾先知所記的那一位，我們遇見了，就是約瑟的兒子拿撒勒人耶穌。」
verses.e: Philip found Nathanael , and said to him , " We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets , wrote : Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph . "

verses.z: 拿但業對他說：「拿撒勒還能出甚麼好的嗎？」腓力說：「你來看！」
verses.e: Nathanael said to him , " Can any good thing come out of Nazareth ? " Philip said to him , " Come and see . "

verses.z: 耶穌看見拿但業來，就指着他說：「看哪，這是個真以色列人，他心裏是沒有詭詐的。」
verses.e: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and said about him , " Behold , an Israelite indeed , in whom is no deceit ! "

verses.z: 拿但業對耶穌說：「你從哪裏知道我呢？」耶穌回答說：「腓力還沒有招呼你，你在無花果樹底下，我就看見你了。」
verses.e: Nathanael said to him , " How do you know me ? " Jesus answered him , " Before Philip called you , when you were under the fig tree , I saw you . "

verses.z: 拿但業說：「拉比，你是上帝的兒子，你是以色列的王！」
verses.e: Nathanael answered him , " Rabbi , you are the Son of God ! You are King of Israel ! "

verses.z: 光照在黑暗裏，黑暗卻不接受光。
verses.e: The light shines in the darkness , and the darkness hasn't overcome it .

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「因為我說『在無花果樹底下看見你』，你就信嗎？你將要看見比這更大的事」；
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Because I told you , ' I saw you underneath the fig tree , ' do you believe ? You will see greater things than these ! "

verses.z: 又說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們將要看見天開了，上帝的使者上去下來在人子身上。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Most certainly , I tell you all , hereafter you will see heaven opened , and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man . "

verses.z: 有一個人，是從上帝那裏差來的，名叫約翰。
verses.e: There came a man sent from God , whose name was John .

verses.z: 這人來，為要作見證，就是為光作見證，叫眾人因他可以信。
verses.e: The same came as a witness , that he might testify about the light , that all might believe through him .

verses.z: 他不是那光，乃是要為光作見證。
verses.e: He was not the light , but was sent that he might testify about the light .

verses.z: 那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。
verses.e: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world .

verses.z: 「我實實在在地告訴你們，人進羊圈，不從門進去，倒從別處爬進去，那人就是賊，就是強盜。
verses.e: " Most certainly , I tell you , one who doesn't enter by the door into the sheep fold , but climbs up some other way , is a thief and a robber .

verses.z: 盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊得生命，並且得的更豐盛。
verses.e: The thief only comes to steal , kill , and destroy . I came that they may have life , and may have it abundantly .

verses.z: 我是好牧人；好牧人為羊捨命。
verses.e: " I am the good shepherd . The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep .

verses.z: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看見狼來，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，趕散了羊群。
verses.e: He who is a hired hand , and not a shepherd , who doesn't own the sheep , sees the wolf coming , leaves the sheep , and flees . The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them .

verses.z: 雇工[逃走]，因他是雇工，並不顧念羊。
verses.e: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn't care for the sheep .

verses.z: 我是好牧人；我認識我的羊，我的羊也認識我，
verses.e: I am the good shepherd . I know my own , and I'm known by my own ;

verses.z: 正如父認識我，我也認識父一樣；並且我為羊捨命。
verses.e: even as the Father knows me , and I know the Father . I lay down my life for the sheep .

verses.z: 我另外有羊，不是這圈裏的；我必須領他們來，他們也要聽我的聲音，並且要合成一群，歸一個牧人了。
verses.e: I have other sheep which are not of this fold . I must bring them also , and they will hear my voice . They will become one flock with one shepherd .

verses.z: 我父愛我；因我將命捨去，好再取回來。
verses.e: Therefore the Father loves me , because I lay down my life , that I may take it again .

verses.z: 沒有人奪我的命去，是我自己捨的。我有權柄捨了，也有權柄取回來。這是我從我父所受的命令。」
verses.e: No one takes it away from me , but I lay it down by myself . I have power to lay it down , and I have power to take it again . I received this commandment from my Father . "

verses.z: 猶太人為這些話又起了紛爭。
verses.e: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words .

verses.z: 從門進去的，才是羊的牧人。
verses.e: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep .

verses.z: 內中有好些人說：「他是被鬼附着，而且瘋了，為甚麼聽他呢？」
verses.e: Many of them said , " He has a demon and is insane ! Why do you listen to him ? "

verses.z: 又有人說：「這不是鬼附之人所說的話。鬼豈能叫瞎子的眼睛開了呢？」
verses.e: Others said , " These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon . It isn't possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind , is it ? "

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷有修殿節，是冬天的時候。
verses.e: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 耶穌在殿裏所羅門的廊下行走。
verses.e: It was winter , and Jesus was walking in the temple , in Solomon's porch .

verses.z: 猶太人圍着他，說：「你叫我們猶疑不定到幾時呢？你若是基督，就明明地告訴我們。」
verses.e: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him , " How long will you hold us in suspense ? If you are the Christ , tell us plainly . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我已經告訴你們，你們不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以為我作見證；
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " I told you , and you don't believe . The works that I do in my Father's name , these testify about me .

verses.z: 只是你們不信，因為你們不是我的羊。
verses.e: But you don't believe , because you are not of my sheep , as I told you .

verses.z: 我的羊聽我的聲音，我也認識他們，他們也跟着我。
verses.e: My sheep hear my voice , and I know them , and they follow me .

verses.z: 我又賜給他們永生；他們永不滅亡，誰也不能從我手裏把他們奪去。
verses.e: I give eternal life to them . They will never perish , and no one will snatch them out of my hand .

verses.z: 我父把羊賜給我，他比萬有都大，誰也不能從我父手裏把他們奪去。
verses.e: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all . No one is able to snatch them out of my Father's hand .

verses.z: 看門的就給他開門；羊也聽他的聲音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊領出來。
verses.e: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him , and the sheep listen to his voice . He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out .

verses.z: 我與父原為一。」
verses.e: I and the Father are one . "

verses.z: 猶太人又拿起石頭來要打他。
verses.e: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「我從父顯出許多善事給你們看，你們是為哪一件拿石頭打我呢？」
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " I have shown you many good works from my Father . For which of those works do you stone me ? "

verses.z: 猶太人回答說：「我們不是為善事拿石頭打你，是為你說僭妄的話；又為你是個人，反將自己當作上帝。」
verses.e: The Jews answered him , " We don't stone you for a good work , but for blasphemy , because you , being a man , make yourself God . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們的律法上豈不是寫着『我曾說你們是神』嗎？
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Isn't it written in your law , ' I said , you are gods ' ?

verses.z: 經上的話是不能廢的；若那些承受上帝道的人尚且稱為神，
verses.e: If he called them gods , to whom the word of God came ( and the Scripture can't be broken ) ,

verses.z: 父所分別為聖、又差到世間來的，他自稱是上帝的兒子，你們還向他說『你說僭妄的話』嗎？
verses.e: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world , ' You blaspheme , ' because I said , ' I am the Son of God ' ?

verses.z: 我若不行我父的事，你們就不必信我；
verses.e: If I don't do the works of my Father , don't believe me .

verses.z: 我若行了，你們縱然不信我，也當信這些事，叫你們又知道又明白父在我裏面，我也在父裏面。」
verses.e: But if I do them , though you don't believe me , believe the works , that you may know and believe that the Father is in me , and I in the Father . "

verses.z: 他們又要拿他，他卻逃出他們的手走了。
verses.e: They sought again to seize him , and he went out of their hand .

verses.z: 既放出自己的羊來，就在前頭走，羊也跟着他，因為認得他的聲音。
verses.e: Whenever he brings out his own sheep , he goes before them ; and the sheep follow him , for they know his voice .

verses.z: 耶穌又往約旦河外去，到了約翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那裏。
verses.e: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first , and he stayed there .

verses.z: 有許多人來到他那裏。他們說：「約翰一件神蹟沒有行過，但約翰指着這人所說的一切話都是真的。」
verses.e: Many came to him . They said , " John indeed did no sign , but everything that John said about this man is true . "

verses.z: 在那裏，信耶穌的人就多了。
verses.e: Many believed in him there .

verses.z: 羊不跟着生人；因為不認得他的聲音，必要逃跑。」
verses.e: They will by no means follow a stranger , but will flee from him ; for they don't know the voice of strangers . "

verses.z: 耶穌將這比喻告訴他們，但他們不明白所說的是甚麼意思。
verses.e: Jesus spoke this parable to them , but they didn't understand what he was telling them .

verses.z: 所以，耶穌又對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，我就是羊的門。
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them again , " Most certainly , I tell you , I am the sheep's door .

verses.z: 凡在我以先來的都是賊，是強盜；羊卻不聽他們。
verses.e: All who came before me are thieves and robbers , but the sheep didn't listen to them .

verses.z: 我就是門；凡從我進來的，必然得救，並且出入得草吃。
verses.e: I am the door . If anyone enters in by me , he will be saved , and will go in and go out and will find pasture .

verses.z: 有一個患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是馬利亞和她姊姊馬大的村莊。
verses.e: Now a certain man was sick , Lazarus from Bethany , of the village of Mary and her sister , Martha .

verses.z: 若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因為他沒有光。」
verses.e: But if a man walks in the night , he stumbles , because the light isn't in him . "

verses.z: 耶穌說了這話，隨後對他們說：「我們的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。」
verses.e: He said these things , and after that , he said to them , " Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep , but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep . "

verses.z: 門徒說：「主啊，他若睡了，就必好了。」
verses.e: The disciples therefore said , " Lord , if he has fallen asleep , he will recover . "

verses.z: 耶穌這話是指着他死說的，他們卻以為是說照常睡了。
verses.e: Now Jesus had spoken of his death , but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep .

verses.z: 耶穌就明明地告訴他們說：「拉撒路死了。
verses.e: So Jesus said to them plainly then , " Lazarus is dead .

verses.z: 我沒有在那裏就歡喜，這是為你們的緣故，好叫你們相信。[如今]我們可以往他那裏去吧。」
verses.e: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there , so that you may believe . Nevertheless , let's go to him . "

verses.z: 多馬，又稱為低土馬，就對那同作門徒的說：「我們也去和他同死吧。」
verses.e: Thomas therefore , who is called Didymus , said to his fellow disciples , " Let's also go , that we may die with him . "

verses.z: 耶穌到了，就知道拉撒路在墳墓裏已經四天了。
verses.e: So when Jesus came , he found that he had been in the tomb four days already .

verses.z: 伯大尼離耶路撒冷不遠，約有六里路。
verses.e: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem , about fifteen stadia away .

verses.z: 有好些猶太人來看馬大和馬利亞，要為她們的兄弟安慰她們。
verses.e: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary , to console them concerning their brother .

verses.z: 這馬利亞就是那用香膏抹主，又用頭髮擦他腳的；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。
verses.e: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair , whose brother Lazarus was sick .

verses.z: 馬大聽見耶穌來了，就出去迎接他；馬利亞卻仍然坐在家裏。
verses.e: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming , she went and met him , but Mary stayed in the house .

verses.z: 馬大對耶穌說：「主啊，你若早在這裏，我兄弟必不死。
verses.e: Therefore Martha said to Jesus , " Lord , if you would have been here , my brother wouldn't have died .

verses.z: 就是現在，我也知道，你無論向上帝求甚麼，上帝也必賜給你。」
verses.e: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God , God will give you . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你兄弟必然復活。」
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Your brother will rise again . "

verses.z: 馬大說：「我知道在末日復活的時候，他必復活。」
verses.e: Martha said to him , " I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day . "

verses.z: 耶穌對她說：「復活在我，生命也在我。信我的人雖然死了，也必復活；
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " I am the resurrection and the life . He who believes in me will still live , even if he dies .

verses.z: 凡活着信我的人必永遠不死。你信這話嗎？」
verses.e: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die . Do you believe this ? "

verses.z: 馬大說：「主啊，是的，我信你是基督，是上帝的兒子，就是那要臨到世界的。」
verses.e: She said to him , " Yes , Lord . I have come to believe that you are the Christ , God's Son , he who comes into the world . "

verses.z: 馬大說了這話，就回去暗暗地叫她妹子馬利亞，說：「夫子來了，叫你。」
verses.e: When she had said this , she went away and called Mary , her sister , secretly , saying , " The Teacher is here and is calling you . "

verses.z: 馬利亞聽見了，就急忙起來，到耶穌那裏去。
verses.e: When she heard this , she arose quickly and went to him .

verses.z: 她姊妹兩個就打發人去見耶穌，說：「主啊，你所愛的人病了。」
verses.e: The sisters therefore sent to him , saying , " Lord , behold , he for whom you have great affection is sick . "

verses.z: 那時，耶穌還沒有進村子，仍在馬大迎接他的地方。
verses.e: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village , but was in the place where Martha met him .

verses.z: 那些同馬利亞在家裏安慰她的猶太人，見她急忙起來出去，就跟着她，以為她要往墳墓那裏去哭。
verses.e: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her , when they saw Mary , that she rose up quickly and went out , followed her , saying , " She is going to the tomb to weep there . "

verses.z: 馬利亞到了耶穌那裏，看見他，就俯伏在他腳前，說：「主啊，你若早在這裏，我兄弟必不死。」
verses.e: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him , she fell down at his feet , saying to him , " Lord , if you would have been here , my brother wouldn't have died . "

verses.z: 耶穌看見她哭，並看見與她同來的猶太人也哭，就心裏悲歎，又甚憂愁，
verses.e: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews weeping who came with her , he groaned in the spirit and was troubled ,

verses.z: 便說：「你們把他安放在哪裏？」他們回答說：「請主來看。」
verses.e: and said , " Where have you laid him ? " They told him , " Lord , come and see . "

verses.z: 耶穌哭了。
verses.e: Jesus wept .

verses.z: 猶太人就說：「你看他愛這人是何等懇切。」
verses.e: The Jews therefore said , " See how much affection he had for him ! "

verses.z: 其中有人說：「他既然開了瞎子的眼睛，豈不能叫這人不死嗎？」
verses.e: Some of them said , " Couldn't this man , who opened the eyes of him who was blind , have also kept this man from dying ? "

verses.z: 耶穌又心裏悲歎，來到墳墓前；那墳墓是個洞，有一塊石頭擋着。
verses.e: Jesus therefore , again groaning in himself , came to the tomb . Now it was a cave , and a stone lay against it .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們把石頭挪開。」那死人的姊姊馬大對他說：「主啊，他現在必是臭了，因為他[死了]已經四天了。」
verses.e: Jesus said , " Take away the stone . " Martha , the sister of him who was dead , said to him , " Lord , by this time there is a stench , for he has been dead four days . "

verses.z: 耶穌聽見，就說：「這病不至於死，乃是為上帝的榮耀，叫上帝的兒子因此得榮耀。」
verses.e: But when Jesus heard it , he said , " This sickness is not to death , but for the glory of God , that God's Son may be glorified by it . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我不是對你說過，你若信，就必看見上帝的榮耀嗎？」
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Didn't I tell you that if you believed , you would see God's glory ? "

verses.z: 他們就把石頭挪開。耶穌舉目[望天]，說：「父啊，我感謝你，因為你已經聽我。
verses.e: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying . Jesus lifted up his eyes and said , " Father , I thank you that you listened to me .

verses.z: 我也知道你常聽我，但我說這話是為周圍站着的眾人，叫他們信是你差了我來。」
verses.e: I know that you always listen to me , but because of the multitude standing around I said this , that they may believe that you sent me . "

verses.z: 說了這話，就大聲呼叫說：「拉撒路出來！」
verses.e: When he had said this , he cried with a loud voice , " Lazarus , come out ! "

verses.z: 那死人就出來了，手腳裹着布，臉上包着手巾。耶穌對他們說：「解開，叫他走！」
verses.e: He who was dead came out , bound hand and foot with wrappings , and his face was wrapped around with a cloth . Jesus said to them , " Free him , and let him go . "

verses.z: 那些來看馬利亞的猶太人見了耶穌所做的事，就多有信他的；
verses.e: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him .

verses.z: 但其中也有去見法利賽人的，將耶穌所做的事告訴他們。
verses.e: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done .

verses.z: 祭司長和法利賽人聚集公會，說：「這人行好些神蹟，我們怎麼辦呢？
verses.e: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council , and said , " What are we doing ? For this man does many signs .

verses.z: 若這樣由着他，人人都要信他，羅馬人也要來奪我們的地土和我們的百姓。」
verses.e: If we leave him alone like this , everyone will believe in him , and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation . "

verses.z: 內中有一個人，名叫該亞法，本年作大祭司，對他們說：「你們不知道甚麼。
verses.e: But a certain one of them , Caiaphas , being high priest that year , said to them , " You know nothing at all ,

verses.z: 耶穌素來愛馬大和她妹子並拉撒路。
verses.e: Now Jesus loved Martha , and her sister , and Lazarus .

verses.z: 獨不想一個人替百姓死，免得通國滅亡，就是你們的益處。」
verses.e: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation not perish . "

verses.z: 他這話不是出於自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以預言耶穌將要替這一國死；
verses.e: Now he didn't say this of himself , but being high priest that year , he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation ,

verses.z: 也不但替這一國死，並要將上帝四散的子民都聚集歸一。
verses.e: and not for the nation only , but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad .

verses.z: 從那日起，他們就商議要殺耶穌。
verses.e: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death .

verses.z: 所以，耶穌不再顯然行在猶太人中間，就離開那裏往靠近曠野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法蓮，就在那裏和門徒同住。
verses.e: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews , but departed from there into the country near the wilderness , to a city called Ephraim . He stayed there with his disciples .

verses.z: 猶太人的逾越[節]近了，有許多人從鄉下上耶路撒冷去，要在節前潔淨自己。
verses.e: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand . Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover , to purify themselves .

verses.z: 他們就尋找耶穌，站在殿裏彼此說：「你們的意思如何，他不來過節嗎？」
verses.e: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple , " What do you think — that he isn't coming to the feast at all ? "

verses.z: 那時，祭司長和法利賽人早已吩咐說，若有人知道耶穌在哪裏，就要報明，好去拿他。
verses.e: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was , he should report it , that they might seize him .

verses.z: 聽見拉撒路病了，就在所居之地仍住了兩天。
verses.e: When therefore he heard that he was sick , he stayed two days in the place where he was .

verses.z: 然後對門徒說：「我們再往猶太去吧。」
verses.e: Then after this he said to the disciples , " Let's go into Judea again . "

verses.z: 門徒說：「拉比，猶太人近來要拿石頭打你，你還往那裏去嗎？」
verses.e: The disciples asked him , " Rabbi , the Jews were just trying to stone you . Are you going there again ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「白日不是有十二小時嗎？人在白日走路，就不致跌倒，因為看見這世上的光。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " Aren't there twelve hours of daylight ? If a man walks in the day , he doesn't stumble , because he sees the light of this world .

verses.z: 逾越節前六日，耶穌來到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路從死裏復活之處。
verses.e: Then , six days before the Passover , Jesus came to Bethany , where Lazarus was , who had been dead , whom he raised from the dead .

verses.z: 但祭司長商議連拉撒路也要殺了；
verses.e: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also ,

verses.z: 因有好些猶太人為拉撒路的緣故，回去信了耶穌。
verses.e: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus .

verses.z: 第二天，有許多上來過節的人聽見耶穌將到耶路撒冷，
verses.e: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast . When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,

verses.z: 就拿着棕樹枝出去迎接他，喊着說：和散那！奉主名來的以色列王是應當稱頌的！
verses.e: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him , and cried out , " Hosanna ! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord , the King of Israel ! "

verses.z: 耶穌得了一個驢駒，就騎上，如[經]上所記的說：
verses.e: Jesus , having found a young donkey , sat on it . As it is written ,

verses.z: 錫安的民哪，不要懼怕！你的王騎着驢駒來了。
verses.e: " Don't be afraid , daughter of Zion . Behold , your King comes , sitting on a donkey's colt . "

verses.z: 這些事門徒起先不明白，等到耶穌得了榮耀以後才想起這話是指着他寫的，並且眾人果然向他這樣行了。
verses.e: His disciples didn't understand these things at first , but when Jesus was glorified , then they remembered that these things were written about him , and that they had done these things to him .

verses.z: 當耶穌呼喚拉撒路，叫他從死復活出墳墓的時候，同耶穌在那裏的眾人就作見證。
verses.e: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it .

verses.z: 眾人因聽見耶穌行了這神蹟，就去迎接他。
verses.e: For this cause also the multitude went and met him , because they heard that he had done this sign .

verses.z: 法利賽人彼此說：「看哪，你們是徒勞無益，世人都隨從他去了。」
verses.e: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves , " See how you accomplish nothing . Behold , the world has gone after him . "

verses.z: 有人在那裏給耶穌預備筵席；馬大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶穌坐席的人中。
verses.e: So they made him a supper there . Martha served , but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him .

verses.z: 那時，上來過節禮拜的人中，有幾個希臘人。
verses.e: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast .

verses.z: 他們來見加利利、伯賽大的腓力，求他說：「先生，我們願意見耶穌。」
verses.e: Therefore , these came to Philip , who was from Bethsaida of Galilee , and asked him , saying , " Sir , we want to see Jesus . "

verses.z: 腓力去告訴安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告訴耶穌。
verses.e: Philip came and told Andrew , and in turn , Andrew came with Philip , and they told Jesus .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「人子得榮耀的時候到了。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified .
