verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，一粒麥子不落在地裏死了，仍舊是一粒，若是死了，就結出許多子粒來。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies , it remains by itself alone . But if it dies , it bears much fruit .

verses.z: 愛惜自己生命的，就失喪生命；在這世上恨惡自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。
verses.e: He who loves his life will lose it . He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life .

verses.z: 若有人服事我，就當跟從我；我在哪裏，服事我的人也要在那裏；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。」
verses.e: If anyone serves me , let him follow me . Where I am , there my servant will also be . If anyone serves me , the Father will honor him .

verses.z: 「我現在心裏憂愁，我說甚麼才好呢？父啊，救我脫離這時候；但我原是為這時候來的。
verses.e: " Now my soul is troubled . What shall I say ? ' Father , save me from this time ' ? But I came to this time for this cause .

verses.z: 父啊，願你榮耀你的名！」當時就有聲音從天上來，說：「我已經榮耀了我的名，還要再榮耀。」
verses.e: Father , glorify your name ! " Then a voice came out of the sky , saying , " I have both glorified it and will glorify it again . "

verses.z: 站在旁邊的眾人聽見，就說：「打雷了。」還有人說：「有天使對他說話。」
verses.e: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered . Others said , " An angel has spoken to him . "

verses.z: 馬利亞就拿着一斤極貴的真哪噠香膏，抹耶穌的腳，又用自己頭髮去擦，屋裏就滿了膏的香氣。
verses.e: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard , very precious , and anointed Jesus ' feet and wiped his feet with her hair . The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這聲音不是為我，是為你們來的。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " This voice hasn't come for my sake , but for your sakes .

verses.z: 現在這世界受審判，這世界的王要被趕出去。
verses.e: Now is the judgment of this world . Now the prince of this world will be cast out .

verses.z: 我若從地上被舉起來，就要吸引萬人來歸我。」
verses.e: And I , if I am lifted up from the earth , will draw all people to myself . "

verses.z: 耶穌這話原是指着自己將要怎樣死說的。
verses.e: But he said this , signifying by what kind of death he should die .

verses.z: 眾人回答說：「我們聽見律法上有話說，基督是永存的，你怎麼說『人子必須被舉起來』呢？這人子是誰呢？」
verses.e: The multitude answered him , " We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever . How do you say , ' The Son of Man must be lifted up ' ? Who is this Son of Man ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「光在你們中間還有不多的時候，應當趁着有光行走，免得黑暗臨到你們；那在黑暗裏行走的，不知道往何處去。
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them , " Yet a little while the light is with you . Walk while you have the light , that darkness doesn't overtake you . He who walks in the darkness doesn't know where he is going .

verses.z: 你們應當趁着有光，信從這光，使你們成為光明之子。」耶穌說了這話，就離開他們隱藏了。
verses.e: While you have the light , believe in the light , that you may become children of light . " Jesus said these things , and he departed and hid himself from them .

verses.z: 他雖然在他們面前行了許多神蹟，他們還是不信他。
verses.e: But though he had done so many signs before them , yet they didn't believe in him ,

verses.z: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：主啊，我們所傳的有誰信呢？主的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
verses.e: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled , which he spoke : " Lord , who has believed our report ? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed ? "

verses.z: 他們所以不能信，因為以賽亞又說：
verses.e: For this cause they couldn't believe , for Isaiah said again :

verses.z: 有一個門徒，就是那將要賣耶穌的加略人猶大，
verses.e: Then Judas Iscariot , Simon's son , one of his disciples , who would betray him , said ,

verses.z: 主叫他們瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他們眼睛看見，心裏明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。
verses.e: " He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart , lest they should see with their eyes , and perceive with their heart , and would turn , and I would heal them . "

verses.z: 以賽亞因為看見他的榮耀，就指着他說這話。
verses.e: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory , and spoke of him .

verses.z: 雖然如此，官長中卻有好些信他的，只因法利賽人的緣故，就不承認，恐怕被趕出會堂。
verses.e: Nevertheless , even many of the rulers believed in him , but because of the Pharisees they didn't confess it , so that they wouldn't be put out of the synagogue ,

verses.z: 這是因他們愛人的榮耀過於愛上帝的榮耀。
verses.e: for they loved men's praise more than God's praise .

verses.z: 耶穌大聲說：「信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我來的。
verses.e: Jesus cried out and said , " Whoever believes in me , believes not in me , but in him who sent me .

verses.z: 人看見我，就是看見那差我來的。
verses.e: He who sees me sees him who sent me .

verses.z: 我到世上來，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗裏。
verses.e: I have come as a light into the world , that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness .

verses.z: 若有人聽見我的話不遵守，我不審判他。我來本不是要審判世界，乃是要拯救世界。
verses.e: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn't believe , I don't judge him . For I came not to judge the world , but to save the world .

verses.z: 棄絕我、不領受我話的人，有審判他的－就是我所講的道在末日要審判他。
verses.e: He who rejects me , and doesn't receive my sayings , has one who judges him . The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day .

verses.z: 因為我沒有憑着自己講，惟有差我來的父已經給我命令，叫我說甚麼，講甚麼。
verses.e: For I spoke not from myself , but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment , what I should say and what I should speak .

verses.z: 說：「這香膏為甚麼不賣三十兩銀子賙濟窮人呢？」
verses.e: " Why wasn't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor ? "

verses.z: 我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所講的話正是照着父對我所說的。」
verses.e: I know that his commandment is eternal life . The things therefore which I speak , even as the Father has said to me , so I speak . "

verses.z: 他說這話，並不是掛念窮人，乃因他是個賊，又帶着錢囊，常取其中所存的。
verses.e: Now he said this , not because he cared for the poor , but because he was a thief , and having the money box , used to steal what was put into it .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「由她吧！她是為我安葬之日存留的。
verses.e: But Jesus said , " Leave her alone . She has kept this for the day of my burial .

verses.z: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，只是你們不常有我。」
verses.e: For you always have the poor with you , but you don't always have me . "

verses.z: 有許多猶太人知道耶穌在那裏，就來了，不但是為耶穌的緣故，也是要看他從死裏所復活的拉撒路。
verses.e: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there ; and they came , not for Jesus ' sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead .

verses.z: 逾越節以前，耶穌知道自己離世歸父的時候到了。他既然愛世間屬自己的人，就愛他們到底。
verses.e: Now before the feast of the Passover , Jesus , knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father , having loved his own who were in the world , he loved them to the end .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「凡洗過澡的人，只要把腳一洗，全身就乾淨了。你們是乾淨的，然而不都是乾淨的。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed , but is completely clean . You are clean , but not all of you . "

verses.z: 耶穌原知道要賣他的是誰，所以說：「你們不都是乾淨的。」
verses.e: For he knew him who would betray him ; therefore he said , " You are not all clean . "

verses.z: 耶穌洗完了他們的腳，就穿上衣服，又坐下，對他們說：「我向你們所做的，你們明白嗎？
verses.e: So when he had washed their feet , put his outer garment back on , and sat down again , he said to them , " Do you know what I have done to you ?

verses.z: 你們稱呼我夫子，稱呼我主，你們說的不錯，我本來是。
verses.e: You call me , ' Teacher ' and ' Lord . ' You say so correctly , for so I am .

verses.z: 我是你們的主，你們的夫子，尚且洗你們的腳，你們也當彼此洗腳。
verses.e: If I then , the Lord and the Teacher , have washed your feet , you also ought to wash one another's feet .

verses.z: 我給你們作了榜樣，叫你們照着我向你們所做的去做。
verses.e: For I have given you an example , that you should also do as I have done to you .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，僕人不能大於主人，差人也不能大於差他的人。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , a servant is not greater than his lord , neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him .

verses.z: 你們既知道這事，若是去行就有福了。
verses.e: If you know these things , blessed are you if you do them .

verses.z: 我這話不是指着你們眾人說的，我知道我所揀選的是誰。現在要應驗經上的話，說：『同我吃飯的人用腳踢我。』
verses.e: I don't speak concerning all of you . I know whom I have chosen ; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled , ' He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me . '

verses.z: 如今事情還沒有成就，我要先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候可以信我是[基督]。
verses.e: From now on , I tell you before it happens , that when it happens , you may believe that I am he .

verses.z: 吃晚飯的時候，魔鬼已將賣耶穌的意思放在西門的兒子加略人猶大心裏。
verses.e: During supper , the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot , Simon's son , to betray him ,

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , he who receives whomever I send , receives me ; and he who receives me , receives him who sent me . "

verses.z: 耶穌說了這話，心裏憂愁，就明說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」
verses.e: When Jesus had said this , he was troubled in spirit , and testified , " Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me . "

verses.z: 門徒彼此對看，猜不透所說的是誰。
verses.e: The disciples looked at one another , perplexed about whom he spoke .

verses.z: 有一個門徒，是耶穌所愛的，側身挨近耶穌的懷裏。
verses.e: One of his disciples , whom Jesus loved , was at the table , leaning against Jesus ' chest .

verses.z: 西門‧彼得點頭對他說：「你告訴我們，主是指着誰說的。」
verses.e: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , and said to him , " Tell us who it is of whom he speaks . "

verses.z: 那門徒便就勢靠着耶穌的胸膛，問他說：「主啊，是誰呢？」
verses.e: He , leaning back , as he was , on Jesus ' chest , asked him , " Lord , who is it ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我蘸一點餅給誰，就是誰。」耶穌就蘸了一點餅，遞給加略人西門的兒子猶大。
verses.e: Jesus therefore answered , " It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it . " So when he had dipped the piece of bread , he gave it to Judas , the son of Simon Iscariot .

verses.z: 他吃了以後，撒但就入了他的心。耶穌便對他說：「你所做的，快做吧！」
verses.e: After the piece of bread , then Satan entered into him . Then Jesus said to him , " What you do , do quickly . "

verses.z: 同席的人沒有一個知道是為甚麼對他說這話。
verses.e: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him .

verses.z: 有人因猶大帶着錢囊，以為耶穌是對他說：「你去買我們過節所應用的東西」，或是叫他拿甚麼賙濟窮人。
verses.e: For some thought , because Judas had the money box , that Jesus said to him , " Buy what things we need for the feast , " or that he should give something to the poor .

verses.z: 耶穌知道父已將萬有交在他手裏，且知道自己是從上帝出來的，又要歸到上帝那裏去，
verses.e: Jesus , knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands , and that he came from God and was going to God ,

verses.z: 猶大受了那點餅，立刻就出去。那時候是夜間了。
verses.e: Therefore having received that morsel , he went out immediately . It was night .

verses.z: 他既出去，耶穌就說：「如今人子得了榮耀，上帝在人子身上也得了榮耀。
verses.e: When he had gone out , Jesus said , " Now the Son of Man has been glorified , and God has been glorified in him .

verses.z: 上帝要因自己榮耀人子，並且要快快地榮耀他。
verses.e: If God has been glorified in him , God will also glorify him in himself , and he will glorify him immediately .

verses.z: 小子們，我還有不多的時候與你們同在；後來你們要找我，但我所去的地方你們不能到。這話我曾對猶太人說過，如今也照樣對你們說。
verses.e: Little children , I will be with you a little while longer . You will seek me , and as I said to the Jews , ' Where I am going , you can't come , ' so now I tell you .

verses.z: 我賜給你們一條新命令，乃是叫你們彼此相愛；我怎樣愛你們，你們也要怎樣相愛。
verses.e: A new commandment I give to you , that you love one another . Just as I have loved you , you also love one another .

verses.z: 你們若有彼此相愛的心，眾人因此就認出你們是我的門徒了。」
verses.e: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples , if you have love for one another . "

verses.z: 西門‧彼得問耶穌說：「主往哪裏去？」耶穌回答說：「我所去的地方，你現在不能跟我去，後來卻要跟我去。」
verses.e: Simon Peter said to him , " Lord , where are you going ? " Jesus answered , " Where I am going , you can't follow now , but you will follow afterwards . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「主啊，我為甚麼現在不能跟你去？我願意為你捨命！」
verses.e: Peter said to him , " Lord , why can't I follow you now ? I will lay down my life for you . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你願意為我捨命嗎？我實實在在地告訴你，雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Will you lay down your life for me ? Most certainly I tell you , the rooster won't crow until you have denied me three times .

verses.z: 就離席站起來，脫了衣服，拿一條手巾束腰，
verses.e: arose from supper , and laid aside his outer garments . He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist .

verses.z: 隨後把水倒在盆裏，就洗門徒的腳，並用自己所束的手巾擦乾。
verses.e: Then he poured water into the basin , and began to wash the disciples ' feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him .

verses.z: 挨到西門‧彼得，彼得對他說：「主啊，你洗我的腳嗎？」
verses.e: Then he came to Simon Peter . He said to him , " Lord , do you wash my feet ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我所做的，你如今不知道，後來必明白。」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " You don't know what I am doing now , but you will understand later . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「你永不可洗我的腳！」耶穌說：「我若不洗你，你就與我無分了。」
verses.e: Peter said to him , " You will never wash my feet ! " Jesus answered him , " If I don't wash you , you have no part with me . "

verses.z: 西門‧彼得說：「主啊，不但我的腳，連手和頭也要洗。」
verses.e: Simon Peter said to him , " Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head ! "

verses.z: 「你們心裏不要憂愁；你們信上帝，也當信我。
verses.e: " Don't let your heart be troubled . Believe in God . Believe also in me .

verses.z: 我在父裏面，父在我裏面，你不信嗎？我對你們所說的話，不是憑着自己說的，乃是住在我裏面的父做他自己的事。
verses.e: Don't you believe that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? The words that I tell you , I speak not from myself ; but the Father who lives in me does his works .

verses.z: 你們當信我，我在父裏面，父在我裏面；即或不信，也當因我所做的事信我。
verses.e: Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ; or else believe me for the very works ' sake .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，並且要做比這更大的事，因為我往父那裏去。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , he who believes in me , the works that I do , he will do also ; and he will do greater works than these , because I am going to my Father .

verses.z: 你們奉我的名無論求甚麼，我必成就，叫父因兒子得榮耀。
verses.e: Whatever you will ask in my name , I will do it , that the Father may be glorified in the Son .

verses.z: 你們若奉我的名求甚麼，我必成就。」
verses.e: If you will ask anything in my name , I will do it .

verses.z: 「你們若愛我，就必遵守我的命令。
verses.e: If you love me , keep my commandments .

verses.z: 我要求父，父就另外賜給你們一位保惠師，叫他永遠與你們同在，
verses.e: I will pray to the Father , and he will give you another Counselor , that he may be with you forever :

verses.z: 就是真理的[聖]靈，乃世人不能接受的；因為不見他，也不認識他。你們卻認識他，因他常與你們同在，也要在你們裏面。
verses.e: the Spirit of truth , whom the world can't receive , for it doesn't see him and doesn't know him . You know him , for he lives with you and will be in you .

verses.z: 我不撇下你們為孤兒，我必到你們這裏來。
verses.e: I will not leave you orphans . I will come to you .

verses.z: 還有不多的時候，世人不再看見我，你們卻看見我；因為我活着，你們也要活着。
verses.e: Yet a little while , and the world will see me no more ; but you will see me . Because I live , you will live also .

verses.z: 在我父的家裏有許多住處；若是沒有，我就早已告訴你們了。我去原是為你們預備地方去。
verses.e: In my Father's house are many homes . If it weren't so , I would have told you . I am going to prepare a place for you .

verses.z: 到那日，你們就知道我在父裏面，你們在我裏面，我也在你們裏面。
verses.e: In that day you will know that I am in my Father , and you in me , and I in you .

verses.z: 有了我的命令又遵守的，這人就是愛我的；愛我的必蒙我父愛他，我也要愛他，並且要向他顯現。」
verses.e: One who has my commandments and keeps them , that person is one who loves me . One who loves me will be loved by my Father , and I will love him , and will reveal myself to him . "

verses.z: 猶大（不是加略人猶大）問耶穌說：「主啊，為甚麼要向我們顯現，不向世人顯現呢？」
verses.e: Judas ( not Iscariot ) said to him , " Lord , what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us , and not to the world ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「人若愛我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必愛他，並且我們要到他那裏去，與他同住。
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " If a man loves me , he will keep my word . My Father will love him , and we will come to him and make our home with him .

verses.z: 不愛我的人就不遵守我的道。你們所聽見的道不是我的，乃是差我來之父的道。
verses.e: He who doesn't love me doesn't keep my words . The word which you hear isn't mine , but the Father's who sent me .

verses.z: 「我還與你們同住的時候，已將這些話對你們說了。
verses.e: " I have said these things to you while still living with you .

verses.z: 但保惠師，就是父因我的名所要差來的聖靈，他要將一切的事指教你們，並且要叫你們想起我對你們所說的一切話。
verses.e: But the Counselor , the Holy Spirit , whom the Father will send in my name , will teach you all things , and will remind you of all that I said to you .

verses.z: 我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裏不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。
verses.e: Peace I leave with you . My peace I give to you ; not as the world gives , I give to you . Don't let your heart be troubled , neither let it be fearful .

verses.z: 你們聽見我對你們說了，我去還要到你們這裏來。你們若愛我，因我到父那裏去，就必喜樂，因為父是比我大的。
verses.e: You heard how I told you , ' I am going away , and I will come back to you . ' If you loved me , you would have rejoiced because I said ' I am going to my Father ; ' for the Father is greater than I .

verses.z: 現在事情還沒有成就，我預先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候就可以信。
verses.e: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens , you may believe .

verses.z: 我若去為你們預備了地方，就必再來接你們到我那裏去，我在哪裏，叫你們也在那裏。
verses.e: If I go and prepare a place for you , I will come again and will receive you to myself ; that where I am , you may be there also .

verses.z: 以後我不再和你們多說話，因為這世界的王將到。他在我裏面是毫無所有；
verses.e: I will no more speak much with you , for the prince of the world comes , and he has nothing in me .

verses.z: 但要叫世人知道我愛父，並且父怎樣吩咐我，我就怎樣行。起來，我們走吧！」
verses.e: But that the world may know that I love the Father , and as the Father commanded me , even so I do . Arise , let's go from here .

verses.z: 我往哪裏去，你們知道；那條路，你們也知道。」
verses.e: You know where I go , and you know the way . "

verses.z: 多馬對他說：「主啊，我們不知道你往哪裏去，怎麼知道那條路呢？」
verses.e: Thomas said to him , " Lord , we don't know where you are going . How can we know the way ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉着我，沒有人能到父那裏去。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " I am the way , the truth , and the life . No one comes to the Father , except through me .

verses.z: 你們若認識我，也就認識我的父。從今以後，你們認識他，並且已經看見他。」
verses.e: If you had known me , you would have known my Father also . From now on , you know him and have seen him . "

verses.z: 腓力對他說：「求主將父顯給我們看，我們就知足了。」
verses.e: Philip said to him , " Lord , show us the Father , and that will be enough for us . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「腓力，我與你們同在這樣長久，你還不認識我嗎？人看見了我，就是看見了父；你怎麼說『將父顯給我們看』呢？
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Have I been with you such a long time , and do you not know me , Philip ? He who has seen me has seen the Father . How do you say , ' Show us the Father ' ?

verses.z: 「我是真葡萄樹，我父是栽培的人。
verses.e: " I am the true vine , and my Father is the farmer .

verses.z: 你們若遵守我的命令，就常在我的愛裏，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的愛裏。
verses.e: If you keep my commandments , you will remain in my love , even as I have kept my Father's commandments and remain in his love .

verses.z: 「這些事我已經對你們說了，是要叫我的喜樂存在你們心裏，並叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
verses.e: I have spoken these things to you , that my joy may remain in you , and that your joy may be made full .

verses.z: 你們要彼此相愛，像我愛你們一樣；這就是我的命令。
verses.e: " This is my commandment , that you love one another , even as I have loved you .

verses.z: 人為朋友捨命，人的愛心沒有比這個大的。
verses.e: Greater love has no one than this , that someone lay down his life for his friends .

verses.z: 你們若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。
verses.e: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you .

verses.z: 以後我不再稱你們為僕人，因僕人不知道主人所做的事。我乃稱你們為朋友；因我從我父所聽見的，已經都告訴你們了。
verses.e: No longer do I call you servants , for the servant doesn't know what his lord does . But I have called you friends , for everything that I heard from my Father , I have made known to you .

verses.z: 不是你們揀選了我，是我揀選了你們，並且分派你們去結果子，叫你們的果子常存，使你們奉我的名，無論向父求甚麼，他就賜給你們。
verses.e: You didn't choose me , but I chose you and appointed you , that you should go and bear fruit , and that your fruit should remain ; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name , he may give it to you .

verses.z: 我這樣吩咐你們，是要叫你們彼此相愛。」
verses.e: " I command these things to you , that you may love one another .

verses.z: 「世人若恨你們，你們知道，恨你們以先已經恨我了。
verses.e: If the world hates you , you know that it has hated me before it hated you .

verses.z: 你們若屬世界，世界必愛屬自己的；只因你們不屬世界，乃是我從世界中揀選了你們，所以世界就恨你們。
verses.e: If you were of the world , the world would love its own . But because you are not of the world , since I chose you out of the world , therefore the world hates you .

verses.z: 凡屬我不結果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡結果子的，他就修理乾淨，使枝子結果子更多。
verses.e: Every branch in me that doesn't bear fruit , he takes away . Every branch that bears fruit , he prunes , that it may bear more fruit .

verses.z: 你們要記念我從前對你們所說的話：『僕人不能大於主人。』他們若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你們；若遵守了我的話，也要遵守你們的話。
verses.e: Remember the word that I said to you : ' A servant is not greater than his lord . ' If they persecuted me , they will also persecute you . If they kept my word , they will also keep yours .

verses.z: 但他們因我的名要向你們行這一切的事，因為他們不認識那差我來的。
verses.e: But they will do all these things to you for my name's sake , because they don't know him who sent me .

verses.z: 我若沒有來教訓他們，他們就沒有罪；但如今他們的罪無可推諉了。
verses.e: If I had not come and spoken to them , they would not have had sin ; but now they have no excuse for their sin .

verses.z: 恨我的，也恨我的父。
verses.e: He who hates me , hates my Father also .

verses.z: 我若沒有在他們中間行過別人未曾行的事，他們就沒有罪；但如今連我與我的父，他們也看見也恨惡了。
verses.e: If I hadn't done among them the works which no one else did , they wouldn't have had sin . But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father .

verses.z: 這要應驗他們律法上所寫的話，說：『他們無故地恨我。』
verses.e: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law , ' They hated me without a cause . '

verses.z: 但我要從父那裏差保惠師來，就是從父出來真理的聖靈；他來了，就要為我作見證。
verses.e: " When the Counselor has come , whom I will send to you from the Father , the Spirit of truth , who proceeds from the Father , he will testify about me .

verses.z: 你們也要作見證，因為你們從起頭就與我同在。」
verses.e: You will also testify , because you have been with me from the beginning .

verses.z: 現在你們因我講給你們的道，已經乾淨了。
verses.e: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you .

verses.z: 你們要常在我裏面，我也常在你們裏面。枝子若不常在葡萄樹上，自己就不能結果子；你們若不常在我裏面，也是這樣。
verses.e: Remain in me , and I in you . As the branch can't bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine , so neither can you , unless you remain in me .

verses.z: 我是葡萄樹，你們是枝子。常在我裏面的，我也常在他裏面，這人就多結果子；因為離了我，你們就不能做甚麼。
verses.e: I am the vine . You are the branches . He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit , for apart from me you can do nothing .

verses.z: 人若不常在我裏面，就像枝子丟在外面枯乾，人拾起來，扔在火裏燒了。
verses.e: If a man doesn't remain in me , he is thrown out as a branch and is withered ; and they gather them , throw them into the fire , and they are burned .

verses.z: 你們若常在我裏面，我的話也常在你們裏面，凡你們所願意的，祈求，就給你們成就。
verses.e: If you remain in me , and my words remain in you , you will ask whatever you desire , and it will be done for you .

verses.z: 你們多結果子，我父就因此得榮耀，你們也就是我的門徒了。
verses.e: " In this my Father is glorified , that you bear much fruit ; and so you will be my disciples .

verses.z: 我愛你們，正如父愛我一樣；你們要常在我的愛裏。
verses.e: Even as the Father has loved me , I also have loved you . Remain in my love .

verses.z: 「我已將這些事告訴你們，使你們不至於跌倒。
verses.e: " I have said these things to you so that you wouldn't be caused to stumble .

verses.z: 為義，是因我往父那裏去，你們就不再見我；
verses.e: about righteousness , because I am going to my Father , and you won't see me any more ;

verses.z: 為審判，是因這世界的王受了審判。
verses.e: about judgment , because the prince of this world has been judged .

verses.z: 「我還有好些事要告訴你們，但你們現在擔當不了。
verses.e: " I still have many things to tell you , but you can't bear them now .

verses.z: 只等真理的聖靈來了，他要引導你們明白一切的真理；因為他不是憑自己說的，乃是把他所聽見的都說出來，並要把將來的事告訴你們。
verses.e: However , when he , the Spirit of truth , has come , he will guide you into all truth , for he will not speak from himself ; but whatever he hears , he will speak . He will declare to you things that are coming .

verses.z: 他要榮耀我，因為他要將受於我的告訴你們。
verses.e: He will glorify me , for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you .

verses.z: 凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我說，他要將受於我的告訴你們。」
verses.e: All things that the Father has are mine ; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you .

verses.z: 「等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我。」
verses.e: " A little while , and you will not see me . Again a little while , and you will see me . "

verses.z: 有幾個門徒就彼此說：「他對我們說：『等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我』；又[說]：『因我往父那裏去。』這是甚麼意思呢？」
verses.e: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another , " What is this that he says to us , ' A little while , and you won't see me , and again a little while , and you will see me ; ' and , ' Because I go to the Father ' ? "

verses.z: 門徒彼此說：「他說『等不多時』到底是甚麼意思呢？我們不明白他所說的話。」
verses.e: They said therefore , " What is this that he says , ' A little while ' ? We don't know what he is saying . "

verses.z: 耶穌看出他們要問他，就說：「我說『等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我』，你們為這話彼此相問嗎？
verses.e: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him , and he said to them , " Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this , that I said , ' A little while , and you won't see me , and again a little while , and you will see me ' ?

verses.z: 人要把你們趕出會堂，並且時候將到，凡殺你們的就以為是事奉上帝。
verses.e: They will put you out of the synagogues . Yes , the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，你們將要痛哭、哀號，世人倒要喜樂；你們將要憂愁，然而你們的憂愁要變為喜樂。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament , but the world will rejoice . You will be sorrowful , but your sorrow will be turned into joy .

verses.z: 婦人生產的時候就憂愁，因為她的時候到了；既生了孩子，就不再記念那苦楚，因為歡喜世上生了一個人。
verses.e: A woman , when she gives birth , has sorrow because her time has come . But when she has delivered the child , she doesn't remember the anguish any more , for the joy that a human being is born into the world .

verses.z: 你們現在也是憂愁，但我要再見你們，你們的心就喜樂了；這喜樂也沒有人能奪去。
verses.e: Therefore you now have sorrow , but I will see you again , and your heart will rejoice , and no one will take your joy away from you .

verses.z: 到那日，你們甚麼也就不問我了。我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若向父求甚麼，他必因我的名賜給你們。
verses.e: " In that day you will ask me no questions . Most certainly I tell you , whatever you may ask of the Father in my name , he will give it to you .

verses.z: 向來你們沒有奉我的名求甚麼，如今你們求，就必得着，叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。」
verses.e: Until now , you have asked nothing in my name . Ask , and you will receive , that your joy may be made full .

verses.z: 「這些事，我是用比喻對你們說的；時候將到，我不再用比喻對你們說，乃要將父明明地告訴你們。
verses.e: " I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech . But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech , but will tell you plainly about the Father .

verses.z: 到那日，你們要奉我的名祈求；我並不對你們說，我要為你們求父。
verses.e: In that day you will ask in my name ; and I don't say to you that I will pray to the Father for you ,

verses.z: 父自己愛你們；因為你們已經愛我，又信我是從父出來的。
verses.e: for the Father himself loves you , because you have loved me , and have believed that I came from God .

verses.z: 我從父出來，到了世界；我又離開世界，往父那裏去。」
verses.e: I came from the Father and have come into the world . Again , I leave the world and go to the Father . "

verses.z: 門徒說：「如今你是明說，並不用比喻了。
verses.e: His disciples said to him , " Behold , now you are speaking plainly , and using no figures of speech .

verses.z: 他們這樣行，是因未曾認識父，也未曾認識我。
verses.e: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me .

verses.z: 現在我們曉得你凡事都知道，也不用人問你，因此我們信你是從上帝出來的。」
verses.e: Now we know that you know all things , and don't need for anyone to question you . By this we believe that you came from God . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「現在你們信嗎？
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Do you now believe ?

verses.z: 看哪，時候將到，且是已經到了，你們要分散，各歸自己的地方去，留下我獨自一人；其實我不是獨自一人，因為有父與我同在。
verses.e: Behold , the time is coming , yes , and has now come , that you will be scattered , everyone to his own place , and you will leave me alone . Yet I am not alone , because the Father is with me .

verses.z: 我將這些事告訴你們，是要叫你們在我裏面有平安。在世上，你們有苦難；但你們可以放心，我已經勝了世界。」
verses.e: I have told you these things , that in me you may have peace . In the world you have trouble ; but cheer up ! I have overcome the world . "

verses.z: 我將這事告訴你們，是叫你們到了時候可以想起我對你們說過了。」「我起先沒有將這事告訴你們，因為我與你們同在。
verses.e: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes , you may remember that I told you about them . I didn't tell you these things from the beginning , because I was with you .

verses.z: 現今我往差我來的[父]那裏去，你們中間並沒有人問我：『你往哪裏去？』
verses.e: But now I am going to him who sent me , and none of you asks me , ' Where are you going ? '

verses.z: 只因我將這事告訴你們，你們就滿心憂愁。
verses.e: But because I have told you these things , sorrow has filled your heart .

verses.z: 然而，我將真情告訴你們，我去是與你們有益的；我若不去，保惠師就不到你們這裏來；我若去，就差他來。
verses.e: Nevertheless I tell you the truth : It is to your advantage that I go away ; for if I don't go away , the Counselor won't come to you . But if I go , I will send him to you .

verses.z: 他既來了，就要叫世人為罪、為義、為審判，自己責備自己。
verses.e: When he has come , he will convict the world about sin , about righteousness , and about judgment ;

verses.z: 為罪，是因他們不信我；
verses.e: about sin , because they don't believe in me ;

verses.z: 耶穌說了這話，就舉目望天，說：「父啊，時候到了，願你榮耀你的兒子，使兒子也榮耀你；
verses.e: Jesus said these things , then lifting up his eyes to heaven , he said , " Father , the time has come . Glorify your Son , that your Son may also glorify you ;

verses.z: 凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，並且我因他們得了榮耀。
verses.e: All things that are mine are yours , and yours are mine , and I am glorified in them .

verses.z: 從今以後，我不在世上，他們卻在世上；我往你那裏去。聖父啊，求你因你所賜給我的名保守他們，叫他們合而為一像我們一樣。
verses.e: I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I am coming to you . Holy Father , keep them through your name which you have given me , that they may be one , even as we are .

verses.z: 我與他們同在的時候，因你所賜給我的名保守了他們，我也護衛了他們；其中除了那滅亡之子，沒有一個滅亡的，好叫經上的話得應驗。
verses.e: While I was with them in the world , I kept them in your name . I have kept those whom you have given me . None of them is lost except the son of destruction , that the Scripture might be fulfilled .

verses.z: 現在我往你那裏去，我還在世上說這話，是叫他們心裏充滿我的喜樂。
verses.e: But now I come to you , and I say these things in the world , that they may have my joy made full in themselves .

verses.z: 我已將你的道賜給他們。世界又恨他們；因為他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
verses.e: I have given them your word . The world hated them because they are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .

verses.z: 我不求你叫他們離開世界，只求你保守他們脫離那惡者。
verses.e: I pray not that you would take them from the world , but that you would keep them from the evil one .

verses.z: 他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
verses.e: They are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .

verses.z: 求你用真理使他們成聖；你的道就是真理。
verses.e: Sanctify them in your truth . Your word is truth .

verses.z: 你怎樣差我到世上，我也照樣差他們到世上。
verses.e: As you sent me into the world , even so I have sent them into the world .

verses.z: 我為他們的緣故，自己分別為聖，叫他們也因真理成聖。
verses.e: For their sakes I sanctify myself , that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth .

verses.z: 正如你曾賜給他權柄管理凡有血氣的，叫他將永生賜給你所賜給他的人。
verses.e: even as you gave him authority over all flesh , so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him .

verses.z: 「我不但為這些人祈求，也為那些因他們的話信我的人祈求，
verses.e: " Not for these only do I pray , but for those also who will believe in me through their word ,

verses.z: 使他們都合而為一。正如你父在我裏面，我在你裏面，使他們也在我們裏面，叫世人可以信你差了我來。
verses.e: that they may all be one ; even as you , Father , are in me , and I in you , that they also may be one in us ; that the world may believe that you sent me .

verses.z: 你所賜給我的榮耀，我已賜給他們，使他們合而為一，像我們合而為一。
verses.e: The glory which you have given me , I have given to them , that they may be one , even as we are one ,

verses.z: 我在他們裏面，你在我裏面，使他們完完全全地合而為一，叫世人知道你差了我來，也知道你愛他們如同愛我一樣。
verses.e: I in them , and you in me , that they may be perfected into one , that the world may know that you sent me and loved them , even as you loved me .

verses.z: 父啊，我在哪裏，願你所賜給我的人也同我在那裏，叫他們看見你所賜給我的榮耀；因為創立世界以前，你已經愛我了。
verses.e: Father , I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am , that they may see my glory which you have given me , for you loved me before the foundation of the world .

verses.z: 公義的父啊，世人未曾認識你，我卻認識你；這些人也知道你差了我來。
verses.e: Righteous Father , the world hasn't known you , but I knew you ; and these knew that you sent me .

verses.z: 我已將你的名指示他們，還要指示他們，使你所愛我的愛在他們裏面，我也在他們裏面。」
verses.e: I made known to them your name , and will make it known ; that the love with which you loved me may be in them , and I in them . "

verses.z: 認識你－獨一的真神，並且認識你所差來的耶穌基督，這就是永生。
verses.e: This is eternal life , that they should know you , the only true God , and him whom you sent , Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 我在地上已經榮耀你，你所託付我的事，我已成全了。
verses.e: I glorified you on the earth . I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do .

verses.z: 父啊，現在求你使我同你享榮耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的榮耀。
verses.e: Now , Father , glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed .

verses.z: 「你從世上賜給我的人，我已將你的名顯明與他們。他們本是你的，你將他們賜給我，他們也遵守了你的道。
verses.e: " I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world . They were yours , and you have given them to me . They have kept your word .

verses.z: 如今他們知道，凡你所賜給我的，都是從你那裏來的；
verses.e: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you ,

verses.z: 因為你所賜給我的道，我已經賜給他們，他們也領受了，又確實知道，我是從你出來的，並且信你差了我來。
verses.e: for the words which you have given me I have given to them ; and they received them , and knew for sure that I came from you . They have believed that you sent me .

verses.z: 我為他們祈求，不為世人祈求，卻為你所賜給我的人祈求，因他們本是你的。
verses.e: I pray for them . I don't pray for the world , but for those whom you have given me , for they are yours .

verses.z: 耶穌說了這話，就同門徒出去，過了汲淪溪。在那裏有一個園子，他和門徒進去了。
verses.e: When Jesus had spoken these words , he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron , where there was a garden , into which he and his disciples entered .

verses.z: 西門‧彼得帶着一把刀，就拔出來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那僕人名叫馬勒古。
verses.e: Simon Peter therefore , having a sword , drew it , struck the high priest's servant , and cut off his right ear . The servant's name was Malchus .

verses.z: 耶穌就對彼得說：「收刀入鞘吧，我父所給我的那杯，我豈可不喝呢？」
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to Peter , " Put the sword into its sheath . The cup which the Father has given me , shall I not surely drink it ? "

verses.z: 那隊兵和千夫長，並猶太人的差役就拿住耶穌，把他捆綁了，
verses.e: So the detachment , the commanding officer , and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him ,

verses.z: 先帶到亞那面前，因為亞那是本年作大祭司該亞法的岳父。
verses.e: and led him to Annas first , for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas , who was high priest that year .

verses.z: 這該亞法就是從前向猶太人發議論說「一個人替百姓死是有益的」那位。
verses.e: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people .

verses.z: 西門‧彼得跟着耶穌，還有一個門徒跟着。那門徒是大祭司所認識的，他就同耶穌進了大祭司的院子。
verses.e: Simon Peter followed Jesus , as did another disciple . Now that disciple was known to the high priest , and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest ;

verses.z: 彼得卻站在門外。大祭司所認識的那個門徒出來，和看門的使女說了一聲，就領彼得進去。
verses.e: but Peter was standing at the door outside . So the other disciple , who was known to the high priest , went out and spoke to her who kept the door , and brought in Peter .

verses.z: 那看門的使女對彼得說：「你不也是這人的門徒嗎？」他說：「我不是。」
verses.e: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter , " Are you also one of this man's disciples ? " He said , " I am not . "

verses.z: 僕人和差役因為天冷，就生了炭火，站在那裏烤火；彼得也同他們站着烤火。
verses.e: Now the servants and the officers were standing there , having made a fire of coals , for it was cold . They were warming themselves . Peter was with them , standing and warming himself .

verses.z: 大祭司就以耶穌的門徒和他的教訓盤問他。
verses.e: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching .

verses.z: 賣耶穌的猶大也知道那地方，因為耶穌和門徒屢次上那裏去聚集。
verses.e: Now Judas , who betrayed him , also knew the place , for Jesus often met there with his disciples .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我從來是明明地對世人說話。我常在會堂和殿裏，就是猶太人聚集的地方教訓人；我在暗地裏並沒有說甚麼。
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " I spoke openly to the world . I always taught in synagogues and in the temple , where the Jews always meet . I said nothing in secret .

verses.z: 你為甚麼問我呢？可以問那聽見的人，我對他們說的是甚麼；我所說的，他們都知道。」
verses.e: Why do you ask me ? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them . Behold , they know the things which I said . "

verses.z: 耶穌說了這話，旁邊站着的一個差役用手掌打他，說：「你這樣回答大祭司嗎？」
verses.e: When he had said this , one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand , saying , " Do you answer the high priest like that ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我若說的不是，你可以指證那不是；我若說的是，你為甚麼打我呢？」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " If I have spoken evil , testify of the evil ; but if well , why do you beat me ? "

verses.z: 亞那就把耶穌解到大祭司該亞法那裏，仍是捆着解去的。
verses.e: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas , the high priest .

verses.z: 西門‧彼得正站着烤火，有人對他說：「你不也是他的門徒嗎？」彼得不承認，說：「我不是。」
verses.e: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself . They said therefore to him , " You aren't also one of his disciples , are you ? " He denied it and said , " I am not . "

verses.z: 有大祭司的一個僕人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的親屬，說：「我不是看見你同他在園子裏嗎？」
verses.e: One of the servants of the high priest , being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off , said , " Didn't I see you in the garden with him ? "

verses.z: 彼得又不承認。立時雞就叫了。
verses.e: Peter therefore denied it again , and immediately the rooster crowed .

verses.z: 眾人將耶穌從該亞法那裏往衙門內解去，那時天還早。他們自己卻不進衙門，恐怕染了污穢，不能吃逾越[節的筵席]。
verses.e: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium . It was early , and they themselves didn't enter into the Praetorium , that they might not be defiled , but might eat the Passover .

verses.z: 彼拉多就出來，到他們那裏，說：「你們告這人是為甚麼事呢？」
verses.e: Pilate therefore went out to them and said , " What accusation do you bring against this man ? "

verses.z: 猶大領了一隊兵，和祭司長並法利賽人的差役，拿着燈籠、火把、兵器，就來到園裏。
verses.e: Judas then , having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees , came there with lanterns , torches , and weapons .

verses.z: 他們回答說：「這人若不是作惡的，我們就不把他交給你。」
verses.e: They answered him , " If this man weren't an evildoer , we wouldn't have delivered him up to you . "

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「你們自己帶他去，按着你們的律法審問他吧。」猶太人說：「我們沒有殺人的權柄。」
verses.e: Pilate therefore said to them , " Take him yourselves , and judge him according to your law . " Therefore the Jews said to him , " It is illegal for us to put anyone to death , "

verses.z: 這要應驗耶穌所說自己將要怎樣死的話了。
verses.e: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled , which he spoke , signifying by what kind of death he should die .

verses.z: 彼拉多又進了衙門，叫耶穌來，對他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」
verses.e: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium , called Jesus , and said to him , " Are you the King of the Jews ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「這話是你自己說的，還是別人論我對你說的呢？」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Do you say this by yourself , or did others tell you about me ? "

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「我豈是猶太人呢？你本國的人和祭司長把你交給我。你做了甚麼事呢？」
verses.e: Pilate answered , " I'm not a Jew , am I ? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me . What have you done ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我的國不屬這世界；我的國若屬這世界，我的臣僕必要爭戰，使我不至於被交給猶太人。只是我的國不屬這世界。」
verses.e: Jesus answered , " My Kingdom is not of this world . If my Kingdom were of this world , then my servants would fight , that I wouldn't be delivered to the Jews . But now my Kingdom is not from here . "

verses.z: 彼拉多就對他說：「這樣，你是王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說我是王。我為此而生，也為此來到世間，特為給真理作見證。凡屬真理的人就聽我的話。」
verses.e: Pilate therefore said to him , " Are you a king then ? " Jesus answered , " You say that I am a king . For this reason I have been born , and for this reason I have come into the world , that I should testify to the truth . Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice . "

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「真理是甚麼呢？」說了這話，又出來到猶太人那裏，對他們說：「我查不出他有甚麼罪來。
verses.e: Pilate said to him , " What is truth ? " When he had said this , he went out again to the Jews , and said to them , " I find no basis for a charge against him .

verses.z: 但你們有個規矩，在逾越節要我給你們釋放一個人，你們要我給你們釋放猶太人的王嗎？」
verses.e: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover . Therefore , do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews ? "

verses.z: 耶穌知道將要臨到自己的一切事，就出來對他們說：「你們找誰？」
verses.e: Jesus therefore , knowing all the things that were happening to him , went out and said to them , " Who are you looking for ? "

verses.z: 他們又喊着說：「不要這人，要巴拉巴！」這巴拉巴是個強盜。
verses.e: Then they all shouted again , saying , " Not this man , but Barabbas ! " Now Barabbas was a robber .

verses.z: 他們回答說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」耶穌說：「我就是！」賣他的猶大也同他們站在那裏。
verses.e: They answered him , " Jesus of Nazareth . " Jesus said to them , " I am he . " Judas also , who betrayed him , was standing with them .

verses.z: 耶穌一說「我就是」，他們就退後倒在地上。
verses.e: When therefore he said to them , " I am he , " they went backward and fell to the ground .

verses.z: 他又問他們說：「你們找誰？」他們說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」
verses.e: Again therefore he asked them , " Who are you looking for ? " They said , " Jesus of Nazareth . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我已經告訴你們，我就是。你們若找我，就讓這些人去吧。」
verses.e: Jesus answered , " I told you that I am he . If therefore you seek me , let these go their way , "

verses.z: 這要應驗耶穌從前的話，說：「你所賜給我的人，我沒有失落一個。」
verses.e: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke , " Of those whom you have given me , I have lost none . "

verses.z: 當下彼拉多將耶穌鞭打了。
verses.e: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him .

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「你不對我說話嗎？你豈不知我有權柄釋放你，也有權柄把你釘十字架嗎？」
verses.e: Pilate therefore said to him , " Aren't you speaking to me ? Don't you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「若不是從上頭賜給你的，你就毫無權柄辦我。所以，把我交給你的那人罪更重了。」
verses.e: Jesus answered , " You would have no power at all against me , unless it were given to you from above . Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin . "

verses.z: 從此，彼拉多想要釋放耶穌，無奈猶太人喊着說：「你若釋放這個人，就不是凱撒的忠臣。凡以自己為王的，就是背叛凱撒了。」
verses.e: At this , Pilate was seeking to release him , but the Jews cried out , saying , " If you release this man , you aren't Caesar's friend ! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多聽見這話，就帶耶穌出來，到了一個地方，名叫「鋪華石處」，希伯來話叫厄巴大，就在那裏坐堂。
verses.e: When Pilate therefore heard these words , he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called " The Pavement " , but in Hebrew , " Gabbatha . "

verses.z: 那日是預備逾越[節]的日子，約有午正。彼拉多對猶太人說：「看哪，這是你們的王！」
verses.e: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover , at about the sixth hour . He said to the Jews , " Behold , your King ! "

verses.z: 他們喊着說：「除掉他！除掉他！釘他在十字架上！」彼拉多說：「我可以把你們的王釘十字架嗎？」祭司長回答說：「除了凱撒，我們沒有王。」
verses.e: They cried out , " Away with him ! Away with him ! Crucify him ! " Pilate said to them , " Shall I crucify your King ? " The chief priests answered , " We have no king but Caesar ! "

verses.z: 於是彼拉多將耶穌交給他們去釘十字架。
verses.e: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified . So they took Jesus and led him away .

verses.z: 他們就把耶穌帶了去。耶穌背着自己的十字架出來，到了一個地方，名叫「髑髏地」，希伯來話叫各各他。
verses.e: He went out , bearing his cross , to the place called " The Place of a Skull " , which is called in Hebrew , " Golgotha " ,

verses.z: 他們就在那裏釘他在十字架上，還有兩個人和他一同釘着，一邊一個，耶穌在中間。
verses.e: where they crucified him , and with him two others , on either side one , and Jesus in the middle .

verses.z: 彼拉多又[用牌子]寫了一個名號，安在十字架上，寫的是：「猶太人的王，拿撒勒人耶穌。」
verses.e: Pilate wrote a title also , and put it on the cross . There was written , " JESUS OF NAZARETH , THE KING OF THE JEWS . "

verses.z: 兵丁用荊棘編做冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上紫袍，
verses.e: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head , and dressed him in a purple garment .

verses.z: 有許多猶太人念這名號；因為耶穌被釘十字架的地方與城相近，並且是用希伯來、羅馬、希臘三樣文字寫的。
verses.e: Therefore many of the Jews read this title , for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city ; and it was written in Hebrew , in Latin , and in Greek .

verses.z: 猶太人的祭司長就對彼拉多說：「不要寫『猶太人的王』，要寫『他自己說：我是猶太人的王』。」
verses.e: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate , " Don't write , ' The King of the Jews , ' but , ' he said , " I am King of the Jews . " ' "

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「我所寫的，我已經寫上了。」
verses.e: Pilate answered , " What I have written , I have written . "

verses.z: 兵丁既然將耶穌釘在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分為四分，每兵一分；又拿他的裏衣，這件裏衣原來沒有縫兒，是上下一片織成的。
verses.e: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments and made four parts , to every soldier a part ; and also the tunic . Now the tunic was without seam , woven from the top throughout .

verses.z: 他們就彼此說：「我們不要撕開，只要拈鬮，看誰得着。」這要應驗經上的話說：他們分了我的外衣，為我的裏衣拈鬮。兵丁果然做了這事。
verses.e: Then they said to one another , " Let's not tear it , but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be , " that the Scripture might be fulfilled , which says , " They parted my garments among them . They cast lots for my clothing . " Therefore the soldiers did these things .

verses.z: 站在耶穌十字架旁邊的，有他母親與他母親的姊妹，並革羅罷的妻子馬利亞，和抹大拉的馬利亞。
verses.e: But standing by Jesus ' cross were his mother , his mother's sister , Mary the wife of Clopas , and Mary Magdalene .

verses.z: 耶穌見母親和他所愛的那門徒站在旁邊，就對他母親說：「母親，看，你的兒子！」
verses.e: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother , and the disciple whom he loved standing there , he said to his mother , " Woman , behold , your son ! "

verses.z: 又對那門徒說：「看，你的母親！」從此，那門徒就接她到自己家裏去了。
verses.e: Then he said to the disciple , " Behold , your mother ! " From that hour , the disciple took her to his own home .

verses.z: 這事以後，耶穌知道各樣的事已經成了，為要使經上的話應驗，就說：「我渴了。」
verses.e: After this , Jesus , seeing that all things were now finished , that the Scripture might be fulfilled , said , " I am thirsty ! "

verses.z: 有一個器皿盛滿了醋，放在那裏；他們就拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在牛膝草上，送到他口。
verses.e: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there ; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop , and held it at his mouth .

verses.z: 又挨近他，說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」他們就用手掌打他。
verses.e: They kept saying , " Hail , King of the Jews ! " and they kept slapping him .

verses.z: 耶穌嘗了那醋，就說：「成了！」便低下頭，將靈魂交付[上帝]了。
verses.e: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar , he said , " It is finished ! " Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit .

verses.z: 猶太人因這日是預備日，又因那安息日是個大日，就求彼拉多叫人打斷他們的腿，把他們拿去，免得屍首當安息日留在十字架上。
verses.e: Therefore the Jews , because it was the Preparation Day , so that the bodies wouldn't remain on the cross on the Sabbath ( for that Sabbath was a special one ) , asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away .

verses.z: 於是兵丁來，把頭一個人的腿，並與耶穌同釘第二個人的腿，都打斷了。
verses.e: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him ;

verses.z: 只是來到耶穌那裏，見他已經死了，就不打斷他的腿。
verses.e: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead , they didn't break his legs .

verses.z: 惟有一個兵拿槍扎他的肋旁，隨即有血和水流出來。
verses.e: However , one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear , and immediately blood and water came out .

verses.z: 看見[這事]的那人就作見證－他的見證也是真的，並且他知道自己所說的是真的－叫你們也可以信。
verses.e: He who has seen has testified , and his testimony is true . He knows that he tells the truth , that you may believe .

verses.z: 這些事成了，為要應驗經上的話說：「他的骨頭一根也不可折斷。」
verses.e: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled , " A bone of him will not be broken . "

verses.z: 經上又有一句說：「他們要仰望自己所扎的人。」
verses.e: Again another Scripture says , " They will look on him whom they pierced . "

verses.z: 這些事以後，有亞利馬太人約瑟，是耶穌的門徒，只因怕猶太人，就暗暗地作門徒。他來求彼拉多，要把耶穌的身體領去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶穌的身體領去了。
verses.e: After these things , Joseph of Arimathaea , being a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews , asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus ' body . Pilate gave him permission . He came therefore and took away his body .

verses.z: 又有尼哥德慕，就是先前夜裏去見耶穌的，帶着沒藥和沉香約有一百斤前來。
verses.e: Nicodemus , who at first came to Jesus by night , also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes , about a hundred Roman pounds .

verses.z: 彼拉多又出來對眾人說：「我帶他出來見你們，叫你們知道我查不出他有甚麼罪來。」
verses.e: Then Pilate went out again , and said to them , " Behold , I bring him out to you , that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him . "

verses.z: 他們就照猶太人殯葬的規矩，把耶穌的身體用細麻布加上香料裹好了。
verses.e: So they took Jesus ' body , and bound it in linen cloths with the spices , as the custom of the Jews is to bury .

verses.z: 在耶穌釘十字架的地方有一個園子，園子裏有一座新墳墓，是從來沒有葬過人的。
verses.e: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden . In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid .

verses.z: 只因是猶太人的預備日，又因那墳墓近，他們就把耶穌安放在那裏。
verses.e: Then , because of the Jews ' Preparation Day ( for the tomb was near at hand ) , they laid Jesus there .

verses.z: 耶穌出來，戴着荊棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。[彼拉多]對他們說：「你們看這個人！」
verses.e: Jesus therefore came out , wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment . Pilate said to them , " Behold , the man ! "

verses.z: 祭司長和差役看見他，就喊着說：「釘他十字架！釘他十字架！」彼拉多說：「你們自己把他釘十字架吧！我查不出他有甚麼罪來。」
verses.e: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him , they shouted , saying , " Crucify ! Crucify ! " Pilate said to them , " Take him yourselves and crucify him , for I find no basis for a charge against him . "

verses.z: 猶太人回答說：「我們有律法，按那律法，他是該死的，因他以自己為上帝的兒子。」
verses.e: The Jews answered him , " We have a law , and by our law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God . "

verses.z: 彼拉多聽見這話，越發害怕，
verses.e: When therefore Pilate heard this saying , he was more afraid .

verses.z: 又進衙門，對耶穌說：「你是哪裏來的？」耶穌卻不回答。
verses.e: He entered into the Praetorium again , and said to Jesus , " Where are you from ? " But Jesus gave him no answer .

verses.z: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶親的筵席，耶穌的母親在那裏。
verses.e: The third day , there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee . Jesus ' mother was there .

verses.z: 對他說：「人都是先擺上好酒，等客喝足了，才擺上次的，你倒把好酒留到如今！」
verses.e: and said to him , " Everyone serves the good wine first , and when the guests have drunk freely , then that which is worse . You have kept the good wine until now ! "

verses.z: 這是耶穌所行的頭一件神蹟，是在加利利的迦拿行的，顯出他的榮耀來；他的門徒就信他了。
verses.e: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee , and revealed his glory ; and his disciples believed in him .

verses.z: 這事以後，耶穌與他的母親、弟兄，和門徒都下迦百農去，在那裏住了不多幾日。
verses.e: After this , he went down to Capernaum , he , and his mother , his brothers , and his disciples ; and they stayed there a few days .

verses.z: 猶太人的逾越節近了，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: The Passover of the Jews was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 看見殿裏有賣牛、羊、鴿子的，並有兌換銀錢的人坐在那裏，
verses.e: He found in the temple those who sold oxen , sheep , and doves , and the changers of money sitting .

verses.z: 耶穌就拿繩子做成鞭子，把牛羊都趕出殿去，倒出兌換銀錢之人的銀錢，推翻他們的桌子，
verses.e: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple , both the sheep and the oxen ; and he poured out the changers ' money and overthrew their tables .

verses.z: 又對賣鴿子的說：「把這些東西拿去！不要將我父的殿當作買賣的地方。」
verses.e: To those who sold the doves , he said , " Take these things out of here ! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace ! "

verses.z: 他的門徒就想起[經上]記着說：「我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒。」
verses.e: His disciples remembered that it was written , " Zeal for your house will eat me up . "

verses.z: 因此猶太人問他說：「你既做這些事，還顯甚麼神蹟給我們看呢？」
verses.e: The Jews therefore answered him , " What sign do you show us , seeing that you do these things ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們拆毀這殿，我三日內要再建立起來。」
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Destroy this temple , and in three days I will raise it up . "

verses.z: 耶穌和他的門徒也被請去赴席。
verses.e: Jesus also was invited , with his disciples , to the wedding .

verses.z: 猶太人便說：「這殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日內就再建立起來嗎？」
verses.e: The Jews therefore said , " It took forty-six years to build this temple ! Will you raise it up in three days ? "

verses.z: 但耶穌這話是以他的身體為殿。
verses.e: But he spoke of the temple of his body .

verses.z: 所以到他從死裏復活以後，門徒就想起他說過這話，便信了聖經和耶穌所說的。
verses.e: When therefore he was raised from the dead , his disciples remembered that he said this , and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said .

verses.z: 當耶穌在耶路撒冷過逾越節的時候，有許多人看見他所行的神蹟，就信了他的名。
verses.e: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover , during the feast , many believed in his name , observing his signs which he did .

verses.z: 耶穌卻不將自己交託他們；因為他知道萬人，
verses.e: But Jesus didn't entrust himself to them , because he knew everyone ,

verses.z: 也用不着誰見證人怎樣，因他知道人心裏所存的。
verses.e: and because he didn't need for anyone to testify concerning man ; for he himself knew what was in man .

verses.z: 酒用盡了，耶穌的母親對他說：「他們沒有酒了。」
verses.e: When the wine ran out , Jesus ' mother said to him , " They have no wine . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「母親，我與你有甚麼相干？我的時候還沒有到。」
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Woman , what does that have to do with you and me ? My hour has not yet come . "

verses.z: 他母親對用人說：「他告訴你們甚麼，你們就做甚麼。」
verses.e: His mother said to the servants , " Whatever he says to you , do it . "

verses.z: 照猶太人潔淨的規矩，有六口石缸擺在那裏，每口可以盛兩三桶水。
verses.e: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews ' way of purifying , containing two or three metretes apiece .

verses.z: 耶穌對用人說：「把缸倒滿了水。」他們就倒滿了，直到缸口。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Fill the water pots with water . " So they filled them up to the brim .

verses.z: 耶穌又說：「現在可以舀出來，送給管筵席的。」他們就送了去。
verses.e: He said to them , " Now draw some out , and take it to the ruler of the feast . " So they took it .

verses.z: 管筵席的嘗了那水變的酒，並不知道是哪裏來的，只有舀水的用人知道。管筵席的便叫新郎來，
verses.e: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine , and didn't know where it came from ( but the servants who had drawn the water knew ) , the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

verses.z: 七日的第一日清早，天還黑的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞來到墳墓那裏，看見石頭從墳墓挪開了，
verses.e: Now on the first day of the week , Mary Magdalene went early , while it was still dark , to the tomb , and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb .

verses.z: 於是兩個門徒回自己的住處去了。
verses.e: So the disciples went away again to their own homes .

verses.z: 馬利亞卻站在墳墓外面哭。哭的時候，低頭往墳墓裏看，
verses.e: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping . So as she wept , she stooped and looked into the tomb ,

verses.z: 就見兩個天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶穌身體的地方坐着，一個在頭，一個在腳。
verses.e: and she saw two angels in white sitting , one at the head and one at the feet , where the body of Jesus had lain .

verses.z: 天使對她說：「婦人，你為甚麼哭？」她說：「因為有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪裏。」
verses.e: They asked her , " Woman , why are you weeping ? " She said to them , " Because they have taken away my Lord , and I don't know where they have laid him . "

verses.z: 說了這話，就轉過身來，看見耶穌站在那裏，卻不知道是耶穌。
verses.e: When she had said this , she turned around and saw Jesus standing , and didn't know that it was Jesus .

verses.z: 耶穌問她說：「婦人，為甚麼哭？你找誰呢？」馬利亞以為是看園的，就對他說：「先生，若是你把他移了去，請告訴我，你把他放在哪裏，我便去取他。」
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Woman , why are you weeping ? Who are you looking for ? " She , supposing him to be the gardener , said to him , " Sir , if you have carried him away , tell me where you have laid him , and I will take him away . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「馬利亞。」馬利亞就轉過來，用希伯來話對他說：「拉波尼！」（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Mary . " She turned and said to him , " Rabboni ! " which is to say , " Teacher ! "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「不要摸我，因我還沒有升上去見我的父。你往我弟兄那裏去，告訴他們說，我要升上去見我的父，也是你們的父，見我的上帝，也是你們的上帝。」
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Don't hold me , for I haven't yet ascended to my Father ; but go to my brothers and tell them , ' I am ascending to my Father and your Father , to my God and your God . ' "

verses.z: 抹大拉的馬利亞就去告訴門徒說：「我已經看見了主。」她又將主對她說的這話告訴他們。
verses.e: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord , and that he had said these things to her .

verses.z: 那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，門徒所在的地方，因怕猶太人，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中，對他們說：「願你們平安！」
verses.e: When therefore it was evening on that day , the first day of the week , and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled , for fear of the Jews , Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them , " Peace be to you . "

verses.z: 就跑來見西門‧彼得和耶穌所愛的那個門徒，對他們說：「有人把主從墳墓裏挪了去，我們不知道放在哪裏。」
verses.e: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved , and said to them , " They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb , and we don't know where they have laid him ! "

verses.z: 說了這話，就把手和肋旁指給他們看。門徒看見主，就喜樂了。
verses.e: When he had said this , he showed them his hands and his side . The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord .

verses.z: 耶穌又對他們說：「願你們平安！父怎樣差遣了我，我也照樣差遣你們。」
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them again , " Peace be to you . As the Father has sent me , even so I send you . "

verses.z: 說了這話，就向他們吹一口氣，說：「你們受聖靈！
verses.e: When he had said this , he breathed on them , and said to them , " Receive the Holy Spirit !

verses.z: 你們赦免誰的罪，誰的罪就赦免了；你們留下誰的罪，誰的罪就留下了。」
verses.e: If you forgive anyone's sins , they have been forgiven them . If you retain anyone's sins , they have been retained . "

verses.z: 那十二個門徒中，有稱為低土馬的多馬；耶穌來的時候，他沒有和他們同在。
verses.e: But Thomas , one of the twelve , called Didymus , wasn't with them when Jesus came .

verses.z: 那些門徒就對他說：「我們已經看見主了。」多馬卻說：「我非看見他手上的釘痕，用指頭探入那釘痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我總不信。」
verses.e: The other disciples therefore said to him , " We have seen the Lord ! " But he said to them , " Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails , put my finger into the print of the nails , and put my hand into his side , I will not believe . "

verses.z: 過了八日，門徒又在屋裏，多馬也和他們同在，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中說：「願你們平安！」
verses.e: After eight days , again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them . Jesus came , the doors being locked , and stood in the middle , and said , " Peace be to you . "

verses.z: 就對多馬說：「伸過你的指頭來，摸我的手；伸出你的手來，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，總要信！」
verses.e: Then he said to Thomas , " Reach here your finger , and see my hands . Reach here your hand , and put it into my side . Don't be unbelieving , but believing . "

verses.z: 多馬說：「我的主！我的上帝！」
verses.e: Thomas answered him , " My Lord and my God ! "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你因看見了我才信；那沒有看見就信的有福了。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Because you have seen me , you have believed . Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed . "

verses.z: 彼得和那門徒就出來，往墳墓那裏去。
verses.e: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out , and they went toward the tomb .

verses.z: 耶穌在門徒面前另外行了許多神蹟，沒有記在這書上。
verses.e: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples , which are not written in this book ;

verses.z: 但記這些事要叫你們信耶穌是基督，是上帝的兒子，並且叫你們信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。
verses.e: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ , the Son of God , and that believing you may have life in his name .

verses.z: 兩個人同跑，那門徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了墳墓，
verses.e: They both ran together . The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first .

verses.z: 低頭往裏看，就見細麻布還放在那裏，只是沒有進去。
verses.e: Stooping and looking in , he saw the linen cloths lying there ; yet he didn't enter in .

verses.z: 西門‧彼得隨後也到了，進墳墓裏去，就看見細麻布還放在那裏，
verses.e: Then Simon Peter came , following him , and entered into the tomb . He saw the linen cloths lying ,

verses.z: 又看見耶穌的裹頭巾沒有和細麻布放在一處，是另在一處捲着。
verses.e: and the cloth that had been on his head , not lying with the linen cloths , but rolled up in a place by itself .

verses.z: 先到墳墓的那門徒也進去，看見就信了。（
verses.e: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in , and he saw and believed .

verses.z: 因為他們還不明白聖經的[意思]，就是耶穌必要從死裏復活。）
verses.e: For as yet they didn't know the Scripture , that he must rise from the dead .

verses.z: 這些事以後，耶穌在提比哩亞海邊又向門徒顯現。他怎樣顯現記在下面：
verses.e: After these things , Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias . He revealed himself this way .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「把剛才打的魚拿幾條來。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Bring some of the fish which you have just caught . "

verses.z: 西門‧彼得就去，把網拉到岸上。那網滿了大魚，共一百五十三條；魚雖這樣多，網卻沒有破。
verses.e: Simon Peter went up , and drew the net to land , full of one hundred fifty-three great fish . Even though there were so many , the net wasn't torn .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們來吃早飯。」門徒中沒有一個敢問他：「你是誰？」因為知道是主。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Come and eat breakfast ! " None of the disciples dared inquire of him , " Who are you ? " knowing that it was the Lord .

verses.z: 耶穌就來拿餅和魚給他們。
verses.e: Then Jesus came and took the bread , gave it to them , and the fish likewise .

verses.z: 耶穌從死裏復活以後，向門徒顯現，這是第三次。
verses.e: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead .

verses.z: 他們吃完了早飯，耶穌對西門‧彼得說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我比這些更深嗎？」彼得說：「主啊，是的，你知道我愛你。」耶穌對他說：「你餵養我的小羊。」
verses.e: So when they had eaten their breakfast , Jesus said to Simon Peter , " Simon , son of Jonah , do you love me more than these ? " He said to him , " Yes , Lord ; you know that I have affection for you . " He said to him , " Feed my lambs . "

verses.z: 耶穌第二次又對他說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我嗎？」彼得說：「主啊，是的，你知道我愛你。」耶穌說：「你牧養我的羊。」
verses.e: He said to him again a second time , " Simon , son of Jonah , do you love me ? " He said to him , " Yes , Lord ; you know that I have affection for you . " He said to him , " Tend my sheep . "

verses.z: 第三次對他說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我嗎？」彼得因為耶穌第三次對他說「你愛我嗎」，就憂愁，對耶穌說：「主啊，你是無所不知的；你知道我愛你。」耶穌說：「你餵養我的羊。
verses.e: He said to him the third time , " Simon , son of Jonah , do you have affection for me ? " Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time , " Do you have affection for me ? " He said to him , " Lord , you know everything . You know that I have affection for you . " Jesus said to him , " Feed my sheep .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你，你年少的時候，自己束上[帶子]，隨意往來；但年老的時候，你要伸出手來，別人要把你束上，帶你到不願意去的地方。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , when you were young , you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to . But when you are old , you will stretch out your hands , and another will dress you and carry you where you don't want to go . "

verses.z: （耶穌說這話是指着彼得要怎樣死，榮耀上帝。）說了這話，就對他說：「你跟從我吧！」
verses.e: Now he said this , signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God . When he had said this , he said to him , " Follow me . "

verses.z: 有西門‧彼得和稱為低土馬的多馬，並加利利的迦拿人拿但業，還有西庇太的兩個兒子，又有兩個門徒，都在一處。
verses.e: Simon Peter , Thomas called Didymus , Nathanael of Cana in Galilee , and the sons of Zebedee , and two others of his disciples were together .

verses.z: 彼得轉過來，看見耶穌所愛的那門徒跟着，（就是在晚飯的時候，靠着耶穌胸膛說：「主啊，賣你的是誰？」的那門徒。）
verses.e: Then Peter , turning around , saw a disciple following . This was the disciple whom Jesus loved , the one who had also leaned on Jesus ' chest at the supper and asked , " Lord , who is going to betray you ? "

verses.z: 彼得看見他，就問耶穌說：「主啊，這人將來如何？」
verses.e: Peter , seeing him , said to Jesus , " Lord , what about this man ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？你跟從我吧！」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " If I desire that he stay until I come , what is that to you ? You follow me . "

verses.z: 於是這話傳在弟兄中間，說那門徒不死。其實，耶穌不是說他不死，乃是說：「我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？」
verses.e: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn't die . Yet Jesus didn't say to him that he wouldn't die , but , " If I desire that he stay until I come , what is that to you ? "

verses.z: 為這些事作見證，並且記載這些事的就是這門徒；我們也知道他的見證是真的。
verses.e: This is the disciple who testifies about these things , and wrote these things . We know that his witness is true .

verses.z: 耶穌所行的事還有許多，若是一一地都寫出來，我想，所寫的書就是世界也容不下了。
verses.e: There are also many other things which Jesus did , which if they would all be written , I suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written .

verses.z: 西門‧彼得對他們說：「我打魚去。」他們說：「我們也和你同去。」他們就出去，上了船；那一夜並沒有打着甚麼。
verses.e: Simon Peter said to them , " I'm going fishing . " They told him , " We are also coming with you . " They immediately went out and entered into the boat . That night , they caught nothing .

verses.z: 天將亮的時候，耶穌站在岸上，門徒卻不知道是耶穌。
verses.e: But when day had already come , Jesus stood on the beach ; yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus .

verses.z: 耶穌就對他們說：「小子！你們有吃的沒有？」他們回答說：「沒有。」
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them , " Children , have you anything to eat ? " They answered him , " No . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們把網撒在船的右邊，就必得着。」他們便撒下網去，竟拉不上來了，因為魚甚多。
verses.e: He said to them , " Cast the net on the right side of the boat , and you will find some . " They cast it therefore , and now they weren't able to draw it in for the multitude of fish .

verses.z: 耶穌所愛的那門徒對彼得說：「是主！」那時西門‧彼得赤着身子，一聽見是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海裏。
verses.e: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter , " It's the Lord ! " So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he wrapped his coat around himself ( for he was naked ) , and threw himself into the sea .

verses.z: 其餘的門徒離岸不遠，約有二百肘，就在小船上把那網魚拉過來。
verses.e: But the other disciples came in the little boat ( for they were not far from the land , but about two hundred cubits away ) , dragging the net full of fish .

verses.z: 他們上了岸，就看見那裏有炭火，上面有魚，又有餅。
verses.e: So when they got out on the land , they saw a fire of coals there , with fish and bread laid on it .

verses.z: 有一個法利賽人，名叫尼哥德慕，是猶太人的官。
verses.e: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你是以色列人的先生，還不明白這事嗎？
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Are you the teacher of Israel , and don't understand these things ?

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你，我們所說的是我們知道的；我們所見證的是我們見過的；你們卻不領受我們的見證。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen , and you don't receive our witness .

verses.z: 我對你們說地上的事，你們尚且不信，若說天上的事，如何能信呢？
verses.e: If I told you earthly things and you don't believe , how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things ?

verses.z: 除了從天降下、仍舊在天的人子，沒有人升過天。
verses.e: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven , the Son of Man , who is in heaven .

verses.z: 摩西在曠野怎樣舉蛇，人子也必照樣被舉起來，
verses.e: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness , even so must the Son of Man be lifted up ,

verses.z: 叫一切信他的都得永生。
verses.e: that whoever believes in him should not perish , but have eternal life .

verses.z: 「上帝愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給[他們]，叫一切信他的，不致滅亡，反得永生。
verses.e: For God so loved the world , that he gave his only born Son , that whoever believes in him should not perish , but have eternal life .

verses.z: 因為上帝差他的兒子降世，不是要定世人的罪，乃是要叫世人因他得救。
verses.e: For God didn't send his Son into the world to judge the world , but that the world should be saved through him .

verses.z: 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已經定了，因為他不信上帝獨生子的名。
verses.e: He who believes in him is not judged . He who doesn't believe has been judged already , because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God .

verses.z: 光來到世間，世人因自己的行為是惡的，不愛光，倒愛黑暗，定他們的罪就是在此。
verses.e: This is the judgment , that the light has come into the world , and men loved the darkness rather than the light , for their works were evil .

verses.z: 這人夜裏來見耶穌，說：「拉比，我們知道你是由上帝那裏來作師傅的；因為你所行的神蹟，若沒有上帝同在，無人能行。」
verses.e: He came to Jesus by night and said to him , " Rabbi , we know that you are a teacher come from God , for no one can do these signs that you do , unless God is with him . "

verses.z: 凡作惡的便恨光，並不來就光，恐怕他的行為受責備。
verses.e: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn't come to the light , lest his works would be exposed .

verses.z: 但行真理的必來就光，要顯明他所行的是靠上帝而行。」
verses.e: But he who does the truth comes to the light , that his works may be revealed , that they have been done in God . "

verses.z: 這事以後，耶穌和門徒到了猶太地，在那裏居住，施洗。
verses.e: After these things , Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea . He stayed there with them and baptized .

verses.z: 約翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因為那裏水多，眾人都去受洗。（
verses.e: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim , because there was much water there . They came and were baptized ;

verses.z: 那時約翰還沒有下在監裏。）
verses.e: for John was not yet thrown into prison .

verses.z: 約翰的門徒和一個猶太人辯論潔淨的禮，
verses.e: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification .

verses.z: 就來見約翰，說：「拉比，從前同你在約旦河外、你所見證的那位，現在施洗，眾人都往他那裏去了。」
verses.e: They came to John and said to him , " Rabbi , he who was with you beyond the Jordan , to whom you have testified , behold , he baptizes , and everyone is coming to him . "

verses.z: 約翰說：「若不是從天上賜的，人就不能得甚麼。
verses.e: John answered , " A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven .

verses.z: 我曾說：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你們自己可以給我作見證。
verses.e: You yourselves testify that I said , ' I am not the Christ , ' but , ' I have been sent before him . '

verses.z: 娶新婦的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站着，聽見新郎的聲音就甚喜樂。故此，我這喜樂滿足了。
verses.e: He who has the bride is the bridegroom ; but the friend of the bridegroom , who stands and hears him , rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice . Therefore my joy is made full .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不重生，就不能見上帝的國。」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Most certainly I tell you , unless one is born anew , he can't see God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 他必興旺，我必衰微。」
verses.e: He must increase , but I must decrease .

verses.z: 「從天上來的是在萬有之上；從地上來的是屬乎地，他所說的也是屬乎地。從天上來的是在萬有之上。
verses.e: " He who comes from above is above all . He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth . He who comes from heaven is above all .

verses.z: 他將所見所聞的見證出來，只是沒有人領受他的見證。
verses.e: What he has seen and heard , of that he testifies ; and no one receives his witness .

verses.z: 那領受他見證的，就印上印，證明上帝是真的。
verses.e: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this , that God is true .

verses.z: 上帝所差來的就說上帝的話，因為上帝賜[聖]靈[給他]是沒有限量的。
verses.e: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God ; for God gives the Spirit without measure .

verses.z: 父愛子，已將萬有交在他手裏。
verses.e: The Father loves the Son , and has given all things into his hand .

verses.z: 信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不着[永]生，上帝的震怒常在他身上。」
verses.e: One who believes in the Son has eternal life , but one who disobeys the Son won't see life , but the wrath of God remains on him . "

verses.z: 尼哥德慕說：「人已經老了，如何能重生呢？豈能再進母腹生出來嗎？」
verses.e: Nicodemus said to him , " How can a man be born when he is old ? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb and be born ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不是從水和[聖]靈生的，就不能進上帝的國。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " Most certainly I tell you , unless one is born of water and Spirit , he can't enter into God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 從肉身生的就是肉身；從靈生的就是靈。
verses.e: That which is born of the flesh is flesh . That which is born of the Spirit is spirit .

verses.z: 我說：『你們必須重生』，你不要以為希奇。
verses.e: Don't marvel that I said to you , ' You must be born anew . '

verses.z: 風隨着意思吹，你聽見風的響聲，卻不曉得從哪裏來，往哪裏去；凡從[聖]靈生的，也是如此。」
verses.e: The wind blows where it wants to , and you hear its sound , but don't know where it comes from and where it is going . So is everyone who is born of the Spirit . "

verses.z: 尼哥德慕問他說：「怎能有這事呢？」
verses.e: Nicodemus answered him , " How can these things be ? "

verses.z: 主知道法利賽人聽見他收門徒，施洗，比約翰還多，（
verses.e: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你若知道上帝的恩賜，和對你說『給我水喝』的是誰，你必早求他，他也必早給了你活水。」
verses.e: Jesus answered her , " If you knew the gift of God , and who it is who says to you , ' Give me a drink , ' you would have asked him , and he would have given you living water . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「先生，沒有打水的器具，井又深，你從哪裏得活水呢？
verses.e: The woman said to him , " Sir , you have nothing to draw with , and the well is deep . So where do you get that living water ?

verses.z: 我們的祖宗雅各將這井留給我們，他自己和兒子並牲畜也都喝這井裏的水，難道你比他還大嗎？」
verses.e: Are you greater than our father Jacob , who gave us the well and drank from it himself , as did his children and his livestock ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「凡喝這水的還要再渴；
verses.e: Jesus answered her , " Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again ,

verses.z: 人若喝我所賜的水就永遠不渴。我所賜的水要在他裏頭成為泉源，直湧到永生。」
verses.e: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again ; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「先生，請把這水賜給我，叫我不渴，也不用來這麼遠打水。」
verses.e: The woman said to him , " Sir , give me this water , so that I don't get thirsty , neither come all the way here to draw . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你去叫你丈夫也到這裏來。」
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Go , call your husband , and come here . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「我沒有丈夫。」耶穌說：「你說沒有丈夫是不錯的。
verses.e: The woman answered , " I have no husband . " Jesus said to her , " You said well , ' I have no husband , '

verses.z: 你已經有五個丈夫，你現在有的並不是你的丈夫。你這話是真的。」
verses.e: for you have had five husbands ; and he whom you now have is not your husband . This you have said truly . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「先生，我看出你是先知。
verses.e: The woman said to him , " Sir , I perceive that you are a prophet .

verses.z: 其實不是耶穌親自施洗，乃是他的門徒施洗，）
verses.e: ( although Jesus himself didn't baptize , but his disciples ) ,

verses.z: 我們的祖宗在這山上禮拜，你們倒說，應當禮拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」
verses.e: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain , and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「婦人，你當信我。時候將到，你們拜父，也不在這山上，也不在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " Woman , believe me , the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father .

verses.z: 你們所拜的，你們不知道；我們所拜的，我們知道，因為救恩是從猶太人出來的。
verses.e: You worship that which you don't know . We worship that which we know ; for salvation is from the Jews .

verses.z: 時候將到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心靈和誠實拜他，因為父要這樣的人拜他。」
verses.e: But the hour comes , and now is , when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth , for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers .

verses.z: 上帝是個靈，所以拜他的必須用心靈和誠實拜他。」
verses.e: God is spirit , and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「我知道彌賽亞（就是那稱為基督的）要來；他來了，必將一切的事都告訴我們。」
verses.e: The woman said to him , " I know that Messiah is coming , he who is called Christ . When he has come , he will declare to us all things . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這和你說話的就是他！」
verses.e: Jesus said to her , " I am he , the one who speaks to you . "

verses.z: 當下門徒回來，就希奇耶穌和一個婦人說話；只是沒有人說：「你是要甚麼？」或說：「你為甚麼和她說話？」
verses.e: Just then , his disciples came . They marveled that he was speaking with a woman ; yet no one said , " What are you looking for ? " or , " Why do you speak with her ? "

verses.z: 那婦人就留下水罐子，往城裏去，對眾人說：
verses.e: So the woman left her water pot , went away into the city , and said to the people ,

verses.z: 「你們來看！有一個人將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了，莫非這就是基督嗎？」
verses.e: " Come , see a man who told me everything that I have done . Can this be the Christ ? "

verses.z: 他就離了猶太，又往加利利去。
verses.e: he left Judea and departed into Galilee .

verses.z: 眾人就出城，往耶穌那裏去。
verses.e: They went out of the city , and were coming to him .

verses.z: 這其間，門徒對耶穌說：「拉比，請吃。」
verses.e: In the meanwhile , the disciples urged him , saying , " Rabbi , eat . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我有食物吃，是你們不知道的。」
verses.e: But he said to them , " I have food to eat that you don't know about . "

verses.z: 門徒就彼此對問說：「莫非有人拿甚麼給他吃嗎？」
verses.e: The disciples therefore said to one another , " Has anyone brought him something to eat ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意，做成他的工。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work .

verses.z: 你們豈不說『到收割的時候還有四個月』嗎？我告訴你們，舉目向田觀看，莊稼已經熟了，可以收割了。
verses.e: Don't you say , ' There are yet four months until the harvest ' ? Behold , I tell you , lift up your eyes and look at the fields , that they are white for harvest already .

verses.z: 收割的人得工價，積蓄五穀到永生，叫撒種的和收割的一同快樂。
verses.e: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life , that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together .

verses.z: 俗語說：『那人撒種，這人收割』，這話可見是真的。
verses.e: For in this the saying is true , ' One sows , and another reaps . '

verses.z: 我差你們去收你們所沒有勞苦的；別人勞苦，你們享受他們所勞苦的。」
verses.e: I sent you to reap that for which you haven't labored . Others have labored , and you have entered into their labor . "

verses.z: 那城裏有好些撒馬利亞人信了耶穌，因為那婦人作見證說：「他將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了。」
verses.e: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman , who testified , " He told me everything that I have done . "

verses.z: 必須經過撒馬利亞，
verses.e: He needed to pass through Samaria .

verses.z: 於是撒馬利亞人來見耶穌，求他在他們那裏住下，他便在那裏住了兩天。
verses.e: So when the Samaritans came to him , they begged him to stay with them . He stayed there two days .

verses.z: 因耶穌的話，信的人就更多了，
verses.e: Many more believed because of his word .

verses.z: 便對婦人說：「現在我們信，不是因為你的話，是我們親自聽見了，知道這真是救世主。」
verses.e: They said to the woman , " Now we believe , not because of your speaking ; for we have heard for ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Savior of the world . "

verses.z: 過了那兩天，耶穌離了那地方，往加利利去。
verses.e: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee .

verses.z: 因為耶穌自己作過見證說：「先知在本地是沒有人尊敬的。」
verses.e: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country .

verses.z: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看見他在耶路撒冷過節所行的一切事，就接待他，因為他們也是上去過節。
verses.e: So when he came into Galilee , the Galileans received him , having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast , for they also went to the feast .

verses.z: 耶穌又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他從前變水為酒的地方。有一個大臣，他的兒子在迦百農患病。
verses.e: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee , where he made the water into wine . There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum .

verses.z: 他聽見耶穌從猶太到了加利利，就來見他，求他下去醫治他的兒子，因為他兒子快要死了。
verses.e: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee , he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son , for he was at the point of death .

verses.z: 耶穌就對他說：「若不看見神蹟奇事，你們總是不信。」
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to him , " Unless you see signs and wonders , you will in no way believe . "

verses.z: 那大臣說：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子還沒有死就下去。」
verses.e: The nobleman said to him , " Sir , come down before my child dies . "

verses.z: 於是到了撒馬利亞的一座城，名叫敘加，靠近雅各給他兒子約瑟的那塊地。
verses.e: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar , near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph .

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「回去吧，你的兒子活了！」那人信耶穌所說的話就回去了。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Go your way . Your son lives . " The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him , and he went his way .

verses.z: 正下去的時候，他的僕人迎見他，說他的兒子活了。
verses.e: As he was going down , his servants met him and reported , saying " Your child lives ! "

verses.z: 他就問甚麼時候見好的。他們說：「昨日未時熱就退了。」
verses.e: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better . They said therefore to him , " Yesterday at the seventh hour , the fever left him . "

verses.z: 他便知道這正是耶穌對他說「你兒子活了」的時候；他自己和全家就都信了。
verses.e: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him , " Your son lives . " He believed , as did his whole house .

verses.z: 這是耶穌在加利利行的第二件神蹟，是他從猶太回去以後行的。
verses.e: This is again the second sign that Jesus did , having come out of Judea into Galilee .

verses.z: 在那裏有雅各井；耶穌因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那時約有午正。
verses.e: Jacob's well was there . Jesus therefore , being tired from his journey , sat down by the well . It was about the sixth hour .

verses.z: 有一個撒馬利亞的婦人來打水。耶穌對她說：「請你給我水喝。」（
verses.e: A woman of Samaria came to draw water . Jesus said to her , " Give me a drink . "

verses.z: 那時門徒進城買食物去了。）
verses.e: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food .

verses.z: 撒馬利亞的婦人對他說：「你既是猶太人，怎麼向我一個撒馬利亞婦人要水喝呢？」原來猶太人和撒馬利亞人沒有來往。
verses.e: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him , " How is it that you , being a Jew , ask for a drink from me , a Samaritan woman ? " ( For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans . )

verses.z: 這事以後，到了猶太人的一個節期，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: After these things , there was a feast of the Jews , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 那天是安息日，所以猶太人對那醫好的人說：「今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。」
verses.e: So the Jews said to him who was cured , " It is the Sabbath . It is not lawful for you to carry the mat . "

verses.z: 他卻回答說：「那使我痊癒的，對我說：『拿你的褥子走吧。』」
verses.e: He answered them , " He who made me well said to me , ' Take up your mat and walk . ' "

verses.z: 他們問他說：「對你說『拿褥子走』的是甚麼人？」
verses.e: Then they asked him , " Who is the man who said to you , ' Take up your mat and walk ' ? "

verses.z: 那醫好的人不知道是誰；因為那裏的人多，耶穌已經躲開了。
verses.e: But he who was healed didn't know who it was , for Jesus had withdrawn , a crowd being in the place .

verses.z: 後來耶穌在殿裏遇見他，對他說：「你已經痊癒了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。」
verses.e: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him , " Behold , you are made well . Sin no more , so that nothing worse happens to you . "

verses.z: 那人就去告訴猶太人，使他痊癒的是耶穌。
verses.e: The man went away , and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well .

verses.z: 所以猶太人逼迫耶穌，因為他在安息日做了這事。
verses.e: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him , because he did these things on the Sabbath .

verses.z: 耶穌就對他們說：「我父做事直到如今，我也做事。」
verses.e: But Jesus answered them , " My Father is still working , so I am working , too . "

verses.z: 所以猶太人越發想要殺他；因他不但犯了安息日，並且稱上帝為他的父，將自己和上帝當作平等。
verses.e: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him , because he not only broke the Sabbath , but also called God his own Father , making himself equal with God .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，子憑着自己不能做甚麼，惟有看見父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照樣做。
verses.e: Jesus therefore answered them , " Most certainly , I tell you , the Son can do nothing of himself , but what he sees the Father doing . For whatever things he does , these the Son also does likewise .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊[門]有一個池子，希伯來話叫作畢士大，[旁邊]有五個廊子；
