verses.e: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate , there is a pool , which is called in Hebrew , " Bethesda " , having five porches .

verses.z: 父愛子，將自己所做的一切事指給他看，還要將比這更大的事指給他看，叫你們希奇。
verses.e: For the Father has affection for the Son , and shows him all things that he himself does . He will show him greater works than these , that you may marvel .

verses.z: 父怎樣叫死人起來，使他們活着，子也照樣隨自己的意思使人活着。
verses.e: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life , even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires .

verses.z: 父不審判甚麼人，乃將審判的事全交與子，
verses.e: For the Father judges no one , but he has given all judgment to the Son ,

verses.z: 叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一樣。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子來的父。
verses.e: that all may honor the Son , even as they honor the Father . He who doesn't honor the Son doesn't honor the Father who sent him .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，那聽我話、又信差我來者的，就有永生；不至於定罪，是已經出死入生了。
verses.e: " Most certainly I tell you , he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life , and doesn't come into judgment , but has passed out of death into life .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，時候將到，現在就是了，死人要聽見上帝兒子的聲音，聽見的人就要活了。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , the hour comes , and now is , when the dead will hear the Son of God's voice ; and those who hear will live .

verses.z: 因為父怎樣在自己有生命，就賜給他兒子也照樣在自己有生命，
verses.e: For as the Father has life in himself , even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself .

verses.z: 並且因為他是人子，就賜給他行審判的權柄。
verses.e: He also gave him authority to execute judgment , because he is a son of man .

verses.z: 你們不要把這事看作希奇。時候要到，凡在墳墓裏的，都要聽見他的聲音，就出來：
verses.e: Don't marvel at this , for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

verses.z: 行善的，復活得生；作惡的，復活定罪。
verses.e: and will come out ; those who have done good , to the resurrection of life ; and those who have done evil , to the resurrection of judgment .

verses.z: 裏面躺着瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血氣枯乾的許多病人。
verses.e: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick , blind , lame , or paralyzed , waiting for the moving of the water ;

verses.z: 「我憑着自己不能做甚麼，我怎麼聽見就怎麼審判。我的審判也是公平的；因為我不求自己的意思，只求那差我來者的意思。」
verses.e: I can of myself do nothing . As I hear , I judge ; and my judgment is righteous , because I don't seek my own will , but the will of my Father who sent me .

verses.z: 「我若為自己作見證，我的見證就不真。
verses.e: " If I testify about myself , my witness is not valid .

verses.z: 另有一位給我作見證，我也知道他給我作的見證是真的。
verses.e: It is another who testifies about me . I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true .

verses.z: 你們曾差人到約翰那裏，他為真理作過見證。
verses.e: You have sent to John , and he has testified to the truth .

verses.z: 其實，我所受的見證不是從人來的；然而，我說這些話，為要叫你們得救。
verses.e: But the testimony which I receive is not from man . However , I say these things that you may be saved .

verses.z: 約翰是點着的明燈，你們情願暫時喜歡他的光。
verses.e: He was the burning and shining lamp , and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light .

verses.z: 但我有比約翰更大的見證；因為父交給我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，這便見證我是父所差來的。
verses.e: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John ; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish , the very works that I do , testify about me , that the Father has sent me .

verses.z: 差我來的父也為我作過見證。你們從來沒有聽見他的聲音，也沒有看見他的形像。
verses.e: The Father himself , who sent me , has testified about me . You have neither heard his voice at any time , nor seen his form .

verses.z: 你們並沒有他的道存在心裏；因為他所差來的，你們不信。
verses.e: You don't have his word living in you , because you don't believe him whom he sent .

verses.z: 你們查考聖經，因你們以為內中有永生；給我作見證的就是這經。
verses.e: " You search the Scriptures , because you think that in them you have eternal life ; and these are they which testify about me .
for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water . Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had .

verses.z: 然而，你們不肯到我這裏來得生命。
verses.e: Yet you will not come to me , that you may have life .

verses.z: 「我不受從人來的榮耀。
verses.e: I don't receive glory from men .

verses.z: 但我知道，你們心裏沒有上帝的愛。
verses.e: But I know you , that you don't have God's love in yourselves .

verses.z: 我奉我父的名來，你們並不接待我；若有別人奉自己的名來，你們倒要接待他。
verses.e: I have come in my Father's name , and you don't receive me . If another comes in his own name , you will receive him .

verses.z: 你們互相受榮耀，卻不求從獨一之上帝來的榮耀，怎能信[我]呢？
verses.e: How can you believe , who receive glory from one another , and you don't seek the glory that comes from the only God ?

verses.z: 不要想我在父面前要告你們；有一位告你們的，就是你們所仰賴的摩西。
verses.e: " Don't think that I will accuse you to the Father . There is one who accuses you , even Moses , on whom you have set your hope .

verses.z: 你們如果信摩西，也必信我，因為他[書上]有指着我寫的話。
verses.e: For if you believed Moses , you would believe me ; for he wrote about me .

verses.z: 你們若不信他的書，怎能信我的話呢？」
verses.e: But if you don't believe his writings , how will you believe my words ? "

verses.z: 在那裏有一個人，病了三十八年。
verses.e: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years .

verses.z: 耶穌看見他躺着，知道他病了許久，就問他說：「你要痊癒嗎？」
verses.e: When Jesus saw him lying there , and knew that he had been sick for a long time , he asked him , " Do you want to be made well ? "

verses.z: 病人回答說：「先生，水動的時候，沒有人把我放在池子裏；我正去的時候，就有別人比我先下去。」
verses.e: The sick man answered him , " Sir , I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up , but while I'm coming , another steps down before me . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「起來，拿你的褥子走吧！」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Arise , take up your mat , and walk . "

verses.z: 那人立刻痊癒，就拿起褥子來走了。
verses.e: Immediately , the man was made well , and took up his mat and walked . Now that day was a Sabbath .

verses.z: 這事以後，耶穌渡過加利利海，就是提比哩亞海。
verses.e: After these things , Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee , which is also called the Sea of Tiberias .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們叫眾人坐下。」原來那地方的草多，眾人就坐下，數目約有五千。
verses.e: Jesus said , " Have the people sit down . " Now there was much grass in that place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand .

verses.z: 耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，就分給那坐着的人；分魚也是這樣，都隨着他們所要的。
verses.e: Jesus took the loaves , and having given thanks , he distributed to the disciples , and the disciples to those who were sitting down , likewise also of the fish as much as they desired .

verses.z: 他們吃飽了，耶穌對門徒說：「把剩下的零碎收拾起來，免得有糟蹋的。」
verses.e: When they were filled , he said to his disciples , " Gather up the broken pieces which are left over , that nothing be lost . "

verses.z: 他們便將那五個大麥餅的零碎，就是眾人吃了剩下的，收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
verses.e: So they gathered them up , and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves , which were left over by those who had eaten .

verses.z: 眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就說：「這真是那要到世間來的先知！」
verses.e: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did , they said , " This is truly the prophet who comes into the world . "

verses.z: 耶穌既知道眾人要來強逼他作王，就獨自又退到山上去了。
verses.e: Jesus therefore , perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king , withdrew again to the mountain by himself .

verses.z: 到了晚上，他的門徒下海邊去，
verses.e: When evening came , his disciples went down to the sea .

verses.z: 上了船，要過海往迦百農去。天已經黑了，耶穌還沒有來到他們那裏。
verses.e: They entered into the boat , and were going over the sea to Capernaum . It was now dark , and Jesus had not come to them .

verses.z: 忽然狂風大作，海就翻騰起來。
verses.e: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing .

verses.z: 門徒搖櫓，約行了十里多路，看見耶穌在海面上走，漸漸近了船，他們就害怕。
verses.e: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia , they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat ; and they were afraid .

verses.z: 有許多人因為看見他在病人身上所行的神蹟，就跟隨他。
verses.e: A great multitude followed him , because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「是我，不要怕！」
verses.e: But he said to them , " It is I . Don't be afraid . "

verses.z: 門徒就喜歡接他上船，船立時到了他們所要去的地方。
verses.e: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat . Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going .

verses.z: 第二日，站在海那邊的眾人知道那裏沒有別的船，只有一隻小船，又知道耶穌沒有同他的門徒上船，乃是門徒自己去的。
verses.e: On the next day , the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there , except the one in which his disciples had embarked , and that Jesus hadn't entered with his disciples into the boat , but his disciples had gone away alone .

verses.z: 然而，有幾隻小船從提比哩亞來，靠近主祝謝後[分餅給人]吃的地方。
verses.e: However , boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks .

verses.z: 眾人見耶穌和門徒都不在那裏，就上了船，往迦百農去找耶穌。
verses.e: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn't there , nor his disciples , they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum , seeking Jesus .

verses.z: 既在海那邊找着了，就對他說：「拉比，是幾時到這裏來的？」
verses.e: When they found him on the other side of the sea , they asked him , " Rabbi , when did you come here ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們找我，並不是因見了神蹟，乃是因吃餅得飽。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Most certainly I tell you , you seek me , not because you saw signs , but because you ate of the loaves and were filled .

verses.z: 不要為那必壞的食物勞力，要為那存到永生的食物勞力，就是人子要賜給你們的，因為人子是父上帝所印證的。」
verses.e: Don't work for the food which perishes , but for the food which remains to eternal life , which the Son of Man will give to you . For God the Father has sealed him . "

verses.z: 眾人問他說：「我們當行甚麼才算做上帝的工呢？」
verses.e: They said therefore to him , " What must we do , that we may work the works of God ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「信上帝所差來的，這就是做上帝的工。」
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " This is the work of God , that you believe in him whom he has sent . "

verses.z: 耶穌上了山，和門徒一同坐在那裏。
verses.e: Jesus went up into the mountain , and he sat there with his disciples .

verses.z: 他們又說：「你行甚麼神蹟，叫我們看見就信你；你到底做甚麼事呢？
verses.e: They said therefore to him , " What then do you do for a sign , that we may see and believe you ? What work do you do ?

verses.z: 我們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，如[經上]寫着說：『他從天上賜下糧來給他們吃。』」
verses.e: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness . As it is written , ' He gave them bread out of heaven to eat . ' "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，那從天上來的糧不是摩西賜給你們的，乃是我父將天上來的真糧賜給你們。
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them , " Most certainly , I tell you , it wasn't Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven , but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven .

verses.z: 因為上帝的糧就是那從天上降下來、賜生命給世界的。」
verses.e: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world . "

verses.z: 他們說：「主啊，常將這糧賜給我們！」
verses.e: They said therefore to him , " Lord , always give us this bread . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我就是生命的糧。到我這裏來的，必定不餓；信我的，永遠不渴。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " I am the bread of life . Whoever comes to me will not be hungry , and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty .

verses.z: 只是我對你們說過，你們已經看見我，還是不信。
verses.e: But I told you that you have seen me , and yet you don't believe .

verses.z: 凡父所賜給我的人必到我這裏來；到我這裏來的，我總不丟棄他。
verses.e: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me . He who comes to me I will in no way throw out .

verses.z: 因為我從天上降下來，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我來者的意思行。
verses.e: For I have come down from heaven , not to do my own will , but the will of him who sent me .

verses.z: 差我來者的意思就是：他所賜給我的，叫我一個也不失落，在末日卻叫他復活。
verses.e: This is the will of my Father who sent me , that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing , but should raise him up at the last day .

verses.z: 那時猶太人的逾越節近了。
verses.e: Now the Passover , the feast of the Jews , was at hand .

verses.z: 因為我父的意思是叫一切見子而信的人得永生，並且在末日我要叫他復活。」
verses.e: This is the will of the one who sent me , that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life ; and I will raise him up at the last day . "

verses.z: 猶太人因為耶穌說「我是從天上降下來的糧」，就私下議論他，
verses.e: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him , because he said , " I am the bread which came down out of heaven . "

verses.z: 說：「這不是約瑟的兒子耶穌嗎？他的父母我們豈不認得嗎？他如今怎麼說『我是從天上降下來的』呢？」
verses.e: They said , " Isn't this Jesus , the son of Joseph , whose father and mother we know ? How then does he say , ' I have come down out of heaven ' ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們不要大家議論。
verses.e: Therefore Jesus answered them , " Don't murmur among yourselves .

verses.z: 若不是差我來的父吸引人，就沒有能到我這裏來的；[到我這裏來的]，在末日我要叫他復活。
verses.e: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him ; and I will raise him up in the last day .

verses.z: 在先知書上寫着說：『他們都要蒙上帝的教訓。』凡聽見父[之教訓]又學習的，就到我這裏來。
verses.e: It is written in the prophets , ' They will all be taught by God . ' Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned , comes to me .

verses.z: 這不是說有人看見過父，惟獨從上帝來的，他看見過父。
verses.e: Not that anyone has seen the Father , except he who is from God . He has seen the Father .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，信的人有永生。
verses.e: Most certainly , I tell you , he who believes in me has eternal life .

verses.z: 我就是生命的糧。
verses.e: I am the bread of life .

verses.z: 你們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，還是死了。
verses.e: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died .

verses.z: 耶穌舉目看見許多人來，就對腓力說：「我們從哪裏買餅叫這些人吃呢？」（
verses.e: Jesus therefore , lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him , said to Philip , " Where are we to buy bread , that these may eat ? "

verses.z: 這是從天上降下來的糧，叫人吃了就不死。
verses.e: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven , that anyone may eat of it and not die .

verses.z: 我是從天上降下來生命的糧；人若吃這糧，就必永遠活着。我所要賜的糧就是我的肉，為世人之生命所賜的。」
verses.e: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven . If anyone eats of this bread , he will live forever . Yes , the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh . "

verses.z: 因此，猶太人彼此爭論說：「這個人怎能把他的肉給我們吃呢？」
verses.e: The Jews therefore contended with one another , saying , " How can this man give us his flesh to eat ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就沒有生命在你們裏面。
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them , " Most certainly I tell you , unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood , you don't have life in yourselves .

verses.z: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他復活。
verses.e: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life , and I will raise him up at the last day .

verses.z: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。
verses.e: For my flesh is food indeed , and my blood is drink indeed .

verses.z: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我裏面，我也常在他裏面。
verses.e: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me , and I in him .

verses.z: 永活的父怎樣差我來，我又因父活着；照樣，吃我[肉]的人也要因我活着。
verses.e: As the living Father sent me , and I live because of the Father , so he who feeds on me will also live because of me .

verses.z: 這就是從天上降下來的糧。吃這糧的人就永遠活着，不像[你們的]祖宗吃過[嗎哪]還是死了。」
verses.e: This is the bread which came down out of heaven — not as our fathers ate the manna and died . He who eats this bread will live forever . "

verses.z: 這些話是耶穌在迦百農會堂裏教訓人說的。
verses.e: He said these things in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum .

verses.z: 他說這話是要試驗腓力；他自己原知道要怎樣行。）
verses.e: He said this to test him , for he himself knew what he would do .

verses.z: 他的門徒中有好些人聽見了，就說：「這話甚難，誰能聽呢？」
verses.e: Therefore many of his disciples , when they heard this , said , " This is a hard saying ! Who can listen to it ? "

verses.z: 耶穌心裏知道門徒為這話議論，就對他們說：「這話是叫你們厭棄嗎？
verses.e: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this , said to them , " Does this cause you to stumble ?

verses.z: 倘或你們看見人子升到他原來所在之處，怎麼樣呢？
verses.e: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before ?

verses.z: 叫人活着的乃是靈，肉體是無益的。我對你們所說的話就是靈，就是生命。
verses.e: It is the spirit who gives life . The flesh profits nothing . The words that I speak to you are spirit , and are life .

verses.z: 只是你們中間有不信的人。」耶穌從起頭就知道誰不信他，誰要賣他。
verses.e: But there are some of you who don't believe . " For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn't believe , and who it was who would betray him .

verses.z: 耶穌又說：「所以我對你們說過，若不是蒙我父的恩賜，沒有人能到我這裏來。」
verses.e: He said , " For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me , unless it is given to him by my Father . "

verses.z: 從此，他門徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。
verses.e: At this , many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him .

verses.z: 耶穌就對那十二個門徒說：「你們也要去嗎？」
verses.e: Jesus said therefore to the twelve , " You don't also want to go away , do you ? "

verses.z: 西門‧彼得回答說：「主啊，你有永生之道，我們還歸從誰呢？
verses.e: Simon Peter answered him , " Lord , to whom would we go ? You have the words of eternal life .

verses.z: 我們已經信了，又知道你是上帝的聖者。」
verses.e: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ , the Son of the living God . "

verses.z: 腓力回答說：「就是二十兩銀子的餅，叫他們各人吃一點也是不夠的。」
verses.e: Philip answered him , " Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may receive a little . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我不是揀選了你們十二個門徒嗎？但你們中間有一個是魔鬼。」
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Didn't I choose you , the twelve , and one of you is a devil ? "

verses.z: 耶穌這話是指着加略人西門的兒子猶大說的；他本是十二個門徒裏的一個，後來要賣耶穌的。
verses.e: Now he spoke of Judas , the son of Simon Iscariot , for it was he who would betray him , being one of the twelve .

verses.z: 有一個門徒，就是西門‧彼得的兄弟安得烈，對耶穌說：
verses.e: One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter's brother , said to him ,

verses.z: 「在這裏有一個孩童，帶着五個大麥餅、兩條魚，只是分給這許多人還算甚麼呢？」
verses.e: " There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish , but what are these among so many ? "

verses.z: 這事以後，耶穌在加利利遊行，不願在猶太遊行，因為猶太人想要殺他。
verses.e: After these things , Jesus was walking in Galilee , for he wouldn't walk in Judea , because the Jews sought to kill him .

verses.z: 但他弟兄上去以後，他也上去過節，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
verses.e: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast , then he also went up , not publicly , but as it were in secret .

verses.z: 正在節期，猶太人尋找耶穌，說：「他在哪裏？」
verses.e: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast , and said , " Where is he ? "

verses.z: 眾人為他紛紛議論，有的說：「他是好人。」有的說：「不然，他是迷惑眾人的。」
verses.e: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him . Some said , " He is a good man . " Others said , " Not so , but he leads the multitude astray . "

verses.z: 只是沒有人明明地講論他，因為怕猶太人。
verses.e: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews .

verses.z: 到了節期，耶穌上殿裏去教訓人。
verses.e: But when it was now the middle of the feast , Jesus went up into the temple and taught .

verses.z: 猶太人就希奇，說：「這個人沒有學過，怎麼明白書呢？」
verses.e: The Jews therefore marveled , saying , " How does this man know letters , having never been educated ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我的教訓不是我自己的，乃是那差我來者的。
verses.e: Jesus therefore answered them , " My teaching is not mine , but his who sent me .

verses.z: 人若立志遵着他的旨意行，就必曉得這教訓或是出於上帝，或是我憑着自己說的。
verses.e: If anyone desires to do his will , he will know about the teaching , whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself .

verses.z: 人憑着自己說，是求自己的榮耀；惟有求那差他來者的榮耀，這人是真的，在他心裏沒有不義。
verses.e: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory , but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true , and no unrighteousness is in him .

verses.z: 摩西豈不是傳律法給你們嗎？你們卻沒有一個人守律法。為甚麼想要殺我呢？」
verses.e: Didn't Moses give you the law , and yet none of you keeps the law ? Why do you seek to kill me ? "

verses.z: 當時猶太人的住棚節近了。
verses.e: Now the feast of the Jews , the Feast of Booths , was at hand .

verses.z: 眾人回答說：「你是被鬼附着了！誰想要殺你？」
verses.e: The multitude answered , " You have a demon ! Who seeks to kill you ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我做了一件事，你們都以為希奇。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " I did one work and you all marvel because of it .

verses.z: 摩西傳割禮給你們（其實不是從摩西起的，乃是從祖先起的），因此你們也在安息日給人行割禮。
verses.e: Moses has given you circumcision ( not that it is of Moses , but of the fathers ) , and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy .

verses.z: 人若在安息日受割禮，免得違背摩西的律法，我在安息日叫一個人全然好了，你們就向我生氣嗎？
verses.e: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath , that the law of Moses may not be broken , are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath ?

verses.z: 不可按外貌斷定是非，總要按公平斷定是非。」
verses.e: Don't judge according to appearance , but judge righteous judgment . "

verses.z: 耶路撒冷人中有的說：「這不是他們想要殺的人嗎？
verses.e: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said , " Isn't this he whom they seek to kill ?

verses.z: 你看他還明明地講道，他們也不向他說甚麼，難道官長真知道這是基督嗎？
verses.e: Behold , he speaks openly , and they say nothing to him . Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ ?

verses.z: 然而，我們知道這個人從哪裏來；只是基督來的時候，沒有人知道他從哪裏來。」
verses.e: However , we know where this man comes from , but when the Christ comes , no one will know where he comes from . "

verses.z: 那時，耶穌在殿裏教訓人，大聲說：「你們也知道我，也知道我從哪裏來；我來並不是由於自己。但那差我來的是真的。你們不認識他，
verses.e: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple , teaching and saying , " You both know me , and know where I am from . I have not come of myself , but he who sent me is true , whom you don't know .

verses.z: 我卻認識他；因為我是從他來的，他也是差了我來。」
verses.e: I know him , because I am from him , and he sent me . "

verses.z: 耶穌的弟兄就對他說：「你離開這裏上猶太去吧，叫你的門徒也看見你所行的事。
verses.e: His brothers therefore said to him , " Depart from here and go into Judea , that your disciples also may see your works which you do .

verses.z: 他們就想要捉拿耶穌；只是沒有人下手，因為他的時候還沒有到。
verses.e: They sought therefore to take him ; but no one laid a hand on him , because his hour had not yet come .

verses.z: 但眾人中間有好些信他的，說：「基督來的時候，他所行的神蹟豈能比這人所行的更多嗎？」
verses.e: But of the multitude , many believed in him . They said , " When the Christ comes , he won't do more signs than those which this man has done , will he ? "

verses.z: 法利賽人聽見眾人為耶穌這樣紛紛議論，祭司長和法利賽人就打發差役去捉拿他。
verses.e: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him , and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him .

verses.z: 於是耶穌說：「我還有不多的時候和你們同在，以後就回到差我來的那裏去。
verses.e: Then Jesus said , " I will be with you a little while longer , then I go to him who sent me .

verses.z: 你們要找我，卻找不着；我所在的地方你們不能到。」
verses.e: You will seek me and won't find me . You can't come where I am . "

verses.z: 猶太人就彼此對問說：「這人要往哪裏去，叫我們找不着呢？難道他要往散住希臘中的猶太人那裏去教訓希臘人嗎？
verses.e: The Jews therefore said among themselves , " Where will this man go that we won't find him ? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks ?

verses.z: 他說：『你們要找我，卻找不着；我所在的地方，你們不能到』，這話是甚麼意思呢？」
verses.e: What is this word that he said , ' You will seek me , and won't find me ; ' and ' Where I am , you can't come ' ? "

verses.z: 節期的末日，就是最大之日，耶穌站着高聲說：「人若渴了，可以到我這裏來喝。
verses.e: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast , Jesus stood and cried out , " If anyone is thirsty , let him come to me and drink !

verses.z: 信我的人就如經上所說：『從他腹中要流出活水的江河來。』」
verses.e: He who believes in me , as the Scripture has said , from within him will flow rivers of living water . "

verses.z: 耶穌這話是指着信他之人要受[聖]靈說的。那時還沒有[賜下聖]靈[來]，因為耶穌尚未得着榮耀。
verses.e: But he said this about the Spirit , which those believing in him were to receive . For the Holy Spirit was not yet given , because Jesus wasn't yet glorified .

verses.z: 人要顯揚名聲，沒有在暗處行事的；你如果行這些事，就當將自己顯明給世人看。」
verses.e: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly . If you do these things , reveal yourself to the world . "

verses.z: 眾人聽見這話，有的說：「這真是那先知。」
verses.e: Many of the multitude therefore , when they heard these words , said , " This is truly the prophet . "

verses.z: 有的說：「這是基督。」但也有的說：「基督豈是從加利利出來的嗎？
verses.e: Others said , " This is the Christ . " But some said , " What , does the Christ come out of Galilee ?

verses.z: 經上豈不是說『基督是大衛的後裔，從大衛本鄉伯利恆出來的』嗎？」
verses.e: Hasn't the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David , and from Bethlehem , the village where David was ? "

verses.z: 於是眾人因着耶穌起了紛爭。
verses.e: So a division arose in the multitude because of him .

verses.z: 其中有人要捉拿他，只是無人下手。
verses.e: Some of them would have arrested him , but no one laid hands on him .

verses.z: 差役回到祭司長和法利賽人那裏。他們對差役說：「你們為甚麼沒有帶他來呢？」
verses.e: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees ; and they said to them , " Why didn't you bring him ? "

verses.z: 差役回答說：「從來沒有像他這樣說話的！」
verses.e: The officers answered , " No man ever spoke like this man ! "

verses.z: 法利賽人說：「你們也受了迷惑嗎？
verses.e: The Pharisees therefore answered them , " You aren't also led astray , are you ?

verses.z: 官長或是法利賽人豈有信他的呢？
verses.e: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him ?

verses.z: 但這些不明白律法的百姓是被咒詛的！」
verses.e: But this multitude that doesn't know the law is cursed . "

verses.z: 因為連他的弟兄[說這話]，是因為不信他。
verses.e: For even his brothers didn't believe in him .

verses.z: 內中有尼哥德慕，就是從前去見耶穌的，對他們說：
verses.e: Nicodemus ( he who came to him by night , being one of them ) said to them ,

verses.z: 「不先聽本人的口供，不知道他所做的事，難道我們的律法還定他的罪嗎？」
verses.e: " Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does ? "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「你也是出於加利利嗎？你且去查考，就可知道加利利沒有出過先知。」
verses.e: They answered him , " Are you also from Galilee ? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee . "
Everyone went to his own house ,

verses.z: 耶穌就對他們說：「我的時候還沒有到；你們的時候常是方便的。
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them , " My time has not yet come , but your time is always ready .

verses.z: 世人不能恨你們，卻是恨我，因為我指證他們所做的事是惡的。
verses.e: The world can't hate you , but it hates me , because I testify about it , that its works are evil .

verses.z: 你們上去過節吧，我現在不上去過這節，因為我的時候還沒有滿。」
verses.e: You go up to the feast . I am not yet going up to this feast , because my time is not yet fulfilled . "

verses.z: 耶穌說了這話，仍舊住在加利利。
verses.e: Having said these things to them , he stayed in Galilee .

verses.z: 於是各人都回家去了；耶穌卻往橄欖山去，
verses.e: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives .

verses.z: 耶穌就直起腰來，對她說：「婦人，那些人在哪裏呢？沒有人定你的罪嗎？」
verses.e: Jesus , standing up , saw her and said , " Woman , where are your accusers ? Did no one condemn you ? "

verses.z: 她說：「主啊，沒有。」耶穌說：「我也不定你的罪。去吧，從此不要再犯罪了！」
verses.e: She said , " No one , Lord . " Jesus said , " Neither do I condemn you . Go your way . From now on , sin no more . "

verses.z: 耶穌又對眾人說：「我是世界的光。跟從我的，就不在黑暗裏走，必要得着生命的光。」
verses.e: Again , therefore , Jesus spoke to them , saying , " I am the light of the world . He who follows me will not walk in the darkness , but will have the light of life . "

verses.z: 法利賽人對他說：「你是為自己作見證，你的見證不真。」
verses.e: The Pharisees therefore said to him , " You testify about yourself . Your testimony is not valid . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我雖然為自己作見證，我的見證還是真的；因我知道我從哪裏來，往哪裏去；你們卻不知道我從哪裏來，往哪裏去。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Even if I testify about myself , my testimony is true , for I know where I came from , and where I am going ; but you don't know where I came from , or where I am going .

verses.z: 你們是以外貌判斷人，我卻不判斷人。
verses.e: You judge according to the flesh . I judge no one .

verses.z: 就是判斷人，我的判斷也是真的；因為不是我獨自在這裏，還有差我來的父與我同在。
verses.e: Even if I do judge , my judgment is true , for I am not alone , but I am with the Father who sent me .

verses.z: 你們的律法上也記着說：『兩個人的見證是真的。』
verses.e: It's also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid .

verses.z: 我是為自己作見證，還有差我來的父也是為我作見證。」
verses.e: I am one who testifies about myself , and the Father who sent me testifies about me . "

verses.z: 他們就問他說：「你的父在哪裏？」耶穌回答說：「你們不認識我，也不認識我的父；若是認識我，也就認識我的父。」
verses.e: They said therefore to him , " Where is your Father ? " Jesus answered , " You know neither me nor my Father . If you knew me , you would know my Father also . "

verses.z: 清早又回到殿裏。眾百姓都到他那裏去，他就坐下，教訓他們。
verses.e: Now very early in the morning , he came again into the temple , and all the people came to him . He sat down and taught them .

verses.z: 這些話是耶穌在殿裏的庫房、教訓人時所說的，也沒有人拿他，因為他的時候還沒有到。
verses.e: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury , as he taught in the temple . Yet no one arrested him , because his hour had not yet come .

verses.z: 耶穌又對他們說：「我要去了，你們要找我，並且你們要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你們不能到。」
verses.e: Jesus said therefore again to them , " I am going away , and you will seek me , and you will die in your sins . Where I go , you can't come . "

verses.z: 猶太人說：「他說『我所去的地方，你們不能到』，難道他要自盡嗎？」
verses.e: The Jews therefore said , " Will he kill himself , because he says , ' Where I am going , you can't come ' ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們是從下頭來的，我是從上頭來的；你們是屬這世界的，我不是屬這世界的。
verses.e: He said to them , " You are from beneath . I am from above . You are of this world . I am not of this world .

verses.z: 所以我對你們說，你們要死在罪中。你們若不信我是[基督]，必要死在罪中。」
verses.e: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins ; for unless you believe that I am he , you will die in your sins . "

verses.z: 他們就問他說：「你是誰？」耶穌對他們說：「就是我從起初所告訴你們的。
verses.e: They said therefore to him , " Who are you ? " Jesus said to them , " Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning .

verses.z: 我有許多事講論你們，判斷你們；但那差我來的是真的，我在他那裏所聽見的，我就傳給世人。」
verses.e: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you . However , he who sent me is true ; and the things which I heard from him , these I say to the world . "

verses.z: 他們不明白耶穌是指着父說的。
verses.e: They didn't understand that he spoke to them about the Father .

verses.z: 所以耶穌說：「你們舉起人子以後，必知道我是[基督]，並且知道我沒有一件事是憑着自己做的。我說這些話乃是照着父所教訓我的。
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to them , " When you have lifted up the Son of Man , then you will know that I am he , and I do nothing of myself , but as my Father taught me , I say these things .

verses.z: 那差我來的是與我同在；他沒有撇下我獨自在這裏，因為我常做他所喜悅的事。」
verses.e: He who sent me is with me . The Father hasn't left me alone , for I always do the things that are pleasing to him . "

verses.z: 文士和法利賽人帶着一個行淫時被拿的婦人來，叫她站在當中，
verses.e: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery . Having set her in the middle ,

verses.z: 耶穌說這話的時候，就有許多人信他。
verses.e: As he spoke these things , many believed in him .

verses.z: 耶穌對信他的猶太人說：「你們若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的門徒；
verses.e: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him , " If you remain in my word , then you are truly my disciples .

verses.z: 你們必曉得真理，真理必叫你們得以自由。」
verses.e: You will know the truth , and the truth will make you free . "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「我們是亞伯拉罕的後裔，從來沒有作過誰的奴僕。你怎麼說『你們必得以自由』呢？」
verses.e: They answered him , " We are Abraham's offspring , and have never been in bondage to anyone . How do you say , ' You will be made free ' ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴僕。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Most certainly I tell you , everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin .

verses.z: 奴僕不能永遠住在家裏；兒子是永遠住在家裏。
verses.e: A bondservant doesn't live in the house forever . A son remains forever .

verses.z: 所以[天父的]兒子若叫你們自由，你們就真自由了。
verses.e: If therefore the Son makes you free , you will be free indeed .

verses.z: 我知道你們是亞伯拉罕的子孫，你們卻想要殺我，因為你們心裏容不下我的道。
verses.e: I know that you are Abraham's offspring , yet you seek to kill me , because my word finds no place in you .

verses.z: 我所說的是在我父那裏看見的；你們所行的是在你們的父那裏聽見的。」
verses.e: I say the things which I have seen with my Father ; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father . "

verses.z: 他們說：「我們的父就是亞伯拉罕。」耶穌說：「你們若是亞伯拉罕的兒子，就必行亞伯拉罕所行的事。
verses.e: They answered him , " Our father is Abraham . " Jesus said to them , " If you were Abraham's children , you would do the works of Abraham .

verses.z: 就對耶穌說：「夫子，這婦人是正行淫之時被拿的。
verses.e: they told him , " Teacher , we found this woman in adultery , in the very act .

verses.z: 我將在上帝那裏所聽見的真理告訴了你們，現在你們卻想要殺我，這不是亞伯拉罕所行的事。
verses.e: But now you seek to kill me , a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God . Abraham didn't do this .

verses.z: 你們是行你們父所行的事。」他們說：「我們不是從淫亂生的；我們只有一位父，就是上帝。」
verses.e: You do the works of your father . " They said to him , " We were not born of sexual immorality . We have one Father , God . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「倘若上帝是你們的父，你們就必愛我；因為我本是出於上帝，也是從上帝而來，並不是由着自己來，乃是他差我來。
verses.e: Therefore Jesus said to them , " If God were your father , you would love me , for I came out and have come from God . For I haven't come of myself , but he sent me .

verses.z: 你們為甚麼不明白我的話呢？無非是因你們不能聽我的道。
verses.e: Why don't you understand my speech ? Because you can't hear my word .

verses.z: 你們是出於你們的父魔鬼，你們父的私慾你們偏要行。他從起初是殺人的，不守真理，因他心裏沒有真理。他說謊是出於自己；因他本來是說謊的，也是說謊之人的父。
verses.e: You are of your father the devil , and you want to do the desires of your father . He was a murderer from the beginning , and doesn't stand in the truth , because there is no truth in him . When he speaks a lie , he speaks on his own ; for he is a liar , and the father of lies .

verses.z: 我將真理告訴你們，你們就因此不信我。
verses.e: But because I tell the truth , you don't believe me .

verses.z: 你們中間誰能指證我有罪呢？我既然將真理告訴你們，為甚麼不信我呢？
verses.e: Which of you convicts me of sin ? If I tell the truth , why do you not believe me ?

verses.z: 出於上帝的，必聽上帝的話；你們不聽，因為你們不是出於上帝。」
verses.e: He who is of God hears the words of God . For this cause you don't hear , because you are not of God . "

verses.z: 猶太人回答說：「我們說你是撒馬利亞人，並且是鬼附着的，這話豈不正對嗎？」
verses.e: Then the Jews answered him , " Don't we say well that you are a Samaritan , and have a demon ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我不是鬼附着的；我尊敬我的父，你們倒輕慢我。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " I don't have a demon , but I honor my Father and you dishonor me .

verses.z: 摩西在律法上吩咐我們把這樣的婦人用石頭打死。你說該把她怎麼樣呢？」
verses.e: Now in our law , Moses commanded us to stone such women . What then do you say about her ? "

verses.z: 我不求自己的榮耀，有一位[為我]求[榮耀]、定是非的。
verses.e: But I don't seek my own glory . There is one who seeks and judges .

verses.z: 我實實在在地告訴你們，人若遵守我的道，就永遠不見死。」
verses.e: Most certainly , I tell you , if a person keeps my word , he will never see death . "

verses.z: 猶太人對他說：「現在我們知道你是鬼附着的。亞伯拉罕死了，眾先知也死了，你還說：『人若遵守我的道，就永遠不嘗死味。』
verses.e: Then the Jews said to him , " Now we know that you have a demon . Abraham died , as did the prophets ; and you say , ' If a man keeps my word , he will never taste of death . '

verses.z: 難道你比我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕還大嗎？他死了，眾先知也死了，你將自己當作甚麼人呢？」
verses.e: Are you greater than our father Abraham , who died ? The prophets died . Who do you make yourself out to be ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我若榮耀自己，我的榮耀就算不得甚麼；榮耀我的乃是我的父，就是你們所說是你們的上帝。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " If I glorify myself , my glory is nothing . It is my Father who glorifies me , of whom you say that he is our God .

verses.z: 你們未曾認識他；我卻認識他。我若說不認識他，我就是說謊的，像你們一樣；但我認識他，也遵守他的道。
verses.e: You have not known him , but I know him . If I said , ' I don't know him , ' I would be like you , a liar . But I know him and keep his word .

verses.z: 你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕歡歡喜喜地仰望我的日子，既看見了就快樂。」
verses.e: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day . He saw it and was glad . "

verses.z: 猶太人說：「你還沒有五十歲，豈見過亞伯拉罕呢？」
verses.e: The Jews therefore said to him , " You are not yet fifty years old ! Have you seen Abraham ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，還沒有亞伯拉罕就有了我。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Most certainly , I tell you , before Abraham came into existence , I AM . "

verses.z: 於是他們拿石頭要打他；耶穌卻躲藏，從殿裏出去了。
verses.e: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him , but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple , having gone through the middle of them , and so passed by .

verses.z: 他們說這話，乃試探耶穌，要得着告他的把柄。耶穌卻彎着腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
verses.e: They said this testing him , that they might have something to accuse him of . But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger .

verses.z: 他們還是不住地問他，耶穌就直起腰來，對他們說：「你們中間誰是沒有罪的，誰就可以先拿石頭打她。」
verses.e: But when they continued asking him , he looked up and said to them , " He who is without sin among you , let him throw the first stone at her . "

verses.z: 於是又彎着腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
verses.e: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger .

verses.z: 他們聽見這話，就從老到少，一個一個地都出去了，只剩下耶穌一人，還有那婦人仍然站在當中。
verses.e: They , when they heard it , being convicted by their conscience , went out one by one , beginning from the oldest , even to the last . Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was , in the middle .

verses.z: 耶穌過去的時候，看見一個人生來是瞎眼的。
verses.e: As he passed by , he saw a man blind from birth .

verses.z: 他們對他說：「你的眼睛是怎麼開的呢？」
verses.e: They therefore were asking him , " How were your eyes opened ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「有一個人，名叫耶穌，他和泥抹我的眼睛，對我說：『你往西羅亞[池子]去洗。』我去一洗，就看見了。」
verses.e: He answered , " A man called Jesus made mud , anointed my eyes , and said to me , ' Go to the pool of Siloam and wash . ' So I went away and washed , and I received sight . "

verses.z: 他們說：「那個人在哪裏？」他說：「我不知道。」
verses.e: Then they asked him , " Where is he ? " He said , " I don't know . "

verses.z: 他們把從前瞎眼的人帶到法利賽人那裏。
verses.e: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees .

verses.z: 耶穌和泥開他眼睛的日子是安息日。
verses.e: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes .

verses.z: 法利賽人也問他是怎麼得看見的。瞎子對他們說：「他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看見了。」
verses.e: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight . He said to them , " He put mud on my eyes , I washed , and I see . "

verses.z: 法利賽人中有的說：「這個人不是從上帝來的，因為他不守安息日。」又有人說：「一個罪人怎能行這樣的神蹟呢？」他們就起了紛爭。
verses.e: Some therefore of the Pharisees said , " This man is not from God , because he doesn't keep the Sabbath . " Others said , " How can a man who is a sinner do such signs ? " So there was division among them .

verses.z: 他們又對瞎子說：「他既然開了你的眼睛，你說他是怎樣的人呢？」他說：「是個先知。」
verses.e: Therefore they asked the blind man again , " What do you say about him , because he opened your eyes ? " He said , " He is a prophet . "

verses.z: 猶太人不信他從前是瞎眼，後來能看見的，等到叫了他的父母來，
verses.e: The Jews therefore didn't believe concerning him , that he had been blind and had received his sight , until they called the parents of him who had received his sight ,

verses.z: 問他們說：「這是你們的兒子嗎？你們說他生來是瞎眼的，如今怎麼能看見了呢？」
verses.e: and asked them , " Is this your son , whom you say was born blind ? How then does he now see ? "

verses.z: 門徒問耶穌說：「拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？」
verses.e: His disciples asked him , " Rabbi , who sinned , this man or his parents , that he was born blind ? "

verses.z: 他父母回答說：「他是我們的兒子，生來就瞎眼，這是我們知道的。
verses.e: His parents answered them , " We know that this is our son , and that he was born blind ;

verses.z: 至於他如今怎麼能看見，我們卻不知道；是誰開了他的眼睛，我們也不知道。他已經成了人，你們問他吧，他自己必能說。」
verses.e: but how he now sees , we don't know ; or who opened his eyes , we don't know . He is of age . Ask him . He will speak for himself . "

verses.z: 他父母說這話，是怕猶太人；因為猶太人已經商議定了，若有認耶穌是基督的，要把他趕出會堂。
verses.e: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews ; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ , he would be put out of the synagogue .

verses.z: 因此他父母說：「他已經成了人，你們問他吧。」
verses.e: Therefore his parents said , " He is of age . Ask him . "

verses.z: 所以法利賽人第二次叫了那從前瞎眼的人來，對他說：「你該將榮耀歸給上帝，我們知道這人是個罪人。」
verses.e: So they called the man who was blind a second time , and said to him , " Give glory to God . We know that this man is a sinner . "

verses.z: 他說：「他是個罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，從前我是眼瞎的，如今能看見了。」
verses.e: He therefore answered , " I don't know if he is a sinner . One thing I do know : that though I was blind , now I see . "

verses.z: 他們就問他說：「他向你做甚麼？是怎麼開了你的眼睛呢？」
verses.e: They said to him again , " What did he do to you ? How did he open your eyes ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「我方才告訴你們，你們不聽，為甚麼又要聽呢？莫非你們也要作他的門徒嗎？」
verses.e: He answered them , " I told you already , and you didn't listen . Why do you want to hear it again ? You don't also want to become his disciples , do you ? "

verses.z: 他們就罵他說：「你是他的門徒；我們是摩西的門徒。
verses.e: They insulted him and said , " You are his disciple , but we are disciples of Moses .

verses.z: 上帝對摩西說話是我們知道的；只是這個人，我們不知道他從哪裏來！」
verses.e: We know that God has spoken to Moses . But as for this man , we don't know where he comes from . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「也不是這人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上顯出上帝的作為來。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " This man didn't sin , nor did his parents , but that the works of God might be revealed in him .

verses.z: 那人回答說：「他開了我的眼睛，你們竟不知道他從哪裏來，這真是奇怪！
verses.e: The man answered them , " How amazing ! You don't know where he comes from , yet he opened my eyes .

verses.z: 我們知道上帝不聽罪人，惟有敬奉上帝、遵行他旨意的，上帝才聽他。
verses.e: We know that God doesn't listen to sinners , but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will , he listens to him .

verses.z: 從創世以來，未曾聽見有人把生來是瞎子的眼睛開了。
verses.e: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind .

verses.z: 這人若不是從上帝來的，甚麼也不能做。」
verses.e: If this man were not from God , he could do nothing . "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「你全然生在罪孽中，還要教訓我們嗎？」於是把他趕出去了。
verses.e: They answered him , " You were altogether born in sins , and do you teach us ? " Then they threw him out .

verses.z: 耶穌聽說他們把他趕出去，後來遇見他，就說：「你信上帝的兒子嗎？」
verses.e: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out , and finding him , he said , " Do you believe in the Son of God ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「主啊，誰是上帝的兒子，叫我信他呢？」
verses.e: He answered , " Who is he , Lord , that I may believe in him ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你已經看見他，現在和你說話的就是他。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " You have both seen him , and it is he who speaks with you . "

verses.z: 他說：「主啊，我信！」就拜耶穌。
verses.e: He said , " Lord , I believe ! " and he worshiped him .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我為審判到這世上來，叫不能看見的，可以看見；能看見的，反瞎了眼。」
verses.e: Jesus said , " I came into this world for judgment , that those who don't see may see ; and that those who see may become blind . "

verses.z: 趁着白日，我們必須做那差我來者的工；黑夜將到，就沒有人能做工了。
verses.e: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day . The night is coming , when no one can work .

verses.z: 同他在那裏的法利賽人聽見這話，就說：「難道我們也瞎了眼嗎？」
verses.e: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things , and said to him , " Are we also blind ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們若瞎了眼，就沒有罪了；但如今你們說『我們能看見』，[所以]你們的罪還在。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " If you were blind , you would have no sin ; but now you say , ' We see . ' Therefore your sin remains .

verses.z: 我在世上的時候，是世上的光。」
verses.e: While I am in the world , I am the light of the world . "

verses.z: 耶穌說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
verses.e: When he had said this , he spat on the ground , made mud with the saliva , anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud ,

verses.z: 對他說：「你往西羅亞池子裏去洗。」（西羅亞翻出來就是「奉差遣」。）他去一洗，回頭就看見了。
verses.e: and said to him , " Go , wash in the pool of Siloam " ( which means " Sent " ) . So he went away , washed , and came back seeing .

verses.z: 他的鄰舍和那素常見他是討飯的，就說：「這不是那從前坐着討飯的人嗎？」
verses.e: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said , " Isn't this he who sat and begged ? "

verses.z: 有人說：「是他」；又有人說：「不是，卻是像他。」他自己說：「是我。」
verses.e: Others were saying , " It is he . " Still others were saying , " He looks like him . " He said , " I am he . "

verses.z: 烏斯地有一個人名叫約伯；那人完全正直，敬畏上帝，遠離惡事。
verses.e: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job . That man was blameless and upright , and one who feared God , and turned away from evil .

verses.z: 你豈不是四面圈上籬笆圍護他和他的家，並他一切所有的嗎？他手所做的都蒙你賜福；他的家產也在地上增多。
verses.e: Haven't you made a hedge around him , and around his house , and around all that he has , on every side ? You have blessed the work of his hands , and his substance is increased in the land .

verses.z: 你且伸手毀他一切所有的；他必當面棄掉你。」
verses.e: But stretch out your hand now , and touch all that he has , and he will renounce you to your face . "

verses.z: 耶和華對撒但說：「凡他所有的都在你手中；只是不可伸手加害於他。」於是撒但從耶和華面前退去。
verses.e: The LORD said to Satan , " Behold , all that he has is in your power . Only on himself don't stretch out your hand . " So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD .

verses.z: 有一天，約伯的兒女正在他們長兄的家裏吃飯喝酒，
verses.e: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother's house ,

verses.z: 有報信的來見約伯，說：「牛正耕地，驢在旁邊吃草，
verses.e: that a messenger came to Job , and said , " The oxen were plowing , and the donkeys feeding beside them ,

verses.z: 示巴人忽然闖來，把牲畜擄去，並用刀殺了僕人；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
verses.e: and the Sabeans attacked , and took them away . Yes , they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword , and I alone have escaped to tell you . "

verses.z: 他還說話的時候，又有人來說：「上帝從天上降下火來，將群羊和僕人都燒滅了；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
verses.e: While he was still speaking , another also came and said , " The fire of God has fallen from the sky , and has burned up the sheep and the servants , and consumed them , and I alone have escaped to tell you . "

verses.z: 他還說話的時候，又有人來說：「迦勒底人分作三隊忽然闖來，把駱駝擄去，並用刀殺了僕人；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
verses.e: While he was still speaking , another also came and said , " The Chaldeans made three bands , and swept down on the camels , and have taken them away , yes , and killed the servants with the edge of the sword ; and I alone have escaped to tell you . "

verses.z: 他還說話的時候，又有人來說：「你的兒女正在他們長兄的家裏吃飯喝酒，
verses.e: While he was still speaking , there came also another , and said , " Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother's house ,

verses.z: 不料，有狂風從曠野颳來，擊打房屋的四角，房屋倒塌在少年人身上，他們就都死了；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
verses.e: and behold , there came a great wind from the wilderness , and struck the four corners of the house , and it fell on the young men , and they are dead . I alone have escaped to tell you . "

verses.z: 他生了七個兒子，三個女兒。
verses.e: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters .

verses.z: 約伯便起來，撕裂外袍，剃了頭，伏在地上下拜，
verses.e: Then Job arose , and tore his robe , and shaved his head , and fell down on the ground , and worshiped .

verses.z: 說：「我赤身出於母胎，也必赤身歸回；賞賜的是耶和華，收取的也是耶和華。耶和華的名是應當稱頌的。」
verses.e: He said , " Naked I came out of my mother's womb , and naked will I return there . The LORD gave , and the LORD has taken away . Blessed be the LORD's name . "

verses.z: 在這一切的事上約伯並不犯罪，也不以上帝為愚妄。
verses.e: In all this , Job didn't sin , nor charge God with wrongdoing .

verses.z: 他的家產有七千羊，三千駱駝，五百對牛，五百母驢，並有許多僕婢。這人在東方人中就為至大。
verses.e: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep , three thousand camels , five hundred yoke of oxen , five hundred female donkeys , and a very great household ; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east .

verses.z: 他的兒子按着日子各在自己家裏設擺筵宴，就打發人去，請了他們的三個姊妹來，與他們一同吃喝。
verses.e: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday ; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them .

verses.z: 筵宴的日子過了，約伯打發人去叫他們自潔。他清早起來，按着他們眾人的數目獻燔祭；因為他說：「恐怕我兒子犯了罪，心中棄掉上帝。」約伯常常這樣行。
verses.e: It was so , when the days of their feasting had run their course , that Job sent and sanctified them , and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all . For Job said , " It may be that my sons have sinned , and renounced God in their hearts . " Job did so continually .

verses.z: 有一天，上帝的眾子來侍立在耶和華面前，撒但也來在其中。
verses.e: Now on the day when God's sons came to present themselves before the LORD , Satan also came among them .

verses.z: 耶和華問撒但說：「你從哪裏來？」撒但回答說：「我從地上走來走去，往返而來。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Satan , " Where have you come from ? " Then Satan answered the LORD , and said , " From going back and forth in the earth , and from walking up and down in it . "

verses.z: 耶和華問撒但說：「你曾用心察看我的僕人約伯沒有？地上再沒有人像他完全正直，敬畏上帝，遠離惡事。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Satan , " Have you considered my servant , Job ? For there is no one like him in the earth , a blameless and an upright man , one who fears God , and turns away from evil . "

verses.z: 撒但回答耶和華說：「約伯敬畏上帝，豈是無故呢？
verses.e: Then Satan answered the LORD , and said , " Does Job fear God for nothing ?

verses.z: 我厭煩我的性命，必由着自己述說我的哀情；因心裏苦惱，我要說話，
verses.e: " My soul is weary of my life . I will give free course to my complaint . I will speak in the bitterness of my soul .

verses.z: 你不是倒出我來好像奶，使我凝結如同奶餅嗎？
verses.e: Haven't you poured me out like milk , and curdled me like cheese ?

verses.z: 你以皮和肉為衣給我穿上，用骨與筋把我全體聯絡。
verses.e: You have clothed me with skin and flesh , and knit me together with bones and sinews .

verses.z: 你將生命和慈愛賜給我；你也眷顧保全我的心靈。
verses.e: You have granted me life and loving kindness . Your visitation has preserved my spirit .

verses.z: 然而，你[待我的]這些事早已藏在你心裏；我知道你久有此意。
verses.e: Yet you hid these things in your heart . I know that this is with you :

verses.z: 我若犯罪，你就察看我，並不赦免我的罪孽。
verses.e: if I sin , then you mark me . You will not acquit me from my iniquity .

verses.z: 我若行惡，便有了禍；我若為義，也不敢抬頭，正是滿心羞愧，眼見我的苦情。
verses.e: If I am wicked , woe to me . If I am righteous , I still will not lift up my head , being filled with disgrace , and conscious of my affliction .

verses.z: 我若昂首自得，你就追捕我如獅子，又在我身上顯出奇能。
verses.e: If my head is held high , you hunt me like a lion . Again you show yourself powerful to me .

verses.z: 你重立見證攻擊我，向我加增惱怒，如軍兵更換着攻擊我。
verses.e: You renew your witnesses against me , and increase your indignation on me . Changes and warfare are with me .

verses.z: 你為何使我出母胎呢？不如我當時氣絕，無人得見我；
verses.e: " ' Why , then , have you brought me out of the womb ? I wish I had given up the spirit , and no eye had seen me .

verses.z: 這樣，就如沒有我一般，一出母胎就被送入墳墓。
verses.e: I should have been as though I had not been . I should have been carried from the womb to the grave .

verses.z: 對上帝說：不要定我有罪，要指示我，你為何與我爭辯？
verses.e: I will tell God , ' Do not condemn me . Show me why you contend with me .

verses.z: 我的日子不是甚少嗎？求你停手寬容我，叫我在往而不返之先－就是往黑暗和死蔭之地以先－可以稍得暢快。
verses.e: Aren't my days few ? Stop ! Leave me alone , that I may find a little comfort ,
before I go where I will not return from , to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death ;

verses.z: 那地甚是幽暗，是死蔭混沌[之地]；那裏的光好像幽暗。
verses.e: the land dark as midnight , of the shadow of death , without any order , where the light is as midnight . ' "

verses.z: 你手所造的，你又欺壓，又藐視，卻光照惡人的計謀。這事你以為美嗎？
verses.e: Is it good to you that you should oppress , that you should despise the work of your hands , and smile on the counsel of the wicked ?

verses.z: 你的眼豈是肉眼？你查看豈像人查看嗎？
verses.e: Do you have eyes of flesh ? Or do you see as man sees ?

verses.z: 你的日子豈像人的日子，你的年歲豈像人的年歲，
verses.e: Are your days as the days of mortals , or your years as man's years ,

verses.z: 就追問我的罪孽，尋察我的罪過嗎？
verses.e: that you inquire after my iniquity , and search after my sin ?

verses.z: 其實，你知道我沒有罪惡，並沒有能救[我]脫離你手的。
verses.e: Although you know that I am not wicked , there is no one who can deliver out of your hand .

verses.z: 你的手創造我，造就我的四肢百體，你還要毀滅我。
verses.e: " ' Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether , yet you destroy me .

verses.z: 求你記念－製造我如摶泥一般，你還要使我歸於塵土嗎？
verses.e: Remember , I beg you , that you have fashioned me as clay . Will you bring me into dust again ?

verses.z: 拿瑪人瑣法回答說：
verses.e: Then Zophar , the Naamathite , answered ,

verses.z: 他若經過，將人拘禁，招人受審，誰能阻擋他呢？
verses.e: If he passes by , or confines , or convenes a court , then who can oppose him ?

verses.z: 他本知道虛妄的人；人的罪孽，他雖不留意，還是無所不見。
verses.e: For he knows false men . He sees iniquity also , even though he doesn't consider it .

verses.z: 空虛的人卻毫無知識；人生在世[好像]野驢的駒子。
verses.e: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey's colt .

verses.z: 你若將心安正，又向主舉手；
verses.e: " If you set your heart aright , stretch out your hands toward him .

verses.z: 你手裏若有罪孽，就當遠遠地除掉，也不容非義住在你帳棚之中。
verses.e: If iniquity is in your hand , put it far away . Don't let unrighteousness dwell in your tents .

verses.z: 那時，你必仰起臉來毫無斑點；你也必堅固，無所懼怕。
verses.e: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot . Yes , you will be steadfast , and will not fear ,

verses.z: 你必忘記你的苦楚，就是想起也如流過去的水一樣。
verses.e: for you will forget your misery . You will remember it like waters that have passed away .

verses.z: 你在世的日子要比正午更明，雖有黑暗仍像早晨。
verses.e: Life will be clearer than the noonday . Though there is darkness , it will be as the morning .

verses.z: 你因有指望就必穩固，也必[四圍]巡查，坦然安息。
verses.e: You will be secure , because there is hope . Yes , you will search , and will take your rest in safety .

verses.z: 你躺臥，無人驚嚇，且有許多人向你求恩。
verses.e: Also you will lie down , and no one will make you afraid . Yes , many will court your favor .

verses.z: 這許多的言語豈不該回答嗎？多嘴多舌的人豈可稱為義嗎？
verses.e: " Shouldn't the multitude of words be answered ? Should a man full of talk be justified ?

verses.z: 但惡人的眼目必要失明。他們無路可逃；他們的指望就是氣絕。
verses.e: But the eyes of the wicked will fail . They will have no way to flee . Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit . "

verses.z: 你誇大的話豈能使人不作聲嗎？你戲笑的時候豈沒有人叫你害羞嗎？
verses.e: Should your boastings make men hold their peace ? When you mock , will no man make you ashamed ?

verses.z: 你說：我的道理純全；我在你眼前潔淨。
verses.e: For you say , ' My doctrine is pure . I am clean in your eyes . '

verses.z: 惟願上帝說話；願他開口攻擊你，
verses.e: But oh that God would speak , and open his lips against you ,

verses.z: 並將智慧的奧祕指示你；他有諸般的智識。所以當知道上帝追討你比你罪孽該得的還少。
verses.e: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom ! For true wisdom has two sides . Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves .

verses.z: 你考察就能測透上帝嗎？你豈能盡情測透全能者嗎？
verses.e: " Can you fathom the mystery of God ? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty ?

verses.z: 他[的智慧]高於天，你還能做甚麼？深於陰間，你還能知道甚麼？
verses.e: They are high as heaven . What can you do ? They are deeper than Sheol . What can you know ?

verses.z: 其量比地長，比海寬。
verses.e: Its measure is longer than the earth , and broader than the sea .

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 凡活物的生命和人類的氣息都在他手中。
verses.e: in whose hand is the life of every living thing , and the breath of all mankind ?

verses.z: 耳朵豈不試驗言語，正如上膛嘗食物嗎？
verses.e: Doesn't the ear try words , even as the palate tastes its food ?

verses.z: 年老的有智慧；壽高的有知識。
verses.e: With aged men is wisdom , in length of days understanding .

verses.z: 在上帝有智慧和能力；他有謀略和知識。
verses.e: " With God is wisdom and might . He has counsel and understanding .

verses.z: 他拆毀的，就不能再建造；他捆住人，便不得開釋。
verses.e: Behold , he breaks down , and it can't be built again . He imprisons a man , and there can be no release .

verses.z: 他把水留住，水便枯乾；他再發出水來，水就翻地。
verses.e: Behold , he withholds the waters , and they dry up . Again , he sends them out , and they overturn the earth .

verses.z: 在他有能力和智慧，被誘惑的與誘惑人的都是屬他。
verses.e: With him is strength and wisdom . The deceived and the deceiver are his .

verses.z: 他把謀士剝衣擄去，又使審判官變成愚人。
verses.e: He leads counselors away stripped . He makes judges fools .

verses.z: 他放鬆君王的綁，又用帶子捆他們的腰。
verses.e: He loosens the bond of kings . He binds their waist with a belt .

verses.z: 他把祭司剝衣擄去，又使有能的人傾敗。
verses.e: He leads priests away stripped , and overthrows the mighty .

verses.z: 你們真是子民哪，你們死亡，智慧也就滅沒了。
verses.e: " No doubt , but you are the people , and wisdom will die with you .

verses.z: 他廢去忠信人的講論，又奪去老人的聰明。
verses.e: He removes the speech of those who are trusted , and takes away the understanding of the elders .

verses.z: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，放鬆有力之人的腰帶。
verses.e: He pours contempt on princes , and loosens the belt of the strong .

verses.z: 他將深奧的事從黑暗中彰顯，使死蔭顯為光明。
verses.e: He uncovers deep things out of darkness , and brings out to light the shadow of death .

verses.z: 他使邦國興旺而又毀滅；他使邦國開廣而又擄去。
verses.e: He increases the nations , and he destroys them . He enlarges the nations , and he leads them captive .

verses.z: 他將地上民中首領的聰明奪去，使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流；
verses.e: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth , and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way .

verses.z: 他們無光，在黑暗中摸索，又使他們東倒西歪，像醉酒的人一樣。
verses.e: They grope in the dark without light . He makes them stagger like a drunken man .

verses.z: 但我也有聰明，與你們一樣，並非不及你們。你們所說的，誰不知道呢？
verses.e: But I have understanding as well as you ; I am not inferior to you . Yes , who doesn't know such things as these ?

verses.z: 我這求告上帝、蒙他應允的人竟成了朋友所譏笑的；公義完全人竟受了人的譏笑。
verses.e: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor , I , who called on God , and he answered . The just , the blameless man is a joke .

verses.z: 安逸的人心裏藐視災禍；這災禍常常等待滑腳的人。
verses.e: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune . It is ready for them whose foot slips .

verses.z: 強盜的帳棚興旺，惹上帝的人穩固，上帝[多將財物]送到他們手中。
verses.e: The tents of robbers prosper . Those who provoke God are secure , who carry their god in their hands .

verses.z: 你且問走獸，走獸必指教你；又問空中的飛鳥，飛鳥必告訴你；
verses.e: " But ask the animals now , and they will teach you ; the birds of the sky , and they will tell you .

verses.z: 或與地說話，地必指教你；海中的魚也必向你說明。
verses.e: Or speak to the earth , and it will teach you . The fish of the sea will declare to you .

verses.z: 看這一切，誰不知道是耶和華的手做成的呢？
verses.e: Who doesn't know that in all these , the LORD's hand has done this ,

verses.z: 這一切，我眼都見過；我耳都聽過，而且明白。
verses.e: " Behold , my eye has seen all this . My ear has heard and understood it .

verses.z: 你們若暗中徇情，他必要責備你們。
verses.e: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality .

verses.z: 他的尊榮豈不叫你們懼怕嗎？他的驚嚇豈不臨到你們嗎？
verses.e: Won't his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you ?

verses.z: 你們以為可記念的箴言是爐灰的箴言；你們以為可靠的堅壘是淤泥的堅壘。
verses.e: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes . Your defenses are defenses of clay .

verses.z: 你們不要作聲，任憑我吧！讓我說話，無論如何我都承當。
verses.e: " Be silent ! Leave me alone , that I may speak . Let come on me what will .

verses.z: 我何必把我的肉掛在牙上，將我的命放在手中。
verses.e: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth , and put my life in my hand ?

verses.z: 他必殺我；我雖無指望，然而我在他面前還要辯明我所行的。
verses.e: Behold , he will kill me . I have no hope . Nevertheless , I will maintain my ways before him .

verses.z: 這要成為我的拯救，因為不虔誠的人不得到他面前。
verses.e: This also will be my salvation , that a godless man will not come before him .

verses.z: 你們要細聽我的言語，使我所辯論的入你們的耳中。
verses.e: Listen carefully to my speech . Let my declaration be in your ears .

verses.z: 我已陳明我的案，知道自己有義。
verses.e: See now , I have set my cause in order . I know that I am righteous .

verses.z: 有誰與我爭論，我就情願緘默不言，氣絕而亡。
verses.e: Who is he who will contend with me ? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit .

verses.z: 你們所知道的，我也知道，並非不及你們。
verses.e: What you know , I know also . I am not inferior to you .

verses.z: 惟有兩件不要向我施行，我就不躲開你的面：
verses.e: " Only don't do two things to me , then I will not hide myself from your face :

verses.z: 就是把你的手縮回，遠離我身；又不使你的驚惶威嚇我。
verses.e: withdraw your hand far from me , and don't let your terror make me afraid .

verses.z: 這樣，你呼叫，我就回答；或是讓我說話，你回答我。
verses.e: Then call , and I will answer , or let me speak , and you answer me .

verses.z: 我的罪孽和罪過有多少呢？求你叫我知道我的過犯與罪愆。
verses.e: How many are my iniquities and sins ? Make me know my disobedience and my sin .

verses.z: 你為何掩面、拿我當仇敵呢？
verses.e: Why do you hide your face , and consider me your enemy ?

verses.z: 你要驚動被風吹的葉子嗎？要追趕枯乾的碎稭嗎？
verses.e: Will you harass a driven leaf ? Will you pursue the dry stubble ?

verses.z: 你按罪狀刑罰我，又使我擔當幼年的罪孽；
verses.e: For you write bitter things against me , and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth .

verses.z: 也把我的腳上了木狗，並窺察我一切的道路，為我的腳掌劃定界限。
verses.e: You also put my feet in the stocks , and mark all my paths . You set a bound to the soles of my feet ,

verses.z: 我已經像滅絕的爛物，像蟲蛀的衣裳。
verses.e: though I am decaying like a rotten thing , like a garment that is moth-eaten .

verses.z: 我真要對全能者說話；我願與上帝理論。
verses.e: " Surely I would speak to the Almighty . I desire to reason with God .

verses.z: 你們是編造謊言的，都是無用的醫生。
verses.e: But you are forgers of lies . You are all physicians of no value .

verses.z: 惟願你們全然不作聲；這就算為你們的智慧！
verses.e: Oh that you would be completely silent ! Then you would be wise .

verses.z: 請你們聽我的辯論，留心聽我口中的分訴。
verses.e: Hear now my reasoning . Listen to the pleadings of my lips .

verses.z: 你們要為上帝說不義的話嗎？為他說詭詐的言語嗎？
verses.e: Will you speak unrighteously for God , and talk deceitfully for him ?

verses.z: 你們要為上帝徇情嗎？要為他爭論嗎？
verses.e: Will you show partiality to him ? Will you contend for God ?

verses.z: 他查出你們來，這豈是好嗎？人欺哄人，你們也要照樣欺哄他嗎？
verses.e: Is it good that he should search you out ? Or as one deceives a man , will you deceive him ?

verses.z: 人為婦人所生，日子短少，多有患難；
verses.e: " Man , who is born of a woman , is of few days , and full of trouble .

verses.z: 但人死亡而消滅；他氣絕，竟在何處呢？
verses.e: But man dies , and is laid low . Yes , man gives up the spirit , and where is he ?

verses.z: 海中的水絕盡，江河消散乾涸。
verses.e: As the waters fail from the sea , and the river wastes and dries up ,

verses.z: 人也是如此，躺下不再起來，等到天沒有了，仍不得復醒，也不得從睡中喚醒。
verses.e: so man lies down and doesn't rise . Until the heavens are no more , they will not awake , nor be roused out of their sleep .

verses.z: 惟願你把我藏在陰間，存於隱密處，等你的忿怒過去；願你為我定了日期，記念我。
verses.e: " Oh that you would hide me in Sheol , that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past , that you would appoint me a set time and remember me !

verses.z: 人若死了豈能[再]活呢？我只要在我一切爭戰的日子，等我被釋放的時候來到。
verses.e: If a man dies , will he live again ? I would wait all the days of my warfare , until my release should come .

verses.z: 你呼叫，我便回答；你手所做的，你必羨慕。
verses.e: You would call , and I would answer you . You would have a desire for the work of your hands .

verses.z: 但如今你數點我的腳步，豈不窺察我的罪過嗎？
verses.e: But now you count my steps . Don't you watch over my sin ?

verses.z: 我的過犯被你封在囊中，也縫嚴了我的罪孽。
verses.e: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag . You fasten up my iniquity .

verses.z: 山崩變為無有；磐石挪開原處。
verses.e: " But the mountain falling comes to nothing . The rock is removed out of its place .

verses.z: 水流消磨石頭，所流溢的洗去地上的塵土；你也照樣滅絕人的指望。
verses.e: The waters wear the stones . The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth . So you destroy the hope of man .

verses.z: 出來如花，又被割下，飛去如影，不能存留。
verses.e: He grows up like a flower , and is cut down . He also flees like a shadow , and doesn't continue .

verses.z: 你攻擊人常常得勝，使他去世；你改變他的容貌，叫他往而不回。
verses.e: You forever prevail against him , and he departs . You change his face , and send him away .

verses.z: 他兒子得尊榮，他也不知道，降為卑，他也不覺得。
verses.e: His sons come to honor , and he doesn't know it . They are brought low , but he doesn't perceive it of them .

verses.z: 但知身上疼痛，心中悲哀。
verses.e: But his flesh on him has pain , and his soul within him mourns . "

verses.z: 這樣的人你豈睜眼看他嗎？又叫我來受審嗎？
verses.e: Do you open your eyes on such a one , and bring me into judgment with you ?

verses.z: 誰能使潔淨之物出於污穢之中呢？無論誰也不能！
verses.e: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean ? Not one .

verses.z: 人的日子既然限定，他的月數在你那裏，你也派定他的界限，使他不能越過，
verses.e: Seeing his days are determined , the number of his months is with you , and you have appointed his bounds that he can't pass .

verses.z: 便求你轉眼不看他，使他得歇息，直等他像雇工人完畢他的日子。
verses.e: Look away from him , that he may rest , until he accomplishes , as a hireling , his day .

verses.z: 樹若被砍下，還可指望發芽，嫩枝生長不息；
verses.e: " For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down , that it will sprout again , that the tender branch of it will not cease .

verses.z: 其根雖然衰老在地裏，幹也死在土中，
verses.e: Though its root grows old in the earth , and its stock dies in the ground ,

verses.z: 及至得了水氣，還要發芽，又長枝條，像新栽的樹一樣。
verses.e: yet through the scent of water it will bud , and sprout boughs like a plant .

verses.z: 提幔人以利法回答說：
verses.e: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered ,

verses.z: 我們這裏有白髮的和年紀老邁的，比你父親還老。
verses.e: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men , much older than your father .

verses.z: 上帝用溫和的話安慰你，你以為太小嗎？
verses.e: Are the consolations of God too small for you , even the word that is gentle toward you ?

verses.z: 你的心為何將你逼去？你的眼為何冒出火星，
verses.e: Why does your heart carry you away ? Why do your eyes flash ,

verses.z: 使你的靈反對上帝，也任你的口發這言語？
verses.e: that you turn your spirit against God , and let such words go out of your mouth ?

verses.z: 人是甚麼，竟算為潔淨呢？婦人所生的是甚麼，竟算為義呢？
verses.e: What is man , that he should be clean ? What is he who is born of a woman , that he should be righteous ?

verses.z: 上帝不信靠他的眾聖者；在他眼前，天也不潔淨，
verses.e: Behold , he puts no trust in his holy ones . Yes , the heavens are not clean in his sight ;

verses.z: 何況那污穢可憎、喝罪孽如水的世人呢！
verses.e: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt , a man who drinks iniquity like water !

verses.z: 我指示你，你要聽；我要述說所看見的，
verses.e: " I will show you , listen to me ; that which I have seen I will declare

verses.z: 就是智慧人從列祖所受，傳說而不隱瞞的。（
verses.e: ( which wise men have told by their fathers , and have not hidden it ;

verses.z: 這地惟獨賜給他們，並沒有外人從他們中間經過。）
verses.e: to whom alone the land was given , and no stranger passed among them ) :

verses.z: 智慧人豈可用虛空的知識回答，用東風充滿肚腹呢？
verses.e: " Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge , and fill himself with the east wind ?

verses.z: 惡人一生之日劬勞痛苦；強暴人一生的年數也是如此。
verses.e: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days , even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor .

verses.z: 驚嚇的聲音常在他耳中；在平安時，搶奪的必臨到他那裏。
verses.e: A sound of terrors is in his ears . In prosperity the destroyer will come on him .

verses.z: 他不信自己能從黑暗中轉回；他被刀劍等候。
verses.e: He doesn't believe that he will return out of darkness . He is waited for by the sword .

verses.z: 他漂流在外求食，[說]：哪裏有食物呢？他知道黑暗的日子在他手邊預備好了。
verses.e: He wanders abroad for bread , saying , ' Where is it ? ' He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand .

verses.z: 急難困苦叫他害怕，而且勝了他，好像君王預備上陣一樣。
verses.e: Distress and anguish make him afraid . They prevail against him , as a king ready to the battle .

verses.z: 他伸手攻擊上帝，以驕傲攻擊全能者，
verses.e: Because he has stretched out his hand against God , and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty ,

verses.z: 挺[着]頸項，用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闖；
verses.e: he runs at him with a stiff neck , with the thick shields of his bucklers ,

verses.z: 是因他的臉蒙上脂油，腰積成肥肉。
verses.e: because he has covered his face with his fatness , and gathered fat on his thighs .

verses.z: 他曾住在荒涼城邑，無人居住、將成亂堆的房屋。
verses.e: He has lived in desolate cities , in houses which no one inhabited , which were ready to become heaps .

verses.z: 他不得富足，財物不得常存，產業在地上也不加增。
verses.e: He will not be rich , neither will his substance continue , neither will their possessions be extended on the earth .

verses.z: 他豈可用無益的話和無濟於事的言語理論呢？
verses.e: Should he reason with unprofitable talk , or with speeches with which he can do no good ?

verses.z: 他不得出離黑暗。火焰要將他的枝子燒乾；因上帝口中的氣，他要滅亡。
verses.e: He will not depart out of darkness . The flame will dry up his branches . He will go away by the breath of God's mouth .

verses.z: 他不用倚靠虛假欺哄自己，因虛假必成為他的報應。
verses.e: Let him not trust in emptiness , deceiving himself , for emptiness will be his reward .

verses.z: 他的日期未到之先，這事必成就；他的枝子不得青綠。
verses.e: It will be accomplished before his time . His branch will not be green .

verses.z: 他必像葡萄樹的葡萄，未熟而落；又像橄欖樹的花，一開而謝。
verses.e: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and will cast off his flower as the olive tree .

verses.z: 原來不敬虔之輩必無生育；受賄賂之人的帳棚必被火燒。
verses.e: For the company of the godless will be barren , and fire will consume the tents of bribery .

verses.z: 他們所懷的是毒害，所生的是罪孽；心裏所預備的是詭詐。
verses.e: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity . Their heart prepares deceit . "

verses.z: 你是廢棄敬畏的意，在上帝面前阻止敬虔的心。
verses.e: Yes , you do away with fear , and hinder devotion before God .

verses.z: 你的罪孽指教你的口；你選用詭詐人的舌頭。
verses.e: For your iniquity teaches your mouth , and you choose the language of the crafty .

verses.z: 你自己的口定你有罪，並非是我；你自己的嘴見證你的不是。
verses.e: Your own mouth condemns you , and not I . Yes , your own lips testify against you .

verses.z: 你豈是頭一個被生的人嗎？你受造在諸山之先嗎？
verses.e: " Are you the first man who was born ? Or were you brought out before the hills ?

verses.z: 你曾聽見上帝的密旨嗎？你還將智慧獨自得盡嗎？
verses.e: Have you heard the secret counsel of God ? Do you limit wisdom to yourself ?

verses.z: 你知道甚麼是我們不知道的呢？你明白甚麼是我們不明白的呢？
verses.e: What do you know that we don't know ? What do you understand which is not in us ?

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 他們向我開口，打我的臉羞辱我，聚會攻擊我。
verses.e: They have gaped on me with their mouth . They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully . They gather themselves together against me .

verses.z: 上帝把我交給不敬虔的人，把我扔到惡人的手中。
verses.e: God delivers me to the ungodly , and casts me into the hands of the wicked .

verses.z: 我素來安逸，他折斷我，掐住我的頸項，把我摔碎，又立我為他的箭靶子。
verses.e: I was at ease , and he broke me apart . Yes , he has taken me by the neck , and dashed me to pieces . He has also set me up for his target .

verses.z: 他的弓箭手四面圍繞我；他破裂我的肺腑，並不留情，把我的膽傾倒在地上，
verses.e: His archers surround me . He splits my kidneys apart , and does not spare . He pours out my bile on the ground .

verses.z: 將我破裂又破裂，如同勇士向我直闖。
verses.e: He breaks me with breach on breach . He runs at me like a giant .

verses.z: 我縫麻布在我皮膚上，把我的角放在塵土中。
verses.e: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin , and have thrust my horn in the dust .

verses.z: 我的臉因哭泣發紫，在我的眼皮上有死蔭。
verses.e: My face is red with weeping . Deep darkness is on my eyelids ,

verses.z: 我的手中卻無強暴；我的祈禱也是清潔。
verses.e: although there is no violence in my hands , and my prayer is pure .

verses.z: 地啊，不要遮蓋我的血！不要[阻擋]我的哀求！
verses.e: " Earth , don't cover my blood . Let my cry have no place to rest .

verses.z: 現今，在天有我的見證，在上有我的中保。
verses.e: Even now , behold , my witness is in heaven . He who vouches for me is on high .

verses.z: 這樣的話我聽了許多；你們安慰人，反叫人愁煩。
verses.e: " I have heard many such things . You are all miserable comforters !

verses.z: 我的朋友譏誚我，我卻向上帝眼淚汪汪。
verses.e: My friends scoff at me . My eyes pour out tears to God ,

verses.z: 願人得與上帝辯白，如同人與朋友辯白一樣；
verses.e: that he would maintain the right of a man with God , of a son of man with his neighbor !

verses.z: 因為再過幾年，我必走那往而不返之路。
verses.e: For when a few years have come , I will go the way of no return .

verses.z: 虛空的言語有窮盡嗎？有甚麼話惹動你回答呢？
verses.e: Shall vain words have an end ? Or what provokes you that you answer ?

verses.z: 我也能說你們那樣的話；你們若處在我的境遇，我也會聯絡言語攻擊你們，又能向你們搖頭。
verses.e: I also could speak as you do . If your soul were in my soul's place , I could join words together against you , and shake my head at you ,

verses.z: 但我必用口堅固你們，用嘴消解[你們的憂愁]。
verses.e: but I would strengthen you with my mouth . The solace of my lips would relieve you .

verses.z: 我雖說話，憂愁仍不得消解；我雖停住不說，憂愁就離開我嗎？
verses.e: " Though I speak , my grief is not subsided . Though I forbear , what am I eased ?

verses.z: 但現在上帝使我困倦，使親友遠離我，
verses.e: But now , God , you have surely worn me out . You have made all my company desolate .

verses.z: 又抓住我，作見證[攻擊我]；我身體的枯瘦也當面見證我的不是。
verses.e: You have shriveled me up . This is a witness against me . My leanness rises up against me . It testifies to my face .

verses.z: 主發怒撕裂我，逼迫我，向我切齒；我的敵人怒目看我。
verses.e: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me . He has gnashed on me with his teeth . My adversary sharpens his eyes on me .

verses.z: 我的心靈消耗，我的日子滅盡；墳墓為我[預備]好了。
verses.e: " My spirit is consumed . My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me .

verses.z: 至於你們眾人，可以再來[辯論]吧！你們中間，我找不着一個智慧人。
verses.e: But as for you all , come back . I will not find a wise man among you .

verses.z: 我的日子已經過了；我的謀算、我心所想望的已經斷絕。
verses.e: My days are past . My plans are broken off , as are the thoughts of my heart .

verses.z: 他們以黑夜為白晝，[說]：亮光近乎黑暗。
verses.e: They change the night into day , saying ' The light is near ' in the presence of darkness .

verses.z: 我若盼望陰間為我的房屋，若下榻在黑暗中，
verses.e: If I look for Sheol as my house , if I have spread my couch in the darkness ,

verses.z: 若對朽壞說：你是我的父；對蟲說：你是我的母親姊妹；
verses.e: if I have said to corruption , ' You are my father , ' and to the worm , ' My mother , ' and ' My sister , '

verses.z: 這樣，我的指望在哪裏呢？我所指望的誰能看見呢？
verses.e: where then is my hope ? As for my hope , who will see it ?

verses.z: 等到安息在塵土中，這指望必下到陰間的門閂那裏了。
verses.e: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol , or descend together into the dust ? "

verses.z: 真有戲笑我的在我這裏，我眼常見他們惹動我。
verses.e: Surely there are mockers with me . My eye dwells on their provocation .

verses.z: 願主拿憑據給我，自己為我作保。[在你以外]誰肯與我擊掌呢？
verses.e: " Now give a pledge . Be collateral for me with yourself . Who is there who will strike hands with me ?

verses.z: 因你使他們心不明理，所以你必不高舉他們。
verses.e: For you have hidden their heart from understanding , therefore you will not exalt them .

verses.z: 控告他的朋友、以朋友為可搶奪的，連他兒女的眼睛也要失明。
verses.e: He who denounces his friends for plunder , even the eyes of his children will fail .

verses.z: 上帝使我作了民中的笑談；他們也吐唾沫在我臉上。
verses.e: " But he has made me a byword of the people . They spit in my face .

verses.z: 我的眼睛因憂愁昏花；我的百體好像影兒。
verses.e: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow . All my members are as a shadow .

verses.z: 正直人因此必驚奇；無辜的人要興起攻擊不敬虔之輩。
verses.e: Upright men will be astonished at this . The innocent will stir himself up against the godless .

verses.z: 然而，義人要持守所行的道；手潔的人要力上加力。
verses.e: Yet the righteous will hold to his way . He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger .

verses.z: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
verses.e: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered ,

verses.z: 活扣為他藏在土內；羈絆為他藏在路上。
verses.e: A noose is hidden for him in the ground , a trap for him on the path .

verses.z: 四面的驚嚇要使他害怕，並且追趕他的腳跟。
verses.e: Terrors will make him afraid on every side , and will chase him at his heels .

verses.z: 他的力量必因飢餓衰敗；禍患要在他旁邊等候。
verses.e: His strength will be famished . Calamity will be ready at his side .

verses.z: 他本身的肢體要被吞吃；死亡的長子要吞吃他的肢體。
verses.e: The members of his body will be devoured . The firstborn of death will devour his members .

verses.z: 他要從所倚靠的帳棚被拔出來，帶到驚嚇的王那裏。
verses.e: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent . He will be brought to the king of terrors .

verses.z: 不屬他的必住在他的帳棚裏；硫磺必撒在他所住之處。
verses.e: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his . Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation .

verses.z: 下邊，他的根本要枯乾；上邊，他的枝子要剪除。
verses.e: His roots will be dried up beneath . His branch will be cut off above .

verses.z: 他的記念在地上必然滅亡；他的名字在街上也不存留。
verses.e: His memory will perish from the earth . He will have no name in the street .

verses.z: 他必從光明中被攆到黑暗裏，必被趕出世界。
verses.e: He will be driven from light into darkness , and chased out of the world .

verses.z: 在本民中必無子無孫；在寄居之地也無一人存留。
verses.e: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people , nor any remaining where he lived .

verses.z: 你尋索言語要到幾時呢？你可以揣摩思想，然後我們就說話。
verses.e: " How long will you hunt for words ? Consider , and afterwards we will speak .

verses.z: 以後來的要驚奇他的日子，好像以前去的受了驚駭。
verses.e: Those who come after will be astonished at his day , as those who went before were frightened .

verses.z: 不義之人的住處總是這樣；此乃不認識上帝之人的地步。
verses.e: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous . This is the place of him who doesn't know God . "

verses.z: 我們為何算為畜生，在你眼中看作污穢呢？
verses.e: Why are we counted as animals , which have become unclean in your sight ?

verses.z: 你這惱怒將自己撕裂的，難道大地為你見棄、磐石挪開原處嗎？
verses.e: You who tear yourself in your anger , will the earth be forsaken for you ? Or will the rock be removed out of its place ?

verses.z: 惡人的亮光必要熄滅；他的火焰必不照耀。
verses.e: " Yes , the light of the wicked will be put out . The spark of his fire won't shine .

verses.z: 他帳棚中的亮光要變為黑暗；他以上的燈也必熄滅。
verses.e: The light will be dark in his tent . His lamp above him will be put out .

verses.z: 他堅強的腳步必見狹窄；自己的計謀必將他絆倒。
verses.e: The steps of his strength will be shortened . His own counsel will cast him down .

verses.z: 因為他被自己的腳陷入網中，走在纏人的網羅上。
verses.e: For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he wanders into its mesh .

verses.z: 圈套必抓住他的腳跟；機關必擒獲他。
verses.e: A snare will take him by the heel . A trap will catch him .

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 他在四圍攻擊我，我便歸於死亡，將我的指望如樹拔出來。
verses.e: He has broken me down on every side , and I am gone . He has plucked my hope up like a tree .

verses.z: 他的忿怒向我發作，以我為敵人。
verses.e: He has also kindled his wrath against me . He counts me among his adversaries .

verses.z: 他的軍旅一齊上來，修築戰路攻擊我，在我帳棚的四圍安營。
verses.e: His troops come on together , build a siege ramp against me , and encamp around my tent .

verses.z: 他把我的弟兄隔在遠處，使我所認識的全然與我生疏。
verses.e: " He has put my brothers far from me . My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me .

verses.z: 我的親戚與我斷絕；我的密友都忘記我。
verses.e: My relatives have gone away . My familiar friends have forgotten me .

verses.z: 在我家寄居的，和我的使女都以我為外人；我在他們眼中看為外邦人。
verses.e: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger . I am an alien in their sight .

verses.z: 我呼喚僕人，雖用口求他，他還是不回答。
verses.e: I call to my servant , and he gives me no answer . I beg him with my mouth .

verses.z: 我口的氣味，我妻子厭惡；我的懇求，我同胞也憎嫌。
verses.e: My breath is offensive to my wife . I am loathsome to the children of my own mother .

verses.z: 連小孩子也藐視我；我若起來，他們都嘲笑我。
verses.e: Even young children despise me . If I arise , they speak against me .

verses.z: 我的密友都憎惡我；我平日所愛的人向我翻臉。
verses.e: All my familiar friends abhor me . They whom I loved have turned against me .

verses.z: 你們攪擾我的心，用言語壓碎我要到幾時呢？
verses.e: " How long will you torment me , and crush me with words ?

verses.z: 我的皮肉緊貼骨頭；我只剩牙皮逃脫了。
verses.e: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh . I have escaped by the skin of my teeth .

verses.z: 我朋友啊，可憐我！可憐我！因為上帝的手攻擊我。
verses.e: " Have pity on me . Have pity on me , you my friends , for the hand of God has touched me .

verses.z: 你們為甚麼彷彿上帝逼迫我，吃我的肉還以為不足呢？
verses.e: Why do you persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?

verses.z: 惟願我的言語現在寫上，都記錄在書上；
verses.e: " Oh that my words were now written ! Oh that they were inscribed in a book !

verses.z: 用鐵筆鐫刻，用鉛灌在磐石上，直存到永遠。
verses.e: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever !

verses.z: 我知道我的救贖主活着，末了必站立在地上。
verses.e: But as for me , I know that my Redeemer lives . In the end , he will stand upon the earth .

verses.z: 我這皮肉滅絕之後，我必在肉體之外得見上帝。
verses.e: After my skin is destroyed , then I will see God in my flesh ,

verses.z: 我自己要見他，親眼要看他，並不像外人。我的心腸在我裏面消滅了！
verses.e: whom I , even I , will see on my side . My eyes will see , and not as a stranger . " My heart is consumed within me .

verses.z: 你們若說：我們逼迫他要何等地重呢？[惹]事的根乃在乎他；
verses.e: If you say , ' How we will persecute him ! ' because the root of the matter is found in me ,

verses.z: 你們就當懼怕刀劍；因為忿怒[惹動]刀劍的刑罰，使你們知道有報應。
verses.e: be afraid of the sword , for wrath brings the punishments of the sword , that you may know there is a judgment . "

verses.z: 你們這十次羞辱我；你們苦待我也不以為恥。
verses.e: You have reproached me ten times . You aren't ashamed that you attack me .

verses.z: 果真我有錯，這錯乃是在我。
verses.e: If it is true that I have erred , my error remains with myself .

verses.z: 你們果然要向我誇大，以我的羞辱為證指責我，
verses.e: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me , and plead against me my reproach ,

verses.z: 就該知道是上帝傾覆我，用網羅圍繞我。
verses.e: know now that God has subverted me , and has surrounded me with his net .

verses.z: 我因委曲呼叫，卻不蒙應允；我呼求，卻不得公斷。
verses.e: " Behold , I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard . I cry for help , but there is no justice .

verses.z: 上帝用籬笆攔住我的道路，使我不得經過；又使我的路徑黑暗。
verses.e: He has walled up my way so that I can't pass , and has set darkness in my paths .

verses.z: 他剝去我的榮光，摘去我頭上的冠冕。
verses.e: He has stripped me of my glory , and taken the crown from my head .

verses.z: 又有一天，上帝的眾子來侍立在耶和華面前，撒但也來在其中。
verses.e: Again , on the day when God's sons came to present themselves before the LORD , Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD .

verses.z: 約伯卻對她說：「你說話像愚頑的婦人一樣。噯！難道我們從上帝手裏得福，不也受禍嗎？」在這一切的事上約伯並不以口犯罪。
verses.e: But he said to her , " You speak as one of the foolish women would speak . What ? Shall we receive good at the hand of God , and shall we not receive evil ? " In all this Job didn't sin with his lips .

verses.z: 約伯的三個朋友－提幔人以利法、書亞人比勒達、拿瑪人瑣法－聽說有這一切的災禍臨到他身上，各人就從本處約會同來，為他悲傷，安慰他。
verses.e: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him , they each came from his own place : Eliphaz the Temanite , Bildad the Shuhite , and Zophar the Naamathite ; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him .

verses.z: 他們遠遠地舉目觀看，認不出他來，就放聲大哭。各人撕裂外袍，把塵土向天揚起來，落在自己的頭上。
verses.e: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance , and didn't recognize him , they raised their voices , and wept ; and they each tore his robe , and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky .

verses.z: 他們就同他七天七夜坐在地上，一個人也不向他說句話，因為他極其痛苦。
verses.e: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights , and no one spoke a word to him , for they saw that his grief was very great .

verses.z: 耶和華問撒但說：「你從哪裏來？」撒但回答說：「我從地上走來走去，往返而來。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Satan , " Where have you come from ? " Satan answered the LORD , and said , " From going back and forth in the earth , and from walking up and down in it . "

verses.z: 耶和華問撒但說：「你曾用心察看我的僕人約伯沒有？地上再沒有人像他完全正直，敬畏上帝，遠離惡事。你雖激動我攻擊他，無故地毀滅他，他仍然持守他的純正。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Satan , " Have you considered my servant Job ? For there is no one like him in the earth , a blameless and an upright man , one who fears God , and turns away from evil . He still maintains his integrity , although you incited me against him , to ruin him without cause . "

verses.z: 撒但回答耶和華說：「人以皮代皮，情願捨去一切所有的，保全性命。
verses.e: Satan answered the LORD , and said , " Skin for skin . Yes , all that a man has he will give for his life .

verses.z: 你且伸手傷他的骨頭和他的肉，他必當面棄掉你。」
verses.e: But stretch out your hand now , and touch his bone and his flesh , and he will renounce you to your face . "

verses.z: 耶和華對撒但說：「他在你手中，只要存留他的性命。」
