verses.e: The LORD said to Satan , " Behold , he is in your hand . Only spare his life . "

verses.z: 於是撒但從耶和華面前退去，擊打約伯，使他從腳掌到頭頂長毒瘡。
verses.e: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD , and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head .

verses.z: 約伯就坐在爐灰中，拿瓦片刮身體。
verses.e: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with , and he sat among the ashes .

verses.z: 他的妻子對他說：「你仍然持守你的純正嗎？你棄掉上帝，死了吧！」
verses.e: Then his wife said to him , " Do you still maintain your integrity ? Renounce God , and die . "

verses.z: 拿瑪人瑣法回答說：
verses.e: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered ,

verses.z: 他的兒女要求窮人的恩；他的手要賠還[不義]之財。
verses.e: His children will seek the favor of the poor . His hands will give back his wealth .

verses.z: 他的骨頭雖然有青年[之力]，卻要和他一同躺臥在塵土中。
verses.e: His bones are full of his youth , but youth will lie down with him in the dust .

verses.z: 他口內雖以惡為甘甜，藏在舌頭底下，
verses.e: " Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth , though he hide it under his tongue ,

verses.z: 愛戀不捨，含在口中；
verses.e: though he spare it , and will not let it go , but keep it still within his mouth ,

verses.z: 他的食物在肚裏卻要化為酸，在他裏面成為虺蛇的惡毒。
verses.e: yet his food in his bowels is turned . It is cobra venom within him .

verses.z: 他吞了財寶，還要吐出；上帝要從他腹中掏出來。
verses.e: He has swallowed down riches , and he will vomit them up again . God will cast them out of his belly .

verses.z: 他必吸飲虺蛇的毒氣；蝮蛇的舌頭也必殺他。
verses.e: He will suck cobra venom . The viper's tongue will kill him .

verses.z: 流奶與蜜之河，他不得再見。
verses.e: He will not look at the rivers , the flowing streams of honey and butter .

verses.z: 他勞碌得來的要賠還，不得享用；不能照所得的財貨歡樂。
verses.e: He will restore that for which he labored , and will not swallow it down . He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten .

verses.z: 他欺壓窮人，且又離棄；強取非自己所蓋的房屋。
verses.e: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor . He has violently taken away a house , and he will not build it up .

verses.z: 我心中急躁，所以我的思念叫我回答。
verses.e: " Therefore my thoughts answer me , even by reason of my haste that is in me .

verses.z: 他因貪而無厭，所喜悅的連一樣也不能保守。
verses.e: " Because he knew no quietness within him , he will not save anything of that in which he delights .

verses.z: 其餘的沒有一樣他不吞滅，所以他的福樂不能長久。
verses.e: There was nothing left that he didn't devour , therefore his prosperity will not endure .

verses.z: 他在滿足有餘的時候，必到狹窄的地步；凡受苦楚的人都必加手在他身上。
verses.e: In the fullness of his sufficiency , distress will overtake him . The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him .

verses.z: 他正要充滿肚腹的時候，上帝必將猛烈的忿怒降在他身上；正在他吃飯的時候，要將這忿怒像雨降在他身上。
verses.e: When he is about to fill his belly , God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him . It will rain on him while he is eating .

verses.z: 他要躲避鐵器；銅弓[的箭]要將他射透。
verses.e: He will flee from the iron weapon . The bronze arrow will strike him through .

verses.z: 他把箭一抽，就從他身上出來；發光的箭頭從他膽中出來，有驚惶臨在他身上。
verses.e: He draws it out , and it comes out of his body . Yes , the glittering point comes out of his liver . Terrors are on him .

verses.z: 他的財寶歸於黑暗；[人]所不吹的火要把他燒滅，要把他帳棚中所剩下的燒毀。
verses.e: All darkness is laid up for his treasures . An unfanned fire will devour him . It will consume that which is left in his tent .

verses.z: 天要顯明他的罪孽；地要興起攻擊他。
verses.e: The heavens will reveal his iniquity . The earth will rise up against him .

verses.z: 他的家產必然過去；上帝發怒的日子，[他的貨物]都要消滅。
verses.e: The increase of his house will depart . They will rush away in the day of his wrath .

verses.z: 這是惡人從上帝所得的分，是上帝為他所定的產業。
verses.e: This is the portion of a wicked man from God , the heritage appointed to him by God . "

verses.z: 我已聽見那羞辱我，責備我的話；我的悟性叫我回答。
verses.e: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame . The spirit of my understanding answers me .

verses.z: 你豈不知亙古以來，自從人生在地，
verses.e: Don't you know this from old time , since man was placed on earth ,

verses.z: 惡人誇勝是暫時的，不敬虔人的喜樂不過轉眼之間嗎？
verses.e: that the triumphing of the wicked is short , the joy of the godless but for a moment ?

verses.z: 他的尊榮雖達到天上，頭雖頂到雲中，
verses.e: Though his height mount up to the heavens , and his head reach to the clouds ,

verses.z: 他終必滅亡，像自己的糞一樣；素來見他的人要說：他在哪裏呢？
verses.e: yet he will perish forever like his own dung . Those who have seen him will say , ' Where is he ? '

verses.z: 他必飛去如夢，不再尋見，速被趕去，如夜間的異象。
verses.e: He will fly away as a dream , and will not be found . Yes , he will be chased away like a vision of the night .

verses.z: 親眼見過他的，必不再見他；他的本處也再見不着他。
verses.e: The eye which saw him will see him no more , neither will his place see him any more .

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 他們的公牛孳生而不斷絕；母牛下犢而不掉胎。
verses.e: Their bulls breed without fail . Their cows calve , and don't miscarry .

verses.z: 他們打發小孩子出去，[多]如羊群；他們的兒女踴躍跳舞。
verses.e: They send out their little ones like a flock . Their children dance .

verses.z: 他們隨着琴鼓歌唱，又因簫聲歡喜。
verses.e: They sing to the tambourine and harp , and rejoice at the sound of the pipe .

verses.z: 他們度日諸事亨通，轉眼下入陰間。
verses.e: They spend their days in prosperity . In an instant they go down to Sheol .

verses.z: 他們對上帝說：離開我們吧！我們不願曉得你的道。
verses.e: They tell God , ' Depart from us , for we don't want to know about your ways .

verses.z: 全能者是誰，我們何必事奉他呢？求告他有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: What is the Almighty , that we should serve him ? What profit should we have , if we pray to him ? '

verses.z: 看哪，他們亨通不在乎自己；惡人所謀定的離我好遠。
verses.e: Behold , their prosperity is not in their hand . The counsel of the wicked is far from me .

verses.z: 惡人的燈何嘗熄滅？患難何嘗臨到他們呢？上帝何嘗發怒，[向他們]分散災禍呢？
verses.e: " How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out , that their calamity comes on them , that God distributes sorrows in his anger ?

verses.z: 他們何嘗像風前的碎稭，如暴風颳去的糠詷呢？
verses.e: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind , as chaff that the storm carries away ?

verses.z: [你們說]：上帝為惡人的兒女積蓄罪孽；[我說]：不如本人受報，好使他親自知道。
verses.e: You say , ' God lays up his iniquity for his children . ' Let him recompense it to himself , that he may know it .

verses.z: 你們要細聽我的言語，就算是你們安慰我。
verses.e: " Listen diligently to my speech . Let this be your consolation .

verses.z: 願他親眼看見自己敗亡，親自飲全能者的忿怒。
verses.e: Let his own eyes see his destruction . Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty .

verses.z: 他的歲月既盡，他還顧他本家嗎？
verses.e: For what does he care for his house after him , when the number of his months is cut off ?

verses.z: 上帝既審判那在高位的，誰能將知識教訓他呢？
verses.e: " Shall any teach God knowledge , since he judges those who are high ?

verses.z: 有人至死身體強壯，盡得平靖安逸；
verses.e: One dies in his full strength , being wholly at ease and quiet .

verses.z: 他的奶桶充滿，他的骨髓滋潤。
verses.e: His pails are full of milk . The marrow of his bones is moistened .

verses.z: 有人至死心中痛苦，終身未嘗福樂的滋味；
verses.e: Another dies in bitterness of soul , and never tastes of good .

verses.z: 他們一樣躺臥在塵土中，都被蟲子遮蓋。
verses.e: They lie down alike in the dust . The worm covers them .

verses.z: 我知道你們的意思，並誣害我的計謀。
verses.e: " Behold , I know your thoughts , the plans with which you would wrong me .

verses.z: 你們說：霸者的房屋在哪裏？惡人住過的帳棚在哪裏？
verses.e: For you say , ' Where is the house of the prince ? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived ? '

verses.z: 你們豈沒有詢問過路的人嗎？不知道他們所引的證據嗎？
verses.e: Haven't you asked wayfaring men ? Don't you know their evidences ,

verses.z: 請寬容我，我又要說話；說了以後，任憑你們嗤笑吧！
verses.e: Allow me , and I also will speak . After I have spoken , mock on .

verses.z: 就是惡人在禍患的日子得存留，在發怒的日子得逃脫。
verses.e: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity , that they are led out to the day of wrath ?

verses.z: 他所行的，有誰當面給他說明？他所做的，有誰報應他呢？
verses.e: Who will declare his way to his face ? Who will repay him what he has done ?

verses.z: 然而他要被抬到塋地；並有人看守墳墓。
verses.e: Yet he will be borne to the grave . Men will keep watch over the tomb .

verses.z: 他要以谷中的土塊為甘甜；在他以先去的無數，在他以後去的更多。
verses.e: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him . All men will draw after him , as there were innumerable before him .

verses.z: 你們對答的話中既都錯謬，怎麼徒然安慰我呢？
verses.e: So how can you comfort me with nonsense , because in your answers there remains only falsehood ? "

verses.z: 我豈是向人訴冤？為何不焦急呢？
verses.e: As for me , is my complaint to man ? Why shouldn't I be impatient ?

verses.z: 你們要看着我而驚奇，用手摀口。
verses.e: Look at me , and be astonished . Lay your hand on your mouth .

verses.z: 我每逢思想，心就驚惶，渾身戰兢。
verses.e: When I remember , I am troubled . Horror takes hold of my flesh .

verses.z: 惡人為何存活，享大壽數，勢力強盛呢？
verses.e: " Why do the wicked live , become old , yes , and grow mighty in power ?

verses.z: 他們眼見兒孫，和他們一同堅立。
verses.e: Their child is established with them in their sight , their offspring before their eyes .

verses.z: 他們的家宅平安無懼；上帝的杖也不加在他們身上。
verses.e: Their houses are safe from fear , neither is the rod of God upon them .

verses.z: 提幔人以利法回答說：
verses.e: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered ,

verses.z: 因此，有網羅環繞你，有恐懼忽然使你驚惶；
verses.e: Therefore snares are around you . Sudden fear troubles you ,

verses.z: 或有黑暗蒙蔽你，並有洪水淹沒你。
verses.e: or darkness , so that you can not see , and floods of waters cover you .

verses.z: 上帝豈不是在高天嗎？你看星宿何其高呢！
verses.e: " Isn't God in the heights of heaven ? See the height of the stars , how high they are !

verses.z: 你說：上帝知道甚麼？他豈能看透幽暗施行審判呢？
verses.e: You say , ' What does God know ? Can he judge through the thick darkness ?

verses.z: 密雲將他遮蓋，使他不能看見；他周遊穹蒼。
verses.e: Thick clouds are a covering to him , so that he doesn't see . He walks on the vault of the sky . '

verses.z: 你要依從上古的道嗎？這道是惡人所行的。
verses.e: Will you keep the old way , which wicked men have trodden ,

verses.z: 他們未到死期，忽然除滅；根基毀壞，好像被江河沖去。
verses.e: who were snatched away before their time , whose foundation was poured out as a stream ,

verses.z: 他們向上帝說：離開我們吧！又[說]：全能者能把我們怎麼樣呢？
verses.e: who said to God , ' Depart from us ! ' and , ' What can the Almighty do for us ? '

verses.z: 哪知上帝以美物充滿他們的房屋；但惡人所謀定的離我好遠。
verses.e: Yet he filled their houses with good things , but the counsel of the wicked is far from me .

verses.z: 義人看見他們的[結局]就歡喜；無辜的人嗤笑他們，
verses.e: The righteous see it , and are glad . The innocent ridicule them ,

verses.z: 人豈能使上帝有益呢？智慧人但能有益於己。
verses.e: " Can a man be profitable to God ? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself .

verses.z: 說：那起來攻擊我們的果然被剪除，其餘的都被火燒滅。
verses.e: saying , ' Surely those who rose up against us are cut off . The fire has consumed their remnant . '

verses.z: 你要認識上帝，就得平安；福氣也必臨到你。
verses.e: " Acquaint yourself with him now , and be at peace . By it , good will come to you .

verses.z: 你當領受他口中的教訓，將他的言語存在心裏。
verses.e: Please receive instruction from his mouth , and lay up his words in your heart .

verses.z: 你若歸向全能者，從你帳棚中遠除不義，就必得建立。
verses.e: If you return to the Almighty , you will be built up , if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents .

verses.z: 要將[你的]珍寶丟在塵土裏，將俄斐的[黃金]丟在溪河石頭之間；
verses.e: Lay your treasure in the dust , the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks .

verses.z: 全能者就必為你的珍寶，作你的寶銀。
verses.e: The Almighty will be your treasure , and precious silver to you .

verses.z: 你就要以全能者為喜樂，向上帝仰起臉來。
verses.e: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty , and will lift up your face to God .

verses.z: 你要禱告他，他就聽你；你也要還你的願。
verses.e: You will make your prayer to him , and he will hear you . You will pay your vows .

verses.z: 你定意要做何事，必然給你成就；亮光也必照耀你的路。
verses.e: You will also decree a thing , and it will be established to you . Light will shine on your ways .

verses.z: 人使[你]降卑，你仍可說：[必得]高升；謙卑的人，上帝必然拯救。
verses.e: When they cast down , you will say , ' be lifted up . ' He will save the humble person .

verses.z: 你為人公義，豈叫全能者喜悅呢？你行為完全，豈能使他得利呢？
verses.e: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous ? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect ?

verses.z: 人非無辜，上帝且要搭救他；他因你手中清潔，必蒙拯救。
verses.e: He will even deliver him who is not innocent . Yes , he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands . "

verses.z: 豈是因你敬畏他就責備你、審判你嗎？
verses.e: Is it for your piety that he reproves you , that he enters with you into judgment ?

verses.z: 你的罪惡豈不是大嗎？你的罪孽也沒有窮盡；
verses.e: Isn't your wickedness great ? Neither is there any end to your iniquities .

verses.z: 因你無故強取弟兄的物為當頭，剝去貧寒人的衣服。
verses.e: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing , and stripped the naked of their clothing .

verses.z: 困乏的人，你沒有給他水喝；飢餓的人，你沒有給他食物。
verses.e: You haven't given water to the weary to drink , and you have withheld bread from the hungry .

verses.z: 有能力的人就得地土；尊貴的人也住在其中。
verses.e: But as for the mighty man , he had the earth . The honorable man , he lived in it .

verses.z: 你打發寡婦空手回去，折斷孤兒的膀臂。
verses.e: You have sent widows away empty , and the arms of the fatherless have been broken .

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 然而他知道我所行的路；他試煉我之後，我必如精金。
verses.e: But he knows the way that I take . When he has tried me , I will come out like gold .

verses.z: 我腳追隨他的步履；我謹守他的道，並不偏離。
verses.e: My foot has held fast to his steps . I have kept his way , and not turned away .

verses.z: 他嘴唇的命令，我未曾背棄；我看重他口中的言語，過於我需用的飲食。
verses.e: I haven't gone back from the commandment of his lips . I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .

verses.z: 只是他[心志]已定，誰能使他轉意呢？他心裏所願的，就行出來。
verses.e: But he stands alone , and who can oppose him ? What his soul desires , even that he does .

verses.z: 他向我所定的，就必做成；這類的事他還有許多。
verses.e: For he performs that which is appointed for me . Many such things are with him .

verses.z: 所以我在他面前驚惶；我思念[這事]便懼怕他。
verses.e: Therefore I am terrified at his presence . When I consider , I am afraid of him .

verses.z: 上帝使我喪膽；全能者使我驚惶。
verses.e: For God has made my heart faint . The Almighty has terrified me .

verses.z: 我的恐懼不是因為黑暗，也不是因為幽暗蒙蔽我的臉。
verses.e: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face .

verses.z: 如今我的哀告還算為悖逆；我的責罰比我的唉哼還重。
verses.e: " Even today my complaint is rebellious . His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning .

verses.z: 惟願我能知道在哪裏可以尋見上帝，能到他的臺前，
verses.e: Oh that I knew where I might find him ! That I might come even to his seat !

verses.z: 我就在他面前將我的案件陳明，滿口辯白。
verses.e: I would set my cause in order before him , and fill my mouth with arguments .

verses.z: 我必知道他回答我的言語，明白他向我所說的話。
verses.e: I would know the words which he would answer me , and understand what he would tell me .

verses.z: 他豈用大能與我爭辯嗎？必不這樣！他必理會我。
verses.e: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power ? No , but he would listen to me .

verses.z: 在他那裏正直人可以與他辯論；這樣，我必永遠脫離那審判我的。
verses.e: There the upright might reason with him , so I should be delivered forever from my judge .

verses.z: 只是，我往前行，他不[在那裏]，往後退，也不能見他。
verses.e: " If I go east , he is not there . If I go west , I can't find him .

verses.z: 他在左邊行事，我卻不能看見，在右邊隱藏，我也不能見他。
verses.e: He works to the north , but I can't see him . He turns south , but I can't catch a glimpse of him .

verses.z: 全能者既定期[罰惡]，為何不使認識他的人看見那日子呢？
verses.e: " Why aren't times laid up by the Almighty ? Why don't those who know him see his days ?

verses.z: 使人赤身無衣，到處流行，且因飢餓扛抬禾捆，
verses.e: so that they go around naked without clothing . Being hungry , they carry the sheaves .

verses.z: 在那些人的圍牆內造油，醡酒，自己還口渴。
verses.e: They make oil within the walls of these men . They tread wine presses , and suffer thirst .

verses.z: 在多民的城內有人唉哼，受傷的人哀號；上帝卻不理會[那惡人]的愚妄。
verses.e: From out of the populous city , men groan . The soul of the wounded cries out , yet God doesn't regard the folly .

verses.z: 又有人背棄光明，不認識光明的道，不住在光明的路上。
verses.e: " These are of those who rebel against the light . They don't know its ways , nor stay in its paths .

verses.z: 殺人的黎明起來，殺害困苦窮乏人，夜間又作盜賊。
verses.e: The murderer rises with the light . He kills the poor and needy . In the night he is like a thief .

verses.z: 姦夫等候黃昏，說：必無眼能見我，就把臉蒙蔽。
verses.e: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight , saying , ' No eye will see me . ' He disguises his face .

verses.z: 盜賊黑夜挖窟窿；白日躲藏，並不認識光明。
verses.e: In the dark they dig through houses . They shut themselves up in the daytime . They don't know the light .

verses.z: 他們看早晨如幽暗，因為他們曉得幽暗的驚駭。
verses.e: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness , for they know the terrors of the thick darkness .

verses.z: [這些惡人猶如浮萍]快快[飄去]。他們所得的分在世上被咒詛；他們不得再走葡萄園的路。
verses.e: " They are foam on the surface of the waters . Their portion is cursed in the earth . They don't turn into the way of the vineyards .

verses.z: 乾旱炎熱消沒雪水；陰間也如此[消沒]犯罪之輩。
verses.e: Drought and heat consume the snow waters , so does Sheol those who have sinned .

verses.z: 有人挪移地界，搶奪群畜而牧養。
verses.e: There are people who remove the landmarks . They violently take away flocks , and feed them .

verses.z: 懷他的母要忘記他；蟲子要吃他，覺得甘甜；他不再被人記念。不義[的人]必如樹折斷。
verses.e: The womb will forget him . The worm will feed sweetly on him . He will be no more remembered . Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree .

verses.z: 他惡待不懷孕不生養的婦人，不善待寡婦。
verses.e: He devours the barren who don't bear . He shows no kindness to the widow .

verses.z: 然而上帝用能力保全有勢力的人；那性命難保的人仍然興起。
verses.e: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power . He rises up who has no assurance of life .

verses.z: 上帝使他們安穩，他們就有所倚靠；上帝的眼目也看顧他們的道路。
verses.e: God gives them security , and they rest in it . His eyes are on their ways .

verses.z: 他們被高舉，不過片時就沒有了；他們降為卑，被除滅，與眾人一樣，又如穀穗被割。
verses.e: They are exalted ; yet a little while , and they are gone . Yes , they are brought low , they are taken out of the way as all others , and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain .

verses.z: 若不是這樣，誰能證實我是說謊的，將我的言語駁為虛空呢？
verses.e: If it isn't so now , who will prove me a liar , and make my speech worth nothing ? "

verses.z: 他們拉去孤兒的驢，強取寡婦的牛為當頭。
verses.e: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless , and they take the widow's ox for a pledge .

verses.z: 他們使窮人離開正道；世上的貧民盡都隱藏。
verses.e: They turn the needy out of the way . The poor of the earth all hide themselves .

verses.z: 這些貧窮人如同野驢出到曠野，殷勤尋找食物；他們[靠着]野地給兒女糊口，
verses.e: Behold , as wild donkeys in the desert , they go out to their work , seeking diligently for food . The wilderness yields them bread for their children .

verses.z: 收割[別人]田間的禾稼，摘取惡人餘剩的葡萄，
verses.e: They cut their food in the field . They glean the vineyard of the wicked .

verses.z: 終夜赤身無衣，天氣寒冷毫無遮蓋，
verses.e: They lie all night naked without clothing , and have no covering in the cold .

verses.z: 在山上被大雨淋濕，因沒有避身之處就挨近磐石。
verses.e: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter .

verses.z: 又有人從母懷中搶奪孤兒，強取窮人的[衣服]為當頭，
verses.e: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor ,

verses.z: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
verses.e: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered ,

verses.z: 上帝有治理之權，有威嚴可畏；他在高處施行和平。
verses.e: " Dominion and fear are with him . He makes peace in his high places .

verses.z: 他的諸軍豈能數算？他的光亮一發，誰不蒙照呢？
verses.e: Can his armies be counted ? On whom does his light not arise ?

verses.z: 這樣在上帝面前，人怎能稱義？婦人所生的怎能潔淨？
verses.e: How then can man be just with God ? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean ?

verses.z: 在上帝眼前，月亮也無光亮，星宿也不清潔。
verses.e: Behold , even the moon has no brightness , and the stars are not pure in his sight ;

verses.z: 何況如蟲的人，如蛆的世人呢！
verses.e: How much less man , who is a worm , and the son of man , who is a worm ! "

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 在水面的周圍劃出界限，直到光明黑暗的交界。
verses.e: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters , and to the confines of light and darkness .

verses.z: 天的柱子因他的斥責震動驚奇。
verses.e: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke .

verses.z: 他以能力攪動大海；他藉知識打傷拉哈伯，
verses.e: He stirs up the sea with his power , and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab .

verses.z: 藉他的靈使天有妝飾；他的手刺殺快蛇。
verses.e: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished . His hand has pierced the swift serpent .

verses.z: 看哪，這不過是上帝工作的些微；我們所聽於他的是何等細微的聲音！他大能的雷聲誰能明透呢？
verses.e: Behold , these are but the outskirts of his ways . How small a whisper do we hear of him ! But the thunder of his power who can understand ? "

verses.z: 無能的人蒙你何等的幫助！膀臂無力的人蒙你何等的拯救！
verses.e: " How have you helped him who is without power ! How have you saved the arm that has no strength !

verses.z: 無智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！你向他多顯大知識！
verses.e: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom , and plentifully declared sound knowledge !

verses.z: 你向誰發出言語來？誰的靈從你而出？
verses.e: To whom have you uttered words ? Whose spirit came out of you ?

verses.z: 在大水和水族以下的陰魂戰兢。
verses.e: " The departed spirits tremble , those beneath the waters and all that live in them .

verses.z: 在上帝面前，陰間顯露；滅亡也不得遮掩。
verses.e: Sheol is naked before God , and Abaddon has no covering .

verses.z: 上帝將北極鋪在空中，將大地懸在虛空；
verses.e: He stretches out the north over empty space , and hangs the earth on nothing .

verses.z: 將水包在密雲中，雲卻不破裂；
verses.e: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds , and the cloud is not burst under them .

verses.z: 遮蔽他的寶座，將雲鋪在其上；
verses.e: He encloses the face of his throne , and spreads his cloud on it .

verses.z: 約伯接着說：
verses.e: Job again took up his parable , and said ,

verses.z: 他豈以全能者為樂，隨時求告上帝呢？
verses.e: Will he delight himself in the Almighty , and call on God at all times ?

verses.z: 上帝的作為，我要指教你們；全能者所行的，我也不隱瞞。
verses.e: I will teach you about the hand of God . I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty .

verses.z: 你們自己也都見過，為何全然變為虛妄呢？
verses.e: Behold , all of you have seen it yourselves ; why then have you become altogether vain ?

verses.z: 上帝為惡人所定的分，強暴人從全能者所得的報乃是這樣：
verses.e: " This is the portion of a wicked man with God , the heritage of oppressors , which they receive from the Almighty .

verses.z: 倘或他的兒女增多，還是被刀所殺；他的子孫必不得飽食。
verses.e: If his children are multiplied , it is for the sword . His offspring will not be satisfied with bread .

verses.z: 他所遺留的人必死而埋葬；他的寡婦也不哀哭。
verses.e: Those who remain of him will be buried in death . His widows will make no lamentation .

verses.z: 他雖積蓄銀子如塵沙，預備衣服如泥土；
verses.e: Though he heap up silver as the dust , and prepare clothing as the clay ;

verses.z: 他只管預備，義人卻要穿上；他的銀子，無辜的人要分取。
verses.e: he may prepare it , but the just will put it on , and the innocent will divide the silver .

verses.z: 他建造房屋如蟲做窩，又如守望者所搭的棚。
verses.e: He builds his house as the moth , as a booth which the watchman makes .

verses.z: 他雖富足躺臥，卻不得收殮，轉眼之間就不在了。
verses.e: He lies down rich , but he will not do so again . He opens his eyes , and he is not .

verses.z: 上帝奪去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。我指着永生的上帝起誓：
verses.e: " As God lives , who has taken away my right , the Almighty , who has made my soul bitter

verses.z: 驚恐如波濤將他追上；暴風在夜間將他颳去。
verses.e: Terrors overtake him like waters . A storm steals him away in the night .

verses.z: 東風把他飄去，又颳他離開本處。
verses.e: The east wind carries him away , and he departs . It sweeps him out of his place .

verses.z: 上帝要向他射箭，並不留情；他恨不得逃脫上帝的手。
verses.e: For it hurls at him , and does not spare , as he flees away from his hand .

verses.z: 人要向他拍掌，並要發叱聲，使他離開本處。
verses.e: Men will clap their hands at him , and will hiss him out of his place .

verses.z: 我的生命尚在我裏面；上帝所賜呼吸之氣仍在我的鼻孔內。
verses.e: ( for the length of my life is still in me , and the spirit of God is in my nostrils ) ;

verses.z: 我的嘴決不說非義之言；我的舌也不說詭詐之語。
verses.e: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness , neither will my tongue utter deceit .

verses.z: 我斷不以你們為是；我至死必不以自己為不正！
verses.e: Far be it from me that I should justify you . Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me .

verses.z: 我持定我的義，必不放鬆；在世的日子，我心必不責備我。
verses.e: I hold fast to my righteousness , and will not let it go . My heart will not reproach me so long as I live .

verses.z: 願我的仇敵如惡人一樣；願那起來攻擊我的，如不義之人一般。
verses.e: " Let my enemy be as the wicked . Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous .

verses.z: 不敬虔的人雖然得利，上帝奪取其命的時候還有甚麼指望呢？
verses.e: For what is the hope of the godless , when he is cut off , when God takes away his life ?

verses.z: 患難臨到他，上帝豈能聽他的呼求？
verses.e: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him ?

verses.z: 銀子有礦；煉金有方。
verses.e: " Surely there is a mine for silver , and a place for gold which they refine .

verses.z: 在磐石中鑿出水道，親眼看見各樣寶物。
verses.e: He cuts out channels among the rocks . His eye sees every precious thing .

verses.z: 他封閉水不得滴流，使隱藏的物顯露出來。
verses.e: He binds the streams that they don't trickle . The thing that is hidden he brings out to light .

verses.z: 然而，智慧有何處可尋？聰明之處在哪裏呢？
verses.e: " But where will wisdom be found ? Where is the place of understanding ?

verses.z: 智慧的價值無人能知，在活人之地也無處可尋。
verses.e: Man doesn't know its price , and it isn't found in the land of the living .

verses.z: 深淵說：不在我內；滄海說：不在我中。
verses.e: The deep says , ' It isn't in me . ' The sea says , ' It isn't with me . '

verses.z: 智慧非用黃金可得，也不能平白銀為它的價值。
verses.e: It can't be gotten for gold , neither will silver be weighed for its price .

verses.z: 俄斐金和貴重的紅瑪瑙，並藍寶石，不足與較量；
verses.e: It can't be valued with the gold of Ophir , with the precious onyx , or the sapphire .

verses.z: 黃金和玻璃不足與比較；精金的器皿不足與兌換。
verses.e: Gold and glass can't equal it , neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold .

verses.z: 珊瑚、水晶都不足論；智慧的價值勝過珍珠。
verses.e: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal . Yes , the price of wisdom is above rubies .

verses.z: 古實的紅璧璽不足與比較；精金也不足與較量。
verses.e: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it . It won't be valued with pure gold .

verses.z: 鐵從地裏挖出；銅從石中鎔化。
verses.e: Iron is taken out of the earth , and copper is smelted out of the ore .

verses.z: 智慧從何處來呢？聰明之處在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Where then does wisdom come from ? Where is the place of understanding ?

verses.z: 是向一切有生命的眼目隱藏，向空中的飛鳥掩蔽。
verses.e: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the birds of the sky .

verses.z: 滅沒和死亡說：我們風聞其名。
verses.e: Destruction and Death say , ' We have heard a rumor of it with our ears . '

verses.z: 上帝明白智慧的道路，曉得智慧的所在。
verses.e: " God understands its way , and he knows its place .

verses.z: 因他鑒察直到地極，遍觀普天之下，
verses.e: For he looks to the ends of the earth , and sees under the whole sky .

verses.z: 要為風定輕重，又度量諸水；
verses.e: He establishes the force of the wind . Yes , he measures out the waters by measure .

verses.z: 他為雨露定命令，為雷電定道路。
verses.e: When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder ,

verses.z: 那時他看見智慧，而且述說；他堅定，並且查究。
verses.e: then he saw it , and declared it . He established it , yes , and searched it out .

verses.z: 他對人說：敬畏主就是智慧；遠離惡便是聰明。
verses.e: To man he said , ' Behold , the fear of the Lord , that is wisdom . To depart from evil is understanding . ' "

verses.z: 人為黑暗定界限，查究幽暗陰翳的石頭，直到極處，
verses.e: Man sets an end to darkness , and searches out , to the furthest bound , the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness .

verses.z: 在無人居住之處刨開礦穴，[過路的人]也想不到他們；又與人遠離，懸在空中搖來搖去。
verses.e: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live . They are forgotten by the foot . They hang far from men , they swing back and forth .

verses.z: 至於地，能出糧食，地內好像被火翻起來。
verses.e: As for the earth , out of it comes bread . Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire .

verses.z: 地中的石頭有藍寶石，並有金沙。
verses.e: Sapphires come from its rocks . It has dust of gold .

verses.z: 礦中的路鷙鳥不得知道；鷹眼也未見過。
verses.e: That path no bird of prey knows , neither has the falcon's eye seen it .

verses.z: 狂傲的野獸未曾行過；猛烈的獅子也未曾經過。
verses.e: The proud animals have not trodden it , nor has the fierce lion passed by there .

verses.z: 人伸手鑿開堅石，傾倒山根，
verses.e: He puts his hand on the flinty rock , and he overturns the mountains by the roots .

verses.z: 約伯又接着說：
verses.e: Job again took up his parable , and said ,

verses.z: 首領靜默無聲，舌頭貼住上膛。
verses.e: The voice of the nobles was hushed , and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth .

verses.z: 耳朵聽我的，就稱我有福；眼睛看我的，便稱讚我；
verses.e: For when the ear heard me , then it blessed me , and when the eye saw me , it commended me ,

verses.z: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人和無人幫助的孤兒。
verses.e: because I delivered the poor who cried , and the fatherless also , who had no one to help him ,

verses.z: 將要滅亡的為我祝福；我也使寡婦心中歡樂。
verses.e: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me , and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy .

verses.z: 我以公義為衣服，以公平為外袍和冠冕。
verses.e: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me . My justice was as a robe and a diadem .

verses.z: 我為瞎子的眼，瘸子的腳。
verses.e: I was eyes to the blind , and feet to the lame .

verses.z: 我為窮乏人的父；素不認識的人，我查明他的案件。
verses.e: I was a father to the needy . I researched the cause of him whom I didn't know .

verses.z: 我打破不義之人的牙床，從他牙齒中奪了所搶的。
verses.e: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth .

verses.z: 我便說：我必死在家中，必增添我的日子，多如塵沙。
verses.e: Then I said , ' I will die in my own house , I will count my days as the sand .

verses.z: 我的根長到水邊；露水終夜霑在我的枝上。
verses.e: My root is spread out to the waters . The dew lies all night on my branch .

verses.z: 惟願我[的景況]如從前的月份，如上帝保守我的日子。
verses.e: " Oh that I were as in the months of old , as in the days when God watched over me ;

verses.z: 我的榮耀在身上增新；我的弓在手中日強。
verses.e: My glory is fresh in me . My bow is renewed in my hand . '

verses.z: 人聽見我而仰望，靜默等候我的指教。
verses.e: " Men listened to me , waited , and kept silence for my counsel .

verses.z: 我說話之後，他們就不再說；我的言語[像雨露]滴在他們身上。
verses.e: After my words they didn't speak again . My speech fell on them .

verses.z: 他們仰望我如仰望雨，又張開口如切慕春雨。
verses.e: They waited for me as for the rain . Their mouths drank as with the spring rain .

verses.z: 他們不敢自信，我就向他們含笑；他們不使我臉上的光改變。
verses.e: I smiled on them when they had no confidence . They didn't reject the light of my face .

verses.z: 我為他們選擇道路，又坐首位；我如君王在軍隊中居住，又如弔喪的安慰傷心的人。
verses.e: I chose out their way , and sat as chief . I lived as a king in the army , as one who comforts the mourners .

verses.z: 那時他的燈照在我頭上；我藉他的光行過黑暗。
verses.e: when his lamp shone on my head , and by his light I walked through darkness ,

verses.z: 我願如壯年的時候：那時我在帳棚中，上帝待我有密友之情；
verses.e: as I was in my prime , when the friendship of God was in my tent ,

verses.z: 全能者仍與我同在；我的兒女都環繞我。
verses.e: when the Almighty was yet with me , and my children were around me ,

verses.z: 奶多可洗我的腳；磐石為我出油成河。
verses.e: when my steps were washed with butter , and the rock poured out streams of oil for me ,

verses.z: 我出到城門，在街上設立座位；
verses.e: when I went out to the city gate , when I prepared my seat in the street .

verses.z: 少年人見我而迴避，老年人也起身站立；
verses.e: The young men saw me and hid themselves . The aged rose up and stood .

verses.z: 王子都停止說話，用手摀口；
verses.e: The princes refrained from talking , and laid their hand on their mouth .

verses.z: 此後，約伯開口咒詛自己的[生]日，
verses.e: After this Job opened his mouth , and cursed the day of his birth .

verses.z: 因沒有把懷我胎的門關閉，也沒有將患難對我的眼隱藏。
verses.e: because it didn't shut up the doors of my mother's womb , nor did it hide trouble from my eyes .

verses.z: 我為何不出[母]胎而死？為何不出[母]腹絕氣？
verses.e: " Why didn't I die from the womb ? Why didn't I give up the spirit when my mother bore me ?

verses.z: 為何有膝接收我？為何有奶哺養我？
verses.e: Why did the knees receive me ? Or why the breast , that I should nurse ?

verses.z: 不然，我就早已躺臥安睡，
verses.e: For now I should have lain down and been quiet . I should have slept , then I would have been at rest ,

verses.z: 和地上為自己重造荒邱的君王、謀士，
verses.e: with kings and counselors of the earth , who built up waste places for themselves ;

verses.z: 或與有金子、將銀子裝滿了房屋的王子一同安息；
verses.e: or with princes who had gold , who filled their houses with silver ;

verses.z: 或像隱而未現、不到期而落的胎，歸於無有，如同未見光的嬰孩。
verses.e: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been , as infants who never saw light .

verses.z: 在那裏惡人止息攪擾，困乏人得享安息，
verses.e: There the wicked cease from troubling . There the weary are at rest .

verses.z: 被囚的人同得安逸，不聽見督工的聲音。
verses.e: There the prisoners are at ease together . They don't hear the voice of the taskmaster .

verses.z: 大小都在那裏；奴僕脫離主人的轄制。
verses.e: The small and the great are there . The servant is free from his master .

verses.z: 說：
verses.e: Job answered :

verses.z: 受患難的人為何有光賜給他呢？心中愁苦的人為何有生命賜給他呢？
verses.e: " Why is light given to him who is in misery , life to the bitter in soul ,

verses.z: 他們切望死，卻不得死；求死，勝於求隱藏的珍寶。
verses.e: who long for death , but it doesn't come ; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures ,

verses.z: 他們尋見墳墓就快樂，極其歡喜。
verses.e: who rejoice exceedingly , and are glad , when they can find the grave ?

verses.z: 人的道路既然遮隱，上帝又把他四面圍困，[為何有光賜給]他呢？
verses.e: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden , whom God has hedged in ?

verses.z: 我未曾吃飯就發出歎息；我唉哼[的聲音]湧出如水。
verses.e: For my sighing comes before I eat . My groanings are poured out like water .

verses.z: 因我所恐懼的臨到我身，我所懼怕的迎我而來。
verses.e: For the thing which I fear comes on me , that which I am afraid of comes to me .

verses.z: 我不得安逸，不得平靜，也不得安息，卻有患難來到。
verses.e: I am not at ease , neither am I quiet , neither do I have rest ; but trouble comes . "

verses.z: 願我生的那日和說懷了男胎的那夜都滅沒。
verses.e: " Let the day perish in which I was born , the night which said , ' There is a boy conceived . '

verses.z: 願那日變為黑暗；願上帝不從上面尋找它；願亮光不照於其上。
verses.e: Let that day be darkness . Don't let God from above seek for it , neither let the light shine on it .

verses.z: 願黑暗和死蔭索取那日；願密雲停在其上；願日蝕恐嚇它。
verses.e: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own . Let a cloud dwell on it . Let all that makes the day black terrify it .

verses.z: 願那夜被幽暗奪取，不在年中的日子同樂，也不入月中的數目。
verses.e: As for that night , let thick darkness seize on it . Let it not rejoice among the days of the year . Let it not come into the number of the months .

verses.z: 願那夜沒有生育，其間也沒有歡樂的聲音。
verses.e: Behold , let that night be barren . Let no joyful voice come therein .

verses.z: 願那咒詛日子且能惹動鱷魚的咒詛那夜。
verses.e: Let them curse it who curse the day , who are ready to rouse up leviathan .

verses.z: 願那夜黎明的星宿變為黑暗，盼亮卻不亮，也不見早晨的光線；
verses.e: Let the stars of its twilight be dark . Let it look for light , but have none , neither let it see the eyelids of the morning ,

verses.z: 但如今，比我年少的人戲笑我；其人之父我曾藐視，不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。
verses.e: " But now those who are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs .

verses.z: 他們厭惡我，躲在旁邊站着，不住地吐唾沫在我臉上。
verses.e: They abhor me , they stand aloof from me , and don't hesitate to spit in my face .

verses.z: 鬆開他們的繩索苦待我，在我面前脫去轡頭。
verses.e: For he has untied his cord , and afflicted me ; and they have thrown off restraint before me .

verses.z: 這等下流人在我右邊起來，推開我的腳，築成戰路來攻擊我。
verses.e: On my right hand rise the rabble . They thrust aside my feet . They cast their ways of destruction up against me .

verses.z: 這些無人幫助的，毀壞我的道，加增我的災。
verses.e: They mar my path . They promote my destruction without anyone's help .

verses.z: 他們來如同闖進大破口，在毀壞之間滾[在我身上]。
verses.e: As through a wide breach they come . They roll themselves in amid the ruin .

verses.z: 驚恐臨到我，驅逐我的尊榮如風；我的福祿如雲過去。
verses.e: Terrors have turned on me . They chase my honor as the wind . My welfare has passed away as a cloud .

verses.z: 現在我心極其悲傷；困苦的日子將我抓住。
verses.e: " Now my soul is poured out within me . Days of affliction have taken hold of me .

verses.z: 夜間，我裏面的骨頭刺我，[疼痛]不止，好像齦我。
verses.e: In the night season my bones are pierced in me , and the pains that gnaw me take no rest .

verses.z: 因[上帝]的大力，我的外衣污穢不堪，又如裏衣的領子將我纏住。
verses.e: My garment is disfigured by great force . It binds me about as the collar of my tunic .

verses.z: 上帝把我扔在淤泥中，我就像塵土和爐灰一般。
verses.e: He has cast me into the mire . I have become like dust and ashes .

verses.z: 他們壯年的氣力既已衰敗，其手之力與我何益呢？
verses.e: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me , men in whom ripe age has perished ?

verses.z: [主啊]，我呼求你，你不應允我；我站起來，你就定睛看我。
verses.e: I cry to you , and you do not answer me . I stand up , and you gaze at me .

verses.z: 你向我變心，待我殘忍，又用大能追逼我，
verses.e: You have turned to be cruel to me . With the might of your hand you persecute me .

verses.z: 把我提在風中，使我駕風而行，又使我消滅在烈風中。
verses.e: You lift me up to the wind , and drive me with it . You dissolve me in the storm .

verses.z: 我知道要使我臨到死地，到那為眾生所定的陰宅。
verses.e: For I know that you will bring me to death , to the house appointed for all living .

verses.z: 然而，人仆倒豈不伸手？遇災難豈不求救呢？
verses.e: " However doesn't one stretch out a hand in his fall ? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help ?

verses.z: 人遭難，我豈不為他哭泣呢？人窮乏，我豈不為他憂愁呢？
verses.e: Didn't I weep for him who was in trouble ? Wasn't my soul grieved for the needy ?

verses.z: 我仰望得好處，災禍就到了；我等待光明，黑暗便來了。
verses.e: When I looked for good , then evil came . When I waited for light , darkness came .

verses.z: 我心裏煩擾不安，困苦的日子臨到我身。
verses.e: My heart is troubled , and doesn't rest . Days of affliction have come on me .

verses.z: 我沒有日光就哀哭行去；我在會中站着求救。
verses.e: I go mourning without the sun . I stand up in the assembly , and cry for help .

verses.z: 我與野狗為弟兄，與鴕鳥為同伴。
verses.e: I am a brother to jackals , and a companion to ostriches .

verses.z: 他們因窮乏飢餓，身體枯瘦，在荒廢淒涼的幽暗中齦乾燥之地，
verses.e: They are gaunt from lack and famine . They gnaw the dry ground , in the gloom of waste and desolation .

verses.z: 我的皮膚黑[而脫落]；我的骨頭因熱燒焦。
verses.e: My skin grows black and peels from me . My bones are burned with heat .

verses.z: 所以，我的琴音[變]為悲音；我的簫聲[變]為哭聲。
verses.e: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning , and my pipe into the voice of those who weep .

verses.z: 在草叢之中採鹹草，羅騰的根為他們的食物。
verses.e: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes . The roots of the broom tree are their food .

verses.z: 他們從人中被趕出；人追喊他們如賊一般，
verses.e: They are driven out from among men . They cry after them as after a thief ,

verses.z: 以致他們住在荒谷之間，在地洞和巖穴中；
verses.e: so that they live in frightful valleys , and in holes of the earth and of the rocks .

verses.z: 在草叢中叫喚，在荊棘下聚集。
verses.e: They bray among the bushes . They are gathered together under the nettles .

verses.z: 這都是愚頑下賤人的兒女；他們被鞭打，趕出境外。
verses.e: They are children of fools , yes , children of wicked men . They were flogged out of the land .

verses.z: 現在這些人以我為歌曲，以我為笑談。
verses.e: " Now I have become their song . Yes , I am a byword to them .

verses.z: 我與眼睛立約，怎能戀戀瞻望處女呢？
verses.e: " I made a covenant with my eyes ; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman ?

verses.z: 就願我的妻子給別人推磨，別人也與她同室。
verses.e: then let my wife grind for another , and let others sleep with her .

verses.z: 因為這是大罪，是審判官[當罰的]罪孽。
verses.e: For that would be a heinous crime . Yes , it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges ,

verses.z: 這本是火焚燒，直到毀滅，必拔除我所有的家產。
verses.e: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction , and would root out all my increase .

verses.z: 我的僕婢與我爭辯的時候，我若藐視不聽他們的情節；
verses.e: " If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant , when they contended with me ,

verses.z: 上帝興起，我怎樣行呢？他察問，我怎樣回答呢？
verses.e: what then will I do when God rises up ? When he visits , what will I answer him ?

verses.z: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他嗎？將他與我摶在腹中的豈不是一位嗎？
verses.e: Didn't he who made me in the womb make him ? Didn't one fashion us in the womb ?

verses.z: 我若不容貧寒人得其所願，或叫寡婦眼中失望，
verses.e: " If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail ,

verses.z: 或獨自吃我一點食物，孤兒沒有與我同吃；（
verses.e: or have eaten my morsel alone , and the fatherless has not eaten of it

verses.z: 從幼年時孤兒與我同長，好像父子一樣；我從出母腹就扶助寡婦。）
verses.e: ( no , from my youth he grew up with me as with a father , I have guided her from my mother's womb ) ;

verses.z: 我若見人因無衣死亡，或見窮乏人身無遮蓋；
verses.e: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or that the needy had no covering ;

verses.z: 從至上的上帝所得之分，從至高全能者所得之業是甚麼呢？
verses.e: For what is the portion from God above , and the heritage from the Almighty on high ?

verses.z: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖，為我祝福；
verses.e: if his heart hasn't blessed me , if he hasn't been warmed with my sheep's fleece ;

verses.z: 我若在城門口見有幫助我的，舉手攻擊孤兒；
verses.e: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless , because I saw my help in the gate ;

verses.z: 情願我的肩頭從缺盆骨脫落，我的膀臂從羊矢骨折斷。
verses.e: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade , and my arm be broken from the bone .

verses.z: 因上帝降的災禍使我恐懼；因他的威嚴，我不能妄為。
verses.e: For calamity from God is a terror to me . Because of his majesty , I can do nothing .

verses.z: 我若以黃金為指望，對精金說：[你是]我的倚靠；
verses.e: " If I have made gold my hope , and have said to the fine gold , ' You are my confidence ; '

verses.z: 我若因財物豐裕，因我手多得資財而歡喜；
verses.e: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because my hand had gotten much ;

verses.z: 我若見太陽發光，明月行在空中，
verses.e: if I have seen the sun when it shined , or the moon moving in splendor ,

verses.z: 心就暗暗被引誘，口便親手；
verses.e: and my heart has been secretly enticed , and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth ;

verses.z: 這也是審判官[當罰的]罪孽，又是我背棄在上的上帝。
verses.e: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges , for I would have denied the God who is above .

verses.z: 我若見恨我的遭報就歡喜，見他遭災便高興；（
verses.e: " If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me , or lifted up myself when evil found him

verses.z: 豈不是禍患臨到不義的，災害臨到作孽的呢？
verses.e: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous , and disaster to the workers of iniquity ?

verses.z: 我沒有容口犯罪，咒詛他的生命；）
verses.e: ( I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse ) ;

verses.z: 若我帳棚的人未嘗說，誰不以主人的食物吃飽呢？（
verses.e: if the men of my tent have not said , ' Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat ? '

verses.z: 從來我沒有容客旅在街上住宿，卻開門迎接行路的人；）
verses.e: ( the foreigner has not camped in the street , but I have opened my doors to the traveler ) ;

verses.z: 我若像亞當遮掩我的過犯，將罪孽藏在懷中；
verses.e: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions , by hiding my iniquity in my heart ,

verses.z: 因懼怕大眾，又因宗族藐視我使我驚恐，以致閉口無言，杜門不出；
verses.e: because I feared the great multitude , and the contempt of families terrified me , so that I kept silence , and didn't go out of the door —

verses.z: 惟願有一位肯聽我！（看哪，在這裏有我所劃的押，願全能者回答我！）
verses.e: oh that I had one to hear me ! Behold , here is my signature ! Let the Almighty answer me ! Let the accuser write my indictment !

verses.z: 願那敵我者所寫的狀詞[在我這裏]！我必帶在肩上，又綁在頭上為冠冕。
verses.e: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder , and I would bind it to me as a crown .

verses.z: 我必向他述說我腳步的數目，必如君王進到他面前。
verses.e: I would declare to him the number of my steps . I would go near to him like a prince .

verses.z: 我若[奪取]田地，這地向我喊冤，犂溝一同哭泣；
verses.e: If my land cries out against me , and its furrows weep together ;

verses.z: 我若吃地的出產不給價值，或叫原主喪命；
verses.e: if I have eaten its fruits without money , or have caused its owners to lose their life ,

verses.z: 上帝豈不是察看我的道路，數點我的腳步呢？
verses.e: Doesn't he see my ways , and count all my steps ?

verses.z: 願這地長蒺藜代替麥子，長惡草代替大麥。約伯的話說完了。
verses.e: let briers grow instead of wheat , and stinkweed instead of barley . " The words of Job are ended .

verses.z: 我若與虛謊同行，腳若追隨詭詐；（
verses.e: " If I have walked with falsehood , and my foot has hurried to deceit

verses.z: 我若被公道的天平稱度，使上帝可以知道我的純正；）
verses.e: ( let me be weighed in an even balance , that God may know my integrity ) ;

verses.z: 我的腳步若偏離正路，我的心若隨着我的眼目，若有玷污粘在我手上；
verses.e: if my step has turned out of the way , if my heart walked after my eyes , if any defilement has stuck to my hands ,

verses.z: 就願我所種的有別人吃，我田所產的被拔出來。
verses.e: then let me sow , and let another eat . Yes , let the produce of my field be rooted out .

verses.z: 我若受迷惑，向婦人[起淫念]，在鄰舍的門外蹲伏，
verses.e: " If my heart has been enticed to a woman , and I have laid wait at my neighbor's door ,

verses.z: 於是這三個人，因約伯自以為義就不再回答他。
verses.e: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .

verses.z: 因此我說：你們要聽我言；我也要陳說我的意見。
verses.e: Therefore I said , ' Listen to me ; I also will show my opinion . '

verses.z: 你們查究所要說的話；那時我等候你們的話，側耳聽你們的辯論，
verses.e: " Behold , I waited for your words , and I listened for your reasoning , while you searched out what to say .

verses.z: 留心聽你們；誰知你們中間無一人折服約伯，駁倒他的話。
verses.e: Yes , I gave you my full attention , but there was no one who convinced Job , or who answered his words , among you .

verses.z: 你們切不可說：我們尋得智慧；上帝能勝他，人卻不能。
verses.e: Beware lest you say , ' We have found wisdom . God may refute him , not man ; '

verses.z: 約伯沒有向我爭辯；我也不用你們的話回答他。
verses.e: for he has not directed his words against me ; neither will I answer him with your speeches .

verses.z: 他們驚奇不再回答，一言不發。
verses.e: " They are amazed . They answer no more . They don't have a word to say .

verses.z: 我豈因他們不說話，站住不再回答，仍舊等候呢？
verses.e: Shall I wait , because they don't speak , because they stand still , and answer no more ?

verses.z: 我也要回答我的一分話，陳說我的意見。
verses.e: I also will answer my part , and I also will show my opinion .

verses.z: 因為我的言語滿懷；我裏面的靈激動我。
verses.e: For I am full of words . The spirit within me constrains me .

verses.z: 我的胸懷如盛酒[之囊]沒有出氣之縫，又如新皮袋快要破裂。
verses.e: Behold , my breast is as wine which has no vent ; like new wineskins it is ready to burst .

verses.z: 那時有布西人蘭族巴拉迦的兒子以利戶向約伯發怒；因約伯自以為義，不以上帝為義。
verses.e: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel , the Buzite , of the family of Ram , was kindled against Job . His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God .

verses.z: 我要說話，使我舒暢；我要開口回答。
verses.e: I will speak , that I may be refreshed . I will open my lips and answer .

verses.z: 我必不看人的情面，也不奉承人。
verses.e: Please don't let me respect any man's person , neither will I give flattering titles to any man .

verses.z: 我不曉得奉承；[若奉承]，造我的主必快快除滅我。
verses.e: For I don't know how to give flattering titles , or else my Maker would soon take me away .

verses.z: 他又向約伯的三個朋友發怒；因為他們想不出回答的話來，仍以約伯為有罪。
verses.e: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .

verses.z: 以利戶要與約伯說話，就等候他們，因為他們比自己年老。
verses.e: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job , because they were older than he .

verses.z: 以利戶見這三個人口中無話回答，就怒氣發作。
verses.e: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men , his wrath was kindled .

verses.z: 布西人巴拉迦的兒子以利戶回答說：我年輕，你們老邁；因此我退讓，不敢向你們陳說我的意見。
verses.e: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered , " I am young , and you are very old . Therefore I held back , and didn't dare show you my opinion .

verses.z: 我說，年老的當先說話；壽高的當以智慧教訓人。
verses.e: I said , ' Days should speak , and multitude of years should teach wisdom . '

verses.z: 但在人裏面有靈；全能者的氣使人有聰明。
verses.e: But there is a spirit in man , and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding .

verses.z: 尊貴的不都有智慧；壽高的不都能明白公平。
verses.e: It is not the great who are wise , nor the aged who understand justice .

verses.z: 約伯啊，請聽我的話，留心聽我一切的言語。
verses.e: " However , Job , please hear my speech , and listen to all my words .

verses.z: 上帝找機會攻擊我，以我為仇敵，
verses.e: Behold , he finds occasions against me . He counts me for his enemy .

verses.z: 把我的腳上了木狗，窺察我一切的道路。
verses.e: He puts my feet in the stocks . He marks all my paths . '

verses.z: 我要回答你說：你這話無理，因上帝比世人更大。
verses.e: " Behold , I will answer you . In this you are not just , for God is greater than man .

verses.z: 你為何與他爭論呢？因他的事都不對人解說？
verses.e: Why do you strive against him , because he doesn't give account of any of his matters ?

verses.z: 上帝說一次、兩次，[世人]卻不理會。
verses.e: For God speaks once , yes twice , though man pays no attention .

verses.z: 人躺在床上沉睡的時候，上帝就用夢和夜間的異象，
verses.e: In a dream , in a vision of the night , when deep sleep falls on men , in slumbering on the bed ,

verses.z: 開通他們的耳朵，將當受的教訓印在他們心上，
verses.e: then he opens the ears of men , and seals their instruction ,

verses.z: 好叫人不從自己的謀算，不行驕傲的事，
verses.e: that he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .

verses.z: 攔阻人不陷於坑裏，不死在刀下。
verses.e: He keeps back his soul from the pit , and his life from perishing by the sword .

verses.z: 人在床上被懲治，骨頭中不住地疼痛，
verses.e: " He is chastened also with pain on his bed , with continual strife in his bones ,

verses.z: 我現在開口，用舌發言。
verses.e: See now , I have opened my mouth . My tongue has spoken in my mouth .

verses.z: 以致他的口厭棄食物，心厭惡美味。
verses.e: so that his life abhors bread , and his soul dainty food .

verses.z: 他的肉消瘦，不得再見；先前不見的骨頭都凸出來。
verses.e: His flesh is so consumed away that it can't be seen . His bones that were not seen stick out .

verses.z: 他的靈魂臨近深坑；他的生命近於滅命的。
verses.e: Yes , his soul draws near to the pit , and his life to the destroyers .

verses.z: 一千天使中，若有一個作傳話的與上帝同在，指示人所當行的事，
verses.e: " If there is beside him an angel , an interpreter , one among a thousand , to show to man what is right for him ,

verses.z: 上帝就給他開恩，說：救贖他免得下坑；我已經得了贖價。
verses.e: then God is gracious to him , and says , ' Deliver him from going down to the pit , I have found a ransom . '

verses.z: 他的肉要比孩童的肉更嫩；他就返老還童。
verses.e: His flesh will be fresher than a child's . He returns to the days of his youth .

verses.z: 他禱告上帝，上帝就喜悅他，使他歡呼朝見上帝的面；上帝又看他為義。
verses.e: He prays to God , and he is favorable to him , so that he sees his face with joy . He restores to man his righteousness .

verses.z: 他在人前歌唱說：我犯了罪，顛倒是非，這竟與我無益。
verses.e: He sings before men , and says , ' I have sinned , and perverted that which was right , and it didn't profit me .

verses.z: 上帝救贖我的靈魂免入深坑；我的生命也必見光。
verses.e: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit . My life will see the light . '

verses.z: 上帝兩次、三次向人行這一切的事，
verses.e: " Behold , God does all these things , twice , yes three times , with a man ,

verses.z: 我的言語[要發明]心中所存的正直；我所知道的，我嘴唇要誠實地說出。
verses.e: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart . That which my lips know they will speak sincerely .

verses.z: 為要從深坑救回人的靈魂，使他被光照耀，與活人一樣。
verses.e: to bring back his soul from the pit , that he may be enlightened with the light of the living .

verses.z: 約伯啊，你當側耳聽我的話，不要作聲，等我講說。
verses.e: Mark well , Job , and listen to me . Hold your peace , and I will speak .

verses.z: 你若有話說，就可以回答我；你只管說，因我願以你為是。
verses.e: If you have anything to say , answer me . Speak , for I desire to justify you .

verses.z: 若不然，你就聽我說；你不要作聲，我便將智慧教訓你。
verses.e: If not , listen to me . Hold your peace , and I will teach you wisdom . "

verses.z: 上帝的靈造我；全能者的氣使我得生。
verses.e: The Spirit of God has made me , and the breath of the Almighty gives me life .

verses.z: 你若回答我，就站起來，在我面前陳明。
verses.e: If you can , answer me . Set your words in order before me , and stand up .

verses.z: 我在上帝面前與你一樣，也是用土造成。
verses.e: Behold , I am toward God even as you are . I am also formed out of the clay .

verses.z: 我不用威嚴驚嚇你，也不用勢力重壓你。
verses.e: Behold , my terror will not make you afraid , neither will my pressure be heavy on you .

verses.z: 你所說的，我聽見了，也聽見你的言語，[說]：
verses.e: " Surely you have spoken in my hearing , I have heard the voice of your words , saying ,

verses.z: 我是清潔無過的，我是無辜的；在我裏面也沒有罪孽。
verses.e: ' I am clean , without disobedience . I am innocent , neither is there iniquity in me .

verses.z: 以利戶又說：
verses.e: Moreover Elihu answered ,

verses.z: 所以，你們明理的人要聽我的話。上帝斷不致行惡；全能者斷不致作孽。
verses.e: " Therefore listen to me , you men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness , from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .

verses.z: 他必按人所做的報應人，使各人照所行的得報。
verses.e: For the work of a man he will give to him , and cause every man to find according to his ways .

verses.z: 上帝必不作惡；全能者也不偏離公平。
verses.e: Yes surely , God will not do wickedly , neither will the Almighty pervert justice .

verses.z: 誰派他治理地，安定全世界呢？
verses.e: Who put him in charge of the earth ? Or who has appointed him over the whole world ?

verses.z: 他若專心為己，將靈和氣收歸自己，
verses.e: If he set his heart on himself , if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath ,

verses.z: 凡有血氣的就必一同死亡；世人必仍歸塵土。
verses.e: all flesh would perish together , and man would turn again to dust .

verses.z: 你若明理，就當聽我的話，留心聽我言語的聲音。
verses.e: " If now you have understanding , hear this . Listen to the voice of my words .

verses.z: 難道恨惡公平的可以掌權嗎？那有公義的、有大能的，豈可定他有罪嗎？
verses.e: Should even one who hates justice govern ? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty ,

verses.z: 他對君王說：[你是]鄙陋的；對貴臣說：[你是]邪惡的。
verses.e: who says to a king , ' Vile ! ' or to nobles , ' Wicked ! ' ?

verses.z: 他待王子不徇情面，也不看重富足的過於貧窮的，因為都是他手所造。
verses.e: He doesn't respect the persons of princes , nor respect the rich more than the poor , for they all are the work of his hands .

verses.z: 你們智慧人要聽我的話；有知識的人要留心聽我說。
verses.e: " Hear my words , you wise men . Give ear to me , you who have knowledge .

verses.z: 在轉眼之間，半夜之中，他們就死亡。百姓被震動而去世；有權力的被奪去非借人手。
verses.e: In a moment they die , even at midnight . The people are shaken and pass away . The mighty are taken away without a hand .

verses.z: 上帝注目觀看人的道路，看明人的腳步。
verses.e: " For his eyes are on the ways of a man . He sees all his goings .

verses.z: 沒有黑暗、陰翳能給作孽的藏身。
verses.e: There is no darkness , nor thick gloom , where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves .

verses.z: 上帝審判人，不必使人到他面前再三鑒察。
verses.e: For he doesn't need to consider a man further , that he should go before God in judgment .

verses.z: 他用難測之法打破有能力的人，設立別人代替他們。
verses.e: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out , and sets others in their place .

verses.z: 他原知道他們的行為，使他們在夜間傾倒滅亡。
verses.e: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works . He overturns them in the night , so that they are destroyed .

verses.z: 他在眾人眼前擊打他們，如同擊打惡人一樣。
verses.e: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others ;

verses.z: 因為他們偏行不跟從他，也不留心他的道，
verses.e: because they turned away from following him , and wouldn't pay attention to any of his ways ,

verses.z: 甚至使貧窮人的哀聲達到他那裏；他也聽了困苦人的哀聲。
verses.e: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him . He heard the cry of the afflicted .

verses.z: 他使人安靜，誰能擾亂呢？他掩面，誰能見他呢？無論待一國或一人都是如此－
verses.e: When he gives quietness , who then can condemn ? When he hides his face , who then can see him ? He is over a nation or a man alike ,

verses.z: 因為耳朵試驗話語，好像上膛嘗食物。
verses.e: For the ear tries words , as the palate tastes food .

verses.z: 使不虔敬的人不得作王，免得有人牢籠百姓。
verses.e: that the godless man may not reign , that there be no one to ensnare the people .

verses.z: 有誰對上帝說：我受了[責罰]，不再犯罪；
verses.e: " For has any said to God , ' I am guilty , but I will not offend any more .

verses.z: 我所看不明的，求你指教我；我若作了孽，必不再作？
verses.e: Teach me that which I don't see . If I have done iniquity , I will do it no more ' ?

verses.z: 他施行報應，豈要隨你的心願、叫你推辭不受嗎？選定的是你，不是我。你所知道的只管說吧！
verses.e: Shall his recompense be as you desire , that you refuse it ? For you must choose , and not I . Therefore speak what you know .

verses.z: 明理的人和聽我話的智慧人必對我說：
verses.e: Men of understanding will tell me , yes , every wise man who hears me :

verses.z: 約伯說話沒有知識，言語中毫無智慧。
verses.e: ' Job speaks without knowledge . His words are without wisdom . '

verses.z: 願約伯被試驗到底，因他回答像惡人一樣。
verses.e: I wish that Job were tried to the end , because of his answering like wicked men .

verses.z: 他在罪上又加悖逆；在我們中間拍手，用許多言語輕慢上帝。
verses.e: For he adds rebellion to his sin . He claps his hands among us , and multiplies his words against God . "

verses.z: 我們當選擇何為是，彼此知道何為善。
verses.e: Let us choose for us that which is right . Let us know among ourselves what is good .

verses.z: 約伯曾說：我是公義，上帝奪去我的理；
verses.e: For Job has said , ' I am righteous , God has taken away my right .

verses.z: 我雖有理，還[算為]說謊言的；我雖無過，受的傷還不能醫治。
verses.e: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar . My wound is incurable , though I am without disobedience . '

verses.z: 誰像約伯，喝譏誚如同喝水呢？
verses.e: What man is like Job , who drinks scorn like water ,

verses.z: 他與作孽的結伴，和惡人同行。
verses.e: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity , and walks with wicked men ?

verses.z: 他說：人以上帝為樂，總是無益。
verses.e: For he has said , ' It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God . '

verses.z: 以利戶又說：
verses.e: Moreover Elihu answered ,

verses.z: 卻無人說：造我的上帝在哪裏？他使人夜間歌唱，
verses.e: But no one says , ' Where is God my Maker , who gives songs in the night ,

verses.z: 教訓我們勝於地上的走獸，使我們有聰明勝於空中的飛鳥。
verses.e: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth , and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky ? '

verses.z: 他們在那裏，因惡人的驕傲呼求，卻無人答應。
verses.e: There they cry , but no one answers , because of the pride of evil men .

verses.z: 虛妄的[呼求]，上帝必不垂聽；全能者也必不眷顧。
verses.e: Surely God will not hear an empty cry , neither will the Almighty regard it .

verses.z: 何況你說，你不得見他；你的案件在他面前，你等候他吧。
verses.e: How much less when you say you don't see him . The cause is before him , and you wait for him !

verses.z: 但如今因他未曾發怒降罰，也不甚理會狂傲，
verses.e: But now , because he has not visited in his anger , neither does he greatly regard arrogance ,

verses.z: 所以約伯開口說虛妄的話，多發無知識的言語。
verses.e: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk , and he multiplies words without knowledge . "

verses.z: 你以為有理，或以為你的公義勝於上帝的公義，
verses.e: " Do you think this to be your right , or do you say , ' My righteousness is more than God's , '

verses.z: 才說這與我有甚麼益處？[我不犯罪]比犯罪有甚麼好處呢？
verses.e: that you ask , ' What advantage will it be to you ? What profit will I have , more than if I had sinned ? '

verses.z: 我要回答你和在你這裏的朋友。
verses.e: I will answer you , and your companions with you .

verses.z: 你要向天觀看，瞻望那高於你的穹蒼。
verses.e: Look to the skies , and see . See the skies , which are higher than you .

verses.z: 你若犯罪，能使上帝受何害呢？你的過犯加增，能使上帝受何損呢？
verses.e: If you have sinned , what effect do you have against him ? If your transgressions are multiplied , what do you do to him ?

verses.z: 你若是公義，還能加增他甚麼呢？他從你手裏還接受甚麼呢？
verses.e: If you are righteous , what do you give him ? Or what does he receive from your hand ?

verses.z: 你的過惡[或能害]你這類的人；你的公義[或能叫]世人[得益處]。
verses.e: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are , and your righteousness may profit a son of man .

verses.z: 人因多受欺壓就哀求，因受能者的轄制便求救，
verses.e: " By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out . They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty .

verses.z: 以利戶又接着說：
verses.e: Elihu also continued , and said ,

verses.z: 他也開通他們的耳朵得受教訓，吩咐他們離開罪孽轉回。
verses.e: He also opens their ears to instruction , and commands that they return from iniquity .

verses.z: 他們若聽從事奉他，就必度日亨通，歷年福樂；
verses.e: If they listen and serve him , they will spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .

verses.z: 若不聽從，就要被刀殺滅，無知無識而死。
verses.e: But if they don't listen , they will perish by the sword ; they will die without knowledge .

verses.z: 那心中不敬虔的人積蓄怒氣；上帝捆綁他們，他們竟不求救；
verses.e: " But those who are godless in heart lay up anger . They don't cry for help when he binds them .

verses.z: 必在青年時死亡，與污穢人一樣[喪命]。
verses.e: They die in youth . Their life perishes among the unclean .

verses.z: 上帝藉着困苦救拔困苦人，趁他們受欺壓開通他們的耳朵。
verses.e: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction , and opens their ear in oppression .

verses.z: 上帝也必引你出離患難，進入寬闊不狹窄之地；擺在你席上的必滿有肥甘。
verses.e: Yes , he would have allured you out of distress , into a wide place , where there is no restriction . That which is set on your table would be full of fatness .

verses.z: 但你滿口有惡人批評的言語；判斷和刑罰抓住你。
verses.e: " But you are full of the judgment of the wicked . Judgment and justice take hold of you .

verses.z: 不可容忿怒觸動你，使你不服責罰；也不可因贖價大就偏行。
verses.e: Don't let riches entice you to wrath , neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside .

verses.z: 你的呼求，或是你一切的勢力，果有靈驗，叫你不受患難嗎？
verses.e: Would your wealth sustain you in distress , or all the might of your strength ?

verses.z: 你再容我片時，我就指示你，因我還有話為上帝說。
verses.e: " Bear with me a little , and I will show you ; for I still have something to say on God's behalf .

verses.z: 不要切慕黑夜，就是眾民在本處被除滅的時候。
verses.e: Don't desire the night , when people are cut off in their place .

verses.z: 你要謹慎，不可重看罪孽，因你選擇罪孽過於選擇苦難。
verses.e: Take heed , don't regard iniquity ; for you have chosen this rather than affliction .

verses.z: 上帝行事有高大的能力；教訓人的有誰像他呢？
verses.e: Behold , God is exalted in his power . Who is a teacher like him ?

verses.z: 誰派定他的道路？誰能說：你所行的不義？
verses.e: Who has prescribed his way for him ? Or who can say , ' You have committed unrighteousness ' ?

verses.z: 你不可忘記稱讚他所行的為大，就是人所歌頌的。
verses.e: " Remember that you magnify his work , about which men have sung .

verses.z: 他所行的，萬人都看見；世人也從遠處觀看。
verses.e: All men have looked on it . Man sees it afar off .

verses.z: 上帝為大，我們不能全知；他的年數不能測度。
verses.e: Behold , God is great , and we don't know him . The number of his years is unsearchable .

verses.z: 他吸取水點，這水點從雲霧中就變成雨；
verses.e: For he draws up the drops of water , which distill in rain from his vapor ,

verses.z: 雲彩將雨落下，沛然降與世人。
verses.e: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly .

verses.z: 誰能明白雲彩如何鋪張，和上帝行宮的雷聲呢？
verses.e: Indeed , can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion ?

verses.z: 我要將所知道的從遠處引來，將公義歸給造我的主。
verses.e: I will get my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .

verses.z: 他將亮光普照在自己的四圍；他又遮覆海底。
verses.e: Behold , he spreads his light around him . He covers the bottom of the sea .

verses.z: 他用這些審判眾民，且賜豐富的糧食。
verses.e: For by these he judges the people . He gives food in abundance .

verses.z: 他以電光遮手，命閃電擊中敵人。
verses.e: He covers his hands with the lightning , and commands it to strike the mark .

verses.z: 所發的雷聲顯明他的[作為]，又向牲畜指明要起[暴風]。
verses.e: Its noise tells about him , and the livestock also , concerning the storm that comes up .

verses.z: 我的言語真不虛謊；有知識全備的與你同在。
verses.e: For truly my words are not false . One who is perfect in knowledge is with you .

verses.z: 上帝有大能，並不藐視人；他的智慧甚廣。
verses.e: " Behold , God is mighty , and doesn't despise anyone . He is mighty in strength of understanding .

verses.z: 他不保護惡人的性命，卻為困苦人伸冤。
verses.e: He doesn't preserve the life of the wicked , but gives justice to the afflicted .

verses.z: 他時常看顧義人，使他們和君王同坐寶座，永遠要被高舉。
verses.e: He doesn't withdraw his eyes from the righteous , but with kings on the throne , he sets them forever , and they are exalted .

verses.z: 他們若被鎖鍊捆住，被苦難的繩索纏住，
verses.e: If they are bound in fetters , and are taken in the cords of afflictions ,

verses.z: 他就把他們的作為和過犯指示他們，叫他們知道有驕傲的行動。
verses.e: then he shows them their work , and their transgressions , that they have behaved themselves proudly .

verses.z: 因此我心戰兢，從原處移動。
verses.e: " Yes , at this my heart trembles , and is moved out of its place .

verses.z: 上帝噓氣成冰；寬闊之水也都凝結。
verses.e: By the breath of God , ice is given , and the width of the waters is frozen .

verses.z: 他使密雲盛滿水氣，布散電光之雲；
verses.e: Yes , he loads the thick cloud with moisture . He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning .

verses.z: 這雲是藉他的指引游行旋轉，得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，
verses.e: It is turned around by his guidance , that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world ,

verses.z: 或為責罰，或為[潤]地，或為施行慈愛。
verses.e: whether it is for correction , or for his land , or for loving kindness , that he causes it to come .

verses.z: 約伯啊，你要留心聽，要站立思想上帝奇妙的作為。
verses.e: " Listen to this , Job . Stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .

verses.z: 上帝如何[吩咐]這些，如何使雲中的電光照耀，你知道嗎？
verses.e: Do you know how God controls them , and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine ?

verses.z: 雲彩如何浮於空中，那知識全備者奇妙的作為，你知道嗎？
verses.e: Do you know the workings of the clouds , the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge ?

verses.z: 南[風]使地寂靜，你的衣服就如火熱，你知道嗎？
verses.e: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind ?

verses.z: 你豈能與上帝同鋪穹蒼嗎？這穹蒼堅硬，如同鑄成的鏡子。
verses.e: Can you , with him , spread out the sky , which is strong as a cast metal mirror ?

verses.z: 我們愚昧不能陳說；請你指教我們該對他說甚麼話。
verses.e: Teach us what we will tell him , for we can't make our case by reason of darkness .

verses.z: 聽啊，上帝轟轟的聲音是他口中所發的響聲。
verses.e: Hear , oh , hear the noise of his voice , the sound that goes out of his mouth .

verses.z: 人豈可說：我願與他說話？豈有人自願滅亡嗎？
verses.e: Will it be told him that I would speak ? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up ?

verses.z: 現在[有雲遮蔽]，人不得見穹蒼的光亮；但風吹過，天又發晴。
verses.e: Now men don't see the light which is bright in the skies , but the wind passes , and clears them .

verses.z: 金光出於北方，在上帝那裏有可怕的威嚴。
verses.e: Out of the north comes golden splendor . With God is awesome majesty .

verses.z: 論到全能者，我們不能測度；他大有能力，有公平和大義，必不苦待人。
verses.e: We can't reach the Almighty . He is exalted in power . In justice and great righteousness , he will not oppress .

verses.z: 所以，人敬畏他；凡自[以為]心中有智慧的人，他都不顧念。
verses.e: Therefore men revere him . He doesn't regard any who are wise of heart . "

verses.z: 他發響聲震遍天下，發電光閃到地極。
verses.e: He sends it out under the whole sky , and his lightning to the ends of the earth .

verses.z: 隨後人聽見有雷聲轟轟，大發威嚴，雷電接連不斷。
verses.e: After it a voice roars . He thunders with the voice of his majesty . He doesn't hold back anything when his voice is heard .

verses.z: 上帝發出奇妙的雷聲；他行大事，我們不能測透。
verses.e: God thunders marvelously with his voice . He does great things , which we can't comprehend .

verses.z: 他對雪說：要降在地上；對大雨和暴雨也是這樣說。
verses.e: For he says to the snow , ' Fall on the earth , ' likewise to the shower of rain , and to the showers of his mighty rain .

verses.z: 他封住各人的手，叫所造的萬人都曉得他的作為。
verses.e: He seals up the hand of every man , that all men whom he has made may know it .

verses.z: 百獸進入穴中，臥在洞內。
verses.e: Then the animals take cover , and remain in their dens .

verses.z: 暴風出於[南]宮；寒冷出於北方。
verses.e: Out of its room comes the storm , and cold out of the north .

verses.z: 那時，耶和華從旋風中回答約伯說：
verses.e: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind ,

verses.z: 為它定界限，又安門和閂，
verses.e: marked out for it my bound , set bars and doors ,

verses.z: 說：你只可到這裏，不可越過；你狂傲的浪要到此止住。
verses.e: and said , ' You may come here , but no further . Your proud waves shall be stopped here ' ?

verses.z: 你自生以來，曾命定晨光，使清晨的日光知道本位，
verses.e: " Have you commanded the morning in your days , and caused the dawn to know its place ,

verses.z: 叫這光普照地的四極，將惡人從其中驅逐出來嗎？
verses.e: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth , and shake the wicked out of it ?

verses.z: 因[這光]，地面改變如泥上印印，[萬物]出現如衣服一樣。
verses.e: It is changed as clay under the seal , and presented as a garment .

verses.z: 亮光不照惡人；強橫的膀臂也必折斷。
verses.e: From the wicked , their light is withheld . The high arm is broken .

verses.z: 你曾進到海源，或在深淵的隱密處行走嗎？
verses.e: " Have you entered into the springs of the sea ? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep ?

verses.z: 死亡的門曾向你顯露嗎？死蔭的門你曾見過嗎？
verses.e: Have the gates of death been revealed to you ? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death ?

verses.z: 地的廣大你能明透嗎？你若全知道，只管說吧！
verses.e: Have you comprehended the earth in its width ? Declare , if you know it all .

verses.z: 光明的居所從何而至？黑暗的本位在於何處？
verses.e: " What is the way to the dwelling of light ? As for darkness , where is its place ,

verses.z: 誰用無知的言語使[我的]旨意暗昧不明？
verses.e: " Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge ?

verses.z: 你能帶到本境，能看明其室之路嗎？
verses.e: that you should take it to its bound , that you should discern the paths to its house ?

verses.z: 你總知道，因為你早已生在世上，你日子的數目也多。
verses.e: Surely you know , for you were born then , and the number of your days is great !

verses.z: 你曾進入雪庫，或見過雹倉嗎？
verses.e: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow , or have you seen the storehouses of the hail ,

verses.z: 這雪雹乃是我為降災，並打仗和爭戰的日子所預備的。
verses.e: which I have reserved against the time of trouble , against the day of battle and war ?

verses.z: 光亮從何路分開？東風從何路分散遍地？
verses.e: By what way is the lightning distributed , or the east wind scattered on the earth ?

verses.z: 誰為雨水分道？誰為雷電開路？
verses.e: Who has cut a channel for the flood water , or the path for the thunderstorm ,

verses.z: 使雨降在無人之地、無人居住的曠野？
verses.e: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man , on the wilderness , in which there is no man ,

verses.z: 使荒廢淒涼[之地]得以豐足，青草得以發生？
verses.e: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground , to cause the tender grass to grow ?

verses.z: 雨有父嗎？露水珠是誰生的呢？
verses.e: Does the rain have a father ? Or who fathers the drops of dew ?

verses.z: 冰出於誰的胎？天上的霜是誰生的呢？
verses.e: Whose womb did the ice come out of ? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky ?

verses.z: 你要如勇士束腰；我問你，你可以指示我。
verses.e: Brace yourself like a man , for I will question you , then you answer me !

verses.z: 諸水堅硬如石頭；深淵之面凝結成冰。
verses.e: The waters become hard like stone , when the surface of the deep is frozen .

verses.z: 你能繫住昴星的結嗎？能解開參星的帶嗎？
verses.e: " Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades , or loosen the cords of Orion ?

verses.z: 你能按時領出十二宮嗎？能引導北斗和隨它的眾星嗎？
verses.e: Can you lead the constellations out in their season ? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs ?

verses.z: 你知道天的定例嗎？能使地歸在天的權下嗎？
verses.e: Do you know the laws of the heavens ? Can you establish its dominion over the earth ?

verses.z: 你能向雲彩揚起聲來，使傾盆的雨遮蓋你嗎？
verses.e: " Can you lift up your voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover you ?

verses.z: 你能發出閃電，叫它行去，使它對你說：我們在這裏？
verses.e: Can you send out lightnings , that they may go ? Do they report to you , ' Here we are ' ?

verses.z: 誰將智慧放在懷中？誰將聰明賜於心內？
verses.e: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts ? Or who has given understanding to the mind ?

verses.z: 誰能用智慧數算雲彩呢？塵土聚集成團，土塊緊緊結連；那時，誰能傾倒天上的瓶呢？
verses.e: Who can count the clouds by wisdom ? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky ,
when the dust runs into a mass , and the clods of earth stick together ?

verses.z: 母獅子在洞中蹲伏，少壯獅子在隱密處埋伏；你能為牠們抓取食物，使牠們飽足嗎？
verses.e: " Can you hunt the prey for the lioness , or satisfy the appetite of the young lions ,

verses.z: 我立大地根基的時候，你在哪裏呢？你若有聰明，只管說吧！
verses.e: " Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth ? Declare , if you have understanding .
when they crouch in their dens , and lie in wait in the thicket ?

verses.z: 烏鴉之雛因無食物飛來飛去，哀告上帝；那時，誰為牠預備食物呢？
verses.e: Who provides for the raven his prey , when his young ones cry to God , and wander for lack of food ?

verses.z: 你若曉得[就說]，是誰定地的尺度？是誰把準繩拉在其上？
verses.e: Who determined its measures , if you know ? Or who stretched the line on it ?

verses.z: 地的根基安置在何處？地的角石是誰安放的？
verses.e: What were its foundations fastened on ? Or who laid its cornerstone ,

verses.z: 那時，晨星一同歌唱；上帝的眾子也都歡呼。
verses.e: when the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?

verses.z: 海水衝出，如出胎胞，那時誰將它關閉呢？
verses.e: " Or who shut up the sea with doors , when it broke out of the womb ,

verses.z: 是我用雲彩當海的衣服，用幽暗當包裹它的布，
verses.e: when I made clouds its garment , and wrapped it in thick darkness ,

verses.z: 山巖間的野山羊幾時生產，你知道嗎？母鹿下犢之期，你能察定嗎？
verses.e: " Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth ? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns ?

verses.z: 你豈能用套繩將野牛籠在犂溝之間？牠豈肯隨你耙山谷之地？
verses.e: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness ? Or will he till the valleys after you ?

verses.z: 豈可因牠的力大就倚靠牠？豈可把你的工交給牠做嗎？
verses.e: Will you trust him , because his strength is great ? Or will you leave to him your labor ?

verses.z: 豈可信靠牠把你的糧食運到家，又收聚你禾場上的穀嗎？
verses.e: Will you confide in him , that he will bring home your seed , and gather the grain of your threshing floor ?

verses.z: 鴕鳥的翅膀歡然搧展，豈是顯慈愛的翎毛和羽毛嗎？
verses.e: " The wings of the ostrich wave proudly , but are they the feathers and plumage of love ?

verses.z: 因牠把蛋留在地上，在塵土中使得溫暖；
verses.e: For she leaves her eggs on the earth , warms them in the dust ,

verses.z: 卻想不到被腳踹碎，或被野獸踐踏。
verses.e: and forgets that the foot may crush them , or that the wild animal may trample them .

verses.z: 牠忍心待雛，似乎不是自己的；雖然徒受勞苦，也不[為雛]懼怕；
verses.e: She deals harshly with her young ones , as if they were not hers . Though her labor is in vain , she is without fear ,

verses.z: 因為上帝使牠沒有智慧，也未將悟性賜給牠。
verses.e: because God has deprived her of wisdom , neither has he imparted to her understanding .

verses.z: 牠幾時挺身展開翅膀，就嗤笑馬和騎馬的人。
verses.e: When she lifts up herself on high , she scorns the horse and his rider .

verses.z: 馬的大力是你所賜的嗎？牠頸項上挓挲的誃是你給牠披上的嗎？
verses.e: " Have you given the horse might ? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane ?

verses.z: 牠們懷胎的月數，你能數算嗎？牠們幾時生產，你能曉得嗎？
verses.e: Can you count the months that they fulfill ? Or do you know the time when they give birth ?

verses.z: 是你叫牠跳躍像蝗蟲嗎？牠噴氣之威使人驚惶。
verses.e: Have you made him to leap as a locust ? The glory of his snorting is awesome .

verses.z: 牠在谷中刨地，自喜其力；牠出去迎接佩帶兵器的人。
verses.e: He paws in the valley , and rejoices in his strength . He goes out to meet the armed men .

verses.z: 牠嗤笑可怕的事並不驚惶，也不因刀劍退回。
verses.e: He mocks at fear , and is not dismayed , neither does he turn back from the sword .

verses.z: 箭袋和發亮的槍，並短槍在牠身上錚錚有聲。
verses.e: The quiver rattles against him , the flashing spear and the javelin .

verses.z: 牠發猛烈的怒氣將地吞下；一聽角聲就不耐站立。
verses.e: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage , neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet .

verses.z: 角每發聲，牠說呵哈；牠從遠處聞着戰氣，又聽見軍長大發雷聲和[兵丁]吶喊。
verses.e: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts , ' Aha ! ' He smells the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .

verses.z: 鷹雀飛翔，展開翅膀一直向南，豈是藉你的智慧嗎？
verses.e: " Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars , and stretches her wings toward the south ?

verses.z: 大鷹上騰在高處搭窩，豈是聽你的吩咐嗎？
verses.e: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up , and makes his nest on high ?

verses.z: 牠住在山巖，以山峰和堅固之所為家，
verses.e: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home , on the point of the cliff and the stronghold .

verses.z: 從那裏窺看食物，眼睛遠遠觀望。
verses.e: From there he spies out the prey . His eyes see it afar off .

verses.z: 牠們屈身，將子生下，就除掉疼痛。
verses.e: They bow themselves . They bear their young . They end their labor pains .

verses.z: 牠的雛也咂血；被殺的人在哪裏，牠也在那裏。
verses.e: His young ones also suck up blood . Where the slain are , there he is . "

verses.z: 這子漸漸肥壯，在荒野長大，去而不回。
verses.e: Their young ones become strong . They grow up in the open field . They go out , and don't return again .

verses.z: 誰放野驢出去自由？誰解開快驢的繩索？
verses.e: " Who has set the wild donkey free ? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey ,

verses.z: 我使曠野作牠的住處，使鹹地當牠的居所。
verses.e: whose home I have made the wilderness , and the salt land his dwelling place ?

verses.z: 牠嗤笑城內的喧嚷，不聽趕牲口的喝聲。
verses.e: He scorns the tumult of the city , neither does he hear the shouting of the driver .

verses.z: 遍山是牠的草場；牠尋找各樣青綠之物。
verses.e: The range of the mountains is his pasture . He searches after every green thing .

verses.z: 野牛豈肯服事你？豈肯住在你的槽旁？
verses.e: " Will the wild ox be content to serve you ? Or will he stay by your feeding trough ?

verses.z: 提幔人以利法回答說：
verses.e: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered ,

verses.z: 獅子的吼叫和猛獅的聲音[盡都止息]；少壯獅子的牙齒也都敲掉。
verses.e: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , the teeth of the young lions , are broken .

verses.z: 老獅子因絕食而死；母獅之子也都離散。
verses.e: The old lion perishes for lack of prey . The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad .

verses.z: 我暗暗地得了默示；我耳朵也聽其細微的聲音。
verses.e: " Now a thing was secretly brought to me . My ear received a whisper of it .

verses.z: 在思念夜中、異象之間，世人沉睡的時候，
verses.e: In thoughts from the visions of the night , when deep sleep falls on men ,

verses.z: 恐懼、戰兢臨到我身，使我百骨打戰。
verses.e: fear came on me , and trembling , which made all my bones shake .

verses.z: 有靈從我面前經過，我身上的毫毛直立。
verses.e: Then a spirit passed before my face . The hair of my flesh stood up .

verses.z: 那靈停住，我卻不能辨其形狀；有影像在我眼前。我在靜默中聽見有聲音[說]：
verses.e: It stood still , but I couldn't discern its appearance . A form was before my eyes . Silence , then I heard a voice , saying ,

verses.z: 必死的人豈能比上帝公義嗎？人豈能比造他的主潔淨嗎？
verses.e: ' Shall mortal man be more just than God ? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker ?

verses.z: 主不信靠他的臣僕，並且指他的使者為愚昧；
verses.e: Behold , he puts no trust in his servants . He charges his angels with error .

verses.z: 何況那住在土房、根基在塵土裏、被蠹蟲所毀壞的人呢？
verses.e: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay , whose foundation is in the dust , who are crushed before the moth !

verses.z: 人若想與你說話，你就厭煩嗎？但誰能忍住不說呢？
verses.e: " If someone ventures to talk with you , will you be grieved ? But who can withhold himself from speaking ?

verses.z: 早晚之間，就被毀滅，永歸無有，無人理會。
verses.e: Between morning and evening they are destroyed . They perish forever without any regarding it .

verses.z: 他帳棚的繩索豈不從中抽出來呢？他死，且是無智慧而死。
verses.e: Isn't their tent cord plucked up within them ? They die , and that without wisdom . '

verses.z: 你素來教導許多的人，又堅固軟弱的手。
verses.e: Behold , you have instructed many , you have strengthened the weak hands .

verses.z: 你的言語曾扶助那將要跌倒的人；你又使軟弱的膝穩固。
verses.e: Your words have supported him who was falling , you have made the feeble knees firm .

verses.z: 但現在禍患臨到你，你就昏迷，挨近你，你便驚惶。
verses.e: But now it has come to you , and you faint . It touches you , and you are troubled .

verses.z: 你的倚靠不是在你敬畏[上帝]嗎？你的盼望不是在你行事純正嗎？
verses.e: Isn't your piety your confidence ? Isn't the integrity of your ways your hope ?

verses.z: 請你追想：無辜的人有誰滅亡？正直的人在何處剪除？
verses.e: " Remember , now , who ever perished , being innocent ? Or where were the upright cut off ?

verses.z: 按我所見，耕罪孽、種毒害的人都照樣收割。
verses.e: According to what I have seen , those who plow iniquity and sow trouble , reap the same .

verses.z: 上帝一出氣，他們就滅亡；上帝一發怒，他們就消沒。
verses.e: By the breath of God they perish . By the blast of his anger are they consumed .

verses.z: 耶和華又對約伯說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD answered Job ,

verses.z: 你要以榮耀莊嚴為妝飾，以尊榮威嚴為衣服；
verses.e: " Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity . Array yourself with honor and majesty .

verses.z: 要發出你滿溢的怒氣，見一切驕傲的人，使他降卑；
verses.e: Pour out the fury of your anger . Look at everyone who is proud , and bring him low .

verses.z: 見一切驕傲的人，將他制伏，把惡人踐踏在本處；
verses.e: Look at everyone who is proud , and humble him . Crush the wicked in their place .

verses.z: 將他們一同隱藏在塵土中，把他們的臉蒙蔽在隱密處；
verses.e: Hide them in the dust together . Bind their faces in the hidden place .

verses.z: 我就認你右手能以救自己。
verses.e: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you .

verses.z: 你且觀看河馬；我造你也造牠。牠吃草與牛一樣；
verses.e: " See now behemoth , which I made as well as you . He eats grass as an ox .

verses.z: 牠的氣力在腰間，能力在肚腹的筋上。
verses.e: Look now , his strength is in his thighs . His force is in the muscles of his belly .

verses.z: 牠搖動尾巴如香柏樹；牠大腿的筋互相聯絡。
verses.e: He moves his tail like a cedar . The sinews of his thighs are knit together .

verses.z: 牠的骨頭[好像]銅管；牠的肢體彷彿鐵棍。
verses.e: His bones are like tubes of bronze . His limbs are like bars of iron .

verses.z: 牠在上帝所造的物中為首；創造牠的給牠刀劍。
verses.e: He is the chief of the ways of God . He who made him gives him his sword .

verses.z: 強辯的豈可與全能者爭論嗎？與上帝辯駁的可以回答這些吧！
verses.e: " Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty ? He who argues with God , let him answer it . "

verses.z: 諸山給牠出食物，也是百獸遊玩之處。
verses.e: Surely the mountains produce food for him , where all the animals of the field play .

verses.z: 牠伏在蓮葉之下，臥在蘆葦隱密處和水窪子裏。
verses.e: He lies under the lotus trees , in the covert of the reed , and the marsh .

verses.z: 蓮葉的陰涼遮蔽牠；溪旁的柳樹環繞牠。
verses.e: The lotuses cover him with their shade . The willows of the brook surround him .

verses.z: 河水泛濫，牠不發戰；就是約旦河的水漲到牠口邊，也是安然。
verses.e: Behold , if a river overflows , he doesn't tremble . He is confident , though the Jordan swells even to his mouth .

verses.z: 在牠防備的時候，誰能捉拿牠？誰能牢籠牠穿牠的鼻子呢？
verses.e: Shall any take him when he is on the watch , or pierce through his nose with a snare ?

verses.z: 於是，約伯回答耶和華說：
verses.e: Then Job answered the LORD ,

verses.z: 我是卑賤的！我用甚麼回答你呢？只好用手摀口。
verses.e: " Behold , I am of small account . What will I answer you ? I lay my hand on my mouth .

verses.z: 我說了一次，再不回答；說了兩次，就不再說。
verses.e: I have spoken once , and I will not answer ; Yes , twice , but I will proceed no further . "

verses.z: 於是，耶和華從旋風中回答約伯說：
verses.e: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind :

verses.z: 你要如勇士束腰；我問你，你可以指示我。
verses.e: " Now brace yourself like a man . I will question you , and you will answer me .

verses.z: 你豈可廢棄我所擬定的？豈可定我有罪，好顯自己為義嗎？
verses.e: Will you even annul my judgment ? Will you condemn me , that you may be justified ?

verses.z: 你有上帝那樣的膀臂嗎？你能像他發雷聲嗎？
verses.e: Or do you have an arm like God ? Can you thunder with a voice like him ?

verses.z: 你能用魚鉤釣上鱷魚嗎？能用繩子壓下牠的舌頭嗎？
verses.e: " Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook , or press down his tongue with a cord ?

verses.z: 沒有那麼兇猛的人敢惹牠。這樣，誰能在我面前站立得住呢？
verses.e: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up . Who then is he who can stand before me ?

verses.z: 誰先給我甚麼，使我償還呢？天下[萬物]都是我的。
verses.e: Who has first given to me , that I should repay him ? Everything under the heavens is mine .

verses.z: 論到鱷魚的肢體和其大力，並美好的骨骼，我不能緘默不言。
verses.e: " I will not keep silence concerning his limbs , nor his mighty strength , nor his goodly frame .

verses.z: 誰能剝牠的外衣？誰能進牠上下牙骨之間呢？
verses.e: Who can strip off his outer garment ? Who will come within his jaws ?

verses.z: 誰能開牠的腮頰？牠牙齒四圍是可畏的。
verses.e: Who can open the doors of his face ? Around his teeth is terror .

verses.z: 牠以堅固的鱗甲為可誇，緊緊合閉，封得嚴密。
