verses.e: Strong scales are his pride , shut up together with a close seal .

verses.z: 這鱗甲一一相連，甚至氣不得透入其間，
verses.e: One is so near to another , that no air can come between them .

verses.z: 都是互相聯絡、膠結，不能分離。
verses.e: They are joined to one another . They stick together , so that they can't be pulled apart .

verses.z: 牠打噴嚏就發出光來；牠眼睛好像早晨的光線。
verses.e: His sneezing flashes out light . His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning .

verses.z: 從牠口中發出燒着的火把，與飛迸的火星；
verses.e: Out of his mouth go burning torches . Sparks of fire leap out .

verses.z: 你能用繩索穿牠的鼻子嗎？能用鉤穿牠的腮骨嗎？
verses.e: Can you put a rope into his nose , or pierce his jaw through with a hook ?

verses.z: 從牠鼻孔冒出煙來，如燒開的鍋和[點着]的蘆葦。
verses.e: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes , as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds .

verses.z: 牠的氣點着煤炭，有火焰從牠口中發出。
verses.e: His breath kindles coals . A flame goes out of his mouth .

verses.z: 牠頸項中存着勁力；在牠面前的都恐嚇蹦跳。
verses.e: There is strength in his neck . Terror dances before him .

verses.z: 牠的肉塊互相聯絡，緊貼其身，不能搖動。
verses.e: The flakes of his flesh are joined together . They are firm on him . They can't be moved .

verses.z: 牠的心結實如石頭，如下磨石那樣結實。
verses.e: His heart is as firm as a stone , yes , firm as the lower millstone .

verses.z: 牠一起來，勇士都驚恐，心裏慌亂，便都昏迷。
verses.e: When he raises himself up , the mighty are afraid . They retreat before his thrashing .

verses.z: 人若用刀，用槍，用標槍，用尖槍扎牠，都是無用。
verses.e: If one attacks him with the sword , it can't prevail ; nor the spear , the dart , nor the pointed shaft .

verses.z: 牠以鐵為乾草，以銅為爛木。
verses.e: He counts iron as straw , and bronze as rotten wood .

verses.z: 箭不能[恐嚇牠]使牠逃避；彈石在牠看為碎稭。
verses.e: The arrow can't make him flee . Sling stones are like chaff to him .

verses.z: 棍棒算為禾稭；牠嗤笑短槍颼的響聲。
verses.e: Clubs are counted as stubble . He laughs at the rushing of the javelin .

verses.z: 牠豈向你連連懇求，說柔和的話嗎？
verses.e: Will he make many petitions to you , or will he speak soft words to you ?

verses.z: 牠肚腹下[如]尖瓦片；牠如釘耙經過淤泥。
verses.e: His undersides are like sharp potsherds , leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge .

verses.z: 牠使深淵開滾如鍋，使洋海如鍋中的膏油。
verses.e: He makes the deep to boil like a pot . He makes the sea like a pot of ointment .

verses.z: 牠行的路隨後發光，令人想深淵如同白髮。
verses.e: He makes a path shine after him . One would think the deep had white hair .

verses.z: 在地上沒有像牠造的那樣，無所懼怕。
verses.e: On earth there is not his equal , that is made without fear .

verses.z: 凡高大的，牠無不藐視；牠在驕傲的水族上作王。
verses.e: He sees everything that is high . He is king over all the sons of pride . "

verses.z: 豈肯與你立約，使你拿牠永遠作奴僕嗎？
verses.e: Will he make a covenant with you , that you should take him for a servant forever ?

verses.z: 你豈可拿牠當雀鳥玩耍嗎？豈可為你的幼女將牠拴住嗎？
verses.e: Will you play with him as with a bird ? Or will you bind him for your girls ?

verses.z: 搭夥的[漁夫]豈可拿牠當貨物嗎？能把牠分給商人嗎？
verses.e: Will traders barter for him ? Will they part him among the merchants ?

verses.z: 你能用倒鉤槍扎滿牠的皮，能用魚叉叉滿牠的頭嗎？
verses.e: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons , or his head with fish spears ?

verses.z: 你按手在牠身上，想與牠爭戰，就不再這樣行吧！
verses.e: Lay your hand on him . Remember the battle , and do so no more .

verses.z: 人指望捉拿牠是徒然的；一見牠，豈不喪膽嗎？
verses.e: Behold , the hope of him is in vain . Won't one be cast down even at the sight of him ?

verses.z: 約伯回答耶和華說：
verses.e: Then Job answered the LORD :

verses.z: 約伯為他的朋友祈禱。耶和華就使約伯從苦境轉回，並且耶和華賜給他的比他從前所有的加倍。
verses.e: The LORD restored Job's prosperity when he prayed for his friends . The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before .

verses.z: 約伯的弟兄、姊妹，和以先所認識的人都來見他，在他家裏一同吃飯；又論到耶和華所降與他的一切災禍，都為他悲傷安慰他。每人也送他一塊[銀子]和一個金環。
verses.e: Then all his brothers , all his sisters , and all those who had been of his acquaintance before , came to him and ate bread with him in his house . They comforted him , and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him . Everyone also gave him a piece of money , and everyone a ring of gold .

verses.z: 這樣，耶和華後來賜福給約伯比先前更多。他有一萬四千羊，六千駱駝，一千對牛，一千母驢。
verses.e: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning . He had fourteen thousand sheep , six thousand camels , one thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand female donkeys .

verses.z: 他也有七個兒子，三個女兒。
verses.e: He had also seven sons and three daughters .

verses.z: 他給長女起名叫耶米瑪，次女叫基洗亞，三女叫基連‧哈樸。
verses.e: He called the name of the first , Jemimah ; and the name of the second , Keziah ; and the name of the third , Keren Happuch .

verses.z: 在那全地的婦女中找不着像約伯的女兒那樣美貌。她們的父親使她們在弟兄中得產業。
verses.e: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job . Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers .

verses.z: 此後，約伯又活了一百四十年，得見他的兒孫，直到四代。
verses.e: After this Job lived one hundred forty years , and saw his sons , and his sons ' sons , to four generations .

verses.z: 這樣，約伯年紀老邁，日子滿足而死。
verses.e: So Job died , being old and full of days .

verses.z: 我知道，你萬事都能做；你的旨意不能攔阻。
verses.e: " I know that you can do all things , and that no purpose of yours can be restrained .

verses.z: 誰用無知的言語使[你的]旨意隱藏呢？我所說的是我不明白的；這些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。
verses.e: You asked , ' Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge ? ' therefore I have uttered that which I didn't understand , things too wonderful for me , which I didn't know .

verses.z: 求你聽我，我要說話；我問你，求你指示我。
verses.e: You said , ' Listen , now , and I will speak ; I will question you , and you will answer me . '

verses.z: 我從前風聞有你，現在親眼看見你。
verses.e: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear , but now my eye sees you .

verses.z: 因此我厭惡自己，在塵土和爐灰中懊悔。
verses.e: Therefore I abhor myself , and repent in dust and ashes . "

verses.z: 耶和華對約伯說話以後，就對提幔人以利法說：「我的怒氣向你和你兩個朋友發作，因為你們議論我不如我的僕人約伯說的是。
verses.e: It was so , that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job , the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite , " My wrath is kindled against you , and against your two friends ; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job has .

verses.z: 現在你們要取七隻公牛，七隻公羊，到我僕人約伯那裏去，為自己獻上燔祭，我的僕人約伯就為你們祈禱。我因悅納他，就不按你們的愚妄辦你們。你們議論我，不如我的僕人約伯說的是。」
verses.e: Now therefore , take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering ; and my servant Job shall pray for you , for I will accept him , that I not deal with you according to your folly . For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job has . "

verses.z: 於是提幔人以利法、書亞人比勒達、拿瑪人瑣法照着耶和華所吩咐的去行；耶和華就悅納約伯。
verses.e: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them , and the LORD accepted Job .

verses.z: 你且呼求，有誰答應你？諸聖者之中，你轉向哪一位呢？
verses.e: " Call now ; is there any who will answer you ? To which of the holy ones will you turn ?

verses.z: 降雨在地上，賜水於田裏；
verses.e: who gives rain on the earth , and sends waters on the fields ;

verses.z: 將卑微的安置在高處，將哀痛的舉到穩妥之地；
verses.e: so that he sets up on high those who are low , those who mourn are exalted to safety .

verses.z: 破壞狡猾人的計謀，使他們所謀的不得成就。
verses.e: He frustrates the plans of the crafty , so that their hands can't perform their enterprise .

verses.z: 他叫有智慧的中了自己的詭計，使狡詐人的計謀速速滅亡。
verses.e: He takes the wise in their own craftiness ; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong .

verses.z: 他們白晝遇見黑暗，午間摸索如在夜間。
verses.e: They meet with darkness in the day time , and grope at noonday as in the night .

verses.z: 上帝拯救窮乏人脫離他們口中的刀和強暴人的手。
verses.e: But he saves from the sword of their mouth , even the needy from the hand of the mighty .

verses.z: 這樣，貧寒的人有指望，罪孽之輩必塞口無言。
verses.e: So the poor has hope , and injustice shuts her mouth .

verses.z: 上帝所懲治的人是有福的！所以你不可輕看全能者的管教。
verses.e: " Behold , happy is the man whom God corrects . Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty .

verses.z: 因為他打破，又纏裹；他擊傷，用手醫治。
verses.e: For he wounds and binds up . He injures and his hands make whole .

verses.z: 你六次遭難，他必救你；就是七次，災禍也無法害你。
verses.e: He will deliver you in six troubles ; yes , in seven no evil will touch you .

verses.z: 忿怒害死愚妄人；嫉妒殺死癡迷人。
verses.e: For resentment kills the foolish man , and jealousy kills the simple .

verses.z: 在饑荒中，他必救你脫離死亡；在爭戰中，他必救你脫離刀劍的權力。
verses.e: In famine he will redeem you from death ; in war , from the power of the sword .

verses.z: 你必被隱藏，不受口舌之害；災殃臨到，你也不懼怕。
verses.e: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue , neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes .

verses.z: 你遇見災害饑饉，就必嬉笑；地上的野獸，你也不懼怕。
verses.e: You will laugh at destruction and famine , neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth .

verses.z: 因為你必與田間的石頭立約；田裏的野獸也必與你和好。
verses.e: For you will be allied with the stones of the field . The animals of the field will be at peace with you .

verses.z: 你必知道你帳棚平安，要查看你的羊圈，一無所失；
verses.e: You will know that your tent is in peace . You will visit your fold , and will miss nothing .

verses.z: 也必知道你的後裔將來發達，你的子孫像地上的青草。
verses.e: You will know also that your offspring will be great , your offspring as the grass of the earth .

verses.z: 你必壽高年邁才歸墳墓，好像禾捆到時收藏。
verses.e: You will come to your grave in a full age , like a shock of grain comes in its season .

verses.z: 這理，我們已經考察，本是如此。你須要聽，要知道是與自己有益。
verses.e: Behold , we have researched it . It is so . Hear it , and know it for your good . "

verses.z: 我曾見愚妄人扎下根，但我忽然咒詛他的住處。
verses.e: I have seen the foolish taking root , but suddenly I cursed his habitation .

verses.z: 他的兒女遠離穩妥的地步，在城門口被壓，並無人搭救。
verses.e: His children are far from safety . They are crushed in the gate . Neither is there any to deliver them ,

verses.z: 他的莊稼有飢餓的人吃盡了，就是在荊棘裏的也搶去了；他的財寶有網羅張口吞滅了。
verses.e: whose harvest the hungry eat up , and take it even out of the thorns . The snare gapes for their substance .

verses.z: 禍患原不是從土中出來；患難也不是從地裏發生。
verses.e: For affliction doesn't come out of the dust , neither does trouble spring out of the ground ;

verses.z: 人生在世必遇患難，如同火星飛騰。
verses.e: but man is born to trouble , as the sparks fly upward .

verses.z: 至於我，我必仰望上帝，把我的事情託付他。
verses.e: " But as for me , I would seek God . I would commit my cause to God ,

verses.z: 他行大事不可測度，行奇事不可勝數：
verses.e: who does great things that can't be fathomed , marvelous things without number ;

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 我因沒有違棄那聖者的言語，就仍以此為安慰，在不止息的痛苦中還可踴躍。
verses.e: Let it still be my consolation , yes , let me exult in pain that doesn't spare , that I have not denied the words of the Holy One .

verses.z: 我有甚麼氣力使我等候？我有甚麼結局使我忍耐？
verses.e: What is my strength , that I should wait ? What is my end , that I should be patient ?

verses.z: 我的氣力豈是石頭的氣力？我的肉身豈是銅的呢？
verses.e: Is my strength the strength of stones ? Or is my flesh of bronze ?

verses.z: 在我豈不是毫無幫助嗎？智慧豈不是從我心中趕出淨盡嗎？
verses.e: Isn't it that I have no help in me , that wisdom is driven away from me ?

verses.z: 那將要灰心、離棄全能者、不敬畏上帝的人，他的朋友當以慈愛待他。
verses.e: " To him who is ready to faint , kindness should be shown from his friend ; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty .

verses.z: 我的弟兄詭詐，好像溪水，又像溪水流乾的河道。
verses.e: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook , as the channel of brooks that pass away ;

verses.z: 這河因結冰發黑，有雪藏在其中；
verses.e: which are black by reason of the ice , in which the snow hides itself .

verses.z: 天氣漸暖就隨時消化，日頭炎熱便從原處乾涸。
verses.e: In the dry season , they vanish . When it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .

verses.z: 結伴的客旅[離棄大道]，順河偏行，到荒野之地死亡。
verses.e: The caravans that travel beside them turn away . They go up into the waste , and perish .

verses.z: 提瑪結伴的客旅瞻望；示巴同夥的人等候。
verses.e: The caravans of Tema looked . The companies of Sheba waited for them .

verses.z: 惟願我的煩惱稱一稱，我一切的災害放在天平裏；
verses.e: " Oh that my anguish were weighed , and all my calamity laid in the balances !

verses.z: 他們因失了盼望就抱愧，來到那裏便蒙羞。
verses.e: They were distressed because they were confident . They came there , and were confounded .

verses.z: 現在你們正是這樣，看見驚嚇的事便懼怕。
verses.e: For now you are nothing . You see a terror , and are afraid .

verses.z: 我豈說：請你們供給我，從你們的財物中送禮物給我？
verses.e: Did I ever say , ' Give to me ' ? or , ' Offer a present for me from your substance ' ?

verses.z: 豈說：拯救我脫離敵人的手嗎？救贖我脫離強暴人的手嗎？
verses.e: or , ' Deliver me from the adversary's hand ' ? or , ' Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors ' ?

verses.z: 請你們教導我，我便不作聲；使我明白在何事上有錯。
verses.e: " Teach me , and I will hold my peace . Cause me to understand my error .

verses.z: 正直的言語力量何其大！但你們責備是責備甚麼呢？
verses.e: How forcible are words of uprightness ! But your reproof , what does it reprove ?

verses.z: 絕望人的講論既然如風，你們還想要駁正言語嗎？
verses.e: Do you intend to reprove words , since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind ?

verses.z: 你們想為孤兒拈鬮，以朋友當貨物。
verses.e: Yes , you would even cast lots for the fatherless , and make merchandise of your friend .

verses.z: 現在請你們看看我，我決不當面說謊。
verses.e: Now therefore be pleased to look at me , for surely I will not lie to your face .

verses.z: 請你們轉意，不要不公；請再轉意，我的事有理。
verses.e: Please return . Let there be no injustice . Yes , return again . My cause is righteous .

verses.z: 現今都比海沙更重，所以我的言語急躁。
verses.e: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas , therefore my words have been rash .

verses.z: 我的舌上豈有不義嗎？我的口裏豈不辨奸惡嗎？
verses.e: Is there injustice on my tongue ? Can't my taste discern mischievous things ?

verses.z: 因全能者的箭射入我身；其毒，我的靈喝盡了；上帝的驚嚇擺陣攻擊我。
verses.e: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me . My spirit drinks up their poison . The terrors of God set themselves in array against me .

verses.z: 野驢有草豈能叫喚？牛有料豈能吼叫？
verses.e: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass ? Or does the ox low over his fodder ?

verses.z: 物淡而無鹽豈可吃嗎？蛋青有甚麼滋味呢？
verses.e: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt ? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg ?

verses.z: 看為可厭的食物，我心不肯挨近。
verses.e: My soul refuses to touch them . They are as loathsome food to me .

verses.z: 惟願我得着所求的，願上帝賜我所切望的；
verses.e: " Oh that I might have my request , that God would grant the thing that I long for ,

verses.z: 就是願上帝把我壓碎，伸手將我剪除。
verses.e: even that it would please God to crush me ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !

verses.z: 人在世上豈無爭戰嗎？他的日子不像雇工人的日子嗎？
verses.e: " Isn't a man forced to labor on earth ? Aren't his days like the days of a hired hand ?

verses.z: 他不再回自己的家；故土也不再認識他。
verses.e: He will return no more to his house , neither will his place know him any more .

verses.z: 我不禁止我口；我靈愁苦，要發出言語；我心苦惱，要吐露哀情。
verses.e: " Therefore I will not keep silent . I will speak in the anguish of my spirit . I will complain in the bitterness of my soul .

verses.z: 我[對上帝說]：我豈是洋海，豈是大魚，你竟防守我呢？
verses.e: Am I a sea , or a sea monster , that you put a guard over me ?

verses.z: 若說：我的床必安慰我，我的榻必解釋我的苦情，
verses.e: When I say , ' My bed will comfort me . My couch will ease my complaint , '

verses.z: 你就用夢驚駭我，用異象恐嚇我，
verses.e: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions ,

verses.z: 甚至我寧肯噎死，寧肯死亡，勝似留我[這一身的]骨頭。
verses.e: so that my soul chooses strangling , death rather than my bones .

verses.z: 我厭棄[性命]，不願永活。你任憑我吧，因我的日子都是虛空。
verses.e: I loathe my life . I don't want to live forever . Leave me alone , for my days are but a breath .

verses.z: 人算甚麼，你竟看他為大，將他放在心上？
verses.e: What is man , that you should magnify him , that you should set your mind on him ,

verses.z: 每早鑒察他，時刻試驗他？
verses.e: that you should visit him every morning , and test him every moment ?

verses.z: 你到何時才轉眼不看我，才任憑我咽下唾沫呢？
verses.e: How long will you not look away from me , nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle ?

verses.z: 像奴僕切慕黑影，像雇工人盼望工價；
verses.e: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow , as a hireling who looks for his wages ,

verses.z: 鑒察人的主啊，我若有罪，於你何妨？為何以我當你的箭靶子，使我厭棄自己的性命？
verses.e: If I have sinned , what do I do to you , you watcher of men ? Why have you set me as a mark for you , so that I am a burden to myself ?

verses.z: 為何不赦免我的過犯，除掉我的罪孽？我現今要躺臥在塵土中；你要殷勤地尋找我，我卻不在了。
verses.e: Why do you not pardon my disobedience , and take away my iniquity ? For now will I lie down in the dust . You will seek me diligently , but I will not be . "

verses.z: 我也照樣經過困苦的日月，夜間的疲乏為我而定。
verses.e: so I am made to possess months of misery , wearisome nights are appointed to me .

verses.z: 我躺臥的時候便說：我何時起來，黑夜就過去呢？我盡是反來覆去，直到天亮。
verses.e: When I lie down , I say , ' When will I arise , and the night be gone ? ' I toss and turn until the dawning of the day .

verses.z: 我的肉體以蟲子和塵土為衣；我的皮膚才收了口又重新破裂。
verses.e: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust . My skin closes up , and breaks out afresh .

verses.z: 我的日子比梭更快，都消耗在無指望之中。
verses.e: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle , and are spent without hope .

verses.z: 求你想念，我的生命不過是一口氣；我的眼睛必不再見福樂。
verses.e: Oh remember that my life is a breath . My eye will no more see good .

verses.z: 觀看我的人，他的眼必不再見我；你的眼目要看我，我卻不在了。
verses.e: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more . Your eyes will be on me , but I will not be .

verses.z: 雲彩消散而過；照樣，人下陰間也不再上來。
verses.e: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away , so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more .

verses.z: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
verses.e: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered ,

verses.z: 他們豈不指教你，告訴你，從心裏發出言語來呢？
verses.e: Shall they not teach you , tell you , and utter words out of their heart ?

verses.z: 蒲草沒有泥豈能發長？蘆荻沒有水豈能生發？
verses.e: " Can the papyrus grow up without mire ? Can the rushes grow without water ?

verses.z: 尚青的時候，還沒有割下，比百樣的草先枯槁。
verses.e: While it is yet in its greenness , not cut down , it withers before any other reed .

verses.z: 凡忘記上帝的人，景況也是這樣；不虔敬人的指望要滅沒。
verses.e: So are the paths of all who forget God . The hope of the godless man will perish ,

verses.z: 他所仰賴的必折斷；他所倚靠的是蜘蛛網。
verses.e: whose confidence will break apart , whose trust is a spider's web .

verses.z: 他要倚靠房屋，房屋卻站立不住；他要抓住房屋，房屋卻不能存留。
verses.e: He will lean on his house , but it will not stand . He will cling to it , but it will not endure .

verses.z: 他在日光之下發青，蔓子爬滿了園子；
verses.e: He is green before the sun . His shoots go out along his garden .

verses.z: 他的根盤繞[石]堆，扎入石地。
verses.e: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile . He sees the place of stones .

verses.z: 他若從本地被拔出，那地就不認識他，[說]：我沒有見過你。
verses.e: If he is destroyed from his place , then it will deny him , saying , ' I have not seen you . '

verses.z: 看哪，這就是他道中之樂；以後必另有人從地而生。
verses.e: Behold , this is the joy of his way . Out of the earth , others will spring .

verses.z: 這些話你要說到幾時？口中的言語[如]狂風[要到幾時呢]？
verses.e: " How long will you speak these things ? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind ?

verses.z: 上帝必不丟棄完全人，也不扶助邪惡人。
verses.e: " Behold , God will not cast away a blameless man , neither will he uphold the evildoers .

verses.z: 他還要以喜笑充滿你的口，以歡呼充滿你的嘴。
verses.e: He will still fill your mouth with laughter , your lips with shouting .

verses.z: 恨惡你的要披戴慚愧；惡人的帳棚必歸於無有。
verses.e: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame . The tent of the wicked will be no more . "

verses.z: 上帝豈能偏離公平？全能者豈能偏離公義？
verses.e: Does God pervert justice ? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness ?

verses.z: 或者你的兒女得罪了他；他使他們受報應。
verses.e: If your children have sinned against him , he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience .

verses.z: 你若殷勤地尋求上帝，向全能者懇求；
verses.e: If you want to seek God diligently , make your supplication to the Almighty .

verses.z: 你若清潔正直，他必定為你起來，使你公義的居所興旺。
verses.e: If you were pure and upright , surely now he would awaken for you , and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous .

verses.z: 你起初雖然微小，終久必甚發達。
verses.e: Though your beginning was small , yet your latter end would greatly increase .

verses.z: 請你考問前代，追念他們的列祖所查究的。
verses.e: " Please inquire of past generations . Find out about the learning of their fathers .

verses.z: 我們不過從昨日才有，一無所知；我們在世的日子好像影兒。
verses.e: ( For we are but of yesterday , and know nothing , because our days on earth are a shadow . )

verses.z: 約伯回答說：
verses.e: Then Job answered ,

verses.z: 他行大事，不可測度，行奇事，不可勝數。
verses.e: He does great things past finding out ; yes , marvelous things without number .

verses.z: 他從我旁邊經過，我卻不看見；他在我面前行走，我倒不知覺。
verses.e: Behold , he goes by me , and I don't see him . He passes on also , but I don't perceive him .

verses.z: 他奪取，誰能阻擋？誰敢問他：你做甚麼？
verses.e: Behold , he snatches away . Who can hinder him ? Who will ask him , ' What are you doing ? '

verses.z: 上帝必不收回他的怒氣；扶助拉哈伯的，屈身在他以下。
verses.e: " God will not withdraw his anger . The helpers of Rahab stoop under him .

verses.z: 既是這樣，我怎敢回答他，怎敢選擇言語與他[辯論呢]？
verses.e: How much less will I answer him , and choose my words to argue with him ?

verses.z: 我雖有義，也不回答他，只要向那審判我的懇求。
verses.e: Though I were righteous , yet I wouldn't answer him . I would make supplication to my judge .

verses.z: 我若呼籲，他應允我；我仍不信他真聽我的聲音。
verses.e: If I had called , and he had answered me , yet I wouldn't believe that he listened to my voice .

verses.z: 他用暴風折斷我，無故地加增我的損傷。
verses.e: For he breaks me with a storm , and multiplies my wounds without cause .

verses.z: 我就是喘一口氣，他都不容，倒使我滿心苦惱。
verses.e: He will not allow me to catch my breath , but fills me with bitterness .

verses.z: [若論]力量，[他真有]能力！若論審判，[他說]誰能將我傳來呢？
verses.e: If it is a matter of strength , behold , he is mighty ! If of justice , ' Who , ' says he , ' will summon me ? '

verses.z: 我真知道是這樣；但人在上帝面前怎能成為義呢？
verses.e: " Truly I know that it is so , but how can man be just with God ?

verses.z: 我雖有義，自己的口要定我為有罪；我雖完全，我口必顯我為彎曲。
verses.e: Though I am righteous , my own mouth will condemn me . Though I am blameless , it will prove me perverse .

verses.z: 我本完全，不顧自己；我厭惡我的性命。
verses.e: I am blameless . I don't respect myself . I despise my life .

verses.z: [善惡無分]，都是一樣；所以我說，完全人和惡人，他都滅絕。
verses.e: " It is all the same . Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked .

verses.z: 若忽然遭殺害之禍，他必戲笑無辜的人遇難。
verses.e: If the scourge kills suddenly , he will mock at the trial of the innocent .

verses.z: 世界交在惡人手中；蒙蔽世界審判官的臉，若不是他，是誰呢？
verses.e: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked . He covers the faces of its judges . If not he , then who is it ?

verses.z: 我的日子比跑信的更快，急速過去，不見福樂。
verses.e: " Now my days are swifter than a runner . They flee away . They see no good .

verses.z: 我的日子過去如快船，如急落抓食的鷹。
verses.e: They have passed away as the swift ships , as the eagle that swoops on the prey .

verses.z: 我若說：我要忘記我的哀情，除去我的[愁容]，心中暢快；
verses.e: If I say , ' I will forget my complaint , I will put off my sad face , and cheer up , '

verses.z: 我因愁苦而懼怕，知道你必不以我為無辜。
verses.e: I am afraid of all my sorrows . I know that you will not hold me innocent .

verses.z: 我必被你定為有罪，我何必徒然勞苦呢？
verses.e: I will be condemned . Why then do I labor in vain ?

verses.z: 若願意與他爭辯，千中之一也不能回答。
verses.e: If he is pleased to contend with him , he can't answer him one time in a thousand .

verses.z: 我若用雪水洗身，用鹼潔淨我的手，
verses.e: If I wash myself with snow , and cleanse my hands with lye ,

verses.z: 你還要扔我在坑裏，我的衣服都憎惡我。
verses.e: yet you will plunge me in the ditch . My own clothes will abhor me .

verses.z: 他本不像我是人，使我可以回答他，又使我們可以同聽審判。
verses.e: For he is not a man , as I am , that I should answer him , that we should come together in judgment .

verses.z: 我們中間沒有聽訟的人可以向我們兩造按手。
verses.e: There is no umpire between us , that might lay his hand on us both .

verses.z: 願他把杖離開我，不使驚惶威嚇我。
verses.e: Let him take his rod away from me . Let his terror not make me afraid ;

verses.z: 我就說話，也不懼怕他，現在我卻不是那樣。
verses.e: then I would speak , and not fear him , for I am not so in myself .

verses.z: 他心裏有智慧，且大有能力。誰向上帝剛硬而得亨通呢？
verses.e: God is wise in heart , and mighty in strength . Who has hardened himself against him and prospered ?

verses.z: 他發怒，把山翻倒挪移，山並不知覺。
verses.e: He removes the mountains , and they don't know it , when he overturns them in his anger .

verses.z: 他使地震動，離其本位，地的柱子就搖撼。
verses.e: He shakes the earth out of its place . Its pillars tremble .

verses.z: 他吩咐日頭不出來，就不出來，又封閉眾星。
verses.e: He commands the sun and it doesn't rise , and seals up the stars .

verses.z: 他獨自鋪張蒼天，步行在海浪之上。
verses.e: He alone stretches out the heavens , and treads on the waves of the sea .

verses.z: 他造北斗、參星、昴星，並南方的密宮；
verses.e: He makes the Bear , Orion , and the Pleiades , and the rooms of the south .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到毗土珥的兒子約珥。
verses.e: The LORD's word that came to Joel , the son of Pethuel .

verses.z: 田荒涼，地悲哀；因為五穀毀壞，新酒乾竭，油也缺乏。
verses.e: The field is laid waste . The land mourns , for the grain is destroyed , The new wine has dried up , and the oil languishes .

verses.z: 農夫啊，你們要慚愧；修理葡萄園的啊，你們要哀號；因為大麥小麥與田間的莊稼都滅絕了。
verses.e: Be confounded , you farmers ! Wail , you vineyard keepers , for the wheat and for the barley ; for the harvest of the field has perished .

verses.z: 葡萄樹枯乾；無花果樹衰殘。石榴樹、棕樹、蘋果樹，連田野一切的樹木也都枯乾；眾人的喜樂盡都消滅。
verses.e: The vine has dried up , and the fig tree withered — the pomegranate tree , the palm tree also , and the apple tree , even all of the trees of the field are withered ; for joy has withered away from the sons of men .

verses.z: 祭司啊，你們當腰束[麻布]痛哭；伺候祭壇的啊，你們要哀號；事奉我上帝的啊，你們要來披上麻布過夜，因為素祭和奠祭從你們上帝的殿中斷絕了。
verses.e: Put on sackcloth and mourn , you priests ! Wail , you ministers of the altar . Come , lie all night in sackcloth , you ministers of my God , for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God's house .

verses.z: 你們要分定禁食的日子，宣告嚴肅會，招聚長老和國中的一切居民到耶和華－你們上帝的殿，向耶和華哀求。
verses.e: Sanctify a fast . Call a solemn assembly . Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD , your God , and cry to the LORD .

verses.z: 哀哉！耶和華的日子臨近了。這日來到，好像毀滅從全能者來到。
verses.e: Alas for the day ! For the day of the LORD is at hand , and it will come as destruction from the Almighty .

verses.z: 糧食不是在我們眼前斷絕了嗎？歡喜快樂不是從我們上帝的殿中止息了嗎？
verses.e: Isn't the food cut off before our eyes , joy and gladness from the house of our God ?

verses.z: 穀種在土塊下朽爛；倉也荒涼，廩也破壞；因為五穀枯乾了。
verses.e: The seeds rot under their clods . The granaries are laid desolate . The barns are broken down , for the grain has withered .

verses.z: 牲畜哀鳴；牛群混亂，因為無草；羊群也受了困苦。
verses.e: How the animals groan ! The herds of livestock are perplexed , because they have no pasture . Yes , the flocks of sheep are made desolate .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我向你求告，因為火燒滅曠野的草場；火焰燒盡田野的樹木。
verses.e: LORD , I cry to you , for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness , and the flame has burned all the trees of the field .

verses.z: 老年人哪，當聽我的話；國中的居民哪，都要側耳而聽。在你們的日子，或你們列祖的日子，曾有這樣的事嗎？
verses.e: Hear this , you elders , and listen , all you inhabitants of the land ! Has this ever happened in your days , or in the days of your fathers ?

verses.z: 田野的走獸向你發喘；因為溪水乾涸，火也燒滅曠野的草場。
verses.e: Yes , the animals of the field pant to you , for the water brooks have dried up , and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness .

verses.z: 你們要將這事傳與子，子傳與孫，孫傳與後代。
verses.e: Tell your children about it , and have your children tell their children , and their children , another generation .

verses.z: 剪蟲剩下的，蝗蟲來吃；蝗蟲剩下的，蝻子來吃；蝻子剩下的，螞蚱來吃。
verses.e: What the swarming locust has left , the great locust has eaten . What the great locust has left , the grasshopper has eaten . What the grasshopper has left , the caterpillar has eaten .

verses.z: 酒醉的人哪，要清醒哭泣；好酒的人哪，都要為甜酒哀號，因為從你們的口中斷絕了。
verses.e: Wake up , you drunkards , and weep ! Wail , all you drinkers of wine , because of the sweet wine , for it is cut off from your mouth .

verses.z: 有一隊蝗蟲又強盛又無數，侵犯我的地；牠的牙齒如獅子的牙齒，大牙如母獅的大牙。
verses.e: For a nation has come up on my land , strong , and without number . His teeth are the teeth of a lion , and he has the fangs of a lioness .

verses.z: 牠毀壞我的葡萄樹，剝了我無花果樹的皮，剝盡而丟棄，使枝條露白。
verses.e: He has laid my vine waste , and stripped my fig tree . He has stripped its bark , and thrown it away . Its branches are made white .

verses.z: [我的民哪]，你當哀號，像處女腰束麻布，為幼年的丈夫哀號。
verses.e: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth !

verses.z: 素祭和奠祭從耶和華的殿中斷絕；事奉耶和華的祭司都悲哀。
verses.e: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD's house . The priests , the LORD's ministers , mourn .

verses.z: 你們要在錫安吹角，在我聖山吹出大聲。國中的居民都要發顫；因為耶和華的日子將到，已經臨近。
verses.e: Blow the trumpet in Zion , and sound an alarm in my holy mountain ! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble , for the day of the LORD comes , for it is close at hand :

verses.z: 牠們一來，地震天動，日月昏暗，星宿無光。
verses.e: The earth quakes before them . The heavens tremble . The sun and the moon are darkened , and the stars withdraw their shining .

verses.z: 耶和華在他軍旅前發聲，他的隊伍甚大；成就他命的是強盛者。因為耶和華的日子大而可畏，誰能當得起呢？
verses.e: The LORD thunders his voice before his army , for his forces are very great ; for he is strong who obeys his command ; for the day of the LORD is great and very awesome , and who can endure it ?

verses.z: 耶和華說：雖然如此，你們應當禁食、哭泣、悲哀，一心歸向我。
verses.e: " Yet even now , " says the LORD , " turn to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning . "

verses.z: 你們要撕裂心腸，不撕裂衣服。歸向耶和華－你們的上帝；因為他有恩典，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，並且後悔不降所說的災。
verses.e: Tear your heart and not your garments , and turn to the LORD , your God ; for he is gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and abundant in loving kindness , and relents from sending calamity .

verses.z: 或者他轉意後悔，留下餘福，就是留下獻給耶和華－你們上帝的素祭和奠祭，也未可知。
verses.e: Who knows ? He may turn and relent , and leave a blessing behind him , even a meal offering and a drink offering to the LORD , your God .

verses.z: 你們要在錫安吹角，分定禁食的日子，宣告嚴肅會。
verses.e: Blow the trumpet in Zion ! Sanctify a fast . Call a solemn assembly .

verses.z: 聚集眾民，使會眾自潔：招聚老者，聚集孩童和吃奶的；使新郎出離洞房，新婦出離內室。
verses.e: Gather the people . Sanctify the assembly . Assemble the elders . Gather the children , and those who nurse from breasts . Let the bridegroom go out of his room , and the bride out of her chamber .

verses.z: 事奉耶和華的祭司要在廊子和祭壇中間哭泣，說：耶和華啊，求你顧惜你的百姓，不要使你的產業受羞辱，列邦管轄他們。為何容列國的人說：「他們的上帝在哪裏」呢？
verses.e: Let the priests , the ministers of the LORD , weep between the porch and the altar , and let them say , " Spare your people , LORD , and don't give your heritage to reproach , that the nations should rule over them . Why should they say among the peoples , ' Where is their God ? ' "

verses.z: 耶和華就為自己的地發熱心，憐恤他的百姓。
verses.e: Then the LORD was jealous for his land , and had pity on his people .

verses.z: 耶和華應允他的百姓說：我必賜給你們五穀、新酒，和油，使你們飽足；我也不再使你們受列國的羞辱；
verses.e: The LORD answered his people , " Behold , I will send you grain , new wine , and oil , and you will be satisfied with them ; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations .

verses.z: 那日是黑暗、幽冥、密雲、烏黑的日子，好像晨光鋪滿山嶺。有一隊蝗蟲又大又強；從來沒有這樣的，以後直到萬代也必沒有。
verses.e: A day of darkness and gloominess , a day of clouds and thick darkness . As the dawn spreading on the mountains , a great and strong people ; there has never been the like , neither will there be any more after them , even to the years of many generations .

verses.z: 卻要使北方來的[軍隊]遠離你們，將他們趕到乾旱荒廢之地：前隊趕入東海，後隊趕入西海；因為他們所行的大惡，臭氣上升，腥味騰空。
verses.e: But I will remove the northern army far away from you , and will drive it into a barren and desolate land , its front into the eastern sea , and its back into the western sea ; and its stench will come up , and its bad smell will rise . " Surely he has done great things .

verses.z: 地土啊，不要懼怕；要歡喜快樂，因為耶和華行了大事。
verses.e: Land , don't be afraid . Be glad and rejoice , for the LORD has done great things .

verses.z: 田野的走獸啊，不要懼怕；因為，曠野的草發生，樹木結果，無花果樹、葡萄樹也都效力。
verses.e: Don't be afraid , you animals of the field ; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up , for the tree bears its fruit . The fig tree and the vine yield their strength .

verses.z: 錫安的民哪，你們要快樂，為耶和華－你們的上帝歡喜；因他賜給你們合宜的秋雨，為你們降下甘霖，就是秋雨、春雨，和先前一樣。
verses.e: " Be glad then , you children of Zion , and rejoice in the LORD , your God ; for he gives you the early rain in just measure , and he causes the rain to come down for you , the early rain and the latter rain , as before .

verses.z: 禾場必滿了麥子；酒醡與油醡必有新酒和油盈溢。
verses.e: The threshing floors will be full of wheat , and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil .

verses.z: 我打發到你們中間的大軍隊，就是蝗蟲、蝻子、螞蚱、剪蟲，那些年所吃的，我要補還你們。
verses.e: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten , the great locust , the grasshopper , and the caterpillar , my great army , which I sent among you .

verses.z: 你們必多吃而得飽足，就讚美為你們行奇妙事之耶和華－你們上帝的名。我的百姓必永遠不致羞愧。
verses.e: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied , and will praise the name of the LORD , your God , who has dealt wondrously with you ; and my people will never again be disappointed .

verses.z: 你們必知道我是在以色列中間，又知道我是耶和華－你們的上帝；在我以外並無別神。我的百姓必永遠不致羞愧。
verses.e: You will know that I am among Israel , and that I am the LORD , your God , and there is no one else ; and my people will never again be disappointed .

verses.z: 以後，我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。你們的兒女要說預言；你們的老年人要做異夢，少年人要見異象。
verses.e: " It will happen afterward , that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh ; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy . Your old men will dream dreams . Your young men will see visions .

verses.z: 在那些日子，我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女。
verses.e: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days , I will pour out my Spirit .

verses.z: 牠們前面如火燒滅，後面如火焰燒盡。未到以前，地如伊甸園；過去以後，成了荒涼的曠野；沒有一樣能躲避牠們的。
verses.e: A fire devours before them , and behind them , a flame burns . The land is as the garden of Eden before them , and behind them , a desolate wilderness . Yes , and no one has escaped them .

verses.z: 「在天上地下，我要顯出奇事，有血，有火，有煙柱。
verses.e: I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth : blood , fire , and pillars of smoke .

verses.z: 日頭要變為黑暗，月亮要變為血，這都在耶和華大而可畏的日子未到以前。
verses.e: The sun will be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes .

verses.z: 到那時候，凡求告耶和華名的就必得救；因為照耶和華所說的，在錫安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脫的人，在剩下的人中必有耶和華所召的。」
verses.e: It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD's name shall be saved ; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape , as the LORD has said , and among the remnant , those whom the LORD calls .

verses.z: 牠們的形狀如馬，奔跑如馬兵。
verses.e: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses , and they run as horsemen .

verses.z: 在山頂蹦跳的響聲如車輛的響聲，又如火焰燒碎稭的響聲，好像強盛的民擺陣預備打仗。
verses.e: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains , they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble , like a strong people set in battle array .

verses.z: 牠們一來，眾民傷慟，臉都變色。
verses.e: At their presence the peoples are in anguish . All faces have grown pale .

verses.z: 牠們如勇士奔跑，像戰士爬城；各都步行，不亂隊伍。
verses.e: They run like mighty men . They climb the wall like warriors . They each march in his line , and they don't swerve off course .

verses.z: 彼此並不擁擠，向前各行其路，直闖兵器，不偏左右。
verses.e: One doesn't jostle another . They each march in their own path . They burst through the defenses and don't break ranks .

verses.z: 牠們蹦上城，躥上牆，爬上房屋，進入窗戶如同盜賊。
verses.e: They rush on the city . They run on the wall . They climb up into the houses . They enter in at the windows like thieves .

verses.z: 「到那日，我使猶大和耶路撒冷被擄之人歸回的時候，
verses.e: " For , behold , in those days , and in that time , when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem ,

verses.z: 要將犂頭打成刀劍，將鐮刀打成戈矛；軟弱的要說：我有勇力。
verses.e: Beat your plowshares into swords , and your pruning hooks into spears . Let the weak say , ' I am strong . '

verses.z: 四圍的列國啊，你們要速速地來，一同聚集。耶和華啊，求你使你的大能者降臨。
verses.e: Hurry and come , all you surrounding nations , and gather yourselves together . " Cause your mighty ones to come down there , LORD .

verses.z: 萬民都當興起，上到約沙法谷；因為我必坐在那裏，審判四圍的列國。
verses.e: " Let the nations arouse themselves , and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat ; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations .

verses.z: 開鐮吧！因為莊稼熟了；踐踏吧！因為酒醡滿了。酒池盈溢；他們的罪惡甚大。
verses.e: Put in the sickle ; for the harvest is ripe . Come , tread , for the wine press is full , the vats overflow , for their wickedness is great . "

verses.z: 許多許多的人在斷定谷，因為耶和華的日子臨近斷定谷。
verses.e: Multitudes , multitudes in the valley of decision ! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision .

verses.z: 日月昏暗，星宿無光。
verses.e: The sun and the moon are darkened , and the stars withdraw their shining .

verses.z: 耶和華必從錫安吼叫，從耶路撒冷發聲，天地就震動。耶和華卻要作他百姓的避難所，作以色列人的保障。
verses.e: The LORD will roar from Zion , and thunder from Jerusalem ; and the heavens and the earth will shake ; but the LORD will be a refuge to his people , and a stronghold to the children of Israel .

verses.z: 你們就知道我是耶和華－你們的上帝，且又住在錫安－我的聖山。那時，耶路撒冷必成為聖；外邦人不再從其中經過。
verses.e: " So you will know that I am the LORD , your God , dwelling in Zion , my holy mountain . Then Jerusalem will be holy , and no strangers will pass through her any more .

verses.z: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒；小山要流奶子；猶大溪河都有水流。必有泉源從耶和華的殿中流出來，滋潤什亭谷。
verses.e: It will happen in that day , that the mountains will drop down sweet wine , the hills will flow with milk , all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters ; and a fountain will flow out from the LORD's house , and will water the valley of Shittim .

verses.z: 埃及必然荒涼，以東變為悽涼的曠野，都因向猶大人所行的強暴，又因在本地流無辜人的血。
verses.e: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness , for the violence done to the children of Judah , because they have shed innocent blood in their land .

verses.z: 我要聚集萬民，帶他們下到約沙法谷，在那裏施行審判；因為他們將我的百姓，就是我的產業以色列，分散在列國中，又分取我的地土，
verses.e: I will gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat ; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people , and for my heritage , Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations . They have divided my land ,

verses.z: 但猶大必存到永遠；耶路撒冷必存到萬代。
verses.e: But Judah will be inhabited forever , and Jerusalem from generation to generation .

verses.z: 我未曾報復流血的罪，現在我要報復，因為耶和華住在錫安。
verses.e: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed , for the LORD dwells in Zion . "

verses.z: 且為我的百姓拈鬮，將童子換妓女，賣童女買酒喝。
verses.e: and have cast lots for my people , and have given a boy for a prostitute , and sold a girl for wine , that they may drink .

verses.z: 「泰爾、西頓，和非利士四境的人哪，你們與我何干？你們要報復我嗎？若報復我，我必使報應速速歸到你們的頭上。
verses.e: " Yes , and what are you to me , Tyre and Sidon , and all the regions of Philistia ? Will you repay me ? And if you repay me , I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head .

verses.z: 你們既然奪取我的金銀，又將我可愛的寶物帶入你們宮殿，
verses.e: Because you have taken my silver and my gold , and have carried my finest treasures into your temples ,

verses.z: 並將猶大人和耶路撒冷人賣給希臘人，使他們遠離自己的境界。
verses.e: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks , that you may remove them far from their border .

verses.z: 我必激動他們離開你們所賣到之地，又必使報應歸到你們的頭上。
verses.e: Behold , I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them , and will return your repayment on your own head ;

verses.z: 我必將你們的兒女賣在猶大人的手中，他們必賣給遠方示巴國的人。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah , and they will sell them to the men of Sheba , to a faraway nation , for the LORD has spoken it . "

verses.z: 當在萬民中宣告說：要預備打仗；激動勇士，使一切戰士上前來。
verses.e: Proclaim this among the nations : " Prepare for war ! Stir up the mighty men . Let all the warriors draw near . Let them come up .

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到亞米太的兒子約拿，說：
verses.e: Now the LORD's word came to Jonah the son of Amittai , saying ,

verses.z: 他們就大大懼怕，對他說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」他們已經知道他躲避耶和華，因為他告訴了他們。
verses.e: Then the men were exceedingly afraid , and said to him , " What have you done ? " For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD , because he had told them .

verses.z: 他們問他說：「我們當向你怎樣行，使海浪平靜呢？」這話是因海浪越發翻騰。
verses.e: Then they said to him , " What shall we do to you , that the sea may be calm to us ? " For the sea grew more and more stormy .

verses.z: 他對他們說：「你們將我抬起來，拋在海中，海就平靜了；我知道你們遭這大風是因我的緣故。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Take me up , and throw me into the sea . Then the sea will be calm for you ; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you . "

verses.z: 然而那些人竭力盪槳，要把船攏岸，卻是不能，因為海浪越發向他們翻騰。
verses.e: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land ; but they could not , for the sea grew more and more stormy against them .

verses.z: 他們便求告耶和華說：「耶和華啊，我們懇求你，不要因這人的性命使我們死亡，不要使流無辜血的罪歸與我們；因為你－耶和華是隨自己的意旨行事。」
verses.e: Therefore they cried to the LORD , and said , " We beg you , LORD , we beg you , don't let us die for this man's life , and don't lay on us innocent blood ; for you , LORD , have done as it pleased you . "

verses.z: 他們遂將約拿抬起，拋在海中，海的狂浪就平息了。
verses.e: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea ; and the sea ceased its raging .

verses.z: 那些人便大大敬畏耶和華，向耶和華獻祭，並且許願。
verses.e: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly ; and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows .

verses.z: 耶和華安排一條大魚吞了約拿，他在魚腹中三日三夜。
verses.e: The LORD prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah , and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights .

verses.z: 「你起來往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民呼喊，因為他們的惡達到我面前。」
verses.e: " Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and preach against it , for their wickedness has come up before me . "

verses.z: 約拿卻起來，逃往他施去躲避耶和華；下到約帕，遇見一隻船，要往他施去。他就給了船價，上了船，要與船上的人同往他施去躲避耶和華。
verses.e: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD . He went down to Joppa , and found a ship going to Tarshish ; so he paid its fare , and went down into it , to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD .

verses.z: 然而耶和華使海中起大風，海就狂風大作，甚至船幾乎破壞。
verses.e: But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea , and there was a mighty storm on the sea , so that the ship was likely to break up .

verses.z: 水手便懼怕，各人哀求自己的神。他們將船上的貨物拋在海中，為要使船輕些。約拿已下到底艙，躺臥沉睡。
verses.e: Then the mariners were afraid , and every man cried to his god . They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship . But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down , and was fast asleep .

verses.z: 船主到他那裏對他說：「你這沉睡的人哪，為何這樣呢？起來，求告你的神，或者神顧念我們，使我們不致滅亡。」
verses.e: So the ship master came to him , and said to him , " What do you mean , sleeper ? Arise , call on your God ! Maybe your God will notice us , so that we won't perish . "

verses.z: 船上的人彼此說：「來吧，我們掣籤，看看這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故。」於是他們掣籤，掣出約拿來。
verses.e: They all said to each other , " Come ! Let's cast lots , that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us . " So they cast lots , and the lot fell on Jonah .

verses.z: 眾人對他說：「請你告訴我們，這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故？你以何事為業？你從哪裏來？你是哪一國？屬哪一族的人？」
verses.e: Then they asked him , " Tell us , please , for whose cause this evil is on us . What is your occupation ? Where do you come from ? What is your country ? Of what people are you ? "

verses.z: 他說：「我是希伯來人。我敬畏耶和華－那創造滄海旱地之天上的上帝。」
verses.e: He said to them , " I am a Hebrew , and I fear the LORD , the God of heaven , who has made the sea and the dry land . "

verses.z: 約拿在魚腹中禱告耶和華－他的上帝，
verses.e: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD , his God , out of the fish's belly .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐魚，魚就把約拿吐在旱地上。
verses.e: Then the LORD spoke to the fish , and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land .

verses.z: 說：我遭遇患難求告耶和華，你就應允我；從陰間的深處呼求，你就俯聽我的聲音。
verses.e: He said , " I called because of my affliction to the LORD . He answered me . Out of the belly of Sheol I cried . You heard my voice .

verses.z: 你將我投下深淵，就是海的深處；大水環繞我，你的波浪洪濤都漫過我身。
verses.e: For you threw me into the depths , in the heart of the seas . The flood was all around me . All your waves and your billows passed over me .

verses.z: 我說：我從你眼前雖被驅逐，我仍要仰望你的聖殿。
verses.e: I said , ' I have been banished from your sight ; yet I will look again toward your holy temple . '

verses.z: 諸水環繞我，幾乎淹沒我；深淵圍住我；海草纏繞我的頭。
verses.e: The waters surrounded me , even to the soul . The deep was around me . The weeds were wrapped around my head .

verses.z: 我下到山根，地的門將我永遠[關住]。耶和華－我的上帝啊，你卻將我的性命從坑中救出來。
verses.e: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains . The earth barred me in forever ; yet you have brought my life up from the pit , LORD my God .

verses.z: 我心在我裏面發昏的時候，我就想念耶和華。我的禱告進入你的聖殿，達到你的面前。
verses.e: " When my soul fainted within me , I remembered the LORD . My prayer came in to you , into your holy temple .

verses.z: 那信奉虛無[之神]的人，離棄憐愛他們的主；
verses.e: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy .

verses.z: 但我必用感謝的聲音獻祭與你。我所許的願，我必償還。救恩出於耶和華。
verses.e: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving . I will pay that which I have vowed . Salvation belongs to the LORD . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話二次臨到約拿說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to Jonah the second time , saying ,

verses.z: 於是上帝察看他們的行為，見他們離開惡道，他就後悔，不把所說的災禍降與他們了。
verses.e: God saw their works , that they turned from their evil way . God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them , and he didn't do it .

verses.z: 「你起來！往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的話。」
verses.e: " Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and preach to it the message that I give you . "

verses.z: 約拿便照耶和華的話起來，往尼尼微去。這尼尼微是極大的城，有三日的路程。
verses.e: So Jonah arose , and went to Nineveh , according to the LORD's word . Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city , three days ' journey across .

verses.z: 約拿進城走了一日，宣告說：「再等四十日，尼尼微必傾覆了！」
verses.e: Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey , and he cried out , and said , " In forty days , Nineveh will be overthrown ! "

verses.z: 尼尼微人信服上帝，便宣告禁食，從最大的到至小的都穿麻衣。
verses.e: The people of Nineveh believed God ; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth , from their greatest even to their least .

verses.z: 這信息傳到尼尼微王的耳中，他就下了寶座，脫下朝服，披上麻布，坐在灰中。
verses.e: The news reached the king of Nineveh , and he arose from his throne , took off his royal robe , covered himself with sackcloth , and sat in ashes .

verses.z: 他又使人遍告尼尼微通城，說：「王和大臣有令，人不可嘗甚麼，牲畜、牛羊不可吃草，也不可喝水。
verses.e: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles , saying , " Let neither man nor animal , herd nor flock , taste anything ; let them not feed , nor drink water ;

verses.z: 人與牲畜都當披上麻布；人要切切求告上帝。各人回頭離開所行的惡道，丟棄手中的強暴。
verses.e: but let them be covered with sackcloth , both man and animal , and let them cry mightily to God . Yes , let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands .

verses.z: 或者上帝轉意後悔，不發烈怒，使我們不致滅亡，也未可知。」
verses.e: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent , and turn away from his fierce anger , so that we might not perish ? "

verses.z: 這事約拿大大不悅，且甚發怒，
verses.e: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly , and he was angry .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「這蓖麻不是你栽種的，也不是你培養的；一夜發生，一夜乾死，你尚且愛惜；
verses.e: The LORD said , " You have been concerned for the vine , for which you have not labored , neither made it grow ; which came up in a night and perished in a night .

verses.z: 何況這尼尼微大城，其中不能分辨左手右手的有十二萬多人，並有許多牲畜，我豈能不愛惜呢？」
verses.e: Shouldn't I be concerned for Nineveh , that great city , in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can't discern between their right hand and their left hand , and also many animals ? "

verses.z: 就禱告耶和華說：「耶和華啊，我在本國的時候豈不是這樣說嗎？我知道你是有恩典、有憐憫的上帝，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，並且後悔不降所說的災，所以我急速逃往他施去。
verses.e: He prayed to the LORD , and said , " Please , LORD , wasn't this what I said when I was still in my own country ? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish , for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful , slow to anger , and abundant in loving kindness , and you relent of doing harm .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，現在求你取我的命吧！因為我死了比活着還好。」
verses.e: Therefore now , LORD , take , I beg you , my life from me , for it is better for me to die than to live . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「你這樣發怒合乎理嗎？」
verses.e: The LORD said , " Is it right for you to be angry ? "

verses.z: 於是約拿出城，坐在城的東邊，在那裏為自己搭了一座棚，坐在棚的蔭下，要看看那城究竟如何。
verses.e: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city , and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade , until he might see what would become of the city .

verses.z: 耶和華上帝安排一棵蓖麻，使其發生高過約拿，影兒遮蓋他的頭，救他脫離苦楚；約拿因這棵蓖麻大大喜樂。
verses.e: The LORD God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort . So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine .

verses.z: 次日黎明，上帝卻安排一條蟲子咬這蓖麻，以致枯槁。
verses.e: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day , and it chewed on the vine so that it withered .

verses.z: 日頭出來的時候，上帝安排炎熱的東風，日頭曝曬約拿的頭，使他發昏，他就為自己求死，說：「我死了比活着還好！」
verses.e: When the sun arose , God prepared a sultry east wind ; and the sun beat on Jonah's head , so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die . He said , " It is better for me to die than to live . "

verses.z: 上帝對約拿說：「你因這棵蓖麻發怒合乎理嗎？」他說：「我發怒以至於死，都合乎理！」
verses.e: God said to Jonah , " Is it right for you to be angry about the vine ? " He said , " I am right to be angry , even to death . "

verses.z: 耶和華的僕人摩西死了以後，耶和華曉諭摩西的幫手，嫩的兒子約書亞，說：
verses.e: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD , the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun , Moses ' servant , saying ,

verses.z: 於是，約書亞吩咐百姓的官長說：
verses.e: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們要走遍營中，吩咐百姓說：『當預備食物；因為三日之內你們要過這約旦河，進去得耶和華－你們上帝賜你們為業之地。』」
verses.e: " Pass through the middle of the camp , and command the people , saying , ' Prepare food ; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan , to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess . ' "

verses.z: 約書亞對呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人說：
verses.e: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to the half-tribe of Manasseh , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們要追念耶和華的僕人摩西所吩咐你們的話說：『耶和華－你們的上帝使你們得享平安，也必將這地賜給你們。』
verses.e: " Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you , saying , ' The LORD your God gives you rest , and will give you this land .

verses.z: 你們的妻子、孩子，和牲畜都可以留在約旦河東、摩西所給你們的地；但你們中間一切大能的勇士都要帶着兵器在你們的弟兄前面過去，幫助他們，
verses.e: Your wives , your little ones , and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan ; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed , all the mighty men of valor , and shall help them

verses.z: 等到耶和華使你們的弟兄像你們一樣得享平安，並且得着耶和華－你們上帝所賜他們為業之地，那時才可以回你們所得之地，承受為業，就是耶和華的僕人摩西在約旦河東、向日出之地所給你們的。」
verses.e: until the LORD has given your brothers rest , as he has given you , and they have also possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them . Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it , which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise . ' "

verses.z: 他們回答約書亞說：「你所吩咐我們行的，我們都必行；你所差遣我們去的，我們都必去。
verses.e: They answered Joshua , saying , " All that you have commanded us we will do , and wherever you send us we will go .

verses.z: 我們從前在一切事上怎樣聽從摩西，現在也必照樣聽從你；惟願耶和華－你的上帝與你同在，像與摩西同在一樣。
verses.e: Just as we listened to Moses in all things , so will we listen to you . Only may the LORD your God be with you , as he was with Moses .

verses.z: 無論甚麼人違背你的命令，不聽從你所吩咐他的一切話，就必治死他。你只要剛強壯膽！」
verses.e: Whoever rebels against your commandment , and doesn't listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death . Only be strong and courageous . "

verses.z: 「我的僕人摩西死了。現在你要起來，和眾百姓過這約旦河，往我所要賜給以色列人的地去。
verses.e: " Moses my servant is dead . Now therefore arise , go across this Jordan , you and all these people , to the land which I am giving to them , even to the children of Israel .

verses.z: 凡你們腳掌所踏之地，我都照着我所應許摩西的話賜給你們了。
verses.e: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on , as I told Moses .

verses.z: 從曠野和這黎巴嫩，直到幼發拉底大河，赫人的全地，又到大海日落之處，都要作你們的境界。
verses.e: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river , the river Euphrates , all the land of the Hittites , and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun , shall be your border .

verses.z: 你平生的日子，必無一人能在你面前站立得住。我怎樣與摩西同在，也必照樣與你同在；我必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。
verses.e: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life . As I was with Moses , so I will be with you . I will not fail you nor forsake you .

verses.z: 你當剛強壯膽！因為你必使這百姓承受那地為業，就是我向他們列祖起誓應許賜給他們的地。
verses.e: " Be strong and courageous ; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them .

verses.z: 只要剛強，大大壯膽，謹守遵行我僕人摩西所吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏離左右，使你無論往哪裏去，都可以順利。
verses.e: Only be strong and very courageous . Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you . Don't turn from it to the right hand or to the left , that you may have good success wherever you go .

verses.z: 這律法書不可離開你的口，總要晝夜思想，好使你謹守遵行這書上所寫的一切話。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事順利。
verses.e: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth , but you shall meditate on it day and night , that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it ; for then you shall make your way prosperous , and then you shall have good success .

verses.z: 我豈沒有吩咐你嗎？你當剛強壯膽！不要懼怕，也不要驚惶；因為你無論往哪裏去，耶和華－你的上帝必與你同在。」
verses.e: Haven't I commanded you ? Be strong and courageous . Don't be afraid . Don't be dismayed , for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go . "

verses.z: 耶路撒冷王亞多尼‧洗德聽見約書亞奪了艾城，盡行毀滅，怎樣待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照樣待艾城和艾城的王，又聽見基遍的居民與以色列人立了和約，住在他們中間，
verses.e: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai , and had utterly destroyed it ; as he had done to Jericho and her king , so he had done to Ai and her king ; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel , and were among them ,

verses.z: 耶和華使他們在以色列人面前潰亂。約書亞在基遍大大地殺敗他們，追趕他們，在伯‧和崙的上坡路擊殺他們，直到亞西加和瑪基大。
verses.e: The LORD confused them before Israel . He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon , and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon , and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah .

verses.z: 他們在以色列人面前逃跑，正在伯‧和崙下坡的時候，耶和華從天上降大冰雹在他們身上，直降到亞西加，打死他們。被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀殺死的還多。
verses.e: As they fled from before Israel , while they were at the descent of Beth Horon , the LORD hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah , and they died . There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword .

verses.z: 當耶和華將亞摩利人交付以色列人的日子，約書亞就禱告耶和華，在以色列人眼前說：日頭啊，你要停在基遍；月亮啊，你要止在亞雅崙谷。
verses.e: Then Joshua spoke to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel . He said in the sight of Israel , " Sun , stand still on Gibeon ! You , moon , stop in the valley of Aijalon ! "

verses.z: 於是日頭停留，月亮止住，直等國民向敵人報仇。這事豈不是寫在雅煞珥書上嗎？日頭在天當中停住，不急速下落，約有一日之久。
verses.e: The sun stood still , and the moon stayed , until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies . Isn't this written in the book of Jashar ? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky , and didn't hurry to go down about a whole day .

verses.z: 在這日以前，這日以後，耶和華聽人的禱告，沒有像這日的，是因耶和華為以色列爭戰。
verses.e: There was no day like that before it or after it , that the LORD listened to the voice of a man ; for the LORD fought for Israel .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人回到吉甲的營中。
verses.e: Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , to the camp to Gilgal .

verses.z: 那五王逃跑，藏在瑪基大洞裏。
verses.e: These five kings fled , and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah .

verses.z: 有人告訴約書亞說：「那五王已經找到了，都藏在瑪基大洞裏。」
verses.e: Joshua was told , saying , " The five kings have been found , hidden in the cave at Makkedah . "

verses.z: 約書亞說：「你們把幾塊大石頭滾到洞口，派人看守，
verses.e: Joshua said , " Roll large stones to cover the cave's entrance , and set men by it to guard them ;

verses.z: 你們卻不可耽延，要追趕你們的仇敵，擊殺他們儘後邊的人，不容他們進自己的城邑，因為耶和華－你們的上帝已經把他們交在你們手裏。」
verses.e: but don't stay there . Pursue your enemies , and attack them from the rear . Don't allow them to enter into their cities ; for the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand . "

verses.z: 就甚懼怕；因為基遍是一座大城，如都城一般，比艾城更大，並且城內的人都是勇士。
verses.e: they were very afraid , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all its men were mighty .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列人大大殺敗他們，直到將他們滅盡；其中剩下的人都進了堅固的城。
verses.e: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed , and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities ,

verses.z: 眾百姓就安然回瑪基大營中，到約書亞那裏。沒有一人敢向以色列人饒舌。
verses.e: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace . None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 約書亞說：「打開洞口，將那五王從洞裏帶出來，領到我面前。」
verses.e: Then Joshua said , " Open the cave entrance , and bring those five kings out of the cave to me . "

verses.z: 眾人就這樣行，將那五王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯崙王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊磯倫王，從洞裏帶出來，領到約書亞面前。
verses.e: They did so , and brought those five kings out of the cave to him : the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jarmuth , the king of Lachish , and the king of Eglon .

verses.z: 帶出那五王到約書亞面前的時候，約書亞就召了以色列眾人來，對那些和他同去的軍長說：「你們近前來，把腳踏在這些王的頸項上。」他們就近前來，把腳踏在這些王的頸項上。
verses.e: When they brought those kings out to Joshua , Joshua called for all the men of Israel , and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him , " Come near . Put your feet on the necks of these kings . " They came near , and put their feet on their necks .

verses.z: 約書亞對他們說：「你們不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。應當剛強壯膽，因為耶和華必這樣待你們所要攻打的一切仇敵。」
verses.e: Joshua said to them , " Don't be afraid , nor be dismayed . Be strong and courageous , for the LORD will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight . "

verses.z: 隨後約書亞將這五王殺死，掛在五棵樹上。他們就在樹上直掛到晚上。
verses.e: Afterward Joshua struck them , put them to death , and hanged them on five trees . They were hanging on the trees until the evening .

verses.z: 日頭要落的時候，約書亞一吩咐，人就把屍首從樹上取下來，丟在他們藏過的洞裏，把幾塊大石頭放在洞口，直存到今日。
verses.e: At the time of the going down of the sun , Joshua commanded , and they took them down off the trees , and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves , and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave , which remain to this very day .

verses.z: 當日，約書亞奪了瑪基大，用刀擊殺城中的人和王；將其中一切人口盡行殺滅，沒有留下一個。他待瑪基大王，像從前待耶利哥王一樣。
verses.e: Joshua took Makkedah on that day , and struck it with the edge of the sword , with its king . He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it . He left no one remaining . He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人從瑪基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。
verses.e: Joshua passed from Makkedah , and all Israel with him , to Libnah , and fought against Libnah .

verses.z: 所以耶路撒冷王亞多尼‧洗德打發人去見希伯崙王何咸、耶末王毗蘭、拉吉王雅非亞，和伊磯倫王底璧，說：
verses.e: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron , Piram king of Jarmuth , Japhia king of Lachish , and Debir king of Eglon , saying ,

verses.z: 耶和華將立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手裏。約書亞攻打這城，用刀擊殺了城中的一切人口，沒有留下一個。他待立拿王，像從前待耶利哥王一樣。
verses.e: The LORD delivered it also , with its king , into the hand of Israel . He struck it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls who were in it . He left no one remaining in it . He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人從立拿往拉吉去，對着拉吉安營，攻打這城。
verses.e: Joshua passed from Libnah , and all Israel with him , to Lachish , and encamped against it , and fought against it .

verses.z: 耶和華將拉吉交在以色列人的手裏。第二天約書亞就奪了拉吉，用刀擊殺了城中的一切人口，是照他向立拿一切所行的。
verses.e: The LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel . He took it on the second day , and struck it with the edge of the sword , with all the souls who were in it , according to all that he had done to Libnah .

verses.z: 那時基色王荷蘭上來幫助拉吉，約書亞就把他和他的民都擊殺了，沒有留下一個。
verses.e: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish ; and Joshua struck him and his people , until he had left him no one remaining .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人從拉吉往伊磯倫去，對着伊磯倫安營，攻打這城。
verses.e: Joshua passed from Lachish , and all Israel with him , to Eglon ; and they encamped against it and fought against it .

verses.z: 當日就奪了城，用刀擊殺了城中的人。那日，約書亞將城中的一切人口盡行殺滅，是照他向拉吉一切所行的。
verses.e: They took it on that day , and struck it with the edge of the sword . He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day , according to all that he had done to Lachish .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人從伊磯倫上希伯崙去，攻打這城，
verses.e: Joshua went up from Eglon , and all Israel with him , to Hebron ; and they fought against it .

verses.z: 就奪了希伯崙和屬希伯崙的諸城邑，用刀將城中的人與王，並那些城邑中的人口，都擊殺了，沒有留下一個，是照他向伊磯倫所行的，把城中的一切人口盡行殺滅。
verses.e: They took it , and struck it with the edge of the sword , with its king and all its cities , and all the souls who were in it . He left no one remaining , according to all that he had done to Eglon ; but he utterly destroyed it , and all the souls who were in it .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人回到底璧，攻打這城，
verses.e: Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , to Debir , and fought against it .

verses.z: 就奪了底璧和屬底璧的城邑，又擒獲底璧的王，用刀將這些城中的人口盡行殺滅，沒有留下一個。他待底璧和底璧王，像從前待希伯崙和立拿與立拿王一樣。
verses.e: He took it , with its king and all its cities . They struck them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it . He left no one remaining . As he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to its king ; as he had done also to Libnah , and to its king .

verses.z: 「求你們上來幫助我，我們好攻打基遍，因為他們與約書亞和以色列人立了和約。」
verses.e: " Come up to me and help me . Let's strike Gibeon ; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel . "

verses.z: 這樣，約書亞擊殺全地的人，就是山地、南地、高原、山坡的人，和那些地的諸王，沒有留下一個。將凡有氣息的盡行殺滅，正如耶和華－以色列的上帝所吩咐的。
verses.e: So Joshua struck all the land , the hill country , the South , the lowland , the slopes , and all their kings . He left no one remaining , but he utterly destroyed all that breathed , as the LORD , the God of Israel , commanded .

verses.z: 約書亞從加低斯‧巴尼亞攻擊到迦薩，又攻擊歌珊全地，直到基遍。
verses.e: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza , and all the country of Goshen , even to Gibeon .

verses.z: 約書亞一時殺敗了這些王，並奪了他們的地，因為耶和華－以色列的上帝為以色列爭戰。
verses.e: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because the LORD , the God of Israel , fought for Israel .

verses.z: 於是約書亞和以色列眾人回到吉甲的營中。
verses.e: Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , to the camp to Gilgal .

verses.z: 於是五個亞摩利王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯崙王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊磯倫王，大家聚集，率領他們的眾軍上去，對着基遍安營，攻打基遍。
verses.e: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites , the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jarmuth , the king of Lachish , and the king of Eglon , gathered themselves together and went up , they and all their armies , and encamped against Gibeon , and made war against it .

verses.z: 基遍人就打發人往吉甲的營中去見約書亞，說：「你不要袖手不顧你的僕人，求你速速上來拯救我們，幫助我們，因為住山地亞摩利人的諸王都聚集攻擊我們。」
verses.e: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal , saying , " Don't abandon your servants ! Come up to us quickly and save us ! Help us ; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us . "

verses.z: 於是約書亞和他一切兵丁，並大能的勇士，都從吉甲上去。
verses.e: So Joshua went up from Gilgal , he and the whole army with him , including all the mighty men of valor .

verses.z: 耶和華對約書亞說：「不要怕他們；因為我已將他們交在你手裏，他們無一人能在你面前站立得住。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Don't fear them , for I have delivered them into your hands . Not a man of them will stand before you . "

verses.z: 約書亞就終夜從吉甲上去，猛然臨到他們那裏。
verses.e: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly . He marched from Gilgal all night .

verses.z: 夏瑣王耶賓聽見這事，就打發人去見瑪頓王約巴、伸崙王、押煞王，
verses.e: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it , he sent to Jobab king of Madon , to the king of Shimron , to the king of Achshaph ,

verses.z: 當時，約書亞轉回奪了夏瑣，用刀擊殺夏瑣王。（素來夏瑣在這諸國中是為首的。）
verses.e: Joshua turned back at that time , and took Hazor , and struck its king with the sword ; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms .

verses.z: 以色列人用刀擊殺城中的人口，將他們盡行殺滅；凡有氣息的沒有留下一個。約書亞又用火焚燒夏瑣。
verses.e: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword , utterly destroying them . There was no one left who breathed . He burned Hazor with fire .

verses.z: 約書亞奪了這些王的一切城邑，擒獲其中的諸王，用刀擊殺他們，將他們盡行殺滅，正如耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐的。
verses.e: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings , with their kings , and he struck them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed them , as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded .

verses.z: 至於造在山岡上的城，除了夏瑣以外，以色列人都沒有焚燒。約書亞只將夏瑣焚燒了。
verses.e: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds , Israel burned none of them , except Hazor only . Joshua burned that .

verses.z: 那些城邑所有的財物和牲畜，以色列人都取為自己的掠物；惟有一切人口都用刀擊殺，直到殺盡；凡有氣息的沒有留下一個。
verses.e: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities , with the livestock , as plunder for themselves ; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword , until they had destroyed them . They didn't leave any who breathed .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣吩咐他僕人摩西，摩西就照樣吩咐約書亞，約書亞也照樣行。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，約書亞沒有一件懈怠不行的。
verses.e: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant , so Moses commanded Joshua . Joshua did so . He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 約書亞奪了那全地，就是山地、一帶南地、歌珊全地、高原、亞拉巴、以色列的山地，和山下的高原。
verses.e: So Joshua captured all that land , the hill country , all the South , all the land of Goshen , the lowland , the Arabah , the hill country of Israel , and the lowland of the same ,

verses.z: 從上西珥的哈拉山，直到黑門山下黎巴嫩平原的巴力‧迦得，並且擒獲那些地的諸王，將他們殺死。
verses.e: from Mount Halak , that goes up to Seir , even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon . He took all their kings , struck them , and put them to death .

verses.z: 約書亞和這諸王爭戰了許多年日。
verses.e: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings .

verses.z: 除了基遍的希未人之外，沒有一城與以色列人講和的，都是以色列人爭戰奪來的。
verses.e: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , except the Hivites , the inhabitants of Gibeon . They took all in battle .

verses.z: 與北方山地、基尼烈南邊的亞拉巴高原，並西邊多珥山岡的諸王；
verses.e: and to the kings who were on the north , in the hill country , in the Arabah south of Chinneroth , in the lowland , and in the heights of Dor on the west ,

verses.z: 因為耶和華的意思是要使他們心裏剛硬，來與以色列人爭戰，好叫他們盡被殺滅，不蒙憐憫，正如耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts , to come against Israel in battle , that he might utterly destroy them , that they might have no favor , but that he might destroy them , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 當時約書亞來到，將住山地、希伯崙、底璧、亞拿伯、猶大山地、以色列山地所有的亞衲族人剪除了。約書亞將他們和他們的城邑盡都毀滅。
verses.e: Joshua came at that time , and cut off the Anakim from the hill country , from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab , and from all the hill country of Judah , and from all the hill country of Israel . Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities .

verses.z: 在以色列人的地沒有留下一個亞衲族人，只在迦薩、迦特，和亞實突有留下的。
verses.e: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel . Only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , did some remain .

verses.z: 這樣，約書亞照着耶和華所吩咐摩西的一切話奪了那全地，就按着以色列支派的宗族將地分給他們為業。於是國中太平，沒有爭戰了。
verses.e: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the LORD spoke to Moses ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . Then the land had rest from war .

verses.z: 又去見東方和西方的迦南人，與山地的亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人，並黑門山根米斯巴地的希未人。
verses.e: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west , the Amorite , the Hittite , the Perizzite , the Jebusite in the hill country , and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah .

verses.z: 這些王和他們的眾軍都出來，人數多如海邊的沙，並有許多馬匹車輛。
verses.e: They went out , they and all their armies with them , many people , even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude , with very many horses and chariots .

verses.z: 這諸王會合，來到米倫水邊，一同安營，要與以色列人爭戰。
verses.e: All these kings met together ; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom , to fight with Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華對約書亞說：「你不要因他們懼怕。明日這時，我必將他們交付以色列人全然殺了。你要砍斷他們馬的蹄筋，用火焚燒他們的車輛。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Don't be afraid because of them ; for tomorrow at this time , I will deliver them up all slain before Israel . You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire . "

verses.z: 於是約書亞率領一切兵丁，在米倫水邊突然向前攻打他們。
verses.e: So Joshua came suddenly , with all the warriors , against them by the waters of Merom , and attacked them .

verses.z: 耶和華將他們交在以色列人手裏，以色列人就擊殺他們，追趕他們到西頓大城，到米斯利弗‧瑪音，直到東邊米斯巴的平原，將他們擊殺，沒有留下一個。
verses.e: The LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel , and they struck them , and chased them to great Sidon , and to Misrephoth Maim , and to the valley of Mizpah eastward . They struck them until they left them no one remaining .

verses.z: 約書亞就照耶和華所吩咐他的去行，砍斷他們馬的蹄筋，用火焚燒他們的車輛。
verses.e: Joshua did to them as the LORD told him . He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire .

verses.z: 以色列人在約旦河外向日出之地擊殺二王，得他們的地，就是從亞嫩谷直到黑門山，並東邊的全亞拉巴之地。
verses.e: Now these are the kings of the land , whom the children of Israel struck , and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise , from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon , and all the Arabah eastward :

verses.z: 一個是耶路撒冷王，一個是希伯崙王，
verses.e: the king of Jerusalem , one ; the king of Hebron , one ;

verses.z: 一個是耶末王，一個是拉吉王，
verses.e: the king of Jarmuth , one ; the king of Lachish , one ;

verses.z: 一個是伊磯倫王，一個是基色王，
verses.e: the king of Eglon , one ; the king of Gezer , one ;

verses.z: 一個是底璧王，一個是基德王，
verses.e: the king of Debir , one ; the king of Geder , one ;

verses.z: 一個是何珥瑪王，一個是亞拉得王，
verses.e: the king of Hormah , one ; the king of Arad , one ;

verses.z: 一個是立拿王，一個是亞杜蘭王，
verses.e: the king of Libnah , one ; the king of Adullam , one ;

verses.z: 一個是瑪基大王，一個是伯特利王，
verses.e: the king of Makkedah , one ; the king of Bethel , one ;

verses.z: 一個是他普亞王，一個是希弗王，
verses.e: the king of Tappuah , one ; the king of Hepher , one ;

verses.z: 一個是亞弗王，一個是拉沙崙王，
verses.e: the king of Aphek , one ; the king of Lassharon , one ;

verses.z: 一個是瑪頓王，一個是夏瑣王，
verses.e: the king of Madon , one ; the king of Hazor , one ;

verses.z: 這二王，有住希實本、亞摩利人的王西宏。他所管之地是從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的[城]，並基列一半，直到亞捫人的境界，雅博河
verses.e: Sihon king of the Amorites , who lived in Heshbon , and ruled from Aroer , which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon , and the middle of the valley , and half Gilead , even to the river Jabbok , the border of the children of Ammon ;

verses.z: 一個是伸崙‧米崙王，一個是押煞王，
verses.e: the king of Shimron Meron , one ; the king of Achshaph , one ;

verses.z: 一個是他納王，一個是米吉多王，
verses.e: the king of Taanach , one ; the king of Megiddo , one ;

verses.z: 一個是基低斯王，一個是靠近迦密的約念王，
verses.e: the king of Kedesh , one ; the king of Jokneam in Carmel , one ;

verses.z: 一個是多珥山岡的多珥王，一個是吉甲的戈印王，
verses.e: the king of Dor in the height of Dor , one ; the king of Goiim in Gilgal , one ;

verses.z: 一個是得撒王；共計三十一個王。
verses.e: the king of Tirzah , one : all the kings thirty-one .

verses.z: 與[約旦河]東邊的亞拉巴，直到基尼烈海，又到亞拉巴的海，就是鹽海，通伯‧耶西末的路，以及南方，直到毗斯迦的山根。
verses.e: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth , eastward , and to the sea of the Arabah , even the Salt Sea , eastward , the way to Beth Jeshimoth ; and on the south , under the slopes of Pisgah :

verses.z: 又有巴珊王噩。他是利乏音人所剩下的，住在亞斯他錄和以得來。
verses.e: and the border of Og king of Bashan , of the remnant of the Rephaim , who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,

verses.z: 他所管之地是黑門山、撒迦、巴珊全地，直到基述人和瑪迦人的境界，並基列一半，直到希實本王西宏的境界。
verses.e: and ruled in Mount Hermon , and in Salecah , and in all Bashan , to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites , and half Gilead , the border of Sihon king of Heshbon .

verses.z: 這二王是耶和華僕人摩西和以色列人所擊殺的；耶和華僕人摩西將他們的地賜給呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人為業。
verses.e: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel struck them . Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites , and the Gadites , and the half-tribe of Manasseh .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列人在約旦河西擊殺了諸王。他們的地是從黎巴嫩平原的巴力‧迦得，直到上西珥的哈拉山。約書亞就將那地按着以色列支派的宗族分給他們為業，
verses.e: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward , from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak , that goes up to Seir . Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions ;

verses.z: 就是赫人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的山地、高原亞拉巴、山坡、曠野，和南地。
verses.e: in the hill country , and in the lowland , and in the Arabah , and in the slopes , and in the wilderness , and in the South ; the Hittite , the Amorite , and the Canaanite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite :

verses.z: [他們的王]：一個是耶利哥王，一個是靠近伯特利的艾城王，
verses.e: the king of Jericho , one ; the king of Ai , which is beside Bethel , one ;

verses.z: 約書亞年紀老邁，耶和華對他說：「你年紀老邁了，還有許多未得之地，
verses.e: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years . The LORD said to him , " You are old and advanced in years , and there remains yet very much land to be possessed .

verses.z: 和在希實本作王亞摩利王西宏的諸城，直到亞捫人的境界；
verses.e: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites , who reigned in Heshbon , to the border of the children of Ammon ;

verses.z: 又有基列地、基述人、瑪迦人的地界，並黑門全山、巴珊全地，直到撒迦；
verses.e: and Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites , and all Mount Hermon , and all Bashan to Salecah ;

verses.z: 又有巴珊王噩的全國－他在亞斯他錄和以得來作王（利乏音人所存留的只剩下他）。這些地的人都是摩西所擊殺、所趕逐的。
verses.e: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan , who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei ( who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim ) ; for Moses attacked these , and drove them out .

verses.z: 以色列人卻沒有趕逐基述人、瑪迦人；這些人仍住在以色列中，直到今日。
verses.e: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn't drive out the Geshurites , nor the Maacathites : but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day .

verses.z: 只是利未支派，摩西沒有把產業分給他們。他們的產業乃是獻與耶和華－以色列上帝的火祭，正如耶和華所應許他們的。
verses.e: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi . The offerings of the LORD , the God of Israel , made by fire are his inheritance , as he spoke to him .

verses.z: 摩西按着呂便支派的宗族分給他們[產業]。
verses.e: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families .

verses.z: 他們的境界是亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，靠近米底巴的全平原；
verses.e: Their border was from Aroer , that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon , and the city that is in the middle of the valley , and all the plain by Medeba ;

verses.z: 希實本並屬希實本平原的各城，底本、巴末‧巴力、伯‧巴力‧勉、
verses.e: Heshbon , and all its cities that are in the plain ; Dibon , Bamoth Baal , Beth Baal Meon ,

verses.z: 雅雜、基底莫、米法押、
verses.e: Jahaz , Kedemoth , Mephaath ,

verses.z: 基列亭、西比瑪、谷中山的細列‧哈沙轄、
verses.e: Kiriathaim , Sibmah , Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley ,

verses.z: 就是非利士人的全境和基述人的全地。
verses.e: " This is the land that still remains : all the regions of the Philistines , and all the Geshurites ;

verses.z: 伯‧毗珥、毗斯迦山坡、伯‧耶西末；
verses.e: Beth Peor , the slopes of Pisgah , Beth Jeshimoth ,

verses.z: 平原的各城，並亞摩利王西宏的全國。這西宏曾在希實本作王，摩西把他和米甸的族長以未、利金、蘇珥、戶珥、利巴擊殺了；這都是住那地屬西宏為首領的。
verses.e: all the cities of the plain , and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , who reigned in Heshbon , whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian , Evi , Rekem , Zur , Hur , and Reba , the princes of Sihon , who lived in the land .

verses.z: 那時以色列人在所殺的人中，也用刀殺了比珥的兒子術士巴蘭。
verses.e: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor , the soothsayer , with the sword , among the rest of their slain .

verses.z: 呂便人的境界就是約旦河與靠近約旦河的地。以上是呂便人按着宗族所得為業的諸城，並屬城的村莊。
verses.e: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families , the cities and its villages .

verses.z: 摩西按着迦得支派的宗族分給他們[產業]。
verses.e: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad , to the children of Gad , according to their families .

verses.z: 他們的境界是雅謝和基列的各城，並亞捫人的一半地，直到拉巴前的亞羅珥；
verses.e: Their border was Jazer , and all the cities of Gilead , and half the land of the children of Ammon , to Aroer that is near Rabbah ;

verses.z: 從希實本到拉抹‧米斯巴和比多寧，又從瑪哈念到底璧的境界，
verses.e: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh , and Betonim ; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir ;

verses.z: 並谷中的伯‧亞蘭、伯‧寧拉、疏割、撒分，就是希實本王西宏國中的餘地，以及約旦河與靠近約旦河的地，直到基尼烈海的極邊，都在約旦河東。
verses.e: and in the valley , Beth Haram , Beth Nimrah , Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , the Jordan's bank , to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward .

verses.z: 以上是迦得人按着宗族所得為業的諸城，並屬城的村莊。
verses.e: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families , the cities and its villages .

verses.z: 摩西把[產業]分給瑪拿西半支派，是按着瑪拿西半支派的宗族所分的。
verses.e: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh . It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families .

verses.z: 從埃及前的西曷河往北，直到以革倫的境界，就算屬迦南人之地。有非利士人五個首領所管的迦薩人、亞實突人、亞實基倫人、迦特人、以革倫人[之地]，並有南方亞衛人之地。
verses.e: from the Shihor , which is before Egypt , even to the border of Ekron northward , which is counted as Canaanite ; the five lords of the Philistines ; the Gazites , and the Ashdodites , the Ashkelonites , the Gittites , and the Ekronites ; also the Avvim ,

verses.z: 他們的境界是從瑪哈念起，包括巴珊全地，就是巴珊王噩的全國，並在巴珊、睚珥的一切城邑，共六十個。
verses.e: Their border was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the villages of Jair , which are in Bashan , sixty cities .

verses.z: 基列的一半，並亞斯他錄、以得來，就是屬巴珊王噩國的二城，是按着宗族給瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉的一半子孫。
verses.e: Half Gilead , Ashtaroth , and Edrei , the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan , were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh , even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families .

verses.z: 以上是摩西在約旦河東對着耶利哥的摩押平原所分給他們的產業。
verses.e: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab , beyond the Jordan at Jericho , eastward .

verses.z: 只是利未支派，摩西沒有把產業分給他們。耶和華－以色列的上帝是他們的產業，正如耶和華所應許他們的。
verses.e: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi . The LORD , the God of Israel , is their inheritance , as he spoke to them .

verses.z: 又有迦南人的全地，並屬西頓人的米亞拉到亞弗，直到亞摩利人的境界。
verses.e: on the south ; all the land of the Canaanites , and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians , to Aphek , to the border of the Amorites ;

verses.z: 還有迦巴勒人之地，並向日出的全黎巴嫩，就是從黑門山根的巴力‧迦得，直到哈馬口。
verses.e: and the land of the Gebalites , and all Lebanon , toward the sunrise , from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath ;

verses.z: 山地的一切居民，從黎巴嫩直到米斯利弗‧瑪音，就是所有的西頓人，我必在以色列人面前趕出他們去。你只管照我所吩咐的，將這地拈鬮分給以色列人為業。
verses.e: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim , even all the Sidonians . I will drive them out from before the children of Israel . Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance , as I have commanded you .

verses.z: 現在你要把這地分給九個支派和瑪拿西半個支派為業。」
verses.e: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh . "

verses.z: 瑪拿西那半支派和呂便、迦得二支派已經受了產業，就是耶和華的僕人摩西在約旦河東所賜給他們的：
verses.e: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance , which Moses gave them , beyond the Jordan eastward , even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them :

verses.z: 是從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，並米底巴的全平原，直到底本，
verses.e: from Aroer , that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon , and the city that is in the middle of the valley , and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon ;

verses.z: 以色列人在迦南地所得的產業，就是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長所分給他們的，都記在下面，
verses.e: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan , which Eleazar the priest , Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers ' houses of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed to them ,

verses.z: 自從耶和華對摩西說這話的時候，耶和華照他所應許的使我存活這四十五年；其間以色列人在曠野行走。看哪，現今我八十五歲了，
verses.e: " Now , behold , the LORD has kept me alive , as he spoke , these forty-five years , from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses , while Israel walked in the wilderness . Now , behold , I am eighty-five years old , today .

verses.z: 我還是強壯，像摩西打發我去的那天一樣；無論是爭戰，是出入，我的力量那時如何，現在還是如何。
verses.e: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me . As my strength was then , even so is my strength now for war , to go out and to come in .

verses.z: 求你將耶和華那日應許我的這山地給我；那裏有亞衲族人，並寬大堅固的城，你也曾聽見了。或者耶和華照他所應許的與我同在，我就把他們趕出去。」
verses.e: Now therefore give me this hill country , of which the LORD spoke in that day ; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there , and great and fortified cities . It may be that the LORD will be with me , and I shall drive them out , as the LORD said . "

verses.z: 於是約書亞為耶孚尼的兒子迦勒祝福，將希伯崙給他為業。
verses.e: Joshua blessed him ; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance .

verses.z: 所以希伯崙作了基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒的產業，直到今日，因為他專心跟從耶和華－以色列的上帝。
verses.e: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day , because he followed the LORD , the God of Israel wholeheartedly .

verses.z: 希伯崙從前名叫基列‧亞巴；亞巴是亞衲族中最尊大的人。於是國中太平，沒有爭戰了。
verses.e: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba , after the greatest man among the Anakim . Then the land had rest from war .

verses.z: 是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，把產業拈鬮分給九個半支派。
verses.e: by the lot of their inheritance , as the LORD commanded by Moses , for the nine tribes , and for the half-tribe .

verses.z: 原來，摩西在約旦河東已經把產業分給那兩個半支派，只是在他們中間沒有把產業分給利未人。
