verses.e: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan ; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them .

verses.z: 因為約瑟的子孫是兩個支派，就是瑪拿西和以法蓮，所以沒有把地分給利未人，但給他們城邑居住，並城邑的郊野，可以牧養他們的牲畜，安置他們的財物。
verses.e: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim . They gave no portion to the Levites in the land , except cities to dwell in , with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就照樣行，把地分了。
verses.e: The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses , and they divided the land .

verses.z: 那時，猶大人來到吉甲見約書亞，有基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒對約書亞說：「耶和華在加低斯‧巴尼亞指着我與你對神人摩西所說的話，你都知道了。
verses.e: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal . Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him , " You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea .

verses.z: 耶和華的僕人摩西從加低斯‧巴尼亞打發我窺探這地，那時我正四十歲；我按着心意回報他。
verses.e: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land . I brought him word again as it was in my heart .

verses.z: 然而，同我上去的眾弟兄使百姓的心消化；但我專心跟從耶和華－我的上帝。
verses.e: Nevertheless , my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt ; but I wholly followed the LORD my God .

verses.z: 當日摩西起誓說：『你腳所踏之地定要歸你和你的子孫永遠為業，因為你專心跟從耶和華－我的上帝。』
verses.e: Moses swore on that day , saying , ' Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever , because you have wholly followed the LORD my God . '

verses.z: 猶大支派按着宗族拈鬮所得之地是在儘南邊，到以東的交界，向南直到尋的曠野。
verses.e: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom , even to the wilderness of Zin southward , at the uttermost part of the south .

verses.z: 又從巴拉往西繞到西珥山，接連到耶琳山的北邊（耶琳就是基撒崙）；又下到伯‧示麥過亭納，
verses.e: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir , and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim ( also called Chesalon ) on the north , and went down to Beth Shemesh , and passed along by Timnah ;

verses.z: 通到以革倫北邊，延到施基崙，接連到巴拉山；又通到雅比聶，直通到海為止。
verses.e: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward ; and the border extended to Shikkeron , and passed along to Mount Baalah , and went out at Jabneel ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .

verses.z: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。這是猶大人按着宗族[所得之地]四圍的交界。
verses.e: The west border was to the shore of the great sea . This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families .

verses.z: 約書亞照耶和華所吩咐的，將猶大人中的一段地，就是基列‧亞巴，分給耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。亞巴是亞衲族的始祖（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）。
verses.e: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah , according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua , even Kiriath Arba , named after the father of Anak ( also called Hebron ) .

verses.z: 迦勒就從那裏趕出亞衲族的三個族長，就是示篩、亞希幔、撻買；
verses.e: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak : Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .

verses.z: 又從那裏上去，攻擊底璧的居民。（這底璧從前名叫基列‧西弗。）
verses.e: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir : now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher .

verses.z: 迦勒說：「誰能攻打基列‧西弗將城奪取，我就把我女兒押撒給他為妻。」
verses.e: Caleb said , " He who strikes Kiriath Sepher , and takes it , to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife . "

verses.z: 迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶奪取了那城，迦勒就把女兒押撒給他為妻。
verses.e: Othniel the son of Kenaz , the brother of Caleb , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife .

verses.z: 押撒過門的時候，勸丈夫向她父親求一塊田，押撒一下驢，迦勒問她說：「你要甚麼？」
verses.e: When she came , she had him ask her father for a field . She got off her donkey , and Caleb said , " What do you want ? "

verses.z: 她說：「求你賜福給我，你既將我安置在南地，求你也給我水泉。」她父親就把上泉下泉賜給她。
verses.e: She said , " Give me a blessing . Because you have set me in the land of the South , give me also springs of water . " So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs .

verses.z: 他們的南界是從鹽海的儘邊，就是從朝南的海汊起，
verses.e: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea , from the bay that looks southward ;

verses.z: 以下是猶大支派按着宗族所得的產業。
verses.e: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families .

verses.z: 猶大支派儘南邊的城邑，與以東交界相近的，就是甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、
verses.e: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel , Eder , Jagur ,

verses.z: 基拿、底摩拿、亞大達、
verses.e: Kinah , Dimonah , Adadah ,

verses.z: 基低斯、夏瑣、以提楠、
verses.e: Kedesh , Hazor , Ithnan ,

verses.z: 西弗、提鍊、比亞綠、
verses.e: Ziph , Telem , Bealoth ,

verses.z: 夏瑣‧哈大他、加略‧希斯崙（加略‧希斯崙就是夏瑣）、
verses.e: Hazor Hadattah , Kerioth Hezron ( also called Hazor ) ,

verses.z: 亞曼、示瑪、摩拉大、
verses.e: Amam , Shema , Moladah ,

verses.z: 哈薩‧迦大、黑實門、伯‧帕列、
verses.e: Hazar Gaddah , Heshmon , Beth Pelet ,

verses.z: 哈薩‧書亞、別是巴、比斯約他、
verses.e: Hazar Shual , Beersheba , Biziothiah ,

verses.z: 巴拉、以因、以森、
verses.e: Baalah , Iim , Ezem ,

verses.z: 通到亞克拉濱坡的南邊，接連到尋，上到加低斯‧巴尼亞的南邊，又過希斯崙，上到亞達珥，繞到甲加，
verses.e: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim , and passed along to Zin , and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea , and passed along by Hezron , went up to Addar , and turned toward Karka ;

verses.z: 伊勒多臘、基失、何珥瑪、
verses.e: Eltolad , Chesil , Hormah ,

verses.z: 洗革拉、麥瑪拿、三撒拿、
verses.e: Ziklag , Madmannah , Sansannah ,

verses.z: 利巴勿、實忻、亞因、臨門，共二十九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Lebaoth , Shilhim , Ain , and Rimmon . All the cities are twenty-nine , with their villages .

verses.z: 在高原有以實陶、瑣拉、亞實拿、
verses.e: In the lowland , Eshtaol , Zorah , Ashnah ,

verses.z: 撒挪亞、隱‧干寧、他普亞、以楠、
verses.e: Zanoah , En Gannim , Tappuah , Enam ,

verses.z: 耶末、亞杜蘭、梭哥、亞西加、
verses.e: Jarmuth , Adullam , Socoh , Azekah ,

verses.z: 沙拉音、亞底他音、基底拉、基底羅他音，共十四座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Shaaraim , Adithaim and Gederah ( or Gederothaim ) ; fourteen cities with their villages .

verses.z: 又有洗楠、哈大沙、麥大‧迦得、
verses.e: Zenan , Hadashah , Migdal Gad ,

verses.z: 底連、米斯巴、約帖、
verses.e: Dilean , Mizpah , Joktheel ,

verses.z: 拉吉、波斯加、伊磯倫、
verses.e: Lachish , Bozkath , Eglon ,

verses.z: 接連到押們，通到埃及小河，直通到海為止。這就是他們的南界。
verses.e: and it passed along to Azmon , went out at the brook of Egypt ; and the border ended at the sea . This shall be your south border .

verses.z: 迦本、拉幔、基提利、
verses.e: Cabbon , Lahmam , Chitlish ,

verses.z: 基低羅、伯‧大袞、拿瑪、瑪基大，共十六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Gederoth , Beth Dagon , Naamah , and Makkedah ; sixteen cities with their villages .

verses.z: 又有立拿、以帖、亞珊、
verses.e: Libnah , Ether , Ashan ,

verses.z: 益弗他、亞實拿、尼悉、
verses.e: Iphtah , Ashnah , Nezib ,

verses.z: 基伊拉、亞革悉、瑪利沙，共九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Keilah , Achzib , and Mareshah ; nine cities with their villages .

verses.z: 又有以革倫和屬以革倫的鎮市村莊；
verses.e: Ekron , with its towns and its villages ;

verses.z: 從以革倫直到海，一切靠近亞實突之地，並屬其地的村莊。
verses.e: from Ekron even to the sea , all that were by the side of Ashdod , with their villages .

verses.z: 亞實突和屬亞實突的鎮市村莊；迦薩和屬迦薩的鎮市村莊；直到埃及小河，並大海和靠近大海之地。
verses.e: Ashdod , its towns and its villages ; Gaza , its towns and its villages ; to the brook of Egypt , and the great sea with its coastline .

verses.z: 在山地有沙密、雅提珥、梭哥、
verses.e: In the hill country , Shamir , Jattir , Socoh ,

verses.z: 大拿、基列‧薩拿（基列‧薩拿就是底璧）、
verses.e: Dannah , Kiriath Sannah ( which is Debir ) ,

verses.z: 東界是從鹽海[南邊]到約旦河口。北界是從約旦河口的海汊起，
verses.e: The east border was the Salt Sea , even to the end of the Jordan . The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan .

verses.z: 亞拿伯、以實提莫、亞念、
verses.e: Anab , Eshtemoh , Anim ,

verses.z: 歌珊、何倫、基羅，共十一座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Goshen , Holon , and Giloh ; eleven cities with their villages .

verses.z: 又有亞拉、度瑪、以珊、
verses.e: Arab , Dumah , Eshan ,

verses.z: 雅農、伯‧他普亞、亞非加、
verses.e: Janim , Beth Tappuah , Aphekah ,

verses.z: 宏他、基列‧亞巴（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）、洗珥，共九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Humtah , Kiriath Arba ( also called Hebron ) , and Zior ; nine cities with their villages .

verses.z: 又有瑪雲、迦密、西弗、淤他、
verses.e: Maon , Carmel , Ziph , Jutah ,

verses.z: 耶斯列、約甸、撒挪亞、
verses.e: Jezreel , Jokdeam , Zanoah ,

verses.z: 該隱、基比亞、亭納，共十座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Kain , Gibeah , and Timnah ; ten cities with their villages .

verses.z: 又有哈忽、伯‧夙、基突、
verses.e: Halhul , Beth Zur , Gedor ,

verses.z: 瑪臘、伯‧亞諾、伊勒提君，共六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Maarath , Beth Anoth , and Eltekon ; six cities with their villages .

verses.z: 上到伯‧曷拉，過伯‧亞拉巴的北邊，上到呂便之子波罕的磐石；
verses.e: The border went up to Beth Hoglah , and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah ; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben .

verses.z: 又有基列‧巴力（基列‧巴力就是基列‧耶琳）、拉巴，共兩座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Kiriath Baal ( also called Kiriath Jearim ) , and Rabbah ; two cities with their villages .

verses.z: 在曠野有伯‧亞拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、
verses.e: In the wilderness , Beth Arabah , Middin , Secacah ,

verses.z: 匿珊、鹽城、隱‧基底，共六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Nibshan , the City of Salt , and En Gedi ; six cities with their villages .

verses.z: 至於住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，猶大人不能把他們趕出去，耶布斯人卻在耶路撒冷與猶大人同住，直到今日。
verses.e: As for the Jebusites , the inhabitants of Jerusalem , the children of Judah couldn't drive them out ; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day .

verses.z: 從亞割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亞都冥坡對面的吉甲；又接連到隱‧示麥泉，直通到隱‧羅結，
verses.e: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor , and so northward , looking toward Gilgal , that faces the ascent of Adummim , which is on the south side of the river . The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh , and ended at En Rogel .

verses.z: 上到欣嫩子谷，貼近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）；又上到欣嫩谷西邊的山頂，就是在利乏音谷極北的邊界；
verses.e: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite ( also called Jerusalem ) southward ; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward , which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward .

verses.z: 又從山頂延到尼弗多亞的水源，通到以弗崙山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列‧耶琳）；
verses.e: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah , and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron ; and the border extended to Baalah ( also called Kiriath Jearim ) ;

verses.z: 約瑟的子孫拈鬮所得之地是從靠近耶利哥的約旦河起，以耶利哥東邊的水為界：從耶利哥上去，通過山地的曠野，到伯特利；
verses.e: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho , at the waters of Jericho on the east , even the wilderness , going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel .

verses.z: 他們沒有趕出住基色的迦南人；迦南人卻住在以法蓮人中間，成為做苦工的僕人，直到今日。
verses.e: They didn't drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer ; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day , and have become servants to do forced labor .

verses.z: 又從伯特利到路斯，接連到亞基人的境界，至亞他綠；
verses.e: It went out from Bethel to Luz , and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth ;

verses.z: 又往西下到押利提人的境界，到下伯‧和崙的境界，直到基色，通到海為止。
verses.e: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites , to the border of Beth Horon the lower , and on to Gezer ; and ended at the sea .

verses.z: 約瑟的兒子瑪拿西、以法蓮就得了他們的地業。
verses.e: The children of Joseph , Manasseh and Ephraim , took their inheritance .

verses.z: 以法蓮子孫的境界，按着宗族所得的，記在下面：他們地業的東界是亞他綠‧亞達到上伯‧和崙；
verses.e: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families . The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar , to Beth Horon the upper .

verses.z: 往西通到北邊的密米他，又向東繞到他納‧示羅，又接連到雅挪哈的東邊；
verses.e: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north . The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh , and passed along it on the east of Janoah .

verses.z: 從雅挪哈下到亞他綠，又到拿拉，達到耶利哥，通到約旦河為止；
verses.e: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth , to Naarah , reached to Jericho , and went out at the Jordan .

verses.z: 從他普亞往西，到加拿河，直通到海為止。這就是以法蓮支派按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah ; and ended at the sea . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families ;

verses.z: 另外在瑪拿西人地業中得了些城邑和屬城的村莊。這都是分給以法蓮子孫的。
verses.e: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .

verses.z: 瑪拿西是約瑟的長子，他的支派拈鬮所得之地記在下面。至於瑪拿西的長子基列之父瑪吉，因為是勇士就得了基列和巴珊。
verses.e: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh , for he was the firstborn of Joseph . As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead , because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .

verses.z: 南歸以法蓮，北歸瑪拿西，以海為界；北邊到亞設，東邊到以薩迦。
verses.e: Southward it was Ephraim's , and northward it was Manasseh's , and the sea was his border . They reached to Asher on the north , and to Issachar on the east .

verses.z: 瑪拿西在以薩迦和亞設境內，有伯‧善和屬伯‧善的鎮市，以伯蓮和屬以伯蓮的鎮市，多珥的居民和屬多珥的鎮市；又有三處山岡，就是隱‧多珥和屬隱‧多珥的鎮市；他納的居民和屬他納的鎮市，米吉多的居民和屬米吉多的鎮市。
verses.e: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar , in Asher Beth Shean and its towns , and Ibleam and its towns , and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns , and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns , and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns , and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns .

verses.z: 只是瑪拿西子孫不能趕出這些城的[居民]，迦南人偏要住在那地。
verses.e: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn't drive out the inhabitants of those cities ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .

verses.z: 及至以色列人強盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，沒有把他們全然趕出。
verses.e: When the children of Israel had grown strong , they put the Canaanites to forced labor , and didn't utterly drive them out .

verses.z: 約瑟的子孫對約書亞說：「耶和華到如今既然賜福與我們，我們也族大人多，你為甚麼僅將一鬮一段之地分給我們為業呢？」
verses.e: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua , saying , " Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance , since we are a numerous people , because the LORD has blessed us so far ? "

verses.z: 約書亞說：「你們如果族大人多，嫌以法蓮山地窄小，就可以上比利洗人、利乏音人之地，在樹林中砍伐[樹木]。」
verses.e: Joshua said to them , " If you are a numerous people , go up to the forest , and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim , since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you . "

verses.z: 約瑟的子孫說：「那山地容不下我們，並且住平原的迦南人，就是住伯‧善和屬伯‧善的鎮市，並住耶斯列平原的人，都有鐵車。」
verses.e: The children of Joseph said , " The hill country is not enough for us . All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns , and those who are in the valley of Jezreel . "

verses.z: 約書亞對約瑟家，就是以法蓮和瑪拿西人，說：「你是族大人多，並且強盛，不可僅有一鬮之地，
verses.e: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph , that is , to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , " You are a numerous people , and have great power . You shall not have one lot only ;

verses.z: 山地也要歸你，雖是樹林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必歸你。迦南人雖有鐵車，雖是強盛，你也能把他們趕出去。」
verses.e: but the hill country shall be yours . Although it is a forest , you shall cut it down , and it's farthest extent shall be yours ; for you shall drive out the Canaanites , though they have chariots of iron , and though they are strong . "

verses.z: 瑪拿西其餘的子孫，按着宗族[拈鬮分地]，就是亞比以謝子孫，希勒子孫，亞斯列子孫，示劍子孫，希弗子孫，示米大子孫；這些按着宗族，都是約瑟兒子瑪拿西子孫的男丁。
verses.e: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families : for the children of Abiezer , for the children of Helek , for the children of Asriel , for the children of Shechem , for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida . These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families .

verses.z: 瑪拿西的玄孫，瑪吉的曾孫，基列的孫子，希弗的兒子西羅非哈沒有兒子，只有女兒。他的女兒名叫瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒；
verses.e: But Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , had no sons , but daughters . These are the names of his daughters : Mahlah , Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .

verses.z: 她們來到祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞並眾首領面前，說：「耶和華曾吩咐摩西在我們弟兄中分給我們產業。」於是約書亞照耶和華所吩咐的，在她們伯叔中，把產業分給她們。
verses.e: They came to Eleazar the priest , and to Joshua the son of Nun , and to the princes , saying , " The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers . " Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father .

verses.z: 除了約旦河東的基列和巴珊地之外，還有十分地歸瑪拿西，
verses.e: Ten parts fell to Manasseh , in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan , which is beyond the Jordan ;

verses.z: 因為瑪拿西的孫女們在瑪拿西的孫子中得了產業。基列地是屬瑪拿西其餘的子孫。
verses.e: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons . The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh .

verses.z: 瑪拿西的境界：從亞設起，到示劍前的密米他，往北到隱‧他普亞居民[之地]。
verses.e: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath , which is before Shechem . The border went along to the right hand , to the inhabitants of En Tappuah .

verses.z: 他普亞地歸瑪拿西，只是瑪拿西境界上的他普亞[城]歸以法蓮子孫。
verses.e: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh ; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim .

verses.z: 其界下到加拿河的南邊。在瑪拿西城邑中的這些城邑都歸以法蓮。瑪拿西的地界是在河北直通到海為止；
verses.e: The border went down to the brook of Kanah , southward of the brook . These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh . The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook , and ended at the sea .

verses.z: 以色列的全會眾都聚集在示羅，把會幕設立在那裏，那地已經被他們制伏了。
verses.e: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh , and set up the Tent of Meeting there . The land was subdued before them .

verses.z: 約書亞就在示羅，耶和華面前，為他們拈鬮。約書亞在那裏，按着以色列人的支派，將地分給他們。
verses.e: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD . There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions .

verses.z: 便雅憫支派，按着宗族拈鬮所得之地，是在猶大、約瑟子孫中間。
verses.e: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families . The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph .

verses.z: 他們的北界是從約旦河起，往上貼近耶利哥的北邊；又往西通過山地，直到伯‧亞文的曠野；
verses.e: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan . The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north , and went up through the hill country westward . It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven .

verses.z: 從那裏往南接連到路斯，貼近路斯（路斯就是伯特利），又下到亞他綠‧亞達，靠近下伯‧和崙南邊的山；
verses.e: The border passed along from there to Luz , to the side of Luz ( also called Bethel ) , southward . The border went down to Ataroth Addar , by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower .

verses.z: 從[那裏]往西，又轉向南，從伯‧和崙南對面的山，直達到猶大人的城基列‧巴力（基列‧巴力就是基列‧耶琳）；這是西界。
verses.e: The border extended , and turned around on the west quarter southward , from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward ; and ended at Kiriath Baal ( also called Kiriath Jearim ) , a city of the children of Judah . This was the west quarter .

verses.z: 南界是從基列‧耶琳的儘邊起，往西達到尼弗多亞的水源；
verses.e: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim . The border went out westward , and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah .

verses.z: 又下到欣嫩子谷對面山的儘邊，就是利乏音谷北邊的山；又下到欣嫩谷，貼近耶布斯的南邊；又下到隱‧羅結；
verses.e: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom , which is in the valley of Rephaim northward . It went down to the valley of Hinnom , to the side of the Jebusite southward , and went down to En Rogel .

verses.z: 又往北通到隱‧示麥，達到亞都冥坡對面的基利綠；又下到呂便之子波罕的磐石；
verses.e: It extended northward , went out at En Shemesh , and went out to Geliloth , which is opposite the ascent of Adummim . It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben .

verses.z: 又接連到亞拉巴對面，往北下到亞拉巴；
verses.e: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward , and went down to the Arabah .

verses.z: 又接連到伯‧曷拉的北邊，直通到鹽海的北汊，就是約旦河的南頭；這是南界。
verses.e: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward ; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea , at the south end of the Jordan . This was the south border .

verses.z: 以色列人中其餘的七個支派還沒有分給他們地業。
verses.e: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel , which had not yet divided their inheritance .

verses.z: 東界是約旦河。這是便雅憫人按着宗族，照他們四圍的交界所得的地業。
verses.e: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter . This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin , by the borders around it , according to their families .

verses.z: 便雅憫支派按着宗族所得的城邑就是：耶利哥、伯‧曷拉、伊麥‧基悉、
verses.e: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , Beth Hoglah , Emek Keziz ,

verses.z: 伯‧亞拉巴、洗瑪臉、伯特利、
verses.e: Beth Arabah , Zemaraim , Bethel ,

verses.z: 亞文、巴拉、俄弗拉、
verses.e: Avvim , Parah , Ophrah ,

verses.z: 基法‧阿摩尼、俄弗尼、迦巴，共十二座城，還有屬城的村莊；
verses.e: Chephar Ammoni , Ophni , and Geba ; twelve cities with their villages .

verses.z: 又有基遍、拉瑪、比錄、
verses.e: Gibeon , Ramah , Beeroth ,

verses.z: 米斯巴、基非拉、摩撒、
verses.e: Mizpeh , Chephirah , Mozah ,

verses.z: 利堅、伊利毗勒、他拉拉、
verses.e: Rekem , Irpeel , Taralah ,

verses.z: 洗拉、以利弗、耶布斯（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）、基比亞、基列，共十四座城，還有屬城的村莊。這是便雅憫人按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: Zelah , Eleph , the Jebusite ( also called Jerusalem ) , Gibeath , and Kiriath ; fourteen cities with their villages . This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families .

verses.z: 約書亞對以色列人說：「耶和華－你們列祖的上帝所賜給你們的地，你們耽延不去得，要到幾時呢？
verses.e: Joshua said to the children of Israel , " How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land , which the LORD , the God of your fathers , has given you ?

verses.z: 你們每支派當選舉三個人，我要打發他們去，他們就要起身走遍那地，按着各支派[應得的]地業寫明，就回到我這裏來。
verses.e: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe . I will send them , and they shall arise , walk through the land , and describe it according to their inheritance ; then they shall come to me .

verses.z: 他們要將地分做七分；猶大仍在南方，住在他的境內。約瑟家仍在北方，住在他的境內。
verses.e: They shall divide it into seven portions . Judah shall live in his borders on the south , and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north .

verses.z: 你們要將地分做七分，寫明了拿到我這裏來。我要在耶和華－我們上帝面前，為你們拈鬮。
verses.e: You shall survey the land into seven parts , and bring the description here to me ; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God .

verses.z: 利未人在你們中間沒有分，因為供耶和華祭司的職任就是他們的產業。迦得支派、呂便支派，和瑪拿西半支派已經在約旦河東得了地業，就是耶和華僕人摩西所給他們的。」
verses.e: However , the Levites have no portion among you ; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance . Gad , Reuben , and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan , which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them . "

verses.z: 劃地勢的人起身去的時候，約書亞囑咐他們說：「你們去走遍那地，劃明地勢，就回到我這裏來。我要在示羅這裏，耶和華面前，為你們拈鬮。」
verses.e: The men arose and went . Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land , saying , " Go walk through the land , survey it , and come again to me . I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh . "

verses.z: 他們就去了，走遍那地，按着城邑分做七分，寫在冊子上，回到示羅營中見約書亞。
verses.e: The men went and passed through the land , and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book . They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh .

verses.z: 為西緬支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二鬮。他們所得的地業是在猶大人地業中間。
verses.e: The second lot came out for Simeon , even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families . Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah .

verses.z: 為西布倫人，按着宗族，拈出第三鬮。他們地業的境界是到撒立；
verses.e: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families . The border of their inheritance was to Sarid .

verses.z: 往西上到瑪拉拉，達到大巴設，又達到約念前的河；
verses.e: Their border went up westward , even to Maralah , and reached to Dabbesheth . It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam .

verses.z: 又從撒立往東轉向日出之地，到吉斯綠‧他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亞；
verses.e: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor . It went out to Daberath , and went up to Japhia .

verses.z: 從那裏往東，接連到迦特‧希弗，至以特‧加汛，通到臨門，臨門延到尼亞；
verses.e: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher , to Ethkazin ; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah .

verses.z: 又繞過尼亞的北邊，轉到哈拿頓，通到伊弗他‧伊勒谷。
verses.e: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon ; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El ;

verses.z: 還有加他、拿哈拉、伸崙、以大拉、伯利恆，共十二座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Kattath , Nahalal , Shimron , Idalah , and Bethlehem : twelve cities with their villages .

verses.z: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是西布倫人按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .

verses.z: 為以薩迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四鬮。
verses.e: The fourth lot came out for Issachar , even for the children of Issachar according to their families .

verses.z: 他們的境界是到耶斯列、基蘇律、書念、
verses.e: Their border was to Jezreel , Chesulloth , Shunem ,

verses.z: 哈弗連、示按、亞拿哈拉、
verses.e: Hapharaim , Shion , Anaharath ,

verses.z: 他們所得為業之地就是：別是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、
verses.e: They had for their inheritance Beersheba ( or Sheba ) , Moladah ,

verses.z: 拉璧、基善、亞別、
verses.e: Rabbith , Kishion , Ebez ,

verses.z: 利篾、隱‧干寧、隱‧哈大、伯‧帕薛；
verses.e: Remeth , Engannim , En Haddah , and Beth Pazzez .

verses.z: 又達到他泊、沙哈洗瑪、伯‧示麥，直通到約旦河為止，共十六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: The border reached to Tabor , Shahazumah , and Beth Shemesh . Their border ended at the Jordan : sixteen cities with their villages .

verses.z: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是以薩迦支派按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families , the cities with their villages .

verses.z: 為亞設支派，按着宗族，拈出第五鬮。
verses.e: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families .

verses.z: 他們的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、
verses.e: Their border was Helkath , Hali , Beten , Achshaph ,

verses.z: 亞拉米勒、亞末、米沙勒；往西達到迦密，又到希曷‧立納，
verses.e: Allammelech , Amad , Mishal . It reached to Carmel westward , and to Shihorlibnath .

verses.z: 轉向日出之地，到伯‧大袞，達到細步綸；往北到伊弗他‧伊勒谷，到伯‧以墨和尼業，也通到迦步勒的左邊；
verses.e: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon , and reached to Zebulun , and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel . It went out to Cabul on the left hand ,

verses.z: 又到義伯崙、利合、哈們、加拿，直到西頓大城；
verses.e: and Ebron , Rehob , Hammon , and Kanah , even to great Sidon .

verses.z: 轉到拉瑪和堅固城泰爾；又轉到何薩，靠近亞革悉一帶地方，直通到海；
verses.e: The border turned to Ramah , to the fortified city of Tyre ; and the border turned to Hosah . It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib ;

verses.z: 哈薩‧書亞、巴拉、以森、
verses.e: Hazar Shual , Balah , Ezem ,

verses.z: 又有烏瑪、亞弗、利合，共二十二座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Ummah also , and Aphek , and Rehob : twenty-two cities with their villages .

verses.z: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是亞設支派按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .

verses.z: 為拿弗他利人，按着宗族，拈出第六鬮。
verses.e: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali , even for the children of Naphtali according to their families .

verses.z: 他們的境界是從希利弗從撒拿音的橡樹，從亞大米‧尼吉和雅比聶，直到拉共，通到約旦河；
verses.e: Their border was from Heleph , from the oak in Zaanannim , Adami-nekeb , and Jabneel , to Lakkum . It ended at the Jordan .

verses.z: 又轉向西到亞斯納‧他泊，從那裏通到戶割，南邊到西布倫，西邊到亞設，又向日出之地，達到約旦河那裏的猶大。
verses.e: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor , and went out from there to Hukkok . It reached to Zebulun on the south , and reached to Asher on the west , and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise .

verses.z: 堅固的城就是：西丁、側耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、
verses.e: The fortified cities were Ziddim , Zer , Hammath , Rakkath , Chinnereth ,

verses.z: 亞大瑪、拉瑪、夏瑣、
verses.e: Adamah , Ramah , Hazor ,

verses.z: 基低斯、以得來、隱‧夏瑣、
verses.e: Kedesh , Edrei , En Hazor ,

verses.z: 以利穩、密大‧伊勒、和璉、伯‧亞納、伯‧示麥，共十九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
verses.e: Iron , Migdal El , Horem , Beth Anath , and Beth Shemesh ; nineteen cities with their villages .

verses.z: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是拿弗他利支派按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families , the cities with their villages .

verses.z: 伊利多拉、比土力、何珥瑪、
verses.e: Eltolad , Bethul , Hormah ,

verses.z: 為但支派，按着宗族，拈出第七鬮。
verses.e: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families .

verses.z: 他們地業的境界是瑣拉、以實陶、伊珥‧示麥、
verses.e: The border of their inheritance was Zorah , Eshtaol , Irshemesh ,

verses.z: 沙拉賓、亞雅崙、伊提拉、
verses.e: Shaalabbin , Aijalon , Ithlah ,

verses.z: 以倫、亭拿他、以革倫、
verses.e: Elon , Timnah , Ekron ,

verses.z: 伊利提基、基比頓、巴拉、
verses.e: Eltekeh , Gibbethon , Baalath ,

verses.z: 伊胡得、比尼‧比拉、迦特‧臨門、
verses.e: Jehud , Bene Berak , Gath Rimmon ,

verses.z: 美‧耶昆、拉昆，並約帕對面的地界。
verses.e: Me Jarkon , and Rakkon , with the border opposite Joppa .

verses.z: 但人的地界越過原得的地界；因為但人上去攻取利善，用刀擊殺城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他們先祖但的名將利善改名為但。
verses.e: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them ; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem , and took it , and struck it with the edge of the sword , and possessed it , and lived therein , and called Leshem , Dan , after the name of Dan their forefather .

verses.z: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是但支派按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .

verses.z: 以色列人按着境界分完了地業，就在他們中間將地給嫩的兒子約書亞為業，
verses.e: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders . The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them .

verses.z: 洗革拉、伯‧瑪加博、哈薩‧蘇撒、
verses.e: Ziklag , Beth Marcaboth , Hazar Susah ,

verses.z: 是照耶和華的吩咐，將約書亞所求的城，就是以法蓮山地的亭拿‧西拉城，給了他。他就修那城，住在其中。
verses.e: According to the LORD's commandment , they gave him the city which he asked , even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim ; and he built the city , and lived there .

verses.z: 這就是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長，在示羅會幕門口，耶和華面前，拈鬮所分的地業。這樣，他們把地分完了。
verses.e: These are the inheritances , which Eleazar the priest , Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers ' houses of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD , at the door of the Tent of Meeting . So they finished dividing the land .

verses.z: 伯‧利巴勿、沙魯險，共十三座城，還有屬城的村莊；
verses.e: Beth Lebaoth , and Sharuhen ; thirteen cities with their villages ;

verses.z: 又有亞因、利門、以帖、亞珊，共四座城，還有屬城的村莊；
verses.e: Ain , Rimmon , Ether , and Ashan ; four cities with their villages ;

verses.z: 並有這些城邑四圍一切的村莊，直到巴拉‧比珥，就是南地的拉瑪。這是西緬支派按着宗族所得的地業。
verses.e: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer , Ramah of the South . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .

verses.z: 西緬人的地業是從猶大人地業中得來的；因為猶大人的分過多，所以西緬人在他們的地業中得了地業。
verses.e: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon ; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them . Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance .

verses.z: 當下，嫩的兒子約書亞從什亭暗暗打發兩個人作探子，吩咐說：「你們去窺探那地和耶利哥。」於是二人去了，來到一個妓女名叫喇合的家裏，就在那裏躺臥。
verses.e: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies , saying , " Go , view the land , including Jericho . " They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab , and slept there .

verses.z: 因為我們聽見你們出埃及的時候，耶和華怎樣在你們前面使紅海的水乾了，並且你們怎樣待約旦河東的兩個亞摩利王西宏和噩，將他們盡行毀滅。
verses.e: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea before you , when you came out of Egypt ; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites , who were beyond the Jordan , to Sihon and to Og , whom you utterly destroyed .

verses.z: 我們一聽見這些事，心就消化了。因你們的緣故，並無一人有膽氣。耶和華－你們的上帝本是上天下地的上帝。
verses.e: As soon as we had heard it , our hearts melted , and there wasn't any more spirit in any man , because of you : for the LORD your God , he is God in heaven above , and on earth beneath .

verses.z: 現在我既是恩待你們，求你們指着耶和華向我起誓，也要恩待我父家，並給我一個實在的證據，
verses.e: Now therefore , please swear to me by the LORD , since I have dealt kindly with you , that you also will deal kindly with my father's house , and give me a true sign ;

verses.z: 要救活我的父母、弟兄、姊妹，和一切屬他們的，拯救我們性命不死。」
verses.e: and that you will save alive my father , my mother , my brothers , and my sisters , and all that they have , and will deliver our lives from death . "

verses.z: 二人對她說：「你若不洩漏我們這件事，我們情願替你們死。耶和華將這地賜給我們的時候，我們必以慈愛誠實待你。」
verses.e: The men said to her , " Our life for yours , if you don't talk about this business of ours ; and it shall be , when the LORD gives us the land , that we will deal kindly and truly with you . "

verses.z: 於是女人用繩子將二人從窗戶裏縋下去；因她的房子是在城牆邊上，她也住在城牆上。
verses.e: Then she let them down by a cord through the window ; for her house was on the side of the wall , and she lived on the wall .

verses.z: 她對他們說：「你們且往山上去，恐怕追趕的人碰見你們；要在那裏隱藏三天，等追趕的人回來，然後才可以走你們的路。」
verses.e: She said to them , " Go to the mountain , lest the pursuers find you . Hide yourselves there three days , until the pursuers have returned . Afterward , you may go your way . "

verses.z: 二人對她說：「[你要這樣行]。[不然]，你叫我們所起的誓就與我們無干了。
verses.e: The men said to her , " We will be guiltless of this your oath which you've made us to swear .

verses.z: 我們來到這地的時候，你要把這條朱紅線繩繫在縋我們下去的窗戶上，並要使你的父母、弟兄，和你父的全家都聚集在你家中。
verses.e: Behold , when we come into the land , tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down . Gather to yourself into the house your father , your mother , your brothers , and all your father's household .

verses.z: 凡出了你家門往街上去的，他的罪必歸到自己的頭上，與我們無干了。凡在你家裏的，若有人下手害他，流他血的罪就歸到我們的頭上。
verses.e: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street , his blood will be on his head , and we will be guiltless . Whoever is with you in the house , his blood shall be on our head , if any hand is on him .

verses.z: 有人告訴耶利哥王說：「今夜有以色列人來到這裏窺探此地。」
verses.e: The king of Jericho was told , " Behold , men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land . "

verses.z: 你若洩漏我們這件事，你叫我們所起的誓就與我們無干了。」
verses.e: But if you talk about this business of ours , then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you've made us to swear . "

verses.z: 女人說：「照你們的話行吧！」於是打發他們去了，又把朱紅線繩繫在窗戶上。
verses.e: She said , " Let it be as you have said . " She sent them away , and they departed . Then she tied the scarlet line in the window .

verses.z: 二人到山上，在那裏住了三天，等着追趕的人回去了。追趕的人一路找他們，卻找不着。
verses.e: They went and came to the mountain , and stayed there three days , until the pursuers had returned . The pursuers sought them all along the way , but didn't find them .

verses.z: 二人就下山回來，過了[河]，到嫩的兒子約書亞那裏，向他述說所遭遇的一切事；
verses.e: Then the two men returned , descended from the mountain , crossed the river , and came to Joshua the son of Nun . They told him all that had happened to them .

verses.z: 又對約書亞說：「耶和華果然將那全地交在我們手中；那地的一切居民在我們面前[心]都消化了。」
verses.e: They said to Joshua , " Truly the LORD has delivered all the land into our hands . Moreover , all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us . "

verses.z: 耶利哥王打發人去見喇合說：「那來到你這裏、進了你家的人要交出來，因為他們來窺探全地。」
verses.e: Jericho's king sent to Rahab , saying , " Bring out the men who have come to you , who have entered into your house ; for they have come to spy out all the land . "

verses.z: 女人將二人隱藏，就回答說：「那人果然到我這裏來；他們是哪裏來的我卻不知道。
verses.e: The woman took the two men and hid them . Then she said , " Yes , the men came to me , but I didn't know where they came from .

verses.z: 天黑、要關城門的時候，他們出去了，往哪裏去我卻不知道。你們快快地去追趕，就必追上。」（
verses.e: About the time of the shutting of the gate , when it was dark , the men went out . Where the men went , I don't know . Pursue them quickly . You may catch up with them . "

verses.z: 先是女人領二人上了房頂，將他們藏在那裏所擺的麻稭中。）
verses.e: But she had brought them up to the roof , and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof .

verses.z: 那些人就往約旦河的渡口追趕他們去了。追趕他們的人一出去，城門就關了。
verses.e: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River . As soon as those who pursued them had gone out , they shut the gate .

verses.z: 二人還沒有躺臥，女人就上房頂，到他們那裏，
verses.e: Before they had lain down , she came up to them on the roof .

verses.z: 對他們說：「我知道耶和華已經把這地賜給你們，並且因你們的緣故我們都驚慌了。這地的一切居民在你們面前[心]都消化了；
verses.e: She said to the men , " I know that the LORD has given you the land , and that the fear of you has fallen upon us , and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Joshua , saying ,

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們要照着我藉摩西所曉諭你們的，為自己設立逃城，
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' Assign the cities of refuge , of which I spoke to you by Moses ,

verses.z: 使那無心而誤殺人的，可以逃到那裏。這些城可以作你們逃避報血仇人的地方。
verses.e: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there . They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood .

verses.z: 那殺人的要逃到這些城中的一座城，站在城門口，將他的事情說給城內的長老們聽。他們就把他收進城裏，給他地方，使他住在他們中間。
verses.e: He shall flee to one of those cities , and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city , and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city . They shall take him into the city with them , and give him a place , that he may live among them .

verses.z: 若是報血仇的追了他來，長老不可將他交在報血仇的手裏；因為他是素無仇恨，無心殺了人的。
verses.e: If the avenger of blood pursues him , then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand ; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally , and didn't hate him before .

verses.z: 他要住在那城裏，站在會眾面前聽審判，等到那時的大祭司死了，殺人的才可以回到本城本家，就是他所逃出來的那城。」
verses.e: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment , until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days . Then the man slayer shall return , and come to his own city , and to his own house , to the city he fled from . ' "

verses.z: 於是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯；在以法蓮山地分定示劍；在猶大山地分定基列‧亞巴（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）；
verses.e: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali , Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim , and Kiriath Arba ( also called Hebron ) in the hill country of Judah .

verses.z: 又在約旦河外耶利哥東，從呂便支派中，在曠野的平原，設立比悉；從迦得支派中設立基列的拉末；從瑪拿西支派中設立巴珊的哥蘭。
verses.e: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward , they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben , Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad , and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .

verses.z: 這都是為以色列眾人和在他們中間寄居的外人所分定的城邑，使誤殺人的都可以逃到那裏，不死在報血仇人的手中，等他站在會眾面前[聽審判]。
verses.e: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel , and for the alien who lives among them , that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there , and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood , until he stands trial before the congregation .

verses.z: 那時，利未人的眾族長來到祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長面前，
verses.e: Then the heads of fathers ' houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest , and to Joshua the son of Nun , and to the heads of fathers ' houses of the tribes of the children of Israel .
and they were for the children of Aaron , of the families of the Kohathites , who were of the children of Levi ; for theirs was the first lot .

verses.z: 將猶大山地的基列‧亞巴和四圍的郊野給了他們。亞巴是亞衲族的始祖。（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）。
verses.e: They gave them Kiriath Arba , named after the father of Anak ( also called Hebron ) , in the hill country of Judah , with its pasture lands around it .

verses.z: 惟將屬城的田地和村莊給了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒為業。
verses.e: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession .

verses.z: 以色列人將希伯崙，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了祭司亞倫的子孫；又給他們立拿和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands , the city of refuge for the man slayer , Libnah with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 雅提珥和屬城的郊野，以實提莫和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Jattir with its pasture lands , Eshtemoa with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 何崙和屬城的郊野，底璧和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Holon with its pasture lands , Debir with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 亞因和屬城的郊野，淤他和屬城的郊野，伯‧示麥和屬城的郊野，共九座城，都是從這二支派中分出來的。
verses.e: Ain with its pasture lands , Juttah with its pasture lands , and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands : nine cities out of those two tribes .

verses.z: 又從便雅憫支派的地業中給了他們基遍和屬城的郊野，迦巴和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with its pasture lands , Geba with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 亞拿突和屬城的郊野，亞勒們和屬城的郊野，共四座城。
verses.e: Anathoth with its pasture lands , and Almon with its pasture lands : four cities .

verses.z: 亞倫子孫作祭司的共有十三座城，還有屬城的郊野。
verses.e: All the cities of the children of Aaron , the priests , were thirteen cities with their pasture lands .

verses.z: 在迦南地的示羅對他們說：「從前耶和華藉着摩西吩咐給我們城邑居住，並城邑的郊野可以牧養我們的牲畜。」
verses.e: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan , saying , " The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in , with their pasture lands for our livestock . "

verses.z: 利未[支派]中哥轄的宗族，就是哥轄其餘的子孫，拈鬮所得的城有從以法蓮支派中分出來的。
verses.e: The families of the children of Kohath , the Levites , even the rest of the children of Kohath , had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim .

verses.z: 以色列人將以法蓮山地的示劍，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們基色和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim , the city of refuge for the man slayer , and Gezer with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 基伯先和屬城的郊野，伯‧和崙和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.e: Kibzaim with its pasture lands , and Beth Horon with its pasture lands : four cities .

verses.z: 又從但支派的地業中給了他們伊利提基和屬城的郊野，基比頓和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Out of the tribe of Dan , Elteke with its pasture lands , Gibbethon with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 亞雅崙和屬城的郊野，迦特‧臨門和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.e: Aijalon with its pasture lands , Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands : four cities .

verses.z: 又從瑪拿西半支派的地業中給了他們他納和屬城的郊野，迦特‧臨門和屬城的郊野，共兩座城。
verses.e: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh , Taanach with its pasture lands , and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands : two cities .

verses.z: 哥轄其餘的子孫共有十座城，還有屬城的郊野。
verses.e: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands .

verses.z: 以色列人又從瑪拿西半支派的地業中將巴珊的哥蘭，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了利未支派革順的子孫；又給他們比‧施提拉和屬城的郊野，共兩座城；
verses.e: They gave to the children of Gershon , of the families of the Levites , out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands , the city of refuge for the man slayer , and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands : two cities .

verses.z: 又從以薩迦支派的地業中給了他們基善和屬城的郊野，大比拉和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishion with its pasture lands , Daberath with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 耶末和屬城的郊野，隱‧干寧和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.e: Jarmuth with its pasture lands , En Gannim with its pasture lands : four cities .

verses.z: 於是以色列人照耶和華所吩咐的，從自己的地業中，將以下所記的城邑和城邑的郊野給了利未人。
verses.e: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance , according to the commandment of the LORD , these cities with their pasture lands .

verses.z: 又從亞設支派的地業中給了他們米沙勒和屬城的郊野，押頓和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Out of the tribe of Asher , Mishal with its pasture lands , Abdon with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 黑甲和屬城的郊野，利合和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.e: Helkath with its pasture lands , and Rehob with its pasture lands : four cities .

verses.z: 又從拿弗他利支派的地業中將加利利的基低斯，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們哈末‧多珥和屬城的郊野，加珥坦和屬城的郊野，共三座城。
verses.e: Out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands , the city of refuge for the man slayer , Hammothdor with its pasture lands , and Kartan with its pasture lands : three cities .

verses.z: 革順人按着宗族[所得的]城，共十三座，還有屬城的郊野。
verses.e: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands .

verses.z: 其餘利未支派米拉利子孫，從西布倫支派的地業中所得的，就是約念和屬城的郊野，加珥他和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: To the families of the children of Merari , the rest of the Levites , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Jokneam with its pasture lands , Kartah with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 丁拿和屬城的郊野，拿哈拉和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.e: Dimnah with its pasture lands , and Nahalal with its pasture lands : four cities .

verses.z: 又從呂便支派的地業中給了他們比悉和屬城的郊野，雅雜和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Out of the tribe of Reuben , Bezer with its pasture lands , Jahaz with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 基底莫和屬城的郊野，米法押和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.e: Kedemoth with its pasture lands , and Mephaath with its pasture lands : four cities .

verses.z: 又從迦得支派的地業中，將基列的拉末，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們瑪哈念和屬城的郊野，
verses.e: Out of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands , the city of refuge for the man slayer , and Mahanaim with its pasture lands ,

verses.z: 希實本和屬城的郊野，雅謝和屬城的郊野，共四座城。
verses.e: Heshbon with its pasture lands , Jazer with its pasture lands : four cities in all .

verses.z: 為哥轄族拈鬮：利未人的祭司、亞倫的子孫，從猶大支派、西緬支派、便雅憫支派的地業中，按鬮得了十三座城。
verses.e: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites . The children of Aaron the priest , who were of the Levites , had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah , out of the tribe of the Simeonites , and out of the tribe of Benjamin .

verses.z: 其餘利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孫，按着宗族拈鬮所得的，共十二座城。
verses.e: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families , even the rest of the families of the Levites . Their lot was twelve cities .

verses.z: 利未人在以色列人的地業中所得的城，共四十八座，並有屬城的郊野。
verses.e: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands .

verses.z: 這些城四圍都有屬城的郊野，城城都是如此。
verses.e: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them . It was this way with all these cities .

verses.z: 這樣，耶和華將從前向他們列祖起誓所應許的全地賜給以色列人，他們就得了為業，住在其中。
verses.e: So the LORD gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers . They possessed it , and lived in it .

verses.z: 耶和華照着向他們列祖起誓所應許的一切話，使他們四境平安；他們一切仇敵中，沒有一人在他們面前站立得住。耶和華把一切仇敵都交在他們手中。
verses.e: The LORD gave them rest all around , according to all that he swore to their fathers . Not a man of all their enemies stood before them . The LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand .

verses.z: 耶和華應許賜福給以色列家的話一句也沒有落空，都應驗了。
verses.e: Nothing failed of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel . All came to pass .

verses.z: 哥轄其餘的子孫，從以法蓮支派、但支派、瑪拿西半支派的地業中，按鬮得了十座城。
verses.e: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim , out of the tribe of Dan , and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh .

verses.z: 革順的子孫，從以薩迦支派、亞設支派、拿弗他利支派、住巴珊的瑪拿西半支派的地業中，按鬮得了十三座城。
verses.e: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar , out of the tribe of Asher , out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan .

verses.z: 米拉利的子孫，按着宗族，從呂便支派、迦得支派、西布倫支派的地業中，[按鬮]得了十二座城。
verses.e: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben , out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun .

verses.z: 以色列人照着耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，將這些城邑和城邑的郊野，按鬮分給利未人。
verses.e: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites , as the LORD commanded by Moses .

verses.z: 從猶大支派、西緬支派的地業中，將以下所記的城給了利未支派哥轄宗族亞倫的子孫；因為給他們拈出頭一鬮，
verses.e: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are mentioned by name :

verses.z: 當時，約書亞召了呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人來，
verses.e: Then Joshua called the Reubenites , the Gadites , and the half-tribe of Manasseh ,

verses.z: 呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人到了靠近約旦河的一帶迦南地，就在約旦河那裏築了一座壇；那壇看着高大。
verses.e: When they came to the region near the Jordan , that is in the land of Canaan , the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan , a great altar to look at .

verses.z: 以色列人聽說呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人靠近約旦河邊，在迦南地屬以色列人的那邊築了一座壇。
verses.e: The children of Israel heard this , " Behold , the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan , in the region around the Jordan , on the side that belongs to the children of Israel . "

verses.z: 全會眾一聽見，就聚集在示羅，要上去攻打他們。
verses.e: When the children of Israel heard of it , the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh , to go up against them to war .

verses.z: 以色列人打發祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈，往基列地去見呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人；
verses.e: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben , and to the children of Gad , and to the half-tribe of Manasseh , into the land of Gilead , Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest .

verses.z: 又打發十個首領與非尼哈同去，就是以色列每支派的一個首領，都是以色列軍中的統領。
verses.e: With him were ten princes , one prince of a fathers ' house for each of the tribes of Israel ; and they were each head of their fathers ' houses among the thousands of Israel .

verses.z: 他們到了基列地，見呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人，對他們說：
verses.e: They came to the children of Reuben , and to the children of Gad , and to the half-tribe of Manasseh , to the land of Gilead , and they spoke with them , saying ,

verses.z: 「耶和華全會眾這樣說，你們今日轉去不跟從耶和華，干犯以色列的上帝，為自己築一座壇，悖逆了耶和華，這犯的是甚麼罪呢？
verses.e: " The whole congregation of the LORD says , ' What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel , to turn away today from following the LORD , in that you have built yourselves an altar , to rebel today against the LORD ?

verses.z: 從前[拜]毗珥的罪孽還算小嗎？雖然瘟疫臨到耶和華的會眾，到今日我們還沒有洗淨這罪。
verses.e: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us , from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day , although there came a plague on the congregation of the LORD ,

verses.z: 你們今日竟轉去不跟從耶和華嗎？你們今日既悖逆耶和華，明日他必向以色列全會眾發怒。
verses.e: that you must turn away today from following the LORD ? It will be , since you rebel today against the LORD , that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel .

verses.z: 你們所得為業之地，若嫌不潔淨，就可以過到耶和華之地，就是耶和華的帳幕所住之地，在我們中間得地業。只是不可悖逆耶和華，也不可得罪我們，在耶和華－我們上帝的壇以外為自己築壇。
verses.e: However , if the land of your possession is unclean , then pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD , in which the LORD's tabernacle dwells , and take possession among us ; but don't rebel against the LORD , nor rebel against us , in building an altar other than the LORD our God's altar .

verses.z: 對他們說：「耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐你們的，你們都遵守了；我所吩咐你們的，你們也都聽從了。
verses.e: and said to them , " You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you , and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you .

verses.z: 從前謝拉的曾孫亞干豈不是在那當滅的物上犯了罪，就有忿怒臨到以色列全會眾嗎？那人在所犯的罪中不獨一人死亡。」
verses.e: Didn't Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing , and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel ? That man didn't perish alone in his iniquity . ' "

verses.z: 於是呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人回答以色列軍中的統領說：
verses.e: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered , and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel ,

verses.z: 「大能者上帝耶和華！大能者上帝耶和華！他是知道的！以色列人也必知道！我們若有悖逆的意思，或是干犯耶和華（願你今日不保佑我們），
verses.e: " The Mighty One , God , the LORD , the Mighty One , God , the LORD , he knows ; and Israel shall know : if it was in rebellion , or if in trespass against the LORD ( don't save us today ) ,

verses.z: 為自己築壇，要轉去不跟從耶和華，或是要將燔祭、素祭、平安祭獻在壇上，願耶和華親自討我們的罪。
verses.e: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following the LORD ; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering , or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings , let the LORD himself require it .

verses.z: 我們行這事並非無故，是特意做的，說：恐怕日後你們的子孫對我們的子孫說：『你們與耶和華－以色列的上帝有何關涉呢？
verses.e: " If we have not out of concern done this , and for a reason , saying , ' In time to come your children might speak to our children , saying , " What have you to do with the LORD , the God of Israel ?

verses.z: 因為耶和華把約旦河定為我們和你們這呂便人、迦得人的交界，你們與耶和華無分了。』這樣，你們的子孫就使我們的子孫不再敬畏耶和華了。
verses.e: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you , you children of Reuben and children of Gad . You have no portion in the LORD . " ' So your children might make our children cease from fearing the LORD .

verses.z: 因此我們說：『不如為自己築一座壇，不是為獻燔祭，也不是為獻[別的]祭，
verses.e: " Therefore we said , ' Let's now prepare to build ourselves an altar , not for burnt offering , nor for sacrifice ;

verses.z: 乃是為你我中間和你我後人中間作證據，好叫我們也在耶和華面前獻燔祭、平安祭，和[別的]祭事奉他，免得你們的子孫日後對我們的子孫說，你們與耶和華無分了。』
verses.e: but it will be a witness between us and you , and between our generations after us , that we may perform the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings , with our sacrifices , and with our peace offerings ; ' that your children may not tell our children in time to come , ' You have no portion in the LORD . '

verses.z: 所以我們說：『日後你們對我們，或對我們的後人這樣說，我們就可以回答說，你們看我們列祖所築的壇是耶和華壇的樣式；這並不是為獻燔祭，也不是為獻[別的]祭，乃是為作你我中間的證據。』
verses.e: " Therefore we said , ' It shall be , when they tell us or our generations this in time to come , that we shall say , " Behold the pattern of the LORD's altar , which our fathers made , not for burnt offering , nor for sacrifice ; but it is a witness between us and you . " '

verses.z: 我們在耶和華－我們上帝帳幕前的壇以外，另築一座壇，為獻燔祭、素祭，和[別的]祭，悖逆耶和華，今日轉去不跟從他，我們斷沒有這個意思。」
verses.e: " Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD , and turn away today from following the LORD , to build an altar for burnt offering , for meal offering , or for sacrifice , besides the LORD our God's altar that is before his tabernacle ! "

verses.z: 你們這許多日子，總沒有撇離你們的弟兄，直到今日，並守了耶和華－你們上帝所吩咐你們當守的。
verses.e: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day , but have performed the duty of the commandment of the LORD your God .

verses.z: 祭司非尼哈與會中的首領，就是與他同來以色列軍中的統領，聽見呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西人所說的話，就都以為美。
verses.e: When Phinehas the priest , and the princes of the congregation , even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him , heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke , it pleased them well .

verses.z: 祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈對呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西人說：「今日我們知道耶和華在我們中間，因為你們沒有向他犯了這罪。現在你們救以色列人脫離耶和華的手了。」
verses.e: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben , to the children of Gad , and to the children of Manasseh , " Today we know that the LORD is among us , because you have not committed this trespass against the LORD . Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the LORD's hand . "

verses.z: 祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈與眾首領離了呂便人、迦得人，從基列地回往迦南地，到了以色列人那裏，[便將這事]回報他們。
verses.e: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest , and the princes , returned from the children of Reuben , and from the children of Gad , out of the land of Gilead , to the land of Canaan , to the children of Israel , and brought them word again .

verses.z: 以色列人以這事為美，就稱頌上帝，不再提上去攻打呂便人、迦得人、毀壞他們所住的地了。
verses.e: The thing pleased the children of Israel ; and the children of Israel blessed God , and spoke no more of going up against them to war , to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived .

verses.z: 呂便人、迦得人給壇起名叫[證壇]，意思說：這壇在我們中間證明耶和華是上帝。
verses.e: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar " A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God . "

verses.z: 如今耶和華－你們上帝照着他所應許的，使你們弟兄得享平安，現在可以轉回你們的帳棚，到耶和華的僕人摩西在約旦河東所賜你們為業之地。
verses.e: Now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers , as he spoke to them . Therefore now return and go to your tents , to the land of your possession , which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan .

verses.z: 只要切切地謹慎遵行耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐你們的誡命律法，愛耶和華－你們的上帝，行他一切的道，守他的誡命，專靠他，盡心盡性事奉他。」
verses.e: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you , to love the LORD your God , to walk in all his ways , to keep his commandments , to hold fast to him , and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul . "

verses.z: 於是約書亞為他們祝福，打發他們去，他們就回自己的帳棚去了。
verses.e: So Joshua blessed them , and sent them away ; and they went to their tents .

verses.z: 瑪拿西那半支派，摩西早已在巴珊分給他們[地業]。這半支派，約書亞在約旦河西，在他們弟兄中，分給他們[地業]。約書亞打發他們回帳棚的時候為他們祝福，
verses.e: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan ; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward . Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents , he blessed them ,

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們帶許多財物，許多牲畜和金、銀、銅、鐵，並許多衣服，回你們的帳棚去，要將你們從仇敵奪來的物，與你們眾弟兄同分。」
verses.e: and spoke to them , saying , " Return with much wealth to your tents , with very much livestock , with silver , with gold , with bronze , with iron , and with very much clothing . Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers . "

verses.z: 於是呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人從迦南地的示羅起行，離開以色列人，回往他們得為業的基列地，就是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的得了為業之地。
verses.e: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned , and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan , to go to the land of Gilead , to the land of their possession , which they owned , according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華使以色列人安靜，不與四圍的一切仇敵爭戰，已經多日。約書亞年紀老邁，
verses.e: After many days , when the LORD had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around , and Joshua was old and well advanced in years ,

verses.z: 你們一人必追趕千人，因耶和華－你們的上帝照他所應許的，為你們爭戰。
verses.e: One man of you shall chase a thousand ; for it is the LORD your God who fights for you , as he spoke to you .

verses.z: 你們要分外謹慎，愛耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: Take good heed therefore to yourselves , that you love the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你們若稍微轉去，與你們中間所剩下的這些國民聯絡，彼此結親，互相往來，
verses.e: " But if you do at all go back , and hold fast to the remnant of these nations , even these who remain among you , and make marriages with them , and go in to them , and they to you ;

verses.z: 你們要確實知道，耶和華－你們的上帝必不再將他們從你們眼前趕出；他們卻要成為你們的網羅、機檻、肋上的鞭、眼中的刺，直到你們在耶和華－你們上帝所賜的這美地上滅亡。
verses.e: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight ; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you , a scourge in your sides , and thorns in your eyes , until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you .

verses.z: 「我現在要走世人必走的路。你們是一心一意地知道，耶和華－你們上帝所應許賜福與你們的話沒有一句落空，都應驗在你們身上了。
verses.e: " Behold , today I am going the way of all the earth . You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you . All have happened to you . Not one thing has failed of it .

verses.z: 耶和華－你們上帝所應許的一切福氣怎樣臨到你們身上，耶和華也必照樣使各樣禍患臨到你們身上，直到把你們從耶和華－你們上帝所賜的這美地上除滅。
verses.e: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which the LORD your God spoke to you , so the LORD will bring on you all the evil things , until he has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you ,

verses.z: 你們若違背耶和華－你們上帝吩咐你們所守的約，去事奉別神，叩拜他，耶和華的怒氣必向你們發作，使你們在他所賜的美地上速速滅亡。」
verses.e: when you disobey the covenant of the LORD your God , which he commanded you , and go and serve other gods , and bow down yourselves to them . Then the LORD's anger will be kindled against you , and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you . "

verses.z: 就把以色列眾人的長老、族長、審判官，並官長都召了來，對他們說：「我年紀已經老邁。
verses.e: Joshua called for all Israel , for their elders and for their heads , and for their judges and for their officers , and said to them , " I am old and well advanced in years .

verses.z: 耶和華－你們的上帝因你們的緣故向那些國所行的一切事，你們親眼看見了，因那為你們爭戰的是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: You have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you ; for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you .

verses.z: 我所剪除和所剩下的各國，從約旦河起到日落之處的大海，我已經拈鬮分給你們各支派為業。
verses.e: Behold , I have allotted to you these nations that remain , to be an inheritance for your tribes , from the Jordan , with all the nations that I have cut off , even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun .

verses.z: 耶和華－你們的上帝必將他們從你們面前趕出去，使他們離開你們，你們就必得他們的地為業，正如耶和華－你們的上帝所應許的。
verses.e: The LORD your God will thrust them out from before you , and drive them from out of your sight . You shall possess their land , as the LORD your God spoke to you .

verses.z: 所以，你們要大大壯膽，謹守遵行寫在摩西律法書上的一切話，不可偏離左右。
verses.e: " Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses , that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left ;

verses.z: 不可與你們中間所剩下的這些國民攙雜。他們的神，你們不可提他的名，不可指着他起誓，也不可事奉、叩拜；
verses.e: that you not come among these nations , these that remain among you ; neither make mention of the name of their gods , nor cause to swear by them , neither serve them , nor bow down yourselves to them ;

verses.z: 只要照着你們到今日所行的，專靠耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: but hold fast to the LORD your God , as you have done to this day .

verses.z: 因為耶和華已經把又大又強的國民從你們面前趕出；直到今日，沒有一人在你們面前站立得住。
verses.e: " For the LORD has driven great and strong nations out from before you . But as for you , no man has stood before you to this day .

verses.z: 約書亞將以色列的眾支派聚集在示劍，召了以色列的長老、族長、審判官，並官長來，他們就站在上帝面前。
verses.e: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem , and called for the elders of Israel , for their heads , for their judges , and for their officers ; and they presented themselves before God .

verses.z: 我不肯聽巴蘭的話，所以他倒為你們連連祝福。這樣，我便救你們脫離巴勒的手。
verses.e: but I would not listen to Balaam ; therefore he blessed you still . So I delivered you out of his hand .

verses.z: 你們過了約旦河，到了耶利哥；耶利哥人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、迦南人、赫人、革迦撒人、希未人、耶布斯人都與你們爭戰；我把他們交在你們手裏。
verses.e: " ' You went over the Jordan , and came to Jericho . The men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorite , the Perizzite , the Canaanite , the Hittite , the Girgashite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite ; and I delivered them into your hand .

verses.z: 我打發黃蜂飛在你們前面，將亞摩利人的二王從你們面前攆出，並不是用你的刀，也不是用你的弓。
verses.e: I sent the hornet before you , which drove them out from before you , even the two kings of the Amorites ; not with your sword , nor with your bow .

verses.z: 我賜給你們地土，非你們所修治的；我賜給你們城邑，非你們所建造的。你們就住在其中，又得吃非你們所栽種的葡萄園、橄欖園的果子。』
verses.e: I gave you a land on which you had not labored , and cities which you didn't build , and you live in them . You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn't plant . '

verses.z: 「現在你們要敬畏耶和華，誠心實意地事奉他，將你們列祖在大河那邊和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和華。
verses.e: " Now therefore fear the LORD , and serve him in sincerity and in truth . Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River , in Egypt ; and serve the LORD .

verses.z: 若是你們以事奉耶和華為不好，今日就可以選擇所要事奉的：是你們列祖在大河那邊所事奉的神呢？是你們所住這地的亞摩利人的神呢？至於我和我家，我們必定事奉耶和華。」
verses.e: If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD , choose today whom you will serve ; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River , or the gods of the Amorites , in whose land you dwell ; but as for me and my house , we will serve the LORD . "

verses.z: 百姓回答說：「我們斷不敢離棄耶和華去事奉別神；
verses.e: The people answered , " Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD , to serve other gods ;

verses.z: 因耶和華－我們的上帝曾將我們和我們列祖從埃及地的為奴之家領出來，在我們眼前行了那些大神蹟，在我們所行的道上，所經過的諸國，都保護了我們。
verses.e: for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage , and who did those great signs in our sight , and preserved us in all the way in which we went , and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed .

verses.z: 耶和華又把住此地的亞摩利人都從我們面前趕出去。所以，我們必事奉耶和華，因為他是我們的上帝。」
verses.e: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples , even the Amorites who lived in the land . Therefore we also will serve the LORD ; for he is our God . "

verses.z: 約書亞對百姓說：「你們不能事奉耶和華；因為他是聖潔的上帝，是忌邪的上帝，必不赦免你們的過犯罪惡。
verses.e: Joshua said to the people , " You can't serve the LORD , for he is a holy God . He is a jealous God . He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins .

verses.z: 約書亞對眾民說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：『古時你們的列祖，就是亞伯拉罕和拿鶴的父親他拉，住在大河那邊事奉別神，
verses.e: Joshua said to all the people , " The LORD , the God of Israel , says , ' Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River , even Terah , the father of Abraham , and the father of Nahor . They served other gods .

verses.z: 你們若離棄耶和華去事奉外邦神，耶和華在降福之後，必轉而降禍與你們，把你們滅絕。」
verses.e: If you forsake the LORD , and serve foreign gods , then he will turn and do you evil , and consume you , after he has done you good . "

verses.z: 百姓回答約書亞說：「不然，我們定要事奉耶和華。」
verses.e: The people said to Joshua , " No , but we will serve the LORD . "

verses.z: 約書亞對百姓說：「你們選定耶和華，要事奉他，你們自己作見證吧！」他們說：「我們願意作見證。」
verses.e: Joshua said to the people , " You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD yourselves , to serve him . " They said , " We are witnesses . "

verses.z: 約書亞說：「你們現在要除掉你們中間的外邦神，專心歸向耶和華－以色列的上帝。」
verses.e: " Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you , and incline your heart to the LORD , the God of Israel . "

verses.z: 百姓回答約書亞說：「我們必事奉耶和華－我們的上帝，聽從他的話。」
verses.e: The people said to Joshua , " We will serve the LORD our God , and we will listen to his voice . "

verses.z: 當日，約書亞就與百姓立約，在示劍為他們立定律例典章。
verses.e: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day , and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem .

verses.z: 約書亞將這些話都寫在上帝的律法書上，又將一塊大石頭立在橡樹下耶和華的聖所旁邊。
verses.e: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God ; and he took a great stone , and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD .

verses.z: 約書亞對百姓說：「看哪，這石頭可以向我們作見證；因為是聽見了耶和華所吩咐我們的一切話，倘或你們背棄你們的上帝，這石頭就可以向你們作見證。」
verses.e: Joshua said to all the people , " Behold , this stone shall be a witness against us , for it has heard all the LORD's words which he spoke to us . It shall be therefore a witness against you , lest you deny your God . "

verses.z: 於是約書亞打發百姓各歸自己的地業去了。
verses.e: So Joshua sent the people away , each to his own inheritance .

verses.z: 這些事以後，耶和華的僕人嫩的兒子約書亞，正一百一十歲，就死了。
verses.e: After these things , Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the LORD , died , being one hundred ten years old .

verses.z: 我將你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕從大河那邊帶來，領他走遍迦南全地，又使他的子孫眾多，把以撒賜給他；
verses.e: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River , and led him throughout all the land of Canaan , and multiplied his offspring , and gave him Isaac .

verses.z: 以色列人將他葬在他地業的境內，就是在以法蓮山地的亭拿‧西拉，在迦實山的北邊。
verses.e: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah , which is in the hill country of Ephraim , on the north of the mountain of Gaash .

verses.z: 約書亞在世和約書亞死後，那些知道耶和華為以色列人所行諸事的長老還在的時候，以色列人事奉耶和華。
verses.e: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua , and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua , and had known all the work of the LORD , that he had worked for Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人從埃及所帶來約瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示劍，就是在雅各從前用一百塊[銀子]向示劍的父親、哈抹的子孫所買的那塊地裏；這就作了約瑟子孫的產業。
verses.e: They buried the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , in Shechem , in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver . They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph .

verses.z: 亞倫的兒子以利亞撒也死了，就把他葬在他兒子非尼哈所得以法蓮山地的小山上。
verses.e: Eleazar the son of Aaron died . They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son , which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim .

verses.z: 又把雅各和以掃賜給以撒，將西珥山賜給以掃為業；後來雅各和他的子孫下到埃及去了。
verses.e: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau : and I gave to Esau Mount Seir , to possess it . Jacob and his children went down into Egypt .

verses.z: 我差遣摩西、亞倫，並照我在埃及中所行的降災與埃及，然後把你們領出來。
verses.e: " ' I sent Moses and Aaron , and I plagued Egypt , according to that which I did among them : and afterward I brought you out .

verses.z: 我領你們列祖出埃及，他們就到了紅海；埃及人帶領車輛馬兵追趕你們列祖到紅海。
verses.e: I brought your fathers out of Egypt : and you came to the sea . The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea .

verses.z: 你們列祖哀求耶和華，他就使你們和埃及人中間黑暗了，又使海水淹沒埃及人。我在埃及所行的事，你們親眼見過。你們在曠野也住了許多年日。
verses.e: When they cried out to the LORD , he put darkness between you and the Egyptians , and brought the sea on them , and covered them ; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt . You lived in the wilderness many days .

verses.z: 我領你們到約旦河東亞摩利人所住之地。他們與你們爭戰，我將他們交在你們手中，你們便得了他們的地為業；我也在你們面前將他們滅絕。
verses.e: " ' I brought you into the land of the Amorites , that lived beyond the Jordan . They fought with you , and I gave them into your hand . You possessed their land , and I destroyed them from before you .

verses.z: 那時，摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒起來攻擊以色列人，打發人召了比珥的兒子巴蘭來咒詛你們。
verses.e: Then Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , arose and fought against Israel . He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you ,

verses.z: 約書亞清早起來，和以色列眾人都離開什亭，來到約旦河，就住在那裏，等候過河。
verses.e: Joshua got up early in the morning ; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan , he and all the children of Israel . They camped there before they crossed over .

verses.z: 約書亞說：「看哪，普天下主的約櫃必在你們前頭過去，到約旦河裏，因此你們就知道在你們中間有永生上帝；並且他必在你們面前趕出迦南人、赫人、希未人、比利洗人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、耶布斯人。
verses.e: Joshua said , " By this you shall know that the living God is among you , and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite , the Hittite , the Hivite , the Perizzite , the Girgashite , the Amorite , and the Jebusite out from before you .
Behold , the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan .

verses.z: 你們現在要從以色列支派中揀選十二個人，每支派一人，
verses.e: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel , for every tribe a man .

verses.z: 等到抬普天下主耶和華[約]櫃的祭司把腳站在約旦河水裏，約旦河的水，就是從上往下流的水，必然斷絕，立起成壘。」
verses.e: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of GOD , the Lord of all the earth , rest in the waters of the Jordan , that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off . The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap . "

verses.z: 百姓離開帳棚要過約旦河的時候，抬約櫃的祭司乃在百姓的前頭。
verses.e: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan , the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people ,

verses.z: 他們到了約旦河，腳一入水（原來約旦河水在收割的日子漲過兩岸），
verses.e: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan , and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water ( for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest ) ,

verses.z: 那從上往下流的水便在極遠之地、撒拉但旁的亞當城那裏停住，立起成壘；那往亞拉巴的海，就是鹽海，下流的水全然斷絕。於是百姓在耶利哥的對面過去了。
verses.e: the waters which came down from above stood , and rose up in one heap a great way off , at Adam , the city that is beside Zarethan ; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah , even the Salt Sea , were wholly cut off . Then the people passed over near Jericho .

verses.z: 抬耶和華約櫃的祭司在約旦河中的乾地上站定，以色列眾人都從乾地上過去，直到國民盡都過了約旦河。
verses.e: The priests who bore the ark of the LORD's covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan ; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground , until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan .

verses.z: 過了三天，官長走遍營中，
verses.e: After three days , the officers went through the middle of the camp ;

verses.z: 吩咐百姓說：「你們看見耶和華－你們上帝的約櫃，又見祭司利未人抬着，就要離開所住的地方，跟着約櫃去。
verses.e: and they commanded the people , saying , " When you see the ark of the LORD your God's covenant , and the Levitical priests bearing it , then leave your place and follow it .

verses.z: 只是你們和約櫃相離要量二千肘，不可與約櫃相近，使你們知道所當走的路，因為這條路你們向來沒有走過。」
verses.e: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure — don't come closer to it — that you may know the way by which you must go ; for you have not passed this way before . "

verses.z: 約書亞吩咐百姓說：「你們要自潔，因為明天耶和華必在你們中間行奇事。」
verses.e: Joshua said to the people , " Sanctify yourselves ; for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you . "

verses.z: 約書亞又吩咐祭司說：「你們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭過去。」於是他們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭走。
verses.e: Joshua spoke to the priests , saying , " Take up the ark of the covenant , and cross over before the people . " They took up the ark of the covenant , and went before the people .

verses.z: 耶和華對約書亞說：「從今日起，我必使你在以色列眾人眼前尊大，使他們知道我怎樣與摩西同在，也必照樣與你同在。
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that as I was with Moses , so I will be with you .

verses.z: 你要吩咐抬約櫃的祭司說：『你們到了約旦河的水邊上，就要在約旦河水裏站住。』」
verses.e: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant , saying , ' When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan , you shall stand still in the Jordan . ' "

verses.z: 約書亞對以色列人說：「你們近前來，聽耶和華－你們上帝的話。」
verses.e: Joshua said to the children of Israel , " Come here , and hear the words of the LORD your God . "

verses.z: 國民盡都過了約旦河，耶和華就對約書亞說：
verses.e: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan , the LORD spoke to Joshua , saying ,

verses.z: 抬[約]櫃的祭司站在約旦河中，等到耶和華曉諭約書亞吩咐百姓的事辦完了，是照摩西所吩咐約書亞的一切話。於是百姓急速過去了。
verses.e: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak to the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua ; and the people hurried and passed over .

verses.z: 眾百姓盡都過了河，耶和華的[約]櫃和祭司就在百姓面前過去。
verses.e: When all the people had completely crossed over , the LORD's ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people .

verses.z: 呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人都照摩西所吩咐他們的，帶着兵器在以色列人前頭過去。
verses.e: The children of Reuben , and the children of Gad , and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel , as Moses spoke to them .

verses.z: 約有四萬人都準備打仗，在耶和華面前過去，到耶利哥的平原，等候上陣。
verses.e: About forty thousand men , ready and armed for war , passed over before the LORD to battle , to the plains of Jericho .

verses.z: 當那日，耶和華使約書亞在以色列眾人眼前尊大。在他平生的日子，百姓敬畏他，像從前敬畏摩西一樣。
verses.e: On that day , the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Joshua , saying ,

verses.z: 「你吩咐抬法櫃的祭司從約旦河裏上來。」
verses.e: " Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant , that they come up out of the Jordan . "

verses.z: 約書亞就吩咐祭司說：「你們從約旦河裏上來。」
verses.e: Joshua therefore commanded the priests , saying , " Come up out of the Jordan ! "

verses.z: 抬耶和華約櫃的祭司從約旦河裏上來，腳掌剛落旱地，約旦河的水就流到原處，仍舊漲過兩岸。
verses.e: When the priests who bore the ark of the LORD's covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan , and the soles of the priests ' feet had been lifted up to the dry ground , the waters of the Jordan returned to their place , and went over all its banks , as before .

verses.z: 正月初十日，百姓從約旦河裏上來，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的東邊安營。
verses.e: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month , and encamped in Gilgal , on the east border of Jericho .

verses.z: 「你從民中要揀選十二個人，每支派一人，
verses.e: " Take twelve men out of the people , a man out of every tribe ,

verses.z: 他們從約旦河中取來的那十二塊石頭，約書亞就立在吉甲，
verses.e: Joshua set up those twelve stones , which they took out of the Jordan , in Gilgal .

verses.z: 對以色列人說：「日後你們的子孫問他們的父親說：『這些石頭是甚麼意思？』
verses.e: He spoke to the children of Israel , saying , " When your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , ' What do these stones mean ? '

verses.z: 你們就告訴他們說：『以色列人曾走乾地過這約旦河；
verses.e: Then you shall let your children know , saying , ' Israel came over this Jordan on dry land .

verses.z: 因為耶和華－你們的上帝在你們前面使約旦河的水乾了，等着你們過來，就如耶和華－你們的上帝從前在我們前面使紅海乾了，等着我們過來一樣，
verses.e: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over , as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea , which he dried up from before us , until we had crossed over ,

verses.z: 要使地上萬民都知道，耶和華的手大有能力，也要使你們永遠敬畏耶和華－你們的上帝。』」
verses.e: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD's hand is mighty , and that you may fear the LORD your God forever . ' "

verses.z: 吩咐他們說：『你們從這裏，從約旦河中、祭司腳站定的地方，取十二塊石頭帶過去，放在你們今夜要住宿的地方。』」
verses.e: and command them , saying , ' Take from out of the middle of the Jordan , out of the place where the priests ' feet stood firm , twelve stones , carry them over with you , and lay them down in the place where you'll camp tonight . ' "

verses.z: 於是，約書亞將他從以色列人中所預備的那十二個人，每支派一人，都召了來。
verses.e: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel , a man out of every tribe .

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們下約旦河中，過到耶和華－你們上帝的約櫃前頭，按着以色列人十二支派的數目，每人取一塊石頭扛在肩上。
verses.e: Joshua said to them , " Cross before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan , and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel ;

verses.z: 這些石頭在你們中間可以作為證據。日後，你們的子孫問你們說：『這些石頭是甚麼意思？』
verses.e: that this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask in the future , saying , ' What do you mean by these stones ? '

verses.z: 你們就對他們說：『這是因為約旦河的水在耶和華的約櫃前斷絕；約櫃過約旦河的時候，約旦河的水就斷絕了。這些石頭要作以色列人永遠的紀念。』」
verses.e: then you shall tell them , ' Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the LORD's covenant . When it crossed over the Jordan , the waters of the Jordan were cut off . These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever . ' "

verses.z: 以色列人就照約書亞所吩咐的，按着以色列人支派的數目，從約旦河中取了十二塊石頭，都遵耶和華所吩咐約書亞的行了。他們把石頭帶過去，到他們所住宿的地方，就放在那裏。
verses.e: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan , as the LORD spoke to Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel . They carried them over with them to the place where they camped , and laid them down there .

verses.z: 約書亞另把十二塊石頭立在約旦河中，在抬約櫃的祭司腳站立的地方；直到今日，那石頭還在那裏。
verses.e: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan , in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood ; and they are there to this day .

verses.z: 約旦河西亞摩利人的諸王和靠海迦南人的諸王，聽見耶和華在以色列人前面使約旦河的水乾了，等到我們過去，他們的心因以色列人的緣故就消化了，不再有膽氣。
verses.e: When all the kings of the Amorites , who were beyond the Jordan westward , and all the kings of the Canaanites , who were by the sea , heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over , their heart melted , and there was no more spirit in them , because of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人在吉甲安營。正月十四日晚上，在耶利哥的平原守逾越節。
verses.e: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal . They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho .

verses.z: 逾越節的次日，他們就吃了那地的出產；正當那日吃無酵餅和烘的穀。
verses.e: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover , in the same day .

verses.z: 他們吃了那地的出產，第二日嗎哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有嗎哪了。那一年，他們卻吃迦南地的出產。
verses.e: The manna ceased on the next day , after they had eaten of the produce of the land . The children of Israel didn't have manna any more , but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year .

verses.z: 約書亞靠近耶利哥的時候，舉目觀看，不料，有一個人手裏有拔出來的刀，對面站立。約書亞到他那裏，問他說：「你是幫助我們呢，是幫助我們敵人呢？」
verses.e: When Joshua was by Jericho , he lifted up his eyes and looked , and behold , a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand . Joshua went to him and said to him , " Are you for us , or for our enemies ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「不是的，我來是要作耶和華軍隊的元帥。」約書亞就俯伏在地下拜，說：「我主有甚麼話吩咐僕人。」
verses.e: He said , " No ; but I have come now as commander of the LORD's army . " Joshua fell on his face to the earth , and worshiped , and asked him , " What does my lord say to his servant ? "

verses.z: 耶和華軍隊的元帥對約書亞說：「把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站的地方是聖的。」約書亞就照着行了。
verses.e: The prince of the LORD's army said to Joshua , " Take off your sandals , for the place on which you stand is holy . " Joshua did so .

verses.z: 那時，耶和華吩咐約書亞說：「你製造火石刀，第二次給以色列人行割禮。」
verses.e: At that time , the LORD said to Joshua , " Make flint knives , and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time . "

verses.z: 約書亞就製造了火石刀，在「除皮山」那裏給以色列人行割禮。
verses.e: Joshua made himself flint knives , and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins .

verses.z: 約書亞行割禮的緣故，是因為從埃及出來的眾民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以後，都死在曠野的路上。
verses.e: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them : all the people who came out of Egypt , who were males , even all the men of war , died in the wilderness along the way , after they came out of Egypt .

verses.z: 因為出來的眾民都受過割禮；惟獨出埃及以後、在曠野的路上所生的眾民都沒有受過割禮。
verses.e: For all the people who came out were circumcised ; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised .

verses.z: 以色列人在曠野走了四十年，等到國民，就是出埃及的兵丁，都消滅了，因為他們沒有聽從耶和華的話。耶和華曾向他們起誓，必不容他們看見耶和華向他們列祖起誓、應許賜給我們的地，就是流奶與蜜之地。
verses.e: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation , even the men of war who came out of Egypt , were consumed , because they didn't listen to the LORD's voice . The LORD swore to them that he wouldn't let them see the land which the LORD swore to their fathers that he would give us , a land flowing with milk and honey .

verses.z: 他們的子孫，就是耶和華所興起來接續他們的，都沒有受過割禮；因為在路上沒有給他們行割禮，約書亞這才給他們行了。
verses.e: Their children , whom he raised up in their place , were circumcised by Joshua , for they were uncircumcised , because they had not circumcised them on the way .

verses.z: 國民都受完了割禮，就住在營中自己的地方，等到痊癒了。
verses.e: When they were done circumcising the whole nation , they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed .
