verses.z: 耶和華對約書亞說：「我今日將埃及的羞辱從你們身上滾去了。」因此，那地方名叫吉甲，直到今日。
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you . " Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day .

verses.z: 耶利哥的城門因以色列人就關得嚴緊，無人出入。
verses.e: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel . No one went out , and no one came in .

verses.z: 約書亞吩咐百姓說：「你們不可呼喊，不可出聲，連一句話也不可出你們的口，等到我吩咐你們呼喊的日子，那時才可以呼喊。」
verses.e: Joshua commanded the people , saying , " You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard , neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout . Then you shall shout . "

verses.z: 這樣，他使耶和華的[約]櫃繞城，把城繞了一次；眾人回到營裏，就在營裏住宿。
verses.e: So he caused the LORD's ark to go around the city , circling it once . Then they came into the camp , and stayed in the camp .

verses.z: 約書亞清早起來，祭司又抬起耶和華的[約]櫃。
verses.e: Joshua rose early in the morning , and the priests took up the LORD's ark .

verses.z: 七個祭司拿七個羊角在耶和華的[約]櫃前，時常行走吹角；帶兵器的在他們前面走，後隊隨着耶和華的[約]櫃行。[祭司]一面走一面吹。
verses.e: The seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams ' horns in front of the LORD's ark went on continually , and blew the trumpets . The armed men went in front of them . The rear guard came after the LORD's ark . The trumpets sounded as they went .

verses.z: 第二日，眾人把城繞了一次，就回營裏去。六日都是這樣行。
verses.e: The second day they marched around the city once , and returned into the camp . They did this six days .

verses.z: 第七日清早，黎明的時候，他們起來，照樣繞城七次；惟獨這日把城繞了七次。
verses.e: On the seventh day , they rose early at the dawning of the day , and marched around the city in the same way seven times . On this day only they marched around the city seven times .

verses.z: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的時候，約書亞吩咐百姓說：「呼喊吧，因為耶和華已經把城交給你們了！
verses.e: At the seventh time , when the priests blew the trumpets , Joshua said to the people , " Shout , for the LORD has given you the city !

verses.z: 這城和其中所有的都要在耶和華面前毀滅；只有妓女喇合與她家中所有的可以存活，因為她隱藏了我們所打發的使者。
verses.e: The city shall be devoted , even it and all that is in it , to the LORD . Only Rahab the prostitute shall live , she and all who are with her in the house , because she hid the messengers that we sent .

verses.z: 至於你們，務要謹慎，不可取那當滅的物，恐怕你們取了那當滅的物就連累以色列的全營，使全營受咒詛。
verses.e: But as for you , only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction , lest when you have devoted it , you take of the devoted thing ; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it .

verses.z: 惟有金子、銀子，和銅鐵的器皿都要歸耶和華為聖，必入耶和華的庫中。」
verses.e: But all the silver , gold , and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD . They shall come into the LORD's treasury . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：「看哪，我已經把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，並大能的勇士，都交在你手中。
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Behold , I have given Jericho into your hand , with its king and the mighty men of valor .

verses.z: 於是百姓呼喊，[祭司]也吹角。百姓聽見角聲，便大聲呼喊，城牆就塌陷，百姓便上去進城，各人往前直上，將城奪取；
verses.e: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets . When the people heard the sound of the trumpet , the people shouted with a great shout , and the wall fell down flat , so that the people went up into the city , every man straight in front of him , and they took the city .

verses.z: 又將城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驢，都用刀殺盡。
verses.e: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city , both man and woman , both young and old , and ox , sheep , and donkey , with the edge of the sword .

verses.z: 約書亞吩咐窺探地的兩個人說：「你們進那妓女的家，照着你們向她所起的誓，將那女人和她所有的都從那裏帶出來。」
verses.e: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land , " Go into the prostitute's house , and bring the woman and all that she has out from there , as you swore to her . "

verses.z: 當探子的兩個少年人就進去，將喇合與她的父母、弟兄，和她所有的，並她一切的親眷，都帶出來，安置在以色列的營外。
verses.e: The young men who were spies went in , and brought out Rahab with her father , her mother , her brothers , and all that she had . They also brought out all of her relatives , and they set them outside of the camp of Israel .

verses.z: 眾人就用火將城和其中所有的焚燒了；惟有金子、銀子，和銅鐵的器皿都放在耶和華殿的庫中。
verses.e: They burned the city with fire , and all that was in it . Only they put the silver , the gold , and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 約書亞卻把妓女喇合與她父家，並她所有的，都救活了；因為她隱藏了約書亞所打發窺探耶利哥的使者，她就住在以色列中，直到今日。
verses.e: But Rahab the prostitute , her father's household , and all that she had , Joshua saved alive . She lives in the middle of Israel to this day , because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho .

verses.z: 當時，約書亞叫眾人起誓說：「有興起重修這耶利哥城的人，當在耶和華面前受咒詛。他立根基的時候，必喪長子，安門的時候，必喪幼子。」
verses.e: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time , saying , " Cursed is the man before the LORD who rises up and builds this city Jericho . With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation , and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates . "

verses.z: 耶和華與約書亞同在，約書亞的聲名傳揚遍地。
verses.e: So the LORD was with Joshua ; and his fame was in all the land .

verses.z: 你們的一切兵丁要圍繞這城，[一日]圍繞一次，六日都要這樣行。
verses.e: All of your men of war shall march around the city , going around the city once . You shall do this six days .

verses.z: 七個祭司要拿七個羊角走在[約]櫃前。到第七日，你們要繞城七次，祭司也要吹角。
verses.e: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams ' horns before the ark . On the seventh day , you shall march around the city seven times , and the priests shall blow the trumpets .

verses.z: 他們吹的角聲拖長，你們聽見角聲，眾百姓要大聲呼喊，城牆就必塌陷，各人都要往前直上。」
verses.e: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn , and when you hear the sound of the trumpet , all the people shall shout with a great shout ; then the city wall will fall down flat , and the people shall go up , every man straight in front of him . "

verses.z: 嫩的兒子約書亞召了祭司來，吩咐他們說：「你們抬起約櫃來，要有七個祭司拿七個羊角走在耶和華的[約]櫃前」；
verses.e: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests , and said to them , " Take up the ark of the covenant , and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams ' horns before the LORD's ark . "

verses.z: 又對百姓說：「你們前去繞城，帶兵器的要走在耶和華的[約]櫃前。」
verses.e: They said to the people , " Advance ! March around the city , and let the armed men pass on before the LORD's ark . "

verses.z: 約書亞對百姓說完了話，七個祭司拿七個羊角走在耶和華面前吹角；耶和華的約櫃在他們後面跟隨。
verses.e: It was so , that when Joshua had spoken to the people , the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams ' horns before the LORD advanced and blew the trumpets , and the ark of the LORD's covenant followed them .

verses.z: 帶兵器的走在吹角的祭司前面，後隊隨着[約]櫃行。[祭司]一面走一面吹。
verses.e: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets , and the ark went after them . The trumpets sounded as they went .

verses.z: 以色列人在當滅的物上犯了罪；因為猶大支派中，謝拉的曾孫，撒底的孫子，迦米的兒子亞干取了當滅的物；耶和華的怒氣就向以色列人發作。
verses.e: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things ; for Achan , the son of Carmi , the son of Zabdi , the son of Zerah , of the tribe of Judah , took some of the devoted things . Therefore the LORD's anger burned against the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐約書亞說：「起來！你為何這樣俯伏在地呢？
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Get up ! Why have you fallen on your face like that ?

verses.z: 以色列人犯了罪，違背了我所吩咐他們的約，取了當滅的物；又偷竊，又行詭詐，又把那當滅的放在他們的家具裏。
verses.e: Israel has sinned . Yes , they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them . Yes , they have even taken some of the devoted things , and have also stolen , and also deceived . They have even put it among their own stuff .

verses.z: 因此，以色列人在仇敵面前站立不住。他們在仇敵面前轉背[逃跑]，是因成了被咒詛的；你們若不把當滅的物從你們中間除掉，我就不再與你們同在了。
verses.e: Therefore the children of Israel can't stand before their enemies . They turn their backs before their enemies , because they have become devoted for destruction . I will not be with you any more , unless you destroy the devoted things from among you .

verses.z: 你起來，叫百姓自潔，對他們說：『你們要自潔，預備明天，因為耶和華－以色列的上帝這樣說：以色列啊，你們中間有當滅的物，你們若不除掉，在仇敵面前必站立不住！』
verses.e: Get up ! Sanctify the people , and say , ' Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow , for the LORD , the God of Israel , says , " There is a devoted thing among you , Israel . You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted thing from among you . "

verses.z: 到了早晨，你們要按着支派近前來；耶和華所取的支派，要按着宗族近前來；耶和華所取的宗族，要按着家室近前來；耶和華所取的家室，要按着人丁，一個一個地近前來。
verses.e: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes . It shall be that the tribe which the LORD selects shall come near by families . The family which the LORD selects shall come near by households . The household which the LORD selects shall come near man by man .

verses.z: 被取的人有當滅的物在他那裏，他和他所有的必被火焚燒；因他違背了耶和華的約，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。」
verses.e: It shall be , that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire , he and all that he has , because he has transgressed the LORD's covenant , and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel . ' "

verses.z: 於是，約書亞清早起來，使以色列人按着支派近前來，取出來的是猶大支派；
verses.e: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes . The tribe of Judah was selected .

verses.z: 使猶大支派近前來，就取了謝拉的宗族；使謝拉的宗族，按着[家室]人丁，一個一個地近前來，取出來的是撒底；
verses.e: He brought near the family of Judah , and he selected the family of the Zerahites . He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man , and Zabdi was selected .

verses.z: 使撒底的家室，按着人丁，一個一個地近前來，就取出猶大支派的人謝拉的曾孫，撒底的孫子，迦米的兒子亞干。
verses.e: He brought near his household man by man , and Achan , the son of Carmi , the son of Zabdi , the son of Zerah , of the tribe of Judah , was selected .

verses.z: 約書亞對亞干說：「我兒，我勸你將榮耀歸給耶和華－以色列的上帝，在他面前認罪，將你所做的事告訴我，不要向我隱瞞。」
verses.e: Joshua said to Achan , " My son , please give glory to the LORD , the God of Israel , and make confession to him . Tell me now what you have done ! Don't hide it from me ! "

verses.z: 當下，約書亞從耶利哥打發人往伯特利東邊、靠近伯‧亞文的艾城去，吩咐他們說：「你們上去窺探那地。」他們就上去窺探艾城。
verses.e: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai , which is beside Beth Aven , on the east side of Bethel , and spoke to them , saying , " Go up and spy out the land . " The men went up and spied out Ai .

verses.z: 亞干回答約書亞說：「我實在得罪了耶和華－以色列的上帝。我所做的事如此如此：
verses.e: Achan answered Joshua , and said , " I have truly sinned against the LORD , the God of Israel , and this is what I have done .

verses.z: 我在所奪的財物中看見一件美好的示拿衣服，二百舍客勒銀子，一條金子重五十舍客勒，我就貪愛這些物件，便拿去了。現今藏在我帳棚內的地裏，銀子在衣服底下。」
verses.e: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe , two hundred shekels of silver , and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels , then I coveted them and took them . Behold , they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent , with the silver under it . "

verses.z: 約書亞就打發人跑到亞干的帳棚裏。那件衣服果然藏在他帳棚內，銀子在底下。
verses.e: So Joshua sent messengers , and they ran to the tent . Behold , it was hidden in his tent , with the silver under it .

verses.z: 他們就從帳棚裏取出來，拿到約書亞和以色列眾人那裏，放在耶和華面前。
verses.e: They took them from the middle of the tent , and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel . They laid them down before the LORD .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人把謝拉的曾孫亞干和那銀子、那件衣服、那條金子，並亞干的兒女、牛、驢、羊、帳棚，以及他所有的，都帶到亞割谷去。
verses.e: Joshua , and all Israel with him , took Achan the son of Zerah , the silver , the robe , the wedge of gold , his sons , his daughters , his cattle , his donkeys , his sheep , his tent , and all that he had ; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor .

verses.z: 約書亞說：「你為甚麼連累我們呢？今日耶和華必叫你受連累。」於是以色列眾人用石頭打死他，將石頭扔在其上，又用火焚燒他所有的。
verses.e: Joshua said , " Why have you troubled us ? The LORD will trouble you today . " All Israel stoned him with stones , and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones .

verses.z: 眾人在亞干身上堆成一大堆石頭，直存到今日。於是耶和華轉意，不發他的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亞割谷，直到今日。
verses.e: They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day . The LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger . Therefore the name of that place was called " The valley of Achor " to this day .

verses.z: 他們回到約書亞那裏，對他說：「眾民不必都上去，只要二三千人上去就能攻取艾城；不必勞累眾民都去，因為那裏的人少。」
verses.e: They returned to Joshua , and said to him , " Don't let all the people go up , but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai . Don't make all the people to toil there , for there are only a few of them . "

verses.z: 於是民中約有三千人上那裏去，竟在艾城人面前逃跑了。
verses.e: So about three thousand men of the people went up there , and they fled before the men of Ai .

verses.z: 艾城的人擊殺了他們三十六人，從城門前追趕他們，直到示巴琳，在下坡殺敗他們；眾民的心就消化如水。
verses.e: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them . They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim , and struck them at the descent . The hearts of the people melted , and became like water .

verses.z: 約書亞便撕裂衣服；他和以色列的長老把灰撒在頭上，在耶和華的[約]櫃前俯伏在地，直到晚上。
verses.e: Joshua tore his clothes , and fell to the earth on his face before the LORD's ark until the evening , he and the elders of Israel ; and they put dust on their heads .

verses.z: 約書亞說：「哀哉！主耶和華啊，你為甚麼竟領這百姓過約旦河，將我們交在亞摩利人的手中，使我們滅亡呢？我們不如住在約旦河那邊倒好。
verses.e: Joshua said , " Alas , Lord GOD , why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all , to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites , to cause us to perish ? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan !

verses.z: 主啊，以色列人既在仇敵面前轉背[逃跑]，我還有甚麼可說的呢？
verses.e: Oh , Lord , what shall I say , after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies ?

verses.z: 迦南人和這地一切的居民聽見了就必圍困我們，將我們的名從地上除滅。那時你為你的大名要怎樣行呢？」
verses.e: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it , and will surround us , and cut off our name from the earth . What will you do for your great name ? "

verses.z: 耶和華對約書亞說：「不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。你起來，率領一切兵丁上艾城去，我已經把艾城的王和他的民、他的城，並他的地，都交在你手裏。
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Don't be afraid , and don't be dismayed . Take all the warriors with you , and arise , go up to Ai . Behold , I have given into your hand the king of Ai , with his people , his city , and his land .

verses.z: 約書亞清早起來，點齊百姓，他和以色列的長老在百姓前面上艾城去。
verses.e: Joshua rose up early in the morning , mustered the people , and went up , he and the elders of Israel , before the people to Ai .

verses.z: 眾民，就是他所帶領的兵丁，都上去，向前直往，來到城前，在艾城北邊安營。在約書亞和艾城中間有一山谷。
verses.e: All the people , even the men of war who were with him , went up and came near , and came before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai . Now there was a valley between him and Ai .

verses.z: 他挑了約有五千人，使他們埋伏在伯特利和艾城的中間，就是在艾城的西邊，
verses.e: He took about five thousand men , and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai , on the west side of the city .

verses.z: 於是安置了百姓，就是城北的全軍和城西的伏兵。這夜約書亞進入山谷之中。
verses.e: So they set the people , even all the army who was on the north of the city , and their ambush on the west of the city ; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley .

verses.z: 艾城的王看見[這景況]，就和全城的人，清早急忙起來，按所定的時候，出到亞拉巴前，要與以色列人交戰；王卻不知道在城後有伏兵。
verses.e: When the king of Ai saw it , they hurried and rose up early , and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle , he and all his people , at the time appointed , before the Arabah ; but he didn't know that there was an ambush against him behind the city .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人在他們面前裝敗，往那通曠野的路逃跑。
verses.e: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them , and fled by the way of the wilderness .

verses.z: 城內的眾民都被招聚，追趕他們；艾城人追趕的時候，就被引誘離開城。
verses.e: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them . They pursued Joshua , and were drawn away from the city .

verses.z: 艾城和伯特利城沒有一人不出來追趕以色列人的，撇了敞開的城門，去追趕以色列人。
verses.e: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn't go out after Israel . They left the city open , and pursued Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐約書亞說：「你向艾城伸出手裏的短槍，因為我要將城交在你手裏。」約書亞就向城伸出手裏的短槍。
verses.e: The LORD said to Joshua , " Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai , for I will give it into your hand . " Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city .

verses.z: 他一伸手，伏兵就從埋伏的地方急忙起來，奪了城，跑進城去，放火焚燒。
verses.e: The ambush arose quickly out of their place , and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it . They hurried and set the city on fire .

verses.z: 你怎樣待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也當照樣待艾城和艾城的王。只是城內所奪的財物和牲畜，你們可以取為自己的掠物。你要在城後設下伏兵。」
verses.e: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king , except you shall take its goods and its livestock for yourselves . Set an ambush for the city behind it . "

verses.z: 艾城的人回頭一看，不料，城中煙氣沖天，他們就無力向左向右逃跑。那往曠野逃跑的百姓便轉身攻擊追趕他們的人。
verses.e: When the men of Ai looked behind them , they saw , and behold , the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven , and they had no power to flee this way or that way . The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers .

verses.z: 約書亞和以色列眾人見伏兵已經奪了城，城中煙氣飛騰，就轉身回去，擊殺艾城的人。
verses.e: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city , and that the smoke of the city ascended , then they turned back and killed the men of Ai .

verses.z: 伏兵也出城迎擊艾城人，艾城人就困在以色列人中間，前後都是以色列人。於是以色列人擊殺他們，沒有留下一個，也沒有一個逃脫的，
verses.e: The others came out of the city against them , so they were in the middle of Israel , some on this side , and some on that side . They struck them , so that they let none of them remain or escape .

verses.z: 生擒了艾城的王，將他解到約書亞那裏。
verses.e: They captured the king of Ai alive , and brought him to Joshua .

verses.z: 以色列人在田間和曠野殺盡所追趕一切艾城的居民。艾城人倒在刀下，直到滅盡；以色列眾人就回到艾城，用刀殺了城中的人。
verses.e: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field , in the wilderness in which they pursued them , and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed , all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword .

verses.z: 當日殺斃的人，連男帶女共有一萬二千，就是艾城所有的人。
verses.e: All that fell that day , both of men and women , were twelve thousand , even all the people of Ai .

verses.z: 約書亞沒有收回手裏所伸出來的短槍，直到把艾城的一切居民盡行殺滅。
verses.e: For Joshua didn't draw back his hand , with which he stretched out the javelin , until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai .

verses.z: 惟獨城中的牲畜和財物，以色列人都取為自己的掠物，是照耶和華所吩咐約書亞的話。
verses.e: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city , according to the LORD's word which he commanded Joshua .

verses.z: 約書亞將艾城焚燒，使城永為高堆、荒場，直到今日；
verses.e: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever , even a desolation , to this day .

verses.z: 又將艾城王掛在樹上，直到晚上。日落的時候，約書亞吩咐人把屍首從樹上取下來，丟在城門口，在屍首上堆成一大堆石頭，直存到今日。
verses.e: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening . At sundown , Joshua commanded , and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city , and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day .

verses.z: 於是，約書亞和一切兵丁都起來，要上艾城去。約書亞選了三萬大能的勇士，夜間打發他們前往，
verses.e: So Joshua arose , with all the warriors , to go up to Ai . Joshua chose thirty thousand men , the mighty men of valor , and sent them out by night .

verses.z: 那時，約書亞在以巴路山上為耶和華－以色列的上帝築一座壇，
verses.e: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD , the God of Israel , on Mount Ebal ,

verses.z: 是用沒有動過鐵器的整石頭築的，照着耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐以色列人的話，正如摩西律法書上所寫的。眾人在這壇上給耶和華奉獻燔祭和平安祭。
verses.e: as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel , as it is written in the book of the law of Moses : an altar of uncut stones , on which no one had lifted up any iron . They offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD and sacrificed peace offerings .

verses.z: 約書亞在那裏，當着以色列人面前，將摩西所寫的律法抄寫在石頭上。
verses.e: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses ' law , which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 以色列眾人，無論是本地人、是寄居的，和長老、官長，並審判官，都站在[約]櫃兩旁，在抬耶和華約櫃的祭司利未人面前，一半對着基利心山，一半對着以巴路山，為以色列民祝福，正如耶和華僕人摩西先前所吩咐的。
verses.e: All Israel , with their elders , officers , and judges , stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests , who carried the ark of the LORD's covenant , the foreigner as well as the native ; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim , and half of them in front of Mount Ebal , as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded at the first , that they should bless the people of Israel .

verses.z: 隨後，約書亞將律法上祝福、咒詛的話，照着律法書上一切所寫的，都宣讀了一遍。
verses.e: Afterward he read all the words of the law , the blessing and the curse , according to all that is written in the book of the law .

verses.z: 摩西所吩咐的一切話，約書亞在以色列全會眾和婦女、孩子，並他們中間寄居的外人面前，沒有一句不宣讀的。
verses.e: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn't read before all the assembly of Israel , with the women , the little ones , and the foreigners who were among them .

verses.z: 吩咐他們說：「你們要在城後埋伏，不可離城太遠，都要各自準備。
verses.e: He commanded them , saying , " Behold , you shall lie in ambush against the city , behind the city . Don't go very far from the city , but all of you be ready .

verses.z: 我與我所帶領的眾民要向城前往。城裏的人像初次出來攻擊我們的時候，我們就在他們面前逃跑，
verses.e: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city . It shall happen , when they come out against us , as at the first , that we will flee before them .

verses.z: 他們必出來追趕我們，直到我們引誘他們離開城；因為他們必說：『這些人像初次在我們面前逃跑。』所以我們要在他們面前逃跑，
verses.e: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city ; for they will say , ' They flee before us , like the first time . ' So we will flee before them ,

verses.z: 你們就從埋伏的地方起來，奪取那城，因為耶和華－你們的上帝必把城交在你們手裏。
verses.e: and you shall rise up from the ambush , and take possession of the city ; for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand .

verses.z: 你們奪了城以後，就放火燒城，要照耶和華的話行。這是我吩咐你們的。」
verses.e: It shall be , when you have seized the city , that you shall set the city on fire . You shall do this according to the LORD's word . Behold , I have commanded you . "

verses.z: 約書亞打發他們前往，他們就上埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中間，就是在艾城的西邊。這夜約書亞卻在民中住宿。
verses.e: Joshua sent them out ; and they went to set up the ambush , and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai ; but Joshua stayed among the people that night .

verses.z: 約旦河西，住山地、高原，並對着黎巴嫩[山]沿大海一帶的諸王，就是赫人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的諸王，聽見這事，
verses.e: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan , in the hill country , and in the lowland , and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon , the Hittite , the Amorite , the Canaanite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite , heard of it

verses.z: 並他向約旦河東的兩個亞摩利王，就是希實本王西宏和在亞斯他錄的巴珊王噩一切所行的事。
verses.e: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan , to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan , who was at Ashtaroth .

verses.z: 我們的長老和我們那地的一切居民對我們說：『你們手裏要帶着路上用的食物去迎接以色列人，對他們說：我們是你們的僕人；現在求你們與我們立約。』
verses.e: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us , saying , ' Take supplies in your hand for the journey , and go to meet them . Tell them , " We are your servants . Now make a covenant with us . " '

verses.z: 我們出來要往你們這裏來的日子，從家裏帶出來的這餅還是熱的；看哪，現在都乾了，長了霉了。
verses.e: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you ; but now , behold , it is dry , and has become moldy .

verses.z: 這皮酒袋，我們盛酒的時候還是新的；看哪，現在已經破裂。我們這衣服和鞋，因為道路甚遠，也都穿舊了。」
verses.e: These wineskins , which we filled , were new ; and behold , they are torn . These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey . "

verses.z: 以色列人受了他們些食物，並沒有求問耶和華。
verses.e: The men sampled their provisions , and didn't ask counsel from the LORD's mouth .

verses.z: 於是約書亞與他們講和，與他們立約，容他們活着；會眾的首領也向他們起誓。
verses.e: Joshua made peace with them , and made a covenant with them , to let them live . The princes of the congregation swore to them .

verses.z: 以色列人與他們立約之後，過了三天才聽見他們是近鄰，住在以色列人中間的。
verses.e: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them , they heard that they were their neighbors , and that they lived among them .

verses.z: 以色列人起行，第三天到了他們的城邑，就是基遍、基非拉、比錄、基列‧耶琳。
verses.e: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day . Now their cities were Gibeon , Chephirah , Beeroth , and Kiriath Jearim .

verses.z: 因為會眾的首領已經指着耶和華－以色列的上帝向他們起誓，所以以色列人不擊殺他們；全會眾就向首領發怨言。
verses.e: The children of Israel didn't strike them , because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by the LORD , the God of Israel . All the congregation murmured against the princes .

verses.z: 眾首領對全會眾說：「我們已經指着耶和華－以色列的上帝向他們起誓，現在我們不能害他們。
verses.e: But all the princes said to all the congregation , " We have sworn to them by the LORD , the God of Israel . Now therefore we may not touch them .

verses.z: 就都聚集，同心合意地要與約書亞和以色列人爭戰。
verses.e: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel , with one accord .

verses.z: 我們要如此待他們，容他們活着，免得有忿怒因我們所起的誓臨到我們身上。」
verses.e: We will do this to them , and let them live ; lest wrath be on us , because of the oath which we swore to them . "

verses.z: 首領又對會眾說：「要容他們活着。」於是他們為全會眾作了劈柴挑水的人，正如首領對他們所說的話。
verses.e: The princes said to them , " Let them live . " So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation , as the princes had spoken to them .

verses.z: 約書亞召了他們來，對他們說：「為甚麼欺哄我們說『我們離你們甚遠』呢？其實你們是住在我們中間。
verses.e: Joshua called for them , and he spoke to them , saying , " Why have you deceived us , saying , ' We are very far from you , ' when you live among us ?

verses.z: 現在你們是被咒詛的！你們中間的人必斷不了作奴僕，為我上帝的殿作劈柴挑水的人。」
verses.e: Now therefore you are cursed , and some of you will never fail to be slaves , both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God . "

verses.z: 他們回答約書亞說：「因為有人實在告訴你的僕人，耶和華－你的上帝曾吩咐他的僕人摩西，把這全地賜給你們，並在你們面前滅絕這地的一切居民，所以我們為你們的緣故甚怕喪命，就行了這事。
verses.e: They answered Joshua , and said , " Because your servants were certainly told how the LORD your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land , and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you . Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you , and have done this thing .

verses.z: 現在我們在你手中，你以怎樣待我們為善為正，就怎樣做吧！」
verses.e: Now , behold , we are in your hand . Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do . "

verses.z: 於是約書亞這樣待他們，救他們脫離以色列人的手，以色列人就沒有殺他們。
verses.e: He did so to them , and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel , so that they didn't kill them .

verses.z: 當日約書亞使他們在耶和華所要選擇的地方，為會眾和耶和華的壇作劈柴挑水的人，直到今日。
verses.e: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for the LORD's altar to this day , in the place which he should choose .

verses.z: 基遍的居民聽見約書亞向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，
verses.e: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai ,

verses.z: 就設詭計，假充使者，拿舊口袋和破裂縫補的舊皮酒袋馱在驢上，
verses.e: they also resorted to a ruse , and went and made as if they had been ambassadors , and took old sacks on their donkeys , and old , torn-up and bound up wineskins ,

verses.z: 將補過的舊鞋穿在腳上，把舊衣服穿在身上；他們所帶的餅都是乾的，長了霉了。
verses.e: and old and patched sandals on their feet , and wore old garments . All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy .

verses.z: 他們到吉甲營中見約書亞，對他和以色列人說：「我們是從遠方來的，現在求你與我們立約。」
verses.e: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal , and said to him and to the men of Israel , " We have come from a far country . Now therefore make a covenant with us . "

verses.z: 以色列人對這些希未人說：「只怕你們是住在我們中間的；若是這樣，怎能和你們立約呢？」
verses.e: The men of Israel said to the Hivites , " What if you live among us ? How could we make a covenant with you ? "

verses.z: 他們對約書亞說：「我們是你的僕人。」約書亞問他們說：「你們是甚麼人？是從哪裏來的？」
verses.e: They said to Joshua , " We are your servants . " Joshua said to them , " Who are you ? Where do you come from ? "

verses.z: 他們回答說：「僕人從極遠之地而來，是因聽見耶和華－你上帝的名聲和他在埃及所行的一切事，
verses.e: They said to him , " Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of the LORD your God ; for we have heard of his fame , all that he did in Egypt ,

verses.z: 耶穌基督的僕人，雅各的弟兄猶大，寫信給那被召、在父上帝裏蒙愛、為耶穌基督保守的人。
verses.e: Jude , a servant of Jesus Christ , and brother of James , to those who are called , sanctified by God the Father , and kept for Jesus Christ :

verses.z: 但這些人毀謗他們所不知道的。他們本性所知道的事與那沒有靈性的畜類一樣，在這事上竟敗壞了自己。
verses.e: But these speak evil of whatever things they don't know . They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally , like the creatures without reason .

verses.z: 他們有禍了！因為走了該隱的道路，又為利往巴蘭的錯謬裏直奔，並在可拉的背叛中滅亡了。
verses.e: Woe to them ! For they went in the way of Cain , and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire , and perished in Korah's rebellion .

verses.z: 這樣的人在你們的愛席上與你們同吃的時候，正是礁石。他們作牧人，只知餵養自己，無所懼怕；是沒有雨的雲彩，被風飄蕩；是秋天沒有果子的樹，死而又死，連根被拔出來；
verses.e: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you , shepherds who without fear feed themselves ; clouds without water , carried along by winds ; autumn trees without fruit , twice dead , plucked up by the roots ;

verses.z: 是海裏的狂浪，湧出自己可恥的沫子來；是流蕩的星，有墨黑的幽暗為他們永遠存留。
verses.e: wild waves of the sea , foaming out their own shame ; wandering stars , for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever .

verses.z: 亞當的七世孫以諾曾預言這些人說：「看哪，主帶着他的千萬聖者降臨，
verses.e: About these also Enoch , the seventh from Adam , prophesied , saying , " Behold , the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones ,

verses.z: 要在眾人身上行審判，證實那一切不敬虔的人所妄行一切不敬虔的事，又證實不敬虔之罪人所說頂撞他的剛愎話。」
verses.e: to execute judgment on all , and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way , and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him . "

verses.z: 這些人是私下議論，常發怨言的，隨從自己的情慾而行，口中說誇大的話，為得便宜諂媚人。
verses.e: These are murmurers and complainers , walking after their lusts — and their mouth speaks proud things — showing respect of persons to gain advantage .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們要記念我們主耶穌基督之使徒從前所說的話。
verses.e: But you , beloved , remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 他們曾對你們說過，末世必有好譏誚的人隨從自己不敬虔的私慾而行。
verses.e: They said to you , " In the last time there will be mockers , walking after their own ungodly lusts . "

verses.z: 這就是那些引人結黨、屬乎血氣、沒有[聖]靈的人。
verses.e: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual , not having the Spirit .

verses.z: 願憐恤、平安、慈愛多多地加給你們。
verses.e: May mercy , peace , and love be multiplied to you .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們卻要在至聖的真道上造就自己，在聖靈裏禱告，
verses.e: But you , beloved , keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith , praying in the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 保守自己常在上帝的愛中，仰望我們主耶穌基督的憐憫，直到永生。
verses.e: Keep yourselves in God's love , looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life .

verses.z: 有些人存疑心，你們要憐憫他們；
verses.e: On some have compassion , making a distinction ,

verses.z: 有些人你們要從火中搶出來，搭救他們；有些人你們要存懼怕的心憐憫他們，連那被情慾沾染的衣服也當厭惡。
verses.e: and some save , snatching them out of the fire with fear , hating even the clothing stained by the flesh .

verses.z: 那能保守你們不失腳、叫你們無瑕無疵、歡歡喜喜站在他榮耀之前的我們的救主－獨一的上帝，
verses.e: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling , and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy ,

verses.z: 願榮耀、威嚴、能力、權柄，因我們的主耶穌基督歸與他，從萬古以前並現今，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: to God our Savior , who alone is wise , be glory and majesty , dominion and power , both now and forever . Amen .

verses.z: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我想盡心寫信給你們，論我們同得救恩的時候，就不得不寫信勸你們，要為從前一次交付聖徒的真道竭力地爭辯。
verses.e: Beloved , while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation , I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints .

verses.z: 因為有些人偷着進來，就是自古被定受刑罰的，是不虔誠的，將我們上帝的恩變作放縱情慾的機會，並且不認獨一的主宰－我們主耶穌基督。
verses.e: For there are certain men who crept in secretly , even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation : ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into indecency , and denying our only Master , God , and Lord , Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 從前主救了[他的]百姓出埃及地，後來就把那些不信的滅絕了。這一切的事，你們雖然都知道，我卻仍要提醒你們。
verses.e: Now I desire to remind you , though you already know this , that the Lord , having saved a people out of the land of Egypt , afterward destroyed those who didn't believe .

verses.z: 又有不守本位、離開自己住處的天使，主用鎖鍊把他們永遠拘留在黑暗裏，等候大日的審判。
verses.e: Angels who didn't keep their first domain , but deserted their own dwelling place , he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day .

verses.z: 又如所多瑪、蛾摩拉和周圍城邑的人，也照他們一味地行淫，隨從逆性的情慾，就受永火的刑罰，作為鑑戒。
verses.e: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them , having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh , are shown as an example , suffering the punishment of eternal fire .

verses.z: 這些做夢的人也像他們污穢身體，輕慢主治的，毀謗在尊位的。
verses.e: Yet in the same way , these also in their dreaming defile the flesh , despise authority , and slander celestial beings .

verses.z: 天使長米迦勒為摩西的屍首與魔鬼爭辯的時候，尚且不敢用毀謗的話罪責他，只說：「主責備你吧！」。
verses.e: But Michael , the archangel , when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses , dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation , but said , " May the Lord rebuke you ! "

verses.z: 先前滿有人民的城，現在何竟獨坐！先前在列國中為大的，現在竟如寡婦；先前在諸省中為王后的，現在成為進貢的。
verses.e: How the city sits solitary , that was full of people ! She has become as a widow , who was great among the nations ! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave !

verses.z: 敵人伸手，奪取她的美物；她眼見外邦人進入她的聖所－論這外邦人，你曾吩咐不可入你的會中。
verses.e: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things ; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary , concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly .

verses.z: 她的民都歎息，尋求食物；他們用美物換糧食，要救性命。[他們說]：耶和華啊，求你觀看，因為我甚是卑賤。
verses.e: All her people sigh . They seek bread . They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul . " Look , LORD , and see , for I have become despised . "

verses.z: 你們一切過路的人哪，這事你們不介意嗎？你們要觀看：有像這臨到我的痛苦沒有－就是耶和華在他發烈怒的日子使我所受的苦？
verses.e: " Is it nothing to you , all you who pass by ? Look , and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow , which is brought on me , with which the LORD has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger .

verses.z: 他從高天使火進入我的骨頭，剋制了我；他鋪下網羅，絆我的腳，使我轉回；他使我終日淒涼發昏。
verses.e: " From on high has he sent fire into my bones , and it prevails against them . He has spread a net for my feet . He has turned me back . He has made me desolate and I faint all day long .

verses.z: 我罪過的軛是他手所綁的，猶如軛繩縛在我頸項上；他使我的力量衰敗。主將我交在我所不能敵擋的人手中。
verses.e: " The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand . They are knit together . They have come up on my neck . He made my strength fail . The Lord has delivered me into their hands , against whom I am not able to stand .

verses.z: 主輕棄我中間的一切勇士，招聚多人攻擊我，要壓碎我的少年人。主將猶大居民踹下，像在酒醡中一樣。
verses.e: " The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me . He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men . The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press .

verses.z: 我因這些事哭泣；我眼淚汪汪；因為那當安慰我、救我性命的，離我甚遠。我的兒女孤苦，因為仇敵得了勝。
verses.e: " For these things I weep . My eye , my eye runs down with water , because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me . My children are desolate , because the enemy has prevailed . "

verses.z: 錫安舉手，無人安慰。耶和華論雅各已經出令，使四圍的人作他仇敵；耶路撒冷在他們中間像不潔之物。
verses.e: Zion spreads out her hands . There is no one to comfort her . The LORD has commanded concerning Jacob , that those who are around him should be his adversaries . Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing .

verses.z: 耶和華是公義的！[他這樣待我]，是因我違背他的命令。眾民哪，請聽我的話，看我的痛苦；我的處女和少年人都被擄去。
verses.e: " The LORD is righteous , for I have rebelled against his commandment . Please hear all you peoples , and see my sorrow . My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity .

verses.z: 我招呼我所親愛的，他們卻愚弄我。我的祭司和長老正尋求食物、救性命的時候，就在城中絕氣。
verses.e: " I called for my lovers , but they deceived me . My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city , while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls .

verses.z: 她夜間痛哭，淚流滿腮；在一切所親愛的中間沒有一個安慰她的。她的朋友都以詭詐待她，成為她的仇敵。
verses.e: She weeps bitterly in the night . Her tears are on her cheeks . Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her . All her friends have dealt treacherously with her . They have become her enemies .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你觀看，因為我在急難中。我心腸擾亂；我心在我裏面翻轉，因我大大悖逆。在外，刀劍使人喪子；在家，猶如死亡。
verses.e: " Look , LORD ; for I am in distress . My heart is troubled . My heart turns over within me , for I have grievously rebelled . Abroad , the sword bereaves . At home , it is like death .

verses.z: 聽見我歎息的有人；安慰我的卻無人！我的仇敵都聽見我所遭的患難；因你做這事，他們都喜樂。你必使你報告的日子來到，他們就像我一樣。
verses.e: " They have heard that I sigh . There is no one to comfort me . All my enemies have heard of my trouble . They are glad that you have done it . You will bring the day that you have proclaimed , and they will be like me .

verses.z: 願他們的惡行都呈在你面前；你怎樣因我的一切罪過待我，求你照樣待他們；因我歎息甚多，心中發昏。
verses.e: " Let all their wickedness come before you . Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions . For my sighs are many , and my heart is faint .

verses.z: 猶大因遭遇苦難，又因多服勞苦就遷到[外邦]。她住在列國中，尋不着安息；追逼她的都在狹窄之地將她追上。
verses.e: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude . She dwells among the nations . She finds no rest . All her persecutors overtook her in her distress .

verses.z: 錫安的路徑因無人來守聖節就悲傷；她的城門淒涼；她的祭司歎息；她的處女受艱難，自己也愁苦。
verses.e: The roads to Zion mourn , because no one comes to the solemn assembly . All her gates are desolate . Her priests sigh . Her virgins are afflicted , and she herself is in bitterness .

verses.z: 她的敵人為首；她的仇敵亨通；因耶和華為她許多的罪過使她受苦；她的孩童被敵人擄去。
verses.e: Her adversaries have become the head . Her enemies prosper ; for the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions . Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary .

verses.z: 錫安城的威榮全都失去。她的首領像找不着草場的鹿；在追趕的人前無力行走。
verses.e: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion . Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture . They have gone without strength before the pursuer .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷在困苦窘迫之時，就追想古時一切的樂境。她百姓落在敵人手中，無人救濟；敵人看見，就因她的荒涼嗤笑。
verses.e: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old ; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary , and no one helped her . The adversaries saw her . They mocked at her desolations .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷大大犯罪，所以成為不潔之物；素來尊敬她的，見她赤露就都藐視她；她自己也歎息退後。
verses.e: Jerusalem has grievously sinned . Therefore she has become unclean . All who honored her despise her , because they have seen her nakedness . Yes , she sighs and turns backward .

verses.z: 她的污穢是在衣襟上；她不思想自己的結局，所以非常地敗落，無人安慰她。[她說]：耶和華啊，求你看我的苦難，因為仇敵誇大。
verses.e: Her filthiness was in her skirts . She didn't remember her latter end . Therefore she has come down astoundingly . She has no comforter . " See , LORD , my affliction ; for the enemy has magnified himself . "

verses.z: 主何竟發怒，使黑雲遮蔽錫安城！他將以色列的華美從天扔在地上；在他發怒的日子並不記念自己的腳凳。
verses.e: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger ! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth , and hasn't remembered his footstool in the day of his anger .

verses.z: 錫安城的長老坐在地上默默無聲；他們揚起塵土落在頭上，腰束麻布；耶路撒冷的處女垂頭至地。
verses.e: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground . They keep silence . They have cast up dust on their heads . They have clothed themselves with sackcloth . The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground .

verses.z: 我眼中流淚，以致失明；我的心腸擾亂，肝[膽]塗地，都因我眾民遭毀滅，又因孩童和吃奶的在城內街上發昏。
verses.e: My eyes fail with tears . My heart is troubled . My bile is poured on the earth , because of the destruction of the daughter of my people , because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city .

verses.z: 那時，他們在城內街上發昏，好像受傷的，在母親的懷裏，將要喪命；對母親說：穀、酒在哪裏呢？
verses.e: They ask their mothers , " Where is grain and wine ? " when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city , when their soul is poured out into their mothers ' bosom .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的民哪，我可用甚麼向你證明呢？我可用甚麼與你相比呢？錫安的民哪，我可拿甚麼和你比較，好安慰你呢？因為你的裂口大如海，誰能醫治你呢？
verses.e: What shall I testify to you ? What shall I liken to you , daughter of Jerusalem ? What shall I compare to you , that I may comfort you , virgin daughter of Zion ? For your breach is as big as the sea . Who can heal you ?

verses.z: 你的先知為你見虛假和愚昧的異象，並沒有顯露你的罪孽，使你被擄的歸回；卻為你見虛假的默示和使你被趕出本境的緣故。
verses.e: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you . They have not uncovered your iniquity , to reverse your captivity , but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment .

verses.z: 凡過路的都向你拍掌。他們向耶路撒冷城嗤笑，搖頭，[說]：難道人所稱為全美的，稱為全地所喜悅的，就是這城嗎？
verses.e: All that pass by clap their hands at you . They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem , saying , " Is this the city that men called ' The perfection of beauty , the joy of the whole earth ' ? "

verses.z: 你的仇敵都向你大大張口；他們嗤笑，又切齒說：我們吞滅她。這真是我們所盼望的日子臨到了！我們親眼看見了！
verses.e: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you . They hiss and gnash their teeth . They say , " We have swallowed her up . Certainly this is the day that we looked for . We have found it . We have seen it . "

verses.z: 耶和華成就了他所定的，應驗了他古時所命定的。他傾覆了，並不顧惜，使你的仇敵向你誇耀；使你敵人的角也被高舉。
verses.e: The LORD has done that which he planned . He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old . He has thrown down , and has not pitied . He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you . He has exalted the horn of your adversaries .

verses.z: 錫安民的心哀求主。錫安的城牆啊，願你流淚如河，晝夜不息；願你眼中的瞳人淚流不止。
verses.e: Their heart cried to the Lord . O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night . Give yourself no relief . Don't let your eyes rest .

verses.z: 夜間，每逢交更的時候要起來呼喊，在主面前傾心如水。你的孩童在各市口上受餓發昏；你要為他們的性命向主舉手禱告。
verses.e: Arise , cry out in the night , at the beginning of the watches ! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord . Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children , who faint for hunger at the head of every street .

verses.z: 主吞滅雅各一切的住處，並不顧惜。他發怒傾覆猶大民的保障，使這保障坍倒在地；他辱沒這國和其中的首領。
verses.e: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity . He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah . He has brought them down to the ground . He has profaned the kingdom and its princes .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你觀看！見你向誰這樣行？婦人豈可吃自己所生育手裏所搖弄的嬰孩嗎？祭司和先知豈可在主的聖所中被殺戮嗎？
verses.e: " Look , LORD , and see to whom you have done thus ! Should the women eat their offspring , the children that they held and bounced on their knees ? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord ?

verses.z: 少年人和老年人都在街上躺臥；我的處女和壯丁都倒在刀下；你發怒的日子殺死他們。你殺了，並不顧惜。
verses.e: " The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets . My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword . You have killed them in the day of your anger . You have slaughtered , and not pitied .

verses.z: 你招聚四圍驚嚇我的，像在大會的日子招聚[人]一樣。耶和華發怒的日子，無人逃脫，無人存留。我所搖弄所養育的嬰孩，仇敵都殺淨了。
verses.e: " You have called , as in the day of a solemn assembly , my terrors on every side . There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD's anger . My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up .

verses.z: 他發烈怒，把以色列的角全然砍斷，在仇敵面前收回右手。他像火焰四圍吞滅，將雅各燒毀。
verses.e: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger . He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy . He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire , which devours all around .

verses.z: 他張弓好像仇敵；他站着舉起右手，如同敵人將悅人眼目的，盡行殺戮。在錫安百姓的帳棚上倒出他的忿怒，像火一樣。
verses.e: He has bent his bow like an enemy . He has stood with his right hand as an adversary . He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye . In the tent of the daughter of Zion , he has poured out his wrath like fire .

verses.z: 主如仇敵吞滅以色列和錫安的一切宮殿，拆毀百姓的保障；在猶大民中加增悲傷哭號。
verses.e: The Lord has become as an enemy . He has swallowed up Israel . He has swallowed up all her palaces . He has destroyed his strongholds . He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah .

verses.z: 他強取自己的帳幕，好像是園中的[窩]棚，毀壞他的聚會之處。耶和華使聖節和安息日在錫安都被忘記，又在怒氣的憤恨中藐視君王和祭司。
verses.e: He has violently taken away his tabernacle , as if it were a garden . He has destroyed his place of assembly . The LORD has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion . In the indignation of his anger , he has despised the king and the priest .

verses.z: 耶和華丟棄自己的祭壇，憎惡自己的聖所，將宮殿的牆垣交付仇敵。他們在耶和華的殿中喧嚷，像在聖會之日一樣。
verses.e: The Lord has cast off his altar . He has abhorred his sanctuary . He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy . They have made a noise in the LORD's house , as in the day of a solemn assembly .

verses.z: 耶和華定意拆毀錫安的城牆；他拉了準繩，不將手收回，定要毀滅。他使外郭和城牆都悲哀，一同衰敗。
verses.e: The LORD has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion . He has stretched out the line . He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying ; He has made the rampart and wall lament . They languish together .

verses.z: 錫安的門都陷入地內；主將她的門閂毀壞，折斷。她的君王和首領落在沒有律法的列國中；她的先知不得見耶和華的異象。
verses.e: Her gates have sunk into the ground . He has destroyed and broken her bars . Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not . Yes , her prophets find no vision from the LORD .

verses.z: 我是因耶和華忿怒的杖，遭遇困苦的人。
verses.e: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .

verses.z: 他向我如熊埋伏，如獅子在隱密處。
verses.e: He is to me as a bear lying in wait , as a lion in hiding .

verses.z: 他使我轉離正路，將我撕碎，使我淒涼。
verses.e: He has turned away my path , and pulled me in pieces . He has made me desolate .

verses.z: 他張弓將我當作箭靶子。
verses.e: He has bent his bow , and set me as a mark for the arrow .

verses.z: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。
verses.e: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys .

verses.z: 我成了眾民的笑話；他們終日以我為歌曲。
verses.e: I have become a derision to all my people , and their song all day long .

verses.z: 他用苦楚充滿我，使我飽用茵蔯。
verses.e: He has filled me with bitterness . He has stuffed me with wormwood .

verses.z: 他又用沙石磣斷我的牙，用灰塵將我蒙蔽。
verses.e: He has also broken my teeth with gravel . He has covered me with ashes .

verses.z: 你使我遠離平安，我忘記好處。
verses.e: You have removed my soul far away from peace . I forgot prosperity .

verses.z: 我就說：我的力量衰敗；我在耶和華那裏毫無指望！
verses.e: I said , " My strength has perished , along with my expectation from the LORD . "

verses.z: [耶和華啊]，求你記念我如茵蔯和苦膽的困苦窘迫。
verses.e: Remember my affliction and my misery , the wormwood and the bitterness .

verses.z: 他引導我，使我行在黑暗中，不行在光明裏。
verses.e: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness , and not in light .

verses.z: 我心想念這些，就在裏面憂悶。
verses.e: My soul still remembers them , and is bowed down within me .

verses.z: 我想起這事，心裏就有指望。
verses.e: This I recall to my mind ; therefore I have hope .

verses.z: 我們不致消滅，是出於耶和華諸般的慈愛；是因他的憐憫不致斷絕。
verses.e: It is because of the LORD's loving kindnesses that we are not consumed , because his mercies don't fail .

verses.z: 每早晨，這都是新的；你的誠實極其廣大！
verses.e: They are new every morning . Great is your faithfulness .

verses.z: 我心裏說：耶和華是我的分，因此，我要仰望他。
verses.e: " The LORD is my portion , " says my soul . " Therefore I will hope in him . "

verses.z: 凡等候耶和華，心裏尋求他的，耶和華必施恩給他。
verses.e: The LORD is good to those who wait for him , to the soul who seeks him .

verses.z: 人仰望耶和華，靜默等候他的救恩，這原是好的。
verses.e: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD .

verses.z: 人在幼年負軛，這原是好的。
verses.e: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth .

verses.z: 他當獨坐無言，因為這是耶和華加在他身上的。
verses.e: Let him sit alone and keep silence , because he has laid it on him .

verses.z: 他當口貼塵埃，或者有指望。
verses.e: Let him put his mouth in the dust , if it is so that there may be hope .

verses.z: 他真是終日再三反手攻擊我。
verses.e: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long .

verses.z: 他當由人打他的腮頰，要滿受凌辱。
verses.e: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him . Let him be filled full of reproach .

verses.z: 因為主必不永遠丟棄人。
verses.e: For the Lord will not cast off forever .

verses.z: 主雖使人憂愁，還要照他諸般的慈愛發憐憫。
verses.e: For though he causes grief , yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses .

verses.z: 因他並不甘心使人受苦，使人憂愁。
verses.e: For he does not afflict willingly , nor grieve the children of men .

verses.z: 人將世上被囚的踹在腳下，
verses.e: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth ,

verses.z: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，
verses.e: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High ,

verses.z: 或在人的訟事上顛倒是非，這都是主看不上的。
verses.e: to subvert a man in his cause , the Lord doesn't approve .

verses.z: 除非主命定，誰能說成就成呢？
verses.e: Who is he who says , and it comes to pass , when the Lord doesn't command it ?

verses.z: 禍福不都出於至高者的口嗎？
verses.e: Doesn't evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High ?

verses.z: 活人因自己的罪受罰，為何發怨言呢？
verses.e: Why should a living man complain , a man for the punishment of his sins ?

verses.z: 他使我的皮肉枯乾；他折斷我的骨頭。
verses.e: He has made my flesh and my skin old . He has broken my bones .

verses.z: 我們當深深考察自己的行為，再歸向耶和華。
verses.e: Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the LORD .

verses.z: 我們當誠心向天上的上帝舉手禱告。
verses.e: Let's lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens .

verses.z: 我們犯罪背逆，你並不赦免。
verses.e: " We have transgressed and have rebelled . You have not pardoned .

verses.z: 你自被怒氣遮蔽，追趕我們；你施行殺戮，並不顧惜。
verses.e: " You have covered us with anger and pursued us . You have killed . You have not pitied .

verses.z: 你以黑雲遮蔽自己，以致禱告不得透入。
verses.e: You have covered yourself with a cloud , so that no prayer can pass through .

verses.z: 你使我們在萬民中成為污穢和渣滓。
verses.e: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples .

verses.z: 我們的仇敵都向我們大大張口。
verses.e: " All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us .

verses.z: 恐懼和陷坑，殘害和毀滅，都臨近我們。
verses.e: Terror and the pit have come on us , devastation and destruction . "

verses.z: 因我眾民遭的毀滅，我就眼淚下流如河。
verses.e: My eye runs down with streams of water , for the destruction of the daughter of my people .

verses.z: 我的眼多多流淚，總不止息，
verses.e: My eye pours down and doesn't cease , without any intermission ,

verses.z: 他築壘攻擊我，用苦楚和艱難圍困我。
verses.e: He has built against me , and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship .

verses.z: 直等耶和華垂顧，從天觀看。
verses.e: until the LORD looks down , and sees from heaven .

verses.z: 因我本城的眾民，我的眼，使我的心傷痛。
verses.e: My eye affects my soul , because of all the daughters of my city .

verses.z: 無故與我為仇的追逼我，像追雀鳥一樣。
verses.e: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird , those who are my enemies without cause .

verses.z: 他們使我的命在牢獄中斷絕，並將一塊石頭拋在我身上。
verses.e: They have cut off my life in the dungeon , and have cast a stone on me .

verses.z: 眾水流過我頭，我說：我[命]斷絕了！
verses.e: Waters flowed over my head . I said , " I am cut off . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我從深牢中求告你的名。
verses.e: I called on your name , LORD , out of the lowest dungeon .

verses.z: 你曾聽見我的聲音；我求你解救，你不要掩耳不聽。
verses.e: You heard my voice : " Don't hide your ear from my sighing , and my cry . "

verses.z: 我求告你的日子，你臨近我，說：不要懼怕！
verses.e: You came near in the day that I called on you . You said , " Don't be afraid . "

verses.z: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤；你救贖了我的命。
verses.e: Lord , you have pleaded the causes of my soul . You have redeemed my life .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你見了我受的委屈；求你為我伸冤。
verses.e: LORD , you have seen my wrong . Judge my cause .

verses.z: 他使我住在幽暗之處，像死了許久的人一樣。
verses.e: He has made me dwell in dark places , as those who have been long dead .

verses.z: 他們仇恨我，謀害我，你都看見了。
verses.e: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你聽見他們辱罵我的話，知道他們向我所設的計，
verses.e: You have heard their reproach , LORD , and all their plans against me ,

verses.z: 並那些起來攻擊我的人口中所說的話，以及終日向我所設的計謀。
verses.e: the lips of those that rose up against me , and their plots against me all day long .

verses.z: 求你觀看，他們坐下，起來，都以我為歌曲。
verses.e: You see their sitting down and their rising up . I am their song .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你要按着他們手所做的向他們施行報應。
verses.e: You will pay them back , LORD , according to the work of their hands .

verses.z: 你要使他們心裏剛硬，使你的咒詛臨到他們。
verses.e: You will give them hardness of heart , your curse to them .

verses.z: 你要發怒追趕他們，從耶和華的天下除滅他們。
verses.e: You will pursue them in anger , and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD .

verses.z: 他用籬笆圍住我，使我不能出去；他使我的銅鍊沉重。
verses.e: He has walled me about , so that I can't go out . He has made my chain heavy .

verses.z: 我哀號求救；他使我的禱告不得上達。
verses.e: Yes , when I cry , and call for help , he shuts out my prayer .

verses.z: 他用鑿過的石頭擋住我的道；他使我的路彎曲。
verses.e: He has walled up my ways with cut stone . He has made my paths crooked .

verses.z: 黃金何其失光！純金何其變色！聖所的石頭倒在各市口上。
verses.e: How the gold has become dim ! The most pure gold has changed ! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street .

verses.z: 慈心的婦人，當我眾民被毀滅的時候，親手煮自己的兒女作為食物。
verses.e: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children . They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people .

verses.z: 耶和華發怒成就他所定的，倒出他的烈怒；在錫安使火着起，燒毀錫安的根基。
verses.e: The LORD has accomplished his wrath . He has poured out his fierce anger . He has kindled a fire in Zion , which has devoured its foundations .

verses.z: 地上的君王和世上的居民都不信敵人和仇敵能進耶路撒冷的城門。
verses.e: The kings of the earth didn't believe , neither did all the inhabitants of the world , that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 這都因她先知的罪惡和祭司的罪孽；他們在城中流了義人的血。
verses.e: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her .

verses.z: 他們在街上如瞎子亂走，又被血玷污，以致人不能摸他們的衣服。
verses.e: They wander as blind men in the streets . They are polluted with blood , So that men can't touch their garments .

verses.z: 人向他們喊着說：不潔淨的，躲開，躲開！不要挨近我！他們逃走飄流的時候，列國中有人說：他們不可仍[在這裏]寄居。
verses.e: " Go away ! " they cried to them . " Unclean ! Go away ! Go away ! Don't touch ! When they fled away and wandered , men said among the nations , " They can't live here any more . "

verses.z: 耶和華發怒，將他們分散，不再眷顧他們；人不重看祭司，也不厚待長老。
verses.e: The LORD's anger has scattered them . He will not pay attention to them any more . They didn't respect the persons of the priests . They didn't favor the elders .

verses.z: 我們[仰望]人來幫助，以致眼目失明，還是枉然；我們所盼望的，竟盼望一個不能救人的國！
verses.e: Our eyes still fail , looking in vain for our help . In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save .

verses.z: 仇敵追趕我們的腳步像打獵的，以致我們不敢在自己的街上行走。我們的結局臨近；我們的日子滿足；我們的結局來到了。
verses.e: They hunt our steps , so that we can't go in our streets . Our end is near . Our days are fulfilled , for our end has come .

verses.z: 追趕我們的比空中的鷹更快；他們在山上追逼我們，在曠野埋伏，等候我們。
verses.e: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky . They chased us on the mountains . They set an ambush for us in the wilderness .

verses.z: 錫安寶貴的眾子好比精金，現在何竟算為窯匠手所做的瓦瓶？
verses.e: The precious sons of Zion , comparable to fine gold , how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers , the work of the hands of the potter !

verses.z: 耶和華的受膏者好比我們鼻中的氣，在他們的坑中被捉住；我們曾論到他說：我們必在他蔭下，在列國中存活。
verses.e: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the LORD , was taken in their pits ; of whom we said , under his shadow we will live among the nations .

verses.z: 住烏斯地的以東民哪，只管歡喜快樂；[苦]杯也必傳到你那裏；你必喝醉，以致露體。
verses.e: Rejoice and be glad , daughter of Edom , who dwells in the land of Uz . The cup will pass through to you also . You will be drunken , and will make yourself naked .

verses.z: 錫安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罰受足了，耶和華必不使你再被擄去。以東的民哪，他必追討你的罪孽，顯露你的罪惡。
verses.e: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished , daughter of Zion . He will no more carry you away into captivity . He will visit your iniquity , daughter of Edom . He will uncover your sins .

verses.z: 野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子，我民的婦人倒成為殘忍，好像曠野的鴕鳥一般。
verses.e: Even the jackals offer their breast . They nurse their young ones . But the daughter of my people has become cruel , like the ostriches in the wilderness .

verses.z: 吃奶孩子的舌頭因乾渴貼住上膛；孩童求餅，無人擘給他們。
verses.e: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst . The young children ask for bread , and no one breaks it for them .

verses.z: 素來吃美好食物的，現今在街上變為孤寒；素來臥朱紅褥子的，現今躺臥糞堆。
verses.e: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets . Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills .

verses.z: 都因我眾民的罪孽比所多瑪的罪還大；所多瑪雖然無人加手於她，還是轉眼之間被傾覆。
verses.e: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom , which was overthrown as in a moment . No hands were laid on her .

verses.z: 錫安的貴冑素來比雪純淨，比奶更白；他們的身體比紅寶玉更紅，像光潤的藍寶石一樣。
verses.e: Her nobles were purer than snow . They were whiter than milk . They were more ruddy in body than rubies . Their polishing was like sapphire .

verses.z: 現在他們的面貌比煤炭更黑，以致在街上無人認識；他們的皮膚緊貼骨頭，枯乾如同槁木。
verses.e: Their appearance is blacker than a coal . They are not known in the streets . Their skin clings to their bones . It is withered . It has become like wood .

verses.z: 餓死的不如被刀殺的，因為這是缺了田間的土產，就身體衰弱，漸漸消滅。
verses.e: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger ; for these pine away , stricken through , for lack of the fruits of the field .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你記念我們所遭遇的事，觀看我們所受的凌辱。
verses.e: Remember , LORD , what has come on us . Look , and see our reproach .

verses.z: 因飢餓燥熱，我們的皮膚就黑如爐。
verses.e: Our skin is black like an oven , because of the burning heat of famine .

verses.z: 敵人在錫安玷污婦人，在猶大的城邑玷污處女。
verses.e: They ravished the women in Zion , the virgins in the cities of Judah .

verses.z: 他們吊起首領的手，也不尊敬老人的面。
verses.e: Princes were hanged up by their hands . The faces of elders were not honored .

verses.z: 少年人扛磨石，孩童背木柴，都絆跌了。
verses.e: The young men carry millstones . The children stumbled under loads of wood .

verses.z: 老年人在城門口斷絕；少年人不再作樂。
verses.e: The elders have ceased from the gate , and the young men from their music .

verses.z: 我們心中的快樂止息，跳舞變為悲哀。
verses.e: The joy of our heart has ceased . Our dance is turned into mourning .

verses.z: 冠冕從我們的頭上落下；我們犯罪了，我們有禍了！
verses.e: The crown has fallen from our head . Woe to us , for we have sinned !

verses.z: 這些事我們心裏發昏，我們的眼睛昏花。
verses.e: For this our heart is faint . For these things our eyes are dim :

verses.z: 錫安山荒涼，野狗行在其上。
verses.e: for the mountain of Zion , which is desolate . The foxes walk on it .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你存到永遠；你的寶座存到萬代。
verses.e: You , LORD , remain forever . Your throne is from generation to generation .

verses.z: 我們的產業歸與外邦人；我們的房屋歸與外路人。
verses.e: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers , our houses to aliens .

verses.z: 你為何永遠忘記我們？為何許久離棄我們？
verses.e: Why do you forget us forever , and forsake us for so long a time ?

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你使我們向你回轉，我們便得回轉。求你復新我們的日子，像古時一樣。
verses.e: Turn us to yourself , LORD , and we will be turned . Renew our days as of old .

verses.z: 你竟全然棄絕我們，向我們大發烈怒？
verses.e: But you have utterly rejected us . You are very angry against us .

verses.z: 我們是無父的孤兒；我們的母親好像寡婦。
verses.e: We are orphans and fatherless . Our mothers are as widows .

verses.z: 我們出錢才得水喝；我們的柴是人賣給我們的。
verses.e: We must pay for water to drink . Our wood is sold to us .

verses.z: 追趕我們的，到了我們的頸項上；我們疲乏不得歇息。
verses.e: Our pursuers are on our necks . We are weary , and have no rest .

verses.z: 我們投降埃及人和亞述人，為要得糧吃飽。
verses.e: We have given our hands to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .

verses.z: 我們列祖犯罪，而今不在了；我們擔當他們的罪孽。
verses.e: Our fathers sinned , and are no more . We have borne their iniquities .

verses.z: 奴僕轄制我們，無人救我們脫離他們的手。
verses.e: Servants rule over us . There is no one to deliver us out of their hand .

verses.z: 因為曠野的刀劍，我們冒着險才得糧食。
verses.e: We get our bread at the peril of our lives , because of the sword in the wilderness .

verses.z: 耶和華從會幕中呼叫摩西，對他說：
verses.e: The LORD called to Moses , and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting , saying ,

verses.z: 「人的供物若以綿羊或山羊為燔祭，就要獻上沒有殘疾的公羊。
verses.e: " ' If his offering is from the flock , from the sheep or from the goats , for a burnt offering , he shall offer a male without defect .

verses.z: 要把羊宰於壇的北邊，在耶和華面前；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把羊血灑在壇的周圍。
verses.e: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD . Aaron's sons , the priests , shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar .

verses.z: 要把燔祭牲切成塊子，連頭和脂油，祭司就要擺在壇上火的柴上；
verses.e: He shall cut it into its pieces , with its head and its fat . The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar ,

verses.z: 但臟腑與腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉獻，燒在壇上。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water . The priest shall offer the whole , and burn it on the altar . It is a burnt offering , an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 「人奉給耶和華的供物，若以鳥為燔祭，就要獻斑鳩或是雛鴿為供物。
verses.e: " ' If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds , then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons .

verses.z: 祭司要把鳥拿到壇前，揪下頭來，把鳥燒在壇上；鳥的血要流在壇的旁邊；
verses.e: The priest shall bring it to the altar , and wring off its head , and burn it on the altar ; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar ;

verses.z: 又要把鳥的嗉子和髒物除掉，丟在壇的東邊[倒]灰的地方。
verses.e: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers , and cast it beside the altar on the east part , in the place of the ashes .

verses.z: 要拿着鳥的兩個翅膀，把鳥撕開，只是不可撕斷；祭司要在壇上、在火的柴上焚燒。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。」
verses.e: He shall tear it by its wings , but shall not divide it apart . The priest shall burn it on the altar , on the wood that is on the fire . It is a burnt offering , an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們中間若有人獻供物給耶和華，要從牛群羊群中獻牲畜為供物。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD , you shall offer your offering of the livestock , from the herd and from the flock .

verses.z: 「他的供物若以牛為燔祭，就要在會幕門口獻一隻沒有殘疾的公牛，可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
verses.e: " ' If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd , he shall offer a male without defect . He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting , that he may be accepted before the LORD .

verses.z: 他要按手在燔祭牲的頭上，燔祭便蒙悅納，為他贖罪。
verses.e: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering , and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him .

verses.z: 他要在耶和華面前宰公牛；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要奉上血，把血灑在會幕門口、壇的周圍。
verses.e: He shall kill the bull before the LORD . Aaron's sons , the priests , shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 那人要剝去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成塊子。
verses.e: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces .

verses.z: 祭司亞倫的子孫要把火放在壇上，把柴擺在火上。
verses.e: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar , and lay wood in order on the fire ;

verses.z: 亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把肉塊和頭並脂油擺在壇上火的柴上。
verses.e: and Aaron's sons , the priests , shall lay the pieces , the head , and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar ;

verses.z: 但燔祭的臟腑與腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全燒在壇上，當作燔祭，獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water . The priest shall burn all of it on the altar , for a burnt offering , an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 亞倫的兒子拿答、亞比戶各拿自己的香爐，盛上火，加上香，在耶和華面前獻上凡火，是耶和華沒有吩咐他們的，
verses.e: Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , each took his censer , and put fire in it , and laid incense on it , and offered strange fire before the LORD , which he had not commanded them .

verses.z: 使你們可以將聖的、俗的，潔淨的、不潔淨的，分別出來；
verses.e: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common , and between the unclean and the clean .

verses.z: 又使你們可以將耶和華藉摩西曉諭以色列人的一切律例教訓他們。」
verses.e: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses . "

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫和他剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說：「你們獻給耶和華火祭中所剩的素祭，要在壇旁不帶酵而吃，因為是至聖的。
verses.e: Moses spoke to Aaron , and to Eleazar and to Ithamar , his sons who were left , " Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire , and eat it without yeast beside the altar ; for it is most holy ;

verses.z: 你們要在聖處吃；因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中，這是你的分和你兒子的分；所吩咐我的本是這樣。
verses.e: and you shall eat it in a holy place , because it is your portion , and your sons ' portion , of the offerings of the LORD made by fire ; for so I am commanded .

verses.z: 所搖的胸，所舉的腿，你們要在潔淨地方吃。你和你的兒女都要同吃；因為這些是從以色列人平安祭中給你，當你的分和你兒子的分。
verses.e: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place , you , and your sons , and your daughters with you : for they are given as your portion , and your sons ' portion , out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 所舉的腿，所搖的胸，他們要與火祭的脂油一同帶來當搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這要歸你和你兒子，當作永得的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐的。」
verses.e: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD . It shall be yours , and your sons ' with you , as a portion forever , as the LORD has commanded . "

verses.z: 當下摩西急切地尋找作贖罪祭的公山羊，誰知已經焚燒了，便向亞倫剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪發怒，說：
verses.e: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering , and , behold , it was burned . He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar , the sons of Aaron who were left , saying ,

verses.z: 「這贖罪祭既是至聖的，主又給了你們，為要你們擔當會眾的罪孽，在耶和華面前為他們贖罪，你們為何沒有在聖所吃呢？
verses.e: " Why haven't you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary , since it is most holy , and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation , to make atonement for them before the LORD ?

verses.z: 看哪，這祭牲的血並沒有拿到聖所裏去，你們本當照我所吩咐的，在聖所裏吃這祭肉。」
verses.e: Behold , its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary . You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary , as I commanded . "

verses.z: 亞倫對摩西說：「今天他們在耶和華面前獻上贖罪祭和燔祭，我又遇見這樣的災，若今天吃了贖罪祭，耶和華豈能看為美呢？」
verses.e: Aaron spoke to Moses , " Behold , today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD ; and such things as these have happened to me . If I had eaten the sin offering today , would it have been pleasing in the LORD's sight ? "

verses.z: 就有火從耶和華面前出來，把他們燒滅，他們就死在耶和華面前。
verses.e: Fire came out from before the LORD , and devoured them , and they died before the LORD .

verses.z: 摩西聽見[這話]，便以為美。
verses.e: When Moses heard that , it was pleasing in his sight .

verses.z: 於是摩西對亞倫說：「這就是耶和華所說：『我在親近我的人中要顯為聖；在眾民面前，我要得榮耀。』」亞倫就默默不言。
verses.e: Then Moses said to Aaron , " This is what the LORD spoke of , saying , ' I will show myself holy to those who come near me , and before all the people I will be glorified . ' " Aaron held his peace .

verses.z: 摩西召了亞倫叔父烏薛的兒子米沙利、以利撒反來，對他們說：「上前來，把你們的親屬從聖所前抬到營外。」
verses.e: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan , the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron , and said to them , " Draw near , carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp . "

verses.z: 於是二人上前來，把他們穿着袍子抬到營外，是照摩西所吩咐的。
verses.e: So they came near , and carried them in their tunics out of the camp , as Moses had said .

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說：「不可蓬頭散髮，也不可撕裂衣裳，免得你們死亡，又免得耶和華向會眾發怒；只要你們的弟兄以色列全家為耶和華所發的火哀哭。
verses.e: Moses said to Aaron , and to Eleazar and to Ithamar , his sons , " Don't let the hair of your heads go loose , and don't tear your clothes , so that you don't die , and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation ; but let your brothers , the whole house of Israel , bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled .

verses.z: 你們也不可出會幕的門，恐怕你們死亡，因為耶和華的膏油在你們的身上。」他們就照摩西的話行了。
verses.e: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting , lest you die ; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you . " They did according to the word of Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭亞倫說：
verses.e: Then the LORD said to Aaron ,

verses.z: 「你和你兒子進會幕的時候，清酒、濃酒都不可喝，免得你們死亡；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: " You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting , or you will die . This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying to them ,

verses.z: 凡在海裏、河裏，並一切水裏游動的活物，無翅無鱗的，你們都當以為可憎。
verses.e: All that don't have fins and scales in the seas and rivers , all that move in the waters , and all the living creatures that are in the waters , they are an abomination to you ,

verses.z: 這些無翅無鱗、以為可憎的，你們不可吃牠的肉；死的也當以為可憎。
verses.e: and you shall detest them . You shall not eat of their meat , and you shall detest their carcasses .

verses.z: 凡水裏無翅無鱗的，你們都當以為可憎。
verses.e: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you .

verses.z: 「雀鳥中你們當以為可憎、不可吃的乃是：鵰、狗頭鵰、紅頭鵰、
verses.e: " ' You shall detest these among the birds ; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination : the eagle , the vulture , the black vulture ,

verses.z: 鷂鷹、小鷹與其類；
verses.e: the red kite , any kind of black kite ,

verses.z: 烏鴉與其類；
verses.e: any kind of raven ,

verses.z: 鴕鳥、夜鷹、魚鷹、鷹與其類；
verses.e: the horned owl , the screech owl , the gull , any kind of hawk ,

verses.z: 鴞鳥、鸕鶿、貓頭鷹、
verses.e: the little owl , the cormorant , the great owl ,

verses.z: 角鴟、鵜鶘、禿鵰、
verses.e: the white owl , the desert owl , the osprey ,

verses.z: 鸛、鷺鷥與其類；戴鵀與蝙蝠。
verses.e: the stork , any kind of heron , the hoopoe , and the bat .

verses.z: 「你們曉諭以色列人說，在地上一切走獸中可吃的乃是這些：
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth .

verses.z: 「凡有翅膀用四足爬行的物，你們都當以為可憎。
verses.e: " ' All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you .

verses.z: 只是有翅膀用四足爬行的物中，有足有腿，在地上蹦跳的，你們還可以吃。
verses.e: Yet you may eat these : of all winged creeping things that go on all fours , which have long , jointed legs for hopping on the earth .

verses.z: 其中有蝗蟲、螞蚱、蟋蟀與其類；蚱蜢與其類；這些你們都可以吃。
verses.e: Even of these you may eat : any kind of locust , any kind of katydid , any kind of cricket , and any kind of grasshopper .

verses.z: 但是有翅膀有四足的爬物，你們都當以為可憎。
verses.e: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you .

verses.z: 「這些都能使你們不潔淨。凡摸了死的，必不潔淨到晚上。
verses.e: " ' By these you will become unclean : whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 凡拿了死的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。
verses.e: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 凡走獸分蹄不成兩瓣、也不倒嚼的，是與你們不潔淨；凡摸了的就不潔淨。
verses.e: " ' Every animal which has a split hoof that isn't completely divided , or doesn't chew the cud , is unclean to you . Everyone who touches them shall be unclean .

verses.z: 凡四足的走獸，用掌行走的，是與你們不潔淨；摸其屍的，必不潔淨到晚上。
verses.e: Whatever goes on its paws , among all animals that go on all fours , they are unclean to you . Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 拿其屍的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。這些是與你們不潔淨的。
verses.e: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the evening . They are unclean to you .

verses.z: 「地上爬物與你們不潔淨的乃是這些：鼬鼠、鼫鼠、蜥蜴與其類；
verses.e: " ' These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth : the weasel , the rat , any kind of great lizard ,

verses.z: 凡蹄分兩瓣、倒嚼的走獸，你們都可以吃。
verses.e: Whatever parts the hoof , and is cloven-footed , and chews the cud among the animals , that you may eat .

verses.z: 壁虎、龍子、守宮、蛇醫、蝘蜓。
verses.e: the gecko , and the monitor lizard , the wall lizard , the skink , and the chameleon .

verses.z: 這些爬物都是與你們不潔淨的。在牠死了以後，凡摸了的，必不潔淨到晚上。
verses.e: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep . Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 其中死了的，掉在甚麼東西上，這東西就不潔淨，無論是木器、衣服、皮子、口袋，不拘是做甚麼工用的器皿，須要放在水中，必不潔淨到晚上，到晚上才潔淨了。
verses.e: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean ; whether it is any vessel of wood , or clothing , or skin , or sack , whatever vessel it is , with which any work is done , it must be put into water , and it shall be unclean until the evening . Then it will be clean .

verses.z: 若有死了掉在瓦器裏的，其中不拘有甚麼，就不潔淨，你們要把這瓦器打破了。
verses.e: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean . You shall break it .

verses.z: 其中一切可吃的食物，沾水的就不潔淨，並且那樣器皿中一切可喝的，也必不潔淨。
verses.e: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean . All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean .

verses.z: 其中已死的，若有一點掉在甚麼物件上，那物件就不潔淨，不拘是爐子，是鍋臺，就要打碎，都不潔淨，也必與你們不潔淨。
verses.e: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean ; whether oven , or range for pots , it shall be broken in pieces . They are unclean , and shall be unclean to you .

verses.z: 但是泉源或是聚水的池子仍是潔淨；惟挨了那死的，就不潔淨。
verses.e: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean , but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean .

verses.z: 若是死的，有一點掉在要種的子粒上，子粒仍是潔淨；
verses.e: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown , it is clean .

verses.z: 若水已經澆在子粒上，那死的有一點掉在上頭，這子粒就與你們不潔淨。
verses.e: But if water is put on the seed , and part of their carcass falls on it , it is unclean to you .

verses.z: 「你們可吃的走獸若是死了，有人摸牠，必不潔淨到晚上；
verses.e: " ' If any animal of which you may eat dies , he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 但那倒嚼或分蹄之中不可吃的乃是：駱駝－因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
verses.e: " ' Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud , or of those who part the hoof : the camel , because it chews the cud but doesn't have a parted hoof , is unclean to you .

verses.z: 有人吃那死了的走獸，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服；拿了死走獸的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。
verses.e: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the evening . He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 「凡地上的爬物是可憎的，都不可吃。
verses.e: " ' Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination . It shall not be eaten .

verses.z: 凡用肚子行走的和用四足行走的，或是有許多足的，就是一切爬在地上的，你們都不可吃，因為是可憎的。
verses.e: Whatever goes on its belly , and whatever goes on all fours , or whatever has many feet , even all creeping things that creep on the earth , them you shall not eat ; for they are an abomination .

verses.z: 你們不可因甚麼爬物使自己成為可憎的，也不可因這些使自己不潔淨，以致染了污穢。
verses.e: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps . You shall not make yourselves unclean with them , that you should be defiled by them .

verses.z: 我是耶和華－你們的上帝；所以你們要成為聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。你們也不可在地上的爬物污穢自己。
verses.e: For I am the LORD your God . Sanctify yourselves therefore , and be holy ; for I am holy . You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth .

verses.z: 我是把你們從埃及地領出來的耶和華，要作你們的上帝；所以你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。」
verses.e: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt , to be your God . You shall therefore be holy , for I am holy .

verses.z: 這是走獸、飛鳥，和水中游動的活物，並地上爬物的條例。
verses.e: " ' This is the law of the animal , and of the bird , and of every living creature that moves in the waters , and of every creature that creeps on the earth ,

verses.z: 要把潔淨的和不潔淨的，可吃的與不可吃的活物，都分別出來。
verses.e: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean , and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten . ' "

verses.z: 沙番－因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
verses.e: The hyrax , because it chews the cud but doesn't have a parted hoof , is unclean to you .

verses.z: 觠子－因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
verses.e: The hare , because it chews the cud but doesn't have a parted hoof , is unclean to you .

verses.z: 豬－因為蹄分兩瓣，卻不倒嚼，就與你們不潔淨。
verses.e: The pig , because it has a split hoof , and is cloven-footed , but doesn't chew the cud , is unclean to you .

verses.z: 這些獸的肉，你們不可吃；死的，你們不可摸，都與你們不潔淨。
verses.e: You shall not eat their meat . You shall not touch their carcasses . They are unclean to you .

verses.z: 「水中可吃的乃是這些：凡在水裏、海裏、河裏、有翅有鱗的，都可以吃。
verses.e: " ' You may eat of all these that are in the waters : whatever has fins and scales in the waters , in the seas , and in the rivers , that you may eat .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：若有婦人懷孕生男孩，她就不潔淨七天，像在月經污穢的日子不潔淨一樣。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' If a woman conceives , and bears a male child , then she shall be unclean seven days ; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean .

verses.z: 第八天，要給嬰孩行割禮。
verses.e: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised .

verses.z: 婦人在產血不潔之中，要家居三十三天。她潔淨的日子未滿，不可摸聖物，也不可進入聖所。
verses.e: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days . She shall not touch any holy thing , nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying are completed .

verses.z: 她若生女孩，就不潔淨兩個七天，像污穢[的時候]一樣，要在產血不潔之中，家居六十六天。
verses.e: But if she bears a female child , then she shall be unclean two weeks , as in her period ; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days .

verses.z: 「滿了潔淨的日子，無論是為男孩是為女孩，她要把一歲的羊羔為燔祭，一隻雛鴿或是一隻斑鳩為贖罪祭，帶到會幕門口交給祭司。
verses.e: " ' When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter , she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting , a year old lamb for a burnt offering , and a young pigeon or a turtledove , for a sin offering .

verses.z: 祭司要獻在耶和華面前，為她贖罪，她的血源就潔淨了。這條例是為生育的婦人，無論是生男生女。
verses.e: He shall offer it before the LORD , and make atonement for her ; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood . " ' This is the law for her who bears , whether a male or a female .

verses.z: 她的力量若不夠獻一隻羊羔，她就要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻為燔祭，一隻為贖罪祭。祭司要為她贖罪，她就潔淨了。」
verses.e: If she cannot afford a lamb , then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons : the one for a burnt offering , and the other for a sin offering . The priest shall make atonement for her , and she shall be clean . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 祭司要察看，皮上若長了白癤，使毛變白，在長白癤之處有了紅瘀肉，
verses.e: and the priest shall examine him . Behold , if there is a white swelling in the skin , and it has turned the hair white , and there is raw flesh in the swelling ,

verses.z: 這是肉皮上的舊大痲瘋，祭司要定他為不潔淨，不用將他關鎖，因為他是不潔淨了。
verses.e: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean . He shall not isolate him , for he is already unclean .

verses.z: 大痲瘋若在皮上四外發散，長滿了患災病人的皮，據祭司察看，從頭到腳無處不有，
verses.e: " If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin , and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet , as far as it appears to the priest ,

verses.z: 祭司就要察看，全身的肉若長滿了大痲瘋，就要定那患災病的為潔淨；全身都變為白，他乃潔淨了。
verses.e: then the priest shall examine him . Behold , if the leprosy has covered all his flesh , he shall pronounce him clean of the plague . It has all turned white : he is clean .

verses.z: 但紅肉幾時顯在他的身上就幾時不潔淨。
verses.e: But whenever raw flesh appears in him , he shall be unclean .

verses.z: 祭司一看那紅肉就定他為不潔淨。紅肉本是不潔淨，是大痲瘋。
verses.e: The priest shall examine the raw flesh , and pronounce him unclean : the raw flesh is unclean . It is leprosy .

verses.z: 紅肉若復原，又變白了，他就要來見祭司。
verses.e: Or if the raw flesh turns again , and is changed to white , then he shall come to the priest .

verses.z: 祭司要察看，災病處若變白了，祭司就要定那患災病的為潔淨，他乃潔淨了。
verses.e: The priest shall examine him . Behold , if the plague has turned white , then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague . He is clean .

verses.z: 「人若在皮肉上長瘡，卻治好了，
verses.e: " When the body has a boil on its skin , and it has healed ,

verses.z: 在長瘡之處又起了白癤，或是白中帶紅的火斑，就要給祭司察看。
verses.e: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling , or a bright spot , reddish-white , then it shall be shown to the priest .

verses.z: 「人的肉皮上若長了癤子，或長了癬，或長了火斑，在他肉皮上成了大痲瘋的災病，就要將他帶到祭司亞倫或亞倫作祭司的一個子孫面前。
verses.e: " When a man shall have a swelling in his body's skin , or a scab , or a bright spot , and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy , then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons , the priests .

verses.z: 祭司要察看，若現象窪於皮，其上的毛也變白了，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病發在瘡中。
verses.e: The priest shall examine it . Behold , if its appearance is deeper than the skin , and its hair has turned white , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean . It is the plague of leprosy . It has broken out in the boil .

verses.z: 祭司若察看，其上沒有白毛，也沒有窪於皮，乃是發暗，就要將他關鎖七天。
verses.e: But if the priest examines it , and behold , there are no white hairs in it , and it isn't deeper than the skin , but is dim , then the priest shall isolate him seven days .

verses.z: 若在皮上發散開了，祭司就要定他為不潔淨，是災病。
verses.e: If it spreads in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean . It is a plague .

verses.z: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有發散，便是瘡的痕跡，祭司就要定他為潔淨。
verses.e: But if the bright spot stays in its place , and hasn't spread , it is the scar from the boil ; and the priest shall pronounce him clean .

verses.z: 「人的皮肉上若起了火毒，火毒的瘀[肉]成了火斑，或是白中帶紅的，或是全白的，
