verses.e: " Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin , and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot , reddish-white , or white ,

verses.z: 祭司就要察看，火斑中的毛若變白了，現象又深於皮，是大痲瘋在火毒中發出，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病。
verses.e: then the priest shall examine it ; and behold , if the hair in the bright spot has turned white , and its appearance is deeper than the skin , it is leprosy . It has broken out in the burning , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean . It is the plague of leprosy .

verses.z: 但是祭司察看，在火斑中若沒有白毛，也沒有窪於皮，乃是發暗，就要將他關鎖七天。
verses.e: But if the priest examines it , and behold , there is no white hair in the bright spot , and it isn't deeper than the skin , but has faded , then the priest shall isolate him seven days .

verses.z: 到第七天，祭司要察看他，火斑若在皮上發散開了，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病。
verses.e: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day . If it has spread in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean . It is the plague of leprosy .

verses.z: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有在皮上發散，乃是發暗，是起的火毒，祭司要定他為潔淨，不過是火毒的痕跡。
verses.e: If the bright spot stays in its place , and hasn't spread in the skin , but is faded , it is the swelling from the burn , and the priest shall pronounce him clean , for it is the scar from the burn .

verses.z: 「無論男女，若在頭上有災病，或是男人鬍鬚上有災病，
verses.e: " When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard ,

verses.z: 祭司要察看肉皮上的災病，若災病處的毛已經變白，災病的現象深於肉上的皮，這便是大痲瘋的災病。祭司要察看他，定他為不潔淨。
verses.e: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body . If the hair in the plague has turned white , and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body's skin , it is the plague of leprosy ; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean .

verses.z: 祭司就要察看；這災病現象若深於皮，其間有細黃毛，就要定他為不潔淨，這是頭疥，是頭上或是鬍鬚上的大痲瘋。
verses.e: then the priest shall examine the plague ; and behold , if its appearance is deeper than the skin , and the hair in it is yellow and thin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean . It is an itch . It is leprosy of the head or of the beard .

verses.z: 祭司若察看頭疥的災病，現象不深於皮，其間也沒有黑毛，就要將長頭疥災病的關鎖七天。
verses.e: If the priest examines the plague of itching , and behold , its appearance isn't deeper than the skin , and there is no black hair in it , then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days .

verses.z: 第七天，祭司要察看災病，若頭疥沒有發散，其間也沒有黃毛，頭疥的現象不深於皮，
verses.e: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague ; and behold , if the itch hasn't spread , and there is no yellow hair in it , and the appearance of the itch isn't deeper than the skin ,

verses.z: 那人就要剃去鬚髮，但他不可剃頭疥之處。祭司要將那長頭疥的，再關鎖七天。
verses.e: then he shall be shaved , but he shall not shave the itch . Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days .

verses.z: 第七天，祭司要察看頭疥，頭疥若沒有在皮上發散，現象也不深於皮，就要定他為潔淨，他要洗衣服，便成為潔淨。
verses.e: On the seventh day , the priest shall examine the itch ; and behold , if the itch hasn't spread in the skin , and its appearance isn't deeper than the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him clean . He shall wash his clothes and be clean .

verses.z: 但他得潔淨以後，頭疥若在皮上發散開了，
verses.e: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing ,

verses.z: 祭司就要察看他。頭疥若在皮上發散，就不必找那黃毛，他是不潔淨了。
verses.e: then the priest shall examine him ; and behold , if the itch has spread in the skin , the priest shall not look for the yellow hair ; he is unclean .

verses.z: 祭司若看頭疥已經止住，其間也長了黑毛，頭疥已然痊癒，那人是潔淨了，就要定他為潔淨。
verses.e: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it , then the itch is healed . He is clean . The priest shall pronounce him clean .

verses.z: 「無論男女，皮肉上若起了火斑，就是白火斑，
verses.e: " When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body , even white bright spots ,

verses.z: 祭司就要察看，他們肉皮上的火斑若白中帶黑，這是皮上發出的白癬，那人是潔淨了。
verses.e: then the priest shall examine them . Behold , if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white , it is a harmless rash . It has broken out in the skin . He is clean .

verses.z: 若火斑在他肉皮上是白的，現象不深於皮，其上的毛也沒有變白，祭司就要將有災病的人關鎖七天。
verses.e: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body , and its appearance isn't deeper than the skin , and its hair hasn't turned white , then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days .

verses.z: 「人頭上的髮若掉了，他不過是頭禿，還是潔淨。
verses.e: " If a man's hair has fallen from his head , he is bald . He is clean .

verses.z: 他頂前若掉了頭髮，他不過是頂門禿，還是潔淨。
verses.e: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head , his forehead is bald . He is clean .

verses.z: 頭禿處或是頂門禿處若有白中帶紅的災病，這就是大痲瘋發在他頭禿處或是頂門禿處，
verses.e: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead , it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead .

verses.z: 祭司就要察看，他起的那災病若在頭禿處或是頂門禿處有白中帶紅的，像肉皮上大痲瘋的現象，
verses.e: Then the priest shall examine him . Behold , if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head , or in his bald forehead , like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body ,

verses.z: 那人就是長大痲瘋，不潔淨的，祭司總要定他為不潔淨，他的災病是在頭上。
verses.e: he is a leprous man . He is unclean . The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean . His plague is on his head .

verses.z: 「身上有長大痲瘋災病的，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬頭散髮，蒙着上唇，喊叫說：『不潔淨了！不潔淨了！』
verses.e: " The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes , and the hair of his head shall hang loose . He shall cover his upper lip , and shall cry , ' Unclean ! Unclean ! '

verses.z: 災病在他身上的日子，他便是不潔淨；他既是不潔淨，就要獨居營外。」
verses.e: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean . He is unclean . He shall dwell alone . His dwelling shall be outside of the camp .

verses.z: 「染了大痲瘋災病的衣服，無論是羊毛衣服、是麻布衣服，
verses.e: " The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in , whether it is a woolen garment , or a linen garment ;

verses.z: 無論是在經上、在緯上，是麻布的、是羊毛的，是在皮子上，或在皮子做的甚麼物件上，
verses.e: whether it is in warp or woof ; of linen or of wool ; whether in leather , or in anything made of leather ;

verses.z: 或在衣服上、皮子上，經上、緯上，或在皮子做的甚麼物件上，這災病若是發綠，或是發紅，是大痲瘋的災病，要給祭司察看。
verses.e: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the leather , or in the warp , or in the woof , or in anything made of leather ; it is the plague of leprosy , and shall be shown to the priest .

verses.z: 第七天，祭司要察看他，若看災病止住了，沒有在皮上發散，祭司還要將他關鎖七天。
verses.e: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day . Behold , if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn't spread in the skin , then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days .

verses.z: 祭司就要察看那災病，把染了災病的物件關鎖七天。
verses.e: The priest shall examine the plague , and isolate the plague seven days .

verses.z: 第七天，他要察看那災病，災病或在衣服上，經上、緯上，皮子上，若發散，這皮子無論當作何用，這災病是蠶食的大痲瘋，都是不潔淨了。
verses.e: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day . If the plague has spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in the skin , whatever use the skin is used for , the plague is a destructive mildew . It is unclean .

verses.z: 那染了災病的衣服，或是經上、緯上，羊毛上，麻衣上，或是皮子做的甚麼物件上，他都要焚燒；因為這是蠶食的大痲瘋，必在火中焚燒。
verses.e: He shall burn the garment , whether the warp or the woof , in wool or in linen , or anything of leather , in which the plague is , for it is a destructive mildew . It shall be burned in the fire .

verses.z: 「祭司要察看，若災病在衣服上，經上、緯上，或是皮子做的甚麼物件上，沒有發散，
verses.e: " If the priest examines it , and behold , the plague hasn't spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in anything of skin ;

verses.z: 祭司就要吩咐他們，把染了災病的物件洗了，再關鎖七天。
verses.e: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in , and he shall isolate it seven more days .

verses.z: 洗過以後，祭司要察看，那物件若沒有變色，災病也沒有消散，那物件就不潔淨，是透重的災病，無論正面反面，都要在火中焚燒。
verses.e: Then the priest shall examine it , after the plague is washed ; and behold , if the plague hasn't changed its color , and the plague hasn't spread , it is unclean ; you shall burn it in the fire . It is a mildewed spot , whether the bareness is inside or outside .

verses.z: 洗過以後，祭司要察看，若見那災病發暗，他就要把那災病從衣服上，皮子上，經上、緯上，都撕去。
verses.e: If the priest looks , and behold , the plague has faded after it is washed , then he shall tear it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof ;

verses.z: 若仍現在衣服上，或是經上、緯上、皮子做的甚麼物件上，這就是災病又發了，必用火焚燒那染災病的物件。
verses.e: and if it appears again in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in anything of skin , it is spreading . You shall burn what the plague is in with fire .

verses.z: 所洗的衣服，或是經，或是緯，或是皮子做的甚麼物件，若災病離開了，要再洗，就潔淨了。」
verses.e: The garment , either the warp , or the woof , or whatever thing of skin it is , which you shall wash , if the plague has departed from them , then it shall be washed the second time , and it will be clean . "

verses.z: 這就是大痲瘋災病的條例，無論是在羊毛衣服上，麻布衣服上，經上、緯上，和皮子做的甚麼物件上，可以定為潔淨或是不潔淨。
verses.e: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen , either in the warp , or the woof , or in anything of skin , to pronounce it clean , or to pronounce it unclean .

verses.z: 第七天，祭司要再察看他，若災病發暗，而且沒有在皮上發散，祭司要定他為潔淨，原來是癬；那人就要洗衣服，得為潔淨。
verses.e: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day . Behold , if the plague has faded and the plague hasn't spread in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him clean . It is a scab . He shall wash his clothes , and be clean .

verses.z: 但他為得潔淨，將身體給祭司察看以後，癬若在皮上發散開了，他要再將身體給祭司察看。
verses.e: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing , he shall show himself to the priest again .

verses.z: 祭司要察看，癬若在皮上發散，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋。
verses.e: The priest shall examine him ; and behold , if the scab has spread on the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean . It is leprosy .

verses.z: 「人有了大痲瘋的災病，就要將他帶到祭司面前。
verses.e: " When the plague of leprosy is in a man , then he shall be brought to the priest ;

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：「
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「第八天，他要取兩隻沒有殘疾的公羊羔和一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔，又要把調油的細麵[伊法]十分之三為素祭，並油一羅革，一同取來。
verses.e: " On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect , one ewe lamb a year old without defect , three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering , mixed with oil , and one log of oil .

verses.z: 行潔淨之禮的祭司要將那求潔淨的人和這些東西安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前。
verses.e: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed , and those things , before the LORD , at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 祭司要取一隻公羊羔獻為贖愆祭，和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；
verses.e: " The priest shall take one of the male lambs , and offer him for a trespass offering , with the log of oil , and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.z: 把公羊羔宰於聖地，就是宰贖罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地。贖愆祭要歸祭司，與贖罪祭一樣，是至聖的。
verses.e: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering , in the place of the sanctuary ; for as the sin offering is the priest's , so is the trespass offering . It is most holy .

verses.z: 祭司要取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
verses.e: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed , and on the thumb of his right hand , and on the big toe of his right foot .

verses.z: 祭司要從那一羅革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌裏，
verses.e: The priest shall take some of the log of oil , and pour it into the palm of his own left hand .

verses.z: 把右手的一個指頭蘸在左手的油裏，在耶和華面前用指頭彈七次。
verses.e: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand , and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD .

verses.z: 將手裏所剩的油抹在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹在贖愆祭牲的血上。
verses.e: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed , and on the thumb of his right hand , and on the big toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering .

verses.z: 祭司手裏所剩的油要抹在那求潔淨人的頭上，在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
verses.e: The rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed , and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD .

verses.z: 祭司要獻贖罪祭，為那本不潔淨、求潔淨的人贖罪；然後要宰燔祭牲，
verses.e: " The priest shall offer the sin offering , and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness . Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering ;

verses.z: 長大痲瘋得潔淨的日子，其例乃是這樣：要帶他去見祭司；
verses.e: " This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing : He shall be brought to the priest ,

verses.z: 把燔祭和素祭獻在壇上，為他贖罪，他就潔淨了。
verses.e: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar . The priest shall make atonement for him , and he shall be clean .

verses.z: 「他若貧窮不能預備夠數，就要取一隻公羊羔作贖愆祭，可以搖一搖，為他贖罪；也要把調油的細麵[伊法]十分之一為素祭，和油一羅革一同取來；
verses.e: " If he is poor , and can't afford so much , then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved , to make atonement for him , and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering , and a log of oil ;

verses.z: 又照他的力量取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭。
verses.e: and two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , such as he is able to afford ; and the one shall be a sin offering , and the other a burnt offering .

verses.z: 第八天，要為潔淨，把這些帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司。
verses.e: " On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest , to the door of the Tent of Meeting , before the LORD .

verses.z: 祭司要把贖愆祭的羊羔和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
verses.e: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering , and the log of oil , and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.z: 要宰了贖愆祭的羊羔，取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
verses.e: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering . The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed , and on the thumb of his right hand , and on the big toe of his right foot .

verses.z: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌裏，
verses.e: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand ;

verses.z: 把左手裏的油，在耶和華面前，用右手的一個指頭彈七次，
verses.e: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD .

verses.z: 又把手裏的油抹些在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹贖愆祭之血的原處。
verses.e: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed , and on the thumb of his right hand , and on the big toe of his right foot , on the place of the blood of the trespass offering .

verses.z: 祭司手裏所剩的油要抹在那求潔淨人的頭上，在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
verses.e: The rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed , to make atonement for him before the LORD .

verses.z: 祭司要出到營外察看，若見他的大痲瘋痊癒了，
verses.e: and the priest shall go out of the camp . The priest shall examine him . Behold , if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper ,

verses.z: 那人又要照他的力量獻上一隻斑鳩或是一隻雛鴿，
verses.e: He shall offer one of the turtledoves , or of the young pigeons , which ever he is able to afford ,

verses.z: 就是他所能辦的，一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭，與素祭一同獻上；祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
verses.e: of the kind he is able to afford , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , with the meal offering . The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD . "

verses.z: 這是那有大痲瘋災病的人、不能將[關乎]得潔淨之物預備夠數的條例。」
verses.e: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy , who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們到了我賜給你們為業的迦南地，我若使你們所得為業之地的房屋中有大痲瘋的災病，
verses.e: " When you have come into the land of Canaan , which I give to you for a possession , and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession ,

verses.z: 房主就要去告訴祭司說：『據我看，房屋中似乎有災病。』
verses.e: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest , saying , ' There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house . '

verses.z: 祭司還沒有進去察看災病以前，就要吩咐人把房子騰空，免得房子裏所有的都成了不潔淨；然後祭司要進去察看房子。
verses.e: The priest shall command that they empty the house , before the priest goes in to examine the plague , that all that is in the house not be made unclean . Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house .

verses.z: 他要察看那災病，災病若在房子的牆上有發綠或發紅的凹斑紋，現象窪於牆，
verses.e: He shall examine the plague ; and behold , if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks , greenish or reddish , and it appears to be deeper than the wall ,

verses.z: 祭司就要出到房門外，把房子封鎖七天。
verses.e: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house , and shut up the house seven days .

verses.z: 第七天，祭司要再去察看，災病若在房子的牆上發散，
verses.e: The priest shall come again on the seventh day , and look . If the plague has spread in the walls of the house ,

verses.z: 就要吩咐人為那求潔淨的拿兩隻潔淨的活鳥和香柏木、朱紅色[線]，並牛膝草來。
verses.e: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds , cedar wood , scarlet , and hyssop .

verses.z: 就要吩咐人把那有災病的石頭挖出來，扔在城外不潔淨之處；
verses.e: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague , and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city .

verses.z: 也要叫人刮房內的四圍，所刮掉的灰泥要倒在城外不潔淨之處；
verses.e: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over . They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place .

verses.z: 又要用別的石頭代替那挖出來的石頭，要另用灰泥墁房子。
verses.e: They shall take other stones , and put them in the place of those stones ; and he shall take other mortar , and shall plaster the house .

verses.z: 「他挖出石頭，刮了房子，墁了以後，災病若在房子裏又發現，
verses.e: " If the plague comes again , and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones , and after he has scraped the house , and after it was plastered ,

verses.z: 祭司就要進去察看，災病若在房子裏發散，這就是房內蠶食的大痲瘋，是不潔淨。
verses.e: then the priest shall come in and look ; and behold , if the plague has spread in the house , it is a destructive mildew in the house . It is unclean .

verses.z: 他就要拆毀房子，把石頭、木頭、灰泥都搬到城外不潔淨之處。
verses.e: He shall break down the house , its stones , and its timber , and all the house's mortar . He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place .

verses.z: 在房子封鎖的時候，進去的人必不潔淨到晚上；
verses.e: " Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 在房子裏躺着的必洗衣服；在房子裏吃飯的也必洗衣服。
verses.e: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes ; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes .

verses.z: 「房子墁了以後，祭司若進去察看，見災病在房內沒有發散，就要定房子為潔淨，因為災病已經消除。
verses.e: " If the priest shall come in , and examine it , and behold , the plague hasn't spread in the house , after the house was plastered , then the priest shall pronounce the house clean , because the plague is healed .

verses.z: 要為潔淨房子取兩隻鳥和香柏木、朱紅色[線]並牛膝草，
verses.e: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds , cedar wood , scarlet , and hyssop .

verses.z: 祭司要吩咐用瓦器盛活水，把一隻鳥宰在上面。
verses.e: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water .

verses.z: 用瓦器盛活水，把一隻鳥宰在上面，
verses.e: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water .

verses.z: 把香柏木、牛膝草、朱紅色[線]，並那活鳥，都蘸在被宰的鳥血中與活水中，用以灑房子七次。
verses.e: He shall take the cedar wood , the hyssop , the scarlet , and the living bird , and dip them in the blood of the slain bird , and in the running water , and sprinkle the house seven times .

verses.z: 要用鳥血、活水、活鳥、香柏木、牛膝草，並朱紅色[線]，潔淨那房子。
verses.e: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird , and with the running water , with the living bird , with the cedar wood , with the hyssop , and with the scarlet ;

verses.z: 但要把活鳥放在城外田野裏。這樣潔淨房子，房子就潔淨了。」
verses.e: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field . So shall he make atonement for the house ; and it shall be clean . "

verses.z: 這是為各類大痲瘋的災病和頭疥，
verses.e: This is the law for any plague of leprosy , and for an itch ,

verses.z: 並衣服與房子的大痲瘋，
verses.e: and for the destructive mildew of a garment , and for a house ,

verses.z: 以及癤子、癬、火斑所立的條例，
verses.e: and for a swelling , and for a scab , and for a bright spot ;

verses.z: 指明何時為潔淨，何時為不潔淨。這是大痲瘋的條例。
verses.e: to teach when it is unclean , and when it is clean . This is the law of leprosy .

verses.z: 至於那隻活鳥，祭司要把牠和香柏木、朱紅色[線]並牛膝草一同蘸於宰在活水上的鳥血中，
verses.e: As for the living bird , he shall take it , the cedar wood , the scarlet , and the hyssop , and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water .

verses.z: 用以在那長大痲瘋求潔淨的人身上灑七次，就定他為潔淨，又把活鳥放在田野裏。
verses.e: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird go into the open field .

verses.z: 求潔淨的人當洗衣服，剃去毛髮，用水洗澡，就潔淨了；然後可以進營，只是要在自己的帳棚外居住七天。
verses.e: " He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes , and shave off all his hair , and bathe himself in water ; and he shall be clean . After that he shall come into the camp , but shall dwell outside his tent seven days .

verses.z: 第七天，再把頭上所有的頭髮與鬍鬚、眉毛，並全身的毛，都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就潔淨了。
verses.e: It shall be on the seventh day , that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows . He shall shave off all his hair . He shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his body in water . Then he shall be clean .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 凡摸了他身下之物的，必不潔淨到晚上；拿了那物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening . He who carries those things shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 患漏症的人沒有用水涮手，無論摸了誰，誰必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: " ' Whomever he who has the discharge touches , without having rinsed his hands in water , he shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 患漏症人所摸的瓦器就必打破；所摸的一切木器也必用水涮洗。
verses.e: " ' The earthen vessel , which he who has the discharge touches , shall be broken ; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water .

verses.z: 「患漏症的人痊癒了，就要為潔淨自己計算七天，也必洗衣服，用活水洗身，就潔淨了。
verses.e: " ' When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge , then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing , and wash his clothes ; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water , and shall be clean .

verses.z: 第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，來到會幕門口、耶和華面前，把鳥交給祭司。
verses.e: " ' On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , and come before the LORD to the door of the Tent of Meeting , and give them to the priest .

verses.z: 祭司要獻上一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人患的漏症，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
verses.e: The priest shall offer them , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering . The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge .

verses.z: 「人若[夢]遺，他必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗全身。
verses.e: " ' If any man has an emission of semen , then he shall bathe all his flesh in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 無論是衣服是皮子，被精所染，必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗。
verses.e: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 若男女交合，兩個人必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗澡。
verses.e: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen , they shall both bathe themselves in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 「女人行經，必污穢七天；凡摸她的，必不潔淨到晚上。
verses.e: " ' If a woman has a discharge , and her discharge in her flesh is blood , she shall be in her impurity seven days . Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 「你們曉諭以色列人說：人若身患漏症，他因這漏症就不潔淨了。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When any man has a discharge from his body , because of his discharge he is unclean .

verses.z: 女人在污穢之中，凡她所躺的物件都為不潔淨，所坐的物件也都不潔淨。
verses.e: " ' Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean . Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean .

verses.z: 凡摸她床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 凡摸她所坐甚麼物件的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 在女人的床上，或在她坐的物上，若有別的物件，人一摸了，必不潔淨到晚上。
verses.e: If it is on the bed , or on anything she sits on , when he touches it , he shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 男人若與那女人同房，染了她的污穢，就要七天不潔淨；所躺的床也為不潔淨。
verses.e: " ' If any man lies with her , and her monthly flow is on him , he shall be unclean seven days ; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean .

verses.z: 「女人若在經期以外患多日的血漏，或是經期過長，有了漏症，她就因這漏症不潔淨，與她在經期不潔淨一樣。
verses.e: " ' If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period , or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period , all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period . She is unclean .

verses.z: 她在患漏症的日子所躺的床、所坐的物都要看為不潔淨，與她月經的時候一樣。
verses.e: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period . Everything she sits on shall be unclean , as the uncleanness of her period .

verses.z: 凡摸這些物件的，就為不潔淨，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean , and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 女人的漏症若好了，就要計算七天，然後才為潔淨。
verses.e: " ' But if she is cleansed of her discharge , then she shall count to herself seven days , and after that she shall be clean .

verses.z: 第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，帶到會幕門口給祭司。
verses.e: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , and bring them to the priest , to the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 他患漏症，無論是下流的，是止住的，都是不潔淨。
verses.e: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge : whether his body runs with his discharge , or his body has stopped from his discharge , it is his uncleanness .

verses.z: 祭司要獻一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人血漏不潔，祭司要在耶和華面前為她贖罪。
verses.e: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering ; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge .

verses.z: 「你們要這樣使以色列人與他們的污穢隔絕，免得他們玷污我的帳幕，就因自己的污穢死亡。」
verses.e: " ' Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness , so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them . ' "

verses.z: 這是患漏症和[夢]遺而不潔淨的，
verses.e: This is the law of him who has a discharge , and of him who has an emission of semen , so that he is unclean by it ;

verses.z: 並有月經病的和患漏症的，無論男女，並人與不潔淨女人同房的條例。
verses.e: and of her who has her period , and of a man or woman who has a discharge , and of him who lies with her who is unclean .

verses.z: 他所躺的床都為不潔淨，所坐的物也為不潔淨。
verses.e: " ' Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean ; and everything he sits on shall be unclean .

verses.z: 凡摸那床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 那坐患漏症人所坐之物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 那摸患漏症人身體的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: " ' He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 若患漏症人吐在潔淨的人身上，那人必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.e: " ' If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean , then he shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 患漏症人所騎的鞍子也為不潔淨。
verses.e: " ' Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean .

verses.z: 亞倫的兩個兒子近到耶和華面前死了。死了之後，耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron , when they came near before the LORD , and died ;

verses.z: 但那拈鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒的羊要活着安置在耶和華面前，用以贖罪，打發[人送]到曠野去，歸與阿撒瀉勒。
verses.e: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD , to make atonement for him , to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness .

verses.z: 「亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛牽來宰了，為自己和本家贖罪；
verses.e: " Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering , which is for himself , and shall make atonement for himself and for his house , and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself .

verses.z: 拿香爐，從耶和華面前的壇上盛滿火炭，又拿一捧搗細的香料，都帶入幔子內，
verses.e: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD , and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small , and bring it within the veil .

verses.z: 在耶和華面前，把香放在火上，使香的煙雲遮掩法[櫃]上的施恩座，免得他死亡；
verses.e: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD , that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant , so that he will not die .

verses.z: 也要取些公牛的血，用指頭彈在施恩座的東面，又在施恩座的前面彈血七次。
verses.e: He shall take some of the blood of the bull , and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east ; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times .

verses.z: 「隨後他要宰那為百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血帶入幔子內，彈在施恩座的上面和前面，好像彈公牛的血一樣。
verses.e: " Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people , and bring his blood within the veil , and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull , and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat .

verses.z: 他因以色列人諸般的污穢、過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，當這樣在聖所行贖罪之禮，並因會幕在他們污穢之中，也要照樣而行。
verses.e: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel , and because of their transgressions , even all their sins ; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness .

verses.z: 他進聖所贖罪的時候，會幕裏不可有人，直等到他為自己和本家並以色列全會眾贖了罪出來。
verses.e: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place , until he comes out , and has made atonement for himself and for his household , and for all the assembly of Israel .

verses.z: 他出來，要到耶和華面前的壇那裏，在壇上行贖罪之禮，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在壇上四角的周圍；
verses.e: " He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it , and shall take some of the bull's blood , and some of the goat's blood , and put it around on the horns of the altar .

verses.z: 也要用指頭把血彈在壇上七次，潔淨了壇，從壇上除掉以色列人諸般的污穢，使壇成聖。」
verses.e: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times , and cleanse it , and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 「要告訴你哥哥亞倫，不可隨時進聖所的幔子內、到櫃上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因為我要從雲中顯現在施恩座上。
verses.e: and the LORD said to Moses , " Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil , before the mercy seat which is on the ark ; lest he die ; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat .

verses.z: 「亞倫為聖所和會幕並壇獻完了贖罪祭，就要把那隻活着的公山羊奉上。
verses.e: " When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place , the Tent of Meeting , and the altar , he shall present the live goat .

verses.z: 兩手按在羊頭上，承認以色列人諸般的罪孽過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，把這罪都歸在羊的頭上，藉着所派之人的手，送到曠野去。
verses.e: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat , and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel , and all their transgressions , even all their sins ; and he shall put them on the head of the goat , and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready .

verses.z: 要把這羊放在曠野，這羊要擔當他們一切的罪孽，帶到無人之地。
verses.e: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land , and he shall release the goat in the wilderness .

verses.z: 「亞倫要進會幕，把他進聖所時所穿的細麻布衣服脫下，放在那裏，
verses.e: " Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting , and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place , and shall leave them there .

verses.z: 又要在聖處用水洗身，穿上衣服，出來，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭獻上，為自己和百姓贖罪。
verses.e: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place , put on his garments , and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people , and make atonement for himself and for the people .

verses.z: 贖罪祭牲的脂油要在壇上焚燒。
verses.e: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar .

verses.z: 那放羊歸與阿撒瀉勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。
verses.e: " He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp .

verses.z: 作贖罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既帶入聖所贖罪，這牛羊就要搬到營外，將皮、肉、糞用火焚燒。
verses.e: The bull for the sin offering , and the goat for the sin offering , whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place , shall be carried outside the camp ; and they shall burn their skins , their flesh , and their dung with fire .

verses.z: 焚燒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。」
verses.e: He who burns them shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp .

verses.z: 「每逢七月初十日，你們要刻苦己心，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，甚麼工都不可做；這要作你們永遠的定例。
verses.e: " It shall be a statute to you forever : in the seventh month , on the tenth day of the month , you shall afflict your souls , and shall do no kind of work , whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you ;

verses.z: 亞倫進聖所，要帶一隻公牛犢為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。
verses.e: " Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering , and a ram for a burnt offering .

verses.z: 因在這日要為你們贖罪，使你們潔淨。你們要在耶和華面前得以潔淨，脫盡一切的罪愆。
verses.e: for on this day shall atonement be made for you , to cleanse you . You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD .

verses.z: 這日你們要守為聖安息日，要刻苦己心；這為永遠的定例。
verses.e: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you , and you shall afflict your souls . It is a statute forever .

verses.z: 那受膏、接續他父親承接聖職的祭司要穿上細麻布的聖衣，行贖罪之禮。
verses.e: The priest , who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father's place , shall make the atonement , and shall put on the linen garments , even the holy garments .

verses.z: 他要在至聖所和會幕與壇行贖罪之禮，並要為眾祭司和會眾的百姓贖罪。
verses.e: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary ; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar ; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly .

verses.z: 這要作你們永遠的定例－就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次為他們贖罪。」於是，亞倫照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.e: " This shall be an everlasting statute for you , to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins . " It was done as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 要穿上細麻布聖內袍，把細麻布褲子穿在身上，腰束細麻布帶子，頭戴細麻布冠冕；這都是聖服。他要用水洗身，然後穿戴。
verses.e: He shall put on the holy linen tunic . He shall have the linen trousers on his body , and shall put on the linen sash , and he shall be clothed with the linen turban . They are the holy garments . He shall bathe his body in water , and put them on .

verses.z: 要從以色列會眾取兩隻公山羊為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。
verses.e: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering , and one ram for a burnt offering .

verses.z: 「亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛奉上，為自己和本家贖罪；
verses.e: " Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering , which is for himself , and make atonement for himself and for his house .

verses.z: 也要把兩隻公山羊安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前，
verses.e: He shall take the two goats , and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 為那兩隻羊拈鬮，一鬮歸與耶和華，一鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒。
verses.e: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats : one lot for the LORD , and the other lot for the scapegoat .

verses.z: 亞倫要把那拈鬮歸與耶和華的羊獻為贖罪祭，
verses.e: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD , and offer him for a sin offering .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若吃甚麼血，我必向那吃血的人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
verses.e: " ' Any man of the house of Israel , or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them , who eats any kind of blood , I will set my face against that soul who eats blood , and will cut him off from among his people .

verses.z: 因為活物的生命是在血中。我把這血賜給你們，可以在壇上為你們的生命贖罪；因血裏有生命，所以能贖罪。
verses.e: For the life of the flesh is in the blood . I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls ; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life .

verses.z: 因此，我對以色列人說：你們都不可吃血；寄居在你們中間的外人也不可吃血。
verses.e: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel , " No person among you may eat blood , nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood . "

verses.z: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若打獵得了可吃的禽獸，必放出牠的血來，用土掩蓋。
verses.e: " ' Whatever man there is of the children of Israel , or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them , who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten , he shall pour out its blood , and cover it with dust .

verses.z: 「論到一切活物的生命，就在血中。所以我對以色列人說：無論甚麼活物的血，你們都不可吃，因為一切活物的血就是他的生命。凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
verses.e: For as to the life of all flesh , its blood is with its life . Therefore I said to the children of Israel , " You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh ; for the life of all flesh is its blood . Whoever eats it shall be cut off . "

verses.z: 凡吃自死的，或是被野獸撕裂的，無論是本地人，是寄居的，必不潔淨到晚上，都要洗衣服，用水洗身，到了晚上才為潔淨。
verses.e: " ' Every person that eats what dies of itself , or that which is torn by animals , whether he is native-born or a foreigner , shall wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the evening . Then he shall be clean .

verses.z: 但他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必擔當他的罪孽。」
verses.e: But if he doesn't wash them , or bathe his flesh , then he shall bear his iniquity . ' "

verses.z: 「你曉諭亞倫和他兒子並以色列眾人說，耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：
verses.e: " Speak to Aaron , and to his sons , and to all the children of Israel , and say to them , ' This is the thing which the LORD has commanded :

verses.z: 凡以色列家中的人宰公牛，或是綿羊羔，或是山羊，不拘宰於營內營外，
verses.e: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull , or lamb , or goat in the camp , or who kills it outside the camp ,

verses.z: 若未曾牽到會幕門口、耶和華的帳幕前獻給耶和華為供物，流血的罪必歸到那人身上。他流了血，要從民中剪除。
verses.e: and hasn't brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD before the LORD's tabernacle : blood shall be imputed to that man . He has shed blood . That man shall be cut off from among his people .

verses.z: 這是為要使以色列人把他們在田野裏所獻的祭帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司，獻與耶和華為平安祭。
verses.e: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices , which they sacrifice in the open field , that they may bring them to the LORD , to the door of the Tent of Meeting , to the priest , and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD .

verses.z: 祭司要把血灑在會幕門口、耶和華的壇上，把脂油焚燒，獻給耶和華為馨香的祭。
verses.e: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD's altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting , and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 他們不可再獻祭給他們行邪淫所隨從的鬼魔；這要作他們世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols , after which they play the prostitute . This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations . '

verses.z: 「你要曉諭他們說：凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，獻燔祭或是[平安]祭，
verses.e: " You shall say to them , ' Any man there is of the house of Israel , or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them , who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice ,

verses.z: 若不帶到會幕門口獻給耶和華，那人必從民中剪除。
verses.e: and doesn't bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD , that man shall be cut off from his people .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses ,

verses.z: 不可露你孫女或是外孫女的下體，露了她們的下體就是露了自己的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son's daughter , or of your daughter's daughter , even their nakedness ; for theirs is your own nakedness .

verses.z: 你繼母從你父親生的女兒本是你的妹妹，不可露她的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife's daughter , conceived by your father , since she is your sister .

verses.z: 不可露你姑母的下體；她是你父親的骨肉之親。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister . She is your father's near kinswoman .

verses.z: 不可露你姨母的下體；她是你母親的骨肉之親。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister , for she is your mother's near kinswoman .

verses.z: 不可親近你伯叔之妻，羞辱了你伯叔；她是你的伯叔母。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother . You shall not approach his wife . She is your aunt .

verses.z: 不可露你兒婦的下體；她是你兒子的妻，不可露她的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law . She is your son's wife . You shall not uncover her nakedness .

verses.z: 不可露你弟兄妻子的下體；這本是你弟兄的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife . It is your brother's nakedness .

verses.z: 不可露了婦人的下體，又露她女兒的下體，也不可娶她孫女或是外孫女，露她們的下體；她們是骨肉之親，這本是大惡。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter . You shall not take her son's daughter , or her daughter's daughter , to uncover her nakedness . They are near kinswomen . It is wickedness .

verses.z: 你妻還在的時候，不可另娶她的姊妹作對頭，露她的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister , to be a rival , to uncover her nakedness , while her sister is still alive .

verses.z: 「女人行經不潔淨的時候，不可露她的下體，與她親近。
verses.e: " ' You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness , as long as she is impure by her uncleanness .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and say to them , ' I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 不可與鄰舍的妻行淫，玷污自己。
verses.e: " ' You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor's wife , and defile yourself with her .

verses.z: 不可使你的兒女經火歸與摩洛，也不可褻瀆你上帝的名。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech . You shall not profane the name of your God . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 不可與男人苟合，像與女人一樣；這本是可憎惡的。
verses.e: " ' You shall not lie with a man as with a woman . That is detestable .

verses.z: 不可與獸淫合，玷污自己。女人也不可站在獸前，與牠淫合；這本是逆性的事。
verses.e: " ' You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it . No woman may give herself to an animal , to lie down with it : it is a perversion .

verses.z: 「在這一切的事上，你們都不可玷污自己；因為我在你們面前所逐出的列邦，在這一切的事上玷污了自己；
verses.e: " ' Don't defile yourselves in any of these things ; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled .

verses.z: 連地也玷污了，所以我追討那地的罪孽，那地也吐出它的居民。
verses.e: The land was defiled . Therefore I punished its iniquity , and the land vomited out her inhabitants .

verses.z: 故此，你們要守我的律例典章。這一切可憎惡的事，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，都不可行，（
verses.e: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances , and shall not do any of these abominations ; neither the native-born , nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

verses.z: 在你們以先居住那地的人行了這一切可憎惡的事，地就玷污了，）
verses.e: ( for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations , and the land became defiled ) ,

verses.z: 免得你們玷污那地的時候，地就把你們吐出，像吐出在你們以先的國民一樣。
verses.e: that the land not vomit you out also , when you defile it , as it vomited out the nation that was before you .

verses.z: 無論甚麼人，行了其中可憎的一件事，必從民中剪除。
verses.e: " ' For whoever shall do any of these abominations , even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people .

verses.z: 你們從前住的埃及地，那裏人的行為，你們不可效法，我要領你們到的迦南地，那裏人的行為也不可效法，也不可照他們的惡俗行。
verses.e: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt , where you lived . You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan , where I am bringing you . You shall not follow their statutes .

verses.z: 所以，你們要守我所吩咐的，免得你們隨從那些可憎的惡俗，就是在你們以先[的人]所常行的，以致玷污了自己。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: Therefore you shall keep my requirements , that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you , and that you do not defile yourselves with them . I am the LORD your God . ' "

verses.z: 你們要遵我的典章，守我的律例，按此而行。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: You shall do my ordinances . You shall keep my statutes and walk in them . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 所以，你們要守我的律例典章；人若遵行，就必因此活着。我是耶和華。
verses.e: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances , which if a man does , he shall live in them . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「你們都不可露骨肉之親的下體，親近他們。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' None of you shall approach any close relatives , to uncover their nakedness : I am the LORD .

verses.z: 不可露你母親的下體，羞辱了你父親。她是你的母親，不可露她的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father , nor the nakedness of your mother : she is your mother . You shall not uncover her nakedness .

verses.z: 不可露你繼母的下體；這本是你父親的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife . It is your father's nakedness .

verses.z: 你的姊妹，不拘是異母同父的，是異父同母的，無論是生在家生在外的，都不可露她們的下體。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister , the daughter of your father , or the daughter of your mother , whether born at home or born abroad .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 不可摘盡葡萄園的果子，也不可拾取葡萄園所掉的果子；要留給窮人和寄居的。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: You shall not glean your vineyard , neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard . You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你們不可偷盜，不可欺騙，也不可彼此說謊。
verses.e: " ' You shall not steal . " ' You shall not lie . " ' You shall not deceive one another .

verses.z: 不可指着我的名起假誓，褻瀆你上帝的名。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall not swear by my name falsely , and profane the name of your God . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「不可欺壓你的鄰舍，也不可搶奪他的物。雇工人的工價，不可在你那裏過夜，留到早晨。
verses.e: " ' You shall not oppress your neighbor , nor rob him . " ' The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning .

verses.z: 不可咒罵聾子，也不可將絆腳石放在瞎子面前，只要敬畏你的上帝。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall not curse the deaf , nor put a stumbling block before the blind ; but you shall fear your God . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「你們施行審判，不可行不義；不可偏護窮人，也不可重看有勢力的人，只要按着公義審判你的鄰舍。
verses.e: " ' You shall do no injustice in judgment . You shall not be partial to the poor , nor show favoritism to the great ; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness .

verses.z: 不可在民中往來搬弄是非，也不可與鄰舍為敵，置之於死。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people . " ' You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「不可心裏恨你的弟兄；總要指摘你的鄰舍，免得因他擔罪。
verses.e: " ' You shall not hate your brother in your heart . You shall surely rebuke your neighbor , and not bear sin because of him .

verses.z: 不可報仇，也不可埋怨你本國的子民，卻要愛人如己。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall not take vengeance , nor bear any grudge against the children of your people ; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「你們要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜與異類配合；不可用兩樣攙雜的種種你的地，也不可用兩樣攙雜的料做衣服穿在身上。
verses.e: " ' You shall keep my statutes . " ' You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals . " ' You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed ; " ' Don't wear a garment made of two kinds of material .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列全會眾說：你們要聖潔，因為我耶和華－你們的上帝是聖潔的。
verses.e: " Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel , and tell them , ' You shall be holy ; for I , the LORD your God , am holy .

verses.z: 「婢女許配了丈夫，還沒有被贖、得釋放，人若與她行淫，二人要受刑罰，卻不把他們治死，因為婢女還沒有得自由。
verses.e: " ' If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl , pledged to be married to another man , and not ransomed or given her freedom ; they shall be punished . They shall not be put to death , because she was not free .

verses.z: 那人要把贖愆祭，就是一隻公綿羊牽到會幕門口、耶和華面前。
verses.e: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD , to the door of the Tent of Meeting , even a ram for a trespass offering .

verses.z: 祭司要用贖愆祭的羊在耶和華面前贖他所犯的罪，他的罪就必蒙赦免。
verses.e: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed ; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him .

verses.z: 「你們到了迦南地，栽種各樣結果子的樹木，就要以所結的果子如未受割禮的一樣。三年之久，你們要以這些果子，如未受割禮的，是不可吃的。
verses.e: " ' When you come into the land , and have planted all kinds of trees for food , then you shall count their fruit as forbidden . For three years it shall be forbidden to you . It shall not be eaten .

verses.z: 但第四年所結的果子全要成為聖，用以讚美耶和華。
verses.e: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy , for giving praise to the LORD .

verses.z: 第五年，你們要吃那樹上的果子，好叫樹給你們結果子更多。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit , that it may yield its increase to you . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你們不可吃帶血的物；不可用法術，也不可觀兆。
verses.e: " ' You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it . You shall not use enchantments , nor practice sorcery .

verses.z: 頭的周圍不可剃，鬍鬚的周圍也不可損壞。
verses.e: " ' You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard .

verses.z: 不可為死人用刀劃身，也不可在身上刺花紋。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead , nor tattoo any marks on you . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「不可辱沒你的女兒，使她為娼妓，恐怕地上[的人]專向淫亂，地就滿了大惡。
verses.e: " ' Don't profane your daughter , to make her a prostitute ; lest the land fall to prostitution , and the land become full of wickedness .

verses.z: 你們各人都當孝敬父母，也要守我的安息日。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: " ' Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father . You shall keep my Sabbaths . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你們要守我的安息日，敬我的聖所。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall keep my Sabbaths , and reverence my sanctuary ; I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「不可偏向那些交鬼的和行巫術的；不可求問他們，以致被他們玷污了。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: " ' Don't turn to those who are mediums , nor to the wizards . Don't seek them out , to be defiled by them . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「在白髮的人面前，你要站起來；也要尊敬老人，又要敬畏你的上帝。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly ; and you shall fear your God . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「若有外人在你們國中和你同居，就不可欺負他。
verses.e: " ' If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land , you shall not do him wrong .

verses.z: 和你們同居的外人，你們要看他如本地人一樣，並要愛他如己，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you , and you shall love him as yourself ; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「你們施行審判，不可行不義；在尺、秤、升、斗上也是如此。
verses.e: " ' You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment , in measures of length , of weight , or of quantity .

verses.z: 要用公道天平、公道法碼、公道升斗、公道秤。我是耶和華－你們的上帝，曾把你們從埃及地領出來的。
verses.e: You shall have just balances , just weights , a just ephah , and a just hin . I am the LORD your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例典章。我是耶和華。」
verses.e: " ' You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances , and do them . I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 你們不可偏向虛無的神，也不可為自己鑄造神[像]。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: " ' Don't turn to idols , nor make molten gods for yourselves . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你們獻平安祭給耶和華的時候，要獻得可蒙悅納。
verses.e: " ' When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD , you shall offer it so that you may be accepted .

verses.z: 這祭物要在獻的那一天和第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就必用火焚燒。
verses.e: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it , and on the next day . If anything remains until the third day , it shall be burned with fire .

verses.z: 第三天若再吃，這就為可憎惡的，必不蒙悅納。
verses.e: If it is eaten at all on the third day , it is an abomination . It will not be accepted ;

verses.z: 凡吃的人必擔當他的罪孽；因為他褻瀆了耶和華的聖物，那人必從民中剪除。
verses.e: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity , because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD , and that soul shall be cut off from his people .

verses.z: 「在你們的地收割莊稼，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取所遺落的。
verses.e: " ' When you reap the harvest of your land , you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field , neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest .

verses.z: 「若有人獻素祭為供物給耶和華，要用細麵澆上油，加上乳香，
verses.e: " ' When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD , his offering shall be of fine flour . He shall pour oil on it , and put frankincense on it .

verses.z: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫。這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
verses.e: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons ' . It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire .

verses.z: 「凡獻給耶和華的素祭都不可有酵；因為你們不可燒一點酵、一點蜜當作火祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: " ' No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast ; for you shall burn no yeast , nor any honey , as an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 這些物要獻給耶和華作為初熟的供物，只是不可在壇上獻為馨香的祭。
verses.e: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD , but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar .

verses.z: 凡獻為素祭的供物都要用鹽調和，在素祭上不可缺了你上帝立約的鹽。一切的供物都要配鹽而獻。
verses.e: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt . You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering . With all your offerings you shall offer salt .

verses.z: 若向耶和華獻初熟之物為素祭，要獻上烘了的禾穗子，就是軋了的新穗子，當作初熟之物的素祭。
verses.e: " ' If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD , you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed .

verses.z: 並要抹上油，加上乳香；這是素祭。
verses.e: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it . It is a meal offering .

verses.z: 祭司要把其中作為紀念的，就是一些軋了的禾穗子和一些油，並所有的乳香，都焚燒，是向耶和華獻的火祭。」
verses.e: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil , along with all its frankincense . It is an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 帶到亞倫子孫作祭司的那裏；祭司就要從細麵中取出一把來，並取些油和所有的乳香，然後要把所取的這些作為紀念，燒在壇上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: He shall bring it to Aaron's sons , the priests . He shall take his handful of its fine flour , and of its oil , with all its frankincense , and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar , an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫；這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
verses.e: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons ' . It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire .

verses.z: 「若用爐中烤的物為素祭，就要用調油的無酵細麵餅，或是抹油的無酵薄餅。
verses.e: " ' When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven , it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil , or unleavened wafers anointed with oil .

verses.z: 若用鐵鏊上做的物為素祭，就要用調油的無酵細麵，
verses.e: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle , it shall be of unleavened fine flour , mixed with oil .

verses.z: 分成塊子，澆上油；這是素祭。
verses.e: You shall cut it in pieces , and pour oil on it . It is a meal offering .

verses.z: 若用煎盤做的物為素祭，就要用油與細麵做成。
verses.e: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan , it shall be made of fine flour with oil .

verses.z: 要把這些東西做的素祭帶到耶和華面前，並奉給祭司，帶到壇前。
verses.e: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD . It shall be presented to the priest , and he shall bring it to the altar .

verses.z: 祭司要從素祭中取出作為紀念的，燒在壇上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial , and shall burn it on the altar , an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「與鄰舍之妻行淫的，姦夫淫婦都必治死。
verses.e: " ' The man who commits adultery with another man's wife , even he who commits adultery with his neighbor's wife , the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 與繼母行淫的，就是羞辱了他父親，總要把他們二人治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
verses.e: " ' The man who lies with his father's wife has uncovered his father's nakedness . Both of them shall surely be put to death . Their blood shall be upon themselves .

verses.z: 與兒婦同房的，總要把他們二人治死；他們行了逆倫的事，罪要歸到他們身上。
verses.e: " ' If a man lies with his daughter-in-law , both of them shall surely be put to death . They have committed a perversion . Their blood shall be upon themselves .

verses.z: 人若與男人苟合，像與女人一樣，他們二人行了可憎的事，總要把他們治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
verses.e: " ' If a man lies with a male , as with a woman , both of them have committed an abomination . They shall surely be put to death . Their blood shall be upon themselves .

verses.z: 人若娶妻，並娶其母，便是大惡，要把這三人用火焚燒，使你們中間免去大惡。
verses.e: " ' If a man takes a wife and her mother , it is wickedness . They shall be burned with fire , both he and they , that there may be no wickedness among you .

verses.z: 人若與獸淫合，總要治死他，也要殺那獸。
verses.e: " ' If a man lies with an animal , he shall surely be put to death ; and you shall kill the animal .

verses.z: 女人若與獸親近，與牠淫合，你要殺那女人和那獸，總要把他們治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
verses.e: " ' If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it , you shall kill the woman and the animal . They shall surely be put to death . Their blood shall be upon them .

verses.z: 「人若娶他的姊妹，無論是異母同父的，是異父同母的，彼此見了下體，這是可恥的事；他們必在本民的眼前被剪除。他露了姊妹的下體，必擔當自己的罪孽。
verses.e: " ' If a man takes his sister — his father's daughter , or his mother's daughter — and sees her nakedness , and she sees his nakedness , it is a shameful thing . They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people . He has uncovered his sister's nakedness . He shall bear his iniquity .

verses.z: 婦人有月經，若與她同房，露了她的下體，就是露了婦人的血源，婦人也露了自己的血源，二人必從民中剪除。
verses.e: " ' If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period , and uncovers her nakedness , he has made her fountain naked , and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood . Both of them shall be cut off from among their people .

verses.z: 不可露姨母或是姑母的下體，這是露了骨肉之親的下體；二人必擔當自己的罪孽。
verses.e: " ' You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister , nor of your father's sister , for he has made his close relative naked . They shall bear their iniquity .

verses.z: 「你還要曉諭以色列人說：凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的兒女獻給摩洛的，總要治死他；本地人要用石頭把他打死。
verses.e: " Moreover , you shall tell the children of Israel , ' Anyone of the children of Israel , or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel , who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death . The people of the land shall stone that person with stones .

verses.z: 人若與伯叔之妻同房，就羞辱了他的伯叔；二人要擔當自己的罪，必無子女而死。
verses.e: If a man lies with his uncle's wife , he has uncovered his uncle's nakedness . They shall bear their sin . They shall die childless .

verses.z: 人若娶弟兄之妻，這本是污穢的事，羞辱了他的弟兄；二人必無子女。
verses.e: " ' If a man takes his brother's wife , it is an impurity . He has uncovered his brother's nakedness . They shall be childless .

verses.z: 「所以，你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例典章，免得我領你們去住的那地把你們吐出。
verses.e: " ' You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances , and do them , that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out .

verses.z: 我在你們面前所逐出的國民，你們不可隨從他們的風俗；因為他們行了這一切的事，所以我厭惡他們。
verses.e: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you ; for they did all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .

verses.z: 但我對你們說過，你們要承受他們的地，就是我要賜給你們為業、流奶與蜜之地。我是耶和華－你們的上帝，使你們與萬民有分別的。
verses.e: But I have said to you , " You shall inherit their land , and I will give it to you to possess it , a land flowing with milk and honey . " I am the LORD your God , who has separated you from the peoples .

verses.z: 所以，你們要把潔淨和不潔淨的禽獸分別出來；不可因我給你們分為不潔淨的禽獸，或是滋生在地上的活物，使自己成為可憎惡的。
verses.e: " ' You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean , and between the unclean fowl and the clean . You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal , or by bird , or by anything with which the ground teems , which I have separated from you as unclean for you .

verses.z: 你們要歸我為聖，因為我－耶和華是聖的，並叫你們與萬民有分別，使你們作我的民。
verses.e: You shall be holy to me , for I , the LORD , am holy , and have set you apart from the peoples , that you should be mine .

verses.z: 「無論男女，是交鬼的或行巫術的，總要治死他們。人必用石頭把他們打死，罪要歸到他們身上。」
verses.e: " ' A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death . They shall be stoned with stones . Their blood shall be upon themselves . ' "

verses.z: 我也要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除；因為他把兒女獻給摩洛，玷污我的聖所，褻瀆我的聖名。
verses.e: I also will set my face against that person , and will cut him off from among his people , because he has given of his offspring to Molech , to defile my sanctuary , and to profane my holy name .

verses.z: 那人把兒女獻給摩洛，本地人若佯為不見，不把他治死，
verses.e: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech , and don't put him to death ,

verses.z: 我就要向這人和他的家變臉，把他和一切隨他與摩洛行邪淫的人都從民中剪除。
verses.e: then I will set my face against that man and against his family , and will cut him off , and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech , from among their people .

verses.z: 「人偏向交鬼的和行巫術的，隨他們行邪淫，我要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
verses.e: " ' The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards , to play the prostitute after them , I will even set my face against that person , and will cut him off from among his people .

verses.z: 所以你們要自潔成聖，因為我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: " ' Sanctify yourselves therefore , and be holy ; for I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你們要謹守遵行我的律例；我是叫你們成聖的耶和華。
verses.e: You shall keep my statutes , and do them . I am the LORD who sanctifies you .

verses.z: 凡咒罵父母的，總要治死他；他咒罵了父母，他的罪要歸到他身上。
verses.e: " ' For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death . He has cursed his father or his mother . His blood shall be upon himself .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你告訴亞倫子孫作祭司的說：祭司不可為民中的死人沾染自己，
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Speak to the priests , the sons of Aaron , and say to them , ' A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people ,

verses.z: 「在弟兄中作大祭司、頭上倒了膏油、又承接聖職、穿了[聖]衣的，不可蓬頭散髮，也不可撕裂衣服。
verses.e: " ' He who is the high priest among his brothers , upon whose head the anointing oil is poured , and who is consecrated to put on the garments , shall not let the hair of his head hang loose , or tear his clothes .

verses.z: 不可挨近死屍，也不可為父母沾染自己。
verses.e: He must not go in to any dead body , or defile himself for his father or for his mother .

verses.z: 不可出聖所，也不可褻瀆上帝的聖所，因為上帝膏油的冠冕在他頭上。我是耶和華。
verses.e: He shall not go out of the sanctuary , nor profane the sanctuary of his God ; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 他要娶處女為妻。
verses.e: " ' He shall take a wife in her virginity .

verses.z: 寡婦或是被休的婦人，或是被污為妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的處女為妻。
verses.e: He shall not marry a widow , or one divorced , or a woman who has been defiled , or a prostitute . He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife .

verses.z: 不可在民中辱沒他的兒女，因為我是叫他成聖的耶和華。」
verses.e: He shall not profane his offspring among his people , for I am the LORD who sanctifies him . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你告訴亞倫說：你世世代代的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來獻他上帝的食物。
verses.e: " Say to Aaron , ' None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God .

verses.z: 因為凡有殘疾的，無論是瞎眼的、瘸腿的、塌鼻子的、肢體有餘的、
verses.e: For whatever man he is that has a defect , he shall not draw near : a blind man , or a lame , or he who has a flat nose , or any deformity ,

verses.z: 折腳折手的、
verses.e: or a man who has an injured foot , or an injured hand ,

verses.z: 除非為他骨肉之親的父母、兒女、弟兄，
verses.e: except for his relatives that are near to him : for his mother , for his father , for his son , for his daughter , for his brother ,

verses.z: 駝背的、矮矬的、眼睛有毛病的、長癬的、長疥的，或是損壞腎子的，都不可近前來。
verses.e: or hunchbacked , or a dwarf , or one who has a defect in his eye , or an itching disease , or scabs , or who has damaged testicles .

verses.z: 祭司亞倫的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來，將火祭獻給耶和華。他有殘疾，不可近前來獻上帝的食物。
verses.e: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire . Since he has a defect , he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God .

verses.z: 上帝的食物，無論是聖的，至聖的，他都可以吃。
verses.e: He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .

verses.z: 但不可進到幔子前，也不可就近壇前；因為他有殘疾，免得褻瀆我的聖所。我是叫他成聖的耶和華。」
verses.e: He shall not come near to the veil , nor come near to the altar , because he has a defect ; that he may not profane my sanctuaries , for I am the LORD who sanctifies them . ' "

verses.z: 於是，摩西曉諭亞倫和亞倫的子孫，並以色列眾人。
verses.e: So Moses spoke to Aaron , and to his sons , and to all the children of Israel .

verses.z: 和未曾出嫁、作處女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。
verses.e: and for his virgin sister who is near to him , who has had no husband ; for her he may defile himself .

verses.z: 祭司既在民中為首，就不可從俗沾染自己。
verses.e: He shall not defile himself , being a chief man among his people , to profane himself .

verses.z: 不可使頭光禿；不可剃除鬍鬚的周圍，也不可用刀劃身。
verses.e: " ' They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh .

verses.z: 要歸上帝為聖，不可褻瀆上帝的名；因為耶和華的火祭，就是上帝的食物，是他們獻的，所以他們要成為聖。
verses.e: They shall be holy to their God , and not profane the name of their God , for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire , the bread of their God . Therefore they shall be holy .

verses.z: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人為妻，也不可娶被休的婦人為妻，因為祭司是歸上帝為聖。
verses.e: " ' They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute , or profane . A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband ; for he is holy to his God .

verses.z: 所以你要使他成聖，因為他奉獻你上帝的食物；你要以他為聖，因為我－使你們成聖的耶和華－是聖的。
verses.e: Therefore you shall sanctify him , for he offers the bread of your God . He shall be holy to you , for I the LORD , who sanctify you , am holy .

verses.z: 祭司的女兒若行淫辱沒自己，就辱沒了父親，必用火將她焚燒。
verses.e: " ' The daughter of any priest , if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute , she profanes her father . She shall be burned with fire .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「凡外人不可吃聖物；寄居在祭司家的，或是雇工人，都不可吃聖物；
verses.e: " ' No stranger shall eat of the holy thing : a foreigner living with the priests , or a hired servant , shall not eat of the holy thing .

verses.z: 倘若祭司買人，是他的錢買的，那人就可以吃聖物；生在他家的人也可以吃。
verses.e: But if a priest buys a slave , purchased by his money , he shall eat of it ; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread .

verses.z: 祭司的女兒若嫁外人，就不可吃舉祭的聖物。
verses.e: If a priest's daughter is married to an outsider , she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things .

verses.z: 但祭司的女兒若是寡婦，或是被休的，沒有孩子，又歸回父家，與她青年一樣，就可以吃她父親的食物；只是外人不可吃。
verses.e: But if a priest's daughter is a widow , or divorced , and has no child , and has returned to her father's house as in her youth , she may eat of her father's bread ; but no stranger shall eat any of it .

verses.z: 若有人誤吃了聖物，要照聖物的原數加上五分之一交給祭司。
verses.e: " ' If a man eats something holy unwittingly , then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it , and shall give the holy thing to the priest .

verses.z: 祭司不可褻瀆以色列人所獻給耶和華的聖物，
verses.e: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , which they offer to the LORD ,

verses.z: 免得他們在吃聖物上自取罪孽，因為我是叫他們成聖的耶和華。」
verses.e: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things ; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭亞倫和他子孫，並以色列眾人說：以色列家中的人，或在以色列中寄居的，凡獻供物，無論是所許的願，是甘心獻的，就是獻給耶和華作燔祭的，
verses.e: " Speak to Aaron , and to his sons , and to all the children of Israel , and say to them , ' Whoever is of the house of Israel , or of the foreigners in Israel , who offers his offering , whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings , which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering :

verses.z: 要將沒有殘疾的公牛，或是綿羊，或是山羊[獻上]，如此方蒙悅納。
verses.e: that you may be accepted , you shall offer a male without defect , of the bulls , of the sheep , or of the goats .

verses.z: 「你吩咐亞倫和他子孫說：要遠離以色列人所分別為聖、歸給我的聖物，免得褻瀆我的聖名。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel , which they make holy to me , and that they not profane my holy name . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 凡有殘疾的，你們不可獻上，因為這不蒙悅納。
verses.e: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect , for it shall not be acceptable for you .

verses.z: 凡從牛群或是羊群中，將平安祭獻給耶和華，為要還特許的願，或是作甘心獻的，所獻的必純全無殘疾的才蒙悅納。
verses.e: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow , or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock , it shall be perfect to be accepted . It shall have no defect .

verses.z: 瞎眼的、折傷的、殘廢的、有瘤子的、長癬的、長疥的都不可獻給耶和華，也不可在壇上作為火祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: You shall not offer what is blind , is injured , is maimed , has a wart , is festering , or has a running sore to the LORD , nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD .

verses.z: 無論是公牛是綿羊羔，若肢體有餘的，或是缺少的，只可作甘心祭獻上；用以還願，卻不蒙悅納。
verses.e: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts , that you may offer for a free will offering ; but for a vow it shall not be accepted .

verses.z: 腎子損傷的，或是壓碎的，或是破裂的，或是騸了的，不可獻給耶和華，在你們的地上也不可[這樣]行。
verses.e: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised , crushed , broken , or cut . You must not do this in your land .

verses.z: 這類的物，你們從外人的手，一樣也不可接受作你們上帝的食物獻上；因為這些都有損壞，有殘疾，不蒙悅納。」
verses.e: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner , because their corruption is in them . There is a defect in them . They shall not be accepted for you . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「才生的公牛，或是綿羊或是山羊，七天當跟着母；從第八天以後，可以當供物蒙悅納，作為耶和華的火祭。
verses.e: " When a bull , a sheep , or a goat is born , it shall remain seven days with its mother . From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 無論是母牛是母羊，不可同日宰母和子。
verses.e: Whether it is a cow or ewe , you shall not kill it and its young both in one day .

verses.z: 你們獻感謝祭給耶和華，要獻得可蒙悅納。
verses.e: " When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD , you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted .

verses.z: 你要對他們說：你們世世代代的後裔，凡身上有污穢、親近以色列人所分別為聖、歸耶和華聖物的，那人必在我面前剪除。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " Tell them , ' If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD , having his uncleanness on him , that soul shall be cut off from before me . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 要當天吃，一點不可留到早晨。我是耶和華。
verses.e: It shall be eaten on the same day ; you shall leave none of it until the morning . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 「你們要謹守遵行我的誡命。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " Therefore you shall keep my commandments , and do them . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 你們不可褻瀆我的聖名；我在以色列人中，卻要被尊為聖。我是叫你們成聖的耶和華，
verses.e: You shall not profane my holy name , but I will be made holy among the children of Israel . I am the LORD who makes you holy ,

verses.z: 把你們從埃及地領出來，作你們的上帝。我是耶和華。」
verses.e: who brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God . I am the LORD . "

verses.z: 亞倫的後裔，凡長大痲瘋的，或是有漏症的，不可吃聖物，直等他潔淨了。無論誰摸那因死屍不潔淨的物，或是遺精的人，
verses.e: " ' Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean . Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead , or a man who has a seminal emission ,

verses.z: 或是摸甚麼使他不潔淨的爬物，或是摸那使他不潔淨的人（不拘那人有甚麼不潔淨），
verses.e: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean , or a man from whom he may become unclean , whatever uncleanness he has —

verses.z: 摸了這些人、物的，必不潔淨到晚上；若不用水洗身，就不可吃聖物。
verses.e: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening , and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water .

verses.z: 日落的時候，他就潔淨了，然後可以吃聖物，因為這是他的食物。
verses.e: When the sun is down , he shall be clean ; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things , because it is his bread .

verses.z: 自死的或是被野獸撕裂的，他不可吃，因此污穢自己。我是耶和華。
verses.e: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals , defiling himself by it . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 所以他們要守我所吩咐的，免得輕忽了，因此擔罪而死。我是叫他們成聖的耶和華。
verses.e: " ' They shall therefore follow my commandment , lest they bear sin for it and die in it , if they profane it . I am the LORD who sanctifies them .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我賜給你們的地，收割莊稼的時候，要將初熟的莊稼一捆帶給祭司。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When you have come into the land which I give to you , and shall reap its harvest , then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest .

verses.z: 他要把這一捆在耶和華面前搖一搖，使你們得蒙悅納。祭司要在安息日的次日把這捆搖一搖。
verses.e: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD , to be accepted for you . On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it .

verses.z: 搖這捆的日子，你們要把一歲、沒有殘疾的公綿羊羔獻給耶和華為燔祭。
verses.e: On the day when you wave the sheaf , you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 同獻的素祭，就是調油的細麵[伊法]十分之二，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。同獻的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。
verses.e: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil , an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma ; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine , the fourth part of a hin .

verses.z: 無論是餅，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你們都不可吃，直等到把你們獻給上帝的供物帶來的那一天才可以吃。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。」
verses.e: You must not eat bread , or roasted grain , or fresh grain , until this same day , until you have brought the offering of your God . This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .

verses.z: 「你們要從安息日的次日，獻禾捆為搖祭的那日算起，要滿了七個安息日。
verses.e: " ' You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath , from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering : seven Sabbaths shall be completed .

verses.z: 到第七個安息日的次日，共計五十天，又要將新素祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days ; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 要從你們的住處取出細麵[伊法]十分之二，加酵，烤成兩個搖祭的餅，當作初熟之物獻給耶和華。
verses.e: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour . They shall be baked with yeast , for first fruits to the LORD .

verses.z: 又要將一歲、沒有殘疾的羊羔七隻、公牛犢一隻、公綿羊兩隻，和餅一同奉上。這些與同獻的素祭和奠祭要作為燔祭獻給耶和華，就是作馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old , one young bull , and two rams . They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD , with their meal offering and their drink offerings , even an offering made by fire , of a sweet aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 你們要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，兩隻一歲的公綿羊羔為平安祭。
verses.e: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering , and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：耶和華的節期，你們要宣告為聖會的節期。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' The set feasts of the LORD , which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations , even these are my set feasts .

verses.z: 祭司要把這些和初熟[麥子做]的餅一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這是獻與耶和華為聖物歸給祭司的。
verses.e: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD , with the two lambs . They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest .

verses.z: 當這日，你們要宣告聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you . You shall do no regular work . This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations .

verses.z: 「在你們的地收割莊稼，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取所遺落的；要留給窮人和寄居的。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: " ' When you reap the harvest of your land , you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field . You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest . You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner . I am the LORD your God . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：七月初一，你們要守為聖安息日，要吹角作紀念，當有聖會。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' In the seventh month , on the first day of the month , there shall be a solemn rest for you , a memorial of blowing of trumpets , a holy convocation .

verses.z: 甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；要將火祭獻給耶和華。」
verses.e: You shall do no regular work . You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「七月初十是贖罪日；你們要守為聖會，並要刻苦己心，也要將火祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: " However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement . It shall be a holy convocation to you . You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 當這日，甚麼工都不可做；因為是贖罪日，要在耶和華－你們的上帝面前贖罪。
verses.e: You shall do no kind of work in that same day , for it is a day of atonement , to make atonement for you before the LORD your God .

verses.z: 當這日，凡不刻苦己心的，必從民中剪除。
verses.e: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people .

verses.z: 六日要做工，第七日是聖安息日，當有聖會；你們甚麼工都不可做。這是在你們一切的住處向耶和華守的安息日。
verses.e: " ' Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest , a holy convocation ; you shall do no kind of work . It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings .

verses.z: 凡這日做甚麼工的，我必將他從民中除滅。
verses.e: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day , I will destroy that person from among his people .

verses.z: 你們甚麼工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: You shall do no kind of work : it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .

verses.z: 你們要守這日為聖安息日，並要刻苦己心。從這月初九日晚上到[次日]晚上，要守為安息日。」
verses.e: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you , and you shall deny yourselves . In the ninth day of the month at evening , from evening to evening , you shall keep your Sabbath . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：這七月十五日是住棚節，要在耶和華面前守這節七日。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and say , ' On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD .

verses.z: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
verses.e: On the first day shall be a holy convocation . You shall do no regular work .

verses.z: 七日內要將火祭獻給耶和華。第八日當守聖會，要將火祭獻給耶和華。這是嚴肅會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
verses.e: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD . On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you . You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD . It is a solemn assembly ; you shall do no regular work .

verses.z: 「這是耶和華的節期，就是你們要宣告為聖會的節期；要將火祭、燔祭、素祭、祭物，並奠祭，各歸各日，獻給耶和華。
verses.e: " ' These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations , to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD , a burnt offering , a meal offering , a sacrifice , and drink offerings , each on its own day —

verses.z: 這是在耶和華的安息日以外，又在你們的供物和所許的願，並甘心獻給耶和華的以外。
verses.e: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD , and in addition to your gifts , and in addition to all your vows , and in addition to all your free will offerings , which you give to the LORD .

verses.z: 「你們收藏了地的出產，就從七月十五日起，要守耶和華的節七日。第一日為聖安息；第八日也為聖安息。
verses.e: " ' So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month , when you have gathered in the fruits of the land , you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days . On the first day shall be a solemn rest , and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest .

verses.z: 耶和華的節期，就是你們到了日期要宣告為聖會的，乃是這些。」
verses.e: " ' These are the set feasts of the LORD , even holy convocations , which you shall proclaim in their appointed season .

verses.z: 第一日要拿美好樹上的果子和棕樹上的枝子，與茂密樹的枝條並河旁的柳枝，在耶和華－你們的上帝面前歡樂七日。
verses.e: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees , branches of palm trees , and boughs of thick trees , and willows of the brook ; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days .

verses.z: 每年七月間，要向耶和華守這節七日。這為你們世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year . It is a statute forever throughout your generations . You shall keep it in the seventh month .

verses.z: 你們要住在棚裏七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚裏，
verses.e: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days . All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters ,

verses.z: 好叫你們世世代代知道，我領以色列人出埃及地的時候曾使他們住在棚裏。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt . I am the LORD your God . ' "

verses.z: 於是，摩西將耶和華的節期傳給以色列人。
verses.e: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD .

verses.z: 「正月十四日，黃昏的時候，是耶和華的逾越節。
verses.e: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening , is the LORD's Passover .

verses.z: 這月十五日是向耶和華守的無酵節；你們要吃無酵餅七日。
verses.e: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD . Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread .

verses.z: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；
