verses.e: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation . You shall do no regular work .

verses.z: 要將火祭獻給耶和華七日。第七日是聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。」
verses.e: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days . In the seventh day is a holy convocation . You shall do no regular work . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 有一個以色列婦人的兒子，他父親是埃及人，[一日]閒遊在以色列人中。這以色列婦人的兒子和一個以色列人在營裏爭鬥。
verses.e: The son of an Israelite woman , whose father was an Egyptian , went out among the children of Israel ; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp .

verses.z: 這以色列婦人的兒子褻瀆了[聖]名，並且咒詛，就有人把他送到摩西那裏。（他母親名叫示羅密，是但支派底伯利的女兒。）
verses.e: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name , and cursed ; and they brought him to Moses . His mother's name was Shelomith , the daughter of Dibri , of the tribe of Dan .

verses.z: 他們把那人收在監裏，要得耶和華所指示的話。
verses.e: They put him in custody until the LORD's will should be declared to them .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「把那咒詛[聖名]的人帶到營外。叫聽見的人都放手在他頭上；全會眾就要用石頭打死他。
verses.e: " Bring him who cursed out of the camp ; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head , and let all the congregation stone him .

verses.z: 你要曉諭以色列人說：凡咒詛上帝的，必擔當他的罪。
verses.e: You shall speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin .

verses.z: 那褻瀆耶和華名的，必被治死；全會眾總要用石頭打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他褻瀆[耶和華]名的時候，必被治死。
verses.e: He who blasphemes the LORD's name , he shall surely be put to death . All the congregation shall certainly stone him . The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name .

verses.z: 打死人的，必被治死；
verses.e: " ' He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜，以命償命。
verses.e: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good , life for life .

verses.z: 人若使他鄰舍的身體有殘疾，他怎樣行，也要照樣向他行：
verses.e: If anyone injures his neighbor , it shall be done to him as he has done :

verses.z: 「要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點着。
verses.e: " Command the children of Israel , that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light , to cause a lamp to burn continually .

verses.z: 以傷還傷，以眼還眼，以牙還牙。他怎樣叫人的身體有殘疾，也要照樣向他行。
verses.e: fracture for fracture , eye for eye , tooth for tooth . It shall be done to him as he has injured someone .

verses.z: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。
verses.e: He who kills an animal shall make it good ; and he who kills a man shall be put to death .

verses.z: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同歸一例。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born ; for I am the LORD your God . ' "

verses.z: 於是，摩西曉諭以色列人，他們就把那咒詛[聖名]的人帶到營外，用石頭打死。以色列人就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.e: Moses spoke to the children of Israel ; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp , and stoned him with stones . The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 在會幕中法[櫃]的幔子外，亞倫從晚上到早晨必在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: Outside of the veil of the Testimony , in the Tent of Meeting , Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually . It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations .

verses.z: 他要在耶和華面前常收拾精[金]燈臺上的燈。」
verses.e: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually .

verses.z: 「你要取細麵，烤成十二個餅，每餅用麵[伊法]十分之二。
verses.e: " You shall take fine flour , and bake twelve cakes of it : two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake .

verses.z: 要把餅擺列兩行，每行六個，在耶和華面前精[金]的桌子上；
verses.e: You shall set them in two rows , six on a row , on the pure gold table before the LORD .

verses.z: 又要把淨乳香放在每行餅上，作為紀念，就是作為火祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: You shall put pure frankincense on each row , that it may be to the bread for a memorial , even an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 每安息日要常擺在耶和華面前；這為以色列人作永遠的約。
verses.e: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually . It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 這餅是要給亞倫和他子孫的；他們要在聖處吃，為永遠的定例，因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中是至聖的。」
verses.e: It shall be for Aaron and his sons . They shall eat it in a holy place ; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute . "

verses.z: 耶和華在西奈山對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai ,

verses.z: 第五十年，你們要當作聖年，在遍地給一切的居民宣告自由。這年必為你們的禧年，各人要歸自己的產業，各歸本家。
verses.e: You shall make the fiftieth year holy , and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants . It shall be a jubilee to you ; and each of you shall return to his own property , and each of you shall return to his family .

verses.z: 第五十年要作為你們的禧年。這年不可耕種；地中自長的，不可收割；沒有修理的葡萄樹也不可摘取[葡萄]。
verses.e: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you . In it you shall not sow , neither reap that which grows of itself , nor gather from the undressed vines .

verses.z: 因為這是禧年，你們要當作聖年，吃地中[自出]的土產。
verses.e: For it is a jubilee ; it shall be holy to you . You shall eat of its increase out of the field .

verses.z: 「這禧年，你們各人要歸自己的地業。
verses.e: " ' In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property .

verses.z: 你若賣甚麼給鄰舍，或是從鄰舍的手中買甚麼，彼此不可虧負。
verses.e: " ' If you sell anything to your neighbor , or buy from your neighbor , you shall not wrong one another .

verses.z: 你要按禧年以後的年數向鄰舍買；他也要按年數的收成賣給你。
verses.e: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor . According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you .

verses.z: 年歲若多，要照數加添價值；年歲若少，要照數減去價值，因為他照收成的數目賣給你。
verses.e: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price , and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price ; for he is selling the number of the crops to you .

verses.z: 你們彼此不可虧負，只要敬畏你們的上帝，因為我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: You shall not wrong one another , but you shall fear your God ; for I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 「我的律例，你們要遵行，我的典章，你們要謹守，就可以在那地上安然居住。
verses.e: " ' Therefore you shall do my statutes , and keep my ordinances and do them ; and you shall dwell in the land in safety .

verses.z: 地必出土產，你們就要吃飽，在那地上安然居住。
verses.e: The land shall yield its fruit , and you shall eat your fill , and dwell therein in safety .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所賜你們那地的時候，地就要向耶和華守安息。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When you come into the land which I give you , then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD .

verses.z: 你們若說：『這第七年我們不耕種，也不收藏土產，吃甚麼呢？』
verses.e: If you said , " What shall we eat the seventh year ? Behold , we shall not sow , nor gather in our increase ; "

verses.z: 我必在第六年將我所命的福賜給你們，地便生三年的土產。
verses.e: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year , and it shall bear fruit for the three years .

verses.z: 第八年，你們要耕種，也要吃陳糧，等到第九年出產收來的時候，你們還吃陳糧。」
verses.e: You shall sow the eighth year , and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year . Until its fruits come in , you shall eat the old store .

verses.z: 「地不可永賣，因為地是我的；你們在我面前是客旅，是寄居的。
verses.e: " ' The land shall not be sold in perpetuity , for the land is mine ; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me .

verses.z: 在你們所得為業的全地，也要准人將地贖回。
verses.e: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land .

verses.z: 你的弟兄若漸漸窮乏，賣了幾分地業，他至近的親屬就要來把弟兄所賣的贖回。
verses.e: " ' If your brother becomes poor , and sells some of his possessions , then his kinsman who is next to him shall come , and redeem that which his brother has sold .

verses.z: 若沒有能給他贖回的，他自己漸漸富足，能夠贖回，
verses.e: If a man has no one to redeem it , and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it ,

verses.z: 就要算出賣地的年數，把餘剩年數的價值還那買主，自己便歸回自己的地業。
verses.e: then let him reckon the years since its sale , and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it ; and he shall return to his property .

verses.z: 倘若不能為自己得回所賣的，仍要存在買主的手裏直到禧年；到了禧年，地業要出[買主的手]，自己便歸回自己的地業。
verses.e: But if he isn't able to get it back for himself , then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee . In the Jubilee it shall be released , and he shall return to his property .

verses.z: 「人若賣城內的住宅，賣了以後，一年之內可以贖回；在一整年，必有贖回的權柄。
verses.e: " ' If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city , then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold . For a full year he shall have the right of redemption .

verses.z: 六年要耕種田地，也要修理葡萄園，收藏地的出產。
verses.e: You shall sow your field six years , and you shall prune your vineyard six years , and gather in its fruits ;

verses.z: 若在一整年之內不贖回，這城內的房屋就定准永歸買主，世世代代為業；在禧年也不得出[買主的手]。
verses.e: If it isn't redeemed within the space of a full year , then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it , throughout his generations . It shall not be released in the Jubilee .

verses.z: 但房屋在無城牆的村莊裏，要看如鄉下的田地一樣，可以贖回；到了禧年，都要出[買主的手]。
verses.e: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country : they may be redeemed , and they shall be released in the Jubilee .

verses.z: 然而利未人所得為業的城邑，其中的房屋，利未人可以隨時贖回。
verses.e: " ' Nevertheless , in the cities of the Levites , the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time .

verses.z: 若是一個利未人不將所賣的房屋贖回，是在所得為業的城內，到了禧年就要出[買主的手]，因為利未人城邑的房屋是他們在以色列人中的產業。
verses.e: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold , and the city of his possession , and it shall be released in the Jubilee ; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 只是他們各城郊野之地不可賣，因為是他們永遠的產業。」
verses.e: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold , for it is their perpetual possession .

verses.z: 「你的弟兄在你那裏若漸漸貧窮，手中缺乏，你就要幫補他，使他與你同住，像外人和寄居的一樣。
verses.e: " ' If your brother has become poor , and his hand can't support himself among you , then you shall uphold him . He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident .

verses.z: 不可向他取利，也不可向他多要；只要敬畏你的上帝，使你的弟兄與你同住。
verses.e: Take no interest from him or profit ; but fear your God , that your brother may live among you .

verses.z: 你借錢給他，不可向他取利；借糧給他，也不可向他多要。
verses.e: You shall not lend him your money at interest , nor give him your food for profit .

verses.z: 我是耶和華－你們的上帝，曾領你們從埃及地出來，為要把迦南地賜給你們，要作你們的上帝。」
verses.e: I am the LORD your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , to give you the land of Canaan , and to be your God .

verses.z: 「你的弟兄若在你那裏漸漸窮乏，將自己賣給你，不可叫他像奴僕服事你。
verses.e: " ' If your brother has grown poor among you , and sells himself to you , you shall not make him to serve as a slave .

verses.z: 第七年，地要守聖安息，就是向耶和華守的安息，不可耕種田地，也不可修理葡萄園。
verses.e: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land , a Sabbath to the LORD . You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard .

verses.z: 他要在你那裏像雇工人和寄居的一樣，要服事你直到禧年。
verses.e: As a hired servant , and as a temporary resident , he shall be with you ; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee .

verses.z: 到了禧年，他和他兒女要離開你，一同出去歸回本家，到他祖宗的地業那裏去。
verses.e: Then he shall go out from you , he and his children with him , and shall return to his own family , and to the possession of his fathers .

verses.z: 因為他們是我的僕人，是我從埃及地領出來的，不可賣為奴僕。
verses.e: For they are my servants , whom I brought out of the land of Egypt . They shall not be sold as slaves .

verses.z: 不可嚴嚴地轄管他，只要敬畏你的上帝。
verses.e: You shall not rule over him with harshness , but shall fear your God .

verses.z: 至於你的奴僕、婢女，可以從你四圍的國中買。
verses.e: " ' As for your male and your female slaves , whom you may have from the nations that are around you , from them you may buy male and female slaves .

verses.z: 並且那寄居在你們中間的外人和他們的家屬，在你們地上所生的，你們也可以從其中買人；他們要作你們的產業。
verses.e: Moreover , of the children of the aliens who live among you , of them you may buy , and of their families who are with you , which they have conceived in your land ; and they will be your property .

verses.z: 你們要將他們遺留給你們的子孫為產業，要永遠從他們中間揀出奴僕；只是你們的弟兄以色列人，你們不可嚴嚴地轄管。
verses.e: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you , to hold for a possession . Of them you may take your slaves forever , but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule , one over another , with harshness .

verses.z: 「住在你那裏的外人，或是寄居的，若漸漸富足，你的弟兄卻漸漸窮乏，將自己賣給那外人，或是寄居的，或是外人的宗族，
verses.e: " ' If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich , and your brother beside him has grown poor , and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you , or to a member of the stranger's family ,

verses.z: 賣了以後，可以將他贖回。無論是他的弟兄，
verses.e: after he is sold he may be redeemed . One of his brothers may redeem him ;

verses.z: 或伯叔、伯叔的兒子，本家的近支，都可以贖他。他自己若漸漸富足，也可以自贖。
verses.e: or his uncle , or his uncle's son , may redeem him , or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him ; or if he has grown rich , he may redeem himself .

verses.z: 遺落自長的莊稼不可收割；沒有修理的葡萄樹也不可摘取葡萄。這年，地要守聖安息。
verses.e: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap , and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine . It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land .

verses.z: 他要和買主計算，從賣自己的那年起，算到禧年；所賣的價值照着年數多少，好像工人每年的工價。
verses.e: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee . The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years ; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant .

verses.z: 若缺少的年數多，就要按着年數從買價中償還他的贖價。
verses.e: If there are yet many years , according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for .

verses.z: 若到禧年只缺少幾年，就要按着年數和買主計算，償還他的贖價。
verses.e: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee , then he shall reckon with him ; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption .

verses.z: 他和買主同住，要像每年雇的工人，買主不可嚴嚴地轄管他。
verses.e: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him . He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight .

verses.z: 他若不這樣被贖，到了禧年，要和他的兒女一同出去。
verses.e: If he isn't redeemed by these means , then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee : he and his children with him .

verses.z: 因為以色列人都是我的僕人，是我從埃及地領出來的。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: For to me the children of Israel are servants ; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt . I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 地在安息年所出的，要給你和你的僕人、婢女、雇工人，並寄居的外人當食物。
verses.e: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you ; for yourself , for your servant , for your maid , for your hired servant , and for your stranger , who lives as a foreigner with you .

verses.z: 這年的土產也要給你的牲畜和你地上的走獸當食物。」
verses.e: For your livestock also , and for the animals that are in your land , shall all its increase be for food .

verses.z: 「你要計算七個安息年，就是七七年。這便為你成了七個安息年，共是四十九年。
verses.e: " ' You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years , seven times seven years ; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years , even forty-nine years .

verses.z: 當年七月初十日，你要大發角聲；這日就是贖罪日，要在遍地發出角聲。
verses.e: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month . On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land .

verses.z: 「你們不可做甚麼虛無的神[像]，不可立雕刻的偶像或是柱像，也不可在你們的地上安甚麼鏨成的石像，向它跪拜，因為我是耶和華－你們的上帝。
verses.e: " ' You shall make for yourselves no idols , and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar , and you shall not place any figured stone in your land , to bow down to it ; for I am the LORD your God .

verses.z: 你們要吃陳糧，又因新糧挪開陳糧。
verses.e: You shall eat old supplies long kept , and you shall move out the old because of the new .

verses.z: 我要在你們中間立我的帳幕；我的心也不厭惡你們。
verses.e: I will set my tent among you , and my soul won't abhor you .

verses.z: 我要在你們中間行走；我要作你們的上帝，你們要作我的子民。
verses.e: I will walk among you , and will be your God , and you will be my people .

verses.z: 我是耶和華－你們的上帝，曾將你們從埃及地領出來，使你們不作埃及人的奴僕；我也折斷你們所負的軛，叫你們挺身而走。」
verses.e: I am the LORD your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , that you should not be their slaves . I have broken the bars of your yoke , and made you walk upright .

verses.z: 「你們若不聽從我，不遵行我的誡命，
verses.e: " ' But if you will not listen to me , and will not do all these commandments ,

verses.z: 厭棄我的律例，厭惡我的典章，不遵行我一切的誡命，背棄我的約，
verses.e: and if you shall reject my statutes , and if your soul abhors my ordinances , so that you will not do all my commandments , but break my covenant ,

verses.z: 我待你們就要這樣：我必命定驚惶，叫眼目乾癟、精神消耗的癆病熱病轄制你們。你們也要白白地撒種，因為仇敵要吃你們所種的。
verses.e: I also will do this to you : I will appoint terror over you , even consumption and fever , that shall consume the eyes , and make the soul to pine away . You will sow your seed in vain , for your enemies will eat it .

verses.z: 我要向你們變臉，你們就要敗在仇敵面前。恨惡你們的，必轄管你們；無人追趕，你們卻要逃跑。
verses.e: I will set my face against you , and you will be struck before your enemies . Those who hate you will rule over you ; and you will flee when no one pursues you .

verses.z: 你們因這些事若還不聽從我，我就要為你們的罪加七倍懲罰你們。
verses.e: " ' If you in spite of these things will not listen to me , then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins .

verses.z: 我必斷絕你們因勢力而有的驕傲，又要使[覆]你們的天如鐵，[載]你們的地如銅。
verses.e: I will break the pride of your power , and I will make your sky like iron , and your soil like bronze .

verses.z: 你們要守我的安息日，敬我的聖所。我是耶和華。
verses.e: " ' You shall keep my Sabbaths , and have reverence for my sanctuary . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 你們要白白地勞力；因為你們的地不出土產，其上的樹木也不結果子。
verses.e: Your strength will be spent in vain ; for your land won't yield its increase , neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit .

verses.z: 「你們行事若與我反對，不肯聽從我，我就要按你們的罪加七倍降災與你們。
verses.e: " ' If you walk contrary to me , and won't listen to me , then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins .

verses.z: 我也要打發野地的走獸到你們中間，搶吃你們的兒女，吞滅你們的牲畜，使你們的人數減少，道路荒涼。
verses.e: I will send the wild animals among you , which will rob you of your children , destroy your livestock , and make you few in number . Your roads will become desolate .

verses.z: 「你們因這些事若仍不改正歸我，行事與我反對，
verses.e: " ' If by these things you won't be turned back to me , but will walk contrary to me ,

verses.z: 我就要行事與你們反對，因你們的罪擊打你們七次。
verses.e: then I will also walk contrary to you ; and I will strike you , even I , seven times for your sins .

verses.z: 我又要使刀劍臨到你們，報復你們背約的仇；聚集你們在各城內，降瘟疫在你們中間，也必將你們交在仇敵的手中。
verses.e: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant . You will be gathered together within your cities , and I will send the pestilence among you . You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy .

verses.z: 我要折斷你們的杖，就是斷絕你們的糧。那時，必有十個女人在一個爐子給你們烤餅，按分量秤給你們；你們要吃，也吃不飽。
verses.e: When I break your staff of bread , ten women shall bake your bread in one oven , and they shall deliver your bread again by weight . You shall eat , and not be satisfied .

verses.z: 「你們因這一切的事若不聽從我，卻行事與我反對，
verses.e: " ' If you in spite of this won't listen to me , but walk contrary to me ,

verses.z: 我就要發烈怒，行事與你們反對，又因你們的罪懲罰你們七次。
verses.e: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath . I will also chastise you seven times for your sins .

verses.z: 並且你們要吃兒子的肉，也要吃女兒的肉。
verses.e: You will eat the flesh of your sons , and you will eat the flesh of your daughters .

verses.z: 「你們若遵行我的律例，謹守我的誡命，
verses.e: " ' If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments , and do them ,

verses.z: 我又要毀壞你們的邱壇，砍下你們的日像，把你們的屍首扔在你們偶像的身上；我的心也必厭惡你們。
verses.e: I will destroy your high places , and cut down your incense altars , and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols ; and my soul will abhor you .

verses.z: 我要使你們的城邑變為荒涼，使你們的眾聖所成為荒場；我也不聞你們馨香的香氣。
verses.e: I will lay your cities waste , and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation . I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings .

verses.z: 我要使地成為荒場，住在其上的仇敵就因此詫異。
verses.e: I will bring the land into desolation , and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it .

verses.z: 我要把你們散在列邦中；我也要拔刀追趕你們。你們的地要成為荒場；你們的城邑要變為荒涼。
verses.e: I will scatter you among the nations , and I will draw out the sword after you . Your land will be a desolation , and your cities shall be a waste .

verses.z: 「你們在仇敵之地居住的時候，你們的地荒涼，要享受眾安息；正在那時候，地要歇息，享受安息。
verses.e: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies ' land . Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths .

verses.z: 地多時為荒場，就要多時歇息；地這樣歇息，是你們住在其上的安息年所不能得的。
verses.e: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest , even the rest which it didn't have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it .

verses.z: 至於你們剩下的人，我要使他們在仇敵之地心驚膽怯。葉子被風吹的響聲，要追趕他們；他們要逃避，像人逃避刀劍，無人追趕，卻要跌倒。
verses.e: " ' As for those of you who are left , I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies . The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight ; and they shall flee , as one flees from the sword . They will fall when no one pursues .

verses.z: 無人追趕，他們要彼此撞跌，像在刀劍之前。你們在仇敵面前也必站立不住。
verses.e: They will stumble over one another , as it were before the sword , when no one pursues . You will have no power to stand before your enemies .

verses.z: 你們要在列邦中滅亡；仇敵之地要吞吃你們。
verses.e: You will perish among the nations . The land of your enemies will eat you up .

verses.z: 你們剩下的人必因自己的罪孽和祖宗的罪孽在仇敵之地消滅。
verses.e: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies ' lands ; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them .

verses.z: 我就給你們降下時雨，叫地生出土產，田野的樹木結果子。
verses.e: then I will give you your rains in their season , and the land shall yield its increase , and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit .

verses.z: 「他們要承認自己的罪和他們祖宗的罪，就是干犯我的那罪，並且承認自己行事與我反對，
verses.e: " ' If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers , in their trespass which they trespassed against me ; and also that because they walked contrary to me ,

verses.z: 我所以行事與他們反對，把他們帶到仇敵之地。那時，他們未受割禮的心若謙卑了，他們也服了罪孽的刑罰，
verses.e: I also walked contrary to them , and brought them into the land of their enemies ; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled , and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity ,

verses.z: 我就要記念我與雅各所立的約，與以撒所立的約，與亞伯拉罕所立的約，並要記念這地。
verses.e: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob , my covenant with Isaac , and also my covenant with Abraham ; and I will remember the land .

verses.z: 他們離開這地，地在荒廢無人的時候就要享受安息。並且他們要服罪孽的刑罰；因為他們厭棄了我的典章，心中厭惡了我的律例。
verses.e: The land also will be left by them , and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them ; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances , and their soul abhorred my statutes .

verses.z: 雖是這樣，他們在仇敵之地，我卻不厭棄他們，也不厭惡他們，將他們盡行滅絕，也不背棄我與他們所立的約，因為我是耶和華－他們的上帝。
verses.e: Yet for all that , when they are in the land of their enemies , I will not reject them , neither will I abhor them , to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them ; for I am the LORD their God .

verses.z: 我卻要為他們的緣故記念我與他們先祖所立的約。他們的先祖是我在列邦人眼前、從埃及地領出來的，為要作他們的上帝。我是耶和華。」
verses.e: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations , that I might be their God . I am the LORD . ' "

verses.z: 這些律例、典章，和法度是耶和華與以色列人在西奈山藉着摩西立的。
verses.e: These are the statutes , ordinances , and laws , which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses .

verses.z: 你們打糧食要打到摘葡萄的時候，摘葡萄要摘到撒種的時候；並且要吃得飽足，在你們的地上安然居住。
verses.e: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage , and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time . You shall eat your bread to the full , and dwell in your land safely .

verses.z: 我要賜平安在[你們的]地上；你們躺臥，無人驚嚇。我要叫惡獸從[你們的]地上熄滅；刀劍也必不經過你們的地。
verses.e: " ' I will give peace in the land , and you shall lie down , and no one will make you afraid . I will remove evil animals out of the land , neither shall the sword go through your land .

verses.z: 你們要追趕仇敵，他們必倒在你們刀下。
verses.e: You shall chase your enemies , and they shall fall before you by the sword .

verses.z: 你們五個人要追趕一百人，一百人要追趕一萬人；仇敵必倒在你們刀下。
verses.e: Five of you shall chase a hundred , and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand ; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword .

verses.z: 我要眷顧你們，使你們生養眾多，也要與你們堅定所立的約。
verses.e: " ' I will have respect for you , make you fruitful , multiply you , and will establish my covenant with you .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 人不可改換，也不可更換，或是好的換壞的，或是壞的換好的。若以牲畜更換牲畜，所許的與所換的都要成為聖。
verses.e: He shall not alter it , nor exchange it , a good for a bad , or a bad for a good . If he shall at all exchange animal for animal , then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy .

verses.z: 若牲畜不潔淨，是不可獻給耶和華為供物的，就要把牲畜安置在祭司面前。
verses.e: If it is any unclean animal , of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD , then he shall set the animal before the priest ;

verses.z: 祭司就要估定價值；牲畜是好是壞，祭司怎樣估定，就要以怎樣為是。
verses.e: and the priest shall evaluate it , whether it is good or bad . As the priest evaluates it , so it shall be .

verses.z: 他若一定要贖回，就要在你所估定的價值以外加上五分之一。
verses.e: But if he will indeed redeem it , then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation .

verses.z: 「人將房屋分別為聖，歸給耶和華，祭司就要估定價值。房屋是好是壞，祭司怎樣估定，就要以怎樣為定。
verses.e: " ' When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD , then the priest shall evaluate it , whether it is good or bad . As the priest evaluates it , so it shall stand .

verses.z: 將房屋分別為聖的人，若要贖回房屋，就必在你所估定的價值以外加上五分之一，房屋仍舊歸他。
verses.e: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house , then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it , and it shall be his .

verses.z: 「人若將承受為業的幾分地分別為聖，歸給耶和華，你要按這地撒種多少估定價值，若撒大麥一賀梅珥，[要估]價五十舍客勒。
verses.e: " ' If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession , then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it . The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver .

verses.z: 他若從禧年將地分別為聖，就要以你所估定的價為定。
verses.e: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee , according to your valuation it shall stand .

verses.z: 倘若他在禧年以後將地分別為聖，祭司就要按着未到禧年所剩的年數推算價值，也要從你所估的減去價值。
verses.e: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee , then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee ; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation .

verses.z: 將地分別為聖的人若定要把地贖回，他便要在你所估的價值以外加上五分之一，地就准定歸他。
verses.e: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it , then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it , and it shall remain his .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：人還特許的願，被許的人要按你所估的價值歸給耶和華。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and say to them , ' When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow , according to your valuation ,

verses.z: 他若不贖回那地，或是將地賣給別人，就再不能贖了。
verses.e: If he will not redeem the field , or if he has sold the field to another man , it shall not be redeemed any more ;

verses.z: 但到了禧年，那地從[買主手下]出來的時候，就要歸耶和華為聖，和永獻的地一樣，要歸祭司為業。
verses.e: but the field , when it goes out in the Jubilee , shall be holy to the LORD , as a devoted field . It shall be owned by the priests .

verses.z: 他若將所買的一塊地，不是承受為業的，分別為聖歸給耶和華，
verses.e: " ' If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought , which is not of the field of his possession ,

verses.z: 祭司就要將你所估的價值給他推算到禧年。當日，他要以你所估的價銀為聖，歸給耶和華。
verses.e: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee ; and he shall give your valuation on that day , as a holy thing to the LORD .

verses.z: 到了禧年，那地要歸賣主，就是那承受為業的原主。
verses.e: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought , even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs .

verses.z: 凡你所估定的價銀都要按着聖所的平：二十季拉為一舍客勒。
verses.e: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary : twenty gerahs to the shekel .

verses.z: 「惟獨牲畜中頭生的，無論是牛是羊，既歸耶和華，誰也不可再分別為聖，因為這是耶和華的。
verses.e: " ' However the firstborn among animals , which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn , no man may dedicate , whether an ox or a sheep . It is the LORD's .

verses.z: 若是不潔淨的牲畜生的，就要按你所估定的價值加上五分之一贖回；若不贖回，就要按你所估定的價值賣了。
verses.e: If it is an unclean animal , then he shall buy it back according to your valuation , and shall add to it the fifth part of it ; or if it isn't redeemed , then it shall be sold according to your valuation .

verses.z: 「但一切永獻的，就是人從他所有永獻給耶和華的，無論是人，是牲畜，是他承受為業的地，都不可賣，也不可贖。凡永獻的是歸給耶和華為至聖。
verses.e: " ' Notwithstanding , no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has , whether of man or animal , or of the field of his possession , shall be sold or redeemed . Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD .

verses.z: 凡從人中當滅的都不可贖，必被治死。」
verses.e: " ' No one devoted to destruction , who shall be devoted from among men , shall be ransomed . He shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 你估定的，從二十歲到六十歲的男人，要按聖所的平，估定價銀五十舍客勒。
verses.e: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver , according to the shekel of the sanctuary .

verses.z: 「地上所有的，無論是地上的種子是樹上的果子，十分之一是耶和華的，是歸給耶和華為聖的。
verses.e: " ' All the tithe of the land , whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees , is the LORD's . It is holy to the LORD .

verses.z: 人若要贖這十分之一的甚麼物，就要加上五分之一。
verses.e: If a man redeems anything of his tithe , he shall add a fifth part to it .

verses.z: 凡牛群羊群中，一切從杖下經過的，每第十隻要歸給耶和華為聖。
verses.e: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks , whatever passes under the rod , the tenth shall be holy to the LORD .

verses.z: 不可問是好是壞，也不可更換；若定要更換，所更換的與本來的牲畜都要成為聖，不可贖回。」
verses.e: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad , neither shall he exchange it . If he exchanges it at all , then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy . It shall not be redeemed . ' "

verses.z: 這就是耶和華在西奈山為以色列人所吩咐摩西的命令。
verses.e: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai .

verses.z: 若是女人，你要估定三十舍客勒。
verses.e: If she is a female , then your valuation shall be thirty shekels .

verses.z: 若是從五歲到二十歲，男子你要估定二十舍客勒，女子估定十舍客勒。
verses.e: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old , then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels , and for a female ten shekels .

verses.z: 若是從一月到五歲，男子你要估定五舍客勒，女子估定三舍客勒。
verses.e: If the person is from a month old to five years old , then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver , and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver .

verses.z: 若是從六十歲以上，男人你要估定十五舍客勒，女人估定十舍客勒。
verses.e: If the person is from sixty years old and upward ; if he is a male , then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels , and for a female ten shekels .

verses.z: 他若貧窮，不能照你所估定的價，就要把他帶到祭司面前，祭司要按許願人的力量估定他的價。
verses.e: But if he is poorer than your valuation , then he shall be set before the priest , and the priest shall assign a value to him . The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay .

verses.z: 「[所許的]若是牲畜，就是人獻給耶和華為供物的，凡這一類獻給耶和華的，都要成為聖。
verses.e: " ' If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD , all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy .

verses.z: 「人獻供物為平安祭，若是從牛群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的獻在耶和華面前。
verses.e: " ' If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings , if he offers it from the herd , whether male or female , he shall offer it without defect before the LORD .

verses.z: 兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
verses.e: and the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the loins , and the cover on the liver , with the kidneys , he shall take away .

verses.z: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，是獻給耶和華為食物的火祭。
verses.e: The priest shall burn it on the altar : it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 「人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和華面前獻上。
verses.e: " ' If his offering is a goat , then he shall offer it before the LORD .

verses.z: 要按手在山羊頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍，
verses.e: He shall lay his hand on its head , and kill it before the Tent of Meeting ; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar .

verses.z: 又把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下，獻給耶和華為火祭。
verses.e: He shall offer from it as his offering , an offering made by fire to the LORD ; the fat that covers the innards , and all the fat that is on the innards ,
and the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the loins , and the cover on the liver , with the kidneys , he shall take away .

verses.z: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，作為馨香火祭的食物。脂油都是耶和華的。
verses.e: The priest shall burn them on the altar : it is the food of the offering made by fire , for a pleasant aroma ; all the fat is the LORD's .

verses.z: 在你們一切的住處，脂油和血都不可吃；這要成為你們世世代代永遠的定例。」
verses.e: " ' It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings , that you shall eat neither fat nor blood . ' "

verses.z: 他要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕門口。亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把血灑在壇的周圍。
verses.e: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering , and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting . Aaron's sons , the priests , shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar .

verses.z: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，也要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
verses.e: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD . The fat that covers the innards , and all the fat that is on the innards ,

verses.z: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
verses.e: and the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the loins , and the cover on the liver , with the kidneys , he shall take away .

verses.z: 亞倫的子孫要把這些燒在壇的燔祭上，就是在火的柴上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering , which is on the wood that is on the fire : it is an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 「人向耶和華獻供物為平安祭，若是從羊群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的。
verses.e: " ' If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock , either male or female , he shall offer it without defect .

verses.z: 若獻一隻羊羔為供物，必在耶和華面前獻上，
verses.e: If he offers a lamb for his offering , then he shall offer it before the LORD ;

verses.z: 並要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍。
verses.e: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering , and kill it before the Tent of Meeting . Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar .

verses.z: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，其中的脂油和整肥尾巴都要在靠近脊骨處取下，並要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
verses.e: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD ; its fat , the entire tail fat , he shall take away close to the backbone ; and the fat that covers the entrails , and all the fat that is on the entrails ,

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 與平安祭公牛上所取的一樣；祭司要把這些燒在燔祭的壇上。
verses.e: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings . The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering .

verses.z: 公牛的皮和所有的肉，並頭、腿、臟、腑、糞，
verses.e: He shall carry the bull's skin , all its meat , with its head , and with its legs , its innards , and its dung

verses.z: 就是全公牛，要搬到營外潔淨之地、倒灰之所，用火燒在柴上。
verses.e: — all the rest of the bull — outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out , and burn it on wood with fire . It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out .

verses.z: 「以色列全會眾若行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，是隱而未現、會眾看不出來的，
verses.e: " ' If the whole congregation of Israel sins , and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly , and they have done any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done , and are guilty ;

verses.z: 會眾一知道所犯的罪就要獻一隻公牛犢為贖罪祭，牽到會幕前。
verses.e: when the sin in which they have sinned is known , then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering , and bring it before the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 會中的長老就要在耶和華面前按手在牛的頭上，將牛在耶和華面前宰了。
verses.e: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD ; and the bull shall be killed before the LORD .

verses.z: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血帶到會幕，
verses.e: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 把指頭蘸於血中，在耶和華面前對着幔子彈血七次，
verses.e: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD , before the veil .

verses.z: 又要把些血抹在會幕內、耶和華面前壇的四角上，再把所有的血倒在會幕門口、燔祭壇的腳那裏。
verses.e: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD , that is in the Tent of Meeting ; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering , which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 把牛所有的脂油都取下，燒在壇上；
verses.e: All its fat he shall take from it , and burn it on the altar .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：若有人在耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事上誤犯了一件，
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' If anyone sins unintentionally , in any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done , and does any one of them ,

verses.z: 收拾這牛，與那贖罪祭的牛一樣。祭司要為他們贖罪，他們必蒙赦免。
verses.e: He shall do this with the bull ; as he did with the bull of the sin offering , so he shall do with this ; and the priest shall make atonement for them , and they shall be forgiven .

verses.z: 他要把牛搬到營外燒了，像燒頭一個牛一樣；這是會眾的贖罪祭。
verses.e: He shall carry the bull outside the camp , and burn it as he burned the first bull . It is the sin offering for the assembly .

verses.z: 「官長若行了耶和華－他上帝所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，
verses.e: " ' When a ruler sins , and unwittingly does any one of all the things which the LORD his God has commanded not to be done , and is guilty ,

verses.z: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要牽一隻沒有殘疾的公山羊為供物，
verses.e: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him , he shall bring as his offering a goat , a male without defect .

verses.z: 按手在羊的頭上，宰於耶和華面前、宰燔祭牲的地方；這是贖罪祭。
verses.e: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat , and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD . It is a sin offering .

verses.z: 祭司要用指頭蘸些贖罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，把血倒在燔祭壇的腳那裏。
verses.e: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering . He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering .

verses.z: 所有的脂油，祭司都要燒在壇上，正如平安祭的脂油一樣。至於他的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。
verses.e: All its fat he shall burn on the altar , like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings ; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin , and he will be forgiven .

verses.z: 「民中若有人行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，
verses.e: " ' If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly , in doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done , and is guilty ,

verses.z: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要為所犯的罪牽一隻沒有殘疾的母山羊為供物，
verses.e: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him , then he shall bring for his offering a goat , a female without defect , for his sin which he has sinned .

verses.z: 按手在贖罪祭牲的頭上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了。
verses.e: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering , and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering .

verses.z: 或是受膏的祭司犯罪，使百姓陷在罪裏，就當為他所犯的罪把沒有殘疾的公牛犢獻給耶和華為贖罪祭。
verses.e: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people , then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to the LORD for a sin offering .

verses.z: 祭司要用指頭蘸些羊的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，所有的血都要倒在壇的腳那裏，
verses.e: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger , and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering ; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar .

verses.z: 又要把羊所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭牲的脂油一樣。祭司要在壇上焚燒，在耶和華面前作為馨香[的祭]，為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
verses.e: All its fat he shall take away , like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings ; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to the LORD ; and the priest shall make atonement for him , and he will be forgiven .

verses.z: 「人若牽一隻綿羊羔為贖罪祭的供物，必要牽一隻沒有殘疾的母羊，
verses.e: " ' If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering , he shall bring a female without defect .

verses.z: 按手在贖罪祭牲的頭上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了作贖罪祭。
verses.e: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering , and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering .

verses.z: 祭司要用指頭蘸些贖罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，所有的血都要倒在壇的腳那裏，
verses.e: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering ; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar .

verses.z: 又要把所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭羊羔的脂油一樣。祭司要按獻給耶和華火祭的條例，燒在壇上。至於所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。」
verses.e: He shall remove all its fat , like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings . The priest shall burn them on the altar , on the offerings of the LORD made by fire . The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned , and he will be forgiven .

verses.z: 他要牽公牛到會幕門口，在耶和華面前按手在牛的頭上，把牛宰於耶和華面前。
verses.e: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD ; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull , and kill the bull before the LORD .

verses.z: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血帶到會幕，
verses.e: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull , and bring it to the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 把指頭蘸於血中，在耶和華面前對着聖所的幔子彈血七次，
verses.e: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood , and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD , before the veil of the sanctuary .

verses.z: 又要把些血抹在會幕內、耶和華面前香壇的四角上，再把公牛所有的血倒在會幕門口、燔祭壇的腳那裏。
verses.e: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD , which is in the Tent of Meeting ; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering , which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 要把贖罪祭公牛所有的脂油，乃是蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
verses.e: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it : the fat that covers the innards , and all the fat that is on the innards ,

verses.z: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下，
verses.e: and the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the loins , and the cover on the liver , with the kidneys , he shall remove ,

verses.z: 「若有人聽見發誓的聲音，他本是見證，卻不把所看見的、所知道的說出來，這就是罪；他要擔當他的罪孽。
verses.e: " ' If anyone sins , in that he hears a public adjuration to testify , he being a witness , whether he has seen or known , if he doesn't report it , then he shall bear his iniquity .

verses.z: 他要照例獻第二隻為燔祭。至於他所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。
verses.e: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering , according to the ordinance ; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned , and he shall be forgiven .

verses.z: 「他的力量若不夠獻兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，就要因所犯的罪帶供物來，就是細麵伊法十分之一為贖罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因為是贖罪祭。
verses.e: " ' But if he can't afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons , then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned , one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering . He shall put no oil on it , and he shall not put any frankincense on it , for it is a sin offering .

verses.z: 他要把供物帶到祭司那裏，祭司要取出自己的一把來作為紀念，按獻給耶和華火祭的條例燒在壇上；這是贖罪祭。
verses.e: He shall bring it to the priest , and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion , and burn it on the altar , on the offerings of the LORD made by fire . It is a sin offering .

verses.z: 至於他在這幾件事中所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。[剩下的麵]都歸與祭司，和素祭一樣。」
verses.e: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things , and he will be forgiven ; and the rest shall be the priest's , as the meal offering . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「人若在耶和華的聖物上誤犯了罪，有了過犯，就要照你所估的，按聖所的舍客勒拿銀子，將贖愆祭牲－就是羊群中一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊－牽到耶和華面前為贖愆祭；
verses.e: " If anyone commits a trespass , and sins unwittingly regarding the LORD's holy things , then he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD : a ram without defect from the flock , according to your estimation in silver by shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary , for a trespass offering .

verses.z: 並且他因在聖物上的差錯要償還，另外加五分之一，都給祭司。祭司要用贖愆祭的公綿羊為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
verses.e: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing , and shall add a fifth part to it , and give it to the priest ; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering , and he will be forgiven .

verses.z: 「若有人犯罪，行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，他雖然不知道，還是有了罪，就要擔當他的罪孽；
verses.e: " If anyone sins , doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done , though he didn't know it , he is still guilty , and shall bear his iniquity .

verses.z: 也要照你所估定的價，從羊群中牽一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊來，給祭司作贖愆祭。至於他誤行的那錯事，祭司要為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
verses.e: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock , according to your estimation , for a trespass offering , to the priest ; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn't know it , and he will be forgiven .

verses.z: 這是贖愆祭，因他在耶和華面前實在有了罪。」
verses.e: It is a trespass offering . He is certainly guilty before the LORD . "

verses.z: 或是有人摸了不潔的物，無論是不潔的死獸，是不潔的死畜，是不潔的死蟲，他卻不知道，因此成了不潔，就有了罪。
verses.e: " ' Or if anyone touches any unclean thing , whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal , or the carcass of unclean livestock , or the carcass of unclean creeping things , and it is hidden from him , and he is unclean , then he shall be guilty .

verses.z: 或是他摸了別人的污穢，無論是染了甚麼污穢，他卻不知道，一知道了就有了罪。
verses.e: " ' Or if he touches the uncleanness of man , whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean , and it is hidden from him ; when he knows of it , then he shall be guilty .

verses.z: 或是有人嘴裏冒失發誓，要行惡，要行善，無論人在甚麼事上冒失發誓，他卻不知道，一知道了就要在這其中的一件上有了罪。
verses.e: " ' Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good — whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath , and it is hidden from him — when he knows of it , then he will be guilty of one of these .

verses.z: 他有了罪的時候，就要承認所犯的罪，
verses.e: It shall be , when he is guilty of one of these , he shall confess that in which he has sinned ;

verses.z: 並要因所犯的罪，把他的贖愆祭牲－就是羊群中的母羊，或是一隻羊羔，或是一隻山羊－牽到耶和華面前為贖罪祭。至於他的罪，祭司要為他贖了。
verses.e: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned : a female from the flock , a lamb or a goat , for a sin offering ; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin .

verses.z: 「他的力量若不夠獻一隻羊羔，就要因所犯的罪，把兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿帶到耶和華面前為贖愆祭：一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭。
verses.e: " ' If he can't afford a lamb , then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned , two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , to the LORD ; one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering .

verses.z: 把這些帶到祭司那裏，祭司就要先把那贖罪祭獻上，從鳥的頸項上揪下頭來，只是不可把鳥撕斷，
verses.e: He shall bring them to the priest , who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering . He shall wring off its head from its neck , but shall not sever it completely .

verses.z: 也把些贖罪祭牲的血彈在壇的旁邊，剩下的血要流在壇的腳那裏；這是贖罪祭。
verses.e: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar ; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar . It is a sin offering .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 祭司要穿上細麻布衣服，又要把細麻布褲子穿在身上，把壇上所燒的燔祭灰收起來，倒在壇的旁邊；
verses.e: The priest shall put on his linen garment , and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body ; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar , and he shall put them beside the altar .

verses.z: 隨後要脫去這衣服，穿上別的衣服，把灰拿到營外潔淨之處。
verses.e: He shall take off his garments , and put on other garments , and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place .

verses.z: 壇上的火要在其上常常燒着，不可熄滅。祭司要每日早晨在上面燒柴，並要把燔祭擺在壇上，在其上燒平安祭牲的脂油。
verses.e: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it , it shall not go out ; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning . He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it , and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings .

verses.z: 在壇上必有常常燒着的火，不可熄滅。」
verses.e: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually ; it shall not go out .

verses.z: 「素祭的條例乃是這樣：亞倫的子孫要在壇前把這祭獻在耶和華面前。
verses.e: " ' This is the law of the meal offering : the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD , before the altar .

verses.z: 祭司要從其中－就是從素祭的細麵中－取出自己的一把，又要取些油和素祭上所有的乳香，燒在壇上，奉給耶和華為馨香素祭的紀念。
verses.e: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering , and of its oil , and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering , and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma , as its memorial portion , to the LORD .

verses.z: 所剩下的，亞倫和他子孫要吃，必在聖處不帶酵而吃，要在會幕的院子裏吃。
verses.e: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat . It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place . They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: [烤的時候]不可攙酵。這是從所獻給我的火祭中賜給他們的分，是至聖的，和贖罪祭並贖愆祭一樣。
verses.e: It shall not be baked with yeast . I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire . It is most holy , as are the sin offering and the trespass offering .

verses.z: 凡獻給耶和華的火祭，亞倫子孫中的男丁都要吃這一分，直到萬代，作他們永得的分。摸這些祭物的，都要成為聖。」
verses.e: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it , as their portion forever throughout your generations , from the offerings of the LORD made by fire . Whoever touches them shall be holy . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「若有人犯罪，干犯耶和華，在鄰舍交付他的物上，或是在交易上行了詭詐，或是搶奪人的財物，或是欺壓鄰舍，
verses.e: " If anyone sins , and commits a trespass against the LORD , and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit , or of bargain , or of robbery , or has oppressed his neighbor ,

verses.z: 「當亞倫受膏的日子，他和他子孫所要獻給耶和華的供物，就是細麵伊法十分之一，為常獻的素祭：早晨一半，晚上一半。
verses.e: " This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons , which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed : one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually , half of it in the morning , and half of it in the evening .

verses.z: 要在鐵鏊上用油調和做成，調勻了，你就拿進來；烤好了分成塊子，獻給耶和華為馨香的素祭。
verses.e: It shall be made with oil in a griddle . When it is soaked , you shall bring it in . You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 亞倫的子孫中，接續他為受膏的祭司，要把這素祭獻上，要全燒給耶和華。這是永遠的定例。
verses.e: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it . By a statute forever , it shall be wholly burned to the LORD .

verses.z: 祭司的素祭都要燒了，卻不可吃。」
verses.e: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned . It shall not be eaten . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你對亞倫和他的子孫說，贖罪祭的條例乃是這樣：要在耶和華面前、宰燔祭牲的地方宰贖罪祭牲；這是至聖的。
verses.e: " Speak to Aaron and to his sons , saying , ' This is the law of the sin offering : in the place where the burnt offering is killed , the sin offering shall be killed before the LORD . It is most holy .

verses.z: 為贖罪獻這祭的祭司要吃，要在聖處，就是在會幕的院子裏吃。
verses.e: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it . It shall be eaten in a holy place , in the court of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 凡摸這祭肉的要成為聖；這祭牲的血若彈在甚麼衣服上，所彈的那一件要在聖處洗淨。
verses.e: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy . When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment , you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place .

verses.z: 惟有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在銅器裏，這銅器要擦磨，在水中涮淨。
verses.e: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken ; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel , it shall be scoured , and rinsed in water .

verses.z: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以吃；這是至聖的。
verses.e: Every male among the priests shall eat of it . It is most holy .

verses.z: 或是在撿了遺失的物上行了詭詐，說謊起誓，在這一切的事上犯了甚麼罪；
verses.e: or has found that which was lost , and lied about it , and swearing to a lie — in any of these things that a man sins in his actions —

verses.z: 凡贖罪祭，若將血帶進會幕在聖所贖罪，那肉都不可吃，必用火焚燒。」
verses.e: No sin offering , of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place , shall be eaten . It shall be burned with fire .

verses.z: 他既犯了罪，有了過犯，就要歸還他所搶奪的，或是因欺壓所得的，或是人交付他的，或是人遺失他所撿的物，
verses.e: then it shall be , if he has sinned , and is guilty , he shall restore that which he took by robbery , or the thing which he has gotten by oppression , or the deposit which was committed to him , or the lost thing which he found ,

verses.z: 或是他因甚麼物起了假誓，就要如數歸還，另外加上五分之一，在查出他有罪的日子要交還本主。
verses.e: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely : he shall restore it in full , and shall add a fifth part more to it . He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty .

verses.z: 也要照你所估定的價，把贖愆祭牲－就是羊群中一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊－牽到耶和華面前，給祭司為贖愆祭。
verses.e: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD : a ram without defect from the flock , according to your estimation , for a trespass offering , to the priest .

verses.z: 祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪；他無論行了甚麼事，使他有了罪，都必蒙赦免。」
verses.e: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD , and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要吩咐亞倫和他的子孫說，燔祭的條例乃是這樣：燔祭要放在壇的柴上，從晚上到天亮，壇上的火要常常燒着。
verses.e: " Command Aaron and his sons , saying , ' This is the law of the burnt offering : the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning ; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it .

verses.z: 「贖愆祭的條例乃是如此：這祭是至聖的。
verses.e: " ' This is the law of the trespass offering : It is most holy .

verses.z: 凡素祭，無論是油調和的是乾的，都要歸亞倫的子孫，大家均分。」
verses.e: Every meal offering , mixed with oil or dry , belongs to all the sons of Aaron , one as well as another .

verses.z: 「人獻與耶和華平安祭的條例乃是這樣：
verses.e: " ' This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which one shall offer to the LORD :

verses.z: 他若為感謝獻上，就要用調油的無酵餅和抹油的無酵薄餅，並用油調勻細麵做的餅，與感謝祭一同獻上。
verses.e: If he offers it for a thanksgiving , then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil , and unleavened wafers anointed with oil , and cakes mixed with oil .

verses.z: 要用有酵的餅和為感謝獻的平安祭，與供物一同獻上。
verses.e: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread .

verses.z: 從各樣的供物中，他要把一個餅獻給耶和華為舉祭，是要歸給灑平安祭牲血的祭司。
verses.e: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD . It shall be the priest's who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings .

verses.z: 為感謝獻平安祭牲的肉，要在獻的日子吃，一點不可留到早晨。
verses.e: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering . He shall not leave any of it until the morning .

verses.z: 若所獻的是為還願，或是甘心獻的，必在獻祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
verses.e: " ' But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow , or a free will offering , it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice . On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten ,

verses.z: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚燒；
verses.e: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire .

verses.z: 第三天若吃了平安祭的肉，這祭必不蒙悅納，人所獻的也不算為祭，反為可憎嫌的，吃這祭肉的，就必擔當他的罪孽。
verses.e: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day , it will not be accepted , and it shall not be credited to him who offers it . It will be an abomination , and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity .

verses.z: 「挨了污穢物的肉就不可吃，要用火焚燒。至於平安祭的肉，凡潔淨的人都要吃；
verses.e: " ' The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten . It shall be burned with fire . As for the meat , everyone who is clean may eat it ;

verses.z: 人在那裏宰燔祭牲，也要在那裏宰贖愆祭牲；其血，祭司要灑在壇的周圍。
verses.e: In the place where they kill the burnt offering , he shall kill the trespass offering ; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar .

verses.z: 只是獻與耶和華平安祭的肉，人若不潔淨而吃了，這人必從民中剪除。
verses.e: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD , having his uncleanness on him , that soul shall be cut off from his people .

verses.z: 有人摸了甚麼不潔淨的物，或是人的不潔淨，或是不潔淨的牲畜，或是不潔可憎之物，吃了獻與耶和華平安祭的肉，這人必從民中剪除。」
verses.e: When anyone touches any unclean thing , the uncleanness of man , or an unclean animal , or any unclean abomination , and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD , that soul shall be cut off from his people . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：牛的脂油、綿羊的脂油、山羊的脂油，你們都不可吃。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' You shall eat no fat , of bull , or sheep , or goat .

verses.z: 自死的和被野獸撕裂的，那脂油可以做別的使用，只是你們萬不可吃。
verses.e: The fat of that which dies of itself , and the fat of that which is torn of animals , may be used for any other service , but you shall in no way eat of it .

verses.z: 無論何人吃了獻給耶和華當火祭牲畜的脂油，那人必從民中剪除。
verses.e: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD , even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people .

verses.z: 在你們一切的住處，無論是雀鳥的血是野獸的血，你們都不可吃。
verses.e: You shall not eat any blood , whether it is of bird or of animal , in any of your dwellings .

verses.z: 無論是誰吃血，那人必從民中剪除。」
verses.e: Whoever it is who eats any blood , that soul shall be cut off from his people . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：獻平安祭給耶和華的，要從平安祭中取些來奉給耶和華。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings .

verses.z: 又要將肥尾巴和蓋臟的脂油，
verses.e: He shall offer all of its fat : the fat tail , and the fat that covers the innards ,

verses.z: 他親手獻給耶和華的火祭，就是脂油和胸，要帶來，好把胸在耶和華面前作搖祭，搖一搖。
verses.e: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire . He shall bring the fat with the breast , that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.z: 祭司要把脂油在壇上焚燒，但胸要歸亞倫和他的子孫。
verses.e: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar , but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons ' .

verses.z: 你們要從平安祭中把右腿作舉祭，奉給祭司。
verses.e: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings .

verses.z: 亞倫子孫中，獻平安祭牲血和脂油的，要得這右腿為分；
verses.e: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings , and the fat , shall have the right thigh for a portion .

verses.z: 因為我從以色列人的平安祭中，取了這搖的胸和舉的腿給祭司亞倫和他子孫，作他們從以色列人中所永得的分。」
verses.e: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings , and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel . ' "

verses.z: 這是從耶和華火祭中，作亞倫受膏的分和他子孫受膏的分，正在摩西叫他們前來給耶和華供祭司職分的日子，
verses.e: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron , and the consecrated portion of his sons , out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire , in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest's office ;

verses.z: 就是在摩西膏他們的日子，耶和華吩咐以色列人給他們的。這是他們世世代代永得的分。
verses.e: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel , in the day that he anointed them . It is their portion forever throughout their generations .

verses.z: 這就是燔祭、素祭、贖罪祭、贖愆祭，和平安祭的條例，並承接聖職的禮，
verses.e: This is the law of the burnt offering , the meal offering , the sin offering , the trespass offering , the consecration , and the sacrifice of peace offerings

verses.z: 都是耶和華在西奈山所吩咐摩西的，就是他在西奈曠野吩咐以色列人獻供物給耶和華之日所說的。
verses.e: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD , in the wilderness of Sinai .

verses.z: 兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
verses.e: and he shall take away the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the loins , and the cover on the liver , with the kidneys ;

verses.z: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，為獻給耶和華的火祭，是贖愆祭。
verses.e: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD : it is a trespass offering .

verses.z: 祭司中的男丁都可以吃這祭物；要在聖處吃，是至聖的。
verses.e: Every male among the priests may eat of it . It shall be eaten in a holy place . It is most holy .

verses.z: 贖罪祭怎樣，贖愆祭也是怎樣，兩個祭是一個條例。獻贖愆祭贖罪的祭司要得這祭物。
verses.e: " ' As is the sin offering , so is the trespass offering ; there is one law for them . The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it .

verses.z: 獻燔祭的祭司，無論為誰奉獻，要親自得他所獻那燔祭牲的皮。
verses.e: The priest who offers any man's burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered .

verses.z: 凡在爐中烤的素祭和煎盤中做的，並鐵鏊上做的，都要歸那獻祭的祭司。
verses.e: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven , and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle , shall be the priest's who offers it .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 摩西用膏油抹帳幕和其中所有的，使它成聖；
verses.e: Moses took the anointing oil , and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it , and sanctified them .

verses.z: 又用膏油在壇上彈了七次，又抹了壇和壇的一切器皿，並洗濯盆和盆座，使它成聖；
verses.e: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times , and anointed the altar and all its vessels , and the basin and its base , to sanctify them .

verses.z: 又把膏油倒在亞倫的頭上膏他，使他成聖。
verses.e: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head , and anointed him , to sanctify him .

verses.z: 摩西帶了亞倫的兒子來，給他們穿上內袍，束上腰帶，包上裹頭巾，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: Moses brought Aaron's sons , and clothed them with tunics , and tied sashes on them , and put headbands on them , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 他牽了贖罪祭的公牛來，亞倫和他兒子按手在贖罪祭公牛的頭上，
verses.e: He brought the bull of the sin offering , and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering .

verses.z: 就宰了公牛。摩西用指頭蘸血，抹在壇上四角的周圍，使壇潔淨，把血倒在壇的腳那裏，使壇成聖，壇就潔淨了；
verses.e: He killed it ; and Moses took the blood , and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger , and purified the altar , and poured out the blood at the base of the altar , and sanctified it , to make atonement for it .

verses.z: 又取臟上所有的脂油和肝上的網子，並兩個腰子與腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上；
verses.e: He took all the fat that was on the innards , and the cover of the liver , and the two kidneys , and their fat ; and Moses burned it on the altar .

verses.z: 惟有公牛，連皮帶肉並糞，用火燒在營外，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: But the bull , and its skin , and its meat , and its dung , he burned with fire outside the camp , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 他奉上燔祭的公綿羊；亞倫和他兒子按手在羊的頭上，
verses.e: He presented the ram of the burnt offering . Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram .

verses.z: 就宰了公羊。摩西把血灑在壇的周圍，
verses.e: He killed it ; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar .

verses.z: 「你將亞倫和他兒子一同帶來，並將聖衣、膏油，與贖罪祭的一隻公牛、兩隻公綿羊、一筐無酵餅都帶來，
verses.e: " Take Aaron and his sons with him , and the garments , and the anointing oil , and the bull of the sin offering , and the two rams , and the basket of unleavened bread ;

verses.z: 把羊切成塊子，把頭和肉塊並脂油都燒了。
verses.e: He cut the ram into its pieces ; and Moses burned the head , and the pieces , and the fat .

verses.z: 用水洗了臟腑和腿，就把全羊燒在壇上為馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: He washed the innards and the legs with water ; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar . It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma . It was an offering made by fire to the LORD , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 他又奉上第二隻公綿羊，就是承接聖職之禮的羊；亞倫和他兒子按手在羊的頭上，
verses.e: He presented the other ram , the ram of consecration . Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram .

verses.z: 就宰了羊。摩西把些血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，
verses.e: He killed it ; and Moses took some of its blood , and put it on the tip of Aaron's right ear , and on the thumb of his right hand , and on the great toe of his right foot .

verses.z: 又帶了亞倫的兒子來，把些血抹在他們的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，又把血灑在壇的周圍。
verses.e: He brought Aaron's sons ; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear , and on the thumb of their right hand , and on the great toe of their right foot ; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar .

verses.z: 取脂油和肥尾巴，並臟上一切的脂油與肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，並右腿，
verses.e: He took the fat , the fat tail , all the fat that was on the innards , the cover of the liver , the two kidneys and their fat , and the right thigh ;

verses.z: 再從耶和華面前、盛無酵餅的筐子裏取出一個無酵餅，一個油餅，一個薄餅，都放在脂油和右腿上，
verses.e: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD , he took one unleavened cake , one cake of oiled bread , and one wafer , and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh .

verses.z: 把這一切放在亞倫的手上和他兒子的手上作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
verses.e: He put all these in Aaron's hands and in his sons ' hands , and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.z: 摩西從他們的手上拿下來，燒在壇上的燔祭上，都是為承接聖職獻給耶和華馨香的火祭。
verses.e: Moses took them from their hands , and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering . They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma . It was an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 摩西拿羊的胸作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，是承接聖職之禮，歸摩西的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: Moses took the breast , and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD . It was Moses ' portion of the ram of consecration , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 又招聚會眾到會幕門口。」
verses.e: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting . "

verses.z: 摩西取點膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子和他兒子的衣服上，使他和他們的衣服一同成聖。
verses.e: Moses took some of the anointing oil , and some of the blood which was on the altar , and sprinkled it on Aaron , on his garments , and on his sons , and on his sons ' garments with him , and sanctified Aaron , his garments , and his sons , and his sons ' garments with him .

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子說：「把肉煮在會幕門口，在那裏吃，又吃承接聖職筐子裏的餅，按我所吩咐的說：『這是亞倫和他兒子要吃的。』
verses.e: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons , " Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting , and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration , as I commanded , saying , ' Aaron and his sons shall eat it . '

verses.z: 剩下的肉和餅，你們要用火焚燒。
verses.e: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire .

verses.z: 你們七天不可出會幕的門，等到你們承接聖職的日子滿了，因為主叫你們七天承接聖職。
verses.e: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days , until the days of your consecration are fulfilled : for he shall consecrate you seven days .

verses.z: 像今天所行的都是耶和華吩咐行的，為你們贖罪。
verses.e: What has been done today , so the LORD has commanded to do , to make atonement for you .

verses.z: 七天你們要晝夜住在會幕門口，遵守耶和華的吩咐，免得你們死亡，因為所吩咐我的就是這樣。」
verses.e: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days , and keep the LORD's command , that you don't die : for so I am commanded . "

verses.z: 於是亞倫和他兒子行了耶和華藉着摩西所吩咐的一切事。
verses.e: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses .

verses.z: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的行了；於是會眾聚集在會幕門口。
verses.e: Moses did as the LORD commanded him ; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 摩西告訴會眾說：「這就是耶和華所吩咐當行的事。」
verses.e: Moses said to the congregation , " This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done . "

verses.z: 摩西帶了亞倫和他兒子來，用水洗了他們。
verses.e: Moses brought Aaron and his sons , and washed them with water .

verses.z: 給亞倫穿上內袍，束上腰帶，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工織的帶子把以弗得繫在他身上，
verses.e: He put the tunic on him , tied the sash on him , clothed him with the robe , put the ephod on him , and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it .

verses.z: 又給他戴上胸牌，把烏陵和土明放在胸牌內，
verses.e: He placed the breastplate on him . He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate .

verses.z: 把冠冕戴在他頭上，在冠冕的前面釘上金牌，就是聖冠，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: He set the turban on his head . He set the golden plate , the holy crown , on the front of the turban , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 到了第八天，摩西召了亞倫和他兒子，並以色列的眾長老來，
verses.e: On the eighth day , Moses called Aaron and his sons , and the elders of Israel ;

verses.z: 惟有贖罪祭的脂油和腰子，並肝上取的網子，都燒在壇上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的；
verses.e: but the fat , and the kidneys , and the cover from the liver of the sin offering , he burned upon the altar , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 又用火將肉和皮燒在營外。
verses.e: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp .

verses.z: 亞倫宰了燔祭牲，他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍，
verses.e: He killed the burnt offering ; and Aaron's sons delivered the blood to him , and he sprinkled it around on the altar .

verses.z: 又把燔祭一塊一塊地、連頭遞給他，他都燒在壇上；
verses.e: They delivered the burnt offering to him , piece by piece , and the head . He burned them upon the altar .

verses.z: 又洗了臟腑和腿，燒在壇上的燔祭上。
verses.e: He washed the innards and the legs , and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar .

verses.z: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那給百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊宰了，為罪獻上，和先獻的一樣；
verses.e: He presented the people's offering , and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people , and killed it , and offered it for sin , like the first .

verses.z: 也奉上燔祭，照例而獻。
verses.e: He presented the burnt offering , and offered it according to the ordinance .

verses.z: 他又奉上素祭，從其中取一滿把，燒在壇上；這是在早晨的燔祭以外。
verses.e: He presented the meal offering , and filled his hand from there , and burned it upon the altar , in addition to the burnt offering of the morning .

verses.z: 亞倫宰了那給百姓作平安祭的公牛和公綿羊。他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍；
verses.e: He also killed the bull and the ram , the sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people . Aaron's sons delivered to him the blood , which he sprinkled around on the altar ;

verses.z: 又把公牛和公綿羊的脂油、肥尾巴，並蓋[臟]的脂油與腰子，和肝上的網子，都遞給他；
verses.e: and the fat of the bull and of the ram , the fat tail , and that which covers the innards , and the kidneys , and the cover of the liver ;

verses.z: 對亞倫說：「你當取牛群中的一隻公牛犢作贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊作燔祭，都要沒有殘疾的，獻在耶和華面前。
verses.e: and he said to Aaron , " Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering , and a ram for a burnt offering , without defect , and offer them before the LORD .

verses.z: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油燒在壇上。
verses.e: and they put the fat upon the breasts , and he burned the fat on the altar .

verses.z: 胸和右腿，亞倫當作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，都是照摩西所吩咐的。
verses.e: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD , as Moses commanded .

verses.z: 亞倫向百姓舉手，為他們祝福。他獻了贖罪祭、燔祭、平安祭就下來了。
verses.e: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people , and blessed them ; and he came down from offering the sin offering , and the burnt offering , and the peace offerings .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫進入會幕，又出來為百姓祝福，耶和華的榮光就向眾民顯現。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting , and came out , and blessed the people ; and the LORD's glory appeared to all the people .

verses.z: 有火從耶和華面前出來，在壇上燒盡燔祭和脂油；眾民一見，就都歡呼，俯伏在地。
verses.e: Fire came out from before the LORD , and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar . When all the people saw it , they shouted , and fell on their faces .

verses.z: 你也要對以色列人說：『你們當取一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，又取一隻牛犢和一隻綿羊羔，都要一歲、沒有殘疾的，作燔祭，
verses.e: You shall speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' Take a male goat for a sin offering ; and a calf and a lamb , both a year old , without defect , for a burnt offering ;

verses.z: 又取一隻公牛，一隻公綿羊作平安祭，獻在耶和華面前，並取調油的素祭，因為今天耶和華要向你們顯現。』」
verses.e: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings , to sacrifice before the LORD ; and a meal offering mixed with oil : for today the LORD appears to you . ' "

verses.z: 於是他們把摩西所吩咐的，帶到會幕前；全會眾都近前來，站在耶和華面前。
verses.e: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting . All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD .

verses.z: 摩西說：「這是耶和華吩咐你們所當行的；耶和華的榮光就要向你們顯現。」
verses.e: Moses said , " This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do ; and the LORD's glory shall appear to you . "

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫說：「你就近壇前，獻你的贖罪祭和燔祭，為自己與百姓贖罪，又獻上百姓的供物，為他們贖罪，都照耶和華所吩咐的。」
verses.e: Moses said to Aaron , " Draw near to the altar , and offer your sin offering , and your burnt offering , and make atonement for yourself , and for the people ; and offer the offering of the people , and make atonement for them , as the LORD commanded . "

verses.z: 於是，亞倫就近壇前，宰了為自己作贖罪祭的牛犢。
verses.e: So Aaron came near to the altar , and killed the calf of the sin offering , which was for himself .

verses.z: 亞倫的兒子把血奉給他，他就把指頭蘸在血中，抹在壇的四角上，又把血倒在壇腳那裏。
verses.e: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him ; and he dipped his finger in the blood , and put it on the horns of the altar , and poured out the blood at the base of the altar ;

verses.z: 提阿非羅大人哪，有好些人提筆作書，述說在我們中間所成就的事，是照傳道的人從起初親眼看見又傳給我們的。
verses.e: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us ,

verses.z: 燒香的時候，眾百姓在外面禱告。
verses.e: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense .

verses.z: 有主的使者站在香壇的右邊，向他顯現。
verses.e: An angel of the Lord appeared to him , standing on the right side of the altar of incense .

verses.z: 撒迦利亞看見，就驚慌害怕。
verses.e: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him , and fear fell upon him .

verses.z: 天使對他說：「撒迦利亞，不要害怕，因為你的祈禱已經被聽見了。你的妻子伊利莎白要給你生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫約翰。
verses.e: But the angel said to him , " Don't be afraid , Zacharias , because your request has been heard . Your wife , Elizabeth , will bear you a son , and you shall call his name John .

verses.z: 你必歡喜快樂；有許多人因他出世，也必喜樂。
verses.e: You will have joy and gladness , and many will rejoice at his birth .

verses.z: 他在主面前將要為大，淡酒濃酒都不喝，從母腹裏就被聖靈充滿了。
verses.e: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord , and he will drink no wine nor strong drink . He will be filled with the Holy Spirit , even from his mother's womb .

verses.z: 他要使許多以色列人回轉，歸於主－他們的上帝。
verses.e: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God .

verses.z: 他必有以利亞的心志能力，行在主的前面，叫為父的心轉向兒女，叫悖逆的人轉從義人的智慧，又為主預備合用的百姓。」
verses.e: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah , ' to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children , ' and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just ; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord . "

verses.z: 撒迦利亞對天使說：「我憑着甚麼可知道這事呢？我已經老了，我的妻子也年紀老邁了。」
verses.e: Zacharias said to the angel , " How can I be sure of this ? For I am an old man , and my wife is well advanced in years . "

verses.z: 天使回答說：「我是站在上帝面前的加百列，奉差而來對你說話，將這好信息報給你。
verses.e: The angel answered him , " I am Gabriel , who stands in the presence of God . I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news .
even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us ,

verses.z: 到了時候，這話必然應驗；只因你不信，你必啞巴，不能說話，直到這事成就的日子。」
verses.e: Behold , you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen , because you didn't believe my words , which will be fulfilled in their proper time . "

verses.z: 百姓等候撒迦利亞，詫異他許久在殿裏。
verses.e: The people were waiting for Zacharias , and they marveled that he delayed in the temple .

verses.z: 及至他出來，不能和他們說話，他們就知道他在殿裏見了異象；因為他直向他們打手式，竟成了啞巴。
verses.e: When he came out , he could not speak to them . They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple . He continued making signs to them , and remained mute .

verses.z: 他供職的日子已滿，就回家去了。
verses.e: When the days of his service were fulfilled , he departed to his house .

verses.z: 這些日子以後，他的妻子伊利莎白懷了孕，就隱藏了五個月，
verses.e: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived , and she hid herself five months , saying ,

verses.z: 說：「主在眷顧我的日子，這樣看待我，要把我在人間的羞恥除掉。」
verses.e: " Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me , to take away my reproach among men . "

verses.z: 到了第六個月，天使加百列奉上帝的差遣往加利利的一座城去（這城名叫拿撒勒），
verses.e: Now in the sixth month , the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth ,

verses.z: 到一個童女那裏，是已經許配大衛家的一個人，名叫約瑟。童女的名字叫馬利亞；
verses.e: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph , of David's house . The virgin's name was Mary .

verses.z: 天使進去，對她說：「蒙大恩的女子，我問你安，主和你同在了！」
verses.e: Having come in , the angel said to her , " Rejoice , you highly favored one ! The Lord is with you . Blessed are you among women ! "

verses.z: 馬利亞因這話就很驚慌，又反覆思想這樣問安是甚麼意思。
verses.e: But when she saw him , she was greatly troubled at the saying , and considered what kind of salutation this might be .

verses.z: 這些事我既從起頭都詳細考察了，就定意要按着次序寫給你，
verses.e: it seemed good to me also , having traced the course of all things accurately from the first , to write to you in order , most excellent Theophilus ;

verses.z: 天使對她說：「馬利亞，不要怕！你在上帝面前已經蒙恩了。
verses.e: The angel said to her , " Don't be afraid , Mary , for you have found favor with God .

verses.z: 你要懷孕生子，可以給他起名叫耶穌。
verses.e: Behold , you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son , and shall name him ' Jesus . '

verses.z: 他要為大，稱為至高者的兒子；主上帝要把他祖大衛的位給他。
verses.e: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High . The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David ,

verses.z: 他要作雅各家的王，直到永遠；他的國也沒有窮盡。」
verses.e: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever . There will be no end to his Kingdom . "

verses.z: 馬利亞對天使說：「我沒有出嫁，怎麼有這事呢？」
verses.e: Mary said to the angel , " How can this be , seeing I am a virgin ? "

verses.z: 天使回答說：「聖靈要臨到你身上，至高者的能力要蔭庇你，因此所要生的聖者必稱為上帝的兒子。
verses.e: The angel answered her , " The Holy Spirit will come on you , and the power of the Most High will overshadow you . Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God .

verses.z: 況且你的親戚伊利莎白，在年老的時候也懷了男胎，就是那素來稱為不生育的，現在有孕六個月了。
verses.e: Behold , Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age ; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren .

verses.z: 因為，出於上帝的話，沒有一句不帶能力的。」
verses.e: For nothing spoken by God is impossible . "

verses.z: 馬利亞說：「我是主的使女，情願照你的話成就在我身上。」天使就離開她去了。
verses.e: Mary said , " Behold , the servant of the Lord ; let it be done to me according to your word . " Then the angel departed from her .

verses.z: 那時候，馬利亞起身，急忙往山地裏去，來到猶大的一座城；
verses.e: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste , into a city of Judah ,

verses.z: 使你知道所學之道都是確實的。
verses.e: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed .

verses.z: 進了撒迦利亞的家，問伊利莎白安。
verses.e: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth .

verses.z: 伊利莎白一聽馬利亞問安，所懷的胎就在腹裏跳動。伊利莎白且被聖靈充滿，
verses.e: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting , the baby leaped in her womb ; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 高聲喊着說：「你在婦女中是有福的！你所懷的胎也是有福的！
verses.e: She called out with a loud voice and said , " Blessed are you among women , and blessed is the fruit of your womb !

verses.z: 我主的母到我這裏來，這是從哪裏得的呢？
verses.e: Why am I so favored , that the mother of my Lord should come to me ?

verses.z: 因為你問安的聲音一入我耳，我腹裏的胎就歡喜跳動。
verses.e: For behold , when the voice of your greeting came into my ears , the baby leaped in my womb for joy !

verses.z: 這相信的女子是有福的！因為主對她所說的話都要應驗。」
verses.e: Blessed is she who believed , for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord ! "

verses.z: 馬利亞說：我心尊主為大；
verses.e: Mary said , " My soul magnifies the Lord .

verses.z: 我靈以上帝我的救主為樂；
verses.e: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior ,

verses.z: 因為他顧念他使女的卑微；從今以後，萬代要稱我有福。
verses.e: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant . For behold , from now on , all generations will call me blessed .

verses.z: 那有權能的，為我成就了大事；他的名為聖。
verses.e: For he who is mighty has done great things for me . Holy is his name .

verses.z: 當猶太王希律的時候，亞比雅班裏有一個祭司，名叫撒迦利亞；他妻子是亞倫的後人，名叫伊利莎白。
verses.e: There was in the days of Herod , the king of Judea , a certain priest named Zacharias , of the priestly division of Abijah . He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron , and her name was Elizabeth .

verses.z: 他憐憫敬畏他的人，直到世世代代。
verses.e: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him .

verses.z: 他用膀臂施展大能；那狂傲的人正心裏妄想就被他趕散了。
verses.e: He has shown strength with his arm . He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .

verses.z: 他叫有權柄的失位，叫卑賤的升高；
verses.e: He has put down princes from their thrones , and has exalted the lowly .

verses.z: 叫飢餓的得飽美食，叫富足的空手回去。
verses.e: He has filled the hungry with good things . He has sent the rich away empty .

verses.z: 他扶助了他的僕人以色列，
verses.e: He has given help to Israel , his servant , that he might remember mercy ,

verses.z: 為要記念亞伯拉罕和他的後裔，施憐憫直到永遠，正如從前對我們列祖所說的話。
verses.e: as he spoke to our fathers , to Abraham and his offspring forever . "

verses.z: 馬利亞和伊利莎白同住，約有三個月，就回家去了。
verses.e: Mary stayed with her about three months , and then returned to her house .

verses.z: 伊利莎白的產期到了，就生了一個兒子。
