verses.e: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled , and she gave birth to a son .

verses.z: 鄰里親族聽見主向她大施憐憫，就和她一同歡樂。
verses.e: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her , and they rejoiced with her .

verses.z: 到了第八日，他們來要給孩子行割禮，並要照他父親的名字叫他撒迦利亞。
verses.e: On the eighth day , they came to circumcise the child ; and they would have called him Zacharias , after the name of his father .

verses.z: 他們二人在上帝面前都是義人，遵行主的一切誡命禮儀，沒有可指摘的，
verses.e: They were both righteous before God , walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord .

verses.z: 他母親說：「不可！要叫他約翰。」
verses.e: His mother answered , " Not so ; but he will be called John . "

verses.z: 他們說：「你親族中沒有叫這名字的。」
verses.e: They said to her , " There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name . "

verses.z: 他們就向他父親打手式，問他要叫這孩子甚麼名字。
verses.e: They made signs to his father , what he would have him called .

verses.z: 他要了一塊寫字的板，就寫上，說：「他的名字是約翰。」他們便都希奇。
verses.e: He asked for a writing tablet , and wrote , " His name is John . " They all marveled .

verses.z: 撒迦利亞的口立時開了，舌頭也[舒展了]，就說出話來，稱頌上帝。
verses.e: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed , and he spoke , blessing God .

verses.z: 周圍居住的人都懼怕；這一切的事就傳遍了猶太的山地。
verses.e: Fear came on all who lived around them , and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea .

verses.z: 凡聽見的人都將這事放在心裏，說：「這個孩子將來怎麼樣呢？因為有主與他同在。」
verses.e: All who heard them laid them up in their heart , saying , " What then will this child be ? " The hand of the Lord was with him .

verses.z: 他父親撒迦利亞被聖靈充滿了，就預言說：
verses.e: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit , and prophesied , saying ,

verses.z: 主－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的！因他眷顧他的百姓，為他們施行救贖，
verses.e: " Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel , for he has visited and redeemed his people ;

verses.z: 在他僕人大衛家中，為我們興起了拯救的角，
verses.e: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

verses.z: 只是沒有孩子；因為伊利莎白不生育，兩個人又年紀老邁了。
verses.e: But they had no child , because Elizabeth was barren , and they both were well advanced in years .

verses.z: 正如主藉着從創世以來聖先知的口所說的話，
verses.e: ( as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old ) ,

verses.z: 拯救我們脫離仇敵和一切恨我們之人的手，
verses.e: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us ;

verses.z: 向我們列祖施憐憫，記念他的聖約－
verses.e: to show mercy toward our fathers , to remember his holy covenant ,

verses.z: 就是他對我們祖宗亞伯拉罕所起的誓－
verses.e: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father ,

verses.z: 叫我們既從仇敵手中被救出來，
verses.e: to grant to us that we , being delivered out of the hand of our enemies , should serve him without fear ,

verses.z: 就可以終身在他面前，坦然無懼地用聖潔、公義事奉他。
verses.e: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life .

verses.z: 孩子啊！你要稱為至高者的先知；因為你要行在主的前面，預備他的道路，
verses.e: And you , child , will be called a prophet of the Most High ; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways ,

verses.z: 叫他的百姓因罪得赦，就知道救恩。
verses.e: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins ,

verses.z: 因我們上帝憐憫的心腸，叫清晨的日光從高天臨到我們，
verses.e: because of the tender mercy of our God , by which the dawn from on high will visit us ,

verses.z: 要照亮坐在黑暗中死蔭裏的人，把我們的腳引到平安的路上。
verses.e: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death ; to guide our feet into the way of peace . "

verses.z: 撒迦利亞按班次在上帝面前供祭司的職分，
verses.e: Now while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his division

verses.z: 那孩子漸漸長大，心靈強健，住在曠野，直到他顯明在以色列人面前的日子。
verses.e: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit , and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel .

verses.z: 照祭司的規矩掣籤，得進主殿燒香。
verses.e: according to the custom of the priest's office , his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense .

verses.z: 這事以後，主又設立七十個人，差遣他們兩個兩個地在他前面，往自己所要到的各城各地方去，
verses.e: Now after these things , the Lord also appointed seventy others , and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come .

verses.z: 無論進哪一城，人若不接待你們，你們就到街上去，
verses.e: But into whatever city you enter and they don't receive you , go out into its streets and say ,

verses.z: 說：『就是你們城裏的塵土黏在我們的腳上，我們也當着你們擦去。雖然如此，你們該知道上帝的國臨近了。』
verses.e: ' Even the dust from your city that clings to us , we wipe off against you . Nevertheless know this , that God's Kingdom has come near to you . '

verses.z: 我告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪所受的，比那城還容易受呢！」
verses.e: I tell you , it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city .

verses.z: 「哥拉汛哪，你有禍了！伯賽大啊，你有禍了！因為在你們中間所行的異能若行在泰爾、西頓，他們早已披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。
verses.e: " Woe to you , Chorazin ! Woe to you , Bethsaida ! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you , they would have repented long ago , sitting in sackcloth and ashes .

verses.z: 當審判的日子，泰爾、西頓所受的，比你們還容易受呢！
verses.e: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you .

verses.z: 迦百農啊，你已經升到天上，將來必推下陰間。」
verses.e: You , Capernaum , who are exalted to heaven , will be brought down to Hades .

verses.z: [又對門徒說]：「聽從你們的就是聽從我；棄絕你們的就是棄絕我；棄絕我的就是棄絕那差我來的。」
verses.e: Whoever listens to you listens to me , and whoever rejects you rejects me . Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me . "

verses.z: 那七十個人歡歡喜喜地回來，說：「主啊！因你的名，就是鬼也服了我們。」
verses.e: The seventy returned with joy , saying , " Lord , even the demons are subject to us in your name ! "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「我曾看見撒但從天上墜落，像閃電一樣。
verses.e: He said to them , " I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven .

verses.z: 我已經給你們權柄可以踐踏蛇和蠍子，又勝過仇敵一切的能力，斷沒有甚麼能害你們。
verses.e: Behold , I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions , and over all the power of the enemy . Nothing will in any way hurt you .

verses.z: 就對他們說：「要收的莊稼多，做工的人少。所以，你們當求莊稼的主打發工人出去收他的莊稼。
verses.e: Then he said to them , " The harvest is indeed plentiful , but the laborers are few . Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest , that he may send out laborers into his harvest .

verses.z: 然而，不要因鬼服了你們就歡喜，要因你們的名記錄在天上歡喜。」
verses.e: Nevertheless , don't rejoice in this , that the spirits are subject to you , but rejoice that your names are written in heaven . "

verses.z: 正當那時，耶穌被聖靈感動就歡樂，說：「父啊，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。父啊！是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
verses.e: In that same hour , Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit , and said , " I thank you , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding , and revealed them to little children . Yes , Father , for so it was well-pleasing in your sight . "

verses.z: 一切所有的都是我父交付我的；除了父，沒有人知道子是誰；除了子和子所願意指示的，沒有人知道父是誰。」
verses.e: Turning to the disciples , he said , " All things have been delivered to me by my Father . No one knows who the Son is , except the Father , and who the Father is , except the Son , and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him . "

verses.z: 耶穌轉身暗暗地對門徒說：「看見你們所看見的，那眼睛就有福了。
verses.e: Turning to the disciples , he said privately , " Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see ,

verses.z: 我告訴你們，從前有許多先知和君王要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。」
verses.e: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see , and didn't see them , and to hear the things which you hear , and didn't hear them . "

verses.z: 有一個律法師起來試探耶穌，說：「夫子！我該做甚麼才可以承受永生？」
verses.e: Behold , a certain lawyer stood up and tested him , saying , " Teacher , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「律法上寫的是甚麼？你念的是怎樣呢？」
verses.e: He said to him , " What is written in the law ? How do you read it ? "

verses.z: 他回答說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡力、盡意愛主－你的上帝；又要愛鄰舍如同自己。」
verses.e: He answered , " You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart , with all your soul , with all your strength , and with all your mind ; and your neighbor as yourself . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你回答的是；你這樣行，就必得[永]生。」
verses.e: He said to him , " You have answered correctly . Do this , and you will live . "

verses.z: 那人要顯明自己有理，就對耶穌說：「誰是我的鄰舍呢？」
verses.e: But he , desiring to justify himself , asked Jesus , " Who is my neighbor ? "

verses.z: 你們去吧！我差你們出去，如同羊羔進入狼群。
verses.e: Go your ways . Behold , I send you out as lambs among wolves .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「有一個人從耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在強盜手中。他們剝去他的衣裳，把他打個半死，就丟下他走了。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho , and he fell among robbers , who both stripped him and beat him , and departed , leaving him half dead .

verses.z: 偶然有一個祭司從這條路下來，看見他就從那邊過去了。
verses.e: By chance a certain priest was going down that way . When he saw him , he passed by on the other side .

verses.z: 又有一個利未人來到這地方，看見他，也照樣從那邊過去了。
verses.e: In the same way a Levite also , when he came to the place and saw him , passed by on the other side .

verses.z: 惟有一個撒馬利亞人行路來到那裏，看見他就動了慈心，
verses.e: But a certain Samaritan , as he traveled , came where he was . When he saw him , he was moved with compassion ,

verses.z: 上前用油和酒倒在他的傷處，包裹好了，扶他騎上自己的牲口，帶到店裏去照應他。
verses.e: came to him , and bound up his wounds , pouring on oil and wine . He set him on his own animal , brought him to an inn , and took care of him .

verses.z: 第二天拿出二錢銀子來，交給店主，說：『你且照應他；此外所費用的，我回來必還你。』
verses.e: On the next day , when he departed , he took out two denarii , gave them to the host , and said to him , ' Take care of him . Whatever you spend beyond that , I will repay you when I return . '

verses.z: 你想，這三個人哪一個是落在強盜手中的鄰舍呢？」
verses.e: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers ? "

verses.z: 他說：「是憐憫他的。」耶穌說：「你去照樣行吧。」
verses.e: He said , " He who showed mercy on him . " Then Jesus said to him , " Go and do likewise . "

verses.z: 他們走路的時候，耶穌進了一個村莊。有一個女人，名叫馬大，接他到自己家裏。
verses.e: As they went on their way , he entered into a certain village , and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house .

verses.z: 她有一個妹子，名叫馬利亞，在耶穌腳前坐着聽他的道。
verses.e: She had a sister called Mary , who also sat at Jesus ' feet and heard his word .

verses.z: 不要帶錢囊，不要帶口袋，不要帶鞋；在路上也不要問人的安。
verses.e: Carry no purse , nor wallet , nor sandals . Greet no one on the way .

verses.z: 馬大伺候的事多，心裏忙亂，就進前來，說：「主啊，我的妹子留下我一個人伺候，你不在意嗎？請吩咐她來幫助我。」
verses.e: But Martha was distracted with much serving , and she came up to him , and said , " Lord , don't you care that my sister left me to serve alone ? Ask her therefore to help me . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「馬大！馬大！你為許多的事思慮煩擾，
verses.e: Jesus answered her , " Martha , Martha , you are anxious and troubled about many things ,

verses.z: 但是不可少的只有一件；馬利亞已經選擇那上好的福分，是不能奪去的。」
verses.e: but one thing is needed . Mary has chosen the good part , which will not be taken away from her . "

verses.z: 無論進哪一家，先要說：『願這一家平安。』
verses.e: Into whatever house you enter , first say , ' Peace be to this house . '

verses.z: 那裏若有當得平安的人，你們所求的平安就必臨到那家；不然，就歸與你們了。
verses.e: If a son of peace is there , your peace will rest on him ; but if not , it will return to you .

verses.z: 你們要住在那家，吃喝他們所供給的，因為工人得工價是應當的；不要從這家搬到那家。
verses.e: Remain in that same house , eating and drinking the things they give , for the laborer is worthy of his wages . Don't go from house to house .

verses.z: 無論進哪一城，人若接待你們，給你們擺上甚麼，你們就吃甚麼。
verses.e: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you , eat the things that are set before you .

verses.z: 要醫治那城裏的病人，對他們說：『上帝的國臨近你們了。』
verses.e: Heal the sick who are there and tell them , ' God's Kingdom has come near to you . '

verses.z: 耶穌在一個地方禱告；禱告完了，有個門徒對他說：「求主教導我們禱告，像約翰教導他的門徒。」
verses.e: When he finished praying in a certain place , one of his disciples said to him , " Lord , teach us to pray , just as John also taught his disciples . "

verses.z: 因為，凡祈求的，就得着；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
verses.e: For everyone who asks receives . He who seeks finds . To him who knocks it will be opened .

verses.z: 你們中間作父親的，誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？求魚，反拿蛇當魚給他呢？
verses.e: " Which of you fathers , if your son asks for bread , will give him a stone ? Or if he asks for a fish , he won't give him a snake instead of a fish , will he ?

verses.z: 求[雞]蛋，反給他蠍子呢？
verses.e: Or if he asks for an egg , he won't give him a scorpion , will he ?

verses.z: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女；何況天父，豈不更將聖靈給求他的人嗎？」
verses.e: If you then , being evil , know how to give good gifts to your children , how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him ? "

verses.z: 耶穌趕出一個叫人啞巴的鬼；鬼出去了，啞巴就說出話來；眾人都希奇。
verses.e: He was casting out a demon , and it was mute . When the demon had gone out , the mute man spoke ; and the multitudes marveled .

verses.z: 內中卻有人說：「他是靠着鬼王別西卜趕鬼。」
verses.e: But some of them said , " He casts out demons by Beelzebul , the prince of the demons . "

verses.z: 又有人試探耶穌，向他求從天上來的神蹟。
verses.e: Others , testing him , sought from him a sign from heaven .

verses.z: 他曉得他們的意念，便對他們說：「凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；凡一家自相紛爭，就必敗落。
verses.e: But he , knowing their thoughts , said to them , " Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation . A house divided against itself falls .

verses.z: 若撒但自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？因為你們說我是靠着別西卜趕鬼。
verses.e: If Satan also is divided against himself , how will his kingdom stand ? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul .

verses.z: 我若靠着別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠着誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。
verses.e: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul , by whom do your children cast them out ? Therefore they will be your judges .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們禱告的時候，要說：我們在天上的父：願人都尊你的名為聖。願你的國降臨；願你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。
verses.e: He said to them , " When you pray , say , ' Our Father in heaven , may your name be kept holy . May your Kingdom come . May your will be done on earth , as it is in heaven .

verses.z: 我若靠着上帝的能力趕鬼，這就是上帝的國臨到你們了。
verses.e: But if I by God's finger cast out demons , then God's Kingdom has come to you .

verses.z: 壯士披掛整齊，看守自己的住宅，他所有的都平安無事；
verses.e: " When the strong man , fully armed , guards his own dwelling , his goods are safe .

verses.z: 但有一個比他更壯的來，勝過他，就奪去他所倚靠的盔甲兵器，又分了他的贓。
verses.e: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him , he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted , and divides his plunder .

verses.z: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」
verses.e: " He who is not with me is against me . He who doesn't gather with me scatters .

verses.z: 「污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇[之處]；既尋不着，便說：『我要回到我所出來的屋裏去。』
verses.e: The unclean spirit , when he has gone out of the man , passes through dry places , seeking rest ; and finding none , he says , ' I will turn back to my house from which I came out . '

verses.z: 到了，就看見[裏面]打掃乾淨，修飾好了，
verses.e: When he returns , he finds it swept and put in order .

verses.z: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裏。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。」
verses.e: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself , and they enter in and dwell there . The last state of that man becomes worse than the first . "

verses.z: 耶穌正說這話的時候，眾人中間有一個女人大聲說：「懷你胎的和乳養你的有福了！」
verses.e: It came to pass , as he said these things , a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him , " Blessed is the womb that bore you , and the breasts which nursed you ! "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「是，卻還不如聽上帝之道而遵守的人有福。」
verses.e: But he said , " On the contrary , blessed are those who hear the word of God , and keep it . "

verses.z: 當眾人聚集的時候，耶穌開講說：「這世代是一個邪惡的世代。他們求看神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。
verses.e: When the multitudes were gathering together to him , he began to say , " This is an evil generation . It seeks after a sign . No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet .

verses.z: 我們日用的飲食，天天賜給我們。
verses.e: Give us day by day our daily bread .

verses.z: 約拿怎樣為尼尼微人成了神蹟，人子也要照樣為這世代的人成了神蹟。
verses.e: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites , so the Son of Man will also be to this generation .

verses.z: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪；因為她從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪，在這裏有一人比所羅門更大。
verses.e: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them , for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon ; and behold , one greater than Solomon is here .

verses.z: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪，在這裏有一人比約拿更大。」
verses.e: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation , and will condemn it , for they repented at the preaching of Jonah ; and behold , one greater than Jonah is here .

verses.z: 「沒有人點燈放在地窨子裏，或是斗底下，總是放在燈臺上，使進來的人得見亮光。
verses.e: " No one , when he has lit a lamp , puts it in a cellar or under a basket , but on a stand , that those who come in may see the light .

verses.z: 你眼睛就是身上的燈。你的眼睛若瞭亮，全身就光明；眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。
verses.e: The lamp of the body is the eye . Therefore when your eye is good , your whole body is also full of light ; but when it is evil , your body also is full of darkness .

verses.z: 所以，你要省察，恐怕你裏頭的光或者黑暗了。
verses.e: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn't darkness .

verses.z: 若是你全身光明，毫無黑暗，就必全然光明，如同燈的明光照亮你。」
verses.e: If therefore your whole body is full of light , having no part dark , it will be wholly full of light , as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light . "

verses.z: 說話的時候，有一個法利賽人請耶穌同他吃飯，耶穌就進去坐席。
verses.e: Now as he spoke , a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him . He went in and sat at the table .

verses.z: 這法利賽人看見耶穌飯前不洗[手]便詫異。
verses.e: When the Pharisee saw it , he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner .

verses.z: 主對他說：「如今你們法利賽人洗淨杯盤的外面，你們裏面卻滿了勒索和邪惡。
verses.e: The Lord said to him , " Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter , but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness .

verses.z: 赦免我們的罪，因為我們也赦免凡虧欠我們的人。不叫我們遇見試探；救我們脫離凶惡。」
verses.e: Forgive us our sins , for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us . Bring us not into temptation , but deliver us from the evil one . ' "

verses.z: 無知的人哪，造外面的，不也造裏面嗎？
verses.e: You foolish ones , didn't he who made the outside make the inside also ?

verses.z: 只要把裏面的施捨給人，凡物於你們就都潔淨了。
verses.e: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within , and behold , all things will be clean to you .

verses.z: 「你們法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、芸香並各樣菜蔬獻上十分之一，那公義和愛上帝的事反倒不行了。這原是你們當行的；那也是不可不行的。
verses.e: But woe to you Pharisees ! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb , but you bypass justice and God's love . You ought to have done these , and not to have left the other undone .

verses.z: 你們法利賽人有禍了！因為你們喜愛會堂裏的首位，又喜愛人在街市上問你們的安。
verses.e: Woe to you Pharisees ! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces .

verses.z: 你們有禍了！因為你們如同不顯露的墳墓，走在上面的人並不知道。」
verses.e: Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you are like hidden graves , and the men who walk over them don't know it . "

verses.z: 律法師中有一個回答耶穌說：「夫子！你這樣說也把我們糟蹋了。」
verses.e: One of the lawyers answered him , " Teacher , in saying this you insult us also . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們律法師也有禍了！因為你們把難擔的擔子放在人身上，自己一個指頭卻不肯動。
verses.e: He said , " Woe to you lawyers also ! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry , and you yourselves won't even lift one finger to help carry those burdens .

verses.z: 你們有禍了！因為你們修造先知的墳墓，那先知正是你們的祖宗所殺的。
verses.e: Woe to you ! For you build the tombs of the prophets , and your fathers killed them .

verses.z: 可見你們祖宗所做的事，你們又證明又喜歡；因為他們殺了先知，你們修造[先知的墳墓]。
verses.e: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers . For they killed them , and you build their tombs .

verses.z: 所以上帝用智慧曾說：『我要差遣先知和使徒到他們那裏去，有的他們要殺害，有的他們要逼迫』，
verses.e: Therefore also the wisdom of God said , ' I will send to them prophets and apostles ; and some of them they will kill and persecute ,

verses.z: 耶穌又說：「你們中間誰有一個朋友半夜到他那裏去，說：『朋友！請借給我三個餅；
verses.e: He said to them , " Which of you , if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him , ' Friend , lend me three loaves of bread ,

verses.z: 使創世以來所流眾先知血的罪都要問在這世代的人身上，
verses.e: that the blood of all the prophets , which was shed from the foundation of the world , may be required of this generation ,

verses.z: 就是從亞伯的血起，直到被殺在壇和殿中間撒迦利亞的血為止。我實在告訴你們，這都要問在這世代的人身上。
verses.e: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah , who perished between the altar and the sanctuary . ' Yes , I tell you , it will be required of this generation .

verses.z: 你們律法師有禍了！因為你們把知識的鑰匙奪了去，自己不進去，正要進去的人你們也阻擋他們。」
verses.e: Woe to you lawyers ! For you took away the key of knowledge . You didn't enter in yourselves , and those who were entering in , you hindered . "

verses.z: 耶穌從那裏出來，文士和法利賽人就極力地催逼他，引動他多說話，
verses.e: As he said these things to them , the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry , and to draw many things out of him ,

verses.z: 私下窺聽，要拿他的話柄。
verses.e: lying in wait for him , and seeking to catch him in something he might say , that they might accuse him .

verses.z: 因為我有一個朋友行路，來到我這裏，我沒有甚麼給他擺上。』
verses.e: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey , and I have nothing to set before him , '

verses.z: 那人在裏面回答說：『不要攪擾我，門已經關閉，孩子們也同我在床上了，我不能起來給你。』
verses.e: and he from within will answer and say , ' Don't bother me . The door is now shut , and my children are with me in bed . I can't get up and give it to you ' ?

verses.z: 我告訴你們，雖不因他是朋友起來給他，但因他情詞迫切地直求，就必起來照他所需用的給他。
verses.e: I tell you , although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend , yet because of his persistence , he will get up and give him as many as he needs .

verses.z: 我又告訴你們，你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
verses.e: " I tell you , keep asking , and it will be given you . Keep seeking , and you will find . Keep knocking , and it will be opened to you .

verses.z: 這時，有幾萬人聚集，甚至彼此踐踏。耶穌開講，先對門徒說：「你們要防備法利賽人的酵，就是假冒為善。
verses.e: Meanwhile , when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together , so much so that they trampled on each other , he began to tell his disciples first of all , " Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy .

verses.z: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨褻瀆聖靈的，總不得赦免。
verses.e: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven , but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven .

verses.z: 人帶你們到會堂，並官府和有權柄的人面前，不要思慮怎麼分訴，說甚麼話；
verses.e: When they bring you before the synagogues , the rulers , and the authorities , don't be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say ;

verses.z: 因為正在那時候，聖靈要指教你們當說的話。」
verses.e: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say . "

verses.z: 眾人中有一個人對耶穌說：「夫子！請你吩咐我的兄長和我分開家業。」
verses.e: One of the multitude said to him , " Teacher , tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你這個人！誰立我作你們斷事的官，給你們分家業呢？」
verses.e: But he said to him , " Man , who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you ? "

verses.z: 於是對眾人說：「你們要謹慎自守，免去一切的貪心，因為人的生命不在乎家道豐富。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Beware ! Keep yourselves from covetousness , for a man's life doesn't consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses . "

verses.z: 就用比喻對他們說：「有一個財主田產豐盛；
verses.e: He spoke a parable to them , saying , " The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly .

verses.z: 自己心裏思想說：『我的出產沒有地方收藏，怎麼辦呢？』
verses.e: He reasoned within himself , saying , ' What will I do , because I don't have room to store my crops ? '

verses.z: 又說：『我要這麼辦：要把我的倉房拆了，另蓋更大的，在那裏好收藏我一切的糧食和財物，
verses.e: He said , ' This is what I will do . I will pull down my barns , build bigger ones , and there I will store all my grain and my goods .

verses.z: 然後要對我的靈魂說：靈魂哪，你有許多財物積存，可作多年的費用，只管安安逸逸地吃喝快樂吧！』
verses.e: I will tell my soul , " Soul , you have many goods laid up for many years . Take your ease , eat , drink , and be merry . " '

verses.z: 掩蓋的事沒有不露出來的；隱藏的事沒有不被人知道的。
verses.e: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed , nor hidden that will not be known .

verses.z: 上帝卻對他說：『無知的人哪，今夜必要你的靈魂；你所預備的要歸誰呢？』
verses.e: " But God said to him , ' You foolish one , tonight your soul is required of you . The things which you have prepared — whose will they be ? '

verses.z: 凡為自己積財，在上帝面前卻不富足的，也是這樣。」
verses.e: So is he who lays up treasure for himself , and is not rich toward God . "

verses.z: 耶穌又對門徒說：「所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮吃甚麼，為身體憂慮穿甚麼；
verses.e: He said to his disciples , " Therefore I tell you , don't be anxious for your life , what you will eat , nor yet for your body , what you will wear .

verses.z: 因為生命勝於飲食，身體勝於衣裳。
verses.e: Life is more than food , and the body is more than clothing .

verses.z: 你想烏鴉，也不種也不收，又沒有倉又沒有庫，上帝尚且養活牠。你們比飛鳥是何等地貴重呢！
verses.e: Consider the ravens : they don't sow , they don't reap , they have no warehouse or barn , and God feeds them . How much more valuable are you than birds !

verses.z: 你們哪一個能用思慮使壽數多加一刻呢？
verses.e: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height ?

verses.z: 這最小的事，你們尚且不能做，為甚麼還憂慮其餘的事呢？
verses.e: If then you aren't able to do even the least things , why are you anxious about the rest ?

verses.z: 你想百合花怎麼長起來；它也不勞苦，也不紡線。然而我告訴你們，就是所羅門極榮華的時候，他所穿戴的，還不如這花一朵呢！
verses.e: Consider the lilies , how they grow . They don't toil , neither do they spin ; yet I tell you , even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .

verses.z: 你們這小信的人哪，野地裏的草今天還在，明天就丟在爐裏，上帝還給它這樣的妝飾，何況你們呢！
verses.e: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field , which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven , how much more will he clothe you , O you of little faith ?

verses.z: 你們不要求吃甚麼，喝甚麼，也不要掛心；
verses.e: " Don't seek what you will eat or what you will drink ; neither be anxious .

verses.z: 因此，你們在暗中所說的，將要在明處被人聽見；在內室附耳所說的，將要在房上被人宣揚。」
verses.e: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light . What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops .

verses.z: 這都是外邦人所求的。你們必須用這些東西，你們的父是知道的。
verses.e: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things , but your Father knows that you need these things .

verses.z: 你們只要求他的國，這些東西就必加給你們了。
verses.e: But seek God's Kingdom , and all these things will be added to you .

verses.z: 你們這小群，不要懼怕，因為你們的父樂意把國賜給你們。
verses.e: " Don't be afraid , little flock , for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the Kingdom .

verses.z: 你們要變賣所有的賙濟人，為自己預備永不壞的錢囊，用不盡的財寶在天上，就是賊不能近、蟲不能蛀的地方。
verses.e: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy . Make for yourselves purses which don't grow old , a treasure in the heavens that doesn't fail , where no thief approaches and no moth destroys .

verses.z: 因為，你們的財寶在哪裏，你們的心也在那裏。」
verses.e: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .

verses.z: 「你們腰裏要束上帶，燈也要點着，
verses.e: " Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning .

verses.z: 自己好像[僕]人等候主人從婚姻的筵席上回來。他來到，叩門，就立刻給他開門。
verses.e: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast , that when he comes and knocks , they may immediately open to him .

verses.z: 主人來了，看見僕人警醒，那僕人就有福了。我實在告訴你們，主人必叫他們坐席，自己束上帶，進前伺候他們。
verses.e: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes . Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself , make them recline , and will come and serve them .

verses.z: 或是二更天來，或是三更天來，看見僕人這樣，那僕人就有福了。
verses.e: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so .

verses.z: 家主若知道賊甚麼時候來，就必警醒，不容賊挖透房屋，這是你們所知道的。
verses.e: But know this , that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming , he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into .

verses.z: 「我的朋友，我對你們說，那殺身體以後不能再做甚麼的，不要怕他們。
verses.e: " I tell you , my friends , don't be afraid of those who kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .

verses.z: 你們也要預備；因為你們想不到的時候，人子就來了。」
verses.e: Therefore be ready also , for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don't expect him . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「主啊，這比喻是為我們說的呢？還是為眾人呢？」
verses.e: Peter said to him , " Lord , are you telling this parable to us , or to everybody ? "

verses.z: 主說：「誰是那忠心有見識的管家，主人派他管理家裏的人，按時分糧給他們呢？
verses.e: The Lord said , " Who then is the faithful and wise steward , whom his lord will set over his household , to give them their portion of food at the right times ?

verses.z: 主人來到，看見僕人這樣行，那僕人就有福了。
verses.e: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
verses.e: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has .

verses.z: 那僕人若心裏說：『我的主人必來得遲』，就動手打僕人和使女，並且吃喝醉酒；
verses.e: But if that servant says in his heart , ' My lord delays his coming , ' and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants , and to eat and drink and to be drunken ,

verses.z: 在他想不到的日子，不知道的時辰，那僕人的主人要來，重重地處治他，定他和不忠心的人同罪。
verses.e: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn't expecting him and in an hour that he doesn't know , and will cut him in two , and place his portion with the unfaithful .

verses.z: 僕人知道主人的意思，卻不預備，又不順他的意思行，那僕人必多受責打；
verses.e: That servant who knew his lord's will , and didn't prepare nor do what he wanted , will be beaten with many stripes ,

verses.z: 惟有那不知道的，做了當受責打的事，必少受責打；因為多給誰，就向誰多取；多託誰，就向誰多要。」
verses.e: but he who didn't know , and did things worthy of stripes , will be beaten with few stripes . To whomever much is given , of him will much be required ; and to whom much was entrusted , of him more will be asked .

verses.z: 「我來要把火丟在地上，倘若已經着起來，不也是我所願意的嗎？
verses.e: " I came to throw fire on the earth . I wish it were already kindled .

verses.z: 我要指示你們當怕的是誰：當怕那殺了以後又有權柄丟在地獄裏的。我實在告訴你們，正要怕他。
verses.e: But I will warn you whom you should fear . Fear him who after he has killed , has power to cast into Gehenna . Yes , I tell you , fear him .

verses.z: 我有當受的洗還沒有成就，我是何等地迫切呢？
verses.e: But I have a baptism to be baptized with , and how distressed I am until it is accomplished !

verses.z: 你們以為我來，是叫地上太平嗎？我告訴你們，不是，乃是叫人紛爭。
verses.e: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth ? I tell you , no , but rather division .

verses.z: 從今以後，一家五個人將要紛爭：三個人和兩個人相爭，兩個人和三個人相爭；
verses.e: For from now on , there will be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .

verses.z: 父親和兒子相爭，兒子和父親相爭；母親和女兒相爭，女兒和母親相爭；婆婆和媳婦相爭，媳婦和婆婆相爭。」
verses.e: They will be divided , father against son , and son against father ; mother against daughter , and daughter against her mother ; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law , and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law . "

verses.z: 耶穌又對眾人說：「你們看見西邊起了雲彩，就說：『要下一陣雨』；果然就有。
verses.e: He said to the multitudes also , " When you see a cloud rising from the west , immediately you say , ' A shower is coming , ' and so it happens .

verses.z: 起了南風，就說：『將要燥熱』；也就有了。
verses.e: When a south wind blows , you say , ' There will be a scorching heat , ' and it happens .

verses.z: 假冒為善的人哪，你們知道分辨天地的氣色，怎麼不知道分辨這時候呢？」
verses.e: You hypocrites ! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky , but how is it that you don't interpret this time ?

verses.z: 「你們又為何不自己審量甚麼是合理的呢？
verses.e: " Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right ?

verses.z: 你同[告]你的對頭去見官，還在路上，務要盡力地和他了結；恐怕他拉你到官面前，官交付差役，差役把你下在監裏。
verses.e: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate , try diligently on the way to be released from him , lest perhaps he drag you to the judge , and the judge deliver you to the officer , and the officer throw you into prison .

verses.z: 我告訴你，若有半文錢沒有還清，你斷不能從那裏出來。」
verses.e: I tell you , you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny . "

verses.z: 五個麻雀不是賣二分銀子嗎？但在上帝面前，一個也不忘記；
verses.e: " Aren't five sparrows sold for two assaria coins ? Not one of them is forgotten by God .

verses.z: 就是你們的頭髮，也都被數過了。不要懼怕，你們比許多麻雀還貴重！」
verses.e: But the very hairs of your head are all counted . Therefore don't be afraid . You are of more value than many sparrows .

verses.z: 「我又告訴你們，凡在人面前認我的，人子在上帝的使者面前也必認他；
verses.e: " I tell you , everyone who confesses me before men , the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God ;

verses.z: 在人面前不認我的，人子在上帝的使者面前也必不認他。
verses.e: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God's angels .

verses.z: 正當那時，有人將彼拉多使加利利人的血攙雜在他們祭物中的事告訴耶穌。
verses.e: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices .

verses.z: 安息日，耶穌在會堂裏教訓人。
verses.e: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day .

verses.z: 有一個女人被鬼附着，病了十八年，腰彎得一點直不起來。
verses.e: Behold , there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years . She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up .

verses.z: 耶穌看見，便叫過她來，對她說：「女人，你脫離這病了！」
verses.e: When Jesus saw her , he called her and said to her , " Woman , you are freed from your infirmity . "

verses.z: 於是用兩隻手按着她；她立刻直起腰來，就歸榮耀與上帝。
verses.e: He laid his hands on her , and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God .

verses.z: 管會堂的因為耶穌在安息日治病，就氣忿忿地對眾人說：「有六日應當做工；那六日之內可以來求醫，在安息日卻不可。」
verses.e: The ruler of the synagogue , being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath , said to the multitude , " There are six days in which men ought to work . Therefore come on those days and be healed , and not on the Sabbath day ! "

verses.z: 主說：「假冒為善的人哪，難道你們各人在安息日不解開槽上的牛、驢，牽去飲嗎？
verses.e: Therefore the Lord answered him , " You hypocrites ! Doesn't each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water ?

verses.z: 況且這女人本是亞伯拉罕的後裔，被撒但捆綁了這十八年，不當在安息日解開她的綁嗎？」
verses.e: Ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years , be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說這話，他的敵人都慚愧了；眾人因他所行一切榮耀的事，就都歡喜了。
verses.e: As he said these things , all his adversaries were disappointed ; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「上帝的國好像甚麼？我拿甚麼來比較呢？
verses.e: He said , " What is God's Kingdom like ? To what shall I compare it ?

verses.z: 好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在園子裏，長大成樹，天上的飛鳥宿在它的枝上。」
verses.e: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden . It grew and became a large tree , and the birds of the sky live in its branches . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們以為這些加利利人比眾加利利人更有罪，所以受這害嗎？
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans , because they suffered such things ?

verses.z: 又說：「我拿甚麼來比上帝的國呢？
verses.e: Again he said , " To what shall I compare God's Kingdom ?

verses.z: 好比麵酵，有婦人拿來藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」
verses.e: It is like yeast , which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour , until it was all leavened . "

verses.z: 耶穌往耶路撒冷去，在所經過的各城各鄉教訓人。
verses.e: He went on his way through cities and villages , teaching , and traveling on to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 有一個人問他說：「主啊，得救的人少嗎？」
verses.e: One said to him , " Lord , are they few who are saved ? " He said to them ,

verses.z: 耶穌對眾人說：「你們要努力進窄門。我告訴你們，將來有許多人想要進去，卻是不能。
verses.e: " Strive to enter in by the narrow door , for many , I tell you , will seek to enter in and will not be able .

verses.z: 及至家主起來關了門，你們站在外面叩門，說：『主啊，給我們開門！』他就回答說：『我不認識你們，不曉得你們是哪裏來的！』
verses.e: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door , and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door , saying , ' Lord , Lord , open to us ! ' then he will answer and tell you , ' I don't know you or where you come from . '

verses.z: 那時，你們要說：『我們在你面前吃過喝過，你也在我們的街上教訓過人。』
verses.e: Then you will begin to say , ' We ate and drank in your presence , and you taught in our streets . '

verses.z: 他要說：『我告訴你們，我不曉得你們是哪裏來的。你們這一切作惡的人，離開我去吧！』
verses.e: He will say , ' I tell you , I don't know where you come from . Depart from me , all you workers of iniquity . '

verses.z: 你們要看見亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，和眾先知都在上帝的國裏，你們卻被趕到外面，在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。
verses.e: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham , Isaac , Jacob , and all the prophets in God's Kingdom , and yourselves being thrown outside .

verses.z: 從東、從西、從南、從北將有人來，在上帝的國裏坐席。
verses.e: They will come from the east , west , north , and south , and will sit down in God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！
verses.e: I tell you , no , but unless you repent , you will all perish in the same way .

verses.z: 只是有在後的，將要在前；有在前的，將要在後。」
verses.e: Behold , there are some who are last who will be first , and there are some who are first who will be last . "

verses.z: 正當那時，有幾個法利賽人來對耶穌說：「離開這裏去吧，因為希律想要殺你。」
verses.e: On that same day , some Pharisees came , saying to him , " Get out of here and go away , for Herod wants to kill you . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們去告訴那個狐狸說：『今天、明天我趕鬼治病，第三天我的事就成全了。』
verses.e: He said to them , " Go and tell that fox , ' Behold , I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow , and the third day I complete my mission .

verses.z: 雖然這樣，今天、明天、後天，我必須前行，因為先知在耶路撒冷之外喪命是不能的。
verses.e: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day , for it can't be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem . '

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊！耶路撒冷啊！你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裏來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下；只是你們不願意。
verses.e: " Jerusalem , Jerusalem , you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her ! How often I wanted to gather your children together , like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings , and you refused !

verses.z: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。我告訴你們，[從今以後]你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：『奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。』」
verses.e: Behold , your house is left to you desolate . I tell you , you will not see me until you say , ' Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord ! ' "

verses.z: 從前西羅亞樓倒塌了，壓死十八個人；你們以為那些人比一切住在耶路撒冷的人更有罪嗎？
verses.e: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them — do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem ?

verses.z: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！」
verses.e: I tell you , no , but , unless you repent , you will all perish in the same way . "

verses.z: 於是用比喻說：「一個人有一棵無花果樹栽在葡萄園裏。他來到樹前找果子，卻找不着。
verses.e: He spoke this parable . " A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard , and he came seeking fruit on it and found none .

verses.z: 就對管園的說：『看哪，我這三年來到這無花果樹前找果子，竟找不着。把它砍了吧，何必白佔地土呢！』
verses.e: He said to the vine dresser , ' Behold , these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree , and found none . Cut it down ! Why does it waste the soil ? '

verses.z: 管園的說：『主啊，今年且留着，等我周圍掘開土，加上糞；
verses.e: He answered , ' Lord , leave it alone this year also , until I dig around it and fertilize it .

verses.z: 以後若結果子便罷，不然再把它砍了。』」
verses.e: If it bears fruit , fine ; but if not , after that , you can cut it down . ' "

verses.z: 安息日，耶穌到一個法利賽人的首領家裏去吃飯，他們就窺探他。
verses.e: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread , they were watching him .

verses.z: 你被請的時候，就去坐在末位上，好叫那請你的人來對你說：『朋友，請上座。』那時，你在同席的人面前就有光彩了。
verses.e: But when you are invited , go and sit in the lowest place , so that when he who invited you comes , he may tell you , ' Friend , move up higher . ' Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you .

verses.z: 因為，凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。」
verses.e: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled , and whoever humbles himself will be exalted . "

verses.z: 耶穌又對請他的人說：「你擺設午飯或晚飯，不要請你的朋友、弟兄、親屬，和富足的鄰舍，恐怕他們也請你，你就得了報答。
verses.e: He also said to the one who had invited him , " When you make a dinner or a supper , don't call your friends , nor your brothers , nor your kinsmen , nor rich neighbors , or perhaps they might also return the favor , and pay you back .

verses.z: 你擺設筵席，倒要請那貧窮的、殘廢的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，你就有福了！
verses.e: But when you make a feast , ask the poor , the maimed , the lame , or the blind ;

verses.z: 因為他們沒有甚麼可報答你。到義人復活的時候，你要得着報答。」
verses.e: and you will be blessed , because they don't have the resources to repay you . For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous . "

verses.z: 同席的有一人聽見這話，就對耶穌說：「在上帝國裏吃飯的有福了！」
verses.e: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things , he said to him , " Blessed is he who will feast in God's Kingdom ! "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「有一人擺設大筵席，請了許多客。
verses.e: But he said to him , " A certain man made a great supper , and he invited many people .

verses.z: 到了坐席的時候，打發僕人去對所請的人說：『請來吧！樣樣都齊備了。』
verses.e: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited , ' Come , for everything is ready now . '

verses.z: 眾人一口同音地推辭。頭一個說：『我買了一塊地，必須去看看。請你准我辭了。』
verses.e: They all as one began to make excuses . " The first said to him , ' I have bought a field , and I must go and see it . Please have me excused . '

verses.z: 又有一個說：『我買了五對牛，要去試一試。請你准我辭了。』
verses.e: " Another said , ' I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I must go try them out . Please have me excused . '

verses.z: 在他面前有一個患水臌的人。
verses.e: Behold , a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him .

verses.z: 又有一個說：『我才娶了妻，所以不能去。』
verses.e: " Another said , ' I have married a wife , and therefore I can't come . '

verses.z: 那僕人回來，把這事都告訴了主人。家主就動怒，對僕人說：『快出去，到城裏大街小巷，領那貧窮的、殘廢的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的來。』
verses.e: " That servant came , and told his lord these things . Then the master of the house , being angry , said to his servant , ' Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in the poor , maimed , blind , and lame . '

verses.z: 僕人說：『主啊，你所吩咐的已經辦了，還有空座。』
verses.e: " The servant said , ' Lord , it is done as you commanded , and there is still room . '

verses.z: 主人對僕人說：『你出去到路上和籬笆那裏，勉強人進來，坐滿我的屋子。
verses.e: " The lord said to the servant , ' Go out into the highways and hedges , and compel them to come in , that my house may be filled .

verses.z: 我告訴你們，先前所請的人沒有一個得嘗我的筵席。』」
verses.e: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper . For many are called , but few are chosen . ' "

verses.z: 有極多的人和耶穌同行。他轉過來對他們說：
verses.e: Now great multitudes were going with him . He turned and said to them ,

verses.z: 「人到我這裏來，若不愛我勝過愛自己的父母、妻子、兒女、弟兄、姊妹，和自己的性命，就不能作我的門徒。
verses.e: " If anyone comes to me , and doesn't disregard his own father , mother , wife , children , brothers , and sisters , yes , and his own life also , he can't be my disciple .

verses.z: 凡不背着自己十字架跟從我的，也不能作我的門徒。
verses.e: Whoever doesn't bear his own cross and come after me , can't be my disciple .

verses.z: 你們哪一個要蓋一座樓，不先坐下算計花費，能蓋成不能呢？
verses.e: For which of you , desiring to build a tower , doesn't first sit down and count the cost , to see if he has enough to complete it ?

verses.z: 恐怕安了地基，不能成功，看見的人都笑話他，說：
verses.e: Or perhaps , when he has laid a foundation and isn't able to finish , everyone who sees begins to mock him ,

verses.z: 耶穌對律法師和法利賽人說：「安息日治病可以不可以？」
verses.e: Jesus , answering , spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees , saying , " Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath ? "

verses.z: 『這個人開了工，卻不能完工。』
verses.e: saying , ' This man began to build and wasn't able to finish . '

verses.z: 或是一個王出去和別的王打仗，豈不先坐下酌量，能用一萬兵去敵那領二萬兵來攻打他的嗎？
verses.e: Or what king , as he goes to encounter another king in war , will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand ?

verses.z: 若是不能，就趁敵人還遠的時候，派使者去求和息的條款。
verses.e: Or else , while the other is yet a great way off , he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace .

verses.z: 這樣，你們無論甚麼人，若不撇下一切所有的，就不能作我的門徒。」
verses.e: So therefore , whoever of you who doesn't renounce all that he has , he can't be my disciple .

verses.z: 「鹽本是好的；鹽若失了味，可用甚麼叫它再鹹呢？
verses.e: " Salt is good , but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless , with what do you season it ?

verses.z: 或用在田裏，或堆在糞裏，都不合式，只好丟在外面。有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
verses.e: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile . It is thrown out . He who has ears to hear , let him hear . "

verses.z: 他們卻不言語。耶穌就治好那人，叫他走了；
verses.e: But they were silent . He took him , and healed him , and let him go .

verses.z: 便對他們說：「你們中間誰有驢或有牛，在安息日掉在井裏，不立時拉牠上來呢？」
verses.e: He answered them , " Which of you , if your son or an ox fell into a well , wouldn't immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day ? "

verses.z: 他們不能對答這話。
verses.e: They couldn't answer him regarding these things .

verses.z: 耶穌見所請的客揀擇首位，就用比喻對他們說：
verses.e: He spoke a parable to those who were invited , when he noticed how they chose the best seats , and said to them ,

verses.z: 「你被人請去赴婚姻的筵席，不要坐在首位上，恐怕有比你尊貴的客被他請來；
verses.e: " When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast , don't sit in the best seat , since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him ,

verses.z: 那請你們的人前來對你說：『讓座給這一位吧！』你就羞羞慚慚地退到末位上去了。
verses.e: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you , ' Make room for this person . ' Then you would begin , with shame , to take the lowest place .

verses.z: 眾稅吏和罪人都挨近耶穌，要聽他[講道]。
verses.e: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him .

verses.z: 我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在上帝的使者面前也是這樣為他歡喜。」
verses.e: Even so , I tell you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting . "

verses.z: 耶穌又說：「一個人有兩個兒子。
verses.e: He said , " A certain man had two sons .

verses.z: 小兒子對父親說：『父親，請你把我應得的家業分給我。』他父親就把產業分給他們。
verses.e: The younger of them said to his father , ' Father , give me my share of your property . ' So he divided his livelihood between them .

verses.z: 過了不多幾日，小兒子就把他一切所有的都收拾起來，往遠方去了。在那裏任意放蕩，浪費資財。
verses.e: Not many days after , the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country . There he wasted his property with riotous living .

verses.z: 既耗盡了一切所有的，又遇着那地方大遭饑荒，就窮苦起來。
verses.e: When he had spent all of it , there arose a severe famine in that country , and he began to be in need .

verses.z: 於是去投靠那地方的一個人；那人打發他到田裏去放豬。
verses.e: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country , and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs .

verses.z: 他恨不得拿豬所吃的豆莢充飢，也沒有人給他。
verses.e: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate , but no one gave him any .

verses.z: 他醒悟過來，就說：『我父親有多少的雇工，口糧有餘，我倒在這裏餓死嗎？
verses.e: But when he came to himself , he said , ' How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough to spare , and I'm dying with hunger !

verses.z: 我要起來，到我父親那裏去，向他說：父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；
verses.e: I will get up and go to my father , and will tell him , " Father , I have sinned against heaven and in your sight .

verses.z: 從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子，把我當作一個雇工吧！』
verses.e: I am no more worthy to be called your son . Make me as one of your hired servants . " '

verses.z: 法利賽人和文士私下議論說：「這個人接待罪人，又同他們吃飯。」
verses.e: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured , saying , " This man welcomes sinners , and eats with them . "

verses.z: 於是起來，往他父親那裏去。相離還遠，他父親看見，就動了慈心，跑去抱着他的頸項，連連與他親嘴。
verses.e: " He arose and came to his father . But while he was still far off , his father saw him and was moved with compassion , and ran , fell on his neck , and kissed him .

verses.z: 兒子說：『父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子。』
verses.e: The son said to him , ' Father , I have sinned against heaven and in your sight . I am no longer worthy to be called your son . '

verses.z: 父親卻吩咐僕人說：『把那上好的袍子快拿出來給他穿；把戒指戴在他指頭上；把鞋穿在他腳上；
verses.e: " But the father said to his servants , ' Bring out the best robe and put it on him . Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet .

verses.z: 把那肥牛犢牽來宰了，我們可以吃喝快樂；
verses.e: Bring the fattened calf , kill it , and let's eat and celebrate ;

verses.z: 因為我這個兒子是死而復活，失而又得的。』他們就快樂起來。
verses.e: for this , my son , was dead and is alive again . He was lost and is found . ' Then they began to celebrate .

verses.z: 那時，大兒子正在田裏。他回來，離家不遠，聽見作樂跳舞的聲音，
verses.e: " Now his elder son was in the field . As he came near to the house , he heard music and dancing .

verses.z: 便叫過一個僕人來，問是甚麼事。
verses.e: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on .

verses.z: 僕人說：『你兄弟來了；你父親因為得他無災無病地回來，把肥牛犢宰了。』
verses.e: He said to him , ' Your brother has come , and your father has killed the fattened calf , because he has received him back safe and healthy . '

verses.z: 大兒子卻生氣，不肯進去；他父親就出來勸他。
verses.e: But he was angry and would not go in . Therefore his father came out and begged him .

verses.z: 他對父親說：『我服事你這多年，從來沒有違背過你的命，你並沒有給我一隻山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快樂。
verses.e: But he answered his father , ' Behold , these many years I have served you , and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours , but you never gave me a goat , that I might celebrate with my friends .

verses.z: 耶穌就用比喻說：
verses.e: He told them this parable :

verses.z: 但你這個兒子和娼妓吞盡了你的產業，他一來了，你倒為他宰了肥牛犢。』
verses.e: But when this your son came , who has devoured your living with prostitutes , you killed the fattened calf for him . '

verses.z: 父親對他說：『兒啊！你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；
verses.e: " He said to him , ' Son , you are always with me , and all that is mine is yours .

verses.z: 只是你這個兄弟是死而復活、失而又得的，所以我們理當歡喜快樂。』」
verses.e: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad , for this , your brother , was dead , and is alive again . He was lost , and is found . ' "

verses.z: 「你們中間誰有一百隻羊失去一隻，不把這九十九隻撇在曠野、去找那失去的羊，直到找着呢？
verses.e: " Which of you men , if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them , wouldn't leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost , until he found it ?

verses.z: 找着了，就歡歡喜喜地扛在肩上，回到家裏，
verses.e: When he has found it , he carries it on his shoulders , rejoicing .

verses.z: 就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：『我失去的羊已經找着了，你們和我一同歡喜吧！』
verses.e: When he comes home , he calls together his friends and his neighbors , saying to them , ' Rejoice with me , for I have found my sheep which was lost ! '

verses.z: 我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在天上也要這樣為他歡喜，較比為九十九個不用悔改的義人歡喜更大。」
verses.e: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents , than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance .

verses.z: 「或是一個婦人有十塊錢，若失落一塊，豈不點上燈，打掃屋子，細細地找，直到找着嗎？
verses.e: " Or what woman , if she had ten drachma coins , if she lost one drachma coin , wouldn't light a lamp , sweep the house , and seek diligently until she found it ?

verses.z: 找着了，就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：『我失落的那塊錢已經找着了，你們和我一同歡喜吧！』
verses.e: When she has found it , she calls together her friends and neighbors , saying , ' Rejoice with me , for I have found the drachma which I had lost ! '

verses.z: 耶穌又對門徒說：「有一個財主的管家，別人向他主人告他浪費主人的財物。
verses.e: He also said to his disciples , " There was a certain rich man who had a manager . An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions .

verses.z: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不義，在大事上也不義。
verses.e: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much . He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much .

verses.z: 倘若你們在不義的錢財上不忠心，誰還把那真實的[錢財]託付你們呢？
verses.e: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon , who will commit to your trust the true riches ?

verses.z: 倘若你們在別人的東西上不忠心，誰還把你們自己的東西給你們呢？
verses.e: If you have not been faithful in that which is another's , who will give you that which is your own ?

verses.z: 一個僕人不能事奉兩個主；不是惡這個愛那個，就是重這個輕那個。你們不能又事奉上帝，又事奉瑪門。」
verses.e: No servant can serve two masters , for either he will hate the one and love the other ; or else he will hold to one and despise the other . You aren't able to serve God and Mammon . "

verses.z: 法利賽人是貪愛錢財的；他們聽見這一切話，就嗤笑耶穌。
verses.e: The Pharisees , who were lovers of money , also heard all these things , and they scoffed at him .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們是在人面前自稱為義的，你們的心，上帝卻知道；因為人所尊貴的，是上帝看為可憎惡的。
verses.e: He said to them , " You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men , but God knows your hearts . For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God .

verses.z: 律法和先知到約翰為止，從此上帝國的福音傳開了，人人努力要進去。
verses.e: " The law and the prophets were until John . From that time the Good News of God's Kingdom is preached , and everyone is forcing his way into it .

verses.z: 天地廢去較比律法的一點一畫落空還容易。
verses.e: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall .

verses.z: 凡休妻另娶的就是犯姦淫；娶被休之妻的也是犯姦淫。」
verses.e: " Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery . He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery .

verses.z: 「有一個財主穿着紫色[袍]和細麻布衣服，天天奢華宴樂。
verses.e: " Now there was a certain rich man , and he was clothed in purple and fine linen , living in luxury every day .

verses.z: 主人叫他來，對他說：『我聽見你這事怎麼樣呢？把你所經管的交代明白，因你不能再作[我的]管家。』
verses.e: He called him , and said to him , ' What is this that I hear about you ? Give an accounting of your management , for you can no longer be manager . '

verses.z: 又有一個討飯的，名叫拉撒路，渾身生瘡，被人放在財主門口，
verses.e: A certain beggar , named Lazarus , was taken to his gate , full of sores ,

verses.z: 要得財主桌子上掉下來的[零碎]充飢，並且狗來舔他的瘡。
verses.e: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man's table . Yes , even the dogs came and licked his sores .

verses.z: 後來那討飯的死了，被天使帶去放在亞伯拉罕的懷裏。財主也死了，並且埋葬了。
verses.e: The beggar died , and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham's bosom . The rich man also died and was buried .

verses.z: 他在陰間受痛苦，舉目遠遠地望見亞伯拉罕，又望見拉撒路在他懷裏，
verses.e: In Hades , he lifted up his eyes , being in torment , and saw Abraham far off , and Lazarus at his bosom .

verses.z: 就喊着說：『我祖亞伯拉罕哪，可憐我吧！打發拉撒路來，用指頭尖蘸點水，涼涼我的舌頭；因為我在這火焰裏，極其痛苦。』
verses.e: He cried and said , ' Father Abraham , have mercy on me , and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue ! For I am in anguish in this flame . '

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：『兒啊，你該回想你生前享過福，拉撒路也受過苦；如今他在這裏得安慰，你倒受痛苦。
verses.e: " But Abraham said , ' Son , remember that you , in your lifetime , received your good things , and Lazarus , in the same way , bad things . But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish .

verses.z: 不但這樣，並且在你我之間，有深淵限定，以致人要從這邊過到你們那邊是不能的；要從那邊過到我們這邊也是不能的。』
verses.e: Besides all this , between us and you there is a great gulf fixed , that those who want to pass from here to you are not able , and that no one may cross over from there to us . '

verses.z: 財主說：『我祖啊！既是這樣，求你打發拉撒路到我父家去；
verses.e: " He said , ' I ask you therefore , father , that you would send him to my father's house —

verses.z: 因為我還有五個弟兄，他可以對他們作見證，免得他們也來到這痛苦的地方。』
verses.e: for I have five brothers — that he may testify to them , so they won't also come into this place of torment . '

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：『他們有摩西和先知[的話]可以聽從。』
verses.e: " But Abraham said to him , ' They have Moses and the prophets . Let them listen to them . '

verses.z: 那管家心裏說：『主人辭我，不用我再作管家，我將來做甚麼？鋤地呢？無力；討飯呢？怕羞。
verses.e: " The manager said within himself , ' What will I do , seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me ? I don't have strength to dig . I am ashamed to beg .

verses.z: 他說：『我祖亞伯拉罕哪，不是的，若有一個從死裏[復活的]，到他們那裏去的，他們必要悔改。』
verses.e: " He said , ' No , father Abraham , but if one goes to them from the dead , they will repent . '

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕說：『若不聽從摩西和先知[的話]，就是有一個從死裏復活的，他們也是不聽勸。』」
verses.e: " He said to him , ' If they don't listen to Moses and the prophets , neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead . ' "

verses.z: 我知道怎麼行，好叫人在我不作管家之後，接我到他們家裏去。』
verses.e: I know what I will do , so that when I am removed from management , they may receive me into their houses . '

verses.z: 於是把欠他主人債的，一個一個地叫了來，問頭一個說：『你欠我主人多少？』
verses.e: Calling each one of his lord's debtors to him , he said to the first , ' How much do you owe to my lord ? '

verses.z: 他說：『一百簍油。』管家說：『拿你的帳，快坐下，寫五十。』
verses.e: He said , ' A hundred batos of oil . ' He said to him , ' Take your bill , and sit down quickly and write fifty . '

verses.z: 又問一個說：『你欠多少？』他說：『一百石麥子。』管家說：『拿你的帳，寫八十。』
verses.e: Then he said to another , ' How much do you owe ? ' He said , ' A hundred cors of wheat . ' He said to him , ' Take your bill , and write eighty . '

verses.z: 主人就誇獎這不義的管家做事聰明；因為今世之子，在世事之上，較比光明之子更加聰明。
verses.e: " His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely , for the children of this world are , in their own generation , wiser than the children of the light .

verses.z: 我又告訴你們，要藉着那不義的錢財結交朋友，到了錢財無用的時候，他們可以接你們到永存的帳幕裏去。
verses.e: I tell you , make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon , so that when you fail , they may receive you into the eternal tents .

verses.z: 耶穌又對門徒說：「絆倒人的事是免不了的；但那絆倒人的有禍了。
verses.e: He said to the disciples , " It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come , but woe to him through whom they come !

verses.z: 這樣，你們做完了一切所吩咐的，只當說：『我們是無用的僕人，所做的本是我們應分做的。』」
verses.e: Even so you also , when you have done all the things that are commanded you , say , ' We are unworthy servants . We have done our duty . ' "

verses.z: 耶穌往耶路撒冷去，經過撒馬利亞和加利利。
verses.e: As he was on his way to Jerusalem , he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee .

verses.z: 進入一個村子，有十個長大痲瘋的，迎面而來，遠遠地站着，
verses.e: As he entered into a certain village , ten men who were lepers met him , who stood at a distance .

verses.z: 高聲說：「耶穌，夫子，可憐我們吧！」
verses.e: They lifted up their voices , saying , " Jesus , Master , have mercy on us ! "

verses.z: 耶穌看見，就對他們說：「你們去把身體給祭司察看。」他們去的時候就潔淨了。
verses.e: When he saw them , he said to them , " Go and show yourselves to the priests . " As they went , they were cleansed .

verses.z: 內中有一個見自己已經好了，就回來大聲歸榮耀與上帝，
verses.e: One of them , when he saw that he was healed , turned back , glorifying God with a loud voice .

verses.z: 又俯伏在耶穌腳前感謝他；這人是撒馬利亞人。
verses.e: He fell on his face at Jesus ' feet , giving him thanks ; and he was a Samaritan .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「潔淨了的不是十個人嗎？那九個在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Jesus answered , " Weren't the ten cleansed ? But where are the nine ?

verses.z: 除了這外族人，再沒有別人回來歸榮耀與上帝嗎？」
verses.e: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God , except this foreigner ? "

verses.z: 就對那人說：「起來，走吧！你的信救了你了。」
verses.e: Then he said to him , " Get up , and go your way . Your faith has healed you . "

verses.z: 就是把磨石拴在這人的頸項上，丟在海裏，還強如他把這小子裏的一個絆倒了。
verses.e: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck , and he were thrown into the sea , rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble .

verses.z: 法利賽人問：「上帝的國幾時來到？」耶穌回答說：「上帝的國來到不是眼所能見的。
verses.e: Being asked by the Pharisees when God's Kingdom would come , he answered them , " God's Kingdom doesn't come with observation ;

verses.z: 人也不得說：『看哪，在這裏！看哪，在那裏！』因為上帝的國就在你們心裏。」
verses.e: neither will they say , ' Look , here ! ' or , ' Look , there ! ' for behold , God's Kingdom is within you . "

verses.z: 他又對門徒說：「日子將到，你們巴不得看見人子的一個日子，卻不得看見。
verses.e: He said to the disciples , " The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man , and you will not see it .

verses.z: 人將要對你們說：『看哪，在那裏！看哪，在這裏！』你們不要出去，也不要跟隨他們！
verses.e: They will tell you , ' Look , here ! ' or ' Look , there ! ' Don't go away or follow after them ,

verses.z: 因為人子在他[降臨]的日子，好像閃電從天這邊一閃直照到天那邊。
verses.e: for as the lightning , when it flashes out of one part under the sky , shines to another part under the sky , so will the Son of Man be in his day .

verses.z: 只是他必須先受許多苦，又被這世代棄絕。
verses.e: But first , he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation .

verses.z: 挪亞的日子怎樣，人子的日子也要怎樣。
verses.e: As it was in the days of Noah , even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man .

verses.z: 那時候的人又吃又喝，又娶又嫁，到挪亞進方舟的那日，洪水就來，把他們全都滅了。
verses.e: They ate , they drank , they married , and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship , and the flood came and destroyed them all .

verses.z: 又好像羅得的日子；人又吃又喝，又買又賣，又耕種又蓋造。
verses.e: Likewise , even as it was in the days of Lot : they ate , they drank , they bought , they sold , they planted , they built ;

verses.z: 到羅得出所多瑪的那日，就有火與硫磺從天上降下來，把他們全都滅了。
verses.e: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom , it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all .

verses.z: 你們要謹慎！若是你的弟兄得罪[你]，就勸戒他；他若懊悔，就饒恕他。
verses.e: Be careful . If your brother sins against you , rebuke him . If he repents , forgive him .

verses.z: 人子顯現的日子也要這樣。
verses.e: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed .

verses.z: 當那日，人在房上，器具在屋裏，不要下來拿；人在田裏，也不要回家。
verses.e: In that day , he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house , let him not go down to take them away . Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back .

verses.z: 你們要回想羅得的妻子。
verses.e: Remember Lot's wife !

verses.z: 凡想要保全生命的，必喪掉生命；凡喪掉生命的，必救活生命。
verses.e: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it , but whoever loses his life preserves it .

verses.z: 我對你們說，當那一夜，兩個人在一個床上，要取去一個，撇下一個。
verses.e: I tell you , in that night there will be two people in one bed . One will be taken and the other will be left .

verses.z: 兩個女人一同推磨，要取去一個，撇下一個。」
verses.e: There will be two grinding grain together . One will be taken and the other will be left . "
They , answering , asked him , " Where , Lord ? " He said to them , " Where the body is , there the vultures will also be gathered together . "

verses.z: 門徒說：「主啊，在哪裏[有這事]呢？」耶穌說：「屍首在哪裏，鷹也必聚在那裏。」
倘若他一天七次得罪你，又七次回轉，說：『我懊悔了』，你總要饒恕他。」
verses.e: If he sins against you seven times in the day , and seven times returns , saying , ' I repent , ' you shall forgive him . "

verses.z: 使徒對主說：「[求主]加增我們的信心。」
verses.e: The apostles said to the Lord , " Increase our faith . "

verses.z: 主說：「你們若有信心像一粒芥菜種，就是對這棵桑樹說：『你要拔起根來，栽在海裏』，它也必聽從你們。
verses.e: The Lord said , " If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed , you would tell this sycamore tree , ' Be uprooted and be planted in the sea , ' and it would obey you .

verses.z: 你們誰有僕人耕地或是放羊，從田裏回來，就對他說：『你快來坐下吃飯』呢？
verses.e: But who is there among you , having a servant plowing or keeping sheep , that will say when he comes in from the field , ' Come immediately and sit down at the table ' ?

verses.z: 豈不對他說：『你給我預備晚飯，束上帶子伺候我，等我吃喝完了，你才可以吃喝』嗎？
verses.e: Wouldn't he rather tell him , ' Prepare my supper , clothe yourself properly , and serve me while I eat and drink . Afterward you shall eat and drink ' ?

verses.z: 僕人照所吩咐的去做，主人還謝謝他嗎？
verses.e: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded ? I think not .

verses.z: 耶穌設一個比喻，是要人常常禱告，不可灰心。
verses.e: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up ,

verses.z: 說：「有兩個人上殿裏去禱告：一個是法利賽人，一個是稅吏。
verses.e: " Two men went up into the temple to pray ; one was a Pharisee , and the other was a tax collector .

verses.z: 法利賽人站着，自言自語地禱告說：『上帝啊，我感謝你，我不像別人勒索、不義、姦淫，也不像這個稅吏。
verses.e: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this : ' God , I thank you that I am not like the rest of men : extortionists , unrighteous , adulterers , or even like this tax collector .

verses.z: 我一個禮拜禁食兩次，凡我所得的都捐上十分之一。』
verses.e: I fast twice a week . I give tithes of all that I get . '

verses.z: 那稅吏遠遠地站着，連舉目望天也不敢，只捶着胸說：『上帝啊，開恩可憐我這個罪人！』
verses.e: But the tax collector , standing far away , wouldn't even lift up his eyes to heaven , but beat his chest , saying , ' God , be merciful to me , a sinner ! '

verses.z: 我告訴你們，這人回家去比那人倒算為義了；因為，凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。」
verses.e: I tell you , this man went down to his house justified rather than the other ; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled , but he who humbles himself will be exalted . "

verses.z: 有人抱着自己的嬰孩來見耶穌，要他摸他們；門徒看見就責備那些人。
verses.e: They were also bringing their babies to him , that he might touch them . But when the disciples saw it , they rebuked them .

verses.z: 耶穌卻叫他們來，說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們，因為在上帝國的正是這樣的人。
verses.e: Jesus summoned them , saying , " Allow the little children to come to me , and don't hinder them , for God's Kingdom belongs to such as these .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，凡要承受上帝國的，若不像小孩子，斷不能進去。」
verses.e: Most certainly , I tell you , whoever doesn't receive God's Kingdom like a little child , he will in no way enter into it . "

verses.z: 有一個官問耶穌說：「良善的夫子，我該做甚麼事才可以承受永生？」
verses.e: A certain ruler asked him , saying , " Good Teacher , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼稱我是良善的？除了上帝一位之外，再沒有良善的。
verses.e: Jesus asked him , " Why do you call me good ? No one is good , except one : God .

verses.z: 說：「某城裏有一個官，不懼怕上帝，也不尊重世人。
verses.e: saying , " There was a judge in a certain city who didn't fear God and didn't respect man .

verses.z: 誡命你是曉得的：『不可姦淫；不可殺人；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；當孝敬父母。』」
verses.e: You know the commandments : ' Don't commit adultery , ' ' Don't murder , ' ' Don't steal , ' ' Don't give false testimony , ' ' Honor your father and your mother . ' "

verses.z: 那人說：「這一切我從小都遵守了。」
verses.e: He said , " I have observed all these things from my youth up . "

verses.z: 耶穌聽見了，就說：「你還缺少一件：要變賣你一切所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」
verses.e: When Jesus heard these things , he said to him , " You still lack one thing . Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor . Then you will have treasure in heaven ; then come , follow me . "

verses.z: 他聽見這話，就甚憂愁，因為他很富足。
verses.e: But when he heard these things , he became very sad , for he was very rich .

verses.z: 耶穌看見他，就說：「有錢財的人進上帝的國是何等的難哪！
verses.e: Jesus , seeing that he became very sad , said , " How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God's Kingdom !

verses.z: 駱駝穿過針的眼比財主進上帝的國還容易呢！」
verses.e: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 聽見的人說：「這樣，誰能得救呢？」
verses.e: Those who heard it said , " Then who can be saved ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「在人所不能的事，在上帝卻能。」
verses.e: But he said , " The things which are impossible with men are possible with God . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「看哪，我們已經撇下自己所有的跟從你了。」
verses.e: Peter said , " Look , we have left everything and followed you . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，人為上帝的國撇下房屋，或是妻子、弟兄、父母、兒女，
verses.e: He said to them , " Most certainly I tell you , there is no one who has left house , or wife , or brothers , or parents , or children , for God's Kingdom's sake ,

verses.z: 那城裏有個寡婦，常到他那裏，說：『我有一個對頭，求你給我伸冤。』
verses.e: A widow was in that city , and she often came to him , saying , ' Defend me from my adversary ! '

verses.z: 沒有在今世不得百倍，在來世不得永生的。」
verses.e: who will not receive many times more in this time , and in the world to come , eternal life . "

verses.z: 耶穌帶着十二個門徒，對他們說：「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，先知所寫的一切事都要成就在人子身上。
verses.e: He took the twelve aside and said to them , " Behold , we are going up to Jerusalem , and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed .

verses.z: 他將要被交給外邦人；他們要戲弄他，凌辱他，吐唾沫在他臉上，
verses.e: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles , will be mocked , treated shamefully , and spit on .

verses.z: 並要鞭打他，殺害他；第三日他要復活。」
verses.e: They will scourge and kill him . On the third day , he will rise again . "

verses.z: 這些事門徒一樣也不懂得，意思乃是隱藏的；他們不曉得所說的是甚麼。
verses.e: They understood none of these things . This saying was hidden from them , and they didn't understand the things that were said .

verses.z: 耶穌將近耶利哥的時候，有一個瞎子坐在路旁討飯。
verses.e: As he came near Jericho , a certain blind man sat by the road , begging .

verses.z: 聽見許多人經過，就問是甚麼事。
verses.e: Hearing a multitude going by , he asked what this meant .

verses.z: 他們告訴他，是拿撒勒人耶穌經過。
verses.e: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by .

verses.z: 他就呼叫說：「大衛的子孫耶穌啊，可憐我吧！」
verses.e: He cried out , " Jesus , you son of David , have mercy on me ! "

verses.z: 在前頭走的人就責備他，不許他作聲；他卻越發喊叫說：「大衛的子孫，可憐我吧！」
verses.e: Those who led the way rebuked him , that he should be quiet ; but he cried out all the more , " You son of David , have mercy on me ! "

verses.z: 他多日不准，後來心裏說：『我雖不懼怕上帝，也不尊重世人，
verses.e: He wouldn't for a while ; but afterward he said to himself , ' Though I neither fear God nor respect man ,

verses.z: 耶穌站住，吩咐把他領過來，到了跟前，就問他說：
verses.e: Standing still , Jesus commanded him to be brought to him . When he had come near , he asked him ,

verses.z: 「你要我為你做甚麼？」他說：「主啊，我要能看見。」
verses.e: " What do you want me to do ? " He said , " Lord , that I may see again . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你可以看見！你的信救了你了。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Receive your sight . Your faith has healed you . "

verses.z: 瞎子立刻看見了，就跟隨耶穌，[一路]歸榮耀與上帝。眾人看見這事，也讚美上帝。
verses.e: Immediately he received his sight and followed him , glorifying God . All the people , when they saw it , praised God .

verses.z: 只因這寡婦煩擾我，我就給她伸冤吧，免得她常來纏磨我！』」
verses.e: yet because this widow bothers me , I will defend her , or else she will wear me out by her continual coming . ' "

verses.z: 主說：「你們聽這不義之官所說的話。
verses.e: The Lord said , " Listen to what the unrighteous judge says .

verses.z: 上帝的選民晝夜呼籲他，他縱然為他們忍了多時，豈不終久給他們伸冤嗎？
verses.e: Won't God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night , and yet he exercises patience with them ?

verses.z: 我告訴你們，要快快地給他們伸冤了。然而，人子來的時候，遇得見世上有信德嗎？」
verses.e: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly . Nevertheless , when the Son of Man comes , will he find faith on the earth ? "

verses.z: 耶穌向那些仗着自己是義人，藐視別人的，設一個比喻，
verses.e: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness , and who despised all others :

verses.z: 耶穌進了耶利哥，正經過的時候，
verses.e: He entered and was passing through Jericho .

verses.z: 人子來，為要尋找、拯救失喪的人。」
verses.e: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost . "

verses.z: 眾人正在聽見這些話的時候，耶穌因為將近耶路撒冷，又因他們以為上帝的國快要顯出來，就另設一個比喻，說：
verses.e: As they heard these things , he went on and told a parable , because he was near Jerusalem , and they supposed that God's Kingdom would be revealed immediately .

verses.z: 「有一個貴冑往遠方去，要得國回來，
verses.e: He said therefore , " A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return .

verses.z: 便叫了他的十個僕人來，交給他們十錠銀子，說：『你們去做生意，直等我回來。』
verses.e: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins , and told them , ' Conduct business until I come . '

verses.z: 他本國的人卻恨他，打發使者隨後去，說：『我們不願意這個人作我們的王。』
verses.e: But his citizens hated him , and sent an envoy after him , saying , ' We don't want this man to reign over us . '

verses.z: 他既得國回來，就吩咐叫那領銀子的僕人來，要知道他們做生意賺了多少。
verses.e: " When he had come back again , having received the kingdom , he commanded these servants , to whom he had given the money , to be called to him , that he might know what they had gained by conducting business .

verses.z: 頭一個上來，說：『主啊，你的一錠銀子已經賺了十錠。』
verses.e: The first came before him , saying , ' Lord , your mina has made ten more minas . '

verses.z: 主人說：『好！良善的僕人，你既在最小的事上有忠心，可以有權柄管十座城。』
verses.e: " He said to him , ' Well done , you good servant ! Because you were found faithful with very little , you shall have authority over ten cities . '

verses.z: 第二個來，說：『主啊，你的一錠銀子已經賺了五錠。』
verses.e: " The second came , saying , ' Your mina , Lord , has made five minas . '

verses.z: 主人說：『你也可以管五座城。』
verses.e: " So he said to him , ' And you are to be over five cities . '

verses.z: 有一個人名叫撒該，作稅吏長，是個財主。
verses.e: There was a man named Zacchaeus . He was a chief tax collector , and he was rich .

verses.z: 又有一個來說：『主啊，看哪，你的一錠銀子在這裏，我把它包在手巾裏存着。
verses.e: Another came , saying , ' Lord , behold , your mina , which I kept laid away in a handkerchief ,

verses.z: 我原是怕你，因為你是嚴厲的人；沒有放下的，還要去拿，沒有種下的，還要去收。』
verses.e: for I feared you , because you are an exacting man . You take up that which you didn't lay down , and reap that which you didn't sow . '

verses.z: 主人對他說：『你這惡僕，我要憑你的口定你的罪。你既知道我是嚴厲的人，沒有放下的，還要去拿，沒有種下的，還要去收，
verses.e: " He said to him , ' Out of your own mouth I will judge you , you wicked servant ! You knew that I am an exacting man , taking up that which I didn't lay down and reaping that which I didn't sow .

verses.z: 為甚麼不把我的銀子交給銀行，等我來的時候，連本帶利都可以要回來呢？』
verses.e: Then why didn't you deposit my money in the bank , and at my coming , I might have earned interest on it ? '

verses.z: 就對旁邊站着的人說：『奪過他這一錠來，給那有十錠的。』
verses.e: He said to those who stood by , ' Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas . '

verses.z: 他們說：『主啊，他已經有十錠了。』
verses.e: " They said to him , ' Lord , he has ten minas ! '

verses.z: [主人說]：『我告訴你們，凡有的，還要加給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。
verses.e: ' For I tell you that to everyone who has , will more be given ; but from him who doesn't have , even that which he has will be taken away from him .

verses.z: 至於我那些仇敵，不要我作他們王的，把他們拉來，在我面前殺了吧！』」
verses.e: But bring those enemies of mine who didn't want me to reign over them here , and kill them before me . ' "

verses.z: 耶穌說完了這話，就在前面走，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: Having said these things , he went on ahead , going up to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 將近伯法其和伯大尼，在一座山名叫橄欖山那裏，就打發兩個門徒，說：
verses.e: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany , at the mountain that is called Olivet , he sent two of his disciples ,

verses.z: 他要看看耶穌是怎樣的人；只因人多，他的身量又矮，所以不得看見，
verses.e: He was trying to see who Jesus was , and couldn't because of the crowd , because he was short .

verses.z: 「你們往對面村子裏去，進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裏，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開牽來。
verses.e: saying , " Go your way into the village on the other side , in which , as you enter , you will find a colt tied , which no man has ever sat upon . Untie it and bring it .

verses.z: 若有人問為甚麼解牠，你們就說：『主要用牠。』」
verses.e: If anyone asks you , ' Why are you untying it ? ' say to him : ' The Lord needs it . ' "

verses.z: 打發的人去了，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的。
verses.e: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them .

verses.z: 他們解驢駒的時候，主人問他們說：「解驢駒做甚麼？」
verses.e: As they were untying the colt , its owners said to them , " Why are you untying the colt ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「主要用牠。」
verses.e: They said , " The Lord needs it . "

verses.z: 他們牽到耶穌那裏，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶穌騎上。
verses.e: Then they brought it to Jesus . They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them .

verses.z: 走的時候，眾人把衣服鋪在路上。
verses.e: As he went , they spread their cloaks on the road .

verses.z: 將近耶路撒冷，正下橄欖山的時候，眾門徒因所見過的一切異能，都歡樂起來，大聲讚美上帝，
verses.e: As he was now getting near , at the descent of the Mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen ,

verses.z: 說：奉主名來的王是應當稱頌的！在天上有和平；在至高之處有榮光。
verses.e: saying , " Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord ! Peace in heaven , and glory in the highest ! "

verses.z: 眾人中有幾個法利賽人對耶穌說：「夫子，責備你的門徒吧！」
verses.e: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him , " Teacher , rebuke your disciples ! "

verses.z: 就跑到前頭，爬上桑樹，要看耶穌，因為耶穌必從那裏經過。
verses.e: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him , for he was going to pass that way .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我告訴你們，若是他們閉口不說，這些石頭必要呼叫起來。」
verses.e: He answered them , " I tell you that if these were silent , the stones would cry out . "

verses.z: 耶穌快到耶路撒冷，看見城，就為它哀哭，
verses.e: When he came near , he saw the city and wept over it ,

verses.z: 說：「巴不得你在這日子知道關係你平安的事；無奈這事現在是隱藏的，叫你的眼看不出來。
verses.e: saying , " If you , even you , had known today the things which belong to your peace ! But now , they are hidden from your eyes .

verses.z: 因為日子將到，你的仇敵必築起土壘，周圍環繞你，四面困住你，
verses.e: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you , surround you , hem you in on every side ,

verses.z: 並要掃滅你和你裏頭的兒女，連一塊石頭也不留在石頭上，因你不知道眷顧你的時候。」
verses.e: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground . They will not leave in you one stone on another , because you didn't know the time of your visitation . "

verses.z: 耶穌進了殿，趕出裏頭做買賣的人，
verses.e: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it ,

verses.z: 對他們說：「[經上]說：我的殿必作禱告的殿，你們倒使它成為賊窩了。」
verses.e: saying to them , " It is written , ' My house is a house of prayer , ' but you have made it a ' den of robbers ' ! "

verses.z: 耶穌天天在殿裏教訓人。祭司長和文士與百姓的尊長都想要殺他，
verses.e: He was teaching daily in the temple , but the chief priests , the scribes , and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him .

verses.z: 但尋不出法子來，因為百姓都側耳聽他。
verses.e: They couldn't find what they might do , for all the people hung on to every word that he said .

verses.z: 耶穌到了那裏，抬頭一看，對他說：「撒該，快下來！今天我必住在你家裏。」
verses.e: When Jesus came to the place , he looked up and saw him , and said to him , " Zacchaeus , hurry and come down , for today I must stay at your house . "

verses.z: 他就急忙下來，歡歡喜喜地接待耶穌。
verses.e: He hurried , came down , and received him joyfully .

verses.z: 眾人看見，都私下議論說：「他竟到罪人家裏去住宿。」
verses.e: When they saw it , they all murmured , saying , " He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner . "

verses.z: 撒該站着對主說：「主啊，我把所有的一半給窮人；我若訛詐了誰，就還他四倍。」
verses.e: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord , " Behold , Lord , half of my goods I give to the poor . If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone , I restore four times as much . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「今天救恩到了這家，因為他也是亞伯拉罕的子孫。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Today , salvation has come to this house , because he also is a son of Abraham .

verses.z: 當那些日子，凱撒奧古斯都有旨意下來，叫天下人民都報名上冊。
verses.e: Now in those days , a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled .

verses.z: 那天使對他們說：「不要懼怕！我報給你們大喜的信息，是關乎萬民的；
verses.e: The angel said to them , " Don't be afraid , for behold , I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people .

verses.z: 因今天在大衛的城裏，為你們生了救主，就是主基督。
verses.e: For there is born to you today , in David's city , a Savior , who is Christ the Lord .

verses.z: 你們要看見一個嬰孩，包着布，臥在[馬]槽裏，那就是記號了。」
verses.e: This is the sign to you : you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth , lying in a feeding trough . "

verses.z: 忽然，有一大隊天兵同那天使讚美上帝說：
verses.e: Suddenly , there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying ,

verses.z: 在至高之處榮耀歸與上帝！在地上平安歸與他所喜悅的人！
verses.e: " Glory to God in the highest , on earth peace , good will toward men . "

verses.z: 眾天使離開他們，升天去了。牧羊的人彼此說：「我們往伯利恆去，看看所成的事，就是主所指示我們的。」
verses.e: When the angels went away from them into the sky , the shepherds said to one another , " Let's go to Bethlehem , now , and see this thing that has happened , which the Lord has made known to us . "

verses.z: 他們急忙去了，就尋見馬利亞和約瑟，又有那嬰孩臥在[馬]槽裏；
verses.e: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph , and the baby was lying in the feeding trough .

verses.z: 既然看見，就把天使論這孩子的話傳開了。
verses.e: When they saw it , they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child .

verses.z: 凡聽見的，就詫異牧羊之人對他們所說的話。
verses.e: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds .

verses.z: 馬利亞卻把這一切的事存在心裏，反覆思想。
verses.e: But Mary kept all these sayings , pondering them in her heart .

verses.z: 這是居里扭作敘利亞巡撫的時候，頭一次行報名上冊的事。
verses.e: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria .

verses.z: 牧羊的人回去了，因所聽見所看見的一切事，正如[天使]向他們所說的，就歸榮耀與上帝，讚美他。
verses.e: The shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , just as it was told them .

verses.z: 滿了八天，就給孩子行割禮，與他起名叫耶穌；這就是沒有成胎以前，天使所起的名。
verses.e: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child , his name was called Jesus , which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb .

verses.z: 按摩西律法滿了潔淨的日子，他們帶着孩子上耶路撒冷去，要把他獻與主，（
verses.e: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled , they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

verses.z: 正如主的律法上所記：「凡頭生的男子必稱聖歸主。」）
verses.e: ( as it is written in the law of the Lord , " Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord " ) ,

verses.z: 又要照主的律法上所說，或用一對斑鳩，或用兩隻雛鴿獻祭。
verses.e: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord , " A pair of turtledoves , or two young pigeons . "

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷有一個人，名叫西面；這人又公義又虔誠，素常盼望以色列的安慰[者]來到，又有聖靈在他身上。
verses.e: Behold , there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon . This man was righteous and devout , looking for the consolation of Israel , and the Holy Spirit was on him .

verses.z: 他得了聖靈的啟示，知道自己未死以前，必看見主所立的基督。
verses.e: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ .

verses.z: 他受了[聖]靈的感動，進入聖殿，正遇見耶穌的父母抱着孩子進來，要照律法的規矩辦理。
verses.e: He came in the Spirit into the temple . When the parents brought in the child , Jesus , that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law ,

verses.z: 西面就用手接過他來，稱頌上帝說：
verses.e: then he received him into his arms and blessed God , and said ,

verses.z: 主啊！如今可以照你的話，釋放僕人安然去世；
verses.e: " Now you are releasing your servant , Master , according to your word , in peace ;

verses.z: 眾人各歸各城，報名上冊。
verses.e: All went to enroll themselves , everyone to his own city .

verses.z: 因為我的眼睛已經看見你的救恩－
verses.e: for my eyes have seen your salvation ,

verses.z: 就是你在萬民面前所預備的：
verses.e: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples ;

verses.z: 是照亮外邦人的光，又是你民以色列的榮耀。
verses.e: a light for revelation to the nations , and the glory of your people Israel . "

verses.z: 孩子的父母因這論耶穌的話就希奇。
verses.e: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him .

verses.z: 西面給他們祝福，又對孩子的母親馬利亞說：「這[孩子]被立，是要叫以色列中許多人跌倒，許多人興起；又要作毀謗的話柄，叫許多人心裏的意念顯露出來；你自己的心也要被刀刺透。」
