verses.e: Simeon blessed them , and said to Mary , his mother , " Behold , this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel , and for a sign which is spoken against .
Yes , a sword will pierce through your own soul , that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed . "

verses.z: 又有女先知，名叫亞拿，是亞設支派法內力的女兒，年紀已經老邁，從作童女出嫁的時候，同丈夫住了七年就寡居了，
verses.e: There was one Anna , a prophetess , the daughter of Phanuel , of the tribe of Asher ( she was of a great age , having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity ,

verses.z: 現在已經八十四歲，並不離開聖殿，禁食祈求，晝夜事奉上帝。
verses.e: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years ) , who didn't depart from the temple , worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day .

verses.z: 正當那時，她進前來稱謝上帝，將孩子的事對一切盼望耶路撒冷得救贖的人講說。
verses.e: Coming up at that very hour , she gave thanks to the Lord , and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 約瑟和馬利亞照主的律法辦完了一切的事，就回加利利，到自己的城拿撒勒去了。
verses.e: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord , they returned into Galilee , to their own city , Nazareth .

verses.z: 約瑟也從加利利的拿撒勒城上猶太去，到了大衛的城，名叫伯利恆，因他本是大衛一族一家的人，
verses.e: Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judea , to David's city , which is called Bethlehem , because he was of the house and family of David ,

verses.z: 孩子漸漸長大，強健起來，充滿智慧，又有上帝的恩在他身上。
verses.e: The child was growing , and was becoming strong in spirit , being filled with wisdom , and the grace of God was upon him .

verses.z: 每年到逾越節，他父母就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover .

verses.z: 當他十二歲的時候，他們按着節期的規矩上去。
verses.e: When he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast ;

verses.z: 守滿了節期，他們回去，孩童耶穌仍舊在耶路撒冷。他的父母並不知道，
verses.e: and when they had fulfilled the days , as they were returning , the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem . Joseph and his mother didn't know it ,

verses.z: 以為他在同行的人中間，走了一天的路程，就在親族和熟識的人中找他，
verses.e: but supposing him to be in the company , they went a day's journey ; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances .

verses.z: 既找不着，就回耶路撒冷去找他。
verses.e: When they didn't find him , they returned to Jerusalem , looking for him .

verses.z: 過了三天，就遇見他在殿裏，坐在教師中間，一面聽，一面問。
verses.e: After three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the middle of the teachers , both listening to them and asking them questions .

verses.z: 凡聽見他的，都希奇他的聰明和他的應對。
verses.e: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers .

verses.z: 他父母看見就很希奇。他母親對他說：「我兒！為甚麼向我們這樣行呢？看哪，你父親和我傷心來找你！」
verses.e: When they saw him , they were astonished ; and his mother said to him , " Son , why have you treated us this way ? Behold , your father and I were anxiously looking for you . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「為甚麼找我呢？豈不知我應當以我父的事為念嗎？」
verses.e: He said to them , " Why were you looking for me ? Didn't you know that I must be in my Father's house ? "

verses.z: 要和他所聘之妻馬利亞一同報名上冊。那時馬利亞的身孕已經重了。
verses.e: to enroll himself with Mary , who was pledged to be married to him as wife , being pregnant .

verses.z: 他所說的這話，他們不明白。
verses.e: They didn't understand the saying which he spoke to them .

verses.z: 他就同他們下去，回到拿撒勒，並且順從他們。他母親把這一切的事都存在心裏。
verses.e: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth . He was subject to them , and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .

verses.z: 耶穌的智慧和身量，並上帝和人喜愛他的心，都一齊增長。
verses.e: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature , and in favor with God and men .

verses.z: 他們在那裏的時候，馬利亞的產期到了，
verses.e: While they were there , the day had come for her to give birth .

verses.z: 就生了頭胎的兒子，用布包起來，放在馬槽裏，因為客店裏沒有地方。
verses.e: She gave birth to her firstborn son . She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough , because there was no room for them in the inn .

verses.z: 在伯利恆之野地裏有牧羊的人，夜間按着更次看守羊群。
verses.e: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field , and keeping watch by night over their flock .

verses.z: 有主的使者站在他們旁邊，主的榮光四面照着他們；牧羊的人就甚懼怕。
verses.e: Behold , an angel of the Lord stood by them , and the glory of the Lord shone around them , and they were terrified .

verses.z: 有一天，耶穌在殿裏教訓百姓，講福音的時候，祭司長和文士並長老上前來，
verses.e: On one of those days , as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News , the priests and scribes came to him with the elders .

verses.z: 到了時候，打發一個僕人到園戶那裏去，叫他們把園中當納的果子交給他；園戶竟打了他，叫他空手回去。
verses.e: At the proper season , he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard . But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty .

verses.z: 又打發一個僕人去，他們也打了他，並且凌辱他，叫他空手回去。
verses.e: He sent yet another servant , and they also beat him and treated him shamefully , and sent him away empty .

verses.z: 又打發第三個僕人去，他們也打傷了他，把他推出去了。
verses.e: He sent yet a third , and they also wounded him and threw him out .

verses.z: 園主說：『我怎麼辦呢？我要打發我的愛子去，或者他們尊敬他。』
verses.e: The lord of the vineyard said , ' What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son . It may be that seeing him , they will respect him . '

verses.z: 不料，園戶看見他，就彼此商量說：『這是承受產業的，我們殺他吧，使產業歸於我們！』
verses.e: " But when the farmers saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , ' This is the heir . Come , let's kill him , that the inheritance may be ours . '

verses.z: 於是把他推出葡萄園外，殺了。這樣，葡萄園的主人要怎樣處治他們呢？
verses.e: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him . What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them ?

verses.z: 他要來除滅這些園戶，將葡萄園轉給別人。」聽見的人說：「這是萬不可的！」
verses.e: He will come and destroy these farmers , and will give the vineyard to others . " When they heard that , they said , " May that never be ! "

verses.z: 耶穌看着他們說：「[經上]記着：匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。這是甚麼意思呢？
verses.e: But he looked at them and said , " Then what is this that is written , ' The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone ' ?

verses.z: 凡掉在那石頭上的，必要跌碎；那石頭掉在誰的身上，就要把誰砸得稀爛。」
verses.e: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces , but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust . "

verses.z: 文士和祭司長看出這比喻是指着他們說的，當時就想要下手拿他，只是懼怕百姓。
verses.e: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour , but they feared the people — for they knew he had spoken this parable against them .

verses.z: 問他說：「你告訴我們，你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
verses.e: They asked him , " Tell us : by what authority do you do these things ? Or who is giving you this authority ? "

verses.z: 於是窺探耶穌，打發奸細裝作好人，要在他的話上得把柄，好將他交在巡撫的政權之下。
verses.e: They watched him and sent out spies , who pretended to be righteous , that they might trap him in something he said , so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor .

verses.z: 奸細就問耶穌說：「夫子，我們曉得你所講所傳都是正道，也不取人的外貌，乃是誠誠實實傳上帝的道。
verses.e: They asked him , " Teacher , we know that you say and teach what is right , and aren't partial to anyone , but truly teach the way of God .

verses.z: 我們納稅給凱撒，可以不可以？」
verses.e: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar , or not ? "

verses.z: 耶穌看出他們的詭詐，就對他們說：
verses.e: But he perceived their craftiness , and said to them , " Why do you test me ?

verses.z: 「拿一個銀錢來給我看。這像和這號是誰的？」他們說：「是凱撒的。」
verses.e: Show me a denarius . Whose image and inscription are on it ? " They answered , " Caesar's . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這樣，凱撒的物當歸給凱撒，上帝的物當歸給上帝。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's , and to God the things that are God's . "

verses.z: 他們當着百姓，在這話上得不着把柄，又希奇他的應對，就閉口無言了。
verses.e: They weren't able to trap him in his words before the people . They marveled at his answer and were silent .

verses.z: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。有幾個來問耶穌說：
verses.e: Some of the Sadducees came to him , those who deny that there is a resurrection .

verses.z: 「夫子！摩西為我們寫着說：『人若有妻無子就死了，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』
verses.e: They asked him , " Teacher , Moses wrote to us that if a man's brother dies having a wife , and he is childless , his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother .

verses.z: 有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，沒有孩子死了；
verses.e: There were therefore seven brothers . The first took a wife , and died childless .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我也要問你們一句話，你們且告訴我。
verses.e: He answered them , " I also will ask you one question . Tell me :

verses.z: 第二個、第三個也娶過她；
verses.e: The second took her as wife , and he died childless .

verses.z: 那七個人都娶過她，沒有留下孩子就死了。
verses.e: The third took her , and likewise the seven all left no children , and died .

verses.z: 後來婦人也死了。
verses.e: Afterward the woman also died .

verses.z: 這樣，當復活的時候，她是哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們七個人都娶過她。」
verses.e: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be ? For the seven had her as a wife . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這世界的人有娶有嫁；
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " The children of this age marry and are given in marriage .

verses.z: 惟有算為配得那世界，與從死裏復活的人也不娶也不嫁；
verses.e: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage .

verses.z: 因為他們不能再死，和天使一樣；既是復活的人，就為上帝的兒子。
verses.e: For they can't die any more , for they are like the angels and are children of God , being children of the resurrection .

verses.z: 至於死人復活，摩西在荊棘篇上，稱主是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，就指示明白了。
verses.e: But that the dead are raised , even Moses showed at the bush , when he called the Lord ' The God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . '

verses.z: 上帝原不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝；因為在他那裏，人都是活的。」
verses.e: Now he is not the God of the dead , but of the living , for all are alive to him . "

verses.z: 有幾個文士說：「夫子！你說得好。」
verses.e: Some of the scribes answered , " Teacher , you speak well . "

verses.z: 約翰的洗禮是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？」
verses.e: the baptism of John , was it from heaven , or from men ? "

verses.z: 以後他們不敢再問他甚麼。
verses.e: They didn't dare to ask him any more questions .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「人怎麼說基督是大衛的子孫呢？
verses.e: He said to them , " Why do they say that the Christ is David's son ?

verses.z: 詩篇上大衛自己說：主對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，
verses.e: David himself says in the book of Psalms , ' The Lord said to my Lord , " Sit at my right hand ,

verses.z: 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
verses.e: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet . " '

verses.z: 大衛既稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」
verses.e: " David therefore calls him Lord , so how is he his son ? "

verses.z: 眾百姓聽的時候，耶穌對門徒說：
verses.e: In the hearing of all the people , he said to his disciples ,

verses.z: 「你們要防備文士。他們好穿長衣遊行，喜愛人在街市上問他們安，又喜愛會堂裏的高位，筵席上的首座；
verses.e: " Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes , and love greetings in the marketplaces , the best seats in the synagogues , and the best places at feasts ;

verses.z: 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，假意作很長的禱告。這些人要受更重的刑罰！」
verses.e: who devour widows ' houses , and for a pretense make long prayers . These will receive greater condemnation . "

verses.z: 他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必說：『你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
verses.e: They reasoned with themselves , saying , " If we say , ' From heaven , ' he will say , ' Why didn't you believe him ? '

verses.z: 若說『從人間來』，百姓都要用石頭打死我們，因為他們信約翰是先知。」
verses.e: But if we say , ' From men , ' all the people will stone us , for they are persuaded that John was a prophet . "

verses.z: 於是回答說：「不知道是從哪裏來的。」
verses.e: They answered that they didn't know where it was from .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們，我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things . "

verses.z: 耶穌就設比喻對百姓說：「有人栽了一個葡萄園，租給園戶，就往外國去住了許久。
verses.e: He began to tell the people this parable : " A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers , and went into another country for a long time .

verses.z: 耶穌抬頭觀看，見財主把捐項投在庫裏，
verses.e: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury .

verses.z: 當時，耶穌對他們說：「民要攻打民，國要攻打國；
verses.e: Then he said to them , " Nation will rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom .

verses.z: 地要大大震動，多處必有饑荒、瘟疫，又有可怕的異象和大神蹟從天上顯現。
verses.e: There will be great earthquakes , famines , and plagues in various places . There will be terrors and great signs from heaven .

verses.z: 但這一切的事以先，人要下手拿住你們，逼迫你們，把你們交給會堂，並且收在監裏，又為我的名拉你們到君王諸侯面前。
verses.e: But before all these things , they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you , delivering you up to synagogues and prisons , bringing you before kings and governors for my name's sake .

verses.z: 但這些事終必為你們的見證。
verses.e: It will turn out as a testimony for you .

verses.z: 所以，你們當立定心意，不要預先思想怎樣分訴；
verses.e: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer ,

verses.z: 因為我必賜你們口才、智慧，是你們一切敵人所敵不住、駁不倒的。
verses.e: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict .

verses.z: 連你們的父母、弟兄、親族、朋友也要把你們交官；你們也有被他們害死的。
verses.e: You will be handed over even by parents , brothers , relatives , and friends . They will cause some of you to be put to death .

verses.z: 你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡，
verses.e: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake .

verses.z: 然而，你們連一根頭髮也必不損壞。
verses.e: And not a hair of your head will perish .

verses.z: 你們常存忍耐，就必保全靈魂。」
verses.e: " By your endurance you will win your lives .

verses.z: 又見一個窮寡婦投了兩個小錢，
verses.e: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins .

verses.z: 「你們看見耶路撒冷被兵圍困，就可知道它成荒場的日子近了。
verses.e: " But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies , then know that its desolation is at hand .

verses.z: 那時，在猶太的應當逃到山上；在城裏的應當出來；在鄉下的不要進城；
verses.e: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains . Let those who are in the middle of her depart . Let those who are in the country not enter therein .

verses.z: 因為這是報應的日子，使[經上]所寫的都得應驗。
verses.e: For these are days of vengeance , that all things which are written may be fulfilled .

verses.z: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了！因為將有大災難降在這地方，也有震怒臨到這百姓。
verses.e: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days ! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people .

verses.z: 他們要倒在刀下，又被擄到各國去。耶路撒冷要被外邦人踐踏，直到外邦人的日期滿了。」
verses.e: They will fall by the edge of the sword , and will be led captive into all the nations . Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled .

verses.z: 「日、月、星辰要顯出異兆，地上的邦國也有困苦；因海中波浪的響聲，就慌慌不定。
verses.e: " There will be signs in the sun , moon , and stars ; and on the earth anxiety of nations , in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves ;

verses.z: 天勢都要震動，人想起那將要臨到世界的事，就都嚇得魂不附體。
verses.e: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world , for the powers of the heavens will be shaken .

verses.z: 那時，他們要看見人子有能力，有大榮耀駕雲降臨。
verses.e: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory .

verses.z: 一有這些事，你們就當挺身昂首，因為你們得贖的日子近了。」
verses.e: But when these things begin to happen , look up and lift up your heads , because your redemption is near . "

verses.z: 耶穌又設比喻對他們說：「你們看無花果樹和各樣的樹；它發芽的時候，你們一看見，自然曉得夏天近了。
verses.e: He told them a parable . " See the fig tree and all the trees .

verses.z: 就說：「我實在告訴你們，這窮寡婦所投的比眾人還多；
verses.e: He said , " Truly I tell you , this poor widow put in more than all of them ,
When they are already budding , you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near .

verses.z: 這樣，你們看見這些事漸漸地成就，也該曉得上帝的國近了。
verses.e: Even so you also , when you see these things happening , know that God's Kingdom is near .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished .

verses.z: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」
verses.e: Heaven and earth will pass away , but my words will by no means pass away .

verses.z: 「你們要謹慎，恐怕因貪食、醉酒，並今生的思慮累住你們的心，那日子就如同網羅忽然臨到你們；
verses.e: " So be careful , or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing , drunkenness , and cares of this life , and that day will come on you suddenly .

verses.z: 因為那日子要[這樣]臨到全地上一切居住的人。
verses.e: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth .

verses.z: 你們要時時警醒，常常祈求，使你們能逃避這一切要來的事，得以站立在人子面前。」
verses.e: Therefore be watchful all the time , praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen , and to stand before the Son of Man . "

verses.z: 耶穌每日在殿裏教訓人，每夜出城在一座山，名叫橄欖山住宿。
verses.e: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple , and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet .

verses.z: 眾百姓清早上[聖]殿，到耶穌那裏，要聽他講道。
verses.e: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him .

verses.z: 因為眾人都是自己有餘，拿出來投在捐項裏，但這寡婦是自己不足，把她一切養生的都投上了。」
verses.e: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance , but she , out of her poverty , put in all that she had to live on . "

verses.z: 有人談論聖殿是用美石和供物妝飾的；
verses.e: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts , he said ,

verses.z: 耶穌就說：「論到你們所看見的這一切，將來日子到了，在這裏沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」
verses.e: " As for these things which you see , the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down . "

verses.z: 他們問他說：「夫子！甚麼時候有這事呢？這事將到的時候有甚麼預兆呢？」
verses.e: They asked him , " Teacher , so when will these things be ? What is the sign that these things are about to happen ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們要謹慎，不要受迷惑；因為將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是[基督]』，又說：『時候近了』，你們不要跟從他們！
verses.e: He said , " Watch out that you don't get led astray , for many will come in my name , saying , ' I am he , ' and , ' The time is at hand . ' Therefore don't follow them .

verses.z: 你們聽見打仗和擾亂的事，不要驚惶；因為這些事必須先有，只是末期不能立時就到。」
verses.e: When you hear of wars and disturbances , don't be terrified , for these things must happen first , but the end won't come immediately . "

verses.z: 除酵節（又名逾越[節]）近了。
verses.e: Now the feast of unleavened bread , which is called the Passover , was approaching .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們進了城，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而來，你們就跟着他，到他所進的房子裏去，
verses.e: He said to them , " Behold , when you have entered into the city , a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you . Follow him into the house which he enters .

verses.z: 對那家的主人說：『夫子說：客房在哪裏？我與門徒好在那裏吃逾越[節的筵席]。』
verses.e: Tell the master of the house , ' The Teacher says to you , " Where is the guest room , where I may eat the Passover with my disciples ? " '

verses.z: 他必指給你們擺設整齊的一間大樓，你們就在那裏預備。」
verses.e: He will show you a large , furnished upper room . Make preparations there . "

verses.z: 他們去了，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的；他們就預備了逾越[節的筵席]。
verses.e: They went , found things as Jesus had told them , and they prepared the Passover .

verses.z: 時候到了，耶穌坐席，使徒也和他同坐。
verses.e: When the hour had come , he sat down with the twelve apostles .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「我很願意在受害以先和你們吃這逾越[節的筵席]。
verses.e: He said to them , " I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer ,

verses.z: 我告訴你們，我不[再]吃[這筵席]，直到成就在上帝的國裏。」
verses.e: for I tell you , I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 耶穌接過杯來，祝謝了，說：「你們拿這個，大家分着喝。
verses.e: He received a cup , and when he had given thanks , he said , " Take this and share it among yourselves ,

verses.z: 我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直等上帝的國來到。」
verses.e: for I tell you , I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine , until God's Kingdom comes . "

verses.z: 又拿起餅來，祝謝了，就擘開，遞給他們，說：「這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們也應當如此行，為的是記念我。」
verses.e: He took bread , and when he had given thanks , he broke and gave it to them , saying , " This is my body which is given for you . Do this in memory of me . "

verses.z: 祭司長和文士想法子怎麼才能殺害耶穌，是因他們懼怕百姓。
verses.e: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death , for they feared the people .

verses.z: 飯後也照樣拿起杯來，說：「這杯是用我血所立的新約，是為你們流出來的。
verses.e: Likewise , he took the cup after supper , saying , " This cup is the new covenant in my blood , which is poured out for you .

verses.z: 看哪，那賣我之人的手與我一同在桌子上。
verses.e: But behold , the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table .

verses.z: 人子固然要照所預定的去世，但賣人子的人有禍了！」
verses.e: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined , but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed ! "

verses.z: 他們就彼此對問，是哪一個要做這事。
verses.e: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing .

verses.z: 門徒起了爭論，他們中間哪一個可算為大。
verses.e: A dispute also arose among them , which of them was considered to be greatest .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「外邦人有君王為主治理他們，那掌權管他們的稱為恩主。
verses.e: He said to them , " The kings of the nations lord it over them , and those who have authority over them are called ' benefactors . '

verses.z: 但你們不可這樣；你們裏頭為大的，倒要像年幼的，為首領的，倒要像服事人的。
verses.e: But not so with you . Rather , the one who is greater among you , let him become as the younger , and one who is governing , as one who serves .

verses.z: 是誰為大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大嗎？然而，我在你們中間如同服事人的。
verses.e: For who is greater , one who sits at the table , or one who serves ? Isn't it he who sits at the table ? But I am among you as one who serves .

verses.z: 我在磨煉之中，常和我同在的就是你們。
verses.e: " But you are those who have continued with me in my trials .

verses.z: 我將國賜給你們，正如我父賜給我一樣，
verses.e: I confer on you a kingdom , even as my Father conferred on me ,

verses.z: 這時，撒但入了那稱為加略人猶大的心；他本是十二門徒裏的一個。
verses.e: Satan entered into Judas , who was also called Iscariot , who was counted with the twelve .

verses.z: 叫你們在我國裏，坐在我的席上吃喝，並且坐在寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。」
verses.e: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom . You will sit on thrones , judging the twelve tribes of Israel . "

verses.z: [主又說]：「西門！西門！撒但想要得着你們，好篩你們像篩麥子一樣；
verses.e: The Lord said , " Simon , Simon , behold , Satan asked to have all of you , that he might sift you as wheat ,

verses.z: 但我已經為你祈求，叫你不至於失了信心。你回頭以後，要堅固你的弟兄。」
verses.e: but I prayed for you , that your faith wouldn't fail . You , when once you have turned again , establish your brothers . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「主啊，我就是同你下監，同你受死，也是甘心！」
verses.e: He said to him , " Lord , I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death ! "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「彼得，我告訴你，今日雞還沒有叫，你要三次說不認得我。」
verses.e: He said , " I tell you , Peter , the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times . "

verses.z: 耶穌又對他們說：「我差你們出去的時候，沒有錢囊，沒有口袋，沒有鞋，你們缺少甚麼沒有？」他們說：「沒有。」
verses.e: He said to them , " When I sent you out without purse , bag , and sandals , did you lack anything ? " They said , " Nothing . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「但如今有錢囊的可以帶着，有口袋的也可以帶着，沒有刀的要賣衣服買刀。
verses.e: Then he said to them , " But now , whoever has a purse , let him take it , and likewise a bag . Whoever has none , let him sell his cloak , and buy a sword .

verses.z: 我告訴你們，[經上]寫着說：『他被列在罪犯之中。』這話必應驗在我身上，因為那關係我的事必然成就。」
verses.e: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me : ' He was counted with transgressors . ' For that which concerns me is being fulfilled . "

verses.z: 他們說：「主啊，請看！這裏有兩把刀。」耶穌說：「夠了。」
verses.e: They said , " Lord , behold , here are two swords . " He said to them , " That is enough . "

verses.z: 耶穌出來，照常往橄欖山去，門徒也跟隨他。
verses.e: He came out and went , as his custom was , to the Mount of Olives . His disciples also followed him .

verses.z: 他去和祭司長並守殿官商量，怎麼可以把耶穌交給他們。
verses.e: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them .

verses.z: 到了那地方，就對他們說：「你們要禱告，免得入了迷惑。」
verses.e: When he was at the place , he said to them , " Pray that you don't enter into temptation . "

verses.z: 於是離開他們約有扔一塊石頭那麼遠，跪下禱告，
verses.e: He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw , and he knelt down and prayed ,

verses.z: 說：「父啊！你若願意，就把這杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。」
verses.e: saying , " Father , if you are willing , remove this cup from me . Nevertheless , not my will , but yours , be done . "

verses.z: 有一位天使從天上顯現，加添他的力量。
verses.e: An angel from heaven appeared to him , strengthening him .

verses.z: 耶穌極其傷痛，禱告更加懇切，汗珠如大血點滴在地上。
verses.e: Being in agony , he prayed more earnestly . His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground .

verses.z: 禱告完了，就起來，到門徒那裏，見他們因為憂愁都睡着了，
verses.e: When he rose up from his prayer , he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief ,

verses.z: 就對他們說：「你們為甚麼睡覺呢？起來禱告，免得入了迷惑！」
verses.e: and said to them , " Why do you sleep ? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation . "

verses.z: 說話之間，來了許多人。那十二個門徒裏名叫猶大的，走在前頭，就近耶穌，要與他親嘴。
verses.e: While he was still speaking , a crowd appeared . He who was called Judas , one of the twelve , was leading them . He came near to Jesus to kiss him .

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「猶大！你用親嘴[的暗號]賣人子嗎？」
verses.e: But Jesus said to him , " Judas , do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss ? "

verses.z: 左右的人見光景不好，就說：「主啊！我們拿刀砍可以不可以？」
verses.e: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen , they said to him , " Lord , shall we strike with the sword ? "

verses.z: 他們歡喜，就約定給他銀子。
verses.e: They were glad , and agreed to give him money .

verses.z: 內中有一個人把大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。
verses.e: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「到了這個地步，由他們吧！」就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。
verses.e: But Jesus answered , " Let me at least do this " — and he touched his ear and healed him .

verses.z: 耶穌對那些來拿他的祭司長和守殿官並長老說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？
verses.e: Jesus said to the chief priests , captains of the temple , and elders , who had come against him , " Have you come out as against a robber , with swords and clubs ?

verses.z: 我天天同你們在殿裏，你們不下手拿我。現在卻是你們的時候，黑暗掌權了。」
verses.e: When I was with you in the temple daily , you didn't stretch out your hands against me . But this is your hour , and the power of darkness . "

verses.z: 他們拿住耶穌，把他帶到大祭司的宅裏。彼得遠遠地跟着。
verses.e: They seized him and led him away , and brought him into the high priest's house . But Peter followed from a distance .

verses.z: 他們在院子裏生了火，一同坐着；彼得也坐在他們中間。
verses.e: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together , Peter sat among them .

verses.z: 有一個使女看見彼得坐在[火]光裏，就定睛看他，說：「這個人素來也是同那人一夥的。」
verses.e: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light , and looking intently at him , said , " This man also was with him . "

verses.z: 彼得卻不承認，說：「女子，我不認得他。」
verses.e: He denied Jesus , saying , " Woman , I don't know him . "

verses.z: 過了不多的時候，又有一個人看見他，說：「你也是他們一黨的。」彼得說：「你這個人！我不是。」
verses.e: After a little while someone else saw him and said , " You also are one of them ! " But Peter answered , " Man , I am not ! "

verses.z: 約過了一小時，又有一個人極力地說：「他實在是同那人一夥的，因為他也是加利利人。」
verses.e: After about one hour passed , another confidently affirmed , saying , " Truly this man also was with him , for he is a Galilean ! "

verses.z: 他應允了，就找機會，要趁眾人不在跟前的時候把耶穌交給他們。
verses.e: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude .

verses.z: 彼得說：「你這個人！我不曉得你說的是甚麼！」正說話之間，雞就叫了。
verses.e: But Peter said , " Man , I don't know what you are talking about ! " Immediately , while he was still speaking , a rooster crowed .

verses.z: 主轉過身來看彼得，彼得便想起主對他所說的話：「今日雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
verses.e: The Lord turned and looked at Peter . Then Peter remembered the Lord's word , how he said to him , " Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times . "

verses.z: 他就出去痛哭。
verses.e: He went out , and wept bitterly .

verses.z: 看守耶穌的人戲弄他，打他，
verses.e: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him .

verses.z: 又蒙着他的眼，問他說：「你是先知，告訴我們打你的是誰？」
verses.e: Having blindfolded him , they struck him on the face and asked him , " Prophesy ! Who is the one who struck you ? "

verses.z: 他們還用許多別的話辱罵他。
verses.e: They spoke many other things against him , insulting him .

verses.z: 天一亮，民間的眾長老連祭司長帶文士都聚會，把耶穌帶到他們的公會裏，
verses.e: As soon as it was day , the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together , both chief priests and scribes , and they led him away into their council , saying ,

verses.z: 說：「你若是基督，就告訴我們。」耶穌說：「我若告訴你們，你們也不信；
verses.e: " If you are the Christ , tell us . " But he said to them , " If I tell you , you won't believe ,

verses.z: 我若問你們，你們也不回答。
verses.e: and if I ask , you will in no way answer me or let me go .

verses.z: 從今以後，人子要坐在上帝權能的右邊。」
verses.e: From now on , the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God . "

verses.z: 除酵[節]，須宰逾越[羊羔]的那一天到了。
verses.e: The day of unleavened bread came , on which the Passover must be sacrificed .

verses.z: 他們都說：「這樣，你是上帝的兒子嗎？」耶穌說：「你們所說的是。」
verses.e: They all said , " Are you then the Son of God ? " He said to them , " You say it , because I am . "

verses.z: 他們說：「何必再用見證呢？他親口所說的，我們都親自聽見了。」
verses.e: They said , " Why do we need any more witness ? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth ! "

verses.z: 耶穌打發彼得、約翰，說：「你們去為我們預備逾越[節的筵席]，好叫我們吃。」
verses.e: Jesus sent Peter and John , saying , " Go and prepare the Passover for us , that we may eat . "

verses.z: 他們問他說：「要我們在哪裏預備？」
verses.e: They said to him , " Where do you want us to prepare ? "

verses.z: 眾人都起來，把耶穌解到彼拉多面前，
verses.e: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate .

verses.z: 祭司長和文士都站着，極力地告他。
verses.e: The chief priests and the scribes stood , vehemently accusing him .

verses.z: 希律和他的兵丁就藐視耶穌，戲弄他，給他穿上華麗衣服，把他送回彼拉多那裏去。
verses.e: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him . Dressing him in luxurious clothing , they sent him back to Pilate .

verses.z: 從前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。
verses.e: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day , for before that they were enemies with each other .

verses.z: 彼拉多傳齊了祭司長和官府並百姓，
verses.e: Pilate called together the chief priests , the rulers , and the people ,

verses.z: 就對他們說：「你們解這人到我這裏，說他是誘惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾將你們告他的事，在你們面前審問他，並沒有查出他甚麼罪來；
verses.e: and said to them , " You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people , and behold , having examined him before you , I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him .

verses.z: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回來。可見他沒有做甚麼該死的事。
verses.e: Neither has Herod , for I sent you to him , and see , nothing worthy of death has been done by him .

verses.z: 故此，我要責打他，把他釋放了。」
verses.e: I will therefore chastise him and release him . "
Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast .

verses.z: 眾人卻一齊喊着說：「除掉這個人！釋放巴拉巴給我們！」
verses.e: But they all cried out together , saying , " Away with this man ! Release to us Barabbas ! " —

verses.z: 這巴拉巴是因在城裏作亂殺人，下在監裏的。
verses.e: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city , and for murder .

verses.z: 就告他說：「我們見這人誘惑國民，禁止納稅給凱撒，並說自己是基督，是王。」
verses.e: They began to accuse him , saying , " We found this man perverting the nation , forbidding paying taxes to Caesar , and saying that he himself is Christ , a king . "

verses.z: 彼拉多願意釋放耶穌，就又勸解他們。
verses.e: Then Pilate spoke to them again , wanting to release Jesus ,

verses.z: 無奈他們喊着說：「釘他十字架！釘他十字架！」
verses.e: but they shouted , saying , " Crucify ! Crucify him ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多第三次對他們說：「為甚麼呢？這人做了甚麼惡事呢？我並沒有查出他甚麼該死的罪來。所以，我要責打他，把他釋放了。」
verses.e: He said to them the third time , " Why ? What evil has this man done ? I have found no capital crime in him . I will therefore chastise him and release him . "

verses.z: 他們大聲催逼彼拉多，求他把耶穌釘在十字架上。他們的聲音就得了勝。
verses.e: But they were urgent with loud voices , asking that he might be crucified . Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed .

verses.z: 彼拉多這才照他們所求的定案，
verses.e: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done .

verses.z: 把他們所求的那作亂殺人、下在監裏的釋放了，把耶穌交給他們，任憑他們的意思行。
verses.e: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder , for whom they asked , but he delivered Jesus up to their will .

verses.z: 帶耶穌去的時候，有一個古利奈人西門，從鄉下來；他們就抓住他，把十字架擱在他身上，叫他背着跟隨耶穌。
verses.e: When they led him away , they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene , coming from the country , and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus .

verses.z: 有許多百姓跟隨耶穌，內中有好些婦女；婦女們為他號咷痛哭。
verses.e: A great multitude of the people followed him , including women who also mourned and lamented him .

verses.z: 耶穌轉身對她們說：「耶路撒冷的女子，不要為我哭，當為自己和自己的兒女哭。
verses.e: But Jesus , turning to them , said , " Daughters of Jerusalem , don't weep for me , but weep for yourselves and for your children .

verses.z: 因為日子要到，人必說：『不生育的，和未曾懷胎的，未曾乳養嬰孩的，有福了！』
verses.e: For behold , the days are coming in which they will say , ' Blessed are the barren , the wombs that never bore , and the breasts that never nursed . '

verses.z: 彼拉多問耶穌說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說的是。」
verses.e: Pilate asked him , " Are you the King of the Jews ? " He answered him , " So you say . "

verses.z: 那時，人要向大山說：倒在我們身上！向小山說：遮蓋我們！
verses.e: Then they will begin to tell the mountains , ' Fall on us ! ' and tell the hills , ' Cover us . '

verses.z: 「這些事既行在有汁水的樹上，那枯乾的樹將來怎麼樣呢？」
verses.e: For if they do these things in the green tree , what will be done in the dry ? "

verses.z: 又有兩個犯人，和耶穌一同帶來處死。
verses.e: There were also others , two criminals , led with him to be put to death .

verses.z: 到了一個地方，名叫「髑髏地」，就在那裏把耶穌釘在十字架上，又釘了兩個犯人：一個在左邊，一個在右邊。
verses.e: When they came to the place that is called " The Skull " , they crucified him there with the criminals , one on the right and the other on the left .

verses.z: 當下耶穌說：「父啊！赦免他們；因為他們所做的，他們不曉得。」[兵丁]就拈鬮分他的衣服。
verses.e: Jesus said , " Father , forgive them , for they don't know what they are doing . " Dividing his garments among them , they cast lots .

verses.z: 百姓站在那裏觀看。官府也嗤笑他，說：「他救了別人；他若是基督，上帝所揀選的，可以救自己吧！」
verses.e: The people stood watching . The rulers with them also scoffed at him , saying , " He saved others . Let him save himself , if this is the Christ of God , his chosen one ! "

verses.z: 兵丁也戲弄他，上前拿醋送給他喝，
verses.e: The soldiers also mocked him , coming to him and offering him vinegar ,

verses.z: 說：「你若是猶太人的王，可以救自己吧！」
verses.e: and saying , " If you are the King of the Jews , save yourself ! "

verses.z: 在耶穌以上有一個牌子寫着：「這是猶太人的王。」
verses.e: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek , Latin , and Hebrew : " THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS . "

verses.z: 那同釘的兩個犯人有一個譏笑他，說：「你不是基督嗎？可以救自己和我們吧！」
verses.e: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him , saying , " If you are the Christ , save yourself and us ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多對祭司長和眾人說：「我查不出這人有甚麼罪來。」
verses.e: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes , " I find no basis for a charge against this man . "

verses.z: 那一個就應聲責備他，說：「你既是一樣受刑的，還不怕上帝嗎？
verses.e: But the other answered , and rebuking him said , " Don't you even fear God , seeing you are under the same condemnation ?

verses.z: 我們是應該的，因我們所受的與我們所做的相稱，但這個人沒有做過一件不好的事。」
verses.e: And we indeed justly , for we receive the due reward for our deeds , but this man has done nothing wrong . "

verses.z: 就說：「耶穌啊，你得國降臨的時候，求你記念我！」
verses.e: He said to Jesus , " Lord , remember me when you come into your Kingdom . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「我實在告訴你，今日你要同我在樂園裏了。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Assuredly I tell you , today you will be with me in Paradise . "

verses.z: 那時約有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，
verses.e: It was now about the sixth hour , and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour .

verses.z: 日頭變黑了；殿裏的幔子從當中裂為兩半。
verses.e: The sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was torn in two .

verses.z: 耶穌大聲喊着說：「父啊！我將我的靈魂交在你手裏。」說了這話，氣就斷了。
verses.e: Jesus , crying with a loud voice , said , " Father , into your hands I commit my spirit ! " Having said this , he breathed his last .

verses.z: 百夫長看見所成的事，就歸榮耀與上帝，說：「這真是個義人！」
verses.e: When the centurion saw what was done , he glorified God , saying , " Certainly this was a righteous man . "

verses.z: 聚集觀看的眾人見了這所成的事都捶着胸回去了。
verses.e: All the multitudes that came together to see this , when they saw the things that were done , returned home beating their chests .

verses.z: 還有一切與耶穌熟識的人，和從加利利跟着他來的婦女們，都遠遠地站着看這些事。
verses.e: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance , watching these things .

verses.z: 但他們越發極力地說：「他煽惑百姓，在猶太遍地傳道，從加利利起，直到這裏了。」
verses.e: But they insisted , saying , " He stirs up the people , teaching throughout all Judea , beginning from Galilee even to this place . "

verses.z: 有一個人名叫約瑟，是個議士，為人善良公義；
verses.e: Behold , there was a man named Joseph , who was a member of the council , a good and righteous man

verses.z: 眾人所謀所為，他並沒有附從。他本是猶太、亞利馬太城裏素常盼望上帝國的人。
verses.e: ( he had not consented to their counsel and deed ) , from Arimathaea , a city of the Jews , who was also waiting for God's Kingdom .

verses.z: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體，
verses.e: This man went to Pilate , and asked for Jesus ' body .

verses.z: 就取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在石頭鑿成的墳墓裏；那裏頭從來沒有葬過人。
verses.e: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth , and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone , where no one had ever been laid .

verses.z: 那日是預備日，安息日也快到了。
verses.e: It was the day of the Preparation , and the Sabbath was drawing near .

verses.z: 那些從加利利和耶穌同來的婦女跟在後面，看見了墳墓和他的身體怎樣安放。
verses.e: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after , and saw the tomb and how his body was laid .

verses.z: 她們就回去，預備了香料香膏。她們在安息日，便遵着誡命安息了。
verses.e: They returned and prepared spices and ointments . On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment .

verses.z: 彼拉多一聽見，就問：「這人是加利利人嗎？」
verses.e: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned , he asked if the man was a Galilean .

verses.z: 既曉得耶穌屬希律所管，就把他送到希律那裏去。那時希律正在耶路撒冷。
verses.e: When he found out that he was in Herod's jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who was also in Jerusalem during those days .

verses.z: 希律看見耶穌，就很歡喜；因為聽見過他的事，久已想要見他，並且指望看他行一件神蹟，
verses.e: Now when Herod saw Jesus , he was exceedingly glad , for he had wanted to see him for a long time , because he had heard many things about him . He hoped to see some miracle done by him .

verses.z: 於是問他許多的話，耶穌卻一言不答。
verses.e: He questioned him with many words , but he gave no answers .

verses.z: 七日的頭一日，黎明的時候，那些婦女帶着所預備的香料來到墳墓前，
verses.e: But on the first day of the week , at early dawn , they and some others came to the tomb , bringing the spices which they had prepared .

verses.z: 那告訴使徒的就是抹大拉的馬利亞和約亞拿，並雅各的母親馬利亞，還有與她們在一處的婦女。
verses.e: Now they were Mary Magdalene , Joanna , and Mary the mother of James . The other women with them told these things to the apostles .

verses.z: 她們這些話，使徒以為是胡言，就不相信。
verses.e: These words seemed to them to be nonsense , and they didn't believe them .

verses.z: 彼得起來，跑到墳墓前，低頭往裏看，見細麻布獨在一處，就回去了，心裏希奇所成的事。
verses.e: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb . Stooping and looking in , he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves , and he departed to his home , wondering what had happened .

verses.z: 正當那日，門徒中有兩個人往一個村子去；這村子名叫以馬忤斯，離耶路撒冷約有二十五里。
verses.e: Behold , two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus , which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他們彼此談論所遇見的這一切事。
verses.e: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened .

verses.z: 正談論相問的時候，耶穌親自就近他們，和他們同行；
verses.e: While they talked and questioned together , Jesus himself came near , and went with them .

verses.z: 只是他們的眼睛迷糊了，不認識他。
verses.e: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們走路彼此談論的是甚麼事呢？」他們就站住，臉上帶着愁容。
verses.e: He said to them , " What are you talking about as you walk , and are sad ? "

verses.z: 二人中有一個名叫革流巴的回答說：「你在耶路撒冷作客，還不知道這幾天在那裏所出的事嗎？」
verses.e: One of them , named Cleopas , answered him , " Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn't know the things which have happened there in these days ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「甚麼事呢？」他們說：「就是拿撒勒人耶穌的事。他是個先知，在上帝和眾百姓面前，說話行事都有大能。
verses.e: He said to them , " What things ? " They said to him , " The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene , who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people ;

verses.z: 看見石頭已經從墳墓滾開了，
verses.e: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb .

verses.z: 祭司長和我們的官府竟把他解去，定了死罪，釘在十字架上。
verses.e: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death , and crucified him .

verses.z: 但我們素來所盼望、要贖以色列民的就是他！不但如此，而且這事成就，現在已經三天了。
verses.e: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel . Yes , and besides all this , it is now the third day since these things happened .

verses.z: 再者，我們中間有幾個婦女使我們驚奇；她們清早到了墳墓那裏，
verses.e: Also , certain women of our company amazed us , having arrived early at the tomb ;

verses.z: 不見他的身體，就回來告訴我們，說看見了天使顯現，說他活了。
verses.e: and when they didn't find his body , they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels , who said that he was alive .

verses.z: 又有我們的幾個人往墳墓那裏去，所遇見的正如婦女們所說的，只是沒有看見他。」
verses.e: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said , but they didn't see him . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「無知的人哪，先知所說的一切話，你們的心信得太遲鈍了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Foolish people , and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken !

verses.z: 基督這樣受害，又進入他的榮耀，豈不是應當的嗎？」
verses.e: Didn't the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory ? "

verses.z: 於是從摩西和眾先知起，凡經上所指着自己的話都給他們講解明白了。
verses.e: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets , he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself .

verses.z: 將近他們所去的村子，耶穌好像還要往前行，
verses.e: They came near to the village where they were going , and he acted like he would go further .

verses.z: 他們卻強留他，說：「時候晚了，日頭已經平西了，請你同我們住下吧！」耶穌就進去，要同他們住下。
verses.e: They urged him , saying , " Stay with us , for it is almost evening , and the day is almost over . " He went in to stay with them .

verses.z: 她們就進去，只是不見主耶穌的身體。
verses.e: They entered in , and didn't find the Lord Jesus ' body .

verses.z: 到了坐席的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，擘開，遞給他們。
verses.e: When he had sat down at the table with them , he took the bread and gave thanks . Breaking it , he gave it to them .

verses.z: 他們的眼睛明亮了，這才認出他來。忽然耶穌不見了。
verses.e: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him ; then he vanished out of their sight .

verses.z: 他們彼此說：「在路上，他和我們說話，給我們講解聖經的時候，我們的心豈不是火熱的嗎？」
verses.e: They said to one another , " Weren't our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way , and while he opened the Scriptures to us ? "

verses.z: 他們就立時起身，回耶路撒冷去，正遇見十一個使徒和他們的同人聚集在一處，
verses.e: They rose up that very hour , returned to Jerusalem , and found the eleven gathered together , and those who were with them ,

verses.z: 說：「主果然復活，已經現給西門看了。」
verses.e: saying , " The Lord is risen indeed , and has appeared to Simon ! "

verses.z: 兩個人就把路上[所遇見]，和擘餅的時候怎麼被他們認出來的事，都述說了一遍。
verses.e: They related the things that happened along the way , and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread .

verses.z: 正說這話的時候，耶穌親自站在他們當中，說：「願你們平安！」
verses.e: As they said these things , Jesus himself stood among them , and said to them , " Peace be to you . "

verses.z: 他們卻驚慌害怕，以為所看見的是魂。
verses.e: But they were terrified and filled with fear , and supposed that they had seen a spirit .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們為甚麼愁煩？為甚麼心裏起疑念呢？
verses.e: He said to them , " Why are you troubled ? Why do doubts arise in your hearts ?

verses.z: 你們看我的手，我的腳，就[知道]實在是我了。摸我看看！魂無骨無肉，你們看，我是有的。」
verses.e: See my hands and my feet , that it is truly me . Touch me and see , for a spirit doesn't have flesh and bones , as you see that I have . "

verses.z: 正在猜疑之間，忽然有兩個人站在旁邊，衣服放光。
verses.e: While they were greatly perplexed about this , behold , two men stood by them in dazzling clothing .

verses.z: 說了這話，就把手和腳給他們看。
verses.e: When he had said this , he showed them his hands and his feet .

verses.z: 他們正喜得不敢信，並且希奇；耶穌就說：「你們這裏有甚麼吃的沒有？」
verses.e: While they still didn't believe for joy , and wondered , he said to them , " Do you have anything here to eat ? "

verses.z: 他們便給他一片燒魚。
verses.e: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb .

verses.z: 他接過來，在他們面前吃了。
verses.e: He took them , and ate in front of them .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「這就是我從前與你們同在之時所告訴你們的話說：摩西的律法、先知的書，和詩篇上所記的，凡指着我的話都必須應驗。」
verses.e: He said to them , " This is what I told you while I was still with you , that all things which are written in the law of Moses , the prophets , and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled . "

verses.z: 於是耶穌開他們的心竅，使他們能明白聖經，
verses.e: Then he opened their minds , that they might understand the Scriptures .

verses.z: 又對他們說：「照[經上]所寫的，基督必受害，第三日從死裏復活，
verses.e: He said to them , " Thus it is written , and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day ,

verses.z: 並且人要奉他的名傳悔改、赦罪的道，從耶路撒冷起直傳到萬邦。
verses.e: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations , beginning at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 你們就是這些事的見證。
verses.e: You are witnesses of these things .

verses.z: 我要將我父所應許的降在你們身上，你們要在城裏等候，直到你們領受從上頭來的能力。」
verses.e: Behold , I send out the promise of my Father on you . But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high . "

verses.z: 婦女們驚怕，將臉伏地。那兩個人就對她們說：「為甚麼在死人中找活人呢？
verses.e: Becoming terrified , they bowed their faces down to the earth . The men said to them , " Why do you seek the living among the dead ?

verses.z: 耶穌領他們到伯大尼的對面，就舉手給他們祝福。
verses.e: He led them out as far as Bethany , and he lifted up his hands and blessed them .

verses.z: 正祝福的時候，他就離開他們，被帶到天上去了。
verses.e: While he blessed them , he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven .

verses.z: 他們就拜他，大大地歡喜，回耶路撒冷去，
verses.e: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy ,

verses.z: 常在殿裏稱頌上帝。
verses.e: and were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .

verses.z: 他不在這裏，已經復活了。當記念他還在加利利的時候怎樣告訴你們，
verses.e: He isn't here , but is risen . Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee ,

verses.z: 說：『人子必須被交在罪人手裏，釘在十字架上，第三日復活。』」
verses.e: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified , and the third day rise again ? "

verses.z: 她們就想起耶穌的話來，
verses.e: They remembered his words ,

verses.z: 便從墳墓那裏回去，把這一切的事告訴十一個使徒和其餘的人。
verses.e: returned from the tomb , and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest .

verses.z: 凱撒提庇留在位第十五年，本丟‧彼拉多作猶太巡撫，希律作加利利分封的王，他兄弟腓力作以土利亞和特拉可尼地方分封的王，呂撒聶作亞比利尼分封的王，
verses.e: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis , and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene ,

verses.z: 眾人問他說：「這樣，我們當做甚麼呢？」
verses.e: The multitudes asked him , " What then must we do ? "

verses.z: 約翰回答說：「有兩件衣裳的，就分給那沒有的；有食物的，也當這樣行。」
verses.e: He answered them , " He who has two coats , let him give to him who has none . He who has food , let him do likewise . "

verses.z: 又有稅吏來要受洗，問他說：「夫子，我們當做甚麼呢？」
verses.e: Tax collectors also came to be baptized , and they said to him , " Teacher , what must we do ? "

verses.z: 約翰說：「除了例定的數目，不要多取。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Collect no more than that which is appointed to you . "

verses.z: 又有兵丁問他說：「我們當做甚麼呢？」約翰說：「不要以強暴待人，也不要訛詐人，自己有錢糧就當知足。」
verses.e: Soldiers also asked him , saying , " What about us ? What must we do ? " He said to them , " Extort from no one by violence , neither accuse anyone wrongfully . Be content with your wages . "

verses.z: 百姓指望[基督來]的時候，人都心裏猜疑，或者約翰是基督。
verses.e: As the people were in expectation , and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John , whether perhaps he was the Christ ,

verses.z: 約翰說：「我是用水給你們施洗，但有一位能力比我更大的要來，我就是給他解鞋帶也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。
verses.e: John answered them all , " I indeed baptize you with water , but he comes who is mightier than I , the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen . He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire .

verses.z: 他手裏拿着簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裏，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。」
verses.e: His winnowing fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor , and will gather the wheat into his barn ; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire . "

verses.z: 約翰又用許多別的話勸百姓，向他們傳福音。
verses.e: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people ,

verses.z: 只是分封的王希律，因他兄弟之妻希羅底的緣故，並因他所行的一切惡事，受了約翰的責備；
verses.e: but Herod the tetrarch , being reproved by him for Herodias , his brother's wife , and for all the evil things which Herod had done ,

verses.z: 亞那和該亞法作大祭司。那時，撒迦利亞的兒子約翰在曠野裏，上帝的話臨到他。
verses.e: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas , the word of God came to John , the son of Zacharias , in the wilderness .

verses.z: 又另外添了一件，就是把約翰收在監裏。
verses.e: added this also to them all , that he shut up John in prison .

verses.z: 眾百姓都受了洗，耶穌也受了洗。正禱告的時候，天就開了，
verses.e: Now when all the people were baptized , Jesus also had been baptized and was praying . The sky was opened ,

verses.z: 聖靈降臨在他身上，形狀彷彿鴿子；又有聲音從天上來，說：「你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。」
verses.e: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him ; and a voice came out of the sky , saying " You are my beloved Son . In you I am well pleased . "

verses.z: 耶穌開頭[傳道]，年紀約有三十歲。依人看來，他是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是希里的兒子；
verses.e: Jesus himself , when he began to teach , was about thirty years old , being the son ( as was supposed ) of Joseph , the son of Heli ,

verses.z: 希里是瑪塔的兒子；瑪塔是利未的兒子；利未是麥基的兒子；麥基是雅拿的兒子；雅拿是約瑟的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Matthat , the son of Levi , the son of Melchi , the son of Jannai , the son of Joseph ,

verses.z: 約瑟是瑪他提亞的兒子；瑪他提亞是亞摩斯的兒子；亞摩斯是拿鴻的兒子；拿鴻是以斯利的兒子；以斯利是拿該的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Mattathias , the son of Amos , the son of Nahum , the son of Esli , the son of Naggai ,

verses.z: 拿該是瑪押的兒子；瑪押是瑪他提亞的兒子；瑪他提亞是西美的兒子；西美是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是猶大的兒子；猶大是約亞拿的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Maath , the son of Mattathias , the son of Semein , the son of Joseph , the son of Judah ,

verses.z: 約亞拿是利撒的兒子；利撒是所羅巴伯的兒子；所羅巴伯是撒拉鐵的兒子；撒拉鐵是尼利的兒子；尼利是麥基的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Joanan , the son of Rhesa , the son of Zerubbabel , the son of Shealtiel , the son of Neri ,

verses.z: 麥基是亞底的兒子；亞底是哥桑的兒子；哥桑是以摩當的兒子；以摩當是珥的兒子；珥是約細的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Melchi , the son of Addi , the son of Cosam , the son of Elmodam , the son of Er ,

verses.z: 約細是以利以謝的兒子；以利以謝是約令的兒子；約令是瑪塔的兒子；瑪塔是利未的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Jose , the son of Eliezer , the son of Jorim , the son of Matthat , the son of Levi ,

verses.z: 他就來到約旦河一帶地方，宣講悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
verses.e: He came into all the region around the Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins .

verses.z: 利未是西緬的兒子；西緬是猶大的兒子；猶大是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是約南的兒子；約南是以利亞敬的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Simeon , the son of Judah , the son of Joseph , the son of Jonan , the son of Eliakim ,

verses.z: 以利亞敬是米利亞的兒子；米利亞是買南的兒子；買南是瑪達他的兒子；瑪達他是拿單的兒子；拿單是大衛的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Melea , the son of Menan , the son of Mattatha , the son of Nathan , the son of David ,

verses.z: 大衛是耶西的兒子；耶西是俄備得的兒子；俄備得是波阿斯的兒子；波阿斯是撒門的兒子；撒門是拿順的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Jesse , the son of Obed , the son of Boaz , the son of Salmon , the son of Nahshon ,

verses.z: 拿順是亞米拿達的兒子；亞米拿達是亞蘭的兒子；亞蘭是希斯崙的兒子；希斯崙是法勒斯的兒子；法勒斯是猶大的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Amminadab , the son of Aram , the son of Hezron , the son of Perez , the son of Judah ,

verses.z: 猶大是雅各的兒子；雅各是以撒的兒子；以撒是亞伯拉罕的兒子；亞伯拉罕是他拉的兒子；他拉是拿鶴的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Jacob , the son of Isaac , the son of Abraham , the son of Terah , the son of Nahor ,

verses.z: 拿鶴是西鹿的兒子；西鹿是拉吳的兒子；拉吳是法勒的兒子；法勒是希伯的兒子；希伯是沙拉的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Serug , the son of Reu , the son of Peleg , the son of Eber , the son of Shelah ,

verses.z: 沙拉是該南的兒子；該南是亞法撒的兒子；亞法撒是閃的兒子；閃是挪亞的兒子；挪亞是拉麥的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Cainan , the son of Arphaxad , the son of Shem , the son of Noah , the son of Lamech ,

verses.z: 拉麥是瑪土撒拉的兒子；瑪土撒拉是以諾的兒子；以諾是雅列的兒子；雅列是瑪勒列的兒子；瑪勒列是該南的兒子；該南是以挪士的兒子；
verses.e: the son of Methuselah , the son of Enoch , the son of Jared , the son of Mahalaleel , the son of Cainan ,

verses.z: 以挪士是塞特的兒子；塞特是亞當的兒子；亞當是上帝的兒子。
verses.e: the son of Enos , the son of Seth , the son of Adam , the son of God .

verses.z: 正如先知以賽亞書上所記的話，說：在曠野有人聲喊着說：預備主的道，修直他的路！
verses.e: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet , " The voice of one crying in the wilderness , ' Make ready the way of the Lord . Make his paths straight .

verses.z: 一切山窪都要填滿；大小山岡都要削平！彎彎曲曲的地方要改為正直；高高低低的道路要改為平坦！
verses.e: Every valley will be filled . Every mountain and hill will be brought low . The crooked will become straight , and the rough ways smooth .

verses.z: 凡有血氣的，都要見上帝的救恩！
verses.e: All flesh will see God's salvation . ' "

verses.z: 約翰對那出來要受他洗的眾人說：「毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？
verses.e: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him , " You offspring of vipers , who warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?

verses.z: 你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。不要自己心裏說：『有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。』我告訴你們，上帝能從這些石頭中，給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。
verses.e: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance , and don't begin to say among yourselves , ' We have Abraham for our father ; ' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones !

verses.z: 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。」
verses.e: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees . Every tree therefore that doesn't produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire . "

verses.z: 耶穌被聖靈充滿，從約旦河回來，聖靈將他引到曠野，
verses.e: Jesus , full of the Holy Spirit , returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

verses.z: 因為[經上]記着說：主要為你吩咐他的使者保護你；
verses.e: for it is written , ' He will put his angels in charge of you , to guard you ; '

verses.z: 他們要用手托着你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。」
verses.e: and , ' On their hands they will bear you up , lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone . ' "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「[經上]說：『不可試探主－你的上帝。』」
verses.e: Jesus answering , said to him , " It has been said , ' You shall not tempt the Lord your God . ' "

verses.z: 魔鬼用完了各樣的試探，就暫時離開耶穌。
verses.e: When the devil had completed every temptation , he departed from him until another time .

verses.z: 耶穌滿有聖靈的能力，回到加利利；他的名聲就傳遍了四方。
verses.e: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee , and news about him spread through all the surrounding area .

verses.z: 他在各會堂裏教訓人，眾人都稱讚他。
verses.e: He taught in their synagogues , being glorified by all .

verses.z: 耶穌來到拿撒勒，就是他長大的地方。在安息日，照他平常的規矩進了會堂，站起來要念[聖經]。
verses.e: He came to Nazareth , where he had been brought up . He entered , as was his custom , into the synagogue on the Sabbath day , and stood up to read .

verses.z: 有人把先知以賽亞的書交給他，他就打開，找到一處寫着說：
verses.e: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him . He opened the book , and found the place where it was written ,

verses.z: 主的靈在我身上，因為他用膏膏我，叫我傳福音給貧窮的人；差遣我報告：被擄的得釋放，瞎眼的得看見，叫那受壓制的得自由，
verses.e: " The Spirit of the Lord is on me , because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor . He has sent me to heal the broken hearted , to proclaim release to the captives , recovering of sight to the blind , to deliver those who are crushed ,

verses.z: 報告上帝悅納人的禧年。
verses.e: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord . "

verses.z: 四十天受魔鬼的試探。那些日子沒有吃甚麼；日子滿了，他就餓了。
verses.e: for forty days , being tempted by the devil . He ate nothing in those days . Afterward , when they were completed , he was hungry .

verses.z: 於是把書捲起來，交還執事，就坐下。會堂裏的人都定睛看他。
verses.e: He closed the book , gave it back to the attendant , and sat down . The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「今天這經應驗在你們耳中了。」
verses.e: He began to tell them , " Today , this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing . "

verses.z: 眾人都稱讚他，並希奇他口中所出的恩言；又說：「這不是約瑟的兒子嗎？」
verses.e: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth ; and they said , " Isn't this Joseph's son ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們必引這俗語向我說：『醫生，你醫治自己吧！我們聽見你在迦百農所行的事，也當行在你自己家鄉裏』」；
verses.e: He said to them , " Doubtless you will tell me this proverb , ' Physician , heal yourself ! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum , do also here in your hometown . ' "

verses.z: 又說：「我實在告訴你們，沒有先知在自己家鄉被人悅納的。
verses.e: He said , " Most certainly I tell you , no prophet is acceptable in his hometown .

verses.z: 我對你們說實話，當以利亞的時候，天閉塞了三年零六個月，遍地有大饑荒，那時，以色列中有許多寡婦，
verses.e: But truly I tell you , there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah , when the sky was shut up three years and six months , when a great famine came over all the land .

verses.z: 以利亞並沒有奉差往她們一個人那裏去，只奉差往西頓的撒勒法一個寡婦那裏去。
verses.e: Elijah was sent to none of them , except to Zarephath , in the land of Sidon , to a woman who was a widow .

verses.z: 先知以利沙的時候，以色列中有許多長大痲瘋的，但內中除了敘利亞國的乃縵，沒有一個得潔淨的。」
verses.e: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet , yet not one of them was cleansed , except Naaman , the Syrian . "

verses.z: 會堂裏的人聽見這話，都怒氣滿胸，
verses.e: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things .

verses.z: 就起來攆他出城（他們的城造在山上）；他們帶他到山崖，要把他推下去。
verses.e: They rose up , threw him out of the city , and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on , that they might throw him off the cliff .

verses.z: 魔鬼對他說：「你若是上帝的兒子，可以吩咐這塊石頭變成食物。」
verses.e: The devil said to him , " If you are the Son of God , command this stone to become bread . "

verses.z: 他卻從他們中間直行，過去了。
verses.e: But he , passing through the middle of them , went his way .

verses.z: 耶穌下到迦百農，就是加利利的一座城，在安息日教訓眾人。
verses.e: He came down to Capernaum , a city of Galilee . He was teaching them on the Sabbath day ,

verses.z: 他們很希奇他的教訓，因為他的話裏有權柄。
verses.e: and they were astonished at his teaching , for his word was with authority .

verses.z: 在會堂裏有一個人，被污鬼的精氣附着，大聲喊叫說：
verses.e: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon ; and he cried out with a loud voice ,

verses.z: 「唉！拿撒勒的耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，乃是上帝的聖者。」
verses.e: saying , " Ah ! what have we to do with you , Jesus of Nazareth ? Have you come to destroy us ? I know who you are : the Holy One of God ! "

verses.z: 耶穌責備他說：「不要作聲，從這人身上出來吧！」鬼把那人摔倒在眾人中間，就出來了，卻也沒有害他。
verses.e: Jesus rebuked him , saying , " Be silent and come out of him ! " When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them , he came out of him , having done him no harm .

verses.z: 眾人都驚訝，彼此對問說：「這是甚麼道理呢？因為他用權柄能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼就出來。」
verses.e: Amazement came on all and they spoke together , one with another , saying , " What is this word ? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits , and they come out ! "

verses.z: 於是耶穌的名聲傳遍了周圍地方。
verses.e: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region .

verses.z: 耶穌出了會堂，進了西門的家。西門的岳母害熱病甚重，有人為她求耶穌。
verses.e: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon's house . Simon's mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever , and they begged him to help her .

verses.z: 耶穌站在她旁邊，斥責那熱病，熱就退了。她立刻起來服事他們。
verses.e: He stood over her and rebuked the fever , and it left her . Immediately she rose up and served them .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「[經上]記着說：『人活着不是單靠食物，[乃是靠上帝口裏所出的一切話]。』」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , saying , " It is written , ' Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word of God . ' "

verses.z: 日落的時候，凡有病人的，不論害甚麼病，都帶到耶穌那裏。耶穌按手在他們各人身上，醫好他們。
verses.e: When the sun was setting , all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him ; and he laid his hands on every one of them , and healed them .

verses.z: 又有鬼從好些人身上出來，喊着說：「你是上帝的兒子。」耶穌斥責他們，不許他們說話，因為他們知道他是基督。
verses.e: Demons also came out of many , crying out and saying , " You are the Christ , the Son of God ! " Rebuking them , he didn't allow them to speak , because they knew that he was the Christ .

verses.z: 天亮的時候，耶穌出來，走到曠野地方。眾人去找他，到了他那裏，要留住他，不要他離開他們。
verses.e: When it was day , he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him , and came to him , and held on to him , so that he wouldn't go away from them .

verses.z: 但耶穌對他們說：「我也必須在別城傳上帝國的福音，因我奉差原是為此。」
verses.e: But he said to them , " I must preach the good news of God's Kingdom to the other cities also . For this reason I have been sent . "

verses.z: 於是耶穌在加利利的各會堂傳道。
verses.e: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee .

verses.z: 魔鬼又領他上了[高山]，霎時間把天下的萬國都指給他看，
verses.e: The devil , leading him up on a high mountain , showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time .

verses.z: 對他說：「這一切權柄、榮華，我都要給你，因為這原是交付我的，我願意給誰就給誰。
verses.e: The devil said to him , " I will give you all this authority and their glory , for it has been delivered to me , and I give it to whomever I want .

verses.z: 你若在我面前下拜，這都要歸你。」
verses.e: If you therefore will worship before me , it will all be yours . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「[經上]記着說：當拜主－你的上帝，單要事奉他。」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Get behind me , Satan ! For it is written , ' You shall worship the Lord your God , and you shall serve him only . ' "

verses.z: 魔鬼又領他到耶路撒冷去，叫他站在殿頂上，對他說：「你若是上帝的兒子，可以從這裏跳下去；
verses.e: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple , and said to him , " If you are the Son of God , cast yourself down from here ,

verses.z: 耶穌站在革尼撒勒湖邊，眾人擁擠他，要聽上帝的道。
verses.e: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God , he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret .

verses.z: 他的夥伴西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰，也是這樣。耶穌對西門說：「不要怕！從今以後，你要得人了。」
verses.e: and so also were James and John , sons of Zebedee , who were partners with Simon . Jesus said to Simon , " Don't be afraid . From now on you will be catching people alive . "

verses.z: 他們把兩隻船攏了岸，就撇下所有的，跟從了耶穌。
verses.e: When they had brought their boats to land , they left everything , and followed him .

verses.z: 有一回，耶穌在一個城裏，有人滿身長了大痲瘋，看見他，就俯伏在地，求他說：「主若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
verses.e: While he was in one of the cities , behold , there was a man full of leprosy . When he saw Jesus , he fell on his face and begged him , saying , " Lord , if you want to , you can make me clean . "

verses.z: 耶穌伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」大痲瘋立刻就離了他的身。
verses.e: He stretched out his hand and touched him , saying , " I want to . Be made clean . " Immediately the leprosy left him .

verses.z: 耶穌囑咐他：「你切不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又要為你得了潔淨，照摩西所吩咐的獻上[禮物]，對眾人作證據。」
verses.e: He commanded him to tell no one , " But go your way and show yourself to the priest , and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded , for a testimony to them . "

verses.z: 但耶穌的名聲越發傳揚出去。有極多的人聚集來聽道，也指望醫治他們的病。
verses.e: But the report concerning him spread much more , and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities .

verses.z: 耶穌卻退到曠野去禱告。
verses.e: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed .

verses.z: 有一天，耶穌教訓人，有法利賽人和教法師在旁邊坐着；他們是從加利利各鄉村和猶太並耶路撒冷來的。主的能力與耶穌同在，使他能醫治病人。
verses.e: On one of those days , he was teaching ; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee , Judea , and Jerusalem . The power of the Lord was with him to heal them .

verses.z: 有人用褥子抬着一個癱子，要抬進去放在耶穌面前，
verses.e: Behold , men brought a paralyzed man on a cot , and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus .

verses.z: 卻因人多，尋不出法子抬進去，就上了房頂，從瓦間把他連褥子縋到當中，正在耶穌面前。
verses.e: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude , they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus .

verses.z: 他見有兩隻船灣在湖邊；打魚的人卻離開船洗網去了。
verses.e: He saw two boats standing by the lake , but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets .

verses.z: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：「你的罪赦了。」
verses.e: Seeing their faith , he said to him , " Man , your sins are forgiven you . "

verses.z: 文士和法利賽人就議論說：「這說僭妄話的是誰？除了上帝以外，誰能赦罪呢？」
verses.e: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , " Who is this who speaks blasphemies ? Who can forgive sins , but God alone ? "

verses.z: 耶穌知道他們所議論的，就說：「你們心裏議論的是甚麼呢？
verses.e: But Jesus , perceiving their thoughts , answered them , " Why are you reasoning so in your hearts ?

verses.z: 或說『你的罪赦了』，或說『你起來行走』，哪一樣容易呢？
verses.e: Which is easier to say , ' Your sins are forgiven you , ' or to say , ' Arise and walk ' ?

verses.z: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄。」就對癱子說：「我吩咐你，起來，拿你的褥子回家去吧！」
verses.e: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins , " he said to the paralyzed man , " I tell you , arise , take up your cot , and go to your house . "

verses.z: 那人當眾人面前立刻起來，拿着他所躺臥的[褥子]回家去，歸榮耀與上帝。
verses.e: Immediately he rose up before them , and took up that which he was laying on , and departed to his house , glorifying God .

verses.z: 眾人都驚奇，也歸榮耀與上帝，並且滿心懼怕，說：「我們今日看見非常的事了。」
verses.e: Amazement took hold on all , and they glorified God . They were filled with fear , saying , " We have seen strange things today . "

verses.z: 這事以後，耶穌出去，看見一個稅吏，名叫利未，坐在稅關上，就對他說：「你跟從我來。」
verses.e: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office , and said to him , " Follow me ! "

verses.z: 他就撇下所有的，起來，跟從了耶穌。
verses.e: He left everything , and rose up and followed him .

verses.z: 利未在自己家裏為耶穌大擺筵席，有許多稅吏和別人與他們一同坐席。
verses.e: Levi made a great feast for him in his house . There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them .

verses.z: 有一隻船是西門的，耶穌就上去，請他把船撐開，稍微離岸，就坐下，從船上教訓眾人。
verses.e: He entered into one of the boats , which was Simon's , and asked him to put out a little from the land . He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat .

verses.z: 法利賽人和文士就向耶穌的門徒發怨言說：「你們為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同吃喝呢？」
verses.e: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples , saying , " Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「無病的人用不着醫生；有病的人才用得着。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Those who are healthy have no need for a physician , but those who are sick do .

verses.z: 我來本不是召義人悔改，乃是召罪人悔改。」
verses.e: I have not come to call the righteous , but sinners , to repentance . "

verses.z: 他們說：「約翰的門徒屢次禁食祈禱，法利賽人的[門徒]也是這樣；惟獨你的門徒又吃又喝。」
verses.e: They said to him , " Why do John's disciples often fast and pray , likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees , but yours eat and drink ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，豈能叫陪伴之人禁食呢？
verses.e: He said to them , " Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them ?

verses.z: 但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那日他們就要禁食了。」
verses.e: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them . Then they will fast in those days . "

verses.z: 耶穌又設一個比喻，對他們說：「沒有人把新衣服撕下一塊來補在舊衣服上；若是這樣，就把新的撕破了，並且所撕下來的那塊新的和舊的也不相稱。
verses.e: He also told a parable to them . " No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment , or else he will tear the new , and also the piece from the new will not match the old .

verses.z: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裏；若是這樣，新酒必將皮袋裂開，酒便漏出來，皮袋也就壞了。
verses.e: No one puts new wine into old wineskins , or else the new wine will burst the skins , and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed .

verses.z: 但新酒必須裝在新皮袋裏。
verses.e: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins , and both are preserved .

verses.z: 沒有人喝了陳酒又想喝新的；他總說陳的好。」
verses.e: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new , for he says , ' The old is better . ' "

verses.z: 講完了，對西門說：「把船開到水深之處，下網打魚。」
verses.e: When he had finished speaking , he said to Simon , " Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch . "

verses.z: 西門說：「夫子，我們整夜勞力，並沒有打着甚麼。但依從你的話，我就下網。」
verses.e: Simon answered him , " Master , we worked all night and caught nothing ; but at your word I will let down the net . "

verses.z: 他們下了網，就圈住許多魚，網險些裂開，
verses.e: When they had done this , they caught a great multitude of fish , and their net was breaking .

verses.z: 便招呼那隻船上的同伴來幫助。他們就來，把魚裝滿了兩隻船，甚至船要沉下去。
verses.e: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat , that they should come and help them . They came and filled both boats , so that they began to sink .

verses.z: 西門‧彼得看見，就俯伏在耶穌膝前，說：「主啊，離開我，我是個罪人！」
verses.e: But Simon Peter , when he saw it , fell down at Jesus ' knees , saying , " Depart from me , for I am a sinful man , Lord . "

verses.z: 他和一切同在的人都驚訝這一網所打的魚。
verses.e: For he was amazed , and all who were with him , at the catch of fish which they had caught ;

verses.z: 有一個安息日，耶穌從麥地經過。他的門徒掐了麥穗，用手搓着吃。
verses.e: Now on the second Sabbath after the first , he was going through the grain fields . His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate , rubbing them in their hands .

verses.z: 他就周圍看着他們眾人，對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原。
verses.e: He looked around at them all , and said to the man , " Stretch out your hand . " He did , and his hand was restored as sound as the other .

verses.z: 他們就滿心大怒，彼此商議怎樣處治耶穌。
verses.e: But they were filled with rage , and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus .

verses.z: 那時，耶穌出去，上山禱告，整夜禱告上帝；
verses.e: In these days , he went out to the mountain to pray , and he continued all night in prayer to God .

verses.z: 到了天亮，叫他的門徒來，就從他們中間挑選十二個人，稱他們為使徒。
verses.e: When it was day , he called his disciples , and from them he chose twelve , whom he also named apostles :

verses.z: [這十二個人]有西門（耶穌又給他起名叫彼得），還有他兄弟安得烈，又有雅各和約翰，腓力和巴多羅買，
verses.e: Simon , whom he also named Peter ; Andrew , his brother ; James ; John ; Philip ; Bartholomew ;

verses.z: 馬太和多馬，亞勒腓的兒子雅各和奮銳黨的西門，
verses.e: Matthew ; Thomas ; James the son of Alphaeus ; Simon who was called the Zealot ;

verses.z: 雅各的兒子猶大，和賣主的加略人猶大。
verses.e: Judas the son of James ; and Judas Iscariot , who also became a traitor .

verses.z: 耶穌和他們下了山，站在一塊平地上；同站的有許多門徒，又有許多百姓，從猶太全地和耶路撒冷，並泰爾、西頓的海邊來，都要聽他[講道]，又指望醫治他們的病；
verses.e: He came down with them and stood on a level place , with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases ,

verses.z: 還有被污鬼纏磨的，也得了醫治。
verses.e: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits ; and they were being healed .

verses.z: 眾人都想要摸他；因為有能力從他身上發出來，醫好了他們。
verses.e: All the multitude sought to touch him , for power came out of him and healed them all .

verses.z: 有幾個法利賽人說：「你們為甚麼做安息日不可做的事呢？」
verses.e: But some of the Pharisees said to them , " Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day ? "

verses.z: 耶穌舉目看着門徒，說：你們貧窮的人有福了！因為上帝的國是你們的。
verses.e: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples , and said : " Blessed are you who are poor , for God's Kingdom is yours .

verses.z: 你們飢餓的人有福了！因為你們將要飽足。你們哀哭的人有福了！因為你們將要喜笑。
verses.e: Blessed are you who hunger now , for you will be filled . Blessed are you who weep now , for you will laugh .

verses.z: 「人為人子恨惡你們，拒絕你們，辱罵你們，棄掉你們的名，以為是惡，你們就有福了！
verses.e: Blessed are you when men hate you , and when they exclude and mock you , and throw out your name as evil , for the Son of Man's sake .

verses.z: 當那日，你們要[歡喜]跳躍，因為你們在天上的賞賜是大的。他們的祖宗待先知也是這樣。
verses.e: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy , for behold , your reward is great in heaven , for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets .

verses.z: 但你們富足的人有禍了！因為你們受過你們的安慰。
verses.e: " But woe to you who are rich ! For you have received your consolation .

verses.z: 你們飽足的人有禍了！因為你們將要飢餓。你們喜笑的人有禍了！因為你們將要哀慟哭泣。
verses.e: Woe to you , you who are full now , for you will be hungry . Woe to you who laugh now , for you will mourn and weep .

verses.z: 「人都說你們好的時候，你們就有禍了！因為他們的祖宗待假先知也是這樣。」
verses.e: Woe , when men speak well of you , for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets .

verses.z: 「只是我告訴你們這聽道的人，你們的仇敵，要愛他！恨你們的，要待他好！
verses.e: " But I tell you who hear : love your enemies , do good to those who hate you ,

verses.z: 咒詛你們的，要為他祝福！凌辱你們的，要為他禱告！
verses.e: bless those who curse you , and pray for those who mistreat you .

verses.z: 有人打你這邊的臉，連那邊的臉也由他打。有人奪你的外衣，連裏衣也由他拿去。
verses.e: To him who strikes you on the cheek , offer also the other ; and from him who takes away your cloak , don't withhold your coat also .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「[經上記着]大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所做的事，連這個你們也沒有念過嗎？
verses.e: Jesus , answering them , said , " Haven't you read what David did when he was hungry , he and those who were with him ,

verses.z: 凡求你的，就給他。有人奪你的東西去，不用再要回來。
verses.e: Give to everyone who asks you , and don't ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again .

verses.z: 你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人。
verses.e: " As you would like people to do to you , do exactly so to them .

verses.z: 你們若單愛那愛你們的人，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也愛那愛他們的人。
verses.e: " If you love those who love you , what credit is that to you ? For even sinners love those who love them .

verses.z: 你們若善待那善待你們的人，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也是這樣行。
verses.e: If you do good to those who do good to you , what credit is that to you ? For even sinners do the same .

verses.z: 你們若借給人，指望從他收回，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也借給罪人，要如數收回。
verses.e: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive , what credit is that to you ? Even sinners lend to sinners , to receive back as much .

verses.z: 你們倒要愛仇敵，也要善待他們，並要借給人不指望償還，你們的賞賜就必大了，你們也必作至高者的兒子，因為他恩待那忘恩的和作惡的。
verses.e: But love your enemies , and do good , and lend , expecting nothing back ; and your reward will be great , and you will be children of the Most High ; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil .

verses.z: 你們要慈悲，像你們的父慈悲一樣。」
verses.e: " Therefore be merciful , even as your Father is also merciful .

verses.z: 「你們不要論斷人，就不被論斷；你們不要定人的罪，就不被定罪；你們要饒恕人，就必蒙饒恕；
verses.e: Don't judge , and you won't be judged . Don't condemn , and you won't be condemned . Set free , and you will be set free .

verses.z: 你們要給人，就必有給你們的，並且用十足的升斗，連搖帶按，上尖下流地倒在你們懷裏；因為你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。」
verses.e: " Give , and it will be given to you : good measure , pressed down , shaken together , and running over , will be given to you . For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you . "

verses.z: 耶穌又用比喻對他們說：「瞎子豈能領瞎子，兩個人不是都要掉在坑裏嗎？
verses.e: He spoke a parable to them . " Can the blind guide the blind ? Won't they both fall into a pit ?

verses.z: 他怎麼進了上帝的殿，拿陳設餅吃，又給跟從的人吃？這餅除了祭司以外，別人都不可吃。」
verses.e: how he entered into God's house , and took and ate the show bread , and gave also to those who were with him , which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone ? "

verses.z: 學生不能高過先生；凡學成了的不過和先生一樣。
verses.e: A disciple is not above his teacher , but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher .

verses.z: 為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中有刺，卻不想自己眼中有樑木呢？
verses.e: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye , but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye ?

verses.z: 你不見自己眼中有樑木，怎能對你弟兄說：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？你這假冒為善的人！先去掉自己眼中的樑木，然後才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。」
verses.e: Or how can you tell your brother , ' Brother , let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye , ' when you yourself don't see the beam that is in your own eye ? You hypocrite ! First remove the beam from your own eye , and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye .

verses.z: 「因為，沒有好樹結壞果子，也沒有壞樹結好果子。
verses.e: " For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit , nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit .

verses.z: 凡樹木看果子，就可以認出它來。人不是從荊棘上摘無花果，也不是從蒺藜裏摘葡萄。
verses.e: For each tree is known by its own fruit . For people don't gather figs from thorns , nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush .

verses.z: 善人從他心裏所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他[心裏]所存的惡就發出惡來；因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。」
verses.e: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good , and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil , for out of the abundance of the heart , his mouth speaks .

verses.z: 「你們為甚麼稱呼我『主啊，主啊』卻不遵我的話行呢？
verses.e: " Why do you call me , ' Lord , Lord , ' and don't do the things which I say ?

verses.z: 凡到我這裏來，聽見我的話就去行的，我要告訴你們他像甚麼人：
verses.e: Everyone who comes to me , and hears my words and does them , I will show you who he is like .

verses.z: 他像一個人蓋房子，深深地挖地，把根基安在磐石上；到發大水的時候，水沖那房子，房子總不能搖動，因為根基立在磐石上。
verses.e: He is like a man building a house , who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock . When a flood arose , the stream broke against that house , and could not shake it , because it was founded on the rock .

verses.z: 惟有聽見不去行的，就像一個人在土地上蓋房子，沒有根基；水一沖，隨即倒塌了，並且那房子壞的很大。」
verses.e: But he who hears and doesn't do , is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation , against which the stream broke , and immediately it fell ; and the ruin of that house was great . "

verses.z: 又對他們說：「人子是安息日的主。」
verses.e: He said to them , " The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath . "

verses.z: 又有一個安息日，耶穌進了會堂教訓人，在那裏有一個人右手枯乾了。
verses.e: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught . There was a man there , and his right hand was withered .

verses.z: 文士和法利賽人窺探耶穌，在安息日治病不治病，要得把柄去告他。
verses.e: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him , to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath , that they might find an accusation against him .

verses.z: 耶穌卻知道他們的意念，就對那枯乾一隻手的人說：「起來！站在當中。」那人就起來，站着。
verses.e: But he knew their thoughts ; and he said to the man who had the withered hand , " Rise up and stand in the middle . " He arose and stood .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「我問你們，在安息日行善行惡，救命害命，哪樣是可以的呢？」
verses.e: Then Jesus said to them , " I will ask you something : Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good , or to do harm ? To save a life , or to kill ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對百姓講完了這一切的話，就進了迦百農。
verses.e: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people , he entered into Capernaum .

verses.z: 那託來的人回到百夫長家裏，看見僕人已經好了。
verses.e: Those who were sent , returning to the house , found that the servant who had been sick was well .

verses.z: 過了不多時，耶穌往一座城去，這城名叫拿因，他的門徒和極多的人與他同行。
verses.e: Soon afterwards , he went to a city called Nain . Many of his disciples , along with a great multitude , went with him .

verses.z: 將近城門，有一個死人被抬出來。這人是他母親獨生的兒子；他母親又是寡婦。有城裏的許多人同着寡婦送殯。
verses.e: Now when he came near to the gate of the city , behold , one who was dead was carried out , the only born son of his mother , and she was a widow . Many people of the city were with her .

verses.z: 主看見那寡婦，就憐憫她，對她說：「不要哭！」
verses.e: When the Lord saw her , he had compassion on her and said to her , " Don't cry . "

verses.z: 於是進前按着槓，抬的人就站住了。耶穌說：「少年人，我吩咐你，起來！」
verses.e: He came near and touched the coffin , and the bearers stood still . He said , " Young man , I tell you , arise ! "

verses.z: 那死人就坐起，並且說話。耶穌便把他交給他母親。
verses.e: He who was dead sat up and began to speak . Then he gave him to his mother .

verses.z: 眾人都驚奇，歸榮耀與上帝，說：「有大先知在我們中間興起來了！」又說：「上帝眷顧了他的百姓！」
verses.e: Fear took hold of all , and they glorified God , saying , " A great prophet has arisen among us ! " and , " God has visited his people ! "

verses.z: 他這事的風聲就傳遍了猶太和周圍地方。
verses.e: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region .

verses.z: 約翰的門徒把這些事都告訴約翰。
verses.e: The disciples of John told him about all these things .

verses.z: 他便叫了兩個門徒來，打發他們到主那裏去，說：「那將要來的是你嗎？還是我們等候別人呢？」
verses.e: John , calling to himself two of his disciples , sent them to Jesus , saying , " Are you the one who is coming , or should we look for another ? "

verses.z: 有一個百夫長所寶貴的僕人害病，快要死了。
verses.e: A certain centurion's servant , who was dear to him , was sick and at the point of death .

verses.z: 那兩個人來到耶穌那裏，說：「施洗的約翰打發我們來問你：『那將要來的是你嗎？還是我們等候別人呢？』」
verses.e: When the men had come to him , they said , " John the Baptizer has sent us to you , saying , ' Are you he who comes , or should we look for another ? ' "

verses.z: 正當那時候，耶穌治好了許多有疾病的，受災患的，被惡鬼附着的，又開恩叫好些瞎子能看見。
verses.e: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits ; and to many who were blind he gave sight .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們去，把所看見所聽見的事告訴約翰，就是瞎子看見，瘸子行走，長大痲瘋的潔淨，聾子聽見，死人復活，窮人有福音傳給他們。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard : that the blind receive their sight , the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , the deaf hear , the dead are raised up , and the poor have good news preached to them .

verses.z: 凡不因我跌倒的，就有福了！」
verses.e: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me . "

verses.z: 約翰所差來的人既走了，耶穌就對眾人講論約翰說：「你們從前出去到曠野，是要看甚麼呢？要看風吹動的蘆葦嗎？
verses.e: When John's messengers had departed , he began to tell the multitudes about John , " What did you go out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken by the wind ?

verses.z: 你們出去，到底是要看甚麼？要看穿細軟衣服的人嗎？那穿華麗衣服、宴樂度日的人是在王宮裏。
verses.e: But what did you go out to see ? A man clothed in soft clothing ? Behold , those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings ' courts .

verses.z: 你們出去，究竟是要看甚麼？要看先知嗎？我告訴你們，是的，他比先知大多了。
verses.e: But what did you go out to see ? A prophet ? Yes , I tell you , and much more than a prophet .

verses.z: [經上]記着說：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面預備道路』，所說的就是這個人。
verses.e: This is he of whom it is written , ' Behold , I send my messenger before your face , who will prepare your way before you . '

verses.z: 我告訴你們，凡婦人所生的，沒有一個大過約翰的；然而上帝國裏最小的比他還大。」
verses.e: " For I tell you , among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer ; yet he who is least in God's Kingdom is greater than he . "

verses.z: 眾百姓和稅吏既受過約翰的洗，聽見這話，就以上帝為義；
verses.e: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this , they declared God to be just , having been baptized with John's baptism .

verses.z: 百夫長風聞耶穌的事，就託猶太人的幾個長老去求耶穌來救他的僕人。
verses.e: When he heard about Jesus , he sent to him elders of the Jews , asking him to come and save his servant .
