verses.z: 但法利賽人和律法師沒有受過約翰的洗，竟為自己廢棄了上帝的旨意。
verses.e: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God , not being baptized by him themselves .

verses.z: [主又說]：「這樣，我可用甚麼比這世代的人呢？他們好像甚麼呢？
verses.e: " To what then should I compare the people of this generation ? What are they like ?

verses.z: 好像孩童坐在街市上，彼此呼叫說：我們向你們吹笛，你們不跳舞；我們向你們舉哀，你們不啼哭。
verses.e: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another , saying , ' We piped to you , and you didn't dance . We mourned , and you didn't weep . '

verses.z: 施洗的約翰來，不吃餅，不喝酒，你們說他是被鬼附着的。
verses.e: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine , and you say , ' He has a demon . '

verses.z: 人子來，也吃也喝，你們說他是貪食好酒的人，是稅吏和罪人的朋友。
verses.e: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking , and you say , ' Behold , a glutton and a drunkard , a friend of tax collectors and sinners ! '

verses.z: 但智慧之子都以智慧為是。」
verses.e: Wisdom is justified by all her children . "

verses.z: 有一個法利賽人請耶穌和他吃飯；耶穌就到法利賽人家裏去坐席。
verses.e: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him . He entered into the Pharisee's house and sat at the table .

verses.z: 那城裏有一個女人，是個罪人，知道耶穌在法利賽人家裏坐席，就拿着盛香膏的玉瓶，
verses.e: Behold , a woman in the city who was a sinner , when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee's house , brought an alabaster jar of ointment .

verses.z: 站在耶穌背後，挨着他的腳哭，眼淚濕了耶穌的腳，就用自己的頭髮擦乾，又用嘴連連親他的腳，把香膏抹上。
verses.e: Standing behind at his feet weeping , she began to wet his feet with her tears , and she wiped them with the hair of her head , kissed his feet , and anointed them with the ointment .

verses.z: 請耶穌的法利賽人看見這事，心裏說：「這人若是先知，必知道摸他的是誰，是個怎樣的女人；乃是個罪人。」
verses.e: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it , he said to himself , " This man , if he were a prophet , would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him , that she is a sinner . "

verses.z: 他們到了耶穌那裏，就切切地求他說：「你給他行這事是他所配得的；
verses.e: When they came to Jesus , they begged him earnestly , saying , " He is worthy for you to do this for him ,

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「西門！我有句話要對你說。」西門說：「夫子，請說。」
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Simon , I have something to tell you . " He said , " Teacher , say on . "

verses.z: [耶穌說]：「一個債主有兩個人欠他的債；一個欠五十兩銀子，一個欠五兩銀子；
verses.e: " A certain lender had two debtors . The one owed five hundred denarii , and the other fifty .

verses.z: 因為他們無力償還，債主就開恩免了他們兩個人的債。這兩個人哪一個更愛他呢？」
verses.e: When they couldn't pay , he forgave them both . Which of them therefore will love him most ? "

verses.z: 西門回答說：「我想是那多得恩免的人。」耶穌說：「你斷的不錯。」
verses.e: Simon answered , " He , I suppose , to whom he forgave the most . " He said to him , " You have judged correctly . "

verses.z: 於是轉過來向着那女人，便對西門說：「你看見這女人嗎？我進了你的家，你沒有給我水洗腳；但這女人用眼淚濕了我的腳，用頭髮擦乾。
verses.e: Turning to the woman , he said to Simon , " Do you see this woman ? I entered into your house , and you gave me no water for my feet , but she has wet my feet with her tears , and wiped them with the hair of her head .

verses.z: 你沒有與我親嘴；但這女人從我進來的時候就不住地用嘴親我的腳。
verses.e: You gave me no kiss , but she , since the time I came in , has not ceased to kiss my feet .

verses.z: 你沒有用油抹我的頭；但這女人用香膏抹我的腳。
verses.e: You didn't anoint my head with oil , but she has anointed my feet with ointment .

verses.z: 所以我告訴你，她許多的罪都赦免了，因為她的愛多；但那赦免少的，他的愛就少。」
verses.e: Therefore I tell you , her sins , which are many , are forgiven , for she loved much . But one to whom little is forgiven , loves little . "

verses.z: 於是對那女人說：「你的罪赦免了。」
verses.e: He said to her , " Your sins are forgiven . "

verses.z: 同席的人心裏說：「這是甚麼人，竟赦免人的罪呢？」
verses.e: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves , " Who is this who even forgives sins ? "

verses.z: 因為他愛我們的百姓，給我們建造會堂。」
verses.e: for he loves our nation , and he built our synagogue for us . "

verses.z: 耶穌對那女人說：「你的信救了你；平平安安回去吧！」
verses.e: He said to the woman , " Your faith has saved you . Go in peace . "

verses.z: 耶穌就和他們同去。離那家不遠，百夫長託幾個朋友去見耶穌，對他說：「主啊！不要勞動；因你到我舍下，我不敢當。
verses.e: Jesus went with them . When he was now not far from the house , the centurion sent friends to him , saying to him , " Lord , don't trouble yourself , for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof .

verses.z: 我也自以為不配去見你，只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必好了。
verses.e: Therefore I didn't even think myself worthy to come to you ; but say the word , and my servant will be healed .

verses.z: 因為我在人的權下，也有兵在我以下，對這個說：『去！』他就去；對那個說：『來！』他就來；對我的僕人說：『你做這事！』他就去做。」
verses.e: For I also am a man placed under authority , having under myself soldiers . I tell this one , ' Go ! ' and he goes ; and to another , ' Come ! ' and he comes ; and to my servant , ' Do this , ' and he does it . "

verses.z: 耶穌聽見這話，就希奇他，轉身對跟隨的眾人說：「我告訴你們，這麼大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也沒有遇見過。」
verses.e: When Jesus heard these things , he marveled at him , and turned and said to the multitude who followed him , " I tell you , I have not found such great faith , no , not in Israel . "

verses.z: 過了不多日，耶穌周遊各城各鄉傳道，宣講上帝國的福音。和他同去的有十二個門徒，
verses.e: Soon afterwards , he went about through cities and villages , preaching and bringing the good news of God's Kingdom . With him were the twelve ,

verses.z: 他說：「上帝國的奧祕只叫你們知道；至於別人，就用比喻，叫他們看也看不見，聽也聽不明。」
verses.e: He said , " To you it is given to know the mysteries of God's Kingdom , but to the rest it is given in parables , that ' seeing they may not see , and hearing they may not understand . '

verses.z: 「這比喻乃是這樣：種子就是上帝的道。
verses.e: " Now the parable is this : The seed is the word of God .

verses.z: 那些在路旁的，就是人聽了道，隨後魔鬼來，從他們心裏把道奪去，恐怕他們信了得救。
verses.e: Those along the road are those who hear ; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart , that they may not believe and be saved .

verses.z: 那些在磐石上的，就是人聽道，歡喜領受，但心中沒有根，不過暫時相信，及至遇見試煉就退後了。
verses.e: Those on the rock are they who , when they hear , receive the word with joy ; but these have no root . They believe for a while , then fall away in time of temptation .

verses.z: 那落在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，走開以後，被今生的思慮、錢財、宴樂擠住了，便結不出成熟的子粒來。
verses.e: What fell among the thorns , these are those who have heard , and as they go on their way they are choked with cares , riches , and pleasures of life ; and they bring no fruit to maturity .

verses.z: [那落]在好土裏的，就是人聽了道，持守在誠實善良的心裏，並且忍耐着結實。」
verses.e: Those in the good ground , these are those who with an honest and good heart , having heard the word , hold it tightly , and produce fruit with perseverance .

verses.z: 「沒有人點燈用器皿蓋上，或放在床底下，乃是放在燈臺上，叫進來的人看見亮光。
verses.e: " No one , when he has lit a lamp , covers it with a container or puts it under a bed ; but puts it on a stand , that those who enter in may see the light .

verses.z: 因為掩藏的事沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事沒有不露出來被人知道的。
verses.e: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed , nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light .

verses.z: 所以，你們應當小心怎樣聽；因為凡有的，還要加給他；凡沒有的，連他自以為有的，也要奪去。」
verses.e: Be careful therefore how you hear . For whoever has , to him will be given ; and whoever doesn't have , from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has . "

verses.z: 耶穌的母親和他弟兄來了，因為人多，不得到他跟前。
verses.e: His mother and brothers came to him , and they could not come near him for the crowd .

verses.z: 還有被惡鬼所附、被疾病所累、已經治好的幾個婦女，內中有稱為抹大拉的馬利亞（曾有七個鬼從她身上趕出來），
verses.e: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities : Mary who was called Magdalene , from whom seven demons had gone out ;

verses.z: 有人告訴他說：「你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要見你。」
verses.e: Some people told him , " Your mother and your brothers stand outside , desiring to see you . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「聽了上帝之道而遵行的人就是我的母親，我的弟兄了。」
verses.e: But he answered them , " My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it . "

verses.z: 有一天，耶穌和門徒上了船，對門徒說：「我們可以渡到湖那邊去。」他們就開了船。
verses.e: Now on one of those days , he entered into a boat , himself and his disciples , and he said to them , " Let's go over to the other side of the lake . " So they launched out .

verses.z: 正行的時候，耶穌睡着了。湖上忽然起了暴風，船將滿了[水]，甚是危險。
verses.e: But as they sailed , he fell asleep . A wind storm came down on the lake , and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water .

verses.z: 門徒來叫醒了他，說：「夫子！夫子！我們喪命啦！」耶穌醒了，斥責那狂風大浪；風浪就止住，平靜了。
verses.e: They came to him and awoke him , saying , " Master , Master , we are dying ! " He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water ; then they ceased , and it was calm .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們的信心在哪裏呢？」他們又懼怕又希奇，彼此說：「這到底是誰？他吩咐風和水，連風和水也聽從他了。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Where is your faith ? " Being afraid , they marveled , saying to one another , " Who is this then , that he commands even the winds and the water , and they obey him ? "

verses.z: 他們到了格拉森人的地方，就是加利利的對面。
verses.e: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes , which is opposite Galilee .

verses.z: 耶穌上了岸，就有城裏一個被鬼附着的人迎面而來。這個人許久不穿衣服，不住房子，只住在墳塋裏。
verses.e: When Jesus stepped ashore , a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him . He wore no clothes , and didn't live in a house , but in the tombs .

verses.z: 他見了耶穌，就俯伏在他面前，大聲喊叫，說：「至高上帝的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？求你不要叫我受苦！」
verses.e: When he saw Jesus , he cried out and fell down before him , and with a loud voice said , " What do I have to do with you , Jesus , you Son of the Most High God ? I beg you , don't torment me ! "

verses.z: 是因耶穌曾吩咐污鬼從那人身上出來。原來這鬼屢次抓住他；他常被人看守，又被鐵鍊和腳鐐捆鎖，他竟把鎖鍊掙斷，被鬼趕到曠野去。
verses.e: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man . For the unclean spirit had often seized the man . He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters . Breaking the bonds apart , he was driven by the demon into the desert .

verses.z: 又有希律的家宰苦撒的妻子約亞拿，並蘇撒拿，和好些別的婦女，都是用自己的財物供給耶穌和門徒。
verses.e: and Joanna , the wife of Chuzas , Herod's steward ; Susanna ; and many others who served them from their possessions .

verses.z: 耶穌問他說：「你名叫甚麼？」他說：「我名叫『群』」；這是因為附着他的鬼多。
verses.e: Jesus asked him , " What is your name ? " He said , " Legion , " for many demons had entered into him .

verses.z: 鬼就央求耶穌，不要吩咐他們到無底坑裏去。
verses.e: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss .

verses.z: 那裏有一大群豬在山上吃食。鬼央求耶穌，准他們進入豬裏去。耶穌准了他們，
verses.e: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain , and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those . Then he allowed them .

verses.z: 鬼就從那人出來，進入豬裏去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在湖裏淹死了。
verses.e: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs , and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned .

verses.z: 放豬的看見這事就逃跑了，去告訴城裏和鄉下的人。
verses.e: When those who fed them saw what had happened , they fled and told it in the city and in the country .

verses.z: 眾人出來要看是甚麼事；到了耶穌那裏，看見鬼所離開的那人，坐在耶穌腳前，穿着衣服，心裏明白過來，他們就害怕。
verses.e: People went out to see what had happened . They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out , sitting at Jesus ' feet , clothed and in his right mind ; and they were afraid .

verses.z: 看見這事的便將被鬼附着的人怎麼得救告訴他們。
verses.e: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed .

verses.z: 格拉森四圍的人，因為害怕得很，都求耶穌離開他們；耶穌就上船回去了。
verses.e: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them , for they were very much afraid . Then he entered into the boat and returned .

verses.z: 鬼所離開的那人懇求和耶穌同在；耶穌卻打發他回去，說：
verses.e: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him , but Jesus sent him away , saying ,

verses.z: 「你回家去，傳說上帝為你做了何等大的事。」他就去，滿城裏傳揚耶穌為他做了何等大的事。
verses.e: " Return to your house , and declare what great things God has done for you . " He went his way , proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him .

verses.z: 當許多人聚集、又有人從各城裏出來見耶穌的時候，耶穌就用比喻說：
verses.e: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him , he spoke by a parable :

verses.z: 耶穌回來的時候，眾人迎接他，因為他們都等候他。
verses.e: When Jesus returned , the multitude welcomed him , for they were all waiting for him .

verses.z: 有一個管會堂的，名叫睚魯，來俯伏在耶穌腳前，求耶穌到他家裏去；
verses.e: Behold , a man named Jairus came . He was a ruler of the synagogue . He fell down at Jesus ' feet and begged him to come into his house ,

verses.z: 因他有一個獨生女兒，約有十二歲，快要死了。耶穌去的時候，眾人擁擠他。
verses.e: for he had an only born daughter , about twelve years of age , and she was dying . But as he went , the multitudes pressed against him .

verses.z: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，在醫生手裏花盡了她一切養生的，並沒有一人能醫好她。
verses.e: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years , who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any ,

verses.z: 她來到耶穌背後，摸他的衣裳繸子，血漏立刻就止住了。
verses.e: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak . Immediately the flow of her blood stopped .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「摸我的是誰？」眾人都不承認。彼得和同行的人都說：「夫子，眾人擁擁擠擠緊靠着你。」
verses.e: Jesus said , " Who touched me ? " When all denied it , Peter and those with him said , " Master , the multitudes press and jostle you , and you say , ' Who touched me ? ' "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「總有人摸我，因我覺得有能力從我身上出去。」
verses.e: But Jesus said , " Someone did touch me , for I perceived that power has gone out of me . "

verses.z: 那女人知道不能隱藏，就戰戰兢兢地來俯伏在耶穌腳前，把摸他的緣故和怎樣立刻得好了，當着眾人都說出來。
verses.e: When the woman saw that she was not hidden , she came trembling ; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .

verses.z: 耶穌對她說：「女兒，你的信救了你；平平安安地去吧！」
verses.e: He said to her , " Daughter , cheer up . Your faith has made you well . Go in peace . "

verses.z: 還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裏來，說：「你的女兒死了，不要勞動夫子。」
verses.e: While he still spoke , one from the ruler of the synagogue's house came , saying to him , " Your daughter is dead . Don't trouble the Teacher . "

verses.z: 「有一個撒種的出去撒種。撒的時候，有落在路旁的，被人踐踏，天上的飛鳥又來吃盡了。
verses.e: " The farmer went out to sow his seed . As he sowed , some fell along the road , and it was trampled under foot , and the birds of the sky devoured it .

verses.z: 耶穌聽見就對他說：「不要怕，只要信！你的女兒就必得救。」
verses.e: But Jesus hearing it , answered him , " Don't be afraid . Only believe , and she will be healed . "

verses.z: 耶穌到了他的家，除了彼得、約翰、雅各，和女兒的父母，不許別人同他進去。
verses.e: When he came to the house , he didn't allow anyone to enter in , except Peter , John , James , the father of the child , and her mother .

verses.z: 眾人都為這女兒哀哭捶胸。耶穌說：「不要哭！她不是死了，是睡着了。」
verses.e: All were weeping and mourning her , but he said , " Don't weep . She isn't dead , but sleeping . "

verses.z: 他們曉得女兒已經死了，就嗤笑耶穌。
verses.e: They were ridiculing him , knowing that she was dead .

verses.z: 耶穌拉着她的手，呼叫說：「女兒，起來吧！」
verses.e: But he put them all outside , and taking her by the hand , he called , saying , " Child , arise ! "

verses.z: 她的靈魂便回來，她就立刻起來了。耶穌吩咐給她東西吃。
verses.e: Her spirit returned , and she rose up immediately . He commanded that something be given to her to eat .

verses.z: 她的父母驚奇得很；耶穌囑咐他們，不要把所做的事告訴人。
verses.e: Her parents were amazed , but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done .

verses.z: 有落在磐石上的，一出來就枯乾了，因為得不着滋潤。
verses.e: Some seed fell on the rock , and as soon as it grew , it withered away , because it had no moisture .

verses.z: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘一同生長，把它擠住了。
verses.e: Some fell amid the thorns , and the thorns grew with it and choked it .

verses.z: 又有落在好土裏的，生長起來，結實百倍。」耶穌說了這些話，就大聲說：「有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
verses.e: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit . " As he said these things , he called out , " He who has ears to hear , let him hear ! "

verses.z: 門徒問耶穌說：「這比喻是甚麼意思呢？」
verses.e: Then his disciples asked him , " What does this parable mean ? "

verses.z: 耶穌叫齊了十二個門徒，給他們能力、權柄，制伏一切的鬼，醫治各樣的病，
verses.e: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons , and to cure diseases .

verses.z: 使徒回來，將所做的事告訴耶穌，耶穌就帶他們暗暗地離開那裏，往一座城去；那城名叫伯賽大。
verses.e: The apostles , when they had returned , told him what things they had done . He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida .

verses.z: 但眾人知道了，就跟着他去；耶穌便接待他們，對他們講論上帝國[的道]，醫治那些需醫的人。
verses.e: But the multitudes , perceiving it , followed him . He welcomed them , spoke to them of God's Kingdom , and he cured those who needed healing .

verses.z: 日頭快要平西，十二個門徒來對他說：「請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裏去借宿找吃的，因為我們這裏是野地。」
verses.e: The day began to wear away ; and the twelve came and said to him , " Send the multitude away , that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food , for we are here in a deserted place . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們給他們吃吧！」門徒說：「我們不過有五個餅，兩條魚，若不去為這許多人買食物就不夠。」
verses.e: But he said to them , " You give them something to eat . " They said , " We have no more than five loaves and two fish , unless we should go and buy food for all these people . "

verses.z: 那時，人數約有五千。耶穌對門徒說：「叫他們一排一排地坐下，每排大約五十個人。」
verses.e: For they were about five thousand men . He said to his disciples , " Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each . "

verses.z: 門徒就如此行，叫眾人都坐下。
verses.e: They did so , and made them all sit down .

verses.z: 耶穌拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前。
verses.e: He took the five loaves and the two fish , and looking up to the sky , he blessed them , broke them , and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude .

verses.z: 他們就吃，並且都吃飽了；把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二籃子。
verses.e: They ate and were all filled . They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over .

verses.z: 耶穌自己禱告的時候，門徒也同他在那裏。耶穌問他們說：「眾人說我是誰？」
verses.e: As he was praying alone , the disciples were near him , and he asked them , " Who do the multitudes say that I am ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；還有人說是古時的一個先知又活了。」
verses.e: They answered , " ' John the Baptizer , ' but others say , ' Elijah , ' and others , that one of the old prophets has risen again . "

verses.z: 又差遣他們去宣傳上帝國[的道]，醫治病人，
verses.e: He sent them out to preach God's Kingdom and to heal the sick .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們說我是誰？」彼得回答說：「是上帝所立的基督。」
verses.e: He said to them , " But who do you say that I am ? " Peter answered , " The Christ of God . "

verses.z: 耶穌切切地囑咐他們，不可將這事告訴人，
verses.e: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one ,

verses.z: 又說：「人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，第三日復活。」
verses.e: saying , " The Son of Man must suffer many things , and be rejected by the elders , chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and the third day be raised up . "

verses.z: 耶穌又對眾人說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，天天背起他的十字架來跟從我。
verses.e: He said to all , " If anyone desires to come after me , let him deny himself , take up his cross , and follow me .

verses.z: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
verses.e: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it , but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it .

verses.z: 人若賺得全世界，卻喪了自己，賠上自己，有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world , and loses or forfeits his own self ?

verses.z: 凡把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在自己的榮耀裏，並天父與聖天使的榮耀裏降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。
verses.e: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words , of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory , and the glory of the Father , and of the holy angels .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前，必看見上帝的國。」
verses.e: But I tell you the truth : There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 說了這話以後約有八天，耶穌帶着彼得、約翰、雅各上山去禱告。
verses.e: About eight days after these sayings , he took with him Peter , John , and James , and went up onto the mountain to pray .

verses.z: 正禱告的時候，他的面貌就改變了，衣服潔白放光。
verses.e: As he was praying , the appearance of his face was altered , and his clothing became white and dazzling .

verses.z: 對他們說：「行路的時候，不要帶柺杖和口袋，不要帶食物和銀子，也不要帶兩件褂子。
verses.e: He said to them , " Take nothing for your journey — no staffs , nor wallet , nor bread , nor money . Don't have two tunics each .

verses.z: 忽然有摩西、以利亞兩個人同耶穌說話；
verses.e: Behold , two men were talking with him , who were Moses and Elijah ,

verses.z: 他們在榮光裏顯現，談論耶穌去世的事，就是他在耶路撒冷將要成的事。
verses.e: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure , which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 彼得和他的同伴都打盹，既清醒了，就看見耶穌的榮光，並同他站着的那兩個人。
verses.e: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep , but when they were fully awake , they saw his glory , and the two men who stood with him .

verses.z: 二人正要和耶穌分離的時候，彼得對耶穌說：「夫子，我們在這裏真好！可以搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」他卻不知道所說的是甚麼。
verses.e: As they were parting from him , Peter said to Jesus , " Master , it is good for us to be here . Let's make three tents : one for you , one for Moses , and one for Elijah , " not knowing what he said .

verses.z: 說這話的時候，有一朵雲彩來遮蓋他們；他們進入雲彩裏就懼怕。
verses.e: While he said these things , a cloud came and overshadowed them , and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud .

verses.z: 有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的兒子，我所揀選的，你們要聽他。」
verses.e: A voice came out of the cloud , saying , " This is my beloved Son . Listen to him ! "

verses.z: 聲音住了，只見耶穌一人在那裏。當那些日子，門徒不提所看見的事，一樣也不告訴人。
verses.e: When the voice came , Jesus was found alone . They were silent , and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen .

verses.z: 第二天，他們下了山，就有許多人迎見耶穌。
verses.e: On the next day , when they had come down from the mountain , a great multitude met him .

verses.z: 其中有一人喊叫說：「夫子！求你看顧我的兒子，因為他是我的獨生子。
verses.e: Behold , a man from the crowd called out , saying , " Teacher , I beg you to look at my son , for he is my only born child .

verses.z: 他被鬼抓住就忽然喊叫；鬼又叫他抽瘋，口中流沫，並且重重地傷害他，難以離開他。
verses.e: Behold , a spirit takes him , he suddenly cries out , and it convulses him so that he foams ; and it hardly departs from him , bruising him severely .

verses.z: 無論進哪一家，就住在那裏，也從那裏起行。
verses.e: Into whatever house you enter , stay there , and depart from there .

verses.z: 我求過你的門徒，把鬼趕出去，他們卻是不能。」
verses.e: I begged your disciples to cast it out , and they couldn't . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代啊，我在你們這裏，忍耐你們要到幾時呢？將你的兒子帶到這裏來吧！」
verses.e: Jesus answered , " Faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you and bear with you ? Bring your son here . "

verses.z: 正來的時候，鬼把他摔倒，叫他重重地抽瘋。耶穌就斥責那污鬼，把孩子治好了，交給他父親。
verses.e: While he was still coming , the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently . But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit , healed the boy , and gave him back to his father .

verses.z: 眾人都詫異上帝的大能。耶穌所做的一切事，眾人正希奇的時候，耶穌對門徒說：
verses.e: They were all astonished at the majesty of God . But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did , he said to his disciples ,

verses.z: 「你們要把這些話存在耳中，因為人子將要被交在人手裏。」
verses.e: " Let these words sink into your ears , for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men . "

verses.z: 他們不明白這話，意思乃是隱藏的，叫他們不能明白，他們也不敢問這話的意思。
verses.e: But they didn't understand this saying . It was concealed from them , that they should not perceive it , and they were afraid to ask him about this saying .

verses.z: 門徒中間起了議論，誰將為大。
verses.e: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest .

verses.z: 耶穌看出他們心中的議論，就領一個小孩子來，叫他站在自己旁邊，
verses.e: Jesus , perceiving the reasoning of their hearts , took a little child , and set him by his side ,

verses.z: 對他們說：「凡為我名接待這小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，就是接待那差我來的。你們中間最小的，他便為大。」
verses.e: and said to them , " Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me . Whoever receives me receives him who sent me . For whoever is least among you all , this one will be great . "

verses.z: 約翰說：「夫子，我們看見一個人奉你的名趕鬼，我們就禁止他，因為他不與我們一同跟從[你]。」
verses.e: John answered , " Master , we saw someone casting out demons in your name , and we forbade him , because he doesn't follow with us . "

verses.z: 凡不接待你們的，你們離開那城的時候，要把腳上的塵土跺下去，見證他們的不是。」
verses.e: As many as don't receive you , when you depart from that city , shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「不要禁止他；因為不敵擋你們的，就是幫助你們的。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Don't forbid him , for he who is not against us is for us . "

verses.z: 耶穌被接上升的日子將到，他就定意向耶路撒冷去，
verses.e: It came to pass , when the days were near that he should be taken up , he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

verses.z: 便打發使者在他前頭走。他們到了撒馬利亞的一個村莊，要為他預備。
verses.e: and sent messengers before his face . They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans , so as to prepare for him .

verses.z: 那裏的人不接待他，因他面向耶路撒冷去。
verses.e: They didn't receive him , because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他的門徒雅各、約翰看見了，就說：「主啊，你要我們吩咐火從天上降下來燒滅他們，像以利亞所做的嗎？」
verses.e: When his disciples , James and John , saw this , they said , " Lord , do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them , just as Elijah did ? "

verses.z: 耶穌轉身責備兩個門徒，說：「你們的心如何，你們並不知道。
verses.e: But he turned and rebuked them , " You don't know of what kind of spirit you are .

verses.z: 人子來不是要滅人的性命，是要救人的性命。」說着就往別的村莊去了。
verses.e: For the Son of Man didn't come to destroy men's lives , but to save them . " They went to another village .

verses.z: 他們走路的時候，有一人對耶穌說：「你無論往哪裏去，我要跟從你。」
verses.e: As they went on the way , a certain man said to him , " I want to follow you wherever you go , Lord . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，只是人子沒有枕頭的地方。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests , but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head . "

verses.z: 又對一個人說：「跟從我來！」那人說：「主，容我先回去埋葬我的父親。」
verses.e: He said to another , " Follow me ! " But he said , " Lord , allow me first to go and bury my father . "

verses.z: 門徒就出去，走遍各鄉宣傳福音，到處治病。
verses.e: They departed and went throughout the villages , preaching the Good News and healing everywhere .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「任憑死人埋葬他們的死人，你只管去傳揚上帝國[的道]。」
verses.e: But Jesus said to him , " Leave the dead to bury their own dead , but you go and announce God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 又有一人說：「主，我要跟從你，但容我先去辭別我家裏的人。」
verses.e: Another also said , " I want to follow you , Lord , but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「手扶着犂向後看的，不配進上帝的國。」
verses.e: But Jesus said to him , " No one , having put his hand to the plow and looking back , is fit for God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 分封的王希律聽見耶穌所做的一切事，就游移不定；因為有人說：「是約翰從死裏復活」；
verses.e: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him ; and he was very perplexed , because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead ,

verses.z: 又有人說：「是以利亞顯現」；還有人說：「是古時的一個先知又活了。」
verses.e: and by some that Elijah had appeared , and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again .

verses.z: 希律說：「約翰我已經斬了，這卻是甚麼人？我竟聽見他這樣的事呢？」就想要見他。
verses.e: Herod said , " I beheaded John , but who is this about whom I hear such things ? " He sought to see him .

verses.z: 耶和華藉瑪拉基傳給以色列的默示。
verses.e: A revelation , the LORD's word to Israel by Malachi .

verses.z: 甚願你們中間有一人關上[殿]門，免得你們徒然在我壇上燒[火]。萬軍之耶和華說：我不喜悅你們，也不從你們手中收納供物。
verses.e: " Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors , that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain ! I have no pleasure in you , " says the LORD of Armies , " neither will I accept an offering at your hand .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：從日出之地到日落之處，我的名在外邦中必尊為大。在各處，人必奉我的名燒香，獻潔淨的供物，因為我的名在外邦中必尊為大。
verses.e: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down , my name is great among the nations , and in every place incense will be offered to my name , and a pure offering ; for my name is great among the nations , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 你們卻褻瀆我的名，說：『耶和華的桌子是污穢的，其上的食物是可藐視的。』
verses.e: " But you profane it when you say , ' The LORD's table is polluted , and its fruit , even its food , is contemptible . '

verses.z: 你們又說：『這些事何等煩瑣！』並嗤之以鼻。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。你們把搶奪的、瘸腿的、有病的拿來獻上為祭。我豈能從你們手中收納呢？這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: You say also , ' Behold , what a weariness it is ! ' And you have sniffed at it " , says the LORD of Armies ; " and you have brought that which was taken by violence , the lame , and the sick ; thus you bring the offering . Should I accept this at your hand ? " says the LORD .

verses.z: 行詭詐的在群中有公羊，他許願卻用有殘疾的獻給主，這人是可咒詛的。因為我是大君王，我的名在外邦中是可畏的。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: " But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male , and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing ; for I am a great King , " says the LORD of Armies , " and my name is awesome among the nations . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我曾愛你們。」你們卻說：「你在何事上愛我們呢？」耶和華說：「以掃不是雅各的哥哥嗎？我卻愛雅各，
verses.e: " I have loved you , " says the LORD . Yet you say , " How have you loved us ? " " Wasn't Esau Jacob's brother ? " says the LORD , " Yet I loved Jacob ;

verses.z: 惡以掃，使他的山嶺荒涼，把他的地業[交給]曠野的野狗。」
verses.e: but Esau I hated , and made his mountains a desolation , and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness . "

verses.z: 以東人說：「我們現在雖被毀壞，卻要重建荒廢之處。」萬軍之耶和華如此說：「任他們建造，我必拆毀；人必稱他們的地為『罪惡之境』；稱他們的民為『耶和華永遠惱怒之民』。」
verses.e: Whereas Edom says , " We are beaten down , but we will return and build the waste places , " the LORD of Armies says , " They shall build , but I will throw down ; and men will call them ' The Wicked Land , ' even the people against whom the LORD shows wrath forever . "

verses.z: 你們必親眼看見，也必說：「願耶和華在以色列境界之外被尊為大！」
verses.e: Your eyes will see , and you will say , " The LORD is great — even beyond the border of Israel ! "

verses.z: 「藐視我名的祭司啊，萬軍之耶和華對你們說：兒子尊敬父親，僕人敬畏主人；我既為父親，尊敬我的在哪裏呢？我既為主人，敬畏我的在哪裏呢？你們卻說：『我們在何事上藐視你的名呢？』
verses.e: " A son honors his father , and a servant his master . If I am a father , then where is my honor ? And if I am a master , where is the respect due me ? " says the LORD of Armies to you priests who despise my name . " You say , ' How have we despised your name ? '

verses.z: 你們將污穢的食物獻在我的壇上，且說：『我們在何事上污穢你呢？』因你們說，耶和華的桌子是可藐視的。
verses.e: You offer polluted bread on my altar . You say , ' How have we polluted you ? ' In that you say , ' The LORD's table is contemptible . '

verses.z: 你們將瞎眼的獻為祭物，這不為惡嗎？將瘸腿的、有病的獻上，這不為惡嗎？你獻給你的省長，他豈喜悅你，豈能看你的情面嗎？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: When you offer the blind for sacrifice , isn't that evil ? And when you offer the lame and sick , isn't that evil ? Present it now to your governor ! Will he be pleased with you ? Or will he accept your person ? " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 「現在我勸你們懇求上帝，他好施恩與我們。這[妄獻]的事，既由你們經手，他豈能看你們的情面嗎？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: " Now , please entreat the favor of God , that he may be gracious to us . With this , will he accept any of you ? " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 「眾祭司啊，這誡命是傳給你們的。
verses.e: " Now , you priests , this commandment is for you .

verses.z: 我們豈不都是一位父嗎？豈不是一位上帝所造的嗎？我們各人怎麼以詭詐待弟兄，背棄了[上帝]與我們列祖所立的約呢？
verses.e: Don't we all have one father ? Hasn't one God created us ? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother , profaning the covenant of our fathers ?

verses.z: 猶大人行事詭詐，並且在以色列和耶路撒冷中行一件可憎的事；因為猶大人褻瀆耶和華所喜愛的聖潔，娶[事奉]外邦神的女子為妻。
verses.e: Judah has dealt treacherously , and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem ; for Judah has profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loves , and has married the daughter of a foreign god .

verses.z: 凡行這事的，無論何人，就是獻供物給萬軍之耶和華，耶和華也必從雅各的帳棚中剪除他。
verses.e: The LORD will cut off the man who does this , him who wakes and him who answers , out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 你們又行了一件這樣的事，使[前妻]歎息哭泣的眼淚遮蓋耶和華的壇，以致耶和華不再看顧那供物，也不樂意從你們手中收納。
verses.e: " This again you do : you cover the LORD's altar with tears , with weeping , and with sighing , because he doesn't regard the offering any more , neither receives it with good will at your hand .

verses.z: 你們還說：「這是為甚麼呢？」因耶和華在你和你幼年所娶的妻中間作見證。她雖是你的配偶，又是你盟約的妻，你卻以詭詐待她。
verses.e: Yet you say , ' Why ? ' Because the LORD has been witness between you and the wife of your youth , against whom you have dealt treacherously , though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant .

verses.z: 雖然上帝有靈的餘[力能造多人]，他不是單造一人嗎？為何只造一人呢？乃是他願人得虔誠的後裔。所以當謹守你們的心，誰也不可以詭詐待幼年所娶的妻。
verses.e: Did he not make you one , although he had the residue of the Spirit ? Why one ? He sought godly offspring . Therefore take heed to your spirit , and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝說：「休妻的事和以強暴待妻的人都是我所恨惡的！所以當謹守你們的心，不可行詭詐。」這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: One who hates and divorces " , says the LORD , the God of Israel , " covers his garment with violence ! " says the LORD of Armies . " Therefore pay attention to your spirit , that you don't be unfaithful .

verses.z: 你們用言語煩瑣耶和華，你們還說：「我們在何事上煩瑣他呢？」因為你們說：「凡行惡的，耶和華眼看為善，並且他喜悅他們」；或說：「公義的上帝在哪裏呢？」
verses.e: You have wearied the LORD with your words . Yet you say , ' How have we wearied him ? ' In that you say , ' Everyone who does evil is good in the LORD's sight , and he delights in them ; ' or ' Where is the God of justice ? '

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：你們若不聽從，也不放在心上，將榮耀歸與我的名，我就使咒詛臨到你們，使你們的福分變為咒詛；因你們不把誡命放在心上，我已經咒詛你們了。
verses.e: If you will not listen , and if you will not take it to heart , to give glory to my name , " says the LORD of Armies , " then I will send the curse on you , and I will curse your blessings . Indeed , I have cursed them already , because you do not take it to heart .

verses.z: 我必斥責你們的種子，又把你們犧牲的糞抹在你們的臉上；你們要與糞一同除掉。
verses.e: Behold , I will rebuke your offspring , and will spread dung on your faces , even the dung of your feasts ; and you will be taken away with it .

verses.z: 你們就知道我傳這誡命給你們，使我與利未所立的約可以常存。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you , that my covenant may be with Levi , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 我曾與他立生命和平安的約。我將這兩樣賜給他，使他存敬畏的心，他就敬畏我，懼怕我的名。
verses.e: " My covenant was with him of life and peace ; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me ; and he was reverent toward me , and stood in awe of my name .

verses.z: 真實的律法在他口中，他嘴裏沒有不義的話。他以平安和正直與我同行，使多人回頭離開罪孽。
verses.e: The law of truth was in his mouth , and unrighteousness was not found in his lips . He walked with me in peace and uprightness , and turned many away from iniquity .

verses.z: 祭司的嘴裏當存知識，人也當由他口中尋求律法，因為他是萬軍之耶和華的使者。
verses.e: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge , and they should seek the law at his mouth ; for he is the messenger of the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 你們卻偏離正道，使許多人在律法上跌倒。你們廢棄[我]與利未所立的約。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: But you have turned away from the path . You have caused many to stumble in the law . You have corrupted the covenant of Levi , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 所以我使你們被眾人藐視，看為下賤；因你們不守我的道，竟在律法上瞻徇情面。」
verses.e: " Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people , according to the way you have not kept my ways , but have had respect for persons in the law .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我要差遣我的使者在我前面預備道路。你們所尋求的主必忽然進入他的殿；立約的使者，就是你們所仰慕的，快要來到。」
verses.e: " Behold , I send my messenger , and he will prepare the way before me ! The Lord , whom you seek , will suddenly come to his temple . Behold , the messenger of the covenant , whom you desire , is coming ! " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：你們要將當納的十分之一全然送入倉庫，使我家有糧，以此試試我，是否為你們敞開天上的窗戶，傾福與你們，甚至無處可容。
verses.e: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse , that there may be food in my house , and test me now in this , " says the LORD of Armies , " if I will not open you the windows of heaven , and pour you out a blessing , that there will not be enough room for .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必為你們斥責蝗蟲，不容牠毀壞你們的土產。你們田間的葡萄樹在未熟之先也不掉果子。
verses.e: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes , and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground ; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：萬國必稱你們為有福的，因你們的地必成為喜樂之地。」
verses.e: " All nations shall call you blessed , for you will be a delightful land , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「你們用話頂撞我，你們還說：『我們用甚麼話頂撞了你呢？』
verses.e: " Your words have been harsh against me , " says the LORD . " Yet you say , ' What have we spoken against you ? '

verses.z: 你們說：『事奉上帝是徒然的，遵守上帝所吩咐的，在萬軍之耶和華面前苦苦齋戒，有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: You have said , ' It is vain to serve God , ' and ' What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of Armies ?

verses.z: 如今我們稱狂傲的人為有福，並且行惡的人得建立；他們雖然試探上帝，卻得脫離[災難]。』」
verses.e: Now we call the proud happy ; yes , those who work wickedness are built up ; yes , they tempt God , and escape . '

verses.z: 那時，敬畏耶和華的彼此談論，耶和華側耳而聽，且有紀念冊在他面前，記錄那敬畏耶和華、思念他名的人。
verses.e: Then those who feared the LORD spoke one with another ; and the LORD listened and heard , and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared the LORD and who honored his name .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「在我所定的日子，他們必屬我，特特歸我。我必憐恤他們，如同人憐恤服事自己的兒子。
verses.e: They shall be mine , " says the LORD of Armies , " my own possession in the day that I make . I will spare them , as a man spares his own son who serves him .

verses.z: 那時你們必歸回，將善人和惡人，事奉上帝的和不事奉上帝的，分別出來。」
verses.e: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked , between him who serves God and him who doesn't serve him .

verses.z: 他來的日子，誰能當得起呢？他顯現的時候，誰能立得住呢？因為他如煉[金]之人的火，如漂布之人的鹼。
verses.e: " But who can endure the day of his coming ? And who will stand when he appears ? For he is like a refiner's fire , and like launderers ' soap ;

verses.z: 他必坐下如煉淨銀子的，必潔淨利未人，熬煉他們像金銀一樣；他們就憑公義獻供物給耶和華。
verses.e: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver , and he will purify the sons of Levi , and refine them as gold and silver ; and they shall offer to the LORD offerings in righteousness .

verses.z: 那時，猶大和耶路撒冷所獻的供物必蒙耶和華悅納，彷彿古時之日、上古之年。
verses.e: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to the LORD as in the days of old and as in ancient years .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我必臨近你們，施行審判。我必速速作見證，警戒行邪術的、犯姦淫的、起假誓的、虧負人之工價的、欺壓寡婦孤兒的、屈枉寄居的，和不敬畏我的。」
verses.e: I will come near to you to judgment . I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers , against the adulterers , against the perjurers , and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages , the widow , and the fatherless , and who deprive the foreigner of justice , and don't fear me , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 「因我－耶和華是不改變的，所以你們雅各之子沒有滅亡。
verses.e: " For I , the LORD , don't change ; therefore you , sons of Jacob , are not consumed .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：從你們列祖的日子以來，你們常常偏離我的典章而不遵守。現在你們要轉向我，我就轉向你們。你們卻問說：『我們如何才是轉向呢？』
verses.e: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them . Return to me , and I will return to you , " says the LORD of Armies . " But you say , ' How shall we return ? '

verses.z: 人豈可奪取上帝之物呢？你們竟奪取我[的供物]。你們卻說：『我們在何事上奪取你[的供物]呢？』就是你們在當納的十分之一和當獻的供物上。
verses.e: Will a man rob God ? Yet you rob me ! But you say , ' How have we robbed you ? ' In tithes and offerings .

verses.z: 因你們通國的人都奪取我[的供物]，咒詛就臨到你們身上。
verses.e: You are cursed with the curse ; for you rob me , even this whole nation .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「那日臨近，勢如燒着的火爐，凡狂傲的和行惡的必如碎稭，在那日必被燒盡，根本枝條一無存留。
verses.e: " For behold , the day comes , burning like a furnace , when all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble . The day that comes will burn them up , " says the LORD of Armies , " so that it will leave them neither root nor branch .

verses.z: 但向你們敬畏我名的人必有公義的日頭出現，其光線有醫治之能。你們必出來跳躍如圈裏的肥犢。
verses.e: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings . You will go out and leap like calves of the stall .

verses.z: 你們必踐踏惡人；在我所定的日子，他們必如灰塵在你們腳掌之下。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: You shall tread down the wicked ; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 「你們當記念我僕人摩西的律法，就是我在何烈[山]為以色列眾人所吩咐他的律例典章。
verses.e: " Remember the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel , even statutes and ordinances .

verses.z: 「看哪，耶和華大而可畏之日未到以前，我必差遣先知以利亞到你們那裏去。
verses.e: Behold , I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes .

verses.z: 他必使父親的心轉向兒女，兒女的心轉向父親，免得我來咒詛遍地。」
verses.e: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers , lest I come and strike the earth with a curse . "

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕的後裔，大衛的子孫，耶穌基督的家譜：
verses.e: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ , the son of David , the son of Abraham .

verses.z: 希西家生瑪拿西；瑪拿西生亞們；亞們生約西亞；
verses.e: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh . Manasseh became the father of Amon . Amon became the father of Josiah .

verses.z: 百姓被遷到巴比倫的時候，約西亞生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。
verses.e: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon .

verses.z: 遷到巴比倫之後，耶哥尼雅生撒拉鐵；撒拉鐵生所羅巴伯；
verses.e: After the exile to Babylon , Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel . Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel .

verses.z: 所羅巴伯生亞比玉；亞比玉生以利亞敬；以利亞敬生亞所；
verses.e: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud . Abiud became the father of Eliakim . Eliakim became the father of Azor .

verses.z: 亞所生撒督；撒督生亞金；亞金生以律；
verses.e: Azor became the father of Zadok . Zadok became the father of Achim . Achim became the father of Eliud .

verses.z: 以律生以利亞撒；以利亞撒生馬但；馬但生雅各；
verses.e: Eliud became the father of Eleazar . Eleazar became the father of Matthan . Matthan became the father of Jacob .

verses.z: 雅各生約瑟，就是馬利亞的丈夫。那稱為基督的耶穌是從馬利亞生的。
verses.e: Jacob became the father of Joseph , the husband of Mary , from whom was born Jesus , who is called Christ .

verses.z: 這樣，從亞伯拉罕到大衛共有十四代；從大衛到遷至巴比倫的時候也有十四代；從遷至巴比倫的時候到基督又有十四代。
verses.e: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations ; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations ; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ , fourteen generations .

verses.z: 耶穌基督降生的事記在下面：他母親馬利亞已經許配了約瑟，還沒有迎娶，馬利亞就從聖靈懷了孕。
verses.e: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this : After his mother , Mary , was engaged to Joseph , before they came together , she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 她丈夫約瑟是個義人，不願意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。
verses.e: Joseph , her husband , being a righteous man , and not willing to make her a public example , intended to put her away secretly .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生猶大和他的弟兄；
verses.e: Abraham became the father of Isaac . Isaac became the father of Jacob . Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers .

verses.z: 正思念這事的時候，有主的使者向他夢中顯現，[說]：「大衛的子孫約瑟，不要怕！只管娶過你的妻子馬利亞來，因她所懷的孕是從聖靈來的。
verses.e: But when he thought about these things , behold , an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream , saying , " Joseph , son of David , don't be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife , for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 她將要生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫耶穌，因他要將自己的百姓從罪惡裏救出來。」
verses.e: She shall give birth to a son . You shall name him Jesus , for it is he who shall save his people from their sins . "

verses.z: 這一切的事成就是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，
verses.e: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet , saying ,

verses.z: 說：必有童女懷孕生子；人要稱他的名為以馬內利。（以馬內利翻出來就是「上帝與我們同在」。）
verses.e: " Behold , the virgin shall be with child , and shall give birth to a son . They shall call his name Immanuel , " which is , being interpreted , " God with us . "

verses.z: 約瑟醒了，起來，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶過來；
verses.e: Joseph arose from his sleep , and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him , and took his wife to himself ;

verses.z: 只是沒有和她同房，等她生了兒子，就給他起名叫耶穌。
verses.e: and didn't know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son . He named him Jesus .

verses.z: 猶大從她瑪氏生法勒斯和謝拉；法勒斯生希斯崙；希斯崙生亞蘭；
verses.e: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar . Perez became the father of Hezron . Hezron became the father of Ram .

verses.z: 亞蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；
verses.e: Ram became the father of Amminadab . Amminadab became the father of Nahshon . Nahshon became the father of Salmon .

verses.z: 撒門從喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯從路得氏生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；
verses.e: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab . Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth . Obed became the father of Jesse .

verses.z: 耶西生大衛王。大衛從烏利亞的妻子生所羅門；
verses.e: Jesse became the father of King David . David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah's wife .

verses.z: 所羅門生羅波安；羅波安生亞比雅；亞比雅生亞撒；
verses.e: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam . Rehoboam became the father of Abijah . Abijah became the father of Asa .

verses.z: 亞撒生約沙法；約沙法生約蘭；約蘭生烏西雅；
verses.e: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat . Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram . Joram became the father of Uzziah .

verses.z: 烏西雅生約坦；約坦生亞哈斯；亞哈斯生希西家；
verses.e: Uzziah became the father of Jotham . Jotham became the father of Ahaz . Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah .

verses.z: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，給他們權柄，能趕逐污鬼，並醫治各樣的病症。
verses.e: He called to himself his twelve disciples , and gave them authority over unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal every disease and every sickness .

verses.z: 行路不要帶口袋；不要帶兩件褂子，也不要帶鞋和柺杖。因為工人得飲食是應當的。
verses.e: Take no bag for your journey , neither two coats , nor sandals , nor staff : for the laborer is worthy of his food .

verses.z: 你們無論進哪一城，哪一村，要打聽那裏誰是好人，就住在他家，直住到走的時候。
verses.e: Into whatever city or village you enter , find out who in it is worthy , and stay there until you go on .

verses.z: 進他家裏去，要請他的安。
verses.e: As you enter into the household , greet it .

verses.z: 那家若配得平安，你們所求的平安就必臨到那家；若不配得，你們所求的平安仍歸你們。
verses.e: If the household is worthy , let your peace come on it , but if it isn't worthy , let your peace return to you .

verses.z: 凡不接待你們、不聽你們話的人，你們離開那家，或是那城的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去。
verses.e: Whoever doesn't receive you or hear your words , as you go out of that house or that city , shake the dust off your feet .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪和蛾摩拉所受的，比那城還容易受呢！」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city .

verses.z: 「我差你們去，如同羊進入狼群；所以你們要靈巧像蛇，馴良像鴿子。
verses.e: " Behold , I send you out as sheep among wolves . Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves .

verses.z: 你們要防備人；因為他們要把你們交給公會，也要在會堂裏鞭打你們，
verses.e: But beware of men , for they will deliver you up to councils , and in their synagogues they will scourge you .

verses.z: 並且你們要為我的緣故被送到諸侯君王面前，對他們和外邦人作見證。
verses.e: Yes , and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony to them and to the nations .

verses.z: 你們被交的時候，不要思慮怎樣說話，或說甚麼話。到那時候，必賜給你們當說的話；
verses.e: But when they deliver you up , don't be anxious how or what you will say , for it will be given you in that hour what you will say .

verses.z: 這十二使徒的名：頭一個叫西門（又稱彼得），還有他兄弟安得烈，西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰，
verses.e: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these . The first , Simon , who is called Peter ; Andrew , his brother ; James the son of Zebedee ; John , his brother ;

verses.z: 因為不是你們自己說的，乃是你們父的靈在你們裏頭說的。
verses.e: For it is not you who speak , but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you .

verses.z: 弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要與父母為敵，害死他們；
verses.e: " Brother will deliver up brother to death , and the father his child . Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death .

verses.z: 並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的必然得救。
verses.e: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake , but he who endures to the end will be saved .

verses.z: 有人在這城裏逼迫你們，就逃到那城裏去。我實在告訴你們，以色列的城邑，你們還沒有走遍，人子就到了。
verses.e: But when they persecute you in this city , flee into the next , for most certainly I tell you , you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come .

verses.z: 學生不能高過先生；僕人不能高過主人。
verses.e: " A disciple is not above his teacher , nor a servant above his lord .

verses.z: 學生和先生一樣，僕人和主人一樣，也就罷了。人既罵家主是別西卜，何況他的家人呢？」
verses.e: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher , and the servant like his lord . If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul , how much more those of his household !

verses.z: 「所以，不要怕他們；因為掩蓋的事沒有不露出來的，隱藏的事沒有不被人知道的。
verses.e: Therefore don't be afraid of them , for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed , or hidden that will not be known .

verses.z: 我在暗中告訴你們的，你們要在明處說出來；你們耳中所聽的，要在房上宣揚出來。
verses.e: What I tell you in the darkness , speak in the light ; and what you hear whispered in the ear , proclaim on the housetops .

verses.z: 那殺身體、不能殺靈魂的，不要怕他們；惟有能把身體和靈魂都滅在地獄裏的，正要怕他。
verses.e: Don't be afraid of those who kill the body , but are not able to kill the soul . Rather , fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna .

verses.z: 兩個麻雀不是賣一分銀子嗎？若是你們的父不許，一個也不能掉在地上；
verses.e: " Aren't two sparrows sold for an assarion coin ? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father's will .

verses.z: 腓力和巴多羅買，多馬和稅吏馬太，亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太，
verses.e: Philip ; Bartholomew ; Thomas ; Matthew the tax collector ; James the son of Alphaeus ; Lebbaeus , who was also called Thaddaeus ;

verses.z: 就是你們的頭髮也都被數過了。
verses.e: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered .

verses.z: 所以，不要懼怕，你們比許多麻雀還貴重！」
verses.e: Therefore don't be afraid . You are of more value than many sparrows .

verses.z: 「凡在人面前認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必認他；
verses.e: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men , I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven .

verses.z: 凡在人面前不認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必不認他。」
verses.e: But whoever denies me before men , I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven .

verses.z: 「你們不要想我來是叫地上太平；我來並不是叫地上太平，乃是叫地上動刀兵。
verses.e: " Don't think that I came to send peace on the earth . I didn't come to send peace , but a sword .

verses.z: 因為我來是叫人與父親生疏，女兒與母親生疏，媳婦與婆婆生疏。
verses.e: For I came to set a man at odds against his father , and a daughter against her mother , and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law .

verses.z: 人的仇敵就是自己家裏的人。
verses.e: A man's foes will be those of his own household .

verses.z: 「愛父母過於愛我的，不配作我的門徒；愛兒女過於愛我的，不配作我的門徒；
verses.e: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me ; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn't worthy of me .

verses.z: 不背着他的十字架跟從我的，也不配作我的門徒。
verses.e: He who doesn't take his cross and follow after me isn't worthy of me .

verses.z: 得着生命的，將要失喪生命；為我失喪生命的，將要得着生命。」
verses.e: He who seeks his life will lose it ; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it .

verses.z: 奮銳黨的西門，還有賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
verses.e: Simon the Zealot ; and Judas Iscariot , who also betrayed him .

verses.z: 「人接待你們就是接待我；接待我就是接待那差我來的。
verses.e: " He who receives you receives me , and he who receives me receives him who sent me .

verses.z: 人因為先知的名接待先知，必得先知所得的賞賜；人因為義人的名接待義人，必得義人所得的賞賜。
verses.e: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet's reward . He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward .

verses.z: 無論何人，因為門徒的名，只把一杯涼水給這小子裏的一個喝，我實在告訴你們，這人不能不得賞賜。」
verses.e: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple , most certainly I tell you , he will in no way lose his reward . "

verses.z: 耶穌差這十二個人去，吩咐他們說：「外邦人的路，你們不要走；撒馬利亞人的城，你們不要進；
verses.e: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them , saying , " Don't go among the Gentiles , and don't enter into any city of the Samaritans .

verses.z: 寧可往以色列家迷失的羊那裏去。
verses.e: Rather , go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel .

verses.z: 隨走隨傳，說『天國近了！』
verses.e: As you go , preach , saying , ' The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand ! '

verses.z: 醫治病人，叫死人復活，叫長大痲瘋的潔淨，把鬼趕出去。你們白白地得來，也要白白地捨去。
verses.e: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , and cast out demons . Freely you received , so freely give .

verses.z: 腰袋裏不要帶金銀銅錢；
verses.e: Don't take any gold , silver , or brass in your money belts .

verses.z: 耶穌吩咐完了十二個門徒，就離開那裏，往各城去傳道、教訓人。
verses.e: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples , he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities .

verses.z: [經上]記着說：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面預備道路』，所說的就是這個人。
verses.e: For this is he , of whom it is written , ' Behold , I send my messenger before your face , who will prepare your way before you . '

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，凡婦人所生的，沒有一個興起來大過施洗約翰的；然而天國裏最小的比他還大。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer ; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he .

verses.z: 從施洗約翰的時候到如今，天國是努力進入的，努力的人就得着了。
verses.e: From the days of John the Baptizer until now , the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence , and the violent take it by force .

verses.z: 因為眾先知和律法說預言，到約翰為止。
verses.e: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John .

verses.z: 你們若肯領受，這人就是那應當來的以利亞。
verses.e: If you are willing to receive it , this is Elijah , who is to come .

verses.z: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
verses.e: He who has ears to hear , let him hear .

verses.z: 我可用甚麼比這世代呢？好像孩童坐在街市上招呼同伴，說：
verses.e: " But to what shall I compare this generation ? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces , who call to their companions

verses.z: 我們向你們吹笛，你們不跳舞；我們向你們舉哀，你們不捶胸。
verses.e: and say , ' We played the flute for you , and you didn't dance . We mourned for you , and you didn't lament . '

verses.z: 約翰來了，也不吃也不喝，人就說他是被鬼附着的；
verses.e: For John came neither eating nor drinking , and they say , ' He has a demon . '

verses.z: 人子來了，也吃也喝，人又說他是貪食好酒的人，是稅吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧之子總以智慧為是。」
verses.e: The Son of Man came eating and drinking , and they say , ' Behold , a gluttonous man and a drunkard , a friend of tax collectors and sinners ! ' But wisdom is justified by her children . "

verses.z: 約翰在監裏聽見基督所做的事，就打發[兩個]門徒去，
verses.e: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ , he sent two of his disciples

verses.z: 耶穌在諸城中行了許多異能，那些城的人終不悔改，就在那時候責備他們，說：
verses.e: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done , because they didn't repent .

verses.z: 「哥拉汛哪，你有禍了！伯賽大啊，你有禍了！因為在你們中間所行的異能，若行在泰爾、西頓，他們早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。
verses.e: " Woe to you , Chorazin ! Woe to you , Bethsaida ! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you , they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes .

verses.z: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，泰爾、西頓所受的，比你們還容易受呢！
verses.e: But I tell you , it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you .

verses.z: 迦百農啊，你已經升到天上，將來必墜落陰間；因為在你那裏所行的異能，若行在所多瑪，它還可以存到今日。
verses.e: You , Capernaum , who are exalted to heaven , you will go down to Hades . For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you , it would have remained until today .

verses.z: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪所受的，比你還容易受呢！」
verses.e: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment , than for you . "

verses.z: 那時，耶穌說：「父啊，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。
verses.e: At that time , Jesus answered , " I thank you , Father , Lord of heaven and earth , that you hid these things from the wise and understanding , and revealed them to infants .

verses.z: 父啊，是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
verses.e: Yes , Father , for so it was well-pleasing in your sight .

verses.z: 一切所有的，都是我父交付我的；除了父，沒有人知道子；除了子和子所願意指示的，沒有人知道父。
verses.e: All things have been delivered to me by my Father . No one knows the Son , except the Father ; neither does anyone know the Father , except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him .

verses.z: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裏來，我就使你們得安息。
verses.e: " Come to me , all you who labor and are heavily burdened , and I will give you rest .

verses.z: 我心裏柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裏就必得享安息。
verses.e: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me , for I am gentle and humble in heart ; and you will find rest for your souls .

verses.z: 問他說：「那將要來的是你嗎？還是我們等候別人呢？」
verses.e: and said to him , " Are you he who comes , or should we look for another ? "

verses.z: 因為我的軛是容易的，我的擔子是輕省的。」
verses.e: For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們去，把所聽見、所看見的事告訴約翰。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Go and tell John the things which you hear and see :

verses.z: 就是瞎子看見，瘸子行走，長大痲瘋的潔淨，聾子聽見，死人復活，窮人有福音傳給他們。
verses.e: the blind receive their sight , the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , the deaf hear , the dead are raised up , and the poor have good news preached to them .

verses.z: 凡不因我跌倒的就有福了！」
verses.e: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me . "

verses.z: 他們走的時候，耶穌就對眾人講論約翰說：「你們從前出到曠野是要看甚麼呢？要看風吹動的蘆葦嗎？
verses.e: As these went their way , Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John , " What did you go out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken by the wind ?

verses.z: 你們出去到底是要看甚麼？要看穿細軟[衣服]的人嗎？那穿細軟[衣服]的人是在王宮裏。
verses.e: But what did you go out to see ? A man in soft clothing ? Behold , those who wear soft clothing are in kings ' houses .

verses.z: 你們出去究竟是為甚麼？是要看先知嗎？我告訴你們，是的，他比先知大多了。
verses.e: But why did you go out ? To see a prophet ? Yes , I tell you , and much more than a prophet .

verses.z: 那時，耶穌在安息日從麥地經過。他的門徒餓了，就掐起麥穗來吃。
verses.e: At that time , Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields . His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat .

verses.z: 那裏有一個人枯乾了一隻手。有人問耶穌說：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。
verses.e: And behold , there was a man with a withered hand . They asked him , " Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day ? " so that they might accuse him .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們中間誰有一隻羊，當安息日掉在坑裏，不把牠抓住、拉上來呢？
verses.e: He said to them , " What man is there among you who has one sheep , and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day , won't he grab on to it and lift it out ?

verses.z: 人比羊何等貴重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」
verses.e: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep ! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day . "

verses.z: 於是對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原，和那隻手一樣。
verses.e: Then he told the man , " Stretch out your hand . " He stretched it out ; and it was restored whole , just like the other .

verses.z: 法利賽人出去，商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。
verses.e: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him , how they might destroy him .

verses.z: 耶穌知道了，就離開那裏，有許多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；
verses.e: Jesus , perceiving that , withdrew from there . Great multitudes followed him ; and he healed them all ,

verses.z: 又囑咐他們，不要給他傳名。
verses.e: and commanded them that they should not make him known ,

verses.z: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：
verses.e: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet , saying ,

verses.z: 看哪！我的僕人，我所揀選、所親愛、心裏所喜悅的，我要將我的靈賜給他；他必將公理傳給外邦。
verses.e: " Behold , my servant whom I have chosen , my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased . I will put my Spirit on him . He will proclaim justice to the nations .

verses.z: 他不爭競，不喧嚷；街上也沒有人聽見他的聲音。
verses.e: He will not strive , nor shout , neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets .

verses.z: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌說：「看哪，你的門徒做安息日不可做的事了！」
verses.e: But the Pharisees , when they saw it , said to him , " Behold , your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath . "

verses.z: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷；將殘的燈火，他不吹滅；等他施行公理，叫公理得勝。
verses.e: He won't break a bruised reed . He won't quench a smoking flax , until he leads justice to victory .

verses.z: 外邦人都要仰望他的名。
verses.e: In his name , the nations will hope . "

verses.z: 當下，有人將一個被鬼附着、又瞎又啞的人帶到耶穌那裏，耶穌就醫治他，甚至那啞巴又能說話，又能看見。
verses.e: Then one possessed by a demon , blind and mute , was brought to him ; and he healed him , so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw .

verses.z: 眾人都驚奇，說：「這不是大衛的子孫嗎？」
verses.e: All the multitudes were amazed , and said , " Can this be the son of David ? "

verses.z: 但法利賽人聽見，就說：「這個人趕鬼，無非是靠着鬼王別西卜啊。」
verses.e: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said , " This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul , the prince of the demons . "

verses.z: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對他們說：「凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；一城一家自相紛爭，必站立不住；
verses.e: Knowing their thoughts , Jesus said to them , " Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation , and every city or house divided against itself will not stand .

verses.z: 若撒但趕逐撒但，就是自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？
verses.e: If Satan casts out Satan , he is divided against himself . How then will his kingdom stand ?

verses.z: 我若靠着別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠着誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。
verses.e: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons , by whom do your children cast them out ? Therefore they will be your judges .

verses.z: 我若靠着上帝的靈趕鬼，這就是上帝的國臨到你們了。
verses.e: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons , then God's Kingdom has come upon you .

verses.z: 人怎能進壯士家裏，搶奪他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的[家財]。
verses.e: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods , unless he first bind the strong man ? Then he will plunder his house .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「[經上記着]大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過嗎？
verses.e: But he said to them , " Haven't you read what David did when he was hungry , and those who were with him :

verses.z: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」
verses.e: " He who is not with me is against me , and he who doesn't gather with me , scatters .

verses.z: 所以我告訴你們：「人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都可得赦免，惟獨褻瀆聖靈，總不得赦免。
verses.e: Therefore I tell you , every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men , but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men .

verses.z: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨說話干犯聖靈的，今世來世總不得赦免。」
verses.e: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man , it will be forgiven him ; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit , it will not be forgiven him , either in this age , or in that which is to come .

verses.z: 「你們或以為樹好，果子也好；樹壞，果子也壞；因為看果子就可以知道樹。
verses.e: " Either make the tree good and its fruit good , or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt ; for the tree is known by its fruit .

verses.z: 毒蛇的種類！你們既是惡人，怎能說出好話來呢？因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。
verses.e: You offspring of vipers , how can you , being evil , speak good things ? For out of the abundance of the heart , the mouth speaks .

verses.z: 善人從他[心裏]所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他[心裏]所存的惡就發出惡來。
verses.e: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things , and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things .

verses.z: 我又告訴你們，凡人所說的閒話，當審判的日子，必要句句供出來；
verses.e: I tell you that every idle word that men speak , they will give account of it in the day of judgment .

verses.z: 因為要憑你的話定你為義，也要憑你的話定你有罪。」
verses.e: For by your words you will be justified , and by your words you will be condemned . "

verses.z: 當時，有幾個文士和法利賽人對耶穌說：「夫子，我們願意你顯個神蹟給我們看。」
verses.e: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered , " Teacher , we want to see a sign from you . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「一個邪惡淫亂的世代求看神蹟，除了先知約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。
verses.e: But he answered them , " An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign , but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet .

verses.z: 他怎麼進了上帝的殿，吃了陳設餅，這餅不是他和跟從他的人可以吃得，惟獨祭司才可以吃。
verses.e: how he entered into God's house and ate the show bread , which was not lawful for him to eat , nor for those who were with him , but only for the priests ?

verses.z: 約拿三日三夜在大魚肚腹中，人子也要這樣三日三夜在地裏頭。
verses.e: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish , so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth .

verses.z: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪，在這裏有一人比約拿更大！
verses.e: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it , for they repented at the preaching of Jonah ; and behold , someone greater than Jonah is here .

verses.z: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪；因為她從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪，在這裏有一人比所羅門更大！」
verses.e: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it , for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon ; and behold , someone greater than Solomon is here .

verses.z: 「污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇[之處]，卻尋不着。
verses.e: " When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man , he passes through waterless places seeking rest , and doesn't find it .

verses.z: 於是說：『我要回到我所出來的屋裏去。』到了，就看見裏面空閒，打掃乾淨，修飾好了，
verses.e: Then he says , ' I will return into my house from which I came ; ' and when he has come back , he finds it empty , swept , and put in order .

verses.z: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裏。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。這邪惡的世代也要如此。」
verses.e: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is , and they enter in and dwell there . The last state of that man becomes worse than the first . Even so will it be also to this evil generation . "

verses.z: 耶穌還對眾人說話的時候，不料他母親和他弟兄站在外邊，要與他說話。
verses.e: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes , behold , his mother and his brothers stood outside , seeking to speak to him .

verses.z: 有人告訴他說：「看哪，你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要與你說話。」
verses.e: One said to him , " Behold , your mother and your brothers stand outside , seeking to speak to you . "

verses.z: 他卻回答那人說：「誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？」
verses.e: But he answered him who spoke to him , " Who is my mother ? Who are my brothers ? "

verses.z: 就伸手指着門徒，說：「看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
verses.e: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples , and said , " Behold , my mother and my brothers !

verses.z: 再者，律法上所記的，當安息日，祭司在殿裏犯了安息日還是沒有罪，你們沒有念過嗎？
verses.e: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless ?

verses.z: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母親了。」
verses.e: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven , he is my brother , and sister , and mother . "

verses.z: 但我告訴你們，在這裏有一人比殿更大。
verses.e: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here .

verses.z: 『我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。』你們若明白這話的意思，就不將無罪的當作有罪的了。
verses.e: But if you had known what this means , ' I desire mercy , and not sacrifice , ' you wouldn't have condemned the guiltless .

verses.z: 因為人子是安息日的主。」
verses.e: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath . "

verses.z: 耶穌離開那地方，進了一個會堂。
verses.e: He departed from there and went into their synagogue .

verses.z: 當那一天，耶穌從房子裏出來，坐在海邊。
verses.e: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside .

verses.z: 門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻呢？」
verses.e: The disciples came , and said to him , " Why do you speak to them in parables ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「因為天國的奧祕只叫你們知道，不叫他們知道。
verses.e: He answered them , " To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven , but it is not given to them .

verses.z: 凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；凡沒有的，連他所有的，也要奪去。
verses.e: For whoever has , to him will be given , and he will have abundance ; but whoever doesn't have , from him will be taken away even that which he has .

verses.z: 所以我用比喻對他們講，是因他們看也看不見，聽也聽不見，也不明白。
verses.e: Therefore I speak to them in parables , because seeing they don't see , and hearing , they don't hear , neither do they understand .

verses.z: 在他們身上，正應了以賽亞的預言，說：你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得；
verses.e: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled , which says , ' By hearing you will hear , and will in no way understand ; Seeing you will see , and will in no way perceive ;

verses.z: 因為這百姓油蒙了心，耳朵發沉，眼睛閉着，恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。
verses.e: for this people's heart has grown callous , their ears are dull of hearing , and they have closed their eyes ; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes , hear with their ears , understand with their heart , and would turn again , and I would heal them . '

verses.z: 「但你們的眼睛是有福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。
verses.e: " But blessed are your eyes , for they see ; and your ears , for they hear .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，從前有許多先知和義人要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。」
verses.e: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see , and didn't see them ; and to hear the things which you hear , and didn't hear them .

verses.z: 「所以，你們當聽這撒種的比喻。
verses.e: " Hear , then , the parable of the farmer .

verses.z: 凡聽見天國道理不明白的，那惡者就來，把所撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是撒在路旁的了。
verses.e: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn't understand it , the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart . This is what was sown by the roadside .

verses.z: 有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下，眾人都站在岸上。
verses.e: Great multitudes gathered to him , so that he entered into a boat and sat ; and all the multitude stood on the beach .

verses.z: 撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，當下歡喜領受，
verses.e: What was sown on the rocky places , this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it ;

verses.z: 只因心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
verses.e: yet he has no root in himself , but endures for a while . When oppression or persecution arises because of the word , immediately he stumbles .

verses.z: 撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑把道擠住了，不能結實。
verses.e: What was sown among the thorns , this is he who hears the word , but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word , and he becomes unfruitful .

verses.z: 撒在好地上的，就是人聽道明白了，後來結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」
verses.e: What was sown on the good ground , this is he who hears the word and understands it , who most certainly bears fruit and produces , some one hundred times as much , some sixty , and some thirty . "

verses.z: 耶穌又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像人撒好種在田裏，
verses.e: He set another parable before them , saying , " The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field ,

verses.z: 及至人睡覺的時候，有仇敵來，將稗子撒在麥子裏就走了。
verses.e: but while people slept , his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat , and went away .

verses.z: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。
verses.e: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain , then the darnel weeds appeared also .

verses.z: 田主的僕人來告訴他說：『主啊，你不是撒好種在田裏嗎？從哪裏來的稗子呢？』
verses.e: The servants of the householder came and said to him , ' Sir , didn't you sow good seed in your field ? Where did these darnel weeds come from ? '

verses.z: 主人說：『這是仇敵做的。』僕人說：『你要我們去薅出來嗎？』
verses.e: " He said to them , ' An enemy has done this . ' " The servants asked him , ' Do you want us to go and gather them up ? '

verses.z: 主人說：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，連麥子也拔出來。
verses.e: " But he said , ' No , lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds , you root up the wheat with them .

verses.z: 他用比喻對他們講許多道理，說：「有一個撒種的出去撒種；
verses.e: He spoke to them many things in parables , saying , " Behold , a farmer went out to sow .

verses.z: 容這兩樣一齊長，等着收割。當收割的時候，我要對收割的人說，先將稗子薅出來，捆成捆，留着燒；惟有麥子要收在倉裏。』」
verses.e: Let both grow together until the harvest , and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers , " First , gather up the darnel weeds , and bind them in bundles to burn them ; but gather the wheat into my barn . " ' "

verses.z: 他又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在田裏。
verses.e: He set another parable before them , saying , " The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took , and sowed in his field ,

verses.z: 這原是百種裏最小的，等到長起來，卻比各樣的菜都大，且成了樹，天上的飛鳥來宿在它的枝上。」
verses.e: which indeed is smaller than all seeds . But when it is grown , it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree , so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches . "

verses.z: 他又對他們講個比喻說：「天國好像麵酵，有婦人拿來，藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」
verses.e: He spoke another parable to them . " The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal , until it was all leavened . "

verses.z: 這都是耶穌用比喻對眾人說的話；若不用比喻，就不對他們說甚麼。
verses.e: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes ; and without a parable , he didn't speak to them ,

verses.z: 這是要應驗先知的話，說：我要開口用比喻，把創世以來所隱藏的事發明出來。
verses.e: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet , saying , " I will open my mouth in parables ; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world . "

verses.z: 當下，耶穌離開眾人，進了房子。他的門徒進前來，說：「請把田間稗子的比喻講給我們聽。」
verses.e: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away , and went into the house . His disciples came to him , saying , " Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field . "

verses.z: 他回答說：「那撒好種的就是人子；
verses.e: He answered them , " He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man ,

verses.z: 田地就是世界；好種就是天國之子；稗子就是那惡者之子；
verses.e: the field is the world , the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom , and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one .

verses.z: 撒稗子的仇敵就是魔鬼；收割的時候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。
verses.e: The enemy who sowed them is the devil . The harvest is the end of the age , and the reapers are angels .

verses.z: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
verses.e: As he sowed , some seeds fell by the roadside , and the birds came and devoured them .

verses.z: 將稗子薅出來用火焚燒，世界的末了也要如此。
verses.e: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire ; so will it be at the end of this age .

verses.z: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作惡的，從他國裏挑出來，
verses.e: The Son of Man will send out his angels , and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity ,

verses.z: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。
verses.e: and will cast them into the furnace of fire . There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

verses.z: 那時，義人在他們父的國裏，要發出光來，像太陽一樣。有耳[可聽]的，就應當聽！」
verses.e: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father . He who has ears to hear , let him hear .

verses.z: 「天國好像寶貝藏在地裏，人遇見了就把它藏起來，歡歡喜喜地去變賣一切所有的，買這塊地。
verses.e: " Again , the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field , which a man found and hid . In his joy , he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field .

verses.z: 天國又好像買賣人尋找好珠子，
verses.e: " Again , the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls ,

verses.z: 遇見一顆重價的珠子，就去變賣他一切所有的，買了這顆珠子。
verses.e: who having found one pearl of great price , he went and sold all that he had and bought it .

verses.z: 天國又好像網撒在海裏，聚攏各樣水族，
verses.e: " Again , the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind ,

verses.z: 網既滿了，人就拉上岸來，坐下，揀好的收在器具裏，將不好的丟棄了。
verses.e: which , when it was filled , fishermen drew up on the beach . They sat down and gathered the good into containers , but the bad they threw away .

verses.z: 世界的末了也要這樣。天使要出來，從義人中把惡人分別出來，
verses.e: So it will be in the end of the world . The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous ,

verses.z: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
verses.e: Others fell on rocky ground , where they didn't have much soil , and immediately they sprang up , because they had no depth of earth .

verses.z: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」
verses.e: and will cast them into the furnace of fire . There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth . "

verses.z: [耶穌說]：「這一切的話你們都明白了嗎？」他們說：「我們明白了。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Have you understood all these things ? " They answered him , " Yes , Lord . "

verses.z: 他說：「凡文士受教作天國的門徒，就像一個家主從他庫裏拿出新舊的東西來。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder , who brings out of his treasure new and old things . "

verses.z: 耶穌說完了這些比喻，就離開那裏，
verses.e: When Jesus had finished these parables , he departed from there .

verses.z: 來到自己的家鄉，在會堂裏教訓人，甚至他們都希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這等智慧和異能呢？
verses.e: Coming into his own country , he taught them in their synagogue , so that they were astonished and said , " Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works ?

verses.z: 這不是木匠的兒子嗎？他母親不是叫馬利亞嗎？他弟兄們不是叫雅各、約西、西門、猶大嗎？
verses.e: Isn't this the carpenter's son ? Isn't his mother called Mary , and his brothers James , Joses , Simon , and Judas ?

verses.z: 他妹妹們不是都在我們這裏嗎？這人從哪裏有這一切的事呢？」
verses.e: Aren't all of his sisters with us ? Where then did this man get all of these things ? "

verses.z: 他們就厭棄他。耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」
verses.e: They were offended by him . But Jesus said to them , " A prophet is not without honor , except in his own country and in his own house . "

verses.z: 耶穌因為他們不信，就在那裏不多行異能了。
verses.e: He didn't do many mighty works there because of their unbelief .

verses.z: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
verses.e: When the sun had risen , they were scorched . Because they had no root , they withered away .

verses.z: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它擠住了；
verses.e: Others fell among thorns . The thorns grew up and choked them .

verses.z: 又有落在好土裏的，就結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。
verses.e: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit : some one hundred times as much , some sixty , and some thirty .

verses.z: 有耳[可聽]的，就應當聽！」
verses.e: He who has ears to hear , let him hear . "

verses.z: 那時，分封的王希律聽見耶穌的名聲，
verses.e: At that time , Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus ,

verses.z: 於是打發人去，在監裏斬了約翰，
verses.e: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison .

verses.z: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給了女子；女子拿去給她母親。
verses.e: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady ; and she brought it to her mother .

verses.z: 約翰的門徒來，把屍首領去埋葬了，就去告訴耶穌。
verses.e: His disciples came , took the body , and buried it . Then they went and told Jesus .

verses.z: 耶穌聽見了，就上船從那裏獨自退到野地裏去。眾人聽見，就從各城裏步行跟隨他。
verses.e: Now when Jesus heard this , he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart . When the multitudes heard it , they followed him on foot from the cities .

verses.z: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，治好了他們的病人。
verses.e: Jesus went out , and he saw a great multitude . He had compassion on them and healed their sick .

verses.z: 天將晚的時候，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，時候已經過了，請叫眾人散開，他們好往村子裏去，自己買吃的。」
verses.e: When evening had come , his disciples came to him , saying , " This place is deserted , and the hour is already late . Send the multitudes away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves food . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「不用他們去，你們給他們吃吧！」
verses.e: But Jesus said to them , " They don't need to go away . You give them something to eat . "

verses.z: 門徒說：「我們這裏只有五個餅，兩條魚。」
verses.e: They told him , " We only have here five loaves and two fish . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「拿過來給我。」
verses.e: He said , " Bring them here to me . "

verses.z: 於是吩咐眾人坐在草地上，就拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒又遞給眾人。
verses.e: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass ; and he took the five loaves and the two fish , and looking up to heaven , he blessed , broke and gave the loaves to the disciples ; and the disciples gave to the multitudes .

verses.z: 就對臣僕說：「這是施洗的約翰從死裏復活，所以這些異能從他裏面發出來。」
verses.e: and said to his servants , " This is John the Baptizer . He is risen from the dead . That is why these powers work in him . "

verses.z: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了，把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
verses.e: They all ate and were filled . They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces .

verses.z: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，約有五千。
verses.e: Those who ate were about five thousand men , in addition to women and children .

verses.z: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊去，等他叫眾人散開。
verses.e: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .

verses.z: 散了眾人以後，他就獨自上山去禱告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那裏。
verses.e: After he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into the mountain by himself to pray . When evening had come , he was there alone .

verses.z: 那時船在海中，因風不順，被浪搖撼。
verses.e: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea , distressed by the waves , for the wind was contrary .

verses.z: 夜裏四更天，耶穌在海面上走，往門徒那裏去。
verses.e: In the fourth watch of the night , Jesus came to them , walking on the sea .

verses.z: 門徒看見他在海面上走，就驚慌了，說：「是個鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起來。
verses.e: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea , they were troubled , saying , " It's a ghost ! " and they cried out for fear .

verses.z: 耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心，是我，不要怕！」
verses.e: But immediately Jesus spoke to them , saying , " Cheer up ! It is I ! Don't be afraid . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「主，如果是你，請叫我從水面上走到你那裏去。」
verses.e: Peter answered him and said , " Lord , if it is you , command me to come to you on the waters . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你來吧。」彼得就從船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶穌那裏去；
verses.e: He said , " Come ! " Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus .

verses.z: 起先，希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，把約翰拿住，鎖在監裏。
verses.e: For Herod had arrested John , bound him , and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias , his brother Philip's wife .

verses.z: 只因見風甚大，就害怕，將要沉下去，便喊着說：「主啊，救我！」
verses.e: But when he saw that the wind was strong , he was afraid , and beginning to sink , he cried out , saying , " Lord , save me ! "

verses.z: 耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，說：「你這小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑呢？」
verses.e: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand , took hold of him , and said to him , " You of little faith , why did you doubt ? "

verses.z: 他們上了船，風就住了。
verses.e: When they got up into the boat , the wind ceased .

verses.z: 在船上的人都拜他，說：「你真是上帝的兒子了。」
verses.e: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him , saying , " You are truly the Son of God ! "

verses.z: 他們過了[海]，來到革尼撒勒地方。
verses.e: When they had crossed over , they came to the land of Gennesaret .

verses.z: 那裏的人一認出是耶穌，就打發人到周圍地方去，把所有的病人帶到他那裏，
verses.e: When the people of that place recognized him , they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick ;

verses.z: 只求耶穌准他們摸他的衣裳繸子；摸着的人就都好了。
verses.e: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment . As many as touched it were made whole .

verses.z: 因為約翰曾對他說：「你娶這婦人是不合理的。」
verses.e: For John said to him , " It is not lawful for you to have her . "

verses.z: 希律就想要殺他，只是怕百姓，因為他們以約翰為先知。
verses.e: When he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .

verses.z: 到了希律的生日，希羅底的女兒在眾人面前跳舞，使希律歡喜。
verses.e: But when Herod's birthday came , the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod .

verses.z: 希律就起誓，應許隨她所求的給她。
verses.e: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask .
