verses.z: 女兒被母親所使，就說：「請把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏，拿來給我。」
verses.e: She , being prompted by her mother , said , " Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer . "

verses.z: 王便憂愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐給她；
verses.e: The king was grieved , but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him , he commanded it to be given ,

verses.z: 那時，有法利賽人和文士從耶路撒冷來見耶穌，說：
verses.e: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem , saying ,

verses.z: 耶穌就叫了眾人來，對他們說：「你們要聽，也要明白。
verses.e: He summoned the multitude , and said to them , " Hear , and understand .

verses.z: 入口的不能污穢人，出口的乃能污穢人。」
verses.e: That which enters into the mouth doesn't defile the man ; but that which proceeds out of the mouth , this defiles the man . "

verses.z: 當時，門徒進前來對他說：「法利賽人聽見這話，不服，你知道嗎？」
verses.e: Then the disciples came and said to him , " Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「凡栽種的物，若不是我天父栽種的，必要拔出來。
verses.e: But he answered , " Every plant which my heavenly Father didn't plant will be uprooted .

verses.z: 任憑他們吧！他們是瞎眼領路的；若是瞎子領瞎子，兩個人都要掉在坑裏。」
verses.e: Leave them alone . They are blind guides of the blind . If the blind guide the blind , both will fall into a pit . "

verses.z: 彼得對耶穌說：「請將這比喻講給我們聽。」
verses.e: Peter answered him , " Explain the parable to us . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們到如今還不明白嗎？
verses.e: So Jesus said , " Do you also still not understand ?

verses.z: 豈不知凡入口的，是運到肚子裏，又落在茅廁裏嗎？
verses.e: Don't you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body ?

verses.z: 惟獨出口的，是從心裏發出來的，這才污穢人。
verses.e: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart , and they defile the man .

verses.z: 因為從心裏發出來的，有惡念、凶殺、姦淫、苟合、偷盜、妄證、謗讟。
verses.e: For out of the heart come evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , sexual sins , thefts , false testimony , and blasphemies .

verses.z: 「你的門徒為甚麼犯古人的遺傳呢？因為吃飯的時候，他們不洗手。」
verses.e: " Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders ? For they don't wash their hands when they eat bread . "

verses.z: 這都是污穢人的；至於不洗手吃飯，那卻不污穢人。」
verses.e: These are the things which defile the man ; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn't defile the man . "

verses.z: 耶穌離開那裏，退到泰爾、西頓的境內去。
verses.e: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon .

verses.z: 有一個迦南婦人，從那地方出來，喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我！我女兒被鬼附得甚苦。」
verses.e: Behold , a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried , saying , " Have mercy on me , Lord , you son of David ! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon ! "

verses.z: 耶穌卻一言不答。門徒進前來，求他說：「這婦人在我們後頭喊叫，請打發她走吧。」
verses.e: But he answered her not a word . His disciples came and begged him , saying , " Send her away ; for she cries after us . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我奉差遣不過是到以色列家迷失的羊那裏去。」
verses.e: But he answered , " I wasn't sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel . "

verses.z: 那婦人來拜他，說：「主啊，幫助我！」
verses.e: But she came and worshiped him , saying , " Lord , help me . "

verses.z: 他回答說：「不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。」
verses.e: But he answered , " It is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs . "

verses.z: 婦人說：「主啊，不錯；但是狗也吃牠主人桌子上掉下來的碎渣兒。」
verses.e: But she said , " Yes , Lord , but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters ' table . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「婦人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，給你成全了吧。」從那時候，她女兒就好了。
verses.e: Then Jesus answered her , " Woman , great is your faith ! Be it done to you even as you desire . " And her daughter was healed from that hour .

verses.z: 耶穌離開那地方，來到靠近加利利的海邊，就上山坐下。
verses.e: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee ; and he went up on the mountain and sat there .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們為甚麼因着你們的遺傳犯上帝的誡命呢？
verses.e: He answered them , " Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition ?

verses.z: 有許多人到他那裏，帶着瘸子、瞎子、啞巴、有殘疾的，和好些別的病人，都放在他腳前；他就治好了他們。
verses.e: Great multitudes came to him , having with them the lame , blind , mute , maimed , and many others , and they put them down at his feet . He healed them ,

verses.z: 甚至眾人都希奇；因為看見啞巴說話，殘疾的痊癒，瘸子行走，瞎子看見，他們就歸榮耀給以色列的上帝。
verses.e: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking , the injured healed , the lame walking , and the blind seeing — and they glorified the God of Israel .

verses.z: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。我不願意叫他們餓着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」
verses.e: Jesus summoned his disciples and said , " I have compassion on the multitude , because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat . I don't want to send them away fasting , or they might faint on the way . "

verses.z: 門徒說：「我們在這野地，哪裏有這麼多的餅叫這許多人吃飽呢？」
verses.e: The disciples said to him , " Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「有七個，還有幾條小魚。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " How many loaves do you have ? " They said , " Seven , and a few small fish . "

verses.z: 他就吩咐眾人坐在地上，
verses.e: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground ;

verses.z: 拿着這七個餅和幾條魚，祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒；門徒又遞給眾人。
verses.e: and he took the seven loaves and the fish . He gave thanks and broke them , and gave to the disciples , and the disciples to the multitudes .

verses.z: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，裝滿了七個筐子。
verses.e: They all ate and were filled . They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over .

verses.z: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，共有四千。
verses.e: Those who ate were four thousand men , in addition to women and children .

verses.z: 耶穌叫眾人散去，就上船，來到馬加丹的境界。
verses.e: Then he sent away the multitudes , got into the boat , and came into the borders of Magdala .

verses.z: 上帝說：『當孝敬父母』；又說：『咒罵父母的，必治死他。』
verses.e: For God commanded , ' Honor your father and your mother , ' and , ' He who speaks evil of father or mother , let him be put to death . '

verses.z: 你們倒說：『無論何人對父母說：我所當奉給你的已經作了供獻，
verses.e: But you say , ' Whoever may tell his father or his mother , " Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God , "

verses.z: 他就可以不孝敬父母。』這就是你們藉着遺傳，廢了上帝的誡命。
verses.e: he shall not honor his father or mother . ' You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition .

verses.z: 假冒為善的人哪，以賽亞指着你們說的預言是不錯的。他說：
verses.e: You hypocrites ! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you , saying ,

verses.z: 這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我；
verses.e: ' These people draw near to me with their mouth , and honor me with their lips ; but their heart is far from me .

verses.z: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人，所以拜我也是枉然。」
verses.e: And they worship me in vain , teaching as doctrine rules made by men . ' "

verses.z: 法利賽人和撒都該人來試探耶穌，請他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看。
verses.e: The Pharisees and Sadducees came , and testing him , asked him to show them a sign from heaven .

verses.z: 也不記得那七個餅分給四千人、又收拾了多少筐子[的零碎]嗎？
verses.e: or the seven loaves for the four thousand , and how many baskets you took up ?

verses.z: 我對你們說：『要防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵』，這話不是指着餅說的，你們怎麼不明白呢？」
verses.e: How is it that you don't perceive that I didn't speak to you concerning bread ? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees . "

verses.z: 門徒這才曉得他說的不是叫他們防備餅的酵，乃是防備法利賽人和撒都該人的教訓。
verses.e: Then they understood that he didn't tell them to beware of the yeast of bread , but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees .

verses.z: 耶穌到了凱撒利亞‧腓立比的境內，就問門徒說：「人說我－－人子是誰？」
verses.e: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi , he asked his disciples , saying , " Who do men say that I , the Son of Man , am ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是耶利米或是先知裏的一位。」
verses.e: They said , " Some say John the Baptizer , some , Elijah , and others , Jeremiah or one of the prophets . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們說我是誰？」
verses.e: He said to them , " But who do you say that I am ? "

verses.z: 西門‧彼得回答說：「你是基督，是永生上帝的兒子。」
verses.e: Simon Peter answered , " You are the Christ , the Son of the living God . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「西門‧巴‧約拿，你是有福的！因為這不是屬血肉[的]指示你的，乃是我在天上的父指示的。
verses.e: Jesus answered him , " Blessed are you , Simon Bar Jonah , for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you , but my Father who is in heaven .

verses.z: 我還告訴你，你是彼得，我要把我的教會建造在這磐石上；陰間的權柄不能勝過他。
verses.e: I also tell you that you are Peter , and on this rock I will build my assembly , and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it .

verses.z: 我要把天國的鑰匙給你，凡你在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。」
verses.e: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven , and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven ; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「晚上天發紅，你們就說：『天必要晴。』
verses.e: But he answered them , " When it is evening , you say , ' It will be fair weather , for the sky is red . '

verses.z: 當下，耶穌囑咐門徒，不可對人說他是基督。
verses.e: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ .

verses.z: 從此，耶穌才指示門徒，他必須上耶路撒冷去，受長老、祭司長、文士許多的苦，並且被殺，第三日復活。
verses.e: From that time , Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders , chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and the third day be raised up .

verses.z: 彼得就拉着他，勸他說：「主啊，萬不可如此！這事必不臨到你身上。」
verses.e: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him , saying , " Far be it from you , Lord ! This will never be done to you . "

verses.z: 耶穌轉過來，對彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！你是絆我腳的；因為你不體貼上帝的意思，只體貼人的意思。」
verses.e: But he turned and said to Peter , " Get behind me , Satan ! You are a stumbling block to me , for you are not setting your mind on the things of God , but on the things of men . "

verses.z: 於是耶穌對門徒說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
verses.e: Then Jesus said to his disciples , " If anyone desires to come after me , let him deny himself , take up his cross , and follow me .

verses.z: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我喪掉生命的，必得着生命。
verses.e: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it , and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it .

verses.z: 人若賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
verses.e: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life ? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life ?

verses.z: 人子要在他父的榮耀裏，同着眾使者降臨；那時候，他要照各人的行為報應各人。
verses.e: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels , and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前必看見人子降臨在他的國裏。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom . "

verses.z: 早晨天發紅，又發黑，你們就說：『今日必有風雨。』你們知道分辨天上的氣色，倒不能分辨這時候的神蹟。
verses.e: In the morning , ' It will be foul weather today , for the sky is red and threatening . ' Hypocrites ! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky , but you can't discern the signs of the times !

verses.z: 一個邪惡淫亂的世代求神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他看。」耶穌就離開他們去了。
verses.e: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign , and there will be no sign given to it , except the sign of the prophet Jonah . " He left them and departed .

verses.z: 門徒渡到那邊去，忘了帶餅。
verses.e: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees . "

verses.z: 門徒彼此議論說：「這是因為我們沒有帶餅吧。」
verses.e: They reasoned among themselves , saying , " We brought no bread . "

verses.z: 耶穌看出來，就說：「你們這小信的人，為甚麼因為沒有餅彼此議論呢？
verses.e: Jesus , perceiving it , said , " Why do you reason among yourselves , you of little faith , because you have brought no bread ?

verses.z: 你們還不明白嗎？不記得那五個餅分給五千人、又收拾了多少籃子[的零碎]嗎？
verses.e: Don't you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand , and how many baskets you took up ,

verses.z: 過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，暗暗地上了高山，
verses.e: After six days , Jesus took with him Peter , James , and John his brother , and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves .

verses.z: 門徒問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」
verses.e: His disciples asked him , saying , " Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「以利亞固然先來，並要復興萬事；
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Elijah indeed comes first , and will restore all things ;

verses.z: 只是我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，人卻不認識他，竟任意待他。人子也將要這樣受他們的害。」
verses.e: but I tell you that Elijah has come already , and they didn't recognize him , but did to him whatever they wanted to . Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them . "

verses.z: 門徒這才明白耶穌所說的是指着施洗的約翰。
verses.e: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer .

verses.z: 耶穌和門徒到了眾人那裏，有一個人來見耶穌，跪下，
verses.e: When they came to the multitude , a man came to him , kneeling down to him and saying ,

verses.z: 說：「主啊，憐憫我的兒子！他害癲癇的病很苦，屢次跌在火裏，屢次跌在水裏。
verses.e: " Lord , have mercy on my son , for he is epileptic and suffers grievously ; for he often falls into the fire , and often into the water .

verses.z: 我帶他到你門徒那裏，他們卻不能醫治他。」
verses.e: So I brought him to your disciples , and they could not cure him . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧！」
verses.e: Jesus answered , " Faithless and perverse generation ! How long will I be with you ? How long will I bear with you ? Bring him here to me . "

verses.z: 耶穌斥責那鬼，鬼就出來；從此孩子就痊癒了。
verses.e: Jesus rebuked the demon , and it went out of him , and the boy was cured from that hour .

verses.z: 門徒暗暗地到耶穌跟前，說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出那鬼呢？」
verses.e: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately , and said , " Why weren't we able to cast it out ? "

verses.z: 就在他們面前變了形像，臉面明亮如日頭，衣裳潔白如光。
verses.e: He was changed before them . His face shone like the sun , and his garments became as white as the light .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「是因你們的信心小。我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說：『你從這邊挪到那邊』，它也必挪去；並且你們沒有一件不能做的事了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Because of your unbelief . For most certainly I tell you , if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed , you will tell this mountain , ' Move from here to there , ' and it will move ; and nothing will be impossible for you .

verses.z: 至於這一類的鬼，若不禱告、禁食，他就不出來。」
verses.e: But this kind doesn't go out except by prayer and fasting . "

verses.z: 他們還住在加利利的時候，耶穌對門徒說：「人子將要被交在人手裏。
verses.e: While they were staying in Galilee , Jesus said to them , " The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men ,

verses.z: 他們要殺害他，第三日他要復活。」門徒就大大地憂愁。
verses.e: and they will kill him , and the third day he will be raised up . " They were exceedingly sorry .

verses.z: 到了迦百農，有收丁稅的人來見彼得，說：「你們的先生不納丁稅嗎？」
verses.e: When they had come to Capernaum , those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter , and said , " Doesn't your teacher pay the didrachma ? "

verses.z: 彼得說：「納。」他進了屋子，耶穌先向他說：「西門，你的意思如何？世上的君王向誰征收關稅、丁稅？是向自己的兒子呢？是向外人呢？」
verses.e: He said , " Yes . " When he came into the house , Jesus anticipated him , saying , " What do you think , Simon ? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute ? From their children , or from strangers ? "

verses.z: 彼得說：「是向外人。」耶穌說：「既然如此，兒子就可以免稅了。
verses.e: Peter said to him , " From strangers . " Jesus said to him , " Therefore the children are exempt .

verses.z: 但恐怕觸犯他們，你且往海邊去釣魚，把先釣上來的魚拿起來，開了牠的口，必得一塊錢，可以拿去給他們，作你我的稅銀。」
verses.e: But , lest we cause them to stumble , go to the sea , cast a hook , and take up the first fish that comes up . When you have opened its mouth , you will find a stater coin . Take that , and give it to them for me and you . "

verses.z: 忽然，有摩西、以利亞向他們顯現，同耶穌說話。
verses.e: Behold , Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him .

verses.z: 彼得對耶穌說：「主啊，我們在這裏真好！你若願意，我就在這裏搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」
verses.e: Peter answered and said to Jesus , " Lord , it is good for us to be here . If you want , let's make three tents here : one for you , one for Moses , and one for Elijah . "

verses.z: 說話之間，忽然有一朵光明的雲彩遮蓋他們，且有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。你們要聽他！」
verses.e: While he was still speaking , behold , a bright cloud overshadowed them . Behold , a voice came out of the cloud , saying , " This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased . Listen to him . "

verses.z: 門徒聽見，就俯伏在地，極其害怕。
verses.e: When the disciples heard it , they fell on their faces , and were very afraid .

verses.z: 耶穌進前來，摸他們，說：「起來，不要害怕！」
verses.e: Jesus came and touched them and said , " Get up , and don't be afraid . "

verses.z: 他們舉目不見一人，只見耶穌在那裏。
verses.e: Lifting up their eyes , they saw no one , except Jesus alone .

verses.z: 下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」
verses.e: As they were coming down from the mountain , Jesus commanded them , saying , " Don't tell anyone what you saw , until the Son of Man has risen from the dead . "

verses.z: 當時，門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「天國裏誰是最大的？」
verses.e: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus , saying , " Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven ? "

verses.z: 「你們要小心，不可輕看這小子裏的一個；我告訴你們，他們的使者在天上，常見我天父的面。
verses.e: See that you don't despise one of these little ones , for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven .
For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost .

verses.z: 一個人若有一百隻羊，一隻走迷了路，你們的意思如何？他豈不撇下這九十九隻，往山裏去找那隻迷路的羊嗎？
verses.e: " What do you think ? If a man has one hundred sheep , and one of them goes astray , doesn't he leave the ninety-nine , go to the mountains , and seek that which has gone astray ?

verses.z: 若是找着了，我實在告訴你們，他為這一隻羊歡喜，比為那沒有迷路的九十九隻歡喜還大呢！
verses.e: If he finds it , most certainly I tell you , he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray .

verses.z: 你們在天上的父也是這樣，不願意這小子裏失喪一個。」
verses.e: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish .

verses.z: 「倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁着只有他和你在一處的時候，指出他的錯來。他若聽你，你便得了你的弟兄；
verses.e: " If your brother sins against you , go , show him his fault between you and him alone . If he listens to you , you have gained back your brother .

verses.z: 他若不聽，你就另外帶一兩個人同去，要憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都可定準。
verses.e: But if he doesn't listen , take one or two more with you , that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .

verses.z: 若是不聽他們，就告訴教會；若是不聽教會，就看他像外邦人和稅吏一樣。
verses.e: If he refuses to listen to them , tell it to the assembly . If he refuses to hear the assembly also , let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector .

verses.z: 「我實在告訴你們，凡你們在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你們在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven , and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven .

verses.z: 我又告訴你們，若是你們中間有兩個人在地上同心合意地求甚麼事，我在天上的父必為他們成全。
verses.e: Again , assuredly I tell you , that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask , it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven .

verses.z: 耶穌便叫一個小孩子來，使他站在他們當中，
verses.e: Jesus called a little child to himself , and set him in the middle of them

verses.z: 因為無論在哪裏，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裏就有我在他們中間。」
verses.e: For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there I am in the middle of them . "

verses.z: 那時，彼得進前來，對耶穌說：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我當饒恕他幾次呢？到七次可以嗎？」
verses.e: Then Peter came and said to him , " Lord , how often shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? Until seven times ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我對你說，不是到七次，乃是到七十個七次。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " I don't tell you until seven times , but , until seventy times seven .

verses.z: 天國好像一個王要和他僕人算帳。
verses.e: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants .

verses.z: 才算的時候，有人帶了一個欠一千萬銀子的來。
verses.e: When he had begun to settle , one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents .

verses.z: 因為他沒有甚麼償還之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子兒女，並一切所有的都賣了償還。
verses.e: But because he couldn't pay , his lord commanded him to be sold , with his wife , his children , and all that he had , and payment to be made .

verses.z: 那僕人就俯伏拜他，說：『主啊，寬容我，將來我都要還清。』
verses.e: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him , saying , ' Lord , have patience with me , and I will repay you all ! '

verses.z: 那僕人的主人就動了慈心，把他釋放了，並且免了他的債。
verses.e: The lord of that servant , being moved with compassion , released him and forgave him the debt .

verses.z: 「那僕人出來，遇見他的一個同伴欠他十兩銀子，便揪着他，掐住他的喉嚨，說：『你把所欠的還我！』
verses.e: " But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii , and he grabbed him and took him by the throat , saying , ' Pay me what you owe ! '

verses.z: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，說：『寬容我吧，將來我必還清。』
verses.e: " So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him , saying , ' Have patience with me , and I will repay you ! '

verses.z: 說：「我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成小孩子的樣式，斷不得進天國。
verses.e: and said , " Most certainly I tell you , unless you turn and become as little children , you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven .

verses.z: 他不肯，竟去把他下在監裏，等他還了所欠的債。
verses.e: He would not , but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due .

verses.z: 眾同伴看見他所做的事就甚憂愁，去把這事都告訴了主人。
verses.e: So when his fellow servants saw what was done , they were exceedingly sorry , and came and told their lord all that was done .

verses.z: 於是主人叫了他來，對他說：『你這惡奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，
verses.e: Then his lord called him in and said to him , ' You wicked servant ! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me .

verses.z: 你不應當憐恤你的同伴，像我憐恤你嗎？』
verses.e: Shouldn't you also have had mercy on your fellow servant , even as I had mercy on you ? '

verses.z: 主人就大怒，把他交給掌刑的，等他還清了所欠的債。
verses.e: His lord was angry , and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him .

verses.z: 你們各人若不從心裏饒恕你的弟兄，我天父也要這樣待你們了。」
verses.e: So my heavenly Father will also do to you , if you don't each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds . "

verses.z: 所以，凡自己謙卑像這小孩子的，他在天國裏就是最大的。
verses.e: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven .

verses.z: 凡為我的名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我。」
verses.e: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me ,

verses.z: 「凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，沉在深海裏。
verses.e: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble , it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea .

verses.z: 這世界有禍了，因為將人絆倒；絆倒人的事是免不了的，但那絆倒人的有禍了！
verses.e: " Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling ! For it must be that the occasions come , but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes !

verses.z: 倘若你一隻手，或是一隻腳，叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉。你缺一隻手，或是一隻腳，進入永生，強如有兩手兩腳被丟在永火裏。
verses.e: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble , cut it off and cast it from you . It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled , rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire .

verses.z: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就把它剜出來丟掉。你只有一隻眼進入[永]生，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄的火裏。」
verses.e: If your eye causes you to stumble , pluck it out and cast it from you . It is better for you to enter into life with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire .

verses.z: 耶穌說完了這些話，就離開加利利，來到猶太的境界約旦河外。
verses.e: When Jesus had finished these words , he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan .

verses.z: 門徒對耶穌說：「人和妻子既是這樣，倒不如不娶。」
verses.e: His disciples said to him , " If this is the case of the man with his wife , it is not expedient to marry . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這話不是人都能領受的，惟獨賜給誰，誰才能領受。
verses.e: But he said to them , " Not all men can receive this saying , but those to whom it is given .

verses.z: 因為有生來是閹人，也有被人閹的，並有為天國的緣故自閹的。這話誰能領受就可以領受。」
verses.e: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother's womb , and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men ; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven's sake . He who is able to receive it , let him receive it . "

verses.z: 那時，有人帶着小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌給他們按手禱告，門徒就責備那些人。
verses.e: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray ; and the disciples rebuked them .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們；因為在天國的，正是這樣的人。」
verses.e: But Jesus said , " Allow the little children , and don't forbid them to come to me ; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these . "

verses.z: 耶穌給他們按手，就離開那地方去了。
verses.e: He laid his hands on them , and departed from there .

verses.z: 有一個人來見耶穌，說：「夫子，我該做甚麼善事才能得永生？」
verses.e: Behold , one came to him and said , " Good teacher , what good thing shall I do , that I may have eternal life ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼以善事問我呢？只有一位是善的。你若要進入[永]生，就當遵守誡命。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Why do you call me good ? No one is good but one , that is , God . But if you want to enter into life , keep the commandments . "

verses.z: 他說：「甚麼誡命？」耶穌說：「就是不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；
verses.e: He said to him , " Which ones ? " Jesus said , " ' You shall not murder . ' ' You shall not commit adultery . ' ' You shall not steal . ' ' You shall not offer false testimony . '

verses.z: 當孝敬父母；又當愛人如己。」
verses.e: ' Honor your father and your mother . ' And , ' You shall love your neighbor as yourself . ' "

verses.z: 有許多人跟着他，他就在那裏把他們[的病人]治好了。
verses.e: Great multitudes followed him , and he healed them there .

verses.z: 那少年人說：「這一切我都遵守了，還缺少甚麼呢？」
verses.e: The young man said to him , " All these things I have observed from my youth . What do I still lack ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你若願意作完全人，可去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " If you want to be perfect , go , sell what you have , and give to the poor , and you will have treasure in heaven ; and come , follow me . "

verses.z: 那少年人聽見這話，就憂憂愁愁地走了，因為他的產業很多。
verses.e: But when the young man heard this , he went away sad , for he was one who had great possessions .

verses.z: 耶穌對門徒說：「我實在告訴你們，財主進天國是難的。
verses.e: Jesus said to his disciples , " Most certainly I say to you , a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty .

verses.z: 我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進上帝的國還容易呢！」
verses.e: Again I tell you , it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 門徒聽見這話，就希奇得很，說：「這樣誰能得救呢？」
verses.e: When the disciples heard it , they were exceedingly astonished , saying , " Who then can be saved ? "

verses.z: 耶穌看着他們，說：「在人這是不能的，在上帝凡事都能。」
verses.e: Looking at them , Jesus said , " With men this is impossible , but with God all things are possible . "

verses.z: 彼得就對他說：「看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你，將來我們要得甚麼呢？」
verses.e: Then Peter answered , " Behold , we have left everything and followed you . What then will we have ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們這跟從我的人，到復興的時候，人子坐在他榮耀的寶座上，你們也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me , in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory , you also will sit on twelve thrones , judging the twelve tribes of Israel .

verses.z: 凡為我的名撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父親、母親、兒女、田地的，必要得着百倍，並且承受永生。
verses.e: Everyone who has left houses , or brothers , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name's sake , will receive one hundred times , and will inherit eternal life .

verses.z: 有法利賽人來試探耶穌，說：「人無論甚麼緣故都可以休妻嗎？」
verses.e: Pharisees came to him , testing him and saying , " Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason ? "

verses.z: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後；在後的，將要在前。」
verses.e: But many will be last who are first , and first who are last .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「那起初造人的，是造男造女，
verses.e: He answered , " Haven't you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female ,

verses.z: 並且說：『因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。』[這經]你們沒有念過嗎？
verses.e: and said , ' For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother , and shall be joined to his wife ; and the two shall become one flesh ' ?

verses.z: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。所以，上帝配合的，人不可分開。」
verses.e: So that they are no more two , but one flesh . What therefore God has joined together , don't let man tear apart . "

verses.z: 法利賽人說：「這樣，摩西為甚麼吩咐給妻子休書，就可以休她呢？」
verses.e: They asked him , " Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「摩西因為你們的心硬，所以許你們休妻，但起初並不是這樣。
verses.e: He said to them , " Moses , because of the hardness of your hearts , allowed you to divorce your wives , but from the beginning it has not been so .

verses.z: 我告訴你們，凡休妻另娶的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是犯姦淫了；有人娶那被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。」
verses.e: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife , except for sexual immorality , and marries another , commits adultery ; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery . "

verses.z: 當希律王的時候，耶穌生在猶太的伯利恆。有幾個博士從東方來到耶路撒冷，[說]：
verses.e: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod , behold , wise men from the east came to Jerusalem , saying ,

verses.z: 他們看見那星，就大大地歡喜；
verses.e: When they saw the star , they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy .

verses.z: 進了房子，看見小孩子和他母親馬利亞，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭開寶盒，拿黃金、乳香、沒藥為禮物獻給他。
verses.e: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary , his mother , and they fell down and worshiped him . Opening their treasures , they offered to him gifts : gold , frankincense , and myrrh .

verses.z: 博士因為在夢中被[主]指示不要回去見希律，就從別的路回本地去了。
verses.e: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod , they went back to their own country another way .

verses.z: 他們去後，有主的使者向約瑟夢中顯現，說：「起來！帶着小孩子同他母親逃往埃及，住在那裏，等我吩咐你；因為希律必尋找小孩子，要除滅他。」
verses.e: Now when they had departed , behold , an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream , saying , " Arise and take the young child and his mother , and flee into Egypt , and stay there until I tell you , for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him . "

verses.z: 約瑟就起來，夜間帶着小孩子和他母親往埃及去，
verses.e: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt ,

verses.z: 住在那裏，直到希律死了。這是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，說：「我從埃及召出我的兒子來。」
verses.e: and was there until the death of Herod , that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet , saying , " Out of Egypt I called my son . "

verses.z: 希律見自己被博士愚弄，就大大發怒，差人將伯利恆城裏並四境所有的男孩，照着他向博士仔細查問的時候，凡兩歲以裏的，都殺盡了。
verses.e: Then Herod , when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men , was exceedingly angry , and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside , from two years old and under , according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men .

verses.z: 這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：
verses.e: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled , saying ,

verses.z: 在拉瑪聽見號咷大哭的聲音，是拉結哭她兒女，不肯受安慰，因為他們都不在了。
verses.e: " A voice was heard in Ramah , lamentation , weeping and great mourning , Rachel weeping for her children ; she wouldn't be comforted , because they are no more . "

verses.z: 希律死了以後，有主的使者在埃及向約瑟夢中顯現，說：
verses.e: But when Herod was dead , behold , an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt , saying ,

verses.z: 「那生下來作猶太人之王的在哪裏？我們在東方看見他的星，特來拜他。」
verses.e: " Where is he who is born King of the Jews ? For we saw his star in the east , and have come to worship him . "

verses.z: 「起來！帶着小孩子和他母親往以色列地去，因為要害小孩子性命的人已經死了。」
verses.e: " Arise and take the young child and his mother , and go into the land of Israel , for those who sought the young child's life are dead . "

verses.z: 約瑟就起來，把小孩子和他母親帶到以色列地去；
verses.e: He arose and took the young child and his mother , and came into the land of Israel .

verses.z: 只因聽見亞基老接着他父親希律作了猶太王，就怕往那裏去，又在夢中被[主]指示，便往加利利境內去了，
verses.e: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father , Herod , he was afraid to go there . Being warned in a dream , he withdrew into the region of Galilee ,

verses.z: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那裏。這是要應驗先知所說，他將稱為拿撒勒人的話了。
verses.e: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth ; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene .

verses.z: 希律王聽見了，就心裏不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。
verses.e: When King Herod heard it , he was troubled , and all Jerusalem with him .

verses.z: 他就召齊了祭司長和民間的文士，問他們說：「基督當生在何處？」
verses.e: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people , he asked them where the Christ would be born .

verses.z: 他們回答說：「在猶太的伯利恆。因為有先知記着，說：
verses.e: They said to him , " In Bethlehem of Judea , for this is written through the prophet ,

verses.z: 猶大地的伯利恆啊，你在猶大諸城中並不是最小的；因為將來有一位君王要從你那裏出來，牧養我以色列民。」
verses.e: ' You Bethlehem , land of Judah , are in no way least among the princes of Judah ; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people , Israel . ' "

verses.z: 當下，希律暗暗地召了博士來，細問那星是甚麼時候出現的，
verses.e: Then Herod secretly called the wise men , and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared .

verses.z: 就差他們往伯利恆去，說：「你們去仔細尋訪那小孩子，尋到了就來報信，我也好去拜他。」
verses.e: He sent them to Bethlehem , and said , " Go and search diligently for the young child . When you have found him , bring me word , so that I also may come and worship him . "

verses.z: 他們聽見王的話就去了。在東方所看見的那星忽然在他們前頭行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上頭停住了。
verses.e: They , having heard the king , went their way ; and behold , the star , which they saw in the east , went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was .

verses.z: 「因為天國好像家主清早去雇人進他的葡萄園做工，
verses.e: " For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household , who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard .

verses.z: 及至那先雇的來了，他們以為必要多得；誰知也是各得一錢。
verses.e: When the first came , they supposed that they would receive more ; and they likewise each received a denarius .

verses.z: 他們得了，就埋怨家主說：
verses.e: When they received it , they murmured against the master of the household ,

verses.z: 『我們整天勞苦受熱，那後來的只做了一小時，你竟叫他們和我們一樣嗎？』
verses.e: saying , ' These last have spent one hour , and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat ! '

verses.z: 家主回答其中的一人說：『朋友，我不虧負你，你與我講定的不是一錢銀子嗎？
verses.e: " But he answered one of them , ' Friend , I am doing you no wrong . Didn't you agree with me for a denarius ?

verses.z: 拿你的走吧！我給那後來的和給你一樣，這是我願意的。
verses.e: Take that which is yours , and go your way . It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you .

verses.z: 我的東西難道不可隨我的意思用嗎？因為我作好人，你就紅了眼嗎？』
verses.e: Isn't it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own ? Or is your eye evil , because I am good ? '

verses.z: 這樣，那在後的，將要在前；在前的，將要在後了。」
verses.e: So the last will be first , and the first last . For many are called , but few are chosen . "

verses.z: 耶穌上耶路撒冷去的時候，在路上把十二個門徒帶到一邊，對他們說：
verses.e: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem , he took the twelve disciples aside , and on the way he said to them ,

verses.z: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交給祭司長和文士。他們要定他死罪，
verses.e: " Behold , we are going up to Jerusalem , and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes , and they will condemn him to death ,

verses.z: 又交給外邦人，將他戲弄，鞭打，釘在十字架上；第三日他要復活。」
verses.e: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock , to scourge , and to crucify ; and the third day he will be raised up . "

verses.z: 和工人講定一天一錢銀子，就打發他們進葡萄園去。
verses.e: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day , he sent them into his vineyard .

verses.z: 那時，西庇太兒子的母親同她兩個兒子上前來拜耶穌，求他一件事。
verses.e: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons , kneeling and asking a certain thing of him .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你要甚麼呢？」她說：「願你叫我這兩個兒子在你國裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」
verses.e: He said to her , " What do you want ? " She said to him , " Command that these , my two sons , may sit , one on your right hand and one on your left hand , in your Kingdom . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼；我將要喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？」他們說：「我們能。」
verses.e: But Jesus answered , " You don't know what you are asking . Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink , and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ? " They said to him , " We are able . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是我父為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」
verses.e: He said to them , " You will indeed drink my cup , and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give , but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father . "

verses.z: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒他們弟兄二人。
verses.e: When the ten heard it , they were indignant with the two brothers .

verses.z: 耶穌叫了他們來，說：「你們知道外邦人有君王為主治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
verses.e: But Jesus summoned them , and said , " You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them , and their great ones exercise authority over them .

verses.z: 只是在你們中間，不可這樣；你們中間誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
verses.e: It shall not be so among you ; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant .

verses.z: 誰願為首，就必作你們的僕人。
verses.e: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant ,

verses.z: 正如人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。」
verses.e: even as the Son of Man came not to be served , but to serve , and to give his life as a ransom for many . "

verses.z: 他們出耶利哥的時候，有極多的人跟隨他。
verses.e: As they went out from Jericho , a great multitude followed him .

verses.z: 約在巳初出去，看見市上還有閒站的人，
verses.e: He went out about the third hour , and saw others standing idle in the marketplace .

verses.z: 有兩個瞎子坐在路旁，聽說是耶穌經過，就喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
verses.e: Behold , two blind men sitting by the road , when they heard that Jesus was passing by , cried out , " Lord , have mercy on us , you son of David ! "

verses.z: 眾人責備他們，不許他們作聲；他們卻越發喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
verses.e: The multitude rebuked them , telling them that they should be quiet , but they cried out even more , " Lord , have mercy on us , you son of David ! "

verses.z: 耶穌就站住，叫他們來，說：「要我為你們做甚麼？」
verses.e: Jesus stood still and called them , and asked , " What do you want me to do for you ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「主啊，要我們的眼睛能看見！」
verses.e: They told him , " Lord , that our eyes may be opened . "

verses.z: 耶穌就動了慈心，把他們的眼睛一摸，他們立刻看見，就跟從了耶穌。
verses.e: Jesus , being moved with compassion , touched their eyes ; and immediately their eyes received their sight , and they followed him .

verses.z: 就對他們說：『你們也進葡萄園去，所當給的，我必給你們。』他們也進去了。
verses.e: He said to them , ' You also go into the vineyard , and whatever is right I will give you . ' So they went their way .

verses.z: 約在午正和申初又出去，也是這樣行。
verses.e: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour , and did likewise .

verses.z: 約在酉初出去，看見還有人站在那裏，就問他們說：『你們為甚麼整天在這裏閒站呢？』
verses.e: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle . He said to them , ' Why do you stand here all day idle ? '

verses.z: 他們說：『因為沒有人雇我們。』他說：『你們也進葡萄園去。』
verses.e: " They said to him , ' Because no one has hired us . ' " He said to them , ' You also go into the vineyard , and you will receive whatever is right . '

verses.z: 到了晚上，園主對管事的說：『叫工人都來，給他們工錢，從後來的起，到先來的為止。』
verses.e: " When evening had come , the lord of the vineyard said to his manager , ' Call the laborers and pay them their wages , beginning from the last to the first . '

verses.z: 約在酉初雇的人來了，各人得了一錢銀子。
verses.e: " When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came , they each received a denarius .

verses.z: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄欖山那裏。
verses.e: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage , to the Mount of Olives , then Jesus sent two disciples ,

verses.z: 耶穌既進了耶路撒冷，合城都驚動了，說：「這是誰？」
verses.e: When he had come into Jerusalem , all the city was stirred up , saying , " Who is this ? "

verses.z: 眾人說：「這是加利利拿撒勒的先知耶穌。」
verses.e: The multitudes said , " This is the prophet , Jesus , from Nazareth of Galilee . "

verses.z: 耶穌進了上帝的殿，趕出殿裏一切做買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子，和賣鴿子之人的凳子，
verses.e: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the money changers ' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves .

verses.z: 對他們說：「[經上]記着說：我的殿必稱為禱告的殿，你們倒使它成為賊窩了。」
verses.e: He said to them , " It is written , ' My house shall be called a house of prayer , ' but you have made it a den of robbers ! "

verses.z: 在殿裏有瞎子、瘸子到耶穌跟前，他就治好了他們。
verses.e: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple , and he healed them .

verses.z: 祭司長和文士看見耶穌所行的奇事，又見小孩子在殿裏喊着說：「和散那歸於大衛的子孫！」就甚惱怒，
verses.e: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did , and the children who were crying in the temple and saying , " Hosanna to the son of David ! " they were indignant ,

verses.z: 對他說：「這些人所說的，你聽見了嗎？」耶穌說：「是的。[經上]說『你從嬰孩和吃奶的口中完全了讚美』的話，你們沒有念過嗎？」
verses.e: and said to him , " Do you hear what these are saying ? " Jesus said to them , " Yes . Did you never read , ' Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies , you have perfected praise ' ? "

verses.z: 於是離開他們，出城到伯大尼去，在那裏住宿。
verses.e: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany , and camped there .

verses.z: 早晨回城的時候，他餓了，
verses.e: Now in the morning , as he returned to the city , he was hungry .

verses.z: 看見路旁有一棵無花果樹，就走到跟前，在樹上找不着甚麼，不過有葉子，就對樹說：「從今以後，你永不結果子。」那無花果樹就立刻枯乾了。
verses.e: Seeing a fig tree by the road , he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves . He said to it , " Let there be no fruit from you forever ! " Immediately the fig tree withered away .

verses.z: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：「你們往對面村子裏去，必看見一匹驢拴在那裏，還有驢駒同在一處；你們解開，牽到我這裏來。
verses.e: saying to them , " Go into the village that is opposite you , and immediately you will find a donkey tied , and a colt with her . Untie them and bring them to me .

verses.z: 門徒看見了，便希奇說：「無花果樹怎麼立刻枯乾了呢？」
verses.e: When the disciples saw it , they marveled , saying , " How did the fig tree immediately wither away ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行無花果樹上所行的事，就是對這座山說：『你挪開此地，投在海裏！』也必成就。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Most certainly I tell you , if you have faith and don't doubt , you will not only do what was done to the fig tree , but even if you told this mountain , ' Be taken up and cast into the sea , ' it would be done .

verses.z: 你們禱告，無論求甚麼，只要信，就必得着。」
verses.e: All things , whatever you ask in prayer , believing , you will receive . "

verses.z: 耶穌進了殿，正教訓人的時候，祭司長和民間的長老來問他說：「你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
verses.e: When he had come into the temple , the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching , and said , " By what authority do you do these things ? Who gave you this authority ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「我也要問你們一句話，你們若告訴我，我就告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " I also will ask you one question , which if you tell me , I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things .

verses.z: 約翰的洗禮是從哪裏來的？是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？」他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必對我們說：『這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
verses.e: The baptism of John , where was it from ? From heaven or from men ? " They reasoned with themselves , saying , " If we say , ' From heaven , ' he will ask us , ' Why then did you not believe him ? '

verses.z: 若說『從人間來』，我們又怕百姓，因為他們都以約翰為先知。」
verses.e: But if we say , ' From men , ' we fear the multitude , for all hold John as a prophet . "

verses.z: 於是回答耶穌說：「我們不知道。」耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」
verses.e: They answered Jesus , and said , " We don't know . " He also said to them , " Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things .

verses.z: 又說：「一個人有兩個兒子。他來對大兒子說：『我兒，你今天到葡萄園裏去做工。』
verses.e: But what do you think ? A man had two sons , and he came to the first , and said , ' Son , go work today in my vineyard . '

verses.z: 他回答說：『我不去』，以後自己懊悔，就去了。
verses.e: He answered , ' I will not , ' but afterward he changed his mind , and went .

verses.z: 若有人對你們說甚麼，你們就說：『主要用牠。』那人必立時讓你們牽來。
verses.e: If anyone says anything to you , you shall say , ' The Lord needs them , ' and immediately he will send them . "

verses.z: 又來對小兒子也是這樣說。他回答說：『父啊，我去』，他卻不去。
verses.e: He came to the second , and said the same thing . He answered , ' I'm going , sir , ' but he didn't go .

verses.z: 你們想，這兩個兒子是哪一個遵行父命呢？」他們說：「大兒子。」耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，稅吏和娼妓倒比你們先進上帝的國。
verses.e: Which of the two did the will of his father ? " They said to him , " The first . " Jesus said to them , " Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God's Kingdom before you .

verses.z: 因為約翰遵着義路到你們這裏來，你們卻不信他；稅吏和娼妓倒信他。你們看見了，後來還是不懊悔去信他。」
verses.e: For John came to you in the way of righteousness , and you didn't believe him ; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him . When you saw it , you didn't even repent afterward , that you might believe him .

verses.z: 「你們再聽一個比喻：有個家主栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，裏面挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
verses.e: " Hear another parable . There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard , set a hedge about it , dug a wine press in it , built a tower , leased it out to farmers , and went into another country .

verses.z: 收果子的時候近了，就打發僕人到園戶那裏去收果子。
verses.e: When the season for the fruit came near , he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit .

verses.z: 園戶拿住僕人，打了一個，殺了一個，用石頭打死一個。
verses.e: The farmers took his servants , beat one , killed another , and stoned another .

verses.z: 主人又打發別的僕人去，比先前更多；園戶還是照樣待他們。
verses.e: Again , he sent other servants more than the first ; and they treated them the same way .

verses.z: 後來打發他的兒子到他們那裏去，[意思]說：『他們必尊敬我的兒子。』
verses.e: But afterward he sent to them his son , saying , ' They will respect my son . '

verses.z: 不料，園戶看見他兒子，就彼此說：『這是承受產業的。來吧，我們殺他，佔他的產業！』
verses.e: But the farmers , when they saw the son , said among themselves , ' This is the heir . Come , let's kill him and seize his inheritance . '

verses.z: 他們就拿住他，推出葡萄園外，殺了。
verses.e: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard , then killed him .

verses.z: 這事成就是要應驗先知的話，說：
verses.e: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet , saying ,

verses.z: 園主來的時候要怎樣處治這些園戶呢？」
verses.e: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes , what will he do to those farmers ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「要下毒手除滅那些惡人，將葡萄園另租給那按着時候交果子的園戶。」
verses.e: They told him , " He will miserably destroy those miserable men , and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「[經上寫着]：匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。這是主所做的，在我們眼中看為希奇。這經你們沒有念過嗎？
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Did you never read in the Scriptures , ' The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner . This was from the Lord . It is marvelous in our eyes ' ?

verses.z: 所以我告訴你們，上帝的國必從你們奪去，賜給那能結果子的百姓。
verses.e: " Therefore I tell you , God's Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit .

verses.z: 誰掉在這石頭上，必要跌碎；這石頭掉在誰的身上，就要把誰砸得稀爛。」
verses.e: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces , but on whomever it will fall , it will scatter him as dust . "

verses.z: 祭司長和法利賽人聽見他的比喻，就看出他是指着他們說的。
verses.e: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables , they perceived that he spoke about them .

verses.z: 他們想要捉拿他，只是怕眾人，因為眾人以他為先知。
verses.e: When they sought to seize him , they feared the multitudes , because they considered him to be a prophet .

verses.z: 要對錫安的居民說：看哪，你的王來到你這裏，是溫柔的，又騎着驢，就是騎着驢駒子。」
verses.e: " Tell the daughter of Zion , behold , your King comes to you , humble , and riding on a donkey , on a colt , the foal of a donkey . "

verses.z: 門徒就照耶穌所吩咐的去行，
verses.e: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them ,

verses.z: 牽了驢和驢駒來，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
verses.e: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them ; and he sat on them .

verses.z: 眾人多半把衣服鋪在路上；還有人砍下樹枝來鋪在路上。
verses.e: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road . Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road .

verses.z: 前行後隨的眾人喊着說：和散那歸於大衛的子孫！奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！高高在上和散那！
verses.e: The multitudes who went in front of him , and those who followed , kept shouting , " Hosanna to the son of David ! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord ! Hosanna in the highest ! "

verses.z: 耶穌又用比喻對他們說：
verses.e: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables , saying ,

verses.z: 那些僕人就出去，到大路上，凡遇見的，不論善惡都召聚了來，筵席上就坐滿了客。
verses.e: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found , both bad and good . The wedding was filled with guests .

verses.z: 王進來觀看賓客，見那裏有一個沒有穿禮服的，
verses.e: " But when the king came in to see the guests , he saw there a man who didn't have on wedding clothing ,

verses.z: 就對他說：『朋友，你到這裏來怎麼不穿禮服呢？』那人無言可答。
verses.e: and he said to him , ' Friend , how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing ? ' He was speechless .

verses.z: 於是王對使喚的人說：『捆起他的手腳來，把他丟在外邊的黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』
verses.e: Then the king said to the servants , ' Bind him hand and foot , take him away , and throw him into the outer darkness . That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be . '

verses.z: 因為被召的人多，選上的人少。」
verses.e: For many are called , but few chosen . "

verses.z: 當時，法利賽人出去商議，怎樣就着耶穌的話陷害他，
verses.e: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk .

verses.z: 就打發他們的門徒同希律黨的人去見耶穌，說：「夫子，我們知道你是誠實人，並且誠誠實實傳上帝的道，甚麼人你都不徇情面，因為你不看人的外貌。
verses.e: They sent their disciples to him , along with the Herodians , saying , " Teacher , we know that you are honest , and teach the way of God in truth , no matter whom you teach ; for you aren't partial to anyone .

verses.z: 請告訴我們，你的意見如何？納稅給凱撒可以不可以？」
verses.e: Tell us therefore , what do you think ? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar , or not ? "

verses.z: 耶穌看出他們的惡意，就說：「假冒為善的人哪，為甚麼試探我？
verses.e: But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said , " Why do you test me , you hypocrites ?

verses.z: 拿一個上稅的錢給我看！」他們就拿一個銀錢來給他。
verses.e: Show me the tax money . " They brought to him a denarius .

verses.z: 「天國好比一個王為他兒子擺設娶親的筵席，
verses.e: " The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king , who made a wedding feast for his son ,

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這像和這號是誰的？」
verses.e: He asked them , " Whose is this image and inscription ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「是凱撒的。」耶穌說：「這樣，凱撒的物當歸給凱撒；上帝的物當歸給上帝。」
verses.e: They said to him , " Caesar's . " Then he said to them , " Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's , and to God the things that are God's . "

verses.z: 他們聽見就希奇，離開他走了。
verses.e: When they heard it , they marveled , and left him and went away .

verses.z: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。那天，他們來問耶穌說：
verses.e: On that day Sadducees ( those who say that there is no resurrection ) came to him . They asked him ,

verses.z: 「夫子，摩西說：『人若死了，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』
verses.e: saying , " Teacher , Moses said , ' If a man dies , having no children , his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother . '

verses.z: 從前，在我們這裏有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有孩子，撇下妻子給兄弟。
verses.e: Now there were with us seven brothers . The first married and died , and having no offspring left his wife to his brother .

verses.z: 第二、第三，直到第七個，都是如此。
verses.e: In the same way , the second also , and the third , to the seventh .

verses.z: 末後，婦人也死了。
verses.e: After them all , the woman died .

verses.z: 這樣，當復活的時候，她是七個人中哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們都娶過她。」
verses.e: In the resurrection therefore , whose wife will she be of the seven ? For they all had her . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們錯了；因為不明白聖經，也不曉得上帝的大能。
verses.e: But Jesus answered them , " You are mistaken , not knowing the Scriptures , nor the power of God .

verses.z: 就打發僕人去，請那些被召的人來赴席，他們卻不肯來。
verses.e: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast , but they would not come .

verses.z: 當復活的時候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
verses.e: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage , but are like God's angels in heaven .

verses.z: 論到死人復活，上帝[在經上]向你們所說的，你們沒有念過嗎？
verses.e: But concerning the resurrection of the dead , haven't you read that which was spoken to you by God , saying ,

verses.z: 他說：『我是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』上帝不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝。」
verses.e: ' I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ' ? God is not the God of the dead , but of the living . "

verses.z: 眾人聽見這話，就希奇他的教訓。
verses.e: When the multitudes heard it , they were astonished at his teaching .

verses.z: 法利賽人聽見耶穌堵住了撒都該人的口，他們就聚集。
verses.e: But the Pharisees , when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees , gathered themselves together .

verses.z: 內中有一個人是律法師，要試探耶穌，就問他說：
verses.e: One of them , a lawyer , asked him a question , testing him .

verses.z: 「夫子，律法上的誡命，哪一條是最大的呢？」
verses.e: " Teacher , which is the greatest commandment in the law ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主－你的上帝。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " ' You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart , with all your soul , and with all your mind . '

verses.z: 這是誡命中的第一，且是最大的。
verses.e: This is the first and great commandment .

verses.z: 其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。
verses.e: A second likewise is this , ' You shall love your neighbor as yourself . '

verses.z: 王又打發別的僕人，說：『你們告訴那被召的人，我的筵席已經預備好了，牛和肥畜已經宰了，各樣都齊備，請你們來赴席。』
verses.e: Again he sent out other servants , saying , ' Tell those who are invited , " Behold , I have prepared my dinner . My cattle and my fatlings are killed , and all things are ready . Come to the wedding feast ! " '

verses.z: 這兩條誡命是律法和先知一切[道理]的總綱。」
verses.e: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments . "

verses.z: 法利賽人聚集的時候，耶穌問他們說：
verses.e: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together , Jesus asked them a question ,

verses.z: 「論到基督，你們的意見如何？他是誰的子孫呢？」他們回答說：「是大衛的子孫。」
verses.e: saying , " What do you think of the Christ ? Whose son is he ? " They said to him , " Of David . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這樣，大衛被聖靈感動，怎麼還稱他為主，說：
verses.e: He said to them , " How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord , saying ,

verses.z: 主對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，等我把你仇敵放在你的腳下。
verses.e: ' The Lord said to my Lord , sit on my right hand , until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet ' ?

verses.z: 大衛既稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」
verses.e: " If then David calls him Lord , how is he his son ? "

verses.z: 他們沒有一個人能回答一言。從那日以後，也沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
verses.e: No one was able to answer him a word , neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward .

verses.z: 那些人不理就走了；一個到自己田裏去；一個做買賣去；
verses.e: But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his own farm , another to his merchandise ;

verses.z: 其餘的拿住僕人，凌辱他們，把他們殺了。
verses.e: and the rest grabbed his servants , treated them shamefully , and killed them .

verses.z: 王就大怒，發兵除滅那些兇手，燒毀他們的城。
verses.e: When the king heard that , he was angry , and sent his armies , destroyed those murderers , and burned their city .

verses.z: 於是對僕人說：『喜筵已經齊備，只是所召的人不配。
verses.e: " Then he said to his servants , ' The wedding is ready , but those who were invited weren't worthy .

verses.z: 所以你們要往岔路口上去，凡遇見的，都召來赴席。』
verses.e: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways , and as many as you may find , invite to the wedding feast . '

verses.z: 那時，耶穌對眾人和門徒講論，
verses.e: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples ,

verses.z: 也不要受師尊的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的師尊，就是基督。
verses.e: Neither be called masters , for one is your master , the Christ .

verses.z: 你們中間誰為大，誰就要作你們的用人。
verses.e: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant .

verses.z: 凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。
verses.e: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled , and whoever humbles himself will be exalted .

verses.z: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們正當人前，把天國[的門]關了，自己不進去，正要進去的人，你們也不容他們進去。
verses.e: " Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you devour widows ' houses , and as a pretense you make long prayers . Therefore you will receive greater condemnation .

" But woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men ; for you don't enter in yourselves , neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter .

verses.z: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們走遍洋海陸地，勾引一個人入教，既入了教，卻使他作地獄之子，比你們還加倍。
verses.e: Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte ; and when he becomes one , you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves .

verses.z: 「你們這瞎眼領路的有禍了！你們說：『凡指着殿起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指着殿中金子起誓的，他就該謹守。』
verses.e: " Woe to you , you blind guides , who say , ' Whoever swears by the temple , it is nothing ; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple , he is obligated . '

verses.z: 你們這無知瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是金子呢？還是叫金子成聖的殿呢？
verses.e: You blind fools ! For which is greater , the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold ?

verses.z: 你們又說：『凡指着壇起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指着壇上禮物起誓的，他就該謹守。』
verses.e: And , ' Whoever swears by the altar , it is nothing ; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it , he is obligated . '

verses.z: 你們這瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是禮物呢？還是叫禮物成聖的壇呢？
verses.e: You blind fools ! For which is greater , the gift , or the altar that sanctifies the gift ?

verses.z: 說：「文士和法利賽人坐在摩西的位上，
verses.e: saying , " The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses ' seat .

verses.z: 所以，人指着壇起誓，就是指着壇和壇上一切所有的起誓；
verses.e: He therefore who swears by the altar , swears by it and by everything on it .

verses.z: 人指着殿起誓，就是指着殿和那住在殿裏的起誓；
verses.e: He who swears by the temple , swears by it and by him who has been living in it .

verses.z: 人指着天起誓，就是指着上帝的寶座和那坐在上面的起誓。
verses.e: He who swears by heaven , swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it .

verses.z: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、茴香、芹菜獻上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，就是公義、憐憫、信實，反倒不行了。這[更重的]是你們當行的；那也是不可不行的。
verses.e: " Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you tithe mint , dill , and cumin , and have left undone the weightier matters of the law : justice , mercy , and faith . But you ought to have done these , and not to have left the other undone .

verses.z: 你們這瞎眼領路的，蠓蟲你們就濾出來，駱駝你們倒吞下去。
verses.e: You blind guides , who strain out a gnat , and swallow a camel !

verses.z: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們洗淨杯盤的外面，裏面卻盛滿了勒索和放蕩。
verses.e: " Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter , but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness .

verses.z: 你這瞎眼的法利賽人，先洗淨杯盤的裏面，好叫外面也乾淨了。
verses.e: You blind Pharisee , first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter , that its outside may become clean also .

verses.z: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們好像粉飾的墳墓，外面好看，裏面卻裝滿了死人的骨頭和一切的污穢。
verses.e: " Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you are like whitened tombs , which outwardly appear beautiful , but inwardly are full of dead men's bones and of all uncleanness .

verses.z: 你們也是如此，在人前，外面顯出公義來，裏面卻裝滿了假善和不法的事。
verses.e: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men , but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .

verses.z: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們建造先知的墳，修飾義人的墓，說：
verses.e: " Woe to you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous ,

verses.z: 凡他們所吩咐你們的，你們都要謹守遵行。但不要效法他們的行為；因為他們能說，不能行。
verses.e: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe , observe and do , but don't do their works ; for they say , and don't do .

verses.z: 『若是我們在我們祖宗的時候，必不和他們同流先知的血。』
verses.e: and say , ' If we had lived in the days of our fathers , we wouldn't have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets . '

verses.z: 這就是你們自己證明是殺害先知者的子孫了。
verses.e: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets .

verses.z: 你們去充滿你們祖宗的惡貫吧！
verses.e: Fill up , then , the measure of your fathers .

verses.z: 你們這些蛇類、毒蛇之種啊，怎能逃脫地獄的刑罰呢？
verses.e: You serpents , you offspring of vipers , how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna ?

verses.z: 所以我差遣先知和智慧人並文士到你們這裏來，有的你們要殺害，要釘十字架；有的你們要在會堂裏鞭打，從這城追逼到那城，
verses.e: Therefore , behold , I send to you prophets , wise men , and scribes . Some of them you will kill and crucify ; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city ,

verses.z: 叫世上所流義人的血都歸到你們身上，從義人亞伯的血起，直到你們在殿和壇中間所殺的巴拉加的兒子撒迦利亞的血為止。
verses.e: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth , from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah , whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，這一切的罪都要歸到這世代了。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , all these things will come upon this generation .

verses.z: 「耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷啊，你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裏來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下，只是你們不願意。
verses.e: " Jerusalem , Jerusalem , who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her ! How often I would have gathered your children together , even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings , and you would not !

verses.z: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。
verses.e: Behold , your house is left to you desolate .

verses.z: 我告訴你們，從今以後，你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：『奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。』」
verses.e: For I tell you , you will not see me from now on , until you say , ' Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord ! ' "

verses.z: 他們把難擔的重擔捆起來，擱在人的肩上，但自己一個指頭也不肯動。
verses.e: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne , and lay them on men's shoulders ; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them .

verses.z: 他們一切所做的事都是要叫人看見，所以將佩戴的經文做寬了，[衣裳的]繸子做長了，
verses.e: But they do all their works to be seen by men . They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments ,

verses.z: 喜愛筵席上的首座，會堂裏的高位，
verses.e: and love the place of honor at feasts , the best seats in the synagogues ,

verses.z: 又喜愛人在街市上問他安，稱呼他拉比。
verses.e: the salutations in the marketplaces , and to be called ' Rabbi , Rabbi ' by men .

verses.z: 但你們不要受拉比的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的夫子；你們都是弟兄。
verses.e: But you are not to be called ' Rabbi ' , for one is your teacher , the Christ , and all of you are brothers .

verses.z: 也不要稱呼地上的人為父，因為只有一位是你們的父，就是在天上的父。
verses.e: Call no man on the earth your father , for one is your Father , he who is in heaven .

verses.z: 耶穌出了[聖]殿，正走的時候，門徒進前來，把殿宇指給他看。
verses.e: Jesus went out from the temple , and was going on his way . His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple .

verses.z: 那時，必有許多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨惡；
verses.e: Then many will stumble , and will deliver up one another , and will hate one another .

verses.z: 且有好些假先知起來，迷惑多人。
verses.e: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray .

verses.z: 只因不法的事增多，許多人的愛心才漸漸冷淡了。
verses.e: Because iniquity will be multiplied , the love of many will grow cold .

verses.z: 惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
verses.e: But he who endures to the end will be saved .

verses.z: 這天國的福音要傳遍天下，對萬民作見證，然後末期才來到。」
verses.e: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations , and then the end will come .

verses.z: 「你們看見先知但以理所說的『那行毀壞可憎的』站在聖地（讀[這經]的人須要會意）。
verses.e: " When , therefore , you see the abomination of desolation , which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet , standing in the holy place ( let the reader understand ) ,

verses.z: 那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
verses.e: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains .

verses.z: 在房上的，不要下來拿家裏的東西；
verses.e: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house .

verses.z: 在田裏的，也不要回去取衣裳。
verses.e: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes .

verses.z: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了。
verses.e: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days !

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們不是看見這殿宇嗎？我實在告訴你們，將來在這裏沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」
verses.e: But he answered them , " You see all of these things , don't you ? Most certainly I tell you , there will not be left here one stone on another , that will not be thrown down . "

verses.z: 你們應當祈求，叫你們逃走的時候，不遇見冬天或是安息日。
verses.e: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath ,

verses.z: 因為那時必有大災難，從世界的起頭直到如今，沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
verses.e: for then there will be great suffering , such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now , no , nor ever will be .

verses.z: 若不減少那日子，凡有血氣的總沒有一個得救的；只是為選民，那日子必減少了。
verses.e: Unless those days had been shortened , no flesh would have been saved . But for the sake of the chosen ones , those days will be shortened .

verses.z: 那時，若有人對你們說：『基督在這裏』，或說：『基督在那裏』，你們不要信！
verses.e: " Then if any man tells you , ' Behold , here is the Christ ! ' or , ' There ! ' don't believe it .

verses.z: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯大神蹟、大奇事，倘若能行，連選民也就迷惑了。
verses.e: For false christs and false prophets will arise , and they will show great signs and wonders , so as to lead astray , if possible , even the chosen ones .

verses.z: 看哪，我預先告訴你們了。
verses.e: " Behold , I have told you beforehand .

verses.z: 若有人對你們說：『看哪，基督在曠野裏』，你們不要出去！[或說]：『看哪，基督在內屋中』，你們不要信！
verses.e: " If therefore they tell you , ' Behold , he is in the wilderness , ' don't go out ; or ' Behold , he is in the inner rooms , ' don't believe it .

verses.z: 閃電從東邊發出，直照到西邊。人子降臨也要這樣。
verses.e: For as the lightning flashes from the east , and is seen even to the west , so will the coming of the Son of Man be .

verses.z: 屍首在哪裏，鷹也必聚在那裏。」
verses.e: For wherever the carcass is , that is where the vultures gather together .

verses.z: 「那些日子的災難一過去，日頭就變黑了，月亮也不放光，眾星要從天上墜落，天勢都要震動。
verses.e: " But immediately after the suffering of those days , the sun will be darkened , the moon will not give its light , the stars will fall from the sky , and the powers of the heavens will be shaken ;

verses.z: 耶穌在橄欖山上坐着，門徒暗暗地來說：「請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事？你降臨和世界的末了有甚麼預兆呢？」
verses.e: As he sat on the Mount of Olives , the disciples came to him privately , saying , " Tell us , when will these things be ? What is the sign of your coming , and of the end of the age ? "

verses.z: 那時，人子的兆頭要顯在天上，地上的萬族都要哀哭。他們要看見人子，有能力，有大榮耀，駕着天上的雲降臨。
verses.e: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky . Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn , and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory .

verses.z: 他要差遣使者，用號筒的大聲，將他的選民，從四方，從天這邊到天那邊，都招聚了來。」
verses.e: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet , and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds , from one end of the sky to the other .

verses.z: 「你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
verses.e: " Now from the fig tree learn this parable : When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves , you know that the summer is near .

verses.z: 這樣，你們看見這一切的事，也該知道人子近了，正在門口了。
verses.e: Even so you also , when you see all these things , know that he is near , even at the doors .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished .

verses.z: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」
verses.e: Heaven and earth will pass away , but my words will not pass away .

verses.z: 「但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟獨父知道。
verses.e: " But no one knows of that day and hour , not even the angels of heaven , but my Father only .

verses.z: 挪亞的日子怎樣，人子降臨也要怎樣。
verses.e: As the days of Noah were , so will the coming of the Son of Man be .

verses.z: 當洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亞進方舟的那日；
verses.e: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking , marrying and giving in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ship ,

verses.z: 不知不覺洪水來了，把他們全都沖去。人子降臨也要這樣。
verses.e: and they didn't know until the flood came and took them all away , so will the coming of the Son of Man be .

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Be careful that no one leads you astray .

verses.z: 那時，兩個人在田裏，取去一個，撇下一個。
verses.e: Then two men will be in the field : one will be taken and one will be left .

verses.z: 兩個女人推磨，取去一個，撇下一個。
verses.e: Two women will be grinding at the mill : one will be taken and one will be left .

verses.z: 所以，你們要警醒，因為不知道你們的主是哪一天來到。
verses.e: Watch therefore , for you don't know in what hour your Lord comes .

verses.z: 家主若知道幾更天有賊來，就必警醒，不容人挖透房屋；這是你們所知道的。
verses.e: But know this , that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming , he would have watched , and would not have allowed his house to be broken into .

verses.z: 所以，你們也要預備，因為你們想不到的時候，人子就來了。」
verses.e: Therefore also be ready , for in an hour that you don't expect , the Son of Man will come .

verses.z: 「誰是忠心有見識的僕人，為主人所派，管理家裏的人，按時分糧給他們呢？
verses.e: " Who then is the faithful and wise servant , whom his lord has set over his household , to give them their food in due season ?

verses.z: 主人來到，看見他這樣行，那僕人就有福了。
verses.e: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has .

verses.z: 倘若那惡僕心裏說：『我的主人必來得遲』，
verses.e: But if that evil servant should say in his heart , ' My lord is delaying his coming , '

verses.z: 就動手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。
verses.e: and begins to beat his fellow servants , and eat and drink with the drunkards ,

verses.z: 因為將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是基督』，並且要迷惑許多人。
verses.e: For many will come in my name , saying , ' I am the Christ , ' and will lead many astray .

verses.z: 在想不到的日子，不知道的時辰，那僕人的主人要來，
verses.e: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn't expect it and in an hour when he doesn't know it ,

verses.z: 重重地處治他，定他和假冒為善的人同罪；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」
verses.e: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites . That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be .

verses.z: 你們也要聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，總不要驚慌；因為[這些事]是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
verses.e: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars . See that you aren't troubled , for all this must happen , but the end is not yet .

verses.z: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有饑荒、地震。
verses.e: For nation will rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom ; and there will be famines , plagues , and earthquakes in various places .

verses.z: 這都是災難的起頭。
verses.e: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains .

verses.z: 那時，人要把你們陷在患難裏，也要殺害你們；你們又要為我的名被萬民恨惡。
verses.e: " Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you . You will be hated by all of the nations for my name's sake .

verses.z: 「那時，天國好比十個童女拿着燈出去迎接新郎。
verses.e: " Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom .

verses.z: 她們去買的時候，新郎到了。那預備好了的，同他進去坐席，門就關了。
verses.e: While they went away to buy , the bridegroom came , and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast , and the door was shut .

verses.z: 其餘的童女隨後也來了，說：『主啊，主啊，給我們開門！』
verses.e: Afterward the other virgins also came , saying , ' Lord , Lord , open to us . '

verses.z: 他卻回答說：『我實在告訴你們，我不認識你們。』
verses.e: But he answered , ' Most certainly I tell you , I don't know you . '

verses.z: 所以，你們要警醒；因為那日子，那時辰，你們不知道。」
verses.e: Watch therefore , for you don't know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming .

verses.z: 「[天國]又好比一個人要往外國去，就叫了僕人來，把他的家業交給他們，
verses.e: " For it is like a man going into another country , who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them .

verses.z: 按着各人的才幹給他們銀子：一個給了五千，一個給了二千，一個給了一千，就往外國去了。
verses.e: To one he gave five talents , to another two , to another one , to each according to his own ability . Then he went on his journey .

verses.z: 那領五千的隨即拿去做買賣，另外賺了五千。
verses.e: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them , and made another five talents .

verses.z: 那領二千的也照樣另賺了二千。
verses.e: In the same way , he also who got the two gained another two .

verses.z: 但那領一千的去掘開地，把主人的銀子埋藏了。
verses.e: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord's money .

verses.z: 過了許久，那些僕人的主人來了，和他們算帳。
verses.e: " Now after a long time the lord of those servants came , and settled accounts with them .

verses.z: 其中有五個是愚拙的，五個是聰明的。
verses.e: Five of them were foolish , and five were wise .

verses.z: 那領五千銀子的又帶着那另外的五千來，說：『主啊，你交給我五千銀子。請看，我又賺了五千。』
verses.e: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents , saying , ' Lord , you delivered to me five talents . Behold , I have gained another five talents in addition to them . '

verses.z: 主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』
verses.e: " His lord said to him , ' Well done , good and faithful servant . You have been faithful over a few things , I will set you over many things . Enter into the joy of your lord . '

verses.z: 那領二千的也來，說：『主啊，你交給我二千銀子。請看，我又賺了二千。』
verses.e: " He also who got the two talents came and said , ' Lord , you delivered to me two talents . Behold , I have gained another two talents in addition to them . '

verses.z: 主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』
verses.e: " His lord said to him , ' Well done , good and faithful servant . You have been faithful over a few things . I will set you over many things . Enter into the joy of your lord . '

verses.z: 那領一千的也來，說：『主啊，我知道你是忍心的人，沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
verses.e: " He also who had received the one talent came and said , ' Lord , I knew you that you are a hard man , reaping where you didn't sow , and gathering where you didn't scatter .

verses.z: 我就害怕，去把你的一千銀子埋藏在地裏。請看，你的原銀子在這裏。』
verses.e: I was afraid , and went away and hid your talent in the earth . Behold , you have what is yours . '

verses.z: 主人回答說：『你這又惡又懶的僕人，你既知道我沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
verses.e: " But his lord answered him , ' You wicked and slothful servant . You knew that I reap where I didn't sow , and gather where I didn't scatter .

verses.z: 就當把我的銀子放給兌換銀錢的人，到我來的時候，可以連本帶利收回。
verses.e: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers , and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest .

verses.z: 奪過他這一千來，給那有一萬的。
verses.e: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents .

verses.z: 因為凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。
verses.e: For to everyone who has will be given , and he will have abundance , but from him who doesn't have , even that which he has will be taken away .

verses.z: 愚拙的拿着燈，卻不預備油；
verses.e: Those who were foolish , when they took their lamps , took no oil with them ,

verses.z: 把這無用的僕人丟在外面黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』」
verses.e: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness , where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth . '

verses.z: 「當人子在他榮耀裏、同着眾天使降臨的時候，要坐在他榮耀的寶座上。
verses.e: " But when the Son of Man comes in his glory , and all the holy angels with him , then he will sit on the throne of his glory .

verses.z: 萬民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他們分別出來，好像牧羊的分別綿羊山羊一般，
verses.e: Before him all the nations will be gathered , and he will separate them one from another , as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats .

verses.z: 把綿羊安置在右邊，山羊在左邊。
verses.e: He will set the sheep on his right hand , but the goats on the left .

verses.z: 於是王要向那右邊的說：『你們這蒙我父賜福的，可來承受那創世以來為你們所預備的國；
verses.e: Then the King will tell those on his right hand , ' Come , blessed of my Father , inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world ;

verses.z: 因為我餓了，你們給我吃，渴了，你們給我喝；我作客旅，你們留我住；
verses.e: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat . I was thirsty and you gave me drink . I was a stranger and you took me in .

verses.z: 我赤身露體，你們給我穿；我病了，你們看顧我；我在監裏，你們來看我。』
verses.e: I was naked and you clothed me . I was sick and you visited me . I was in prison and you came to me . '

verses.z: 義人就回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，給你吃，渴了，給你喝？
verses.e: " Then the righteous will answer him , saying , ' Lord , when did we see you hungry and feed you , or thirsty and give you a drink ?

verses.z: 甚麼時候見你作客旅，留你住，或是赤身露體，給你穿？
verses.e: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in , or naked and clothe you ?

verses.z: 又甚麼時候見你病了，或是在監裏，來看你呢？』
verses.e: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you ? '

verses.z: 聰明的拿着燈，又預備油在器皿裏。
verses.e: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps .

verses.z: 王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。』
verses.e: " The King will answer them , ' Most certainly I tell you , because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers , you did it to me . '

verses.z: 王又要向那左邊的說：『你們這被咒詛的人，離開我！進入那為魔鬼和他的使者所預備的永火裏去！
verses.e: Then he will say also to those on the left hand , ' Depart from me , you cursed , into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels ;

verses.z: 因為我餓了，你們不給我吃，渴了，你們不給我喝；
verses.e: for I was hungry , and you didn't give me food to eat ; I was thirsty , and you gave me no drink ;

verses.z: 我作客旅，你們不留我住；我赤身露體，你們不給我穿；我病了，我在監裏，你們不來看顧我。』
verses.e: I was a stranger , and you didn't take me in ; naked , and you didn't clothe me ; sick , and in prison , and you didn't visit me . '

verses.z: 他們也要回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露體，或病了，或在監裏，不伺候你呢？』
verses.e: " Then they will also answer , saying , ' Lord , when did we see you hungry , or thirsty , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and didn't help you ? '

verses.z: 王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既不做在我這[弟兄]中一個最小的身上，就是不做在我身上了。』
verses.e: " Then he will answer them , saying , ' Most certainly I tell you , because you didn't do it to one of the least of these , you didn't do it to me . '

verses.z: 這些人要往永刑裏去；那些義人要往永生裏去。」
verses.e: These will go away into eternal punishment , but the righteous into eternal life . "

verses.z: 新郎遲延的時候，她們都打盹，睡着了。
verses.e: Now while the bridegroom delayed , they all slumbered and slept .

verses.z: 半夜有人喊着說：『新郎來了，你們出來迎接他！』
verses.e: But at midnight there was a cry , ' Behold ! The bridegroom is coming ! Come out to meet him ! '

verses.z: 那些童女就都起來收拾燈。
verses.e: Then all those virgins arose , and trimmed their lamps .

verses.z: 愚拙的對聰明的說：『請分點油給我們，因為我們的燈要滅了。』
verses.e: The foolish said to the wise , ' Give us some of your oil , for our lamps are going out . '

verses.z: 聰明的回答說：『恐怕不夠你我用的；不如你們自己到賣油的那裏去買吧。』
verses.e: But the wise answered , saying , ' What if there isn't enough for us and you ? You go rather to those who sell , and buy for yourselves . '

verses.z: 耶穌說完了這一切的話，就對門徒說：
verses.e: When Jesus had finished all these words , he said to his disciples ,

verses.z: 耶穌看出他們的意思，就說：「為甚麼難為這女人呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
verses.e: However , knowing this , Jesus said to them , " Why do you trouble the woman ? She has done a good work for me .

verses.z: 因為常有窮人和你們同在；只是你們不常有我。
verses.e: For you always have the poor with you , but you don't always have me .

verses.z: 她將這香膏澆在我身上是為我安葬做的。
verses.e: For in pouring this ointment on my body , she did it to prepare me for burial .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所行的，作個紀念。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world , what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her . "

verses.z: 當下，十二門徒裏有一個稱為加略人猶大的，去見祭司長，
verses.e: Then one of the twelve , who was called Judas Iscariot , went to the chief priests

verses.z: 說：「我把他交給你們，你們願意給我多少錢？」他們就給了他三十塊錢。
verses.e: and said , " What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you ? " So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver .

verses.z: 從那時候，他就找機會要把耶穌交給他們。
verses.e: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him .

verses.z: 除酵節的第一天，門徒來問耶穌說：「你吃逾越[節的筵席]，要我們在哪裏給你預備？」
verses.e: Now on the first day of unleavened bread , the disciples came to Jesus , saying to him , " Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們進城去，到某人那裏，對他說：『夫子說：我的時候快到了，我與門徒要在你家裏守逾越[節]。』」
verses.e: He said , " Go into the city to a certain person , and tell him , ' The Teacher says , " My time is at hand . I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples . " ' "

verses.z: 門徒遵着耶穌所吩咐的就去預備了逾越[節的筵席]。
verses.e: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them , and they prepared the Passover .

verses.z: 「你們知道，過兩天是逾越節，人子將要被交給人，釘在十字架上。」
verses.e: " You know that after two days the Passover is coming , and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified . "

verses.z: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒坐席。
verses.e: Now when evening had come , he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples .

verses.z: 正吃的時候，耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」
verses.e: As they were eating , he said , " Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me . "

verses.z: 他們就甚憂愁，一個一個地問他說：「主，是我嗎？」
verses.e: They were exceedingly sorrowful , and each began to ask him , " It isn't me , is it , Lord ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「同我蘸手在盤子裏的，就是他要賣我。
verses.e: He answered , " He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me .

verses.z: 人子必要去世，正如[經上]指着他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。」
verses.e: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him , but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed ! It would be better for that man if he had not been born . "

verses.z: 賣耶穌的猶大問他說：「拉比，是我嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」
verses.e: Judas , who betrayed him , answered , " It isn't me , is it , Rabbi ? " He said to him , " You said it . "

verses.z: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝福，就擘開，遞給門徒，說：「你們拿着吃，這是我的身體」；
verses.e: As they were eating , Jesus took bread , gave thanks for it , and broke it . He gave to the disciples and said , " Take , eat ; this is my body . "

verses.z: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們，說：「你們都喝這個；
verses.e: He took the cup , gave thanks , and gave to them , saying , " All of you drink it ,

verses.z: 因為這是我立約的血，為多人流出來，使罪得赦。
verses.e: for this is my blood of the new covenant , which is poured out for many for the remission of sins .

verses.z: 但我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在我父的國裏同你們喝新的那日子。」
