verses.e: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on , until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 那時，祭司長和民間的長老聚集在大祭司稱為該亞法的院裏。
verses.e: Then the chief priests , the scribes , and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas .

verses.z: 他們唱了詩，就出來往橄欖山去。
verses.e: When they had sung a hymn , they went out to the Mount of Olives .

verses.z: 那時，耶穌對他們說：「今夜，你們為我的緣故都要跌倒。因為[經上]記着說：我要擊打牧人，羊就分散了。
verses.e: Then Jesus said to them , " All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight , for it is written , ' I will strike the shepherd , and the sheep of the flock will be scattered . '

verses.z: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。」
verses.e: But after I am raised up , I will go before you into Galilee . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「眾人雖然為你的緣故跌倒，我卻永不跌倒。」
verses.e: But Peter answered him , " Even if all will be made to stumble because of you , I will never be made to stumble . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你，今夜雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Most certainly I tell you that tonight , before the rooster crows , you will deny me three times . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。」眾門徒都是這樣說。
verses.e: Peter said to him , " Even if I must die with you , I will not deny you . " All of the disciples also said likewise .

verses.z: 耶穌同門徒來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼，就對他們說：「你們坐在這裏，等我到那邊去禱告。」
verses.e: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane , and said to his disciples , " Sit here , while I go there and pray . "

verses.z: 於是帶着彼得和西庇太的兩個兒子同去，就憂愁起來，極其難過，
verses.e: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled .

verses.z: 便對他們說：「我心裏甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裏等候，和我一同警醒。」
verses.e: Then Jesus said to them , " My soul is exceedingly sorrowful , even to death . Stay here and watch with me . "

verses.z: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：「我父啊，倘若可行，求你叫這杯離開我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。」
verses.e: He went forward a little , fell on his face , and prayed , saying , " My Father , if it is possible , let this cup pass away from me ; nevertheless , not what I desire , but what you desire . "

verses.z: 大家商議要用詭計拿住耶穌，殺他，
verses.e: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him .

verses.z: 來到門徒那裏，見他們睡着了，就對彼得說：「怎麼樣？你們不能同我警醒片時嗎？
verses.e: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping , and said to Peter , " What , couldn't you watch with me for one hour ?

verses.z: 總要警醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。」
verses.e: Watch and pray , that you don't enter into temptation . The spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak . "

verses.z: 第二次又去禱告說：「我父啊，這杯若不能離開我，必要我喝，就願你的意旨成全。」
verses.e: Again , a second time he went away and prayed , saying , " My Father , if this cup can't pass away from me unless I drink it , your desire be done . "

verses.z: 又來，見他們睡着了，因為他們的眼睛困倦。
verses.e: He came again and found them sleeping , for their eyes were heavy .

verses.z: 耶穌又離開他們去了。第三次禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣。
verses.e: He left them again , went away , and prayed a third time , saying the same words .

verses.z: 於是來到門徒那裏，對他們說：「現在你們仍然睡覺安歇吧！時候到了，人子被賣在罪人手裏了。
verses.e: Then he came to his disciples and said to them , " Are you still sleeping and resting ? Behold , the hour is at hand , and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .

verses.z: 起來！我們走吧。看哪，賣我的人近了！」
verses.e: Arise , let's be going . Behold , he who betrays me is at hand . "

verses.z: 說話之間，那十二個門徒裏的猶大來了，並有許多人帶着刀棒，從祭司長和民間的長老那裏與他同來。
verses.e: While he was still speaking , behold , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs , from the chief priests and elders of the people .

verses.z: 那賣耶穌的給了他們一個暗號，說：「我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們可以拿住他。」
verses.e: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign , saying , " Whoever I kiss , he is the one . Seize him . "

verses.z: 猶大隨即到耶穌跟前，說：「請拉比安」，就與他親嘴。
verses.e: Immediately he came to Jesus , and said , " Greetings , Rabbi ! " and kissed him .

verses.z: 只是說：「當節的日子不可，恐怕民間生亂。」
verses.e: But they said , " Not during the feast , lest a riot occur among the people . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「朋友，你來要做的事，就做吧。」於是那些人上前，下手拿住耶穌。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Friend , why are you here ? " Then they came and laid hands on Jesus , and took him .

verses.z: 有跟隨耶穌的一個人伸手拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
verses.e: Behold , one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword , and struck the servant of the high priest , and cut off his ear .

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「收刀入鞘吧！凡動刀的，必死在刀下。
verses.e: Then Jesus said to him , " Put your sword back into its place , for all those who take the sword will die by the sword .

verses.z: 你想，我不能求我父現在為我差遣十二營多天使來嗎？
verses.e: Or do you think that I couldn't ask my Father , and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels ?

verses.z: 若是這樣，經上所說，事情必須如此的話怎麼應驗呢？」
verses.e: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so ? "

verses.z: 當時，耶穌對眾人說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？我天天坐在殿裏教訓人，你們並沒有拿我。
verses.e: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes , " Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me ? I sat daily in the temple teaching , and you didn't arrest me .

verses.z: 但這一切的事成就了，為要應驗先知書上的話。」當下，門徒都離開他，逃走了。
verses.e: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled . " Then all the disciples left him and fled .

verses.z: 拿耶穌的人把他帶到大祭司該亞法那裏去；文士和長老已經在那裏聚會。
verses.e: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest , where the scribes and the elders were gathered together .

verses.z: 彼得遠遠地跟着耶穌，直到大祭司的院子，進到裏面，就和差役同坐，要看這事到底怎樣。
verses.e: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest , and entered in and sat with the officers , to see the end .

verses.z: 祭司長和全公會尋找假見證控告耶穌，要治死他。
verses.e: Now the chief priests , the elders , and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus , that they might put him to death ,

verses.z: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裏，
verses.e: Now when Jesus was in Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper ,

verses.z: 雖有好些人來作假見證，總得不着實據。末後有兩個人前來，說：
verses.e: and they found none . Even though many false witnesses came forward , they found none . But at last two false witnesses came forward

verses.z: 「這個人曾說：『我能拆毀上帝的殿，三日內又建造起來。』」
verses.e: and said , " This man said , ' I am able to destroy the temple of God , and to build it in three days . ' "

verses.z: 大祭司就站起來，對耶穌說：「你甚麼都不回答嗎？這些人作見證告你的是甚麼呢？」
verses.e: The high priest stood up and said to him , " Have you no answer ? What is this that these testify against you ? "

verses.z: 耶穌卻不言語。大祭司對他說：「我指着永生上帝叫你起誓告訴我們，你是上帝的兒子基督不是？」
verses.e: But Jesus stayed silent . The high priest answered him , " I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ , the Son of God . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你說的是。然而，我告訴你們，後來你們要看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕着天上的雲降臨。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " You have said so . Nevertheless , I tell you , after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power , and coming on the clouds of the sky . "

verses.z: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說：「他說了僭妄的話，我們何必再用見證人呢？這僭妄的話，現在你們都聽見了。
verses.e: Then the high priest tore his clothing , saying , " He has spoken blasphemy ! Why do we need any more witnesses ? Behold , now you have heard his blasphemy .

verses.z: 你們的意見如何？」他們回答說：「他是該死的。」
verses.e: What do you think ? " They answered , " He is worthy of death ! "

verses.z: 他們就吐唾沫在他臉上，用拳頭打他，也有用手掌打他的，說：
verses.e: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists , and some slapped him ,

verses.z: 「基督啊！你是先知，告訴我們打你的是誰？」
verses.e: saying , " Prophesy to us , you Christ ! Who hit you ? "

verses.z: 彼得在外面院子裏坐着，有一個使女前來，說：「你素來也是同那加利利人耶穌一夥的。」
verses.e: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court , and a maid came to him , saying , " You were also with Jesus , the Galilean ! "

verses.z: 有一個女人拿着一玉瓶極貴的香膏來，趁耶穌坐席的時候，澆在他的頭上。
verses.e: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment , and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table .

verses.z: 彼得在眾人面前卻不承認，說：「我不知道你說的是甚麼！」
verses.e: But he denied it before them all , saying , " I don't know what you are talking about . "

verses.z: 既出去，到了門口，又有一個[使女]看見他，就對那裏的人說：「這個人也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。」
verses.e: When he had gone out onto the porch , someone else saw him and said to those who were there , " This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth . "

verses.z: 彼得又不承認，並且起誓說：「我不認得那個人。」
verses.e: Again he denied it with an oath , " I don't know the man . "

verses.z: 過了不多的時候，旁邊站着的人前來，對彼得說：「你真是他們一黨的，你的口音把你露出來了。」
verses.e: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter , " Surely you are also one of them , for your speech makes you known . "

verses.z: 彼得就發咒起誓地說：「我不認得那個人。」立時，雞就叫了。
verses.e: Then he began to curse and to swear , " I don't know the man ! " Immediately the rooster crowed .

verses.z: 彼得想起耶穌所說的話：「雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」他就出去痛哭。
verses.e: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him , " Before the rooster crows , you will deny me three times . " Then he went out and wept bitterly .

verses.z: 門徒看見就很不喜悅，說：「何用這樣的枉費呢！
verses.e: But when his disciples saw this , they were indignant , saying , " Why this waste ?

verses.z: 這[香膏]可以賣許多錢，賙濟窮人。」
verses.e: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor . "

verses.z: 到了早晨，眾祭司長和民間的長老大家商議要治死耶穌，
verses.e: Now when morning had come , all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death .

verses.z: 買了窯戶的一塊田；這是照着主所吩咐我的。」
verses.e: and they gave them for the potter's field , as the Lord commanded me . "

verses.z: 耶穌站在巡撫面前；巡撫問他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」
verses.e: Now Jesus stood before the governor ; and the governor asked him , saying , " Are you the King of the Jews ? " Jesus said to him , " So you say . "

verses.z: 他被祭司長和長老控告的時候，甚麼都不回答。
verses.e: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .

verses.z: 彼拉多就對他說：「他們作見證告你這麼多的事，你沒有聽見嗎？」
verses.e: Then Pilate said to him , " Don't you hear how many things they testify against you ? "

verses.z: 耶穌仍不回答，連一句話也不說，以致巡撫甚覺希奇。
verses.e: He gave him no answer , not even one word , so that the governor marveled greatly .

verses.z: 巡撫有一個常例，每逢這節期，隨眾人所要的釋放一個囚犯給他們。
verses.e: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired .

verses.z: 當時有一個出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。
verses.e: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas .

verses.z: 眾人聚集的時候，彼拉多就對他們說：「你們要我釋放哪一個給你們？是巴拉巴呢？是稱為基督的耶穌呢？」
verses.e: When therefore they were gathered together , Pilate said to them , " Whom do you want me to release to you ? Barabbas , or Jesus who is called Christ ? "

verses.z: 巡撫原知道他們是因為嫉妒才把他解了來。
verses.e: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up .

verses.z: 正坐堂的時候，他的夫人打發人來說：「這義人的事，你一點不可管，因為我今天在夢中為他受了許多的苦。」
verses.e: While he was sitting on the judgment seat , his wife sent to him , saying , " Have nothing to do with that righteous man , for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him . "

verses.z: 就把他捆綁，解去，交給巡撫彼拉多。
verses.e: They bound him , led him away , and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate , the governor .

verses.z: 祭司長和長老挑唆眾人，求釋放巴拉巴，除滅耶穌。
verses.e: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus .

verses.z: 巡撫對眾人說：「這兩個人，你們要我釋放哪一個給你們呢？」他們說：「巴拉巴。」
verses.e: But the governor answered them , " Which of the two do you want me to release to you ? " They said , " Barabbas ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「這樣，那稱為基督的耶穌我怎麼辦他呢？」他們都說：「把他釘十字架！」
verses.e: Pilate said to them , " What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ ? " They all said to him , " Let him be crucified ! "

verses.z: 巡撫說：「為甚麼呢？他做了甚麼惡事呢？」他們便極力地喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
verses.e: But the governor said , " Why ? What evil has he done ? " But they cried out exceedingly , saying , " Let him be crucified ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多見說也無濟於事，反要生亂，就拿水在眾人面前洗手，說：「流這義人的血，罪不在我，你們承當吧。」
verses.e: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained , but rather that a disturbance was starting , he took water and washed his hands before the multitude , saying , " I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person . You see to it . "

verses.z: 眾人都回答說：「他的血歸到我們和我們的子孫身上。」
verses.e: All the people answered , " May his blood be on us and on our children ! "

verses.z: 於是彼拉多釋放巴拉巴給他們，把耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。
verses.e: Then he released Barabbas to them , but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified .

verses.z: 巡撫的兵就把耶穌帶進衙門，叫全營的兵都聚集在他那裏。
verses.e: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium , and gathered the whole garrison together against him .

verses.z: 他們給他脫了衣服，穿上一件朱紅色袍子，
verses.e: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him .

verses.z: 用荊棘編做冠冕，戴在他頭上，拿一根葦子放在他右手裏，跪在他面前，戲弄他，說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」
verses.e: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head , and a reed in his right hand ; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him , saying , " Hail , King of the Jews ! "

verses.z: 這時候，賣耶穌的猶大看見耶穌已經定了罪，就後悔，把那三十塊錢拿回來給祭司長和長老，說：
verses.e: Then Judas , who betrayed him , when he saw that Jesus was condemned , felt remorse , and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders ,

verses.z: 又吐唾沫在他臉上，拿葦子打他的頭。
verses.e: They spat on him , and took the reed and struck him on the head .

verses.z: 戲弄完了，就給他脫了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。
verses.e: When they had mocked him , they took the robe off him , and put his clothes on him , and led him away to crucify him .

verses.z: 他們出來的時候，遇見一個古利奈人，名叫西門，就勉強他同去，好背着耶穌的十字架。
verses.e: As they came out , they found a man of Cyrene , Simon by name , and they compelled him to go with them , that he might carry his cross .

verses.z: 到了一個地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髏地」。
verses.e: When they came to a place called " Golgotha " , that is to say , " The place of a skull , "

verses.z: 兵丁拿苦膽調和的酒給耶穌喝；他嘗了，就不肯喝。
verses.e: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall . When he had tasted it , he would not drink .

verses.z: 他們既將他釘在十字架上，就拈鬮分他的衣服，
verses.e: When they had crucified him , they divided his clothing among them , casting lots ,

verses.z: 又坐在那裏看守他。
verses.e: and they sat and watched him there .

verses.z: 在他頭以上安一個牌子，寫着他的罪狀，說：「這是猶太人的王耶穌。」
verses.e: They set up over his head the accusation against him written , " THIS IS JESUS , THE KING OF THE JEWS . "

verses.z: 當時，有兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。
verses.e: Then there were two robbers crucified with him , one on his right hand and one on the left .

verses.z: 從那裏經過的人譏誚他，搖着頭，說：
verses.e: Those who passed by blasphemed him , wagging their heads

verses.z: 「我賣了無辜之人的血是有罪了。」他們說：「那與我們有甚麼相干？你自己承當吧！」
verses.e: saying , " I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood . " But they said , " What is that to us ? You see to it . "

verses.z: 「你這拆毀[聖]殿、三日又建造起來的，可以救自己吧！你如果是上帝的兒子，就從十字架上下來吧！」
verses.e: and saying , " You who destroy the temple and build it in three days , save yourself ! If you are the Son of God , come down from the cross ! "

verses.z: 祭司長和文士並長老也是這樣戲弄他，說：
verses.e: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes , the Pharisees , and the elders , said ,

verses.z: 「他救了別人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，現在可以從十字架上下來，我們就信他。
verses.e: " He saved others , but he can't save himself . If he is the King of Israel , let him come down from the cross now , and we will believe in him .

verses.z: 他倚靠上帝，上帝若喜悅他，現在可以救他；因為他曾說：『我是上帝的兒子。』」
verses.e: He trusts in God . Let God deliver him now , if he wants him ; for he said , ' I am the Son of God . ' "

verses.z: 那和他同釘的強盜也是這樣地譏誚他。
verses.e: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach .

verses.z: 從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
verses.e: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour .

verses.z: 約在申初，耶穌大聲喊着說：「以利！以利！拉馬撒巴各大尼？」就是說：「我的上帝！我的上帝！為甚麼離棄我？」
verses.e: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying , " Eli , Eli , lima sabachthani ? " That is , " My God , my God , why have you forsaken me ? "

verses.z: 站在那裏的人，有的聽見就說：「這個人呼叫以利亞呢！」
verses.e: Some of them who stood there , when they heard it , said , " This man is calling Elijah . "

verses.z: 內中有一個人趕緊跑去，拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝。
verses.e: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge , filled it with vinegar , put it on a reed , and gave him a drink .

verses.z: 其餘的人說：「且等着，看以利亞來救他不來。」
verses.e: The rest said , " Let him be . Let's see whether Elijah comes to save him . "

verses.z: 猶大就把那銀錢丟在殿裏，出去吊死了。
verses.e: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed . Then he went away and hanged himself .

verses.z: 耶穌又大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。
verses.e: Jesus cried again with a loud voice , and yielded up his spirit .

verses.z: 忽然，殿裏的幔子從上到下裂為兩半，地也震動，磐石也崩裂，
verses.e: Behold , the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom . The earth quaked and the rocks were split .

verses.z: 墳墓也開了，已睡聖徒的身體多有起來的。
verses.e: The tombs were opened , and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised ;

verses.z: 到耶穌復活以後，他們從墳墓裏出來，進了聖城，向許多人顯現。
verses.e: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection , they entered into the holy city and appeared to many .

verses.z: 百夫長和一同看守耶穌的人看見地震並所經歷的事，就極其害怕，說：「這真是上帝的兒子了！」
verses.e: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus , when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done , were terrified , saying , " Truly this was the Son of God ! "

verses.z: 有好些婦女在那裏，遠遠地觀看；她們是從加利利跟隨耶穌來服事他的。
verses.e: Many women were there watching from afar , who had followed Jesus from Galilee , serving him .

verses.z: 內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有西庇太兩個兒子的母親。
verses.e: Among them were Mary Magdalene , Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of the sons of Zebedee .

verses.z: 到了晚上，有一個財主，名叫約瑟，是亞利馬太來的，他也是耶穌的門徒。
verses.e: When evening had come , a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph , who himself was also Jesus ' disciple , came .

verses.z: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；彼拉多就吩咐給他。
verses.e: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus ' body . Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up .

verses.z: 約瑟取了身體，用乾淨細麻布裹好，
verses.e: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

verses.z: 祭司長拾起銀錢來，說：「這是血價，不可放在庫裏。」
verses.e: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said , " It's not lawful to put them into the treasury , since it is the price of blood . "

verses.z: 安放在自己的新墳墓裏，就是他鑿在磐石裏的。他又把大石頭滾到墓門口，就去了。
verses.e: and laid it in his own new tomb , which he had cut out in the rock . Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb , and departed .

verses.z: 有抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞在那裏，對着墳墓坐着。
verses.e: Mary Magdalene was there , and the other Mary , sitting opposite the tomb .

verses.z: 次日，就是預備日的第二天，祭司長和法利賽人聚集來見彼拉多，說：
verses.e: Now on the next day , which was the day after the Preparation Day , the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate ,

verses.z: 「大人，我們記得那誘惑人的還活着的時候曾說：『三日後我要復活。』
verses.e: saying , " Sir , we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive : ' After three days I will rise again . '

verses.z: 因此，請吩咐人將墳墓把守妥當，直到第三日，恐怕他的門徒來，把他偷了去，就告訴百姓說：『他從死裏復活了。』這樣，那後來的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」
verses.e: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day , lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away , and tell the people , ' He is risen from the dead ; ' and the last deception will be worse than the first . "

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「你們有看守的兵，去吧！盡你們所能的把守妥當。」
verses.e: Pilate said to them , " You have a guard . Go , make it as secure as you can . "

verses.z: 他們就帶着看守的兵同去，封了石頭，將墳墓把守妥當。
verses.e: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure , sealing the stone .

verses.z: 他們商議，就用那銀錢買了窯戶的一塊田，為要埋葬外鄉人。
verses.e: They took counsel , and bought the potter's field with them to bury strangers in .

verses.z: 所以那塊田直到今日還叫做「血田」。
verses.e: Therefore that field has been called " The Field of Blood " to this day .

verses.z: 這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：「他們用那三十塊錢，就是被估定之人的價錢，是以色列人中所估定的，
verses.e: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled , saying , " They took the thirty pieces of silver , the price of him upon whom a price had been set , whom some of the children of Israel priced ,

verses.z: 安息日將盡，七日的頭一日，天快亮的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞來看墳墓。
verses.e: Now after the Sabbath , as it began to dawn on the first day of the week , Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb .

verses.z: 耶穌對她們說：「不要害怕！你們去告訴我的弟兄，叫他們往加利利去，在那裏必見我。」
verses.e: Then Jesus said to them , " Don't be afraid . Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee , and there they will see me . "

verses.z: 她們去的時候，看守的兵有幾個進城去，將所經歷的事都報給祭司長。
verses.e: Now while they were going , behold , some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened .

verses.z: 祭司長和長老聚集商議，就拿許多銀錢給兵丁，說：
verses.e: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel , they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers ,

verses.z: 「你們要這樣說：『夜間我們睡覺的時候，他的門徒來，把他偷去了。』
verses.e: saying , " Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept .

verses.z: 倘若這話被巡撫聽見，有我們勸他，保你們無事。」
verses.e: If this comes to the governor's ears , we will persuade him and make you free of worry . "

verses.z: 兵丁受了銀錢，就照所囑咐他們的去行。這話就傳說在猶太人中間，直到今日。
verses.e: So they took the money and did as they were told . This saying was spread abroad among the Jews , and continues until today .

verses.z: 十一個門徒往加利利去，到了耶穌約定的山上。
verses.e: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee , to the mountain where Jesus had sent them .

verses.z: 他們見了耶穌就拜他，然而還有人疑惑。
verses.e: When they saw him , they bowed down to him ; but some doubted .

verses.z: 耶穌進前來，對他們說：「天上地下所有的權柄都賜給我了。
verses.e: Jesus came to them and spoke to them , saying , " All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth .

verses.z: 所以，你們要去，使萬民作我的門徒，奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗。
verses.e: Go and make disciples of all nations , baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit ,

verses.z: 忽然，地大震動；因為有主的使者從天上下來，把石頭滾開，坐在上面。
verses.e: Behold , there was a great earthquake , for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it .

verses.z: 凡我所吩咐你們的，都教訓他們遵守，我就常與你們同在，直到世界的末了。」
verses.e: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you . Behold , I am with you always , even to the end of the age . " Amen .

verses.z: 他的相貌如同閃電，衣服潔白如雪。
verses.e: His appearance was like lightning , and his clothing white as snow .

verses.z: 看守的人就因他嚇得渾身亂戰，甚至和死人一樣。
verses.e: For fear of him , the guards shook , and became like dead men .

verses.z: 天使對婦女說：「不要害怕！我知道你們是尋找那釘十字架的耶穌。
verses.e: The angel answered the women , " Don't be afraid , for I know that you seek Jesus , who has been crucified .

verses.z: 他不在這裏，照他所說的，已經復活了。你們來看安放主的地方。
verses.e: He is not here , for he has risen , just like he said . Come , see the place where the Lord was lying .

verses.z: 快去告訴他的門徒，說他從死裏復活了，並且在你們以先往加利利去，在那裏你們要見他。看哪，我已經告訴你們了。」
verses.e: Go quickly and tell his disciples , ' He has risen from the dead , and behold , he goes before you into Galilee ; there you will see him . ' Behold , I have told you . "

verses.z: 婦女們就急忙離開墳墓，又害怕，又大大地歡喜，跑去要報給他的門徒。
verses.e: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy , and ran to bring his disciples word .

verses.z: 忽然，耶穌遇見她們，說：「願你們平安！」她們就上前抱住他的腳拜他。
verses.e: As they went to tell his disciples , behold , Jesus met them , saying , " Rejoice ! " They came and took hold of his feet , and worshiped him .

verses.z: 那時，有施洗的約翰出來，在猶太的曠野傳道，說：
verses.e: In those days , John the Baptizer came , preaching in the wilderness of Judea , saying ,

verses.z: 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。
verses.e: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees . Therefore every tree that doesn't produce good fruit is cut down , and cast into the fire .

verses.z: 我是用水給你們施洗，叫你們悔改。但那在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是給他提鞋也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。
verses.e: " I indeed baptize you in water for repentance , but he who comes after me is mightier than I , whose sandals I am not worthy to carry . He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 他手裏拿着簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裏，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。」
verses.e: His winnowing fork is in his hand , and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor . He will gather his wheat into the barn , but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire . "

verses.z: 當下，耶穌從加利利來到約旦河，見了約翰，要受他的洗。
verses.e: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John , to be baptized by him .

verses.z: 約翰想要攔住他，說：「我當受你的洗，你反倒上我這裏來嗎？」
verses.e: But John would have hindered him , saying , " I need to be baptized by you , and you come to me ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你暫且許我，因為我們理當這樣盡諸般的義。」於是約翰許了他。
verses.e: But Jesus , answering , said to him , " Allow it now , for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness . " Then he allowed him .

verses.z: 耶穌受了洗，隨即從水裏上來。天忽然為他開了，他就看見上帝的靈彷彿鴿子降下，落在他身上。
verses.e: Jesus , when he was baptized , went up directly from the water : and behold , the heavens were opened to him . He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove , and coming on him .

verses.z: 從天上有聲音說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。」
verses.e: Behold , a voice out of the heavens said , " This is my beloved Son , with whom I am well pleased . "

verses.z: 「天國近了，你們應當悔改！」
verses.e: " Repent , for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand ! "

verses.z: 這人就是先知以賽亞所說的。他說：「在曠野有人聲喊着說：預備主的道，修直他的路！」
verses.e: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet , saying , " The voice of one crying in the wilderness , make the way of the Lord ready ! Make his paths straight ! "

verses.z: 這約翰身穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
verses.e: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel's hair with a leather belt around his waist . His food was locusts and wild honey .

verses.z: 那時，耶路撒冷和猶太全地，並約旦河一帶地方的人，都出去到約翰那裏，
verses.e: Then people from Jerusalem , all of Judea , and all the region around the Jordan went out to him .

verses.z: 承認他們的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。
verses.e: They were baptized by him in the Jordan , confessing their sins .

verses.z: 約翰看見許多法利賽人和撒都該人也來受洗，就對他們說：「毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？
verses.e: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism , he said to them , " You offspring of vipers , who warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?

verses.z: 你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。
verses.e: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance !

verses.z: 不要自己心裏說：『有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。』我告訴你們，上帝能從這些石頭中給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。
verses.e: Don't think to yourselves , ' We have Abraham for our father , ' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones .

verses.z: 當時，耶穌被[聖]靈引到曠野，受魔鬼的試探。
verses.e: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「撒但，退去吧！因為[經上]記着說：當拜主－你的上帝，單要事奉他。」
verses.e: Then Jesus said to him , " Get behind me , Satan ! For it is written , ' You shall worship the Lord your God , and you shall serve him only . ' "

verses.z: 於是，魔鬼離了耶穌，有天使來伺候他。
verses.e: Then the devil left him , and behold , angels came and served him .

verses.z: 耶穌聽見約翰下了監，就退到加利利去；
verses.e: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up , he withdrew into Galilee .

verses.z: 後又離開拿撒勒，往迦百農去，就住在那裏。那地方靠海，在西布倫和拿弗他利的邊界上。
verses.e: Leaving Nazareth , he came and lived in Capernaum , which is by the sea , in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali ,

verses.z: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，
verses.e: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet , saying ,

verses.z: 說：西布倫地，拿弗他利地，就是沿海的路，約旦河外，外邦人的加利利地－
verses.e: " The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali , toward the sea , beyond the Jordan , Galilee of the Gentiles ,

verses.z: 那坐在黑暗裏的百姓看見了大光；坐在死蔭之地的人有光發現照着他們。
verses.e: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light ; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death , to them light has dawned . "

verses.z: 從那時候，耶穌就傳起道來，說：「天國近了，你們應當悔改！」
verses.e: From that time , Jesus began to preach , and to say , " Repent ! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand . "

verses.z: 耶穌在加利利海邊行走，看見弟兄二人，就是那稱呼彼得的西門和他兄弟安得烈，在海裏撒網；他們本是打魚的。
verses.e: Walking by the sea of Galilee , he saw two brothers : Simon , who is called Peter , and Andrew , his brother , casting a net into the sea ; for they were fishermen .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Come after me , and I will make you fishers for men . "

verses.z: 他禁食四十晝夜，後來就餓了。
verses.e: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights , he was hungry afterward .

verses.z: 他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
verses.e: They immediately left their nets and followed him .

verses.z: 從那裏往前走，又看見弟兄二人，就是西庇太的兒子雅各和他兄弟約翰，同他們的父親西庇太在船上補網，耶穌就招呼他們，
verses.e: Going on from there , he saw two other brothers , James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , in the boat with Zebedee their father , mending their nets . He called them .

verses.z: 他們立刻捨了船，別了父親，跟從了耶穌。
verses.e: They immediately left the boat and their father , and followed him .

verses.z: 耶穌走遍加利利，在各會堂裏教訓人，傳天國的福音，醫治百姓各樣的病症。
verses.e: Jesus went about in all Galilee , teaching in their synagogues , preaching the Good News of the Kingdom , and healing every disease and every sickness among the people .

verses.z: 他的名聲就傳遍了敘利亞。那裏的人把一切害病的，就是害各樣疾病、各樣疼痛的和被鬼附的、癲癇的、癱瘓的，都帶了來，耶穌就治好了他們。
verses.e: The report about him went out into all Syria . They brought to him all who were sick , afflicted with various diseases and torments , possessed with demons , epileptics , and paralytics ; and he healed them .

verses.z: 當下，有許多人從加利利、低加坡里、耶路撒冷、猶太、約旦河外來跟着他。
verses.e: Great multitudes from Galilee , Decapolis , Jerusalem , Judea , and from beyond the Jordan followed him .

verses.z: 那試探人的進前來，對他說：「你若是上帝的兒子，可以吩咐這些石頭變成食物。」
verses.e: The tempter came and said to him , " If you are the Son of God , command that these stones become bread . "

verses.z: 耶穌卻回答說：「[經上]記着說：人活着，不是單靠食物，乃是靠上帝口裏所出的一切話。」
verses.e: But he answered , " It is written , ' Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word that proceeds out of God's mouth . ' "

verses.z: 魔鬼就帶他進了聖城，叫他站在殿頂上，
verses.e: Then the devil took him into the holy city . He set him on the pinnacle of the temple ,

verses.z: 對他說：「你若是上帝的兒子，可以跳下去，因為[經上]記着說：主要為你吩咐他的使者用手托着你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。」
verses.e: and said to him , " If you are the Son of God , throw yourself down , for it is written , ' He will command his angels concerning you , ' and , ' On their hands they will bear you up , so that you don't dash your foot against a stone . ' "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「[經上]又記着說：『不可試探主－你的上帝。』」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Again , it is written , ' You shall not test the Lord , your God . ' "

verses.z: 魔鬼又帶他上了一座最高的山，將世上的萬國與萬國的榮華都指給他看，
verses.e: Again , the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain , and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory .

verses.z: 對他說：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把這一切都賜給你。」
verses.e: He said to him , " I will give you all of these things , if you will fall down and worship me . "

verses.z: 耶穌看見這許多的人，就上了山，既已坐下，門徒到他跟前來，
verses.e: Seeing the multitudes , he went up onto the mountain . When he had sat down , his disciples came to him .

verses.z: 為義受逼迫的人有福了！因為天國是他們的。
verses.e: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness ' sake , for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven .

verses.z: 「人若因我辱罵你們，逼迫你們，捏造各樣壞話毀謗你們，你們就有福了！
verses.e: " Blessed are you when people reproach you , persecute you , and say all kinds of evil against you falsely , for my sake .

verses.z: 應當歡喜快樂，因為你們在天上的賞賜是大的。在你們以前的先知，人也是這樣逼迫他們。」
verses.e: Rejoice , and be exceedingly glad , for great is your reward in heaven . For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you .

verses.z: 「你們是世上的鹽。鹽若失了味，怎能叫它再鹹呢？以後無用，不過丟在外面，被人踐踏了。
verses.e: " You are the salt of the earth , but if the salt has lost its flavor , with what will it be salted ? It is then good for nothing , but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men .

verses.z: 你們是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隱藏的。
verses.e: " You are the light of the world . A city located on a hill can't be hidden .

verses.z: 人點燈，不放在斗底下，是放在燈臺上，就照亮一家的人。
verses.e: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket , but on a stand ; and it shines to all who are in the house .

verses.z: 你們的光也當這樣照在人前，叫他們看見你們的好行為，便將榮耀歸給你們在天上的父。」
verses.e: Even so , let your light shine before men , that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven .

verses.z: 「莫想我來要廢掉律法和先知。我來不是要廢掉，乃是要成全。
verses.e: " Don't think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets . I didn't come to destroy , but to fulfill .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，就是到天地都廢去了，律法的一點一畫也不能廢去，都要成全。
verses.e: For most certainly , I tell you , until heaven and earth pass away , not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law , until all things are accomplished .

verses.z: 所以，無論何人廢掉這誡命中最小的一條，又教訓人這樣做，他在天國要稱為最小的。但無論何人遵行這誡命，又教訓人遵行，他在天國要稱為大的。
verses.e: Therefore , whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so , shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven ; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven .

verses.z: 他就開口教訓他們，說：
verses.e: He opened his mouth and taught them , saying ,

verses.z: 我告訴你們，你們的義若不勝於文士和法利賽人的義，斷不能進天國。」
verses.e: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees , there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven .

verses.z: 「你們聽見有吩咐古人的話，說：『不可殺人』；[又說]：『凡殺人的難免受審判。』
verses.e: " You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones , ' You shall not murder ; ' and ' Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment . '

verses.z: 只是我告訴你們，凡向弟兄動怒的，難免受審判；凡罵弟兄是拉加的，難免公會[的審判]；凡罵弟兄是魔利的，難免地獄的火。
verses.e: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment . Whoever says to his brother , ' Raca ! ' will be in danger of the council . Whoever says , ' You fool ! ' will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna .

verses.z: 所以，你在祭壇上獻禮物的時候，若想起弟兄向你懷怨，
verses.e: " If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar , and there remember that your brother has anything against you ,

verses.z: 就把禮物留在壇前，先去同弟兄和好，然後來獻禮物。
verses.e: leave your gift there before the altar , and go your way . First be reconciled to your brother , and then come and offer your gift .

verses.z: 你同告你的對頭還在路上，就趕緊與他和息，恐怕他把你送給審判官，審判官交付衙役，你就下在監裏了。
verses.e: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way ; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge , and the judge deliver you to the officer , and you be cast into prison .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你，若有一文錢沒有還清，你斷不能從那裏出來。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny .

verses.z: 「你們聽見有話說：『不可姦淫。』
verses.e: " You have heard that it was said , ' You shall not commit adultery ; '

verses.z: 只是我告訴你們，凡看見婦女就動淫念的，這人心裏已經與她犯姦淫了。
verses.e: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart .

verses.z: 若是你的右眼叫你跌倒，就剜出來丟掉，寧可失去百體中的一體，不叫全身丟在地獄裏。
verses.e: If your right eye causes you to stumble , pluck it out and throw it away from you . For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna .

verses.z: 虛心的人有福了！因為天國是他們的。
verses.e: " Blessed are the poor in spirit , for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven .

verses.z: 若是右手叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉，寧可失去百體中的一體，不叫全身下入地獄。」
verses.e: If your right hand causes you to stumble , cut it off , and throw it away from you . For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish , than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna .

verses.z: 「又有話說：『人若休妻，就當給她休書。』
verses.e: " It was also said , ' Whoever shall put away his wife , let him give her a writing of divorce , '

verses.z: 只是我告訴你們，凡休妻的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是叫她作淫婦了；人若娶這被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。」
verses.e: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife , except for the cause of sexual immorality , makes her an adulteress ; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery .

verses.z: 「你們又聽見有吩咐古人的話，說：『不可背誓，所起的誓總要向主謹守。』
verses.e: " Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones , ' You shall not make false vows , but shall perform to the Lord your vows , '

verses.z: 只是我告訴你們，甚麼誓都不可起。不可指着天起誓，因為天是上帝的座位；
verses.e: but I tell you , don't swear at all : neither by heaven , for it is the throne of God ;

verses.z: 不可指着地起誓，因為地是他的腳凳；也不可指着耶路撒冷起誓，因為耶路撒冷是大君的京城；
verses.e: nor by the earth , for it is the footstool of his feet ; nor by Jerusalem , for it is the city of the great King .

verses.z: 又不可指着你的頭起誓，因為你不能使一根頭髮變黑變白了。
verses.e: Neither shall you swear by your head , for you can't make one hair white or black .

verses.z: 你們的話，是，就說是；不是，就說不是；若再多說就是出於那惡者。」
verses.e: But let your ' Yes ' be ' Yes ' and your ' No ' be ' No . ' Whatever is more than these is of the evil one .

verses.z: 「你們聽見有話說：『以眼還眼，以牙還牙。』
verses.e: " You have heard that it was said , ' An eye for an eye , and a tooth for a tooth . '

verses.z: 只是我告訴你們，不要與惡人作對。有人打你的右臉，連左臉也轉過來由他打；
verses.e: But I tell you , don't resist him who is evil ; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek , turn to him the other also .

verses.z: 哀慟的人有福了！因為他們必得安慰。
verses.e: Blessed are those who mourn , for they shall be comforted .

verses.z: 有人想要告你，要拿你的裏衣，連外衣也由他拿去；
verses.e: If anyone sues you to take away your coat , let him have your cloak also .

verses.z: 有人強逼你走一里路，你就同他走二里；
verses.e: Whoever compels you to go one mile , go with him two .

verses.z: 有求你的，就給他；有向你借貸的，不可推辭。」
verses.e: Give to him who asks you , and don't turn away him who desires to borrow from you .

verses.z: 「你們聽見有話說：『當愛你的鄰舍，恨你的仇敵。』
verses.e: " You have heard that it was said , ' You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy . '

verses.z: 只是我告訴你們，要愛你們的仇敵，為那逼迫你們的禱告。
verses.e: But I tell you , love your enemies , bless those who curse you , do good to those who hate you , and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you ,

verses.z: [這樣]就可以作你們天父的兒子；因為他叫日頭照好人，也照歹人；降雨給義人，也給不義的人。
verses.e: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven . For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good , and sends rain on the just and the unjust .

verses.z: 你們若[單]愛那愛你們的人，有甚麼賞賜呢？就是稅吏不也是這樣行嗎？
verses.e: For if you love those who love you , what reward do you have ? Don't even the tax collectors do the same ?

verses.z: 你們若單請你弟兄的安，比人有甚麼長處呢？就是外邦人不也是這樣行嗎？
verses.e: If you only greet your friends , what more do you do than others ? Don't even the tax collectors do the same ?

verses.z: 所以，你們要完全，像你們的天父完全一樣。」
verses.e: Therefore you shall be perfect , just as your Father in heaven is perfect .

verses.z: 溫柔的人有福了！因為他們必承受地土。
verses.e: Blessed are the gentle , for they shall inherit the earth .

verses.z: 飢渴慕義的人有福了！因為他們必得飽足。
verses.e: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness , for they shall be filled .

verses.z: 憐恤人的人有福了！因為他們必蒙憐恤。
verses.e: Blessed are the merciful , for they shall obtain mercy .

verses.z: 清心的人有福了！因為他們必得見上帝。
verses.e: Blessed are the pure in heart , for they shall see God .

verses.z: 使人和睦的人有福了！因為他們必稱為上帝的兒子。
verses.e: Blessed are the peacemakers , for they shall be called children of God .

verses.z: 「你們要小心，不可將善事行在人的面前，故意叫他們看見，若是這樣，就不能得你們天父的賞賜了。
verses.e: " Be careful that you don't do your charitable giving before men , to be seen by them , or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven .

verses.z: 願你的國降臨；願你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。
verses.e: Let your Kingdom come . Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven .

verses.z: 我們日用的飲食，今日賜給我們。
verses.e: Give us today our daily bread .

verses.z: 免我們的債，如同我們免了人的債。
verses.e: Forgive us our debts , as we also forgive our debtors .

verses.z: 不叫我們遇見試探；救我們脫離凶惡。因為國度、權柄、榮耀，全是你的，直到永遠。阿們！
verses.e: Bring us not into temptation , but deliver us from the evil one . For yours is the Kingdom , the power , and the glory forever . Amen . '

verses.z: 「你們饒恕人的過犯，你們的天父也必饒恕你們[的過犯]；
verses.e: " For if you forgive men their trespasses , your heavenly Father will also forgive you .

verses.z: 你們不饒恕人的過犯，你們的[天]父也必不饒恕你們的過犯。」
verses.e: But if you don't forgive men their trespasses , neither will your Father forgive your trespasses .

verses.z: 「你們禁食的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，臉上帶着愁容；因為他們把臉弄得難看，故意叫人看出他們是禁食。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
verses.e: " Moreover when you fast , don't be like the hypocrites , with sad faces . For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting . Most certainly I tell you , they have received their reward .

verses.z: 你禁食的時候，要梳頭洗臉，
verses.e: But you , when you fast , anoint your head and wash your face ,

verses.z: 不叫人看出你禁食來，只叫你暗中的父看見；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。」
verses.e: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting , but by your Father who is in secret ; and your Father , who sees in secret , will reward you .

verses.z: 「不要為自己積攢財寶在地上；地上有蟲子咬，能銹壞，也有賊挖窟窿來偷。
verses.e: " Don't lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth , where moth and rust consume , and where thieves break through and steal ;

verses.z: 所以，你施捨的時候，不可在你前面吹號，像那假冒為善的人在會堂裏和街道上所行的，故意要得人的榮耀。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
verses.e: Therefore , when you do merciful deeds , don't sound a trumpet before yourself , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may get glory from men . Most certainly I tell you , they have received their reward .

verses.z: 只要積攢財寶在天上；天上沒有蟲子咬，不能銹壞，也沒有賊挖窟窿來偷。
verses.e: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust consume , and where thieves don't break through and steal ;

verses.z: 因為你的財寶在哪裏，你的心也在那裏。」
verses.e: for where your treasure is , there your heart will be also .

verses.z: 「眼睛就是身上的燈。你的眼睛若瞭亮，全身就光明；
verses.e: " The lamp of the body is the eye . If therefore your eye is sound , your whole body will be full of light .

verses.z: 你的眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。你裏頭的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等大呢！」
verses.e: But if your eye is evil , your whole body will be full of darkness . If therefore the light that is in you is darkness , how great is the darkness !

verses.z: 「一個人不能事奉兩個主；不是惡這個、愛那個，就是重這個、輕那個。你們不能又事奉上帝，又事奉瑪門。」
verses.e: " No one can serve two masters , for either he will hate the one and love the other , or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other . You can't serve both God and Mammon .

verses.z: 「所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮吃甚麼，喝甚麼；為身體憂慮穿甚麼。生命不勝於飲食嗎？身體不勝於衣裳嗎？
verses.e: Therefore I tell you , don't be anxious for your life : what you will eat , or what you will drink ; nor yet for your body , what you will wear . Isn't life more than food , and the body more than clothing ?

verses.z: 你們看那天上的飛鳥，也不種，也不收，也不積蓄在倉裏，你們的天父尚且養活牠。你們不比飛鳥貴重得多嗎？
verses.e: See the birds of the sky , that they don't sow , neither do they reap , nor gather into barns . Your heavenly Father feeds them . Aren't you of much more value than they ?

verses.z: 你們哪一個能用思慮使壽數多加一刻呢？
verses.e: " Which of you by being anxious , can add one moment to his lifespan ?

verses.z: 何必為衣裳憂慮呢？你想野地裏的百合花怎麼長起來；它也不勞苦，也不紡線。
verses.e: Why are you anxious about clothing ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow . They don't toil , neither do they spin ,

verses.z: 然而我告訴你們，就是所羅門極榮華的時候，他所穿戴的，還不如這花一朵呢！
verses.e: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these .

verses.z: 你施捨的時候，不要叫左手知道右手所做的，
verses.e: But when you do merciful deeds , don't let your left hand know what your right hand does ,

verses.z: 你們這小信的人哪！野地裏的草今天還在，明天就丟在爐裏，上帝還給它這樣的妝飾，何況你們呢！
verses.e: But if God so clothes the grass of the field , which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven , won't he much more clothe you , you of little faith ?

verses.z: 所以，不要憂慮說，吃甚麼？喝甚麼？穿甚麼？
verses.e: " Therefore don't be anxious , saying , ' What will we eat ? ' , ' What will we drink ? ' or , ' With what will we be clothed ? '

verses.z: 這都是外邦人所求的。你們需用的這一切東西，你們的天父是知道的。
verses.e: For the Gentiles seek after all these things ; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things .

verses.z: 你們要先求他的國和他的義，這些東西都要加給你們了。
verses.e: But seek first God's Kingdom and his righteousness ; and all these things will be given to you as well .

verses.z: 所以，不要為明天憂慮，因為明天自有明天的憂慮；一天的難處一天當就夠了。」
verses.e: Therefore don't be anxious for tomorrow , for tomorrow will be anxious for itself . Each day's own evil is sufficient .

verses.z: 要叫你施捨的事行在暗中。你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。」
verses.e: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret , then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly .

verses.z: 「你們禱告的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，愛站在會堂裏和十字路口上禱告，故意叫人看見。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
verses.e: " When you pray , you shall not be as the hypocrites , for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets , that they may be seen by men . Most certainly , I tell you , they have received their reward .

verses.z: 你禱告的時候，要進你的內屋，關上門，禱告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。
verses.e: But you , when you pray , enter into your inner room , and having shut your door , pray to your Father who is in secret ; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly .

verses.z: 你們禱告，不可像外邦人，用許多重複話，他們以為話多了必蒙垂聽。
verses.e: In praying , don't use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do ; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking .

verses.z: 你們不可效法他們；因為你們沒有祈求以先，你們所需用的，你們的父早已知道了。
verses.e: Therefore don't be like them , for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him .

verses.z: 所以，你們禱告要這樣說：我們在天上的父：願人都尊你的名為聖。
verses.e: Pray like this : " ' Our Father in heaven , may your name be kept holy .

verses.z: 「你們不要論斷人，免得你們被論斷。
verses.e: " Don't judge , so that you won't be judged .

verses.z: 求魚，反給他蛇呢？
verses.e: Or if he asks for a fish , who will give him a serpent ?

verses.z: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女，何況你們在天上的父，豈不更把好東西給求他的人嗎？
verses.e: If you then , being evil , know how to give good gifts to your children , how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him !

verses.z: 所以，無論何事，你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人，因為這就是律法和先知[的道理]。」
verses.e: Therefore , whatever you desire for men to do to you , you shall also do to them ; for this is the law and the prophets .

verses.z: 「你們要進窄門。因為引到滅亡，那門是寬的，路是大的，進去的人也多；
verses.e: " Enter in by the narrow gate ; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction , and there are many who enter in by it .

verses.z: 引到[永]生，那門是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。」
verses.e: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life ! There are few who find it .

verses.z: 「你們要防備假先知。他們到你們這裏來，外面披着羊皮，裏面卻是殘暴的狼。
verses.e: " Beware of false prophets , who come to you in sheep's clothing , but inwardly are ravening wolves .

verses.z: 憑着他們的果子，就可以認出他們來。荊棘上豈能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜裏豈能摘無花果呢？
verses.e: By their fruits you will know them . Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles ?

verses.z: 這樣，凡好樹都結好果子，惟獨壞樹結壞果子。
verses.e: Even so , every good tree produces good fruit , but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit .

verses.z: 好樹不能結壞果子；壞樹不能結好果子。
verses.e: A good tree can't produce evil fruit , neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit .

verses.z: 凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。
verses.e: Every tree that doesn't grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire .

verses.z: 因為你們怎樣論斷人，也必怎樣被論斷；你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。
verses.e: For with whatever judgment you judge , you will be judged ; and with whatever measure you measure , it will be measured to you .

verses.z: 所以，憑着他們的果子就可以認出他們來。」
verses.e: Therefore by their fruits you will know them .

verses.z: 「凡稱呼我『主啊，主啊』的人不能都進天國；惟獨遵行我天父旨意的人才能進去。
verses.e: " Not everyone who says to me , ' Lord , Lord , ' will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven , but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven .

verses.z: 當那日必有許多人對我說：『主啊，主啊，我們不是奉你的名傳道，奉你的名趕鬼，奉你的名行許多異能嗎？』
verses.e: Many will tell me in that day , ' Lord , Lord , didn't we prophesy in your name , in your name cast out demons , and in your name do many mighty works ? '

verses.z: 我就明明地告訴他們說：『我從來不認識你們，你們這些作惡的人，離開我去吧！』」
verses.e: Then I will tell them , ' I never knew you . Depart from me , you who work iniquity . '

verses.z: 「所以，凡聽見我這話就去行的，好比一個聰明人，把房子蓋在磐石上；
verses.e: " Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them , I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock .

verses.z: 雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞着那房子，房子總不倒塌，因為根基立在磐石上。
verses.e: The rain came down , the floods came , and the winds blew and beat on that house ; and it didn't fall , for it was founded on the rock .

verses.z: 凡聽見我這話不去行的，好比一個無知的人，把房子蓋在沙土上；
verses.e: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn't do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand .

verses.z: 雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，並且倒塌得很大。」
verses.e: The rain came down , the floods came , and the winds blew and beat on that house ; and it fell — and its fall was great . "

verses.z: 耶穌講完了這些話，眾人都希奇他的教訓；
verses.e: When Jesus had finished saying these things , the multitudes were astonished at his teaching ,

verses.z: 因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像他們的文士。
verses.e: for he taught them with authority , and not like the scribes .

verses.z: 為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中有刺，卻不想自己眼中有樑木呢？
verses.e: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye , but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye ?

verses.z: 你自己眼中有樑木，怎能對你弟兄說：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？
verses.e: Or how will you tell your brother , ' Let me remove the speck from your eye , ' and behold , the beam is in your own eye ?

verses.z: 你這假冒為善的人！先去掉自己眼中的樑木，然後才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
verses.e: You hypocrite ! First remove the beam out of your own eye , and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother's eye .

verses.z: 不要把聖物給狗，也不要把你們的珍珠丟在豬前，恐怕牠踐踏了珍珠，轉過來咬你們。」
verses.e: " Don't give that which is holy to the dogs , neither throw your pearls before the pigs , lest perhaps they trample them under their feet , and turn and tear you to pieces .

verses.z: 「你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
verses.e: " Ask , and it will be given you . Seek , and you will find . Knock , and it will be opened for you .

verses.z: 因為凡祈求的，就得着；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
verses.e: For everyone who asks receives . He who seeks finds . To him who knocks it will be opened .

verses.z: 你們中間誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？
verses.e: Or who is there among you who , if his son asks him for bread , will give him a stone ?

verses.z: 耶穌下了山，有許多人跟着他。
verses.e: When he came down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .

verses.z: 耶穌聽見就希奇，對跟從的人說：「我實在告訴你們，這麼大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也沒有遇見過。
verses.e: When Jesus heard it , he marveled and said to those who followed , " Most certainly I tell you , I haven't found so great a faith , not even in Israel .

verses.z: 我又告訴你們，從東從西，將有許多人來，在天國裏與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各一同坐席；
verses.e: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west , and will sit down with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven ,

verses.z: 惟有本國的子民竟被趕到外邊黑暗裏去，在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」
verses.e: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness . There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth . "

verses.z: 耶穌對百夫長說：「你回去吧！照你的信心，給你成全了。」那時，他的僕人就好了。
verses.e: Jesus said to the centurion , " Go your way . Let it be done for you as you have believed . " His servant was healed in that hour .

verses.z: 耶穌到了彼得家裏，見彼得的岳母害熱病躺着。
verses.e: When Jesus came into Peter's house , he saw his wife's mother lying sick with a fever .

verses.z: 耶穌把她的手一摸，熱就退了；她就起來服事耶穌。
verses.e: He touched her hand , and the fever left her . So she got up and served him .

verses.z: 到了晚上，有人帶着許多被鬼附的來到耶穌跟前，他只用一句話就把鬼都趕出去，並且治好了一切有病的人。
verses.e: When evening came , they brought to him many possessed with demons . He cast out the spirits with a word , and healed all who were sick ,

verses.z: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：他代替我們的軟弱，擔當我們的疾病。
verses.e: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet , saying , " He took our infirmities and bore our diseases . "

verses.z: 耶穌見許多人圍着他，就吩咐渡到那邊去。
verses.e: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him , he gave the order to depart to the other side .

verses.z: 有一個文士來，對他說：「夫子，你無論往哪裏去，我要跟從你。」
verses.e: A scribe came and said to him , " Teacher , I will follow you wherever you go . "

verses.z: 有一個長大痲瘋的來拜他，說：「主若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
verses.e: Behold , a leper came to him and worshiped him , saying , " Lord , if you want to , you can make me clean . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests , but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head . "

verses.z: 又有一個門徒對耶穌說：「主啊，容我先回去埋葬我的父親。」
verses.e: Another of his disciples said to him , " Lord , allow me first to go and bury my father . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「任憑死人埋葬他們的死人；你跟從我吧！」
verses.e: But Jesus said to him , " Follow me , and leave the dead to bury their own dead . "

verses.z: 耶穌上了船，門徒跟着他。
verses.e: When he got into a boat , his disciples followed him .

verses.z: 海裏忽然起了暴風，甚至船被波浪掩蓋；耶穌卻睡着了。
verses.e: Behold , a violent storm came up on the sea , so much that the boat was covered with the waves ; but he was asleep .

verses.z: 門徒來叫醒了他，說：「主啊，救我們，我們喪命啦！」
verses.e: The disciples came to him and woke him up , saying , " Save us , Lord ! We are dying ! "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們這小信的人哪，為甚麼膽怯呢？」於是起來，斥責風和海，風和海就大大地平靜了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Why are you fearful , O you of little faith ? " Then he got up , rebuked the wind and the sea , and there was a great calm .

verses.z: 眾人希奇，說：「這是怎樣的人？連風和海也聽從他了！」
verses.e: The men marveled , saying , " What kind of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ? "

verses.z: 耶穌既渡到那邊去，來到加大拉人的地方，就有兩個被鬼附的人從墳塋裏出來迎着他，極其凶猛，甚至沒有人能從那條路上經過。
verses.e: When he came to the other side , into the country of the Gergesenes , two people possessed by demons met him there , coming out of the tombs , exceedingly fierce , so that nobody could pass that way .

verses.z: 他們喊着說：「上帝的兒子，我們與你有甚麼相干？時候還沒有到，你就上這裏來叫我們受苦嗎？」
verses.e: Behold , they cried out , saying , " What do we have to do with you , Jesus , Son of God ? Have you come here to torment us before the time ? "

verses.z: 耶穌伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」他的大痲瘋立刻就潔淨了。
verses.e: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him , saying , " I want to . Be made clean . " Immediately his leprosy was cleansed .

verses.z: 離他們很遠，有一大群豬吃食。
verses.e: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them .

verses.z: 鬼就央求耶穌，說：「若把我們趕出去，就打發我們進入豬群吧！」
verses.e: The demons begged him , saying , " If you cast us out , permit us to go away into the herd of pigs . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「去吧！」鬼就出來，進入豬群。全群忽然闖下山崖，投在海裏淹死了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Go ! " They came out and went into the herd of pigs ; and behold , the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water .

verses.z: 放豬的就逃跑進城，將這一切事和被鬼附的人所遭遇的都告訴人。
verses.e: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything , including what happened to those who were possessed with demons .

verses.z: 合城的人都出來迎見耶穌，既見了就央求他離開他們的境界。
verses.e: Behold , all the city came out to meet Jesus . When they saw him , they begged that he would depart from their borders .

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你切不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " See that you tell nobody ; but go , show yourself to the priest , and offer the gift that Moses commanded , as a testimony to them . "

verses.z: 耶穌進了迦百農，有一個百夫長進前來，求他說：
verses.e: When he came into Capernaum , a centurion came to him , asking him for help ,

verses.z: 「主啊，我的僕人害癱瘓病，躺在家裏，甚是疼苦。」
verses.e: saying , " Lord , my servant lies in the house paralyzed , grievously tormented . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我去醫治他。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " I will come and heal him . "

verses.z: 百夫長回答說：「主啊，你到我舍下，我不敢當；只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必好了。
verses.e: The centurion answered , " Lord , I'm not worthy for you to come under my roof . Just say the word , and my servant will be healed .

verses.z: 因為我在人的權下，也有兵在我以下；對這個說『去！』他就去；對那個說『來！』他就來；對我的僕人說『你做這事！』他就去做。」
verses.e: For I am also a man under authority , having under myself soldiers . I tell this one , ' Go , ' and he goes ; and tell another , ' Come , ' and he comes ; and tell my servant , ' Do this , ' and he does it . "

verses.z: 耶穌上了船，渡過[海]，來到自己的城裏。
verses.e: He entered into a boat and crossed over , and came into his own city .

verses.z: 耶穌在屋裏坐席的時候，有好些稅吏和罪人來，與耶穌和他的門徒一同坐席。
verses.e: As he sat in the house , behold , many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples .

verses.z: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌的門徒說：「你們的先生為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同吃飯呢？」
verses.e: When the Pharisees saw it , they said to his disciples , " Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners ? "

verses.z: 耶穌聽見，就說：「康健的人用不着醫生，有病的人才用得着。
verses.e: When Jesus heard it , he said to them , " Those who are healthy have no need for a physician , but those who are sick do .

verses.z: [經上說]：『我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。』這句話的意思，你們且去揣摩。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。」
verses.e: But you go and learn what this means : ' I desire mercy , and not sacrifice , ' for I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance . "

verses.z: 那時，約翰的門徒來見耶穌，說：「我們和法利賽人常常禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？」
verses.e: Then John's disciples came to him , saying , " Why do we and the Pharisees fast often , but your disciples don't fast ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，陪伴之人豈能哀慟呢？但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那時候他們就要禁食。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them ? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them , and then they will fast .

verses.z: 沒有人把新布補在舊衣服上；因為所補上的反帶壞了那衣服，破的就更大了。
verses.e: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment ; for the patch would tear away from the garment , and a worse hole is made .

verses.z: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裏；若是這樣，皮袋就裂開，酒漏出來，連皮袋也壞了。惟獨把新酒裝在新皮袋裏，兩樣就都保全了。」
verses.e: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins , or else the skins would burst , and the wine be spilled , and the skins ruined . No , they put new wine into fresh wineskins , and both are preserved . "

verses.z: 耶穌說這話的時候，有一個管[會堂的]來拜他，說：「我女兒剛才死了，求你去按手在她身上，她就必活了。」
verses.e: While he told these things to them , behold , a ruler came and worshiped him , saying , " My daughter has just died , but come and lay your hand on her , and she will live . "

verses.z: 耶穌便起來跟着他去；門徒也跟了去。
verses.e: Jesus got up and followed him , as did his disciples .

verses.z: 有人用褥子抬着一個癱子到耶穌跟前來。耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：「小子，放心吧！你的罪赦了。」
verses.e: Behold , they brought to him a man who was paralyzed , lying on a bed . Jesus , seeing their faith , said to the paralytic , " Son , cheer up ! Your sins are forgiven you . "

verses.z: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，來到耶穌背後，摸他的衣裳繸子；
verses.e: Behold , a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him , and touched the fringe of his garment ;

verses.z: 因為她心裏說：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊癒。」
verses.e: for she said within herself , " If I just touch his garment , I will be made well . "

verses.z: 耶穌轉過來，看見她，就說：「女兒，放心！你的信救了你。」從那時候，女人就痊癒了。
verses.e: But Jesus , turning around and seeing her , said , " Daughter , cheer up ! Your faith has made you well . " And the woman was made well from that hour .

verses.z: 耶穌到了管[會堂]的家裏，看見有吹手，又有許多人亂嚷，
verses.e: When Jesus came into the ruler's house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder ,

verses.z: 就說：「退去吧！這閨女不是死了，是睡着了。」他們就嗤笑他。
verses.e: he said to them , " Make room , because the girl isn't dead , but sleeping . " They were ridiculing him .

verses.z: 眾人既被攆出，耶穌就進去，拉着閨女的手，閨女便起來了。
verses.e: But when the crowd was sent out , he entered in , took her by the hand , and the girl arose .

verses.z: 於是這風聲傳遍了那地方。
verses.e: The report of this went out into all that land .

verses.z: 耶穌從那裏往前走，有兩個瞎子跟着他，喊叫說：「大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
verses.e: As Jesus passed by from there , two blind men followed him , calling out and saying , " Have mercy on us , son of David ! "

verses.z: 耶穌進了房子，瞎子就來到他跟前。耶穌說：「你們信我能做這事嗎？」他們說：「主啊，我們信。」
verses.e: When he had come into the house , the blind men came to him . Jesus said to them , " Do you believe that I am able to do this ? " They told him , " Yes , Lord . "

verses.z: 耶穌就摸他們的眼睛，說：「照着你們的信給你們成全了吧。」
verses.e: Then he touched their eyes , saying , " According to your faith be it done to you . "

verses.z: 有幾個文士心裏說：「這個人說僭妄的話了。」
verses.e: Behold , some of the scribes said to themselves , " This man blasphemes . "

verses.z: 他們的眼睛就開了。耶穌切切地囑咐他們說：「你們要小心，不可叫人知道。」
verses.e: Then their eyes were opened . Jesus strictly commanded them , saying , " See that no one knows about this . "

verses.z: 他們出去，竟把他的名聲傳遍了那地方。
verses.e: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land .

verses.z: 他們出去的時候，有人將鬼所附的一個啞巴帶到耶穌跟前來。
verses.e: As they went out , behold , a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him .

verses.z: 鬼被趕出去，啞巴就說出話來。眾人都希奇，說：「在以色列中，從來沒有見過這樣的事。」
verses.e: When the demon was cast out , the mute man spoke . The multitudes marveled , saying , " Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel ! "

verses.z: 法利賽人卻說：「他是靠着鬼王趕鬼。」
verses.e: But the Pharisees said , " By the prince of the demons , he casts out demons . "

verses.z: 耶穌走遍各城各鄉，在會堂裏教訓人，宣講天國的福音，又醫治各樣的病症。
verses.e: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages , teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom , and healing every disease and every sickness among the people .

verses.z: 他看見許多的人，就憐憫他們；因為他們困苦流離，如同羊沒有牧人一般。
verses.e: But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered , like sheep without a shepherd .

verses.z: 於是對門徒說：「要收的莊稼多，做工的人少。
verses.e: Then he said to his disciples , " The harvest indeed is plentiful , but the laborers are few .

verses.z: 所以，你們當求莊稼的主打發工人出去收他的莊稼。」
verses.e: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest . "

verses.z: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就說：「你們為甚麼心裏懷着惡念呢？
verses.e: Jesus , knowing their thoughts , said , " Why do you think evil in your hearts ?

verses.z: 或說『你的罪赦了』，或說『你起來行走』，哪一樣容易呢？
verses.e: For which is easier , to say , ' Your sins are forgiven ; ' or to say , ' Get up , and walk ' ?

verses.z: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄」；就對癱子說：「起來！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」
verses.e: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins — " ( then he said to the paralytic ) , " Get up , and take up your mat , and go to your house . "

verses.z: 那人就起來，回家去了。
verses.e: He arose and departed to his house .

verses.z: 眾人看見都驚奇，就歸榮耀與上帝，因為他將這樣的權柄賜給人。
verses.e: But when the multitudes saw it , they marveled and glorified God , who had given such authority to men .

verses.z: 耶穌從那裏往前走，看見一個人名叫馬太，坐在稅關上，就對他說：「你跟從我來。」他就起來跟從了耶穌。
verses.e: As Jesus passed by from there , he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office . He said to him , " Follow me . " He got up and followed him .

verses.z: 當猶大王約坦、亞哈斯、希西家在位的時候，摩利沙人彌迦得耶和華的默示，論撒馬利亞和耶路撒冷。
verses.e: The LORD's word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .

verses.z: 不要在迦特報告這事，總不要哭泣；我在伯‧亞弗拉滾於灰塵之中。
verses.e: Don't tell it in Gath . Don't weep at all . At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust .

verses.z: 沙斐的居民哪，你們要赤身蒙羞過去。撒南的居民不敢出來。伯‧以薛人的哀哭使你們無處可站。
verses.e: Pass on , inhabitant of Shaphir , in nakedness and shame . The inhabitant of Zaanan won't come out . The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection .

verses.z: 瑪律的居民心甚憂急，切望得好處，因為災禍從耶和華那裏臨到耶路撒冷的城門。
verses.e: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good , because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 拉吉的居民哪，要用快馬套車；錫安民的罪由你而起；以色列人的罪過在你那裏顯出。
verses.e: Harness the chariot to the swift steed , inhabitant of Lachish . She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion ; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you .

verses.z: 猶大啊，你要將禮物送給摩利設‧迦特。亞革悉的眾族必用詭詐待以色列諸王。
verses.e: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath . The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel .

verses.z: 瑪利沙的居民哪，我必使那奪取你的來到你這裏；以色列的尊貴人必到亞杜蘭。
verses.e: I will yet bring a conqueror to you , inhabitants of Mareshah . The glory of Israel will come to Adullam .

verses.z: 猶大啊，要為你所喜愛的兒女剪除你的頭髮，使頭光禿，要大大地光禿，如同禿鷹，因為他們都被擄去離開你。
verses.e: Shave your heads , and cut off your hair for the children of your delight . Enlarge your baldness like the vulture , for they have gone into captivity from you !

verses.z: 萬民哪，你們都要聽！地和其上所有的，也都要側耳而聽！主耶和華從他的聖殿要見證你們的不是。
verses.e: Hear , you peoples , all of you ! Listen , O earth , and all that is therein . Let the Lord GOD be witness against you , the Lord from his holy temple .

verses.z: 看哪，耶和華出了他的居所，降臨步行地的高處。
verses.e: For behold , the LORD comes out of his place , and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth .

verses.z: 眾山在他以下必消化，諸谷必崩裂，如蠟化在火中，如水沖下山坡。
verses.e: The mountains melt under him , and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire , like waters that are poured down a steep place .

verses.z: 這都因雅各的罪過，以色列家的罪惡。雅各的罪過在哪裏呢？豈不是在撒馬利亞嗎？猶大的邱壇在哪裏呢？豈不是在耶路撒冷嗎？
verses.e: " All this is for the disobedience of Jacob , and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the disobedience of Jacob ? Isn't it Samaria ? And what are the high places of Judah ? Aren't they Jerusalem ?

verses.z: 所以我必使撒馬利亞變為田野的亂堆，又作為種葡萄之處；也必將她的石頭倒在谷中，露出根基來。
verses.e: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field , like places for planting vineyards ; and I will pour down its stones into the valley , and I will uncover its foundations .

verses.z: 她一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎；她所得的財物必被火燒；所有的偶像我必毀滅；因為是從妓女雇價所聚來的，後必歸為妓女的雇價。
verses.e: All her idols will be beaten to pieces , all her temple gifts will be burned with fire , and I will destroy all her images ; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them , and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return . "

verses.z: 先知說：因此我必大聲哀號，赤腳露體而行；又要呼號如野狗，哀鳴如鴕鳥。
verses.e: For this I will lament and wail . I will go stripped and naked . I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches .

verses.z: 因為撒馬利亞的傷痕無法醫治，延及猶大和耶路撒冷我民的城門。
verses.e: For her wounds are incurable ; for it has come even to Judah . It reaches to the gate of my people , even to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 禍哉，那些在床上圖謀罪孽、造作奸惡的！天一發亮，因手有能力就行出來了。
verses.e: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds ! When the morning is light , they practice it , because it is in the power of their hand .

verses.z: 你們起來去吧！這不是你們安息之所；因為污穢使人毀滅，而且大大毀滅。
verses.e: Arise , and depart ! For this is not your resting place , because of uncleanness that destroys , even with a grievous destruction .

verses.z: 若有人心存虛假，用謊言[說]：我要向你們預言得清酒和濃酒。那人就必作這民的先知。
verses.e: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies , saying , " I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink , " he would be the prophet of this people .

verses.z: 雅各家啊，我必要聚集你們，必要招聚以色列剩下的人，安置在一處，如波斯拉的羊，又如草場上的羊群；因為人數[眾]多就必大大喧嘩。
verses.e: I will surely assemble all of you , Jacob . I will surely gather the remnant of Israel . I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as a flock in the middle of their pasture . They will swarm with people .

verses.z: 開路的在他們前面上去；他們直闖過城門，從城門出去。他們的王在前面行；耶和華引導他們。
verses.e: He who breaks open the way goes up before them . They break through the gate , and go out . Their king passes on before them , with the LORD at their head .

verses.z: 他們貪圖田地就佔據，貪圖房屋便奪取；他們欺壓人，霸佔房屋和產業。
verses.e: They covet fields and seize them , and houses , then take them away . They oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .

verses.z: 所以耶和華如此說：我籌劃災禍降與這族；這禍在你們的頸項上不能解脫；你們也不能昂首而行，因為這時勢是惡的。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says : " Behold , I am planning against these people a disaster , from which you will not remove your necks , neither will you walk haughtily , for it is an evil time .

verses.z: 到那日，必有人向你們提起悲慘的哀歌，譏刺說：我們全然敗落了！耶和華將我們的分轉歸別人，何竟使這分離開我們？他將我們的田地分給悖逆的人。
verses.e: In that day they will take up a parable against you , and lament with a doleful lamentation , saying , ' We are utterly ruined ! My people's possession is divided up . Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors ! ' "

verses.z: 所以在耶和華的會中，你必沒有人拈鬮拉準繩。
verses.e: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD's assembly .

verses.z: 他們說：你們不可說預言；不可向這些人說預言，不住地羞辱[我們]。
verses.e: " Don't prophesy ! " — they prophesy — " Don't prophesy about these things . Disgrace won't overtake us . "

verses.z: 雅各家啊，豈可說耶和華的心不忍耐嗎？這些事是他所行的嗎？我－[耶和華]的言語豈不是與行動正直的人有益嗎？
verses.e: Shall it be said , O house of Jacob , " Is the LORD's Spirit angry ? Are these his doings ? Don't my words do good to him who walks blamelessly ? "

verses.z: 然而，近來我的民興起如仇敵，從那些安然經過不願打仗之人身上剝去外衣。
verses.e: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy . You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care , returning from battle .

verses.z: 你們將我民中的婦人從安樂家中趕出，又將我的榮耀從她們的小孩子盡行奪去。
verses.e: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses ; from their young children you take away my blessing forever .

verses.z: 我說：雅各的首領，以色列家的官長啊，你們要聽！你們不當知道公平嗎？
verses.e: I said , " Please listen , you heads of Jacob , and rulers of the house of Israel : Isn't it for you to know justice ?

verses.z: 以人血建立錫安，以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。
verses.e: who build up Zion with blood , and Jerusalem with iniquity .

verses.z: 首領為賄賂行審判；祭司為雇價施訓誨；先知為銀錢行占卜。他們卻倚賴耶和華，說：耶和華不是在我們中間嗎？災禍必不臨到我們。
verses.e: Her leaders judge for bribes , and her priests teach for a price , and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money ; yet they lean on the LORD , and say , " Isn't the LORD among us ? No disaster will come on us . "

verses.z: 所以因你們的緣故，錫安必被耕種像一塊田，耶路撒冷必變為亂堆；這殿的山必像叢林的高處。
verses.e: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field , and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble , and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest .

verses.z: 你們惡善好惡，從人身上剝皮，從人骨頭上剔肉，
verses.e: You who hate the good , and love the evil ; who tear off their skin , and their flesh from off their bones ;

verses.z: 吃我民的肉，剝他們的皮，打折他們的骨頭，分成塊子像要下鍋，又像釜中的肉。
verses.e: who also eat the flesh of my people , and peel their skin from off them , and break their bones , and chop them in pieces , as for the pot , and as meat within the cauldron .

verses.z: 到了[遭災的]時候，這些人必哀求耶和華，他卻不應允他們。那時他必照他們所行的惡事向他們掩面。
verses.e: Then they will cry to the LORD , but he will not answer them . Yes , he will hide his face from them at that time , because they made their deeds evil . "

verses.z: 論到使我民走差路的先知－他們牙齒有所嚼的，他們就呼喊說：平安了！凡不供給他們吃的，他們就預備攻擊他－耶和華如此說：
verses.e: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray — for those who feed their teeth , they proclaim , " Peace ! " and whoever doesn't provide for their mouths , they prepare war against him :

verses.z: 你們必遭遇黑夜，以致不見異象；又必遭遇幽暗，以致不能占卜。日頭必向你們沉落，白晝變為黑暗。
verses.e: " Therefore night is over you , with no vision , and it is dark to you , that you may not divine ; and the sun will go down on the prophets , and the day will be black over them .

verses.z: 先見必抱愧，占卜的必蒙羞，都必摀着嘴唇，因為上帝不應允他們。
verses.e: The seers shall be disappointed , and the diviners confounded . Yes , they shall all cover their lips , for there is no answer from God . "

verses.z: 至於我，我藉耶和華的靈，滿有力量、公平、才能，可以向雅各說明他的過犯，向以色列指出他的罪惡。
verses.e: But as for me , I am full of power by the LORD's Spirit , and of judgment , and of might , to declare to Jacob his disobedience , and to Israel his sin .

verses.z: 雅各家的首領、以色列家的官長啊，當聽我的話！你們厭惡公平，在一切事上屈枉正直；
verses.e: Please listen to this , you heads of the house of Jacob , and rulers of the house of Israel , who abhor justice , and pervert all equity ,

verses.z: 末後的日子，耶和華殿的山必堅立，超乎諸山，高舉過於萬嶺；萬民都要流歸這山。
verses.e: But in the latter days , it will happen that the mountain of the LORD's temple will be established on the top of the mountains , and it will be exalted above the hills ; and peoples will stream to it .

verses.z: 錫安的民哪，你要疼痛劬勞，彷彿產難的婦人；因為你必從城裏出來，住在田野，到巴比倫去。在那裏要蒙解救；在那裏耶和華必救贖你脫離仇敵的手。
verses.e: Be in pain , and labor to give birth , daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail ; for now you will go out of the city , and will dwell in the field , and will come even to Babylon . There you will be rescued . There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies .

verses.z: 現在有許多國的民聚集攻擊你，說：願錫安被玷污！願我們親眼見她[遭報]！
verses.e: Now many nations have assembled against you , that say , " Let her be defiled , and let our eye gloat over Zion . "

verses.z: 他們卻不知道耶和華的意念，也不明白他的籌劃。他聚集他們，好像把禾捆聚到禾場一樣。
verses.e: But they don't know the thoughts of the LORD , neither do they understand his counsel ; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor .

verses.z: 錫安的民哪，起來踹穀吧！我必使你的角成為鐵，使你的蹄成為銅。你必打碎多國的民，將他們的財獻與耶和華，將他們的貨獻與普天下的主。
verses.e: Arise and thresh , daughter of Zion , for I will make your horn iron , and I will make your hoofs bronze . You will beat in pieces many peoples . I will devote their gain to the LORD , and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth .

verses.z: 必有許多國的民前往，說：來吧，我們登耶和華的山，奔雅各上帝的殿。主必將他的道教訓我們；我們也要行他的路。因為訓誨必出於錫安；耶和華的言語必出於耶路撒冷。
verses.e: Many nations will go and say , " Come ! Let's go up to the mountain of the LORD , and to the house of the God of Jacob ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths . " For the law will go out of Zion , and the LORD's word from Jerusalem ;

verses.z: 他必在多國的民中施行審判，為遠方強盛的國斷定是非。他們要將刀打成犂頭，把槍打成鐮刀。這國不舉刀攻擊那國；他們也不再學習戰事。
verses.e: and he will judge between many peoples , and will decide concerning strong nations afar off . They will beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruning hooks . Nation will not lift up sword against nation , neither will they learn war any more .

verses.z: 人人都要坐在自己葡萄樹下和無花果樹下，無人驚嚇。這是萬軍之耶和華親口說的。
verses.e: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree . No one will make them afraid , for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken .

verses.z: 萬民各奉己神的名而行；我們卻永永遠遠奉耶和華－我們上帝的名而行。
verses.e: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods , but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever .

verses.z: 耶和華說：到那日，我必聚集瘸腿的，招聚被趕出的和我所懲治的。
verses.e: " In that day , " says the LORD , " I will assemble that which is lame , and I will gather that which is driven away , and that which I have afflicted ;

verses.z: 我必使瘸腿的為餘剩之民，使趕到遠方的為強盛之民。耶和華要在錫安山作王治理他們，從今直到永遠。
verses.e: and I will make that which was lame a remnant , and that which was cast far off a strong nation : and the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on , even forever . "

verses.z: 你這羊群的高臺、錫安城的山哪，從前的權柄－就是耶路撒冷民的國權－必歸與你。
verses.e: You , tower of the flock , the hill of the daughter of Zion , to you it will come . Yes , the former dominion will come , the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 現在你為何大聲哭號呢？疼痛抓住你彷彿產難的婦人，是因你中間沒有君王嗎？你的謀士滅亡了嗎？
verses.e: Now why do you cry out aloud ? Is there no king in you ? Has your counselor perished , that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail ?

verses.z: 成群的民哪，現在你要聚集成隊；[因為]仇敵圍攻我們，要用杖擊打以色列審判者的臉。
verses.e: Now you shall gather yourself in troops , daughter of troops . He has laid siege against us . They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek .

verses.z: 耶和華說：到那日，我必從你中間剪除馬匹，毀壞車輛，
verses.e: " It will happen in that day " , says the LORD , " that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots .

verses.z: 也必從你國中除滅城邑，拆毀一切的保障，
verses.e: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds .

verses.z: 又必除掉你手中的邪術；你那裏也不再有占卜的。
verses.e: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand . You shall have no soothsayers .

verses.z: 我必從你中間除滅雕刻的偶像和柱像，你就不再跪拜自己手所造的。
verses.e: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you ; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands .

verses.z: 我必從你中間拔出木偶，又毀滅你的城邑。
verses.e: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you ; and I will destroy your cities .

verses.z: 我也必在怒氣和忿怒中向那不聽從的列國施報。
verses.e: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn't listen . "

verses.z: 伯利恆的以法他啊，你在猶大諸城中為小，將來必有一位從你那裏出來，在以色列中為我作掌權的；他的根源從亙古，從太初就有。
verses.e: But you , Bethlehem Ephrathah , being small among the clans of Judah , out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel ; whose goings out are from of old , from ancient times .

verses.z: 耶和華必將以色列人交付[敵人]，直等那生產的婦人生下子來。那時掌權者其餘的弟兄必歸到以色列人那裏。
verses.e: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth . Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel .

verses.z: 他必起來，倚靠耶和華的大能，並耶和華－他上帝之名的威嚴，牧養[他的羊群]。他們要[安然]居住；因為他必日見尊大，直到地極。
verses.e: He shall stand , and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD , in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God . They will live , for then he will be great to the ends of the earth .

verses.z: 這位必作[我們的]平安。當亞述人進入我們的地境，踐踏宮殿的時候，我們就立起七個牧者，八個首領攻擊他。
verses.e: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses , then we will raise against him seven shepherds , and eight leaders of men .

verses.z: 他們必用刀劍毀壞亞述地和寧錄地的關口。亞述人進入我們的地境踐踏的時候，他必拯救我們。
verses.e: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in its gates . He will deliver us from the Assyrian , when he invades our land , and when he marches within our border .

verses.z: 雅各餘剩的人必在多國的民中，如從耶和華那裏降下的露水，又如甘霖降在草上；不仗賴人[力]，也不等候世人[之功]。
verses.e: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from the LORD , like showers on the grass , that don't wait for man nor wait for the sons of men .

verses.z: 雅各餘剩的人必在多國多民中，如林間百獸中的獅子，又如少壯獅子在羊群中。他若經過就必踐踏撕裂，無人搭救。
verses.e: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations , among many peoples , like a lion among the animals of the forest , like a young lion among the flocks of sheep ; who , if he goes through , treads down and tears in pieces , and there is no one to deliver .

verses.z: 願你的手舉起，高過敵人！願你的仇敵都被剪除！
verses.e: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries , and let all of your enemies be cut off .

verses.z: 以色列人哪，當聽耶和華的話！要起來向山嶺爭辯，使岡陵聽你的話。
verses.e: Listen now to what the LORD says : " Arise , plead your case before the mountains , and let the hills hear what you have to say .

verses.z: 惡人家中不仍有非義之財和可惡的小升斗嗎？
verses.e: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked , and a short ephah that is accursed ?

verses.z: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中詭詐的法碼，豈可算為清潔呢？
verses.e: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales , and a bag of deceitful weights ?

verses.z: 城裏的富戶滿行強暴；其中的居民也說謊言，口中的舌頭是詭詐的。
verses.e: Her rich men are full of violence , her inhabitants speak lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their speech .

verses.z: 因此，我擊打你，使你的傷痕甚重，使你因你的罪惡荒涼。
verses.e: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound . I have made you desolate because of your sins .

verses.z: 你要吃，卻吃不飽；你的虛弱必顯在你中間。你必挪去，卻不得救護；所救護的，我必交給刀劍。
verses.e: You shall eat , but not be satisfied . Your hunger will be within you . You will store up , but not save , and that which you save I will give up to the sword .

verses.z: 你必撒種，卻不得收割；踹橄欖，卻不得油抹身；踹葡萄，卻不得酒喝。
verses.e: You will sow , but won't reap . You will tread the olives , but won't anoint yourself with oil ; and crush grapes , but won't drink the wine .

verses.z: 因為你守暗利的惡規，行亞哈家一切所行的，順從他們的計謀；因此，我必使你荒涼，使你的居民令人嗤笑，你們也必擔當我民的羞辱。
verses.e: For the statutes of Omri are kept , and all the works of Ahab's house . You walk in their counsels , that I may make you a ruin , and your inhabitants a hissing . You will bear the reproach of my people . "

verses.z: 山嶺和地永久的根基啊，要聽耶和華爭辯的話！因為耶和華要與他的百姓爭辯，與以色列爭論。
verses.e: Hear , you mountains , the LORD's indictment , and you enduring foundations of the earth ; for the LORD has a case against his people , and he will contend with Israel .

verses.z: 我的百姓啊，我向你做了甚麼呢？我在甚麼事上使你厭煩？你可以對我證明。
verses.e: My people , what have I done to you ? How have I burdened you ? Answer me !

verses.z: 我曾將你從埃及地領出來，從作奴僕之家救贖你；我也差遣摩西、亞倫，和米利暗在你前面行。
verses.e: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed you out of the house of bondage . I sent before you Moses , Aaron , and Miriam .

verses.z: 我的百姓啊，你們當追念摩押王巴勒所設的謀和比珥的兒子巴蘭回答他的話，並你們從什亭到吉甲[所遇見的事]，好使你們知道耶和華公義的作為。
verses.e: My people , remember now what Balak king of Moab devised , and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal , that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD . "

verses.z: 我朝見耶和華，在至高上帝面前跪拜，當獻上甚麼呢？豈可獻一歲的牛犢為燔祭嗎？
verses.e: How shall I come before the LORD , and bow myself before the exalted God ? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings , with calves a year old ?

verses.z: 耶和華豈喜悅千千的公羊，或是萬萬的油河嗎？我豈可為自己的罪過獻我的長子嗎？為心中的罪惡獻我身所生的嗎？
verses.e: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams ? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil ? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience ? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?

verses.z: 世人哪，耶和華已指示你何為善。他向你所要的是甚麼呢？只要你行公義，好憐憫，存謙卑的心，與你的上帝同行。
verses.e: He has shown you , O man , what is good . What does the LORD require of you , but to act justly , to love mercy , and to walk humbly with your God ?

verses.z: 耶和華向這城呼叫，智慧人必敬畏他的名。你們當聽是誰派定刑杖的懲罰。
verses.e: The LORD's voice calls to the city — and wisdom fears your name — " Listen to the rod , and he who appointed it .

verses.z: 哀哉！我好像夏天的果子已被收盡，又像摘了葡萄所剩下的，沒有一掛可吃的；我心羨慕初熟的無花果。
