verses.e: Misery is mine ! Indeed , I am like one who gathers the summer fruits , as gleanings of the vineyard . There is no cluster of grapes to eat . My soul desires to eat the early fig .

verses.z: 那時我的仇敵，就是曾對我說「耶和華－你上帝在哪裏」的，他一看見這事就被羞愧遮蓋。我必親眼見他[遭報]；他必被踐踏，如同街上的泥土。
verses.e: Then my enemy will see it , and shame will cover her who said to me , " Where is the LORD your God ? " My eyes will see her . Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets .

verses.z: 以色列啊，日子必到，你的牆垣必重修；到那日，你的境界必開展。
verses.e: A day to build your walls ! In that day , he will extend your boundary .

verses.z: 當那日，人必從亞述，從埃及的城邑，從埃及到大河，從這海到那海，從這山到那山，都歸到你這裏。
verses.e: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt , and from Egypt even to the River , and from sea to sea , and mountain to mountain .

verses.z: 然而，這地因居民的緣故，又因他們行事的結果，必然荒涼。
verses.e: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein , for the fruit of their doings .

verses.z: 求[耶和華]在迦密山的樹林中，用你的杖牧放你獨居的民，就是你產業的羊群。求你容他們在巴珊和基列得食物，像古時一樣。
verses.e: Shepherd your people with your staff , the flock of your heritage , who dwell by themselves in a forest . Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land , in Bashan and Gilead , as in the days of old .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我要把奇事顯給他們看，好像出埃及地的時候一樣。
verses.e: " As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt , I will show them marvelous things . "

verses.z: 列國看見這事就必為自己的勢力慚愧；他們必用手摀口，掩耳不聽。
verses.e: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might . They will lay their hand on their mouth . Their ears will be deaf .

verses.z: 他們必舔土如蛇，又如土中腹行的物，戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。他們必戰懼投降耶和華，也必因我們的上帝而懼怕。
verses.e: They will lick the dust like a serpent . Like crawling things of the earth , they will come trembling out of their dens . They will come with fear to the LORD our God , and will be afraid because of you .

verses.z: 上帝啊，有何神像你，赦免罪孽，饒恕你產業之餘民的罪過，不永遠懷怒，喜愛施恩？
verses.e: Who is a God like you , who pardons iniquity , and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage ? He doesn't retain his anger forever , because he delights in loving kindness .

verses.z: 必再憐憫我們，將我們的罪孽踏在腳下，又將我們的一切罪投於深海。
verses.e: He will again have compassion on us . He will tread our iniquities under foot . You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea .

verses.z: 地上虔誠人滅盡；世間沒有正直人；各人埋伏，要殺人流血，都用網羅獵取弟兄。
verses.e: The godly man has perished out of the earth , and there is no one upright among men . They all lie in wait for blood ; every man hunts his brother with a net .

verses.z: 你必按古時起誓應許我們列祖的話，向雅各發誠實，向亞伯拉罕施慈愛。
verses.e: You will give truth to Jacob , and mercy to Abraham , as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old .

verses.z: 他們雙手作惡；君王徇情面，審判官要賄賂；位分大的吐出惡意，都彼此結聯行惡。
verses.e: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently . The ruler and judge ask for a bribe . The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul . Thus they conspire together .

verses.z: 他們最好的，不過是蒺藜；最正直的，不過是荊棘籬笆。你守望者[說]，降罰的日子已經來到。他們必擾亂不安。
verses.e: The best of them is like a brier . The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge . The day of your watchmen , even your visitation , has come ; now is the time of their confusion .

verses.z: 不要倚賴鄰舍；不要信靠密友。要守住你的口；不要向你懷中的妻提說。
verses.e: Don't trust in a neighbor . Don't put confidence in a friend . With the woman lying in your embrace , be careful of the words of your mouth !

verses.z: 因為，兒子藐視父親；女兒抗拒母親；媳婦抗拒婆婆；人的仇敵就是自己家裏的人。
verses.e: For the son dishonors the father , the daughter rises up against her mother , the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law ; a man's enemies are the men of his own house .

verses.z: 至於我，我要仰望耶和華，要等候那救我的上帝；我的上帝必應允我。
verses.e: But as for me , I will look to the LORD . I will wait for the God of my salvation . My God will hear me .

verses.z: 我的仇敵啊，不要向我誇耀。我雖跌倒，卻要起來；我雖坐在黑暗裏，耶和華卻作我的光。
verses.e: Don't rejoice against me , my enemy . When I fall , I will arise . When I sit in darkness , the LORD will be a light to me .

verses.z: 我要忍受耶和華的惱怒；因我得罪了他，直等他為我辨屈，為我伸冤。他必領我到光明中；我必得見他的公義。
verses.e: I will bear the indignation of the LORD , because I have sinned against him , until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me . He will bring me out to the light . I will see his righteousness .

verses.z: 上帝的兒子，耶穌基督福音的起頭。
verses.e: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ , the Son of God .

verses.z: 他從水裏一上來，就看見天裂開了，聖靈彷彿鴿子，降在他身上。
verses.e: Immediately coming up from the water , he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove .

verses.z: 又有聲音從天上來，[說]：「你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。」
verses.e: A voice came out of the sky , " You are my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased . "

verses.z: 聖靈就把耶穌催到曠野裏去。
verses.e: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness .

verses.z: 他在曠野四十天，受撒但的試探，並與野獸同在一處，且有天使來伺候他。
verses.e: He was there in the wilderness forty days , tempted by Satan . He was with the wild animals ; and the angels were serving him .

verses.z: 約翰下監以後，耶穌來到加利利，宣傳上帝的福音，
verses.e: Now after John was taken into custody , Jesus came into Galilee , preaching the Good News of God's Kingdom ,

verses.z: 說：「日期滿了，上帝的國近了。你們當悔改，信福音！」
verses.e: and saying , " The time is fulfilled , and God's Kingdom is at hand ! Repent , and believe in the Good News . "

verses.z: 耶穌順着加利利的海邊走，看見西門和西門的兄弟安得烈在海裏撒網；他們本是打魚的。
verses.e: Passing along by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew , the brother of Simon , casting a net into the sea , for they were fishermen .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " Come after me , and I will make you into fishers for men . "

verses.z: 他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
verses.e: Immediately they left their nets , and followed him .

verses.z: 耶穌稍往前走，又見西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰在船上補網。
verses.e: Going on a little further from there , he saw James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , who were also in the boat mending the nets .

verses.z: 正如先知以賽亞書上記着說：看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面，預備道路。
verses.e: As it is written in the prophets , " Behold , I send my messenger before your face , who will prepare your way before you :

verses.z: 耶穌隨即招呼他們，他們就把父親西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟從耶穌去了。
verses.e: Immediately he called them , and they left their father , Zebedee , in the boat with the hired servants , and went after him .

verses.z: 到了迦百農，耶穌就在安息日進了會堂教訓人。
verses.e: They went into Capernaum , and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught .

verses.z: 眾人很希奇他的教訓；因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像文士。
verses.e: They were astonished at his teaching , for he taught them as having authority , and not as the scribes .

verses.z: 在會堂裏，有一個人被污鬼附着。他喊叫說：
verses.e: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit , and he cried out ,

verses.z: 「拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，乃是上帝的聖者。」
verses.e: saying , " Ha ! What do we have to do with you , Jesus , you Nazarene ? Have you come to destroy us ? I know who you are : the Holy One of God ! "

verses.z: 耶穌責備他說：「不要作聲！從這人身上出來吧。」
verses.e: Jesus rebuked him , saying , " Be quiet , and come out of him ! "

verses.z: 污鬼叫那人抽了一陣瘋，大聲喊叫，就出來了。
verses.e: The unclean spirit , convulsing him and crying with a loud voice , came out of him .

verses.z: 眾人都驚訝，以致彼此對問說：「這是甚麼事？是個新道理啊！他用權柄吩咐污鬼，連污鬼也聽從了他。」
verses.e: They were all amazed , so that they questioned among themselves , saying , " What is this ? A new teaching ? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits , and they obey him ! "

verses.z: 耶穌的名聲就傳遍了加利利的四方。
verses.e: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area .

verses.z: 他們一出會堂，就同着雅各、約翰，進了西門和安得烈的家。
verses.e: Immediately , when they had come out of the synagogue , they came into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .

verses.z: 在曠野有人聲喊着說：預備主的道，修直他的路。
verses.e: the voice of one crying in the wilderness , ' Make ready the way of the Lord ! Make his paths straight ! ' "

verses.z: 西門的岳母正害熱病躺着，就有人告訴耶穌。
verses.e: Now Simon's wife's mother lay sick with a fever , and immediately they told him about her .

verses.z: 耶穌進前拉着她的手，扶她起來，熱就退了，她就服事他們。
verses.e: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up . The fever left her immediately , and she served them .

verses.z: 天晚日落的時候，有人帶着一切害病的，和被鬼附的，來到耶穌跟前。
verses.e: At evening , when the sun had set , they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons .

verses.z: 合城的人都聚集在門前。
verses.e: All the city was gathered together at the door .

verses.z: 耶穌治好了許多害各樣病的人，又趕出許多鬼，不許鬼說話，因為鬼認識他。
verses.e: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons . He didn't allow the demons to speak , because they knew him .

verses.z: 次日早晨，天未亮的時候，耶穌起來，到曠野地方去，在那裏禱告。
verses.e: Early in the morning , while it was still dark , he rose up and went out , and departed into a deserted place , and prayed there .

verses.z: 西門和同伴追了他去，
verses.e: Simon and those who were with him searched for him .

verses.z: 遇見了就對他說：「眾人都找你。」
verses.e: They found him and told him , " Everyone is looking for you . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「我們可以往別處去，到鄰近的鄉村，我也好在那裏傳道，因為我是為這事出來的。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Let's go elsewhere into the next towns , that I may preach there also , because I came out for this reason . "

verses.z: 於是在加利利全地，進了會堂，傳道，趕鬼。
verses.e: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee , preaching and casting out demons .

verses.z: [照這話]，約翰來了，在曠野施洗，傳悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
verses.e: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins .

verses.z: 有一個長大痲瘋的來求耶穌，向他跪下，說：「你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
verses.e: A leper came to him , begging him , kneeling down to him , and saying to him , " If you want to , you can make me clean . "

verses.z: 耶穌動了慈心，就伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」
verses.e: Being moved with compassion , he stretched out his hand , and touched him , and said to him , " I want to . Be made clean . "

verses.z: 大痲瘋即時離開他，他就潔淨了。
verses.e: When he had said this , immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean .

verses.z: 耶穌嚴嚴地囑咐他，就打發他走，
verses.e: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out ,

verses.z: 對他說：「你要謹慎，甚麼話都不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又因為你潔淨了，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。」
verses.e: and said to him , " See that you say nothing to anybody , but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded , for a testimony to them . "

verses.z: 那人出去，倒說許多的話，把這件事傳揚開了，叫耶穌以後不得再明明地進城，只好在外邊曠野地方。人從各處都就了他來。
verses.e: But he went out , and began to proclaim it much , and to spread about the matter , so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city , but was outside in desert places . People came to him from everywhere .

verses.z: 猶太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到約翰那裏，承認他們的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。
verses.e: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him . They were baptized by him in the Jordan river , confessing their sins .

verses.z: 約翰穿駱駝毛[的衣服]，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
verses.e: John was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist . He ate locusts and wild honey .

verses.z: 他傳道說：「有一位在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是彎腰給他解鞋帶也是不配的。
verses.e: He preached , saying , " After me comes he who is mightier than I , the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen .

verses.z: 我是用水給你們施洗，他卻要用聖靈給你們施洗。」
verses.e: I baptized you in water , but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit . "

verses.z: 那時，耶穌從加利利的拿撒勒來，在約旦河裏受了約翰的洗。
verses.e: In those days , Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized by John in the Jordan .

verses.z: 耶穌從那裏起身，來到猶太的境界並約旦河外。眾人又聚集到他那裏，他又照常教訓他們。
verses.e: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan . Multitudes came together to him again . As he usually did , he was again teaching them .

verses.z: 到了屋裏，門徒就問他這事。
verses.e: In the house , his disciples asked him again about the same matter .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「凡休妻另娶的，就是犯姦淫，辜負他的妻子；
verses.e: He said to them , " Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her .

verses.z: 妻子若離棄丈夫另嫁，也是犯姦淫了。」
verses.e: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another , she commits adultery . "

verses.z: 有人帶着小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌摸他們，門徒便責備那些人。
verses.e: They were bringing to him little children , that he should touch them , but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them .

verses.z: 耶穌看見就惱怒，對門徒說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們；因為在上帝國的，正是這樣的人。
verses.e: But when Jesus saw it , he was moved with indignation and said to them , " Allow the little children to come to me ! Don't forbid them , for God's Kingdom belongs to such as these .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，凡要承受上帝國的，若不像小孩子，斷不能進去。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , whoever will not receive God's Kingdom like a little child , he will in no way enter into it . "

verses.z: 於是抱着小孩子，給他們按手，為他們祝福。
verses.e: He took them in his arms and blessed them , laying his hands on them .

verses.z: 耶穌出來行路的時候，有一個人跑來，跪在他面前，問他說：「良善的夫子，我當做甚麼事才可以承受永生？」
verses.e: As he was going out into the way , one ran to him , knelt before him , and asked him , " Good Teacher , what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼稱我是良善的？除了上帝一位之外，再沒有良善的。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Why do you call me good ? No one is good except one — God .

verses.z: 誡命你是曉得的：不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；不可虧負人；當孝敬父母。」
verses.e: You know the commandments : ' Do not murder , ' ' Do not commit adultery , ' ' Do not steal , ' ' Do not give false testimony , ' ' Do not defraud , ' ' Honor your father and mother . ' "

verses.z: 有法利賽人來問他說：「人休妻可以不可以？」意思要試探他。
verses.e: Pharisees came to him testing him , and asked him , " Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife ? "

verses.z: 他對耶穌說：「夫子，這一切我從小都遵守了。」
verses.e: He said to him , " Teacher , I have observed all these things from my youth . "

verses.z: 耶穌看着他，就愛他，對他說：「你還缺少一件：去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」
verses.e: Jesus looking at him loved him , and said to him , " One thing you lack . Go , sell whatever you have and give to the poor , and you will have treasure in heaven ; and come , follow me , taking up the cross . "

verses.z: 他聽見這話，臉上就變了色，憂憂愁愁地走了，因為他的產業很多。
verses.e: But his face fell at that saying , and he went away sorrowful , for he was one who had great possessions .

verses.z: 耶穌周圍一看，對門徒說：「有錢財的人進上帝的國是何等地難哪！」
verses.e: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples , " How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God's Kingdom ! "

verses.z: 門徒希奇他的話。耶穌又對他們說：「小子，倚靠錢財的人進上帝的國是何等地難哪！
verses.e: The disciples were amazed at his words . But Jesus answered again , " Children , how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God's Kingdom !

verses.z: 駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進上帝的國還容易呢。」
verses.e: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 門徒就分外希奇，對他說：「這樣誰能得救呢？」
verses.e: They were exceedingly astonished , saying to him , " Then who can be saved ? "

verses.z: 耶穌看着他們，說：「在人是不能，在上帝卻不然，因為上帝凡事都能。」
verses.e: Jesus , looking at them , said , " With men it is impossible , but not with God , for all things are possible with God . "

verses.z: 彼得就對他說：「看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你了。」
verses.e: Peter began to tell him , " Behold , we have left all and have followed you . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，人為我和福音撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父母、兒女、田地，
verses.e: Jesus said , " Most certainly I tell you , there is no one who has left house , or brothers , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or land , for my sake , and for the sake of the Good News ,

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「摩西吩咐你們的是甚麼？」
verses.e: He answered , " What did Moses command you ? "

verses.z: 沒有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母親、兒女、田地，並且要受逼迫，在來世必得永生。
verses.e: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time : houses , brothers , sisters , mothers , children , and land , with persecutions ; and in the age to come eternal life .

verses.z: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後，在後的，將要在前。」
verses.e: But many who are first will be last , and the last first . "

verses.z: 他們行路上耶路撒冷去。耶穌在前頭走，門徒就希奇，跟從的人也害怕。耶穌又叫過十二個門徒來，把自己將要遭遇的事告訴他們說：
verses.e: They were on the way , going up to Jerusalem ; and Jesus was going in front of them , and they were amazed ; and those who followed were afraid . He again took the twelve , and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him .

verses.z: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子將要被交給祭司長和文士，他們要定他死罪，交給外邦人。
verses.e: " Behold , we are going up to Jerusalem . The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes . They will condemn him to death , and will deliver him to the Gentiles .

verses.z: 他們要戲弄他，吐唾沫在他臉上，鞭打他，殺害他。過了三天，他要復活。」
verses.e: They will mock him , spit on him , scourge him , and kill him . On the third day he will rise again . "

verses.z: 西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰進前來，對耶穌說：「夫子，我們無論求你甚麼，願你給我們做。」
verses.e: James and John , the sons of Zebedee , came near to him , saying , " Teacher , we want you to do for us whatever we will ask . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「要我給你們做甚麼？」
verses.e: He said to them , " What do you want me to do for you ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「賜我們在你的榮耀裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」
verses.e: They said to him , " Grant to us that we may sit , one at your right hand and one at your left hand , in your glory . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼。我所喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？我所受的洗，你們能受嗎？」
verses.e: But Jesus said to them , " You don't know what you are asking . Are you able to drink the cup that I drink , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「我們能。」耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們也要喝；我所受的洗，你們也要受；
verses.e: They said to him , " We are able . " Jesus said to them , " You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink , and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ;

verses.z: 他們說：「摩西許人寫了休書便可以休妻。」
verses.e: They said , " Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written , and to divorce her . "

verses.z: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」
verses.e: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give , but for whom it has been prepared . "

verses.z: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒雅各、約翰。
verses.e: When the ten heard it , they began to be indignant toward James and John .

verses.z: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們說：「你們知道，外邦人有尊為君王的，治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
verses.e: Jesus summoned them and said to them , " You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them , and their great ones exercise authority over them .

verses.z: 只是在你們中間，不是這樣。你們中間，誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
verses.e: But it shall not be so among you , but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant .

verses.z: 在你們中間，誰願為首，就必作眾人的僕人。
verses.e: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all .

verses.z: 因為人子來，並不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命作多人的贖價。」
verses.e: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve , and to give his life as a ransom for many . "

verses.z: 到了耶利哥；耶穌同門徒並許多人出耶利哥的時候，有一個討飯的瞎子，是底買的兒子巴底買，坐在路旁。
verses.e: They came to Jericho . As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude , the son of Timaeus , Bartimaeus , a blind beggar , was sitting by the road .

verses.z: 他聽見是拿撒勒的耶穌，就喊着說：「大衛的子孫耶穌啊！可憐我吧！」
verses.e: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene , he began to cry out and say , " Jesus , you son of David , have mercy on me ! "

verses.z: 有許多人責備他，不許他作聲。他卻越發大聲喊着說：「大衛的子孫哪，可憐我吧！」
verses.e: Many rebuked him , that he should be quiet , but he cried out much more , " You son of David , have mercy on me ! "

verses.z: 耶穌就站住，說：「叫過他來。」他們就叫那瞎子，對他說：「放心，起來！他叫你啦。」
verses.e: Jesus stood still and said , " Call him . " They called the blind man , saying to him , " Cheer up ! Get up . He is calling you ! "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「摩西因為你們的心硬，所以寫這條例給你們；
verses.e: But Jesus said to them , " For your hardness of heart , he wrote you this commandment .

verses.z: 瞎子就丟下衣服，跳起來，走到耶穌那裏。
verses.e: He , casting away his cloak , sprang up , and came to Jesus .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「要我為你做甚麼？」瞎子說：「拉波尼，我要能看見。」
verses.e: Jesus asked him , " What do you want me to do for you ? " The blind man said to him , " Rabboni , that I may see again . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你去吧！你的信救了你了。」瞎子立刻看見了，就在路上跟隨耶穌。
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Go your way . Your faith has made you well . " Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way .

verses.z: 但從起初創造的時候，上帝造人是造男造女。
verses.e: But from the beginning of the creation , God made them male and female .

verses.z: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
verses.e: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother , and will join to his wife ,

verses.z: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。
verses.e: and the two will become one flesh , so that they are no longer two , but one flesh .

verses.z: 所以，上帝配合的，人不可分開。」
verses.e: What therefore God has joined together , let no man separate . "

verses.z: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄欖山那裏；耶穌就打發兩個門徒，
verses.e: When they came near to Jerusalem , to Bethsphage and Bethany , at the Mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples

verses.z: 那將要來的我祖大衛之國是應當稱頌的！高高在上和散那！
verses.e: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord ! Hosanna in the highest ! "

verses.z: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，入了[聖]殿，周圍看了各樣物件。天色已晚，就和十二個門徒出城，往伯大尼去了。
verses.e: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem . When he had looked around at everything , it being now evening , he went out to Bethany with the twelve .

verses.z: 第二天，他們從伯大尼出來，耶穌餓了。
verses.e: The next day , when they had come out from Bethany , he was hungry .

verses.z: 遠遠地看見一棵無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就往那裏去，或者在樹上可以找着甚麼。到了樹下，竟找不着甚麼，不過有葉子，因為不是收無花果的時候。
verses.e: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it . When he came to it , he found nothing but leaves , for it was not the season for figs .

verses.z: 耶穌就對樹說：「從今以後，永沒有人吃你的果子。」他的門徒也聽見了。
verses.e: Jesus told it , " May no one ever eat fruit from you again ! " and his disciples heard it .

verses.z: 他們來到耶路撒冷。耶穌進入[聖]殿，趕出殿裏做買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子和賣鴿子之人的凳子；
verses.e: They came to Jerusalem , and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple , and overthrew the money changers ' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves .

verses.z: 也不許人拿着器具從殿裏經過；
verses.e: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple .

verses.z: 便教訓他們說：「[經上]不是記着說：我的殿必稱為萬國禱告的殿嗎？你們倒使它成為賊窩了。」
verses.e: He taught , saying to them , " Isn't it written , ' My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations ' ? But you have made it a den of robbers ! "

verses.z: 祭司長和文士聽見這話，就想法子要除滅耶穌，卻又怕他，因為眾人都希奇他的教訓。
verses.e: The chief priests and the scribes heard it , and sought how they might destroy him . For they feared him , because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching .

verses.z: 每天晚上，耶穌出城去。
verses.e: When evening came , he went out of the city .

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們往對面村子裏去，一進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裏，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開，牽來。
verses.e: and said to them , " Go your way into the village that is opposite you . Immediately as you enter into it , you will find a young donkey tied , on which no one has sat . Untie him and bring him .

verses.z: 早晨，他們從那裏經過，看見無花果樹連根都枯乾了。
verses.e: As they passed by in the morning , they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots .

verses.z: 彼得想起耶穌的話來，就對他說：「拉比，請看！你所咒詛的無花果樹已經枯乾了。」
verses.e: Peter , remembering , said to him , " Rabbi , look ! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們當信服上帝。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Have faith in God .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，無論何人對這座山說：『你挪開此地，投在海裏！』他若心裏不疑惑，只信他所說的必成，就必給他成了。
verses.e: For most certainly I tell you , whoever may tell this mountain , ' Be taken up and cast into the sea , ' and doesn't doubt in his heart , but believes that what he says is happening , he shall have whatever he says .

verses.z: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信是得着的，就必得着。
verses.e: Therefore I tell you , all things whatever you pray and ask for , believe that you have received them , and you shall have them .

verses.z: 你們站着禱告的時候，若想起有人得罪你們，就當饒恕他，好叫你們在天上的父也饒恕你們的過犯。
verses.e: Whenever you stand praying , forgive , if you have anything against anyone ; so that your Father , who is in heaven , may also forgive you your transgressions .

verses.z: 你們若不饒恕人，你們在天上的父也不饒恕你們的過犯。」
verses.e: But if you do not forgive , neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions . "

verses.z: 他們又來到耶路撒冷。耶穌在殿裏行走的時候，祭司長和文士並長老進前來，
verses.e: They came again to Jerusalem , and as he was walking in the temple , the chief priests , the scribes , and the elders came to him ,

verses.z: 問他說：「你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
verses.e: and they began saying to him , " By what authority do you do these things ? Or who gave you this authority to do these things ? "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「我要問你們一句話，你們回答我，我就告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " I will ask you one question . Answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .

verses.z: 若有人對你們說：『為甚麼做這事？』你們就說：『主要用牠。』那人必立時讓你們牽來。」
verses.e: If anyone asks you , ' Why are you doing this ? ' say , ' The Lord needs him ; ' and immediately he will send him back here . "

verses.z: 約翰的洗禮是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？你們可以回答我。」
verses.e: The baptism of John — was it from heaven , or from men ? Answer me . "

verses.z: 他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必說：『這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
verses.e: They reasoned with themselves , saying , " If we should say , ' From heaven ; ' he will say , ' Why then did you not believe him ? '

verses.z: 若說『從人間來』，卻又怕百姓，因為眾人真以約翰為先知。」
verses.e: If we should say , ' From men ' " — they feared the people , for all held John to really be a prophet .

verses.z: 於是回答耶穌說：「我們不知道。」耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」
verses.e: They answered Jesus , " We don't know . " Jesus said to them , " Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things . "

verses.z: 他們去了，便看見一匹驢駒拴在門外街道上，就把牠解開。
verses.e: They went away , and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street , and they untied him .

verses.z: 在那裏站着的人，有幾個說：「你們解驢駒做甚麼？」
verses.e: Some of those who stood there asked them , " What are you doing , untying the young donkey ? "

verses.z: 門徒照着耶穌所說的回答，那些人就任憑他們牽去了。
verses.e: They said to them just as Jesus had said , and they let them go .

verses.z: 他們把驢駒牽到耶穌那裏，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
verses.e: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it , and Jesus sat on it .

verses.z: 有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，也有人把田間的樹枝砍下來，鋪在路上。
verses.e: Many spread their garments on the way , and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road .

verses.z: 前行後隨的人都喊着說：和散那！奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！
verses.e: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out , " Hosanna ! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord !

verses.z: 耶穌就用比喻對他們說：「有人栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
verses.e: He began to speak to them in parables . " A man planted a vineyard , put a hedge around it , dug a pit for the wine press , built a tower , rented it out to a farmer , and went into another country .

verses.z: [經上寫着說]：匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。
verses.e: Haven't you even read this Scripture : ' The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner .

verses.z: 這是主所做的，在我們眼中看為希奇。這經你們沒有念過嗎？」
verses.e: This was from the Lord . It is marvelous in our eyes ' ? "

verses.z: 他們看出這比喻是指着他們說的，就想要捉拿他，只是懼怕百姓，於是離開他走了。
verses.e: They tried to seize him , but they feared the multitude ; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them . They left him and went away .

verses.z: 後來，他們打發幾個法利賽人和幾個希律黨的人到耶穌那裏，要就着他的話陷害他。
verses.e: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him , that they might trap him with words .

verses.z: 他們來了，就對他說：「夫子，我們知道你是誠實的，甚麼人你都不徇情面；因為你不看人的外貌，乃是誠誠實實傳上帝的道。納稅給凱撒可以不可以？
verses.e: When they had come , they asked him , " Teacher , we know that you are honest , and don't defer to anyone ; for you aren't partial to anyone , but truly teach the way of God . Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar , or not ?

verses.z: 我們該納不該納？」耶穌知道他們的假意，就對他們說：「你們為甚麼試探我？拿一個銀錢來給我看！」
verses.e: Shall we give , or shall we not give ? " But he , knowing their hypocrisy , said to them , " Why do you test me ? Bring me a denarius , that I may see it . "

verses.z: 他們就拿了來。耶穌說：「這像和這號是誰的？」他們說：「是凱撒的。」
verses.e: They brought it . He said to them , " Whose is this image and inscription ? " They said to him , " Caesar's . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「凱撒的物當歸給凱撒，上帝的物當歸給上帝。」他們就很希奇他。
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's , and to God the things that are God's . " They marveled greatly at him .

verses.z: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。他們來問耶穌說：
verses.e: Some Sadducees , who say that there is no resurrection , came to him . They asked him , saying ,

verses.z: 「夫子，摩西為我們寫着說：『人若死了，撇下妻子，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』
verses.e: " Teacher , Moses wrote to us , ' If a man's brother dies and leaves a wife behind him , and leaves no children , that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother . '

verses.z: 到了時候，打發一個僕人到園戶那裏，要從園戶收葡萄園的果子。
verses.e: When it was time , he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard .

verses.z: 有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有留下孩子。
verses.e: There were seven brothers . The first took a wife , and dying left no offspring .

verses.z: 第二個娶了她，也死了，沒有留下孩子。第三個也是這樣。
verses.e: The second took her , and died , leaving no children behind him . The third likewise ;

verses.z: 那七個人都沒有留下孩子；末了，那婦人也死了。
verses.e: and the seven took her and left no children . Last of all the woman also died .

verses.z: 當復活的時候，她是哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們七個人都娶過她。」
verses.e: In the resurrection , when they rise , whose wife will she be of them ? For the seven had her as a wife . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們所以錯了，豈不是因為不明白聖經，不曉得上帝的大能嗎？
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Isn't this because you are mistaken , not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God ?

verses.z: 人從死裏復活，也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
verses.e: For when they will rise from the dead , they neither marry nor are given in marriage , but are like angels in heaven .

verses.z: 論到死人復活，你們沒有念過摩西的書荊棘篇上[所載的]嗎？上帝對摩西說：『我是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』
verses.e: But about the dead , that they are raised , haven't you read in the book of Moses about the Bush , how God spoke to him , saying , ' I am the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ' ?

verses.z: 上帝不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝。你們是大錯了。」
verses.e: He is not the God of the dead , but of the living . You are therefore badly mistaken . "

verses.z: 有一個文士來，聽見他們辯論，曉得耶穌回答的好，就問他說：「誡命中哪是第一[要緊的]呢？」
verses.e: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together , and knowing that he had answered them well , asked him , " Which commandment is the greatest of all ? "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「第一[要緊的]就是說：『以色列啊，你要聽，主－我們上帝是獨一的主。
verses.e: Jesus answered , " The greatest is : ' Hear , Israel , the Lord our God , the Lord is one .

verses.z: 園戶拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。
verses.e: They took him , beat him , and sent him away empty .

verses.z: 你要盡心、盡性、盡意、盡力愛主－你的上帝。』
verses.e: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart , with all your soul , with all your mind , and with all your strength . ' This is the first commandment .

verses.z: 其次就是說：『要愛人如己。』再沒有比這兩條誡命更大的了。」
verses.e: The second is like this : ' You shall love your neighbor as yourself . ' There is no other commandment greater than these . "

verses.z: 那文士對耶穌說：「夫子說，上帝是一位，實在不錯；除了他以外，再沒有別的上帝；
verses.e: The scribe said to him , " Truly , teacher , you have said well that he is one , and there is none other but he ;

verses.z: 並且盡心、盡智、盡力愛他，又愛人如己，就比一切燔祭和各樣祭祀好的多。」
verses.e: and to love him with all the heart , with all the understanding , all the soul , and with all the strength , and to love his neighbor as himself , is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices . "

verses.z: 耶穌見他回答的有智慧，就對他說：「你離上帝的國不遠了。」從此以後，沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
verses.e: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely , he said to him , " You are not far from God's Kingdom . " No one dared ask him any question after that .

verses.z: 耶穌在殿裏教訓人，就問他們說：「文士怎麼說基督是大衛的子孫呢？
verses.e: Jesus responded , as he taught in the temple , " How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David ?

verses.z: 大衛被聖靈感動，說：主對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
verses.e: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit , ' The Lord said to my Lord , " Sit at my right hand , until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet . " '

verses.z: 大衛既自己稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」眾人都喜歡聽他。
verses.e: Therefore David himself calls him Lord , so how can he be his son ? " The common people heard him gladly .

verses.z: 耶穌在教訓之間，說：「你們要防備文士；他們好穿長衣遊行，喜愛人在街市上問他們的安，
verses.e: In his teaching he said to them , " Beware of the scribes , who like to walk in long robes , and to get greetings in the marketplaces ,

verses.z: 又喜愛會堂裏的高位，筵席上的首座。
verses.e: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts ,

verses.z: 再打發一個僕人到他們那裏。他們打傷他的頭，並且凌辱他。
verses.e: Again , he sent another servant to them ; and they threw stones at him , wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully treated .

verses.z: 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，假意作很長的禱告。這些人要受更重的刑罰！」
verses.e: those who devour widows ' houses , and for a pretense make long prayers . These will receive greater condemnation . "

verses.z: 耶穌對銀庫坐着，看眾人怎樣投錢入庫。有好些財主往裏投了若干的錢。
verses.e: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury . Many who were rich cast in much .

verses.z: 有一個窮寡婦來，往裏投了兩個小錢，就是一個大錢。
verses.e: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins , which equal a quadrans coin .

verses.z: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：「我實在告訴你們，這窮寡婦投入庫裏的，比眾人所投的更多。
verses.e: He called his disciples to himself and said to them , " Most certainly I tell you , this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury ,

verses.z: 因為，他們都是自己有餘，拿出來投在裏頭；但這寡婦是自己不足，把她一切養生的都投上了。」
verses.e: for they all gave out of their abundance , but she , out of her poverty , gave all that she had to live on . "

verses.z: 又打發一個僕人去，他們就殺了他。後又打發好些僕人去，有被他們打的，有被他們殺的。
verses.e: Again he sent another , and they killed him , and many others , beating some , and killing some .

verses.z: 園主還有一位是他的愛子，末後又打發他去，[意思]說：『他們必尊敬我的兒子。』
verses.e: Therefore still having one , his beloved son , he sent him last to them , saying , ' They will respect my son . '

verses.z: 不料，那些園戶彼此說：『這是承受產業的。來吧，我們殺他，產業就歸我們了！』
verses.e: But those farmers said among themselves , ' This is the heir . Come , let's kill him , and the inheritance will be ours . '

verses.z: 於是拿住他，殺了他，把他丟在園外。
verses.e: They took him , killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard .

verses.z: 這樣，葡萄園的主人要怎麼辦呢？他要來除滅那些園戶，將葡萄園轉給別人。
verses.e: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do ? He will come and destroy the farmers , and will give the vineyard to others .

verses.z: 耶穌從殿裏出來的時候，有一個門徒對他說：「夫子，請看，這是何等的石頭！何等的殿宇！」
verses.e: As he went out of the temple , one of his disciples said to him , " Teacher , see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings ! "

verses.z: 然而，福音必須先傳給萬民。
verses.e: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations .

verses.z: 人把你們拉去交官的時候，不要預先思慮說甚麼；到那時候，賜給你們甚麼話，你們就說甚麼；因為說話的不是你們，乃是聖靈。
verses.e: When they lead you away and deliver you up , don't be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say , but say whatever will be given you in that hour . For it is not you who speak , but the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要起來與父母為敵，害死他們；
verses.e: " Brother will deliver up brother to death , and the father his child . Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death .

verses.z: 並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。」
verses.e: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake , but he who endures to the end will be saved .

verses.z: 「你們看見那行毀壞可憎的，站在不當站的地方（讀[這經]的人須要會意）。那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
verses.e: " But when you see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , standing where it ought not " ( let the reader understand ) , " then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains ,

verses.z: 在房上的，不要下來，也不要進去拿家裏的東西；
verses.e: and let him who is on the housetop not go down , nor enter in , to take anything out of his house .

verses.z: 在田裏的，也不要回去取衣裳。
verses.e: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak .

verses.z: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了！
verses.e: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days !

verses.z: 你們應當祈求，叫這些事不在冬天臨到。
verses.e: Pray that your flight won't be in the winter .

verses.z: 因為在那些日子必有災難，自從上帝創造萬物直到如今，並沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
verses.e: For in those days there will be oppression , such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now , and never will be .

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你看見這大殿宇嗎？將來在這裏沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Do you see these great buildings ? There will not be left here one stone on another , which will not be thrown down . "

verses.z: 若不是主減少那日子，凡有血氣的，總沒有一個得救的；只是為主的選民，他將那日子減少了。
verses.e: Unless the Lord had shortened the days , no flesh would have been saved ; but for the sake of the chosen ones , whom he picked out , he shortened the days .

verses.z: 那時若有人對你們說：『看哪，基督在這裏』，或說：『基督在那裏』，你們不要信！
verses.e: Then if anyone tells you , ' Look , here is the Christ ! ' or , ' Look , there ! ' don't believe it .

verses.z: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯神蹟奇事，倘若能行，就把選民迷惑了。
verses.e: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders , that they may lead astray , if possible , even the chosen ones .

verses.z: 你們要謹慎。看哪，凡事我都預先告訴你們了。」
verses.e: But you watch . " Behold , I have told you all things beforehand .

verses.z: 「在那些日子，那災難以後，日頭要變黑了，月亮也不放光，
verses.e: But in those days , after that oppression , the sun will be darkened , the moon will not give its light ,

verses.z: 眾星要從天上墜落，天勢都要震動。
verses.e: the stars will be falling from the sky , and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken .

verses.z: 那時，他們要看見人子有大能力、大榮耀，駕雲降臨。
verses.e: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory .

verses.z: 他要差遣天使，把他的選民，從四方，從地極直到天邊，都招聚了來。」
verses.e: Then he will send out his angels , and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds , from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky .

verses.z: 「你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
verses.e: " Now from the fig tree , learn this parable . When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves , you know that the summer is near ;

verses.z: 這樣，你們幾時看見這些事成就，也該知道人子近了，正在門口了。
verses.e: even so you also , when you see these things coming to pass , know that it is near , at the doors .

verses.z: 耶穌在橄欖山上對[聖]殿而坐。彼得、雅各、約翰，和安得烈暗暗地問他說：
verses.e: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple , Peter , James , John , and Andrew asked him privately ,

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
verses.e: Most certainly I say to you , this generation will not pass away until all these things happen .

verses.z: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」
verses.e: Heaven and earth will pass away , but my words will not pass away .

verses.z: 「但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。
verses.e: " But of that day or that hour no one knows — not even the angels in heaven , nor the Son , but only the Father .

verses.z: 你們要謹慎，警醒祈禱，因為你們不曉得那日期幾時來到。
verses.e: Watch , keep alert , and pray ; for you don't know when the time is .

verses.z: 這事正如一個人離開本家，寄居外邦，把權柄交給僕人，分派各人當做的工，又吩咐看門的警醒。
verses.e: " It is like a man traveling to another country , having left his house and given authority to his servants , and to each one his work , and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch .

verses.z: 所以，你們要警醒；因為你們不知道家主甚麼時候來，或晚上，或半夜，或雞叫，或早晨；
verses.e: Watch therefore , for you don't know when the lord of the house is coming — whether at evening , or at midnight , or when the rooster crows , or in the morning ;

verses.z: 恐怕他忽然來到，看見你們睡着了。
verses.e: lest , coming suddenly , he might find you sleeping .

verses.z: 我對你們所說的話，也是對眾人說：要警醒！」
verses.e: What I tell you , I tell all : Watch ! "

verses.z: 「請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事呢？這一切事將成的時候有甚麼預兆呢？」
verses.e: " Tell us , when will these things be ? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
verses.e: Jesus , answering , began to tell them , " Be careful that no one leads you astray .

verses.z: 將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是[基督]』，並且要迷惑許多人。
verses.e: For many will come in my name , saying , ' I am he ! ' and will lead many astray .

verses.z: 你們聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，不要驚慌。[這些事]是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
verses.e: " When you hear of wars and rumors of wars , don't be troubled . For those must happen , but the end is not yet .

verses.z: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有地震、饑荒。這都是災難的起頭。
verses.e: For nation will rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom . There will be earthquakes in various places . There will be famines and troubles . These things are the beginning of birth pains .

verses.z: 但你們要謹慎；因為人要把你們交給公會，並且你們在會堂裏要受鞭打，又為我的緣故站在諸侯與君王面前，對他們作見證。
verses.e: " But watch yourselves , for they will deliver you up to councils . You will be beaten in synagogues . You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake , for a testimony to them .

verses.z: 過兩天是逾越[節]，又是除酵節，祭司長和文士想法子怎麼用詭計捉拿耶穌，殺他。
verses.e: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread , and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him .

verses.z: 十二門徒之中，有一個加略人猶大去見祭司長，要把耶穌交給他們。
verses.e: Judas Iscariot , who was one of the twelve , went away to the chief priests , that he might deliver him to them .

verses.z: 他們聽見就歡喜，又應許給他銀子；他就尋思如何得便把耶穌交給他們。
verses.e: They , when they heard it , were glad , and promised to give him money . He sought how he might conveniently deliver him .

verses.z: 除酵節的第一天，就是宰逾越[羊羔]的那一天，門徒對耶穌說：「你吃逾越[節的筵席]要我們往哪裏去預備呢？」
verses.e: On the first day of unleavened bread , when they sacrificed the Passover , his disciples asked him , " Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover ? "

verses.z: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：「你們進城去，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而來，你們就跟着他。
verses.e: He sent two of his disciples and said to them , " Go into the city , and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you . Follow him ,

verses.z: 他進哪家去，你們就對那家的主人說：『夫子說：客房在哪裏？我與門徒好在那裏吃逾越[節的筵席]。』
verses.e: and wherever he enters in , tell the master of the house , ' The Teacher says , " Where is the guest room , where I may eat the Passover with my disciples ? " '

verses.z: 他必指給你們擺設整齊的一間大樓，你們就在那裏為我們預備。」
verses.e: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready . Get ready for us there . "

verses.z: 門徒出去，進了城，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的。他們就預備了逾越[節的筵席]。
verses.e: His disciples went out , and came into the city , and found things as he had said to them , and they prepared the Passover .

verses.z: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒都來了。
verses.e: When it was evening he came with the twelve .

verses.z: 他們坐席正吃的時候，耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個與我同吃的人要賣我了。」
verses.e: As they sat and were eating , Jesus said , " Most certainly I tell you , one of you will betray me — he who eats with me . "

verses.z: 他們就憂愁起來，一個一個地問他說：「是我嗎？」
verses.e: They began to be sorrowful , and to ask him one by one , " Surely not I ? " And another said , " Surely not I ? "

verses.z: 只是說：「當節的日子不可，恐怕百姓生亂。」
verses.e: For they said , " Not during the feast , because there might be a riot among the people . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「是十二個門徒中同我蘸手在盤子裏的那個人。
verses.e: He answered them , " It is one of the twelve , he who dips with me in the dish .

verses.z: 人子必要去世，正如[經上]指着他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。」
verses.e: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him , but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed ! It would be better for that man if he had not been born . "

verses.z: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝了福，就擘開，遞給他們，說：「你們拿着吃，這是我的身體」；
verses.e: As they were eating , Jesus took bread , and when he had blessed it , he broke it and gave to them , and said , " Take , eat . This is my body . "

verses.z: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們；他們都喝了。
verses.e: He took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave to them . They all drank of it .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「這是我立約的血，為多人流出來的。
verses.e: He said to them , " This is my blood of the new covenant , which is poured out for many .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在上帝的國裏喝新的那日子。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God's Kingdom . "

verses.z: 他們唱了詩，就出來，往橄欖山去。
verses.e: When they had sung a hymn , they went out to the Mount of Olives .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們都要跌倒了，因為[經上]記着說：我要擊打牧人，羊就分散了。
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight , for it is written , ' I will strike the shepherd , and the sheep will be scattered . '

verses.z: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。」
verses.e: However , after I am raised up , I will go before you into Galilee . "

verses.z: 彼得說：「眾人雖然跌倒，我總不能。」
verses.e: But Peter said to him , " Although all will be offended , yet I will not . "

verses.z: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裏坐席的時候，有一個女人拿着一玉瓶至貴的真哪噠香膏來，打破玉瓶，把膏澆在耶穌的頭上。
verses.e: While he was at Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper , as he sat at the table , a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard — very costly . She broke the jar and poured it over his head .

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「我實在告訴你，就在今天夜裏，雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " Most certainly I tell you that you today , even this night , before the rooster crows twice , you will deny me three times . "

verses.z: 彼得卻極力地說：「我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。」眾門徒都是這樣說。
verses.e: But he spoke all the more , " If I must die with you , I will not deny you . " They all said the same thing .

verses.z: 他們來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼。耶穌對門徒說：「你們坐在這裏，等我禱告。」
verses.e: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane . He said to his disciples , " Sit here while I pray . "

verses.z: 於是帶着彼得、雅各、約翰同去，就驚恐起來，極其難過，
verses.e: He took with him Peter , James , and John , and began to be greatly troubled and distressed .

verses.z: 對他們說：「我心裏甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裏等候，警醒。」
verses.e: He said to them , " My soul is exceedingly sorrowful , even to death . Stay here and watch . "

verses.z: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：「倘若可行，便叫那時候過去。」
verses.e: He went forward a little , and fell on the ground , and prayed that if it were possible , the hour might pass away from him .

verses.z: 他說：「阿爸！父啊！在你凡事都能；求你將這杯撤去。然而，不要從我的意思，只要從你的意思。」
verses.e: He said , " Abba , Father , all things are possible to you . Please remove this cup from me . However , not what I desire , but what you desire . "

verses.z: 耶穌回來，見他們睡着了，就對彼得說：「西門，你睡覺嗎？不能警醒片時嗎？
verses.e: He came and found them sleeping , and said to Peter , " Simon , are you sleeping ? Couldn't you watch one hour ?

verses.z: 總要警醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。」
verses.e: Watch and pray , that you may not enter into temptation . The spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak . "

verses.z: 耶穌又去禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣，
verses.e: Again he went away and prayed , saying the same words .

verses.z: 有幾個人心中很不喜悅，說：「何用這樣枉費香膏呢？
verses.e: But there were some who were indignant among themselves , saying , " Why has this ointment been wasted ?

verses.z: 又來見他們睡着了，因為他們的眼睛甚是困倦；他們也不知道怎麼回答。
verses.e: Again he returned and found them sleeping , for their eyes were very heavy ; and they didn't know what to answer him .

verses.z: 第三次來，對他們說：「現在你們仍然睡覺安歇吧！夠了，時候到了。看哪，人子被賣在罪人手裏了。
verses.e: He came the third time and said to them , " Sleep on now , and take your rest . It is enough . The hour has come . Behold , the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .

verses.z: 起來！我們走吧。看哪，那賣我的人近了！」
verses.e: Arise ! Let's get going . Behold , he who betrays me is at hand . "

verses.z: 說話之間，忽然那十二個門徒裏的猶大來了，並有許多人帶着刀棒，從祭司長和文士並長老那裏與他同來。
verses.e: Immediately , while he was still speaking , Judas , one of the twelve , came — and with him a multitude with swords and clubs , from the chief priests , the scribes , and the elders .

verses.z: 賣耶穌的人曾給他們一個暗號，說：「我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們把他拿住，牢牢靠靠地帶去。」
verses.e: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign , saying , " Whomever I will kiss , that is he . Seize him , and lead him away safely . "

verses.z: 猶大來了，隨即到耶穌跟前，說：「拉比」，便與他親嘴。
verses.e: When he had come , immediately he came to him and said , " Rabbi ! Rabbi ! " and kissed him .

verses.z: 他們就下手拿住他。
verses.e: They laid their hands on him and seized him .

verses.z: 旁邊站着的人，有一個拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
verses.e: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest , and cut off his ear .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？
verses.e: Jesus answered them , " Have you come out , as against a robber , with swords and clubs to seize me ?

verses.z: 我天天教訓人，同你們在殿裏，你們並沒有拿我。但[這事成就]，為要應驗經上的話。」
verses.e: I was daily with you in the temple teaching , and you didn't arrest me . But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled . "

verses.z: 這香膏可以賣三十多兩銀子賙濟窮人。」他們就向那女人生氣。
verses.e: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor . " So they grumbled against her .

verses.z: 門徒都離開他，逃走了。
verses.e: They all left him , and fled .

verses.z: 有一個少年人，赤身披着一塊麻布，跟隨耶穌，眾人就捉拿他。
verses.e: A certain young man followed him , having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body . The young men grabbed him ,

verses.z: 他卻丟了麻布，赤身逃走了。
verses.e: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked .

verses.z: 他們把耶穌帶到大祭司那裏，又有眾祭司長和長老並文士都來和大祭司一同聚集。
verses.e: They led Jesus away to the high priest . All the chief priests , the elders , and the scribes came together with him .

verses.z: 彼得遠遠地跟着耶穌，一直進入大祭司的院裏，和差役一同坐在火光裏烤火。
verses.e: Peter had followed him from a distance , until he came into the court of the high priest . He was sitting with the officers , and warming himself in the light of the fire .

verses.z: 祭司長和全公會尋找見證控告耶穌，要治死他，卻尋不着。
verses.e: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death , and found none .

verses.z: 因為有好些人作假見證告他，只是他們的見證各不相合。
verses.e: For many gave false testimony against him , and their testimony didn't agree with each other .

verses.z: 又有幾個人站起來作假見證告他，說：
verses.e: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him , saying ,

verses.z: 「我們聽見他說：『我要拆毀這人手所造的殿，三日內就另造一座不是人手所造的。』」
verses.e: " We heard him say , ' I will destroy this temple that is made with hands , and in three days I will build another made without hands . ' "

verses.z: 他們就是這麼作見證，也是各不相合。
verses.e: Even so , their testimony didn't agree .

verses.z: 耶穌說：「由她吧！為甚麼難為她呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
verses.e: But Jesus said , " Leave her alone . Why do you trouble her ? She has done a good work for me .

verses.z: 大祭司起來站在中間，問耶穌說：「你甚麼都不回答嗎？這些人作見證告你的是甚麼呢？」
verses.e: The high priest stood up in the middle , and asked Jesus , " Have you no answer ? What is it which these testify against you ? "

verses.z: 耶穌卻不言語，一句也不回答。大祭司又問他說：「你是那當稱頌者的兒子基督不是？」
verses.e: But he stayed quiet , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , " Are you the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「我是。你們必看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕着天上的雲降臨。」
verses.e: Jesus said , " I am . You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power , and coming with the clouds of the sky . "

verses.z: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說：「我們何必再用見證人呢？
verses.e: The high priest tore his clothes and said , " What further need have we of witnesses ?

verses.z: 你們已經聽見他這僭妄的話了。你們的意見如何？」他們都定他該死的罪。
verses.e: You have heard the blasphemy ! What do you think ? " They all condemned him to be worthy of death .

verses.z: 就有人吐唾沫在他臉上，又蒙着他的臉，用拳頭打他，對他說：「你說預言吧！」差役接過他來，用手掌打他。
verses.e: Some began to spit on him , and to cover his face , and to beat him with fists , and to tell him , " Prophesy ! " The officers struck him with the palms of their hands .

verses.z: 彼得在下邊院子裏；來了大祭司的一個使女，
verses.e: As Peter was in the courtyard below , one of the maids of the high priest came ,

verses.z: 見彼得烤火，就看着他，說：「你素來也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。」
verses.e: and seeing Peter warming himself , she looked at him and said , " You were also with the Nazarene , Jesus ! "

verses.z: 彼得卻不承認，說：「我不知道，也不明白你說的是甚麼。」於是出來，到了前院，雞就叫了。
verses.e: But he denied it , saying , " I neither know nor understand what you are saying . " He went out on the porch , and the rooster crowed .

verses.z: 那使女看見他，又對旁邊站着的人說：「這也是他們一黨的。」
verses.e: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by , " This is one of them . "

verses.z: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，要向他們行善隨時都可以；只是你們不常有我。
verses.e: For you always have the poor with you , and whenever you want to , you can do them good ; but you will not always have me .

verses.z: 彼得又不承認。過了不多的時候，旁邊站着的人又對彼得說：「你真是他們一黨的！因為你是加利利人。」
verses.e: But he again denied it . After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter , " You truly are one of them , for you are a Galilean , and your speech shows it . "

verses.z: 彼得就發咒起誓地說：「我不認得你們說的這個人。」
verses.e: But he began to curse and to swear , " I don't know this man of whom you speak ! "

verses.z: 立時雞叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶穌對他所說的話：「雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。」思想起來，就哭了。
verses.e: The rooster crowed the second time . Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him , " Before the rooster crows twice , you will deny me three times . " When he thought about that , he wept .

verses.z: 她所做的，是盡她所能的；她是為我安葬的事把香膏預先澆在我身上。
verses.e: She has done what she could . She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所做的，以為記念。」
verses.e: Most certainly I tell you , wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world , that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her . "

verses.z: 一到早晨，祭司長和長老、文士、全公會的人大家商議，就把耶穌捆綁，解去交給彼拉多。
verses.e: Immediately in the morning the chief priests , with the elders , scribes , and the whole council , held a consultation , bound Jesus , carried him away , and delivered him up to Pilate .

verses.z: 他原曉得，祭司長是因為嫉妒才把耶穌解了來。
verses.e: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up .

verses.z: 只是祭司長挑唆眾人，寧可釋放巴拉巴給他們。
verses.e: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude , that he should release Barabbas to them instead .

verses.z: 彼拉多又說：「那麼樣，你們所稱為猶太人的王，我怎麼辦他呢？」
verses.e: Pilate again asked them , " What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews ? "

verses.z: 他們又喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
verses.e: They cried out again , " Crucify him ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多說：「為甚麼呢？他做了甚麼惡事呢？」他們便極力地喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
verses.e: Pilate said to them , " Why , what evil has he done ? " But they cried out exceedingly , " Crucify him ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多要叫眾人喜悅，就釋放巴拉巴給他們，將耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。
verses.e: Pilate , wishing to please the multitude , released Barabbas to them , and handed over Jesus , when he had flogged him , to be crucified .

verses.z: 旁邊站着的人，有的聽見就說：「看哪，他叫以利亞呢！」
verses.e: Some of those who stood by , when they heard it , said , " Behold , he is calling Elijah . "

verses.z: 有一個人跑去，把海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝，說：「且等着，看以利亞來不來把他取下。」
verses.e: One ran , and filling a sponge full of vinegar , put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink , saying , " Let him be . Let's see whether Elijah comes to take him down . "

verses.z: 耶穌大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。
verses.e: Jesus cried out with a loud voice , and gave up the spirit .

verses.z: 殿裏的幔子從上到下裂為兩半。
verses.e: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom .

verses.z: 對面站着的百夫長看見耶穌這樣喊叫斷氣，就說：「這人真是上帝的兒子！」
verses.e: When the centurion , who stood by opposite him , saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last , he said , " Truly this man was the Son of God ! "

verses.z: 彼拉多又問他說：「你看，他們告你這麼多的事，你甚麼都不回答嗎？」

verses.z: 還有些婦女遠遠地觀看；內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有小雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有撒羅米，

verses.e: who , when he was in Galilee , followed him and served him ; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem .

verses.z: 到了晚上，因為這是預備日，就是安息日的前一日，
verses.e: When evening had now come , because it was the Preparation Day , that is , the day before the Sabbath ,

verses.z: 有亞利馬太的約瑟前來，他是尊貴的議士，也是等候上帝國的。他放膽進去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；

verses.z: 彼拉多詫異耶穌已經死了，便叫百夫長來，問他耶穌死了久不久。
verses.e: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead ; and summoning the centurion , he asked him whether he had been dead long .

verses.z: 既從百夫長得知實情，就把耶穌的屍首賜給約瑟。
verses.e: When he found out from the centurion , he granted the body to Joseph .

verses.z: 約瑟買了細麻布，把耶穌取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在磐石中鑿出來的墳墓裏，又滾過一塊石頭來擋住墓門。
verses.e: He bought a linen cloth , and taking him down , wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock . He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb .

verses.z: 抹大拉的馬利亞和約西的母親馬利亞都看見安放他的地方。
verses.e: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses , saw where he was laid .

verses.z: 耶穌仍不回答，以致彼拉多覺得希奇。
verses.e: But Jesus made no further answer , so that Pilate marveled .

verses.z: 每逢這節期，巡撫照眾人所求的，釋放一個囚犯給他們。
verses.e: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner , whomever they asked of him .

verses.z: 有一個人名叫巴拉巴，和作亂的人一同捆綁。他們作亂的時候，曾殺過人。

verses.e: When the Sabbath was past , Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James , and Salome bought spices , that they might come and anoint him .

verses.z: 她去告訴那向來跟隨耶穌的人；那時他們正哀慟哭泣。
verses.e: She went and told those who had been with him , as they mourned and wept .

verses.z: 他們聽見耶穌活了，被馬利亞看見，卻是不信。
verses.e: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her , they disbelieved .

verses.z: 這事以後，門徒中間有兩個人往鄉下去。走路的時候，耶穌變了形像，向他們顯現。
verses.e: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked , on their way into the country .

verses.z: 他們就去告訴其餘的門徒；其餘的門徒也是不信。
verses.e: They went away and told it to the rest . They didn't believe them , either .

verses.z: 後來，十一個門徒坐席的時候，耶穌向他們顯現，責備他們不信，心裏剛硬，因為他們不信那些在他復活以後看見他的人。
verses.e: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table ; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they didn't believe those who had seen him after he had risen .

verses.e: for it was very big . Looking up , they saw that the stone was rolled back .

verses.z: 那少年人對她們說：「不要驚恐！你們尋找那釘十字架的拿撒勒人耶穌，他已經復活了，不在這裏。請看安放他的地方。

verses.e: He was reclining at the table in his house , and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples , for there were many , and they followed him .

verses.z: 法利賽人中的文士看見耶穌和罪人並稅吏一同吃飯，就對他門徒說：「他和稅吏並罪人一同吃喝嗎？」
verses.e: The scribes and the Pharisees , when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors , said to his disciples , " Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners ? "

verses.z: 耶穌聽見，就對他們說：「康健的人用不着醫生，有病的人才用得着。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。」
verses.e: When Jesus heard it , he said to them , " Those who are healthy have no need for a physician , but those who are sick . I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance . "

verses.z: 當下，約翰的門徒和法利賽人禁食。他們來問耶穌說：「約翰的門徒和法利賽人的門徒禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？」

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「[經上記着]大衛和跟從他的人缺乏飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過嗎？
verses.e: He said to them , " Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry — he , and those who were with him ?

verses.e: How he entered into God's house at the time of Abiathar the high priest , and ate the show bread , which is not lawful to eat except for the priests , and gave also to those who were with him ? "

verses.z: 耶穌上了山，隨自己的意思叫人來；他們便來到他那裏。
verses.e: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted , and they went to him .

verses.z: 他就設立十二個人，要他們常和自己同在，也要差他們去傳道，
verses.e: He appointed twelve , that they might be with him , and that he might send them out to preach

verses.z: 並給他們權柄趕鬼。
verses.e: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons :

verses.z: [這十二個人]有西門（耶穌又給他起名叫彼得），
verses.e: Simon ( to whom he gave the name Peter ) ;

verses.z: 還有西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰（又給這兩個人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思），
verses.e: James the son of Zebedee ; and John , the brother of James , ( whom he called Boanerges , which means , Sons of Thunder ) ;

verses.z: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多羅買、馬太、多馬、亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太，並奮銳黨的西門，
verses.e: Andrew ; Philip ; Bartholomew ; Matthew ; Thomas ; James , the son of Alphaeus ; Thaddaeus ; Simon the Zealot ;

verses.z: 還有賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
verses.e: and Judas Iscariot , who also betrayed him . Then he came into a house .

verses.z: 眾人窺探耶穌，在安息日醫治不醫治，意思是要控告耶穌。
verses.e: They watched him , whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day , that they might accuse him .

verses.z: 耶穌進了一個屋子，眾人又聚集，甚至他連飯也顧不得吃。
verses.e: The multitude came together again , so that they could not so much as eat bread .

verses.z: 耶穌的親屬聽見，就出來要拉住他，因為他們說他癲狂了。
verses.e: When his friends heard it , they went out to seize him ; for they said , " He is insane . "

verses.z: 從耶路撒冷下來的文士說：「他是被別西卜附着」；又說：「他是靠着鬼王趕鬼。」
verses.e: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said , " He has Beelzebul , " and , " By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons . "

verses.z: 耶穌叫他們來，用比喻對他們說：「撒但怎能趕出撒但呢？
verses.e: He summoned them and said to them in parables , " How can Satan cast out Satan ?

verses.z: 若一國自相紛爭，那國就站立不住；
verses.e: If a kingdom is divided against itself , that kingdom cannot stand .

verses.z: 若一家自相紛爭，那家就站立不住。
verses.e: If a house is divided against itself , that house cannot stand .

verses.z: 若撒但自相攻打紛爭，他就站立不住，必要滅亡。
verses.e: If Satan has risen up against himself , and is divided , he can't stand , but has an end .

verses.z: 沒有人能進壯士家裏，搶奪他的家具；必先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的家。
verses.e: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man ; then he will plunder his house .

verses.z: 我實在告訴你們，世人一切的罪和一切褻瀆的話都可得赦免；
verses.e: " Most certainly I tell you , all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven , including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme ;

verses.z: 凡褻瀆聖靈的，卻永不得赦免，乃要擔當永遠的罪。」
verses.e: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness , but is subject to eternal condemnation . "

verses.z: 耶穌對那枯乾一隻手的人說：「起來，站在當中。」
verses.e: He said to the man whose hand was withered , " Stand up . "

verses.z: [這話是]因為他們說：「他是被污鬼附着的。」
verses.e: — because they said , " He has an unclean spirit . "

verses.z: 當下，耶穌的母親和弟兄來，站在外邊，打發人去叫他。
verses.e: His mother and his brothers came , and standing outside , they sent to him , calling him .

verses.z: 有許多人在耶穌周圍坐着，他們就告訴他說：「看哪，你母親和你弟兄在外邊找你。」
verses.e: A multitude was sitting around him , and they told him , " Behold , your mother , your brothers , and your sisters are outside looking for you . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？」
verses.e: He answered them , " Who are my mother and my brothers ? "

verses.z: 就四面觀看那周圍坐着的人，說：「看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
verses.e: Looking around at those who sat around him , he said , " Behold , my mother and my brothers !

verses.z: 凡遵行上帝旨意的人就是我的弟兄姊妹和母親了。」
verses.e: For whoever does the will of God is my brother , my sister , and mother . "

verses.z: 又問眾人說：「在安息日行善行惡，救命害命，哪樣是可以的呢？」他們都不作聲。
verses.e: He said to them , " Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm ? To save a life or to kill ? " But they were silent .

verses.z: 耶穌怒目周圍看他們，憂愁他們的心剛硬，就對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原。
verses.e: When he had looked around at them with anger , being grieved at the hardening of their hearts , he said to the man , " Stretch out your hand . " He stretched it out , and his hand was restored as healthy as the other .

verses.z: 法利賽人出去，同希律一黨的人商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。
verses.e: The Pharisees went out , and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him , how they might destroy him .

verses.z: 耶穌和門徒退到海邊去，有許多人從加利利跟隨他。
verses.e: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples ; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee , from Judea ,

verses.z: 還有許多人聽見他所做的大事，就從猶太、耶路撒冷、以土買、約旦河外，並泰爾、西頓的四方來到他那裏。
verses.e: from Jerusalem , from Idumaea , beyond the Jordan , and those from around Tyre and Sidon . A great multitude , hearing what great things he did , came to him .

verses.z: 他因為人多，就吩咐門徒叫一隻小船伺候着，免得眾人擁擠他。
verses.e: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd , so that they wouldn't press on him .

verses.z: 耶穌又在海邊教訓人。有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海裏，眾人都靠近海，站在岸上。
verses.e: Again he began to teach by the seaside . A great multitude was gathered to him , so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down . All the multitude were on the land by the sea .

verses.z: 無人的時候，跟隨耶穌的人和十二個門徒問他這比喻的意思。
verses.e: When he was alone , those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「上帝國的奧祕只叫你們知道，若是對外人講，凡事就用比喻，
verses.e: He said to them , " To you is given the mystery of God's Kingdom , but to those who are outside , all things are done in parables ,

verses.z: 叫他們看是看見，卻不曉得；聽是聽見，卻不明白；恐怕他們回轉過來，就得赦免。」
verses.e: that ' seeing they may see and not perceive , and hearing they may hear and not understand , lest perhaps they should turn again , and their sins should be forgiven them . ' "

verses.z: 又對他們說：「你們不明白這比喻嗎？這樣怎能明白一切的比喻呢？
verses.e: He said to them , " Don't you understand this parable ? How will you understand all of the parables ?

verses.z: 撒種之人所撒的就是道。
verses.e: The farmer sows the word .

verses.z: 那撒在路旁的，就是人聽了道，撒但立刻來，把撒在他心裏的道奪了去。
verses.e: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown ; and when they have heard , immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them .

verses.z: 那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，
verses.e: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places , who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with joy .

verses.z: 但他心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
verses.e: They have no root in themselves , but are short-lived . When oppression or persecution arises because of the word , immediately they stumble .

verses.z: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，
verses.e: Others are those who are sown among the thorns . These are those who have heard the word ,

verses.z: 後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了，就不能結實。
verses.e: and the cares of this age , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word , and it becomes unfruitful .

verses.z: 耶穌就用比喻教訓他們許多道理。在教訓之間，對他們說：
verses.e: He taught them many things in parables , and told them in his teaching ,

verses.z: 那撒在好地上的，就是人聽道，又領受，並且結實，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」
verses.e: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word , accept it , and bear fruit , some thirty times , some sixty times , and some one hundred times . "

verses.z: 耶穌又對他們說：「人拿燈來，豈是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在燈臺上嗎？
verses.e: He said to them , " Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed ? Isn't it put on a stand ?

verses.z: 因為掩藏的事，沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事，沒有不露出來的。
verses.e: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known , neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light .

verses.z: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
verses.e: If any man has ears to hear , let him hear . "

verses.z: 又說：「你們所聽的要留心。你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們，並且要多給你們。
verses.e: He said to them , " Take heed what you hear . With whatever measure you measure , it will be measured to you ; and more will be given to you who hear .

verses.z: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪去。」
verses.e: For whoever has , to him more will be given ; and he who doesn't have , even that which he has will be taken away from him . "

verses.z: 又說：「上帝的國如同人把種撒在地上。
verses.e: He said , " God's Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth ,

verses.z: 黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種就發芽漸長，那人卻不曉得如何這樣。
verses.e: and should sleep and rise night and day , and the seed should spring up and grow , though he doesn't know how .

verses.z: 地生五穀是出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒；
verses.e: For the earth bears fruit by itself : first the blade , then the ear , then the full grain in the ear .

verses.z: 穀既熟了，就用鐮刀去割，因為收成的時候到了。」
verses.e: But when the fruit is ripe , immediately he puts in the sickle , because the harvest has come . "

verses.z: 「你們聽啊！有一個撒種的出去撒種。
verses.e: " Listen ! Behold , the farmer went out to sow .

verses.z: 又說：「上帝的國，我們可用甚麼比較呢？可用甚麼比喻表明呢？
verses.e: He said , " How will we liken God's Kingdom ? Or with what parable will we illustrate it ?

verses.z: 好像一粒芥菜種，種在地裏的時候，雖比地上的百種都小，
verses.e: It's like a grain of mustard seed , which , when it is sown in the earth , though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth ,

verses.z: 但種上以後，就長起來，比各樣的菜都大，又長出大枝來，甚至天上的飛鳥可以宿在它的蔭下。」
verses.e: yet when it is sown , grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs , and puts out great branches , so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow . "

verses.z: 耶穌用許多這樣的比喻，照他們所能聽的，對他們講道。
verses.e: With many such parables he spoke the word to them , as they were able to hear it .

verses.z: 若不用比喻，就不對他們講；沒有人的時候，就把一切的道講給門徒聽。
verses.e: Without a parable he didn't speak to them ; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything .

verses.z: 當那天晚上，耶穌對門徒說：「我們渡到那邊去吧。」
verses.e: On that day , when evening had come , he said to them , " Let's go over to the other side . "

verses.z: 門徒離開眾人，耶穌仍在船上，他們就把他一同帶去；也有別的船和他同行。
verses.e: Leaving the multitude , they took him with them , even as he was , in the boat . Other small boats were also with him .

verses.z: 忽然起了暴風，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。
verses.e: A big wind storm arose , and the waves beat into the boat , so much that the boat was already filled .

verses.z: 耶穌在船尾上，枕着枕頭睡覺。門徒叫醒了他，說：「夫子！我們喪命，你不顧嗎？」
verses.e: He himself was in the stern , asleep on the cushion ; and they woke him up and asked him , " Teacher , don't you care that we are dying ? "

verses.z: 耶穌醒了，斥責風，向海說：「住了吧！靜了吧！」風就止住，大大地平靜了。
verses.e: He awoke and rebuked the wind , and said to the sea , " Peace ! Be still ! " The wind ceased and there was a great calm .

verses.z: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
verses.e: As he sowed , some seed fell by the road , and the birds came and devoured it .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「為甚麼膽怯？你們還沒有信心嗎？」
verses.e: He said to them , " Why are you so afraid ? How is it that you have no faith ? "

verses.z: 他們就大大地懼怕，彼此說：「這到底是誰，連風和海也聽從他了。」
verses.e: They were greatly afraid and said to one another , " Who then is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ? "

verses.z: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
verses.e: Others fell on the rocky ground , where it had little soil , and immediately it sprang up , because it had no depth of soil .

verses.z: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
verses.e: When the sun had risen , it was scorched ; and because it had no root , it withered away .

verses.z: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它擠住了，就不結實；
verses.e: Others fell among the thorns , and the thorns grew up and choked it , and it yielded no fruit .

verses.z: 又有落在好土裏的，就發生長大，結實有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；
verses.e: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit , growing up and increasing . Some produced thirty times , some sixty times , and some one hundred times as much . "

verses.z: 又說：「有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
verses.e: He said , " Whoever has ears to hear , let him hear . "

verses.z: 他們來到海那邊格拉森人的地方。
verses.e: They came to the other side of the sea , into the country of the Gadarenes .

verses.z: 就再三地求耶穌，不要叫他們離開那地方。
verses.e: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country .

verses.z: 在那裏山坡上，有一大群豬吃食；
verses.e: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding .

verses.z: 鬼就央求耶穌說：「求你打發我們往豬群裏，附着豬去。」
verses.e: All the demons begged him , saying , " Send us into the pigs , that we may enter into them . "

verses.z: 耶穌准了他們，污鬼就出來，進入豬裏去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在海裏，淹死了。[豬的數目]約有二千。
verses.e: At once Jesus gave them permission . The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs . The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea , and they were drowned in the sea .

verses.z: 放豬的就逃跑了，去告訴城裏和鄉下的人。眾人就來，要看是甚麼事。
verses.e: Those who fed the pigs fled , and told it in the city and in the country . The people came to see what it was that had happened .

verses.z: 他們來到耶穌那裏，看見那被鬼附着的人，就是從前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心裏明白過來，他們就害怕。
verses.e: They came to Jesus , and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting , clothed , and in his right mind , even him who had the legion ; and they were afraid .

verses.z: 看見這事的，便將鬼附之人所遇見的和那群豬的事都告訴了眾人；
verses.e: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons , and about the pigs .

verses.z: 眾人就央求耶穌離開他們的境界。
verses.e: They began to beg him to depart from their region .

verses.z: 耶穌上船的時候，那從前被鬼附着的人懇求和耶穌同在。
verses.e: As he was entering into the boat , he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him .

verses.z: 耶穌不許，卻對他說：「你回家去，到你的親屬那裏，將主為你所做的是何等大的事，是怎樣憐憫你，都告訴他們。」
verses.e: He didn't allow him , but said to him , " Go to your house , to your friends , and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you . "

verses.z: 耶穌一下船，就有一個被污鬼附着的人從墳塋裏出來迎着他。
verses.e: When he had come out of the boat , immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs .

verses.z: 那人就走了，在低加坡里傳揚耶穌為他做了何等大的事，眾人就都希奇。
verses.e: He went his way , and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him , and everyone marveled .

verses.z: 耶穌坐船又渡到那邊去，就有許多人到他那裏聚集；他正在海邊上。
verses.e: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side , a great multitude was gathered to him ; and he was by the sea .

verses.z: 有一個管會堂的人，名叫睚魯，來見耶穌，就俯伏在他腳前，
verses.e: Behold , one of the rulers of the synagogue , Jairus by name , came ; and seeing him , he fell at his feet

verses.z: 再三地求他，說：「我的小女兒快要死了，[求你]去按手在她身上，使她痊癒，得以活了。」
verses.e: and begged him much , saying , " My little daughter is at the point of death . Please come and lay your hands on her , that she may be made healthy , and live . "

verses.z: 耶穌就和他同去。有許多人跟隨擁擠他。
verses.e: He went with him , and a great multitude followed him , and they pressed upon him on all sides .

verses.z: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，
verses.e: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years ,

verses.z: 在好些醫生手裏受了許多的苦，又花盡了她所有的，一點也不見好，病勢反倒更重了。
verses.e: and had suffered many things by many physicians , and had spent all that she had , and was no better , but rather grew worse ,

verses.z: 她聽見耶穌的事，就從後頭來，雜在眾人中間，摸耶穌的衣裳，
verses.e: having heard the things concerning Jesus , came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes .

verses.z: 意思說：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊癒。」
verses.e: For she said , " If I just touch his clothes , I will be made well . "

verses.z: 於是她血漏的源頭立刻乾了；她便覺得身上的災病好了。
verses.e: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up , and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction .

verses.z: 那人常住在墳塋裏，沒有人能捆住他，就是用鐵鍊也不能；
verses.e: He lived in the tombs . Nobody could bind him any more , not even with chains ,

verses.z: 耶穌頓時心裏覺得有能力從自己身上出去，就在眾人中間轉過來，說：「誰摸我的衣裳？」
verses.e: Immediately Jesus , perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him , turned around in the crowd and asked , " Who touched my clothes ? "

verses.z: 門徒對他說：「你看眾人擁擠你，還說『誰摸我』嗎？」
verses.e: His disciples said to him , " You see the multitude pressing against you , and you say , ' Who touched me ? ' "

verses.z: 耶穌周圍觀看，要見做這事的女人。
verses.e: He looked around to see her who had done this thing .

verses.z: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐懼戰兢，來俯伏在耶穌跟前，將實情全告訴他。
verses.e: But the woman , fearing and trembling , knowing what had been done to her , came and fell down before him , and told him all the truth .

verses.z: 耶穌對她說：「女兒，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧！你的災病痊癒了。」
verses.e: He said to her , " Daughter , your faith has made you well . Go in peace , and be cured of your disease . "

verses.z: 還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裏來，說：「你的女兒死了，何必還勞動先生呢？」
verses.e: While he was still speaking , people came from the synagogue ruler's house , saying , " Your daughter is dead . Why bother the Teacher any more ? "

verses.z: 耶穌聽見所說的話，就對管會堂的說：「不要怕，只要信！」
verses.e: But Jesus , when he heard the message spoken , immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue , " Don't be afraid , only believe . "

verses.z: 於是帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰同去，不許別人跟隨他。
verses.e: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter , James , and John the brother of James .

verses.z: 他們來到管會堂的家裏；耶穌看見那裏亂嚷，並有人大大地哭泣哀號，
verses.e: He came to the synagogue ruler's house , and he saw an uproar , weeping , and great wailing .

verses.z: 進到裏面，就對他們說：「為甚麼亂嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。」
verses.e: When he had entered in , he said to them , " Why do you make an uproar and weep ? The child is not dead , but is asleep . "

verses.z: 因為人屢次用腳鐐和鐵鍊捆鎖他，鐵鍊竟被他掙斷了，腳鐐也被他弄碎了；總沒有人能制伏他。
verses.e: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains , and the chains had been torn apart by him , and the fetters broken in pieces . Nobody had the strength to tame him .

verses.z: 他們就嗤笑耶穌。耶穌把他們都攆出去，就帶着孩子的父母和跟隨的人進了孩子所在的地方，
verses.e: They ridiculed him . But he , having put them all out , took the father of the child , her mother , and those who were with him , and went in where the child was lying .

verses.z: 就拉着孩子的手，對她說：「大利大，古米！」（翻出來就是說：「閨女，我吩咐你起來！」）
verses.e: Taking the child by the hand , he said to her , " Talitha cumi ! " which means , being interpreted , " Girl , I tell you , get up ! "

verses.z: 那閨女立時起來走。他們就大大地驚奇；閨女已經十二歲了。
verses.e: Immediately the girl rose up and walked , for she was twelve years old . They were amazed with great amazement .

verses.z: 耶穌切切地囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給她東西吃。
verses.e: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this , and commanded that something should be given to her to eat .

verses.z: 他晝夜常在墳塋裏和山中喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。
verses.e: Always , night and day , in the tombs and in the mountains , he was crying out , and cutting himself with stones .

verses.z: 他遠遠地看見耶穌，就跑過去拜他，
verses.e: When he saw Jesus from afar , he ran and bowed down to him ,

verses.z: 大聲呼叫說：「至高上帝的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？我指着上帝懇求你，不要叫我受苦！」
verses.e: and crying out with a loud voice , he said , " What have I to do with you , Jesus , you Son of the Most High God ? I adjure you by God , don't torment me . "

verses.z: 是因耶穌曾吩咐他說：「污鬼啊，從這人身上出來吧！」
verses.e: For he said to him , " Come out of the man , you unclean spirit ! "

verses.z: 耶穌問他說：「你名叫甚麼？」回答說：「我名叫『群』，因為我們多的緣故」；
verses.e: He asked him , " What is your name ? " He said to him , " My name is Legion , for we are many . "

verses.z: 耶穌離開那裏，來到自己的家鄉；門徒也跟從他。
verses.e: He went out from there . He came into his own country , and his disciples followed him .

verses.z: 又對他們說：「你們無論到何處，進了人的家，就住在那裏，直到離開那地方。
verses.e: He said to them , " Wherever you enter into a house , stay there until you depart from there .

verses.z: 何處的人不接待你們，不聽你們，你們離開那裏的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去，對他們作見證。」
verses.e: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you , as you depart from there , shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them . Assuredly , I tell you , it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city ! "

verses.z: 門徒就出去傳道，叫人悔改，
verses.e: They went out and preached that people should repent .

verses.z: 又趕出許多的鬼，用油抹了許多病人，治好他們。
verses.e: They cast out many demons , and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them .

verses.z: 耶穌的名聲傳揚出來。希律王聽見了，就說：「施洗的約翰從死裏復活了，所以這些異能由他裏面發出來。」
verses.e: King Herod heard this , for his name had become known , and he said , " John the Baptizer has risen from the dead , and therefore these powers are at work in him . "

verses.z: 但別人說：「是以利亞。」又有人說：「是先知，[正]像先知中的一位。」
verses.e: But others said , " He is Elijah . " Others said , " He is a prophet , or like one of the prophets . "

verses.z: 希律聽見卻說：「是我所斬的約翰，他復活了。」
verses.e: But Herod , when he heard this , said , " This is John , whom I beheaded . He has risen from the dead . "

verses.z: 先是希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，差人去拿住約翰，鎖在監裏，因為希律已經娶了那婦人。
verses.e: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias , his brother Philip's wife , for he had married her .

verses.z: 約翰曾對希律說：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」
verses.e: For John had said to Herod , " It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife . "

verses.z: 於是希羅底懷恨他，想要殺他，只是不能；
verses.e: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him , but she couldn't ,

verses.z: 到了安息日，他在會堂裏教訓人。眾人聽見，就甚希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這些事呢？所賜給他的是甚麼智慧？他手所做的是何等的異能呢？
verses.e: When the Sabbath had come , he began to teach in the synagogue , and many hearing him were astonished , saying , " Where did this man get these things ? " and , " What is the wisdom that is given to this man , that such mighty works come about by his hands ?

verses.z: 因為希律知道約翰是義人，是聖人，所以敬畏他，保護他，聽他講論，就多照着行，並且樂意聽他。
verses.e: for Herod feared John , knowing that he was a righteous and holy man , and kept him safe . When he heard him , he did many things , and he heard him gladly .

verses.z: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律擺設筵席，請了大臣和千夫長，並加利利作首領的。
verses.e: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles , the high officers , and the chief men of Galilee .

verses.z: 希羅底的女兒進來跳舞，使希律和同席的人都歡喜。王就對女子說：「你隨意向我求甚麼，我必給你。」
verses.e: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced , she pleased Herod and those sitting with him . The king said to the young lady , " Ask me whatever you want , and I will give it to you . "

verses.z: 又對她起誓說：「隨你向我求甚麼，就是我國的一半，我也必給你。」
verses.e: He swore to her , " Whatever you ask of me , I will give you , up to half of my kingdom . "

verses.z: 她就出去對她母親說：「我可以求甚麼呢？」她母親說：「施洗約翰的頭。」
verses.e: She went out and said to her mother , " What shall I ask ? " She said , " The head of John the Baptizer . "

verses.z: 她就急忙進去見王，求他說：「我願王立時把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏給我。」
