verses.e: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested , " I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter . "

verses.z: 王就甚憂愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辭，
verses.e: The king was exceedingly sorry , but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests , he didn't wish to refuse her .

verses.z: 隨即差一個護衛兵，吩咐拿約翰的頭來。護衛兵就去，在監裏斬了約翰，
verses.e: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John's head ; and he went and beheaded him in the prison ,

verses.z: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給女子，女子就給她母親。
verses.e: and brought his head on a platter , and gave it to the young lady ; and the young lady gave it to her mother .

verses.z: 約翰的門徒聽見了，就來把他的屍首領去，葬在墳墓裏。
verses.e: When his disciples heard this , they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb .

verses.z: 這不是那木匠嗎？不是馬利亞的兒子雅各、約西、猶大、西門的長兄嗎？他妹妹們不也是在我們這裏嗎？」他們就厭棄他。
verses.e: Isn't this the carpenter , the son of Mary and brother of James , Joses , Judah , and Simon ? Aren't his sisters here with us ? " So they were offended at him .

verses.z: 使徒聚集到耶穌那裏，將一切所做的事、所傳的道全告訴他。
verses.e: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus , and they told him all things , whatever they had done , and whatever they had taught .

verses.z: 他就說：「你們來，同我暗暗地到曠野地方去歇一歇。」這是因為來往的人多，他們連吃飯也沒有工夫。
verses.e: He said to them , " Come away into a deserted place , and rest awhile . " For there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .

verses.z: 他們就坐船，暗暗地往曠野地方去。
verses.e: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves .

verses.z: [眾人]看見他們去，有許多認識他們的，就從各城步行，一同跑到那裏，比他們先趕到了。
verses.e: They saw them going , and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities . They arrived before them and came together to him .

verses.z: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，因為他們如同羊沒有牧人一般，於是開口教訓他們許多道理。
verses.e: Jesus came out , saw a great multitude , and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd ; and he began to teach them many things .

verses.z: 天已經晚了，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，天已經晚了，
verses.e: When it was late in the day , his disciples came to him and said , " This place is deserted , and it is late in the day .

verses.z: 請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裏去，自己買甚麼吃。」
verses.e: Send them away , that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread , for they have nothing to eat . "

verses.z: 耶穌回答說：「你們給他們吃吧。」門徒說：「我們可以去買二十兩銀子的餅給他們吃嗎？」
verses.e: But he answered them , " You give them something to eat . " They asked him , " Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅，可以去看看。」他們知道了，就說：「五個餅，兩條魚。」
verses.e: He said to them , " How many loaves do you have ? Go see . " When they knew , they said , " Five , and two fish . "

verses.z: 耶穌吩咐他們，叫眾人一幫一幫地坐在青草地上。
verses.e: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地、親屬、本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」
verses.e: Jesus said to them , " A prophet is not without honor , except in his own country , and among his own relatives , and in his own house . "

verses.z: 眾人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。
verses.e: They sat down in ranks , by hundreds and by fifties .

verses.z: 耶穌拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前，也把那兩條魚分給眾人。
verses.e: He took the five loaves and the two fish ; and looking up to heaven , he blessed and broke the loaves , and he gave to his disciples to set before them , and he divided the two fish among them all .

verses.z: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了。
verses.e: They all ate and were filled .

verses.z: 門徒就把碎餅碎魚收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
verses.e: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish .

verses.z: 吃餅的男人共有五千。
verses.e: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men .

verses.z: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊伯賽大去，等他叫眾人散開。
verses.e: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side , to Bethsaida , while he himself sent the multitude away .

verses.z: 他既辭別了他們，就往山上去禱告。
verses.e: After he had taken leave of them , he went up the mountain to pray .

verses.z: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶穌獨自在岸上；
verses.e: When evening had come , the boat was in the middle of the sea , and he was alone on the land .

verses.z: 看見門徒因風不順，搖櫓甚苦。夜裏約有四更天，就在海面上走，往他們那裏去，意思要走過他們去。
verses.e: Seeing them distressed in rowing , for the wind was contrary to them , about the fourth watch of the night he came to them , walking on the sea ; and he would have passed by them ,

verses.z: 但門徒看見他在海面上走，以為是鬼怪，就喊叫起來；
verses.e: but they , when they saw him walking on the sea , supposed that it was a ghost , and cried out ;

verses.z: 耶穌就在那裏不得行甚麼異能，不過按手在幾個病人身上，治好他們。
verses.e: He could do no mighty work there , except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them .

verses.z: 因為他們都看見了他，且甚驚慌。耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心！是我，不要怕！」
verses.e: for they all saw him and were troubled . But he immediately spoke with them and said to them , " Cheer up ! It is I ! Don't be afraid . "

verses.z: 於是到他們那裏，上了船，風就住了；他們心裏十分驚奇。
verses.e: He got into the boat with them ; and the wind ceased , and they were very amazed among themselves , and marveled ;

verses.z: 這是因為他們不明白那分餅的事，心裏還是愚頑。
verses.e: for they hadn't understood about the loaves , but their hearts were hardened .

verses.z: 既渡過去，來到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，
verses.e: When they had crossed over , they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore .

verses.z: 一下船，眾人認得是耶穌，
verses.e: When they had come out of the boat , immediately the people recognized him ,

verses.z: 就跑遍那一帶地方，聽見他在何處，便將有病的人用褥子抬到那裏。
verses.e: and ran around that whole region , and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was .

verses.z: 凡耶穌所到的地方，或村中，或城裏，或鄉間，他們都將病人放在街市上，求耶穌只容他們摸他的衣裳繸子；凡摸着的人就都好了。
verses.e: Wherever he entered — into villages , or into cities , or into the country — they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment ; and as many as touched him were made well .

verses.z: 他也詫異他們不信，就往周圍鄉村教訓人去了。
verses.e: He marveled because of their unbelief . He went around the villages teaching .

verses.z: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，差遣他們兩個兩個地出去，也賜給他們權柄，制伏污鬼；
verses.e: He called to himself the twelve , and began to send them out two by two ; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits .

verses.z: 並且囑咐他們：「行路的時候不要帶食物和口袋，腰袋裏也不要帶錢，除了柺杖以外，甚麼都不要帶；
verses.e: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey , except a staff only : no bread , no wallet , no money in their purse ,

verses.z: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿兩件褂子」；
verses.e: but to wear sandals , and not put on two tunics .

verses.z: 有法利賽人和幾個文士從耶路撒冷來，到耶穌那裏聚集。
verses.e: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him , having come from Jerusalem .

verses.z: 摩西說：『當孝敬父母』；又說：『咒罵父母的，必治死他。』
verses.e: For Moses said , ' Honor your father and your mother ; ' and , ' He who speaks evil of father or mother , let him be put to death . '

verses.z: 你們倒說：『人若對父母說：我所當奉給你的，已經作了各耳板』（各耳板就是供獻的意思），
verses.e: But you say , ' If a man tells his father or his mother , " Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban , " ' " that is to say , given to God ,

verses.z: 以後你們就不容他再奉養父母。
verses.e: " then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother ,

verses.z: 這就是你們承接遺傳，廢了上帝的道。你們還做許多這樣的事。」
verses.e: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down . You do many things like this . "

verses.z: 耶穌又叫眾人來，對他們說：「你們都要聽我的話，也要明白。
verses.e: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them , " Hear me , all of you , and understand .

verses.z: 從外面進去的不能污穢人，惟有從裏面出來的乃能污穢人。」
verses.e: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him ; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man .
If anyone has ears to hear , let him hear ! "

verses.z: 耶穌離開眾人，進了屋子，門徒就問他這比喻的意思。
verses.e: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude , his disciples asked him about the parable .

verses.z: 耶穌對他們說：「你們也是這樣不明白嗎？豈不曉得凡從外面進入的，不能污穢人，
verses.e: He said to them , " Are you also without understanding ? Don't you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can't defile him ,

verses.z: 因為不是入他的心，乃是入他的肚腹，又落到茅廁裏（[這是說]，各樣的食物都是潔淨的）」；
verses.e: because it doesn't go into his heart , but into his stomach , then into the latrine , making all foods clean ? "

verses.z: 他們曾看見他的門徒中有人用俗手，就是沒有洗的手，吃飯。（
verses.e: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled , that is unwashed , hands , they found fault .

verses.z: 又說：「從人裏面出來的，那才能污穢人；
verses.e: He said , " That which proceeds out of the man , that defiles the man .

verses.z: 因為從裏面，就是從人心裏，發出惡念、苟合、
verses.e: For from within , out of the hearts of men , proceed evil thoughts , adulteries , sexual sins , murders , thefts ,

verses.z: 偷盜、凶殺、姦淫、貪婪、邪惡、詭詐、淫蕩、嫉妒、謗讟、驕傲、狂妄。
verses.e: covetings , wickedness , deceit , lustful desires , an evil eye , blasphemy , pride , and foolishness .

verses.z: 這一切的惡都是從裏面出來，且能污穢人。」
verses.e: All these evil things come from within and defile the man . "

verses.z: 耶穌從那裏起身，往泰爾、西頓的境內去，進了一家，不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。
verses.e: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon . He entered into a house and didn't want anyone to know it , but he couldn't escape notice .

verses.z: 當下，有一個婦人，她的小女兒被污鬼附着，聽見耶穌的事，就來俯伏在他腳前。
verses.e: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit , having heard of him , came and fell down at his feet .

verses.z: 這婦人是希臘人，屬敘利腓尼基族。她求耶穌趕出那鬼離開她的女兒。
verses.e: Now the woman was a Greek , a Syrophoenician by race . She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter .

verses.z: 耶穌對她說：「讓兒女們先吃飽，不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。」
verses.e: But Jesus said to her , " Let the children be filled first , for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs . "

verses.z: 婦人回答說：「主啊，不錯；但是狗在桌子底下也吃孩子們的碎渣兒。」
verses.e: But she answered him , " Yes , Lord . Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs . "

verses.z: 耶穌對她說：「因這句話，你回去吧；鬼已經離開你的女兒了。」
verses.e: He said to her , " For this saying , go your way . The demon has gone out of your daughter . "

verses.z: 原來法利賽人和猶太人都拘守古人的遺傳，若不仔細洗手就不吃飯；
verses.e: ( For the Pharisees and all the Jews don't eat unless they wash their hands and forearms , holding to the tradition of the elders .

verses.z: 她就回家去，見小孩子躺在床上，鬼已經出去了。
verses.e: She went away to her house , and found the child having been laid on the bed , with the demon gone out .

verses.z: 耶穌又離了泰爾的境界，經過西頓，就從低加坡里境內來到加利利海。
verses.e: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon , and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis .

verses.z: 有人帶着一個耳聾舌結的人來見耶穌，求他按手在他身上。
verses.e: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech . They begged him to lay his hand on him .

verses.z: 耶穌領他離開眾人，到一邊去，就用指頭探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌頭，
verses.e: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears ; and he spat and touched his tongue .

verses.z: 望天歎息，對他說：「以法大！」就是說：「開了吧！」
verses.e: Looking up to heaven , he sighed , and said to him , " Ephphatha ! " that is , " Be opened ! "

verses.z: 他的耳朵就開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。
verses.e: Immediately his ears were opened , and the impediment of his tongue was released , and he spoke clearly .

verses.z: 耶穌囑咐他們不要告訴人；但他越發囑咐，他們越發傳揚開了。
verses.e: He commanded them that they should tell no one , but the more he commanded them , so much the more widely they proclaimed it .

verses.z: 眾人分外希奇，說：「他所做的事都好，他連聾子也叫他們聽見，啞巴也叫他們說話。」
verses.e: They were astonished beyond measure , saying , " He has done all things well . He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak ! "

verses.z: 從市上來，若不洗浴也不吃飯；還有好些別的規矩，他們歷代拘守，就是洗杯、罐、銅器[等物]。）
verses.e: They don't eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves , and there are many other things which they have received to hold to : washings of cups , pitchers , bronze vessels , and couches . )

verses.z: 法利賽人和文士問他說：「你的門徒為甚麼不照古人的遺傳，用俗手吃飯呢？」
verses.e: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him , " Why don't your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders , but eat their bread with unwashed hands ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「以賽亞指着你們假冒為善之人所說的預言是不錯的。如經上說：這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我。
verses.e: He answered them , " Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites , as it is written , ' This people honors me with their lips , but their heart is far from me .

verses.z: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人，所以拜我也是枉然。
verses.e: They worship me in vain , teaching as doctrines the commandments of men . '

verses.z: 你們是離棄上帝的誡命，拘守人的遺傳」；
verses.e: " For you set aside the commandment of God , and hold tightly to the tradition of men — the washing of pitchers and cups , and you do many other such things . "

verses.z: 又說：「你們誠然是廢棄上帝的誡命，要守自己的遺傳。
verses.e: He said to them , " Full well do you reject the commandment of God , that you may keep your tradition .

verses.z: 那時，又有許多人聚集，並沒有甚麼吃的。耶穌叫門徒來，說：
verses.e: In those days , when there was a very great multitude , and they had nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them ,

verses.z: 隨即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。
verses.e: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha .

verses.z: 法利賽人出來盤問耶穌，求他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看，想要試探他。
verses.e: The Pharisees came out and began to question him , seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him .

verses.z: 耶穌心裏深深地歎息，說：「這世代為甚麼求神蹟呢？我實在告訴你們，沒有神蹟給這世代看。」
verses.e: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said , " Why does this generation seek a sign ? Most certainly I tell you , no sign will be given to this generation . "

verses.z: 他就離開他們，又上[船]往海那邊去了。
verses.e: He left them , and again entering into the boat , departed to the other side .

verses.z: 門徒忘了帶餅；在船上除了一個餅，沒有別的食物。
verses.e: They forgot to take bread ; and they didn't have more than one loaf in the boat with them .

verses.z: 耶穌囑咐他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人的酵和希律的酵。」
verses.e: He warned them , saying , " Take heed : beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod . "

verses.z: 他們彼此議論說：「[這是因為]我們沒有餅吧。」
verses.e: They reasoned with one another , saying , " It's because we have no bread . "

verses.z: 耶穌看出來，就說：「你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論呢？你們還不省悟，還不明白嗎？你們的心還是愚頑嗎？
verses.e: Jesus , perceiving it , said to them , " Why do you reason that it's because you have no bread ? Don't you perceive yet or understand ? Is your heart still hardened ?

verses.z: 你們有眼睛，看不見嗎？有耳朵，聽不見嗎？也不記得嗎？
verses.e: Having eyes , don't you see ? Having ears , don't you hear ? Don't you remember ?

verses.z: 我擘開那五個餅分給五千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少籃子呢？」他們說：「十二個。」
verses.e: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand , how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up ? " They told him , " Twelve . "

verses.z: 「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。
verses.e: " I have compassion on the multitude , because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat .

verses.z: 「[又擘開]那七個餅分給四千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少筐子呢？」他們說：「七個。」
verses.e: " When the seven loaves fed the four thousand , how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up ? " They told him , " Seven . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「你們還是不明白嗎？」
verses.e: He asked them , " Don't you understand yet ? "

verses.z: 他們來到伯賽大，有人帶一個瞎子來，求耶穌摸他。
verses.e: He came to Bethsaida . They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him .

verses.z: 耶穌拉着瞎子的手，領他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他說：「你看見甚麼了？」
verses.e: He took hold of the blind man by the hand , and brought him out of the village . When he had spat on his eyes , and laid his hands on him , he asked him if he saw anything .

verses.z: 他就抬頭一看，說：「我看見人了；他們好像樹木，並且行走。」
verses.e: He looked up , and said , " I see men , but I see them like walking trees . "

verses.z: 隨後又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就復了原，樣樣都看得清楚了。
verses.e: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes . He looked intently , and was restored , and saw everyone clearly .

verses.z: 耶穌打發他回家，說：「連這村子你也不要進去。」
verses.e: He sent him away to his house , saying , " Don't enter into the village , nor tell anyone in the village . "

verses.z: 耶穌和門徒出去，往凱撒利亞‧腓立比村莊去；在路上問門徒說：「人說我是誰？」
verses.e: Jesus went out , with his disciples , into the villages of Caesarea Philippi . On the way he asked his disciples , " Who do men say that I am ? "

verses.z: 他們說：「[有人說]是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是先知裏的一位。」
verses.e: They told him , " John the Baptizer , and others say Elijah , but others , one of the prophets . "

verses.z: 又問他們說：「你們說我是誰？」彼得回答說：「你是基督。」
verses.e: He said to them , " But who do you say that I am ? " Peter answered , " You are the Christ . "

verses.z: 我若打發他們餓着回家，就必在路上困乏，因為其中有從遠處來的。」
verses.e: If I send them away fasting to their home , they will faint on the way , for some of them have come a long way . "

verses.z: 耶穌就禁戒他們，不要告訴人。
verses.e: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him .

verses.z: 從此，他教訓他們說：「人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，過三天復活。」
verses.e: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things , and be rejected by the elders , the chief priests , and the scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .

verses.z: 耶穌明明地說這話，彼得就拉着他，勸他。
verses.e: He spoke to them openly . Peter took him and began to rebuke him .

verses.z: 耶穌轉過來，看着門徒，就責備彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！因為你不體貼上帝的意思，只體貼人的意思。」
verses.e: But he , turning around and seeing his disciples , rebuked Peter , and said , " Get behind me , Satan ! For you have in mind not the things of God , but the things of men . "

verses.z: 於是叫眾人和門徒來，對他們說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
verses.e: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them , " Whoever wants to come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .

verses.z: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我和福音喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
verses.e: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it ; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it .

verses.z: 人就是賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life ?

verses.z: 人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
verses.e: For what will a man give in exchange for his life ?

verses.z: 凡在這淫亂罪惡的世代，把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在他父的榮耀裏，同聖天使降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。」
verses.e: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation , the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels . "

verses.z: 門徒回答說：「在這野地，從哪裏能得餅，叫這些人吃飽呢？」
verses.e: His disciples answered him , " From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place ? "

verses.z: 耶穌問他們說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「七個。」
verses.e: He asked them , " How many loaves do you have ? " They said , " Seven . "

verses.z: 他吩咐眾人坐在地上，就拿着這七個餅祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，門徒就擺在眾人面前。
verses.e: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground , and he took the seven loaves . Having given thanks , he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve , and they served the multitude .

verses.z: 又有幾條小魚；耶穌祝了福，就吩咐也擺在眾人面前。
verses.e: They also had a few small fish . Having blessed them , he said to serve these also .

verses.z: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
verses.e: They ate and were filled . They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over .

verses.z: 人數約有四千。耶穌打發他們走了，
verses.e: Those who had eaten were about four thousand . Then he sent them away .

verses.z: 耶穌又對他們說：「我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前，必要看見上帝的國大有能力臨到。」
verses.e: He said to them , " Most certainly I tell you , there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God's Kingdom come with power . "

verses.z: 門徒將這話存記在心，彼此議論「從死裏復活」是甚麼意思。
verses.e: They kept this saying to themselves , questioning what the " rising from the dead " meant .

verses.z: 他們就問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」
verses.e: They asked him , saying , " Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「以利亞固然先來復興萬事；[經上]不是指着人子說，他要受許多的苦被人輕慢呢？
verses.e: He said to them , " Elijah indeed comes first , and restores all things . How is it written about the Son of Man , that he should suffer many things and be despised ?

verses.z: 我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，他們也任意待他，正如[經上]所指着他的話。」
verses.e: But I tell you that Elijah has come , and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to , even as it is written about him . "

verses.z: 耶穌到了門徒那裏，看見有許多人圍着他們，又有文士和他們辯論。
verses.e: Coming to the disciples , he saw a great multitude around them , and scribes questioning them .

verses.z: 眾人一見耶穌，都甚希奇，就跑上去問他的安。
verses.e: Immediately all the multitude , when they saw him , were greatly amazed , and running to him , greeted him .

verses.z: 耶穌問他們說：「你們和他們辯論的是甚麼？」
verses.e: He asked the scribes , " What are you asking them ? "

verses.z: 眾人中間有一個人回答說：「夫子，我帶了我的兒子到你這裏來，他被啞巴鬼附着。
verses.e: One of the multitude answered , " Teacher , I brought to you my son , who has a mute spirit ;

verses.z: 無論在哪裏，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齒，身體枯乾。我請過你的門徒把鬼趕出去，他們卻是不能。」
verses.e: and wherever it seizes him , it throws him down ; and he foams at the mouth , grinds his teeth , and becomes rigid . I asked your disciples to cast it out , and they weren't able . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「噯！不信的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧。」
verses.e: He answered him , " Unbelieving generation , how long shall I be with you ? How long shall I bear with you ? Bring him to me . "

verses.z: 過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各、約翰暗暗地上了高山，就在他們面前變了形像，
verses.e: After six days Jesus took with him Peter , James , and John , and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves , and he was changed into another form in front of them .

verses.z: 他們就帶了他來。他一見耶穌，鬼便叫他重重地抽瘋，倒在地上，翻來覆去，口中流沫。
verses.e: They brought him to him , and when he saw him , immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground , wallowing and foaming at the mouth .

verses.z: 耶穌問他父親說：「他得這病有多少日子呢？」回答說：「從小的時候。
verses.e: He asked his father , " How long has it been since this has been happening to him ? " He said , " From childhood .

verses.z: 鬼屢次把他扔在火裏、水裏，要滅他。你若能做甚麼，求你憐憫我們，幫助我們。」
verses.e: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him . But if you can do anything , have compassion on us and help us . "

verses.z: 耶穌對他說：「你若能[信]，在信的人，凡事都能。」
verses.e: Jesus said to him , " If you can believe , all things are possible to him who believes . "

verses.z: 孩子的父親立時喊着說：「我信！但我信不足，求主幫助。」
verses.e: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears , " I believe . Help my unbelief ! "

verses.z: 耶穌看見眾人都跑上來，就斥責那污鬼，說：「你這聾啞的鬼，我吩咐你從他裏頭出來，再不要進去！」
verses.e: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together , he rebuked the unclean spirit , saying to him , " You mute and deaf spirit , I command you , come out of him , and never enter him again ! "

verses.z: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大地抽了一陣瘋，就出來了。[孩子]好像死了一般，以致眾人多半說：「他是死了。」
verses.e: After crying out and convulsing him greatly , it came out of him . The boy became like one dead , so much that most of them said , " He is dead . "

verses.z: 但耶穌拉着他的手，扶他起來，他就站起來了。
verses.e: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up ; and he arose .

verses.z: 耶穌進了屋子，門徒就暗暗地問他說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出他去呢？」
verses.e: When he had come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , " Why couldn't we cast it out ? "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「非用禱告，這一類的[鬼]總不能出來。」
verses.e: He said to them , " This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting . "

verses.z: 衣服放光，極其潔白，地上漂布的，沒有一個能漂得那樣白。
verses.e: His clothing became glistening , exceedingly white , like snow , such as no launderer on earth can whiten them .

verses.z: 他們離開那地方，經過加利利；耶穌不願意人知道。
verses.e: They went out from there and passed through Galilee . He didn't want anyone to know it ,

verses.z: 於是教訓門徒，說：「人子將要被交在人手裏，他們要殺害他；被殺以後，過三天他要復活。」
verses.e: for he was teaching his disciples , and said to them , " The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men , and they will kill him ; and when he is killed , on the third day he will rise again . "

verses.z: 門徒卻不明白這話，又不敢問他。
verses.e: But they didn't understand the saying , and were afraid to ask him .

verses.z: 他們來到迦百農。耶穌在屋裏問門徒說：「你們在路上議論的是甚麼？」
verses.e: He came to Capernaum , and when he was in the house he asked them , " What were you arguing among yourselves on the way ? "

verses.z: 門徒不作聲，因為他們在路上彼此爭論誰為大。
verses.e: But they were silent , for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest .

verses.z: 耶穌坐下，叫十二個門徒來，說：「若有人願意作首先的，他必作眾人末後的，作眾人的用人。」
verses.e: He sat down and called the twelve ; and he said to them , " If any man wants to be first , he shall be last of all , and servant of all . "

verses.z: 於是領過一個小孩子來，叫他站在門徒中間，又抱起他來，對他們說：
verses.e: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them . Taking him in his arms , he said to them ,

verses.z: 「凡為我名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我來的。」
verses.e: " Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me ; and whoever receives me , doesn't receive me , but him who sent me . "

verses.z: 約翰對耶穌說：「夫子，我們看見一個人奉你的名趕鬼，我們就禁止他，因為他不跟從我們。」
verses.e: John said to him , " Teacher , we saw someone who doesn't follow us casting out demons in your name ; and we forbade him , because he doesn't follow us . "

verses.z: 耶穌說：「不要禁止他；因為沒有人奉我名行異能，反倒輕易毀謗我。
verses.e: But Jesus said , " Don't forbid him , for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me .

verses.z: [忽然]，有以利亞同摩西向他們顯現，並且和耶穌說話。
verses.e: Elijah and Moses appeared to them , and they were talking with Jesus .

verses.z: 不敵擋我們的，就是幫助我們的。
verses.e: For whoever is not against us is on our side .

verses.z: 凡因你們是屬基督，給你們一杯水喝的，我實在告訴你們，他不能不得賞賜。」
verses.e: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ's , most certainly I tell you , he will in no way lose his reward .

verses.z: 「凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，扔在海裏。
verses.e: " Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble , it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck .

verses.z: 倘若你一隻手叫你跌倒，就把它砍下來；
verses.e: If your hand causes you to stumble , cut it off . It is better for you to enter into life maimed , rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna , into the unquenchable fire ,

verses.z: 你缺了肢體進入[永]生，強如有兩[隻]手落到地獄，入那不滅的火裏去。
verses.e: ' where their worm doesn't die , and the fire is not quenched . '

verses.z: 倘若你一隻腳叫你跌倒，就把它砍下來；
verses.e: If your foot causes you to stumble , cut it off . It is better for you to enter into life lame , rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna , into the fire that will never be quenched —

verses.z: 你瘸腿進入[永]生，強如有兩隻腳被丟在地獄裏。
verses.e: ' where their worm doesn't die , and the fire is not quenched . '

verses.z: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就去掉它；你只有一隻眼進入上帝的國，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄裏。
verses.e: If your eye causes you to stumble , throw it out . It is better for you to enter into God's Kingdom with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire ,

verses.z: 在那裏，蟲是不死的，火是不滅的。
verses.e: ' where their worm doesn't die , and the fire is not quenched . '

verses.z: 因為必用火當鹽醃各人。
verses.e: For everyone will be salted with fire , and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt .

verses.z: 彼得對耶穌說：「拉比，我們在這裏真好！可以搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」
verses.e: Peter answered Jesus , " Rabbi , it is good for us to be here . Let's make three tents : one for you , one for Moses , and one for Elijah . "

verses.z: 鹽本是好的，若失了味，可用甚麼叫它再鹹呢？你們裏頭應當有鹽，彼此和睦。」
verses.e: Salt is good , but if the salt has lost its saltiness , with what will you season it ? Have salt in yourselves , and be at peace with one another . "

verses.z: 彼得不知道說甚麼才好，因為他們甚是懼怕。
verses.e: For he didn't know what to say , for they were very afraid .

verses.z: 有一朵雲彩來遮蓋他們；也有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，你們要聽他。」
verses.e: A cloud came , overshadowing them , and a voice came out of the cloud , " This is my beloved Son . Listen to him . "

verses.z: 門徒忽然周圍一看，不再見一人，只見耶穌同他們在那裏。
verses.e: Suddenly looking around , they saw no one with them any more , except Jesus only .

verses.z: 下山的時候，耶穌囑咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」
verses.e: As they were coming down from the mountain , he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen , until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead .

verses.z: 論尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鴻所得的默示。
verses.e: A revelation about Nineveh . The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite .

verses.z: 你們像叢雜的荊棘，像喝醉了的人，又如枯乾的碎稭全然燒滅。
verses.e: For entangled like thorns , and drunken as with their drink , they are consumed utterly like dry stubble .

verses.z: 有一人從你那裏出來，圖謀邪惡，設惡計攻擊耶和華。
verses.e: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD , who counsels wickedness .

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：尼尼微雖然勢力充足，人數繁多，也被剪除，歸於無有。猶大啊，我雖然使你受苦，卻不再使你受苦。
verses.e: The LORD says : " Though they are in full strength and likewise many , even so they will be cut down and pass away . Though I have afflicted you , I will afflict you no more .

verses.z: 現在我必從你[頸項]上折斷他的軛，扭開他的繩索。
verses.e: Now I will break his yoke from off you , and will burst your bonds apart . "

verses.z: 耶和華已經出令，指着尼尼微說：你名下的人必不留後；我必從你神的廟中除滅雕刻的偶像和鑄造的偶像；我必因你鄙陋，使你歸於墳墓。
verses.e: The LORD has commanded concerning you : " No more descendants will bear your name . Out of the house of your gods , I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image . I will make your grave , for you are vile . "

verses.z: 看哪，有報好信傳平安之人的腳登山，[說]：猶大啊，可以守你的節期，還你所許的願吧！因為那惡人不再從你中間經過，他已滅絕淨盡了。
verses.e: Behold , on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news , who publishes peace ! Keep your feasts , Judah ! Perform your vows , for the wicked one will no more pass through you . He is utterly cut off .

verses.z: 耶和華是忌邪施報的上帝。耶和華施報大有忿怒；向他的敵人施報，向他的仇敵懷怒。
verses.e: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges . The LORD avenges and is full of wrath . The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries , and he maintains wrath against his enemies .

verses.z: 耶和華不輕易發怒，大有能力，萬不以[有罪的]為無罪。他乘旋風和暴風而來，雲彩為他腳下的塵土。
verses.e: The LORD is slow to anger , and great in power , and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished . The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm , and the clouds are the dust of his feet .

verses.z: 他斥責海，使海乾了，使一切江河乾涸。巴珊和迦密[的樹林]衰殘；黎巴嫩的花草也衰殘了。
verses.e: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry , and dries up all the rivers . Bashan and Carmel languish . The flower of Lebanon languishes .

verses.z: 大山因他震動；小山也都消化。大地在他面前突起；世界和住在其間的也都如此。
verses.e: The mountains quake before him , and the hills melt away . The earth trembles at his presence , yes , the world , and all who dwell in it .

verses.z: 他發忿恨，誰能立得住呢？他發烈怒，誰能當得起呢？他的忿怒如火傾倒；磐石因他崩裂。
verses.e: Who can stand before his indignation ? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger ? His wrath is poured out like fire , and the rocks are broken apart by him .

verses.z: 耶和華本為善，在患難的日子為人的保障，並且認得那些投靠他的人。
verses.e: The LORD is good , a stronghold in the day of trouble ; and he knows those who take refuge in him .

verses.z: 但他必以漲溢的洪水淹沒尼尼微，又驅逐仇敵進入黑暗。
verses.e: But with an overflowing flood , he will make a full end of her place , and will pursue his enemies into darkness .

verses.z: 尼尼微人哪，設何謀攻擊耶和華呢？他必[將你們]滅絕淨盡；災難不再興起。
verses.e: What do you plot against the LORD ? He will make a full end . Affliction won't rise up the second time .

verses.z: 尼尼微啊，那打碎[邦國]的上來攻擊你。你要看守保障，謹防道路，使腰強壯，大大勉力。（
verses.e: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you . Keep the fortress ! Watch the way ! Strengthen your waist ! Fortify your power mightily !

verses.z: 尼尼微現在空虛荒涼，人心消化，雙膝相碰，腰都疼痛，臉都變色。
verses.e: She is empty , void , and waste . The heart melts , the knees knock together , their bodies and faces have grown pale .

verses.z: 獅子的洞和少壯獅子餵養之處在哪裏呢？公獅母獅小獅遊行、無人驚嚇之地在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Where is the den of the lions , and the feeding place of the young lions , where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion's cubs , and no one made them afraid ?

verses.z: 公獅為小獅撕碎許多食物，為母獅掐死活物，把撕碎的、掐死的充滿牠的洞穴。
verses.e: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs , and strangled prey for his lionesses , and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我與你為敵，必將你的車輛焚燒成煙，刀劍也必吞滅你的少壯獅子。我必從地上除滅你所撕碎的，你使者的聲音必不再聽見。」
verses.e: " Behold , I am against you , " says the LORD of Armies , " and I will burn her chariots in the smoke , and the sword will devour your young lions ; and I will cut off your prey from the earth , and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard . "

verses.z: 耶和華復興雅各的榮華，好像以色列的榮華一樣；因為使地空虛的，已經使雅各和以色列空虛，將他們的葡萄枝毀壞了。）
verses.e: For the LORD restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel , for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches .

verses.z: 他勇士的盾牌是紅的，精兵都穿朱紅[衣服]。在他預備[爭戰]的日子，戰車上的鋼鐵閃爍如火，柏木把的[槍]也掄起來了。
verses.e: The shield of his mighty men is made red . The valiant men are in scarlet . The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation , and the pine spears are brandished .

verses.z: 車輛在街上急行，在寬闊處奔來奔去，形狀如火把，飛跑如閃電。
verses.e: The chariots rage in the streets . They rush back and forth in the wide ways . Their appearance is like torches . They run like the lightnings .

verses.z: 尼尼微王招聚他的貴冑；他們步行絆跌，速上城牆，預備擋牌。
verses.e: He summons his picked troops . They stumble on their way . They dash to its wall , and the protective shield is put in place .

verses.z: 河閘開放，宮殿沖沒。
verses.e: The gates of the rivers are opened , and the palace is dissolved .

verses.z: 王后蒙羞，被人擄去；宮女搥胸，哀鳴如鴿。此乃命定之事。
verses.e: It is decreed : she is uncovered , she is carried away ; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves , beating on their breasts .

verses.z: 尼尼微自古以來[充滿人民]，如同聚水的池子；現在居民卻都逃跑。[雖有人呼喊說]：站住！站住！卻無人回顧。
verses.e: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water , yet they flee away . " Stop ! Stop ! " they cry , but no one looks back .

verses.z: 你們搶掠金銀吧！因為所積蓄的無窮，華美的寶器無數。
verses.e: Take the plunder of silver . Take the plunder of gold , for there is no end of treasure , an abundance of every precious thing .

verses.z: 禍哉！這流人血的城，充滿謊詐和強暴－搶奪的事總不止息。
verses.e: Woe to the bloody city ! It is all full of lies and robbery — no end to the prey .

verses.z: 但她被遷移，被擄去；她的嬰孩在各市口上也被摔死。人為她的尊貴人拈鬮；她所有的大人都被鍊子鎖着。
verses.e: Yet was she carried away . She went into captivity . Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets , and they cast lots for her honorable men , and all her great men were bound in chains .

verses.z: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏，並因仇敵的緣故尋求避難所。
verses.e: You also will be drunken . You will be hidden . You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy .

verses.z: 你一切保障必像無花果樹上初熟的無花果，若一搖撼就落在想吃之人的口中。
verses.e: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs . If they are shaken , they fall into the mouth of the eater .

verses.z: 你地上的人民如同婦女；你國中的關口向仇敵敞開；你的門閂被火焚燒。
verses.e: Behold , your troops among you are women . The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies . The fire has devoured your bars .

verses.z: 你要打水預備受困；要堅固你的保障，踹土和泥，修補磚窯。
verses.e: Draw water for the siege . Strengthen your fortresses . Go into the clay , and tread the mortar . Make the brick kiln strong .

verses.z: 在那裏，火必燒滅你；刀必殺戮你，吞滅你如同蝻子。任你加增人數多如蝻子，多如蝗蟲吧！
verses.e: There the fire will devour you . The sword will cut you off . It will devour you like the grasshopper . Multiply like grasshoppers . Multiply like the locust .

verses.z: 你增添商賈，多過天上的星；蝻子吃盡而去。
verses.e: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies . The grasshopper strips and flees away .

verses.z: 你的首領多如蝗蟲；你的軍長彷彿成群的螞蚱，天涼的時候齊落在籬笆上，日頭一出便都飛去，人不知道落在何處。
verses.e: Your guards are like the locusts , and your officials like the swarms of locusts , which settle on the walls on a cold day , but when the sun appears , they flee away , and their place is not known where they are .

verses.z: 亞述王啊，你的牧人睡覺；你的貴冑安歇；你的人民散在山間，無人招聚。
verses.e: Your shepherds slumber , king of Assyria . Your nobles lie down . Your people are scattered on the mountains , and there is no one to gather them .

verses.z: 你的損傷無法醫治；你的傷痕極其重大。凡聽你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。你所行的惡誰沒有時常遭遇呢？
verses.e: There is no healing your wound , for your injury is fatal . All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you , for who hasn't felt your endless cruelty ?

verses.z: 鞭聲響亮，車輪轟轟，馬匹踢跳，車輛奔騰，
verses.e: The noise of the whip , the noise of the rattling of wheels , prancing horses , and bounding chariots ,

verses.z: 馬兵爭先，刀劍發光，槍矛閃爍，被殺的甚多，屍首成了大堆，屍骸無數，人碰着而跌倒，
verses.e: the horseman charging , and the flashing sword , the glittering spear , and a multitude of slain , and a great heap of corpses , and there is no end of the bodies . They stumble on their bodies

verses.z: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行，慣行邪術，藉淫行誘惑列國，用邪術誘惑多族。
verses.e: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute , the mistress of witchcraft , who sells nations through her prostitution , and families through her witchcraft .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：我與你為敵；我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你臉上，使列國看見你的赤體，使列邦觀看你的醜陋。
verses.e: " Behold , I am against you , " says the LORD of Armies , " and I will lift your skirts over your face . I will show the nations your nakedness , and the kingdoms your shame .

verses.z: 我必將可憎污穢之物拋在你身上，辱沒你，為眾目所觀。
verses.e: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile , and will make you a spectacle .

verses.z: 凡看見你的，都必逃跑離開你，說：尼尼微荒涼了！有誰為你悲傷呢？我何處尋得安慰你的人呢？
verses.e: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you , and say , ' Nineveh is laid waste ! Who will mourn for her ? ' Where will I seek comforters for you ? "

verses.z: 你豈比挪亞們強呢？挪亞們坐落在眾河之間，周圍有水；海作她的濠溝，又作她的城牆。
verses.e: Are you better than No-Amon , who was situated among the rivers , who had the waters around her , whose rampart was the sea , and her wall was of the sea ?

verses.z: 古實和埃及是她無窮的力量；弗人和路比族是她的幫手。
verses.e: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength . Put and Libya were her helpers .

verses.z: 哈迦利亞的兒子尼希米的言語如下：亞達薛西王二十年基斯流月，我在書珊城的宮中。
verses.e: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah . Now in the month Chislev , in the twentieth year , as I was in Susa the palace ,

verses.z: 這都是你的僕人、你的百姓，就是你用大力和大能的手所救贖的。
verses.e: " Now these are your servants and your people , whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand .

verses.z: 主啊，求你側耳聽你僕人的祈禱，和喜愛敬畏你名眾僕人的祈禱，使你僕人現今亨通，在王面前蒙恩。」我是作王酒政的。
verses.e: Lord , I beg you , let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant , and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name ; and please prosper your servant today , and grant him mercy in the sight of this man . " Now I was cup bearer to the king .

verses.z: 那時，有我一個弟兄哈拿尼，同着幾個人從猶大來。我問他們那些被擄歸回、剩下逃脫的猶大人和耶路撒冷的光景。
verses.e: Hanani , one of my brothers , came , he and certain men out of Judah ; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped , who were left of the captivity , and concerning Jerusalem .

verses.z: 他們對我說：「那些被擄歸回剩下的人在猶大省遭大難，受凌辱；並且耶路撒冷的城牆拆毀，城門被火焚燒。」
verses.e: They said to me , " The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach . The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down , and its gates are burned with fire . "

verses.z: 我聽見這話，就坐下哭泣，悲哀幾日，在天上的上帝面前禁食祈禱，說：
verses.e: When I heard these words , I sat down and wept , and mourned several days ; and I fasted and prayed before the God of heaven ,

verses.z: 「耶和華－天上的上帝，大而可畏的上帝啊，你向愛你、守你誡命的人守約施慈愛。
verses.e: and said , " I beg you , LORD , the God of heaven , the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments ,

verses.z: 願你睜眼看，側耳聽，你僕人晝夜在你面前為你眾僕人以色列民的祈禱，承認我們以色列人向你所犯的罪；我與我父家都有罪了。
verses.e: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open , that you may listen to the prayer of your servant which I pray before you at this time , day and night , for the children of Israel your servants , while I confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you . Yes , I and my father's house have sinned .

verses.z: 我們向你所行的甚是邪惡，沒有遵守你藉着僕人摩西所吩咐的誡命、律例、典章。
verses.e: We have dealt very corruptly against you , and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the ordinances , which you commanded your servant Moses .

verses.z: 求你記念所吩咐你僕人摩西的話，說：『你們若犯罪，我就把你們分散在萬民中；
verses.e: " Remember , I beg you , the word that you commanded your servant Moses , saying , ' If you trespass , I will scatter you among the peoples ;

verses.z: 但你們若歸向我，謹守遵行我的誡命，你們被趕散的人雖在天涯，我也必從那裏將他們招聚回來，帶到我所選擇立為我名的居所。』
verses.e: but if you return to me , and keep my commandments and do them , though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens , yet I will gather them from there , and will bring them to the place that I have chosen , to cause my name to dwell there . '

verses.z: 簽名的是：哈迦利亞的兒子－省長尼希米，和西底家；
verses.e: Now those who sealed were : Nehemiah the governor , the son of Hacaliah , and Zedekiah ,

verses.z: 還有他們的弟兄示巴尼、荷第雅、基利他、毗萊雅、哈難、
verses.e: and their brothers , Shebaniah , Hodiah , Kelita , Pelaiah , Hanan ,

verses.z: 米迦、利合、哈沙比雅、
verses.e: Mica , Rehob , Hashabiah ,

verses.z: 撒刻、示利比、示巴尼、
verses.e: Zaccur , Sherebiah , Shebaniah ,

verses.z: 荷第雅、巴尼、比尼努；
verses.e: Hodiah , Bani , and Beninu .

verses.z: 又有民的首領，就是巴錄、巴哈‧摩押、以攔、薩土、巴尼、
verses.e: The chiefs of the people : Parosh , Pahathmoab , Elam , Zattu , Bani ,

verses.z: 布尼、押甲、比拜、
verses.e: Bunni , Azgad , Bebai ,

verses.z: 亞多尼雅、比革瓦伊、亞丁、
verses.e: Adonijah , Bigvai , Adin ,

verses.z: 亞特、希西家、押朔、
verses.e: Ater , Hezekiah , Azzur ,

verses.z: 荷第雅、哈順、比賽、
verses.e: Hodiah , Hashum , Bezai ,

verses.z: 哈拉、亞拿突、尼拜、
verses.e: Hariph , Anathoth , Nobai ,

verses.z: 祭司：西萊雅、亞撒利雅、耶利米、
verses.e: Seraiah , Azariah , Jeremiah ,

verses.z: 抹比押、米書蘭、希悉、
verses.e: Magpiash , Meshullam , Hezir ,

verses.z: 米示薩別、撒督、押杜亞、
verses.e: Meshezabel , Zadok , Jaddua ,

verses.z: 毗拉提、哈難、亞奈雅、
verses.e: Pelatiah , Hanan , Anaiah ,

verses.z: 何細亞、哈拿尼雅、哈述、
verses.e: Hoshea , Hananiah , Hasshub ,

verses.z: 哈羅黑、毗利哈、朔百、
verses.e: Hallohesh , Pilha , Shobek ,

verses.z: 利宏、哈沙拿、瑪西雅、
verses.e: Rehum , Hashabnah , Maaseiah ,

verses.z: 亞希雅、哈難、亞難、
verses.e: Ahiah , Hanan , Anan ,

verses.z: 瑪鹿、哈琳、巴拿。
verses.e: Malluch , Harim , and Baanah .

verses.z: 其餘的民、祭司、利未人、守門的、歌唱的、尼提寧，和一切離絕鄰邦居民歸服上帝律法的，並他們的妻子、兒女，凡有知識能明白的，
verses.e: The rest of the people , the priests , the Levites , the gatekeepers , the singers , the temple servants , and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God , their wives , their sons , and their daughters — everyone who had knowledge and understanding —

verses.z: 都隨從他們貴冑的弟兄，發咒起誓，必遵行上帝藉他僕人摩西所傳的律法，謹守遵行耶和華－我們主的一切誡命、典章、律例；
verses.e: joined with their brothers , their nobles , and entered into a curse and into an oath , to walk in God's law , which was given by Moses the servant of God , and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord , and his ordinances and his statutes ;

verses.z: 巴施戶珥、亞瑪利雅、瑪基雅、
verses.e: Pashhur , Amariah , Malchijah ,

verses.z: 並不將我們的女兒嫁給這地的居民，也不為我們的兒子娶他們的女兒。
verses.e: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land , nor take their daughters for our sons ;

verses.z: 這地的居民若在安息日，或甚麼聖日，帶了貨物或糧食來賣給我們，我們必不買。每逢第七年必不耕種，凡欠我們債的必不追討。
verses.e: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell , that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath , or on a holy day ; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt .

verses.z: 我們又為自己定例，每年各人捐銀一舍客勒三分之一，為我們上帝殿的使用，
verses.e: Also we made ordinances for ourselves , to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God :

verses.z: 就是為陳設餅、常獻的素祭，和燔祭，安息日、月朔、節期所獻的與聖物，並以色列人的贖罪祭，以及我們上帝殿裏一切的費用。
verses.e: for the show bread , for the continual meal offering , for the continual burnt offering , for the Sabbaths , for the new moons , for the set feasts , for the holy things , for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel , and for all the work of the house of our God .

verses.z: 我們的祭司、利未人，和百姓都掣籤，看每年是哪一族按定期將[獻祭的]柴奉到我們上帝的殿裏，照着律法上所寫的，燒在耶和華－我們上帝的壇上。
verses.e: We , the priests , the Levites , and the people , cast lots for the wood offering , to bring it into the house of our God , according to our fathers ' houses , at times appointed year by year , to burn on the LORD our God's altar , as it is written in the law ;

verses.z: 又定每年將我們地上初熟的土產和各樣樹上初熟的果子都奉到耶和華的殿裏。
verses.e: and to bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees , year by year , to the LORD's house ;

verses.z: 又照律法上所寫的，將我們頭胎的兒子和首生的牛羊都奉到我們上帝的殿，交給我們上帝殿裏供職的祭司；
verses.e: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock , as it is written in the law , and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks , to bring to the house of our God , to the priests who minister in the house of our God ;

verses.z: 並將初熟之麥子所磨的麵和舉祭、各樣樹上[初熟]的果子、新酒與油奉給祭司，收在我們上帝殿的庫房裏，把我們地上所產的十分之一奉給利未人，因利未人在我們一切城邑的土產中當取十分之一。
verses.e: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough , our wave offerings , the fruit of all kinds of trees , and the new wine and the oil , to the priests , to the rooms of the house of our God ; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites ; for they , the Levites , take the tithes in all our farming villages .

verses.z: 利未人取十分之一的時候，亞倫的子孫中，當有一個祭司與利未人同在。利未人也當從十分之一中取十分之一，奉到我們上帝殿的屋子裏，收在庫房中。
verses.e: The priest , the descendent of Aaron , shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes . The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God , to the rooms , into the treasure house .

verses.z: 以色列人和利未人要將五穀、新酒，和油為舉祭，奉到收存聖所器皿的屋子裏，就是供職的祭司、守門的、歌唱的所住的屋子。這樣，我們就不離棄我們上帝的殿。
verses.e: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain , of the new wine , and of the oil , to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are , and the priests who minister , with the gatekeepers and the singers . We will not forsake the house of our God .

verses.z: 哈突、示巴尼、瑪鹿、
verses.e: Hattush , Shebaniah , Malluch ,

verses.z: 哈琳、米利末、俄巴底亞、
verses.e: Harim , Meremoth , Obadiah ,

verses.z: 但以理、近頓、巴錄、
verses.e: Daniel , Ginnethon , Baruch ,

verses.z: 米書蘭、亞比雅、米雅民、
verses.e: Meshullam , Abijah , Mijamin ,

verses.z: 瑪西亞、璧該、示瑪雅；
verses.e: Maaziah , Bilgai , and Shemaiah . These were the priests .

verses.z: 又有利未人，就是亞散尼的兒子耶書亞、希拿達的子孫賓內、甲篾；
verses.e: The Levites : Jeshua the son of Azaniah , Binnui of the sons of Henadad , Kadmiel ;

verses.z: 百姓的首領住在耶路撒冷。其餘的百姓掣籤，每十人中使一人來住在聖城耶路撒冷，那九人住在[別的]城邑。
verses.e: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem . The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem , the holy city , and nine parts in the other cities .

verses.z: 祭司中有雅斤，又有約雅立的兒子耶大雅；
verses.e: Of the priests : Jedaiah the son of Joiarib , Jachin ,

verses.z: 還有管理上帝殿的西萊雅。西萊雅是希勒家的兒子；希勒家是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是撒督的兒子；撒督是米拉約的兒子；米拉約是亞希突的兒子。
verses.e: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah , the son of Meshullam , the son of Zadok , the son of Meraioth , the son of Ahitub , the ruler of God's house ,

verses.z: 還有他們的弟兄在殿裏供職的，共八百二十二名；又有耶羅罕的兒子亞大雅。耶羅罕是毗拉利的兒子；毗拉利是暗洗的兒子；暗洗是撒迦利亞的兒子；撒迦利亞是巴施戶珥的兒子；巴施戶珥是瑪基雅的兒子。
verses.e: and their brothers who did the work of the house , eight hundred twenty-two ; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham , the son of Pelaliah , the son of Amzi , the son of Zechariah , the son of Pashhur , the son of Malchijah ,

verses.z: 還有他的弟兄作族長的，二百四十二名；又有亞薩列的兒子亞瑪帥。亞薩列是亞哈賽的兒子；亞哈賽是米實利末的兒子；米實利末是音麥的兒子。
verses.e: and his brothers , chiefs of fathers ' households , two hundred forty-two ; and Amashsai the son of Azarel , the son of Ahzai , the son of Meshillemoth , the son of Immer ,

verses.z: 還有他們弟兄、大能的勇士共一百二十八名。哈基多琳的兒子撒巴第業是他們的長官。
verses.e: and their brothers , mighty men of valor , one hundred twenty-eight ; and their overseer was Zabdiel , the son of Haggedolim .

verses.z: 利未人中有哈述的兒子示瑪雅。哈述是押利甘的兒子；押利甘是哈沙比雅的兒子；哈沙比雅是布尼的兒子。
verses.e: Of the Levites : Shemaiah the son of Hasshub , the son of Azrikam , the son of Hashabiah , the son of Bunni ;

verses.z: 又有利未人的族長沙比太和約撒拔管理上帝殿的外事。
verses.e: and Shabbethai and Jozabad , of the chiefs of the Levites , who had the oversight of the outward business of God's house ;

verses.z: 祈禱的時候，為稱謝領首的是米迦的兒子瑪他尼。米迦是撒底的兒子；撒底是亞薩的兒子；又有瑪他尼弟兄中的八布迦為副。還有沙母亞的兒子押大。沙母亞是加拉的兒子；加拉是耶杜頓的兒子。
verses.e: and Mattaniah the son of Mica , the son of Zabdi , the son of Asaph , who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer , and Bakbukiah , the second among his brothers ; and Abda the son of Shammua , the son of Galal , the son of Jeduthun .

verses.z: 在聖城的利未人共二百八十四名。
verses.e: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four .

verses.z: 守門的是亞谷和達們，並守門的弟兄，共一百七十二名。
verses.e: Moreover the gatekeepers , Akkub , Talmon , and their brothers , who kept watch at the gates , were one hundred seventy-two .

verses.z: 凡甘心樂意住在耶路撒冷的，百姓都為他們祝福。
verses.e: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 其餘的以色列人、祭司、利未人都住在猶大的一切城邑，各在自己的地業中。
verses.e: The residue of Israel , of the priests , and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah , everyone in his inheritance .

verses.z: 尼提寧卻住在俄斐勒；西哈和基斯帕管理他們。
verses.e: But the temple servants lived in Ophel ; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷、利未人的長官，管理上帝殿事務的是歌唱者亞薩的子孫、巴尼的兒子烏西。巴尼是哈沙比雅的兒子；哈沙比雅是瑪他尼的兒子；瑪他尼是米迦的兒子。
verses.e: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani , the son of Hashabiah , the son of Mattaniah , the son of Mica , of the sons of Asaph , the singers responsible for the service of God's house .

verses.z: 王為歌唱的出命令，每日供給他們必有一定之糧。
verses.e: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them , and a settled provision for the singers , as every day required .

verses.z: 猶大兒子謝拉的子孫、米示薩別的兒子毗他希雅輔助王辦理猶大民的事。
verses.e: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel , of the children of Zerah the son of Judah , was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people .

verses.z: 至於村莊和屬村莊的田地，有猶大人住在基列‧亞巴和屬基列‧亞巴的鄉村；底本和屬底本的鄉村；葉甲薛和屬葉甲薛的村莊；
verses.e: As for the villages with their fields , some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns , in Dibon and its towns , in Jekabzeel and its villages ,

verses.z: 耶書亞、摩拉大、伯‧帕列、
verses.e: in Jeshua , in Moladah , Beth Pelet ,

verses.z: 哈薩‧書亞、別是巴，和屬別是巴的鄉村；
verses.e: in Hazar Shual , in Beersheba and its towns ,

verses.z: 洗革拉、米哥拿，和屬米哥拿的鄉村；
verses.e: in Ziklag , in Meconah and in its towns ,

verses.z: 音‧臨門、瑣拉、耶末、
verses.e: in En Rimmon , in Zorah , in Jarmuth ,

verses.z: 以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提寧，和所羅門僕人的後裔都住在猶大城邑，各在自己的地業中。本省的首領住在耶路撒冷的記在下面：
verses.e: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem ; but in the cities of Judah , everyone lived in his possession in their cities — Israel , the priests , the Levites , the temple servants , and the children of Solomon's servants .

verses.z: 撒挪亞、亞杜蘭，和屬這兩處的村莊；拉吉和屬拉吉的田地；亞西加和屬亞西加的鄉村。他們所住的地方是從別是巴直到欣嫩谷。
verses.e: Zanoah , Adullam , and their villages , Lachish and its fields , and Azekah and its towns . So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom .

verses.z: 便雅憫人從迦巴起，住在密抹、亞雅、伯特利和屬伯特利的鄉村。
verses.e: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward , at Michmash and Aija , and at Bethel and its towns ,

verses.z: 亞拿突、挪伯、亞難雅、
verses.e: at Anathoth , Nob , Ananiah ,

verses.z: 夏瑣、拉瑪、基他音、
verses.e: Hazor , Ramah , Gittaim ,

verses.z: 哈疊、洗編、尼八拉、
verses.e: Hadid , Zeboim , Neballat ,

verses.z: 羅德、阿挪、匠人之谷。
verses.e: Lod , and Ono , the valley of craftsmen .

verses.z: 利未人中有幾班曾住在猶大地歸於便雅憫的。
verses.e: Of the Levites , certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin's territory .

verses.z: 其中有些猶大人和便雅憫人。猶大人中有法勒斯的子孫、烏西雅的兒子亞他雅。烏西雅是撒迦利雅的兒子；撒迦利雅是亞瑪利雅的兒子；亞瑪利雅是示法提雅的兒子；示法提雅是瑪勒列的兒子。
verses.e: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem . Of the children of Judah : Athaiah the son of Uzziah , the son of Zechariah , the son of Amariah , the son of Shephatiah , the son of Mahalalel , of the children of Perez ;

verses.z: 又有巴錄的兒子瑪西雅。巴錄是谷何西的兒子；谷何西是哈賽雅的兒子；哈賽雅是亞大雅的兒子；亞大雅是約雅立的兒子；約雅立是撒迦利雅的兒子；撒迦利雅是示羅尼的兒子。
verses.e: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch , the son of Colhozeh , the son of Hazaiah , the son of Adaiah , the son of Joiarib , the son of Zechariah , the son of the Shilonite .

verses.z: 住在耶路撒冷、法勒斯的子孫共四百六十八名，都是勇士。
verses.e: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men .

verses.z: 便雅憫人中有米書蘭的兒子撒路。米書蘭是約葉的兒子；約葉是毗大雅的兒子；毗大雅是哥賴雅的兒子；哥賴雅是瑪西雅的兒子；瑪西雅是以鐵的兒子；以鐵是耶篩亞的兒子。
verses.e: These are the sons of Benjamin : Sallu the son of Meshullam , the son of Joed , the son of Pedaiah , the son of Kolaiah , the son of Maaseiah , the son of Ithiel , the son of Jeshaiah .

verses.z: 其次有迦拜、撒來[的子孫]，共九百二十八名。
verses.e: After him Gabbai and Sallai , nine hundred twenty-eight .

verses.z: 細基利的兒子約珥是他們的長官。哈西努亞的兒子猶大是耶路撒冷的副官。
verses.e: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer ; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city .

verses.z: 同着撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和耶書亞回來的祭司與利未人記在下面：祭司是西萊雅、耶利米、以斯拉、
verses.e: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua : Seraiah , Jeremiah , Ezra ,

verses.z: 耶書亞生約雅金；約雅金生以利亞實；以利亞實生耶何耶大；
verses.e: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim , and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib , and Eliashib became the father of Joiada ,

verses.z: 耶何耶大生約拿單；約拿單生押杜亞。
verses.e: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan , and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua .

verses.z: 在約雅金的時候，祭司作族長的西萊雅族有米拉雅；耶利米族有哈拿尼雅；
verses.e: In the days of Joiakim were priests , heads of fathers ' households : of Seraiah , Meraiah ; of Jeremiah , Hananiah ;

verses.z: 以斯拉族有米書蘭；亞瑪利雅族有約哈難；
verses.e: of Ezra , Meshullam ; of Amariah , Jehohanan ;

verses.z: 米利古族有約拿單；示巴尼族有約瑟；
verses.e: of Malluchi , Jonathan ; of Shebaniah , Joseph ;

verses.z: 哈琳族有押拿；米拉約族有希勒愷；
verses.e: of Harim , Adna ; of Meraioth , Helkai ;

verses.z: 易多族有撒迦利亞；近頓族有米書蘭；
verses.e: of Iddo , Zechariah ; of Ginnethon , Meshullam ;

verses.z: 亞比雅族有細基利；米拿民族[某]；摩亞底族有毗勒太；
verses.e: of Abijah , Zichri ; of Miniamin , of Moadiah , Piltai ;

verses.z: 璧迦族有沙母亞；示瑪雅族有約拿單；
verses.e: of Bilgah , Shammua ; of Shemaiah , Jehonathan ;

verses.z: 約雅立族有瑪特乃；耶大雅族有烏西；
verses.e: of Joiarib , Mattenai ; of Jedaiah , Uzzi ;

verses.z: 亞瑪利雅、瑪鹿、哈突、
verses.e: Amariah , Malluch , Hattush ,

verses.z: 撒來族有加萊；亞木族有希伯；
verses.e: of Sallai , Kallai ; of Amok , Eber ;

verses.z: 希勒家族有哈沙比雅；耶大雅族有拿坦業。
verses.e: of Hilkiah , Hashabiah ; of Jedaiah , Nethanel .

verses.z: 至於利未人，當以利亞實、耶何耶大、約哈難、押杜亞的時候，他們的族長記在冊上。波斯王大流士在位的時候，[作族長的]祭司也記在冊上。
verses.e: As for the Levites , in the days of Eliashib , Joiada , Johanan , and Jaddua , there were recorded the heads of fathers ' households ; also the priests , in the reign of Darius the Persian .

verses.z: 利未人作族長的記在歷史上，直到以利亞實的兒子約哈難的時候。
verses.e: The sons of Levi , heads of fathers ' households , were written in the book of the chronicles , even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib .

verses.z: 利未人的族長是哈沙比雅、示利比、甲篾的兒子耶書亞，與他們弟兄的班次相對，照着神人大衛的命令一班一班地讚美稱謝。
verses.e: The chiefs of the Levites : Hashabiah , Sherebiah , and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel , with their brothers close to them , to praise and give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God , section next to section .

verses.z: 瑪他尼、八布迦、俄巴底亞、米書蘭、達們、亞谷是守門的，就是在庫房那裏守門。
verses.e: Mattaniah , Bakbukiah , Obadiah , Meshullam , Talmon , and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates .

verses.z: 這都是在約撒達的孫子、耶書亞的兒子約雅金和省長尼希米，並祭司文士以斯拉的時候，[有職任的]。
verses.e: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua , the son of Jozadak , and in the days of Nehemiah the governor , and of Ezra the priest and scribe .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷城牆告成的時候，眾民就把各處的利未人招到耶路撒冷，要稱謝、歌唱、敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，歡歡喜喜地行告成之禮。
verses.e: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem , they sought the Levites out of all their places , to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness , both with giving thanks and with singing , with cymbals , stringed instruments , and with harps .

verses.z: 歌唱的人從耶路撒冷的周圍和尼陀法的村莊與伯‧吉甲，又從迦巴和押瑪弗的田地聚集，因為歌唱的人在耶路撒冷四圍為自己立了村莊。
verses.e: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together , both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites ;
also from Beth Gilgal and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth , for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem .

verses.z: 示迦尼、利宏、米利末、
verses.e: Shecaniah , Rehum , Meremoth ,

verses.z: 祭司和利未人就潔淨自己，也潔淨百姓和城門，並城牆。
verses.e: The priests and the Levites purified themselves ; and they purified the people , the gates , and the wall .

verses.z: 我帶猶大的首領上城，使稱謝的人分為兩大隊，排列而行：第一隊在城上往右邊向糞廠門行走，
verses.e: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall , and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession . One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate ;

verses.z: 在他們後頭的有何沙雅與猶大首領的一半，
verses.e: and after them went Hoshaiah , with half of the princes of Judah ,

verses.z: 又有亞撒利雅、以斯拉、米書蘭、
verses.e: and Azariah , Ezra , and Meshullam ,

verses.z: 猶大、便雅憫、示瑪雅、耶利米。
verses.e: Judah , Benjamin , Shemaiah , Jeremiah ,

verses.z: 還有些吹號之祭司的子孫，約拿單的兒子撒迦利亞。約拿單是示瑪雅的兒子；示瑪雅是瑪他尼的兒子；瑪他尼是米該亞的兒子；米該亞是撒刻的兒子；撒刻是亞薩的兒子；
verses.e: and some of the priests ' sons with trumpets : Zechariah the son of Jonathan , the son of Shemaiah , the son of Mattaniah , the son of Micaiah , the son of Zaccur , the son of Asaph ;

verses.z: 又有撒迦利亞的弟兄示瑪雅、亞撒利、米拉萊、基拉萊、瑪艾、拿坦業、猶大、哈拿尼，都拿着神人大衛的樂器，文士以斯拉引領他們。
verses.e: and his brothers , Shemaiah , Azarel , Milalai , Gilalai , Maai , Nethanel , Judah , and Hanani , with the musical instruments of David the man of God ; and Ezra the scribe was before them .

verses.z: 他們經過泉門往前，從大衛城的臺階隨地勢而上，在大衛宮殿以上，直行到朝東的水門。
verses.e: By the spring gate , and straight before them , they went up by the stairs of David's city , at the ascent of the wall , above David's house , even to the water gate eastward .

verses.z: 第二隊稱謝的人要與那一隊相迎而行。我和民的一半跟隨他們，在城牆上過了爐樓，直到寬牆；
verses.e: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them , and I after them , with the half of the people on the wall above the tower of the furnaces , even to the wide wall ,

verses.z: 又過了以法蓮門、古門、魚門、哈楠業樓、哈米亞樓，直到羊門，就在護衛門站住。
verses.e: and above the gate of Ephraim , and by the old gate , and by the fish gate , the tower of Hananel , and the tower of Hammeah , even to the sheep gate ; and they stood still in the gate of the guard .

verses.z: 易多、近頓、亞比雅、
verses.e: Iddo , Ginnethoi , Abijah ,

verses.z: 於是，這兩隊稱謝的人連我和官長的一半，站在上帝的殿裏。
verses.e: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God's house stood , and I and the half of the rulers with me ;

verses.z: 還有祭司以利亞金、瑪西雅、米拿民、米該亞、以利約乃、撒迦利亞、哈楠尼亞吹號；
verses.e: and the priests , Eliakim , Maaseiah , Miniamin , Micaiah , Elioenai , Zechariah , and Hananiah , with trumpets ;

verses.z: 又有瑪西雅、示瑪雅、以利亞撒、烏西、約哈難、瑪基雅、以攔，和以謝[奏樂]。歌唱的就大聲歌唱，伊斯拉希雅管理他們。
verses.e: and Maaseiah , Shemaiah , Eleazar , Uzzi , Jehohanan , Malchijah , Elam , and Ezer . The singers sang loud , with Jezrahiah their overseer .

verses.z: 那日，眾人獻大祭而歡樂；因為上帝使他們大大歡樂，連婦女帶孩童也都歡樂，甚至耶路撒冷中的歡聲聽到遠處。
verses.e: They offered great sacrifices that day , and rejoiced , for God had made them rejoice with great joy ; and the women and the children also rejoiced , so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away .

verses.z: 當日，派人管理庫房，將舉祭、初熟之物和所取的十分之一，就是按各城田地，照律法所定歸給祭司和利未人的分，都收在裏頭。猶大人因祭司和利未人供職，就歡樂了。
verses.e: On that day , men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures , for the wave offerings , for the first fruits , and for the tithes , to gather into them according to the fields of the cities the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites ; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who served .

verses.z: 祭司利未人遵守上帝所吩咐的，並守潔淨的禮。歌唱的、守門的，照着大衛和他兒子所羅門的命令[也如此行]。
verses.e: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification , and so did the singers and the gatekeepers , according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son .

verses.z: 古時，在大衛和亞薩的日子，有歌唱的伶長，並有讚美稱謝上帝的詩歌。
verses.e: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers , and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God .

verses.z: 當所羅巴伯和尼希米的時候，以色列眾人將歌唱的、守門的，每日所當得的分供給他們，又給利未人當得的分；利未人又給亞倫的子孫當得的分。
verses.e: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers , as every day required ; and they set apart that which was for the Levites ; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron .

verses.z: 米雅民、瑪底雅、璧迦、
verses.e: Mijamin , Maadiah , Bilgah ,

verses.z: 示瑪雅、約雅立、耶大雅、
verses.e: Shemaiah , Joiarib , Jedaiah ,

verses.z: 撒路、亞木、希勒家、耶大雅。這些人在耶書亞的時候作祭司和他們弟兄的首領。
verses.e: Sallu , Amok , Hilkiah , and Jedaiah . These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua .

verses.z: 利未人是耶書亞、賓內、甲篾、示利比、猶大、瑪他尼。這瑪他尼和他的弟兄管理稱謝的事。
verses.e: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua , Binnui , Kadmiel , Sherebiah , Judah , and Mattaniah , who was over the thanksgiving songs , he and his brothers .

verses.z: 他們的弟兄八布迦和烏尼照自己的班次與他們相對。
verses.e: Also Bakbukiah and Unno , their brothers , were close to them according to their offices .

verses.z: 當日，人念摩西的[律法]書給百姓聽，遇見書上寫着說，亞捫人和摩押人永不可入上帝的會；
verses.e: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people ; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever ,

verses.z: 我見利未人所當得的分無人供給他們，甚至供職的利未人與歌唱的俱各奔回自己的田地去了。
verses.e: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them , so that the Levites and the singers , who did the work , had each fled to his field .

verses.z: 我就斥責官長說：「為何離棄上帝的殿呢？」我便招聚利未人，使他們照舊供職。
verses.e: Then I contended with the rulers , and said , " Why is God's house forsaken ? " I gathered them together , and set them in their place .

verses.z: 猶大眾人就把五穀、新酒，和油的十分之一送入庫房。
verses.e: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain , the new wine , and the oil to the treasuries .

verses.z: 我派祭司示利米雅、文士撒督，和利未人毗大雅作庫官管理庫房；副官是哈難。哈難是撒刻的兒子；撒刻是瑪他尼的兒子。這些人都是忠信的，他們的職分是將[所供給的]分給他們的弟兄。
verses.e: I made treasurers over the treasuries , Shelemiah the priest , and Zadok the scribe , and of the Levites , Pedaiah : and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur , the son of Mattaniah ; for they were counted faithful , and their business was to distribute to their brothers .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，求你因這事記念我，不要塗抹我為上帝的殿與其中的禮節所行的善。
verses.e: Remember me , my God , concerning this , and don't wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for its observances .

verses.z: 那些日子，我在猶大見有人在安息日醡酒，搬運禾捆馱在驢上，又把酒、葡萄、無花果，和各樣的擔子在安息日擔入耶路撒冷，我就在他們賣食物的那日警戒他們。
verses.e: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah , bringing in sheaves , and loading donkeys with wine , grapes , figs , and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day ; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food .

verses.z: 又有泰爾人住在耶路撒冷；他們把魚和各樣貨物運進來，在安息日賣給猶大人。
verses.e: Some men of Tyre also lived there , who brought in fish and all kinds of wares , and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 我就斥責猶大的貴冑說：「你們怎麼行這惡事犯了安息日呢？
verses.e: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah , and said to them , " What evil thing is this that you do , and profane the Sabbath day ?

verses.z: 從前你們列祖豈不是這樣行，以致我們上帝使一切災禍臨到我們和這城嗎？現在你們還犯安息日，使忿怒越發臨到以色列！」
verses.e: Didn't your fathers do this , and didn't our God bring all this evil on us and on this city ? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath . "

verses.z: 在安息日的前一日，耶路撒冷城門有黑影的時候，我就吩咐人將門關鎖，不過安息日不准開放。我又派我幾個僕人管理城門，免得有人在安息日擔甚麼擔子進城。
verses.e: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath , I commanded that the doors should be shut , and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath . I set some of my servants over the gates , so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day .

verses.z: 因為他們沒有拿食物和水來迎接以色列人，且雇了巴蘭咒詛他們，但我們的上帝使那咒詛變為祝福。
verses.e: because they didn't meet the children of Israel with bread and with water , but hired Balaam against them to curse them ; however , our God turned the curse into a blessing .

verses.z: 於是商人和販賣各樣貨物的，一兩次住宿在耶路撒冷城外。
verses.e: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice .

verses.z: 我就警戒他們說：「你們為何在城外住宿呢？若再這樣，我必下手拿辦你們。」從此以後，他們在安息日不再來了。
verses.e: Then I testified against them , and said to them , " Why do you stay around the wall ? If you do so again , I will lay hands on you . " From that time on , they didn't come on the Sabbath .

verses.z: 我吩咐利未人潔淨自己，來守城門，使安息日為聖。我的上帝啊，求你因這事記念我，照你的大慈愛憐恤我。
verses.e: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves , and that they should come and keep the gates , to sanctify the Sabbath day . Remember me for this also , my God , and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness .

verses.z: 那些日子，我也見猶大人娶了亞實突、亞捫、摩押的女子為妻。
verses.e: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod , of Ammon , and of Moab ;

verses.z: 他們的兒女說話，一半是亞實突的話，不會說猶大的話，所說的是照着各族的方言。
verses.e: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod , and could not speak in the Jews ' language , but according to the language of each people .

verses.z: 我就斥責他們，咒詛他們，打了他們幾個人，拔下他們的頭髮，叫他們指着上帝起誓，必不將自己的女兒嫁給外邦人的兒子，也不為自己和兒子娶他們的女兒。
verses.e: I contended with them , cursed them , struck certain of them , plucked off their hair , and made them swear by God , " You shall not give your daughters to their sons , nor take their daughters for your sons , or for yourselves .

verses.z: 我[又說]：「以色列王所羅門不是在這樣的事上犯罪嗎？在多國中並沒有一王像他，且蒙他上帝所愛，上帝立他作以色列全國的王；然而連他也被外邦女子引誘犯罪。
verses.e: Didn't Solomon king of Israel sin by these things ? Yet among many nations there was no king like him , and he was loved by his God , and God made him king over all Israel . Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin .

verses.z: 如此，我豈聽你們行這大惡，娶外邦女子干犯我們的上帝呢？」
verses.e: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil , to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women ? "

verses.z: 大祭司以利亞實的孫子、耶何耶大的一個兒子是和倫人參巴拉的女婿，我就從我這裏把他趕出去。
verses.e: One of the sons of Joiada , the son of Eliashib the high priest , was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite ; therefore I chased him from me .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，求你記念他們的罪；因為他們玷污了祭司的職任，違背你與祭司利未人所立的約。
verses.e: Remember them , my God , because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites .

verses.z: 以色列民聽見這律法，就與一切閒雜人絕交。
verses.e: It came to pass , when they had heard the law , that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel .

verses.z: 這樣，我潔淨他們，使他們離絕一切外邦人，派定祭司和利未人的班次，使他們各盡其職。
verses.e: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites , everyone in his work ;

verses.z: 我又派[百姓]按定期獻柴和初熟的土產。我的上帝啊，求你記念我，施恩與我。
verses.e: and for the wood offering , at appointed times , and for the first fruits . Remember me , my God , for good .

verses.z: 先是蒙派管理我們上帝殿中庫房的祭司以利亞實與多比雅結親，
verses.e: Now before this , Eliashib the priest , who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God , being allied to Tobiah ,

verses.z: 便為他預備一間大屋子，就是從前收存素祭、乳香、器皿，和照命令供給利未人、歌唱的、守門的五穀、新酒，和油的十分之一，並歸祭司舉祭的屋子。
verses.e: had prepared for him a great room , where before they laid the meal offerings , the frankincense , the vessels , and the tithes of the grain , the new wine , and the oil , which were given by commandment to the Levites , the singers , and the gatekeepers ; and the wave offerings for the priests .

verses.z: 那時我不在耶路撒冷；因為巴比倫王亞達薛西三十二年，我回到王那裏。過了多日，我向王告假。
verses.e: But in all this , I was not at Jerusalem ; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king ; and after some days I asked leave of the king ,

verses.z: 我來到耶路撒冷，就知道以利亞實為多比雅在上帝殿的院內預備屋子的那件惡事。
verses.e: and I came to Jerusalem , and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah , in preparing him a room in the courts of God's house .

verses.z: 我甚惱怒，就把多比雅的一切家具從屋裏都拋出去，
verses.e: It grieved me severely . Therefore I threw all Tobiah's household stuff out of the room .

verses.z: 吩咐人潔淨這屋子，遂將上帝殿的器皿和素祭、乳香又搬進去。
verses.e: Then I commanded , and they cleansed the rooms . I brought into them the vessels of God's house , with the meal offerings and the frankincense again .

verses.z: 亞達薛西王二十年尼散月，在王面前擺酒，我拿起酒來奉給王。我素來在王面前沒有愁容。
verses.e: In the month Nisan , in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king , when wine was before him , I picked up the wine , and gave it to the king . Now I had not been sad before in his presence .

verses.z: 和倫人參巴拉，並為奴的亞捫人多比雅，聽見有人來為以色列人求好處，就甚惱怒。
verses.e: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it , it grieved them exceedingly , because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 我到了耶路撒冷，在那裏住了三日。
verses.e: So I came to Jerusalem , and was there three days .

verses.z: 我夜間起來，有幾個人也一同起來；但上帝使我心裏要為耶路撒冷做甚麼事，我並沒有告訴人。除了我騎的牲口以外，也沒有別的牲口在我那裏。
verses.e: I arose in the night , I and a few men with me . I didn't tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem . There wasn't any animal with me except the animal that I rode on .

verses.z: 當夜我出了谷門，往野狗井去，到了糞廠門，察看耶路撒冷的城牆，見城牆拆毀，城門被火焚燒。
verses.e: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal's well , then to the dung gate ; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem , which were broken down , and its gates were consumed with fire .

verses.z: 我又往前，到了泉門和王池，但所騎的牲口沒有地方過去。
verses.e: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king's pool , but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass .

verses.z: 於是夜間沿溪而上，察看城牆，又轉身進入谷門，就回來了。
verses.e: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall ; and I turned back , and entered by the valley gate , and so returned .

verses.z: 我往哪裏去，我做甚麼事，官長都不知道。我還沒有告訴猶大平民、祭司、貴冑、官長，和其餘做工的人。
verses.e: The rulers didn't know where I went , or what I did . I had not as yet told it to the Jews , nor to the priests , nor to the nobles , nor to the rulers , nor to the rest who did the work .

verses.z: 以後，我對他們說：「我們所遭的難，耶路撒冷怎樣荒涼，城門被火焚燒，你們都看見了。來吧，我們重建耶路撒冷的城牆，免得再受凌辱！」
verses.e: Then I said to them , " You see the bad situation that we are in , how Jerusalem lies waste , and its gates are burned with fire . Come , let's build up the wall of Jerusalem , that we won't be disgraced . "

verses.z: 我告訴他們我上帝施恩的手怎樣幫助我，並王對我所說的話。他們就說：「我們起來建造吧！」於是他們奮勇做這善工。
verses.e: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me , and also about the king's words that he had spoken to me . They said , " Let's rise up and build . " So they strengthened their hands for the good work .

verses.z: 但和倫人參巴拉，並為奴的亞捫人多比雅和阿拉伯人基善聽見就嗤笑我們，藐視我們，說：「你們做甚麼呢？要背叛王嗎？」
verses.e: But when Sanballat the Horonite , Tobiah the Ammonite servant , and Geshem the Arabian , heard it , they ridiculed us and despised us , and said , " What is this thing that you are doing ? Will you rebel against the king ? "

verses.z: 王對我說：「你既沒有病，為甚麼面帶愁容呢？這不是別的，必是你心中愁煩。」於是我甚懼怕。
verses.e: The king said to me , " Why is your face sad , since you are not sick ? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart . " Then I was very much afraid .

verses.z: 我回答他們說：「天上的上帝必使我們亨通。我們作他僕人的，要起來建造；你們卻在耶路撒冷無分、無權、無紀念。」
verses.e: Then I answered them , and said to them , " The God of heaven will prosper us . Therefore we , his servants , will arise and build ; but you have no portion , nor right , nor memorial in Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 我對王說：「願王萬歲！我列祖墳墓所在的那城荒涼，城門被火焚燒，我豈能面無愁容嗎？」
verses.e: I said to the king , " Let the king live forever ! Why shouldn't my face be sad , when the city , the place of my fathers ' tombs , lies waste , and its gates have been consumed with fire ? "

verses.z: 王問我說：「你要求甚麼？」於是我[默]禱天上的上帝。
verses.e: Then the king said to me , " What is your request ? " So I prayed to the God of heaven .

verses.z: 我對王說：「僕人若在王眼前蒙恩，王若喜歡，求王差遣我往猶大，到我列祖墳墓所在的那城去，我好重新建造。」
verses.e: I said to the king , " If it pleases the king , and if your servant has found favor in your sight , I ask that you would send me to Judah , to the city of my fathers ' tombs , that I may build it . "

verses.z: 那時王后坐在王的旁邊。王問我說：「你去要多少日子？幾時回來？」我就定了日期。於是王喜歡差遣我去。
verses.e: The king said to me ( the queen was also sitting by him ) , " How long will your journey be ? When will you return ? " So it pleased the king to send me , and I set a time for him .

verses.z: 我又對王說：「王若喜歡，求王賜我詔書，通知大河西的省長准我經過，直到猶大；
verses.e: Moreover I said to the king , " If it pleases the king , let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River , that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah ;

verses.z: 又賜詔書，通知管理王園林的亞薩，使他給我木料，做屬殿營樓之門的橫樑和城牆，與我自己房屋使用的。」王就允准我，因我上帝施恩的手幫助我。
verses.e: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king's forest , that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple , for the wall of the city , and for the house that I will occupy . " The king granted my requests , because of the good hand of my God on me .

verses.z: 王派了軍長和馬兵護送我。我到了河西的省長那裏，將王的詔書交給他們。
verses.e: Then I came to the governors beyond the River , and gave them the king's letters . Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me .

verses.z: 那時，大祭司以利亞實和他的弟兄眾祭司起來建立羊門，分別為聖，安立門扇，[又築城牆]到哈米亞樓，直到哈楠業樓，分別為聖。
verses.e: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests , and they built the sheep gate . They sanctified it , and set up its doors . They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah , to the tower of Hananel .

verses.z: 其次是哈路抹的兒子耶大雅對着自己的房屋修造。其次是哈沙尼的兒子哈突修造。
verses.e: Next to them , Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house . Next to him , Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs .

verses.z: 哈琳的兒子瑪基雅和巴哈‧摩押的兒子哈述修造一段，並修造爐樓。
verses.e: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces .

verses.z: 其次是管理耶路撒冷那一半、哈羅黑的兒子沙龍和他的女兒們修造。
verses.e: Next to him , Shallum the son of Hallohesh , the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem , he and his daughters made repairs .

verses.z: 哈嫩和撒挪亞的居民修造谷門，立門，安門扇和閂鎖，又建築城牆一千肘，直到糞廠門。
verses.e: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate . They built it , and set up its doors , its bolts , and its bars , and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate .

verses.z: 管理伯‧哈基琳、利甲的兒子瑪基雅修造糞廠門，立門，安門扇和閂鎖。
verses.e: Malchijah the son of Rechab , the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem , repaired the dung gate . He built it , and set up its doors , its bolts , and its bars .

verses.z: 管理米斯巴、各荷西的兒子沙崙修造泉門，立門，蓋門頂，安門扇和閂鎖，又修造靠近王園西羅亞池的牆垣，直到那從大衛城下來的臺階。
verses.e: Shallun the son of Colhozeh , the ruler of the district of Mizpah , repaired the spring gate . He built it , covered it , and set up its doors , its bolts , and its bars ; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king's garden , even to the stairs that go down from David's city .

verses.z: 其次是管理伯‧夙一半、押卜的兒子尼希米修造，直到大衛墳地的對面，又到挖成的池子，並勇士的房屋。
verses.e: After him , Nehemiah the son of Azbuk , the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur , made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David , and to the pool that was made , and to the house of the mighty men .

verses.z: 其次是利未人巴尼的兒子利宏修造。其次是管理基伊拉一半、哈沙比雅為他所管的本境修造。
verses.e: After him , the Levites — Rehum the son of Bani made repairs . Next to him , Hashabiah , the ruler of half the district of Keilah , made repairs for his district .

verses.z: 其次是利未人弟兄中管理基伊拉那一半、希拿達的兒子巴瓦伊修造。
verses.e: After him , their brothers , Bavvai the son of Henadad , the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs .

verses.z: 其次是管理米斯巴、耶書亞的兒子以謝修造一段，對着武庫的上坡、[城牆]轉彎之處。
verses.e: Next to him , Ezer the son of Jeshua , the ruler of Mizpah , repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall .

verses.z: 其次是耶利哥人建造。其次是音利的兒子撒刻建造。
verses.e: Next to him the men of Jericho built . Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built .

verses.z: 其次是薩拜的兒子巴錄竭力修造一段，從[城牆]轉彎，直到大祭司以利亞實的府門。
verses.e: After him , Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion , from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest .

verses.z: 其次是哈哥斯的孫子、烏利亞的兒子米利末修造一段，從以利亞實的府門，直到以利亞實府的盡頭。
verses.e: After him , Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion , from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib .

verses.z: 其次是住平原的祭司修造。
verses.e: After him , the priests , the men of the surrounding area made repairs .

verses.z: 其次是便雅憫與哈述對着自己的房屋修造。其次是亞難尼的孫子、瑪西雅的兒子亞撒利雅在靠近自己的房屋修造。
verses.e: After them , Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house . After them , Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house .

verses.z: 其次是希拿達的兒子賓內修造一段，從亞撒利雅的房屋直到[城牆]轉彎，又到城角。
verses.e: After him , Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion , from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall , and to the corner .

verses.z: 烏賽的兒子巴拉[修造]對着[城牆]的轉彎和王上宮凸出來的城樓，靠近護衛院的那一段。其次是巴錄的兒子毗大雅[修造]。（
verses.e: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall , and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king , which is by the court of the guard . After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs .

verses.z: 尼提寧住在俄斐勒，直到朝東水門的對面和凸出來的城樓。）
verses.e: ( Now the temple servants lived in Ophel , to the place opposite the water gate toward the east , and the tower that stands out . )

verses.z: 其次是提哥亞人又修一段，對着那凸出來的大樓，直到俄斐勒的牆。
verses.e: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion , opposite the great tower that stands out , and to the wall of Ophel .

verses.z: 從馬門往上，眾祭司各對自己的房屋修造。
verses.e: Above the horse gate , the priests made repairs , everyone across from his own house .

verses.z: 其次是音麥的兒子撒督對着自己的房屋修造。其次是守東門、示迦尼的兒子示瑪雅修造。
verses.e: After them , Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house . After him , Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah , the keeper of the east gate , made repairs .

verses.z: 哈西拿的子孫建立魚門，架橫樑、安門扇，和閂鎖。
verses.e: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate . They laid its beams , and set up its doors , its bolts , and its bars .

verses.z: 其次是示利米雅的兒子哈拿尼雅和薩拉的第六子哈嫩又修一段。其次是比利迦的兒子米書蘭對着自己的房屋修造。
verses.e: After him , Hananiah the son of Shelemiah , and Hanun , the sixth son of Zalaph , repaired another portion . After him , Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room .

verses.z: 其次是銀匠瑪基雅修造到尼提寧和商人的房屋，對着哈米弗甲門，直到城的角樓。
verses.e: After him , Malchijah , one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants , and of the merchants , made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner .

verses.z: 銀匠與商人在城的角樓和羊門中間修造。
verses.e: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate , the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs .

verses.z: 其次是哈哥斯的孫子、烏利亞的兒子米利末修造。其次是米示薩別的孫子、比利迦的兒子米書蘭修造。其次是巴拿的兒子撒督修造。
verses.e: Next to them , Meremoth the son of Uriah , the son of Hakkoz made repairs . Next to them , Meshullam the son of Berechiah , the son of Meshezabel made repairs . Next to them , Zadok the son of Baana made repairs .

verses.z: 其次是提哥亞人修造；但是他們的貴冑不用肩擔他們主的工作。
verses.e: Next to them , the Tekoites made repairs ; but their nobles didn't put their necks to the Lord's work .

verses.z: 巴西亞的兒子耶何耶大與比所玳的兒子米書蘭修造古門，架橫樑，安門扇和閂鎖。
verses.e: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate . They laid its beams and set up its doors , its bolts , and its bars .

verses.z: 其次是基遍人米拉提，米倫人雅頓與基遍人，並屬河西總督所管的米斯巴人修造。
verses.e: Next to them , Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite , the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah , repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River .

verses.z: 其次是銀匠哈海雅的兒子烏薛修造。其次是做香的哈拿尼雅修造。這些人修堅耶路撒冷，直到寬牆。
verses.e: Next to him , Uzziel the son of Harhaiah , goldsmiths , made repairs . Next to him , Hananiah , one of the perfumers , made repairs , and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall .

verses.z: 其次是管理耶路撒冷一半、戶珥的兒子利法雅修造。
verses.e: Next to them , Rephaiah the son of Hur , the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem , made repairs .

verses.z: 參巴拉聽見我們修造城牆就發怒，大大惱恨，嗤笑猶大人，
verses.e: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall , he was angry , and was very indignant , and mocked the Jews .

verses.z: 猶大人說：「灰土尚多，扛抬的人力氣已經衰敗，所以我們不能建造城牆。」
verses.e: Judah said , " The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble , so that we are not able to build the wall . "

verses.z: 我們的敵人且說：「趁他們不知不見，我們進入他們中間，殺他們，使工作止住。」
verses.e: Our adversaries said , " They will not know or see , until we come in among them and kill them , and cause the work to cease . "

verses.z: 那靠近敵人居住的猶大人十次從各處來見我們，說：「你們必要回到我們那裏。」
verses.e: When the Jews who lived by them came , they said to us ten times from all places , " Wherever you turn , they will attack us . "

verses.z: 所以我使百姓各按宗族拿刀、拿槍、拿弓站在城牆後邊低窪的空處。
