verses.e: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall , in the open places . I set the people by family groups with their swords , their spears , and their bows .

verses.z: 我察看了，就起來對貴冑、官長，和其餘的人說：「不要怕他們！當記念主是大而可畏的。你們要為弟兄、兒女、妻子、家產爭戰。」
verses.e: I looked , and rose up , and said to the nobles , to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , " Don't be afraid of them ! Remember the Lord , who is great and awesome , and fight for your brothers , your sons , your daughters , your wives , and your houses . "

verses.z: 仇敵聽見我們知道他們的心意，見上帝也破壞他們的計謀，[就不來了]。我們都回到城牆那裏，各做各的工。
verses.e: When our enemies heard that it was known to us , and God had brought their counsel to nothing , all of us returned to the wall , everyone to his work .

verses.z: 從那日起，我的僕人一半做工，一半拿槍、拿盾牌、拿弓、穿鎧甲，官長都站在猶大眾人的後邊。
verses.e: From that time forth , half of my servants did the work , and half of them held the spears , the shields , the bows , and the coats of mail ; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah .

verses.z: 修造城牆的，扛抬材料的，都一手做工一手拿兵器。
verses.e: Those who built the wall , and those who bore burdens loaded themselves ; everyone with one of his hands did the work , and with the other held his weapon .

verses.z: 修造的人都腰間佩刀修造，吹角的人在我旁邊。
verses.e: Among the builders , everyone wore his sword at his side , and so built . He who sounded the trumpet was by me .

verses.z: 我對貴冑、官長，和其餘的人說：「這工程浩大，我們在城牆上相離甚遠；
verses.e: I said to the nobles , and to the rulers and to the rest of the people , " The work is great and widely spread out , and we are separated on the wall , far from one another .

verses.z: 對他弟兄和撒馬利亞的軍兵說：「這些軟弱的猶大人做甚麼呢？要保護自己嗎？要獻祭嗎？要一日成功嗎？要從土堆裏拿出火燒的石頭再立牆嗎？」
verses.e: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria , and said , " What are these feeble Jews doing ? Will they fortify themselves ? Will they sacrifice ? Will they finish in a day ? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish , since they are burned ? "

verses.z: 你們聽見角聲在哪裏，就聚集到我們那裏去。我們的上帝必為我們爭戰。」
verses.e: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet , rally there to us . Our God will fight for us . "

verses.z: 於是，我們做工，一半拿兵器，從天亮直到星宿出現的時候。
verses.e: So we did the work . Half of the people held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared .

verses.z: 那時，我又對百姓說：「各人和他的僕人當在耶路撒冷住宿，好在夜間保守我們，白晝做工。」
verses.e: Likewise at the same time I said to the people , " Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and may labor in the day . "

verses.z: 這樣，我和弟兄僕人，並跟從我的護兵都不脫衣服，出去打水也帶兵器。
verses.e: So neither I , nor my brothers , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard who followed me took off our clothes . Everyone took his weapon to the water .

verses.z: 亞捫人多比雅站在旁邊，說：「他們所修造的石牆，就是狐狸上去也必跐倒。」
verses.e: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him , and he said , " What they are building , if a fox climbed up it , he would break down their stone wall . "

verses.z: 我們的上帝啊，求你垂聽，因為我們被藐視。求你使他們的毀謗歸於他們的頭上，使他們在擄到之地作為掠物。
verses.e: " Hear , our God , for we are despised . Turn back their reproach on their own head . Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity .

verses.z: 不要遮掩他們的罪孽，不要使他們的罪惡從你面前塗抹，因為他們在修造的人眼前惹動你的怒氣。
verses.e: Don't cover their iniquity . Don't let their sin be blotted out from before you ; for they have insulted the builders . "

verses.z: 這樣，我們修造城牆，城牆就都連絡，高至一半，因為百姓專心做工。
verses.e: So we built the wall ; and all the wall was joined together to half its height , for the people had a mind to work .

verses.z: 參巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人、亞捫人、亞實突人聽見修造耶路撒冷城牆，着手進行堵塞破裂的地方，就甚發怒。
verses.e: But when Sanballat , Tobiah , the Arabians , the Ammonites , and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward , and that the breaches began to be filled , they were very angry ;

verses.z: 大家同謀要來攻擊耶路撒冷，使城內擾亂。
verses.e: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem , and to cause confusion among us .

verses.z: 然而，我們禱告我們的上帝，又因他們的緣故，就派人看守，晝夜防備。
verses.e: But we made our prayer to our God , and set a watch against them day and night because of them .

verses.z: 百姓和他們的妻大大呼號，埋怨他們的弟兄猶大人。
verses.e: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews .

verses.z: 我和我的弟兄與僕人也將銀錢糧食借給百姓；我們大家都當免去利息。
verses.e: I likewise , my brothers and my servants , lend them money and grain . Please let us stop this usury .

verses.z: 如今我勸你們將他們的田地、葡萄園、橄欖園、房屋，並向他們所取的銀錢、糧食、新酒，和油，百分之一的利息都歸還他們。」
verses.e: Please restore to them , even today , their fields , their vineyards , their olive groves , and their houses , also the hundredth part of the money , and of the grain , the new wine , and the oil , that you are charging them . "

verses.z: 眾人說：「我們必歸還，不再向他們索要，必照你的話行。」我就召了祭司來，叫眾人起誓，必照着所應許的而行。
verses.e: Then they said , " We will restore them , and will require nothing of them . We will do so , even as you say . " Then I called the priests , and took an oath of them , that they would do according to this promise .

verses.z: 我也抖着胸前的衣襟，說：「凡不成就這應許的，願上帝照樣抖他離開家產和他勞碌得來的，直到抖空了。」會眾都說：「阿們！」又讚美耶和華。百姓就照着所應許的去行。
verses.e: Also I shook out my lap , and said , " So may God shake out every man from his house , and from his labor , that doesn't perform this promise ; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this . " All the assembly said , " Amen , " and praised the LORD . The people did according to this promise .

verses.z: 自從我奉派作猶大地的省長，就是從亞達薛西王二十年直到三十二年，共十二年之久，我與我弟兄都沒有吃省長的俸祿。
verses.e: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah , from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king , that is , twelve years , I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor .

verses.z: 在我以前的省長加重百姓的擔子，[每日]索要糧食和酒，並銀子四十舍客勒，就是他們的僕人也轄制百姓；但我因敬畏上帝不這樣行。
verses.e: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people , and took bread and wine from them , plus forty shekels of silver ; yes , even their servants ruled over the people , but I didn't do so , because of the fear of God .

verses.z: 並且我恆心修造城牆，並沒有置買田地；我的僕人也都聚集在那裏做工。
verses.e: Yes , I also continued in the work of this wall . We didn't buy any land . All my servants were gathered there to the work .

verses.z: 除了從四圍外邦中來的猶大人以外，有猶大平民和官長一百五十人在我席上吃飯。
verses.e: Moreover there were at my table , of the Jews and the rulers , one hundred fifty men , in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us .

verses.z: 每日預備一隻公牛，六隻肥羊，又預備些飛禽；每十日一次，多預備各樣的酒。雖然如此，我並不要省長的俸祿，因為百姓服役甚重。
verses.e: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep . Also fowls were prepared for me , and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine . Yet for all this , I didn't demand the governor's pay , because the bondage was heavy on this people .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，求你記念我為這百姓所行的一切事，施恩與我。
verses.e: Remember me , my God , for all the good that I have done for this people .

verses.z: 有的說：「我們和兒女人口眾多，要去得糧食度命」；
verses.e: For there were some who said , " We , our sons and our daughters , are many . Let us get grain , that we may eat and live . "

verses.z: 有的說：「我們典了田地、葡萄園、房屋，要得糧食充飢」；
verses.e: There were also some who said , " We are mortgaging our fields , our vineyards , and our houses . Let us get grain , because of the famine . "

verses.z: 有的說：「我們已經指着田地、葡萄園，借了錢給王納稅。
verses.e: There were also some who said , " We have borrowed money for the king's tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral .

verses.z: 我們的身體與我們弟兄的身體一樣；我們的兒女與他們的兒女一般。現在我們將要使兒女作人的僕婢，我們的女兒已有為婢的；我們並無力拯救，因為我們的田地、葡萄園已經歸了別人。」
verses.e: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers , our children as their children . Behold , we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants , and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage . It is also not in our power to help it , because other men have our fields and our vineyards . "

verses.z: 我聽見他們呼號說這些話，便甚發怒。
verses.e: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words .

verses.z: 我心裏籌劃，就斥責貴冑和官長說：「你們各人向弟兄取利！」於是我招聚大會攻擊他們。
verses.e: Then I consulted with myself , and contended with the nobles and the rulers , and said to them , " You exact usury , everyone of his brother . " I held a great assembly against them .

verses.z: 我對他們說：「我們盡力贖回我們弟兄，就是賣與外邦的猶大人；你們還要賣弟兄，使我們贖回來嗎？」他們就靜默不語，無話可答。
verses.e: I said to them , " We , after our ability , have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations ; and would you even sell your brothers , and should they be sold to us ? " Then they held their peace , and found not a word to say .

verses.z: 我又說：「你們所行的不善！你們行事不當敬畏我們的上帝嗎？不然，難免我們的仇敵外邦人毀謗我們。
verses.e: Also I said , " The thing that you do is not good . Shouldn't you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations , our enemies ?

verses.z: 參巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人基善和我們其餘的仇敵聽見我已經修完了城牆，其中沒有破裂之處（那時我還沒有安門扇）的，
verses.e: Now when it was reported to Sanballat , Tobiah , Geshem the Arabian , and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall , and that there was no breach left in it ( though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates ) ,

verses.z: 我到了米希大別的孫子、第來雅的兒子示瑪雅家裏；那時，他閉門不出。他說：「我們不如在上帝的殿裏會面，將殿門關鎖；因為他們要來殺你，就是夜裏來殺你。」
verses.e: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel , who was shut in at his home ; and he said , " Let us meet together in God's house , within the temple , and let's shut the doors of the temple ; for they will come to kill you . Yes , in the night they will come to kill you . "

verses.z: 我說：「像我這樣的人豈要逃跑呢？像我這樣的人豈能進入殿裏保全生命呢？我不進去！」
verses.e: I said , " Should a man like me flee ? Who is there that , being such as I , would go into the temple to save his life ? I will not go in . "

verses.z: 我看明上帝沒有差遣他，是他自己說這話攻擊我，是多比雅和參巴拉賄買了他。
verses.e: I discerned , and behold , God had not sent him , but he pronounced this prophecy against me . Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him .

verses.z: 賄買他的緣故，是要叫我懼怕，依從他犯罪，他們好傳揚惡言毀謗我。
verses.e: He was hired so that I would be afraid , do so , and sin , and that they might have material for an evil report , that they might reproach me .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，多比雅、參巴拉、女先知挪亞底，和其餘的先知要叫我懼怕，求你記念他們所行的這些事。
verses.e: " Remember , my God , Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works , and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear . "

verses.z: 以祿[月]二十五[日]，城牆修完了，共修了五十二天。
verses.e: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul , in fifty-two days .

verses.z: 我們一切仇敵、四圍的外邦人聽見了便懼怕，愁眉不展；因為見這工作完成是出乎我們的上帝。
verses.e: When all our enemies heard of it , all the nations that were around us were afraid , and they lost their confidence ; for they perceived that this work was done by our God .

verses.z: 在那些日子，猶大的貴冑屢次寄信與多比雅，多比雅也來[信]與他們。
verses.e: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah , and Tobiah's letters came to them .

verses.z: 在猶大有許多人與多比雅結盟；因他是亞拉的兒子，示迦尼的女婿，並且他的兒子約哈難娶了比利迦兒子米書蘭的女兒為妻。
verses.e: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah ; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife .

verses.z: 他們常在我面前說多比雅的善行，也將我的話傳與他。多比雅又常寄信來，要叫我懼怕。
verses.e: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me , and reported my words to him . Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear .

verses.z: 參巴拉和基善就打發人來見我，說：「請你來，我們在阿挪平原的一個村莊相會。」他們卻想害我。
verses.e: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me , saying , " Come ! Let's meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono . " But they intended to harm me .

verses.z: 於是我差遣人去見他們，說：「我現在辦理大工，不能下去。焉能停工下去見你們呢？」
verses.e: I sent messengers to them , saying , " I am doing a great work , so that I can't come down . Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you ? "

verses.z: 他們這樣四次打發人來見我，我都如此回答他們。
verses.e: They sent to me four times like this ; and I answered them the same way .

verses.z: 參巴拉第五次打發僕人來見我，手裏拿着未封的信，
verses.e: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand ,

verses.z: 信上寫着說：「外邦人中有風聲，迦施慕也說，你和猶大人謀反，修造城牆，你要作他們的王；
verses.e: in which was written , " It is reported among the nations , and Gashmu says it , that you and the Jews intend to rebel . Because of that , you are building the wall . You would be their king , according to these words .

verses.z: 你又派先知在耶路撒冷指着你宣講，說在猶大有王。現在這話必傳與王知；所以請你來，與我們彼此商議。」
verses.e: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem , saying , ' There is a king in Judah ! ' Now it will be reported to the king according to these words . Come now therefore , and let's take counsel together . "

verses.z: 我就差遣人去見他，說：「你所說的這事，一概沒有，是你心裏捏造的。」
verses.e: Then I sent to him , saying , " There are no such things done as you say , but you imagine them out of your own heart . "

verses.z: 他們都要使我們懼怕，意思說，他們的手必軟弱，以致工作不能成就。[上帝啊]，求你堅固我的手。
verses.e: For they all would have made us afraid , saying , " Their hands will be weakened from the work , that it not be done . " But now , strengthen my hands .

verses.z: 城牆修完，我安了門扇，守門的、歌唱的，和利未人都已派定。
verses.e: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors , and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed ,

verses.z: 亞拉的子孫六百五十二名；
verses.e: The children of Arah : six hundred fifty-two .

verses.z: 巴哈‧摩押的後裔，就是耶書亞和約押的子孫二千八百一十八名；
verses.e: The children of Pahathmoab , of the children of Jeshua and Joab : two thousand eight hundred eighteen .

verses.z: 以攔的子孫一千二百五十四名；
verses.e: The children of Elam : one thousand two hundred fifty-four .

verses.z: 薩土的子孫八百四十五名；
verses.e: The children of Zattu : eight hundred forty-five .

verses.z: 薩改的子孫七百六十名；
verses.e: The children of Zaccai : seven hundred sixty .

verses.z: 賓內的子孫六百四十八名；
verses.e: The children of Binnui : six hundred forty-eight .

verses.z: 比拜的子孫六百二十八名；
verses.e: The children of Bebai : six hundred twenty-eight .

verses.z: 押甲的子孫二千三百二十二名；
verses.e: The children of Azgad : two thousand three hundred twenty-two .

verses.z: 亞多尼干的子孫六百六十七名；
verses.e: The children of Adonikam : six hundred sixty-seven .

verses.z: 比革瓦伊的子孫二千零六十七名；
verses.e: The children of Bigvai : two thousand sixty-seven .

verses.z: 我就派我的弟兄哈拿尼和營樓的宰官哈拿尼雅管理耶路撒冷；因為哈拿尼雅是忠信的，又敬畏上帝過於眾人。
verses.e: I put my brother Hanani , and Hananiah the governor of the fortress , in charge of Jerusalem ; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many .

verses.z: 亞丁的子孫六百五十五名；
verses.e: The children of Adin : six hundred fifty-five .

verses.z: 亞特的後裔，就是希西家的子孫九十八名；
verses.e: The children of Ater : of Hezekiah , ninety-eight .

verses.z: 哈順的子孫三百二十八名；
verses.e: The children of Hashum : three hundred twenty-eight .

verses.z: 比賽的子孫三百二十四名；
verses.e: The children of Bezai : three hundred twenty-four .

verses.z: 哈拉的子孫一百一十二名；
verses.e: The children of Hariph : one hundred twelve .

verses.z: 基遍人九十五名；
verses.e: The children of Gibeon : ninety-five .

verses.z: 伯利恆人和尼陀法人共一百八十八名；
verses.e: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah : one hundred eighty-eight .

verses.z: 亞拿突人一百二十八名；
verses.e: The men of Anathoth : one hundred twenty-eight .

verses.z: 伯‧亞斯瑪弗人四十二名；
verses.e: The men of Beth Azmaveth : forty-two .

verses.z: 基列‧耶琳人、基非拉人、比錄人共七百四十三名；
verses.e: The men of Kiriath Jearim , Chephirah , and Beeroth : seven hundred forty-three .

verses.z: 我吩咐他們說：「等到太陽上升才可開耶路撒冷的城門；人尚看守的時候就要關門上閂；也當派耶路撒冷的居民各按班次看守自己房屋對面之處。」
verses.e: I said to them , " Don't let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot ; and while they stand guard , let them shut the doors , and you bar them ; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , everyone in his watch , with everyone near his house . "

verses.z: 拉瑪人和迦巴人共六百二十一名；
verses.e: The men of Ramah and Geba : six hundred twenty-one .

verses.z: 默瑪人一百二十二名；
verses.e: The men of Michmas : one hundred twenty-two .

verses.z: 伯特利人和艾人共一百二十三名；
verses.e: The men of Bethel and Ai : one hundred twenty-three .

verses.z: 別的尼波人五十二名；
verses.e: The men of the other Nebo : fifty-two .

verses.z: 別的以攔子孫一千二百五十四名；
verses.e: The children of the other Elam : one thousand two hundred fifty-four .

verses.z: 哈琳的子孫三百二十名；
verses.e: The children of Harim : three hundred twenty .

verses.z: 耶利哥人三百四十五名；
verses.e: The children of Jericho : three hundred forty-five .

verses.z: 羅德人、哈第人、阿挪人共七百二十一名；
verses.e: The children of Lod , Hadid , and Ono : seven hundred twenty-one .

verses.z: 西拿人三千九百三十名。
verses.e: The children of Senaah : three thousand nine hundred thirty .

verses.z: 祭司：耶書亞家，耶大雅的子孫九百七十三名；
verses.e: The priests : The children of Jedaiah , of the house of Jeshua : nine hundred seventy-three .

verses.z: 城是廣大，其中的民卻稀少，房屋還沒有建造。
verses.e: Now the city was wide and large ; but the people were few therein , and the houses were not built .

verses.z: 音麥的子孫一千零五十二名；
verses.e: The children of Immer : one thousand fifty-two .

verses.z: 巴施戶珥的子孫一千二百四十七名；
verses.e: The children of Pashhur : one thousand two hundred forty-seven .

verses.z: 哈琳的子孫一千零一十七名。
verses.e: The children of Harim : one thousand seventeen .

verses.z: 利未人：何達威的後裔，就是耶書亞和甲篾的子孫七十四名。
verses.e: The Levites : the children of Jeshua , of Kadmiel , of the children of Hodevah : seventy-four .

verses.z: 歌唱的：亞薩的子孫一百四十八名。
verses.e: The singers : the children of Asaph : one hundred forty-eight .

verses.z: 守門的：沙龍的子孫、亞特的子孫、達們的子孫、亞谷的子孫、哈底大的子孫、朔拜的子孫，共一百三十八名。
verses.e: The gatekeepers : the children of Shallum , the children of Ater , the children of Talmon , the children of Akkub , the children of Hatita , the children of Shobai : one hundred thirty-eight .

verses.z: 尼提寧：西哈的子孫、哈蘇巴的子孫、答巴俄的子孫、
verses.e: The temple servants : the children of Ziha , the children of Hasupha , the children of Tabbaoth ,

verses.z: 基綠的子孫、西亞的子孫、巴頓的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Keros , the children of Sia , the children of Padon ,

verses.z: 利巴拿的子孫、哈迦巴的子孫、薩買的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Lebana , the children of Hagaba , the children of Salmai ,

verses.z: 哈難的子孫、吉德的子孫、迦哈的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Hanan , the children of Giddel , the children of Gahar ,

verses.z: 我的上帝感動我心，招聚貴冑、官長，和百姓，要照家譜計算。我找着第一次上來之人的家譜，其上寫着：
verses.e: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles , and the rulers , and the people , that they might be listed by genealogy . I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first , and I found this written in it :

verses.z: 利亞雅的子孫、利汛的子孫、尼哥大的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Reaiah , the children of Rezin , the children of Nekoda ,

verses.z: 迦散的子孫、烏撒的子孫、巴西亞的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Gazzam , the children of Uzza , the children of Paseah ,

verses.z: 比賽的子孫、米烏寧的子孫、尼普心的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Besai , the children of Meunim , the children of Nephushesim ,

verses.z: 巴卜的子孫、哈古巴的子孫、哈忽的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Bakbuk , the children of Hakupha , the children of Harhur ,

verses.z: 巴洗律的子孫、米希大的子孫、哈沙的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Bazlith , the children of Mehida , the children of Harsha ,

verses.z: 巴柯的子孫、西西拉的子孫、答瑪的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Barkos , the children of Sisera , the children of Temah ,

verses.z: 尼細亞的子孫、哈提法的子孫。
verses.e: the children of Neziah , and the children of Hatipha .

verses.z: 所羅門僕人的後裔，就是瑣太的子孫、瑣斐列的子孫、比路大的子孫、
verses.e: The children of Solomon's servants : the children of Sotai , the children of Sophereth , the children of Perida ,

verses.z: 雅拉的子孫、達昆的子孫、吉德的子孫、
verses.e: the children of Jaala , the children of Darkon , the children of Giddel ,

verses.z: 示法提雅的子孫、哈替的子孫、玻黑列‧哈斯巴音的子孫、亞們的子孫。
verses.e: the children of Shephatiah , the children of Hattil , the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim , and the children of Amon .

verses.z: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒從前擄去猶大省的人，現在他們的子孫從被擄到之地回耶路撒冷和猶大，各歸本城。
verses.e: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away , whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away , and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah , everyone to his city ,

verses.z: 尼提寧和所羅門僕人的後裔共三百九十二名。
verses.e: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon's servants were three hundred ninety-two .

verses.z: 從特米拉、特哈薩、基綠、亞頓、音麥上來的，不能指明他們的宗族譜系是以色列人不是；
verses.e: These were those who went up from Tel Melah , Tel Harsha , Cherub , Addon , and Immer ; but they could not show their fathers ' houses , nor their offspring , whether they were of Israel :

verses.z: 他們是第萊雅的子孫、多比雅的子孫、尼哥大的子孫，共六百四十二名。
verses.e: The children of Delaiah , the children of Tobiah , the children of Nekoda : six hundred forty-two .

verses.z: 祭司中，哈巴雅的子孫、哈哥斯的子孫、巴西萊的子孫；因為他們的先祖娶了基列人巴西萊的女兒為妻，所以起名叫巴西萊。
verses.e: Of the priests : the children of Hobaiah , the children of Hakkoz , the children of Barzillai , who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite , and was called after their name .

verses.z: 這三家的人在族譜之中尋查自己的譜系，卻尋不着，因此算為不潔，不准供祭司的職任。
verses.e: These searched for their genealogical records , but couldn't find them . Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood .

verses.z: 省長對他們說：「不可吃至聖的物，直到有用烏陵和土明決疑的祭司興起來。」
verses.e: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim .

verses.z: 會眾共有四萬二千三百六十名。
verses.e: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty ,

verses.z: 此外，還有他們的僕婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百四十五名。
verses.e: in addition to their male servants and their female servants , of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven . They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women .

verses.z: 他們有馬七百三十六匹，騾子二百四十五匹，
verses.e: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six ; their mules , two hundred forty-five ;

verses.z: 駱駝四百三十五隻，驢六千七百二十匹。
verses.e: their camels , four hundred thirty-five ; their donkeys , six thousand seven hundred twenty .

verses.z: 他們是同着所羅巴伯、耶書亞、尼希米、亞撒利雅、拉米、拿哈瑪尼、末底改、必珊、米斯毗列、比革瓦伊、尼宏、巴拿回來的。
verses.e: who came with Zerubbabel , Jeshua , Nehemiah , Azariah , Raamiah , Nahamani , Mordecai , Bilshan , Mispereth , Bigvai , Nehum , and Baanah . The number of the men of the people of Israel :

verses.z: 有些族長為工程捐助。省長捐入庫中的金子一千達利克，碗五十個，祭司的禮服五百三十件。
verses.e: Some from among the heads of fathers ' households gave to the work . The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold , fifty basins , and five hundred thirty priests ' garments .

verses.z: 又有族長捐入工程庫的金子二萬達利克，銀子二千二百彌拿。
verses.e: Some of the heads of fathers ' households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold , and two thousand two hundred minas of silver .

verses.z: 其餘百姓所捐的金子二萬達利克，銀子二千彌拿，祭司的禮服六十七件。
verses.e: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold , plus two thousand minas of silver , and sixty-seven priests ' garments .

verses.z: 於是祭司、利未人、守門的、歌唱的、民中的一些人、尼提寧，並以色列眾人，各住在自己的城裏。
verses.e: So the priests , the Levites , the gatekeepers , the singers , some of the people , the temple servants , and all Israel lived in their cities . When the seventh month had come , the children of Israel were in their cities .

verses.z: 以色列人民的數目記在下面：巴錄的子孫二千一百七十二名；
verses.e: The children of Parosh : two thousand one hundred seventy-two .

verses.z: 示法提雅的子孫三百七十二名；
verses.e: The children of Shephatiah : three hundred seventy-two .

verses.z: 到了七月，以色列人住在自己的城裏。那時，他們如同一人聚集在水門前的寬闊處，請文士以斯拉將耶和華藉摩西傳給以色列人的律法書帶來。
verses.e: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate ; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the LORD had commanded to Israel .

verses.z: 又對他們說：「你們去吃肥美的，喝甘甜的，有不能預備的就分給他，因為今日是我們主的聖日。你們不要憂愁，因靠耶和華而得的喜樂是你們的力量。」
verses.e: Then he said to them , " Go your way . Eat the fat , drink the sweet , and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared , for today is holy to our Lord . Don't be grieved , for the joy of the LORD is your strength . "

verses.z: 於是利未人使眾民靜默，說：「今日是聖日；不要作聲，也不要憂愁。」
verses.e: So the Levites calmed all the people , saying , " Hold your peace , for the day is holy . Don't be grieved . "

verses.z: 眾民都去吃喝，也分給人，大大快樂，因為他們明白所教訓他們的話。
verses.e: All the people went their way to eat , to drink , to send portions , and to celebrate , because they had understood the words that were declared to them .

verses.z: 次日，眾民的族長、祭司，和利未人都聚集到文士以斯拉那裏，要留心聽律法上的話。
verses.e: On the second day , the heads of fathers ' households of all the people , the priests , and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe , to study the words of the law .

verses.z: 他們見律法上寫着，耶和華藉摩西吩咐以色列人要在七月節住棚，
verses.e: They found written in the law how the LORD had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month ;

verses.z: 並要在各城和耶路撒冷宣傳報告說：「你們當上山，將橄欖樹、野橄欖樹、番石榴樹、棕樹，和各樣茂密樹的枝子取來，照着所寫的搭棚。」
verses.e: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem , saying , " Go out to the mountain , and get olive branches , branches of wild olive , myrtle branches , palm branches , and branches of thick trees , to make temporary shelters , as it is written . "

verses.z: 於是百姓出去，取了樹枝來，各人在自己的房頂上，或院內，或上帝殿的院內，或水門的寬闊處，或以法蓮門的寬闊處搭棚。
verses.e: So the people went out and brought them , and made themselves temporary shelters , everyone on the roof of his house , in their courts , in the courts of God's house , in the wide place of the water gate , and in the wide place of Ephraim's gate .

verses.z: 從擄到之地歸回的全會眾就搭棚，住在棚裏。從嫩的兒子約書亞的時候直到這日，以色列人沒有這樣行。於是眾人大大喜樂。
verses.e: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters , for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so . There was very great gladness .

verses.z: 從頭一天直到末一天，以斯拉每日念上帝的律法書。眾人守節七日，第八日照例有嚴肅會。
verses.e: Also day by day , from the first day to the last day , he read in the book of the law of God . They kept the feast seven days ; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly , according to the ordinance .

verses.z: 七月初一日，祭司以斯拉將律法書帶到聽了能明白的男女會眾面前。
verses.e: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly , both men and women , and all who could hear with understanding , on the first day of the seventh month .

verses.z: 在水門前的寬闊處，從清早到晌午，在眾男女、一切聽了能明白的人面前讀這律法書。眾民側耳而聽。
verses.e: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday , in the presence of the men and the women , and of those who could understand . The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law .

verses.z: 文士以斯拉站在為這事特備的木臺上。瑪他提雅、示瑪、亞奈雅、烏利亞、希勒家，和瑪西雅站在他的右邊；毗大雅、米沙利、瑪基雅、哈順、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亞，和米書蘭站在他的左邊。
verses.e: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood , which they had made for the purpose ; and beside him stood Mattithiah , Shema , Anaiah , Uriah , Hilkiah , and Maaseiah , on his right hand ; and on his left hand , Pedaiah , Mishael , Malchijah , Hashum , Hashbaddanah , Zechariah , and Meshullam .

verses.z: 以斯拉站在眾民以上，在眾民眼前展開這書。他一展開，眾民就都站起來。
verses.e: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people ( for he was above all the people ) , and when he opened it , all the people stood up .

verses.z: 以斯拉稱頌耶和華至大的上帝；眾民都舉手應聲說：「阿們！阿們！」就低頭，面伏於地，敬拜耶和華。
verses.e: Then Ezra blessed the LORD , the great God . All the people answered , " Amen , Amen , " with the lifting up of their hands . They bowed their heads , and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground .

verses.z: 耶書亞、巴尼、示利比、雅憫、亞谷、沙比太、荷第雅、瑪西雅、基利他、亞撒利雅、約撒拔、哈難、毗萊雅，和利未人使百姓明白律法；百姓都[站]在自己的地方。
verses.e: Also Jeshua , Bani , Sherebiah , Jamin , Akkub , Shabbethai , Hodiah , Maaseiah , Kelita , Azariah , Jozabad , Hanan , Pelaiah , and the Levites , caused the people to understand the law ; and the people stayed in their place .

verses.z: 他們清清楚楚地念上帝的律法書，講明意思，使百姓明白所念的。
verses.e: They read in the book , in the law of God , distinctly ; and they gave the sense , so that they understood the reading .

verses.z: 省長尼希米和作祭司的文士以斯拉，並教訓百姓的利未人，對眾民說：「今日是耶和華－你們上帝的聖日，不要悲哀哭泣。」[這是]因為眾民聽見律法書上的話都哭了；
verses.e: Nehemiah , who was the governor , Ezra the priest and scribe , and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people , " Today is holy to the LORD your God . Don't mourn , nor weep . " For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law .

verses.z: 這月二十四日，以色列人聚集禁食，身穿麻衣，頭蒙灰塵。
verses.e: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting , with sackcloth , and dirt on them .

verses.z: 就施行神蹟奇事在法老和他一切臣僕，並他國中的眾民身上。你也得了名聲，正如今日一樣，因為你知道他們向我們列祖行事狂傲。
verses.e: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh , against all his servants , and against all the people of his land , for you knew that they dealt proudly against them , and made a name for yourself , as it is today .

verses.z: 你又在我們列祖面前把海分開，使他們在海中行走乾地，將追趕他們的人拋在深海，如石頭拋在大水中；
verses.e: You divided the sea before them , so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land ; and you cast their pursuers into the depths , as a stone into the mighty waters .

verses.z: 並且白晝用雲柱引導他們，黑夜用火柱照亮他們當行的路。
verses.e: Moreover , in a pillar of cloud you led them by day ; and in a pillar of fire by night , to give them light in the way in which they should go .

verses.z: 你也降臨在西奈山，從天上與他們說話，賜給他們正直的典章、真實的律法、美好的條例與誡命，
verses.e: " You also came down on Mount Sinai , and spoke with them from heaven , and gave them right ordinances and true laws , good statutes and commandments ,

verses.z: 又使他們知道你的安息聖日，並藉你僕人摩西傳給他們誡命、條例、律法。
verses.e: and made known to them your holy Sabbath , and commanded them commandments , statutes , and a law , by Moses your servant ,

verses.z: 從天上賜下糧食充他們的飢，從磐石使水流出解他們的渴，又吩咐他們進去得你起誓應許賜給他們的地。
verses.e: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger , and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst , and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them .

verses.z: 「但我們的列祖行事狂傲，硬着頸項不聽從你的誡命；
verses.e: " But they and our fathers behaved proudly , hardened their neck , didn't listen to your commandments ,

verses.z: 不肯順從，也不記念你在他們中間所行的奇事，竟硬着頸項，居心背逆，自立首領，要回他們為奴之地。但你是樂意饒恕人，有恩典，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，有豐盛慈愛的上帝，並不丟棄他們。
verses.e: and refused to obey . They weren't mindful of your wonders that you did among them , but hardened their neck , and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage . But you are a God ready to pardon , gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and abundant in loving kindness , and didn't forsake them .

verses.z: 他們雖然鑄了一隻牛犢，彼此說『這是領你出埃及的神』，因而大大惹動你的怒氣；
verses.e: Yes , when they had made themselves a molded calf , and said , ' This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt , ' and had committed awful blasphemies ,

verses.z: 你還是大施憐憫，在曠野不丟棄他們。白晝，雲柱不離開他們，仍引導他們行路；黑夜，火柱也不離開他們，仍照亮他們當行的路。
verses.e: yet you in your manifold mercies didn't forsake them in the wilderness . The pillar of cloud didn't depart from over them by day , to lead them in the way ; neither did the pillar of fire by night , to show them light , and the way in which they should go .

verses.z: 以色列人就與一切外邦人離絕，站着承認自己的罪惡和列祖的罪孽。
verses.e: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers .

verses.z: 你也賜下你良善的靈教訓他們；未嘗不賜嗎哪使他們糊口，並賜水解他們的渴。
verses.e: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them , and didn't withhold your manna from their mouth , and gave them water for their thirst .

verses.z: 在曠野四十年，你養育他們，他們就一無所缺：衣服沒有穿破，腳也沒有腫。
verses.e: " Yes , forty years you sustained them in the wilderness . They lacked nothing . Their clothes didn't grow old , and their feet didn't swell .

verses.z: 並且你將列國之地照分賜給他們，他們就得了西宏之地、希實本王之地，和巴珊王噩之地。
verses.e: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples , which you allotted according to their portions . So they possessed the land of Sihon , even the land of the king of Heshbon , and the land of Og king of Bashan .

verses.z: 你也使他們的子孫多如天上的星，帶他們到你所應許他們列祖進入得為業之地。
verses.e: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky , and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it .

verses.z: 這樣，他們進去得了那地，你在他們面前制伏那地的居民，就是迦南人；將迦南人和其君王，並那地的居民，都交在他們手裏，讓他們任意而待。
verses.e: " So the children went in and possessed the land ; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , and gave them into their hands , with their kings and the peoples of the land , that they might do with them as they pleased .

verses.z: 他們得了堅固的城邑、肥美的地土、充滿各樣美物的房屋、鑿成的水井、葡萄園、橄欖園，並許多果木樹。他們就吃而得飽，身體肥胖，因你的大恩，心中快樂。
verses.e: They took fortified cities and a rich land , and possessed houses full of all good things , cisterns dug out , vineyards , olive groves , and fruit trees in abundance . So they ate , were filled , became fat , and delighted themselves in your great goodness .

verses.z: 「然而，他們不順從，竟背叛你，將你的律法丟在背後，殺害那勸他們歸向你的眾先知，大大惹動你的怒氣。
verses.e: " Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you , cast your law behind their back , killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you , and they committed awful blasphemies .

verses.z: 所以你將他們交在敵人的手中，磨難他們。他們遭難的時候哀求你，你就從天上垂聽，照你的大憐憫賜給他們拯救者，救他們脫離敵人的手。
verses.e: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries , who distressed them . In the time of their trouble , when they cried to you , you heard from heaven ; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries .

verses.z: 但他們得平安之後，又在你面前行惡，所以你丟棄他們在仇敵的手中，使仇敵轄制他們。然而他們轉回哀求你，你仍從天上垂聽，屢次照你的憐憫拯救他們，
verses.e: But after they had rest , they did evil again before you ; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies , so that they had the dominion over them ; yet when they returned and cried to you , you heard from heaven ; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies ,

verses.z: 又警戒他們，要使他們歸服你的律法。他們卻行事狂傲，不聽從你的誡命，干犯你的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），扭轉肩頭，硬着頸項，不肯聽從。
verses.e: and testified against them , that you might bring them again to your law . Yet they were arrogant , and didn't listen to your commandments , but sinned against your ordinances ( which if a man does , he shall live in them ) , turned their backs , stiffened their neck , and would not hear .

verses.z: 那日的四分之一站在自己的地方念耶和華－他們上帝的律法書，又四分之一認罪，敬拜耶和華－他們的上帝。
verses.e: They stood up in their place , and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God a fourth part of the day ; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped the LORD their God .

verses.z: 但你多年寬容他們，又用你的靈藉眾先知勸戒他們，他們仍不聽從，所以你將他們交在列國之民的手中。
verses.e: Yet many years you put up with them , and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets . Yet they would not listen . Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands .

verses.z: 然而你大發憐憫，不全然滅絕他們，也不丟棄他們；因為你是有恩典、有憐憫的上帝。
verses.e: " Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn't make a full end of them , nor forsake them ; for you are a gracious and merciful God .

verses.z: 「我們的上帝啊，你是至大、至能、至可畏、守約施慈愛的上帝。我們的君王、首領、祭司、先知、列祖，和你的眾民，從亞述列王的時候直到今日所遭遇的苦難，現在求你不要以為小。
verses.e: Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the awesome God , who keeps covenant and loving kindness , don't let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us , on our kings , on our princes , on our priests , on our prophets , on our fathers , and on all your people , since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day .

verses.z: 在一切臨到我們的事上，你卻是公義的；因你所行的是誠實，我們所做的是邪惡。
verses.e: However you are just in all that has come on us ; for you have dealt truly , but we have done wickedly .

verses.z: 我們的君王、首領、祭司、列祖都不遵守你的律法，不聽從你的誡命和你警戒他們的話。
verses.e: Also our kings , our princes , our priests , and our fathers have not kept your law , nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them .

verses.z: 他們在本國裏沾你大恩的時候，在你所賜給他們這廣大肥美之地上不事奉你，也不轉離他們的惡行。
verses.e: For they have not served you in their kingdom , and in your great goodness that you gave them , and in the large and rich land which you gave before them . They didn't turn from their wicked works .

verses.z: 我們現今作了奴僕；至於你所賜給我們列祖享受其上的土產，並美物之地，看哪，我們在這地上作了奴僕！
verses.e: " Behold , we are servants today , and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good , behold , we are servants in it .

verses.z: 這地許多出產歸了列王，就是你因我們的罪所派轄制我們的。他們任意轄制我們的身體和牲畜，我們遭了大難。」
verses.e: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins . Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock , at their pleasure , and we are in great distress .

verses.z: 因這一切的事，我們立確實的約，寫在冊上。我們的首領、利未人，和祭司都簽了名。
verses.e: Yet for all this , we make a sure covenant , and write it ; and our princes , our Levites , and our priests , seal it . "

verses.z: 耶書亞、巴尼、甲篾、示巴尼、布尼、示利比、巴尼、基拿尼站在利未人的臺上，大聲哀求耶和華－他們的上帝。
verses.e: Then Jeshua , Bani , Kadmiel , Shebaniah , Bunni , Sherebiah , Bani , and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs , and cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God .

verses.z: 利未人耶書亞、甲篾、巴尼、哈沙尼、示利比、荷第雅、示巴尼、毗他希雅說：「你們要站起來稱頌耶和華－你們的上帝，永世無盡。耶和華啊，你榮耀之名是應當稱頌的！超乎一切稱頌和讚美。」
verses.e: Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabneiah , Sherebiah , Hodiah , Shebaniah , and Pethahiah , said , " Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting ! Blessed be your glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise !

verses.z: 「你，惟獨你是耶和華！你造了天和天上的天，並天上的萬象，地和地上的萬物，海和海中所有的；這一切都是你所保存的。天軍也都敬拜你。
verses.e: You are the LORD , even you alone . You have made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their army , the earth and all things that are on it , the seas and all that is in them , and you preserve them all . The army of heaven worships you .

verses.z: 你是耶和華上帝，曾揀選亞伯蘭，領他出迦勒底的吾珥，給他改名叫亞伯拉罕。
verses.e: You are the LORD , the God who chose Abram , brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees , gave him the name of Abraham ,

verses.z: 你見他在你面前心裏誠實，就與他立約，應許把迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、革迦撒人之地賜給他的後裔，且應驗了你的話，因為你是公義的。
verses.e: found his heart faithful before you , and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite , the Hittite , the Amorite , the Perizzite , the Jebusite , and the Girgashite , to give it to his offspring , and have performed your words , for you are righteous .

verses.z: 「你曾看見我們列祖在埃及所受的困苦，垂聽他們在紅海邊的哀求，
verses.e: " You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt , and heard their cry by the Red Sea ,

verses.z: 以色列人出埃及地後，第二年二月初一日，耶和華在西奈的曠野、會幕中曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai , in the Tent of Meeting , on the first day of the second month , in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt , saying ,

verses.z: 約瑟子孫、屬以法蓮的，有亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪；屬瑪拿西的，有比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列；
verses.e: Of the children of Joseph : of Ephraim : Elishama the son of Ammihud ; of Manasseh : Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur .

verses.z: 屬便雅憫的，有基多尼的兒子亞比但；
verses.e: Of Benjamin : Abidan the son of Gideoni .

verses.z: 屬但的，有亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝；
verses.e: Of Dan : Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai .

verses.z: 屬亞設的，有俄蘭的兒子帕結；
verses.e: Of Asher : Pagiel the son of Ochran .

verses.z: 屬迦得的，有丟珥的兒子以利雅薩；
verses.e: Of Gad : Eliasaph the son of Deuel .

verses.z: 屬拿弗他利的，有以南的兒子亞希拉。
verses.e: Of Naphtali : Ahira the son of Enan . "

verses.z: 這都是從會中選召的，各作本支派的首領，都是以色列軍中的統領。」
verses.e: These are those who were called of the congregation , the princes of the tribes of their fathers ; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel .

verses.z: 於是，摩西、亞倫帶着這些按名指定的人，
verses.e: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name .

verses.z: 當二月初一日招聚全會眾。會眾就照他們的家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外的，都述說自己的家譜。
verses.e: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month ; and they declared their ancestry by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , one by one .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，他就怎樣在西奈的曠野數點他們。
verses.e: As the LORD commanded Moses , so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai .

verses.z: 「你要按以色列全會眾的家室、宗族、人名的數目計算所有的男丁。
verses.e: " Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , every male , one by one ,

verses.z: 以色列的長子，呂便子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有四萬六千五百名。
verses.e: The children of Reuben , Israel's firstborn , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , one by one , every male from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Reuben , were forty-six thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 西緬子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有五萬九千三百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Simeon , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , those who were counted of it , according to the number of the names , one by one , every male from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Simeon , were fifty-nine thousand three hundred .

verses.z: 迦得子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名。
verses.e: Of the children of Gad , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Gad , were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty .

verses.z: 猶大子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Judah , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Judah , were seventy-four thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 以薩迦子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Issachar , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Issachar , were fifty-four thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 凡以色列中，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗的，你和亞倫要照他們的軍隊數點。
verses.e: from twenty years old and upward , all who are able to go out to war in Israel . You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions .

verses.z: 西布倫子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Zebulun , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Zebulun , were fifty-seven thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 約瑟子孫屬以法蓮子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Joseph : of the children of Ephraim , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Ephraim , were forty thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 瑪拿西子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Manasseh , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Manasseh , were thirty-two thousand two hundred .

verses.z: 便雅憫子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Benjamin , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Benjamin , were thirty-five thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 但子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Dan , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Dan , were sixty-two thousand seven hundred .

verses.z: 每支派中必有一人作本支派的族長，幫助你們。
verses.e: With you there shall be a man of every tribe , each one head of his fathers ' house .

verses.z: 亞設子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Asher , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Asher , were forty-one thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 拿弗他利子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
verses.e: Of the children of Naphtali , their generations , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war :
those who were counted of them , of the tribe of Naphtali , were fifty-three thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 這些就是被數點的，是摩西、亞倫，和以色列中十二個首領所數點的；這十二個人各作各宗族的代表。
verses.e: These are those who were counted , whom Moses and Aaron counted , and the twelve men who were princes of Israel , each one for his fathers ' house .

verses.z: 這樣，凡以色列人中被數的，照着宗族，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗、被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。
verses.e: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers ' houses , from twenty years old and upward , all who were able to go out to war in Israel —
all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty .

verses.z: 利未人卻沒有按着支派數在其中，
verses.e: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them .

verses.z: 因為耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: For the LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「惟獨利未支派你不可數點，也不可在以色列人中計算他們的總數。
verses.e: " Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count , neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel ;

verses.z: 他們的名字：屬呂便的，有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿；
verses.e: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you : Of Reuben : Elizur the son of Shedeur .

verses.z: 只要派利未人管法[櫃]的帳幕和其中的器具，並屬乎帳幕的；他們要抬帳幕和其中的器具，並要辦理帳幕的事，在帳幕的四圍安營。
verses.e: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony , and over all its furnishings , and over all that belongs to it . They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings ; and they shall take care of it , and shall encamp around it .

verses.z: 帳幕將往前行的時候，利未人要拆卸；將支搭的時候，利未人要豎起。近前來的外人必被治死。
verses.e: When the tabernacle is to move , the Levites shall take it down ; and when the tabernacle is to be set up , the Levites shall set it up . The stranger who comes near shall be put to death .

verses.z: 以色列人支搭帳棚，要照他們的軍隊，各歸本營，各歸本纛。
verses.e: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents , every man by his own camp , and every man by his own standard , according to their divisions .

verses.z: 但利未人要在法[櫃]帳幕的四圍安營，免得忿怒臨到以色列會眾；利未人並要謹守法[櫃]的帳幕。」
verses.e: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony , that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel . The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony . "

verses.z: 以色列人就這樣行。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，他們就照樣行了。
verses.e: Thus the children of Israel did . According to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so they did .

verses.z: 屬西緬的，有蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑；
verses.e: Of Simeon : Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai .

verses.z: 屬猶大的，有亞米拿達的兒子拿順；
verses.e: Of Judah : Nahshon the son of Amminadab .

verses.z: 屬以薩迦的，有蘇押的兒子拿坦業；
verses.e: Of Issachar : Nethanel the son of Zuar .

verses.z: 屬西布倫的，有希倫的兒子以利押；
verses.e: Of Zebulun : Eliab the son of Helon .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 在你們快樂的日子和節期，並月朔，獻燔祭和平安祭，也要吹號，這都要在你們的上帝面前作為紀念。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: " Also in the day of your gladness , and in your set feasts , and in the beginnings of your months , you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings , and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings ; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God . I am the LORD your God . "

verses.z: 第二年二月二十日，雲彩從法[櫃]的帳幕收上去。
verses.e: In the second year , in the second month , on the twentieth day of the month , the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant .

verses.z: 以色列人就按站往前行，離開西奈的曠野，雲彩停住在巴蘭的曠野。
verses.e: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai ; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran .

verses.z: 這是他們照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，初次往前行。
verses.e: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses .

verses.z: 按着軍隊首先往前行的是猶大營的纛。統領軍隊的是亞米拿達的兒子拿順。
verses.e: First , the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies . Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army .

verses.z: 統領以薩迦支派軍隊的是蘇押的兒子拿坦業。
verses.e: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar .

verses.z: 統領西布倫支派軍隊的是希倫的兒子以利押。
verses.e: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun .

verses.z: 帳幕拆卸，革順的子孫和米拉利的子孫就抬着帳幕先往前行。
verses.e: The tabernacle was taken down ; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari , who bore the tabernacle , went forward .

verses.z: 按着軍隊往前行的是呂便營的纛。統領軍隊的是示丟珥的兒子以利蓿。
verses.e: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies . Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army .

verses.z: 統領西緬支派軍隊的是蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑。
verses.e: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon .

verses.z: 「你要用銀子做兩枝號，都要錘出來的，用以招聚會眾，並叫眾營起行。
verses.e: " Make two trumpets of silver . You shall make them of beaten work . You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps .

verses.z: 統領迦得支派軍隊的是丟珥的兒子以利雅薩。
verses.e: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad .

verses.z: 哥轄人抬着聖物先往前行。他們未到以前，[抬帳幕的]已經把帳幕支好。
verses.e: The Kohathites set forward , bearing the sanctuary . The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived .

verses.z: 按着軍隊往前行的是以法蓮營的纛，統領軍隊的是亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪。
verses.e: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies . Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army .

verses.z: 統領瑪拿西支派軍隊的是比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列。
verses.e: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh .

verses.z: 統領便雅憫支派軍隊的是基多尼的兒子亞比但。
verses.e: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin .

verses.z: 在諸營末後的是但營的纛，按着軍隊往前行。統領軍隊的是亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝。
verses.e: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan , which was the rear guard of all the camps , set forward according to their armies . Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army .

verses.z: 統領亞設支派軍隊的是俄蘭的兒子帕結。
verses.e: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher .

verses.z: 統領拿弗他利支派軍隊的是以南的兒子亞希拉。
verses.e: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali .

verses.z: 以色列人按着軍隊往前行，就是這樣。
verses.e: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies ; and they went forward .

verses.z: 摩西對他岳父－米甸人流珥的兒子何巴－說：「我們要行路，往耶和華所應許之地去；他曾說：『我要將這地賜給你們。』現在求你和我們同去，我們必厚待你，因為耶和華指着以色列人已經應許給好處。」
verses.e: Moses said to Hobab , the son of Reuel the Midianite , Moses ' father-in-law , " We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said , ' I will give it to you . ' Come with us , and we will treat you well ; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel . "

verses.z: 吹這號的時候，全會眾要到你那裏，聚集在會幕門口。
verses.e: When they blow them , all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 何巴回答說：「我不去；我要回本地本族那裏去。」
verses.e: He said to him , " I will not go ; but I will depart to my own land , and to my relatives . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「求你不要離開我們；因為你知道我們要在曠野安營，你可以當作我們的眼目。
verses.e: Moses said , " Don't leave us , please ; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness , and you can be our eyes .

verses.z: 你若和我們同去，將來耶和華有甚麼好處待我們，我們也必以甚麼好處待你。」
verses.e: It shall be , if you go with us — yes , it shall be — that whatever good the LORD does to us , we will do the same to you . "

verses.z: 以色列人離開耶和華的山，往前行了三天的路程；耶和華的約櫃在前頭行了三天的路程，為他們尋找安歇的地方。
verses.e: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days ' journey . The ark of the LORD's covenant went before them three days ' journey , to seek out a resting place for them .

verses.z: 他們拔營往前行，日間有耶和華的雲彩在他們以上。
verses.e: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day , when they set forward from the camp .

verses.z: 約櫃往前行的時候，摩西就說：「耶和華啊，求你興起！願你的仇敵四散！願恨你的人從你面前逃跑！」
verses.e: When the ark went forward , Moses said , " Rise up , LORD , and let your enemies be scattered ! Let those who hate you flee before you ! "

verses.z: 約櫃停住的時候，他就說：「耶和華啊，求你回到以色列的千萬人中！」
verses.e: When it rested , he said , " Return , LORD , to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel . "

verses.z: 若單吹一枝，眾首領，就是以色列軍中的統領，要聚集到你那裏。
verses.e: If they blow just one , then the princes , the heads of the thousands of Israel , shall gather themselves to you .

verses.z: 吹出大聲的時候，東邊安的營都要起行。
verses.e: When you blow an alarm , the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward .

verses.z: 二次吹出大聲的時候，南邊安的營都要起行。他們將起行，必吹出大聲。
verses.e: When you blow an alarm the second time , the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward . They shall blow an alarm for their journeys .

verses.z: 但招聚會眾的時候，你們要吹號，卻不要吹出大聲。
verses.e: But when the assembly is to be gathered together , you shall blow , but you shall not sound an alarm .

verses.z: 亞倫子孫作祭司的要吹這號；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.e: " The sons of Aaron , the priests , shall blow the trumpets . This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations .

verses.z: 你們在自己的地，與欺壓你們的敵人打仗，就要用號吹出大聲，便在耶和華－你們的上帝面前得蒙紀念，也蒙拯救脫離仇敵。
verses.e: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you , then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets . Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God , and you will be saved from your enemies .

verses.z: 眾百姓發怨言，他們的惡語達到耶和華的耳中。耶和華聽見了就怒氣發作，使火在他們中間焚燒，直燒到營的邊界。
verses.e: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD . When the LORD heard it , his anger burned ; and the LORD's fire burned among them , and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp .

verses.z: 摩西聽見百姓各在各家的帳棚門口哭號。耶和華的怒氣便大發作，摩西就不喜悅。
verses.e: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families , every man at the door of his tent ; and the LORD's anger burned greatly ; and Moses was displeased .

verses.z: 摩西對耶和華說：「你為何苦待僕人？我為何不在你眼前蒙恩，竟把這管理百姓的重任加在我身上呢？
verses.e: Moses said to the LORD , " Why have you treated your servant so badly ? Why haven't I found favor in your sight , that you lay the burden of all this people on me ?

verses.z: 這百姓豈是我懷的胎，豈是我生下來的呢？你竟對我說：『把他們抱在懷裏，如養育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓應許給他們祖宗的地去。』
verses.e: Have I conceived all this people ? Have I brought them out , that you should tell me , ' Carry them in your bosom , as a nurse carries a nursing infant , to the land which you swore to their fathers ' ?

verses.z: 我從哪裏得肉給這百姓吃呢？他們都向我哭號說：『你給我們肉吃吧！』
verses.e: Where could I get meat to give all these people ? For they weep before me , saying , ' Give us meat , that we may eat . '

verses.z: 管理這百姓的責任太重了，我獨自擔當不起。
verses.e: I am not able to bear all this people alone , because it is too heavy for me .

verses.z: 你這樣待我，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你立時將我殺了，不叫我見自己的苦情。」
verses.e: If you treat me this way , please kill me right now , if I have found favor in your sight ; and don't let me see my wretchedness . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你從以色列的長老中招聚七十個人，就是你所知道作百姓的長老和官長的，到我這裏來，領他們到會幕前，使他們和你一同站立。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel , whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them ; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting , that they may stand there with you .

verses.z: 我要在那裏降臨，與你說話，也要把降於你身上的靈分賜他們，他們就和你同當這管百姓的重任，免得你獨自擔當。
verses.e: I will come down and talk with you there . I will take of the Spirit which is on you , and will put it on them ; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you , that you don't bear it yourself alone .

verses.z: 又要對百姓說：『你們應當自潔，預備明天吃肉，因為你們哭號說：誰給我們肉吃！我們在埃及很好。這聲音達到了耶和華的耳中，所以他必給你們肉吃。
verses.e: " Say to the people , ' Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow , and you will eat meat ; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD , saying , " Who will give us meat to eat ? For it was well with us in Egypt . " Therefore the LORD will give you meat , and you will eat .

verses.z: 你們不止吃一天、兩天、五天、十天、二十天，
verses.e: You will not eat just one day , or two days , or five days , or ten days , or twenty days ,

verses.z: 百姓向摩西哀求，摩西祈求耶和華，火就熄了。
verses.e: The people cried to Moses ; and Moses prayed to the LORD , and the fire abated .

verses.z: 要吃一個整月，甚至肉從你們鼻孔裏噴出來，使你們厭惡了，因為你們厭棄住在你們中間的耶和華，在他面前哭號說：我們為何出了埃及呢！』」
verses.e: but a whole month , until it comes out at your nostrils , and it is loathsome to you ; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you , and have wept before him , saying , " Why did we come out of Egypt ? " ' "

verses.z: 摩西[對耶和華]說：「這與我同住的百姓、步行的男人有六十萬，你還說：『我要把肉給他們，使他們可以吃一個整月。』
verses.e: Moses said , " The people , among whom I am , are six hundred thousand men on foot ; and you have said , ' I will give them meat , that they may eat a whole month . '

verses.z: 難道給他們宰了羊群牛群，或是把海中所有的魚都聚了來，就夠他們吃嗎？」
verses.e: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them , to be sufficient for them ? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them , to be sufficient for them ? "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「耶和華的膀臂豈是縮短了嗎？現在要看我的話向你應驗不應驗。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Has the LORD's hand grown short ? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not . "

verses.z: 摩西出去，將耶和華的話告訴百姓，又招聚百姓的長老中七十個人來，使他們站在[會]幕的四圍。
verses.e: Moses went out , and told the people the LORD's words ; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them around the Tent .

verses.z: 耶和華在雲中降臨，對摩西說話，把降與他身上的靈分賜那七十個長老。靈停在他們身上的時候，他們就受感說話，以後卻沒有再說。
verses.e: The LORD came down in the cloud , and spoke to him , and took of the Spirit that was on him , and put it on the seventy elders . When the Spirit rested on them , they prophesied , but they did so no more .

verses.z: 但有兩個人仍在營裏，一個名叫伊利達，一個名叫米達。他們本是在那些被錄的人中，卻沒有到[會]幕那裏去。靈停在他們身上，他們就在營裏說預言。
verses.e: But two men remained in the camp . The name of one was Eldad , and the name of the other Medad ; and the Spirit rested on them . They were of those who were written , but had not gone out to the Tent ; and they prophesied in the camp .

verses.z: 有個少年人跑來告訴摩西說：「伊利達、米達在營裏說預言。」
verses.e: A young man ran , and told Moses , and said , " Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp ! "

verses.z: 摩西的幫手，嫩的兒子約書亞，就是摩西所揀選的一個人，說：「請我主摩西禁止他們。」
verses.e: Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of Moses , one of his chosen men , answered , " My lord Moses , forbid them ! "

verses.z: 摩西對他說：「你為我的緣故嫉妒人嗎？惟願耶和華的百姓都受感說話！願耶和華把他的靈降在他們身上！」
verses.e: Moses said to him , " Are you jealous for my sake ? I wish that all the LORD's people were prophets , that the LORD would put his Spirit on them ! "

verses.z: 那地方便叫做他備拉，因為耶和華的火燒在他們中間。
verses.e: The name of that place was called Taberah , because the LORD's fire burned among them .

verses.z: 於是，摩西和以色列的長老都回到營裏去。
verses.e: Moses went into the camp , he and the elders of Israel .

verses.z: 有風從耶和華那裏颳起，把鵪鶉由海面颳來，飛散在營邊和營的四圍；這邊約有一天的路程，那邊約有一天的路程，離地面約有二肘。
verses.e: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea , and let them fall by the camp , about a day's journey on this side , and a day's journey on the other side , around the camp , and about two cubits above the surface of the earth .

verses.z: 百姓起來，終日終夜，並次日一整天，捕取鵪鶉；至少的也取了十賀梅珥，為自己擺列在營的四圍。
verses.e: The people rose up all that day , and all of that night , and all the next day , and gathered the quails . He who gathered least gathered ten homers ; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp .

verses.z: 肉在他們牙齒之間尚未嚼爛，耶和華的怒氣就向他們發作，用最重的災殃擊殺了他們。
verses.e: While the meat was still between their teeth , before it was chewed , the LORD's anger burned against the people , and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague .

verses.z: 那地方便叫做基博羅‧哈他瓦，因為他們在那裏葬埋那起貪慾之心的人。
verses.e: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah , because there they buried the people who lusted .

verses.z: 百姓從基博羅‧哈他瓦走到哈洗錄，就住在哈洗錄。
verses.e: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth ; and they stayed at Hazeroth .

verses.z: 他們中間的閒雜人大起貪慾的心；以色列人又哭號說：「誰給我們肉吃呢？
verses.e: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly ; and the children of Israel also wept again , and said , " Who will give us meat to eat ?

verses.z: 我們記得，在埃及的時候不花錢就吃魚，也記得有黃瓜、西瓜、韭菜、誄、蒜。
verses.e: We remember the fish , which we ate in Egypt for nothing ; the cucumbers , and the melons , and the leeks , and the onions , and the garlic ;

verses.z: 現在我們的心血枯竭了，除這嗎哪以外，在我們眼前並沒有別的東西。」
verses.e: but now we have lost our appetite . There is nothing at all except this manna to look at . "

verses.z: 這嗎哪彷彿芫荽子，又好像珍珠。
verses.e: The manna was like coriander seed , and it looked like bdellium .

verses.z: 百姓周圍行走，把嗎哪收起來，或用磨推，或用臼搗，煮在鍋中，又做成餅，滋味好像新油。
verses.e: The people went around , gathered it , and ground it in mills , or beat it in mortars , and boiled it in pots , and made cakes of it . Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil .

verses.z: 夜間露水降在營中，嗎哪也隨着降下。）
verses.e: When the dew fell on the camp in the night , the manna fell on it .

verses.z: 摩西娶了古實女子為妻。米利暗和亞倫因他所娶的古實女子就毀謗他，說：
verses.e: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married ; for he had married a Cushite woman .

verses.z: 雲彩從[會]幕上挪開了，不料，米利暗長了大痲瘋，有雪[那樣]白。亞倫一看米利暗長了大痲瘋，
verses.e: The cloud departed from over the Tent ; and behold , Miriam was leprous , as white as snow . Aaron looked at Miriam , and behold , she was leprous .

verses.z: 就對摩西說：「我主啊，求你不要因我們愚昧犯罪，便將這罪加在我們身上。
verses.e: Aaron said to Moses , " Oh , my lord , please don't count this sin against us , in which we have done foolishly , and in which we have sinned .

verses.z: 求你不要使她像那出母腹、肉已半爛的死胎。」
verses.e: Let her not , I pray , be as one dead , of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb . "

verses.z: 於是摩西哀求耶和華說：「上帝啊，求你醫治她！」
verses.e: Moses cried to the LORD , saying , " Heal her , God , I beg you ! "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「她父親若吐唾沫在她臉上，她豈不蒙羞七天嗎？現在要把她在營外關鎖七天，然後才可以領她進來。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " If her father had but spit in her face , shouldn't she be ashamed seven days ? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days , and after that she shall be brought in again . "

verses.z: 於是米利暗關鎖在營外七天。百姓沒有行路，直等到把米利暗領進來。
verses.e: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days , and the people didn't travel until Miriam was brought in again .

verses.z: 以後百姓從哈洗錄起行，在巴蘭的曠野安營。
verses.e: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth , and encamped in the wilderness of Paran .

verses.z: 「難道耶和華單與摩西說話，不也與我們說話嗎？」這話耶和華聽見了。（
verses.e: They said , " Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses ? Hasn't he spoken also with us ? " And the LORD heard it .

verses.z: 摩西為人極其謙和，勝過世上的眾人。）
verses.e: Now the man Moses was very humble , more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth .

verses.z: 耶和華忽然對摩西、亞倫、米利暗說：「你們三個人都出來，到會幕這裏。」他們三個人就出來了。
verses.e: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses , to Aaron , and to Miriam , " You three come out to the Tent of Meeting ! " The three of them came out .

verses.z: 耶和華在雲柱中降臨，站在[會]幕門口，召亞倫和米利暗，二人就出來了。
verses.e: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud , and stood at the door of the Tent , and called Aaron and Miriam ; and they both came forward .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「你們且聽我的話：你們中間若有先知，我－耶和華必在異象中向他顯現，在夢中與他說話。
verses.e: He said , " Now hear my words . If there is a prophet among you , I , the LORD , will make myself known to him in a vision . I will speak with him in a dream .

verses.z: 我的僕人摩西不是這樣；他是在我全家盡忠的。
verses.e: My servant Moses is not so . He is faithful in all my house .

verses.z: 我要與他面對面說話，乃是明說，不用謎語，並且他必見我的形像。你們毀謗我的僕人摩西，為何不懼怕呢？」
verses.e: With him , I will speak mouth to mouth , even plainly , and not in riddles ; and he shall see the LORD's form . Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant , against Moses ? "

verses.z: 耶和華就向他們二人發怒而去。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against them ; and he departed .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 屬西布倫支派的有梭底的兒子迦疊。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Zebulun , Gaddiel the son of Sodi .

verses.z: 約瑟的子孫，屬瑪拿西支派的有穌西的兒子迦底。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Joseph , of the tribe of Manasseh , Gaddi the son of Susi .

verses.z: 屬但支派的有基瑪利的兒子亞米利。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Dan , Ammiel the son of Gemalli .

verses.z: 屬亞設支派的有米迦勒的兒子西帖。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Asher , Sethur the son of Michael .

verses.z: 屬拿弗他利支派的有縛西的兒子拿比。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Naphtali , Nahbi the son of Vophsi .

verses.z: 屬迦得支派的有瑪基的兒子臼利。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Gad , Geuel the son of Machi .

verses.z: 這就是摩西所打發、窺探那地之人的名字。摩西就稱嫩的兒子何希阿為約書亞。
verses.e: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land . Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua .

verses.z: 摩西打發他們去窺探迦南地，說：「你們從南地上山地去，
verses.e: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan , and said to them , " Go up this way by the South , and go up into the hill country .

verses.z: 看那地如何，其中所住的民是強是弱，是多是少，
verses.e: See the land , what it is ; and the people who dwell therein , whether they are strong or weak , whether they are few or many ;

verses.z: 所住之地是好是歹，所住之處是營盤是堅城。
verses.e: and what the land is that they dwell in , whether it is good or bad ; and what cities they are that they dwell in , whether in camps , or in strongholds ;

verses.z: 「你打發人去窺探我所賜給以色列人的迦南地，他們每支派中要打發一個人，都要作首領的。」
verses.e: " Send men , that they may spy out the land of Canaan , which I give to the children of Israel . Of every tribe of their fathers , you shall send a man , every one a prince among them . "

verses.z: 又看那地土是肥美是瘠薄，其中有樹木沒有。你們要放開膽量，把那地的果子帶些來。」（那時正是葡萄初熟的時候。）
verses.e: and what the land is , whether it is fertile or poor , whether there is wood therein , or not . Be courageous , and bring some of the fruit of the land . " Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes .

verses.z: 他們上去窺探那地，從尋的曠野到利合，直到哈馬口。
verses.e: So they went up , and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob , to the entrance of Hamath .

verses.z: 他們從南地上去，到了希伯崙；在那裏有亞衲族人亞希幔、示篩、撻買。（原來希伯崙城被建造比埃及的鎖安城早七年。）
verses.e: They went up by the South , and came to Hebron ; and Ahiman , Sheshai , and Talmai , the children of Anak , were there . ( Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt . )

verses.z: 他們到了以實各谷，從那裏砍了葡萄樹的一枝，上頭有一掛葡萄，兩個人用槓抬着，又[帶了]些石榴和無花果來。（
verses.e: They came to the valley of Eshcol , and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes , and they bore it on a staff between two . They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs .

verses.z: 因為以色列人從那裏砍來的那掛葡萄，所以那地方叫做以實各谷。）
verses.e: That place was called the valley of Eshcol , because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there .

verses.z: 過了四十天，他們窺探那地才回來，
verses.e: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days .

verses.z: 到了巴蘭曠野的加低斯，見摩西、亞倫，並以色列的全會眾，回報摩西、亞倫，並全會眾，又把那地的果子給他們看；
verses.e: They went and came to Moses , to Aaron , and to all the congregation of the children of Israel , to the wilderness of Paran , to Kadesh ; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation . They showed them the fruit of the land .

verses.z: 又告訴摩西說：「我們到了你所打發我們去的那地，果然是流奶與蜜之地；這就是那地的果子。
verses.e: They told him , and said , " We came to the land where you sent us . Surely it flows with milk and honey , and this is its fruit .

verses.z: 然而住那地的民強壯，城邑也堅固寬大，並且我們在那裏看見了亞衲族的人。
verses.e: However , the people who dwell in the land are strong , and the cities are fortified and very large . Moreover , we saw the children of Anak there .

verses.z: 亞瑪力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亞摩利人住在山地；迦南人住在海邊並約旦河旁。」
verses.e: Amalek dwells in the land of the South . The Hittite , the Jebusite , and the Amorite dwell in the hill country . The Canaanite dwells by the sea , and along the side of the Jordan . "

verses.z: 摩西就照耶和華的吩咐從巴蘭的曠野打發他們去；他們都是以色列人的族長。
verses.e: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD . All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 迦勒在摩西面前安撫百姓，說：「我們立刻上去得那地吧！我們足能得勝。」
verses.e: Caleb stilled the people before Moses , and said , " Let's go up at once , and possess it ; for we are well able to overcome it ! "

verses.z: 但那些和他同去的人說：「我們不能上去攻擊那民，因為他們比我們強壯。」
verses.e: But the men who went up with him said , " We aren't able to go up against the people ; for they are stronger than we . "

verses.z: 探子[中有]人論到所窺探之地，向以色列人報惡信，說：「我們所窺探、經過之地是吞吃居民之地，我們在那裏所看見的人民都身量高大。
verses.e: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel , saying , " The land , through which we have gone to spy it out , is a land that eats up its inhabitants ; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature .

verses.z: 我們在那裏看見亞衲族人，就是偉人；他們是偉人的後裔。據我們看，自己就如蚱蜢一樣；據他們看，我們也是如此。」
verses.e: There we saw the Nephilim , the sons of Anak , who come from the Nephilim . We were in our own sight as grasshoppers , and so we were in their sight . "

verses.z: 他們的名字：屬呂便支派的有撒刻的兒子沙母亞。
verses.e: These were their names : Of the tribe of Reuben , Shammua the son of Zaccur .

verses.z: 屬西緬支派的有何利的兒子沙法。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Simeon , Shaphat the son of Hori .

verses.z: 屬猶大支派的有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Judah , Caleb the son of Jephunneh .

verses.z: 屬以薩迦支派的有約色的兒子以迦。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Issachar , Igal the son of Joseph .

verses.z: 屬以法蓮支派的有嫩的兒子何希阿。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Ephraim , Hoshea the son of Nun .

verses.z: 屬便雅憫支派的有拉孚的兒子帕提。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Benjamin , Palti the son of Raphu .

verses.z: 當下，全會眾大聲喧嚷；那夜百姓都哭號。
verses.e: All the congregation lifted up their voice , and cried ; and the people wept that night .

verses.z: 但全會眾說：「拿石頭打死他們[二人]。」忽然，耶和華的榮光在會幕中向以色列眾人顯現。
verses.e: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones . The LORD's glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「這百姓藐視我要到幾時呢？我在他們中間行了這一切神蹟，他們還不信我要到幾時呢？
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " How long will this people despise me ? How long will they not believe in me , for all the signs which I have worked among them ?

verses.z: 我要用瘟疫擊殺他們，使他們不得承受[那地]，叫你的後裔成為大國，比他們強勝。」
verses.e: I will strike them with the pestilence , and disinherit them , and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they . "

verses.z: 摩西對耶和華說：「埃及人必聽見這事；因為你曾施展大能，將這百姓從他們中間領上來。
verses.e: Moses said to the LORD , " Then the Egyptians will hear it ; for you brought up this people in your might from among them .

verses.z: 埃及人要將這事傳給迦南地的居民；那民已經聽見你－耶和華是在這百姓中間；因為你面對面被人看見，有你的雲彩停在他們以上。你日間在雲柱中，夜間在火柱中，在他們前面行。
verses.e: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land . They have heard that you LORD are among this people ; for you LORD are seen face to face , and your cloud stands over them , and you go before them , in a pillar of cloud by day , and in a pillar of fire by night .

verses.z: 如今你若把這百姓殺了，如殺一人，那些聽見你名聲的列邦必議論說：
verses.e: Now if you killed this people as one man , then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak , saying ,

verses.z: 『耶和華因為不能把這百姓領進他向他們起誓應許之地，所以在曠野把他們殺了。』
verses.e: ' Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them , therefore he has slain them in the wilderness . '

verses.z: 現在求主大顯能力，照你所說過的話說：
verses.e: Now please let the power of the Lord be great , according as you have spoken , saying ,

verses.z: 『耶和華不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛，赦免罪孽和過犯；萬不以[有罪的]為無罪，必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。』
verses.e: ' The LORD is slow to anger , and abundant in loving kindness , forgiving iniquity and disobedience ; and he will by no means clear the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children , on the third and on the fourth generation . '

verses.z: 求你照你的大慈愛赦免這百姓的罪孽，好像你從埃及到如今常赦免他們一樣。」
verses.e: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness , and just as you have forgiven this people , from Egypt even until now . "

verses.z: 以色列眾人向摩西、亞倫發怨言；全會眾對他們說：「巴不得我們早死在埃及地，或是死在這曠野。
verses.e: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron . The whole congregation said to them , " We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt , or that we had died in this wilderness !

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我照着你的話赦免了他們。
verses.e: The LORD said , " I have pardoned according to your word ;

verses.z: 然我指着我的永生起誓，遍地要被我的榮耀充滿。
verses.e: but in very deed — as I live , and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD's glory —

verses.z: 這些人雖看見我的榮耀和我在埃及與曠野所行的神蹟，仍然試探我這十次，不聽從我的話，
verses.e: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs , which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness , yet have tempted me these ten times , and have not listened to my voice ;

verses.z: 他們斷不得看見我向他們的祖宗所起誓應許之地。凡藐視我的，一個也不得看見；
verses.e: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers , neither shall any of those who despised me see it .

verses.z: 惟獨我的僕人迦勒，因他另有一個心志，專一跟從我，我就把他領進他所去過的那地；他的後裔也必得那地為業。
verses.e: But my servant Caleb , because he had another spirit with him , and has followed me fully , him I will bring into the land into which he went . His offspring shall possess it .

verses.z: 亞瑪力人和迦南人住在谷中，明天你們要轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去。」
verses.e: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley , tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 「這惡會眾向我發怨言，[我忍耐]他們要到幾時呢？以色列人向我所發的怨言，我都聽見了。
verses.e: " How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me ? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel , which they complain against me .

verses.z: 你們告訴他們，耶和華說：『我指着我的永生起誓，我必要照你們達到我耳中的話待你們。
verses.e: Tell them , ' As I live , says the LORD , surely as you have spoken in my ears , so I will do to you .

verses.z: 你們的屍首必倒在這曠野，並且你們中間凡被數點、從二十歲以外、向我發怨言的，
verses.e: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness ; and all who were counted of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , who have complained against me ,

verses.z: 耶和華為甚麼把我們領到那地，使我們倒在刀下呢？我們的妻子和孩子必被擄掠。我們回埃及去豈不好嗎？」
verses.e: Why does the LORD bring us to this land , to fall by the sword ? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed ! Wouldn't it be better for us to return into Egypt ? "

verses.z: 必不得進我起誓應許叫你們住的那地；惟有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞才能進去。
verses.e: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein , except Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .

verses.z: 但你們的[婦人]孩子，就是你們所說、要被擄掠的，我必把他們領進去，他們就得知你們所厭棄的那地。
verses.e: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed , and they shall know the land which you have rejected .

verses.z: 至於你們，你們的屍首必倒在這曠野；
verses.e: But as for you , your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness .

verses.z: 你們的兒女必在曠野飄流四十年，擔當你們淫行的罪，直到你們的屍首在曠野消滅。
verses.e: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years , and shall bear your prostitution , until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness .

verses.z: 按你們窺探那地的四十日，一年頂一日，你們要擔當罪孽四十年，就知道我與你們疏遠了，
verses.e: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land , even forty days , for every day a year , you will bear your iniquities , even forty years , and you will know my alienation . '

verses.z: 我－耶和華說過，我總要這樣待這一切聚集敵我的惡會眾；他們必在這曠野消滅，在這裏死亡。』」
verses.e: I , the LORD , have spoken . I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me . In this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die . "

verses.z: 摩西所打發、窺探那地的人回來，報那地的惡信，叫全會眾向摩西發怨言，
verses.e: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land , who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land ,

verses.z: 這些報惡信的人都遭瘟疫，死在耶和華面前。
verses.e: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land , died by the plague before the LORD .

verses.z: 其中惟有嫩的兒子約書亞和耶孚尼的兒子迦勒仍然存活。
verses.e: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land .

verses.z: 摩西將這些話告訴以色列眾人，他們就甚悲哀。
verses.e: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel , and the people mourned greatly .

verses.z: 眾人彼此說：「我們不如立一個首領回埃及去吧！」
verses.e: They said to one another , " Let's choose a leader , and let's return into Egypt . "

verses.z: 清早起來，上山頂去，說：「我們在這裏，我們有罪了；情願上耶和華所應許的地方去。」
verses.e: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain , saying , " Behold , we are here , and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised ; for we have sinned . "

verses.z: 摩西說：「你們為何違背耶和華的命令呢？這事不能順利了。
verses.e: Moses said , " Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD , since it shall not prosper ?

verses.z: 不要上去；因為耶和華不在你們中間，恐怕你們被仇敵殺敗了。
verses.e: Don't go up , for the LORD isn't among you ; that way you won't be struck down before your enemies .

verses.z: 亞瑪力人和迦南人都在你們面前，你們必倒在刀下；因你們退回不跟從耶和華，所以他必不與你們同在。」
verses.e: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you , and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD ; therefore the LORD will not be with you . "

verses.z: 他們卻擅敢上山頂去，然而耶和華的約櫃和摩西沒有出營。
verses.e: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain . Nevertheless , the ark of the LORD's covenant and Moses didn't depart out of the camp .

verses.z: 於是亞瑪力人和住在那山上的迦南人都下來擊打他們，把他們殺退了，直到何珥瑪。
verses.e: Then the Amalekites came down , and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain , and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫就俯伏在以色列全會眾面前。
verses.e: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 窺探地的人中，嫩的兒子約書亞和耶孚尼的兒子迦勒撕裂衣服，
verses.e: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , who were of those who spied out the land , tore their clothes .

verses.z: 對以色列全會眾說：「我們所窺探、經過之地是極美之地。
verses.e: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel , saying , " The land , which we passed through to spy it out , is an exceedingly good land .

verses.z: 耶和華若喜悅我們，就必將我們領進那地，把地賜給我們；那地原是流奶與蜜之地。
verses.e: If the LORD delights in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it to us : a land which flows with milk and honey .

verses.z: 但你們不可背叛耶和華，也不要怕那地的居民；因為他們是我們的食物，並且蔭庇他們的已經離開他們。有耶和華與我們同在，不要怕他們！」
verses.e: Only don't rebel against the LORD , neither fear the people of the land ; for they are bread for us . Their defense is removed from over them , and the LORD is with us . Don't fear them . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine , for an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 「獻公牛、公綿羊、綿羊羔、山羊羔，每隻都要這樣辦理。
verses.e: Thus it shall be done for each bull , for each ram , for each of the male lambs , or of the young goats .

verses.z: 照你們所預備的數目，按着隻數都要這樣辦理。
verses.e: According to the number that you shall prepare , so you shall do to everyone according to their number .

verses.z: 凡本地人將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，都要這樣辦理。
verses.e: " ' All who are native-born shall do these things in this way , in offering an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 若有外人和你們同居，或有人世世代代住在你們中間，願意將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，你們怎樣辦理，他也要照樣辦理。
verses.e: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you , or whoever may be among you throughout your generations , and will offer an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD , as you do , so he shall do .

verses.z: 至於會眾，你們和同居的外人都歸一例，作為你們世世代代永遠的定例，在耶和華面前，你們怎樣，寄居的也要怎樣。
verses.e: For the assembly , there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner , a statute forever throughout your generations . As you are , so the foreigner shall be before the LORD .

verses.z: 你們並與你們同居的外人當有一樣的條例，一樣的典章。」
verses.e: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所領你們進去的那地，
