verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When you come into the land where I bring you ,

verses.z: 吃那地的糧食，就要把舉祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land , you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所賜給你們居住的地，
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When you have come into the land of your habitations , which I give to you ,

verses.z: 你們要用初熟的麥子磨麵，做餅當舉祭奉獻；你們舉上，好像舉禾場的舉祭一樣。
verses.e: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering . As the wave offering of the threshing floor , so you shall heave it .

verses.z: 你們世世代代要用初熟的麥子磨麵，當舉祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: Of the first of your dough , you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations .

verses.z: 「你們有錯誤的時候，不守耶和華所曉諭摩西的這一切命令，
verses.e: " ' When you err , and don't observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses —

verses.z: 就是耶和華藉摩西一切所吩咐你們的，自那日以至你們的世世代代，
verses.e: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses , from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations —

verses.z: 若有誤行，是會眾所不知道的，後來全會眾就要將一隻公牛犢作燔祭，並照典章把素祭和奠祭一同獻給耶和華為馨香[之祭]，又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭。
verses.e: then it shall be , if it was done unwittingly , without the knowledge of the congregation , that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering , for a pleasant aroma to the LORD , with its meal offering and its drink offering , according to the ordinance , and one male goat for a sin offering .

verses.z: 祭司要為以色列全會眾贖罪，他們就必蒙赦免，因為這是錯誤。他們又因自己的錯誤，把供物，就是向耶和華獻的火祭和贖罪祭，一並奉到耶和華面前。
verses.e: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel , and they shall be forgiven ; for it was an error , and they have brought their offering , an offering made by fire to the LORD , and their sin offering before the LORD , for their error .

verses.z: 以色列全會眾和寄居在他們中間的外人就必蒙赦免，因為這罪是百姓誤犯的。
verses.e: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven , as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them ; for with regard to all the people , it was done unwittingly .

verses.z: 「若有一個人誤犯了罪，他就要獻一歲的母山羊作贖罪祭。
verses.e: " ' If a person sins unwittingly , then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering .

verses.z: 那誤行的人犯罪的時候，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪，他就必蒙赦免。
verses.e: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD . He shall make atonement for him ; and he shall be forgiven .

verses.z: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他們中間的外人，若誤行了甚麼事，必歸一樣的條例。
verses.e: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly , for him who is native-born among the children of Israel , and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them .

verses.z: 若願意從牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，獻給耶和華，無論是燔祭是[平安]祭，為要還特許的願，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你們節期獻的，都要奉給耶和華為馨香[之祭]。
verses.e: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD — a burnt offering , or a sacrifice , to accomplish a vow , or as a free will offering , or in your set feasts , to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD , of the herd , or of the flock —

verses.z: 但那擅敢行事的，無論是本地人是寄居的，他褻瀆了耶和華，必從民中剪除。
verses.e: " ' But the soul who does anything with a high hand , whether he is native-born or a foreigner , blasphemes the LORD . That soul shall be cut off from among his people .

verses.z: 因他藐視耶和華的言語，違背耶和華的命令，那人總要剪除；他的罪孽要歸到他身上。」
verses.e: Because he has despised the LORD's word , and has broken his commandment , that soul shall be utterly cut off . His iniquity shall be on him . ' "

verses.z: 以色列人在曠野的時候，遇見一個人在安息日撿柴。
verses.e: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness , they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day .

verses.z: 遇見他撿柴的人，就把他帶到摩西、亞倫並全會眾那裏，
verses.e: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron , and to all the congregation .

verses.z: 將他收在監內；因為當怎樣辦他，還沒有指明。
verses.e: They put him in custody , because it had not been declared what should be done to him .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「總要把那人治死；全會眾要在營外用石頭把他打死。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " The man shall surely be put to death . All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp . "

verses.z: 於是全會眾將他帶到營外，用石頭打死他，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp , and stoned him to death with stones , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人，叫他們世世代代在衣服邊上做繸子，又在底邊的繸子上釘一根藍細帶子。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations , and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue .

verses.z: 你們佩帶這繸子，好叫你們看見就記念遵行耶和華一切的命令，不隨從自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你們素常一樣；
verses.e: It shall be to you for a fringe , that you may see it , and remember all the LORD's commandments , and do them ; and that you don't follow your own heart and your own eyes , after which you used to play the prostitute ;

verses.z: 那獻供物的就要將細麵[伊法]十分之一，並油一欣四分之一，調和作素祭，獻給耶和華。
verses.e: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil .

verses.z: 使你們記念遵行我一切的命令，成為聖潔，歸與你們的上帝。
verses.e: so that you may remember and do all my commandments , and be holy to your God .

verses.z: 「我是耶和華－你們的上帝，曾把你們從埃及地領出來，要作你們的上帝。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
verses.e: I am the LORD your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the LORD your God . "

verses.z: 無論是燔祭是[平安]祭，你要為每隻綿羊羔，一同預備奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。
verses.e: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering , one fourth of a hin , with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice , for each lamb .

verses.z: 為公綿羊預備細麵[伊法]十分之二，並油一欣三分之一，調和作素祭，
verses.e: " ' For a ram , you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil ;

verses.z: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香[之祭]。
verses.e: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 你預備公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，為要還特許的願，或是作平安祭，獻給耶和華，
verses.e: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice , to accomplish a vow , or for peace offerings to the LORD ,

verses.z: 就要把細麵[伊法]十分之三，並油半欣，調和作素祭，和公牛一同獻上，
verses.e: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil ;

verses.z: 利未的曾孫、哥轄的孫子、以斯哈的兒子可拉，和呂便子孫中以利押的兒子大坍、亞比蘭，與比勒的兒子安，
verses.e: Now Korah , the son of Izhar , the son of Kohath , the son of Levi , with Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , and On , the son of Peleth , sons of Reuben , took some men .

verses.z: 耶和華又使你和你一切弟兄－利未的子孫－一同親近他，這豈為小事？你們還要求祭司的職任嗎？
verses.e: and that he has brought you near , and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you ? Do you seek the priesthood also ?

verses.z: 你和你一黨的人聚集是要攻擊耶和華。亞倫算甚麼，你們竟向他發怨言呢？」
verses.e: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against the LORD ! What is Aaron that you complain against him ? "

verses.z: 摩西打發人去召以利押的兒子大坍、亞比蘭。他們說：「我們不上去！
verses.e: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab ; and they said , " We won't come up !

verses.z: 你將我們從流奶與蜜之地領上來，要在曠野殺我們，這豈為小事？你還要自立為王轄管我們嗎？
verses.e: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey , to kill us in the wilderness , but you must also make yourself a prince over us ?

verses.z: 並且你沒有將我們領到流奶與蜜之地，也沒有把田地和葡萄園給我們為業。難道你要剜這些人的眼睛嗎？我們不上去！」
verses.e: Moreover you haven't brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey , nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards . Will you put out the eyes of these men ? We won't come up . "

verses.z: 摩西就甚發怒，對耶和華說：「求你不要享受他們的供物。我並沒有奪過他們一匹驢，也沒有害過他們一個人。」
verses.e: Moses was very angry , and said to the LORD , " Don't respect their offering . I have not taken one donkey from them , neither have I hurt one of them . "

verses.z: 摩西對可拉說：「明天，你和你一黨的人，並亞倫，都要站在耶和華面前；
verses.e: Moses said to Korah , " You and all your company go before the LORD , you , and they , and Aaron , tomorrow .

verses.z: 各人要拿一個香爐，共二百五十個，把香放在上面，到耶和華面前。你和亞倫也各拿自己的香爐。」
verses.e: Each man take his censer and put incense on it , and each man bring before the LORD his censer , two hundred fifty censers ; you also , and Aaron , each with his censer . "

verses.z: 於是他們各人拿一個香爐，盛上火，加上香，同摩西、亞倫站在會幕門前。
verses.e: They each took his censer , and put fire in it , and laid incense on it , and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron .

verses.z: 可拉招聚全會眾到會幕門前，要攻擊摩西、亞倫；耶和華的榮光就向全會眾顯現。
verses.e: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting . The LORD's glory appeared to all the congregation .

verses.z: 並以色列會中的二百五十個首領，就是有名望選入會中的人，在摩西面前一同起來，
verses.e: They rose up before Moses , with some of the children of Israel , two hundred fifty princes of the congregation , called to the assembly , men of renown .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們離開這會眾，我好在轉眼之間把他們滅絕。」
verses.e: " Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment ! "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫就俯伏在地，說：「上帝，萬人之靈的上帝啊，一人犯罪，你就要向全會眾發怒嗎？」
verses.e: They fell on their faces , and said , " God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and will you be angry with all the congregation ? "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你吩咐會眾說：『你們離開可拉、大坍、亞比蘭帳棚的四圍。』」
verses.e: " Speak to the congregation , saying , ' Get away from around the tent of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram ! ' "

verses.z: 摩西起來，往大坍、亞比蘭那裏去；以色列的長老也隨着他去。
verses.e: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram ; and the elders of Israel followed him .

verses.z: 他吩咐會眾說：「你們離開這惡人的帳棚吧，他們的物件，甚麼都不可摸，恐怕你們陷在他們的罪中，與他們一同消滅。」
verses.e: He spoke to the congregation , saying , " Depart , please , from the tents of these wicked men , and touch nothing of theirs , lest you be consumed in all their sins ! "

verses.z: 於是眾人離開可拉、大坍、亞比蘭帳棚的四圍。大坍、亞比蘭帶着妻子、兒女、小孩子，都出來，站在自己的帳棚門口。
verses.e: So they went away from the tent of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram , on every side . Dathan and Abiram came out , and stood at the door of their tents with their wives , their sons , and their little ones .

verses.z: 摩西說：「我行的這一切事本不是憑我自己心意行的，乃是耶和華打發我行的，必有證據使你們知道。
verses.e: Moses said , " Hereby you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works ; for they are not from my own mind .

verses.z: 這些人死若與世人無異，或是他們所遭的與世人相同，就不是耶和華打發我來的。
verses.e: If these men die the common death of all men , or if they experience what all men experience , then the LORD hasn't sent me .

verses.z: 聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫，說：「你們擅自專權！全會眾個個既是聖潔，耶和華也在他們中間，你們為甚麼自高，超過耶和華的會眾呢？」
verses.e: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron , and said to them , " You take too much on yourself , since all the congregation are holy , everyone of them , and the LORD is among them ! Why do you lift yourselves up above the LORD's assembly ? "

verses.z: 倘若耶和華創作一件新事，使地開口，把他們和一切屬他們的都吞下去，叫他們活活地墜落陰間，你們就明白這些人是藐視耶和華了。」
verses.e: But if the LORD makes a new thing , and the ground opens its mouth , and swallows them up with all that belong to them , and they go down alive into Sheol , then you shall understand that these men have despised the LORD . "

verses.z: 摩西剛說完了這一切話，他們腳下的地就開了口，
verses.e: As he finished speaking all these words , the ground that was under them split apart .

verses.z: 把他們和他們的家眷，並一切屬可拉的人丁、財物，都吞下去。
verses.e: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households , all of Korah's men , and all their goods .

verses.z: 這樣，他們和一切屬他們的，都活活地墜落陰間；地口在他們上頭照舊合閉，他們就從會中滅亡。
verses.e: So they , and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol . The earth closed on them , and they perished from among the assembly .

verses.z: 在他們四圍的以色列眾人聽他們呼號，就都逃跑，說：「恐怕地也把我們吞下去。」
verses.e: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry ; for they said , " Lest the earth swallow us up ! "

verses.z: 又有火從耶和華那裏出來，燒滅了那獻香的二百五十個人。
verses.e: Fire came out from the LORD , and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你吩咐祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒從火中撿起那些香爐來，把火撒在別處，因為那些香爐是聖的。
verses.e: " Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , that he take up the censers out of the burning , and scatter the fire away from the camp ; for they are holy ,

verses.z: 把那些犯罪、自害己命之人的香爐，叫人錘成片子，用以包壇。那些香爐本是他們在耶和華面前獻過的，所以是聖的，並且可以給以色列人作記號。」
verses.e: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives . Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar , for they offered them before the LORD . Therefore they are holy . They shall be a sign to the children of Israel . "

verses.z: 於是祭司以利亞撒將被燒之人所獻的銅香爐拿來，人就錘出來，用以包壇，
verses.e: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered ; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar ,

verses.z: 摩西聽見這話就俯伏在地，
verses.e: When Moses heard it , he fell on his face .

verses.z: 給以色列人作紀念，使亞倫後裔之外的人不得近前來在耶和華面前燒香，免得他遭可拉和他一黨所遭的。這乃是照耶和華藉着摩西所吩咐的。
verses.e: to be a memorial to the children of Israel , to the end that no stranger who isn't of the offspring of Aaron , would come near to burn incense before the LORD , that he not be as Korah and as his company ; as the LORD spoke to him by Moses .

verses.z: 第二天，以色列全會眾都向摩西、亞倫發怨言說：「你們殺了耶和華的百姓了。」
verses.e: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron , saying , " You have killed the LORD's people ! "

verses.z: 會眾聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫的時候，向會幕觀看，不料，有雲彩遮蓋了，耶和華的榮光顯現。
verses.e: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron , they looked toward the Tent of Meeting . Behold , the cloud covered it , and the LORD's glory appeared .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫就來到會幕前。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們離開這會眾，我好在轉眼之間把他們滅絕。」他們二人就俯伏於地。
verses.e: " Get away from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment ! " They fell on their faces .

verses.z: 摩西對亞倫說：「拿你的香爐，把壇上的火盛在其中，又加上香，快快帶到會眾那裏，為他們贖罪；因為有忿怒從耶和華那裏出來，瘟疫已經發作了。」
verses.e: Moses said to Aaron , " Take your censer , put fire from the altar in it , lay incense on it , carry it quickly to the congregation , and make atonement for them ; for wrath has gone out from the LORD ! The plague has begun . "

verses.z: 亞倫照着摩西所說的拿來，跑到會中，不料，瘟疫在百姓中已經發作了。他就加上香，為百姓贖罪。
verses.e: Aaron did as Moses said , and ran into the middle of the assembly . The plague had already begun among the people . He put on the incense , and made atonement for the people .

verses.z: 他站在活人死人中間，瘟疫就止住了。
verses.e: He stood between the dead and the living ; and the plague was stayed .

verses.z: 除了因可拉事情死的以外，遭瘟疫死的，共有一萬四千七百人。
verses.e: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred , in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah .

verses.z: 對可拉和他一黨的人說：「到了早晨，耶和華必指示誰是屬他的，誰是聖潔的，就叫誰親近他；他所揀選的是誰，必叫誰親近他。
verses.e: He said to Korah and to all his company , " In the morning , the LORD will show who are his , and who is holy , and will cause him to come near to him . Even him whom he shall choose , he will cause to come near to him .

verses.z: 亞倫回到會幕門口，到摩西那裏，瘟疫已經止住了。
verses.e: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting , and the plague was stopped .

verses.z: 可拉啊，你們要這樣行，你和你的一黨要拿香爐來。
verses.e: Do this : have Korah and all his company take censers ,

verses.z: 明日，在耶和華面前，把火盛在爐中，把香放在其上。耶和華揀選誰，誰就為聖潔。你們這利未的子孫擅自專權了！」
verses.e: put fire in them , and put incense on them before the LORD tomorrow . It shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses , he shall be holy . You have gone too far , you sons of Levi ! "

verses.z: 摩西又對可拉說：「利未的子孫哪，你們聽我說！
verses.e: Moses said to Korah , " Hear now , you sons of Levi !

verses.z: 以色列的上帝從以色列會中將你們分別出來，使你們親近他，辦耶和華帳幕的事，並站在會眾面前替他們當差。
verses.e: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel , to bring you near to himself , to do the service of the LORD's tabernacle , and to stand before the congregation to minister to them ;

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「把亞倫的杖還放在法[櫃]前，給這些背叛之子留作記號。這樣，你就使他們向我發的怨言止息，免得他們死亡。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant , to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion ; that you may make an end of their complaining against me , that they not die . "

verses.z: 摩西就這樣行。耶和華怎樣吩咐他，他就怎樣行了。
verses.e: Moses did so . As the LORD commanded him , so he did .

verses.z: 以色列人對摩西說：「我們死啦！我們滅亡啦！都滅亡啦！
verses.e: The children of Israel spoke to Moses , saying , " Behold , we perish ! We are undone ! We are all undone !

verses.z: 凡挨近耶和華帳幕的是必死的。我們都要死亡嗎？」
verses.e: Everyone who keeps approaching the LORD's tabernacle , dies ! Will we all perish ? "

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人，從他們手下取杖，每支派一根；從他們所有的首領，按着支派，共取十二根。你要將各人的名字寫在各人的杖上，
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and take rods from them , one for each fathers ' house , of all their princes according to their fathers ' houses , twelve rods . Write each man's name on his rod .

verses.z: 並要將亞倫的名字寫在利未的杖上，因為各族長必有一根杖。
verses.e: You shall write Aaron's name on Levi's rod . There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 你要把這些杖存在會幕內法[櫃]前，就是我與你們相會之處。
verses.e: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant , where I meet with you .

verses.z: 後來我所揀選的那人，他的杖必發芽。這樣，我必使以色列人向你們所發的怨言止息，不再達到我耳中。」
verses.e: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud . I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against you , cease from me . "

verses.z: 於是摩西曉諭以色列人，他們的首領就把杖交給他，按着支派，每首領一根，共有十二根；亞倫的杖也在其中。
verses.e: Moses spoke to the children of Israel ; and all their princes gave him rods , for each prince one , according to their fathers ' houses , a total of twelve rods . Aaron's rod was among their rods .

verses.z: 摩西就把杖存在法[櫃]的帳幕內，在耶和華面前。
verses.e: Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony .

verses.z: 第二天，摩西進法[櫃]的帳幕去。誰知利未族亞倫的杖已經發了芽，生了花苞，開了花，結了熟杏。
verses.e: On the next day , Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony ; and behold , Aaron's rod for the house of Levi had sprouted , budded , produced blossoms , and bore ripe almonds .

verses.z: 摩西就把所有的杖從耶和華面前拿出來，給以色列眾人看；他們看見了，各首領就把自己的杖拿去。
verses.e: Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel . They looked , and each man took his rod .

verses.z: 耶和華對亞倫說：「你和你的兒子，並你本族的人，要一同擔當干犯聖所的罪孽。你和你的兒子也要一同擔當干犯祭司職任的罪孽。
verses.e: The LORD said to Aaron , " You and your sons and your fathers ' house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary ; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .

verses.z: 你要拿這些當至聖物吃；凡男丁都可以吃。你當以此物為聖。
verses.e: You shall eat of it like the most holy things . Every male shall eat of it . It shall be holy to you .

verses.z: 以色列人所獻的舉祭並搖祭都是你的；我已賜給你和你的兒女，當作永得的分；凡在你家中的潔淨人都可以吃。
verses.e: " This is yours , too : the wave offering of their gift , even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel . I have given them to you , and to your sons and to your daughters with you , as a portion forever . Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it .

verses.z: 凡油中、新酒中、五穀中至好的，就是以色列人所獻給耶和華初熟之物，我都賜給你。
verses.e: " I have given to you all the best of the oil , all the best of the vintage , and of the grain , the first fruits of them which they give to the LORD .

verses.z: 凡從他們地上所帶來給耶和華初熟之物也都要歸與你。你家中的潔淨人都可以吃。
verses.e: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land , which they bring to the LORD , shall be yours . Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it .

verses.z: 以色列中一切永獻的都必歸與你。
verses.e: " Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours .

verses.z: 他們所有奉給耶和華的，連人帶牲畜，凡頭生的，都要歸給你；只是人頭生的，總要贖出來；不潔淨牲畜頭生的，也要贖出來。
verses.e: Everything that opens the womb , of all flesh which they offer to the LORD , both of man and animal , shall be yours . Nevertheless , you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man , and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals .

verses.z: 其中在一月之外所當贖的，要照你所估定的價，按聖所的平，用銀子五舍客勒贖出來（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
verses.e: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old , according to your estimation , for five shekels of money , according to the shekel of the sanctuary , which weighs twenty gerahs .

verses.z: 只是頭生的牛，或是頭生的綿羊和山羊，必不可贖，都是聖的，要把牠的血灑在壇上，把牠的脂油焚燒，當作馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: " But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow , or the firstborn of a sheep , or the firstborn of a goat . They are holy . You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar , and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire , for a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 牠的肉必歸你，像被搖的胸、[被舉的]右腿歸你一樣。
verses.e: Their meat shall be yours , as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh , it shall be yours .

verses.z: 凡以色列人所獻給耶和華聖物中的舉祭，我都賜給你和你的兒女，當作永得的分。這是給你和你的後裔、在耶和華面前作為永遠的鹽約。」
verses.e: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to the LORD , I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you , as a portion forever . It is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD to you and to your offspring with you . "

verses.z: 你要帶你弟兄利未人，就是你祖宗支派的人前來，使他們與你聯合，服事你，只是你和你的兒子，要一同在法[櫃]的帳幕前[供職]。
verses.e: Bring your brothers also , the tribe of Levi , the tribe of your father , near with you , that they may be joined to you , and minister to you ; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony .

verses.z: 耶和華對亞倫說：「你在以色列人的境內不可有產業，在他們中間也不可有分。我就是你的分，是你的產業。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Aaron , " You shall have no inheritance in their land , neither shall you have any portion among them . I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 「凡以色列中出產的十分之一，我已賜給利未的子孫為業；因他們所辦的是會幕的事，所以賜給他們為酬他們的勞。
verses.e: " To the children of Levi , behold , I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance , in return for their service which they serve , even the service of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 從今以後，以色列人不可挨近會幕，免得他們擔罪而死。
verses.e: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting , lest they bear sin , and die .

verses.z: 惟獨利未人要辦會幕的事，擔當罪孽；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。他們在以色列人中不可有產業；
verses.e: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting , and they shall bear their iniquity . It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations . Among the children of Israel , they shall have no inheritance .

verses.z: 因為以色列人中出產的十分之一，就是獻給耶和華為舉祭的，我已賜給利未人為業。所以我對他們說：『在以色列人中不可有產業。』」
verses.e: For the tithe of the children of Israel , which they offer as a wave offering to the LORD , I have given to the Levites for an inheritance . Therefore I have said to them , ' Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭利未人說：你們從以色列人中所取的十分之一，就是我給你們為業的，要再從那十分之一中取十分之一作為舉祭獻給耶和華，
verses.e: " Moreover you shall speak to the Levites , and tell them , ' When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance , then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for the LORD , a tithe of the tithe .

verses.z: 這舉祭要算為你們場上的穀，又如滿酒醡的酒。
verses.e: Your wave offering shall be credited to you , as though it were the grain of the threshing floor , and as the fullness of the wine press .

verses.z: 這樣，你們從以色列人中所得的十分之一也要作舉祭獻給耶和華，從這十分之一中，將所獻給耶和華的舉祭歸給祭司亞倫。
verses.e: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to the LORD of all your tithes , which you receive of the children of Israel ; and of it you shall give the LORD's wave offering to Aaron the priest .

verses.z: 奉給你們的一切禮物，要從其中將至好的，就是分別為聖的，獻給耶和華為舉祭。
verses.e: Out of all your gifts , you shall offer every wave offering to the LORD , of all its best parts , even the holy part of it . '

verses.z: 他們要守所吩咐你的，並守全帳幕，只是不可挨近聖所的器具和壇，免得他們和你們都死亡。
verses.e: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent ; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar , that they not die , neither they nor you .

verses.z: 所以你要對利未人說：你們從其中將至好的舉起，這就算為你們場上的糧，又如酒醡的酒。
verses.e: " Therefore you shall tell them , ' When you heave its best from it , then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor , and as the increase of the wine press .

verses.z: 你們和你們家屬隨處可以吃；這原是你們的賞賜，是酬你們在會幕裏辦事的勞。
verses.e: You may eat it anywhere , you and your households , for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 你們從其中將至好的舉起，就不致因這物擔罪。你們不可褻瀆以色列人的聖物，免得死亡。」
verses.e: You shall bear no sin by reason of it , when you have heaved from it its best . You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , that you not die . ' "

verses.z: 他們要與你聯合，也要看守會幕，辦理帳幕一切的事，只是外人不可挨近你們。
verses.e: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting , for all the service of the Tent . A stranger shall not come near to you .

verses.z: 你們要看守聖所和壇，免得忿怒再臨到以色列人。
verses.e: " You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar , that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel .

verses.z: 我已將你們的弟兄利未人從以色列人中揀選出來歸耶和華，是給你們為賞賜的，為要辦理會幕的事。
verses.e: Behold , I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel . They are a gift to you , dedicated to the LORD , to do the service of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 你和你的兒子要為一切屬壇和幔子內的事一同守祭司的職任。你們要這樣供職；我將祭司的職任給你們當作賞賜事奉我。凡挨近的外人必被治死。」
verses.e: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar , and for that within the veil . You shall serve . I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift . The stranger who comes near shall be put to death . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭亞倫說：「我已將歸我的舉祭，就是以色列人一切分別為聖的物，交給你經管；因你受過膏，把這些都賜給你和你的子孫，當作永得的分。
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Aaron , " Behold , I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings , even all the holy things of the children of Israel . I have given them to you by reason of the anointing , and to your sons , as a portion forever .

verses.z: 以色列人歸給我至聖的供物，就是一切的素祭、贖罪祭、贖愆祭，其中所有[存留]不經火的，都為至聖之物，要歸給你和你的子孫。
verses.e: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire : every offering of theirs , even every meal offering of theirs , and every sin offering of theirs , and every trespass offering of theirs , which they shall give to me , shall be most holy for you and for your sons .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 收起母牛灰的人必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服。這要給以色列人和寄居在他們中間的外人作為永遠的定例。」
verses.e: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the evening . It shall be to the children of Israel , and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them , for a statute forever .

verses.z: 「摸了人死屍的，就必七天不潔淨。
verses.e: " He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days .

verses.z: 那人到第三天要用這除污穢的水潔淨自己，第七天就潔淨了。他若在第三天不潔淨自己，第七天就不潔淨了。
verses.e: He shall purify himself with water on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean ; but if he doesn't purify himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .

verses.z: 凡摸了人死屍、不潔淨自己的，就玷污了耶和華的帳幕，這人必從以色列中剪除；因為那除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他就為不潔淨，污穢還在他身上。
verses.e: Whoever touches a dead person , the body of a man who has died , and doesn't purify himself , defiles the LORD's tabernacle ; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel ; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him , he shall be unclean . His uncleanness is yet on him .

verses.z: 「人死在帳棚裏的條例乃是這樣：凡進那帳棚的，和一切在帳棚裏的，都必七天不潔淨。
verses.e: " This is the law when a man dies in a tent : everyone who comes into the tent , and everyone who is in the tent , shall be unclean seven days .

verses.z: 凡敞口的器皿，就是沒有紮上蓋的，也是不潔淨。
verses.e: Every open vessel , which has no covering bound on it , is unclean .

verses.z: 無論何人在田野裏摸了被刀殺的，或是屍首，或是人的骨頭，或是墳墓，就要七天不潔淨。
verses.e: " Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword , or a dead body , or a bone of a man , or a grave , shall be unclean seven days .

verses.z: 要為這不潔淨的人拿些燒成的除罪灰放在器皿裏，倒上活水。
verses.e: " For the unclean , they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering ; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel .

verses.z: 必當有一個潔淨的人拿牛膝草蘸在這水中，把水灑在帳棚上，和一切器皿並帳棚內的眾人身上，又灑在摸了骨頭，或摸了被殺的，或摸了自死的，或摸了墳墓的那人身上。
verses.e: A clean person shall take hyssop , dip it in the water , and sprinkle it on the tent , on all the vessels , on the persons who were there , and on him who touched the bone , or the slain , or the dead , or the grave .

verses.z: 第三天和第七天，潔淨的人要灑水在不潔淨的人身上，第七天就使他成為潔淨。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就潔淨了。
verses.e: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day . On the seventh day , he shall purify him . He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at evening .

verses.z: 「耶和華命定律法中的一條律例乃是這樣說：你要吩咐以色列人，把一隻沒有殘疾、未曾負軛、純紅的母牛牽到你這裏來，
verses.e: " This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded . Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot , in which is no defect , and which was never yoked .

verses.z: 「但那污穢而不潔淨自己的，要將他從會中剪除，因為他玷污了耶和華的聖所。除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他是不潔淨的。
verses.e: But the man who shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly , because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD . The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him . He is unclean .

verses.z: 這要給你們作為永遠的定例。並且那灑除污穢水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污穢水的，必不潔淨到晚上。
verses.e: It shall be a perpetual statute to them . He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes , and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening .

verses.z: 不潔淨人所摸的一切物就不潔淨；摸了這物的人必不潔淨到晚上。」
verses.e: " Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean ; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening . "

verses.z: 交給祭司以利亞撒；他必牽到營外，人就把牛宰在他面前。
verses.e: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest , and he shall bring her outside of the camp , and one shall kill her before his face .

verses.z: 祭司以利亞撒要用指頭蘸這牛的血，向會幕前面彈七次。
verses.e: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger , and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times .

verses.z: 人要在他眼前把這母牛焚燒；牛的皮、肉、血、糞都要焚燒。
verses.e: One shall burn the heifer in his sight ; her skin , and her meat , and her blood , with her dung , shall he burn .

verses.z: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱紅色[線]都丟在燒牛的火中。
verses.e: The priest shall take cedar wood , hyssop , and scarlet , and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer .

verses.z: 祭司必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後可以進營。
verses.e: Then the priest shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp , and the priest shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 燒牛的人必不潔淨到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。
verses.e: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the evening .

verses.z: 必有一個潔淨的人收起母牛的灰，存在營外潔淨的地方，為以色列會眾調做除污穢的水。這本是除罪的。
verses.e: " A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer , and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place ; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity . It is a sin offering .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 「在南邊，按着軍隊是呂便營的纛。有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿作呂便人的首領。
verses.e: " On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions . The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬六千五百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of it , were forty-six thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 挨着他安營的是西緬支派。蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑作西緬人的首領。
verses.e: " Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon . The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬九千三百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were fifty-nine thousand three hundred .

verses.z: 又有迦得支派。丟珥的兒子以利雅薩作迦得人的首領。
verses.e: " The tribe of Gad : the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名，
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty .

verses.z: 凡屬呂便營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十五萬一千四百五十名，要作第二隊往前行。
verses.e: " All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty , according to their armies . They shall set out second .

verses.z: 「隨後，會幕要往前行，有利未營在諸營中間。他們怎樣安營就怎樣往前行，各按本位，各歸本纛。
verses.e: " Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out , with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps . As they encamp , so shall they set out , every man in his place , by their standards .

verses.z: 「在西邊，按着軍隊是以法蓮營的纛。亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪作以法蓮人的首領。
verses.e: " On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions . The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were forty thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 「以色列人要各歸自己的纛下，在本族的旗號那裏，對着會幕的四圍安營。
verses.e: " The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard , with the banners of their fathers ' houses . They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it .

verses.z: 挨着他的是瑪拿西支派。比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列作瑪拿西人的首領。
verses.e: " Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh . The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were thirty-two thousand two hundred .

verses.z: 又有便雅憫支派。基多尼的兒子亞比但作便雅憫人的首領。
verses.e: " The tribe of Benjamin : the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。
verses.e: His army , and those who were counted of them , were thirty-five thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 凡屬以法蓮營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十萬零八千一百名，要作第三隊往前行。
verses.e: " All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred , according to their divisions . They shall set out third .

verses.z: 「在北邊，按着軍隊是但營的纛。亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝作但人的首領。
verses.e: " On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions . The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were sixty-two thousand seven hundred .

verses.z: 挨着他安營的是亞設支派。俄蘭的兒子帕結作亞設人的首領。
verses.e: " Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher . The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were forty-one thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 又有拿弗他利支派。以南的兒子亞希拉作拿弗他利人的首領。
verses.e: " The tribe of Naphtali : the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan .

verses.z: 在東邊，向日出之地，照着軍隊安營的是猶大營的纛。有亞米拿達的兒子拿順作猶大人的首領。
verses.e: " Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah , according to their divisions . The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were fifty-three thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 凡但營被數的，共有十五萬七千六百名，要歸本纛作末隊往前行。」
verses.e: " All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred . They shall set out last by their standards . "

verses.z: 這些以色列人，照他們的宗族，按他們的軍隊，在諸營中被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。
verses.e: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers ' houses . All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty .

verses.z: 惟獨利未人沒有數在以色列人中，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 以色列人就這樣行，各人照他們的家室、宗族歸於本纛，安營起行，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: Thus the children of Israel did . According to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so they encamped by their standards , and so they set out , everyone by their families , according to their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of them , were seventy-four thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 挨着他安營的是以薩迦支派。有蘇押的兒子拿坦業作以薩迦人的首領。
verses.e: " Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar . The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of it , were fifty-four thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 又有西布倫支派。希倫的兒子以利押作西布倫人的首領。
verses.e: " The tribe of Zebulun : the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon .

verses.z: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。
verses.e: His division , and those who were counted of it , were fifty-seven thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 凡屬猶大營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十八萬六千四百名，要作第一隊往前行。
verses.e: " All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred , according to their divisions . They shall set out first .

verses.z: 正月間，以色列全會眾到了尋的曠野，就住在加低斯。米利暗死在那裏，就葬在那裏。
verses.e: The children of Israel , even the whole congregation , came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month . The people stayed in Kadesh . Miriam died there , and was buried there .

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫就招聚會眾到磐石前。摩西說：「你們這些背叛的人聽我說：我為你們使水從這磐石中流出來嗎？」
verses.e: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock , and he said to them , " Hear now , you rebels ! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you ? "

verses.z: 摩西舉手，用杖擊打磐石兩下，就有許多水流出來，會眾和他們的牲畜都喝了。
verses.e: Moses lifted up his hand , and struck the rock with his rod twice , and water came out abundantly . The congregation and their livestock drank .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：「因為你們不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我為聖，所以你們必不得領這會眾進我所賜給他們的地去。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron , " Because you didn't believe in me , to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them . "

verses.z: 這水名叫米利巴水，是因以色列人向耶和華爭鬧，耶和華就在他們面前顯為聖。
verses.e: These are the waters of Meribah ; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD , and he was sanctified in them .

verses.z: 摩西從加低斯差遣使者去見以東王，說：「你的弟兄以色列人這樣說：『我們所遭遇的一切艱難，
verses.e: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom , saying : " Your brother Israel says : You know all the travail that has happened to us ;

verses.z: 就是我們的列祖下到埃及，我們在埃及久住；埃及人惡待我們的列祖和我們，
verses.e: how our fathers went down into Egypt , and we lived in Egypt a long time . The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers .

verses.z: 我們哀求耶和華的時候，他聽了我們的聲音，差遣使者把我們從埃及領出來。這事你都知道。如今，我們在你邊界上的城加低斯。
verses.e: When we cried to the LORD , he heard our voice , sent an angel , and brought us out of Egypt . Behold , we are in Kadesh , a city in the edge of your border .

verses.z: 求你容我們從你的地經過。我們不走田間和葡萄園，也不喝井裏的水，只走大道，不偏左右，直到過了你的境界。』」
verses.e: " Please let us pass through your land . We will not pass through field or through vineyard , neither will we drink from the water of the wells . We will go along the king's highway . We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed your border . "

verses.z: 以東[王]說：「你不可從我的[地]經過，免得我帶刀出去攻擊你。」
verses.e: Edom said to him , " You shall not pass through me , lest I come out with the sword against you . "

verses.z: 以色列人說：「我們要走大道上去；我們和牲畜若喝你的水，必給你價值。不求別的，只求你容我們步行過去。」
verses.e: The children of Israel said to him , " We will go up by the highway ; and if we drink your water , I and my livestock , then I will give its price . Only let me , without doing anything else , pass through on my feet . "

verses.z: 會眾沒有水喝，就聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫。
verses.e: There was no water for the congregation ; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron .

verses.z: 以東[王]說：「你們不可經過！」就率領許多人出來，要用強硬的手攻擊以色列人。
verses.e: He said , " You shall not pass through . " Edom came out against him with many people , and with a strong hand .

verses.z: 這樣，以東[王]不肯容以色列人從他的境界過去。於是他們轉去，離開他。
verses.e: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border , so Israel turned away from him .

verses.z: 以色列全會眾從加低斯起行，到了何珥山。
verses.e: They traveled from Kadesh , and the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , came to Mount Hor .

verses.z: 耶和華在附近以東邊界的何珥山上曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor , by the border of the land of Edom , saying ,

verses.z: 「亞倫要歸到他列祖那裏。他必不得入我所賜給以色列人的地；因為在米利巴水，你們違背了我的命。
verses.e: " Aaron shall be gathered to his people ; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel , because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah .

verses.z: 你帶亞倫和他的兒子以利亞撒上何珥山，
verses.e: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up to Mount Hor ;

verses.z: 把亞倫的[聖]衣脫下來，給他的兒子以利亞撒穿上；亞倫必死在那裏，歸[他列祖]。」
verses.e: and strip Aaron of his garments , and put them on Eleazar his son . Aaron shall be gathered , and shall die there . "

verses.z: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的行。三人當着會眾的眼前上了何珥山。
verses.e: Moses did as the LORD commanded . They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation .

verses.z: 摩西把亞倫的[聖]衣脫下來，給他的兒子以利亞撒穿上，亞倫就死在山頂那裏。於是摩西和以利亞撒下了山。
verses.e: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments , and put them on Eleazar his son . Aaron died there on the top of the mountain , and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain .

verses.z: 全會眾，就是以色列全家，見亞倫已經死了，便都為亞倫哀哭了三十天。
verses.e: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead , they wept for Aaron thirty days , even all the house of Israel .

verses.z: 百姓向摩西爭鬧說：「我們的弟兄曾死在耶和華面前，我們恨不得與他們同死。
verses.e: The people quarreled with Moses , and spoke , saying , " We wish that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD !

verses.z: 你們為何把耶和華的會眾領到這曠野、使我們和牲畜都死在這裏呢？
verses.e: Why have you brought the LORD's assembly into this wilderness , that we should die there , we and our animals ?

verses.z: 你們為何逼着我們出埃及、領我們到這壞地方呢？這地方不好撒種，也沒有無花果樹、葡萄樹、石榴樹，又沒有水喝。」
verses.e: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in to this evil place ? It is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates ; neither is there any water to drink . "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫離開會眾，到會幕門口，俯伏在地；耶和華的榮光向他們顯現。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting , and fell on their faces . The LORD's glory appeared to them .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你拿着杖去，和你的哥哥亞倫招聚會眾，在他們眼前吩咐磐石發出水來，水就從磐石流出，給會眾和他們的牲畜喝。」
verses.e: " Take the rod , and assemble the congregation , you , and Aaron your brother , and speak to the rock before their eyes , that it pour out its water . You shall bring water to them out of the rock ; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink . "

verses.z: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的，從耶和華面前取了杖去。
verses.e: Moses took the rod from before the LORD , as he commanded him .

verses.z: 住南地的迦南人亞拉得王，聽說以色列人從亞他林路來，就和以色列人爭戰，擄了他們幾個人。
verses.e: The Canaanite , the king of Arad , who lived in the South , heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim . He fought against Israel , and took some of them captive .

verses.z: 以色列人起行，安營在阿伯。
verses.e: The children of Israel traveled , and encamped in Oboth .

verses.z: 又從阿伯起行，安營在以耶‧亞巴琳，與摩押相對的曠野，向日出之地。
verses.e: They traveled from Oboth , and encamped at Iyeabarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrise .

verses.z: 從那裏起行，安營在撒烈谷。
verses.e: From there they traveled , and encamped in the valley of Zered .

verses.z: 從那裏起行，安營在亞嫩河那邊。這亞嫩河是在曠野，從亞摩利的境界流出來的；原來亞嫩河是摩押的邊界，在摩押和亞摩利人搭界的地方。
verses.e: From there they traveled , and encamped on the other side of the Arnon , which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites ; for the Arnon is the border of Moab , between Moab and the Amorites .

verses.z: 所以耶和華的戰記上說：「蘇法的哇哈伯與亞嫩河的谷，
verses.e: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of the LORD , " Vaheb in Suphah , the valleys of the Arnon ,

verses.z: 並向亞珥城眾谷的下坡，是靠近摩押的境界。」
verses.e: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar , leans on the border of Moab . "

verses.z: 以色列人從那裏[起行]，到了比珥。從前耶和華吩咐摩西說：「招聚百姓，我好給他們水喝」，說的就是這井。
verses.e: From there they traveled to Beer ; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses , " Gather the people together , and I will give them water . "

verses.z: 當時，以色列人唱歌說：井啊，湧上水來！你們要向這井歌唱。
verses.e: Then Israel sang this song : " Spring up , well ! Sing to it ,

verses.z: 這井是首領和民中的尊貴人用圭用杖所挖所掘的。以色列人從曠野往瑪他拿去，
verses.e: the well , which the princes dug , which the nobles of the people dug , with the scepter , and with their poles . " From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah ;

verses.z: 從瑪他拿到拿哈列，從拿哈列到巴末，
verses.e: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel ; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth ;

verses.z: 以色列人向耶和華發願說：「你若將這民交付我手，我就把他們的城邑盡行毀滅。」
verses.e: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD , and said , " If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand , then I will utterly destroy their cities . "

verses.z: 從巴末到摩押地的谷，又到那下望曠野之毗斯迦的山頂。
verses.e: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab , to the top of Pisgah , which looks down on the desert .

verses.z: 以色列人差遣使者去見亞摩利人的王西宏，說：
verses.e: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites , saying ,

verses.z: 「求你容我們從你的地經過；我們不偏入田間和葡萄園，也不喝井裏的水，只走大道，直到過了你的境界。」
verses.e: " Let me pass through your land . We will not turn away into field or vineyard . We will not drink of the water of the wells . We will go by the king's highway , until we have passed your border . "

verses.z: 西宏不容以色列人從他的境界經過，就招聚他的眾民出到曠野，要攻擊以色列人，到了雅雜與以色列人爭戰。
verses.e: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border , but Sihon gathered all his people together , and went out against Israel into the wilderness , and came to Jahaz . He fought against Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人用刀殺了他，得了他的地，從亞嫩河到雅博河，直到亞捫人的[境界]，因為亞捫人的境界多有堅壘。
verses.e: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword , and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok , even to the children of Ammon ; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified .

verses.z: 以色列人奪取這一切的城邑，也住亞摩利人的城邑，就是希實本與希實本的一切鄉村。
verses.e: Israel took all these cities . Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites , in Heshbon , and in all its villages .

verses.z: 這希實本是亞摩利王西宏的[京]城；西宏曾與摩押的先王爭戰，從他手中奪取了全地，直到亞嫩河。
verses.e: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites , who had fought against the former king of Moab , and taken all his land out of his hand , even to the Arnon .

verses.z: 所以那些作詩歌的說：你們來到希實本；願西宏的城被修造，被建立。
verses.e: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say , " Come to Heshbon . Let the city of Sihon be built and established ;

verses.z: 因為有火從希實本發出，有火焰出於西宏的城，燒盡摩押的亞珥和亞嫩河邱壇的祭司。
verses.e: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon . It has devoured Ar of Moab , The lords of the high places of the Arnon .

verses.z: 摩押啊，你有禍了！基抹的民哪，你們滅亡了！基抹的男子逃奔，女子被擄，交付亞摩利的王西宏。
verses.e: Woe to you , Moab ! You are undone , people of Chemosh ! He has given his sons as fugitives , and his daughters into captivity , to Sihon king of the Amorites .

verses.z: 耶和華應允了以色列人，把迦南人交付他們，他們就把迦南人和迦南人的城邑盡行毀滅。那地方的名便叫何珥瑪。
verses.e: The LORD listened to the voice of Israel , and delivered up the Canaanites ; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities . The name of the place was called Hormah .

verses.z: 我們射了他們；希實本直到底本盡皆毀滅。我們使地變成荒場，直到挪法；這挪法直[延]到米底巴。
verses.e: We have shot at them . Heshbon has perished even to Dibon . We have laid waste even to Nophah , Which reaches to Medeba . "

verses.z: 這樣，以色列人就住在亞摩利人之地。
verses.e: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites .

verses.z: 摩西打發人去窺探雅謝，以色列人就佔了雅謝的鎮市，趕出那裏的亞摩利人。
verses.e: Moses sent to spy out Jazer . They took its villages , and drove out the Amorites who were there .

verses.z: 以色列人轉回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的眾民都出來，在以得來與他們交戰。
verses.e: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan . Og the king of Bashan went out against them , he and all his people , to battle at Edrei .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「不要怕他！因我已將他和他的眾民，並他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像從前待住希實本的亞摩利王西宏一般。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Don't fear him , for I have delivered him into your hand , with all his people , and his land . You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites , who lived at Heshbon . "

verses.z: 於是他們殺了他和他的眾子，並他的眾民，沒有留下一個，就得了他的地。
verses.e: So they struck him , with his sons and all his people , until there were no survivors ; and they possessed his land .

verses.z: 他們從何珥山起行，往紅海那條路走，要繞過以東地。百姓因這路難行，心中甚是煩躁，
verses.e: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea , to go around the land of Edom . The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey .

verses.z: 就怨讟上帝和摩西說：「你們為甚麼把我們從埃及領出來、使我們死在曠野呢？這裏沒有糧，沒有水，我們的心厭惡這淡薄的食物。」
verses.e: The people spoke against God and against Moses : " Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness ? For there is no bread , there is no water , and our soul loathes this disgusting food ! "

verses.z: 於是耶和華使火蛇進入百姓中間，蛇就咬他們。以色列人中死了許多。
verses.e: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people , and they bit the people . Many people of Israel died .

verses.z: 百姓到摩西那裏，說：「我們怨讟耶和華和你，有罪了。求你禱告耶和華，叫這些蛇離開我們。」於是摩西為百姓禱告。
verses.e: The people came to Moses , and said , " We have sinned , because we have spoken against the LORD and against you . Pray to the LORD , that he take away the serpents from us . " Moses prayed for the people .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你製造一條火蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望這蛇，就必得活。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Make a venomous snake , and set it on a pole . It shall happen that everyone who is bitten , when he sees it , shall live . "

verses.z: 摩西便製造一條銅蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望這銅蛇就活了。
verses.e: Moses made a serpent of bronze , and set it on the pole . If a serpent had bitten any man , when he looked at the serpent of bronze , he lived .

verses.z: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原、約旦河東，對着耶利哥安營。
verses.e: The children of Israel traveled , and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho .

verses.z: 巴蘭回答說：「是摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒打發人到我這裏來，[說]：
verses.e: Balaam said to God , " Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , has said to me ,

verses.z: 『從埃及出來的民遮滿地面，你來為我咒詛他們，或者我能與他們爭戰，把他們趕出去。』」
verses.e: ' Behold , the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth . Now , come curse them for me . Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them , and shall drive them out . ' "

verses.z: 上帝對巴蘭說：「你不可同他們去，也不可咒詛那民，因為那民是蒙福的。」
verses.e: God said to Balaam , " You shall not go with them . You shall not curse the people , for they are blessed . "

verses.z: 巴蘭早晨起來，對巴勒的使臣說：「你們回本地去吧，因為耶和華不容我和你們同去。」
verses.e: Balaam rose up in the morning , and said to the princes of Balak , " Go to your land ; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you . "

verses.z: 摩押的使臣就起來，回巴勒那裏去，說：「巴蘭不肯和我們同來。」
verses.e: The princes of Moab rose up , and they went to Balak , and said , " Balaam refuses to come with us . "

verses.z: 巴勒又差遣使臣，比先前的又多又尊貴。
verses.e: Balak again sent princes , more , and more honorable than they .

verses.z: 他們到了巴蘭那裏，對他說：「西撥的兒子巴勒這樣說：『求你不容甚麼事攔阻你不到我這裏來，
verses.e: They came to Balaam , and said to him , " Balak the son of Zippor says , ' Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me ,

verses.z: 因為我必使你得極大的尊榮。你向我要甚麼，我就給你甚麼；只求你來為我咒詛這民。』」
verses.e: for I will promote you to very great honor , and whatever you say to me I will do . Please come therefore , and curse this people for me . ' "

verses.z: 巴蘭回答巴勒的臣僕說：「巴勒就是將他滿屋的金銀給我，我行大事小事也不得越過耶和華－我上帝的命。
verses.e: Balaam answered the servants of Balak , " If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I can't go beyond the word of the LORD my God , to do less or more .

verses.z: 現在我請你們今夜在這裏住宿，等我得知耶和華還要對我說甚麼。」
verses.e: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well , that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me . "

verses.z: 以色列人向亞摩利人所行的一切事，西撥的兒子巴勒都看見了。
verses.e: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites .

verses.z: 當夜，上帝臨到巴蘭那裏，說：「這些人若來召你，你就起來同他們去，你只要遵行我對你所說的話。」
verses.e: God came to Balaam at night , and said to him , " If the men have come to call you , rise up , go with them ; but only the word which I speak to you , that you shall do . "

verses.z: 巴蘭早晨起來，備上驢，和摩押的使臣一同去了。
verses.e: Balaam rose up in the morning , and saddled his donkey , and went with the princes of Moab .

verses.z: 上帝因他去就發了怒；耶和華的使者站在路上敵擋他。他騎着驢，有兩個僕人跟隨他。
verses.e: God's anger burned because he went ; and the LORD's angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him . Now he was riding on his donkey , and his two servants were with him .

verses.z: 驢看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裏有拔出來的刀，就從路上跨進田間，巴蘭便打驢，要叫牠回轉上路。
verses.e: The donkey saw the LORD's angel standing in the way , with his sword drawn in his hand ; and the donkey turned out of the path , and went into the field . Balaam struck the donkey , to turn her into the path .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者就站在葡萄園的窄路上；這邊有牆，那邊也有牆。
verses.e: Then the LORD's angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards , a wall being on this side , and a wall on that side .

verses.z: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就貼靠牆，將巴蘭的腳擠傷了；巴蘭又打驢。
verses.e: The donkey saw the LORD's angel , and she thrust herself to the wall , and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall . He struck her again .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者又往前去，站在狹窄之處，左右都沒有轉折的地方。
verses.e: The LORD's angel went further , and stood in a narrow place , where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .

verses.z: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就臥在巴蘭底下，巴蘭發怒，用杖打驢。
verses.e: The donkey saw the LORD's angel , and she lay down under Balaam . Balaam's anger burned , and he struck the donkey with his staff .

verses.z: 耶和華叫驢開口，對巴蘭說：「我向你行了甚麼，你竟打我這三次呢？」
verses.e: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey , and she said to Balaam , " What have I done to you , that you have struck me these three times ? "

verses.z: 巴蘭對驢說：「因為你戲弄我，我恨不能手中有刀，把你殺了。」
verses.e: Balaam said to the donkey , " Because you have mocked me , I wish there were a sword in my hand , for now I would have killed you . "

verses.z: 摩押人因以色列民甚多，就大大懼怕，心內憂急，
verses.e: Moab was very afraid of the people , because they were many . Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 驢對巴蘭說：「我不是你從小時直到今日所騎的驢嗎？我素常向你這樣行過嗎？」巴蘭說：「沒有。」
verses.e: The donkey said to Balaam , " Am I not your donkey , on which you have ridden all your life long until today ? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you ? " He said , " No . "

verses.z: 當時，耶和華使巴蘭的眼目明亮，他就看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裏有拔出來的刀，巴蘭便低頭俯伏在地。
verses.e: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam , and he saw the LORD's angel standing in the way , with his sword drawn in his hand ; and he bowed his head , and fell on his face .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者對他說：「你為何這三次打你的驢呢？我出來敵擋你，因你所行的，在我面前偏僻。
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to him , " Why have you struck your donkey these three times ? Behold , I have come out as an adversary , because your way is perverse before me .

verses.z: 驢看見我就三次從我面前偏過去；驢若沒有偏過去，我早把你殺了，留牠存活。」
verses.e: The donkey saw me , and turned away before me these three times . Unless she had turned away from me , surely now I would have killed you , and saved her alive . "

verses.z: 巴蘭對耶和華的使者說：「我有罪了。我不知道你站在路上阻擋我；你若不喜歡我去，我就轉回。」
verses.e: Balaam said to the LORD's angel , " I have sinned ; for I didn't know that you stood in the way against me . Now therefore , if it displeases you , I will go back again . "

verses.z: 耶和華的使者對巴蘭說：「你同這些人去吧！你只要說我對你說的話。」於是巴蘭同着巴勒的使臣去了。
verses.e: The LORD's angel said to Balaam , " Go with the men ; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you . " So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .

verses.z: 巴勒聽見巴蘭來了，就往摩押[京]城去迎接他；這城是在邊界上，在亞嫩河旁。
verses.e: When Balak heard that Balaam had come , he went out to meet him to the City of Moab , which is on the border of the Arnon , which is in the utmost part of the border .

verses.z: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「我不是急急地打發人到你那裏去召你嗎？你為何不到我這裏來呢？我豈不能使你得尊榮嗎？」
verses.e: Balak said to Balaam , " Didn't I earnestly send for you to summon you ? Why didn't you come to me ? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor ? "

verses.z: 巴蘭說：「我已經到你這裏來了！現在我豈能擅自說甚麼呢？上帝將甚麼話傳給我，我就說甚麼。」
verses.e: Balaam said to Balak , " Behold , I have come to you . Have I now any power at all to speak anything ? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth . "

verses.z: 巴蘭和巴勒同行，來到基列‧胡瑣。
verses.e: Balaam went with Balak , and they came to Kiriath Huzoth .

verses.z: 對米甸的長老說：「現在這眾人要把我們四圍所有的一概餂盡，就如牛餂盡田間的草一般。」那時西撥的兒子巴勒作摩押王。
verses.e: Moab said to the elders of Midian , " Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us , as the ox licks up the grass of the field . " Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time .

verses.z: 巴勒宰了牛羊，送給巴蘭和陪伴的使臣。
verses.e: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep , and sent to Balaam , and to the princes who were with him .

verses.z: 到了早晨，巴勒領巴蘭到巴力的高處；巴蘭從那裏觀看以色列[營]的邊界。
verses.e: In the morning , Balak took Balaam , and brought him up into the high places of Baal ; and he saw from there part of the people .

verses.z: 他差遣使者往大河邊的毗奪去，到比珥的兒子巴蘭本鄉那裏，召巴蘭來，說：「有一宗民從埃及出來，遮滿地面，與我對居。
verses.e: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor , to Pethor , which is by the River , to the land of the children of his people , to call him , saying , " Behold , there is a people who came out of Egypt . Behold , they cover the surface of the earth , and they are staying opposite me .

verses.z: 這民比我強盛，現在求你來為我咒詛他們，或者我能得勝，攻打他們，趕出此地。因為我知道，你為誰祝福，誰就得福；你咒詛誰，誰就受咒詛。」
verses.e: Please come now therefore , and curse this people for me ; for they are too mighty for me . Perhaps I shall prevail , that we may strike them , and that I may drive them out of the land ; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed , and he whom you curse is cursed . "

verses.z: 摩押的長老和米甸的長老手裏拿着卦金，到了巴蘭那裏，將巴勒的話都告訴了他。
verses.e: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand . They came to Balaam , and spoke to him the words of Balak .

verses.z: 巴蘭說：「你們今夜在這裏住宿，我必照耶和華所曉諭我的回報你們。」摩押的使臣就在巴蘭那裏住下了。
verses.e: He said to them , " Lodge here this night , and I will bring you word again , as the LORD shall speak to me . " The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam .

verses.z: 上帝臨到巴蘭那裏，說：「在你這裏的人都是誰？」
verses.e: God came to Balaam , and said , " Who are these men with you ? "

verses.z: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你在這裏給我築七座壇，為我預備七隻公牛，七隻公羊。」
verses.e: Balaam said to Balak , " Build here seven altars for me , and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me . "

verses.z: 誰能數點雅各的塵土？誰能計算以色列的四分之一？我願如義人之死而死；我願如義人之終而終。
verses.e: Who can count the dust of Jacob , or count the fourth part of Israel ? Let me die the death of the righteous ! Let my last end be like his ! "

verses.z: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「你向我做的是甚麼事呢？我領你來咒詛我的仇敵，不料，你竟為他們祝福。」
verses.e: Balak said to Balaam , " What have you done to me ? I took you to curse my enemies , and behold , you have blessed them altogether . "

verses.z: 他回答說：「耶和華傳給我的話，我能不謹慎傳說嗎？」
verses.e: He answered and said , " Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth ? "

verses.z: 巴勒說：「求你同我往別處去，在那裏可以看見他們；你不能全看見，只能看見他們邊界上的人。在那裏要為我咒詛他們。」
verses.e: Balak said to him , " Please come with me to another place , where you may see them . You shall see just part of them , and shall not see them all . Curse them from there for me . "

verses.z: 於是領巴蘭到了瑣腓田，上了毗斯迦山頂，築了七座壇；每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
verses.e: He took him into the field of Zophim , to the top of Pisgah , and built seven altars , and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar .

verses.z: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你站在這燔祭旁邊，等我往那邊去迎見[耶和華]。」
verses.e: He said to Balak , " Stand here by your burnt offering , while I meet God over there . "

verses.z: 耶和華臨到巴蘭那裏，將話傳給他；又說：「你回到巴勒那裏，要如此如此說。」
verses.e: The LORD met Balaam , and put a word in his mouth , and said , " Return to Balak , and say this . "

verses.z: 他就回到巴勒那裏，見他站在燔祭旁邊；摩押的使臣也和他在一處。巴勒問他說：「耶和華說了甚麼話呢？」
verses.e: He came to him , and behold , he was standing by his burnt offering , and the princes of Moab with him . Balak said to him , " What has the LORD spoken ? "

verses.z: 巴蘭就題詩歌說：巴勒，你起來聽；西撥的兒子，你聽我言。
verses.e: He took up his parable , and said , " Rise up , Balak , and hear ! Listen to me , you son of Zippor .

verses.z: 上帝非人，必不致說謊，也非人子，必不致後悔。他說話豈不照着行呢？他發言豈不要成就呢？
verses.e: God is not a man , that he should lie , nor a son of man , that he should repent . Has he said , and he won't do it ? Or has he spoken , and he won't make it good ?

verses.z: 巴勒照巴蘭的話行了。巴勒和巴蘭在每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
verses.e: Balak did as Balaam had spoken ; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram .

verses.z: 我奉[命]祝福；上帝也曾賜福，此事我不能翻轉。
verses.e: Behold , I have received a command to bless . He has blessed , and I can't reverse it .

verses.z: 他未見雅各中有罪孽，也未見以色列中有奸惡。耶和華－他的上帝和他同在；有歡呼王的聲音在他們中間。
verses.e: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob . Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel . The LORD his God is with him . The shout of a king is among them .

verses.z: 上帝領他們出埃及；他們似乎有野牛之力。
verses.e: God brings them out of Egypt . He has as it were the strength of the wild ox .

verses.z: 斷沒有法術可以害雅各，也沒有占卜可以害以色列。現在必有人論及雅各，就是論及以色列說：上帝為他行了何等的大事！
verses.e: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob ; neither is there any divination with Israel . Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel , ' What has God done ! '

verses.z: 這民起來，彷彿母獅，挺身，好像公獅，未曾吃野食，未曾喝被傷者之血，決不躺臥。
verses.e: Behold , a people rises up as a lioness . As a lion he lifts himself up . He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey , and drinks the blood of the slain . "

verses.z: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「你一點不要咒詛他們，也不要為他們祝福。」
verses.e: Balak said to Balaam , " Neither curse them at all , nor bless them at all . "

verses.z: 巴蘭回答巴勒說：「我豈不是告訴你說『凡耶和華所說的，我必須遵行』嗎？」
verses.e: But Balaam answered Balak , " Didn't I tell you , saying , ' All that the LORD speaks , that I must do ' ? "

verses.z: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「來吧，我領你往別處去，或者上帝喜歡你在那裏為我咒詛他們。」
verses.e: Balak said to Balaam , " Come now , I will take you to another place ; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there . "

verses.z: 巴勒就領巴蘭到那下望曠野的毗珥[山]頂上。
verses.e: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor , that looks down on the desert .

verses.z: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你在這裏為我築七座壇，又在這裏為我預備七隻公牛，七隻公羊。」
verses.e: Balaam said to Balak , " Build seven altars for me here , and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here . "

verses.z: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你站在你的燔祭旁邊，我且往前去，或者耶和華來迎見我。他指示我甚麼，我必告訴你。」於是巴蘭上一淨光的高處。
verses.e: Balaam said to Balak , " Stand by your burnt offering , and I will go . Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me . Whatever he shows me I will tell you . " He went to a bare height .

verses.z: 巴勒就照巴蘭的話行，在每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
verses.e: Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar .

verses.z: 上帝迎見巴蘭；巴蘭說：「我預備了七座壇，在每座壇上獻了一隻公牛，一隻公羊。」
verses.e: God met Balaam , and he said to him , " I have prepared the seven altars , and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar . "

verses.z: 耶和華將話傳給巴蘭，又說：「你回到巴勒那裏，要如此如此說。」
verses.e: The LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth , and said , " Return to Balak , and thus you shall speak . "

verses.z: 他就回到巴勒那裏，見他同摩押的使臣都站在燔祭旁邊。
verses.e: He returned to him , and behold , he was standing by his burnt offering , he , and all the princes of Moab .

verses.z: 巴蘭便題起詩歌說：巴勒引我出亞蘭，摩押王引我出東山，[說]：來啊，為我咒詛雅各；來啊，怒罵以色列。
verses.e: He took up his parable , and said , " From Aram has Balak brought me , the king of Moab from the mountains of the East . Come , curse Jacob for me . Come , defy Israel .

verses.z: 上帝沒有咒詛的，我焉能咒詛？耶和華沒有怒罵的，我焉能怒罵？
verses.e: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed ? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied ?

verses.z: 我從高峰看他，從小山望他；這是獨居的民，不列在萬民中。
verses.e: For from the top of the rocks I see him . From the hills I see him . Behold , it is a people that dwells alone , and shall not be listed among the nations .

verses.z: 巴蘭見耶和華喜歡賜福與以色列，就不像前兩次去求法術，卻面向曠野。
verses.e: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel , he didn't go , as at the other times , to use divination , but he set his face toward the wilderness .

verses.z: 巴勒向巴蘭生氣，就拍起手來，對巴蘭說：「我召你來為我咒詛仇敵，不料，你這三次竟為他們祝福。
verses.e: Balak's anger burned against Balaam , and he struck his hands together . Balak said to Balaam , " I called you to curse my enemies , and , behold , you have altogether blessed them these three times .

verses.z: 如今你快回本地去吧！我想使你得大尊榮，耶和華卻阻止你不得尊榮。」
verses.e: Therefore , flee to your place , now ! I thought to promote you to great honor ; but , behold , the LORD has kept you back from honor . "

verses.z: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「我豈不是對你所差遣到我那裏的使者說：
verses.e: Balaam said to Balak , " Didn't I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me , saying ,

verses.z: 『巴勒就是將他滿屋的金銀給我，我也不得越過耶和華的命，憑自己的心意行好行歹。耶和華說甚麼，我就要說甚麼』？」
verses.e: ' If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I can't go beyond the LORD's word , to do either good or bad from my own mind . I will say what the LORD says ' ?

verses.z: 「現在我要回本族去。你來，我告訴你這民日後要怎樣待你的民。」
verses.e: Now , behold , I go to my people . Come , I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days . "

verses.z: 他就題起詩歌說：比珥的兒子巴蘭說：眼目閉住的人說，
verses.e: He took up his parable , and said , " Balaam the son of Beor says , the man whose eyes are open says ;

verses.z: 得聽上帝的言語，明白至高者的意旨，看見全能者的異象，眼目睜開而仆倒的人說：
verses.e: he says , who hears the words of God , knows the knowledge of the Most High , and who sees the vision of the Almighty , falling down , and having his eyes open :

verses.z: 我看他卻不在現時；我望他卻不在近日。有星要出於雅各，有杖要興於以色列，必打破摩押的四角，毀壞擾亂之子。
verses.e: I see him , but not now . I see him , but not near . A star will come out of Jacob . A scepter will rise out of Israel , and shall strike through the corners of Moab , and crush all the sons of Sheth .

verses.z: 他必得以東為基業，又得仇敵之地西珥為產業；以色列必行事勇敢。
verses.e: Edom shall be a possession . Seir , his enemy , also shall be a possession , while Israel does valiantly .

verses.z: 有一位出於雅各的，必掌大權；他要除滅城中的餘民。
verses.e: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion , and shall destroy the remnant from the city . "

verses.z: 巴蘭舉目，看見以色列人照着支派居住。上帝的靈就臨到他身上，
verses.e: Balaam lifted up his eyes , and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes ; and the Spirit of God came on him .

verses.z: 巴蘭觀看亞瑪力，就題起詩歌說：亞瑪力原為諸國之首，但他終必沉淪。
verses.e: He looked at Amalek , and took up his parable , and said , " Amalek was the first of the nations , but his latter end shall come to destruction . "

verses.z: 巴蘭觀看基尼人，就題起詩歌說：你的住處本是堅固；你的窩巢做在巖穴中。
verses.e: He looked at the Kenite , and took up his parable , and said , " Your dwelling place is strong . Your nest is set in the rock .

verses.z: 然而基尼必至衰微，直到亞述把你擄去。
verses.e: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted , until Asshur carries you away captive . "

verses.z: 巴蘭又題起詩歌說：哀哉！上帝行這事，誰能得活？
verses.e: He took up his parable , and said , " Alas , who shall live when God does this ?

verses.z: 必有人乘船從基提界[而來]，苦害亞述，苦害希伯；他也必至沉淪。
verses.e: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim . They shall afflict Asshur , and shall afflict Eber . He also shall come to destruction . "

verses.z: 於是巴蘭起來，回他本地去；巴勒也回去了。
verses.e: Balaam rose up , and went and returned to his place ; and Balak also went his way .

verses.z: 他便題起詩歌說：比珥的兒子巴蘭說，眼目閉住的人說，
verses.e: He took up his parable , and said , " Balaam the son of Beor says , the man whose eyes are open says ;

verses.z: 得聽上帝的言語，得見全能者的異象，眼目睜開而仆倒的人說：
verses.e: he says , who hears the words of God , who sees the vision of the Almighty , falling down , and having his eyes open :

verses.z: 雅各啊，你的帳棚何等華美！以色列啊，你的帳幕何其華麗！
verses.e: How goodly are your tents , Jacob , and your dwellings , Israel !

verses.z: 如接連的山谷，如河旁的園子，如耶和華所栽的沉香樹，如水邊的香柏木。
verses.e: As valleys they are spread out , as gardens by the riverside , as aloes which the LORD has planted , as cedar trees beside the waters .

verses.z: 水要從他的桶裏流出；種子要撒在多水之處。他的王必超過亞甲；他的國必要振興。
verses.e: Water shall flow from his buckets . His seed shall be in many waters . His king shall be higher than Agag . His kingdom shall be exalted .

verses.z: 上帝領他出埃及；他似乎有野牛之力。他要吞吃敵國，折斷他們的骨頭，用箭射透他們。
verses.e: God brings him out of Egypt . He has as it were the strength of the wild ox . He shall consume the nations his adversaries , shall break their bones in pieces , and pierce them with his arrows .

verses.z: 他蹲如公獅，臥如母獅，誰敢惹他？凡給你祝福的，願他蒙福；凡咒詛你的，願他受咒詛。
verses.e: He couched , he lay down as a lion , as a lioness ; who shall rouse him up ? Everyone who blesses you is blessed . Everyone who curses you is cursed . "

verses.z: 以色列人住在什亭，百姓與摩押女子行起淫亂。
verses.e: Israel stayed in Shittim ; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab ;

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「祭司亞倫的孫子，以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈，使我向以色列人所發的怒消了；因他在他們中間，以我的忌邪為心，使我不在忌邪中把他們除滅。
verses.e: " Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel , in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them , so that I didn't consume the children of Israel in my jealousy .

verses.z: 因此，你要說：『我將我平安的約賜給他。
verses.e: Therefore say , ' Behold , I give to him my covenant of peace .

verses.z: 這約要給他和他的後裔，作為永遠當祭司職任的約；因他為上帝有忌邪的心，為以色列人贖罪。』」
verses.e: It shall be to him , and to his offspring after him , the covenant of an everlasting priesthood , because he was jealous for his God , and made atonement for the children of Israel . ' "

verses.z: 那與米甸女人一同被殺的以色列人，名叫心利，是撒路的兒子，是西緬一個宗族的首領。
verses.e: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain , who was slain with the Midianite woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a fathers ' house among the Simeonites .

verses.z: 那被殺的米甸女人，名叫哥斯比，是蘇珥的女兒；這蘇珥是米甸一個宗族的首領。
verses.e: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur . He was head of the people of a fathers ' house in Midian .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要擾害米甸人，擊殺他們；
verses.e: " Harass the Midianites , and strike them ;

verses.z: 因為他們用詭計擾害你們，在毗珥的事上和他們的姊妹、米甸首領的女兒哥斯比的事上，用這詭計誘惑了你們；這哥斯比，當瘟疫流行的日子，因毗珥的事被殺了。」
verses.e: for they harassed you with their wiles , wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor , and in the incident regarding Cozbi , the daughter of the prince of Midian , their sister , who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor . "

verses.z: 因為這女子叫百姓來，一同給她們的神獻祭，百姓就吃[她們的祭物]，跪拜她們的神。
verses.e: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods . The people ate and bowed down to their gods .

verses.z: 以色列人與巴力‧毗珥連合，耶和華的怒氣就向以色列人發作。
verses.e: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor , and the LORD's anger burned against Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「將百姓中所有的族長在我面前對着日頭懸掛，使我向以色列人所發的怒氣可以消了。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Take all the chiefs of the people , and hang them up to the LORD before the sun , that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel . "

verses.z: 於是摩西吩咐以色列的審判官說：「凡屬你們的人，有與巴力‧毗珥連合的，你們各人要把他們殺了。」
verses.e: Moses said to the judges of Israel , " Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor . "

verses.z: 摩西和以色列全會眾正在會幕門前哭泣的時候，誰知，有以色列中的一個人，當他們眼前，帶着一個米甸女人到他弟兄那裏去。
verses.e: Behold , one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses , and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel , while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 祭司亞倫的孫子，以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈看見了，就從會中起來，手裏拿着槍，
verses.e: When Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , saw it , he rose up from the middle of the congregation , and took a spear in his hand .

verses.z: 跟隨那以色列人進亭子裏去，便將以色列人和那女人由腹中刺透。這樣，在以色列人中瘟疫就止息了。
verses.e: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion , and thrust both of them through , the man of Israel , and the woman through her body . So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 那時遭瘟疫死的，有二萬四千人。
verses.e: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand .

verses.z: 瘟疫之後，耶和華曉諭摩西和祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒說：
verses.e: After the plague , the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , saying ,

verses.z: 地便開口吞了他們，和可拉、可拉的黨類一同死亡。那時火燒滅了二百五十個人；他們就作了警戒。
verses.e: and the earth opened its mouth , and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died ; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men , and they became a sign .

verses.z: 然而可拉的眾子沒有死亡。
verses.e: Notwithstanding , the sons of Korah didn't die .

verses.z: 按着家族，西緬的眾子：屬尼母利的，有尼母利族；屬雅憫的，有雅憫族；屬雅斤的，有雅斤族；
verses.e: The sons of Simeon after their families : of Nemuel , the family of the Nemuelites ; of Jamin , the family of the Jaminites ; of Jachin , the family of the Jachinites ;

verses.z: 屬謝拉的，有謝拉族；屬掃羅的，有掃羅族。
verses.e: of Zerah , the family of the Zerahites ; of Shaul , the family of the Shaulites .

verses.z: 這就是西緬的各族，共有二萬二千二百名。
verses.e: These are the families of the Simeonites , twenty-two thousand two hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，迦得的眾子：屬洗分的，有洗分族；屬哈基的，有哈基族；屬書尼的，有書尼族；
verses.e: The sons of Gad after their families : of Zephon , the family of the Zephonites ; of Haggi , the family of the Haggites ; of Shuni , the family of the Shunites ;

verses.z: 屬阿斯尼的，有阿斯尼族；屬以利的，有以利族；
verses.e: of Ozni , the family of the Oznites ; of Eri , the family of the Erites ;

verses.z: 屬亞律的，有亞律族；屬亞列利的，有亞列利族。
verses.e: of Arod , the family of the Arodites ; of Areli , the family of the Arelites .

verses.z: 這就是迦得子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
verses.e: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them , forty thousand and five hundred .

verses.z: 猶大的兒子是珥和俄南。這珥和俄南死在迦南地。
verses.e: The sons of Judah : Er and Onan . Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 「你們要將以色列全會眾，按他們的宗族，凡以色列中從二十歲以外、能出去打仗的，計算總數。」
verses.e: " Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel , from twenty years old and upward , by their fathers ' houses , all who are able to go out to war in Israel . "

verses.z: 按着家族，猶大[其餘]的眾子：屬示拉的，有示拉族；屬法勒斯的，有法勒斯族；屬謝拉的，有謝拉族。
verses.e: The sons of Judah after their families were : of Shelah , the family of the Shelanites ; of Perez , the family of the Perezites ; of Zerah , the family of the Zerahites .

verses.z: 法勒斯的兒子：屬希斯崙的，有希斯崙族；屬哈母勒的，有哈母勒族。
verses.e: The sons of Perez were : of Hezron , the family of the Hezronites ; of Hamul , the family of the Hamulites .

verses.z: 這就是猶大的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有七萬六千五百名。
verses.e: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them , seventy-six thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，以薩迦的眾子：屬陀拉的，有陀拉族；屬普瓦的，有普瓦族；
verses.e: The sons of Issachar after their families : of Tola , the family of the Tolaites ; of Puvah , the family of the Punites ;

verses.z: 屬雅述的，有雅述族；屬伸崙的，有伸崙族。
verses.e: of Jashub , the family of the Jashubites ; of Shimron , the family of the Shimronites .

verses.z: 這就是以薩迦的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有六萬四千三百名。
verses.e: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them , sixty-four thousand three hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，西布倫的眾子：屬西烈的，有西烈族；屬以倫的，有以倫族；屬雅利的，有雅利族。
verses.e: The sons of Zebulun after their families : of Sered , the family of the Seredites ; of Elon , the family of the Elonites ; of Jahleel , the family of the Jahleelites .

verses.z: 這就是西布倫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有六萬零五百名。
verses.e: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them , sixty thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，約瑟的兒子有瑪拿西、以法蓮。
verses.e: The sons of Joseph after their families : Manasseh and Ephraim .

verses.z: 瑪拿西的眾子：屬瑪吉的，有瑪吉族；瑪吉生基列；屬基列的，有基列族。
verses.e: The sons of Manasseh : of Machir , the family of the Machirites ; and Machir became the father of Gilead ; of Gilead , the family of the Gileadites .

verses.z: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒在摩押平原與耶利哥相對的約旦河邊向以色列人說：
verses.e: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho , saying ,

verses.z: 基列的眾子：屬伊以謝的，有伊以謝族；屬希勒的，有希勒族；
verses.e: These are the sons of Gilead : of Iezer , the family of the Iezerites ; of Helek , the family of the Helekites ;

verses.z: 屬亞斯烈的，有亞斯烈族；屬示劍的，有示劍族；
verses.e: and Asriel , the family of the Asrielites ; and Shechem , the family of the Shechemites ;

verses.z: 屬示米大的，有示米大族；屬希弗的，有希弗族。
verses.e: and Shemida , the family of the Shemidaites ; and Hepher , the family of the Hepherites .

verses.z: 希弗的兒子：西羅非哈沒兒子，只有女兒。西羅非哈女兒的名字就是瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
verses.e: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons , but daughters : and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah , Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .

verses.z: 這就是瑪拿西的各族；他們中間被數的，共有五萬二千七百名。
verses.e: These are the families of Manasseh . Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，以法蓮的眾子：屬書提拉的，有書提拉族；屬比結的，有比結族；屬他罕的，有他罕族。
verses.e: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families : of Shuthelah , the family of the Shuthelahites ; of Becher , the family of the Becherites ; of Tahan , the family of the Tahanites .

verses.z: 書提拉的眾子：屬以蘭的，有以蘭族。
verses.e: These are the sons of Shuthelah : of Eran , the family of the Eranites .

verses.z: 這就是以法蓮子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有三萬二千五百名。按着家族，這都是約瑟的子孫。
verses.e: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them , thirty-two thousand five hundred . These are the sons of Joseph after their families .

verses.z: 按着家族，便雅憫的眾子：屬比拉的，有比拉族；屬亞實別的，有亞實別族；屬亞希蘭的，有亞希蘭族；
verses.e: The sons of Benjamin after their families : of Bela , the family of the Belaites ; of Ashbel , the family of the Ashbelites ; of Ahiram , the family of the Ahiramites ;

verses.z: 屬書反的，有書反族；屬戶反的，有戶反族。
verses.e: of Shephupham , the family of the Shuphamites ; of Hupham , the family of the Huphamites .

verses.z: 「將你們中間從二十歲以外的[計算總數]」；是照耶和華吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的話。
verses.e: " Take a census , from twenty years old and upward , as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel . " These are those who came out of the land of Egypt .

verses.z: 比拉的眾子是亞勒、乃幔。[屬亞勒的]，有亞勒族；屬乃幔的，有乃幔族。
verses.e: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman : the family of the Ardites ; and of Naaman , the family of the Naamites .

verses.z: 按着家族，這就是便雅憫的子孫，其中被數的，共有四萬五千六百名。
verses.e: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families ; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，但的眾子：屬書含的，有書含族。按着家族，這就是但的各族。
verses.e: These are the sons of Dan after their families : of Shuham , the family of the Shuhamites . These are the families of Dan after their families .

verses.z: 照其中被數的，書含所有的各族，共有六萬四千四百名。
verses.e: All the families of the Shuhamites , according to those who were counted of them , were sixty-four thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，亞設的眾子：屬音拿的，有音拿族；屬亦施韋的，有亦施韋族；屬比利亞的，有比利亞族。
verses.e: The sons of Asher after their families : of Imnah , the family of the Imnites ; of Ishvi , the family of the Ishvites ; of Beriah , the family of the Berites .

verses.z: 比利亞的眾子：屬希別的，有希別族；屬瑪結的，有瑪結族。
verses.e: Of the sons of Beriah : of Heber , the family of the Heberites ; of Malchiel , the family of the Malchielites .

verses.z: 亞設的女兒名叫西拉。
verses.e: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah .

verses.z: 這就是亞設子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
verses.e: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them , fifty-three thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 按着家族，拿弗他利的眾子：屬雅薛的，有雅薛族；屬沽尼的，有沽尼族；
verses.e: The sons of Naphtali after their families : of Jahzeel , the family of the Jahzeelites ; of Guni , the family of the Gunites ;

verses.z: 屬耶色的，有耶色族；屬示冷的，有示冷族。
verses.e: of Jezer , the family of the Jezerites ; of Shillem , the family of the Shillemites .

verses.z: 以色列的長子是呂便。呂便的眾子：屬哈諾的，有哈諾族；屬法路的，有法路族；
verses.e: Reuben , the firstborn of Israel ; the sons of Reuben : of Hanoch , the family of the Hanochites ; of Pallu , the family of the Palluites ;

verses.z: 按着家族，這就是拿弗他利的各族；他們中間被數的，共有四萬五千四百名。
verses.e: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families ; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred .

verses.z: 以色列人中被數的，共有六十萬零一千七百三十名。
verses.e: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel , six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要按着人名的數目將地分給這些人為業。
verses.e: " To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names .

verses.z: 人多的，你要把產業多分給他們；人少的，你要把產業少分給他們；要照被數的人數，把產業分給各人。
