verses.e: To the more you shall give the more inheritance , and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance . To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given .

verses.z: 雖是這樣，還要拈鬮分地。他們要按着祖宗各支派的名字承受為業。
verses.e: Notwithstanding , the land shall be divided by lot . According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit .

verses.z: 要按着所拈的鬮，看人數多，人數少，把產業分給他們。」
verses.e: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer . "

verses.z: 利未人，按着他們的各族被數的：屬革順的，有革順族；屬哥轄的，有哥轄族；屬米拉利的，有米拉利族。
verses.e: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families : of Gershon , the family of the Gershonites ; of Kohath , the family of the Kohathites ; of Merari , the family of the Merarites .

verses.z: 利未的各族有立尼族、希伯倫族、瑪利族、母示族、可拉族。哥轄生暗蘭。
verses.e: These are the families of Levi : the family of the Libnites , the family of the Hebronites , the family of the Mahlites , the family of the Mushites , and the family of the Korahites . Kohath became the father of Amram .

verses.z: 暗蘭的妻名叫約基別，是利未女子，生在埃及。她給暗蘭生了亞倫、摩西，並他們的姊姊米利暗。
verses.e: The name of Amram's wife was Jochebed , the daughter of Levi , who was born to Levi in Egypt . She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses , and Miriam their sister .

verses.z: 屬希斯倫的，有希斯倫族；屬迦米的，有迦米族；
verses.e: of Hezron , the family of the Hezronites ; of Carmi , the family of the Carmites .

verses.z: 亞倫生拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
verses.e: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu , Eleazar and Ithamar .

verses.z: 拿答、亞比戶在耶和華面前獻凡火的時候就死了。
verses.e: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD .

verses.z: 利未人中，凡一個月以外、被數的男丁，共有二萬三千。他們本來沒有數在以色列人中；因為在以色列人中，沒有分給他們產業。
verses.e: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand , every male from a month old and upward ; for they were not counted among the children of Israel , because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 這些就是被摩西和祭司以利亞撒所數的；他們在摩押平原與耶利哥相對的約旦河邊數點以色列人。
verses.e: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest , who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho .

verses.z: 但被數的人中，沒有一個是摩西和祭司亞倫從前在西奈的曠野所數的以色列人，
verses.e: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest , who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai .

verses.z: 因為耶和華論到他們說：「他們必要死在曠野。」所以，除了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞以外，連一個人也沒有存留。
verses.e: For the LORD had said of them , " They shall surely die in the wilderness . " There was not a man left of them , except Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .

verses.z: 這就是呂便的各族；其中被數的，共有四萬三千七百三十名。
verses.e: These are the families of the Reubenites ; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty .

verses.z: 法路的兒子是以利押。
verses.e: The son of Pallu : Eliab .

verses.z: 以利押的眾子是尼母利、大坍、亞比蘭。這大坍、亞比蘭，就是從會中選召的，與可拉一黨同向耶和華爭鬧的時候也向摩西、亞倫爭鬧；
verses.e: The sons of Eliab : Nemuel , Dathan , and Abiram . These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation , who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD ;

verses.z: 屬約瑟的兒子瑪拿西的各族，有瑪拿西的玄孫，瑪吉的曾孫，基列的孫子，希弗的兒子西羅非哈的女兒，名叫瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。她們前來，
verses.e: Then the daughters of Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near . These are the names of his daughters : Mahlah , Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .

verses.z: 他若沒有弟兄，就要把他的產業給他父親的弟兄。
verses.e: If he has no brothers , then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers .

verses.z: 他父親若沒有弟兄，就要把他的產業給他族中最近的親屬，他便要得為業。』這要作以色列人的律例典章，是照耶和華吩咐摩西的。」
verses.e: If his father has no brothers , then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family , and he shall possess it . This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel , as the LORD commanded Moses . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你上這亞巴琳山，觀看我所賜給以色列人的地。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Go up into this mountain of Abarim , and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel .

verses.z: 看了以後，你也必歸到你列祖那裏，像你哥哥亞倫一樣。
verses.e: When you have seen it , you also shall be gathered to your people , as Aaron your brother was gathered ;

verses.z: 因為你們在尋的曠野，當會眾爭鬧的時候，違背了我的命，沒有在[湧]水之地、會眾眼前尊我為聖。」（這水就是尋的曠野加低斯米利巴水。）
verses.e: because in the strife of the congregation , you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin , to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes . " ( These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin . )

verses.z: 摩西對耶和華說：
verses.e: Moses spoke to the LORD , saying ,

verses.z: 「願耶和華萬人之靈的上帝，立一個人治理會眾，
verses.e: " Let the LORD , the God of the spirits of all flesh , appoint a man over the congregation ,

verses.z: 可以在他們面前出入，也可以引導他們，免得耶和華的會眾如同沒有牧人的羊群一般。」
verses.e: who may go out before them , and who may come in before them , and who may lead them out , and who may bring them in , that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「嫩的兒子約書亞是心中有[聖]靈的；你將他領來，按手在他[頭]上，
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Take Joshua the son of Nun , a man in whom is the Spirit , and lay your hand on him .

verses.z: 使他站在祭司以利亞撒和全會眾面前，囑咐他，
verses.e: Set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation ; and commission him in their sight .

verses.z: 站在會幕門口，在摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並眾首領與全會眾面前，說：
verses.e: They stood before Moses , before Eleazar the priest , and before the princes and all the congregation , at the door of the Tent of Meeting , saying ,

verses.z: 又將你的尊榮給他幾分，使以色列全會眾都聽從他。
verses.e: You shall give authority to him , that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey .

verses.z: 他要站在祭司以利亞撒面前；以利亞撒要憑烏陵的判斷，在耶和華面前為他求問。他和以色列全會眾都要遵以利亞撒的命出入。」
verses.e: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest , who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD . At his word they shall go out , and at his word they shall come in , both he and all the children of Israel with him , even all the congregation . "

verses.z: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的將約書亞領來，使他站在祭司以利亞撒和全會眾面前，
verses.e: Moses did as the LORD commanded him . He took Joshua , and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation .

verses.z: 按手在他[頭]上，囑咐他，是照耶和華藉摩西所說的話。
verses.e: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him , as the LORD spoke by Moses .

verses.z: 「我們的父親死在曠野。他不與可拉同黨聚集攻擊耶和華，是在自己罪中死的；他也沒有兒子。
verses.e: " Our father died in the wilderness . He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah , but he died in his own sin . He had no sons .

verses.z: 為甚麼因我們的父親沒有兒子就把他的名從他族中除掉呢？求你們在我們父親的弟兄中分給我們產業。」
verses.e: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family , because he had no son ? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father . "

verses.z: 於是，摩西將她們的案件呈到耶和華面前。
verses.e: Moses brought their cause before the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「西羅非哈的女兒說得有理。你定要在她們父親的弟兄中，把地分給她們為業；要將她們父親的產業歸給她們。
verses.e: " The daughters of Zelophehad speak right . You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brothers . You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them .

verses.z: 你也要曉諭以色列人說：『人若死了沒有兒子，就要把他的產業歸給他的女兒。
verses.e: You shall speak to the children of Israel , saying , ' If a man dies , and has no son , then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter .

verses.z: 他若沒有女兒，就要把他的產業給他的弟兄。
verses.e: If he has no daughter , then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 這是每安息日獻的燔祭；那常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭在外。」
verses.e: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath , in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「每月朔，你們要將兩隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，七隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，獻給耶和華為燔祭。
verses.e: " ' In the beginnings of your months , you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD : two young bulls , one ram , seven male lambs a year old without defect ,

verses.z: 每隻公牛要用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之三作為素祭；那隻公羊也用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之二作為素祭；
verses.e: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil , for each bull ; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil , for the one ram ;

verses.z: 每隻羊羔要用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之一作為素祭和馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭。
verses.e: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb , as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma , an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 一隻公牛要奠酒半欣，一隻公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一隻羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。這是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
verses.e: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull , the third part of a hin for the ram , and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb . This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year .

verses.z: 又要將一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，獻給耶和華；要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。」
verses.e: Also , one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「正月十四日是耶和華的逾越節。
verses.e: " ' In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month , is the LORD's Passover .

verses.z: 這月十五日是節期，要吃無酵餅七日。
verses.e: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast . Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days .

verses.z: 第一日當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
verses.e: In the first day shall be a holy convocation . You shall do no regular work ,

verses.z: 當將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為燔祭。
verses.e: but you shall offer an offering made by fire , a burnt offering to the LORD : two young bulls , one ram , and seven male lambs a year old . They shall be without defect ,

verses.z: 「你要吩咐以色列人說：『獻給我的供物，就是獻給我作馨香火祭的食物，你們要按日期獻給我』；
verses.e: " Command the children of Israel , and tell them , ' See that you present my offering , my food for my offerings made by fire , as a pleasant aroma to me , in their due season . '

verses.z: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
verses.e: with their meal offering , fine flour mixed with oil . You shall offer three tenths for a bull , and two tenths for the ram .

verses.z: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
verses.e: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs ;

verses.z: 並獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering , to make atonement for you .

verses.z: 你們獻這些，要在早晨常獻的燔祭以外。
verses.e: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .

verses.z: 一連七日，每日要照這例把馨香火祭的食物獻給耶和華，是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: In this way you shall offer daily , for seven days , the food of the offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD . It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering .

verses.z: 第七日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。」
verses.e: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation . You shall do no regular work .

verses.z: 「七七[節]莊稼初熟，你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子，當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
verses.e: " ' Also in the day of the first fruits , when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks , you shall have a holy convocation . You shall do no regular work ;

verses.z: 只要將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD : two young bulls , one ram , seven male lambs a year old ;

verses.z: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為每隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
verses.e: and their meal offering , fine flour mixed with oil , three tenths for each bull , two tenths for the one ram ,

verses.z: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
verses.e: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs ;

verses.z: 又要對他們說：你們要獻給耶和華的火祭，就是沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，每日兩隻，作為常獻的燔祭。
verses.e: You shall tell them , ' This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD : male lambs a year old without defect , two day by day , for a continual burnt offering .

verses.z: 並獻一隻公山羊為你們贖罪。
verses.e: and one male goat , to make atonement for you .

verses.z: 這些，你們要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外，都要沒有殘疾的。」
verses.e: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering , you shall offer them and their drink offerings . See that they are without defect .

verses.z: 早晨要獻一隻，黃昏的時候要獻一隻；
verses.e: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning , and you shall offer the other lamb at evening ,

verses.z: 又用細麵伊法十分之一，並搗成的油一欣四分之一，調和作為素祭。
verses.e: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering , mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil .

verses.z: 這是西奈山所命定為常獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
verses.e: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma , an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 為這一隻羊羔，要同獻奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在聖所中，你要將醇酒奉給耶和華為奠祭。
verses.e: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb . You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place .

verses.z: 晚上，你要獻那一隻羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同獻的奠祭獻上，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。」
verses.e: The other lamb you shall offer at evening . As the meal offering of the morning , and as its drink offering , you shall offer it , an offering made by fire , for a pleasant aroma to the LORD .

verses.z: 「當安息日，要獻兩隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，並用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之二為素祭，又將同獻的奠祭獻上。
verses.e: " ' On the Sabbath day , you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect , and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil , and its drink offering :

verses.z: 「七月初一日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做，是你們當守為吹角的日子。
verses.e: " ' In the seventh month , on the first day of the month , you shall have a holy convocation ; you shall do no regular work . It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you .

verses.z: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
verses.e: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs ;

verses.z: 又獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在贖罪祭和常獻的燔祭，與同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。」
verses.e: one male goat for a sin offering , in addition to the sin offering of atonement , and the continual burnt offering , and its meal offering , and their drink offerings .

verses.z: 「七月十五日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做，要向耶和華守節七日。
verses.e: " ' On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation . You shall do no regular work . You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days .

verses.z: 又要將公牛犢十三隻，公綿羊兩隻，一歲的公羊羔十四隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為馨香的燔祭。
verses.e: You shall offer a burnt offering , an offering made by fire , of a pleasant aroma to the LORD : thirteen young bulls , two rams , fourteen male lambs a year old , all without defect ;

verses.z: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為那十三隻公牛，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之三；為那兩隻公羊，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之二；
verses.e: and their meal offering , fine flour mixed with oil : three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls , two tenths for each ram of the two rams ,

verses.z: 為那十四隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
verses.e: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs ;

verses.z: 並獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering , in addition to the continual burnt offering , its meal offering , and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「第二日[要獻]公牛犢十二隻，公綿羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
verses.e: " ' On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls , two rams , and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
verses.e: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls , for the rams , and for the lambs , according to their number , after the ordinance ;

verses.z: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering , in addition to the continual burnt offering , with its meal offering and their drink offerings .

verses.z: 你們要將公牛犢一隻，公綿羊一隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD : one young bull , one ram , seven male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 「第三日[要獻]公牛十一隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
verses.e: " ' On the third day : eleven bulls , two rams , fourteen male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
verses.e: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls , for the rams , and for the lambs , according to their number , after the ordinance ;

verses.z: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering , in addition to the continual burnt offering , and its meal offering , and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「第四日[要獻]公牛十隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
verses.e: " ' On the fourth day ten bulls , two rams , fourteen male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
verses.e: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls , for the rams , and for the lambs , according to their number , after the ordinance ;

verses.z: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering ; in addition to the continual burnt offering , its meal offering , and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「第五日[要獻]公牛九隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
verses.e: " ' On the fifth day : nine bulls , two rams , fourteen male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
verses.e: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls , for the rams , and for the lambs , according to their number , after the ordinance ,

verses.z: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering , in addition to the continual burnt offering , and its meal offering , and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「第六日[要獻]公牛八隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
verses.e: " ' On the sixth day : eight bulls , two rams , fourteen male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
verses.e: and their meal offering , fine flour mixed with oil : three tenths for the bull , two tenths for the ram ,

verses.z: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
verses.e: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls , for the rams , and for the lambs , according to their number , after the ordinance ,

verses.z: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering ; in addition to the continual burnt offering , its meal offering , and the drink offerings of it .

verses.z: 「第七日[要獻]公牛七隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
verses.e: " ' On the seventh day : seven bulls , two rams , fourteen male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
verses.e: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls , for the rams , and for the lambs , according to their number , after the ordinance ,

verses.z: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering ; in addition to the continual burnt offering , its meal offering , and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「第八日你們當有嚴肅會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；
verses.e: " ' On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly . You shall do no regular work ;

verses.z: 只要將公牛一隻，公羊一隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔七隻作火祭，獻給耶和華為馨香的燔祭；
verses.e: but you shall offer a burnt offering , an offering made by fire , a pleasant aroma to the LORD : one bull , one ram , seven male lambs a year old without defect ;

verses.z: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
verses.e: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull , for the ram , and for the lambs , shall be according to their number , after the ordinance ,

verses.z: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering , in addition to the continual burnt offering , with its meal offering , and its drink offering .

verses.z: 「這些祭要在你們的節期獻給耶和華，都在所許的願並甘心所獻的以外，作為你們的燔祭、素祭、奠祭，和平安祭。」
verses.e: " ' You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts — in addition to your vows and your free will offerings — for your burnt offerings , your meal offerings , your drink offerings , and your peace offerings . ' "

verses.z: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
verses.e: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs ;

verses.z: 於是，摩西照耶和華所吩咐他的一切話告訴以色列人。
verses.e: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。
verses.e: and one male goat for a sin offering , to make atonement for you ;

verses.z: 這些是在月朔的燔祭和同獻的素祭，並常獻的燔祭與同獻的素祭，以及照例同獻的奠祭以外，都作為馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。」
verses.e: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering , and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering , and their drink offerings , according to their ordinance , for a pleasant aroma , an offering made by fire to the LORD .

verses.z: 「七月初十日，你們當有聖會；要刻苦己心，甚麼工都不可做。
verses.e: " ' On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation . You shall afflict your souls . You shall do no kind of work ;

verses.z: 只要將公牛犢一隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
verses.e: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma : one young bull , one ram , seven male lambs a year old , all without defect ;

verses.z: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵：為一隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
verses.e: and their meal offering , fine flour mixed with oil : three tenths for the bull , two tenths for the one ram ,

verses.z: 耶和華在西奈山曉諭摩西的日子，亞倫和摩西的後代如下：
verses.e: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai .

verses.z: 你要囑咐亞倫和他的兒子謹守自己祭司的職任。近前來的外人必被治死。」
verses.e: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons , and they shall keep their priesthood , but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「我從以色列人中揀選了利未人，代替以色列人一切頭生的；利未人要歸我。
verses.e: " Behold , I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel ; and the Levites shall be mine ,

verses.z: 因為凡頭生的是我的；我在埃及地擊殺一切頭生的那日就把以色列中一切頭生的，連人帶牲畜都分別為聖歸我；他們定要屬我。我是耶和華。」
verses.e: for all the firstborn are mine . On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel , both man and animal . They shall be mine . I am the LORD . "

verses.z: 耶和華在西奈的曠野曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要照利未人的宗族、家室數點他們。凡一個月以外的男子都要數點。」
verses.e: " Count the children of Levi by their fathers ' houses , by their families . You shall count every male from a month old and upward . "

verses.z: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的數點他們。
verses.e: Moses counted them according to the LORD's word , as he was commanded .

verses.z: 利未眾子的名字是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
verses.e: These were the sons of Levi by their names : Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

verses.z: 革順的兒子，按着家室，是立尼、示每。
verses.e: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families : Libni and Shimei .

verses.z: 哥轄的兒子，按着家室，是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
verses.e: The sons of Kohath by their families : Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel .

verses.z: 亞倫的兒子，長子名叫拿答，還有亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
verses.e: These are the names of the sons of Aaron : Nadab the firstborn , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .

verses.z: 米拉利的兒子，按着家室，是抹利、母示。這些按着宗族是利未人的家室。
verses.e: The sons of Merari by their families : Mahli and Mushi . These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers ' houses .

verses.z: 屬革順的，有立尼族、示每族。這是革順的二族。
verses.e: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites , and the family of the Shimeites . These are the families of the Gershonites .

verses.z: 其中被數、從一個月以外所有的男子共有七千五百名。
verses.e: Those who were counted of them , according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward , even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred .

verses.z: 這革順的二族要在帳幕後西邊安營。
verses.e: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward .

verses.z: 拉伊勒的兒子以利雅薩作革順人宗族的首領。
verses.e: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers ' house of the Gershonites .

verses.z: 革順的子孫在會幕中所要看守的，就是帳幕和罩棚，並罩棚的蓋與會幕的門簾，
verses.e: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle , the tent , its covering , the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting ,

verses.z: 院子的帷子和門簾（院子是圍帳幕和壇的），並一切使用的繩子。
verses.e: the hangings of the court , the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar , and its cords for all of its service .

verses.z: 屬哥轄的，有暗蘭族、以斯哈族、希伯倫族、烏薛族。這是哥轄的諸族。
verses.e: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites , the family of the Izharites , the family of the Hebronites , and the family of the Uzzielites . These are the families of the Kohathites .

verses.z: 按所有男子的數目，從一個月以外看守聖所的，共有八千六百名。
verses.e: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward , there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary .

verses.z: 哥轄兒子的諸族要在帳幕的南邊安營。
verses.e: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle .

verses.z: 這是亞倫兒子的名字，都是受膏的祭司，是摩西叫他們承接聖職供祭司職分的。
verses.e: These are the names of the sons of Aaron , the priests who were anointed , whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office .

verses.z: 烏薛的兒子以利撒反作哥轄宗族家室的首領。
verses.e: The prince of the fathers ' house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel .

verses.z: 他們所要看守的是[約]櫃、桌子、燈臺、兩座壇與聖所內使用的器皿，並簾子和一切使用之物。
verses.e: Their duty shall be the ark , the table , the lamp stand , the altars , the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister , the screen , and all its service .

verses.z: 祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒作利未人眾首領的領袖，要監察那些看守聖所的人。
verses.e: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites , with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary .

verses.z: 屬米拉利的，有抹利族、母示族。這是米拉利的二族。
verses.e: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites . These are the families of Merari .

verses.z: 他們被數的，按所有男子的數目，從一個月以外的，共有六千二百名。
verses.e: Those who were counted of them , according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward , were six thousand two hundred .

verses.z: 亞比亥的兒子蘇列作米拉利二宗族的首領。他們要在帳幕的北邊安營。
verses.e: The prince of the fathers ' house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail . They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle .

verses.z: 米拉利子孫的職分是看守帳幕的板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，和帳幕一切所使用的器具，
verses.e: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle's boards , its bars , its pillars , its sockets , all its instruments , all its service ,

verses.z: 院子四圍的柱子、帶卯的座、橛子，和繩子。
verses.e: the pillars of the court around it , their sockets , their pins , and their cords .

verses.z: 在帳幕前東邊，向日出之地安營的是摩西、亞倫，和亞倫的兒子。他們看守聖所，替以色列人守[耶和華]所吩咐的。近前來的外人必被治死。
verses.e: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward , in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise , shall be Moses , with Aaron and his sons , keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel . The outsider who comes near shall be put to death .

verses.z: 凡被數的利未人，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華吩咐所數的，按着家室，從一個月以外的男子，共有二萬二千名。
verses.e: All who were counted of the Levites , whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD , by their families , all the males from a month old and upward , were twenty-two thousand .

verses.z: 拿答、亞比戶在西奈的曠野向耶和華獻凡火的時候就死在耶和華面前了。他們也沒有兒子。以利亞撒、以他瑪在他們的父親亞倫面前供祭司的職分。
verses.e: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai , and they had no children . Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the presence of Aaron their father .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「你要從以色列人中數點一個月以外、凡頭生的男子，把他們的名字記下。
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward , and take the number of their names .

verses.z: 我是耶和華。你要揀選利未人歸我，代替以色列人所有頭生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列所有頭生的牲畜。」
verses.e: You shall take the Levites for me — I am the LORD — instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel ; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel . "

verses.z: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的把以色列人頭生的都數點了。
verses.e: Moses counted , as the LORD commanded him , all the firstborn among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 按人名的數目，從一個月以外、凡頭生的男子，共有二萬二千二百七十三名。
verses.e: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward , of those who were counted of them , were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你揀選利未人代替以色列人所有頭生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列人的牲畜。利未人要歸我；我是耶和華。
verses.e: " Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel , and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock ; and the Levites shall be mine . I am the LORD .

verses.z: 以色列人中頭生的男子比利未人多二百七十三個，必當將他們贖出來。
verses.e: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites ,

verses.z: 你要按人丁，照聖所的平，每人取贖銀五舍客勒（一舍客勒是二十季拉），
verses.e: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one ; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them ( the shekel is twenty gerahs ) ;

verses.z: 把那多餘之人的贖銀交給亞倫和他的兒子。」
verses.e: and you shall give the money , with which their remainder is redeemed , to Aaron and to his sons . "

verses.z: 於是摩西從那被利未人所贖以外的人取了贖銀。
verses.e: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites ;

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 從以色列人頭生的所取之銀，按聖所的平，有一千三百六十五[舍客勒]。
verses.e: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money , one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary ;

verses.z: 摩西照耶和華的話把這贖銀給亞倫和他的兒子，正如耶和華所吩咐的。
verses.e: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons , according to the LORD's word , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 「你使利未支派近前來，站在祭司亞倫面前好服事他，
verses.e: " Bring the tribe of Levi near , and set them before Aaron the priest , that they may minister to him .

verses.z: 替他和會眾在會幕前守所吩咐的，辦理帳幕的事。
verses.e: They shall keep his requirements , and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting , to do the service of the tabernacle .

verses.z: 又要看守會幕的器具，並守所吩咐以色列人的，辦理帳幕的事。
verses.e: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting , and the obligations of the children of Israel , to do the service of the tabernacle .

verses.z: 你要將利未人給亞倫和他的兒子，因為他們是從以色列人中選出來給他的。
verses.e: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons . They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 摩西曉諭以色列各支派的首領說：「耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：
verses.e: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel , saying , " This is the thing which the LORD has commanded .

verses.z: 她若在丈夫家裏許了願或起了誓，約束自己，
verses.e: " If she vowed in her husband's house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath ,

verses.z: 丈夫聽見，卻向她默默不言，也沒有不應承，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
verses.e: and her husband heard it , and held his peace at her and didn't disallow her , then all her vows shall stand , and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand .

verses.z: 丈夫聽見的日子，若把這兩樣全廢了，婦人口中所許的願或是約束自己的話就都不得為定，[因]她丈夫已經把這兩樣廢了；耶和華也必赦免她。
verses.e: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them , then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows , or concerning the bond of her soul , shall not stand . Her husband has made them void . The LORD will forgive her .

verses.z: 凡她所許的願和刻苦約束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以堅定，也可以廢去。
verses.e: Every vow , and every binding oath to afflict the soul , her husband may establish it , or her husband may make it void .

verses.z: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是堅定她所許的願和約束自己的話；因丈夫聽見的日子向她默默不言，就使這兩樣堅定。
verses.e: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day , then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her . He has established them , because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them .

verses.z: 但她丈夫聽見以後，若使這兩樣全廢了，就要擔當婦人的罪孽。」
verses.e: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them , then he shall bear her iniquity . "

verses.z: 這是丈夫待妻子，父親待女兒，女兒年幼、還在父家，耶和華所吩咐摩西的律例。
verses.e: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between a father and his daughter , being in her youth , in her father's house .

verses.z: 人若向耶和華許願或起誓，要約束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切話行。
verses.e: When a man vows a vow to the LORD , or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond , he shall not break his word . He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth .

verses.z: 女子年幼、還在父家的時候，若向耶和華許願，要約束自己，
verses.e: " Also , when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge , being in her father's house , in her youth ,

verses.z: 她父親也聽見她所許的願並約束自己的話，卻向她默默不言，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
verses.e: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul , and her father says nothing to her , then all her vows shall stand , and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand .

verses.z: 但她父親聽見的日子若不應承她所許的願和約束自己的話，就都不得為定；耶和華也必赦免她，因為她父親不應承。
verses.e: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears , none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul , shall stand . The LORD will forgive her , because her father has forbidden her .

verses.z: 她若出了嫁，有願在身，或是口中出了約束自己的冒失話，
verses.e: " If she has a husband , while her vows are on her , or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul ,

verses.z: 她丈夫聽見的日子，卻向她默默不言，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
verses.e: and her husband hears it , and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it ; then her vows shall stand , and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand .

verses.z: 但她丈夫聽見的日子，若不應承，就算廢了她所許的願和她出口約束自己的冒失話；耶和華也必赦免她。
verses.e: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it , then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips , with which she has bound her soul . The LORD will forgive her .

verses.z: 寡婦或是被休的婦人所許的願，就是她約束自己的話，都要為定。
verses.e: " But the vow of a widow , or of her who is divorced , everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 又用火焚燒他們所住的城邑和所有的營寨，
verses.e: All their cities in the places in which they lived , and all their encampments , they burned with fire .

verses.z: 把一切所奪的、所擄的，連人帶牲畜都帶了去，
verses.e: They took all the captives , and all the plunder , both of man and of animal .

verses.z: 將所擄的人，所奪的牲畜、財物，都帶到摩押平原，在約旦河邊與耶利哥相對的營盤，交給摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並以色列的會眾。
verses.e: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder , to Moses , and to Eleazar the priest , and to the congregation of the children of Israel , to the camp at the plains of Moab , which are by the Jordan at Jericho .

verses.z: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾一切的首領，都出到營外迎接他們。
verses.e: Moses and Eleazar the priest , with all the princes of the congregation , went out to meet them outside of the camp .

verses.z: 摩西向打仗回來的軍長，就是千夫長、百夫長，發怒，
verses.e: Moses was angry with the officers of the army , the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds , who came from the service of the war .

verses.z: 對他們說：「你們要存留這一切婦女的活命嗎？
verses.e: Moses said to them , " Have you saved all the women alive ?

verses.z: 這些婦女因巴蘭的計謀，叫以色列人在毗珥的事上得罪耶和華，以致耶和華的會眾遭遇瘟疫。
verses.e: Behold , these caused the children of Israel , through the counsel of Balaam , to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor , and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD .

verses.z: 所以，你們要把一切的男孩和所有已嫁的女子都殺了。
verses.e: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones , and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him .

verses.z: 但女孩子中，凡沒有出嫁的，你們都可以存留她的活命。
verses.e: But all the girls , who have not known man by lying with him , keep alive for yourselves .

verses.z: 你們要在營外駐紮七日；凡殺了人的，和一切摸了被殺的，並你們所擄來的人口，第三日，第七日，都要潔淨自己，
verses.e: " Encamp outside of the camp for seven days . Whoever has killed any person , and whoever has touched any slain , purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day , you and your captives .

verses.z: 「你要在米甸人身上報以色列人的仇，後來要歸到你列祖那裏。」
verses.e: " Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites . Afterward you shall be gathered to your people . "

verses.z: 也要因一切的衣服、皮物、山羊[毛]織的物，和各樣的木器，潔淨自己。」
verses.e: You shall purify every garment , and all that is made of skin , and all work of goats ' hair , and all things made of wood . "

verses.z: 祭司以利亞撒對打仗回來的兵丁說：「耶和華所吩咐摩西律法中的條例乃是這樣：
verses.e: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle , " This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses .

verses.z: 金、銀、銅、鐵、錫、鉛，
verses.e: However the gold , and the silver , the bronze , the iron , the tin , and the lead ,

verses.z: 凡能見火的，你們要叫它經火就為潔淨，然而還要用除污穢的水潔淨它；凡不能見火的，你們要叫它過水。
verses.e: everything that may withstand the fire , you shall make to go through the fire , and it shall be clean ; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity . All that doesn't withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water .

verses.z: 第七日，你們要洗衣服，就為潔淨，然後可以進營。」
verses.e: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day , and you shall be clean . Afterward you shall come into the camp . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾的各族長，要計算所擄來的人口和牲畜的總數。
verses.e: " Count the plunder that was taken , both of man and of animal , you , and Eleazar the priest , and the heads of the fathers ' households of the congregation ;

verses.z: 把所擄來的分作兩半：一半歸與出去打仗的精兵，一半歸與全會眾。
verses.e: and divide the plunder into two parts : between the men skilled in war , who went out to battle , and all the congregation .

verses.z: 又要從出去打仗所得的人口、牛、驢、羊群中，每五百取一，作為貢物奉給耶和華。
verses.e: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle : one soul of five hundred ; of the persons , of the cattle , of the donkeys , and of the flocks .

verses.z: 從他們一半之中，要取出來交給祭司以利亞撒，作為耶和華的舉祭。
verses.e: Take it from their half , and give it to Eleazar the priest , for the LORD's wave offering .

verses.z: 摩西吩咐百姓說：「要從你們中間叫人帶兵器出去攻擊米甸，好在米甸人身上為耶和華報仇。
verses.e: Moses spoke to the people , saying , " Arm men from among you for war , that they may go against Midian , to execute the LORD's vengeance on Midian .

verses.z: 從以色列人的一半之中，就是從人口、牛、驢、羊群、各樣牲畜中，每五十取一，交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人。」
verses.e: Of the children of Israel's half , you shall take one drawn out of every fifty , of the persons , of the cattle , of the donkeys , and of the flocks , of all the livestock , and give them to the Levites , who perform the duty of the LORD's tabernacle . "

verses.z: 於是摩西和祭司以利亞撒照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.e: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 除了兵丁所奪的財物以外，所擄來的：羊六十七萬五千隻；
verses.e: Now the plunder , over and above the booty which the men of war took , was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep ,

verses.z: 牛七萬二千隻；
verses.e: seventy-two thousand head of cattle ,

verses.z: 驢六萬一千匹；
verses.e: sixty-one thousand donkeys ,

verses.z: 女人共三萬二千口，都是沒有出嫁的。
verses.e: and thirty-two thousand persons in all , of the women who had not known man by lying with him .

verses.z: 出去打仗之人的分，就是他們所得的那一半，共計羊三十三萬七千五百隻，
verses.e: The half , which was the portion of those who went out to war , was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep ;

verses.z: 從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有六百七十五隻；
verses.e: and the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five .

verses.z: 牛三萬六千隻，從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有七十二隻；
verses.e: The cattle were thirty-six thousand , of which the LORD's tribute was seventy-two .

verses.z: 驢三萬零五百匹，從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有六十一匹；
verses.e: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred , of which the LORD's tribute was sixty-one .

verses.z: 從以色列眾支派中，每支派要打發一千人去打仗。」
verses.e: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe , throughout all the tribes of Israel , to the war . "

verses.z: 人一萬六千口，從其中歸耶和華的，有三十二口。
verses.e: The persons were sixteen thousand , of whom the LORD's tribute was thirty-two persons .

verses.z: 摩西把貢物，就是歸與耶和華的舉祭，交給祭司以利亞撒，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: Moses gave the tribute , which was the LORD's wave offering , to Eleazar the priest , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 以色列人所得的那一半，就是摩西從打仗的人取來分給他們的。（
verses.e: Of the children of Israel's half , which Moses divided off from the men who fought

verses.z: 會眾的那一半有：羊三十三萬七千五百隻；
verses.e: ( now the congregation's half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep ,

verses.z: 牛三萬六千隻；
verses.e: thirty-six thousand head of cattle ,

verses.z: 驢三萬零五百匹；
verses.e: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys ,

verses.z: 人一萬六千口。）
verses.e: and sixteen thousand persons ) ,

verses.z: 無論是人口是牲畜，摩西每五十取一，交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: even of the children of Israel's half , Moses took one drawn out of every fifty , both of man and of animal , and gave them to the Levites , who performed the duty of the LORD's tabernacle , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 帶領千軍的各軍長，就是千夫長、百夫長，都近前來見摩西，
verses.e: The officers who were over the thousands of the army , the captains of thousands , and the captains of hundreds , came near to Moses .

verses.z: 對他說：「僕人權下的兵已經計算總數，並不短少一人。
verses.e: They said to Moses , " Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command , and there lacks not one man of us .

verses.z: 於是從以色列千萬人中，每支派交出一千人，共一萬二千人，帶着兵器預備打仗。
verses.e: So there were delivered , out of the thousands of Israel , a thousand from every tribe , twelve thousand armed for war .

verses.z: 如今我們將各人所得的金器，就是腳鍊子、鐲子、打印的戒指、耳環、手釧，都送來為耶和華的供物，好在耶和華面前為我們的生命贖罪。」
verses.e: We have brought the LORD's offering , what every man found : gold ornaments , armlets , bracelets , signet rings , earrings , and necklaces , to make atonement for our souls before the LORD . "

verses.z: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒就收了他們的金子，都是打成的器皿。
verses.e: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold , even all worked jewels .

verses.z: 千夫長、百夫長所獻給耶和華為舉祭的金子共有一萬六千七百五十舍客勒。
verses.e: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD , of the captains of thousands , and of the captains of hundreds , was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels .

verses.z: 各兵丁都為自己奪了財物。
verses.e: The men of war had taken booty , every man for himself .

verses.z: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒收了千夫長、百夫長的金子，就帶進會幕，在耶和華面前作為以色列人的紀念。
verses.e: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds , and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD .

verses.z: 摩西就打發每支派的一千人去打仗，並打發祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈同去；非尼哈手裏拿着聖所的器皿和吹大聲的號筒。
verses.e: Moses sent them , one thousand of every tribe , to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest , to the war , with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand .

verses.z: 他們就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的，與米甸人打仗，殺了所有的男丁。
verses.e: They fought against Midian , as the LORD commanded Moses . They killed every male .

verses.z: 在所殺的人中，殺了米甸的五王，就是以未、利金、蘇珥、戶珥、利巴，又用刀殺了比珥的兒子巴蘭。
verses.e: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain : Evi , Rekem , Zur , Hur , and Reba , the five kings of Midian . They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword .

verses.z: 以色列人擄了米甸人的婦女孩子，並將他們的牲畜、羊群，和所有的財物都奪了來，當作擄物，
verses.e: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones ; and all their livestock , all their flocks , and all their goods , they took as plunder .

verses.z: 呂便子孫和迦得子孫的牲畜極其眾多；他們看見雅謝地和基列地是可牧放牲畜之地，
verses.e: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock . They saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead . Behold , the place was a place for livestock .

verses.z: 當日，耶和華的怒氣發作，就起誓說：
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned in that day , and he swore , saying ,

verses.z: 『凡從埃及上來、二十歲以外的人斷不得看見我對亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許之地，因為他們沒有專心跟從我。
verses.e: ' Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I swore to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob ; because they have not wholly followed me ,

verses.z: 惟有基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞可以看見，因為他們專心跟從我。』
verses.e: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite , and Joshua the son of Nun , because they have followed the LORD completely . '

verses.z: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，使他們在曠野飄流四十年，等到在耶和華眼前行惡的那一代人都消滅了。
verses.e: The LORD's anger burned against Israel , and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years , until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD's sight was consumed .

verses.z: 誰知，你們起來接續先祖，增添罪人的數目，使耶和華向以色列大發烈怒。
verses.e: " Behold , you have risen up in your fathers ' place , an increase of sinful men , to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel .

verses.z: 你們若退後不跟從他，他還要把以色列人撇在曠野，便是你們使這眾民滅亡。」
verses.e: For if you turn away from after him , he will yet again leave them in the wilderness ; and you will destroy all these people . "

verses.z: 兩支派的人挨近摩西，說：「我們要在這裏為牲畜壘圈，為[婦人]孩子造城。
verses.e: They came near to him , and said , " We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock , and cities for our little ones ;

verses.z: 我們自己要帶兵器行在以色列人的前頭，好把他們領到他們的地方；但我們的[婦人]孩子，因這地居民的緣故，要住在堅固的城內。
verses.e: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel , until we have brought them to their place . Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land .

verses.z: 我們不回家，直等到以色列人各承受自己的產業。
verses.e: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance .

verses.z: 我們不和他們在約旦河那邊一帶之地同受產業，因為我們的產業是坐落在約旦河東邊這裏。」
verses.e: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond , because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward . "

verses.z: 就來見摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾的首領，說：
verses.e: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses , and to Eleazar the priest , and to the princes of the congregation , saying ,

verses.z: 摩西對他們說：「你們若這樣行，在耶和華面前帶着兵器出去打仗，
verses.e: Moses said to them : " If you will do this thing , if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war ,

verses.z: 所有帶兵器的人都要在耶和華面前過約旦河，等他趕出他的仇敵，
verses.e: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him ,

verses.z: 那地被耶和華制伏了，然後你們可以回來，向耶和華和以色列才為無罪，這地也必在耶和華面前歸你們為業。
verses.e: and the land is subdued before the LORD ; then afterward you shall return , and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel . Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD .

verses.z: 倘若你們不這樣行，就得罪耶和華，要知道你們的罪必追上你們。
verses.e: " But if you will not do so , behold , you have sinned against the LORD ; and be sure your sin will find you out .

verses.z: 如今你們口中所出的，只管去行，為你們的[婦人]孩子造城，為你們的羊群壘圈。」
verses.e: Build cities for your little ones , and folds for your sheep ; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth . "

verses.z: 迦得子孫和呂便子孫對摩西說：「僕人要照我主所吩咐的去行。
verses.e: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses , saying , " Your servants will do as my lord commands .

verses.z: 我們的妻子、孩子、羊群，和所有的牲畜都要留在基列的各城。
verses.e: Our little ones , our wives , our flocks , and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead ;

verses.z: 但你的僕人，凡帶兵器的，都要照我主所說的話，在耶和華面前過去打仗。」
verses.e: but your servants will pass over , every man who is armed for war , before the LORD to battle , as my lord says . "

verses.z: 於是，摩西為他們囑咐祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列眾支派的族長，說：
verses.e: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest , and to Joshua the son of Nun , and to the heads of the fathers ' households of the tribes of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 「迦得子孫和呂便子孫，凡帶兵器在耶和華面前去打仗的，若與你們一同過約旦河，那地被你們制伏了，你們就要把基列地給他們為業。
verses.e: Moses said to them , " If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan , every man who is armed to battle before the LORD , and the land is subdued before you , then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession ;

verses.z: 「亞大錄、底本、雅謝、寧拉、希實本、以利亞利、示班、尼波、比穩，
verses.e: " Ataroth , Dibon , Jazer , Nimrah , Heshbon , Elealeh , Sebam , Nebo , and Beon ,

verses.z: 倘若他們不帶兵器和你們一同過去，就要在迦南地你們中間得產業。」
verses.e: but if they will not pass over with you armed , they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan . "

verses.z: 迦得子孫和呂便子孫回答說：「耶和華怎樣吩咐僕人，僕人就怎樣行。
verses.e: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , " As the LORD has said to your servants , so will we do .

verses.z: 我們要帶兵器，在耶和華面前過去，進入迦南地，只是約旦河這邊、我們所得為業之地[仍歸]我們。」
verses.e: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan , and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan . "

verses.z: 摩西將亞摩利王西宏的國和巴珊王噩的國，連那地和周圍的城邑，都給了迦得子孫和呂便子孫，並約瑟的兒子瑪拿西半個支派。
verses.e: Moses gave to them , even to the children of Gad , and to the children of Reuben , and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph , the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan ; the land , according to its cities and borders , even the cities of the surrounding land .

verses.z: 迦得子孫建造底本、亞他錄、亞羅珥、
verses.e: The children of Gad built Dibon , Ataroth , Aroer ,

verses.z: 亞他錄‧朔反、雅謝、約比哈、
verses.e: Atroth-shophan , Jazer , Jogbehah ,

verses.z: 伯‧寧拉、伯‧哈蘭，都是堅固城。他們又壘羊圈。
verses.e: Beth Nimrah , and Beth Haran : fortified cities and folds for sheep .

verses.z: 呂便子孫建造希實本、以利亞利、基列亭、
verses.e: The children of Reuben built Heshbon , Elealeh , Kiriathaim ,

verses.z: 尼波、巴力‧免、西比瑪（尼波、巴力‧免，名字是改了的），又給他們所建造的城另起別名。
verses.e: Nebo , and Baal Meon , ( their names being changed ) , and Sibmah . They gave other names to the cities which they built .

verses.z: 瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉，他的子孫往基列去，佔了那地，趕出那裏的亞摩利人。
verses.e: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead , took it , and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein .

verses.z: 就是耶和華在以色列會眾前面所攻取之地，是可牧放牲畜之地，你僕人也有牲畜」；
verses.e: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel , is a land for livestock ; and your servants have livestock . "

verses.z: 摩西將基列賜給瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉，他[子孫]就住在那裏。
verses.e: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh ; and he lived therein .

verses.z: 瑪拿西的子孫睚珥去佔了基列的村莊，就稱這些村莊為哈倭特‧睚珥。
verses.e: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages , and called them Havvoth Jair .

verses.z: 挪巴去佔了基納和基納的鄉村，就按自己的名稱基納為挪巴。
verses.e: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages , and called it Nobah , after his own name .

verses.z: 又說：「我們若在你眼前蒙恩，求你把這地給我們為業，不要領我們過約旦河。」
verses.e: They said , " If we have found favor in your sight , let this land be given to your servants for a possession . Don't bring us over the Jordan . "

verses.z: 摩西對迦得子孫和呂便子孫說：「難道你們的弟兄去打仗，你們竟坐在這裏嗎？
verses.e: Moses said to the children of Gad , and to the children of Reuben , " Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here ?

verses.z: 你們為何使以色列人灰心喪膽、不過去進入耶和華所賜給他們的那地呢？
verses.e: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them ?

verses.z: 我先前從加低斯‧巴尼亞打發你們先祖去窺探那地，他們也是這樣行。
verses.e: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land .

verses.z: 他們上以實各谷，去窺探那地回來的時候，使以色列人灰心喪膽，不進入耶和華所賜給他們的地。
verses.e: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol , and saw the land , they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel , that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them .

verses.z: 以色列人按着軍隊，在摩西、亞倫的手下出埃及地所行的路程記在下面。
verses.e: These are the journeys of the children of Israel , when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron .

verses.z: 從以琳起行，安營在紅海邊。
verses.e: They traveled from Elim , and encamped by the Red Sea .

verses.z: 從紅海邊起行，安營在汛的曠野。
verses.e: They traveled from the Red Sea , and encamped in the wilderness of Sin .

verses.z: 從汛的曠野起行，安營在脫加。
verses.e: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin , and encamped in Dophkah .

verses.z: 從脫加起行，安營在亞錄。
verses.e: They traveled from Dophkah , and encamped in Alush .

verses.z: 從亞錄起行，安營在利非訂；在那裏，百姓沒有水喝。
verses.e: They traveled from Alush , and encamped in Rephidim , where there was no water for the people to drink .

verses.z: 從利非訂起行，安營在西奈的曠野。
verses.e: They traveled from Rephidim , and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai .

verses.z: 從西奈的曠野起行，安營在基博羅‧哈他瓦。
verses.e: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai , and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah .

verses.z: 從基博羅‧哈他瓦起行，安營在哈洗錄。
verses.e: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah , and encamped in Hazeroth .

verses.z: 從哈洗錄起行，安營在利提瑪。
verses.e: They traveled from Hazeroth , and encamped in Rithmah .

verses.z: 從利提瑪起行，安營在臨門‧帕烈。
verses.e: They traveled from Rithmah , and encamped in Rimmon Perez .

verses.z: 摩西遵着耶和華的吩咐記載他們所行的路程，其路程乃是這樣：
verses.e: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD . These are their journeys according to their starting points .

verses.z: 從臨門‧帕烈起行，安營在立拿。
verses.e: They traveled from Rimmon Perez , and encamped in Libnah .

verses.z: 從立拿起行，安營在勒撒。
verses.e: They traveled from Libnah , and encamped in Rissah .

verses.z: 從勒撒起行，安營在基希拉他。
verses.e: They traveled from Rissah , and encamped in Kehelathah .

verses.z: 從基希拉他起行，安營在沙斐山。
verses.e: They traveled from Kehelathah , and encamped in Mount Shepher .

verses.z: 從沙斐山起行，安營在哈拉大。
verses.e: They traveled from Mount Shepher , and encamped in Haradah .

verses.z: 從哈拉大起行，安營在瑪吉希錄。
verses.e: They traveled from Haradah , and encamped in Makheloth .

verses.z: 從瑪吉希錄起行，安營在他哈。
verses.e: They traveled from Makheloth , and encamped in Tahath .

verses.z: 從他哈起行，安營在他拉。
verses.e: They traveled from Tahath , and encamped in Terah .

verses.z: 從他拉起行，安營在密加。
verses.e: They traveled from Terah , and encamped in Mithkah .

verses.z: 從密加起行，安營在哈摩拿。
verses.e: They traveled from Mithkah , and encamped in Hashmonah .

verses.z: 正月十五日，就是逾越節的次日，以色列人從蘭塞起行，在一切埃及人眼前昂然無懼地出去。
verses.e: They traveled from Rameses in the first month , on the fifteenth day of the first month ; on the next day after the Passover , the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians ,

verses.z: 從哈摩拿起行，安營在摩西錄。
verses.e: They traveled from Hashmonah , and encamped in Moseroth .

verses.z: 從摩西錄起行，安營在比尼‧亞干。
verses.e: They traveled from Moseroth , and encamped in Bene Jaakan .

verses.z: 從比尼‧亞干起行，安營在曷‧哈及甲。
verses.e: They traveled from Bene Jaakan , and encamped in Hor Haggidgad .

verses.z: 從曷‧哈及甲起行，安營在約巴他。
verses.e: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad , and encamped in Jotbathah .

verses.z: 從約巴他起行，安營在阿博拿。
verses.e: They traveled from Jotbathah , and encamped in Abronah .

verses.z: 從阿博拿起行，安營在以旬‧迦別。
verses.e: They traveled from Abronah , and encamped in Ezion Geber .

verses.z: 從以旬‧迦別起行，安營在尋的曠野，就是加低斯。
verses.e: They traveled from Ezion Geber , and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin .

verses.z: 從加低斯起行，安營在何珥山，以東地的邊界。
verses.e: They traveled from Kadesh , and encamped in Mount Hor , in the edge of the land of Edom .

verses.z: 以色列人出了埃及地後四十年，五月初一日，祭司亞倫遵着耶和華的吩咐上何珥山，就死在那裏。
verses.e: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there , in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt , in the fifth month , on the first day of the month .

verses.z: 亞倫死在何珥山的時候年一百二十三歲。
verses.e: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor .

verses.z: 那時，埃及人正葬埋他們的長子，就是耶和華在他們中間所擊殺的；耶和華也敗壞他們的神。
verses.e: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn , whom the LORD had struck among them . The LORD also executed judgments on their gods .

verses.z: 住在迦南南地的迦南人亞拉得王聽說以色列人來了。
verses.e: The Canaanite king of Arad , who lived in the South in the land of Canaan , heard of the coming of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人從何珥山起行，安營在撒摩拿。
verses.e: They traveled from Mount Hor , and encamped in Zalmonah .

verses.z: 從撒摩拿起行，安營在普嫩。
verses.e: They traveled from Zalmonah , and encamped in Punon .

verses.z: 從普嫩起行，安營在阿伯。
verses.e: They traveled from Punon , and encamped in Oboth .

verses.z: 從阿伯起行，安營在以耶‧亞巴琳，摩押的邊界。
verses.e: They traveled from Oboth , and encamped in Iye Abarim , in the border of Moab .

verses.z: 從以耶‧亞巴琳起行，安營在底本‧迦得。
verses.e: They traveled from Iyim , and encamped in Dibon Gad .

verses.z: 從底本‧迦得起行，安營在亞門‧低比拉太音。
verses.e: They traveled from Dibon Gad , and encamped in Almon Diblathaim .

verses.z: 從亞門‧低比拉太音起行，安營在尼波對面的亞巴琳山裏。
verses.e: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim , and encamped in the mountains of Abarim , before Nebo .

verses.z: 從亞巴琳山起行，安營在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面。
verses.e: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim , and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho .

verses.z: 他們在摩押平原沿約旦河邊安營，從伯‧耶施末直到亞伯‧什亭。
verses.e: They encamped by the Jordan , from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab .

verses.z: 以色列人從蘭塞起行，安營在疏割。
verses.e: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses , and encamped in Succoth .

verses.z: 耶和華在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho , saying ,

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們過約旦河進迦南地的時候，
verses.e: Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , " When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan ,

verses.z: 就要從你們面前趕出那裏所有的居民，毀滅他們一切鏨成的[石]像和他們一切鑄成的偶像，又拆毀他們一切的邱壇。
verses.e: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you , destroy all their stone idols , destroy all their molten images , and demolish all their high places .

verses.z: 你們要奪那地，住在其中，因我把那地賜給你們為業。
verses.e: You shall take possession of the land , and dwell therein ; for I have given the land to you to possess it .

verses.z: 你們要按家室拈鬮，承受那地；人多的，要把產業多分給他們；人少的，要把產業少分給他們。拈出何地給何人，就要歸何人。你們要按宗族的支派承受。
verses.e: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families ; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance , and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance . Wherever the lot falls to any man , that shall be his . You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers .

verses.z: 倘若你們不趕出那地的居民，所容留的居民就必作你們眼中的刺，肋下的荊棘，也必在你們所住的地上擾害你們。
verses.e: " But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you , then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides . They will harass you in the land in which you dwell .

verses.z: 而且我素常有意怎樣待他們，也必照樣待你們。」
verses.e: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them , so I will do to you . "

verses.z: 從疏割起行，安營在曠野邊的以倘。
verses.e: They traveled from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , which is in the edge of the wilderness .

verses.z: 從以倘起行，轉到比‧哈希錄，是在巴力‧洗分對面，就在密奪安營。
verses.e: They traveled from Etham , and turned back to Pihahiroth , which is before Baal Zephon , and they encamped before Migdol .

verses.z: 從比‧哈希錄對面起行，經過海中到了[書珥]曠野，又在伊坦的曠野走了三天的路程，就安營在瑪拉。
verses.e: They traveled from before Hahiroth , and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness . They went three days ' journey in the wilderness of Etham , and encamped in Marah .

verses.z: 從瑪拉起行，來到以琳（以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕樹），就在那裏安營。
verses.e: They traveled from Marah , and came to Elim . In Elim , there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees , and they encamped there .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們要從哈薩‧以難劃到示番為東界。
verses.e: " ' You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham .

verses.z: 這界要從示番下到亞延東邊的利比拉，又要達到基尼烈湖的東邊。
verses.e: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah , on the east side of Ain . The border shall go down , and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward .

verses.z: 這界要下到約旦河，通到鹽海為止。這四圍的邊界以內，要作你們的地。」
verses.e: The border shall go down to the Jordan , and end at the Salt Sea . This shall be your land according to its borders around it . ' "

verses.z: 摩西吩咐以色列人說：「這地就是耶和華吩咐拈鬮給九個半支派承受為業的；
verses.e: Moses commanded the children of Israel , saying , " This is the land which you shall inherit by lot , which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes , and to the half-tribe ;

verses.z: 因為呂便支派和迦得支派按着宗族受了產業，瑪拿西半個支派也受了產業。
verses.e: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers ' houses , the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers ' houses , and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance .

verses.z: 這兩個半支派已經在耶利哥對面、約旦河東、向日出之地受了產業。」
verses.e: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward , toward the sunrise . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「要給你們分地為業之人的名字是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞。
verses.e: " These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance : Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun .

verses.z: 又要從每支派中選一個首領幫助他們。
verses.e: You shall take one prince of every tribe , to divide the land for inheritance .

verses.z: 這些人的名字：猶大支派有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。
verses.e: These are the names of the men : Of the tribe of Judah , Caleb the son of Jephunneh .

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們到了迦南地，就是歸你們為業的迦南四境之地，
verses.e: " Command the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When you come into the land of Canaan ( this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance , even the land of Canaan according to its borders ) ,

verses.z: 西緬支派有亞米忽的兒子示母利。
verses.e: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon , Shemuel the son of Ammihud .

verses.z: 便雅憫支派有基斯倫的兒子以利達。
verses.e: Of the tribe of Benjamin , Elidad the son of Chislon .

verses.z: 但支派有一個首領，約利的兒子布基。
verses.e: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince , Bukki the son of Jogli .

verses.z: 約瑟的子孫瑪拿西支派有一個首領，以弗的兒子漢聶。
verses.e: Of the children of Joseph : of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince , Hanniel the son of Ephod .

verses.z: 以法蓮支派有一個首領，拾弗但的兒子基母利。
verses.e: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince , Kemuel the son of Shiphtan .

verses.z: 西布倫支派有一個首領，帕納的兒子以利撒番。
verses.e: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince , Elizaphan the son of Parnach .

verses.z: 以薩迦支派有一個首領，阿散的兒子帕鐵。
verses.e: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince , Paltiel the son of Azzan .

verses.z: 亞設支派有一個首領，示羅米的兒子亞希忽。
verses.e: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince , Ahihud the son of Shelomi .

verses.z: 拿弗他利支派有一個首領，亞米忽的兒子比大黑。」
verses.e: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince , Pedahel the son of Ammihud . "

verses.z: 這些人就是耶和華所吩咐、在迦南地把產業分給以色列人的。
verses.e: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan .

verses.z: 南角要從尋的曠野，貼着以東的邊界；南界要從鹽海東頭起，
verses.e: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom , and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward .

verses.z: 繞到亞克拉濱坡的南邊，接連到尋，直通到加低斯‧巴尼亞的南邊，又通到哈薩‧亞達，接連到押們，
verses.e: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim , and pass along to Zin ; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea ; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar , and pass along to Azmon .

verses.z: 從押們轉到埃及小河，直通到海為止。
verses.e: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt , and it shall end at the sea .

verses.z: 「西邊要以大海為界；這就是你們的西界。
verses.e: " ' For the western border , you shall have the great sea and its border . This shall be your west border .

verses.z: 「北界要從大海起，劃到何珥山，
verses.e: " ' This shall be your north border : from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor .

verses.z: 從何珥山劃到哈馬口，通到西達達，
verses.e: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath ; and the border shall pass by Zedad .

verses.z: 又通到西斐崙，直到哈薩‧以難。這要作你們的北界。
verses.e: Then the border shall go to Ziphron , and it shall end at Hazar Enan . This shall be your north border .

verses.z: 耶和華在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho , saying ,

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們過約旦河，進了迦南地，
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them , ' When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan ,

verses.z: 就要分出幾座城，為你們作逃城，使誤殺人的可以逃到那裏。
verses.e: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you , that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there .

verses.z: 這些城可以作逃避報仇人的城，使誤殺人的不至於死，等他站在會眾面前聽審判。
verses.e: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger , that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment .

verses.z: 你們所分出來的城，要作六座逃城。
verses.e: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge .

verses.z: 在約旦河東要分出三座城，在迦南地也要分出三座城，都作逃城。
verses.e: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan , and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan . They shall be cities of refuge .

verses.z: 這六座城要給以色列人和他們中間的外人，並寄居的，作為逃城，使誤殺人的都可以逃到那裏。
verses.e: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel , for the stranger , and for the foreigner living among them , that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there .

verses.z: 「倘若人用鐵器打人，以致打死，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
verses.e: " ' But if he struck him with an instrument of iron , so that he died , he is a murderer . The murderer shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 若用可以打死人的石頭打死了人，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
verses.e: If he struck him with a stone in the hand , by which a man may die , and he died , he is a murderer . The murderer shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 若用可以打死人的木器打死了人，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
verses.e: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand , by which a man may die , and he died , he is a murderer . The murderer shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 報血仇的必親自殺那故殺人的，一遇見就殺他。
verses.e: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death . When he meets him , he shall put him to death .

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人，要從所得為業的地中把些城給利未人居住，也要把這城四圍的郊野給利未人。
verses.e: " Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance . You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites .

verses.z: 人若因怨恨把人推倒，或是埋伏往人身上扔物，以致於死，
verses.e: If he shoved him out of hatred , or hurled something at him while lying in wait , so that he died ,

verses.z: 或是因仇恨用手打人，以致於死，那打人的必被治死。他是故殺人的；報血仇的一遇見就殺他。
verses.e: or in hostility struck him with his hand , so that he died , he who struck him shall surely be put to death . He is a murderer . The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him .

verses.z: 「倘若人沒有仇恨，忽然將人推倒，或是沒有埋伏把物扔在人身上，
verses.e: " ' But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility , or hurled on him anything without lying in wait ,

verses.z: 或是沒有看見的時候用可以打死人的石頭扔在人身上，以致於死，本來與他無仇，也無意害他。
verses.e: or with any stone , by which a man may die , not seeing him , and cast it on him so that he died , and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm ,

verses.z: 會眾就要照典章，在打死人的和報血仇的中間審判。
verses.e: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances .

verses.z: 會眾要救這誤殺人的脫離報血仇人的手，也要使他歸入逃城。他要住在其中，直等到受聖膏的大祭司死了。
verses.e: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood , and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge , where he had fled . He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest , who was anointed with the holy oil .

verses.z: 但誤殺人的，無論甚麼時候，若出了逃城的境外，
verses.e: " ' But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees ,

verses.z: 報血仇的在逃城境外遇見他，將他殺了，報血仇的就沒有流血之罪。
verses.e: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge , and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer , he shall not be guilty of blood ,

verses.z: 因為誤殺人的該住在逃城裏，等到大祭司死了。大祭司死了以後，誤殺人的才可以回到他所得為業之地。
verses.e: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest . But after the death of the high priest , the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession .

verses.z: 這在你們一切的住處，要作你們世世代代的律例典章。
verses.e: " ' These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings .

verses.z: 這城邑要歸他們居住，城邑的郊野可以牧養他們的牛羊和各樣的牲畜，又可以安置他們的財物。
verses.e: They shall have the cities to dwell in . Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock , and for their possessions , and for all their animals .

verses.z: 「無論誰故殺人，要憑幾個見證人的口把那故殺人的殺了，只是不可憑一個見證的口叫人死。
verses.e: " ' Whoever kills any person , the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses ; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies .

verses.z: 故殺人、犯死罪的，你們不可收贖價代替他的命；他必被治死。
verses.e: " ' Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death . He shall surely be put to death .

verses.z: 那逃到逃城的人，你們不可為他收贖價，使他在大祭司未死以先再來住在本地。
verses.e: " ' You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge , that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest .

verses.z: 這樣，你們就不污穢所住之地，因為血是污穢地的；若有在地上流人血的，非流那殺人者的血，那地就不得潔淨。
verses.e: " ' So you shall not pollute the land where you live ; for blood pollutes the land . No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it , but by the blood of him who shed it .

verses.z: 你們不可玷污所住之地，就是我住在其中之地，因為我－耶和華住在以色列人中間。」
verses.e: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit , where I dwell ; for I , the LORD , dwell among the children of Israel . ' "

verses.z: 你們給利未人的郊野，要從城根起，四圍往外量一千肘。
verses.e: " The pasture lands of the cities , which you shall give to the Levites , shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it .

verses.z: 另外東量二千肘，南量二千肘，西量二千肘，北量二千肘，為邊界，城在當中；這要歸他們作城邑的郊野。
verses.e: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits , and for the south side two thousand cubits , and for the west side two thousand cubits , and for the north side two thousand cubits , the city being in the middle . This shall be the pasture lands of their cities .

verses.z: 你們給利未人的城邑，其中當有六座逃城，使誤殺人的可以逃到那裏。此外還要給他們四十二座城。
verses.e: " The cities which you shall give to the Levites , they shall be the six cities of refuge , which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to . Besides them you shall give forty-two cities .

verses.z: 你們要給利未人的城，共有四十八座，連城帶郊野[都要給他們]。
verses.e: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands .

verses.z: 以色列人所得的地業從中要把些城邑給[利未人]；人多的就多給，人少的就少給；各[支派]要按所承受為業之地把城邑給利未人。」
verses.e: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel , from the many you shall take many , and from the few you shall take few . Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 約瑟的後裔，瑪拿西的孫子，瑪吉的兒子基列，他子孫中的諸族長來到摩西和作首領的以色列人族長面前，說：
verses.e: The heads of the fathers ' households of the family of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes , the heads of the fathers ' households of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，西羅非哈的眾女兒就怎樣行。
verses.e: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses :

verses.z: 西羅非哈的女兒瑪拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他們伯叔的兒子。
verses.e: for Mahlah , Tirzah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Noah , the daughters of Zelophehad , were married to their father's brothers ' sons .

verses.z: 她們嫁入約瑟兒子、瑪拿西子孫的族中；她們的產業仍留在同宗支派中。
verses.e: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph . Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father .

verses.z: 這是耶和華在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面－藉着摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令典章。
verses.e: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho .

verses.z: 「耶和華曾吩咐我主拈鬮分給以色列人為業，我主也受了耶和華的吩咐將我們兄弟西羅非哈的產業分給他的眾女兒。
verses.e: They said , " The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel . My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters .

verses.z: 她們若嫁以色列[別]支派的人，就必將我們祖宗所遺留的產業加在她們丈夫支派的產業中。這樣，我們拈鬮所得的產業就要減少了。
verses.e: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers , and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong . So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance .

verses.z: 到了以色列人的禧年，這女兒的產業就必加在她們丈夫支派的產業上。這樣，我們祖宗支派的產業就減少了。」
verses.e: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes , then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong . So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers . "

verses.z: 摩西照耶和華的話吩咐以色列人說：「約瑟支派的人說得有理。
verses.e: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD's word , saying , " The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right .

verses.z: 論到西羅非哈的眾女兒，耶和華這樣吩咐說：她們可以隨意嫁人，只是要嫁同宗支派的人。
verses.e: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , ' Let them be married to whom they think best , only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father .

verses.z: 這樣，以色列人的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派，因為以色列人要各守各祖宗支派的產業。
verses.e: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe ; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers .

verses.z: 凡在以色列支派中得了產業的女子必作同宗支派人的妻，好叫以色列人各自承受他祖宗的產業。
verses.e: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father , that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers .

verses.z: 這樣，他們的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派，因為以色列支派的人要各守各的產業。」
verses.e: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe ; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 又要把燈臺和燈臺的一切器具包在海狗皮裏，放在抬架上。
verses.e: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin , and shall put it on the frame .

verses.z: 在金壇上要鋪藍色毯子，蒙上海狗皮，把槓穿上。
verses.e: " On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth , and cover it with a covering of sealskin , and shall put in its poles .

verses.z: 又要把聖所用的一切器具包在藍色毯子裏，用海狗皮蒙上，放在抬架上。
verses.e: " They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary , and put them in a blue cloth , cover them with a covering of sealskin , and shall put them on the frame .

verses.z: 要收去壇上的灰，把紫色毯子鋪在壇上；
verses.e: " They shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth on it .

verses.z: 又要把所用的一切器具，就是火鼎、肉鍤子、鏟子、盤子，一切屬壇的器具都擺在壇上，又蒙上海狗皮，把槓穿上。
verses.e: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it , the fire pans , the meat hooks , the shovels , and the basins — all the vessels of the altar ; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin , and put in its poles .

verses.z: 將要起營的時候，亞倫和他兒子把聖所和聖所的一切器具遮蓋完了，哥轄的子孫就要來抬，只是不可摸聖物，免得他們死亡。會幕裏這些物件是哥轄子孫所當抬的。
verses.e: " When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary , as the camp moves forward ; after that , the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it ; but they shall not touch the sanctuary , lest they die . The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 「祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒所要看守的是點燈的油與香料，並當獻的素祭和膏油，也要看守全帳幕與其中所有的，並聖所和聖所的器具。」
verses.e: " The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light , the sweet incense , the continual meal offering , and the anointing oil , the requirements of all the tabernacle , and of all that is in it , the sanctuary , and its furnishings . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron , saying ,

verses.z: 「你們不可將哥轄人的支派從利未人中剪除。
verses.e: " Don't cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites ;

verses.z: 他們挨近至聖物的時候，亞倫和他兒子要進去派他們各人所當辦的，所當抬的。這樣待他們，好使他們活着，不致死亡。
verses.e: but do this to them , that they may live , and not die , when they approach the most holy things : Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden ;

verses.z: 「你從利未人中，將哥轄子孫的總數，照他們的家室、宗族，
verses.e: " Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi , by their families , by their fathers ' houses ,

verses.z: 只是他們連片時不可進去觀看聖所，免得他們死亡。」
verses.e: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment , lest they die . "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要將革順子孫的總數，照着宗族、家室，
verses.e: " Take a census of the sons of Gershon also , by their fathers ' houses , by their families ;

verses.z: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，全都數點。
verses.e: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old : all who enter in to wait on the service , to do the work in the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 革順人各族所辦的事、所抬的物乃是這樣：
verses.e: " This is the service of the families of the Gershonites , in serving and in bearing burdens :

verses.z: 他們要抬帳幕的幔子和會幕，並會幕的蓋與其上的海狗皮，和會幕的門簾，
verses.e: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting , its covering , the covering of sealskin that is on it , the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting ,

verses.z: 院子的帷子和門簾（院子是圍帳幕和壇的）、繩子，並所用的器具，不論是做甚麼用的，他們都要經理。
verses.e: the hangings of the court , the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar , their cords , and all the instruments of their service , and whatever shall be done with them . They shall serve in there .

verses.z: 革順的子孫在一切抬物辦事之上都要憑亞倫和他兒子的吩咐；他們所當抬的，要派他們看守。
verses.e: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites , in all their burden and in all their service ; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities .

verses.z: 這是革順子孫的各族在會幕裏所辦的事；他們所看守的，必在祭司亞倫兒子以他瑪的手下。」
verses.e: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting . Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .

verses.z: 「至於米拉利的子孫，你要照着家室、宗族把他們數點。
verses.e: " As for the sons of Merari , you shall count them by their families , by their fathers ' houses ;

verses.z: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，全都計算。
verses.e: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old , all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，你都要數點。
verses.e: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old — everyone who enters on the service , to do the work of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 他們辦理會幕的事，就是抬帳幕的板、閂、柱子，和帶卯的座，
verses.e: This is the duty of their burden , according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting : the tabernacle's boards , its bars , its pillars , its sockets ,

verses.z: 院子四圍的柱子和其上帶卯的座、橛子、繩子，並一切使用的器具。他們所抬的器具，你們要按名指定。
verses.e: the pillars of the court around it , their sockets , their pins , their cords , with all their instruments , and with all their service . You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name .

verses.z: 這是米拉利子孫各族在會幕裏所辦的事，都在祭司亞倫兒子以他瑪的手下。」
verses.e: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari , according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest . "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫與會眾的諸首領將哥轄的子孫，照着家室、宗族，
verses.e: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families , and by their fathers ' houses ,

verses.z: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，都數點了。
verses.e: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old , everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 被數的共有二千七百五十名。
verses.e: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty .

verses.z: 這是哥轄各族中被數的，是在會幕裏辦事的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
verses.e: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites , all who served in the Tent of Meeting , whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses .

verses.z: 革順子孫被數的，照着家室、宗族，
verses.e: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon , by their families , and by their fathers ' houses ,

verses.z: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，共有二千六百三十名。
verses.e: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old — everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting ,

verses.z: 哥轄子孫在會幕[搬運]至聖之物，所辦的事乃是這樣：
verses.e: " This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting , regarding the most holy things .
