even those who were counted of them , by their families , by their fathers ' houses , were two thousand six hundred thirty .

verses.z: 這是革順子孫各族中被數的，是在會幕裏辦事的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
verses.e: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon , all who served in the Tent of Meeting , whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD .

verses.z: 米拉利子孫中各族被數的，照着家室、宗族，
verses.e: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari , by their families , by their fathers ' houses ,

verses.z: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，共有三千二百名。
verses.e: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old — everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting ,
even those who were counted of them by their families , were three thousand two hundred .

verses.z: 這是米拉利子孫各族中被數的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
verses.e: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari , whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses .

verses.z: 凡被數的利未人，就是摩西、亞倫並以色列眾首領，照着家室、宗族所數點的，
verses.e: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted , by their families and by their fathers ' houses ,

verses.z: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏做抬物之工的，共有八千五百八十名。
verses.e: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old , everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting ,
even those who were counted of them , were eight thousand five hundred eighty .

verses.z: 摩西按他們所辦的事、所抬的物，憑耶和華的吩咐數點他們；他們這樣被摩西數點，正如耶和華所吩咐他的。
verses.e: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses , everyone according to his service and according to his burden . Thus they were counted by him , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 起營的時候，亞倫和他兒子要進去摘下遮掩[櫃]的幔子，用以蒙蓋法櫃，
verses.e: When the camp moves forward , Aaron shall go in with his sons ; and they shall take down the veil of the screen , cover the ark of the Testimony with it ,

verses.z: 又用海狗皮蓋在上頭，再蒙上純藍色的毯子，把槓穿上。
verses.e: put a covering of sealskin on it , spread a blue cloth over it , and put in its poles .

verses.z: 又用藍色毯子鋪在陳設餅的桌子上，將盤子、調羹、奠[酒]的爵，和杯擺在上頭。桌子上也必有常[設的]餅。
verses.e: " On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth , and put on it the dishes , the spoons , the bowls , and the cups with which to pour out ; and the continual bread shall be on it .

verses.z: 在其上又要蒙朱紅色的毯子，再蒙上海狗皮，把槓穿上。
verses.e: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth , and cover it with a covering of sealskin , and shall put in its poles .

verses.z: 要拿藍色毯子，把燈臺和燈臺上所用的燈盞、剪子、蠟花盤，並一切盛油的器皿，全都遮蓋。
verses.e: " They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light , its lamps , its snuffers , its snuff dishes , and all its oil vessels , with which they minister to it .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 各人所分別為聖的物，無論是甚麼，都要歸給祭司。」
verses.e: Every man's holy things shall be his ; whatever any man gives the priest , it shall be his . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：人的妻若有邪行，得罪她丈夫，
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them : ' If any man's wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him ,

verses.z: 有人與她行淫，事情嚴密，瞞過她丈夫，而且她被玷污，沒有作見證的人，當她行淫的時候也沒有被捉住，
verses.e: and a man lies with her carnally , and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed , and she is defiled , there is no witness against her , and she isn't taken in the act ;

verses.z: 她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她是被玷污，或是她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她並沒有被玷污，
verses.e: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him , and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled ; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him , and he is jealous of his wife and she isn't defiled ;

verses.z: 這人就要將妻送到祭司那裏，又為她帶着大麥麵伊法十分之一作供物，不可澆上油，也不可加上乳香；因為這是疑恨的素祭，是思念的素祭，使人思念罪孽。
verses.e: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest , and shall bring her offering for her : one tenth of an ephah of barley meal . He shall pour no oil on it , nor put frankincense on it , for it is a meal offering of jealousy , a meal offering of memorial , bringing iniquity to memory .

verses.z: 「祭司要使那婦人近前來，站在耶和華面前。
verses.e: The priest shall bring her near , and set her before the LORD .

verses.z: 祭司要把聖水盛在瓦器裏，又從帳幕的地上取點塵土，放在水中。
verses.e: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel ; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water .

verses.z: 祭司要叫那婦人蓬頭散髮，站在耶和華面前，把思念的素祭，就是疑恨的素祭，放在她手中。祭司手裏拿着致咒詛的苦水，
verses.e: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD , and let the hair of the woman's head go loose , and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands , which is the meal offering of jealousy . The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse .

verses.z: 要叫婦人起誓，對她說：『若沒有人與你行淫，也未曾背着丈夫做污穢的事，你就免受這致咒詛苦水的災。
verses.e: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman , " If no man has lain with you , and if you haven't gone aside to uncleanness , being under your husband's authority , be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse .

verses.z: 「你吩咐以色列人，使一切長大痲瘋的，患漏症的，並因死屍不潔淨的，都出營外去。
verses.e: " Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper , everyone who has a discharge , and whoever is unclean by a corpse .

verses.z: 你若背着丈夫行了污穢的事，在你丈夫以外有人與你行淫，
verses.e: But if you have gone astray , being under your husband's authority , and if you are defiled , and some man has lain with you besides your husband — "

verses.z: （祭司叫婦人發咒起誓），願耶和華叫你大腿消瘦，肚腹發脹，使你在你民中被人咒詛，成了誓語；
verses.e: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing , and the priest shall tell the woman , " May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people , when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away , and your body to swell ;

verses.z: 並且這致咒詛的水入你的腸中，要叫你的肚腹發脹，大腿消瘦。』婦人要回答說：『阿們，阿們。』
verses.e: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels , and make your body swell , and your thigh fall away . " The woman shall say , " Amen , Amen . "

verses.z: 「祭司要寫這咒詛的話，將所寫的字抹在苦水裏，
verses.e: " ' The priest shall write these curses in a book , and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness .

verses.z: 又叫婦人喝這致咒詛的苦水；這水要進入她裏面[變]苦了。
verses.e: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse ; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter .

verses.z: 祭司要從婦人的手中取那疑恨的素祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，拿到壇前；
verses.e: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman's hand , and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD , and bring it to the altar .

verses.z: 又要從素祭中取出一把，作為這事的紀念，燒在壇上，然後叫婦人喝這水。
verses.e: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering , as its memorial portion , and burn it on the altar , and afterward shall make the woman drink the water .

verses.z: 叫她喝了以後，她若被玷污，得罪了丈夫，這致咒詛的水必進入她裏面[變]苦了，她的肚腹就要發脹，大腿就要消瘦，那婦人便要在他民中被人咒詛。
verses.e: When he has made her drink the water , then it shall happen , if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband , that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter , and her body will swell , and her thigh will fall away ; and the woman will be a curse among her people .

verses.z: 若婦人沒有被玷污，卻是清潔的，就要免受這災，且要懷孕。
verses.e: If the woman isn't defiled , but is clean ; then she shall be free , and shall conceive offspring .

verses.z: 「妻子背着丈夫行了污穢的事，
verses.e: " ' This is the law of jealousy , when a wife , being under her husband , goes astray , and is defiled ,

verses.z: 無論男女都要使他們出到營外，免得污穢他們的營；這營是我所住的。」
verses.e: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don't defile their camp , in the midst of which I dwell . "

verses.z: 或是人生了疑恨的心，疑恨他的妻，就有這疑恨的條例。那時他要叫婦人站在耶和華面前，祭司要在她身上照這條例而行。
verses.e: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man , and he is jealous of his wife ; then he shall set the woman before the LORD , and the priest shall execute on her all this law .

verses.z: 男人就為無罪，婦人必擔當自己的罪孽。」
verses.e: The man shall be free from iniquity , and that woman shall bear her iniquity . ' "

verses.z: 以色列人就這樣行，使他們出到營外。耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎樣行了。
verses.e: The children of Israel did so , and put them outside of the camp ; as the LORD spoke to Moses , so the children of Israel did .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女，若犯了人所常犯的罪，以致干犯耶和華，那人就有了罪。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel : ' When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit , so as to trespass against the LORD , and that soul is guilty ,

verses.z: 他要承認所犯的罪，將所虧負人的，如數賠還，另外加上五分之一，也歸與所虧負的人。
verses.e: then he shall confess his sin which he has done ; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full , add to it the fifth part of it , and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty .

verses.z: 那人若沒有親屬可受所賠還的，那所賠還的就要歸與服事耶和華的祭司；至於那為他贖罪的公羊是在外。
verses.e: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt , the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest's , in addition to the ram of the atonement , by which atonement shall be made for him .

verses.z: 以色列人一切的聖物中，所奉給祭司的舉祭都要歸與祭司。
verses.e: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel , which they present to the priest , shall be his .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 第八日，他要把兩隻斑鳩或兩隻雛鴿帶到會幕門口，交給祭司。
verses.e: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest , to the door of the Tent of Meeting .

verses.z: 祭司要獻一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，為他贖那因死屍而有的罪，並要當日使他的頭成為聖潔。
verses.e: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , and make atonement for him , because he sinned by reason of the dead , and shall make his head holy that same day .

verses.z: 他要另選離俗歸耶和華的日子，又要牽一隻一歲的公羊羔來作贖愆祭；但先前的日子要歸徒然，因為他在離俗之間被玷污了。
verses.e: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation , and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering ; but the former days shall be void , because his separation was defiled .

verses.z: 「拿細耳人滿了離俗的日子乃有這條例：人要領他到會幕門口，
verses.e: " ' This is the law of the Nazirite : when the days of his separation are fulfilled , he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting ,

verses.z: 他要將供物奉給耶和華，就是一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔作燔祭，一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔作贖罪祭，和一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊作平安祭，
verses.e: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD : one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering , one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering , one ram without defect for peace offerings ,

verses.z: 並一筐子無酵調油的細麵餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅，並同獻的素祭和奠祭。
verses.e: a basket of unleavened bread , cakes of fine flour mixed with oil , and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings .

verses.z: 祭司要在耶和華面前獻那人的贖罪祭和燔祭；
verses.e: The priest shall present them before the LORD , and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering .

verses.z: 也要把那隻公羊和那筐無酵餅獻給耶和華作平安祭，又要將同獻的素祭和奠祭獻上。
verses.e: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD , with the basket of unleavened bread . The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering .

verses.z: 拿細耳人要在會幕門口剃離俗的頭，把離俗頭上的髮放在平安祭下的火上。
verses.e: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting , take the hair of the head of his separation , and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings .

verses.z: 他剃了以後，祭司就要取那已煮的公羊一條前腿，又從筐子裏取一個無酵餅和一個無酵薄餅，都放在他手上。
verses.e: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram , one unleavened cake out of the basket , and one unleavened wafer , and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation ;

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女許了特別的願，就是拿細耳人的願，要離俗歸耶和華。
verses.e: " Speak to the children of Israel , and tell them : ' When either man or woman shall make a special vow , the vow of a Nazirite , to separate himself to the LORD ,

verses.z: 祭司要拿這些作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這與所搖的胸、所舉的腿同為聖物，歸給祭司。然後拿細耳人可以喝酒。
verses.e: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD . They are holy for the priest , together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered . After that the Nazirite may drink wine .

verses.z: 「許願的拿細耳人為離俗所獻的供物，和他以外所能得的獻給耶和華，就有這條例。他怎樣許願就當照離俗的條例行。」
verses.e: " ' This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to the LORD for his separation , in addition to that which he is able to afford . According to his vow which he vows , so he must do after the law of his separation . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你告訴亞倫和他兒子說：你們要這樣為以色列人祝福，說：
verses.e: " Speak to Aaron and to his sons , saying , ' This is how you shall bless the children of Israel . ' You shall tell them ,

verses.z: 『願耶和華賜福給你，保護你。
verses.e: ' The LORD bless you , and keep you .

verses.z: 願耶和華使他的臉光照你，賜恩給你。
verses.e: The LORD make his face to shine on you , and be gracious to you .

verses.z: 願耶和華向你仰臉，賜你平安。』
verses.e: The LORD lift up his face toward you , and give you peace . '

verses.z: 他們要如此奉我的名為以色列人祝福；我也要賜福給他們。」
verses.e: " So they shall put my name on the children of Israel ; and I will bless them . "

verses.z: 他就要遠離清酒濃酒，也不可喝甚麼清酒濃酒做的醋；不可喝甚麼葡萄汁，也不可吃鮮葡萄和乾葡萄。
verses.e: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink . He shall drink no vinegar of wine , or vinegar of fermented drink , neither shall he drink any juice of grapes , nor eat fresh grapes or dried .

verses.z: 在一切離俗的日子，凡葡萄樹上結的，自核至皮所做的物，都不可吃。
verses.e: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine , from the seeds even to the skins .

verses.z: 「在他一切許願離俗的日子，不可用剃頭刀剃頭，要由髮綹長長了。他要聖潔，直到離俗歸耶和華的日子滿了。
verses.e: " ' All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head , until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD . He shall be holy . He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long .

verses.z: 在他離俗歸耶和華的一切日子，不可挨近死屍。
verses.e: " ' All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body .

verses.z: 他的父母或是弟兄姊妹死了的時候，他不可因他們使自己不潔淨，因為那離俗歸上帝的[憑據]是在他頭上。
verses.e: He shall not make himself unclean for his father , or for his mother , for his brother , or for his sister , when they die , because his separation to God is on his head .

verses.z: 在他一切離俗的日子是歸耶和華為聖。
verses.e: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD .

verses.z: 「若在他旁邊忽然有人死了，以致沾染了他離俗的頭，他要在第七日，得潔淨的時候，剃頭。
verses.e: " ' If any man dies very suddenly beside him , and he defiles the head of his separation , then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing . On the seventh day he shall shave it .

verses.z: 摩西立完了帳幕，就把帳幕用膏抹了，使它成聖，又把其中的器具和壇，並壇上的器具，都抹了，使它成聖。
verses.e: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle , and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture , and the altar with all its vessels , and had anointed and sanctified them ;

verses.z: 用膏抹壇的日子，首領都來行奉獻壇的禮，眾首領就在壇前獻供物。
verses.e: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed . The princes gave their offerings before the altar .

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：「眾首領為行奉獻壇的禮，要每天一個首領來獻供物。」
verses.e: The LORD said to Moses , " They shall offer their offering , each prince on his day , for the dedication of the altar . "

verses.z: 頭一日獻供物的是猶大支派的亞米拿達的兒子拿順。
verses.e: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab , of the tribe of Judah ,

verses.z: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
verses.e: and his offering was : one silver platter , the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary , both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering ;

verses.z: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
verses.e: one golden ladle of ten shekels , full of incense ;

verses.z: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
verses.e: one young bull , one ram , one male lamb a year old , for a burnt offering ;

verses.z: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
verses.e: one male goat for a sin offering ;

verses.z: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是亞米拿達兒子拿順的供物。
verses.e: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings , two head of cattle , five rams , five male goats , and five male lambs a year old . This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab .

verses.z: 第二日來獻的是以薩迦[子孫]的首領、蘇押的兒子拿坦業。
verses.e: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar , prince of Issachar , gave his offering .

verses.z: 他獻為供物的是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十[舍客勒]，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
verses.e: He offered for his offering : one silver platter , the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary , both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering ;

verses.z: 當天，以色列的眾首領，就是各族的族長，都來奉獻。他們是各支派的首領，管理那些被數的人。
verses.e: the princes of Israel , the heads of their fathers ' houses , gave offerings . These were the princes of the tribes . These are they who were over those who were counted ;

verses.z: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
verses.e: one golden ladle of ten shekels , full of incense ;

verses.z: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
verses.e: one young bull , one ram , one male lamb a year old , for a burnt offering ;

verses.z: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
verses.e: one male goat for a sin offering ;

verses.z: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是蘇押兒子拿坦業的供物。
verses.e: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings , two head of cattle , five rams , five male goats , five male lambs a year old . This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar .

verses.z: 第三日[來獻的]是西布倫子孫的首領、希倫的兒子以利押。
verses.e: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon , prince of the children of Zebulun ,

verses.z: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
verses.e: gave his offering : one silver platter , the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary , both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering ;

verses.z: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
verses.e: one golden ladle of ten shekels , full of incense ;

verses.z: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
verses.e: one young bull , one ram , one male lamb a year old , for a burnt offering ;

verses.z: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
verses.e: one male goat for a sin offering ;

verses.z: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是希倫兒子以利押的供物。
verses.e: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings , two head of cattle , five rams , five male goats , and five male lambs a year old . This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon .

verses.z: 他們把自己的供物送到耶和華面前，就是六輛篷子車和十二隻公牛。每兩個首領奉獻一輛車，每首領奉獻一隻牛。他們把這些都奉到帳幕前。
verses.e: and they brought their offering before the LORD , six covered wagons and twelve oxen ; a wagon for every two of the princes , and for each one an ox . They presented them before the tabernacle .

verses.z: 第四日[來獻的]是呂便子孫的首領、示丟珥的兒子以利蓿。
verses.e: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur , prince of the children of Reuben ,

verses.z: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十[舍客勒]，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
verses.e: gave his offering : one silver platter , the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary , both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering ;

verses.z: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
verses.e: one golden ladle of ten shekels , full of incense ;

verses.z: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
verses.e: one young bull , one ram , one male lamb a year old , for a burnt offering ;

verses.z: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
verses.e: one male goat for a sin offering ;

verses.z: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是示丟珥的兒子以利蓿的供物。
verses.e: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings , two head of cattle , five rams , five male goats , and five male lambs a year old . This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur .

verses.z: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；

verses.z: 又把四輛車，八隻牛，照米拉利子孫所辦的事交給他們；他們都在祭司亞倫的兒子以他瑪手下。
verses.e: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari , according to their service , under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .

verses.z: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
verses.e: one golden ladle of ten shekels , full of incense ;

verses.e: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings , two head of cattle , five rams , five male goats , and five male lambs a year old . This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan .

verses.z: 用膏抹壇的日子，以色列的眾首領為行獻壇之禮所獻的是：銀盤子十二個，銀碗十二個，金盂十二個；
verses.e: This was the dedication offering of the altar , on the day when it was anointed , by the princes of Israel : twelve silver platters , twelve silver bowls , twelve golden ladles ;

verses.z: 每盤子[重]一百三十[舍客勒]，每碗重七十[舍客勒]。一切器皿的銀子，按聖所的平，共有二千四百[舍客勒]。
verses.e: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels , and each bowl seventy ; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels , according to the shekel of the sanctuary ;

verses.z: 十二個金盂盛滿了香，按聖所的平，每盂重十[舍客勒]，所有的金子共一百二十[舍客勒]。
verses.e: the twelve golden ladles , full of incense , weighing ten shekels apiece , according to the shekel of the sanctuary ; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels ;

verses.z: 作燔祭的，共有公牛十二隻，公羊十二隻，一歲的公羊羔十二隻，並同獻的素祭作贖罪祭的公山羊十二隻；
verses.e: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls , the rams twelve , the male lambs a year old twelve , and their meal offering ; and twelve male goats for a sin offering ;

verses.z: 作平安祭的，共有公牛二十四隻，公綿羊六十隻，公山羊六十隻，一歲的公羊羔六十隻。這就是用膏抹壇之後，為行奉獻壇之禮所獻的。
verses.e: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings : twenty-four bulls , sixty rams , sixty male goats , and sixty male lambs a year old . This was the dedication offering of the altar , after it was anointed .

verses.z: 摩西進會幕要與耶和華說話的時候，聽見法櫃的施恩座以上、二基路伯中間有與他說話的聲音，就是耶和華與他說話。
verses.e: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD , he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony , from between the two cherubim ; and he spoke to him .

verses.z: 但車與牛都沒有交給哥轄子孫；因為他們辦的是聖所的事，在肩頭上抬聖物。
verses.e: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none , because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them ; they carried it on their shoulders .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 將利未人奉到耶和華面前，以色列人要按手在他們[頭]上。
verses.e: You shall present the Levites before the LORD . The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites ,

verses.z: 亞倫也將他們奉到耶和華面前，為以色列人當作搖祭，使他們好辦耶和華的事。
verses.e: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel , that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD .

verses.z: 利未人要按手在那兩隻牛的頭上；你要將一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，獻給耶和華，為利未人贖罪。
verses.e: " The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls , and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD , to make atonement for the Levites .

verses.z: 你也要使利未人站在亞倫和他兒子面前，將他們當作搖祭奉給耶和華。
verses.e: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons , and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD .

verses.z: 「這樣，你從以色列人中將利未人分別出來，利未人便要歸我。
verses.e: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel , and the Levites shall be mine .

verses.z: 此後利未人要進去辦會幕的事，你要潔淨他們，將他們當作搖祭奉上；
verses.e: " After that , the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting . You shall cleanse them , and offer them as a wave offering .

verses.z: 因為他們是從以色列人中全然給我的，我揀選他們歸我，是代替以色列人中一切頭生的。
verses.e: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel ; instead of all who open the womb , even the firstborn of all the children of Israel , I have taken them to me .

verses.z: 以色列人中一切頭生的，連人帶牲畜，都是我的。我在埃及地擊殺一切頭生的那天，將他們分別為聖歸我。
verses.e: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine , both man and animal . On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , I sanctified them for myself .

verses.z: 我揀選利未人代替以色列人中一切頭生的。
verses.e: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel .

verses.z: 我從以色列人中將利未人當作賞賜給亞倫和他的兒子，在會幕中辦以色列人的事，又為以色列人贖罪，免得他們挨近聖所，有災殃臨到他們中間。」
verses.e: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel , to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting , and to make atonement for the children of Israel , so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary . "

verses.z: 「你告訴亞倫說：點燈的時候，七盞燈都要向燈臺前面發光。」
verses.e: " Speak to Aaron , and tell him , ' When you light the lamps , the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand . ' "

verses.z: 摩西、亞倫，並以色列全會眾便向利未人如此行。凡耶和華指着利未人所吩咐摩西的，以色列人就向他們這樣行。
verses.e: Moses , and Aaron , and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites . According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites , so the children of Israel did to them .

verses.z: 於是利未人潔淨自己，除了罪，洗了衣服；亞倫將他們當作搖祭奉到耶和華面前，又為他們贖罪，潔淨他們。
verses.e: The Levites purified themselves from sin , and they washed their clothes ; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them .

verses.z: 然後利未人進去，在亞倫和他兒子面前，在會幕中辦事。耶和華指着利未人怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎樣向他們行了。
verses.e: After that , the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons : as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites , so they did to them .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「利未人是這樣：從二十五歲以外，他們要前來任職，辦會幕的事。
verses.e: " This is what is assigned to the Levites : from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting ;

verses.z: 到了五十歲要停工退任，不再辦事，
verses.e: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work , and shall serve no more ,

verses.z: 只要在會幕裏，和他們的弟兄一同伺候，謹守所吩咐的，不再辦事了。至於所吩咐利未人的，你要這樣向他們行。」
verses.e: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting , to perform the duty , and shall perform no service . This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties . "

verses.z: 亞倫便這樣行。他點燈臺上的燈，[使燈]向前[發光]，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: Aaron did so . He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand , as the LORD commanded Moses .

verses.z: 這燈臺的做法是用金子錘出來的，連座帶花都是錘出來的。摩西製造燈臺，是照耶和華所指示的樣式。
verses.e: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand , beaten work of gold . From its base to its flowers , it was beaten work . He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses .

verses.z: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 「你從以色列人中選出利未人來，潔淨他們。
verses.e: " Take the Levites from among the children of Israel , and cleanse them .

verses.z: 潔淨他們當這樣行：用除罪水彈在他們身上，又叫他們用剃頭刀刮全身，洗衣服，潔淨自己。
verses.e: You shall do this to them to cleanse them : sprinkle the water of cleansing on them , let them shave their whole bodies with a razor , let them wash their clothes , and cleanse themselves .

verses.z: 然後叫他們取一隻公牛犢，並同獻的素祭，就是調油的細麵；你要另取一隻公牛犢作贖罪祭。
verses.e: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering , fine flour mixed with oil ; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering .

verses.z: 將利未人奉到會幕前，招聚以色列全會眾。
verses.e: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting . You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 以色列人出埃及地以後，第二年正月，耶和華在西奈的曠野吩咐摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai , in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt , saying ,

verses.z: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們和你們後代中，若有人因死屍而不潔淨，或在遠方行路，還要向耶和華守逾越節。
verses.e: " Say to the children of Israel , ' If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body , or is on a journey far away , he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD .

verses.z: 他們要在二月十四日黃昏的時候，守逾越節。要用無酵餅與苦菜，和逾越節[的羊羔]同吃。
verses.e: In the second month , on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it ; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs .

verses.z: 一點不可留到早晨；羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。他們要照逾越節的一切律例而守。
verses.e: They shall leave none of it until the morning , nor break a bone of it . According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it .

verses.z: 那潔淨而不行路的人若推辭不守逾越節，那人要從民中剪除；因為他在所定的日期不獻耶和華的供物，應該擔當他的罪。
verses.e: But the man who is clean , and is not on a journey , and fails to keep the Passover , that soul shall be cut off from his people . Because he didn't offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season , that man shall bear his sin .

verses.z: 若有外人寄居在你們中間，願意向耶和華守逾越節，他要照逾越節的律例典章行，不管是寄居的是本地人，同歸一例。」
verses.e: " ' If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD , then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover , and according to its ordinance . You shall have one statute , both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land . ' "

verses.z: 立起帳幕的那日，有雲彩遮蓋帳幕，就是法[櫃]的帳幕；從晚上到早晨，雲彩在其上，形狀如火。
verses.e: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up , the cloud covered the tabernacle , even the Tent of the Testimony . At evening it was over the tabernacle , as it were the appearance of fire , until morning .

verses.z: 常是這樣，雲彩遮蓋帳幕，夜間形狀如火。
verses.e: So it was continually . The cloud covered it , and the appearance of fire by night .

verses.z: 雲彩幾時從帳幕收上去，以色列人就幾時起行；雲彩在哪裏停住，以色列人就在那裏安營。
verses.e: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent , then after that the children of Israel traveled ; and in the place where the cloud remained , there the children of Israel encamped .

verses.z: 以色列人遵耶和華的吩咐起行，也遵耶和華的吩咐安營。雲彩在帳幕上停住幾時，他們就住營幾時。
verses.e: At the commandment of the LORD , the children of Israel traveled , and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped . As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped .

verses.z: 雲彩在帳幕上停留許多日子，以色列人就守耶和華所吩咐的不起行。
verses.e: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days , then the children of Israel kept the LORD's command , and didn't travel .

verses.z: 「以色列人應當在所定的日期守逾越節，
verses.e: " Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season .

verses.z: 有時雲彩在帳幕上幾天，他們就照耶和華的吩咐住營，也照耶和華的吩咐起行。
verses.e: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle ; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped , and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled .

verses.z: 有時從晚上到早晨，有這雲彩[在帳幕上]；早晨雲彩收上去，他們就起行。有時晝夜[雲彩停在帳幕上]，收上去的時候，他們就起行。
verses.e: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning ; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning , they traveled ; or by day and by night , when the cloud was taken up , they traveled .

verses.z: 雲彩停留在帳幕上，無論是兩天，是一月，是一年，以色列人就住營不起行；但雲彩收上去，他們就起行。
verses.e: Whether it was two days , or a month , or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle , remaining on it , the children of Israel remained encamped , and didn't travel ; but when it was taken up , they traveled .

verses.z: 他們遵耶和華的吩咐安營，也遵耶和華的吩咐起行。他們守耶和華所吩咐的，都是憑耶和華吩咐摩西的。
verses.e: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped , and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled . They kept the LORD's command , at the commandment of the LORD by Moses .

verses.z: 就是本月十四日黃昏的時候，你們要在所定的日期守這節，要按這節的律例典章而守。」
verses.e: On the fourteenth day of this month , at evening , you shall keep it in its appointed season . You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances . "

verses.z: 於是摩西吩咐以色列人守逾越節。
verses.e: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover .

verses.z: 他們就在西奈的曠野，正月十四日黃昏的時候，守逾越節。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照樣行了。
verses.e: They kept the Passover in the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at evening , in the wilderness of Sinai . According to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did .

verses.z: 有幾個人因死屍而不潔淨，不能在那日守逾越節。當日他們到摩西、亞倫面前，
verses.e: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man , so that they could not keep the Passover on that day , and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day .

verses.z: 說：「我們雖因死屍而不潔淨，為何被阻止、不得同以色列人在所定的日期獻耶和華的供物呢？」
verses.e: Those men said to him , " We are unclean because of the dead body of a man . Why are we kept back , that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel ? "

verses.z: 摩西對他們說：「你們暫且等候，我可以去聽耶和華指着你們是怎樣吩咐的。」
verses.e: Moses answered them , " Wait , that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you . "

verses.z: 耶和華對摩西說：
verses.e: The LORD spoke to Moses , saying ,

verses.z: 俄巴底亞得了耶和華的默示。論以東說：我從耶和華那裏聽見信息，並有使者被差往列國去，[說]：起來吧，一同起來與以東爭戰！
verses.e: The vision of Obadiah . This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom . We have heard news from the LORD , and an ambassador is sent among the nations , saying , " Arise , and let's rise up against her in battle .

verses.z: 因你向兄弟雅各行強暴，羞愧必遮蓋你，你也必永遠斷絕。
verses.e: For the violence done to your brother Jacob , shame will cover you , and you will be cut off forever .

verses.z: 當外人擄掠雅各的財物，外邦人進入他的城門，為耶路撒冷拈鬮的日子，你竟站在一旁，像與他們同夥。
verses.e: In the day that you stood on the other side , in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem , even you were like one of them .

verses.z: 你兄弟遭難的日子，你不當瞪眼看着；猶大人被滅的日子，你不當因此歡樂；他們遭難的日子，你不當說狂傲的話。
verses.e: But don't look down on your brother in the day of his disaster , and don't rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction . Don't speak proudly in the day of distress .

verses.z: 我民遭災的日子，你不當進他們的城門；他們遭災的日子，你不當瞪眼看着他們受苦；他們遭災的日子，你不當伸手搶他們的財物；
verses.e: Don't enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity . Don't look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity , neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity .

verses.z: 你不當站在岔路口剪除他們中間逃脫的；他們遭難的日子，你不當將他們剩下的人交付[仇敵]。
verses.e: Don't stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape . Don't deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress .

verses.z: 耶和華降罰的日子臨近萬國。你怎樣行，[他]也必照樣向你行；你的報應必歸到你頭上。
verses.e: For the day of the LORD is near all the nations ! As you have done , it will be done to you . Your deeds will return upon your own head .

verses.z: 你們猶大人在我聖山怎樣喝了[苦杯]，萬國也必照樣常常地喝；且喝且咽，他們就歸於無有。
verses.e: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain , so all the nations will drink continually . Yes , they will drink , swallow down , and will be as though they had not been .

verses.z: 在錫安山必有逃脫的人，那山也必成聖；雅各家必得原有的產業。
verses.e: But in Mount Zion , there will be those who escape , and it will be holy . The house of Jacob will possess their possessions .

verses.z: 雅各家必成為大火；約瑟家必為火焰；以掃家必如碎稭；火必將他燒着吞滅。以掃家必無餘剩的。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: The house of Jacob will be a fire , the house of Joseph a flame , and the house of Esau for stubble . They will burn among them and devour them . There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau . " Indeed , the LORD has spoken .

verses.z: 南地的人必得以掃山；高原的人必得非利士地，也得以法蓮地和撒馬利亞地；便雅憫人必得基列。
verses.e: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau , and those of the lowland , the Philistines . They will possess the field of Ephraim , and the field of Samaria . Benjamin will possess Gilead .

verses.z: 我使你－以東在列國中為最小的，被人大大藐視。
verses.e: Behold , I have made you small among the nations . You are greatly despised .

verses.z: 在迦南人中被擄的以色列眾人[必得地]直到撒勒法；在西法拉中被擄的耶路撒冷人必得南地的城邑。
verses.e: The captives of this army of the children of Israel , who are among the Canaanites , will possess even to Zarephath ; and the captives of Jerusalem , who are in Sepharad , will possess the cities of the Negev .

verses.z: 必有拯救者上到錫安山，審判以掃山；國度就歸耶和華了。
verses.e: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau , and the kingdom will be the LORD's .

verses.z: 住在山穴中、居所在高處的啊，你因狂傲自欺，心裏說：誰能將我拉下地去呢？
verses.e: The pride of your heart has deceived you , you who dwell in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high , who says in his heart , ' Who will bring me down to the ground ? '

verses.z: 你雖如大鷹高飛，在星宿之間搭窩，我必從那裏拉下你來。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Though you mount on high as the eagle , and though your nest is set among the stars , I will bring you down from there , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 盜賊若來在你那裏，或強盜夜間而來－你何竟被剪除－豈不偷竊直到夠了呢？摘葡萄的若來到你那裏，豈不剩下些葡萄呢？
verses.e: " If thieves came to you , if robbers by night — oh , what disaster awaits you — wouldn't they only steal until they had enough ? If grape pickers came to you , wouldn't they leave some gleaning grapes ?

verses.z: 以掃[的隱密處]何竟被搜尋？他隱藏的寶物何竟被查出？
verses.e: How Esau will be ransacked ! How his hidden treasures are sought out !

verses.z: 與你結盟的都送你上路，直到交界；與你和好的欺騙你，且勝過你；與你一同吃飯的設下網羅陷害你；在你心裏毫無聰明。
verses.e: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way , even to the border . The men who were at peace with you have deceived you , and prevailed against you . Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you . There is no understanding in him . "

verses.z: 耶和華說：到那日，我豈不從以東除滅智慧人？從以掃山除滅聰明人？
verses.e: " Won't I in that day " , says the LORD , " destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mountain of Esau ?

verses.z: 提幔哪，你的勇士必驚惶，甚至以掃山的人都被殺戮剪除。
verses.e: Your mighty men , Teman , will be dismayed , to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter .

verses.z: 為基督耶穌被囚的保羅，同兄弟提摩太寫信給我們所親愛的同工腓利門，
verses.e: Paul , a prisoner of Christ Jesus , and Timothy our brother , to Philemon , our beloved fellow worker ,

verses.z: 就是為我在捆鎖中所生的兒子阿尼西謀求你。
verses.e: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus , whom I have become the father of in my chains ,

verses.z: 他從前與你沒有益處，但如今與你我都有益處。
verses.e: who once was useless to you , but now is useful to you and to me .

verses.z: 我現在打發他親自回你那裏去；他是我心上的人。
verses.e: I am sending him back . Therefore receive him , that is , my own heart ,

verses.z: 我本來有意將他留下，在我為福音所受的捆鎖中替你伺候我。
verses.e: whom I desired to keep with me , that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News .

verses.z: 但不知道你的意思，我就不願意這樣行，叫你的善行不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心。
verses.e: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent , that your goodness would not be as of necessity , but of free will .

verses.z: 他暫時離開你，或者是叫你永遠得着他，
verses.e: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever ,

verses.z: 不再是奴僕，乃是高過奴僕，是親愛的兄弟。在我實在是如此，何況在你呢！這也不拘是按肉體說，是按主說。
verses.e: no longer as a slave , but more than a slave , a beloved brother — especially to me , but how much rather to you , both in the flesh and in the Lord .

verses.z: 你若以我為同伴，就收納他，如同收納我一樣。
verses.e: If then you count me a partner , receive him as you would receive me .

verses.z: 他若虧負你，或欠你甚麼，都歸在我的帳上；
verses.e: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything , put that to my account .

verses.z: 我必償還，這是我－保羅親筆寫的。我並不用對你說，連你自己也是虧欠於我。
verses.e: I , Paul , write this with my own hand : I will repay it ( not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides ) .

verses.z: 和妹子亞腓亞並與我們同當兵的亞基布，以及在你家的教會。
verses.e: to the beloved Apphia , to Archippus our fellow soldier , and to the assembly in your house :

verses.z: 兄弟啊，望你使我在主裏因你得快樂，並望你使我的心在基督裏得暢快。
verses.e: Yes , brother , let me have joy from you in the Lord . Refresh my heart in the Lord .

verses.z: 我寫信給你，深信你必順服，知道你所要行的必過於我所說的。
verses.e: Having confidence in your obedience , I write to you , knowing that you will do even beyond what I say .

verses.z: 此外你還要給我預備住處；因為我盼望藉着你們的禱告，必蒙恩到你們那裏去。
verses.e: Also , prepare a guest room for me , for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you .

verses.z: 為基督耶穌與我同坐監的以巴弗問你安。
verses.e: Epaphras , my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus , greets you ,

verses.z: 與我同工的馬可、亞里達古、底馬、路加也都問你安。
verses.e: as do Mark , Aristarchus , Demas , and Luke , my fellow workers .

verses.z: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩[常]在你的心裏。阿們！
verses.e: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Amen .

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安從上帝我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
verses.e: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 我禱告的時候提到你，常為你感謝我的上帝；
verses.e: I thank my God always , making mention of you in my prayers ,

verses.z: 因聽說你的愛心並你向主耶穌和眾聖徒的信心。
verses.e: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints ,

verses.z: 願你與人所同有的信心顯出功效，使人知道你們各樣善事都是為基督做的。
verses.e: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 兄弟啊，我為你的愛心，大有快樂，大得安慰，因眾聖徒的心從你得了暢快。
verses.e: For we have much joy and comfort in your love , because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you , brother .

verses.z: 我雖然靠着基督能放膽吩咐你合宜的事，
verses.e: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate ,

verses.z: 然而像我這有年紀的保羅，現在又是為基督耶穌被囚的，寧可憑着愛心求你，
verses.e: yet for love's sake I rather appeal to you , being such a one as Paul , the aged , but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 基督耶穌的僕人保羅和提摩太寫信給凡住腓立比、在基督耶穌裏的眾聖徒，和諸位監督，諸位執事。
verses.e: Paul and Timothy , servants of Jesus Christ , to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi , with the overseers and servants :

verses.z: 使你們能分別是非，作誠實無過的人，直到基督的日子；
verses.e: so that you may approve the things that are excellent , that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ ,

verses.z: 並靠着耶穌基督結滿了仁義的果子，叫榮耀稱讚歸與上帝。
verses.e: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ , to the glory and praise of God .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我願意你們知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音興旺，
verses.e: Now I desire to have you know , brothers , that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News ,

verses.z: 以致我受的捆鎖在御營全軍和其餘的人中，已經顯明是為基督的緣故。
verses.e: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard , and to all the rest , that my bonds are in Christ ,

verses.z: 並且那在主裏的弟兄多半因我受的捆鎖就篤信不疑，越發放膽傳上帝的道，無所懼怕。
verses.e: and that most of the brothers in the Lord , being confident through my bonds , are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear .

verses.z: 有的傳基督是出於嫉妒紛爭，也有的是出於好意。
verses.e: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife , and some also out of good will .

verses.z: 這一等是出於愛心，知道我是為辯明福音設立的；
verses.e: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition , thinking that they add affliction to my chains ;

verses.z: 那一等傳基督是出於結黨，並不誠實，意思要加增我捆鎖的苦楚。
verses.e: but the latter out of love , knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News .

verses.z: 這有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，無論怎樣，基督究竟被傳開了。為此，我就歡喜，並且還要歡喜；
verses.e: What does it matter ? Only that in every way , whether in pretense or in truth , Christ is proclaimed . I rejoice in this , yes , and will rejoice .

verses.z: 因為我知道，這事藉着你們的祈禱和耶穌基督之靈的幫助，終必叫我得救。
verses.e: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 願恩惠、平安從上帝我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們！
verses.e: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 照着我所切慕、所盼望的，沒有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放膽，無論是生是死，總叫基督在我身上照常顯大。
verses.e: according to my earnest expectation and hope , that I will in no way be disappointed , but with all boldness , as always , now also Christ will be magnified in my body , whether by life or by death .

verses.z: 因我活着就是基督，我死了就有益處。
verses.e: For to me to live is Christ , and to die is gain .

verses.z: 但我在肉身活着，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道該挑選甚麼。
verses.e: But if I live on in the flesh , this will bring fruit from my work ; yet I don't know what I will choose .

verses.z: 我正在兩難之間，情願離世與基督同在，因為這是好得無比的。
verses.e: But I am hard pressed between the two , having the desire to depart and be with Christ , which is far better .

verses.z: 然而，我在肉身活着，為你們更是要緊的。
verses.e: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake .

verses.z: 我既然這樣深信，就知道仍要住在世間，且與你們眾人同住，使你們在所信的道上又長進又喜樂，
verses.e: Having this confidence , I know that I will remain , yes , and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith ,

verses.z: 叫你們在基督耶穌裏的歡樂，因我再到你們那裏去，就越發加增。
verses.e: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again .

verses.z: 只要你們行事為人與基督的福音相稱，叫我或來見你們，或不在你們那裏，可以聽見你們的景況，知道你們同有一個心志，站立得穩，為所信的福音齊心努力。
verses.e: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ , that whether I come and see you or am absent , I may hear of your state , that you stand firm in one spirit , with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News ;

verses.z: 凡事不怕敵人的驚嚇，這是證明他們沉淪，你們得救都是出於上帝。
verses.e: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries , which is for them a proof of destruction , but to you of salvation , and that from God .

verses.z: 因為你們蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，並要為他受苦。
verses.e: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ , not only to believe in him , but also to suffer on his behalf ,

verses.z: 我每逢想念你們，就感謝我的上帝；
verses.e: I thank my God whenever I remember you ,

verses.z: 你們的爭戰，就與你們在我身上從前所看見、現在所聽見的一樣。
verses.e: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me .

verses.z: 每逢為你們眾人祈求的時候，常是歡歡喜喜地祈求。
verses.e: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all , making my requests with joy ,

verses.z: 因為從頭一天直到如今，你們是同心合意地興旺福音。
verses.e: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now ;

verses.z: 我深信那在你們心裏動了善工的，必成全這工，直到耶穌基督的日子。
verses.e: being confident of this very thing , that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 我為你們眾人有這樣的意念，原是應當的；因你們常在我心裏，無論我是在捆鎖之中，是辯明證實福音的時候，你們都與我一同得恩。
verses.e: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you , because I have you in my heart , because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News , you all are partakers with me of grace .

verses.z: 我體會基督耶穌的心腸，切切地想念你們眾人；這是上帝可以給我作見證的。
verses.e: For God is my witness , how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 我所禱告的，就是要你們的愛心在知識和各樣見識上多而又多，
verses.e: This I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment ,

verses.z: 所以，在基督裏若有甚麼勸勉，愛心有甚麼安慰，[聖]靈有甚麼交通，[心中]有甚麼慈悲憐憫，
verses.e: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ , if any consolation of love , if any fellowship of the Spirit , if any tender mercies and compassion ,

verses.z: 叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的，因耶穌的名無不屈膝，
verses.e: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow , of those in heaven , those on earth , and those under the earth ,

verses.z: 無不口稱「耶穌基督為主」，使榮耀歸與父上帝。
verses.e: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord , to the glory of God the Father .

verses.z: 這樣看來，我親愛的[弟兄]，你們既是常順服的，不但我在你們那裏，就是我如今不在你們那裏，更是順服的，就當恐懼戰兢做成你們得救的工夫。
verses.e: So then , my beloved , even as you have always obeyed , not only in my presence , but now much more in my absence , work out your own salvation with fear and trembling .

verses.z: 因為你們立志行事都是上帝在你們心裏運行，為要成就他的美意。
verses.e: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure .

verses.z: 凡所行的，都不要發怨言，起爭論，
verses.e: Do all things without complaining and arguing ,

verses.z: 使你們無可指摘，誠實無偽，在這彎曲悖謬的世代作上帝無瑕疵的兒女。你們顯在這世代中，好像明光照耀，
verses.e: that you may become blameless and harmless , children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation , among whom you are seen as lights in the world ,

verses.z: 將生命的道表明出來，叫我在基督的日子好誇我沒有空跑，也沒有徒勞。
verses.e: holding up the word of life , that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn't run in vain nor labor in vain .

verses.z: 我以你們的信心為供獻的祭物，我若被澆奠在其上，也是喜樂，並且與你們眾人一同喜樂。
verses.e: Yes , and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith , I am glad and rejoice with you all .

verses.z: 你們也要照樣喜樂，並且與我一同喜樂。
verses.e: In the same way , you also should be glad and rejoice with me .

verses.z: 我靠主耶穌指望快打發提摩太去見你們，叫我知道你們的事，心裏就得着安慰。
verses.e: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon , that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing .

verses.z: 你們就要意念相同，愛心相同，有一樣的心思，有一樣的意念，使我的喜樂可以滿足。
verses.e: make my joy full by being like-minded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind ;

verses.z: 因為我沒有別人與我同心，實在掛念你們的事。
verses.e: For I have no one else like-minded , who will truly care about you .

verses.z: 別人都求自己的事，並不求耶穌基督的事。
verses.e: For they all seek their own , not the things of Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 但你們知道提摩太的明證；他興旺福音，與我同勞，待我像兒子待父親一樣。
verses.e: But you know that he has proved himself . As a child serves a father , so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News .

verses.z: 所以，我一看出我的事要怎樣了結，就盼望立刻打發他去；
verses.e: Therefore I hope to send him at once , as soon as I see how it will go with me .

verses.z: 但我靠着主自信我也必快去。
verses.e: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly .

verses.z: 然而，我想必須打發以巴弗提到你們那裏去。他是我的兄弟，與我一同做工，一同當兵，是你們所差遣的，也是供給我需用的。
verses.e: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , fellow worker , fellow soldier , and your apostle and servant of my need ,

verses.z: 他很想念你們眾人，並且極其難過，因為你們聽見他病了。
verses.e: since he longed for you all , and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick .

verses.z: 他實在是病了，幾乎要死；然而上帝憐恤他，不但憐恤他，也憐恤我，免得我憂上加憂。
verses.e: For indeed he was sick nearly to death , but God had mercy on him , and not on him only , but on me also , that I might not have sorrow on sorrow .

verses.z: 所以我越發急速打發他去，叫你們再見他，就可以喜樂，我也可以少些憂愁。
verses.e: I have sent him therefore the more diligently , that when you see him again , you may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .

verses.z: 故此，你們要在主裏歡歡樂樂地接待他，而且要尊重這樣的人；
verses.e: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy , and hold such people in honor ,

verses.z: 凡事不可結黨，不可貪圖虛浮的榮耀；只要存心謙卑，各人看別人比自己強。
verses.e: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit , but in humility , each counting others better than himself ;

verses.z: 因他為做基督的工夫，幾乎至死，不顧性命，要補足你們供給我的不及之處。
verses.e: because for the work of Christ he came near to death , risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me .

verses.z: 各人不要單顧自己的事，也要顧別人的事。
verses.e: each of you not just looking to his own things , but each of you also to the things of others .

verses.z: 你們當以基督耶穌的心為心：
verses.e: Have this in your mind , which was also in Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 他本有上帝的形像，不以自己與上帝同等為強奪的；
verses.e: who , existing in the form of God , didn't consider equality with God a thing to be grasped ,

verses.z: 反倒虛己，取了奴僕的形像，成為人的樣式；
verses.e: but emptied himself , taking the form of a servant , being made in the likeness of men .

verses.z: 既有人的樣子，就自己卑微，存心順服，以至於死，且死在十字架上。
verses.e: And being found in human form , he humbled himself , becoming obedient to the point of death , yes , the death of the cross .

verses.z: 所以，上帝將他升為至高，又賜給他那超乎萬名之上的名，
verses.e: Therefore God also highly exalted him , and gave to him the name which is above every name ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，我還有話說，你們要靠主喜樂。我把這話再寫給你們，於我並不為難，於你們卻是妥當。
verses.e: Finally , my brothers , rejoice in the Lord ! To write the same things to you , to me indeed is not tiresome , but for you it is safe .

verses.z: 使我認識基督，曉得他復活的大能，並且曉得和他一同受苦，效法他的死，
verses.e: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection , and the fellowship of his sufferings , becoming conformed to his death ,

verses.z: 或者我也得以從死裏復活。
verses.e: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead .

verses.z: 這不是說我已經得着了，已經完全了；我乃是竭力追求，或者可以得着基督耶穌所以得着我的。
verses.e: Not that I have already obtained , or am already made perfect ; but I press on , that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我不是以為自己已經得着了；我只有一件事，就是忘記背後，努力面前的，
verses.e: Brothers , I don't regard myself as yet having taken hold , but one thing I do : forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before ,

verses.z: 向着標竿直跑，要得上帝在基督耶穌裏從上面召我來得的獎賞。
verses.e: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 所以我們中間，凡是完全人總要存這樣的心；若在甚麼事上存別樣的心，上帝也必以此指示你們。
verses.e: Let us therefore , as many as are perfect , think this way . If in anything you think otherwise , God will also reveal that to you .

verses.z: 然而，我們到了甚麼地步，就當照着甚麼地步行。
verses.e: Nevertheless , to the extent that we have already attained , let's walk by the same rule . Let's be of the same mind .

verses.z: 弟兄們，你們要一同效法我，也當留意看那些照我們榜樣行的人。
verses.e: Brothers , be imitators together of me , and note those who walk this way , even as you have us for an example .

verses.z: 因為有許多人行事是基督十字架的仇敵。我屢次告訴你們，現在又流淚地告訴你們：
verses.e: For many walk , of whom I told you often , and now tell you even weeping , as the enemies of the cross of Christ ,

verses.z: 他們的結局就是沉淪；他們的神就是自己的肚腹。他們以自己的羞辱為榮耀，專以地上的事為念。
verses.e: whose end is destruction , whose god is the belly , and whose glory is in their shame , who think about earthly things .

verses.z: 應當防備犬類，防備作惡的，防備妄自行割的。
verses.e: Beware of the dogs ; beware of the evil workers ; beware of the false circumcision .

verses.z: 我們卻是天上的國民，並且等候救主，就是主耶穌基督從天上降臨。
verses.e: For our citizenship is in heaven , from where we also wait for a Savior , the Lord Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 他要按着那能叫萬有歸服自己的大能，將我們這卑賤的身體改變形狀，和他自己榮耀的身體相似。
verses.e: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory , according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself .

verses.z: 因為[真]受割禮的，乃是我們這以上帝的靈敬拜、在基督耶穌裏誇口、不靠着肉體的。
verses.e: For we are the circumcision , who worship God in the Spirit , and rejoice in Christ Jesus , and have no confidence in the flesh ;

verses.z: 其實，我也可以靠肉體；若是別人想他可以靠肉體，我更可以靠着了。
verses.e: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh . If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh , I yet more :

verses.z: 我第八天受割禮；我是以色列族、便雅憫支派的人，是希伯來人所生的希伯來人。就律法說，我是法利賽人；
verses.e: circumcised the eighth day , of the stock of Israel , of the tribe of Benjamin , a Hebrew of Hebrews ; concerning the law , a Pharisee ;

verses.z: 就熱心說，我是逼迫教會的；就律法上的義說，我是無可指摘的。
verses.e: concerning zeal , persecuting the assembly ; concerning the righteousness which is in the law , found blameless .

verses.z: 只是我先前以為與我有益的，我現在因基督都當作有損的。
verses.e: However , I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ .

verses.z: 不但如此，我也將萬事當作有損的，因我以認識我主基督耶穌為至寶。我為他已經丟棄萬事，看作糞土，為要得着基督；
verses.e: Yes most certainly , and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus , my Lord , for whom I suffered the loss of all things , and count them nothing but refuse , that I may gain Christ

verses.z: 並且得以在他裏面，不是有自己因律法而得的義，乃是有信基督的義，就是因信上帝而來的義，
verses.e: and be found in him , not having a righteousness of my own , that which is of the law , but that which is through faith in Christ , the righteousness which is from God by faith ,

verses.z: 我所親愛、所想念的弟兄們，你們就是我的喜樂，我的冠冕。我親愛的[弟兄]，你們應當靠主站立得穩。
verses.e: Therefore , my brothers , beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , stand firm in the Lord in this way , my beloved .

verses.z: 我靠主大大地喜樂，因為你們思念我的心如今又發生；你們向來就思念我，只是沒得機會。
verses.e: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me ; in which you did indeed take thought , but you lacked opportunity .

verses.z: 我並不是因缺乏說這話；我無論在甚麼景況都可以知足，這是我已經學會了。
verses.e: Not that I speak because of lack , for I have learned in whatever state I am , to be content in it .

verses.z: 我知道怎樣處卑賤，也知道怎樣處豐富；或飽足，或飢餓；或有餘，或缺乏，隨事隨在，我都得了秘訣。
verses.e: I know how to be humbled , and I also know how to abound . In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry , both to abound and to be in need .

verses.z: 我靠着那加給我力量的，凡事都能做。
verses.e: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me .

verses.z: 然而，你們和我同受患難原是美事。
verses.e: However you did well that you shared in my affliction .

verses.z: 腓立比人哪，你們也知道我初傳福音離了馬其頓的時候，論到授受的事，除了你們以外，並沒有別的教會供給我。
verses.e: You yourselves also know , you Philippians , that in the beginning of the Good News , when I departed from Macedonia , no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only .

verses.z: 就是我在帖撒羅尼迦，你們也一次兩次地打發人供給我的需用。
verses.e: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need .

verses.z: 我並不求甚麼餽送，所求的就是你們的果子漸漸增多，歸在你們的帳上。
verses.e: Not that I seek for the gift , but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account .

verses.z: 但我樣樣都有，並且有餘。我已經充足，因我從以巴弗提受了你們的餽送，當作極美的香氣，為上帝所收納、所喜悅的祭物。
verses.e: But I have all things and abound . I am filled , having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you , a sweet-smelling fragrance , an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God .

verses.z: 我的上帝必照他榮耀的豐富，在基督耶穌裏，使你們一切所需用的都充足。
verses.e: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 我勸友阿蝶和循都基，要在主裏同心。
verses.e: I exhort Euodia , and I exhort Syntyche , to think the same way in the Lord .

verses.z: 願榮耀歸給我們的父上帝，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever ! Amen .

verses.z: 請問在基督耶穌裏的各位聖徒安。在我這裏的眾弟兄都問你們安。
verses.e: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus . The brothers who are with me greet you .

verses.z: 眾聖徒都問你們安。在凱撒家裏的人特特地問你們安。
verses.e: All the saints greet you , especially those who are of Caesar's household .

verses.z: 願主耶穌基督的恩[常]在你們心裏！
verses.e: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .

verses.z: 我也求你這真實同負一軛的，幫助這兩個女人，因為她們在福音上曾與我一同勞苦；還有革利免，並其餘和我一同做工的，他們的名字都在生命冊上。
verses.e: Yes , I beg you also , true partner , help these women , for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also , and the rest of my fellow workers , whose names are in the book of life .

verses.z: 你們要靠主常常喜樂。我再說，你們要喜樂。
verses.e: Rejoice in the Lord always ! Again I will say , " Rejoice ! "

verses.z: 當叫眾人知道你們謙讓的心。主已經近了。
verses.e: Let your gentleness be known to all men . The Lord is at hand .

verses.z: 應當一無掛慮，只要凡事藉着禱告、祈求，和感謝，將你們所要的告訴上帝。
verses.e: In nothing be anxious , but in everything , by prayer and petition with thanksgiving , let your requests be made known to God .

verses.z: 上帝所賜、出人意外的平安必在基督耶穌裏保守你們的心懷意念。
verses.e: And the peace of God , which surpasses all understanding , will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我還有未盡的話：凡是真實的、可敬的、公義的、清潔的、可愛的、有美名的，若有甚麼德行，若有甚麼稱讚，這些事你們都要思念。
verses.e: Finally , brothers , whatever things are true , whatever things are honorable , whatever things are just , whatever things are pure , whatever things are lovely , whatever things are of good report : if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise , think about these things .

verses.z: 你們在我身上所學習的，所領受的，所聽見的，所看見的，這些事你們都要去行，賜平安的上帝就必與你們同在。
verses.e: Do the things which you learned , received , heard , and saw in me , and the God of peace will be with you .

verses.z: 以色列王大衛兒子所羅門的箴言：
verses.e: The proverbs of Solomon , the son of David , king of Israel :

verses.z: 我兒，惡人若引誘你，你不可隨從。
verses.e: My son , if sinners entice you , don't consent .

verses.z: 他們若說：你與我們同去，我們要埋伏流人之血，要蹲伏害無罪之人；
verses.e: If they say , " Come with us . Let's lie in wait for blood . Let's lurk secretly for the innocent without cause .

verses.z: 我們好像陰間，把他們活活吞下；他們如同下坑的人，被我們囫圇吞了；
verses.e: Let's swallow them up alive like Sheol , and whole , like those who go down into the pit .

verses.z: 我們必得各樣寶物，將所擄來的，裝滿房屋；
verses.e: We'll find all valuable wealth . We'll fill our houses with plunder .

verses.z: 你與我們大家同分，我們共用一個囊袋；
verses.e: You shall cast your lot among us . We'll all have one purse " —

verses.z: 我兒，不要與他們同行一道，禁止你腳走他們的路。
verses.e: my son , don't walk on the path with them . Keep your foot from their path ,

verses.z: 因為，他們的腳奔跑行惡；他們急速流人的血，
verses.e: for their feet run to evil . They hurry to shed blood .

verses.z: 好像飛鳥，網羅設在眼前仍不躲避。
verses.e: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird ;

verses.z: 這些人埋伏，是為自流己血；蹲伏，是為自害己命。
verses.e: but these lay in wait for their own blood . They lurk secretly for their own lives .

verses.z: 凡貪戀財利的，所行之路都是如此；這貪戀之心乃奪去得財者之命。
verses.e: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain . It takes away the life of its owners .

verses.z: 要使人曉得智慧和訓誨，分辨通達的言語，
verses.e: to know wisdom and instruction ; to discern the words of understanding ;

verses.z: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在寬闊處發聲，
verses.e: Wisdom calls aloud in the street . She utters her voice in the public squares .

verses.z: 在熱鬧街頭喊叫，在城門口，在城中發出言語，
verses.e: She calls at the head of noisy places . At the entrance of the city gates , she utters her words :

verses.z: 說：你們愚昧人喜愛愚昧，褻慢人喜歡褻慢，愚頑人恨惡知識，要到幾時呢？
verses.e: " How long , you simple ones , will you love simplicity ? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery , and fools hate knowledge ?

verses.z: 你們當因我的責備回轉；我要將我的靈澆灌你們，將我的話指示你們。
verses.e: Turn at my reproof . Behold , I will pour out my spirit on you . I will make known my words to you .

verses.z: 我呼喚，你們不肯聽從；我伸手，無人理會；
verses.e: Because I have called , and you have refused ; I have stretched out my hand , and no one has paid attention ;

verses.z: 反輕棄我一切的勸戒，不肯受我的責備。
verses.e: but you have ignored all my counsel , and wanted none of my reproof ;

verses.z: 你們遭災難，我就發笑；驚恐臨到你們，我必嗤笑。
verses.e: I also will laugh at your disaster . I will mock when calamity overtakes you ,

verses.z: 驚恐臨到你們，好像狂風；災難來到，如同暴風；急難痛苦臨到你們身上。
verses.e: when calamity overtakes you like a storm , when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind , when distress and anguish come on you .

verses.z: 那時，你們必呼求我，我卻不答應，懇切地尋找我，卻尋不見。
verses.e: Then they will call on me , but I will not answer . They will seek me diligently , but they will not find me ,

verses.z: 因為，你們恨惡知識，不喜愛敬畏耶和華，
verses.e: because they hated knowledge , and didn't choose the fear of the LORD .

verses.z: 使人處事領受智慧、仁義、公平、正直的訓誨，
verses.e: to receive instruction in wise dealing , in righteousness , justice , and equity ;

verses.z: 不聽我的勸戒，藐視我一切的責備，
verses.e: They wanted none of my counsel . They despised all my reproof .

verses.z: 所以必吃自結的果子，充滿自設的計謀。
verses.e: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own schemes .

verses.z: 愚昧人背道，必殺己身；愚頑人安逸，必害己命。
verses.e: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them . The careless ease of fools will destroy them .

verses.z: 惟有聽從我的，必安然居住，得享安靜，不怕災禍。
verses.e: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely , and will be at ease , without fear of harm . "

verses.z: 使愚人靈明，使少年人有知識和謀略，
verses.e: to give prudence to the simple , knowledge and discretion to the young man —

verses.z: 使智慧人聽見，增長學問，使聰明人得着智謀，
verses.e: that the wise man may hear , and increase in learning ; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel ;

verses.z: 使人明白箴言和譬喻，懂得智慧人的言詞和謎語。
verses.e: to understand a proverb and parables , the words and riddles of the wise .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華是知識的開端；愚妄人藐視智慧和訓誨。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge , but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction .

verses.z: 我兒，要聽你父親的訓誨，不可離棄你母親的法則；
verses.e: My son , listen to your father's instruction , and don't forsake your mother's teaching ;

verses.z: 因為這要作你頭上的華冠，你項上的[金]鍊。
verses.e: for they will be a garland to grace your head , and chains around your neck .

verses.z: 所羅門的箴言：智慧之子使父親歡樂；愚昧之子叫母親擔憂。
verses.e: The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son makes a glad father ; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother .

verses.z: 以眼傳神的，使人憂患；口裏愚妄的，必致傾倒。
verses.e: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow , but a chattering fool will fall .

verses.z: 義人的口是生命的泉源；強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。
verses.e: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life , but violence covers the mouth of the wicked .

verses.z: 恨能挑啟爭端；愛能遮掩一切過錯。
verses.e: Hatred stirs up strife , but love covers all wrongs .

verses.z: 明哲人嘴裏有智慧；無知人背上受刑杖。
verses.e: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment , but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding .

verses.z: 智慧人積存知識；愚妄人的口速致敗壞。
verses.e: Wise men lay up knowledge , but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin .

verses.z: 富戶的財物是他的堅城；窮人的貧乏是他的敗壞。
verses.e: The rich man's wealth is his strong city . The destruction of the poor is their poverty .

verses.z: 義人的勤勞致生；惡人的進項致死。
verses.e: The labor of the righteous leads to life . The increase of the wicked leads to sin .

verses.z: 謹守訓誨的，乃在生命的道上；違棄責備的，便失迷了路。
verses.e: He is in the way of life who heeds correction , but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray .

verses.z: 隱藏怨恨的，有說謊的嘴；口出讒謗的，是愚妄的人。
verses.e: He who hides hatred has lying lips . He who utters a slander is a fool .

verses.z: 多言多語難免有過；禁止嘴唇是有智慧。
verses.e: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience , but he who restrains his lips does wisely .

verses.z: 不義之財毫無益處；惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。
verses.e: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing , but righteousness delivers from death .

verses.z: 義人的舌乃[似]高銀；惡人的心所值無幾。
verses.e: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver . The heart of the wicked is of little worth .

verses.z: 義人的口教養多人；愚昧人因無知而死亡。
verses.e: The lips of the righteous feed many , but the foolish die for lack of understanding .

verses.z: 耶和華所賜的福使人富足，並不加上憂慮。
verses.e: The LORD's blessing brings wealth , and he adds no trouble to it .

verses.z: 愚妄人以行惡為戲耍；明哲人卻以智慧為樂。
verses.e: It is a fool's pleasure to do wickedness , but wisdom is a man of understanding's pleasure .

verses.z: 惡人所怕的，必臨到他；義人所願的，必蒙應允。
verses.e: What the wicked fear will overtake them , but the desire of the righteous will be granted .

verses.z: 暴風一過，惡人歸於無有；義人的根基卻是永久。
verses.e: When the whirlwind passes , the wicked is no more ; but the righteous stand firm forever .

verses.z: 懶惰人叫差他的人如醋倒牙，如煙薰目。
verses.e: As vinegar to the teeth , and as smoke to the eyes , so is the sluggard to those who send him .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華使人日子加多；但惡人的年歲必被減少。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD prolongs days , but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .

verses.z: 義人的盼望[必得]喜樂；惡人的指望必致滅沒。
verses.e: The prospect of the righteous is joy , but the hope of the wicked will perish .

verses.z: 耶和華的道是正直人的保障，卻成了作孽人的敗壞。
verses.e: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright , but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity .

verses.z: 耶和華不使義人受飢餓；惡人所欲的，他必推開。
verses.e: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry , but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked .

verses.z: 義人永不挪移；惡人不得住在地上。
verses.e: The righteous will never be removed , but the wicked will not dwell in the land .

verses.z: 義人的口滋生智慧；乖謬的舌必被割斷。
verses.e: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom , but the perverse tongue will be cut off .

verses.z: 義人的嘴能令人喜悅；惡人的口[說]乖謬的話。
verses.e: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable , but the mouth of the wicked is perverse .

verses.z: 手懶的，要受貧窮；手勤的，卻要富足。
verses.e: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand , but the hand of the diligent brings wealth .

verses.z: 夏天聚斂的，是智慧之子；收割時沉睡的，是貽羞之子。
verses.e: He who gathers in summer is a wise son , but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame .

verses.z: 福祉臨到義人的頭；強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。
verses.e: Blessings are on the head of the righteous , but violence covers the mouth of the wicked .

verses.z: 義人的紀念被稱讚；惡人的名字必朽爛。
verses.e: The memory of the righteous is blessed , but the name of the wicked will rot .

verses.z: 心中智慧的，必受命令；口裏愚妄的，必致傾倒。
verses.e: The wise in heart accept commandments , but a chattering fool will fall .

verses.z: 行正直路的，步步安穩；走彎曲道的，必致敗露。
verses.e: He who walks blamelessly walks surely , but he who perverts his ways will be found out .

verses.z: 詭詐的天平為耶和華所憎惡；公平的法碼為他所喜悅。
verses.e: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD , but accurate weights are his delight .

verses.z: 義人享福，合城喜樂；惡人滅亡，人都歡呼。
verses.e: When it goes well with the righteous , the city rejoices . When the wicked perish , there is shouting .

verses.z: 城因正直人祝福便高舉，卻因邪惡人的口就傾覆。
verses.e: By the blessing of the upright , the city is exalted , but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked .

verses.z: 藐視鄰舍的，毫無智慧；明哲人卻靜默不言。
verses.e: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom , but a man of understanding holds his peace .

verses.z: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事；心中誠實的，遮隱事情。
verses.e: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence , but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret .

verses.z: 無智謀，民就敗落；謀士多，人便安居。
verses.e: Where there is no wise guidance , the nation falls , but in the multitude of counselors there is victory .

verses.z: 為外人作保的，必受虧損；恨惡擊掌的，卻得安穩。
verses.e: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it , but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure .

verses.z: 恩德的婦女得尊榮；強暴的男子得資財。
verses.e: A gracious woman obtains honor , but violent men obtain riches .

verses.z: 仁慈的人善待自己；殘忍的人擾害己身。
verses.e: The merciful man does good to his own soul , but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh .

verses.z: 惡人經營，得虛浮的工價；撒義種的，得實在的果效。
verses.e: Wicked people earn deceitful wages , but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward .

verses.z: 恆心為義的，[必得]生命；追求邪惡的，[必致]死亡。
verses.e: He who is truly righteous gets life . He who pursues evil gets death .

verses.z: 驕傲來，羞恥也來；謙遜人卻有智慧。
verses.e: When pride comes , then comes shame , but with humility comes wisdom .

verses.z: 心中乖僻的，為耶和華所憎惡；行事完全的，為他所喜悅。
verses.e: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD , but those whose ways are blameless are his delight .

verses.z: 惡人[雖然]連手，必不免受罰；義人的後裔必得拯救。
verses.e: Most certainly , the evil man will not be unpunished , but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered .

verses.z: 婦女美貌而無見識，[如同]金環帶在豬鼻上。
verses.e: Like a gold ring in a pig's snout , is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion .

verses.z: 義人的心願盡得好處；惡人的指望致干忿怒。
verses.e: The desire of the righteous is only good . The expectation of the wicked is wrath .

verses.z: 有施散的，卻更增添；有吝惜過度的，反致窮乏。
verses.e: There is one who scatters , and increases yet more . There is one who withholds more than is appropriate , but gains poverty .

verses.z: 好施捨的，必得豐裕；滋潤人的，必得滋潤。
verses.e: The liberal soul shall be made fat . He who waters shall be watered also himself .

verses.z: 屯糧不賣的，民必咒詛他；情願出賣的，人必為他祝福。
verses.e: People curse someone who withholds grain , but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it .

verses.z: 懇切求善的，就求得恩惠；惟獨求惡的，惡必臨到他身。
verses.e: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor , but he who searches after evil , it shall come to him .

verses.z: 倚仗自己財物的，必跌倒；義人必發旺，如青葉。
verses.e: He who trusts in his riches will fall , but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf .

verses.z: 擾害己家的，必承受清風；愚昧人必作慧心人的僕人。
verses.e: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind . The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart .

verses.z: 正直人的純正必引導自己；奸詐人的乖僻必毀滅自己。
verses.e: The integrity of the upright shall guide them , but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them .

verses.z: 義人所結的果子就是生命樹；有智慧的，必能得人。
verses.e: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life . He who is wise wins souls .

verses.z: 看哪，義人在世尚且受報，何況惡人和罪人呢？
verses.e: Behold , the righteous shall be repaid in the earth , how much more the wicked and the sinner !

verses.z: 發怒的日子資財無益；惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。
verses.e: Riches don't profit in the day of wrath , but righteousness delivers from death .

verses.z: 完全人的義必指引他的路；但惡人必因自己的惡跌倒。
verses.e: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way , but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness .

verses.z: 正直人的義必拯救自己；奸詐人必陷在自己的罪孽中。
verses.e: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them , but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires .

verses.z: 惡人一死，他的指望必滅絕；罪人的盼望也必滅沒。
verses.e: When a wicked man dies , hope perishes , and expectation of power comes to nothing .

verses.z: 義人得脫離患難，有惡人來代替他。
verses.e: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble , and the wicked takes his place .

verses.z: 不虔敬的人用口敗壞鄰舍；義人卻因知識得救。
verses.e: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor , but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge .

verses.z: 喜愛管教的，就是喜愛知識；恨惡責備的，卻是畜類。
verses.e: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge , but he who hates reproof is stupid .

verses.z: 義人顧惜他牲畜的命；惡人的憐憫也是殘忍。
verses.e: A righteous man respects the life of his animal , but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel .

verses.z: 耕種自己田地的，必得飽食；追隨虛浮的，卻是無知。
verses.e: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread , but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding .

verses.z: 惡人想得壞人的網羅；義人的根得以結實。
verses.e: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men , but the root of the righteous flourishes .

verses.z: 惡人嘴中的過錯是自己的網羅；但義人必脫離患難。
verses.e: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips , but the righteous shall come out of trouble .

verses.z: 人因口所結的果子，必飽得美福；人手所做的，必為自己的報應。
verses.e: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth . The work of a man's hands shall be rewarded to him .

verses.z: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看為正直；惟智慧人肯聽人的勸教。
verses.e: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes , but he who is wise listens to counsel .

verses.z: 愚妄人的惱怒立時顯露；通達人能忍辱藏羞。
verses.e: A fool shows his annoyance the same day , but one who overlooks an insult is prudent .

verses.z: 說出真話的，顯明公義；作假見證的，顯出詭詐。
verses.e: He who is truthful testifies honestly , but a false witness lies .

verses.z: 說話浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌頭卻為醫人的良藥。
verses.e: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword , but the tongue of the wise heals .

verses.z: 口吐真言，永遠堅立；舌說謊話，只存片時。
verses.e: Truth's lips will be established forever , but a lying tongue is only momentary .

verses.z: 善人必蒙耶和華的恩惠；設詭計的人，耶和華必定他的罪。
verses.e: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD , but he will condemn a man of wicked plans .

verses.z: 圖謀惡事的，心存詭詐；勸人和睦的，便得喜樂。
verses.e: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil , but joy comes to the promoters of peace .

verses.z: 義人不遭災害；惡人滿受禍患。
verses.e: No mischief shall happen to the righteous , but the wicked shall be filled with evil .

verses.z: 說謊言的嘴為耶和華所憎惡；行事誠實的，為他所喜悅。
verses.e: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD , but those who do the truth are his delight .

verses.z: 通達人隱藏知識；愚昧人的心彰顯愚昧。
verses.e: A prudent man keeps his knowledge , but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness .

verses.z: 殷勤人的手必掌權；懶惰的人必服苦。
verses.e: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule , but laziness ends in slave labor .

verses.z: 人心憂慮，屈而不伸；一句良言，使心歡樂。
verses.e: Anxiety in a man's heart weighs it down , but a kind word makes it glad .

verses.z: 義人引導他的鄰舍；惡人的道叫人失迷。
verses.e: A righteous person is cautious in friendship , but the way of the wicked leads them astray .

verses.z: 懶惰的人不烤打獵所得的；殷勤的人卻得寶貴的財物。
verses.e: The slothful man doesn't roast his game , but the possessions of diligent men are prized .

verses.z: 在公義的道上有生命；其路之中並無死亡。
verses.e: In the way of righteousness is life ; in its path there is no death .

verses.z: 人靠惡行不能堅立；義人的根必不動搖。
verses.e: A man shall not be established by wickedness , but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .

verses.z: 才德的婦人是丈夫的冠冕；貽羞的婦人如同朽爛在她丈夫的骨中。
verses.e: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband , but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones .

verses.z: 義人的思念是公平；惡人的計謀是詭詐。
verses.e: The thoughts of the righteous are just , but the advice of the wicked is deceitful .

verses.z: 惡人的言論是埋伏流人的血；正直人的口必拯救人。
verses.e: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood , but the speech of the upright rescues them .

verses.z: 惡人傾覆，歸於無有；義人的家必站得住。
verses.e: The wicked are overthrown , and are no more , but the house of the righteous shall stand .

verses.z: 人必按自己的智慧被稱讚；心中乖謬的，必被藐視。
verses.e: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom , but he who has a warped mind shall be despised .

verses.z: 被人輕賤，卻有僕人，強如自尊，缺少食物。
verses.e: Better is he who is little known , and has a servant , than he who honors himself and lacks bread .

verses.z: 智慧子[聽]父親的教訓；褻慢人不聽責備。
verses.e: A wise son listens to his father's instruction , but a scoffer doesn't listen to rebuke .

verses.z: 驕傲只啟爭競；聽勸言的，卻有智慧。
verses.e: Pride only breeds quarrels , but wisdom is with people who take advice .

verses.z: 不勞而得之財必然消耗；勤勞積蓄的，必見加增。
verses.e: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away , but he who gathers by hand makes it grow .

verses.z: 所盼望的遲延未得，令人心憂；所願意的臨到，卻是生命樹。
verses.e: Hope deferred makes the heart sick , but when longing is fulfilled , it is a tree of life .

verses.z: 藐視訓言的，自取滅亡；敬畏誡命的，必得善報。
verses.e: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it , but he who respects a command will be rewarded .

verses.z: 智慧人的法則是生命的泉源，可以使人離開死亡的網羅。
verses.e: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life , to turn from the snares of death .

verses.z: 美好的聰明使人蒙恩；奸詐人的道路崎嶇難行。
verses.e: Good understanding wins favor , but the way of the unfaithful is hard .

verses.z: 凡通達人都憑知識行事；愚昧人張揚自己的愚昧。
verses.e: Every prudent man acts from knowledge , but a fool exposes folly .

verses.z: 奸惡的使者必陷在禍患裏；忠信的使臣乃醫人的良藥。
verses.e: A wicked messenger falls into trouble , but a trustworthy envoy gains healing .

verses.z: 棄絕管教的，[必致]貧受辱；領受責備的，必得尊榮。
verses.e: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline , but he who heeds correction shall be honored .

verses.z: 所欲的成就，心覺甘甜；遠離惡事，為愚昧人所憎惡。
verses.e: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul , but fools detest turning from evil .

verses.z: 人因口所結的果子，必享美福；奸詐人[必遭]強暴。
verses.e: By the fruit of his lips , a man enjoys good things , but the unfaithful crave violence .

verses.z: 與智慧人同行的，必得智慧；和愚昧人作伴的，必受虧損。
verses.e: One who walks with wise men grows wise , but a companion of fools suffers harm .

verses.z: 禍患追趕罪人；義人必得善報。
verses.e: Misfortune pursues sinners , but prosperity rewards the righteous .

verses.z: 善人給子孫遺留產業；罪人為義人積存資財。
verses.e: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children , but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous .

verses.z: 窮人耕種多得糧食，但因不義，有消滅的。
verses.e: An abundance of food is in poor people's fields , but injustice sweeps it away .

verses.z: 不忍用杖打兒子的，是恨惡他；疼愛兒子的，隨時管教。
verses.e: One who spares the rod hates his son , but one who loves him is careful to discipline him .

verses.z: 義人吃得飽足；惡人肚腹缺糧。
verses.e: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul , but the belly of the wicked goes hungry .

verses.z: 謹守口的，得保生命；大張嘴的，必致敗亡。
verses.e: He who guards his mouth guards his soul . One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin .

verses.z: 懶惰人羨慕，卻無所得；殷勤人必得豐裕。
verses.e: The soul of the sluggard desires , and has nothing , but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied .

verses.z: 義人恨惡謊言；惡人有臭名，且致慚愧。
verses.e: A righteous man hates lies , but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace .

verses.z: 行為正直的，有公義保守；犯罪的，被邪惡傾覆。
verses.e: Righteousness guards the way of integrity , but wickedness overthrows the sinner .

verses.z: 假作富足的，卻一無所有；裝作窮乏的，卻廣有財物。
verses.e: There are some who pretend to be rich , yet have nothing . There are some who pretend to be poor , yet have great wealth .

verses.z: 人的資財是他生命的贖價；窮乏人卻聽不見威嚇的話。
verses.e: The ransom of a man's life is his riches , but the poor hear no threats .

verses.z: 義人的光明亮；惡人的燈要熄滅。
verses.e: The light of the righteous shines brightly , but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out .

verses.z: 智慧婦人建立家室；愚妄婦人親手拆毀。
verses.e: Every wise woman builds her house , but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands .

verses.z: 心中的苦楚，自己知道；心裏的喜樂，外人無干。
verses.e: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy ; he will not share these with a stranger .

verses.z: 奸惡人的房屋必傾倒；正直人的帳棚必興盛。
verses.e: The house of the wicked will be overthrown , but the tent of the upright will flourish .

verses.z: 有一條路，人以為正，至終成為死亡之路。
verses.e: There is a way which seems right to a man , but in the end it leads to death .

verses.z: 人在喜笑中，心也憂愁；快樂至極就生愁苦。
verses.e: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful , and mirth may end in heaviness .

verses.z: 心中背道的，必滿得自己的結果；善人必從自己[的行為得以知足]。
verses.e: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways ; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways .

verses.z: 愚蒙人是話都信；通達人步步謹慎。
verses.e: A simple man believes everything , but the prudent man carefully considers his ways .

verses.z: 智慧人懼怕，就遠離惡事；愚妄人卻狂傲自恃。
verses.e: A wise man fears and shuns evil , but the fool is hot headed and reckless .

verses.z: 輕易發怒的，行事愚妄；設立詭計的，被人恨惡。
verses.e: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly , and a crafty man is hated .

verses.z: 愚蒙人得愚昧為產業；通達人得知識為冠冕。
verses.e: The simple inherit folly , but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .

verses.z: 壞人俯伏在善人面前；惡人俯伏在義人門口。
verses.e: The evil bow down before the good , and the wicked at the gates of the righteous .

verses.z: 行動正直的，敬畏耶和華；行事乖僻的，卻藐視他。
verses.e: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD , but he who is perverse in his ways despises him .

verses.z: 貧窮人連鄰舍也恨他；富足人朋友最多。
verses.e: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor , but the rich person has many friends .

verses.z: 藐視鄰舍的，這人有罪；憐憫貧窮的，這人有福。
verses.e: He who despises his neighbor sins , but he who has pity on the poor is blessed .

verses.z: 謀惡的，豈非走入迷途嗎？謀善的，[必得]慈愛和誠實。
