verses.e: Don't they go astray who plot evil ? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good .

verses.z: 諸般勤勞都有益處；嘴上多言乃致窮乏。
verses.e: In all hard work there is profit , but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty .

verses.z: 智慧人的財為自己的冠冕；愚妄人的愚昧終是愚昧。
verses.e: The crown of the wise is their riches , but the folly of fools crowns them with folly .

verses.z: 作真見證的，救人性命；吐出謊言的，[施行]詭詐。
verses.e: A truthful witness saves souls , but a false witness is deceitful .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華的，大有倚靠；他的兒女也有避難所。
verses.e: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress , and he will be a refuge for his children .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華就是生命的泉源，可以使人離開死亡的網羅。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life , turning people from the snares of death .

verses.z: 帝王榮耀在乎民多；君王衰敗在乎民少。
verses.e: In the multitude of people is the king's glory , but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince .

verses.z: 不輕易發怒的，大有聰明；性情暴躁的，大顯愚妄。
verses.e: He who is slow to anger has great understanding , but he who has a quick temper displays folly .

verses.z: 愚妄人口中驕傲，如杖責打己身；智慧人的嘴必保守自己。
verses.e: The fool's talk brings a rod to his back , but the lips of the wise protect them .

verses.z: 心中安靜是肉體的生命；嫉妒是骨中的朽爛。
verses.e: The life of the body is a heart at peace , but envy rots the bones .

verses.z: 欺壓貧寒的，是辱沒造他的主；憐憫窮乏的，乃是尊敬主。
verses.e: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker , but he who is kind to the needy honors him .

verses.z: 惡人在所行的惡上必被推倒；義人臨死，有所投靠。
verses.e: The wicked is brought down in his calamity , but in death , the righteous has a refuge .

verses.z: 智慧存在聰明人心中；愚昧人心裏所存的，顯而易見。
verses.e: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding , and is even made known in the inward part of fools .

verses.z: 公義使邦國高舉；罪惡是人民的羞辱。
verses.e: Righteousness exalts a nation , but sin is a disgrace to any people .

verses.z: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠；貽羞的僕人遭其震怒。
verses.e: The king's favor is toward a servant who deals wisely , but his wrath is toward one who causes shame .

verses.z: 家裏無牛，槽頭乾淨；土產加多乃憑牛力。
verses.e: Where no oxen are , the crib is clean , but much increase is by the strength of the ox .

verses.z: 誠實見證人不說謊話；假見證人吐出謊言。
verses.e: A truthful witness will not lie , but a false witness pours out lies .

verses.z: 褻慢人尋智慧，卻尋不着；聰明人易得知識。
verses.e: A scoffer seeks wisdom , and doesn't find it , but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person .

verses.z: 到愚昧人面前，不見他嘴中有知識。
verses.e: Stay away from a foolish man , for you won't find knowledge on his lips .

verses.z: 通達人的智慧在乎明白己道；愚昧人的愚妄乃是詭詐。
verses.e: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way , but the folly of fools is deceit .

verses.z: 愚妄人犯罪，以為戲耍；正直人互相喜悅。
verses.e: Fools mock at making atonement for sins , but among the upright there is good will .

verses.z: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言語暴戾，觸動怒氣。
verses.e: A gentle answer turns away wrath , but a harsh word stirs up anger .

verses.z: 捨棄正路的，必受嚴刑；恨惡責備的，必致死亡。
verses.e: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way . Whoever hates reproof shall die .

verses.z: 陰間和滅亡尚在耶和華眼前，何況世人的心呢？
verses.e: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD — how much more then the hearts of the children of men !

verses.z: 褻慢人不愛受責備；他也不就近智慧人。
verses.e: A scoffer doesn't love to be reproved ; he will not go to the wise .

verses.z: 心中喜樂，面帶笑容；心裏憂愁，靈被損傷。
verses.e: A glad heart makes a cheerful face , but an aching heart breaks the spirit .

verses.z: 聰明人心求知識；愚昧人口吃愚昧。
verses.e: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge , but the mouths of fools feed on folly .

verses.z: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦；心中歡暢的，常享豐筵。
verses.e: All the days of the afflicted are wretched , but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast .

verses.z: 少有財寶，敬畏耶和華，強如多有財寶，煩亂不安。
verses.e: Better is little , with the fear of the LORD , than great treasure with trouble .

verses.z: 吃素菜，彼此相愛，強如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
verses.e: Better is a dinner of herbs , where love is , than a fattened calf with hatred .

verses.z: 暴怒的人挑啟爭端；忍怒的人止息紛爭。
verses.e: A wrathful man stirs up contention , but one who is slow to anger appeases strife .

verses.z: 懶惰人的道像荊棘的籬笆；正直人的路是平坦的大道。
verses.e: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch , but the path of the upright is a highway .

verses.z: 智慧人的舌善發知識；愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
verses.e: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge , but the mouths of fools gush out folly .

verses.z: 智慧子使父親喜樂；愚昧人藐視母親。
verses.e: A wise son makes a father glad , but a foolish man despises his mother .

verses.z: 無知的人以愚妄為樂；聰明的人按正直而行。
verses.e: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom , but a man of understanding keeps his way straight .

verses.z: 不先商議，所謀無效；謀士眾多，所謀乃成。
verses.e: Where there is no counsel , plans fail ; but in a multitude of counselors they are established .

verses.z: 口善應對，自覺喜樂；話合其時，何等美好。
verses.e: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth . How good is a word at the right time !

verses.z: 智慧人從生命的道上升，使他遠離在下的陰間。
verses.e: The path of life leads upward for the wise , to keep him from going downward to Sheol .

verses.z: 耶和華必拆毀驕傲人的家，卻要立定寡婦的地界。
verses.e: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud , but he will keep the widow's borders intact .

verses.z: 惡謀為耶和華所憎惡；良言乃為純淨。
verses.e: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked , but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing .

verses.z: 貪戀財利的，擾害己家；恨惡賄賂的，必得存活。
verses.e: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house , but he who hates bribes will live .

verses.z: 義人的心，思量如何回答；惡人的口吐出惡言。
verses.e: The heart of the righteous weighs answers , but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil .

verses.z: 耶和華遠離惡人，卻聽義人的禱告。
verses.e: The LORD is far from the wicked , but he hears the prayer of the righteous .

verses.z: 耶和華的眼目無處不在；惡人善人，他都鑒察。
verses.e: The LORD's eyes are everywhere , keeping watch on the evil and the good .

verses.z: 眼有光，使心喜樂；好信息，使骨滋潤。
verses.e: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart . Good news gives health to the bones .

verses.z: 聽從生命責備的，必常在智慧人中。
verses.e: The ear that listens to reproof lives , and will be at home among the wise .

verses.z: 棄絕管教的，輕看自己的生命；聽從責備的，卻得智慧。
verses.e: He who refuses correction despises his own soul , but he who listens to reproof gets understanding .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的訓誨；尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom . Before honor is humility .

verses.z: 溫良的舌是生命樹；乖謬的嘴使人心碎。
verses.e: A gentle tongue is a tree of life , but deceit in it crushes the spirit .

verses.z: 愚妄人藐視父親的管教；領受責備的，得着見識。
verses.e: A fool despises his father's correction , but he who heeds reproof shows prudence .

verses.z: 義人家中多有財寶；惡人得利反受擾害。
verses.e: In the house of the righteous is much treasure , but the income of the wicked brings trouble .

verses.z: 智慧人的嘴播揚知識；愚昧人的心並不如此。
verses.e: The lips of the wise spread knowledge ; not so with the heart of fools .

verses.z: 惡人獻祭，為耶和華所憎惡；正直人祈禱，為他所喜悅。
verses.e: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD , but the prayer of the upright is his delight .

verses.z: 惡人的道路，為耶和華所憎惡；追求公義的，為他所喜愛。
verses.e: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD , but he loves him who follows after righteousness .

verses.z: 心中的謀算在乎人；舌頭的應對由於耶和華。
verses.e: The plans of the heart belong to man , but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD .

verses.z: 王的嘴中有神語，審判之時，他的口必不差錯。
verses.e: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king . He shall not betray his mouth .

verses.z: 公道的天平和秤都屬耶和華；囊中一切法碼都為他所定。
verses.e: Honest balances and scales are the LORD's ; all the weights in the bag are his work .

verses.z: 作惡，為王所憎惡，因國位是靠公義堅立。
verses.e: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong , for the throne is established by righteousness .

verses.z: 公義的嘴為王所喜悅；說正直話的，為王所喜愛。
verses.e: Righteous lips are the delight of kings . They value one who speaks the truth .

verses.z: 王的震怒如殺人的使者；但智慧人能止息王怒。
verses.e: The king's wrath is a messenger of death , but a wise man will pacify it .

verses.z: 王的臉光使人有生命；王的恩典好像春雲時雨。
verses.e: In the light of the king's face is life . His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain .

verses.z: 得智慧勝似得金子；選聰明強如選銀子。
verses.e: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold ! Yes , to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver .

verses.z: 正直人的道是遠離惡事；謹守己路的，是保全性命。
verses.e: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil . He who keeps his way preserves his soul .

verses.z: 驕傲在敗壞以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
verses.e: Pride goes before destruction , and an arrogant spirit before a fall .

verses.z: 心裏謙卑與窮乏人來往，強如將擄物與驕傲人同分。
verses.e: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor , than to divide the plunder with the proud .

verses.z: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看為清潔；惟有耶和華衡量人心。
verses.e: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes , but the LORD weighs the motives .

verses.z: 謹守訓言的，必得好處；倚靠耶和華的，便為有福。
verses.e: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity . Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed .

verses.z: 心中有智慧，必稱為通達人；嘴中的甜言，加增人的學問。
verses.e: The wise in heart shall be called prudent . Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction .

verses.z: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源；愚昧人必被愚昧懲治。
verses.e: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it , but the punishment of fools is their folly .

verses.z: 智慧人的心教訓他的口，又使他的嘴增長學問。
verses.e: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth , and adds learning to his lips .

verses.z: 良言[如同]蜂房，使心覺甘甜，使骨得醫治。
verses.e: Pleasant words are a honeycomb , sweet to the soul , and health to the bones .

verses.z: 有一條路，人以為正，至終成為死亡之路。
verses.e: There is a way which seems right to a man , but in the end it leads to death .

verses.z: 勞力人的胃口使他勞力，因為他的口腹催逼他。
verses.e: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him , for his mouth urges him on .

verses.z: 匪徒圖謀奸惡，嘴上彷彿有燒焦的火。
verses.e: A worthless man devises mischief . His speech is like a scorching fire .

verses.z: 乖僻人播散紛爭；傳舌的，離間密友。
verses.e: A perverse man stirs up strife . A whisperer separates close friends .

verses.z: 強暴人誘惑鄰舍，領他走不善之道。
verses.e: A man of violence entices his neighbor , and leads him in a way that is not good .

verses.z: 你所做的，要交託耶和華，你所謀的，就必成立。
verses.e: Commit your deeds to the LORD , and your plans shall succeed .

verses.z: 眼目緊合的，圖謀乖僻；嘴唇緊閉的，成就邪惡。
verses.e: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities , one who compresses his lips , is bent on evil .

verses.z: 白髮是榮耀的冠冕，在公義的道上必能得着。
verses.e: Gray hair is a crown of glory . It is attained by a life of righteousness .

verses.z: 不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士；治服己心的，強如取城。
verses.e: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty ; one who rules his spirit , than he who takes a city .

verses.z: 籤放在懷裏，定事由耶和華。
verses.e: The lot is cast into the lap , but its every decision is from the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華所造的，各適其用；就是惡人也為禍患的日子所造。
verses.e: The LORD has made everything for its own end — yes , even the wicked for the day of evil .

verses.z: 凡心裏驕傲的，為耶和華所憎惡；[雖然]連手，他必不免受罰。
verses.e: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD ; they shall certainly not be unpunished .

verses.z: 因憐憫誠實，罪孽得贖；敬畏耶和華的，遠離惡事。
verses.e: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for . By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil .

verses.z: 人所行的，若蒙耶和華喜悅，耶和華也使他的仇敵與他和好。
verses.e: When a man's ways please the LORD , he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him .

verses.z: 多有財利，行事不義，不如少有財利，行事公義。
verses.e: Better is a little with righteousness , than great revenues with injustice .

verses.z: 人心籌算自己的道路；惟耶和華指引他的腳步。
verses.e: A man's heart plans his course , but the LORD directs his steps .

verses.z: 設筵滿屋，大家相爭，不如有塊乾餅，大家相安。
verses.e: Better is a dry morsel with quietness , than a house full of feasting with strife .

verses.z: 一句責備話深入聰明人的心，強如責打愚昧人一百下。
verses.e: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool .

verses.z: 惡人只尋背叛，所以必有嚴厲的使者奉差攻擊他。
verses.e: An evil man seeks only rebellion ; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him .

verses.z: 寧可遇見丟崽子的母熊，不可遇見正行愚妄的愚昧人。
verses.e: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man , rather than a fool in his folly .

verses.z: 以惡報善的，禍患必不離他的家。
verses.e: Whoever rewards evil for good , evil shall not depart from his house .

verses.z: 紛爭的起頭[如]水放開，所以，在爭鬧之先必當止息爭競。
verses.e: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam , therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out .

verses.z: 定惡人為義的，定義人為惡的，這都為耶和華所憎惡。
verses.e: He who justifies the wicked , and he who condemns the righteous , both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD .

verses.z: 愚昧人既無聰明，為何手拿價銀買智慧呢？
verses.e: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom , since he has no understanding ?

verses.z: 朋友乃時常親愛，弟兄為患難而生。
verses.e: A friend loves at all times ; and a brother is born for adversity .

verses.z: 在鄰舍面前擊掌作保乃是無知的人。
verses.e: A man void of understanding strikes hands , and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor .

verses.z: 喜愛爭競的，是喜愛過犯；高立家門的，乃自取敗壞。
verses.e: He who loves disobedience loves strife . One who builds a high gate seeks destruction .

verses.z: 僕人辦事聰明，必管轄貽羞之子，又在眾子中同分產業。
verses.e: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame , and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers .

verses.z: 心存邪僻的，尋不着好處；舌弄是非的，陷在禍患中。
verses.e: One who has a perverse heart doesn't find prosperity , and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble .

verses.z: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦；愚頑人的父毫無喜樂。
verses.e: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves . The father of a fool has no joy .

verses.z: 喜樂的心乃是良藥；憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。
verses.e: A cheerful heart makes good medicine , but a crushed spirit dries up the bones .

verses.z: 惡人暗中受賄賂，為要顛倒判斷。
verses.e: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret , to pervert the ways of justice .

verses.z: 明哲人眼前有智慧；愚昧人眼望地極。
verses.e: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding , but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth .

verses.z: 愚昧子使父親愁煩，使母親憂苦。
verses.e: A foolish son brings grief to his father , and bitterness to her who bore him .

verses.z: 刑罰義人為不善；責打君子為不義。
verses.e: Also to punish the righteous is not good , nor to flog officials for their integrity .

verses.z: 寡少言語的，有知識；性情溫良的，有聰明。
verses.e: He who spares his words has knowledge . He who is even tempered is a man of understanding .

verses.z: 愚昧人若靜默不言也可算為智慧；閉口不說也可算為聰明。
verses.e: Even a fool , when he keeps silent , is counted wise . When he shuts his lips , he is thought to be discerning .

verses.z: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金；惟有耶和華熬煉人心。
verses.e: The refining pot is for silver , and the furnace for gold , but the LORD tests the hearts .

verses.z: 行惡的，留心聽奸詐之言；說謊的，側耳聽邪惡之語。
verses.e: An evildoer heeds wicked lips . A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue .

verses.z: 戲笑窮人的，是辱沒造他的主；幸災樂禍的，必不免受罰。
verses.e: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker . He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished .

verses.z: 子孫為老人的冠冕；父親是兒女的榮耀。
verses.e: Children's children are the crown of old men ; the glory of children is their parents .

verses.z: 愚頑人說美言本不相宜，何況君王說謊話呢？
verses.e: Excellent speech isn't fitting for a fool , much less do lying lips fit a prince .

verses.z: 賄賂在餽送的人眼中看為寶玉，隨處運動都得順利。
verses.e: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it ; wherever he turns , he prospers .

verses.z: 遮掩人過的，尋求人愛；屢次挑錯的，離間密友。
verses.e: He who covers an offense promotes love ; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends .

verses.z: 與眾寡合的，獨自尋求心願，並惱恨一切真智慧。
verses.e: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness , and defies all sound judgment .

verses.z: 耶和華的名是堅固臺；義人奔入便得安穩。
verses.e: The LORD's name is a strong tower : the righteous run to him , and are safe .

verses.z: 富足人的財物是他的堅城，在他心想，猶如高牆。
verses.e: The rich man's wealth is his strong city , like an unscalable wall in his own imagination .

verses.z: 敗壞之先，人心驕傲；尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
verses.e: Before destruction the heart of man is proud , but before honor is humility .

verses.z: 未曾聽完先回答的，便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
verses.e: He who answers before he hears , that is folly and shame to him .

verses.z: 人有疾病，心能忍耐；心靈憂傷，誰能承當呢？
verses.e: A man's spirit will sustain him in sickness , but a crushed spirit , who can bear ?

verses.z: 聰明人的心得知識；智慧人的耳求知識。
verses.e: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge . The ear of the wise seeks knowledge .

verses.z: 人的禮物為他開路，引他到高位的人面前。
verses.e: A man's gift makes room for him , and brings him before great men .

verses.z: 先訴情由的，似乎有理；但鄰舍來到，就察出實情。
verses.e: He who pleads his cause first seems right — until another comes and questions him .

verses.z: 掣籤能止息爭競，也能解散強勝的人。
verses.e: The lot settles disputes , and keeps strong ones apart .

verses.z: 弟兄結怨，[勸他和好]，比取堅固城還難；[這樣的]爭競如同堅寨的門閂。
verses.e: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city . Disputes are like the bars of a fortress .

verses.z: 愚昧人不喜愛明哲，只喜愛顯露心意。
verses.e: A fool has no delight in understanding , but only in revealing his own opinion .

verses.z: 人口中所結的果子，必充滿肚腹；他嘴所出的，必使他飽足。
verses.e: A man's stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth . With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied .

verses.z: 生死在舌頭的權下，喜愛它的，必吃它所結的果子。
verses.e: Death and life are in the power of the tongue ; those who love it will eat its fruit .

verses.z: 得着[賢]妻的，是得着好處，也是蒙了耶和華的恩惠。
verses.e: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing , and obtains favor of the LORD .

verses.z: 貧窮人說哀求的話；富足人用威嚇的話回答。
verses.e: The poor plead for mercy , but the rich answer harshly .

verses.z: 濫交朋友的，自取敗壞；但有一朋友比弟兄更親密。
verses.e: A man of many companions may be ruined , but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother .

verses.z: 惡人來，藐視隨來；羞恥到，辱罵同到。
verses.e: When wickedness comes , contempt also comes , and with shame comes disgrace .

verses.z: 人口中的言語如同深水；智慧的泉源好像湧流的河水。
verses.e: The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters . The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook .

verses.z: 瞻徇惡人的情面，偏斷義人的案件，都為不善。
verses.e: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good , nor to deprive the innocent of justice .

verses.z: 愚昧人張嘴啟爭端，開口招鞭打。
verses.e: A fool's lips come into strife , and his mouth invites beatings .

verses.z: 愚昧人的口自取敗壞；他的嘴是他生命的網羅。
verses.e: A fool's mouth is his destruction , and his lips are a snare to his soul .

verses.z: 傳舌人的言語如同美食，深入人的心腹。
verses.e: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels : they go down into a person's innermost parts .

verses.z: 做工懈怠的，與浪費人為弟兄。
verses.e: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction .

verses.z: 行為純正的貧窮人勝過乖謬愚妄的[富足]人。
verses.e: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool .

verses.z: 愚昧人宴樂度日是不合宜的；何況僕人管轄王子呢？
verses.e: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool , much less for a servant to have rule over princes .

verses.z: 人有見識就不輕易發怒；寬恕人的過失便是自己的榮耀。
verses.e: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger . It is his glory to overlook an offense .

verses.z: 王的忿怒好像獅子吼叫；他的恩典卻如草上的甘露。
verses.e: The king's wrath is like the roaring of a lion , but his favor is like dew on the grass .

verses.z: 愚昧的兒子是父親的禍患；妻子的爭吵[如雨]連連滴漏。
verses.e: A foolish son is the calamity of his father . A wife's quarrels are a continual dripping .

verses.z: 房屋錢財是祖宗所遺留的；惟有賢慧的妻是耶和華所賜的。
verses.e: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers , but a prudent wife is from the LORD .

verses.z: 懶惰使人沉睡；懈怠的人必受飢餓。
verses.e: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep . The idle soul shall suffer hunger .

verses.z: 謹守誡命的，保全生命；輕忽己路的，必致死亡。
verses.e: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul , but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die .

verses.z: 憐憫貧窮的，就是借給耶和華；他的善行，耶和華必償還。
verses.e: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD ; he will reward him .

verses.z: 趁有指望，管教你的兒子；你的心不可任他死亡。
verses.e: Discipline your son , for there is hope ; don't be a willing party to his death .

verses.z: 暴怒的人必受刑罰；你若救他，必須再救。
verses.e: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty , for if you rescue him , you must do it again .

verses.z: 心無知識的，乃為不善；腳步急快的，難免犯罪。
verses.e: It isn't good to have zeal without knowledge , nor to be hasty with one's feet and miss the way .

verses.z: 你要聽勸教，受訓誨，使你終久有智慧。
verses.e: Listen to counsel and receive instruction , that you may be wise in your latter end .

verses.z: 人心多有計謀；惟有耶和華的籌算才能立定。
verses.e: There are many plans in a man's heart , but the LORD's counsel will prevail .

verses.z: 施行仁慈的，令人愛慕；窮人強如說謊言的。
verses.e: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness . A poor man is better than a liar .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華的，[得着]生命；他必恆久知足，不遭禍患。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD leads to life , then contentment ; he rests and will not be touched by trouble .

verses.z: 懶惰人放手在盤子裏，就是向口撤回，他也不肯。
verses.e: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish ; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again .

verses.z: 鞭打褻慢人，愚蒙人必長見識；責備明哲人，他就明白知識。
verses.e: Flog a scoffer , and the simple will learn prudence ; rebuke one who has understanding , and he will gain knowledge .

verses.z: 虐待父親、攆出母親的，是貽羞致辱之子。
verses.e: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach .

verses.z: 我兒，不可聽了教訓而又偏離知識的言語。
verses.e: If you stop listening to instruction , my son , you will stray from the words of knowledge .

verses.z: 匪徒作見證戲笑公平；惡人的口吞下罪孽。
verses.e: A corrupt witness mocks justice , and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity .

verses.z: 刑罰是為褻慢人預備的；鞭打是為愚昧人的背預備的。
verses.e: Penalties are prepared for scoffers , and beatings for the backs of fools .

verses.z: 人的愚昧傾敗他的道；他的心也抱怨耶和華。
verses.e: The foolishness of man subverts his way ; his heart rages against the LORD .

verses.z: 財物使朋友增多；但窮人朋友遠離。
verses.e: Wealth adds many friends , but the poor is separated from his friend .

verses.z: 作假見證的，必不免受罰；吐出謊言的，終不能逃脫。
verses.e: A false witness shall not be unpunished . He who pours out lies shall not go free .

verses.z: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情；愛送禮的，人都為他的朋友。
verses.e: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler , and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts .

verses.z: 貧窮人，弟兄都恨他；何況他的朋友，更遠離他！他用言語追隨，他們卻走了。
verses.e: All the relatives of the poor shun him ; how much more do his friends avoid him ! He pursues them with pleas , but they are gone .

verses.z: 得着智慧的，愛惜生命；保守聰明的，必得好處。
verses.e: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul . He who keeps understanding shall find good .

verses.z: 作假見證的，不免受罰；吐出謊言的，也必滅亡。
verses.e: A false witness shall not be unpunished . He who utters lies shall perish .

verses.z: 我兒，你若領受我的言語，存記我的命令，
verses.e: My son , if you will receive my words , and store up my commandments within you ,

verses.z: 智慧必入你心；你的靈要以知識為美。
verses.e: For wisdom will enter into your heart . Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul .

verses.z: 謀略必護衛你；聰明必保守你，
verses.e: Discretion will watch over you . Understanding will keep you ,

verses.z: 要救你脫離惡道，脫離說乖謬話的人。
verses.e: to deliver you from the way of evil , from the men who speak perverse things ,

verses.z: 那等人捨棄正直的路，行走黑暗的道，
verses.e: who forsake the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness ,

verses.z: 歡喜作惡，喜愛惡[人]的乖僻，
verses.e: who rejoice to do evil , and delight in the perverseness of evil ,

verses.z: 在他們的道中彎曲，在他們的路上偏僻。
verses.e: who are crooked in their ways , and wayward in their paths ,

verses.z: 智[慧]要救你脫離淫婦，就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。
verses.e: to deliver you from the strange woman , even from the foreigner who flatters with her words ,

verses.z: 她離棄幼年的配偶，忘了上帝的盟約。
verses.e: who forsakes the friend of her youth , and forgets the covenant of her God ;

verses.z: 她的家陷入死地；她的路偏向陰間。
verses.e: for her house leads down to death , her paths to the departed spirits .

verses.z: 凡到她那裏去的，不得轉回，也得不着生命的路。
verses.e: None who go to her return again , neither do they attain to the paths of life .

verses.z: 側耳聽智慧，專心求聰明，
verses.e: so as to turn your ear to wisdom , and apply your heart to understanding ;

verses.z: [智慧]必使你行善人的道，守義人的路。
verses.e: Therefore walk in the way of good men , and keep the paths of the righteous .

verses.z: 正直人必在世上居住；完全人必在地上存留。
verses.e: For the upright will dwell in the land . The perfect will remain in it .

verses.z: 惟有惡人必然剪除；奸詐的，必然拔出。
verses.e: But the wicked will be cut off from the land . The treacherous will be rooted out of it .

verses.z: 呼求明哲，揚聲求聰明，
verses.e: yes , if you call out for discernment , and lift up your voice for understanding ;

verses.z: 尋找它，如尋找銀子，搜求它，如搜求隱藏的珍寶，
verses.e: if you seek her as silver , and search for her as for hidden treasures ;

verses.z: 你就明白敬畏耶和華，得以認識上帝。
verses.e: then you will understand the fear of the LORD , and find the knowledge of God .

verses.z: 因為，耶和華賜人智慧；知識和聰明都由他口而出。
verses.e: For the LORD gives wisdom . Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding .

verses.z: 他給正直人存留真智慧，給行為純正的人作盾牌，
verses.e: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright . He is a shield to those who walk in integrity ,

verses.z: 為要保守公平人的路，護庇虔敬人的道。
verses.e: that he may guard the paths of justice , and preserve the way of his saints .

verses.z: 你也必明白仁義、公平、正直、一切的善道。
verses.e: Then you will understand righteousness and justice , equity and every good path .

verses.z: 酒能使人褻慢，濃酒使人喧嚷；凡因酒錯誤的，就無智慧。
verses.e: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler . Whoever is led astray by them is not wise .

verses.z: 兩樣的法碼，兩樣的升斗，都為耶和華所憎惡。
verses.e: Differing weights and differing measures , both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD .

verses.z: 孩童的動作是清潔，是正直，都顯明他的本性。
verses.e: Even a child makes himself known by his doings , whether his work is pure , and whether it is right .

verses.z: 能聽的耳，能看的眼，都是耶和華所造的。
verses.e: The hearing ear , and the seeing eye , the LORD has made even both of them .

verses.z: 不要貪睡，免致貧窮；眼要睜開，你就吃飽。
verses.e: Don't love sleep , lest you come to poverty . Open your eyes , and you shall be satisfied with bread .

verses.z: 買物的說：不好，不好；及至[買]去，他便自誇。
verses.e: " It's no good , it's no good , " says the buyer ; but when he is gone his way , then he boasts .

verses.z: 有金子和許多珍珠，惟有知識的嘴乃為貴重的珍寶。
verses.e: There is gold and abundance of rubies , but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel .

verses.z: 誰為生人作保，就拿誰的衣服；誰為外人[作保]，誰就要承當。
verses.e: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger ; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman .

verses.z: 以虛謊而得的食物，人覺甘甜；但後來，他的口必充滿塵沙。
verses.e: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man , but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel .

verses.z: 計謀都憑籌算立定；打仗要憑智謀。
verses.e: Plans are established by advice ; by wise guidance you wage war !

verses.z: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事；大張嘴的，不可與他結交。
verses.e: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets ; therefore don't keep company with him who opens wide his lips .

verses.z: 王的威嚇如同獅子吼叫；惹動他怒的，是自害己命。
verses.e: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion . He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life .

verses.z: 咒罵父母的，他的燈必滅，變為漆黑的黑暗。
verses.e: Whoever curses his father or his mother , his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness .

verses.z: 起初速得的產業，終久卻不為福。
verses.e: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won't be blessed in the end .

verses.z: 你不要說，我要以惡報惡；要等候耶和華，他必拯救你。
verses.e: Don't say , " I will pay back evil . " Wait for the LORD , and he will save you .

verses.z: 兩樣的法碼為耶和華所憎惡；詭詐的天平也為不善。
verses.e: The LORD detests differing weights , and dishonest scales are not pleasing .

verses.z: 人的腳步為耶和華所定；人豈能明白自己的路呢？
verses.e: A man's steps are from the LORD ; how then can man understand his way ?

verses.z: 人冒失說，[這是]聖物，許願之後才查問，就是自陷網羅。
verses.e: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication , then later to consider his vows .

verses.z: 智慧的王簸散惡人，用碌碡滾軋他們。
verses.e: A wise king winnows out the wicked , and drives the threshing wheel over them .

verses.z: 人的靈是耶和華的燈，鑒察人的心腹。
verses.e: The spirit of man is the LORD's lamp , searching all his innermost parts .

verses.z: 王因仁慈和誠實得以保全他的國位，也因仁慈立穩。
verses.e: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe . His throne is sustained by love .

verses.z: 強壯乃少年人的榮耀；白髮為老年人的尊榮。
verses.e: The glory of young men is their strength . The splendor of old men is their gray hair .

verses.z: 遠離紛爭是人的尊榮；愚妄人都愛爭鬧。
verses.e: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife , but every fool will be quarreling .

verses.z: 鞭傷除淨人的罪惡；責打[能入]人的心腹。
verses.e: Wounding blows cleanse away evil , and beatings purge the innermost parts .

verses.z: 懶惰人因冬寒不肯耕種，到收割的時候，他必討飯而無所得。
verses.e: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter ; therefore he shall beg in harvest , and have nothing .

verses.z: 人心懷藏謀略，好像深水，惟明哲人才能汲引出來。
verses.e: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water , but a man of understanding will draw it out .

verses.z: 人多述說自己的仁慈，但忠信人誰能遇着呢？
verses.e: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love , but who can find a faithful man ?

verses.z: 行為純正的義人，他的子孫是有福的！
verses.e: A righteous man walks in integrity . Blessed are his children after him .

verses.z: 王坐在審判的位上，以眼目驅散諸惡。
verses.e: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes .

verses.z: 誰能說，我潔淨了我的心，我脫淨了我的罪？
verses.e: Who can say , " I have made my heart pure . I am clean and without sin " ?

verses.z: 王的心在耶和華手中，好像隴溝的水隨意流轉。
verses.e: The king's heart is in the LORD's hand like the watercourses . He turns it wherever he desires .

verses.z: 惡人的心樂人受禍；他眼並不憐恤鄰舍。
verses.e: The soul of the wicked desires evil ; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes .

verses.z: 褻慢的人受刑罰，愚蒙的人就得智慧；智慧人受訓誨，便得知識。
verses.e: When the mocker is punished , the simple gains wisdom . When the wise is instructed , he receives knowledge .

verses.z: 義人思想惡人的家，知道惡人傾倒，必致滅亡。
verses.e: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked , and brings the wicked to ruin .

verses.z: 塞耳不聽窮人哀求的，他將來呼籲也不蒙應允。
verses.e: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor , he will also cry out , but shall not be heard .

verses.z: 暗中送的禮物挽回怒氣；懷中搋的賄賂止息暴怒。
verses.e: A gift in secret pacifies anger , and a bribe in the cloak , strong wrath .

verses.z: 秉公行義使義人喜樂，使作孽的人敗壞。
verses.e: It is joy to the righteous to do justice ; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity .

verses.z: 迷離通達道路的，必住在陰魂的會中。
verses.e: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits .

verses.z: 愛宴樂的，必致窮乏；好酒，愛膏油的，必不富足。
verses.e: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man . He who loves wine and oil won't be rich .

verses.z: 惡人作了義人的贖價；奸詐人代替正直人。
verses.e: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous , the treacherous for the upright .

verses.z: 寧可住在曠野，不與爭吵使氣的婦人同住。
verses.e: It is better to dwell in a desert land , than with a contentious and fretful woman .

verses.z: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看為正；惟有耶和華衡量人心。
verses.e: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes , but the LORD weighs the hearts .

verses.z: 智慧人家中[積蓄]寶物膏油；愚昧人隨得來隨吞下。
verses.e: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise , but a foolish man swallows it up .

verses.z: 追求公義仁慈的，就尋得生命、公義，和尊榮。
verses.e: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life , righteousness , and honor .

verses.z: 智慧人爬上勇士的城牆，傾覆他所倚靠的堅壘。
verses.e: A wise man scales the city of the mighty , and brings down the strength of its confidence .

verses.z: 謹守口與舌的，就保守自己免受災難。
verses.e: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles .

verses.z: 心驕氣傲的人名叫褻慢；他行事狂妄，都出於驕傲。
verses.e: The proud and arrogant man — " Scoffer " is his name — he works in the arrogance of pride .

verses.z: 懶惰人的心願將他殺害，因為他手不肯做工。
verses.e: The desire of the sluggard kills him , for his hands refuse to labor .

verses.z: 有終日貪得無饜的；義人施捨而不吝惜。
verses.e: There are those who covet greedily all day long ; but the righteous give and don't withhold .

verses.z: 惡人的祭物是可憎的；何況他存惡意來獻呢？
verses.e: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination — how much more , when he brings it with a wicked mind !

verses.z: 作假見證的必滅亡；惟有聽真情而言的，其言長存。
verses.e: A false witness will perish . A man who listens speaks to eternity .

verses.z: 惡人臉無羞恥；正直人行事堅定。
verses.e: A wicked man hardens his face ; but as for the upright , he establishes his ways .

verses.z: 行仁義公平比獻祭更蒙耶和華悅納。
verses.e: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice .

verses.z: 沒有人能以智慧、聰明、謀略敵擋耶和華。
verses.e: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD .

verses.z: 馬是為打仗之日預備的；得勝乃在乎耶和華。
verses.e: The horse is prepared for the day of battle ; but victory is with the LORD .

verses.z: 惡人發達，眼高心傲，這乃是罪。
verses.e: A high look and a proud heart , the lamp of the wicked , is sin .

verses.z: 殷勤籌劃的，足致豐裕；行事急躁的，都必缺乏。
verses.e: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit ; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty .

verses.z: 用詭詐之舌求財的，就是自己取死；所得之財乃是吹來吹去的浮雲。
verses.e: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death .

verses.z: 惡人的強暴必將自己掃除，因他們不肯按公平行事。
verses.e: The violence of the wicked will drive them away , because they refuse to do what is right .

verses.z: 負罪之人的路甚是彎曲；至於清潔的人，他所行的乃是正直。
verses.e: The way of the guilty is devious , but the conduct of the innocent is upright .

verses.z: 寧可住在房頂的角上，不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。
verses.e: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman .

verses.z: 美名勝過大財；恩寵強如金銀。
verses.e: A good name is more desirable than great riches , and loving favor is better than silver and gold .

verses.z: 趕出褻慢人，爭端就消除；紛爭和羞辱也必止息。
verses.e: Drive out the mocker , and strife will go out ; yes , quarrels and insults will stop .

verses.z: 喜愛清心的人因他嘴上的恩言，王必與他為友。
verses.e: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king's friend .

verses.z: 耶和華的眼目眷顧聰明人，卻傾敗奸詐人的言語。
verses.e: The LORD's eyes watch over knowledge , but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful .

verses.z: 懶惰人說：外頭有獅子；我在街上就必被殺。
verses.e: The sluggard says , " There is a lion outside ! I will be killed in the streets ! "

verses.z: 淫婦的口為深坑；耶和華所憎惡的，必陷在其中。
verses.e: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit . He who is under the LORD's wrath will fall into it .

verses.z: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心，用管教的杖可以遠遠趕除。
verses.e: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child ; the rod of discipline drives it far from him .

verses.z: 欺壓貧窮為要利己的，並送[禮]與富戶的，都必缺乏。
verses.e: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich , both come to poverty .

verses.z: 你須側耳聽受智慧人的言語，留心領會我的知識。
verses.e: Turn your ear , and listen to the words of the wise . Apply your heart to my teaching .

verses.z: 你若心中存記，嘴上咬定，這便為美。
verses.e: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you , if all of them are ready on your lips .

verses.z: 我今日以此特特指教你，為要使你倚靠耶和華。
verses.e: I teach you today , even you , so that your trust may be in the LORD .

verses.z: 富戶窮人在世相遇，都為耶和華所造。
verses.e: The rich and the poor have this in common : The LORD is the maker of them all .

verses.z: 謀略和知識的美事，我豈沒有寫給你嗎？
verses.e: Haven't I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge ,

verses.z: 要使你知道真言的實理，你好將真言回覆那打發你來的人。
verses.e: To teach you truth , reliable words , to give sound answers to the ones who sent you ?

verses.z: 貧窮人，你不可因他貧窮就搶奪他的物，也不可在城門口欺壓困苦人；
verses.e: Don't exploit the poor because he is poor ; and don't crush the needy in court ;

verses.z: 因耶和華必為他辨屈；搶奪他的，耶和華必奪取那人的命。
verses.e: for the LORD will plead their case , and plunder the life of those who plunder them .

verses.z: 好生氣的人，不可與他結交；暴怒的人，不可與他來往；
verses.e: Don't befriend a hot-tempered man . Don't associate with one who harbors anger ,

verses.z: 恐怕你效法他的行為，自己就陷在網羅裏。
verses.e: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul .

verses.z: 不要與人擊掌，不要為欠債的作保。
verses.e: Don't you be one of those who strike hands , of those who are collateral for debts .

verses.z: 你若沒有甚麼償還，何必使人奪去你睡臥的床呢？
verses.e: If you don't have means to pay , why should he take away your bed from under you ?

verses.z: 你先祖所立的地界，你不可挪移。
verses.e: Don't move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up .

verses.z: 你看見辦事殷勤的人嗎？他必站在君王面前，必不站在下賤人面前。
verses.e: Do you see a man skilled in his work ? He will serve kings . He won't serve obscure men .

verses.z: 通達人見禍藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
verses.e: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself ; but the simple pass on , and suffer for it .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華心存謙卑，就得富有、尊榮、生命為賞賜。
verses.e: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth , honor , and life .

verses.z: 乖僻人的路上有荊棘和網羅；保守自己生命的，必要遠離。
verses.e: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked ; whoever guards his soul stays far from them .

verses.z: 教養孩童，使他走當行的道，就是到老他也不偏離。
verses.e: Train up a child in the way he should go , and when he is old he will not depart from it .

verses.z: 富戶管轄窮人；欠債的是債主的僕人。
verses.e: The rich rule over the poor . The borrower is servant to the lender .

verses.z: 撒罪孽的，必收災禍；他逞怒的杖也必廢掉。
verses.e: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble , and the rod of his fury will be destroyed .

verses.z: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福，因他將食物分給窮人。
verses.e: He who has a generous eye will be blessed , for he shares his food with the poor .

verses.z: 你若與官長坐席，要留意在你面前的是誰。
verses.e: When you sit to eat with a ruler , consider diligently what is before you ;

verses.z: 不可挪移古時的地界，也不可侵入孤兒的田地；
verses.e: Don't move the ancient boundary stone . Don't encroach on the fields of the fatherless ,

verses.z: 因他們的救贖主大有能力，他必向你為他們辨屈。
verses.e: for their Defender is strong . He will plead their case against you .

verses.z: 你要留心領受訓誨，側耳聽從知識的言語。
verses.e: Apply your heart to instruction , and your ears to the words of knowledge .

verses.z: 不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，他必不至於死。
verses.e: Don't withhold correction from a child . If you punish him with the rod , he will not die .

verses.z: 你要用杖打他，就可以救他的靈魂免下陰間。
verses.e: Punish him with the rod , and save his soul from Sheol .

verses.z: 我兒，你心若存智慧，我的心也甚歡喜。
verses.e: My son , if your heart is wise , then my heart will be glad , even mine .

verses.z: 你的嘴若說正直話，我的心腸也必快樂。
verses.e: Yes , my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right .

verses.z: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人，只要終日敬畏耶和華；
verses.e: Don't let your heart envy sinners , but rather fear the LORD all day long .

verses.z: 因為至終必有善報，你的指望也不致斷絕。
verses.e: Indeed surely there is a future hope , and your hope will not be cut off .

verses.z: 我兒，你當聽，當存智慧，好在正道上引導你的心。
verses.e: Listen , my son , and be wise , and keep your heart on the right path !

verses.z: 你若是貪食的，就當拿刀放在喉嚨上。
verses.e: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite .

verses.z: 好飲酒的，好吃肉的，不要與他們來往；
verses.e: Don't be among ones drinking too much wine , or those who gorge themselves on meat ;

verses.z: 因為好酒貪食的，必致貧窮；好睡覺的，必穿破爛衣服。
verses.e: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor ; and drowsiness clothes them in rags .

verses.z: 你要聽從生你的父親；你母親老了，也不可藐視她。
verses.e: Listen to your father who gave you life , and don't despise your mother when she is old .

verses.z: 你當買真理；就是智慧、訓誨，和聰明也都不可賣。
verses.e: Buy the truth , and don't sell it . Get wisdom , discipline , and understanding .

verses.z: 義人的父親必大得快樂；人生智慧的兒子，必因他歡喜。
verses.e: The father of the righteous has great joy . Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him .

verses.z: 你要使父母歡喜，使生你的快樂。
verses.e: Let your father and your mother be glad ! Let her who bore you rejoice !

verses.z: 我兒，要將你的心歸我；你的眼目也要喜悅我的道路。
verses.e: My son , give me your heart ; and let your eyes keep in my ways .

verses.z: 妓女是深坑；外女是窄阱。
verses.e: For a prostitute is a deep pit ; and a wayward wife is a narrow well .

verses.z: 她埋伏好像強盜；她使人中多有奸詐的。
verses.e: Yes , she lies in wait like a robber , and increases the unfaithful among men .

verses.z: 誰有禍患？誰有憂愁？誰有爭鬥？誰有哀歎？誰無故受傷？誰眼目紅赤？
verses.e: Who has woe ? Who has sorrow ? Who has strife ? Who has complaints ? Who has needless bruises ? Who has bloodshot eyes ?

verses.z: 不可貪戀他的美食，因為是哄人的食物。
verses.e: Don't be desirous of his dainties , since they are deceitful food .

verses.z: 就是那流連飲酒、常去尋找調和酒的人。
verses.e: Those who stay long at the wine ; those who go to seek out mixed wine .

verses.z: 酒發紅，在杯中閃爍，你不可觀看，[雖然]下咽舒暢，終久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。
verses.e: Don't look at the wine when it is red , when it sparkles in the cup , when it goes down smoothly .
In the end , it bites like a snake , and poisons like a viper .

verses.z: 你眼必看見異怪的事；你心必發出乖謬的話。
verses.e: Your eyes will see strange things , and your mind will imagine confusing things .

verses.z: 你必像躺在海中，或像臥在桅杆上。
verses.e: Yes , you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea , or as he who lies on top of the rigging :

verses.z: [你必]說：人打我，我卻未受傷；人鞭打我，我竟不覺得。我幾時清醒，我仍去尋酒。
verses.e: " They hit me , and I was not hurt ! They beat me , and I don't feel it ! When will I wake up ? I can do it again . I will look for more . "

verses.z: 不要勞碌求富，休仗自己的聰明。
verses.e: Don't weary yourself to be rich . In your wisdom , show restraint .

verses.z: 你豈要定睛在虛無的[錢財]上嗎？因[錢財]必長翅膀，如鷹向天飛去。
verses.e: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not ? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky .

verses.z: 不要吃惡眼人的飯，也不要貪他的美味；
verses.e: Don't eat the food of him who has a stingy eye , and don't crave his delicacies ,

verses.z: 因為他心怎樣思量，他為人就是怎樣。他雖對你說，請吃，請喝，他的心卻與你相背。
verses.e: for as he thinks about the cost , so he is . " Eat and drink ! " he says to you , but his heart is not with you .

verses.z: 你所吃的那點食物必吐出來；你所說的甘美言語也必落空。
verses.e: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words .

verses.z: 你不要說話給愚昧人聽，因他必藐視你智慧的言語。
verses.e: Don't speak in the ears of a fool , for he will despise the wisdom of your words .

verses.z: 你不要嫉妒惡人，也不要起意與他們相處；
verses.e: Don't be envious of evil men , neither desire to be with them ;

verses.z: 你在患難之日若膽怯，你的力量就微小。
verses.e: If you falter in the time of trouble , your strength is small .

verses.z: 人被拉到死地，你要解救；人將被殺，你須攔阻。
verses.e: Rescue those who are being led away to death ! Indeed , hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter !

verses.z: 你若說：這事我未曾知道，那衡量人心的豈不明白嗎？保守你命的豈不知道嗎？他豈不按各人所行的報應各人嗎？
verses.e: If you say , " Behold , we didn't know this , " doesn't he who weighs the hearts consider it ? He who keeps your soul , doesn't he know it ? Shall he not give to every man according to his work ?

verses.z: 我兒，你要吃蜜，因為是好的；吃蜂房下滴的蜜便覺甘甜。
verses.e: My son , eat honey , for it is good , the droppings of the honeycomb , which are sweet to your taste ;

verses.z: 你心得了智慧，也必覺得如此。你若找着，至終必有善報；你的指望也不致斷絕。
verses.e: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul . If you have found it , then there will be a reward : Your hope will not be cut off .

verses.z: 你這惡人，不要埋伏攻擊義人的家；不要毀壞他安居之所。
verses.e: Don't lay in wait , wicked man , against the habitation of the righteous . Don't destroy his resting place ;

verses.z: 因為，義人雖七次跌倒，仍必興起；惡人卻被禍患傾倒。
verses.e: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again , but the wicked are overthrown by calamity .

verses.z: 你仇敵跌倒，你不要歡喜；他傾倒，你心不要快樂；
verses.e: Don't rejoice when your enemy falls . Don't let your heart be glad when he is overthrown ,

verses.z: 恐怕耶和華看見就不喜悅，將怒氣從仇敵身上轉過來。
verses.e: lest the LORD see it , and it displease him , and he turn away his wrath from him .

verses.z: 不要為作惡的心懷不平，也不要嫉妒惡人；
verses.e: Don't fret yourself because of evildoers , neither be envious of the wicked ;

verses.z: 因為，他們的心圖謀強暴，他們的口談論奸惡。
verses.e: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief .

verses.z: 因為，惡人終不得善報；惡人的燈也必熄滅。
verses.e: for there will be no reward to the evil man . The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out .

verses.z: 我兒，你要敬畏耶和華與君王，不要與反覆無常的人結交，
verses.e: My son , fear the LORD and the king . Don't join those who are rebellious ,

verses.z: 因為他們的災難必忽然而起。耶和華與君王所施行的毀滅，誰能知道呢？
verses.e: for their calamity will rise suddenly . Who knows what destruction may come from them both ?

verses.z: 以下也是智慧人的[箴言]：審判時看人情面是不好的。
verses.e: These also are sayings of the wise : To show partiality in judgment is not good .

verses.z: 對惡人說「你是義人」的，這人萬民必咒詛，列邦必憎惡。
verses.e: He who says to the wicked , " You are righteous , " peoples will curse him , and nations will abhor him —

verses.z: 責備[惡人的]，必得喜悅；美好的福也必臨到他。
verses.e: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty , and a rich blessing will come on them .

verses.z: 應對正直的，猶如與人親嘴。
verses.e: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips .

verses.z: 你要在外頭預備工料，在田間辦理整齊，然後建造房屋。
verses.e: Prepare your work outside , and get your fields ready . Afterwards , build your house .

verses.z: 不可無故作見證陷害鄰舍，也不可用嘴欺騙人。
verses.e: Don't be a witness against your neighbor without cause . Don't deceive with your lips .

verses.z: 不可說：人怎樣待我，我也怎樣待他；我必照他所行的報復他。
verses.e: Don't say , " I will do to him as he has done to me ; I will repay the man according to his work . "

verses.z: 房屋因智慧建造，又因聰明立穩；
verses.e: Through wisdom a house is built ; by understanding it is established ;

verses.z: 我經過懶惰人的田地、無知人的葡萄園，
verses.e: I went by the field of the sluggard , by the vineyard of the man void of understanding .

verses.z: 荊棘長滿了地皮，刺草遮蓋了田面，石牆也坍塌了。
verses.e: Behold , it was all grown over with thorns . Its surface was covered with nettles , and its stone wall was broken down .

verses.z: 我看見就留心思想；我看着就領了訓誨。
verses.e: Then I saw , and considered well . I saw , and received instruction :

verses.z: 再睡片時，打盹片時，抱着手躺臥片時，
verses.e: a little sleep , a little slumber , a little folding of the hands to sleep ,

verses.z: 你的貧窮就必如強盜速來，你的缺乏彷彿拿兵器的人來到。
verses.e: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man .

verses.z: 其中因知識充滿各樣美好寶貴的財物。
verses.e: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure .

verses.z: 智慧人大有能力；有知識的人力上加力。
verses.e: A wise man has great power . A knowledgeable man increases strength ,

verses.z: 你去打仗，要憑智謀；謀士眾多，人便得勝。
verses.e: for by wise guidance you wage your war , and victory is in many advisors .

verses.z: 智慧極高，非愚昧人所能及，所以在城門內不敢開口。
verses.e: Wisdom is too high for a fool . He doesn't open his mouth in the gate .

verses.z: 設計作惡的，必稱為奸人。
verses.e: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer .

verses.z: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪惡；褻慢者為人所憎惡。
verses.e: The schemes of folly are sin . The mocker is detested by men .

verses.z: 以下也是所羅門的箴言，是猶大王希西家的人所謄錄的。
verses.e: These also are proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .

verses.z: 恐怕聽見的人罵你，你的臭名就難以脫離。
verses.e: lest one who hears it put you to shame , and your bad reputation never depart .

verses.z: 一句話說得合宜，就如金蘋果在銀網子裏。
verses.e: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver .

verses.z: 智慧人的勸戒，在順從的人耳中，好像金耳環和精金的妝飾。
verses.e: As an earring of gold , and an ornament of fine gold , so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear .

verses.z: 忠信的使者叫差他的人心裏舒暢，就如在收割時有冰雪的涼氣。
verses.e: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest , so is a faithful messenger to those who send him ; for he refreshes the soul of his masters .

verses.z: 空誇贈送禮物的，好像無雨的風雲。
verses.e: As clouds and wind without rain , so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively .

verses.z: 恆常忍耐可以勸動君王；柔和的舌頭能折斷骨頭。
verses.e: By patience a ruler is persuaded . A soft tongue breaks the bone .

verses.z: 你得了蜜嗎？只可吃夠而已，恐怕你過飽就嘔吐出來。
verses.e: Have you found honey ? Eat as much as is sufficient for you , lest you eat too much , and vomit it .

verses.z: 你的腳要少進鄰舍的家，恐怕他厭煩你，恨惡你。
verses.e: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor's house , lest he be weary of you , and hate you .

verses.z: 作假見證陷害鄰舍的，就是大槌，是利刀，是快箭。
verses.e: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club , a sword , or a sharp arrow .

verses.z: 患難時倚靠不忠誠的人，好像破壞的牙，錯骨縫的腳。
verses.e: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot .

verses.z: 將事隱祕乃上帝的榮耀；將事察清乃君王的榮耀。
verses.e: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing , but the glory of kings is to search out a matter .

verses.z: 對傷心的人唱歌，就如冷天脫衣服，又如鹼上倒醋。
verses.e: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather , or vinegar on soda , so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart .

verses.z: 你的仇敵若餓了，就給他飯吃；若渴了，就給他水喝；
verses.e: If your enemy is hungry , give him food to eat . If he is thirsty , give him water to drink ;

verses.z: 因為，你[這樣行]就是把炭火堆在他的頭上；耶和華也必賞賜你。
verses.e: for you will heap coals of fire on his head , and the LORD will reward you .

verses.z: 北風生雨，讒謗人的舌頭也生怒容。
verses.e: The north wind produces rain ; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face .

verses.z: 寧可住在房頂的角上，不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。
verses.e: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman .

verses.z: 有好消息從遠方來，就如拿涼水給口渴的人喝。
verses.e: Like cold water to a thirsty soul , so is good news from a far country .

verses.z: 義人在惡人面前退縮，好像詵渾之泉，弄濁之井。
verses.e: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well , so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked .

verses.z: 吃蜜過多是不好的；考究自己的榮耀也是可厭的。
verses.e: It is not good to eat much honey , nor is it honorable to seek one's own honor .

verses.z: 人不制伏自己的心，好像毀壞的城邑沒有牆垣。
verses.e: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint .

verses.z: 天之高，地之厚，君王之心也測不透。
verses.e: As the heavens for height , and the earth for depth , so the hearts of kings are unsearchable .

verses.z: 除去銀子的渣滓就有[銀子]出來，銀匠能以做器皿。
verses.e: Take away the dross from the silver , and material comes out for the refiner .

verses.z: 除去王面前的惡人，國位就靠公義堅立。
verses.e: Take away the wicked from the king's presence , and his throne will be established in righteousness .

verses.z: 不要在王面前妄自尊大；不要在大人的位上站立。
verses.e: Don't exalt yourself in the presence of the king , or claim a place among great men ;

verses.z: 寧可有人說：請你上來，強如在你覲見的王子面前叫你退下。
verses.e: for it is better that it be said to you , " Come up here , " than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince , whom your eyes have seen .

verses.z: 不要冒失出去與人爭競，免得至終被他羞辱，你就[不知道]怎樣行了。
verses.e: Don't be hasty in bringing charges to court . What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you ?

verses.z: 你與鄰舍爭訟，要與他一人辯論，不可洩漏人的密事，
verses.e: Debate your case with your neighbor , and don't betray the confidence of another ,

verses.z: 夏天落雪，收割時下雨，都不相宜；愚昧人得尊榮也是如此。
verses.e: Like snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honor is not fitting for a fool .

verses.z: 雇愚昧人的，與雇過路人的，就像射傷眾人的弓箭手。
verses.e: As an archer who wounds all , so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by .

verses.z: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行，就如狗轉過來吃牠所吐的。
verses.e: As a dog that returns to his vomit , so is a fool who repeats his folly .

verses.z: 你見自以為有智慧的人嗎？愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.e: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes ? There is more hope for a fool than for him .

verses.z: 懶惰人說：道上有猛獅，街上有壯獅。
verses.e: The sluggard says , " There is a lion in the road ! A fierce lion roams the streets ! "

verses.z: 門在樞紐轉動，懶惰人在床上也是如此。
verses.e: As the door turns on its hinges , so does the sluggard on his bed .

verses.z: 懶惰人放手在盤子裏，就是向口撤回也以為勞乏。
verses.e: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish . He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth .

verses.z: 懶惰人看自己比七個善於應對的人更有智慧。
verses.e: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion .

verses.z: 過路被事激動，管理不干己的爭競，好像人揪住狗耳。
verses.e: Like one who grabs a dog's ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own .

verses.z: 人欺凌鄰舍，卻說：我豈不是戲耍嗎？他就像瘋狂的人拋擲火把、利箭，與殺人的兵器。
verses.e: Like a madman who shoots torches , arrows , and death ,
is the man who deceives his neighbor and says , " Am I not joking ? "

verses.z: 麻雀往來，燕子翻飛；這樣，無故的咒詛也必不臨到。
verses.e: Like a fluttering sparrow , like a darting swallow , so the undeserved curse doesn't come to rest .

verses.z: 火缺了柴就必熄滅；無人傳舌，爭競便止息。
verses.e: For lack of wood a fire goes out . Without gossip , a quarrel dies down .

verses.z: 好爭競的人煽惑爭端，就如餘火加炭，火上加柴一樣。
verses.e: As coals are to hot embers , and wood to fire , so is a contentious man to kindling strife .

verses.z: 傳舌人的言語，如同美食，深入人的心腹。
verses.e: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels , they go down into the innermost parts .

verses.z: 火熱的嘴，奸惡的心，好像銀渣包的瓦器。
verses.e: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart .

verses.z: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉飾，心裏卻藏着詭詐；
verses.e: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips , but he harbors evil in his heart .

verses.z: 他用甜言蜜語，你不可信他，因為他心中有七樣可憎惡的。
verses.e: When his speech is charming , don't believe him , for there are seven abominations in his heart .

verses.z: 他雖用詭詐遮掩自己的怨恨，他的邪惡必在會中顯露。
verses.e: His malice may be concealed by deception , but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly .

verses.z: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中；滾石頭的，石頭必反滾在他身上。
verses.e: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it . Whoever rolls a stone , it will come back on him .

verses.z: 虛謊的舌恨他所壓傷的人；諂媚的口敗壞人的事。
verses.e: A lying tongue hates those it hurts ; and a flattering mouth works ruin .

verses.z: 鞭子是為打馬，轡頭是為勒驢；刑杖是為打愚昧人的背。
verses.e: A whip is for the horse , a bridle for the donkey , and a rod for the back of fools !

verses.z: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他，恐怕你與他一樣。
verses.e: Don't answer a fool according to his folly , lest you also be like him .

verses.z: 要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他，免得他自以為有智慧。
verses.e: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own eyes .

verses.z: 藉愚昧人手寄信的，是砍斷[自己的]腳，自受損害。
verses.e: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence .

verses.z: 瘸子的腳空存無用；箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。
verses.e: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose , so is a parable in the mouth of fools .

verses.z: 將尊榮給愚昧人的，好像人把石子包在機弦裏。
verses.e: As one who binds a stone in a sling , so is he who gives honor to a fool .

verses.z: 箴言在愚昧人的口中，好像荊棘刺入醉漢的手。
verses.e: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard , so is a parable in the mouth of fools .

verses.z: 不要為明日自誇，因為一日要生何事，你尚且不能知道。
verses.e: Don't boast about tomorrow ; for you don't know what a day may bring .

verses.z: 你的朋友和父親的朋友，你都不可離棄。你遭難的日子，不要上弟兄的家去；相近的鄰舍強如遠方的弟兄。
verses.e: Don't forsake your friend and your father's friend . Don't go to your brother's house in the day of your disaster . A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother .

verses.z: 我兒，你要作智慧人，好叫我的心歡喜，使我可以回答那譏誚我的人。
verses.e: Be wise , my son , and bring joy to my heart , then I can answer my tormentor .

verses.z: 通達人見禍藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
verses.e: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge ; but the simple pass on , and suffer for it .

verses.z: 誰為生人作保，就拿誰的衣服；誰為外女[作保]，誰就承當。
verses.e: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger . Hold it for a wayward woman !

verses.z: 清晨起來，大聲給朋友祝福的，就算是咒詛他。
verses.e: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning , it will be taken as a curse by him .

verses.z: 大雨之日連連滴漏，和爭吵的婦人一樣；
verses.e: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike :

verses.z: 想攔阻她的，便是攔阻風，也是右手抓油。
verses.e: restraining her is like restraining the wind , or like grasping oil in his right hand .

verses.z: 鐵磨鐵，磨出刃來；朋友相感也是如此。
verses.e: Iron sharpens iron ; so a man sharpens his friend's countenance .

verses.z: 看守無花果樹的，必吃樹上的果子；敬奉主人的，必得尊榮。
verses.e: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit . He who looks after his master shall be honored .

verses.z: 水中照臉，彼此[相符]；人與人，心也[相對]。
verses.e: Like water reflects a face , so a man's heart reflects the man .

verses.z: 要別人誇獎你，不可用口自誇；等外人稱讚你，不可用嘴自稱。
verses.e: Let another man praise you , and not your own mouth ; a stranger , and not your own lips .

verses.z: 陰間和滅亡永不滿足；人的眼目也是如此。
verses.e: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied ; and a man's eyes are never satisfied .

verses.z: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金，人的稱讚也[試煉]人。
verses.e: The crucible is for silver , and the furnace for gold ; but man is refined by his praise .

verses.z: 你雖用杵將愚妄人與打碎的麥子一同搗在臼中，他的愚妄還是離不了他。
verses.e: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain , yet his foolishness will not be removed from him .

verses.z: 你要詳細知道你羊群的景況，留心料理你的牛群；
verses.e: Know well the state of your flocks , and pay attention to your herds ,

verses.z: 因為資財不能永有，冠冕豈能存到萬代？
verses.e: for riches are not forever , nor does the crown endure to all generations .

verses.z: 乾草割去，嫩草發現，山上的菜蔬也被收斂。
verses.e: The hay is removed , and the new growth appears , the grasses of the hills are gathered in .

verses.z: 羊羔[之毛]是為你作衣服；山羊是為作田地的價值，
verses.e: The lambs are for your clothing , and the goats are the price of a field .

verses.z: 並有母山羊奶夠你吃，也夠你的家眷吃，且夠養你的婢女。
verses.e: There will be plenty of goats ' milk for your food , for your family's food , and for the nourishment of your servant girls .

verses.z: 石頭重，沙土沉，愚妄人的惱怒比這兩樣更重。
verses.e: A stone is heavy , and sand is a burden ; but a fool's provocation is heavier than both .

verses.z: 忿怒為殘忍，怒氣為狂瀾，惟有嫉妒，誰能敵得住呢？
verses.e: Wrath is cruel , and anger is overwhelming ; but who is able to stand before jealousy ?

verses.z: 當面的責備強如背地的愛情。
verses.e: Better is open rebuke than hidden love .

verses.z: 朋友加的傷痕出於忠誠；仇敵連連親嘴卻是多餘。
verses.e: The wounds of a friend are faithful , although the kisses of an enemy are profuse .

verses.z: 人吃飽了，厭惡蜂房的蜜；人飢餓了，一切苦物都覺甘甜。
verses.e: A full soul loathes a honeycomb ; but to a hungry soul , every bitter thing is sweet .

verses.z: 人離本處飄流，好像雀鳥離窩遊飛。
verses.e: As a bird that wanders from her nest , so is a man who wanders from his home .

verses.z: 膏油與香料使人心喜悅；朋友誠實的勸教也是如此甘美。
verses.e: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart ; so does earnest counsel from a man's friend .

verses.z: 惡人雖無人追趕也逃跑；義人卻膽壯像獅子。
verses.e: The wicked flee when no one pursues ; but the righteous are as bold as a lion .

verses.z: 誘惑正直人行惡道的，必掉在自己的坑裏；惟有完全人必承受福分。
verses.e: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way , he will fall into his own trap ; but the blameless will inherit good .

verses.z: 富足人自以為有智慧，但聰明的貧窮人能將他查透。
verses.e: The rich man is wise in his own eyes ; but the poor who has understanding sees through him .

verses.z: 義人得志，有大榮耀；惡人興起，人就躲藏。
verses.e: When the righteous triumph , there is great glory ; but when the wicked rise , men hide themselves .

verses.z: 遮掩自己罪過的，必不亨通；承認離棄罪過的，必蒙憐恤。
verses.e: He who conceals his sins doesn't prosper , but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy .

verses.z: 常存敬畏的，便為有福；心存剛硬的，必陷在禍患裏。
verses.e: Blessed is the man who always fears ; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble .

verses.z: 暴虐的君王轄制貧民，好像吼叫的獅子、覓食的熊。
verses.e: As a roaring lion or a charging bear , so is a wicked ruler over helpless people .

verses.z: 無知的君多行暴虐；以貪財為可恨的，必年長日久。
verses.e: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment . One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days .

verses.z: 背負流人血之罪的，必往坑裏奔跑，誰也不可攔阻他。
verses.e: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death . No one will support him .

verses.z: 行動正直的，必蒙拯救；行事彎曲的，立時跌倒。
verses.e: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe ; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly .

verses.z: 耕種自己田地的，必得飽食；追隨虛浮的，足受窮乏。
verses.e: One who works his land will have an abundance of food ; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty .

verses.z: 邦國因有罪過，君王就多[更換]；因有聰明知識的人，國必長存。
verses.e: In rebellion , a land has many rulers , but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge .

verses.z: 誠實人必多得福；想要急速發財的，不免受罰。
verses.e: A faithful man is rich with blessings ; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished .

verses.z: 看人的情面乃為不好；人因一塊餅枉法也為不好。
verses.e: To show partiality is not good , yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread .

verses.z: 人有惡眼想要急速發財，卻不知窮乏必臨到他身。
verses.e: A stingy man hurries after riches , and doesn't know that poverty waits for him .

verses.z: 責備人的，後來蒙人喜悅，多於那用舌頭諂媚人的。
verses.e: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue .

verses.z: 偷竊父母的，說：這不是罪，此人就是與強盜同類。
verses.e: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says , " It's not wrong , " is a partner with a destroyer .

verses.z: 心中貪婪的，挑起爭端；倚靠耶和華的，必得豐裕。
verses.e: One who is greedy stirs up strife ; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper .

verses.z: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人；憑智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
verses.e: One who trusts in himself is a fool ; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe .

verses.z: 賙濟貧窮的，不致缺乏；佯為不見的，必多受咒詛。
verses.e: One who gives to the poor has no lack ; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses .

verses.z: 惡人興起，人就躲藏；惡人敗亡，義人增多。
verses.e: When the wicked rise , men hide themselves ; but when they perish , the righteous thrive .

verses.z: 窮人欺壓貧民，好像暴雨[沖]沒糧食。
verses.e: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops .

verses.z: 違棄律法的，誇獎惡人；遵守律法的，卻與惡人相爭。
verses.e: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked ; but those who keep the law contend with them .

verses.z: 壞人不明白公義；惟有尋求耶和華的，無不明白。
verses.e: Evil men don't understand justice ; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully .

verses.z: 行為純正的窮乏人勝過行事乖僻的富足人。
verses.e: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways , and he is rich .

verses.z: 謹守律法的，是智慧之子；與貪食人作伴的，卻羞辱其父。
verses.e: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son ; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father .

verses.z: 人以[厚]利加增財物，是給那憐憫窮人者積蓄的。
verses.e: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor .

verses.z: 轉耳不聽律法的，他的祈禱也為可憎。
verses.e: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer is an abomination .

verses.z: 人屢次受責罰，仍然硬着頸項；他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。
verses.e: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly , with no remedy .

verses.z: 好流人血的，恨惡完全人，索取正直人的性命。
verses.e: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity ; and they seek the life of the upright .

verses.z: 愚妄人怒氣全發；智慧人忍氣含怒。
verses.e: A fool vents all of his anger , but a wise man brings himself under control .

verses.z: 君王若聽謊言，他一切臣僕都是奸惡。
verses.e: If a ruler listens to lies , all of his officials are wicked .

verses.z: 貧窮人、強暴人在世相遇；他們的眼目都蒙耶和華光照。
verses.e: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common : The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both .

verses.z: 君王憑誠實判斷窮人；他的國位必永遠堅立。
verses.e: The king who fairly judges the poor , his throne shall be established forever .

verses.z: 杖打和責備能加增智慧；放縱的兒子使母親羞愧。
verses.e: The rod of correction gives wisdom , but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother .

verses.z: 惡人加多，過犯也加多，義人必看見他們跌倒。
verses.e: When the wicked increase , sin increases ; but the righteous will see their downfall .

verses.z: 管教你的兒子，他就使你得安息，也必使你心裏喜樂。
verses.e: Correct your son , and he will give you peace ; yes , he will bring delight to your soul .

verses.z: 沒有異象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便為有福。
verses.e: Where there is no revelation , the people cast off restraint ; but one who keeps the law is blessed .

verses.z: 只用言語，僕人不肯受管教；他雖然明白，也不留意。
verses.e: A servant can't be corrected by words . Though he understands , yet he will not respond .

verses.z: 義人增多，民就喜樂；惡人掌權，民就歎息。
verses.e: When the righteous thrive , the people rejoice ; but when the wicked rule , the people groan .

verses.z: 你見言語急躁的人嗎？愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.e: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words ? There is more hope for a fool than for him .

verses.z: 人將僕人從小嬌養，這僕人終久必成了他的兒子。
verses.e: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end .

verses.z: 好氣的人挑啟爭端；暴怒的人多多犯罪。
verses.e: An angry man stirs up strife , and a wrathful man abounds in sin .

verses.z: 人的高傲必使他卑下；心裏謙遜的，必得尊榮。
verses.e: A man's pride brings him low , but one of lowly spirit gains honor .

verses.z: 人與盜賊分贓，是恨惡自己的性命；他聽見叫人發誓的聲音，卻不言語。
verses.e: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul . He takes an oath , but dares not testify .

verses.z: 懼怕人的，陷入網羅；惟有倚靠耶和華的，必得安穩。
verses.e: The fear of man proves to be a snare , but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe .

verses.z: 求王恩的人多；定人事乃在耶和華。
verses.e: Many seek the ruler's favor , but a man's justice comes from the LORD .

verses.z: 為非作歹的，被義人憎嫌；行事正直的，被惡人憎惡。
verses.e: A dishonest man detests the righteous , and the upright in their ways detest the wicked .

verses.z: 愛慕智慧的，使父親喜樂；與妓女結交的，卻浪費錢財。
verses.e: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father ; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth .

verses.z: 王藉公平，使國堅定；索要賄賂，使國傾敗。
verses.e: The king by justice makes the land stable , but he who takes bribes tears it down .

verses.z: 諂媚鄰舍的，就是設網羅絆他的腳。
verses.e: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet .

verses.z: 惡人犯罪，自陷網羅；惟獨義人歡呼喜樂。
verses.e: An evil man is snared by his sin , but the righteous can sing and be glad .

verses.z: 義人知道查明窮人的案；惡人沒有聰明，就不得而知。
verses.e: The righteous care about justice for the poor . The wicked aren't concerned about knowledge .

verses.z: 褻慢人煽惑通城；智慧人止息眾怒。
verses.e: Mockers stir up a city , but wise men turn away anger .

verses.z: 智慧人與愚妄人相爭，或怒或笑，總不能使他止息。
verses.e: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man , the fool rages or scoffs , and there is no peace .

verses.z: 我兒，不要忘記我的法則；你心要謹守我的誡命；
verses.e: My son , don't forget my teaching , but let your heart keep my commandments ,

verses.z: 這樣，你的倉房必充滿有餘；你的酒醡有新酒盈溢。
verses.e: so your barns will be filled with plenty , and your vats will overflow with new wine .

verses.z: 我兒，你不可輕看耶和華的管教，也不可厭煩他的責備；
verses.e: My son , don't despise the LORD's discipline , neither be weary of his correction ;

verses.z: 因為耶和華所愛的，他必責備，正如父親責備所喜愛的兒子。
verses.e: for whom the LORD loves , he corrects , even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights .

verses.z: 得智慧，得聰明的，這人便為有福。
verses.e: Happy is the man who finds wisdom , the man who gets understanding .

verses.z: 因為得智慧勝過得銀子，其利益強如精金，
verses.e: For her good profit is better than getting silver , and her return is better than fine gold .

verses.z: 比珍珠寶貴；你一切所喜愛的，都不足與比較。
verses.e: She is more precious than rubies . None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her .

verses.z: 她右手有長壽，左手有富貴。
verses.e: Length of days is in her right hand . In her left hand are riches and honor .

verses.z: 她的道是安樂；她的路全是平安。
verses.e: Her ways are ways of pleasantness . All her paths are peace .

verses.z: 她與持守她的作生命樹；持定她的，俱各有福。
verses.e: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her . Happy is everyone who retains her .

verses.z: 耶和華以智慧立地，以聰明定天，
verses.e: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth . By understanding , he established the heavens .

verses.z: 因為它必將長久的日子，生命的年數與平安，加給你。
verses.e: for they will add to you length of days , years of life , and peace .

verses.z: 以知識使深淵裂開，使天空滴下甘露。
verses.e: By his knowledge , the depths were broken up , and the skies drop down the dew .

verses.z: 我兒，要謹守真智慧和謀略，不可使她離開你的眼目。
verses.e: My son , let them not depart from your eyes . Keep sound wisdom and discretion ,

verses.z: 這樣，她必作你的生命，頸項的美飾。
verses.e: so they will be life to your soul , and grace for your neck .

verses.z: 你就坦然行路，不致碰腳。
verses.e: Then you shall walk in your way securely . Your foot won't stumble .

verses.z: 你躺下，必不懼怕；你躺臥，睡得香甜。
verses.e: When you lie down , you will not be afraid . Yes , you will lie down , and your sleep will be sweet .

verses.z: 忽然來的驚恐，不要害怕；惡人遭毀滅，也不要恐懼。
verses.e: Don't be afraid of sudden fear , neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it comes ;

verses.z: 因為耶和華是你所倚靠的；他必保守你的腳不陷入網羅。
verses.e: for the LORD will be your confidence , and will keep your foot from being taken .

verses.z: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辭，就當向那應得的人施行。
verses.e: Don't withhold good from those to whom it is due , when it is in the power of your hand to do it .

verses.z: 你那裏若有現成的，不可對鄰舍說：去吧，明天再來，我必給你。
verses.e: Don't say to your neighbor , " Go , and come again ; tomorrow I will give it to you , " when you have it by you .

verses.z: 你的鄰舍既在你附近安居，你不可設計害他。
verses.e: Don't devise evil against your neighbor , since he dwells securely by you .

verses.z: 不可使慈愛、誠實離開你，要繫在你頸項上，刻在你心版上。
verses.e: Don't let kindness and truth forsake you . Bind them around your neck . Write them on the tablet of your heart .

verses.z: 人未曾加害與你，不可無故與他相爭。
verses.e: Don't strive with a man without cause , if he has done you no harm .

verses.z: 不可嫉妒強暴的人，也不可選擇他所行的路。
verses.e: Don't envy the man of violence . Choose none of his ways .

verses.z: 因為，乖僻人為耶和華所憎惡；正直人為他所親密。
verses.e: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD , but his friendship is with the upright .

verses.z: 耶和華咒詛惡人的家庭，賜福與義人的居所。
verses.e: The LORD's curse is in the house of the wicked , but he blesses the habitation of the righteous .

verses.z: 他譏誚那好譏誚的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
verses.e: Surely he mocks the mockers , but he gives grace to the humble .

verses.z: 智慧人必承受尊榮；愚昧人高升也成為羞辱。
verses.e: The wise will inherit glory , but shame will be the promotion of fools .

verses.z: 這樣，你必在上帝和世人眼前蒙恩寵，有聰明。
verses.e: So you will find favor , and good understanding in the sight of God and man .

verses.z: 你要專心仰賴耶和華，不可倚靠自己的聰明，
verses.e: Trust in the LORD with all your heart , and don't lean on your own understanding .

verses.z: 在你一切所行的事上都要認定他，他必指引你的路。
verses.e: In all your ways acknowledge him , and he will make your paths straight .

verses.z: 不要自以為有智慧；要敬畏耶和華，遠離惡事。
verses.e: Don't be wise in your own eyes . Fear the LORD , and depart from evil .

verses.z: 這便醫治你的肚臍，滋潤你的百骨。
verses.e: It will be health to your body , and nourishment to your bones .

verses.z: 你要以財物和一切初熟的土產尊榮耶和華。
verses.e: Honor the LORD with your substance , with the first fruits of all your increase ;

verses.z: 雅基的兒子亞古珥的言語就是真言。這人對以鐵和烏甲說：
verses.e: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , the revelation : the man says to Ithiel , to Ithiel and Ucal :

verses.z: 你不要向主人讒謗僕人，恐怕他咒詛你，你便算為有罪。
verses.e: " Don't slander a servant to his master , lest he curse you , and you be held guilty .

verses.z: 有一宗人，咒詛父親，不給母親祝福。
verses.e: There is a generation that curses their father , and doesn't bless their mother .

verses.z: 有一宗人，自以為清潔，卻沒有洗去自己的污穢。
verses.e: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes , yet are not washed from their filthiness .

verses.z: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲，眼皮也是高舉。
verses.e: There is a generation , oh how lofty are their eyes ! Their eyelids are lifted up .

verses.z: 有一宗人，牙如劍，齒如刀，要吞滅地上的困苦人和世間的窮乏人。
verses.e: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords , and their jaws like knives , to devour the poor from the earth , and the needy from among men .

verses.z: 螞蟥有兩個女兒，[常說]：給呀，給呀！有三樣不知足的，連不說「夠的」共有四樣：
verses.e: " The leech has two daughters : ' Give , give . ' " There are three things that are never satisfied ; four that don't say , ' Enough ! ' :

verses.z: 就是陰間和石胎，浸水不足的地，並火。
verses.e: Sheol , the barren womb , the earth that is not satisfied with water , and the fire that doesn't say , ' Enough ! '

verses.z: 戲笑父親、藐視而不聽從母親的，他的眼睛必為谷中的烏鴉啄出來，為鷹雛所吃。
verses.e: " The eye that mocks at his father , and scorns obedience to his mother , the ravens of the valley shall pick it out , the young eagles shall eat it .

verses.z: 我所測不透的奇妙有三樣，連我所不知道的共有四樣：
verses.e: " There are three things which are too amazing for me , four which I don't understand :

verses.z: 就是鷹在空中飛的道；蛇在磐石上爬的道；船在海中行的道；男與女交合的道。
verses.e: The way of an eagle in the air , the way of a serpent on a rock , the way of a ship in the middle of the sea , and the way of a man with a maiden .

verses.z: 我比眾人更蠢笨，也沒有人的聰明。
verses.e: " Surely I am the most ignorant man , and don't have a man's understanding .

verses.z: 淫婦的道也是這樣：她吃了，把嘴一擦就說：我沒有行惡。
verses.e: " So is the way of an adulterous woman : She eats and wipes her mouth , and says , ' I have done nothing wrong . '

verses.z: 使地震動的有三樣，連地擔不起的共有四樣：
verses.e: " For three things the earth trembles , and under four , it can't bear up :

verses.z: 就是僕人作王；愚頑人吃飽；
verses.e: For a servant when he is king , a fool when he is filled with food ,

verses.z: 醜惡的女子出嫁；婢女接續主母。
verses.e: for an unloved woman when she is married , and a servant who is heir to her mistress .

verses.z: 地上有四樣小物，卻甚聰明：
verses.e: " There are four things which are little on the earth , but they are exceedingly wise :

verses.z: 螞蟻是無力之類，卻在夏天預備糧食。
verses.e: The ants are not a strong people , yet they provide their food in the summer .

verses.z: 沙番是軟弱之類，卻在磐石中造房。
verses.e: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk , yet make they their houses in the rocks .

verses.z: 蝗蟲沒有君王，卻分隊而出。
verses.e: The locusts have no king , yet they advance in ranks .

verses.z: 守宮用爪抓[牆]，卻住在王宮。
verses.e: You can catch a lizard with your hands , yet it is in kings ' palaces .

verses.z: 步行威武的有三樣，連行走威武的共有四樣：
verses.e: " There are three things which are stately in their march , four which are stately in going :

verses.z: 我沒有學好智慧，也不認識至聖者。
verses.e: I have not learned wisdom , neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One .

verses.z: 就是獅子－乃百獸中最為猛烈、無所躲避的，
verses.e: The lion , which is mightiest among animals , and doesn't turn away for any ;

verses.z: 獵狗，公山羊，和無人能敵的君王。
verses.e: the greyhound ; the male goat ; and the king against whom there is no rising up .

verses.z: 你若行事愚頑，自高自傲，或是懷了惡念，就當用手[摀口]。
verses.e: " If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself , or if you have thought evil , put your hand over your mouth .

verses.z: 搖牛奶必成奶油；扭鼻子必出血。照樣，激動怒氣必起爭端。
verses.e: For as the churning of milk produces butter , and the wringing of the nose produces blood , so the forcing of wrath produces strife . "

verses.z: 誰升天又降下來？誰聚風在掌握中？誰包水在衣服裏？誰立定地的四極？他名叫甚麼？他兒子名叫甚麼？你知道嗎？
verses.e: Who has ascended up into heaven , and descended ? Who has gathered the wind in his fists ? Who has bound the waters in his garment ? Who has established all the ends of the earth ? What is his name , and what is his son's name , if you know ?

verses.z: 上帝的言語句句都是煉淨的；投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
verses.e: " Every word of God is flawless . He is a shield to those who take refuge in him .

verses.z: 他的言語，你不可加添，恐怕他責備你，你就顯為說謊言的。
verses.e: Don't you add to his words , lest he reprove you , and you be found a liar .

verses.z: 我求你兩件事，在我未死之先，不要不賜給我：
verses.e: " Two things I have asked of you . Don't deny me before I die .

verses.z: 求你使虛假和謊言遠離我；使我也不貧窮也不富足；賜給我需用的飲食，
verses.e: Remove far from me falsehood and lies . Give me neither poverty nor riches . Feed me with the food that is needful for me ,

verses.z: 恐怕我飽足不認[你]，說：耶和華是誰呢？又恐怕我貧窮就偷竊，以致褻瀆我上帝的名。
verses.e: lest I be full , deny you , and say , ' Who is the LORD ? ' or lest I be poor , and steal , and so dishonor the name of my God .

verses.z: 利慕伊勒王的言語，是他母親教訓他的真言。
verses.e: The words of King Lemuel — the revelation which his mother taught him :

verses.z: 才德的婦人誰能得着呢？她的價值遠勝過珍珠。
verses.e: Who can find a worthy woman ? For her value is far above rubies .

verses.z: 她丈夫心裏倚靠她，必不缺少利益；
verses.e: The heart of her husband trusts in her . He shall have no lack of gain .

verses.z: 她一生使丈夫有益無損。
verses.e: She does him good , and not harm , all the days of her life .

verses.z: 她尋找羊羢和麻，甘心用手做工。
verses.e: She seeks wool and flax , and works eagerly with her hands .

verses.z: 她好像商船從遠方運糧來，
verses.e: She is like the merchant ships . She brings her bread from afar .

verses.z: 未到黎明她就起來，把食物分給家中的人，將當做的工分派婢女。
verses.e: She rises also while it is yet night , gives food to her household , and portions for her servant girls .

verses.z: 她想得田地就買來；用手所得之利栽種葡萄園。
verses.e: She considers a field , and buys it . With the fruit of her hands , she plants a vineyard .

verses.z: 她以能力束腰，使膀臂有力。
verses.e: She arms her waist with strength , and makes her arms strong .

verses.z: 她覺得所經營的有利；她的燈終夜不滅。
verses.e: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable . Her lamp doesn't go out by night .

verses.z: 她手拿撚線竿，手把紡線車。
verses.e: She lays her hands to the distaff , and her hands hold the spindle .

verses.z: 我的兒啊，我腹中生的兒啊，我許願得的兒啊！我當怎樣[教訓]你呢？
verses.e: " Oh , my son ! Oh , son of my womb ! Oh , son of my vows !

verses.z: 她張手賙濟困苦人，伸手幫補窮乏人。
verses.e: She opens her arms to the poor ; yes , she extends her hands to the needy .

verses.z: 她不因下雪為家裏的人擔心，因為全家都穿着朱紅衣服。
verses.e: She is not afraid of the snow for her household , for all her household are clothed with scarlet .

verses.z: 她為自己製作繡花毯子；她的衣服是細麻和紫色布做的。
verses.e: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry . Her clothing is fine linen and purple .

verses.z: 她丈夫在城門口與本地的長老同坐，為眾人所認識。
verses.e: Her husband is respected in the gates , when he sits among the elders of the land .

verses.z: 她做細麻布衣裳出賣，又將腰帶賣與商家。
verses.e: She makes linen garments and sells them , and delivers sashes to the merchant .

verses.z: 能力和威儀是她的衣服；她[想到]日後的景況就喜笑。
verses.e: Strength and dignity are her clothing . She laughs at the time to come .

verses.z: 她開口就發智慧；她舌上有仁慈的法則。
verses.e: She opens her mouth with wisdom . Kind instruction is on her tongue .

verses.z: 她觀察家務，並不吃閒飯。
verses.e: She looks well to the ways of her household , and doesn't eat the bread of idleness .

verses.z: 她的兒女起來稱她有福；她的丈夫也稱讚她，
verses.e: Her children rise up and call her blessed . Her husband also praises her :

verses.z: 說：才德的女子很多，惟獨你超過一切。
verses.e: " Many women do noble things , but you excel them all . "

verses.z: 不要將你的精力給婦女；也不要有敗壞君王的行為。
verses.e: Don't give your strength to women , nor your ways to that which destroys kings .

verses.z: 艷麗是虛假的，美容是虛浮的；惟敬畏耶和華的婦女必得稱讚。
verses.e: Charm is deceitful , and beauty is vain ; but a woman who fears the LORD , she shall be praised .

verses.z: 願她享受操作所得的；願她的工作在城門口榮耀她。
verses.e: Give her of the fruit of her hands ! Let her works praise her in the gates !

verses.z: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜；王子說濃酒在那裏也不相宜；
verses.e: It is not for kings , Lemuel , it is not for kings to drink wine , nor for princes to say , ' Where is strong drink ? '

verses.z: 恐怕喝了就忘記律例，顛倒一切困苦人的是非。
verses.e: lest they drink , and forget the law , and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted .

verses.z: 可以把濃酒給將亡的人喝，把[清]酒給苦心的人喝，
verses.e: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish , and wine to the bitter in soul .

verses.z: 讓他喝了，就忘記他的貧窮，不再記念他的苦楚。
verses.e: Let him drink , and forget his poverty , and remember his misery no more .

verses.z: 你當為啞巴開口，為一切孤獨的伸冤。
verses.e: Open your mouth for the mute , in the cause of all who are left desolate .

verses.z: 你當開口按公義判斷，為困苦和窮乏的辨屈。
verses.e: Open your mouth , judge righteously , and serve justice to the poor and needy . "

verses.z: 眾子啊，要聽父親的教訓，留心得知聰明。
verses.e: Listen , sons , to a father's instruction . Pay attention and know understanding ;

verses.z: 我兒，你要聽受我的言語，就必延年益壽。
verses.e: Listen , my son , and receive my sayings . The years of your life will be many .

verses.z: 我已指教你走智慧的道，引導你行正直的路。
verses.e: I have taught you in the way of wisdom . I have led you in straight paths .

verses.z: 你行走，腳步必不致狹窄；你奔跑，也不致跌倒。
verses.e: When you go , your steps will not be hampered . When you run , you will not stumble .

verses.z: 要持定訓誨，不可放鬆；必當謹守，因為它是你的生命。
verses.e: Take firm hold of instruction . Don't let her go . Keep her , for she is your life .

verses.z: 不可行惡人的路；不要走壞人的道。
verses.e: Don't enter into the path of the wicked . Don't walk in the way of evil men .

verses.z: 要躲避，不可經過；要轉身而去。
verses.e: Avoid it , and don't pass by it . Turn from it , and pass on .

verses.z: 這等人若不行惡，不得睡覺；不使人跌倒，睡臥不安；
verses.e: For they don't sleep unless they do evil . Their sleep is taken away , unless they make someone fall .

verses.z: 因為他們以奸惡吃餅，以強暴喝酒。
verses.e: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence .

verses.z: 但義人的路好像黎明的光，越照越明，直到日午。
verses.e: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day .

verses.z: 惡人的道好像幽暗，自己不知因甚麼跌倒。
verses.e: The way of the wicked is like darkness . They don't know what they stumble over .

verses.z: 因我所給你們的是好教訓；不可離棄我的法則。
verses.e: for I give you sound learning . Don't forsake my law .

verses.z: 我兒，要留心聽我的言詞，側耳聽我的話語，
verses.e: My son , attend to my words . Turn your ear to my sayings .

verses.z: 都不可離你的眼目，要存記在你心中。
verses.e: Let them not depart from your eyes . Keep them in the center of your heart .

verses.z: 因為得着它的，就得了生命，又得了醫全體的良藥。
verses.e: For they are life to those who find them , and health to their whole body .

verses.z: 你要保守你心，勝過保守一切，因為一生的果效是由心發出。
verses.e: Keep your heart with all diligence , for out of it is the wellspring of life .

verses.z: 你要除掉邪僻的口，棄絕乖謬的嘴。
verses.e: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth . Put corrupt lips far from you .

verses.z: 你的眼目要向前正看；你的眼睛當向前直觀。
verses.e: Let your eyes look straight ahead . Fix your gaze directly before you .

verses.z: 要修平你腳下的路，堅定你一切的道。
verses.e: Make the path of your feet level . Let all of your ways be established .

verses.z: 不可偏向左右；要使你的腳離開邪惡。
verses.e: Don't turn to the right hand nor to the left . Remove your foot from evil .

verses.z: 我在父親面前為孝子，在母親眼中為獨一的嬌兒。
verses.e: For I was a son to my father , tender and an only child in the sight of my mother .

verses.z: 父親教訓我說：你心要存記我的言語，遵守我的命令，便得存活。
verses.e: He taught me , and said to me : " Let your heart retain my words . Keep my commandments , and live .

verses.z: 要得智慧，要得聰明，不可忘記，也不可偏離我口中的言語。
verses.e: Get wisdom . Get understanding . Don't forget , and don't deviate from the words of my mouth .

verses.z: 不可離棄智慧，智慧就護衛你；要愛她，她就保守你。
verses.e: Don't forsake her , and she will preserve you . Love her , and she will keep you .

verses.z: 智慧為首；[所以]，要得智慧。在你一切所得之內必得聰明。
verses.e: Wisdom is supreme . Get wisdom . Yes , though it costs all your possessions , get understanding .

verses.z: 高舉智慧，她就使你高升；懷抱智慧，她就使你尊榮。
verses.e: Esteem her , and she will exalt you . She will bring you to honor when you embrace her .

verses.z: 她必將華冠加在你頭上，把榮冕交給你。
verses.e: She will give to your head a garland of grace . She will deliver a crown of splendor to you . "

verses.z: 我兒，要留心我智慧的話語，側耳聽我聰明的言詞，
verses.e: My son , pay attention to my wisdom . Turn your ear to my understanding ,

verses.z: 恐怕外人滿得你的力量，你勞碌得來的，歸入外人的家；
verses.e: lest strangers feast on your wealth , and your labors enrich another man's house .

verses.z: 終久，你皮肉和身體消毀，你就悲歎，
