verses.e: You will groan at your latter end , when your flesh and your body are consumed ,

verses.z: 說：我怎麼恨惡訓誨，心中藐視責備，
verses.e: and say , " How I have hated instruction , and my heart despised reproof .

verses.z: 也不聽從我師傅的話，又不側耳聽那教訓我的人？
verses.e: I haven't obeyed the voice of my teachers , nor turned my ear to those who instructed me !

verses.z: 我在[聖]會裏，幾乎落在諸般惡中。
verses.e: I have come to the brink of utter ruin , among the gathered assembly . "

verses.z: 你要喝自己池中的水，飲自己井裏的活水。
verses.e: Drink water out of your own cistern , running water out of your own well .

verses.z: 你的泉源豈可漲溢在外？你的河水豈可流在街上？
verses.e: Should your springs overflow in the streets , streams of water in the public squares ?

verses.z: 惟獨歸你一人，不可與外人同用。
verses.e: Let them be for yourself alone , not for strangers with you .

verses.z: 要使你的泉源蒙福；要喜悅你幼年所娶的妻。
verses.e: Let your spring be blessed . Rejoice in the wife of your youth .

verses.z: 她如可愛的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿；願她的胸懷使你時時知足，她的愛情使你常常戀慕。
verses.e: A loving doe and a graceful deer — let her breasts satisfy you at all times . Be captivated always with her love .

verses.z: 為要使你謹守謀略，嘴唇保存知識。
verses.e: that you may maintain discretion , that your lips may preserve knowledge .

verses.z: 我兒，你為何戀慕淫婦？為何抱外女的胸懷？
verses.e: For why should you , my son , be captivated with an adulteress ? Why embrace the bosom of another ?

verses.z: 因為，人所行的道都在耶和華眼前；他也修平人一切的路。
verses.e: For the ways of man are before the LORD's eyes . He examines all his paths .

verses.z: 惡人必被自己的罪孽捉住；他必被自己的罪惡如繩索纏繞。
verses.e: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him . The cords of his sin hold him firmly .

verses.z: 他因不受訓誨就必死亡；又因愚昧過甚，必走差了路。
verses.e: He will die for lack of instruction . In the greatness of his folly , he will go astray .

verses.z: 因為淫婦的嘴滴下蜂蜜；她的口比油更滑，
verses.e: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey . Her mouth is smoother than oil ,

verses.z: 至終卻苦似茵蔯，快如兩刃的刀。
verses.e: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood , and as sharp as a two-edged sword .

verses.z: 她的腳下入死地；她腳步踏住陰間，
verses.e: Her feet go down to death . Her steps lead straight to Sheol .

verses.z: 以致她找不着生命平坦的道。她的路變遷不定，自己還不知道。
verses.e: She gives no thought to the way of life . Her ways are crooked , and she doesn't know it .

verses.z: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我；不可離棄我口中的話。
verses.e: Now therefore , my sons , listen to me . Don't depart from the words of my mouth .

verses.z: 你所行的道要離她遠，不可就近她的房門，
verses.e: Remove your way far from her . Don't come near the door of her house ,

verses.z: 恐怕將你的尊榮給別人，將你的歲月給殘忍的人；
verses.e: lest you give your honor to others , and your years to the cruel one ;

verses.z: 我兒，你若為朋友作保，替外人擊掌，
verses.e: My son , if you have become collateral for your neighbor , if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger ,

verses.z: 再睡片時，打盹片時，抱着手躺臥片時，
verses.e: A little sleep , a little slumber , a little folding of the hands to sleep —

verses.z: 你的貧窮就必如強盜速來，你的缺乏彷彿拿兵器的人來到。
verses.e: so your poverty will come as a robber , and your scarcity as an armed man .

verses.z: 無賴的惡徒，行動就用乖僻的口，
verses.e: A worthless person , a man of iniquity , is he who walks with a perverse mouth ,

verses.z: 用眼傳神，用腳示意，用指點劃，
verses.e: who winks with his eyes , who signals with his feet , who motions with his fingers ,

verses.z: 心中乖僻，常設惡謀，布散紛爭。
verses.e: in whose heart is perverseness , who devises evil continually , who always sows discord .

verses.z: 所以，災難必忽然臨到他身；他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。
verses.e: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly . He will be broken suddenly , and that without remedy .

verses.z: 耶和華所恨惡的有六樣，連他心所憎惡的共有七樣：
verses.e: There are six things which the LORD hates ; yes , seven which are an abomination to him :

verses.z: 就是高傲的眼，撒謊的舌，流無辜人血的手，
verses.e: arrogant eyes , a lying tongue , hands that shed innocent blood ,

verses.z: 圖謀惡計的心，飛跑行惡的腳，
verses.e: a heart that devises wicked schemes , feet that are swift in running to mischief ,

verses.z: 吐謊言的假見證，並弟兄中布散紛爭的人。
verses.e: a false witness who utters lies , and he who sows discord among brothers .

verses.z: 你就被口中的話語纏住，被嘴裏的言語捉住。
verses.e: you are trapped by the words of your mouth ; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth .

verses.z: 我兒，要謹守你父親的誡命；不可離棄你母親的法則，
verses.e: My son , keep your father's commandment , and don't forsake your mother's teaching .

verses.z: 要常繫在你心上，掛在你項上。
verses.e: Bind them continually on your heart . Tie them around your neck .

verses.z: 你行走，它必引導你；你躺臥，它必保守你；你睡醒，它必與你談論。
verses.e: When you walk , it will lead you . When you sleep , it will watch over you . When you awake , it will talk with you .

verses.z: 因為誡命是燈，法則是光，訓誨的責備是生命的道，
verses.e: For the commandment is a lamp , and the law is light . Reproofs of instruction are the way of life ,

verses.z: 能保你遠離惡婦，遠離外女諂媚的舌頭。
verses.e: to keep you from the immoral woman , from the flattery of the wayward wife's tongue .

verses.z: 你心中不要戀慕她的美色，也不要被她眼皮勾引。
verses.e: Don't lust after her beauty in your heart , neither let her captivate you with her eyelids .

verses.z: 因為，妓女[能使人]只剩一塊餅；淫婦獵取人寶貴的生命。
verses.e: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread . The adulteress hunts for your precious life .

verses.z: 人若懷裏搋火，衣服豈能不燒呢？
verses.e: Can a man scoop fire into his lap , and his clothes not be burned ?

verses.z: 人若在火炭上走，腳豈能不燙呢？
verses.e: Or can one walk on hot coals , and his feet not be scorched ?

verses.z: 親近鄰舍之妻的，也是如此；凡挨近她的，不免受罰。
verses.e: So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife . Whoever touches her will not be unpunished .

verses.z: 我兒，你既落在朋友手中，就當這樣行才可救自己：你要自卑，去懇求你的朋友。
verses.e: Do this now , my son , and deliver yourself , since you have come into the hand of your neighbor . Go , humble yourself . Press your plea with your neighbor .

verses.z: 賊因飢餓偷竊充飢，人不藐視他，
verses.e: Men don't despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry ,

verses.z: 若被找着，他必賠還七倍，必將家中所有的盡都償還。
verses.e: but if he is found , he shall restore seven times . He shall give all the wealth of his house .

verses.z: 與婦人行淫的，便是無知；行這事的，必喪掉生命。
verses.e: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding . He who does it destroys his own soul .

verses.z: 他必受傷損，必被凌辱；他的羞恥不得塗抹。
verses.e: He will get wounds and dishonor . His reproach will not be wiped away .

verses.z: 因為人的嫉恨成了烈怒，報仇的時候決不留情。
verses.e: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband . He won't spare in the day of vengeance .

verses.z: 甚麼贖價，他都不顧；你雖送許多禮物，他也不肯干休。
verses.e: He won't regard any ransom , neither will he rest content , though you give many gifts .

verses.z: 不要容你的眼睛睡覺；不要容你的眼皮打盹。
verses.e: Give no sleep to your eyes , nor slumber to your eyelids .

verses.z: 要救自己，如鹿脫離[獵戶的]手，如鳥脫離捕鳥人的手。
verses.e: Free yourself , like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter , like a bird from the snare of the fowler .

verses.z: 懶惰人哪，你去察看螞蟻的動作就可得智慧。
verses.e: Go to the ant , you sluggard . Consider her ways , and be wise ;

verses.z: 螞蟻沒有元帥，沒有官長，沒有君王，
verses.e: which having no chief , overseer , or ruler ,

verses.z: 尚且在夏天預備食物，在收割時聚斂糧食。
verses.e: provides her bread in the summer , and gathers her food in the harvest .

verses.z: 懶惰人哪，你要睡到幾時呢？你何時睡醒呢？
verses.e: How long will you sleep , sluggard ? When will you arise out of your sleep ?

verses.z: 我兒，你要遵守我的言語，將我的命令存記在心。
verses.e: My son , keep my words . Lay up my commandments within you .

verses.z: 看哪，有一個婦人來迎接他，是妓女的打扮，有詭詐的心思。
verses.e: Behold , there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute , and with crafty intent .

verses.z: 這婦人喧嚷，不守約束，在家裏停不住腳，
verses.e: She is loud and defiant . Her feet don't stay in her house .

verses.z: 有時在街市上，有時在寬闊處，或在各巷口蹲伏，
verses.e: Now she is in the streets , now in the squares , and lurking at every corner .

verses.z: 拉住那少年人，與他親嘴，臉無羞恥對他說：
verses.e: So she caught him , and kissed him . With an impudent face she said to him :

verses.z: 平安祭在我這裏，今日才還了我所許的願。
verses.e: " Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me . Today I have paid my vows .

verses.z: 因此，我出來迎接你，懇切求見你的面，恰巧遇見了你。
verses.e: Therefore I came out to meet you , to diligently seek your face , and I have found you .

verses.z: 我已經用繡花毯子和埃及線織的花紋布鋪了我的床。
verses.e: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry , with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt .

verses.z: 我又用沒藥、沉香、桂皮薰了我的榻。
verses.e: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh , aloes , and cinnamon .

verses.z: 你來，我們可以飽享愛情，直到早晨；我們可以彼此親愛歡樂。
verses.e: Come , let's take our fill of loving until the morning . Let's solace ourselves with loving .

verses.z: 因為我丈夫不在家，出門行遠路；
verses.e: For my husband isn't at home . He has gone on a long journey .

verses.z: 遵守我的命令就得存活；保守我的法則，好像保守眼中的瞳人，
verses.e: Keep my commandments and live ! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye .

verses.z: 他手拿銀囊，必到月望才回家。
verses.e: He has taken a bag of money with him . He will come home at the full moon . "

verses.z: 淫婦用許多巧言誘他隨從，用諂媚的嘴逼他同行。
verses.e: With persuasive words , she led him astray . With the flattering of her lips , she seduced him .

verses.z: 少年人立刻跟隨她，好像牛往宰殺之地；又像愚昧人帶鎖鍊去受刑罰，
verses.e: He followed her immediately , as an ox goes to the slaughter , as a fool stepping into a noose .

verses.z: 直等箭穿他的肝；如同雀鳥急入網羅，卻不知是自喪己命。
verses.e: Until an arrow strikes through his liver , as a bird hurries to the snare , and doesn't know that it will cost his life .

verses.z: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我，留心聽我口中的話。
verses.e: Now therefore , sons , listen to me . Pay attention to the words of my mouth .

verses.z: 你的心不可偏向淫婦的道，不要入她的迷途。
verses.e: Don't let your heart turn to her ways . Don't go astray in her paths ,

verses.z: 因為，被她傷害仆倒的不少；被她殺戮的而且甚多。
verses.e: for she has thrown down many wounded . Yes , all her slain are a mighty army .

verses.z: 她的家是在陰間之路，下到死亡之宮。
verses.e: Her house is the way to Sheol , going down to the rooms of death .

verses.z: 繫在你指頭上，刻在你心版上。
verses.e: Bind them on your fingers . Write them on the tablet of your heart .

verses.z: 對智慧說：你是我的姊妹，稱呼聰明為你的親人，
verses.e: Tell wisdom , " You are my sister . " Call understanding your relative ,

verses.z: 她就保你遠離淫婦，遠離說諂媚話的外女。
verses.e: that they may keep you from the strange woman , from the foreigner who flatters with her words .

verses.z: 我曾在我房屋的窗戶內，從我窗欞之間往外觀看：
verses.e: For at the window of my house , I looked out through my lattice .

verses.z: 見愚蒙人內，少年人中，分明有一個無知的少年人，
verses.e: I saw among the simple ones . I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding ,

verses.z: 從街上經過，走近淫婦的巷口，直往通她家的路去，
verses.e: passing through the street near her corner , he went the way to her house ,

verses.z: 在黃昏，或晚上，或半夜，或黑暗之中。
verses.e: in the twilight , in the evening of the day , in the middle of the night and in the darkness .

verses.z: 智慧豈不呼叫？聰明豈不發聲？
verses.e: Doesn't wisdom cry out ? Doesn't understanding raise her voice ?

verses.z: 你們當受我的教訓，不受白銀；寧得知識，勝過黃金。
verses.e: Receive my instruction rather than silver , knowledge rather than choice gold .

verses.z: 因為智慧比珍珠更美；一切可喜愛的都不足與比較。
verses.e: For wisdom is better than rubies . All the things that may be desired can't be compared to it .

verses.z: 我－智慧以靈明為居所，又尋得知識和謀略。
verses.e: " I , wisdom , have made prudence my dwelling . Find out knowledge and discretion .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華在乎恨惡邪惡；那驕傲、狂妄，並惡道，以及乖謬的口，都為我所恨惡。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil . I hate pride , arrogance , the evil way , and the perverse mouth .

verses.z: 我有謀略和真知識；我乃聰明，我有能力。
verses.e: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine . I have understanding and power .

verses.z: 帝王藉我坐國位；君王藉我定公平。
verses.e: By me kings reign , and princes decree justice .

verses.z: 王子和首領，世上一切的審判官，都是藉我掌權。
verses.e: By me princes rule , nobles , and all the righteous rulers of the earth .

verses.z: 愛我的，我也愛他；懇切尋求我的，必尋得見。
verses.e: I love those who love me . Those who seek me diligently will find me .

verses.z: 豐富尊榮在我；恆久的財並公義也在我。
verses.e: With me are riches , honor , enduring wealth , and prosperity .

verses.z: 我的果實勝過黃金，強如精金；我的出產超乎高銀。
verses.e: My fruit is better than gold , yes , than fine gold , my yield than choice silver .

verses.z: 她在道旁高處的頂上，在十字路口站立，
verses.e: On the top of high places by the way , where the paths meet , she stands .

verses.z: 我在公義的道上走，在公平的路中行，
verses.e: I walk in the way of righteousness , in the middle of the paths of justice ,

verses.z: 使愛我的，承受貨財，並充滿他們的府庫。
verses.e: that I may give wealth to those who love me . I fill their treasuries .

verses.z: 在耶和華造化的起頭，在太初創造萬物之先，就有了我。
verses.e: " The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work , before his deeds of old .

verses.z: 從亙古，從太初，未有世界以前，我已被立。
verses.e: I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , before the earth existed .

verses.z: 沒有深淵，沒有大水的泉源，我已生出。
verses.e: When there were no depths , I was born , when there were no springs abounding with water .

verses.z: 大山未曾奠定，小山未有之先，我已生出。
verses.e: Before the mountains were settled in place , before the hills , I was born ;

verses.z: 耶和華還沒有創造大地和田野，並世上的土質，我已生出。
verses.e: while as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the beginning of the dust of the world .

verses.z: 他立高天，我在那裏；他在淵面的周圍，劃出圓圈。
verses.e: When he established the heavens , I was there . When he set a circle on the surface of the deep ,

verses.z: 上使穹蒼堅硬，下使淵源穩固，
verses.e: when he established the clouds above , when the springs of the deep became strong ,

verses.z: 為滄海定出界限，使水不越過他的命令，立定大地的根基。
verses.e: when he gave to the sea its boundary , that the waters should not violate his commandment , when he marked out the foundations of the earth ,

verses.z: 在城門旁，在城門口，在城門洞，大聲說：
verses.e: Beside the gates , at the entry of the city , at the entry doors , she cries aloud :

verses.z: 那時，我在他那裏為工師，日日為他所喜愛，常常在他面前踴躍，
verses.e: then I was the craftsman by his side . I was a delight day by day , always rejoicing before him ,

verses.z: 踴躍在他為人[預備]可住之地，也喜悅住在世人之間。
verses.e: rejoicing in his whole world . My delight was with the sons of men .

verses.z: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我，因為謹守我道的，便為有福。
verses.e: " Now therefore , my sons , listen to me , for blessed are those who keep my ways .

verses.z: 要聽教訓就得智慧，不可棄絕。
verses.e: Hear instruction , and be wise . Don't refuse it .

verses.z: 聽從我、日日在我門口仰望、在我門框旁邊等候的，那人便為有福。
verses.e: Blessed is the man who hears me , watching daily at my gates , waiting at my door posts .

verses.z: 因為尋得我的，就尋得生命，也必蒙耶和華的恩惠。
verses.e: For whoever finds me finds life , and will obtain favor from the LORD .

verses.z: 得罪我的，卻害了自己的性命；恨惡我的，都喜愛死亡。
verses.e: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul . All those who hate me love death . "

verses.z: 眾人哪，我呼叫你們，我向世人發聲。
verses.e: " I call to you men ! I send my voice to the sons of mankind .

verses.z: 說：愚蒙人哪，你們要會悟靈明；愚昧人哪，你們當心裏明白。
verses.e: You simple , understand prudence ! You fools , be of an understanding heart !

verses.z: 你們當聽，因我要說極美的話；我張嘴要論正直的事。
verses.e: Hear , for I will speak excellent things . The opening of my lips is for right things .

verses.z: 我的口要發出真理；我的嘴憎惡邪惡。
verses.e: For my mouth speaks truth . Wickedness is an abomination to my lips .

verses.z: 我口中的言語都是公義，並無彎曲乖僻。
verses.e: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness . There is nothing crooked or perverse in them .

verses.z: 有聰明的，以為明顯，得知識的，以為正直。
verses.e: They are all plain to him who understands , right to those who find knowledge .

verses.z: 智慧建造房屋，鑿成七根柱子，
verses.e: Wisdom has built her house . She has carved out her seven pillars .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端；認識至聖者便是聰明。
verses.e: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom . The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding .

verses.z: 你藉着我，日子必增多，年歲也必加添。
verses.e: For by me your days will be multiplied . The years of your life will be increased .

verses.z: 你若有智慧，是與自己有益；你若褻慢，就必獨自擔當。
verses.e: If you are wise , you are wise for yourself . If you mock , you alone will bear it .

verses.z: 愚昧的婦人喧嚷；她是愚蒙，一無所知。
verses.e: The foolish woman is loud , undisciplined , and knows nothing .

verses.z: 她坐在自己的家門口，坐在城中高處的座位上，
verses.e: She sits at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,

verses.z: 呼叫過路的，就是直行其道的人，
verses.e: to call to those who pass by , who go straight on their ways ,

verses.z: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裏來！又對那無知的人說：
verses.e: " Whoever is simple , let him turn in here . " As for him who is void of understanding , she says to him ,

verses.z: 偷來的水是甜的，暗[吃的]餅是好的。
verses.e: " Stolen water is sweet . Food eaten in secret is pleasant . "

verses.z: 人卻不知有陰魂在她那裏；她的客在陰間的深處。
verses.e: But he doesn't know that the departed spirits are there , that her guests are in the depths of Sheol .

verses.z: 宰殺牲畜，調和旨酒，設擺筵席；
verses.e: She has prepared her meat . She has mixed her wine . She has also set her table .

verses.z: 打發使女出去，自己在城中至高處呼叫，
verses.e: She has sent out her maidens . She cries from the highest places of the city :

verses.z: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裏來！又對那無知的人說：
verses.e: " Whoever is simple , let him turn in here ! " As for him who is void of understanding , she says to him ,

verses.z: 你們來，吃我的餅，喝我調和的酒。
verses.e: " Come , eat some of my bread , Drink some of the wine which I have mixed !

verses.z: 你們愚蒙人，要捨棄[愚蒙]，就得存活，並要走光明的道。
verses.e: Leave your simple ways , and live . Walk in the way of understanding . "

verses.z: 指斥褻慢人的，必受辱罵；責備惡人的，必被玷污。
verses.e: One who corrects a mocker invites insult . One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse .

verses.z: 不要責備褻慢人，恐怕他恨你；要責備智慧人，他必愛你。
verses.e: Don't reprove a scoffer , lest he hate you . Reprove a wise person , and he will love you .

verses.z: [教導]智慧人，他就越發有智慧；指示義人，他就增長學問。
verses.e: Instruct a wise person , and he will be still wiser . Teach a righteous person , and he will increase in learning .

verses.z: 不從惡人的計謀，不站罪人的道路，不坐褻慢人的座位，
verses.e: Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked , nor stand on the path of sinners , nor sit in the seat of scoffers ;

verses.z: 惟喜愛耶和華的律法，晝夜思想，這人便為有福！
verses.e: but his delight is in the LORD's law . On his law he meditates day and night .

verses.z: 他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁，按時候結果子，葉子也不枯乾。凡他所做的盡都順利。
verses.e: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water , that produces its fruit in its season , whose leaf also does not wither . Whatever he does shall prosper .

verses.z: 惡人並不是這樣，乃像糠詷被風吹散。
verses.e: The wicked are not so , but are like the chaff which the wind drives away .

verses.z: 因此，當審判的時候，惡人必站立不住；罪人在義人的會中也是如此。
verses.e: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .

verses.z: 因為耶和華知道義人的道路；惡人的道路卻必滅亡。
verses.e: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous , but the way of the wicked shall perish .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你為甚麼站在遠處？在患難的時候為甚麼隱藏？
verses.e: Why do you stand far off , LORD ? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble ?

verses.z: 他屈身蹲伏，無倚無靠的人就倒在他爪牙之下。
verses.e: The helpless are crushed . They collapse . They fall under his strength .

verses.z: 他心裏說：上帝竟忘記了；他掩面永不觀看。
verses.e: He says in his heart , " God has forgotten . He hides his face . He will never see it . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你起來！上帝啊，求你舉手，不要忘記困苦人！
verses.e: Arise , LORD ! God , lift up your hand ! Don't forget the helpless .

verses.z: 惡人為何輕慢上帝，心裏說：你必不追究？
verses.e: Why does the wicked person condemn God , and say in his heart , " God won't call me into account " ?

verses.z: [其實]你已經觀看；因為奸惡毒害，你都看見了，為要以手施行報應。無倚無靠的人把[自己]交託你；你向來是幫助孤兒的。
verses.e: But you do see trouble and grief . You consider it to take it into your hand . You help the victim and the fatherless .

verses.z: 願你打斷惡人的膀臂；至於壞人，願你追究他的惡，直到淨盡。
verses.e: Break the arm of the wicked . As for the evil man , seek out his wickedness until you find none .

verses.z: 耶和華永永遠遠為王；外邦人從他的地已經滅絕了。
verses.e: The LORD is King forever and ever ! The nations will perish out of his land .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，謙卑人的心願，你早已知道。你必預備他們的心，也必側耳聽他們[的祈求]，
verses.e: LORD , you have heard the desire of the humble . You will prepare their heart . You will cause your ear to hear ,

verses.z: 為要給孤兒和受欺壓的人伸冤，使強橫的人不再威嚇他們。
verses.e: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed , that man who is of the earth may terrify no more .

verses.z: 惡人在驕橫中把困苦人追得火急；願他們陷在自己所設的計謀裏。
verses.e: In arrogance , the wicked hunt down the weak . They are caught in the schemes that they devise .

verses.z: 因為惡人以心願自誇；貪財的背棄耶和華，並且輕慢他。
verses.e: For the wicked boasts of his heart's cravings . He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD .

verses.z: 惡人面帶驕傲，[說]：耶和華必不追究；他一切所想的都以為沒有上帝。
verses.e: The wicked , in the pride of his face , has no room in his thoughts for God .

verses.z: 凡他所做的，時常穩固；你的審判超過他的眼界。至於他一切的敵人，他都向他們噴氣。
verses.e: His ways are prosperous at all times . He is arrogant , and your laws are far from his sight . As for all his adversaries , he sneers at them .

verses.z: 他心裏說：我必不動搖，世世代代不遭災難。
verses.e: He says in his heart , " I shall not be shaken . For generations I shall have no trouble . "

verses.z: 他滿口是咒罵、詭詐、欺壓，舌底是毒害、奸惡。
verses.e: His mouth is full of cursing , deceit , and oppression . Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity .

verses.z: 他在村莊埋伏等候；他在隱密處殺害無辜的人。他的眼睛窺探無倚無靠的人；
verses.e: He lies in wait near the villages . From ambushes , he murders the innocent . His eyes are secretly set against the helpless .

verses.z: 他埋伏在暗地，如獅子蹲在洞中。他埋伏，要擄去困苦人；他拉網，就把困苦人擄去。
verses.e: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush . He lies in wait to catch the helpless . He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net .

verses.z: 稱謝詩。普天下當向耶和華歡呼！
verses.e: A Psalm of thanksgiving . Shout for joy to the LORD , all you lands !

verses.z: 你們當樂意事奉耶和華，當來向他歌唱！
verses.e: Serve the LORD with gladness . Come before his presence with singing .

verses.z: 你們當曉得耶和華是上帝！我們是他造的，也是屬他的；我們是他的民，也是他草場的羊。
verses.e: Know that the LORD , he is God . It is he who has made us , and we are his . We are his people , and the sheep of his pasture .

verses.z: 當稱謝進入他的門；當讚美進入他的院。當感謝他，稱頌他的名！
verses.e: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving , and into his courts with praise . Give thanks to him , and bless his name .

verses.z: 因為耶和華本為善。他的慈愛存到永遠；他的信實直到萬代。
verses.e: For the LORD is good . His loving kindness endures forever , his faithfulness to all generations .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。我要歌唱慈愛和公平；耶和華啊，我要向你歌頌！
verses.e: A Psalm by David . I will sing of loving kindness and justice . To you , LORD , I will sing praises .

verses.z: 我要用智慧行完全的道。你幾時到我這裏來呢？我要存完全的心行在我家中。
verses.e: I will be careful to live a blameless life . When will you come to me ? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart .

verses.z: 邪僻的事，我都不擺在我眼前；悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨惡，不容沾在我身上。
verses.e: I will set no vile thing before my eyes . I hate the deeds of faithless men . They will not cling to me .

verses.z: 彎曲的心思，我必遠離；一切的惡人，我不認識。
verses.e: A perverse heart will be far from me . I will have nothing to do with evil .

verses.z: 在暗中讒謗他鄰居的，我必將他滅絕；眼目高傲、心裏驕縱的，我必不容他。
verses.e: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor . I won't tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited .

verses.z: 我眼要看國中的誠實人，叫他們與我同住；行為完全的，他要伺候我。
verses.e: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land , that they may dwell with me . He who walks in a perfect way , he will serve me .

verses.z: 行詭詐的，必不得住在我家裏；說謊話的，必不得立在我眼前。
verses.e: He who practices deceit won't dwell within my house . He who speaks falsehood won't be established before my eyes .

verses.z: 我每日早晨要滅絕國中所有的惡人，好把一切作孽的從耶和華的城裏剪除。
verses.e: Morning by morning , I will destroy all the wicked of the land , to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD's city .

verses.z: 困苦人發昏的時候，在耶和華面前吐露苦情的禱告。耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，容我的呼求達到你面前！
verses.e: A Prayer of the afflicted , when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD . Hear my prayer , LORD ! Let my cry come to you .

verses.z: 這都因你的惱恨和忿怒；你把我拾起來，又把我摔下去。
verses.e: because of your indignation and your wrath ; for you have taken me up and thrown me away .

verses.z: 我的年日如日影偏斜；我也如草枯乾。
verses.e: My days are like a long shadow . I have withered like grass .

verses.z: 惟你－耶和華必存到永遠；你可記念的[名]也存到萬代。
verses.e: But you , LORD , will remain forever ; your renown endures to all generations .

verses.z: 你必起來憐恤錫安，因現在是可憐她的時候，日期已經到了。
verses.e: You will arise and have mercy on Zion , for it is time to have pity on her . Yes , the set time has come .

verses.z: 你的僕人原來喜悅她的石頭，可憐她的塵土。
verses.e: For your servants take pleasure in her stones , and have pity on her dust .

verses.z: 列國要敬畏耶和華的名；世上諸王都敬畏你的榮耀。
verses.e: So the nations will fear the LORD's name , all the kings of the earth your glory .

verses.z: 因為耶和華建造了錫安，在他榮耀裏顯現。
verses.e: For the LORD has built up Zion . He has appeared in his glory .

verses.z: 他垂聽窮人的禱告，並不藐視他們的祈求。
verses.e: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute , and has not despised their prayer .

verses.z: 這必為後代的人記下，將來受造的民要讚美耶和華。
verses.e: This will be written for the generation to come . A people which will be created will praise the LORD ,

verses.z: 因為，他從至高的聖所垂看；耶和華從天向地觀察，
verses.e: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary . From heaven , the LORD saw the earth ,

verses.z: 我在急難的日子，求你向我側耳；不要向我掩面！我呼求的日子，求你快快應允我！
verses.e: Don't hide your face from me in the day of my distress . Turn your ear to me . Answer me quickly in the day when I call .

verses.z: 要垂聽被囚之人的歎息，要釋放將要死的人，
verses.e: to hear the groans of the prisoner , to free those who are condemned to death ,

verses.z: 使人在錫安傳揚耶和華的名，在耶路撒冷傳揚讚美他的話，
verses.e: that men may declare the LORD's name in Zion , and his praise in Jerusalem ,

verses.z: 就是在萬民和列國聚會事奉耶和華的時候。
verses.e: when the peoples are gathered together , the kingdoms , to serve the LORD .

verses.z: 他使我的力量中道衰弱，使我的年日短少。
verses.e: He weakened my strength along the course . He shortened my days .

verses.z: 我說：我的上帝啊，不要使我中年去世。你的年數世世無窮！
verses.e: I said , " My God , don't take me away in the middle of my days . Your years are throughout all generations .

verses.z: 你起初立了地的根基；天也是你手所造的。
verses.e: Of old , you laid the foundation of the earth . The heavens are the work of your hands .

verses.z: 天地都要滅沒，你卻要長存；天地都要如外衣漸漸舊了。你要將天地如裏衣更換，天地就都改變了。
verses.e: They will perish , but you will endure . Yes , all of them will wear out like a garment . You will change them like a cloak , and they will be changed .

verses.z: 惟有你永不改變；你的年數沒有窮盡。
verses.e: But you are the same . Your years will have no end .

verses.z: 你僕人的子孫要長存；他們的後裔要堅立在你面前。
verses.e: The children of your servants will continue . Their offspring will be established before you . "

verses.z: 因為，我的年日如煙雲消滅；我的骨頭如火把燒着。
verses.e: For my days consume away like smoke . My bones are burned as a torch .

verses.z: 我的心被傷，如草枯乾，甚至我忘記吃飯。
verses.e: My heart is blighted like grass , and withered , for I forget to eat my bread .

verses.z: 因我唉哼的聲音，我的肉緊貼骨頭。
verses.e: By reason of the voice of my groaning , my bones stick to my skin .

verses.z: 我如同曠野的鵜鶘；我好像荒場的鴞鳥。
verses.e: I am like a pelican of the wilderness . I have become as an owl of the waste places .

verses.z: 我警醒不睡；我像房頂上孤單的麻雀。
verses.e: I watch , and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop .

verses.z: 我的仇敵終日辱罵我；向我猖狂的人指着我賭咒。
verses.e: My enemies reproach me all day . Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse .

verses.z: 我吃過爐灰，如同吃飯；我所喝的與眼淚攙雜。
verses.e: For I have eaten ashes like bread , and mixed my drink with tears ,

verses.z: 大衛的詩。我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！凡在我裏面的，也要稱頌他的聖名！
verses.e: By David . Praise the LORD , my soul ! All that is within me , praise his holy name !

verses.z: 他沒有按我們的罪過待我們，也沒有照我們的罪孽報應我們。
verses.e: He has not dealt with us according to our sins , nor repaid us for our iniquities .

verses.z: 天離地何等的高，他的慈愛向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！
verses.e: For as the heavens are high above the earth , so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him .

verses.z: 東離西有多遠，他叫我們的過犯離我們也有多遠！
verses.e: As far as the east is from the west , so far has he removed our transgressions from us .

verses.z: 父親怎樣憐恤他的兒女，耶和華也怎樣憐恤敬畏他的人！
verses.e: Like a father has compassion on his children , so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him .

verses.z: 因為他知道我們的本體，思念我們不過是塵土。
verses.e: For he knows how we are made . He remembers that we are dust .

verses.z: 至於世人，他的年日如草一樣。他發旺如野地的花，
verses.e: As for man , his days are like grass . As a flower of the field , so he flourishes .

verses.z: 經風一吹，便歸無有；它的原處也不再認識它。
verses.e: For the wind passes over it , and it is gone . Its place remembers it no more .

verses.z: 但耶和華的慈愛歸於敬畏他的人，從亙古到永遠；他的公義也歸於子子孫孫－
verses.e: But the LORD's loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him , his righteousness to children's children ,

verses.z: 就是那些遵守他的約、記念他的訓詞而遵行的人。
verses.e: to those who keep his covenant , to those who remember to obey his precepts .

verses.z: 耶和華在天上立定寶座；他的權柄統管萬有。
verses.e: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens . His kingdom rules over all .

verses.z: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！不可忘記他的一切恩惠！
verses.e: Praise the LORD , my soul , and don't forget all his benefits ,

verses.z: 聽從他命令、成全他旨意、有大能的天使，都要稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: Praise the LORD , you angels of his , who are mighty in strength , who fulfill his word , obeying the voice of his word .

verses.z: 你們作他的諸軍，作他的僕役，行他所喜悅的，都要稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: Praise the LORD , all you armies of his , you servants of his , who do his pleasure .

verses.z: 你們一切被他造的，在他所治理的各處，都要稱頌耶和華！我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: Praise the LORD , all you works of his , in all places of his dominion . Praise the LORD , my soul !

verses.z: 他赦免你的一切罪孽，醫治你的一切疾病。
verses.e: who forgives all your sins , who heals all your diseases ,

verses.z: 他救贖你的命脫離死亡，以仁愛和慈悲為你的冠冕。
verses.e: who redeems your life from destruction , who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies ,

verses.z: 他用美物使你所願的得以知足，以致你如鷹返老還童。
verses.e: who satisfies your desire with good things , so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's .

verses.z: 耶和華施行公義，為一切受屈的人伸冤。
verses.e: The LORD executes righteous acts , and justice for all who are oppressed .

verses.z: 他使摩西知道他的法則，叫以色列人曉得他的作為。
verses.e: He made known his ways to Moses , his deeds to the children of Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華有憐憫，有恩典，不輕易發怒，且有豐盛的慈愛。
verses.e: The LORD is merciful and gracious , slow to anger , and abundant in loving kindness .

verses.z: 他不長久責備，也不永遠懷[怒]。
verses.e: He will not always accuse ; neither will he stay angry forever .

verses.z: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！耶和華－我的上帝啊，你為至大！你以尊榮威嚴為衣服，
verses.e: Bless the LORD , my soul . The LORD , my God , you are very great . You are clothed with honor and majesty .

verses.z: 耶和華使泉源湧在山谷，流在山間，
verses.e: He sends springs into the valleys . They run among the mountains .

verses.z: 使野地的走獸有水喝，野驢得解其渴。
verses.e: They give drink to every animal of the field . The wild donkeys quench their thirst .

verses.z: 天上的飛鳥在水旁住宿，在樹枝上啼叫。
verses.e: The birds of the sky nest by them . They sing among the branches .

verses.z: 他從樓閣中澆灌山嶺；因他作為的功效，地就豐足。
verses.e: He waters the mountains from his rooms . The earth is filled with the fruit of your works .

verses.z: 他使草生長，給六畜吃，使菜蔬發長，供給人用，使人從地裏能得食物，
verses.e: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock , and plants for man to cultivate , that he may produce food out of the earth :

verses.z: 又得酒能悅人心，得油能潤人面，得糧能養人心。
verses.e: wine that makes the heart of man glad , oil to make his face to shine , and bread that strengthens man's heart .

verses.z: 佳美的樹木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏樹，是耶和華所栽種的，都滿了[汁漿]。
verses.e: The LORD's trees are well watered , the cedars of Lebanon , which he has planted ,

verses.z: 雀鳥在其上搭窩；至於鶴，松樹是牠的房屋。
verses.e: where the birds make their nests . The stork makes its home in the cypress trees .

verses.z: 高山為野山羊[的住所]；巖石為沙番的藏處。
verses.e: The high mountains are for the wild goats . The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers .

verses.z: 你安置月亮為定節令；日頭自知沉落。
verses.e: He appointed the moon for seasons . The sun knows when to set .

verses.z: 披上亮光，如披外袍，鋪張穹蒼，如鋪幔子，
verses.e: He covers himself with light as with a garment . He stretches out the heavens like a curtain .

verses.z: 你造黑暗為夜，林中的百獸就都爬出來。
verses.e: You make darkness , and it is night , in which all the animals of the forest prowl .

verses.z: 少壯獅子吼叫，要抓食，向上帝尋求食物。
verses.e: The young lions roar after their prey , and seek their food from God .

verses.z: 日頭一出，獸便躲避，臥在洞裏。
verses.e: The sun rises , and they steal away , and lie down in their dens .

verses.z: 人出去做工，勞碌直到晚上。
verses.e: Man goes out to his work , to his labor until the evening .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地滿了你的豐富。
verses.e: LORD , how many are your works ! In wisdom , you have made them all . The earth is full of your riches .

verses.z: 那裏有海，又大又廣；其中有無數的動物，大小活物都有。
verses.e: There is the sea , great and wide , in which are innumerable living things , both small and large animals .

verses.z: 那裏有船行走，有你所造的鱷魚游泳在其中。
verses.e: There the ships go , and leviathan , whom you formed to play there .

verses.z: 這都仰望你按時給牠食物。
verses.e: These all wait for you , that you may give them their food in due season .

verses.z: 你給牠們，牠們便拾起來；你張手，牠們飽得美食。
verses.e: You give to them ; they gather . You open your hand ; they are satisfied with good .

verses.z: 你掩面，牠們便驚惶；你收回牠們的氣，牠們就死亡，歸於塵土。
verses.e: You hide your face ; they are troubled . You take away their breath ; they die and return to the dust .

verses.z: 在水中立樓閣的棟樑，用雲彩為車輦，藉着風的翅膀而行，
verses.e: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters . He makes the clouds his chariot . He walks on the wings of the wind .

verses.z: 你發出你的靈，牠們便受造；你使地面更換為新。
verses.e: You send out your Spirit and they are created . You renew the face of the ground .

verses.z: 願耶和華的榮耀存到永遠！願耶和華喜悅自己所造的！
verses.e: Let the LORD's glory endure forever . Let the LORD rejoice in his works .

verses.z: 他看地，地便震動；他摸山，山就冒煙。
verses.e: He looks at the earth , and it trembles . He touches the mountains , and they smoke .

verses.z: 我要一生向耶和華唱詩！我還活的時候，要向我上帝歌頌！
verses.e: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live . I will sing praise to my God while I have any being .

verses.z: 願他以我的默念為甘甜！我要因耶和華歡喜！
verses.e: Let my meditation be sweet to him . I will rejoice in the LORD .

verses.z: 願罪人從世上消滅！願惡人歸於無有！我的心哪，要稱頌耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth . Let the wicked be no more . Bless the LORD , my soul . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 以風為使者，以火焰為僕役，
verses.e: He makes his messengers winds , and his servants flames of fire .

verses.z: 將地立在根基上，使地永不動搖。
verses.e: He laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be moved forever .

verses.z: 你用深水遮蓋地面，猶如衣裳；諸水高過山嶺。
verses.e: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak . The waters stood above the mountains .

verses.z: 你的斥責一發，水便奔逃；你的雷聲一發，水便奔流。
verses.e: At your rebuke they fled . At the voice of your thunder they hurried away .

verses.z: 諸山升上，諸谷沉下，歸你為它所安定之地。
verses.e: The mountains rose , the valleys sank down , to the place which you had assigned to them .

verses.z: 你定了界限，使水不能過去，不再轉回遮蓋地面。
verses.e: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over , that they don't turn again to cover the earth .

verses.z: 你們要稱謝耶和華，求告他的名，在萬民中傳揚他的作為！
verses.e: Give thanks to the LORD ! Call on his name ! Make his doings known among the peoples .

verses.z: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例，向以色列定為永遠的約，
verses.e: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute ; to Israel for an everlasting covenant ,

verses.z: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你，作你產業的分。
verses.e: saying , " To you I will give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance , "

verses.z: 當時，他們人丁有限，數目稀少，並且在那地為寄居的。
verses.e: when they were but a few men in number , yes , very few , and foreigners in it .

verses.z: 他們從這邦遊到那邦，從這國行到那國。
verses.e: They went about from nation to nation , from one kingdom to another people .

verses.z: 他不容甚麼人欺負他們，為他們的緣故責備君王，
verses.e: He allowed no one to do them wrong . Yes , he reproved kings for their sakes ,

verses.z: 說：不可難為我受膏的人，也不可惡待我的先知。
verses.e: " Don't touch my anointed ones ! Do my prophets no harm ! "

verses.z: 他命饑荒降在那地上，將所倚靠的糧食全行斷絕，
verses.e: He called for a famine on the land . He destroyed the food supplies .

verses.z: 在他們以先打發一個人去－約瑟被賣為奴僕。
verses.e: He sent a man before them . Joseph was sold for a slave .

verses.z: 人用腳鐐傷他的腳；他被鐵[鍊]捆拘。
verses.e: They bruised his feet with shackles . His neck was locked in irons ,

verses.z: 耶和華的話試煉他，直等到他所說的應驗了。
verses.e: until the time that his word happened , and the LORD's word proved him true .

verses.z: 要向他唱詩歌頌，談論他一切奇妙的作為！
verses.e: Sing to him , sing praises to him ! Tell of all his marvelous works .

verses.z: 王打發人把他解開，就是治理眾民的，把他釋放，
verses.e: The king sent and freed him , even the ruler of peoples , and let him go free .

verses.z: 立他作王家之主，掌管他一切所有的，
verses.e: He made him lord of his house , and ruler of all of his possessions ,

verses.z: 使他隨意捆綁他的臣宰，將智慧教導他的長老。
verses.e: to discipline his princes at his pleasure , and to teach his elders wisdom .

verses.z: 以色列也到了埃及；雅各在含地寄居。
verses.e: Israel also came into Egypt . Jacob lived in the land of Ham .

verses.z: 耶和華使他的百姓生養眾多，使他們比敵人強盛，
verses.e: He increased his people greatly , and made them stronger than their adversaries .

verses.z: 使敵人的心轉去恨他的百姓，並用詭計待他的僕人。
verses.e: He turned their heart to hate his people , to conspire against his servants .

verses.z: 他打發他的僕人摩西和他所揀選的亞倫，
verses.e: He sent Moses , his servant , and Aaron , whom he had chosen .

verses.z: 在敵人中間顯他的神蹟，在含地顯他的奇事。
verses.e: They performed miracles among them , and wonders in the land of Ham .

verses.z: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗；沒有違背他話的。
verses.e: He sent darkness , and made it dark . They didn't rebel against his words .

verses.z: 他叫埃及的水變為血，叫他們的魚死了。
verses.e: He turned their waters into blood , and killed their fish .

verses.z: 要以他的聖名誇耀！尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜！
verses.e: Glory in his holy name . Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice .

verses.z: 在他們的地上以及王宮的內室，青蛙多多滋生。
verses.e: Their land swarmed with frogs , even in the rooms of their kings .

verses.z: 他說一聲，蒼蠅就成群而來，並有虱子進入他們四境。
verses.e: He spoke , and swarms of flies came , and lice in all their borders .

verses.z: 他給他們降下冰雹為雨，在他們的地上降下火焰。
verses.e: He gave them hail for rain , with lightning in their land .

verses.z: 他也擊打他們的葡萄樹和無花果樹，毀壞他們境內的樹木。
verses.e: He struck their vines and also their fig trees , and shattered the trees of their country .

verses.z: 他說一聲，就有蝗蟲螞蚱上來，不計其數，
verses.e: He spoke , and the locusts came with the grasshoppers , without number .

verses.z: 吃盡了他們地上各樣的菜蔬和田地的出產。
verses.e: They ate up every plant in their land , and ate up the fruit of their ground .

verses.z: 他又擊殺他們國內一切的長子，就是他們強壯時頭生的。
verses.e: He struck also all the firstborn in their land , the first fruits of all their manhood .

verses.z: 他領自己的百姓帶銀子金子出來；他支派中沒有一個軟弱的。
verses.e: He brought them out with silver and gold . There was not one feeble person among his tribes .

verses.z: 他們出來的時候，埃及人便歡喜；原來埃及人懼怕他們。
verses.e: Egypt was glad when they departed , for the fear of them had fallen on them .

verses.z: 他鋪張雲彩當遮蓋，夜間使火光照。
verses.e: He spread a cloud for a covering , fire to give light in the night .

verses.z: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力，時常尋求他的面。
verses.e: Seek the LORD and his strength . Seek his face forever more .

verses.z: 他們一求，他就使鵪鶉飛來，並用天上的糧食叫他們飽足。
verses.e: They asked , and he brought quails , and satisfied them with the bread of the sky .

verses.z: 他打開磐石，水就湧出；在乾旱之處，水流成河。
verses.e: He opened the rock , and waters gushed out . They ran as a river in the dry places .

verses.z: 這都因他記念他的聖言和他的僕人亞伯拉罕。
verses.e: For he remembered his holy word , and Abraham , his servant .

verses.z: 他帶領百姓歡樂而出，帶領選民歡呼前往。
verses.e: He brought his people out with joy , his chosen with singing .

verses.z: 他將列國的地賜給他們，他們便承受眾民勞碌得來的，
verses.e: He gave them the lands of the nations . They took the labor of the peoples in possession ,

verses.z: 好使他們遵他的律例，守他的律法。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: that they might keep his statutes , and observe his laws . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 他僕人亞伯拉罕的後裔，他所揀選雅各的子孫哪，你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事，並他口中的判語。
verses.e: Remember his marvelous works that he has done : his wonders , and the judgments of his mouth ,
you offspring of Abraham , his servant , you children of Jacob , his chosen ones .

verses.z: 他是耶和華－我們的上帝；全地都有他的判斷。
verses.e: He is the LORD , our God . His judgments are in all the earth .

verses.z: 他記念他的約，直到永遠；他所吩咐的話，直到千代－
verses.e: He has remembered his covenant forever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations ,

verses.z: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的[約]，向以撒所起的誓。
verses.e: the covenant which he made with Abraham , his oath to Isaac ,

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Give thanks to the LORD , for he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 他拯救他們脫離恨他們人的手，從仇敵手中救贖他們。
verses.e: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .

verses.z: 水淹沒他們的敵人，沒有一個存留。
verses.e: The waters covered their adversaries . There was not one of them left .

verses.z: 那時，他們才信了他的話，歌唱讚美他。
verses.e: Then they believed his words . They sang his praise .

verses.z: 等不多時，他們就忘了他的作為，不仰望他的指教，
verses.e: They soon forgot his works . They didn't wait for his counsel ,

verses.z: 反倒在曠野大起慾心，在荒地試探上帝。
verses.e: but gave in to craving in the desert , and tested God in the wasteland .

verses.z: 他將他們所求的賜給他們，卻使他們的心靈軟弱。
verses.e: He gave them their request , but sent leanness into their soul .

verses.z: 他們又在營中嫉妒摩西和耶和華的聖者亞倫。
verses.e: They envied Moses also in the camp , and Aaron , the LORD's saint .

verses.z: 地裂開，吞下大坍，掩蓋亞比蘭一黨的人。
verses.e: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .

verses.z: 有火在他們的黨中發起；有火焰燒毀了惡人。
verses.e: A fire was kindled in their company . The flame burned up the wicked .

verses.z: 他們在何烈山造了牛犢，叩拜鑄成的像。
verses.e: They made a calf in Horeb , and worshiped a molten image .

verses.z: 誰能傳說耶和華的大能？誰能表明他一切的美德？
verses.e: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD , or fully declare all his praise ?

verses.z: 如此將他們榮耀[的主]換為吃草之牛的像，
verses.e: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass .

verses.z: 忘了上帝－他們的救主；他曾在埃及行大事，
verses.e: They forgot God , their Savior , who had done great things in Egypt ,

verses.z: 在含地行奇事，在紅海行可畏的事。
verses.e: wondrous works in the land of Ham , and awesome things by the Red Sea .

verses.z: 所以，他說要滅絕他們；若非有他所揀選的摩西站在當中，使他的忿怒轉消，恐怕他就滅絕他們。
verses.e: Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had Moses , his chosen , not stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , so that he wouldn't destroy them .

verses.z: 他們又藐視那美地，不信他的話，
verses.e: Yes , they despised the pleasant land . They didn't believe his word ,

verses.z: 在自己帳棚內發怨言，不聽耶和華的聲音。
verses.e: but murmured in their tents , and didn't listen to the LORD's voice .

verses.z: 所以，他對他們起誓：必叫他們倒在曠野，
verses.e: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness ,

verses.z: 叫他們的後裔倒在列國之中，分散在各地。
verses.e: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations , and scatter them in the lands .

verses.z: 他們又與巴力‧毗珥連合，且吃了祭死神的物。
verses.e: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor , and ate the sacrifices of the dead .

verses.z: 他們這樣行，惹耶和華發怒，便有瘟疫流行在他們中間。
verses.e: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds . The plague broke in on them .

verses.z: 凡遵守公平、常行公義的，這人便為有福！
verses.e: Blessed are those who keep justice . Blessed is one who does what is right at all times .

verses.z: 那時，非尼哈站起，刑罰惡人，瘟疫這才止息。
verses.e: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment , so the plague was stopped .

verses.z: 那就算為他的義，世世代代，直到永遠。
verses.e: That was credited to him for righteousness , for all generations to come .

verses.z: 他們在米利巴水又叫耶和華發怒，甚至摩西也受了虧損，
verses.e: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah , so that Moses was troubled for their sakes ;

verses.z: 是因他們惹動他的靈，摩西用嘴說了急躁的話。
verses.e: because they were rebellious against his spirit , he spoke rashly with his lips .

verses.z: 他們不照耶和華所吩咐的滅絕外邦人，
verses.e: They didn't destroy the peoples , as the LORD commanded them ,

verses.z: 反與他們混雜相合，學習他們的行為，
verses.e: but mixed themselves with the nations , and learned their works .

verses.z: 事奉他們的偶像，這就成了自己的網羅，
verses.e: They served their idols , which became a snare to them .

verses.z: 把自己的兒女祭祀鬼魔，
verses.e: Yes , they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons .

verses.z: 流無辜人的血，就是自己兒女的血，把他們祭祀迦南的偶像，那地就被血污穢了。
verses.e: They shed innocent blood , even the blood of their sons and of their daughters , whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan . The land was polluted with blood .

verses.z: 這樣，他們被自己所做的污穢了，在行為上犯了邪淫。
verses.e: Thus they were defiled with their works , and prostituted themselves in their deeds .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；求你也用這恩惠記念我，開你的救恩眷顧我，
verses.e: Remember me , LORD , with the favor that you show to your people . Visit me with your salvation ,

verses.z: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作，憎惡他的產業，
verses.e: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people . He abhorred his inheritance .

verses.z: 將他們交在外邦人的手裏；恨他們的人就轄制他們。
verses.e: He gave them into the hand of the nations . Those who hated them ruled over them .

verses.z: 他們的仇敵也欺壓他們，他們就伏在敵人手下。
verses.e: Their enemies also oppressed them . They were brought into subjection under their hand .

verses.z: 他屢次搭救他們，他們卻設謀背逆，因自己的罪孽降為卑下。
verses.e: He rescued them many times , but they were rebellious in their counsel , and were brought low in their iniquity .

verses.z: 然而，他聽見他們哀告的時候，就眷顧他們的急難，
verses.e: Nevertheless he regarded their distress , when he heard their cry .

verses.z: 為他們記念他的約，照他豐盛的慈愛後悔。
verses.e: He remembered for them his covenant , and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses .

verses.z: 他也使他們在凡擄掠他們的人面前蒙憐恤。
verses.e: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，求你拯救我們，從外邦中招聚我們，我們好稱讚你的聖名，以讚美你為誇勝。
verses.e: Save us , LORD , our God , gather us from among the nations , to give thanks to your holy name , to triumph in your praise !

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的，從亙古直到永遠。願眾民都說：阿們！你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD , the God of Israel , from everlasting even to everlasting ! Let all the people say , " Amen . " Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 使我見你選民的福，樂你國民的樂，與你的產業一同誇耀。
verses.e: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen , that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation , that I may glory with your inheritance .

verses.z: 我們與我們的祖宗一同犯罪；我們作了孽，行了惡。
verses.e: We have sinned with our fathers . We have committed iniquity . We have done wickedly .

verses.z: 我們的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事，不記念你豐盛的慈愛，反倒在紅海行了悖逆。
verses.e: Our fathers didn't understand your wonders in Egypt . They didn't remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses , but were rebellious at the sea , even at the Red Sea .

verses.z: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他們，為要彰顯他的大能，
verses.e: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake , that he might make his mighty power known .

verses.z: 並且斥責紅海，海便乾了；他帶領他們經過深處，如同經過曠野。
verses.e: He rebuked the Red Sea also , and it was dried up ; so he led them through the depths , as through a desert .

verses.z: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Give thanks to the LORD , for he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 那些坐在黑暗中、死蔭裏的人被困苦和鐵[鍊]捆鎖，
verses.e: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death , being bound in affliction and iron ,

verses.z: 是因他們違背上帝的話語，藐視至高者的旨意。
verses.e: because they rebelled against the words of God , and condemned the counsel of the Most High .

verses.z: 所以，他用勞苦治服他們的心；他們仆倒，無人扶助。
verses.e: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor . They fell down , and there was no one to help .

verses.z: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。
verses.e: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .

verses.z: 他從黑暗中和死蔭裏領他們出來，折斷他們的綁索。
verses.e: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death , and broke away their chains .

verses.z: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；
verses.e: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness , for his wonderful deeds to the children of men !

verses.z: 因為他打破了銅門，砍斷了鐵閂。
verses.e: For he has broken the gates of bronze , and cut through bars of iron .

verses.z: 愚妄人因自己的過犯和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。
verses.e: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience , and because of their iniquities .

verses.z: 他們心裏厭惡各樣的食物，就臨近死門。
verses.e: Their soul abhors all kinds of food . They draw near to the gates of death .

verses.z: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。
verses.e: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble , and he saves them out of their distresses .

verses.z: 願耶和華的贖民說這話，就是他從敵人手中所救贖的，
verses.e: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so , whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary ,

verses.z: 他發命醫治他們，救他們脫離死亡。
verses.e: He sends his word , and heals them , and delivers them from their graves .

verses.z: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。
verses.e: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness , for his wonderful deeds to the children of men !

verses.z: 願他們以感謝為祭獻給他，歡呼述說他的作為！
verses.e: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving , and declare his deeds with singing .

verses.z: 在海上坐船，在大水中經理事務的，
verses.e: Those who go down to the sea in ships , who do business in great waters ,

verses.z: 他們看見耶和華的作為，並他在深水中的奇事。
verses.e: these see the LORD's deeds , and his wonders in the deep .

verses.z: 因他一吩咐，狂風就起來，海中的波浪也揚起。
verses.e: For he commands , and raises the stormy wind , which lifts up its waves .

verses.z: 他們上到天空，下到海底；他們的心因患難便消化。
verses.e: They mount up to the sky ; they go down again to the depths . Their soul melts away because of trouble .

verses.z: 他們搖搖晃晃，東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；他們的智慧無法可施。
verses.e: They reel back and forth , and stagger like a drunken man , and are at their wits ' end .

verses.z: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華，他從他們的禍患中領出他們來。
verses.e: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble , and he brings them out of their distress .

verses.z: 他使狂風止息，波浪就平靜。
verses.e: He makes the storm a calm , so that its waves are still .

verses.z: 從各地，從東從西，從南從北，所招聚來的。
verses.e: and gathered out of the lands , from the east and from the west , from the north and from the south .

verses.z: 風息浪靜，他們便歡喜；他就引他們到所願去的海口。
verses.e: Then they are glad because it is calm , so he brings them to their desired haven .

verses.z: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。
verses.e: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness , for his wonderful deeds for the children of men !

verses.z: 願他們在民的會中尊崇他，在長老的位上讚美他！
verses.e: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people , and praise him in the seat of the elders .

verses.z: 他使江河變為曠野，叫水泉變為乾渴之地，
verses.e: He turns rivers into a desert , water springs into a thirsty ground ,

verses.z: 使肥地變為鹼地；這都因其間居民的罪惡。
verses.e: and a fruitful land into a salt waste , for the wickedness of those who dwell in it .

verses.z: 他使曠野變為水潭，叫旱地變為水泉。
verses.e: He turns a desert into a pool of water , and a dry land into water springs .

verses.z: 他使飢餓的人住在那裏，好建造可住的城邑，
verses.e: There he makes the hungry live , that they may prepare a city to live in ,

verses.z: 又種田地，栽葡萄園，得享所出的土產。
verses.e: sow fields , plant vineyards , and reap the fruits of increase .

verses.z: 他又賜福給他們，叫他們生養眾多，也不叫他們的牲畜減少。
verses.e: He blesses them also , so that they are multiplied greatly . He doesn't allow their livestock to decrease .

verses.z: 他們又因暴虐、患難、愁苦，就減少且卑下。
verses.e: Again , they are diminished and bowed down through oppression , trouble , and sorrow .

verses.z: 他們在曠野荒地漂流，尋不見可住的城邑，
verses.e: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way . They found no city to live in .

verses.z: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流。
verses.e: He pours contempt on princes , and causes them to wander in a trackless waste .

verses.z: 他卻將窮乏人安置在高處，脫離苦難，使他的家屬多如羊群。
verses.e: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction , and increases their families like a flock .

verses.z: 正直人看見就歡喜；罪孽之輩必塞口無言。
verses.e: The upright will see it , and be glad . All the wicked will shut their mouths .

verses.z: 凡有智慧的，必在這些事上留心，也必思想耶和華的慈愛。
verses.e: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things . They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD .

verses.z: 又飢又渴，心裏發昏。
verses.e: Hungry and thirsty , their soul fainted in them .

verses.z: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中搭救他們，
verses.e: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble , and he delivered them out of their distresses .

verses.z: 又領他們行走直路，使他們往可居住的城邑。
verses.e: He led them also by a straight way , that they might go to a city to live in .

verses.z: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；
verses.e: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness , for his wonderful deeds to the children of men !

verses.z: 因他使心裏渴慕的人得以知足，使心裏飢餓的人得飽美物。
verses.e: For he satisfies the longing soul . He fills the hungry soul with good .

verses.z: 大衛的詩歌。上帝啊，我心堅定；我口要唱詩歌頌！
verses.e: A Song . A Psalm by David . My heart is steadfast , God . I will sing and I will make music with my soul .

verses.z: 誰能領我進堅固城？誰能引我到以東地？
verses.e: Who will bring me into the fortified city ? Who will lead me to Edom ?

verses.z: 上帝啊，你不是丟棄了我們嗎？上帝啊，你不和我們的軍兵同去嗎？
verses.e: Haven't you rejected us , God ? You don't go out , God , with our armies .

verses.z: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人，因為人的幫助是枉然的。
verses.e: Give us help against the enemy , for the help of man is vain .

verses.z: 我們倚靠上帝才得施展大能，因為踐踏我們敵人的就是他。
verses.e: Through God , we will do valiantly , for it is he who will tread down our enemies .

verses.z: 琴瑟啊，你們當醒起！我自己要極早醒起！
verses.e: Wake up , harp and lyre ! I will wake up the dawn .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你，在列邦中歌頌你！
verses.e: I will give thanks to you , LORD , among the nations . I will sing praises to you among the peoples .

verses.z: 因為，你的慈愛大過諸天；你的誠實達到穹蒼。
verses.e: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens . Your faithfulness reaches to the skies .

verses.z: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！願你的榮耀高過全地！
verses.e: Be exalted , God , above the heavens ! Let your glory be over all the earth .

verses.z: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們，好叫你所親愛的人得救。
verses.e: That your beloved may be delivered , save with your right hand , and answer us .

verses.z: 上帝已經指着他的聖潔說：我要歡樂；我要分開示劍，丈量疏割谷。
verses.e: God has spoken from his sanctuary : " In triumph , I will divide Shechem , and measure out the valley of Succoth .

verses.z: 基列是我的；瑪拿西是我的；以法蓮是護衛我頭的；猶大是我的杖；
verses.e: Gilead is mine . Manasseh is mine . Ephraim also is my helmet . Judah is my scepter .

verses.z: 摩押是我的沐浴盆；我要向以東拋鞋；我必因勝非利士呼喊。
verses.e: Moab is my wash pot . I will toss my sandal on Edom . I will shout over Philistia . "

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。我所讚美的上帝啊，求你不要閉口不言。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . God of my praise , don't remain silent ,

verses.z: 願他的兒女漂流討飯，從他們荒涼之處出來求[食]！
verses.e: Let his children be wandering beggars . Let them be sought from their ruins .

verses.z: 願強暴的債主牢籠他一切所有的！願外人搶他勞碌得來的！
verses.e: Let the creditor seize all that he has . Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor .

verses.z: 願無人向他延綿施恩！願無人可憐他的孤兒！
verses.e: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him , neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children .

verses.z: 願他的後人斷絕，名字被塗抹，不傳於下代！
verses.e: Let his posterity be cut off . In the generation following let their name be blotted out .

verses.z: 願他祖宗的罪孽被耶和華記念！願他母親的罪過不被塗抹！
verses.e: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD . Don't let the sin of his mother be blotted out .

verses.z: 願這些罪常在耶和華面前，使他的名號斷絕於世！
verses.e: Let them be before the LORD continually , that he may cut off their memory from the earth ;

verses.z: 因為他不想施恩，卻逼迫困苦窮乏的和傷心的人，要把他們治死。
verses.e: because he didn't remember to show kindness , but persecuted the poor and needy man , the broken in heart , to kill them .

verses.z: 他愛咒罵，咒罵就臨到他；他不喜愛福樂，福樂就與他遠離！
verses.e: Yes , he loved cursing , and it came to him . He didn't delight in blessing , and it was far from him .

verses.z: 他拿咒罵當衣服穿上；這咒罵就如水進他裏面，像油入他的骨頭。
verses.e: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment . It came into his inward parts like water , like oil into his bones .

verses.z: 願這咒罵當他遮身的衣服，當他常束的腰帶！
verses.e: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself , for the belt that is always around him .

verses.z: 因為惡人的嘴和詭詐人的口已經張開攻擊我；他們用撒謊的舌頭對我說話。
verses.e: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me . They have spoken to me with a lying tongue .

verses.z: 這就是我對頭和用惡言議論我的人從耶和華那裏所受的報應。
verses.e: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD , of those who speak evil against my soul .

verses.z: 主－耶和華啊，求你為你的名[恩]待我；因你的慈愛美好，求你搭救我！
verses.e: But deal with me , GOD the Lord , for your name's sake , because your loving kindness is good , deliver me ;

verses.z: 因為我困苦窮乏，內心受傷。
verses.e: for I am poor and needy . My heart is wounded within me .

verses.z: 我如日影漸漸偏斜而去；我如蝗蟲被抖出來。
verses.e: I fade away like an evening shadow . I am shaken off like a locust .

verses.z: 我因禁食，膝骨軟弱；我身上的肉也漸漸瘦了。
verses.e: My knees are weak through fasting . My body is thin and lacks fat .

verses.z: 我受他們的羞辱，他們看見我便搖頭。
verses.e: I have also become a reproach to them . When they see me , they shake their head .

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你幫助我，照你的慈愛拯救我，
verses.e: Help me , LORD , my God . Save me according to your loving kindness ;

verses.z: 使他們知道這是你的手，是你－耶和華所行的事。
verses.e: that they may know that this is your hand ; that you , LORD , have done it .

verses.z: 任憑他們咒罵，惟願你賜福；他們幾時起來就必蒙羞，你的僕人卻要歡喜。
verses.e: They may curse , but you bless . When they arise , they will be shamed , but your servant shall rejoice .

verses.z: 願我的對頭披戴羞辱！願他們以自己的羞愧為外袍遮身！
verses.e: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor . Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe .

verses.z: 他們圍繞我，說怨恨的話，又無故地攻打我。
verses.e: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred , and fought against me without a cause .

verses.z: 我要用口極力稱謝耶和華；我要在眾人中間讚美他；
verses.e: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth . Yes , I will praise him among the multitude .

verses.z: 因為他必站在窮乏人的右邊，要救他脫離審判他靈魂的人。
verses.e: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy , to save him from those who judge his soul .

verses.z: 他們與我為敵以報我愛，但我[專心]祈禱。
verses.e: In return for my love , they are my adversaries ; but I am in prayer .

verses.z: 他們向我以惡報善，以恨報愛。
verses.e: They have rewarded me evil for good , and hatred for my love .

verses.z: 願你派一個惡人轄制他，派一個對頭站在他右邊！
verses.e: Set a wicked man over him . Let an adversary stand at his right hand .

verses.z: 他受審判的時候，願他出來擔當罪名！願他的祈禱反成為罪！
verses.e: When he is judged , let him come out guilty . Let his prayer be turned into sin .

verses.z: 願他的年日短少！願別人得他的職分！
verses.e: Let his days be few . Let another take his office .

verses.z: 願他的兒女為孤兒，他的妻子為寡婦！
verses.e: Let his children be fatherless , and his wife a widow .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。我是投靠耶和華；你們怎麼對我說：你當像鳥飛往你的山去。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . By David . In the LORD , I take refuge . How can you say to my soul , " Flee as a bird to your mountain " ?

verses.z: 看哪，惡人彎弓，把箭搭在弦上，要在暗中射那心裏正直的人。
verses.e: For , behold , the wicked bend their bows . They set their arrows on the strings , that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart .

verses.z: 根基若毀壞，義人還能做甚麼呢？
verses.e: If the foundations are destroyed , what can the righteous do ?

verses.z: 耶和華在他的聖殿裏；耶和華的寶座在天上；他的慧眼察看世人。
verses.e: The LORD is in his holy temple . The LORD is on his throne in heaven . His eyes observe . His eyes examine the children of men .

verses.z: 耶和華試驗義人；惟有惡人和喜愛強暴的人，他心裏恨惡。
verses.e: The LORD examines the righteous , but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence .

verses.z: 他要向惡人密布網羅；有烈火、硫磺、熱風，作他們杯中的分。
verses.e: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals ; fire , sulfur , and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup .

verses.z: 因為耶和華是公義的，他喜愛公義；正直人必得見他的面。
verses.e: For the LORD is righteous . He loves righteousness . The upright shall see his face .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
verses.e: A Psalm by David . The LORD says to my Lord , " Sit at my right hand , until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet . "

verses.z: 耶和華必使你從錫安伸出能力的杖來；你要在你仇敵中掌權。
verses.e: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion . Rule among your enemies .

verses.z: 當你掌權的日子，你的民要以聖潔的妝飾為衣，甘心犧牲自己；你的民多如清晨的甘露。
verses.e: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power , in holy array . Out of the womb of the morning , you have the dew of your youth .

verses.z: 耶和華起了誓，決不後悔，[說]：你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。
verses.e: The LORD has sworn , and will not change his mind : " You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek . "

verses.z: 在你右邊的主，當他發怒的日子，必打傷列王。
verses.e: The Lord is at your right hand . He will crush kings in the day of his wrath .

verses.z: 他要在列邦中刑罰[惡人]，屍首就遍滿[各處]；他要在許多國中打破[仇敵的]頭。
verses.e: He will judge among the nations . He will heap up dead bodies . He will crush the ruler of the whole earth .

verses.z: 他要喝路旁的河水，因此必抬起頭來。
verses.e: He will drink of the brook on the way ; therefore he will lift up his head .

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！我要在正直人的大會中，並公會中，一心稱謝耶和華。
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart , in the council of the upright , and in the congregation .

verses.z: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端；凡遵行[他命令]的是聰明人。耶和華是永遠當讚美的！
verses.e: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom . All those who do his work have a good understanding . His praise endures forever !

verses.z: 耶和華的作為本為大；凡喜愛的都必考察。
verses.e: The LORD's works are great , pondered by all those who delight in them .

verses.z: 他所行的是尊榮和威嚴；他的公義存到永遠。
verses.e: His work is honor and majesty . His righteousness endures forever .

verses.z: 他行了奇事，使人記念；耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫。
verses.e: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered . The LORD is gracious and merciful .

verses.z: 他賜糧食給敬畏他的人；他必永遠記念他的約。
verses.e: He has given food to those who fear him . He always remembers his covenant .

verses.z: 他向百姓顯出大能的作為，把外邦的地賜給他們為業。
verses.e: He has shown his people the power of his works , in giving them the heritage of the nations .

verses.z: 他手所行的是誠實公平；他的訓詞都是確實的，
verses.e: The works of his hands are truth and justice . All his precepts are sure .

verses.z: 是永永遠遠堅定的，是按誠實正直設立的。
verses.e: They are established forever and ever . They are done in truth and uprightness .

verses.z: 他向百姓施行救贖，命定他的約，直到永遠；他的名聖而可畏。
verses.e: He has sent redemption to his people . He has ordained his covenant forever . His name is holy and awesome !

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！敬畏耶和華，甚喜愛他命令的，這人便為有福！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD , who delights greatly in his commandments .

verses.z: 惡人看見便惱恨，必咬牙而消化；惡人的心願要歸滅絕。
verses.e: The wicked will see it , and be grieved . He shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away . The desire of the wicked will perish .

verses.z: 他的後裔在世必強盛；正直人的後代必要蒙福。
verses.e: His offspring will be mighty in the land . The generation of the upright will be blessed .

verses.z: 他家中有貨物，有錢財；他的公義存到永遠。
verses.e: Wealth and riches are in his house . His righteousness endures forever .

verses.z: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他發現；他有恩惠，有憐憫，有公義。
verses.e: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright , gracious , merciful , and righteous .

verses.z: 施恩與人、借貸與人的，這人事情順利；他被審判的時候要訴明自己的冤。
verses.e: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends . He will maintain his cause in judgment .

verses.z: 他永不動搖；義人被記念，直到永遠。
verses.e: For he will never be shaken . The righteous will be remembered forever .

verses.z: 他必不怕凶惡的信息；他心堅定，倚靠耶和華。
verses.e: He will not be afraid of evil news . His heart is steadfast , trusting in the LORD .

verses.z: 他心確定，總不懼怕，直到他看見敵人[遭報]。
verses.e: His heart is established . He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries .

verses.z: 他施捨[錢財]，賙濟貧窮；他的仁義存到永遠。他的角必被高舉，大有榮耀。
verses.e: He has dispersed , he has given to the poor . His righteousness endures forever . His horn will be exalted with honor .

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！耶和華的僕人哪，你們要讚美，讚美耶和華的名！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Praise , you servants of the LORD , praise the LORD's name .

verses.z: 耶和華的名是應當稱頌的，從今時直到永遠！
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD's name , from this time forward and forever more .

verses.z: 從日出之地到日落之處，耶和華的名是應當讚美的！
verses.e: From the rising of the sun to its going down , the LORD's name is to be praised .

verses.z: 耶和華超乎萬民之上；他的榮耀高過諸天。
verses.e: The LORD is high above all nations , his glory above the heavens .

verses.z: 誰像耶和華－我們的上帝呢？他坐在至高之處，
verses.e: Who is like the LORD , our God , who has his seat on high ,

verses.z: 自己謙卑，觀看天上地下的事。
verses.e: who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth ?

verses.z: 他從灰塵裏抬舉貧寒人，從糞堆中提拔窮乏人，
verses.e: He raises up the poor out of the dust , and lifts up the needy from the ash heap ,

verses.z: 使他們與王子同坐，就是與本國的王子同坐。
verses.e: that he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .

verses.z: 他使不能生育的婦人安居家中，為多子的樂母。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 以色列出了埃及，雅各家離開說異言之民；
verses.e: When Israel went out of Egypt , the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language ,

verses.z: 那時，猶大為主的聖所，以色列為他所治理的國度。
verses.e: Judah became his sanctuary , Israel his dominion .

verses.z: 滄海看見就奔逃；約旦河也倒流。
verses.e: The sea saw it , and fled . The Jordan was driven back .

verses.z: 大山踴躍，如公羊；小山跳舞，如羊羔。
verses.e: The mountains skipped like rams , the little hills like lambs .

verses.z: 滄海啊，你為何奔逃？約旦哪，你為何倒流？
verses.e: What was it , you sea , that you fled ? You Jordan , that you turned back ?

verses.z: 大山哪，你為何踴躍，如公羊？小山哪，你為何跳舞，如羊羔？
verses.e: You mountains , that you skipped like rams ? You little hills , like lambs ?

verses.z: 大地啊，你因見主的面，就是雅各上帝的面，便要震動。
verses.e: Tremble , you earth , at the presence of the Lord , at the presence of the God of Jacob ,

verses.z: 他叫磐石變為水池，叫堅石變為泉源。
verses.e: who turned the rock into a pool of water , the flint into a spring of waters .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，榮耀不要歸與我們，不要歸與我們；要因你的慈愛和誠實歸在你的名下！
verses.e: Not to us , LORD , not to us , but to your name give glory , for your loving kindness , and for your truth's sake .

verses.z: 亞倫家啊，你們要倚靠耶和華！他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。
verses.e: House of Aaron , trust in the LORD ! He is their help and their shield .

verses.z: 你們敬畏耶和華的，要倚靠耶和華！他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。
verses.e: You who fear the LORD , trust in the LORD ! He is their help and their shield .

verses.z: 耶和華向來眷念我們；他還要賜福[給我們]：要賜福給以色列的家，賜福給亞倫的家。
verses.e: The LORD remembers us . He will bless us . He will bless the house of Israel . He will bless the house of Aaron .

verses.z: 凡敬畏耶和華的，無論大小，主必賜福給他。
verses.e: He will bless those who fear the LORD , both small and great .

verses.z: 願耶和華叫你們和你們的子孫日見加增。
verses.e: May the LORD increase you more and more , you and your children .

verses.z: 你們蒙了造天地之耶和華的福！
verses.e: Blessed are you by the LORD , who made heaven and earth .

verses.z: 天，是耶和華的天；地，他卻給了世人。
verses.e: The heavens are the LORD's heavens , but he has given the earth to the children of men .

verses.z: 死人不能讚美耶和華；下到寂靜中的也都不能。
verses.e: The dead don't praise the LORD , nor any who go down into silence ,

verses.z: 但我們要稱頌耶和華，從今時直到永遠。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: but we will bless the LORD , from this time forward and forever more . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 為何容外邦人說：他們的上帝在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Why should the nations say , " Where is their God , now ? "

verses.z: 然而，我們的上帝在天上，都隨自己的意旨行事。
verses.e: But our God is in the heavens . He does whatever he pleases .

verses.z: 他們的偶像是金的，銀的，是人手所造的，
verses.e: Their idols are silver and gold , the work of men's hands .

verses.z: 有口卻不能言，有眼卻不能看，
verses.e: They have mouths , but they don't speak . They have eyes , but they don't see .

verses.z: 有耳卻不能聽，有鼻卻不能聞，
verses.e: They have ears , but they don't hear . They have noses , but they don't smell .

verses.z: 有手卻不能摸，有腳卻不能走，有喉嚨也不能出聲。
verses.e: They have hands , but they don't feel . They have feet , but they don't walk , neither do they speak through their throat .

verses.z: 造他的要和他一樣；凡靠他的也要如此。
verses.e: Those who make them will be like them ; yes , everyone who trusts in them .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和華！他是你的幫助和你的盾牌。
verses.e: Israel , trust in the LORD ! He is their help and their shield .

verses.z: 我愛耶和華，因為他聽了我的聲音和我的懇求。
verses.e: I love the LORD , because he listens to my voice , and my cries for mercy .

verses.z: 我因信，所以如此說話；我受了極大的困苦。
verses.e: I believed , therefore I said , " I was greatly afflicted . "

verses.z: 我曾急促地說：人都是說謊的！
verses.e: I said in my haste , " All people are liars . "

verses.z: 我拿甚麼報答耶和華向我所賜的一切厚恩？
verses.e: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me ?

verses.z: 我要舉起救恩的杯，稱揚耶和華的名。
verses.e: I will take the cup of salvation , and call on the LORD's name .

verses.z: 我要在他眾民面前向耶和華還我的願。
verses.e: I will pay my vows to the LORD , yes , in the presence of all his people .

verses.z: 在耶和華眼中，看聖民之死極為寶貴。
verses.e: Precious in the LORD's sight is the death of his saints .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我真是你的僕人；我是你的僕人，是你婢女的兒子。你已經解開我的綁索。
verses.e: LORD , truly I am your servant . I am your servant , the son of your servant girl . You have freed me from my chains .

verses.z: 我要以感謝為祭獻給你，又要求告耶和華的名。
verses.e: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving , and will call on the LORD's name .

verses.z: 我要在他眾民面前，在耶和華殿的院內，在耶路撒冷當中，向耶和華還我的願。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: I will pay my vows to the LORD , yes , in the presence of all his people ,
in the courts of the LORD's house , in the middle of you , Jerusalem . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 他既向我側耳，我一生要求告他。
verses.e: Because he has turned his ear to me , therefore I will call on him as long as I live .

verses.z: 死亡的繩索纏繞我；陰間的痛苦抓住我；我遭遇患難愁苦。
verses.e: The cords of death surrounded me , the pains of Sheol got a hold of me . I found trouble and sorrow .

verses.z: 那時，我便求告耶和華的名，說：耶和華啊，求你救我的靈魂！
verses.e: Then I called on the LORD's name : " LORD , I beg you , deliver my soul . "

verses.z: 耶和華有恩惠，有公義；我們的上帝以憐憫為懷。
verses.e: The LORD is gracious and righteous . Yes , our God is merciful .

verses.z: 耶和華保護愚人；我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。
verses.e: The LORD preserves the simple . I was brought low , and he saved me .

verses.z: 我的心哪！你要仍歸安樂，因為耶和華用厚恩待你。
verses.e: Return to your rest , my soul , for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you .

verses.z: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡，救我的眼免了流淚，救我的腳免了跌倒。
verses.e: For you have delivered my soul from death , my eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .

verses.z: 我要在耶和華面前行活人之路。
verses.e: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living .

verses.z: 萬國啊，你們都當讚美耶和華！萬民哪，你們都當頌讚他！
verses.e: Praise the LORD , all you nations ! Extol him , all you peoples !

verses.z: 因為他向我們大施慈愛；耶和華的誠實存到永遠。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: For his loving kindness is great toward us . The LORD's faithfulness endures forever . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Give thanks to the LORD , for he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 萬民圍繞我，我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。
verses.e: All the nations surrounded me , but in the LORD's name I cut them off .

verses.z: 他們環繞我，圍困我，我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。
verses.e: They surrounded me , yes , they surrounded me . In the LORD's name I indeed cut them off .

verses.z: 他們如同蜂子圍繞我，好像燒荊棘的火，必被熄滅；我靠耶和華的名，必剿滅他們。
verses.e: They surrounded me like bees . They are quenched like the burning thorns . In the LORD's name I cut them off .

verses.z: 你推我，要叫我跌倒，但耶和華幫助了我。
verses.e: You pushed me back hard , to make me fall , but the LORD helped me .

verses.z: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的詩歌；他也成了我的拯救。
verses.e: The LORD is my strength and song . He has become my salvation .

verses.z: 在義人的帳棚裏，有歡呼拯救的聲音；耶和華的右手施展大能。
verses.e: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous . " The right hand of the LORD does valiantly .

verses.z: 耶和華的右手高舉；耶和華的右手施展大能。
verses.e: The right hand of the LORD is exalted ! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly ! "

verses.z: 我必不致死，仍要存活，並要傳揚耶和華的作為。
verses.e: I will not die , but live , and declare the LORD's works .

verses.z: 耶和華雖嚴嚴地懲治我，卻未曾將我交於死亡。
verses.e: The LORD has punished me severely , but he has not given me over to death .

verses.z: 給我敞開義門；我要進去稱謝耶和華！
verses.e: Open to me the gates of righteousness . I will enter into them . I will give thanks to the LORD .

verses.z: 願以色列說：他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 這是耶和華的門；義人要進去！
verses.e: This is the gate of the LORD ; the righteous will enter into it .

verses.z: 我要稱謝你，因為你已經應允我，又成了我的拯救！
verses.e: I will give thanks to you , for you have answered me , and have become my salvation .

verses.z: 匠人所棄的石頭已成了房角的頭塊石頭。
verses.e: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone .

verses.z: 這是耶和華所做的，在我們眼中看為希奇。
verses.e: This is the LORD's doing . It is marvelous in our eyes .

verses.z: 這是耶和華所定的日子，我們在其中要高興歡喜！
verses.e: This is the day that the LORD has made . We will rejoice and be glad in it !

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你拯救！耶和華啊，求你使我們亨通！
verses.e: Save us now , we beg you , LORD ! LORD , we beg you , send prosperity now .

verses.z: 奉耶和華名來的是應當稱頌的！我們從耶和華的殿中為你們祝福！
verses.e: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD's name ! We have blessed you out of the LORD's house .

verses.z: 耶和華是上帝；他光照了我們。理當用繩索把祭牲拴住，[牽]到壇角那裏。
verses.e: The LORD is God , and he has given us light . Bind the sacrifice with cords , even to the horns of the altar .

verses.z: 你是我的上帝，我要稱謝你！你是我的上帝，我要尊崇你！
verses.e: You are my God , and I will give thanks to you . You are my God , I will exalt you .

verses.z: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Oh give thanks to the LORD , for he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 願亞倫的家說：他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 願敬畏耶和華的說：他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.e: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 我在急難中求告耶和華，他就應允我，把我[安置]在寬闊之地。
verses.e: Out of my distress , I called on the LORD . The LORD answered me with freedom .

verses.z: 有耶和華幫助我，我必不懼怕，人能把我怎麼樣呢？
verses.e: The LORD is on my side . I will not be afraid . What can man do to me ?

verses.z: 在那幫助我的人中，有耶和華幫助我，所以我要看見那恨我的人[遭報]。
verses.e: The LORD is on my side among those who help me . Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me .

verses.z: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴人；
verses.e: It is better to take refuge in the LORD , than to put confidence in man .

verses.z: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴王子。
verses.e: It is better to take refuge in the LORD , than to put confidence in princes .

verses.z: 行為完全、遵行耶和華律法的，這人便為有福！
verses.e: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless , who walk according to the LORD's law .

verses.z: 我一心尋求了你；求你不要叫我偏離你的命令。
verses.e: With my whole heart I have sought you . Don't let me wander from your commandments .

verses.z: 我比年老的更明白，因我守了你的訓詞。
verses.e: I understand more than the aged , because I have kept your precepts .

verses.z: 我禁止我腳走一切的邪路，為要遵守你的話。
verses.e: I have kept my feet from every evil way , that I might observe your word .

verses.z: 我沒有偏離你的典章，因為你教訓了我。
verses.e: I have not turned away from your ordinances , for you have taught me .

verses.z: 你的言語在我上膛何等甘美，在我口中比蜜更甜！
verses.e: How sweet are your promises to my taste , more than honey to my mouth !

verses.z: 我藉着你的訓詞得以明白，所以我恨一切的假道。
verses.e: Through your precepts , I get understanding ; therefore I hate every false way . NUN

verses.z: 你的話是我腳前的燈，是我路上的光。
verses.e: Your word is a lamp to my feet , and a light for my path .

verses.z: 你公義的典章，我曾起誓遵守，我必按誓而行。
verses.e: I have sworn , and have confirmed it , that I will obey your righteous ordinances .

verses.z: 我甚是受苦；耶和華啊，求你照你的話將我救活！
verses.e: I am afflicted very much . Revive me , LORD , according to your word .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你悅納我口中的讚美為供物，又將你的典章教訓我！
verses.e: Accept , I beg you , the willing offerings of my mouth . LORD , teach me your ordinances .

verses.z: 我的性命常在危險之中，我卻不忘記你的律法。
verses.e: My soul is continually in my hand , yet I won't forget your law .

verses.z: 我將你的話藏在心裏，免得我得罪你。
verses.e: I have hidden your word in my heart , that I might not sin against you .

verses.z: 惡人為我設下網羅，我卻沒有偏離你的訓詞。
verses.e: The wicked have laid a snare for me , yet I haven't gone astray from your precepts .

verses.z: 我以你的法度為永遠的產業，因這是我心中所喜愛的。
verses.e: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever , for they are the joy of my heart .

verses.z: 我的心專向你的律例，永遠遵行，一直到底。
verses.e: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever , even to the end . SAMEKH

verses.z: 心懷二意的人為我所恨；但你的律法為我所愛。
verses.e: I hate double-minded men , but I love your law .

verses.z: 你是我藏身之處，又是我的盾牌；我甚仰望你的話語。
verses.e: You are my hiding place and my shield . I hope in your word .

verses.z: 作惡的人哪，你們離開我吧！我好遵守我上帝的命令。
verses.e: Depart from me , you evildoers , that I may keep the commandments of my God .

verses.z: 求你照你的話扶持我，使我存活，也不叫我因失望而害羞。
verses.e: Uphold me according to your word , that I may live . Let me not be ashamed of my hope .

verses.z: 求你扶持我，我便得救，時常看重你的律例。
verses.e: Hold me up , and I will be safe , and will have respect for your statutes continually .

verses.z: 凡偏離你律例的人，你都輕棄他們，因為他們的詭詐必歸虛空。
verses.e: You reject all those who stray from your statutes , for their deceit is in vain .

verses.z: 凡地上的惡人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓；因此我愛你的法度。
verses.e: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross . Therefore I love your testimonies .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是應當稱頌的！求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.e: Blessed are you , LORD . Teach me your statutes .

verses.z: 我因懼怕你，肉就發抖；我也怕你的判語。
verses.e: My flesh trembles for fear of you . I am afraid of your judgments . AYIN

verses.z: 我行過公平和公義，求你不要撇下我給欺壓我的人！
verses.e: I have done what is just and righteous . Don't leave me to my oppressors .

verses.z: 求你為僕人作保，使我得好處，不容驕傲人欺壓我！
verses.e: Ensure your servant's well-being . Don't let the proud oppress me .

verses.z: 我因盼望你的救恩和你公義的話眼睛失明。
verses.e: My eyes fail looking for your salvation , for your righteous word .

verses.z: 求你照你的慈愛待僕人，將你的律例教訓我。
verses.e: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness . Teach me your statutes .

verses.z: 我是你的僕人，求你賜我悟性，使我得知你的法度。
verses.e: I am your servant . Give me understanding , that I may know your testimonies .

verses.z: 這是耶和華降罰的時候，因人廢了你的律法。
verses.e: It is time to act , LORD , for they break your law .

verses.z: 所以，我愛你的命令勝於金子，更勝於精金。
verses.e: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold , yes , more than pure gold .

verses.z: 你一切的訓詞，在萬事上我都以為正直；我卻恨惡一切假道。
verses.e: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right . I hate every false way . PE

verses.z: 你的法度奇妙，所以我一心謹守。
verses.e: Your testimonies are wonderful , therefore my soul keeps them .

verses.z: 我用嘴唇傳揚你口中的一切典章。
verses.e: With my lips , I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth .

verses.z: 你的言語一解開就發出亮光，使愚人通達。
verses.e: The entrance of your words gives light . It gives understanding to the simple .

verses.z: 我張口而氣喘，因我切慕你的命令。
verses.e: I opened my mouth wide and panted , for I longed for your commandments .

verses.z: 求你轉向我，憐憫我，好像你素常待那些愛你名的人。
verses.e: Turn to me , and have mercy on me , as you always do to those who love your name .

verses.z: 求你用你的話使我腳步穩當，不許甚麼罪孽轄制我。
verses.e: Establish my footsteps in your word . Don't let any iniquity have dominion over me .

verses.z: 求你救我脫離人的欺壓，我要遵守你的訓詞。
verses.e: Redeem me from the oppression of man , so I will observe your precepts .

verses.z: 求你用臉光照僕人，又將你的律例教訓我。
verses.e: Make your face shine on your servant . Teach me your statutes .

verses.z: 我的眼淚下流成河，因為他們不守你的律法。
verses.e: Streams of tears run down my eyes , because they don't observe your law . TZADHE

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是公義的；你的判語也是正直的！
verses.e: You are righteous , LORD . Your judgments are upright .

verses.z: 你所命定的法度是憑公義和至誠。
verses.e: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness . They are fully trustworthy .

verses.z: 我心焦急，如同火燒，因我敵人忘記你的言語。
verses.e: My zeal wears me out , because my enemies ignore your words .

verses.z: 我喜悅你的法度，如同喜悅一切的財物。
verses.e: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies , as much as in all riches .

verses.z: 你的話極其精煉，所以你的僕人喜愛。
verses.e: Your promises have been thoroughly tested , and your servant loves them .

verses.z: 我微小，被人藐視，卻不忘記你的訓詞。
verses.e: I am small and despised . I don't forget your precepts .

verses.z: 你的公義永遠長存；你的律法盡都真實。
verses.e: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness . Your law is truth .

verses.z: 我遭遇患難愁苦，你的命令卻是我所喜愛的。
verses.e: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me . Your commandments are my delight .

verses.z: 你的法度永遠是公義的；求你賜我悟性，我就活了。
verses.e: Your testimonies are righteous forever . Give me understanding , that I may live . QOPH

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我一心呼籲你；求你應允我，我必謹守你的律例！
verses.e: I have called with my whole heart . Answer me , LORD ! I will keep your statutes .

verses.z: 我向你呼籲，求你救我！我要遵守你的法度。
verses.e: I have called to you . Save me ! I will obey your statutes .

verses.z: 我趁天未亮呼求；我仰望了你的言語。
verses.e: I rise before dawn and cry for help . I put my hope in your words .

verses.z: 我趁夜更未換將眼睜開，為要思想你的話語。
verses.e: My eyes stay open through the night watches , that I might meditate on your word .

verses.z: 求你照你的慈愛聽我的聲音；耶和華啊，求你照你的典章將我救活！
verses.e: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness . Revive me , LORD , according to your ordinances .

verses.z: 我要默想你的訓詞，看重你的道路。
verses.e: I will meditate on your precepts , and consider your ways .

verses.z: 追求奸惡的人臨近了；他們遠離你的律法。
verses.e: They draw near who follow after wickedness . They are far from your law .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你與我相近；你一切的命令盡都真實！
verses.e: You are near , LORD . All your commandments are truth .

verses.z: 我因[學]你的法度，久已知道是你永遠立定的。
verses.e: Of old I have known from your testimonies , that you have founded them forever . RESH

verses.z: 求你看顧我的苦難，搭救我，因我不忘記你的律法。
verses.e: Consider my affliction , and deliver me , for I don't forget your law .

verses.z: 求你為我辨屈，救贖我，照你的話將我救活。
verses.e: Plead my cause , and redeem me ! Revive me according to your promise .

verses.z: 救恩遠離惡人，因為他們不尋求你的律例。
