verses.e: Salvation is far from the wicked , for they don't seek your statutes .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的慈悲本為大；求你照你的典章將我救活。
verses.e: Great are your tender mercies , LORD . Revive me according to your ordinances .

verses.z: 逼迫我的，抵擋我的，很多，我卻沒有偏離你的法度。
verses.e: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries . I haven't swerved from your testimonies .

verses.z: 我看見奸惡的人就甚憎惡，因為他們不遵守你的話。
verses.e: I look at the faithless with loathing , because they don't observe your word .

verses.z: 你看我怎樣愛你的訓詞！耶和華啊，求你照你的慈愛將我救活！
verses.e: Consider how I love your precepts . Revive me , LORD , according to your loving kindness .

verses.z: 我要在你的律例中自樂；我不忘記你的話。
verses.e: I will delight myself in your statutes . I will not forget your word . GIMEL

verses.z: 你話的總綱是真實；你一切公義的典章是永遠長存。
verses.e: All of your words are truth . Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever . SIN AND SHIN

verses.z: 首領無故地逼迫我，但我的心畏懼你的言語。
verses.e: Princes have persecuted me without a cause , but my heart stands in awe of your words .

verses.z: 我喜愛你的話，好像人得了許多擄物。
verses.e: I rejoice at your word , as one who finds great plunder .

verses.z: 謊話是我所恨惡所憎嫌的；惟你的律法是我所愛的。
verses.e: I hate and abhor falsehood . I love your law .

verses.z: 我因你公義的典章一天七次讚美你。
verses.e: Seven times a day , I praise you , because of your righteous ordinances .

verses.z: 愛你律法的人有大平安，甚麼都不能使他們絆腳。
verses.e: Those who love your law have great peace . Nothing causes them to stumble .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我仰望了你的救恩，遵行了你的命令。
verses.e: I have hoped for your salvation , LORD . I have done your commandments .

verses.z: 我心裏守了你的法度；這法度我甚喜愛。
verses.e: My soul has observed your testimonies . I love them exceedingly .

verses.z: 我遵守了你的訓詞和法度，因我一切所行的都在你面前。
verses.e: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies , for all my ways are before you . TAV

verses.z: 耶和華啊，願我的呼籲達到你面前，照你的話賜我悟性。
verses.e: Let my cry come before you , LORD . Give me understanding according to your word .

verses.z: 求你用厚恩待你的僕人，使我存活，我就遵守你的話。
verses.e: Do good to your servant . I will live and I will obey your word .

verses.z: 願我的懇求達到你面前，照你的話搭救我。
verses.e: Let my supplication come before you . Deliver me according to your word .

verses.z: 願我的嘴發出讚美的話，因為你將律例教訓我。
verses.e: Let my lips utter praise , for you teach me your statutes .

verses.z: 願我的舌頭歌唱你的話，因你一切的命令盡都公義。
verses.e: Let my tongue sing of your word , for all your commandments are righteousness .

verses.z: 願你用手幫助我，因我揀選了你的訓詞。
verses.e: Let your hand be ready to help me , for I have chosen your precepts .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我切慕你的救恩！你的律法也是我所喜愛的。
verses.e: I have longed for your salvation , LORD . Your law is my delight .

verses.z: 願我的性命存活，得以讚美你！願你的典章幫助我！
verses.e: Let my soul live , that I may praise you . Let your ordinances help me .

verses.z: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你尋找僕人，因我不忘記你的命令。
verses.e: I have gone astray like a lost sheep . Seek your servant , for I don't forget your commandments .

verses.z: 求你開我的眼睛，使我看出你律法中的奇妙。
verses.e: Open my eyes , that I may see wondrous things out of your law .

verses.z: 我是在地上作寄居的；求你不要向我隱瞞你的命令！
verses.e: I am a stranger on the earth . Don't hide your commandments from me .

verses.z: 遵守他的法度、一心尋求他的，這人便為有福！
verses.e: Blessed are those who keep his statutes , who seek him with their whole heart .

verses.z: 我時常切慕你的典章，甚至心碎。
verses.e: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times .

verses.z: 受咒詛、偏離你命令的驕傲人，你已經責備他們。
verses.e: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed , who wander from your commandments .

verses.z: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐視，因我遵守你的法度。
verses.e: Take reproach and contempt away from me , for I have kept your statutes .

verses.z: 雖有首領坐着妄論我，你僕人卻思想你的律例。
verses.e: Though princes sit and slander me , your servant will meditate on your statutes .

verses.z: 你的法度是我所喜樂的，是我的謀士。
verses.e: Indeed your statutes are my delight , and my counselors . DALETH

verses.z: 我的性命幾乎歸於塵土；求你照你的話將我救活！
verses.e: My soul is laid low in the dust . Revive me according to your word !

verses.z: 我述說我所行的，你應允了我；求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.e: I declared my ways , and you answered me . Teach me your statutes .

verses.z: 求你使我明白你的訓詞，我就思想你的奇事。
verses.e: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts ! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works .

verses.z: 我的心因愁苦而消化；求你照你的話使我堅立！
verses.e: My soul is weary with sorrow ; strengthen me according to your word .

verses.z: 求你使我離開奸詐的道，開恩將你的律法賜給我！
verses.e: Keep me from the way of deceit . Grant me your law graciously !

verses.z: 這人不做非義的事，但遵行他的道。
verses.e: Yes , they do nothing wrong . They walk in his ways .

verses.z: 我揀選了忠信的道，將你的典章擺在[我面前]。
verses.e: I have chosen the way of truth . I have set your ordinances before me .

verses.z: 我持守你的法度；耶和華啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！
verses.e: I cling to your statutes , LORD . Don't let me be disappointed .

verses.z: 你開廣我心的時候，我就往你命令的道上直奔。
verses.e: I run in the path of your commandments , for you have set my heart free . HE

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你將你的律例指教我，我必遵守到底！
verses.e: Teach me , LORD , the way of your statutes . I will keep them to the end .

verses.z: 求你賜我悟性，我便遵守你的律法，且要一心遵守。
verses.e: Give me understanding , and I will keep your law . Yes , I will obey it with my whole heart .

verses.z: 求你叫我遵行你的命令，因為這是我所喜樂的。
verses.e: Direct me in the path of your commandments , for I delight in them .

verses.z: 求你使我的心趨向你的法度，不趨向非義之財。
verses.e: Turn my heart toward your statutes , not toward selfish gain .

verses.z: 求你叫我轉眼不看虛假，又叫我在你的道中生活。
verses.e: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things . Revive me in your ways .

verses.z: 你向敬畏你的人所應許的話，求你向僕人堅定！
verses.e: Fulfill your promise to your servant , that you may be feared .

verses.z: 求你使我所怕的羞辱遠離我，因你的典章本為美。
verses.e: Take away my disgrace that I dread , for your ordinances are good .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你曾將你的訓詞吩咐我們，為要我們殷勤遵守。
verses.e: You have commanded your precepts , that we should fully obey them .

verses.z: 我羨慕你的訓詞；求你使我在你的公義上生活！
verses.e: Behold , I long for your precepts ! Revive me in your righteousness . VAV

verses.z: 耶和華啊，願你照你的話，使你的慈愛，就是你的救恩，臨到我身上，
verses.e: Let your loving kindness also come to me , LORD , your salvation , according to your word .

verses.z: 我就有話回答那羞辱我的，因我倚靠你的話。
verses.e: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me , for I trust in your word .

verses.z: 求你叫真理的話總不離開我口，因我仰望你的典章。
verses.e: Don't snatch the word of truth out of my mouth , for I put my hope in your ordinances .

verses.z: 我要常守你的律法，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: So I will obey your law continually , forever and ever .

verses.z: 我要自由而行，因我素來考究你的訓詞。
verses.e: I will walk in liberty , for I have sought your precepts .

verses.z: 我也要在君王面前論說你的法度，並不至於羞愧。
verses.e: I will also speak of your statutes before kings , and will not be disappointed .

verses.z: 我要在你的命令中自樂；這命令素來是我所愛的。
verses.e: I will delight myself in your commandments , because I love them .

verses.z: 我又要遵行你的命令，這命令素來是我所愛的；我也要思想你的律例。
verses.e: I reach out my hands for your commandments , which I love . I will meditate on your statutes . ZAYIN

verses.z: 求你記念向你僕人[所應許]的話，叫我有盼望。
verses.e: Remember your word to your servant , because you gave me hope .

verses.z: 但願我行事堅定，得以遵守你的律例。
verses.e: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes !

verses.z: 這話將我救活了；我在患難中，因此得安慰。
verses.e: This is my comfort in my affliction , for your word has revived me .

verses.z: 驕傲的人甚侮慢我，我卻未曾偏離你的律法。
verses.e: The arrogant mock me excessively , but I don't swerve from your law .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我記念你從古以來的典章，就得了安慰。
verses.e: I remember your ordinances of old , LORD , and have comforted myself .

verses.z: 我見惡人離棄你的律法，就怒氣發作，猶如火燒。
verses.e: Indignation has taken hold on me , because of the wicked who forsake your law .

verses.z: 我在世寄居，素來以你的律例為詩歌。
verses.e: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名，遵守你的律法。
verses.e: I have remembered your name , LORD , in the night , and I obey your law .

verses.z: 我所以如此，是因我守你的訓詞。
verses.e: This is my way , that I keep your precepts . HETH

verses.z: 耶和華是我的福分；我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。
verses.e: The LORD is my portion . I promised to obey your words .

verses.z: 我一心求過你的恩；願你照你的話憐憫我！
verses.e: I sought your favor with my whole heart . Be merciful to me according to your word .

verses.z: 我思想我所行的道，就轉步歸向你的法度。
verses.e: I considered my ways , and turned my steps to your statutes .

verses.z: 我看重你的一切命令，就不至於羞愧。
verses.e: Then I wouldn't be disappointed , when I consider all of your commandments .

verses.z: 我急忙遵守你的命令，並不遲延。
verses.e: I will hurry , and not delay , to obey your commandments .

verses.z: 惡人的繩索纏繞我，我卻沒有忘記你的律法。
verses.e: The ropes of the wicked bind me , but I won't forget your law .

verses.z: 我因你公義的典章，半夜必起來稱謝你。
verses.e: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you , because of your righteous ordinances .

verses.z: 凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人，我都與他作伴。
verses.e: I am a friend of all those who fear you , of those who observe your precepts .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地；求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.e: The earth is full of your loving kindness , LORD . Teach me your statutes . TETH

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你向來是照你的話善待僕人。
verses.e: You have treated your servant well , according to your word , LORD .

verses.z: 求你將精明和知識賜給我，因我信了你的命令。
verses.e: Teach me good judgment and knowledge , for I believe in your commandments .

verses.z: 我未受苦以先走迷了路，現在卻遵守你的話。
verses.e: Before I was afflicted , I went astray ; but now I observe your word .

verses.z: 你本為善，所行的也善；求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.e: You are good , and do good . Teach me your statutes .

verses.z: 驕傲人編造謊言攻擊我，我卻要一心守你的訓詞。
verses.e: The proud have smeared a lie upon me . With my whole heart , I will keep your precepts .

verses.z: 我學了你公義的判語，就要以正直的心稱謝你。
verses.e: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart , when I learn your righteous judgments .

verses.z: 他們心蒙脂油，我卻喜愛你的律法。
verses.e: Their heart is as callous as the fat , but I delight in your law .

verses.z: 我受苦是與我有益，為要使我學習你的律例。
verses.e: It is good for me that I have been afflicted , that I may learn your statutes .

verses.z: 你口中的訓言與我有益，勝於千萬的金銀。
verses.e: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver . YODH

verses.z: 你的手製造我，建立我；求你賜我悟性，可以學習你的命令！
verses.e: Your hands have made me and formed me . Give me understanding , that I may learn your commandments .

verses.z: 敬畏你的人見我就要歡喜，因我仰望你的話。
verses.e: Those who fear you will see me and be glad , because I have put my hope in your word .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我知道你的判語是公義的；你使我受苦是以誠實待我。
verses.e: LORD , I know that your judgments are righteous , that in faithfulness you have afflicted me .

verses.z: 求你照着[應許]僕人的話，以慈愛安慰我。
verses.e: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort , according to your word to your servant .

verses.z: 願你的慈悲臨到我，使我存活，因你的律法是我所喜愛的。
verses.e: Let your tender mercies come to me , that I may live ; for your law is my delight .

verses.z: 願驕傲人蒙羞，因為他們無理地傾覆我；但我要思想你的訓詞。
verses.e: Let the proud be disappointed , for they have overthrown me wrongfully . I will meditate on your precepts .

verses.z: 願敬畏你的人歸向我，他們就知道你的法度。
verses.e: Let those who fear you turn to me . They will know your statutes .

verses.z: 我必守你的律例；求你總不要丟棄我！
verses.e: I will observe your statutes . Don't utterly forsake me . BETH

verses.z: 願我的心在你的律例上完全，使我不致蒙羞。
verses.e: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees , that I may not be disappointed . KAPF

verses.z: 我心渴想你的救恩，仰望你的應許。
verses.e: My soul faints for your salvation . I hope in your word .

verses.z: 我因盼望你的應許眼睛失明，說：你何時安慰我？
verses.e: My eyes fail for your word . I say , " When will you comfort me ? "

verses.z: 我好像煙薰的皮袋，卻不忘記你的律例。
verses.e: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke . I don't forget your statutes .

verses.z: 你僕人的年日有多少呢？你幾時向逼迫我的人施行審判呢？
verses.e: How many are the days of your servant ? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me ?

verses.z: 不從你律法的驕傲人為我掘了坑。
verses.e: The proud have dug pits for me , contrary to your law .

verses.z: 你的命令盡都誠實；他們無理地逼迫我，求你幫助我！
verses.e: All of your commandments are faithful . They persecute me wrongfully . Help me !

verses.z: 他們幾乎把我從世上滅絕，但我沒有離棄你的訓詞。
verses.e: They had almost wiped me from the earth , but I didn't forsake your precepts .

verses.z: 求你照你的慈愛將我救活，我就遵守你口中的法度。
verses.e: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness , so I will obey the statutes of your mouth . LAMEDH

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的話安定在天，直到永遠。
verses.e: LORD , your word is settled in heaven forever .

verses.z: 少年人用甚麼潔淨他的行為呢？是要遵行你的話！
verses.e: How can a young man keep his way pure ? By living according to your word .

verses.z: 你的誠實存到萬代；你堅定了地，地就長存。
verses.e: Your faithfulness is to all generations . You have established the earth , and it remains .

verses.z: 天地照你的安排存到今日；萬物都是你的僕役。
verses.e: Your laws remain to this day , for all things serve you .

verses.z: 我若不是喜愛你的律法，早就在苦難中滅絕了！
verses.e: Unless your law had been my delight , I would have perished in my affliction .

verses.z: 我永不忘記你的訓詞，因你用這訓詞將我救活了。
verses.e: I will never forget your precepts , for with them , you have revived me .

verses.z: 我是屬你的，求你救我，因我尋求了你的訓詞。
verses.e: I am yours . Save me , for I have sought your precepts .

verses.z: 惡人等待我，要滅絕我，我卻要揣摩你的法度。
verses.e: The wicked have waited for me , to destroy me . I will consider your statutes .

verses.z: 我看萬事盡都有限，惟有你的命令極其寬廣。
verses.e: I have seen a limit to all perfection , but your commands are boundless . MEM

verses.z: 我何等愛慕你的律法，終日不住地思想。
verses.e: How I love your law ! It is my meditation all day .

verses.z: 你的命令常存在我心裏，使我比仇敵有智慧。
verses.e: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies , for your commandments are always with me .

verses.z: 我比我的師傅更通達，因我思想你的法度。
verses.e: I have more understanding than all my teachers , for your testimonies are my meditation .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用第八。耶和華啊，求你幫助，因虔誠人斷絕了；世人中間的忠信人沒有了。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician ; upon an eight-stringed lyre . A Psalm of David . Help , LORD ; for the godly man ceases . For the faithful fail from among the children of men .

verses.z: 人人向鄰舍說謊；他們說話，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。
verses.e: Everyone lies to his neighbor . They speak with flattering lips , and with a double heart .

verses.z: 凡油滑的嘴唇和誇大的舌頭，耶和華必要剪除。
verses.e: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips , and the tongue that boasts ,

verses.z: 他們曾說：我們必能以舌頭得勝；我們的嘴唇是我們自己的，誰能作我們的主呢？
verses.e: who have said , " With our tongue we will prevail . Our lips are our own . Who is lord over us ? "

verses.z: 耶和華說：因為困苦人的冤屈和貧窮人的歎息，我現在要起來，把他安置在他所切慕的穩妥之地。
verses.e: " Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy , I will now arise , " says the LORD ; " I will set him in safety from those who malign him . "

verses.z: 耶和華的言語是純淨的言語，如同銀子在泥爐中煉過七次。
verses.e: The LORD's words are flawless words , as silver refined in a clay furnace , purified seven times .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你必保護他們；你必保佑他們永遠脫離這世代的人。
verses.e: You will keep them , LORD . You will preserve them from this generation forever .

verses.z: 下流人在世人中升高，就有惡人到處遊行。
verses.e: The wicked walk on every side , when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men .

verses.z: 上行（或譯登階，下同）之詩。我在急難中求告耶和華，他就應允我。
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . In my distress , I cried to the LORD . He answered me .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離說謊的嘴唇和詭詐的舌頭！
verses.e: Deliver my soul , LORD , from lying lips , from a deceitful tongue .

verses.z: 詭詐的舌頭啊，要給你甚麼呢？要拿甚麼加給你呢？
verses.e: What will be given to you , and what will be done more to you , you deceitful tongue ?

verses.z: 就是勇士的利箭和羅騰木的炭火。
verses.e: Sharp arrows of the mighty , with coals of juniper .

verses.z: 我寄居在米設，住在基達帳棚之中，有禍了！
verses.e: Woe is me , that I live in Meshech , that I dwell among the tents of Kedar !

verses.z: 我與那恨惡和睦的人許久同住。
verses.e: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace .

verses.z: 我願和睦，但我發言，他們就要爭戰。
verses.e: I am for peace , but when I speak , they are for war .

verses.z: 上行之詩。我要向山舉目；我的幫助從何而來？
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . I will lift up my eyes to the hills . Where does my help come from ?

verses.z: 我的幫助從造天地的耶和華而來。
verses.e: My help comes from the LORD , who made heaven and earth .

verses.z: 他必不叫你的腳搖動；保護你的必不打盹！
verses.e: He will not allow your foot to be moved . He who keeps you will not slumber .

verses.z: 保護以色列的，也不打盹也不睡覺。
verses.e: Behold , he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep .

verses.z: 保護你的是耶和華；耶和華在你右邊蔭庇你。
verses.e: The LORD is your keeper . The LORD is your shade on your right hand .

verses.z: 白日，太陽必不傷你；夜間，月亮必不害你。
verses.e: The sun will not harm you by day , nor the moon by night .

verses.z: 耶和華要保護你，免受一切的災害；他要保護你的性命。
verses.e: The LORD will keep you from all evil . He will keep your soul .

verses.z: 你出你入，耶和華要保護你，從今時直到永遠。
verses.e: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in , from this time forward , and forever more .

verses.z: 大衛上行之詩。人對我說：我們往耶和華的殿去，我就歡喜。
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . By David . I was glad when they said to me , " Let's go to the LORD's house ! "

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，我們的腳站在你的門內。
verses.e: Our feet are standing within your gates , Jerusalem !

verses.z: 耶路撒冷被建造，如同連絡整齊的一座城。
verses.e: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together ,

verses.z: 眾支派，就是耶和華的支派，上那裏去，按以色列的常例稱讚耶和華的名。
verses.e: where the tribes go up , even the LORD's tribes , according to an ordinance for Israel , to give thanks to the LORD's name .

verses.z: 因為在那裏設立審判的寶座，就是大衛家的寶座。
verses.e: For there are set thrones for judgment , the thrones of David's house .

verses.z: 你們要為耶路撒冷求平安！耶路撒冷啊，愛你的人必然興旺！
verses.e: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem . Those who love you will prosper .

verses.z: 願你城中平安！願你宮內興旺！
verses.e: Peace be within your walls , and prosperity within your palaces .

verses.z: 因我弟兄和同伴的緣故，我要說：願平安在你中間！
verses.e: For my brothers ' and companions ' sakes , I will now say , " Peace be within you . "

verses.z: 因耶和華－我們上帝殿的緣故，我要為你求福！
verses.e: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God , I will seek your good .

verses.z: 上行之詩。坐在天上的[主]啊，我向你舉目。
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . I lift up my eyes to you , you who sit in the heavens .

verses.z: 看哪，僕人的眼睛怎樣望主人的手，使女的眼睛怎樣望主母的手，我們的眼睛也照樣望耶和華－我們的上帝，直到他憐憫我們。
verses.e: Behold , as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master , as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress , so our eyes look to the LORD , our God , until he has mercy on us .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你憐憫我們，憐憫我們！因為我們被藐視，已到極處。
verses.e: Have mercy on us , LORD , have mercy on us , for we have endured much contempt .

verses.z: 我們被那些安逸人的譏誚和驕傲人的藐視，已到極處。
verses.e: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease , with the contempt of the proud .

verses.z: 大衛上行之詩。以色列人要說：若不是耶和華幫助我們，
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . By David . If it had not been the LORD who was on our side , let Israel now say ,

verses.z: 若不是耶和華幫助我們，當人起來攻擊我們、
verses.e: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side , when men rose up against us ,

verses.z: 向我們發怒的時候，就把我們活活地吞了。
verses.e: then they would have swallowed us up alive , when their wrath was kindled against us ,

verses.z: 那時，波濤必漫過我們，河水必淹沒我們，
verses.e: then the waters would have overwhelmed us , the stream would have gone over our soul .

verses.z: 狂傲的水必淹沒我們。
verses.e: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul .

verses.z: 耶和華是應當稱頌的！他沒有把我們當野食交給他們吞吃。
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD , who has not given us as a prey to their teeth .

verses.z: 我們好像雀鳥，從捕鳥人的網羅裏逃脫；網羅破裂，我們逃脫了。
verses.e: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare . The snare is broken , and we have escaped .

verses.z: 我們得幫助，是在乎[倚靠]造天地之耶和華的名。
verses.e: Our help is in the LORD's name , who made heaven and earth .

verses.z: 上行之詩。倚靠耶和華的人好像錫安山，永不動搖。
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion , which can't be moved , but remains forever .

verses.z: 眾山怎樣圍繞耶路撒冷，耶和華也照樣圍繞他的百姓，從今時直到永遠。
verses.e: As the mountains surround Jerusalem , so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more .

verses.z: 惡人的杖不常落在義人的分上，免得義人伸手作惡。
verses.e: For the scepter of wickedness won't remain over the allotment of the righteous , so that the righteous won't use their hands to do evil .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你善待那些為善和心裏正直的人。
verses.e: Do good , LORD , to those who are good , to those who are upright in their hearts .

verses.z: 至於那偏行彎曲道路的人，耶和華必使他和作惡的人一同出去[受刑]。願平安歸於以色列！
verses.e: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways , the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity . Peace be on Israel .

verses.z: 上行之詩。當耶和華將那些被擄的帶回錫安的時候，我們好像做夢的人。
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion , we were like those who dream .

verses.z: 我們滿口喜笑、滿舌歡呼的時候，外邦中就有人說：耶和華為他們行了大事！
verses.e: Then our mouth was filled with laughter , and our tongue with singing . Then they said among the nations , " The LORD has done great things for them . "

verses.z: 耶和華果然為我們行了大事，我們就歡喜。
verses.e: The LORD has done great things for us , and we are glad .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你使我們被擄的人歸回，好像南地的河水復流。
verses.e: Restore our fortunes again , LORD , like the streams in the Negev .

verses.z: 流淚撒種的，必歡呼收割！
verses.e: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy .

verses.z: 那帶種流淚出去的，必要歡歡樂樂地帶禾捆回來！
verses.e: He who goes out weeping , carrying seed for sowing , will certainly come again with joy , carrying his sheaves .

verses.z: 所羅門上行之詩。若不是耶和華建造房屋，建造的人就枉然勞力；若不是耶和華看守城池，看守的人就枉然警醒。
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . By Solomon . Unless the LORD builds the house , they who build it labor in vain . Unless the LORD watches over the city , the watchman guards it in vain .

verses.z: 你們清晨早起，夜晚安歇，吃勞碌得來的飯，本是枉然；惟有耶和華所親愛的，必叫他安然睡覺。
verses.e: It is vain for you to rise up early , to stay up late , eating the bread of toil , for he gives sleep to his loved ones .

verses.z: 兒女是耶和華所賜的產業；所懷的胎是他所給的賞賜。
verses.e: Behold , children are a heritage of the LORD . The fruit of the womb is his reward .

verses.z: 少年時[所生]的兒女好像勇士手中的箭。
verses.e: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man , so are the children of youth .

verses.z: 箭袋充滿的人便為有福；他們在城門口和仇敵說話的時候，必不至於羞愧。
verses.e: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them . They won't be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate .

verses.z: 上行之詩。凡敬畏耶和華、遵行他道的人便為有福！
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD , who walks in his ways .

verses.z: 你要吃勞碌得來的；你要享福，事情順利。
verses.e: For you will eat the labor of your hands . You will be happy , and it will be well with you .

verses.z: 你妻子在你的內室，好像多結果子的葡萄樹；你兒女圍繞你的桌子，好像橄欖栽子。
verses.e: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house , your children like olive shoots around your table .

verses.z: 看哪，敬畏耶和華的人必要這樣蒙福！
verses.e: Behold , this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed .

verses.z: 願耶和華從錫安賜福給你！願你一生一世看見耶路撒冷的好處！
verses.e: May the LORD bless you out of Zion , and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life .

verses.z: 願你看見你兒女的兒女！願平安歸於以色列！
verses.e: Yes , may you see your children's children . Peace be upon Israel .

verses.z: 上行之詩。以色列當說：從我幼年以來，敵人屢次苦害我，
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up . Let Israel now say :

verses.z: 從我幼年以來，敵人屢次苦害我，卻沒有勝了我。
verses.e: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up , yet they have not prevailed against me .

verses.z: [如同]扶犂的在我背上扶犂而耕，耕的犂溝甚長。
verses.e: The plowers plowed on my back . They made their furrows long .

verses.z: 耶和華是公義的；他砍斷了惡人的繩索。
verses.e: The LORD is righteous . He has cut apart the cords of the wicked .

verses.z: 願恨惡錫安的都蒙羞退後！
verses.e: Let them be disappointed and turned backward , all those who hate Zion .

verses.z: 願他們像房頂上的草，未長成而枯乾，
verses.e: Let them be as the grass on the housetops , which withers before it grows up ,

verses.z: 收割的不夠一把，捆禾的也不滿懷。
verses.e: with which the reaper doesn't fill his hand , nor he who binds sheaves , his bosom .

verses.z: 過路的也不說：願耶和華所賜的福歸與你們！我們奉耶和華的名給你們祝福！
verses.e: Neither do those who go by say , " The blessing of the LORD be on you . We bless you in the LORD's name . "

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。耶和華啊，你忘記我要到幾時呢？要到永遠嗎？你掩面不顧我要到幾時呢？
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . How long , LORD ? Will you forget me forever ? How long will you hide your face from me ?

verses.z: 我心裏籌算，終日愁苦，要到幾時呢？我的仇敵升高壓制我，要到幾時呢？
verses.e: How long shall I take counsel in my soul , having sorrow in my heart every day ? How long shall my enemy triumph over me ?

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你看顧我，應允我！使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；
verses.e: Behold , and answer me , LORD , my God . Give light to my eyes , lest I sleep in death ;

verses.z: 免得我的仇敵說：我勝了他；免得我的敵人在我搖動的時候喜樂。
verses.e: lest my enemy say , " I have prevailed against him ; " lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall .

verses.z: 但我倚靠你的慈愛；我的心因你的救恩快樂。
verses.e: But I trust in your loving kindness . My heart rejoices in your salvation .

verses.z: 我要向耶和華歌唱，因他用厚恩待我。
verses.e: I will sing to the LORD , because he has been good to me .

verses.z: 上行之詩。耶和華啊，我從深處向你求告！
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . Out of the depths I have cried to you , LORD .

verses.z: 主啊，求你聽我的聲音！願你側耳聽我懇求的聲音！
verses.e: Lord , hear my voice . Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions .

verses.z: 主－耶和華啊，你若究察罪孽，誰能站得住呢？
verses.e: If you , LORD , kept a record of sins , Lord , who could stand ?

verses.z: 但在你有赦免之恩，要叫人敬畏你。
verses.e: But there is forgiveness with you , therefore you are feared .

verses.z: 我等候耶和華，我的心等候；我也仰望他的話。
verses.e: I wait for the LORD . My soul waits . I hope in his word .

verses.z: 我的心[等候]主，勝於守夜的，[等候]天亮，[勝於]守夜的，[等候]天亮。
verses.e: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning , more than watchmen for the morning .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華！因他有慈愛，有豐盛的救恩。
verses.e: Israel , hope in the LORD , for there is loving kindness with the LORD . Abundant redemption is with him .

verses.z: 他必救贖以色列脫離一切的罪孽。
verses.e: He will redeem Israel from all their sins .

verses.z: 大衛上行之詩。耶和華啊，我的心不狂傲，我的眼不高大；重大和測不透的事，我也不敢行。
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . By David . LORD , my heart isn't arrogant , nor my eyes lofty ; nor do I concern myself with great matters , or things too wonderful for me .

verses.z: 我的心平穩安靜，好像斷過奶的孩子在他母親的懷中；我的心在我裏面真像斷過奶的孩子。
verses.e: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul , like a weaned child with his mother , like a weaned child is my soul within me .

verses.z: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華，從今時直到永遠！
verses.e: Israel , hope in the LORD , from this time forward and forever more .

verses.z: 上行之詩。耶和華啊，求你記念大衛所受的一切苦難！
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . LORD , remember David and all his affliction ,

verses.z: 求你因你僕人大衛的緣故，不要厭棄你的受膏者！
verses.e: For your servant David's sake , don't turn away the face of your anointed one .

verses.z: 耶和華向大衛、憑誠實起了誓，必不反覆，[說]：我要使你所生的坐在你的寶座上。
verses.e: The LORD has sworn to David in truth . He will not turn from it : " I will set the fruit of your body on your throne .

verses.z: 你的眾子若守我的約和我所教訓他們的法度，他們的子孫必永遠坐在你的寶座上。
verses.e: If your children will keep my covenant , my testimony that I will teach them , their children also will sit on your throne forever more . "

verses.z: 因為耶和華揀選了錫安，願意當作自己的居所，
verses.e: For the LORD has chosen Zion . He has desired it for his habitation .

verses.z: 說：這是我永遠安息之所；我要住在這裏，因為是我所願意的。
verses.e: " This is my resting place forever . I will live here , for I have desired it .

verses.z: 我要使其中的糧食豐滿，使其中的窮人飽足。
verses.e: I will abundantly bless her provision . I will satisfy her poor with bread .

verses.z: 我要使祭司披上救恩，聖民大聲歡呼！
verses.e: I will also clothe her priests with salvation . Her saints will shout aloud for joy .

verses.z: 我要叫大衛的角在那裏發生；我為我的受膏者預備明燈。
verses.e: I will make the horn of David to bud there . I have ordained a lamp for my anointed .

verses.z: 我要使他的仇敵披上羞恥；但他的冠冕要在頭上發光。
verses.e: I will clothe his enemies with shame , but on himself , his crown will shine . "

verses.z: 他怎樣向耶和華起誓，向雅各的大能者許願，
verses.e: how he swore to the LORD , and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob :

verses.z: 說：我必不進我的帳幕，也不上我的床榻；
verses.e: " Surely I will not come into the structure of my house , nor go up into my bed ;

verses.z: 我不容我的眼睛睡覺，也不容我的眼目打盹；
verses.e: I will not give sleep to my eyes , or slumber to my eyelids ,

verses.z: 直等我為耶和華尋得所在，為雅各的大能者尋得居所。
verses.e: until I find out a place for the LORD , a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob . "

verses.z: 我們聽說[約櫃]在以法他，我們在基列‧耶琳就尋見了。
verses.e: Behold , we heard of it in Ephrathah . We found it in the field of Jaar .

verses.z: 我們要進他的居所，在他腳凳前下拜。
verses.e: " We will go into his dwelling place . We will worship at his footstool . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你興起，和你有能力的[約]櫃同入安息之所！
verses.e: Arise , LORD , into your resting place , you , and the ark of your strength .

verses.z: 願你的祭司披上公義！願你的聖民歡呼！
verses.e: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness . Let your saints shout for joy !

verses.z: 大衛上行之詩。看哪，弟兄和睦同居是何等地善，何等地美！
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . By David . See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity !

verses.z: 這好比那貴重的油[澆]在亞倫的頭上，流到鬍鬚，又流到他的衣襟；
verses.e: It is like the precious oil on the head , that ran down on the beard , even Aaron's beard , that came down on the edge of his robes ,

verses.z: 又好比黑門的甘露降在錫安山；因為在那裏有耶和華所命定的福，就是永遠的生命。
verses.e: like the dew of Hermon , that comes down on the hills of Zion ; for there the LORD gives the blessing , even life forever more .

verses.z: 上行之詩。耶和華的僕人夜間站在耶和華殿中的，你們當稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: A Song of Ascents . Look ! Praise the LORD , all you servants of the LORD , who stand by night in the LORD's house !

verses.z: 你們當向聖所舉手，稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 願造天地的耶和華，從錫安賜福給你們！
verses.e: May the LORD bless you from Zion , even he who made heaven and earth .

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華的名！耶和華的僕人站在耶和華殿中；站在我們上帝殿院中的，你們要讚美他！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Praise the LORD's name ! Praise him , you servants of the LORD ,

verses.z: 他擊殺許多的民，又殺戮大能的王，
verses.e: He struck many nations , and killed mighty kings —

verses.z: 就是亞摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩，並迦南一切的國王，
verses.e: Sihon king of the Amorites , Og king of Bashan , and all the kingdoms of Canaan —

verses.z: 將他們的地賞賜他的百姓以色列為業。
verses.e: and gave their land for a heritage , a heritage to Israel , his people .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的名存到永遠！耶和華啊，你可記念的名存到萬代！
verses.e: Your name , LORD , endures forever ; your renown , LORD , throughout all generations .

verses.z: 耶和華要為他的百姓伸冤，為他的僕人後悔。
verses.e: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants .

verses.z: 外邦的偶像是金的，銀的，是人手所造的；
verses.e: The idols of the nations are silver and gold , the work of men's hands .

verses.z: 有口卻不能言，有眼卻不能看，
verses.e: They have mouths , but they can't speak . They have eyes , but they can't see .

verses.z: 有耳卻不能聽，口中也沒有氣息。
verses.e: They have ears , but they can't hear , neither is there any breath in their mouths .

verses.z: 造他的要和他一樣，凡靠他的也要如此。
verses.e: Those who make them will be like them , yes , everyone who trusts in them .

verses.z: 以色列家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！亞倫家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: House of Israel , praise the LORD ! House of Aaron , praise the LORD !
you who stand in the LORD's house , in the courts of our God's house .

verses.z: 利未家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！你們敬畏耶和華的，要稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: House of Levi , praise the LORD ! You who fear the LORD , praise the LORD !

verses.z: 住在耶路撒冷的耶和華該從錫安受稱頌。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD from Zion , who dwells in Jerusalem . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！耶和華本為善；要歌頌他的名，因為這是美好的。
verses.e: Praise the LORD , for the LORD is good . Sing praises to his name , for that is pleasant .

verses.z: 耶和華揀選雅各歸自己，揀選以色列特作自己的子民。
verses.e: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself , Israel for his own possession .

verses.z: 原來我知道耶和華為大，也知道我們的主超乎萬神之上。
verses.e: For I know that the LORD is great , that our Lord is above all gods .

verses.z: 耶和華在天上，在地下，在海中，在一切的深處，都隨自己的意旨而行。
verses.e: Whatever the LORD pleased , that he has done , in heaven and in earth , in the seas and in all deeps .

verses.z: 他使雲霧從地極上騰，造電隨雨而閃，從府庫中帶出風來。
verses.e: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth . He makes lightnings with the rain . He brings the wind out of his treasuries .

verses.z: 他將埃及頭生的，連人帶牲畜都擊殺了。
verses.e: He struck the firstborn of Egypt , both of man and animal .

verses.z: 埃及啊，他施行神蹟奇事，在你當中，在法老和他一切臣僕身上。
verses.e: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you , Egypt , on Pharaoh , and on all his servants .

verses.z: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: Give thanks to the LORD , for he is good , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: [稱謝]那擊殺埃及人之長子的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他領以色列人從他們中間出來，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: and brought out Israel from among them , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他施展大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: with a strong hand , and with an outstretched arm , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: [稱謝]那分裂紅海的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who divided the Red Sea apart , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他領以色列從其中經過，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
verses.e: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 卻把法老和他的軍兵推翻在紅海裏，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: [稱謝]那引導自己的民行走曠野的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who led his people through the wilderness , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: [稱謝]那擊殺大君王的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who struck great kings , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他殺戮有名的君王，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
verses.e: and killed mighty kings , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 就是殺戮亞摩利王西宏，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
verses.e: Sihon king of the Amorites , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 你們要稱謝萬神之神，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: Give thanks to the God of gods , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 又殺巴珊王噩，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: Og king of Bashan , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他將他們的地賜他的百姓為業，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
verses.e: and gave their land as an inheritance , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 就是賜他的僕人以色列為業，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: even a heritage to Israel his servant , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他顧念我們在卑微的地步，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: who remembered us in our low estate , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他救拔我們脫離敵人，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: and has delivered us from our adversaries , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他賜糧食給凡有血氣的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: who gives food to every creature , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 你們要稱謝天上的上帝，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven , for his loving kindness endures forever .

verses.z: 你們要稱謝萬主之主，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: Give thanks to the Lord of lords , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: [稱謝]那獨行大奇事的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who alone does great wonders , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: [稱謝]那用智慧造天的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who by understanding made the heavens , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: [稱謝]那鋪地在水以上的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who spread out the earth above the waters , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: [稱謝]那造成大光的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: to him who made the great lights , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他造日頭管白晝，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: the sun to rule by day , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
verses.e: the moon and stars to rule by night , for his loving kindness endures forever ;

verses.z: 我們曾在巴比倫的河邊坐下，一追想錫安就哭了。
verses.e: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down . Yes , we wept , when we remembered Zion .

verses.z: 我們把琴掛在那裏的柳樹上；
verses.e: On the willows in that land , we hung up our harps .

verses.z: 因為在那裏，擄掠我們的要我們唱歌，搶奪我們的[要我們]作樂，[說]：給我們唱一首錫安歌吧！
verses.e: For there , those who led us captive asked us for songs . Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy : " Sing us one of the songs of Zion ! "

verses.z: 我們怎能在外邦唱耶和華的歌呢？
verses.e: How can we sing the LORD's song in a foreign land ?

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，我若忘記你，情願我的右手忘記[技巧]！
verses.e: If I forget you , Jerusalem , let my right hand forget its skill .

verses.z: 我若不記念你，若不看耶路撒冷過於我所最喜樂的，情願我的舌頭貼於上膛！
verses.e: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don't remember you , if I don't prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷[遭難]的日子，以東人說：拆毀！拆毀！直拆到根基！耶和華啊，求你記念這仇！
verses.e: Remember , LORD , against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem , who said , " Raze it ! Raze it even to its foundation ! "

verses.z: 將要被滅的巴比倫城啊，報復你像你待我們的，那人便為有福！
verses.e: Daughter of Babylon , doomed to destruction , he will be happy who repays you , as you have done to us .

verses.z: 拿你的嬰孩摔在磐石上的，那人便為有福！
verses.e: Happy shall he be , who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。我要一心稱謝你，在諸神面前歌頌你。
verses.e: By David . I will give you thanks with my whole heart . Before the gods , I will sing praises to you .

verses.z: 我要向你的聖殿下拜，為你的慈愛和誠實稱讚你的名；因你使你的話顯為大，過於你所應許的。
verses.e: I will bow down toward your holy temple , and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth ; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all .

verses.z: 我呼求的日子，你就應允我，鼓勵我，使我心裏有能力。
verses.e: In the day that I called , you answered me . You encouraged me with strength in my soul .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，地上的君王都要稱謝你，因他們聽見了你口中的言語。
verses.e: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks , LORD , for they have heard the words of your mouth .

verses.z: 他們要歌頌耶和華的作為，因耶和華大有榮耀。
verses.e: Yes , they will sing of the ways of the LORD , for the LORD's glory is great !

verses.z: 耶和華雖高，仍看顧低微的人；他卻從遠處看出驕傲的人。
verses.e: For though the LORD is high , yet he looks after the lowly ; but he knows the proud from afar .

verses.z: 我雖行在患難中，你必將我救活；我的仇敵發怒，你必伸手抵擋他們；你的右手也必救我。
verses.e: Though I walk in the middle of trouble , you will revive me . You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies . Your right hand will save me .

verses.z: 耶和華必成全關乎我的事；耶和華啊，你的慈愛永遠長存！求你不要離棄你手所造的。
verses.e: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me . Your loving kindness , LORD , endures forever . Don't forsake the works of your own hands .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。耶和華啊，你已經鑒察我，認識我。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . LORD , you have searched me , and you know me .

verses.z: 就是在那裏，你的手必引導我；你的右手也必扶持我。
verses.e: even there your hand will lead me , and your right hand will hold me .

verses.z: 我若說：黑暗必定遮蔽我，我周圍的亮光必成為黑夜；
verses.e: If I say , " Surely the darkness will overwhelm me . The light around me will be night , "

verses.z: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我，使你不見，黑夜卻如白晝發亮。黑暗和光明，[在你看]都是一樣。
verses.e: even the darkness doesn't hide from you , but the night shines as the day . The darkness is like light to you .

verses.z: 我的肺腑是你所造的；我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。
verses.e: For you formed my inmost being . You knit me together in my mother's womb .

verses.z: 我要稱謝你，因我受造，奇妙可畏；你的作為奇妙，這是我心深知道的。
verses.e: I will give thanks to you , for I am fearfully and wonderfully made . Your works are wonderful . My soul knows that very well .

verses.z: 我在暗中受造，在地的深處被聯絡；那時，我的形體並不向你隱藏。
verses.e: My frame wasn't hidden from you , when I was made in secret , woven together in the depths of the earth .

verses.z: 我未成形的體質，你的眼早已看見了；你所定的日子，我尚未度一日，你都寫在你的冊上了。
verses.e: Your eyes saw my body . In your book they were all written , the days that were ordained for me , when as yet there were none of them .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你的意念向我何等寶貴！其數何等眾多！
verses.e: How precious to me are your thoughts , God ! How vast is their sum !

verses.z: 我若數點，比海沙更多；我睡醒的時候，仍和你同在。
verses.e: If I would count them , they are more in number than the sand . When I wake up , I am still with you .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你必要殺戮惡人；所以，你們好流人血的，離開我去吧！
verses.e: If only you , God , would kill the wicked . Get away from me , you bloodthirsty men !

verses.z: 我坐下，我起來，你都曉得；你從遠處知道我的意念。
verses.e: You know my sitting down and my rising up . You perceive my thoughts from afar .

verses.z: 因為他們說惡言頂撞你；你的仇敵也妄稱[你的名]。
verses.e: For they speak against you wickedly . Your enemies take your name in vain .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，恨惡你的，我豈不恨惡他們嗎？攻擊你的，我豈不憎嫌他們嗎？
verses.e: LORD , don't I hate those who hate you ? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you ?

verses.z: 我切切地恨惡他們，以他們為仇敵。
verses.e: I hate them with perfect hatred . They have become my enemies .

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你鑒察我，知道我的心思，試煉我，知道我的意念，
verses.e: Search me , God , and know my heart . Try me , and know my thoughts .

verses.z: 看在我裏面有甚麼惡行沒有，引導我走永生的道路。
verses.e: See if there is any wicked way in me , and lead me in the everlasting way .

verses.z: 我行路，我躺臥，你都細察；你也深知我一切所行的。
verses.e: You search out my path and my lying down , and are acquainted with all my ways .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我舌頭上的話，你沒有一句不知道的。
verses.e: For there is not a word on my tongue , but behold , LORD , you know it altogether .

verses.z: 你在我前後環繞我，按手在我身上。
verses.e: You hem me in behind and before . You laid your hand on me .

verses.z: [這樣的]知識奇妙，是我不能測的，至高，是我不能及的。
verses.e: This knowledge is beyond me . It's lofty . I can't attain it .

verses.z: 我往哪裏去躲避你的靈？我往哪裏逃、躲避你的面？
verses.e: Where could I go from your Spirit ? Or where could I flee from your presence ?

verses.z: 我若升到天上，你在那裏；我若在陰間下榻，你也在那裏。
verses.e: If I ascend up into heaven , you are there . If I make my bed in Sheol , behold , you are there !

verses.z: 我若展開清晨的翅膀，[飛]到海極居住，
verses.e: If I take the wings of the dawn , and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea ,

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。愚頑人心裏說：沒有上帝。他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的事；沒有一個人行善。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . By David . The fool has said in his heart , " There is no God . " They are corrupt . They have done abominable deeds . There is no one who does good .

verses.z: 耶和華從天上垂看世人，要看有明白的沒有，有尋求上帝的沒有。
verses.e: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men , to see if there were any who understood , who sought after God .

verses.z: 他們都偏離正路，一同變為污穢；並沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
verses.e: They have all gone aside . They have together become corrupt . There is no one who does good , no , not one .

verses.z: 作孽的都沒有知識嗎？他們吞吃我的百姓，[如同]吃飯一樣，並不求告耶和華。
verses.e: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge , who eat up my people as they eat bread , and don't call on the LORD ?

verses.z: 他們在那裏大大地害怕，因為上帝在義人的族類中。
verses.e: There they were in great fear , for God is in the generation of the righteous .

verses.z: 你們叫困苦人的謀算變為羞辱；然而耶和華是他的避難所。
verses.e: You frustrate the plan of the poor , because the LORD is his refuge .

verses.z: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。耶和華救回他被擄的子民那時，雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
verses.e: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion ! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people , then Jacob shall rejoice , and Israel shall be glad .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離凶惡的人，保護我脫離強暴的人！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . Deliver me , LORD , from evil men . Preserve me from violent men :

verses.z: 願火炭落在他們身上！願他們被丟在火中，拋在深坑裏，不能再起來。
verses.e: Let burning coals fall on them . Let them be thrown into the fire , into miry pits , from where they never rise .

verses.z: 說惡言的人在地上必堅立不住；禍患必獵取強暴的人，將他打倒。
verses.e: An evil speaker won't be established in the earth . Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him .

verses.z: 我知道耶和華必為困苦人伸冤，必為窮乏人辨屈。
verses.e: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted , and justice for the needy .

verses.z: 義人必要稱讚你的名；正直人必住在你面前。
verses.e: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name . The upright will dwell in your presence .

verses.z: 他們心中圖謀奸惡，常常聚集要爭戰。
verses.e: those who devise mischief in their hearts . They continually gather themselves together for war .

verses.z: 他們使舌頭尖利如蛇，嘴裏有虺蛇的毒氣。（細拉）
verses.e: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent . Viper's poison is under their lips . Selah .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離惡人的手，保護我脫離強暴的人！他們圖謀推我跌倒。
verses.e: LORD , keep me from the hands of the wicked . Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet .

verses.z: 驕傲人為我暗設網羅和繩索；他們在路旁鋪下網，設下圈套。（細拉）
verses.e: The proud have hidden a snare for me , they have spread the cords of a net by the path . They have set traps for me . Selah .

verses.z: 我曾對耶和華說：你是我的上帝。耶和華啊，求你留心聽我懇求的聲音！
verses.e: I said to the LORD , " You are my God . " Listen to the cry of my petitions , LORD .

verses.z: 主－耶和華、我救恩的力量啊，在爭戰的日子，你遮蔽了我的頭。
verses.e: LORD , the Lord , the strength of my salvation , you have covered my head in the day of battle .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你不要遂惡人的心願；不要成就他們的計謀，[恐怕]他們自高。（細拉）
verses.e: LORD , don't grant the desires of the wicked . Don't let their evil plans succeed , or they will become proud . Selah .

verses.z: 至於那些昂首圍困我的人，願他們嘴唇的奸惡陷害自己！
verses.e: As for the head of those who surround me , let the mischief of their own lips cover them .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華啊，我曾求告你，求你快快臨到我這裏！我求告你的時候，願你留心聽我的聲音！
verses.e: A Psalm by David . LORD , I have called on you . Come to me quickly ! Listen to my voice when I call to you .

verses.z: 願惡人落在自己的網裏，我卻得以逃脫。
verses.e: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by .

verses.z: 願我的禱告如香陳列在你面前！願我舉手[祈求]，如獻晚祭！
verses.e: Let my prayer be set before you like incense ; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你禁止我的口，把守我的嘴！
verses.e: Set a watch , LORD , before my mouth . Keep the door of my lips .

verses.z: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪惡，以致我和作孽的人同行惡事；也不叫我吃他們的美食。
verses.e: Don't incline my heart to any evil thing , to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity . Don't let me eat of their delicacies .

verses.z: 任憑義人擊打我，[這算為]仁慈；任憑他責備我，[這算為]頭上的膏油；我的頭不要躲閃。正在他們行惡的時候，我仍要祈禱。
verses.e: Let the righteous strike me , it is kindness ; let him reprove me , it is like oil on the head ; don't let my head refuse it ; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds .

verses.z: 他們的審判官被扔在巖下；眾人要聽我的話，因為這話甘甜。
verses.e: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock . They will hear my words , for they are well spoken .

verses.z: 我們的骨頭散在墓旁，好像人耕田、刨地的土塊。
verses.e: " As when one plows and breaks up the earth , our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol . "

verses.z: 主－耶和華啊，我的眼目仰望你；我投靠你，求你不要將我撇得孤苦！
verses.e: For my eyes are on you , LORD , the Lord . I take refuge in you . Don't leave my soul destitute .

verses.z: 求你保護我脫離惡人為我設的網羅和作孽之人的圈套！
verses.e: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me , from the traps of the workers of iniquity .

verses.z: 大衛在洞裏作的訓誨詩，乃是祈禱。我發聲哀告耶和華，發聲懇求耶和華。
verses.e: A contemplation by David , when he was in the cave . A Prayer . I cry with my voice to the LORD . With my voice , I ask the LORD for mercy .

verses.z: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情，陳說我的患難。
verses.e: I pour out my complaint before him . I tell him my troubles .

verses.z: 我的靈在我裏面發昏的時候，你知道我的道路。在我行的路上，敵人為我暗設網羅。
verses.e: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me , you knew my route . On the path in which I walk , they have hidden a snare for me .

verses.z: 求你向我右邊觀看，因為沒有人認識我；我無處避難，也沒有人眷顧我。
verses.e: Look on my right , and see ; for there is no one who is concerned for me . Refuge has fled from me . No one cares for my soul .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我曾向你哀求。我說：你是我的避難所；在活人之地，你是我的福分。
verses.e: I cried to you , LORD . I said , " You are my refuge , my portion in the land of the living . "

verses.z: 求你側耳聽我的呼求，因我落到極卑之地；求你救我脫離逼迫我的人，因為他們比我強盛。
verses.e: Listen to my cry , for I am in desperate need . Deliver me from my persecutors , for they are too strong for me .

verses.z: 求你領我出離被囚之地，我好稱讚你的名。義人必環繞我，因為你是用厚恩待我。
verses.e: Bring my soul out of prison , that I may give thanks to your name . The righteous will surround me , for you will be good to me .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，留心聽我的懇求，憑你的信實和公義應允我。
verses.e: A Psalm by David . Hear my prayer , LORD . Listen to my petitions . In your faithfulness and righteousness , relieve me .

verses.z: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意，因你是我的上帝。你的靈本為善；求你引我到平坦之地。
verses.e: Teach me to do your will , for you are my God . Your Spirit is good . Lead me in the land of uprightness .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你為你的名將我救活，憑你的公義，將我從患難中領出來，
verses.e: Revive me , LORD , for your name's sake . In your righteousness , bring my soul out of trouble .

verses.z: 憑你的慈愛剪除我的仇敵，滅絕一切苦待我的人，因我是你的僕人。
verses.e: In your loving kindness , cut off my enemies , and destroy all those who afflict my soul , for I am your servant .

verses.z: 求你不要審問僕人；因為在你面前，凡活着的人沒有一個是義的。
verses.e: Don't enter into judgment with your servant , for in your sight no man living is righteous .

verses.z: 原來仇敵逼迫我，將我打倒在地，使我住在幽暗之處，像死了許久的人一樣。
verses.e: For the enemy pursues my soul . He has struck my life down to the ground . He has made me live in dark places , as those who have been long dead .

verses.z: 所以，我的靈在我裏面發昏；我的心在我裏面悽慘。
verses.e: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me . My heart within me is desolate .

verses.z: 我追想古時之日，思想你的一切作為，默念你手的工作。
verses.e: I remember the days of old . I meditate on all your doings . I contemplate the work of your hands .

verses.z: 我向你舉手；我的心[渴想]你，如乾旱之地[盼雨]一樣。（細拉）
verses.e: I spread out my hands to you . My soul thirsts for you , like a parched land . Selah .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你速速應允我！我心神耗盡！不要向我掩面，免得我像那些下坑的人一樣。
verses.e: Hurry to answer me , LORD . My spirit fails . Don't hide your face from me , so that I don't become like those who go down into the pit .

verses.z: 求你使我清晨得聽你慈愛[之言]，因我倚靠你；求你使我知道當行的路，因我的心仰望你。
verses.e: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning , for I trust in you . Cause me to know the way in which I should walk , for I lift up my soul to you .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離我的仇敵！我往你那裏藏身。
verses.e: Deliver me , LORD , from my enemies . I flee to you to hide me .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華－我的磐石是應當稱頌的！他教導我的手爭戰，教導我的指頭打仗。
verses.e: By David . Blessed be the LORD , my rock , who trains my hands to war , and my fingers to battle —

verses.z: 你是那拯救君王的；你是那救僕人大衛脫離害命之刀的。
verses.e: You are he who gives salvation to kings , who rescues David , his servant , from the deadly sword .

verses.z: 求你救拔我，救我脫離外邦人的手。他們的口說謊話；他們的右手起假誓。
verses.e: Rescue me , and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners , whose mouths speak deceit , whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood .

verses.z: 我們的兒子從幼年好像樹栽子長大；我們的女兒如同殿角石，是按建宮的樣式鑿成的。
verses.e: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants , our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace .

verses.z: 我們的倉盈滿，能出各樣的糧食；我們的羊在田間孳生千萬。
verses.e: Our barns are full , filled with all kinds of provision . Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields .

verses.z: 我們的牛馱着滿馱，沒有人闖進來[搶奪]，也沒有人出去[爭戰]；我們的街市上也沒有哭號的聲音。
verses.e: Our oxen will pull heavy loads . There is no breaking in , and no going away , and no outcry in our streets .

verses.z: 遇見這光景的百姓便為有福！有耶和華為他們的上帝，這百姓便為有福！
verses.e: Happy are the people who are in such a situation . Happy are the people whose God is the LORD .

verses.z: 他是我慈愛[的主]，我的山寨，我的高臺，我的救主，我的盾牌，是我所投靠的；他使我的百姓服在我以下。
verses.e: my loving kindness , my fortress , my high tower , my deliverer , my shield , and he in whom I take refuge , who subdues my people under me .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，人算甚麼，你竟認識他！世人算甚麼，你竟顧念他！
verses.e: LORD , what is man , that you care for him ? Or the son of man , that you think of him ?

verses.z: 人好像一口氣；他的年日如同影兒快快過去。
verses.e: Man is like a breath . His days are like a shadow that passes away .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你使天下垂，親自降臨，摸山，山就冒煙。
verses.e: Part your heavens , LORD , and come down . Touch the mountains , and they will smoke .

verses.z: 求你發出閃電，使他們四散，射出你的箭，使他們擾亂。
verses.e: Throw out lightning , and scatter them . Send out your arrows , and rout them .

verses.z: 求你從上伸手救拔我，救我出離大水，救我脫離外邦人的手。
verses.e: Stretch out your hand from above , rescue me , and deliver me out of great waters , out of the hands of foreigners ,

verses.z: 他們的口說謊話；他們的右手起假誓。
verses.e: whose mouths speak deceit , whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood .

verses.z: 上帝啊，我要向你唱新歌，用十弦瑟向你歌頌。
verses.e: I will sing a new song to you , God . On a ten-stringed lyre , I will sing praises to you .

verses.z: 大衛的讚美詩。我的上帝我的王啊，我要尊崇你！我要永永遠遠稱頌你的名！
verses.e: A praise psalm by David . I will exalt you , my God , the King . I will praise your name forever and ever .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你一切所造的都要稱謝你；你的聖民也要稱頌你，
verses.e: All your works will give thanks to you , LORD . Your saints will extol you .

verses.z: 傳說你國的榮耀，談論你的大能，
verses.e: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom , and talk about your power ,

verses.z: 好叫世人知道你大能的作為，並你國度威嚴的榮耀。
verses.e: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts , the glory of the majesty of his kingdom .

verses.z: 你的國是永遠的國！你執掌的權柄存到萬代！
verses.e: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom . Your dominion endures throughout all generations . The LORD is faithful in all his words , and loving in all his deeds .

verses.z: 凡跌倒的，耶和華將他們扶持；凡被壓下的，將他們扶起。
verses.e: The LORD upholds all who fall , and raises up all those who are bowed down .

verses.z: 萬民都舉目仰望你；你隨時給他們食物。
verses.e: The eyes of all wait for you . You give them their food in due season .

verses.z: 你張手，使有生氣的都隨願飽足。
verses.e: You open your hand , and satisfy the desire of every living thing .

verses.z: 耶和華在他一切所行的，無不公義；在他一切所做的都有慈愛。
verses.e: The LORD is righteous in all his ways , and gracious in all his works .

verses.z: 凡求告耶和華的，就是誠心求告他的，耶和華便與他們相近。
verses.e: The LORD is near to all those who call on him , to all who call on him in truth .

verses.z: 敬畏他的，他必成就他們的心願，也必聽他們的呼求，拯救他們。
verses.e: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him . He also will hear their cry , and will save them .

verses.z: 我要天天稱頌你，也要永永遠遠讚美你的名！
verses.e: Every day I will praise you . I will extol your name forever and ever .

verses.z: 耶和華保護一切愛他的人，卻要滅絕一切的惡人。
verses.e: The LORD preserves all those who love him , but he will destroy all the wicked .

verses.z: 我的口要說出讚美耶和華的話；惟願凡有血氣的都永永遠遠稱頌他的聖名。
verses.e: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD . Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever .

verses.z: 耶和華本為大，該受大讚美；其大無法測度。
verses.e: Great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised ! His greatness is unsearchable .

verses.z: 這代要對那代頌讚你的作為，也要傳揚你的大能。
verses.e: One generation will commend your works to another , and will declare your mighty acts .

verses.z: 我要默念你威嚴的尊榮和你奇妙的作為。
verses.e: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor , on your wondrous works .

verses.z: 人要傳說你可畏之事的能力；我也要傳揚你的大德。
verses.e: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts . I will declare your greatness .

verses.z: 他們記念你的大恩就要傳出來，並要歌唱你的公義。
verses.e: They will utter the memory of your great goodness , and will sing of your righteousness .

verses.z: 耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。
verses.e: The LORD is gracious , merciful , slow to anger , and of great loving kindness .

verses.z: 耶和華善待萬民；他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。
verses.e: The LORD is good to all . His tender mercies are over all his works .

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！我的心哪，你要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Praise the LORD , my soul .

verses.z: 耶和華要作王，直到永遠！錫安哪，你的上帝要作王，直到萬代！你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: The LORD will reign forever ; your God , O Zion , to all generations . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 我一生要讚美耶和華！我還活的時候要歌頌我的上帝！
verses.e: While I live , I will praise the LORD . I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist .

verses.z: 你們不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人；他一點不能幫助。
verses.e: Don't put your trust in princes , in a son of man in whom there is no help .

verses.z: 他的氣一斷，就歸回塵土；他所打算的，當日就消滅了。
verses.e: His spirit departs , and he returns to the earth . In that very day , his thoughts perish .

verses.z: 以雅各的上帝為幫助、仰望耶和華－他上帝的，這人便為有福！
verses.e: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help , whose hope is in the LORD , his God ,

verses.z: 耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物；他守誠實，直到永遠。
verses.e: who made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that is in them ; who keeps truth forever ;

verses.z: 他為受屈的伸冤，賜食物與飢餓的。耶和華釋放被囚的；
verses.e: who executes justice for the oppressed ; who gives food to the hungry . The LORD frees the prisoners .

verses.z: 耶和華開了瞎子的[眼睛]；耶和華扶起被壓下的人。耶和華喜愛義人。
verses.e: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind . The LORD raises up those who are bowed down . The LORD loves the righteous .

verses.z: 耶和華保護寄居的，扶持孤兒和寡婦，卻使惡人的道路彎曲。
verses.e: The LORD preserves the foreigners . He upholds the fatherless and widow , but he turns the way of the wicked upside down .

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！因歌頌我們的上帝為善為美；讚美的話是合宜的。
verses.e: Praise the LORD , for it is good to sing praises to our God ; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him .

verses.z: 他不喜悅馬的力[大]，不喜愛人的腿[快]。
verses.e: He doesn't delight in the strength of the horse . He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man .

verses.z: 耶和華喜愛敬畏他和盼望他慈愛的人。
verses.e: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him , in those who hope in his loving kindness .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷啊，你要頌讚耶和華！錫安哪，你要讚美你的上帝！
verses.e: Praise the LORD , Jerusalem ! Praise your God , Zion !

verses.z: 因為他堅固了你的門閂，賜福給你中間的兒女。
verses.e: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates . He has blessed your children within you .

verses.z: 他使你境內平安，用上好的麥子使你滿足。
verses.e: He makes peace in your borders . He fills you with the finest of the wheat .

verses.z: 他發命在地；他的話頒行最快。
verses.e: He sends out his commandment to the earth . His word runs very swiftly .

verses.z: 他降雪如羊毛，撒霜如爐灰。
verses.e: He gives snow like wool , and scatters frost like ashes .

verses.z: 他擲下冰雹如碎渣；他發出寒冷，誰能當得起呢？
verses.e: He hurls down his hail like pebbles . Who can stand before his cold ?

verses.z: 他一出令，這些就都消化；他使風颳起，水便流動。
verses.e: He sends out his word , and melts them . He causes his wind to blow , and the waters flow .

verses.z: 他將他的道指示雅各，將他的律例典章指示以色列。
verses.e: He shows his word to Jacob , his statutes and his ordinances to Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華建造耶路撒冷，聚集以色列中被趕散的人。
verses.e: The LORD builds up Jerusalem . He gathers together the outcasts of Israel .

verses.z: 別國他都沒有這樣待過；至於他的典章，他們向來沒有知道。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: He has not done this for just any nation . They don't know his ordinances . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 他醫好傷心的人，裹好他們的傷處。
verses.e: He heals the broken in heart , and binds up their wounds .

verses.z: 他數點星宿的數目，一一稱它的名。
verses.e: He counts the number of the stars . He calls them all by their names .

verses.z: 我們的主為大，最有能力；他的智慧無法測度。
verses.e: Great is our Lord , and mighty in power . His understanding is infinite .

verses.z: 耶和華扶持謙卑人，將惡人傾覆於地。
verses.e: The LORD upholds the humble . He brings the wicked down to the ground .

verses.z: 你們要以感謝向耶和華歌唱，用琴向我們的上帝歌頌。
verses.e: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving . Sing praises on the harp to our God ,

verses.z: 他用雲遮天，為地降雨，使草生長在山上。
verses.e: who covers the sky with clouds , who prepares rain for the earth , who makes grass grow on the mountains .

verses.z: 他賜食給走獸和啼叫的小烏鴉。
verses.e: He provides food for the livestock , and for the young ravens when they call .

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！從天上讚美耶和華，在高處讚美他！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Praise the LORD from the heavens ! Praise him in the heights !

verses.z: 野獸和一切牲畜，昆蟲和飛鳥，
verses.e: wild animals and all livestock , small creatures and flying birds ,

verses.z: 世上的君王和萬民，首領和世上一切審判官，
verses.e: kings of the earth and all peoples , princes and all judges of the earth ,

verses.z: 少年人和處女，老年人和孩童，都當讚美耶和華！
verses.e: both young men and maidens , old men and children .

verses.z: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因為獨有他的名被尊崇；他的榮耀在天地之上。
verses.e: Let them praise the LORD's name , for his name alone is exalted . His glory is above the earth and the heavens .

verses.z: 他將他百姓的角高舉，因此他一切聖民以色列人，就是與他相近的百姓，都讚美他！你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: He has lifted up the horn of his people , the praise of all his saints , even of the children of Israel , a people near to him . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 他的眾使者都要讚美他！他的諸軍都要讚美他！
verses.e: Praise him , all his angels ! Praise him , all his army !

verses.z: 日頭月亮，你們要讚美他！放光的星宿，你們都要讚美他！
verses.e: Praise him , sun and moon ! Praise him , all you shining stars !

verses.z: 天上的天和天上的水，你們都要讚美他！
verses.e: Praise him , you heavens of heavens , you waters that are above the heavens .

verses.z: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因他一吩咐便都造成。
verses.e: Let them praise the LORD's name , for he commanded , and they were created .

verses.z: 他將這些立定，直到永永遠遠；他定了命，不能廢去。
verses.e: He has also established them forever and ever . He has made a decree which will not pass away .

verses.z: 所有在地上的，大魚和一切深洋，
verses.e: Praise the LORD from the earth , you great sea creatures , and all depths ,

verses.z: 火與冰雹，雪和霧氣，成就他命的狂風，
verses.e: lightning and hail , snow and clouds , stormy wind , fulfilling his word ,

verses.z: 大山和小山，結果的樹木和一切香柏樹，
verses.e: mountains and all hills , fruit trees and all cedars ,

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！向耶和華唱新歌，在聖民的會中讚美他！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Sing to the LORD a new song , his praise in the assembly of the saints .

verses.z: 願以色列因造他的主歡喜！願錫安的民因他們的王快樂！
verses.e: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them . Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .

verses.z: 願他們跳舞讚美他的名，擊鼓彈琴歌頌他！
verses.e: Let them praise his name in the dance ! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp !

verses.z: 因為耶和華喜愛他的百姓；他要用救恩當作謙卑人的妝飾。
verses.e: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people . He crowns the humble with salvation .

verses.z: 願聖民因[所得的]榮耀高興！願他們在床上歡呼！
verses.e: Let the saints rejoice in honor . Let them sing for joy on their beds .

verses.z: 願他們口中稱讚上帝為高，手裏有兩刃的刀，
verses.e: May the high praises of God be in their mouths , and a two-edged sword in their hand ,

verses.z: 為要報復列邦，刑罰萬民。
verses.e: to execute vengeance on the nations , and punishments on the peoples ;

verses.z: 要用鍊子捆他們的君王，用鐵鐐鎖他們的大臣；
verses.e: to bind their kings with chains , and their nobles with fetters of iron ;

verses.z: 要在他們身上施行所記錄的審判。他的聖民都有這榮耀。你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: to execute on them the written judgment . All his saints have this honor . Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華啊，誰能寄居你的帳幕？誰能住在你的聖山？
verses.e: A Psalm by David . LORD , who shall dwell in your sanctuary ? Who shall live on your holy hill ?

verses.z: 就是行為正直、做事公義、心裏說實話的人。
verses.e: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right , and speaks truth in his heart ;

verses.z: 他不以舌頭讒謗人，不惡待朋友，也不隨夥毀謗鄰里。
verses.e: he who doesn't slander with his tongue , nor does evil to his friend , nor casts slurs against his fellow man ;

verses.z: 他眼中藐視匪類，卻尊重那敬畏耶和華的人。他發了誓，雖然自己吃虧也不更改。
verses.e: in whose eyes a vile man is despised , but who honors those who fear the LORD ; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts , and doesn't change ;

verses.z: 他不放債取利，不受賄賂以害無辜。行這些事的人必永不動搖。
verses.e: he who doesn't lend out his money for usury , nor take a bribe against the innocent . He who does these things shall never be shaken .

verses.z: 你們要讚美耶和華！在上帝的聖所讚美他！在他顯能力的穹蒼讚美他！
verses.e: Praise the LORD ! Praise God in his sanctuary ! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power !

verses.z: 要因他大能的作為讚美他，按着他極美的大德讚美他！
verses.e: Praise him for his mighty acts ! Praise him according to his excellent greatness !

verses.z: 要用角聲讚美他，鼓瑟彈琴讚美他！
verses.e: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet ! Praise him with harp and lyre !

verses.z: 擊鼓跳舞讚美他！用絲弦的樂器和簫[的聲音]讚美他！
verses.e: Praise him with tambourine and dancing ! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute !

verses.z: 用大響的鈸讚美他！用高聲的鈸讚美他！
verses.e: Praise him with loud cymbals ! Praise him with resounding cymbals !

verses.z: 凡有氣息的都要讚美耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.e: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD ! Praise the LORD !

verses.z: 大衛的金詩。上帝啊，求你保佑我，因為我投靠你。
verses.e: A Poem by David . Preserve me , God , for I take refuge in you .

verses.z: 因為你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間，也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
verses.e: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol , neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption .

verses.z: 你必將生命的道路指示我。在你面前有滿足的喜樂；在你右手中有永遠的福樂。
verses.e: You will show me the path of life . In your presence is fullness of joy . In your right hand there are pleasures forever more .

verses.z: [我的心哪]，你曾對耶和華說：你是我的主；我的好處不在你以外。
verses.e: My soul , you have said to the LORD , " You are my Lord . Apart from you I have no good thing . "

verses.z: 論到世上的聖民，他們又美又善，是我最喜悅的。
verses.e: As for the saints who are in the earth , they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight .

verses.z: 以別[神]代替[耶和華]的，他們的愁苦必加增；他們所澆奠的血我不獻上；我嘴唇也不提別神的名號。
verses.e: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god . Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer , nor take their names on my lips .

verses.z: 耶和華是我的產業，是我杯中的分；我所得的，你為我持守。
verses.e: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup . You made my lot secure .

verses.z: 用繩量給我的地界，坐落在佳美之處；我的產業實在美好。
verses.e: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places . Yes , I have a good inheritance .

verses.z: 我必稱頌那指教我的耶和華；我的心腸在夜間也警戒我。
verses.e: I will bless the LORD , who has given me counsel . Yes , my heart instructs me in the night seasons .

verses.z: 我將耶和華常擺在我面前，因他在我右邊，我便不致搖動。
verses.e: I have set the LORD always before me . Because he is at my right hand , I shall not be moved .

verses.z: 因此，我的心歡喜，我的靈快樂；我的肉身也要安然居住。
verses.e: Therefore my heart is glad , and my tongue rejoices . My body shall also dwell in safety .

verses.z: 大衛的祈禱。耶和華啊，求你聽聞公義，側耳聽我的呼籲！求你留心聽我這不出於詭詐嘴唇的祈禱！
verses.e: A Prayer by David . Hear , LORD , my righteous plea . Give ear to my prayer that doesn't go out of deceitful lips .

verses.z: 他們的心被脂油包裹；他們用口說驕傲的話。
verses.e: They close up their callous hearts . With their mouth they speak proudly .

verses.z: 他們圍困了我們的腳步；他們瞪着眼，要把我們推倒在地。
verses.e: They have now surrounded us in our steps . They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth .

verses.z: 他像獅子急要抓食，又像少壯獅子蹲伏在暗處。
verses.e: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey , as it were a young lion lurking in secret places .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你起來，前去迎敵，將他打倒！用你的刀救護我命脫離惡人。
verses.e: Arise , LORD , confront him . Cast him down . Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword ,

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你用手救我脫離[世]人，脫離那只在今生有福分的世人！你把你的財寶充滿他們的肚腹；他們因有兒女就心滿意足，將其餘的財物留給他們的嬰孩。
verses.e: from men by your hand , LORD , from men of the world , whose portion is in this life . You fill the belly of your cherished ones . Your sons have plenty , and they store up wealth for their children .

verses.z: 至於我，我必在義中見你的面；我醒了的時候，得見你的形像就心滿意足了。
verses.e: As for me , I shall see your face in righteousness . I shall be satisfied , when I awake , with seeing your form .

verses.z: 願我的判語從你面前發出；願你的眼睛觀看公正。
verses.e: Let my sentence come out of your presence . Let your eyes look on equity .

verses.z: 你已經試驗我的心；你在夜間鑒察我；你熬煉我，卻找不着甚麼；我立志叫我口中沒有過失。
verses.e: You have proved my heart . You have visited me in the night . You have tried me , and found nothing . I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey .

verses.z: 論到人的行為，我藉着你嘴唇的言語自己謹守，不行強暴人的道路。
verses.e: As for the deeds of men , by the word of your lips , I have kept myself from the ways of the violent .

verses.z: 我的腳踏定了你的路徑；我的兩腳未曾滑跌。
verses.e: My steps have held fast to your paths . My feet have not slipped .

verses.z: 上帝啊，我曾求告你，因為你必應允我；求你向我側耳，聽我的言語。
verses.e: I have called on you , for you will answer me , God . Turn your ear to me . Hear my speech .

verses.z: 求你顯出你奇妙的慈愛來；你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脫離起來攻擊他們的人。
verses.e: Show your marvelous loving kindness , you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies .

verses.z: 求你保護我，如同保護眼中的瞳人；將我隱藏在你翅膀的蔭下，
verses.e: Keep me as the apple of your eye . Hide me under the shadow of your wings ,

verses.z: 使我脫離那欺壓我的惡人，就是圍困我要害我命的仇敵。
verses.e: from the wicked who oppress me , my deadly enemies , who surround me .

verses.z: 耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。當耶和華救他脫離一切仇敵和掃羅之手的日子，他向耶和華念這詩的話。說：耶和華，我的力量啊，我愛你！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . By David the servant of the LORD , who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies , and from the hand of Saul . He said , I love you , LORD , my strength .

verses.z: 他坐着基路伯飛行；他藉着風的翅膀快飛。
verses.e: He rode on a cherub , and flew . Yes , he soared on the wings of the wind .

verses.z: 他以黑暗為藏身之處，以水的黑暗、天空的厚雲為他四圍的行宮。
verses.e: He made darkness his hiding place , his pavilion around him , darkness of waters , thick clouds of the skies .

verses.z: 因他面前的光輝，他的厚雲行過便有冰雹火炭。
verses.e: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed , hailstones and coals of fire .

verses.z: 耶和華也在天上打雷；至高者發出聲音便有冰雹火炭。
verses.e: The LORD also thundered in the sky . The Most High uttered his voice : hailstones and coals of fire .

verses.z: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散；多多發出閃電，使他們擾亂。
verses.e: He sent out his arrows , and scattered them . He routed them with great lightning bolts .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的斥責一發，你鼻孔的氣一出，海底就出現，大地的根基也顯露。
verses.e: Then the channels of waters appeared . The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke , LORD , at the blast of the breath of your nostrils .

verses.z: 他從高天伸手抓住我，把我從大水中拉上來。
verses.e: He sent from on high . He took me . He drew me out of many waters .

verses.z: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人，因為他們比我強盛。
verses.e: He delivered me from my strong enemy , from those who hated me ; for they were too mighty for me .

verses.z: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我；但耶和華是我的倚靠。
verses.e: They came on me in the day of my calamity , but the LORD was my support .

verses.z: 他又領我到寬闊之處；他救拔我，因他喜悅我。
verses.e: He brought me out also into a large place . He delivered me , because he delighted in me .

verses.z: 耶和華是我的巖石，我的山寨，我的救主，我的上帝，我的磐石，我所投靠的。他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角，是我的高臺。
verses.e: The LORD is my rock , my fortress , and my deliverer ; my God , my rock , in whom I take refuge ; my shield , and the horn of my salvation , my high tower .

verses.z: 耶和華按着我的公義報答我，按着我手中的清潔賞賜我。
verses.e: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness . According to the cleanness of my hands , he has recompensed me .

verses.z: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道，未曾作惡離開我的上帝。
verses.e: For I have kept the ways of the LORD , and have not wickedly departed from my God .

verses.z: 他的一切典章常在我面前；他的律例我也未曾丟棄。
verses.e: For all his ordinances were before me . I didn't put away his statutes from me .

verses.z: 我在他面前作了完全人；我也保守自己遠離我的罪孽。
verses.e: I was also blameless with him . I kept myself from my iniquity .

verses.z: 所以，耶和華按我的公義，按我在他眼前手中的清潔償還我。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness , according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight .

verses.z: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他；完全的人，你以完全待他。
verses.e: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful . With the perfect man , you will show yourself perfect .

verses.z: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他；乖僻的人，你以彎曲待他。
verses.e: With the pure , you will show yourself pure . With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd .

verses.z: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救；高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。
verses.e: For you will save the afflicted people , but the arrogant eyes you will bring down .

verses.z: 你必點着我的燈；耶和華－我的上帝必照明我的黑暗。
verses.e: For you will light my lamp , LORD . My God will light up my darkness .

verses.z: 我藉着你衝入敵軍，藉着我的上帝跳過牆垣。
verses.e: For by you , I advance through a troop . By my God , I leap over a wall .

verses.z: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華；這樣我必從仇敵手中被救出來。
verses.e: I call on the LORD , who is worthy to be praised ; and I am saved from my enemies .

verses.z: 至於上帝，他的道是完全的；耶和華的話是煉淨的。凡投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
verses.e: As for God , his way is perfect . The LORD's word is tried . He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him .

verses.z: 除了耶和華，誰是上帝呢？除了我們的上帝，誰是磐石呢？
verses.e: For who is God , except the LORD ? Who is a rock , besides our God ,

verses.z: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、使我行為完全的，他是上帝。
verses.e: the God who arms me with strength , and makes my way perfect ?

verses.z: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的[蹄]，又使我在高處安穩。
verses.e: He makes my feet like deer's feet , and sets me on my high places .

verses.z: 他教導我的手能以爭戰，甚至我的膀臂能開銅弓。
verses.e: He teaches my hands to war , so that my arms bend a bow of bronze .

verses.z: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌；你的右手扶持我；你的溫和使我為大。
verses.e: You have also given me the shield of your salvation . Your right hand sustains me . Your gentleness has made me great .

verses.z: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊；我的腳未曾滑跌。
verses.e: You have enlarged my steps under me , My feet have not slipped .

verses.z: 我要追趕我的仇敵，並要追上他們；不將他們滅絕，我總不歸回。
verses.e: I will pursue my enemies , and overtake them . I won't turn away until they are consumed .

verses.z: 我要打傷他們，使他們不能起來；他們必倒在我的腳下。
verses.e: I will strike them through , so that they will not be able to rise . They shall fall under my feet .

verses.z: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰；你也使那起來攻擊我的都服在我以下。
verses.e: For you have armed me with strength to the battle . You have subdued under me those who rose up against me .

verses.z: 曾有死亡的繩索纏繞我，匪類的急流使我驚懼，
verses.e: The cords of death surrounded me . The floods of ungodliness made me afraid .

verses.z: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑，叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
verses.e: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me , that I might cut off those who hate me .

verses.z: 他們呼求，卻無人拯救；就是呼求耶和華，他也不應允。
verses.e: They cried , but there was no one to save ; even to the LORD , but he didn't answer them .

verses.z: 我搗碎他們，如同風前的灰塵，倒出他們，如同街上的泥土。
verses.e: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind . I cast them out as the mire of the streets .

verses.z: 你救我脫離百姓的爭競，立我作列國的元首；我素不認識的民必事奉我。
verses.e: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people . You have made me the head of the nations . A people whom I have not known shall serve me .

verses.z: 他們一聽見我的名聲就必順從我；外邦人要投降我。
verses.e: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me . The foreigners shall submit themselves to me .

verses.z: 外邦人要衰殘，戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。
verses.e: The foreigners shall fade away , and shall come trembling out of their strongholds .

verses.z: 耶和華是活[神]。願我的磐石被人稱頌；願救我的上帝被人尊崇。
verses.e: The LORD lives ! Blessed be my rock . Exalted be the God of my salvation ,

verses.z: 這位上帝，就是那為我伸冤、使眾民服在我以下的。
verses.e: even the God who executes vengeance for me , and subdues peoples under me .

verses.z: 你救我脫離仇敵，又把我舉起，高過那些起來攻擊我的；你救我脫離強暴的人。
verses.e: He rescues me from my enemies . Yes , you lift me up above those who rise up against me . You deliver me from the violent man .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你，歌頌你的名。
verses.e: Therefore I will give thanks to you , LORD , among the nations , and will sing praises to your name .

verses.z: 陰間的繩索纏繞我，死亡的網羅臨到我。
verses.e: The cords of Sheol were around me . The snares of death came on me .

verses.z: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他[所立]的王，施慈愛給他的受膏者，就是給大衛和他的後裔，直到永遠。
verses.e: He gives great deliverance to his king , and shows loving kindness to his anointed , to David and to his offspring , forever more .

verses.z: 我在急難中求告耶和華，向我的上帝呼求。他從殿中聽了我的聲音；我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。
verses.e: In my distress I called on the LORD , and cried to my God . He heard my voice out of his temple . My cry before him came into his ears .

verses.z: 那時，因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖；山的根基也震動搖撼。
verses.e: Then the earth shook and trembled . The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken , because he was angry .

verses.z: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰；從他口中發火焚燒，連炭也着了。
verses.e: Smoke went out of his nostrils . Consuming fire came out of his mouth . Coals were kindled by it .

verses.z: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨，有黑雲在他腳下。
verses.e: He bowed the heavens also , and came down . Thick darkness was under his feet .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。諸天述說上帝的榮耀；穹蒼傳揚他的手段。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . The heavens declare the glory of God . The expanse shows his handiwork .

verses.z: 都比金子可羨慕，且比極多的精金可羨慕；比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。
verses.e: They are more to be desired than gold , yes , than much fine gold , sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb .

verses.z: 況且你的僕人因此受警戒，守着這些便有大賞。
verses.e: Moreover your servant is warned by them . In keeping them there is great reward .

verses.z: 誰能知道[自己的]錯失呢？願你赦免我隱而未現的[過錯]。
verses.e: Who can discern his errors ? Forgive me from hidden errors .

verses.z: 求你攔阻僕人不犯任意妄為的罪，不容這罪轄制我，我便完全，免犯大罪。
verses.e: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins . Let them not have dominion over me . Then I will be upright . I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression .

verses.z: 耶和華－我的磐石，我的救贖主啊，願我口中的言語、心裏的意念在你面前蒙悅納。
verses.e: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight , LORD , my rock , and my redeemer .

verses.z: 這日到那日發出言語；這夜到那夜傳出知識。
verses.e: Day after day they pour out speech , and night after night they display knowledge .

verses.z: 無言無語，也無聲音可聽。
verses.e: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard .

verses.z: 它的量帶通遍天下，它的言語傳到地極。上帝在其間為太陽安設帳幕；
verses.e: Their voice has gone out through all the earth , their words to the end of the world . In them he has set a tent for the sun ,

verses.z: 太陽如同新郎出洞房，又如勇士歡然奔路。
verses.e: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room , like a strong man rejoicing to run his course .

verses.z: 它從天這邊出來，繞到天那邊，沒有一物被隱藏不得它的熱氣。
verses.e: His going out is from the end of the heavens , his circuit to its ends . There is nothing hidden from its heat .

verses.z: 耶和華的律法全備，能甦醒人心；耶和華的法度確定，能使愚人有智慧。
verses.e: The LORD's law is perfect , restoring the soul . The LORD's covenant is sure , making wise the simple .

verses.z: 耶和華的訓詞正直，能快活人的心；耶和華的命令清潔，能明亮人的眼目。
verses.e: The LORD's precepts are right , rejoicing the heart . The LORD's commandment is pure , enlightening the eyes .

verses.z: 耶和華的道理潔淨，存到永遠；耶和華的典章真實，全然公義－
verses.e: The fear of the LORD is clean , enduring forever . The LORD's ordinances are true , and righteous altogether .

verses.z: 外邦為甚麼爭鬧？萬民為甚麼謀算虛妄的事？
verses.e: Why do the nations rage , and the peoples plot a vain thing ?

verses.z: 現在，你們君王應當省悟！你們世上的審判官該受管教！
verses.e: Now therefore be wise , you kings . Be instructed , you judges of the earth .

verses.z: 當存畏懼事奉耶和華，又當存戰兢而快樂。
verses.e: Serve the LORD with fear , and rejoice with trembling .

verses.z: 當以嘴親子，恐怕他發怒，你們便在道中滅亡，因為他的怒氣快要發作。凡投靠他的，都是有福的。
verses.e: Give sincere homage to the Son , lest he be angry , and you perish on the way , for his wrath will soon be kindled . Blessed are all those who take refuge in him .

verses.z: 世上的君王一齊起來，臣宰一同商議，要敵擋耶和華並他的受膏者，
verses.e: The kings of the earth take a stand , and the rulers take counsel together , against the LORD , and against his Anointed , saying ,

verses.z: 說：我們要掙開他們的捆綁，脫去他們的繩索。
verses.e: " Let's break their bonds apart , and cast their cords from us . "

verses.z: 那坐在天上的必發笑；主必嗤笑他們。
verses.e: He who sits in the heavens will laugh . The Lord will have them in derision .

verses.z: 那時，他要在怒中責備他們，在烈怒中驚嚇他們，
verses.e: Then he will speak to them in his anger , and terrify them in his wrath :

verses.z: 說：我已經立我的君在錫安－我的聖山上了。
verses.e: " Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion . "

verses.z: [受膏者說]：我要傳[聖]旨。耶和華曾對我說：你是我的兒子，我今日生你。
verses.e: I will tell of the decree : The LORD said to me , " You are my son . Today I have become your father .

verses.z: 你求我，我就將列國賜你為基業，將地極賜你為田產。
verses.e: Ask of me , and I will give the nations for your inheritance , the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession .

verses.z: 你必用鐵杖打破他們；你必將他們如同窯匠的瓦器摔碎。
verses.e: You shall break them with a rod of iron . You shall dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel . "

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。願耶和華在你遭難的日子應允你；願名為雅各上帝的高舉你。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble . May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high ,

verses.z: 願他從聖所救助你，從錫安堅固你，
verses.e: send you help from the sanctuary , grant you support from Zion ,

verses.z: 記念你的一切供獻，悅納你的燔祭，（細拉）
verses.e: remember all your offerings , and accept your burned sacrifice . Selah .

verses.z: 將你心所願的賜給你，成就你的一切籌算。
verses.e: May he grant you your heart's desire , and fulfill all your counsel .

verses.z: 我們要因你的救恩誇勝，要奉我們上帝的名豎立旌旗。願耶和華成就你一切所求的！
verses.e: We will triumph in your salvation . In the name of our God , we will set up our banners . May the LORD grant all your requests .

verses.z: 現在我知道耶和華救護他的受膏者，必從他的聖天上應允他，用右手的能力救護他。
verses.e: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed . He will answer him from his holy heaven , with the saving strength of his right hand .

verses.z: 有人[靠]車，有人[靠]馬，但我們要提到耶和華－我們上帝的名。
verses.e: Some trust in chariots , and some in horses , but we trust in the name of the LORD our God .

verses.z: 他們都屈身仆倒，我們卻起來，立得正直。
verses.e: They are bowed down and fallen , but we rise up , and stand upright .

verses.z: 求耶和華施行拯救；我們呼求的時候，願王應允我們！
verses.e: Save , LORD ! Let the King answer us when we call !

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。耶和華啊，王必因你的能力歡喜；因你的救恩，他的快樂何其大！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . The king rejoices in your strength , LORD ! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation !

verses.z: 你必從世上滅絕他們的子孫，從人間滅絕他們的後裔。
verses.e: You will destroy their descendants from the earth , their posterity from among the children of men .

verses.z: 因為他們有意加害於你；他們想出計謀，卻不能做成。
verses.e: For they intended evil against you . They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed .

verses.z: 你必使他們轉背逃跑，向他們的臉搭箭在弦。
verses.e: For you will make them turn their back , when you aim drawn bows at their face .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，願你因自己的能力顯為至高！這樣，我們就唱詩，歌頌你的大能。
verses.e: Be exalted , LORD , in your strength , so we will sing and praise your power .

verses.z: 他心裏所願的，你已經賜給他；他嘴唇所求的，你未嘗不應允。（細拉）
verses.e: You have given him his heart's desire , and have not withheld the request of his lips . Selah .

verses.z: 你以美福迎接他，把精金的冠冕戴在他頭上。
verses.e: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness . You set a crown of fine gold on his head .

verses.z: 他向你求壽，你便賜給他，就是日子長久，直到永遠。
verses.e: He asked life of you and you gave it to him , even length of days forever and ever .

verses.z: 他因你的救恩大有榮耀；你又將尊榮威嚴加在他身上。
verses.e: His glory is great in your salvation . You lay honor and majesty on him .

verses.z: 你使他有洪福，直到永遠，又使他在你面前歡喜快樂。
