verses.e: For you make him most blessed forever . You make him glad with joy in your presence .

verses.z: 王倚靠耶和華，因至高者的慈愛必不搖動。
verses.e: For the king trusts in the LORD . Through the loving kindness of the Most High , he shall not be moved .

verses.z: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敵；你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。
verses.e: Your hand will find out all of your enemies . Your right hand will find out those who hate you .

verses.z: 你發怒的時候，要使他們如在炎熱的火爐中。耶和華要在他的震怒中吞滅他們；那火要把他們燒盡了。
verses.e: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger . The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath . The fire shall devour them .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用朝鹿。我的上帝，我的上帝！為甚麼離棄我？[為甚麼]遠離不救我？不聽我唉哼的言語？
verses.e: For the Chief Musician ; set to " The Doe of the Morning . " A Psalm by David . My God , my God , why have you forsaken me ? Why are you so far from helping me , and from the words of my groaning ?

verses.z: 我自出母胎就被交在你手裏；從我母親生我，你就是我的上帝。
verses.e: I was thrown on you from my mother's womb . You are my God since my mother bore me .

verses.z: 求你不要遠離我！因為急難臨近了，沒有人幫助我。
verses.e: Don't be far from me , for trouble is near . For there is no one to help .

verses.z: 有許多公牛圍繞我，巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。
verses.e: Many bulls have surrounded me . Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me .

verses.z: 牠們向我張口，好像抓撕吼叫的獅子。
verses.e: They open their mouths wide against me , lions tearing prey and roaring .

verses.z: 我如水被倒出來；我的骨頭都脫了節；我心在我裏面如蠟鎔化。
verses.e: I am poured out like water . All my bones are out of joint . My heart is like wax . It is melted within me .

verses.z: 我的精力枯乾，如同瓦片；我的舌頭貼在我牙床上。你將我安置在死地的塵土中。
verses.e: My strength is dried up like a potsherd . My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth . You have brought me into the dust of death .

verses.z: 犬類圍着我，惡黨環繞我；他們扎了我的手，我的腳。
verses.e: For dogs have surrounded me . A company of evildoers have enclosed me . They have pierced my hands and feet .

verses.z: 我的骨頭，我都能數過；他們瞪着眼看我。
verses.e: I can count all of my bones . They look and stare at me .

verses.z: 他們分我的外衣，為我的裏衣拈鬮。
verses.e: They divide my garments among them . They cast lots for my clothing .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你不要遠離我！我的救主啊，求你快來幫助我！
verses.e: But don't be far off , LORD . You are my help . Hurry to help me !

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，我白日呼求，你不應允，夜間呼求，並不住聲。
verses.e: My God , I cry in the daytime , but you don't answer ; in the night season , and am not silent .

verses.z: 求你救我的靈魂脫離刀劍，救我的生命脫離犬類，
verses.e: Deliver my soul from the sword , my precious life from the power of the dog .

verses.z: 救我脫離獅子的口；你已經應允我，使我脫離野牛的角。
verses.e: Save me from the lion's mouth ! Yes , you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen .

verses.z: 我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄，在會中我要讚美你。
verses.e: I will declare your name to my brothers . Among the assembly , I will praise you .

verses.z: 你們敬畏耶和華的人要讚美他！雅各的後裔都要榮耀他！以色列的後裔都要懼怕他！
verses.e: You who fear the LORD , praise him ! All you descendants of Jacob , glorify him ! Stand in awe of him , all you descendants of Israel !

verses.z: 因為他沒有藐視憎惡受苦的人，也沒有向他掩面；那受苦之人呼籲的時候，他就垂聽。
verses.e: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted , neither has he hidden his face from him ; but when he cried to him , he heard .

verses.z: 我在大會中讚美你的話是從你而來的；我要在敬畏耶和華的人面前還我的願。
verses.e: My praise of you comes in the great assembly . I will pay my vows before those who fear him .

verses.z: 謙卑的人必吃得飽足；尋求耶和華的人必讚美他。願你們的心永遠活着！
verses.e: The humble shall eat and be satisfied . They shall praise the LORD who seek after him . Let your hearts live forever .

verses.z: 地的四極都要想念耶和華，並且歸順他；列國的萬族都要在你面前敬拜。
verses.e: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD . All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you .

verses.z: 因為國權是耶和華的；他是管理萬國的。
verses.e: For the kingdom is the LORD's . He is the ruler over the nations .

verses.z: 地上一切豐肥的人必吃喝而敬拜；凡下到塵土中－不能存活自己性命的人－都要在他面前下拜。
verses.e: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship . All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him , even he who can't keep his soul alive .

verses.z: 但你是聖潔的，是用以色列的讚美為寶座的。
verses.e: But you are holy , you who inhabit the praises of Israel .

verses.z: 他必有後裔事奉他；主所行的事必傳與後代。
verses.e: Posterity shall serve him . Future generations shall be told about the Lord .

verses.z: 他們必來把他的公義傳給將要生的民，言明這事是他所行的。
verses.e: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born , for he has done it .

verses.z: 我們的祖宗倚靠你；他們倚靠你，你便解救他們。
verses.e: Our fathers trusted in you . They trusted , and you delivered them .

verses.z: 他們哀求你，便蒙解救；他們倚靠你，就不羞愧。
verses.e: They cried to you , and were delivered . They trusted in you , and were not disappointed .

verses.z: 但我是蟲，不是人，被眾人羞辱，被百姓藐視。
verses.e: But I am a worm , and no man ; a reproach of men , and despised by the people .

verses.z: 凡看見我的都嗤笑我；他們撇嘴搖頭，[說]：
verses.e: All those who see me mock me . They insult me with their lips . They shake their heads , saying ,

verses.z: 他把[自己]交託耶和華，耶和華可以救他吧！耶和華既喜悅他，可以搭救他吧！
verses.e: " He trusts in the LORD . Let him deliver him . Let him rescue him , since he delights in him . "

verses.z: 但你是叫我出母腹的；我在母懷裏，你就使我有倚靠的心。
verses.e: But you brought me out of the womb . You made me trust while at my mother's breasts .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。
verses.e: A Psalm by David . The LORD is my shepherd ; I shall lack nothing .

verses.z: 他使我躺臥在青草地上，領我在可安歇的水邊。
verses.e: He makes me lie down in green pastures . He leads me beside still waters .

verses.z: 他使我的靈魂甦醒，為自己的名引導我走義路。
verses.e: He restores my soul . He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake .

verses.z: 我雖然行過死蔭的[幽]谷，也不怕遭害，因為你與我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
verses.e: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death , I will fear no evil , for you are with me . Your rod and your staff , they comfort me .

verses.z: 在我敵人面前，你為我擺設筵席；你用油膏了我的頭，使我的[福]杯滿溢。
verses.e: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies . You anoint my head with oil . My cup runs over .

verses.z: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈愛隨着我；我且要住在耶和華的殿中，直到永遠。
verses.e: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life , and I will dwell in the LORD's house forever .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。地和其中所充滿的，世界和住在其間的，都屬耶和華。
verses.e: A Psalm by David . The earth is the LORD's , with its fullness ; the world , and those who dwell in it .

verses.z: 榮耀的王是誰呢？萬軍之耶和華，他是榮耀的王！（細拉）
verses.e: Who is this King of glory ? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory ! Selah .

verses.z: 他把地建立在海上，安定在大水之上。
verses.e: For he has founded it on the seas , and established it on the floods .

verses.z: 誰能登耶和華的山？誰能站在他的聖所？
verses.e: Who may ascend to the LORD's hill ? Who may stand in his holy place ?

verses.z: 就是手潔心清，不向虛妄，起誓不懷詭詐的人。
verses.e: He who has clean hands and a pure heart ; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood , and has not sworn deceitfully .

verses.z: 他必蒙耶和華賜福，又蒙救他的上帝使他成義。
verses.e: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD , righteousness from the God of his salvation .

verses.z: 這是尋求耶和華的族類，是尋求你面的雅各。（細拉）
verses.e: This is the generation of those who seek Him , who seek your face — even Jacob . Selah .

verses.z: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！永久的門戶，你們要被舉起！那榮耀的王將要進來！
verses.e: Lift up your heads , you gates ! Be lifted up , you everlasting doors , and the King of glory will come in .

verses.z: 榮耀的王是誰呢？就是有力有能的耶和華，在戰場上有能的耶和華！
verses.e: Who is the King of glory ? The LORD strong and mighty , the LORD mighty in battle .

verses.z: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！永久的門戶，你們要把頭抬起！那榮耀的王將要進來！
verses.e: Lift up your heads , you gates ; yes , lift them up , you everlasting doors , and the King of glory will come in .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華啊，我的心仰望你。
verses.e: By David . To you , LORD , I lift up my soul .

verses.z: 凡遵守他的約和他法度的人，耶和華都以慈愛誠實待他。
verses.e: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪，因為我的罪重大。
verses.e: For your name's sake , LORD , pardon my iniquity , for it is great .

verses.z: 誰敬畏耶和華，耶和華必指示他當選擇的道路。
verses.e: What man is he who fears the LORD ? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose .

verses.z: 他必安然居住；他的後裔必承受地土。
verses.e: His soul will dwell at ease . His offspring will inherit the land .

verses.z: 耶和華與敬畏他的人親密；他必將自己的約指示他們。
verses.e: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him . He will show them his covenant .

verses.z: 我的眼目時常仰望耶和華，因為他必將我的腳從網裏拉出來。
verses.e: My eyes are ever on the LORD , for he will pluck my feet out of the net .

verses.z: 求你轉向我，憐恤我，因為我是孤獨困苦。
verses.e: Turn to me , and have mercy on me , for I am desolate and afflicted .

verses.z: 我心裏的愁苦甚多，求你救我脫離我的禍患。
verses.e: The troubles of my heart are enlarged . Oh bring me out of my distresses .

verses.z: 求你看顧我的困苦，我的艱難，赦免我一切的罪。
verses.e: Consider my affliction and my travail . Forgive all my sins .

verses.z: 求你察看我的仇敵，因為他們人多，並且痛痛地恨我。
verses.e: Consider my enemies , for they are many . They hate me with cruel hatred .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，我素來倚靠你；求你不要叫我羞愧，不要叫我的仇敵向我誇勝。
verses.e: My God , I have trusted in you . Don't let me be shamed . Don't let my enemies triumph over me .

verses.z: 求你保護我的性命，搭救我，使我不致羞愧，因為我投靠你。
verses.e: Oh keep my soul , and deliver me . Let me not be disappointed , for I take refuge in you .

verses.z: 願純全、正直保守我，因為我等候你。
verses.e: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me , for I wait for you .

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你救贖以色列脫離他一切的愁苦。
verses.e: God , redeem Israel out of all his troubles .

verses.z: 凡等候你的必不羞愧；惟有那無故行奸詐的必要羞愧。
verses.e: Yes , no one who waits for you will be shamed . They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指示我，將你的路教訓我！
verses.e: Show me your ways , LORD . Teach me your paths .

verses.z: 求你以你的真理引導我，教訓我，因為你是救我的上帝。我終日等候你。
verses.e: Guide me in your truth , and teach me , for you are the God of my salvation . I wait for you all day long .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你記念你的憐憫和慈愛，因為這是亙古以來所常有的。
verses.e: LORD , remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness , for they are from old times .

verses.z: 求你不要記念我幼年的罪愆和我的過犯；耶和華啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈愛記念我。
verses.e: Don't remember the sins of my youth , nor my transgressions . Remember me according to your loving kindness , for your goodness ' sake , LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華是良善正直的，所以他必指示罪人走[正]路。
verses.e: Good and upright is the LORD , therefore he will instruct sinners in the way .

verses.z: 他必按公平引領謙卑人，將他的道教訓他們。
verses.e: He will guide the humble in justice . He will teach the humble his way .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華啊，求你為我伸冤，因我向來行事純全；我又倚靠耶和華，並不搖動。
verses.e: By David . Judge me , LORD , for I have walked in my integrity . I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering .

verses.z: 他們的手中有奸惡，右手滿有賄賂。
verses.e: in whose hands is wickedness ; their right hand is full of bribes .

verses.z: 至於我，卻要行事純全；求你救贖我，憐恤我！
verses.e: But as for me , I will walk in my integrity . Redeem me , and be merciful to me .

verses.z: 我的腳站在平坦地方；在眾會中我要稱頌耶和華！
verses.e: My foot stands in an even place . In the congregations I will bless the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你察看我，試驗我，熬煉我的肺腑心腸。
verses.e: Examine me , LORD , and prove me . Try my heart and my mind .

verses.z: 因為你的慈愛常在我眼前，我也按你的真理而行。
verses.e: For your loving kindness is before my eyes . I have walked in your truth .

verses.z: 我沒有和虛謊人同坐，也不與瞞哄人的同群。
verses.e: I have not sat with deceitful men , neither will I go in with hypocrites .

verses.z: 我恨惡惡人的會，必不與惡人同坐。
verses.e: I hate the assembly of evildoers , and will not sit with the wicked .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我要洗手表明無辜，才環繞你的祭壇；
verses.e: I will wash my hands in innocence , so I will go about your altar , LORD ,

verses.z: 我好發稱謝的聲音，也要述說你一切奇妙的作為。
verses.e: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我喜愛你所住的殿和你顯榮耀的居所。
verses.e: LORD , I love the habitation of your house , the place where your glory dwells .

verses.z: 不要把我的靈魂和罪人一同除掉；不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。
verses.e: Don't gather my soul with sinners , nor my life with bloodthirsty men

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華是我的亮光，是我的拯救，我還怕誰呢？耶和華是我性命的保障，我還懼誰呢？
verses.e: By David . The LORD is my light and my salvation . Whom shall I fear ? The LORD is the strength of my life . Of whom shall I be afraid ?

verses.z: 我父母離棄我，耶和華必收留我。
verses.e: When my father and my mother forsake me , then the LORD will take me up .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我，因我仇敵的緣故引導我走平坦的路。
verses.e: Teach me your way , LORD . Lead me in a straight path , because of my enemies .

verses.z: 求你不要把我交給敵人，遂其所願；因為妄作見證的和口吐凶言的，起來攻擊我。
verses.e: Don't deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries , for false witnesses have risen up against me , such as breathe out cruelty .

verses.z: 我若不信在活人之地得見耶和華的恩惠，[就早已喪膽了]。
verses.e: I am still confident of this : I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living .

verses.z: 要等候耶和華！當壯膽，堅固你的心！我再說，要等候耶和華！
verses.e: Wait for the LORD . Be strong , and let your heart take courage . Yes , wait for the LORD .

verses.z: 那作惡的就是我的仇敵，前來吃我肉的時候就絆跌仆倒。
verses.e: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh , even my adversaries and my foes , they stumbled and fell .

verses.z: 雖有軍兵安營攻擊我，我的心也不害怕；雖然興起刀兵攻擊我，我必仍舊安穩。
verses.e: Though an army should encamp against me , my heart shall not fear . Though war should rise against me , even then I will be confident .

verses.z: 有一件事，我曾求耶和華，我仍要尋求：就是一生一世住在耶和華的殿中，瞻仰他的榮美，在他的殿裏求問。
verses.e: One thing I have asked of the LORD , that I will seek after : that I may dwell in the LORD's house all the days of my life , to see the LORD's beauty , and to inquire in his temple .

verses.z: 因為我遭遇患難，他必暗暗地保守我；在他亭子裏，把我藏在他帳幕的隱密處，將我高舉在磐石上。
verses.e: For in the day of trouble , he will keep me secretly in his pavilion . In the secret place of his tabernacle , he will hide me . He will lift me up on a rock .

verses.z: 現在我得以昂首，高過四面的仇敵。我要在他的帳幕裏歡然獻祭；我要唱詩歌頌耶和華。
verses.e: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me . I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent . I will sing , yes , I will sing praises to the LORD .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我用聲音呼籲的時候，求你垂聽；並求你憐恤我，應允我。
verses.e: Hear , LORD , when I cry with my voice . Have mercy also on me , and answer me .

verses.z: [你說]：你們當尋求我的面。那時我心向你說：耶和華啊，你的面我正要尋求。
verses.e: When you said , " Seek my face , " my heart said to you , " I will seek your face , LORD . "

verses.z: 不要向我掩面。不要發怒趕逐僕人，你向來是幫助我的。救我的上帝啊，不要丟掉我，也不要離棄我。
verses.e: Don't hide your face from me . Don't put your servant away in anger . You have been my help . Don't abandon me , neither forsake me , God of my salvation .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華啊，我要求告你！我的磐石啊，不要向我緘默！倘若你向我閉口，我就如將死的人一樣。
verses.e: By David . To you , LORD , I call . My rock , don't be deaf to me , lest , if you are silent to me , I would become like those who go down into the pit .

verses.z: 我呼求你，向你至聖所舉手的時候，求你垂聽我懇求的聲音！
verses.e: Hear the voice of my petitions , when I cry to you , when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place .

verses.z: 不要把我和惡人並作孽的一同除掉；他們與鄰舍說和平話，心裏卻是奸惡。
verses.e: Don't draw me away with the wicked , with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors , but mischief is in their hearts .

verses.z: 願你按着他們所做的，並他們所行的惡事待他們。願你照着他們手所做的待他們，將他們所應得的報應加給他們。
verses.e: Give them according to their work , and according to the wickedness of their doings . Give them according to the operation of their hands . Bring back on them what they deserve .

verses.z: 他們既然不留心耶和華所行的和他手所做的，他就必毀壞他們，不建立他們。
verses.e: Because they don't respect the works of the LORD , nor the operation of his hands , he will break them down and not build them up .

verses.z: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，因為他聽了我懇求的聲音。
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD , because he has heard the voice of my petitions .

verses.z: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的盾牌；我心裏倚靠他就得幫助。所以我心中歡樂，我必用詩歌頌讚他。
verses.e: The LORD is my strength and my shield . My heart has trusted in him , and I am helped . Therefore my heart greatly rejoices . With my song I will thank him .

verses.z: 耶和華是他百姓的力量，又是他受膏者得救的保障。
verses.e: The LORD is their strength . He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed .

verses.z: 求你拯救你的百姓，賜福給你的產業，牧養他們，扶持他們，直到永遠。
verses.e: Save your people , and bless your inheritance . Be their shepherd also , and bear them up forever .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。上帝的眾子啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華，歸給耶和華！
verses.e: A Psalm by David . Ascribe to the LORD , you sons of the mighty , ascribe to the LORD glory and strength .

verses.z: 洪水泛濫之時，耶和華坐着[為王]；耶和華坐着為王，直到永遠。
verses.e: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood . Yes , the LORD sits as King forever .

verses.z: 耶和華必賜力量給他的百姓；耶和華必賜平安的福給他的百姓。
verses.e: The LORD will give strength to his people . The LORD will bless his people with peace .

verses.z: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他，以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華。
verses.e: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name . Worship the LORD in holy array .

verses.z: 耶和華的聲音發在水上；榮耀的上帝打雷，耶和華打雷在大水之上。
verses.e: The LORD's voice is on the waters . The God of glory thunders , even the LORD on many waters .

verses.z: 耶和華的聲音大有能力；耶和華的聲音滿有威嚴。
verses.e: The LORD's voice is powerful . The LORD's voice is full of majesty .

verses.z: 耶和華的聲音震破香柏樹；耶和華震碎黎巴嫩的香柏樹。
verses.e: The LORD's voice breaks the cedars . Yes , the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon .

verses.z: 他也使之跳躍如牛犢，使黎巴嫩和西連跳躍如野牛犢。
verses.e: He makes them also to skip like a calf ; Lebanon and Sirion like a young , wild ox .

verses.z: 耶和華的聲音使火焰分岔。
verses.e: The LORD's voice strikes with flashes of lightning .

verses.z: 耶和華的聲音震動曠野；耶和華震動加低斯的曠野。
verses.e: The LORD's voice shakes the wilderness . The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh .

verses.z: 耶和華的聲音驚動母鹿落胎，樹木也脫落淨光。凡在他殿中的，都稱說[他的]榮耀。
verses.e: The LORD's voice makes the deer calve , and strips the forests bare . In his temple everything says , " Glory ! "

verses.z: 大衛逃避他兒子押沙龍的時候作的詩。耶和華啊，我的敵人何其加增；有許多人起來攻擊我。
verses.e: A Psalm by David , when he fled from Absalom his son . LORD , how my adversaries have increased ! Many are those who rise up against me .

verses.z: 有許多人議論我說：他得不着上帝的幫助。（細拉）
verses.e: Many there are who say of my soul , " There is no help for him in God . " Selah .

verses.z: 但你－耶和華是我四圍的盾牌，是我的榮耀，又是叫我抬起頭來的。
verses.e: But you , LORD , are a shield around me , my glory , and the one who lifts up my head .

verses.z: 我用我的聲音求告耶和華，他就從他的聖山上應允我。（細拉）
verses.e: I cry to the LORD with my voice , and he answers me out of his holy hill . Selah .

verses.z: 我躺下睡覺，我醒着，耶和華都保佑我。
verses.e: I laid myself down and slept . I awakened , for the LORD sustains me .

verses.z: 雖有成萬的百姓來周圍攻擊我，我也不怕。
verses.e: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你起來！我的上帝啊，求你救我！因為你打了我一切仇敵的腮骨，敲碎了惡人的牙齒。
verses.e: Arise , LORD ! Save me , my God ! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone . You have broken the teeth of the wicked .

verses.z: 救恩屬乎耶和華；願你賜福給你的百姓。（細拉）
verses.e: Salvation belongs to the LORD . May your blessing be on your people . Selah .

verses.z: 大衛在獻殿的時候，作這詩歌。耶和華啊，我要尊崇你，因為你曾提拔我，不叫仇敵向我誇耀。
verses.e: A Psalm . A Song for the Dedication of the Temple . By David . I will extol you , LORD , for you have raised me up , and have not made my foes to rejoice over me .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，憐恤我！耶和華啊，求你幫助我！
verses.e: Hear , LORD , and have mercy on me . LORD , be my helper . "

verses.z: 你已將我的哀哭變為跳舞，將我的麻衣脫去，給我披上喜樂，
verses.e: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me . You have removed my sackcloth , and clothed me with gladness ,

verses.z: 好叫我的靈歌頌你，並不住聲。耶和華－我的上帝啊，我要稱謝你，直到永遠！
verses.e: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you , and not be silent . LORD my God , I will give thanks to you forever !

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我曾呼求你，你醫治了我。
verses.e: LORD my God , I cried to you , and you have healed me .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你曾把我的靈魂從陰間救上來，使我存活，不至於下坑。
verses.e: LORD , you have brought up my soul from Sheol . You have kept me alive , that I should not go down to the pit .

verses.z: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們要歌頌他，稱讚他可記念的聖[名]。
verses.e: Sing praise to the LORD , you saints of his . Give thanks to his holy name .

verses.z: 因為，他的怒氣不過是轉眼之間；他的恩典乃是一生之久。一宿雖然有哭泣，早晨便必歡呼。
verses.e: For his anger is but for a moment . His favor is for a lifetime . Weeping may stay for the night , but joy comes in the morning .

verses.z: 至於我，我凡事平順，便說：我永不動搖。
verses.e: As for me , I said in my prosperity , " I shall never be moved . "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你曾施恩，叫我的[江]山穩固；你掩了面，我就驚惶。
verses.e: You , LORD , when you favored me , made my mountain stand strong ; but when you hid your face , I was troubled .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我曾求告你；我向耶和華懇求，[說]：
verses.e: I cried to you , LORD . I made supplication to the Lord :

verses.z: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有甚麼益處呢？塵土豈能稱讚你，傳說你的誠實嗎？
verses.e: " What profit is there in my destruction , if I go down to the pit ? Shall the dust praise you ? Shall it declare your truth ?

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。耶和華啊，我投靠你；求你使我永不羞愧；憑你的公義搭救我！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . In you , LORD , I take refuge . Let me never be disappointed . Deliver me in your righteousness .

verses.z: 我的生命為愁苦所消耗；我的年歲為歎息所曠廢。我的力量因我的罪孽衰敗；我的骨頭也枯乾。
verses.e: For my life is spent with sorrow , my years with sighing . My strength fails because of my iniquity . My bones are wasted away .

verses.z: 我因一切敵人成了羞辱，在我的鄰舍跟前更甚；那認識我的都懼怕我，在外頭看見我的都躲避我。
verses.e: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors , a horror to my acquaintances . Those who saw me on the street fled from me .

verses.z: 我被人忘記，如同死人，無人記念；我好像破碎的器皿。
verses.e: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man . I am like broken pottery .

verses.z: 我聽見了許多人的讒謗，四圍都是驚嚇；他們一同商議攻擊我的時候，就圖謀要害我的性命。
verses.e: For I have heard the slander of many , terror on every side , while they conspire together against me , they plot to take away my life .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我仍舊倚靠你；我說：你是我的上帝。
verses.e: But I trust in you , LORD . I said , " You are my God . "

verses.z: 我終身的事在你手中；求你救我脫離仇敵的手和那些逼迫我的人。
verses.e: My times are in your hand . Deliver me from the hand of my enemies , and from those who persecute me .

verses.z: 求你使你的臉光照僕人，憑你的慈愛拯救我。
verses.e: Make your face to shine on your servant . Save me in your loving kindness .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你叫我不致羞愧，因為我曾呼籲你；求你使惡人羞愧，使他們在陰間緘默無聲。
verses.e: Let me not be disappointed , LORD , for I have called on you . Let the wicked be disappointed . Let them be silent in Sheol .

verses.z: 那撒謊的人逞驕傲輕慢，出狂妄的話攻擊義人；願他的嘴啞而無言。
verses.e: Let the lying lips be mute , which speak against the righteous insolently , with pride and contempt .

verses.z: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你為他們所積存的，在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！
verses.e: Oh how great is your goodness , which you have laid up for those who fear you , which you have worked for those who take refuge in you , before the sons of men !

verses.z: 求你側耳而聽，快快救我！作我堅固的磐石，拯救我的保障！
verses.e: Bow down your ear to me . Deliver me speedily . Be to me a strong rock , a house of defense to save me .

verses.z: 你必把他們藏在你面前的隱密處，免得遇見人的計謀；你必暗暗地保守他們在亭子裏，免受口舌的爭鬧。
verses.e: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man . You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues .

verses.z: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，因為他在堅固城裏向我施展奇妙的慈愛。
verses.e: Praise be to the LORD , for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city .

verses.z: 至於我，我曾急促地說：我從你眼前被隔絕。然而，我呼求你的時候，你仍聽我懇求的聲音。
verses.e: As for me , I said in my haste , " I am cut off from before your eyes . " Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you .

verses.z: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們都要愛他！耶和華保護誠實人，足足報應行事驕傲的人。
verses.e: Oh love the LORD , all you his saints ! The LORD preserves the faithful , and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly .

verses.z: 凡仰望耶和華的人，你們都要壯膽，堅固你們的心！
verses.e: Be strong , and let your heart take courage , all you who hope in the LORD .

verses.z: 因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨；所以，求你為你名的緣故引導我，指點我。
verses.e: For you are my rock and my fortress , therefore for your name's sake lead me and guide me .

verses.z: 求你救我脫離人為我暗設的網羅，因為你是我的保障。
verses.e: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me , for you are my stronghold .

verses.z: 我將我的靈魂交在你手裏；耶和華誠實的上帝啊，你救贖了我。
verses.e: Into your hand I commend my spirit . You redeem me , LORD , God of truth .

verses.z: 我恨惡那信奉虛無[之神]的人；我卻倚靠耶和華。
verses.e: I hate those who regard lying vanities , but I trust in the LORD .

verses.z: 我要為你的慈愛高興歡喜；因為你見過我的困苦，知道我心中的艱難。
verses.e: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness , for you have seen my affliction . You have known my soul in adversities .

verses.z: 你未曾把我交在仇敵手裏；你使我的腳站在寬闊之處。
verses.e: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy . You have set my feet in a large place .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，因為我在急難之中；我的眼睛因憂愁而乾癟，連我的身心也不安舒。
verses.e: Have mercy on me , LORD , for I am in distress . My eye , my soul , and my body waste away with grief .

verses.z: 大衛的訓誨詩。得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的，這人是有福的！
verses.e: By David . A contemplative psalm . Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven , whose sin is covered .

verses.z: 惡人必多受苦楚；惟獨倚靠耶和華的必有慈愛四面環繞他。
verses.e: Many sorrows come to the wicked , but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD .

verses.z: 你們義人應當靠耶和華歡喜快樂；你們心裏正直的人都當歡呼。
verses.e: Be glad in the LORD , and rejoice , you righteous ! Shout for joy , all you who are upright in heart !

verses.z: 凡心裏沒有詭詐、耶和華不算為有罪的，這人是有福的！
verses.e: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn't impute iniquity , in whose spirit there is no deceit .

verses.z: 我閉口不認罪的時候，因終日唉哼而骨頭枯乾。
verses.e: When I kept silence , my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long .

verses.z: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重；我的精液耗盡，如同夏天的乾旱。（細拉）
verses.e: For day and night your hand was heavy on me . My strength was sapped in the heat of summer . Selah .

verses.z: 我向你陳明我的罪，不隱瞞我的惡。我說：我要向耶和華承認我的過犯，你就赦免我的罪惡。（細拉）
verses.e: I acknowledged my sin to you . I didn't hide my iniquity . I said , I will confess my transgressions to the LORD , and you forgave the iniquity of my sin . Selah .

verses.z: 為此，凡虔誠人都當趁你可尋找的時候禱告你；大水泛溢的時候，必不能到他那裏。
verses.e: For this , let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found . Surely when the great waters overflow , they shall not reach to him .

verses.z: 你是我藏身之處；你必保佑我脫離苦難，以得救的樂歌四面環繞我。（細拉）
verses.e: You are my hiding place . You will preserve me from trouble . You will surround me with songs of deliverance . Selah .

verses.z: 我要教導你，指示你當行的路；我要定睛在你身上勸戒你。
verses.e: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go . I will counsel you with my eye on you .

verses.z: 你不可像那無知的騾馬，必用嚼環轡頭勒住牠；不然，就不能馴服。
verses.e: Don't be like the horse , or like the mule , which have no understanding , who are controlled by bit and bridle , or else they will not come near to you .

verses.z: 義人哪，你們應當靠耶和華歡樂；正直人的讚美是合宜的。
verses.e: Rejoice in the LORD , you righteous ! Praise is fitting for the upright .

verses.z: 耶和華使列國的籌算歸於無有，使眾民的思念無有功效。
verses.e: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing . He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect .

verses.z: 耶和華的籌算永遠立定；他心中的思念萬代常存。
verses.e: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .

verses.z: 以耶和華為上帝的，那國是有福的！他所揀選為自己產業的，那民是有福的！
verses.e: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD , the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance .

verses.z: 耶和華從天上觀看；他看見一切的世人。
verses.e: The LORD looks from heaven . He sees all the sons of men .

verses.z: 從他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民－
verses.e: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth ,

verses.z: 他是那造成他們眾人心的，留意他們一切作為的。
verses.e: he who fashions all of their hearts ; and he considers all of their works .

verses.z: 君王不能因兵多得勝；勇士不能因力大得救。
verses.e: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army . A mighty man is not delivered by great strength .

verses.z: 靠馬得救是枉然的；馬也不能因力大救人。
verses.e: A horse is a vain thing for safety , neither does he deliver any by his great power .

verses.z: 耶和華的眼目看顧敬畏他的人和仰望他慈愛的人，
verses.e: Behold , the LORD's eye is on those who fear him , on those who hope in his loving kindness ,

verses.z: 要救他們的命脫離死亡，並使他們在饑荒中存活。
verses.e: to deliver their soul from death , to keep them alive in famine .

verses.z: 你們應當彈琴稱謝耶和華，用十弦瑟歌頌他。
verses.e: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre . Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings .

verses.z: 我們的心向來等候耶和華；他是我們的幫助，我們的盾牌。
verses.e: Our soul has waited for the LORD . He is our help and our shield .

verses.z: 我們的心必靠他歡喜，因為我們向來倚靠他的聖名。
verses.e: For our heart rejoices in him , because we have trusted in his holy name .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你照着我們所仰望你的，向我們施行慈愛！
verses.e: Let your loving kindness be on us , LORD , since we have hoped in you .

verses.z: 應當向他唱新歌，彈得巧妙，聲音洪亮。
verses.e: Sing to him a new song . Play skillfully with a shout of joy !

verses.z: 因為耶和華的言語正直；凡他所做的盡都誠實。
verses.e: For the LORD's word is right . All his work is done in faithfulness .

verses.z: 他喜愛仁義公平；遍地滿了耶和華的慈愛。
verses.e: He loves righteousness and justice . The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD .

verses.z: 諸天藉耶和華的命而造；萬象藉他口中的氣而成。
verses.e: By the LORD's word , the heavens were made : all their army by the breath of his mouth .

verses.z: 他聚集海水如壘，收藏深洋在庫房。
verses.e: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap . He lays up the deeps in storehouses .

verses.z: 願全地都敬畏耶和華！願世上的居民都懼怕他！
verses.e: Let all the earth fear the LORD . Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him .

verses.z: 因為他說有，就有，命立，就立。
verses.e: For he spoke , and it was done . He commanded , and it stood firm .

verses.z: 大衛在亞比米勒面前裝瘋，被他趕出去，就作這詩。我要時時稱頌耶和華；讚美他的話必常在我口中。
verses.e: By David ; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech , who drove him away , and he departed . I will bless the LORD at all times . His praise will always be in my mouth .

verses.z: 少壯獅子還缺食忍餓，但尋求耶和華的甚麼好處都不缺。
verses.e: The young lions do lack , and suffer hunger , but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing .

verses.z: 眾弟子啊，你們當來聽我的話！我要將敬畏耶和華的道教訓你們。
verses.e: Come , you children , listen to me . I will teach you the fear of the LORD .

verses.z: 有何人喜好存活，愛慕[長]壽，得享美福，
verses.e: Who is someone who desires life , and loves many days , that he may see good ?

verses.z: 就要禁止舌頭不出惡言，嘴唇不說詭詐的話。
verses.e: Keep your tongue from evil , and your lips from speaking lies .

verses.z: 要離惡行善，尋求和睦，一心追趕。
verses.e: Depart from evil , and do good . Seek peace , and pursue it .

verses.z: 耶和華的眼目看顧義人；他的耳朵聽他們的呼求。
verses.e: The LORD's eyes are toward the righteous . His ears listen to their cry .

verses.z: 耶和華向行惡的人變臉，要從世上除滅他們的名號。
verses.e: The LORD's face is against those who do evil , to cut off their memory from the earth .

verses.z: [義人]呼求，耶和華聽見了，便救他們脫離一切患難。
verses.e: The righteous cry , and the LORD hears , and delivers them out of all their troubles .

verses.z: 耶和華靠近傷心的人，拯救靈性痛悔的人。
verses.e: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart , and saves those who have a crushed spirit .

verses.z: 義人多有苦難，但耶和華救他脫離這一切，
verses.e: Many are the afflictions of the righteous , but the LORD delivers him out of them all .

verses.z: 我的心必因耶和華誇耀；謙卑人聽見就要喜樂。
verses.e: My soul shall boast in the LORD . The humble shall hear of it and be glad .

verses.z: 又保全他一身的骨頭，連一根也不折斷。
verses.e: He protects all of his bones . Not one of them is broken .

verses.z: 惡必害死惡人；恨惡義人的，必被定罪。
verses.e: Evil shall kill the wicked . Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned .

verses.z: 耶和華救贖他僕人的靈魂；凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
verses.e: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants . None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned .

verses.z: 你們和我當稱耶和華為大，一同高舉他的名。
verses.e: Oh magnify the LORD with me . Let's exalt his name together .

verses.z: 我曾尋求耶和華，他就應允我，救我脫離了一切的恐懼。
verses.e: I sought the LORD , and he answered me , and delivered me from all my fears .

verses.z: 凡仰望他的，便有光榮；他們的臉必不蒙羞。
verses.e: They looked to him , and were radiant . Their faces shall never be covered with shame .

verses.z: 我這困苦人呼求，耶和華便垂聽，救我脫離一切患難。
verses.e: This poor man cried , and the LORD heard him , and saved him out of all his troubles .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者在敬畏他的人四圍安營，搭救他們。
verses.e: The LORD's angel encamps around those who fear him , and delivers them .

verses.z: 你們要嘗嘗[主恩的滋味]，便知道他是美善；投靠他的人有福了！
verses.e: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good . Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him .

verses.z: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們當敬畏他，因敬畏他的一無所缺。
verses.e: Oh fear the LORD , you his saints , for there is no lack with those who fear him .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。耶和華啊，與我相爭的，求你與他們相爭！與我相戰的，求你與他們相戰！
verses.e: By David . Contend , LORD , with those who contend with me . Fight against those who fight against me .

verses.z: 我的骨頭都要說：耶和華啊，誰能像你救護困苦人脫離那比他強壯的，救護困苦窮乏人脫離那搶奪他的？
verses.e: All my bones shall say , " LORD , who is like you , who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him ; yes , the poor and the needy from him who robs him ? "

verses.z: 凶惡的見證人起來，盤問我所不知道的事。
verses.e: Unrighteous witnesses rise up . They ask me about things that I don't know about .

verses.z: 他們向我以惡報善，使我的靈魂孤苦。
verses.e: They reward me evil for good , to the bereaving of my soul .

verses.z: 至於我，當他們有病的時候，我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心；我所求的都歸到自己的懷中。
verses.e: But as for me , when they were sick , my clothing was sackcloth . I afflicted my soul with fasting . My prayer returned into my own bosom .

verses.z: 我這樣行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄；我屈身悲哀，如同人為母親哀痛。
verses.e: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother . I bowed down mourning , as one who mourns his mother .

verses.z: 我在患難中，他們卻歡喜，大家聚集。我所不認識的那些下流人聚集攻擊我；他們不住地把我撕裂。
verses.e: But in my adversity , they rejoiced , and gathered themselves together . The attackers gathered themselves together against me , and I didn't know it . They tore at me , and didn't cease .

verses.z: 他們如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。
verses.e: Like the profane mockers in feasts , they gnashed their teeth at me .

verses.z: 主啊，你看着不理要到幾時呢？求你救我的靈魂脫離他們的殘害！救我的生命脫離少壯獅子！
verses.e: Lord , how long will you look on ? Rescue my soul from their destruction , my precious life from the lions .

verses.z: 我在大會中要稱謝你，在眾民中要讚美你。
verses.e: I will give you thanks in the great assembly . I will praise you among many people .

verses.z: 求你不容那無理與我為仇的向我誇耀！不容那無故恨我的向我擠眼！
verses.e: Don't let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me ; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes .

verses.z: 拿着大小的盾牌，起來幫助我。
verses.e: Take hold of shield and buckler , and stand up for my help .

verses.z: 因為他們不說和平話，倒想出詭詐的言語害地上的安靜人。
verses.e: For they don't speak peace , but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land .

verses.z: 他們大大張口攻擊我，說：阿哈，阿哈，我們的眼已經看見了！
verses.e: Yes , they opened their mouth wide against me . They said , " Aha ! Aha ! Our eye has seen it ! "

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你已經看見了，求你不要閉口！主啊，求你不要遠離我！
verses.e: You have seen it , LORD . Don't keep silent . Lord , don't be far from me .

verses.z: 我的上帝我的主啊，求你奮興醒起，判清我的事，伸明我的冤！
verses.e: Wake up ! Rise up to defend me , my God ! My Lord , contend for me !

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你按你的公義判斷我，不容他們向我誇耀！
verses.e: Vindicate me , LORD my God , according to your righteousness . Don't let them gloat over me .

verses.z: 不容他們心裏說：阿哈，遂我們的心願了！不容他們說：我們已經把他吞了！
verses.e: Don't let them say in their heart , " Aha ! That's the way we want it ! " Don't let them say , " We have swallowed him up ! "

verses.z: 願那喜歡我遭難的一同抱愧蒙羞！願那向我妄自尊大的披慚愧，蒙羞辱！
verses.e: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity . Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me .

verses.z: 願那喜悅我冤屈得伸的歡呼快樂；願他們常說：當尊耶和華為大！耶和華喜悅他的僕人平安。
verses.e: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad . Yes , let them say continually , " May the LORD be magnified , who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant ! "

verses.z: 我的舌頭要終日論說你的公義，時常讚美你。
verses.e: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long .

verses.z: 抽出槍來，擋住那追趕我的；求你對我的靈魂說：我是拯救你的。
verses.e: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me . Tell my soul , " I am your salvation . "

verses.z: 願那尋索我命的，蒙羞受辱！願那謀害我的，退後羞愧！
verses.e: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor . Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded .

verses.z: 願他們像風前的糠，有耶和華的使者趕逐他們。
verses.e: Let them be as chaff before the wind , the LORD's angel driving them on .

verses.z: 願他們的道路又暗又滑，有耶和華的使者追趕他們。
verses.e: Let their way be dark and slippery , the LORD's angel pursuing them .

verses.z: 因他們無故地為我暗設網羅，無故地挖坑，要害我的性命。
verses.e: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me . Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul .

verses.z: 願災禍忽然臨到他身上！願他暗設的網纏住自己！願他落在其中遭災禍！
verses.e: Let destruction come on him unawares . Let his net that he has hidden catch himself . Let him fall into that destruction .

verses.z: 我的心必靠耶和華快樂，靠他的救恩高興。
verses.e: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD . It shall rejoice in his salvation .

verses.z: 耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。惡人的罪過在他心裏說：我眼中不怕上帝！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . By David , the servant of the LORD . A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked : There is no fear of God before his eyes .

verses.z: 願你常施慈愛給認識你的人，常以公義待心裏正直的人。
verses.e: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you , your righteousness to the upright in heart .

verses.z: 不容驕傲人的腳踐踏我；不容凶惡人的手趕逐我。
verses.e: Don't let the foot of pride come against me . Don't let the hand of the wicked drive me away .

verses.z: 在那裏，作孽的人已經仆倒；他們被推倒，不能再起來。
verses.e: There the workers of iniquity are fallen . They are thrust down , and shall not be able to rise .

verses.z: 他自誇自媚，以為他的罪孽終不顯露，不被恨惡。
verses.e: For he flatters himself in his own eyes , too much to detect and hate his sin .

verses.z: 他口中的言語盡是罪孽詭詐；他與智慧善行已經斷絕。
verses.e: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit . He has ceased to be wise and to do good .

verses.z: 他在床上圖謀罪孽，定意行不善的道，不憎惡惡事。
verses.e: He plots iniquity on his bed . He sets himself in a way that is not good . He doesn't abhor evil .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛上及諸天；你的信實達到穹蒼。
verses.e: Your loving kindness , LORD , is in the heavens . Your faithfulness reaches to the skies .

verses.z: 你的公義好像高山；你的判斷如同深淵。耶和華啊，人民、牲畜，你都救護。
verses.e: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God . Your judgments are like a great deep . LORD , you preserve man and animal .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你的慈愛何其寶貴！世人投靠在你翅膀的蔭下。
verses.e: How precious is your loving kindness , God ! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings .

verses.z: 他們必因你殿裏的肥甘得以飽足；你也必叫他們喝你樂河的[水]。
verses.e: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house . You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures .

verses.z: 因為，在你那裏有生命的源頭；在你的光中，我們必得見光。
verses.e: For with you is the spring of life . In your light we will see light .

verses.z: 大衛的詩。不要為作惡的心懷不平，也不要向那行不義的生出嫉妒。
verses.e: By David . Don't fret because of evildoers , neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness .

verses.z: 還有片時，惡人要歸於無有；你就是細察他的住處也要歸於無有。
verses.e: For yet a little while , and the wicked will be no more . Yes , though you look for his place , he isn't there .

verses.z: 但謙卑人必承受地土，以豐盛的平安為樂。
verses.e: But the humble shall inherit the land , and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace .

verses.z: 惡人設謀害義人，又向他咬牙。
verses.e: The wicked plots against the just , and gnashes at him with his teeth .

verses.z: 主要笑他，因見他[受罰]的日子將要來到。
verses.e: The Lord will laugh at him , for he sees that his day is coming .

verses.z: 惡人已經弓上弦，刀出鞘，要打倒困苦窮乏的人，要殺害行動正直的人。
verses.e: The wicked have drawn out the sword , and have bent their bow , to cast down the poor and needy , to kill those who are upright on the path .

verses.z: 他們的刀必刺入自己的心；他們的弓必被折斷。
verses.e: Their sword shall enter into their own heart . Their bows shall be broken .

verses.z: 一個義人所有的雖少，強過許多惡人的富餘。
verses.e: Better is a little that the righteous has , than the abundance of many wicked .

verses.z: 因為惡人的膀臂必被折斷；但耶和華是扶持義人。
verses.e: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken , but the LORD upholds the righteous .

verses.z: 耶和華知道完全人的日子；他們的產業要存到永遠。
verses.e: The LORD knows the days of the perfect . Their inheritance shall be forever .

verses.z: 他們在急難的時候不致羞愧，在饑荒的日子必得飽足。
verses.e: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil . In the days of famine they shall be satisfied .

verses.z: 因為他們如草快被割下，又如青菜快要枯乾。
verses.e: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass , and wither like the green herb .

verses.z: 惡人卻要滅亡。耶和華的仇敵要像羊羔的脂油；他們要消滅，要如煙消滅。
verses.e: But the wicked shall perish . The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields . They will vanish — vanish like smoke .

verses.z: 惡人借貸而不償還；義人卻恩待人，並且施捨。
verses.e: The wicked borrow , and don't pay back , but the righteous give generously .

verses.z: 蒙耶和華賜福的必承受地土；被他咒詛的必被剪除。
verses.e: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land . Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off .

verses.z: 義人的腳步被耶和華立定；他的道路，耶和華也喜愛。
verses.e: A man's steps are established by the LORD . He delights in his way .

verses.z: 他雖失腳也不致全身仆倒，因為耶和華用手攙扶他。
verses.e: Though he stumble , he shall not fall , for the LORD holds him up with his hand .

verses.z: 我從前年幼，現在年老，卻未見過義人被棄，也未見過他的後裔討飯。
verses.e: I have been young , and now am old , yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken , nor his children begging for bread .

verses.z: 他終日恩待人，借給人；他的後裔也蒙福！
verses.e: All day long he deals graciously , and lends . His offspring is blessed .

verses.z: 你當離惡行善，就可永遠[安]居。
verses.e: Depart from evil , and do good . Live securely forever .

verses.z: 因為，耶和華喜愛公平，不撇棄他的聖民；他們永蒙保佑，但惡人的後裔必被剪除。
verses.e: For the LORD loves justice , and doesn't forsake his saints . They are preserved forever , but the children of the wicked shall be cut off .

verses.z: 義人必承受地土，永居其上。
verses.e: The righteous shall inherit the land , and live in it forever .

verses.z: 你當倚靠耶和華而行善，住在地上，以他的信實為糧；
verses.e: Trust in the LORD , and do good . Dwell in the land , and enjoy safe pasture .

verses.z: 義人的口談論智慧；他的舌頭講說公平。
verses.e: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom . His tongue speaks justice .

verses.z: 上帝的律法在他心裏；他的腳總不滑跌。
verses.e: The law of his God is in his heart . None of his steps shall slide .

verses.z: 惡人窺探義人，想要殺他。
verses.e: The wicked watch the righteous , and seek to kill him .

verses.z: 耶和華必不撇他在惡人手中；當審判的時候，也不定他的罪。
verses.e: The LORD will not leave him in his hand , nor condemn him when he is judged .

verses.z: 你當等候耶和華，遵守他的道，他就抬舉你，使你承受地土；惡人被剪除的時候，你必看見。
verses.e: Wait for the LORD , and keep his way , and he will exalt you to inherit the land . When the wicked are cut off , you shall see it .

verses.z: 我見過惡人大有勢力，好像一棵青翠樹在本土生發。
verses.e: I have seen the wicked in great power , spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil .

verses.z: 有人從那裏經過，不料，他沒有了；我也尋找他，卻尋不着。
verses.e: But he passed away , and behold , he was not . Yes , I sought him , but he could not be found .

verses.z: 你要細察那完全人，觀看那正直人，因為和平人有[好]結局。
verses.e: Mark the perfect man , and see the upright , for there is a future for the man of peace .

verses.z: 至於犯法的人，必一同滅絕；惡人終必剪除。
verses.e: As for transgressors , they shall be destroyed together . The future of the wicked shall be cut off .

verses.z: 但義人得救是由於耶和華；他在患難時作他們的營寨。
verses.e: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD . He is their stronghold in the time of trouble .

verses.z: 又要以耶和華為樂，他就將你心裏所求的賜給你。
verses.e: Also delight yourself in the LORD , and he will give you the desires of your heart .

verses.z: 耶和華幫助他們，解救他們；他解救他們脫離惡人，把他們救出來，因為他們投靠他。
verses.e: The LORD helps them and rescues them . He rescues them from the wicked and saves them , because they have taken refuge in him .

verses.z: 當將你的事交託耶和華，並倚靠他，他就必成全。
verses.e: Commit your way to the LORD . Trust also in him , and he will do this :

verses.z: 他要使你的公義如光發出，使你的公平明如正午。
verses.e: he will make your righteousness shine out like light , and your justice as the noon day sun .

verses.z: 你當默然倚靠耶和華，耐性等候他；不要因那道路通達的和那惡謀成就的心懷不平。
verses.e: Rest in the LORD , and wait patiently for him . Don't fret because of him who prospers in his way , because of the man who makes wicked plots happen .

verses.z: 當止住怒氣，離棄忿怒；不要心懷不平，以致作惡。
verses.e: Cease from anger , and forsake wrath . Don't fret ; it leads only to evildoing .

verses.z: 因為作惡的必被剪除；惟有等候耶和華的必承受地土。
verses.e: For evildoers shall be cut off , but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land .

verses.z: 大衛的紀念詩。耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我，不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
verses.e: A Psalm by David , for a memorial . LORD , don't rebuke me in your wrath , neither chasten me in your hot displeasure .

verses.z: 我心跳動，我力衰微，連我眼中的光也沒有了。
verses.e: My heart throbs . My strength fails me . As for the light of my eyes , it has also left me .

verses.z: 我的良朋密友因我的災病都躲在旁邊站着；我的親戚本家也遠遠地站立。
verses.e: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague . My kinsmen stand far away .

verses.z: 那尋索我命的設下網羅；那想要害我的口出惡言，終日思想詭計。
verses.e: They also who seek after my life lay snares . Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things , and meditate deceits all day long .

verses.z: 但我如聾子不聽，像啞巴不開口。
verses.e: But I , as a deaf man , don't hear . I am as a mute man who doesn't open his mouth .

verses.z: 我如不聽見的人，口中沒有回話。
verses.e: Yes , I am as a man who doesn't hear , in whose mouth are no reproofs .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我仰望你！主－我的上帝啊，你必應允我！
verses.e: For I hope in you , LORD . You will answer , Lord my God .

verses.z: 我曾說：恐怕他們向我誇耀；我失腳的時候，他們向我誇大。
verses.e: For I said , " Don't let them gloat over me , or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips . "

verses.z: 我幾乎跌倒；我的痛苦常在我面前。
verses.e: For I am ready to fall . My pain is continually before me .

verses.z: 我要承認我的罪孽；我要因我的罪憂愁。
verses.e: For I will declare my iniquity . I will be sorry for my sin .

verses.z: 但我的仇敵又活潑又強壯，無理恨我的增多了。
verses.e: But my enemies are vigorous and many . Those who hate me without reason are numerous .

verses.z: 因為，你的箭射入我身；你的手壓住我。
verses.e: For your arrows have pierced me , your hand presses hard on me .

verses.z: 以惡報善的與我作對，因我是追求良善。
verses.e: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me , because I follow what is good .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你不要撇棄我！我的上帝啊，求你不要遠離我！
verses.e: Don't forsake me , LORD . My God , don't be far from me .

verses.z: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快幫助我！
verses.e: Hurry to help me , Lord , my salvation .

verses.z: 因你的惱怒，我的肉無一完全；因我的罪過，我的骨頭也不安寧。
verses.e: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation , neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin .

verses.z: 我的罪孽高過我的頭，如同重擔叫我擔當不起。
verses.e: For my iniquities have gone over my head . As a heavy burden , they are too heavy for me .

verses.z: 因我的愚昧，我的傷發臭流膿。
verses.e: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness .

verses.z: 我疼痛，大大拳曲，終日哀痛。
verses.e: I am in pain and bowed down greatly . I go mourning all day long .

verses.z: 我滿腰是火；我的肉無一完全。
verses.e: For my waist is filled with burning . There is no soundness in my flesh .

verses.z: 我被壓傷，身體疲倦；因心裏不安，我就唉哼。
verses.e: I am faint and severely bruised . I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart .

verses.z: 主啊，我的心願都在你面前；我的歎息不向你隱瞞。
verses.e: Lord , all my desire is before you . My groaning is not hidden from you .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長耶杜頓。我曾說：我要謹慎我的言行，免得我舌頭犯罪；惡人在我面前的時候，我要用嚼環勒住我的口。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . For Jeduthun . A Psalm by David . I said , " I will watch my ways , so that I don't sin with my tongue . I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me . "

verses.z: 求你把你的責罰從我身上免去；因你手的責打，我便消滅。
verses.e: Remove your scourge away from me . I am overcome by the blow of your hand .

verses.z: 你因人的罪惡懲罰他的時候，叫他的笑容消滅，如[衣]被蟲所咬。世人真是虛幻！（細拉）
verses.e: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity , you consume his wealth like a moth . Surely every man is but a breath . " Selah .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，留心聽我的呼求！我流淚，求你不要靜默無聲！因為我在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我列祖一般。
verses.e: " Hear my prayer , LORD , and give ear to my cry . Don't be silent at my tears . For I am a stranger with you , a foreigner , as all my fathers were .

verses.z: 求你寬容我，使我在去而不返之先可以力量復原。
verses.e: Oh spare me , that I may recover strength , before I go away and exist no more . "

verses.z: 我默然無聲，連好話也不出口；我的愁苦就發動了，
verses.e: I was mute with silence . I held my peace , even from good . My sorrow was stirred .

verses.z: 我的心在我裏面發熱。我默想的時候，火就燒起，我便用舌頭說話。
verses.e: My heart was hot within me . While I meditated , the fire burned . I spoke with my tongue :

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你叫我曉得我身之終！我的壽數幾何？叫我知道我的生命不長！
verses.e: " LORD , show me my end , what is the measure of my days . Let me know how frail I am .

verses.z: 你使我的年日窄如手掌；我一生的年數，在你面前如同無有。各人最穩妥的時候，真是全然虛幻。（細拉）
verses.e: Behold , you have made my days hand widths . My lifetime is as nothing before you . Surely every man stands as a breath . " Selah .

verses.z: 世人行動實係幻影。他們忙亂，真是枉然；積蓄[財寶]，不知將來有誰收取。
verses.e: " Surely every man walks like a shadow . Surely they busy themselves in vain . He heaps up , and doesn't know who shall gather .

verses.z: 主啊，如今我等甚麼呢？我的指望在乎你！
verses.e: Now , Lord , what do I wait for ? My hope is in you .

verses.z: 求你救我脫離一切的過犯，不要使我受愚頑人的羞辱。
verses.e: Deliver me from all my transgressions . Don't make me the reproach of the foolish .

verses.z: 因我所遭遇的是出於你，我就默然不語。
verses.e: I was mute . I didn't open my mouth , because you did it .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。顯我為義的上帝啊，我呼籲的時候，求你應允我！我在困苦中，你曾使我寬廣；現在求你憐恤我，聽我的禱告！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician ; on stringed instruments . A Psalm by David . Answer me when I call , God of my righteousness . Give me relief from my distress . Have mercy on me , and hear my prayer .

verses.z: 你們這上流人哪，你們將我的尊榮變為羞辱[要到幾時呢]？你們喜愛虛妄，尋找虛假，要到幾時呢？（細拉）
verses.e: You sons of men , how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor ? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood ? Selah .

verses.z: 你們要知道，耶和華已經分別虔誠人歸他自己；我求告耶和華，他必聽我。
verses.e: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly ; The LORD will hear when I call to him .

verses.z: 你們應當畏懼，不可犯罪；在床上的時候，要心裏思想，並要肅靜。（細拉）
verses.e: Stand in awe , and don't sin . Search your own heart on your bed , and be still . Selah .

verses.z: 當獻上公義的祭，又當倚靠耶和華。
verses.e: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness . Put your trust in the LORD .

verses.z: 有許多人說：誰能指示我們甚麼好處？耶和華啊，求你仰起臉來，光照我們。
verses.e: Many say , " Who will show us any good ? " LORD , let the light of your face shine on us .

verses.z: 你使我心裏快樂，勝過那豐收五穀新酒的人。
verses.e: You have put gladness in my heart , more than when their grain and their new wine are increased .

verses.z: 我必安然躺下睡覺，因為獨有你－耶和華使我安然居住。
verses.e: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep , for you alone , LORD , make me live in safety .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。我曾耐性等候耶和華；他垂聽我的呼求。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . I waited patiently for the LORD . He turned to me , and heard my cry .

verses.z: 我未曾把你的公義藏在心裏；我已陳明你的信實和你的救恩；我在大會中未曾隱瞞你的慈愛和誠實。
verses.e: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart . I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation . I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！願你的慈愛和誠實常常保佑我！
verses.e: Don't withhold your tender mercies from me , LORD . Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me .

verses.z: 因有無數的禍患圍困我，我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首；這罪孽比我的頭髮還多，我就心寒膽戰。
verses.e: For innumerable evils have surrounded me . My iniquities have overtaken me , so that I am not able to look up . They are more than the hairs of my head . My heart has failed me .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你開恩搭救我！耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
verses.e: Be pleased , LORD , to deliver me . Hurry to help me , LORD .

verses.z: 願那些尋找我、要滅我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！願那些喜悅我受害的，退後受辱！
verses.e: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it . Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt .

verses.z: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧而敗亡！
verses.e: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me , " Aha ! Aha ! "

verses.z: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜！願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊耶和華為大！
verses.e: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you . Let such as love your salvation say continually , " Let the LORD be exalted ! "

verses.z: 但我是困苦窮乏的，主仍顧念我；你是幫助我的，搭救我的。上帝啊，求你不要耽延！
verses.e: But I am poor and needy . May the Lord think about me . You are my help and my deliverer . Don't delay , my God .

verses.z: 他從禍坑裏，從淤泥中，把我拉上來，使我的腳立在磐石上，使我腳步穩當。
verses.e: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit , out of the miry clay . He set my feet on a rock , and gave me a firm place to stand .

verses.z: 他使我口唱新歌，就是讚美我們上帝的話。許多人必看見而懼怕，並要倚靠耶和華。
verses.e: He has put a new song in my mouth , even praise to our God . Many shall see it , and fear , and shall trust in the LORD .

verses.z: 那倚靠耶和華、不理會狂傲和偏向虛假之輩的，這人便為有福！
verses.e: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust , and doesn't respect the proud , nor such as turn away to lies .

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，你所行的奇事，並你向我們所懷的意念甚多，不能向你陳明；若要陳明，其事不可勝數。
verses.e: Many , LORD , my God , are the wonderful works which you have done , and your thoughts which are toward us . They can't be declared back to you . If I would declare and speak of them , they are more than can be counted .

verses.z: 祭物和禮物，你不喜悅；你已經開通我的耳朵。燔祭和贖罪祭非你所要。
verses.e: Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire . You have opened my ears . You have not required burnt offering and sin offering .

verses.z: 那時我說：看哪，我來了！我的事在經卷上已經記載了。
verses.e: Then I said , " Behold , I have come . It is written about me in the book in the scroll .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，我樂意照你的旨意行；你的律法在我心裏。
verses.e: I delight to do your will , my God . Yes , your law is within my heart . "

verses.z: 我在大會中宣傳公義的佳音；我必不止住我的嘴唇。耶和華啊，這是你所知道的。
verses.e: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly . Behold , I will not seal my lips , LORD , you know .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。眷顧貧窮的有福了！他遭難的日子，耶和華必搭救他。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . Blessed is he who considers the poor . The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，使我起來，好報復他們！
verses.e: But you , LORD , have mercy on me , and raise me up , that I may repay them .

verses.z: 因我的仇敵不得向我誇勝，我從此便知道你喜愛我。
verses.e: By this I know that you delight in me , because my enemy doesn't triumph over me .

verses.z: 你因我純正就扶持我，使我永遠站在你的面前。
verses.e: As for me , you uphold me in my integrity , and set me in your presence forever .

verses.z: 耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的，從亙古直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD , the God of Israel , from everlasting and to everlasting ! Amen and amen .

verses.z: 耶和華必保全他，使他存活；他必在地上享福。求你不要把他交給仇敵，遂其所願。
verses.e: The LORD will preserve him , and keep him alive . He shall be blessed on the earth , and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies .

verses.z: 他病重在榻，耶和華必扶持他；他在病中，你必給他鋪床。
verses.e: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed , and restore him from his bed of illness .

verses.z: 我曾說：耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，醫治我！因為我得罪了你。
verses.e: I said , " LORD , have mercy on me ! Heal me , for I have sinned against you . "

verses.z: 我的仇敵用惡言議論我[說]：他幾時死，他的名才滅亡呢？
verses.e: My enemies speak evil against me : " When will he die , and his name perish ? "

verses.z: 他來看[我]就說假話；他心存奸惡，走到外邊才說出來。
verses.e: If he comes to see me , he speaks falsehood . His heart gathers iniquity to itself . When he goes abroad , he tells it .

verses.z: 一切恨我的，都交頭接耳地議論我；他們設計要害我。
verses.e: All who hate me whisper together against me . They imagine the worst for me .

verses.z: [他們說]：有怪病貼在他身上；他已躺臥，必不能再起來。
verses.e: " An evil disease " , they say , " has afflicted him . Now that he lies he shall rise up no more . "

verses.z: 連我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃過我飯的也用腳踢我。
verses.e: Yes , my own familiar friend , in whom I trusted , who ate bread with me , has lifted up his heel against me .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。上帝啊，我的心切慕你，如鹿切慕溪水。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A contemplation by the sons of Korah . As the deer pants for the water brooks , so my soul pants after you , God .

verses.z: 我的敵人辱罵我，好像打碎我的骨頭，不住地對我說：你的上帝在哪裏呢？
verses.e: As with a sword in my bones , my adversaries reproach me , while they continually ask me , " Where is your God ? "

verses.z: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裏面煩躁？應當仰望上帝，因我還要稱讚他。他是我臉上的光榮，是我的上帝。
verses.e: Why are you in despair , my soul ? Why are you disturbed within me ? Hope in God ! For I shall still praise him , the saving help of my countenance , and my God .

verses.z: 我的心渴想上帝，就是永生上帝；我幾時得朝見上帝呢？
verses.e: My soul thirsts for God , for the living God . When shall I come and appear before God ?

verses.z: 我晝夜以眼淚當飲食；人不住地對我說：你的上帝在哪裏呢？
verses.e: My tears have been my food day and night , while they continually ask me , " Where is your God ? "

verses.z: 我從前與眾人同往，用歡呼稱讚的聲音領他們到上帝的殿裏，大家守節。我追想這些事，我的心極其悲傷。
verses.e: These things I remember , and pour out my soul within me , how I used to go with the crowd , and led them to God's house , with the voice of joy and praise , a multitude keeping a holy day .

verses.z: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裏面煩躁？應當仰望上帝，因他笑臉幫助我；我還要稱讚他。
verses.e: Why are you in despair , my soul ? Why are you disturbed within me ? Hope in God ! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，我的心在我裏面憂悶，所以我從約旦地，從黑門嶺，從米薩山記念你。
verses.e: My God , my soul is in despair within me . Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan , the heights of Hermon , from the hill Mizar .

verses.z: 你的瀑布發聲，深淵就與深淵響應；你的波浪洪濤漫過我身。
verses.e: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls . All your waves and your billows have swept over me .

verses.z: 白晝，耶和華必向我施慈愛；黑夜，我要歌頌禱告賜我生命的上帝。
verses.e: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime . In the night his song shall be with me : a prayer to the God of my life .

verses.z: 我要對上帝－我的磐石說：你為何忘記我呢？我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
verses.e: I will ask God , my rock , " Why have you forgotten me ? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ? "

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你伸我的冤，向不虔誠的國為我辨屈；求你救我脫離詭詐不義的人。
verses.e: Vindicate me , God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation . Oh , deliver me from deceitful and wicked men .

verses.z: 因為你是賜我力量的上帝，為何丟棄我呢？我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
verses.e: For you are the God of my strength . Why have you rejected me ? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ?

verses.z: 求你發出你的亮光和真實，好引導我，帶我到你的聖山，到你的居所！
verses.e: Oh , send out your light and your truth . Let them lead me . Let them bring me to your holy hill , to your tents .

verses.z: 我就走到上帝的祭壇，到我最喜樂的上帝那裏。上帝啊，我的上帝，我要彈琴稱讚你！
verses.e: Then I will go to the altar of God , to God , my exceeding joy . I will praise you on the harp , God , my God .

verses.z: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裏面煩躁？應當仰望上帝，因我還要稱讚他。他是我臉上的光榮，是我的上帝。
verses.e: Why are you in despair , my soul ? Why are you disturbed within me ? Hope in God ! For I shall still praise him : my Savior , my helper , and my God .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。上帝啊，你在古時，我們列祖的日子所行的事，我們親耳聽見了；我們的列祖也給我們述說過。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . By the sons of Korah . A contemplative psalm . We have heard with our ears , God ; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days , in the days of old .

verses.z: 你使我們向敵人轉身退後；那恨我們的人任意搶奪。
verses.e: You make us turn back from the adversary . Those who hate us take plunder for themselves .

verses.z: 你使我們當作快要被吃的羊，把我們分散在列邦中。
verses.e: You have made us like sheep for food , and have scattered us among the nations .

verses.z: 你賣了你的子民也不賺利，所得的價值並不加添你的[資財]。
verses.e: You sell your people for nothing , and have gained nothing from their sale .

verses.z: 你使我們受鄰國的羞辱，被四圍的人嗤笑譏刺。
verses.e: You make us a reproach to our neighbors , a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us .

verses.z: 你使我們在列邦中作了笑談，使眾民向我們搖頭。
verses.e: You make us a byword among the nations , a shaking of the head among the peoples .

verses.z: 我的凌辱終日在我面前，我臉上的羞愧將我遮蔽，
verses.e: All day long my dishonor is before me , and shame covers my face ,

verses.z: 都因那辱罵毀謗人的聲音，又因仇敵和報仇人的緣故。
verses.e: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses , because of the enemy and the avenger .

verses.z: 這都臨到我們身上，我們卻沒有忘記你，也沒有違背你的約。
verses.e: All this has come on us , yet we haven't forgotten you . We haven't been false to your covenant .

verses.z: 我們的心沒有退後；我們的腳也沒有偏離你的路。
verses.e: Our heart has not turned back , neither have our steps strayed from your path ,

verses.z: 你在野狗之處壓傷我們，用死蔭遮蔽我們。
verses.e: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals , and covered us with the shadow of death .

verses.z: 你曾用手趕出外邦人，卻栽培了我們列祖；你苦待列邦，卻叫我們列祖發達。
verses.e: You drove out the nations with your hand , but you planted them . You afflicted the peoples , but you spread them abroad .

verses.z: 倘若我們忘了上帝的名，或向別神舉手，
verses.e: If we have forgotten the name of our God , or spread out our hands to a strange god ,

verses.z: 上帝豈不鑒察這事嗎？因為他曉得人心裏的隱秘。
verses.e: won't God search this out ? For he knows the secrets of the heart .

verses.z: 我們為你的緣故終日被殺；人看我們如將宰的羊。
verses.e: Yes , for your sake we are killed all day long . We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter .

verses.z: 主啊，求你睡醒，為何儘睡呢？求你興起，不要永遠丟棄[我們]！
verses.e: Wake up ! Why do you sleep , Lord ? Arise ! Don't reject us forever .

verses.z: 你為何掩面，不顧我們所遭的苦難和所受的欺壓？
verses.e: Why do you hide your face , and forget our affliction and our oppression ?

verses.z: 我們的性命伏於塵土；我們的肚腹緊貼地面。
verses.e: For our soul is bowed down to the dust . Our body clings to the earth .

verses.z: 求你起來幫助我們！憑你的慈愛救贖我們！
verses.e: Rise up to help us . Redeem us for your loving kindness ' sake .

verses.z: 因為他們不是靠自己的刀劍得地土，也不是靠自己的膀臂得勝，乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂，和你臉上的亮光，因為你喜悅他們。
verses.e: For they didn't get the land in possession by their own sword , neither did their own arm save them ; but your right hand , your arm , and the light of your face , because you were favorable to them .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你是我的王；求你出令使雅各得勝。
verses.e: God , you are my King . Command victories for Jacob !

verses.z: 我們靠你要推倒我們的敵人，靠你的名要踐踏那起來攻擊我們的人。
verses.e: Through you , we will push down our adversaries . Through your name , we will tread down those who rise up against us .

verses.z: 因為，我必不靠我的弓；我的刀也不能使我得勝。
verses.e: For I will not trust in my bow , neither will my sword save me .

verses.z: 惟你救了我們脫離敵人，使恨我們的人羞愧。
verses.e: But you have saved us from our adversaries , and have shamed those who hate us .

verses.z: 我們終日因上帝誇耀，還要永遠稱謝你的名。（細拉）
verses.e: In God we have made our boast all day long . We will give thanks to your name forever . Selah .

verses.z: 但如今你丟棄了我們，使我們受辱，不和我們的軍兵同去。
verses.e: But now you rejected us , and brought us to dishonor , and don't go out with our armies .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，又是愛慕歌，交與伶長。調用百合花。我心裏湧出美辭；我論到我為王做的事，我的舌頭是快手筆。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . Set to " The Lilies . " A contemplation by the sons of Korah . A wedding song . My heart overflows with a noble theme . I recite my verses for the king . My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer .

verses.z: 女子啊，你要聽，要想，要側耳而聽！不要記念你的民和你的父家，
verses.e: Listen , daughter , consider , and turn your ear . Forget your own people , and also your father's house .

verses.z: 王就羨慕你的美貌；因為他是你的主，你當敬拜他。
verses.e: So the king will desire your beauty , honor him , for he is your lord .

verses.z: 泰爾的民[必來]送禮；民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
verses.e: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift . The rich among the people entreat your favor .

verses.z: 王女在[宮]裏極其榮華；她的衣服是用金[線]繡的。
verses.e: The princess inside is all glorious . Her clothing is interwoven with gold .

verses.z: 她要穿錦繡的衣服，被引到王前；隨從她的陪伴童女也要被帶到你面前。
verses.e: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work . The virgins , her companions who follow her , shall be brought to you .

verses.z: 她們要歡喜快樂被引導；她們要進入王宮。
verses.e: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led . They shall enter into the king's palace .

verses.z: 你的子孫要接續你的列祖；你要立他們在全地作王。
verses.e: Your sons will take the place of your fathers . You shall make them princes in all the earth .

verses.z: 我必叫你的名被萬代記念，所以萬民要永永遠遠稱謝你。
verses.e: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations . Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever .

verses.z: 你比世人更美；在你嘴裏滿有恩惠；所以上帝賜福給你，直到永遠。
verses.e: You are the most excellent of the sons of men . Grace has anointed your lips , therefore God has blessed you forever .

verses.z: 大能者啊，願你腰間佩刀，大有榮耀和威嚴！
verses.e: Strap your sword on your thigh , O mighty one , in your splendor and your majesty .

verses.z: 為真理、謙卑、公義赫然坐車前往，無不得勝；你的右手必顯明可畏的事。
verses.e: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth , humility , and righteousness . Let your right hand display awesome deeds .

verses.z: 你的箭鋒快，射中王敵之心；萬民仆倒在你以下。
verses.e: Your arrows are sharp . The nations fall under you , with arrows in the heart of the king's enemies .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的；你的國權是正直的。
verses.e: Your throne , God , is forever and ever . A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom .

verses.z: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡；所以上帝－就是你的上帝－用喜樂油膏你，勝過膏你的同伴。
verses.e: You have loved righteousness , and hated wickedness . Therefore God , your God , has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows .

verses.z: 你的衣服都有沒藥、沉香、肉桂[的香氣]；象牙宮中有絲弦樂器的聲音使你歡喜。
verses.e: All your garments smell like myrrh , aloes , and cassia . Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad .

verses.z: 有君王的女兒在你尊貴婦女之中；王后佩戴俄斐金飾站在你右邊。
verses.e: Kings ' daughters are among your honorable women . At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩歌，交與伶長。調用女音。上帝是我們的避難所，是我們的力量，是[我們]在患難中隨時的幫助。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . By the sons of Korah . According to Alamoth . God is our refuge and strength , a very present help in trouble .

verses.z: 你們要休息，要知道我是上帝！我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
verses.e: " Be still , and know that I am God . I will be exalted among the nations . I will be exalted in the earth . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的上帝是我們的避難所！
verses.e: The LORD of Armies is with us . The God of Jacob is our refuge . Selah .

verses.z: 所以，地雖改變，山雖搖動到海心，
verses.e: Therefore we won't be afraid , though the earth changes , though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas ;

verses.z: 其中的水雖匉訇翻騰，山雖因海漲而戰抖，我們也不害怕。（細拉）
verses.e: though its waters roar and are troubled , though the mountains tremble with their swelling . Selah .

verses.z: 有一道河，這河的分汊使上帝的城歡喜；這城就是至高者居住的聖所。
verses.e: There is a river , the streams of which make the city of God glad , the holy place of the tents of the Most High .

verses.z: 上帝在其中，城必不動搖；到天一亮，上帝必幫助這城。
verses.e: God is within her . She shall not be moved . God will help her at dawn .

verses.z: 外邦喧嚷，列國動搖；上帝發聲，地便鎔化。
verses.e: The nations raged . The kingdoms were moved . He lifted his voice and the earth melted .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的上帝是我們的避難所！（細拉）
verses.e: The LORD of Armies is with us . The God of Jacob is our refuge . Selah .

verses.z: 你們來看耶和華的作為，看他使地怎樣荒涼。
verses.e: Come , see the LORD's works , what desolations he has made in the earth .

verses.z: 他止息刀兵，直到地極；他折弓、斷槍，把戰車焚燒在火中。
verses.e: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth . He breaks the bow , and shatters the spear . He burns the chariots in the fire .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。萬民哪，你們都要拍掌！要用誇勝的聲音向上帝呼喊！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by the sons of Korah . Oh clap your hands , all you nations . Shout to God with the voice of triumph !

verses.z: 因為耶和華至高者是可畏的；他是治理全地的大君王。
verses.e: For the LORD Most High is awesome . He is a great King over all the earth .

verses.z: 他叫萬民服在我們以下，又叫列邦服在我們腳下。
verses.e: He subdues nations under us , and peoples under our feet .

verses.z: 他為我們選擇產業，就是他所愛之雅各的榮耀。（細拉）
verses.e: He chooses our inheritance for us , the glory of Jacob whom he loved . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝上升，有喊聲相送；耶和華上升，有角聲相送。
verses.e: God has gone up with a shout , the LORD with the sound of a trumpet .

verses.z: 你們要向上帝歌頌，歌頌！向我們王歌頌，歌頌！
verses.e: Sing praises to God ! Sing praises ! Sing praises to our King ! Sing praises !

verses.z: 因為上帝是全地的王；你們要用悟性歌頌。
verses.e: For God is the King of all the earth . Sing praises with understanding .

verses.z: 上帝作王治理萬國；上帝坐在他的聖寶座上。
verses.e: God reigns over the nations . God sits on his holy throne .

verses.z: 列邦的君王聚集要作亞伯拉罕之上帝的民。因為世界的盾牌是屬上帝的；他為至高！
verses.e: The princes of the peoples are gathered together , the people of the God of Abraham . For the shields of the earth belong to God . He is greatly exalted !

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩歌。耶和華本為大！在我們上帝的城中，在他的聖山上，該受大讚美。
verses.e: A Song . A Psalm by the sons of Korah . Great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised , in the city of our God , in his holy mountain .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你受的讚美正與你的名相稱，直到地極！你的右手滿了公義。
verses.e: As is your name , God , so is your praise to the ends of the earth . Your right hand is full of righteousness .

verses.z: 因你的判斷，錫安山應當歡喜，猶大的城邑應當快樂。
verses.e: Let Mount Zion be glad ! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments .

verses.z: 你們當周遊錫安，四圍旋繞，數點城樓，
verses.e: Walk about Zion , and go around her . Number its towers .

verses.z: 細看她的外郭，察看她的宮殿，為要傳說到後代。
verses.e: Notice her bulwarks . Consider her palaces , that you may tell it to the next generation .

verses.z: 因為這上帝永永遠遠為我們的上帝；他必作我們引路的，直到死時。
verses.e: For this God is our God forever and ever . He will be our guide even to death .

verses.z: 錫安山－大君王的城，在北面居高華美，為全地所喜悅。
verses.e: Beautiful in elevation , the joy of the whole earth , is Mount Zion , on the north sides , the city of the great King .

verses.z: 上帝在其宮中，自顯為避難所。
verses.e: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge .

verses.z: 看哪，眾王會合，一同經過。
verses.e: For , behold , the kings assembled themselves , they passed by together .

verses.z: 他們見了這城就驚奇喪膽，急忙逃跑。
verses.e: They saw it , then they were amazed . They were dismayed . They hurried away .

verses.z: 他們在那裏被戰兢疼痛抓住，好像產難的婦人一樣。
verses.e: Trembling took hold of them there , pain , as of a woman in travail .

verses.z: [上帝啊]，你用東風打破他施的船隻。
verses.e: With the east wind , you break the ships of Tarshish .

verses.z: 我們在萬軍之耶和華的城中－就是我們上帝的城中－所看見的，正如我們所聽見的。上帝必堅立這城，直到永遠。（細拉）
verses.e: As we have heard , so we have seen , in the city of the LORD of Armies , in the city of our God . God will establish it forever . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝啊，我們在你的殿中想念你的慈愛。
verses.e: We have thought about your loving kindness , God , in the middle of your temple .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。萬民哪，你們都當聽這話！世上一切的居民，
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by the sons of Korah . Hear this , all you peoples . Listen , all you inhabitants of the world ,

verses.z: 他必見智慧人死，又見愚頑人和畜類人一同滅亡，將他們的財貨留給別人。
verses.e: For he sees that wise men die ; likewise the fool and the senseless perish , and leave their wealth to others .

verses.z: 他們心裏思想：他們的家室必永存，住宅必留到萬代；他們以自己的名稱自己的地。
verses.e: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever , and their dwelling places to all generations . They name their lands after themselves .

verses.z: 但人居尊貴中不能長久，如同死亡的畜類一樣。
verses.e: But man , despite his riches , doesn't endure . He is like the animals that perish .

verses.z: 他們行的這道本為自己的愚昧；但他們以後的人還佩服他們的話語。（細拉）
verses.e: This is the destiny of those who are foolish , and of those who approve their sayings . Selah .

verses.z: 他們如同羊群派定下陰間；死亡必作他們的牧者。到了早晨，正直人必管轄他們；他們的美容必被陰間所滅，以致無處可存。
verses.e: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol . Death shall be their shepherd . The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning . Their beauty shall decay in Sheol , far from their mansion .

verses.z: 只是上帝必救贖我的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄，因他必收納我。（細拉）
verses.e: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol , for he will receive me . Selah .

verses.z: 見人發財、家室增榮的時候，你不要懼怕；
verses.e: Don't be afraid when a man is made rich , when the glory of his house is increased ;

verses.z: 因為，他死的時候甚麼也不能帶去；他的榮耀不能隨他下去。
verses.e: for when he dies he will carry nothing away . His glory won't descend after him .

verses.z: 他活着的時候，雖然自誇為有福（你若利己，人必誇獎你）；
verses.e: Though while he lived he blessed his soul — and men praise you when you do well for yourself —

verses.z: 他仍必歸到他歷代的祖宗那裏，永不見光。
verses.e: he shall go to the generation of his fathers . They shall never see the light .

verses.z: 無論上流下流，富足貧窮，都當留心聽！
verses.e: both low and high , rich and poor together .

verses.z: 人在尊貴中而不醒悟，就如死亡的畜類一樣。
verses.e: A man who has riches without understanding , is like the animals that perish .

verses.z: 我口要說智慧的言語；我心要想通達的道理。
verses.e: My mouth will speak words of wisdom . My heart will utter understanding .

verses.z: 我要側耳聽比喻，用琴解謎語。
verses.e: I will incline my ear to a proverb . I will solve my riddle on the harp .

verses.z: 在患難的日子，奸惡隨我腳跟，四面環繞我，我何必懼怕？
verses.e: Why should I fear in the days of evil , when iniquity at my heels surrounds me ?

verses.z: 那些倚仗財貨自誇錢財多的人，
verses.e: Those who trust in their wealth , and boast in the multitude of their riches —

verses.z: 一個也無法贖自己的弟兄，也不能替他將贖價給上帝，
verses.e: none of them can by any means redeem his brother , nor give God a ransom for him .

verses.z: 叫他長遠活着，不見朽壞；因為贖他生命的價值極貴，只可永遠罷休。
verses.e: For the redemption of their life is costly , no payment is ever enough ,
that he should live on forever , that he should not see corruption .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用吹的樂器。耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的言語，顧念我的心思！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician , with the flutes . A Psalm by David . Give ear to my words , LORD . Consider my meditation .

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你定他們的罪！願他們因自己的計謀跌倒；願你在他們許多的過犯中把他們逐出，因為他們背叛了你。
verses.e: Hold them guilty , God . Let them fall by their own counsels . Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions , for they have rebelled against you .

verses.z: 凡投靠你的，願他們喜樂，時常歡呼，因為你護庇他們；又願那愛你名的人都靠你歡欣。
verses.e: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice . Let them always shout for joy , because you defend them . Let them also who love your name be joyful in you .

verses.z: 因為你必賜福與義人；耶和華啊，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面護衛他。
verses.e: For you will bless the righteous . LORD , you will surround him with favor as with a shield .

verses.z: 我的王我的上帝啊，求你垂聽我呼求的聲音！因為我向你祈禱。
verses.e: Listen to the voice of my cry , my King and my God , for I pray to you .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，早晨你必聽我的聲音；早晨我必向你陳明[我的心意]，並要警醒！
verses.e: LORD , in the morning you will hear my voice . In the morning I will lay my requests before you , and will watch expectantly .

verses.z: 因為你不是喜悅惡事的上帝，惡人不能與你同居。
verses.e: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness . Evil can't live with you .

verses.z: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前；凡作孽的，都是你所恨惡的。
verses.e: The arrogant will not stand in your sight . You hate all workers of iniquity .

verses.z: 說謊言的，你必滅絕；好流人血弄詭詐的，都為耶和華所憎惡。
verses.e: You will destroy those who speak lies . The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man .

verses.z: 至於我，我必憑你豐盛的慈愛進入你的居所；我必存敬畏你的心向你的聖殿下拜。
verses.e: But as for me , in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house . I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你因我的仇敵，憑你的公義引領我，使你的道路在我面前正直。
verses.e: Lead me , LORD , in your righteousness because of my enemies . Make your way straight before my face .

verses.z: 因為，他們的口中沒有誠實；他們的心裏滿有邪惡；他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓；他們用舌頭諂媚人。
verses.e: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth . Their heart is destruction . Their throat is an open tomb . They flatter with their tongue .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩。大能者上帝－耶和華已經發言招呼天下，從日出之地到日落之處。
verses.e: A Psalm by Asaph . The Mighty One , God , the LORD , speaks , and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset .

verses.z: 因為，樹林中的百獸是我的，千山上的牲畜也是我的。
verses.e: For every animal of the forest is mine , and the livestock on a thousand hills .

verses.z: 山中的飛鳥，我都知道；野地的走獸也都屬我。
verses.e: I know all the birds of the mountains . The wild animals of the field are mine .

verses.z: 我若是飢餓，我不用告訴你，因為世界和其中所充滿的都是我的。
verses.e: If I were hungry , I would not tell you , for the world is mine , and all that is in it .

verses.z: 我豈吃公牛的肉呢？我豈喝山羊的血呢？
verses.e: Will I eat the meat of bulls , or drink the blood of goats ?

verses.z: 你們要以感謝為祭獻與上帝，又要向至高者還你的願，
verses.e: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving . Pay your vows to the Most High .

verses.z: 並要在患難之日求告我；我必搭救你，你也要榮耀我。
verses.e: Call on me in the day of trouble . I will deliver you , and you will honor me . "

verses.z: 但上帝對惡人說：你怎敢傳說我的律例，口中提到我的約呢？
verses.e: But to the wicked God says , " What right do you have to declare my statutes , that you have taken my covenant on your lips ,

verses.z: 其實你恨惡管教，將我的言語丟在背後。
verses.e: since you hate instruction , and throw my words behind you ?

verses.z: 你見了盜賊就樂意與他同夥，又與行姦淫的人一同有分。
verses.e: When you saw a thief , you consented with him , and have participated with adulterers .

verses.z: 你口任說惡言；你舌編造詭詐。
verses.e: " You give your mouth to evil . Your tongue frames deceit .

verses.z: 從全美的錫安中，上帝已經發光了。
verses.e: Out of Zion , the perfection of beauty , God shines out .

verses.z: 你坐着毀謗你的兄弟，讒毀你親母的兒子。
verses.e: You sit and speak against your brother . You slander your own mother's son .

verses.z: 你行了這些事，我還閉口不言，你想我恰和你一樣；其實我要責備你，將這些事擺在你眼前。
verses.e: You have done these things , and I kept silent . You thought that I was just like you . I will rebuke you , and accuse you in front of your eyes .

verses.z: 你們忘記上帝的，要思想這事，免得我把你們撕碎，無人搭救。
verses.e: " Now consider this , you who forget God , lest I tear you into pieces , and there be no one to deliver .

verses.z: 凡以感謝獻上為祭的便是榮耀我；那按正路而行的，我必使他得着我的救恩。
verses.e: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me , and prepares his way so that I will show God's salvation to him . "

verses.z: 我們的上帝要來，決不閉口。有烈火在他面前吞滅；有暴風在他四圍大颳。
verses.e: Our God comes , and does not keep silent . A fire devours before him . It is very stormy around him .

verses.z: 他招呼上天下地，為要審判他的民，
verses.e: He calls to the heavens above , to the earth , that he may judge his people :

verses.z: 說：招聚我的聖民到我這裏來，就是那些用祭物與我立約的人。
verses.e: " Gather my saints together to me , those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice . "

verses.z: 諸天必表明他的公義，因為上帝是施行審判的。（細拉）
verses.e: The heavens shall declare his righteousness , for God himself is judge . Selah .

verses.z: 我的民哪，你們當聽我的話！以色列啊，我要勸戒你；我是上帝，是你的上帝！
verses.e: " Hear , my people , and I will speak . Israel , I will testify against you . I am God , your God .

verses.z: 我並不因你的祭物責備你；你的燔祭常在我面前。
verses.e: I don't rebuke you for your sacrifices . Your burnt offerings are continually before me .

verses.z: 我不從你家中取公牛，也不從你圈內取山羊；
verses.e: I have no need for a bull from your stall , nor male goats from your pens .

verses.z: 大衛與拔示巴同室以後，先知拿單來見他；他作這詩，交與伶長。上帝啊，求你按你的慈愛憐恤我！按你豐盛的慈悲塗抹我的過犯！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David , when Nathan the prophet came to him , after he had gone in to Bathsheba . Have mercy on me , God , according to your loving kindness . According to the multitude of your tender mercies , blot out my transgressions .

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你為我造清潔的心，使我裏面重新有正直的靈。
verses.e: Create in me a clean heart , O God . Renew a right spirit within me .

verses.z: 不要丟棄我，使我離開你的面；不要從我收回你的聖靈。
verses.e: Don't throw me from your presence , and don't take your Holy Spirit from me .

verses.z: 求你使我仍得救恩之樂，賜我樂意的靈扶持我，
verses.e: Restore to me the joy of your salvation . Uphold me with a willing spirit .

verses.z: 我就把你的道指教有過犯的人，罪人必歸順你。
verses.e: Then I will teach transgressors your ways . Sinners will be converted to you .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你是拯救我的上帝；求你救我脫離流人血的罪！我的舌頭就高聲歌唱你的公義。
verses.e: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed , O God , the God of my salvation . My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness .

verses.z: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇張開，我的口便傳揚讚美你的話！
verses.e: Lord , open my lips . My mouth will declare your praise .

verses.z: 你本不喜愛祭物，若喜愛，我就獻上；燔祭，你也不喜悅。
verses.e: For you don't delight in sacrifice , or else I would give it . You have no pleasure in burnt offering .

verses.z: [上帝所要]的祭就是憂傷的靈；上帝啊，憂傷痛悔的心，你必不輕看。
verses.e: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit . O God , you will not despise a broken and contrite heart .

verses.z: 求你隨你的美意善待錫安，建造耶路撒冷的城牆。
verses.e: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion . Build the walls of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 那時，你必喜愛公義的祭和燔祭並全牲的燔祭；那時，人必將公牛獻在你壇上。
verses.e: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness , in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings . Then they will offer bulls on your altar .

verses.z: 求你將我的罪孽洗除淨盡，並潔除我的罪！
verses.e: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity . Cleanse me from my sin .

verses.z: 因為，我知道我的過犯；我的罪常在我面前。
verses.e: For I know my transgressions . My sin is constantly before me .

verses.z: 我向你犯罪，惟獨得罪了你；在你眼前行了這惡，以致你責備我的時候顯為公義，判斷我的時候顯為清正。
verses.e: Against you , and you only , I have sinned , and done that which is evil in your sight , so you may be proved right when you speak , and justified when you judge .

verses.z: 我是在罪孽裏生的，在我母親懷胎的時候就有了罪。
verses.e: Behold , I was born in iniquity . My mother conceived me in sin .

verses.z: 你所喜愛的是內裏誠實；你在我隱密處，必使我得智慧。
verses.e: Behold , you desire truth in the inward parts . You teach me wisdom in the inmost place .

verses.z: 求你用牛膝草潔淨我，我就乾淨；求你洗滌我，我就比雪更白。
verses.e: Purify me with hyssop , and I will be clean . Wash me , and I will be whiter than snow .

verses.z: 求你使我得聽歡喜快樂[的聲音]，使你所壓傷的骨頭可以踴躍。
verses.e: Let me hear joy and gladness , that the bones which you have broken may rejoice .

verses.z: 求你掩面不看我的罪，塗抹我一切的罪孽。
verses.e: Hide your face from my sins , and blot out all of my iniquities .

verses.z: 以東人多益來告訴掃羅說：「大衛到了亞希米勒家。」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。勇士啊，你為何以作惡自誇？上帝的慈愛是常存的。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A contemplation by David , when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul , " David has come to Ahimelech's house . " Why do you boast of mischief , mighty man ? God's loving kindness endures continually .

verses.z: 你的舌頭邪惡詭詐，好像剃頭刀，快利傷人。
