verses.e: Your tongue plots destruction , like a sharp razor , working deceitfully .

verses.z: 你愛惡勝似愛善，又愛說謊，不愛說公義。（細拉）
verses.e: You love evil more than good , lying rather than speaking the truth . Selah .

verses.z: 詭詐的舌頭啊，你愛說一切毀滅的話！
verses.e: You love all devouring words , you deceitful tongue .

verses.z: 上帝也要毀滅你，直到永遠；他要把你拿去，從你的帳棚中抽出，從活人之地將你拔出。（細拉）
verses.e: God will likewise destroy you forever . He will take you up , and pluck you out of your tent , and root you out of the land of the living . Selah .

verses.z: 義人要看見而懼怕，並要笑他，
verses.e: The righteous also will see it , and fear , and laugh at him , saying ,

verses.z: 說：看哪，這就是那不以上帝為他力量的人，只倚仗他豐富的財物，在邪惡上堅立自己。
verses.e: " Behold , this is the man who didn't make God his strength , but trusted in the abundance of his riches , and strengthened himself in his wickedness . "

verses.z: 至於我，就像上帝殿中的青橄欖樹；我永永遠遠倚靠上帝的慈愛。
verses.e: But as for me , I am like a green olive tree in God's house . I trust in God's loving kindness forever and ever .

verses.z: 我要稱謝你，直到永遠，因為你行了這事。我也要在你聖民面前仰望你的名；這名本為美好。
verses.e: I will give you thanks forever , because you have done it . I will hope in your name , for it is good , in the presence of your saints .

verses.z: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉。愚頑人心裏說：沒有上帝。他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的罪孽；沒有一個人行善。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " Mahalath . " A contemplation by David . The fool has said in his heart , " There is no God . " They are corrupt , and have done abominable iniquity . There is no one who does good .

verses.z: 上帝從天上垂看世人，要看有明白的沒有？有尋求他的沒有？
verses.e: God looks down from heaven on the children of men , to see if there are any who understood , who seek after God .

verses.z: 他們各人都退後，一同變為污穢；並沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
verses.e: Every one of them has gone back . They have become filthy together . There is no one who does good , no , not one .

verses.z: 作孽的沒有知識嗎？他們吞吃我的百姓如同吃飯一樣，並不求告上帝。
verses.e: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge , who eat up my people as they eat bread , and don't call on God ?

verses.z: 他們在無可懼怕之處就大大害怕，因為上帝把那安營攻擊你之人的骨頭散開了。你使他們蒙羞，因為上帝棄絕了他們。
verses.e: There they were in great fear , where no fear was , for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you . You have put them to shame , because God has rejected them .

verses.z: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。上帝救回他被擄的子民那時，雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
verses.e: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion ! When God brings back his people from captivity , then Jacob shall rejoice , and Israel shall be glad .

verses.z: 西弗人來對掃羅說：「大衛豈不是在我們那裏藏身嗎？」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。上帝啊，求你以你的名救我，憑你的大能為我伸冤。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . On stringed instruments . A contemplation by David , when the Ziphites came and said to Saul , " Isn't David hiding himself among us ? " Save me , God , by your name . Vindicate me in your might .

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你聽我的禱告，留心聽我口中的言語。
verses.e: Hear my prayer , God . Listen to the words of my mouth .

verses.z: 因為，外人起來攻擊我，強暴人尋索我的命；他們眼中沒有上帝。（細拉）
verses.e: For strangers have risen up against me . Violent men have sought after my soul . They haven't set God before them . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝是幫助我的，是扶持我命的。
verses.e: Behold , God is my helper . The Lord is the one who sustains my soul .

verses.z: 他要報應我仇敵所行的惡；求你憑你的誠實滅絕他們。
verses.e: He will repay the evil to my enemies . Destroy them in your truth .

verses.z: 我要把甘心祭獻給你。耶和華啊，我要稱讚你的名；這名本為美好。
verses.e: With a free will offering , I will sacrifice to you . I will give thanks to your name , LORD , for it is good .

verses.z: 他從一切的急難中把我救出來；我的眼睛也看見了我仇敵[遭報]。
verses.e: For he has delivered me out of all trouble . My eye has seen triumph over my enemies .

verses.z: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。上帝啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，不要隱藏不聽我的懇求！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . On stringed instruments . A contemplation by David . Listen to my prayer , God . Don't hide yourself from my supplication .

verses.z: 他們在城牆上晝夜繞行；在城內也有罪孽和奸惡。
verses.e: Day and night they prowl around on its walls . Malice and abuse are also within her .

verses.z: 邪惡在其中；欺壓和詭詐不離街市。
verses.e: Destructive forces are within her . Threats and lies don't depart from her streets .

verses.z: 原來不是仇敵辱罵我，若是仇敵，還可忍耐；也不是恨我的人向我狂大，若是恨我的人就必躲避他。
verses.e: For it was not an enemy who insulted me , then I could have endured it . Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me , then I would have hidden myself from him .

verses.z: 不料是你；你原與我平等，是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！
verses.e: But it was you , a man like me , my companion , and my familiar friend .

verses.z: 我們素常彼此談論，以為甘甜；我們與群眾在上帝的殿中同行。
verses.e: We took sweet fellowship together . We walked in God's house with company .

verses.z: 願死亡忽然臨到他們！願他們活活地下入陰間！因為他們的住處，他們的心中，都是邪惡。
verses.e: Let death come suddenly on them . Let them go down alive into Sheol . For wickedness is among them , in their dwelling .

verses.z: 至於我，我要求告上帝；耶和華必拯救我。
verses.e: As for me , I will call on God . The LORD will save me .

verses.z: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀聲悲歎；他也必聽我的聲音。
verses.e: Evening , morning , and at noon , I will cry out in distress . He will hear my voice .

verses.z: 他救贖我命脫離攻擊我的人，使我得享平安，因為與我[相爭的]人甚多。
verses.e: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me , although there are many who oppose me .

verses.z: 那沒有更變、不敬畏上帝的人，從太古常存的上帝必聽見而苦待他。
verses.e: God , who is enthroned forever , will hear and answer them . Selah . They never change and don't fear God .

verses.z: 求你側耳聽我，應允我。我哀歎不安，發聲唉哼，
verses.e: Attend to me , and answer me . I am restless in my complaint , and moan

verses.z: 他背了約，伸手攻擊與他和好的人。
verses.e: He raises his hands against his friends . He has violated his covenant .

verses.z: 他的口如奶油光滑，他的心卻懷着爭戰；他的話比油柔和，其實是拔出來的刀。
verses.e: His mouth was smooth as butter , but his heart was war . His words were softer than oil , yet they were drawn swords .

verses.z: 你要把你的重擔卸給耶和華，他必撫養你；他永不叫義人動搖。
verses.e: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you . He will never allow the righteous to be moved .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你必使惡人下入滅亡的坑；流人血、行詭詐的人必活不到半世，但我要倚靠你。
verses.e: But you , God , will bring them down into the pit of destruction . Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days , but I will trust in you .

verses.z: 都因仇敵的聲音，惡人的欺壓；因為他們將罪孽加在我身上，發怒氣逼迫我。
verses.e: because of the voice of the enemy , because of the oppression of the wicked . For they bring suffering on me . In anger they hold a grudge against me .

verses.z: 我心在我裏面甚是疼痛；死的驚惶臨到我身。
verses.e: My heart is severely pained within me . The terrors of death have fallen on me .

verses.z: 恐懼戰兢歸到我身；驚恐漫過了我。
verses.e: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me . Horror has overwhelmed me .

verses.z: 我說：但願我有翅膀像鴿子，我就飛去，得享安息。
verses.e: I said , " Oh that I had wings like a dove ! Then I would fly away , and be at rest .

verses.z: 我必遠遊，宿在曠野。（細拉）
verses.e: Behold , then I would wander far off . I would lodge in the wilderness . " Selah .

verses.z: 我必速速逃到避所，脫離狂風暴雨。
verses.e: " I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm . "

verses.z: 主啊，求你吞滅他們，變亂他們的舌頭！因為我在城中見了強暴爭競的事。
verses.e: Confuse them , Lord , and confound their language , for I have seen violence and strife in the city .

verses.z: 非利士人在迦特拿住大衛。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用遠方無聲鴿。上帝啊，求你憐憫我，因為人要把我吞了，終日攻擊欺壓我。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " Silent Dove in Distant Lands . " A poem by David , when the Philistines seized him in Gath . Be merciful to me , God , for man wants to swallow me up . All day long , he attacks and oppresses me .

verses.z: 我倚靠上帝，我要讚美他的話；我倚靠耶和華，我要讚美他的話。
verses.e: In God , I will praise his word . In the LORD , I will praise his word .

verses.z: 我倚靠上帝，必不懼怕。人能把我怎麼樣呢？
verses.e: I have put my trust in God . I will not be afraid . What can man do to me ?

verses.z: 上帝啊，我向你所許的願在我身上；我要將感謝祭獻給你。
verses.e: Your vows are on me , God . I will give thank offerings to you .

verses.z: 因為你救我的命脫離死亡。你豈不是[救護]我的腳不跌倒、使我在生命光中行在上帝面前嗎？
verses.e: For you have delivered my soul from death , and prevented my feet from falling , that I may walk before God in the light of the living .

verses.z: 我的仇敵終日要把我吞了，因逞驕傲攻擊我的人甚多。
verses.e: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long , for they are many who fight proudly against me .

verses.z: 我懼怕的時候要倚靠你。
verses.e: When I am afraid , I will put my trust in you .

verses.z: 我倚靠上帝，我要讚美他的話；我倚靠上帝，必不懼怕。血氣之輩能把我怎麼樣呢？
verses.e: In God , I praise his word . In God , I put my trust . I will not be afraid . What can flesh do to me ?

verses.z: 他們終日顛倒我的話；他們一切的心思都是要害我。
verses.e: All day long they twist my words . All their thoughts are against me for evil .

verses.z: 他們聚集，埋伏窺探我的腳蹤，等候要害我的命。
verses.e: They conspire and lurk , watching my steps . They are eager to take my life .

verses.z: 他們豈能因罪孽逃脫嗎？上帝啊，求你在怒中使眾民墮落！
verses.e: Shall they escape by iniquity ? In anger cast down the peoples , God .

verses.z: 我幾次流離，你都記數；求你把我眼淚裝在你的皮袋裏。這不都記在你冊子上嗎？
verses.e: You count my wanderings . You put my tears into your container . Aren't they in your book ?

verses.z: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敵都要轉身退後。上帝幫助我，這是我所知道的。
verses.e: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call . I know this : that God is for me .

verses.z: 大衛逃避掃羅，藏在洞裏。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。上帝啊，求你憐憫我，憐憫我！因為我的心投靠你。我要投靠在你翅膀的蔭下，等到災害過去。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " Do Not Destroy . " A poem by David , when he fled from Saul , in the cave . Be merciful to me , God , be merciful to me , for my soul takes refuge in you . Yes , in the shadow of your wings , I will take refuge , until disaster has passed .

verses.z: 因為，你的慈愛高及諸天；你的誠實達到穹蒼。
verses.e: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens , and your truth to the skies .

verses.z: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！願你的榮耀高過全地！
verses.e: Be exalted , God , above the heavens . Let your glory be over all the earth .

verses.z: 我要求告至高的上帝，就是為我成全[諸事]的上帝。
verses.e: I cry out to God Most High , to God who accomplishes my requests for me .

verses.z: 那要吞我的人辱罵我的時候，上帝從天上必施恩救我，也必向我發出慈愛和誠實。
verses.e: He will send from heaven , and save me , he rebukes the one who is pursuing me . Selah . God will send out his loving kindness and his truth .

verses.z: 我的性命在獅子中間；我躺臥在性如烈火的世人當中。他們的牙齒是槍、箭；他們的舌頭是快刀。
verses.e: My soul is among lions . I lie among those who are set on fire , even the sons of men , whose teeth are spears and arrows , and their tongue a sharp sword .

verses.z: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！願你的榮耀高過全地！
verses.e: Be exalted , God , above the heavens ! Let your glory be above all the earth !

verses.z: 他們為我的腳設下網羅，壓制我的心；他們在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。（細拉）
verses.e: They have prepared a net for my steps . My soul is bowed down . They dig a pit before me . They fall into the middle of it themselves . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝啊，我心堅定，我心堅定；我要唱詩，我要歌頌！
verses.e: My heart is steadfast , God . My heart is steadfast . I will sing , yes , I will sing praises .

verses.z: 我的靈啊，你當醒起！琴瑟啊，你們當醒起！我自己要極早醒起！
verses.e: Wake up , my glory ! Wake up , lute and harp ! I will wake up the dawn .

verses.z: 主啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你，在列邦中歌頌你！
verses.e: I will give thanks to you , Lord , among the peoples . I will sing praises to you among the nations .

verses.z: 大衛的金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。世人哪，你們默然不語，真合公義嗎？施行審判，豈按正直嗎？
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " Do Not Destroy . " A poem by David . Do you indeed speak righteousness , silent ones ? Do you judge blamelessly , you sons of men ?

verses.z: 義人見[仇敵]遭報就歡喜，要在惡人的血中洗腳。
verses.e: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance . He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked ,

verses.z: 因此，人必說：義人誠然有善報；在地上果有施行判斷的上帝！
verses.e: so that men shall say , " Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous . Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth . "

verses.z: 不然！你們是心中作惡；你們在地上秤出你們手所行的強暴。
verses.e: No , in your heart you plot injustice . You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth .

verses.z: 惡人一出母胎就[與]上帝疏遠，一離母腹便走錯路，說謊話。
verses.e: The wicked go astray from the womb . They are wayward as soon as they are born , speaking lies .

verses.z: 他們的毒氣好像蛇的毒氣；他們好像塞耳的聾虺，
verses.e: Their poison is like the poison of a snake , like a deaf cobra that stops its ear ,

verses.z: 不聽行法術的聲音，雖用極靈的咒語也是不聽。
verses.e: which doesn't listen to the voice of charmers , no matter how skillful the charmer may be .

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你敲碎他們口中的牙！耶和華啊，求你敲掉少壯獅子的大牙！
verses.e: Break their teeth , God , in their mouth . Break out the great teeth of the young lions , LORD .

verses.z: 願他們消滅，如急流的水一般；他們瞅準射箭的時候，願箭頭彷彿砍斷。
verses.e: Let them vanish like water that flows away . When they draw the bow , let their arrows be made blunt .

verses.z: 願他們像蝸牛消化過去，又像婦人墜落未見天日的胎。
verses.e: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away , like the stillborn child , who has not seen the sun .

verses.z: 你們用荊棘燒火，鍋還未熱，他要用旋風把青的和燒着的一齊颳去。
verses.e: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns , he will sweep away the green and the burning alike .

verses.z: 掃羅打發人窺探大衛的房屋，要殺他。那時，大衛作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。我的上帝啊，求你救我脫離仇敵，把我安置在高處，得脫那些起來攻擊我的人。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " Do Not Destroy . " A poem by David , when Saul sent , and they watched the house to kill him . Deliver me from my enemies , my God . Set me on high from those who rise up against me .

verses.z: 我的上帝要以慈愛迎接我；上帝要叫我看見我仇敵[遭報]。
verses.e: My God will go before me with his loving kindness . God will let me look at my enemies in triumph .

verses.z: 不要殺他們，恐怕我的民忘記。主啊，你是我們的盾牌；求你用你的能力使他們四散，且降為卑。
verses.e: Don't kill them , or my people may forget . Scatter them by your power , and bring them down , Lord our shield .

verses.z: 因他們口中的罪和嘴裏的言語，並咒罵虛謊的話，願他們在驕傲之中被纏住了。
verses.e: For the sin of their mouth , and the words of their lips , let them be caught in their pride , for the curses and lies which they utter .

verses.z: 求你發怒，使他們消滅，以致歸於無有，叫他們知道上帝在雅各中間掌權，直到地極。（細拉）
verses.e: Consume them in wrath . Consume them , and they will be no more . Let them know that God rules in Jacob , to the ends of the earth . Selah .

verses.z: 到了晚上，任憑他們轉回；任憑他們叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
verses.e: At evening let them return . Let them howl like a dog , and go around the city .

verses.z: 他們必走來走去，尋找食物，若不得飽就終夜在外。
verses.e: They shall wander up and down for food , and wait all night if they aren't satisfied .

verses.z: 但我要歌頌你的力量，早晨要高唱你的慈愛；因為你作過我的高臺，在我急難的日子作過我的避難所。
verses.e: But I will sing of your strength . Yes , I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning . For you have been my high tower , a refuge in the day of my distress .

verses.z: 我的力量啊，我要歌頌你；因為上帝是我的高臺，是賜恩與我的上帝。
verses.e: To you , my strength , I will sing praises . For God is my high tower , the God of my mercy .

verses.z: 求你救我脫離作孽的人和喜愛流人血的人！
verses.e: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity . Save me from the bloodthirsty men .

verses.z: 因為，他們埋伏要害我的命；有能力的人聚集來攻擊我。耶和華啊，這不是為我的過犯，也不是為我的罪愆。
verses.e: For , behold , they lie in wait for my soul . The mighty gather themselves together against me , not for my disobedience , nor for my sin , LORD .

verses.z: 我雖然無過，他們預備整齊，跑來攻擊我。求你興起鑒察，幫助我！
verses.e: I have done no wrong , yet they are ready to attack me . Rise up , behold , and help me !

verses.z: 萬軍之上帝－耶和華以色列的上帝啊！求你興起，懲治萬邦！不要憐憫行詭詐的惡人！（細拉）
verses.e: You , LORD God of Armies , the God of Israel , rouse yourself to punish the nations . Show no mercy to the wicked traitors . Selah .

verses.z: 他們晚上轉回，叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
verses.e: They return at evening , howling like dogs , and prowl around the city .

verses.z: 他們口中噴吐[惡言]，嘴裏有刀；[他們說]：有誰聽見？
verses.e: Behold , they spew with their mouth . Swords are in their lips , " For " , they say , " who hears us ? "

verses.z: 但你－耶和華必笑話他們；你要嗤笑萬邦。
verses.e: But you , LORD , laugh at them . You scoff at all the nations .

verses.z: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你，因為上帝是我的高臺。
verses.e: Oh , my Strength , I watch for you , for God is my high tower .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器，調用第八。耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我，也不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician ; on stringed instruments , upon the eight-stringed lyre . A Psalm by David . LORD , don't rebuke me in your anger , neither discipline me in your wrath .

verses.z: 我的一切仇敵都必羞愧，大大驚惶；他們必要退後，忽然羞愧。
verses.e: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed . They shall turn back , they shall be disgraced suddenly .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你可憐我，因為我軟弱。耶和華啊，求你醫治我，因為我的骨頭發戰。
verses.e: Have mercy on me , LORD , for I am faint . LORD , heal me , for my bones are troubled .

verses.z: 我心也大大地驚惶。耶和華啊，你要到幾時[才救我]呢？
verses.e: My soul is also in great anguish . But you , LORD — how long ?

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你轉回搭救我！因你的慈愛拯救我。
verses.e: Return , LORD . Deliver my soul , and save me for your loving kindness ' sake .

verses.z: 因為，在死地無人記念你，在陰間有誰稱謝你？
verses.e: For in death there is no memory of you . In Sheol , who shall give you thanks ?

verses.z: 我因唉哼而困乏；我每夜流淚，把床榻漂起，把褥子濕透。
verses.e: I am weary with my groaning . Every night I flood my bed . I drench my couch with my tears .

verses.z: 我因憂愁眼睛乾癟，又因我一切的敵人眼睛昏花。
verses.e: My eye wastes away because of grief . It grows old because of all my adversaries .

verses.z: 你們一切作孽的人，離開我吧！因為耶和華聽了我哀哭的聲音。
verses.e: Depart from me , all you workers of iniquity , for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping .

verses.z: 耶和華聽了我的懇求；耶和華必收納我的禱告。
verses.e: The LORD has heard my supplication . The LORD accepts my prayer .

verses.z: 大衛與兩河間的亞蘭並瑣巴的亞蘭爭戰的時候，約押轉回，在鹽谷攻擊以東，殺了一萬二千人。那時，大衛作這金詩，叫人學習，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。上帝啊，你丟棄了我們，使我們破敗；你向我們發怒，求你使我們復興！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " The Lily of the Covenant . " A teaching poem by David , when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah , and Joab returned , and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt . God , you have rejected us . You have broken us down . You have been angry . Restore us , again .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你不是丟棄了我們嗎？上帝啊，你不和我們的軍兵同去嗎？
verses.e: Haven't you , God , rejected us ? You don't go out with our armies , God .

verses.z: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人，因為人的幫助是枉然的。
verses.e: Give us help against the adversary , for the help of man is vain .

verses.z: 我們倚靠上帝才得施展大能，因為踐踏我們敵人的就是他。
verses.e: Through God we will do valiantly , for it is he who will tread down our adversaries .

verses.z: 你使地震動，而且崩裂；求你將裂口醫好，因為地搖動。
verses.e: You have made the land tremble . You have torn it . Mend its fractures , for it quakes .

verses.z: 你叫你的民遇見艱難；你叫我們喝那使人東倒西歪的酒。
verses.e: You have shown your people hard things . You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger .

verses.z: 你把旌旗賜給敬畏你的人，可以為真理揚起來。（細拉）
verses.e: You have given a banner to those who fear you , that it may be displayed because of the truth . Selah .

verses.z: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們，好叫你所親愛的人得救。
verses.e: So that your beloved may be delivered , save with your right hand , and answer us .

verses.z: 上帝已經指着他的聖潔說：我要歡樂；我要分開示劍，丈量疏割谷。
verses.e: God has spoken from his sanctuary : " I will triumph . I will divide Shechem , and measure out the valley of Succoth .

verses.z: 基列是我的，瑪拿西也是我的。以法蓮是護衛我頭的；猶大是我的杖。
verses.e: Gilead is mine , and Manasseh is mine . Ephraim also is the defense of my head . Judah is my scepter .

verses.z: 摩押是我的沐浴盆；我要向以東拋鞋。非利士啊，你還能因我歡呼嗎？
verses.e: Moab is my wash basin . I will throw my sandal on Edom . I shout in triumph over Philistia . "

verses.z: 誰能領我進堅固城？誰能引我到以東地？
verses.e: Who will bring me into the strong city ? Who has led me to Edom ?

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。上帝啊，求你聽我的呼求，側耳聽我的禱告！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . For a stringed instrument . By David . Hear my cry , God . Listen to my prayer .

verses.z: 我心裏發昏的時候，我要從地極求告你。求你領我到那比我更高的磐石！
verses.e: From the end of the earth , I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed . Lead me to the rock that is higher than I .

verses.z: 因為你作過我的避難所，作過我的堅固臺，脫離仇敵。
verses.e: For you have been a refuge for me , a strong tower from the enemy .

verses.z: 我要永遠住在你的帳幕裏！我要投靠在你翅膀下的隱密處！（細拉）
verses.e: I will dwell in your tent forever . I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你原是聽了我所許的願；你將產業賜給敬畏你名的人。
verses.e: For you , God , have heard my vows . You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name .

verses.z: 你要加添王的壽數；他的年歲必存到世世。
verses.e: You will prolong the king's life . His years will be for generations .

verses.z: 他必永遠坐在上帝面前；願你預備慈愛和誠實保佑他！
verses.e: He shall be enthroned in God's presence forever . Appoint your loving kindness and truth , that they may preserve him .

verses.z: 這樣，我要歌頌你的名，直到永遠，好天天還我所許的願。
verses.e: So I will sing praise to your name forever , that I may fulfill my vows daily .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。我的心默默無聲，專等候上帝；我的救恩是從他[而來]。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To Jeduthun . A Psalm by David . My soul rests in God alone . My salvation is from him .

verses.z: 不要仗勢欺人，也不要因搶奪而驕傲；若財寶加增，不要放在心上。
verses.e: Don't trust in oppression . Don't become vain in robbery . If riches increase , don't set your heart on them .

verses.z: 上帝說了一次、兩次，我都聽見：就是能力都屬乎上帝。
verses.e: God has spoken once ; twice I have heard this , that power belongs to God .

verses.z: 主啊，慈愛也是屬乎你，因為你照着各人所行的報應他。
verses.e: Also to you , Lord , belongs loving kindness , for you reward every man according to his work .

verses.z: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高臺，我必不很動搖。
verses.e: He alone is my rock , my salvation , and my fortress . I will never be greatly shaken .

verses.z: 你們大家攻擊一人，把他毀壞，如同毀壞歪斜的牆、將倒的壁，要到幾時呢？
verses.e: How long will you assault a man ? Would all of you throw him down , like a leaning wall , like a tottering fence ?

verses.z: 他們彼此商議，專要從他的尊位上把他推下；他們喜愛謊話，口雖祝福，心卻咒詛。（細拉）
verses.e: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place . They delight in lies . They bless with their mouth , but they curse inwardly . Selah .

verses.z: 我的心哪，你當默默無聲，專等候上帝，因為我的盼望是從他[而來]。
verses.e: My soul , wait in silence for God alone , for my expectation is from him .

verses.z: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高臺，我必不動搖。
verses.e: He alone is my rock and my salvation , my fortress . I will not be shaken .

verses.z: 我的拯救、我的榮耀都在乎上帝；我力量的磐石、我的避難所都在乎上帝。
verses.e: My salvation and my honor is with God . The rock of my strength , and my refuge , is in God .

verses.z: 你們眾民當時時倚靠他，在他面前傾心吐意；上帝是我們的避難所。（細拉）
verses.e: Trust in him at all times , you people . Pour out your heart before him . God is a refuge for us . Selah .

verses.z: 下流人真是虛空；上流人也是虛假；放在天平裏就必浮起；他們一共比空氣還輕。
verses.e: Surely men of low degree are just a breath , and men of high degree are a lie . In the balances they will go up . They are together lighter than a breath .

verses.z: 大衛在猶大曠野的時候，作了這詩。上帝啊，你是我的上帝，我要切切地尋求你，在乾旱疲乏無水之地，我渴想你；我的心切慕你。
verses.e: A Psalm by David , when he was in the desert of Judah . God , you are my God . I will earnestly seek you . My soul thirsts for you . My flesh longs for you , in a dry and weary land , where there is no water .

verses.z: 他們必被刀劍所殺，被野狗所吃。
verses.e: They shall be given over to the power of the sword . They shall be jackal food .

verses.z: 但是王必因上帝歡喜。凡指着他發誓的必要誇口，因為說謊之人的口必被塞住。
verses.e: But the king shall rejoice in God . Everyone who swears by him will praise him , for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced .

verses.z: 我在聖所中曾如此瞻仰你，為要見你的能力和你的榮耀。
verses.e: So I have seen you in the sanctuary , watching your power and your glory .

verses.z: 因你的慈愛比生命更好，我的嘴唇要頌讚你。
verses.e: Because your loving kindness is better than life , my lips shall praise you .

verses.z: 我還活的時候要這樣稱頌你；我要奉你的名舉手。
verses.e: So I will bless you while I live . I will lift up my hands in your name .

verses.z: 我在床上記念你，在夜更的時候思想你；我的心就像飽足了骨髓肥油，我也要以歡樂的嘴唇讚美你。
verses.e: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food . My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips ,
when I remember you on my bed , and think about you in the night watches .

verses.z: 因為你曾幫助我，我就在你翅膀的蔭下歡呼。
verses.e: For you have been my help . I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings .

verses.z: 我心緊緊地跟隨你；你的右手扶持我。
verses.e: My soul stays close to you . Your right hand holds me up .

verses.z: 但那些尋索要滅我命的人必往地底下去；
verses.e: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。上帝啊，我哀歎的時候，求你聽我的聲音！求你保護我的性命，不受仇敵的驚恐！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . Hear my voice , God , in my complaint . Preserve my life from fear of the enemy .

verses.z: 義人必因耶和華歡喜，並要投靠他；凡心裏正直的人都要誇口。
verses.e: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD , and shall take refuge in him . All the upright in heart shall praise him !

verses.z: 求你把我隱藏，使我脫離作惡之人的暗謀和作孽之人的擾亂。
verses.e: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked , from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil ;

verses.z: 他們磨舌如刀，發出苦毒的言語，好像比準了的箭，
verses.e: who sharpen their tongue like a sword , and aim their arrows , deadly words ,

verses.z: 要在暗地射完全人；他們忽然射他，並不懼怕。
verses.e: to shoot innocent men from ambushes . They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly .

verses.z: 他們彼此勉勵設下惡計；他們商量暗設網羅，說：誰能看見？
verses.e: They encourage themselves in evil plans . They talk about laying snares secretly . They say , " Who will see them ? "

verses.z: 他們圖謀奸惡，[說]：我們是極力圖謀的。他們各人的意念心思是深的。
verses.e: They plot injustice , saying , " We have made a perfect plan ! " Surely man's mind and heart are cunning .

verses.z: 但上帝要射他們；他們忽然被箭射傷。
verses.e: But God will shoot at them . They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow .

verses.z: 他們必然絆跌，被自己的舌頭所害；凡看見他們的必都搖頭。
verses.e: Their own tongues shall ruin them . All who see them will shake their heads .

verses.z: 眾人都要害怕，要傳揚上帝的工作，並且明白他的作為。
verses.e: All mankind shall be afraid . They shall declare the work of God , and shall wisely ponder what he has done .

verses.z: 大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。上帝啊，錫安的人都等候讚美你；所許的願也要向你償還。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . A song . Praise waits for you , God , in Zion . Vows shall be performed to you .

verses.z: 你澆透地的犂溝，潤平犂脊，降甘霖，使地軟和；其中發長的，蒙你賜福。
verses.e: You drench its furrows . You level its ridges . You soften it with showers . You bless it with a crop .

verses.z: 你以恩典為年歲的冠冕；你的路徑都滴下脂油，
verses.e: You crown the year with your bounty . Your carts overflow with abundance .

verses.z: 滴在曠野的草場上。小山以歡樂束腰；
verses.e: The wilderness grasslands overflow . The hills are clothed with gladness .

verses.z: 草場以羊群為衣；谷中也長滿了五穀。這一切都歡呼歌唱。
verses.e: The pastures are covered with flocks . The valleys also are clothed with grain . They shout for joy ! They also sing .

verses.z: 聽禱告的[主]啊，凡有血氣的都要來就你。
verses.e: You who hear prayer , all men will come to you .

verses.z: 罪孽勝了我；至於我們的過犯，你都要赦免。
verses.e: Sins overwhelmed me , but you atoned for our transgressions .

verses.z: 你所揀選、使他親近你、住在你院中的，這人便為有福！我們必因你居所、你聖殿的美福知足了。
verses.e: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near , that he may live in your courts . We will be filled with the goodness of your house , your holy temple .

verses.z: 拯救我們的上帝啊，你必以威嚴秉公義應允我們；你本是一切地極和海上遠處的人所倚靠的。
verses.e: By awesome deeds of righteousness , you answer us , God of our salvation . You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth , of those who are far away on the sea .

verses.z: 他既以大能束腰，就用力量安定諸山，
verses.e: By your power , you form the mountains , having armed yourself with strength .

verses.z: 使諸海的響聲和其中波浪的響聲，並萬民的喧嘩，都平靜了。
verses.e: You still the roaring of the seas , the roaring of their waves , and the turmoil of the nations .

verses.z: 住在地極的人因你的神蹟懼怕；你使日出日落之地都歡呼。
verses.e: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders . You call the morning's dawn and the evening with songs of joy .

verses.z: 你眷顧地，降下透雨，使地大得肥美。上帝的河滿了水；你這樣澆灌了地，好為人預備五穀。
verses.e: You visit the earth , and water it . You greatly enrich it . The river of God is full of water . You provide them grain , for so you have ordained it .

verses.z: 一篇詩歌，交與伶長。全地都當向上帝歡呼！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A song . A Psalm . Make a joyful shout to God , all the earth !

verses.z: 上帝啊，你曾試驗我們，熬煉我們，如熬煉銀子一樣。
verses.e: For you , God , have tested us . You have refined us , as silver is refined .

verses.z: 你使我們進入網羅，把重擔放在我們的身上。
verses.e: You brought us into prison . You laid a burden on our backs .

verses.z: 你使人坐車軋我們的頭；我們經過水火，你卻使我們到豐富之地。
verses.e: You allowed men to ride over our heads . We went through fire and through water , but you brought us to the place of abundance .

verses.z: 我要用燔祭進你的殿，向你還我的願，
verses.e: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings . I will pay my vows to you ,

verses.z: 就是在急難時我嘴唇所發的、口中所許的。
verses.e: which my lips promised , and my mouth spoke , when I was in distress .

verses.z: 我要把肥牛作燔祭，將公羊的香祭獻給你，又把公牛和山羊獻上。（細拉）
verses.e: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals , with the offering of rams , I will offer bulls with goats . Selah .

verses.z: 凡敬畏上帝的人，你們都來聽！我要述說他為我所行的事。
verses.e: Come and hear , all you who fear God . I will declare what he has done for my soul .

verses.z: 我曾用口求告他；我的舌頭也稱他為高。
verses.e: I cried to him with my mouth . He was extolled with my tongue .

verses.z: 我若心裏注重罪孽，主必不聽。
verses.e: If I cherished sin in my heart , the Lord wouldn't have listened .

verses.z: 但上帝實在聽見了；他側耳聽了我禱告的聲音。
verses.e: But most certainly , God has listened . He has heard the voice of my prayer .

verses.z: 歌頌他名的榮耀！用讚美的言語將他的榮耀發明！
verses.e: Sing to the glory of his name ! Offer glory and praise !

verses.z: 上帝是應當稱頌的！他並沒有推卻我的禱告，也沒有叫他的慈愛離開我。
verses.e: Blessed be God , who has not turned away my prayer , nor his loving kindness from me .

verses.z: 當對上帝說：你的作為何等可畏！因你的大能，仇敵要投降你。
verses.e: Tell God , " How awesome are your deeds ! Through the greatness of your power , your enemies submit themselves to you .

verses.z: 全地要敬拜你，歌頌你，要歌頌你的名。（細拉）
verses.e: All the earth will worship you , and will sing to you ; they will sing to your name . " Selah .

verses.z: 你們來看上帝所行的，他向世人所做之事是可畏的。
verses.e: Come , and see God's deeds — awesome work on behalf of the children of men .

verses.z: 他將海變成乾地，眾民步行過河；我們在那裏因他歡喜。
verses.e: He turned the sea into dry land . They went through the river on foot . There , we rejoiced in him .

verses.z: 他用權能治理[萬民]，直到永遠。他的眼睛鑒察列邦；悖逆的人不可自高。（細拉）
verses.e: He rules by his might forever . His eyes watch the nations . Don't let the rebellious rise up against him . Selah .

verses.z: 萬民哪，你們當稱頌我們的上帝，使人得聽讚美他的聲音。
verses.e: Praise our God , you peoples ! Make the sound of his praise heard ,

verses.z: 他使我們的性命存活，也不叫我們的腳搖動。
verses.e: who preserves our life among the living , and doesn't allow our feet to be moved .

verses.z: 一篇詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。願上帝憐憫我們，賜福與我們，用臉光照我們，（細拉）
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . With stringed instruments . A Psalm . A song . May God be merciful to us , bless us , and cause his face to shine on us . Selah .

verses.z: 好叫世界得知你的道路，萬國得知你的救恩。
verses.e: That your way may be known on earth , and your salvation among all nations ,

verses.z: 上帝啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！
verses.e: let the peoples praise you , God . Let all the peoples praise you .

verses.z: 願萬國都快樂歡呼；因為你必按公正審判萬民，引導世上的萬國。（細拉）
verses.e: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy , for you will judge the peoples with equity , and govern the nations on earth . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！
verses.e: Let the peoples praise you , God . Let all the peoples praise you .

verses.z: 地已經出了土產；上帝－就是我們的上帝要賜福與我們。
verses.e: The earth has yielded its increase . God , even our own God , will bless us .

verses.z: 上帝要賜福與我們；地的四極都要敬畏他！
verses.e: God will bless us . All the ends of the earth shall fear him .

verses.z: 大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。願上帝興起，使他的仇敵四散，叫那恨他的人從他面前逃跑。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by David . A song . Let God arise ! Let his enemies be scattered ! Let them who hate him also flee before him .

verses.z: 你的會眾住在其中；上帝啊，你的恩惠是為困苦人預備的。
verses.e: Your congregation lived therein . You , God , prepared your goodness for the poor .

verses.z: 主發命令，傳好信息的婦女成了大群。
verses.e: The Lord announced the word . The ones who proclaim it are a great company .

verses.z: 統兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了；在家等候的婦女分受所奪的。
verses.e: " Kings of armies flee ! They flee ! " She who waits at home divides the plunder ,

verses.z: 你們安臥在羊圈的時候，好像鴿子的翅膀鍍白銀，翎毛鍍黃金一般。
verses.e: while you sleep among the camp fires , the wings of a dove sheathed with silver , her feathers with shining gold .

verses.z: 全能者在境內趕散列王的時候，勢如飄雪在撒們。
verses.e: When the Almighty scattered kings in her , it snowed on Zalmon .

verses.z: 巴珊山是上帝的山；巴珊山是多峰多嶺的山。
verses.e: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains . The mountains of Bashan are rugged .

verses.z: 你們多峰多嶺的山哪，為何斜看上帝所願居住的山？耶和華必住這山，直到永遠！
verses.e: Why do you look in envy , you rugged mountains , at the mountain where God chooses to reign ? Yes , the LORD will dwell there forever .

verses.z: 上帝的車輦累萬盈千；主在其中，好像在西奈聖山一樣。
verses.e: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands . The Lord is among them , from Sinai , into the sanctuary .

verses.z: 你已經升上高天，擄掠仇敵；你在人間，就是在悖逆的人間，受了供獻，叫耶和華上帝可以與他們同住。
verses.e: You have ascended on high . You have led away captives . You have received gifts among people , yes , among the rebellious also , that the LORD God might dwell there .

verses.z: 天天背負我們重擔的主，就是拯救我們的上帝，是應當稱頌的！（細拉）
verses.e: Blessed be the Lord , who daily bears our burdens , even the God who is our salvation . Selah .

verses.z: 他們被驅逐，如煙被[風]吹散；惡人見上帝之面而消滅，如蠟被火鎔化。
verses.e: As smoke is driven away , so drive them away . As wax melts before the fire , so let the wicked perish at the presence of God .

verses.z: 上帝是為我們施行諸般救恩的上帝；人能脫離死亡是在乎主耶和華。
verses.e: God is to us a God of deliverance . To GOD , the Lord , belongs escape from death .

verses.z: 但上帝要打破他仇敵的頭，就是那常犯罪之人的髮頂。
verses.e: But God will strike through the head of his enemies , the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness .

verses.z: 主說：我要使眾民從巴珊而歸，使他們從深海而回，
verses.e: The Lord said , " I will bring you again from Bashan , I will bring you again from the depths of the sea ,

verses.z: 使你打碎仇敵，你的腳踹在血中，使你狗的舌頭從其中得分。
verses.e: that you may crush them , dipping your foot in blood , that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies . "

verses.z: 上帝啊，你是我的上帝，我的王；人已經看見你行走，進入聖所。
verses.e: They have seen your processions , God , even the processions of my God , my King , into the sanctuary .

verses.z: 歌唱的行在前，作樂的隨在後，都在擊鼓的童女中間。
verses.e: The singers went before , the minstrels followed after , among the ladies playing with tambourines ,

verses.z: 從以色列源頭而來的，當在各會中稱頌主上帝！
verses.e: " Bless God in the congregations , even the Lord in the assembly of Israel ! "

verses.z: 在那裏，有統管他們的小便雅憫，有猶大的首領和他們的群眾，有西布倫的首領，有拿弗他利的首領。
verses.e: There is little Benjamin , their ruler , the princes of Judah , their council , the princes of Zebulun , and the princes of Naphtali .

verses.z: 以色列的能力是上帝所賜的；上帝啊，求你堅固你為我們所成全的事！
verses.e: Your God has commanded your strength . Strengthen , God , that which you have done for us .

verses.z: 因你耶路撒冷的殿，列王必帶貢物獻給你。
verses.e: Because of your temple at Jerusalem , kings shall bring presents to you .

verses.z: 惟有義人必然歡喜，在上帝面前高興快樂。
verses.e: But let the righteous be glad . Let them rejoice before God . Yes , let them rejoice with gladness .

verses.z: 求你叱喝蘆葦中的野獸和群公牛，並列邦中的牛犢。把銀塊踹在腳下；上帝已經趕散好爭戰的列邦。
verses.e: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds , the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples . Trample under foot the bars of silver . Scatter the nations who delight in war .

verses.z: 埃及的公侯要出來朝見上帝；古實人要急忙舉手[禱告]。
verses.e: Princes shall come out of Egypt . Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God .

verses.z: 世上的列國啊，你們要向上帝歌唱；願你們歌頌主！
verses.e: Sing to God , you kingdoms of the earth ! Sing praises to the Lord — Selah —

verses.z: 歌頌那自古駕行在諸天以上的[主]！他發出聲音，是極大的聲音。
verses.e: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens , which are of old ; behold , he utters his voice , a mighty voice .

verses.z: 你們要將能力歸給上帝。他的威榮在以色列之上；他的能力是在穹蒼。
verses.e: Ascribe strength to God ! His excellency is over Israel , his strength is in the skies .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你從聖所顯為可畏；以色列的上帝是那將力量權能賜給他百姓的。上帝是應當稱頌的！
verses.e: You are awesome , God , in your sanctuaries . The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people . Praise be to God !

verses.z: 你們當向上帝唱詩，歌頌他的名；為那坐車行過曠野的修平大路。他的名是耶和華，要在他面前歡樂！
verses.e: Sing to God ! Sing praises to his name ! Extol him who rides on the clouds : to the LORD , his name ! Rejoice before him !

verses.z: 上帝在他的聖所作孤兒的父，作寡婦的伸冤者。
verses.e: A father of the fatherless , and a defender of the widows , is God in his holy habitation .

verses.z: 上帝叫孤獨的有家，使被囚的出來享福；惟有悖逆的住在乾燥之地。
verses.e: God sets the lonely in families . He brings out the prisoners with singing , but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你曾在你百姓前頭出來，在曠野行走。（細拉）
verses.e: God , when you went out before your people , when you marched through the wilderness . . . Selah .

verses.z: 那時，地見上帝的面而震動，天也落雨；西奈山見以色列上帝的面也震動。
verses.e: The earth trembled . The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai — at the presence of God , the God of Israel .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你降下大雨；你產業[以色列]疲乏的時候，你使他堅固。
verses.e: You , God , sent a plentiful rain . You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用百合花。上帝啊，求你救我！因為眾水要淹沒我。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " Lilies . " By David . Save me , God , for the waters have come up to my neck !

verses.z: 我哭泣，以禁食[刻苦]我心；這倒算為我的羞辱。
verses.e: When I wept and I fasted , that was to my reproach .

verses.z: 我拿麻布當衣裳，就成了他們的笑談。
verses.e: When I made sackcloth my clothing , I became a byword to them .

verses.z: 坐在城門口的談論我；酒徒也以我為歌曲。
verses.e: Those who sit in the gate talk about me . I am the song of the drunkards .

verses.z: 但我在悅納的時候向你－耶和華祈禱。上帝啊，求你按你豐盛的慈愛，憑你拯救的誠實應允我！
verses.e: But as for me , my prayer is to you , LORD , in an acceptable time . God , in the abundance of your loving kindness , answer me in the truth of your salvation .

verses.z: 求你搭救我出離淤泥，不叫我陷在其中；求你使我脫離那些恨我的人，使我出離深水。
verses.e: Deliver me out of the mire , and don't let me sink . Let me be delivered from those who hate me , and out of the deep waters .

verses.z: 求你不容大水漫過我，不容深淵吞滅我，不容坑坎在我以上合口。
verses.e: Don't let the flood waters overwhelm me , neither let the deep swallow me up . Don't let the pit shut its mouth on me .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你應允我！因為你的慈愛本為美好；求你按你豐盛的慈悲回轉眷顧我！
verses.e: Answer me , LORD , for your loving kindness is good . According to the multitude of your tender mercies , turn to me .

verses.z: 不要掩面不顧你的僕人；我是在急難之中，求你速速地應允我！
verses.e: Don't hide your face from your servant , for I am in distress . Answer me speedily !

verses.z: 求你親近我，救贖我！求你因我的仇敵把我贖回！
verses.e: Draw near to my soul and redeem it . Ransom me because of my enemies .

verses.z: 你知道我受的辱罵、欺凌、羞辱；我的敵人都在你面前。
verses.e: You know my reproach , my shame , and my dishonor . My adversaries are all before you .

verses.z: 我陷在深淤泥中，沒有立腳之地；我到了深水中，大水漫過我身。
verses.e: I sink in deep mire , where there is no foothold . I have come into deep waters , where the floods overflow me .

verses.z: 辱罵傷破了我的心，我又滿了憂愁。我指望有人體恤，卻沒有一個；我指望有人安慰，卻找不着一個。
verses.e: Reproach has broken my heart , and I am full of heaviness . I looked for some to take pity , but there was none ; for comforters , but I found none .

verses.z: 他們拿苦膽給我當食物；我渴了，他們拿醋給我喝。
verses.e: They also gave me poison for my food . In my thirst , they gave me vinegar to drink .

verses.z: 願他們的筵席在他們面前變為網羅，在他們平安的時候變為機檻。
verses.e: Let their table before them become a snare . May it become a retribution and a trap .

verses.z: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見；願你使他們的腰常常戰抖。
verses.e: Let their eyes be darkened , so that they can't see . Let their backs be continually bent .

verses.z: 求你將你的惱恨倒在他們身上，叫你的烈怒追上他們。
verses.e: Pour out your indignation on them . Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them .

verses.z: 願他們的住處變為荒場；願他們的帳棚無人居住。
verses.e: Let their habitation be desolate . Let no one dwell in their tents .

verses.z: 因為，你所擊打的，他們就逼迫；你所擊傷的，他們戲說他的愁苦。
verses.e: For they persecute him whom you have wounded . They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt .

verses.z: 願你在他們的罪上加罪，不容他們在你面前稱義。
verses.e: Charge them with crime upon crime . Don't let them come into your righteousness .

verses.z: 願他們從生命冊上被塗抹，不得記錄在義人之中。
verses.e: Let them be blotted out of the book of life , and not be written with the righteous .

verses.z: 但我是困苦憂傷的；上帝啊，願你的救恩將我安置在高處。
verses.e: But I am in pain and distress . Let your salvation , God , protect me .

verses.z: 我因呼求困乏，喉嚨發乾；我因等候上帝，眼睛失明。
verses.e: I am weary with my crying . My throat is dry . My eyes fail looking for my God .

verses.z: 我要以詩歌讚美上帝的名，以感謝稱他為大！
verses.e: I will praise the name of God with a song , and will magnify him with thanksgiving .

verses.z: 這便叫耶和華喜悅，勝似獻牛，或是獻有角有蹄的公牛。
verses.e: It will please the LORD better than an ox , or a bull that has horns and hoofs .

verses.z: 謙卑的人看見了就喜樂；尋求上帝的人，願你們的心甦醒。
verses.e: The humble have seen it , and are glad . You who seek after God , let your heart live .

verses.z: 因為耶和華聽了窮乏人，不藐視被囚的人。
verses.e: For the LORD hears the needy , and doesn't despise his captive people .

verses.z: 願天和地、洋海和其中一切的動物都讚美他！
verses.e: Let heaven and earth praise him ; the seas , and everything that moves therein !

verses.z: 因為上帝要拯救錫安，建造猶大的城邑；他的民要在那裏居住，得以為業。
verses.e: For God will save Zion , and build the cities of Judah . They shall settle there , and own it .

verses.z: 他僕人的後裔要承受為業；愛他名的人也要住在其中。
verses.e: The children also of his servants shall inherit it . Those who love his name shall dwell therein .

verses.z: 無故恨我的，比我頭髮還多；無理與我為仇、要把我剪除的，甚為強盛。我沒有搶奪的，要叫我償還。
verses.e: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head . Those who want to cut me off , being my enemies wrongfully , are mighty . I have to restore what I didn't take away .

verses.z: 上帝啊，我的愚昧，你原知道；我的罪愆不能隱瞞。
verses.e: God , you know my foolishness . My sins aren't hidden from you .

verses.z: 萬軍的主－耶和華啊，求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！以色列的上帝啊，求你叫那尋求你的，不要因我受辱！
verses.e: Don't let those who wait for you be shamed through me , Lord GOD of Armies . Don't let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me , God of Israel .

verses.z: 因我為你的緣故受了辱罵，滿面羞愧。
verses.e: Because for your sake , I have borne reproach . Shame has covered my face .

verses.z: 我的弟兄看我為外路人；我的同胞看我為外邦人。
verses.e: I have become a stranger to my brothers , an alien to my mother's children .

verses.z: 因我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒，並且辱罵你人的辱罵都落在我身上。
verses.e: For the zeal of your house consumes me . The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me .

verses.z: 大衛指着便雅憫人古實的話，向耶和華唱的流離歌。耶和華－我的上帝啊，我投靠你！求你救我脫離一切追趕我的人，將我救拔出來！
verses.e: A meditation by David , which he sang to the LORD , concerning the words of Cush , the Benjamite . LORD , my God , I take refuge in you . Save me from all those who pursue me , and deliver me ,

verses.z: 上帝是我的盾牌；他拯救心裏正直的人。
verses.e: My shield is with God , who saves the upright in heart .

verses.z: 上帝是公義的審判者，又是天天[向惡人]發怒的上帝。
verses.e: God is a righteous judge , yes , a God who has indignation every day .

verses.z: 若有人不回頭，他的刀必磨快，弓必上弦，預備妥當了。
verses.e: If a man doesn't repent , he will sharpen his sword ; he has bent and strung his bow .

verses.z: 他也預備了殺人的器械；他所射的是火[箭]。
verses.e: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death . He makes ready his flaming arrows .

verses.z: 試看惡人因奸惡而劬勞，所懷的是毒害，所生的是虛假。
verses.e: Behold , he travails with iniquity . Yes , he has conceived mischief , and brought out falsehood .

verses.z: 他掘了坑，又挖深了，竟掉在自己所挖的阱裏。
verses.e: He has dug a hole , and has fallen into the pit which he made .

verses.z: 他的毒害必臨到他自己的頭上；他的強暴必落到他自己的腦袋上。
verses.e: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head . His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head .

verses.z: 我要照着耶和華的公義稱謝他，歌頌耶和華至高者的名。
verses.e: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness , and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High .

verses.z: 恐怕他們像獅子撕裂我，甚至撕碎，無人搭救。
verses.e: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion , ripping it in pieces , while there is no one to deliver .

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我若行了這事，若有罪孽在我手裏，
verses.e: LORD , my God , if I have done this , if there is iniquity in my hands ,

verses.z: 我若以惡報那與我交好的人－連那無故與我為敵的，我也救了他，
verses.e: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me ( yes , I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary ) ,

verses.z: 就任憑仇敵追趕我，直到追上，將我的性命踏在地下，使我的榮耀歸於灰塵。（細拉）
verses.e: let the enemy pursue my soul , and overtake it ; yes , let him tread my life down to the earth , and lay my glory in the dust . Selah .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你在怒中起來，挺身而立，抵擋我敵人的暴怒！求你為我興起！你已經命定施行審判！
verses.e: Arise , LORD , in your anger . Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries . Awake for me . You have commanded judgment .

verses.z: 願眾民的會環繞你！願你從其上歸於高位！
verses.e: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you . Rule over them on high .

verses.z: 耶和華向眾民施行審判；耶和華啊，求你按我的公義和我心中的純正判斷我。
verses.e: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples . Judge me , LORD , according to my righteousness , and to my integrity that is in me .

verses.z: 願惡人的惡斷絕！願你堅立義人！因為公義的上帝察驗人的心腸肺腑。
verses.e: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end , but establish the righteous ; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God .

verses.z: 大衛的紀念詩，交與伶長。上帝啊，求你[快快]搭救我！耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . By David . A reminder . Hurry , God , to deliver me . Come quickly to help me , LORD .

verses.z: 願那些尋索我命的，抱愧蒙羞；願那些喜悅我遭害的，退後受辱。
verses.e: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul . Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace .

verses.z: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧退後。
verses.e: Let them be turned because of their shame who say , " Aha ! Aha ! "

verses.z: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜；願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊上帝為大！
verses.e: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you . Let those who love your salvation continually say , " Let God be exalted ! "

verses.z: 但我是困苦窮乏的；上帝啊，求你速速到我這裏來！你是幫助我的，搭救我的。耶和華啊，求你不要耽延！
verses.e: But I am poor and needy . Come to me quickly , God . You are my help and my deliverer . LORD , don't delay .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我投靠你；求你叫我永不羞愧！
verses.e: In you , LORD , I take refuge . Never let me be disappointed .

verses.z: 我的仇敵議論我；那些窺探要害我命的彼此商議，
verses.e: For my enemies talk about me . Those who watch for my soul conspire together ,

verses.z: 說：上帝已經離棄他；我們追趕他，捉拿他吧！因為沒有人搭救。
verses.e: saying , " God has forsaken him . Pursue and take him , for no one will rescue him . "

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你不要遠離我！我的上帝啊，求你速速幫助我！
verses.e: God , don't be far from me . My God , hurry to help me .

verses.z: 願那與我性命為敵的，羞愧被滅；願那謀害我的，受辱蒙羞。
verses.e: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed . Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me .

verses.z: 我卻要常常盼望，並要越發讚美你。
verses.e: But I will always hope , and will add to all of your praise .

verses.z: 我的口終日要述說你的公義和你的救恩，因我不計其數。
verses.e: My mouth will tell about your righteousness , and of your salvation all day , though I don't know its full measure .

verses.z: 我要來[說]主－耶和華大能的事；我單要提說你的公義。
verses.e: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD . I will make mention of your righteousness , even of yours alone .

verses.z: 上帝啊，自我年幼時，你就教訓我；直到如今，我傳揚你奇妙的作為。
verses.e: God , you have taught me from my youth . Until now , I have declared your wondrous works .

verses.z: 上帝啊，我到年老髮白的時候，求你不要離棄我！等我將你的能力指示下代，將你的大能指示後世的人。
verses.e: Yes , even when I am old and gray-haired , God , don't forsake me , until I have declared your strength to the next generation , your might to everyone who is to come .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你的公義甚高；行過大事的上帝啊，誰能像你！
verses.e: God , your righteousness also reaches to the heavens . You have done great things . God , who is like you ?

verses.z: 求你憑你的公義搭救我，救拔我；側耳聽我，拯救我！
verses.e: Deliver me in your righteousness , and rescue me . Turn your ear to me , and save me .

verses.z: 你是叫我們多經歷重大急難的，必使我們復活，從地的深處救上來。
verses.e: You , who have shown us many and bitter troubles , you will let me live . You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth .

verses.z: 求你使我越發昌大，又轉來安慰我。
verses.e: Increase my honor and comfort me again .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，我要鼓瑟稱讚你，稱讚你的誠實！以色列的聖者啊，我要彈琴歌頌你！
verses.e: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness , my God . I sing praises to you with the lyre , Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 我歌頌你的時候，我的嘴唇和你所贖我的靈魂都必歡呼；
verses.e: My lips shall shout for joy ! My soul , which you have redeemed , sings praises to you !

verses.z: 並且我的舌頭必終日講論你的公義，因為那些謀害我的人已經蒙羞受辱了。
verses.e: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long , for they are disappointed , and they are confounded , who want to harm me .

verses.z: 求你作我常住的磐石；你已經命定要救我，因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨。
verses.e: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go . Give the command to save me , for you are my rock and my fortress .

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，求你救我脫離惡人的手，脫離不義和殘暴之人的手。
verses.e: Rescue me , my God , from the hand of the wicked , from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man .

verses.z: 主－耶和華啊，你是我所盼望的；從我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。
verses.e: For you are my hope , Lord GOD , my confidence from my youth .

verses.z: 我從出母胎被你扶持；使我出母腹的是你。我必常常讚美你！
verses.e: I have relied on you from the womb . You are he who took me out of my mother's womb . I will always praise you .

verses.z: 許多人以我為怪，但你是我堅固的避難所。
verses.e: I am a marvel to many , but you are my strong refuge .

verses.z: 你的讚美，你的榮耀終日必滿了我的口。
verses.e: My mouth shall be filled with your praise , with your honor all day long .

verses.z: 我年老的時候，求你不要丟棄我！我力氣衰弱的時候，求你不要離棄我！
verses.e: Don't reject me in my old age . Don't forsake me when my strength fails .

verses.z: 所羅門的詩。上帝啊，求你將判斷的權柄賜給王，將公義賜給王的兒子。
verses.e: By Solomon . God , give the king your justice ; your righteousness to the royal son .

verses.z: 他施和海島的王要進貢；示巴和西巴的王要獻禮物。
verses.e: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute . The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts .

verses.z: 諸王都要叩拜他；萬國都要事奉他。
verses.e: Yes , all kings shall fall down before him . All nations shall serve him .

verses.z: 因為，窮乏人呼求的時候，他要搭救；沒有人幫助的困苦人，他也要搭救。
verses.e: For he will deliver the needy when he cries ; the poor , who has no helper .

verses.z: 他要憐恤貧寒和窮乏的人，拯救窮苦人的性命。
verses.e: He will have pity on the poor and needy . He will save the souls of the needy .

verses.z: 他要救贖他們脫離欺壓和強暴；他們的血在他眼中看為寶貴。
verses.e: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence . Their blood will be precious in his sight .

verses.z: 他們要存活。示巴的金子要奉給他；人要常常為他禱告，終日稱頌他。
verses.e: He will live ; and Sheba's gold will be given to him . Men will pray for him continually . They will bless him all day long .

verses.z: 在地的山頂上，五穀必然茂盛；所結的穀實要響動，如黎巴嫩[的樹林]；城裏的人要發旺，如地上的草。
verses.e: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land . Its fruit sways like Lebanon . Let it flourish , thriving like the grass of the field .

verses.z: 他的名要存到永遠，要留傳如日之久。人要因他蒙福；萬國要稱他有福。
verses.e: His name endures forever . His name continues as long as the sun . Men shall be blessed by him . All nations will call him blessed .

verses.z: 獨行奇事的耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的！
verses.e: Praise be to the LORD God , the God of Israel , who alone does marvelous deeds .

verses.z: 他榮耀的名也當稱頌，直到永遠。願他的榮耀充滿全地！阿們！阿們！
verses.e: Blessed be his glorious name forever ! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory ! Amen and amen .

verses.z: 他要按公義審判你的民，按公平審判你的困苦人。
verses.e: He will judge your people with righteousness , and your poor with justice .

verses.z: 耶西的兒子－大衛的祈禱完畢。
verses.e: This ends the prayers by David , the son of Jesse .

verses.z: 大山小山都要因公義使民得享平安。
verses.e: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people . The hills bring the fruit of righteousness .

verses.z: 他必為民中的困苦人伸冤，拯救窮乏之輩，壓碎那欺壓人的。
verses.e: He will judge the poor of the people . He will save the children of the needy , and will break the oppressor in pieces .

verses.z: 太陽還存，月亮還在，人要敬畏你，直到萬代！
verses.e: They shall fear you while the sun endures ; and as long as the moon , throughout all generations .

verses.z: 他必降臨，像雨降在已割的草[地]上，如甘霖滋潤田地。
verses.e: He will come down like rain on the mown grass , as showers that water the earth .

verses.z: 在他的日子，義人要發旺，大有平安，好像月亮長存。
verses.e: In his days , the righteous shall flourish , and abundance of peace , until the moon is no more .

verses.z: 他要執掌權柄，從這海直到那海，從大河直到地極。
verses.e: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea , from the River to the ends of the earth .

verses.z: 住在曠野的，必在他面前下拜；他的仇敵必要舔土。
verses.e: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him . His enemies shall lick the dust .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩。上帝實在恩待以色列那些清心的人！
verses.e: A Psalm by Asaph . Surely God is good to Israel , to those who are pure in heart .

verses.z: 所以上帝的民歸到這裏，喝盡了滿[杯的苦]水。
verses.e: Therefore their people return to them , and they drink up waters of abundance .

verses.z: 他們說：上帝怎能曉得？至高者豈有知識呢？
verses.e: They say , " How does God know ? Is there knowledge in the Most High ? "

verses.z: 看哪，這就是惡人；他們既是常享安逸，財寶便加增。
verses.e: Behold , these are the wicked . Being always at ease , they increase in riches .

verses.z: 我實在徒然潔淨了我的心，徒然洗手表明無辜。
verses.e: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain , and washed my hands in innocence ,

verses.z: 因為，我終日遭災難；每早晨受懲治。
verses.e: For all day long I have been plagued , and punished every morning .

verses.z: 我若說，我要這樣講，這就是以奸詐待你的眾子。
verses.e: If I had said , " I will speak thus " , behold , I would have betrayed the generation of your children .

verses.z: 我思索怎能明白這事，眼看實係為難，
verses.e: When I tried to understand this , it was too painful for me —

verses.z: 等我進了上帝的聖所，思想他們的結局。
verses.e: until I entered God's sanctuary , and considered their latter end .

verses.z: 你實在把他們安在滑地，使他們掉在沉淪之中。
verses.e: Surely you set them in slippery places . You throw them down to destruction .

verses.z: 他們轉眼之間成了何等的荒涼！他們被驚恐滅盡了。
verses.e: How they are suddenly destroyed ! They are completely swept away with terrors .

verses.z: 至於我，我的腳幾乎失閃；我的腳險些滑跌。
verses.e: But as for me , my feet were almost gone . My steps had nearly slipped .

verses.z: 人睡醒了，怎樣看夢；主啊，你醒了也必照樣輕看他們的影像。
verses.e: As a dream when one wakes up , so , Lord , when you awake , you will despise their fantasies .

verses.z: 因而，我心裏發酸，肺腑被刺。
verses.e: For my soul was grieved . I was embittered in my heart .

verses.z: 我這樣愚昧無知，在你面前如畜類一般。
verses.e: I was so senseless and ignorant . I was a brute beast before you .

verses.z: 然而，我常與你同在；你攙着我的右手。
verses.e: Nevertheless , I am continually with you . You have held my right hand .

verses.z: 你要以你的訓言引導我，以後必接我到榮耀裏。
verses.e: You will guide me with your counsel , and afterward receive me to glory .

verses.z: 除你以外，在天上我有誰呢？除你以外，在地上我也沒有所愛慕的。
verses.e: Whom do I have in heaven ? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you .

verses.z: 我的肉體和我的心腸衰殘；但上帝是我心裏的力量，又是我的福分，直到永遠。
verses.e: My flesh and my heart fails , but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever .

verses.z: 遠離你的，必要死亡；凡離棄你行邪淫的，你都滅絕了。
verses.e: For , behold , those who are far from you shall perish . You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you .

verses.z: 但我親近上帝是與我有益；我以主耶和華為我的避難所，好叫我述說你一切的作為。
verses.e: But it is good for me to come close to God . I have made the Lord GOD my refuge , that I may tell of all your works .

verses.z: 我見惡人和狂傲人享平安就心懷不平。
verses.e: For I was envious of the arrogant , when I saw the prosperity of the wicked .

verses.z: 他們死的時候沒有疼痛；他們的力氣卻也壯實。
verses.e: For there are no struggles in their death , but their strength is firm .

verses.z: 他們不像別人受苦，也不像別人遭災。
verses.e: They are free from burdens of men , neither are they plagued like other men .

verses.z: 所以，驕傲如鏈子戴在他們的項上；強暴像衣裳遮住他們的身體。
verses.e: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck . Violence covers them like a garment .

verses.z: 他們的眼睛因體胖而凸出；他們所得的，過於心裏所想的。
verses.e: Their eyes bulge with fat . Their minds pass the limits of conceit .

verses.z: 他們譏笑人，憑惡意說欺壓人的話；他們說話自高。
verses.e: They scoff and speak with malice . In arrogance , they threaten oppression .

verses.z: 他們的口褻瀆上天；他們的舌毀謗全地。
verses.e: They have set their mouth in the heavens . Their tongue walks through the earth .

verses.z: 亞薩的訓誨詩。上帝啊，你為何永遠丟棄我們呢？你為何向你草場的羊發怒，如煙冒出呢？
verses.e: A contemplation by Asaph . God , why have you rejected us forever ? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture ?

verses.z: 上帝啊，敵人辱罵要到幾時呢？仇敵褻瀆你的名要到永遠嗎？
verses.e: How long , God , shall the adversary reproach ? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever ?

verses.z: 你為甚麼縮回你的右手？求你從懷中伸出來，毀滅他們。
verses.e: Why do you draw back your hand , even your right hand ? Take it from your chest and consume them !

verses.z: 上帝自古以來為我的王，在地上施行拯救。
verses.e: Yet God is my King of old , working salvation throughout the earth .

verses.z: 你曾用能力將海分開，將水中大魚的頭打破。
verses.e: You divided the sea by your strength . You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters .

verses.z: 你曾砸碎鱷魚的頭，把牠給曠野的禽獸為食物。
verses.e: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces . You gave him as food to people and desert creatures .

verses.z: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河；你使長流的江河乾了。
verses.e: You opened up spring and stream . You dried up mighty rivers .

verses.z: 白晝屬你，黑夜也屬你；亮光和日頭是你所預備的。
verses.e: The day is yours , the night is also yours . You have prepared the light and the sun .

verses.z: 地的一切疆界是你所立的；夏天和冬天是你所定的。
verses.e: You have set all the boundaries of the earth . You have made summer and winter .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，仇敵辱罵，愚頑民褻瀆了你的名，求你記念這事。
verses.e: Remember this , that the enemy has mocked you , LORD . Foolish people have blasphemed your name .

verses.z: 不要將你斑鳩的性命交給野獸；不要永遠忘記你困苦人的性命。
verses.e: Don't deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts . Don't forget the life of your poor forever .

verses.z: 求你記念你古時所得來的會眾，就是你所贖、作你產業支派的，並記念你向來所居住的錫安山。
verses.e: Remember your congregation , which you purchased of old , which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance : Mount Zion , in which you have lived .

verses.z: 求你顧念所立的約，因為地上黑暗之處都滿了強暴的居所。
verses.e: Honor your covenant , for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth .

verses.z: 不要叫受欺壓的人蒙羞回去；要叫困苦窮乏的人讚美你的名。
verses.e: Don't let the oppressed return ashamed . Let the poor and needy praise your name .

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你起來為自己伸訴！要記念愚頑人怎樣終日辱罵你。
verses.e: Arise , God ! Plead your own cause . Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day .

verses.z: 不要忘記你敵人的聲音；那起來敵你之人的喧嘩時常上升。
verses.e: Don't forget the voice of your adversaries . The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually .

verses.z: 求你舉步去看那日久荒涼之地，仇敵在聖所中所行的一切惡事。
verses.e: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins , all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary .

verses.z: 你的敵人在你會中吼叫；他們豎了自己的旗為記號。
verses.e: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly . They have set up their standards as signs .

verses.z: 他們好像人揚起斧子，砍伐林中的樹。
verses.e: They behaved like men wielding axes , cutting through a thicket of trees .

verses.z: 聖所中一切雕刻的，他們現在用斧子錘子打壞了。
verses.e: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers .

verses.z: 他們用火焚燒你的聖所，褻瀆你名的居所，[拆毀]到地。
verses.e: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground . They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name .

verses.z: 他們心裏說：我們要盡行毀滅；他們就在遍地把上帝的會所都燒毀了。
verses.e: They said in their heart , " We will crush them completely . " They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped .

verses.z: 我們不見我們的標幟，不再有先知；我們內中也沒有人知道[這災禍]要到幾時呢！
verses.e: We see no miraculous signs . There is no longer any prophet , neither is there among us anyone who knows how long .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。上帝啊，我們稱謝你，我們稱謝你！因為你的名相近，人都述說你奇妙的作為。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " Do Not Destroy . " A Psalm by Asaph . A song . We give thanks to you , God . We give thanks , for your Name is near . Men tell about your wondrous works .

verses.z: 惡人一切的角，我要砍斷；惟有義人的角必被高舉。
verses.e: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked , but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up .

verses.z: 我到了所定的日期，必按正直施行審判。
verses.e: When I choose the appointed time , I will judge blamelessly .

verses.z: 地和其上的居民都消化了；我曾立了地的柱子。（細拉）
verses.e: The earth and all its inhabitants quake . I firmly hold its pillars . Selah .

verses.z: 我對狂傲人說：不要行事狂傲！對凶惡人說：不要舉角！
verses.e: I said to the arrogant , " Don't boast ! " I said to the wicked , " Don't lift up the horn .

verses.z: 不要把你們的角高舉；不要挺着頸項說話。
verses.e: Don't lift up your horn on high . Don't speak with a stiff neck . "

verses.z: 因為高舉非從東，非從西，也非從南而來。
verses.e: For neither from the east , nor from the west , nor yet from the south , comes exaltation .

verses.z: 惟有上帝斷定；他使這人降卑，使那人升高。
verses.e: But God is the judge . He puts down one , and lifts up another .

verses.z: 耶和華手裏有杯，其中的酒起沫，杯內滿了攙雜的酒；他倒出來，地上的惡人必都喝這酒的渣滓，而且喝盡。
verses.e: For in the LORD's hand there is a cup , full of foaming wine mixed with spices . He pours it out . Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs .

verses.z: 但我要宣揚，直到永遠！我要歌頌雅各的上帝！
verses.e: But I will declare this forever : I will sing praises to the God of Jacob .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。在猶大，上帝為人所認識；在以色列，他的名為大。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . On stringed instruments . A Psalm by Asaph . A song . In Judah , God is known . His name is great in Israel .

verses.z: 人的忿怒要成全你的榮美；人的餘怒，你要禁止。
verses.e: Surely the wrath of man praises you . The survivors of your wrath are restrained .

verses.z: 你們許願，當向耶和華－你們的上帝還願；在他四面的人都當拿貢物獻給那可畏的主。
verses.e: Make vows to the LORD your God , and fulfill them ! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared .

verses.z: 他要挫折王子的驕氣；他向地上的君王顯威可畏。
verses.e: He will cut off the spirit of princes . He is feared by the kings of the earth .

verses.z: 在撒冷有他的帳幕；在錫安有他的居所。
verses.e: His tabernacle is also in Salem . His dwelling place in Zion .

verses.z: 他在那裏折斷弓上的火箭，並盾牌、刀劍，和爭戰[的兵器]。（細拉）
verses.e: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow , the shield , and the sword , and the weapons of war . Selah .

verses.z: 你從有野食之山而來，有光華和榮美。
verses.e: Glorious are you , and excellent , more than mountains of game .

verses.z: 心中勇敢的人都被搶奪；他們睡了長覺，沒有一個英雄能措手。
verses.e: Valiant men lie plundered , they have slept their last sleep . None of the men of war can lift their hands .

verses.z: 雅各的上帝啊，你的斥責一發，[坐]車的、[騎]馬的都沉睡了。
verses.e: At your rebuke , God of Jacob , both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep .

verses.z: 惟獨你是可畏的！你怒氣一發，誰能在你面前站得住呢？
verses.e: You , even you , are to be feared . Who can stand in your sight when you are angry ?

verses.z: 你從天上使人聽判斷。上帝起來施行審判，要救地上一切謙卑的人；那時地就懼怕而靜默。（細拉）
verses.e: You pronounced judgment from heaven . The earth feared , and was silent ,
when God arose to judgment , to save all the afflicted ones of the earth . Selah .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。我要向上帝發聲呼求；我向上帝發聲，他必留心聽我。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To Jeduthun . A Psalm by Asaph . My cry goes to God ! Indeed , I cry to God for help , and for him to listen to me .

verses.z: 我便說：這是我的懦弱，[但我要追念]至高者[顯出]右手之年代。
verses.e: Then I thought , " I will appeal to this : the years of the right hand of the Most High . "

verses.z: 我要提說耶和華所行的；我要記念你古時的奇事。
verses.e: I will remember the LORD's deeds ; for I will remember your wonders of old .

verses.z: 我也要思想你的經營，默念你的作為。
verses.e: I will also meditate on all your work , and consider your doings .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你的作為是潔淨的；有何神大如上帝呢？
verses.e: Your way , God , is in the sanctuary . What god is great like God ?

verses.z: 你是行奇事的上帝；你曾在列邦中彰顯你的能力。
verses.e: You are the God who does wonders . You have made your strength known among the peoples .

verses.z: 你曾用你的膀臂贖了你的民，就是雅各和約瑟的子孫。（細拉）
verses.e: You have redeemed your people with your arm , the sons of Jacob and Joseph . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝啊，諸水見你，一見就都驚惶；深淵也都戰抖。
verses.e: The waters saw you , God . The waters saw you , and they writhed . The depths also convulsed .

verses.z: 雲中倒出水來；天空發出響聲；你的箭也飛行四方。
verses.e: The clouds poured out water . The skies resounded with thunder . Your arrows also flashed around .

verses.z: 你的雷聲在旋風中；電光照亮世界；大地戰抖震動。
verses.e: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind . The lightnings lit up the world . The earth trembled and shook .

verses.z: 你的道在海中；你的路在大水中；你的腳蹤無人知道。
verses.e: Your way was through the sea , your paths through the great waters . Your footsteps were not known .

verses.z: 我在患難之日尋求主；我在夜間不住地舉手禱告；我的心不肯受安慰。
verses.e: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord . My hand was stretched out in the night , and didn't get tired . My soul refused to be comforted .

verses.z: 你曾藉摩西和亞倫的手引導你的百姓，好像羊群一般。
verses.e: You led your people like a flock , by the hand of Moses and Aaron .

verses.z: 我想念上帝，就煩燥不安；我沉吟悲傷，心便發昏。（細拉）
verses.e: I remember God , and I groan . I complain , and my spirit is overwhelmed . Selah .

verses.z: 你叫我不能閉眼；我煩亂不安，甚至不能說話。
verses.e: You hold my eyelids open . I am so troubled that I can't speak .

verses.z: 我追想古時之日，上古之年。
verses.e: I have considered the days of old , the years of ancient times .

verses.z: 我想起我夜間的歌曲，捫心自問；我心裏也仔細省察。
verses.e: I remember my song in the night . I consider in my own heart ; my spirit diligently inquires :

verses.z: 難道主要永遠丟棄[我]，不再施恩嗎？
verses.e: " Will the Lord reject us forever ? Will he be favorable no more ?

verses.z: 難道他的慈愛永遠窮盡，他的應許世世廢棄嗎？
verses.e: Has his loving kindness vanished forever ? Does his promise fail for generations ?

verses.z: 難道上帝忘記開恩，因發怒就止住他的慈悲嗎？（細拉）
verses.e: Has God forgotten to be gracious ? Has he , in anger , withheld his compassion ? " Selah .

verses.z: 亞薩的訓誨詩。我的民哪，你們要留心聽我的訓誨，側耳聽我口中的話。
verses.e: A contemplation by Asaph . Hear my teaching , my people . Turn your ears to the words of my mouth .

verses.z: 他們不遵守上帝的約，不肯照他的律法行；
verses.e: They didn't keep God's covenant , and refused to walk in his law .

verses.z: 又忘記他所行的和他顯給他們奇妙的作為。
verses.e: They forgot his doings , his wondrous deeds that he had shown them .

verses.z: 他在埃及地，在瑣安田，在他們祖宗的眼前施行奇事。
verses.e: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers , in the land of Egypt , in the field of Zoan .

verses.z: 他將海分裂，使他們過去，又叫水立起如壘。
verses.e: He split the sea , and caused them to pass through . He made the waters stand as a heap .

verses.z: 他白日用雲彩，終夜用火光引導他們。
verses.e: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud , and all night with a light of fire .

verses.z: 他在曠野分裂磐石，多多地給他們水喝，如從深淵而出。
verses.e: He split rocks in the wilderness , and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths .

verses.z: 他使水從磐石湧出，叫水如江河下流。
verses.e: He brought streams also out of the rock , and caused waters to run down like rivers .

verses.z: 他們卻仍舊得罪他，在乾燥之地悖逆至高者。
verses.e: Yet they still went on to sin against him , to rebel against the Most High in the desert .

verses.z: 他們心中試探上帝，隨自己所欲的求食物，
verses.e: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire .

verses.z: 並且妄論上帝說：上帝在曠野豈能擺設筵席嗎？
verses.e: Yes , they spoke against God . They said , " Can God prepare a table in the wilderness ?

verses.z: 我要開口說比喻；我要說出古時的謎語，
verses.e: I will open my mouth in a parable . I will utter dark sayings of old ,

verses.z: 他曾擊打磐石，使水湧出，成了江河；他還能賜糧食嗎？還能為他的百姓預備肉嗎？
verses.e: Behold , he struck the rock , so that waters gushed out , and streams overflowed . Can he give bread also ? Will he provide meat for his people ? "

verses.z: 所以，耶和華聽見就發怒；有烈火向雅各燒起；有怒氣向以色列上騰；
verses.e: Therefore the LORD heard , and was angry . A fire was kindled against Jacob , anger also went up against Israel ,

verses.z: 因為他們不信服上帝，不倚賴他的救恩。
verses.e: because they didn't believe in God , and didn't trust in his salvation .

verses.z: 他卻吩咐天空，又敞開天上的門，
verses.e: Yet he commanded the skies above , and opened the doors of heaven .

verses.z: 降嗎哪，像雨給他們吃，將天上的糧食賜給他們。
verses.e: He rained down manna on them to eat , and gave them food from the sky .

verses.z: 各人吃大能者的食物；他賜下糧食，使他們飽足。
verses.e: Man ate the bread of angels . He sent them food to the full .

verses.z: 他領東風起在天空，又用能力引了南風來。
verses.e: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky . By his power he guided the south wind .

verses.z: 他降肉，像雨在他們當中，多如塵土，又降飛鳥，多如海沙，
verses.e: He also rained meat on them as the dust , winged birds as the sand of the seas .

verses.z: 落在他們的營中，在他們住處的四面。
verses.e: He let them fall in the middle of their camp , around their habitations .

verses.z: 他們吃了，而且飽足；這樣就隨了他們所欲的。
verses.e: So they ate , and were well filled . He gave them their own desire .

verses.z: 是我們所聽見、所知道的，也是我們的祖宗告訴我們的。
verses.e: which we have heard and known , and our fathers have told us .

verses.z: 他們貪而無厭，食物還在他們口中的時候，
verses.e: They didn't turn from their cravings . Their food was yet in their mouths ,

verses.z: 上帝的怒氣就向他們上騰，殺了他們內中的肥壯人，打倒以色列的少年人。
verses.e: when the anger of God went up against them , killed some of their strongest , and struck down the young men of Israel .

verses.z: 雖是這樣，他們仍舊犯罪，不信他奇妙的作為。
verses.e: For all this they still sinned , and didn't believe in his wondrous works .

verses.z: 因此，他叫他們的日子全歸虛空，叫他們的年歲盡屬驚恐。
verses.e: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity , and their years in terror .

verses.z: 他殺他們的時候，他們才求問他，回心轉意，切切地尋求上帝。
verses.e: When he killed them , then they inquired after him . They returned and sought God earnestly .

verses.z: 他們也追念上帝是他們的磐石，至高的上帝是他們的救贖主。
verses.e: They remembered that God was their rock , the Most High God , their redeemer .

verses.z: 他們卻用口諂媚他，用舌向他說謊。
verses.e: But they flattered him with their mouth , and lied to him with their tongue .

verses.z: 因他們的心向他不正，在他的約上也不忠心。
verses.e: For their heart was not right with him , neither were they faithful in his covenant .

verses.z: 但他有憐憫，赦免他們的罪孽，不滅絕他們，而且屢次消他的怒氣，不發盡他的忿怒。
verses.e: But he , being merciful , forgave iniquity , and didn't destroy them . Yes , many times he turned his anger away , and didn't stir up all his wrath .

verses.z: 他想到他們不過是血氣，是一陣去而不返的風。
verses.e: He remembered that they were but flesh , a wind that passes away , and doesn't come again .

verses.z: 我們不將這些事向他們的子孫隱瞞，要將耶和華的美德和他的能力，並他奇妙的作為，述說給後代聽。
verses.e: We will not hide them from their children , telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD , his strength , and his wondrous deeds that he has done .

verses.z: 他們在曠野悖逆他，在荒地叫他擔憂，何其多呢！
verses.e: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness , and grieved him in the desert !

verses.z: 他們再三試探上帝，惹動以色列的聖者。
verses.e: They turned again and tempted God , and provoked the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 他們不追念他的能力和贖他們脫離敵人的日子；
verses.e: They didn't remember his hand , nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary ;

verses.z: 他怎樣在埃及地顯神蹟，在瑣安田顯奇事，
verses.e: how he set his signs in Egypt , his wonders in the field of Zoan ,

verses.z: 把他們的江河並河汊的水都變為血，使他們不能喝。
verses.e: he turned their rivers into blood , and their streams , so that they could not drink .

verses.z: 他叫蒼蠅成群落在他們當中，嘬盡他們，又叫青蛙滅了他們，
verses.e: He sent among them swarms of flies , which devoured them ; and frogs , which destroyed them .

verses.z: 把他們的土產交給螞蚱，把他們辛苦得來的交給蝗蟲。
verses.e: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar , and their labor to the locust .

verses.z: 他降冰雹打壞他們的葡萄樹，下嚴霜打壞他們的桑樹，
verses.e: He destroyed their vines with hail , their sycamore fig trees with frost .

verses.z: 又把他們的牲畜交給冰雹，把他們的群畜交給閃電。
verses.e: He also gave over their livestock to the hail , and their flocks to hot thunderbolts .

verses.z: 他使猛烈的怒氣和忿怒、惱恨、苦難成了一群降災的使者，臨到他們。
verses.e: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger , wrath , indignation , and trouble , and a band of angels of evil .

verses.z: 因為，他在雅各中立法度，在以色列中設律法；是他吩咐我們祖宗要傳給子孫的，
verses.e: For he established a covenant in Jacob , and appointed a teaching in Israel , which he commanded our fathers , that they should make them known to their children ;

verses.z: 他為自己的怒氣修平了路，將他們交給瘟疫，使他們死亡，
verses.e: He made a path for his anger . He didn't spare their soul from death , but gave their life over to the pestilence ,

verses.z: 在埃及擊殺一切長子，在含的帳棚中擊殺他們強壯時頭生的。
verses.e: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt , the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham .

verses.z: 他卻領出自己的民如羊，在曠野引他們如羊群。
verses.e: But he led out his own people like sheep , and guided them in the wilderness like a flock .

verses.z: 他領他們穩穩妥妥地，使他們不致害怕；海卻淹沒他們的仇敵。
verses.e: He led them safely , so that they weren't afraid , but the sea overwhelmed their enemies .

verses.z: 他帶他們到自己聖地的邊界，到他右手所得的這山地。
verses.e: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary , to this mountain , which his right hand had taken .

verses.z: 他在他們面前趕出外邦人，用繩子將外邦的地量給他們為業，叫以色列支派的人住在他們的帳棚裏。
verses.e: He also drove out the nations before them , allotted them for an inheritance by line , and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents .

verses.z: 他們仍舊試探、悖逆至高的上帝，不守他的法度，
verses.e: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God , and didn't keep his testimonies ,

verses.z: 反倒退後，行詭詐，像他們的祖宗一樣；他們改變，如同翻背的弓。
verses.e: but turned back , and dealt treacherously like their fathers . They were twisted like a deceitful bow .

verses.z: 因他們的邱壇惹了他的怒氣；因他們雕刻的偶像觸動他的憤恨。
verses.e: For they provoked him to anger with their high places , and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images .

verses.z: 上帝聽見就發怒，極其憎惡以色列人。
verses.e: When God heard this , he was angry , and greatly abhorred Israel ,

verses.z: 使將要生的後代子孫可以曉得；他們也要起來告訴他們的子孫，
verses.e: that the generation to come might know , even the children who should be born ; who should arise and tell their children ,

verses.z: 甚至他離棄示羅的帳幕，就是他在人間所搭的帳棚；
verses.e: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh , the tent which he placed among men ,

verses.z: 又將他的約櫃交與人擄去，將他的榮耀交在敵人手中；
verses.e: and delivered his strength into captivity , his glory into the adversary's hand .

verses.z: 並將他的百姓交與刀劍，向他的產業發怒。
verses.e: He also gave his people over to the sword , and was angry with his inheritance .

verses.z: 少年人被火燒滅；處女也無喜歌。
verses.e: Fire devoured their young men . Their virgins had no wedding song .

verses.z: 祭司倒在刀下，寡婦卻不哀哭。
verses.e: Their priests fell by the sword , and their widows couldn't weep .

verses.z: 那時，主像世人睡醒，像勇士飲酒呼喊。
verses.e: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep , like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine .

verses.z: 他就打退了他的敵人，叫他們永蒙羞辱；
verses.e: He struck his adversaries backward . He put them to a perpetual reproach .

verses.z: 並且他棄掉約瑟的帳棚，不揀選以法蓮支派，
verses.e: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph , and didn't choose the tribe of Ephraim ,

verses.z: 卻揀選猶大支派－他所喜愛的錫安山；
verses.e: But chose the tribe of Judah , Mount Zion which he loved .

verses.z: 蓋造他的聖所，好像高峰，又像他建立永存之地；
verses.e: He built his sanctuary like the heights , like the earth which he has established forever .

verses.z: 好叫他們仰望上帝，不忘記上帝的作為，惟要守他的命令。
verses.e: that they might set their hope in God , and not forget God's deeds , but keep his commandments ,

verses.z: 又揀選他的僕人大衛，從羊圈中將他召來，
verses.e: He also chose David his servant , and took him from the sheepfolds ;

verses.z: 叫他不再跟從那些帶奶的母羊，為要牧養自己的百姓雅各和自己的產業以色列。
verses.e: from following the ewes that have their young , he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob , his people , and Israel , his inheritance .

verses.z: 於是，他按心中的純正牧養他們，用手中的巧妙引導他們。
verses.e: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart , and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands .

verses.z: 不要像他們的祖宗，是頑梗悖逆、居心不正之輩，向着上帝，心不誠實。
verses.e: and might not be as their fathers — a stubborn and rebellious generation , a generation that didn't make their hearts loyal , whose spirit was not steadfast with God .

verses.z: 以法蓮的子孫帶着兵器，拿着弓，臨陣之日轉身退後。
verses.e: The children of Ephraim , being armed and carrying bows , turned back in the day of battle .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩。上帝啊，外邦人進入你的產業，污穢你的聖殿，使耶路撒冷變成荒堆，
verses.e: A Psalm by Asaph . God , the nations have come into your inheritance . They have defiled your holy temple . They have laid Jerusalem in heaps .

verses.z: 為何容外邦人說「他們的上帝在哪裏」呢？願你使外邦人知道你在我們眼前伸你僕人流血的冤。
verses.e: Why should the nations say , " Where is their God ? " Let it be known among the nations , before our eyes , that vengeance for your servants ' blood is being poured out .

verses.z: 願被囚之人的歎息達到你面前；願你按你的大能力存留那些將要死的人。
verses.e: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you . According to the greatness of your power , preserve those who are sentenced to death .

verses.z: 主啊，願你將我們鄰邦所羞辱你的羞辱加七倍歸到他們身上。
verses.e: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you , Lord .

verses.z: 這樣，你的民，你草場的羊，要稱謝你，直到永遠；要述說讚美你的話，直到萬代。
verses.e: So we , your people and sheep of your pasture , will give you thanks forever . We will praise you forever , to all generations .

verses.z: 把你僕人的屍首交與天空的飛鳥為食，把你聖民的肉交與地上的野獸，
verses.e: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky , the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth .

verses.z: 在耶路撒冷周圍流他們的血如水，無人葬埋。
verses.e: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem . There was no one to bury them .

verses.z: 我們成為鄰國的羞辱，成為我們四圍人的嗤笑譏刺。
verses.e: We have become a reproach to our neighbors , a scoffing and derision to those who are around us .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，這到幾時呢？你要動怒到永遠嗎？你的憤恨要如火焚燒嗎？
verses.e: How long , LORD ? Will you be angry forever ? Will your jealousy burn like fire ?

verses.z: 願你將你的忿怒倒在那不認識你的外邦和那不求告你名的國度。
verses.e: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don't know you , on the kingdoms that don't call on your name ,

verses.z: 因為他們吞了雅各，把他的住處變為荒場。
verses.e: for they have devoured Jacob , and destroyed his homeland .

verses.z: 求你不要記念我們先祖的罪孽，向我們追討；願你的慈悲快迎着我們，因為我們落到極卑微的地步。
verses.e: Don't hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us . Let your tender mercies speedily meet us , for we are in desperate need .

verses.z: 拯救我們的上帝啊，求你因你名的榮耀幫助我們！為你名的緣故搭救我們，赦免我們的罪。
verses.e: Help us , God of our salvation , for the glory of your name . Deliver us , and forgive our sins , for your name's sake .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。耶和華－我們的主啊，你的名在全地何其美！你將你的榮耀彰顯於天。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician ; on an instrument of Gath . A Psalm by David . LORD , our Lord , how majestic is your name in all the earth ! You have set your glory above the heavens !

verses.z: 你因敵人的緣故，從嬰孩和吃奶的口中，建立了能力，使仇敵和報仇的閉口無言。
verses.e: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength , because of your adversaries , that you might silence the enemy and the avenger .

verses.z: 我觀看你指頭所造的天，並你所陳設的月亮星宿，
verses.e: When I consider your heavens , the work of your fingers , the moon and the stars , which you have ordained ,

verses.z: [便說]：人算甚麼，你竟顧念他！世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他！
verses.e: what is man , that you think of him ? What is the son of man , that you care for him ?

verses.z: 你叫他比天使微小一點，並賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕。
verses.e: For you have made him a little lower than the angels , and crowned him with glory and honor .

verses.z: 你派他管理你手所造的，使萬物，就是一切的牛羊、田野的獸、空中的鳥、海裏的魚，凡經行海道的，都服在他的腳下。
verses.e: You make him ruler over the works of your hands . You have put all things under his feet :
All sheep and cattle , yes , and the animals of the field ,
the birds of the sky , the fish of the sea , and whatever passes through the paths of the seas .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的主啊，你的名在全地何其美！
verses.e: LORD , our Lord , how majestic is your name in all the earth !

verses.z: 亞薩的詩，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。領約瑟如領羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心聽！坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你發出光來！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " The Lilies of the Covenant . " A Psalm by Asaph . Hear us , Shepherd of Israel , you who lead Joseph like a flock , you who sit above the cherubim , shine out .

verses.z: 它的影子遮滿了山，枝子好像佳美的香柏樹。
verses.e: The mountains were covered with its shadow . Its boughs were like God's cedars .

verses.z: 它發出枝子，長到大海，發出蔓子，延到大河。
verses.e: It sent out its branches to the sea , its shoots to the River .

verses.z: 你為何拆毀這樹的籬笆，任憑一切過路的人摘取？
verses.e: Why have you broken down its walls , so that all those who pass by the way pluck it ?

verses.z: 林中出來的野豬把它糟踏；野地的走獸拿它當食物。
verses.e: The boar out of the wood ravages it . The wild animals of the field feed on it .

verses.z: 萬軍之上帝啊，求你回轉！從天上垂看，眷顧這葡萄樹，
verses.e: Turn again , we beg you , God of Armies . Look down from heaven , and see , and visit this vine ,

verses.z: 保護你右手所栽的和你為自己所堅固的枝子。
verses.e: the stock which your right hand planted , the branch that you made strong for yourself .

verses.z: 這樹已經被火焚燒，被刀砍伐；他們因你臉上的怒容就滅亡了。
verses.e: It's burned with fire . It's cut down . They perish at your rebuke .

verses.z: 願你的手扶持你右邊的人，就是你為自己所堅固的人子。
verses.e: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand , on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself .

verses.z: 這樣，我們便不退後離開你；求你救活我們，我們就要求告你的名。
verses.e: So we will not turn away from you . Revive us , and we will call on your name .

verses.z: 耶和華－萬軍之上帝啊，求你使我們回轉，使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
verses.e: Turn us again , LORD God of Armies . Cause your face to shine , and we will be saved .

verses.z: 在以法蓮、便雅憫、瑪拿西前面施展你的大能，來救我們。
verses.e: Before Ephraim , Benjamin , and Manasseh , stir up your might ! Come to save us !

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你使我們回轉，使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
verses.e: Turn us again , God . Cause your face to shine , and we will be saved .

verses.z: 耶和華－萬軍之上帝啊，你向你百姓的禱告發怒，要到幾時呢？
verses.e: LORD God of Armies , how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people ?

verses.z: 你以眼淚當食物給他們吃，又多量出眼淚給他們喝。
verses.e: You have fed them with the bread of tears , and given them tears to drink in large measure .

verses.z: 你使鄰邦因我們紛爭；我們的仇敵彼此戲笑。
verses.e: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors . Our enemies laugh among themselves .

verses.z: 萬軍之上帝啊，求你使我們回轉，使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
verses.e: Turn us again , God of Armies . Cause your face to shine , and we will be saved .

verses.z: 你從埃及挪出一棵葡萄樹，趕出外邦人，把這樹栽上。
verses.e: You brought a vine out of Egypt . You drove out the nations , and planted it .

verses.z: 你在這樹根前預備了[地方]，它就深深扎根，爬滿了地。
