verses.e: You cleared the ground for it . It took deep root , and filled the land .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。你們當向上帝－我們的力量大聲歡呼，向雅各的上帝發聲歡樂！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . On an instrument of Gath . By Asaph . Sing aloud to God , our strength ! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob !

verses.z: 我是耶和華－你的上帝，曾把你從埃及地領上來；你要大大張口，我就給你充滿。
verses.e: I am the LORD , your God , who brought you up out of the land of Egypt . Open your mouth wide , and I will fill it .

verses.z: 無奈，我的民不聽我的聲音；以色列全不理我。
verses.e: But my people didn't listen to my voice . Israel desired none of me .

verses.z: 我便任憑他們心裏剛硬，隨自己的計謀而行。
verses.e: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts , that they might walk in their own counsels .

verses.z: 甚願我的民肯聽從我，以色列肯行我的道，
verses.e: Oh that my people would listen to me , that Israel would walk in my ways !

verses.z: 我便速速治服他們的仇敵，反手攻擊他們的敵人。
verses.e: I would soon subdue their enemies , and turn my hand against their adversaries .

verses.z: 恨耶和華的人必來投降，但他的百姓必永久長存。
verses.e: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him , and their punishment would last forever .

verses.z: 他也必拿上好的麥子給他們吃，又拿從磐石出的蜂蜜叫他們飽足。
verses.e: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat . I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock . "

verses.z: 唱起詩歌，打手鼓，彈美琴與瑟。
verses.e: Raise a song , and bring here the tambourine , the pleasant lyre with the harp .

verses.z: 當在月朔並月望－我們過節的日期吹角，
verses.e: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon , at the full moon , on our feast day .

verses.z: 因這是為以色列定的律例，是雅各上帝的典章。
verses.e: For it is a statute for Israel , an ordinance of the God of Jacob .

verses.z: 他去攻擊埃及地的時候，在約瑟中間立此為證。我[在那裏]聽見我所不明白的言語：
verses.e: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant , when he went out over the land of Egypt , I heard a language that I didn't know .

verses.z: [上帝說]：我使你的肩得脫重擔，你的手放下筐子。
verses.e: " I removed his shoulder from the burden . His hands were freed from the basket .

verses.z: 你在急難中呼求，我就搭救你；我在雷的隱密處應允你，在米利巴水那裏試驗你。（細拉）
verses.e: You called in trouble , and I delivered you . I answered you in the secret place of thunder . I tested you at the waters of Meribah . " Selah .

verses.z: 我的民哪，你當聽，我要勸戒你；以色列啊，甚願你肯聽從我。
verses.e: " Hear , my people , and I will testify to you , Israel , if you would listen to me !

verses.z: 在你當中，不可有別的神；外邦的神，你也不可下拜。
verses.e: There shall be no strange god in you , neither shall you worship any foreign god .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩。上帝站在有權力者的會中，在諸神中行審判，
verses.e: A Psalm by Asaph . God presides in the great assembly . He judges among the gods .

verses.z: 說：你們審判不秉公義，徇惡人的情面，要到幾時呢？（細拉）
verses.e: " How long will you judge unjustly , and show partiality to the wicked ? " Selah .

verses.z: 你們當為貧寒的人和孤兒伸冤；當為困苦和窮乏的人施行公義。
verses.e: " Defend the weak , the poor , and the fatherless . Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed .

verses.z: 當保護貧寒和窮乏的人，救他們脫離惡人的手。
verses.e: Rescue the weak and needy . Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked . "

verses.z: 你們仍不知道，也不明白，在黑暗中走來走去；地的根基都搖動了。
verses.e: They don't know , neither do they understand . They walk back and forth in darkness . All the foundations of the earth are shaken .

verses.z: 我曾說：你們是神，都是至高者的兒子。
verses.e: I said , " You are gods , all of you are sons of the Most High .

verses.z: 然而，你們要死，與世人一樣，要仆倒，像王子中的一位。
verses.e: Nevertheless you shall die like men , and fall like one of the rulers . "

verses.z: 上帝啊，求你起來審判世界，因為你要得萬邦為業。
verses.e: Arise , God , judge the earth , for you inherit all of the nations .

verses.z: 亞薩的詩歌。上帝啊，求你不要靜默！上帝啊，求你不要閉口，也不要不作聲！
verses.e: A song . A Psalm by Asaph . God , don't keep silent . Don't keep silent , and don't be still , God .

verses.z: 他們在隱‧多珥滅亡，成了地上的糞土。
verses.e: who perished at Endor , who became as dung for the earth .

verses.z: 求你叫他們的首領像俄立和西伊伯，叫他們的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。
verses.e: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb , yes , all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna ,

verses.z: 他們說：我們要得上帝的住處，作為自己的產業。
verses.e: who said , " Let's take possession of God's pasture lands . "

verses.z: 我的上帝啊，求你叫他們像旋風的塵土，像風前的碎稭。
verses.e: My God , make them like tumbleweed , like chaff before the wind .

verses.z: 火怎樣焚燒樹林，火焰怎樣燒着山嶺，
verses.e: As the fire that burns the forest , as the flame that sets the mountains on fire ,

verses.z: 求你也照樣用狂風追趕他們，用暴雨恐嚇他們。
verses.e: so pursue them with your tempest , and terrify them with your storm .

verses.z: 願你使他們滿面羞恥，好叫他們尋求你－耶和華的名！
verses.e: Fill their faces with confusion , that they may seek your name , LORD .

verses.z: 願他們永遠羞愧驚惶！願他們慚愧滅亡！
verses.e: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever . Yes , let them be confounded and perish ;

verses.z: 使他們知道：惟獨你－名為耶和華的－是全地以上的至高者！
verses.e: that they may know that you alone , whose name is the LORD , are the Most High over all the earth .

verses.z: 因為你的仇敵喧嚷，恨你的抬起頭來。
verses.e: For , behold , your enemies are stirred up . Those who hate you have lifted up their heads .

verses.z: 他們同謀奸詐要害你的百姓，彼此商議要害你所隱藏的人。
verses.e: They conspire with cunning against your people . They plot against your cherished ones .

verses.z: 他們說：來吧，我們將他們剪滅，使他們不再成國！使以色列的名不再被人記念！
verses.e: " Come , " they say , " let's destroy them as a nation , that the name of Israel may be remembered no more . "

verses.z: 他們同心商議，彼此結盟，要抵擋你，
verses.e: For they have conspired together with one mind . They form an alliance against you .

verses.z: 就是住帳棚的以東人和以實瑪利人，摩押和夏甲人，
verses.e: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites ; Moab , and the Hagrites ;

verses.z: 迦巴勒、亞捫，和亞瑪力、非利士並泰爾的居民。
verses.e: Gebal , Ammon , and Amalek ; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre ;

verses.z: 亞述也與他們連合；他們作羅得子孫的幫手。（細拉）
verses.e: Assyria also is joined with them . They have helped the children of Lot . Selah .

verses.z: 求你待他們，如待米甸，如在基順河待西西拉和耶賓一樣。
verses.e: Do to them as you did to Midian , as to Sisera , as to Jabin , at the river Kishon ;

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。萬軍之耶和華啊，你的居所何等可愛！
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . On an instrument of Gath . A Psalm by the sons of Korah . How lovely are your dwellings , LORD of Armies !

verses.z: 在你的院宇住一日，勝似[在別處住]千日；寧可在我上帝殿中看門，不願住在惡人的帳棚裏。
verses.e: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand . I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God , than to dwell in the tents of wickedness .

verses.z: 因為耶和華－上帝是日頭，是盾牌，要賜下恩惠和榮耀。他未嘗留下一樣好處不給那些行動正直的人。
verses.e: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield . The LORD will give grace and glory . He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華啊，倚靠你的人便為有福！
verses.e: LORD of Armies , blessed is the man who trusts in you .

verses.z: 我羨慕渴想耶和華的院宇；我的心腸，我的肉體向永生上帝呼籲。
verses.e: My soul longs , and even faints for the courts of the LORD . My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華－我的王，我的上帝啊，在你祭壇那裏，麻雀為自己找着房屋，燕子為自己找着菢雛之窩。
verses.e: Yes , the sparrow has found a home , and the swallow a nest for herself , where she may have her young , near your altars , LORD of Armies , my King , and my God .

verses.z: 如此住在你殿中的便為有福！他們仍要讚美你。（細拉）
verses.e: Blessed are those who dwell in your house . They are always praising you . Selah .

verses.z: 靠你有力量、心中想往錫安大道的，這人便為有福！
verses.e: Blessed are those whose strength is in you , who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage .

verses.z: 他們經過「流淚谷」，叫這谷變為泉源之地；並有秋雨之福蓋滿了全谷。
verses.e: Passing through the valley of Weeping , they make it a place of springs . Yes , the autumn rain covers it with blessings .

verses.z: 他們行走，力上加力，各人到錫安朝見上帝。
verses.e: They go from strength to strength . Every one of them appears before God in Zion .

verses.z: 耶和華－萬軍之上帝啊，求你聽我的禱告！雅各的上帝啊，求你留心聽！（細拉）
verses.e: LORD , God of Armies , hear my prayer . Listen , God of Jacob . Selah .

verses.z: 上帝啊，你是我們的盾牌；求你垂顧觀看你受膏者的面！
verses.e: Behold , God our shield , look at the face of your anointed .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。耶和華啊，你已經向你的地施恩，救回被擄的雅各。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . A Psalm by the sons of Korah . LORD , you have been favorable to your land . You have restored the fortunes of Jacob .

verses.z: 慈愛和誠實彼此相遇；公義和平安彼此相親。
verses.e: Mercy and truth meet together . Righteousness and peace have kissed each other .

verses.z: 誠實從地而生；公義從天而現。
verses.e: Truth springs out of the earth . Righteousness has looked down from heaven .

verses.z: 耶和華必將好處賜給[我們]；我們的地也要[多]出土產。
verses.e: Yes , the LORD will give that which is good . Our land will yield its increase .

verses.z: 公義要行在他面前，叫他的腳蹤成為[可走的]路。
verses.e: Righteousness goes before him , and prepares the way for his steps .

verses.z: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽，遮蓋了他們一切的過犯。（細拉）
verses.e: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people . You have covered all their sin . Selah .

verses.z: 你收轉了所發的忿怒和你猛烈的怒氣。
verses.e: You have taken away all your wrath . You have turned from the fierceness of your anger .

verses.z: 拯救我們的上帝啊，求你使我們回轉，叫你的惱恨向我們止息。
verses.e: Turn us , God of our salvation , and cause your indignation toward us to cease .

verses.z: 你要向我們發怒到永遠嗎？你要將你的怒氣延留到萬代嗎？
verses.e: Will you be angry with us forever ? Will you draw out your anger to all generations ?

verses.z: 你不再將我們救活，使你的百姓靠你歡喜嗎？
verses.e: Won't you revive us again , that your people may rejoice in you ?

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你使我們得見你的慈愛，又將你的救恩賜給我們。
verses.e: Show us your loving kindness , LORD . Grant us your salvation .

verses.z: 我要聽上帝－耶和華所說的話；因為他必應許將平安賜給他的百姓－他的聖民；他們卻不可再轉去妄行。
verses.e: I will hear what God , the LORD , will speak , for he will speak peace to his people , his saints ; but let them not turn again to folly .

verses.z: 他的救恩誠然與敬畏他的人相近，叫榮耀住在我們的地上。
verses.e: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him , that glory may dwell in our land .

verses.z: 大衛的祈禱。耶和華啊，求你側耳應允我，因我是困苦窮乏的。
verses.e: A Prayer by David . Hear , LORD , and answer me , for I am poor and needy .

verses.z: 因你為大，且行奇妙的事；惟獨你是上帝。
verses.e: For you are great , and do wondrous things . You are God alone .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我；我要照你的真理行；求你使我專心敬畏你的名！
verses.e: Teach me your way , LORD . I will walk in your truth . Make my heart undivided to fear your name .

verses.z: 主－我的上帝啊，我要一心稱讚你；我要榮耀你的名，直到永遠。
verses.e: I will praise you , Lord my God , with my whole heart . I will glorify your name forever more .

verses.z: 因為，你向我發的慈愛是大的；你救了我的靈魂免入極深的陰間。
verses.e: For your loving kindness is great toward me . You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol .

verses.z: 上帝啊，驕傲的人起來攻擊我，又有一黨強橫的人尋索我的命；他們沒有將你放在眼中。
verses.e: God , the proud have risen up against me . A company of violent men have sought after my soul , and they don't hold regard for you before them .

verses.z: 主啊，你是有憐憫有恩典的上帝，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和誠實。
verses.e: But you , Lord , are a merciful and gracious God , slow to anger , and abundant in loving kindness and truth .

verses.z: 求你向我轉臉，憐恤我，將你的力量賜給僕人，救你婢女的兒子。
verses.e: Turn to me , and have mercy on me ! Give your strength to your servant . Save the son of your servant .

verses.z: 求你向我顯出恩待我的憑據，叫恨我的人看見便羞愧，因為你－耶和華幫助我，安慰我。
verses.e: Show me a sign of your goodness , that those who hate me may see it , and be shamed , because you , LORD , have helped me , and comforted me .

verses.z: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔誠人。我的上帝啊，求你拯救這倚靠你的僕人！
verses.e: Preserve my soul , for I am godly . You , my God , save your servant who trusts in you .

verses.z: 主啊，求你憐憫我，因我終日求告你。
verses.e: Be merciful to me , Lord , for I call to you all day long .

verses.z: 主啊，求你使僕人心裏歡喜，因為我的心仰望你。
verses.e: Bring joy to the soul of your servant , for to you , Lord , do I lift up my soul .

verses.z: 主啊，你本為良善，樂意饒恕人，有豐盛的慈愛賜給凡求告你的人。
verses.e: For you , Lord , are good , and ready to forgive , abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，垂聽我懇求的聲音。
verses.e: Hear , LORD , my prayer . Listen to the voice of my petitions .

verses.z: 我在患難之日要求告你，因為你必應允我。
verses.e: In the day of my trouble I will call on you , for you will answer me .

verses.z: 主啊，諸神之中沒有可比你的；你的作為也無可比。
verses.e: There is no one like you among the gods , Lord , nor any deeds like your deeds .

verses.z: 主啊，你所造的萬民都要來敬拜你；他們也要榮耀你的名。
verses.e: All nations you have made will come and worship before you , Lord . They shall glorify your name .

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩歌。耶和華所立的根基在聖山上。
verses.e: A Psalm by the sons of Korah ; a Song . His foundation is in the holy mountains .

verses.z: 他愛錫安的門，勝於愛雅各一切的住處。
verses.e: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob .

verses.z: 上帝的城啊，有榮耀的事乃指着你說的。（細拉）
verses.e: Glorious things are spoken about you , city of God . Selah .

verses.z: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比倫人，是在認識我之中的；看哪，非利士和泰爾並古實人，個個生在那裏。
verses.e: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me . Behold , Philistia , Tyre , and also Ethiopia : " This one was born there . "

verses.z: 論到錫安，必說：這一個、那一個都生在其中，而且至高者必親自堅立這城。
verses.e: Yes , of Zion it will be said , " This one and that one was born in her ; " the Most High himself will establish her .

verses.z: 當耶和華記錄萬民的時候，他要點出這一個生在那裏。（細拉）
verses.e: The LORD will count , when he writes up the peoples , " This one was born there . " Selah .

verses.z: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都[要說]：我的泉源都在你裏面。
verses.e: Those who sing as well as those who dance say , " All my springs are in you . "

verses.z: 可拉後裔的詩歌，就是以斯拉人希幔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉利暗俄。耶和華－拯救我的上帝啊，我晝夜在你面前呼籲。
verses.e: A Song . A Psalm by the sons of Korah . For the Chief Musician . To the tune of " The Suffering of Affliction . " A contemplation by Heman , the Ezrahite . LORD , the God of my salvation , I have cried day and night before you .

verses.z: 你豈要行奇事給死人看嗎？難道陰魂還能起來稱讚你嗎？（細拉）
verses.e: Do you show wonders to the dead ? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you ? Selah .

verses.z: 豈能在墳墓裏述說你的慈愛嗎？豈能在滅亡中述說你的信實嗎？
verses.e: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave ? Or your faithfulness in Destruction ?

verses.z: 你的奇事豈能在幽暗裏被知道嗎？你的公義豈能在忘記之地被知道嗎？
verses.e: Are your wonders made known in the dark ? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness ?

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我呼求你；我早晨的禱告要達到你面前。
verses.e: But to you , LORD , I have cried . In the morning , my prayer comes before you .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你為何丟棄我？為何掩面不顧我？
verses.e: LORD , why do you reject my soul ? Why do you hide your face from me ?

verses.z: 我自幼受苦，幾乎死亡；我受你的驚恐，甚至慌張。
verses.e: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up . While I suffer your terrors , I am distracted .

verses.z: 你的烈怒漫過我身；你的驚嚇把我剪除。
verses.e: Your fierce wrath has gone over me . Your terrors have cut me off .

verses.z: 這些終日如水環繞我，一齊都來圍困我。
verses.e: They came around me like water all day long . They completely engulfed me .

verses.z: 你把我的良朋密友隔在遠處，使我所認識的人進入黑暗裏。
verses.e: You have put lover and friend far from me , and my friends into darkness .

verses.z: 願我的禱告達到你面前；求你側耳聽我的呼求！
verses.e: Let my prayer enter into your presence . Turn your ear to my cry .

verses.z: 因為我心裏滿了患難；我的性命臨近陰間。
verses.e: For my soul is full of troubles . My life draws near to Sheol .

verses.z: 我算和下坑的人同列，如同無力的人一樣。
verses.e: I am counted among those who go down into the pit . I am like a man who has no help ,

verses.z: 我被丟在死人中，好像被殺的人躺在墳墓裏。他們是你不再記念的，與你隔絕了。
verses.e: set apart among the dead , like the slain who lie in the grave , whom you remember no more . They are cut off from your hand .

verses.z: 你把我放在極深的坑裏，在黑暗地方，在深處。
verses.e: You have laid me in the lowest pit , in the darkest depths .

verses.z: 你的忿怒重壓我身；你用一切的波浪困住我。（細拉）
verses.e: Your wrath lies heavily on me . You have afflicted me with all your waves . Selah .

verses.z: 你把我所認識的隔在遠處，使我為他們所憎惡；我被拘困，不得出來。
verses.e: You have taken my friends from me . You have made me an abomination to them . I am confined , and I can't escape .

verses.z: 我的眼睛因困苦而乾癟。耶和華啊，我天天求告你，向你舉手。
verses.e: My eyes are dim from grief . I have called on you daily , LORD . I have spread out my hands to you .

verses.z: 以斯拉人以探的訓誨詩。我要歌唱耶和華的慈愛，直到永遠；我要用口將你的信實傳與萬代。
verses.e: A contemplation by Ethan , the Ezrahite . I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever . With my mouth , I will make known your faithfulness to all generations .

verses.z: 你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已殺的人；你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敵。
verses.e: You have broken Rahab in pieces , like one of the slain . You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm .

verses.z: 天屬你，地也屬你；世界和其中所充滿的都為你所建立。
verses.e: The heavens are yours . The earth also is yours , the world and its fullness . You have founded them .

verses.z: 南北為你所創造；他泊和黑門都因你的名歡呼。
verses.e: You have created the north and the south . Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name .

verses.z: 你有大能的膀臂；你的手有力，你的右手也高舉。
verses.e: You have a mighty arm . Your hand is strong , and your right hand is exalted .

verses.z: 公義和公平是你寶座的根基；慈愛和誠實行在你前面。
verses.e: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne . Loving kindness and truth go before your face .

verses.z: 知道[向你]歡呼的，那民是有福的！耶和華啊，他們在你臉上的光裏行走。
verses.e: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you . They walk in the light of your presence , LORD .

verses.z: 他們因你的名終日歡樂，因你的公義得以高舉。
verses.e: In your name they rejoice all day . In your righteousness , they are exalted .

verses.z: 你是他們力量的榮耀；因為你喜悅我們，我們的角必被高舉。
verses.e: For you are the glory of their strength . In your favor , our horn will be exalted .

verses.z: 我們的盾牌屬耶和華；我們的王屬以色列的聖者。
verses.e: For our shield belongs to the LORD , our king to the Holy One of Israel .

verses.z: 當時，你在異象中曉諭你的聖民，說：我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上；我高舉那從民中所揀選的。
verses.e: Then you spoke in vision to your saints , and said , " I have given strength to the warrior . I have exalted a young man from the people .

verses.z: 因我曾說：[你的]慈悲必建立到永遠；你的信實必堅立在天上。
verses.e: I indeed declare , " Love stands firm forever . You established the heavens . Your faithfulness is in them . "

verses.z: 我尋得我的僕人大衛，用我的聖膏膏他。
verses.e: I have found David , my servant . I have anointed him with my holy oil ,

verses.z: 我的手必使他堅立；我的膀臂也必堅固他。
verses.e: with whom my hand shall be established . My arm will also strengthen him .

verses.z: 仇敵必不勒索他；凶惡之子也不苦害他。
verses.e: No enemy will tax him . No wicked man will oppress him .

verses.z: 我要在他面前打碎他的敵人，擊殺那恨他的人。
verses.e: I will beat down his adversaries before him , and strike those who hate him .

verses.z: 只是我的信實和我的慈愛要與他同在；因我的名，他的角必被高舉。
verses.e: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him . In my name , his horn will be exalted .

verses.z: 我要使他的[左]手伸到海上，右手伸到河上。
verses.e: I will set his hand also on the sea , and his right hand on the rivers .

verses.z: 他要稱呼我說：你是我的父，是我的上帝，是拯救我的磐石。
verses.e: He will call to me , ' You are my Father , my God , and the rock of my salvation ! '

verses.z: 我也要立他為長子，為世上最高的君王。
verses.e: I will also appoint him my firstborn , the highest of the kings of the earth .

verses.z: 我要為他存留我的慈愛，直到永遠；我與他立的約必要堅定。
verses.e: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more . My covenant will stand firm with him .

verses.z: 我也要使他的後裔存到永遠，使他的寶座如天之久。
verses.e: I will also make his offspring endure forever , and his throne as the days of heaven .

verses.z: 我與我所揀選的人立了約，向我的僕人大衛起了誓：
verses.e: " I have made a covenant with my chosen one , I have sworn to David , my servant ,

verses.z: 倘若他的子孫離棄我的律法，不照我的典章行，
verses.e: If his children forsake my law , and don't walk in my ordinances ;

verses.z: 背棄我的律例，不遵守我的誡命，
verses.e: if they break my statutes , and don't keep my commandments ;

verses.z: 我就要用杖責罰他們的過犯，用鞭責罰他們的罪孽。
verses.e: then I will punish their sin with the rod , and their iniquity with stripes .

verses.z: 只是我必不將我的慈愛全然收回，也必不叫我的信實廢棄。
verses.e: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him , nor allow my faithfulness to fail .

verses.z: 我必不背棄我的約，也不改變我口中所出的。
verses.e: I will not break my covenant , nor alter what my lips have uttered .

verses.z: 我一次指着自己的聖潔起誓：我決不向大衛說謊！
verses.e: Once I have sworn by my holiness , I will not lie to David .

verses.z: 他的後裔要存到永遠；他的寶座在我面前如日之恆一般，
verses.e: His offspring will endure forever , his throne like the sun before me .

verses.z: 又如月亮永遠堅立，如天上確實的見證。（細拉）
verses.e: It will be established forever like the moon , the faithful witness in the sky . " Selah .

verses.z: 但你惱怒你的受膏者，就丟掉棄絕他。
verses.e: But you have rejected and spurned . You have been angry with your anointed .

verses.z: 你厭惡了與僕人所立的約，將他的冠冕踐踏於地。
verses.e: You have renounced the covenant of your servant . You have defiled his crown in the dust .

verses.z: 我要建立你的後裔，直到永遠；要建立你的寶座，直到萬代。（細拉）
verses.e: ' I will establish your offspring forever , and build up your throne to all generations . ' " Selah .

verses.z: 你拆毀了他一切的籬笆，使他的保障變為荒場。
verses.e: You have broken down all his hedges . You have brought his strongholds to ruin .

verses.z: 凡過路的人都搶奪他；他成為鄰邦的羞辱。
verses.e: All who pass by the way rob him . He has become a reproach to his neighbors .

verses.z: 你高舉了他敵人的右手；你叫他一切的仇敵歡喜。
verses.e: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries . You have made all of his enemies rejoice .

verses.z: 你叫他的刀劍捲刃，叫他在爭戰之中站立不住。
verses.e: Yes , you turn back the edge of his sword , and haven't supported him in battle .

verses.z: 你使他的光輝止息，將他的寶座推倒於地。
verses.e: You have ended his splendor , and thrown his throne down to the ground .

verses.z: 你減少他青年的日子，又使他蒙羞。（細拉）
verses.e: You have shortened the days of his youth . You have covered him with shame . Selah .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，這要到幾時呢？你要將自己隱藏到永遠嗎？你的忿怒如火焚燒要到幾時呢？
verses.e: How long , LORD ? Will you hide yourself forever ? Will your wrath burn like fire ?

verses.z: 求你想念我的時候是何等的短少；你創造世人，要使他們歸何等的虛空呢？
verses.e: Remember how short my time is , for what vanity you have created all the children of men !

verses.z: 誰能常活免死、救他的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄呢？（細拉）
verses.e: What man is he who shall live and not see death , who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol ? Selah .

verses.z: 主啊，你從前憑你的信實向大衛立誓要施行的慈愛在哪裏呢？
verses.e: Lord , where are your former loving kindnesses , which you swore to David in your faithfulness ?

verses.z: 耶和華啊，諸天要稱讚你的奇事；在聖者的會中，要稱讚你的信實。
verses.e: The heavens will praise your wonders , LORD , your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones .

verses.z: 主啊，求你記念僕人們所受的羞辱，記念我怎樣將一切強盛民的[羞辱]存在我懷裏。
verses.e: Remember , Lord , the reproach of your servants , how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples ,

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵用這羞辱羞辱了你的僕人，羞辱了你受膏者的腳蹤。
verses.e: With which your enemies have mocked , LORD , with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one .

verses.z: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
verses.e: Blessed be the LORD forever more . Amen , and Amen .

verses.z: 在天空誰能比耶和華呢？神的眾子中，誰能像耶和華呢？
verses.e: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD ? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD ,

verses.z: 他在聖者的會中，是大有威嚴的上帝，比一切在他四圍的更可畏懼。
verses.e: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones , to be feared above all those who are around him ?

verses.z: 耶和華－萬軍之上帝啊，哪一個大能者像你耶和華？你的信實是在你的四圍。
verses.e: LORD , God of Armies , who is a mighty one , like you ? LORD , your faithfulness is around you .

verses.z: 你管轄海的狂傲；波浪翻騰，你就使它平靜了。
verses.e: You rule the pride of the sea . When its waves rise up , you calm them .

verses.z: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用慕拉便。我要一心稱謝耶和華；我要傳揚你一切奇妙的作為。
verses.e: For the Chief Musician . Set to " The Death of the Son . " A Psalm by David . I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart . I will tell of all your marvelous works .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，認識你名的人要倚靠你，因你沒有離棄尋求你的人。
verses.e: Those who know your name will put their trust in you , for you , LORD , have not forsaken those who seek you .

verses.z: 應當歌頌居錫安的耶和華，將他所行的傳揚在眾民中。
verses.e: Sing praises to the LORD , who dwells in Zion , and declare among the people what he has done .

verses.z: 因為那追討流人血之罪的－他記念受屈的人，不忘記困苦人的哀求。
verses.e: For he who avenges blood remembers them . He doesn't forget the cry of the afflicted .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是從死門把我提拔起來的；求你憐恤我，看那恨我的人所加給我的苦難，
verses.e: Have mercy on me , LORD . See my affliction by those who hate me , and lift me up from the gates of death ,

verses.z: 好叫我述說你一切的美德；我必在錫安城的門因你的救恩歡樂。
verses.e: that I may show all of your praise . I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion .

verses.z: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中；他們的腳在自己暗設的網羅裏纏住了。
verses.e: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made . In the net which they hid , their own foot is taken .

verses.z: 耶和華已將自己顯明了，他已施行審判；惡人被自己手所做的纏住了。（細拉）
verses.e: The LORD has made himself known . He has executed judgment . The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands . Meditation . Selah .

verses.z: 惡人，就是忘記上帝的外邦人，都必歸到陰間。
verses.e: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol , even all the nations that forget God .

verses.z: 窮乏人必不永久被忘；困苦人的指望必不永遠落空。
verses.e: For the needy shall not always be forgotten , nor the hope of the poor perish forever .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你起來，不容人得勝！願外邦人在你面前受審判！
verses.e: Arise , LORD ! Don't let man prevail . Let the nations be judged in your sight .

verses.z: 我要因你歡喜快樂；至高者啊，我要歌頌你的名！
verses.e: I will be glad and rejoice in you . I will sing praise to your name , O Most High .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，求你使外邦人恐懼；願他們知道自己不過是人。（細拉）
verses.e: Put them in fear , LORD . Let the nations know that they are only men . Selah .

verses.z: 我的仇敵轉身退去的時候，他們一見你的面就跌倒滅亡。
verses.e: When my enemies turn back , they stumble and perish in your presence .

verses.z: 因你已經為我伸冤，為我辨屈；你坐在寶座上，按公義審判。
verses.e: For you have maintained my just cause . You sit on the throne judging righteously .

verses.z: 你曾斥責外邦，你曾滅絕惡人；你曾塗抹他們的名，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: You have rebuked the nations . You have destroyed the wicked . You have blotted out their name forever and ever .

verses.z: 仇敵到了盡頭；他們被毀壞，直到永遠。你拆毀他們的城邑，連他們的名號都歸於無有。
verses.e: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin . The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished .

verses.z: 惟耶和華坐着[為王]，直到永遠；他已經為審判設擺他的寶座。
verses.e: But the LORD reigns forever . He has prepared his throne for judgment .

verses.z: 他要按公義審判世界，按正直判斷萬民。
verses.e: He will judge the world in righteousness . He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness .

verses.z: 耶和華又要給受欺壓的人作高臺，在患難的時候作高臺。
verses.e: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed ; a high tower in times of trouble .

verses.z: 神人摩西的祈禱。主啊，你世世代代作我們的居所。
verses.e: A Prayer by Moses , the man of God . Lord , you have been our dwelling place for all generations .

verses.z: 我們一生的年日是七十歲，若是強壯可到八十歲；但其中所矜誇的不過是勞苦愁煩，轉眼成空，我們便如飛而去。
verses.e: The days of our years are seventy , or even by reason of strength eighty years ; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow , for it passes quickly , and we fly away .

verses.z: 誰曉得你怒氣的權勢？誰按着你該受的敬畏曉得你的忿怒呢？
verses.e: Who knows the power of your anger , your wrath according to the fear that is due to you ?

verses.z: 求你指教我們怎樣數算自己的日子，好叫我們得着智慧的心。
verses.e: So teach us to count our days , that we may gain a heart of wisdom .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，我們要等到幾時呢？求你轉回，為你的僕人後悔。
verses.e: Relent , LORD ! How long ? Have compassion on your servants !

verses.z: 求你使我們早早飽得你的慈愛，好叫我們一生一世歡呼喜樂。
verses.e: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness , that we may rejoice and be glad all our days .

verses.z: 求你照着你使我們受苦的日子，和我們遭難的年歲，叫我們喜樂。
verses.e: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us , for as many years as we have seen evil .

verses.z: 願你的作為向你僕人顯現；願你的榮耀向他們子孫顯明。
verses.e: Let your work appear to your servants , your glory to their children .

verses.z: 願主－我們上帝的榮美歸於我們身上。願你堅立我們手所做的工；我們手所做的工，願你堅立。
verses.e: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us . Establish the work of our hands for us . Yes , establish the work of our hands .

verses.z: 諸山未曾生出，地與世界你未曾造成，從亙古到永遠，你是上帝。
verses.e: Before the mountains were born , before you had formed the earth and the world , even from everlasting to everlasting , you are God .

verses.z: 你使人歸於塵土，說：你們世人要歸回。
verses.e: You turn man to destruction , saying , " Return , you children of men . "

verses.z: 在你看來，千年如已過的昨日，又如夜間的一更。
verses.e: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past , like a watch in the night .

verses.z: 你叫他們如水沖去；他們如睡一覺。早晨，他們如生長的草，
verses.e: You sweep them away as they sleep . In the morning they sprout like new grass .

verses.z: 早晨發芽生長，晚上割下枯乾。
verses.e: In the morning it sprouts and springs up . By evening , it is withered and dry .

verses.z: 我們因你的怒氣而消滅，因你的忿怒而驚惶。
verses.e: For we are consumed in your anger . We are troubled in your wrath .

verses.z: 你將我們的罪孽擺在你面前，將我們的隱惡擺在你面光之中。
verses.e: You have set our iniquities before you , our secret sins in the light of your presence .

verses.z: 我們經過的日子都在你震怒之下；我們度盡的年歲好像一聲歎息。
verses.e: For all our days have passed away in your wrath . We bring our years to an end as a sigh .

verses.z: 住在至高者隱密處的，必住在全能者的蔭下。
verses.e: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty .

verses.z: 禍患必不臨到你，災害也不挨近你的帳棚。
verses.e: no evil shall happen to you , neither shall any plague come near your dwelling .

verses.z: 因他要為你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保護你。
verses.e: For he will put his angels in charge of you , to guard you in all your ways .

verses.z: 他們要用手托着你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。
verses.e: They will bear you up in their hands , so that you won't dash your foot against a stone .

verses.z: 你要踹在獅子和虺蛇的身上，踐踏少壯獅子和大蛇。
verses.e: You will tread on the lion and cobra . You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot .

verses.z: 上帝[說]：因為他專心愛我，我就要搭救他；因為他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高處。
verses.e: " Because he has set his love on me , therefore I will deliver him . I will set him on high , because he has known my name .

verses.z: 他若求告我，我就應允他；他在急難中，我要與他同在；我要搭救他，使他尊貴。
verses.e: He will call on me , and I will answer him . I will be with him in trouble . I will deliver him , and honor him .

verses.z: 我要使他足享長壽，將我的救恩顯明給他。
verses.e: I will satisfy him with long life , and show him my salvation . "

verses.z: 我要論到耶和華說：他是我的避難所，是我的山寨，是我的上帝，是我所倚靠的。
verses.e: I will say of the LORD , " He is my refuge and my fortress ; my God , in whom I trust . "

verses.z: 他必救你脫離捕鳥人的網羅和毒害的瘟疫。
verses.e: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler , and from the deadly pestilence .

verses.z: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你；你要投靠在他的翅膀底下；他的誠實是大小的盾牌。
verses.e: He will cover you with his feathers . Under his wings you will take refuge . His faithfulness is your shield and rampart .

verses.z: 你必不怕黑夜的驚駭，或是白日飛的箭，
verses.e: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night , nor of the arrow that flies by day ,

verses.z: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫，或是午間滅人的毒病。
verses.e: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness , nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday .

verses.z: 雖有千人仆倒在你旁邊，萬人仆倒在你右邊，這災卻不得臨近你。
verses.e: A thousand may fall at your side , and ten thousand at your right hand ; but it will not come near you .

verses.z: 你惟親眼觀看，見惡人遭報。
verses.e: You will only look with your eyes , and see the recompense of the wicked .

verses.z: 耶和華是我的避難所；你已將至高者當你的居所，
verses.e: Because you have made the LORD your refuge , and the Most High your dwelling place ,

verses.z: 安息日的詩歌。稱謝耶和華！歌頌你至高者的名！
verses.e: A Psalm . A song for the Sabbath day . It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD , to sing praises to your name , Most High ,

verses.z: 你卻高舉了我的角，如野牛的角；我是被新油膏了的。
verses.e: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox . I am anointed with fresh oil .

verses.z: 我眼睛看見仇敵[遭報]；我耳朵聽見那些起來攻擊我的惡人[受罰]。
verses.e: My eye has also seen my enemies . My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me .

verses.z: 義人要發旺如棕樹，生長如黎巴嫩的香柏樹。
verses.e: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree . He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon .

verses.z: 他們栽於耶和華的殿中，發旺在我們上帝的院裏。
verses.e: They are planted in the LORD's house . They will flourish in our God's courts .

verses.z: 他們年老的時候仍要結果子，要滿了汁漿而常發青，
verses.e: They will still produce fruit in old age . They will be full of sap and green ,

verses.z: 好顯明耶和華是正直的。他是我的磐石，在他毫無不義。
verses.e: to show that the LORD is upright . He is my rock , and there is no unrighteousness in him .

verses.z: 用十弦的樂器和瑟，用琴彈幽雅的聲音，早晨傳揚你的慈愛；每夜傳揚你的信實。這本為美事。
verses.e: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning , and your faithfulness every night ,
with the ten-stringed lute , with the harp , and with the melody of the lyre .

verses.z: 因你－耶和華藉着你的作為叫我高興，我要因你手的工作歡呼。
verses.e: For you , LORD , have made me glad through your work . I will triumph in the works of your hands .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的工作何其大！你的心思極其深！
verses.e: How great are your works , LORD ! Your thoughts are very deep .

verses.z: 畜類人不曉得；愚頑人也不明白。
verses.e: A senseless man doesn't know , neither does a fool understand this :

verses.z: 惡人茂盛如草，一切作孽之人發旺的時候，正是他們要滅亡，直到永遠。
verses.e: though the wicked spring up as the grass , and all the evildoers flourish , they will be destroyed forever .

verses.z: 惟你－耶和華是至高，直到永遠。
verses.e: But you , LORD , are on high forever more .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵都要滅亡；一切作孽的也要離散。
verses.e: For behold , your enemies , LORD , for behold , your enemies shall perish . All the evildoers will be scattered .

verses.z: 耶和華作王！他以威嚴為衣穿上；耶和華以能力為衣，以能力束腰，世界就堅定，不得動搖。
verses.e: The LORD reigns ! He is clothed with majesty ! The LORD is armed with strength . The world also is established . It can't be moved .

verses.z: 你的寶座從太初立定；你從亙古就有。
verses.e: Your throne is established from long ago . You are from everlasting .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，大水揚起，大水發聲，波浪澎湃。
verses.e: The floods have lifted up , LORD , the floods have lifted up their voice . The floods lift up their waves .

verses.z: 耶和華在高處大有能力，勝過諸水的響聲，洋海的大浪。
verses.e: Above the voices of many waters , the mighty breakers of the sea , the LORD on high is mighty .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你的法度最的確；你的殿永稱為聖，是合宜的。
verses.e: Your statutes stand firm . Holiness adorns your house , LORD , forever more .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你是伸冤的上帝；伸冤的上帝啊，求你發出光來！
verses.e: LORD , you God to whom vengeance belongs , you God to whom vengeance belongs , shine out .

verses.z: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知識的，難道自己不懲治人嗎？
verses.e: He who disciplines the nations , won't he punish ? He who teaches man knows .

verses.z: 耶和華知道人的意念是虛妄的。
verses.e: The LORD knows the thoughts of man , that they are futile .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，你所管教、用律法所教訓的人是有福的！
verses.e: Blessed is the man whom you discipline , LORD , and teach out of your law ,

verses.z: 你使他在遭難的日子得享平安；惟有惡人陷在所挖的坑中。
verses.e: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity , until the pit is dug for the wicked .

verses.z: 因為耶和華必不丟棄他的百姓，也不離棄他的產業。
verses.e: For the LORD won't reject his people , neither will he forsake his inheritance .

verses.z: 審判要轉向公義；心裏正直的，必都隨從。
verses.e: For judgment will return to righteousness . All the upright in heart shall follow it .

verses.z: 誰肯為我起來攻擊作惡的？誰肯為我站起抵擋作孽的？
verses.e: Who will rise up for me against the wicked ? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers ?

verses.z: 若不是耶和華幫助我，我就住在寂靜之中了。
verses.e: Unless the LORD had been my help , my soul would have soon lived in silence .

verses.z: 我正說我失了腳，耶和華啊，那時你的慈愛扶助我。
verses.e: When I said , " My foot is slipping ! " Your loving kindness , LORD , held me up .

verses.z: 我心裏多憂多疑，你安慰我，就使我歡樂。
verses.e: In the multitude of my thoughts within me , your comforts delight my soul .

verses.z: 審判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立，使驕傲人受應得的報應！
verses.e: Rise up , you judge of the earth . Pay back the proud what they deserve .

verses.z: 那藉着律例架弄殘害、在位上行奸惡的，豈能與你相交嗎？
verses.e: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you , which brings about mischief by statute ?

verses.z: 他們大家聚集攻擊義人，將無辜的人定為死罪。
verses.e: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .

verses.z: 但耶和華向來作了我的高臺；我的上帝作了我投靠的磐石。
verses.e: But the LORD has been my high tower , my God , the rock of my refuge .

verses.z: 他叫他們的罪孽歸到他們身上。他們正在行惡之中，他要剪除他們；耶和華－我們的上帝要把他們剪除。
verses.e: He has brought on them their own iniquity , and will cut them off in their own wickedness . The LORD , our God , will cut them off .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，惡人誇勝要到幾時呢？要到幾時呢？
verses.e: LORD , how long will the wicked , how long will the wicked triumph ?

verses.z: 他們絮絮叨叨說傲慢的話；一切作孽的人都自己誇張。
verses.e: They pour out arrogant words . All the evildoers boast .

verses.z: 耶和華啊，他們強壓你的百姓，苦害你的產業。
verses.e: They break your people in pieces , LORD , and afflict your heritage .

verses.z: 他們殺死寡婦和寄居的，又殺害孤兒。
verses.e: They kill the widow and the alien , and murder the fatherless .

verses.z: 他們說：耶和華必不看見；雅各的上帝必不思念。
verses.e: They say , " The LORD will not see , neither will Jacob's God consider . "

verses.z: 你們民間的畜類人當思想；你們愚頑人到幾時才有智慧呢？
verses.e: Consider , you senseless among the people ; you fools , when will you be wise ?

verses.z: 造耳朵的，難道自己不聽見嗎？造眼睛的，難道自己不看見嗎？
verses.e: He who implanted the ear , won't he hear ? He who formed the eye , won't he see ?

verses.z: 來啊，我們要向耶和華歌唱，向拯救我們的磐石歡呼！
verses.e: Oh come , let's sing to the LORD . Let's shout aloud to the rock of our salvation !

verses.z: 四十年之久，我厭煩那世代，說：這是心裏迷糊的百姓，竟不曉得我的作為！
verses.e: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation , and said , " They are a people who err in their heart . They have not known my ways . "

verses.z: 所以，我在怒中起誓，說：他們斷不可進入我的安息！
verses.e: Therefore I swore in my wrath , " They won't enter into my rest . "

verses.z: 我們要來感謝他，用詩歌向他歡呼！
verses.e: Let's come before his presence with thanksgiving . Let's extol him with songs !

verses.z: 因耶和華為大上帝，為大王，超乎萬神之上。
verses.e: For the LORD is a great God , a great King above all gods .

verses.z: 地的深處在他手中；山的高峰也屬他。
verses.e: In his hand are the deep places of the earth . The heights of the mountains are also his .

verses.z: 海洋屬他，是他造的；旱地也是他手造成的。
verses.e: The sea is his , and he made it . His hands formed the dry land .

verses.z: 來啊，我們要屈身敬拜，在造我們的耶和華面前跪下。
verses.e: Oh come , let's worship and bow down . Let's kneel before the LORD , our Maker ,

verses.z: 因為他是我們的上帝；我們是他草場的羊，是他手下的民。惟願你們今天聽他的話：
verses.e: for he is our God . We are the people of his pasture , and the sheep in his care . Today , oh that you would hear his voice !

verses.z: 你們不可硬着心，像當日在米利巴，就是在曠野的瑪撒。
verses.e: Don't harden your heart , as at Meribah , as in the day of Massah in the wilderness ,

verses.z: 那時，你們的祖宗試我探我，並且觀看我的作為。
verses.e: when your fathers tempted me , tested me , and saw my work .

verses.z: 你們要向耶和華唱新歌！全地都要向耶和華歌唱！
verses.e: Sing to the LORD a new song ! Sing to the LORD , all the earth .

verses.z: 人在列邦中要說：耶和華作王！世界就堅定，不得動搖；他要按公正審判眾民。
verses.e: Say among the nations , " The LORD reigns . " The world is also established . It can't be moved . He will judge the peoples with equity .

verses.z: 願天歡喜，願地快樂！願海和其中所充滿的澎湃！
verses.e: Let the heavens be glad , and let the earth rejoice . Let the sea roar , and its fullness !

verses.z: 願田和其中所有的都歡樂！那時，林中的樹木都要在耶和華面前歡呼。
verses.e: Let the field and all that is in it exult ! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

verses.z: 因為他來了，他來要審判全地。他要按公義審判世界，按他的信實審判萬民。
verses.e: before the LORD ; for he comes , for he comes to judge the earth . He will judge the world with righteousness , the peoples with his truth .

verses.z: 要向耶和華歌唱，稱頌他的名！天天傳揚他的救恩！
verses.e: Sing to the LORD ! Bless his name ! Proclaim his salvation from day to day !

verses.z: 在列邦中述說他的榮耀！在萬民中述說他的奇事！
verses.e: Declare his glory among the nations , his marvelous works among all the peoples .

verses.z: 因耶和華為大，當受極大的讚美；他在萬神之上，當受敬畏。
verses.e: For the LORD is great , and greatly to be praised ! He is to be feared above all gods .

verses.z: 外邦的神都屬虛無；惟獨耶和華創造諸天。
verses.e: For all the gods of the peoples are idols , but the LORD made the heavens .

verses.z: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前；有能力與華美在他聖所。
verses.e: Honor and majesty are before him . Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary .

verses.z: 民中的萬族啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華，都歸給耶和華！
verses.e: Ascribe to the LORD , you families of nations , ascribe to the LORD glory and strength .

verses.z: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他，拿供物來進入他的院宇。
verses.e: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name . Bring an offering , and come into his courts .

verses.z: 當以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華；全地要在他面前戰抖！
verses.e: Worship the LORD in holy array . Tremble before him , all the earth .

verses.z: 耶和華作王！願地快樂！願眾海島歡喜！
verses.e: The LORD reigns ! Let the earth rejoice ! Let the multitude of islands be glad !

verses.z: 你們愛耶和華的，都當恨惡罪惡；他保護聖民的性命，搭救他們脫離惡人的手。
verses.e: You who love the LORD , hate evil ! He preserves the souls of his saints . He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked .

verses.z: 散布亮光是為義人；預備喜樂是為正直人。
verses.e: Light is sown for the righteous , and gladness for the upright in heart .

verses.z: 你們義人當靠耶和華歡喜，稱謝他可記念的聖[名]。
verses.e: Be glad in the LORD , you righteous people ! Give thanks to his holy Name .

verses.z: 密雲和幽暗在他的四圍；公義和公平是他寶座的根基。
verses.e: Clouds and darkness are around him . Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne .

verses.z: 有烈火在他前頭行，燒滅他四圍的敵人。
verses.e: A fire goes before him , and burns up his adversaries on every side .

verses.z: 他的閃電光照世界，大地看見便震動。
verses.e: His lightning lights up the world . The earth sees , and trembles .

verses.z: 諸山見耶和華的面，就是全地之主的面，便消化如蠟。
verses.e: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD , at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth .

verses.z: 諸天表明他的公義；萬民看見他的榮耀。
verses.e: The heavens declare his righteousness . All the peoples have seen his glory .

verses.z: 願一切事奉雕刻的偶像、靠虛無[之神]自誇的，都蒙羞愧。萬神哪，你們都當拜他。
verses.e: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images , who boast in their idols . Worship him , all you gods !

verses.z: 耶和華啊，錫安聽見你的判斷就歡喜；猶大的城邑也都快樂。
verses.e: Zion heard and was glad . The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments , LORD .

verses.z: 因為你－耶和華至高，超乎全地；你被尊崇，遠超萬神之上。
verses.e: For you , LORD , are most high above all the earth . You are exalted far above all gods .

verses.z: 一篇詩。你們要向耶和華唱新歌！因為他行過奇妙的事；他的右手和聖臂施行救恩。
verses.e: A Psalm . Sing to the LORD a new song , for he has done marvelous things ! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him .

verses.z: 耶和華發明了他的救恩，在列邦人眼前顯出公義；
verses.e: The LORD has made known his salvation . He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations .

verses.z: 記念他向以色列家所發的慈愛，所憑的信實。地的四極都看見我們上帝的救恩。
verses.e: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel . All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God .

verses.z: 全地都要向耶和華歡樂；要發起大聲，歡呼歌頌！
verses.e: Make a joyful noise to the LORD , all the earth ! Burst out and sing for joy , yes , sing praises !

verses.z: 要用琴歌頌耶和華，用琴和詩歌的聲音歌頌他！
verses.e: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp , with the harp and the voice of melody .

verses.z: 用號和角聲，在大君王耶和華面前歡呼！
verses.e: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn , make a joyful noise before the King , the LORD .

verses.z: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃；世界和住在其間的也要發聲。
verses.e: Let the sea roar with its fullness ; the world , and those who dwell therein .

verses.z: 願大水拍手；願諸山在耶和華面前一同歡呼；
verses.e: Let the rivers clap their hands . Let the mountains sing for joy together .

verses.z: 因為他來要審判遍地。他要按公義審判世界，按公正審判萬民。
verses.e: Let them sing before the LORD , for he comes to judge the earth . He will judge the world with righteousness , and the peoples with equity .

verses.z: 耶和華作王；萬民當戰抖！他坐在二基路伯上，地當動搖。
verses.e: The LORD reigns ! Let the peoples tremble . He sits enthroned among the cherubim . Let the earth be moved .

verses.z: 耶和華在錫安為大；他超乎萬民之上。
verses.e: The LORD is great in Zion . He is high above all the peoples .

verses.z: 他們當稱讚他大而可畏的名；他本為聖！
verses.e: Let them praise your great and awesome name . He is Holy !

verses.z: 王有能力，喜愛公平，堅立公正，在雅各中施行公平和公義。
verses.e: The King's strength also loves justice . You establish equity . You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob .

verses.z: 你們當尊崇耶和華－我們的上帝，在他腳凳前下拜。他本為聖！
verses.e: Exalt the LORD our God . Worship at his footstool . He is Holy !

verses.z: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亞倫；在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。他們求告耶和華，他就應允他們。
verses.e: Moses and Aaron were among his priests , Samuel was among those who call on his name . They called on the LORD , and he answered them .

verses.z: 他在雲柱中對他們說話；他們遵守他的法度和他所賜給他們的律例。
verses.e: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud . They kept his testimonies , the statute that he gave them .

verses.z: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，你應允他們；你是赦免他們的上帝，卻按他們所行的報應他們。
verses.e: You answered them , LORD our God . You are a God who forgave them , although you took vengeance for their doings .

verses.z: 你們要尊崇耶和華－我們的上帝，在他的聖山下拜，因為耶和華－我們的上帝本為聖！
verses.e: Exalt the LORD , our God . Worship at his holy hill , for the LORD , our God , is holy !

verses.z: 耶穌基督的啟示，就是上帝賜給他，叫他將必要快成的事指示他的眾僕人。他就差遣使者曉諭他的僕人約翰。
verses.e: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ , which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon , which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant , John ,

verses.z: 當主日，我被[聖]靈感動，聽見在我後面有大聲音如吹號，說：
verses.e: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day , and I heard behind me a loud voice , like a trumpet

verses.z: 「你所看見的當寫在書上，達與以弗所、士每拿、別迦摩、推雅推喇、撒狄、非拉鐵非、老底嘉那七個教會。」
verses.e: saying , " What you see , write in a book and send to the seven assemblies : to Ephesus , Smyrna , Pergamum , Thyatira , Sardis , Philadelphia , and to Laodicea . "

verses.z: 我轉過身來，要看是誰發聲與我說話；既轉過來，就看見七個金燈臺。
verses.e: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me . Having turned , I saw seven golden lamp stands .

verses.z: 燈臺中間有一位好像人子，身穿長衣，直垂到腳，胸間束着金帶。
verses.e: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man , clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet , and with a golden sash around his chest .

verses.z: 他的頭與髮皆白，如白羊毛，如雪；眼目如同火焰；
verses.e: His head and his hair were white as white wool , like snow . His eyes were like a flame of fire .

verses.z: 腳好像在爐中鍛鍊光明的銅；聲音如同眾水的聲音。
verses.e: His feet were like burnished brass , as if it had been refined in a furnace . His voice was like the voice of many waters .

verses.z: 他右手拿着七星，從他口中出來一把兩刃的利劍；面貌如同烈日放光。
verses.e: He had seven stars in his right hand . Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword . His face was like the sun shining at its brightest .

verses.z: 我一看見，就仆倒在他腳前，像死了一樣。他用右手按着我，說：「不要懼怕！我是首先的，我是末後的，
verses.e: When I saw him , I fell at his feet like a dead man . He laid his right hand on me , saying , " Don't be afraid . I am the first and the last ,

verses.z: 又是那存活的；我曾死過，現在又活了，直活到永永遠遠；並且拿着死亡和陰間的鑰匙。
verses.e: and the Living one . I was dead , and behold , I am alive forever and ever . Amen . I have the keys of Death and of Hades .

verses.z: 所以你要把所看見的，和現在的事，並將來必成的事，都寫出來。
verses.e: Write therefore the things which you have seen , and the things which are , and the things which will happen hereafter .

verses.z: 約翰便將上帝的道和耶穌基督的見證，凡自己所看見的都證明出來。
verses.e: who testified to God's word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ , about everything that he saw .

verses.z: 論到你所看見、在我右手中的七星和七個金燈臺的奧祕，那七星就是七個教會的使者，七燈臺就是七個教會。」
verses.e: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand , and the seven golden lamp stands is this : The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies . The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies .

verses.z: 念這書上預言的和那些聽見又遵守其中所記載的，都是有福的，因為日期近了。
verses.e: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy , and keep the things that are written in it , for the time is near .

verses.z: 約翰寫信給亞細亞的七個教會。但願從那昔在、今在、以後永在的[上帝]，和他寶座前的七靈，
verses.e: John , to the seven assemblies that are in Asia : Grace to you and peace from God , who is and who was and who is to come ; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne ;

verses.z: 並那誠實作見證的、從死裏首先復活、為世上君王元首的耶穌基督，有恩惠、平安歸與你們！他愛我們，用自己的血使我們脫離罪惡，
verses.e: and from Jesus Christ , the faithful witness , the firstborn of the dead , and the ruler of the kings of the earth . To him who loves us , and washed us from our sins by his blood —

verses.z: 又使我們成為國民，作他父上帝的祭司。但願榮耀、權能歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: and he made us to be a Kingdom , priests to his God and Father — to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever . Amen .

verses.z: 看哪，他駕雲降臨！眾目要看見他，連刺他的人也要看見他；地上的萬族都要因他哀哭。這話是真實的。阿們！
verses.e: Behold , he is coming with the clouds , and every eye will see him , including those who pierced him . All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him . Even so , Amen .

verses.z: 主上帝說：「我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛，是昔在、今在、以後[永]在的全能者。」
verses.e: " I am the Alpha and the Omega , " says the Lord God , " who is and who was and who is to come , the Almighty . "

verses.z: 我－約翰就是你們的弟兄，和你們在耶穌的患難、國度、忍耐裏一同有分，為上帝的道，並為給耶穌作的見證，曾在那名叫拔摩的海島上。
verses.e: I John , your brother and partner with you in the oppression , Kingdom , and perseverance in Christ Jesus , was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God's Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 我又看見另有一位大力的天使從天降下，披着雲彩，頭上有虹，臉面像日頭，兩腳像火柱。
verses.e: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky , clothed with a cloud . A rainbow was on his head . His face was like the sun , and his feet like pillars of fire .

verses.z: 我從天使手中把小書卷接過來，吃盡了，在我口中果然甜如蜜，吃了以後，肚子覺得發苦了。
verses.e: I took the little book out of the angel's hand , and ate it . It was as sweet as honey in my mouth . When I had eaten it , my stomach was made bitter .

verses.z: 天使對我說：「你必指着多民、多國、多方、多王再說預言。」
verses.e: They told me , " You must prophesy again over many peoples , nations , languages , and kings . "

verses.z: 他手裏拿着小書卷，是展開的。他右腳踏海，左腳踏地，
verses.e: He had in his hand a little open book . He set his right foot on the sea , and his left on the land .

verses.z: 大聲呼喊，好像獅子吼叫。呼喊完了，就有七雷發聲。
verses.e: He cried with a loud voice , as a lion roars . When he cried , the seven thunders uttered their voices .

verses.z: 七雷發聲之後，我正要寫出來，就聽見從天上有聲音說：「七雷所說的，你要封上，不可寫出來。」
verses.e: When the seven thunders sounded , I was about to write ; but I heard a voice from the sky saying , " Seal up the things which the seven thunders said , and don't write them . "

verses.z: 我所看見的那踏海踏地的天使向天舉起右手來，
verses.e: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

verses.z: 指着那創造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永遠遠的，起誓說：「不再有時日了。」
verses.e: and swore by him who lives forever and ever , who created heaven and the things that are in it , the earth and the things that are in it , and the sea and the things that are in it , that there will no longer be delay ,

verses.z: 但在第七位天使吹號發聲的時候，上帝的奧祕就成全了，正如上帝所傳給他僕人眾先知的佳音。
verses.e: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel , when he is about to sound , then the mystery of God is finished , as he declared to his servants the prophets .

verses.z: 我先前從天上所聽見的那聲音又吩咐我說：「你去，把那踏海踏地之天使手中展開的小書卷取過來。」
verses.e: The voice which I heard from heaven , again speaking with me , said , " Go , take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land . "

verses.z: 我就走到天使那裏，對他說：「請你把小書卷給我。」他對我說：「你拿着吃盡了，便叫你肚子發苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。」
verses.e: I went to the angel , telling him to give me the little book . He said to me , " Take it and eat it . It will make your stomach bitter , but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey . "

verses.z: 有一根葦子賜給我，當作量度的杖；且有話說：「起來！將上帝的殿和祭壇，並在殿中禮拜的人都量一量。
verses.e: A reed like a rod was given to me . Someone said , " Rise and measure God's temple , and the altar , and those who worship in it .

verses.z: 住在地上的人就為他們歡喜快樂，互相餽送禮物，因這兩位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。
verses.e: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them , and they will be glad . They will give gifts to one another , because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth .

verses.z: 過了這三天半，有生氣從上帝那裏進入他們裏面，他們就站起來；看見他們的人甚是害怕。
verses.e: After the three and a half days , the breath of life from God entered into them , and they stood on their feet . Great fear fell on those who saw them .

verses.z: 兩位先知聽見有大聲音從天上來，對他們說：「上到這裏來。」他們就駕着雲上了天，他們的仇敵也看見了。
verses.e: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them , " Come up here ! " They went up into heaven in a cloud , and their enemies saw them .

verses.z: 正在那時候，地大震動，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的有七千人；其餘的都恐懼，歸榮耀給天上的上帝。
verses.e: In that day there was a great earthquake , and a tenth of the city fell . Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake , and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven .

verses.z: 第二樣災禍過去，第三樣災禍快到了。
verses.e: The second woe is past . Behold , the third woe comes quickly .

verses.z: 第七位天使吹號，天上就有大聲音說：世上的國成了我主和主基督的國；他要作王，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: The seventh angel sounded , and great voices in heaven followed , saying , " The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ . He will reign forever and ever ! "

verses.z: 在上帝面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位長老，就面伏於地，敬拜上帝，
verses.e: The twenty-four elders , who sit on their thrones before God's throne , fell on their faces and worshiped God ,

verses.z: 說：昔在、今在的主上帝－全能者啊，我們感謝你！因你執掌大權作王了。
verses.e: saying : " We give you thanks , Lord God , the Almighty , the one who is and who was , because you have taken your great power and reigned .

verses.z: 外邦發怒，你的忿怒也臨到了；審判死人的時候也到了。你的僕人眾先知和眾聖徒，凡敬畏你名的人，連大帶小得賞賜的時候也到了。你敗壞那些敗壞世界之人的時候也就到了。
verses.e: The nations were angry , and your wrath came , as did the time for the dead to be judged , and to give your bondservants the prophets , their reward , as well as to the saints and those who fear your name , to the small and the great , and to destroy those who destroy the earth . "

verses.z: 當時，上帝天上的殿開了，在他殿中現出他的約櫃。隨後有閃電、聲音、雷轟、地震、大雹。
verses.e: God's temple that is in heaven was opened , and the ark of the Lord's covenant was seen in his temple . Lightnings , sounds , thunders , an earthquake , and great hail followed .

verses.z: 只是殿外的院子要留下不用量，因為這是給了外邦人的；他們要踐踏聖城四十二個月。
verses.e: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple , and don't measure it , for it has been given to the nations . They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months .

verses.z: 我要使我那兩個見證人，穿着毛衣，傳道一千二百六十天。」
verses.e: I will give power to my two witnesses , and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days , clothed in sackcloth . "

verses.z: 他們就是那兩棵橄欖樹，兩個燈臺，立在世界之主面前的。
verses.e: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands , standing before the Lord of the earth .

verses.z: 若有人想要害他們，就有火從他們口中出來，燒滅仇敵。凡想要害他們的都必這樣被殺。
verses.e: If anyone desires to harm them , fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies . If anyone desires to harm them , he must be killed in this way .

verses.z: 這二人有權柄，在他們傳道的日子叫天閉塞不下雨；又有權柄叫水變為血，並且能隨時隨意用各樣的災殃攻擊世界。
verses.e: These have the power to shut up the sky , that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy . They have power over the waters , to turn them into blood , and to strike the earth with every plague , as often as they desire .

verses.z: 他們作完見證的時候，那從無底坑裏上來的獸必與他們交戰，並且得勝，把他們殺了。
verses.e: When they have finished their testimony , the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them , and overcome them , and kill them .

verses.z: 他們的屍首就倒在大城裏的街上；這城按着靈意叫所多瑪，又叫埃及，就是他們的主釘十字架之處。
verses.e: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city , which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt , where also their Lord was crucified .

verses.z: 從各民、各族、各方、各國中，有人觀看他們的屍首三天半，又不許把屍首放在墳墓裏。
verses.e: From among the peoples , tribes , languages , and nations , people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days , and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb .

verses.z: 天上現出大異象來：有一個婦人身披日頭，腳踏月亮，頭戴十二星的冠冕。
verses.e: A great sign was seen in heaven : a woman clothed with the sun , and the moon under her feet , and on her head a crown of twelve stars .

verses.z: 我聽見在天上有大聲音說：「我上帝的救恩、能力、國度，並他基督的權柄，現在都來到了！因為那在我們上帝面前晝夜控告我們弟兄的，已經被摔下去了。
verses.e: I heard a loud voice in heaven , saying , " Now the salvation , the power , and the Kingdom of our God , and the authority of his Christ has come ; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down , who accuses them before our God day and night .

verses.z: 弟兄勝過牠，是因羔羊的血和自己所見證的道。他們雖至於死，也不愛惜性命。
verses.e: They overcame him because of the Lamb's blood , and because of the word of their testimony . They didn't love their life , even to death .

verses.z: 所以，諸天和住在其中的，你們都快樂吧！只是地與海有禍了！因為魔鬼知道自己的時候不多，就氣忿忿地下到你們那裏去了。」
verses.e: Therefore rejoice , heavens , and you who dwell in them . Woe to the earth and to the sea , because the devil has gone down to you , having great wrath , knowing that he has but a short time . "

verses.z: 龍見自己被摔在地上，就逼迫那生男孩子的婦人。
verses.e: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth , he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child .

verses.z: 於是有大鷹的兩個翅膀賜給婦人，叫她能飛到曠野，到自己的地方，躲避那蛇；她在那裏被養活一載二載半載。
verses.e: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman , that she might fly into the wilderness to her place , so that she might be nourished for a time , times , and half a time , from the face of the serpent .

verses.z: 蛇就在婦人身後，從口中吐出水來，像河一樣，要將婦人沖去。
verses.e: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river , that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream .

verses.z: 地卻幫助婦人，開口吞了從龍口吐出來的水。
verses.e: The earth helped the woman , and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth .

verses.z: 龍向婦人發怒，去與她其餘的兒女爭戰，這兒女就是那守上帝誡命、為耶穌作見證的。
verses.e: The dragon grew angry with the woman , and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring , who keep God's commandments and hold Jesus ' testimony .

verses.z: 那時龍就站在海邊的沙上。
她懷了孕，在生產的艱難中疼痛呼叫。
verses.e: She was with child . She cried out in pain , laboring to give birth .

verses.z: 天上又現出異象來：有一條大紅龍，七頭十角；七頭上戴着七個冠冕。
verses.e: Another sign was seen in heaven . Behold , a great red dragon , having seven heads and ten horns , and on his heads seven crowns .

verses.z: 牠的尾巴拖拉着天上星辰的三分之一，摔在地上。龍就站在那將要生產的婦人面前，等她生產之後，要吞吃她的孩子。
verses.e: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky , and threw them to the earth . The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth , so that when she gave birth he might devour her child .

verses.z: 婦人生了一個男孩子，是將來要用鐵杖轄管萬國的；她的孩子被提到上帝寶座那裏去了。
verses.e: She gave birth to a son , a male child , who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron . Her child was caught up to God and to his throne .

verses.z: 婦人就逃到曠野，在那裏有上帝給她預備的地方，使她被養活一千二百六十天。
verses.e: The woman fled into the wilderness , where she has a place prepared by God , that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days .

verses.z: 在天上就有了爭戰。米迦勒同他的使者與龍爭戰，龍也同牠的使者去爭戰，
verses.e: There was war in the sky . Michael and his angels made war on the dragon . The dragon and his angels made war .

verses.z: 並沒有得勝，天上再沒有牠們的地方。
verses.e: They didn't prevail . No place was found for them any more in heaven .

verses.z: 大龍就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的。牠被摔在地上，牠的使者也一同被摔下去。
verses.e: The great dragon was thrown down , the old serpent , he who is called the devil and Satan , the deceiver of the whole world . He was thrown down to the earth , and his angels were thrown down with him .

verses.z: 我又看見一個獸從海中上來，有十角七頭，在十角上戴着十個冠冕，七頭上有褻瀆的名號。
verses.e: Then I stood on the sand of the sea . I saw a beast coming up out of the sea , having ten horns and seven heads . On his horns were ten crowns , and on his heads , blasphemous names .

verses.z: 擄掠人的，必被擄掠；用刀殺人的，必被刀殺。聖徒的忍耐和信心就是在此。
verses.e: If anyone is to go into captivity , he will go into captivity . If anyone is to be killed with the sword , he must be killed . Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints .

verses.z: 我又看見另有一個獸從地中上來，有兩角如同羊羔，說話好像龍。
verses.e: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth . He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon .

verses.z: 牠在頭一個獸面前，施行頭一個獸所有的權柄，並且叫地和住在地上的人拜那死傷醫好的頭一個獸。
verses.e: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence . He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast , whose fatal wound was healed .

verses.z: 又行大奇事，甚至在人面前，叫火從天降在地上。
verses.e: He performs great signs , even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people .

verses.z: 牠因賜給牠權柄在獸面前能行奇事，就迷惑住在地上的人，說：「要給那受刀傷還活着的獸作個像。」
verses.e: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast , saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived .

verses.z: 又有權柄賜給牠，叫獸像有生氣，並且能說話，又叫所有不拜獸像的人都被殺害。
verses.e: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast , that the image of the beast should both speak , and cause as many as wouldn't worship the image of the beast to be killed .

verses.z: 牠又叫眾人，無論大小、貧富、自主的、為奴的，都在右手上或是在額上受一個印記。
verses.e: He causes all , the small and the great , the rich and the poor , and the free and the slave , to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads ;

verses.z: 除了那受印記、有了獸名或有獸名數目的，都不得做買賣。
verses.e: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark , which is the name of the beast or the number of his name .

verses.z: 在這裏有智慧：凡有聰明的，可以算計獸的數目；因為這是人的數目，它的數目是六百六十六。
verses.e: Here is wisdom . He who has understanding , let him calculate the number of the beast , for it is the number of a man . His number is six hundred sixty-six .

verses.z: 我所看見的獸，形狀像豹，腳像熊的腳，口像獅子的口。那龍將自己的能力、座位，和大權柄都給了牠。
verses.e: The beast which I saw was like a leopard , and his feet were like those of a bear , and his mouth like the mouth of a lion . The dragon gave him his power , his throne , and great authority .

verses.z: 我看見獸的七頭中，有一個似乎受了死傷，那死傷卻醫好了。全地的人都希奇跟從那獸，
verses.e: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally . His fatal wound was healed , and the whole earth marveled at the beast .

verses.z: 又拜那龍－因為牠將自己的權柄給了獸，也拜獸，說：「誰能比這獸，誰能與牠交戰呢？」
verses.e: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast ; and they worshiped the beast , saying , " Who is like the beast ? Who is able to make war with him ? "

verses.z: 又賜給牠說誇大褻瀆話的口，又有權柄賜給牠，可以任意而行四十二個月。
verses.e: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him . Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him .

verses.z: 獸就開口向上帝說褻瀆的話，褻瀆上帝的名並他的帳幕，以及那些住在天上的。
verses.e: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God , to blaspheme his name , his dwelling , and those who dwell in heaven .

verses.z: 又任憑牠與聖徒爭戰，並且得勝；也把權柄賜給牠，制伏各族、各民、各方、各國。
verses.e: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them . Authority over every tribe , people , language , and nation was given to him .

verses.z: 凡住在地上、名字從創世以來沒有記在被殺之羔羊生命冊上的人，都要拜牠。
verses.e: All who dwell on the earth will worship him , everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed .

verses.z: 凡有耳的，就應當聽！
verses.e: If anyone has an ear , let him hear .

verses.z: 我又觀看，見羔羊站在錫安山，同他又有十四萬四千人，都有他的名和他父的名寫在額上。
verses.e: I saw , and behold , the Lamb standing on Mount Zion , and with him a number , one hundred forty-four thousand , having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads .

verses.z: 這人也必喝上帝大怒的酒；此酒斟在上帝忿怒的杯中純一不雜。他要在聖天使和羔羊面前，在火與硫磺之中受痛苦。
verses.e: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God , which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger . He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb .

verses.z: 他受痛苦的煙往上冒，直到永永遠遠。那些拜獸和獸像，受牠名之印記的，晝夜不得安寧。」
verses.e: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever . They have no rest day and night , those who worship the beast and his image , and whoever receives the mark of his name .

verses.z: 聖徒的忍耐就在此；他們是守上帝誡命和耶穌真道的。
verses.e: Here is the perseverance of the saints , those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus . "

verses.z: 我聽見從天上有聲音說：「你要寫下：從今以後，在主裏面而死的人有福了！」[聖]靈說：「是的，他們息了自己的勞苦，做工的果效也隨着他們。」
verses.e: I heard a voice from heaven saying , " Write , ' Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on . ' " " Yes , " says the Spirit , " that they may rest from their labors , for their works follow with them . "

verses.z: 我又觀看，見有一片白雲，雲上坐着一位好像人子，頭上戴着金冠冕，手裏拿着快鐮刀。
verses.e: I looked , and saw a white cloud , and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man , having on his head a golden crown , and in his hand a sharp sickle .

verses.z: 又有一位天使從殿中出來，向那坐在雲上的大聲喊着說：「伸出你的鐮刀來收割；因為收割的時候已經到了，地上的莊稼已經熟透了。」
verses.e: Another angel came out of the temple , crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud , " Send your sickle and reap , for the hour to reap has come ; for the harvest of the earth is ripe ! "

verses.z: 那坐在雲上的，就把鐮刀扔在地上，地上的莊稼就被收割了。
verses.e: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth , and the earth was reaped .

verses.z: 又有一位天使從天上的殿中出來，他也拿着快鐮刀。
verses.e: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven . He also had a sharp sickle .

verses.z: 又有一位天使從祭壇中出來，是有權柄管火的，向拿着快鐮刀的大聲喊着說：「伸出快鐮刀來，收取地上葡萄樹的果子，因為葡萄熟透了！」
verses.e: Another angel came out from the altar , he who has power over fire , and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle , saying , " Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth , for the earth's grapes are fully ripe ! "

verses.z: 那天使就把鐮刀扔在地上，收取了地上的葡萄，丟在上帝忿怒的大酒醡中。
verses.e: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God .

verses.z: 我聽見從天上有聲音，像眾水的聲音和大雷的聲音，並且我所聽見的好像彈琴的所彈的琴聲。
verses.e: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder . The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps .

verses.z: 那酒醡踹在城外，就有血從酒醡裏流出來，高到馬的嚼環，遠有六百里。
verses.e: The wine press was trodden outside of the city , and blood came out of the wine press , up to the bridles of the horses , as far as one thousand six hundred stadia .

verses.z: 他們在寶座前，並在四活物和眾長老前唱歌，彷彿是新歌；除了從地上買來的那十四萬四千人以外，沒有人能學這歌。
verses.e: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders . No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand , those who had been redeemed out of the earth .

verses.z: 這些人未曾沾染婦女，他們原是童身。羔羊無論往哪裏去，他們都跟隨他。他們是從人間買來的，作初熟的果子歸與上帝和羔羊。
verses.e: These are those who were not defiled with women , for they are virgins . These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes . These were redeemed by Jesus from among men , the first fruits to God and to the Lamb .

verses.z: 在他們口中察不出謊言來；他們是沒有瑕疵的。
verses.e: In their mouth was found no lie , for they are blameless .

verses.z: 我又看見另有一位天使飛在空中，有永遠的福音要傳給住在地上的人，就是各國、各族、各方、各民。
verses.e: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven , having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth — to every nation , tribe , language , and people .

verses.z: 他大聲說：「應當敬畏上帝，將榮耀歸給他！因他施行審判的時候已經到了。應當敬拜那創造天地海和眾水泉源的。」
verses.e: He said with a loud voice , " Fear the Lord , and give him glory , for the hour of his judgment has come . Worship him who made the heaven , the earth , the sea , and the springs of waters ! "

verses.z: 又有第二位天使接着說：「叫萬民喝邪淫、大怒之酒的巴比倫大城傾倒了！傾倒了！」
verses.e: Another , a second angel , followed , saying , " Babylon the great has fallen , which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality . "

verses.z: 又有第三位天使接着他們，大聲說：「若有人拜獸和獸像，在額上或在手上受了印記，
verses.e: Another angel , a third , followed them , saying with a great voice , " If anyone worships the beast and his image , and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand ,

verses.z: 我又看見在天上有異象，大而且奇，就是七位天使掌管末了的七災，因為上帝的大怒在這七災中發盡了。
verses.e: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky : seven angels having the seven last plagues , for in them God's wrath is finished .

verses.z: 我看見彷彿有玻璃海，其中有火攙雜。又看見那些勝了獸和獸的像並牠名字數目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿着上帝的琴，
verses.e: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire , and those who overcame the beast , his image , and the number of his name , standing on the sea of glass , having harps of God .

verses.z: 唱上帝僕人摩西的歌和羔羊的歌，說：主上帝－全能者啊，你的作為大哉！奇哉！萬世之王啊，你的道途義哉！誠哉！
verses.e: They sang the song of Moses , the servant of God , and the song of the Lamb , saying , " Great and marvelous are your works , Lord God , the Almighty ! Righteous and true are your ways , you King of the nations .

verses.z: 主啊，誰敢不敬畏你，不將榮耀歸與你的名呢？因為獨有你是聖的。萬民都要來在你面前敬拜，因你公義的作為已經顯出來了。
verses.e: Who wouldn't fear you , Lord , and glorify your name ? For you only are holy . For all the nations will come and worship before you . For your righteous acts have been revealed . "

verses.z: 此後，我看見在天上那存法櫃的殿開了。
verses.e: After these things I looked , and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened .

verses.z: 那掌管七災的七位天使從殿中出來，穿着潔白光明的細麻衣，胸間束着金帶。
verses.e: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out , clothed with pure , bright linen , and wearing golden sashes around their chests .

verses.z: 四活物中有一個把盛滿了活到永永遠遠之上帝大怒的七個金碗給了那七位天使。
verses.e: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God , who lives forever and ever .

verses.z: 因上帝的榮耀和能力，殿中充滿了煙。於是沒有人能以進殿，直等到那七位天使[所降]的七災完畢了。
verses.e: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power . No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished .

verses.z: 我聽見有大聲音從殿中出來，向那七位天使說：「你們去，把盛上帝大怒的七碗倒在地上。」
verses.e: I heard a loud voice out of the temple , saying to the seven angels , " Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth ! "

verses.z: 第五位天使把碗倒在獸的座位上，獸的國就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌頭；
verses.e: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast , and his kingdom was darkened . They gnawed their tongues because of the pain ,

verses.z: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的瘡，就褻瀆天上的上帝，並不悔改所行的。
verses.e: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores . They still didn't repent of their works .

verses.z: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼發拉底大河上，河水就乾了，要給那從日出之地所來的眾王預備道路。
verses.e: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river , the Euphrates . Its water was dried up , that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise .

verses.z: 我又看見三個污穢的靈，好像青蛙，從龍口、獸口並假先知的口中出來。
verses.e: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon , and out of the mouth of the beast , and out of the mouth of the false prophet , three unclean spirits , something like frogs ;

verses.z: 他們本是鬼魔的靈，施行奇事，出去到普天下眾王那裏，叫他們在上帝全能者的大日聚集爭戰。（
verses.e: for they are spirits of demons , performing signs , which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth , to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty .

verses.z: 看哪，我來像賊一樣。那警醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人見他羞恥的有福了！）
verses.e: " Behold , I come like a thief . Blessed is he who watches , and keeps his clothes , so that he doesn't walk naked , and they see his shame . "

verses.z: 那三個鬼魔便叫眾王聚集在一處，希伯來話叫作哈米吉多頓。
verses.e: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew , " Harmagedon " .

verses.z: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大聲音從殿中的寶座上出來，說：「成了！」
verses.e: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air . A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven , from the throne , saying , " It is done ! "

verses.z: 又有閃電、聲音、雷轟、大地震，自從地上有人以來，沒有這樣大、這樣厲害的地震。
verses.e: There were lightnings , sounds , and thunders ; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth — so great an earthquake and so mighty .

verses.z: 那大城裂為三段，列國的城也都倒塌了；上帝也想起巴比倫大城來，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯遞給他。
verses.e: The great city was divided into three parts , and the cities of the nations fell . Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God , to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath .

verses.z: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有惡而且毒的瘡生在那些有獸印記、拜獸像的人身上。
verses.e: The first went , and poured out his bowl into the earth , and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast , and who worshiped his image .

verses.z: 各海島都逃避了，眾山也不見了。
verses.e: Every island fled away , and the mountains were not found .

verses.z: 又有大雹子從天落在人身上，每一個約重一他連得。為這雹子的災極大，人就褻瀆上帝。
verses.e: Great hailstones , about the weight of a talent , came down out of the sky on people . People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail , for this plague was exceedingly severe .

verses.z: 第二位天使把碗倒在海裏，海就變成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。
verses.e: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea , and it became blood as of a dead man . Every living thing in the sea died .

verses.z: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河與眾水的泉源裏，水就變成血了。
verses.e: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water , and they became blood .

verses.z: 我聽見掌管眾水的天使說：昔在、今在的聖者啊，你這樣判斷是公義的；
verses.e: I heard the angel of the waters saying , " You are righteous , who are and who were , O Holy One , because you have judged these things .

verses.z: 他們曾流聖徒與先知的血，現在你給他們血喝；這是他們所該受的。
verses.e: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets , and you have given them blood to drink . They deserve this . "

verses.z: 我又聽見祭壇[中有聲音]說：是的，主上帝－全能者啊，你的判斷義哉！誠哉！
verses.e: I heard the altar saying , " Yes , Lord God , the Almighty , true and righteous are your judgments . "

verses.z: 第四位天使把碗倒在日頭上，叫日頭能用火烤人。
verses.e: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun , and it was given to him to scorch men with fire .

verses.z: 人被大熱所烤，就褻瀆那有權掌管這些災的上帝之名，並不悔改將榮耀歸給上帝。
verses.e: People were scorched with great heat , and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues . They didn't repent and give him glory .

verses.z: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位前來對我說：「你到這裏來，我將坐在眾水上的大淫婦所要受的刑罰指給你看。
verses.e: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me , saying , " Come here . I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters ,

verses.z: 又是七位王；五位已經傾倒了，一位還在，一位還沒有來到；他來的時候，必須暫時存留。
verses.e: They are seven kings . Five have fallen , the one is , and the other has not yet come . When he comes , he must continue a little while .

verses.z: 那先前有如今沒有的獸，就是第八位；他也和那七位同列，並且歸於沉淪。
verses.e: The beast that was , and is not , is himself also an eighth , and is of the seven ; and he goes to destruction .

verses.z: 你所看見的那十角就是十王；他們還沒有得國，但他們一時之間要和獸同得權柄，與王一樣。
verses.e: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet , but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour .

verses.z: 他們同心合意將自己的能力、權柄給那獸。
verses.e: These have one mind , and they give their power and authority to the beast .

verses.z: 他們與羔羊爭戰，羔羊必勝過他們，因為羔羊是萬主之主、萬王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召、被選、有忠心的，[也必得勝]。」
verses.e: These will war against the Lamb , and the Lamb will overcome them , for he is Lord of lords and King of kings ; and those who are with him are called , chosen , and faithful . "

verses.z: 天使又對我說：「你所看見那淫婦坐的眾水，就是多民、多人、多國、多方。
verses.e: He said to me , " The waters which you saw , where the prostitute sits , are peoples , multitudes , nations , and languages .

verses.z: 你所看見的那十角與獸必恨這淫婦，使她冷落赤身，又要吃她的肉，用火將她燒盡。
verses.e: The ten horns which you saw , they and the beast will hate the prostitute , will make her desolate , will strip her naked , will eat her flesh , and will burn her utterly with fire .

verses.z: 因為上帝使諸王同心合意，遵行他的旨意，把自己的國給那獸，直等到上帝的話都應驗了。
verses.e: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind , to be of one mind , and to give their kingdom to the beast , until the words of God should be accomplished .

verses.z: 你所看見的那女人就是管轄地上眾王的大城。」
verses.e: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth . "

verses.z: 地上的君王與她行淫，住在地上的人喝醉了她淫亂的酒。」
verses.e: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality . Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality . "

verses.z: 我被[聖]靈感動，天使帶我到曠野去，我就看見一個女人騎在朱紅色的獸上；那獸有七頭十角，遍體有褻瀆的名號。
verses.e: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness . I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast , full of blasphemous names , having seven heads and ten horns .

verses.z: 那女人穿着紫色和朱紅色的衣服，用金子、寶石、珍珠為妝飾；手拿金杯，杯中盛滿了可憎之物，就是她淫亂的污穢。
verses.e: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet , and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls , having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth .

verses.z: 在她額上有名寫着說：「奧祕哉！大巴比倫，作世上的淫婦和一切可憎之物的母。」
verses.e: And on her forehead a name was written , " MYSTERY , BABYLON THE GREAT , THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH . "

verses.z: 我又看見那女人喝醉了聖徒的血和為耶穌作見證之人的血。我看見她，就大大地希奇。
verses.e: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus . When I saw her , I wondered with great amazement .

verses.z: 天使對我說：「你為甚麼希奇呢？我要將這女人和馱着她的那七頭十角獸的奧祕告訴你。
verses.e: The angel said to me , " Why do you wonder ? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her , which has the seven heads and the ten horns .

verses.z: 你所看見的獸，先前有，如今沒有，將要從無底坑裏上來，又要歸於沉淪。凡住在地上、名字從創世以來沒有記在生命冊上的，見先前有、如今沒有、以後再有的獸，就必希奇。
verses.e: The beast that you saw was , and is not ; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction . Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was , and is not , and shall be present .

verses.z: 智慧的心在此[可以思想]。那七頭就是女人所坐的七座山，
verses.e: Here is the mind that has wisdom . The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits .

verses.z: 此後，我看見另有一位有大權柄的天使從天降下，地就因他的榮耀發光。
verses.e: After these things , I saw another angel coming down out of the sky , having great authority . The earth was illuminated with his glory .

verses.z: 因怕她的痛苦，就遠遠地站着說：哀哉！哀哉！巴比倫大城，堅固的城啊，一時之間你的刑罰就來到了。
verses.e: standing far away for the fear of her torment , saying , ' Woe , woe , the great city , Babylon , the strong city ! For your judgment has come in one hour . '

verses.z: 地上的客商也都為她哭泣悲哀，因為沒有人再買他們的貨物了；
verses.e: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her , for no one buys their merchandise any more :

verses.z: 這貨物就是金、銀、寶石、珍珠、細麻布、紫色料、綢子、朱紅色料、各樣香木、各樣象牙的器皿、各樣極寶貴的木頭，和銅、鐵、漢白玉的器皿，
verses.e: merchandise of gold , silver , precious stones , pearls , fine linen , purple , silk , scarlet , all expensive wood , every vessel of ivory , every vessel made of most precious wood , and of brass , and iron , and marble ;

verses.z: 並肉桂、荳蔻、香料、香膏、乳香、酒、油、細麵、麥子、牛、羊、車、馬，和奴僕、人口。
verses.e: and cinnamon , incense , perfume , frankincense , wine , olive oil , fine flour , wheat , cattle , sheep , horses , chariots , and people's bodies and souls .

verses.z: [巴比倫]哪，你所貪愛的果子離開了你；你一切的珍饈美味和華美的物件也從你中間毀滅，決不能再見了。
verses.e: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you . All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you , and you will find them no more at all .

verses.z: 販賣這些貨物、藉着她發了財的客商，因怕她的痛苦，就遠遠地站着哭泣悲哀，說：
verses.e: The merchants of these things , who were made rich by her , will stand far away for the fear of her torment , weeping and mourning ,

verses.z: 哀哉！哀哉！這大城啊，素常穿着細麻、紫色、朱紅色的衣服，又用金子、寶石，和珍珠為妝飾。
verses.e: saying , ' Woe , woe , the great city , she who was dressed in fine linen , purple , and scarlet , and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls !

verses.z: 一時之間，這麼大的富厚就歸於無有了。凡船主和坐船往各處去的，並眾水手，連所有靠海為業的，都遠遠地站着，
verses.e: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate . ' Every ship master , and everyone who sails anywhere , and mariners , and as many as gain their living by sea , stood far away ,

verses.z: 看見燒她的煙，就喊着說：「有何城能比這大城呢？」
verses.e: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning , saying , ' What is like the great city ? '

verses.z: 他們又把塵土撒在頭上，哭泣悲哀，喊着說：哀哉！哀哉！這大城啊。凡有船在海中的，都因她的珍寶成了富足！她在一時之間就成了荒場！
verses.e: They cast dust on their heads , and cried , weeping and mourning , saying , ' Woe , woe , the great city , in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth ! ' For she is made desolate in one hour .

verses.z: 他大聲喊着說：巴比倫大城傾倒了！傾倒了！成了鬼魔的住處和各樣污穢之靈的巢穴，並各樣污穢可憎之雀鳥的巢穴。
verses.e: He cried with a mighty voice , saying , " Fallen , fallen is Babylon the great , and she has become a habitation of demons , a prison of every unclean spirit , and a prison of every unclean and hated bird !

verses.z: 天哪，眾聖徒、眾使徒、眾先知啊，你們都要因她歡喜，因為上帝已經在她身上伸了你們的冤。
verses.e: " Rejoice over her , O heaven , you saints , apostles , and prophets , for God has judged your judgment on her . "

verses.z: 有一位大力的天使舉起一塊石頭，好像大磨石，扔在海裏，說：巴比倫大城也必這樣猛力地被扔下去，決不能再見了。
verses.e: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea , saying , " Thus with violence will Babylon , the great city , be thrown down , and will be found no more at all .

verses.z: 彈琴、作樂、吹笛、吹號的聲音，在你中間決不能再聽見；各行手藝人在你中間決不能再遇見；推磨的聲音在你中間決不能再聽見；
verses.e: The voice of harpists , minstrels , flute players , and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you . No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you . The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you .

verses.z: 燈光在你中間決不能再照耀；新郎和新婦的聲音，在你中間決不能再聽見。你的客商原來是地上的尊貴人；萬國也被你的邪術迷惑了。
verses.e: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you . The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you , for your merchants were the princes of the earth ; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived .

verses.z: 先知和聖徒，並地上一切被殺之人的血，都在這城裏看見了。
verses.e: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints , and of all who have been slain on the earth . "

verses.z: 因為列國都被她邪淫大怒的酒傾倒了。地上的君王與她行淫；地上的客商因她奢華太過就發了財。
verses.e: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality , the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her , and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury . "
