verses.z: 我又聽見從天上有聲音說：我的民哪，你們要從那城出來，免得與她一同有罪，受她所受的災殃；
verses.e: I heard another voice from heaven , saying , " Come out of her , my people , that you have no participation in her sins , and that you don't receive of her plagues ,

verses.z: 因她的罪惡滔天；她的不義，上帝已經想起來了。
verses.e: for her sins have reached to the sky , and God has remembered her iniquities .

verses.z: 她怎樣待人，也要怎樣待她，按她所行的加倍地報應她；用她調酒的杯加倍地調給她[喝]。
verses.e: Return to her just as she returned , and repay her double as she did , and according to her works . In the cup which she mixed , mix to her double .

verses.z: 她怎樣榮耀自己，怎樣奢華，也當叫她照樣痛苦悲哀，因她心裏說：我坐了皇后的位，並不是寡婦，決不至於悲哀。
verses.e: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton , so much give her of torment and mourning . For she says in her heart , ' I sit a queen , and am no widow , and will in no way see mourning . '

verses.z: 所以在一天之內，她的災殃要一齊來到，就是死亡、悲哀、饑荒。她又要被火燒盡了，因為審判她的主上帝大有能力。
verses.e: Therefore in one day her plagues will come : death , mourning , and famine ; and she will be utterly burned with fire , for the Lord God who has judged her is strong .

verses.z: 地上的君王，素來與她行淫、一同奢華的，看見燒她的煙，就必為她哭泣哀號。
verses.e: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her , when they look at the smoke of her burning ,

verses.z: 此後，我聽見好像群眾在天上大聲說：哈利路亞！救恩、榮耀、權能都屬乎我們的上帝！
verses.e: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven , saying , " Hallelujah ! Salvation , power , and glory belong to our God ;

verses.z: 我就俯伏在他腳前要拜他。他說：「千萬不可！我和你，並你那些為耶穌作見證的弟兄同是作僕人的，你要敬拜上帝。」因為預言中的靈意乃是為耶穌作見證。
verses.e: I fell down before his feet to worship him . He said to me , " Look ! Don't do it ! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus . Worship God , for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy . "

verses.z: 我觀看，見天開了。有一匹白馬，騎在馬上的稱為誠信真實，他審判，爭戰，都按着公義。
verses.e: I saw heaven opened , and behold , a white horse , and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True . In righteousness he judges and makes war .

verses.z: 他的眼睛如火焰，他頭上戴着許多冠冕；又有寫着的名字，除了他自己沒有人知道。
verses.e: His eyes are a flame of fire , and on his head are many crowns . He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself .

verses.z: 他穿着濺了血的衣服；他的名稱為上帝之道。
verses.e: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood . His name is called " The Word of God . "

verses.z: 在天上的眾軍騎着白馬，穿着細麻衣，又白又潔，跟隨他。
verses.e: The armies which are in heaven , clothed in white , pure , fine linen , followed him on white horses .

verses.z: 有利劍從他口中出來，可以擊殺列國。他必用鐵杖轄管他們，並要踹全能上帝烈怒的酒醡。
verses.e: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp , double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations . He will rule them with an iron rod . He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God , the Almighty .

verses.z: 在他衣服和大腿上有名寫着說：「萬王之王，萬主之主。」
verses.e: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written , " KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS . "

verses.z: 我又看見一位天使站在日頭中，向天空所飛的鳥大聲喊着說：「你們聚集來赴上帝的大筵席，
verses.e: I saw an angel standing in the sun . He cried with a loud voice , saying to all the birds that fly in the sky , " Come ! Be gathered together to the great supper of God ,

verses.z: 可以吃君王與將軍的肉，壯士與馬和騎馬者的肉，並一切自主的為奴的，以及大小人民的肉。」
verses.e: that you may eat the flesh of kings , the flesh of captains , the flesh of mighty men , and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them , and the flesh of all men , both free and slave , small and great . "

verses.z: 我看見那獸和地上的君王，並他們的眾軍都聚集，要與騎[白]馬的並他的軍兵爭戰。
verses.e: I saw the beast , the kings of the earth , and their armies , gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army .

verses.z: 他的判斷是真實公義的；因他判斷了那用淫行敗壞世界的大淫婦，並且向淫婦討流僕人血的罪，給他們伸冤。
verses.e: for his judgments are true and righteous . For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality , and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand . "

verses.z: 那獸被擒拿；那在獸面前曾行奇事、迷惑受獸印記和拜獸像之人的假先知，也與獸同被擒拿。他們兩個就活活地被扔在燒着硫磺的火湖裏；
verses.e: The beast was taken , and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight , with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image . These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur .

verses.z: 其餘的被騎[白]馬者口中出來的劍殺了；飛鳥都吃飽了他們的肉。
verses.e: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse , the sword which came out of his mouth . So all the birds were filled with their flesh .

verses.z: 又說：哈利路亞！燒淫婦的煙往上冒，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: A second said , " Hallelujah ! Her smoke goes up forever and ever . "

verses.z: 那二十四位長老與四活物就俯伏敬拜坐寶座的上帝，說：阿們！哈利路亞！
verses.e: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne , saying , " Amen ! Hallelujah ! "

verses.z: 有聲音從寶座出來說：上帝的眾僕人哪，凡敬畏他的，無論大小，都要讚美我們的上帝！
verses.e: A voice came from the throne , saying , " Give praise to our God , all you his servants , you who fear him , the small and the great ! "

verses.z: 我聽見好像群眾的聲音，眾水的聲音，大雷的聲音，說：哈利路亞！因為主－我們的上帝、全能者作王了。
verses.e: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude , and like the voice of many waters , and like the voice of mighty thunders , saying , " Hallelujah ! For the Lord our God , the Almighty , reigns !

verses.z: 我們要歡喜快樂，將榮耀歸給他。因為，羔羊婚娶的時候到了；新婦也自己預備好了，
verses.e: Let's rejoice and be exceedingly glad , and let's give the glory to him . For the wedding of the Lamb has come , and his wife has made herself ready . "

verses.z: 就蒙恩得穿光明潔白的細麻衣。（這細麻衣就是聖徒所行的義。）
verses.e: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright , pure , fine linen , for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints .

verses.z: 天使吩咐我說：「你要寫上：凡被請赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！」又對我說：「這是上帝真實的話。」
verses.e: He said to me , " Write , ' Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb . ' " He said to me , " These are true words of God . "

verses.z: 「你要寫信給以弗所教會的使者，說：『那右手拿着七星、在七個金燈臺中間行走的，說：
verses.e: " To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write : " He who holds the seven stars in his right hand , he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things :

verses.z: 你將要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你們中間幾個人下在監裏，叫你們被試煉，你們必受患難十日。你務要至死忠心，我就賜給你那生命的冠冕。
verses.e: Don't be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer . Behold , the devil is about to throw some of you into prison , that you may be tested ; and you will have oppression for ten days . Be faithful to death , and I will give you the crown of life .

verses.z: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，必不受第二次死的害。』」
verses.e: He who has an ear , let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies . He who overcomes won't be harmed by the second death .

verses.z: 「你要寫信給別迦摩教會的使者，說：『那有兩刃利劍的，說：
verses.e: " To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write : " He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things :

verses.z: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之處；當我忠心的見證人安提帕在你們中間、撒但所住的地方被殺之時，你還堅守我的名，沒有棄絕我的道。
verses.e: " I know your works and where you dwell , where Satan's throne is . You hold firmly to my name , and didn't deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness , my faithful one , who was killed among you , where Satan dwells .

verses.z: 然而，有幾件事我要責備你：因為在你那裏有人服從了巴蘭的教訓；這巴蘭曾教導巴勒將絆腳石放在以色列人面前，叫他們吃祭偶像之物，行姦淫的事。
verses.e: But I have a few things against you , because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam , who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel , to eat things sacrificed to idols , and to commit sexual immorality .

verses.z: 你那裏也有人照樣服從了尼哥拉一黨人的教訓。
verses.e: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans .

verses.z: 所以，你當悔改；若不悔改，我就快臨到你那裏，用我口中的劍攻擊他們。
verses.e: Repent therefore , or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth .

verses.z: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將那隱藏的嗎哪賜給他，並賜他一塊白石，石上寫着新名；除了那領受的以外，沒有人能認識。』」
verses.e: He who has an ear , let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies . To him who overcomes , to him I will give of the hidden manna , and I will give him a white stone , and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it .

verses.z: 「你要寫信給推雅推喇教會的使者，說：『那眼目如火焰、腳像光明銅的上帝之子說：
verses.e: " To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write : " The Son of God , who has his eyes like a flame of fire , and his feet are like burnished brass , says these things :

verses.z: 我知道你的行為、愛心、信心、勤勞、忍耐，又知道你末後所行的[善]事，比起初所行的更多。
verses.e: " I know your works , your love , faith , service , patient endurance , and that your last works are more than the first .

verses.z: 我知道你的行為、勞碌、忍耐，也知道你不能容忍惡人。你也曾試驗那自稱為使徒卻不是使徒的，看出他們是假的來。
verses.e: " I know your works , and your toil and perseverance , and that you can't tolerate evil men , and have tested those who call themselves apostles , and they are not , and found them false .

verses.z: 然而，有一件事我要責備你，就是你容讓那自稱是先知的婦人耶洗別教導我的僕人，引誘他們行姦淫，吃祭偶像之物。
verses.e: But I have this against you , that you tolerate your woman Jezebel , who calls herself a prophetess . She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols .

verses.z: 我曾給她悔改的機會，她卻不肯悔改她的淫行。
verses.e: I gave her time to repent , but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality .

verses.z: 看哪，我要叫她病臥在床。那些與她行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他們同受大患難。
verses.e: Behold , I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression , unless they repent of her works .

verses.z: 我又要殺死她的黨類，叫眾教會知道，我是那察看人肺腑心腸的，並要照你們的行為報應你們各人。
verses.e: I will kill her children with Death , and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts . I will give to each one of you according to your deeds .

verses.z: 至於你們推雅推喇其餘的人，就是一切不從那教訓、不曉得他們素常所說撒但深奧之理的人，我告訴你們，我不將別的擔子放在你們身上。
verses.e: But to you I say , to the rest who are in Thyatira — as many as don't have this teaching , who don't know what some call ' the deep things of Satan ' — to you I say , I am not putting any other burden on you .

verses.z: 但你們已經有的，總要持守，直等到我來。
verses.e: Nevertheless , hold that which you have firmly until I come .

verses.z: 那得勝又遵守我命令到底的，我要賜給他權柄制伏列國；
verses.e: He who overcomes , and he who keeps my works to the end , to him I will give authority over the nations .

verses.z: 他必用鐵杖轄管他們，將他們如同窯戶的瓦器打得粉碎，像我從我父領受的權柄一樣。
verses.e: He will rule them with a rod of iron , shattering them like clay pots , as I also have received of my Father ;

verses.z: 我又要把晨星賜給他。
verses.e: and I will give him the morning star .

verses.z: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
verses.e: He who has an ear , let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies .

verses.z: 你也能忍耐，曾為我的名勞苦，並不乏倦。
verses.e: You have perseverance and have endured for my name's sake , and have not grown weary .

verses.z: 然而有一件事我要責備你，就是你把起初的愛心離棄了。
verses.e: But I have this against you , that you left your first love .

verses.z: 所以，應當回想你是從哪裏墜落的，並要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就臨到你那裏，把你的燈臺從原處挪去。
verses.e: Remember therefore from where you have fallen , and repent and do the first works ; or else I am coming to you swiftly , and will move your lamp stand out of its place , unless you repent .

verses.z: 然而你還有一件可取的事，就是你恨惡尼哥拉一黨人的行為，這也是我所恨惡的。
verses.e: But this you have , that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans , which I also hate .

verses.z: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將上帝樂園中生命樹的果子賜給他吃。』」
verses.e: He who has an ear , let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies . To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life , which is in the Paradise of my God .

verses.z: 「你要寫信給士每拿教會的使者，說：『那首先的、末後的、死過又活的，說：
verses.e: " To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write : " The first and the last , who was dead , and has come to life says these things :

verses.z: 我知道你的患難，你的貧窮（你卻是富足的），也知道那自稱是猶太人所說的毀謗話，其實他們不是猶太人，乃是撒但一會的人。
verses.e: " I know your works , oppression , and your poverty ( but you are rich ) , and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews , and they are not , but are a synagogue of Satan .

verses.z: 我又看見一位天使從天降下，手裏拿着無底坑的鑰匙和一條大鍊子。
verses.e: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven , having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand .

verses.z: 那迷惑他們的魔鬼被扔在硫磺的火湖裏，就是獸和假先知所在的地方。他們必晝夜受痛苦，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur , where the beast and the false prophet are also . They will be tormented day and night forever and ever .

verses.z: 我又看見一個白色的大寶座與坐在上面的；從他面前天地都逃避，再無可見之處了。
verses.e: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it , from whose face the earth and the sky fled away . There was found no place for them .

verses.z: 我又看見死了的人，無論大小，都站在寶座前。案卷展開了，並且另有一卷展開，就是生命冊。死了的人都憑着這些案卷所記載的，照他們所行的受審判。
verses.e: I saw the dead , the great and the small , standing before the throne , and they opened books . Another book was opened , which is the book of life . The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books , according to their works .

verses.z: 於是海交出其中的死人；死亡和陰間也交出其中的死人；他們都照各人所行的受審判。
verses.e: The sea gave up the dead who were in it . Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them . They were judged , each one according to his works .

verses.z: 死亡和陰間也被扔在火湖裏；這火湖就是第二次的死。
verses.e: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire . This is the second death , the lake of fire .

verses.z: 若有人名字沒記在生命冊上，他就被扔在火湖裏。
verses.e: If anyone was not found written in the book of life , he was cast into the lake of fire .

verses.z: 他捉住那龍，就是古蛇，又叫魔鬼，也叫撒但，把牠捆綁一千年，
verses.e: He seized the dragon , the old serpent , who is the devil and Satan , who deceives the whole inhabited earth , and bound him for a thousand years ,

verses.z: 扔在無底坑裏，將無底坑關閉，用印封上，使牠不得再迷惑列國。等到那一千年完了，以後必須暫時釋放牠。
verses.e: and cast him into the abyss , and shut it and sealed it over him , that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished . After this , he must be freed for a short time .

verses.z: 我又看見幾個寶座，也有坐在上面的，並有審判的權柄賜給他們。我又看見那些因為給耶穌作見證，並為上帝之道被斬者的靈魂，和那沒有拜過獸與獸像，也沒有在額上和手上受過他印記之人的靈魂，他們都復活了，與基督一同作王一千年。
verses.e: I saw thrones , and they sat on them , and judgment was given to them . I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God , and such as didn't worship the beast nor his image , and didn't receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand . They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years .

verses.z: 這是頭一次的復活。（其餘的死人還沒有復活，直等那一千年完了。）
verses.e: The rest of the dead didn't live until the thousand years were finished . This is the first resurrection .

verses.z: 在頭一次復活有分的有福了，聖潔了！第二次的死在他們身上沒有權柄。他們必作上帝和基督的祭司，並要與基督一同作王一千年。
verses.e: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection . Over these , the second death has no power , but they will be priests of God and of Christ , and will reign with him one thousand years .

verses.z: 那一千年完了，撒但必從監牢裏被釋放，
verses.e: And after the thousand years , Satan will be released from his prison

verses.z: 出來要迷惑地上四方的列國，就是歌革和瑪各，叫他們聚集爭戰。他們的人數多如海沙。
verses.e: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth , Gog and Magog , to gather them together to the war , whose number is as the sand of the sea .

verses.z: 他們上來遍滿了全地，圍住聖徒的營與蒙愛的城，就有火從天降下，燒滅了他們。
verses.e: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city . Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them .

verses.z: 我又看見一個新天新地；因為先前的天地已經過去了，海也不再有了。
verses.e: I saw a new heaven and a new earth , for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away , and the sea is no more .

verses.z: 我被[聖]靈感動，天使就帶我到一座高大的山，將那由上帝那裏、從天而降的聖城耶路撒冷指示我。
verses.e: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain , and showed me the holy city , Jerusalem , coming down out of heaven from God ,

verses.z: 城中有上帝的榮耀；城的光輝如同極貴的寶石，好像碧玉，明如水晶。
verses.e: having the glory of God . Her light was like a most precious stone , like a jasper stone , clear as crystal ;

verses.z: 有高大的牆，有十二個門，門上有十二位天使，門上又寫着以色列十二個支派的名字。
verses.e: having a great and high wall with twelve gates , and at the gates twelve angels , and names written on them , which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel .

verses.z: 東邊有三門，北邊有三門，南邊有三門，西邊有三門。
verses.e: On the east were three gates , and on the north three gates , and on the south three gates , and on the west three gates .

verses.z: 城牆有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的名字。
verses.e: The wall of the city had twelve foundations , and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb .

verses.z: 對我說話的，拿着金葦子當尺，要量那城和城門城牆。
verses.e: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city , its gates , and its walls .

verses.z: 城是四方的，長寬一樣。天使用葦子量那城，共有四千里，長、寬、高都是一樣；
verses.e: The city is square . Its length is as great as its width . He measured the city with the reed : twelve thousand twelve stadia . Its length , width , and height are equal .

verses.z: 又量了城牆，按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。
verses.e: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits , by the measure of a man , that is , of an angel .

verses.z: 牆是碧玉造的；城是精金的，如同明淨的玻璃。
verses.e: The construction of its wall was jasper . The city was pure gold , like pure glass .

verses.z: 城牆的根基是用各樣寶石修飾的：第一根基是碧玉；第二是藍寶石；第三是綠瑪瑙；第四是綠寶石；
verses.e: The foundations of the city's wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones . The first foundation was jasper , the second sapphire , the third chalcedony , the fourth emerald ,

verses.z: 我又看見聖城新耶路撒冷由上帝那裏從天而降，預備好了，就如新婦妝飾整齊，等候丈夫。
verses.e: I saw the holy city , New Jerusalem , coming down out of heaven from God , prepared like a bride adorned for her husband .

verses.z: 第五是紅瑪瑙；第六是紅寶石；第七是黃璧璽；第八是水蒼玉；第九是紅璧璽；第十是翡翠；第十一是紫瑪瑙；第十二是紫晶。
verses.e: the fifth sardonyx , the sixth sardius , the seventh chrysolite , the eighth beryl , the ninth topaz , the tenth chrysoprase , the eleventh jacinth , and the twelfth amethyst .

verses.z: 十二個門是十二顆珍珠，每門是一顆珍珠。城內的街道是精金，好像明透的玻璃。
verses.e: The twelve gates were twelve pearls . Each one of the gates was made of one pearl . The street of the city was pure gold , like transparent glass .

verses.z: 我未見城內有殿，因主上帝－全能者和羔羊為城的殿。
verses.e: I saw no temple in it , for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple .

verses.z: 那城內又不用日月光照；因有上帝的榮耀光照，又有羔羊為城的燈。
verses.e: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine , for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb .

verses.z: 列國要在城的光裏行走；地上的君王必將自己的榮耀歸與那城。
verses.e: The nations will walk in its light . The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it .

verses.z: 城門白晝總不關閉，在那裏原沒有黑夜。
verses.e: Its gates will in no way be shut by day ( for there will be no night there ) ,

verses.z: 人必將列國的榮耀、尊貴歸與那城。
verses.e: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter .

verses.z: 凡不潔淨的，並那行可憎與虛謊之事的，總不得進那城；只有名字寫在羔羊生命冊上的[才得進去]。
verses.e: There will in no way enter into it anything profane , or one who causes an abomination or a lie , but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life .

verses.z: 我聽見有大聲音從寶座出來說：「看哪，上帝的帳幕在人間。他要與人同住，他們要作他的子民。上帝要親自與他們同在，作他們的上帝。
verses.e: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying , " Behold , God's dwelling is with people ; and he will dwell with them , and they will be his people , and God himself will be with them as their God .

verses.z: 上帝要擦去他們一切的眼淚；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭號、疼痛，因為以前的事都過去了。」
verses.e: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes . Death will be no more ; neither will there be mourning , nor crying , nor pain any more . The first things have passed away . "

verses.z: 坐寶座的說：「看哪，我將一切都更新了！」又說：「你要寫上；因這些話是可信的，是真實的。」
verses.e: He who sits on the throne said , " Behold , I am making all things new . " He said , " Write , for these words of God are faithful and true . "

verses.z: 他又對我說：「都成了！我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是初，我是終。我要將生命泉的水白白賜給那口渴的人喝。
verses.e: He said to me , " I am the Alpha and the Omega , the Beginning and the End . I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life .

verses.z: 得勝的，必承受這些為業：我要作他的上帝，他要作我的兒子。
verses.e: He who overcomes , I will give him these things . I will be his God , and he will be my son .

verses.z: 惟有膽怯的、不信的、可憎的、殺人的、淫亂的、行邪術的、拜偶像的，和一切說謊話的，他們的分就在燒着硫磺的火湖裏；這是第二次的死。」
verses.e: But for the cowardly , unbelieving , sinners , abominable , murderers , sexually immoral , sorcerers , idolaters , and all liars , their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur , which is the second death . "

verses.z: 拿着七個金碗、盛滿末後七災的七位天使中，有一位來對我說：「你到這裏來，我要將新婦，就是羔羊的妻，指給你看。」
verses.e: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came , and he spoke with me , saying , " Come here . I will show you the bride , the Lamb's wife . "

verses.z: 天使又指示我在城內街道當中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，從上帝和羔羊的寶座流出來。
verses.e: He showed me a river of water of life , clear as crystal , proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb ,

verses.z: 他又對我說：「不可封了這書上的預言，因為日期近了。
verses.e: He said to me , " Don't seal up the words of the prophecy of this book , for the time is at hand .

verses.z: 不義的，叫他仍舊不義；污穢的，叫他仍舊污穢；為義的，叫他仍舊為義；聖潔的，叫他仍舊聖潔。」
verses.e: He who acts unjustly , let him act unjustly still . He who is filthy , let him be filthy still . He who is righteous , let him do righteousness still . He who is holy , let him be holy still . "

verses.z: 「看哪，我必快來！賞罰在我，要照各人所行的報應他。
verses.e: " Behold , I am coming soon ! My reward is with me , to repay to each man according to his work .

verses.z: 我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是首先的，我是末後的；我是初，我是終。」
verses.e: I am the Alpha and the Omega , the First and the Last , the Beginning and the End .

verses.z: 那些洗淨自己衣服的有福了！可得權柄能到生命樹那裏，也能從門進城。
verses.e: Blessed are those who do his commandments , that they may have the right to the tree of life , and may enter in by the gates into the city .

verses.z: 城外有那些犬類、行邪術的、淫亂的、殺人的、拜偶像的，並一切喜好說謊言、編造虛謊的。
verses.e: Outside are the dogs , the sorcerers , the sexually immoral , the murderers , the idolaters , and everyone who loves and practices falsehood .

verses.z: 「我－耶穌差遣我的使者為眾教會將這些事向你們證明。我是大衛的根，又是他的後裔。我是明亮的晨星。」
verses.e: I , Jesus , have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies . I am the root and the offspring of David , the Bright and Morning Star . "

verses.z: [聖]靈和新婦都說：「來！」聽見的人也該說：「來！」口渴的人也當來；願意的，都可以白白取生命的水[喝]。
verses.e: The Spirit and the bride say , " Come ! " He who hears , let him say , " Come ! " He who is thirsty , let him come . He who desires , let him take the water of life freely .

verses.z: 我向一切聽見這書上預言的作見證，若有人在這預言上加添甚麼，上帝必將寫在這書上的災禍加在他身上；
verses.e: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book : if anyone adds to them , God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book .

verses.z: 這書上的預言，若有人刪去甚麼，上帝必從這書上所寫的生命樹和聖城刪去他的分。
verses.e: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy , God will take away his part from the tree of life , and out of the holy city , which are written in this book .

verses.z: 在河這邊與那邊有生命樹，結十二樣果子，每月都結果子；樹上的葉子乃為醫治萬民。
verses.e: in the middle of its street . On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life , bearing twelve kinds of fruits , yielding its fruit every month . The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations .

verses.z: 證明這事的說：「是了，我必快來！」阿們！主耶穌啊，我願你來！
verses.e: He who testifies these things says , " Yes , I am coming soon . " Amen ! Yes , come , Lord Jesus !

verses.z: 願主耶穌的恩惠[常]與眾聖徒同在。阿們！
verses.e: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints . Amen .

verses.z: 以後再沒有咒詛；在城裏有上帝和羔羊的寶座；他的僕人都要事奉他，
verses.e: There will be no curse any more . The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it , and his servants will serve him .

verses.z: 也要見他的面。他的名字必寫在他們的額上。
verses.e: They will see his face , and his name will be on their foreheads .

verses.z: 不再有黑夜；他們也不用燈光、日光，因為主上帝要光照他們。他們要作王，直到永永遠遠。
verses.e: There will be no night , and they need no lamp light or sun light ; for the Lord God will illuminate them . They will reign forever and ever .

verses.z: 天使又對我說：「這些話是真實可信的。主就是眾先知被感之靈的上帝，差遣他的使者，將那必要快成的事指示他僕人。」
verses.e: He said to me , " These words are faithful and true . The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon . "

verses.z: 「看哪，我必快來！凡遵守這書上預言的有福了！」
verses.e: " Behold , I am coming soon ! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book . "

verses.z: 這些事是我－約翰所聽見、所看見的；我既聽見、看見了，就在指示我的天使腳前俯伏要拜他。
verses.e: Now I , John , am the one who heard and saw these things . When I heard and saw , I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things .

verses.z: 他對我說：「千萬不可！我與你和你的弟兄眾先知，並那些守這書上言語的人，同是作僕人的。你要敬拜上帝。」
verses.e: He said to me , " You must not do that ! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers , the prophets , and with those who keep the words of this book . Worship God . "

verses.z: 「你要寫信給撒狄教會的使者，說：『那有上帝的七靈和七星的，說：我知道你的行為，按名你是活的，其實是死的。
verses.e: " And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write : " He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things : " I know your works , that you have a reputation of being alive , but you are dead .

verses.z: 你既遵守我忍耐的道，我必在普天下人受試煉的時候，保守你免去你的試煉。
verses.e: Because you kept my command to endure , I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world , to test those who dwell on the earth .

verses.z: 我必快來，你要持守你所有的，免得人奪去你的冠冕。
verses.e: I am coming quickly ! Hold firmly that which you have , so that no one takes your crown .

verses.z: 得勝的，我要叫他在我上帝殿中作柱子，他也必不再從那裏出去。我又要將我上帝的名和我上帝城的名（這城就是從天上、從我上帝那裏降下來的新耶路撒冷），並我的新名，都寫在他上面。
verses.e: He who overcomes , I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God , and he will go out from there no more . I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God , the new Jerusalem , which comes down out of heaven from my God , and my own new name .

verses.z: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
verses.e: He who has an ear , let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies .

verses.z: 「你要寫信給老底嘉教會的使者，說：『那為阿們的，為誠信真實見證的，在上帝創造萬物之上為元首的，說：
verses.e: " To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write : " The Amen , the Faithful and True Witness , the Beginning of God's creation , says these things :

verses.z: 我知道你的行為，你也不冷也不熱；我巴不得你或冷或熱。
verses.e: " I know your works , that you are neither cold nor hot . I wish you were cold or hot .

verses.z: 你既[如]溫[水]，也不冷也不熱，所以我必從我口中把你吐出去。
verses.e: So , because you are lukewarm , and neither hot nor cold , I will vomit you out of my mouth .

verses.z: 你說：我是富足，已經發了財，一樣都不缺；卻不知道你是那困苦、可憐、貧窮、瞎眼、赤身的。
verses.e: Because you say , ' I am rich , and have gotten riches , and have need of nothing , ' and don't know that you are the wretched one , miserable , poor , blind , and naked ;

verses.z: 我勸你向我買火煉的金子，叫你富足；又買白衣穿上，叫你赤身的羞恥不露出來；又買眼藥擦你的眼睛，使你能看見。
verses.e: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire , that you may become rich ; and white garments , that you may clothe yourself , and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed ; and eye salve to anoint your eyes , that you may see .

verses.z: 凡我所疼愛的，我就責備管教他；所以你要發熱心，也要悔改。
verses.e: As many as I love , I reprove and chasten . Be zealous therefore , and repent .

verses.z: 你要警醒，堅固那剩下將要衰微的；因我見你的行為，在我上帝面前，沒有一樣是完全的。
verses.e: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain , which you were about to throw away , for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God .

verses.z: 看哪，我站在門外叩門，若有聽見我聲音就開門的，我要進到他那裏去，我與他，他與我一同坐席。
verses.e: Behold , I stand at the door and knock . If anyone hears my voice and opens the door , then I will come in to him and will dine with him , and he with me .

verses.z: 得勝的，我要賜他在我寶座上與我同坐，就如我得了勝，在我父的寶座上與他同坐一般。
verses.e: He who overcomes , I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne , as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne .

verses.z: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
verses.e: He who has an ear , let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies . "

verses.z: 所以要回想你是怎樣領受、怎樣聽見的，又要遵守，並要悔改。若不警醒，我必臨到你那裏，如同賊一樣。我幾時臨到，你也決不能知道。
verses.e: Remember therefore how you have received and heard . Keep it and repent . If therefore you won't watch , I will come as a thief , and you won't know what hour I will come upon you .

verses.z: 然而在撒狄，你還有幾名是未曾污穢自己衣服的，他們要穿白衣與我同行，因為他們是配得過的。
verses.e: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn't defile their garments . They will walk with me in white , for they are worthy .

verses.z: 凡得勝的必這樣穿白衣，我也必不從生命冊上塗抹他的名；且要在我父面前，和我父眾使者面前，認他的名。
verses.e: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments , and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life , and I will confess his name before my Father , and before his angels .

verses.z: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
verses.e: He who has an ear , let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies .

verses.z: 「你要寫信給非拉鐵非教會的使者，說：『那聖潔、真實、拿着大衛的鑰匙、開了就沒有人能關、關了就沒有人能開的，說：
verses.e: " To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write : " He who is holy , he who is true , he who has the key of David , he who opens and no one can shut , and who shuts and no one opens , says these things :

verses.z: 我知道你的行為，你略有一點力量，也曾遵守我的道，沒有棄絕我的名。看哪，我在你面前給你一個敞開的門，是無人能關的。
verses.e: " I know your works ( behold , I have set before you an open door , which no one can shut ) , that you have a little power , and kept my word , and didn't deny my name .

verses.z: 那撒但一會的，自稱是猶太人，其實不是猶太人，乃是說謊話的，我要使他們來，在你腳前下拜，也使他們知道我是已經愛你了。
verses.e: Behold , I make some of the synagogue of Satan , of those who say they are Jews , and they are not , but lie — behold , I will make them to come and worship before your feet , and to know that I have loved you .

verses.z: 此後，我觀看，見天上有門開了。我初次聽見好像吹號的聲音，對我說：「你上到這裏來，我要將以後必成的事指示你。」
verses.e: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven ; and the first voice that I heard , like a trumpet speaking with me , was one saying , " Come up here , and I will show you the things which must happen after this . "

verses.z: 那二十四位長老就俯伏在坐寶座的面前敬拜那活到永永遠遠的，又把他們的冠冕放在寶座前，說：
verses.e: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever , and throw their crowns before the throne , saying ,

verses.z: 我們的主，我們的上帝，你是配得榮耀、尊貴、權柄的；因為你創造了萬物，並且萬物是因你的旨意被創造而有的。
verses.e: " Worthy are you , our Lord and God , the Holy One , to receive the glory , the honor , and the power , for you created all things , and because of your desire they existed and were created ! "

verses.z: 我立刻被[聖]靈感動，見有一個寶座安置在天上，又有一位坐在寶座上。
verses.e: Immediately I was in the Spirit . Behold , there was a throne set in heaven , and one sitting on the throne

verses.z: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和紅寶石；又有虹圍着寶座，好像綠寶石。
verses.e: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius . There was a rainbow around the throne , like an emerald to look at .

verses.z: 寶座的周圍又有二十四個座位；其上坐着二十四位長老，身穿白衣，頭上戴着金冠冕。
verses.e: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones . On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting , dressed in white garments , with crowns of gold on their heads .

verses.z: 有閃電、聲音、雷轟從寶座中發出；又有七盞火燈在寶座前點着；這七燈就是上帝的七靈。
verses.e: Out of the throne proceed lightnings , sounds , and thunders . There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne , which are the seven Spirits of God .

verses.z: 寶座前好像一個玻璃海，如同水晶。寶座中和寶座周圍有四個活物，前後遍體都滿了眼睛。
verses.e: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass , similar to crystal . In the middle of the throne , and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind .

verses.z: 第一個活物像獅子，第二個像牛犢，第三個臉面像人，第四個像飛鷹。
verses.e: The first creature was like a lion , the second creature like a calf , the third creature had a face like a man , and the fourth was like a flying eagle .

verses.z: 四活物各有六個翅膀，遍體內外都滿了眼睛。他們晝夜不住地說：聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！主上帝是昔在、今在、以後[永]在的全能者。
verses.e: The four living creatures , each one of them having six wings , are full of eyes around and within . They have no rest day and night , saying , " Holy , holy , holy is the Lord God , the Almighty , who was and who is and who is to come ! "

verses.z: 每逢四活物將榮耀、尊貴、感謝歸給那坐在寶座上、活到永永遠遠者的時候，
verses.e: When the living creatures give glory , honor , and thanks to him who sits on the throne , to him who lives forever and ever ,

verses.z: 我看見坐寶座的右手中有書卷，裏外都寫着字，用七印封嚴了。
verses.e: I saw , in the right hand of him who sat on the throne , a book written inside and outside , sealed shut with seven seals .

verses.z: 又叫他們成為國民，作祭司歸於上帝，在地上執掌王權。
verses.e: and made us kings and priests to our God ; and we will reign on the earth . "

verses.z: 我又看見且聽見，寶座與活物並長老的周圍有許多天使的聲音；他們的數目有千千萬萬，
verses.e: I looked , and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne , the living creatures , and the elders . The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands , and thousands of thousands ,

verses.z: 大聲說：曾被殺的羔羊是配得權柄、豐富、智慧、能力、尊貴、榮耀、頌讚的。
verses.e: saying with a loud voice , " Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power , wealth , wisdom , strength , honor , glory , and blessing ! "

verses.z: 我又聽見在天上、地上、地底下、滄海裏，和天地間一切所有被造之物，都說：但願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀、權勢都歸給坐寶座的和羔羊，直到永永遠遠！
verses.e: I heard every created thing which is in heaven , on the earth , under the earth , on the sea , and everything in them , saying , " To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing , the honor , the glory , and the dominion , forever and ever ! Amen ! "

verses.z: 四活物就說：「阿們！」眾長老也俯伏敬拜。
verses.e: The four living creatures said , " Amen ! " Then the elders fell down and worshiped .

verses.z: 我又看見一位大力的天使大聲宣傳說：「有誰配展開那書卷，揭開那七印呢？」
verses.e: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice , " Who is worthy to open the book , and to break its seals ? "

verses.z: 在天上、地上、地底下，沒有能展開、能觀看那書卷的。
verses.e: No one in heaven above , or on the earth , or under the earth , was able to open the book or to look in it .

verses.z: 因為沒有配展開、配觀看那書卷的，我就大哭。
verses.e: Then I wept much , because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it .

verses.z: 長老中有一位對我說：「不要哭！看哪，猶大支派中的獅子，大衛的根，他已得勝，能以展開那書卷，揭開那七印。」
verses.e: One of the elders said to me , " Don't weep . Behold , the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah , the Root of David , has overcome : he who opens the book and its seven seals . "

verses.z: 我又看見寶座與四活物，並長老之中有羔羊站立，像是被殺過的，有七角七眼，就是上帝的七靈，奉差遣往普天下去的。
verses.e: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures , and in the middle of the elders , a Lamb standing , as though it had been slain , having seven horns and seven eyes , which are the seven Spirits of God , sent out into all the earth .

verses.z: 這羔羊前來，從坐寶座的右手裏拿了書卷。
verses.e: Then he came , and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne .

verses.z: 他既拿了書卷，四活物和二十四位長老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴和盛滿了香的金爐；這香就是眾聖徒的祈禱。
verses.e: Now when he had taken the book , the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb , each one having a harp , and golden bowls full of incense , which are the prayers of the saints .

verses.z: 他們唱新歌，說：你配拿書卷，配揭開七印；因為你曾被殺，用自己的血從各族、各方、各民、各國中買了人來，叫他們歸於上帝，
verses.e: They sang a new song , saying , " You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals , for you were killed , and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe , language , people , and nation ,

verses.z: 我看見羔羊揭開七印中第一印的時候，就聽見四活物中的一個活物，聲音如雷，說：「你來！」
verses.e: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals , and I heard one of the four living creatures saying , as with a voice of thunder , " Come and see ! "

verses.z: 大聲喊着說：「聖潔真實的主啊，你不審判住在地上的人，給我們伸流血的冤，要等到幾時呢？」
verses.e: They cried with a loud voice , saying , " How long , Master , the holy and true , until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth ? "

verses.z: 於是有白衣賜給他們各人；又有話對他們說，還要安息片時，等着一同作僕人的和他們的弟兄也像他們被殺，滿足了數目。
verses.e: A long white robe was given to each of them . They were told that they should rest yet for a while , until their fellow servants and their brothers , who would also be killed even as they were , should complete their course .

verses.z: 揭開第六印的時候，我又看見地大震動，日頭變黑像毛布，滿月變[紅]像血，
verses.e: I saw when he opened the sixth seal , and there was a great earthquake . The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair , and the whole moon became as blood .

verses.z: 天上的星辰墜落於地，如同無花果樹被大風搖動，落下未熟的果子一樣。
verses.e: The stars of the sky fell to the earth , like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind .

verses.z: 天就挪移，好像書卷被捲起來；山嶺海島都被挪移離開本位。
verses.e: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up . Every mountain and island was moved out of its place .

verses.z: 地上的君王、臣宰、將軍、富戶、壯士，和一切為奴的、自主的，都藏在山洞和巖石穴裏，
verses.e: The kings of the earth , the princes , the commanding officers , the rich , the strong , and every slave and free person , hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains .

verses.z: 向山和巖石說：「倒在我們身上吧！把我們藏起來，躲避坐寶座者的面目和羔羊的忿怒；
verses.e: They told the mountains and the rocks , " Fall on us , and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne , and from the wrath of the Lamb ,

verses.z: 因為他們忿怒的大日到了，誰能站得住呢？」
verses.e: for the great day of his wrath has come , and who is able to stand ? "

verses.z: 我就觀看，見有一匹白馬；騎在馬上的，拿着弓，並有冠冕賜給他。他便出來，勝了又要勝。
verses.e: Then a white horse appeared , and he who sat on it had a bow . A crown was given to him , and he came out conquering , and to conquer .

verses.z: 揭開第二印的時候，我聽見第二個活物說：「你來！」
verses.e: When he opened the second seal , I heard the second living creature saying , " Come ! "

verses.z: 就另有一匹馬出來，是紅的，有權柄給了那騎馬的，可以從地上奪去太平，使人彼此相殺；又有一把大刀賜給他。
verses.e: Another came out , a red horse . To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth , and that they should kill one another . There was given to him a great sword .

verses.z: 揭開第三印的時候，我聽見第三個活物說：「你來！」我就觀看，見有一匹黑馬；騎在馬上的，手裏拿着天平。
verses.e: When he opened the third seal , I heard the third living creature saying , " Come and see ! " And behold , a black horse , and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand .

verses.z: 我聽見在四活物中似乎有聲音說：「一錢銀子買一升麥子，一錢銀子買三升大麥；油和酒不可糟蹋。」
verses.e: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying , " A choenix of wheat for a denarius , and three choenix of barley for a denarius ! Don't damage the oil and the wine ! "

verses.z: 揭開第四印的時候，我聽見第四個活物說：「你來！」
verses.e: When he opened the fourth seal , I heard the fourth living creature saying , " Come and see ! "

verses.z: 我就觀看，見有一匹灰色馬；騎在馬上的，名字叫作死，陰府也隨着他；有權柄賜給他們，可以用刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫、野獸，殺害地上四分之一的人。
verses.e: And behold , a pale horse , and the name of he who sat on it was Death . Hades followed with him . Authority over one fourth of the earth , to kill with the sword , with famine , with death , and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him .

verses.z: 揭開第五印的時候，我看見在祭壇底下，有為上帝的道、並為作見證被殺之人的靈魂，
verses.e: When he opened the fifth seal , I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God , and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had .

verses.z: 此後，我看見四位天使站在地的四角，執掌地上四方的風，叫風不吹在地上、海上，和樹上。
verses.e: After this , I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth , holding the four winds of the earth , so that no wind would blow on the earth , or on the sea , or on any tree .

verses.z: 大聲喊着說：「願救恩歸與坐在寶座上我們的上帝，也歸與羔羊！」
verses.e: They cried with a loud voice , saying , " Salvation be to our God , who sits on the throne , and to the Lamb ! "

verses.z: 眾天使都站在寶座和眾長老並四活物的周圍，在寶座前，面伏於地，敬拜上帝，
verses.e: All the angels were standing around the throne , the elders , and the four living creatures ; and they fell on their faces before his throne , and worshiped God ,

verses.z: 說：阿們！頌讚、榮耀、智慧、感謝、尊貴、權柄、大力都歸與我們的上帝，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
verses.e: saying , " Amen ! Blessing , glory , wisdom , thanksgiving , honor , power , and might , be to our God forever and ever ! Amen . "

verses.z: 長老中有一位問我說：「這些穿白衣的是誰？是從哪裏來的？」
verses.e: One of the elders answered , saying to me , " These who are arrayed in the white robes , who are they , and where did they come from ? "

verses.z: 我對他說：「我主，你知道。」他向我說：「這些人是從大患難中出來的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白淨了。
verses.e: I told him , " My lord , you know . " He said to me , " These are those who came out of the great suffering . They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb's blood .

verses.z: 所以，他們在上帝寶座前，晝夜在他殿中事奉他。坐寶座的要用帳幕覆庇他們。
verses.e: Therefore they are before the throne of God , and they serve him day and night in his temple . He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them .

verses.z: 他們不再飢，不再渴；日頭和炎熱也必不傷害他們。
verses.e: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more . The sun won't beat on them , nor any heat ;

verses.z: 因為寶座中的羔羊必牧養他們，領他們到生命水的泉源；上帝也必擦去他們一切的眼淚。」
verses.e: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters . And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes . "

verses.z: 我又看見另有一位天使，從日出之地上來，拿着永生上帝的印。他就向那得着權柄能傷害地和海的四位天使大聲喊着說：
verses.e: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise , having the seal of the living God . He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea ,

verses.z: 「地與海並樹木，你們不可傷害，等我們印了我們上帝眾僕人的額。」
verses.e: saying , " Don't harm the earth , the sea , or the trees , until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads ! "

verses.z: 我聽見以色列人各支派中受印的數目有十四萬四千。
verses.e: I heard the number of those who were sealed , one hundred forty-four thousand , sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel :

verses.z: 猶大支派中受印的有一萬二千；呂便支派中有一萬二千；迦得支派中有一萬二千；
verses.e: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed , of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand , of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand ,

verses.z: 亞設支派中有一萬二千；拿弗他利支派中有一萬二千；瑪拿西支派中有一萬二千；
verses.e: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand , of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand , of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand ,

verses.z: 西緬支派中有一萬二千；利未支派中有一萬二千；以薩迦支派中有一萬二千；
verses.e: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand , of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand , of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand ,

verses.z: 西布倫支派中有一萬二千；約瑟支派中有一萬二千；便雅憫支派中受印的有一萬二千。
verses.e: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand , of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand , and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed .

verses.z: 此後，我觀看，見有許多的人，沒有人能數過來，是從各國、各族、各民、各方來的，站在寶座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕樹枝，
verses.e: After these things I looked , and behold , a great multitude which no man could count , out of every nation and of all tribes , peoples , and languages , standing before the throne and before the Lamb , dressed in white robes , with palm branches in their hands .

verses.z: 羔羊揭開第七印的時候，天上寂靜約有二刻。
verses.e: When he opened the seventh seal , there was silence in heaven for about half an hour .

verses.z: 第三位天使吹號，就有燒着的大星，好像火把從天上落下來，落在江河的三分之一和眾水的泉源上。
verses.e: The third angel sounded , and a great star fell from the sky , burning like a torch , and it fell on one third of the rivers , and on the springs of water .

verses.z: （這星名叫「茵蔯」。）眾水的三分之一變為茵蔯，因水變苦，就死了許多人。
verses.e: The name of the star is " Wormwood . " One third of the waters became wormwood . Many people died from the waters , because they were made bitter .

verses.z: 第四位天使吹號，日頭的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一都被擊打，以致日月星的三分之一黑暗了，白晝的三分之一沒有光，黑夜也是這樣。
verses.e: The fourth angel sounded , and one third of the sun was struck , and one third of the moon , and one third of the stars , so that one third of them would be darkened ; and the day wouldn't shine for one third of it , and the night in the same way .

verses.z: 我又看見一個鷹飛在空中，並聽見牠大聲說：「三位天使要吹那其餘的號。你們住在地上的民，禍哉！禍哉！禍哉！」
verses.e: I saw , and I heard an eagle , flying in mid heaven , saying with a loud voice , " Woe ! Woe ! Woe to those who dwell on the earth , because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels , who are yet to sound ! "

verses.z: 我看見那站在上帝面前的七位天使，有七枝號賜給他們。
verses.e: I saw the seven angels who stand before God , and seven trumpets were given to them .

verses.z: 另有一位天使，拿着金香爐來，站在祭壇旁邊。有許多香賜給他，要和眾聖徒的祈禱一同獻在寶座前的金壇上。
verses.e: Another angel came and stood over the altar , having a golden censer . Much incense was given to him , that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne .

verses.z: 那香的煙和眾聖徒的祈禱從天使的手中一同升到上帝面前。
verses.e: The smoke of the incense , with the prayers of the saints , went up before God out of the angel's hand .

verses.z: 天使拿着香爐，盛滿了壇上的火，倒在地上；隨有雷轟、大聲、閃電、地震。
verses.e: The angel took the censer , and he filled it with the fire of the altar , then threw it on the earth . Thunders , sounds , lightnings , and an earthquake followed .

verses.z: 拿着七枝號的七位天使就預備要吹。
verses.e: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound .

verses.z: 第一位天使吹號，就有雹子與火攙着血丟在地上；地的三分之一和樹的三分之一被燒了，一切的青草也被燒了。
verses.e: The first sounded , and there followed hail and fire , mixed with blood , and they were thrown to the earth . One third of the earth was burned up , and one third of the trees were burned up , and all green grass was burned up .

verses.z: 第二位天使吹號，就有彷彿火燒着的大山扔在海中；海的三分之一變成血，
verses.e: The second angel sounded , and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea . One third of the sea became blood ,

verses.z: 海中的活物死了三分之一，船隻也壞了三分之一。
verses.e: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died . One third of the ships were destroyed .

verses.z: 第五位天使吹號，我就看見一個星從天落到地上，有無底坑的鑰匙賜給它。
verses.e: The fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth . The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him .

verses.z: 有尾巴像蠍子，[尾巴上]的毒鉤能傷人五個月。
verses.e: They have tails like those of scorpions , with stingers . In their tails they have power to harm men for five months .

verses.z: 有無底坑的使者作牠們的王，按着希伯來話，名叫亞巴頓，希臘話，名叫亞玻倫。
verses.e: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss . His name in Hebrew is " Abaddon " , but in Greek , he has the name " Apollyon " .

verses.z: 第一樣災禍過去了，還有兩樣災禍要來。
verses.e: The first woe is past . Behold , there are still two woes coming after this .

verses.z: 第六位天使吹號，我就聽見有聲音從上帝面前金壇的四角出來，
verses.e: The sixth angel sounded . I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God ,

verses.z: 吩咐那吹號的第六位天使，說：「把那捆綁在幼發拉底大河的四個使者釋放了。」
verses.e: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet , " Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates ! "

verses.z: 那四個使者就被釋放；他們原是預備好了，到某年某月某日某時，要殺人的三分之一。
verses.e: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year , so that they might kill one third of mankind .

verses.z: 馬軍有二萬萬；他們的數目我聽見了。
verses.e: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million . I heard the number of them .

verses.z: 我在異象中看見那些馬和騎馬的，騎馬的胸前有甲如火，與紫瑪瑙並硫磺。馬的頭好像獅子頭，有火、有煙、有硫磺從馬的口中出來。
verses.e: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them , having breastplates of fiery red , hyacinth blue , and sulfur yellow ; and the horses ' heads resembled lions ' heads . Out of their mouths proceed fire , smoke , and sulfur .

verses.z: 口中所出來的火與煙並硫磺，這三樣災殺了人的三分之一。
verses.e: By these three plagues , one third of mankind was killed : by the fire , the smoke , and the sulfur , which proceeded out of their mouths .

verses.z: 這馬的能力是在口裏和尾巴上；因這尾巴像蛇，並且有頭用以害人。
verses.e: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails . For their tails are like serpents , and have heads ; and with them they harm .

verses.z: 它開了無底坑，便有煙從坑裏往上冒，好像大火爐的煙；日頭和天空都因這煙昏暗了。
verses.e: He opened the pit of the abyss , and smoke went up out of the pit , like the smoke from a burning furnace . The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit .

verses.z: 其餘未曾被這些災所殺的人仍舊不悔改自己手所做的，還是去拜鬼魔和那些不能看、不能聽、不能走，金、銀、銅、木、石的偶像，
verses.e: The rest of mankind , who were not killed with these plagues , didn't repent of the works of their hands , that they wouldn't worship demons , and the idols of gold , and of silver , and of brass , and of stone , and of wood , which can't see , hear , or walk .

verses.z: 又不悔改他們那些凶殺、邪術、姦淫、偷竊的事。
verses.e: They didn't repent of their murders , their sorceries , their sexual immorality , or their thefts .

verses.z: 有蝗蟲從煙中出來，飛到地上；有能力賜給牠們，好像地上蠍子的能力一樣，
verses.e: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth , and power was given to them , as the scorpions of the earth have power .

verses.z: 並且吩咐牠們說，不可傷害地上的草和各樣青物，並一切樹木，惟獨要傷害額上沒有上帝印記的人。
verses.e: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth , neither any green thing , neither any tree , but only those people who don't have God's seal on their foreheads .

verses.z: 但不許蝗蟲害死他們，只叫他們受痛苦五個月。這痛苦就像蠍子螫人的痛苦一樣。
verses.e: They were given power , not to kill them , but to torment them for five months . Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person .

verses.z: 在那些日子，人要求死，決不得死；願意死，死卻遠避他們。
verses.e: In those days people will seek death , and will in no way find it . They will desire to die , and death will flee from them .

verses.z: 蝗蟲的形狀，好像預備出戰的馬一樣，頭上戴的好像金冠冕，臉面好像[男]人的臉面，
verses.e: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war . On their heads were something like golden crowns , and their faces were like people's faces .

verses.z: 頭髮像女人的頭髮，牙齒像獅子的牙齒。
verses.e: They had hair like women's hair , and their teeth were like those of lions .

verses.z: 胸前有甲，好像鐵甲。牠們翅膀的聲音，好像許多車馬奔跑上陣的聲音。
verses.e: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron . The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war .

verses.z: 耶穌基督的僕人保羅，奉召為使徒，特派傳上帝的福音。
verses.e: Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , set apart for the Good News of God ,

verses.z: 在禱告之間常常懇求，或者照上帝的旨意，終能得平坦的道路往你們那裏去。
verses.e: requesting , if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you .

verses.z: 因為我切切地想見你們，要把些屬靈的恩賜分給你們，使你們可以堅固；
verses.e: For I long to see you , that I may impart to you some spiritual gift , to the end that you may be established ;

verses.z: 這樣，我在你們中間，因你與我彼此的信心，就可以同得安慰。
verses.e: that is , that I with you may be encouraged in you , each of us by the other's faith , both yours and mine .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道，我屢次定意往你們那裏去，要在你們中間得些果子，如同在其餘的外邦人中一樣；只是到如今仍有阻隔。
verses.e: Now I don't desire to have you unaware , brothers , that I often planned to come to you ( and was hindered so far ) , that I might have some fruit among you also , even as among the rest of the Gentiles .

verses.z: 無論是希臘人、化外人、聰明人、愚拙人，我都欠他們的債，
verses.e: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners , both to the wise and to the foolish .

verses.z: 所以情願盡我的力量，將福音也傳給你們在羅馬的人。
verses.e: So as much as is in me , I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome .

verses.z: 我不以福音為恥；這福音本是上帝的大能，要救一切相信的，先是猶太人，後是希臘人。
verses.e: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ , because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes , for the Jew first , and also for the Greek .

verses.z: 因為上帝的義正在這福音上顯明出來；這義是本於信，以至於信。如[經上]所記：「義人必因信得生。」
verses.e: For in it is revealed God's righteousness from faith to faith . As it is written , " But the righteous shall live by faith . "

verses.z: 原來，上帝的忿怒從天上顯明在一切不虔不義的人身上，就是那些行不義阻擋真理的人。
verses.e: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness ,

verses.z: 上帝的事情，人所能知道的，原顯明在人心裏，因為上帝已經給他們顯明。
verses.e: because that which is known of God is revealed in them , for God revealed it to them .

verses.z: 這福音是上帝從前藉眾先知在聖經上所應許的，
verses.e: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures ,

verses.z: 自從造天地以來，上帝的永能和神性是明明可知的，雖是眼不能見，但藉着所造之物就可以曉得，叫人無可推諉。
verses.e: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen , being perceived through the things that are made , even his everlasting power and divinity , that they may be without excuse .

verses.z: 因為，他們雖然知道上帝，卻不當作上帝榮耀他，也不感謝他。他們的思念變為虛妄，無知的心就昏暗了。
verses.e: Because knowing God , they didn't glorify him as God , and didn't give thanks , but became vain in their reasoning , and their senseless heart was darkened .

verses.z: 自稱為聰明，反成了愚拙，
verses.e: Professing themselves to be wise , they became fools ,

verses.z: 將不能朽壞之上帝的榮耀變為偶像，彷彿必朽壞的人和飛禽、走獸、昆蟲的樣式。
verses.e: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man , and of birds , four-footed animals , and creeping things .

verses.z: 所以，上帝任憑他們逞着心裏的情慾行污穢的事，以致彼此玷辱自己的身體。
verses.e: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness , that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves ;

verses.z: 他們將上帝的真實變為虛謊，去敬拜事奉受造之物，不敬奉那造物的主－主乃是可稱頌的，直到永遠。阿們！
verses.e: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie , and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator , who is blessed forever . Amen .

verses.z: 因此，上帝任憑他們放縱可羞恥的情慾。他們的女人把順性的用處變為逆性的用處；
verses.e: For this reason , God gave them up to vile passions . For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature .

verses.z: 男人也是如此，棄了女人順性的用處，慾火攻心，彼此貪戀，男和男行可羞恥的事，就在自己身上受這妄為當得的報應。
verses.e: Likewise also the men , leaving the natural function of the woman , burned in their lust toward one another , men doing what is inappropriate with men , and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error .

verses.z: 他們既然故意不認識上帝，上帝就任憑他們存邪僻的心，行那些不合理的事；
verses.e: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge , God gave them up to a reprobate mind , to do those things which are not fitting ;

verses.z: 裝滿了各樣不義、邪惡、貪婪、惡毒；滿心是嫉妒、凶殺、爭競、詭詐、毒恨；
verses.e: being filled with all unrighteousness , sexual immorality , wickedness , covetousness , malice ; full of envy , murder , strife , deceit , evil habits , secret slanderers ,

verses.z: 論到他兒子－我主耶穌基督。按肉體說，是從大衛後裔生的；
verses.e: concerning his Son , who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh ,

verses.z: 又是讒毀的、背後說人的、怨恨上帝的、侮慢人的、狂傲的、自誇的、捏造惡事的、違背父母的、
verses.e: backbiters , hateful to God , insolent , arrogant , boastful , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,

verses.z: 無知的、背約的、無親情的、不憐憫人的。
verses.e: without understanding , covenant breakers , without natural affection , unforgiving , unmerciful ;

verses.z: 他們雖知道上帝判定行這樣事的人是當死的，然而他們不但自己去行，還喜歡別人去行。
verses.e: who , knowing the ordinance of God , that those who practice such things are worthy of death , not only do the same , but also approve of those who practice them .

verses.z: 按聖善的靈說，因從死裏復活，以大能顯明是上帝的兒子。
verses.e: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness , by the resurrection from the dead , Jesus Christ our Lord ,

verses.z: 我們從他受了恩惠並使徒的職分，在萬國之中叫人為他的名信服真道；
verses.e: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name's sake ;

verses.z: 其中也有你們這蒙召屬耶穌基督的人。
verses.e: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ ;

verses.z: 我寫信給你們在羅馬、為上帝所愛、奉召作聖徒的眾人。願恩惠、平安從我們的父上帝並主耶穌基督歸與你們！
verses.e: to all who are in Rome , beloved of God , called to be saints : Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 第一，我靠着耶穌基督，為你們眾人感謝我的上帝，因你們的信德傳遍了天下。
verses.e: First , I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you , that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world .

verses.z: 我在他兒子福音上，用心靈所事奉的上帝可以見證，我怎樣不住地提到你們；
verses.e: For God is my witness , whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son , how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers ,

verses.z: 弟兄們，我心裏所願的，向上帝所求的，是要以色列人得救。
verses.e: Brothers , my heart's desire and my prayer to God is for Israel , that they may be saved .

verses.z: 因為，人心裏相信就可以稱義，口裏承認就可以得救。
verses.e: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation .

verses.z: 經上說：「凡信他的人必不至於羞愧。」
verses.e: For the Scripture says , " Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed . "

verses.z: 猶太人和希臘人並沒有分別，因為眾人同有一位主；他也厚待一切求告他的人。
verses.e: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek ; for the same Lord is Lord of all , and is rich to all who call on him .

verses.z: 因為「凡求告主名的就必得救」。
verses.e: For , " Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved . "

verses.z: 然而，人未曾信他，怎能求他呢？未曾聽見他，怎能信他呢？沒有傳道的，怎能聽見呢？
verses.e: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed ? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard ? How will they hear without a preacher ?

verses.z: 若沒有奉差遣，怎能傳道呢？如[經]上所記：「報福音、傳喜信的人，他們的腳[蹤]何等佳美！」
verses.e: And how will they preach unless they are sent ? As it is written : " How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace , who bring glad tidings of good things ! "

verses.z: 只是人沒有都聽從福音，因為以賽亞說：「主啊，我們所傳的有誰信呢？」
verses.e: But they didn't all listen to the glad news . For Isaiah says , " Lord , who has believed our report ? "

verses.z: 可見，信道是從聽道來的，聽道是從基督的話來的。
verses.e: So faith comes by hearing , and hearing by the word of God .

verses.z: 但我說，人沒有聽見嗎？誠然聽見了。他們的聲音傳遍天下；他們的言語傳到地極。
verses.e: But I say , didn't they hear ? Yes , most certainly , " Their sound went out into all the earth , their words to the ends of the world . "

verses.z: 我再說，以色列人不知道嗎？先有摩西說：我要用那不成子民的惹動你們的憤恨；我要用那無知的民觸動你們的怒氣。
verses.e: But I ask , didn't Israel know ? First Moses says , " I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation . I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding . "

verses.z: 我可以證明，他們向上帝有熱心，但不是按着真知識；
verses.e: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God , but not according to knowledge .

verses.z: 又有以賽亞放膽說：沒有尋找我的，我叫他們遇見；沒有訪問我的，我向他們顯現。
verses.e: Isaiah is very bold and says , " I was found by those who didn't seek me . I was revealed to those who didn't ask for me . "

verses.z: 至於以色列人，他說：「我整天伸手招呼那悖逆頂嘴的百姓。」
verses.e: But about Israel he says , " All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people . "

verses.z: 因為不知道上帝的義，想要立自己的義，就不服上帝的義了。
verses.e: For being ignorant of God's righteousness , and seeking to establish their own righteousness , they didn't subject themselves to the righteousness of God .

verses.z: 律法的總結就是基督，使凡信他的都得着義。
verses.e: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes .

verses.z: 摩西寫着說：「人若行那出於律法的義，就必因此活着。」
verses.e: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law , " The one who does them will live by them . "

verses.z: 惟有出於信心的義如此說：「你不要心裏說：誰要升到天上去呢？（就是要領下基督來；）
verses.e: But the righteousness which is of faith says this , " Don't say in your heart , ' Who will ascend into heaven ? ' ( that is , to bring Christ down ) ;

verses.z: 誰要下到陰間去呢？（就是要領基督從死裏上來。）」
verses.e: or , ' Who will descend into the abyss ? ' ( that is , to bring Christ up from the dead . ) "

verses.z: 他到底怎麼說呢？他說：這道離你不遠，正在你口裏，在你心裏－（就是我們所傳信[主]的道。）
verses.e: But what does it say ? " The word is near you , in your mouth and in your heart ; " that is , the word of faith which we preach :

verses.z: 你若口裏認耶穌為主，心裏信上帝叫他從死裏復活，就必得救。
verses.e: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead , you will be saved .

verses.z: 我且說，上帝棄絕了他的百姓嗎？斷乎沒有！因為我也是以色列人，亞伯拉罕的後裔，屬便雅憫支派的。
verses.e: I ask then , did God reject his people ? May it never be ! For I also am an Israelite , a descendant of Abraham , of the tribe of Benjamin .

verses.z: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見；願你時常彎下他們的腰。
verses.e: Let their eyes be darkened , that they may not see . Always keep their backs bent . "

verses.z: 我且說，他們失腳是要他們跌倒嗎？斷乎不是！反倒因他們的過失，救恩便臨到外邦人，要激動他們發憤。
verses.e: I ask then , did they stumble that they might fall ? May it never be ! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles , to provoke them to jealousy .

verses.z: 若他們的過失為天下的富足，他們的缺乏為外邦人的富足，何況他們的豐滿呢？
verses.e: Now if their fall is the riches of the world , and their loss the riches of the Gentiles , how much more their fullness !

verses.z: 我對你們外邦人說這話；因我是外邦人的使徒，所以敬重我的職分，
verses.e: For I speak to you who are Gentiles . Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles , I glorify my ministry ,

verses.z: 或者可以激動我骨肉之親發憤，好救他們一些人。
verses.e: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh , and may save some of them .

verses.z: 若他們被丟棄，天下就得[與上帝]和好，他們被收納，豈不是死而復生嗎？
verses.e: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world , what would their acceptance be , but life from the dead ?

verses.z: 所獻的新麵若是聖潔，全團也就聖潔了；樹根若是聖潔，樹枝也就聖潔了。
verses.e: If the first fruit is holy , so is the lump . If the root is holy , so are the branches .

verses.z: 若有幾根枝子被折下來，你這野橄欖得接在其中，一同得着橄欖根的肥汁，
verses.e: But if some of the branches were broken off , and you , being a wild olive , were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree ,

verses.z: 你就不可向[舊]枝子誇口；若是誇口，[當知道]不是你托着根，乃是根托着你。
verses.e: don't boast over the branches . But if you boast , remember that it is not you who support the root , but the root supports you .

verses.z: 你若說，那枝子被折下來是特為叫我接上。
verses.e: You will say then , " Branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in . "

verses.z: 上帝並沒有棄絕他預先所知道的百姓。你們豈不曉得經上論到以利亞是怎麼說的呢？他在上帝面前怎樣控告以色列人說：
verses.e: God didn't reject his people , whom he foreknew . Or don't you know what the Scripture says about Elijah ? How he pleads with God against Israel :

verses.z: 不錯！他們因為不信，所以被折下來；你因為信，所以立得住；你不可自高，反要懼怕。
verses.e: True ; by their unbelief they were broken off , and you stand by your faith . Don't be conceited , but fear ;

verses.z: 上帝既不愛惜原來的枝子，也必不愛惜你。
verses.e: for if God didn't spare the natural branches , neither will he spare you .

verses.z: 可見，上帝的恩慈和嚴厲向那跌倒的人是嚴厲的，向你是有恩慈的，只要你長久在他的恩慈裏；不然，你也要被砍下來。
verses.e: See then the goodness and severity of God . Toward those who fell , severity ; but toward you , goodness , if you continue in his goodness ; otherwise you also will be cut off .

verses.z: 而且他們若不是長久不信，仍要被接上，因為上帝能夠把他們重新接上。
verses.e: They also , if they don't continue in their unbelief , will be grafted in , for God is able to graft them in again .

verses.z: 你是從那天生的野橄欖上砍下來的，尚且逆着性得接在好橄欖上，何況這本樹的枝子，要接在本樹上呢！
verses.e: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree , and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree , how much more will these , which are the natural branches , be grafted into their own olive tree ?

verses.z: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道這奧祕（恐怕你們自以為聰明），就是以色列人有幾分是硬心的，等到外邦人的數目添滿了，
verses.e: For I don't desire you to be ignorant , brothers , of this mystery , so that you won't be wise in your own conceits , that a partial hardening has happened to Israel , until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in ,

verses.z: 於是以色列全家都要得救。如[經上]所記：必有一位救主從錫安出來，要消除雅各家的一切罪惡；
verses.e: and so all Israel will be saved . Even as it is written , " There will come out of Zion the Deliverer , and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob .

verses.z: 又[說]：我除去他們罪的時候，這就是我與他們所立的約。
verses.e: This is my covenant with them , when I will take away their sins . "

verses.z: 就着福音說，他們為你們的緣故是仇敵；就着揀選說，他們為列祖的緣故是蒙愛的。
verses.e: Concerning the Good News , they are enemies for your sake . But concerning the election , they are beloved for the fathers ' sake .

verses.z: 因為上帝的恩賜和選召是沒有後悔的。
verses.e: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable .

verses.z: 「主啊，他們殺了你的先知，拆了你的祭壇，只剩下我一個人；他們還要尋索我的命。」
verses.e: " Lord , they have killed your prophets . They have broken down your altars . I am left alone , and they seek my life . "

verses.z: 你們從前不順服上帝，如今因他們的不順服，你們倒蒙了憐恤。
verses.e: For as you in time past were disobedient to God , but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience ,

verses.z: 這樣，他們也是不順服，叫他們因着施給你們的憐恤，現在也就蒙憐恤。
verses.e: even so these also have now been disobedient , that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy .

verses.z: 因為上帝將眾人都圈在不順服之中，特意要憐恤眾人。
verses.e: For God has bound all to disobedience , that he might have mercy on all .

verses.z: 深哉，上帝豐富的智慧和知識！他的判斷何其難測！他的蹤跡何其難尋！
verses.e: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God ! How unsearchable are his judgments , and his ways past tracing out !

verses.z: 誰知道主的心？誰作過他的謀士呢？
verses.e: " For who has known the mind of the Lord ? Or who has been his counselor ? "

verses.z: 誰是先給了他，使他後來償還呢？
verses.e: " Or who has first given to him , and it will be repaid to him again ? "

verses.z: 因為萬有都是本於他，倚靠他，歸於他。願榮耀歸給他，直到永遠。阿們！
verses.e: For of him and through him and to him are all things . To him be the glory for ever ! Amen .

verses.z: 上帝的回話是怎麼說的呢？[他說]：「我為自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的。」
verses.e: But how does God answer him ? " I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal . "

verses.z: 如今也是這樣，照着揀選的恩典，還有所留的餘數。
verses.e: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace .

verses.z: 既是出於恩典，就不在乎行為；不然，恩典就不是恩典了。
verses.e: And if by grace , then it is no longer of works ; otherwise grace is no longer grace . But if it is of works , it is no longer grace ; otherwise work is no longer work .

verses.z: 這是怎麼樣呢？以色列人所求的，他們沒有得着。惟有蒙揀選的人得着了；其餘的就成了頑梗不化的。
verses.e: What then ? That which Israel seeks for , that he didn't obtain , but the chosen ones obtained it , and the rest were hardened .

verses.z: 如[經上]所記：上帝給他們昏迷的心，眼睛不能看見，耳朵不能聽見，直到今日。
verses.e: According as it is written , " God gave them a spirit of stupor , eyes that they should not see , and ears that they should not hear , to this very day . "

verses.z: 大衛也說：願他們的筵席變為網羅，變為機檻，變為絆腳石，作他們的報應。
verses.e: David says , " Let their table be made a snare , a trap , a stumbling block , and a retribution to them .

verses.z: 所以，弟兄們，我以上帝的慈悲勸你們，將身體獻上，當作活祭，是聖潔的，是上帝所喜悅的；你們如此事奉乃是理所當然的。
verses.e: Therefore I urge you , brothers , by the mercies of God , to present your bodies a living sacrifice , holy , acceptable to God , which is your spiritual service .

verses.z: 愛弟兄，要彼此親熱；恭敬人，要彼此推讓。
verses.e: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another ; in honor prefer one another ,

verses.z: 殷勤，不可懶惰；要心裏火熱，常常服事主。
verses.e: not lagging in diligence , fervent in spirit , serving the Lord ,

verses.z: 在指望中要喜樂；在患難中要忍耐；禱告要恆切。
verses.e: rejoicing in hope , enduring in troubles , continuing steadfastly in prayer ,

verses.z: 聖徒缺乏，要幫補；客，要一味地款待。
verses.e: contributing to the needs of the saints , and given to hospitality .

verses.z: 逼迫你們的，要給他們祝福；只要祝福，不可咒詛。
verses.e: Bless those who persecute you ; bless , and don't curse .

verses.z: 與喜樂的人要同樂；與哀哭的人要同哭。
verses.e: Rejoice with those who rejoice . Weep with those who weep .

verses.z: 要彼此同心；不要志氣高大，倒要俯就卑微的人。不要自以為聰明。
verses.e: Be of the same mind one toward another . Don't set your mind on high things , but associate with the humble . Don't be wise in your own conceits .

verses.z: 不要以惡報惡；眾人以為美的事要留心去做。
verses.e: Repay no one evil for evil . Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men .

verses.z: 若是能行，總要盡力與眾人和睦。
verses.e: If it is possible , as much as it is up to you , be at peace with all men .

verses.z: 親愛的弟兄，不要自己伸冤，寧可讓步，聽憑主怒；因為[經上]記着：「主說：『伸冤在我，我必報應。』」
verses.e: Don't seek revenge yourselves , beloved , but give place to God's wrath . For it is written , " Vengeance belongs to me ; I will repay , says the Lord . "

verses.z: 不要效法這個世界，只要心意更新而變化，叫你們察驗何為上帝的善良、純全、可喜悅的旨意。
verses.e: Don't be conformed to this world , but be transformed by the renewing of your mind , so that you may prove what is the good , well-pleasing , and perfect will of God .

verses.z: 所以，「你的仇敵若餓了，就給他吃，若渴了，就給他喝；因為你這樣行就是把炭火堆在他的頭上。」
verses.e: Therefore " If your enemy is hungry , feed him . If he is thirsty , give him a drink ; for in doing so , you will heap coals of fire on his head . "

verses.z: 你不可為惡所勝，反要以善勝惡。
verses.e: Don't be overcome by evil , but overcome evil with good .

verses.z: 我憑着所賜我的恩對你們各人說：不要看自己過於所當看的；要照着上帝所分給各人信心的大小，看得合乎中道。
verses.e: For I say through the grace that was given me , to everyone who is among you , not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think ; but to think reasonably , as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith .

verses.z: 正如我們一個身子上有好些肢體，肢體也不都是一樣的用處。
verses.e: For even as we have many members in one body , and all the members don't have the same function ,

verses.z: 我們這許多人，在基督裏成為一身，互相聯絡作肢體，也是如此。
verses.e: so we , who are many , are one body in Christ , and individually members of one another ,

verses.z: 按我們所得的恩賜，各有不同。或說預言，就當照着信心的程度說[預言]；
verses.e: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us : if prophecy , let's prophesy according to the proportion of our faith ;

verses.z: 或作執事，就當[專一]執事；或作教導的，就當[專一]教導；
verses.e: or service , let's give ourselves to service ; or he who teaches , to his teaching ;

verses.z: 或作勸化的，就當[專一]勸化；施捨的，就當誠實；治理的，就當殷勤；憐憫人的，就當甘心。
verses.e: or he who exhorts , to his exhorting ; he who gives , let him do it with generosity ; he who rules , with diligence ; he who shows mercy , with cheerfulness .

verses.z: 愛人不可虛假。惡，要厭惡；善，要親近。
verses.e: Let love be without hypocrisy . Abhor that which is evil . Cling to that which is good .

verses.z: 在上有權柄的，人人當順服他，因為沒有權柄不是出於上帝的。凡掌權的都是上帝所命的。
verses.e: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities , for there is no authority except from God , and those who exist are ordained by God .

verses.z: 愛是不加害與人的，所以愛就完全了律法。
verses.e: Love doesn't harm a neighbor . Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law .

verses.z: 再者，你們曉得，現今就是該趁早睡醒的時候；因為我們得救，現今比[初]信的時候更近了。
verses.e: Do this , knowing the time , that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep , for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed .

verses.z: 黑夜已深，白晝將近。我們就當脫去暗昧的行為，帶上光明的兵器。
verses.e: The night is far gone , and the day is near . Let's therefore throw off the deeds of darkness , and let's put on the armor of light .

verses.z: 行事為人要端正，好像行在白晝。不可荒宴醉酒；不可好色邪蕩；不可爭競嫉妒。
verses.e: Let's walk properly , as in the day ; not in reveling and drunkenness , not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts , and not in strife and jealousy .

verses.z: 總要披戴主耶穌基督，不要為肉體安排，去[放縱]私慾。
verses.e: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ , and make no provision for the flesh , for its lusts .

verses.z: 所以，抗拒掌權的就是抗拒上帝的命；抗拒的必自取刑罰。
verses.e: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God ; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment .

verses.z: 作官的原不是叫行善的懼怕，乃是叫作惡的懼怕。你願意不懼怕掌權的嗎？你只要行善，就可得他的稱讚；
verses.e: For rulers are not a terror to the good work , but to the evil . Do you desire to have no fear of the authority ? Do that which is good , and you will have praise from the authority ,

verses.z: 因為他是上帝的用人，是與你有益的。你若作惡，卻當懼怕，因為他不是空空地佩劍；他是上帝的用人，是伸冤的，刑罰那作惡的。
verses.e: for he is a servant of God to you for good . But if you do that which is evil , be afraid , for he doesn't bear the sword in vain ; for he is a servant of God , an avenger for wrath to him who does evil .

verses.z: 所以，你們必須順服，不但是因為刑罰，也是因為良心。
verses.e: Therefore you need to be in subjection , not only because of the wrath , but also for conscience ' sake .

verses.z: 你們納糧，也為這個緣故；因他們是上帝的差役，常常特管這事。
verses.e: For this reason you also pay taxes , for they are servants of God's service , continually doing this very thing .

verses.z: 凡人所當得的，就給他。當得糧的，給他納糧；當得稅的，給他上稅；當懼怕的，懼怕他；當恭敬的，恭敬他。
verses.e: Therefore give everyone what you owe : if you owe taxes , pay taxes ; if customs , then customs ; if respect , then respect ; if honor , then honor .

verses.z: 凡事都不可虧欠人，惟有彼此相愛要常以為虧欠，因為愛人的就完全了律法。
verses.e: Owe no one anything , except to love one another ; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law .

verses.z: 像那不可姦淫，不可殺人，不可偷盜，不可貪婪，或有別的誡命，都包在愛人如己這一句話之內了。
verses.e: For the commandments , " You shall not commit adultery , " " You shall not murder , " " You shall not steal , " " You shall not covet , " and whatever other commandments there are , are all summed up in this saying , namely , " You shall love your neighbor as yourself . "

verses.z: 信心軟弱的，你們要接納，但不要辯論所疑惑的事。
verses.e: Now accept one who is weak in faith , but not for disputes over opinions .

verses.z: 你這個人，為甚麼論斷弟兄呢？又為甚麼輕看弟兄呢？因我們都要站在上帝的臺前。
verses.e: But you , why do you judge your brother ? Or you again , why do you despise your brother ? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ .

verses.z: [經上]寫着：主說：我憑着我的永生起誓：萬膝必向我跪拜；萬口必向我承認。
verses.e: For it is written , " ' As I live , ' says the Lord , ' to me every knee will bow . Every tongue will confess to God . ' "

verses.z: 這樣看來，我們各人必要將自己的事在上帝面前說明。
verses.e: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God .

verses.z: 所以，我們不可再彼此論斷，寧可定意誰也不給弟兄放下絆腳跌人之物。
verses.e: Therefore let's not judge one another any more , but judge this rather , that no man put a stumbling block in his brother's way , or an occasion for falling .

verses.z: 我憑着主耶穌確知深信，凡物本來沒有不潔淨的；惟獨人以為不潔淨的，在他就不潔淨了。
verses.e: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself ; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean , to him it is unclean .

verses.z: 你若因食物叫弟兄憂愁，就不是按着愛人的道理行。基督已經替他死，你不可因你的食物叫他敗壞。
verses.e: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved , you walk no longer in love . Don't destroy with your food him for whom Christ died .

verses.z: 不可叫你的善被人毀謗；
verses.e: Then don't let your good be slandered ,

verses.z: 因為上帝的國不在乎吃喝，只在乎公義、和平，並聖靈中的喜樂。
verses.e: for God's Kingdom is not eating and drinking , but righteousness , peace , and joy in the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 在這幾樣上服事基督的，就為上帝所喜悅，又為人所稱許。
verses.e: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men .

verses.z: 所以，我們務要追求和睦的事與彼此建立[德行]的事。
verses.e: So then , let's follow after things which make for peace , and things by which we may build one another up .

verses.z: 有人信百物都可吃；但那軟弱的，只吃蔬菜。
verses.e: One man has faith to eat all things , but he who is weak eats only vegetables .

verses.z: 不可因食物毀壞上帝的工程。凡物固然潔淨，但有人因食物叫人跌倒，就是他的罪了。
verses.e: Don't overthrow God's work for food's sake . All things indeed are clean , however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating .

verses.z: 無論是吃肉是喝酒，是甚麼別的事，叫弟兄跌倒，一概不做才好。
verses.e: It is good to not eat meat , drink wine , nor do anything by which your brother stumbles , is offended , or is made weak .

verses.z: 你有信心，就當在上帝面前守着。人在自己以為可行的事上能不自責，就有福了。
verses.e: Do you have faith ? Have it to yourself before God . Happy is he who doesn't judge himself in that which he approves .

verses.z: 若有疑心而吃的，就必有罪，因為他吃不是出於信心。凡不出於信心的都是罪。
verses.e: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats , because it isn't of faith ; and whatever is not of faith is sin .
Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ , according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages ,
but now is revealed , and by the Scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the eternal God , is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations ;
to the only wise God , through Jesus Christ , to whom be the glory forever ! Amen .

verses.z: 吃的人不可輕看不吃的人；不吃的人不可論斷吃的人；因為上帝已經收納他了。
verses.e: Don't let him who eats despise him who doesn't eat . Don't let him who doesn't eat judge him who eats , for God has accepted him .

verses.z: 你是誰，竟論斷別人的僕人呢？他或站住或跌倒，自有他的主人在；而且他也必要站住，因為主能使他站住。
verses.e: Who are you who judge another's servant ? To his own lord he stands or falls . Yes , he will be made to stand , for God has power to make him stand .

verses.z: 有人看這日比那日強；有人看日日都是一樣。只是各人心裏要意見堅定。
verses.e: One man esteems one day as more important . Another esteems every day alike . Let each man be fully assured in his own mind .

verses.z: 守日的人是為主守的。吃的人是為主吃的，因他感謝上帝；不吃的人是為主不吃的，也感謝上帝。
verses.e: He who observes the day , observes it to the Lord ; and he who does not observe the day , to the Lord he does not observe it . He who eats , eats to the Lord , for he gives God thanks . He who doesn't eat , to the Lord he doesn't eat , and gives God thanks .

verses.z: 我們沒有一個人為自己活，也沒有一個人為自己死。
verses.e: For none of us lives to himself , and none dies to himself .

verses.z: 我們若活着，是為主而活；若死了，是為主而死。所以，我們或活或死總是主的人。
verses.e: For if we live , we live to the Lord . Or if we die , we die to the Lord . If therefore we live or die , we are the Lord's .

verses.z: 因此，基督死了，又活了，為要作死人並活人的主。
verses.e: For to this end Christ died , rose , and lived again , that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living .

verses.z: 我們堅固的人應該擔代不堅固人的軟弱，不求自己的喜悅。
verses.e: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak , and not to please ourselves .

verses.z: 又說：你們外邦人當與主的百姓一同歡樂；
verses.e: Again he says , " Rejoice , you Gentiles , with his people . "

verses.z: 又說：外邦啊，你們當讚美主！萬民哪，你們都當頌讚他！
verses.e: Again , " Praise the Lord , all you Gentiles ! Let all the peoples praise him . "

verses.z: 又有以賽亞說：將來有耶西的根，就是那興起來要治理外邦的；外邦人要仰望他。
verses.e: Again , Isaiah says , " There will be the root of Jesse , he who arises to rule over the Gentiles ; in him the Gentiles will hope . "

verses.z: 但願使人有盼望的上帝，因信將諸般的喜樂、平安充滿你們的心，使你們藉着聖靈的能力大有盼望！
verses.e: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing , that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 弟兄們，我自己也深信你們是滿有良善，充足了諸般的知識，也能彼此勸戒。
verses.e: I myself am also persuaded about you , my brothers , that you yourselves are full of goodness , filled with all knowledge , able also to admonish others .

verses.z: 但我稍微放膽寫信給你們，是要提醒你們的記性，特因上帝所給我的恩典，
verses.e: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you , because of the grace that was given to me by God ,

verses.z: 使我為外邦人作基督耶穌的僕役，作上帝福音的祭司，叫所獻上的外邦人，因着聖靈成為聖潔，可蒙悅納。
verses.e: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles , serving as a priest of the Good News of God , that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable , sanctified by the Holy Spirit .

verses.z: 所以論到上帝的事，我在基督耶穌裏有可誇的。
verses.e: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God .

verses.z: 除了基督藉我做的那些事，我甚麼都不敢提，只提他藉我言語作為，用神蹟奇事的能力，並聖靈的能力，使外邦人順服；
verses.e: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles , by word and deed ,

verses.z: 甚至我從耶路撒冷，直轉到以利哩古，到處傳了基督的福音。
verses.e: in the power of signs and wonders , in the power of God's Spirit ; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum , I have fully preached the Good News of Christ ;

verses.z: 我們各人務要叫鄰舍喜悅，使他得益處，建立[德行]。
verses.e: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good , to be building him up .

verses.z: 我立了志向，不在基督的名被稱過的地方傳福音，免得建造在別人的根基上。
verses.e: yes , making it my aim to preach the Good News , not where Christ was already named , that I might not build on another's foundation .

verses.z: 就如[經上]所記：未曾聞知他信息的，將要看見；未曾聽過的，將要明白。
verses.e: But , as it is written , " They will see , to whom no news of him came . They who haven't heard will understand . "

verses.z: 我因多次被攔阻，總不得到你們那裏去。
verses.e: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you ,

verses.z: 但如今，在這裏再沒有[可傳的]地方，而且這好幾年，我切心想望到西班牙去的時候，可以到你們那裏，
verses.e: but now , no longer having any place in these regions , and having these many years a longing to come to you ,

verses.z: 盼望從你們那裏經過，得見你們，先與你們彼此交往，心裏稍微滿足，然後蒙你們送行。
verses.e: whenever I travel to Spain , I will come to you . For I hope to see you on my journey , and to be helped on my way there by you , if first I may enjoy your company for a while .

verses.z: 但現在，我往耶路撒冷去供給聖徒。
verses.e: But now , I say , I am going to Jerusalem , serving the saints .

verses.z: 因為馬其頓和亞該亞人樂意湊出捐項給耶路撒冷聖徒中的窮人。
verses.e: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem .

verses.z: 這固然是他們樂意的，其實也算是所欠的債；因外邦人既然在他們屬靈的好處上有分，就當把養身之物供給他們。
verses.e: Yes , it has been their good pleasure , and they are their debtors . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , they owe it to them also to serve them in material things .

verses.z: 等我辦完了這事，把這善果向他們交付明白，我就要路過你們那裏，往西班牙去。
verses.e: When therefore I have accomplished this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will go on by way of you to Spain .

verses.z: 我也曉得，去的時候必帶着基督豐盛的恩典而去。
verses.e: I know that when I come to you , I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ .

verses.z: 因為基督也不求自己的喜悅，如[經上]所記：「辱罵你人的辱罵都落在我身上。」
verses.e: For even Christ didn't please himself . But , as it is written , " The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me . "

verses.z: 弟兄們，我藉着我們主耶穌基督，又藉着[聖]靈的愛，勸你們與我一同竭力，為我祈求上帝，
verses.e: Now I beg you , brothers , by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit , that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me ,

verses.z: 叫我脫離在猶太不順從的人，也叫我為耶路撒冷所辦的捐項可蒙聖徒悅納，
verses.e: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea , and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints ,
