verses.z: 並叫我順着上帝的旨意，歡歡喜喜地到你們那裏，與你們同得安息。
verses.e: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God , and together with you , find rest .

verses.z: 願賜平安的上帝常和你們眾人同在。阿們！
verses.e: Now the God of peace be with you all . Amen .

verses.z: 從前所寫的[聖經]都是為教訓我們寫的，叫我們因聖經所生的忍耐和安慰可以得着盼望。
verses.e: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning , that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope .

verses.z: 但願賜忍耐安慰的上帝叫你們彼此同心，效法基督耶穌，
verses.e: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 一心一口榮耀上帝－我們主耶穌基督的父！
verses.e: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 所以，你們要彼此接納，如同基督接納你們一樣，使榮耀歸與上帝。
verses.e: Therefore accept one another , even as Christ also accepted you , to the glory of God .

verses.z: 我說，基督是為上帝真理作了受割禮人的執事，要證實所應許列祖的話，
verses.e: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God , that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers ,

verses.z: 並叫外邦人因他的憐憫榮耀上帝。如[經上]所記：因此，我要在外邦中稱讚你，歌頌你的名；
verses.e: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy . As it is written , " Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name . "

verses.z: 我對你們舉薦我們的姊妹非比；她是堅革哩教會中的女執事。
verses.e: I commend to you Phoebe , our sister , who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae ,

verses.z: 又問在基督裏經過試驗的亞比利安。問亞利多布家裏的人安。
verses.e: Greet Apelles , the approved in Christ . Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus .

verses.z: 又問我親屬希羅天安。問拿其數家在主裏的人安。
verses.e: Greet Herodion , my kinsman . Greet them of the household of Narcissus , who are in the Lord .

verses.z: 又問為主勞苦的土非拿氏和土富撒氏安。問可親愛為主多受勞苦的彼息氏安。
verses.e: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa , who labor in the Lord . Greet Persis , the beloved , who labored much in the Lord .

verses.z: 又問在主蒙揀選的魯孚和他母親安；他的母親就是我的母親。
verses.e: Greet Rufus , the chosen in the Lord , and his mother and mine .

verses.z: 又問亞遜其土、弗勒干、黑米、八羅巴、黑馬，並與他們在一處的弟兄們安。
verses.e: Greet Asyncritus , Phlegon , Hermes , Patrobas , Hermas , and the brothers who are with them .

verses.z: 又問非羅羅古和猶利亞，尼利亞和他姊妹，同阿林巴並與他們在一處的眾聖徒安。
verses.e: Greet Philologus and Julia , Nereus and his sister , and Olympas , and all the saints who are with them .

verses.z: 你們親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。基督的眾教會都問你們安。
verses.e: Greet one another with a holy kiss . The assemblies of Christ greet you .

verses.z: 弟兄們，那些離間你們、叫你們跌倒、背乎所學之道的人，我勸你們要留意躲避他們。
verses.e: Now I beg you , brothers , look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling , contrary to the doctrine which you learned , and turn away from them .

verses.z: 因為這樣的人不服事我們的主基督，只服事自己的肚腹，用花言巧語誘惑那些老實人的心。
verses.e: For those who are such don't serve our Lord Jesus Christ , but their own belly ; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent .

verses.z: 你們的順服已經傳於眾人，所以我為你們歡喜；但我願意你們在善上聰明，在惡上愚拙。
verses.e: For your obedience has become known to all . I rejoice therefore over you . But I desire to have you wise in that which is good , but innocent in that which is evil .

verses.z: 請你們為主接待她，合乎聖徒的體統。她在何事上要你們幫助，你們就幫助她；因她素來幫助許多人，也幫助了我。
verses.e: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints , and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you , for she herself also has been a helper of many , and of my own self .

verses.z: 賜平安的上帝快要將撒但踐踏在你們腳下。願我主耶穌基督的恩常和你們同在！
verses.e: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet . The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you .

verses.z: 與我同工的提摩太，和我的親屬路求、耶孫、所西巴德，問你們安。
verses.e: Timothy , my fellow worker , greets you , as do Lucius , Jason , and Sosipater , my relatives .

verses.z: 我這代筆寫信的德提，在主裏面問你們安。
verses.e: I , Tertius , who write the letter , greet you in the Lord .

verses.z: 那接待我、也接待全教會的該猶問你們安。
verses.e: Gaius , my host and host of the whole assembly , greets you . Erastus , the treasurer of the city , greets you , as does Quartus , the brother .

verses.z: 城內管銀庫的以拉都和兄弟括土問你們安。
verses.e: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all ! Amen .

verses.z: 惟有上帝能照我所傳的福音和所講的耶穌基督，並照永古隱藏不言的奧祕，堅固你們的心。
這奧祕如今顯明出來，而且按着永生上帝的命，藉眾先知的書指示萬國的民，使他們信服真道。
願榮耀，因耶穌基督，歸與獨一全智的上帝，直到永遠。阿們！
問百基拉和亞居拉安。他們在基督耶穌裏與我同工，
verses.e: Greet Prisca and Aquila , my fellow workers in Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 也為我的命將自己的頸項置之度外。不但我感謝他們，就是外邦的眾教會也感謝他們。
verses.e: who risked their own necks for my life , to whom not only I give thanks , but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles .

verses.z: 又問在他們家中的教會安。問我所親愛的以拜尼土安；他在亞細亞是歸基督初結的果子。
verses.e: Greet the assembly that is in their house . Greet Epaenetus , my beloved , who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ .

verses.z: 又問馬利亞安；她為你們多受勞苦。
verses.e: Greet Mary , who labored much for us .

verses.z: 又問我親屬與我一同坐監的安多尼古和猶尼亞安；他們在使徒中是有名望的，也是比我先在基督裏。
verses.e: Greet Andronicus and Junia , my relatives and my fellow prisoners , who are notable among the apostles , who were also in Christ before me .

verses.z: 又問我在主裏面所親愛的暗伯利安。
verses.e: Greet Amplias , my beloved in the Lord .

verses.z: 又問在基督裏與我們同工的耳巴奴，並我所親愛的士大古安。
verses.e: Greet Urbanus , our fellow worker in Christ , and Stachys , my beloved .

verses.z: 你這論斷人的，無論你是誰，也無可推諉。你在甚麼事上論斷人，就在甚麼事上定自己的罪；因你這論斷人的，自己所行卻和別人一樣。
verses.e: Therefore you are without excuse , O man , whoever you are who judge . For in that which you judge another , you condemn yourself . For you who judge practice the same things .

verses.z: 卻將榮耀、尊貴、平安加給一切行善的人，先是猶太人，後是希臘人。
verses.e: But glory , honor , and peace go to every man who does good , to the Jew first , and also to the Greek .

verses.z: 因為上帝不偏待人。
verses.e: For there is no partiality with God .

verses.z: 凡沒有律法犯了罪的，也必不按律法滅亡；凡在律法以下犯了罪的，也必按律法受審判。（
verses.e: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law . As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law .

verses.z: 原來在上帝面前，不是聽律法的為義，乃是行律法的稱義。
verses.e: For it isn't the hearers of the law who are righteous before God , but the doers of the law will be justified

verses.z: 沒有律法的外邦人若順着本性行律法上的事，他們雖然沒有律法，自己就是自己的律法。
verses.e: ( for when Gentiles who don't have the law do by nature the things of the law , these , not having the law , are a law to themselves ,

verses.z: 這是顯出律法的功用刻在他們心裏，他們是非之心同作見證，並且他們的思念互相較量，或以為是，或以為非。）
verses.e: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts , their conscience testifying with them , and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them )

verses.z: 就在上帝藉耶穌基督審判人隱祕事的日子，照着我的福音所言。
verses.e: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men , according to my Good News , by Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 你稱為猶太人，又倚靠律法，且指着上帝誇口；
verses.e: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew , rest on the law , glory in God ,

verses.z: 既從律法中受了教訓，就曉得上帝的旨意，也能分別是非；
verses.e: know his will , and approve the things that are excellent , being instructed out of the law ,

verses.z: 又深信自己是給瞎子領路的，是黑暗中人的光，
verses.e: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind , a light to those who are in darkness ,

verses.z: 我們知道這樣行的人，上帝必照真理審判他。
verses.e: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things .

verses.z: 是蠢笨人的師傅，是小孩子的先生，在律法上有知識和真理的模範。
verses.e: a corrector of the foolish , a teacher of babies , having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth .

verses.z: 你既是教導別人，還不教導自己嗎？你講說人不可偷竊，自己還偷竊嗎？
verses.e: You therefore who teach another , don't you teach yourself ? You who preach that a man shouldn't steal , do you steal ?

verses.z: 你說人不可姦淫，自己還姦淫嗎？你厭惡偶像，自己還偷竊廟中之物嗎？
verses.e: You who say a man shouldn't commit adultery , do you commit adultery ? You who abhor idols , do you rob temples ?

verses.z: 你指着律法誇口，自己倒犯律法、玷辱上帝嗎？
verses.e: You who glory in the law , do you dishonor God by disobeying the law ?

verses.z: 上帝的名在外邦人中，因你們受了褻瀆，正如[經上]所記的。
verses.e: For " the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you , " just as it is written .

verses.z: 你若是行律法的，割禮固然於你有益；若是犯律法的，你的割禮就算不得割禮。
verses.e: For circumcision indeed profits , if you are a doer of the law , but if you are a transgressor of the law , your circumcision has become uncircumcision .

verses.z: 所以那未受割禮的，若遵守律法的條例，他雖然未受割禮，豈不算是有割禮嗎？
verses.e: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law , won't his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision ?

verses.z: 而且那本來未受割禮的，若能全守律法，豈不是要審判你這有儀文和割禮竟犯律法的人嗎？
verses.e: Won't those who are physically uncircumcised , but fulfill the law , judge you , who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law ?

verses.z: 因為外面作猶太人的，不是[真]猶太人；外面肉身的割禮，也不是[真]割禮。
verses.e: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly , neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh ;

verses.z: 惟有裏面作的，才是[真]猶太人；[真]割禮也是心裏的，在乎靈，不在乎儀文。這人的稱讚不是從人來的，乃是從上帝來的。
verses.e: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly , and circumcision is that of the heart , in the spirit , not in the letter ; whose praise is not from men , but from God .

verses.z: 你這人哪，你論斷行這樣事的人，自己所行的卻和別人一樣，你以為能逃脫上帝的審判嗎？
verses.e: Do you think this , O man who judges those who practice such things , and do the same , that you will escape the judgment of God ?

verses.z: 還是你藐視他豐富的恩慈、寬容、忍耐，不曉得他的恩慈是領你悔改呢？
verses.e: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness , forbearance , and patience , not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance ?

verses.z: 你竟任着你剛硬不悔改的心，為自己積蓄忿怒，以致上帝震怒，顯他公義審判的日子來到。
verses.e: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath , revelation , and of the righteous judgment of God ,

verses.z: 他必照各人的行為報應各人。
verses.e: who " will pay back to everyone according to their works : "

verses.z: 凡恆心行善、尋求榮耀、尊貴和不能朽壞[之福]的，就以永生報應他們；
verses.e: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory , honor , and incorruptibility , eternal life ;

verses.z: 惟有結黨、不順從真理、反順從不義的，就以忿怒、惱恨報應他們；
verses.e: but to those who are self-seeking and don't obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , will be wrath , indignation ,

verses.z: 將患難、困苦加給一切作惡的人，先是猶太人，後是希臘人，
verses.e: oppression , and anguish on every soul of man who does evil , to the Jew first , and also to the Greek .

verses.z: 這樣說來，猶太人有甚麼長處？割禮有甚麼益處呢？
verses.e: Then what advantage does the Jew have ? Or what is the profit of circumcision ?

verses.z: 就如[經上]所記：沒有義人，連一個也沒有。
verses.e: As it is written , " There is no one righteous ; no , not one .

verses.z: 沒有明白的；沒有尋求上帝的；
verses.e: There is no one who understands . There is no one who seeks after God .

verses.z: 都是偏離正路，一同變為無用。沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
verses.e: They have all turned away . They have together become unprofitable . There is no one who does good , no , not so much as one . "

verses.z: 他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓；他們用舌頭弄詭詐，嘴唇裏有虺蛇的毒氣，
verses.e: " Their throat is an open tomb . With their tongues they have used deceit . " " The poison of vipers is under their lips . "

verses.z: 滿口是咒罵苦毒。
verses.e: " Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness . "

verses.z: 殺人流血，他們的腳飛跑，
verses.e: " Their feet are swift to shed blood .

verses.z: 所經過的路便行殘害暴虐的事。
verses.e: Destruction and misery are in their ways .

verses.z: 平安的路，他們未曾知道；
verses.e: The way of peace , they haven't known . "

verses.z: 他們眼中不怕上帝。
verses.e: " There is no fear of God before their eyes . "

verses.z: 我們曉得律法上的話都是對律法以下之人說的，好塞住各人的口，叫普世的人都伏在上帝審判之下。
verses.e: Now we know that whatever things the law says , it speaks to those who are under the law , that every mouth may be closed , and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God .

verses.z: 凡事大有好處：第一是上帝的聖言交託他們。
verses.e: Much in every way ! Because first of all , they were entrusted with the revelations of God .

verses.z: 所以凡有血氣的，沒有一個因行律法能在上帝面前稱義，因為律法本是叫人知罪。
verses.e: Because by the works of the law , no flesh will be justified in his sight ; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin .

verses.z: 但如今，上帝的義在律法以外已經顯明出來，有律法和先知為證：
verses.e: But now apart from the law , a righteousness of God has been revealed , being testified by the law and the prophets ;

verses.z: 就是上帝的義，因信耶穌基督加給一切相信的人，並沒有分別。
verses.e: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe . For there is no distinction ,

verses.z: 因為世人都犯了罪，虧缺了上帝的榮耀；
verses.e: for all have sinned , and fall short of the glory of God ;

verses.z: 如今卻蒙上帝的恩典，因基督耶穌的救贖，就白白地稱義。
verses.e: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus ,

verses.z: 上帝設立耶穌作挽回祭，是憑着耶穌的血，藉着人的信，要顯明上帝的義；因為他用忍耐的心寬容人先時所犯的罪，
verses.e: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood , for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins , in God's forbearance ;

verses.z: 好在今時顯明他的義，使人知道他自己為義，也稱信耶穌的人為義。
verses.e: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time , that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus .

verses.z: 既是這樣，哪裏能誇口呢？沒有可誇的了。用何法沒有的呢？是用立功之法嗎？不是，乃用信[主]之法。
verses.e: Where then is the boasting ? It is excluded . By what kind of law ? Of works ? No , but by a law of faith .

verses.z: 所以我們看定了：人稱義是因着信，不在乎遵行律法。
verses.e: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law .

verses.z: 難道上帝只作猶太人的上帝嗎？不也是作外邦人的上帝嗎？是的，也作外邦人的上帝。
verses.e: Or is God the God of Jews only ? Isn't he the God of Gentiles also ? Yes , of Gentiles also ,

verses.z: 即便有不信的，這有何妨呢？難道他們的不信就廢掉上帝的信嗎？
verses.e: For what if some were without faith ? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God ?

verses.z: 上帝既是一位，他就要因信稱那受割禮的為義，也要因信稱那未受割禮的為義。
verses.e: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith .

verses.z: 這樣，我們因信廢了律法嗎？斷乎不是！更是堅固律法。
verses.e: Do we then nullify the law through faith ? May it never be ! No , we establish the law .

verses.z: 斷乎不能！不如說，上帝是真實的，人都是虛謊的。如[經上]所記：你責備人的時候，顯為公義；被人議論的時候，可以得勝。
verses.e: May it never be ! Yes , let God be found true , but every man a liar . As it is written , " that you might be justified in your words , and might prevail when you come into judgment . "

verses.z: 我且照着人的常話說，我們的不義若顯出上帝的義來，我們可以怎麼說呢？上帝降怒，是他不義嗎？
verses.e: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God , what will we say ? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath ? I speak like men do .

verses.z: 斷乎不是！若是這樣，上帝怎能審判世界呢？
verses.e: May it never be ! For then how will God judge the world ?

verses.z: 若上帝的真實，因我的虛謊越發顯出他的榮耀，為甚麼我還受審判，好像罪人呢？
verses.e: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory , why am I also still judged as a sinner ?

verses.z: 為甚麼不說，我們可以作惡以成善呢？這是毀謗我們的人說我們有這話。這等人定罪是該當的。
verses.e: Why not ( as we are slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say ) , " Let's do evil , that good may come ? " Those who say so are justly condemned .

verses.z: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我們比他們強嗎？決不是的！因我們已經證明：猶太人和希臘人都在罪惡之下。
verses.e: What then ? Are we better than they ? No , in no way . For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin .

verses.z: 如此說來，我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕憑着肉體得了甚麼呢？
verses.e: What then will we say that Abraham , our forefather , has found according to the flesh ?

verses.z: 是怎麼算的呢？是在他受割禮的時候呢？是在他未受割禮的時候呢？不是在受割禮的時候，乃是在未受割禮的時候。
verses.e: How then was it counted ? When he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .

verses.z: 並且他受了割禮的記號，作他未受割禮的時候因信稱義的印證，叫他作一切未受割禮而信之人的父，使他們也算為義；
verses.e: He received the sign of circumcision , a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision , that he might be the father of all those who believe , though they might be in uncircumcision , that righteousness might also be accounted to them .

verses.z: 又作受割禮之人的父，就是那些不但受割禮，並且按我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕未受割禮而信之蹤跡去行的人。
verses.e: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision , but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham , which he had in uncircumcision .

verses.z: 因為[上帝]應許亞伯拉罕和他後裔，必得承受世界，不是因律法，乃是因信而得的義。
verses.e: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn't through the law , but through the righteousness of faith .

verses.z: 若是屬乎律法的人才得為後嗣，信就歸於虛空，應許也就廢棄了。
verses.e: For if those who are of the law are heirs , faith is made void , and the promise is made of no effect .

verses.z: 因為律法是惹動忿怒的；哪裏沒有律法，那裏就沒有過犯。
verses.e: For the law produces wrath ; for where there is no law , neither is there disobedience .

verses.z: 所以[人得為後嗣]是本乎信，因此就屬乎恩，叫應許定然歸給一切後裔；不但歸給那屬乎律法的，也歸給那效法亞伯拉罕之信的。
verses.e: For this cause it is of faith , that it may be according to grace , to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring , not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham , who is the father of us all .

verses.z: 亞伯拉罕所信的，是那叫死人復活、使無變為有的上帝，他在主面前作我們世人的父。如[經上]所記：「我已經立你作多國的父。」
verses.e: As it is written , " I have made you a father of many nations . " This is in the presence of him whom he believed : God , who gives life to the dead , and calls the things that are not , as though they were .

verses.z: 他在無可指望的時候，因信仍有指望，就得以作多國的父，正如先前所說：「你的後裔將要如此。」
verses.e: Against hope , Abraham in hope believed , to the end that he might become a father of many nations , according to that which had been spoken , " So will your offspring be . "

verses.z: 他將近百歲的時候，雖然想到自己的身體如同已死，撒拉的生育已經斷絕，他的信心還是不軟弱；
verses.e: Without being weakened in faith , he didn't consider his own body , already having been worn out , ( he being about a hundred years old ) , and the deadness of Sarah's womb .

verses.z: 倘若亞伯拉罕是因行為稱義，就有可誇的；只是在上帝面前並無可誇。
verses.e: For if Abraham was justified by works , he has something to boast about , but not toward God .

verses.z: 並且仰望上帝的應許，總沒有因不信心裏起疑惑，反倒因信心裏得堅固，將榮耀歸給上帝，
verses.e: Yet , looking to the promise of God , he didn't waver through unbelief , but grew strong through faith , giving glory to God ,

verses.z: 且滿心相信上帝所應許的必能做成。
verses.e: and being fully assured that what he had promised , he was also able to perform .

verses.z: 所以，這就算為他的義。
verses.e: Therefore it also was " credited to him for righteousness . "

verses.z: 「算為他義」的這句話不是單為他寫的，
verses.e: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone ,

verses.z: 也是為我們將來得算為義之人寫的，就是我們這信上帝使我們的主耶穌從死裏復活的人。
verses.e: but for our sake also , to whom it will be accounted , who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead ,

verses.z: 耶穌被交給人，是為我們的過犯；復活，是為叫我們稱義。
verses.e: who was delivered up for our trespasses , and was raised for our justification .

verses.z: 經上說甚麼呢？說：「亞伯拉罕信上帝，這就算為他的義。」
verses.e: For what does the Scripture say ? " Abraham believed God , and it was accounted to him for righteousness . "

verses.z: 做工的得工價，不算恩典，乃是該得的；
verses.e: Now to him who works , the reward is not counted as grace , but as something owed .

verses.z: 惟有不做工的，只信稱罪人為義的上帝，他的信就算為義。
verses.e: But to him who doesn't work , but believes in him who justifies the ungodly , his faith is accounted for righteousness .

verses.z: 正如大衛稱那在行為以外蒙上帝算為義的人是有福的。
verses.e: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works :

verses.z: [他]說：得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的，這人是有福的。
verses.e: " Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven , whose sins are covered .

verses.z: 主不算為有罪的，這人是有福的。
verses.e: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin . "

verses.z: 如此看來，這福是單加給那受割禮的人嗎？不也是加給那未受割禮的人嗎？因我們所說，亞伯拉罕的信，就算為他的義，
verses.e: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised , or on the uncircumcised also ? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness .

verses.z: 我們既因信稱義，就藉着我們的主耶穌基督得與上帝相和。
verses.e: Being therefore justified by faith , we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ ;

verses.z: 因為我們作仇敵的時候，且藉着上帝兒子的死，得與上帝和好；既已和好，就更要因他的生得救了。
verses.e: For if while we were enemies , we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son , much more , being reconciled , we will be saved by his life .

verses.z: 不但如此，我們既藉着我主耶穌基督得與上帝和好，也就藉着他以上帝為樂。
verses.e: Not only so , but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ , through whom we have now received the reconciliation .

verses.z: 這就如罪是從一人入了世界，死又是從罪來的，於是死就臨到眾人，因為眾人都犯了罪。
verses.e: Therefore , as sin entered into the world through one man , and death through sin , so death passed to all men because all sinned .

verses.z: 沒有律法之先，罪已經在世上；但沒有律法，罪也不算罪。
verses.e: For until the law , sin was in the world ; but sin is not charged when there is no law .

verses.z: 然而從亞當到摩西，死就作了王，連那些不與亞當犯一樣罪過的，也在他的權下。亞當乃是那以後要來之人的預像。
verses.e: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses , even over those whose sins weren't like Adam's disobedience , who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come .

verses.z: 只是過犯不如恩賜，若因一人的過犯，眾人都死了，何況上帝的恩典，與那因耶穌基督一人恩典中的賞賜，豈不更加倍地臨到眾人嗎？
verses.e: But the free gift isn't like the trespass . For if by the trespass of the one the many died , much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man , Jesus Christ , abound to the many .

verses.z: 因一人犯罪就定罪，也不如恩賜，原來審判是由一人而定罪，恩賜乃是由許多過犯而稱義。
verses.e: The gift is not as through one who sinned ; for the judgment came by one to condemnation , but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification .

verses.z: 若因一人的過犯，死就因這一人作了王，何況那些受洪恩又蒙所賜之義的，豈不更要因耶穌基督一人在生命中作王嗎？
verses.e: For if by the trespass of the one , death reigned through the one ; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one , Jesus Christ .

verses.z: 如此說來，因一次的過犯，眾人都被定罪；照樣，因一次的義行，眾人也就被稱義得生命了。
verses.e: So then as through one trespass , all men were condemned ; even so through one act of righteousness , all men were justified to life .

verses.z: 因一人的悖逆，眾人成為罪人；照樣，因一人的順從，眾人也成為義了。
verses.e: For as through the one man's disobedience many were made sinners , even so through the obedience of the one , many will be made righteous .

verses.z: 我們又藉着他，因信得進入現在所站的這恩典中，並且歡歡喜喜盼望上帝的榮耀。
verses.e: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand . We rejoice in hope of the glory of God .

verses.z: 律法本是外添的，叫過犯顯多；只是罪在哪裏顯多，恩典就更顯多了。
verses.e: The law came in that the trespass might abound ; but where sin abounded , grace abounded more exceedingly ,

verses.z: 就如罪作王叫人死；照樣，恩典也藉着義作王，叫人因我們的主耶穌基督得永生。
verses.e: that as sin reigned in death , even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord .

verses.z: 不但如此，就是在患難中也是歡歡喜喜的；因為知道患難生忍耐，
verses.e: Not only this , but we also rejoice in our sufferings , knowing that suffering produces perseverance ;

verses.z: 忍耐生老練，老練生盼望；
verses.e: and perseverance , proven character ; and proven character , hope ;

verses.z: 盼望不至於羞恥，因為所賜給我們的聖靈將上帝的愛澆灌在我們心裏。
verses.e: and hope doesn't disappoint us , because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us .

verses.z: 因我們還軟弱的時候，基督就按所定的日期為罪人死。
verses.e: For while we were yet weak , at the right time Christ died for the ungodly .

verses.z: 為義人死，是少有的；為仁人死，或者有敢做的。
verses.e: For one will hardly die for a righteous man . Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die .

verses.z: 惟有基督在我們還作罪人的時候為我們死，上帝的愛就在此向我們顯明了。
verses.e: But God commends his own love toward us , in that while we were yet sinners , Christ died for us .

verses.z: 現在我們既靠着他的血稱義，就更要藉着他免去[上帝的]忿怒。
verses.e: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we will be saved from God's wrath through him .

verses.z: 這樣，怎麼說呢？我們可以仍在罪中、叫恩典顯多嗎？
verses.e: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?

verses.z: 他死是向罪死了，只有一次；他活是向上帝活着。
verses.e: For the death that he died , he died to sin one time ; but the life that he lives , he lives to God .

verses.z: 這樣，你們向罪也當看自己是死的；向上帝在基督耶穌裏，卻當看自己是活的。
verses.e: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin , but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord .

verses.z: 所以，不要容罪在你們必死的身上作王，使你們順從身子的私慾。
verses.e: Therefore don't let sin reign in your mortal body , that you should obey it in its lusts .

verses.z: 也不要將你們的肢體獻給罪作不義的器具；倒要像從死裏復活的人，將自己獻給上帝，並將肢體作義的器具獻給上帝。
verses.e: Also , do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness , but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead , and your members as instruments of righteousness to God .

verses.z: 罪必不能作你們的主；因你們不在律法之下，乃在恩典之下。
verses.e: For sin will not have dominion over you , for you are not under law , but under grace .

verses.z: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我們在恩典之下，不在律法之下，就可以犯罪嗎？斷乎不可！
verses.e: What then ? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace ? May it never be !

verses.z: 豈不曉得你們獻上自己作奴僕，順從誰，就作誰的奴僕嗎？或作罪的奴僕，以至於死；或作順命的奴僕，以致成義。
verses.e: Don't you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone , you are the servants of whomever you obey , whether of sin to death , or of obedience to righteousness ?

verses.z: 感謝上帝！因為你們從前雖然作罪的奴僕，現今卻從心裏順服了所傳給你們道理的模範。
verses.e: But thanks be to God that , whereas you were bondservants of sin , you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered .

verses.z: 你們既從罪裏得了釋放，就作了義的奴僕。
verses.e: Being made free from sin , you became bondservants of righteousness .

verses.z: 我因你們肉體的軟弱，就照人的常話對你們說。你們從前怎樣將肢體獻給不潔不法作奴僕，以至於不法；現今也要照樣將肢體獻給義作奴僕，以至於成聖。
verses.e: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh ; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness , even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification .

verses.z: 斷乎不可！我們在罪上死了的人豈可仍在罪中活着呢？
verses.e: May it never be ! We who died to sin , how could we live in it any longer ?

verses.z: 因為你們作罪之奴僕的時候，就不被義約束了。
verses.e: For when you were servants of sin , you were free from righteousness .

verses.z: 你們現今所看為羞恥的事，當日有甚麼果子呢？那些事的結局就是死。
verses.e: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed ? For the end of those things is death .

verses.z: 但現今，你們既從罪裏得了釋放，作了上帝的奴僕，就有成聖的果子，那結局就是永生。
verses.e: But now , being made free from sin and having become servants of God , you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life .

verses.z: 因為罪的工價乃是死；惟有上帝的恩賜，在我們的主基督耶穌裏，乃是永生。
verses.e: For the wages of sin is death , but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord .

verses.z: 豈不知我們這受洗歸入基督耶穌的人是受洗歸入他的死嗎？
verses.e: Or don't you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death ?

verses.z: 所以，我們藉着洗禮歸入死，和他一同埋葬，原是叫我們一舉一動有新生的樣式，像基督藉着父的榮耀從死裏復活一樣。
verses.e: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death , that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father , so we also might walk in newness of life .

verses.z: 我們若在他死的形狀上與他聯合，也要在他復活的形狀上與他聯合；
verses.e: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death , we will also be part of his resurrection ;

verses.z: 因為知道我們的舊人和他同釘十字架，使罪身滅絕，叫我們不再作罪的奴僕；
verses.e: knowing this , that our old man was crucified with him , that the body of sin might be done away with , so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin .

verses.z: 因為已死的人是脫離了罪。
verses.e: For he who has died has been freed from sin .

verses.z: 我們若是與基督同死，就信必與他同活。
verses.e: But if we died with Christ , we believe that we will also live with him ,

verses.z: 因為知道基督既從死裏復活，就不再死，死也不再作他的主了。
verses.e: knowing that Christ , being raised from the dead , dies no more . Death no longer has dominion over him !

verses.z: 弟兄們，我現在對明白律法的人說，你們豈不曉得律法管人是在活着的時候嗎？
verses.e: Or don't you know , brothers ( for I speak to men who know the law ) , that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives ?

verses.z: 那本來叫人活的誡命，反倒叫我死；
verses.e: The commandment which was for life , this I found to be for death ;

verses.z: 因為罪趁着機會，就藉着誡命引誘我，並且殺了我。
verses.e: for sin , finding occasion through the commandment , deceived me , and through it killed me .

verses.z: 這樣看來，律法是聖潔的，誡命也是聖潔、公義、良善的。
verses.e: Therefore the law indeed is holy , and the commandment holy , righteous , and good .

verses.z: 既然如此，那良善的是叫我死嗎？斷乎不是！[叫我死的乃是罪]。但罪藉着那良善的叫我死，就顯出真是罪，叫罪因着誡命更顯出是惡極了。
verses.e: Did then that which is good become death to me ? May it never be ! But sin , that it might be shown to be sin , was producing death in me through that which is good ; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful .

verses.z: 我們原曉得律法是屬乎靈的，但我是屬乎肉體的，是已經賣給罪了。
verses.e: For we know that the law is spiritual , but I am fleshly , sold under sin .

verses.z: 因為我所做的，我自己不明白；我所願意的，我並不做；我所恨惡的，我倒去做。
verses.e: For I don't understand what I am doing . For I don't practice what I desire to do ; but what I hate , that I do .

verses.z: 若我所做的，是我所不願意的，我就應承律法是善的。
verses.e: But if what I don't desire , that I do , I consent to the law that it is good .

verses.z: 既是這樣，就不是我做的，乃是住在我裏頭的罪做的。
verses.e: So now it is no more I that do it , but sin which dwells in me .

verses.z: 我也知道，在我裏頭，就是我肉體之中，沒有良善。因為，立志為善由得我，只是行出來由不得我。
verses.e: For I know that in me , that is , in my flesh , dwells no good thing . For desire is present with me , but I don't find it doing that which is good .

verses.z: 故此，我所願意的善，我反不做；我所不願意的惡，我倒去做。
verses.e: For the good which I desire , I don't do ; but the evil which I don't desire , that I practice .

verses.z: 就如女人有了丈夫，丈夫還活着，就被律法約束；丈夫若死了，就脫離了丈夫的律法。
verses.e: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives , but if the husband dies , she is discharged from the law of the husband .

verses.z: 若我去做所不願意做的，就不是我做的，乃是住在我裏頭的罪做的。
verses.e: But if what I don't desire , that I do , it is no more I that do it , but sin which dwells in me .

verses.z: 我覺得有個律，就是我願意為善的時候，便有惡與我同在。
verses.e: I find then the law that , while I desire to do good , evil is present .

verses.z: 因為按着我裏面的意思，我是喜歡上帝的律；
verses.e: For I delight in God's law after the inward person ,

verses.z: 但我覺得肢體中另有個律和我心中的律交戰，把我擄去，叫我附從那肢體中犯罪的律。
verses.e: but I see a different law in my members , warring against the law of my mind , and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members .

verses.z: 我真是苦啊！誰能救我脫離這取死的身體呢？
verses.e: What a wretched man I am ! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death ?

verses.z: 感謝上帝，靠着我們的主耶穌基督[就能脫離了]。這樣看來，我以內心順服上帝的律，我肉體卻順服罪的律了。
verses.e: I thank God through Jesus Christ , our Lord ! So then with the mind , I myself serve God's law , but with the flesh , sin's law .

verses.z: 所以丈夫活着，她若歸於別人，便叫淫婦；丈夫若死了，她就脫離了丈夫的律法，雖然歸於別人，也不是淫婦。
verses.e: So then if , while the husband lives , she is joined to another man , she would be called an adulteress . But if the husband dies , she is free from the law , so that she is no adulteress , though she is joined to another man .

verses.z: 我的弟兄們，這樣說來，你們藉着基督的身體，在律法上也是死了，叫你們歸於別人，就是歸於那從死裏復活的，叫我們結果子給上帝。
verses.e: Therefore , my brothers , you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ , that you would be joined to another , to him who was raised from the dead , that we might produce fruit to God .

verses.z: 因為我們屬肉體的時候，那因律法而生的惡慾就在我們肢體中發動，以致結成死亡的果子。
verses.e: For when we were in the flesh , the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death .

verses.z: 但我們既然在捆我們的律法上死了，現今就脫離了律法，叫我們服事[主]，要按着心靈的新樣，不按着儀文的舊樣。
verses.e: But now we have been discharged from the law , having died to that in which we were held ; so that we serve in newness of the spirit , and not in oldness of the letter .

verses.z: 這樣，我們可說甚麼呢？律法是罪嗎？斷乎不是！只是非因律法，我就不知何為罪。非律法說「不可起貪心」，我就不知何為貪心。
verses.e: What shall we say then ? Is the law sin ? May it never be ! However , I wouldn't have known sin except through the law . For I wouldn't have known coveting unless the law had said , " You shall not covet . "

verses.z: 然而，罪趁着機會，就藉着誡命叫諸般的貪心在我裏頭發動；因為沒有律法，罪是死的。
verses.e: But sin , finding occasion through the commandment , produced in me all kinds of coveting . For apart from the law , sin is dead .

verses.z: 我以前沒有律法是活着的；但是誡命來到，罪又活了，我就死了。
verses.e: I was alive apart from the law once , but when the commandment came , sin revived and I died .

verses.z: 如今，那些在基督耶穌裏的就不定罪了。
verses.e: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus , who don't walk according to the flesh , but according to the Spirit .

verses.z: 基督若在你們心裏，身體就因罪而死，心靈卻因義而活。
verses.e: If Christ is in you , the body is dead because of sin , but the spirit is alive because of righteousness .

verses.z: 然而，叫耶穌從死裏復活者的靈若住在你們心裏，那叫基督耶穌從死裏復活的，也必藉着住在你們心裏的[聖]靈，使你們必死的身體又活過來。
verses.e: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you , he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you .

verses.z: 弟兄們，這樣看來，我們並不是欠肉體的債去順從肉體活着。
verses.e: So then , brothers , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .

verses.z: 你們若順從肉體活着，必要死；若靠着[聖]靈治死身體的惡行，必要活着。
verses.e: For if you live after the flesh , you must die ; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body , you will live .

verses.z: 因為凡被上帝的靈引導的，都是上帝的兒子。
verses.e: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God , these are children of God .

verses.z: 你們所受的，不是奴僕的心，仍舊害怕；所受的，乃是兒子的心，因此我們呼叫：「阿爸！父！」
verses.e: For you didn't receive the spirit of bondage again to fear , but you received the Spirit of adoption , by whom we cry , " Abba ! Father ! "

verses.z: 聖靈與我們的心同證我們是上帝的兒女；
verses.e: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God ;

verses.z: 既是兒女，便是後嗣，就是上帝的後嗣，和基督同作後嗣。如果我們和他一同受苦，也必和他一同得榮耀。
verses.e: and if children , then heirs — heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ , if indeed we suffer with him , that we may also be glorified with him .

verses.z: 我想，現在的苦楚若比起將來要顯於我們的榮耀就不足介意了。
verses.e: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us .

verses.z: 受造之物切望等候上帝的眾子顯出來。
verses.e: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed .

verses.z: 因為賜生命[聖]靈的律，在基督耶穌裏釋放了我，使我脫離罪和死的律了。
verses.e: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death .

verses.z: 因為受造之物服在虛空之下，不是自己願意，乃是因那叫他如此的。
verses.e: For the creation was subjected to vanity , not of its own will , but because of him who subjected it , in hope

verses.z: 但受造之物仍然指望脫離敗壞的轄制，得享上帝兒女自由的榮耀。
verses.e: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God .

verses.z: 我們知道，一切受造之物一同歎息，勞苦，直到如今。
verses.e: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now .

verses.z: 不但如此，就是我們這有[聖]靈初結果子的，也是自己心裏歎息，等候得着兒子的名分，乃是我們的身體得贖。
verses.e: Not only so , but ourselves also , who have the first fruits of the Spirit , even we ourselves groan within ourselves , waiting for adoption , the redemption of our body .

verses.z: 我們得救是在乎盼望；只是所見的盼望不是盼望，誰還盼望他所見的呢？
verses.e: For we were saved in hope , but hope that is seen is not hope . For who hopes for that which he sees ?

verses.z: 但我們若盼望那所不見的，就必忍耐等候。
verses.e: But if we hope for that which we don't see , we wait for it with patience .

verses.z: 況且，我們的軟弱有[聖]靈幫助；我們本不曉得當怎樣禱告，只是[聖]靈親自用說不出來的歎息替我們禱告。
verses.e: In the same way , the Spirit also helps our weaknesses , for we don't know how to pray as we ought . But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can't be uttered .

verses.z: 鑒察人心的，曉得[聖]靈的意思，因為[聖]靈照着上帝的[旨意]替聖徒祈求。
verses.e: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit's mind , because he makes intercession for the saints according to God .

verses.z: 我們曉得萬事都互相效力，叫愛上帝的人得益處，就是按他旨意被召的人。
verses.e: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God , for those who are called according to his purpose .

verses.z: 因為他預先所知道的人，就預先定下效法他兒子的模樣，使他兒子在許多弟兄中作長子。
verses.e: For whom he foreknew , he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brothers .

verses.z: 律法既因肉體軟弱，有所不能行的，上帝就差遣自己的兒子，成為罪身的形狀，作了贖罪祭，在肉體中定了罪案，
verses.e: For what the law couldn't do , in that it was weak through the flesh , God did , sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin , he condemned sin in the flesh ,

verses.z: 預先所定下的人又召他們來；所召來的人又稱他們為義；所稱為義的人又叫他們得榮耀。
verses.e: Whom he predestined , those he also called . Whom he called , those he also justified . Whom he justified , those he also glorified .

verses.z: 既是這樣，還有甚麼說的呢？上帝若幫助我們，誰能敵擋我們呢？
verses.e: What then shall we say about these things ? If God is for us , who can be against us ?

verses.z: 上帝既不愛惜自己的兒子，為我們眾人捨了，豈不也把萬物和他一同白白地賜給我們嗎？
verses.e: He who didn't spare his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how would he not also with him freely give us all things ?

verses.z: 誰能控告上帝所揀選的人呢？有上帝稱他們為義了。
verses.e: Who could bring a charge against God's chosen ones ? It is God who justifies .

verses.z: 誰能定他們的罪呢？有基督耶穌已經死了，而且從死裏復活，現今在上帝的右邊，也替我們祈求。
verses.e: Who is he who condemns ? It is Christ who died , yes rather , who was raised from the dead , who is at the right hand of God , who also makes intercession for us .

verses.z: 誰能使我們與基督的愛隔絕呢？難道是患難嗎？是困苦嗎？是逼迫嗎？是飢餓嗎？是赤身露體嗎？是危險嗎？是刀劍嗎？
verses.e: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ ? Could oppression , or anguish , or persecution , or famine , or nakedness , or peril , or sword ?

verses.z: 如[經上]所記：我們為你的緣故終日被殺；人看我們如將宰的羊。
verses.e: Even as it is written , " For your sake we are killed all day long . We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter . "

verses.z: 然而，靠着愛我們的[主]，在這一切的事上已經得勝有餘了。
verses.e: No , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us .

verses.z: 因為我深信無論是死，是生，是天使，是掌權的，是有能的，是現在的事，是將來的事，
verses.e: For I am persuaded that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor things present , nor things to come , nor powers ,

verses.z: 是高處的，是低處的，是別的受造之物，都不能叫我們與上帝的愛隔絕；這愛是在我們的主基督耶穌裏的。
verses.e: nor height , nor depth , nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God's love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord .

verses.z: 使律法的義成就在我們這不隨從肉體、只隨從[聖]靈的人身上。
verses.e: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don't walk according to the flesh , but according to the Spirit .

verses.z: 因為，隨從肉體的人體貼肉體的事；隨從[聖]靈的人體貼[聖]靈的事。
verses.e: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh , but those who live according to the Spirit , the things of the Spirit .

verses.z: 體貼肉體的，就是死；體貼[聖]靈的，乃是生命、平安。
verses.e: For the mind of the flesh is death , but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace ;

verses.z: 原來體貼肉體的，就是與上帝為仇；因為不服上帝的律法，也是不能服，
verses.e: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God , for it is not subject to God's law , neither indeed can it be .

verses.z: 而且屬肉體的人不能得上帝的喜歡。
verses.e: Those who are in the flesh can't please God .

verses.z: 如果上帝的靈住在你們心裏，你們就不屬肉體，乃屬[聖]靈了。人若沒有基督的靈，就不是屬基督的。
verses.e: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit , if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you . But if any man doesn't have the Spirit of Christ , he is not his .

verses.z: 我在基督裏說真話，並不謊言，有我良心被聖靈感動，給我作見證：
verses.e: I tell the truth in Christ . I am not lying , my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

verses.z: 不但如此，還有利百加，既從一個人，就是從我們的祖宗以撒懷了孕，（
verses.e: Not only so , but Rebekah also conceived by one , by our father Isaac .

verses.z: [雙子]還沒有生下來，善惡還沒有做出來，只因要顯明上帝揀選人的旨意，不在乎人的行為，乃在乎召人的[主]。）
verses.e: For being not yet born , neither having done anything good or bad , that the purpose of God according to election might stand , not of works , but of him who calls ,

verses.z: 上帝就對利百加說：「將來，大的要服事小的。」
verses.e: it was said to her , " The elder will serve the younger . "

verses.z: 正如[經上]所記：雅各是我所愛的；以掃是我所惡的。
verses.e: Even as it is written , " Jacob I loved , but Esau I hated . "

verses.z: 這樣，我們可說甚麼呢？難道上帝有甚麼不公平嗎？斷乎沒有！
verses.e: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? May it never be !

verses.z: 因他對摩西說：我要憐憫誰就憐憫誰，要恩待誰就恩待誰。
verses.e: For he said to Moses , " I will have mercy on whom I have mercy , and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion . "

verses.z: 據此看來，這不在乎那定意的，也不在乎那奔跑的，只在乎發憐憫的上帝。
verses.e: So then it is not of him who wills , nor of him who runs , but of God who has mercy .

verses.z: 因為經上有話向法老說：「我將你興起來，特要在你身上彰顯我的權能，並要使我的名傳遍天下。」
verses.e: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh , " For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up , that I might show in you my power , and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth . "

verses.z: 如此看來，上帝要憐憫誰就憐憫誰，要叫誰剛硬就叫誰剛硬。
verses.e: So then , he has mercy on whom he desires , and he hardens whom he desires .

verses.z: 這樣，你必對我說：「他為甚麼還指責人呢？有誰抗拒他的旨意呢？」
verses.e: You will say then to me , " Why does he still find fault ? For who withstands his will ? "

verses.z: 我是大有憂愁，心裏時常傷痛；
verses.e: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart .

verses.z: 你這個人哪，你是誰，竟敢向上帝強嘴呢？受造之物豈能對造他的說：「你為甚麼這樣造我呢？」
verses.e: But indeed , O man , who are you to reply against God ? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it , " Why did you make me like this ? "

verses.z: 窯匠難道沒有權柄從一團泥裏拿一塊做成貴重的器皿，又拿一塊做成卑賤的器皿嗎？
verses.e: Or hasn't the potter a right over the clay , from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor , and another for dishonor ?

verses.z: 倘若上帝要顯明他的忿怒，彰顯他的權能，就多多忍耐寬容那可怒、預備遭毀滅的器皿，
verses.e: What if God , willing to show his wrath and to make his power known , endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction ,

verses.z: 又要將他豐盛的榮耀彰顯在那蒙憐憫、早預備得榮耀的器皿上。
verses.e: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy , which he prepared beforehand for glory —

verses.z: 這[器皿]就是我們被上帝所召的，不但是從猶太人中，也是從外邦人中。這有甚麼不可呢？
verses.e: us , whom he also called , not from the Jews only , but also from the Gentiles ?

verses.z: 就像上帝在何西阿書上說：那本來不是我子民的，我要稱為「我的子民」；本來不是蒙愛的，我要稱為「蒙愛的」。
verses.e: As he says also in Hosea , " I will call them ' my people , ' which were not my people ; and her ' beloved , ' who was not beloved . "

verses.z: 從前在甚麼地方對他們說：你們不是我的子民，將來就在那裏稱他們為「永生上帝的兒子」。
verses.e: " It will be that in the place where it was said to them , ' You are not my people , ' there they will be called ' children of the living God . ' "

verses.z: 以賽亞指着以色列人喊着說：「以色列人雖多如海沙，得救的不過是剩下的餘數；
verses.e: Isaiah cries concerning Israel , " If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea , it is the remnant who will be saved ;

verses.z: 因為主要在世上施行他的話，叫他的話都成全，速速地完結。」
verses.e: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness , because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth . "

verses.z: 又如以賽亞先前說過：若不是萬軍之主給我們存留餘種，我們早已像所多瑪、蛾摩拉的樣子了。
verses.e: As Isaiah has said before , " Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed , we would have become like Sodom , and would have been made like Gomorrah . "

verses.z: 為我弟兄，我骨肉之親，就是自己被咒詛，與基督分離，我也願意。
verses.e: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers ' sake , my relatives according to the flesh

verses.z: 這樣，我們可說甚麼呢？那本來不追求義的外邦人反得了義，就是因信而得的義。
verses.e: What shall we say then ? That the Gentiles , who didn't follow after righteousness , attained to righteousness , even the righteousness which is of faith ;

verses.z: 但以色列人追求律法的義，反得不着律法的義。
verses.e: but Israel , following after a law of righteousness , didn't arrive at the law of righteousness .

verses.z: 這是甚麼緣故呢？是因為他們不憑着信心求，只憑着行為求；他們正跌在那絆腳石上。
verses.e: Why ? Because they didn't seek it by faith , but as it were by works of the law . They stumbled over the stumbling stone ,

verses.z: 就如經上所記：我在錫安放一塊絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石；信靠他的人必不至於羞愧。
verses.e: even as it is written , " Behold , I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense ; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed . "

verses.z: 他們是以色列人；那兒子的名分、榮耀、諸約、律法、禮儀、應許都是他們的。
verses.e: who are Israelites ; whose is the adoption , the glory , the covenants , the giving of the law , the service , and the promises ;

verses.z: 列祖就是他們的祖宗；按肉體說，基督也是從他們出來的。他是在萬有之上，永遠可稱頌的上帝。阿們！
verses.e: of whom are the fathers , and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh , who is over all , God , blessed forever . Amen .

verses.z: 這不是說上帝的話落了空。因為從以色列生的不都是以色列人，
verses.e: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing . For they are not all Israel that are of Israel .

verses.z: 也不因為是亞伯拉罕的後裔就都作他的兒女；惟獨「從以撒生的才要稱為你的後裔。」
verses.e: Neither , because they are Abraham's offspring , are they all children . But , " your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac . "

verses.z: 這就是說，肉身所生的兒女不是上帝的兒女，惟獨那應許的兒女才算是後裔。
verses.e: That is , it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God , but the children of the promise are counted as heirs .

verses.z: 因為所應許的話是這樣說：「到[明年]這時候我要來，撒拉必生一個兒子。」
verses.e: For this is a word of promise : " At the appointed time I will come , and Sarah will have a son . "

verses.z: 當士師秉政的時候，國中遭遇饑荒。在猶大的伯利恆，有一個人帶着妻子和兩個兒子往摩押地去寄居。
verses.e: In the days when the judges judged , there was a famine in the land . A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and his two sons .

verses.z: 說：「不然，我們必與你一同回你本國去。」
verses.e: They said to her , " No , but we will return with you to your people . "

verses.z: 拿俄米說：「我女兒們哪，回去吧！為何要跟我去呢？我還能生子作你們的丈夫嗎？
verses.e: Naomi said , " Go back , my daughters . Why do you want to go with me ? Do I still have sons in my womb , that they may be your husbands ?

verses.z: 我女兒們哪，回去吧！我年紀老邁，不能再有丈夫；即或說，我還有指望，今夜有丈夫可以生子，
verses.e: Go back , my daughters , go your way ; for I am too old to have a husband . If I should say , ' I have hope , ' if I should even have a husband tonight , and should also bear sons ,

verses.z: 你們豈能等着他們長大呢？你們豈能等着他們不嫁別人呢？我女兒們哪，不要這樣。我為你們的緣故甚是愁苦，因為耶和華伸手攻擊我。」
verses.e: would you then wait until they were grown ? Would you then refrain from having husbands ? No , my daughters , for it grieves me seriously for your sakes , for the LORD's hand has gone out against me . "

verses.z: 兩個兒婦又放聲而哭，俄珥巴與婆婆親嘴[而別]，只是路得捨不得拿俄米。
verses.e: They lifted up their voices and wept again ; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law , but Ruth stayed with her .

verses.z: 拿俄米說：「看哪，你嫂子已經回她本國和她[所拜]的神那裏去了，你也跟着你嫂子回去吧！」
verses.e: She said , " Behold , your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god . Follow your sister-in-law . "

verses.z: 路得說：「不要催我回去不跟隨你。你往哪裏去，我也往那裏去；你在哪裏住宿，我也在那裏住宿；你的國就是我的國，你的上帝就是我的上帝。
verses.e: Ruth said , " Don't urge me to leave you , and to return from following you , for where you go , I will go ; and where you stay , I will stay . Your people will be my people , and your God my God .

verses.z: 你在哪裏死，我也在那裏死，也葬在那裏。除非死能使你我相離！不然，願耶和華重重地降罰與我。」
verses.e: Where you die , I will die , and there I will be buried . May the LORD do so to me , and more also , if anything but death parts you and me . "

verses.z: 拿俄米見路得定意要跟隨自己去，就不再勸她了。
verses.e: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her , she stopped urging her .

verses.z: 於是二人同行，來到伯利恆。她們到了伯利恆，合城的人就都驚訝。婦女們說：「這是拿俄米嗎？」
verses.e: So they both went until they came to Bethlehem . When they had come to Bethlehem , all the city was excited about them , and they asked , " Is this Naomi ? "

verses.z: 這人名叫以利米勒，他的妻名叫拿俄米；他兩個兒子，一個名叫瑪倫，一個名叫基連，都是猶大伯利恆的以法他人。他們到了摩押地，就住在那裏。
verses.e: The name of the man was Elimelech , and the name of his wife Naomi . The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion , Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah . They came into the country of Moab and lived there .

verses.z: 拿俄米對她們說：「不要叫我拿俄米，要叫我瑪拉，因為全能者使我受了大苦。
verses.e: She said to them , " Don't call me Naomi . Call me Mara , for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me .

verses.z: 我滿滿地出去，耶和華使我空空地回來。耶和華降禍與我；全能者使我受苦。既是這樣，你們為何還叫我拿俄米呢？」
verses.e: I went out full , and the LORD has brought me home again empty . Why do you call me Naomi , since the LORD has testified against me , and the Almighty has afflicted me ? "

verses.z: 拿俄米和她兒婦摩押女子路得，從摩押地回來到伯利恆，正是動手割大麥的時候。
verses.e: So Naomi returned , and Ruth the Moabitess , her daughter-in-law , with her , who returned out of the country of Moab . They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest .

verses.z: 後來拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒死了，剩下婦人和她兩個兒子。
verses.e: Elimelech , Naomi's husband , died ; and she was left with her two sons .

verses.z: 這兩個兒子娶了摩押女子為妻，一個名叫俄珥巴，一個名叫路得，在那裏住了約有十年。
verses.e: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab . The name of the one was Orpah , and the name of the other was Ruth . They lived there about ten years .

verses.z: 瑪倫和基連二人也死了，剩下拿俄米，沒有丈夫，也沒有兒子。
verses.e: Mahlon and Chilion both died , and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband .

verses.z: 她就與兩個兒婦起身，要從摩押地歸回；因為她在摩押地聽見耶和華眷顧自己的百姓，賜糧食與他們。
verses.e: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law , that she might return from the country of Moab ; for she had heard in the country of Moab how the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread .

verses.z: 於是她和兩個兒婦起行離開所住的地方，要回猶大地去。
verses.e: She went out of the place where she was , and her two daughters-in-law with her . They went on the way to return to the land of Judah .

verses.z: 拿俄米對兩個兒婦說：「你們各人回娘家去吧。願耶和華恩待你們，像你們恩待已死的人與我一樣！
verses.e: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law , " Go , return each of you to her mother's house . May the LORD deal kindly with you , as you have dealt with the dead and with me .

verses.z: 願耶和華使你們各在新夫家中得平安！」於是拿俄米與她們親嘴。她們就放聲而哭，
verses.e: May the LORD grant you that you may find rest , each of you in the house of her husband . " Then she kissed them , and they lifted up their voices , and wept .

verses.z: 拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒的親族中，有一個人名叫波阿斯，是個大財主。
verses.e: Naomi had a relative of her husband's , a mighty man of wealth , of the family of Elimelech , and his name was Boaz .

verses.z: 路得就俯伏在地叩拜，對他說：「我既是外邦人，怎麼蒙你的恩，這樣顧恤我呢？」
verses.e: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground , and said to him , " Why have I found favor in your sight , that you should take knowledge of me , since I am a foreigner ? "

verses.z: 波阿斯回答說：「自從你丈夫死後，凡你向婆婆所行的，並你離開父母和本地，到素不認識的民中，這些事人全都告訴我了。
verses.e: Boaz answered her , " I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband , and how you have left your father , your mother , and the land of your birth , and have come to a people that you didn't know before .

verses.z: 願耶和華照你所行的賞賜你。你來投靠耶和華－以色列上帝的翅膀下，願你滿得他的賞賜。」
verses.e: May the LORD repay your work , and a full reward be given to you from the LORD , the God of Israel , under whose wings you have come to take refuge . "

verses.z: 路得說：「我主啊，願在你眼前蒙恩。我雖然不及你的一個使女，你還用慈愛的話安慰我的心。」
verses.e: Then she said , " Let me find favor in your sight , my lord , because you have comforted me , and because you have spoken kindly to your servant , though I am not as one of your servants . "

verses.z: 到了吃飯的時候，波阿斯對路得說：「你到這裏來吃餅，將餅蘸在醋裏。」路得就在收割的人旁邊坐下；他們把烘了的穗子遞給她。她吃飽了，還有餘剩的。
verses.e: At meal time Boaz said to her , " Come here , and eat some bread , and dip your morsel in the vinegar . " She sat beside the reapers , and they passed her parched grain . She ate , was satisfied , and left some of it .

verses.z: 她起來又拾取麥穗，波阿斯吩咐僕人說：「她就是在捆中拾取麥穗，也可以容她，不可羞辱她；
verses.e: When she had risen up to glean , Boaz commanded his young men , saying , " Let her glean even among the sheaves , and don't reproach her .

verses.z: 並要從捆裏抽出些來，留在地下任她拾取，不可叱嚇她。」
verses.e: Also pull out some for her from the bundles , and leave it . Let her glean , and don't rebuke her . "

verses.z: 這樣，路得在田間拾取麥穗，直到晚上，將所拾取的打了，約有一伊法大麥。
verses.e: So she gleaned in the field until evening ; and she beat out that which she had gleaned , and it was about an ephah of barley .

verses.z: 她就把所拾取的帶進城去給婆婆看，又把她吃飽了所剩的給了婆婆。
verses.e: She took it up , and went into the city . Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned ; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough .

verses.z: 婆婆問她說：「你今日在哪裏拾取麥穗，在哪裏做工呢？願那顧恤你的得福。」路得就告訴婆婆說：「我今日在一個名叫波阿斯的人那裏做工。」
verses.e: Her mother-in-law said to her , " Where have you gleaned today ? Where have you worked ? Blessed be he who noticed you . " She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked , " The man's name with whom I worked today is Boaz . "

verses.z: 摩押女子路得對拿俄米說：「容我往田間去，我蒙誰的恩，就在誰的身後拾取麥穗。」拿俄米說：「女兒啊，你只管去。」
verses.e: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi , " Let me now go to the field , and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor . " She said to her , " Go , my daughter . "

verses.z: 拿俄米對兒婦說：「願那人蒙耶和華賜福，因為他不斷地恩待活人死人。」拿俄米又說：「那是我們本族的人，是一個至近的親屬。」
verses.e: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law , " May he be blessed by the LORD , who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead . " Naomi said to her , " The man is a close relative to us , one of our near kinsmen . "

verses.z: 摩押女子路得說：「他對我說：『你要緊隨我的僕人[拾取麥穗]，直等他們收完了我的莊稼。』」
verses.e: Ruth the Moabitess said , " Yes , he said to me , ' You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest . ' "

verses.z: 拿俄米對兒婦路得說：「女兒啊，你跟着他的使女出去，不叫人遇見你在別人田間，這才為好。」
verses.e: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law , " It is good , my daughter , that you go out with his maidens , and that they not harm you in any other field . "

verses.z: 於是路得與波阿斯的使女常在一處拾取麥穗，直到收完了大麥和小麥。路得仍與婆婆同住。
verses.e: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz , to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest ; and she lived with her mother-in-law .

verses.z: 路得就去了，來到田間，在收割的人身後拾取麥穗。她恰巧到了以利米勒本族的人波阿斯那塊田裏。
verses.e: She went , and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers ; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz , who was of the family of Elimelech .

verses.z: 波阿斯正從伯利恆來，對收割的人說：「願耶和華與你們同在！」他們回答說：「願耶和華賜福與你！」
verses.e: Behold , Boaz came from Bethlehem , and said to the reapers , " May the LORD be with you . " They answered him , " May the LORD bless you . "

verses.z: 波阿斯問監管收割的僕人說：「那是誰家的女子？」
verses.e: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers , " Whose young lady is this ? "

verses.z: 監管收割的僕人回答說：「是那摩押女子，跟隨拿俄米從摩押地回來的。
verses.e: The servant who was set over the reapers answered , " It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab .

verses.z: 她說：『請你容我跟着收割的人拾取打捆剩下的麥穗。』她從早晨直到如今，除了在屋子裏坐一會兒，常在這裏。」
verses.e: She said , ' Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves . ' So she came , and has continued even from the morning until now , except that she rested a little in the house . "

verses.z: 波阿斯對路得說：「女兒啊，聽我說，不要往別人田裏拾取麥穗，也不要離開這裏，要常與我使女們在一處。
verses.e: Then Boaz said to Ruth , " Listen , my daughter . Don't go to glean in another field , and don't go from here , but stay here close to my maidens .

verses.z: 我的僕人在那塊田收割，你就跟着他們去。我已經吩咐僕人不可欺負你；你若渴了，就可以到器皿那裏喝僕人打來的水。」
verses.e: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap , and go after them . Haven't I commanded the young men not to touch you ? When you are thirsty , go to the vessels , and drink from that which the young men have drawn . "

verses.z: 路得的婆婆拿俄米對她說：「女兒啊，我不當為你找個安身之處，使你享福嗎？
verses.e: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her , " My daughter , shall I not seek rest for you , that it may be well with you ?

verses.z: 波阿斯說：「女兒啊，願你蒙耶和華賜福。你末後的恩比先前更大；因為少年人無論貧富，你都沒有跟從。
verses.e: He said , " You are blessed by the LORD , my daughter . You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning , because you didn't follow young men , whether poor or rich .

verses.z: 女兒啊，現在不要懼怕，凡你所說的，我必照着行；我本城的人都知道你是個賢德的女子。
verses.e: Now , my daughter , don't be afraid . I will do to you all that you say ; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman .

verses.z: 我實在是你一個至近的親屬，只是還有一個人比我更近。
verses.e: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman . However , there is a kinsman nearer than I .

verses.z: 你今夜在這裏住宿，明早他若肯為你盡親屬的本分，就由他吧！倘若不肯，我指着永生的耶和華起誓，我必為你盡了本分，你只管躺到天亮。」
verses.e: Stay this night , and in the morning , if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman , good . Let him do the kinsman's duty . But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you , then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you , as the LORD lives . Lie down until the morning . "

verses.z: 路得便在他腳下躺到天快亮，人彼此不能辨認的時候就起來了。波阿斯說：「不可使人知道有女子到場上來」；
verses.e: She lay at his feet until the morning , then she rose up before one could discern another . For he said , " Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor . "

verses.z: 又對路得說：「打開你所披的外衣。」她打開了，波阿斯就撮了六[簸箕]大麥，幫她扛在肩上，她便進城去了。
verses.e: He said , " Bring the mantle that is on you , and hold it . " She held it ; and he measured six measures of barley , and laid it on her ; then he went into the city .

verses.z: 路得回到婆婆那裏，婆婆說：「女兒啊，怎麼樣了？」路得就將那人向她所行的述說了一遍，
verses.e: When she came to her mother-in-law , she said , " How did it go , my daughter ? " She told her all that the man had done for her .

verses.z: 又說：「那人給了我六[簸箕]大麥，對我說：『你不可空手回去見你的婆婆。』」
verses.e: She said , " He gave me these six measures of barley ; for he said , ' Don't go empty to your mother-in-law . ' "

verses.z: 婆婆說：「女兒啊，你只管安坐等候，看這事怎樣成就，因為那人今日不辦成這事必不休息。」
verses.e: Then she said , " Wait , my daughter , until you know what will happen ; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today . "

verses.z: 你與波阿斯的使女常在一處，波阿斯不是我們的親族嗎？他今夜在場上簸大麥；
verses.e: Now isn't Boaz our kinsman , with whose maidens you were ? Behold , he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor .

verses.z: 你要沐浴抹膏，換上衣服，下到場上，卻不要使那人認出你來。你等他吃喝完了，
verses.e: Therefore wash yourself , anoint yourself , get dressed , and go down to the threshing floor ; but don't make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking .

verses.z: 到他睡的時候，你看準他睡的地方，就進去掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裏，他必告訴你所當做的事。」
verses.e: It shall be , when he lies down , that you shall note the place where he is lying . Then you shall go in , uncover his feet , and lie down . Then he will tell you what to do . "

verses.z: 路得說：「凡你所吩咐的，我必遵行。」
verses.e: She said to her , " All that you say , I will do . "

verses.z: 路得就下到場上，照她婆婆所吩咐她的而行。
verses.e: She went down to the threshing floor , and did everything that her mother-in-law told her .

verses.z: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心裏歡暢，就去睡在麥堆旁邊。路得便悄悄地來掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裏。
verses.e: When Boaz had eaten and drunk , and his heart was merry , he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain . She came softly , uncovered his feet , and lay down .

verses.z: 到了夜半，那人忽然驚醒，翻過身來，不料有女子躺在他的腳下。
verses.e: At midnight , the man was startled and turned himself ; and behold , a woman lay at his feet .

verses.z: 他就說：「你是誰？」回答說：「我是你的婢女路得。求你用你的衣襟遮蓋我，因為你是我一個至近的親屬。」
verses.e: He said , " Who are you ? " She answered , " I am Ruth your servant . Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant ; for you are a near kinsman . "

verses.z: 波阿斯到了城門，坐在那裏，恰巧波阿斯所說的那至近的親屬經過。波阿斯說：「某人哪，你來坐在這裏。」他就來坐下。
verses.e: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there . Behold , the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by . Boaz said to him , " Come over here , friend , and sit down ! " He came over , and sat down .

verses.z: 又娶了瑪倫的妻摩押女子路得為妻，好在死人的產業上存留他的名，免得他的名在本族本鄉滅沒。你們今日可以作見證。」
verses.e: Moreover , Ruth the Moabitess , the wife of Mahlon , I have purchased to be my wife , to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance , that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place . You are witnesses today . "

verses.z: 在城門坐着的眾民和長老都說：「我們作見證。願耶和華使進你家的這女子，像建立以色列家的拉結、利亞二人一樣。又願你在以法他得亨通，在伯利恆得名聲。
verses.e: All the people who were in the gate , and the elders , said , " We are witnesses . May the LORD make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah , which both built the house of Israel ; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah , and be famous in Bethlehem .

verses.z: 願耶和華從這少年女子賜你後裔，使你的家像她瑪從猶大所生法勒斯的家一般。」
verses.e: Let your house be like the house of Perez , whom Tamar bore to Judah , of the offspring which the LORD will give you by this young woman . "

verses.z: 於是，波阿斯娶了路得為妻，與她同房。耶和華使她懷孕生了一個兒子。
verses.e: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife ; and he went in to her , and the LORD enabled her to conceive , and she bore a son .

verses.z: 婦人們對拿俄米說：「耶和華是應當稱頌的！因為今日沒有撇下你，使你無至近的親屬。願這孩子在以色列中得名聲。
verses.e: The women said to Naomi , " Blessed be the LORD , who has not left you today without a near kinsman . Let his name be famous in Israel .

verses.z: 他必提起你的精神，奉養你的老，因為是愛慕你的那兒婦所生的。有這兒婦比有七個兒子還好！」
verses.e: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age ; for your daughter-in-law , who loves you , who is better to you than seven sons , has given birth to him . "

verses.z: 拿俄米就把孩子抱在懷中，作他的養母。
verses.e: Naomi took the child , laid him in her bosom , and became nurse to him .

verses.z: 鄰舍的婦人說：「拿俄米得孩子了！」就給孩子起名叫俄備得。這俄備得是耶西的父，耶西是大衛的父。
verses.e: The women , her neighbors , gave him a name , saying , " A son is born to Naomi " . They named him Obed . He is the father of Jesse , the father of David .

verses.z: 法勒斯的後代記在下面：法勒斯生希斯崙；
verses.e: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez : Perez became the father of Hezron ,

verses.z: 希斯崙生蘭；蘭生亞米拿達；
verses.e: and Hezron became the father of Ram , and Ram became the father of Amminadab ,

verses.z: 波阿斯又從本城的長老中揀選了十人，對他們說：「請你們坐在這裏。」他們就都坐下。
verses.e: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city , and said , " Sit down here , " and they sat down .

verses.z: 亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；
verses.e: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon , and Nahshon became the father of Salmon ,

verses.z: 撒門生波阿斯；波阿斯生俄備得；
verses.e: and Salmon became the father of Boaz , and Boaz became the father of Obed ,

verses.z: 俄備得生耶西；耶西生大衛。
verses.e: and Obed became the father of Jesse , and Jesse became the father of David .

verses.z: 波阿斯對那至近的親屬說：「從摩押地回來的拿俄米，現在要賣我們族兄以利米勒的那塊地；
verses.e: He said to the near kinsman , " Naomi , who has come back out of the country of Moab , is selling the parcel of land , which was our brother Elimelech's .

verses.z: 我想當贖那塊地的是你，其次是我，以外再沒有別人了。你可以在這裏的人面前和我本國的長老面前說明，你若肯贖就贖，若不肯贖就告訴我。」那人回答說：「我肯贖。」
verses.e: I thought I should tell you , saying , ' Buy it before those who sit here , and before the elders of my people . ' If you will redeem it , redeem it ; but if you will not redeem it , then tell me , that I may know . For there is no one to redeem it besides you ; and I am after you . " He said , " I will redeem it . "

verses.z: 波阿斯說：「你從拿俄米手中買這地的時候，也當娶死人的妻摩押女子路得，使死人在產業上存留他的名。」
verses.e: Then Boaz said , " On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi , you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess , the wife of the dead , to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance . "

verses.z: 那人說：「這樣我就不能贖了，恐怕於我的產業有礙。你可以贖我所當贖的，我不能贖了。」
verses.e: The near kinsman said , " I can't redeem it for myself , lest I endanger my own inheritance . Take my right of redemption for yourself ; for I can't redeem it . "

verses.z: 從前，在以色列中要定奪甚麼事，或贖回，或交易，這人就脫鞋給那人。以色列人都以此為證據。
verses.e: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging , to confirm all things : a man took off his sandal , and gave it to his neighbor ; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel .

verses.z: 那人對波阿斯說：「你自己買吧！」於是將鞋脫下來了。
verses.e: So the near kinsman said to Boaz , " Buy it for yourself , " then he took off his sandal .

verses.z: 波阿斯對長老和眾民說：「你們今日作見證，凡屬以利米勒和基連、瑪倫的，我都從拿俄米手中置買了；
verses.e: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people , " You are witnesses today , that I have bought all that was Elimelech's , and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's , from the hand of Naomi .

verses.z: 所羅門的歌，是歌中的雅歌。
verses.e: The Song of songs , which is Solomon's .

verses.z: 你的兩腮因髮辮而秀美；你的頸項因珠串而華麗。
verses.e: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings , your neck with strings of jewels .

verses.z: 我們要為你編上金辮，鑲上銀釘。
verses.e: We will make you earrings of gold , with studs of silver .

verses.z: 王正坐席的時候，我的哪噠香膏發出香味。
verses.e: While the king sat at his table , my perfume spread its fragrance .

verses.z: 我以我的良人為一袋沒藥，常在我懷中。
verses.e: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh , that lies between my breasts .

verses.z: 我以我的良人為一棵鳳仙花，在隱‧基底葡萄園中。
verses.e: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi .

verses.z: 我的佳偶，你甚美麗！你甚美麗！你的眼[好像]鴿子眼。
verses.e: Behold , you are beautiful , my love . Behold , you are beautiful . Your eyes are like doves .

verses.z: 我的良人哪，你甚美麗可愛！我們以青草為床榻，
verses.e: Behold , you are beautiful , my beloved , yes , pleasant ; and our couch is verdant .

verses.z: 以香柏樹為房屋的棟樑，以松樹為椽子。
verses.e: The beams of our house are cedars . Our rafters are firs .

verses.z: 願他用口與我親嘴；因你的愛情比酒更美。
verses.e: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth ; for your love is better than wine .

verses.z: 你的膏油馨香；你的名[如同]倒出來的[香]膏，所以眾童女都愛你。
verses.e: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance . Your name is oil poured out , therefore the virgins love you .

verses.z: 願你吸引我，我們就快跑跟隨你。王帶我進了內室，我們必因你歡喜快樂。我們要稱讚你的愛情，勝似稱讚[美]酒。他們愛你是理所當然的。
verses.e: Take me away with you . Let's hurry . The king has brought me into his rooms . Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you . We will praise your love more than wine ! Beloved They are right to love you .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我雖然黑，卻是秀美，如同基達的帳棚，好像所羅門的幔子。
verses.e: I am dark , but lovely , you daughters of Jerusalem , like Kedar's tents , like Solomon's curtains .

verses.z: 不要因日頭把我曬黑了就輕看我。我同母的弟兄向我發怒，他們使我看守葡萄園；我自己的葡萄園卻沒有看守。
verses.e: Don't stare at me because I am dark , because the sun has scorched me . My mother's sons were angry with me . They made me keeper of the vineyards . I haven't kept my own vineyard .

verses.z: 我心所愛的啊，求你告訴我，你在何處牧羊？晌午在何處使羊歇臥？我何必在你同伴的羊群旁邊好像蒙着臉的人呢？
verses.e: Tell me , you whom my soul loves , where you graze your flock , where you rest them at noon ; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions ?

verses.z: 你這女子中極美麗的，你若不知道，只管跟隨羊群的腳蹤去，把你的山羊羔牧放在牧人帳棚的旁邊。
verses.e: If you don't know , most beautiful among women , follow the tracks of the sheep . Graze your young goats beside the shepherds ' tents .

verses.z: 我的佳偶，我將你比法老車上套的駿馬。
verses.e: I have compared you , my love , to a steed in Pharaoh's chariots .

verses.z: 我是沙崙的玫瑰花，是谷中的百合花。
verses.e: I am a rose of Sharon , a lily of the valleys .

verses.z: 我良人對我說：〔新郎〕我的佳偶，我的美人，起來，與我同去！
verses.e: My beloved spoke , and said to me , " Rise up , my love , my beautiful one , and come away .

verses.z: 因為冬天已往，雨水止住過去了。
verses.e: For behold , the winter is past . The rain is over and gone .

verses.z: 地上百花開放，[百鳥]鳴叫的時候已經來到；斑鳩的聲音在我們境內也聽見了。
verses.e: The flowers appear on the earth . The time of the singing has come , and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land .

verses.z: 無花果樹的果子漸漸成熟；葡萄樹開花放香。我的佳偶，我的美人，起來，與我同去！
verses.e: The fig tree ripens her green figs . The vines are in blossom . They give out their fragrance . Arise , my love , my beautiful one , and come away . "

verses.z: 我的鴿子啊，你在磐石穴中，在陡巖的隱密處。求你容我得見你的面貌，得聽你的聲音；因為你的聲音柔和，你的面貌秀美。
verses.e: My dove in the clefts of the rock , in the hiding places of the mountainside , let me see your face . Let me hear your voice ; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely .

verses.z: 要給我們擒拿狐狸，就是毀壞葡萄園的小狐狸，因為我們的葡萄正在開花。
verses.e: Catch for us the foxes , the little foxes that plunder the vineyards ; for our vineyards are in blossom .

verses.z: 良人屬我，我也屬他；他在百合花中牧放[群羊]。
verses.e: My beloved is mine , and I am his . He browses among the lilies .

verses.z: 我的良人哪，求你等到天起涼風、日影飛去的時候，你要轉回，好像羚羊，或像小鹿在比特山上。
verses.e: Until the day is cool , and the shadows flee away , turn , my beloved , and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether .

verses.z: 我的佳偶在女子中，好像百合花在荊棘內。
verses.e: As a lily among thorns , so is my love among the daughters .

verses.z: 我的良人在男子中，如同蘋果樹在樹林中。我歡歡喜喜坐在他的蔭下，嘗他果子的滋味，覺得甘甜。
verses.e: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood , so is my beloved among the sons . I sat down under his shadow with great delight , his fruit was sweet to my taste .

verses.z: 他帶我入筵宴所，以愛為旗在我以上。
verses.e: He brought me to the banquet hall . His banner over me is love .

verses.z: 求你們給我葡萄乾增補我力，給我蘋果暢快我心，因我思愛成病。
verses.e: Strengthen me with raisins , refresh me with apples ; for I am faint with love .

verses.z: 他的左手在我頭下；他的右手將我抱住。
verses.e: His left hand is under my head . His right hand embraces me .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿囑咐你們：不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的，等他自己情願。
verses.e: I adjure you , daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , or by the hinds of the field , that you not stir up , nor awaken love , until it so desires .

verses.z: [聽啊]！是我良人的聲音；看哪！他躥山越嶺而來。
verses.e: The voice of my beloved ! Behold , he comes , leaping on the mountains , skipping on the hills .

verses.z: 我的良人好像羚羊，或像小鹿。他站在我們牆壁後，從窗戶往裏觀看，從窗欞往裏窺探。
verses.e: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer . Behold , he stands behind our wall ! He looks in at the windows . He glances through the lattice .

verses.z: 我夜間躺臥在床上，尋找我心所愛的；我尋找他，卻尋不見。
verses.e: By night on my bed , I sought him whom my soul loves . I sought him , but I didn't find him .

verses.z: 轎柱是用銀做的，轎底是用金做的；坐墊是紫色的，其中所鋪的乃耶路撒冷眾女子的愛情。
verses.e: He made its pillars of silver , its bottom of gold , its seat of purple , the middle of it being paved with love , from the daughters of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 錫安的眾女子啊，你們出去觀看所羅門王！頭戴冠冕，就是在他婚筵的日子、心中喜樂的時候，他母親給他戴上的。
verses.e: Go out , you daughters of Zion , and see King Solomon , with the crown with which his mother has crowned him , in the day of his weddings , in the day of the gladness of his heart .

verses.z: 我說：我要起來，遊行城中，在街市上，在寬闊處，尋找我心所愛的。我尋找他，卻尋不見。
verses.e: I will get up now , and go about the city ; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves . I sought him , but I didn't find him .

verses.z: 城中巡邏看守的人遇見我；[我問他們]：你們看見我心所愛的沒有？
verses.e: The watchmen who go about the city found me ; " Have you seen him whom my soul loves ? "

verses.z: 我剛離開他們就遇見我心所愛的。我拉住他，不容他走，領他入我母家，到懷我者的內室。
verses.e: I had scarcely passed from them , when I found him whom my soul loves . I held him , and would not let him go , until I had brought him into my mother's house , into the room of her who conceived me .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿囑咐你們：不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的，等他自己情願。
verses.e: I adjure you , daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , or by the hinds of the field , that you not stir up nor awaken love , until it so desires .

verses.z: 那從曠野上來、形狀如煙柱、以沒藥和乳香並商人各樣香粉薰的是誰呢？
verses.e: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke , perfumed with myrrh and frankincense , with all spices of the merchant ?

verses.z: 看哪，是所羅門的轎；四圍有六十個勇士，都是以色列中的勇士；
verses.e: Behold , it is Solomon's carriage ! Sixty mighty men are around it , of the mighty men of Israel .

verses.z: 手都持刀，善於爭戰，腰間佩刀，防備夜間有驚慌。
verses.e: They all handle the sword , and are expert in war . Every man has his sword on his thigh , because of fear in the night .

verses.z: 所羅門王用黎巴嫩木為自己製造一乘華轎。
verses.e: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon .

verses.z: 我的佳偶，你甚美麗！你甚美麗！你的眼在帕子內[好像]鴿子眼。你的頭髮如同山羊群臥在基列山旁。
verses.e: Behold , you are beautiful , my love . Behold , you are beautiful . Your eyes are like doves behind your veil . Your hair is as a flock of goats , that descend from Mount Gilead .

verses.z: 我妹子，我新婦，你的愛情何其美！你的愛情比酒更美！你膏油的香氣勝過一切香品！
verses.e: How beautiful is your love , my sister , my bride ! How much better is your love than wine , the fragrance of your perfumes than all kinds of spices !

verses.z: 我新婦，你的嘴唇滴蜜，好像蜂房滴蜜；你的舌下有蜜，有奶。你衣服的香氣如黎巴嫩的香氣。
verses.e: Your lips , my bride , drip like the honeycomb . Honey and milk are under your tongue . The smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon .

verses.z: 我妹子，我新婦，乃是關鎖的園，禁閉的井，封閉的泉源。
verses.e: My sister , my bride , is a locked up garden ; a locked up spring , a sealed fountain .

verses.z: 你園內所種的結了石榴，有佳美的果子，並鳳仙花與哪噠樹。
verses.e: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates , with precious fruits , henna with spikenard plants ,

verses.z: 有哪噠和番紅花，菖蒲和桂樹，並各樣乳香木、沒藥、沉香，與一切上等的果品。
verses.e: spikenard and saffron , calamus and cinnamon , with every kind of incense tree ; myrrh and aloes , with all the best spices ,

verses.z: 你是園中的泉，活水的井，從黎巴嫩流下來的溪水。
verses.e: a fountain of gardens , a well of living waters , flowing streams from Lebanon .

verses.z: 北風啊，興起！南風啊，吹來！吹在我的園內，使其中的香氣發出來。願我的良人進入自己園裏，吃他佳美的果子。
verses.e: Awake , north wind , and come , you south ! Blow on my garden , that its spices may flow out . Let my beloved come into his garden , and taste his precious fruits .

verses.z: 你的牙齒如[新]剪毛的一群[母]羊，洗淨上來，個個都有雙生，沒有一隻喪掉子的。
verses.e: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock , which have come up from the washing , where every one of them has twins . None is bereaved among them .

verses.z: 你的唇好像一條朱紅線；你的嘴也秀美。你的兩太陽在帕子內，如同一塊石榴。
verses.e: Your lips are like scarlet thread . Your mouth is lovely . Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil .

verses.z: 你的頸項好像大衛建造收藏軍器的高臺，其上懸掛一千盾牌，都是勇士的籐牌。
verses.e: Your neck is like David's tower built for an armory , on which a thousand shields hang , all the shields of the mighty men .

verses.z: 你的兩乳好像百合花中吃草的一對小鹿，就是母鹿雙生的。
verses.e: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe , which feed among the lilies .

verses.z: 我要往沒藥山和乳香岡去，直等到天起涼風、日影飛去的時候[回來]。
verses.e: Until the day is cool , and the shadows flee away , I will go to the mountain of myrrh , to the hill of frankincense .

verses.z: 我的佳偶，你全然美麗，毫無瑕疵！
verses.e: You are all beautiful , my love . There is no spot in you .

verses.z: 我的新婦，求你與我一同離開黎巴嫩，與我一同離開黎巴嫩。從亞瑪拿頂，從示尼珥與黑門頂，從有獅子的洞，從有豹子的山往下觀看。
verses.e: Come with me from Lebanon , my bride , with me from Lebanon . Look from the top of Amana , from the top of Senir and Hermon , from the lions ' dens , from the mountains of the leopards .

verses.z: 我妹子，我新婦，你奪了我的心。你用眼一看，用你項上的一條[金]鍊，奪了我的心！
verses.e: You have ravished my heart , my sister , my bride . You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes , with one chain of your neck .

verses.z: 我妹子，我新婦，我進了我的園中，採了我的沒藥和香料，吃了我的蜜房和蜂蜜，喝了我的酒和奶。〔耶路撒冷的眾女子〕我的朋友們，請吃！我所親愛的，請喝，且多多地喝！
verses.e: I have come into my garden , my sister , my bride . I have gathered my myrrh with my spice ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey ; I have drunk my wine with my milk . Friends Eat , friends ! Drink , yes , drink abundantly , beloved .

verses.z: 我的良人白而且紅，超乎萬人之上。
verses.e: My beloved is white and ruddy . The best among ten thousand .

verses.z: 他的頭[像]至精的金子；他的頭髮厚密纍垂，黑如烏鴉。
verses.e: His head is like the purest gold . His hair is bushy , black as a raven .

verses.z: 他的眼如溪水旁的鴿子[眼]，用奶洗淨，安得合式。
verses.e: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks , washed with milk , mounted like jewels .

verses.z: 他的兩腮如香花畦，如香草臺；他的嘴唇[像]百合花，且滴下沒藥汁。
verses.e: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes . His lips are like lilies , dropping liquid myrrh .

verses.z: 他的兩手[好像]金管，鑲嵌水蒼玉；他的身體[如同]雕刻的象牙，周圍鑲嵌藍寶石。
verses.e: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl . His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires .

verses.z: 他的腿[好像]白玉石柱，安在精金座上；他的形狀如黎巴嫩，且佳美如香柏樹。
verses.e: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold . His appearance is like Lebanon , excellent as the cedars .

verses.z: 他的口極其甘甜；他全然可愛。耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，這是我的良人；這是我的朋友。
verses.e: His mouth is sweetness ; yes , he is altogether lovely . This is my beloved , and this is my friend , daughters of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 我身睡臥，我心卻醒。這是我良人的聲音；他敲門[說]：〔新郎〕我的妹子，我的佳偶，我的鴿子，我的完全人，求你給我開門；因我的頭滿了露水，我的頭髮被夜露滴濕。
verses.e: I was asleep , but my heart was awake . It is the voice of my beloved who knocks : " Open to me , my sister , my love , my dove , my undefiled ; for my head is filled with dew , and my hair with the dampness of the night . "

verses.z: [我回答說]：我脫了衣裳，怎能再穿上呢？我洗了腳，怎能再玷污呢？
verses.e: I have taken off my robe . Indeed , must I put it on ? I have washed my feet . Indeed , must I soil them ?

verses.z: 我的良人從[門]孔裏伸進手來，我便因他動了心。
verses.e: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening . My heart pounded for him .

verses.z: 我起來，要給我良人開門。我的兩手滴下沒藥；我的指頭有沒藥汁滴在門閂上。
verses.e: I rose up to open for my beloved . My hands dripped with myrrh , my fingers with liquid myrrh , on the handles of the lock .

verses.z: 我給我的良人開了門；我的良人卻已轉身走了。他說話的時候，我神不守舍；我尋找他，竟尋不見；我呼叫他，他卻不回答。
verses.e: I opened to my beloved ; but my beloved left , and had gone away . My heart went out when he spoke . I looked for him , but I didn't find him . I called him , but he didn't answer .

verses.z: 城中巡邏看守的人遇見我，打了我，傷了我；看守城牆的人奪去我的披肩。
verses.e: The watchmen who go about the city found me . They beat me . They bruised me . The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我囑咐你們：若遇見我的良人，要告訴他，我因思愛成病。
verses.e: I adjure you , daughters of Jerusalem , If you find my beloved , that you tell him that I am faint with love .

verses.z: 你這女子中極美麗的，你的良人比別人的良人有何強處？你的良人比別人的良人有何強處，你就這樣囑咐我們？
verses.e: How is your beloved better than another beloved , you fairest among women ? How is your beloved better than another beloved , that you do so adjure us ?

verses.z: 你這女子中極美麗的，你的良人往何處去了？你的良人轉向何處去了，我們好與你同去尋找他。
verses.e: Where has your beloved gone , you fairest among women ? Where has your beloved turned , that we may seek him with you ?

verses.z: 那向外觀看、如晨光發現、美麗如月亮、皎潔如日頭、威武如展開旌旗軍隊的是誰呢？
verses.e: Who is she who looks out as the morning , beautiful as the moon , clear as the sun , and awesome as an army with banners ?

verses.z: 我下入核桃園，要看谷中青綠的植物，要看葡萄發芽沒有，石榴開花沒有。
verses.e: I went down into the nut tree grove , to see the green plants of the valley , to see whether the vine budded , and the pomegranates were in flower .

verses.z: 不知不覺，我的心將我安置在我尊長的車中。
verses.e: Without realizing it , my desire set me with my royal people's chariots .

verses.z: 回來，回來，書拉密女；你回來，你回來，使我們得觀看你。〔新娘〕你們為何要觀看書拉密女，像觀看瑪哈念跳舞的呢？
verses.e: Return , return , Shulammite ! Return , return , that we may gaze at you . Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite , as at the dance of Mahanaim ?

verses.z: 我的良人下入自己園中，到香花畦，在園內牧放[群羊]，採百合花。
verses.e: My beloved has gone down to his garden , to the beds of spices , to pasture his flock in the gardens , and to gather lilies .

verses.z: 我屬我的良人，我的良人也屬我；他在百合花中牧放[群羊]。
verses.e: I am my beloved's , and my beloved is mine . He browses among the lilies .

verses.z: 我的佳偶啊，你美麗如得撒，秀美如耶路撒冷，威武如展開旌旗的軍隊。
verses.e: You are beautiful , my love , as Tirzah , lovely as Jerusalem , awesome as an army with banners .

verses.z: 求你掉轉眼目不看我，因你的眼目使我驚亂。你的頭髮如同山羊群臥在基列山旁。
verses.e: Turn away your eyes from me , for they have overcome me . Your hair is like a flock of goats , that lie along the side of Gilead .

verses.z: 你的牙齒如一群母羊洗淨上來，個個都有雙生，沒有一隻喪掉子的。
verses.e: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes , which have come up from the washing , of which every one has twins ; not one is bereaved among them .

verses.z: 你的兩太陽在帕子內，如同一塊石榴。
verses.e: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil .

verses.z: 有六十王后八十妃嬪，並有無數的童女。
verses.e: There are sixty queens , eighty concubines , and virgins without number .

verses.z: 我的鴿子，我的完全人，只有這一個是她母親獨生的，是生養她者所寶愛的。眾女子見了就稱她有福；王后妃嬪見了也讚美她。
verses.e: My dove , my perfect one , is unique . She is her mother's only daughter . She is the favorite one of her who bore her . The daughters saw her , and called her blessed . The queens and the concubines saw her , and they praised her .

verses.z: 王女啊，你的腳在鞋中何其美好！你的大腿圓潤，好像美玉，是巧匠的手做成的。
verses.e: How beautiful are your feet in sandals , prince's daughter ! Your rounded thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a skillful workman .

verses.z: 我屬我的良人，他也戀慕我。
verses.e: I am my beloved's . His desire is toward me .

verses.z: 我的良人，來吧！你我可以往田間去；你我可以在村莊住宿。
verses.e: Come , my beloved ! Let's go out into the field . Let's lodge in the villages .

verses.z: 我們早晨起來往葡萄園去，看看葡萄發芽開花沒有，石榴放蕊沒有；我在那裏要將我的愛情給你。
verses.e: Let's go early up to the vineyards . Let's see whether the vine has budded , its blossom is open , and the pomegranates are in flower . There I will give you my love .

verses.z: 風茄放香，在我們的門內有各樣新陳佳美的果子；我的良人，這都是我為你存留的。
verses.e: The mandrakes produce fragrance . At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits , new and old , which I have stored up for you , my beloved .

verses.z: 你的肚臍[如]圓杯，不缺調和的酒；你的腰如一堆麥子，周圍有百合花。
verses.e: Your body is like a round goblet , no mixed wine is wanting . Your waist is like a heap of wheat , set about with lilies .

verses.z: 你的兩乳好像一對小鹿，就是母鹿雙生的。
verses.e: Your two breasts are like two fawns , that are twins of a roe .

verses.z: 你的頸項如象牙臺；你的眼目[像]希實本、巴特‧拉併門旁的水池；你的鼻子彷彿朝大馬士革的黎巴嫩塔。
verses.e: Your neck is like an ivory tower . Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim . Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus .

verses.z: 你的頭在你身上好像迦密山；你頭上的髮是紫黑色；王的心因這下垂的髮綹繫住了。
verses.e: Your head on you is like Carmel . The hair of your head like purple . The king is held captive in its tresses .

verses.z: 我所愛的，你何其美好！何其可悅，使人歡暢喜樂！
