verses.e: How beautiful and how pleasant you are , love , for delights !

verses.z: 你的身量好像棕樹；你的兩乳如同其上的果子，纍纍下垂。
verses.e: This , your stature , is like a palm tree , your breasts like its fruit .

verses.z: 我說：我要上這棕樹，抓住枝子。願你的兩乳好像葡萄纍纍下垂，你鼻子的氣味香如蘋果；
verses.e: I said , " I will climb up into the palm tree . I will take hold of its fruit . " Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine , the smell of your breath like apples .

verses.z: 你的口如上好的酒。〔新娘〕[女子說]：為我的良人下咽舒暢，流入睡覺人的嘴中。
verses.e: Your mouth is like the best wine , that goes down smoothly for my beloved , gliding through the lips of those who are asleep .

verses.z: 巴不得你像我的兄弟，像吃我母親奶的兄弟；我在外頭遇見你就與你親嘴，誰也不輕看我。
verses.e: Oh that you were like my brother , who nursed from the breasts of my mother ! If I found you outside , I would kiss you ; yes , and no one would despise me .

verses.z: 我是牆；我兩乳像[其上的]樓。那時，我在他眼中像得平安的人。
verses.e: I am a wall , and my breasts like towers , then I was in his eyes like one who found peace .

verses.z: 所羅門在巴力‧哈們有一葡萄園；他將這葡萄園交給看守的人，為其中的果子必交一千[舍客勒]銀子。
verses.e: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon . He leased out the vineyard to keepers . Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit .

verses.z: 我自己的葡萄園在我面前。所羅門哪，一千[舍客勒]歸你，二百[舍客勒]歸看守果子的人。
verses.e: My own vineyard is before me . The thousand are for you , Solomon , two hundred for those who tend its fruit .

verses.z: 你這住在園中的，同伴都要聽你的聲音，求你使我也得聽見。
verses.e: You who dwell in the gardens , with friends in attendance , let me hear your voice !

verses.z: 我的良人哪，求你快來！如羚羊或小鹿在香草山上。
verses.e: Come away , my beloved ! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices !

verses.z: 我必引導你，領你進我母親的家；我可以領受教訓，也就使你喝石榴汁釀的香酒。
verses.e: I would lead you , bringing you into the house of my mother , who would instruct me . I would have you drink spiced wine , of the juice of my pomegranate .

verses.z: 他的左手必在我頭下；他的右手必將我抱住。
verses.e: His left hand would be under my head . His right hand would embrace me .

verses.z: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我囑咐你們：不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的，等他自己情願。
verses.e: I adjure you , daughters of Jerusalem , that you not stir up , nor awaken love , until it so desires .

verses.z: 那靠着良人從曠野上來的是誰呢？〔新娘〕我在蘋果樹下叫醒你。你母親在那裏為你劬勞；生養你的在那裏[為你]劬勞。
verses.e: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness , leaning on her beloved ? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you . There your mother conceived you . There she was in labor and bore you .

verses.z: 求你將我放在你心上如印記，帶在你臂上如戳記。因為愛情如死之堅強，嫉恨如陰間之殘忍；所發的電光是火焰的電光，是耶和華的烈焰。
verses.e: Set me as a seal on your heart , as a seal on your arm ; for love is strong as death . Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol . Its flashes are flashes of fire , a very flame of the LORD .

verses.z: 愛情，眾水不能熄滅，大水也不能淹沒。若有人拿家中所有的財寶要換愛情，就全被藐視。
verses.e: Many waters can't quench love , neither can floods drown it . If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love , he would be utterly scorned .

verses.z: 我們有一小妹；她的兩乳尚未長成，人來提親的日子，我們當為她怎樣辦理？
verses.e: We have a little sister . She has no breasts . What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for ?

verses.z: 她若是牆，我們要在其上建造銀塔；她若是門，我們要用香柏木板圍護她。
verses.e: If she is a wall , we will build on her a turret of silver . If she is a door , we will enclose her with boards of cedar .

verses.z: 上帝的僕人，耶穌基督的使徒保羅，憑着上帝選民的信心與敬虔真理的知識，
verses.e: Paul , a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ , according to the faith of God's chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness ,

verses.z: 因為有許多人不服約束，說虛空話欺哄人；那奉割禮的更是這樣。
verses.e: For there are also many unruly men , vain talkers and deceivers , especially those of the circumcision ,

verses.z: 這些人的口總要堵住。他們因貪不義之財，將不該教導的教導人，敗壞人的全家。
verses.e: whose mouths must be stopped : men who overthrow whole houses , teaching things which they ought not , for dishonest gain's sake .

verses.z: 有克里特人中的一個本地先知說：「克里特人常說謊話，乃是惡獸，又饞又懶。」
verses.e: One of them , a prophet of their own , said , " Cretans are always liars , evil beasts , and idle gluttons . "

verses.z: 這個見證是真的。所以，你要嚴嚴地責備他們，使他們在真道上純全無疵，
verses.e: This testimony is true . For this cause , reprove them sharply , that they may be sound in the faith ,

verses.z: 不聽猶太人荒渺的言語和離棄真道之人的誡命。
verses.e: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth .

verses.z: 在潔淨的人，凡物都潔淨；在污穢不信的人，甚麼都不潔淨，連心地和天良也都污穢了。
verses.e: To the pure , all things are pure , but to those who are defiled and unbelieving , nothing is pure ; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled .

verses.z: 他們說是認識上帝，行事卻和他相背；本是可憎惡的，是悖逆的，在各樣善事上是可廢棄的。
verses.e: They profess that they know God , but by their deeds they deny him , being abominable , disobedient , and unfit for any good work .

verses.z: 盼望那無謊言的上帝在萬古之先所應許的永生，
verses.e: in hope of eternal life , which God , who can't lie , promised before time began ;

verses.z: 到了日期，藉着傳揚的工夫把他的道顯明了；這傳揚[的責任]是按着上帝－我們救主的命令交託了我。
verses.e: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior ,

verses.z: [現在]寫信給提多，就是照着我們共信之道作我真兒子的。願恩惠、平安從父上帝和我們的救主基督耶穌歸與你！
verses.e: to Titus , my true child according to a common faith : Grace , mercy , and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior .

verses.z: 我從前留你在克里特，是要你將那沒有辦完的事都辦整齊了，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城設立長老。
verses.e: I left you in Crete for this reason , that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city , as I directed you —

verses.z: 若有無可指責的人，只作一個婦人的丈夫，兒女也是信主的，沒有人告他們是放蕩不服約束的，[就可以設立]。
verses.e: if anyone is blameless , the husband of one wife , having children who believe , who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior .

verses.z: 監督既是上帝的管家，必須無可指責，不任性，不暴躁，不因酒滋事，不打人，不貪無義之財；
verses.e: For the overseer must be blameless , as God's steward , not self-pleasing , not easily angered , not given to wine , not violent , not greedy for dishonest gain ;

verses.z: 樂意接待遠人，好善，莊重，公平，聖潔自持；
verses.e: but given to hospitality , a lover of good , sober minded , fair , holy , self-controlled ,

verses.z: 堅守所教真實的道理，就能將純正的教訓勸化人，又能把爭辯的人駁倒了。
verses.e: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching , that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine , and to convict those who contradict him .

verses.z: 但你所講的總要合乎那純正的道理。
verses.e: But say the things which fit sound doctrine ,

verses.z: 不可私拿東西，要顯為忠誠，以致凡事尊榮我們救主－上帝的道。
verses.e: not stealing , but showing all good fidelity , that they may adorn the doctrine of God , our Savior , in all things .

verses.z: 因為上帝救眾人的恩典已經顯明出來，
verses.e: For the grace of God has appeared , bringing salvation to all men ,

verses.z: 教訓我們除去不敬虔的心和世俗的情慾，在今世自守、公義、敬虔度日，
verses.e: instructing us to the intent that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we would live soberly , righteously , and godly in this present age ;

verses.z: 等候所盼望的福，並等候至大的上帝和我們救主耶穌基督的榮耀顯現。
verses.e: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior , Jesus Christ ,

verses.z: 他為我們捨了自己，要贖我們脫離一切罪惡，又潔淨我們，特作自己的子民，熱心為善。
verses.e: who gave himself for us , that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession , zealous for good works .

verses.z: 這些事你要講明，勸戒人，用各等權柄責備人；不可叫人輕看你。
verses.e: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority . Let no one despise you .

verses.z: 勸老年人要有節制、端莊、自守，在信心、愛心、忍耐上都要純全無疵。
verses.e: that older men should be temperate , sensible , sober minded , sound in faith , in love , and in perseverance ,

verses.z: 又勸老年婦人，舉止行動要恭敬，不說讒言，不給酒作奴僕，用善道教訓人，
verses.e: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior , not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine , teachers of that which is good ,

verses.z: 好指教少年婦人，愛丈夫，愛兒女，
verses.e: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands , to love their children ,

verses.z: 謹守，貞潔，料理家務，待人有恩，順服自己的丈夫，免得上帝的道理被毀謗。
verses.e: to be sober minded , chaste , workers at home , kind , being in subjection to their own husbands , that God's word may not be blasphemed .

verses.z: 又勸少年人要謹守。
verses.e: Likewise , exhort the younger men to be sober minded .

verses.z: 你自己凡事要顯出善行的榜樣；在教訓上要正直、端莊，
verses.e: In all things show yourself an example of good works . In your teaching , show integrity , seriousness , incorruptibility ,

verses.z: 言語純全，無可指責，叫那反對的人，既無處可說我們的不是，便自覺羞愧。
verses.e: and soundness of speech that can't be condemned , that he who opposes you may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say about us .

verses.z: [勸]僕人要順服自己的主人，凡事討他的喜歡，不可頂撞他，
verses.e: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things , not contradicting ,

verses.z: 你要提醒眾人，叫他們順服作官的、掌權的，遵他的命，預備行各樣的善事。
verses.e: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities , to be obedient , to be ready for every good work ,

verses.z: 分門結黨的人，警戒過一兩次，就要棄絕他。
verses.e: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning ,

verses.z: 因為知道這等人已經背道，犯了罪，自己明知不是，還是去做。
verses.e: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful , being self-condemned .

verses.z: 我打發亞提馬或是推基古到你那裏去的時候，你要趕緊往尼哥坡里去見我，因為我已經定意在那裏過冬。
verses.e: When I send Artemas to you , or Tychicus , be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis , for I have determined to winter there .

verses.z: 你要趕緊給律師西納和亞波羅送行，叫他們沒有缺乏。
verses.e: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily , that nothing may be lacking for them .

verses.z: 並且我們的人要學習正經事業，預備所需用的，免得不結果子。
verses.e: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs , that they may not be unfruitful .

verses.z: 同我在一處的人都問你安。請代問那些因有信心愛我們的人安。願恩惠[常]與你們眾人同在！
verses.e: All who are with me greet you . Greet those who love us in faith . Grace be with you all . Amen .

verses.z: 不要毀謗，不要爭競，總要和平，向眾人大顯溫柔。
verses.e: to speak evil of no one , not to be contentious , to be gentle , showing all humility toward all men .

verses.z: 我們從前也是無知、悖逆、受迷惑、服事各樣私慾，和宴樂，常存惡毒嫉妒的心，是可恨的，又是彼此相恨。
verses.e: For we were also once foolish , disobedient , deceived , serving various lusts and pleasures , living in malice and envy , hateful , and hating one another .

verses.z: 但到了上帝－我們救主的恩慈和他向人所施的慈愛顯明的時候，
verses.e: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared ,

verses.z: 他便救了我們；並不是因我們自己所行的義，乃是照他的憐憫，藉着重生的洗和聖靈的更新。
verses.e: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves , but according to his mercy , he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit ,

verses.z: 聖靈就是上帝藉着耶穌基督－我們救主厚厚澆灌在我們身上的，
verses.e: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior ;

verses.z: 好叫我們因他的恩得稱為義，可以憑着永生的盼望成為後嗣。
verses.e: that being justified by his grace , we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life .

verses.z: 這話是可信的。我也願你把這些事切切實實地講明，使那些已信上帝的人留心做正經事業。這都是美事，並且與人有益。
verses.e: This saying is faithful , and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently , so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works . These things are good and profitable to men ;

verses.z: 要遠避無知的辯論和家譜[的空談]，以及紛爭，並因律法而起的爭競，因為這都是虛妄無益的。
verses.e: but shun foolish questionings , genealogies , strife , and disputes about the law ; for they are unprofitable and vain .

verses.z: 大流士[王]第二年八月，耶和華的話臨到易多的孫子、比利家的兒子先知撒迦利亞，說：
verses.e: In the eighth month , in the second year of Darius , the LORD's word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo , saying ,

verses.z: 那站在番石榴樹中間的人說：「這是奉耶和華差遣在遍地走來走去的。」
verses.e: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered , " They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth . "

verses.z: 那些騎馬的對站在番石榴樹中間耶和華的使者說：「我們已在遍地走來走去，見全地都安息平靜。」
verses.e: They reported to the LORD's angel who stood among the myrtle trees , and said , " We have walked back and forth through the earth , and behold , all the earth is at rest and in peace . "

verses.z: 於是，耶和華的使者說：「萬軍之耶和華啊，你惱恨耶路撒冷和猶大的城邑已經七十年，你不施憐憫要到幾時呢？」
verses.e: Then the LORD's angel replied , " O LORD of Armies , how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah , against which you have had indignation these seventy years ? "

verses.z: 耶和華就用美善的安慰話回答那與我說話的天使。
verses.e: The LORD answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words .

verses.z: 與我說話的天使對我說：「你要宣告說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：我為耶路撒冷為錫安，心裏極其火熱。
verses.e: So the angel who talked with me said to me , " Proclaim , saying , ' The LORD of Armies says : " I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy .

verses.z: 我甚惱怒那安逸的列國，因我從前稍微惱怒[我民]，他們就加害過分。
verses.e: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease ; for I was but a little displeased , but they added to the calamity . "

verses.z: 所以耶和華如此說：現今我回到耶路撒冷，仍施憐憫，我的殿必重建在其中，準繩必拉在耶路撒冷之上。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: Therefore the LORD says : " I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy . My house shall be built in it , " says the LORD of Armies , " and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem . " '

verses.z: 你要再宣告說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：我的城邑必再豐盛發達。耶和華必再安慰錫安，揀選耶路撒冷。」
verses.e: " Proclaim further , saying , ' The LORD of Armies says : " My cities will again overflow with prosperity , and the LORD will again comfort Zion , and will again choose Jerusalem . " ' "

verses.z: 我舉目觀看，見有四角。
verses.e: I lifted up my eyes and saw , and behold , four horns .

verses.z: 我就問與我說話的天使說：「這是甚麼意思？」他回答說：「這是打散猶大、以色列，和耶路撒冷的角。」
verses.e: I asked the angel who talked with me , " What are these ? " He answered me , " These are the horns which have scattered Judah , Israel , and Jerusalem . "

verses.z: 「耶和華曾向你們列祖大大發怒。
verses.e: " The LORD was very displeased with your fathers .

verses.z: 耶和華又指四個匠人給我看。
verses.e: The LORD showed me four craftsmen .

verses.z: 我說：「他們來做甚麼呢？」他說：「這是打散猶大的角，使人不敢抬頭；但這些匠人來威嚇列國，打掉他們的角，就是舉起打散猶大地的角。」
verses.e: Then I asked , " What are these coming to do ? " He said , " These are the horns which scattered Judah , so that no man lifted up his head ; but these have come to terrify them , to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it . "

verses.z: 所以你要對以色列人說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要轉向我，我就轉向你們。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: Therefore tell them , the LORD of Armies says : ' Return to me , ' says the LORD of Armies , ' and I will return to you , ' says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 不要效法你們列祖。從前的先知呼叫他們說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：『你們要回頭離開你們的惡道惡行。』他們卻不聽，也不順從我。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Don't you be like your fathers , to whom the former prophets proclaimed , saying : The LORD of Armies says , ' Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings ; ' but they didn't hear nor listen to me , says the LORD .

verses.z: 你們的列祖在哪裏呢？那些先知能永遠存活嗎？
verses.e: Your fathers , where are they ? And the prophets , do they live forever ?

verses.z: 只是我的言語和律例，就是所吩咐我僕人眾先知的，豈不臨到你們列祖嗎？他們就回頭，說：『萬軍之耶和華定意按我們的行動作為向我們怎樣行，他已照樣行了。』」
verses.e: But my words and my decrees , which I commanded my servants the prophets , didn't they overtake your fathers ? " Then they repented and said , ' Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us , according to our ways and according to our practices , so he has dealt with us . ' "

verses.z: 大流士第二年十一月，就是細罷特月二十四日，耶和華的話臨到易多的孫子、比利家的兒子先知撒迦利亞，說：
verses.e: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month , which is the month Shebat , in the second year of Darius , the LORD's word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo , saying ,

verses.z: 「我夜間觀看，見一人騎着紅馬，站在窪地番石榴樹中間。在他身後又有紅馬、黃馬，和白馬。」
verses.e: " I had a vision in the night , and behold , a man riding on a red horse , and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine ; and behind him there were red , brown , and white horses .

verses.z: 我對與我說話的天使說：「主啊，這是甚麼意思？」他說：「我要指示你這是甚麼意思。」
verses.e: Then I asked , ' My lord , what are these ? ' " The angel who talked with me said to me , " I will show you what these are . "

verses.z: 當春雨的時候，你們要向發閃電的耶和華求雨。他必為眾人降下甘霖，使田園生長菜蔬。
verses.e: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time , the LORD who makes storm clouds , and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field .

verses.z: 我必再領他們出埃及地，招聚他們出亞述，領他們到基列和黎巴嫩；這地尚且不夠他們居住。
verses.e: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt , and gather them out of Assyria . I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon ; and there won't be room enough for them .

verses.z: 耶和華必經過苦海，擊打海浪，使尼羅河的深處都枯乾。亞述的驕傲必致卑微；埃及的權柄必然滅沒。
verses.e: He will pass through the sea of affliction , and will strike the waves in the sea , and all the depths of the Nile will dry up ; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down , and the scepter of Egypt will depart .

verses.z: 我必使他們倚靠我，得以堅固；一舉一動必奉我的名。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will strengthen them in the LORD . They will walk up and down in his name , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 因為，家神所言的是虛空；卜士所見的是虛假；做夢者所說的是假夢。他們白白地安慰人，所以眾人如羊流離，因無牧人就受苦。
verses.e: For the teraphim have spoken vanity , and the diviners have seen a lie ; and they have told false dreams . They comfort in vain . Therefore they go their way like sheep . They are oppressed , because there is no shepherd .

verses.z: 我的怒氣向牧人發作；我必懲罰公山羊；因我－萬軍之耶和華眷顧自己的羊群，就是[猶大]家，必使他們如駿馬在陣上。
verses.e: My anger is kindled against the shepherds , and I will punish the male goats , for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock , the house of Judah , and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle .

verses.z: 房角石、釘子、爭戰的弓，和一切掌權的都從他而出。
verses.e: From him will come the cornerstone , from him the tent peg , from him the battle bow , from him every ruler together .

verses.z: 他們必如勇士在陣上將[仇敵]踐踏在街上的泥土中。他們必爭戰，因為耶和華與他們同在；騎馬的也必羞愧。
verses.e: They will be as mighty men , treading down muddy streets in the battle . They will fight , because the LORD is with them . The riders on horses will be confounded .

verses.z: 我要堅固猶大家，拯救約瑟家，要領他們歸回。我要憐恤他們；他們必像未曾棄絕的一樣，都因我是耶和華－他們的上帝，我必應允他們[的禱告]。
verses.e: " I will strengthen the house of Judah , and I will save the house of Joseph . I will bring them back , for I have mercy on them . They will be as though I had not cast them off , for I am the LORD their God , and I will hear them .

verses.z: 以法蓮人必如勇士；他們心中暢快如同喝酒；他們的兒女必看見而快活；他們的心必因耶和華喜樂。
verses.e: Ephraim will be like a mighty man , and their heart will rejoice as through wine . Yes , their children will see it and rejoice . Their heart will be glad in the LORD .

verses.z: 我要發嘶聲，聚集他們，因我已經救贖他們。他們的人數必加增，如從前加增一樣。
verses.e: I will signal for them and gather them , for I have redeemed them . They will increase as they were before .

verses.z: 我雖然播散他們在列國中，他們必在遠方記念我。他們與兒女都必存活，且得歸回。
verses.e: I will sow them among the peoples . They will remember me in far countries . They will live with their children and will return .

verses.z: 黎巴嫩哪，開開你的門，任火燒滅你的香柏樹。
verses.e: Open your doors , Lebanon , that the fire may devour your cedars .

verses.z: 我折斷那稱為「榮美」的杖，表明我廢棄與萬民所立的約。
verses.e: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart , that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples .

verses.z: 當日就廢棄了。這樣，那些仰望我的困苦羊就知道所說的是耶和華的話。
verses.e: It was broken in that day ; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was the LORD's word .

verses.z: 我對他們說：「你們若以為美，就給我工價。不然，就罷了！」於是他們給了三十塊錢作為我的工價。
verses.e: I said to them , " If you think it best , give me my wages ; and if not , keep them . " So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver .

verses.z: 耶和華吩咐我說：「要把眾人所估定美好的價值丟給窯戶。」我便將這三十塊錢，在耶和華的殿中丟給窯戶了。
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Throw it to the potter — the handsome price that I was valued at by them ! " I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the LORD's house .

verses.z: 我又折斷稱為「聯索」的那根杖，表明我廢棄猶大與以色列弟兄的情誼。
verses.e: Then I cut apart my other staff , Union , that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel .

verses.z: 耶和華又吩咐我說：「你再取愚昧牧人所用的器具，
verses.e: The LORD said to me , " Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd .

verses.z: 因我要在這地興起一個牧人。他不看顧喪亡的，不尋找分散的，不醫治受傷的，也不牧養強壯的；卻要吃肥[羊]的肉，撕裂牠的蹄子。
verses.e: For , behold , I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off , neither will seek those who are scattered , nor heal that which is broken , nor feed that which is sound ; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep , and will tear their hoofs in pieces .

verses.z: 無用的牧人丟棄羊群有禍了！刀必臨到他的膀臂和右眼上。他的膀臂必全然枯乾；他的右眼也必昏暗失明。」
verses.e: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock ! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye . His arm will be completely withered , and his right eye will be totally blinded ! "

verses.z: 松樹啊，應當哀號；因為香柏樹傾倒，佳美的樹毀壞。巴珊的橡樹啊，應當哀號，因為茂盛的樹林已經倒了。
verses.e: Wail , cypress tree , for the cedar has fallen , because the stately ones are destroyed . Wail , you oaks of Bashan , for the strong forest has come down .

verses.z: 聽啊，有牧人哀號的聲音，因他們榮華[的草場]毀壞了。有少壯獅子咆哮的聲音，因約旦河旁的叢林荒廢了。
verses.e: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds ! For their glory is destroyed — a voice of the roaring of young lions ! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined .

verses.z: 耶和華－我的上帝如此說：「你－撒迦利亞要牧養這將宰的群羊。
verses.e: The LORD my God says : " Feed the flock of slaughter .

verses.z: 買他們的宰了他們，以自己為無罪；賣他們的說：『耶和華是應當稱頌的，因我成為富足。』牧養他們的並不憐恤他們。
verses.e: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished . Those who sell them say , ' Blessed be the LORD , for I am rich ; ' and their own shepherds don't pity them .

verses.z: 耶和華說：『我不再憐恤這地的居民，必將這民交給各人的鄰舍和他們王的手中。他們必毀滅這地，我也不救這民脫離他們的手。』」
verses.e: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land , " says the LORD ; " but , behold , I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor's hand and into the hand of his king . They will strike the land , and out of their hand I will not deliver them . "

verses.z: 於是，我牧養這將宰的群羊，就是群中最困苦的羊。我拿着兩根杖，一根我稱為「榮美」，一根我稱為「聯索」。這樣，我牧養了群羊。
verses.e: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered , especially the oppressed of the flock . I took for myself two staffs . The one I called " Favor " and the other I called " Union " , and I fed the flock .

verses.z: 一月之內，我除滅三個牧人，因為我的心厭煩他們；他們的心也憎嫌我。
verses.e: I cut off the three shepherds in one month ; for my soul was weary of them , and their soul also loathed me .

verses.z: 我就說：「我不牧養你們。要死的，由他死；要喪亡的，由他喪亡；餘剩的，由他們彼此相食。」
verses.e: Then I said , " I will not feed you . That which dies , let it die ; and that which is to be cut off , let it be cut off ; and let those who are left eat each other's flesh . "

verses.z: 耶和華論以色列的默示。鋪張諸天、建立地基、造人裏面之靈的耶和華說：
verses.e: A revelation of the LORD's word concerning Israel : The LORD , who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth , and forms the spirit of man within him says :

verses.z: 「我必將那施恩叫人懇求的靈，澆灌大衛家和耶路撒冷的居民。他們必仰望我，就是他們所扎的；必為我悲哀，如喪獨生子，又為我愁苦，如喪長子。
verses.e: I will pour on David's house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication . They will look to me whom they have pierced ; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son , and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn .

verses.z: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈達臨門的悲哀。
verses.e: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem , like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo .

verses.z: 境內一家一家地都必悲哀。大衛家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。拿單家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
verses.e: The land will mourn , every family apart ; the family of David's house apart , and their wives apart ; the family of the house of Nathan apart , and their wives apart ;

verses.z: 利未家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。示每家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
verses.e: the family of the house of Levi apart , and their wives apart ; the family of the Shimeites apart , and their wives apart ;

verses.z: 其餘的各家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
verses.e: all the families who remain , every family apart , and their wives apart .

verses.z: 「我必使耶路撒冷被圍困的時候，向四圍列國的民成為令人昏醉的杯；這默示也論到猶大。
verses.e: " Behold , I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples , and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem .

verses.z: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻擊他的萬民當作一塊重石頭；凡舉起的必受重傷。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples . All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded , and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it .

verses.z: 耶和華說：到那日，我必使一切馬匹驚惶，使騎馬的顛狂。我必看顧猶大家，使列國的一切馬匹瞎眼。
verses.e: In that day , " says the LORD , " I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness . I will open my eyes on the house of Judah , and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness .

verses.z: 猶大的族長必心裏說：『耶路撒冷的居民倚靠萬軍之耶和華－他們的上帝，就作我們的能力。』
verses.e: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart , ' The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the LORD of Armies their God . '

verses.z: 「那日，我必使猶大的族長如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆裏；他們必左右燒滅四圍列國的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本處，就是耶路撒冷。
verses.e: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood , and like a flaming torch among sheaves . They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left ; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place , even in Jerusalem .

verses.z: 「耶和華必先拯救猶大的帳棚，免得大衛家的榮耀和耶路撒冷居民的榮耀勝過猶大。
verses.e: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first , that the glory of David's house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah .

verses.z: 那日，耶和華必保護耶路撒冷的居民。他們中間軟弱的必如大衛；大衛的家必如上帝，如行在他們前面之耶和華的使者。
verses.e: In that day the LORD will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem . He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David , and David's house will be like God , like the LORD's angel before them .

verses.z: 那日，我必定意滅絕來攻擊耶路撒冷各國的民。
verses.e: It will happen in that day , that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem .

verses.z: 「那日，必給大衛家和耶路撒冷的居民開一個泉源，洗除罪惡與污穢。」
verses.e: " In that day there will be a fountain opened to David's house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , for sin and for uncleanness .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「那日，我必從地上除滅偶像的名，不再被人記念；也必使這地不再有[假]先知與污穢的靈。
verses.e: It will come to pass in that day , says the LORD of Armies , that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land , and they will be remembered no more . I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land .

verses.z: 若再有人說預言，生他的父母必對他說：『你不得存活，因為你託耶和華的名說假預言。』生他的父母在他說預言的時候，要將他刺透。
verses.e: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies , then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him , ' You must die , because you speak lies in the LORD's name ; ' and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies .

verses.z: 那日，凡作先知說預言的必因他所論的異象羞愧，不再穿毛衣哄騙人。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies ; they won't wear a hairy mantle to deceive ,

verses.z: 他必說：『我不是先知，我是耕地的；我從幼年作人的奴僕。』
verses.e: but he will say , ' I am no prophet , I am a tiller of the ground ; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth . '

verses.z: 必有人問他說：『你兩臂中間是甚麼傷呢？』他必回答說：『這是我在親友家中所受的傷。』」
verses.e: One will say to him , ' What are these wounds between your arms ? ' Then he will answer , ' Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends . '

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：刀劍哪，應當興起，攻擊我的牧人和我的同伴。擊打牧人，羊就分散；我必反手加在微小者的身上。
verses.e: " Awake , sword , against my shepherd , and against the man who is close to me , " says the LORD of Armies . " Strike the shepherd , and the sheep will be scattered ; and I will turn my hand against the little ones .

verses.z: 耶和華說：這全地的人，三分之二必剪除而死，三分之一仍必存留。
verses.e: It shall happen that in all the land , " says the LORD , " two parts in it will be cut off and die ; but the third will be left in it .

verses.z: 我要使這三分之一經火，熬煉他們，如熬煉銀子；試煉他們，如試煉金子。他們必求告我的名，我必應允他們。我要說：這是我的子民。他們也要說：耶和華是我[們]的上帝。
verses.e: I will bring the third part into the fire , and will refine them as silver is refined , and will test them like gold is tested . They will call on my name , and I will hear them . I will say , ' It is my people ; ' and they will say , ' The LORD is my God . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的日子臨近，你的財物必被搶掠，在你中間分散。
verses.e: Behold , a day of the LORD comes , when your plunder will be divided within you .

verses.z: 全地，從迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的臨門，要變為亞拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是從便雅憫門到第一門之處，又到角門，並從哈楠業樓，直到王的酒醡。
verses.e: All the land will be made like the Arabah , from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem ; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place , from Benjamin's gate to the place of the first gate , to the corner gate , and from the tower of Hananel to the king's wine presses .

verses.z: 人必住在其中，不再有咒詛。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。
verses.e: Men will dwell therein , and there will be no more curse ; but Jerusalem will dwell safely .

verses.z: 耶和華用災殃攻擊那與耶路撒冷爭戰的列國人，必是這樣：他們兩腳站立的時候，肉必消沒，眼在眶中乾癟，舌在口中潰爛。
verses.e: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem : their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet , and their eyes will consume away in their sockets , and their tongue will consume away in their mouth .

verses.z: 那日，耶和華必使他們大大擾亂。他們各人彼此揪住，舉手攻擊。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them ; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor , and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor .

verses.z: 猶大也必在耶路撒冷爭戰。那時四圍各國的財物，就是許多金銀衣服，必被收聚。
verses.e: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem ; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together : gold , silver , and clothing , in great abundance .

verses.z: 那臨到馬匹、騾子、駱駝、驢，和營中一切牲畜的災殃是與那災殃一般。
verses.e: A plague like this will fall on the horse , on the mule , on the camel , on the donkey , and on all the animals that will be in those camps .

verses.z: 所有來攻擊耶路撒冷列國中剩下的人，必年年上來敬拜[大]君王－萬軍之耶和華，並守住棚節。
verses.e: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King , the LORD of Armies , and to keep the feast of booths .

verses.z: 地上[萬]族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜[大]君王－萬軍之耶和華的，必無雨降在他們的地上。
verses.e: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn't go up to Jerusalem to worship the King , the LORD of Armies , on them there will be no rain .

verses.z: 埃及族若不上來，[雨]也不降在他們的地上；凡不上來守住棚節的列國人，耶和華也必用這災攻擊他們。
verses.e: If the family of Egypt doesn't go up and doesn't come , neither will it rain on them . This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike the nations that don't go up to keep the feast of booths .

verses.z: 這就是埃及的刑罰和那不上來守住棚節之列國的刑罰。
verses.e: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don't go up to keep the feast of booths .

verses.z: 因為我必聚集萬國與耶路撒冷爭戰，城必被攻取，房屋被搶奪，婦女被玷污，城中的民一半被擄去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。
verses.e: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle ; and the city will be taken , the houses rifled , and the women ravished . Half of the city will go out into captivity , and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city .

verses.z: 當那日，馬的鈴鐺上必有「歸耶和華為聖」的這句話。耶和華殿內的鍋必如祭壇前的碗一樣。
verses.e: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses , " HOLY TO THE LORD " ; and the pots in the LORD's house will be like the bowls before the altar .

verses.z: 凡耶路撒冷和猶大的鍋都必歸萬軍之耶和華為聖。凡獻祭的都必來取這鍋，煮[肉]在其中。當那日，在萬軍之耶和華的殿中必不再有迦南人。
verses.e: Yes , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies ; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them , and cook in them . In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 那時，耶和華必出去與那些國爭戰，好像從前爭戰一樣。
verses.e: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations , as when he fought in the day of battle .

verses.z: 那日，他的腳必站在耶路撒冷前面朝東的橄欖山上。這山必從中間分裂，自東至西成為極大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。
verses.e: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east ; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west , making a very great valley . Half of the mountain will move toward the north , and half of it toward the south .

verses.z: 你們要從我山的谷中逃跑，因為山谷必延到亞薩。你們逃跑，必如猶大王烏西雅年間的人逃避大地震一樣。耶和華－我的上帝必降臨，有一切聖者同來。
verses.e: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains , for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel . Yes , you shall flee , just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah . The LORD my God will come , and all the holy ones with you .

verses.z: 那日，必沒有光，三光必退縮。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that there will not be light , cold , or frost .

verses.z: 那日，必是耶和華所知道的，不是白晝，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。
verses.e: It will be a unique day which is known to the LORD — not day , and not night ; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light .

verses.z: 那日，必有活水從耶路撒冷出來，一半往東海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。
verses.e: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem , half of them toward the eastern sea , and half of them toward the western sea . It will be so in summer and in winter .

verses.z: 耶和華必作全地的王。那日耶和華必為獨一無二的，他的名也是獨一無二的。
verses.e: The LORD will be King over all the earth . In that day the LORD will be one , and his name one .

verses.z: 我又舉目觀看，見一人手拿準繩。
verses.e: I lifted up my eyes , and saw , and behold , a man with a measuring line in his hand .

verses.z: 錫安城啊，應當歡樂歌唱，因為我來要住在你中間。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: Sing and rejoice , daughter of Zion ! For behold , I come and I will dwell within you , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 那時，必有許多國歸附耶和華，作他的子民。他要住在你中間，你就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你那裏去了。
verses.e: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day , and shall be my people ; and I will dwell among you , and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you .

verses.z: 耶和華必收回猶大作他聖地的分，也必再揀選耶路撒冷。
verses.e: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land , and will again choose Jerusalem .

verses.z: 凡有血氣的都當在耶和華面前靜默無聲；因為他興起，從聖所出來了。
verses.e: Be silent , all flesh , before the LORD ; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation ! "

verses.z: 我說：「你往哪裏去？」他對我說：「要去量耶路撒冷，看有多寬多長。」
verses.e: Then I asked , " Where are you going ? " He said to me , " To measure Jerusalem , to see what is its width and what is its length . "

verses.z: 與我說話的天使去的時候，又有一位天使迎着他來，
verses.e: Behold , the angel who talked with me went out , and another angel went out to meet him ,

verses.z: 對他說：「你跑去告訴那少年人說，耶路撒冷必有人居住，好像無城牆的鄉村，因為人民和牲畜甚多。
verses.e: and said to him , " Run , speak to this young man , saying , ' Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls , because of the multitude of men and livestock in it .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我要作耶路撒冷四圍的火城，並要作其中的榮耀。」
verses.e: For I , ' says the LORD , ' will be to her a wall of fire around it , and I will be the glory in the middle of her .

verses.z: 耶和華說：「我從前分散你們在天的四方，現在你們要從北方之地逃回。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: Come ! Come ! Flee from the land of the north , ' says the LORD ; ' for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky , ' says the LORD .

verses.z: 與巴比倫人同住的錫安民哪，應當逃脫。
verses.e: ' Come , Zion ! Escape , you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon . '

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說，在顯出榮耀之後，差遣我去[懲罰]那擄掠你們的列國，摸你們的就是摸他眼中的瞳人。
verses.e: For the LORD of Armies says : ' For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you ; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye .

verses.z: 看哪，我要向他們掄手，他們就必作服事他們之人的擄物，你們便知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我了。
verses.e: For , behold , I will shake my hand over them , and they will be a plunder to those who served them ; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me .

verses.z: 天使又指給我看：大祭司約書亞站在耶和華的使者面前；撒但也站在約書亞的右邊，與他作對。
verses.e: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD's angel , and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary .

verses.z: 當那日，你們各人要請鄰舍坐在葡萄樹和無花果樹下。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
verses.e: In that day , ' says the LORD of Armies , ' you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華向撒但說：「撒但哪，耶和華責備你！就是揀選耶路撒冷的耶和華責備你！這不是從火中抽出來的一根柴嗎？」
verses.e: The LORD said to Satan , " The LORD rebuke you , Satan ! Yes , the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you ! Isn't this a burning stick plucked out of the fire ? "

verses.z: 約書亞穿着污穢的衣服站在使者面前。
verses.e: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments , and was standing before the angel .

verses.z: 使者吩咐站在面前的說：「你們要脫去他污穢的衣服」；又對約書亞說：「我使你脫離罪孽，要給你穿上華美的衣服。」
verses.e: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him , saying , " Take the filthy garments off him . " To him he said , " Behold , I have caused your iniquity to pass from you , and I will clothe you with rich clothing . "

verses.z: 我說：「要將潔淨的冠冕戴在他頭上。」他們就把潔淨的冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上[華美的]衣服，耶和華的使者在旁邊站立。
verses.e: I said , " Let them set a clean turban on his head . " So they set a clean turban on his head , and clothed him ; and the LORD's angel was standing by .

verses.z: 耶和華的使者告誡約書亞說：
verses.e: The LORD's angel solemnly assured Joshua , saying ,

verses.z: 「萬軍之耶和華如此說：你若遵行我的道，謹守我的命令，你就可以管理我的家，看守我的院宇；我也要使你在這些站立的人中間來往。
verses.e: " The LORD of Armies says : ' If you will walk in my ways , and if you will follow my instructions , then you also shall judge my house , and shall also keep my courts , and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by .

verses.z: 大祭司約書亞啊，你和坐在你面前的同伴都當聽。（他們是作預兆的。）我必使我僕人[大衛]的苗裔發出。
verses.e: Hear now , Joshua the high priest , you and your fellows who sit before you , for they are men who are a sign ; for , behold , I will bring out my servant , the Branch .

verses.z: 看哪，我在約書亞面前所立的石頭，在一塊石頭上有七眼。萬軍之耶和華說：我要親自雕刻這石頭，並要在一日之間除掉這地的罪孽。
verses.e: For , behold , the stone that I have set before Joshua : on one stone are seven eyes ; behold , I will engrave its inscription , ' says the LORD of Armies , ' and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day .

verses.z: 那與我說話的天使又來叫醒我，好像人睡覺被喚醒一樣。
verses.e: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me , as a man who is wakened out of his sleep .

verses.z: 誰藐視這日的事為小呢？這七[眼]乃是耶和華的眼睛，遍察全地，見所羅巴伯手拿線鉈就歡喜。」
verses.e: Indeed , who despises the day of small things ? For these seven shall rejoice , and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel . These are the LORD's eyes , which run back and forth through the whole earth . "

verses.z: 我又問天使說：「這燈臺左右的兩棵橄欖樹是甚麼意思？」
verses.e: Then I asked him , " What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it ? "

verses.z: 我二次問他說：「這兩根橄欖枝在兩個流出金色[油]的金嘴旁邊是甚麼意思？」
verses.e: I asked him the second time , " What are these two olive branches , which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves ? "

verses.z: 他對我說：「你不知道這是甚麼意思嗎？」我說：「主啊，我不知道。」
verses.e: He answered me , " Don't you know what these are ? " I said , " No , my lord . "

verses.z: 他說：「這是兩個受膏者站在普天下主的旁邊。」
verses.e: Then he said , " These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth . "

verses.z: 他問我說：「你看見了甚麼？」我說：「我看見了一個純金的燈臺，頂上有燈盞，燈臺上有七盞燈，每盞有七個管子。
verses.e: He said to me , " What do you see ? " I said , " I have seen , and behold , a lamp stand all of gold , with its bowl on the top of it , and its seven lamps on it ; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it ;

verses.z: 旁邊有兩棵橄欖樹，一棵在燈盞的右邊，一棵在燈盞的左邊。」
verses.e: and two olive trees by it , one on the right side of the bowl , and the other on the left side of it . "

verses.z: 我問與我說話的天使說：「主啊，這是甚麼意思？」
verses.e: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me , saying , " What are these , my lord ? "

verses.z: 與我說話的天使回答我說：「你不知道這是甚麼意思嗎？」我說：「主啊，我不知道。」
verses.e: Then the angel who talked with me answered me , " Don't you know what these are ? " I said , " No , my lord . "

verses.z: 他對我說：「這是耶和華指示所羅巴伯的。萬軍之耶和華說：不是倚靠勢力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的靈[方能成事]。
verses.e: Then he answered and spoke to me , saying , " This is the LORD's word to Zerubbabel , saying , ' Not by might , nor by power , but by my Spirit , ' says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 大山哪，你算甚麼呢？在所羅巴伯面前，你必成為平地。他必搬出一塊石頭，安在[殿]頂上。人且大聲歡呼說：『願恩惠恩惠歸與這殿！』」
verses.e: Who are you , great mountain ? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain ; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ' Grace , grace , to it ! ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
verses.e: Moreover the LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「所羅巴伯的手立了這殿的根基，他的手也必完成這工，你就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你們這裏來了。
verses.e: " The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house . His hands shall also finish it ; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you .

verses.z: 我又舉目觀看，見有一飛行的書卷。
verses.e: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw , and behold , a flying scroll .

verses.z: 我問與我說話的天使說：「她們要將量器抬到哪裏去呢？」
verses.e: Then I said to the angel who talked with me , " Where are these carrying the ephah basket ? "

verses.z: 他對我說：「要往示拿地去，為它蓋造房屋；等房屋齊備，就把它安置在自己的地方。」
verses.e: He said to me , " To build her a house in the land of Shinar . When it is prepared , she will be set there in her own place . "

verses.z: 他問我說：「你看見甚麼？」我回答說：「我看見一飛行的書卷，長二十肘，寬十肘。」
verses.e: He said to me , " What do you see ? " I answered , " I see a flying scroll ; its length is twenty cubits , and its width ten cubits . "

verses.z: 他對我說：「這是發出行在遍地上的咒詛。凡偷竊的必按卷上這面的話除滅；凡起[假]誓的必按卷上那面的話除滅。
verses.e: Then he said to me , " This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land , for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side ; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必使這書卷出去，進入偷竊人的家和指我名起假誓人的家，必常在他家裏，連房屋帶木石都毀滅了。」
verses.e: I will cause it to go out , " says the LORD of Armies , " and it will enter into the house of the thief , and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name ; and it will remain in the middle of his house , and will destroy it with its timber and its stones . "

verses.z: 與我說話的天使出來，對我說：「你要舉目觀看，見所出來的是甚麼？」
verses.e: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me , " Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing . "

verses.z: 我說：「這是甚麼呢？」他說：「這出來的是量器。」他又說：「這是惡人在遍地的形狀。」
verses.e: I said , " What is it ? " He said , " This is the ephah basket that is appearing . " He said moreover , " This is their appearance in all the land —

verses.z: （我見有一片圓鉛被舉起來。）這坐在量器中的是個婦人。
verses.e: and behold , a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up — and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket . "

verses.z: 天使說：「這是罪惡。」他就把婦人扔在量器中，將那片圓鉛扔在量器的口上。
verses.e: He said , " This is Wickedness ; " and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket ; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth .

verses.z: 我又舉目觀看，見有兩個婦人出來，在她們翅膀中有風，[飛得甚快]，翅膀如同鸛鳥的翅膀。她們將量器抬起來，懸在天地中間。
verses.e: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw , and behold , there were two women ; and the wind was in their wings . Now they had wings like the wings of a stork , and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky .

verses.z: 我又舉目觀看，見有四輛車從兩山中間出來；那山是銅山。
verses.e: Again I lifted up my eyes , and saw , and behold , four chariots came out from between two mountains ; and the mountains were mountains of bronze .

verses.z: 「你要從被擄之人中取黑玳、多比雅、耶大雅的[金銀]。這三人是從巴比倫來到西番雅的兒子約西亞的家裏。當日你要進他的家，
verses.e: " Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah ; and come the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah , where they have come from Babylon .

verses.z: 取這金銀做冠冕，戴在約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞的頭上，
verses.e: Yes , take silver and gold , and make crowns , and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest ;

verses.z: 對他說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：看哪，那名稱為大衛苗裔的，他要在本處長起來，並要建造耶和華的殿。
verses.e: and speak to him , saying , ' The LORD of Armies says , " Behold , the man whose name is the Branch ! He will grow up out of his place ; and he will build the LORD's temple .

verses.z: 他要建造耶和華的殿，並擔負尊榮，坐在位上掌王權；又必在位上作祭司，使兩職之間籌定和平。
verses.e: He will build the LORD's temple . He will bear the glory , and will sit and rule on his throne . He will be a priest on his throne . The counsel of peace will be between them both .

verses.z: 這冠冕要歸希連、多比雅、耶大雅，和西番雅的兒子賢，放在耶和華的殿裏為記念。」
verses.e: The crowns shall be to Helem , to Tobijah , to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the LORD's temple .

verses.z: 遠方的人也要來建造耶和華的殿，你們就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你們這裏來。你們若留意聽從耶和華－你們上帝的話，[這事]必然成就。
verses.e: Those who are far off shall come and build in the LORD's temple ; and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you . This will happen , if you will diligently obey the LORD your God's voice . " ' "

verses.z: 第一輛車套着紅馬，第二輛車套着黑馬。
verses.e: In the first chariot were red horses . In the second chariot were black horses .

verses.z: 第三輛車套着白馬，第四輛車套着有斑點的壯馬。
verses.e: In the third chariot were white horses . In the fourth chariot were dappled horses , all of them powerful .

verses.z: 我就問與我說話的天使說：「主啊，這是甚麼意思？」
verses.e: Then I asked the angel who talked with me , " What are these , my lord ? "

verses.z: 天使回答我說：「這是天的四風，是從普天下的主面前出來的。」
verses.e: The angel answered me , " These are the four winds of the sky , which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth .

verses.z: 套着黑馬的[車]往北方去，白馬跟隨在後；有斑點的馬往南方去。
verses.e: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country ; and the white went out after them ; and the dappled went out toward the south country . "

verses.z: 壯馬出來，要在遍地走來走去。天使說：「你們只管在遍地走來走去。」牠們就照樣行了。
verses.e: The strong went out , and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth . He said , " Go around and through the earth ! " So they walked back and forth through the earth .

verses.z: 他又呼叫我說：「看哪，往北方去的已在北方安慰我的心。」
verses.e: Then he called to me , and spoke to me , saying , " Behold , those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country . "

verses.z: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 大流士王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和華的話臨到撒迦利亞。
verses.e: In the fourth year of King Darius , the LORD's word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , the month of Chislev .

verses.z: 不可欺壓寡婦、孤兒、寄居的，和貧窮人。誰都不可心裏謀害弟兄。』」
verses.e: Don't oppress the widow , the fatherless , the foreigner , nor the poor ; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart . '

verses.z: 他們卻不肯聽從，扭轉肩頭，塞耳不聽，
verses.e: But they refused to listen , and turned their backs , and stopped their ears , that they might not hear .

verses.z: 使心硬如金鋼石，不聽律法和萬軍之耶和華用靈藉從前的先知所說的話。故此，萬軍之耶和華大發烈怒。
verses.e: Yes , they made their hearts as hard as flint , lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets . Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我曾呼喚他們，他們不聽；將來他們呼求我，我也不聽！
verses.e: It has come to pass that , as he called and they refused to listen , so they will call and I will not listen , " said the LORD of Armies ;

verses.z: 我必以旋風吹散他們到素不認識的萬國中。這樣，他們的地就荒涼，甚至無人來往經過，因為他們使美好之地荒涼了。」
verses.e: " but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known . Thus the land was desolate after them , so that no man passed through nor returned ; for they made the pleasant land desolate . "

verses.z: 那時伯特利人已經打發沙利色和利堅米勒，並跟從他們的人，去懇求耶和華的恩，
verses.e: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD's favor ,

verses.z: 並問萬軍之耶和華殿中的祭司和先知說：「我歷年以來，在五月間哭泣齋戒，現在還當這樣行嗎？」
verses.e: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets , saying , " Should I weep in the fifth month , separating myself , as I have done these so many years ? "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華的話就臨到我說：
verses.e: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me , saying ,

verses.z: 「你要宣告國內的眾民和祭司，說：『你們這七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，豈是絲毫向我禁食嗎？
verses.e: " Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests , saying , ' When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years , did you at all fast to me , really to me ?

verses.z: 你們吃喝，不是為自己吃，為自己喝嗎？
verses.e: When you eat and when you drink , don't you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves ?

verses.z: 當耶路撒冷和四圍的城邑有居民，正興盛，南地高原有人居住的時候，耶和華藉從前的先知所宣告的話，你們不[當聽]嗎？』」
verses.e: Aren't these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity , and its cities around her , and the South and the lowland were inhabited ? ' "

verses.z: 耶和華的話又臨到撒迦利亞說：
verses.e: The LORD's word came to Zechariah , saying ,

verses.z: 「萬軍之耶和華曾對[你們的列祖]如此說：『要按至理判斷，各人以慈愛憐憫弟兄。
verses.e: " Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken , saying , ' Execute true judgment , and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me .

verses.z: 那日以先，人得不着雇價，牲畜也是如此；且因敵人的緣故，出入之人不得平安，乃因我使眾人互相攻擊。
verses.e: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal , neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in , because of the adversary . For I set all men everyone against his neighbor .

verses.z: 但如今，我待這餘剩的民必不像從前。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days , " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 因為他們必平安撒種，葡萄樹必結果子，地土必有出產，天也必降甘露。我要使這餘剩的民享受這一切的福。
verses.e: " For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit , and the ground will give its increase , and the heavens will give their dew . I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things .

verses.z: 猶大家和以色列家啊，你們從前在列國中怎樣成為可咒詛的；照樣，我要拯救你們，使人稱你們為有福的。你們不要懼怕，手要強壯。」
verses.e: It shall come to pass that , as you were a curse among the nations , house of Judah and house of Israel , so I will save you , and you shall be a blessing . Don't be afraid . Let your hands be strong . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「你們列祖惹我發怒的時候，我怎樣定意降禍，並不後悔。
verses.e: For the LORD of Armies says : " As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath , " says the LORD of Armies , " and I didn't repent ,

verses.z: 現在我照樣定意施恩與耶路撒冷和猶大家，你們不要懼怕。
verses.e: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah . Don't be afraid .

verses.z: 你們所當行的是這樣：各人與鄰舍說話誠實，在城門口按至理判斷，使人和睦。
verses.e: These are the things that you shall do : speak every man the truth with his neighbor . Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates ,

verses.z: 誰都不可心裏謀害鄰舍，也不可喜愛起假誓，因為這些事都為我所恨惡。這是耶和華說的。」
verses.e: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor , and love no false oath ; for all these are things that I hate , " says the LORD .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華的話臨到我說：
verses.e: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me .

verses.z: 「萬軍之耶和華如此說：四月、五月禁食的日子，七月、十月禁食的日子，必變為猶大家歡喜快樂的日子和歡樂的節期；所以你們要喜愛誠實與和平。」
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " The fasts of the fourth , fifth , seventh , and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy , gladness , and cheerful feasts . Therefore love truth and peace . "

verses.z: 「萬軍之耶和華如此說：我為錫安心裏極其火熱，我為她火熱，向[她的仇敵]發烈怒。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy , and I am jealous for her with great wrath . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「將來必有列國的人和多城的居民來到。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come .

verses.z: 這城的居民必到那城，說：『我們要快去懇求耶和華的恩，尋求萬軍之耶和華；我也要去。』
verses.e: The inhabitants of one will go to another , saying , ' Let's go speedily to entreat the favor of the LORD , and to seek the LORD of Armies . I will go also . '

verses.z: 必有列邦的人和強國的民來到耶路撒冷尋求萬軍之耶和華，懇求耶和華的恩。
verses.e: Yes , many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of the LORD . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：在那些日子，必有十個人從列國諸族中出來，拉住一個猶大人的衣襟，說：『我們要與你們同去，因為我們聽見上帝與你們同在了。』」
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " In those days , ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew , saying , ' We will go with you , for we have heard that God is with you . ' "

verses.z: 耶和華如此說：我現在回到錫安，要住在耶路撒冷中。耶路撒冷必稱為誠實的城，萬軍之耶和華的山必稱為聖山。
verses.e: The LORD says : " I have returned to Zion , and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem . Jerusalem shall be called ' The City of Truth ; ' and the mountain of the LORD of Armies , ' The Holy Mountain . ' "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：將來必有年老的男女坐在耶路撒冷街上，因為年紀老邁就手拿柺杖。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem , every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age .

verses.z: 城中街上必滿有男孩女孩玩耍。
verses.e: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：到那日，這事在餘剩的民眼中看為希奇，在我眼中也看為希奇嗎？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days , should it also be marvelous in my eyes ? " says the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：我要從東方從西方救回我的民。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " Behold , I will save my people from the east country and from the west country .

verses.z: 我要領他們來，使他們住在耶路撒冷中。他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的上帝，都憑誠實和公義。」
verses.e: I will bring them , and they will dwell within Jerusalem . They will be my people , and I will be their God , in truth and in righteousness . "

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「當建造萬軍之耶和華的殿，立根基之日的先知所說的話，現在你們聽見，應當手裏強壯。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies says : " Let your hands be strong , you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of Armies was laid , even the temple , that it might be built .

verses.z: 耶和華的默示應驗在哈得拉地大馬士革－世人和以色列各支派的眼目都仰望耶和華－
verses.e: A revelation . The LORD's word is against the land of Hadrach , and will rest upon Damascus — for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD —

verses.z: 我必除滅以法蓮的戰車和耶路撒冷的戰馬；爭戰的弓也必除滅。他必向列國講和平；他的權柄必從這海管到那海，從大河管到地極。
verses.e: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem . The battle bow will be cut off ; and he will speak peace to the nations . His dominion will be from sea to sea , and from the River to the ends of the earth .

verses.z: 錫安哪，我因與你立約的血，將你中間被擄而囚的人從無水的坑中釋放出來。
verses.e: As for you also , because of the blood of your covenant , I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water .

verses.z: 你們被囚而有指望的人都要轉回保障。我今日說明，我必加倍賜福給你們。
verses.e: Turn to the stronghold , you prisoners of hope ! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you .

verses.z: 我拿猶大作上弦的弓；我拿以法蓮為張弓的箭。錫安哪，我要激發你的眾子，攻擊希臘的眾子，使你如勇士的刀。
verses.e: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me . I have loaded the bow with Ephraim . I will stir up your sons , Zion , against your sons , Greece , and will make you like the sword of a mighty man .

verses.z: 耶和華必顯現在他們以上；他的箭必射出像閃電。主耶和華必吹角，乘南方的旋風而行。
verses.e: The LORD will be seen over them . His arrow will flash like lightning . The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet , and will go with whirlwinds of the south .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華必保護他們；他們必吞滅[仇敵]，踐踏彈石。他們必喝[血]吶喊，猶如飲酒；他們必像盛滿[血]的碗，又像壇的四角滿了[血]。
verses.e: The LORD of Armies will defend them . They will destroy and overcome with sling stones . They will drink , and roar as through wine . They will be filled like bowls , like the corners of the altar .

verses.z: 當那日，耶和華－他們的上帝必看他的民如群羊，拯救他們；因為[他們必像]冠冕上的寶石，高舉在他的地以上。
verses.e: The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people ; for they are like the jewels of a crown , lifted on high over his land .

verses.z: 他的恩慈何等大！他的榮美何其盛！五穀健壯少男；新酒培養處女。
verses.e: For how great is his goodness , and how great is his beauty ! Grain will make the young men flourish , and new wine the virgins .

verses.z: 和靠近的哈馬，並泰爾、西頓；因為這二城的人大有智慧。
verses.e: and Hamath , also , which borders on it , Tyre and Sidon , because they are very wise .

verses.z: 泰爾為自己修築保障，積蓄銀子如塵沙，堆起精金如街上的泥土。
verses.e: Tyre built herself a stronghold , and heaped up silver like the dust , and fine gold like the mire of the streets .

verses.z: 主必趕出她，打敗她海上的權利；她必被火燒滅。
verses.e: Behold , the Lord will dispossess her , and he will strike her power in the sea ; and she will be devoured with fire .

verses.z: 亞實基倫看見必懼怕；迦薩看見甚痛苦；以革倫因失了盼望蒙羞。迦薩必不再有君王；亞實基倫也不再有居民。
verses.e: Ashkelon will see it , and fear ; Gaza also , and will writhe in agony ; as will Ekron , for her expectation will be disappointed ; and the king will perish from Gaza , and Ashkelon will not be inhabited .

verses.z: 私生子必住在亞實突；我必除滅非利士人的驕傲。
verses.e: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod , and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines .

verses.z: 我必除去他口中帶血之肉和牙齒內可憎之物。他必作為餘剩的人歸與我們的上帝，必在猶大像族長；以革倫人必如耶布斯人。
verses.e: I will take away his blood out of his mouth , and his abominations from between his teeth ; and he also will be a remnant for our God ; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah , and Ekron as a Jebusite .

verses.z: 我必在我家的四圍安營，使敵軍不得任意往來，暴虐的人也不再經過，因為我親眼看顧[我的家]。
verses.e: I will encamp around my house against the army , that no one pass through or return ; and no oppressor will pass through them any more : for now I have seen with my eyes .

verses.z: 錫安的民哪，應當大大喜樂；耶路撒冷的民哪，應當歡呼。看哪，你的王來到你這裏！他是公義的，並且施行拯救，謙謙和和地騎着驢，就是騎着驢的駒子。
verses.e: Rejoice greatly , daughter of Zion ! Shout , daughter of Jerusalem ! Behold , your King comes to you ! He is righteous , and having salvation ; lowly , and riding on a donkey , even on a colt , the foal of a donkey .

verses.z: 當猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞在位的時候，耶和華的話臨到希西家的玄孫，亞瑪利雅的曾孫，基大利的孫子，古示的兒子西番雅。
verses.e: The LORD's word which came to Zephaniah , the son of Cushi , the son of Gedaliah , the son of Amariah , the son of Hezekiah , in the days of Josiah , the son of Amon , king of Judah .

verses.z: 耶和華說：當那日，從魚門必發出悲哀的聲音，從二城發出哀號的聲音，從山間發出大破裂的響聲。
verses.e: In that day , says the LORD , there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate , a wailing from the second quarter , and a great crashing from the hills .

verses.z: 瑪革提施的居民哪，你們要哀號，因為迦南的商民都滅亡了！凡搬運銀子的都被剪除。
verses.e: Wail , you inhabitants of Maktesh , for all the people of Canaan are undone ! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off .

verses.z: 那時，我必用燈巡查耶路撒冷；我必懲罰那些[如酒]在渣滓上澄清的；他們心裏說：耶和華必不降福，也不降禍。
verses.e: It will happen at that time , that I will search Jerusalem with lamps , and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs , who say in their heart , " The LORD will not do good , neither will he do evil . "

verses.z: 他們的財寶必成為掠物；他們的房屋必變為荒場。他們必建造房屋，卻不得住在其內；栽種葡萄園，卻不得喝所出的酒。
verses.e: Their wealth will become a plunder , and their houses a desolation . Yes , they will build houses , but won't inhabit them . They will plant vineyards , but won't drink their wine .

verses.z: 耶和華的大日臨近，臨近而且甚快，乃是耶和華日子的風聲；勇士必痛痛地哭號。
verses.e: The great day of the LORD is near . It is near and hurries greatly , the voice of the day of the LORD . The mighty man cries there bitterly .

verses.z: 那日是忿怒的日子，是急難困苦的日子，是荒廢淒涼的日子，是黑暗幽冥、密雲烏黑的日子，
verses.e: That day is a day of wrath , a day of distress and anguish , a day of trouble and ruin , a day of darkness and gloom , a day of clouds and blackness ,

verses.z: 是吹角吶喊的日子，要攻擊堅固城和高大的城樓。
verses.e: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements .

verses.z: 我必使災禍臨到人身上，使他們行走如同瞎眼的，因為得罪了我。他們的血必倒出如灰塵；他們的肉必拋棄如糞土。
verses.e: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD . Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung .

verses.z: 當耶和華發怒的日子，他們的金銀不能救他們；他的忿怒如火必燒滅全地，毀滅這地的一切居民，而且大大毀滅。
verses.e: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD's wrath , but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy ; for he will make an end , yes , a terrible end , of all those who dwell in the land .

verses.z: 耶和華說：我必從地上除滅萬類。
verses.e: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth , says the LORD .

verses.z: 我必除滅人和牲畜，與空中的鳥、海裏的魚，以及絆腳石和惡人；我必將人從地上剪除。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: I will sweep away man and animal . I will sweep away the birds of the sky , the fish of the sea , and the heaps of rubble with the wicked . I will cut off man from the surface of the earth , says the LORD .

verses.z: 我必伸手攻擊猶大和耶路撒冷的一切居民，也必從這地方剪除所剩下的巴力，並基瑪林的名和祭司，
verses.e: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem . I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place — the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests ,

verses.z: 與那些在房頂上敬拜天上萬象的，並那些敬拜耶和華指着他起誓，又指着瑪勒堪起誓的，
verses.e: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops , those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam ,

verses.z: 與那些轉去不跟從耶和華的，和不尋求耶和華也不訪問他的。
verses.e: those who have turned back from following the LORD , and those who haven't sought the LORD nor inquired after him .

verses.z: 你要在主耶和華面前靜默無聲，因為耶和華的日子快到。耶和華已經預備祭物，將他的客分別為聖。
verses.e: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD , for the day of the LORD is at hand . For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice . He has consecrated his guests .

verses.z: 到了我－耶和華獻祭的日子，必懲罰首領和王子，並一切穿外邦衣服的。
verses.e: It will happen in the day of the LORD's sacrifice that I will punish the princes , the king's sons , and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing .

verses.z: 到那日，我必懲罰一切跳過門檻、將強暴和詭詐[得來之物]充滿主人房屋的。
verses.e: In that day , I will punish all those who leap over the threshold , who fill their master's house with violence and deceit .

verses.z: 不知羞恥的國民哪，你們應當聚集！趁命令沒有發出，日子過去如[風前的]糠，耶和華的烈怒未臨到你們，他發怒的日子未到以先，你們應當聚集前來。
verses.e: Gather yourselves together , yes , gather together , you nation that has no shame ,

verses.z: 這事臨到他們是因他們驕傲，自誇自大，毀謗萬軍之耶和華的百姓。
verses.e: This they will have for their pride , because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of Armies .

verses.z: 耶和華必向他們顯可畏之威，因他必叫世上的諸神瘦弱。列國海島的居民各在自己的地方敬拜他。
verses.e: The LORD will be awesome to them , for he will famish all the gods of the land . Men will worship him , everyone from his place , even all the shores of the nations .

verses.z: 古實人哪，你們必被我的刀所殺。
verses.e: You Cushites also , you will be killed by my sword .

verses.z: 耶和華必伸手攻擊北方，毀滅亞述，使尼尼微荒涼，又乾旱如曠野。
verses.e: He will stretch out his hand against the north , destroy Assyria , and will make Nineveh a desolation , as dry as the wilderness .

verses.z: 群畜，就是各國的走獸必臥在其中；鵜鶘和箭豬要宿在柱頂上。在窗戶內有鳴叫的聲音；門檻都必毀壞，香柏木已經露出。
verses.e: Herds will lie down in the middle of her , all kinds of animals . Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals . Their calls will echo through the windows . Desolation will be in the thresholds , for he has laid bare the cedar beams .

verses.z: 這是素來歡樂安然居住的城，心裏說：惟有我，除我以外再沒有別的；現在何竟荒涼成為野獸躺臥之處！凡經過的人都必搖手嗤笑她。
verses.e: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly , that said in her heart , " I am , and there is no one besides me . " How she has become a desolation , a place for animals to lie down in ! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists .
before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff , before the fierce anger of the LORD comes on you , before the day of the LORD's anger comes on you .

verses.z: 世上遵守耶和華典章的謙卑人哪，你們都當尋求耶和華！當尋求公義謙卑，或者在耶和華發怒的日子可以隱藏起來。
verses.e: Seek the LORD , all you humble of the land , who have kept his ordinances . Seek righteousness . Seek humility . It may be that you will be hidden in the day of the LORD's anger .

verses.z: 迦薩必致見棄；亞實基倫必然荒涼。人在正午必趕出亞實突的民；以革倫也被拔出根來。
verses.e: For Gaza will be forsaken , and Ashkelon a desolation . They will drive out Ashdod at noonday , and Ekron will be rooted up .

verses.z: 住沿海之地的基利提族有禍了！迦南、非利士人之地啊，耶和華的話與你反對，[說]：我必毀滅你，以致無人居住。
verses.e: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast , the nation of the Cherethites ! The LORD's word is against you , Canaan , the land of the Philistines . I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant .

verses.z: 沿海之地要變為草場，其上有牧人的住處和羊群的圈。
verses.e: The sea coast will be pastures , with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks .

verses.z: 這地必為猶大家剩下的人所得；他們必在那裏牧放[群羊]，晚上必躺臥在亞實基倫的房屋中；因為耶和華－他們的上帝必眷顧他們，使他們被擄的人歸回。
verses.e: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah . They will find pasture . In the houses of Ashkelon , they will lie down in the evening , for the LORD , their God , will visit them and restore them .

verses.z: 我聽見摩押人的毀謗和亞捫人的辱罵，就是毀謗我的百姓，自誇自大，侵犯他們的境界。
verses.e: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon , with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border .

verses.z: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝說：我指着我的永生起誓：摩押必像所多瑪，亞捫人必像蛾摩拉，都變為刺草、鹽坑、永遠荒廢之地。我百姓所剩下的必擄掠他們；我國中所餘剩的必得着他們的地。
verses.e: Therefore , as I live , says the LORD of Armies , the God of Israel , surely Moab will be as Sodom , and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah , a possession of nettles and salt pits , and a perpetual desolation . The remnant of my people will plunder them , and the survivors of my nation will inherit them .

verses.z: 這悖逆、污穢、欺壓的城有禍了！
verses.e: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted , the oppressing city !

verses.z: 祈禱我的，就是我所分散的民，必從古實河外來，給我獻供物。
verses.e: From beyond the rivers of Cush , my worshipers , even the daughter of my dispersed people , will bring my offering .

verses.z: 當那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事自覺羞愧；因為那時我必從你中間除掉矜誇高傲之輩，你也不再於我的聖山狂傲。
verses.e: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me ; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones , and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain .

verses.z: 我卻要在你中間留下困苦貧寒的民；他們必投靠我－耶和華的名。
verses.e: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people , and they will take refuge in the LORD's name .

verses.z: 以色列所剩下的人必不作罪孽，不說謊言，口中也沒有詭詐的舌頭；而且吃喝躺臥，無人驚嚇。
verses.e: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies , neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth , for they will feed and lie down , and no one will make them afraid . "

verses.z: 錫安的民哪，應當歌唱！以色列啊，應當歡呼！耶路撒冷的民哪，應當滿心歡喜快樂！
verses.e: Sing , daughter of Zion ! Shout , Israel ! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart , daughter of Jerusalem .

verses.z: 耶和華已經除去你的刑罰，趕出你的仇敵。以色列的王－耶和華在你中間；你必不再懼怕災禍。
verses.e: The LORD has taken away your judgments . He has thrown out your enemy . The King of Israel , the LORD , is among you . You will not be afraid of evil any more .

verses.z: 當那日，必有話向耶路撒冷說：不要懼怕！錫安哪；不要手軟！
verses.e: In that day , it will be said to Jerusalem , " Don't be afraid , Zion . Don't let your hands be weak . "

verses.z: 耶和華－你的上帝是施行拯救、大有能力的[主]。他在你中間必因你歡欣喜樂，默然愛你，且因你喜樂而歡呼。
verses.e: The LORD , your God , is among you , a mighty one who will save . He will rejoice over you with joy . He will calm you in his love . He will rejoice over you with singing .

verses.z: 那些屬你、為無大會愁煩、因你擔當羞辱的，我必聚集他們。
verses.e: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you . They are a burden and a reproach to you .

verses.z: 那時，我必罰辦一切苦待你的人，又拯救你瘸腿的，聚集你被趕出的。那些在全地受羞辱的，我必使他們得稱讚，有名聲。
verses.e: Behold , at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you ; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away . I will give them praise and honor , whose shame has been in all the earth .

verses.z: 她不聽從命令，不領受訓誨，不倚靠耶和華，不親近她的上帝。
verses.e: She didn't obey the voice . She didn't receive correction . She didn't trust in the LORD . She didn't draw near to her God .

verses.z: 那時，我必領你們進來，聚集你們；我使你們被擄之人歸回的時候，就必使你們在地上的萬民中有名聲，得稱讚。這是耶和華說的。
verses.e: At that time I will bring you in , and at that time I will gather you ; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes , says the LORD .

verses.z: 她中間的首領是咆哮的獅子；她的審判官是晚上的豺狼，一點[食物]也不留到早晨。
verses.e: Her princes within her are roaring lions . Her judges are evening wolves . They leave nothing until the next day .

verses.z: 她的先知是虛浮詭詐的人；她的祭司褻瀆聖所，強解律法。
verses.e: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people . Her priests have profaned the sanctuary . They have done violence to the law .

verses.z: 耶和華在她中間是公義的，斷不做非義的事，每早晨顯明他的公義，無日不然；只是不義的人不知羞恥。
verses.e: The LORD , within her , is righteous . He will do no wrong . Every morning he brings his justice to light . He doesn't fail , but the unjust know no shame .

verses.z: 我－[耶和華]已經除滅列國的民；他們的城樓毀壞。我使他們的街道荒涼，以致無人經過；他們的城邑毀滅，以致無人，也無居民。
verses.e: I have cut off nations . Their battlements are desolate . I have made their streets waste , so that no one passes by . Their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , so that there is no inhabitant .

verses.z: 我說：你只要敬畏我，領受訓誨；如此，你的住處不致照我所擬定的除滅。只是你們從早起來就在一切事上敗壞自己。
verses.e: I said , " Just fear me . Receive correction , " so that her dwelling won't be cut off , according to all that I have appointed concerning her . But they rose early and corrupted all their doings .

verses.z: 耶和華說：你們要等候我，直到我興起擄掠的日子；因為我已定意招聚列國，聚集列邦，將我的惱怒－就是我的烈怒都傾在她們身上。我的忿怒如火，必燒滅全地。
verses.e: " Therefore wait for me " , says the LORD , " until the day that I rise up to the prey , for my determination is to gather the nations , that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation , even all my fierce anger , for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy .

verses.z: 那時，我必使萬民用清潔的言語好求告[我]－耶和華的名，同心合意地事奉我。
verses.e: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples , that they may all call on the LORD's name , to serve him shoulder to shoulder .
